1: Adam, Seth, Enosh;
Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared;
Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech;
Noah, Shem, Ham, na Japheth.
Japheth ne mba; Gomer, na Magog, na Madai, na Javan, na Tubal, na Meshech, na Tiras.
Na Gomer ne mba; Ashkenaz, na Diphath, na Togarmah.
Na Javan ne mba; Elishah, na Tarshish, Kittim, na Rodanim.
Ham ne mba; Cush, na Mizraim, Put, na Canaan.
Na Cush ne mba; Seba, na Havilah, na Sabta, na Raamah, na Sabteca. Na Raamah ne mba; Sheba, na Dedan.
Na Cush woo Nimrod: Ɔno na ɔhyɛɛ ase yɛɛ otumfo wɔ asaase do.
Na Mizraim woo Ludim, naa Anamim, na Lehabim, na Naphtuhim,
na Pathrusim, na Casluhim (a Philistia fo fi hɔn mu bae no), na Caphtorim.
Na Canaan woo n'abakan Zidon, na Heth;
na Jebusnyi, na Amorinyi, na Girgashnyi;
na Hivinyi, na Arknyi, na Sinnyi;
na Arvadnyi na Zemarnyi, na Hamathanyi.
Shem ne mba; Elam, na Asshur, na Arpachshad, na Lud, na Aram, na Uz, na Hul, na Gether, na Meshech.
Na Arpachshad woo Shelah, na Shelah woo Eber.
Na wɔwoo mba beenu maa Eber: Ɔbaako ne dzin dze Peleg; na ne nda no mu no nna asaase paae; na no nua dzin dze Joktan.
Na Joktan woo Almodad, na Sheleph, na Hazarmaveth, na Jerah;
na Hadoram, na Uzal, na Diklah;
na Ebal, na Abimael, na Sheba;
na Ophir, na Havilah, na Jobab. Iyinom nyinara nye Joktan ne mba.
Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah;
Eber, Peleg, Reu;
Serug, Nahor, Terah;
Abram (Ɔnoara nye Abraham).
Abraham ne mba; Isaac, na Ishmael.
Iyinom nye hɔn mbasantsen: Ishmael n'abakan, Nebaioth; nna Kedar, na Adbeel, na Mibsam,
Mishma, na Dumah, Massa; Hadad, na Tema,
Jetur, Naphish, na Kedemah. Iyinom nye Ishmael ne mba.
Abraham no nwewe Keturah ne mba: Ɔwoo Zimran, na Jokshan, na Medan, na Midian, na Ishbak, na Shuah. Na Jokshan ne mba; Sheba, na Dedan.
Na Midian ne mba; Ephah, na Epher, na Hanoch, na Abida, na Eldaah Iyinom nyinara nye Keturah ne mba.
Na Abraham woo Isaac. Isaac ne mba; Esau, na Israel.
Esau ne mba; Eliphaz, Reuel, na Jeush, na Jalam, na Korah.
Eliphaz ne mba; Teman, na Omar, Zephi, na Gatam, Kenaz, na Timna, na Amalek.
Reuel ne mba; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, na Mizzah.
Seir ne mba; Lotan na Shobal na Zibeon na Anah, na Dishon na Ezer na Dishan.
Na Lotan ne mba; Hori na Honam; na Timna yɛ Lotan n'akyerɛbaa.
Shobal ne mba; Alian na Manahath na Ebal, Shephi na Onam. Na Zibeon ne mba; Aiah na Anah.
Anah ne mba; Dishon. Na Dishon ne mba; Hamran na Eshban na Ithran na Cheran.
Ezer ne mba; Bilhan na Zaavan, Jaakan. Dishan ne mba; Uz na Aran.
Afei ahemfo a wodzii hen wɔ Edom asaase do, ansaana ɔhen biara ridzi Israelmba do hen no nye woyinom: Beor ne ba Bela; na no kurow dzin dze Dinhabah.
Na Bela wui, na Zerah a ofi Bozrah ne ba Jobab bedzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Na Jobab wui, na Husham a ofi Temanfo hɔn asaase do no bedzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Na Husham wui, na Hadad ne ba Bedad a okum Midian wɔ Moab haban mu no ne ba no, bedzii hen wɔ n'ananmu: Na no kurow dzin dze Avith.
Na Hadad wui, na Samlah a ofi Masrekah bedzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Na Samlah wui, na Shaul a ofi Rehoboth a ɔwɔ Esutsen no ho no bedzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Na Shaul wui, na Achbor ne ba Baalhanan bedzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Na Baal-hanan wui, na Hadad bedzii hen wɔ n'ananmu; na no kurow dzin dze Pai: Na ne yer ne dzin dze Mehetabel, Mezahab ne babaa, Matred ne babaa a.
Na Hadad wui. Na Edom ekunyin nye yi; okunyin Timna, okunyin Aliah, okunyin Jetheth;
okunyin Oholibamah, okunyin Elah, okunyin pinon;
okunyin Kenaz, okunyin Magdiel, okunin Iram. Wonyinom nye Edom ekunyin.
2: Woyinom nye Israel ne mba; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, na Judah, Issachar na Zebulum;
Dan, Joseph na Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad na Asher.
Judah ne mba; Er, na Onan, na Shelah: Baasa yi na Canaannyi Bathshua woo hɔn maa no no. Na Judah n'abakan Er, ɔyɛɛ nyimpa bɔn wɔ Ewuradze enyim; na okum no.
Na n'asew Tamar woo Perez na Zerah maa no. Judah ne mba nyinara wɔyɛ beenum.
Perez ne mba; Hezron na Hamul.
Zerah ne mba; Zimri, na Ethan, na Heman, na Calcol, na Dara: Hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ beenum.
Na Carmi ne mba; Achar, Israel hɔn hawfo no a ɔtõo mbra wɔ adze a woehyira do no ho no.
Na Ethan ne mba; Azariah.
Hezron so ne mba a wɔwoo hɔn maa no; Jerahmeel, na Ram, na Chelubai.
Na Ram woo Amminadab, na Amminadab woo Nahson; Judahmba mu bapɔmba no;
na Nahshon woo Salma, na Salma woo Boaz;
na Boaz woo Obed, na Obed woo Jesse;
na Jesse woo n'abakan Eliab, na otsīa ebien Abinadab, na otsīa ebiasa Shimea;
otsīa anan Nethanel, otsīa enum Raddai;
otsīa esia Ozem, otsīa esuon David;
na hɔn nkyerɛbaa nye Zeruiah na Abigail. Na Zeruiah na mba; Abishai, na Joab, na Asahel, baasa.
Na Abigail woo Amasa: Na Amasa n'egya nye Ishmaelnyi Jether.
Na Hezron ne ba Caleb nye ne yer Azubah, na Jerioth wowoo mba: Na ne mba nye yinom; Jesher, na Shobab, na Ardon.
Na Azubah wui, na Caleb faa Ephrath waar no, na ɔwoo Hur maa no.
Na Hur woo Uri, na Uri woo Bezalel.
Na n'ekyir no Hezron kɔr Gilead n'egya Machir ne babaa nkyɛn; ɔno na ɔfaa no waar no aber a oedzi mfe eduosia; na ɔwoo Segub maa no.
Na Segub woo Jair a onyaa Gilead asaase do nkurow eduonu ebiasa no.
Na Geshur na Aram gyee Jair nkurow no wɔ hɔn nsamu, nye Kenath, na no nkurobaase, mekyerɛ nkurow eduosia. Woyinom nyinara Gilead n'egya Machir ne mba a.
Na Hezron wui wɔ Caleb-ephrathah no, nna Hezron ne yer Abijah woo Tekoa n'egya Ashhur maa no.
Na Hezron n'abakan Jerahmeel ne mba nye abakan Ram na Bunah, na Oren, na Ozem, Ahijah.
Na Jerahmeel wɔ yer kor so a ne dzin dze Atarah; ɔno nye Onam ne nã.
Na Jerahmeel n'abakan Ram ne mba nye Maaz, na Jamin, na Eker.
Na Onam ne mba nye Shammai na Jada: Na Shammai ne mba; Nadab na Abishur.
Na Abishur ne yer ne dzin dze Abihail; na ɔwoo Ahban, na Molid maa no.
Na Nadab ne mba; Seled, na Appaim: Na Seled wui dɛ oennya mba.
Na Appaim ne mba; Ishi. Na Ishi ne mba; Sheshan. Na Sheshan ne mba; Ahlai.
Na Shammai no nua Jada ne mba; Jether, na Jonathan; na Jether wui dɛ oennya mba.
Na Jonathan ne mba; Peleth na Zaza. Woyinom nye Jerahmeel ne mba.
Afei Sheshan nnyi mbabanyin, gyedɛ mbabaa. Na Sheshan nyaa akowaa, Egyptnyi ni a ne dzin dze Jarha.
Na Sheshan dze ne babaa maa n'akowaa Jarha ayewar; na ɔwoo Attai maa no.
Na Attai woo Nathan, na Nathan woo Zabad;
Na Zabad woo Ephlal, na Ephla woo Obed;
na Obed woo Jehu, na Jehu woo Azariah;
na Azariah woo Helez, na Helez woo Eleasah;
na Eleasah woo Sismai, na Sismai woo Shallum;
na Shallum woo Jekamiah na Jekamiah woo Elishama.
Na Jerahmeel no nua Caleb ne mba nye n'abakan Mesha a ɔyɛ Ziph n'egya no; na Hebron n'egya Mareshah ne mba; no. 43, Na Hebron ne mba; Korah, na Tappuah, na Rakem, na Shema.
Na Shema woo Raham, Jorkeam n'egya no; na Rekem woo Shammai.
Na Shammai ne ba nye Maon; na Maon yɛ Beth-zur n'egya.
Na Caleb no nwewe Ephah woo Haran, na Moza, na Gazez: Na Haran woo Gazez.
Na Jahdai ne mba; Regem, na Jotham, na Geshan, na Pelet, na Ephah, na Shaaph.
Caleb no nwewe Maacah woo Sheber na Tirhanan.
Eso ɔwoo Shaaph, Madmannah n'egya, Sheva Machbena n'egya, na Gibea n'egya; na Caleb ne babaa nye Achsah.
Woyinom nye Caleb ne mba; Ephrathah n'abakan, Hur ne ba no, Kiriath-jearim n'egya Shobal;
Beth-lehem n'egya Salma, Bethgader n'egya Hareph.
Na Kiriath-jearim n'egya Shobal nyaa mba; Haroeh, Menuhoth ɔfã.
Na Kiriath-jearim n'ebusuafo; Ithrifo, na Puthfo, na Shumathfo, na Mishrafo; hɔn mu na Zorathfo na Eshtaolfo; no fi bae.
Salma ne mba; Bethlehem, na Netophathfo, Atroth-beth-Joab, na Manahathfo ɔfã, Zorfo no.
Na kyerɛwfo a wɔtse Jabez hɔn ebusuafo no; Tirathfo, Shimeathfo, Sucathfo. Woyinom nye Kenifo a wofi Rechab fie egya, Hammath, mu bae no.
3: Afei woyinom nye David ne mba a wɔwoo hɔn maa no wɔ Hebron: Abakan, Amnon a ɔnye Jezreelnyi Ahinoam woo no no; otsīa ebien, Daniel a ɔnye Carmelnyi Abigail woo no no;
otsīa ebiasa, Absalom, Geshurhen Talmai ne babaa Maacah ba no; otsīa anan, Adonijiah, Haggith ba no;
otsīa enum, Shephatiah a ɔnye Abital woo no; otsīa esia, Ithream a ɔnye ne yer Eglah woo no.
Beesia na wɔwoo hɔn maa no wɔ Hebron; na hɔ na odzii hen mfe esuon na abosoom esia: Na Jerusalem na odzii hen mfe eduasa ebiasa.
Na wonyinom na wɔwoo hɔn maa no wɔ Jerusalem: Shimea, na Shobab, na Nathan, na Solomon, baanan, ɔnye Ammiel ne babaa Bathshua woo hɔn:
Na Ibhar, na Elishama, na Eliphelet;
na Nogah, na Nepheg, na Japhia;
na Elishama, na Eliada, na Eliphelet, baakron.
Woyinom nyinara wɔyɛ David ne mba, ɔsor nwewefo mba no; na hɔn akyerɛbaa nye Tamar.
Na Solomon ne ba nye Rehoboam, ne ba nye Abijah, ne ba nye Asa, ne ba nye Jehoshaphat;
ne ba nye Joram, ne ba nye Ahaziah, ne ba nye Joash;
ne ba nye Amaziah, ne ba nye Azariah, ne ba nye Jotham;
ne ba nye Ahaz, ne ba nye Hezekiah, ne ba nye Menasseh;
ne ba nye Amon ne ba nye Josiah.
Josiah ne mba; n'abakan no Johanan, otsīa ebien no Jehoiakim, otsīa ebiasa no Zedekiah, otsīa anan no Shallum.
Na Jehoiakim ne mba ne ba Jeconiah, ne ba Zedekiah.
Na Jeconiah ndɔmmumnyi no ne mba; ne ba Shealtiel.
na Malchiram, na Pedaiah, na Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, na Nedabiah.
Na Pedaiah ne mba; Zerubbabel, na Shimei: Na Zerubbabel ne mba; Meshullam, na Hananiah; na Shelomith nye hɔn akyerɛbaa:
Na Hashubah, na Ohel, na Berechiah, na Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, beenum.
Na Hananiah ne mba; Pelatiah, na Jeshaiah: Rephaiah ne mba, Arnan ne mba, Obadiah ne mba, Arnan ne mba, Obadiah ne mba, Shecaniah ne mba.
Na Shecaniah ne mba; Shemaiah na Shemaiah ne mba; Hattush, na Igal, na Bariah, na Neariah, na Shaphat, esia.
Na Neariah ne mba; Elioenai, na Hizkiah, na Azrikam, baasa.
Na Elioenai ne mba; Hodaviah, na Eliashib, na Pelaiah, na Akkub, na Johanan, na Delaiah, na Anani, beesuon.
4: Judah ne mba; Perez Hezron, na Carmi, na Hur, na Shobal.
Na Shobal ne ba Reaiah woo Jahath; na Jahath woo Ahumai na Lahad. Wonyinom nye Zorathfo ebusuafo.
Na woyinom nye Etam n'egya ne mba; Jezreel, na Ishma, na Idbash: Na hɔn akyerɛbaa de dzin dze Hazzelelponi:
Na Gedor n'egya Penuel, na Hushah n'egya Ezer. Woyinom nye Beth-lehem n'egya Ephrathah, n'abakan Hur ne mba.
Na Tekoa n'egya Ashhur wɔ yernom beenu, Helah na Naarah.
Na Naarah woo Ahuzzam, na Hepher, na Temeni, na Haahashtari maa no. Woyinom nye Naarah ne mba.
Na Helah ne mba nye Zereth, Izhar, na Ethnan.
Na Hakkoz woo Anub, na Zobebah, na Harum ne ba Aharhel n'ebusuafo.
Na Jabez nyaa enyimnyam seen no nuanom: Na ne nã frɛɛ ne dzin Jabez, see dɛ, medze yaw na mowoo no.

Na Jabez frɛɛ Israel Nyankopɔn, see dɛ, ao nkyɛ edze nhyira ara eehyira me, na aatrɛ me he mu, na wo nsa edzi m'ekyir, na nkyɛ eesie me efi mbusu ho, ma ɔammbɛyɛ me yaw! Na Nyankopɔn doom no dza obisae no.
Na Shuhah no nua Chelub woo Mehir a ɔyɛ Eshton n'egya ho.
Na Eshton woo Beth-raphia, na Paseah, na Ir-nahash n'egya Tehinah. Wonyinom nye Recah nkorɔfo.
Na Kenaz ne mba; Othniel, na Seraiah: Na Othniel ne mba; Hathath.
Na Meonothai woo Ophrah: Na Seraiah woo Ge-harashim n'egya Joab; na wɔyɛ edwimfo.
Na Jephunneh ne ba caleb ne mba; Iru, Elah, na Naam: Na Elah ne mba : Na Kenaz.
Jehallelel ne mba; Ziph, na Ziphah, Tiria, na Asarel.
Na Ezrah ne mba; Jether, na Mered, na Epher, na Jalon na: Na ɔwoo Miriam, na Shammai, na Eshtemoa n'egya Ishbah.
Na ne yer Judahnyi no woo Gedor n'egya Jered, na Soco n'egya Heber, na Zanoah n'egya Jekuthiel. Na wonyinom nye Pharaoh ne babaa Bithiah a Mered faa no waar no no me mba.
Na Hodiah ne yer, Naham n'akyerɛbaa no, ne mba ne Marminyi Keilah, na Maacathnyi Eshtemoa hɔn egya.
Na Shimon ne mba; Ammon, na Rinnah, Benhanan, na Tilon. Na Ishi ne mba; Zoheth, na Ben-zoheth.
Judah ne ba Sheiah ne mba; Lecah n'egya Er, na Mareshah n'egya Laadah, na hɔn a wodzi ndwera fɛɛfɛw edwin hɔn fie ebusuafo, wofi Ashbea fie;
na Jokim, na Cozeba mbarimba, na Joash, na Saraph a wɔwɔ tum wɔ Moab, na Jashubi-lehem. Na kyerɛwee no yɛ tsetse dze.
Woyinom nye awemfo, na Netaim na Gederah ekuromfo: Hɔ na wɔnye ɔhen no tsenae wɔ n'edwuma no ntsi.
Simeon ne mba; Nemuel, na Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul:
Ne ba Shallum, ne ba Mibsam, ne ba Mishma.
Na Mishma ne mba; ne ba Hammuel, ne ba Zaccur, ne ba Shimei.
Na Shimei nyaa mbabanyin duesia na mbabaa esia; na no nuanom no dze woennya mba pii, nkyii so hɔn ebusua nyinara anndɔr, dɛ Judahmba.
Na wɔtsenaa Beer-sheeba, na Moladah, na Hazarshual;
na Bilhah, na Ezem, na Tolad;
na Bethuel, na Hormah, na Ziklag;
na Beth-marcaboth, na Hazar-susim, na Beth-biri, na Shaaraim. Iyinom nye hɔn nkurow dze bodu David n'ahendzi do.
na hɔn nkuroba nye Etam, na Ain, Rimmon, na Tochen, na Ashan, nkurow enum:
Na hɔn nkuroba nyinara wɔabɔ nkurow no ara ho aprɔw dze kodu Baal. Iyinom nye hɔn tsenabew, na wɔwɔ hɔn ananakan.
Na Meshoba, na Jamlech, na Amaziah ne ba Joshah;
na Joel, na Jehu, Joshibiah ne ba no, Seraiah ne ba no, Asiel ne ba no,
na Elioenai, na Jaakobah, na Jeshohaiah, na Asaiah, na Adeil, na Jeshohaiah, na Asaiah, na Adiel, na Jesimiel, na Benaiah;
na Ziza, Shiphi ne ba no, Allon ne ba no, Jedaiah ne ba no, Shimri ne ba no, Shemaiah ne ba no;
woyinom a wɔabobɔ hɔn edzin yi wɔyɛ mbapɔmba wɔ hɔn ebusua ebusua mu: Na hɔn egyanom efiefi trɛɛ kɛsenara.
Na osii mu kɔr mbrɛ wɔnam kɔ Gedor ahɛnee, mekyerɛ ɔbɔn no no boka afamu, dɛ wɔrokɔhwehwɛ edzidzibea ama hɔn nguankuw.
Na wohun edzidzibea frɔmfrɔm a oye, na asaase no mu trɛ, no do dwe komm; na hɔn a nkyɛ nkan no wɔtsetse hɔ no wofi Ham mu.

Na woyinom a wɔabobɔ dzin akyerɛw no bae wɔ Judahhen Hezekiah ne nda no mu, na wɔkɔbobɔɔ hɔn asesee, na Meunim a wohun no hɔ no, na wɔsɛɛ hɔn pasapasa, dze bodu ndɛ da yi, na wɔtsenatsenaa hɔn ananmu: Osiandɛ edzidzibea wɔ hɔ ma hɔn nguankuw.
Na hɔn mu binom, mekyerɛ Simeon ne mba no mu, mbarimba ahaenum, sii mu kɔr bepɔw Seir do, na hɔn asafohemfo nye Pelatiah, na Neariah, na Rephaiah, na Uzziel, Ishi mba no.
Na wokunkum Amalekfo nkaa a wofii nsa guanee no, na wɔtsenaa hɔ dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
5: Na Israel n'abakan Reuben ne mba, (na ɔnoara nye abakan dze, na susuampa dɛ oguu n'egya n'adaa ho fī ntsi, wɔdze n'abakan ndzinoa maa Israel ne ba Joseph ne mba no; na ananakan no so woemmbu ano wɔ abakan ndzinoa no do.
Osiandɛ Judah dzii no nuanom do nyim, na ɔbapɔmba no fii no mu bae; na abakan ndzinoa no dze ɔyɛɛ Joseph dze);
Israel n'abakan Reuben ne mba; Hanoch, na Pallu, Hezron, na Carmi.
Joel ne mba; ne ba Shemaiah, ne ba Gog, ne ba Shimei;
ne ba Micah, ne ba Reaiah, ne ba Baal:
Ne ba Beerah a Assyriahen Tilgath-pilneser faa no ndɔmmum kɔree no: Ɔno nye Reubenfo mu bapɔmba.
Na no nuanom dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, wɔ aber a woruba hɔn ebusuasantsen ananakan ano no nye yi; otsitsir Jeiel, na Zechariah,
na Bela Azaz ne ba no, Shema ne ba no, Joel ne ba no a ɔtsenaa Aroer araa dze kodur Nebo na Baal-meon ho:
Na boka afamu so ɔtsenae araa dze kodur sar no n'ahɛnee a ofi esutsen Euphrates ho: Osiandɛ hɔn mbowakuw dɔree wɔ Gilead asaase do.
Na Saul ne nda no mu no ɔnye Hagrifo dzii akõ, ma wɔtotɔr hɔn nsaano: Na wɔtsenatsenaa hɔn asesee mu wɔ Gilead boka afamu asaase no do nyinara.
Na Gadmba no tsenaa hɔn tsentsendo, wɔ Bashan asaase do dze kodur Salecah:
Joel dzi kan, na Shapham dzi hɔ, na Janai, na Shapham dzi hɔ, na Janai, na Shaphat wɔ Bashan:
Na hɔn nuanom a wofi hɔn egyanom efiefi nye yi; Michael, na Meshullam, na Sheba, na Jorai, na Jacan, na Zia, na Eber, beesuon.
Woyinom nye Abihail, Huri ne ba no, Jaroah ne ba no, Gilead ne ba no, Michael ne ba no, Jeshishai ne ba no, Jahdo ne ba no, Buz ne ba no, ne mba;
Ahi, Abdiel ne ba no, Guni ne ba no, hɔn egyanom efiefi do otsitsir.
Na wɔtsenaa Gilead wɔ Bashan, na no nkuroba mu, na Sharon no nkurotsia nyinara araa dze kodur hɔn ahe do.
Iyinom nyinara wobuu ano ananakan do wɔ Judahhen Jotham ne nda no mu, na Israelhen Jeroboam ne nda nda no mu.

Reuben ne mba, na Gadfo, na Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no, nyimpa ndandamfo mu, mbarimba a wokitsa kyɛm na afõwa, na wɔtow egyen, na wonyim ɔsa yɛ no, wɔyɛ nyimpa mpemanan ahaesuon eduosia a wotum dɛ wotu kɔ ɔsa.
Na wɔnye Hagrifo, nye Jetur, na Naphish, na Nodab dzii akõ.
Na wɔboaa hɔn ma wɔfaa hɔn do, na wɔdze Hagrifo no, na hɔn a wɔkã hɔn ho no nyinara, hyɛɛ hɔn nsa: Osiandɛ wɔtsēaa mu frɛɛ Nyame wɔ ɔkõ no mu, na otsiee hɔn; osiandɛ wɔdze hɔn werɛ tweer no.
Na wɔfaa hɔn mbowakuw kɔree; hɔn efumpɔnkɔ mu mpemeduonum, na nguan mu mpemahaenueduonum, na nsoaso mu mpemebien, na nyimpa mu mpemɔha.
Na piigyan hwee ase totɔree, osiandɛ ɔsa no ofi Nyame hɔ. Na wɔtsenatsenaa hɔn ananmu dze kodur ndɔmmumkɔ no mu.
Na Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no mba no tsenaa asaase no do; na wɔdɔree fi Bashan dze kodur Baal-hermon na Senir na bepɔw Hermon ho.

Na woyinom nye hɔn egyanom efi efi do etsitsir; mekyerɛ Epher, na Ishi, na Eliel, na Azriel, na Jeremiah, na Hodaviah, na Jahdiel, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, nyimpa a wɔwɔ dzin egyanom efiefi do etsitsir.
Na wɔfoom hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn, na wokedzii asaase no do aman a Nyankopɔn sɛɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn enyim no ekyir wɔ ndwamanyɛ mu.

Na Israel Nyankopɔn bɔɔ Assyriahen Pul no sunsum nkenyan, na Assyriahen Tilgath-pilneser no sunsum, na ɔfaa hɔn kɔree, mekyerɛ Reubenfo, na Gadfo, na Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no, na wɔdze hɔn baa Halah, na Habor, na Hara, na esutsen Gozan ho, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
6: Levi ne mba; Gershon, Kohath, na Merari.
Na Kohath ne mba; Amram, Izhar, na Hebron, na Uzziel.
Na Amram ne mba; Aaron, na Moses, na Miriam. Na Aaron ne mba; Nadab na Abihu, Eleazar na Ithamar.
Eleazar woo Phinehas, Phinehas woo Abishua;
na Abishua woo Bukki, na Bukki woo Uzzi;
na Uzzi woo Zerahiah, na Zerahiah woo Meraioth;
Meraioth woo Amariah, na Amariah woo Ahitub;
na Ahitub woo Zadok, na Zadok woo Ahimaaz;
na Ahimaaz woo Azariah, na Azariah woo Johanan;
na Johanan woo Azariah, (ɔno nye nyia odzii sɔfo wɔ dan no a Solomon sii no wɔ Jerusalem no mu no):
Na Azariah woo Amariah, na Amariah woo Ahitub;
na Ahitub woo Zadok, na Zadok woo Shallum;
na Shallum woo Hilkiah, na Hilkiah woo Azariah;
na Azariah woo Seraiah, na Seraiah woo Jehozadak;
na Jehozadak kɔr ndɔmmumyɛ mu wɔ aber a Ewuradze nam Nebuchadnezzar nsa do faa Judah na Jerusalem kɔree no.
Levi ne mba; Gershom, Kohath, na Merari.
Na iyinom nye Gershom mba no hɔn edzin; Libni na Shimei.
Na Kohath ne mba nye Amram, na Izhar, na Hebron, na Uzziel.
Merari ner mba; Mahli na Mushi. Na iyinom nye Levifo ebusua ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi efi tsetsee.
Gershom dze; ne ba Libni, ne ba Jahath, ne ba Zimmah;
ne ba Joah ne ba Iddo, ne ba Zerah, ne ba Jeatherai.
Kohath ne mba; ne ba Aminadab, ne ba Korah, ne ba Assir;
ne ba Elkanah, na ne ba Eliasaph, na ne ba Assir;
ne ba Tahath, ne ba Uriel, ne ba Uzziah, na ne ba Shaul.
Na Elkanah ne mba; Amasai, na Ahimoth.
Elkanah dze: Elkanah ne mba; ne ba Zophai, na ne ba Nahath;
ne ba Eliab, ne ba Jeroham, ne ba Elkanah.
Na Samuel ne mba; abakan Joel, na otsīa ebien Abijah.
Merari ne mba; Mahli, ne ba Libni, ne ba Shimei, ne ba Uzzah;
ne ba Shimea, ne ba Haggiah, ne ba Asaiah.
Na woyinom nye hɔn a David dze hɔn sisii Ewuradze fie ndwom edwuma do, ofi ber a adaka no nyaa ahomgye no.
Na wɔdze ndwom soom wɔ ehyiadzibuw no ne ntamadan no enyim, dze kodur dɛ Solomon sii Ewuradze ne fi no wɔ Jerusalem: A wogyinagyinaa hɔn som no mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn akyenan tsetsee.
Na woyinom nye hɔn a wogyinae no, na hɔn mba no. Kohathfo no mba no mu: Ɔdwontofo Heman, Joel ne ba no, Samuel ne ba no;
Elkanah ne ba no, Jeroham ne ba no, Eliel ne ba no, Toah ne ba no;
Zuph ne ba no, Elkanah ne ba no, Mahath ne ba no, Amasai ne ba no;
Elkanah ne ba no, Joel ne ba no, Azariah ne ba no, Zephaniah ne ba no;
Tahath ne ba no, Assir ne ba no, Ebiasaph ne ba no, Korah ne ba no;
Izhar ne ba no, Kohath ne ba no, Levi ne ba no, Israel ne ba no.
Na no nua Asaph a ogyinaa ne nsa enyimfa no, mekyerɛ Asaph, Berechiah ne ba no, Shimea ne ba no;
Michael ne ba no, Baaseiah ne ba no, Malchijah ne ba no;
Ethni ne ba no, Zerah ne ba no, Adaiah ne ba no;
Ethan ne ba no, Zimmah ne ba no, Shimei ne ba no,
Jahath ne ba no, Gershom ne ba no, Levi ne ba no.
Na abankum afamu hɔn nuanom Merari: Ethan, Kishi ne ba no, Abdi ne ba no, Malluch ne ba no;
Hashabiah ne ba no, Amaziah ne ba no, Hilkiah ne ba no;
Amzi ne ba no, Bani ne ba no, Shemer ne ba no;
Mahli ne ba no, Mushi ne ba no, Merari ne ba no, Levi ne ba no,
Naa hɔn nuanom Levifo no wɔdze hɔn maa Nyankopɔn ne fi ntamadan ho som nyinara.

Na Aaron na ne mba na wɔbɔɔ afɔr wɔ ɔhyew afɔrmbukyia no, na eduhuam afɔrmbukyia no do, wɔdze maa bea krɔnkrɔn edwuma no nyinara, na wɔpatae maa Israel, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn n'akowaa Moses hyɛe no nyinara.
Na woyinom nye Aaron ne mba; ne ba Eleazar, ne ba Phinehas, ne ba Abishua;
ne ba Bukki, ne ba Uzzi, ne ba Zerahiah;
ne ba Meraioth, ne ba Amariah, ne ba Ahitub;
ne ba Zadok, ne ba Ahimaaz.
Afei iyinom nye hɔn tsenabea horow dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nseraban tsetsee wɔ hɔn ahe do: Aaronmba no a wofi Kohathfo ebusua mu no nyaa hɔn kyɛfa, osiandɛ hɔndze no nye tonto a odzi kan,
hɔn na wɔmaa hɔn Hebron a ɔwɔ Judah asaase do, na no nkurotsia-asaase a ɔabɔ ho aprɔw no;
na kurow no ne haban, na no nkurobaase no dze, wɔdze maa Jephunneh ne ba Caleb.
Na wɔdze guansumabew nkurow no maa Aaron ne mba no, guansumabew kurow, Hebron; Libnah so nye ne mfikyisaase, na Jattir, na Eshtemoa nye ne mfikyisaase;
na Hilen nye ne mfikyisaase, Debir nye ne mfikyisaase;
na Ashan nye ne mfikyisaase, na Beth-shemesh nye ne mfikyisaase:
Na Benjamin ebusuakuw mu so; Geba nye ne mfikyisaase, na Allemeth nye ne mfikyisaase, na Anathoth nye ne mfikyisaase. Hɔn nkurow a ɔwɔ hɔn ebusua ebusua mu nyinara yɛ nkurow duebiasa.
Na Kohathmba nkaa no wɔnam tonto do fi ebusuakuw no mu ebusua mu, fi ebusuakuw fã no mu, Manasseh fã no mu, maa hɔn nkurow do.

Na Gershom ne mba, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee no, wɔdze Issachar ebusuakuw mu, na Asher ebusuakuw mu, na Naphtali ebusuakuw mu, na Manasseh ebusuakuw a ɔwɔ Bashan no mu, nkurow duebiasa maa hɔn.
Merarimba no, wɔnam tonto do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, wɔdze Reuben ebusuakuw mu, na Gad ebusuakuw mu, na Zebulun ebusuakuw mu, nkurow duebien maa hɔn.
Na Israelmba no dze nkurow no nye ne mfikyisaase no maa Levifo no.
Na wɔnam tonto do dze Judahmba ebusuakuw mu, na Simeonmba ebusuakuw mu, nkurow yi a wɔabobɔ dzin yi mae.
Na Kohathmba ebusua ebusua no mu binom nyaa hɔn ahe do nkurow wɔ Ephraim ebusuakuw mu.
Na wɔmaa hɔn guansumabew nkurow, Shechem nye ne mfikyisaase wɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow mu; Gezer so nye ne mfikyisaase;
na Jokmeam nye ne mfikyisaase, na Beth-horon nye ne mfikyisaase;
na Aijalon nye ne mfikyisaase, na Gathrimmon nye ne mfikyisaase;
na Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no mu: Aner nye me mfikyisaase, na Bileam nye ne mfikyisaase, wɔdze maa Kohathmba ebusua nkaa no.
Gershommba no wɔmaa hɔn Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no ebusua mu, Golan a ɔwɔ Bashan nye ne mfikyisaase;
na Issachar ebusuakuw mu; Kedesh nye ne mfikyisaase, Daberath nye ne mfikyisaase;
na Ramoth nye ne mfikyisaase, na Anem nye ne mfikyisaase:
Na Asher ebusuakuw mu; Mashal nye ne mfikyisaase, na Abdon nye ne mfikyisaase;
na Hukok nye ne mfikyisaase; na Rehob nye ne mfikyisaase:
Na Naphtali ebusuakuw mu; Kedesh a ɔwɔ Galilee nye ne mfikyisaase, na Hammon nye ne mfikyisaase, na Kiriathaim nye ne mfikyisaase.
Levifo nkaa no, Merarimba no, wɔmaa hɔn Zebulun ebusuakuw mu, Rimmono nye ne mfikyisaase, Tabor nye ne mfikyisaase:
Na Jericho-Jordan egya, Jordan no boka afamu so, wɔmaa hɔn Reuben ebusuakuw mu, Bezer a ɔwɔ sar no do nye ne mfikyisaase, na Jahzah nye ne mfikyisaase,
na Kedemoth nye ne mfikyisaase, na Mephaath nye ne mfikyisaase,
na Gad ebusuakuw mu; Ramoth a ɔwɔ Gilead nye ne mfikyisaase, na Mahanaim nye ne mfikyisaase,
na Heshbon nye ne mfikyisaase, na Jazer nye ne mfikyisaase.
7: Na Issachar mba nye yi; Tola, na Puah, Jashub, na Shimron, baanan.

Na Tola mba; Uzzi, na Rephaiah, na Jeriel, na Jahmai, na Ibsam, na Shemuel, hɔn egyanom efiefi etsitsir, dɛ, Tola dze; mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam wɔ hɔn mbasantsen mu: Hɔn dodow wɔ David ne nda no mu no ɔyɛ mpemeduonuebien na ahaesia.
Na Uzzi mba; Izrahiah: Na Izrahiah mba; Michael, na Obadiah, na Joel, Isshiah, beenum: Hɔn nyinara nyimpa etsitsir a.
Na hɔn a wɔkã hɔn ho, nam hɔn mbasantsen do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efiefi tsetsee no, nye akodzi dɔmekuwekuw, mpemeduasaesia: Na wɔwɔ yernom na mba pii.
Na hɔn nuanom a wɔwɔ Issachar ebusua ebusua nyinara mu, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam no, wobuu hɔn ano dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ananakan tse a, wɔyɛ mpemesuon eduowɔtwe.
Benjamin mba; Bela, na Becher, na Jediael, basaa.
Na Bela mba; Ezbon, na Uzzi, na Uzziel, na Jerimoth, na Iri, beenum; egyanom efiefi etsitsir, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam; na wɔkaan hɔn ananakan do mpemeduonuebien na eduasa anan.
Na Becher mba; Zemirah, na Joash, na Eliezer, na Elioenai, na Omri, na Jeremoth, na Abijah, na Anathoth, na Alemeth. Woyinom nyinara Becher ne mba a.
Na wɔkaan hɔn ananakan do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mbasantsen tse, hɔn egyanom efiefi do etsitsir, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, mpemeduonu na ahaebien.
Na Jedial mba; Bilhan na Bilhan mba; Jeush, na Benjamin, na Ehud, na Chenaanah, na Zethan, na Tarshish, na Ahishahar.
Woyinom nyinara wɔyɛ Jediael ne mba, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efiefi tsetsee, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, mpemduesuon ahaenu a wotum fir edzi kedzi akõ wɔ dɔm mu.
Shuppim so, na Huppim, Ir mba, Hushim, Aher mba.
Naphtali mba; Jahziel, na Guni, na Jezer, na Shallum, Bilhah mba.
Manasseh mba; Asriel a ne yer woo no no: (No nwewe Aramnyi no woo Gilead n'egya Machir:
Na Machir waar Huppim na Shuppim akyerɛbaa a ne dzin dze Maacah); na nyia otsīa ebien no ne dzin dze Zelophehad: Na Zelophehad nyaa mbabaa.
Na Machir ne yer Maacah woo babanyin, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Peresh; na no nuabanyin dzin dze Sheresh; na ne mba nye Ulam na Rakem.
Na Ulam mba; Bedan. Woyinom mu nye Gilead, Machir ne ba no, Manasseh ne ba no mba.
Na n'akyerɛbaa Hammolecheth woo Ishhod, na Aiezer, na Mahlah.
Na Shemida mba nye Ahian, na Shechem, na Likhi, na Aniam.
Na Ephraim mba; Shuthelah, na ne ba Bered, na ne ba Tahath, na ne ba Eleadah, na ne ba Tahath.
Na ne ba Zabad na ne ba Shuthelah, na Ezer, na Elead a Gath mbrarimba a wɔwoo hɔn wɔ asaase no do no kunkum hɔn, osiandɛ wosianee baa dɛ wɔrekɛfa hɔn mbowakuw akɔ.
Na hɔn egya Ephraim gyaam hɔn nda pii, na no nuanom baa dɛ wɔrebɛkyekye no werɛ.
Na ɔkɔr ne yer nkyɛn, na onyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Beriah, osiandɛ mbusu na ɔbaa ne fie.
Na ne babaa nye Sheerah a ɔkyekyeer Beth-horon anaafo na etsifi, na Uzzen-sheerah.
Na Rephah yɛ ne ba, na Resheph, na ne ba Telah, na ne ba Tahan;
ne ba Ladan, ne ba Ammihud, ne ba Elishama;
ne ba Nun, ne ba Joshua.
Na hɔn enyadze na hɔn tsenabew nye Beth-el na no ho nkuroba, na boka afamu Naaran, na anee afamu Gezer, nye no ho nkuroba; Shechem so na no ho nkuroba, dze kodu Azzah na no ho nkuroba;
na Manassehmba hɔn ahe nkyɛn no, Beth-shean na no nkuroba, Taanach na no nkuroba, Megiddo na no nkuroba, Dor na no nkuroba. Iyinom mu na Israel ne ba Joseph ne mba tsenae.
Asher mba; Imnah, na Ishvah, na Ishvi, na Beriah, na hɔn akyerɛbaa Serah.
Na Beriah mba; Heber, na Malchiel a ɔyɛ Birzaith n'egya no.
Na Heber woo Japhlet, na Shomer, na Hotham, na n'akyerɛbaa Shua.
Na Japhlet ne mba; Pasach, na Bimhal, na Ashvath. Woyinom nye Japhlet ne mba.
Na Shemer mba; Ahi, na Rohgah, Jehubbah, na Aram.
Na no nua Helem mba; Zophah, na Imna, na Shelesh, na Amal.
Zophah mba; Suah, na Harnephar, na Shual, na Beri, na Imral.
Bezer, na Hod, na Shamma, na Shilshah, na Ithran, na Beera.
Na Jether mba; Jephunneh, na Pispah, na Ara.
Na Ulla mba; Arah, na Hanniel, na Rizia.

Woyinom nyinara wɔyɛ Asher ne mba, egyanom efiefi do etsitsir, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn, mbapɔmba mu etsitsir. Na hɔn dodow wobu ano dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ananakan tse a, wotu ɔsa a wɔyɛ mbarimba mpemeduonuesia.
8: Na Benjamin woo n'abakan Bela, otsīa ebien Ashbel, otsīa ebiasa Aharah;
Otsīa anan Nohah, na otsīa enum Rapha.
Na Bela nyaa mba, Addar, na Gera, na Abihud;
na Abishua, na Naaman, na Ahoah;
na Gera, na Shephuphan, na Huram.
Na woyinom nye Ehud ne mba: Woyinom nye Geba atsefo mu egyanom efiefi do etsitsir, na wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔr Manahath:
Na Naaman, na Ahijah, na Gera, ɔnoara na ɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree; na ɔwoo Uzza na Ahihud.
Na Shaharaim woo mba wɔ Moab haban mu, oegya hɔn kwan n'ekyir no; Hushim na Baara wɔyɛ ne yernom.
Na ɔnye ne yer Hodesh woo Jobab, na Zibia, na Mesha, na Malcam;
na Jeuz, na Shachia, na Mirmah. Woyinom nye ne ba, egyanom efiefi do etsitsir.
Na ɔnye Hushim woo Abitub na Elpaal.
Na Elpaal mba; Eber, na Misham, na Shemed a ɔkyekyeer Ono na Lod, nye no nkuroba.
na Beriah, na Shema a wɔyɛ Aijalon atsefo mu egyanom efiefi do etsitsir a wɔpaam Gath atsefo;
na Ahio, Shashak, na Jeremoth;
na Zebadiah, na Arad, na Eder;
na Machael, na Ishpah, na Joha, Beriah mab no;
na Zebadiah, na Meshullam, na Hizki, na Heber;
na Ishmerai, na Izliah, na Jobab, Elpaal mba no;
na Jakim, na Zichri, na Zabdi;
na Elienai, na Zillethai, na Eliel;
na Adaiah, na Beraiah, na Shimrath, Shimei mba no;
na Ishpan, na Eber, na Eliel;
na Abdon, na Zichri, na Hanan;
na Hananiah, na Elam, na Anthothijah;
na Iphdeiah, na Penuel, Shashak mba no;
na Shamsherai, na Shehariah, na Athaliah;
na Jaareshiah, na Elijah, na Zichri, Jeroham mba no.
Woyinom nye egyanom efiefi do etsitsir hɔn ebusuasantsen nyina mu, nyimpa tsitsir: Woyinom tsenaa Jerusalem.
Na Gibeon hɔ na Gibeon n'egya, Jeiel a ne yer dzin dze Maacah tsenae:
Na n'abakan banyin Abdon, na Zur, na Kish, na Baal, na Nadab;
na Gedor, na Ahio, na Zecher.
Na Mikloth woo Shimeah. Na hɔn so wɔnye hɔn nuanom tsenaa Jerusalem, wɔ hɔn nuanom no hɔn tsentsendo.
Na Ner woo Kish; na Kish woo Saul; na Saul woo Jonathan, na Malchishua, na Abinadab na Eshbaal.
Na Jonathan ne ba nye Merib-baal; na Merib-baal woo Michah.
Micah mba; Pithon, na Melech, na Tarea, na Ahaz.
Na Ahaz woo Jehoaddah; ne Jehoaddah woo Alemeth, na Azmaveth, na Zimri; na Zimri woo Moza:
Na Moza woo Binea; ne ba nye Raphah, ne ba Eleasah, ne ba Azel:
Na Azel nyaa mbabanyin beesia, hɔn edzin nye yi; Azrikam, Bocheru, na Ishmael, na Sheariah, na Obadiah, na Hanan. Woyinom nyinara wɔyɛ Azel ne mba.
Na no nua Eshek mba; n'abakan Ulam, otsīa ebien Jeush, na otsīa ebiasa Eliphelet.
Na Ulam ne mba no wɔyɛ mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, egyentofo a, na wonyaa mba piigyan, na mbabanyin hɔn mba, ɔha eduonum. Woyinom nyinara wofi Benjamin ne mba mu.
9: Nna wobuu Israel nyinara ano dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ananakan tsetsee; na, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo nwoma no mu: Na wɔfaa Judah ndɔmmum kɔr Babylon wɔ hɔn mbrato ntsi.
Afei atsefo kankan a wɔtsenaa hɔn enyadze mu wɔ hɔn nkurow mu nye Israel, asɔfo no, Levifo no, na Nethifo.
Na Jerusalem dze, Judahmba, na Benjaminmba, na Ephraim na Manassehmba no mu binom tsenatsenaa hɔ;
Uthai, Ammihud ne ba no, Omri ne ba no, Imri ne ba no, Bani ne ba no, ofi Judah ne ba Perez ne mba mu.
Na Shilofo mu; abakan Asaiah, na ne mba. 6 Na Zerah ne mba mu; Jeul, na no nuanom, ahaesia eduokron.
Na Benjamin ne mba mu; Sallu, Meshullam ne ba no, Hodaviah ne ba no, Hassenuah ne ba no;
na Ibneiah, Jerohom ne ba no, na Elah, Uzzi ne ba no, Michri ne ba no, na Meshullam, Shephatiah ne ba no, Reuel ne ba no, Ibnijah ne ba no;
na hɔn nuanom dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuasantsen tsetsee, ahaakron eduonum esia. Mbarimba yi nyinara wɔyɛ egyanom efiefi do etsitsir dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efiefi tsetsee.
Na asɔfo no mu; Jedaiah, na Jehoiarib, na Jachin;
na Azariah, Hilkiah ne ba no, Meshullam ne ba no, Zadok ne ba no, Meraioth ne ba no, Ahitub ne ba no, Nyankopɔn ne fie ɔpanyin;
na Adaiah, Jeroham ne ba no, na Maasai, Adiel ne ba no, Jahzerah ne ba no, Meshullam ne ba no, Meshillemith ne ba no, Immer ne ba no;
na hɔn nuanom, hɔn egyanom efiefi do etsitsir, apem ahasuon eduosia; mbarimba ara a wotum Nyankopɔn ne fie ɔsom-edwuma yɛ.
Na Levifo mu; Shemaiah, Hasshub ba no, Azrikam ba no, Hashabiah ba no, Merarimba mu;
na Bakbakkar, Heresh, na Galal, na Mattaniah, Mica ba no, Zichri ba no, Asaph ba no;
na Obadiah, Shemaiah ba no, Galal ba no, Jeduthun ba no, na Berechiah, Asa ba no, Elkanah ba no a ɔtse Netophathfo nkuroba mu no.
Na mbobowanoahwɛfo no; Shallum, na Akkub, na Talmon, na Ahiman, na hɔn nuanom: Shallum nye otsitsir;
ɔno na ofitsi yi ara ogyina ɔhen no kuropon ano boka afamu: Hɔn na wɔyɛ Levimba nseraben mbobowanoahwɛfo.

Na Shallum, Kore ba no, Ebiasaph ba no, Korah ba no, na no nuanom, wofi n'egya fie, Korahfo no, wɔhwɛ ɔsomedwuma no do, ntamadan no no mbobotsenanoahwɛfo a: Na hɔn egyanom, Ewuradze ne nseraban no no ahɛnee no ano ahwɛfo a;
na Eleazar ne ba Phinehas nna odzii hɔn do ɔpanyin mber a etwa mu no, na Ewuradze dzii n'ekyir.
Zechariah, Meshelemiah ne ba no, nye ehyiadzibuw no n'abowanoahwɛfo.

Wonyinom nyinara a wɔsaan mu yii hɔn dɛ wɔmbɛyɛ mbobowanoahwɛfo wɔ mbobotsenano no wɔyɛ ahaenu duebien. Woyinom na wobuu ano hɔn ananakan do wɔ hɔn nkurobaase, hɔn na David na ɔdzehunyi Samuel dze hɔn sisii hɔn nokwardzi edwuma mu.
Nna hɔn na hɔn mba hwɛɛ Ewuradze fie mbobotsen no ano, mekyerɛ ntamadan ofi no, apatumu apatumu.
Mfɛndzanan do na abowanoahwɛfo no wɔ, boka, anee, kwaamu, na pomu afamu.
Na hɔn nuanom a wɔwɔ hɔn nkurobaase, ɔwɔ dɛ wɔba nda esuon biara mu ofi ber to ber bɛkã hɔn ho:
Na mbobowanoahwɛfo etsitsir baanan no a wɔyɛ Levifo no, wɔwɔ nokwardzi edwuma mu, na wɔhwɛ Nyankopɔn ne fie mpia na adzekorabea no do.
Na wɔtsetse Nyankopɔn ne dan no ho bɔ ho aprɔw, osiandɛ ɔweɔn no da hɔn do, na no mbuei anapa anapa no dzi wɔ hɔn.
Na hɔn mu binom hwɛ ɔsom ndzɛmba no do; osiandɛ wobu ano dze ba mu, na wobu ano fa kɔ.
Wɔdze hɔn mu binom so sisii dan mu ndzɛmba no, na krɔnkrɔn-bea ndzɛmba no nyinara, na isiam pa, na nsã, na ngo, na krɔbɔw, na nduhuam no do.
Na asɔmfomba no binom dze nduhuam foraforae yɛɛ ɔserango no.
Na Mattithiah, Levifo no mu baako, a ɔyɛ Korahnyi Shallum n'abakan no, nyaa nokwar edwuma wɔ ndzɛmba a wɔtõ no wɔ kyesɛn mu do.
Na hɔn nuanom no a wofi Kohathfo mu no mu binom wɔhwɛ kyerɛboodoo no do, dɛ wonsiesie no ahomgyeda biara.
Na woyinom nye adwontofo, Levifo mu egyanom efiefi do etsitsir a wɔtsenaa mpia mu na wɔnnyɛ edwuma nkaa no bi: Osiandɛ hɔn edwuma da hɔn do adzekyee na adzesaa.
Woyinom nye Levifo mu egyanom efiefi do etsitsir, wɔ hɔn ebusuasantsen nyina mu, nyimpa tsitsir: Woyinom na wɔtsenaa Jerusalem.
Na Gibeon hɔ na Gibeon n'egya, Jeiel a ne yer dzin dze Maacah tsenae:
Na n'abakan Abdon, na Zur, na Kish, na Baal, na Ner, na Nadab;
na Gedor, na Ahio, na Zechariah, na Mikloth.
Na Mikloth woo Shimeam. Na hɔn so wɔnye hɔn nuanom tsenaa Jerusalem, wɔ hɔn nuanom tsenaa Jerusalem, wɔ hɔn nuanom no hɔn tsentsendo.
Na Ner woo Kish; na Kish woo Saul; na Saul woo Jonathan, na Malchishua, na Abinadab, na Eshbaal.
Na Jonathan ne ba nye Merib-baal; na Merib-baal woo Micah.
Na Micah mba; Pithon, na Melech, na Tahrea, na Ahaz.
Na Ahaz woo Jarah; na Jarah woo Alemeth, na Azmaveth, na Zimri; na Zimri woo Moza:
Na Moza woo Binea; na ne ba Rephaiah, ne ba Eleasah, ne ba Azel:
Na Azel nyaa mbabanyin beesia, hɔn edzin nye yi; Azrikam, Bocheru, na Ishmael, na Sheariah, na Obadiah, na Hanan: Wonyinom nye Azel ne mba.
10: Afei Philistiafo nye Israel kõe: Na Israel mbarimba no fii Philistiafo no enyim guanee, na wɔtotɔree wɔ bepɔw Gilboa do.
Na Philistiafo no tsiiw Saul na ne mba dzendzenndzen; na Philistiafo no kum Jonathan, na Philistiafo no kum Jonathan, na Abinabab, na Malchi-shua, Saul ne mbabanyin no
Na ɔkõ no kyeer Saul do, na egyentofo no too no; na no ho hiahiaa no wɔ egyentofo no ntsi.

Nna Saul see n'akodzesoafo no dɛ, twe w'afõwa, na fa wɔ me; amma monomonomfo yi aammba na woeemmbogu m'enyim ase. Na n'akodzesoafo no annyɛ; osiandɛ osuroo dodoodow. Dɛm ntsi Saul faa n'afõwa, na otwae hwee do.
Na n'akodzesoafo no hun dɛ Saul ewu no, ɔno so otwae hwee n'afõwa do dɛmara, na owui.
Nna Saul, na ne mbabanyin baasa no, na ne fi nyinara wɔbɔɔ mu wui.
Na aber a Israel mbarimba a wɔwɔ bɔnsa no mu no hun dɛ woegu no, na Saul na ne mbabanyin ewuwu no, wɔdandaan hɔn nkurow no gyae, na woguanguanee; na Philistiafo no bae bɛtsenatsenaa mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ adze kyee enyim na a Philistiafo wɔbaa dɛ woribeyiyi atɔfo no ho ndzɛmba no, nna wohun Saul na ne mbabanyin no dɛ wɔatotɔ wɔ bepɔw Gilboa do.
Na woyiyii no ho ndzɛmba, na wotwaa ne tsir, na wɔfaa n'akodze, na wɔsomae ma wɔdze kekyimaa Philistiafo asaase do hyiae, dɛ wɔnkɔbɔ hɔn abosom, na ɔman no amandzɛɛ.
Na wɔdze n'akodze no koguu hɔn abosondan mu, na wɔdze ne tsir no kɛfaam Dagon dan mu.
Na aber a Jabeshgilead nyinara tsee dza Philistiafo dze ayɛ Saul no nyinara no,
nna mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam no nyinara soɛree, na wokeyiyii Saul, na ne mba hɔn efun no, na wɔdze baa Jabesh, na wobesiee hɔn mbiew no wɔ esudur no ase wɔ Jabesh, na wodzii mbuada nda esuon.
Nna Saul wui wɔ no bɔn a ɔyɛe tsiaa Ewuradze, osian Ewuradze n'asɛm a oenndzi do no ntsi; na eso dɛ okebisaa, ɔsamamfrɛnyi hɔ adze hwehwɛɛ n'ekyir kwan,
na ɔannhwehwɛ Ewuradze ekyir kwan: Dɛm ntsi na okum no, na ɔdaan ahendzi no maa Jesse ne ba David.
11: Nna Israel nyinara boaboaa hɔn ano kɔr David nkyɛn wɔ Hebron, dɛ, hwɛ, yɛyɛ wo biew na wo honam.

Mber a etwa mu asen no, mekyerɛ aber a Saul dzi hen no, ɔwo nye nyia ɔdze Israel fir edzi na ɔdze hɔn ba: Na w'Ewuradze Nyankopɔn see wo dɛ, ɔwo na ebɛyɛn me man Israel, na ɔwo na ebɛyɛ bapɔmba wɔ me man Israel do.

Nna Israel mpanyimfo no nyinara baa ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ Hebron yi; na David nye hɔn dzii ahyɛmu wɔ Ewuradze enyim wɔ Hebron; na wɔseraa David ngo hyɛɛ no ɔhen wɔ Israel do, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm a ɔnam Samuel abaw do no tse.
Na David na Israel nyinara sii mu kɔr Jerusalem (ɔnoara nye Jebus); nna Jebusfo no, asaase no do atsefo no, wɔwɔ hɔ.
Na Jebus atsefo no see David dɛ, ɔwo mma mmba ha. Naaso David gyee Zion akoban no; ɔnoara so nye David kurow no.
Na David see dɛ, obiara a obedzi kan eku Jebusfo no ɔbɛyɛ otsitsir na safohen. Na Zeruiah ne ba Joab dzii kan fowee kɔree, na wɔyɛɛ no otsitsir.
Na David tsenaa akoban no mu; dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ no David no kurow.
Na ɔkyekyeer kurow no bɔɔ aprɔw, ɔdze fi Millo araa bɔɔ aprɔw: Na Joab yɛɛ kurow nkaa no yie.
Na David daa ho yɛɛ kɛse ara; osiandɛ dɔm Ewuradze no dzii n'ekyir.
Afei woyinom nye mbarimba akatakyi a David nyae no mu etsitsir a wɔhyɛɛ hɔnho dzen kãa no ho wɔ n'ahendzi no mu, dɛ wɔnye Israel nyinara bɛhyɛ no hen, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm a ɔwɔ Israel ho no tse.
Na mbarimba akatakyi a David nyae no hɔn dodow nye yi: Jashobeam Hachmonnyi bi ne ba no, eduasa no mu otsitsir no; ɔno na ɔmaa ne peaa do wɔ ahaasa do kum hɔn prɛko no.
Na ɔno n'ekyir nye Eleazar, Dodo ba, ahohnyi a ɔyɛ mbarimba basaa no mu baako no.
ɔno na ɔwɔ David nkyɛn wɔ Pasdammim, na hɔ na Philistiafo wɔaboaboa hɔn ano dɛ wɔrobɔkõ, beebi mbrɛ asaasetɔw a atoko ayɛ do mã wɔ; na ɔman no fii Philistiafo no enyim guanee.
Na wokegyinaa ne finimfin, na wɔperee, na wokum Philistiafo no; na Ewuradze nam konyim kɛse do gyee hɔn nkwa.
Na etsitsir eduasa no mu baasa siaan famu kɔr ɔbotan no do wɔ David nkyɛn, wɔ Adullam ɔbo-tu no mu; nna Philistiafo dɔm no akyer nsera wɔ Rephaim ɔbɔn no mu.
Aber no na David wɔ tu no mu, na Philistiafo bansifo no so wɔwɔ Bethlehem aber no mu.
Na David no kɔn dɔe, na ɔsee dɛ, ao kɛtseankyɛ obi aama me Beth-lehem nsubura a ɔwɔ kuropon no ho no mu nsu bi ma maanom!
Na baasa no bɔe faa Philistiafo dɔm no mu, na wɔkɛsaaw Beth-lehem nsubura a ɔwɔ kuropon no ho no mu nsu bi, na wɔfae dze brɛɛ David: Na ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔnom, na mbom ohuei gui maa Ewuradze,

na ɔsee dɛ, me Nyankopɔn ma ɔmpar me, dɛ mebɛyɛ iyi: Ana monnom mbarimba yi a wɔdze hɔn nkwa kitsaa hɔn nsamu yi bɔgyaa? Na wɔdze hɔn nkwa kitsaa hɔn nsamu kɛfae bae. Dɛm ntsi ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔnom. Iyinom na mbarimba akatakyi baasa no yɛe.
Na Joab no nua Abishai, na ɔyɛ baasa no mu otsitsir: Na ɔmaa ne peaa do wɔ ahaasa do kunkum hɔn, na onyaa dzin wɔ baasa no mu.
Baasa no mu, ɔno na ɔyɛ onyimnyamfo dodow sen beenu no, na wɔyɛɛ no hɔn safohen: Naaso ɔannto asɔpɔn baasa no.
Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah, ɔbarimba bi a ɔyɛ ndam a ofi Kabzeel ne ba no a ɔyɛɛ akatakyidze no, ɔno na okum Moab nyimpa gyatasɛfo beenu no: Na osianee so kokum gyata wɔ maa bi mu wɔ esukwankyɛba ber mu.

Na okokum Egyptnyi bi, ɔbarimba kɛse bi a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa enum; na Egyptnyi no kitsa peaa a ɔtse dɛ ɔtanwemfo nsadua wɔ ne nsamu; na ɔdze poma sianee kɔr ne nkyɛn, na okohwiim peaa no wɔ Egyptnyi no nsamu, na ɔdze nankasa ne peaa no kum no.
Iyinom na Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah yɛe, na onyaa dzin wɔ mbarimba akatakyi baasa no mu.
Hwɛ, ɔyɛ onyimnyamfo dodow sen eduasa no, na mbom ɔannto asɔpɔn baasa no: Na David dze no sii n'annkɔbeafo do.
Eso dɔm no mu mbarimba akatakyi no nye yi; Joab no nua Asahel, dodo ne ba Elhanan a ofi Bethlehem;
Harorinyi Shammoth, Pelonyi Helez;
Tekonyi Ikkesh ne ba Ira, Anathothnyi Abiezer;
Hushathnyi Sibbecai, Ahohnyi Llai;
Netophathnyi Maharai, Netophathnyi Baanah ne ba Heled;
Ribai a ofi Benjaminmba Gibeah ne ba Ithai, Pirathonyi Benaiah;
Hurai a ofi Gaash nwora mu, Arbathnyi Abiel;
Baharumnyi Azmaveth, Shaalbonnyi Eliahba;
Gizonnyi Hashem ne mba, Hararnyi Shage ne ba Jonathan;
Hararnyi Sacar ne ba Ahiam, Ur ne ba Eliphal;
Mecherathnyi Hepher, Pelonyi Ahijah;
Carmelnyi Hezro, Ezbai ne ba Naarai;
Nathan no nua Joel, Hagri ne ba Mibhar;
Ammonnyi Zelek, Berothnyi Naharai, Zeruiah ne ba Joab n'akodzesoafo.
Ithrinyi Ira, Ithrinyi Gareb;
Hittinyi Uriah, Ahlai ne ba Zabad;
Reubennyi Shiza ne ba Adina, Reubenfo mu otsitsir, na eduasa kã no ho;
Maacah ne ba Hanan, na Mithnyi Joshaphat;
Ashterathnyi Uzzia, Aroernyi Hotham ne mba Shama na Jeiel;
Shimri ne ba Jediael, na no nua Tizinyi Joha;
Mahavinyi Eliel, na Elnaam ne mba Jeribai, na Joshuaviah, na Moabnyi Ithmah;
Eliel, na Obed, na Mezobanyi Jaasiel.
12: Afei woyinom nye hɔn a wɔbaa David nkyɛn wɔ Ziklag mber a osian Kish ne ba Saul ntsi ɔda ho siiw noho do no: Na wɔwɔ mbarimba akatakyi, n'akodzi mu aboafo no mu.
Wɔdze egyen emiamia, na wotum dze nsa enyimfa na abankum nyina tow tsīabo do abo, na egyen do egyen-menaba; wɔyɛ Saul no nuanom a wofi Benjamin mu.
Ahiezer nye otsitsir, nna Joash, Gibeathnyi Shemaah mba no; na Jeziel, na Pelet, Azmaveth mba no; na Beracah, na Jehu Anathothnyi no;
na Gibeonnyi Ishmaiah, eduasa no mu ɔbarimba katakyi, na ɔhwɛ eduasa no do; na Jeremiah, na Jahaziel, na Johanan, na Gederathnyi Jozabad;
Eluzai, na Jerimoth, na Bealiah, na Shemariah, na Haruphnyi Shephatiah;
Elkanah, na Isshiah, na Azarel, na Joezer, na Korahnyi Jashobeam;
na Joelah, na Zebadiah, Jeroham a ofi Gedor mba no.

Na Gadfo mu hɔn a wɔtsee hɔnho baa David nkyɛn wɔ sar no do tu no mu no, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, mbarimba akofo a wontum suo kyɛm na peaa mu a, hɔn enyim tse dɛ ngyata enyim, na hɔn ho yɛ har dɛ mbepɔw do atwe no nye yi:
Otsitsir Ezer, otsīa ebien Obadiah, otsīa ebiasa Eliab;
otsīa anan Mishmannah, otsīa enum Jeremiah;
otsīa esia Attai, otsīa esuon Eliel;
otsīa awɔtwe Johanan, otsīa akron Elzabad;
otsīa du Jeremiah, otsīa dubiako Machbannai.
Gadmba mu woyinom na wɔyɛ dɔm mu asafohemfo: Nyia osuar dodow botum ɔha, na ɔkɛse no so apem.
Woyinom nye hɔn a wosii mu kotwaa Jordan wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu, aber a oeyir akata no kɔn nyinara do no; na wɔkãa hɔn a wofi abɔn no mu nyinara gui, boka afamu, na anee afamu nyina.
Na Benjamin na Judahmba mu binom baa David nkyɛn wɔ tu no mu.

Na David fiir edzi kɔr hɔn enyim, na obuae see hɔn dɛ, sɛ hom baa me nkyɛn asomdwee mu dɛ hom robɔboa me a, ɔno m'akoma bɛfam hom ho: Na sɛ hom ba dɛ woribeyi me ama m'atamfo, wɔ dɛ mfom bi nnyi me nsamu yi a, ɔnodze hɛn egyanom Nyankopɔn nhwɛ na ɔnkã enyim.

Nna sunsum no baa Amasai a ɔyɛ eduasa no mu otsitsir no do, na ɔsee dɛ, yɛyɛ wodze, David na yɛwɔ w'afã, ɔwo Jesse ba: Asomdwee, asomdwee nkã wo, na asomdwee nkã w'aboafo; na wo Nyankopɔn roboa wo. Nna David gyee hɔn, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn kuw no do asafohemfo.

Manasseh mu so binom danee kɔr David nkyɛn, aber a ɔnye Philistiafo reba nye Saul abɔkõ no; na wɔammboa hɔn: Osiandɛ Philistiafo asafohemfo no kɔr egyina gyaa no kwan, dɛ, hɛn etsir na ɔdze bɔwaa akɔ no wura Saul nkyɛn.
Na osii mu kɔr Ziklag no, Manasseh mu binom waae kɔr ne nkyɛn, Adnah, na Jozabad, na Jediael, na Michael, na Jozabad, na Elinu, na Zillethai, na Manasseh mu mpem do asafohemfo.
Na hɔn na wɔboaa David ma ɔnye epoobɔfo dzii esi; osiandɛ hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, na wɔyɛ dɔm no mu asafohemfo.
Na daa nyina wɔdze David nkyɛn ba ara, dɛ wɔbɔboa no, kodur dɛ wɔyɛɛ dɔm kɛse, dɛ Nyankopɔn no dɔm.
Na wonyinom nye hɔn mu etsitsir a woemia ama akodzi a wɔbaa David nkyɛn wɔ Hebron, dɛ wɔrebɛdan Saul n'ahendzi no ama no, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm no tse no, hɔn dodow.
Judahmba a wokitsa kyɛm na peaa a woemia ama akodzi wɔyɛ mpemesia ahaawɔtwe.
Simeonmba mu mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam ma akodzi, mpemesuon na nyimpa ɔha.
Levimba mu mpemanan na nyimpa ahaesia.
Na Jehoiada na ɔyɛ Aaron fie ɔbapɔmba, na nyimpa mpensa ahaesuon kã no ho;
na Zadok, aberantsɛ ɔkatakyi a ɔyɛ ndam, na n'egya fi mu asafohemfo eduonu ebien.
Na Benjaminmba mu, Saul no nuanom, mpensa na ɔdze bodu mber no nna hɔn mu nyimpadodow ara esie hɔn nokwardzi ama Saul fie.
Na Ephraimmba mu mpemeduonu ahaawɔtwe, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, nyimpa a wɔwɔ dzin wɔ hɔn egyanom efiefi.
Na Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no mu, mpemduawɔtwe a wɔbɔɔ hɔn dzin dɛ wɔmbra mbɛhyɛ David hen.
Na Issacharmba mu, nyimpa a wɔwɔ mber mu nhumu, dɛ wɔdze bohu dza ɔsɛ dɛ Israel yɛ no; hɔn mu etsitsir yɛ ahaenu; na hɔn nuanom nyinara hwɛ hɔn ano.
Zebulun mu, hɔn a wotum fir edzi wɔ dɔm no mu a wɔdze akodze horow nyinara mia, dze tum siesie kɔ mpasuar do, mpemmeduonum; na wobotum ahyehyɛ mpasuar, na wɔnnyɛ akoma ntanta.
Na Naphtali mu asafohemfo apem, na nyimpa a wokitsa kyɛm na peaa mpemeduasa esuon kã hɔn ho.
Na Danfo mu hɔn a wobotum mpasuar do kɔ, mpemeduonu awɔtwe na ahaesia.
Na Asher mu hɔn a wotum fir edzi wɔ dɔm no mu a wotum kɔ mpasuar do, mpemeduanan.
Na Jordan n'egya no ho, Reubenfo mu, na Gadfo, na Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no mu, nyimpa a wɔdze ɔkõ mu akodze horow nyinara mpemɔha eduonu.

Woyinom nyinara, wɔyɛ mbarimba akofo a wobotum akɔ mpasuar do no, wɔdze akoma a odzi mu baa Hebron, dɛ wɔbɛhyɛ David hen wɔ Israel nyinara do: Na Israel nkaa no nyinara so yɛɛ akoma kor dɛ wɔbɛhyɛ David hen.
Na wɔnye David dzii hɔ ndaansa, dzidzii nomee: Nna hɔn nuanom esiesie hɔn ekyir.

Nkyii so hɔn a wɔbɛn hɔn no, mekyerɛ ɔdze kodu Issachar na Zebulun na Naphtali, wɔdze edziban wɔ nsoaso, na efumpɔnkɔ, na nsoasompɔnkɔ, na anantwi do bae, isiam edziban, adɔmba tatar, na esikyireamba esia, na wenyin, na ngo, na anantwi, na nguan piigyan: Nna enyigye aba Israel.
13: Na David nye apem apem do na ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo, mekyerɛ mbapɔmba no nyinara kɔr egyina.

Na David see Israel bagua no nyinara dɛ, sɛ ɔhwɛ dɛ oye ma hom, na sɛ ofir Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn hɔ a, hom mma yentwar mu nsoma ma wɔnkɔ hɛn nuanom a wɔaka wɔ Israel asaase nyinara do beebiara, nye asɔfo na Levifo a wɔkã hɔn ho wɔ hɔn edzidzibea nkurow mu no mkyɛn, ma wonhyiahyia hɔnho mbraa hɛn nkyɛn:
Na yɛnkɛfa hɛn Nyankopɔn adakaa no mbra hɛn nkyɛn bio: Osiandɛ Saul ne nda mu no yɛannhwehwɛ n'ekyir kwan.
Na bagua no nyinara see dɛ wɔbɛyɛ dɛm: Osiandɛ asɛm no tsen wɔ ɔman no nyinara enyi do.
Nna David poon Israel man mu nyinara hyiae, ofi Egypt ɔwora Shihor ho araa dze kodu Hamath ahɛnee, dɛ wɔrekɛfa Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no efi Kiriath-jearim aba.
Na David na Israel nyinara fowee kɔr Baalah, ɔno nye Kiriath-jearim a odzi wɔ Judah no, dɛ wɔrekɛfa Nyankopɔn Ewuradze a ɔtse cherubfo no do a wɔdze dzin no frɛ no no, n'adakaa no efi hɔ aba.
Na woyii Nyankopɔn adakaa no wɔ tseatseanam fofor bi do, na wɔdze fii Abinadab fie firii: Na Uzza na Ahio piaa tseaseanam no.
Na David na Israel nyinara wɔdze hɔn ahoɔdzen nyinara goree wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim: Mekyerɛ wɔdze ndwom, na ɔnye nsankutsen, na ɔnye bɛntaasanku, na ɔnye mpintsin, na ɔnye akasaa, na ɔnye mbɛn.
Na aber a wodur Chidon ewuporoweebea no, Uzza tseen ne nsa suoo adaka no mu; osiandɛ anantwi no fintsiwii.
Na Ewuradze n'ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ Uzza do, na ɔbɔɔ no, osiandɛ ɔtseen ne nsa kãa adaka no ntsi: Na hɔ na owui wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na David ɔammpɛ, osiandɛ Ewuradze ebu afa Uzza do ntsi: Na ɔfrɛɛ bea no Perez-uzza, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na David suroo Nyankopɔn da no, dɛ, mibesi dɛn medze Nyankopɔn adakaa no maba me nkyɛn wɔ fie?
Nna David ennyi adaka no ammba ne nkyɛn wɔ David kurow no mu, na mbom ɔdze maan nkyɛn kɔr Gittinyi Obed-edom n'ebusua mu wɔ ne fie abosoom ebiasa.
Na Nyankopɔn adakaa no ɔkaa Obed-edom n'ebusua mu wɔ ne fie abosoom ebiasa: Na Ewuradze hyiraa Obed-edom fi, na dza ɔwɔ nyinara.
14: Na Tyrehen Hiram somaa abɔfo ma wɔbaa David nkyɛn na cedar ndua, na abodwimfo na nduadwimfo na nduadwimfo, dɛ wombesi ofi mma no.
Na David hun dɛ Ewuradze etsintsim ne dzin ahyɛ Israel do hen, na osian ne man Israel ntsi, wɔama n'ahendzi do wɔ sor.
Na David warwaar yernom bi so wɔ Jerusalem: Na David wowoo mbabanyin na mbabaa bi so bio.
Na mba a onyae no wɔ Jerusalɛm no hɔn edzin nye yi; Shammua, na Shobab, Nathan, na Solomon;
na Ibhar, na Elishua, na Elpelet;
na Nogah, na Nepheg, na Japhia;
na Elishama, na Beeliada, na Eliphelet:
Na aber a Philistiafo tsee dɛ wɔasera David ahyɛ no hen wɔ Israel nyinara do no, Philistiafo no nyinara sii mu kɔr dɛ wɔrokɔhwehwɛ David: Na David tsee, na ofiir edzi kɔr hɔn do.
Nna Philistiafo aba dze abɛyer Rephaim bɔnsa no mu.
Na David bisaa Nyankopɔn, dɛ, ana momfow monkɔ Philistiafo no do a? Ana ibeyi hɔn ahyɛ me nsa a? Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, fow kɔ; na mibeyi hɔn ahyɛ wo nsa.
Nna wɔfowee baa Baal-perazim, na David kunkum hɔn wɔ hɔ; na David see dɛ, Nyankopɔn nam me nsa do atsew m'atamfo mu, dɛ nsu ntsewee. Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bea no dzin dɛ Baalperazim.
Na wɔdaan hɔn nyame gyaa hɔ; na David hyɛe ma wɔdze gya hyeew no.
Na Philistiafo no sanee bae dze bɛyeer bɔnsa no mu bio.
Na David bisa Nyankopɔn bio; na Nyankopɔn see no dɛ, mma mmfow nnkɔ nnkedzi hɔn ekyir: Dan fi hɔn nkyɛn, na bra hɔn do wɔ bakandua no ne tsentsendo.
Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ etse nantsew ndze wɔ bakandua no etsifi a, ɔno fir edzi kɔkõ: Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn efir edzi dzi w'enyim dɛ orukoku Philistiafo dɔm no.
Na David yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no: Na wokunkum Philistiafo dɔm no fi Gibeon araa dze kodur Gezer.
Na David ne nka tahyee asaase nyinara do; na Ewuradze maa no ho suro baa amanaman nyinara do.
15: Na David sisii adan maa noho wɔ David kurow mu; na osiesiee bea bi maa Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no, na ɔbɔɔ asese bi maa no.
Nna David see dɛ, obiara nnyi dɛ ɔsoa Nyankopɔn adakaa no gyedɛ Levifo no ara nko: Osiandɛ hɔn na Ewuradze asan mu eyi hɔn dɛ wɔnsoa Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no, na wɔnsom no daa
Na David poon Israel nyinara behyiaa Jerusalem, dɛ wɔrekɛfa Ewuradze n'adakaa no aba ne sibew a oesiesie ama no no.
Na David boaa Aaronmba, na Levifo no ano:
Kohathmba no mu; otsitsir Uriel, na no nuanom ɔha eduonu:
Merarimba mu; otsitsir Asaiah, na no nuanom ahaenu eduonu:
Gershommba mu; otsitsir Joel, na no nuanom ɔha eduasa:
Elizaphanmba mu; otsitsir Shemaiah, na no nuanom ahaenu:
Hebronmba mu; otsitsir Eliel, na no nuanom eduowɔtwe:
Uzzielmba mu; otsitsir Amminadab, na no nuanom ɔha duebien.
Na David kɛfrɛɛ asɔfo Zadok na Abiathar, na Levifo no, Uriel, Asaiah, na Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, na Amminadab,
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nye Levifo mu egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir: Hom ntsew homho, hom na hom nuanom nyina, na hom dze Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, n'adakaa no aba ne sibew a mesiesie mama no no.
Na osiandɛ nkan no hom annnsoa ntsi, Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn bui faa hɛn do, dɛ yɛannhwehwɛ no dɛ mbrɛ n'amambra no tse.
Nna asɔfo na Levifo no tseew hɔnho dɛ wɔrekɛfa Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, n'adakaa no aba.
Na Levifo mba no soaa Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no wɔ hɔn kɔn ho, wɔdze no ho mpoma no, dɛ mbrɛ Moses nam Ewuradze n'asɛm no do hyɛe no.

Na David kãa kyerɛɛ Levifo safohen no dɛ wonyi hɔn nuanom no adwontofo a wɔdzedze asanku ndzɛmba, bɛntaasanku na nsankutsen na nkasaa a wɔma ɔgyegye kɛse na a wɔma ɔgyegye kɛse na wɔma ndze do enyigye mu.
Nna Levifo no yii Joel ne ba Heman; na no nuanom mu, Berechiah ne ba Asaph; na hɔn nuanom Merari ne mba no mu, Kushaiah ne ba Ethan;

na hɔn nuanom a wodzi hɔn ekyir no kã hɔn ho, Zechariah, Ben, na Jaaziel, na Shemiramoth, na Jehiel, na Unni, Eliab, na Benaiah na Maaseiah, na Mattithiah, na Eliphelehu, na Mikneiah, na Obed-edom, na Jeiel, mbobowanoahwɛfo no.
Nna woyii adwontofo no, Heman, Asaph, na Ethan, dɛ wɔmfa boran nkasaa nwosow ma wɔntse nka;
na Zechariah, na Aziel, na Shemiramoth, na Jehiel, na Unni, na Eliab, na Maaseiah, na Benaiah, dɛ wɔmfa bɛntaasanku mbɔ no wɔ Alamoth do;
na Mattithiah, na Eliphelehu, na Mikneiah, na Obed-edom, na Jeiel, na Azaziah, wɔbɔ nsankutsen wɔ Sheminith do, dze kyerɛ kwan.
Na Chenaniah, Levifo safohen no, ɔhwɛ ndwom no do: Ɔno na ɔkyerɛkyerɛe wɔ ndwom no ho, osiandɛ ɔyɛ onyansafo.
Na Berechiah na Elkanah wɔyɛ adaka no mbobowanoahwɛfo.

Na Shebaniah, na Joshaphat, na Nethanel, na Amasai, na Zechariah, na Benaiah, na Eliezer, asɔfo no, nna wɔhɛn mbɛn wɔ Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no enyim: Na Obed-edom na Jehiah nna wɔyɛ adaka no mbobowanoahwɛfo.
Nna David, na Israel mpanyimfo, na apem apem do asafohemfo no, dze enyigye sii mu kɔr dɛ wɔrekɛfa Ewuradze n'ahyɛmudaka no efi Obed-edom fie aba:
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Nyankopɔn boaa Levifo a wɔso Ewuradze n'ahyɛmudaka no no, wɔdze anantwisaa esuon na ndwanyin esuon bɔɔ afɔr.
Na David hyɛɛ ndwera fɛɛfɛw bataker, na Levifo a wɔso adaka no nyinara, na adwontofo no, na Chenaniah ndwom kyerɛkyerɛfo a ɔkã adwontofo no ho no: Na ndwera ephod gu David no ho.
Dɛm na Israel nyinara wɔdze esebɔ na ɔnye mbɛnhɛn, na ɔnye totorobɛnto, na ɔnye nkasaa a ɔgyegye kɛse ɔnye bɛntaasanku na nsankutsen, dze Ewuradze n'ahyɛmudaka no bae.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ewuradze n'ahyɛmudaka no dur David kurow mu no, Saul ne babaa Michal hwɛɛ tokura mu, na ohun ɔhen David dɛ ɔresaw na ɔrogor; na obuu no enyimtsia wɔ n'akoma mu.
16: Na wɔdze Nyankopɔn adakaa no bae, na wɔdze besii asese a David abɔ ama no no ne finimfin: Na wɔbɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr na asomdwee afɔr wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na aber a David wiee ɔhyew-afɔr na asomdwee afɔr bɔ no, ɔdze Ewuradze ne dzin hyiraa ɔman no.
Na ɔkyɛɛ Israelnyi biara adze, ɔbarimba na ɔbaa nyina, ɔmaa obiara boodoo ntɔwmu, na nankum, na esikyireamba a wɔabɔ no etɔw.
Na oyii Levifo no bi sisii hɔ dɛ wɔnsom wɔ Ewuradze n'adakaa no enyim, na wɔnkamfo Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na wɔnda no ase na wonyi no ayɛw:

Asaph nye otsitsir, na Zechariah dzi no do hɔ, Jeiel, na Shemiramoth, na Jehiel, na Mattithiah, na Eliab, na Benaiah, na Obed-edom, na Jeiel, wɔdzedze bɛntaasanku ɔnye nsankutsen; na Asaph dze akasaa a ɔgyegye kɛse:
Na Benaiah na Jahaziel asɔfo no a wɔhɛn ntotorobɛnto daa, wɔ Nyankopɔn n'ahyɛmudaka no enyim.
Da no ara na David dzii kan hyehyɛɛ dɛ wondua Asaph na no nuanom nsa do nda Ewuradze ase.
Hom mfa ndaase mma Ewuradze, hom mbɔ ne dzin; hom mma wonhu ne nyɛe wɔ aman mu.
Hom ntow ndwom mma no, hom ntow ayɛyindwom mma no; hom nkã n'anwanwa dwuma nyinara ho asɛm.
Hom nhyehyɛ homho wɔ ne dzin krɔnkrɔn no mu: Wɔmma hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Ewuradze hɔn akoma ntɔ mu.
Hom nhwehwɛ Ewuradze na n'ahoɔdzen; hom nhwehwɛ n'enyim daa.
Hom nkaa n'anwanwa dwuma a ɔayɛ; n'ahobowdze, na n'ano atsɛmbunsɛm;
Hom n'akowaa Israel asefo, hom Jacobmba a wɔasan mu eyi hom.
Ɔno nye Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn; n'atsɛmbunsɛm wɔ asaase nyinara do.
Hom nkaa n'ahyɛmu no daa, asɛm a ɔhyɛe maa mbasantsen apem no;
Ahyɛmu a ɔnye Abraham dzii no, na ne ntam a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ Isaac no;
Na osii no pi maa Jacob dɛ ahyɛdze, ɔdze maa Israel dɛ daa ahyɛmu no:
Dɛ, ɔwo na medze Canaan asaase mebɛma wo, hom tontotwe no do egyapadze nye no.
Aber a hom nyimpadodow ano nndɔɔ sõ; nyew, wosuar koraa, na wɔyɛ amamforafo wɔ mu no;
na wokyinkyinii fi ɔman mu kɔr ɔman mu, na wofii ahenman kor mu kɔr ɔman kor so mu.
Ɔamma nyimpa bi kwan ma ɔannyɛ hɔn bɔn; nyew, otwuuw ahemfo enyim wɔ hɔn ntsi;
dɛ, mma hom nkã hɔn a masera hɔn, na mma hom nnyɛ mo nkɔnhyɛfo bɔn bi.
Asaase nyinara, hom ntow ndwom mma Ewuradze; hom nkyerɛ no nkwagye mfi da nto da.
Hom nkã n'enyimnyam wɔ amanaman mu, n'anwanwa dwuma wɔ aman nyinara mu.
Na Ewuradze yɛ kɛse, na ɔsɛ dɛ woyi no ayɛw dɛ: Ɔno so na ɔsɛ dɛ wosuro no sen enyame nyinara.
Na aman enyame nyinara yɛ abosom: Na Ewuradze na ɔyɛɛ ɔsor.
Enyidzi na tumdzi wɔ n'enyim: Ahoɔdzen na enyika wɔ ne tsenabew.
Aman mbusuakuw, hom mma Ewuradze, hom mma Ewuradze enyimnyam na ahoɔdzen.
Hom mma Ewuradze enyimnyam a ɔsɛ ne dzin: Hom mfa ayɛyɛdze mbra, na hom mbra n'enyim: Hom nsɔr Ewuradze wɔ krɔnkrɔnyɛ ahoɔfɛw mu.
Asaase nyinara, hom ho mpopo wɔ n'enyim: Wiadze so woetsim no dɛ wohim no a ɔnnkɛyɛ.
Wɔmma ɔsor enyi ngye, na asaase ho nsɛpɛw no: Na wɔnkã no wɔ amanaman mu dɛ, Ewuradze dzi hen.
Wɔmma po, na ne mãyɛ nwor; wɔmma haban, na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara ndzi ehurusi;
nna kwaa mu ndua nyinara bɔtow ahosɛpɛw ndwom wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na ɔreba ebobu asaase atsɛn.
Hom mfa ndaase mma Ewuradze; na oye: Na n'ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
Na hom nse dɛ, gye hɛn nkwa, hɛn nkwagye Nyankopɔn, na boaboa hɛn ano na yi hɛn fi amanaman mu, na yɛnda wo dzin krɔnkrɔn no ase, na yɛntenan wɔ w'ayɛyi mu.
Nhyira nkã Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, mfi daapem nkesi daapem. Na ɔman no nyinara see dɛ, amen, na woyii Ewuradze ayɛw.
Nna ogyaa Asaph na no nuanom hɔ, wɔ Ewuradze n'ahyɛmudaka no enyim, dɛ wɔnsom wɔ adaka no enyim daa, dɛ mbrɛ da biara no mu edwuma gye:
Na Obed-edom nye hɔn nuanom, yɛ eduosia awɔtwe: Jeduthun ne ba Obed-edom so na Hosah dɛ wɔnyɛ mbobowanoahwɛfo:
Na ogyaa ɔsɔfo Zadok, na no nuanom asɔfo no, wɔ Ewuradze ntamadan no enyim wɔ bea bea sorɔnsorɔm a ɔwɔ Gibeon no mu,
dɛ wɔmbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr mma Ewuradze wɔ ɔhyew afɔrmbukyia no do daa anapa na ewimbir, mekyerɛ dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Ewuradze ne mbra a ɔhyɛɛ Israel no mu nyinara tse;
na Heman na Jeduthun kã hɔn ho, na nkaa a wɔsaan mu yii hɔn a wɔbobɔɔ hɔn dzin, dɛ wɔmfa ndaase mma Ewuradze, osiandɛ n'ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa;
na Heman na Jeduthun kã hɔn ho dze ntotorobɛnto na nkasaa a ɔgyegye kɛse, na ɔnye Nyankopɔn ndwom ho ndzɛmba: Na Jeduthun mba wɔnhwɛ kuropon ano.
Na ɔman no nyinara sii mu kɔree, nyimpa biara kɔr ne fie: Na David sanee kɔr dɛ orikehyira ne fi.
17: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a David tsenaa fie no, nna Dvid see nkɔnhyɛni Nathan dɛ, hwɛ emi metse cedar ofi mu, na Ewuradze n'ahyɛmudaka no dze, osi atam ase.
Na Nathan see David dɛ, yɛ dza ɔwɔ w'akoma mu nyinara; na Nyankopɔn dzi w'ekyir.
Na ɔbaa dɛ anago no ara nna Nyankopɔn n'asɛm baa Nathan hɔ, dɛ,
kɔ na kɛkã kyerɛ m'akowaa David dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, mma ɔwo nnsi ofi mma me ma menntsena mu:
Osiandɛ ofitsi da a miyii Israel bae araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi, menntsenaa ofi bi mu da; mbom mifi asese mu kɔ asese mu, na mifi ntamadan kor mu kɔ kor so mu.
Mbeambea nyinara a menye Israel anantsew no do, ana menye Israel atsɛmbuafo a mehyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnnyɛn me man ni mu bi kãa asɛm bi, dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom nnsi me cedar ofi.
Dɛm ntsi afei mbrɛ kã kyerɛ m'akowaa David nye yi, dɛ, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi, emi na miyii wo fii nguamban mu, fii nguan ekyir dzi, ama aabɛyɛ ɔpanyin wɔ me man Israel do;
na medzi w'ekyir wɔ beebiara mbrɛ ekɔree, na metwitwa w'atamfo nyinara mefi w'enyim; na mebɛma enya dzin, dɛ asaase do akɛsefo hɔn dzin.
Na mibesiesie beebi mama me man Israel, na matsɛn hɔn, na wɔaatsena hɔnankasahɔn tsenabew, na woeenntutu hɔn bio dɛ asɔpɔn no,
na dɛ ofi da a mehyɛɛ atsɛmbuafo dɛ wɔnhwɛ me man Israel do no; na mebɛbrɛ w'atamfo nyinara adze. Sɛnkyirii so mekã kyerɛ wo dɛ Ewuradze besi wo ofi bi.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wo nda sõ dɛ ebɔkɔ w'egyanom nkyɛn a, medze w'asenyi a obedzi w'ekyir no a obefi wo mba mu no, mibesi hɔ; na mama n'ahendzi etsim.
Ɔno na obesi ofi ama me, na mebɛma n'ahendzi etsim hɔ daa.
Emi na mebɛyɛ n'egya, na ɔno ayɛ me ba: Na mirinnyi mo mbɔbɔrhu mmfi no ho, dɛ mbrɛ miyii mifii nyia odzi w'enyim no ho no:
Na medze no mibesi me fi na m'ahendzi mu daa.
Dɛ mbrɛ nsɛm yi nyinara tse, na mbrɛ enyido-adzehu yi nyinara tse no, dɛmara so na Nathan kãa kyerɛɛ David.
Na ɔhen David sii mu kɔree, na ɔkɛtsenaa Ewuradze enyim; na ɔsee dɛ, emi nye woana, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, na me fi nye bɛn, na edze me aba ebodu ha yi?
Na Nyankopɔn, iyi yɛ w'enyi do adze ketseaba; na ɔwo Ewuradze Nyankopɔn dze akã w'akowaa ne fi ho asɛm dze ama mber tsentsen bi a ɔreba, na ebu me dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa bi a ɔkrɔn ne dzibew tse.
Na David botum ase wo dɛn bio wɔ enyidzi a wɔdze edzi w'akowaa ho? Osiandɛ ɔwoara inyim w'akowaa.
Ewuradze, osian w'akowaa ntsi, na dɛ mbrɛ wankasa w'akoma tse no, nna ayɛ adze kɛse yi nyinara, dɛ erema woehu ndzɛmba akɛse yi nyinara.
Ewuradze, obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo, nkyii so Nyame biara nnyi hɔ kã wo ho, dɛ mbrɛ dza yɛndze hɛn aso atse no nyinara tse no.

Na ɔman kor mmuana na ɔwɔ asaase do a ɔtse dɛ wo man Israel a Nyankopɔn sii mu kɔree kɔpoon hɔn dze yɛɛ ɔman maa noho dɛ edze ndzɛ mba akɛse a ɔyɛ hu agye dzin, dɛ etutu amanaman efi wo man a epoon hɔn fii Egypt no enyim?
Na wo man Israel na eyɛɛ hɔn wankasa wo man daa; na ɔwo Ewuradze bɛyɛɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn.
Na afei, Ewuradze, ma asɛm a akã wɔ w'akowaa ho, na ne fi ho no, ntsim hɔ daa, na yɛ dɛ mbrɛ akã no.
Na ma wo dzin ntsim na wonhuhor na daa dɛ, dɔm Ewuradze nye Israel Nyankopɔn, mekyerɛ Israel Nyankopɔn a: Na w'akowaa David fi etsim wɔ w'enyim.
Na ɔwoara me Nyankopɔn, na ada no edzi akyerɛ w'akowaa dɛ ibesi no ofi: Dɛm ntsi na w'akowaa ehu no wɔ n'akoma mu dɛ ɔbɔ w'enyim mpaa yi.
Na afei, Ewuradze, ɔwoara nye Nyankopɔn, na edze papa yi abɔ w'akowaa anohoba:
Na afei ayɛ wo fɛw dɛ ibehyira w'akowaa ne fi, ama ɔaako w'enyim daa: Na ɔwo, Ewuradze, ehyira yi, na woehyira no daa.
18: Na iyi ekyir no ɔbaa dɛ David kãa Philistiafo no gya, na ɔbrɛɛ hɔn adze, na ɔgyee Gath na no nkurobaase wɔ Philistiafo nsamu.
Ɔkãa Moab so gya, na Moab fo no bɛyɛɛ nkowaa maa David, na wɔdze ayɛyɛdze bae.
Na David kãa Zobahhen Hadarezer gya dze kodur Hamath, aber a osii mu kɔr dɛ oriketintsim n'ahendzi wɔ esutsen Euphrates ho no mu.
Na David gyee no hɔ ntseaseanam apem, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemesuon, na anamɔnmufo mpemeduonu: Na David twitwaa ntseaseanam mpɔnkɔ nyinarea hɔn anantsir ntsin na ogyaa hɔn mu ntseaseanam ɔha ho dze.
Na aber a Damascus Syriafo no baa dɛ wɔrobɔboa Zobahhen Hadarezer no, David kum Syriafo no mu nyimpa mpemeduonuebioen.
Na David dze bansifo bɛtsenaa Damascus Syria: Na Syriafo no bɛyɛɛ nkowaa maa David, na wɔdze ayɛyɛdze bae. Na Ewuradze maa David konyimdzi wɔ beebiara mbrɛ ɔkɔree.
Na David gyegyee sika akyɛm a ɔwowɔ Hadarezer no nkowaa ho no, na ɔdze baa Jerusalem.
Na Hadarezer no kurow Tibhath na Cun mu, na David faa boran piigyan a Solomon dze yɛɛ boran po, na edum no, na boran ndzɛmba no.
Na aber a Hamathhan Tou tsee dɛ David akã Zobahhen Hadarezer no dɔm nyinara gya no,

ɔsomaa ne ba Hadoram ma ɔbaa ɔhen David nkyɛn bekyiaa no, na ohyiraa no dɛ ɔnye Hadarezer akõ, na ɔakã no gya ntsi: Osiandɛ Hadarezer nye Tou dzii akõ; na ɔwɔ sika na dwetɛ na boran ndzɛmba n'ahorow nyinara wɔ ne nkyɛn.
Iyinom so na ɔhen David tui sii nkyɛn maa Ewuradze dze kãa dwetɛ na sika a ɔkɔsoae fii amanaman nyinara mu no ho; ofi Edom, na Moab, na Ammonmba, na Philistiafo, na Amalek hɔ.
Sɛnkyirii so Zeruiah ne ba Abishai kum Edomfo mu nyimpa mpemduawɔtwe wɔ Nkyen Bɔnsa no mu.
Na ɔdze bansifo tsenaa Edom, na Edomfo no nyinara bɛyɛɛ nkowaa maa David. Na Ewuradze maa David konyimdzi wɔ beebiara mbrɛ ɔkɔree.
Na David dzii hen wɔ Israel nyinara do, na odzii atsɛmbu na tseneneesɛm maa ne man nyinara.
Na Zeruiah ba Joab na ɔhwɛ dɔm no do; na Ahilud ba Jehoshaphat nye ɔsɛnkaafo.
Na Ahitub ba Zadok, na Abiathar ba Abimelech, nye asɔfo; na Shavsha nye ɔkyerɛwfo;
na Jehoaida ba Benaiah na ɔhwɛ Cherethfo na Pelethfo no do; na David mba no na wɔyɛ etsitsir wɔ ɔhen no nkyɛn.
19: Na iyi ekyir no ɔbaa dɛ Ammonmba hɔn hen Nahash wui, na ne ba bedzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.

Na David see dɛ, mebɛyɛ Nahash ba Hanun ayamuyie, osiandɛ n'egya yɛɛ me ayamuyie, nna David somaa abɔfo dɛ wɔnkɛkyekye no werɛ wɔ n'egya ntsi. Na David no nkowaa baa Hanum nkyɛn wɔ Ammonmba asaase no do, dɛ wɔrebɛkyekye no werɛ.

Nna Ammonmba asafohemfo ne see Hanum dɛ ana edwen dɛ David odzi w'egya nnyi ntsi na ɔasoma akyekyewerɛfo wɔ wo nkyɛn yi? Ana no nkowaa yi ammba wo nkyɛn dɛ wɔrobɔhwehwɛ asaase yi, woebobutuw no, na wɔaserasera ahwɛ bi a?
Nna Hanum faa David no nkowaa no, na oyiyii hɔn, na otwitwaa hɔn ntar mu finimfin finimfin araa dze bodur hɔn nserɛekyir, na ogyaa hɔn kwan.

Nna obi sii mu kɔree, na ɔkɛkãa mbrɛ wɔdze yɛɛ mbarimba no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ David. Na ɔsomae ma wokehyiaa hɔn kwan; osiandɛ woegu mbarimba no enyim ase kɛse. Na ɔhen no see dɛ. Hom ntsintsim wɔ Jerico ma onkodu dɛ hom mbɔdwesa bofuw, ana nkyii hom asan aba.
Na aber a Ammonmba no hun dɛ hɔn ho abɔn David no, Hanum na Ammonmba no wɔdze dwetɛ talent apem somae ma wɔdze kɛgyee Mesopotamia, na Arammaacah, na Zobah ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo asa.
Nna wɔgyee nntseaseanam mpemeduasaebien, na Maacahhen na ne man asa; hɔn a wɔbae bɛkyeer nsera wɔ Medeba enyim. Na Ammonmba no fifii hɔn nkuriow mu poon hɔnho hyiae, na wɔbaa ɔsa.
Na aber a David tsee no, nna ɔsomaa Joab, na mbarimba akatakyi dɔm no nyinara ma wɔkɔree.
Na Ammonmba no puei, na wɔbaabaa mpasuar wɔ kurow no mu kuropon ano: Na ahemfo no a wɔbae no hɔnara nko wɔtsenae wɔ haban no mu.
Afei aber a Joab hun dɛ ɔkõ no wɔ n'enyim na n'ekyir no, nna ɔpaa Israel mu mbarimba a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn nyinara mu bi, na ɔmaa wɔbaae kehyiaa Syriafo no.
Na nkorɔfo nkaa no ɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ no nua Abishai nsa, na wɔbaa hɔnho mu kɔr Ammonmba no do.
Na ɔsee dɛ, sɛ Syriafo no yɛ dzen dodow ma me a, ɔno bɔboa me: Na sɛ Ammonmba no yɛ dzen dodow ma wo a, ɔno mo so mobɔboa wo.
Nya akokodur, na ma yɛnyɛ hɛnho mbarimba mma hɛn man, na hɛn Nyankopɔn no nkurow no: Na Ewuradze nyɛ dza oye wɔ n'enyiwa do.
Nna Joab na nkorɔfo a wɔkã no ho no twee piin Syriafo no enyim dze kɔbɔɔ enyim; na woguanee wɔ n'enyim.
Na aber a Ammonmba no hun dɛ Syriafo no eguan no, nna hɔn so woguanee wɔ no nua Abishai enyim, na wɔkɛhɛɛn kurow no mu. Nna Joab baa Jerusalem.
Na aber a Syriafo nno hun dɛ woegu wɔ Israel enyim no, nna wɔsomaa abɔfo, ma wɔkɔpoon Syriafo a wɔwɔ Esutsen egya no bae, dɛ Hadarezer no dɔm safohen Shophach na odzi hɔn enyim.
Na wɔbɛkãa kyerɛɛ David; na ɔpoon Israel nyinara hyiae, na okotwaa Jordan, na ɔbaa hɔn do, na ɔbaa hɔn do mpasuar hyia hɔn. Dɛm ntsi aber a David baa mpasuar hyia Syriafo no, nna wɔnye no kõe.
Na Syriafo no guanee wɔ Israel enyim, na David kunkum Syriafo mu ntseaseanammufo no mumpemesuon, na anamɔnmufo no mu mpemesuon, na anamɔnmufo no mu mpemeduanan, na okum dɔm safohen panyin Shophach.
Na aber a Hadarezer no nkowaa no hundɛ woegu wɔ Israel enyim no, wɔnye David siesiei, na wɔsoom no: Nkyii so Syriafo no ammpɛ dɛ wɔboa Ammonmba no bio.
20: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a n'afedan no durii no, aber a ahemfo wotu sa mu no, nna Joab dze dɔm no n'ahoɔdzen no kɔree kɛsɛɛ Ammonmba man no, na wokotuaa Rabbah. Na David dze, otsintsimii wɔ Jerusalem. Na Joab bɔɔ Rabbah, na obutuuw no.
Na David yii hɔn hen n'ahenkyɛw no wɔ ne tsir, na ohun dɛ ɔtow sika talent, na no mu wɔ aboɔdzen abo; na wɔdze hyɛɛ David nne tsir: Na ɔdze kurow no mu asadze piigyan mbordo puei bae.

Na ɔdze nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ mu no puei bae, na ɔdze nseradaa, na dadze dɛtseporoweedze, na nkuma twitwaa hɔn. Na mbrɛ David dze yɛɛ Ammonmba nkurow no nyinara nye no. Na David na ɔman no nyinara sanee baa Jerusalem.
Na iyi ekyir no ɔbaa dɛ Philistiafo no nyaa ɔkõ wɔ Gezer: Nna Hushathnyi Sibbecai kum Sippai a ɔyɛ ɔkraban no ne mba no mu bi no: Na wɔbrɛɛ hɔn adze.
Na wɔnye Philistiafo nyaa ɔkõ bio; na Jair ne ba Elhanan kum Gittinyi Goliath no nua Lahmi a ne peaa no kura tse dɛ ɔtanwemfo n'asadua.
Na ɔkõ baa bio wɔ Gath, mbrɛ ɔbarimba pankor bi a ne nsatseaba na n'anansɔba yɛ eduonu anan, nsakum kor do esia, na anansa kor do esia; na ɔno so wɔwoo no maa ɔkraban.
Na aber a orutwitwa Israel mpowa no, David nua Shimea ne ba Jonathan kum no.
Woyinom na wɔwoo hɔn maa ɔkraban no wɔ Gath; na wɔtotɔree wɔ David, na no nkowaa no hɔn nsaano.
21: Na Satan gyinaa Israel do tsentsen, na onuu David mu dɛ ɔnkɛkan Israel.
Na David see Joab na ɔman no mu asafohemfo no dɛ, hom nkɔ nkɛkan Israel mfi Beer-sheba araa nkodu Dan na hom mbɛkã nkyerɛ me, ma munhu hɔn dodow.

Na Joab see dɛ, Ewuradze nyɛ ne man dɛ mbrɛ wɔtse yi mpɛn ɔha so nkã ho: Na, mo wura ɔhen, ana hɔn nyinara nnyɛ mo wura ɔhen, ana hɔn nyinara nnyɛ mo wura no nkowaa bi a? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mo wura rohwehwɛ dɛm adze yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔnoara bɛyɛ asodzi ama Israel?
Naaso ɔhen no n'asɛm yɛɛ dzen wɔ Joab do. Dɛm ntsi Joab fiir edzi na osii mu kekyinii faa Israel nyinara mu, na ɔbaa Jerusalɛm.
Na Joab dze ɔman hɔn anobu no dodow no brɛɛ David. Na hɔn a wofi Israel mu nyinara wɔyɛ apempem na mbarimba mpemɔha a wɔtwee afõwa: Na Judah yɛ mbarimba mpemahaananeduosuon a wɔtwee afõwa.
Na Levi na Benjamin dze, ɔannkan hɔn ammfora: Osiandɛ ɔhen n'asɛm no yɛɛ Joab tantan.
Na Nyankopɔn ammpɛ dɛm adze yi; dɛm ntsi ɔbɔɔ Israel.
Na David see Nyankopɔn dɛ, mayɛ bɔn kɛsenara, dɛ mayɛ dɛm adze yi: Na afei, meserɛ wo, yi w'akowaa no bɔn kɔ; na mayɛ nkwaseadze dodow.
Na Ewuradze dze kãa kyerɛɛ Gad, David n'adzehunyi no, dɛ,
Kɔ na kɛkã kyerɛ David dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, nzɛmba ebiasa na medze si w'enyim; fa no mu kor, na menyɛ mma wo.
Na Gad baa David nkyɛn, na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, Fa mu dza epɛ;

dɛ mfe ebiasa ɔkɔm; anaa abosoom ebiasa a wɔbɛsɛɛ wo wɔ w'atamfo enyim aber a w'atamfo afõwa roto wo; anaaso Ewuradze n'afõwa roto wo; anaaso Ewuradze n'afõwa, mekyerɛ asaase no do nyimpa ɔyardɔm, ndaansa a, na Ewuradze no bɔfoe resɛɛ nyimpa wɔ Israel mbew nyinara do. Afei hwɛ mbuae kor ma memfa mensan menkɛma nyia ɔsoma me no.
Na David see Gad dɛ, Mo ho akyer me papaara: Afei ma monhwe Ewuradze nsamu; na n'adɔyɛ dɔɔ sõ dodow: Na mma monnhwe ɔdasanyi nsamu.
Nna Ewuradze maa ɔyardɔm baa Israel do: Na Israel mu nyimpa mpemeduosuon wuwui.

Na Nyankopɔn somaa ɔbɔfo ma ɔkɔr Jerusalɛm dɛ ɔnkɛsɛɛ no: Na aber a ɔrebɛsɛɛ no, nna Ewuradze hwɛe, na onuu noho wɔ bɔn no ho, na ɔsee ɔbɔfo a ɔresɛɛ no dɛ, ayɛ yie; afei gyina wo nsa. Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no gyinaa Jebusnyi Ornan n'ewuporowee no ho.

Na David maa n'enyiwa do, na ohun Ewuradze no bɔfoe no dɛ ogyina asaase na ɔsor ntamu. na afõwa a wɔatwe kitsa ne nsamu, na ɔatsen no wɔ Jerusalem do. Nna David na amanmpanyin no a wofurafura eyitam no, dze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu.

Na David see Nyankopɔn dɛ, ana nnyɛ mara na mehyɛɛ dɛ wɔnkan ɔman no? Mbom mara nye nyia ɔayɛ bɔn na ɔabɔ mbusu yi; naa nguan yi dze, ɛbɛnadze na wɔayɛ? M'Ewuradze Nyankopɔn. Meserɛ wo, na wo nsa mbra emi, na m'egya fi do; na mma ɔmmba wo man do, ma wɔnnhaw.
Nna Ewuradze no bɔfoe no hyɛɛ Gad dɛ ɔnkɛse David dɛ David ɔmfow nkɔ nkesi afɔrmbukyia mma Ewuradze wɔ Jebusnyi Ornan n'ewuporowee ho.
Na David fowee kɔree dɛ mbrɛ Gad n'asɛm a ɔkãe no Ewuradze ne dzin mu no tse.
Na Ornan daan noho, na ohun ɔbɔfo no; na ne mbabanyin baanan a wɔkã no ho no wɔdze hɔnho sumae. Nna Ornan roporow ewifua.
Na aber a David dur Ornan nkyɛn no, Ornan hwɛe na ohun David, na ofiir edzi fii ewuporowee ho, na ɔkotoow David na ɔdze n'enyim boom famu.
Nna David see Ornan dɛ, fa ewuporoweebea yi ma me, ma minsi do afɔrmbukyia memma Ewuradze: No bo a odzi ara pɛr na fa ma me: Ma woeesianka ɔyardɔm no efi ɔman no do.

Na Ornan see David dɛ, Gye fa, na ma mo wura ɔhen nyɛ dza oye wɔ n'enyiwa do: Hwɛ, mema wo anantwi a wɔdze bɔbɔ ɔhyewafɔr, na ɔporow ndadze a wɔdze bɛpaa nyena, na ewifua a wɔdze bɛyɛ edziban-afɔr medze ne nyinaa mema.
Na ɔhen David see Ornan dɛ, oho; na ɔtɔ ara na mebɛma bo a odzi matɔ: Na mennkɛfa adze a ɔyɛ wodze mama Ewuradze, dɛ medze adze a annsom me bo mobɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr.
Nna David maa Ornan sika a woeker shekel ahaesia dze tɔɔ bea no.
Na David sii hɔ afɔrmbukyia maa Ewuradze, na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr na asomdwee afɔr, na ɔfrɛɛ Ewuradze; na ɔdze gya fi sor gyee no do wɔ ɔhyew afɔrmbukyia no do.
Na Ewuradze hyɛɛ ɔbɔfo no; na ɔdze n'afõwa no sanee hyɛɛ bɔha no mu.
Aber no a David hun dɛ Ewuradze agye no do wɔ Jebusnyi Ornan ewuporowee no, nna ɔbɔɔ afɔr wɔ hɔ.
Na Ewuradze ne ntamadan a Moses yɛe no wɔ sar no do, na ɔhyewafɔr mbukyia no wɔ sorɔnsorɔmbea a ɔwɔ Gibeon no aber no mu.
Naaso David enntum annkɔ ɔno n'enyim ennkebisa Nyankopɔn: Na osuroi wɔ Ewuradze no bɔfoe afõwa no ntsi.
22: Nna David see dɛ, iyi nye Ewuradze Nyankopɔn ne fi no, na iyi nye Israel ɔhyew afɔrmbukyia.
Na David hyɛe ma wɔkɔboaboaa ahɔho a wɔwɔ Israel no ano; na osisii aboedwimfo dɛ wɔmpaa abo a wɔasen mfa nsi Nyamkopɔn ne fi no.
Na David siesiee dadze piigyan a wɔmfa mbɔ mbobotsenano apon ho mprɛgow, na nkrɔkrɔw no; na boran piigyan a onnyi nkerii;
na cedar ndua a onnyi anobu: Na Zidonfo na Tyrefo dze cedar ndua piigyan brɛɛ David.

Na David see dɛ, me ba Solomon yɛ abofra a ɔyɛ mberɛw, na ofi a wobesi ama Ewuradze no ɔnyɛ kɛse paara, ɔnyɛ dzin na enyimnyam wɔ asaase nyinara do: Dɛm ntsi mebɛyɛ ahosiesie mama no. Nna David siesiee pii pa ana oruwu.
Nna ɔfrɛɛ ne ba Solomon, na ɔhyɛɛ no dɛ onsi ofi mma Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no.
Na David see ne ba Solomon dɛ, emidze, ɔwɔ m'akoma mu dɛ nkyɛ mibesi ofi mama Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn ne dzin.
Na Ewurade n'asɛm baa mo hɔ dɛ, ɔwo akã bɔgya egu dodow, na edzi akõ akɛse: Mma ɔwo nnsi ofi mma me dzin, osiandɛ ɔwo akã bɔgya pii egu famu wɔ m'enyim:
Hwɛ, wɔbɔwo ɔbarimba ama wo, ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ ahomgye nyimpa; na mebɛma no ahomgye efi n'atamfo nyinara ho ehyia: Na wɔbɛfrɛ e dzin Solomon, na medze asomdwee na kommyɛ mebɛma Israel wɔ ne nda mu:
Ɔno na obesi ofi ama me dzin na ɔbɛyɛ me ɔba, na emi so mayɛ no egya; na mebɛma n'ahendzi egua no etsim wɔ Israel do daa.
Afei, me ba, Ewuradze ndzi w'ekyir; na yɛ prɔmprɔm, na si Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ne fi no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔakã wɔ wo ho no.
Adwenmutsewee na nteasee ara na Ewuradze mfa mma wo, na ɔnhyɛ wo Israel ho mbra; ma ɔnam dɛm do eedzi Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ne mbra do.
ɔno na ebɛyɛ prɔmprɔm, sɛ idzi ahyɛdze na atsɛmbudze a Ewuradze dze hyɛɛ Moses wɔ Israel ho no do a: Hyɛ dzen, na nya akokodur; mma nnsuro, eso mma wo ho nntu.

Afei, hwɛ, m'ahohia mu na mesiesie Ewuradze ne fi ho sika talent mpemɔha, na dwetɛ talent pepem; na boran na dadze a wonnyi nkerii; na ɔdɔɔ sõ piigyan: Ndua na abo so mesiesie; na ɔwoara edze ni aakã ho.
Nkyii so edwimfo piigyan wɔ wo nkyɛn, abopaafo na abo na ndua edwimfo, na nkorɔfo a wɔawea edwuma nyinara ho nyinara;
sika, dwetɛ, na boran, na dadze no nnyi anobu; soɛr na yɛ, na Ewuradze ndzi w'ekyir.
David hyɛɛ Israel asafohen no so dɛ wɔmboa ne ba Solomon, dɛ,
aso nnyɛ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn na odzi hom ekyir? Ana ɔmmaa hom ahomgye wɔ hom ho nyinara nnhyiae? Na ɔdze asaase no do atsefo no ahyɛ me nsa; na wɔabrɛ asaase no adze wɔ Ewuradze na ne man enyim.

Afei hom mfa hom akoma na hom akra enyi do dɛ hom bɔhwehwɛ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn pɔn ekyir kwan; dɛm ntsi hom nsoɛr nkesi Ewuradze Nyankopɔn no krɔnkrɔn-bea no, dɛ wɔdze Ewuradze n'ahyɛmudaka no, na Nyankopɔn ne ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn bɛba ofi a wobesi ama Ewuradze ne dzin no.
23: Afei David yɛɛ akɔdaa na odzii mfe pii; na ɔdze ne ba Solomon sii Israel do hen.
Na ɔboaa Israel asafohen nyinara, ɔnye asɔfo na Levifo no ano hyiae.
Na wɔkaan Levifo no, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa na ekyir no: Na hɔn dodow dɛ mbrɛ wosi a wɔyɛ mbarimba ara nko yɛ mpemeduasaawɔtwe.
Woyinom mu mpemeduonuanan na wɔnhwɛ Ewuradze fie edwuma no do; na mpemesia nyɛ akyerɛwfo na atsɛmbuafo:
Na mpemanan nyɛ abowanoahwɛfo; na mpemanan mfa ndzɛmba a, David dɛ, meyɛe memaa ayɛyi no nyi Ewuradze ayɛw.
Na David kyekyɛɛ hɔn mu ebupɛn ebupɛn dɛ mbrɛ Levi mba tse; Gershon, Kohath, na Merari.
Gershonfo dze Ladan na Shimei.
Ladanmba otsitsir Jehiel, na Zetham, na Joel, baasa.
Shimeimba; Shelomoth, na Haziel, na Haran, baasa. Woyinom nye Ladan egyanom etsitsir.
Na Shimeimba; Jahath, Zina, na Jeush, na Beriah. Baanan yinom nye Shimeimba.
Na Jahath nye otsitsir, na Zizah tsiã hɔ: Na Jeush na Beriah ennya mba pii; dɛm ntsi wɔbɛyɛɛ egyanom fi kor wɔ nkanee kor mu.
Kohath ne mba; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, na Uzziel, baanan.

Amram ne mba; Aaron na Moses: Na woyii Aaron sii nkyɛn, dɛ ɔntsew akrɔnkrɔndze no ho, ɔno na ne mba, nkesi daa, dɛ wɔnhyew eduhuam wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na wɔnsom no, na wonhyira wɔ ne dzin mu, nkesi daa.
Na Moses, Nyame nyimpa no dze, wɔbɔɔ ne mba no edzin foraa Levi ebusuakuw no mu.
Moses ne mba; Gershom na Eliezer.
Gershom ne mba; Shebuel otsitsir.
Na Eliezer ne mba, Rehabiah otsitsir. Na Eliezer ennya mba bi so bio; na Rehabiah mba na wɔdɔɔ sõ dodow.
Izhar ne mba; Shelomith otsitsir.
Hebron ne mba; Jeriah otsitsir, Amariah tsīa hɔ, Jahaziel tsīa ebiasa, na Jekameam tsia anan.
Uzziel ne mba; Micah otsitsir, na Isshiah tsīa hɔ.
Merari ne mba; Mahli na Mushi. Mahli ne mba; Eleazar na Kish.
Na Eleazar wui, na oennya mbabanyin, dɛ mbabaa ara nko: Na hɔn nuanom Kish mbabanyin no warwaar hɔn.
Mushi ne mba; Mahli, na Eder, na Jeremoth, baasa.
Woyinom nye Levimba no, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tse, mekyerɛ egyanom mu etsitsir mu hɔn a wɔkan hɔn wɔyɛ Ewuradze fie ɔsom-edwuma no a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir no.
Na David see dɛ, Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no ama ne man asomdwee; na ɔtse Jerusalem afebɔɔ.
Na eso onnkehia ama Levifo no dɛ wɔsoa ntamadan no na no som ho ndzɛmba no nyina bio.
Na wɔnam David ne nsɛm a odzi ekyir no do kaan Levimba no hɔn dodow, ofitsi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir no.
Na hɔn gyinabew wɔ Aaronmba no enyim dɛ wɔyɛ Ewuradze fie ɔsom-edwuma no, wɔ abanguado, na mpia mu, na wɔtsew akrɔnkrɔndze nyinara ho, mekyerɛ Ewuradze fie ɔsom-edwuma no;
na kyerɛpaanoo no so, na edzibanafɔr epitsi ntatar dze, anaa dza wɔakyew no wɔ sɛn mu, anaa dza wɔafɔw, na etwadze na esusudze nyinara;
na wongyina hɔ anapa daa wɔnda Ewuradze ase wonyi no ayɛw, na ewimbir so dɛmara;
na wɔmbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr nyina mma Ewuradze, wɔ ahomgyenda mu, na abosoom fofor mu, na afahyɛ mu, no dodow mu dɛ mbrɛ atɔrmuadze tse daa nyina wɔ Ewuradze enyim:
na dɛ wɔnhwɛ ehyiadzi ntamadan ahwɛdze, na krɔnkrɔn-bea ahwɛdze, na hɔn nuanom Aaronmba ahwɛdze no mfa nsom Ewuradze ne fi no.
24: Na Aaronmba no hɔn mu nkyekyɛmu nye yinom. Aaron ne mba; Nadab na Abihu, Eleazer na Ithamar.
Na Nadab na Abihu dzii hɔn egya enyim wuwui, na woennya mba: Dɛm ntsi Eleazar na Ithamar bedzii asɔfo.
Na David kyekyɛɛ hɔn mu, mekyerɛ Zadok a ofi Eleazarmba mu, na Ahimelech a ofi Ithamarmba mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dwumayɛ dzibew tse wɔ hɔn som no mu.
Na wohun Eleazarmba mu mbarimba etsitsir pii seen Ithamarmba mu, na wɔkyekyɛɛ hɔn mu: Eleazarmba nyaa egyanom efi etsitsir duesia na Ithamarmba, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn efi tsetsee, awɔtwe.
Dɛm na wosii dze tonto kyekyɛɛ hɔn mu, yinom nye yinom; na krɔnkrɔn-bea asafohen na Nyankopɔn n'asafohen no nyina fi Eleazarmba mu, na Ithamarmba mu.

Na ɔkyerɛwfo Nethanel a ofi Levifo mu no ne ba Shemaiah kyerɛɛw hɔn wɔ ɔhen, na asafohen, na ɔsɔfo Zadok, na Abiathar ba Ahimelech, na asɔfo na Levifo egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir no enyim: Woyii egyanom fi kor maa Eleazar, na woyii kor so maa Ithamar.
Afei kyɛfa a odzi kan no bae maa Jehoiarib, dza otsiã ebien no bae maa Jedaiah;
dza otsiã ebiasa no bae maa Harim, dza otsiã anan no bae maa Seorim;
dza otsiã enum no bae maa Malchijah, dza otsiã esia no bae maa Mijamin;
dza otsiã esuon no bae maa Hakkoz, dza otsiã awɔtwe no bae maa Abijah;
dza otsiã akron no bae maa Jeshua, dza otsiã du no bae maa Shecaniah;
dza otsiã dubiako no bae maa Eliashib, dza otsiã duebien no bae maa Jakim;
dza otsiã duebiasa no bae maa Huppah, dza otsiã duanan no bae maa Jeshebeab;
dza otsiã duenum no bae maa Bilgah, dza otsiã duesia no bae maa Immer:
Dza otsiã duesuon no bae maa Hezir, dza otsiã duawɔtwe no bae maa Happizzez;
dza otsiã duakron no bae maa Pethahiah, dza otsiã eduonu no bae maa Jehezkel;
dza otsiã eduonu biako no bae maa Jachin, dza otsiã eduonu ebien no bae maa Gamul;
dza otsiã eduonu ebiasa no bae maa Delaiah, dza otsiã eduonu anan no bae maa Maaziah.
Iyi nye hɔn dwumayɛ dzibew wɔ hɔn som no mu, dɛ wɔnhɛn Ewuradze fie dɛ mbrɛ atɔrmuadze a wɔnam hɔn egya Aaron nsa do dze maa hɔn no tse, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no hyɛɛ no no.
Na Levimba nkaa no dze: Amram mba dze, Shubael; Shubael mba dze, Jehseiah.
Rehabiah dze; Rehabiah mba dze, Isshiah otsitsir no.
Izharfo dze, Shelomoth; Shelomoth mba dze, Jahath.
Na Hebron ne mba: Jeriah otsitsir, Amariah tsiã hɔ, Jahaziel tsiã ebiasa, Jekameam tsiã anan.
Uzziel ne mba, Micah; Micah mba dze, Shamir.
Micah no nua, Isshiah: Isshiah mba dza, Zechariah.
Merari ne mba; Mahli na Mushi: Jaaziah ne mba; Beno.
Merari ne mba; Jaaziah dze, Beno, na Shoham, na Zaccur, na Ibri.
Mahli dze; Eleazar, ɔno a oennya mba.
Kish dze; Kish ne mba, Jerahmeel.
Na Mushi ne mba; Mahli, na Eder, na Jerimoth. Woyinom nye Levifo mba dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee no.

Woyinom so twee tonto dɛ hɔn nuanom Aaronmba no ara wɔ ɔhen David, na Zadok na Ahimelech, na asɔfo no na Levifo egyanom efi mu etsitsir no enyim; otsitsir no n'egyanom efi dɛ no nua kuma no dze no ara.
