25: Nkyii so David na dɔm no asofohen no yiyii Asaph, na Heman, na Jeduthun mba no mu hɔn a wɔnsom mfa nsankutsen, na mbɛntasanku, na akasamu nhyɛ nkɔm: Na hɔn a wɔyɛɛ edwuma dɛ mbrɛ hɔn som tse no hɔn dodow nye yi:
Asaph mba mu; Zaccur, na Joseph, na Nethaniah, na Asharelah, Asaph ne mba a wɔwɔ Asaph ne nsano, hɔn a wɔhyɛɛ ɔhen no ne nsaano nkɔm.
Jeduthun dze: Jeduthun ne mba; Gedaliah, na Zeri, na Jeshaiah, Hashabiah na Mattithiah, beesia; hɔn a wɔwɔ hɔn egya Jeduthum ne nsaano, wɔdze nsankutsen hyɛɛ nkɔm wɔdze ndaase na ayɛyi maa Ewuradze.
Heman dze: Heman ne mba; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, na Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, na Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth:
Wonyim nyinara nye Heman ne mba, ɔno nye ɔhen n'adzehunyi no, dɛ ɔmfa Nyankopɔn ne sɛm mu mma abɛn do. Na Nyankopɔn maa Heman mbabanyin duanan na mbabaa baasa.
Wonyinom nyinara wɔ hɔn egya ne nsaano, wɔ Ewuradze fie adwontow no mu, dzedze nkasaa, mbɛntaasanku, na nsankutsen som Nyankopɔn fie; Asaph, Jeduthun, na Heman wɔwɔ ɔhen no ne nsaano.
Na wɔnye hɔn nuanom a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ hɔn Ewuradze fie adwontow no, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ ho enyansafo no nyinara hɔn dodow yɛ ahaenu eduowɔtwe awɔtwe.
Na wɔtwee hɔn ɔhwɛ-edwuma no ho tonto, hɔn nyinara pɛr, ekumaba dɛ ɔkɛse, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo dɛ osuanyi.
Afei kyɛfa a odzi kan a ɔyɛ Asaph dze no bae maa Joseph: Dza otsīa ebien no bae maa Gedaliah; ɔno na no nuanom na ne mba wɔyɛ duebien:
Dza otsīa ebiasa no bae maa Zaccur, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien;
dza otsīa enum no bae maa Nethaniel, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
Dza otsīa esia bae maa Bukkiah, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
Dza otsīa esuon no bae maa Jesharelah, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
Dza otsīa awɔtwe no bae maa Jeshaiah, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien
Dza otsīa akron no bae maa Mattaniah, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
Dza otsīa du no bae maa Shimei, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
Dza otsīa dubiako no bae maa Azarel, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
Dza otsīa duebien no bae maa Hashabiah, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
Dza otsīa duebiasa no bae maa Shubael, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
Dza otsīa duanan no bae maa Mattithiah, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
Dza otsīa duenum no bae maa Jeremoth, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
Dza otsīa duesia no bae maa Hananiah ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
Dza otsīa duesuon no bae maa Joshbekashah, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
Dza otsīa duawɔtwe no bae maa Hanani, ne mba na no nuanom duebien:
Dza otsīa duakron no bae maa Malloth, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
Dza otsīa eduonu no bae maa Eliathah, ne mba na no nuano, duebien:
Dza otsīa eduonu biako no bae maa Hothir, ne mba na nuanom, duebien:
Dza otsīa eduonu ebien no bae maa Giddalti, ne mba na no nuanom duebien:
Dza otsīa eduonu ebiasa no bae maa Mahazioth, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
Dza otsīa eduonu anan no bae maa Romamti-ezer, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien.
26: Abowanoahwɛfo no mu nkyekyɛmu nye yi: Korahfo no mu; Kore ba Meshelemiah a ofi Asaph mba mu.
Na Meshelemiah nyaa mba; Zechariah n'abakan, Jediael tsīa hɔ, Zebadiah tsīa ebiasa, Jathniel tsīa anan.
Elam tsīa enum, Jehohanan tsīa esia, Eliehoenai tsīa esuon.
Na Obed-edom nyaa mba; Shemaiah n'abakan, Jehozabad tsīa hɔ, Joah tsīa ebiasa, na Sacar tsīa anan, na Nethanel tsīa enum;
Ammiel tsīa esia, Issachar tsīa esuon, Peullethai tsīa awɔtwe; na Nyankopɔn hyiraa no.
Na ne ba Shemaiah so wɔwoo mba maa no a wɔhwɛɛ hɔn egya fie do; na wɔyɛ mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam.
Shemaiah ne mba; Othni, na Raphael, na Obed, Elzabad, no nuanom wɔyɛ mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam, Elihu, na Semachiah.
Woyinom nyinara fi Obed-edom ne mba mu: Wɔnye hɔn mba na hɔn nuanom, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔwɔ ɔsom mu ahoɔdzen; eduosia ebien a wɔyɛ Obed-edom dze.
Na Meshelemiah nyaa mba na enuanom, mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam duawɔtwe.
Hosah a ofi Merarimba mu no so nyaa mba; Shimri otsitsir, (ɔnnyɛ abakan dze, naaso n'egya yɛɛ no otsitsir);
Hilkiah tsīa hɔ, Tebaliah tsīa ebiasa, Zechariah tsīa anan: Hosah mba na no nuanom nyinara wɔyɛ duebiasa.
Woyinom nye abowanahwɛfo no hɔn nkyekyɛmu, mbrɛ mbarimba etsitsir no tsetsee; wɔwɔ ɔweɔn-edwuma dɛ hɔn nuanom no ara so, dɛ wɔnsom wɔ Ewuradze fie.
Na wɔtwee tonto, ekumaba tse dɛ ɔkɛse, dɛ mbrɛ hɔ egyanom efi tsetsee, wɔ kuropon biara ano.
Na boka afamu tonto no bɔɔ Shelemiah. Nna ne ba Zechariah a ɔyɛ nyimdzee mu ɔfotunyi no wɔtwee no ho tonto; na e kyɛfa kedzii kwaamu afamu.
Na Obed-edom dze wɔ pomu afamu; na ne mba dze nye akoradzedan no.
Shuppim na Hosah dze wɔ anee afamu, Shallecheth kuropon ho, afowee tsempɔn no do, ɔweɔn na ɔweɔn dzi abɔenyim.
Levifo beesia wɔ boka afamu, baaan wɔ kwaamu afamu da kor, na akoradzedan no ho dze, beenu beenu.
Parbar dze, ɔwɔ anee afamu, baanan wɔ tsempɔn no ano, na beenu wɔ Parbar ho.
Woyinom nye abowanoahwɛfo no hɔn nkyekyɛmu; Korahfo mba, a Merarimba no mu.
Na Levifo no mu bi, Ahijah hwɛ Nyankopɔn fie akoradze na akrɔnkrɔndze akoradze no do.
Ladan ne mba; Gershonfo mba a wɔyɛ Ladan dze no, egyanom efi mu etsitsir a wɔyɛ Gershonnyi Ladan dze no; Jehieli.
Jehieli ne mba; Zetham, na no nua Joel a wɔhwɛ Ewuradze fie akoradze no do.
Amramfo, Azharfo, Hebronfo, Uzzielfo, no mu:
Na Moses ne ba Hershom ne ba Shebuel na odzi akoradze no do ɔpanyin.
Na no nuanom; Eliezer dze mu na ne ba Rehabiah, na ne ba Jeshariah, na ne ba Joram, na ne ba Zichri, na ne ba Shelomoth fi bae.

Shelomoth yi na no nuanom na wodzii akrɔnkrɔndze a ɔhen David, na n'egyanom efi mu etsitsir no, apem apem na ɔha ɔha do asafohen na dɔm do asafohen na no yɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn no nyinara akoradze do mpanyin.
Akodzi mu asadze mu bi na wɔyɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn dɛ wɔdze repempam Ewuradze ne fi no.
Na ndzɛmba nyinara so a adzehunyi Samuel, na Saul Kish ba, na Abner Ner ba, na Joab Zeruiah ba yɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn no; obiara n'adze biara a ɔayɛ no krɔnkrɔn no, ɔwɔ Shelomoth, na no nuanom nsaase.
Izharfo mu Chenaniah na ne mba a wɔhwɛ Israel kwasafo edwuma no do, dɛ wɔyɛ akyerɛwfo na atsɛmbuafo.
Hebronfo mu, Hashabiah na no nuanom, mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam, apem ahaesuon, na wɔhwɛ Israel do wɔ Jordan egya anee afamu; wɔ Ewuradze n'edwuma nyinara, na ɔhen no no som afamu.

Hebronfo mu na otsitsir Jerijah wɔ, mekyerɛ Hebronfo no mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi mu ebusuasantsen tse. David ahendzi mu afe a otsīa eduanan mu na wɔhwehwɛɛ hɔn, na wohun hɔn mu mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam wɔ Jazer a ɔwɔ Gilead.

Na no nuanom, mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam no, wɔyɛ mpemebien ahaesuon, egyanom efi etsitsir a David dze hɔn sisii Reubenfo, na Gadfo, na Manassehfo ebusua fã no do, wɔ asɛm biara a ɔfa Nyankopɔn ho, na ɔhen no no ho nsɛm ho.
27: Afei Israelmba a woebu hɔn ano, dɛ, efi mu etsitsir na apem apem na ɔha ɔha do asafohen, na hɔn ahwɛdofo a wɔsoom ɔhen no, wɔ nkyekyɛmu horow no nsɛm nyinara mu, hɔn a wɔbaa mu na hɔn a wofiir edzi bosoom bosoom wɔ afrenhyia abosoom nyinara mu, wɔ nkyekyɛmu biara mu no yɛ nyimpa mpemeduonuanan.
Bosoom a odzi kan no mu nkyekyɛmu a odzi kan no do na Zabdiel ba Jashobeam hwɛ: Na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu nyimpa wɔyɛ mpemeduonuanan.
Ofi Perez mba mu, dɔm no do asafohen nyinara mu otsitsir wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu.
Na bosoom a otsīa ebien ne nkyekyɛmu no do na Ahohnyi Dodai hwɛ, na ne nkyekyɛmu no do ɔpanyin nye Mikloth: Na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonuanan.
Bosoom a otsīa ebiasa no dɔm a otsīa ebiasa no do safohen nye Benaiah, ɔsɔfo Jehoiada ne ba, otsitsir no; na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonuanan.
Iyi nye Benaiah no a ɔyɛ eduasa no mu ɔbarimba katakyi a ɔhwɛ eduasa no do: Na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu na ne ba Ammizabad dzi.
Safohen a otsīa anan wɔ bosoom a otsīa anan no mu no nye Asahel, Joab no nua no, na ne ba Zebediah dzii n'ekyir: Na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonuanan.
Safohen a otsīa enum wɔ bosoom a otsīa enum no mu no nye Izrahnyi Shamhuth: Na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonuanan.
Safohen a otsīa esia wɔ bosoom a otsīa esia no mu no nye Tekoanyi Ikkesh ne ba Ira: Na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonuanan.
Safohen a otsīa esuon wɔ bosoom a otsīa esuon no mu no nye Pelonnyi Helez, ofi Ephraimmba mu: Na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonuanan.
Safohen a otsīa awɔtwe wɔ bosoom a otsīa awɔtwe no mu no nye Hushahnyi Sibbecai, ofi Zerahfo mu: Na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonuanan.
Safohen a otsīa akron wɔ bosoom a otsīa akron no mu no nye Anathothnyi Abiezer, ofi Benjaminfo mu: Na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonuanan.
Safohen a otsīa du wɔ bosoom a otsīa du no mu no nye Netophathnyi Maharai, ofi Zerahfo mu: Na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonuanan.
Safohen a otsīa dubiako wɔ bosoom a otsīa dubiako no mu no nye Pirathonnyi Benaiah, ofi Ephraimmba mu: Na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonuanan.
Safohen a otsīa duebien wɔ bosoom a otsīa duebien no mu no nye Netophathnyi Heldai, ofi Othniel: Na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonuanan.
Nkyii so hɔn a wɔhwɛ Israel ebusuakuw duebien no do: Reubenfo hwɛdofo nye Zichri ba Eliezer: Simeonfo mu, Maacah ba Shephatiah:
Levi mu, Kemuel ba Hashabiah: Aaron mu, Zadok.
Judah mu, Elihu, David no nuanom no mu baako: Issachar mu, Michael ba Omri:
Zebulun mu, Obadiah ba Ishmaiah: Naphtali mu, Azriel ba Jeremoth:
Ephraimmba mu, Azaziah ba Hoshea: Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no mu, Pedaiah ba Joel:
Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no a ɔwɔ Gilead no mu, Zechariah ba Iddo: Benjamin mu, Abner ba Jaasiel.
Dan mu, Jeroham ba Azarel. Woyinom nye Israel ebusuakuw do asafohen.
Na David emmbu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na hɔn a wonndzii no ano: Osiandɛ Ewuradze akã dɛ ɔbɛma Israel adɔr dɛ ɔsor nworaba.
Zeruiah ne ba Joab na ɔhyɛɛ ase kanee, na oennwie; na iyi kɔtwetwee ebufuw baa Israel do; nkyii so wɔammfa dodow no annhyɛ ɔhen David ne mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na ɔhen n'akoradze no do na Adiel ba Azmaveth hwɛ: Na akoradze a ɔwɔ asaase no do, nkurow mu, na nkurobaase, na abantsentsen mu no, Uzziah ba Jonathan na ɔhwɛ:
Na hɔn a wɔyɛ hamu-edwuma dɔw asaase no do na Chelub ba Ezri hwɛ:
Na wenyin nture do na Ramathnyi Shimei hwɛ: Na wenyin nture ndɔbaa mu akoransa no do na Shephamnyi Zabdi hwɛ:
Na ngondua na sycomore ndua a ɔwɔ tɛtɛr mu no na Gedernyi Baal-hanan hwɛ: Na ngo fiadze no do na Joash hwɛ:
Na anantwi a wɔnyɛn hɔn wɔ Sharon no do na Sharonnyi Shitrai hwɛ: Na anantwi a wɔwɔ mbɔnsa no mu no Adlai ba Shaphat hwɛ:
Na efumpɔnkɔ do na Ishaelnyi Obil hwɛ: Na nsoaso do na Meronothnyi Jehdeiah hwɛ:
Na nguan do na Hagrinyi Jaziz hwɛ. Woyinom nyinara wɔyɛ ɔhen David n'ahodze do ahwɛfo.
Nkyii so David n'awɔfaase Jonathan na ɔyɛ ɔpamfo, nyimpa a ɔwɔ ntseasee, na ɔkyerɛwfo: Na Hachmoni ne ba Jehiel na ɔnye ɔhen ne mba no tse:
Na Ahithophel nye ɔhen ne pamfo, na Archnyi Hushai nye ɔhen ne nyɛnko:
Na Ahithophel n'ekyir na Benaiah ba Jehoiada na Ablathar dzi: Na ɔhen no dɔm do safohen nye Joab.
28: Na David hyiahyiaa Israel asafohen nyinara, ebusuakuw do asafohen, na ekuwekuw no do asafohen a wɔsom ɔhen esiado esiado, na apem apem do asafohen, na ɔha ɔha do asafohen, na ɔhen na ne mba ahodze na enyadze nyinara do ahwɛdofo, wɔnye edzibewdzifo, na mbarimba akatakyi, mekyerɛ mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam nyinara baa Jerusalem.

Nna ɔhen David soɛree gyinaa n'anan do, na ɔsee dɛ, mo nuanom, na me man, hom ntsie me: Emidze, ɔwɔ m'akoma mu dɛ nkyɛ mibesi ahomgye fi mama Ewuradze n'ahyɛmudaka no, na ɔayɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn n'ananadzegua; na mesiesie ama ne si no.
Na Nyankopɔn see me dɛ, mma ɔwo nnsi ofi mma me dzin, osiandɛ ɔwo yɛ akodzi nyimpa, na akã bɔgya egu.

Naaso Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, saan mu yii emi wɔ m'egya fi nyinara mu dɛ mindzi Israelhen daa, na ɔasan mu eyi Judah ayɛ no ɔpayin; na Judah ofi mu so oeyi m'egya; na m'egya mba mu so, onyaa mo ho enyisɔ dɛ ɔdze me besi Israel nyinara do hen:
Na me mba nyinara mu so, (na Ewuradze ama'me mba pii), ɔasan mu eyi me ba Solomon dɛ ɔntsena Ewuradze n'ahendzi a odzi no wɔ Israel no do egua do.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, Wo ba Solomon na obesi me fi na m'abangua no: Osiandɛ masan mu eyi no ayɛ me ba, na mo so mebeyɛ n'egya.
Na mebɛma n'ahendzi etsim hɔ daa, sɛ ɔwɔw do dzi me mbra nsɛm na m'atsɛmbudze do, dɛ ndɛ da yi a.
Dɛm ntsi afei, Israel nyinara a wɔyɛ Ewuradze bagua no enyim, na hɛn Nyankopɔn ne mbransɛm nyinara nsew na hom nhwehwɛ ekyir no daa.

Na ɔwo, me ba Solomon, hu w'egya ne Nyankopɔn no, na fa akoma a odzi mu na ɔpɛ adwen som no: Na Ewuradze pɛnsapɛnsa akoma nyinara mu, na ohu adwen nyinara mu nsusui: Sɛ ehwehwɛ no a, ɔbɛma ehu no; na sɛ epow no a, ɔbɔtow wo akyen korakora.
Afei hwɛ yie; na Ewuradze asan mu eyi wo dɛ si ofi yɛ krɔnkrɔn-bea no: Hyɛ woho dzen, na yɛ.
Nna David dze asɔrdan n'abrandaa, na no ho adan, na n'adzekorambea, na n'abansor mpia, na ne mpiakyir mpia, na no mbɔbɔrhu dan no nsusudo maa ne ba Solomon:
Na dza ɔnam sunsum no do nyae nyinara no nsusudo, Ewuradze fie abagua, na mpia a etwa ho eyia nyinara, Ewuaradze fie adzekorambea:
Na asɔfo na Levifo nkyekyɛmu no so, na Ewuradze fie ɔsom ho ndzɛmba nyinara:
Sika ndzɛmba no wɔ sika ne nkerii do, dɛ wɔmfa nyɛ ɔsom nyinara ho ndzɛmba nyinara dwetɛ ndzɛmba nyinara ne nkerii, dɛ wɔmfa nyɛ ɔsom nyinara ne ndzɛmba nyinara.

na sika kandzeandua, na no ho sika kandzea ne nkerii: Ɔnye kandzeadua biara na no ho nkandzea ne nkerii: Dwetɛ kandzeadua, dwetɛ kandzeadua biara na no ho nkandzea ne nkerii, dɛ mbrɛ kandzeadua biara no ho som tse;
na kyerɛpaanoo apon no, nkorkor, sika a woeker; na dwetɛ apon no no dwetɛ;
na edzinam, na mbɛɛsen, na nkuraba no, sika mapa a: Na sika nkorbaa dze, mbrɛ korbaa biara ne nkerii tse: Na dwetɛ nkorbaa dze, mbrɛ korbaa biara ne nkerii tse:
Na eduhuam afɔrmbukyia no ho sika a woeyiyi mu ne nkerii: Na tseaseanam esusudo no ho sika, mekyerɛ cherubfo a wɔtserɛɛw hɔn atsaban mu kataa Ewuradze ahyɛmudaka no do no.
David see dɛ, Iyi nyina kyerɛw a ofi Ewuradze nsamu bae no ama matse ase, mekyerɛ nsusudo ndwuma nyinara.

Na David see ne ba Solomon dɛ, hyɛ woho dzen na nya akokodur, na yɛ: Mma nnsuro, nkyii so mma wo bo nntu: Ma Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, mekyerɛ me Nyankopɔn no, ɔnye wo nam; ɔremmpa wo, eso orinngya wo hɔ, dze ekodu dɛ wobowie Ewuradze fi ɔsom-edwuma no nyinara yɛ.

Na, hwɛ, asɔfo na Levifo nkyekyɛmu a wɔbɔsom Nyankopɔn fie nye yi: Na dwuma no nyina mu, nyimpa biara a ɔpra ne yamu a ɔwɔ ɔsom biara ho nyansa no, ɔbɛba wo nkyɛn: Asafohen no na ɔman no nyinara so bedzi w'anosɛm nyinara do.
29: Na ɔhen David see bagua no nyinara dɛ, me ba Solomon, ɔbaako a Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi no no ɔda ho yɛ abofra na ɔyɛ mberɛw, na edwuma no sõ: Osiandɛ ahemfi no nnyɛ nyimpa ndze, na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn dze a.

Afei medze m'ahoɔdzen nyinara mesiesie me Nyankopɔn fi no ho sika ama sika ndzɛmba, na dwetɛ ama boran dzɛmba, na dwetɛ ama dwetɛ ndzɛmba, na boron ama boron ndzɛmba, na ndua ama ndua ndzɛmba; onyɛ abo, na nhyehyɛmu abo, abo senasena, na abo nworanworan, na aboɔdzen abo n'ahorow nyinara, na marble abo piigyan.
Nkyii so, osian mo dɔ a medze esi me Nyankopɔn fi no ho ntsi, sika na dwetɛ a ɔyɛ mankasa m'akoradze no, medze no so mema me Nyankopɔn fi no, dze kã dza mesiesie mama krɔnkrɔn-bea no nyinara ho;
sika talent mpensa, ophir sika, na dwetɛ a woeyiyi mu talent mpemesuon, dɛ wɔmfa ndura adan no n'afasu no ho:
Wɔmfa sika nyeyɛ sika ndzɛmba, na wɔmfa dwetɛ nyeyɛ dwetɛ ndzɛmba, na wɔmfa nyɛ edwimfo nsaano edwuma no nyinara. Na afei, woana na ɔpra ne yamu tu noho hyɛ Ewuradze nsa ndɛ da yi?
Nna egyanom efi mu mbapɔmba, na Israel ebusuakuw mu mbapɔmba, na apem apem na ɔha ɔha do asafohen wɔnye ɔhen n'edwuma do ahwɛdofo no praa hɔn yamu mae;
na wɔmaa Nyankopɔn fie ɔsom no ho sika talent mpemenum na daric mpemdu, na dwetɛ talent mpemdu, na boran talent mpemduawɔtwe, na dadze talent mpemɔha.
Na hɔn a wohun aboɔdzen abo wɔ hɔn hɔ no, wɔdze maa Ewuradze fie akoradze, wɔ Gershonnyi Jehiel ne nsaase.
Na ɔman no dzii ehurusi, dɛ wɔpraa hɔn yamu yii mae, osiandɛ wɔdze akoma a odzi mu praa hɔn yamu yii maa Ewuradze: Na ɔhen David so dze dew kɛse dzii ehurusi.
Dɛm ntsi David hyiraa Ewuradze wɔ bagua no nyinara enyim: Na David see dɛ, ao Ewuradze, hɛn egya Israel ne Nyankopɔn, nhyira nkã wo mbersantsen mfesantsen.

Ɔwo, Ewuradze, na akɛseyɛ, na ahoɔdzen, na enyimnyam, na konyimdzi, na tumdzi dzi wɔ wo: Na dza ɔwɔ ɔsor na asaase nyinara yɛ wodze; ɔwo, Ewuradze, na ahendzi no yɛ wodze, na ɔwo na wɔama wo do ayɛ adze nyinara otsitsir.
Ahonya na enyimnyam nyinara fi wo hɔ ba, na ɔwo na ehyɛ adze nyinara do; na wo nsamu na ahoɔdzen na tum wɔ; na ɔwo wo nsamu na ɔwɔ dɛ edze akɛseyɛ ma, na edze ahoɔdzen ma nyimpa nyinara.
Na afei, hɛn Nyankopɔn, yɛda wo ase, na yeyi w'enyimnyam dzin no ayɛw.
Na emi nye woana, na me man nye ɛbɛn, dɛ yebotum apra hɛn yamu yeeyi ama dɛm yi? Na adze nyina fi wo nsamu, na woara w'adze na yɛdze ama wo.
Na yɛyɛ ahɔho wɔ wo nkyɛn, na amamforafo, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn egyanom nyinara yɛe: Hɛn nda tse dɛ sunsuma wɔ asaase do, na enyidado bi nnyi hɔ.
Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn, okuw yi nyinara a yesiesie dɛ yɛdze ribesi wo ofi ama wo dzin krɔnkrɔn yi wo nsamu na ofi, na ne nyinara yɛ woara wodze.

Me Nyankopɔn, minyim so dɛ ɔwo esɔ akoma hwɛ, na ewɔ enyigye wɔ tsenenee ho. Emidze, m'akoma ne tsenenee mu na mapra me yamu mama ndzɛmba yinom yi: Na afei medze enyigye na mehu wo man a wɔwɔ ha yi, dɛ wɔapra hɔn yamu woeyi ama wo.
Ewuradze, hɛn egyanom Abraham, Isaac, na Israel Nyankopɔn, fa iyi sie wo man akoma mu adwen mu nsusui mu daa daa, na siesie hɔn akoma ma woho:
Na fa akoma a odzi mu ma me ba Solomon, ma onsie wo mbransɛm, w'adasesɛm, na w'ahyɛdze, na ɔnyɛ yinom nyinara, na onsi ahemfie a mesiesie ho ama no.
Na David see bagua no nyinara dɛ, afei hom nhyira Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn. Na bagua no nyinara hyiraa Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no, na wɔkotowee sɔɔr Ewuradze, na ɔhen no.
Na wɔbobɔɔ afɔr maa Ewuradze, na wɔbɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr maa Ewurazde, da no n'adzekyee no, anantwinyin apem, ndwanyin apem, na nguambaa apem, na hɔn ho huensa, na afɔr piigyan maa Israel nyinara;
Na wɔdze enyigye kɛse wodzidzii na wɔnomee wɔ Ewuradze enyim da no. Na wɔhyɛɛ David ba Solomon ɔhen ne mpɛn ebien, na wɔseraa no ngo maa Ewuradze dɛ bapɔmba, na Zadok dɛ ɔsɔfo.
Nna Solomon dzii n'egya David ananmu tsenaa Ewuradze egua no do dɛ ɔhen, na ɔyɛɛ prɔmprɔm; na Israel nyinara yɛɛ setsie maa no.
Na asafohen nyinara, na mbarimba akatakyi, na ɔhen David ne mba no nyinara so, wɔbrɛɛ hɔnho adze maa ɔhen Solomon.
Na Ewuradze maa Solomon do kɛsenara wɔ Israel nyinara enyim, na ɔmaa no ahendzi mu tumdzi bi a Israelhen biara a odzii n'enyim no ennya no dɛm da.
Afei David, Jesse ba no, dzii Israel nyinara do hen.
Na aber a ɔdze dzii Israel do hen no ɔyɛ mfe eduanan; odzii hen mfe esuon wɔ Hebron, na mfe eduasa ebiasa na odzii hen wɔ Jerusalem.
Na owuu nkɔdaayɛsu pa mu, nda pii, ahonya, na enyimnyam ahyɛ no mã: Na ne ba Solomon dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Afei ɔhen David ho nsɛm a odzi kan na dza odzi ekyir no, hwɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ adzehunyi Samuel nsɛm na nkɔnhyɛnyi Nathan nsɛm, na adzehunyi Gad nsɛm no mu;
ɔnye n'ahendzi na no tum, na mber a ɔfaa ne tsir do, na Israel do, na asaase no n'ahendzi nyinara do no.

1: Paul a wɔnam Nyankopɔn ne pɛ do wɔafrɛ no ayɛ Jesus Christ ɔsomafo, nye onua Sosthenes,
dze kɛma Nyankopɔn asɔr a ɔwɔ Corinth, hɔn a wɔasan hɔn ho wɔ Christ Jesus mu, wɔafrɛ hɔn ayɛ hɔn ahotsewfo, nye hɔn a wɔbɔ hɛn Ewuradz Jesus Christ ne dzin wɔ mbea nyina, hɔn Ewuradze nye hɛndze;
Adom nkã hom nye asomdwee a ofi hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Christ.
Meda me Nyankopɔn ase daa wɔ hom ho, wɔ Nyankopɔn adom a wɔdze adom hom wɔ Christ Jesus mu ntsi,
dɛ adze nyina mu wɔama hom enya homho wɔ no mu, wɔ kasahom nye nyimdzee nyina mu,
dɛ mbrɛ Christ ho dase etsim hom mu;
ma hom nnka ekyir wɔ adom akyɛdze biara mu; ber a hom rotweɔn hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ ne nyikyerɛ no:
Ɔno so na ɔbɛma hom etsim ekodu ewiei amma sõ bi aammba hom do wɔ Ewuradze Jesus Christ da no mu.
Nyankopɔn a wɔnam no do afrɛ hom aba ne Ba hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ anyɛnkoyɛ mu no, ɔyɛ nokwafo.
Afei, enuanom, menam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ ne dzin do meserɛ hom dɛ hom nyina nkã asɛnkor, na mma mpaapaamu mmba hom mu, na mbom hom nyina ndzi mu wɔ adwen kor nye tsirmsɛm kor mu.
Na, mo nuanom, hɔn a wofi Chloe fie ebeyi me hom ho asotsiw dɛ wentwiwentwi wɔ hom mu.
Dza mekyerɛ nye yi, dɛ hom nyina kekã dɛ, emidze, meyɛ Paul dze, emidze meyɛ Apollos dze, emidze meyɛ Cephas dze, emidze meyɛ Christ dze.
Ana wɔapaapaa Christ mu? Ana Paul na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu maa hom? Anaa Paul dzin mu na wonumaa hom hyɛe?
Meda Naynkopɔn ase dɛ mennuma hom mu bi dɛ Crispus nye Gaius,
mma obi aannkã dɛ wonumaa hom hyɛɛ mankasa me dzin mu.
Na eso munumaa Stephanas fiefo: Na nkaa no dze, sɛ munumaa bi a, minnyim.
Na Christ annsoma me dɛ mumbonuma, na mbom dɛ membɛkã asɛmpa no, nnyɛ dɛ ɔkasa-nyansa mu a, amma Christ mbeamudua no aannyɛ kwa.
Na mbeamudua no ho asɛm no yɛ nkwaseasɛm ma hɔn a wɔrehera, na hɛn a wɔregye hɛn nkwa dze, ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn tum ma hɛn.
Na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, mebɛsɛɛ enyansafo nyansaa, na enyimdzefo nyimdzee no meyi no tokyen.
Onyansafo wɔ hen? ɔkyerɛwfo wɔ hen? Ana Nyankopɔn nndaan wiadze nyansaa nkwaseasɛm?
Na Nyankopɔn nyansaa mu wiadze ammfa nyansaa do ennhu Nyankopɔn no, ɔsɔɔ Nyankopɔn enyi dɛ ɔnam asɛnka no nkwaseasɛm no do bɛgye hɔn a wɔgye dzi nkwa.
Osiandɛ Jewfo rohwehwɛ asɛnkyerɛdze, na Greekfo dze, wɔhwehwɛ nyansa;
na hɛndze, yɛkã Christ a wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu ho asɛm, dza ɔyɛ fintsidua ma Jewfo, na nkwaseasɛm ma amanamamfo no,
na hɔn a wɔafrɛ hɔn no dze, Jewfo o, Greekfo o, Christ yɛ Nyankopɔn no tum a Nyankopɔn ne nyansaa ma hɔn.
Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn nkwaseadze yɛ nyansa kyɛn nyimpa, na Nyankopɔn n'adze a ɔyɛ mberɛW yɛ dzen kyɛn nyimpa.
Na enuanom, hom nhwɛ hom frɛ no, dɛ nnyɛ honam afamu enyansafo pii, nnyɛ etumfo pii, nnyɛ adehye pii:
Na wiadze nkwaseadze na Nyankopɔn apa dɛ ɔdze bɛhyɛ enyansafo enyito, na wiadze my dza ɔyɛ mberɛw na Nyankopɔn apa dɛ ɔdze bɛhyɛ dza ɔyɛ dzen enyito;
na wiadze mu dza onnyi dzin, nye dza wommbu no hwee na Nyankopɔn apa, ndzɛmba a onnyi hɔ mpo, dɛ ɔdze bɛma dza ɔwɔ hɔ ayɛ kwa;
amma honam biara aannhyehyɛ noho wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na ofi no mu na hom wɔ Christ Jesus mu, ɔno na wofi Nyankopɔn mu ayɛ no nyansa nye tsenenee, nye ahotsew, nye ɔpon ama hɛn:
dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, nyia ɔhyehyɛ noho, wɔmma ɔnhyehyɛ noho wɔ Ewuradze mu.
2: Na emidze, enuanom, mebaa hom nkyɛn no, mammfa kasa nye nyansa kyɛnee bɛkãa hom Nyankopɔn asumasɛm no.
Na musuaa me tsirmu dɛ nkyɛ munnkohu biribi wɔ hom mu, gyedɛ Jesus Christ nye dɛ wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Na emidze, mberɛwyɛ, nye osuro, nye ahopopo pii mu na menye hom tsenae.
Na m'asɛm nye m'asɛnka enndua enyansasɛm ntsɛfɛwbɔ mu, na mbom ɔnam Sunsum ne nyikyerɛ nye tum mu,
mma hom gyedzi eenngyina nyimpa nyansaa mu, na mbom eegyina Nyankopɔn tum mu.
Naaso yɛkã nyansa wɔ hɔn a wodzi mu no mu, na nnyɛ nyansa a ɔyɛ wiadze yi dze, anaaso wiadze etumfo a wɔrebɛyɛ gyan dze a:
Na mbom yɛkã Nyankopɔn nyansaa wɔ esumasɛm mu, nyansaa a ohuntae a Nyankopɔn hyɛe too hɔ maa hɛn enyimnyam ansaana wiadze bɔbɔɔ adze;
ɔno na waidze yi mu etumfo mu obiara ennhu: Sɛ wohunii a nkyɛ wɔammbɔ enyimnyam Ewuradze no mbeamudua mu;
na mbom dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, dza enyiwa nnhunii na aso nntsee, na ɔannhɛn nyimpa akoma mu, ndzɛmba a Nyankopɔn esiesie ama hɔn a wɔdɔ no.
Na hɛndze, Nyankopɔn nam Sunsum no do eyi akyerɛ hɛn: Na Sunsum no pepɛ adze nyina mu, Nyankopɔn adze a no mu dɔ mu mpo.
Na nyimpa mu woana na onyim dza ɔwɔ nyimpa mu dɛ nyimpa no sunsum a ɔwɔ no mu? Dɛmara na obi nnyim Nyankopɔn dze, dɛ Nyankopɔn Sunsum no.
Na hɛndze, nnyɛ wiadze sunsum na yenyae na mbom sunsum a ofi Nyankopɔn mu a, ma yeehu dza Nyankopɔn dze adom hɛn.
Ndzɛmba yi so na yɛkã, nnyɛ nsɛm a nyimpa nyansaa kyerɛkyerɛ mu, na mbom nsɛm a Sunsum kyerɛkyerɛ mu a: yɛdze sunsum adze to sunsum adze ho.
Na honammunyi nngye Nyankopɔn Sunsum adze, osiandɛ ɔyɛ nkwaseasɛm ma no, na onntum nnhu mu, osiandɛ wohu no sunsum mu.
Na nyia ɔyɛ Sunsummunyi dze, obu adze nyina atsɛn, na nankasa dze, obi mmbu no atsɛn.
Na woana na oehu Ewuradze adwen, ma ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ no? Na hɛndze, yɛwɔ Christ adwen.
3: Na mo so, enuanom, menntum annkasa annkyerɛ hom dɛ sunsummufo na mbom dɛ honammufo, dɛ Christ mu nkɔkowaba.
Numfonsu na medze maa hom na hom nomee, na nnyɛ edziban bi a: Na hom nnyae nntumii: Eso seseiara hom nntum,
na hom da ho yɛ honammufo na mbrɛ nyinkun nye wentwiwentwi wɔ hom mu yi, hom nnyɛ honammufo, na hom nnantsew nyimpamu anaa?
Na sɛ ɔbaako se dɛ, emidze, meyɛ Paul dze, na obi so se dɛ, emidze meyɛ Apollos dze a, hom nnyɛ honammufo anaa?
Na Apollos nye woana? Na Paul nye woana? Wɔyɛ asomfo a hom nam hɔn do gyee dzii, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze dze maa hɔn mu biara.
Emi na muduae, Apollos na oguguu do nsu na Nyankopɔn na ɔmaa ndɔbaa no.
Dɛm ntsi nnyɛ nyia odua na ɔyɛ biribi, eso nnyɛ nyia ogugu do nsu a, na Nyankopɔn a ɔma ndɔbaa no a.
Na nyia odua nye nyia ogugu do nsu yɛ kor, na hɔn mu biara benya nankasa n'akatua dɛ mbrɛ nankasa n'edwuma tse.
Na yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn nedwumaboafo; hom yɛ Nyankopɔn kwã, Nyankopɔn dan.
Dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn adom a ɔdze adom me tse, dɛ ɔdantofo panyin nyansafo, motoo fapem, na obi so rotow do. Na wɔmma obiara nhwɛ yie mbrɛ odua tow do.
Na fapem fofor biara dze, obiara runntum nnto nnka dza wɔato no ho, ɔno nye Jesus Christ.
Na sɛ obiara dze sika, dwetɛ, aboɔdzen abo, dua, ehuntum, nye mburonan tow fapem no do a;
obiara n'edwuma bɛda edzi: na da no beyi ato gua, osiandɛ wɔnam ogya do beyi akyerɛ, na ogya no ara bɔsɔ obiara n'adwuma ahwɛ, mbrɛ ɔtse biara.
Sɛ obiara n'edwuma a ɔatow wɔ do no tsena hɔ a, obenya akatua.
Sɛ obiara n'edwuma hyew a, obedzi anhwer, na nankasa dze wɔbɛgye no nkwa, na ɔtse dɛ ɔnam ogya mu.
Ana hom nnyim dɛ hom yɛ Nyankopɔn asɔrfi, na Nyankopɔn Sunsum no tse hom mu?
Sɛ obiara Sɛɛ Nyankopɔn asɔrfi a, ɔno na Nyankopɔn bɛsɛɛ no: Na Nyankopɔn asɔrfi ho tsew, ɔno nye homara.
Mma obi nndaadaa noho. Sɛ obiara susu dɛ ɔyɛ hom mu nyansafo wɔ wiadze yi mu a, wɔmma ɔnyɛ kwasea ama ɔaayɛ nyansafo.
Na wiadze yi nyansaa yɛ nkwaseasɛm wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim. Na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, ɔno na ɔkyer enyansafo wɔ hɔn enyitsew mu;
na bio, Nyankopɔn nyim enyansafo adwendwen dɛ ɔyɛ kwa.
Dɛm ntsi mma obi nnhyehyɛ noho wɔ nyimpa mu. Na adze nyina yɛ homdze;
Paul o, Apollos o, Cephas o, wiadze o, nkwa o, owu o, dza ɔwɔ hɔ sesei o, dza ɔrebɛba o; ne nyina yɛ homdze;
Na hom yɛ Christ dze, na Christ yɛ Nyankopɔn dze.
4: Dɛm na nyimpa mbu hɛn, dɛ Christ asomfo nye Nyankopɔn esumasɛm do ahwɛfo.
Na, afei, dza wɔhwehwɛ no ɔhwɛfo ho nye dɛ wohu no ɔnokwafo.
Na emidze, ɔyɛ me asɛm ketseaba bi dɛ hom anaa nyimpa abaguafo bobu me atsɛn: Mankasa mpo mummbu moho atsɛn.
Na mankasa minnyim biribi tsia mo ho, naaso minndzi bem wɔ iyi mu: Nyia obu me atsɛn nye Ewuradze.

Dɛm ntsi mma hom nntwar ber ano mmbu biribi ho atsɛn, ma onkodu dɛ Ewuradze bɛba, ɔno na ɔdze sum mu dza osuma nyina bɛba kan mu, na oeyi akoma mu apam edzi: Nna obiara benya n'ayɛyi efi Nyankopɔn hɔ.
Nsɛm yi, enuanom, madan ama mankasa moho nye Apollos ma hom eesūa wɔ hɛn ho dɛ mma hom nntra dza wɔakyerɛw no, amma ɔbaako ntsi obi aannhoran enntsia ɔbaako.
Na woana na ɔyɛ wo dɛ ɔsor wo nko? Na ebɛnadze na ewɔ a wɔammfa amma wo? Na sɛ inyae a, ɔyɛ dɛn na ehyehyɛ woho dɛ gyama ennya?
Hom ewie mee dada; hom enya homho dada; hom ekwetsi hɛn edzi hen: nkyɛ mepɛ dɛ hom dzi hen ampa, ma hɛn so nye hom eedzi.
Na mususu dɛ Nyankopɔn dze hɛn asomafo edzi ekyir, dɛ hɔn a woeyi hɔn ama owu; osiandɛ yɛayɛ ahwɛdze ama wiadze nye abɔfo nye nyimpa.
Yɛyɛ nkwasea wɔ Christ ntsi, na homdze, hom yɛ enyansafo wɔ Christ mu; yɛyɛ mberɛw, na homdze hom yɛ dzen; homdze hom yɛ enyimnyamfo na hɛndze yɛyɛ ahorohoraafo.
ɔdze bodu sesei dɔn yi mu ɔkɔm nye nsukɔn nyina dze hɛn, yedzi adagyaw, wɔbɔ hɛn ekutuku, yennyi beebi tse;
na yɛberɛ dze hɛnara hɛn nsa yɛ edwuma; wɔyaw hɛn a, yehyira; wɔhaw hɛn a, yɛpen;
wɔsɛɛ hɛn dzin a, yɛbɔ hɛn hɔn; yɛayɛ dɛ wiadze fī, nyimpa mu ntɔmpamu dze ebodu ndɛ.
Nnyɛ dɛ merebɛhyɛ hom fɛr ntsi, na mekyerɛw yi, na mbom dɛ murubotu hom fo dɛ mo dɔmba a.
Na sɛ hom wɔ akwankyerɛfo pedu wɔ Christ mu mpo a, hom nnyi egyanom pii: Na emi na menam asɛmpa no do mowoo hom wɔ Christ Jesus mu.
Dɛm ntsi meserɛ hom dɛ hom nyɛ m'asuasuafo.
Iyi ntsi na masoma Timothy a ɔyɛ me ba dɔfo nye nokwafo wɔ EWuradze mu no wɔ hom nkyɛn; ɔno na ɔbɛkaa hom m'akwan a ɔwɔ Christ mu, dɛ mbrɛ mekyerɛkyerɛ wɔ asɔrasɔr nyina mu, wɔ mbeambea nyina.
Na wosusu dɛ gyama meremmba hom nkyɛn ntsi na binom rohoran.
Na sɛ Ewuradze pɛ a, mebɛba hom nkyɛn ntsɛmara, na mubohu hɔn a wɔahoran no hɔn tum, na nnyɛ hɔn asɛm a.
Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn ahendzi nnyi asɛm mu, na mbom tum a.
Mmuana na hom pɛ? Memfa abaa membra hom nkyɛn, anaa memfa ɔdɔ nye ɔdwe sunsum?
5: Wɔkã no ampaara dɛ ndwamanyɛ wɔ hom mu, ndwamanyɛ mpo a onnyi amanamamfo mu, dɛ obi bɛfa n'egya yer.
Na hom ahoran, na mbom hom enndzi awerɛhow, ma woeeyi nyia ɔayɛ dɛm adze yi wɔ hom mu.
Na emidze, minnyi hɔ wɔ honam mu saampa, naaso mowɔ hɔ wɔ sunsum mu ntsi, mebu atsɛn dada dɛ gyama mowɔ hɔ, wɔ nyia ɔyɛɛ dɛm adze no ho,
Wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus dzin mu, dɛ sɛ hom nye mo sunsum hyia mu, na hɛn Ewuradze Jesus no tum ka ho a,
mibeyi onyii no ahyɛ Satan nsa ma honam no aasɛɛ, ma wɔaagye sunsum no nkwa wɔ Ewuradze Jesus da no mu.
Hom ahohyehyɛ nnye. Ana hom nnyim dɛ mbɔrkaw kakra kaw mbɔr no nyina?
Dɛm ntsi hom nyi mbɔrkaw dadaw no, ma hom yɛ epitsi Na hɛn apahoguan Christ so woeku no:
Dɛm ntsi hom mma yɛnhyɛ fa, nnyɛ dɛ yedzi mbɔrkaw dadaw bi a, eso nnyɛ dɛ yedzi nyitan nye emumuyɛ mbɔrkaw bi a, na mbom dɛ yedzi kotooyɛ nye nokwar epitsi a.
Mekyerɛɛw no mo nwoma no mu brɛɛ hom dɛ mma hom nnye ndwaman mmforafora;
na nnyɛ wiadze yi ndwaman, anaadɛ enyiberfo nye apempensifo, anaa abosonsɔrfo bi koraa; ɔnodze na nkyɛ dɛ hom fi wiadze;

na afei dze, mekyerɛw hom dɛ mma hom nye hɔn nndzi afora, sɛ obiara a wɔfrɛ no onua yɛ edwaman anaa onyiberfo, anaa ɔbosonsɔrnyi, anaa bɔndzekoo, anaa ɔsabokwanyi, anaa ɔpempensinyi, dɛm nyimpa no mma hom nye no nndzidzi mpo.
Na ɔfa mo ho pɛn dɛ mubobu hɔn a wɔmmfi mu no atsɛn? Ana nnyɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ mu no na hom bu hɔn atsɛn?
Na hɔn a wonnyi mu no dze, Nyankopɔn na obu hɔn atsɛn. Hom nyi nyimpa bɔn no mfi hom mu.
6: Aso hom mu bi nye ne nyɛnko wɔ asɛm bi a osi no bo dɛ ɔkɔ hɔn a wɔnntsen no enyim asɛndzii, na nnyɛ ahotsewfo no enyim a?
Ana hom nnyim dɛ ahotsewfo no na wobobu wiadze atsɛn? Na sɛ hom na hom bobu wiadze atsɛn a, ana hom nnsɛ dɛ hom dzi nsɛm nkakraba?
Ana hom nyim dɛ yebobu abɔfo atsɛn? Na ankantsɛm nkwa yi mu ndzɛmba?
Na sɛ hom wɔ nkwa yi mu ndzɛmba ho asɛm a, hɔn a wommbu hɔn bi wɔ ɔsor mu na hom dze hɔn yɛ baguafo?
Mekã yi mehyɛ hom enyito. Ana mbrɛ ɔtse nye dɛ onyansafo bi nnyi hom mu a obotum ebu nua nye nua ntamu atsɛn,
na onua nye nua yi atsɛn wɔ hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi enyim mpo yi?
Esintɔ enya aba hom mu dada dɛ hom dze homho kokɔ mbra mu. Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom mma wonndzi hom emim mbom? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom mma wonnsisi hom mbom?
Na mbom homankasa hom dzi emim na hom sisi, na hom dze yi yɛ hom nuanom mpo.
Ana hom nnyim dɛ hɔn a wɔnntsen rinnya Nyankopɔn ahenman ayɛ hɔndze? Mma wɔnndaadaa hom: Ndwaman, nye abosonsɔrfo, nye awartofo, nye mbaakowaa, nye mbarimba a wɔnye hɔnho da,
nye ewifo, nye enyiberfo, nye asabokwafo, nye abɔndzekoofo, nye apempensifo rinnya Nyankopɔn ahenman no.
Na nkyɛ mbrɛ hom mu bi tse nye no; na afei wɔatsew hom ho, na afei woebu hom bem wɔ Ewuradze Jesus Christ dzin mu, na hɛn Nyankopɔn Sunsum no mu.
Mowɔ adze nyina ho kwan, na nnyɛ adze nyina na ɔfata; mowɔ adze nyina ho kwan, na memma biribi nnhyɛ mo do.
Edziban yɛ yafun dze, na yafun yɛ edziban dze, naaso Nyankopɔn bɛma emu ebien nyina ayɛ kwa. Na nyimpadua nnyi hɔ mma ndwamanyɛ, na ɔwɔ hɔ ma Ewuradze, na Ewuradze wɔ hɔ ma nyimpadua;
na Nyankopɔn nyaan Ewuradze, na ɔnam no tum do benyan hɛn so bi.
Ana hom nnyim dɛ hom nyimpadua yɛ Christ ho mfakuwa? Aso memfa Christ ho mfakuwa menyɛ no edwaman dze? Atserkwa!
Ana hom nnyim dɛ nyia ɔdze noho bɔ edwaman ho no, na ɔnye no ayɛ nyimpadua kor? Na ɔse, hɔn beenu bɛyɛ honankor.
Na nyia ɔdze noho bɔ Ewuradze ho no nye no yɛ sunsum kor.
Hom nguan ndwamanyɛ. Bɔn biara a nyimpa yɛ nnyi ne nyimpadua mu, na nyia ɔyɛ edwaman no ɔyɛ nankasa ne nyimpadua bɔn.
Anaaso hom nnyim dɛ hom nyimpadua yɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a ɔwɔ hom mu a hom enya no Nyankopɔn hɔ no n'asɔrfi? Na nnyɛ homankasa homdze:
Osiandɛ wɔtɔɔ hom aboɔdzen: Dɛm ntsi hom nhyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ hom nyimpadua mu.
7: Na dza hom kyerɛwee brɛɛ me no ho dze, oye ma ɔbanyin dɛ ɔmmfa noho nnkã ɔbaa.
Na ndwamanyɛ ntsi, hom mma ɔbanyin biara nnya nankasa ne yer, na ɔbaa biara nnya nankasa no kun.
Wɔmma okun mma ɔyer no dza ɔsɛ, na ɔyer no so mma okun no dza ɔsɛ dɛmara.
ɔyer no nnyi nankasa ne nyimpadua do tum, na mbom okun no a, na dɛmara so na okun no nnyi nankasa ne nyimpadua do tum, na mbom ɔyer no a.
Mma hom mmfa homho nnkam homho, gyedɛ hom yɛ anokor wɔ mber bi, ma hom eenya asɔr ho adagyer, na hom aasan abehyia mu bio, mma hom ho a hom nntum nnsie ntsi, Satan aannsɔ hom annhwɛ.
Na iyi mekã no ɔkwanma afamu, na nnyɛ nhyɛdo bi a.
Na mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ nyimpa nyina Yɛ dɛ mbrɛ metse yi; naaso obiara wɔ n'adom akyɛdze fi Nyankopɔn hɔ: Obi wɔ no dɛ, obi so wɔ no dɛm.
Na mekã kyerɛ esigyafo nye ekunafo dɛ, oye ma hɔn dɛ wɔntsena dɛ emi.
Na sɛ wonnyi ahohyɛdo a, wɔnwar: Na awar yɛ kyɛn ɔhyew.
Na awarfo dze, mehyɛ hɔn (nnyɛ emi a, na mbom Ewuradze a) dɛ mma ɔbaa nngyaa no kun,
(na sɛ ogyaa no a, ondzi sigyaw; annyɛ dɛm a, ɔnye no kun nkɔbɔ mu); na mma okun so nnkõ ne yer.
Na nkaa no dze, emi na mekã, na nnyɛ Ewuradze a, dɛ, sɛ onua bi wɔ yer a ɔnngye nndzi, na sɛ ɔbaa no pen dɛ ɔnye no tsena a, mma ɔnnkõ no.
Na ɔbaa so a ɔwɔ kun a ɔnngye nndzi, na sɛ okun no pen dɛ ɔnye no tsena a, mma ɔnnkõ no.
Na okun a ɔnngye nndzi no ho tsew ɔyer no mu, na ɔyer a ɔnngye nndzi no ho tsew okun no mu: Ɔnntse dɛm a, nna hom mba ho wɔ fī, na afei dze hɔn ho tsew.
Na sɛ nyia ɔnngye nndzi paa noho a, ma ɔmpaa noho; onua kor no, anaa akyerɛbaa kor no wɔnnkyekyeer no wɔ dɛm asɛm yi mu: Na asomdwee mu na Nyankopɔn afrɛ hɛn.
Na ɔyer, sɛ ebɛgye wo kun nkwa a, ɔwo inyim anaa? Anaaso okun, sɛ ebɛgye wo yer nkwa a, ɔwo inyim anaa?
Gyesɛ dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze akyerɛ ama obiara no, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn afrɛ obiara no, dɛmara na ɔmbɔ ne bra; na mbrɛ mehyehyɛ no wɔ asɔr nyina mu nye no.
Sɛ wɔfrɛɛ obi na ɔyɛ twatsiatwa a, mma ɔnndan monomonomnyi; sɛ wɔfrɛɛ obi na ɔyɛ monomonomnyi a, mma wonntwa no twatsia.
Twatsiatwa nnyɛ hwee, na monomonomyɛ so nnyɛ hwee, na mbom Nyankopɔn ahyɛdze ne ndzido na ohia.
ɔfrɛ kor a wɔfrɛɛ obi wɔ mu no, wɔmma ɔntsena mu.
Wɔfrɛɛ wo na eyɛ akowaa a, mma ɔnnyɛ wo asɛm, na sɛ ibotum enya wo dehyee edzi a, ɔno yɛ no dɛm.
Na nyia wɔfrɛɛ no Ewuradze mu na ɔyɛ akowaa no, ɔyɛ Ewuradze ne dehyee; dɛmara so na ɔdehye a wɔfrɛɛ no, ɔyɛ Christ Jesus akowaa.
Wɔdze bo tɔɔ hom: Mma hom nnyɛ nyimpa nkowaa.
Enuanom, biribiara a wɔafrɛ obi wɔ mu no, ɔnoara mu na ɔnye Nyankopɔn ntsena.
Ba mbaabun ho dze, minnyi Ewuradze hɔ ahyɛdze bi, na mekã m'adwen dɛ nyia oenya Ewuradze hɔ ehumbɔbɔr dɛ ondzi nokwar.
Na dza mususu dɛ oye nye dɛ sesei ahohia yi ntsi oye ma nyimpa dɛ ɔtsena hɔ dɛmara.
Wɔakyekyer wo ɔyer ho anaa? Mma nnhwehwɛ ɔsan. Wɔasan wo ɔyer ho anaa? Mma nnhwehwɛ ɔyer.
Na sɛ awar mpo a, ennyɛ bɔn, na sɛ ɔbaabun war a, ɔnnyɛ bɔn; naaso dɛm nkorɔfo no benya ɔhaw wɔ honam mu, na emidze, mepɛ dɛ mokora hom do.
Na iyi na mekã enuanom, dɛ woetwa mber no tsia, na afei hɔn a wɔwɔ yernom aayɛ dɛ wonnyi bi.
Na hɔn a wosū no aayɛ dɛ wonnsū, na hɔn a hɔn enyi agye aayɛ dɛ hɔn enyi nngye, na hɔn a wɔtɔ aayɛ dɛ wonnyi adze,
Na hɔn a wɔdze wiadze ayɛ, aayɛ dɛ wɔmmfa nnyɛ nnwie; osiandɛ wiadze no su rutwa mu.
Na mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ hom nnyɛ dadwen. Osigyanyi yɛ Ewuradze ndzɛmba ho dadwen, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ asɔ Ewuradze enyi;
Na ɔwarfo dze, ɔyɛ wiadze ndzɛmba ho dadwen, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ asɔ ne yer enyi.

Na sorbi da ɔbaawarfo nye ɔbaabun ntamu: Ɔbaasigyanyi yɛ dadwen wɔ Ewuradze ndzɛmba ho, ama no ho aatsew wɔ nyimpadua nye sunsum so mu; na ɔbaawarfo dze, ɔyɛ dadwen wɔ wiadze ndzɛmba ho, mbrɛ ɔbɔsɔ no kun enyi.
Homankasa hom yie ntsi na mekã yi, nnyɛ dɛ merehyɛ hom katraka, na mbom fɛw a ɔbɛyɛ, na ɔsom a hom bɔsom Ewuradze enyim dɛ biribi nnyɛ hom basabasa ntsi.
Na sɛ obi dwen dɛ ne nyɛe wɔ ne baabun a ɔasõ awar do ɔmmfata, na sɛ ohia so a, wɔmma ɔnyɛ dza ɔpɛ; ɔnnyɛ bɔn, wɔmma wɔnwar.
Na nyia ogyina n'akoma mu pintsinn, na ahohia bi nnda no do, na ɔwɔ nankasa ne pɛ do tum, na oesua n'akoma mu dɛ ɔbɛma ne baabun atsena hɔ no, ɔbɛyɛ yie.
Dɛm ntsi nyia ɔdze nankasa ne baabun ma awar, ɔyɛ yie, na nyia ɔmmfa no mma awar ɔbɛyɛ yie asen no.
Ber tsentsen a ɔbaa no kun tse ase no wɔakyekyer no, na sɛ no kun ka beebi a, nna odzi noho dɛ ɔwar obiara a ɔpɛ, Ewuradze mu nko na ɔnyɛ.
Na sɛ ɔtsena hɔ dɛmara a, iyi na ɔyɛ nhyira ma no, dɛ mbrɛ m'adwen tse: na mususu dɛ mo so mowɔ Nyankopɔn Sunsum.
8: Na abosom afɔrbɔdze ho dze, yenyim dɛ hɛn nyina wowɔ nyimdzee: nyimdzee horan, na dɔ dze tow do.
Sɛ obi susu dɛ onyim biribi a, onnyae nnhunii dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ dɛ ohu;
na sɛ obi dɔ Nyankopɔn a, ɔno na Nyankopɔn nyim no.
Na abosom afɔrbɔdze ne dzi ho dze, yenyim dɛ ɔbosom nnyɛ hwee wɔ wiadze mu, na eso nyame bi nnyi hɔ dɛ ɔbaako no ara.
Na kaansa ɔsor o, asaase o, dza wɔfrɛ hɔn enyame pii wɔ hɔ, dɛ enyame pii nye ewuranom pii wɔ hɔ no a,
hɛndze Nyame kor na yɛwɔ, Egya no a adze nyina fir no mu, na hɛn so yɛwɔ hɔ ma no, nye Ewuradze kor, Jesus Christ a adze nyina nam no do, na hɛn so yɛnam no do.
Naaso nyimdzee no nnyi nyimpa nyina mu, na binom dze hɔn abosomnyim a aka hɔ no dzi no dɛ abosom afɔrbɔdze, na dɛ hɔn tsibowa yɛ mberɛw ntsi, fī ka hɔn.
Na edziban nnkamfo hɛn mma Nyankopɔn, na nnyɛ sɛ yedzi a na yɛbor do, anaa yenndzi a, na yɛka bi a.
Na hom nhwɛ yie, ama ho kwan a hom wɔ no aannyɛ fintsidua amma hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw no.
Na sɛ obi hu wo a ewɔ enyimdzee dɛ etse edzidzii wɔ abosondan mu a, na sɛ ɔyɛ mberɛw a, ana ennkɛma ne tsibowa enya ntowdo ekedzi abosom afɔrbɔdze?
Nna ɔnam wo nyimdzee do na nyia ɔyɛ mberɛw a ɔyɛ onua a Christ wui maa no no ɔrehera.
Na sɛ hom yɛ enuanom no bɔn dɛm pirapira hɔn tsibowa a ɔyɛ mberɛw no a, nna Christ na hom reyɛ no bɔn.
Dɛm ntsi, sɛ edziban ma mo nua fintsiw a, mirinndzi bɔnam ara da, na maamma mo nua emmfintsiw.
9: Ana menndze moho? Ana mennyɛ ɔsomafo? Ana munnhun hɛn Ewuradze Jesus? Ana nnyɛ hom nye m'edwuma wɔ Ewuradze mu?
Sɛ mennyɛ ɔsomafo mma binom a, homdze ara meyɛ mema hom, masomafo yɛ nsɔwano nye hom wɔ Ewuradze mu.
Me nyiano a miyi kyerɛ hɔn a wɔpɛnsa mo mu nye yi.
Ana yennyi ho kwan dɛ yedzidzi na yɛnom?
Ana yennyi ho kwan dɛ yɛdze ɔyer a ɔyɛ gyedzinyi kyima, dɛ ɔsomafo nkaa no, nye Ewuradze n'enuanom no, nye Cephas?
Anaaso emi nko nye Barnabas yennyi ho kwan dɛ yegyaa dwumadzi anaa?
Sordaanyi woana na ɔbɔ nankasa ne kaw kɔ sa? Woana na ɔyɛ wenyin ture na onndzi n'aba bi? Anaaso woana na ɔnyɛn anyɛnmbowa na ɔnnom anyɛnmbowa hɔn numfonsu bi?
Anaa mekã yi nyimpa afamu, anaa mbra no so nnkã dɛm?
Na wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses mbra no mu dɛ, Mma nnkyekyer nantwi a ɔporow eburow no ano. Aso anantwi no ho no ohia Nyankopɔn,
anaa hɛn ntsi ara na ɔkã dɛm? ɛhɛɛ, hɛn ntsi a na wɔakyerɛwee, osiandɛ nyia ofuntum ɔsɛ dɛ ofuntum enyidado mu, na nyia ɔporow enurow no yɛ no enyidado mu dɛ obenya mu bi.
Sɛ yeduaa sunsum ndzɛmba maa hom a, ana ɔyɛ adze a ɔsõ biara dɛ yebobu hom honam mu ndzɛmba?
Sɛ binom enya hom ho kwan yi bi a, ana nnyɛ hɛn mbom a? Naaso yɛammfa kwan a ɔtse dɛm yi do, na mbom yɛsɔw adze nyina, mma yeennsiw Christ asɛmpa no kwan.
Ana hom nnyim dɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ asɔr ho edwuma no dzi asɔrdan mu adze no bi? Na dɛ hɔn a wɔsom afɔrmbukyia ho no nye afɔrmbukyia no nya hɔn kyɛpɛn?
Dɛmara so na Ewuradze hyɛɛ dɛ hɔn a wɔkã asɛmpa no dzidzi asɛmpa no ho.
Na emidze, mennyɛ yinomɛ ho biara; eso mennkyerɛw yi dɛ wɔnyɛ dɛm mma me; na oye ma me dɛ mubowu mbom, kyɛn dɛ obiara bɛma m'ahohyehyɛ ayɛ kwa.
Na sɛ mekã asɛmpa no a, minnyi biribi a medze hyehyɛ moho: Na ehiasɛm da mo do, na sɛ mannkã asɛmpa no a, nkyɛ mundue!
Na sɛ meyɛ yi mankasa me pɛ do a, mowɔ akatua, sɛ eso mannyɛ no mankasa me pɛ do a, wɔdze afihwɛ edwuma ahyɛ me nsa.
Na afei m'akatua nye dza ɔwɔ hen? Ɔno nye dɛ sɛ mekã asɛmpa no a, memma akabɔ nnkã asɛmpa no ho, mma maammfa asɛmpa no ho kwan a mowɔ annyɛ adze ntrado.
Na kaansa midzi moho wɔ nyimpa nyina afamu, medze moho yɛɛ akowaa maa nyimpa nyina, ma me nsa aaka dodowara.
Meyɛɛ Jewnyi maa Jewfo ma meenya Jewfo; hɔn a wɔwɔ mbra no ase no, dɛ nyia ɔwɔ mbra no ase, minnyi mbra no ase dze, na meyɛɛ moho dɛ nyia ɔwɔ mbra no ase, ma meenya hɔn a wɔwɔ mbra ase:
Na hɔn a wonnyi mbra no, meyɛɛ dɛ minnyi mbra maa hɔn, (nnyɛ dɛ minnyi mbra wɔ Naynkopɔn afamu, na mbom mowɔ mbra ase wɔ Christ afamu) ma meenya hɔn a wonnyi mbra.
Hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw no, meyɛɛ dɛ nyia ɔyɛ mberɛW maa hɔn, ma meenya hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw. Mayɛ moho adze nyina ama nyimpa nyina, ma menam akwan nyina mu maagye binom nkwa.
Na iyi nyina asɛmpa no ntsi na meyɛ, ma meenya ho bi.
Ana hom nnyim dɛ hɔn a wotutu empiresibea mu mbirika no, hɔn nyina tu dze, naaso ɔbaako na onya empirenyimdze no? Dɛmara na hom so ntu mbirika, ma hom eenya.
Na obiara a ɔper edzi empirenyim no ɔsɔr noho wɔ adze nyina mu; hɔndze wɔyɛ ma woeenya abɔtsir a ɔsɛɛ, na hɛndze dza ɔnnsɛɛ a.
Dɛm ntsi emidze, mbirika a mutu yi, munntu no esunsumabo mu, ekutuku a motow yi, monntow no dɛ dza morokõ aahow:
Na mbom mehyɛ mo honam amen, na midzi no nya, amma makã asɛmpa akyerɛ binom ekyir no, mankasa woeennyi me tokyen.
10: Na, enuanom, memmpɛ dɛ hom yɛ atam dɛ hɛn egyanom nyina wɔ nsuwusiw no ase, na hɔn nyina nduaa po no mu,
na wonumaa hɔn nyina hyɛɛ Moses mu wɔ nsuwusiw no nye po no mu,
na hɔn nyina dzii sunsum edziban kor no ara bi,
na hɔn nyina noom sunsum nsu kor no ara bi; na wɔnomee fii sunsum botan a ɔkaa hɔn: do na ɔbotan no nye Christ.
Naaso hɔn mu piinara Nyankopɔn enyi annsɔ hɔn; na wodwuruuw hɔn sar no do.
Na iyinom yɛɛ hɛn ho nsɛntoho, na hɛn kɔn aanndɔ ndzebɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kɔn dɔe.
Na mma hom nnyɛ abosonsɔrfo dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu binom yɛe, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, ɔman no tsenaa ase dzidzii, nomee, na wɔsoɛree goree.
Eso mma hom mma yɛmmbɔ ndwamanbra dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu binom yɛe, na mpemeduonuebiasa totɔr da kor.
Eso mma yɛnnsɔ Ewuradze nnhwɛ, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu binom sɔɔ no hwɛe, na nwɔ kunkum hɔn.
Eso mma hom nnhwinhwin, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu binom hwinhwinii, na ɔsɛɛfo sɛɛ hɔn.
Na yinom nyina yɛɛ hɔn wɔ nsɛntoho ntsi, na wɔkyerɛwee maa hɛn a mber no ewiei ato hɛn yi hɛn afotu.
Dɛm ntsi ma nyia ɔdwen dɛ ogyina hɔ no nhwɛ yie mma ɔaannhwe ase.
Nsɔhwɛ bi nntoo hom dɛ dza nyimpa tum soa ara, na Nyankopɔn yɛ ɔnokwafo a ɔremma wɔnnsɔ hom nnhwɛ nnkyɛn dza hom botum, na mbom ɔdze ɔkwan bɛka nsɔhwɛ no ho a wɔnam mu fi nsa, ma hom eetum asɔw.
Dɛm ntsi, m'adɔfo, hom nguan abosonsɔr.
Mekasa kyerɛ hom dɛ enyansafo: Hom mbu dza mekã ho atsɛn.
Nhyira kuraba a yehyira do no, nnyɛ Christ bɔ gyaa o ho nkyitahodzi anaa? Paano a yebubu no, nnyɛ Christ nyimpadua nkitahodzi anaa?
Osiandɛ ɔyɛ paanoo kor no, hɛn a yɛdɔɔ sõ no yɛ nyimpadua kor; na hɛn nyina yedzi paano kor no ara bi.
Hom nhwɛ honam afamu Israel: ana hɔn a wodzi afɔrbɔdze no nye afɔrmbukyia no nndzi nkitaho?
Ebɛn mbɔ na merekã? Dɛ adze a wɔdze abɔ afɔr ama abosom yɛ biribi, anaa dɛ ɔbosom yɛ biribi?
Dabi, na mbom dɛ dza amanamamfo dze bɔ afɔr no, wɔbɔ ma mbɔnsam, na nnyɛ Nyankopɔn bi a: Na memmpɛ dɛ hom nye mbɔnsam dzi nkitaho.
Hom runntum nnom Ewuradze kuraba mu nye mbɔnsan kuraba mu; hom runntum nnyɛ Ewuradze pon mu fafafo.
Ana Ewuradze na yeriyi no nyinkun anaa? Hɛn ho yɛ dzen sen no anaa?
Kwan da adze nyina ho, na nnyɛ adze nyina na ɔfata; kwan da adze nyina ho, na nnyɛ adze nyina na ɔtow do.
Mma obiara nnhwehwɛ nankasa nedze, na mbom ɔnhwehwɛ ne nyɛnko dze.
Biribiara a wɔtɔn no nangua do no hom ndzi, na mma hom mmbisabisa mu wɔ tsibowa ntsi:
na asaase nye no mu adze nyina yɛ Ewuradze dze.
Sɛ hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi mu bi hyia hom edzidzi na hom pɛ dɛ hom kɔ a, dza wɔdze besisi hom enyim nyina hom ndzi, mma hom mmbisabisa mu wɔ hom tsibowa ntsi.
Na sɛ obi se hom dɛ, Iyi yɛ adze a wɔdze abɔ afɔr ama abosom a, mma hom nndzi, wɔ nyia ɔkyerɛe no ntsi, nye tsibowa ntsi:
medɛ tsibowa a, nnyɛ wodze, na nyia no nedze na mekyerɛ; na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔdze obi ne tsibowa bobu m'ahodzi atsɛn?
Na sɛ medze ndaase dzi bi a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔbɔbɔ me dzin bɔn wɔ dza meda ho ase ntsi?
Dɛm ntsi sɛ hom ridzidzi o, hom ronom o, hom reyɛ biribi o, hom nyɛ ne nyina mma Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
Hom nyɛ nyimpa a fintsidua nnyi hɔn mu mma Jewfo nye Greekfo nye Nyankopɔn asɔrmba:
Dɛ mbrɛ mo so mosɔ nyimpa nyina enyi wɔ adze nyina mu, monnhwehwɛ mankasa me mfaso, na mbom dza ɔyɛ nyimpa pii dze, ma woennya kwa.
11: Hom nyɛ m'esuasuafo, dɛ mbrɛ mo so meyɛ Christ suasuafo.
Afei miyi hom ayɛw dɛ hom kaa me adze nyina mu, na hom kura atsetsesɛm no mu, dɛ mbrɛ medze hyɛɛ hom nsa no ara.
Na mepɛ dɛ hom hu dɛ ɔbarimba biara ne tsir nye Christ, na ɔbaa ne tsir nye ɔbarimba, na Christ ne tsir nye Nyankopɔn.
Ɔbarimba biara a ɔrosɔr, anaa ɔrehyɛ nkɔm, na wɔakata ne tsir no, ɔhyɛ ne tsir fɛr.
Na ɔbaa biara a ɔrosɔr, anaa ɔrehyɛ nkɔm, na ɔannkata ne tsir no, ɔhyɛ ne tsir fɛr, na ɔtse dɛ nyia ɔapra ne tsir no ara.
Na sɛ ɔannkata ne tsir a, ma ɔmpra ne tsir so; na sɛ ɔyɛ enyiwu ma ɔbaa dɛ oyi anaa ɔpra ne tsir a, ɔnodze ma ɔnkata ne tsir.
Na ɔbarimba dze, ɔnnsɛ dɛ ɔkata ne tsir, osiandɛ ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn no honyi nye n'enyimnyam, na ɔbaa dze ɔyɛ ɔbarimba n'enyimnyam.
Na nnyɛ ɔbarimba na ɔfi ɔbaa mu, na mbom ɔbaa na ofi ɔbarimba mu;
eso nnyɛ ɔbaa ntsi na wɔbɔɔ ɔbarimba, na mbom ɔbarimba ntsi na wɔbɔɔ ɔbaa.
Iyi ntsi na ɔsɛ dɛ ɔbaa nya dza ɔkyerɛ tumdzi wɔ ne tsir do, wɔ abɔfo no ntsi.
Naaso Ewuradze mu dze, ɔbarimba nnkwetsir baa, na ɔbaa so nnkwetsir ɔbarimba:
Na dɛ mbrɛ ɔbaa fi ɔbarimba mu no, mbrɛ ɔbarimba so nam ɔbaa do ba nye no; na adze nyina fi Nyankopɔn mu.
Homankasa mbu hom mu atsɛn; ana oye dɛ ɔbaa dze tsir a ɔannkata yɛ asɔr ma Nyankopɔn?
Ana ɔbrasu ara mpo nnkyerɛkyerɛ hom dɛ sɛ ɔbarimba sie tsir kusuww a, ɔyɛ ahorohoraa ma no?
Na sɛ ɔbaa dze osie tsir kusuww a, ɔyɛ enyimnyam ma no, osiandɛ wɔdze ne tsinhwi maa no dɛ akatado.
Na sɛ obi pɛ dɛ odzi ntokwano a, hɛndze yemmbu dɛm bra, na Nyankopɔn asɔrasɔr no nnyɛ dɛm.
Na medze yinom rehyɛ hom a, minnyi hom ayɛw dɛ hom nnhyia mu wɔ papa ntsi, na mbom bɔn ntsi a.
Kan dze nye dɛ metse dɛ sɛ hom hyia mu wɔ asɔr mu a, mpaapaamu wɔ hom mu; na megye bi midzi.
Na ɔwɔ dɛ fɛkuwbɔ horow ba hom mu, na hɔn a wɔgye hɔn to mu no aada edzi wɔ hom mu.
Na sɛ hom behyia fakor a, nnyɛ Ewuradze edzidzi na hom dzi no:
Na hom ridzidzi a, ɔbaako dzi kan dzi nankasa n'edziban, na obi ɔkɔm dze no, na obi abow.
Ebɛn a? Ana hom nnyi efi a hom dzidzi mu? Anaa nnyɛ Nyankopɔn asɔr na hom bu no enyimtsia, na hom hyɛ hɔn a wonnyi bi enyito? Mense hom dɛn? Minyi hom ayɛw wɔ yi mu anaa? Minnyi hom ayɛw.
Na emidze, minyaa Ewuradze nsamu dza medze memaa hom no, ɔnyɛ dɛ Ewuradze Jesus anago no a woyii no mae no, ɔfaa paanoo;
na ɔdaa ase no, obubui, na ɔsee dɛ, me nyimpadua a wɔdze ama hom nye yi: Hom nyɛ yi mfa nyɛ me nkaa.
Dɛmara so na edzidzi ekyir no ɔfaa kuraba no see dɛ, kuraba yi nye ahyɛmu fofor no wɔ mo bɔgyaa mu: Hom nyɛ yi mber biara a hom bɔnom no mfa nyɛ me nkaa.
Na mber biara a hom dzi paanoo yi, na hom nom kuraba yi, hom bɔ Ewuradze wu no ho dawur dze kesi dɛ ɔbɛba.
Dɛm ntsi obiara a obedzi paanoo yi, anaa ɔbɔnom Ewuradze kuraba yi dɛ mbrɛ ɔnnsɛ no, obedzi Ewuradze nyimpadua nye no bɔgyaa ho fɔ.
Na ma nyimpa nsɔ noho nhwɛ, na ondua dɛm ndzi paanoo no bi, na ɔnnom kuraba no bi.
Na nyia odzi na ɔnom odzi na ɔnom dze atsɛmbu ba nankasa noho do, osiandɛ oemmbu Ewuradze nyimpadua bi yie.
Iyi ntsi na hom mu pii ayɛ mberɛw na wɔyaryar, na nnyɛkuma so adeda.
Na sɛ yeebu hɛnankasa hɛnho yie a, nkyɛ wommbubu hɛn atsɛn.
Na sɛ wobu hɛn atsɛn a, Ewuradze tsēa hɛn amma woeemmbu yɛnye wiadze fɔ.
Dɛm ntsi, mo nuanom, sɛ hom behyia mu rebedzidzi a, hom ntweɔntweɔn homho.
Na sɛ ɔkɔm dze bi a, wɔmma ondzidzi fie, mma hom eemmbehyia mu emmbenya atsɛmbu. Na nkaa no dze, sɛ meba a, mebɛsesɛw.
12: Na sunsum mu akyɛdze ho dze, enuanom, memmpɛ dɛ hom yɛ ho atam.
Hom nyim dɛ nkan no a hom yɛ amanamamfo no wogyaa hom kɔr abosom mmum nkyɛn, dɛ mbrɛ wogyaa hom kɔree ara.
Dɛm ntsi merema hom ehu dɛ obiara a ɔnam Nyankopɔn Sunsum mu kasa no, ɔmmfrɛ Jesus ebusudze; na obiara nntum nnkã dɛ Jesus nye Ewuradze gyesɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu.
Na akyɛdze horow wɔ hɔ, na Sunsum kor no ara a.
Na ɔsom horow wɔ hɔ, na Ewuradze kor no ara a.
Na dwumadzi horow wɔ hɔ, na Nyankopɔn kor no ara na ɔyɛ adze nyina wɔ hɔn nyina mu.
Naaso wɔdze Sunsum edziyi no ma hɔn nyina nkorkor, na aayɛ hɔn mfaso.
Na wɔnam Sunsum mu ama obi enyansasɛm, obi so nyimdzeesɛm, dɛ mbrɛ Sunsum kor no ara tse:
obi so gyedzi, wɔ Sunsum kor no ara mu; obi so yarsa akyɛdze wɔ Sunsum kor no ara mu; obi so etumdzeyɛ; obi so nkɔnhyɛ; obi so esunsum mu hu; obi so kasa horow; obi so kasa horow nkyerɛase:
na yinom nyina Sunsum kor no ara na ɔyɛ, na ɔkyekyɛ ma hɔn nkorkor dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ.
Na dɛ mbrɛ nyimpadua yɛ kor, na ɔwɔ mfafakuwa pii, na nyimpadua ne mfafakuwa no nyina dɔɔ sõ dze, naaso wɔyɛ nyimpadua kor no, mbrɛ Christ so tse nye no.
Na hɛn nyina so, Jewfo o, Greekfo o, Nkowaa o, adehye o, woenuma hɛn Sunsum kor mu aba nyimpadua kor mu; na wɔama hɛn nyina anom Sunsum kor no ara bi.
Na nyimpadua nnyɛ fafakuwa kor, na pii.
Sɛ anan se dɛ, Mennyɛ nsa ntsi mennyɛ nyimpadua ho bi a, nna nnyɛ iyi ntsi na ɔma ɔnnyɛ nyimpadua ho bi.
Na sɛ aso se dɛ, Mennyɛ enyiwa ntsi mennyɛ nyimpadua ho bi a, nna nnyɛ yi ntsi na ɔma ɔnnyɛ nyimpadua ho bi.
Na sɛ nyimpadua nyina yɛ enyiwa a, ɔtse no wɔ hen? Ne nyina yɛ ɔtse a, ohūa no wɔ hen?
Na afei Nyankopɔn dze mfafakuwa esisi nyimpa ho nkokor dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ.
Na sɛ hɔn nyina yɛ fafakuwa kor a, nyimpadua no wɔ hɛn?
Na afei mfafakuwa dɔɔ sõ dze, naaso nyimpadua no yɛ kor.
Na enyiwa nntum nnse nsa dɛ, minnyi wo ho hia; anaaso bio, tsir nntum nnse anan dɛ, minnyi wo ho hia.
Na mbom nyimpadua ho mfafakuwa a wɔyɛ dɛ wɔyɛ mberɛw dodow no hɔn na hɔn ho hia;
na nyimpadua ho bi a yɛdwen dɛ ɔnnsɛ enyidzi pii no na yɛhyɛ no enyidzi pii; na dza ɔnnyɛ fɛw wɔ hɛn ho no na ɔwɔ ahoka pii;
na dza ɔyɛ fɛw wɔ hɛn ho no nnhia dɛm: Na Nyankopɔn dze nyimoadua no atoatoa mu, na mfafakuwa a wɔka bi no ɔama hɔn enyidzi pii;
amma mpaapaamu aammba nyimpadua no mu, na mbom mfafakuwa no eenya ndwendo kor no ara ama hɔnho nkorkor.
Na sɛ fafakuwa kor hu amandze a, mfafakuwa no nyina hu bi; na eso wɔhyɛ fafakuwa kor enyimnyam a, mfafakuwa no nyina nye no dzi dɛw.
Na afei hom yɛ Christ nyimpadua no nye no ho mfafakuwa nkorkor.
Na Nyankopɔn dze binom esisi asɔr no mu: Dza odzi kan asomafo, otsīa ebien nkɔnhyɛfo, otsīa ebiasa akyerɛkyerɛfo, nkyii atumdzeyɛ, na nkyii yarsa akyɛdze, mboa, mpanyindzi, ɔkasa horow.
Ana hɔn nyina yɛ asomafo? Hɔn nyina yɛ nkɔnhyɛfo? Hɔn nyina yɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo? Hɔn nyina yɛ etumdzeyɛfo?
hɔn nyina wɔ yarsa akyɛdze? Hɔn nyina kasa kasa hohrow? Hɔn nyina akyerɛ ase?
Naaso hom mper akyɛdze tsitsir no ho. Na mbom merekyerɛ hom kwan a oye kyɛn biribiara.
13: Sɛ medze nyimpa nye abɔfo tɛkyerɛma nekasa, na minnyi ɔdɔ a, mayɛ dɛ ayewa a ɔgyegye nye akasaa a ɔwosow.
Na sɛ mowɔ nkɔnhyɛ akyɛdze, na minyim esumasɛm nyina nye nyimdzee nyina, na sɛ mowɔ gyedzi nyina ma mututu mbepɔw, na minnyi ɔdɔ a, mennsɛ hwee.
Na sɛ medze m'adze nyina menyɛn ehiafo, na sɛ medze me nyimpadua ma dɛ wɔnhyew, na sɛ minnyi ɔdɔ a, minnya ho hwee.
Ɔdɔ pen kyɛr, na yamu ye, ɔdɔ nnyɛ ahoɔyaw, ɔdɔ nnyɛ ahohyehyɛ, ɔnnhoran;
ɔnnyɛ noho dza ɔmmfata, ɔnnhwehwɛ nankasa nedze, no bo nnhaw no, ommbu bɔn ho akontaa;
onndzi dɛw wɔ dza ɔnntsen ho, na ɔnye nokwar no dzi dɛw;
ɔsoa adze nyina; ɔgye adze nyina dzi; onya adze nyina ho enyidado; ɔsɔw adze nyina.
Ɔdɔ mmbɔ adze da: na nkɔnhyɛnsɛm dze, wobogu no; ɔkasa horow dze, wobegyaa; nyimdzee dze, wobogu no.
Na yenyim fã-na-fã, na yɛhyɛ nkɔm fã-na-fa:
Na sɛ dza odzi mu no nya ba a, nna wobogu dza ɔyɛ fã-na-fã no.
Meyɛ abofra no, mekasaa dɛ abofra, metsee adze ase dɛ abofra, modween dɛ abofra, na mebɛyɛɛ panyin no, medze mbofrasɛm guu nkyɛn.
Na sesei dze yɛnam ahwehwɛ mu hu adze wɔ bɛ mu, na ndaamba dze enyim na enyim: sesei dze minyim fã-na-fã, na ndaamba dze mubohu dɛ mbrɛ woehu mo so.
Na afei gyedzi, enyidado, ɔdɔ, ebisa yi na ɔwɔ hɔ daa; na hɔn mu kɛse nye ɔdɔ.
14: Hom mpɛ ɔdɔ ekyir, naaso hom mbɔ mbɔdzen nhwehwɛ sunsum mu akyɛdze, na ne kɛse no nye dɛ hom bɛhyɛ nkɔm.
Na nyia ɔkasa kasa bi no, ɔnnkasa nnkyerɛ nyimpa, na mbom ɔdze kyerɛ Nyankopɔn; na obi nntse, na sunsum mu na ɔkã esumasɛm.
Na nyia ɔhyɛ nkɔm no, ɔka ntowdo nye afotu nye awerɛkyekyer kyerɛ nyimpa.
Nyia ɔkasa kasa bi no, ɔtow nankasa noho do, na nyia ɔhyɛ nkɔm no ɔtow asɔr no do.
Mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ hom nyina kasa kasa horow dze, na mbom nkyɛ hom aahyɛ nkɔm: Na nyia ɔhyɛ nkɔm sõ sen nyia ɔkasa kasa horow, gyedɛ ɔkyerɛ ase na asɔr no eenya ntowdo.
Na afei, enuanom, sɛ meba hom nkyɛn mebɛkasa kasa horow, na sɛ mannkasa annkyerɛ hom wɔ nyikyerɛ mu, anaa nyimdzee mu, anaa nkɔnhyɛ mu, anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ mu a, mfaso bɛn na mebɛyɛ ama hom?
Na ndzɛmba a wonnyi nkwa mpo, dɛ atsɛntɛbɛn anaa nsanku, sɛ wɔanngyegye ndze horow a, wɔbɛyɛ dɛn ehu dza wɔrehɛn anaa dza wɔrepran?
Na sɛ totorobɛnto no annhɛn yie a, woana besiesie noho akɔ akono?
Dɛmara na hom so, sɛ hom ammfa hom tɛkyerɛma annkã asɛm a ase nnyɛ tse-na a, wɔbɛyɛ dɛn ehu dza hom kã? Hom bɛyɛ dɛ hɔn a wɔkasa gu mframa mu.
Annyɛ a, ndze horow pii wɔ wiadze, naaso no mu biara nnyi hɔ a onnyi ase.
Na sɛ minnyim ndze no ase a, mebɛyɛ nyia ɔkasa no dɛ ɔpɔtɔnyi, na nyia ɔkasa no ayɛ me dɛ ɔpɔtɔnyi.
Dɛmara na hom so robɔ sunsum mu akyɛdze ho mbɔdzen yi, hom nhwehwɛ dɛ hom bɔbor do ama asɔr no ntowdo.
Dɛm ntsi nyia ɔkasa kasa bi no ɔnsɔr dɛ ɔnkyerɛ ase.
Na sɛ mosɔr wɔ kasa bi mu a, mo sunsum sɔr dze, na m'adwen dze nnsow aba.
Nna ɔtse dɛn nye no mbɔ? Medze sunsum bɔsɔr, na medze me ntseasee so masɔr, medze sunsum bɔtow ndwom, na medze ntseasee so matow ndwom.
Na sɛ edze sunsum hyira a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na nyia ɔtse nyia onnyim ho bi ne tsenabew no bɛse Amen wɔ wo ndaase no ekyir, sɛ onnyim dza akã no a?
Na ɔwodze eda ase yie dze, na ɔnodze onnya ntowdo.
Meda Nyankopɔn ase dɛ mekasa ɔkasa horow sen hom nyina:
naaso, asɔr mu dze, mepɛ dɛ medze me ntseasee kã nsɛmfua enum ma maakyerɛkyerɛ binom so, kyɛn dɛ mebɛka nsɛm mpemdu wɔ ɔkasa bi mu.
Enuanom, mma hom nnyɛ mbofra wɔ adwen mu, na mbom bɔn mu na hom nyɛ mbofraba, na adwen mu dze hom nyɛ dɛ hɔn a woewie nyin.
Na wɔakyerɛw no mbra no mu dɛ, Medze ananaben gyirama, nye ananaben ano na mebɛkasa akyerɛ ɔman yi, na nnyɛ dɛm mpo na wobetsie me, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Dɛm ntsi kasa horow nnyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze mma hɔn a wɔgye dzi, na mbom ɔdze ma hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi; na nkɔnhyɛ dze, nnyɛ hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi dze, na mbom hɔn a wɔgye dzi a.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ asɔr nyina behyia, na hɔn nyina kasa kasa horow, na sɛ nyimpa bi a wonnyim ho bi, na wɔnngye nndzi ba mu a, wɔnnkɛse dɛ hom egyingyam anaa?
Na sɛ hɔn nyina hyɛ nkɔm, na sɛ obi a ɔnngye nndzi anaa onnyim ho bi ba mu a, hɔn nyina twuw n'enyim, hɔn nyina bu no atsɛn;
na n'akoma mu esumasɛm ada edzi, na dɛm no ɔdze n'enyim ebutuw famu asɔr Nyankopɔn akã dɛ, Nyankopɔn wɔ hom mu ampa.
Nna, enuanom, ɔtse dɛn nye no mbɔ? Sɛ hom behyia mu a, hom mu biara wɔ ndwom, wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ, wɔ nyikyerɛsɛm, wɔ kasa bi, wɔ nkyerɛase bi. Hom mma wɔnnyɛ adze nyina mma ntowdo.
Sɛ obi kasa kasa bi a, ɔnyɛ beenu, na ɔtra dɛm a, baasa, na wondzi esiado, na ɔbaako nkyerɛ ase:
na sɛ asekyerɛnyi nnyi hɔ a, ommua n'ano wɔ asɔr no mu, na ɔnkasa nkyerɛ nankasa noho nye Nyankopɔn.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo no dze, beenu anaa baasa nkasa, na nkaa no nyinyi mu.
Na sɛ woyi biribi kyerɛ obi a ɔtse nkyɛn a, nyia odzi kan no mmua n'ano.
Na hom nyina botum ahyɛ nkɔm nkorkor, na hom nyina aafa mu afotu;
na nkɔnhyɛfo hɔn esunsum no hyɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no ase;
na Nyankopɔn nnyɛ sakasaka Nyankopɔn, na mbom ɔyɛ asomdwee dze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ahotsewfo asɔr nyina mu.
Hom mma mbaa no mmua hɔn ano wɔ asɔr mu, na wɔmmaa hɔn kwan dɛ wɔnkasa, na mbom wɔmbrɛ hɔnho adze dɛ mbra no so se.
Na sɛ wɔpɛ biribi esūa a, wombisa hɔnankasa hɔn kunnom wɔ fie, osiandɛ ɔyɛ enyiwu ma ɔbaa dɛ ɔbɛkasa wɔ asɔr fi mu.
Ebɛn a? Hom mu na Nyankopɔn asɛm firii kɔree? Ana hom nkotoo na ɔbaa hom hɔ?
Sɛ obi dwen noho dɛ ɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi anaa sunsumnyi a, onhu dza merekyerɛw hom yi dɛ ɔyɛ Ewuradze ahyɛdze.
Na sɛ obi nnyim adze a, mma onnhu dze.
Dɛm ntsi, mo nuanom, hom mbɔ mbɔdzen nhwehwɛ nkɔnhyɛ akyɛdze, na mma hom nnsiw kasa horow mu kasa kwan.
Na hom mma wɔnyɛ adze nyina fɛfɛɛfɛw esiado esiado.
15: Na afei, enuanom, merema hom ehu asɛmpa no a mekãa kyerɛɛ hom, na hom so gyee, na hom gyina mu so,
ɔnam do na hom nya nkwa so, sɛ hom suo asɛm no ara a medze kãa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ hom no mu dzen a, gyesɛ hom gyee dzii kwa.
Na nsɛm a odzi kan a mo so minyae a medze hyɛɛ hom nsa nye dɛ hɛn bɔn ntsi na Christ wui dɛ mbrɛ kyerɛwnsɛm no se;
Na dɛ wosiee no, na ne ndaansa no wonyaan no dɛ mbrɛ kyerɛwnsɛm no se;
Na dɛ oyii noho kyerɛɛ Cephas, na nkyii oyii noho kyerɛɛ duebien no;
na nkyii oyii noho kyerɛɛ enuanom bɔbor ahaenum prɛko a hɔn mu piinara tsetse hɔ sesei, na binom adeda;
na nkyii oyii noho kyerɛɛ James; na nkyii oyii noho kyerɛɛ asomafo no nyina;
na hɔn nyinara ekyir, na oyii noho kyerɛɛ mo so a metse dɛ obi a wɔwo no ber a ɔnnsõe mu.
Na emi nye asomafo no mu ekumaba a mennsɛ dɛ wɔfrɛ me ɔsomafo, osiandɛ mihiahiaa Nyankopɔn asɔr ho.
Naaso ɔnam Nyankopɔn adom do na metse mbrɛ metse yi, na n'adom a ɔdze doom me na annyɛ gyan: Na mbom mayɛ edwuma pii asen hɔn nyina, naaso nnyɛ emi a, na mbom Nyankopɔn adom a ɔnye me nam a.
Ntsi sɛ emi o, hɔn o, mbrɛ yɛkã nye yi, na mbrɛ hom gyee dzii nye yi.
Na sɛ wɔkã no Christ ho dɛ oenyan efi ewufo mu a, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom mu binom kã dɛ ewufosoɛr bi nnyi?
Na sɛ ewufosoɛr bi nnyi a, nna Christ so nnyanee:
Na sɛ Christ nnyanee a, nna hɛn asɛnka yɛ gyan, na hom gyedzi so yɛ gyan.
ɛhɛɛ, na wobohu hɛn so dɛ yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ho adasekrumfo, osiandɛ yedzi Nyankopɔn dase dɛ oenyan Christ a onnyaan no, sɛ ɔtse dɛɛm dɛ ewufo nnyan a.
Na sɛ ewufo nnyan a, nna Christ so nnyanee;
na sɛ Christ nnyanee a, hom gyedzi yɛ kwa, hom da ho wɔ hom bɔn mu.
Nna eso hɔn a wɔdeda wɔ Christ mu no ahera.
Sɛ nkwa yi mu nko na yeenya enyidado wɔ Christ mu a, nyimpa nyina mu abɔbɔfo nye hɛn.
Na afei Christ enyan efi ewufo mu ayɛ hɔn a wɔdeda mu eduaba kan.
Na mbrɛ owu nam nyimpa do bae no, nyimpa na ewufosoɛr so nam no do bae.
Na dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nyina wu wɔ Adam mu no, dɛmara so na hɔn nyina benya nkwa wɔ Christ mu.
Obiara wɔ nankasa ne kyɛpɛn do: Christ nye eduaba kan, na nkyii hɔn a wɔyɛ Christ dze, wɔ ne ba mu.
Na nkyii ewiei no reba a ɔdze ahendzi no bɛhyɛ Nyankopɔn nye Egya no nsa, ber a ɔama mpanyindzi nye tumdzi nye ahoɔdzen nyina ayɛ kwa.
Na ɔtwar dɛ odzi hen kodu dɛ ɔdze n'atamfo nyina egu n'ananadze.
Na ɔtamfo a odzi ekyir a ɔbɛma ɔayɛ kwa, nye owu.
Na ɔdze adze nyina egu n'ananadze. Na sɛ ɔkã dɛ ɔdze adze nyina egu n'ananadze a, no mu da hɔ pefee dɛ nyia ɔdze adze nyina guu n'ananadze no nnka ho bi.
Na sɛ onya dze ndzɛmba nyina gu n'ananadze a, nna ɔba no nankasa so dze noho bɛhyɛ nyia ɔdze adze nyina guu ananadze no n'ase, na Nyankopɔn aayɛ adze nyina mu adze nyina.
Ɔnntse dɛm a, hɔn a wonuma hɔn ma ewufo no, wɔbɛyɛ dɛn? Sɛ ewufo nnyan koraa a, ɔyɛ dɛn na wonuma hɔn ma ewufo?
Ɔyɛ dɛn na hɛn so amandze sian hɛn dɔnhwer nyina?
Enuanom, mekã hom ho ahohyehyɛ a mowɔ wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Christ Jesus mu dɛ muwu.
Sɛ nyimpa afamu nko na menye mbowa kõe wɔ Ephesus a, ɔyɛ me ebɛn mfaso? Na sɛ ewufo nnyan a, hom mma yendzidzi na yɛnnom, na ɔkyena na yeewu.
Mma wɔnndaadaa hom: Fɛkuw bɔn sɛɛ bra pa.
Hon ntsew hom enyi tsenenee mu, na mma hom nnyɛ bɔn; na binom nnyi Nyankopɔn ho nyimdzee: Mekã yi mehyɛ hom enyito.
Na bi a obi bɛse dɛ, Ewufo dua dɛn nyan? Na nyimpadua so bɛn na wɔdze bɛba?
Ɔkwasea, dza idua no nnya nkwa, gyedɛ owu ansaana,
na dza idua no nnyɛ dua a ɔbɛba no na idua, na burofua ara kwa, bi a ewifua anaa nkaa no mu bi a;
na Nyankopɔn na ɔma no dua kor a ɔpɛ, na ɔma aba biara nankasa no dua.
Nnyɛ nam nyina na ɔyɛ nam kor: Ɔsor nyimpa nam, ɔsor mbowa dze, ɔsor anoma dze, ɔsor esunam dze.
Sor abɔdze so wɔ hɔ, na famu abɔdze wɔ hɔ: Na ɔsor sor dze no n'enyimnyam, na ɔsor famu dze no nedze.
Ewia enyimnyam nko, bosoom dze nko, nworaba dze nko: Na ɔsosor nworaba enyimnyam nkorkor,
Mbrɛ ewufo mu soɛr so tse nye no wodua no prɔwee mu: Wonyan no dza ɔmmprɔw;
wodua no enyimguase mu: Wonyan no enyimnyam mu; wodua no mberɛw mu: Wonyan no ahoɔdzen mu; wodua no no mberɛw mu: Wonayn no ahoɔdzen mu;
Wodua no ɔkra nyimpadua: Wonyan no sunsum nyimpadua. Sɛ ɔkra nyimpadua wɔ hɔ a, nna sunsum dze so wɔ hɔ.
Dɛmara so na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Adam a odzi kan no bɛyɛɛ ɔkra tseasefo: Adam a odzi ekyir no bɛyɛɛ sunsum a ɔma nkwa.
Naaso nnyɛ sunsum dze no na odzi kan, na mbom ɔkra dze no a, na nkyii sunsum dze no reba.
Nyimpa a odzi kan no fi famu yɛ famunyi, nyimpa a otsīa ebien no fi sor.
Mbrɛ famunyi no tse, mbrɛ so hɔn a wɔyɛ famufo tse nye no: na mbrɛ ɔsornyi no tse no, mbrɛ so hɔn a wɔyɛ ɔsorfo tse nye no.
Na mbrɛ yɛahyɛ famunyi no suban no, mbrɛ so yɛbɛhyɛ ɔsornyi no suban nye no.
Na, enuanom, dza mekã nye dɛ honam nye bɔgya nntum nnya Nyankopɔn ahenman no; na eso dza ɔprɔw rinnya dza ɔmmprɔw no.
Hwɛ, merekã hom esumasɛm: Nyɛ hɛn nyina na yɛbɛdeda, na wɔbɛsakyer hɛn nyina,
amonmu ara, enyi rubu, wɔ ekyir abɛntoa no mu: Na wɔbɛhɛn abɛntoa no, na ewufo no bɛnyan dɛ wɔmmprɔw da, na hɛndze, yɛbɛsakyer.
Na dza ɔprɔw yi otwar dɛ ɔhyɛ dza ɔmmprɔw, na dza owu yi otwar dɛ ɔhyɛ dza onnwu.
Na sɛ dza ɔprɔw yi nya hyɛ dza ɔmmprɔw a, na dza owu yi nya hyɛ dza onnwu a, nna asɛm a wɔakyerɛw no bɛba mu dɛ, owu, wɔamen no konyim mu.
Owu, wo konyim wɔ hen? Owu, wo hwirom wɔ hen?
Owu hwirom nye bɔn, na bɔn tum nye mbra no:
na ndaase nkã Nyankopɔn a ɔnam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ do ma hɛn konyim.
Dɛm ntsi, mo nuanom adɔfo, hom ntsintsim, mma hom nnhim, hom mbor do wɔ Ewuradze edwuma mu daa, osiandɛ hom nyim dɛ hom berɛ nnyɛ gyan wɔ Ewuradze mu.
16: Na ɔtow a wɔdze kɛma ahotsewfo no ho dze, dɛ mbrɛ mehyehyɛɛ asɔrasɔr a ɔwɔ Galatia mu no, dɛmara na hom so nyɛ.
Dapɛn mu da a odzi kan no, hom nyina ntsīatsia ngu hom nkyɛn nkorkor, dɛ mbrɛ obiara esi no yie, ma minya ba a, wɔaanngyegye tow.
Na sɛ musu a, hɔn a hom dze nwoma bɛkyerɛ dɛ wɔfata dɛm edwuma, mobɔsoma hɔn dze hom akyɛdze akɔ Jerusalem;
Na sɛ ɔsɛ dɛ mo so mokɔ a, menye hɔn bɔkɔ.
Na mikesi Macedonia a, mebɛba hom nkyɛn; na Macedonia na mirikesi.
Na hom nkyɛn na annyɛ a mebɛtsena menye hom edzi awɔwber mpo, na beebiara a mobɔkɔ no hom eegya me kwan.
Na afei dze memmpɛ dɛ muhu hom kwan do nko; na sɛ Ewuradze ma ho kwan a, m'enyi da dɛ mebɛkyɛr hom nkyɛn kakra.
Na mebɛkyɛr Ephesus ekodu Pentecost:
na woebue abow kɛse a biribi befir mu ama me, na atamfo no wɔdɔɔ sõ.
Na sɛ Timothy ba a, hom nhwɛ ma ɔaammfa hu nye hom anntsena: Na ɔyɛ Ewuradze edwuma no bi dɛ mbrɛ mo so meyɛ.
Dɛm ntsi mma obi mmbu no enyimtsia. Na hom ngya no kwan asomdwee mu ma ɔmbra me nkyɛn: Na morotweɔn ɔno nye enuanom no.
Na onua Apollos ho dze, meserɛɛ no pii dɛ ɔnye enuanom no mbra hom nkyɛn, na ɔannyɛ ne pɛ koraa dɛ ɔbɛba sesei; na onya mu kwan a, ɔbɛba.
Hom nweɔn, hom ngyina gyedzi no mu pintsinn, hom nyɛ dɛ mbarimba, hom mma homho nyɛ dzen.
Hom nyɛ dza hom yɛ nyina wɔ dɔ mu.
Na meserɛ hom, enuanom, (hom nyim Stephanas fifo, dɛ wɔyɛ Achaea aba a odzi kan, na dɛ wɔdze hɔnho ama ahotsewfo som no),
dɛ hom so mbrɛ homho adze mma dɛm nkorɔfo, nye obiara a ɔboa wɔ edwuma no mu na ɔberɛ.
Na m'enyi gye wɔ Stephanas nye Fortunatus nye Achaicus hɔn ba no ho, na dza aka hom afamu no wɔabɛyɛ ama me.
Na wɔabɔdwedwe mo sunsum nye homdze: Hom nhu hɔn a wɔtse dɛm no yie.
Asia asɔrasɔr kyiakyia hom. Aɔuila nye Prisca kyia hom pii wɔ Ewuradze mu, nye asɔr a ɔwɔ hɔn fie.
Enuanom nyina kyia hom. Hom mfa mfewano krɔnkrɔn nkyiakyia homho.
Emi Paul me nsaano nkyia nye yi.
Sɛ obi nndɔ Ewuradze a, wɔmma ɔnyɛ ebusudze. Maran atha. (Ewuradze reba.)
Ewuradze Jesus Christ adom nkã hom.
Mo dɔ nkã hom nyina wɔ Christ Jesus mu. Amen.

1: Dza ofi ahyɛse, dza yɛatse, dza yɛdze hɛn enyiwa ehu, dza yɛhwɛe, na yɛdze hɛn nsa kãe wɔ nkwa asɛm no ho,
Ɔna nkwa no woyii no kyerɛe, na yeehu na yedzi ho dase, na yɛkã onnyiewiei nkwa a ɔnye Egya no wɔ hɔ, na woyii no kyerɛɛ hɛn no no ho asɛm kyerɛ hom);
dza yeehu na yɛatse na yɛkã kyerɛ hom so, na hom so nye hɛn eenya nkitahodzi; na hɛn nkitahodzi yɛnye Egya nye ne Ba Jesus Christ na yɛyɛ:
Na iyinom yɛkyerɛw brɛ hom, na hom dɛw aahyɛ mã.
Na amandzɛɛ a yɛatse wo ne nkyɛn, na yɛbɔ kyerɛ hom nye yi, dɛ Nyankopɔn yɛ kan na sum biara nnyi no mu.
Sɛ yɛkã dɛ yɛnye no wɔ nkitahodzi, na yɛnantsew sum mu a, yedzi ator, na yɛnnyi nokwar no:
Na sɛ yɛnantsew kan mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔno ɔwɔ kan mu no a, yenyinya nkitahodzi wɔ hɛn mu, na ne Ba Jesus Christ bɔgya no tsew hɛn ho fi bɔn nyina mu.
Sɛ yɛkã dɛ yennyi bɔn a, yɛdaadaa hɛnho, na nokwar no nnyi hɛn mu.
Sɛ yɛkã hɛn bɔn kyerɛ a, ɔyɛ nokwafo nye tseneneenyi dɛ ɔdze hɛn bɔn nyina bɛkyɛ hɛn, na ɔatsew hɛn ho wɔ dza ɔnntsen nyina ho.
Sɛ yɛkã dɛ yɛnnyɛɛ bɔn a, yɛyɛ no ɔtorfo, na n'asɛm nnyi hɛn mu.
2: Me mba nkakraba, mekyerɛw yinom mebrɛ hom na hom aannyɛ bɔn. Na sɛ obi yɛ bɔn a, yɛwɔ ɔkasagyefo wɔ Egya no nkyɛn, Jesus Christ ɔtseneneenyi no:
Na ɔno nye hɛn bɔn ho mpatadze, na nnyɛ hɛn nko hɛndze, na mbom wiadze nyina dze ho so bi.
Na sɛ yedzi n'ahyɛdze do a, iyiara na yɛdze hu dɛ yenyim no.
Nyia ɔkã dɛ, minyim no, na onndzi n'ahyɛdze do no, ɔyɛ ɔtor, na nokwar no nnyi no mu:
Na obiara a odzi n'asɛm do no, ɔno no mu ampaara na Nyankopɔn dɔ edzi mu. Iyi na yɛdze hu dɛ yɛwɔ no mu:
Nyia ɔkã dɛ ɔtse no mu no, ɔsɛ no dɛ ɔnantsew dɛ mbrɛ ɔno so nantsewee.
Adɔfo, nnyɛ ahyɛdze fofor na mekyerɛw mebrɛ hom, na mbom ahyɛdze dadaw no nye asɛm a ofi ahyɛse hom tsee no.
Bio, mekyerɛw ahyɛdze fofor mebrɛ hom a ɔyɛ nokwar wɔ ɔno nye hom mu; osiandɛ sum resen, na nokwar kan no enya rehyerɛn.
Nyia ɔkã dɛ ɔwɔ kan no mu, na ɔtan no nua, ɔwɔ sum mu dze besi sesei.
Nyia ɔdɔ no nua, ɔwɔ kan no mu, na fintsidua bi nnyi no mu.
Na nyia ɔtan no nua tse sum mu, na ɔnantsew sum mu, na onnyim mbrɛ ɔrokɔ, osiandɛ sum no efura n'enyi.
Mekyerɛw mebrɛ hom, me mba nkakraba, osiandɛ wɔdze hom bɔn akyɛ hom wɔ ne dzin ntsi.
Mekyerɛw mebrɛ hom, egyanom, dɛ hom ehu nyia ɔwɔ hɔ fi ahyɛse no. Mekyerɛw mebrɛ hom, mberantsɛ, dɛ hom edzi ɔbɔn no do konyim. Mekyerɛw mebrɛ hom, mbofra nkakraba, dɛ hom ehu Egya no.
Makyerɛw mabrɛ hom, egyanom, dɛ hom ehu nyia ɔwɔ hɔ fi ahyɛse no. Makyerɛw mabrɛ hom mberantsɛ dɛ hom yɛ dzen, na Nyankopɔn asɛm tse hom mu, na hom edzi ɔbɔn no do konyim.
Mma hom nndɔ wiadze, anaadɛ ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ wiadze. Na nyia ɔdɔ wiadze, Egya no ho dɔ nnyi no mu.
Na dza ɔwɔ wiadze nyina, honam akɔndɔ, enyiwa akɔndɔ, nye asetsena mu enyimnyampɛ, ommfir Egya no, na mbom ofir wiadze.
Na wiadze rutwa mu, nye n’akɔndɔ, na nyia ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn apɛdze no tsena hɔ daa.
Mbofra nkakraba, dɔn a odziekyir no nye yi: Na dɛ mbrɛ hom atse dɛ antichrist rebɛba, sesei mpo antichrist pii aba; nna yɛdze hu dɛ dɔn a odzi ekyir no nye yi.
Wofii hɛn mu kɔree, na wɔnnkã hɛn ho, na sɛ wɔkã hɛn ho a, nkyɛ wɔnye hɛn tsenaa hɔ: Na wofiir edzi ma aada edzi de wɔnnkã hɛn ho.
Na homdze, hom enya ngosera bi fir Krɔnkrɔnnyi no hɔ, na hom nyim adze nyina.
Mannkyerɛw mammbrɛ hom dɛ hom nnyim nokwar no, na mbom dɛ hom nyim, na dɛ ator biara mmfi nokwar no mu.
Woana na ɔyɛ ɔtorfo dɛ nyia ɔpow dɛ Jesus nye Christ no? Oyi nye antichrist no, nyia ɔpow Egya nye Ba no.
Obiara a ɔpow ɔba no, onnyi Egya no; na nyia ɔpaa mu bɔ ɔba ne dzin no ɔwɔ Egya no so.
Na homdze, hom mma dza ofi ahyɛse no hom tsee no ntsena hom mu. Na sɛ dza hom fi ahyɛse tsee no ntsena hom mu a, hom bɛtsena ɔba no nye Egya no mu.
Na anohoba a ɔabɔ hɛn nye onnyiewiei nkwa.
Iyiniom na makyerɛw mabrɛ hom wɔ hɔn a wɔpɛ dɛ wɔdze hom fom kwan no ho.

Na homdze, ngosera a hom nyae wɔ ne nsamu no tse hom mu, na onnhia hom dɛ obi kyerɛkyerɛ hom, na mbom dɛ mbrɛ no ngosera no ara kyerɛkyerɛ hom adze nyina ho, na ɔyɛ nokwar, na ɔnnyɛ ator, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔakyerɛkyerɛ hom no ara hom tsena mu.
Na afei, me mba nkakraba, hom ntsena no mu; na sɛ oyi noho edzi a, yaayɛ ndam, na hɛn enyi eennwu n’enyim wɔ ne ba mu.
Sɛ hom nyim dɛ ɔyɛ tseneneenyi a, hom nhu dɛ obiara a ɔyɛ tsenenee no, ɔno na ɔwo no.
3: Hom nhwɛ dɔ bi a Egya no dze akyɛ hɛn, dɛ wɔfrɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn mba: Na yɛyɛ so. Iyi ntsi wiadze nnyim hɛn, osiandɛ oennhu no.
Adɔfo, afei yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn mba, na mbrɛ yɛbɛyɛ no nnyae nndaa edzi, na yenyim dɛ, sɛ oyi noho edzi a, yɛbɛyɛ dɛ ɔno, osiandɛ yebohu no dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse.
Na obiara a ɔwɔ enyidado yi wɔ no mu no, ɔtsew noho, dɛ mbrɛ ono no ho tsew.
Obiara a ɔyɛ bɔn, ɔyɛ dze tõ mbra, na bɔn yɛ mbrato.
Na hom nyim dɛ wɔdaa no edzi na oeeyi bɔn akɔ; na ɔnodze, bɔn nnyi no mu.
Obiara a ɔtse no mu nnyɛ bɔn: Obiara a ɔyɛ bɔn, nna onnhun no; na eso onnyim no.
Mbofra nkakraba, mma obiara nndaadaa hom: Nyia ɔyɛ dza ɔtsen no ɔtsen, dɛ mbrɛ no so tsen no:
Nyia ɔyɛ bɔn fir abɔnsam, osiandɛ abɔnsam na ofi ahyɛse yɛɛ bɔn. Iyi ntsi wɔdaa Nyankopɔn Ba edzi ama ɔaasɛɛ abɔnsam ndwuma.
Obiara a Nyankopɔn awo no nnyɛ bɔn, osiandɛ n’aba tse no mu: Na onntum nnyɛ bɔn, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn awo no.
Iyi mu na Nyankopɔn mba nye abɔnsam mba da edzi: Obiara a ɔnnyɛ dza ɔtsen nye nyia ɔnndɔ no nua no mmfir Nyankopɔn.
Na iyi nye amandzɛɛ a hom fi ahyɛse no tsee no, dɛ yɛndodɔ hɛnho:
Nnyɛ dɛ Cain a ofir ɔbɔn no mu a okum no nua no. Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na okum no? Osiandɛ no ndwuma yɛ bɔn, na no nua dze tsen.
Mo nuanom, sɛ wiadze tan hom a, mma ɔnnyɛ hom nwanwa.
Hɛndze yenyim dɛ yeetwa mu fi wu mu akɔ nkwa mu, osiandɛ yɛdɔ enuanom no. Nyia ɔnndɔ no nua tse wu mu.
Obiara a ɔnndɔ no nua yɛ wudzifo: Na hom nyim dɛ onnyiewiei nkwa nntsena owudzifo biara mu.
Iyi mu na yɛdze hu dɔ, osiandɛ ɔno ɔdze no nkwa too hɔ maa hɛn, na ɔse hɛn so dɛ yɛdze hɛn nkwa to hɔ ma enuanom no.
Na nyia ɔwɔ wiadze adze, na ohu no nua dɛ ehia no, na ɔbɔ no ayamuɔwen no, Nyankopɔn dɔ no dua dɛn tse no mu?
Me mba nkakraba, mma yɛmmfa asɛm anaa tɛkyerɛma nndɔ, na mbom hom mma yɛndɔ wɔ nyɛe nye nokwar mu.
Na iyi mu na yɛdze bohu dɛ yefi nokwar no mu, na yɛdze besi hɛn akoma pi wɔ n’enyim,
aber biara a hɛn akoma bu hɛn fɔ no, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn sõ kyɛn hɛn akoma, na onyim adze nyina.
Adɔfo, sɛ hɛn akoma mmbu hɛn fɔ a, nna yɛwɔ ndam wɔ Nyankopɔn afamu;
na biribiara a yɛserɛ no, yenya wɔ no hɔ, osiandɛ yedzi n’ahyɛdze do, na yɛyɛ dza ɔyɛ enyisɔ wɔ n’enyim.
Na iyi nye n’ahyɛdze, dɛ yɛngye ne Ba Jesus Christ ndzi, na yɛndodɔ hɛnho, dɛ mbrɛ ɔmaa hɛn ahyɛdze no.
Na nyia odzi n’ahyɛdze do no, ɔtse no mu, na ɔno so tse no mu. Na dza yɛdze hu dɛ ɔtse hɛn mu nye Sunsum a ɔdze ama hɛn no.
4: Adɔfo, mma hom nngye esunsum nyina nndzi, na mbom hom nsɔ esunsum nhwɛ dɛ wofir Nyankopɔn anaa: Osiandɛ nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo pii efir aba wiadze.
Iyi mu na hom hu Nyankopɔn Sunsum: Sunsum biara a ɔpaa mu kã dɛ Jesus Christ aba wɔ honam mu no fir Nyankopɔn:
Na sunsum biara a ɔnnkã dɛ Jesus Christ aba wɔ honam mu no, mmfir Nyankopɔn mu: Na iyi nye antichrist a hom atse dɛ ɔreba wiadze a oenya aba wiadze no dze.
Me mba nkakraba, hom fir Nyankopɔn mu, na hom edzi bɔn do konyim: Osiandɛ nyia ɔwɔ hom mu no sõ kyɛn nyia ɔwɔ wiadze.
Hɔndze, wofi wiadze mu, na wofi wiadze mu kasa, na wiadze tsie hɔn.
Hɛndze, yefi Nyankopɔn mu: Nyia onyim Nyankopɔn no tsie hɛn; nyia ommfi Nyankopɔn mu no nntsie hɛn. Iyi mu na yɛdze hu nokwar sunsum, nye ndaadaa sunsum.
Adɔfo, hom mma yɛndodɔ hɛnho; na dɔ fir Nyankopɔn, na obiara a ɔdɔ no, Nyankopɔn awo no na onyim Nyankopɔn.
Nyia ɔnndɔ no, onnyim Nyankopɔn, na Nyankopɔn nye dɔ.
Iyi mu na Nyankopɔn dɔ yii noho edzi wɔ hɛn ho, dɛ Nyankopon somaa ne Ba a ɔwoo no kor baa wiadze, dɛ yendua no do nnya nkwa.
Iyi no mu na ɔdɔ wɔ, nnyɛ dɛ hɛn na yɛdɔɔ Nyankopɔn, na ɔno na ɔdɔɔ hɛn, na ɔsomaa ne ba dɛ ɔmbɛyɛ mpatadze wɔ hɛn bɔn ho.
Adɔfo, sɛ Nyankopɔn dɔɔ hɛn dɛm a, ɔsɛ hɛn so dɛ yɛdodɔ hɛnho.
Obiara nnhun Nyankopɔn pɛn; sɛ yɛdodɔ hɛnho a, Nyankopɔn tse hɛn mu, na no dɔ edzi mu wɔ hɛn mu;
iyi mu na yehu dɛ yɛtse no mu, na ɔno so tse hɛn mu, osiandɛ ɔama hɛn no Sunsum no bi.
Na yeehu na yedzi dase dɛ Egya no asoma ɔba no dɛ wiadze Agyenkwa.
Obiara a ɔpaa mu kã dɛ Jesus nye Nyankopɔn Ba no, Nyankopɔn tse no mu na ɔno so tse Nyankopɔn mu.
Na yenyim, na yɛagye dɔ a Nyankopɔn wɔ no wɔ hɛn ho no edzi. Nyankopɔn nye dɔ; na nyia ɔtse dɔ mu no, ɔtse Nyankopɔn mu, na Nyankopɔn tse no mu.
Iyi no mu na ɔdɔ edzi mu wɔ hɛn mu, na yaayɛ ndam wɔ atsɛmbu da no mu; osiandɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔno tse no, mbrɛ hɛn so yɛtse wɔ wiadze ha nye no.
Hu nnyi dɔ mu; na mbom dɔ a odzi mu pam hu, osiandɛ hu wo ɔhaw; na nyia osuro no nnwie mu dzi wɔ dɔ mu.
Yɛdɔ, osiandɛ ɔno na odzi kan dɔɔ hɛn.
Sɛ obi kã dɛ, modɔ Nyankopɔn, na ɔtan no nua a, ɔyɛ ɔtorfo, na nyia ɔnndɔ no nua a ohu no no bɛyɛ dɛn adɔ Nyankopɔn a onnhu no?
Na ahyɛdze yi na yeenya no wɔ no hɔ, dɛ nyia ɔdɔ Nyankopɔn ɔndɔ no nua so.
5: Obiara a ɔgye dzi dɛ Jesus nye Christ no, Nyankopɔn awo no: Na obiara a ɔdɔ nyia ɔwoe no, ɔdɔ nyia ɔwoo no no so.
Iyi na yɛdze hu dɛ yɛdɔ Nyankopɔn mba, dɛ yɛdɔ Nyankopɔn na yɛyɛ n’ahyɛdze.
Na Nyankopɔn dɔ nye yi, dɛ yebedzi n’ahyɛdze do: Na n’ahyɛdze no nnyɛ dzen.
Osiandɛ biribiara a Nyankopɔn awo no odzi wiadze do konyim: Na iyi nye konyim a oedzi wiadze do nyim no, mekyerɛ hɛn gyedzi.
Na woana na odzi wiadze do konyim, dɛ nyia ogye dzi dɛ Jesus yɛ Nyankopon Ba?
Oyi nye nyia ɔnam nsu nye bɔgya do bae, mekyerɛ Jesus Christ; nnyɛ nsu nko, na mbom nsu nye bɔgya do.
Na Sunsum no na odzi dase, osiandɛ Sunsum no nye nokwar no.
Na baasa na wodzi dase, Sunsum no, nye nsu no, nye bɔgya no: Na baasa yi bɔ mu yɛ kor.
Sɛ yɛgye nyimpa ne dasee a, Nyankopɔn dasee sõ kyɛn no: Na Nyankopɔn dasee nye dase a oedzi wɔ ne Ba ho.
Nyia ɔgye Nyankopɔn Ba dzi no wɔ dase wɔ nankasa no mu; nyia ɔnngye Nyankopɔn nndzi no ɔayɛ no ɔtorfo; osiandɛ ɔanngye dase a Nyankopɔn edzi wɔ ne Ba ho enndzi.
Na iyi nye dase no, dɛ Nyankopɔn maa hɛn onnyiewiei nkwa, na nkwa yi wɔ ne Ba mu.
Nyia ɔwɔ ɔba no ɔwɔ nkwa no, nyia onnyi Nyankopɔn Ba no nnyi nkwa no.
Makyerɛw iyinom mabrɛ hom, na hom eehu dɛ hom wɔ onnyiewiei nkwa, hom a hom agye Nyankopɔn Ba ne dzin edzi.
Na ndam a yɛdze kɔ ne nkyɛn nye dɛ, sɛ yɛserɛ biribiara dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ a, otsie hɛn:
Na sɛ yenyim dɛ otsie hɛn wɔ dza yɛserɛ no ho a, yenyim dɛ yenya ndzɛmba no wɔ no hɔ no.
Sɛ obi hu no nua dɛ ɔyɛ bɔn a ɔnnkɔ owu mu a, ɔmbɛserɛ, na Nyankopɔn bɛma no nkwa ama hɔn a wɔyɛ bɔn a ɔnnkɔ wu mu no. Bɔn wɔ hɔ a ɔkɔ wu mu: Nnyɛ ɔno ho na mese dɛ ombisa.
Dza ɔnntsen nyina yɛ bɔn: Na bɔn wɔ hɔ a ɔnnkɔ wu mu.
Yenyim dɛ obiara a Nyankopɔn awo no ɔnnyɛ bɔn; na mbom nyia Nyankopɔn awo no no hwɛ noho do, na ɔbɔn no nnkã no.
Yenyim dɛ hɛndze yefir Nyankopɔn, na wiadze nyina da ɔbɔn no mu.
Na yenyim dɛ Nyankopɔn Ba aba, na ɔama hɛn ntseasee a yɛdze hu nyia ɔyɛ nokwafo no, na yɛwɔ nokwafo no mu, ne Ba Jesus Christ no. Oyi nye nokwar Nyankopɔn, nye onnyiewiei nkwa.
Me mba nkakraba, hom nsie homho mfi abosom ho.

1: Afei ɔhen David ayɛ akɔdaa na oedzi mfe pii; na wɔdze atam kataa no do, naaso no ho annyɛ no hyew.
Dɛm ntsi no nkowaa see no dɛ, wɔnhwehwɛ ababaawa ɔbaabun bi mbrɛ mo wura ɔhen: Na ombegyina ɔhen enyim, na onyiayia no; na ɔnda wo bo mu, ma mo wura ɔhen nnya ɔhyew.
Nna wɔkɔhwehwɛɛ akataasia fɛɛfɛw bi wɔ Israel asaase nyinara mu, na wokohun Abishag, Shunamnyi no, na wɔdze no brɛɛ ɔhen no.
Na akataasia no no ho yɛ fɛw dodow; na oyiayiaa ɔhen no, na ɔsoom no; na ɔhen no ennhu no.
Nna Haggith ba Adonijah memaa noho do, dɛ, mara na mibedzi hen: Na ɔhyehyɛɛ ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo, na mbarimba eduonum a wɔyɛ n'abrampɔfo.
Na n’egya annkã n’enyim aber biara annse dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ayɛ dɛm yi? Na ɔno so ɔyɛ nyimpa fɛɛfɛw; na wɔwoo Absalom ekyir no, na wɔwoo no.
Na ɔnye Zeruiah ba Joab, na ɔnye ɔsɔfo Abiathar na wotuu egyina: Na wodzii Adonijah ekyir boaa no.
Na ɔsɔfo Zadok, na Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Nathan, na Shimei, na Rei, na David ne mbarimba akatakyi no dze, wɔnnkã Adonijah ho.
Na Adonijah kunkum nguan na anantwi na mbowa a wɔadodɔ seradze wɔ Zoheleth ɔbo a ɔwɔ En-rogel nkyɛn no ho; na ohyiahyiaa no nuanom ɔhen ne mba no nyinara, na ɔhen no nkowaa Judah mbarimba no nyinara:
Na nkɔnhyɛnyi Nathan, na Benaiah, na mbarimba akatakyi no, na no nua Solomon dze, oennhyia hɔn.
Nna Nathan kãa kyerɛɛ Solomon ne nã Bath-sheba, dɛ, ana ɔwo enntsee dɛ Haggith ne ba Adonijah ridzi hen, na hɛn wura David nnyim bi a?
Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, bra, ma memma wo apam, ma edze agye wankasa woho nkwa, na wo ba Solomon no nkwa.

Kɔ na kɛhɛn ɔhen David nkyɛn, na se no dɛ, ana nnyɛ woara, mo wura ɔhen, na ekãa ntam kyerɛɛ w'afonabaa dɛ, ampaara wo ba Solomon ara na obedzi hen wɔ m’ekyir, na ɔnoara na ɔbɛtsena m’ahengua do no bi a? ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na Adonijah ridzi hen yi?
Hwɛ, aber a ɔwo nye ɔhen da do rekasa wɔ hɔ no, mo so mibedzi w’ekyir maba, na mabɛhyɛ wo nsɛm mã.
Na Bath-sheba kɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ pia mu; na ɔhen no ayɛ akɔdaa dodow; na Abishag, Shunamnyi no soom ɔhen no.
Na Bath- sheba bɔɔ no mu adze, na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen no enyidzi. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, erohwehwɛ ebɛnadze?
Na ɔsee no dɛ, mo wura, ɔwoara dze Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn kãa ntam kyerɛɛ w’afonabaa dɛ, ampaara wo ba Solomon ara na obedzi hen wɔ w’ekyir, na ɔnoara na ɔbɛtsena m’ahengua do.
Na afei, hwɛ, Adonijah ridzi hen; na ɔwo, mo wura ɔhen, nnyim yi:
Na oekuku anantwi na mbowa a wɔadɔ seradze na nguan piigyan, na oehyiahyia ɔhen ne mbabanyin no nyinara, na ɔsɔfo Abiathar, na dɔm safohen panyin Joab: Na w’akowaa Solomon dze oennhyia no.
Na ɔwo, mo wura ɔhen, na Israel nyinara enyi da wo do dɛ ebɛkyerɛ hɔn nyia ɔbɛtsena mo wura ɔhen n’ahengua do wɔ n’ekyir.
Ɔno ɔbɛba dɛ, aber a mo wura ɔhen nye n'egyanom bɛkɛda no, wobobu na me ba Solomon ndzebɔnyɛfo,
Na, hwɛ, mber a ɔda do ɔnye ɔhen no rekasa no, nkɔnhyɛnyi Nathan bae.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no dɛ, hwɛ, nkɔnhyɛnyi Nathan nye yi. Na aber a odur ɔhen n’enyim no ɔbɔɔ no mu adze dze n’enyim boom famu wɔ ɔhen n’enyim.
Nathan see dɛ, mo wura ɔhen, ana ase dɛ, Adonijah na ondzi hɛn wɔ m’ekyir, na ɔno na ɔntsena m’ahengua do a?

Na oesian kɔ ndɛ da yi, na oekuku anantwi na mbowa a wɔadodɔ seradze na nguan piigyan, na oehyiahyia ɔhen ne mbabanyin no, na dɔm asafohemfo mpanyin no, na ɔsɔfo Abiathar; na, hwɛ, woridzidzi na wɔronom wɔ n’enyim, na wɔse dɛ, Nyame ngye ɔhen Adonijah nkwa.
Na emi, mara w’akowaa mpo, na ɔsɔfo Zadok, na Jehoiada ba Benaiah, na w’akowaa Solomon dze, oennhyia hɛn.
Ana adze yi mo wura ɔhen na ɔyɛe, na annda no edzi annkyerɛ wo nkowaa nyia ɔbɛtsena mo wura ɔhen n’ahengua do wɔ n’ekyir a?
Nna ɔhen David buae na ɔsee dɛ, wɔmfrɛ Bath-sheba mma me. Na ɔbaa ɔhen no n’enyim, na obegyinaa ɔhen no enyim.
Na ɔhen kãa ntam ɔsee dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze a oyii me kra fii ahohiahia nyinara mu tse ase yi,

ampaara dɛ mbrɛ medze Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, mekãa ntam mekyerɛɛ wo, dɛ, ampa wo ba Solomon ara na obedzi hen wɔ m’ekyir, na ɔnoara na ɔbetsena m’ahengua do wɔ m’ananmu; ampa, dɛmara na mebɛyɛ no ndɛ da yi.
Nna Bath-sheba bɔɔ no mu adze dze n’enyim boom famu, na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen no enyidzi na ɔsee dɛ, wɔmma mo wura ɔhen David ntsena ase daa.
Na ɔhen David see dɛ, wɔmfrɛ ɔsɔfo Zadok, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Nathan, na Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah mma me. Na wɔbaa ɔhen no enyim.
Na ɔhen no see hɔn dɛ, hom mfa hom wura no nkowaa no nkã homho, na wɔmma me ba Solomon ntsena mankasa m’asoasopɔnkɔ do, na wɔmfa no nkɔ Gihon:
Na wɔmma ɔsɔfo Zadok na nkɔnhyɛnyi Nathan nsera no wɔ hɔ nhyɛ no hen wɔ Israel do: Na hom mbɔ abɛn no mu nse dɛ, Nyame ngye ɔhen Solomon nkwa.
Na nkyii hom ndzi n’ekyir mfow mbra, na ɔmbra mbɛtsena m’ahengua do; na ɔno na ondzi hen wɔ m’ananmu: Na mahyɛ no dɛ ɔnyɛ ɔpanyin wɔ Israel na Judah do.
Na Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah buaa ɔhen no na ɔsee dɛ Amen: Ewuradze, mo wura ɔhen ne Nyankopɔn no so nse dɛmara.
Dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze nye mo wura ɔhen tsenae no, mekyerɛ dɛmara so na ɔnye Solomon ntsena, na ɔmma n’ahengua nye kɛse nsen mo wura ɔhen David n'ahengua.
Nna ɔsɔfo Zadok, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Nathan, na Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah, na Cherethfo na Pelethfo no, sianee kɔree, na wɔmaa Solomon tsenaa ɔhen David n’asoasopɔnkɔ do, na wɔdze no baa Gihon.
Na ɔsɔfo Zadok faa ngo ambɛn no wɔ Buw no mu, na ɔdze bɛseraa Solomon. Na wɔhɛɛn abɛn no; na ɔman no nyinara see dɛ, Nyame ngye ɔhen Solomon nkwa.
Na ɔman no nyinara dzii n’ekyir fowee bae, na ɔman no hɛɛn ntɛntɛbɛn, na hɔn enyi gyee enyigye kɛse, ma hɔn dede no maa asaase wosowee.
Na Adonijah na edzidzifo no a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no nyinara tsee wɔ aber a wowiee edzidzi no. Na aber a Joab tsee abɛn no ndze no, ɔsee dɛ, kurow no mu dede yi a ayɛ dɛ abɔ ebutuw yi ase nye dɛn?
Mber a ɔda do rekasa no, hwɛ, ɔsɔfo Abiathar ne ba Jonathan bae: Na Adonijah see dɛ, bra dan mu; na ɔwo yɛ nyimpa a efata, na edze nsɛm pa nam.
Na Jonathan buae see Adonijah dɛ, nokwar hɛn wura ɔhen David ahyɛ Solomon hen:
