Na ɔhen dze ɔsɔfo Zadok, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Nathan, na Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah, na Cherethfo na Pelethfo no akã noho egya no kwan, na wɔama ɔatsena ɔhen n’asoasopɔnkɔ no do:
Nna ɔsɔfo Zadok na nkɔnhyɛnyi Nathan asera no ahyɛ no hen wɔ Gihon: Na wɔdze enyigye dze fi hɔ afow aba, ma kurow no wosoow bio. Iyi nye dede no a hom atse no.
Na eso Solomon ɔtse ahendzi ahengua no do.

Na nkyii so ɔhen no nkowaa no baa behyiraa hɛn wura ɔhen David, dɛ: Wo Nyankopɔn mma Solomon ne dzin nyɛ yie nsen wo dzin, na ɔmma n'ahengua nyɛ kɛse nsen w'ahengua: Na ɔhen bɔɔ no mu adze wɔ mpa no do.
Na eso mbrɛ ɔhen no see nye yi, nhyira nkã Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no a ɔama obi atsena m’ahengua do ndɛ da yi, ma m’enyiwa ara ehu.
Na Adonijah n’edzidzifo no nyinara suroi, na wɔsoɛrsoɛree na nyimpa biara faa no kwan kɔree.
Na Adonijah suroi wɔ Solomon ntsi; na ɔsoɛree kosuoo afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn mu.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Solomon, dɛ, hwɛ, Adonijah osuro ɔhen Solomon: Na, hwɛ, oekosuo afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn mu, dɛ, wɔmma ɔhen Solomon ndzi kan nkã ntamnky erɛ me ndɛ da yi dɛ ɔnnkɛfa afõwa eku n’akowaa.
Na Solomon see dɛ, sɛ ɔnoara kyerɛ noho dɛ nyimpa a ɔfata a, no nhwi bi ronntɔ famu: Na sɛ wohu emumuyɛ wɔ no mu dze a, obowu.
Nna ɔhen Solomon somae ma wɔkɛfaa no fii afɔrmbukyia no ho sianee bae. Na ɔbae na ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔhen Solomon enyidzi: Na Solomon see no dɛ, Kɔ wo fie.
2: Afei David ne nda bɛɛn dɛ obowu; na ɔhyɛɛ ne ba Solomon, dɛ,
Morokɔ asaase do nkorɔfo nyinara kwan no: Dɛm ntsi hyɛ dzen, na yɛ woho ɔbarimba;

na sie Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn n’ahwɛdodze no, dɛ ebɛnantsew n’akwan mu, dɛ ibesie n’ahyɛdze, na ne mbransɛm, na n’atsɛmbu, na ne dasesɛm, dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses mbra no mu tse no, ama aayɛ prɔmprɔm wɔ dza eyɛ nyinara mu, na beebiara so a edan woho fa:

Ma Ewuradze aama n’asɛm a ɔkãe no wɔ mo ho no etsim, dɛ, sɛ wo mba hwɛ hɔn kwan yie, dɛ wɔdze hɔn akoma nyinara na hɔn kra nyinara bɛnantsew m’enyim nokwar mu a, ɔnodze (ɔse dɛ) Israel ahengua do nyimpa rommbɔ wo.

Nkyii so ɔwoara nyim dza eso Zeruiah ba Joab dze yɛɛ me, mekyerɛ dza ɔdze yɛɛ Israel dɔm mu asafohemfo beenu no, Ner ne ba Abner, na Jether ne ba Amasa a okunkum hɔn na ɔkãa ɔsa mu bɔgya gui wɔ asomdwee ber mu, na ɔdze ɔsa mu bɔgya kekaa n’abɔdo a ɔbɔ n’asen ho, na ne mpaboa a ɔhyɛ n’anan ho no mu.
Dɛm ntsi yɛ no dɛ mbrɛ wo nyansaa tse, na ma mma ne tsigon nnsian nnkɔ adakamaa mu asomdwee mu.
Mbom Gileadnyi Barzillai ne mba no na kyerɛ ayamuyie wɔ hɔn do, na ma wɔmfora hɔn a wodzidzi wo pon do no mu. Na dɛm na wɔbaa me nkyɛn aber a mifii wo nua Absalom enyim muguanee no.

Na, hwɛ, Benjamnnyi Shimei, Gera ne ba no a ofi Bahurim no a ɔdze ndom yerɛyerɛw doom me da no a mokɔr Mahanaim no wɔ wo nkyɛn: Na ɔnodze osianee behyiaa me kwan wɔ Jordan do, na medze Ewuradze kãa ntam kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, emi mara meremmfa afõwa munnku wo.
Dɛm ntsi afei mma ɔmmfa noho tɔtrɔtɔ, na ɔwoara yɛ onyansafo; na ibohu dza ɔsɛ dɛ edze bɛyɛ no, na ama ne tsigon dze bɔgya eesian akɔ adakamaa mu.
Na David nye n’egyanom dae, na wosiee no wɔ David kurow no mu.
Na nda a David dze dzii Israel do hen yɛ mfe eduanan: Odzii hen mfe esuon wɔ Hebron, na odzii hen mfe eduasa ebiasa wɔ Jerusalem.
Na Solomon tsenaa n’egya David ahengua do; na n'ahendzi tsiim dzendzenndzen.
Nna Haggith ne ba Adonijah baa Solomon ne nã Bathsheba nkyɛn. Na ɔsee dɛ, eba no asomdwee mu anaa? Na ɔsee dɛ, Asomdwee mu a.
Nkyii so ɔsee dɛ, mowɔ asɛm bi mekã mekyerɛ wo. Na ɔsee dɛ, kã ɛ.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ɔwoara inyim dɛ ahendzi no yɛ medze, na Israel nyinara dze hɔn enyi sii mo do dɛ mara na mibedzi hen: Naaso ahendzi no adan, na ɔakɛyɛ mo nua dze: Na Ewuradze na ɔama ɔayɛ nedze.
Na afei ebisadze kor pɛ na miribisa no wo hɔ, mma nnkam me. Na ɔsee no dɛ, kã ɛ.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Meserɛ wo, kã kyerɛ ɔhen Solomon, (na ɔrennse wo dɛ oho), ma ɔmfa Shunamnyi Abishag mma me ayewar.
Na Beth-sheba see dɛ, oye; mebɛkã makyerɛ ɔhen mama wo.

Dɛm ntsi Bath-sheba sii mu kɔr ɔhen Solomon nkyɛn, dɛ ɔrekɛkasa akyerɛ no ama Adonijah. Na ɔhen no soɛree kehyiaa no, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze maa no, na ɔkɛtsenaa n’ahengua do, na ɔmaa wɔdze ahengua besii hɔ maa ɔhen ne nã; na ɔtsenae wɔ n’enyimfa.
Nna ɔsee dɛ, ebisadze ketseabaa bi na miribebisa wɔ wo hɔ; mma nnkam me. Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, me nã, bisa ɛ: Na merennkam wo.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ma wɔmfa Shunamnyi Abishag mma wo nua Adonijah ayewar.

Na ɔhen Solomon buae na ɔsee ne nã dɛ, na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na iribisa Shunamnyi Abishag ama Adonijah? Bisa ahendzi no so ma no ɛ; na ɔno nye mo nua panyin; bisa ma ɔno, na ɔsɔfo Abiathar, na Zeruiah ba Joab.
Nna ɔhen Solomon dze Ewuradze kãa ntam, dɛ, Nyankopɔn nyɛ me dɛm, na bi so nkã ho, sɛ Adonijah nnkãa asɛm yi nntsiaa nankasa no nkwa a.
Dɛm ntsi afei dɛ Ewuradze a oetsintsim me, na ɔdze me atsena m’egya David n’ahengua do, na ɔakyekyer ofi ama me dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ anohoba no, tse ase yi, ampa woboku Adonijah ndɛ da yi.
Na ɔhen Solomon nam Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah ne nsa do somae; na okotui hyɛɛ no do, ma owui.

Na ɔhen no see ɔsɔfo Abiathar dɛ, kɔ wankasa wo haban mu, wɔ Anathoth; na efata owu ndɛ da yi dze, na murunnku wo, osiandɛ ɔwo esoaa Ewuradze Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no wɔ m’egya David enyim, na osiandɛ ihun amandze wɔ dza m’egya hun mu amandze no nyinara mu.
Nna Solomon taam Abiathar dɛ ɔnnyɛ ɔsɔfo mma Ewuradze; ama ɔaahyɛ Ewuradze n’asɛm a ɔkãe no wɔ Eli fi ho wɔ Shiloh no mã.
Na amandzɛɛ no dur Joab nkyɛn: Na kaansa Joab ɔanndan ennkedzi Absalom ekyir mpo a, ɔadan ekedzi Adonijah ekyir. Na Joab guanee kɔr Ewuradze no Buw no mu, na okosuoo afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn mu.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ ɔhen Solomon dɛ, Joab eguan kɔ Ewuradze no Buw no mu, na, hwɛ, ɔwɔ afɔrmbukyia no ho. Nna Solomon somaa Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah dɛ, Kɔ, kotu hyɛ no do.

Na Benaiah kɔr Ewuradze no buw no mu, na ɔkɛsee no dɛ, mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, Pue bra. Na ɔsee dɛ, Dabida; mubowu ha ara. Na Benaiah dze asɛm brɛɛ ɔhen bio, dɛ, mbrɛ Joab se nye yi, na mbrɛ oebua me nye yi.
Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, yɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔase no ara, na tu hyɛ no do, na sie no; ama eeyi bɔgya a Joab kãe guu gyan no efi emi na m’egya ofi do.

Na Ewuradze mma no bɔgyaa nsan ngu nankasa n’etsifi, osiandɛ otui hyɛɛ mbarimba beenu a wɔtsen na woye sen no no do, na ɔdze afõwa kunkum hɔn, na m’egya David nnyim ho hwee, hɔn nye, Ner ne ba Abner, Israel dɔm mu ɔsafohen, na Jether ne ba Amasa, Judah dɔm mu ɔsafohen no.
Nna hɔn bɔgyaa bɛsan ebogu Joab n’etsifi, na n’asefo etsim daa: Na David, na n’asefo na ne fi, na n'ahengua dze, nnya Ewuradze hɔ asomdwee daa.
Nna Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah sii mu kɔree, na okotui hyɛɛ no do, na okum no, na wokesiee no wɔ nankasa ne fie wɔ sar no do.
Na ɔhen no dze Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah hyɛɛ n'ananmu wɔ dɔm no do: Na ɔhen no dze ɔsɔfo Zadok hyɛɛ Abiathar n'ananmu.
Na ɔhen somaa ma wokehyiaa Shimei, na ɔsee no dɛ, si dan ma woho wɔ Jerusalem na tsena hɔ, na mma mmfi hɔ mmpue nnkɔ beebiara.
Na da no ara a ibopue, na ekotwa ɔwora Kidron no, ɔno hu no ampaara dɛ, owu ara na ibowu: Wo bɔgyaa bogu wankasa w etsifi.
Na Shimei see ɔhen no dɛ, Asɛm no ye: Dɛ mbrɛ mo wura ɔhen ase no, dɛmara so na w’akowaa bɛyɛ. Na Shimei tsenaa Jerusalem nda pii.
Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe ebiasa ekyir no, Shimei no nkowaa mu beenu guanee kɔr Maacah ne ba Achish, Gath hen no nkyɛn. Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Shimei, dɛ, hwɛ, wo nkowaa no wɔ Gath.
Na Shimei soɛree, na ɔhyehyɛɛ n’asoaso, na osii mu kɔr Gath, Achish nkyɛn, dɛ ɔrokɔhwehwɛ no nkowaa no: Na Shimei sii mu kɔree, na ɔkɛfaa no nkowaa no wɔ Gath bae.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Solomon dɛ, Shimei efi Jerusalem akɔ Gath, na ɔaba bio.

Na ɔhen no somaa ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ Shimei, na ɔsee no dɛ, ana mamma ammfa Ewuradze annkã ntam, na menndzi wo dase, dɛ, da no ara a ibopue akɛnantsenantsew beebiara no, ɔno hu no ampaara dɛ, owu ma na ibowu? Na ɔwoara see me dɛ, Asɛm a matse no oye.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na enndzi Ewuradze ne ntam, na mbrasɛm a medze mehyɛɛ wo no do?
Nkyii so ɔhen no see Shimei dɛ, ɔwoara nyim emumuyɛ nyinara a w’akoma nyim a edze yɛɛ m’egya David no: Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze bɛdan w’emumuyɛ no egu wankasa w'etsifi.
Na ɔhen Solomon dze, nhyira bɛkã no, na David n’ahengua no betsim wɔ Ewuradze enyim daa.
Nna ɔhen no hyɛɛ Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah; na ofiir edzi kotui hyɛɛ no do, ma owui. Na ahendzi no tsimii wɔ Solomon ne nsamu.
3: Na Solomon nye Egypthen Pharaoh yɛɛ asew, na ɔfaa Pharaoh ne babaa waar no, na dze no baa David kurow mu, dze kodur dɛ owiee nankasa ne dan, na Ewuradze ne dan, na Jerusalem ho fasu no nyina tow ana.
Naaso mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do ara nko na ɔman no bɔɔ afɔr, osiandɛ wonnsii dan mma Ewuradze ne dzin dze bodur nda no mu.
Na Solomon dɔɔ Ewuradze, ɔnantseew n’egya David n'ahyɛdze no mu: Na mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do ara nko na ɔbɔɔ afɔr na ɔhyeew eduhuam.
Na ɔhen no sii mu kɔr Gibeon dɛ ɔrokɔbɔ afɔr wɔ hɔ; osiandɛ ɔno na ɔyɛ bea sorɔnsorɔm kɛse: Ɔhyew-afɔr apem na Solomon bɔɔ no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.
Gibeon na Ewuradze daa noho edzi kyerɛɛ Solomon wɔ adaaso mu anago: Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, bisa dza memfa memma wo.

Na Solomon see dɛ, ɔwo na akyerɛ w’akowaa m’egya David do ayamuyie kɛse, dɛ mbrɛ ɔnantseew w’enyim nokwar mu, na ndzeyɛtsenenee mu na wo ho akoma mu tsenenee mu; na ɔwo edze ayamuyie kɛse yi esie ama no, dɛ ɔwo ama no ɔba dɛ ɔntsena n’ahengua do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
Na afei, Ewuradze, me Nyankopɔn, ɔwo na ahyɛ w’akowaa ɔhen ahyɛ m’egya David n’ananmu: Na emidze, meyɛ abofra kakraba; minnyim mbrɛ wodua fir edzi anaa wɔba mu.
Na w’akowaa wɔ wo man a ɔwoara asan mu eyi hɔn no mu, ɔman kɛse a hɔn dodow ntsi wonntum hɔn kan na wommbu ano so.
Dɛm ntsi ma w’akowaa ntseasee akoma ma memfa mumbu wo man atsɛn, na munhu papa na bɔn mu; na woana na obotum ebu wo man kɛse yi atsɛn?
Na kasa no yɛɛ Ewuradze fɛw, dɛ Solomon ebisa adze yi.

Na Nyankopɔn see no dɛ, osiandɛ ebisa adze yi, na emmbisa nkwa tsentsen amma woho; nkyii so emmbisa ahonya amma woho, na èmmbisa w’atamfo hɔn nkwa so; na mbom ebisa ntseasee a wɔdze hu atsɛmbu mu ama woho yi;
hwɛ, mayɛ no dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse no ara: Hwɛ, mama wo nyansa na ntseasee akoma; ma obiara a odzi w’enyim nntse dɛ ɔwo, nkyii so w’ekyir obiara ronnsoɛr a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo.
Na eso medze dza ɔwoara emmbisa no mama wo, ahonya na enyidzi nyina, ma ahemfo mu obiara rennye wo nnsɛ wɔ wo nda nyinara mu.
Na sɛ enantsew m’akwan mu, dɛ idzi m’ahyɛdze na me mbransɛm do, dɛ mbrɛ w'egya David nantwewee no a, ɔno mebɛma wo nda awar.
Na Solomon nyanee, na, hwɛ, adaaso a: Na ɔbaa Jerusalem, na obegyinaa Ewuradze n'ahyɛmudaka no enyim, na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyɛw-afɔr, na ɔbɔɔ asomdwee afɔr, na ɔtoo no nkowaa nyinara pon.
Nna mbaa beenu a wɔyɛ ehuhufo, wɔbaa ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ hɔ, na wobegyinaa n’enyim.
Na ɔbaa baako no see dɛ, ao mo wura, emi na ɔbaa yi yɛtse ofi kor mu; na mowoo ɔba wɔ ne nkyɛn wɔ ofi no mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, mowoe n’ekyir da a otsia ebiasa no, nna ɔbaa yi so woe; na yɛwɔ fakor; ɔhɔho bi nnkã hɛn ho wɔ ofi no mu, gyedɛ hɛn beenu ara na yɛwɔ ofi no mu.
Na ɔbaa yi ne ba wuu anago no; osiandɛ ɔdaa no do.
Na ɔsoɛɛr esuom, na ɔbɛfaa me ba wɔ me nkyɛn, mber a w’afonabaa ada, na ɔdze no too no bo mu, na ɔdze ne ba a oewu no too mo bo mu.
Na aber a mosoɛɛr anapa no dɛ merema me ba enumfo no, hwɛ, nna oewu: Na megyeen no anapa no, hwɛ, nna nnyɛ me ba a mowoo no no bi a.
Na ɔbaa kor no so see dɛ, dabida; na me ba nye onyikamfo no, na wo ba nye owufo no. Na oyi se dɛ, oho; na wo ba nye owufo no, na me ba nye onyikamtono. Na mbrɛ wɔkasae wɔ ohen enyim nye yi.
Nna ɔhen no see dɛ, oyi se dɛ, Me ba na ɔtse ase yi, na wo ba nye owufo no: Na oyi so se dɛ, dabida; mbom wo ba nye owufo no, na me ba nye onyikamfo no.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, wɔmbrɛ me afõwa. Na wɔdze afõwa baa ɔhen no enyim.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, wɔnkyɛ ɔba onyikamfo no mu ebien, wɔmfa ɔfã mma ɔbaako, na wɔmfa ɔfã mma ɔbaako so.

Nna ɔbaa a ɔba onyikamfo no yɛ nedze no kasaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no, osiandɛ no nson burbuur no wɔ ne ba no ho, na ɔsee dɛ, ao, mo wura, wɔmfa ɔba onyikamfo no mma no, na mma wonnku no ara da. Na ɔbaako no dze ɔsee dɛ, mma ɔnnyɛ medze eso ɔnnyɛ wodze; wɔnkyɛ mu.
Nna ɔhen no buae see dɛ, wɔmfa ɔba nyikamfo no mma ɔno, na mma wonnku no ara da: Ɔno nye ne nã.
Na Israel nyinara tsee atsɛmbu a ɔhen no bui no; na wosuroo ɔhen no; osiandɛ wohun dɛ Nyankopɔn ne nyansaa wɔ no mu, dɛ obobu atsɛn.
4: Na ɔhen Solomon dzii Israel, nyinara do hen.
Na woyinom nye asafohemfo a onyae; Zadok ne ba Azariah nye ɔsɔfo;
Elihoreph na Ahijah, Shisha ne mba no, nye akyerɛwfo; Jehoshaphat, Ahilud ne ba no, nye ɔsɛnkaafo;
na Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah na ɔhwe dɔm no do; na Zadok na Abiathar nye asɔfo;
na Nathan ne ba Azariah na ɔhwe ahwɛdofo no do; na Nathan ne ba Zabud na ɔyɛ ɔsɔfo, na ɔhen ne nyɛnko a;
na Ahishar na ɔhwɛ fidua no do; na Abda ne ba Adoniram na ɔhwɛ ɔtowyi edwuma no do.
Na Solomon wɔ ahwɛdofo duebien wɔ Israel nyinara do a wɔdze edziban ma ɔhen na ne fidua: Nyimpa baako wɔ dɛ ɔma edziban bosoom kor wɔ afrenhyia mu.
Na hɔn edzin nye yi: Ben-hur wɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu:
Ben-deker, wɔ Makaz, na Shaalbim, na Beth-shemesh, na Elonbeth-hanan:
Ben-hesed, wɔ Aruboth; ɔno na Socoh, na Hepher asaase nyinara dzi wɔ no:
Ben-abinadab, wɔ Dor akoko do nyinara; onyaa Solomon ne babaa Taphath waar no;
Ahilud ne ba Baana, wɔ Taanach na Megiddo, na Beth-shean nyinara a ɔwɔ Zarethan ne nkyɛn, wo Jezreel ase, ifi Beth-shean kodu Abel- meholah, dze kodu Jokmean egya.

Ben-geber, wɔ Ramoth-gilead; ɔno na Manasseh ne ba Jair no nkurow a ɔwɔ Gilead no, dzi wɔ no: Ɔnoara so na Argob asaase a ɔwɔ Bashan, nkurow akɛse eduosia a no ho wɔ afasu na boran adaban no, yɛ nedze:
Iddo ne ba Ahinadab, wɔ Mahanaim:
Ahimaaz, wɔ Naphtali; ɔno so faa Solomon ne babaa Basemath waar no:
Hushai ne ba Baana, wɔ Asher na Bealoth:
Paruah ne ba Jehoshaphat, wɔ Issachar:
Ela ne ba Shimei, wɔ Benjamin:
Uri ne ba Geber, wɔ Gilead asaase do, wɔ Amorifo Sihon na Bashanhen Og ɔman mu; na ɔno nye ɔhwɛdofo kortonoo a ɔwɔ asaase no do.
Judah na Israel wɔdɔɔ sõ, hɔn dodow tse dɛ mpoano anhwea, wodzidzi na wɔnom na hɔn enyi gye.
Na Solomon dzii hen wɔ ahenman a ofi Esutsen no ho nyinara dze kodu Philistiafo asaase do, na Egypt he do: Wɔdze ayɛyɛdze bae, na wɔsoom Solomon wɔ no nkwa no no nyinara mu.
Na Solomon ne dakor edzidzi ɔyɛ isiam-pa etwadze eduasa na eburow-isiam etwadze eduosia;
anantwi a wɔadɔ seradze du, na edzidzibea do anantwi eduonu, na nguan ɔha, ɔsor ntorɔm, na ndoa na nwamsan, na mtumbowa a wɔadɔ seradze.
Osiandɛ ɔno na ɔwɔ tum wɔ esutsen no n'afã ha asaase no nyinara do, ofi Tiphsah araa dze bodu Gaza, wɔ Esutsen n'afã ha ahemfo nyinara do: Na onyaa amandwee wɔ nkyɛnkyɛn nyinara a abɔ no ho aprɔw.
Na Judah na Israel tsenaa no dwudwooddwo, nyimpa biara wɔ no wenyindua ase na n'adɔmbadua ase, ofi Dan araa kodu Beersheba, wɔ Solomon nda nyinara mu.
Na Solomon wɔ ne ntseaseanam ho mpɔnkɔdan mu mpɔnkɔ mpemeduanan, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemduebien.
Na ahwɛdofo no hwehwɛɛ edziban maa ɔhen Solomon, na hɔn a wɔbaa ɔhen Solomon no pon ho nyinara, nyimpa biara wɔ no bosoom mu: Wɔmma hwee nnhia.
Na wɔdze atoko so na efuw a wɔdze ma mpɔnkɔ na mbowa a hɔn ho yɛ har baa beebi mbrɛ ahwɛdofo no wɔwɔ, nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ n’ahwɛdodze tse no ara.
Na Nyankopɔn maa Solomon nyansa na ntseasee dodow mbordo, na akoma a ɔtrɛ, dɛ mpoano anhwea.
Na Solomon ne nyansaa sõ sen bokamba no nyinara hɔn nyansaa, na Egypt nyansa nyinara.
Na ɔyɛ nyansafo sen nyimpa nyinara; ɔsen Ezrahnyi Ethan, na Mahol ne mba, Heman, na Calcol, na Darda: Na ne nka tahyee amanaman nyinara mu hyiae.
Na obubuu mbɛ mpensa: Na no ndwom yɛ apem enum.
Na ɔkãa ndua ho asɛm, ofi cedar a ɔwɔ Lebanon do araa dze kodu hyssop a ofifir fasu mu do: Na ɔkãa mbowadoma, na ntumbowa, na nketsembowa, na esunam so ho asɛm.
Na aman nyinara mu bi baa dɛ woribetsie Solomon ne nyansaa, wofi asaase do ahemfo a wɔtsee ne nyansaa nka no nyinara nkyɛn bae.
5: Na Tyrehen Hiram somaa no nkowaa ma wɔbaa Solomon nkyɛn; na ɔatse dɛ ɔno na wɔasera no ahyɛ no hen wɔ n’egya n'ananmu: Na Hiram yɛ David no dɔfo daa.
Na Solomon somaa ma wɔkɔr Hiram nkyɛn, dɛ,
ɔwoara nyim mbrɛ m'egya David sii na oenntum ennsi dan amma Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn ne dzin, wɔ akokoeko a ɔwɔ no ho hyiae no ntsi, dze kodur dɛ Ewuradze dze hɔn hyɛɛ n’ananadze.
Na afei Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn ama me ahomgye wɔ afã nyinara; ɔtamfo bi nnyi hɔ, na esian bi so nnyi hɔ.

Na, hwɛ, mesua dɛ miribesi dan mama Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn ne dzin, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ m’egya David no, dɛ, wo ba a medze no mebɛhyɛ w’ananmu atsena w’ahengua do no, ɔno na obesi dan ama me dzin.

Dɛm ntsi afei hyɛ ma wontwa cedar ndua wɔ Lebanon mma me; na mo nkowaa bɛba abɛkã wo nkowaa ho; na mebɛma wo apaabɔdze ma edze aama wo nkowaa dɛ mbrɛ ebɛkã nyinara: Osiandɛ ɔwoara nyim dɛ obi nnyi hɛn mu a ɔwɔ nduatwa ho nyansa dɛ Zidonfo.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Hiram tsee Solomon ne nsɛm no, odzii dɛw kɛsenara, na ɔsee dɛ, ndɛ da yi, nhyira nkã Ewuradze a ɔama David ɔba nyansafo wɔ ɔman kɛse yi do.
Na Hiram somaa ma wɔkɔr Solomon nkyɛn, dɛ, matse nkra a esomaa ma wɔdze baa me nkyɛn no: Mebɛyɛ w’apɛdze a ɔwɔ cedar ndua, na kupresindua ho no nyinara.

Mo nkowaa dze befi Lebanon do esian aba po ho: Na mebɛkyer no mpanta edua po do akɔ bea a ɔwoara ebɛkyerɛ me no, na mama wɔasansan wɔ hɔ, na abɛgye: Na wo so ayɛ m’ahwehwɛdze, dɛ ebɛma me fiefo edziban.
Nna Hiram maa Solomon cedar ndua na kupresindua dɛ mbrɛ n’ahwehwɛdze tse nyinara.
Na Solomon maa Hiram ewifua etwadze mpem eduonu dɛ ne fiefo edziban, na ngo krɔnkrɔn etwadze eduonu: Dɛm na Solomon dze maa Hiram afrenhyia afrenhyia.
Na Ewuradze maa Solomon nyansa, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ no anohoba no; na asomdwee daa Hiram na Solomon ntamu; na hɔn beenu no wɔbɔɔ mu yɛɛ kor.
Na ɔhen Solomon gyee Israel nyinara hɔ ɔtowyi edwuma; na ɔtowyi edwuma ho nyimpa yɛ mpem eduasa.
Na ɔsomaa hɔn wɔ Lebanon do, nyimpa mpemdu bosoom esiado esiado: Bosoom na wodzi wɔ Lebanon do, na abosoom ebien na wodzi wɔ fie: Na Adoniram na ɔhwɛ ɔtowyi edwuma no do.
Na Solomon wɔ ndzesoadzefo mpemeduosuon, na mbepɔw no do nduatwafo mpemeduowɔtwe;
ɔsor Solomon n’ahwɛdofo etsitsir a wɔhwɛ edwuma no do, nyimpa mpemebiasa ahaasa a wɔhwɛ nkorɔfo a wɔyɛ edwuma no do no.
Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ ma wɔpaa abo akɛse, abo a ɔsom bo, dɛ wɔdze abo a wɔasen bɛhyɛ dan no ne fapem.
Na Solomon n’adansifo na Hiram n’adansifo na Gebalfo no sinsianee, na wosiesie ndua na abo dɛ wɔdze besi dan no.
6: Na ɔbaa dɛ Israelmba fii Egypt bae no n’ekyir afe a otsia ahaanan edwuowɔtwe no mu, Solomon dzii Israel do hen no n’afe a otsia anan no mu, wɔ bosoom Ziv a ɔyɛ bosoom a otsia ebien no mu no, nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ orisi Ewuradze ne dan no.
Na ɔdan a ɔhen Solomon sii maa Ewuradze no, ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduosia, na ne tɛtɛr basafa eduonu, na no krɔn basafa eduasa.
Na abrandaa a ɔwɔ asɔrfi dan no enyim no, ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔdan no ne tɛtɛr no tse no; na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa du wɔ ɔdan no enyim.
Na ɔyɛɛ ɔdan no ho ntokura a atena-dwuma tsintsim mu.
Na ɔtotoow ɔdan no ne fasu ho asansansamdo hyiae, twitwaa ɔdan no n’afasu ho hyiae, asɔrfi no na mpiakyir nyina ho: Na ɔyɛɛ mpiakyir mpiakyir hyiae:

Ase ɔsansansamdo no ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa enum, na finimfin dze no ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa esia, na dza otsia ebiasa no ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa esuon: Na ɔyɛɛ ɔdan no ne fasu ekyir mbamba hyiae, ma mpuna no annhyɛ ɔdan no n'afasu no mu.
Na ɔdan no, aber a worisi no, wɔdze ɔbo a woesiesie no wɔ abopuei na wɔdze sii: Mber a worisi no, wɔanntse bɔbo, anaa ekuma, anaa edwindadze biara nka wɔ ɔdan no ho.
Finimfin mpiakyir no n’abow wɔ ɔdan no n’enyimfa afamu: Na wɔfow atwer mpomponee dze kɔ finimfin mpia no mu, na wofi finimfin dze no mu kɔ dza otsia ebiasa no mu.
Nna osii dan no, na owiei; na ɔdze cedar mpuna na ntaabow kataa ɔdan no do.
Na osisii asansansamdo no wɔ ɔdan no no ho nyinara, kor no krɔn basafa enum: Na wɔdze cedar mpuna ma osusuoo dan no mu.
Na Ewuradze n'asɛm baa Solomon nkyɛn, dɛ,
ɔwɔ ɔdan yi a irisi ho, sɛ enantsew m'ahyɛdze mu, na eyɛ m’atsɛmbu, na idzi me mbransɛm nyinara do dɛ ebɛnantsew mu a; ɔnodze mebɛma m’asɛm a mekãa mekyerɛɛ w’egya David no etsim ama wo.
Na mebɛtsena Israelmba mu na monnkɔpow me man Israel.
Nna Solomon sii dan no, na owiei.
Na ɔdze cedar ntaabow paam ɔdan no mu afasu no ho; ɔdze ndua kataa no mu afasu, fi dan no ne daadze kodur n’enyi nsamdo mpuna no do: Na ɔdze kupresi ntaabow saam dan no ne daadze.
Na ɔdze cedar ntaabow sii ɔdan no n'ekyir afamu basafa eduonu fi famu kɛpeem nsamdo mpuna no: Mekyerɛ osii dze no mu yɛɛ mpiakyir, mekyerɛ bea krɔnkrɔn no a.
Na ɔdan no, mekyerɛ asɔrfi no a ɔwɔ mpiakyir no enyim no, ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduanan.
Na ɔdan no mu wɔ cedar a woedzi no nkukuduuduw na nhyiren a wɔahanhan edwin: Ne nyinara cedar a; wonnhu ɔbo biara.
Na osiesiee mpiakyir wɔ ɔdan no mu finimfin, dɛ wɔdze Ewuradze n’ahyɛmudaka no besi hɔ.
Na mpiakyir no mu wɔ ɔkwan a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu, na ne tɛtɛr basafa eduonu, na no krɔn basafa eduonu; na ɔdze sika mapa duraa ho: Na ɔdze cedar kataa afɔrpon no ho.
Nna Solomon dze sika mapa duraa ɔdan no mu: Na ɔdze sika ntweaban dze twaa mpiakyir no enyim; na ɔdze sika duraa no.
Na ɔdan no nyina ɔdze sika duraa mu araa kodur dɛ wowiee ɔdan no nyinara: Nkyii so ɔdze sika duraa afɔrpon a ɔwɔ mpiakyir no ho nyinara.
Na ɔdze ngodua yɛɛ cherubfo ebien wɔ mpiakyir no mu, kor ne tsentsen yɛ basafa du.
Na cherub no n’atsaban kor yɛ basafa enum; na cherub no n’atsaban kor no so basafa enum: Ofi atsaban tsir kor ano dze kodu atsaban tsir kor so ano ɔyɛ basafa du.
Na cherub kor no so yɛ basafa du: Cherubfo ebien nyina wɔ nsusui kor na su kor.
Cherub baako no krɔn basafa du, na cherub baako no so tse dɛmara.

Na ɔdze cherubfo no sisii ekyir dan no mu: Na cherubfo no tserɛtserɛɛw hɔn ntsaban mu, ma ɔbaako n’atsaban ɔkã fasu kor, na cherub baako so n’atsaban ɔkã fasu kor no so; na hɔn ntsaban no kekã enyim wɔ ɔdan no ne finimfin.
Na ɔdze sika duraa cherubfo no ho.
Na odzii dan no n'afasu no nyinara ho edwin hyiae, dɛ ɔdze cherubfo, na mbɛdua, na nkyiren a wɔahanhan no ehonyi yɛɛ ho, no mu na n'ekyir.
Na ɔdan no ne daadze so ɔdze sika durae, no mu na n'ekyir.
Na ɔdze ngodua yɛɛ mpiakyir ahɛnee no no mbobow: Mpondua no etsifi na ne nkyɛnmu ɔyɛ fasu no mu ebupɛn enum mu kor.
Nna ɔdze ngodua yɛɛ mbobow ebien; na odzizii do edwin a ɔyɛ cherubfo na mbɛdua na nhyiren a wɔahanhan, na ɔdze sika duraa ho; na ɔtserɛɛw sika no mu kataa cherubfo, na mbɛdua no do.
Dɛmara so na ɔdze ngodua yɛɛ asɔrfi no n'ahɛnee no mpondua no, wɔ fasu no mu ebupɛn anan mu kor:
Na kupresidua mbobow ebien; abow kor wɔ afã ebien a ɔbobɔw, na abow kor no so wɔ afã ebien a ɔbobɔw
Na odzidzii ho edwin, cherubfo na mbɛdua na nhyiren a wɔahanhan: Na ɔdze sika duraa ho dze kekaa tsintsim nkrukyei no mu.
Na ɔdze abo a wɔasen akyerɛpɛn ebiasa, na cedar mpuna akyerɛpɛn kor yɛɛ no mu abangua no.
Afe a otsia anan no mu bosoom Ziv mu, na wɔtoow Ewuradze ne dan no ne fapem.
Na afe a otsia dubiako no mu, bosoom Bul a ɔyɛ bosoom a otsia awɔtwe no mu, na wowie ɔdan no wɔ no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, na mbrɛ ne yɛbea no tse nyinara ho afamu. Nna ɔdze mfe esuon dze sii.
7: Na Solomon ɔdze mfe duebiasa sii nankasa ne fi, na owiee ne fi nyinara.
Na osii Lebanon kwaa dan no; ne tsentsen yɛ basafa ɔha, na ne tɛtɛr basafa eduonum, na no krɔn basafa eduasa, ɔwɔ cedar edum akyerɛpɛn anan do, nye cedar mpuna gu edum no do.
Na wɔdze cedar saam sor wɔ mpuna eduanan enum a ogu edum no do no do; kyerɛpɛn kor mu duenum.
Na ntokura akyerɛpɛn ebiasa wɔ hɔ, na tokura hwɛ tokura enyim araa ban ebiasa.
Na mbobow na mpondua no nyinara yɛ nsamdo-mpuna atweanan: Na tokura hwɛ tokura enyim araa ban ebiasa.
Na ɔyɛɛ edum abrandaa; ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonum, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa eduasa; na abrandaa bi wɔ hɔn enyim, na edum na mpuna durdur wɔ enyim.
Na ɔyɛɛ ahengua abrandaa mbrɛ obobu hɔ atsɛn, mekyerɛ atsɛmbu abrandaa no a: Na ɔdze cedar kataa do fi famu kodur nsamdo enyi.
Na ne fi mbrɛ ɔtse, pampan kor no a ɔwɔ abrandaa no mu afamu no, ne yɛbea tse dɛmara. Ɔyɛɛ dan so a ɔtse dɛ abrandaa yi maa Pharaoh ne babaa, (nyia Solomon waar no no).
Iyinom nyinara yɛ abo a ɔsom bo, mekyerɛ abo a woetwa woesusu no dɛ wɔdze nseradaa sianee, no mu na n’ekyir, mekyerɛ ofi fapem do kɛpem etsifi, na dɛmara ɔdze fi ekyir afamu kodu pampan kɛse no do.
Na fapem no ɔyɛ abo a ɔsom bo, mekyerɛ abo akɛse a, basafa du du abo, na basafa awɔtwe awɔtwe abo.
Na ɔsor abo a ɔsom bo, mekyerɛ ɔbo a woesusu etwa na cedar dua.
Na pampan kɛse a ɔbɔ aprɔw no wɔ abo a woesian akyerɛpɛn ebiasa, na cedar mpuna kyerɛpɛn kor; tse dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze ne dan no no mu afamu na ɔdan no n’abrandaa no tse.
Na ɔhen Solomon somae ma wɔkɛfaa Hiram fi Tyre bae.

Ɔyɛ Naphtali ebusuakuw mu ɔbaa okunafo bi ne ba, na n’egya nye ɔbarimba bi a ofi Tyre, boran odwimfo a; na nyansa na ntseasee na nyimdzee ahyɛ no mã, dɛ ɔdze dzi boran dwuma nyinara mu edwin. Na ɔbaa ɔhen Solomon nkyɛn, na ɔbɛyɛɛ n’edwuma nyinara.
Na ɔyɛɛ boran edum ebien no, ekor ne tsentsen yɛ basafa duawɔtwe; na ahoma basafa duebien abɔ no ho aprɔw.
Na ɔyɛɛ boran ntaado-tsir ebien dɛ wɔdze sisi edum no etsifi: Ntaado-tsir kor no krɔn yɛ basafa enum, na ntaado-tsir kor so no krɔn yɛ basafa enum.
Atena a wɔawen no dam dam, na ntweaban kyinkyimii, wɔ ntaado-tsir a ɔwɔ edum no etsifi no ho; esuon wɔ ntaa­do-tsir kor ho, na esuon wo ntaado-tsir kor so ho.
Nna ɔyɛɛ edum no; na ɔyɛɛ pomegranate-ekutu akyerɛpɛn ebien twaa atena-dwuma no kor ho hyiae, dze kataa ntaado-tsir no a ɔwɔ edum no etsifi no do: Na dɛmara so na ɔyɛe maa ntaado-tsir kor no so.
Na ntaado-tsir a ɔwɔ abrandaa no mu edum no etsifi no wɔyɛɛ no nsukookoo dwuma, basafa anan.
Na edum ebien no do so wɔ ntaado-tsir, ɔbɛn efur a ɔwɔ atena-dwuma no ho no ho: Na pomegranate-ekutu no yɛ ahaenu, akyerɛpɛn akyerɛpɛn bɔ ntaado-tsir kor no ho aprɔw.
Na ɔdze edum no sisii asɔrfi no n’abrandaa no ano: Na ɔmaa enyimfa dum no do sii, na ofrɛɛ ne dzin Jachin: Na ɔmaa abankum dum no do sii hɔ, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Boaz.
Na edum no etsifi wɔ nsukookoo dwuma: Dɛm na ɔdze wiee edum no edwuma no.
Na ɔyɛɛ ogu po no a ofi ano kɛpem ano yɛ basafa du no, otwa kɔntɔnkrɔn, na no krɔn yɛ basafa enum: Na ahoma basafa eduasa bɔ ho aprɔw hyia.
Na nkukuduuduw wowɔ n’ano asease dze bɔ no aprɔw hyia, ne tsentsen basafa du bɔ po no ho aprɔw hyia: Nkukuduuduw no a wogui no woguu no akyerɛpɛn ebien.
ɔtaa anantwi duebien do, ebiasa hwɛ kwaamu afamu, na ebiasa hwɛ anee afamu, na ebiasa hwɛ pomu afamu, na ebiasa hwɛ boka afamu: Na po no taa hɔn do wɔ sor, na hɔn ekyir nyinara wɔ no mu afamu.
Na ne peperepee yɛ nsatseama; na n’ano no wɔyɛɛ no dɛ kuraba ano, ɔtse dɛ nsukookoo ne nhyiren: Odzi bath mpemebien
Na ɔyɛɛ boran eguarsɛn-ase-ndaka du; ngyinado adaka kor ne tsentsen yɛ basafa anan, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa anan, na no krɔn yɛ basafa ebiasa.
Na mbrɛ eguarsɛn-ase-ndaka no ne nyɛbea tse nye yi: Wɔwowɔ nhyehyɛmu; na nhyehyɛmu no hyehyɛ ngua no ntamu:
Na ngyata, anantwi, na cherubfo wowɔ ngua no ntamu nhyehyɛmu no do, na ngyinado bi wɔ ngua no do ɔsor: Na ngyata na anantwi no ase wɔ ahaban-nkyekyeree a ɔsensɛn hɔ edwuma.
Na adaka biara wɔ boran ntwahonan anan, na boran nhyehyɛmu-ndua: Na ne nan anan no wɔ nsusuomu-nsa: Egurasɛn no ase na nsusuomu-nsa bi a woegu, kã ahaban-nkyekyeree ho wɔ ne nkyɛnkyɛn.

Na n’ano wɔ ntaado-tsir no no mu na no do afamu yɛ basafa: Na n’ano yɛ korkorba tse dɛ ngyinado dwuma bi, basafa kor na fã: Na wodzidzii n’ano so edwin, na ne nhyehyɛmu no yɛ atweanan, ɔnnyɛ nkorkorba.
Na ntwahonan anan no wowɔ nhyehyɛmu ntrɛtraba no ase; na ntwahonan no ne nhyɛmu-ndua no hyehyɛ adaka no mu: Na ntwahonan kor no krɔn yɛ basafa kor na fã.
Na ntwahonan no ne nyɛbea tse de tseaseanam ntwahonan nyɛbea: Ne nhyɛmu-ndua, no ho nsusuomudze, na ne hankra-ano, na ne mparba, na ne finimfintu nyinara, wogui.
Na nsusuomu-nsa anan wowɔ adaka kor no kutuw anan no ho: Adaka no ara mu na no nsusuomu-nsa no wɔ.
Na adaka no n’etsifi no wɔyɛɛ korkorba a no krɔn yɛ basafa hyia: Na adaka no n’etsifi na ne nsa na nhyehyɛmu-ntrɛtraba no a na ofi kor no ara mu no wɔ.
Na odzii ne nsa ne ntɛrba, na ne nhyehyɛmu, ntrɛtraba no do edwin, cherubfo ngyata na mbɛdua, dɛ mbrɛ kor ne ntamu tse, nye ahaban-nkyekyeree bɔ aprɔw.
Ndaka du no mbrɛ ɔyɛe no nye yi: Ne nyinara wɔ gubea kor, nsusui kor, na isu kor.
Na ɔyɛɛ boran eguarsɛn du: Eguarsɛn kor dzi bath eduanan: Na eguarsɛn biara yɛ basafa anan: Na eguarsɛn kor wɔ ndaka du no mu kor biara no do.
Na ɔdze ndaka no sisii, enum wɔ ɔdan no n’enyimfa afamu, na enum so wɔ ɔdan no n’abankum afamu: Na ɔdze po no sii ɔdan no ne nyimfa afamu wɔ boka afamu a ɔhwɛ pomu afamu no.
Na Hiram yɛɛ eguarsɛn, na nsofi, na mbɛɛsen no. Nna Hiram wiee edwuma a ɔyɛe maa ɔhen Solomon wɔ Ewuradze ne fi no ho nyinara yɛ:
Edum ebien no, na edum no n’etsifi ntaado-tsir apɔw ebien no; na ntena-dwuma ebien no a wɔdze kataa edum no n’etsifi ntaado-tsir apɔw ebien no ho no;
na ntena-dwuma ebien no ho pomegranate-ekutu ahaanan no; pomegranate-ekutu akyerɛpɛn ebien yɛ atenadwuma kor nedze, dɛ ɔkata ntaado-tsir no n’apɔw ebien no a ɔwɔ edum no no do no ho;
na ndaka du no, na ndaka no do eguarsɛn du no;
na po kor no, na po no n’ase anantwi duebien no;
na asɛn, na nsofi, na mbɛɛsen no: Mekyerɛ ndzɛmba yi nyinara a Hiram yɛe maa ɔhen Solomon, wɔ Ewuradze ne fi no ho no, yɛ boran a wɔapɔw ho.
Jordan Tɛtɛr no do na ɔhen no gui, wɔ hyirew daadze mu wɔ Succoth na Zarethan ntamu.
Na Solomon gyaa ndzɛmba no nyinara ker, osiandɛ ɔsõ dodow mbordo: Woennhu boran no ne nkerii ano.
Na Solomon yɛɛ ndzɛmba no a ɔwɔ Ewuradze ne fi no mu no nyinara: Sika afɔrmbukyia no, na ɔpon no a kyerɛpaanoo no si do no, sika;
na nkandzeandua no, enum wɔ enyimfa afamu, na enum so wɔ abankum, mpiakyir no enyim, sika mapa: Na nhyiren, na nkandzea, na adaban no sika;
na mpokuwa, na nsompo-kuwa, na mbɛɛsen, na ntser, na ogyasɛn no, sika mapa; na no mu afamu ɔdan no, bea krɔnkrɔn ho mbobow, na ɔdan no, mekyerɛ asɔrfi no ho, mbobow no ho apontsɛr so sika a.

Nna wowiee edwuma a ɔhen Solomon yɛe no wɔ Ewuradze ne fi no ho no nyinara yɛ. Na Solomon dze ndzɛmba a n'egya David tui sii hɔ no, mekyerɛ dwetɛ, na sika, na ndzɛmbandzɛmba no bae, na ɔdze besisii Ewuradze fie ndzekoradzebea no mu.
8: Nna Solomon hyiahyiaa Israel mpanyimfo, na ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu etsitsir nyinara, Israelmba egyanom efiefi mbapɔmba no, ma wɔbaa ɔhen Solomon nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalem, dɛ wɔrekɛfa Ewuradze n’ahyɛmudaka no efi Zion a ɔyɛ David kurow no mu aba.
Na Israel mbarimba no nyinara hyiahyiaa hɔnho behyiaa ɔhen Solomon ne nkyɛn wɔ afahyɛ no ase, wo bosoom Ethanim a ɔyɛ bosoom a otsia esuon no mu.
Na Israel mpanyimfo no nyinara bae, na asɔfo no bɔsoaa adaka no.
Na wɔdze Ewuradze n’adakaa no, na ehyiadzibuw no, na ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn a ɔwɔ buw no mu no, bae; mekyerɛ iyinom na asɔfo na Levifo no wɔdze bae.
Na ɔhen Solomon na Israel mpanyimfo no nyinara fi woebehyia wɔ ne nkyɛn no, nye no dzii adaka no enyim rukuku nguan na anantwi a osian hɔn dodow ntsi wonntum nkan so wommbu ano robobɔ afɔr.
Na asɔfo no dze Ewuradze n’ahyɛmudaka no besii ne sibew, wɔ ɔdan no ne mpiakyir, bea krɔnkrɔnkrɔn no, mekyerɛ cherubfo no ntsaban ase.
Na cherubfo no atserɛtserɛw hɔn ntsaban mu wɔ adaka no ne sibew no do, na cherubfo no akata adaka no na no ho mpoma no do wɔ sor.
Na mpoma no wowar dodow ma wohu mpoma no n’etsir wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn mpiakyir no enyim; na wonnhu wɔ abowano; na mbrɛ ɔwɔ ara nye no dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Hweeara nnyi adaka no mu gyedɛ abo apon ebien no a Moses dze guu mu wɔ Horeb no, aber a Ewuradze nye Israelmba dzii ahyɛmu, wɔ aber a wofi Egypt asaase do reba no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a asɔfo no fii bea krɔnkrɔn no do puei no, mununkum bɛhyɛɛ Ewuradze ne dan no mã,
na mununkum no ntsi asɔfo no enntum enngyina annsom: Osiandɛ Ewuradze n’enyimnyam ahyɛ Ewuradze ne dan no mã.
Nna Solomon kãa dɛ, Ewuradze ase dɛ ɔbɛtsena sum kebii mu.
Ampa mesi ɔdan ayɛ tsenabew ama wo, beebi a ebɛtsena hɔ daa.
Na ɔhen no daan n’enyim, na ohyiraa Israel mboanofo no nyinara: Na Israel mboanofo no nyinara gyinagyinaa tsentsen.
Na ɔsee dɛ, nhyira nkã Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn a ɔdze n’ano kasaa kyerɛɛ m’egya David, na ɔdze ne nsa ahyɛ no mã, dɛ,

ofitsi da a medze me man Israel mifii Egypt mebae no, mannsan mu ennyi kurow bi emmfi Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu dɛ wonsi dan, ma me dzin aatsena hɔ; mbom mesaan mu miyii David dɛ ɔnhwɛ me man Israel do.
Afei ɔwɔ m’egya David n’akoma mu dɛ obesi dan ama Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no ne dzin.
Na Ewuradze see m’egya David dɛ, susuampa dɛ ɔwɔ w’akoma mu dɛ nkyɛ ibesi dan ama me dzin no, eyɛɛ no yie dɛ ɔwɔ w’akoma mu:
Naaso ɔwoara nnkesi dan no; na mbom wo ba a ofi w’asen mu bɛba no, ɔno na obesi dan no ama me dzin.
Na Ewuradze ama n’asɛm a ɔkãe no etsim; na masoɛr mahyɛ m’egya David n’ananmu, na metse Israel ahengua do, de mbrɛ Ewuradze bɔɔ anohoba no, na mesi dan no ama Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no ne dzin.
Na meyi hɔ beebi mama adaka no a Ewuradze ahyɛmu a ɔnye hɛn egyanom dzii, wɔ aber a ɔdze hɔn fi Egypt asaase do reba no wɔ mu no.
Na Solomon gyinaa Ewuradze n’afɔrmbukyia no enyim wɔ Israel mboanofo no nyinara enyim, na ɔtserɛɛw ne nsamu wɔ sor:

Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, Onyankopɔn bi nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo, wɔ wimu, wɔ sor, anaa asaase do, wɔ famu: Ɔwo a isie ahyɛmu na mbɔbɔrhu ma wo nkowaa a wɔdze hɔn akoma nyinara nantsew w’enyim:
Ɔwo a esie dza ebɔɔ anohoba maa w’akowaa m’egya David no ama no: Nyew, ɔwo edze w’ano kãe, na edze wo nsa ahyɛ no mã, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.

Dɛm ntsi afei, Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, sie dza abɔ anohoba ama w’akowaa m’egya David no ma no dɛ, nyimpa a ɔbɛtsena Israel ahengua do rommbɔ wo wɔ m’enyim; sɛ wo mba hwɛ hɔn kwan yie ara, dɛ wɔbɛnantsew m’enyim dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo nantseew m’enyim no a.
Dɛm ntsi afei, Israel Nyankopɔn ɛ, meserɛ wo, ma w’asɛm a ekãa kyerɛɛ w’akowaa m’egya David no ntsim.
Ma aso ampa dɛ Nyankopɔn bɛtsena asaase do? Hwɛ, ɔsor na ɔsor mu sor mpo nntum nnkora wo; na akantam ɔdan yi a mesi!
Naaso Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn bu w’akowaa ne mpaabɔ, na no ntotɔserɛ bi, dɛ ibetsie w’akowaa ne nkekamu na ne mpaabɔ a ɔrobɔ no wɔ w’enyim ndɛ da yi:
Dɛ w’enyi bobue wɔ ɔdan yi do adzesaa na adzekyee, mekyerɛ bea a ɔwoara ase dɛ, me dzin bɛtsena hɔ no do: Dɛ ibetsie mpaabɔ a w’akowaa robɔ akyerɛ bea yi do no.
Na tsie w’akowaa, na wo man Israel ntotɔserɛ, aber a wɔrobɔ mpaa kyerɛ bea yi do: Nyew, tsie no wɔ ɔsor wo tsenabea hɔ; na sɛ etse a, fa fir:
Sɛ nyimpa bi yɛ bɔn tsia ne nyɛnko, na ntam bɛda no do dɛ ɔkã, na ɔba bɛkã ntam wɔ w’afɔrmbukyia enyim wɔ ofi yi mu a:
Ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor, na yɛ, na bu wo nkowaa atsɛn, dɛ irubu ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi no fɔ, ma no kwan eebua nankasa n’etsifi: Na irubu ɔtseneneenyi no bem, ma ama no dɛ mbrɛ ne ndzeyɛtsenenee tse.
Sɛ wɔkã wo man Israel gu wɔ atamfo enyim, osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia wo ntsi; sɛ wɔsan ba wo nkyɛn bio, na wɔbɔ wo dzin, na wɔbɔ wo mpaa na wɔtotɔ serɛ wo wɔ ofi yi mu a:
Ɔno ɔwoara tsie wo ɔsor, na fa wo man Israel hɔn bɔn fir, na fa hɔn bra asaase a ɔwoara dze maa hɔn egyanom no do bio.
Sɛ wɔtow ɔsor mu, na nyankom nntɔ, osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia wo ntsi; sɛ wɔbɔ mpaa kyerɛ bea yi do, na wɔbɔ wo dzin, na wɔsan fi hɔn bɔn ho, dɛ ahaw hɔn ntsi a:
Ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor, na fa wo nkowaa, na wo man Israel hɔn bɔn fir, dɛ erekyerɛ hɔn ɔkwan pa a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔfa do; na ma nyankom ntɔ ngu w’asaase a ɔwoara dze ama wo man dɛ egyapadze no do.
Sɛ ɔkɔm ba asaase no do, sɛ ɔyardom ba, sɛ ohuw anaa ɔpo, mbɛbɛw anaa nkonyinko ba; sɛ hɔn atamfo botua hɔn wɔ nkuropon asaase do; owuyar biara, yarba biara ba a;
mpaabɔ na ntotɔserɛ biara a nyimpa biara, anaa wo man Israel nyinara bɛyɛ a nyimpa biara bohu nankasa n’akoma mu ɔhaw na ɔbɛtrɛ ne nsamu akyerɛ ofi yi do no:

Ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor wo tsenabea hɔ, na fa fir, na yɛ, na ma nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ n’akwan nyinara tse, nyia ɔwoara nyim n’akoma mu a; (osiandɛ ɔwo, mekyerɛ ɔwoara nkotoo na inyim nyimpa mba nyinara hɔn akoma mu);
Ma woeesuro wo wɔ nda nyinara a wɔdze bɛtsena asaase a ɔwoara edze maa hɛn egyanom no do no.
Nkyii so ɔhɔho a ommfi wo man Israel mu ho dze, sɛ osian wo dzin ntsi ma ofi ekyirkyir man bi mu ba;
(osiandɛ wɔbɛtse wo dzin kɛse no, na wo nsa dzendzen no, na w’abasa a atsen mu no nka); sɛ ɔba bɔbɔ mpaa kyerɛ ɔdan yi do a:

Ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor wo tsenabea, na yɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔhɔho no rusū frɛ wo no nyinara: Ma asaase do aman nyinara eehu wo dzin, na woeesuro wo, dɛ mbrɛ wo man Israel yɛ, na woeehu dɛ wo dzin na wɔdze frɛ ɔdan yi a mesi yi.
Sɛ wo man fir edzi nye hɔn atamfo kedzi akõ wɔ ɔkwan biara a ɔwoara bɔsoma hɔn do, na wɔbɔ Ewuradze mpaa kyerɛ kurow a asan mu eyi, na ɔdan a mesi mama wo dzin yi do a:
Ɔno ɔwoara tsie hɔn mpaabɔ na hɔn ntotɔserɛ wɔ ɔsor, na dzi hɔn asɛm ma hɔn.
Sɛ wɔyɛ bɔn tsia wo, (osiandɛ nyimpa bi nnyi hɔ a ɔnnyɛ bɔn), na wo bo fuw hɔn, na iyi hɔn ma atamfo, ma wɔfa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔ atamfo asaase do ekyirkyir o, nkyɛnkyɛn o;

naaso sɛ hɔnara wɔdwen wɔ asaase a wɔafa hɔn ndɔmmum akɔ do no do, na wɔsan bio, na wɔtotɔ serɛ wo wɔ hɔn a wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree no hɔn asaase do, dɛ, yɛayɛ bɔn, na yeetwa nkontompɔ, yeedzi emumuyɛsɛm;

sɛ wɔdze hɔn akoma nyinara na hɔn kra nyinara san ba wo nkyɛn wɔ hɔn atamfo a wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree no hɔn asaase do, na wɔbɔ mpaa kyerɛ hɔn asaase a ɔwoara dze maa hɔn egyanom, kurow a ɔwoara asan mu eyi, na ɔdan a mesi mama wo dzin yi do a:
Ɔno ɔwoara tsie hɔn mpaabɔ na hɔn ntotɔserɛ wɔ ɔsor wo tsenabea, na dzi hɔn asɛm ma hɔn;
Na fa wo man a wɔayɛ bɔn etsia wo, na hɔn mbrato a wɔafom wɔ mu etsia wo nyinara fir hɔn; na ma hɔn mbɔbɔrbu wɔ hɔn a wɔfaa ndɔmmum kɔree no enyim, ma wonhu hɔn mbɔbɔr:
osiandɛ wɔyɛ wo man, na w’egyapadze a iyii hɔn wɔ Egypt wɔ dadze fononoo no mu bae:
Na ma w’enyiwa mbue mma w’akowaa no ntotɔserɛ, na wo man Israel ntotɔserɛ dɛ ibetsie hɔn mber biara a wosū frɛ wo no.
Osiandɛ ɔwoara na etseew bɔn fii asaase do aman nyinara mu dɛ wɔyɛ w'egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔwoara nam w'akowaa Moses n’abaw do kãe no, wɔ aber a edze hɔn egyanom fi Egypt reba no, ao Ewuradze Nyankopɔn.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Solomon wiee mpaabɔ na ntotɔserɛ nyinara bɔ maa Ewuradze no, ɔsoɛree fii Ewuradze afɔrmbukyia no enyim, dɛ ogyaa n’anankoroma enyim kosɔw nye ne nsamu trɛ a ɔtrɛɛ kyerɛɛ ɔsor do no.
Na ogyinae, na ɔdze ndze kɛse hyiraa Israel mboanofo no nyinara, dɛ,
Nhyira nkã Ewuradze a ɔama ne man Israel ahomgye, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ anohoba no nyinara tse: N’anohoba pa a ɔnam n’akowaa Moses ne nsa do bɔe no nyinara mu asɛm kor anntɔ famu.
Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn ndzi hɛn ekyir, dɛ mbrɛ odzii hɛn egyanom ekyir no: Ma mma onngyaa hɛn, na so ɔmmpa hɛn:
Ma ɔaadan hɛn akoma akɔ no do, dɛ yɛbɛnantsew n’akwan nyinara mu, na yeedzi ne mbransɛm, na n’ahyɛdze, na n’atsɛmbu a ɔdze hyɛɛ hɛn egyanom do.
Na ma me nsɛm yi a medze medzi ntotɔserɛ wɔ Ewuradze enyim yi mbɛn Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn adzekyee na adzesaa, ma ondzi n’akowaa n'asɛm, na ne man Israel asɛm mma hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ da biara bɛgye:
Ama asaase do aman nyinara woeehu dɛ Ewuradze nye Nyankopɔn: Na obi nnyi hɔ bio.
Dɛm ntsi hom mma hom akoma ndzi mu wɔ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn ho, dɛ wɔbɛnantsew n’ahyɛdze mu, na woedzi ne mbransɛm do dɛ ndɛ da yi.
Na ɔhen no, na Israel nyinara kã no ho bɔɔ afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na Solomon dze anantwi mpemeduonuebien, na nguan mpemɔhaeduonu, bɔɔ asomdwee afɔr a ɔbɔe maa Ewuradze no. Dɛm na ɔhen no na Israelmba no nyinara dze buee Ewuradze ne fi no.

Da no ara ɔhen no yɛɛ Ewuradze ne dan no enyim dampan no ne finimfin no krɔnkrɔn; na hɔ na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyewafɔr ma edziban-afɔr, na asomdwee afɔr ne seradze no: Osiandɛ boran afɔrmbuhyia no a ɔwɔ Ewuradze enyim no suar dodow dɛ ɔbɛgye ɔhyew-afɔr, na asomdwee afɔr ho seradze no.
Nna Solomon hyɛɛ fa no aber no mu, na Israel nyinara kã no ho, mboanofo kɛse, wofi Hamath ahɛnee kodu Egypt ɔwora no ho, wɔ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn enyim nda esuon na nda esuon, mekyerɛ dadu ndaanan.
Da a otsia awɔtwe no ogyaa ɔman no kwan, na wohyiraa ɔhen no, na wɔdze papa nyinara a Ewuradze ayɛ ama n'akowaa David, na ne man Israel no ho enyigye na akoma pa sii mu kɔr hɔn asesee mu.
9: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Solomon wiee Ewuradze ne fi, na ɔhen ne fi no si, na Solomon n'apɛdze a ɔsɔ n'enyi dɛ ɔbɛyɛ nyinara yɛ no,
nna Ewuradze yii noho kyerɛɛ Solomon ne mpɛn ebien, dɛ mbrɛ oyii noho kyerɛɛ no wɔ Gibeon no.
Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, matse wo mpaabɔ na wo ntotɔserɛ a ayɛ no wɔ m’enyim no: Mayɛ ofi a esi yi krɔnkrɔn, dɛ medze me dzin mobɔto hɔ daa; na m’enyiwa na m'akoma atsena hɔ daa nyina.
Na ɔwodze, sɛ enantsew m’enyim dɛ mbrɛ w’egya David nantsewee no, akomamu tsewee mu, na tsenenee mu, dɛ ebɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ dza medze mahyɛ wo nyinara tse, na edzi m’ahyɛdze na m’atsɛmbu do a;
Ɔno mebɛma w'ahendzi ahengua etsim wɔ Israel do daa; dɛ mbrɛ medze mobɔɔ w’egya David anohoba no, dɛ, Israel ahengua do nyimpa rommbɔ wo no.
Mbom sɛ hom san fi m’ekyir, hom anaa hom mba, na woenndzi me mbransɛm na m’ahyɛdze a medze mesi hom enyim yi do, na hom kɔ kɔsom enyame fofor, na hom sɔr hɔn a:
Ɔno mubotwa Israel mefi asaase a medze mama hɔn no do; na ofi a mayɛ no krɔnkrɔn mama me dzin yi mobɔtow efi m’enyim akyen; na Israel bɛdan ɔkasabɛbu na fen wɔ aman nyinara mu:
Na ɔdan yi krɔn kɔ sor dze, naaso obiara a obotwa mu wɔ ho no, no ho bɔbow no, na ɔabo nhwiroma; na wɔase dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na Ewuradze ayɛ asaase yi, na ofi yi dɛm yi?

Na wobobua dɛ, osiandɛ wɔpoow Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn a ɔdze hɔn egyanom fi Egypt asaase do bae no, na wɔkɛtae suoo enyame fofor mu sɔɔr hɔn, na wɔsoom hɔn: Dɛm ntsi na Ewuradze dze mbusu yi nyinara aba hɔn do yi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe eduonu no a Solomon dze sisii efi ebien no, Ewuradze fi na ɔhen ne fi no, n’ewiei no,
(afei Tyrehen Hiram dze cedar ndua na kupresindua, na ɔnye sika, dɛ mbrɛ n’apɛdze tse nyinara ama Solomon), nna ɔhen Solomon maa Hiram nkurow eduonu wɔ Galilee asaase do.
Na Hiram fiir edzi fii Tyre dɛ ɔrobɔhwɛ nkurow a Solomon dze ama no no; na wɔannsɔ n’enyi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, mo nua, ebɛn nkurow nye yi na edze ama me yi? Na ɔfrɛɛ no Cabul asaase dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na Hiram somaa ma wɔdze sika talent ɔha eduonu kɛmaa ɔhen no.
Na iyi nye siantsir a ɔhen Solomon gyegyee ɔtowyi edwuma; dɛ ɔdze besi Ewuradze ne fi, na nankasa ne fi, na Millo, na Jerusalem fasu, na Hazor, na Megiddo, na Gezer no.
Egypthen Pharaoh afow akɔ akɛgye Gezer, na ɔdze ogya ahyew no, na oekuku Canaanfo a wɔtse kurow no mu no, na ɔdze ama ne babaa, Solomon yer no, dɛ awardze.
Na Solomon kyekyeer Gezer, na Beth-horon anaafo no,
na Baalath, na Tamar wɔ sar no do, asaase no do,
na adzekora nkurow a Solomon wɔ no nyinara, na ne ntseaseanam nkurow, na no mpɔnkɔdofo nkurow, na dza Solomon pɛ dɛ osi gye n’enyi wɔ Jerusalem, na Lebanon, na n’ahendzi asaase no nyinara mu.
Nkorɔfo a wɔkae wɔ Amorifo, na Hittifo, na Perizzifo, Hivifo, na Jebusfo mu a wommfi Israelmba mu no dze;
hɔn mba a wɔkaa hɔn ekyir wɔ asaase no do no a Israelmba enntum annsɛɛ hɔn pasapasa no, hɔn na Solomon gyegyee hɔn enyadze ɔtowyi edwuma dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na Israelmba no mu dze, Solomon annyɛ mu bi enyimfo; na hɔn na wɔyɛ mbarimba akofo, na ne gyasefo na ne mbapɔmba, na n’asafohemfo, na ne ntseaseanam na no mpɔnkɔdofo do mpanyimfo.
Woyinom nye Solomon n’edwuma do ahwɛdofo mu mpanyin, ahaenum eduonum a wɔhwɛ nkorɔfo a wɔyɛ edwuma no do.
Na Pharaoh babaa no fii David kurow no mu baa ne fi a Solomon sii maa no no mu: Nna osii Millo.

Na afrenhyia mu mpɛn ebiasa na Solomon bobɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr na asomdwee afɔr, wɔ afɔrmbukyia a osii maa Ewuradze no do, ɔhyew eduhuam kã ho, wɔ afɔrmbukyia a osi Ewuradze enyim no do. Dɛm na ɔdze wiee ofi no
Na ɔhen Solomon yɛɛ ahɛn wɔ Ezion-geber a ɔwɔ Eloth nkyɛn, wɔ epo memen no no mpoano, wɔ Edom asaase do.
Na Hiram somaa no nkowaa, apofomba a wɔwɔ po ho nyimdzee, ma wɔkɛkãa Solomon no nkowaa ho wɔ ahɛn no mu.
Na wɔkɔr Ophir, na wɔkɛfaa hɔ sika, talent ahaanan eduonu, na wɔdze brɛɛ ɔhen Solomon.
10: Na aber a Sheba ɔhembaa no tsee Solomon ne nka wɔ Ewuradze ne dzin ho no, ɔbaa dɛ ɔdze nsɛmbisa dzendzen robɔsɔ no ahwɛ.
Na ɔnye akadofo kɛsenara baa Jerusalem, efumpɔnkɔ a wɔsoso ndubuam, na sika piigyan, na abo a ɔsom bo: Na aber a ɔbaa Solomon nkyɛn no, ɔnye no twetwee dza ɔwɔ n’akoma mu nyinara ho nkɔmbɔ.
Na Solomon kyerɛɛ no ne nsɛm nyinara ano: Asɛm biara ennsuma ɔhen no a ɔannkã annkyerɛ no.
Na aber a Sheba ɔhembaa no hun Solomon ne nyansaa nyinara, na ofi a oesi,
na no pon do edziban, na no nkowaa ntsenaa mu, na n’asomfo ngyinaa mu, na hɔn ntar, na ne nsãhyɛfo, na n’afowee a ɔnam do fow kɔ Ewuradze fie no; nna sunsum bi nnyi no mu bio.
Na ɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, wo ndwuma na wo nyansaa ho asɛm a metsee no wɔ mankasa m’asaase do no yɛ nokwar.
Naaso manngye nsɛm no menndzi, dze bodur dɛ mebae, na medze m’enyiwa mebohu yi: Na hwɛ, wɔannkã ne fã mpo annkyerɛ me: Wo nyansaa na wo prɔmprɔmyɛ bor nka a metsee no do.
Ahomka akã wo nkorɔfo, ahomka akã wo nkowaa yi a wogyinagyina w'enyim daa, na wotsie wo nyansaa no.
Nhyira nkã Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn a ɔpɛ w’asɛm dɛ ɔdze wo esi Israel ahengua do: Osiandɛ Ewuradze dɔ Israel daa, dɛm ntsi na ɔahyɛ wo ɔhen dɛ yɛ atsɛmbudze na adze pɛrpɛr.
Na ɔmaa ɔhen no sika talent ɔha eduonu, na nduhuam burututuitu, na abo a ɔsom bo: Nduhuam a ɔdɔɔ sõ dɛm bi ammba bio a ɔtse dɛ mbrɛ Sheba ɔhembaa no dze maa ɔhen Solomon no.
Na Hiram n'ahɛn no so a wɔdze sika fi Ophir bae no, wɔdze almug ndua piigyan na abo a ɔsom bi fi Ophir bae.
Na ɔhen no dze almug ndua no yɛɛ Ewuradze fi no na ɔhen ne fi no ho edum, nsankutsen so na bɛntaasanku maa adwontofo no: Dɛm almug ndua bi ammba bio, nkyii so woennhu bi araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na ɔhen Solomon maa Sheba ɔhembaa no n’apɛdze nyinara, biribiara a obisae no, ɔsor dza ofi ɔhen Solomon nsamu a ɔdze maa no no. Nna odzii ndan, na osii mu kɔr nankasa n’asaase do, ɔno na no nkowaa.
Na afei sika a ɔbaa Solomon hɔ wɔ afe kor mu ne nkerii yɛ sika talent ahaesia eduosia esia,
ɔsor dza ofi konkosifo hɔ bae, na eguadzifo eguadzi mu, na dza ofi aforaforadɔm ahemfo nyinara hɔ, na aman no mu ambradofo no hɔ.
Na ɔhen Solomon dze sika a wɔabor yɛɛ akyɛm akɛse ahaenu: Sika shekel ahaesia na ɔdze duraa kyɛm kor ho.
Na ɔdze sika a wɔabor yɛɛ akyɛm nkakraba ahaasa; sika pɔɔn ebiasa na ɔdze duraa kyɛm kor ho: Na ɔhen no dze koguu Lebanon kwaa dan no mu.
Nkyii so ɔhen no yɛɛ asombɛn ahengua kɛsenara na ɔdze sika mapa duraa ho.
Ahengua no wɔ ntwerba esia, na ahengua no n’etsifi yɛ korkorba wɔ ekyir: Na nsa wowɔ afã na afã wɔ atsenaa no ho, na ngyata ebien gyinagyina nsa no ho.
Na ngyata duebien gyinagyina ntwerba esia no do hɔ wɔ afã na afã ha: Wɔnnyɛɛ dza ɔtse dɛm bi da wɔ ahenman biara mu.
Na ɔhen Solomon no nkuraba a ɔnom mu nyinara sika dze a, na Lebanon kwaa dan mu nkuraba nyinara sika mapa a: Dwetɛ dze biara nnyi mu; wommbu no hwee wɔ Solomon ne nda no mu.
Na ɔhen wɔ Tarshish ahɛn wɔ po do a ɔkã Hiram n’ahɛn ho: Mfensa biara mu Tarshish ahɛn no ba prɛko, dze sika, na dwetɛ, asombɛn na ndɔpe, na koohaa ba.
Na ɔhen Solomon boor asaase do ahemfo nyinara do wɔ ahonya na nyansa mu.
Na asaase nyinara hwehwɛɛ Solomon n'enyim ehu, dɛ wobetsie ne nyansaa a Nyankopɔn dze ahyɛ n'akoma mu no.
Na hɔn mu nyimpa biara dze n’ayɛyɛdze bae, dwetɛ ndzɛmba, na sika ndzɛmba, na ntar, na ahodze, na nduhuam, mpɔnkɔ, na nsoaso-mpɔnkɔ, afrenhyiadze afrenhyia afrenhyia.
Na Solomon boaboaa ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo ano: Na nyaa ntseaseanam apem ahaanan, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemduebien a ɔdze hɔn siesiee ntseaseanam nkurow no mu, na ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalem.
Na ɔhen no maa dwetɛ yɛɛ dɛ abo wɔ Jerusalem, na ɔmaa cedar yɛɛ dɛ sycomore ndua a ɔwowɔ abɔnmu nkurow mu, wɔ ɔdodow mu.
Na mpɔnkɔ a Solomon nyae no wɔdze fi Egypt bae: Na ɔhen n'eguadzifo no kɛgyegyee hɔn ekuwekuw no, kuw kor wɔ no bo do.
Na wɔdze tseaseanam fi Egypt bae bɛgyee dwetɛ shekel ahaesia, na ɔpɔnkɔ so, shekel ɔha eduonum: Na dɛmara so na wokitsaa bi fiir edzi brɛɛ Hittifo ahemfo nyinara, na Syria ahemfo no.
11: Afei ɔhen Solomon dɔɔ mbaa ananaben piinara kãa Pharaoh ne babaa no ho, mbaa a wofi Moabfo, Ammonfo, Edomfo, Zidonfo, na Hittifo mu;

wofi amanaman a Ewuradze kāa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ Israelmba dɛ, mma hom nnkɔ hɔn mu, nkyii so mma hɔn so mmba hom mu: Na ampa wɔbɛdan hom akoma ekedzi hɔn enyame ekyir no a: Woyinom na Solomon takyeer hɔn ho wɔ ɔdɔ mu.
Na onyaa yernom ahaesuon, ahembaa a, na nwewefo ahaasa: Na ne yernom daan n’akoma.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Solomon yɛɛ akɔdaa no, ne yernom daan n’akoma kedzii enyame fofor ekyir: Na n’akoma enndzi mu wɔ Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn ho, dɛ mbrɛ n'egya David n’akoma tse.
Na Solomon kedzii Zidonfo nyamewa Ashtoreth ekyir, na Ammonfo ekyiwadze Milcom ekyir.
Na Solomon yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, na oenndzi Ewuradze ekyir ennwie, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya David yɛe.
Nna Solomon sii bea sorɔnsorɔm maa Moab ekyiwadze Chemosh, wɔ bepɔw a ɔwɔ Jerusalem enyim no do, na Ammonmba ekyiwadze Molech.
Na dɛm na ɔyɛe maa ne yernom ananaben nyinara a wɔhyeew eduhuam na wɔbɔɔ afɔr maa hɔn enyame.
Na Ewuradze no bo fuuw Solomon, osiandɛ n’akoma adan efi Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no a oeyi noho akyerɛ no mpɛn ebien no ho ntsi,
na ɔahyɛ no asɛm yi ho mbra dɛ mma ɔnnkɔ nnkedzi enyame fofor ekyir: Na oenndzi dza Ewuradze hyɛe no do.
Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze see Solomon dɛ, susuampa dɛ ɔwo ayɛ iyi, na enndzi m’ahyɛmu na m’ahyɛdze a mehyɛɛ wo no do ntsi, ampa mebɛtsew ahendzi no mefi wo nsamu, na medze mama w’akowaa.
Naaso wo nda mu dze merennyɛ, osian w’egya David ntsi: Na mbom mebɛtsew efi wo ba nsamu.
Naaso merenntsew ahendzi no nyinara; na medze ebusuakuw kor mebɛma wo ba, osian m’akowaa David, na Jerusalem a masan mu meyi no ntsi.
Na Ewuradze maa ɔtamfo bi soɛree tsiaa Solomon, Edomnyi Hadad a: Ofi ɔhen n'asefo mu wɔ Edom.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a David bɔɔ Edom, na dɔm safohen Joab fowee kɔr dɛ orikesie atɔfo no, na okum Edom mbanyin nyinara;
(na Joab na Israel nyinara tsenaa hɔ abosoom esia, kodur dɛ okuuw ɔbanyin biara ase wɔ Edom);
ma Hadad guanee, ɔno na Edomfo bi a wofi n’egya nkowaa mu kã no ho, dɛ wɔrokɔ Egypt; nna Hadad yɛ abofra kakrabaa.
Na wɔsoɛree fii Midian, na wɔbaa Paran: Na wɔfaa mbarimba bi wɔ Paran kãa hɔnho, na wɔbaa Egypt, wɔ Egypthen Pharaoh nkyɛn; ɔno na ɔmaa no ofi, na ɔhyehyɛɛ edziban maa no, na ɔmaa no asaase.
Na Hadad nyaa enyimnyam kɛse wɔ Pharaoh enyim, ma ɔdze nankasa ne yer no nua, ɔhembaa Taphenes no nua, maa no ayewar.
Na Taphenes no nua no woo ne babanyin Genubath maa no, ɔno na Taphenes twaa no enumfo wɔ Pharaoh fie: Na Genubath wɔ Pharaoh fie, wɔ Pharaoh ne mba no mu.
Na aber a Hadad tsee no wɔ Egypt dɛ David nye n’egyanom akɛda, na dɔm safohen Joab ewu no, Hadad see Pharaoh dɛ; gya me kwan ma monkɔ mankasa me man mu.
Nna Pharaoh see no dɛ, na ebɛnadze na ehia no wɔ me nkyɛn, ma erohwehwɛ dɛ ekɔ wankasa wo man mu yi? Na obuaa dɛ, nnyɛ biribiara a: Naaso ɔkwan ara na gya me ma monkɔ.
Na Nyankopɔn maa ɔtamfo kor so soɛree tsiaa no, Eliada ba Rezon a oguanee fii no wura Zobahhen Hadadezer nkyɛn no a:
Na ɔboaboaa mbarimba ano maa noho, na ɔbɛyɛɛ dɔm do safohen, wɔ aber a David kum hɔn a wofi Zobah no: Na wosii mu kɔr Damascus, na wɔkɛtsenaa hɔ, na odzii hen wɔ Damascus,
Na ɔyɛɛ ɔtamfo maa Israel wɔ Solomon ne nda nyinara mu, ɔsor mbusu a Hadad bɔe no: Na okyiir Israel, na odzii Syria do hen
Na Nebat ne ba Jeroboam Ephraimnyi bi a ofi Zeredah, Solomon akowaa bi no a ne nã ne dzin dze Zeruah, ɔbaa okunafo bi a, ɔno so maa ne nsa do tsiaa ɔhen no.
Na asɛm a osian ntsi ma ɔmaa ne nsa do tsiaa ɔhen no nye yi: Solomon sii Millo, na osisiiw n’egya David kurow ho etokur.
Na ɔbarimba Jeroboam no ɔyɛ ɔbarimba katakyi a ɔyɛ ndam: Na Solomon hun aberantsɛ no dɛ ɔyɛ kua, na ɔmaa ɔhwɛɛ Joseph fie edwuma nyinara do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber no mu, aber a Jeroboam fi Jerusalem rokɔ no, nkɔnhyɛnyi Shilonnyi Ahijah hun no wɔ ɔkwan nomu; na Ahijah hyɛ atar fofor; na hɔn beenu nko na wɔwɔ haban no mu.
Na Ahijah tae suoo atar fofor a ɔhyɛ no no mu, na ɔtsetseew mu esinesin duebien.
Na ɔsee Jeroboam dɛ, yi esinesin du woara fa; na mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, hwɛ, mebɛtsew ahendzi no mefi Solomon ne nsamu, na medze mbusuakuw du mama wo:
(Na ɔnodze obenya ebusuakuw kor, wɔ m’akowaa David ntsi, na Jerusalem, kurow a masan mu meyi no wɔ Israel mbusuakuw nyinara mu no ntsi):

Osiandɛ wɔapow me, na wɔakɔsom Zidonfo hɔn nyamewa Ashtoreth, Moab nyame Chemosh, na Ammonmba nyame Milcom; na wɔannantsew m'akwan mu dɛ wɔbɛyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ m'enyiwa do, na woedzi m'ahyɛdze na m'atsɛmbu do, dɛ mbrɛ n'egya David yɛe.
Naaso merenngye ahendzi no nyinara wɔ ne nsamu: Na mebɛyɛ no ɔhen, wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu wɔ m'akowaa David ntsi, ɔno a mesaan mu miyii no, osiandɛ odzii me mbransɛm na m'ahyɛdze do:
Na mbom mebɛgye ahendzi no mefi ne ba nsamu, na medze mama wo, mekyerɛ mbusuakuw du no a.
Na medze ebusuakuw kor mebɛma ne ba no, ama m'akowaa David oeenya kandzea daa wɔ m'enyim, wɔ Jerusalem, kurow a masan mu meyi no dɛ medze me dzin mobɔto hɔ no mu.
Na mebɛfa ɔwo, na ibedzi hen dɛ mbrɛ wo kra pɛ nyinara na edzi Israel do hen.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ itsie dza mebɛhyɛ wo nyinara, na enantsew m’akwan do, na eyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ m enyiwa do, dɛ ibedzi m'ahyɛdze na me mbra do, dɛ mbrɛ m akowaa David yɛe no a; ɔno mibedzi w'ekyir, na m’akyekyer ofi a otsim mama wo, dɛ mbrɛ mekyekyeree memaa David no, na medze Israel mebɛma wo.
Na iyi ntsi mibehiahia David n’asefo ho, na nnyɛ daa nyina.
Dɛm ntsi Solomon hwehwɛɛ dɛ oku Jeroboam: Na Jeroboam soɛree, na oguanee kɔr Egypt, wɔ Egypthen Shishak nkyɛn, na ɔtsenaa Egypt araa ma okodur Solomon no wu mu.
Afei Solomon ho nsɛm nkaa, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na ne nyansaa no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Solomon ho nsɛm nwoma no mu bi a?
Na mber a Solomon dze dzii hen wɔ Israel nyinara do wɔ Jerusalem no ɔyɛ mfe eduanan.
Na Solomon nye n’egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no wɔ n’egya David kurow mu: Na ne ba Rehoboam dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
12: Na Rehoboam sii mu kɔr Shechem: Osiandɛ Israel nyinara ba Shechem dɛ wɔrebɛnyɛ no ɔhen.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Nebat ne ba Jeroboam tsee no, (osiandɛ ɔda ho wɔ Egypt, mbrɛ oguanee fi ɔhen Solomon enyim kɔree no, na Jeroboam tsenaa Egypt)
na wɔsomae ma wokehyiaa no; nna Jeroboam na Israel mboanofo no nyinara bae, na wɔbɛkãa kyerɛɛ Rehoboam, dɛ,
w’egya yɛɛ hɛn kɔndua durdur: Dɛm ntsi afei yɛ w’egya no som dzendzen no, na no kɔndua durdur a ɔdze too hɛn do no, harhar, na yɛnsom wo.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom ntwe mu nkɔ ndaansa, na nkyii hom mbra me nkyɛn bio. Na ɔman no twee mu kɔree.
Na ɔhen Rehoboam nye nkɔdaa a wogyinaa n’egya Solomon enyim mber a ɔda ho tse ase no, faa apam, dɛ, apam bɛn na hom dze repam me dɛ memfa mensan nkobua ɔman yi.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, sɛ ndɛ yi ɔwo eyɛ akowaa ma ɔman yi, na esom hɔn, na ibua hɔn, na ekã nsɛm pa kyerɛ hɔn a, ɔno wɔbɛyɛ wo nkowaa daa nyina.
Na ɔpoow nkɔdaa no hɔn apam a wɔdze maa no no, na ɔnye mberantsɛ a wɔnye no nyinii a wogyinaa n'enyim no faa apam.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, apam bɛn na hom dze ma, ma yɛdze mbuae aasan akɛma ɔman yi a wɔakã akyerɛ me, dɛ, yɛ kɔndua a w’egya dze too hɛn do no harhar no?

Na mberantsɛ a wɔnye no nyinii no kãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, dɛm na kã kyerɛ ɔman yi a wɔbɛkãa kyerɛɛ wo dɛ, w’egya yɛɛ hɛn kɔndua durdur, na ɔwodze, yɛ no harhar ma hɛn no; dɛm na kã kyerɛ hɔn, me nsatseaba kakraba yɛ dur sen m’egya n'asen.
Na afei susuampa dɛ m’egya dze kɔndua durdur soaa hom no, emi so mobɔto hom kɔndua no do: M'egya dze mpire tsēaa hom, na emidze medze nyankom-nketsebowa mebɛtsēa hom.
Nna Jeroboam na ɔman no nyinara baa Rehoboam nkyɛn da a otsia ebiasa no, dɛ, mbrɛ ɔhen no kãe no, dɛ, da a otsia ebiasa no, hom mbra me nkyɛn bio no.
Na ɔhen no buaa ɔman no ebufuw mu, na ɔpoow nkɔdaa no hɔn apam a wɔdze maa no no;

na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ mberantsɛ no hɔn apam no tse, dɛ, m’egya yɛɛ hom kɔndua durdur, na emidze mobɔto hom kɔndua do; m’egya dze mpire tsēaa hom, na emidze medze nyankoma-nketsebowa mebɛtsēa hom.
Nna ɔhen no enntsie ɔman no; osiandɛ ɔyɛ adze a ofi Ewuradze hɔ bae, ama ɔaama n’asɛm a Ewuradze nam Shilonnyi Ahijah nsa do kãa kyerɛɛ Nebat ba Jeroboam no etsim.

Na aber a Israel nyinara hun dɛ ɔhen no enntsie hɔn no, ɔman no buaa ɔhen no dɛ, ebɛn kyɛpɛn na yɛwɔ wɔ David mu? Nkyii so yennyi egyapadze wɔ Jesse ne ba no mu: Israel e, hom nkɔ hom asesee mu oo: Afei David, hwɛ wankasa wo fie. Nna Israel sii mu kɔr hɔn asesee mu.
Na Israelmba a wɔtsetse Judah nkurow mu no dze, Rehoboam dzii hɔn do hen.
Nna ɔhen Rehoboam somaa Adoram a ɔhwɛ ɔtowyi edwuma do no; na Israel nyinara siiw no abo, ma ɔtɔree. Na ɔhen Rehoboam yɛɛ ntsɛm foow ne tseaseanam dɛ oruguan akɔ Jerusalem.
Nna Israel tseew etūa wɔ David fi do, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Israel nyinara tsee dɛ Jeroboam asan no, nna wɔsomae ma wokehyiaa no ma ɔbaa mboanofo no nkyɛn, na wɔhyɛɛ no hen wɔ Israel nyinara do: Obiara nnyi hɔ a odzii David fi ekyir, gyedɛ Judah ebusuakuw nko.

Na aber a Rehoboam baa Jerusalem no, ɔboaboaa Judah ofi nyinara, na Benjamin ebusuakuw ano, nyimpa a wɔasan mu eyi mpemɔhaeduowɔtwe a wɔyɛ akofo ano, dɛ ɔnye Israel fi rokɔkõ, adan ahendzi no ama Solomon ne ba Rehoboam bio.
Na Nyankopɔn n’asɛm baa Nyame nyimpa Shemaiah nkyɛn, dɛ,
Kã kyerɛ Solomon ne ba Rehoboam, Judahhen, na Judah na Benjamin fi nyinara, na ɔman nkaa no, dɛ,

mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, mma hom mmfow nnkɔ, nkyii so mma wɔnnye hom nuanom Israelmba nnkɔkõ: Nyimpa biara nsan nkɔ ne fie; na asɛm no fir mara. Nna wotsiee Ewuradze n’asɛm no, na wɔsanee kɔr hɔn kwan, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n’asɛm no tse.
Nna Jeroboam kyekyeer Shechem wɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu, na ɔtsenaa mu; na ofii hɔ kɔree kɛkyekyeer Penuel.
Na Jeroboam see n’akoma mu dɛ, afei na ahendzi no bɛsan akɔ David fie:
Sɛ ɔman yi fow kɔ kɔbɔ afɔr wɔ Ewuradze fie wɔ Jerusalem a, ɔno nna ɔman yi akoma bɛdan akɔ hɔn wura nkyɛn bio, mekyerɛ Judahhen Rehoboam a; na woeku me, na wɔasan akɔ Judahhen Rehoboam nkyɛn.
Nna ɔhen no faa apam, na ɔyɛɛ sika anantwimba ebien; na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔdɔɔ sõ dodow ma hom dɛ hom bɔfow akɔ Jerusalem; Israel, hwɛ w’enyame a wɔdze wo fi Egypt asaase do bae.
Na ɔdze kor kesii Beth-el, na ɔdze kor so kesii Dan.
Na asɛm yi daan bɔn: Osiandɛ ɔman no kɔree kɔsoom kor enyim araa dze kɔr Dan.
Na ɔyɛɛ mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do adan, na ɔhyɛɛ ɔman no nyinara mu binom a wommfi Levimba mu asɔfo.

Na Jeroboam hyehyɛɛ afahyɛ wɔ bosoom a otsīa awɔtwe no mu wɔ bosoom no ne da a otsīa duenum no do, ɔtse dɛ afahyɛ a ɔwɔ Judah no, na ɔfowee kɔr afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn; dɛmara na ɔyɛe no wɔ Beth-el, ɔbɔɔ afɔr maa anantwimba a ɔyɛe no: Na ɔdze mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do asɔfo a ɔyɛe no guu Beth-el.

Na ɔfowee kɔr afɔrmbukyia no a ɔyɛe no wɔ Beth-el wɔ bosoom a otsīa awɔtwe no mu da a otsia duenum no, mekyerɛ bosoom a ɔbɔɔ nankasa ne tsirmu hyɛe no mu a: Na ɔhyehyɛɛ afahyɛ maa Israelmba no, na ɔfowee kɔr afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn dɛ ɔrekɛhyew eduhuam.
13: Na, hwɛ, Nyame nyimpa bi fi Judah nam Ewuradze n'asɛm do baa Beth-el; na Jeroboam gyina afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn dɛ ɔrebɛhyew eduhuam.

Na ɔnam Ewuradze n'asɛm do tsēatseaa mu tsiaa afɔrmbukyia no, na ɔsee dɛ, afɔrmbukyia e, afɔrmbukyia e, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi oo: Hwɛ, wɔbɔwo ɔba bi ama David fie, ne dzin dze Josiah; na wo do na wɔdze mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do asɔfo a wɔhyew wo do eduhuam bɔbɔ afɔr, na wɔahyew nyimpa mbiew wɔ wo do.
Na ɔmaa asɛnkyerɛdze da no ara, dɛ, iyi nye asɛnkyerɛdze a Ewuradze akã no: Hwɛ, afɔrmbukyia no bɛpaa, na nso a ɔwɔ do no ehue egu.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen no tsee Nyame nyimpa no n’asɛm a ɔtsēatsea mu tsiaa afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ Beth-el no, Jeroboam fi afɔrmbukyia no do tseen ne nsa dɛ, hom nsuo no mu. Na ne nsa no a ɔtseen no wɔ no do no sirenii, ma oenntum anntwe no ekyir ammba noho bio.
Afɔrmbukyia no so paae, na nso no huei fi afɔrmbukyia no do gui dɛ mbrɛ asɛnkye rɛdze a Nyame nyimpa no nam Ewuradze n’asɛm do dze maa no tse no.

Na ɔhen no buae see Nyame nyimpa no dɛ, afei serɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn n’adom, na bɔ mpaa ma me, ma me nsa nsan n’ananmu mma me bio. Na Nyame nyimpa no serɛɛ Ewuradze, na ɔhen no ne nsa saan n’ananmu maa no bio, na ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ nkan no ɔtse no ara.
Na ɔhen no see Nyame nyimpa no dɛ, bɛsen nye me nkɔ fie, na kɔdwedwe woho, na mebɛkyɛ wo adze.
Na Nyame nyimpa no see ɔhen no dɛ, sɛ ebɛma me wo fi fã mpo a, mennkɛnye wo akɔ, nkyii so mirinndzi edziban na so moronnom nsu wɔ ha yi:
Na dɛm na ɔnam Ewuradze n'asɛm do wɔdze hyɛɛ me, dɛ, mma nndzi edziban, na so nnom nsu, nkyii so nsan mmfa ɔkwan a enam do bae no.
Nna osii ɔkwan fofor do kɔree, na ɔannsan ammfa ɔkwan a ɔnam do baa Beth-el no do.

Afei nkɔnhyɛnyi akɔdaa bi tse Beth-el; na ne mbabanyin no mu baako bae bɛkãa dwuma a Nyame nyimpa no bedzii no wɔ Beth-el da no nyinara kyerɛɛ no: Nsɛm a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no, so wɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn egya.
Na hɔn egya see hɔn dɛ, ɔkwan mmuana do na ɔfae? Afei ne mbabanyin no hun ɔkwan kor a Nyame nyimpa no a ofi Judah bae no dze faa do.
Na ɔsee ne mbabanyin no dɛ, hom nhyehyɛ asoaso no mma me. Nna wɔhyehyɛɛ asoaso no maa no: Na ɔtsenaa do.
Na otsiiw Nyame nyimpa no, na ɔkɔtoo no dɛ ɔtse esudur bi ase: Na ɔsee no dɛ, ana ɔwo nye Nyame nyimpa a ofi Judah bae no? Na ɔsee dɛ, Emi a.
Nna ɔsee no dɛ, bɛsen nye me nkɔ fie nkedzidzi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, murunntum menye wo nnsan, na so merennye wo nkɔ: Nkyii so mirinndzi edziban na so menye wo ronnom nsu wɔ ha yi:
Osiandɛ wɔnam Ewuradze n’asɛm do see me dɛ, mma nndzi edziban na so nnom nsu wɔ hɔ, na so nndan mmfa ɔkwan a enam do bae no do bio.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, emi so nkɔnhyɛnyi nye me dɛ ɔwoara; na ɔbɔfo bi nam Ewuradze n’asɛm do kãa kyerɛɛ me dɛ, fa no san ma ɔnye wo mbra wo fie, ma ombedzidzi na ɔnnom nsu. Na odzii ator kyerɛɛ no.
Nna ɔnye no sanee kɔree, na okedzii edziban wɔ ne fie, na ɔnoom nsu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔtse pon ho no, Ewuradze n’asɛm baa nkɔnhyɛnyi no a ɔdze no sanee bae no nkyɛn:

Na ɔtsēatseaa mu kyerɛɛ Nyame nyimpa no a ofi Judah bae no, dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, susuampa dɛ ɔwo ayɛ asoɔdzen wɔ Ewuradze n’anosɛm ho, na enndzi mbrasɛm a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze hyɛɛ wo no do,
na asan aba ebedzi edziban na anom nsu wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔsee wo dɛ, mma nndzi edziban, na nnom nsu no ntsi; wo fun ronnkɔ w’egyanom hɔn asamandan mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, odzii edziban, na ɔnomee n’ekyir no, ɔhyehyɛɛ asoaso no maa nkɔnhyɛnyi no a ɔkɛsaan no bae no.
Na aber a ɔkɔree no, gyata hyiaa no ɔkwan no mu, na okum no: Na no fun da kwan no mu, na asoaso no gyina ho; gyata no so gyina fun no ho.
Na, hwɛ, nyimpa twaa mu, na wohun fun no a ɔda ɔkwan no mu, na gyata a ogyina fun no ho no: Na wɔbaa bɛkãa no wɔ kurow no mu mbrɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi akɔdaa no tse no.

Na aber a nkɔnhyɛnyi no a ɔdze no sanee fii ɔkwan no do bae no tsee no ɔsee dɛ, Nyame nyimpa a ɔyɛɛ asoɔdzen wɔ Ewuradze n’anomu asɛm ho no a: Dɛm, ntsi na Ewuradze eyi no ama gyata no ma ɔatsetsew no ekum no, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n’asɛm a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ no no tse no.
Na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ ne mbabanyin no dɛ, hom nhyehyɛ asoaso no mma me. Na wɔhyehyɛɛ no.
Na osii mu kɔree na okohun no fun no dɛ ɔda ɔkwan no mu, na asoaso no na gyata no gyinagyina fun no ho; gyata no enndzi fun no, na so ɔanntsetsew asoaso no mu.
Na nkɔnhyɛnyi no maa Nyame nyimpa no no fun no do, na ɔdze too asoaso no do, na ɔdze no sanee bae: Na ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi akɔdaa no no kurow no mu, dɛ oribegyam no na oesie no.
Na ɔdze no fun no too nankasa n’adakamaa mu; na wogyaam no dɛ, ebei, mo nua!
Na ɔbaa dɛ, osiee no n’ekyir no ɔkãa kyerɛɛ ne mbabanyin no dɛ, sɛ muwu a, ɔno wonsie me wɔ asamandan a woesie Nyame nyimpa no wɔ mu no mu; wɔmfa me mbiew ngu ne mbiew nkyɛn.
Osiandɛ asɛm a ɔnam Ewuradze n’asɛm do tsēatseaa mu tsiaa afɔrmbukyia no wɔ Beth-el na mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm efiefi nyinara a ɔwɔ Samaria nkurow mu no, ɔbɛba mu ampa.

Asɛm yi ekyir no Jeroboam annsan emmfi no kwan bɔn do, na oyii ɔman no nyinara mu binom yɛɛ hɔn mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do asɔfo bio: Obiara a ɔpɛ no, na ɔatsew no ho, ma ɔaayɛ mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm no do hɔ asɔfo.
Na asɛm yi bɛyɛɛ bɔn wɔ Jeroboam fie dɛ wobotwa no akyɛn, na wɔasɛɛ no efi asaase enyi.
14: Aber no mu no Jeroboam ne ba Abijah yaree.
Na Jeroboam see ne yer dɛ, meserɛ wo, Soɛr, na sakyer woho amma woeennhu wo dɛ eyɛ Jeroboam ne yer: Na kɔ Shiloh; hwɛ, hɔ na nkɔnhyɛnyi Ahijah a ɔkãa no wɔ mo ho dɛ mibedzi hen wɔ ɔman yi do no wɔ.
Na fa boodoo ntɔwmu du, na tatarmba, na ewo pɔr kitsa, na kɔ ne nkyɛn: Ɔno na ɔbɛkã dza ɔbɛba abofra no do akyerɛ wo.
Na Jeroboam ne yer no yɛɛ dɛm, na ɔsoɛree na osii mu kɔr Shiloh, na ɔbaa Ahijah fie. Afei Ahijah nnhu adze, na no nkɔdaayɛ ntsi n’enyiwa ayɛ kusukusu.
Na Ewuradze see Ahijah dɛ, hwɛ, Jeroboam ne yer reba wo hɔ ebebisa wo hɔ adze wɔ ne ba ho, na ɔyar: Dɛm na dɛm na kã kyerɛ no: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ ɔba a, obepetuw ayɛ noho dɛ ɔbaa fofor bi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ahijah tsee n’ananadze nka dɛ ɔaba abow no ano no, ɔsee dɛ, bra, ɔwo Jeroboam ne yer; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na epetuw ayɛ woho dɛ obi yi? Na wɔdze nsɛm durdur asoma me wo hɔ.
Kɔ, kɛkã kyerɛ Jeroboam dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Susuampa dɛ memaa wo do wɔ ɔman no mu, na mehyɛɛ wo ɔpanyin wɔ me man Israel do,
na metseew ahendzi no mifii David fie, na medze memaa wo: Naaso ɔwo annyɛ de m’akowaa David a odzii me mbransɛm do, na ɔdze n’akoma nyinara dzii m’ekyir, dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dza ɔtsen nko wɔ m’enyiwa do;
na ɔwo ayɛ bɔn asen hɔn a wodzi w’enyim nyinara, na akɔ akɛyɛ enyame fofor, na ehonyi a woegu ama wo ho, dɛ edze riyi me ebufuw, na atow me akyen w’ekyir:

Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, medze mbusu mebɛba Jeroboam fi do, na metwa Jeroboam mu abofra banyin biara akyen, Israel mu nyia wɔatow no mu na nyia woegyaa no, na mapra Jeroboam fie sɛsɛɛsɛ, dɛ mbrɛ obi pra efikyir, ma ne nyinara asã ana.
Nyia ofi Jeroboam mu a obowu wɔ kurow mu no, nkraman bedzi; na nyia obowu wɔ haban mu no wimu ntumbowa bedzi, na Ewuradze na ɔakã yi.
Dɛm ntsi soɛr, kɔ wo fie: Na sɛ w’anan si kurow no mu ara a, abofra no bowu.
Na Israel nyinara begyam no, na woesie no: Na ɔno nko na ofi Jeroboam mu a ɔbɔkɔ adakamaa mu: Osiandɛ ɔno no mu na woehuadze pa bi wo Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, afamu, wɔ Jeroboam fie.
Nkyii so Ewuradze bɛma ɔhen bi do ama noho wɔ Israel a da no obotwa Jeroboam fi akyen: Na ebɛnadze a? Seseiara mpo.

Na Ewuradze bɔbɔ Israel, dɛ mbrɛ ndzɛmbir hihim wɔ nsu mu; na oetutu Israel efi asaase pa a ɔdze maa hɔn egyanom yi do, na ɔabɔ hɔn apetse Esutsen no n’egya; osiandɛ wɔayɛ hɔn Asherim dze eyi Ewuradze ebufuw.
Na osian Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔayɛ na ɔdze ama Israel ayɛ bɔn no ntsi, obegyaa Israel mu ama.
Na Jeroboam ne yer no soɛree sii mu, na ɔbaa Tirzah: Na obodur ofi no n’apondua ase dze no do ara nna abofra no wui.
Na Israel nyinara siee no, na wogyaam no; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n’asɛm a ɔnam n’akowaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Ahijah ne nsa do kãe no tse no.
Na Jeroboam no ho nsɛm nkaa no, mbrɛ osii dzii akõ, na mbrɛ osii dzii hen no, hwɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na nda a Jeroboam dze dzii hen yɛ mfe eduonu ebien: Na ɔnye n’egyanom kɛdae, na ne babanyin Nadab na ɔhyɛɛ n’ananmu dzii hen.

Na Solomon ne ba Rehoboam dzii hen wɔ Judah. Rehoboam hyɛɛ ase dzii hen no, nna oedzi mfe eduanan biako, na odzii hen mfe duesuon wɔ Jerusalem, kurow a Ewuradze saan mu yii no wɔ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu dɛ ɔdze no dzin bɔto hɔ no mu: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Naamah, Ammonnyi a.
Na Judah yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do; na wɔdze hɔn bɔn a wɔyɛe no yii no nyinkun seen dza hɔn egyanom yɛe no nyinara.
Osiandɛ hɔn so wɔyeyɛɛ mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm, na edum, na Asherim, wɔ koko tsentsen biara do, na dua momon biara ase maa hɔnho;
na sodomfo so wɔ asaase no do: Wɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ amanaman a Ewuradze tui wɔ Israelmba enyim no hɔn ekyiwadze nyinara tse.
Na ɔba dɛ, ɔhen Rehoboam n’afe a otsīa enum no mu no, Egypthen Shishak fowee baa Jerusalem do:
Na ɔfaa Ewuradze ne fie akoradze, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze no; ɔfaa ne nyinara kwa dze kɔree: Na ɔfaa sika akyɛm a Solomon yɛe no nyinara dze kɔree.
Na ɔhen Rehoboam yɛɛ boran akyɛm dze sisii hɔn ananmu, na ɔdze hyɛɛ abrampɔfo a wɔhwɛ ɔhen no ne fie abowano no do asafohemfo no nsa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, mber dodow biara a ɔhen no kɔ Ewuradze ne fie no abrampɔfo no susuo mu, na wɔdze san besi abrampɔfo pia mu.
Afei Rehoboam no ho nsɛm nkaa, na dza ɔyɛe no nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judah ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na akodzi daa Rehoboam na Jeroboam ntamu daa.
Na Renoboam nye n’egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no wɔ n’egyanom nkyɛn wɔ David kurow no mu: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Naamah, Ammonnyi a, na ne babanyin Abijam dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
15: Afei Nebat ne ba ɔhen Jeroboam n'afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu nna Abijam hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Judah do.
Mfe ebiasa na ɔdze dzii hen wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Maacah, Abishalom ne babaa a.
Na ɔnantsewee wɔ n’egya no bɔn a ɔyɛe no wɔ n'enyim no nyinara mu: Na n’akoma enndzi mu wɔ Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn ho, dɛ n’egya David n’akoma.
Naaso osian David ntsi na Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn maa kandzea wɔ Jerusalem, dɛ ɔbɛma ne ba do esi hɔ wɔ n’ekyir, na ɔama Jerusalem etsim:
Osiandɛ David yɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do, na oemmfi adze biara a ɔhyɛɛ no no ho ɔanndan ammfa nkyɛn wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu, gyedɛ Hittinyi Uriah asɛm no nko mu.
Afei akodzi daa Rehoboam na Jeroboam ntamu wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu.
Na Abijam no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe no nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judah ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu a? Na akodzi daa Abijam na Jeroboam ntamu.
Na Abijam nye n’egyanom kɛdae; na wosiee no wɔ David kurow no mu: Na ne babanyin Asa na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
Na Israelhen Jeroboam n’afe a otsia eduonu no mu na Asa hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Judah do.
Na mfe eduanan biako na ɔdze dzii hen wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Maacah, Abishalom ne babaa a.
Na Asa yɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya David yɛe.
Na otutuu sodomfo no fii asaase no do, na oyiyii abosom a n’egyanom yɛe no nyinara wɔ hɔ.
Na ne nã Maacah so otuu no do dɛ ɔyɛ ɔhembaa, osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ ekyiwa honyi bi maa Asherah ntsi; na Asa twaa no honyi no, na ɔkɛhyeew no wɔ ɔwora Kidron do.
Na mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm no dze oennyiyi: Naaso Asa n’akoma dzii mu wɔ Ewuradze ho, ne nda nyinara.
Na ɔdze ndzɛmba a n’egya tui sii hɔ, na ndzɛmba a nankasa tui sii hɔ no baa Ewuradze fie, dwetɛ, na sika, na ndzɛmbandzɛmba.
Na akodzi daa Asa Israel hen Baasha ntamu hɔn nda nyinara.
Na Israelhen Baasha fowee kɔr Judah do, na ɔkɛkyekyeer Ramah, dɛ ɔremma kwan ma obiara nndzi ndɔfir wɔ Judahhen Asa nkyɛn.

Nna Asa faa dwetɛ na sika a wogyaa no wɔ Ewuradze ne fie akoradze mu nyinara, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze no, na ɔdze hyɛɛ n’akowaa nsa: Na ɔhen Asa somaa ma wɔdze kɔr Hezion ba Tabrimmon ba Benhadad, Syriahen a ɔtse Damascus no nkyɛn, dɛ,
Nkyekyeree bi da emi na ɔwo ntamu, wɔ m’egya na w’egya ntamu: Hwɛ, mama wɔdze dwetɛ na sika ayɛyɛdze rebrɛ wo; kɔ, kɛtsetsew ɔwo nye Israelhen Baasha nkyekyeree no mu, ma omfi mo do nkɔ.
Na Ben-hadad tsiee ɔhen Asa, na ɔsomaa no dɔm do asafohemfo no wɔ Israel nkurow no do, na ɔbɔɔ Ijon, na Dan, na Abel-beth-maacah, na Chinneroth nyinara, kãa Naphtali asaase nyinara ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Baasha tsee no, ogyaa Ramah kyekyer, na ɔkɛtsenaa Tirzah.
Nna ɔhen Asa maa wɔbɔɔ dawur wɔ Judah nyinara; obiara woennyi no wɔ mu: Na wɔkɔsoaa Ramah abo, na no ho ndua no a Baasha dze kyekyeree no; na ɔhen Asa dze kyekyeer Benjamin Geba, na Mizpah.
Afei Asa no ho nsɛm nyinara, na ne ndam nyinara, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara na nkurow a ɔkyekyeree, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judah ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu a? Na mbom no nkɔdaaber mu no ɔyaar n’anan.
Na Asa nye n’egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no wɔ n’egyanom nkyɛn wɔ n’egya David kurow no mu: Na ne babanyin Jehoshaphat na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
Na Jeroboam ne ba Nadab hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Judahhen Asa n’afe a otsia ebien no mu, na odzii hen wɔ Israel do mfe ebien.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, na ɔnantseew n’egya no kwan, na no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no mu.
Na Ahijah ne ba Baasha a ofi Issachar fie no paam ne tsir do; na Baasha bɔɔ no wɔ Gibbethon a ɔyɛ Philistiafo dze no do; osiandɛ Nadab na Israel nyinara worutua Gibbethon.
Mekyerɛ Judahhen Asa n’afe a otsia ebiasa no mu na Baasha kum no na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.

Na ɔbaa dɛ ntsɛmara a obedzii hen no, nna ɔbɔɔ Jeroboam fi nyinara; oenngyaa obiara a ogu ahom amma Jeroboam dze kodur dɛ ɔsɛɛ no; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n’asɛm a ɔnam n’akowaa Shilohnyi Ahijah n’abaw do kãe no ntsi:
Osian Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔyɛe, na ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no ntsi; osian n'ebufuwyi a ɔdze yii Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn ebufuw no ntsi.
Afei Nadab no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na akodzi daa Asa na Israelhen Baasha ntamu hɔn nda nyinara.
Judahhen Asa n’afe a otsia ebiasa no mu na Ahijah ne babanyin Baasha hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel nyinara do wɔ Tirzah, na odzii hen mfe eduonu anan.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, na ɔnantseew Jeroboam no kwan, na no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no mu.
16: Na Ewuradze n’asɛm baa Hanani ba Jehu nkyɛn tsiaa Baasha, dɛ,
susuampa dɛ memaa wo do fii huntuma mu, na mehyɛɛ wo ɔpanyin wɔ me man Israel do; na ɔwo anantsew Jeroboam no kwan mu, na ama me man Israel ayɛ bɔn, na wɔdze hɔn bɔn eyi me ebufuw ntsi;
hwɛ, mebɛpra Baasha na ne fi korakora; na mebɛyɛ wo fi dɛ Nebat ne ba Jeroboam ne fi.
Nyia ofi Baasha mu a obowu wɔ kurow mu no nkraman bedzi; na nedze mu nyia obowu wɔ haban mu no, wimu ntumbowa bedzi.
Afei Baasha no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe, na ne ndam, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Baasha nye n’egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no Tirzah; na ne babanyin Elah na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.

Na nkyii so Ewuradze n’asɛm nam Hanani ne ba, nkɔnhyɛnyi Jehu n’abaw do bae betsiaa Baasha na ne fi, osian mbusu a ɔbɔɔ no wɔ Ewuradze enyi do nyinara ntsi, dɛ ɔdze ne nsaano edwuma yii no ebufuw yɛɛ dɛ Jeroboam ne fi no, na osiandɛ okum no ntsi.
Judahhen n’afe a otsia eduonu esia no mu na Baasha ne babanyin Elah hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Tirzah, na odzii hen mfe ebien.
Na n’akowaa Zimri, ne ntseaseanam mu fã do safohen no, paam ne tsir do: Na ɔnodze ɔwɔ Tirzah ronom nsã abow wɔ Arza a ɔhwɛ fiefo no do wɔ Tirzah no ne fie:
Na Zimri kɔr mu na ɔkɔbɔɔ no kum no, wɔ Judahhen Asa n’afe a otsia eduonu esuon no mu, na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu,
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase ridzi hen no, ntsɛmara a ɔtsenaa n’ahengua do no, nna okum Baasha fifo nyinara: Oenngyaa no ɔbanyimba kor mpo, n’ebusuafo mu o, ne mfɛfo mu o.
Dɛm na Zimri sɛɛ Baasha fi nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n’asɛm a ɔnam nkɔnhyɛnyi Jehu do kãe tsiaa Baasha no tse no,
wɔ Baasha no bɔn nyinara, na ne ba Elah no bɔn a ɔyɛe, na wɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn, dɛ, wɔdze hɔn egyangyandze yii Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn ebufuw no ntsi.
Afei Elah no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Judahhen Asa n’afe a otsia eduonu esuon no mu na Zimri dzii hen nda esuon wɔ Tirzah. Afei na ɔman no akyer Gibbethon a ɔyɛ Philistiafo dze no ho nsera.
Na ɔman no a wɔakyer nsera no tsee dɛ wɔrese dɛ, Zimri akɔ apam, na so oekum ɔhen no: Dɛm ntsi Israel nyinara dze dɔm do safohen Omri hyɛɛ hen wɔ Israel do da no ara wɔ nsera no mu.
Na Omri fi Gibbethon sii mu kɔree, na Israel nyinara kã no ho, na wokotuaa Tirzah.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Zimri hun dɛ kurow no wɔagye no, nna osii mu kɔr ɔhen no ne fi aban no mu, na ɔdze ogya hyeew ɔhen no ne fi no guu no do, na owui,
osian no bɔn a ɔyɛe dɛ ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, dɛ ɔnantseew Jeroboam kwan mu, na no bɔn a ɔyɛe dze maa Israel yɛ bɔn no mu ntsi.
Afei Zimri no ho nsɛm nkaa no na no nkontompɔ a otwae no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Nna Israelmba no mu paa akyɛkyɛ ebien: Ɔman no mu fã dzii Ginath ne ba Tibni ekyir, dɛ wɔbɛhyɛ no hen: Na ɔfã so dzii Omri ekyir.
Na ɔman no a wodzii Omri ekyir no nsa daa ɔman no a wodzii Ginath ne ba Tibni ekyir no do: Na Tibni wui. na Omri dzii hen.
Judahhen Asa n’afe a otsia eduasa biako no mu na Omri hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do, na odzii hen mfe duebien: Mfe esia na ɔdze dzii hen wɔ Tirzah.
Na ɔkɔtɔɔ Samaria koko wɔ Shemer hɔ maa dwetɛ talent ebien; na ɔkyekyeer koko no do kurow, na ɔdze koko no wura Shemer ne dzin frɛɛ kurow a ɔkyekyeree no ne dzin dɛ Samaria.
Na Omri yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, na ɔyɛɛ emumuyɛdze seen hɔn wodzii n'enyim nyinara
Osiandɛ ɔnantseew Nebat ba Jeroboam no kwan nyinara, na no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no mu, dɛ wɔdze hɔn egyangyandze beyii Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn no ebufuw.
Afei Omri no ho nsɛm nkaaa no, dza ɔyɛe, na ne mbanyinndam a ɔkyerɛe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Nna Omri nye n’egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no wɔ Samaria: Na ne babanyin Ahab dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Na Judahhen Asa n’afe a otsia eduasa awɔtwe no mu Omri ne ba Ahab hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do: Na Omri ne ba Ahab dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Samaria mfe eduonu ebien.
Na Omri ne ba Ahab yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyim seen hɔn a wodzii n’enyim nyinara.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, dɛ gyama ɔyɛ adze harhar ma no dɛ ɔbɛnantsew Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn mu no ntsi, nna ɔfaa Zidonfo hen Ethbaal ne babaa Jezebel ayewar, na osii mu kɔree kɔsoom Baal, na ɔkotoow no.
Na osii afɔrmbukyia maa Baal wɔ Baal fi a osii no wɔ Samaria no mu.
Na Ahab yɛɛ Asherah no; na Ahab daa ho yɛɛ dodow dɛ ɔdze beyi Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no ebufuw seen Israel ahemfo a wodzii n’enyim nyinara.

Ne nda mu na Bethelnyi Heil kyekyeer Jericho: Ɔhweer n’abakan Abiram dze toow ne fapem, na ɔhweer n’abakyiba banyin Segub sisii n’ano mbobotsen; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm a ɔnam Nun ne ba Joshua abaw do kãe no tse.
17: Na Tishbinyi Elijah a ofi Gilead amamforafo mu no, see Ahab dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn a migyma n'enyim tse ase yi, ɔbɔsu anaaso nyankom ronntɔ mfe yi mu, gyedɛ ɔnam m'asɛm do.
Na Ewuradze n’asɛm baa ne nkyɛn dɛ,
fi ha fir, na dan kɔ boka afamu, na fa woho kosuma ɔwora Cherith a ɔwɔ Jordan enyim no ho.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, ebɔnom ɔwora no mu nsu bi: Na mahyɛ nkonkoran dɛ wɔnnyɛn wo hɔ.
Nna osii mu kɔree kɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm tse: Osiandɛ osii mu kɔree kɛtsenaa ɔwora Cherith a ɔwɔ Jordan enyim no ho
Na nkonkoran no brɛɛ no boodoo na nam anapa, na boodoo na nam ewimbir; na ɔnoom ɔwora no mu nsu bi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔkyɛɛr kakra no, ɔwora no wewee, osiandɛ nyankom nntɔ asaase no do.
Na Ewuradze n’asɛm baa ne nkyɛn, dɛ,
soɛr, kɔ Zarephath a ɔyɛ Zidon dze no, na kɛtsena hɔ: Hwɛ, mahyɛ ɔbaa kunafo bi wɔ hɔ dɛ ɔmbɔ wo akɔhoma.
Nna ɔsoɛree sii mu kɔr Zarephath; na odur kurow no mu kuropon ano no, hwɛ, ɔbaa kunafo bi wɔ hɔ retaatar mbabaaba: Na ɔfrɛɛ no see dɛ, meserɛ wo, kɛsaw nsu kakra gu kuraba mu brɛ me: Na monnom.
Na ɔrokɔ akɛsaw no, ɔfrɛɛ no, na ɔsee dɛ, meserɛ wo, fa boodoo trɔma bi kitsa wo nsamu brɛ me.

Na ɔsee dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn tse ase yi, minnyi tatar biara, gyedɛ isiam nsapuw bi a ɔwɔ barba mu, na ngo kakra a ɔwɔ pɔr mu; na, hwɛ, meretaatar mbabaaba ebien bi, ma maakɔ mekesiesie ama mara na me ba, ma yeedzi na yeewu.
Na Elijah see no dɛ, mma nnsuro; kɔ kɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ase no: Mbom dzi kan yɛ bi tatar kakra ma me, na fa brɛ me, na n’ekyir no ayɛ ɔwo na wo ba dze.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi, Isiam barba no ronnhwer, nkyii so ngo kuraba no rennsã, dze ekodu da a Ewuradze bɛma nyankom atɔ egu asaase do.
Na osii mu kɔree kɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Elijah n’asɛm no tse: Na ɔno, na ɔno, na ne fie dzii no nda pii.
Isiam barba no annhwer, nkyii so ngo pɔr no annsã, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n’asɛm a ɔnam Elijah do kãe no tse no ara.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, nsɛm yi ekyir no, ɔbaa ofiwura no ne babanyin yaree; na ne yarba no mu yɛɛ dzen dodoodow, ma ahom biara annka no mu.
Na ɔsee Elijah dɛ, ɔwo Nyame nyimpa, ebɛnadze na menye wo wɔ yɛ? Ɔwo aba me nkyɛn dɛ edze mo bɔn reba nkaa mu, na eku me ba!
Na ɔsee no dɛ, fa wo ba no ma me. Na oyii no fii no bo mu, na ɔmaa no do kɔr pia mu, mbrɛ ɔtse no, na ɔdze no kɔtoo nankasa ne mpa do.
Na ɔtsēaa mu frɛɛ Ewuradze see dɛ, Ewuradze, me Nyankopɔn e, ana edze mbusu aba okunafo yi so a mabɔsoɛ ne nkyɛn yi do, dɛ iruboku ne ba?
Na ɔtseen no mu butuuw abofra no do mpɛn ebiasa, na ɔtsēaa mu frɛɛ Ewuradze see dɛ, Ewuradze, me Nyankopɔn e, meserɛ wo, ma abofra yi ne kra mbra no mu bio.
Na Ewuradze tsiee Elijah ne ndze: Na abofra no ne kra baa no mu bio, na onyaa nkwa.
Na Elijah faa abofra no na ɔdze no fi pia no mu sianee baa ɔdan no mu, na ɔdze no maa ne nã: Na Elijah see dɛ, hwɛ, wo ba enya nkwa.
Na ɔbaa no see Elijah dɛ, afei na mehu dɛ Nyame nyimpa nye wo, na Ewuradze n'asɛm a ɔwɔ w'anomu yɛ nokwar.
18: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda pii n'ekyir no, Ewuradze n'asɛm baa Elijah nkyɛn, wɔ afe a otsia ebiasa no mu, dɛ, kɔ, keyi woho kyerɛ Ahab; na mebɛma nyamkom atɔ egu asaase do.
Na Elijah sii mu kɔr dɛ orikeyi noho akyerɛ Ahab. Na ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ Samaria.
Na Ahab frɛɛ Obadiah a ɔhwɛ fidua no do no. (Afei Obadiah suro Ewuradze dɛ:
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jezebel rutwitwa Ewuradze no nkɔnhyɛfo no egu no, Obadiah faa nkɔnhyɛfo ɔha, na ɔdze hɔn eduonum eduonum kosumasumaa ɔbo-tu mu, na ɔdze edziban na nsu hwɛɛ hɔn).
