Na Ahab see Obadiah dɛ, kɔ, kekyin asaase no mu, nsubura nyinara, na nwora nyinara ho: Ibi a yebenya nkyɛkyɛr bi dze agye mpɔnkɔ na nsoaso-mponkɔ no nkwa, ma yɛannhwer mbowa no nyinara.
Nna wɔkyɛɛ asaase no mu maa hɔnho dɛ worikekyin do: Ahab nanko faa ɔkwan kor do, na Obadiah nanko so faa ɔkwan kor so do.
Na Obadiah wɔ ɔkwan no mu no, hwɛ, Elijah nye no hyiae: Na ohun no, na ɔdze n'enyim butuuw famu, na ɔsee dɛ, ana ɔwo mo wura Elijah nye no a?
Na obuaa dɛ, emi nye no: Kɔ, kɛkã kyerɛ wo wura dɛ, hwɛ, Elijah wɔ ha.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ebɛnadze mu na mayɛ bɔn, ma ɔwo epɛ dɛ iyi w’akowaa hyɛ Ahab nsa, dɛ onku me yi?
Dɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn tse ase yi, ɔman biara, anaa ahenman biara nnyi hɔ a mo wura nnsomae ma wɔnnkɔr hɔ nnkɔhwehwɛɛ wo: Na sɛ wɔse dɛ, onnyi ha a ɔma ahenman no na ɔman no kã ntam dɛ wonnhun wo.
Na afei ɔwo ese dɛ, Kɔ, kɛkã kyerɛ wo wura dɛ, hwɛ, Elijah wɔ ha.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ mefi wo nkyɛn mokɔ ara a, nkyɛ Ewuradze no sunsum no ehwim wo akɔ beebi mbrɛ minnyim; na dɛm ntsi sɛ mokɔ kɛkã kyerɛ Ahab, na oennhu wo a, oboku me: Na emi, w'akowaa dze, mifi me mberantse mu ara musuro Ewuradze .

Ana wɔnnkãa dza aber a Jezebel rukuku Ewuradze no nkɔnhyɛfo no meyɛe no nnkyerɛɛ mo wura, mbrɛ misii na mefaa Ewuradze no nkɔnhyɛfo no mu mbarimba ɔha, na medze hɔn eduonum eduonum kosumasumaa obo-tu mu, na medze edziban na nsu mohwɛɛ hɔn no?
Na afei ɔwo ese dɛ, kɔ, kɛkã kyerɛ wo wura dɛ, hwɛ, Elijah wɔ ha: Na oboku me.
Na Elijah see dɛ, dɛ dɔm Ewuradze a migyina n’enyim tse ase yi, ampa mibeyi moho makyerɛ no ndɛ da yi.
Nna Obadiah sii mu kɔree kehyiaa Ahab na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ no: Na Ahab kɔree kehyiaa Elijah.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ahab hun Elijah no, Ahab see no dɛ, ana ɔwo nye no, ɔwo Israel no fonafo nye no?
Na obuaa dɛ, emi mommfonaa Israel; mbom ɔwoara, na w’egya fie a, wɔ dɛ hom apow Ewuradze ne mbransɛm, na ɔwo ekedzi Baalim ekyir.
Dɛm ntsi afei soma na wɔnkɔboaboa Israel nyinara ano mbrɛ me wɔ bepɔw Carmel do, na Baal nkɔnhyɛfo ahaanan eduonum no, na Asherah nkɔnhyɛfo ahaanan a wodzidzi Jezebel no pon do no.
Nna Ahab somae ma wɔkɔr Israelmba no nyinara mu, na wɔkɔboaboaa nkɔnhyɛfo no ano kɔr Carmel bepɔw do.

Na Elijah baa ɔman no nyinara nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, hom rigyina adwen ebien ntamu ma ekodu dabɛn? Sɛ Ewuradze nye Nyankopɔn a, hom ndzi n’ekyir: Sɛ Baal so a, ɔno hom ndzi n’ekyir. Na ɔman no emmbua no asɛm biara.
Nna Elijah see ɔman no dɛ, emi, manko ara nye Ewuradze no nkɔnhyɛnyi a ɔaka; na Baal nkɔnhyɛfo dze wɔyɛ mbarimba ahaanan eduonum.

Dɛm ntsi ma wɔmma hɛn anantwi ebien; na ma wɔnsan mu nyi nantwisaa kor mma hɔnho, na wombɔ no epruw, na wɔmfa ngu nyena no do, na mma wɔmmfa gya nngu ase: Na mo so mibesiesie nantwisaa kor no, na medze megu nyena no do, na meremmfa gya nngu ase.
Na hom mfrɛ hom nyame ne dzin, na mo so mebɛfrɛ Ewuradze ne dzin: Na onyame a ɔdze gya bɛgya do no, wɔmma ɔno nyɛ Nyankopɔn. Na ɔman no nyinara buae see dɛ, wɔakã no yie.
Na Elijah see Baal nkɔnhyɛfo no dɛ, hom nsan mu nyi nantwisaa kor mma homho, na hom ndzi kan nsiesie no; osiandɛ hom dɔɔ sõ; na hom mfrɛ hom nyame ne dzin, mbom mma wɔmmfa gya nngu ase.

Na wɔfaa nantwisaa no a wɔdze maa hɔn no, na wosiesiei, na wɔfrɛɛ Baal ne dzin fi anapa araa kodur wigyinae dɛ, Baal e, tsie hɛn, na ndze bi nnyi hɔ, na nyia ɔgye do biara so nnyi hɔ. Na wohuruhuruwii kyiin afɔrmbukyia no a wɔyɛe no ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ wigyinae no, Elijah sii hɔn atwetwe see dɛ, hom mfa ndze kɛse ntsēa mu: Na ɔyɛ nyame; sisei ɔrodwen, anaa oefir edzi, anaa oetu kwan, anaa ibi a ɔada, otwar dɛ wonyan no.
Na wɔtsēaa mu kɛse, na wɔdze asekan na nkambaa twitwaa hɔnho dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ tse no, kodur dɛ bɔgya sɔɔn hɔn ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wigyinae twaa mu no, wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm araa kodur dɛ ɔrokɔ ewimbir afɔr no bɔber; na ndze biara nnyi hɔ, na nyia ɔgye do so nnyi hɔ, na obiara so nnyi hɔ a ɔhwɛ.
Na Elijah see ɔman no nyinara dɛ, hom ntwe mpin me; na ɔman no nyinara twee piin no. Na ɔyɛɛ Ewuradze afɔrmbukyia a ebubu no yie.
Na Elijah faa abo duebien, dɛ mbrɛ Jacob ne mba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw no dodow tse, ɔno a Ewuradze n’asɛm baa ne nkyɛn dɛ, Israel nye wo dzin no.
Na ɔdze abo no sii afɔrmbukyia wɔ Ewuradze ne dzin mu; na ɔtwaa ɔkã a obedzi aba a wogu etwadze ebien wɔ afɔrmbukyia no ho hyiae.
Na osiesiee nyena no, na otwitwaa nantwisaa no epruw, na wɔdze guu enyena no do. Na ɔsee dɛ, hom mfa nsu nhyehyɛ mbarba anan amaama, na wonhue ngu ɔhyewafɔr, na nyena no do.
Na ɔsee dɛ, hom nyɛ no mprɛnu; na wɔyɛɛ no mprɛnu. Na ɔsee dɛ, hom nyɛ no mprɛnsa, na wɔyɛɛ no mprɛnsa.
Na nsu no peem afɔrmbukyia no ho hyiae; na ɔdze nsu hyɛɛ ɔkã no so mã.

Na ɔbaa dɛ ewimbir afɔr no bɔber mu no, nkɔnhyɛnyi Elijah twee pinii, na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, Abraham, Isaac na Israel Nyankopɔn, ndɛ da yi ma wonhu dɛ ɔwoara nye Nyankopɔn wɔ Israel mu, na emi nye w'akowaa, na mayɛ ndzɛmba yi nyinara wɔ w'asɛm do.
Tsie me, Ewuradze tsie me, ma ɔman yi eehu dɛ ɔwoara, Ewuradze nye Nyankopɔn, na ɔwoara adan hɔn akoma asan aba bio.
Nna Ewuradze ne gya dwirii, na ɔbɛhyeew ɔhyew-afɔr no, na nyena no, na abo na dɛtse no, na ɔtafeer nsu a ɔwɔ ɔkã no mu no.
Na aber a ɔman no nyinara hunii no, wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu: Na wɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, ɔno nye Nyankopɔn; Ewuradze, ɔno nye Nyankopɔn.
Na Elijah see hɔn dɛ, hom nkyer Baal no nkɔnhyɛfo no; mma hom mma hɔn mu kor mpo mmfi nsa. Na wɔkyeer hɔn: Na Elijah dze hɔn sianee baa ɔwora Kishon ho, na okum hɔn wɔ hɔ.
Na Elijah see Ahab dɛ, fow kɔ, kedzidzi na nom; na matse nyankom kɛse nka.
Nna Ahab sii mu kɔr dɛ orikedzidzi na ɔanom. Na Elijah sii mu kɔr Carmel n’etsifi; na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ famu, na ɔdze n’enyim hyɛɛ n’anankoroma ntamu.
Na ɔsee n’akowaa dɛ, afei fow kɔ, kɔhwɛ pomu afamu. Na ɔfowee kɔree kɔhwɛe, na ɔsee dɛ, hwee nnyi hɔ. Na ɔsee dɛ, kɔ bio mpɛn esuon.
Na ɔbaa dɛ otsia esuon no, nna ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, mununkum bi fi pomu rosoɛr a osuar dɛ nyimpa ne nsakum. Na ɔsee dɛ, fow kɔ kɛse Ahab dɛ, siesie wo tseaseanam, na sian, ma nyankom no eennsiw wo kwan.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔkyɛɛr kakraabi no, na mununkum na mframa ebir ɔsor tumm, na nyankom kɛse tɔree. Na Ahab tutui kɔr Jezreel.
Na Ewuradze ne nsa baa Elijah do; na ɔbɔɔ n’asen do, na otuu mbirika dzii Ahab enyim kodur Jezreel ahɛnee.
19: Na Ahab kãa dza Elijah yɛe no nyinara kyerɛɛ Jezebel, na mbrɛ osii dze afõwa kum nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara.
Nna Jezebel somaa ɔbɔfo ma ɔkɔr Elijah nkyɛn dɛ, dɛm na enyame no nyɛ me, na bi so nkã ho, sɛ ɔkyena sisei na mamma wo nkwa annyɛ dɛ hɔn mu baako no nkwa a.
Na ohunii no, na no nkwa ntsi, ɔsoɛree sii mu kɔree, na okodur Beer-sheba a ɔyɛ Judah dze no, na ogyaa n’akowaa no wɔ hɔ.

Na ɔno noara dze osii mu kɔr sar no do da kor kwan, na ɔkɔree kɛtsenaa juniper dua bi ase: Na ɔserɛe maa noho dɛ nkyɛ onwu; na ɔsee dɛ, ayɛ yie; afei Ewuradze, yi mo nkwa; na minnye mennsen m'egyanom.
Na ɔdaa famu dae wɔ juniper dua bi ase; na, hwɛ, ɔbɔfo bi kãa no, na ɔsee no dɛ, soɛr dzidzi.
Na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, tatar a wɔatõ no wɔ gyansenama do, na nsu kuraba si n’etsifi. Na odzidzii na ɔnomee, na ɔdaa famu bio.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no baa bio otsia mpɛn ebien no, bɛkãa no see dɛ, soɛr dzidzi; na akwantu no war dodow ma wo.
Na ɔsoɛree, dzidzii na ɔnomee, na ɔnantsewee wɔ edziban no n’ahoɔdzen mu kɔr Nyankopɔn ne bepɔw Horeb ho adaduanan, adzekyee na adzesaa.
Na ɔbaa hɔ ɔbo-tu bi ho, na ɔsoɛɛ hɔ; na, hwɛ, Ewuradze n’asɛm baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, Elijah, ereyɛ ebɛnadze wɔ ha?

Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, dɔm Nyankopɔn ho nyinkun na matwe; osiandɛ Israelmba apow w’ahyɛmu, woedwurudwuruw w’afɔrmbukyia, na wɔdze afõwa ekuku wo nkɔnhyɛfo: Na emi, emi ara nko, na maka; na wɔrohwehwɛ mo nkwa, woeeyi no hɔ.

Na ɔsee dɛ, Pue kɔ, na kegyina bepɔw no do wɔ Ewuradze enyim. Na, hwɛ, Ewuradze botwaa mu, na mframa kɛse dzendzen paapaa mbepɔw mu, na obubuu abotan mu esinesin dzii Ewuradze enyim; na Ewuradze nnyi mframa no mu: Na mframa no ekyir asaasewosow a; na Ewuradze nnyi asaasewosow no mu:
Na asaasewosow no ekyir ogya a; na Ewuradze nnyi ogya no mu: Na ogya no ekyir ndze bɔkɔɔ bi a.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Elijah tsee no, ɔdze n’akatakɔnmu no kataa n’enyim, na opuei kegyinaa ɔbo-tu no n'ahɛnee. Na hwɛ, ndze bi baa ne nkyɛn, see dɛ, Elijah, ereyɛ ebɛnadze wɔ ha?

Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, dɔm Nyankopɔn ho nyinkun na matwe; na Israelmba apow w’ahyɛmu, woedwurudwuruw w’afɔrmbukyia, na wɔdze afõwa ekunkum wo nkɔnhyɛfo; na emi, emi ara nko na maka; na wɔrohwehwɛ mo nkwa woeeyi no hɔ.
Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, kɔ, san fa wo kwan kɔ Damascus sar no do: Na sɛ idu a, sera Hazael ngo hyɛ no hen wɔ Syria do:
Na sera Nimshi ne babanyin Jehu ngo hyɛ no hen wɔ Israel do: Na sera Shaphat ne babanyin Elisha a ofi Abel-meholah no ngo hyɛ no nkɔnhyɛnyi dzi w’ananmu.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, nyia obefi nsa efi Hazael afõwa anomu no, Jehu boku no: Na nyia obefi nsa efi Jehu afõwa anomu no Elisha boku no.
Naaso mibegyaa Israel mu mpemesuon ama moho anankroma nyinara a wommbui mma Baal, na ano biara a ommfeew n'ano.

Nna osii mu fii hɔ kɔree, na okohum Shaphat ba Elisha a ɔdze anantwi mpamho duebien dzi n’enyim rufuntum, na ɔnoara kã dza otsia duebien no ho: Na Elijah twaa mu kɔr ne nkyɛn na ɔtoow n’akatakɔmnu guu no do.
Na ɔdaan anantwi no gyae, na otuu mbirika dzii Elijah ekyir, na ɔsee dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma minkefew m’egya na me nã ano, na nkyii mimbedzi w’ekyir. Na ɔsee no dɛ, kɔ bra; na ebɛnadze na medze mayɛ wo?
Na ofii n’ekyir sanee, na ɔkɛfaa anantwi mpamho no, na okum hɔn, na ɔdze anantwi edwumayɛ-ndua no noaa nam no, na ɔdze maa nkorɔfo no, na wodzii. Nna ɔsoɛree kedzii Elijah ekyir, na ɔsoom no.
20: Na Syriahen Ben-hadad boaboaa no dɔm nyinara ano: Na ahemfo eduasa ebien kã no ho, na mpɔnkɔ na ntseaseanam: Na osii mu kɔree kotuaa Samaria, na ɔnye no kõe.
Na ɔsomaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Israelhen Ahab nkyɛn, wɔ kurow no mu, kɛsee no dɛ, mbrɛ Ben-hadad se nye yi,
wo dwetɛ na wo sika yɛ medze; wo yernom so na wo mba so a wɔyɛ fɛw no, wɔyɛ me dze.
Na Israelhen no buae see dɛ, mo wura ɔhen, ɔtse dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm no tse ara; emi na dza mowɔ nyinara, yɛ wɔdze.
Na abɔfo no baa bio, besee dɛ, mbrɛ Ben-hadad kã nye yi, dɛ, ampa mosomae ma wɔbaa wo nkyɛn, dɛ, yi wo dwetɛ na wo sika, na wo yernom, na wo mba ma medze;
na ɔkyena siseber yi mobɔsoma mo nkowaa wɔ wo nkyɛn, na wɔbɔhwehwɛɛhwɛ wo fie, na wo nkowaa hɔn efiefi; na ɔbɛba dɛ adze biara a ɔyɛ hɔn enyiwa do fɛw no. Wɔbɛfa ekitsa hɔn nsamu, na wɔdze akɔ.

Nna Israelhen no frɛɛ asaase no do mpanyimfo no nyinara, na ɔsee dɛ, meserɛ hom, hom nhyɛ no nsew, na wɔnhwɛ mbrɛ nyimpa yi esi rohwehwɛ bɔn: Osiandɛ ɔsomae ma wɔbaa me nkyɛn bebisaa me yernom, na me mba, na mo dwetɛ, na me sika ho; na mannkam no.
na mpanyimfo no nyinara na ɔman no nyinara see no dɛ, mma nntsie, nkyii so mma mmpen.

Dɛm ntsi ɔsee Ben-hadad n'abɔfoe no dɛ, hom nkɛkã nkyerɛ mo wura ɔhen dɛ, dza ibebisaa no wɔ w'akowaa hɔ asɔpɔn no dze mebɛyɛ: Na adze yi dze merennyɛ. Na abɔfo no sii mu kɔree, na wɔdze asɛm kɛmaa no bio.
Na Ben-hadad somae ma wɔbaa ne nkyɛn, bɛsee dɛ, enyame no nyɛ dɛm mma me, na bi so nkã ho, sɛ Samaria huntuma ɔsõ nkorɔfo a wodzi m'ekyir nyinara nsapuw nsapuw a.
Na Israelhen no buae see dɛ, hom nkɛka nkyerɛ no dɛ. Mma nyia ɔhyɛ n'akodze nntuw noho dɛ nyia oyi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ben-hadad tsee amandzɛɛ yi, wɔ aber a ɔnoara na ahemfo no ronom nsã, wɔ asese mu no, nna ɔsee no nkowaa dɛ, hom mbaa mpasuar. Na wɔbaa mpasuar wɔ kurow no do.
Na, hwɛ, nkɔnhyɛnyi bi twee piin Israelhen Ahab nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, ana ehu nyimpadodow kɛse yi nyinara? Hwɛ, medze hɔn merehyɛ wo nsa ndɛ da yi; na ehu dɛ emi nye Ewuradze.
Na Ahab see dɛ, ɔnam woana do? Na ɔsee dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze sɛ nye yi, ɔnam amansin asafohemfo no hɔn mberantsɛ no do. Nna ɔsee dɛ, woana na ɔnhyɛ ɔkõ no ase? Na obuaa dɛ, ɔwo a.
Na ɔkaan amansin asafohemfo no hɔn mberantsɛ no, na wɔyɛ ahaenu eduasa ebien: Na hɔn ekyir no ɔman no nyinara, mekyerɛ Israelmba a ɔkanee no nyinara, wɔyɛ mpemesuon.
Na wofir edzi wigyinae. Nna Ben-hadad ronom nsã wɔ asese no mu, ɔno na ahemfo no, ahemfo eduasa ebien a wɔboaboaa no no.
Na amansin asafohemfo no hɔn mberantsɛ no dzii kan fiir edzi; na Ben-hadad somae na wɔkɛkãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, mbarimba fi Samaria efir edzi reba.
Na ɔsee dɛ, sɛ asomdwee ntsi na woefir edzi a, hom mfa hɔn enyikan; na sɛ ɔkõ so ntsi na woefir edzi a, hom mfa bɔn enyikan.
Nna woyinom fi kurow no mu fiir edzi, amansin asafohemfo no hɔn mberantsɛ no, na dɔm a wodzi hɔn ekyir no.
Na hɔn nyinara kunkum hɔn nyimpa nkorkor; na Syriafo guanguanee, na Israel tsiiw hɔn: Na Syriahen Ben-hadad tse pɔnkɔ do nye mpɔnkɔdofo no fii nsa guanee.
Na Israelhen no fiir edzi kokunkum mpɔnkɔ na ntseaseanam no, na ɔdze oku kɛse kum Syriafo.
Na nkɔnhyɛnyi wo twee piin Israelhen no na ɔsee no dɛ, kɔ kɛhyɛ woho dzen, na hyɛ no nsew, na hwɛ dza ereyɛ: Osiandɛ afedan no Syriahen no bɔfow aba wo do.
Na Syriahen no no nkowaa see no dɛ, hɔn nyame yɛ akoko do nyame; dɛm ntsi na hɔn ho yɛ dzen kyɛn hɛn no: Na ma yɛnye hɔn nkɔkõ wɔ tɛtɛr mu, ampaara nkyɛ hɛn ho bɛyɛ dzen asen hɔn.
Na iyi na yɛ; yiyi ahemfo no fi hɔ, nyimpa biara mfi ne tsenabew, na fa asafohemfo hyehyɛ hɔn ananmu;

na kan dɔm a ɔtse dɛ dɔm a ahwer hɔn no ma woho, ɔpɔnkɔ nhyɛ ɔpɔnkɔ ananmu, na tseaseanam nhyɛ tseaseanam ananmu: Na yɛnye hɔn bɔkõ wɔ tɛtɛr mu na ampaara hɛn ho bɛyɛ dzen asen hɔn. Na otsiee hɔn ndze, na ɔyɛɛ dɛm.
Na ɔbaa dɛ afedan no mu, Ben-hadad kɛkaan Syriafo no, na osii mu kɔr Aphek, dɛ ɔnye Israel rokɔkõ.
Na wɔkaan Israelmba no so, na wosiesiee hɔnho na wosii mu kɔree kehyiaa hɔn: Na Israelmba no kyeer nsera wɔ hɔn enyim tse dɛ mpɔnkyemba ekuw nkakraba ebien; na Syriafo no dze wɔhyɛɛ ɔman no mã.

Na Nyame nyimpa bi twee pinii bɛkãa kyerɛɛ Israelhen no see dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, osiandɛ Syriafo no ase dɛ, Ewuradze yɛ akoko mu nyame, na ɔnnyɛ ɔbɔn mu nyame no; dɛm ntsi mibeyi nyimpa­dodow kɛse yi nyinara mahyɛ wo nsa, na hom ehu dɛ emi nye Ewuradze.
Na wɔkyekyeer nsera, ɔbaako wɔ ɔbaako so ne tsentsendo nda esuon. Na ɔbaa dɛ, da a otsia esuon no wɔdze ɔkõ no kɔbɔɔ enyim; na Israelmba no kum Syriafo no mu anamɔnmufo mpemɔha da kor mu.
Na nkaa no guanguanee kɔr Aphek kurow no mu; na ɔfasu no bui guu nyimpa mpemeduonuesuon a wɔkae no do. Na Ben-hadad guanee, na ɔkɔr kurow no mu, mpiakyir mpia mu.

Na no nkowaa see no dɛ, hwɛ, afei yɛatse dɛ Israel fie ahemfo no wɔyɛ ahemfo mbɔbɔrhufo: Yɛserɛ wo, ma yɛmfa eyitam nkyekyer hɛn asen, na ntampehoma mbobɔ hɛn etsir, na yemfir edzi nkɔ Israelhen nkyɛn: Gyangyanbiara ɔbɛgye wo kra nkwa.

Nna wɔdze eyitam kyekyeer hɔn asen, na wɔdze ntampehoma bobɔɔ hɔn etsir, na wɔbaa Israelhen no nkyɛn, bɛsee dɛ, w’akowaa Ben-nadaa se dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma mentsena ase. Na ɔsee dɛ, ana ɔda ho tse ase? Ɔyɛ mo nua.

Afei mbarimba no hyɛɛ no nsew yie, na wɔyɛɛ ntsɛm dɛ wɔregye no dɛ ɔyɛ n’adwen; na wɔsee dɛ, wo nua Ben-hadad a. Nna ɔsee dɛ, hom nkɔ nkɛfa no mbra. Nna Ben-hadad fiir edzi baa ne nkyɛn; na ɔmaa ɔfowee baa tseaseanam no mu.

Na Ben-hadad see no dɛ, nkurow a m’egya gyee no wɔ w’egya nsamu no mebɛdan mama; na tsetsew abrɔn ma woho wɔ Damascus, dɛ mbrɛ m’egya yɛe wɔ Samaria no. Na Ahab see dɛ, emi so medze ahyɛmu yi mibegyaa wo ma akɔ. Nna ɔnye no dzii ahyɛmu, na ogyaa no ma ɔkɔree.
Na ɔbarimba bi a ofi nkɔnhyɛfomba no mu nam Ewuradze n’asɛm do see ne nyɛnko dɛ, meserɛ wo, bɔ me. Na nyimpa no poow dɛ ɔbɔbɔ no.
Nna ɔsee no dɛ, osiandɛ enntsie Ewuradze ne ndze ntsi, hwɛ, ifi me nkyɛn isi mu rokɔ ara a, gyata boku wo. Na ofii ne nkyɛn sii mu rokɔ ara, nna gyata hun no, na okum no.
Nna ohun nyimpa fofor so, na ɔsee dɛ, meserɛ wo bɔ me. Na nyimpa no bɔɔ no, ɔbɔɔ no piraa no.
Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi no sii mu kɔree, na ɔkɔtweɔɔn ɔhen no wɔ ɔkwan no mu, na ɔdze n’abɔtsir kyekyeer n’enyim sakyeer noho.

Na aber a ɔhen no rutwa mu no, ɔkaa mu frɛɛ ɔhen no na ɔsee dɛ, w’akowaa fiir edzi kɔr ɔkõ no ne finimfin; na, hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi danee faa nkyɛn, na ɔdze nyimpa bi brɛɛ me, na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ nyimpa yi do: Sɛ ɔnam kwan biara do ma ɔyera a, ɔnodze wɔdze wo nkwa bɛhyɛ no nkwa ananmu, anaaso ibotua dwetɛ talent kor.
Na aber a w’akowaa reyɛ adze wɔ ha na ha no, nna nkɔhwɛ a, ɔkɔ. Na Israelhen no see no dɛ, mbrɛ w’atsɛmbua nyɛ nye no, ɔwoara ebua.
Na ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm yii abotsir no wɔ n’enyiwa do; na Israelhen no hun no dɛ ofi nkɔnhyɛfo no mu.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, osiandɛ egyaa nyimpa a mehyira no do ama ɔsɛɛ no ma oefi wo nsa kɔr no, dɛm ntsi wo nkwa bɛhyɛ no nkwa ananmu, na wo man ahyɛ ne man ananmu.
Na Israelhen no sii mu kɔr ne fie dɛ ɔayɛ sokodaa na no bo efuw, na ɔbaa Samaria
21: Na ɔbaa dɛ nsɛm yi ekyir no, na Jezreelnyi Naboth wɔ wenyin ture bi wɔ Jezreel, wɔ Samariahen Ahab n'ahem nofi ho papaapa.

Na Ahab kãa kyerɛɛ Naboth dɛ, fa wo wenyin ture no ma me, ma memfa menyɛ nye fan ture osiandɛ opin me fi ho; na mebɛma wo wenyin ture a oye sen no mahyɛ ananmu: Anaa, sɛ obeye ama wo a, medze mbrɛ odzi no mebɛma wo wɔ sika mu.
Na Naboth see Ahab dɛ, Ewuradze mma ɔmpar me dɛ, medze m’egyanom hon egyapadze mebɛma wo.

Na Ahab baa ne fie dɛ ɔayɛ sokodaa na no bo efuw osian asɛm a Jezreelnyi Naboth ɔakã akyerɛ no no ntsi: Na ɔsee no dɛ, meremmfa m’egyanom egyapadze memma wo. Na ɔdaa ne mpa do, na ɔdaan n’enyim kɔr ban ho, na ɔammpɛ dɛ odzidzi.
Na ne yer Jezebel baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wo sunsum abɔm dɛm, na inndzidzi yi?

Na ɔsee no dɛ, osiandɛ mekasaa kyerɛɛ Jezreelnyi Naboth, na mesee no dɛ, fa wo wenyin ture no ma me gye sika; anaaso, sɛ epɛ a, mebɛma wo wenyin ture fofor mahyɛ ananmu: Na obuaa dɛ, meremmfa mo wenyin ture memma wo.
Na ne yer Jezebel see no dɛ, afei ana ɔwo na ehwɛ Israel ahendzi do a? Soɛr dzidzi, na ma w’akoma ntɔ wo yamu: Medze Jezreelnyi Naboth no wenyin ture no mebɛma wo.
Nna ɔdze Ahab ne dzin kyerɛkyerɛɛw nwoma, na ɔdze no nsɔwano dze sosɔɔw ano, na ɔsomasomae ma wɔdze nwoma no kɛmaa mpanyimfo no na ekunyin a wɔwɔ no kurow mu a wɔnye Naboth tse no.
Na ɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ nwoma no mu dɛ, hom mbɔ dawur ma wondzi mbuada, na wɔmfa Naboth ndzi tsir wɔ nkorɔfo no mu,
na wɔmfa nyimpa beenu a wɔyɛ Belialmba, ngyina n’enyim, na wɔmma wondzi dase ntsia no, dɛ, ɔwo adom Nyankopɔn na ɔhen. Na nkyii hom mfa no mpue nkesiw no abo ma onwu.

Na no kurow no mu mbarimba no, mekyerɛ mpanyimfo na ekunyin no a wɔtse no kurow no mu no, yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Jezebel somae ma wɔdze kɛmaa hɔn no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ nwoma a ɔsomae ma wɔdze kɛmaa hɔn no mu no.
Wɔbɔɔ dawur dɛ wondzi mbuada, na wɔdze Naboth dzii tsir wɔ nkorɔfo no mu.

Na nyimpa beenu no, Belial mba no, bae bɛtsenaa n'enyim: Na Belial mba no dzii dase tsiaa no, mekyerɛ wɔdze tsiaa Naboth, wɔ ɔman no enyim, dɛ, Naboth adom Nyankopɔn na ɔhen. Nna wɔfaa no fii kurow no mu puei, na wokesiiw no abo ma owui.
Nna wɔsomae ma wɔkɔr Jezebel nkyɛn, dɛ, woesiw Naboth abo, na oewu.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jezebel tsee dɛ woesiw Naboth abo ma oewu no, nna Jezebel see Ahab dɛ, soɛr, kɛfa Jezreelnyi Naboth no wenyin ture no a ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔdze bɛma wo agye sika no yɛ enyadze: Na Naboth nntse ase bio, na oewu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ahab tsee dɛ Naboth ewu no, nna Ahab soɛree dɛ orisian akɔ Jezreelnyi Naboth no wenyin ture no mu ɔakɛfa ayɛ enyadze.
Na Ewuradze n’asɛm baa Tish-binyi Elijah nkyɛn, dɛ,
soɛr, sian kɔ nye Israelhen Ahab a ɔtse Samaria no nkedzi ehyia: Hwɛ, ɔwɔ Naboth no wenyin ture no mu, ehɔ na oesian kɔ dɛ ɔrekɛfa ayɛ enyadze.

Na kã kyerɛ no, dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, ana eku, na eso afa ayɛ enyadze? Na kã kyerɛ no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, beebi mbrɛ nkraman tafeer Naboth no bɔgyaa no hɔ na nkraman bɛtafer ɔwo so wo bɔgyaa.
Na Ahab see Elijah dɛ, me tamfo, ana ehu me? Na obuaa dɛ, mehu wo: Osiandɛ atɔn woho dɛ ereyɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do.
Hwɛ, medze mbusu mebɛba wo do, na mapra wo kwakwaakwa, na metwa Ahab mu abofra banyin biara akyen, na Israel mu nyia wɔatow no mu na nyia woegyaa no:
Na mebɛyɛ wo fi dɛ Nebat ne ba Jeroboam ne fi, na Ahijah ne ba Baasha ne fi, wɔ ebufuw a edze eyi me na ama Israel ayɛ bɔn ntsi.
Na wɔ Jezebel ho so Ewuradze kãa dɛ, nkraman bedzi Jezebel wɔ Jezreel sumpii ho.
Nyia ofi Ahab mu a obowu wɔ kurow mu no, nkraman bedzi; na nyia obowu wɔ haban mu no wimu ntumbowa bedzi.
(Naaso obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ Ahab a ne yer Jezebel hyɛɛ no nkuran ma ɔtɔɔn noho dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do.
Na ɔyɛɛ ekyiwadze dodow dɛ odzii abosom ekyir, dɛ mbrɛ Amorifo a Ewuradze tuu hɔn wɔ Israelmba enyim yɛe no nyinara).
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ahab tsee nsɛm no, ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔdze eyitam kataa noho na odzii mbuada, na ɔdaa eyitam mu, na otsiaa dɔndɔn kɔree.
Na Ewuradze n’asɛm baa Tishbinyi Elijah nkyɛn, dɛ,
ana ehu mbrɛ Ahab esi na ɔabrɛ noho adze wɔ m’enyim a? Osiandɛ ɔabrɛ noho adze wɔ m’enyim ntsi, meremmfa mbusu no memmba wɔ ne nda mu: Na ne ba ne nda mu na medze mbusu no mebɛba ne fi do.
22: Na wɔtsenaa hɔ mfe ebiasa dɛ ɔkõ bi nnyi Syria na Israel ntamu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsīa ebiasa no mu no, Judahhen Jehoshaphat sianee baa Israelhen do.
Na Israelhen no see no nkowaa dɛ, ana hom nyim dɛ Ramoth-gilead yɛ hɛndze, na yɛaye komm na yɛnngye mmfi Syriahen no nsamu?
Na ɔsee Jehoshaphat dɛ, ana enye me bɔkɔ Ramoth-gilead akɔkõ a? Na Jehoshaphat see Israelhen no dɛ, metse dɛ woara, me man tse dɛ wo man, mo mpɔnkɔ tse dɛ wo mpɔnkɔ
Na Jehoshaphat see Israelhen no dɛ, meserɛ wo, bisa Ewuradze n'asɛm ndɛ.
Nna Israelhen no boaboaa nkɔnhyɛfo no ano, mbarimba bɛyɛ ahaanan, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ana monkɔ Ramoth-gilead nkɔkõ, anaa mingyaa? Na wɔsee dɛ, fow kɔ; na Ewuradze dze bɛhyɛ ɔhen nsa.
Na Jehoshaphat see dɛ, ana Ewuradze no nkɔnhyɛnyi bi so nnyi ha, ma yeebebisa no hɔ adze?

Na Israelhen no see Jehoshaphat dɛ, ɔbarimba baako bi da ho wɔ ha a nkyɛ yɛnam no do bebisa Ewuradze hɔ adze, Imlah ne ba Micaiah a: Na mikyir no; osiandɛ ɔnnhyɛ mo ho nkɔm pa, na bɔn nko. Na Jehoshaphat see dɛ, mma mma ɔhen nnse dɛm.
Nna Israelhen no frɛɛ ɔsafohen bi, na ɔsee dɛ, kɛfa Imlah ne ba Micaiah bra ntsɛmara.
Afei Israelhen na Judah hen Jehoshaphat tsetse hɔn nhengua do nkorkor, hyehyɛ hɔn ahenntar, wɔ Samaria kuropon ahɛnee gua do; na nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara rehyɛ nkɔm wɔ hɔn enyim.
Na Chenaanah ne ba Zedekiah yɛɛ dadze mmbɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, Iyinom na edze bosun Syriafo no ara ma wɔahyew.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara hyɛɛ nkɔm dɛm, dɛ, fow kɔ Ramoth-gilead na kɛyɛ yie: Na Ewuradze dze bɛhyɛ ɔhen nsa.
Na ɔbɔfo no ɔkɔr dɛ ɔrekɛfrɛ Micaiah no kãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, afei hwɛ, nkɔnhyɛfo no dze ano kor kã nsɛm pa kyerɛ ɔhen: Meserɛ wo, ma w'asɛm nyɛ dɛ hɔn mu baako n'asɛm, na kã dɛ oye.
Na Micaiah see dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi, dza Ewuradze bɛse me no, ɔno na mebɛkã.
Na aber a ɔbaa ɔhen no nkyɛn no, ɔhen no see no dɛ, Micaiah, ana yɛnkɔ Ramoth-gilead nkɔkõ, anaa yenngyaa? Na obuaa dɛ, fow kɔ na kɛyɛ yie; na Ewuradze dze bɛhyɛ ɔhen nsa.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, mpɛn ahen ara na menkã ntam ngu wo do ma kã dza ɔyɛ nokwar nko wɔ Ewuradze ne dzin mu kyerɛ me?
Na ɔsee dɛ, muhun Israel nyinara dɛ wɔapetse mbepɔw do, dɛ nguan a wonnyi oguanhwɛfo: Na Ewuradze see dɛ, iyinom wonnyi wura; ma wɔnsan, nyimpa biara nkɔ ne fie asomdwee mu.
Na Israelhen no see Jehoshaphat dɛ, ana mannkã mannkyerɛ wo dɛ, ɔnnkɛhyɛ mo ho nkɔm pa, dɛ bɔn nko?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛm ntsi tsie Ewuradze n’asɛm: Muhun Ewuradze dɛ ɔtse n’ahengua do, na ɔsor dɔm nyinara gyinagyina no ho wɔ n’enyimfa na n’abankum.
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, woana na ɔbɛdaadaa Ahab, ma ɔaafow akɔ akɔtɔr wo Ramoth-gilead? Na obi see dɛm; na obi so see dɛm.
Na sunsum bi fiir edzi begyinaa Ewuradze enyim na ɔsee dɛ, mara mebɛdaadaa no.
Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, edze ebɛnadze? Na ɔsee dɛ, mibefir edzi, na makɛyɛ sunsum torfo wɔ no nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara anomu. Na ɔsee dɛ, ɔwo bɛdaadaa no, na so edzi nyim: Fir edzi kɔ, na kɛyɛ dɛm.
Dɛm ntsi afei, hwɛ, Ewuradze dze sunsum torfo ahyɛ wo nkɔnhyɛfo yi nyinara anomu; na Ewuradze akasa wo ho hɔn.
Nna Chenaanah ne ba Zedekiah twee pinii, na ɔbɔɔ Micaiah sotɔr see dɛ, ebɛn kwan do na Ewuradze no sunsum nam me nkyɛn bɛkãa kyerɛɛ wo yi?
Na Micaiah see dɛ, hwɛ da no a ebɔkɔ mpiakyir pia mu dɛ irukosuma woho no na ibohu.
Na Israelhen no see dɛ, fa Micaiah, na fa no san kɔ kɛma kurow no mu ambrado Amon, na ɔhen ne ba Joash;
na se dɛ, mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, hom mfa akowaa yi nto efiadze, na hom mfa ahohiahia edziban na ahohiahia nsu mbɔ no akɔhoma, ma onkodu dɛ mebɛba no asomdwee mu.
Na Micaiah see dɛ, sɛ ɔwoara esan ba no asomdwee mu ara dze a, nna nnyɛ Ewuradze ɔnam mo do akasa. Na ɔsee dɛ, aman, hom nyinara hom ntsie
Nna Israelhen na Judahhen Jehoshaphat sii mu kor Ramoth-gilead.
Na Israelhen no see Jehoshaphat dɛ, mebɛsakyer moho na makɔ ɔkõ no mu; na ɔwodze hyɛ wo ntar. Na Israelhen no sakyeer noho na ɔkɔr ɔkõ no mu.
Afei Syriahen no ahyɛ ne tseaseanam do asafohemfo eduasa ebien no dɛ, mma hom nnye kakraba anaa kɛse nnkõ, gyedɛ Israelhen nkotonoo.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a ntseaseanam do asafohemfo no hun Jehoshaphat no, nna wɔsee dɛ, ampa, Israelhen no nye no; na wɔdaan hɔnho dɛ wɔnye no rokɔkõ: Na Jehoshaphat kekaa mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ntseaseanam do asafohemfo no hun dɛ nnyɛ Israelhen nye no no, nna wogyaa no tsiw saan hɔn ekyir.

Na ɔbarimba bi twee n'egyen mu ntogon mu ara, na ɔdze bɔɔ Israelhen no wɔ mbɔtoa mu na akatabo no ntamu: Dɛm ntsi ɔsee ne tseaseanam-kanyi no dɛ, dan wo nsa, na fa me fi dɔm yi mu; na mepira dzendzen.
Na ɔkõ no mu yɛɛ dzen da no: Na wosuoo ɔhen no mu gyinaa ne tseaseanam mu wɔ Syriafo enyim, na ɔtɔɔr ewimbir: Na bɔgya fi epirakur no mu pemee kɔr tseaseanam no ase.
Na nkekamu bi faa dɔm no mu witɔree ber no, dɛ, nyimpa biara nkɔ no kurow mu, na nyimpa biara nkɔ ne man mu.
Nna ɔhen no wui, na wɔdze no baa Samaria; na wosiee ɔhen no wɔ Samaria.
Na wɔkɔhohoor tseaseanam no mu wɔ Samaria nsutaae ho; na nkraman tafeer no bɔgyaa; (afei mbaa ehuhufo hohor hɔnho wɔ hɔ); dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n’asɛm a ɔkãe no tse no.
Afei Ahab no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na asombɛn dan a osii, na nkurow a ɔkyekyeree nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Ahab nye n’egyanom kɛdae; na ne babanyin Ahaziah dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Na Israelhen Ahab n'afe a otsia anan no mu na Asa ne ba Jehoshaphat hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Judah do.
Jehoshaphat dzii mfe eduasa enum no nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii hen: Na odzii hen mfe eduonu enum wɔ Jerusalem. Na ne nã ne dzin dze Azubah, Shilhi ne babaa a.

Na ɔnantseew n'egya Asa kwan no nyinara do; ɔanndan emmfi ho, dɛ ɔyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do: Naaso oennyi mbea sorɔnsorɔm no emmfi hɔ; ɔman no daa ho bɔɔ afɔr na wɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm no.
Na Jehoshaphat nye Israelhen no ntamu siesiei.
Afei Jehoshaphat no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na ne mbanyinndam a ɔkyerɛe, na mbrɛ osii dzii akõ no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judah ahemfo hon Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na sodomfo nkaa a wɔkae wɔ n’egya Asa nda no mu no, otuu hɔn fii asaase no do.
Na ɔhen bi nnyi Edom: Ahyɛnanmu bi na odzi hen.
Jehoshaphat yɛɛ Tarshish ahɛn dɛ wɔnkɔ Ophir nkɛfa sika: Na wɔannkɔ, osiandɛ ahɛn no bobɔe wɔ Ezion-geber.
Nna Ahab ne ba Ahaziah see Jehoshaphat dɛ, ma mo nkowaa nkã wo nkowaa ho nkɔ ahɛn no mu. Na Jehoshaphat ammpen.
Na Jehoshaphat nye n’egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no kãa n’egyanom ho wɔ n’egya David kurow mu: Na ne babanyin Jehoram dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
Judahhen Jehoshaphat n’afe a otsīa duesuon no mu na Ahab ne ba Ahaziah hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel, na odzii hen mfe ebien wɔ Israel do.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, na ɔnantseew n’egya no kwan no do, na ne nã ne kwan do, na Nebat ne ba Jeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no, no kwan do.
Na ɔsoom Baal, na ɔsɔɔr no, na oyii Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no ebufuw, dɛ mbrɛ dza n’egya yɛe no nyinara tse.

1: Peter, Jesus Christ somafo, dze kɛma hɔn a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn a wɔyɛ amamforafo a wɔapetse wɔ Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia nye Bithynia,
dɛ mbrɛ Egya Nyankopɔn ne nyimdada tse, wɔ Sunsum n'ahotsew mu, dze kɔ setsie nye Jesus Christ no bɔgyaguar mu: Adom nye asomdwee ndɔɔ sõ nkã hom.
Nhyira nkã hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ ne Nyankopɔn nye n'Egya a n'ehumbɔbɔr a ɔdɔɔ sõ ntsi ɔnam Jesus Christ n'ewufo mu soɛr no do awo hɛn fofor ama nkwa enyidado,
akɔ egyapadze a ɔmmprɔw, na ho nnyi fī, na ɔmmpa mu a wɔakora no wɔ sor ama hom a
wɔnam Nyankopɔn no tum do roweɔn hom akɔ nkwagye a woesiesie dɛ woribeyi no ber a odzi ekyir no mu.
No mu na hom ho sɛpɛw hom, hom sesei, sɛ ɔsɛ a, wɔhow hom werɛ ber kumaabi wɔ nsɔhwɛ horow pii mu,
ma woeehu hom gyedzi no nsɔhwɛ dɛ ɔsom bo pii kyɛn sika a ɔsɛɛ (na ogya mu na wɔsɔ hwɛ) aama ayɛyi nye enyimnyam nye enyidzi wɔ Jesus Christ n'ahoyi no mu,
ɔno na hom nnhu no dze, naaso hom dɔ no; na hom nnhu no sesei dze, naaso hom gye no dzi ntsi hom ho sɛpɛw hom wɔ ahosɛpɛw a onnyi kabea a enyimnyam ahyɛ no mã mu,
aber a hom nya hom gyedzi n'ewiei, mekyerɛ hom kra nkwagye no.
Dɛm nkwagye no na nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛɛ adom a ɔbɛba hom do no ho nkɔm too hɔ no, wɔhwehwɛ na wɔpɛnsapɛnsaa mu,
hwehwɛɛ ber no nye ber kor a Christ no Sunsum a ɔwɔ hɔn mu a odzi Christ amandzehu nye eyimnyam a ɔbɛka do no ho dase no yii kyerɛe.

Hɔn na woyii kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, nnyɛ hɔnho bi a, na mbom hom na wɔsom hom kã iyinom a afei hɔn a wɔnam Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a wɔsomaa no fi sor no do kãa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ hom no akã akyerɛ hom: nsɛm a abɔfo pɛ mu ahwɛ.
Dɛm ntsi hom nsi hom adwen tadua, hom enyi nda hɔ na hom mfa enyidado nto adom a wɔdze rebrɛ hom wɔ Jesus Christ ahoyi no mu do koraa;
dɛ setsie mba, mma hom nnyɛ homho dɛ nkan no a hom nnyim dze ntsi no hom taa hom akɔndɔ do no;
na dɛ nyia ɔfrɛɛ hom no yɛ krɔnkrɔn no, homankasa so nyɛ krɔnkrɔn wɔ asetsena nyina mu;
osiandɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, hom nyɛ krɔnkrɔn, osiandɛ emi meyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Na sɛ hom frɛ no dɛ egya, nyia ɔnnhwɛ nyimpa enyim, na obu atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ obiara n'edwuma tse no a, hom mfa suro mbɔ bra wɔ hom ahɔhotsena ber yi mu:
Dɛ hom nyim dɛ wɔammfa ndzɛmba a ɔprɔw, dwetɛ anaa sika, na wɔdze gyee hom fii hom abrabɔ huhuw a, dɛ eguambaa a dzɛm nye nkekaa nyi no ho:
Ɔno na wohun no siei ansaana wɔroto wiadze fapem, na woeyi no akyerɛ ber a odzi ekyir yi mu ama hom a,
hom nam no do ayɛ agyedzifo wɔ Nyame a onyaan no fii ewufo mu, na hom gyedzi nye hom enyidado aatsena Nyame mu.
Osiandɛ hom atsew hom akra ho wɔ setsie mu akɔ enuadɔ a abra nnyi mu ntsi, hom mfi akoma mu ndodɔ homho ɔdzen mu ara:
dɛ hɔn a wommfi aba a ɔprɔw mu, na mbom wofi dza ɔmmprɔw mu, ɔnam Nyame asɛm a ɔtse ase na ɔbɛtsena ase daa no do awo hom fofor.
Na, honam nyina tse dɛ nkyɛkyɛr, na hɔn enyimnyam nyina tse dɛ nkyɛkyɛr nhyiren. Nkyɛkyɛr kyenkyen, na nhyiren po:
Na Ewuradze asɛm dze tse hɔ daa. Na iyi nye asɛmpa a wɔkãa kyerɛɛ hom no.
2: Dɛm ntsi hom nyiyi emumuyɛ nye ndaadaa, nye ndabraba, nye nyitan, nye nsekubɔ nyina ntow ngu,
na hom kɔn ndɔ asɛm no numfonso krɔnkrɔn no dɛ mbɔtoaba a wɔawo hom fofor, na hom eenyin wɔ mu akɔ nkwa mu;
sɛ hom asɔ ahwɛ dɛ Ewuradze yɛ adom a:
Ɔno ma hom ba no hɔ, dɛ enyikan bo a nyimpa apow, na Nyame dze ɔasan mu eyi, na ɔsom bo, a,
hom so wotse dɛ enyikan bo a wɔtow hom sunsum mu dan, asɔfokuw krɔnkrɔn a wɔbɔ sunsum mu afɔr a ɔnam Jesus Christ do sɔ Nyame enyi.
Osiandɛ wɔakyerɛw no kyerɛwsɛm no mu dɛ, hwɛ medze kutuwdo-bo ato Zion, wɔasan mu eyi no, ɔsom bo: Na nyia ɔgye no dzi n'enyi nnkowu.
Ntsi hom a hom gye no dzi no, ɔsom hom bo, na hɔn a wonntsie no dze, ɔbo a adantofo powee no, ɔno na ɔabɛyɛ kutudo-bo:
nye, fintsiw bo, nye ntotoananmu botan ama hɔn; na wofintsiw asɛm no do, osiandɛ wɔyɛ asokyewfo; na ɔno so na woyii hɔn mae.

Na homdze hom yɛ ebusuakuw a wɔasan mu eyi hom, asɔfokuw adehye, ɔman krɔnkrɔn, nkorɔfo a Nyame enya hɔn ayɛ nankasa nedze, dɛ hom mfa nyia oyii hom fii sum mu baa n'anwanwa kan mu no ne akamfo no nkyerɛ:
Hom a nkyɛ nkan no hom nnyɛ ɔman na afei dze hom ayɛ Nyankopɔn man; hom ennya ehumbɔbɔr, afei dze hom enya ehumbɔbɔr.
Adɔfo, mototɔ serɛ hom dɛ ahɔho nye amamfrafo, hom nyi homho mfi honam abɔdze a ɔnye kra kõ no ho;
na hom mbɔ ɔbra pa wɔ amanamanmba mu; na dza wotwir hom wɔ mu dɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo no, wɔhwɛ hom nyɛe pa no a, wɔaahyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ da a ɔbɛba abɔhwɛ hom no mu.
Hom mbrɛ homho adze mma nyimpa tumdzi nyina wɔ Ewuradze ntsi, ɔhempɔn a ɔyɛ ataso o;
ambradofo a ɔsoma hɔn ma ndzebɔnyɛfo ntsēa, nye apapafo ayɛyi o.
Na dɛm papayɛ siw nyia onnyi adwen no nkwaseasɛm ano:
Dɛ hom tse hom ase, na hom mmfa hom fahodzi nnyɛ bɔnyɛ do nkatado, na mbom dɛ Nyame nkowaa.
Hom ndzi nyimpa nyina nyi. Hom ndodɔ enuanom. Hom nsuro Nyankopɔn. Hom ndzi ɔhen nyi.
Nkowaa, hom mfa suro nyina mbrɛ homho adze mma hom wuranom, nnyɛ hɔn a woye na wodwe nko, na hɔn a wɔnntsen so.
Na iyi nye adom, sɛ ahonyim a ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn afamu ntsi, obi nya awerɛhow, hu amandze a ɔnntsen, na ɔsɔw a;
na enyimnyam bɛn na ɔyɛ, dɛ hom fom, na wɔbobɔ hom ekutuku, na hom yɛ abotar gye? Na mbom sɛ hom yɛ papa na hom hu amandze, na hom abotar a, iyi na ɔyɛ adom wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na iyi na wɔfrɛɛ hom baa ho, osiandɛ Christ so hun amandze maa hom, gyaa hom esusudo dɛ hom ndzi n'anamɔn ekyir;
ɔno na ɔannyɛ bɔn, na eso woennhu ndaadaa wɔ n'anomu;
ɔno, na wɔyaaw no na ɔannyaw bi; ohun amandze no ɔammbɔ empuw; na ɔdze noho hyɛɛ nyia obua atsɛn tsenenee no nsa:
Ɔnoarankasa na ɔsoaa hɛn bɔn wɔ no honam mu kɔr dua no do, dɛ yeewu ama ndzebɔn a, yaatsena ase ama tsenenee; ɔno na wɔdze ne mbaa etua asa hom yarba.
Na nkyɛ hom tse dɛ nuan a wɔayew, na afei hom asan aba hom akra hɔn guanhwɛfo nye Hwɛdofo nkyɛn.
3: Dɛmara, na yernom, hom mbrɛ homho adze mma homankasa hom kunnom; na sɛ binom enntsie asɛm no mpo a, wɔkwetsi asɛm no nam hɔn yernom abrabɔ do enya hɔn:
Dɛ wɔbɔhwɛ hom abrabɔ a tsew a osuro ka ho.
Mma hom ahosiesie nnyɛ honamenyi dze, wɔ tsidwow nye sikahyɛ anaa ntarhyɛ mu;
na mbom hom mma ɔnyɛ akoma mu nyimpa a ohunta, sunsum a ɔdwe na ɔyɛ komm a ɔmmprɔw mu, ɔno na ɔsom bo kɛse wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na dɛm na tsetseber mu, mbaa krɔnkrɔn a wɔdze hɔnho tweer Nyame so hyehyɛɛ hɔnho, dɛ wɔbrɛɛ hɔnho adze maa hɔnankasa hɔn kunnom:
Dɛ mbrɛ Sarah so tsiee Abraham, na ofrɛɛ no wura: Ɔno na sɛ hom yɛ papa, na hom ennsuro hu biara a, hom yɛ ne mba.
Kunnom, hom nye hom yernom ntsena nyimdzee mu dɛmara, hom mfa enyidzi mma ɔbaa no, dɛ adze a ɔyɛ mberɛw, dɛ hɔn so nye hom yɛ nkwa adom no dzifo bi: Amma hom asɔr kwan eennsiw.
N'ewiei nye dɛ, hom nyina nnya adwenkor, hom ntsetse mma homho, hom ndodɔ dɛ enuanom, hom nyɛ ayamuhyehye, hom ndwen ahobrɛadze adwen:
Mma hom mmfa bɔn nntua bɔn kaw, ɔyaw nntua ɔyaw kaw; na mbom hom nhyira; na hom nyim dɛ iyi ntsi na wɔfrɛɛ hom, dɛ hom mbenya nhyira.
Na, nyia ɔpɛ dɛ ɔdɔ nkwa, na ohu nda pa no, ma ɔnkora ne tɛkyerɛma wɔ bɔn ho, nye n'anofamfa wɔ ndaadaasɛm ho;
Ma onyi bɔn akwa na ɔnyɛ papa; na ɔnhwehwɛ asomdwee na ontsiw no.
Osiandɛ Ewuradze n'enyiwa wɔ atseneneefo do, na n'aso wɔ hɔn sufrɛ do, na Ewuradze enyi sã hɔn wɔyɛ bɔn.
Na sɛ hom yɛ mbɔdzembɔfo wɔ dza oye ho a, woana nye nyia ɔbɛhaw hom?
Na sɛ hom hu amandze wɔ ɔtsenenee ntsi a, nhyira akã hom; mma hom nnsuro hɔn ho hu, na mma hom bo nntu;
na mbom hom mbu Ewuradze Christ krɔnkrɔn wɔ hom akoma mu: Na hom nsiesie homho daa dɛ hom beyi ano akyerɛ obiara a obisa hom enyidado a ɔwɔ hom mu no ase, wɔ ɔdwe nye suro mu:
na hom enya tsibowa pa, na dza wɔkasa tsia hom wɔ mu no, hɔn a wogu hom abrabɔ pa a ɔwɔ Christ mu ho fī no, hɔn enyi eewu.
Na sɛ ɔpɛ na Nyankopɔn pɛ dɛ hom hu amandze wɔ papayɛ ho a, oye mbom kyɛn dɛ hom bohu wɔ bɔnyɛ ho.
Osiandɛ Christ so hun bɔn ho amandze prɛko, nyia ɔtsen hunii maa hɔn a wɔnntsen, ma ɔdze hɛn aakɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn; wokum no honam mu, na wɔmaa onyaa nkwa wɔ sunsum mu;
ɔno mu so na ɔman kɔree kɛkãa asɛm kyerɛɛ esunsum a wɔwɔ efiadze a,
tsetseber no wɔyɛɛ asoɔdzen, wɔ ber a Nyame ne penkyɛr tweɔnee no, wɔ Noah nda no a wɔrepam hɛn no mu, no mu na, akra kakra, mekyerɛ baawɔtwe, nyaa nkwa wɔ nsu no mu:
Ɔno na afei so ne saso gyee hom nkwa, ɔno nye enuma, nnyɛ honam ho fī yi a, na mbom ɔyɛ tsibowa pa mu nhwehwɛ mu wɔ Nyankopɔn afamu, wɔ Jesus Christ no wusoɛr mu:
Ɔno na ɔkɔr sor no, ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn nyimfa; na abɔfo nye tumdzifo, nye ahoɔdzenfo wɔabrɛ hɔnho adze ama no.
4: Na afei, osiandɛ Christ ehu amandze ama hɛn wɔ honam mu ntsi, hom no mfa adwenkor no ara mmia homho; osiandɛ nyia oehu honam mu amandze no egyaa bɔn yɛ;
na hom honam asetsena ber a aka no, hom aanntsena ase amma nyimpa akɔndɔ bio, na mbom wɔaatsena ase ama Nyankopɔn apɛdze.
Na mber a oetwa mu no dɔɔ sõ dɛ hom dze yɛɛ amanaman apɛdze, dɛ hom nantseew ahoɔdɛw, akɔndɔ bɔn, asabow, asakasakagor, edzidzimee nye abosonsom nkɔkɔw mu:
Ɔno na ɔyɛ hɔn ahobow dɛ hom nye hɔn nntutu mbirika nnkɔ dɛm asakasakayɛ pɔtɔɔ no mu, na wɔkã hom ho nsɛm bɔn;
hɔn na wobeyi ano akyerɛ nyia oesiesie noho dɛ orubobu atseasefo nye ewufo atsɛn no.
Na iyi ntsi na asɛmpa no wɔkãa kyerɛɛ ewufo no so, na woeebu hɔn atsɛn dɛ nyimpa a wɔwɔ honam mu, na wɔaatsena ase dɛ mbrɛ Nyame tse wɔ sunsum mu.
Naaso adze nyina ewiei abɛn: Dɛm ntsi hom mma hom adwen mu ntsew, na hom enyi nda hɔ mma asɔryɛ:
Na ne tsitsir hom mfa ɔdɔ a no mu yɛ dzen ndodɔ homho, osiandɛ dɔ kata bɔn pii do;
hom nyeyɛ homho hɔho a ehwinhwin nnyi mu:
Dɛ mbrɛ obiara enya akyɛdze no, hom mfa nsonsom homho, dɛ Nyame adom horow do efihwɛfo pa.

Sɛ obi kã asɛm a, ma ɔnkã no dɛ Nyame anomunsɛm; sɛ obi som a, ma ɔnsom dɛ ofir ahoɔdzen a Nyankopɔn dze ma: Na wɔnam Jesus Christ do aahyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ adze nyina mu, ɔno na enyimnyam nye ahendzi yɛ nedze mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
Adɔfo, mma hom nndwen nsɔhwɛ gya a ɔaba hom mu rosɔ hom ahwɛ no ho dɛ ɔyɛ ahobowsɛm, dɛ adze hɔho bi aba hom do:
na mbom, dɛ mbrɛ hom ayɛ Christ amandzehu fafafo no, hom ndzi dɛw, na sɛ woyi n'enyimnyam edzi a, hom dze enyigye ama hom ho aasɛpɛw hom mbordo so.
Na sɛ wɔyaw hom wɔ Christ dzin ntsi a, ahomka akã hom, osiandɛ enyimnyam Sunsum nye Nyame Sunsum tse hom do.
Na mma hom mu bi nnhu amandze dɛ owudzifo, anaadɛ owifo, anaadɛ omumuyɛfo, anaadɛ ɔsɛmpɛfo wɔ binom asɛm ho:
Na sɛ ohu amandze dɛ Christiannyi a, mma n'enyi nnwu, na wɔmma ɔnhyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ dzin yi mu.
Osiandɛ ber edu a tsɛmbu hyɛ ase wɔ Nyame fie: Na sɛ odzi kan hyɛ ase hɛn do a, hɔn a wonntsie Nyame asɛmpa no ewiei bowie dɛn?
Na sɛ ɔyɛ dzen dɛ wɔbɛgye nyimpa tsenenee a, hen na nyia ɔnnyɛ nyamesuronyi na ɔyɛ dzebɔnyɛnyi befi?
Dɛm ntsi wɔmma hɔn wohu amandze dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn pɛ no mfa hɔn akra nhyɛ ɔbɔfo nokwafo no ne nsa wɔ papayɛ mu.
5: Mpanyin a wɔwɔ hom mu, mutu hom fo, emi a meyɛ ɔpanyin bi, nye Christ amandzehu ho dasefo, nye enyimnyam a woribeyi no edzi no fafafo:
Hom nnyɛn Nyankopɔn nguankuw a wɔwɔ hom mu, hom nhwɛ hɔn do, nnyɛ nhyɛdo, na mbom ɔpɛdo, Nyame-do; nnyɛ edzifodzepɛ ntsi, na mbom adwen a ɔayɛ krado ntsi;
nnyɛ dɛ hɔn a wodzi dza wodze ahyɛ hom abaw do sõ so abakoma, na mbom hom nyɛ esusudo mma nguankuw no.
Na Oguanhwɛfo panyin no yi noho edzi a, hom eenya enyimnyam ahenkyɛw a ɔmmpa da no.

Dɛmara na hom mberantsɛ so, hom mbrɛ homho adze nhyɛ mpanyimfo ase, nyew, hom nyina mbrɛ homho adze nhyehyɛ homho ase, na hom mfura ahobrɛadze: Osiandɛ Nyamkopɔn siw ahopɔwfo kwan, na ɔdom ahobrɛadzefo.
Dɛm ntsi hom mbrɛ homho adze nhyɛ Nyankopɔn tum nsa no ase, na ɔaama hom do wɔ ber a ɔsɛ mu;
hom ntow hom dadwen nyina nkyen no do, osiandɛ ɔdwen hom do.
Hom nyɛ enyigyen, hom nweɔn: Osiandɛ hom tamfo abɔnsam tse dɛ gyata a a ɔropɔw nenam rohwehwɛ nyia obenya no amen no:
Ɔno na hom nsiw no kwan pintsinn wɔgyedzi no mu, dɛ amandzehu kor no ara na wɔrehyɛ no mã wɔ hom nuanom a wɔwɔ wiadze mu.
Na adom nyina Nyankopɔn a ɔafrɛ hom aba n'enyimnyam no onnyiewiei mu wɔ Christ mu no, sɛ hom nya hu amandze kakra a, ekyirii ɔbɛyɛ hom mu, obesi hom pi, ɔbɛhyɛ hom dzen.
Ɔno na enyimnyam nye tumdzi dzi wɔ no mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
Menam onua nokwafo Silvanus, dɛ mbrɛ mubu no, do, mekyerɛw nsɛntsia yi mabrɛ hom, medze tu hom fo, midzi dase dɛ iyi nye Nyame nokwar adom no: hom ngyina mu pintsinn.
Asɔr a ɔwɔ Babylon a ɔasan mu eyi no bi dɛ hom no, kyia hom; me ba Mark so.
Hom mfa dɔ mfewano nkyiakyia homho. Asomdwee nkã hom a hom wɔ Christ Jesus mu nyina.

1: Afei ɔbarimba bi wɔ hɔ a ofi Ramathaim-zophim, wɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu, na ne dzin dze Elkanah, Jeroham ne ba no, Elihu ne ba no, Tohu ne ba no, Zuph ne ba no, Ephraimnyi a:
na ɔwɔ yernom beenu; ɔbaako ne dzin dze Hannah, na ɔbaako so ne dzin dze Peninnah: Na Peninnah wɔ mba, na Hannah dze onnyi mba.
Na ɔbarimba yi ofi no kurow mu afrenhyia afrenhyia kɔ dɛ ɔrokɔsɔr na ɔabɔ afɔr ama dɔm Ewuradze wɔ Shiloh. Na Eli ne mbabanyin beenu no, Hophni na Phinehas, wɔwɔ hɔ dzi Ewuradze n'asɔfoe.
Na sɛ da du ma Elkanah kɔbɔ afɔr a, ɔma ne yer Peninnah, na ne mbabanyin na ne mbabaa nyinara kyɛpɛn:
Na Hannah dze ɔma no kyɛpɛn mbɔho: Osiandɛ ɔdɔ Hannah, na mbom Ewuradze esiw n'awoo kwan:
Na no kora no yii no ehi dodoodow, dɛ ɔrema no werɛ ahow, osiandɛ Ewuradze esiw n'awoo kwan.
Na ɔyɛ dɛm afrenhyia afrenhyia sɛ ɔkɔ Ewuradze fie a, na oyi no ehi; dɛm ntsi osū, na onndzidzi.
Na no kun Elkanah see no dɛ, Hannah, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na isū? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na inndzidzi? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wo bo nndwe? Ana minnye memma wo nnsen mbabanyin du?
Nna wodzidzii wɔ Shiloh, na wɔnomee wiei no ekyir no Hannah soɛree. Afei ɔsɔfo Eli ɔtse n'egua do wɔ Ewuradze n'asɔrdan no n'ano pondua no ho.
Na ne kra werɛ howee, na oyii mpaa maa Ewuradze, na osūu yayaayaw.

Na ɔbɔɔ anohoba see dɛ, Dɔm Ewuradze, sɛ ehwɛ w'afonabaa n'amandzehu, ekaa me, na wo werɛ emmfir w'afonabaa, na ema no banyimba a, ɔnodze mezde no mebɛma Ewuradze no nkwa nda nyinara, na oyindam bi rennkã ne tsir.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔda ho ara robɔ mpaa wɔ Ewuradze enyim no, Eli hyɛɛ n'ano nsew.
Afei Hannah kasae wɔ n'akoma mu; n'anofamfa nko na ohihimii, na ne ndze dze wɔanntse: Dɛm ntsi Eli dween dɛ ɔabow nsã.
Na Eli see no dɛ, Ebɔbow nsã ara ma eekodu dabɛn? Ma wo nsã no mfi wo do.
Na Hannah buae see dɛ, oho, mo wura, meyɛ ɔbaa a mo sunsum dze yaw; wenyin na nsã dzendzen so monnoom bi, mbom me kra na mehue egu Ewuradze enyim.
Mma mmbu w'abaawa dɛ Belial babaa: Na me nkɔmbɔdzi na m'abohur dodow mu na makasa ebodu sisei.
Nna Eli buae see dɛ, kɔ asomdwee mu: Na Israel Nyankopɔn mma wo w'adzeserɛ a aserɛ wɔ no hɔ no.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ma wo somfo nnya w'enyim enyimnyam. Nna ɔbaa no sii mu kɔr no kwan, na okedzidzii, na n'enyim annyɛ awerɛhow bio.
Na wɔsoɛɛr anapaatu, na wɔkɔsɔree wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na wɔsanee baa hɔn fie wɔ Ramah: Na Elkanah hun ne yer Hannah; na Ewuradze kaa no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a mber durii no, Hannah nyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin; na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Samuel, dɛ, osiandɛ Ewuradze hɔ na meserɛɛ no.
Na ɔbarimba Elkanah no, na ne fi nyinara, sii mu kɔr dɛ ɔrokɔbɔ afrenhyia-afɔr, na ɔapon n'anohoba no dze ama Ewuradze.
Na Hannah dze ɔannkɔ; na ɔsee no kun dɛ, moronnkɔ ara dɛ abofra no etwa enumfo ana, na nkyii medze no maba, ma oeebopue wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na ɔaatsena hɔ daa.

Na no kun Elkanah see no dɛ, yɛ dza ehwɛ a oye no ara; tsintsim dɛ ibotwa no enumfo ana; Ewuradze ara na ɔnhyɛ n'asɛm dzen. Nna ɔbaa no tsintsimii na ɔmaa ne ba no enumfo, dze kodur dɛ otwaa no enumfo ana.
Na otwaa no enumfo no ɔfaa no kaa noho, nye anantwisaa ebiasa, na isiam ephah kor, na wenyin bɔdambɔ, na ɔdze no baa Ewuradze fie wɔ Shiloh: Na abofra no suar.
Na wokum ɔnantwisaa kor na wɔdze abofra no brɛɛ Eli.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ao mo wura, dɛ wo kra tse ase yi, mo wura, emi nye ɔbaa no a obegyinaa wo nkyɛn ha bɔɔ mpaa ma Ewuradze no.
Abofra yi ntsi na mobɔɔ mpaa no; na Ewuradze dze m'aserɛdze a meserɛɛ no wɔ no hɔ no ama me:
Dɛm ntsi mo so medze no mama Ewuradze; mber tsentsen a ɔtse ase no wɔdze no ama Ewuradze. Na ɔsɔɔ Ewuradze wɔ hɔ.
2: Na Hannah bɔɔ mpaa na ɔsee dɛ, m'akoma dzi ehurusi wɔ Ewuradze mu, m'ambɛn ama do wɔ Ewuradze mu, m'anomu atrɛ wɔ m'atamfo do, osiandɛ m'enyi gye wɔ wo nkwagye no mu.
Obiara nnyɛ krɔnkrɔn dɛ Ewuradze; na obiara nnyi hɔ ka wo ho: Nkyii so ɔbotan bi nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn.
Mma hom nnkasa ahohyehyɛ mu pii dɛm bio; mma hom mma ahopɔwsɛm mmfi hom anomu mmpue: Na Ewuradze nye Nyame a ohu adze nyinara, na ɔno na oker ndzeyɛɛ.
Mbarimba akatakyi egyen ebubu, na mberɛwfo dze, wɔdze ahoɔdzen bɔ hɔnho do.
Hɔn a wɔmee no woekedzi edziban ho paa; na hɔn a ɔkɔm dze hɔn no kɔm egyaa: Nyew, ɔbɔnyin awo esuon; na nyia ɔwɔ mba pii no yɛ ɔhokwafo.
Ewuradze na oku, na ɔma nkwa: Ɔno na ɔma wosian kɔ adakamaa mu, na ɔma wɔfow pue.
Ewuradze yɛ obi ohianyi, na ɔyɛ obi obirɛmpɔn: Ɔno na ɔbrɛ obi adze, ɔno so na ɔma obi do.
Ɔma ohianyi do fi huntuma mu, ɔma ɔkwahweaban do fi suminado, dɛ ɔbɛma wɔnye mbapɔmba atsena, na woenya enyimnyam ahengua do atsena: Osiandɛ asaase n'edum yɛ Ewuradze dze, na ɔdze wiadze esi do.
Ɔbɔhwɛ n'ahotseweefo anan do, na emumuyɛfo dze wɔbɔtɔ mmum wɔ sum mu; osiandɛ nyimpa biara nnkodua ahoɔdzen do edzi nyim.
Hɔn a wɔnye Ewuradze dzi aperper no wɔbɔdweredwerew hɔn do; Ewuradze bobu asaase ano atsɛn; na ɔdze ahoɔdzen ama ne hen, na ɔama ne nyia wɔasera no no n'ambɛn do.
Na Elkanah kɔr ne fie wɔ Ramah. Na abofra no soom Ewuradze wɔ ɔsɔfo Eli enyim.
Afei Eli mba no wɔyɛ Belial mba; wonnyim Ewuradze.
Na asɔfo no atɔrmuadze a wɔdze yɛ ɔman no nye dɛ, sɛ nyimpa bi bɔbɔ afɔr a, aber a wɔronoa nam no, nna ɔsɔfo no n'akowaa aba, dze edzinam a ne sē ebiasa wɔ ne nsamu;
na ɔdze abɔwɔ sɛn, anaa dadzehyera, anaa dadzesɛn, anaa kutu no mu; na dza edzinam no dze bɛba nyinara na ɔsɔfo no afa. Mbrɛ wɔdze yɛɛ Israelfo a wɔbaa Shiloh hɔ nyinara nye no.
Nyew, ansaana wɔrebɛhyew seradze no, nna ɔsɔfo no n'akowaa aba abɛse nyimpa a ɔrobɔ afɔr no dɛ, ma nam ma wɔnkɔtotõ mma ɔsɔfo; na ɔrenngye wo hɔ nam a wɔanoa, na momon a.
Na sɛ nyimpa no se no dɛ, wɔrebɛhyew seradze no seseiara, na nkyii afa dodow biara a wo kra kɔn dɔ a; nna ɔse dɛ, oho, na fa ma me seseiara: Na sɛ annyɛ no dɛm a, mebɛfa no enyimpi do.
Na mberantsɛ no hɔn bɔn yɛɛ kɛse dodoodow wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Na nkorɔfo no buu Ewuradze afɔrbɔdze enyimtsia.
Na Samuel dze ɔsomee wɔ Ewuradze enyim, dɛ ɔyɛ abofra a wɔdze ndwera ephod abɔ no do.
Nkyi so ne nã paam bataker kakraba, na ɔdze brɛɛ no afrenhyia afrenhyia, aber a ɔnye no kun ba bɔbɔ afrenhyia-afɔr no.
Na Eli hyiraa Elkanah na ne yer, na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze mma wo asefo wɔ ɔbaa yi mu wɔ adzefɛm a wɔdze afɛm Ewuradze yi ntsi. Na wosii mu kɔr hɔnankasa hɔn fie.
Na Ewuradze bɛseraa Hannah, na wonyinsenii, na ɔwoo mbabanyin baasa na mbabaa beenu. Na abofra Samuel no onyinii wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Afei Eli ayɛ akɔdaa dodow; na ɔtsee adze nyinara a ne mbabanyin dze yɛɛ Israel nyinara, na mbrɛ wɔnye mbaa a wɔbɛyɛɛ edwuma wɔ ehyiadzebuw no ano no da no.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom yɛ dɛm ndzɛmba yi? Na metse hom ndzeyɛɛ bɔn ho nsɛm wɔ ɔman yi nyinara ano.
Oho, me mba; na nnyɛ atsenka pa bi na metse yi: Hom yɛ Ewuradze ne man ma wɔfom.
Sɛ nyimpa bi yɛ obi bɔn a, Nyankopɔn bedzi ama no: Na sɛ nyimpa bi yɛ Ewuradze bɔn a, woana na ɔpɛpa kyɛw ama no? Naaso woenntsie hɔn egya ne ndze, osiandɛ Ewuradze pɛ eku hɔn.
Na abofra Samuel no nyinii ara, na n'enyim baa nyam wɔ Ewuradze, na eso nyimpa nyina enyim.
Na Nyame nyimpa bi baa Eli nkyɛn, na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, ana nnyɛ moho na medaa no edzi mekyerɛɛ w'egya fie, aber a wɔwɔ Egypt, Pharaoh fie nkowaasom mu no?

Na ana nnyɛ emi na mesaan mu miyii no wɔ Israel mbusuakuw nyinara mu dɛ ombedzi mo sɔfoe, na ɔnkɔ m'afɔrmbukyia ho nkɛhyew eduhuam, na ɔnhyɛ ephod wɔ m'enyim? Na ana nnyɛ emi na medze Israelmba hɔn ogya-afɔrbɔdze nyinara memaa w'egya fie no?
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom tsiatsia mo kum-afɔr na m'edziban-afɔr a mahyɛ wɔ me tsenabea do; na idzi wo mba nyi sen me; dɛ hom dze me man Israel ayɛyɛdze nyinara mu adze tsitsir nyɛn homho?

Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse dɛ, ampa mesee dɛ wo fie na w'egya fie nnantsew wɔ m'enyim daa: Na afei dze Ewuradze se dɛ, ɔmpar me koraa; na hɔn a wodzi me nyi no mibedzi hɔn nyi, na hɔn a wobu me enyimtsia no bɛhyɛ ahoraa.
Hwɛ, nda reba a mubotwa w'abasa, na w'egya fie abasa, amma akɔdaa bi aannka wɔ wo fie hɔ.
Na ibohu ahohiahia wɔ me tsenabea hɔ, wɔ ahonya a Nyame dze bɛma Israel no nyinara mu; na akɔdaa bi rennka wo fie hɔ dabiarada.
Na wo nyimpa no a munnkotwa no mefi m'afɔrmbukyia ho akyen no, wɔ hɔ dɛ ɔbɛma w'enyiwa ayɛ siamoo, na ɔahow wo werɛ: Na wo fie na dodow nyinara bowuwu wɔ hɔn mberantsɛber mu.
Na iyi bɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze ama wo, dza ɔbɛba wo mbabanyin beenu no, Hophni na Phinehas do no; da kor na hɔn beenu nyina bowuwu.
Na mebɛma ɔsɔfo nokwafo bi do mama moho a, ɔbɛyɛ dza ɔwɔ m'akoma mu na m'adwen mu: Na ɔbɛnantsew nyia masera no no enyim daa.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, obiara a ɔbɛka wɔ wo fi mu no ɔbɛba abɔbɔ no mu adze ama no agye dwetɛbona no boodoo ntɔwmu, na ɔase dɛ, meserɛ wo, fa me hyɛ asɔfo dwuma no mu kor bi mu, ma meenya boodoo trɔma bi medzi.
3: Na abofra Samuel no soom Ewuradze wɔ Eli enyim. Na Ewuradze n'asɛm soom bo wɔ nda no mu; na enyido-adzehu bi nnyi hɔ.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber no mu, Eli da ne dabew no (afei n'enyiwa ahyɛ ase reyɛ kusukusu, na onntum nnhu adze).
Na Nyankopɔn kandzea no nnyae nndumii, na Samuel da Ewuradze n'asɔrdan no mu, mbrɛ Nyankopɔn n'adaka no wɔ no;
nna Ewuradze frɛɛ Samuel: Ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye yi.
Na otuu mbirika kɔr Eli nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, emi nye yi; na efrɛɛ me. Na ɔsee dɛ, Memmfrɛe; san kɛda. Na ɔkɔree kɛdae.
Na Ewuradze da ho frɛɛ Samuel bio. Na Samuel soɛree kɔr Eli nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, emi nye yi; na efrɛɛ me. Na obuaa dɛ, memmfrɛe, me ba; san kɛda.
Nna Samuel nnyae nnhun Ewuradze, nkyii so wonnyae nnyii Ewuradze n'asɛm nnkyerɛɛ no.
Na Ewuradze frɛɛ Samuel bio ne mpɛn ebiasa. Na ɔsoɛree kɔr Eli nkyɛn na ɔsee dɛ, emi nye yi; na efrɛɛ me. Na Eli hun dɛ Ewuradze na ɔfrɛ abofra no.
Dɛm ntsi Eli see Samuel dɛ, kɔ, kɛda: Na ɔba dɛ sɛ ɔfrɛ wo a, ɔno se dɛ, Ewuradze, kasa, na w'akowaa ritsie. Nna Samuel kɔree kɛdaa ne dabew.
Na Ewuradze bae begyina hɔ frɛɛ dɛ nkan no, dɛ, Samuel, Samuel, nna Samuel see dɛ, kasa; na w'akowaa ritsie.
Na Ewuradze see Samuel dɛ, hwɛ, merebɛyɛ adze bi wɔ Israel mu a obiara a ɔbɛtse no n'aso ebien nyina mu bɛyɛ no gyengyenngyen.
Da no na mebɛyɛ dza makã etsia Eli wɔ ne fi ho nyinara, ofi ahyɛse ara dze kodu ewiei.
Na makã makyerɛ no dɛ mubobu ne fi atsɛn daa, wɔ emumuyɛ no a ɔnoara nyim no ntsi, osiandɛ ne mba twetwee mbusu baa hɔn do, na ɔanntwe hɔn ekyir.
Na dɛm ntsi mesua makyerɛ Eli fi dɛ, wɔremmfa okum-afɔr anaaso ayɛyɛdze mmpata Eli fi emumuyɛ no ara da.
Na Samuel dae ma adze kyee, na obuebuee Ewuradze fie no mbobow no. Na Samuel suroo dɛ ɔbɛkã enyido-adzehu no akyerɛ Eli.
Nna Eli frɛɛ Samuel see dɛ, me ba, Samuel. Na ɔsee dɛ, emi nye yi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ebɛn asɛm na Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ wo no? Meserɛ wo, mma nnsiw me do: Nyankopɔn nyɛ wo dɛm, na bi so nka ho, sɛ isiw me nsɛm a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ wo no nyinara mu bi do a.
Na Samuel kãa ne nyinara kyerɛɛ no, na oennsiw no hweeara do. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze nye no: Dza oye wɔ n'enyiwa do no, wɔmma ɔnyɛ.
Na Samuel nyinii, na Ewuradze dzii n'ekyir, na ɔamma ne nsɛm mu biara anntɔ famu.
Na Israel nyinara a ofi Dan ara dze kodu Beer-sheba hun dɛ wɔahyɛ Samuel dzen dɛ ɔnyɛ Ewuradze no akɔnhyɛnyi.
Na Ewuradze yii noho edzi bio wɔ Shiloh: Osiandɛ Ewuradze nam Ewuradze n'asɛm do yii noho kyerɛɛ Samuel wɔ Shiloh.
4: Na Ewuradze n'asɛm dur Israel nyinara do. Afei Israel tui kɔr Philistiafo do dɛ wɔnye hɔn rokɔkõ, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Ebenezer nkyɛn: Na Philistiafo no bɛkyeer nsera wɔ Aphek.
Na Philistiafo no kɛbaa mpasuar hyiaa Israel: Na wɔdze kɔbɔɔ enyim no, wɔbɔɔ Israel gui wɔ Philistiafo no enyim: Na wokum dɔm a wɔwɔ akono no mu nyimpa bɛyɛ mpemanan.

Na ɔman no baa nseraban no mu no, Israel mpanyimfo no see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na Ewuradze abɔ hɛn egu ndɛ wɔ Philistiafo enyim yi? Wɔmma yɛnkɛfa Ewuradze n'ahyɛmudaka no wɔ Shiloh mbra hɛn nkyɛn, ma ɔmbra hɛn mu, na ɔmbɛgye hɛn mfi hɛn atamfo nsamu.

Nna ɔman no somae ma wɔkɔr Shiloh, na wɔkɛfaa dɔm Ewuradze a ɔtse cherubfo do no, n'ahyɛmudaka no wɔ hɔ bae: Na Eli ne mbabanyin beenu nu, Hophni na Phinehas, nna wɔnye Nyankopɔn n'ahyɛmudaka no wɔwɔ hɔ.
Na aber a Ewuradze n'ahyɛmudaka baa nseraban no mu no, Israel nyinara dze huro kɛse bɔɔ ose, ma asaase wosoow bio.
Na aber a Philistiafo no tsee esebɔ dede no, wɔkãa dɛ, Hebrewfo asese mu esebɔ kɛse dede yi ase nye dɛn? Na wɔtsee ase dɛ Ewuradze n'adakaa no aba nseraban no mu.
Na Philistiafo no suroi, na wɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn aba nseraban no mu. Na wɔsee dɛ, Yendue! Na dɛm adze yi bi nnsii pɛn ara da-na-ndɛ.
Yendue! Woana beyi hɛn efi enyame akatakyi yi nsamu? Iyinom nye enyame a wɔdze ɔyardɔm ahorow nyinara kum Egyptfo wɔ sar no do no.
Hom nhyɛ dzen, na hom nyɛ homho dɛ mbarimba, Philistiafo e, amma hom aannyɛ nkowaa amma Hebrewfo no, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn wɔayɛ ama hom no: Hom nyɛ homho dɛ mbarimba na hom nkõ.
Na Philistiafo no kõe, na wɔbɔɔ Israel gui, na woguanguanee, nyimpa biara kɔr n'asesee mu: Na ɔyɛɛ ɔkõ kɛse dodoodow; osiandɛ Israel mu anamɔnmu dɔm mpemeduasa totɔree.
Na Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no, wɔgyee; na Eli ne mbabanyin beenu no, Hophni na Phinehas, totɔree.
Na Benjaminnyi bi fi dɔm no mu tutuu mbirika dze n'atar ntsetsewee baa Shiloh da no ara, na dɛtse gu n'etsifi.
Na aber a ɔbae no, hwɛ, nna Eli tse n'egua do wɔ ɔkwan nkyɛn rohwɛ; osiandɛ n'akoma tui wɔ Nyankopɔn adakaa no ho. Na obarimba no baa kurow no mu na ɔbɛkãe no, kurow no nyinara kekaa mu.
Na Eli tsee nkekamu ne dede no, ɔsee dɛ, na gyigyeegye dede yi ase nye dɛn? Nna ɔbarimba no kaa noho ntsɛmara, na ɔbae bɛkãa kyerɛɛ Eli.
Afei na Eli edzi mfe eduokron awɔtwe; na n'enyiwa ayɛ kusukusu, ma onnhu adze.
Na ɔbarimba no see Eli dɛ, emi nye nyia ofi dɔm no mu bae no, na ndɛ ara na mifi dɔm no mu muguanee. Na ɔsee dɛ, me ba, asɛm no tse dɛn?

Na nyia ɔdze amandzɛɛ no bae no buae, na ɔsee dɛ, Israel egu wɔ Philistiafo no enyim, na ɔman no so atotɔr pii, na wo mbabanyin beenu no so, Hophni na Phinehas, woewuwu, na Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no so wɔagye.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, ɔbɔɔ Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no dzin no, nna ofii n'egua no do hwee n'ekyir daadze wɔ abotsen no nkyɛn na no kɔn mu bui, na owui: Osiandɛ ɔyɛ akɔdaa, na ɔyɛ dur. Na oebu Israel atsɛn mfe eduanan.
Na n'asew, Phinehas ne yer no, onyinsen ma n'awoo rubodu: Na ɔtsee amandzɛɛ no dɛ wɔafa Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no, na n'asew na no kun ewuwu no, nna ɔkotowee, na owui; na awoko yaw baa no do.
Na orubowu no, mbaa a wogyina ne nkyɛn no see no dɛ, mma nnsuro: Na awo banyin. Na oemmbua, nkyii so ɔannyɛ no asɛm.
Na ɔtoo abofra no dzin Ichabod, see dɛ, enyimnyam no efi Israel kɔ: Osian Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no a wɔagye no ntsi, na osian n'asew na no kun ntsi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, enyimnyam no efi Israel kɔ; osiandɛ wɔagye Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no.
5: Na Philistiafo no faa Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no, na wɔdze fii Ebenezer baa Ashdod.
Na Philistiafo no faa Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no, na wɔdze baa Dagon ne fie, na wɔdze besii Dagon ne nkyɛn.
Na adze kyee no a Ashdodfo no wɔsoɛɛr anapaatu no, hwɛ, Dagon ahwe daadze ma n'enyim bom famu wɔ Ewuradze n'adakaa no enyim. Na wɔfaa Dagon, na wɔdze no sii ne sibew bio.

Na adze kyee a wɔsoɛɛr anapaatu no, hwɛ, Dagon ahwe daadze ma n'enyim bom famu wɔ Ewuradze n'adakaa no enyim; na Dagon ne tsir na ne nsakum ebien nyina etwitwa gu apondua ase dze no do; na Dagon no kutusin no ara nko na aka.
Dɛm ntsi Dagon n'asɔfoe, anaaso obiara a ɔba Dagon fie no, nntsia Dagon n'apondua ase dze no do wɔ Ashdod dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na Nyankopɔn ne nsa yɛɛ dur wɔ Ashdodfo do, na ɔsɛɛ hɔn, na ɔmaa mpɔmpɔ bobɔɔ hɔn; mekyerɛ Ashdod na no ho nkurow no.
Na Ashdodfo no hun dɛ ɔtse dɛm no, wɔsee dɛ, Israel hɔn Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no nnkɛnye hɛn atsena: Osiandɛ ne nsa ayɛ dzen wɔ hɛn, na hɛn nyame Dagon do papa.

Dɛm ntsi wɔsomae ma wokehyiahyiaa Philistiafo mpanyimfo no nyinara ma wɔbaa hɔn nkyɛn, na wɔsee dɛ, yɛnyɛ Israel Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no dɛn? Na wobuaa dɛ, wɔmma wɔnsoa Israel Nyankopɔn n'adaka no nkɔ Gath. Na wɔsoaa Israel Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no kɔr hɔ.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔsoae kɔree n'ekyir no, Ewuradze ne nsa dze ewubɔ kɛsenara baa kurow no do: Na ɔbobɔɔ kurow no mu mba no, nkakraba na akɛse nyina, na mpɔmpɔ bobɔɔ hɔn.

Nna wɔsomae ma wɔdze Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no kɔr Ekron. Na ɔbaa dɛ Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no baa Ekron no, nna Ekronfo no kekaa mu dɛ, wɔdze Israel Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no abrɛ hɛn dze rubokuku hɛn na hɛn nkorɔfo.

Dɛm ntsi wɔsomae ma wokehyiahyiaa Philistiafo mpanyimfo, nna wɔsee dɛ, wɔmma wɔmfa Israel Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no nkɔ n'ananmu bio, amma woeennkuku hɛn na hɛn nkorɔfo: Osiandɛ ewubɔ kɛsenara baa kurow no nyinara do; na Nyankopɔn ne nsa yɛɛ duduudur wɔ hɔ.
Na nkorɔfo no a woennwuwu no, mpɔmpɔ bobɔɔ hɔn: Na kurow no ne ntseamu kɔr sor.
6: Na Ewuradze n'adakaa no dzii Philistiafo mba no mu abosoom esuon.
Na Philistiafo no frɛɛ asɔfo na akɔmfo no dɛ, yɛnyɛ Ewuradze n'adakaa no dɛn? Hom nkyerɛ hɛn dza yɛmfa nka ho nkesi n'ananmu.

Na wɔsee dɛ, Sɛ hom dze Israel Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no rokɔ a, mma hom mmfa no pan nnkɔ; na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ nyinara hom mfa asodzi afɔr mma no: Na hom ho bɛyɛ hom dzen, na hom bohu adze kor a osian ntsi ma ne nsa mmfi hom do.

Nna wɔsee dɛ, Ebɛn asodzi afɔr na yɛmfa mma no? Na wɔsee dɛ, Sika a wɔayɛ no dɛ mpɔmpɔ enum, na sika nkura enum, dɛ mbrɛ Philistiafo mpanyimfo no hɔn dodow tse: Na yarba kor no ara ɔbaa hom na hom mpanyimfo nyinara do.

Dɛm ntsi hom nyɛ hom mpɔmpɔ no n'ehonyi, na hom nkura a wɔsɛɛ asaase no n'ehonyi; na hom mfa enyimnyam mma Israel Nyankopɔn; kyerɛ gyangyan-biara obeyi ne nsa efi hom, na hom enyame, na hom asaase do.
Ɔyɛ dɛm ntsi mbom na hom pirim hom akoma dɛ mbrɛ Egyptfo na Pharaoh piriim hɔn akoma yi? Aber a ɔyɛɛ anwanwadze wɔ hɔn mu no, ana woenngya nkorɔfo no kwan, ma wɔaannkɔ bi a?
Dɛm ntsi afei, hom mfa tseaseanam fofor na hom nsiesie, na anantwiber ebien a wɔma enumfo a kɔndua nnkɔr hɔn do da, na hom mpaa hɔn mba no mfi hɔn ho mbra fie:
Na hom mfa Ewuradze n'adakaa no nsi tseaseanam no do, na hom mfa sika egudze no a hom dze reyɛ asodzi afɔr ama no no ngu sikadaka mu nsi ne nkyɛn; na wongya no kwan ma ɔnkɔ.
Na wɔnhwɛ, sɛ ɔfa noara no ntoaado kwan tõo kɔ Beth-shemesh a, nna ɔnoara na ɔabɔ hɛn mbusu kɛse yi: Na sɛ annyɛ dɛm a, nna yebohu dɛ nnyɛ ne nsa bi na okum hɛn, na esian bi na esian hɛn.
Na mbarimba no yɛɛ dɛm: Na wɔfaa anantwiber a wɔma enumfo ebien, na wɔdze hɔn sesee tseaseanam no, na wɔtoow hɔn mba no mu wɔ fie:
Na wɔdze Ewuradze n'adakaa no sii tseaseanam no do, na wɔdze sikadaka no a sika nkura na hɔn mpɔmpɔ ehonyi wɔ mu no kaa ho.

Na anantwiber no faa akwantsen kɔr Beth-shemesh kwan no do; wɔfaa tsempɔn no do kɔree, mbrɛ wɔrokɔ no na worusū, na wɔanndan ammfa enyimfa anaa abankum; na Philistiafo mpanyimfo no dzii hɔn ekyir kodur Beth-shemesh ntoaado.
Na Beth-shemeshfo rutwa hɔn ewifua wɔ bɔnsa no mu: Na wɔmemaa hɔn enyi do, na wohun adaka no, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn dɛw dɛ wohunii.
Na tseaseanam no baa Beth-shemeshnyi Joshua ne haban mu, na ogyinaa hɔ, beebi mbrɛ ɔbo kɛse bi wɔ: Na wɔpaapaa tseaseanam no no dua no mu, na wɔdze anantwiber no bɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr maa Ewuradze.

Na Levifo no yii Ewuradze n'adakaa no sii famu, na sikadaka no a ɔka ho no a sika egudze no wɔ mu no, na wɔdze sisii ɔbo kɛse no do: Na Beth-shemeshfo bobɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr, na wokunku okum-afɔr da no ara maa Ewuradze.
Na Philistiafo mpanyimfo beenum no nyae hunii no, nna wɔsanee kɔr Ekron da no ara.
Na iyinom nye sika mpɔmpɔ a Philistiafo no dze yɛɛ asodzi afɔr dze maa Ewuradze no; Ashdod dze kor, Gaza dze kor, Ashkelon dze kor, Gath dze kor, Ekron dze kor;

na sika nkura no, tse dɛ mbrɛ Philistiafo nkurow a ɔyɛ mpanyimfo beenum no dze no no dodow tse, nkurow a wɔatotow ho aban na nkurobaase: Mekyerɛ ɔdze kodu ɔbo kɛse no a wɔdze Ewuradze n'adakaa no sii do no ho, ɔbo no wɔ hɔ ara dze bodu ndɛ da yi wɔ Beth-shemeshnyi Joshua ne haban mu.

Na okum Beth-shebeshfo no mu bi, osiandɛ wɔahwɛ Ewuradze n'adakaa no mu, mekyerɛ okum ɔman no mu nyimpa eduosuon, na nyimpa mpemeduonum: Na ɔman no dzii awerɛhow, osiandɛ Ewuradze dze oku kɛse eku ɔman no.
Na Beth-shemeshfo no see dɛ, woana na obotum egyina Ewuradze, Nyankopɔn Krɔnkrɔn yi enyim? Na obefi hɛn nkyɛn akɔ woana hɔ?
Na wotuu abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Kiriath-jearimfo hɔ, dɛ, Philistiafo dze Ewuradze n'adakaa no asan bio; hom mbra, na hom mbɛfa mfow nkɔ hom nkyɛn.
7: Na Kiriath-jearimfo bae bɛfaa Ewuradze n'adakaa no, na wɔdze baa Abinadab fie wɔ koko no do, na wɔtseew ne babanyin Eleazar ho dɛ ɔnhwɛ Ewuradze n'adakaa no do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, ofir da a adaka no tsenaa Kiriath-jearim no, mber no ɔkyɛree; na odzii mfe eduonu: Na Israel fi nyinara fee Ewuradze.

Na Samuel kasaa kyerɛɛ Israel fi nyinara dɛ, sɛ hom dze hom akoma nyinara resan aba Ewuradze hɔ a, ɔno hom nyi enyame ananaben no na Ashtaroth no mfi hom mu, na hom nsiesie hom akoma mma Ewuradze, na hom nsom no nko: Na ɔbɛgye hom efi Philistiafo nsamu.
Nna Israelmba yii Baalim na Ashtaroth no wɔ hɔ, na wɔsoom Ewuradze nko.
Na Samuel see dɛ, Hom mboaboa Israel nyinara ano nkɔ Mizpah, na monsɔr memma Ewuradze mma hom.
Na wokehyiae wɔ Mizpah, na wɔsaaw nsu, na wokohuei guu Ewuradze enyim, na wɔkyeen kɔm da no, na wɔsee wɔ hɔ dɛ, yɛayɛ bɔn etsia Ewuradze. Na Samuel buu Israelmba atsɛn wɔ Mizpah.
Na aber a Philistiafo tsee dɛ Israelmba ekehyia wɔ Mizpah no, Philistiafo mpanyimfo no kɔr Israel do. Na Israel tsee no, wosuroo Philistiafo no.
Na Isrealmba no see Samuel dɛ, mma nngyaa dɛ ibosu afrɛ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn ama hɛn, na ɔaagye hɛn efi Philistiafo nsamu.
Na Samuel faa eguambaa a onum, na ɔdze no bɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr imu maa Ewuradze: Na Samuel sūi frɛɛ Ewuradze maa Israel; na Ewuradze buaa no.

Na aber a Samuel robɔ ɔhyew-afɔr no, Philistiafo no twee pinii dɛ wɔnye Israel robɔkõ: Na Ewuradze maa asenaman paapaa kɛsenara da no guu Philistiafo do, na ɔkaa hɔn gui, na wɔtotɔree wɔ Israel enyim.
Na Israel mbarimba no fii Mizpah puei, na wotsiiw Philistiafo no, na wokunkum hɔn araa dze bodur Beth-car ase.
Nna Samuel faa ɔbo, na ɔdze sii Mizpah na Shen ntamu, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Ebenezer, dɛ, ha na Ewuradze aboa hɛn ebodu.
Nna wɔbrɛɛ Philistiafo no adze, na wɔammba Israel he mu bio: Na Ewuradze ne nsa daa Philistiafo do wɔ Samuel ne nda nyinara mu.
Na nkurow a Philistiafo agye no wɔ Israel hɔ nyinara sanee baa Israel hɔ bio, ofi Ekron araa dze kodur Gath; na ne he na Israel gyee fii Philistiafo nsamu. Na amandwee bɛdaa Israel na Amorifo ntamu.
Na Samuel buu Israel atsɛn no nkwa nda nyinara.
Na afrenhyia afrenhyia nyinara ɔkɔ kɔbɔ aprɔw wɔ Beth-el, na Gilgal, na Mizpah; na obu Israel atsɛn wɔ mbea nyinara do.
Na ɔsan a ɔba Ramah, na hɔ na ne fi wɔ; na hɔ na obu Israel atsɛn: Na osii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ maa Ewuradze.
8: Na ɔbaa dɛ, Samuel yɛɛ akɔdaa no, nna ɔyɛɛ ne mbabanyin atsɛmbuafo wɔ Israel do.
Na n'abakan ne dzin dze Joel; na nyia otsīa hɔ no dzin dze Abijah: Wɔyɛɛ atsɛmbuafo wɔ Beer-sheba.
Na ne mba annantsew n'akwan do, na wɔdanee kedzii mfaso ekyir, na wɔgyegyee mboaba, na wobubuu ntɛn kyew.
Nna Israel mpanyimfo nyinara boaboaa hɔn ano, na wɔbaa Samuel nkyɛn wɔ Ramah:
Na wɔsee no dɛ, hwɛ, ɔwo ayɛ akɔdaa, na wo mbabanyin so nnantsew w'akwan do: Afei hyɛ hen ma hɛn, na ombu hɛn atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ amanaman nyinara yɛ.
Na asɛm no Samuel ammpɛ, aber a wɔsee dɛ, ma hɛn ɔhen ma ombu hɛn atsɛn no. Na Samuel bɔɔ mpaa maa Ewuradze.
Na Ewuradze see Samuel dɛ, tsie ɔman no ndze wɔ dza wɔse wo nyinara mu: Na nnyɛ ɔwo bi na wɔapow wo na emi mbom na wɔapow me dɛ mma mma minndzi hɔn do hen.
Dɛ mbrɛ nyɛe a wɔayɛ nyinara ofitsi da a miyii hɔn wɔ Egypt bae, dze ebodu ndɛ, wɔ dɛ wɔapow me na wɔakɔsom enyame fofor no, dɛmara so na wɔdze reyɛ wo so.
Dɛm ntsi afei tsie hɔn ndze: Mbom dase na dzi kyerɛ hɔn papaara, na kyerɛ hɔn ɔhen a ɔbɔhwɛ hɔn do no ne nyɛe.
Na Samuel kãa Ewuradze ne nsɛm no nyinara kyerɛɛ ɔman no a wobisaa hen wɔ no hɔ no.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ɔhen a ɔbɔhwɛ hom do no mbrɛ ne nyɛe bɛyɛ nye yi: Ɔbɛfa hom mbabanyin, na ɔdze hɔn akɔ ne ntseaseanam, na no mpɔnkɔdofo mu; na wobotu mbirika edzi ne ntseaseanam enyim:
Na ɔdze hɔn ayɛ apem do asafohemfo, na eduonum eduonum do asafohemfo; na ɔbɛma binom adɔw n'asaase, na woebu no ndɔbaa, na wɔayɛ n'akodze, na ne ntseaseanam ho adze.
Na ɔbɛfa hom mbabaa ma wɔaayɛ adɔkɔdɔkɔdzeyɛfo, na sodofo, na boodoo-atofo.
Na ɔbɛgye hom nhaban na hom wenyin nture, na hom ngodua nture; mekyerɛ no mu papa no a, na ɔdze ama n'asomfo.
Na ɔbɛfa hom aba na hom wenyin nture no mu ebupɛn du du, na ɔdze ama n'asafohemfo na n'asomfo.
Na ɔbɛfa hom nkowaa, na hom mfonabaa, na hom mberantsɛ mu apapa no, na hom nsoaso, na ɔdze hɔn egu n'edwuma mu.
ɔbɛfa hom nguan mu ebupɛn du du: Na hom ayɛ no nkowaa.
Na da no hom bosū wɔ hom hen a hom asan mu afa no ntsi; na Ewuradze nnkobua hom da no.
Na ɔman no poow dɛ wobɛtsie Samuel ne ndze; na wɔsee dɛ, oho; ɔhen ara na yɛregye ma ɔaahwɛ hɛn do;
ma hɛn so yaayɛ dɛ mbrɛ amanaman nyinara tse; na ama hɛn hen eebu hɛn atsɛn, na oeepue edzi hɛn enyim, na ɔaakõ hɛn kõ.
Na Samuel tsee ɔman no hɔn nsɛm nyinara na ɔkɛkãa ne nyinara esiado wɔ Ewuradze asomu.
Na Ewuardze see Samuel dɛ, tsie hɔn ndze, na hyɛ ɔhen ma hɔn. Na Samuel see Israel mbarimba no dɛ, hom mu obiara nkɔ no kurow mu.
9: Afei ɔbarimba Benjaminnyi bi wɔ hɔ a ne dzin dze Kish, Abiel ne ba no, Zeror ne ba no, Becorath ne ba no, Aphiah ne ba no, Benjaminnyi bi ne ba no, nyimpa kunyin a.
Na ɔwɔ babanyin bi a ne dzin dze Saul, aberantsɛ a n'enyim wɔ nyam: Na nyimpa a nnyi Israelmba no nyinara mu a n'enyim wɔ nyam sen no: Ofi n'abatsir kɔ sor no ɔwar sen ɔman no mu obiara.
Na Saul n'egya Kish no nsoaso yewee. Na Kish see ne ba Saul dɛ, afei fa nkowaa no mu kor ka woho, na soɛr kɔ, kɔhwehwɛ nsoaso no.
Na okekyimaa Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu, na okekyimaa Shalishah asaase no do, na oennhu hɔn: Na okekyimaa Shaalim asaase do, na wonnyi hɔ: Na okekyimaa Benjaminfo asaase do, na oennhu hɔn.
Na aber a wɔbaa Zuph asaase no do no, Saul see n'akowaa a ɔka no ho no dɛ, bra ma yɛnsan nkɔ; amma m'egya eenngyaa nsoaso no ho adwendwen na ɔaanndwen hɛn ho.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, afei hwɛ, Nyame nyimpa bi wɔ kurow yi mu, na ɔyɛ nyimpa a wodzi no nyi; dza ɔkã nyinara ɔba mu; afei ma yɛnkɔ hɔ, annyɛ a ɔbɛkã hɛn akwantu yi mu ho bi akyerɛ hɛn.
Nna Saul see n'akowaa no dɛ, hwɛ, na sɛ yɛkɔ a, ebɛnadze na yɛdze bɛkɛma ɔbarimba no? na hɛn adze mu edziban asã, na akyɛdze biara nnyi hɔ a yɛdze rekɛma Nyame nyimpa no: Yɛwɔ ebɛnadze?
Na akowaa no buaa Saul bio, na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, mowɔ dwetɛ shekel ebupɛn anan mu kor wɔ me nsamu: Ɔno na medze mebɛma Nyame nyimpa no, ma ɔaakyerɛ hɛn hɛn kwan.
(Nkan no Israel mu sɛ nyimpa bi rikebisa Nyame hɔ adze a, mbrɛ ɔse nye yi, bra ma yɛnkɔ adzehunyi no hɔ: Na dza ndɛ wɔfrɛ no Nkɔnhyɛnyi yi nkan no wɔfrɛ no Adzehunyi).
Nna Saul see n'akowaa no dɛ, mbo-na-kã; bra ma yɛnkɔ. Nna wɔkɔr kurow a Nyame nyimpa no wɔ mu no mu.
Na wɔrofow kurow no n'afowee no wohun nkataasia a worupue akɛsaw nsu, na wɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana adzehunyi bi wɔ hɔ?
Na wobuaa hɔn, na wɔsee dɛ, ɔwɔ hɔ; hwɛ, odzi w'enyim: Afei ka woho, na ɔaba kurow no mu ndɛ; na ɔman no wɔ afɔr ndɛ wɔbɔ no wɔ bea sorɔnsorɔm no do:

Hom du kurow no mu a, ntsɛmara wobohu no ansaana ɔakɔ bea sorɔnsorɔm no do oekedzidzi: Na ɔman no wonnkedzidzi kyerɛ ɔba ana, osiandɛ ɔno na ohyira afɔr no do; na n'ekyir no hɔn a woehyira hɔn no wodzidzi. Dɛm ntsi afei hom mfow nkɔ; na aber yi ara na hom bohu no.
Na wɔfowee kɔr kurow no mu no, hwɛ, Samuel puei behyiaa hɔn, dɛ ɔrokɔfow akɔ bea sorɔnsorɔm no do.
Afei Ewuradze eyi akyerɛ Samuel da a adze rebɛkye ma Saul aba no dɛ,

ɔkyena bɛyɛ siseber yi mobɔsoma nyimpa bi fi Benjamin asaase do wɔ wo hɔ, na sera no ngo hyɛ no panyin wɔ me man Israel do, ma ɔngye me man mfi Philistiafo nsamu: Na m'enyi aba me man do, osiandɛ hɔn sū edu m'enyim.
Na Samuel hun Saul no, Ewuradze see no dɛ, hwɛ nyimpa a mekãa no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ wo no! oyiara na ɔbɛhyɛ me man do.
Nna Saul twee piin Samuel nkyɛn wɔ kuropon no ano, na ɔsee dɛ, meserɛ wo, kyerɛ me mbrɛ adzehunyi no ne fie wɔ.
Na Samuel buaa Saul na ɔsee dɛ, emi nye adzehunyi no; hom ndzi m'enyim kan nkɔ bea sorɔnsorɔm no do, na hom nye me bedzidi ndɛ: Na anapa mebɛma akɔ, na mebɛkã dza ɔwɔ w'akoma mu nyinara makyerɛ wo.
Na wo nsoaso no a wɔyeew ndɛ ndaansa nedze, mma mmfa w'adwen nnkɔ hɔn do, na woehu hɔn. Na woana na dza oye wɔ Israel nyinara yɛ no dze? Ana nnyɛ ɔwo na w'egya fi nyinara dze bi a.

Na Saul buae na ɔsee dɛ, ana mennyɛ Benjaminnyi a mifi Israel mbusuakuw mu aketsewaba no mu bi a? Na m'ebusua nye Benjamin ebusuakuw mu ebusua ebusua nyinara mu kakraba no bi a? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na ekasa dɛm kyerɛ me yi?
Na Samuel faa Saul na n'akowaa no, na ɔdze hɔn baa edzidzidan no mu, na ɔmaa wɔtsenaa hɔn a wohyiaa hɔn edzidzi, bɛyɛ eduasa no, hɔn mu mbrɛ ɔkrɔn.
Na Samuel see edzibanyɛfo no dɛ, fa nankum a medze memaa wo no a mesee wo dɛ, fa sie wo nkyɛn no, bra.

Na sodonyi no kɛfaa aserɛ no, na dza ɔwɔ ho no, na ɔdze besii Saul n'enyim. Na Samuel see dɛ, hwɛ dza wɔdze esie! Fa si w'enyim na dzi; osiandɛ wɔdze esie wo abɛpem mber a wɔahyɛ no: Na mesee dɛ, mehyia ɔman no. Nna Saul nye Samuel dzidzii da no.
Na wofii bea sorɔnsorɔm no do sianee baa kurow no mu no, ɔnye Saul twetwee nkɔmbɔ wɔ dan etsifi.
Na wɔsoɛɛr anapaatu: Na ɔbaa dɛ adze rekye no, nna Samuel frɛɛ Saul wɔ dan etsifi dɛ, soɛr ma minkegya wo kwan. Nna Sual soɛree, beenu nyina, ɔnoara na Samuel, na wopuee gua do.
Worukodu kurotsia no, Samuel see Saul dɛ, kã kyerɛ akowaa no ma ɔmpa ho nkedzi hɛn enyim, (na ɔpaa ho), na ɔwodze afei gyina hɔ komm ma memma tsie Nyankopɔn n'asɛm.
10: Nna Samuel faa ngo toaba no, na ohuei guu ne tsir do, na ɔfeew n'ano, na ɔsee dɛ, ana nnyɛ Ewuradze na ɔdze ngo egu wo do ahyɛ wo hen wɔ m'egyapadze do bi a?

Sɛ isi mu fi me nkyɛn ndɛ rokɔ a, ɔno ibohu mberantsɛ beenu wɔ Rachel ne nda no nkyɛn, wɔ Benjamin he do wɔ Zelzah; na wɔbɛse wo dɛ, nsoaso no a ekɔr dɛ erokɔhwehwɛ no woehu hɔn; na, hwɛ, w'egya egyaa nsoaso no ho dwen, na ɔrodwen hom ho dɛ, me ba yi meyɛ no dɛn?

Nkyii ifi hɔ ekɔ kan, na ibodu Tabor esudur no ho a, enye mbarimba baasa behyia hɔ a wɔrofow akɔ Nyankopɔn hɔ wɔ Beth-el, ɔbaako so mpɔnkyemba ebiasa, na ɔbaako so so boodoo ntɔwmu ebiasa, na ɔbaako so so wenyin bɔdambɔ:
Na wobekyia wo, na wɔdze boodoo ntɔwmu ebien ama wo; na agye no wɔ hɔn nsamu.

Ɔno n'ekyir no ibodu Nyankopɔn no kokoe no ho, mbrɛ Philistiafo bansifo no wɔ no: Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ isi kurow no mu hɔ a, ibehyia nkɔnhyɛfo kuw a wofi bea soronsorɔm no do resian a wɔdze bɛnta-sanku na mpintsin, na abɛn a, na nsanku dzi hɔn enyim; na wɔrehyɛ nkɔm:
Na Ewuradze no sunsum bɛba wo do dzendzenndzen, na enye hɔn bɛhyɛ nkɔm, na adan ayɛ nyimpa fofor.
Na ma ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze yi ba mu ma wo a, yɛ dɛ mbrɛ obesi w'enyim no ara; na Nyankopɔn dzi w'ekyir.
Na dzi m'enyim kan sian kɔ Gilgal; na, hwɛ, mebɛba wo nkyɛn mabɔbɔ ɔhye-afɔr, na okum asomdwee-afɔr; nda esuon na tsintsim araa kɛpem aber a mebɛba wo nkyɛn, na mabɛkyerɛ wo dza yɛ.
Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm, dɛ aber a ɔdaan noho fi Samuel nkyɛn rokɔ no, Nyankopɔn maa no akoma fofor: Na nsɛnkyerɛdze no nyinara baa mu da no ara.
Na wɔbaa koko no do hɔ no, hwɛ, nkɔnhyɛfo no kuw nye no hyiae; na Nyankopɔn no sunsum baa no do dzendzenndzen, na ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm wɔ hɔn mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, hɔn a wonyim no dada no hun dɛ, hwɛ, ɔnye nkɔnhyɛfo no rehyɛ nkɔm no, nna nkorɔfo no sesee hɔnho nkorkor dɛ, ebɛnadze na aba Kish ba no do yi? Ana Saul so dɔm nkɔnhyɛfo no a?
Na obi a ofi hɔ ara buae na ɔsee dɛ, na hɔn egya nye woana? Dɛm ntsi ɔbɛyɛɛ fen dɛ, ana Saul so dɔm nkɔnhyɛfo no a?
Na owiee nkɔm hyɛ no, ɔbaa bea sorɔnsorɔm no do.
Na Saul n'egyanua see ɔno na n'akowaa no, dɛ, henfa na hom kɔree? Na ɔsee dɛ, yɛkɔhwehwɛɛ nsoasoa no: Na yehun dɛ wonnyi beebiara no na yɛkɔr Samuel hɔ.
Na Saul n'agyanua no see dɛ, meserɛ wo, kã dza Samuel kãa kyerɛɛ hom no kyerɛɛ hom no kyerɛ me.
Na Saul see n'agyanua no dɛ, ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɛn kotoo dɛ woehu nsoaso no. Na ahendzi no ho asɛm no a Samuel kãe no dze, ɔannkã annkyerɛ no.
Na Samuel hyiaa ɔman no ma wɔbaa Ewuradze nkyɛn wɔ Mizpah;
na ɔsee Israelmba no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no ɔse nye yi, emi na medzi Israel fii Egypt bae, na megyee hom wɔ Egyptfo nsamu:

Na ndɛ da yi hom apow hom Nyankopɔn a ɔnoara na ogyaa hom wɔ hom amandzehu na hom ahohiahia nyinara mu; na hom ase no dɛ, oho, ɔhen ara, na hyɛ no wɔ hɛn do. Dɛm ntsi afei hom mfa homho mbɛkyerɛ wɔ Ewuradze enyim dɛ mbrɛ hom ebusuakuw ebusuakuw na hom mpempem tsetsee.
Nna Samuel maa Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw bɛsenee, na woyii Benjamin ebusuakuw no.
Na ɔmaa Benjamin ebusuakuw no bɛnee dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, na woyii Matrifo ebusua no: Na woyii Kish ne ba Saul; na wɔhwehwɛɛ no no woennhu no.
Dɛm ntsi wobisaa Ewuradze bio dɛ, ana nyimpa no benya aba ha ana? Na Ewuradze buaa dɛ, hwɛ, ɔdze noho ekosuma dzɛmba no mu.
Na wotuu mbirinka kɛfaa no wɔ hɔ bae; na aber a obegyinaa ɔman no mu no, nna ɔbɔ ɔman no nyinara do ofi n'abatsir do kɔ sor.
Na Samuel see ɔman no nyinara dɛ, hom nhwɛ nyia Ewuradze asan mu eyi no no, kyerɛdɛ obiara nye no nnsɛ wɔ ɔman no nyinara mu? Na ɔman no nyinara bɔɔ se see dɛ, Nyame ngye ɔhen nkwa.
Nna Samuel kãa ahendzi no no suban kyerɛɛ ɔman no, na ɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ nwoma mu, na ɔdze too Ewuradze enyim. Na Samuel gyaa ɔman no nyinara kwan na wɔkɔree, nyimpa biara kɔr ne fie.
Na Saul so kɔr ne fie wɔ Gibeah; na dɔm no a Nyankopɔn akã hɔn akoma no nye no kɔree.
Na Bilial mba bi dze wɔsee dɛ, nyimpa yi bɛyɛ dɛn agye hɛn nkwa? Na wobuu no enyimtsia, na wɔammfa akyɛdze ammbrɛ no. Na ɔannkasa.
11: Nna Ammonnyi Nahash bae, na ɔbɛkyeer Jabesh-gilead do nsera: Na Jabesh mbarimba no nyinara see Nahash dɛ, enye hɛn ndzi ahyɛmu, na yɛnsom wo.
Na Ammonnyi Nahash see hɔn dɛ, dza mibegyina do menye hom ayɛ nye dɛ wobotutu hom enyiwa enyimfa nyinara; na medze mebɛyɛ enyimguase mato Israel nyinara do.
Na Jabesh mpanyimfo no see no dɛ, ma hɛn mu kwan nda esuon, ma yentutu abɔfo ma wɔnkɔ Israel ntoaado nyinara: Na sɛ obi nnyi hɔ a ɔbɛgye hɛn nkwa a, ɔno yɛaba wo hɔ.
Nna abɔfo no baa Saul Gibeah, na wɔbɛkãa nsɛm yi wɔ ɔman no asomu: Na ɔman no nyinara memaa hɔn ndze do na wosūi.
Na, hwɛ, Saul ka anantwi do fi haban mu reba; na Saul see dɛ, ebɛnadze na ɔyɛ ɔman no yi ma worusū yi? Na wɔkãa Jabeshfo nsɛm no kyerɛɛ no.
Na Saul tsee nsɛm no, Nyame sunsum baa no do dzendzenndzen, na n'ebufuw dzɛɛw kɛsenara.

Na ɔfaa anantwi ebien, na otwitwaa hɔn mu esinesin, na ɔdze hyɛɛ abɔfo nsa somae ma wɔdze kekyimaa Israel ntoaado nyinara, dɛ, obiara a oemmfir edzi emmbedzi Saul na Samuel ekyir no mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ n'anantwi nye yi. Na Ewuradze no ho hu tɔɔ ɔman no do, na wofiir ezdi baa dɛ nyimpa kor.
Na ɔkaan hɔn wɔ Bezek; na Israelmba no wɔyɛ mpemahaasa, na Judahmba no wɔyɛ mpemeduasa.
Na wɔsee abɔfo a wɔbae no dɛ, dza wɔnkɛkã nkyerɛ Jabesh-gilead nye yi, ɔkyena aber a iwi ano reyɛ dzen no, nna wɔagye hom. Na abɔfo no bae na wɔbɛkãa kyerɛɛ Jabeshfo; na ɔyɛɛ hɔn dɛw.
Dɛm ntsi Jabeshfo see dɛ, yebefir edzi aba hom nkyɛn ɔkyena, ma hom aayɛ hɛn dza homara hwɛ a oye nyinara.

Na n'adzekyeenyim no ɔyɛɛ dɛm dɛ Saul buaee ɔman no mu ekuw ebiasa; na wɔbaa nsera no mu anapa dasu mu, na wɔbae bokunkum Ammonfo ara ma okodur adzekyee ne hyew no: Na ɔbaa dɛ, hɔn a wɔkae no wɔbɔe petsee, ma hɔn mu beenu mpo annka fakor.
Nna ɔman no see Samuel dɛ, woana na ɔsee dɛ, aso Saul na obedzi hɛn do hen no? Wɔmfa nyimpa no mbra ma yenku hɔn.
Na Saul see dɛ, worunnku nyimpa biara ndɛ da yi: Osiandɛ ndɛ Ewuradze ayɛ nkwagye edwuma wɔ Israel.
Nna Samuel see ɔman no dɛ, hom mbra ma yɛnkɔ Gilgal, na yɛnkɛyɛ ahendzi no fofor wɔ hɔ.

Na ɔman no nyinara kɔr Gilgal; na hɔ na wɔhyɛɛ Saul ɔhen wɔ Ewuradze enyim wɔ Gilgal; na hɔ na wɔbobɔɔ okum asomdwee-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na hɔ na Saul na Israel mbarimba nyinara dzii ehurusi kɛsenara.
12: Na Samuel see Israel nyinara dɛ, hwɛ, metsie hom ndze wɔ dza hom see me no nyinara mu, na mahyɛ hom do hen.
Na afei, hwɛ, ɔhen no na odzi hom enyim yi: Na emi mayɛ akɔdaa, na me tsir ehuro gon; na, hwɛ, me mbabanyin wɔnye hom wɔ hɔ: Na manantsew hom enyim fi mo mbofra mu dze ebodu ndɛ da yi.

Emi nye yi: Wɔngye mo ho dase wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na ne nyia wɔasera no yi n'enyim: Woana ne nantwi na mafa? Anaa woana na mesisi no? Woana na matseetsee no? anaa woana ne nsamu na magye mboaba dɛ medze rekata m'enyiwa? Na mebɛhyɛ hom ananmu.
Na wɔsee dɛ, innsisii hɛn, enntseetsee hɛn so, nkyii so enngyee obiara ne nsamu biribiara.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ewuradze dzi dase dze tsia hom, na ne nyia wɔasera no no dzi dase ndɛ, dɛ hom nnhun biribiara wɔ me nsamu. Na wɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ dasefo.
Na Samuel see ɔman no dɛ, Ewuradze na ɔhyɛɛ Moses na Aaron, na oyii hom egyanom fii Egypt asaase do bae.
Dɛm ntsi afei hom ngyina dzen, ma menye hom nyi atsɛn wɔ Ewuradze enyim wɔ Ewuradze ne tsenenee ndwuma nyinara a ɔyɛe maa hom na egyanom no ho.
Aber a Jacob baa Egypt, na hom egyanom kekaa mu frɛɛ Ewuradze no, nna Ewuradze somaa Moses na Aaron, ma wokeyii hom egyanom fii Egypt, na wɔmaa wɔbɛtsenatsenaa ha yi.
Na hɔn werɛ fiir Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn, na ɔtɔɔn hɔn hyɛɛ Hazor ne sahen Sisera nsa na Philistiafo nsa, na Moabhen nsa, na wɔnye hɔn kõe.
Na wɔkekaa mu frɛɛ Ewuradze, na wɔsee dɛ, yɛayɛ bɔn, osiandɛ yɛapow Ewuradze, na yɛakɔsom Baalim na Ashtaroth: Na afei dze gye hɛn fi hɛn atamfo nsamu, na yɛbɔsom wo.
Nna Ewuradze somaa Jerubbaal, na Bedan, na Jephthan, na Samuel, ma wɔbɛgyee hom fii atamfo nsamu hyiae, ma hom tsenaa dwudwoodwo.
Na aber a hom hun dɛ Ammonmba hɔn hen Nahash etu reba hom do no, hom see no dɛ, oho, na ɔhen na ɔmbɔhwɛ hɛn do: Aber a Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn na ɔyɛ hom hen no.
Dɛm ntsi afei, hom nhwɛ, ɔhen a hom asan mu afa no, na nyia hom ebisa no no nye yi, na, hwɛ, Ewuradze ahyɛ hom do hen.
Sɛ hom rusuro Ewuradze, na hom asom no, na hom etsie ne ndze, na hom renntsew Ewuradze ne mbrasɛm do etūa, na hom na ɔhen a ɔhwɛ hom do no nyina reyɛ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn akadofo a, oye.
Na sɛ hom enntsie Ewuradze ne ndze, na hom tsew Ewuradze ne mbrasɛm do etūa a, ɔno Ewuradze nsa bɛtsēa hom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtsēaa hom egyanom no.
Dɛm ntsi afei, hom ngyina dzen na wɔnhwɛ adze kɛse yi a Ewuradze rebɛyɛ no hom enyiwa do yi.
Ana nnyɛ ewifua twaber nye ndɛ bi a? Merefrɛ Ewuradze, ma ɔaama asenaman na nsu aba; na hom aahwɛ ehu dɛ hom ndzebɔn a hom ayɛ no wɔ Ewuradze enyim dɛ hom ebisa ɔhen ama homho no ɔsõ.
Nna Samuel frɛɛ Ewuradze, na Ewuradze maa asenaman na nsu baa da no: Na ɔman no nyinara suroo Ewuradze na Samuel kɛsenara.
Na ɔman no nyinara see Samuel dɛ, sɔr ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ma wo nkowaa, amma yeennwuwu: Na yɛdze bɔn yi aka hɛn bɔn nyinara ho, dɛ yeebisa ɔhen ama hɛnho.
Na Samuel see ɔman no dɛ, mma hom nnsuro: Hom ayɛ bɔn yi nyinara ampa: Naaso mma wɔnnsan hom ekyir dɛ wɔrennka Ewuradze do bio, na wɔmfa hom akoma nyinara nsom Ewuradze;
na mma hom nndan mfa nkyɛn: Ɔnodze hom bekedzi ndzɛmba gyangyan a ɔnnyɛ mfaso, eso onntum nngye nkwa no ekyir, osiandɛ adze gyangyan a.
Na osian Ewuradze ne dzin kɛse no ntsi ɔnnkɔpow ne man: Osiandɛ ɔayɛ Ewuradze fɛw dɛ ɔbɛyɛ hom ɔman ama noho.
Nkyii so emidze, Nyame mpa ngu dɛ mebɛyɛ bɔn metsia Ewuradze dɛ mibegyaa dɛ mosɔr mema hom: Mbom mebɛkyerɛkyerɛ hom wɔ ɔkwan a oye na ɔtsen no mu.
Osuro nko na hom nsuro Ewuradze, na wɔmfa hom akoma nyinara nsom no nokwar mu: Na wɔndwen ndzɛmba akɛseakɛse a ɔayɛ ama hom no ho.
Na sɛ bɔn ara na hom bɛda ho ayɛ dze a, ɔno hom bɛhyew, hom na hom hen nyina.
13: Saul hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduasa; na odzii Israel do hen mfe ebien.

Na Saul saan mu yii Israel mu mbarimba mpensa maa noho: Na hɔn mu mpenu wɔ Saul nkyɛn wɔ Michmash na Beth-el bepɔw do, na apem wɔ Jonathan nkyɛn wɔ Benjamin Gibeah: Na ɔmaa ɔman nkaa no mu nyimpa biara kɔr n'asesee mu.
Na Jonathan kum Philistiafo hɔn bansifo a wɔwɔ Geba no, na Philistiafo tsee, na Saul bɔɔ abɛn mu wɔ asaase no do nyinara dɛ, wɔmma Hebrewfo ntse.
Na Israel nyinara tsee dɛ Saul eku Philistiafo hɔn bansifo no, na dɛ Philistiafo ekyir Israel. Na wohyiahyiaa aman no boaa ano kedzii Saul ekyir kɔr Gilgal.

Na Philistiafo boaboaa hɔn ano wɔnye Israel robɔkõ, ntseaseanam npemeduasa, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemesia, na nkorɔfo a hɔn dodow yɛ dɛ mpoano anhwea: Na wɔbae, na wɔbɛkyeer nsera wɔ Michmash, wɔ Bethaven no boka afamu.
Na Israel mbarimba hun dɛ akyer hɔn do no, (osiandɛ ɔman no hɔn ho hiahiaa hɔn), nna ɔman no dze hɔnho kosumasumaa abu-tu, na ndɔtɔ, na abotan, na amona mu.
Afei Hebrewfo no bi twaa Jordan kɔr Gad na Gilead asaase do; na Saul dze, ɔda ho wɔ Gilgal, na ɔman no nyinara wɔdze ahopopo dzi n'ekyir.
Na otsintsiim nda esuon, dɛ mbrɛ mber a Samuel hyɛɛ no tse no ara: Na Samuel dze ɔammba Gilgal; na ɔman no fii ne nkyɛn petsee
Na Saul see dɛ, wɔmfa ɔhyew-afɔr no mbrɛ me ha, na asomdwee afɔr no. Na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ owiee ɔhyew-afɔr no bɔ ara pɛ, na hwɛ, Samuel bae; na Saul puei behyiaa no kwan, dɛ orikehyia no.
Na Samuel see dɛ, ebɛnadze na ayɛ yi? na Saul see dɛ, osiandɛ muhun dɛ ɔman no efi me nkyɛn apetse, na wo so ammba aber a ehyɛe no mu, na Philistiafo aboa hɔn ano wɔ Michmash no;
dɛm ntsi na mesee dɛ, afei Philistiafo rebɛba mo do wɔ Gilgal, nna mennserɛ Ewuradze n'adom yi: Dɛm ntsi na mehyɛɛ moho mobɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr no a.
Na Samuel see Saul dɛ, ayɛ nkwaseadze: Enndzi Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ne mbrasɛm a ɔhyɛɛ wo no do; na afei na nkyɛ Ewuradze rebɛma w'ahendzi etsim wɔ Israel do daa.
