Na afei dze w'ahendzi nnkɛda ho atsena hɔ: Ewuradze ahwehwɛ nyimpa a n'akoma da no ho ama noho, na Ewuradze ahyɛ no dɛ ɔnyɛ ɔhen wɔ ne man do.
Na Samuel soɛree, na ofi Gilgal kɔr Benjamin Gibeah. Na Saul kaan nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn hɔ no, bɛyɛ nyimpa ahaesia.
Na Saul ne ba Jonathan na nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ hɔn nkyɛn hɔ no, wɔtsenaa Benjamin Geba: Na Philistiafo dze wɔbɔɔ asese wɔ Michmash.
Na adzesɛɛfo fii Philistiafo nsera mu wɔnam no ekuw ebiasa puei: Kuw kor danee faa Ophrah kwan no kɔr Shual asaase do:
Na kuw kor so danee faa Bethhoron kwan do: Na kow kor so danee faa ɔhe a ɔhwɛ Zeboim bɔnsa ne tsentsendo no no kwan do kɔr sar no do afamu.
Afei na ɔtomfo biara nnyi Israel asaase do beebiara: Osiandɛ Philistiafo see dɛ, bɛyɛ na Hebrewfo abobɔ mfõwa na mpeaa:
Mbom Israel nyinara wɔkɔ Philistiafo hɔ, ma nyimpa biara kɛsew no funtumdadze, na n'asɔw, na n'ekuma na no tutudaadze;
naaso wɔwɔ ntutudaadze na nsɔw, na ndaadzefē, na nkuma no ho kitaa; na dza wɔdze sew nsɔsɔw.
Dɛm ntsi ɔbaa dɛ kõ da no mu, woennhu afõwa anaa peaa wɔ ɔman a wɔwɔ Saul na Jonathan nkyɛn hɔ no mu biara nsamu: Na Saul na ne ba Jonathan nsamu na wohun bi.
Na Philistiafo hɔn bansifo no puei faa Michmash afae.
14: Afei ɔbaa dɛ da bi Saul ne ba Jonathan see aberantsɛ a ɔso n'akodze no dɛ, bra ma yɛnkɔ Philistiafo hɔn bansifo a wɔwɔ noho no nkyɛn. Na ɔannkã annkyerɛ n'egya.
Na Saul tse Gibeah no kurotsia noho ara wɔ pomegranate dua a ɔwɔ Migron no n'ase: Na nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn hɔ wɔbɛyɛ nyimpa ahaesia;
na Ahijah, Ewuradze no sɔfoe Eli a ɔtse Shiloh ne ba Phinehas ne ba Ichabod no nua Ahitub ne ba no, na ɔhyɛ ephod no. Na ɔman no nnyim dɛ Jonathan kɔ.
Na afae a Jonathan ɔhwehwɛ dɛ ɔfa mu kɔ Philistiafo hɔ bansifo no nkyɛn no ne ntamu n'afã ha wɔ ɔbotan mpatantwer: Na kor ne dzin dze Bozez, na kor so ne dzin dze Seneh.
Mpatantwer kor soɛr wɔ kwaamu afamu wɔ Michmash tsentsendo, na kor so wɔ pomu afamu wɔ Geba ne tsentsendo.

Na Jonathan see aberantsɛ a ɔso n'akodze no dɛ, bra ma yɛnkɔ monomonomfo yi hɔn bansifo no nkyɛn: Annyɛ a gyangyanbiara Ewuradze bedzi dwuma ama hɛn: Osiandɛ biribiara nnsiw Ewuradze kwan dɛ ɔdze pii anaa kumaabi bɛgye nkwa.
Na n'akodzesoafo no see no dɛ, yɛ dza ɔwɔ w'akoma mu nyinara; dan woho, hwɛ meka wo ho dɛ mbrɛ w'akoma pɛ no ara.
Nna Jonathan see dɛ, yebotwa mu akɔ nkorɔfo no nkyɛn, na yebeyi hɛnho akyerɛ hɔn.
Sɛ wɔse hɛn dɛm, dɛ, wontsintsim ma wɔmbra hɛn nkyɛn ana a; ɔno yebegyina hɛn ananmu dzinn, na yɛnnkɔkɔ hɔn nkyɛn.
Na sɛ wɔse dɛm, dɛ, wɔmbra hɛn nkyɛn a; ɔno yɛbɔkɔ: Osiandɛ Ewuradze eyi hɔn ahyɛ hɛn nsa: Na iyi na ɔbɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze ama hɛn.
Na hɔn beenu nyina yii hɔnho edzi kyerɛɛ Philistiafo hɔn bansifo no: Na Philistiafo no see dɛ, wɔnhwɛ, Hebrewfo no efifi etu a wokosumasumaa mu no mu epue wɔreba.
Na bansifo no buaa Jonathan na n'akodzesoafo no, na wɔsee dɛ, wɔmbra hɛn nkyɛn, na yɛnkyerɛ hom biribi. Na Jonathan see n'akodzesoafo no dɛ, bra bedzi m'ekyir, na Ewuradze eyi hɔn ahyɛ Israel nsa.
Na Jonathan dze ne nsa na n'anan fowee na n'akodzesoafo no dzii n'ekyir: Na wɔtotɔr Jonathan n'enyim; na n'akodzesoafo no dzii n'ekyir kunkum hɔn.
Na ku a odzi kan a Jonathan na n'akodzesoafo no kumii no, ɔbɛyɛ nyimpa eduonu, ɔbɛyɛ nantwi mpamho funtum kwan fã do.
Na ahopopo baa nseraban no mu, haban no mu, na ɔman no nyinara hɔn mu; bansifo no na adzesɛɛfo no, hɔn so hɔn ho popoe: Na asaase wosowee; nna ahohim kɛse mbordo baa hɔ.
Na Saul n'aweɔmfo a wɔwɔ Benjamin-Gibeah no wɔhwɛe, na hwɛ, nyimpa dodow no wɔrotwe, na wɔkɔ ha ba ha.
Na Saul see nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no dɛ, afei wɔnkan na wonhu nyia oefi hɛn mu kɔ. Na wɔkanee no, na, hwɛ, Jonathan na n'akodzesoafo no wonnyi hɔ.
Na Saul see Ahijah dɛ, fa Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no bra ha. Osiandɛ aber no na Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no wɔ Israelmba nkyɛn wɔ hɔ.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Saul rekasa kyerɛ ɔsɔfo no, nna begyabegya no a ɔbaa Philistiafo hɔn asesee mu no da ho ara dze mu, na ɔyɛɛ kɛse: Na Saul see ɔsɔfo no dɛ, twe wo nsa.
Na Saul na nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no nyinara, wɔboaa ano, na wɔbaa akono: Na, hwɛ, hɔn nyinara wɔdze hɔn mfõwa dzii hɔnho mpatakitsa, na ɔkõ mbusu kɛsenara baa hɔ.
Afei Hebrewfo a wɔnye Philistiafo wɔ hɔ dɛ nkan no a wofii hɔn nkyɛn kɔr nseraban no mu, wofi ɔman a etwa ho ehyia no mu, hɔn so mpo danee bɛkaa Israelfo a wɔka Saul na Jonathan ho no ho.
Dɛmara so na Israel mbarimba a wɔdze hɔnho kosumaa Ephraim nkokodo nkurow mu no, wɔtsee dɛ Philistiafo eguan no, hɔn so mpo wotui taa hɔn do wɔ ɔkõ no mu.
Nna Ewuradze gyee israel nkwa da no: Na ɔkõ no twaa mu traa Beth-aven.

Na Israel mbarimba tseetsee da no: Na Saul kãa ntam guu ɔman no do, dɛ, mpaa nka nyimpa a obedzi edziban biara kyerɛ ewimbir ana, na mindzi m'atamfo wer. Dɛm ntsi ɔman no mu obiara ammfa edziban annkã n'ano.
Na ɔman no nyinara baa kwaa no mu no; na ewo wɔ daadze no do.
Na aber a ɔman no baa kwaa no mu no, hwɛ, nna ewo rososɔ na nyimpa biara ammfa ne nsa annkɔ n'ano, na ɔman no suro ntam no.
Na Jonathan dze, aber a n'egya dze ntam rebra ɔman no, ɔanntse: Dɛm ntsi ɔdze poma a ɔdze ne nsamu no n'ano dze bɔɔ ewokyɛm no mu, na ɔdze ne nsa kɔr n'ano; na n'enyiwa do tsetseew no.
Nna ɔman no mu obi buae see dɛ, w'egya dze ntam abra ɔman no ketsee dɛ, nyimpa a obedzi edziban bi ndɛ da yi no mpaa nkã no. Na nkorɔfo no tɔɔ bitsi.
Nna Jonathan see dɛ, M'egya afona asaase yi: Meserɛ hom, hom nhwɛ, osiandɛ mekãa ewo kakra mohwɛe ntsi, mbrɛ m'enyiwa do edua atsetsew me.
Na nna sɛ ɔman yi dzii hɔn atamfo asadze a wonyae no bi mbɔ ɛ? Na afei oku kɛse ammba Philistiafo no mu.
Na da no wokum Philistiafo no bi fi Michmash kodur Aijalon: Na ɔman no tɔɔ bitsi dodoodow.
Na ɔman no tui hyɛɛ asadze no do, na wɔfaa nguan, na anantwi, na anantwimba, na wokunkum hɔn wɔ daadze: Na ɔman dze bɔgya kaa ho dzii.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛ Saul dɛ, hwɛ, ɔman no reyɛ bɔn tsia Ewuradze, dɛ wɔdze bɔgyaa aka ho redzi. Na ɔsee dɛ, hom etwa nkontompɔ: Wompirew ɔbo kɛse mbrɛ me ndɛ.

Na Saul see dɛ, hom mpetse nkɔ ɔman no mu, na wɔnkɛse hɔn dɛ, nyimpa biara mfa ne nantwi, na nyimpa biara mfa no guan mbrɛ me ha, na wonkumkum hɔn wɔ ha ndzi: Na mma wɔnnyɛ bɔn nntsia Ewuradze dɛ wɔdze bɔgyaa no bɛka ho edzi. Na ɔman no nyinara mu nyimpa biara dze ne nantwi baa anago no, na wokunkum hɔn wɔ hɔ.
Na Saul sii afɔrmbukyia maa Ewuradze: Ɔnoara nye afɔrmbukyia kan dze a osii maa Ewuradze.

Na Saul see dɛ, hom mma yensian nketsiw Philistiafo anago yi, na yɛnsɛɛ hɔn nkodu adzekyee, na mma yenngyaa hɔn mu nyimpa biara. Na wɔsee dɛ, Biribiara a oye wɔ w'enyi do no, yɛ. Nna ɔsɔfo no see dɛ, hom mma yɛntwe mpin Nyankopɔn nkyɛn wɔ ha.
Na Saul bisaa Nyankopɔn hɔ apam dɛ, ana minsian minketsiw Philistiafo no anaa? Ana ibeyi hɔn ahyɛ Israel nsa a? Na oemmbua no da no.
Na Saul see dɛ, hom ntwe mpin ha, hom ɔman nu etsiber nyinara: Na hom nhwɛ na wonhu adze kor a bɔn yi wɔ mu ndɛ da yi.
Na dɛ Ewuradze a ɔgye Israel nkwa tse ase yi, sɛ ɔwɔ me ba Jonathan mpo mu a, owu na obowu. Na ɔman no nyinara mu nyimpa biara emmbua no.
Nna ɔsee Israel nyinara dɛ, hom nkedzi fakor, ma emi nye me ba Jonathan so nkedzi fakor. Na ɔman no see Saul dɛ, dza ɔye wɔ w'enyi do no yɛ.
Dɛm ntsi Saul see Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, dɛ, da nokwar edzi. Na tonto bɔɔ Jonathan na Samuel: Na ɔman no wofii mu.
Na Saul see dɛ, hom ntwe emi na me ba Jonathan ntamu tonto. Na ɔbɔɔ Jonathan.
Nna Saul see Jonathan dɛ, kã dza ayɛ kyerɛ me. Na Jonathan kãa kyerɛ no, see dɛ, ɔkã na medze me poma a ɔdze me nsamu no n'ano mekãa ewo kakra mosɔe mohwɛe; na, hwɛ, mubowu ara.
Na Saul see dɛ, Nyankopɔn nyɛ dɛm na bi so nka ho: Na owu ara na ibowu Jonathan.

Na ɔman no see Saul dɛ, aso Jonathan nwu, nyia ɔayɛ Israel mu nkwagye kɛse edwuma yi a? Nyame mpa ngu: Dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi, ne tsinhwi kor ronntɔ famu; osiandɛ ɔnye Nyankopɔn na wɔayɛ edwuma ndɛ da yi. Nna ɔman no gyee Jonathan, ma oennwu.
Nna Saul gyaa Philistiafo no ekyir dzi na osii mu kɔree: Na Philistiafo no kɔr hɔnankasa hɔn man mu.
Afei aber a Saul nyaa Israel do ahendzi no, ɔnye n'atamfo nyinara kɔkõe hyiae, Moab, na Ammonmba, na Edom, na Zobah ahemfo no, na Philistiafo no kɔkõe: Na beebiara a ɔdaan noho kɔree no, odzii nyim.
Na ɔyɛɛ mbanyindze, na okunkum Amalekfo, na ɔgyee Israel fii hɔn a wɔsɛɛ hɔn no nsamu.
Afei Saul ne mbabanyin nye Jonathan, na Ishvi, na Malchi-shua: Na ne mbabaa beenu no hɔn ezdin nye yi; abakan no ne dzin dze Michal:
Na Saul ne yer dzin dze Ahinoam, Ahimaaz ne babaa a: Na no dɔm mu ɔsafohen ne dzin dze Abner, Saul n'egyanua Ner ne babanyin a.
Na Saul n'egya Kish na Abner n'egya Ner wɔyɛ Abiel ne mbabanyin.
Na asayɛ dzendzenndzen daa Philistiafo do wɔ Saul ne nda nyinara mu: Na sɛ Saul hu ɔbarimba katakyi biara, anaa ɔbarimba a ɔyɛ ndam a, nna ɔafa no aba ne nkyɛn.
15: Na Samuel see Saul dɛ, Ewuradze somaa me dɛ membɛsera wo ngo menhyɛ wo hen wɔ me man Israel do: Dɛm ntsi afei tsie Ewuradze ne nsɛm.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi, mahyɛ dza Amalek dze yɛɛ Israel no nsew, mbrɛ ɔyɛe ma mber a ofi Egypt reba no, ɔno noara kesii no mpa wɔ ɔkwan mu.
Afei kɔ na koku Amalek, na sɛɛ dza wɔwɔ nyinara pasapasa, na mma nngyaa hɔn; mbom ku ɔbarimba na ɔbaa nyina, abofra na enumfoanoba, ɔnantwi na oguan, efupɔnkɔ na asoaso.
Na Saul frɛɛ ɔman no hyiae na ɔkaan hɔn wɔ Telaim, anamɔnmufo mpemahaenu, na Judah mbarimba mpemdu.
Na Saul baa Amalek kurow no ho, na ɔhyɛɛ atsɛweefo wɔ bɔnsa no mu.

Na Saul see Kenifo no dɛ, hom nkɔ, womfi Amalekfo no mu nsian nkɔ, mma maammfa hɔn annka hom ho ansɛɛ hom: Osiandɛ hom yɛɛ Israelmba nyinara ayamuyie, aber a wofii Egypt reba no. Na Kenifo no fii Amalekfo no mu kɔree.
Na Saul kunkum Amalekfo no fi Havilah dɛ edze rokɔ Shur a ɔwɔ Egypt enyim no.
Na ɔkyeer Amalekhen Agag enyikan, na ɔdze afõwa anomu sɛɛ ɔman no nyinara pasapasa.

Na Saul na ɔman no wogyaa Agag, na nguan na anantwi mu dza wɔye dodoodow no na dza wɔadodɔ seradze mu bi; na nguambaa, na dza oye nyinara, na wɔammpɛ dɛ wɔsɛɛ no pasapasa: Na adze biara a ɔyɛ efifidze na atantandze no, ɔno na wɔsɛɛ no pasapasa.
Nna Ewuradze n'asɛm baa Samuel hɔ, dɛ,
menu moho dɛ mehyɛɛ Saul hen: Osiandɛ oegyaa m'ekyir dzi asan n'ekyir, na ɔamma me mbransɛm enntsim. Na Samuel no bo fuw dodoodow, na osūi frɛɛ Ewuradze anago no nyinara.
Na Samuel soɛɛr ahanamakye dɛ orikehyia Saul anapa no; na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Samuel dɛ, Saul baa Carmel, na, hwɛ, oesi ne nkaabɔdze, na ɔadan noho etwa mu, na oesian kɔ Gilgal.
Na Samuel baa Saul hɔ; na Saul see no dɛ Ewuradze nhyira wo: Medzi Ewuradze ne mbrasɛm do.
Na Samuel see dɛ, na nguan sū a ogu m'asomu yi, na anantwi sū a metse yi mbɔ ase nye dɛn?
Na Saul see dɛ, wɔdze hɔn fi Amalekfo mu bae: Osiandɛ ɔman no gyaa nguan na anantwi mu dza oye dodow no dɛ wɔdze robɔbɔ okum-afɔr ama Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn; na nkaa no yɛasɛɛ no pasapasa.
Nna Samuel see Saul dɛ, gyina, na menkã dza Ewuradze akã akyerɛ me anago yi menkyerɛ wo. Na ɔsee no dɛ, kã ɛ.
Na Samuel see dɛ, kaansa ehwɛ adze ketsewabaa wɔ woara w'enyi do mpo a, ana wɔannyɛ wo Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw do otsitsir bi a? Na Ewuradze seraa wo ngo hyɛɛ wo Israel do hen;
na Ewuradze somaa wo ɔkwan bi see dɛ, kɔ na kɛsɛɛ Amalekfo ndzebɔnyɛfo no pasapasa, na nye hɔn nkõ araa ma wɔnhyew ana.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na enntsie Ewuradze ne ndze, na itui hyɛɛ asadze no do, na eyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do yi?
Na Saul see Samuel dɛ, nyew, metsie Ewuradze ne ndze, na makɔ ɔkwan a Ewuradze somaa me no, na medze Amalekhen Agag maba, na masɛɛ Amalekfo no pasapasa.
Na ɔman no na wɔfaa asadze, nguan na anantwi, adze a woehyira do no mu adze tsitsir no dɛ wɔdze robɔbɔ okum-afɔr ama Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn wɔ Gilgal.
Na Samuel see dɛ, na Ewuradze wɔ pɛ kɛse wɔ ɔhyew-afɔr mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔwɔ Ewuradze ne ndze ne ntsei mu no a? Hwɛ, ritsie oye sen afɔr, na rekyɛn aso ɔsen ndwanyin seradze.
Osiandɛ etuatsew tse dɛ bɔn a ɔyɛ abayisɛm, na asoɔdzen tse dɛ abosonsɔr na ikumsɔr. Osiandɛ ɔwo apow Ewuradze n'asɛm ntsi, ɔno so ɔapow dɛ eyɛ ɔhen.
Na Saul see Samuel dɛ, mayɛ bɔn: Osiandɛ matõ Ewuradze ne mbrasɛm, na wo nsɛm:
Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, fa mo bɔn fir me, na enye me nsan nkɔ, ma monkɔsɔr Ewuradze.
Na Samuel see Saul dɛ, merennye wo nnsan nnkɔ: Osiandɛ apow Ewuradze n'asɛm, na Ewuradze apow wo dɛ eyɛ ɔhen wɔ Israel do.
Na Samuel daan noho dɛ ɔrokɔ ara, nna ɔtaae suoo ne bataker no ne nsiase no mu, na ɔtsewee.
Na Samuel see no dɛ, ndɛ da yi Ewuradze atsew Israel ahendzi no efi wo nsamu, na ɔdze ama wo nyɛnko bi a ɔyɛ sen wo.
Na eso Israel Ahoɔdzen no rinndzi ator na orunnu noho so: Osiandɛ ɔnnyɛ nyimpa na oeenu noho.
Nna ɔsee dɛ, mayɛ bɔn: Naaso, meserɛ wo, afei hwɛ me enyimnyam wɔ me man mpanyimfo na Israel enyim, na enye me nsan nkɔ, ma monkɔsɔr Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn no.
Nna Samuel sanee kezdii Saul ekyir bio na Saul kɔsɔɔr Ewuradze.
Nna Samuel see dɛ, hom mfa Amalekfo hen Agag no mbrɛ me ha. Na Agag baa ne nkyɛn bɔkɔɔ. Na Agag see dɛ, ampa owu no wenwen no etwa mu kɔ.
Na Samuel see dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ w'afõwa ama mbaa ahwer mba no, dɛmara so na wo nã bɔhwer mba wɔ mbaa mu. Na Samuel bɔɔ Agag epuruw wɔ Ewuradze enyim wɔ Gilgal.
Nna Samuel sii mu kɔr Ramah; na Saul sii mu kɔr ne fie wɔ Saul Gibeah.
Na Samuel ammba ammbɔhwɛ Saul bio araa ma okodur no wu da; na Samuel gyaam Saul: Na Ewuradze nuu noho dɛ ɔhyɛɛ Saul hen wɔ Israel do.
16: Na Ewuradze see Samuel dɛ, Ibegyam Saul ara ma eekodu dabɛn, hwɛ dɛ mapow no dɛ ɔyɛ ɔhen wɔ Israel do? hyɛ w'ambɛn no ngo mã, na kɔ, morosoma wo Beth-lehemnyi Jesse hɔ: Na mesiesie ɔhen bi ama moho esie wɔ ne mbabanyin no mu.
Na Samuel see dɛ, mebɛyɛ dɛn makɔ? Sɛ Saul tse a, oboku me. Na Ewuradze see dɛ, fa ɔnantwiber eburwa ka woho, na kɛse dɛ, maba dɛ morobɔbɔ okum-afɔr ama Ewuradze.
Na frɛ Jesse ma ɔmbra afɔr no ho, na mebɛkyerɛ wo dza yɛ: Na sera nyia mobɔbɔ ne dzin akyerɛ wo no ma me.
Na Samuel yɛɛ dza Ewuradze kãe no, na ɔbaa Beth-lehem. Na kurow no mu mpanyimfo dze ahopopo behyiaa no kwan, na wɔsee dɛ, eba no asomdwee mu anaa?
Na ɔsee dɛ, asomdwee mu a: Maba dɛ morobɔbɔ afɔr ama Ewuradze: Hom ntsew homho, na wɔnye me nkɔ afɔr no ho. Na ɔtseew Jesse na ne mbabanyin no ho, na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn ma wɔbaa afɔr no ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔbae no, nna ɔhwɛɛ Eliab, na ɔsee dɛ, ampa Ewuradze ne nyia wɔasera no no na ɔwɔ n'enyim no.
Na Ewuradze see Samuel dɛ, mma nnhwɛ n'enyim, anaa ne tsipɛn ne tsentsen; osiandɛ memmpɛ no; na Ewuradze nnhwɛ dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa hwɛ; na nyimpa hwɛ dza opue n'enyiwa do, na Ewuradze dze ɔhwɛ akoma mu.
Nna Jesse frɛɛ Abinadab, ɔmaa otwaa mu wɔ Samuel enyim. Na ɔsee dɛ, iyi so Ewuradze nnsaan mu nnyii no.
Nna Jesse maa Shammah twaa mu. Na ɔsee dɛ, iyi so Ewuradze nnsaan mu nnyii no.
Na Jesse maa ne mba beesuon no botwaa mu wɔ Samuel enyim. Na Samuel see Jesse dɛ, Ewuradze nnsaan mu nnyii woyinom.
Na Samuel see Jesse dɛ, ana wo mba nyinara wɔ ha a? Na ɔsee dɛ, Ekumaba no nko na ɔaka, na, hwɛ, ɔrohwɛ nguan. Na Samuel see Jesse dɛ, soma ma wɔnkɛfa no mbra: Na yɛrenntsena ase, gyedɛ ɔaba ha ana.
Na ɔsomae ma wɔkɛfaa no bae. Na ɔber, n'enyim yɛ fɛw, na no ho so yɛ fɛw. Na Ewuradze see dɛ, Soɛr, sera no: Na ɔno nye yi.
Nna Samuel faa ngo ammbɛn no, na ɔseraa no wɔ no nuanom no hɔn finimfin: Na ofitsi da no ara dze kɔ no Ewuradze no sunsum baa David do dzendzenndzen. Nna Samuel soɛree, na osii mu kɔr Ramah.
Afei Ewuradze no sunsum fii Saul ho firii, na sunsum bɔn fi Ewuradze hɔ bɛhaaw no.
Na Saul no nkowaa see no dɛ, afei hwɛ, sunsum bɔn bi na ofi Ewuradze hɔ rehaw wo yi.
Afei wɔmma hɛn wura nhyɛ no nkowaa a wɔwɔ w'enyim yi, ma wɔnkɔhwehwɛ nyimpa a onyim sanku bɔ papaara: Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ sunsum bɔn no fi Nyankopɔn hɔ ba wo do a, ɔdze ne nsa abɔ, ma aadwe wo.
Na Saul see no nkowaa no dɛ, afei hom nhwehwɛ nyimpa a onyim bɔ yie mma me na hom mfa no mbrɛ me.

Nna mberantsɛ no mu baako buae, na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, mehu Beth-lehemnyi Jesse ne babanyin bi a onyim bɔ papaara, na ɔbarimba katakyi a ɔyɛ ndam a, ɔsa barimba a, na asɛm mu ɔbadwembanyi a, na ɔhoɔfɛfo a, na Ewuradze dzi n'ekyir.
Dɛm ntsi Saul tuu abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Jesse hɔ kɛsee dɛ, gya wo babanyin David a ɔwɔ nguan no nkyɛn kwan, ma ɔmbra mo hɔ.
Na Jesse faa asoaso dze boodoo, na wenyin bɔdambɔ, na apɔnkyeba soaa no, na ɔdze somaa ne babanyin David ma ɔdze kɛmaa Saul.
Na David baa Saul hɔ, na obegyinaa n'enyim: Na ɔdɔɔ no kɛsenara; na ɔbɛyɛɛ n'akodzesoafo.
Na Saul somae ma wɔkɔr Jesse hɔ, dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma David ngyina m'enyim; na oenya m'enyim enyimnyam.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ sunsum bɔn fi Nyankopɔn hɔ ba Saul do a, nna David afa sanku no, na ɔdze ne nsa abɔ: Nna Saul ahyɛ nsi, na no ho adwe no, na sunsum bɔn no efi no do kɔ.
17: Afei Philistiafo boaboaa hɔn dɔm ano dɛ wɔrobɔkõ, na wɔkɔboaa ano wɔ Socoh a ɔyɛ Judah dze no, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Socoh na Azekah ntamu wɔ Ephes-dammim.
Na Saul na Israel mbarimba no boaboaa hɔn ano, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Elah ɔbɔn mu, na wɔbaa mpasuar wɔ Philistia no do.
Na Philistiafo no gyinaa bepɔw no do wɔ afã hɔ: Na Israel gyinaa bepɔw no do wɔ afã ha: Na bɔnsa da ntamu.
Na ɔkatakyi bi fi Philistiafo nseraban mu puei, wɔfrɛ no Goliath, ofi Gath, ne tsentsen yɛ basafa esia na nsama.
Na boran-kyɛw hyɛ ne tsir, na ɔhyɛ boran-bon akontar, na akontar no no dur tow boran shekel mpemenum.
Na kɔɔber anan-nkataho ɔkata n'anan ho, na boran ogyapatsia wɔ ne mbatsir ntamu.
Na ne peaa no kura tse dɛ ɔtanwemfo n'asadua; na ne peaa ne tsir tow dadze shekel ahaesia: Na no kokyɛmsoafo dzi n'enyim.

Na obegyinae na ɔtsēaa mu frɛɛ Israel dɔm no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom epue abɛbaa hom mpasuar yi? Ana mennyɛ Philistianyi, na hom yɛ Saul no nkowaa bi a? Hom nsan mu nyi ɔbarimba bi mma homho, na wɔmma onsian mbra me nkyɛn.
Sɛ otum nye me kõ, na oku me a, ɔno yɛbɛyɛ hom nkowaa: Na sɛ midzi no do nyim na muku no a, ɔnodze hom bɛyɛ hɛn nkowaa, na wɔasom hɛn.
Na Philistianyi no see dɛ, ndɛ da yi murutwa Israel dɔm no mpoa; hom mma me mbarimba bi, ma yɛnkõ.
Na aber a Saul na Israel nyinara tsee Philistianyi no ne nsɛm no, hɔn abaw gowee, na wosuroo kɛsenara.
Afei David nye Ephrathnyi a ofi Beth-lehem-judah a ne dzin dze Jesse, ne babanyin; na ɔwɔ mbabanyin baawɔtwe: Na Saul ne nda no mu no, nna ɔbarimba no ayɛ akɔdaa, oedzi mfe ara yie wɔ adasa mu.
Na Jesse ne mbabanyin mpanyin baasa no dzii Saul n'ekyir kɔr ɔsa: Na ne mbabanyin baasa a wɔkɔr ɔsa no hɔn edzin nye Eliab, abakan no, na nyia ɔdzi n'ekyir nye Abinadab, na otsīa ebiasa nye Shammah.
Na David na ɔyɛ ekumaba: Na mpanyin baasa no dzii Saul n'ekyir kɔree.
Na David dze, odzii Saul akɔnaaba kɔree kɔhwɛɛ n'egya no nguan wɔ Beth-lehem.
Na Philistianyi no twee bɛɛn anapa na ewimbir, na ɔdaa noho edzi adaduanan.
Na Jesse see ne ba David dɛ, afei fa wo nuanom adze yi, eburow kyewee ephah yi na ntɔwmu du yi, na soa ka woho ara kɔ nsera mu fa kɛma wo nuanom;
na fa twoosuw du yi kɛma hɔn apem do safohen no, na hwɛ mbrɛ wo nuanom hɔn ho tse, na gye hɔn hɔ asɛnkyerɛdze bra.
Afei Saul, na hɔn, na Israel mbarimba no nyinara, wɔwɔ Elah ɔbɔn no mu, nye Philistiafo rokõ.
Na David soɛɛr ahanamakye, na ɔdaan nguan no gyaa ɔhwɛfo, na ɔfae kɔree, dɛ mbrɛ Jesse hyɛɛ no no; na okodur mbrɛ ntseaseanam no wɔ, aber a dɔm a wɔrokɔ akono no wɔrobɔ ose gye do.
Na Israel na Philistiafo no baabaa mpasuar, dɔm hwɛ dɔm enyim.
Na David dze n'adzesoadze no hyɛɛ adzesoadze do hwɛfo no ne nsa, na otutuu mbirika kɔr dɔm no nkyɛn, na ɔkɔree kekyiakyiaa no nuanom no.
Na ɔnye hɔn rekasa no, hwɛ, ɔkatakyi no, Philistianyi a ofi Gath no a wɔfrɛ no Goliath no, ofi Philistiafo mpasuar no do puei, na ɔbɛkãa nsɛm kor no ara: Na David tsee.
Na Israel mbarimba no nyinara, aber a wohun ɔbarimba no, wofi n'enyim guanee, na wosuroo dodoodow.

Na Israel mbarimba no see dɛ, ana hom ehu ɔbarimba yi a oepue yi? Ampaara Israel ara na ɔaba rubotwa hɔn mpoa: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, nyimpa a oboku no no, ɔhen dze ahonya kɛse bɛma oenya noho, na ɔdze ne babaa ama no, na ɔama n'egya fie afa noho edzi wɔ Israel.

Na David kãa kyerɛɛ mbarimba a wogyina ne nkyɛn no dɛ, ebɛnadze na wɔbɛyɛ ama nyimpa a oboku Philistianyi yi, na oeyi ahorahoraa efi Israel do no? Na Philistianyi monomonomnyi so nye woana, na obotwa tseasefo Nyankopɔn no dɔm mpoa yi?
Na nkorɔfo no buaa no dɛmara, dɛ, mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ ama nyimpa a oboku no nye no.

Na aber a ɔrekasa kyerɛ mbarimba no no nua panyin Eliab tsee; na Eliab n'ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ David do, na ɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ebae? Na woana na edaan nguan kakra a wɔwɔ sar no do no gyaa no? Minyim wo ntsɛn na w'akoma mu mmaman: Ɔkõ ara na ebae bɔhwɛe.
Na David see dɛ, na mayɛ dɛn? Ana onnyi siantsir bi a?
Na ɔdaan noho fii ne nkyɛn kɔr obi so do, na ɔkãa no dɛmara, na nkorɔfo no buaa no bio dɛ nkan no dze no ara.
Na aber a wɔtsee nsɛm a David kãe no, wɔkɛkãa no wɔ Saul enyim: Na ɔsomae ma wɔkɛfaa no bae.
Na David see Saul dɛ, mma onnsian ɔno ntsi ma nyimpa biara n'akoma mmpa; w'akowaa bɔkɔ na ɔnye Philistianyi yi akɔkõ.
Na Saul see David dɛ, irunntum nnkɔ Philistianyi yi do nnkɛnye no nkõ: Osiandɛ ɔwodze eyɛ abofra, na ɔnodze ɔyɛ ɔsabarimba dze fi no mbofra mu.
Na David see Saul dɛ, w'akowaa rohwɛ n'egya no nguan; na sɛ ogyata anaa osisi ba bɛkyer eguambaa wɔ nguankuw no mu a,
mifir edzi mitsiw no, na mukoku no, na miyi no mifi n'anomu: Na sɛ ɔsoɛr mo do a, musuo n'abɔdwesa mu, na mobɔ no na muku no.
W'akowaa kum gyata na osisi nyina: Na Philistianyi monomonomnyi yi bɛyɛ dɛ hɔn mu baako, ɔnam dɛ oetwa tseasefo Nyankopɔn no dɔm mpoa ntsi.
Na David see dɛ, Ewuradze a oyii me fii gyata na osisi nsamu no, ɔnoara obeyi me efi Philistianyi yi nsamu. Na Saul see David dɛ, kɔ, na Ewuradze bedzi w'ekyir.
Na Saul dze ne ntar hyɛɛ David, na ɔdze boran kukukyɛw hyɛɛ ne tsir, na ɔdze dadze ntar hyɛɛ no.
Na David ɔdze n'afõwa bɔɔ n'atar do, na ɔnantsewee hwɛe; osiandɛ ɔnnsɔe nnhwɛe. Na David see Saul dɛ, munnkotum medze iyinom makɔ; na monnsɔe monnhwɛe. Na David yiyii no wɔ no ho.
Na ɔfaa no poma kitsaa ne nsamu, na ɔpaa nkokwabo enum wɔ ɔwora no mu, na ɔdze guu oguanhwɛfo kotoku a ɔwɔ no mu, mekyerɛ no bɔtɔ no mu a; na ne tsiabo kitsa ne nsamu: Na ɔtwee piin Philistianyi no.
Na Philistianyi no ɔbae ara twee piin David; na ɔbarimba a ɔso akokyɛm no dzi n'enyim.
Na Philistianyi no totoo n'enyi, na ohun David no, obuu no enyimtsia: Osiandɛ ɔyɛ abofra koraa, na ɔber, na n'enyim so yɛ fɛw.
Na Philistianyi no see David dɛ, ana ɔkraman nye me na edze mpoma reba mo do yi? Na Philistianyi no frɛɛ n'enyame dze paa David.
Na Philistianyi no see David dɛ, bra me nkyɛn, na medze wo nam mebɛma wimu ntumbowa, na haban mu mbowadoma.
Nna David see Philistianyi no dɛ, ɔwo edze afõwa na ɔnye mpeaa, na ɔnye gyapatsia, reba mo do: Na emi dze menam dɔm Ewuradze, Israel dɔm a etwa hɔn mpoa no hɔn Nyankopɔn no ne dzin mu na mereba.

Ndɛ da yi Ewuradze beyi wo ahyɛ me nsa; na meku wo, na meyi wo tsir wɔ do; na medze Philistiafo dɔm no hɔn efun mama wimu ntumbowa, na asaase do mbowadoma abɔyafo ndɛ; ama asaase nyinara eehu dɛ Nyankopɔn bi wɔ Israel:
Na aama bagua yi nyinara ehu dɛ Ewuradze ɔno ɔnndze afõwa na peaa no ɔdze gye nkwa: Osiandɛ ɔko no yɛ Ewuradze dze, na ɔdze hom bɛhyɛ hɛn nsa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, Philistianyi, no soɛree, na ɔbae na ɔtwee piin dɛ oribehyia David no, nna David yɛɛ no ntsɛm, na otutuu mbirika kɔr dɔm no do dɛ orikehyia Philistianyi no.
Na David dze ne nsa dɔɔ no kotoku no mu, na oyii ɔbo wɔ mu, na ɔtoow no tsiabo mu, na ɔbɔɔ Philistianyi no, wɔ no momapɔw do; na ɔbo no kɔdɔɔ no momapɔw no mu, na ɔhwee daadze ma n'enyim butuuw famu.
Dɛm na David dze tsiabo na ɔbo dzii nyim wɔ Philistianyi no do, na ɔbɔɔ Philistianyi no, na okum no; na afõwa bi nndze David ne nsamu.
Nna David tutuu mbirika na okegyinaa Philistianyi no do, na osuoo n'afõwa no mu, na ɔtwee fii no bɔha mu, na okum no, na ɔdze twaa ne tsir. Na Philistifo no hun dɛ hɔn ɔkatakyi no ewu no, woguanee.

Na Israel na Judah mbarimba no soɛree, na wɔbɔɔ ose gyee do, na wotsiiw Philistiafo no dze kodur dɛ erobɔkɔ Gai na Ekron mbobotsenano. Na Philistiafo no hɔn epirafo hwehwee daadze wɔ Shaaraim ɔkwan mu araa dze kodur Gath, na Ekron.
Na Israelmba no gyaa Philistiafo no do ka na wɔsanee, na wɔbɔfoow hɔn asesee no.
Na David faa Philistianyi no ne tsir no, na ɔdze baa Jerusalem; na n'akodze no dze ɔdze guu n'asesee no mu.
Na aber a Saul hun dɛ David rokɔ Philistianyi no do no, ɔsee ne sahen Abner dɛ, Abner, na abofra yi woana ba a? Na Abner see dɛ, dɛ wo kra tse ase yi, ɔhen, munnkotum makyerɛ.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, bisabisa nyia ne ba nye abɔtoaba yi.
Na David kokum Philistianyi no na ɔreba no, Abner faa no, na ɔdze no baa Saul n'enyim, nna Philistianyi no ne tsir dze ne nsamu.
Na Saul see no dɛ, woana ba nye wo, aberantsɛ? Na David buaa dɛ, w'akowaa Jesse, Beth-lehenyi no ne ba nye me.
18: Na ɔbaa dɛ owiee dɛ ɔkasa kyerɛ Saul no, Jonathan ne kra takyeer David ne kra ho, na Jonathan dɔɔ no dɛ noara ne kra.
Na da no ara na Saul faa no, na ɔamma ɔannkɔ fie n'egya fie bio.
Na Jonathan na David dzii ahyɛmu, osiandɛ ɔdɔɔ no dɛ noara ne kra.
Na Jonathan worɔɔw ne bataker a ɔhyɛ no no, na ɔdze maa David, na ne ntar, mekyerɛ n'afõwa, na n'egyen, na n'abɔyamu so mpo.
Na David fiir edzi kɔr beebiara mbrɛ Saul somaa no no, na ɔbɔɔ ne bra nyansa mu: Na Saul dze no hyɛɛ panyin wɔ akofo no hɔn do, na ɔsɔɔ ɔman no nyinara enyi, na Saul no nkowaa no so enyi.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, David kokum Philistianyi no na ɔsanee ɔreba no, nna mbaa no fii Israel nkurow nyinara mu puepuei, wɔrotow ndwom, na wɔresaw, dɛ woribehyia ɔhen Saul kwan, na wɔdze mpintsin, ɔnye ehurusi, na ɔnye asanku.
Na mbaa no toow ndwom kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔnho wɔ hɔn agor no mu, na wɔsee dɛ, Saul eku n'apem apem, na David eku ne mpedu mpedu.
Na Saul no bo fuuw dodoodow, na asɛm no annyɛ no dɛw; na ɔsee dɛ, wɔdze mpedu mpedu ama David, na emidze apem apem na wɔdze ama me: Na ebɛnadze bio na aka dɛ onya dɛ gyama ahenman yi a?
Na ofitsi da no ara ɔdze kɔ no, Saul n'enyi saa David.
Na ɔbaa dɛ n'adzekyee no, sunsum bɔn a ofi Nyankopɔn hɔ baa Saul do dzendzenndzen, na ɔkɔm wɔ ofi no mu: Na David dze ne nsa bɔɔ sanku, dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛ no daa no: Na Saul ne peaa dze ne nsamu.
Na Saul toow peaa no; na ɔsee dɛ, mobɔbɔ David ma oekitsa ban. Na David twee noho fii n'enyim mprɛnu.
Na Saul suroo David, osiandɛ Ewuradze dzi n'ekyir, na oefi Saul ne nkyɛn.
Dɛm ntsi Saul yii no wɔ ne nkyɛn, na ɔyɛɛ no ne safohen wɔ apem do: Na opue kɔ na ɔba wɔ ɔman no enyim.
Na David bɔɔ ne bra nyansa mu wɔ n'akwan nyinara mu; na Ewuradze dzii n'ekyir.
Na aber a Saul hun dɛ ɔbɔɔ ne bra nyansa mu dodoodow no, ɔbɔɔ no ho hu.
Na Israel na Judah nyinara wɔdɔɔ David, osiandɛ ɔno na opue kɔ na ɔba wɔ hɔn enyim.

Na Saul see David dɛ, hwɛ, me babaa panyin Merab, ɔno na medze no mebɛma wo ayewar: Na ɔwo ndam ara na yɛ fa ma me, na kõ Ewuradze no kõ. Osiandɛ Saul see dɛ, Mma me nsa nnda no do, mbom wɔmma Philistiafo nsa nda no do.
Na David see Saul dɛ, emi nye woana, na mo nkwa, anaa m'egya ebusua nye ebɛnadze wɔ Israel, na emi mebɛyɛ ɔhen n'asew?
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a nkyɛ wɔdze Saul ne babaa Merab bɛma David no, nna wɔdze no maa Meholathnyi Adriel ayewar.
Na Saul ne babaa Michal dɔɔ David: Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Saul, na asɛm no sɔɔ n'enyi.
Na Saul see dɛ, medze no mebɛma, ama ɔaayɛ efir ama no, na ama Philistiafo hɔn nsa aada no do. Dɛm ntsi Saul see David ne mpɛn ebien no dɛ, ndɛ da yi ebɛyɛ m'asew.
Na Saul hyɛɛ no nkowaa dɛ, wɔnye David ntu egyina nsumaa mu nse dɛ, hwɛ, ɔhen pɛ wo, na no nkowaa nyinara wɔdɔ wo: Dɛm ntsi afei yɛ ɔhen n'asew.
Na Saul no nkowaa no kãa nsɛm no wɔ David n'asomu. Na David see dɛ, ana ɔhwɛ hom enyi do dɛ ebɛyɛ ɔhen n'asew ɔyɛ adze ba, hwɛ no dɛ meyɛ ohianyi, na minnyi enyim?
Na Saul no nkowaa no kɛkãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, mbrɛ David kãe nye yi.

Na Saul see dɛ, mbrɛ hom nkɛse David nye yi, ɔhen ronnhwehwɛ tsiadze biara, na ɔrohwehwɛ Philistiafo hɔn mbarimba anower ɔha, ama oeedzi ɔhen n'atamfo do wer. Afei Saul dwen dɛ ɔreyɛ ma David akɔtɔ wɔ Philistiafo hɔn nsamu.
Na no nkowaa no kɛkãa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ David no, ɔyɛɛ David dɛw papaara dɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔhen n'asew. Na nda no enndu;
na David soɛree sii mu, ɔno na ne mbarimba no, na wokokum Philistiafo hɔn mu mbarimba ahaenu, na David dze hɔn mbarimba anower bae, ma wɔkanee ma odur ano dze maa ɔhen no, ama ɔaayɛ ɔhen n'asew.
Na Saul hwɛe hun dɛ Ewuradze dzi David n'ekyir; na Saul ne babaa Michal dɔɔ no.
Na Saul daa ho ara suroo David dodow; na Saul yɛɛ David ne tamfo ara daa.
Nna Philistiafo asafohemfo no fir edzi: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber biara sɛ wotu a, David ɔkyerɛ noho nyansa mu kyɛn Saul no nkowaa nyinara; ma dɛm ntsi wɔbɔɔ ne dzin enyidzi mu papaara.
19: Na Saul kasaa kyerɛɛ ne ba Jonathan, na no nkowaa nyinara, dɛ wonku David.

Na Saul ne ba Jonathan pɛ David n'asɛm dodow. Na Jonathan kãa kyerɛɛ David dɛ, m'egya Saul rohwewhɛ eku wo: Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, hwɛ woho yie kɛpem anapa, na tsena nsumaa mu beebi, na fa woho suma:
Na mubopue mekegyina m'egya ne nkyɛn wɔ haban mu mbrɛ ewɔ no, na menye m'egya atwetwe nkɔmbɔ wɔ wo ho; na sɛ muhu biribiara a, mebɛkã makyerɛ wo.
Na Jonathan kasaa no ho yie kyerɛɛ n'egya Saul, na ɔsee no dɛ, mma ɔhen nnyɛ bɔn nntsia n'akowaa David: Osiandɛ ɔnnyɛɛ bɔn nntsia wo, na osiandɛ no ndwuma a ɔwɔ w'afamu oye dodoodow:

Osiandɛ ɔdze no nkwa kitsaa ne nsamu, na okokum Philistianyi no, na Ewuradze dzii konyim kɛsenara maa Israel nyinara: Ɔwoara hunii, na idzii dɛw: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbom na ebɛyɛ bɔn etsia bɔgya a onndzi fɔ, dɛ iboku David gyan ara gyan yi?
Na Saul tsiee Jonathan ne ndze: Na Saul kãa ntam dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi, wonkoku no.
Na Jonathan frɛɛ David, na Jonathan daa nsɛm no nyinara edzi kyerɛɛ no. Na Jonathan dze David brɛɛ Saul, na ɔbɛtsenaa n'enyim, dɛ nkan no ara.
Na ɔsa baa bio: Na David tui, na ɔnye Philistiafo no kɔkõe, na okum hɔn ku kɛsenara; na wofii n'enyim guanee.
Na sunsum bɔn a ofi Ewuradze hɔ baa Saul do, wɔ aber a ɔtse ne fie, na ne peaa dze ne nsamu no; na David dze ne nsa bɔɔ sanku.
Na Saul hwehwɛɛ dɛ ɔdze peaa no wɔ David ma okitsa ban; na ɔtwee noho fii Saul n'enyim, na ɔtoow peaa no ma ɔkɔwɔɔ ban no mu: Na David guanee, na ofii nsa anago no.
Na Saul somaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr David ne fie dɛ wɔnkɛtsɛw no, na wonku no anapa no: Na David ne yer Michal kãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, sɛ anngye woho nkwa anago yi a, ɔkyena woboku wo.
Nna Michal dze David duaa tokura mu sii famu: Na oguanee kɔree, na ofii nsa.
Na Michal faa teraphim no, na ɔdze toow mpa no do, na ɔdze mpɔnkyenhwi sundze too n'etsifi, na ɔdze ɔtam no kataa do.
Na aber a Saul somaa abɔfo dɛ wɔnkɛfa David no, ɔsee dɛ, ɔyar.
Na Saul somaa abɔfo no dɛ wɔnkɔhwɛ David, dɛ, wɔmfa no wɔ mpa no do mbrɛ me, ma munku no.
Na ɔbɔfo no baa dan mu no, hwɛ, teraphim no na ɔda mpa no do, ɔnye mpɔnkyenhwi sundze no wɔ n'etsifi.
Na Saul see Michal dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na adaadaa me dɛm yi, na ama me tamfo ɔkɔ ma oefi nsa yi? Na Michal buaa Saul dɛ, ɔsee me dɛ, ma monkɔ; ebɛn ntsi na munku wo?
Na David guanee, na ofii nsa, na ɔbaa Samuel nkyɛn wɔ Ramah, na ɔbɛkãa dza Saul dze ayɛ no nyinara kyerɛɛ no. Na ɔno na Samuel wɔkɔree kɛtsenaa Naioth.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Saul dɛ, hwɛ, David wɔ Naioth wɔ Ramah.
Na Saul somaa abɔfo dɛ wɔnkɛfa David: Na aber a wohun nkɔnhyɛfo kuw no dɛ wɔrehyɛ nkɔm, na Samuel gyina hɔ dɛ ɔrohwɛ hɔn do no, Nyankopɔn no sunsum baa Saul n'abɔfoe no hɔn do, na hɔn so wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm.
Na wɔkɛkãa kyerɛɛ Saul no, ɔsomaa abɔfo fofor, na hɔn so wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm. Na Saul somaa abɔfo bio a otsīa ebiasa na hɔn so wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm.
Na ɔnoara so sii mu kɔr Ramah, na ɔbaa bura kɛse a ɔwɔ Secu ne nkyɛn: Na obisaa dɛ, Samuel na David wɔwɔ henfa? Na obi see dɛ, hwɛ, wɔwɔ Naioth wɔ Ramah.
Na ɔkɔr Naioth hɔ wɔ Ramah: Na Nyankopɔn no sunsum no baa ɔno so no do, na ɔrokɔ no, na ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm ara dze kodur dɛ ɔbaa Naioth wɔ Ramah.
Na ɔno so pɔɔr ne ntar, na ɔno so hyɛɛ nkɔm wɔ Samuel n'enyim, na odzii adagyaw daa hɔ adzekyee no nyinara na adzesaa no nyinara. Dɛm ntsi na wɔse dɛ, ana Saul so dɔm nkɔnhyɛfo no a?
20: Na David guanee fii Naioth wɔ Ramah, na ɔbae bɛkãa no wɔ Jonathan n'enyim dɛ, ebɛnadze na mayɛ? M'emumuyɛ nye mmuana? Na mo bɔn a ɔwɔ w'egya enyim nye mmuana, ma ɔrohwehwɛ mo nkwa yi?
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Nyame mpa ngu; innkowu bi: Hwɛ, m'egya rennyɛ biribi kɛse anaa kakraba biara gyedɛ oyi kyerɛ me ana: Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn ntsi na m'egya dze dɛm asɛm yi bosuma me? Ɔnntse dɛm.

Na nkyii so David kãa ntam, na ɔsee dɛ, onyim na w'egya nyim dɛ menya w'enyim enyimnyam; na ɔrese dɛ, mma Jonathan nnhu yi, ma no werɛ nnhow: Na ampaara dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi, na dɛ wo kra tse ase yi, ɔnamɔn pɛr na ɔda emi na owu ntamu.
Nna Jonathan see David dɛ, Biribiara a wo kra rohwehwɛ no, mebɛyɛ mama wo.
Na David see Jonathan dɛ, hwɛ, ɔkyena na bosoom fir fofor, na ɔwɔ dɛ menye ɔhen tsena edzidzii: Na ma monkɔ nkosuma moho wɔ haban mu, ma onkodu da a otsīa ebiasa no n'ewimbir.
Sɛ w'egya hwehwɛ me a, ɔno se dɛ, David serɛɛ me kwan enyiberdo ara, dɛ ɔrobɔ hwii ɔakɔ no kurow mu Beth-lehem: Na ebusua no nyinara hɔn afrenhyia-afɔr no bɔ edu:
Sɛ ɔse dɛ, oye a, nna asomdwee wɔ hɔ ma w'akowaa: Na sɛ no bo fuw a, nna ɔno hu dɛ oesua dɛ ɔbɛyɛ bɔn.
Dɛm ntsi enye w'akowaa ndzi no ayamuyie mu: Osiandɛ Ewuradze n'ahyɛmu na ama w'akowaa enye wo ahɛn mu: Na sɛ emumuyɛ bi wɔ mo mu a, ɔwoara ku me; na ebɛn ntsi na edze me bɛkɛma w'egya.
Na Jonathan see dɛ, Iyi mpar wo: Na sɛ minyim ara dɛ m'egya esua dɛ ɔbɛyɛ wo bɔn a, aso nkyɛ mennkɛkã makyerɛ wo?
Na David see Jonathan dɛ, sɛ gyangyanbiara w'egya buaa wo ebufuw mu a, woana bɛkã akyerɛ me?
Na Jonathan see David dɛ, bra ma yɛnkɔ haban mu. Na hɔn beenu nyina sii mu kɔr haban mu.

Na Jonathan see David dɛ, Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔnyɛ dasefo: Sɛ ɔkyena, anaa ɔkyena n'adzekyee siseber yi na mahwehwɛ n'adwen mu ehu mu a, hwɛ, sɛ papa bi wɔ David ho a, ana monnkɔsoma ma ɔaaba wo hɔ, na ɔaabɛda no edzi akyerɛ wo?

Sɛ m'egya nya pɛ dɛ ɔbɛyɛ wo bɔn, na sɛ mannda no edzi mannkyerɛ wo, na manngye wo kwan ma annkɔ no asomdwee mu a, Ewuradze nnyɛ Jonathan dɛm, na dza ɔkyɛn dɛm so: Na Ewuradze ndzi w'ekyir, dɛ mbrɛ oedzi m'egya n'ekyir no.
Na nnyɛ meda ho tse ase yi nko na fa Ewuradze n'ayamuyie yɛ me, amma meennwu:
Na eso mma nntwa w'ayamuyie do mmfi me fie da: Oho, nnyɛ aber mpo a Ewuradze etwa David n'atamfo nyinara efi asaase enyi do a.
Nna Jonathan nye David ne fi dzii ahyɛmu see dɛ, na Ewuradze bɔhwehwɛ no wɔ David n'atamfo hɔn nsamu.
Na Jonathan maa David kãa ntam bio, wɔ dɔ a ɔdze dɔ no ntsi: Osiandɛ ɔdɔɔ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔdɔɔ noara ne kra.
Nna Jonathan see no dɛ, ɔkyena na bosoom fir fofor: Na wɔbɔhwehwɛ wo, osiandɛ w'egua bɛda hɔ pan.
Na sɛ idzi ndaansa a, ɔno kɔ ntsɛntsɛm ara na bra beebi mbrɛ aber a edwuma no wɔ do no, isumaa woho wɔ hɔ no, na tsena ɔbo Ezel nkyɛn.
Na mobɔtow egyen-menaba ebiasa wɔ wo nkyɛn, dɛ gyama morotow botae mu.

Na, hwɛ, mobɔsoma abofra dɛ, kɔ, kɔhwehwɛ egyen-menaba no. Sɛ mese abofra no dɛ, hwɛ, egyen-menaba no wɔ wo nkyɛmfamu ha: Tase, na bra a; nna asomdwee wɔ hɔ ma wo na bɔn bi nnyi hɔ, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi.
Na sɛ mese abofra no dɛm dɛ, hwɛ, egyen-menaba no wɔ w'enyim noho a: Ɔno kɔ wo kwan; na Ewuradze agye wo kwan.
Na asɛm a emi na ɔwo akã ho asɛm no dze, hwɛ, Ewuradze gyina emi na ɔwo ntamu daa.
Nna David dze noho kosumaa haban mu: Na bosoom fiir fofor no, ɔhen no kɛtsenaa edzidzii.
Na ɔhen no tsena n'egua do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛ no daa no, mekyerɛ ban ho egua no do a; na Jonathan soɛree gyinae, na Abner tsena Saul ne nkyɛn: Na David ne tsenabew no daa pan.
Naaso Saul annkã asɛm bi da no: Na ɔdween dɛ, biribi ayɛ no, no ho nntsew; ampaara no ho nntsew.
na ɔbaa dɛ bosoom fiir fofor no adzekyee no a ɔyɛ da a otsīa ebien no, David ne tsenabew no daa pan: Na Saul see ne ba Jonathan dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na Jesse ne ba no ammba edzidzii ndeda na ndɛ yi?
Na Jonathan buaa Saul dɛ, David serɛɛ me kwan enyiberdo ara dɛ ɔrokɔ Beth-lehem:

Na ɔsee dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma monkɔ; na hɛn ebusua wɔ afɔr bɔ wɔ kurow no mu; na mo nua ahyɛ me dɛ monkɔ hɔ: Na afei, sɛ menya w'enyim enyimnyam a, meserɛ wo, ma monkɔ monkɔhwɛ mo nuanom. Dɛm ntsi na ɔammba ɔhen no pon ho.
Nna Saul n'ebufuw dzɛɛw Jonathan do, na ɔsee no dɛ, ɔwo ɔbaa brakyewnyi etuatsewnyi ne ba, ana minnyim dɛ afa Jesse ne ba no nyɛnko dze rehyɛ wankasa woho, na wo na n'adagyaw ho enyito bi a?
Na aber tsentsen ara a Jesse ne ba no tse ase yi, ɔwo na w'ahendzi so rinngyina. Dɛm ntsi afei soma ma wɔnkɛfa no mbrɛ me, na owu na obowu.
Na Jonathan buaa n'egya Saul na ɔsee no dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na woboku no? Ebɛnadze na ɔayɛ?
Na Saul toow ne peaa no wɔ no do dɛ ɔdze rowɔ no; na ɔnam iyi do na Jonathan hun dɛ n'egya oesua dɛ oboku David.
Nna Jonathan dze ebufuhyew soɛree fii pon no ho, na oenndzi edziban biara bosoom ne da a otsīa ebien no mu: Na odzii awerɛhow wɔ David ntsi, osiandɛ n'egya ahyɛ no fɛr.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, n'anapa no, Jonathan puei kɔr haban mu wɔ aber a ɔnye David hyɛe no ara mu, na abofra kakraba bi ka no ho.
Na ɔsee n'abofra no dɛ, tu mbirika, na kɔhwehwɛ egyen-menaba a morotow yi. Na abofra no tuu mbirika rokɔ no, ɔtoow egyen-menaba ma ɔtraa no.
Na abofra no dur mbrɛ egyen-menaba a Jonathan towee no wɔ no, Jonathan tsēatseaa mu wɔ abofra no n'ekyir see dɛ, ana egyen-menaba no nnyi w'enyim noho bi a?
Na Jonathan tsēatseaa mu wɔ abofra no n'ekyir dɛ, ka woho, yɛ ntsɛm, mma nngyina. Na Jonathan n'abofra no tasee egyen-menaba no, na ɔbaa no wura nkyɛn.
Na abofra no nnyim ho hwee: Jonathan na David nko na wonyim asɛm no.
Na Jonathan dze n'akodze maa abofra no, na ɔsee no dɛ, duom, fa kɔ kurow no mu.
Na abofra no kɔree ara, nna David soɛree fii beebi mbrɛ odzi kɔ pomu afamu no, na ɔdae n'enyim bobutuuw famu, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze mpɛn ebiasa: Na wofifeew hɔn ano, na wosūi araa ma David ɔboor do.

Na Jonathan see David dɛ, kɔ no asomdwee mu, susuampa dɛ hɛn beenu nyina akekã ntam wɔ Ewuradze ne dzin mu, dɛ, Ewuradze wɔ emi na ɔwo ntamu, na m'asefo na w'asefo ntamu daa no. Na ɔsoɛree na osii mu kɔree: Na Jonathan kɔr kurow no mu.
21: Nna David baa ɔsɔfo Ahimelech nkyɛn wɔ Nob: Na Ahimelech dze ahopopo behyiaa David kwan, na ɔsee no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wo nko nam, na nyimpa biara nka wo ho yi?

Na David see ɔsɔfo Ahimelech dɛ, ɔhen akyerɛ me edwuma bi, na ɔase me dɛ, mma nyimpa biara nnhu edwuma a morosoma wo wɔ ho yi, na dza mahyɛ wo bo ho biribiara: Na mberantsɛ no so makyerɛ hɔn wɔ beebi.
Dɛm ntsi afei, ebɛnadze na ɔwɔ wo nsamu? Ma me boodoo ntɔwmu enum, anaa biribiara a ɔwɔ hɔ sesei.
Na ɔsɔfo no buaa David, na ɔsee dɛ, Boodoo hun biara nnyi me nsamu, na boodoo krɔnkrɔn na ɔwɔ hɔ; sɛ mberantsɛ no esie hɔnho wɔ mbaa ho dze a.

Na David buaa ɔsɔfo no, na ɔsee no dɛ, ampaara bɛyɛ ha nda ebiasa yi yɛnnkɔr mbaa nkyɛn; aber a misii mu no na mberantsɛ no hɔn ndzɛmba yɛ krɔnkrɔn, kaansa ɔyɛ kwasafo akwantu mpo a; na ankantsɛm ndɛ mbom na hɔn ndzɛmba ho nnkɛtsew?
Na ɔsɔfo no maa no boodoo krɔnkrɔn: Na boodoo biara nnyi hɔ dɛ kyerɛ-boodoo no a woyi no wɔ Ewuradze n'enyim, na da a woyi no wɔdze boodoohyew kogu hɔ no.
Afei da no na Saul no nkowaa mu nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a woesianka no wɔ Ewuradze n'enyim: Na ne dzin dze Doeg, Edomnyi a ɔyɛ Saul no mbowahwɛfo mu otsitsir no a.
Na David see Ahimelech dɛ, ana peaa anaa afõwa biara nnyi wo nsamu wɔ ha? Na ɔhen n'edwuma no wɔregye no ntsɛm ntsi, mammfa m'afõwa na m'akodze so mammba.

Na ɔsɔfo no see dɛ, Philistianyi Goliath no a ikum no wɔ Elah ɔbɔn mu no, n'afõwa no, hwɛ, ɔno na wɔakyekyer no wɔ ɔtam mu wɔ ephod no n'ekyir hɔ no: Sɛ ebɛfa ɔno a, fa: Na biara nnyi ha dɛ ɔno. Na David see dɛ, biara nntse dɛ ɔno fa ma me.
Na David soɛree, na Saul no ho ntsi oguaan da no, na ɔkɔr Gathhen, Achish nkyɛn.
Na Achish no nkowaa see no dɛ, ana nnyɛ David, asaase no do hen no nye yi bi? Ana wɔanntow no ho ndwom wɔ asaw mu annse dɛ, Saul eku n'apem apem, na David ne mpedu mpedu?
Na David dze nsɛm yi siee n'akoma mu, na osuroo Gathhen Achish dodoodow.
Na ɔsakyeer ne nyɛe wɔ hɔn enyim, na ɔyɛɛ noho dɛ nyia ɔabɔ dam wɔ hɔn nsamu, na ɔwerɛwerɛɛw kuropon ano mbobow no ho, na ɔmaa ne ntafi sinsiaan n'abɔdwesa mu.
Nna Achish see no nkowaa no dɛ, hwɛ, hom ehu dɛ ɔbarimba yi ɔabɔ dam: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na hom dze no brɛ me yi?
Ana mihia abɔdamfo na hom dze oyi aba dɛ ɔmbɛyɛ abɔdamdzi wɔ m'enyim? Ma aso oyi ɔmbra me fie?
22: Dɛm ntsi David sii mu fii hɔ kɔree, na ofii nsa kɔr Adullam ɔbo-tu mu: Na no nuanom, na n'egya na ne fifo nyinara tsee no, wosii mu kɔr ne nkyɛn wɔ hɔ.
Na obiara a no ho akyer no, na obiara a odze kaw, na obiara a no werɛ ahow wɔboaboa hɔn ano kɔr ne nkyɛn; na ɔbɛyɛɛ safohen wɔ hɔn do: Na mbarimba bɛyɛ ahaanan na wɔbɛkaa no ho.
Na David fii hɔ sii mu kɔr Mizpeh wɔ Moab, na ɔsee Moabhen no dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma m'egya na me nã mfir edzi mbɛnye hom ntsena nkodu dɛ mubohu dza Nyame bɛyɛ ama me ana.
Na ɔdze hɔn baa Moabhen no n'enyim: Na wɔnye no tsenaa wɔ mber a David wɔ otu no mu no nyinara.
Na nkɔnhyɛnyi Gad see David dɛ, mma nntsena otu no mu; fi hɔ, na kɔ Judah asaase do. Nna David fii hɔ, na ɔbaa Hereth kwaa no mu.
Na Saul tsee dɛ woehu David na mbarimba a wɔka no ho no: Afei Saul tse Gibeah, wɔ tamarisk dua a ɔwɔ Ramah no n'ase, ne peaa dze ne nsamu, na no nkowaa nyinara gyinagyina no ho.

Na Saul see no nkowaa a wogyinagyina no ho no dɛ, hom Benjaminfo, hom ntsie ɛ, aso Jesse ne ba no na ɔbɛmema hom nyinara nhaban, na wenyin nture, anaa ɔno na ɔbɛhyehyɛ hom nyinara mpem do asafohemfo na aha do asafohemfo;

ma dɛm ntsi hom nyinara apam me tsir do, na me ba nye Jesse ne ba no yɛ kor a, obiara nnkã nnkyerɛ me, na hom mu obiara nndzi yaw mma me, anaa onntue m'aso dɛ me ba ahyɛ m'akowaa tsirmu dɛ ɔnye me ndzi esi, ɔntsetsɛw, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi?
Nna Edomnyi Doeg a ogyina Saul no nkowaa no nkyɛn no, buae na ɔsee dɛ, muhun Jesse ne ba no dɛ ɔaba Nob, Ahimelech, Ahitub ne ba no, nkyɛn.
Na obisaa Ewuradze maa no, na ɔmaa no edzidzidze, na ɔdze Philistianyi Goliath n'afõwa no maa no.
Nna ɔhen no somae ma wokehyiaa ɔsɔfo Ahimelech, Ahitub ne ba no, na n'egya ne fiefo nyinara, asɔfo a wɔwɔ Nob no; na hɔn nyinara wɔbaa ɔhen no ne nkyɛn.
Na Saul see dɛ, ɔwo Ahitub ne ba, tsie ɛ. Na obuaa dɛ, emi nye yi, mo wura.
Na Saul see no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom apam me tsir do, ɔwo na Jesse ne ba no, wɔ dɛ ama no edziban, na afõwa, na ebisa Nyankopɔn ama no, dɛ ɔnsoɛr mo do, na ɔntsetsɛw, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi?
Nna Ahimelech buaa ɔhen no, na ɔsee dɛ, na wo nkowaa nyinara hɔn mu woana na odzi nokwar dɛ David a ɔyɛ ɔhen n'asew no, na wɔafa no nkɔ w'apamfo mu, na wodzi no nyi wɔ wo fie no?
Ana ndɛ na mahyɛ ase dɛ mibisa Nyankopɔn mema no? Iyi ɔmpar me: Mma ɔhen mmfa asɛm biara nnto n'akowaa do, na m'egya fifo nyinara so do: Na w'akowaa nnyim iyi nyinara ho hwee, kumaabi o, dodow o.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, owu ara na ibowu, Ahimelech, ɔwo, na w'eya fie nyinara.

Na ɔhen no see brampafo a wogyinagyina no ho no dɛ, hom ndan homho, na wonku Ewuradze n'asɔfoe no; osiandɛ hɔn so hɔn nsa wɔ David dze mu, na osiandɛ wonyim dɛ oguanee, na wɔammbɛkã annkyerɛ me. Na ɔhen no no nkowaa no wɔammpɛ dɛ wɔtsen hɔn nsa kã Ewuradze n'asɔfoe no.
Na ɔhen no see Doeg dɛ, Dan woho, na tu hyɛ ɔsɔfo no do. Na Edomnyi Doeg daan noho, na otui hyɛɛ asɔfo no do, na okum nyimpa a wɔhyɛ ndwera ephod eduowɔtwe enum da no.
Na Nob, asɔfo no hɔn kurow no so, ɔdze afõwa anomu kum hɔn, mbarimba na mbaa, mbofraba na numfoanomba, na anantwi, na nsoaso na nguan nyina, ɔdze afõwa anomu kum hɔn.
Na Ahimelech, Ahitub ne ba no, ne mbabanyin mu baako a wɔfrɛ no Abiathar no ofii nsa, na oguanee fãa David.
Na Abiathar kãa kyerɛɛ David dɛ Saul eku Ewuradze n'asɔfoe no.
Na David see Abiathar dɛ, da no a Edomnyi Doeg wɔ hɔ no, nna muhun dɛ ɔyɛ dɛn ara a, ɔbɛkã akyerɛ Saul: Emi na mama w'egya ne fie nyimpa nyinara woewu.
Enye me ntsena, mma nnsuro; na nyia ɔrohwehwɛ mo nkwa no na ɔrohwehwɛ wo nkwa: Na me nkyɛn dze wɔbɔhwɛ wo do.
23: Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ David dɛ, hwɛ, Philistiafo nye Keilah rokõ, na wɔrofow ewuporowee no.
Dɛm ntsi David bisaa Ewuradze dɛ, ana monkɔ munkoku Philistiafo yi? Na Ewuradze see David dɛ, kɔ, na koku Philistiafo no, na gye Keilah nkwa.
Na David ne mbarimba no see no dɛ, hwɛ, yesuro wɔ Judah ha yi, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na burbur nkyii yɛbɔkɔ Keilah nye Philistiafo akɔkõ.
Nna David daa ho ara bisaa Ewuradze bio. Na Ewuradze buaa no na ɔsee dɛ, soɛr, sian kɔ Keilah; na mibeyi Philistiafo no ahyɛ wo nsa.
Na David na ne mbarimba no sii mu kɔr Keilah, na wɔnye Philistiafo no kɔkõe, na wɔfaa hɔn anyɛmbowa bae, na wokum hɔn oku kɛsenara. Nna David gyee Keilahfo nkwa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Ahimelech ne ba Abiathar ruguan akɔ David nkyɛn wɔ Keila no, ephod kitsa ne nsamu na ɔdze kɔree.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Saul dɛ David aba Keilah. Na Saul see dɛ, Nyankopɔn eyi no ahyɛ me nsa; na wɔatow no mu dɛ ɔakɛhɛn kurow a ɔwɔ nkuropon na adaban mu.
Na Saul hyiahyiaa ɔman no nyinara dɛ wɔnkɔ ɔsa, wɔnkɔ Keilah, wonkotua David na ne mbarimba no.
Na David hun dɛ Saul rekyer no ho sa bɔn; na ɔsee ɔsɔfo Abiathar dɛ, fa ephod no bra ha.
Nna David see dɛ, Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, w'akowaa atse no ampaara dɛ Saul rohwehwɛ aba Keilah, abɛsɛɛ kurow no wɔ me ntsi.
Ana Keilahfo beyi me ahyɛ ne nsa? Ana Saul bɛba dɛ mbrɛ w'akowaa matse no? Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn e, mokotow serɛ wo, kã kyerɛ w'akowaa. Na Ewuradze see dɛ, ɔbɛba.
Nna David see dɛ, Ana Keilah beyi emi na me mbarimba no ahyɛ Saul nsa? Na Ewuradze see dɛ, wobeyi wo ama.
Nna David na ne mbarimba a wɔbɛyɛ ahaesia no, wɔsoɛree, na wosii mu fii Keilah, na wɔkɔr beebiara a wobotum kɔ. Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Saul dɛ, David efi nsa eguan efi Keilah; na ogyaa dɛ ɔbɔkɔ.
Na David kɛtsenaa sar no do, wɔ akoban no mu, na ɔtsenaa kokodo nkurow no mu wɔ Ziph sar no do. Na daa nyinara Saul hwehwɛɛ no, na Nyankopɔn ennyi no annhyɛ ne nsa.
Na David hun dɛ Saul epue robɔhwehwɛ no nkwa: Na David wɔ Ziph sar no do wɔ kwaa no mu.
Na Saul ne ba Jonathan soɛree na ɔkɔr David nkyɛn, wɔ kwaa no mu, na ɔkɛhyɛɛ ne nsa dzen wɔ Nyankopɔn mu.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, mma nnsuro; na m'egya Saul ne nsa nnkɛkã wo; na ebɛyɛ hen wɔ Israel do, na mayɛ w'edziekyir; na m'egya Saul so nyim no dɛm.
Na hɔn beenu no dzii ahyɛmu wɔ Ewuradze n'enyim: Na David tsenaa kwaa no mu, na Jonathan sii mu kɔr ne fie.
Nna Ziphfo no baa Saul nkyɛn hɔ wɔ Gibeah, dɛ, ana nnyɛ David na oesuma noho wɔ hɛn nkyɛn wɔ akoban no mu wɔ kwaa no mu, wɔ Hachilah koko a ɔwɔ sar no no pomu afamu no, no do no?
Dɛm ntsi afei, ɔhen, sian bra, dɛ mbrɛ wo kra no hwehwɛ a ɔrohwehwɛ dɛ osian ba no tse no ara; na hɛn afamu dze nye dɛ yebeyi no ahyɛ ɔhen ne nsa.
Na Saul see dɛ, Ewuradze nhyira hom; osiandɛ hom ehu mbɔbɔr.
Meserɛ hom, hom nkɔ, wonkesi no pi ara yie, na wɔnhwɛ wonhu ne tsenabew mbrɛ n'adae wɔ, na nyia oehu no hɔ: Na wɔakã akyerɛ me dɛ ɔyɛ n'adze ndaadaa mu dɛ biribi.

Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ, na wɔnhyɛ sumabew a osumasuma noho wɔ hɔ nyinara nsew, na wonsi no pi mbra me nkyɛn bio, na menye hom nkɔ: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ ɔwɔ asaase no do a, ɔno mobɔhwehwɛ no meyi no epue wɔ Judah mpempem nyinara mu.
Na wɔsoɛree, na wodzii Saul n'enyim kan kɔr Ziph: Na David na ne mbarimba no dze wɔwɔ Maon sar no do, wɔ Arabah no mu wɔ sar no pomu afamu.
Na Saul na ne mbarimba no sii mu kɔr dɛ wɔrokɔhwehwɛ no. Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ David: Dɛm ntsi osianee baa ɔbotan no ho, na ɔkɛtsenaa Moan sar no do. Na Saul tsee no, otsiiw David wɔ Moan sar no do.

Na Saul nam bepɔw no n'afã ha, nna David na ne mbarimba no so wɔnam bepɔw no n'afã noho: Na David yɛɛ ntsɛm fii hɔ, wɔ Saul no ho hu ntsi; osiandɛ Saul na ne mbarimba no bɔɔ david na ne mbarimba no hɔn ho aprɔw dɛ wɔrekyer hɔn.
Na ɔbɔfo bi baa Saul hɔ dɛ, ka woho bra: Na Philistiafo abɛta ahyɛ asaase no do.
Nna Saul gyaa David tsiw na ɔsanee, na osii mu kɔr Philistiafo no hɔn do: Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bea no Sela-hammahlekoth.
Na David fii hɔ sii mu kɔree, na ɔkɛtsenaa En-gedi akoban no mu.
24: Na ɔbaa dɛ, Saul gyaa Philistiafo no do ka na ɔsanee no, wɔkãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, hwɛ, David wɔ En-gedi sar no do.
Nna Saul faa mbarimba mpensa a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn wɔ Israel nyinara mu, na osii mu kɔr dɛ ɔrokɔhwehwɛ David na ne mbarimba no wɔ hamu mpɔnkye hɔn mbotan no do.
Na ɔbaa nguamban no ho wɔ ɔkwan nkyɛn, mbrɛ ɔbo-tu bi wɔ; na Saul kɔr mu dɛ ɔrekɛkata n'anan ho. Nna David na ne mbarimba no wɔtsetse ɔbo-tu no no mu noho ara.

Na David ne mbarimba no see no dɛ, hwɛ, da a Ewuradze see wo no nye yi, dɛ, hwɛ, mibeyi wo tamfo no mahyɛ wo nsa, na ayɛ no mbrɛ woara ehwɛ a oye ma wo no. Nna David soɛree, na otwaa Saul ne bataker nsiase ano bi nsumaa mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ n'ekyir no, David n'akoma tui, osiandɛ oetwa Saul ne nsiase no ano bi ntsi.
Na ɔsee ne mbarimba no dɛ, Ewuradze mpa ngu dɛ mebɛyɛ mo wura, nyia Ewuradze asera no no dɛm adze yi, dɛ mebɛtsen me nsa makã no, hwɛ dɛ ɔyɛ nyia Ewuradze asera no.
Nna David dze nsɛm yi siiw ne mbarimbano kwan, na ɔamma hɔn kwan ma wɔannsoɛr Saul do. Na Saul soɛree fii ɔbo-tu no mu, na osii mu kɔr no kwan.

N'ekyir no David so soɛree, na ofii ɔbo-tu no mu puei, na ɔtsēatseaa mu dzii Saul n'ekyir dɛ, mo wura ɔhen. Na Saul buu no kɔn ekyir no, nna David bɔɔ no mu adze dze n'enyim boom famu, na ɔyɛɛ no enyidzi.
Na David see Saul dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na itsie nkorɔfo hɔn nsɛm, dɛ, hwɛ, David rohwehwɛ wo bɔn no?

Hwɛ, ndɛ da yi w'enyi ehu mbrɛ Ewuradze sii na ɔdze wo hyɛɛ me nsa ndɛ wɔ ɔbo-tu no mu: Na binom see me dɛ munku wo: Na m'enyi gyaa wo; na mesee dɛ, mennkɛtsen me nsa makã mo wura; osiandɛ ɔno nye nyia Ewuradze asera no no.

Nkyii so, m'egya, hwɛ, nyew, hwɛ wo bataker nsiase ano bi na ɔdze me nsamu yi: Na dɛ mutwaa wo bataker nsiase ano bi, na mennku wo no, hwɛ na hu dɛ bɔn na mbrato biara nnyi me nsamu, na mennyɛɛ bɔn bi minntsiaa wo, kaansa ɔwo ereyɛ me kra ha eyi no wɔ hɔ mpo a.
Ewuradze mbua emi na ɔwo ntamu atsɛn, na Ewuradze ndzi no wer mma me: Na mara me nsa dze mennkɛfa akã wo.
Dɛ mbrɛ tsetse mpanyin no hɔn bɛ no se no, omumuyɛfo mu na emumuyɛ fi ba: Na mara me nsa dze mennkɛfa akã wo.
Woana na Israelhen epue ka no do yi? Woana na iritsiw no yi? Ɔkraman fun yi a, ɔkraman-dwuw yi a.
Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze nyɛ ɔtsɛmbuafo, na ombua emi na ɔwo ntamu atsɛn, na ɔnhwɛ, na ondzi m'asɛm mma me, na onyi me mfi wo nsamu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, David kãa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Saul wiei no, Saul see dɛ, ana wo ndze nye yi, me ba David? Na Saul maa ne ndze do, na osūi.
Na ɔsee David dɛ, ɔwo eyɛ tseneneenyi sen me, na ɔwo ayɛ me papa wɔ mber a emi mayɛ wo bɔn.
Na ada no edzi ndɛ da yi wɔ mbrɛ esi na enye me edzi no yie: Susuampa dɛ Ewuradze yii me hyɛɛ wo nsa na ennku me no.
Ana sɛ obi hu ne tamfo a, ɔbɛma ɔdze noho sɔkyee akɔ? Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze etua wo kaw pa wɔ dza ndɛ da yi ayɛ ama me no ntsi.
Na afei na Israel ahenman begyina wɔ wo nsamu.
Dɛm ntsi afei, fa Ewuradze kã ntam kyerɛ me dɛ innkoku m'asefo a wodzi m'ekyir no hɔn ase, na ennkɛsɛɛ me dzin wɔ m'egya ne fie.
Na David kãa ntam kyerɛɛ Saul. Na Saul sii mu kɔr fie; na David na ne mbarimba no dze wɔfowee kɔr tu no mu.
25: Na Samuel wui; na Israel nyinara poon hɔnho hyiae, na wogyaam no, na wosiee no wɔ ne fie wɔ Ramah. Na David soɛree, na osii mu kɔr Paran sar no do.
Na ɔbarimba bi wɔ Maon a n'enyadze wɔ Carmel; na ɔbarimba no yɛ nyimpa kɛse, na ɔwɔ nguan mpemebiasa, na mpɔnkye apem: Na orususua no guan ho wɔ Carmel.
Na ɔbarimba no ne dzin dze Nabal; na ne yer ne dzin dze Abigail: Na ɔbaa no wɔ ntseasee papa, na no ho yɛ fɛw: Na ɔbarimba no dze ɔyɛ dzen, na ne nyɛe muo; na ofi Caleb fie.
Na David tsee no wɔ sar no do dɛ Nabal rususua no nguan ho.
Na David somaa mberantsɛ du, na David see mberantsɛ no dɛ, hom mfow nkɔ Carmel, na wɔnkɔ Nabal hɔ, na wɔnkɔbɔ me dzin nkyia no:
Na dɛm na hom nse nyia a ɔtse no atseyie mu no, dɛ, asomdwee nkã ɔwo, na asomdwee nkã wo fie so, na asomdwee nkã dza ewɔ nyinara.
Na afei matse dɛ ewɔ nguansusuafo: Wo nguanhwɛfo afei wɔnye hɛn atsena, na yɛannyɛ hɔn bɔn, nkyii so hɔn biribiara annyew, wɔ mber a wɔdze wɔ Carmel no nyinara.
Bisa wo mberantsɛ no, na wɔbɛkã akyerɛ wo: Dɛm ntsi ma mberantsɛ no nnya w'enyim enyimnyam: Na yɛaba da pa mu: Meserɛ wo, fa biribiara a ɔbɔtɔ wo nsamu ma wo nkowaa, na wo ba David.
Na David ne mberantsɛ no bae no, wɔkãa nsɛm no nyinara kyerɛɛ Nabal wɔ David ne dzin mu, na wɔyɛɛ fõo.
Na Nabal buaa David no nkowaa no, na ɔsee dɛ, David nye woana? Na Jesse ne ba no nye woana? Nkowaa pii na ndɛ ber yi woguan fi hɔn wuranom nkyɛn.
Aso nkyii memfa m'edziban, na mo nsu, na me nam a meku medze rema mo nguansusuafo, memma nkorɔfo a minnyim mbrɛ wofi?
Na David ne mberantsɛ no daan hɔnho faa hɔn kwan do, na wɔsanee, na wɔbae bɛkãa nsɛm yi nyinara kyerɛɛ no.

Na David see ne mberantsɛ no dɛ, hom nyinara wɔmfa hom mfõwa mbobɔ. Na hɔn nyinara dze hɔn mfõwa bobɔe; na David so dze n'afõwa bɔe: Na nyimpa bɛyɛ ahaanan na wɔka David no do; na ahaenu na wɔtsenaa ndzɛmba no ho.
Na mberantsɛ no mu baako kɛkãa kyerɛɛ Abigail, Nabal ne yer no, dɛ, hwɛ, David somaa abɔfo fi sar no do dɛ woribekyia hɛn wura; na otutuu hɔn akakanyi.
Na mbarimba no woye ma hɛn dodow, na wɔannyɛ hɛn bɔn, nkyii so yɛannyew biribiara mber tsentsen a yɛnye hɔn nenamee, wɔ aber a yɛwɔ haban mu no:
Wɔyɛɛ fadum maa hɛn adzesaa na adzekyee nyina, wɔ mber tsentsen ara a yɛnye hɔn wɔ hɔ rohwɛ nguan no nyinara.
Dɛm ntsi afei hwɛ na dwen dza ebɛyɛ; na mbusu na wɔakyerɛ no wɔ hɛn wura, na no fi nyinara do: Na ɔyɛ Belial ba dodow dɛ obi nntum nnkasa nnkyerɛ no.

Nna Abigail yɛɛ ntsɛm, na ɔkɛfaa ntɔwmu ahaenu na wenyin mbɔdambɔ ebien, na nguan enum a woesiesie no dada, na eburow kyewee esusudze enum, na esikyireamba nsiansiaw ɔha, na adɔmba miamiae ahaenu, na ɔdze soasoaa nsoaso.
Na ɔsee ne mberantsɛ no dɛ, hom ndzi m'enyim kan nkɔ; hwɛ, midzi hom ekyir. Na ɔannkã annkyerɛ no kun Nabal.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, ɔtse n'asoaso do, na orisian aba bepɔw no ase no, hwɛ, David na ne mbarimba no sianee behyiaa no; na ohyiaa hɔn.
Nna David akã dɛ, ampaara gyan ara gyan na mahwɛ dza akowaa yi wɔ no wɔ sar no do no nyinara do, ma dza ɔyɛ nedze no nyinara no mu kor ara annyew: Nna ɔdze bɔn ahyɛ me papa ananmu yi.
Sɛ ondu mbrɛ anapa enyim ntsetsew na megya dza ɔwɔ no nyinara mu abɔdomaba ɔbanyin kor mpo a, ɔno Nyame nyɛ David n'atamfo dɛm, na dza ɔkyɛn dɛm so.
Na Abigail hun David no, ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm, na ofii n'asoaso do dwirii, na ɔhwee David n'enyim dze n'enyim butuuw famu, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze kɔr famu.
Na otwae hwee n'ananadze, na ɔsee dɛ, mo do a, mo wura, mo do na emumuyɛ no nda: Na meserɛ wo, ma w'afonabaa nkasa wɔ w'asomu, na tsie w'afonabaa ne nsɛm.

Meserɛ wo, mma wo wura nntsin Beliahnyi yi do, mekyerɛ Nabal no a: Na dɛ mbrɛ ne dzin tse no, mbrɛ ɔnoara so tse nye no; ne dzin dze Nabal, na nkwaseadze nye no tse: Na emi w'afonabaa dze, mennhu mo wura ne mberantsɛ a esomaa hɔn no.

Dɛm ntsi afei, mo wura, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi, na dɛ wo kra tse ase yi, susuampa dɛ Ewuradze atwe wo ekyir wɔ bɔgya ho sõ ho, na ɔamma ammfa woara wo nsa enndzi wer amma woho no, dɛm ntsi afei, wɔmma w'atamfo, na hɔn a wɔpɛ mo wura bɔn no nnyɛ dɛ Nabal.
Na afei akyɛdze yi a w'afonabaa dze abrɛ mo wura yi, ma wɔmfa mma mberantsɛ a wodzi mo wura ekyir no.
Meserɛ wo, fa w'afonabaa no mfom kyɛ no: Na ampaara Ewuradze bɛkyekyer ofi a otsim mo wura, osiandɛ mo wura na ɔkõ Ewuradze no kõ; na worunnhu bɔn bi wɔ wo mu wo nda nyinara.

Na kaansa ɔdasanyi soɛr dɛ oritsiw wo, na ɔrohwehwɛ wo kra mpo a, mo wura ne kra wɔbɛkyekyer no nkwa boaba no mu wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn; na w'atamfo hɔn akra dze, ɔbɔtow hɔn tsiabo mu dɛ wofi tsiabo no tokur mu.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ Ewuradze nya yɛ mo wura yie dɛ mbrɛ ɔakã no wɔ wo ho no nyinara, na ɔhyɛ wo hen wɔ Israel do a,
ɔno iyi nnkɛyɛ wo awerɛhow, anaa akoma mu fintsidua ama mo wura, dɛ aka bɔgya egu gyan, anaa dɛ mo wura edzi wer ama noho: Na sɛ Ewuradze nya nye mo wura dze no yie a, ɔno kaa w'afonabaa.
Na David see Abigail dɛ, nhyira nkã Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no a ɔsomaa wo ndɛ da yi, dɛ nye me mbedzi ehyia no:
Na nhyira nkã wo nyansaa, na nhyira nkã wo, ɔwo a ndɛ da yi atwe me ekyir wɔ bɔgya ho sõ ho, na amma mammfa mara me nsa ennkedzi wer amma moho.

No nokwar ara dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn no a ɔatwe me ekyir ma mannyɛ wo bɔn no tse ase yi, sɛ annka woho ammba emmbehyia me kwan a, nkyɛ ampaara dɛ ondu anapa enyim tsetsewee nna abɔdomaba ɔbanyin kor mpo nnkae mmaa Nabal.
Nna David gyee dza ɔdze brɛɛ no wɔ ne nsamu: Na ɔsee no dɛ, fow kɔ wo fie asomdwee mu; hwɛ, metsie wo ndze, na mahwɛ w'enyim.

Na Abigail baa Nabal nkyɛn; na, hwɛ, ɔato pon wɔ ne fie, dɛ ɔhen bi no pon, na Nabal n'akoma enyi agye wɔ no mu, osiandɛ ɔabow tetaa: Dɛm ntsi ɔannkã hwee annkyerɛ no, kumaabi o, dodow o, ma okodur anapa enyim tsetsewee ana.
Na ɔbaa dɛ anapa no a nsã no fii Nabal n'enyi do no, nna ne yer no kãa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ no, na n'akoma gyenee wɔ no mu, na ɔyɛɛ dɛ ɔbɔ.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, bɛyɛ n'ekyir dadu no nna Ewuradze bɔɔ Nabal ma owui.

Na aber a David tsee dɛ Nabal ewu no, ɔsee dɛ, nhyira nkã Ewuradze a oedzi m'enyimguase ho asɛm wɔ Nabal nsamu, na ɔatwe n'akowaa ekyir wɔ bɔn ho: Na Nabal ne ndzebɔnyɛ no Ewuradze ama ɔasan ebua narankasa n'etsifi. Na David somae ma wɔkɛkãa Abigail no ho asɛm dɛ wɔnkɛfa no mbrɛ no ma ɔnwar no.
Na David no nkowaa no dur Abigail nkyɛn wɔ Carmel no, wɔkãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, David asoma hɛn wo hɔ, dɛ yɛmbɛfa wo nkɛma no ma ɔnwar wo.
Na ɔsoɛree, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze dze n'enyim boom daadze, na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, w'afonabaa yɛ abaawa dɛ ɔhohor mo wura no nkowaa hɔn anan ho.
Na Abigail yɛɛ ntsɛm soɛree, na ɔtsenaa asoaso do; na osii mu dzii David n'abɔfoe no ekyir kɔree, na ɔbɛyɛɛ ne yer.
David faa Ahinoam a ofi Jezreel no so; na hɔn beenu nyina bɛyɛɛ ne yernom.
Afei nna Saul dze ne babaa Michal, David ne yer no, ama Palti, Laish a ofi Gallim no ne ba no.
26: Na Ziphfo baa Saul hɔ wɔ Gibeah, dɛ, ana David nnsuma noho wɔ Hachilah koko a ɔwɔ sar no n'enyim no no do no bi a?
Nna Saul soɛree, na osii mu kɔr Ziph sar no do, na Israel mbarimba a wɔapa hɔn mpemebiasa ka no ho, dɛ, ɔrokɔhwehwɛ David wɔ Ziph sar no do.
Na Saul kyeer nsera wɔ Hachilah koko a ɔwɔ sar no n'enyim no no do, wɔ ɔkwan nkyɛn. Na David dze ɔtsenaa sar no do, na ohun dɛ Saul aka no do aba sar no no do.
Dɛm ntsi David somaa aserafo, na ohun dɛ Saul aba ampa.

Na David soɛree, na ɔbaa beebi mbrɛ Saul akyer nsera no: Na David hun beebi mbrɛ Saul na ne sahen Abner, Ner ne ba no dedae: Na Saul daa mbrɛ ntseaseanam no sisii no ne ntamu hɔ, na nkorɔfo no akyer nsera abɔ no aprɔw.
Nna David buae, na ɔsee Hittinyi Ahimelech, na Zeruiah ne ba Abishai, Joab no nua no, dɛ, woana na ɔnye me basian akɔ Saul nkyɛn wɔ nseraban no mu? Na Abishai see dɛ, mara menye wo besian akɔ.
Nna David na Abishai baa nkorɔfo no nkyɛn anago: Na, hwɛ, Saul da mbrɛ ntseaseanam sisii no ne ntamu hɔ ɔada, na ne peaa si famu wɔ n'etsifi: Na Abner na nkorɔfo no deda hɔ no ho aprɔw.
Nna Abishai see David dɛ, Nyame eyi wo tamfo ahyɛ wo nsa ndɛ: Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, ma memfa peaa no monwɔ no ɔwɔprɛko nkitsa daadze, na moronnwɔ no mprɛnu.
Na David see Abishai dɛ, mma nnsɛɛ no: Na woana na obotum dɛ ɔtsen ne nsa kã Ewuradze ne nyia wɔasera no no, na onnkedzi fɔ?
Na David see dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi, Ewuradze boku no; anaa ne da bodu ma oewu; anaa ɔbɔkɔ akono na ɔakɔtɔ.
Ewuradze mpa ngu dɛ mebɛtsen me nsa makã nyia Ewuradze asera no no: Na mbom meserɛ wo, fa peaa no a osi n'etsifi no, na nsukuraba no, ma yɛnkɔ.
Nna David faa peaa no na nsukuraba no, wɔ Saul n'etsifi; na wɔkɔree, na nyimpa biara ennhu, ɔanntse so, nkyii so obiara ennyan: Na hɔn nyinara wɔadeda; osiandɛ nda heii fi Ewuradze hɔ atotɔ hɔn do.
Nna David twaa mu kɔr afã noho, na okegyinaa bepɔw no etsifi ekyirkyir noho ara; ɔkwan kɛsenara da hɔn ntamu:
Na David tsēatseaa mu frɛɛ nkorɔfo no, na Ner ne ba Abner dɛ, Abner, immbua? Nna Abner buae, na ɔsee dɛ, ɔwo woana nye wo na etsēatsea mu frɛ ɔhen no?
Na David see Abner dɛ, Ana nnyɛ ɔkobarimba nye wo bi a? Na woana na ɔnye wo sɛ wɔ Israel mu? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na annweɔn wo wura ɔhen? Na nkorɔfo yi hɔn mu baako baa hɔ dɛ nkyɛ ɔrebɛsɛɛ wo wura ɔhen
Adze a ayɛ yi onnye. Dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi, hom sɛ owu, osiandɛ hom annweɔn hom wura, Ewuradze ne nyia wɔasera no no. Na afei, hwɛ mbrɛ ɔhen ne peaa no wɔ, na nsukuraba no a osi n'etsifi no.
Na Saul nyim David ne ndze, na ɔsee dɛ, ana wo ndze nye no a, me ba David? Na David see dɛ, me ndze a, mo wura, ɔhen.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na mo wura ritsiw n'akowaa yi? Na mayɛ dɛn? Anaa ebɛn bɔn wɔ me nsamu?

Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, wɔmma mo wura ɔhen ntsie n'akowaa ne nsɛm. Sɛ Ewuradze na oenunu wo dɛ soɛr mo do a, ɔno ma ɔngye afɔrbɔdze: Na sɛ adasamba dze a, ɔno mpaa nkã hɔn wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Osiandɛ woeyi me edzi ndɛ dɛ mma memmfam Ewuradze n'egyapadze ho, dɛ, Kɔ, kɔsom enyame fofor.
Dɛm ntsi afei, mma mo bɔgyaa mmfi Ewuradze enyim nngu famu: Osiandɛ Israelhen epue rohwehwɛ ɔkraman-dwuw, dɛ mbrɛ obi ritsiw akokɔhwerɛw wɔ mbepɔw do.
Nna Saul see dɛ, mayɛ bɔn: San bra, me ba David: Na merennyɛ wo bɔn bio, osiandɛ mo nkwa asom bo wɔ w'enyi do ndɛ da yi: Hwɛ, mayɛ nkwaseadze, na mafom mbordo.
Na David buae na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, peaa no nye yi, ɔhen! Nkyii ma mberantsɛ no mu baako mbra mbɛfa.
Na Ewuradze bɛdan nyimpa biara ne ndzeyɛtsenenee na no nokwardzi ama no; susuampa dɛ Ewuradze yii wo hyɛɛ me nsa ndɛ da yi, na mammpɛ dɛ metsen me nsa kã nyia Ewuradze asera no no.
Na, hwɛ, dɛ mbrɛ wo nkwa soom bo ndɛ da yi wɔ m'enyi do no, dɛmara so na wɔmma mo nkwa nsom bo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, na wɔmma onyi me mfi ahohiahia nyinara mu.
Nna Saul see David dɛ, nhyira nkã wo, me ba David: Etumdze ara na ebɛyɛ, na konyim ara so na ibedzi. Nna David sii mu kɔr no kwan, na Saul sanee kɔr ne tsenabew.
27: Na David see n'akoma mu dɛ, afei ɔka da kor a mebɛhera wɔ Saul nsamu: Biribiara nnye mma me ma ɔnnsen dɛ mibefi nsa akɔ Philistiafo asaase do; na Saul n'enyidado a ɔwɔ mo ho bɛpa dɛ ɔbɔhwehwɛ me bio wɔ Israel ntoaado nyinara: Nna mibefi ne nsamu mefir.
Na David soɛree, na otwaa mu, ɔno na mbarimba ahaesia a wɔka no ho no, kɔr Maoch ba Achish, Gathhen no nkyɛn.
Na David nye Achish tsenaa Gath, ɔno na ne mbarimba no, nyimpa biara ɔnye ne fifo, mpo David ɔnye ne yernom beenu no, Ahinoam Jezreelnyi no, na Abigail, Carmelnyi no, Nabal ne yer no.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Saul dɛ David eguan kɔ Gath: Na ɔannda ho annhwehwɛ no bio.
Na David see Achish dɛ, sɛ afei menya w'enyim enyimnyam a, ma wɔmma me tsenabew bi wɔ ɔman mu nkurow no bi mu ma menkɛtsena hɔ; na bɛyɛ dɛn ntsi na w'akowaa nye wo bɛtsena ahenkurow mu?
Nna Achish dze Ziklag maa no da no ara: Dɛm ntsi na ɔdze bodu ndɛ ara Ziklag yɛ Judah ahemfo dze.
Na nda a David dze tsenaa Philistiafo hɔn man mu no, ɔyɛ afrenhyia ara mu, na abosoom anan.

Na David na ne mbarimba no sii mu kɔree, na wokotuaa Geshurfo, na Girzifo, na Amalekfo; na aman no nye asaase no do atsefo a wofir tsetse a nkyɛ wɔtsetse beebi mbrɛ edze rokɔ Shur no, ɔdze kodu Egypt asaase no do mpo.
Na David bɔɔ asaase no, na oenngyaa ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa enyikan, na ɔfaa nguan no, na anantwi no, na nsoaso no, na efumpɔnkɔ no, na ndzefuradze no kɔree, na ɔsanee, na ɔbaa Achish nkyɛn.
Na Achish see dɛ, henfa na ndɛ hom kɔr ntuae? Na David see dɛ, yɛkɔr Judah no pomu afamu, na Jerahmeelfo hɔn pomu afamu, na Kenifo hɔn pomu afamu.
Na David enngyaa ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa enyikan, dɛ ɔdze hɔn bɛba Gath, dɛ, bohu na wɔrekã hɛn ho asɛm dɛ, mbrɛ David yɛe nye yi, na mber a ɔtse Philistiafo hɔn man mu no nyinara n'adze a ɔyɛe ara nye no.
Na Achish gyee David dzii, dɛ, ɔayɛ ma no nkorɔfo Israel ekyir no kɔkɔɔkɔ: Dɛm ntsi ɔbɛyɛ m'akowaa daa.
28: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu Philistiafo poon hɔn dɔm hyiaa dɛ worutu sa wɔnye Israel akɔkõ. Na Achish see David dɛ, hu ampaara dɛ ibedzi dɔm no mu nye me etu akɔ, ɔwo na wo mbarimba no.
Na David see Achish dɛ, afei na ibohu dza w'akowaa mebɛyɛ. Na Achish see David dɛ, dɛm ntsi na mebɛyɛ wo me tsir do ɔhwɛfo daa.
Afei nna Samuel ewu, na Israel nyinara egyam no, na woesie no wɔ Ramah, mekyerɛ nankasa no kurow no mu a. Na Saul etu asamamfrɛfo, na abayifo no efi asaase no do.
Na Philistiafo poon hɔnho hyiae, na wɔbae bɛkyeer nsera wɔ Shunem: Na Saul poon Israel nyinara hyiae, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Gilboa.
Na Saul hun Philistiafo hɔn dɔm no, osuroi, na n'akoma tuu kɛsenara.
Na Saul kebisaa Ewuradze no, Ewuradze emmbua no, wɔ adaaso mu, wɔ Urim mu, na ɔkɔnhyɛfo so mu.
Na Saul see no nkowaa dɛ, wɔnhwehwɛ ɔbaa samamfrɛnyi mma me, ma monkɔ no hɔ minkebisa adze. Na no nkowaa see no dɛ, hwɛ, ɔbaa samamfrɛnyi bi wɔ En-dor.

Na Saul sakyeer noho, na ɔkɔree, ɔno na mbarimba beenu ka no ho, na wodur ɔbaa no nkyɛn anago: Na ɔsee no dɛ, meserɛ wo, dua samamfrɛ do hyɛ me nkɔm, na ma obiara a mobɔbɔ ne dzin makyerɛ wo no ɔmfow mbra mma me.
Na ɔbaa no see no dɛ, hwɛ, woara nyim dza Saul ayɛ, mbrɛ oedua na oetwitwa hɔn a wɔyɛ asamamfrɛfo na abayifo hɔn ase efi asaase yi do: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na irusua mo nkwa efir, dɛ ereyɛ ma meewu yi?
Na Saul dze Ewuradze kãa ntam kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi, asɛm biara nnkɛba wo do wɔ iyi ho.
Nna ɔbaa no see dɛ, woana na memma ɔmfow mbra mma wo? Na ɔsee dɛ, ma Samuel mfow mbra mma me.
Na ɔbaa no hun Samuel no nna ɔdze ndze kɛsenara kaa mu: Na ɔbaa no kãa kyerɛɛ Saul dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na adaadaa me yi? Na ɔwo nye Saul.
Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, mma nnsuro: Na ebɛnadze na ihu? Na ɔbaa no see Saul dɛ, muhu onyame bi dɛ ofi asaase mu rofow ba.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, no su tse dɛn? Na ɔsee dɛ, akɔdaa bi na ɔrofow ba; na ɔhyɛ bataker wusuww. Na Saul hun dɛ Samuel a, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze dze n'enyim boom famu, na ɔyɛɛ enyidzi.

Na Samuel see Saul dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ahaw me edze me afow aba yi? Na Saul buaa dɛ, mo ho ehiahia me dodoodow; osiandɛ Philistiafo etu mo do sa, na Nyankopɔn efi me nkyɛn kɔ, na ommbua me bio, onndua nkɔnhyɛfo do, na onndua adaaso mu so: Dɛ ntsi na mafrɛ wo, ama aakyerɛ me dza menyɛ.
Na Samuel see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na ibisa me, hwɛ dɛ Ewuradze efi wo nkyɛn kɔ, na ɔabɛyɛ wo tamfo yi?
Na Ewuradze ayɛ ama noho, dɛ mbrɛ ɔnam mo do kãe no: Na Ewuradze ehwim ahendzi no wɔ wo nsamu, na ɔdze akɛma wo nyɛnko, mekyerɛ David a.
Osiandɛ ɔwo enntsie Ewuradze ne ndze, na annyɛ n'ebufuhyew edwuma wɔ Amalek do, dɛm ntsi na Ewuradze ayɛ wo dɛm adze yi ndɛ da yi.
Nkyii so Ewuradze beyi Israel so aka wo ho ahyɛ Philistiafo nsa: Na ɔkyena ɔwo na wo mbabanyin bɛba abɛka mo ho: Ewuradze beyi Israel dɔm so ahyɛ Philistiafo nsa.

Nna ntsɛmara Saul bui hwee hɔ dze ne tsentsen nyina binaam famu, na osuroo dodoodow, osian Samuel ne nsɛm no ntsi: Na ahoɔdzen biara nnyi no mu; osiandɛ onndzii edziban biara adzekyee no nyinara, na adzesaa no nyinara so.
Na ɔbaa no baa Saul nkyɛn, na ohun dɛ ɔafona dodoodow, na ɔsee no dɛ, hwɛ, w'afonabaa etsie wo ndze, na medze mo nkwa ekitsa me nsamu, na metsie wo nsɛm a ekãa kyerɛɛ me no.
Dɛm ntsi afei meserɛ wo, wo so tsie w'afonabaa ne ndze, na ma memfa edziban trɔma bi mbesi w'enyim; na dzi, ama eenya ahoɔdzen dze akɔ wo kwan.
Na ɔpowee, na ɔsee dɛ, minnkedzi. Na no nkowaa no, nye ɔbaa no nyina wɔhyɛɛ no; na otsiee hɔn ndze. Nna ɔsoɛɛr famu, na ɔtsenaa mpa no do.
Na ɔbaa no wɔ ɔnantwiba a ɔadɔ seradze wɔ fie hɔ; na ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm kokum no; na ɔfaa isiam fetsewee, na ɔdze too epitsi boodoo:
Na ɔdze besii Saul na no nkowaa no enyim; na wodzii. Nna wɔsoɛree, na wosii mu kɔr anago no.
29: Afei Philistiafo poon hɔn dɔm nyinara bae behyiaa Aphek: Na Israelfo kɛkyeer nsera wɔ nsunyiwa a ɔwɔ Jezreel no nkyɛn.
Na Philistiafo asafohemfo no botwaa mu ɔha ɔha na apem apem mu: Na David na ne mbarimba no ka Achish ho botwaa mu wɔ nkyidɔm no mu.

Nna Philistiafo asafohemfo no see dɛ, Hebrewfo yi reyɛ ha dɛn? Na Achish see Philistiafo asafohemfo no dɛ, ana nnyɛ oyi nye David, Israelhen Saul n'akowaa a ɔnye me atsena dɛm nda yi, anaa dɛm mfe yi a munnhun mfom biara wɔ no mu ɔdze ebodu ndɛ da yi no bi a?

Na Philistiafo asafohemfo no hɔn bo fuuw no; na Philistiafo asafohemfo no see no dɛ, ma ɔbarimba yi nsan, na ɔnkɔ ne tsenabew mbrɛ edze no tsenae no bio, na mma ɔnnye hɛn nnkɔ akono, amma ɔaanndan n'enyi wɔ hɛn do wɔ ɔkõ no mu: Na ebɛnadze na oyi dze bɛpata no wura? Anna nnyɛ mbarimba yi hɔn etsir bi a?
Ana nnyɛ oyi nye David a wɔtoow no ho ndwom wɔ asaw mu dɛ, Saul eku n'apem apem, na David ne mpedu mpedu no?

Nna Achish frɛɛ David, na ɔsee no dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi, ayɛ dza ɔtsen, na wo nkɔrmbaa wɔ me nkyɛn wɔ dɔm no mu oye wɔ m'enyi do: Na ofitsi da a ebaa me nkyɛn ɔdze ebodu ndɛ da yi munnhun bɔn bi wɔ wo mu: Naaso asafohemfo no wɔmmpen wo.
Dɛm ntsi, afei, san, na kɔ no asomdwee mu, amma aannyɛ ma Philistiafo asafohemfo hɔn bo eemmfuw.
Na David see Achish dɛ, na ebɛnadze na mayɛ? Na ebɛnadze na ofitsi dɛ mebaa w'enyim dze ebodu ndɛ da yi ehu no w'akowaa mu, ma dɛm ntsi mma monnkɔ mennkɛnye mo wura ɔhen n'atamfo nkɔkõ yi?
Na Achish buae na ɔsee David dɛ, minyim dɛ iyi wɔ m'enyi do dɛ Nyankopɔn no bɔfoe: Naaso Philistiafo asafohemfo na wɔakã dɛ, mma ɔnnye hɛn nnkɔ akono.
Dɛm ntsi afei, enye wo wura no nkowaa a wɔnye wo bae no nsoɛr ahanamakye: Na wɔsoɛr ahanamakye ara, na enyim tsetsew a, wonsi mu nkɔ.
Nna David soɛɛr ahanamakye, ɔno na ne mbarimba no, dɛ worisi mu anapa no wɔasan akɔ Philistiafo hɔn asaase do. Na Philistiafo no sii mu kɔr Jezreel.
30: Na ɔbaa dɛ, ne ndaansa no a David na ne mbarimba no wɔbaa Ziklag no, na Amalekfo ekotua pomu no, na ziklag, na wɔabɔ Ziklag, na wɔdze gya ahyew no;
na wɔafa mbaa na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara, nkakraba na akɛse nyina ndɔmmum: Woennku obiara, mbom wɔsoaa hɔn kɔree, na wɔkɔr hɔn kwan.
Na aber a David na ne mbarimba no wɔbaa kurow no mu no, nna, hwɛ wɔdze gya ahyew no; na wɔafa hɔn yernom, na hɔn mbabanyin, na hɔn mbabaa ndɔmmum kɔ.
Nna David na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no wɔmaa hɔn ndze do wosūi araa kodur dɛ wonnyi ahom bio dɛ wɔdze bosū.
Na David ne yernom beenu no so wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum, Jezreelnyi Ahinoam, na Abigail, Carmelnyi Nabal ne yer no.

Na David no ho hiahiaa no kɛsenara; osiandɛ nkorɔfo no kãa dɛ wobesiw no abo, osiandɛ nkorɔfo no nyinara hɔn kra no werɛ howee, ɔbarimba biara wɔ ne mbabanyin na ne mbabaa ntsi: Na David dze, ɔhyɛɛ noho dzen wɔ Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn mu.
Nna David see ɔsɔfo Abiathar, Ahimelech ne ba no, dɛ, meserɛ wo, fa ephod no brɛ me ha. Na Abiathar dze ephod no brɛɛ David wɔ hɔ.
Nna David bisaa Ewuradze dɛ, sɛ mitsiw dɔm yi a, ana mobɔto hɔn a? Na obuaa no dɛ, tsiw hɔn: Na ampaara dɛ ebɔto hɔn, na ɔyɛ dɛn ara a wo nsa bɛkã hɔn nyinara bio.
Nna David sii mu kɔree, ɔno na mbarimba ahaesia a wɔka no ho no, na wobodur ɔwora besor ho, mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaa ekyir no siankae no.
Na David dze otsiiw hɔn, ɔno na mbarimba ahaanan: Na ahaenu a wɔatotɔ bahaw dodow dɛ wonnkotum etwa ɔwora Besor no siankaa ekyir:
Na wokohun Egyptnyi bi wɔ haban mu, na wɔdze no brɛɛ David, na wɔmaa no edziban ma odzii, na wɔmaa no nsu ma ɔnomee:
Na wɔmaa no adɔmba etɔw no ho kakra, na esikyireamba esiaw ebien; na odzii no, no sunsum sanee baa no mu bio: Osiandɛ onndzii edziban biara, na ɔnnoom nsu biara so, adaansa, adzekyee na adzesaa.
Na David see no dɛ, ɔwo yɛ woana nedze? Na henfa na ifi? Na ɔsee dɛ, meyɛ Egyptnyi aberantsɛ, Amaleknyi bi n'akowaa; na mo wura daan me gyae, osiandɛ ndɛ ndaansa na yarba kãa me.
Yekotuaa Cherethfo hɔn pomu afamu, na dza ɔyɛ Judah dze no, na Caleb no pomu afamu; na yɛdze gya hyeew Ziklag.
Na David see no dɛ, ana edze me besian akɔ dɔm yi nkyɛn a? Na ɔsee dɛ, fa Nyame kã ntam kyerɛ me dɛ innkoku me, nkyii so innkeyi me ahyɛ mo wura nsa, na medze wo besian makɔ dɔm yi nkyɛn.
Na ɔdze no sianee kɔree no, nna hwɛ, wɔapetse wɔ famu hɔ nyinara woridzidzi na wɔronom, na wɔresaw, osian asadze pii a wɔakɛfa no wɔ Philistiafo asaase do, na Judah asaase do no nyinara ntsi.
Na David ofitsi adansaber no kunkum hɔn araa dze kodur n'adzekyee no ewimbir: Na hɔn mu nyimpa biara emmfi nsa, gyedɛ mberantsɛ ahaanan a wɔkoko efumpɔnkɔ do guanee no.
Na David gyee dza Amalekfo kɛfae no nyinara bio: Na David gyee ne yernom beenu no.
Na annka hɔn biribiara, kakraba o, kɛse o, mbabanyin o, mbabaa o, asadze o, adze biara a wɔfae o: David dze ne nyinara sanee bae.
Na David faa nguan na anantwi no nyinara, dza wɔkaa hɔn dzii mbowa nkaa no enyim no, na ɔsee dɛ, David n'asadze nye yi.

Na David baa mbarimba ahaenu no a wɔtotɔɔ bahaw ma woenntum annka David do no a wɔmaa wɔtsenaa ɔwora Besor ho no, hɔn nkyɛn: Na wosii mu kehyiaa David, na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no kwan: Na David bɛɛn nkorɔfo no okyiaa hɔn.

Nna hɔn a wɔnye David kɔree no hɔn mu nyimpa bɔn, na Belial mbarimba no buae, na wɔsee dɛ, osiandɛ wɔnnye hɛn annkɔ ntsi, yɛnnkɛma hɔn asadze a yɛakɛgye yi mu biara, gyedɛ nyimpa biara ne yer na ne mba, ama wɔaahwɛ hɔn nye hɔn akɔ.
Nna David see dɛ, mma hom nnyɛ dɛm, mo nuanom, wɔ dza Ewuradze dze ama hɛn no ho, ɔno a ɔahwɛ hɛn do, na oeyi dɔm a wɔbaa hɛn do no ahyɛ hɛn nsa.
Woana na obetsie hom wɔ asɛm yi mu? Na mbrɛ nyia ɔkɔ akono ne kyɛpɛn tse no, dɛmara so na nyia ɔtsena ndzɛmba ho ne kyɛpɛn tse; wɔnkyɛ no pɛrpɛr.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ofitsi da no ara dze rokɔ no, ɔdze too hɔ yɛɛ ahyɛdze na ɔmom maa Israel, dze bodu ndɛ.
Na David dur Ziklag no, ɔsomae ma wɔdze asadze no bi kɛmaa Judah mpanyimfo a wɔyɛ ne mfɛfo no dɛ, hwɛ, Ewuradze n'atamfo asadze mu nhyira a wɔdze rebrɛ hom nye yi;
dze kɛma hɔn a wɔwɔ Beth-el, na hɔn a wɔwɔ Ramoth pomu afamu, na hɔn a wɔwɔ Jattir;
na hɔn a wɔwɔ Aroer, na hɔn a wɔwɔ Siphmoth, na hɔn a wɔwɔ Eshtemoa;
na hɔn a wɔwɔ Racal, na hɔn a wɔwɔ Jerahmeelfo nkurow mu, na hɔn a wɔwɔ Kenifo nkurow mu;
na hɔn a wɔwɔ Hormah, na hɔn a wɔwɔ Cor-ashan, na hɔn a wɔwɔ Athach;
na hɔn a wɔwɔ Hebron, na mbeambea nyinara a David nankasa ɔnye ne nyimpa kyinkyinii no hɔ.
31: Afei Philistiafo nye Israel kõe: Na Israel mbarimba fii Philistiafo enyim guanee, na wɔtotɔree wɔ Gilboa bepɔw do.
Na Philistiafo no tsiiw Saul na ne mba no; na Philistiafo no kum Jonathan, na Abinadab, na Malchi-shua, Saul ne mba no.
Na ɔkõ no yɛɛ dzen tsiaa Saul, na egyentofo no too no, na no ho hiahiaa no kɛsenara wɔ egyentofo no ntsi.

Nna Saul see n'akodzesoanyi no dɛ, twe w'afõwa na fa wɔ mo mu; amma monomonomfo yinom aammba ammbɔwɔ me, na woeennsi me atwetwe. Na n'akodzesoanyi no ammpen; osiandɛ osuroo dodow. Dɛm ntsi Saul faa afõwa no, na ɔhwee do.
Na n'akodzesoanyi no hun dɛ Saul ewu no, ɔno so hwee n'afõwa do dɛmara, na ɔnye no wui.
Dɛm na Saul na ne mbabanyin baasa, na n'akodzesoanyi, na ne mbarimba nyinara so wuwuu prɛko da no ara.
Na Israel mbarimba a wɔwɔ bɔnsa no egya na hɔn a wɔwɔ Jordan egya no hun dɛ Israel mbarimba no eguan, na Saul na ne mbabanyin atotɔr no, wɔdaan nkurow no gyae; na Philistiafo bae bɛtsenaa mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ n'adzekyee no Philistiafo baa beyiyii atɔfo ho adze no, wohun Saul na ne mbabanyin baasa no dɛ wɔatotɔ wɔ Gilboa bepɔw do.
Na wotwaa ne tsir, na woyii no ho akodze, na wɔsomae ma wɔdze kyiin Philistiafo asaase do hyiae, dɛ wɔnkɔbɔ hɔn abosondan na ɔman no amandzɛɛ.
Na wɔdze n'akodze no kesiee Ashtaroth dan mu: Na wɔdze no fun no sɛɛn Beth-shan ɔfasu ho.
Na Jabesh-gilead atsefo tsee dza Philistiafo dze ayɛ Saul no,
akombarimba no nyinara soɛree nantseew anago nyina kɛfaa Saul no fun na ne mbabanyin no hɔn efun no fii Beth-shan ɔfasu no ho; na wɔbaa Jabesh bɛhyeew no wɔ hɔ.
Na wɔfaa hɔn mbiew kesiee no wɔ tamarisk dua no ase wɔ Jabesh, na wodzii mbuada nda esuon.

1: Paul nye Silvanus nye Timothy dze kɛma Thessalonica asɔr a ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn Egya no nye Ewuradze Jesus Christ mu: Adom nye asomdwee nkã hom
Yɛda Nyankopɔn ase daa wɔ hom nyina ntsi, yɛbɔ hom dzin wɔ hɛn asɔryɛ nu;
na daa yɛkaa hom gyedzi dwuma nye hon dɔ mbɔdzembɔ, nye Ewuradze Jesus Christ mu enyidado ho abotar, wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Egya no enyim;
na, enuanom a Nyame adɔ hom, yenyim ɔsan a ɔasan mu eyi hom,
osiandɛ hɛn asɛmpa no ammba hom nkyɛn wɔ asɛm mu nko, na mbom wɔ tum mu, nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu, nye taduasi pii mu; dɛ mbrɛ hom nyim nyimpa ban a yɛkyerɛɛ hɛnho dɛ yɛyɛ wɔ hom afamu.
Na hom so yɛɛ hɛn nye Ewuradze esuasuafo dze Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn dɛw no gyee asɛm no wɔ ahohia pii mu;
na hom bɛyɛɛ fasusu maa hɔn a wɔgye dzi nyina wɔ Macedonia nye Achaia nyina.
Na ofi hom mu na Nyankopɔn asɛm agyegye, wɔ nnyɛ Macedonia nye Achaia nko, na mbom mbae nyina so hom gyedzi a ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn afamu ekodu hɔ, ma onnhia dɛ yɛkã ho asɛm bi mpo.
Na hɔnara wɔkã hɛn ho asɛm kyerɛ kwan kor a yenyae wɔ hom mu, na mbrɛ hom danee fii abosom nkyɛn baa Nyankopɔn hɔ, dɛ hom rɔbɔsom Nyame tseasefo nokwafo no,
na hom aatweɔn ne Ba a onyaan no fii ewufo mu no efi sor, Jesus a ɔgye hɔn fi ebufuw a ɔreba no mu no.
2: Na, enuanom, homankasa nyim hɛn kwan a yenyae no wɔ hom mu no dɛ annyɛ gyan:
na yeedzi kan ehu amandze pii na wɔabɔ hɛn adapaa, wɔ Philippi dɛ mbrɛ hom nyim no, yɛyɛɛ ndam wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn mu dɛ yɛbɛkã Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no akyerɛ hom wɛ ɔkõ pii mu.
Na hɛn afotusɛn mmfi mfom anaadɛ efifidze, anaa ndaadaa mu:
Na dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn ebu hɛn bi dɛ ɔdze asɛmpa no ahyɛ hɛn nsa no, dɛmara na yɛkasa; nnyɛ dɛ yɛsɔ nyimpa enyi, na mbom Nyankopɔn a ɔsɔ adze nyina hwɛ no a.
Na yɛnnkã adɛfɛdɛfɛsɛm da dɛ mbrɛ hom nyim, eso yɛmmfa asɛm bi nnyɛ enyikaber nkatado, Nyame nye daefo;
eso yɛnnhwehwɛ nyimpa enyimnyam wɔ hom anaa binom hɔ, ber a yɛwɔ ho kwan dɛ yɛdze hɛnho hyehyɛ hom do, dɛ Christ asomfo no.
Mbom yɛyɛɛ abrɛfo wɔ hom mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔbagyegyefo bi nyɛn nankasa ne mba:
na dɛ yɛdɔ hom asɛm yie dɛm ntsi, yɛpɛɛ dɛ nnyɛ Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no nko na yɛbɛkyɛ ama hom, na hɛnankasa h2n akra so mpo, osiandɛ hom ho yɛɛ hɛn na dodow.
Na enuanom, hom kaa hɛn mbɔdzembɔ nye fona: Na yɛyɛɛ edwuma adzesaa nye adzekyee, mma yaannyɛ adzesoadze ama hom mu biara, na yɛdze kãa Nyame asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ hom.
Hom nye adasefo na Nyankopɔn so, mbrɛ yeduae bɔɔ hɛn bra, dɛ afɔbu biara nnyi mu, krɔnkrɔn mu, tsenenee mu, maa hom a hom gye dzi no,
dɛ hom nyim mbrɛ yɛtutuu hom fo nkorkor dɛ egya nye mba, na yɛhyɛɛ hom dzen, na yedzii dase,
dɛ hom nnantsew dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ Nyankopɔn a ɔafrɛ hom akɔ n'ahendzi nye n'enyimnyam mu no.

Iyi ntsi so yenngyaa Nyankopɔn ase da, osiadɛ hom gyee Nyankopɔn amandzɛɛ asɛm no wɔ hɛn hɔ no, hom anngye no dɛ nyimpa asɛm, na mbom dɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm mbrɛ ɔtse so ampa, ɔno so na ɔyɛ hom a hom gye dzi mu edwuma.
Na hom, enuanom, yɛɛ Nyankopɔn asɔr a ɔwɔ Judea wɔ Christ Jesus mu no esuafo: Osiandɛ hom so hun homankasa hom mamfo nsamu amandze dɛmara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn so hunii wɔ Judafo nsamu;
hɔn a wokum Ewuradze Jesus nye nkɔnhyɛfo no, na wɔapempam hɛn, na wɔnnsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi, na wotsia nyimpa nyina:
wɔbra amamfo mma wonnya nkwa; amawɔaama hɔn bɔn ayɛ mã daa: nanso ebufuw no enya aba hɔn do ewie.
Na hɛndze, enuanom, yefii hom nkyɛn mber kakraabi wɔ enyi na nnyɛ akoma mu no, yɛbɔ mbɔdzen pii wɔ enyigyina kɛse mu dɛ yebohu hom enyim:
osiandɛ yɛpɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ yɛba hom nkyɛn, mankasa Paul, prɛko nye mpɛn ebien; na abɔnsamsiiw hɛn kwan.
Na ebɛnadze nye hɛn enyidado, anaadɛ enyigye, anaadɛ ahohyehyɛ-abɔtsir? Ana nnyɛ homara wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Christ enyim wɔ ne ba mu?
Homara nye hɛn enyimnyam nye hɛn enyigye.
3: Dɛm ntsi yenntum nnkom do bio no, yɛdween dɛ oye dɛ wogya hɛn nko ekyir wɔ Athens;
na yɛsomaa Timothy a ɔyɛ hɛn nua nye Nyankopɔn somfo wɔ Christ asɛmpa no mu no dɛ ɔmbɛhyɛ hom dzen, na ɔnkyekye hom werɛ gyedzi no ho;
amma amandzehu yi eennhihim obiara; na homankasa nyim dɛ woeyi hɛn ato hɔ ama dɛm.
Na yɛwɔ hom nkyɛn no yɛkãa kyerɛɛ hom siee dɛ yebohu amandze; dɛ mbrɛ ɔbaa mu, na hom nyim no.
Iyi ntsi na mo so munntum nnkom do bio no, mosomae ma meehu hom gyedzi amma bi a ɔgyegyefo no aanngyegye hom na hɛn mbɔdzembɔ aannyɛ kwa.
Na afei Timothy fi hom nkyɛn baa hɛn nkyɛn bɛkãa hɛn hom gyedzi nye hom dɔ ho nsɛm pa, na dɛ hom kaa hɛn yie daa, na hom afe dɛ hom hu hɛn so yɛafe dɛ yehu hom no kyerɛɛ hɛn.
Iyi ntsi enuanom, hɛn werɛ kyekye hom nyina ho, wɔ hɛn amandzehu nye hɛn ahohia nyina mu, wɔ hom gyedzi ntsi.
Na afei sɛ hom gyina pintsinn wɔ Ewuradze mu a, yeenya nkwa.
Na hom ho ndaase bɛn na yebotum ada Nyankopɔn bio, wɔ dɛw nyina a yedzi wɔ hom ntsi wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim;
dɛ adzesaa nye adzekyee yɛreserɛ pii dɛ yembohu hom enyim ma yaabɛhyɛ dza ɔaka wɔ hom gyedzi mu no mã?
Na hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Egya noara, nye Ewuradze Jesus Christ ntsen hɛn kwan mbra hom nkyɛn.
Na Ewuradze mma hom ndɔɔ sõ na hom mbor do wɔ dɔ mu mma homho nkorkor, nye nyimpa nyina, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn so yɛyɛ ma hom no;
na ɔaahyɛ hom akoma dzen, dɛ afɔbu nnyi mu, krɔnkrɔnyɛ mu wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Egya no enyim, wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ nye n'ahotsewfo hɔn ba mu.
4: Dza ɔaka no, enuanom, yɛserɛ hom na yetu hom fo wɔ Ewuradze Jesus mu dɛ, mbrɛ hom nyaa no hɛn hɔ mbrɛ ɔsɛ dɛ hom nantsew na hom sɔ Nyankopɔ enyi no, dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛ yi ara, dɛmara na hom mbor do pii.
Na homankasa hom nyim ahyɛdze a yɛnam Ewuradze Jesus do hyɛɛ hom no.
Na iyi nye Nyankop0n ne pɛ, hom ahosan, dɛ hom nyi homho mfi ndwamansɛm ho;
dɛ hom mu biara bohu mbrɛ odua kora ne yer wɔ ahosan nye enyidzi mu.
Nnyɛ akɔndɔ nhyɛdo mu dɛ amanamamfo a wonnyim Nyankopɔn;
amma obiara eemmbu do ennkesisi no nua wɔ asɛm no mu, osiandɛ Ewuradze nye yinom nyina ho werdzifo, dɛ mbrɛ yɛbɔɔ hom nkaa nkan no, na yedzii ho dase no.
Na Nyankopɔn annfrɛ hɛn annkɔ efifidze mu, na mbom ahosan mua.
Dɛm ntsi nyia ɔpow iyi no, nnyɛ nyimpa bi na ɔpow no, na Nyankopɔn a ɔdze no Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ama hom no a.
Na enuadɔ ho dze, onnhia hom dɛ obi kyerɛw brɛ hom; osiandɛ Nyankopɔn akyerɛkyerɛ homankasa dɛ hom ndɔdɔ homho.
Na ampa so hom yɛ no wɔ eneanom a wɔwɔ Macedonia nyinaho. Naaso enuanom, yetu hom fo, dɛ hom mbor do pii;
