na hom mbɔ mbɔdze nyɛ komm na hom nyɛ homankasa hom adze, na hom mfa hom nsa nyɛ edwuma, dɛ mbrɛ yɛhyɛɛ hom no;
na hom aanantsew dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata wɔ hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyir no enyim, na biribi eennhia hom.
Na enuanom, yɛmmpɛ dɛ hom yɛ atam wɔ hɔn a wɔdeda no ho, mma hom eenndzi awerɛhow dɛ nkaa no a wonnyi enyidado no.
Na sɛ yɛgye dzi dɛ Jesus wui na ɔsoɛɛr bio a, dɛmara na Nyankopɔn dze hɔn a wɔadeda wɔ Jesus mu bɛka no ho aba.
Na iyidze, yɛnam Ewuradze asɛm do kã kyerɛ hom dɛ, hɛn a yɛtse ase, na yɛreka ekodu Ewuradze ne ba mu, yennkotwar hɔn a wɔadeda no ano.
Osiandɛ Ewuradze nankasa dze frɛ kɛse, nye bɔfopanyin no ne ndze, nye Nyankopɔn akasamu no fi sor besian, na Christ mu ewufo bɛdzi kan asoɛr;
ansaana wɔaabɛfa hɛn a yɛtsetse ase na yɛaka no aka hɔn ho wɔ nsuwusiw no mu ma yeekehyia Ewuradze wɔ wimu, na dɛm na yɛnye Ewuradze bɛtsena daa.
Dɛm ntsi hom mfa nsɛm yi nkyekyekye hom werɛ nkorkor.
5: Na nda no nye mber no ho dze, enuanom, onnhia hom dɛ wɔkyerɛw biribi brɛ hom.
homankasa nyim pɛr dɛ Ewuradze da no bɛba dɛ owifo ba anago.
Na ber a wɔrese dɛ, asomdwee nye ahotɔ, nna awerɛfir sɛɛ bɛba hɔn do dɛ mbrɛ awoko ba ɔbaa a onyinsen do; na wonnkefi nsa.
Na homdze, enuanom, hom nnyi sum mu, nna da no abɔto hom dɛ owifo.
Hom nyina yɛ kan mba nye adzekee mba; yɛnnyɛ adzesaa anaa sum mba.
Dɛm ntsi mma hom mma yɛnndeda dɛ nkaa no, na mbom hom mma yɛnweɔn na hɛn enyi nda hɔ.
Na hɔn a wɔda da anago; na hɔn a wɔbow bow anago.
Na hɛndze yɛyɛ adzekyee mba ntsi, hom mma hɛn enyi nda hɔ, yɛnhyɛ gyedzi nye ɔdɔ dɛ akatabɔ, nye nkwagye ho enyidado no dɛ dadzekyɛw.
Na Nyankopɔn ennyi hɛn annto hɔ amma ebufuw, na mbom dɛ yebenya nkwagye a ɔnam Christ do.
Ɔno na owui maa hɛn ma sɛ yɛtse ase o, yɛda o, yɛnye no nyina aatsena ase.
Dɛm ntsi hom ntutu homho fo, na hom ntotow homho do nkorkor dɛ mbrɛ so hom reyɛ yi.
Na yɛserɛ hom, enuanom, dɛ hom nhu hɔn a wɔyɛ hom mu edwuma, na wodzi hom do mpanyin wɔ Ewuradze mu, na wɔkasa kyerɛ hom no;
na hom mbu hɔn kɔnkrɔnn wɔ ɔdɔ mu, wɔ hɔn edwuma no ntsi. Hom nnya asomdwee wɔ hom mu.
Na yetuhom fo so, enuanom, dɛ hom nkasa nkyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ basabasa, hom nkyekye hɔn a hɔn akoma apa werɛ, hom nwaw hɔn a wɔyɛ mbɛrɛw, na hom nyɛ penkyɛr wɔ nyimpa nyina afamu.
Hom nhwɛ mma obi ammfa bɔn enntua obi bɔn kaw; na mbom hom ndzi dzaoye ekyir daa, wɔ homho nkorkor nye nyimpa nyina afamu.
Hom enyi ngye daa;
hom mfua asɔryɛ nu;
adze nyina mu hom nda ase: na iyi nye Nyankopɔn ne pɛ wɔ Christ Jesus mu wɔ hom ho.
Mma hom nndum Sunsum no;
mma hom mmbu nkɔnhyɛsɛm tootooba;
hom nsɔ adze nyina nhwɛ; hom nsuo dza oye mu dzen;
hom nyi homho wɔ bɔn su nyina ho.
Na asomdwee Nyankopɔn nankasa nsan hom ho koraa, na 0nkora hom sunsum nye kra nye nyimpadua do dɛ asɛm bi nnyi ho wɔ Ewuradze Jesus Christ ne ba mu.
Ɔsɛnkordzifo nye nyia ɔfrɛ hom no, ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ so.
Enuanom, hom nsɔr mma hɛn.
Hom mfa mfewano krɔnkrɔn nkyiakyia enuanom nyina.
Mekã hom Ewuradze dɛ hom mma wɔnkenkan nwoma yi nkyerɛ enuanom no nyina.
Ewuradze Jesus Christ adom nkã hom.

1: Paul, Christ Jesus somafo, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn Agyenkwa Nyame nye hɛn enyidado Christ Jesus n'ahyɛdze tse;
dze kɛma Timothy, monokwar ba wɔ gyedzi mu; Adom, mbɔbɔrhu nye asomdwee mfi ɛnya Nyankopɔn nye Christ Jesus hɛn Ewuradze hɔ nkã wo.
Dɛ mbrɛ morokɔ Macedonia a, meserɛɛ wo dɛ tsena Ephesus na eetu binom fo, amma wɔaannkyerɛ ɔkyerɛ fofor bi,
na eso woeenntsie anansesɛm nye ananakan a onnyi ewiei a ɔdze nsɛmbisa ba kyɛn Nyame ofihwɛ a ɔwɔ gyedzi mu no; dɛmara so na meyɛ sesei.
Na ahyɛdze no ewiei nye ɔdɔ a ofi akoma krɔnn nye tsibowa pa nye gyedzi a ɔnnyɛ abra mu;
ɔno na binom atow atser ho adan akɔ nsɛm gyangyan mu;
wɔpɛ dɛ wɔyɛ mbrakyerɛfo, naaso wonnyim dza wɔse, nye dza wɔrekã no ɔdzendo no ase.
Na hɛndze yenyim dɛ mbra no, sɛ obi dzi do nokwar mu a, oye,
dɛ yenyim dɛ mbra wɔnnhyɛ nnto hɔ mma ɔtseneneenyi, na mbom wɔhyɛe maa mbratofo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo, hɔn a hɔn ho nntsew, nye ahohurafo, egyanom nye nanom ekumfo, nyimpakumfo,
ndwaman, hɔn a wɔnye mbarimba deda, edwotwafo, atorfo, ntamtofo, ɔnye biribiara a ɔnye nkyerɛkyerɛ pa no nnsaa;
dɛ mbrɛ Nyame siarfo n'enyimnyam asɛmpa a wɔdze hyɛɛ me nsa no tse.
Na meda hɛn Ewuradze Christ Jesus a ɔhyɛɛ me dzen dɛ oebu me nokwarfo dze me ahyɛ ɔsom no mu no ase;
emi a nkyɛ nkan no meyɛ busuyɛnyi nye ɔhonankanyi nye ɔbofo, naaso minyaa ehumbɔbɔr; osiandɛ minnyim na meyɛe wɔ ekyingye mu;
na hɛn Ewuradze n'adom dɔɔ sõ mbordo wɔ gyedzi nye dɔ a ɔwɔ Christ Jesus mu mu.
Ɔyɛ nokwasɛm a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔgye pen koraa, dɛ Christ Jesus baa wiadze bɛgyee ndzebɔnyɛfo nkwa; hɔn mu otsitsir nye me;
na eso iyi ntsi na minyaa ehumbɔbɔr ama ɔnam emi, otsitsir yi mu, Christ Jesus eeyi ne penkɛr nyina edzi, ma maayɛ hɔn a nkyirkyir wɔbɛgye no edzi akɔ onnyiewiei nkwa mu no ntoho.
Na afei, mbersantsen Hena ɔmmprɔw, wonnhu no a no nkotonoo nye Nyankopɔn no, enyidzi nye enyimnyam nkã no mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
Dɛm kasakyerɛ yi na medze hyɛ wo nsa, me ba Timothy, dɛ mbrɛ nkɔnhyɛnsɛm a wɔkãa no wo ho kan no tse, na aafa do akõ ɔkõ pa,
eesuo gyedzi nye tsibowa pa a binom egyaa mu akyen egu esu wɔ gyedzi no ho no mu dzen;
hɔn mu bi nye Hymenæus nye Aleɛander a meyi hɔn mama abɔnsam dɛ wɔnkyerɛ hɔn mma wɔaannkã ebususɛm.
2: Dɛm ntsi, dza odzi ne nyina kan, mutu fo dɛ wɔnyɛ nkotoserɛ, mpaayi, kasama, nye aseda mma nyimpa nyina;
mma ahemfo nye hɔn a wodzi tum nyina: Ma yaatsena ase dwudwoodwo komm wɔ nyamesompa nye fɔntɔmmyɛ nyina mu.
Iyi na oye na ɔyɛ enyisɔ wɔ hɛn Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn enyim;
ɔno a ɔpɛ dɛ wɔgye nyimpa nyina nkwa, na wɔba nkwar no ho no nyimdzee mu.
Na Onyame kortoo na ɔwɔ hɔ, nye Nyame nye nyimpa ntamugyinafo kor, onyimpa Christ Jesus no;
ɔno a ɔdze noho maa dɛɛ asatsir maa nyimpa nyina; dɛ ɔnyɛ dase wɔ ber a ɔsɛ mu;
no ho na wɔahyɛ me ɔsɛnkafo nye ɔsomafo, (mekã nokwar, minndzi ator), amanaman kyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ gyedzi nye nokwar mu.
Dɛm ntsi mepɛ dɛ mbarimba yɛ asɔr wɔ mbea nyina, wɔma nsa krɔnkrɔn do a ebufuw anaa anyanyan nnyi mu.
Dɛmara na mbaa nhyɛ ntar a ɔnnyɛ hyerɛpɛɛ, mfa enyi a ɔfɛr adze nye enyidahɔ nkeka hɔnho, nnyɛ etsidwow, anaa sika, anaa ahondze pa anaa aboɔdzen ntar;
na mbom, (dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ mbaa a woyi nyamesom kyerɛ), wɔ ndwuma pa mu.
Hom mma ɔbaa nyɛ komm nsūa wɔ ahobrɛadze nyina mu.
Na ɔbaa dze, memma no kwan dɛ ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ, anaa ondzi ɔbanyin do tum, na mbom ɔnyɛ komm.
Na wodzii kan bɔɔ Adam ansaana wɔrebɔ Eve;
na nnyɛ Adam na wɔdaadaa no, na ɔbaa no na wɔdaadaa no ɔkɔtɔɔ mbrato mu;
naaso sɛ ɔdze enyidahɔ tsena gyedzi nye dɔ nye ahotsew mu a, wɔbɛgye no abawoo mu.
3: Nokwasɛm nye yi, Sɛ obi pɛ ɔhwɛfo-dwuma a, ɔapɛ edwuma pa.
Dɛm ntsi ɔsɛ ɔhwɛfo dɛ no ho nnyi asɛm, ɔyɛ ɔyer baako kun, n'enyi da hɔ, n'adwen mu tsew, ɔyɛ wense wense, ɔpɛ ahɔhoyɛ, otum kyerɛkyerɛ;
ɔnnyɛ nsahweam, ɔnnyɛ pupopupo; na mbom ɔdwe, ɔnnyɛ tutuwpɛnyi, ɔnnyɛ sikanyibernyi;
ɔhom nankasa ne fi do yie, ma ne mba hyɛ n'ase wɔ fɔntɔmmyɛ nyina mu;
(na sɛ obi nnhu nankasa ne fi do hom a, ɔyɛ dɛn tum hwɛ Nyame asɔr do?)
Nnyɛ abaɛfor a, amma ɔaannhoran annkɔhwe abɔnsam n'afɔbu mu.
Afei so ɔsɛ dɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyir so bɔ no dzin pa; amma ɔaannhwe enyimguase nye abɔnsam efir mu.
Dɛmara na asɔr mu asomfo no so ɔsɛ dɛ hɔn enyim yɛ fɔntɔmm, wɔnnyɛ tɛkyerɛmanta, wɔnnyɛ nsahweam, wɔnnyɛ edzifodzepɛfo;
wɔkora gyedzi esumasɛm no wɔ tsibowa a ɔho tsew mu.
Na yinom so wondzi kan nsɔ hɔn nhwɛ ana, sɛ hɔn ho nnyi asɛm bi a, wɔasom dɛ asɔr mu asomfo.
Mbaa so hɔn enyim nyɛ fɔntɔmm dɛmara, wɔnnyɛ nsekubɔfo, hɔn enyi da hɔ, wodzi nokwar wɔ adze nyina mu.
Asɔr mu asomfo nyɛ ɔyer baako baako kunnom a wɔhwɛ hɔn mba nye hɔnankasahɔn fi do yie.
Na hɔn a wɔasom yie dɛ asɔr mu asomfo no, wonya gyinabew pa, nye ndam kɛse wɔ gyedzi a ɔwɔ Christ Jesus mu no mu.
Iyinim na mekyerɛw mebrɛ wo, naaso m'enyi da dɛ mebɛba wo nkyɛn ntsɛm;
na sɛ bi a mebɛkyɛr a, eehu mbrɛ ɔsɛ dɛ ebɔ wo bra wɔ Nyankopɔn fie a ɔyɛ Onyame tseasefo n'asɔr mu a ɔyɛ nokwar no ne fadum nye ne ngyinado no.

Na ɔho nnyi ekyingye dɛ nyamesom esumasɛm no sõ; ɔno wɔdaa no edzi wɔ honam mu, wobuu no bem wɔ sunsum mu, abɔfo hun no, wɔbɔɔ no dawur wɔ amanaman mu, wɔgyee no dzii wɔ wiadze, wɔfaa no kɔr sor wɔ enyimnyam mu.
4: Na Sunsum no kã kotoo dɛ, mber a odzi ekyir no mu, binom betsin ndaadaa sunsum nye mbɔnsam nkyerɛkyerɛ do atwe hɔnho efi gyedzi no ho;
wɔ hɔn a wodzi ator ndabraba ntsi; wɔasaa hɔn wɔhɔn tsibowa nu dɛ wɔdze dadze hyew;
wɔbra awar, na wɔkã dɛ wontua edziban a Nyankopɔn bɔɔ dɛ hɔn a wɔgye dzi na wonyim nokwar no mfa ndaase ngye ndzi no.
Na Nyame abɔdze nyina ye, na sɛ yɛdze ndaase gye a, ɔnngyɛ dɛ yekyir biribiara;
osiandɛ wɔdze Nyame asɛm nye asɔryɛ tsew ho.
Sɛ ekaakaa enuanom no yinom a, ebɛyɛ Jesus Christ somfo pa a wɔanyɛn no gyedzi no nye nkyerɛkyerɛ pa a edzi ekyir no mu;
na ebususɛm huhuw na mberwa anansesɛm no dze, pow. Na bɔ nyamesom ho mbɔdzen;
na honam mu mbɔdzen ho mfaso suar; na nyamesom ho wɔ mfaso ma adze nyina, na ɔwɔ nkwa a ɔwɔ hɔ sesei nye dza ɔreba no ho anohoba.
Nokwasɛm nye yi, na ɔsɛ dɛ wɔgye pen koraa.
Na iyi ho na yɛbɔ mbɔdzen na yɛper, osiandɛ yɛdze hɛn enyidado ato Nyame tseasefo a ɔyɛ nyimpa nyina hɔn Agyenkwa, nkanka hɔn a wɔyɛ agyedzifo.
Iyinom na tu ho fo na kyerɛkyerɛ.
Mma obi mmbu w'berantsɛyɛtootooba; na mbom yɛ esusudo ma agyedzifo, wɔkasa mu, abrabɔ mu, ɔdɔ mu, gyedzi mu, ahotsew mu.
Ma w'enyi nku akenkan, afotu, nkyerɛkyerɛ mu ara nkodu dɛ mebɛba.
Mma w'enyi mmpa akyɛdze a wɔnam nkɔnhyɛ nye mpanyimfo nsa a wɔdze guu wo do maa wo no do.
Bɔ yinom ho mbɔdzen; fa woho ma hɔn koraa; na wo mpontu aada edzi wɔ adze nyina mu.
Ma w'enyi nkuku wankasa nye wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho. Tsena mu; na eyɛ dɛm a, ebɛgye woho nye w'etsiefo nkwa.
5: Mma nntwuw ɔpanyin enyim, na mbom tu no fo dɛ egya; mberatsɛ no dɛ enuanom;
mberwa no dɛ nanom; mbabaawa no dɛ nkyerɛbaa, wɔ ahotsew nyina mu.
Ekunafo a wɔyɛ ekunafo ara ampa no dzi hɔn nyi.
Na sɛ okunafo bi wɔ mba anaa mbanana a, wɔmma wonsūa dɛ wodzi kan kyerɛ nyamesompa wɔ hɔn efiefi do, na wontua hɔn awofo kaw; na iyi na ɔsɔ enyi wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na nyia ɔyɛ okunafo ampa, na aka no nko, ɔdze n'enyidado to nyame do, na ofua nkotoserɛ nye mpaayi mu adzekyee nye adzesaa.
Na nyia ɔdze noho ma agofɛw no, ɔyɛ tseaseewu.
Na hom nsɛm yi do, amma woeennya hɔn ho asɛm no annkã.
Na sɛ obi annhwɛ nankasa nedze, nkanka ne fiefo a ɔapa gyedzi no, ɔyɛ nyimpa bɔn kyɛn nyia ɔnngye nndzi.
Mma wɔmmfa obi a onngyae nndzii mfe eduosia mmofra ekunafo nnkan, na mbom nyia ɔawar okun baako a,
wɔbɔ no dzin pa wɔ ndwuma ntsi; sɛ ɔanyɛn mbofra, sɛ ɔayɛ ahɔhoyɛ, sɛ ɔahohor ahotsewfo anan ho, sɛ ɔaboa ahohiafo, sɛ ɔabɔ mbɔdzen aka ndwuma pa nyina do a.
Na ekunafo a wonnyinii dze, mma nngye hɔn; na sɛ Christ ho fon hɔn a, wɔpɛ dɛ wɔwar;
na wonya afɔbu dɛ wɔapa gyedzi kankan no.
Na no mu ara so na wosūa enyihaw, kyimakyima efiefi; na nnyɛ enyihaw nko, na wɔyɛ anobɛrbɛr nye agyesɛm so, kekã nsɛm a ɔnnsɛ hɔn dɛ wɔkã.
Dɛm ntsi mepɛ dɛ hɔn a wonnyinii wɔwar, wo mba, hwɛ fie, na wɔaamma ɔtamfo biara kwan mma ɔaannyaw;
na binom adan ekedzi abɔnsam ekyir dada.
Na sɛ ɔbaa gyedzinyi bi wɔ ekunafo a, wɔmma ɔmboa asɔr; na ɔaaboa hɔn a wɔyɛ ekunafo ara ampa no.
Mpanyimfo a wodzi panyin yie no, wombu hɔn wɔsɛ enyidzi mbɔho, nkanka hɔn a wɔyɛ edwuma wɔ asɛm no nye nkyerɛkyerɛ mu no.
Na kyerɛw no kã dɛ, mma nnkyeyer nantwi a ɔporow eburow no n'ano, na eso dɛ, odwumayɛfo n'apaadze sɛ no.
Mma nntsie ɔpanyin ho ntoã, gyesɛ adasefo beenu anaa baasa anomu.
Hɔn a wɔyɛ bɔn no kã hɔn enyim, na nkaa no so eesuro.
Mehyɛ wo wɔ Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Christ Jesus nye abɔfo a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn no enyim dɛ, hwɛ yinom yie, na mma nnyɛ tsirmsum, eso mma nnyɛ biribiara nyiyimu do.
Mma mmfa wo nsa nngu obiara do awerɛfir mu, na so mmfa woho mmfora binom bɔn; sie woho krɔnn.
Mma nnda ho nnom nsu nko, na wo yafun nye wo mberɛw a etɔ yɛ ntsi, nom wenyin kakra.
Nyimpa binom hɔn bɔn da edzi dzi hɔn enyim dze hɔn rokɔ atsɛmbu mu, na binom dze dzi hɔn ekyir.
Dɛmara na ndwuma pa so da edzi; na dza ɔsor mbrɛ ɔtse no nntum nnhuntsa.
6: Wɔmma dodow a wɔwɔ kɔndua ase dɛ nkowaa mbu hɔn wuranom dɛ wɔsɛ enyidzi nyina, na Nyankopɔn dzin nye nkyerɛkyerɛ no wɔaannkasa ho bɔn.
Na hɔn a wɔwɔ wuranom gyedzifo, mma wommbu hɔn enyimtsia dɛ wɔyɛ enuanom ntsi; na mbom wɔnsom hɔn yie, osiandɛ hɔn a woenya adɔyɛ no bi no, wɔyɛ agyedzifo nye adɔfo. Iyinom na kyerɛkyrɛ na tu ho fo.
Sɛ obi kyerɛ ɔkyerɛ fofor bi, na ɔammpen hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ nsɛm a oye no nye nkyerɛkyerɛ no a ɔdze kɔ nyamesompa mu no a,
ɔahoran, onnyim hwee, na mbom ɔyar ekyingye nye nokotwa a dza ofi mu ba nye nyitan. etutuwpɛ, ndzebɔ, adwembɔn,
ɔham a ɔsɛ nyimpa a wɔaprɔw adwen mu, na nokwar abɔ hɔn, wosusu dɛ nyamesompa yɛ adzepɛ kwan.
Na nyamesompa a abodwee kã ho yɛ adzenya kɛse;
na yɛammfa hwee ammba wiadze, eso yerunntum mmfa hwee mmfi mu nnkɔ;
na sɛ yɛwɔ edziban nye akataho a, hom mma ɔnoara ndɔɔ hɛn sõ.
Na mbom hɔn a wɔpɛ ayɛ ahonyafo no, wɔhwe nsɔhwɛ nye efir nye nkwasea akɔndɔ pii a ɔyɛ mbusu a ɔtwe hɔn kogu ɔsɛɛ nye ɔhera mu.
Na sikapɛ nye bɔn horow nyina ndwow a binom edzi ekyir atɔ gon efi gyedzi no ho, na wɔdze yaw pii awowɔ hɔnho.
Na ɔwo, Nyame nyimpa dze, guan fi yinom ho; na dzi tsenenee, nyamesompa, gyedzi, ɔdɔ, abotar, nye ɔdwe ekyir.
Kõ gyedzi no kõ pa, suo onnyiewiei nkwa a wɔbɔɔ dzin frɛɛ wo a idzii ho adanse pa no wɔ adasefo pii enyim no mu.
Mutu wo fo wɔ Nyankopɔn a ɔma ndzɛmba nyina nkwa, nye Christ Jesus a odzii adanse pa no wɔ Pontius Pilate enyim no enyim,
dɛ dzi ahyɛdze no do, mma dzɛm anaa fɛr bi mmba wo ho ma onkesi hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ ne mfirii mu:
dza ɔbɛkyerɛ wo nankasa n'aber mu, ɔno a ɔyɛ Otumfo siarfo kortonoo, ahemfo Hen, nye ewuranom Ewuradze;
onyia no nko wɔ nkwa a ɔkyē, ɔtse kan a wopinkyɛn ho a ɔnnyɛ mu; nyia nyimpa biara nnhun no da; ɔno na enyidzi nye daa tumdzi nkã no. Amen.

Kasa kyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ ahonyafo wɔ sesei wiadze yi mu dɛ, mma wɔnndwen ekromponsɛm, eso mma wɔmmfa hɔn enyi nnto ahonyadze a onnsi pi no do, na mbom wɔmfa nto Nyankopɔn a ɔma hɛn adze nyina pii dɛ yɛndzi no do;
dɛ wɔnyɛ yie, dɛ wɔnyɛ ahonyafo wɔ ndwuma pa mu, dɛ wɔnkyɛ adze ɔhardo, na wonyi mma ɔpɛdo:
Na wɔmfa nhyehyɛ fapem pa nto hɔ mma hɔnho nsie ndaamba, ama woeesuo nkwa a ɔyɛ nokwar nkwa no mu.
O Timothy, kora dza wɔdze ahyɛ wo nsa no, dan woho fi ebususɛm huhuw, nye nyimdzee a wɔboa frɛ no dɛm ne ngyegye bra no ho:
Ɔno na binom paa mu kãe a wɔato atser gyedzi no ho. Adom nkã wo.

1: Na wɔhyɛɛ David ba Solomon dzen wɔ n'ahendzi no mu, na n'Ewuradze Nyankopɔn dzii n’ekyir, na ɔmemaa no do kɛsenara.
Na Solomon kasaa kyerɛɛ Israel nyinara, apem apem na ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no, na atsɛmbuafo no, na Israel nyinara mu ɔbapɔmba biara, egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir no.
Nna Solomon, na mboanofo a wɔkã no ho no nyinara sii mu kɔr bea sorɔnsorɔm no a ɔwɔ Gibeon no do; osiandɛ hɔ na Nyankopɔn n’ehyiadzibuw no a Ewuradze n’akowaa Moses yɛɛ no wɔ sar no do no wɔ.
Na Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no dze David akɛfa no wɔ Kiriath-jearim aba bea a David esiesie ama no no do; osiandɛ oesi buw bi ama no wɔ Jerusalem.
Nkyii so boran afɔrmbukyia no a Bezalel, Uri ba no, Hur ba no, yɛe no, ɔwɔ Ewuradze ne ntamadan no enyim hɔ: Na Solomon na mboanofo no hwehwɛɛ n’ekyir kwan.
Na Solomon fowee kɔr boran afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ Ewuradze enyim no a osi ehyiadzibuw no enyim no ho, na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyewafɔr apem wɔ do.
Anago no ara nna Nyankopɔn yii noho kyerɛɛ Solomon, na ɔsee no dɛ, bisa dza memfa memma wo.
Na Solomon see Nyankopɔn dɛ, ɔwo na ayɛ m’egya David ayamuyie kɛse, na ahyɛ me ɔhen wɔ n'ananmu.
Afei, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, ma w'anohoba ntsim mma m’egya David: Osiandɛ ɔwo ahyɛ me ɔhen wɔ ɔman a hɔn dodow tse dɛ asaase do huntuma do.
Afei ma me nyansa na nyimdzee, ma mimfir edzi na memba mu wɔ ɔman yi enyim: Na woana na obotum ebu wo man yi a ɔyɛ kɛse dɛm yi atsɛn?

Na Nyankopɔn see Solomon dɛ, osiandɛ iyi wɔ w’akoma mu, na emmbisa ahonya, akoradze, anaa enyidzi, na eso hɔn a wɔtan wo hɔn nkwa, nkyii so emmbisa nkwa tsentsen; na mbom ebisa nyansa na nyimdzee ama woho, ma edze eebu me man a mahyɛ wo hɔn do hen no atsɛn ntsi yi:
Nyansa na nyimdzee wɔdze ama wo; na mebɛma wo ahonya, na akoradze, na enyidzi so a ahemfo a woedzi w’enyim no mu biara ennya no dɛm, eso hɔn a wodzi w’ekyir no mu biara rinnya ne saso.
Nna Solomon fii n’akwantu a otui kɔr bea sorɔnsorɔm no a ɔwɔ Gibeon no, fii ehyiadzibuw no enyim baa Jerusalem; na odzii hen wɔ Israel do.
Na Solomon boaboaa ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo ano: Na onyaa ntseaseanam apem ahaanan, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemduebien, na ɔdze hɔn sisii ntseaseanam nkurow no mu, na ɔnye ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalem.
Na ɔhen no maa dwetɛ na sika yɛɛ dɛ abo wɔ Jerusalem, ɔmaa cedar so yɛɛ dɛ sycomore ndua a ɔwowɔ abɔn mu nkurow mu, wɔ ɔdodow mu.
Na mpɔnkɔ a Solomon nyae no, wɔdze fi Egypt bae; ɔhen n’eguadzifo no kɛgyegyee hɔn ekuwekuw mu, kuw kor wɔ no bo do.
Na wɔkɛfaa tseaseanam fi Egypt bae dze bɛgyee dwetɛ shekel ahaesia, na mpɔnkɔ so, dze bɛgyee ɔha eduonum: Na dɛmara so na wokitsaa bi wɔdze fiir edzi brɛɛ Hittifo ahemfo nyinara, na Syria ahemfo no.
2: Afei Solomon suaa dɛ obesi ofi ama Ewuradze ne dzin, na ofi ama n’ahendzi.
Na Solomon kaan ndzesoadzefo mpemeduosuon a wɔsoasoa adze, na mbepɔw do nduatwafo mpemeduowɔtwe, na mpemebiasa ahaesia a wɔhwɛ hɔn do.
Na Solomon somae ma wɔkɔr Tyrehen Huram nkyɛn, dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo nye m’egya David yɛe, na ekɛmaa no cedar dɛ ɔmfa nsi ofi ntsena mu no, mekyerɛ dɛmara so na enye me nyɛ.

Hwɛ, mirisi dan mama m’Ewuradze Nyankopɔn ne dzin, na wɔaayɛ no krɔnkrɔn ama no, na wɔaahyew eduahuam a ɔyɛ huam wɔ n'enyim, na wɔdze aama daa kyerɛpaanoo no, na ɔhyew-afɔr no anapa na ewimbir, ahomgyeda, na abosoom fofor, na hɛn Ewuradze Nyankopɔn n’afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ no. Iyi yɛ ɔmom ma Israel daa.
Na ɔdan a mirisi no so: Osiandɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn no sõ sen enyame nyinara.
Na woana ara na obotum esi dan ama no, hwɛ dɛ ɔsor na ɔsor no sorsor mpo nntum nnkora no yi? Woana nye me mbɔ na mibesi dan ama no, gyedɛ eduhuam a wɔhyew wɔ n’enyim nko?

Dɛm ntsi afei, brɛ me nyimpa onyansafo bi a obedzi edwin wɔ sika, na dwetɛ, na boran, na dadze, na ɔberdum, na serdaa, na bibiri mu, na obotum eyiyi nsema ahorow nyinara, ma ɔmbɛkã edwimfo a wɔwɔ me nkyɛn wɔ Judah na Jerusalem a m’egya David siesiee hɔn siei no ho.
Eso fa cedar ndua, kupresi ndua, na algum ndua fi Lebanon brɛ me: Na minyim dɛ wo nkowaa botum etwa ndua wɔ Lebanon: Na, hwɛ, mo nkowaa bɛkã wo nkowaa ho,
ma woeesiesie ndua piigyan ama me: Osiandɛ dan a miribesi no ɔsõ na ɔyɛ nwanwa.
Na, hwɛ, mebɛma wo nkowaa, nduatwafo a wotwa ndua no edziban, ewietwadze mpemeduonu, na atoko etwadze mpemeduonu, na wenyin bath mpemeduonu, na ngo bath mpemeduonu.
Nna Tyrehen Huram buaa no wɔ nwoma a ɔdze brɛɛ Solomon no mu dɛ, osiandɛ Ewuradze dɔ ne man ntsi, nna ɔahyɛ wo hen wɔ hɔn do.
Nkyii so Huram see dɛ, nhyira nkã Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛɛ ɔsor na asaase, dɛ ɔama ɔhen David ɔba nyansafo a wɔama no nyimdzee na ntseasee a obesi dan ama Ewuradze, na ofi ama n'ahendzi.
Na afei masoma ɔbarimba onyansafo a wɔama no ntseasee, mekyerɛ m'egya Huram.

Ɔbaa bi a ofi Dan ne mbabaa mu ne ba, n'egya nye ɔbarimba bi a ofi Tyre, onyim sika, na dwetɛ, boran, dadze, abo, na ndua, ɔberdum, bibiri, na ndwera fɛɛfɛw, na serdaa mu edwin dzi; eso onyim nsema ahorow nyinara yiyi, na ndwindze biara ho edwin: Ma wɔmma no dzibew bi ma ɔnkã wo mbarimba enyansafo, na mo wura David w’egya ne mbarimba enyansafo no ho.
Dɛm ntsi afei ewifua na atoko, ngo na nsã a mo wura kãa ho asɛm no, wɔmma ɔmfa mbrɛ no nkowaa:
Na yebotwa ndua efi Lebanon, dodow ara a ibehia no: Na yɛdze no mpanta no edua po do abrɛ wo wɔ Joppa; na ɔwo so edze afow akɔ Jerusalem.
Na Solomon kaan ahɔho a wɔwɔ Israel asaase do no nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ nkanee a n’egya David dze kaan hɔn no tse; na wohun hɔn dɛ wɔyɛ mpemɔha eduonum na mpemebiasa ahaesia.
Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn mu mpemeduosuon dɛ wɔnsoasoa adze, na mpemeduowɔtwe a wɔyɛ mbepɔw do nduatwafo, na mpemebiasa ahaesia a wɔyɛ ahwɛdofo dɛ wɔmma nkorɔfo no nyɛ edwuma.
3: Nna Solomon hyɛɛ ase dɛ orisi Ewuradze ne fi no wɔ Jerusalem bepɔw Moriah do, mbrɛ Ewuradze yii noho kyerɛɛ n’egya David no, wɔ bea a David esiesie, wɔ Jebusnyi Ornan n’ewuporowee no.
Na n’ahendzi no n’afe a otsia anan no mu bosoom a otsia ebien no mu da a otsia ebien no mu da a otsia ebien no, nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ orisi.
Afei fapem a Solomon hyɛe dze maa Nyankopɔn ne fi ne nsii no nye yi. Ne tsentsen basafa mu dɛ mbrɛ nkan no nsusui tse no, ɔyɛ basafa eduosia, na ne tɛtɛr basafa eduonu.
Na abrandaa a ɔwɔ dan no enyim no ne tsentsen, dɛ mbrɛ ɔdan no ne tɛtɛr tse, ɔyɛ basafa eduonu, na no krɔn ɔha eduonu: Na ɔdze sika mapa duraa no mu afamu.
Na dan kɛse no ɔdze kupresindua saam do, na ɔdze sika pa duraa ho, na odzidzii do edwin, mbɛdua na ntweaban.
Na ɔdze abo a ɔsom bo kataa ɔdan no ho wɔ ne fɛw ntsi: Na sika no yɛ Parvaim sika.
Na ɔdze sika duraa dan no, mpuna no, apondua no, na n'afasu no, na no mbobow no ho: Na oyiyii cherubfo wɔ afasu no ho.
Na ɔyɛɛ krɔnkrɔn mu krɔnkrɔn dan no; ne tsentsen, dɛ mbrɛ dan no ne tɛtɛr no tse, ɔyɛ basafa eduonu, na ne tɛtɛr basafa eduonu; na ɔdze sika pa a n’ano tow talent ahaesia duraa ho.
Na ne mprɛgow ne nkerii no n’ano tow sika shekel eduonum. Na ɔdze sika duraduraa ɔsor mpia no ho.
Na ɔyɛɛ cherubfo ebien osian-edwuma wɔ krɔnkrɔn mu krɔnkrɔn dan no mu; na wɔdze sika duraa ho.
Na cherubfo no hɔn ntsaban ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu: Cherub baako n’atsaban kor basafa enum, ɔkã dan no ne fasu no; na atsaban kor no so yɛ basafa enum, ɔkã cherub baako no so n’atsaban.
Na cherub baako no so n’atsaban kor yɛ basafa enum, ɔkã ɔdan no ne fasu no; na n’atsaban kor no so yɛ basafa enum, ɔkã cherub baako no so n’atsaban no.
Cherubfo yi hɔn ntsaban mu tsɛw basafa eduonu: Na wogyinagyina hɔn anan do, na hɔn enyim dzi dan no no do afamu.
Na ɔdze bibiri, na ɔberdum, na serdaa, na ndwera pa dze yɛɛ ntwamutam no, na ɔween cherubfo wɔ mu.
Eso dan no enyim edum ebien a n’atsentsen yɛ basafa eduasa enum, na ntaadotsir a ɔwɔ no mu kor etsifi ɔyɛ basafa enum.
Na ɔyɛɛ ntweaban wɔ mpiakyir no mu, na ɔdze sensɛɛn edum no etsifi; na ɔyeyɛɛ pome­granate-ekutu ɔha, na ɔdze hyehyɛɛ ntweaban no mu.
Na ɔdze edum no sisii asɔrfi no enyim, kor wɔ enyimfa, na kor so wɔ abankum afamu; na ɔfrɛɛ dza ɔwɔ enyimfa no ne dzin Jachin, na dza ɔwɔ abankum no ne dzin Boaz.
4: Nkyii so ɔyɛɛ boran afɔrmbukyia, ne tsentsen basafa eduonu, na ne tɛtɛr basafa eduonu, na no krɔn basafa du.
Eso ɔyɛɛ ogu-po no a ofi ano kɛpem ano yɛ basafa du no, otwa kɔntɔnkrɔn, na no krɔn yɛ basafa enum; na ahoma basafa eduasa bɔ ho aprɔw hyia.
Na nkukuduuduw ne saso wowɔ n’ase dze bɔ no aprɔw hyia, du wɔ basafa kor mu, ɔbɔ po no ho aprɔw hyia. Nkukuduuduw no a wogui no, woguu no akyerɛpɛn ebien.
Ogyinaa anantwi duebien do, ebiasa hwɛ kwaamu afamu, na ebiasa hwɛ anee afamu, na ebiasa hwɛ pomu afamu, na ebiasa hwɛ boka afamu: Na po no taa hɔn do wɔ sor, na hɔn ekyir nyinara wɔ no mu afamu.
Na ne peperepe yɛ nsatseama; na n'ano no wɔyɛɛ no dɛ kuraba ano, ɔtse dɛ nsukooko ne nhyiren: Odzi bath mpemebiasa.

Eso ɔyɛɛ eguarsɛn du, na ɔdze enum sisii enyimfa afamu, na enum so abankum afamu, dɛ wɔnhohor adze ho wɔ mu; ndzɛmba a ɔyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr ho dze na wɔhohoor ho wɔ mu: Na po no dze, ɔwɔ hɔ ma asɔfo no, ma wɔaahohor hɔnho wɔ mu.
Na ɔyɛɛ sika nkandzeadua du no dɛ mbrɛ no ho ɔmom tse no na ɔdze sisii asɔrfi no mu, enum wɔ enyimfa, na enum so wɔ abankum.
Eso ɔyɛɛ apon du, na ɔdze sisii asɔrfi no mu, enum wɔ enyimfa afamu, na enum so wɔ abankum afamu. Na ɔyɛɛ sika mbɛɛsen ɔha.
Nkyii so ɔyɛɛ asɔfo hɔn abangua no, na abangua kɛse no, na abangua no ano mbobow no, na ɔdze boran duraa mbobow no ho.
Na ɔdze po no sii dan no ne nyimfa afamu wɔ boka afamu a ɔhwɛ pomu afamu no.
Na Huram yɛɛ nsenaba, na nsofi, na mbɛɛsen no. Nna Huram wiee edwuma a ɔyɛe maa ɔhen Solomon wɔ ma a Nyankopɔn ne fi no ho yɛ:
Edum ebien no, na edum no n’etsifi ntaadotsir apɔw ebien no; na ntena-dwuma ebien no a wɔdze kata edum no n’etsifi ntaadotsir apɔw no ho no;
na ntena-dwuma ebien no ho pomegranate-ekutu ahaanan no; pomegranate-ekutu akyerɛpɛn ebien yɛ atena-dwuma kor nedze, dɛ ɔkata ntaadotsir no n’apɔw ebien no a ɔwɔ edum no no do no ho.
Ɔyɛɛ ndaka no so, na ɔyɛɛ ndaka no do eguarsɛn no,
po kor, na n’ase anantwi duebien no.
Nsenaba no so, na nsofi no, na edzinam no, na no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, na n'egya Huram yɛe maa ɔhen Solomon dze maa Ewuradze ne fi no, ɔyɛ boran a wɔapɔw ho hyɛnn.
Jordan Tɛtɛr mu hɔ na ɔhen no gui, wɔ hyirew daadze mu wɔ Succoth na Zeredah ntamu.
Dɛm na Solomon yɛɛ ndzɛmba yi nyinara kɛse piigyan: Na woennhu boran no ne nkerii ano.
Na Solomon yɛɛ ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn ne fi no mu nyinara, sika afɔrmbukyia no so, na apon a kyerɛpaanoo no sisi do no;
na nkandzeandua no nye no ho nkandzea, ma wɔaasɔ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔmon no tse wɔ mpiakyir no enyim no, yɛ sika mapa;
na no ho nhyiren, na mkandzea, na ndabaa no, sika a, ne nyinara sika ara nko;
na edumgya, na mbɛɛsen, na ntser, na ngyasɛn no, sika mapa: Na dan no n'ahɛnee no dze, no mu afamu krɔnkrɔn mu krɔnkrɔn-bea no no mbobow no, na dan no, mekyerɛ asɔrfi no no mbobow no, sika a.
5: Nna wowiee edwuma a Solomon yɛe maa Ewuradze ne fi no nyinara yɛ. Na Solomon dze ndzɛmba a n'egya David tui sii hɔ no bae; mekyerɛ dwetɛ, na sika, na ndzɛmbandzɛmba no nyinara, na ɔdze besisii Nyankopɔn fie ndzekorabea.

Nna Solomon hyiahyiaa Israel mpanyimfo, na ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu etsitsir nyinara, Israelmba egyanom efiefi mbapɔmba no, ma wɔbaa Jerusalem, dɛ wɔrekɛfa Ewuradze n'ahyɛmudaka no efi Zion a ɔyɛ David kurow no mu aba.
Na Israel mbarimba no nyinara hyiahyiaa hɔnho behyiaa ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ afahyɛ no ase, wɔ bosoom a otsia esuon no mu.
Na Israel mpanyimfo no nyinara bae, na Levifo no bɛmaa adaka no do.
Na wɔdze adaka no, na ehyiadzibuw no, na ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn a ɔwɔ Buw no mu no bae; iyinom na asɔfo na Levifo no wɔdze bae.
Na ɔhen Solomon na Israel mboanofo no nyinara a woebehyia wɔ ne nkyɛn no, wodzi adaka no enyim, rukuku nguan na anantwi a osian hɔn dodow ntsi wonntum nnkan eso wommbu ano, dze robobɔ afɔr.
Na asɔfo no dze Ewuradze n'ahyɛmudaka no bae dze besii ne sibew, wɔ dan no ne mpiakyir, krɔnkrɔn mu krɔnkrɔn-bea no mu; mekyerɛ cherubfo no hɔn ntsaban ase.
Na cherubfo no atserɛtserɛw hɔn ntsaban mu wɔ akata adaka no na no ho mpoma no do wɔ ɔsor.
Na mpoma no wowar dodow ma wohu mpoma no n'etsifi wɔ adaka no ho wɔ mpiakyir no enyim; na wonnhu wɔ abowano: Na mbrɛ ɔwɔ ara nye no, bodu ndɛ da yi.
Hweeara nnyi adaka no mu gyedɛ abopon ebien no a Moses dze guu mu wɔ Horeb no, wɔ mbrɛ Ewuradze nye Israelmba dzii ahyɛmu, wɔ mber a wofi Egypt asaase do reba no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a asɔfo no wofii bea krɔnkrɔn no do puei no, (osiandɛ asɔfo a wɔwɔ hɔ no nyinara wɔatsew hɔnho, na woenndzi hɔn nkyekyɛmu ekyir;

eso Levifo no a wɔyɛ adwontofo no, hɔn nyinara, mekyerɛ Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, na hɔn mba na hɔn nuanom no, wɔhyehyɛ ndwera fɛɛfɛw, kitsakitsa nkasaa na bɛntaasanku na nsankutsen gyinagyina afɔrmbukyia no no boka afamu na asɔfo ɔha eduonu rehɛn mbɛn kã hɔn ho):

Nna ɔbaa dɛ, aber a mbɛnhɛmfo na adwontofo no wɔyɛɛ dɛ ɔbaakofo, na wɔdze ndze kor wɔdze riyi Ewuradze ayɛw da no ase; na aber a wɔdze mbɛn na nkasaa na asanku ndzɛmba maa hɔn ndze do riyi Ewuradze ayɛw, dɛ, na oye; na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa no: Nna mununkum bɛhyɛɛ dan no mã, mekyerɛ Ewuradze ne dan no a,
na osian mununkum no ntsi asɔfo no enntum enngyina annsom: Osiandɛ Ewuradze n’enyimnyam ahyɛ Nyankopɔn ne dan no mã.
6: Nna Solomon kãa dɛ, Ewuradze ase dɛ, ɔbɛtsena sum kebii mu.
Na emidze mesi dan ayɛ tsenabew ama wo, na beebi a ebɛtsena hɔ daa.
Na ɔhen no daan n’enyi, na ohyiraa Israel mboanofo nyinara: Na Israel mboanofo no nyinara gyinagyinaa tsentsen.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Nhyira nkã Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn a ɔdze n’ano kyerɛɛ m’egya David, na ɔdze ne nsa ahyɛ no mã, dɛ,

Ofitsi da a medze me man mifi Egypt asaase do mebae no, mannsan mu ennyi kurow bi emmfi Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu dɛ wonsi mu dan, ma me dzin ntsena hɔ; nkyii so mannsan mu ennyi nyimpa biara dɛ ondzi panyin wɔ me man Israel do:
Mbom masan mu eyi Jerusalem, dɛ me dzin ntsena hɔ; na masan mu eyi David dɛ ɔnhwɛ me man Israel do.
Afei ɔwɔ m egya David n’akoma mu dɛ nkyɛ obesi dan ama Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ne dzin.
Na Ewuradze see m’egya David dɛ, susuampa dɛ ɔwɔ w’akoma mu dɛ nkyɛ ibesi dan ama me dzin no, ayɛ no yie dɛ ɔwɔ w’akoma mu:
Naaso ɔwoara nnkesi dan no, na mbom wo ba a ofi w'asen mu bɛba no, ɔno na obesi dan no ama me dzin.
Na Ewuradze ama n’asɛm a ɔkãe no ahyɛ mã; na masoɛr mahyɛ m’egya David n’ananmu, na metse Israel ahengua do, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze bɔɔ anohoba no, na mesi dan no ama Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no ne dzin.
Na hɔ na medze adaka no a Ewuradze n’ahyɛmu a ɔnye Israelmba dzii no wɔ mu no esi.
Na ogyinaa Ewuradze n’afɔmbukyia no enyim wɔ Israel mboanofo no nyinara enyim, na ɔtrɛɛ ne nsamu:

(Osiandɛ Solomon ayɛ boran sumpii bi a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa enum, na ne tɛtɛr basafa enum, na no krɔn basafa ebiasa, na ɔdze esi abangua no ne finimfin; na ɔno do na okegyinae, na ɔkotoow n’anankoroma enyim wɔ Israel mboanofo no nyinara enyim, na ɔtrɛɛ ne nsamu wɔ sɔr):
na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, Onyankopɔn bi nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo, wɔ sor, anaa asaase do a isie ahyɛmu na mbɔbɔrhu ma wo nkowaa a wɔdze hɔn akoma nyinara nantsew w’enyim:
Ɔwɔ a esie dza edze bɔɔ w’akowaa m’egya David anohoba no ama no: Nyew, ɔwo edze w’ano kãe, na edze wo nsa ahyɛ no mã, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.

Dɛm ntsi afei, Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, sie dza edze abo anohoba ama w’akowaa m’egya David no ma no, dɛ, nyimpa a ɔbɛtsena Israel ahengua do rommbɔ wo wɔ m’enyim; sɛ wo mba hwɛ hɔn kwan yie, dɛ wɔbɛnantsew wɔ me mbra mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo anantsew wɔ m’enyim yi ara a.
Dɛm ntsi afei, Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, ma w’asɛm a ekãa kyerɛɛ w’akowaa David no ntsim.
Ma aso ampa dɛ Nyankopɔn bɛtsena nyimpa nkyɛn wɔ asaase do a? Hwɛ, ɔsor na ɔsor no sorsor mpo nntum nnkora wo; na ankantsɛm ɔdan yi a mesi yi!
Naaso Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn, bu w’akowaa ne mpaabɔ, na no ntotɔserɛ bi, dɛ ibetsie w’akowaa ne nkekamu na ne mpaabɔ a ɔrobɔ no w’enyim yi:
Dɛ w’enyi bobue wɔ ɔdan yi do adzekyee na adzesaa, mekyerɛ bea a ɔwoara ase dɛ edze wo dzin bɛtsena hɔ no do; dɛ ibetsie mpaabɔ a w’akowaa bɔbɔ akyerɛ bea yi do no.
Na tsie w’akowaa na wo man Israel ntotɔserɛ, aber a wɔrobɔ mpaa kyerɛ bea yi do; nyew, tsie no wɔ wo tsenabea hɔ, mekyerɛ ɔsor a; na sɛ etse a, fa fir.
Sɛ nyimpa bi yɛ bɔn tsia ne nyɛnko, na ntam bi bɛda no do dɛ ɔkã, na ɔba bɛkã ntam wɔ w’afɔrmbukyia enyim wɔ ofi yi mu a:
Ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ sor, na yɛ, na bu wo nkowaa atsɛn, dɛ erehyɛ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi no ananmu, ma no kwan eebua nankasa n’etsifi; na irubu ɔtseneneenyi no bem, ma aama no dɛ mbrɛ ne ndzeyɛtsenenee tse.
Na sɛ wɔkã wo man Israel gu wɔ atamfo enyim osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia wo ntsi; na wɔsan ba bio bɔbɔ wo dzin, na wɔbɔ mpaa na wɔtotɔ serɛ wɔ w’enyim wɔ ofi yi mu a:
Ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ sor, na fa wo man Israel hɔn bɔn fir, na fa hɔn bra asaase a ɔwoara dze maa hɔn na hɔn egyanom no do bio.
Sɛ wɔtow sor mu, na nyankom nntɔ, osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia wo ntsi; na sɛ wɔbɔ mpaa kyerɛ bea yi do, na wɔbɔ wo dzin, na wɔsan fi hɔn bɔn ho, dɛ ahaw hɔn ntsi a:
Ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ sor, na fa wo nkowaa na wo man Israel hɔn bɔn fir hɔn, dɛ erekyerɛ hɔn ɔkwan pa a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔfa do; na ma nyankom ntɔ ngu w’asaase a ɔwoara dze ama wo man dɛ egyapadze no do.
Sɛ ɔkɔm ba asaase no do, sɛ ɔyardɔm ba, sɛ ehuw anaa ɔpo, mbɛbɛw anaa nkonyinko ba; sɛ hɔn atamfo botua hɔn wɔ hɔn nkuropon asaase do; owuyar biara anaa yarba biara ba a;
mpaabɔ na ntotɔserɛ biara a nyimpa biara, anaa wo man Israel nyinara bɛyɛ a nyimpa biara bohu nankasa no wuyar na nankasa ne yaw, na ɔbetrɛ ne nsamu akyerɛ ofi yi do no:

Ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor wo tsenabea hɔ, na fa fir na ma nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ n'akwan nyinara tse, nyia ɔwoara inyim n’akoma mu a; (osiandɛ ɔwo, mekyerɛ ɔwoara nkotoo, na inyim nyimpa mba hɔn akoma mu);
ama woeesuro wo, na wɔaanantsew w'akwan do, mber tsentsen a wɔdze bɛtsena asaase a ɔwoara edze maa hɔn egyanom no do no.
Nkyii so ɔhɔho a ommfi wo man Israel mu ho dze, sɛ wo dzin kɛse, na wo tum nsa, na w'abasa a atsen mu no ntsi, ma ofi ekyirkyir man bi mu ba; na sɛ wɔba bɔbɔ mpaa kyerɛ dan yi do a:

Ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor, mehyerɛ wo tsenabea hɔ, na yɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔhɔho no sū frɛ wo no nyinara: Ma asaase do aman nyinara eehu wo dzin, na woeesuro wo, dɛ mbrɛ wo man Israel yɛ, na woeehu dɛ wo dzin na wɔdze frɛ ɔdan yi a mesi yi.
Sɛ wo man fir edzi nye hɔn atamfo kedzi akõ, wɔ ɔkwan biara a ɔwoara bɔsoma hɔn do, na wɔbɔ wo mpaa kyerɛ kurow a asan mu eyi, na dan a mesi mama wo dzin yi do a:
Ɔno ɔwoara tsie hɔn mpaabɔ na hɔn ntotɔserɛ wɔ sor, na dzi hɔn asɛm ma hɔn.
Sɛ wɔyɛ bɔn tsia wo, (osiandɛ nyimpa bi nnyi hɔ a onnyi bɔn), na wo bo fuw hɔn, na iyi hɔn ma atamfo, ma wɔfa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔ asaase bi do ekyirkyir o, ɔbɛn o;
naaso sɛ hɔnara wɔdwen wɔ asaase a wɔafa hɔn ndɔmmum akɔ do no do, na wɔsan bio, na wɔtotɔ serɛ wo wɔ hɔn ndɔmmum asaase no do, dɛ, yɛayɛ bon, yeetwa nkontompɔ, yeedzi emumuyɛsɛm;

sɛ wɔdze hɔn akoma nyinara na hɔn kra nyinara san ba wo nkyɛn wɔ hɔn ndɔmmum asaase no do, mbrɛ wɔafa hɔn ndɔmmum akɔ no, na woyi mpaa kyerɛ hɔn asaase a ɔwoara edze maa hon egyanom, na kurow a ɔwoara asan mu eyi, na wɔkyerɛ ɔdan a mesi mama wo dzin yi do a:
Ɔno ɔwoara tsie hɔn mpaabɔ na hɔn ntotɔserɛ wɔ sor, mekyerɛ wo tsenabea hɔ, na dzi hɔn asɛm ma hɔn; na fa fir wo man a wɔayɛ bɔn etsia wo no.
Afei, me Nyankopɔn, meserɛ wo, bue w’enyiwa, na kyɛn w’aso wɔ mpaabɔ a wɔbɔ wɔ ha yi do.
Dɛm ntsi afei, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, soɛr kɔ w'ahomgyebea no mu, ɔwo, na w’ahoɔdzen adaka no: Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, ma w’asɔfoe wɔnhyɛ nkwagye, na ma w'ahostseweefo enyi ngye wɔ papa mu.
Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, mma nndan wo nyia asera no no enyi: Kaa w'akowaa David adɔyɛ no.
7: Afei aber a Solomon wiee mpaa bɔ no, ogya fi sor dwirii, na ɔbɛhyɛɛw ɔhyew-afɔr na okum-afɔr no; na Ewuradze n'enyimnyam bɛhyɛɛ dan no mã.
Na asɔfo no enntum annhɛn Ewuradze ne dan no mu, osiandɛ Ewuradze n’enyimnyam no ahyɛ Ewuradze ne dan no mã.

Na aber a ogya no rudwir, na Ewuradze n’enyimnyam reba ofi no do no, Israelmba no nyinara hwɛe; na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze dze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu wɔ abonsɛwee no do sɔree, na wɔdaa Ewuradze ase, dɛ, na oye; na n'ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
Nna ɔhen no na ɔman no nyinara bɔɔ okum-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na ɔhen Solomon dze anantwi mpemeduonuebien, na nguan mpemɔhaeduonu bɔɔ okum-afɔr. Dɛm na ɔhen no na ɔman no nyinara dze tseew Nyankopɔn fi no ho.

Na asɔfo no gyinagyina hɔ, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nhwɛdo-dwuma tsetsee; Levifo no so kitsakitsa Ewuradze no ndwom ho ndzɛmba a ɔhen David yɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa nda Ewuradze ase, dɛ, n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa, aber a David nam hɔn som do yii ayɛw no: Na asɔfo no henhɛɛn mbɛn wɔ hɔn enyim; na Israel nyinara gyinagyinaa hɔ.

Nkyii so Solomon yɛɛ abangua a ɔwɔ Ewuradze fi no enyim no ne finimfin no krɔnkrɔn; na hɔ na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr, na asomdwee-afɔr ho seradze no: Osiandɛ boran afɔrmbukyia a Solomon yɛe no, ɔhyew-afɔr, na edziban-afɔr, na seradze no nnsen do.
Nna Solomon hyɛɛ fa no aber no mu, nda esuon, na Israel nyinara kã no ho, mboanofo kɛsenara, wofi Hamath ahɛnee dze kodu Egypt ɔwora no ho.
Na da a otsia awɔtwe no wɔbɔɔ ngua a no mu yɛ nwin: Na afɔrmbukyia no ne ntsewho no wodzii no nda esuon, na afahyɛ no so nda esuon.

Na bosoom a otsia esuon no ne da a otsia eduonu ebiasa no, nna ogyaa ɔman no kwan ma wɔkɔr hɔn asesee mu, wɔdze enyigye na akoma pa wɔ yie a Ewuradze ayɛ ama David, na Solomon, na ne man Israel no ntsi.
Nna Solomon wiee Ewuradze ne fi, na ɔhen ne fi no: Na dza ɔbaa Solomon n’akoma mu nyinara dɛ ɔbɛyɛ wɔ Ewuradze ne fi mu, na nankasa ne fi mu nyinara, owiee yɛ dwudwoodwo.
Na Ewuradze yii noho kyerɛɛ Solomon anago, na ɔsee no dɛ, matse wo mpaabɔ, na masan mu eyi bea yi ama moho dɛ afɔrbɔ ofi.
Sɛ motow ɔsor mu ma nyankom nntɔ, anaa sɛ mehyɛ mbɛbɛw dɛ wɔmbɛmen asaase no, anaa medze ɔyardɔm ba me man mu;
sɛ me man a wɔdze me dzin frɛ hɔn no brɛ hɔnho adze, na wɔbɔ mpaa, na wɔhwehwɛ m’enyim, na wɔsan fi hɔn kwan bɔn do a; ɔno mibefi ɔsor metsie, na medze hɔn bɔn efir, na mayɛ hɔn asaase no edur.
Afei mubobue m’enyiwa, na makyɛn m’aso, wɔ mpaabɔ a wɔbɔ no, wɔ ha yi do.
Na afei na masan mu eyi ofi yi na mayɛ no krɔnkrɔn, dɛ me dzin ntsena hɔ daa: Na m’enyiwa na m’akoma bɛtsena hɔ daa nyinara.
Na ɔwodze, sɛ ebɛnantsew m’enyim dɛ mbrɛ w’egya David nantsewee, na ayɛ dɛ mbrɛ medze mahyɛ wo no nyinara, na edzi m'ahyɛdze na m’atsɛmbu no do a;
ɔno mebɛma w’ahendzi ahengua etsim hɔ, dɛ mbrɛ menye w'egya David dzii ahyɛmu, dɛ, wɔremma nyimpa a ɔbɛyɛ Israel do ɔhwɛfo mmbɔ wo no.
Na sɛ hom san, na wɔpow m’ahyɛdze na me mbransɛm a medze mesi hom enyim yi, na hom kɔ kɔsom enyame fofor, na wɔsɔr hɔn a:
Ɔno mubotu hɔn efi m’asaase a medze mama hɔn no do; na ofi a mayɛ no krɔnkrɔn ama me dzin yi, mobɔtow efi m’enyi do akyɛn, na mayɛ no ɔkasabɛbu na fen wɔ aman nyinara mu.
Na ofi yi a ɔkron dɛm yi, obiara a obotwa mu wɔ ho no, no ho bɔbow no, na ɔase dɛ, ɔye dɛn ntsi na Ewuradze ayɛ asaase yi, na ofi yi dɛm yi?

Na wobobua dɛ, osiandɛ wɔpoow Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn a ɔdze hɔn fii Egypt asaase do bae no, na wɔkɛtae suoo enyame fofor mu sɔɔr hɔn, na wɔsoom hɔn: Dɛm ntsi na ɔdze mbusu yi nyinara aba hɔn do yi.
8: Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe eduonu a Solomon dze sisii Ewuradze ne fi, na nankasa ne fi, n’ewiei no,
nna nkurow a Huram dze maa Solomon no, Solomon kyekyeree, na ɔmaa Israelmba kɛtsenatsenaa hɔ.
Na Solomon sii mu kɔr Hamath-zobah, na okedzii do nyim.
Na ɔkyekyeer Tadmor wɔ sar no do, na adzekora nkurow a ɔkyekyeer no wɔ Hamath no nyinara.
Eso ɔkyekyeer etsifi Beth-horon, na anaafo Beth-horon, nkurow a wɔagyegye ho ban a ɔwowɔ afasu, nkuropon, na apon ekyir adaban;

na Baalath, na adzekora nkurow a Solomon wɔ no nyinara, na ne ntseaseanam nkurow nyinara, na no mpɔnkɔdofo nkurow, na dza Solomon pɛɛ dɛ ɔkyekyer dze gye n'enyi wɔ Jerusalem nyinara, na Lebanon, na n'ahendzi asaase no nyinara mu.
Na nkorɔfo a wɔkae wɔ Hittifo, na Amorifo, na Perizzifo, na Hivifo, na Jebusfo mu nyinara a wommfi Israel mu no dze;
hɔn mba a wɔkaa hɔn ehyir wɔ asaase no do no a Israelmba enntum annsɛɛ hɔn pasapasa no bi no, hɔn na Solomon gyegyee hɔn enyadze ɔtow-edwuma dze bodur ndɛ da yi.
Na Israelmba no mu dze, Solomon annyɛ mu bi n'edwuma mu nkowaa; na hɔn nye mbarimba akofo, na n'asafohemfo do etsitsir, na ne ntseaseanam na no mpɔnkɔdofo do mpanyimfo.
Na woyinom nye ɔhen Solomon n’ahwɛdofo mu etsitsir; mekyerɛ nyimpa ahaenu eduonum a wɔhwɛ nkorɔfo no do.
Na Solomon dze Pharaoh babaa no fii David kurow mu baa ofi a oesi ama no no mu: Na ɔsee dɛ, me yer nnkɛtsena Israelhen David fie, osiandɛ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze n’adakaa no aba no hɔ yɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Nna Solomon bɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr maa Ewuradze wɔ Ewuradze n’afɔrmbukyia a osii no wɔ nkrandaa no enyim no do,

mekyerɛ dɛ mbrɛ da biara no mu edwuma regye, ɔbɔɔ afɔr dɛ mbrɛ Moses ne mbrasɛm tse, ahomgyenda dze, na bosoom fofor dze na afahyɛ dze, afrenhyia mu mpɛn ebiasa, mekyerɛ epitsi afahyɛ no mu, na adapɛn-da afahyɛ no mu, na ntamadan afahyɛ no mu.

Na, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya David no mom no tse no ɔdze asɔfo no hɔn nkyekyɛmu no sisii hɔn som do, na Levifo no so hɔn nhwɛdodwuma mu, dɛ wonyi ayɛw, na wɔnsom wɔ asɔfo no enyim, dɛ mbrɛ da biara no mu edwuma regye: Mbobowanoahwɛfo no so dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkyekyɛmu tse wɔ kuropon biara ano: na dɛm na Nyame nyimpa David hyɛe.
Na woemmfi ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm a ɔwɔ asɔfo na Levifo no do wɔ asɛm biara, anaa akoradze no ho emmfi.
Afei Solomon n’edwuma nyinara wosiesiei maa daa wɔtoow Ewuradze ne dan no ne fapem, na okodur dɛ wowiei. Nna wowiee Ewuradze ne fi no korakora.
Nna Solomon sii mu kɔr Eziongeber, na Eloth, wɔ mpoano wɔ Edom asaase do.
Na Huram nam no nkowaa nsa do dze ahɛn, na nkowaa a wɔwɔ po ho nyimdzee brɛɛ no; na wɔnye Solomon no nkowaa no kɔr Ophir, na wɔkɛfaa hɔ sika talent ahaanan eduonum, na wɔdze brɛɛ ɔhen Solomon.
9: Na aber a Sheba ɔhembaa bo tsee Solomon ne nka no, nna ɔbaa dɛ ɔdze nsɛmbisa dzendzen robɔsɔ Solomon ahwɛ wɔ Jerusalem, ɔnye akadofo kɛsenara, na efumpɔnkɔ a wɔsoso nduhuam, na sika piigyan, na abo a ɔsom bo; na aber a ɔbaa Solomon nkyɛn no, ɔnye twetwee dza ɔwɔ n’akoma mu nyinara ho nkɔmbɔ.
Na Solomon kyerɛɛ no ne nsɛm nyinara ano: Na asɛm biara ennsuma Solomon a ɔannkã annkyerɛ no.
Na aber a Sheba ɔhembaa no hun Solomon ne nyansaa, na ofi a oesi,
na no pon do edziban, na no nkowaa ntsenatsenaamu, na n’asomfo ngyinaamu na hɔn ntar; ne nsãhyɛfo so, na hɔn ntar; na n’afowee a ɔnam do fow kɔ Ewuradze fie no; nna sunsum bi nnyi no mu bio.
Na ɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, wo ndwuma na wo nyansaa ho asɛm a metsee no wɔ mankasa m’asaase do no yɛ nokwar.
Naaso manngye hɔn nsɛm no menndzi, dze bodu dɛ mebae, na medze m’enyiwa mebohu yi: Na, hwɛ, wɔannkã wo nyansaa ne kɛseyɛ ne fã mpo annkyerɛ me: Ɔwo ebor nka a metsee no do.
Ahomka akã wo nkorɔfo, na ahomka akã wo nkowaa yi a wogyinagyina w’enyim daa, na wotsie wo nyansaa no.

Nhyira nkã w’Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn a ɔpɛ w’asɛm dɛ ɔdze wo esi n'ahengua do, dɛ dzi hen ma w’Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn: Osiandɛ wo Nyankopɔn dɔ Israel, dɛ ɔdze hɔn betsim hɔ daa, dɛm ntsi na ɔahyɛ wo hɔn do hen, dɛ yɛ atsɛmbudze na adze pɛrpɛr.
Na ɔmaa ɔhen no sika talent ɔha eduonu, na nduhuam piigyan, na abo a ɔsom bo: Na eduhuam a ɔtse dɛm dɛ mbrɛ Sheba ɔhembaa no dze maa ɔhen Solomon no bi ammba bio.
Na Huram no nkowaa, na Solomon no nkowaa no a wɔdze sika fi Ophir bae no, wɔdze algum ndua na abo a ɔsom bo bae.
Na ɔhen no dze algum ndua no yɛɛ Ewuradze ne fi na ɔhen ne fi no no edum, na nsankutsen na bɛntaasanku maa adwontofo no: Na wonnhun bi dɛm pɛn wɔ Judah asaase do.
Na ɔhen Solomon maa Sheba ɔhembaa no n’apɛdze nyinara, biribiara a obisae nyina, ɔsor dza ɔdze brɛɛ ɔhen no. Nna odzii ndan, na osii mu kɔr nankasa n’asaase do, ɔno na no nkowaa.
Afei sika a ɔbaa Solomon hɔ wɔ afe kor mu no ne nkerii yɛ sika talent ahaesia eduosia esia;
na ɔsor dza konkosifo na eguadzifo dze bae no; na Arabia ahemfo nyinara na ɔman no mu ambradofo no so wɔdze sika na dwetɛ brɛɛ Solomon.
Na ɔhen Solomon dze sika a wɔabor yɛɛ akyɛm akɛse ahaenu: Sika a wɔabor shekel ahaesia na ɔdze duraa kyɛm kor ho.
Na ɔdze sika a wɔabor yɛɛ akyɛm nkakraba ahaasa; sika shekel ahaasa na ɔdze duraa kyɛm kor ho: Na ɔhen no dze koguu Lebanon kwaa dan no mu.
Nkyii so ɔhen no yɛɛ asombɛn ahengua kɛsenara, na ɔdze sika mapa duraa ho.
Na ahengua no ho wɔ ntwerba esia, nye sika ananadzegua a wɔabobɔ mu afam ahengua no ho, na nsa wowɔ afã na afã wɔ atsenaa no ho, na ngyata ebien gyinagyina nsa no ho.
Na ngyata duebien gyinagyina ntwerba esia no do hɔ wɔ afã ha na ha: Wɔnnyɛɛ dza ɔtse dɛm bi da wɔ ahenman biara mu.
Na ɔhen Solomon no nkuraba a ɔnom mu nyinara sika dze a, na Lebanon kwaa dan no mu nkuraba nyinara sika mapa a: Dwetɛ dze wommbu no hwee wɔ Solomon ne nda no mu.
Na ɔhen no wɔ ahɛn a wɔnye Huram no nkowaa no kɔ Tarshish: Mfensa biara mu Tarshish ahɛn no ba prɛko, wɔdze sika, na dwetɛ, asombɛn, na ndɔpe, na koohaa ba.
Nna ɔhen Solomon boor asaase do ahemfo nyinara do wɔ ahonya na nyansa mu.
Na asaase do ahemfo nyinara hwehwɛɛ Solomon n’enyim ehu, dɛ wobetsie ne nyansaa a Nyankopɔn dze ahyɛ n’akoma mu no.
Na hɔn mu nyimpa biara dze n’ayɛyɛdze bae, dwetɛ ndzɛmba, na sika ndzɛmba, na ntar, akodze, na nduhuam, mpɔnkɔ, na nsoasompɔnkɔ, afrenhyiadze afrenhyia afrenhyia.
Na Solomon nyaa mpɔnkɔ na ntseaseanam ho mpɔnkɔdan mpemanan, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemduebien a ɔdze hɔn siesiee ntseaseanam nkurow no mu, na ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalem.
Na ɔhwɛɛ ahemfo no nyinara do dze fi Esutsen no ho araa dze kodur Philistiafo asaase do, na Egypt ahe do.
Na ɔhen no maa dwetɛ yɛɛ dɛ abo wɔ Jerusalem, na ɔmaa cedar so yɛɛ dɛ sycamore ndua a ɔwowɔ abɔnmu nkurow mu, wɔ ɔdodow mu.
Na wɔdze mponko fi Egypt, na asaase nyinara brɛɛ Solomon.

Afei Solomon ho nsɛm nkaa no, kan dze na ekyir dze, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Nathan n’a bakɔsɛm, na Shilonnyi Ahijah no nkɔn-hyɛsɛm, na ɔdzehunyi Iddo n'enyido-adzehusɛm a Nebat no ba Jeroboam hunii no mu bi a?
Na Solomon dzii Israel nyinara do hen wɔ Jerusalem mfe eduanan.
Na Solomon nye n’egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no wɔ n’egya David kurow mu: Na ne ba Rehoboam dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
10: Na Rehoboam sii mu kɔr Shechem: Osiandɛ Israel nyinara aba Shechem dɛ wɔrɛbɛhyɛ no hen.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Nebat ba Jeroboam tsee no, (osiandɛ ɔda ho wɔ Egypt, mbrɛ oguanee fii ɔhen Solomon enyim kɔree no), nna Jeroboam sanee fii Egypt bae.
Na wɔsomae ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ no; na Jeroboam na Israel nyinara bae, na wɔbɛkãa kyerɛɛ Rehoboam, dɛ,
w’egya yɛɛ hɛn kɔndua durdur: Dɛm ntsi afei yɛ w’egya no som dzendzen, na no kɔndua durdur a ɔdze too hɛn do no, harhar, na yɛnsom wo.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ondzi ndaansa, na hom mbra me nkyɛn bio. Na ɔman no twee mu kɔree.
Na ɔhen Rehoboam nye nkɔdaa a wogyinaa n’egya Solomon enyim mber a ɔda ho tse ase no faa apam dɛ, apam bɛn na hom dze repam me ma medze mbuae maasan akɛma ɔman yi?
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, sɛ eyɛ ayamuyie ma ɔman yi, na esɔ hɔn enyi, na ekã nsɛm pa kyerɛ hɔn a, ɔno wɔbeyɛ wo nkowaa daa nyina.
Na ɔpoow nkɔdaa no hɔn apam a wɔdze maa no no, na ɔnye mberantsɛ a wɔnye no nyinii a wogyinaa n’enyim no faa apam.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, apam bɛn na hom dze ma, ma yɛdze mbuae aasan akɛma ɔman yi a wɔakã akyerɛ me dɛ, yɛ kɔndua a w’egya dze too hɛn do no harhar no?

Na mberantsɛ a wɔnye no nyinii no kãa kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, dɛm na kã kyerɛ ɔman yi a wɔbɛkãa kyerɛɛ wo, dɛ, w’egya yɛɛ hɛn kɔndua durdur, na ɔwodze yɛ no harhar ma hɛn no; dɛm na kã kyerɛ hɔn, me nsatseaba kakraba ɔyɛ dur sen m’egya n’asen.
Na afei susuampa dɛ m’egya dze kɔndua durdur soaa hom no, emi so mobɔto hom kɔndua no do: M’egya dze mpire tsēaa hom, na emidze medze nyankoma-nketsebowa mebɛtsēa hom.
Nna Jeroboam na ɔman no nyinara baa Rehoboam nkyɛn da a otsia ebiasa no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no kãe no, dɛ, da a otsia ebiasa no hom mbra me nkyɛn bio no.
Na ɔhen no buaa hɔn ebufuw mu; na ɔhen Rehoboam poow nkɔdaa no hɔn apam no,
na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ mberantsɛ no hɔn apam no tse, dɛ, m’egya yɛɛ hom kɔndua durdur, na emidze mobɔto do: M’egya dze mpire tsēaa hom, na emidze medze nyankoma-nketsebowa mebɛtsēa hom.
Nna ɔhen no enntsie ɔman no; osiandɛ of Nyankopɔn hɔ na ɔbaa dɛm, ama Ewuradze eetsim n’asɛm a ɔnam Shilonnyi Ahijah ne nsa do kãa kyerɛɛ Nebat ba Jeroboam no.

Na aber a Israel nyinara hun dɛ ɔhen no enntsie hɔn no, nna ɔman no buaa ɔhen no, dɛ, ebɛn kyɛpɛn na yɛwɔ wɔ David mu? Nkyii so yennyi egyapadze wɔ Jesse ne ba no mu: Israel e, hom nkɔ hom asesee mu o: Afei David, hwɛ wankasa wo fie, nna Israel nyinara sii mu kɔr hɔn asesee mu.
Na Israelmba a wɔtsetse Judah nkurow mu no dze Rehoboam dzii hɔn do hen.
Nna ɔhen Rehoboam somaa Hadoram a ɔhwe ɔtow-edwuma do no; na Israelmba no siiw no abo, ma ɔtɔree. Na ɔhen Rehoboam yɛɛ ntsɛm foow ne tseaseanam, dɛ oruguan akɔ Jerusalem.
Nna Israel tseew etūa wɔ David fi do, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
11: Na aber a Rehoboam baa Jerusalem no, ohyiahyiaa Judah na Benjamin ofi, nyimpa a wɔasan mu eyi mpemɔhaeduowɔtwe a wɔyɛ akofo ano, dɛ ɔnye Israel rokɔkõ, adan ahendzi no ama Rehoboam bio.
Na Ewuradze n'asɛm baa Nyame nyimpa Shemaiah nkyɛn, dɛ,
kã kyerɛ Solomon ba Rehoboam, Judahhen, na Israel nyinara a wɔwɔ Judah na Benjamin, dɛ,

mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, mma hom mmfow nnkɔ, nkyii so mma wɔnnye hom nuanom nnkɔkõ: Nyimpa biara nsan nkɔ ne fie, na asɛm yi fir mara. Nna wotsiee Ewuradze ne nsɛm no, na wofii Jeroboam do nkɔree no do sanee.
Na Rehoboam tsenaa Jerusalem, na ɔkyekyeer twitwagye nkurow wɔ Judah.
Ɔkyekyeer Beth-lehem so, na Etam, na Tekoa,
na Beth-zur, na Soco, na Adullam,
na Gath, na Mareshah, na Ziph,
na Adoraim, na Lachish, na Azekah,
na Zorah, na Aijalon na Hebron a wɔwɔ Judah na Benjamin mu nkurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban no.
Na ɔhyehyɛɛ akoban no dzen, na ɔdze asafohemfo, na akɔhomabɔdze, na ngo na nsã, akoradze koguu mu.
Na ɔdze akyɛm na mpeaa kurakuraa nkurow ahorow nyinara mu, na ɔyeyɛɛ hɔn dzendzen mbordo. Na Judah na Benjamin yɛɛ nedze.
Na asɔfo na Levifo a wɔwɔ Israel nyinara mu no fi hɔn ahe nyinara do kɔr ne nkyɛn.
Na Levifo no gyaa hɔn mfikyisaase na hɔn enyadze hɔ, na wɔbaa Judah na Jerusalem: Osiandɛ Jeroboam na ne mba tuu hɔn dɛ mma wonndzi Ewuradze n’asɔfoe:
Na ɔhyehyɛɛ n’asɔfoe maa mbea sorɔnsorɔm no, na mpɔnkyenyin, na anantwimba a ɔyɛe no.

Na hɔn ekyir no, hɔn a wɔdze hɔn akoma maa dɛ wobefi Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu ahwehwɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, wɔbaa Jerusalem, dɛ wɔrobɔbɔ afɔr ama Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no.
Nna wɔyɛɛ Judah ahendzi no dzendzen, na wɔhyɛɛ Solomon ba Rehoboam dzen, mfe ebiasa: Osiandɛ wɔnantseew David na Solomon kwan do mfe ebiasa.
Na Rehoboam waar David ne ba Jerimoth ne babaa Mahalath, na Jesse ba Eliab ne babaa Abihail;
na ɔwoo mba maa no; Jeush, na Shemariah, na Zaham.
Na ɔno n’ekyir na ɔwaar Absalom ne babaa Maacah; na ɔwoo Abijah, na Attai, na Ziza, na Shelomith maa no.
Na Rehoboam dɔɔ Absalom ne babaa Maacah seen ne yernom na no nwewefo nyinara: (Na ɔwaar yernom duawɔtwe, na nwewefo eduosia, na ɔwoo mbabanyin eduonu awɔtwe na mbabaa eduosia).
Na Rehoboam hyɛɛ Maacah ba Abijah otsitsir, mekyerɛ no nuanom mu ɔpanyin: Osiandɛ ɔdween dɛ ɔbɛyɛ no ɔhen.

Na ɔyɛɛ no nyansa mu, na ɔdze ne mbabanyin no nyinara mu binom petsee Judah na Benjamin asaase nyinara do, kurow biara a wɔabɔ ho ban mu: Na ɔmaa hɔn akɔhomabɔdze piigyan. Na ɔhwehwɛɛ yernom pii memaa hɔn.
12: Nna ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Rehoboam n'ahendzi tsintsimii na ɔyɛɛ dzen no, nna ɔpoow Ewuradze ne mbra, na Israel nyinara kã no ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔhen Rehoboam n'afe a otsia enum no mu, nna Egypthen Shishak fowee baa Jerusalem do, osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia Ewuradze,
ɔdze ntseaseanam apem ahaenu, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemeduosia: Na nkorɔfo a wɔnye no fi Egypt bae no, wonnyi anobu; Lubifo, Sukkifo, na Ethiopiafo.
Na ɔgyegyee nkurowa wɔabobɔ ho ban no a ɔyɛ Judah dze no, na obodur Jerusalem.

Afei nkɔnhyɛnyi Shemaiah baa Rehoboam, na Judah mbapɔmba no a osian Shishak ntsi ma wɔaboa ano wɔ Jerusalem no, nkyɛn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi; hom apow me, dɛm ntsi mo so megyaa hom ahyɛ Shishak nsa.
Nna Israel mbapɔmba na ɔhen no wɔbrɛɛ hɔnho adze; na wɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze dzi bem.

Na aber a Ewuradze hun dɛ wɔabrɛ hɔnho adze no, Ewuradze baa Shemaiah nkyɛn, dɛ, wɔabrɛ hɔnho adze; mennkɛsɛɛ hɔn: Mbom ɔyɛ kakra a mebɛma woefi mu, na m’ebufuw runndua Shishak nsa do nnhue nngu Jerusalem do.
Naaso wɔbɛyɛ no nkowaa; ama woeehu mo som, na aman no ahendzi som no.
Nna Egypthen Shishak fowee baa Jerusalem do, na ɔbɛfaa Ewuradze ne fie akoradze, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze no; ɔfaa ne nyinara dze kɔree: Ɔfaa sika akyɛm a Solomon yɛe no dze kɔree.
Na ɔhen Rehoboam yɛɛ boran akyɛm dze sisii n'ananmu, na ɔdze hyɛɛ abrampɔfo a wɔhwɛ ɔhen ne fie abowano no do asafohemfo no nsa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, mber dodow biara a ɔhen no kɛhɛn Ewuradze ne fie no, abrampɔfo no ba bosusuo mu, na wɔdze san besi abrampɔfo pia no mu.
Na ɔbrɛɛ noho adze no, Ewuradze n’ebufuw danee fii no do, dɛ ɔmmpɛ dɛ ɔsɛɛ no nwionn nwionn: Na nkyii so woehu ndze pa wɔ Judah mu.

Nna ɔhen Rehoboam hyɛɛ noho dzen wɔ Jerusalem, na odzii hen: Na aber a Rehoboam hyɛɛ ase dzii hen no nna oedzi mfe eduanan biako, na odzii hen mfe duesuon wɔ Jerusalem, kurow no a Ewuradze saan mu yii no wɔ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu dɛ ɔdze ne dzin bɔto hɔ no a: Nã ne na ne dzin dze Naamah, Ammonnyi a.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo, osiandɛ ɔammfa n’akoma ennsi do dɛ ɔbɔhwehwɛ Ewuradze.

Afei Rehoboam no ho nsɛm, kan dze na ekyir dze ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Shemaiah na adzehunyi Iddo abakɔnsɛm no mu, dɛ mbrɛ ananakan no tsetsee bi a? Na akodzi daa Rehoboam na Jeroboam ntamu daa.
Na Rehoboam nye n'egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no wɔ David kurow mu: Na ne babanyin Abijah dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu
13: Ɔhen Jeroboam n'afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu na Abijah hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Judah do.
Mfe ebiasa na odzii hen wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Micaiah, Uriel a ofi Gibeah ne babaa a. Na akodzi baa Abijah na Jeroboam ntamu.

Na Abijah dze dɔm mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam, mekyerɛ mbarimba a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn mpemahaanan, kɔr akono: Na Jeroboam dze mbarimba a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn a wɔyɛ mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam, mpemahaawɔtwe, baa mpasuar kehyiaa no:
Na Abijah kegyinaa bepɔw Zemaraim a ɔwɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu no do, na ɔsee dɛ, Jerusalem na Israel, hom ntsie me;
ana ɔnnsɛ dza hom hu dɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, dze Israel do ahendzi no maa David daa, mekyerɛ dɛ ɔnam nkyɛn ahyɛmudzi do dze maa ɔno na ne mba no bi a?
Naaso Nebat ba Jeroboam, David ba Solomon n’akowaa no soɛree tseew no wura do etūa.
Na nyimpa huhuw, Belial mba bi, boaa ano kɔr ne nkyɛn a wɔhyɛɛ hɔnho dzen tsiaa Solomon ba Rehoboam, wɔ aber a Rehoboam yɛ aberantsɛ na n’akoma mberɛw, na onnkotum esiw hɔn wan.
Na afei hom dwen dɛ hom besiw Ewuradze n’ahendzi no a ɔwɔ David mba nsamu no kwan; na hom yɛ nyimpadodow kɛse, na sika anantwimba a Jeroboam yɛe maa hom dɛ hom enyame no wɔ hom nkyɛn.

Ana hom nnyiyii Ewuradze n’asɔfoe, Aaron mbabanyin no, na Levifo no edzi, na hom nhyehyɛɛ asɔfo mma homho dɛ mbrɛ asaase binom do aman no tsetsee? Dɛm ntsi obiara a ɔdze nantwisaa eburwa na ndwanyin esuon ba dɛ wɔmfa no nsi nkyɛn no, ɔnoara na ɔnyɛ ɔsɔfo mma hɔn a wɔnnyɛ enyame no.
Na hɛndze, Ewuradze nye hɛn Nyankopɔn, na yɛmmpoow no; na yewɔ asɔfo a wɔsom Ewuradze, Aaronmba no a, na Levifo no wɔwɔ hɔn edwuma mu:

Na anapa biara, na ewimbir biara wɔhyew ɔhyew-afɔr na eduhuam pa ma Ewuradze: Wosiesie kyerɛpaanoo so yie wɔ pon krɔnkrɔn no do; na sika kandzeadua na ne nkandzea no, ma ɔdzɛw ewimbir biara: Na hɛn na yɛhwɛ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn n’ahwɛdodze no do; na homdze hom apow no.
Na, hwɛ, Nyankopɔn kã hɛn ho dzi hɛn kan, na n’asɔfoe dzedze ewubɔ mbɛn dɛ wɔdze bɛhɛn ewubɔ etsia hom. Israel e, mma hom nnye Ewuradze, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn no nnkõ; na onnkesi hom yie.
Na Jeroboam hyɛɛ atsɛweefo bɔɔ aprɔw, ma wobefiir hɔn ekyir: Na wobedzii Judah enyim, na atsɛweefo no dzii hɔn ekyir.
Na aber a Judah twaa hɔn enyi ekyir no, hwɛ nna dɔm no wɔ hɔn enyim na hɔn ekyir: Na wosūi frɛɛ Ewuradze, na asɔfo no hehɛɛn mbɛn no.
Nna Judah mbarimba no bɔɔ ose gyee do: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Judah mbarimba no bɔɔ ose no, nna Nyankopɔn kãa Jeroboam na Israel nyinara gya wɔ Abijah na Judah enyim.
Na Israelmba no gui wɔ Judah enyim: Na Nyankopɔn yii hɔn hyɛɛ hɔn nsa.
Na Abijah na ne man kunkum hɔn oku kɛse: Ma dɛm ntsi hɔn a wɔhwee ase totɔree wɔ Israel mu wɔyɛ mbarimba a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn mpemahaenum.
Mbrɛ wosii brɛɛ Israelmba no adze aber no no nye yi, na Judahmba no dzii nyim, osiandɛ wɔtweer Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no.
Na Abijah tsiiw Jeroboam, na ɔkɛgyegyee ne nsamu nkurow, Beth-el nye no nkurobaase, na Jeshanah nye no nkurobaase, na Ephron nye no nkurobaase.
Nkyii so Jeroboam ennya ahoɔdzen bio wɔ Abijah ne nda no mu: Na Ewuradze bɔɔ no ma owui.
Na Abijah dze ɔhyɛɛ dzen, na ɔwarwaar yernom duanan, na ɔwowoo mbabanyin eduonu ebien, na mbabaa duesia.
Na Abijah no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na n’akwan, na ne nsɛm no, wɔakyerɛw no wo nkɔnnyɛnyi Iddo ne nkyerɛkyerɛase nwoma no mu.
14: Nna Abijah nye n'egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no wɔ David kurow mu, na ne ba babanyin Asa dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu: Ne nda no mu na asaase no do dwee mfe du.
Na Asa yɛɛ dza oye na ɔtsen wɔ n'Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn enyi do:
Na oyiyii anana afɔrmbukyia, na mbea sorɔnsorɔm no, na odwuruuw edum no, na otwitwaa Asherim no gui;
na ɔhyɛɛ Judah dɛ wɔnhwehwɛ Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no, na wondzi ne mbra na ne mbransɛm no do.
Eso oyiyii Judah nkurow nyinara do mbea sorɔnsorɔm, na ewia ehonyi no: Na ahenman no mu dwee wɔ n’enyim.
Na ɔkyekyeer nkurow a ɔyɛ dzen wɔ Judah, osiandɛ asaase no do dwee na oenndzi akõ bi wɔ mfe no mu; osiandɛ Ewuradze ama no ahomgye.

Na ɔsee Judah dɛ, hom mma yɛnkyekyer nkurow yi, na yɛnyɛ fasu, na aban atsentsen, mbobotsen, na ndaban wo hɔ; asaase no da ho wɔ hɛn enyim, osiandɛ yɛahwehwɛ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn; yɛahwehwɛ no, na ɔama hɛn ahomgye wɔ afã nyinara. Nna wɔkyekyeree na wɔyɛɛ prɔmprɔm.
Na Asa wɔ dɔm a wosuo akokyɛm na mpeaa mu, Judah mu nyimpa mpemahaasa; na Benjamin mu nyimpa a wosuo akyɛm mu, na wɔtow egyen, mpemahaenu eduowɔtwe: Woyinom nyinara mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam a.
Na Ethiopianyi Zerah dze dɔm mpempem, na ntseaseanam ahaasa fiir edzi baa hɔn do; na obodur Mareshah.
Nna Asa fiir edzi kehyiaa no na wɔbaa mpasuar no wɔ Zephathah bɔnsa mu, wɔ Mareshah ho.

Na Asa sūi frɛɛ Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn, na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, obi nnyi hɔ kã wo ho dɛ ɔbɔboa, wɔ ɔkatakyi na nyia onnyi ahoɔdzen no ntamu: Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn e, boa hɛn; na ɔwoara na yɛtwer wo, na wo dzin mu na yɛaba ribehyia nyimpadodow yi. Ewuradze, ɔwo nye ehen Nyankopɔn; mma mma ɔdasanyi nndzi wo do nyim.
Nna Ewuradze kãa Ethiopiafo no gya wɔ Asa, na Judah enyim; na Ethiopiafo no gui.

Na Asa na nkorɔfo a wɔkã no ho no tsiiw hɔn kodur Gerar: Na Ethiopiafo no mu nyimpa dodowara hwehwee ase a woenntum anngye hɔnho nkwa; na wɔsɛɛ hɔn wɔ Ewuradze, na no dɔm enyim; na wɔfaa asadze piigyan kɔree.
Na wɔkãa nkurow a abɔ Gerar ho aprɔw no nyinara gya; na Ewuradze ho suro baa hɔn do: Na wɔfoom nkurow no nyinara; osiandɛ asadze pii wowɔ mu.
Wɔkɛkãa mbowakuw asesee no so gya, na wɔfaa nguan piigyan na efumpɔnkɔ kɔree, na wɔdanee baa Jerusalem.
15: Na Nyankopɔn no sunsum baa Obed ba Azariah do;

na ofiir edzi kehyiaa Asa, na ɔsee no dɛ, Asa, na Judah na Benjamin nyinara, hom ntsie me: Ewuradze wɔ hom nkyɛn, aber a hom wɔ ne nkyɛn yi; na sɛ hom hwehwɛ no a, hom bohu no; na sɛ hom pow no a, ɔbɔpow hom.
Afei mber tsentsenntsen na Israel wonnyi nokwar Nyankopɔn, na wonnyi ɔsɔfo a ɔkyerɛkyerɛ, na wonnyi mbra:
Na sɛ ahokyer mu no wɔsan ba Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na wɔhwehwɛ no a, ɔma wohu no.
Na mber no mu no na asomdwee bi nnyi hɔ mma nyia ofir edzi na nyia ɔba mu so, na ɔfona kɛse wɔ asaase no do atsefo no nyinara do.
Na wɔbobɔɔ hɔnho pɔsɔpɔsɔ, ɔman tsiaa ɔman, na kurow tsiaa kurow osiandɛ Nyankopɔn dze ahohia nyinara fonaa hɔn.
Na homdze, hom nhyɛ dzen, na mma mma hom abaw nngow: Na hom edwuma benya akatua.

Na aber a Asa tsee nsɛm yi, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Obed no nkɔnhyɛ no, nna ɔhyɛɛ dzen, na oyiyii ekyiwadze no fii Judah na Benjamin asaase nyinara do, na nkurow a ɔgyegyee no wɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu no mu; na ɔyɛɛ Ewuradze n’afɔrmbukyia a ɔwɔ Ewuradze ne nkrandaa no enyim no fofor.

Na ohyiahyiaa Judah na Benjamin nyinara, na hɔn a wofi Ephraim na Manasseh, na Simeon mu baa hɔn nkyɛn ahɔhotsena no boaa ano; osiandɛ Israel mu piigyan waae baa ne nkyɛn, aber a wohun dɛ n’Ewuradze Nyankopɔn dzi n’ekyir no.
Nna wohyiahyiaa hɔnho kehyiaa Jerusalem wɔ bosoom a otsia ebiasa no mu, wɔ Asa n’ahendzi no mu afe a otsia duenum no mu.
Na da no wɔdze asadze a wɔdze bae no mu, anantwi ahaesuon na nguan mpemesuon bɔɔ Ewuradze okum-afɔr.
Na wodzii ahyɛmu dɛ wɔdze hɔn akoma nyinara na ɔnye hɔn kra nyinara bɔhwehwɛ Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no;
na dɛ obiara a ɔnnkɛpɛ dɛ ɔhwehwɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, kakraba o, ɔkɛse o, ɔbarimba o, ɔbaa o, wonku no.
Na wɔdze ndze kɛse, na esebɔ, na ɔnye nkasamu, na ɔnye mbɛn suae kyerɛɛ Ewuradze.
Na Judah nyinara hɔn enyi gyee wɔ ntam no ho; osiandɛ hɔn akoma nyinara na wɔdze suae, na wɔdze hɔn pɛ nyinara hwehwɛɛ no; na ɔmaa wohun no: Na Ewuradze maa hɔn ahomgye wɔ mbea nyinara.
Na ɔhen Asa ne nã Maacah so, otuu no fii ahembaadzi mu, osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ ekyiwa honyi bi maa Asherah ntsi; na Asa twaa no honyi no, na ɔyɛɛ no huntuhuntu, na ɔkɛhyeew no wɔ ɔwora Kidron ho.
Na mbea sorɔnsorɔm no dze, woennyiyi emmfi Israel: Naaso Asa n’akoma dzii mu wɔ ne nda nyinara mu.
Na ɔdze ndzɛmba a n’egya yɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn, na dza nankasa yɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn no baa Nyankopɔn ne fie, dwetɛ, na sika, na ndzɛmbandzɛmba.
Na akodzi bi ammba araa dze kodur Asa n’ahendzi mu afe a otsia eduasa enum no mu.
16: Asa n’ahendzi no afe a otsia eduasa esia no mu, na Israelhen Baasha fowee kɔr Judah do, na ɔkɛkyekyeer Ramah, dɛ ɔremma kwan ma obiara nndzi Judahhen Asa nkyɛn akɔnaaba.
Nna Asa faa dwetɛ na sika fi Ewuradze ne fie na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze mu, na ɔsomae ma wɔdze kɔr Syriahen Benhadad a ɔtse Damascus no nkyɛn dɛ,
Nkyekyeree bi da emi na ɔwo ntamu, dɛ mbrɛ nkyɛ ɔda m’egya na w’egya ntamu no: Hwɛ, mama wɔdze dwetɛ na sika rebrɛ wo; kɔ, kɛtsetsew ɔwo nye Israelhen Baasha nkyekyeree no mu, ma omfi mo do nkɔ.
Na Ben-hadad tsiee ohen Asa, na osomaa no dom do asafohemfo wo Israel nkurow do; na wokoboo Ijon, na Dan, na Abel-maim, na Naphtali adzekora nkurow no nyinara.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Baasha tsee no, nna ogyaa Ramah kyekyer, na ɔmaa n’edwuma no kae.
Nna ɔhen Asa faa Judah nyinara; na wɔkɔsoaa Ramah abo, na ndua no a Baasha dze kyekyeree no; na ɔdze kyekyeer Geba na Mizpah.
Na aber no mu no adzehunyi Hanani baa Judahhen Asa nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, osiandɛ ɔwo atwer Syriahen, na anntwer Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn no, dɛm ntsi na Syriahen no dɔm no efi wo nsa eguan no.
Ana Ethiopiafo na Lubifo no nnyɛ dɔmtutuw, wɔ ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo dodow mbordo mu bi a? Naaso, osiandɛ etweer Ewuradze ntsi, ɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ wo nsa.
Na Ewuradze dze n’enyi kɔ asaase nyina do aprɔw, dɛ ɔbɛkyerɛ no ho ne dzen wɔ hɔn a hɔn akoma dzi mu wɔ no ho no hɔn afamu. Iyi mu na ayɛ nkwaseadze; dɛm ntsi ofi ha kɔ yi ibenya akodzi.
Nna Asa no bo fuuw adzehunyi no, na ɔdze no kɔtoo adaduadan no mu; na onyaa no ebufuw wɔ asem yi ntsi. Na Asa tseetsee ɔman no mu binom wɔ mber no ara mu.
Na, hwɛ, Asa no ho nsɛm, kan dze na ekyir dze no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Judah na Israel ahemfo nwoma no mu.
Na Asa n’ahendzi no mu afe a otsia eduasa akron no mu na ɔyaar n’anan; ne yarba no yɛɛ kɛse mbordo: Naaso ne yarba no mu no ɔannhwehwɛ Ewuradze, na mbom enunsimfo a.
Na Asa nye n’egyanom kɛdae, na owui wɔ n’ahendzi no mu afe a otsia eduanan biako no mu.

Na wosiee no wɔ nankasa n’asamandan a otwae maa noho wɔ David kurow mu no mu, na wɔdze no too mpa a nduhuam na ndur ahorow a wɔaforafora no nduforaforafo nyansaa mu ahyɛ do mã no do: Na wɔhyeew ɔhyew kɛsenara maa no.
17: Na ne babanyin Jehoshaphat dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu, na ɔhyɛɛ noho dzen dze tsiaa Israel.
Na ɔdze dɔm guguu Judah nkurow a wɔabɔ ho ban nyinara mu, na ɔdze bansifo sisii Judah asaase do, na Ephraim nkurow a n’egya Asa gyegyee no mu.
Na Ewuradze dzii Jehoshaphat n’ekyir, osiandɛ ɔnantseew n’egya David n’akwan a odzi kan no mu, na ɔannhwehwɛ Baalim n’ekyir kwan;
na mbom ɔhwehwɛɛ n’egya ne Nyankopɔn no, na ɔnantseew ne mbransɛm no mu, na nnyɛ Israel ndzeyɛɛ no ekyir a.
Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze tsintsiim ahendzi no wɔ ne nsamu; na Judah nyinara dze ayɛyɛdze brɛɛ Jehoshaphat, na onyaa adze na enyidzi piigyan.
Na wɔmaa n'akoma do wɔ Ewuradze n'akwan do: Na nkyii so oyiyii mbea sorɔnsorɔm na Asherim no fii Judah.
Eso n'ahendzi no mu afe a otsia ebiasa no mu no ɔsomaa ne mbapɔmba, mekyerɛ Benn-hail, na Obadiah, na Zechariah, na Nethanel, na Micaiah, dɛ wɔnkɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ Judah nkurow no mu.

na Levifo, mekyerɛ Shemaiah, na Nethaniah, na Zebadiah, na Asahel, na Shemiramoth, na Jehonathan, na Adonijah, na Tobijah, na Tob-adonijah a wɔyɛ Levifo no kã hɔn ho; na asɔfo no, Elishama na Jehoram so kã hɔn ho.
Na wɔkyerɛkyerɛe wɔ Judah, dɛ wɔwɔ Ewuradze ne mbra nwoma no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn; na wokekyimakyimaa Judah nkurow no nyinara mu; na wɔkɛkyerɛkyerɛe wɔ ɔman no mu.
Na Ewuradze ho suro baa asaase a wɔabɔ Judah ho aprɔw no mu ahendzi nyinara do, ma dɛm ntsi wɔnnye Jehosaphat enndzi akõ.
Na Philistiafo no mu binom dze ayɛyɛdze, na ɔtowyi dwetɛ brɛɛ Jehoshaphat; Arabiafo no so dze nguankuw nguankuw brɛɛ no, ndwanyin mpemesuon ahaesuon, na mpɔnkyenyin mpemesuon ahaesuon.
Na Jehoshaphat yɛɛ kɛse mbordo; na osisii adan na adzekora nkurow wɔ Judah.
Na onyaa ndwuma pii wɔ Judah nkurow no mu; na mbarimba akofo, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, wɔ Jerusalem.
Na hɔn nkanee dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee nye yi: Judah mu, mpem do asafohemfo no; ɔsafohen Adnah, na mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam mpemahaasa kã no ho:
Na ɔsafohen Jehohanan na odzi no do, na nyimpa mpemahaenu eduowɔtwe kã no ho:
Na ɔno so no do na Zichri ne ba Amasiah a ɔdze noho maa Ewuradze ɔpɛ do no dzi; na mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam mpemahaenu kã no ho:
Na Benjamin mu; Eliada ɔbarimba ɔkatakyi a ɔyɛ ndam bi, na nyimpa a wɔdze egyen na kyɛm emiamia mpemahaenu kã no ho:
Na no do na Jehozabad dzi, na nyimpa mpemɔha eduowɔtwe a woesiesie hɔnho ama ɔsa kã no ho.
Woyinom nye hɔn a wɔsom ɔhen no, ɔsor hɔn a ɔhen no dze hɔn guguu Judah nyinara mu nkurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban no mu no.
18: Afei Jehoshaphat nyaa adze na enyidzi piigyan; na ɔnye Ahab yɛɛ asew.
Na mfe bi n'ekyir no osii mu kɔr Ahab nkyɛn wɔ Samaria. Na Ahab kunkum nguan na anantwi piigyan dze maa ɔno, na nkorɔfo a wɔkã no ho no, na ɔdaadaa no dɛ ɔnye no mfow nkɔ Ramoth-gilead.
Na Israelhen Ahab see Judahhen Jehoshaphat dɛ, ana enye me bɔkɔ Ramoth-glead a? Na obuaa no dɛ, metse dɛ woara, na me man tse dɛ wo man; na yɛnye wo bɔkɔ ɔsa no.
Na Jehoshaphat see Israelhen no dɛ, meserɛ wo, bisa Ewuradze n’asɛm ndɛ.
Nna Israelhen no boaboaa nkɔnhyɛfo no ano, mbarimba ahaanan, na ɔsee hon dɛ, ana yɛnkɔ Ramoth-gilead nkɔkõ, anaa mingyaa? Na wɔsee dɛ, fow kɔ; na Nyankopɔn dze bɛhyɛ ɔhen ne nsa.
Na Jehoshaphat see dɛ, ana Ewuradze no nkɔnhyɛnyi bi so nnyi ha, ma yebebisa no ho adze?

Na Israelhen no see Jehoshaphat dɛ, ɔbarimba baako bi da ho wɔ hɔ a nkyɛ yɛnam no do bebisa Ewuradze adze: Na mikyir no; osiandɛ ɔnnhyɛ mo ho nkɔm pa, na bɔn ara nko ɔno nye Imla ne ba Micaiah. Na Jehoshaphat see dɛ, mma mma ɔhen nnse dɛm.
Nna Israelhen no frɛɛ ɔsafohen bi, na ɔsee dɛ, kɛfa Imla ne ba Micaiah bra ntsɛmara.
Afei Israelhen na Judahhen Jehoshaphat tsetse hɔn ahengua do nkorkor, hyehyɛ hɔn ahentar, na wɔtsetse Samaria kuropon ahɛnee gua do; na nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara rehyɛ nkɔm wɔ hɔn enyim.
Na Chenaanah ne ba Zedekiah yɛɛ dadze mmbɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, Iyinom na edze bosun Syriafo no araa ma wɔaahyew.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara hyehyɛɛ nkɔm dɛm, dɛ, fow kɔ Ramoth-gilead, na onsi wo yie: Na Ewuradze dze bɛhyɛ ɔhen nsa.
Na ɔbɔfo no a ɔkɔr dɛ ɔrekɛfrɛ Micaiah no kãa kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, hwɛ, nkɔnhyɛfo nsɛm no dze anokor yi papa kyerɛ ɔhen: Dɛm ntsi meserɛ wo, ma w’asɛm nyɛ dɛ hɔndze no kor, na kã asɛm pa.
Na Micaiah see dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi, dza me Nyankopɔn bɛse no, ɔno na mebɛkã.
Na aber a ɔbaa ɔhen no nkyɛn no, ɔhen no see no dɛ, Micaiah, ana yɛnkɔ Ramoth-gilead nkɔkõ, anaa mingyaa? Na ɔsee dɛ, hom mfow nkɔ, na onsi hom yie; na wobeyi hɔn ahyɛ hom nsa.
Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, mpɛn ahen ara na menkã ntam ngu wo do ma ennkã hwee dɛ dza ɔyɛ nokwar nko wɔ Ewuradze ne dzin mu kyerɛ me?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Muhun Israel nyinara dɛ wɔapetse mbepɔw do, dɛ nguan a wonnyi oguanhwɛfo: Na Ewuradze see dɛ, Iyinom wonnyi wura; ma wɔnsan, nyimpa biara nkɔ ne fie asomdwee mu.
Na Israelhen no see Jehoshaphat dɛ, ana mannkã mannkyerɛ wo dɛ ɔnnkɛhyɛ mo ho nkɔm pa, dɛ bɔn nko?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛm ntsi hom ntsie Ewuradze n'asɛm: Muhun Ewuradze dɛ ɔtse n'ahengua do, na ɔsor dɔm nyinara gyinagyma n’enyimfa na n’abankum.
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, woana na ɔbɛdaadaa Israelhen Ahab ma ɔaafow akɔ akɔtɔr wɔ Ramoth-gilead? Na obi kasaa see dɛm, na obi so see dɛm
Na sunsum bi fiir edzi begyinaa Ewuradze enyim, na ɔsee dɛ, mara mebɛdaadaa no. Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, edze ebɛn adze?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Mibefir edzi, na makɛyɛ sunsum torfo wɔ no nkɔnhyɛfo nyinara anomu. Na ɔsee dɛ, ɔwo bɛdaadaa no, na eso edzi nyim: Fir edzi kɔ, na kɛyɛ dɛm.
Dɛm ntsi afei, hwɛ, Ewuradze dze sunsum torfo ahyɛ wo nkɔnhyɛfo yi anomu; na Ewuradze akasa wo ho bɔn.
Nna Chenaanah ne ba Zedekiah twee pinii, na ɔbɔɔ Micaiah sotɔr see dɛ, ebɛn ɔkwan do na Ewuradze no sunsum nam fi me nkyɛn bɛkãa kyerɛɛ wo yi?
Na Micaiah see dɛ, hwɛ, da no a ebɔkɔ mpiakyir pia mu dɛ irukosuma woho no na ibohu.
Na Israelhen no see dɛ, hom mfa Micaiah, na hom mfa no nsan nkɔ kurow no mu ambrado Amon, na ɔhen ne ba Joash nkyɛn;
na hom nse dɛ, mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, hom mfa akowaa yi nto efiadze, na hom mfa ahohiahia edziban na ahohiahia nsu nnyɛn no, na onkodu dɛ mebɛsan aba no asomdwee mu.
Na Micaiah see dɛ, sɛ ɔwoara esan ba no asomdwee mu ara dze a, nna nnyɛ Ewuradze na ɔnam mo do akasa. Na ɔsee dɛ, aman, hom nyinara hom ntsie.
Na Israelhen no na Judahhen Jehoshaphat fowee kɔr Ramoth-gilead.
Na Israelhen no see Jehoshaphat dɛ, Mebɛsakyer moho, na makɔ akono: Na ɔwodze hyɛ w’ahentar. Nna Israelhen no sakyeer noho; na wosii mu kɔr akono.
Afei Syriahen no ahyɛ ne ntseaseanam do asafohemfo no, dɛ, mma hom nnye kakraba anaa kɛse nnkõ, gyedɛ Israelhen no nkotonoo.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ntseaseanam do asafohemfo no hun Jehoshaphat no, nna wɔsee dɛ, Israelhen nye no. Dɛm ntsi wotwae yeer no dɛ wɔnye no rokɔkõ: Na Jehoshaphat kekaa mu, na Ewuradze boaa no; na Nyankopɔn nuu hɔn mu ma wɔdanee fii no ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ntseaseanam do asafohen no hun dɛ nnyɛ Israelhen nye no, nna wogyaa no tsiw saan ekyir.
Na ɔbarimba bi twee n’egyen mu ntɔgonmu ara gyan, na ɔbɔɔ Israelhen no wɔ mbɔboamu na akatabo no ntamu: Dɛm ntsi ɔsee tseaseanam kafo no dɛ, dan wo nsa, na fa me fi dɔm yi mu; na mepira dzendzen.
Na ɔkõ no mu yɛɛ dzen da no: Naaso Israelhen no suoo noho mu gyinaa ne tseaseanam mu wɔ Syriafo no enyim araa dze kodur ewimbir: Na bɛyɛ mber a wi rokɔtɔ no na owui.
19: Na Judahhen Jehoshaphat sanee kɔr ne fie asomdwee mu wɔ Jerusalem.

Na Hanani ne ba Jehu adzehunyi no fiir edzi kehyiaa no kwan, na ɔsee ɔhen Jehoshaphat dɛ, aso ɔsɛ dɛ eboa ndzebɔnyɛfo, na edɔ hɔn a wokyir Ewuradze no anaa? Na iyi ntsi ebufuw fi Ewuradze enyim da wo do.
Naaso woehu wo ho ndzɛmba pa, wɔ dɛ ɔwo etwitwa Asheroth no efi asaase no do, na esiesie w’akoma dɛ erohwehwɛ Nyankopɔn.
Na Jehoshaphat tsenaa Jerusalem: Na ofiir edzi kɔr ɔman no mu ɔdze fi Beer-sheba kodu Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu, na ɔdze hɔn sanee baa Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no nkyɛn.
Na osisii atsɛmbuafo wɔ asaase no do wɔ Judah nkurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban nyinara mu, nkurow nkurow,
na ɔsee atsɛmbuafo no dɛ, Hom ndwen dza hom yɛ ho: Osiandɛ hom mmbu atsɛn mma nyimpa, na mbom Ewuradze a; na ɔwɔ hom nkyɛn wɔ atsɛmbu no mu.
Dɛm ntsi afei wɔmma Ewuradze ho suro mbra hom do; hom nhwɛ yie na hom nyɛ: Na emumuyɛ, na enyimhwɛ, na mboabadzi, nnyi Ewuradze, hɛn Nyankopɔn afamu.
Nkyii so Jerusalem na Jehoshaphat dze Levifo na asɔfo, na Israel egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir no mu binom sisii hɔ maa Ewuradze n'atsɛmbusɛm, na mansotwensɛm. Na wɔsanee baa Jerusalem.
Na ɔbraa hɔn, dɛ, dɛm na hom nyɛ wɔ Ewuradze no suro mu nokwar mu, na akoma a odzi mu mu.

Na aber biara a mansotwensɛm biara ɔba hom nkyɛn a ofi hom nuanom a wɔtsetse hɔn nkurow mu, wɔ bɔgya na bɔgya ntamu asem, mbra na mbrasɛm, ahyɛdze na atsɛmbu nsɛm ntamu asɛm no, hom mbɔ hɔn nkaa mma woeenndzi sõ wɔ Ewuradze afamu, na ebufuw aammba hom na hom nuanom do: Hom nyɛ yi, na hom nnkedzi sõ.

Na, hwɛ, ɔsɔfopanyin Amariah na ɔhwɛ hom do wɔ Ewuradze afamu nsɛm nyinara ho; na Ishmael ne ba Zebadiah, Judah fie ɔpanyin no so, wɔ ɔhen afamu nsɛm nyinara ho: Levifo no so nyɛ asafohemfo wɔ hom enyim. Hom nyɛ no akokodur mu, na Ewuradze ndzi apapafo no ekyir.
20: Na ɔbaa dɛ, iyi ekyir no, nna Moabmba, na Ammonmba, na Ammonfo binom kã hɔn ho, wɔbaa Jehoshaphat do dɛ wɔnye no robɔkõ.
Nna obi bae bɛkãa kyerɛɛ Jehoshaphat dɛ, Dɔmtutuw bi fi po no egya fi Syria reba wo do; na, hwɛ, wɔwɔ Hazazon-tamar (ɔnoara nye En-gedi).
Na Jehoshaphat suroi, na ɔdze n’enyi sii do dɛ ɔbɔhwehwɛ Ewuradze; na ɔbɔɔ mbuadadzi ho dawur wɔ Judah nyinara mu.
Na Judah poon hɔnho hyiae, dɛ wɔrobɔ-wehwɛ Ewuradze hɔ mboa: Mekyerɛ wofi Judah nkurow nyinara mu na wɔbaa dɛ wɔrobɔhwehwɛ Ewuradze.
Na Jehoshaphat gyinaa Judah na Jerusalem bagua no mu, wɔ Ewuradze ne fi no mu, wɔ abangua fofor no enyim;

na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, hɛn egyanom Nyankopɔn, ana ɔwo nnyɛ Nyankopɔn wɔ ɔsor? Na ana ɔwo nnyɛ amanaman ahendzi nyinara do ɔhwɛfo bi a? Na wo nsamu na tum na mbanyinndam wɔ, ma dɛm ntsi obi runntum nngyina w’enyim.
Ana nnyɛ ɔwo, hɛn Nyankopɔn, na ituu asaase yi do atsefo no fii wo man Israel enyim, na edze maa wo nyɛnko Abraham daa no bi a?
Na wɔtsenaa do, na wosii wo do krɔnkrɔn-bea maa wo dzin, dɛ,

sɛ mbusu bi, afõwa, atsɛmbu, anaa ɔyardɔm, anaa ɔkɔm ba hɛn do a, yɛbɛba ebegyina ofi yi enyim, na w’enyim, (osiandɛ wo dzin wɔ oh yi mu), na yeesū afrɛ wo wɔ hɛn amandzehu mu, na ɔwo etsie hɛn na agye hɛn nkwa.
Na afei, hwɛ, Ammonmba, na Moab na Seir bepɔw mba no a ɔwoara ammpɛ ma Israel annkɔ hɔn ntuae, aber a wofi Egypt asaase do reba no, na mbom wɔdanee fii hɔn ho, na wɔannsɛɛ hɔn po;
hwɛ, mbrɛ woesi rutua hɛn kaw, dɛ wɔaba rubotu hɛn efi w'enyadze a ɔwoara edze ama hɛn dɛ yendzi no do.
Hɛn Nyankopɔn e, ana innkobu hɔn atsɛn? Osiandɛ yennyi tum bi a yɛdze rigyina kuw kɛse yi a wɔreba hɛn do yi enyim; nkyii so yennyim dza yɛnnyɛ: Na ɔwoara na hɛn enyi da wo do.
Na Judah nyinara, nye hɔn mbofraba, hɔn yernom, na hɔn mba, gyinagyinaa Ewuradze enyim.
Nna Ewuradze no sunsum baa Jahaziel, Zechariah ba no, Benaiah ba no, Jeiel ba no, Mattaniah ba no, Levinyi a ofi Asaph mba no mu no do wo mboanofo no finimfin;

na ɔsee dɛ, hom ntsie, Judah nyinara, na hom Jerusalem atsefo, na ɔwo ɔhen Jehoshaphat: Mbrɛ Ewuradze se hom nye yi, mma hom nnsuro, nkyii so mma hom akoma nntu osian nyimpadodow kɛse yi ntsi; osiandɛ ɔkõ yi nnyɛ homdze bi a, na Nyankopɔn dze a.
Ɔkyena hom nsian nkɔ hɔn do; hwɛ, wɔnam Ziz afowee rofow aba; na hom bohu hɔn wɔ bɔnsa no n'ewiei, wɔ Jeruel sar no enyim.

Hom nnkehia dɛ wɔbɔkõ wɔ ɔkõ yi mu: Hom nhuruhuruw ngyina, hom ngyina dzen, na wɔnhwɛ Ewuradze a ɔkã hom ho no, no nkwagye, Judah na Jerusalem e: Mma hom nnsuro na hom akoma nntu so: Ɔkyena hom mfir edzi nkɔ hɔn do; na Ewuradze bedzi hom ekyir.
Na Jehoshaphat bɔɔ ne tsir adze dze n’enyim kãa famu: Na Judah nyinara na Jerusalem atsefo no hwehwee famu wɔ Ewuradze enyim sɔɔr Ewuradze.
Na Levifo a wofi Kofaathfo mba, na Korahfo mba mu no, soɛree gyinagyinaa dɛ wɔdze ndze kɛse mbordo riyi Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no ayɛw.

Na wɔsoɛɛr anapaatu, na wofiir edzi kɔr Tekoa sar no do: Na worifir edzi akɔ no, Jehoshaphat gyinae na ɔsee dɛ, Judah, na hom Jerusalem atsefo, hom ntsie me; hom ngye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn ndzi, na hom betsim; hom ngye no nkɔnhyɛfo no ndzi, na hom bɛyɛ prɔmprɔm.

Na aber a ɔnye ɔman no faa apam no, nna ɔhyehyɛɛ hɔn a wɔntow ndwom mma Ewuradze, na wonyi no ayɛw wɔ n’ahokeka krɔnkrɔn mu, aber a worifir edzi wɔ dɔm no enyim no, na wɔsee dɛ, hom nda Ewuradze ase; na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
Na aber a wɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ wɔrotow ndwom na woriyi ayɛw no nna Ewuradze maa atsɛweefo baa Ammonmba, Moab, na Seir bepɔw do atsefo a wɔbaa Judah do no do; na wɔbɔɔ hɔn gui.
Na Ammon na Moabmba no soɛree tsiaa Seir bepɔw do atsefo no, dɛ woruku hɔn asɛɛ hɔn pasapasa: Na aber a wowiee Seir atsefo no, obiara boae ma wɔsɛɛ obi so.
Na aber a Judah baa sar no do ahwɛɛtsentsen no nkyɛn no, nna wɔdanee hwɛɛ nyimpadodow no; na, hwɛ, wɔayɛ efun gugu famu, na obiara nnyi hɔ a ofii nsa guanee.

Na aber a Jehoshaphat na no nkorɔfo no baa dɛ wɔrebɛfa hɔn asadze no, nna wohunii wɔ hɔn mu ahonyadze na ntar, na ndwindze a ɔsom bo piigyan a hɔnara wɔtasee fae, ɔsõ ma dɛ wobotum asoa akɔ: Na wɔdze asadze no fom araa ndaansa, osiandɛ ɔdɔɔ sõ dodow.
Na da a otsia anan no wɔpoon hɔnho hyiae wɔ Beracah bɔnsa no mu; osiandɛ hɔ na wohyiraa Ewuradze: Dɛm ntsi na wɔfrɛɛ no Beracah Bɔnsa, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Nna wɔsanee, Judah na Jerusalem mbarimba nyinara, na Jehoshaphat dzi hɔn enyim, dɛ wɔdze enyigye reba Jerusalem bio; osiandɛ Ewuradze ama hɔn enyi agye wɔ hɔn atamfo ho.
Na wɔdze bɛntaasanku na nsankutsen na mbɛn bae bɛhɛɛn Ewuradze fie wɔ Jerusalem.
Na Nyankopɔn ho suro kãa ɔman no mu ahendzi no nyinara, wɔ aber a wɔtsee dɛ Ewuradze nye Israel hɔn atamfo akõ no.
Nna Jehoshaphat n’ahenman mu dwee: Osiandɛ ne Nyankopɔn maa no ahomgye wɔ mbea nyinara hyiae.
Na Jehoshaphat dzii hen wɔ Judah do: Aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduasa enum; na odzii hen mfe eduonu enum wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Azubah, Shilhi ne babaa a.
Na ɔnantseew n’egya Asa kwan do, na ɔanndan emmfi ho emmfi, dɛ ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do.
Naaso mbea sorɔnsorɔm no dze oennyiyi no hɔ; nkyii so ɔman no nnyae mmfaa hɔn akoma nnsii hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no do.
Afei Jehoshaphat no ho nsɛm nkaa no, kan dze na ekyir dze no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Hanani ne ba Jehu n’abakɔsɛm a wɔdze hyɛɛ Israel ahemfo nwoma no mu no mu.
Na iyi ekyir na Judahhen Jehoshaphat dze noho kɔbɔɔ Israelhen Ahaziah ho; ɔnoara na ɔyɛɛ ndzeyɛbɔn dodow no:
Na ɔdze noho bɔɔ ho dɛ wɔbɛyɛ ahɛn akɔ Tarshish: Na wɔyɛɛ ahɛn no Ezion-geber.
Nna Dodavahu a ofi Mareshah ne ba Eliezer hyɛɛ Jehoshaphat ho nkɔm, dɛ, osiandɛ ɔwo edze woho abɔ Ahaziah ho ntsi no, Ewuradze asekyɛw wo ndwuma. Na ahɛn no bobɔe, ma woenntum annkɔ Tarshish.
21: Na Jehoshaphat nye n’egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no kãa n’egyanom ho wɔ David kurow mu: Na ne babanyin Jehoram dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
Na onyaa enuanom Jehoshaphat mbabanyin, Azariah, na Jehiel, na Zechariah, na Azariah, na Michael, na Shephatiah: Woyinom nyinara Israelhen Jehoshaphat ne mba a.
Na hɔn egya maa hɔn akyɛdze kɛsenara, dwetɛ, na sika, na ndzɛmba a ɔsom bo, ɔnye Judah mu nkurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban: Na ahendzi no dze, ɔdze maa Jehoram osiandɛ ɔno nye abakan.
Afei aber a Jehoram soɛree baa n’egya n'ahendzi no do, na ɔhyɛɛ noho dzen no, nna ɔdze afõwa kunkum no nuanom no nyinara, na Israel mbapɔmba no mu binom so.
Aber a Jehoram hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduasa ebien; na odzii hen mfe awɔtwe wɔ Jerusalem.
Na ɔnantseew Israel ahemfo kwan do, dɛ mbrɛ Ahab fi yɛe no: Osiandɛ onyaa Ahab ne babaa waar no: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do.
Naaso Ewuradze ammpɛ dɛ ɔsɛɛ David fi no, osian ahyɛmu a ɔnye David edzi no ntsi, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ anohoba dɛ ɔbɛma ɔno na ne mba kandzea dabaa no.
Ne nda mu na Edom tseew etūa fii Judah nsaadze, na wɔkɛhyɛɛ hɔnara hɔn do hen.
Nna Jehoram nye n’asafohemfo, na ne ntseaseanam nyinara kã no ho twaa mu kɔree: Na ɔsoɛɛr anago, na okunkum Edomfo a woetwa no ho ehyia, na ntseaseanam do asafohemfo no.
Nna Edom tseew etūa fii Judah ne nsaadze, dze bodu ndɛ da yi: Nna Libnah so tseew etūa mber no ara mu fii ne nsaadze: Osiandɛ wɔapow Ewuradze, n'egyanom Nyankopɔn no ntsi.
Nkyii so oyiyii mbea sorɔnsorɔm wɔ Judah mbepɔw no do, na ɔyɛɛ Jerusalem atsefo no ma wɔkɔr ndwamanyɛ mu, na ɔmaa Judah tɔɔ gon.
Na nkyerɛwee bi fi nkɔnhyɛnyi Elijah hɔ baa ne nkyɛn baa, dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze w'egya David ne Nyankopɔn se nye yi, osiandɛ ɔwo annantsew w'egya Jehoshaphat akwan do, na Judahhen Asa akwan do;
na mbom anantsew Israel ahemfo akwan do, na ayɛ Judah na Jerusalem atsefo ma wɔakɔ ndwamanyɛ mu, dɛ mbrɛ Ahab fi yɛe no; na eso ekuku wo nuanom a wofi w'egya fie a woye sen ɔwoara no ntsi:
Hwɛ, Ewuradze dze owuyar kɛse bɔbɔ wo man, na wo mba, na wo yernom, na w’ahodze nyinara:
Na ɔwoara so ɔnam wo yafun mu yarba do ibenya yarba son ekodu dɛ osian yarba no ntsi w’ayamudze botu egu daa nyina.
Na Ewuradze nunuu Philistiafo, na Arabiafo a wɔwɔ Ethiopiafo nkyɛn no hɔn sunsum tsiaa Jehoram:

Na wɔfowee baa Judah do, na wɔtseew mu, na wɔsosoo ahodze a wohun no wɔ ɔhen no ne fie no nyinara, na ne mbabanyin so, na ne yemom kɔree; ma dɛm ntsi ɔannka ɔbabanyin biara amma no, gyedɛ Jehoahaz, ne mbabanyin mu ekumaba no.
Na iyi nyinara ekyir no Ewuradze dze yarba a onnyi edur bɔɔ no wɔ n’ayamudze mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, mber guu mu, mfe ebien n’ewiei no, nna osian ne yarba no ntsi n’ayamudze tui gui, na owuu yarba bɔn mu. Na ne man annhyew ɔhyew bi amma no a ɔtse dɛ n’egyanom ɔhyew no.

Aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduasa ebien, na odzii hen mfe awotwe wo Jerusalem: Na ɔkɔr dɛ ɔnnyɛ obiara asɛm; na wosiee no wɔ David kurow mu, na nnyɛ ahemfo no hɔn asamandan no mu bi a.
22: Na Jerusalem atsefo no yɛɛ ne ba ekumaba Ahaziah ɔhen hyɛɛ n’ananmu: Osiandɛ mbarimba kuw a wɔnye Arabiafo no baa nseraban no mu no kunkum mpanyin no nyinara. Nna Judahhen Jehoram ne ba Ahaziah dzii hen.
Aber a Ahaziah hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduanan ebien; na odzii hen afrenhyia wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Athaliah, Omri ne babaa a.
Ɔno so ɔnantseew Ahab n akwan do: Osiandɛ ne nã nye ne pamfo a ɔmaa ɔyɛɛ emumuyɛ.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ Ahab fi yɛe no: Osiandɛ n'egya no wu ekyir no hɔn na wɔbɛyɛɛ n'apamfo dze maa ne nsɛɛe.
Hɔn apam so ekyir na ɔnantsewee, na ɔnye Israelhen Ahab ne ba Jehoram tuu sa wɔ Syriahen Hazael do wɔ Hamoth-gilead: Na Syriafo no piraa Joram.

Na ɔsanee baa Jezreel dɛ ɔrebɛyɛ n’epirakur a, aber a ɔnye Syriahen Hazael rokõ no a wopiraa no wɔ Ramah no edur. Na Judahhen Jehoram ne ba Azariah sii mu kɔr dɛ ɔrokɔhwɛ Ahab ne ba Jehoram wɔ Jezreel, osiandɛ ɔyar.
Afei Ahaziah ne nsɛɛe fi Nyankopɔn hɔ, wɔ dɛ osii mu kɔr Joram nkyɛn: Osiandɛ aber a odurii no, nna ɔnye Jehoram fiir edzi kɔr Nimshi ne ba Jehu a Ewuradze asera no dɛ ontwa Ahab ne fi do no do.
