Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jehu rubu Ahab fi atsɛn no, nna okohun Judah asafohemfo, na Ahaziah no nuanom mbabanyin no dɛ wɔrosom Ahaziah, na okunkum hɔn.

Na ɔhwehwɛɛ Ahaziah, na wɔkyeer no, (afei na oesuma noho wɔ Samaria), na wɔdze no brɛɛ Jehu, na wokum no; na wosiee no, na wɔsee dɛ, Jehoshaphat a ɔdze n’akoma nyinara hwehwɛɛ Ewuradze no ne ba nye no. Na Ahaziah fie ennya tum dɛ ɔdze bosuo ahendzi no mu.
Afei aber a Ahaziah ne nã Athaliah hun dɛ ne ba ewu no, nna ɔsoɛree na ɔsɛɛ Judah fie adehye asefo no nyinara.

Na ɔhen no ne babaa Jehoshabeath faa Ahaziah ne ba Joash, na owiaa no fii ɔhen ne mba no a wokum hɔn no mu, na ɔdze ɔno na ne gyegyefo kɛhyɛɛ mpiakyir. Nna Jehoshabeath, ɔhen Jehoram ne babaa no, ɔsɔfo Jehoida ne yer no, (ɔyɛ Ahaziah n’akyerɛbaa ntsi) ɔdze no sumaa Athaliah, ma dɛm ntsi oennku no.
Na ɔnye hɔn wokosumaa Nyankopɔn ne fie mfe esia: Na Athaliah yɛɛ ɔhembaa wɔ asaase no do.
23: Na afe a otsia esuon no mu no Jehoiada hyɛɛ noho dzen, na ɔfaa ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo, Jeroham ne ba Azariah, na Jehohanan ne ba Ishmael, na Obed ne ba Azariah, na Adaiah ne ba Maaseiah, na Zichri ne ba Elishaphat, ma wɔnye no dzii ahyɛmu.
Na wokekyiin Judah mu, na wohyiahyiaa Judah nkurow no nyinara mu Levifo no, na Israel egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir no, na wɔbaa Jerusalem.
Na mboanofo no nyinara nye ɔhen no dzii ahyɛmu wɔ Nyankopɔn fie. Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hwɛ, ɔhen ne ba no na obedzi hen, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze akã no wɔ David mba ho no.
Adze a hom nyɛ nye yi: Hom mu nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor a ɔba mu ahomgyeda no, wofi asɔfo na Levifo no mu no, na wɔnyɛ mbobowanoahwɛfo;
na nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor so ntsena ɔhen no ne fie; na nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor so ntsena fapem no no nkuropon no ano: Na ɔman no nyinara ngyina Ewuradze fie abangua no do.
Na mma mma obiara nnhɛn Ewuradze ne fie no mu, gyedɛ asɔfo no na Levifo no mu hɔn a wɔsom no; hɔn na wɔnhɛn mu, osiandɛ wɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn: Na ɔman no nyinara dze, wɔnhwɛ Ewuradze ne fie do ahwɛdze no.
Na Levifo no mbɔ ɔhen no ho aprɔw, nyimpa biara mfa n’akodze nkitsa ne nsamu; na obiara a ɔbɛba ofi no mu no, wɔmma wonku no: Na hom ndzi ɔhen no nkyɛn aber a ɔreba fie, na aber a orupue.

Nna Levifo na Judah nyinara yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɔfo Jehoiada hyɛe no nyinara: Na wɔfefaa nyimpa biara ne nyimpa, hɔn a wɔwɔ dɛ wɔba mu ahomgyeda no, kãa hɔn a wɔwɔ dɛ wofir edzi ahomgyeda no ho; osiandɛ ɔsɔfo Jehoiada ammpon nkyekyɛmu no.
Na ɔsɔfo Jehoiada yiyii mpeaa na akyɛm akɛse na akyɛm nkakraba a ɔyɛ ɔhen David dze no a ɔwɔ Ewuradze fie no, memaa ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no.
Na ɔdze ɔman nonyinara gymagyinae, nyimpa biara n’akodze kitsa ne nsamu, ofi dan no n’enyimfa afamu kodu dan no n'abankum afamu, wɔ afɔrmbukyia no na dan no ho, bɔɔ ɔhen no ho aprɔw.
Nna wɔdze ɔhen ne ba no fiir edzi, na wɔdze ahenkyɛw no soaa no, na wɔdze dase no maa no, na wɔhyɛɛ no hen: Na Jehoiada na ne mba seraa no; na wɔsee dɛ, Nyame ngye ɔhen nkwa.
Na aber a Athaliah tsee ɔman no a worututu mbirika na woriyi ɔhen ayɛw no ne gyigyeegye no, nna ɔbaa ɔman no nkyɛn wɔ Ewuradze fie:

Na ɔhwɛe, na hwɛ, ɔhen no gyina no dum no ho, wɔ ahɛnee, na asafohemfo no mbɛn no wɔ ɔhen no nkyɛn; na asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyinara enyi gyee, na wɔhɛɛn mbɛn; adwontofo no so goree wɔ nsanku ndzɛmba do, na wɔkyerɛɛ ayɛyi adwontow no. Nna Athaliah tsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔsee dɛ, nkɔnkɔnsa o, nkɔnkɔnsa o.

Na ɔsɔfo Jehoiada dze ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no a wɔhwɛ dɔm no do no puei, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa no mfa akyerɛpɛn no ntamu; na nyia obedzi n’ekyir no, wɔmma wɔmfa afõwa nku no: Na ɔsɔfo no see dɛ, mma wonnku no wɔ Ewuradze fie.
Nna wɔmaa no kwan; na osii mu kɔr mpɔnkɔ ahɛnee aponkɛse no ano kɔr ahemfie: Na wokum no wɔ hɔ.
Na Jehoiada dzii ahyɛmu wɔ ɔnoara, na ɔman no nyinara, na ɔhen no ntamu, dɛ wɔnyɛ Ewuradze ne man.
Na ɔman no nyinara sii mu kor Baal fie kobubuu no gui, na wobubuu n’afɔrmbukyia na n’ehonyi no esinesin, na wokum Baal no sɔfoe Mattan wɔ afɔrmbukyia no enyim.

Na Jehoiada hyehyɛɛ Ewuradze ne fi do ahwɛdofo dze hyɛɛ asɔfo no nsa, Levifo no a David kyekyɛɛ hɔn mu sisii Ewuradze ne fi do, dɛ wɔmbɔ Ewuradze ne hyew-afɔr no nsa, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses mbra no mu no, wɔdze enyigye na adwontow, dɛ mbrɛ David ne nhyehyɛɛ tse no.
Na ɔdze mbobow-anoahwɛfo no gyinagyinaa Ewuradze fi mbobotsen no ano, amma obi a no ho egu fi wɔ adze biara mu aannhɛn mu.

Na ɔfaa ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo, na ekunyin no, na ɔman no do ambradofo, na asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyinara na wɔdze ɔhen no fi Ewuradze fie sianee: Na wɔnam sor abobotsen no mu baa ɔhen no ne fie, na wɔdze ɔhen no tsenaa ahendzi ahengua no do.
Nna asaase no do nkorɔfo nyinara enyi gyee, na kurow no mu dwee: Na wɔdze afõwa kum Athaliah.
24: Aber a Joash hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe esuon; na odzii hen mfe eduanan wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Zibiah, ofi Beer-sheba.
Na Joash yɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do wɔ ɔsɔfo Jehoiada ne nda nyinara mu.
Na Jehoiada waar yernom beenu maa no; na ɔwowoo mbabanyin na mbabaa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, iyi ekyir no, Joash nyaa adwen dɛ ɔbɛdan Ewuradze ne fi no fofor.

Na ɔpoon asɔfo na Levifo no hyiae, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mfir edzi nkɔ Judah nkurow do, na hom nkɔboaboa sika ano wɔ Israel nyinara hɔ dɛ hom dze rebɛyɛ hom Nyankopɔn fi no yie afrenhyia afrenhyia, na hom nhwɛ ma adze no nyɛ harhar. Naaso Levifo no amma annyɛ har.
Na ɔhen no frɛɛ otsitsir Jehoiada, na ɔsee no dɛ ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na emmbisa Levifo no dɛ wɔngyegye Judah na Jerusalem tow a Ewuradze n'akowaa Moses, na Israel mboanofo no hyɛe maa dasebuw no mmba?
Na Athaliah, ɔbaa bɔn no, ne mba ebubu Nyankopɔn fi no mu; na Ewuradze fie ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn nyinara so wɔahwer no ama Baalim.
Nna ɔhen no hyɛe ma wɔpaam adaka bi, na wɔdze sii Ewuradze fi abotsen no ano guado.
Na wɔbɔɔ dawur faa Judah na Jerusalem, dɛ wɔmfa Nyankopɔn n’akowaa Moses tow a ɔdze too Israel do wɔ sar no do no mbrɛ Ewuradze.
Na mbapɔmba no nyinara na ɔman no nyinara enyi gyee, na wɔdze bae boguu adaka no mu araa kodur dɛ wowiei.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, mber du ma wɔdze adaka no nam Levifo no nsa do ba ɔhen no n’efiadze, na sɛ wohu dɛ sika no dɔɔ sõ a, nna ɔhen ne kyerɛwfo na nyia ɔsɔfopanyin no hyɛɛ no dɛ ɔnhwɛ do no ba na wohue no wɔ adaka no mu, na wɔma do soa kesi ne sibew bio. Dɛm na wɔyɛɛ no daa nyina, na wɔboaboaa sika piigyan ano.

Na ɔhen no na Jehoiada dze maa hɔn a wɔyɛ Ewuradze fi som edwuma no; na wɔdze bobɔɔ abopaafo na nduadwimfo paa dɛ wɔndan Ewuradze ne fi no fofor, na hɔn a wɔyɛ dadze na boran dwuma no so dɛ wommiamia Ewuradze ne fi no mu.
Nna edwumafo no yɛɛ edwuma, na hɔn na wowiee edwuma no yɛ, na wɔdze Nyankopɔn ne fi no gyinaa ne gyinabew, na wɔhyɛɛ no dzen.

Na aber a wowiei no, nna wɔdze sika no nkaa baa ɔhen no na Jehoiada enyim, ɔno na wɔdze yeyɛɛ ndzɛmba-ndzɛmba maa Ewuradze ne fi no, mekyerɛ ndzɛmbandzɛmba a wɔdze som, na wɔdze bɔ afɔr, ntser, na sika na dwetɛ ndzɛmba no. Na wɔbɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze fi no mu daa wɔ Jehoiada ne nda nyinara mu.
Na Jehoiada yɛɛ akɔdaa na odzii nda pii, na owui; aber a owui no na oedzi mfe ɔha eduasa.
Na wokesiee no David kurow mu wɔ ahemfo no mu, osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ papa wɔ Israel mu, na Nyankopɔn na ne fi no ho afamu.
Afei Jehoiada no wu ekyir ho Judah mbapɔmba no bae, na wɔbɛyɛɛ ɔhen no enyidzi. Nna ɔhen no tsiee hɔn.
Na wɔpoow Ewuradze hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no, ne fi no, na wɔkɔsoom Asherim na abosom no: Na ebufuw baa Judah na Jerusalem do wɔ hɔn asodzi yi ntsi.
Naaso ɔsomaa nkɔnhyɛfo ma wɔkɔr hɔn nkyɛn, dɛ wɔnkɛsan hɔn mbra Ewuradze nkyɛn bio; na wodzii dase tsiaa hɔn: Na wɔammpɛ dɛ wɔma aso.

Na Nyankopɔn no sunsum baa ɔsɔfo Jehoiada ne ba Zechariah do; na okegyinaa ɔman no do, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ Nyankopɔn se nye yi, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom tõ Ewuradze ne mbransɛm, ma hom nntum nnyɛ prɔmprɔm yi? Osiandɛ hom apow Ewuradze ntsi, ɔno so ɔapow hom.
Na wɔpaam ne tsir do, na wokesiiw no abo dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm tse wɔ Ewuradze fie abangua no do.
Dɛm na ɔhen Joash annkaa adɔyɛ a n’egya Jehoiada dze yɛɛ no no, na okum ne ba no. Na aber a owui no, ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze nhwɛ na ombisa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ afe no n’ewiei no, nna Syriafo dɔm baa no do: Na wɔbɔɔ Judah na Jerusalem, na wɔbɛsɛɛ ɔman no hɔn asafohemfo nyinara, na wɔdze hɔn asadze no nyinara kɛmaa Damascushen no.
Na Syriafo dɔm no dze nyimpa kuw kakraabi bae, na Ewuradze dze dɔmtutuw kɛsenara hyɛɛ hɔn nsa, osiandɛ wɔapow Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no. Nna wobuu Joash atsɛn.

Na aber a wofi ne nkyɛn sii mu no, (osiandɛ wogyaa no wɔ yarba son mu), nna nankasa no nkowaa paam ne tsir do wɔ ɔsɔfo Jehoiada ne mba hɔn bɔgyaa no ntsi, na wokokum no wɔ ne mpa do, na owui: Na wosiee no wɔ David kurow mu, na woennsie no wɔ ahemfo hɔn asamandan no mu.
Na woyinom nye hɔn a wɔpaam ne tsir do no, Ammonnyi Shimeath ne ba Zabad, na Moabnyi Shimrith ne ba Jehozabad.

Afei ɔfa ne mba no, na adzesoadze a ɔdeda no do ne kɛse, na Nyankopɔn ne fi ne mmiamia mu ho no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ ahemfo nwoma ne nkyerɛkyerɛase no mu. Na ne babanyin Amaziah dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
25: Aber a Amaziah hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no na oedzi mfe eduonu enum; na odzii hen mfe eduonu akron wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Jehoaddan, ofi Jerusalem.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do, naaso ɔnndze akoma a odzi mu.
Afei ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wotsiim ahendzi no maa no no, nna okunkum no nkowaa a wokum n egya ohen no.

Na hɔn mba dze, woennkuku hɔn, mbom ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no mbra no mu wɔ Moses no nwoma no mu, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛe no, dɛ, Egyanom runnwu wɔ mba ntsi, nkyii so mba runnwu wɔ egyanom ntsi; na mbom nyimpa biara bowu wo nankasa no bɔn ntsi.

Nkyii so Amaziah poon Judah hyiae, na ɔhyehyɛɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efiefi tsetsee, wɔ mpem do asafohemfo na ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo ase, mekyerɛ Judah na Benjamin nyinara: Na ɔkaan hɔn fi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir do, na ohun dɛ wɔyɛ mbarimba a woasan mu eyi hɔn mpemahaasa a wotum ɔsa tu a, wobotum esuo peaa na kyɛm mu.
Eso ɔdze dwetɛ talent ɔha bɔɔ Israel mu mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam mpemɔha paa.
Na Nyame nyimpa bi baa ne nkyɛn, dɛ, ɔhen, mma mma Israel dɔm no nnye wo nnkɔ; osiandɛ Ewuradze nndzi Israel ekyir, ɔnye dɛ, onndzi Ephraimmba no nyinara ekyir.
Na mbom sɛ ɔwoara bɔkɔ a, nna yɛ mbanyindze, na hyɛ dzen wɔ ɔkõ no mu: Ɔno Nyankopɔn bɛma ahwe ase wɔ atamfo no enyim; osiandɛ Nyankopɔn wɔ tum a ɔdze bɔboa, na ɔdze bɛma obi ahwe ase.
Na Amaziah see Nyame nyimpa no dɛ, na talent ɔha a medze mama Israel dɔm no yɛnyɛ no dɛn? Na Nyame nyimpa no buaa dɛ, Ewuradze yɛ otumfo dɛ ɔbɛma wo dza ɔdɔɔ sõ sen iyi.
Na Amaziah yiyii hɔn, ɔnye dɛ, oyii dɔm a wofi Ephraim baa ne nkyɛn no, dɛ wɔnsan nkɔ fie: Dɛm ntsi hɔn ebufuw dzɛɛw kɛsenara wɔ Judah do, na wɔsanee kɔr fie wɔ ebufuhyew mu.
Na Amaziah nyaa akokodur, na ɔdze no nkorɔfo no sii mu kɔr nkyen bɔnsa no mu, na okokum Seirmba no mu nyimpa mpemdu.
Na Judahmba no faa hɔn mu mpemdu so enyikan kɔree, na wɔdze hɔn baa ɔbotan no etsifi, na wɔtotoow hɔn fi ɔbotan no n’etsifi hwehwee famu, ma hɔn nyinara hɔn mu tsetseew esinesin.

Na dɔm no mu nyimpa no a Amaziah maa wɔsanee, dɛ mma mma wɔnnye no nkɔ ɔsa no, kotui hyɛɛ Judah nkurow do, dze fi Samaria araa kodur Beth-horon, na wokunkum hɔn mu nyimpa mpensa na wɔfaa asadze piigyan.
Afei ɔbaa dɛ, n’ekyir no a Amaziah fi Edomfo nkumii no bae no, nna ɔdze Seirmba enyame bae, na ɔdze hon besisii hɔ dɛ wɔnyɛ n’enyame, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ hɔn enyim, na ɔhyeew eduhuam maa hɔn.

Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze n’ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ Amaziah do, na ɔsomaa nkɔnhyɛnyi ma ɔbaa ne nkyɛn a ɔbɛsee no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ahwehwɛ ɔman bi enyame a woenntum ennyi hɔnankasa hɔn man emmfi wo nsamu no ekyir kwan yi?

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔnye no rekasa no nna ɔhen no see no dɛ, ana yɛahyɛ wo ɔhen n’apamfo bi a? Gyaa; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na woboku wo? Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi no gyaa, na ɔsee dɛ, muhu dɛ Nyankopɔn esua dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ wo, osiandɛ ɔwo ayɛ iyi, na enntsie m’apam ntsi.
Nna Judahhen Amaziah gyee apam, na ɔsomae ma wɔkɔr Israelhen Joash, Jehoahaz ne ba no, Jehu ne ba no nkyɛn dɛ, bra, ma yendzi enyimhu nkorkor.

Na Israelhen Joash somae ma wɔkɔr Judahhen Amaziah nkyɛn, dɛ, kɔkrɔnsoɛ a ɔwɔ Lebanon do no somae ma wɔkɔr cedar a ɔwɔ Lebanon do no nkyɛn, dɛ, fa wo babaa ma me babanyin ayewar: Na abowa bɔyafo bi a ɔwɔ Lebanon do botwaa mu, na otsiatsiaa kɔkrɔnsoɛ no do.
ɔwo ese dɛ, hwɛ, ɔwoara eku Edom; na w’akoma ama wo do dɛ irutwa mpoa: Afei tsena fie; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edze woho rebɛgyegye mu ama wo mbusu, ma aahwe ase yi, mekyerɛ ɔwo, na Judah kã wo ho?
Na Amaziah enntsie; osiandɛ ofi Nyankopɔn hɔ, ma oeeyi hɔn ahyɛ hɔn atamfo nsa, osiandɛ, wɔahwɛ hwɛ Edom enyame no n’ekyir kwan.
Nna Israelhen Joash sii mu kɔree; na ɔno na Judahhen Amaziah wodzii enyimhu wɔ Beth-shemesh a ɔyɛ Judah dze no.
Na wɔbɔɔ Judah gui wɔ Israel enyim; na woguanguanee, nyimpa biara kɔr n'asesee mu.

Na Israelhen Joash kyeer Judahhen Amaziah, Jehoahaz ba Joash ba no, wɔ Beth-shemesh, na ɔdze no baa Jerusalem, na obobubuu Jerusalem fasu no fi Ephraim kuropon ho dze kodur kutuwdo kuropon no ho, basafa ahaanan.
Na ɔfaa sika na dwetɛ nyinara, na ndzɛmba-ndzɛmba nyina a wohun no wɔ Nyankopɔn ne fie wɔ Obed-edom nkyɛn no nyinara, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze no, adɔmhobafo no so, na ɔsanee kɔr Samaria.
Na Judahhen Amaziah, Joash ba no dzii mfe duenum wɔ Israelhen Joash, Jehoahaz ne ba no, no wu ekyir.
Afei Amaziah no ho nsɛm nkaa no, kan dze na ekyir dze no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judah na Israel ahemfo nwoma no mu?
Afei ofitsi mber a Amaziah sanee fii Ewuradze ekyir dzi no, nna wɔpaam ne tsir do wɔ Jerusalem; na oguanee kɔr Lachish, na wokokum no wɔ hɔ.
Na wɔdze no too mpɔnkɔ do bae, na wosiee no kãa n'egyanom ho wɔ Judah kurow no mu.
26: Na Judah ɔman no nyinara faa Uzziah oedzi mfe duesia, na wɔhyɛɛ no hen wɔ n'egya Amaziah n'ananmu.
Ɔno na ɔkyekyeer Eloth, na ɔdanee maa Judah, n'ekyir no ɔhen no nye n'egyanom kɛdae.
Aber a Uzziah ridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe duesia; na odzii hen mfe eduonum ebien wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Jechiliah, ofi Jerusalem.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ n'egya Amaziah yɛe no nyinara.
Na ɔdze sii n'enyi do dɛ ɔrohwehwɛ Nyankopɔn wɔ Zechariah a ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn maa ɔyɛɛ prɔmpɔm.
Na ofiir edzi nye Philistiafo kɔkõe, na obubuu Gath fasu, na Jabueh fasu, na Ashdod fasu no; na ɔkvekyeer nkurow wɔ Ashdod man mu, na Philistiafo no mu.
Na Nyankopɔn buae tsiaa Philistiafo no, na Arabiafo a wɔtsetse Gur-baal, na Meunifo no.
Na Ammonfo dze akyɛdze brɛɛ Uzziah: Na ne dzin tahyee araa dze kodur Egypt ahɛnee mu mpo; osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ dzen mbordo.
Nkyii so Uzziah totoow aban atsentsen wɔ Jerusalem wɔ kutuwdo kuropon no ho, na bɔnsa mu nkuropon no ho, na fasu no no mponee no ho, na ɔhyehyɛɛ no dzen.

Na ɔtotoow aban atsentsen wɔ sar no do, na otutuu nsubura pii, osiandɛ ɔwɔ mbowakuw pii wɔ ɔbɔn no mu na tɛtɛr no mu: Na ɔwɔ ekuafo na wenyin turehwɛfo wɔ mbepɔw no do, na nhaban-ber no mu; osiandɛ ɔpɛ ekuayɛ.

Nkyii so Uzziah ɔwɔ mbarimba Ekuafo dɔm a, wotu sa ekuw mu ekuw mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkanee a wɔnam ɔkyerɛwfo Jeiel na ɔhwɛdofo Maaseiah do kanee no no dodow tsetsee, wɔ ɔhen no n’asafohemfo no mu baako, Hananiah, ne nsaadze.
Egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir, mekyerɛ mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam nyinara, hɔn dodow yɛ mpemebien ahaesia.
Na hɔn nsaadze na dɔm a wɔatsetse hɔn, mpemahaasa na mpemesuon ahaenum a wɔdze tum kɛse yɛ sa, dze boaa ɔhen no tsiaa atamfo no.
Na Uzziah siesiee akyɛm, na mpeaa, na ndadzekyɛw, na ndadzentar, na ngyen, na tsiabo abo, maa hɔn, mekyerɛ wɔdze maa dɔm no nyinara.

Na ɔyɛɛ mfir a ɔyɛ edwimfo pa edwin wɔ Jerusalem, dɛ onsisi aban atsentsen do na akoban do, ma wɔmfa ntotow egyen-menaba na abo akɛse nyina. Na ne dzin tahyee kɔr ekyirkyir; osiandɛ wɔboaa no nwanwa mu araa kodur dɛ oyɛɛ dzen.

Na aber a ɔyɛɛ dzen no, nna n’akoma maa do ma ɔbɔɔ ɔbrafun, na ɔyɛɛ bɔn tsiaa Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn; osiandɛ ɔnoara sii mu kɔr Ewuradze n’asɔrdan no mu dɛ ɔrekɛhyew eduhuam wɔ eduhuamhyew afɔrmbukyia no do.
Na ɔsɔfo Azariah dzii n’ekyir kɛhɛɛn mu, na Ewuradze n’asɔfoe eduowɔtwe, mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam, kã no ho:

Na wosiiw ɔhen Uzziah kwan, na wɔsee no dɛ, Uzziah, ɔnnyɛ ɔwo wodze, dɛ ebɛhyew eduhuam ama Ewuradze, na mbom Aaronmba asɔfo no a wɔayɛ hɔn krɔnkrɔn dɛ wɔnhyew eduhuam no na hɔndze a: Fi krɔnkrɔn-bea yi do ha fi, na ayɛ bɔn; nkyii so ɔrennyɛ w’enyidzii wɔ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn enyim.

Nna Uzziah no bo fuwii; na eduhuamhyew adze no dze ne nsamu dɛ ɔdze rebɛhyew eduhuam; na aber a no bo fuuw asɔfo no, kwata fifiir no momapɔw do wɔ asɔfo no enyim wɔ Ewuradze ne fie hɔ, wɔ eduhuamhyew afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn.
Na ɔsɔfopanyin Azariah, na asɔfo no nyinara, hwɛɛ no, na, hwɛ, ɔayar kwata wɔ no momapɔw do, na wosunsuun no fii hɔ ntsɛmara; nyew, ɔnoara so yɛɛ ntsɛm fiir edzi, osiandɛ Ewuradze abɔ no.

Na ɔhen Uzziah yɛɛ ɔkwatanyi dze kodur no wu da, na ɔkɛtsenaa nkyɛn ofi bi mu, ɔyɛ ɔkwatanyi ntsi; osiandɛ woetwa no efi Ewuradze fie: Na ne ba Jotham na ɔhwɛɛ ɔhen ne fidua no do, dɛ obuu asaase no do nkorɔfo no atsɛn.
Afei Uzziah no ho nsɛm nkaa no, kan dze na ekyir dze no, Amoz ne ba nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah kyerɛwee.
Nna Uzziah nye n’egyanom kɛdae; na wokesiee no n’egyanom nkyɛn wɔ haban mu esiei a ɔyɛ ahemfo dze no mu; na wɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ ɔkwatanyi: Na ne babanyin Jotham dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
27: Aber a Jotham hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no, nna oedzi mfe eduonu enum, na odzii hen mfe duesia wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nā ne dzin dze Jerushah, Zadok ne babaa a.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsɛn wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya Uzziah yɛe no nyinara tse: Naaso ɔannkɛhɛn Ewuradze n’asɔrdan no mu. Na ɔman no daa ho bɔɔ ɔbrafun.
Ɔno na osii Ewuradze fi abotsen sor dze no, na Ophel fasu no do so osii pii.
Nkyii so ɔkyekyeer nkurow wɔ Judah nkokodo nkurow mu, na ɔtotoow aban dzendzen na aban atsentsen wɔ kwaa mu.

Ɔnoara na ɔnye Ammonmba hen no so kõe, na odzii hɔn do nyim. Na afe no ara mu na Ammonmba no maa no dwetɛ talent ɔha, na ewifua esusudze mpemdu, na atoko so mpemdu. Dɛmara na Ammonmba no dze brɛɛ no wɔ afe a otsia ebien na ebiasa no mu so.
Nna Jotham bɛyɛɛ ɔkatakyi, osiandɛ ɔhyehyɛɛ n’akwan wɔ Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn enyim.
Afei Jotham no ho asɛm nkaa no na n’akodzi nyinara, na n’akwan no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel na Judah ahemfo nwoma no mu.
Aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu enum, na odzii hen mfe duesia wɔ Jerusalem.
Na Jotham nye n’egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no wɔ David kurow mu: Na ne babanyin Ahaz dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
28: Aber a Ahaz hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu; na odzii hen mfe duesia wɔ Jerusalem: Na ɔannyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze n’enyiwa do, dɛ n’egya David:
Mbom ɔnantseew Israel ahemfo akwan do, no so ɔyɛɛ ogu-ehonyi maa Baalim.
Nkyii so ɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ Hinnom ne ba bɔnsa no mu, na ɔhyeew ne mba wɔ ogya no mu, dɛ mbrɛ amanamamfo a Ewuradze tuu hɔn fii Israel enyim no hɔn ekyiwadze no tse.
Na ɔbɔɔ afor na ɔhyeew eduahuam wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do, na nkokodo na ndua momon biara ase.

Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn yii no hyɛɛ Syriahen nsa; na wɔkãa no gya, na wɔfaa ne nyimpa mu piigyan ndɔmmum, na wɔdze hɔn kɔr Damascus eso oyii no hyɛɛ Israelhen nsa, ɔno na ɔdze oku kɛse kãa no gya.
Na Remaliah ne ba Pekah kunkum Judah mu nyimpa mpemɔhaeduonu da kor, hɔn nyinara mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam a; osiandɛ wɔapow Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no ntsi.
Na Zichri, ɔbarimba katakyi bi a ofi Ephraim, okum ɔhen no ne ba Maaseiah, na ofi no do ɔhwɛfo Azrikam, na Elkanah a odzi hen n’ekyir no.
Na Israelmba no faa hɔn nuanom mu nyimpa mpemahaenu ndɔmmum, mbaa, mbabanyin, na mbabaa, na wɔfaa asadze so piigyan wɔ hɔn ho kɔree, na wɔdze asadze no kɔr Samaria.

Na Ewuradze no nkɔnhyɛnyi bi wɔ hɔ a ne dzin dze Oded: Ma ɔno na ofiir edzi kehyiaa dɔm a wɔbaa Samaria no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hwɛ, osiandɛ Ewuradze, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn no bo fuuw Judah ntsi, na ɔdze hɔn ahyɛ hom nsa, na hom dze ebufuw a ekodu ɔsor ekuku hɔn.
Na afei hom robɔ tsirmpɔw dɛ hom ribedzi Judah na Jerusalemmba no nya ayɛ nkowaa na mfonabaa ama homho: Ama homara so homankasa hom mbrato nndeda hom do wɔ hom Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn afamu bi a?
Dɛm ntsi afei hom ntsie me, na hom mma ndɔmmum a hom faa hɔn ndɔmmum wɔ hom nuanom mu no nsan nkɔ: Na Ewuradze n’ebufuhyew no wɔ hom do.
Nna Ephraimmba mu etsitsir no mu binom, Johanan ne ba Azariah, Meshillemoth ne ba Berechiah, na Shallum ne ba Jehizkiah, na Hadlai ne ba Amasa, soɛrsoɛree tsiaa hɔn a wofi ɔsa bae no,

na wɔsee hɔn dɛ, mma hom mmfa ndɔmmum no mmba ha: Na dza ɔdze asodzi a otsia Ewuradze bɛba hɛn do no ho na hom bɔ tsirmpɔw, ma wɔdze bi akã hɛn bɔn na hɛn asodzii ho: Na hɛn asodzii dɔɔ sõ, osiandɛ ebufuhyew wɔ Israel do.
Nna mbarimba a woemia no gyaa ndɔmmum na asadze no wɔ mbapɔmba na mboanofo no nyinara enyim.

Na mbarimba a woabobɔ hɔn edzin no soɛrsoɛree, na wɔfaa ndɔmmum no, na wɔdze asadze no bi furafuraa hɔn a wodzi adagyaw wɔ hɔn mu no, na wɔhyehyɛɛ hɔn ntar na wɔhyehyɛɛ hɔn mpaboa, na wɔmaa hɔn biribi ma wodzii na wɔnomee. Na wɔseraa hɔn, na wɔdze hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw wɔ hɔn mu no nyinara tsenatsenaa nsoaso do, na wɔdze hɔn baa Jericho, mbɛ kurow no mu, wɔ hɔn nuanom nkyɛn: Nna wɔsanee kɔr Samaria.
Aber no mu na ɔhen Ahaz somae ma wɔkɔr Assyria ahemfo no hɔ dɛ wɔmbɔboa no.
Osiandɛ Edomfo no baa bio bɛkãa Judah gya, na wɔfaa ndɔmmum kɔree.

Philistiafo no so ebotua ɔbɔnmu nkurow, na Judah Pomu afamu nkurow no, na wɔagye Beth-shemesh, na Aijalon, na Gederoth, na Soco nye no nkurobaase na Timnah nye no nkurobaase; Gimzo so na no nkurobaase: Na wɔtsenaa hɔ.
Na osian Israelhen Ahaz ntsi Ewuradze brɛɛ Judah adze; osiandɛ ɔayɛ Judah mu akɔhwidze, na ɔafom Ewuradze yayaayaw.
Na Assyriahen Tilgath-pilneser baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔbɛtseetsee no, na mbom ɔannhyɛ no dzen.
Na Ahaz faa Ewuradze ne fie, na ɔhen no na ahenmba fie adze na ɔdze maa Asyriahen no: Na iyi ammboa no biara.
Na n’ahohia mber mu no na mbom ɔfoom Ewuradze dodoodow, ɔhen Ahaz yi ara a.

Na ɔbɔɔ afɔr maa Damascus enyame a wɔkãa no gya no: Na ɔsee dɛ, osiandɛ Syria ahemfo hɔn enyame no boaa hon no ntsi, dɛm ntsi na mobɔbɔ afɔr ama hɔn, ma wɔaaboa me. Mbom wɔyɛɛ ɔno, na Israel nyinara hɔn nsɛɛe.
Na Ahaz boaboaa Nyankopɔn fie ndzɛmba no ano, na otwitwaa Nyankopɔn fie ndzɛmba no mu esinesin, na ɔtotoow Ewuradze fie mbobow no mu; na osisii afɔrmbukyia wɔ Jerusalem kutuw biara do.
Na oyiyii mbea sorɔnsorɔm wɔ Judah kurow biara mu, dɛ wɔnhyew eduhuam mma enyame fofor, na oyii Ewuradze n egyanom hɔn Nyankopɔn no ebufuw.
Afei no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na n’akwan nyinara, kan dze na ekyir dze no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Judah na Israel ahemfo nwoma no mu.
Na Ahaz nye n’egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no wɔ kurow no mu, mekyerɛ, Jerusalem mu; na wɔammfa no ammba Israel ahemfo hɔn asamandan no mu: Na ne babayin Hezekiah dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
29: Aber a Hezekiah hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu enum; na odzii hen mfe eduonu akron wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Abijah, Zechariah ne babaa a.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ dza n’egya David yɛe no tse nyinara.
Ɔno na n’ahendzi mu afe a odzi kan no mu, bosoom a odzi kan no mu no, obuebuee Ewuradze fie mbobow no, na omiamiaa mu.
Na ɔdze asɔfo na Levifo no bae, na ɔboaboaa hɔn kehyiaa boka afamu bea tɛtɛr no do,
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom ntsie me, hom Levifo; afei hom nyɛ homho krɔnkrɔn, na hom nyɛ Ewuradze, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn fi no krɔnkrɔn, na hom nyiyi efifidze no mfi bea krɔnkrɔn no do hɔ.
Na hɛn egyanom fomee, na wɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn enyiwa do, na wɔpoow no, na wɔdaan hɔn enyi fii Ewuradze ne tsenabew no ho, na wɔdaan hɔn ekyir maa no.
Eso wɔatotow nkrandaa no no mbobow no mu, na woedundum nkandzea no, na wɔannhyew eduhuam na wɔammbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr so wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn no do amma Israel Nyankopɔn no.
Dɛm ntsi na Ewuradze n’ebufuw baa Judah na Jerusalem do, na oyii hɔn maa dɛ wɔntotow hɔn ndzi akɔnaaba, wɔnyɛ anwanwadze, na nhwiromabɔ, dɛ mbrɛ homara hom dze hom enyiwa hu yi.
Na, hwɛ, hɛn egyanom atotɔr afõwa ano, na hɛn mbabanyin na hɛn mbabaa na hɛn yernom no, wɔwɔ ndɔmmum mu, wɔ iyi ntsi.
Afei ɔwɔ m’akoma mu dɛ menye Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, bedzi ahyɛmu, ma n’ebufuhyew no aadan efi hɛn do.
Me mba, afei mma hom nnyɛ akwadwer: Na Ewuradze asan mu eyi hom dɛ hom ngyina n’enyim nsom no, na hom nyɛ n’asomfo, na wɔnhyew eduhuam.

Nna Levifo no soɛree, Amasai ne ba Mahath, na Azariah ne ba Joel a wofi Kohathfo mba mu no: Na Merari ne mba mu, Abdi ne ba Kish, na Jehallelel ne ba Azariah: Na Gershonfo mu, Zimmah ne ba Joah, na Joah ne ba Eden:
Na Elizaphfo mba mu, Shimri na Jeuel: Na Asaph ne mba mu, Zechariah na Mathaniah:
Na Heman ne mba mu, Jehuel na Shimei: Na Jeduthun ne mba mu, Shemaiah na Uzziel.
Na wɔboaboaa hɔn nuanom ano, na wɔsaan hɔnho krɔnkrɔn, na wɔkɔree, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm a ɔnam Ewuradze n’asɛm do tse no, dɛ wɔrebɛpepa Ewuradze ne fi no mu.

Na asɔfo no kɛhɛɛn Ewuradze ne fi no mu afamu dɛ wɔrekɛprapra mu, na woyiyii efifidze no nyinara a wohun no wɔ Ewuradze n’asɔrdan no mu no dze baa Ewuradze ne fi no n’abangua no do. Na Levifo no sosoe fii hɔ, dɛ wɔrokɔtow egu ɔwora Kidron mu.

Afei bosoom a odzi kan no mu da a odzi kan no na wɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ wɔreyɛ krɔnkrɔn no, na bosoom no ne da a otsia awɔtwe no wɔbaa Ewuradze ne nkrandaa no ho; na wɔyɛɛ Ewuradze ne fi no krɔnkrɔn nda awɔtwe: Na bosoom a odzi kan no ne da a otsia duesia no na wowiei.

Nna wɔhɛɛn mu kɔr hen Hezekiah nkyɛn wɔ ahemfi no mu, na wɔsee dɛ, yɛaprapra Ewuradze ne fie hɔ nyinara, na ɔhyew afɔrmbukyia no, nye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara ho, na kyerɛpaanoo pon no, ɔnye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara ho.
Nkyii so ndzɛmba no nyinara a ɔhen Ahaz n’ahendzi no mu no ɔtowee gui wɔ aber a ɔtõo mbra no, yeesiesie na yɛayɛ no krɔnkrɔn; na, hwɛ ɔwowɔ Ewuradze n’afɔrmbukyia no enyim.
Nna ɔhen Hezekiah soɛɛr ahanamakye, na ɔboaboaa kurow no mu asafohemfo no ano, na osii mu kɔr Ewuradze ne fie.

Na wɔdze anantwisaa esuon, na ndwanyin esuon, na nguambaa esuon, na mpɔnkyenyin esuon, bae wɔ ahenman no na krɔnkrɔn-bea no na Judah ho bɔn ho afɔr ntsi. Na ɔhyɛɛ Aaron ne mba asɔfo no dɛ wɔmfa mbɔ afɔr wɔ Ewuradze n’afɔrmbukyia no do.

Na wokunkum anantwisaa no, na asɔfo no sɔɔw bɔgya no, na wɔdze petsee afɔrmbukyia no do: Na wokunkum ndwanyin no, na wɔdze bɔgya no petsee afɔrmbukyia no do: Wokunkum nguambaa no so, na wɔdze bɔgya no petsee afɔrmbukyia no do.
Na wɔdze hɔn ho afɔr mpɔnkyenyin piin ɔhen no na mboanofo no enyim; na wɔdze hɔn nsa guguu hɔn do:

Na asɔfo no kunkum hɔn, na wɔdze hɔn bɔgyaa no yɛɛ bɔn ho afɔr guu afɔrmbukyia no do, dɛ wɔdze repata ama Israel nyinara: Osiandɛ ɔhen no hyɛɛ dɛ ɔhyew-afɔr na bɔn ho afɔr no wɔmbɔ mma Israel nyinara.

Na ɔdze Levifo no gyinagyinaa Ewuradze ne fi no mu, wɔdzedze nkasaa, nye mbɛntaasanku, na ɔnye nsankutsen, dɛ mbrɛ David na ɔhen n’adzehunyi Gad, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Nathan mbrasɛm no tse: Na mbrasɛm no fi Ewuradze ho ɔnam no nkɔnhyɛfo do.
Na Levifo no dzedze David n’adwontow ndzɛmba no gyinagyinae, na asɔfo no so dzedze mbɛn.
Na Hezekiah hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr wɔ afɔr­mbukyia no do. Na aber a ɔhyew-afɔr no hyɛɛ ase no, nna Ewuradze no ndwom no, na ntotorobɛnto ɔnye Israelhen David n’asanku ndzɛmba no so hyɛɛ ase.
Na mboanofo no nyinara kotokotowee na adwontofo no toow ndwom, na mbɛnhɛmfo no hɛnee; iyi nyinara do araa dze kodur dɛ wowiee ɔhyew-afɔr no bɔ.
Na aber a wowiee afɔr no bɔ no, nna ɔhen no na hɔn a wohun hɔn wɔ ne nkyɛn no nyinara, bobɔɔ hɔn mu adze sɔree.
Nkyii so ɔhen Hezekiah na asafohemfo no hyɛɛ Levifo no dɛ wɔmfa David, na adzehunyi Asaph nsɛm no nyi Ewuradze ayɛw. Na wɔdze enyigye yii ayɛw, na wɔbobɔɔ hɔn tsir adze sɔree.

Nna Hezekiah buae see dɛ, afei hom etu homho esi nkyɛn ama Ewuradze, hom ntwe mpin, na hom mfa okum-afɔr na aseda-afɔr mbra Ewuradze fie. Na mboanofo no dze okum-afɔr na aseda-afɔr bae; na dodow a wɔwɔ ayamuyi akoma no dze ɔhyew-afɔr bae.
Na ɔhyew-afɔr a mboanofo no dze bae no n’ano si anantwisaa eduosuon, ndwanyin ɔha, na nguambaa ahaenu: Iyinom nyinara wɔdze bɔbɔɔ Ewuradze ɔhyew-afɔr.
Na etuhoakyɛ ndzɛmba no yɛ anantwi ahaesia na nguan mpemebiasa.

Na asɔfo no dze hɔn ho suar dodow, ma dɛm ntsi woenntum enngua ɔhyew-afɔr no nyinara: Dɛm ntsi hɔn nuanom Levifoɔ no boaa hɔn araa kodur dɛ wowie edwuma no, na so okodur dɛ asɔfo no yɛɛ hɔn ho krɔnkrɔn: Osiandɛ Levifo no wɔtsen wɔ akoma mu dodow na wɔyɛɛ hɔnho krɔnkrɔn seen asɔfo no.
Na eso ɔhyew-afɔr no dɔɔ sõ piigyan, nye asomdwee-afɔr ho seradze no, na ɔnye ɔnom-afɔr a ɔkã ɔhyew-afɔr biara ho no no. Nna wɔhyehyɛɛ Ewuradze fie ɔsom no pɛpɛɛper.
Na Hezekiah na ɔman no nyinara, hɔn enyi gyee, osian dza Nyankopɔn esiesie ama ɔman no ntsi: Osiandɛ adze no wɔyɛɛ no awerɛfir mu.
30: Na Hezekiah somae ma wɔkɔr Israel na Judah nyinara do, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛw nwoma so kɛmaa Ephraim na Manasseh, dɛ wɔmbra Ewuradze fie wɔ Jerusalem, mbedzi apaho no mma Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no.
Na ɔhen no, na n’asafohemfo na mboanofo a wɔwɔ Jerusalem nyinara faa apam, dɛ wobedzi apaho no wɔ bosoom a otsia ebien no mu.
Na woenntum enndzi no aber no mu, osiandɛ asɔfo no nnyae nnyɛɛ hɔnho krɔnkrɔn ma wɔnndɔɔ sõ, nkyii so ɔman no nnhyiahyiaa hɔnho nnkehyiaa Jerusalem.
Na asɛm no tsenee wɔ ɔhen no na mboanofo no nyinara enyiwa do.

Nna wɔhyɛɛ mom pintsinn dɛ wɔmbɔ dawur wɔ Israel nyinara mu, mfi Beer-sheba araa nkodu Dan, dɛ wɔmbra mbedzi apaho no mma Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no wɔ Jerusalem: Osiandɛ wonndzii no nyimpa dodow kɛse dɛm yi dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerew no.

Nna ɔman nwoma-asoafo no dze nwoma no a ofi ɔhen no na n’asafohemfo no hɔ no sii mu kɔree kekyiin Israel na Judah nyinara mu, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm no tse, dɛ, hom Israelmba, hom nsan mbra Ewuradze, Abraham, Isaac, na Israel Nyankopɔn no, nkyɛn, ma ɔno so aasan aba nkaa a wofii nsa guanee wɔ hom mu no a wofii Assyria ahemfo nsamu firii no nkyɛn.
Na mma hom nnyɛ dɛ hom egyanom, na hom nuanom a wɔfoom Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn, ma ogyaa hɔn mu maa ɔsɛɛ, dɛ mbrɛ hom hu yi.

Afei mma hom nnyɛ akɔnkyefo dɛ mbrɛ hom egyanom yɛe; mbom hom ngyaa homho mma Ewuradze, na hom nkɛhɛn no krɔnkrɔn-bea a ɔayɛ no krɔnkrɔn daa no, na hom nsora Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn, ma n’ebufuhyew no mfi hom do mfir.

Na sɛ hom san ba Ewuradze nkyɛn a, hom nuanom na hom mba benya mbɔbɔrhu wɔ hɔn a wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum no enyim, na wɔasan aba asaase yi do bio: Na Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn yɛ ɔdomfo na mbɔbɔrhufo, na onnkeyi n’enyi efi hon do, sɛ hom san ba ne nkyɛn a.
Nna ɔman nwoma-asoafo no twaa fi kurow mu kɔr kurow mu dze faa Ephraim na Manasseh man mu araa dze kodur Zebulun: Na wɔseresereew hɔn, na wosii hɔn atwetwe.
Naaso binom a wofi Asher na Manasseh na Zebulun mu brɛɛ hɔnho adze, na wɔbaa Jerusalem.
Judah mu so Nyankopɔn ne nsa baa hɔ dɛ ɔrema hɔn akoma kor, dɛ wondzi ɔhen no na asafohemfo no mbrasɛm a wɔnam Ewuradze n’asɛm do hyɛe no do.
Na nkorɔfo piinara behyiae wɔ Jerusalem dɛ wɔrebɛhyɛ epitsi fa no wɔ bosoom a otsia ebien no mu, mboanofo kɛsenara.
Na wɔsoɛree yiyii afɔrmbukyia a ɔwɔ Jerusalem no, na eduhuamhyew afɔrmbukyia no nyinara so woyiyii, na wɔkɔtowee guu ɔwora Kidron mu.
Nna wokunkum apaho no wɔ bosoom a otsia ebien no ne da a otsia duanan no: Na asɔfo no na Levifo no enyi tõe, na wɔyɛɛ hɔnho krɔnkrɔn, na wɔdze ɔhyew-afɔr baa Ewuradze ne fie.
Na wokegyinagyinaa hɔn gyinabew wɔ hɔn kyenan do, dɛ mbrɛ Nyame nyimpa Moses mbra no tse: Asɔfo no dze bɔgya no a wɔgyee no wɔ Levifo no nsamu no petsee.
Osiandɛ dodowara wɔ mboanofo no mu a wɔnnyɛɛ hɔnho krɔnkrɔn: Dɛm ntsi Levifo no na ɔdaa hɔn do dɛ wokuku apaho no dze ma obiara a no ho nntsew, ma wɔaayɛ hɔn krɔnkrɔn ama Ewuradze.

Na ɔman no mu nyimpa dodow, mekyerɛ nyimpa pii, Ephraim na Manasseh, Issachar na Zebulun mu ɔdodowara nntseew hɔnho, naaso wokwetsiir dza wɔakyerɛw no dzii apaho no. Na Hezekiah bɔɔ mpaa maa hɔn see dɛ, Ewuradze pa no mfa mfir obiara
a oesiesie n’akoma dɛ ɔrohwehwɛ Nyankopɔn, Ewuradze no, n’egyanom Nyankopɔn no, kaansa wɔnntseew noho dɛ mbrɛ krɔnkrɔn-bea ahoguar no tse mpo a.
Na Ewuradze tsiee Hezekiah, na ɔbɔɔ ɔman no esu.
Na Israelmba a wohun hɔn wɔ Jerusalem no, dze enyigye kɛse hyɛɛ epitsi fa no nda esuon: Na Levifo no na asɔfo dze asanku ndzɛmba dzendzen toow ndwom dze yii Ewuradze ayɛw daa daa.

Na Hezekiah kasaa akomatɔyamu mu kyerɛɛ Levifo no nyinara a wonyim Ewuradze no som ho nyansa yie. Nna wodzidzii wɔ afahyɛ no ase nda esuon no, wɔbobɔɔ asomdwee-afɔr, na wɔkamfoo Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no.
Na mboanofo no nyina faa apam dɛ wobedzi nda esuon fofor so: Na wɔdze enyigye dzii nda esuon so bio.
Na Judahhen Hezekiah maa mboanofo no afɔrbɔdze anantwisaa apem na nguan mpemesuon; na asafohemfo no so maa mboanofo no anantwisaa apem na nguan mpemdu: Na asɔfo dodowara yɛɛ hɔnho krɔnkrɔn.
Na Judah mboanofo no nyinara, nye asɔfo na Levifo no, na mboanofo no a wofi Israel bae no nyinara, na ahɔho a wofi Israel asaase do bae no, na hɔn a wɔtse Judah no, enyi gyee.
Nna enyigye kɛse baa Jerusalem: Osiandɛ ofi Israelhen David ne ba Solomon n’aber do no, ne saso mmba pɛn wɔ Jerusalem.
Nna asɔfo na Levifo no soɛree na wohyiraa ɔman no: Na wɔtsee hɔn ndze, na hɔn mpaabɔ dur ne tsenabea krɔnkrɔn, mekyerɛ ɔsor.
31: Afei aber a wowiee iyi nyinara no, Israel nyinara a wohun hɔn no fiir edzi kɔr Judah nkurow no mu, na wokobubuu edum no mu esinesin, na wotwitwaa Asherim no, na wodwuruuw mbea sorɔnsorɔm, na afɔrmbukyia no wɔ Judah na Benjamin nyinara, wɔ Ephraim na Manasseh mu so, kodur dɛ wɔsɛɛ ne nyinara. Nna Israelmba no nyinara sanee, nyimpa biara kɔr n’enyadze mu, wɔ hɔnankasa hɔn nkurow mu.

Na Hezekiah hyehyɛɛ asɔfo na Levifo nkyekyɛmu no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkyekyɛmu tsetsee, nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ no som tse, asɔfo no na Levifo no nyina, dze ma ɔhyew-afɔr na asomdwee-afɔr, dɛ wɔnsom na wɔnda ase, na wonyi ayɛw wɔ Ewuradze ne nseraban aponkɛse no mu.

Eso ɔhyɛɛ ɔhen no ne kyɛpɛn a ofi n’ahodze mu dze maa ɔhyew-afɔr no, ɔnye dɛ, anapa na ewimbir ɔhyew-afɔr no dze, na ahomgyeda, na abosoom fofor, na afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ, ɔhyew-afɔr no dze, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Ewuradze ne mbra nwoma no mu no.
Nkyii so ɔhyɛɛ nkorɔfoa wɔtse Jerusalem no dɛ wɔmfa asɔfo no na Levifo no hɔn kyɛfa no mma ma wɔdze hɔnho aama Ewuradze ne mbra no.

Na ntsɛmara a mbrasɛm no tahyee ara nna Israelmba no dze eburow, na nsã, na ngo, na ewo, na haban mu ndɔbaa nyinara mu nduadzewakan piigyan bae; na adze nyinara mu ebupɛn du du no so wɔdze baa piigyan.

Na Israel na Judah-mba a wɔtsetse Judah nkurow mu no hɔn so wɔdze anantwi na nguan mu ebupɛn du du, na ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn a wɔayɛ no krɔnkrɔn ama hɔn Ewuradze Nyankopɔn no ebupɛn du du no bae, na wɔdze guu hɔ ekuwekuw
Bosoom a otsīa ebiasa no mu wɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ wɔrotow ekuwekuw no ne fapem, na wowiei wɔ bosoom a otsia esuon no mu.
Na aber a Hezekiah na asafohemfo no bae bohun ekuwekuw no, nna wohyiraa Ewuradze, na ne man Israel.
Nna Hezekiah bisaa asɔfo na Levifo no ekuwekuw no ho asɛm.

Na osɔfo panyin Azariah a ofi Zadok fie no, obuae see dɛ, ofitsi dɛ ɔman no hyɛɛ ase dɛ wɔdze ayɛyɛdze reba Ewuradze ne fie no, yeedzidzi amee, na yeegyaa pii osiandɛ Ewuradze ehyira ne man; na dza ɔkãe no nye fiadze kɛse yi.
Nna Hezekiah hyɛɛ dɛ wonsiesie mpia wɔ Ewuradze ne fi no mu; na wosiesiei.
Na wɔdze ayɛyɛdze no, na ebupɛn du du no, na ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn bɛhyɛɛ mu nokwar mu ara: Na Levinyi Conaniah na ɔyɛ ɔpanyin wɔ do, na no nua Shimei dzi hɔ.

Na Jehiel, na Azaziah, na Nahath, na Asahel, na Jerimoth, na Jozabad, na Eliel, na Ismachiah, na Mahath, na Benaiah nye ahwɛdofo wɔ Conaniah na no nua Shimei nsaadze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen Hezekiah, na Nyankopɔn ne fi do ɔpanyin Azariah hyehyɛe no.
Na Levinyi Imnah ne ba Kore, boka kuropon ano ɔhwɛfo no, na ɔhwɛ Nyankopɔn n’ayamuyi ayɛyɛdze no do, dɛ ɔdze Ewuradze afɔrbɔdze, na krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn no bɛma.

Na ɔno n’ase na Eden, na Miniamin, na Jesbua, na Shemaiah, Amariah, na Shecaniah wɔ, wɔ asɔfo nkurow no mu, wɔ hɔn nokwardzi edwuma mu, dɛ wɔdze bɛma hɔn nuanom dɛ mbrɛ nkyekyɛmu no tsetsee no, ɔkɛse dze tse dɛ ekumaba dze:

Ɔsor hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn mbarimba ananakan do a, ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe ebiasa do dze rokɔ no. Mekyerɛ obiara a ɔhɛn Ewuradze n fie, dɛ mbrɛ da biara n’edwuma regye dɛ wɔbɔsom wɔ hɔn ahwɛdodze dɛ mbrɛ hon nkyekyɛmu tsetsee no;
na asɔfo no mu hɔn a wɔkaan ananakan do dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efiefi tsetsee, na Levifo no so ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu do dze roKɔ no, wɔ hɔn ahwɛdodze mu wɔ hɔn nkye kyɛmu do;
na hɔn mbofraba, hɔn yernom, na hɔn mbabanyin, na hɔn mbabaa nyinara mu hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn ananakan do, wɔ mboanofo no nyinara mu: Na hɔn nokwardzi edwuma no mu na wɔtseew hɔnho wɔ krɔnkrɔndze ho:

Eso Aaronmba asɔfo no a wɔwɔ hɔn nkurow no mfikyisaase do nhaban mu no, mbarimba a wɔabobɔ hɔn edzin, wɔwɔ kurow biara mu nkorkor, dɛ wɔmfa kyɛpɛn mma asɔfo no mu mbanyin, na hɔn a wɔkaan hon ananakan do wɔ Levifo no mu no nyinara.
Na dɛm na Hezekiah yɛe no wɔ Judah nyinara mu; na ɔyɛɛ dza oye na ɔtsen na ɔyɛ nokwar wɔ n’Ewuradze Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na edwuma biara a ɔhyɛɛ ase wɔ Nyankopɔn ne fie ɔsom no mu, na mbra no mu, na mbransɛm no mu, dɛ ɔrohwehwɛ ne Nyankopɔn no, ɔdze n’akoma nyina yɛe, na osii no yie.
32: Nsɛm yi, na nokwardzi yi ekyir no, Assyriahen Sennacherib bae na ɔbɛhɛɛn Judah, na ɔkyeer nsera wɔ kurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban no do, na ɔdween dɛ ɔbɛgye ama noho.
Na aber a Hezekiah hun dɛ Sennacherib aba, na oesua dɛ ɔnye Jerusalem robɔkõ no,
nna ɔnye ne mbapɔmba na ne mbarimba akatakyi faa apam dɛ wobesiw nsunyiwa a ɔwowɔ kurow no ekyir no; na wɔboaa no.
Nna nkorɔfo pii behyiae, na wosisiiw nsunyiwa no nyinara, na ɔwora no a ɔpem da asaase no ne finimfin no, dɛ, ɔbɛyɛ den na Assyria ahemfo bɛba ebonu nsu pii?
Na ɔhyɛɛ dzen, na ɔtoow fasu a ebubu no nyinara, na ɔmaa do kodur aban atsentsen no ho, na fasu fofor so wɔ kurow no ekyir, na ɔhyɛɛ Milio dzen wɔ David kurow mu, na ɔyeyɛɛ akodze na akyɛm piigyan.
Na ɔdze ɔsa mu asafohemfo sisii ɔman no do, na ɔpoon hɔn behyiaa ne nkyɛn wɔ kurow no no kuropon ano gua no do, na ɔkasaa akomatɔmu mu kyerɛɛ hɔn, dɛ,
hom nhyɛ homho dzen na wonnya akokodur, mma hom nsuro na eso hom abaw mu nntu wɔ Assyriahen no, na eso nyimpadodow a wɔkã no ho no ntsi: Ɔdodow wɔ hɛn nkyɛn sen ɔno:
Ɔno honam abasa na ɔnye no wɔ hɔ; na hɛndze, hɛn Ewuradze Nyankopɔn na ɔnye hɔn wɔ hɔ dɛ ɔbɔboa hɛn, na ɔaakõ hɛn kõ ama hɛn. Nna ɔman no dze hɔnho tweer Judahhen Hezekiah ne nsɛm no do.

Iyi ekyir no Assyriahen Sennacherib somaa no nkowaa ma wɔbaa Jerusalem, (afei na ɔnoara wɔ Lachish ho, na n’etumfo nyinara so kã no ho), Judahhen Hezekiah na Judah nyinara a wɔwɔ Jerusalem no nkyɛn, dɛ,
mbrɛ Assyriahen Sennacherib se nye yi, ebenadze do na hom enyi da, ma hom retsena ntuae yi mu wɔ Jerusalem yi?
Ana nnyɛ ndaadaa na Hezekiah redaadaa hom, ma ɔdze hom ahyɛ owu nsa wɔ ɔkɔm na nsukɔm mu, dɛ, hɛn Ewuradze Nyankopɔn beyi hɛn efi Assyriahen no nsamu no bi a?
Ana nnyɛ ɔnoara Hezekiah yi bi na oeyiyi ne mbea sorɔnsorɔm na n’afɔrmbukyia no, na ɔahyɛ Judah na Jerusalem, dɛ, afɔrmbukyia kor enyim na hom nsɔr, na no do na hom nhyew eduhuam no bi a?
Ana hom nnyim dza emi na m’egyanom dze ayɛ asaase do aman nyinara no? Ana asaase do amanaman hɔn enyame no nam kwan biara do tumii gyee hɔn asaase no wɔ me nsamu a?
Amanaman no a m’egyanora sɛɛ hɔn pasapasa no mu enyame nyinara mu woana na otumii gyee ne man fii me nsamu, na hom, hom Nyankopɔn no botum agye hom efi me nsamu yi?

Dɛm ntsi afei mma mma Hezekiah nnsisi hom, na so ɔnndaadaa hom dɛm yi, nkyii so mma hom nngye no nndzi: Osiandɛ ɔman anaa ahenman biara mu nyame biara enntum anngye ne man emmfi me nsamu, na m’egyanom nsamu: Na ankantsɛm hom Nyankopɔn! ɔno na ɔrebɛgye hom efi me nsamu a?
Na no nkorɔfo no so kasaa pii dze tsiaa Ewuradze Nyankopɔn na wɔdze tsiaa n’akowaa Hezekiah.

Ɔkyerekyerɛɛw nwoma so dze bɛyeyaaw Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na ɔkasaa tsiaa no, dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ asaase no amanaman a wɔanngye hɔn man emmfi me nsamu no tse no, mbrɛ eso Hezekiah ne Nyankopɔn no renngye ne man mmfi me nsamu ara nye no.
Na wɔdze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu wɔ Jewfo kasaa mu frɛɛ Jerusalem nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ fasu no do no, dɛ worupuw hɔn, na wɔafona hɔn; ma wɔaagye kurow no.
Na wɔkasaa Jerusalem Nyankopɔn no ho, dɛ, asaase do aman enyame no a wɔyɛ nyimpa nsaano edwuma no ho.
Na ɔhen Hezekiah, na Amoz ne ba nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah, bɔɔ mpaa wɔ iyi ntsi, na wosūi frɛɛ ɔsor.

Na Ewuradze somaa ɔbɔfo bi a okotwitwaa Assyriahen no ne nseraban mu mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, na mbapɔmba no, na asafohemfo no nyinara. Nna ɔdze enyimguase sanee kɔr nankasa n’a-saase do. Na aber a okodur ne nyame fie no nna hɔn a wofi nankasa ne yafun mu no, dze afõwa kum no wɔ hɔ.
Dɛm na Ewuradze gyee Hezekiah na Jerusalem atsefo no nkwa fii Assyriahen Sennacherib, na nyimpa nkaa no nyinara nsamu, na ogyaa hɔn wɔ afã beebiara.
Na dodowara dze akyɛdze brɛɛ Ewuradze wɔ Jerusalem, na ndzɛmba a ɔsom bo brɛɛ Judahhen Hezekiah: Ma dɛm ntsi ofitsi ber no na wohuhoor no wɔ amanaman nyinara enyi do.
Nda no mu Hezekiah yaar owuyar: Na ɔbɔɔ mpaa maa Ewuradze; na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ no, na ɔmaa no asɛnkyerɛdze.
Mbom Hezekiah annhyɛ ananmu bio dɛ mbrɛ yie a wɔyɛe maa no no tse; na n’akoma maa do: Dɛm ntsi ebufuw baa ɔnoara, na Judah na Jerusalem do.
Naaso Hezekiah brɛɛ noho adze wɔ n’akoma ne ntsɛn no ho, ɔno na Jerusalem atsefo nyinara, ma dɛm ntsi Ewuradze n’ebufuw no ammba hɔn do wɔ Hezekiah ne nda no mu.
Na Hezekiah nyaa ahonyadze na enyidzi kɛse mbordo: Na ɔyɛɛ ndzekorabea maa dwetɛ, na sika, na abo a ɔsom bo, na nduhuam, na akyɛm, na ndzɛmbandzɛmba pa nyinara;
adzekoraadan so dze maa eburow na nsã na ngo ndɔbaa; na mbowadan dze maa fiembowa ahorow nyinara, na nguaroban mu nguankuw.
Nkyii so ɔkyekyeer nkurow maa noho, na onyaa nguankuw na anantwikuw piigyan: Na Nyankopɔn maa no ahodze pii.
Na ɔnoara Hezekiah yi ara so na osiiw Gihon nsu etsifi nsunyiwa no ano, na ɔdze nsu no nam daadze ase tõo baa David kurow no n’anee afamu. Na Hezekiah yɛɛ prɔmprɔm wɔ no ndwurna nyinara mu.

Naaso Babylon mbapɔmba abɔfoe a wɔsomaa hɔn ma wɔkɔr ne nkyɛn dɛ wonkebisa anwanwadze a wɔyɛɛ no wɔ asaase no do no ho asɛm no bae no, Nyankopɔn gyaa no ho dɛ ɔrosɔ no ahwɛ ama oeehu dza ɔwɔ n’akoma mu nyinara.
Afei Hezekiah no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na ne ndzeyɛɛ pa, hwɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Amoz ne ba nkɔnhyeɛyi Isaiah n’enyido-adzehu no mu wɔ Judah na Israel ahemfo nwoma no mu.
Na Hezekiah nye n’egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no wɔ David ne mba asamandan mu afowee: Na Judah na Jerusalem atsefo nyinara yɛɛ no enyidzi wɔ no wu mu. Na ne babanyin Manasseh dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
33: Aber a Manasseh hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no na oedzi mfe duebien; na odzii hen mfe eduonum enum wɔ Jerusalem.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ wiadzefo a Ewuradze tuu hɔn fii Israelmba enyim no hɔn ekyiwadze no tse.
Osiandɛ osii mbea sorɔnsorɔm a n’egya Hezekiah bubui gui no bio; na osisii afɔrmbukyia dze maa Baalim no, na ɔyɛɛ Asheroth, na ɔsɔɔr sɔr dɔm nyinara, na ɔsoom hɔn.
Na osisii afɔrmbukyia wɔ Ewuradze fie a Ewuradze kãa ho asɛm dɛ, Jerusalem na me dzin bɛtsena hɔ daa no, mu.
Na osisii afɔrmbukyia dze memaa sor dɔm nyinara wɔ Ewuradze fie abangua ebien no do.

Eso ɔmaa ne mba faa ogya mu wɔ Hinnom ne ba bɔnsa no mu: Na ɔyɛɛ akɔmfodze, na ɔkyeer nkaber, na odzii esumansɛm, na ɔnye asamamfrɛfo na abayifo yɛe: Ɔbɔɔ mbusu pii wɔ Ewuradze enyi do dze yii no ebufuw.

Na ɔdze bosom no ne sianhonyi a ɔyɛe no sii Nyankopɔn ne fi no mu, dza Nyankopɔn kãa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ David na ne ba Solomon dɛ, ofi yi mu na Jerusalem a masan mu meyi no wɔ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu no mu, na medze me dzin mobɔto daa no a:

Nkyii so meremma Israel hɔn anan nntu mmfi asaase a mahyehyɛ mama hom egyanom no do bio; sɛ wɔrodwen a ara reyɛ dza medze mahyɛ hɔn nyinara a, mekyerɛ mbra na ahyɛdze na mom no a ɔnam Moses ne nsa no a.
Na Manasseh yɛɛ Judan Jerusalem atsefo no ma wɔfomee ma dɛm ntsi wɔbɔɔ mbusu dodow seen amanaman a Ewuradze sɛɛ hɔn wɔ Israelmba enyim no.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Manasseh ne man: Na woenntsie.
Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze maa Assyriahen dɔm do asafohemfo no baa hɔn do, na wɔdze nkɔtɔkorba kyeer Manasseh, na wɔ dze mpokyerɛ too no, na wɔdze no kɔr Babylon.
Na aber a ɔwɔ ahohiahia mu no nna ɔhwehwɛɛ n’Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn, na ɔbrɛɛ noho adze kɛsenara wɔ n’egyanom Nvankopɔn enyim.
Na ɔbɔɔ mpaa maa no; na otsiee n’akyɛpa, na ɔtsee no nkotoserɛ no, na ɔdze no sanee baa n’ahendzi no mu bio wɔ Jerusalem. Nna Manasseh hun dɛ Ewuradze no ɔno nye Nyankopɔn.

Afei iyi ekyir no ɔtoow David kurow no ekyir fasu, wɔ Gihon n’anee afamu, wɔ bɔnsa no mu, mekyerɛ edze rokɔ enam kuropon no n’ahɛnee; na ɔdze bɔɔ Ophel ho aprɔw, na ɔmaa do ma ɔkrɔɔn kɛsenara: Na ɔdze asafohemfo a wɔyɛ ndam guguu Judah nkurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban nyinara mu.
Na oyiyii enyame nana no, na abosom no fii Ewuradze ne fi no mu, na afɔrmbukyia nyinara a osisii no wɔ Ewuradze ne fie bepɔw do, na Jerusalem no nyinara, na ɔdze fii kurow no mu kɔtotowee gui.
Na osii Ewuradze n’afɔrmbukyia no, na ɔbobɔɔ asomdwee-afɔr na ndaase-afɔr, na ɔhyɛɛ Judah dɛ wɔnsom Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no.
Naaso ɔman no daa ho ara bɔɔ okum-afɔr wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do, na hɔn Ewuradze Nyankopɔn ara nko na wɔdze maa no.
Afei Manasseh no ho asɛm nkaa no, na ne mpaa a ɔbɔe maa ne Nyankopɔn, na adzehufo a wɔkasaa kyerɛɛ no wo Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn dzin mu no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo ho nsɛm no mu.

Eso ne mpaabɔ, na mbrɛ Nyankopɔn sii na otsiee n’akyɛpa no, na no bɔn na ne mbrato nyinara, na fakor mbrɛ ɔtotoow mbea sorɔnsorɔm, na osisii Asherim, na osiaan ehonyi no, ansaana ɔrebrɛ noho adze no: Hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Hozai n’abakɔnsɛm no mu.
Nna Manasseh nye n’egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no wɔ nankasa ne fie: Na ne babanyin Amon dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
Aber a Amon hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu ebien; na odzii hen mfe ebien wɔ Jerusalem.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya Manasseh yɛe: Na Amon bɔɔ okum-afɔr dze maa ehonyi a woesian a n’egya Manasseh yɛe no, na ɔsoom hɔn.
Na ɔammbrɛ noho adze wɔ Ewuradze enyim, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya Manasseh ɔbrɛɛ noho adze no; na ɔnoara Amon yi mbom na ɔfoom mbordo.
Na no nkowaa paam ne tsir do, na wokum no wɔ nankasa ne fie.
Na asaase no do nkorɔfo no kunkum hɔn a wɔpaam ɔhen Amon ne tsir do no nyinara; na asaase no do nkorɔfo no hyɛɛ ne babanyin Josiah ɔhen wɔ n’ananmu.
34: Aber a Josiah hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe awɔtwe; na odzii hen mfe eduasa biako wɔ Jerusalem.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze n’enyiwa do, na ɔnantseew n’egya David n’akwan do, na ɔanndan ammfa nkyɛn annkɔ enyimfa anaa abankum.

Na n’ahendzi mu afe a otsia awɔtwe no a ɔda ho yɛ abofra no, nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ ɔrohwehwɛ n’egya David ne Nyankopɔn no n’ekyir kwan: Na afe a otsia duebien no mu no nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ ɔretsew Judah na Jerusalem ho efi mbea sorɔnsorɔm, na Asherim, na sian-ehonyi na ogu-ehonyi no ho.

Na wodwuruuw Baalim n’afɔrmbukyia no wɔ n’enyim; na ewia-ehonyi no a osisi do wɔ sor no, otwitwae gui; na Asherim na sian-ehonyi, na ogu-ehonyi no, obubuu no esinesin, na ɔyɛɛ no huntuma, na ɔtowee petsee hɔn a wɔbɔɔ afɔr maa hɔn no hɔn ndakamaa no do.
Na ɔhyeew asɔfo no hɔn mbiew no wɔ hɔn afɔrmbukyia no do, na ɔtseew Judah na Jerusalem ho.
Na dɛmara so na ɔyɛɛ no wɔ Manasseh na Ephraim na Simeon nkurow do, araa dze kodur Naphtali, wɔ hɔn amamfo do hyiae.
Na odwuruuw afɔrmbukyia no, na osiiw Asherim, na sian-ehonyi no huntuhuntu, na otwitwaa ewia-ehonyi no nyinara gui wɔ Israel asaase no nyinara mu, na ɔsanee baa Jerusalem.

Afei n’ahendzi no mu afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu, aber a ɔtseew asaase no, na ofi no ho no, ɔsomaa Azaliah ne ba Shaphan, na kurow no mu ambrado Maaseiah, na Joahaz ɔsɛnkaafo no ne ba Joah, dɛ wɔnkɔ nkemiamia Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn ne fi no mu.

Na wɔbaa ɔsɔfopanyin Hilkiah nkyɛn, na woyii sika no a wɔdze baa Nyankopɔn fie a Levifo, abowanoahwɛfo no, wɔagyegye no wɔ Manasseh na Ephraim, na Israel nkaa no nyinara, na Judah na Benjamin, na Jerusalem atsefo no hɔ no, mae.
Na wɔdze hyɛɛ edwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ Ewuradze ne fi do ahwɛfo no nsa; na edwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ Ewuradze ne fie edwuma no dze maa dɛ wɔnsesa ofi no mu, na wommiamia mu;
mekyerɛ nduadwimfo na adansifo no na wɔdze maa hɔn, dɛ wɔmfa ntotɔ abo a woetwa, na nsɛwdo ndua, na wɔmfa nyɛ mpuna mma adan no a Judah ahemfo asɛɛ no no mu.

Na mbarimba no yɛɛ edwuma no nokwar mu: Na hɔn ahwɛdofo nye Jahath na Obadiah, Levifo a wofi Merarimba mu; na Zechariah na Meshullam a wofi Kohathfo mba mu no, dɛ wompiapia no: Na Levifo nkaa no, hɔn a wonyim nsanku ndzɛmba mu nyinara.
Eso hɔn na wɔhwɛ ndzesoadzefo do, na wopiapia hɔn a wɔyɛ edwuma nyinara wɔ ɔsom ahorow biara mu: Na Levifo no mu binom yɛ akyerɛwfo, na mpanyimfo, na mbobowanoahwɛfo.
Na aber a woriyi sika a wɔdze aba Ewuradze fie no epue no, nna ɔsɔfo Hilkiah hun Ewuradze ne mbra nwoma no a wɔdze nam Moses do mae no.
Na Hilkiah buae see ɔkyerɛwfo Shaphan dɛ, mehu mbra nwoma no wɔ Ewuradze fie. Na Hilkiah dze nwoma no maa Shaphan.
Na Shaphan dze nwoma no kɛmaa ɔhen no, na nkyii so ɔdze asɛm brɛɛ ɔhen no bio, dɛ, dza wɔdze hyɛɛ wo nkowaa nsa no nyinara wɔreyɛ.
Na woehue sika a wohun no wɔ Ewuradze fie no, na wɔdze ahyɛ ahwɛdofo no na edwumayɛfo no nsa.
Na ɔkyerɛwfo Shaphan kãa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no dɛ, ɔsɔfo Hilkiah dze nwoma bi ama me. Na Shaphan kenkaan mu wɔ ɔhen no enyim.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen no tsee mbra no ne nsɛm no, nna ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu.
Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ Hilkiah, na Shaphan ne ba Ahikam, na Micah ne ba Abdon, na ɔkyerɛwfo Shaphan, na ɔhen n’akowaa Asaiah, dɛ,

Hom nkɔ nkebisa Ewuradze hɔ adze mma emi, na hɔn a wɔaka wɔ Israel na Judah mu no, wɔ nwoma no a woehu no no mu nsɛm no ho: Na Ewuradze n’ebufuw a woehue egu hɛn do no ɔsõ, osiandɛ hɛn egyanom enndzi Ewuradze n’asɛm do, annyɛ dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma yi mu no tse.

Nna Hilkiah, na hɔn a ɔhen no hyɛɛ hɔn no sii mu kɔr ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Huldah, ntardohwefo Shallum, Tokham ba no, Hasrah ba no, ne yer no nkyɛn (nna ɔtse Jerusalem afã a otsia ebien no mu;) na wɔkãa no dɛm kyerɛɛ no.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Hom nkɛkã nkyerɛ ɔbarimba a ɔsomaa hom wɔ me nkyɛn no dɛ,
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ medze mbusu mebɛba bea yi, na no do atsefo do, mekyerɛ ndom a wɔakyerew no wɔ nwoma a wɔkenkaan no wɔ Judahhen no enyim no mu nyinara:
Osiandɛ wɔapow me, na wɔakɛhyew eduhuam ama enyame fofor, ma wɔdze hɔn nsaano ndwuma nyinara eyi me ebufuw; dɛm ntsi na woehue m’ebufuhyew egu bea yi do a, na wonnkodum no.
Na Judahhen a ɔsomaa hom dɛ worabebisa Ewuradze hɔ adze no dze, mbrɛ hom nse no nye yi, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nyeyi: Ɔwɔ nsɛm a atse no ho dze,

osiandɛ w’akoma yɛ mberɛw, na ebrɛɛ woho adze wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim, aber a etsee ne nsɛm a otsia bea yi, na no do atsefo no ho no, na abrɛ woho adze wɔ m’enyim, na atsetsew wo ntar mu, na esū wɔ m’enyim ntsi; mo so metsie wo, Ewuradze na ɔse.

Hwɛ, mobɔboaboa wo makɔ w'egyanom nkyɛn na wɔbɔboaboa wo akɔ w’adakamaa mu asomdwee mu, nkyii so w’enyiwa nnkohu mbusu nyinara a medze mereba bea yi, na no do atsefo no do no. Na wɔdze asɛm brɛɛ ɔhen no bio.
Nna ɔhen no somae na wokehyiaa Judah na Jerusalem amanmapanyin no nyinara ma wɔbaa ne nkyɛn.

Na ɔhen no, na Judah mbarimba no nyinara na Jerusalem atsefo no nyinara na asɔfo no, na Levifo no, ɔman no nyinara, akɛse na nkakra nyina sii mu kɔr Ewuradze fie: Na ɔkenkaan ahyɛmu nwoma no a wohun no wɔ Ewuradze fie no no mu nsɛm no nyinara guu hɔn asomu.
Na ɔhen no gyinaa ne gyinabew, na odzii ahyɛmu wɔ Ewuradze n'ekyir, na ɔdze n'akoma nyinara, na ɔnye ne kra nyinara edzi ne mbransɛm, na n'adasesɛm, na n'ahyɛdze a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma yi mu no do.
Na ɔmaa hɔn a wohun hɔn wɔ Jerusalem na Benjamin mu nyinara gyinaa do. Na Jerusalem atsefo no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no, n'ahyɛmu no tse.

Na Josiah yiyii ekyiwadze no nyinara fii aman a ɔyɛ Israelmba dze no nyinara mu, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn a wohun hɔn wɔ Israel mu no nyinara dɛ wɔnsom, mekyerɛ dɛ wɔnsom Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn no. Ne nda nyinara mu no woemmfi Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no, n'ekyir dzi no ho emmfir.
35: Na Josiah dzii apaho wɔ Jerusalem maa Ewuradze: Na wokunkum apaho no wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu da a otsīa duanan no mu.
Na ɔdze asɔfo no kesisii hɔn ahwɛdodze mu, na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dzen maa Ewuradze fie ɔsom no.

Na ɔsee Levifo no a wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ Israel nyinara no a wɔyɛ akrɔnkrɔmfo dze ma Ewuradze no dɛ, hom mfa adaka krɔnkrɔn no mbesi ofi no a David ne ba Israelhen Solomon sii no mu; ɔnnkɛyɛ hom kɔn ho adzesoadze bio: Afei hom nsom Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn, na ne man Israel.
Na hom nsiesie homho dɛ mbrɛ hom egyanom efiefi tsetsee wɔ hom nkyekyɛmu mu dɛ mbrɛ Israelhen David ne nkyerɛwee, na dɛ mbrɛ ne ba Solomon ne nkyerɛwee no tse.
Na hom ngyinagyina bea krɔnkrɔn no do dɛ mbrɛ hom nuanom ɔman no mba no egyanom efiefi mpaapaamu no tsetsee, na wɔmma Levifo egyanom ofi kor nnya kyɛfa kor.
Na hom nkuku apaho no, na wɔnnyɛ homho krɔnkrɔn, na hom nsiesie mfa mma hom nuanom, na wɔnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n’asɛm a ɔnam Moses nsa do no tse.

Na Josiah yii nguankuw mu, nguambaa na mpɔnkyemba, dze maa ɔman mba no, dɛ wɔmfa ne nyinara nyeyɛ apaho ayɛyɛdze mma hɔn a wohun hɔn wɔ hɔ no nyinara, no dodow yɛ mpemeduasa, na anantwisaa so mpemebiasa: Iyi nyinara fi ɔhen no n’ahoɔdzen mu.

Na ne mbapɔmba no yiyii niaa ɔman no, asɔfo no, na Levifo no, ayamuyi mu. Hilkiah na Zechariah na Jehiel, Nyankopɔn fie mbapɔmba no, dze apaho afɔrbɔdze nguan mpemebien ahaesia, na anantwi ahaasa maa asɔfo no.
Conaniah so, na Sheniaiah na Nethanel, no nuanom no, na Hashabiah na Jeiel na Jozabad, Levifo etsitsir no, dze apaho afɔrbɔdze nguan mpemenum, na anantwi ahaenum maa Levifo no.
Nna wosiesiee ɔsom no, na asɔfo no gyinagymaa hɔn gyinabew, na Levifo no so wowɔ hɔn nkyekyɛmu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm no tse.
Na wokunkum apaho no, na asɔfo no dze bɔgya no a wɔsɔɔw no hɔn nsamu no petsee, na Levifo no guguaa hɔn.
Na woyii ɔhyew-afɔr no ma wɔdze aamema dɛ mbrɛ ɔman no mba egyanom efiefi mpaapaamu no tsetsee, dɛ wɔmfa nkɛma Ewuradze, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses nwoma no mu no. Na wɔyɛɛ anantwi no so dɛmara.
Na wɔdze ogya totõo apaho no dɛ mbrɛ mom no tse: Na afɔrbɔdze krɔnkrɔn no, wɔnoaa no wɔ nsenaba, na nkutu, na asɛn mu, na wɔmemaa do kɛmaa ɔman mba no ntsɛmara.

Na n’ekyir no wosiesiei maa hɔnho, na asɔfo no; osiandɛ Aaronmba asɔfo no woennya adagyer wɔ ɔhyew-afɔr no bɔ na seradze ne hyew ho araa ma okodur adzesaa: Dɛm ntsi na Levifo no siesiee bi maa hɔnho, na Aaronmba asɔfo no.

Na adwontofo Asaphmba no so wɔ hɔn gyinabew dɛ mbrɛ David, na Asaph, na Heman, na ɔhen n’adzehunyi Jeduthun, mbrasɛm no tse; na mbobowanoahwɛfo no wowɔ kuropon biara ano: Wonnyi dɛ wofi hɔn som mu fir, na hɔn nuanom Levifo no siesiei maa hɔn.
Nna wosiesiee Ewuradze no som no nyinara da no ara, dɛ wobedzi apaho no, na wɔabɔ ɔhyew-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze n’afɔrmbukyia no do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen Josiah ne mbrasɛm no tse.
Na Israelmba a wohun hɔn wɔ hɔ no dzii apaho no mber no mu, na epitsi afahyɛ no nda esuon.

Na woenndzi apaho bi a ɔtse dɛ iyi, wɔ Israel, ofitsi nkɔnhyɛnyi Samuel ne nda no mu; nkyii so Israel ahemfo mu biara enndzi dɛm apaho a ɔtse dɛ mbrɛ Josiah, na asɔfo no, na Levifo no, na Judah nyinara na Israel a wohun hɔn wɔ hɔ no, na Jerusalem atsefo no dzii no.
Josiah n’ahendzi mu afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu na wodzii apaho yi.
Iyi nyinara n’ekyir no, aber a Josiah esiesie asɔrfi no, nna Egypthen Neco sii mu kɔr dɛ ɔrokɔkõ wɔ Carchemish wɔ Euphrates ho: Na Josiah fiir edzi kehyiaa no.

Na ɔsomaa abɔfo wɔ ne nkyɛn, dɛ, ebɛnadze na menye wo wɔ yɛ, ɔwo Judahhen? Mammba wo do ndɛ da yi, na mbom ofi a menye no wɔ akodzi no do a; na Nyankopɔn ahye me dɛ menyɛ no ntsɛm: Gyaa dɛ edze woho bɛgyegye mu wo Nyankopɔn a ɔkã mo ho no ho, mm a ɔaannsɛɛ wo.
Naaso Josiah ammpɛ dɛ ɔdan n’ekyir fi no ho, na mbom ɔsakyeer noho na ɔnye no aakɔkõ, na oenntsie Neco ne nsɛm no a Nyankopɔn anomu no, na ɔbae bɔkõe wɔ Megiddo bɔnsa no mu.
Na egyentofo no totowee bobɔɔ ɔhen Josiah; na ɔhen no see no nkowaa no dɛ, hom mfa me mfi ha nkɔ; na mepira dɛ.

Nna no nkowaa no yii no fii tseaseanam no mu, na wɔdze no koo tseaseanam a otsia ebien no a ɔwɔ no mu, na wɔdze no baa Jerusalem; na owui, na wosiee no wɔ n’egyanom asamandan no mu. Na Judah na Jerusalem nyinara wogyaam Josiah.

Na Jeremiah twaa Josiah ho kwadwom: Na mbarimba adwontofo na mbaa adwontofo nyinara kãa Josiah ho asɛm wɔ kwadwom mu dze bodu ndɛ da yi; na wɔdze yɛɛ ɔmom wɔ Israel mu: Na, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no kwadwom no mu.
Afei Josiah no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na ne ndzeyɛɛ pa dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Ewuradze ne mbra mu tse,
na no ho nsɛm, kan dze na ekyir dze no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel na Judah ahemfo nwoma no mu.
36: Nna asaase no do ɔman no faa Josiah ne babanyin Jehoahaz, na wɔhyɛɛ no hen wɔ n’egya n’ananmu wɔ Jerusalem.
Aber a Jehoahaz hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu ebiasa: Na odzii hen abosoom ebiasa wɔ Jerusalem.
Na Egypthen no tuu no do wɔ Jerusalem, na odzii asaase no ɔsakaw gyee dwetɛ talent ɔha na sika talent.
Na Egypthen no dze no nua Eliakim hyɛɛ hen wɔ Judah na Jerusalem do, na ɔdaan ne dzin Jehoiakim. Na Neco faa no nua Jehoahaz, na ɔdze no kɔr Egypt.
Aber a Jehoiakim hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu enum; na odzii hen mfe dubiako wo Jerusalem: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn enyi do.
Ɔno na Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar fowee baa no do, na ɔtoo no mpokyerɛ, dɛ ɔdze no rokɔ Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar dze Ewuradze ne fie ndzɛmba no bi so kɔr Babylon, na ɔdze kesisii n'asɔrdan mu wɔ Babylon
Afei Jehoiakim no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na n’ekyiwadze a ɔyɛe, no, na dza wohun no wɔ mu no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel na Judahahemfo nwoma no mu: Na ne babanyin Jehoiachin dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Aber a Jehoiachin hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe awɔtwe; na odzii hen abosoom ebiasa na dadu wɔ Jerusalem: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do.
Na n’afedan no, ɔhen Nebuchadnezzar somae ma wɔkɛfaa no kɔr Babylon, ka Ewuradze ne fie ndzɛmba fɛɛfɛw no ho, na ɔhyɛɛ no nua Zedekiah ɔhen wɔ Judah na Jerusalem do.
Aber a Zedekiah hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu biako; na odzii hen mfe dubiako wɔ Jerusalem,
na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn enyi do; ɔammbrɛ noho adze wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah a ɔkasaa Ewuradze ano no enyim,
na ɔno so ɔtseew etūa wo ohen Nebuchadnezzar a ɔmaa ɔdze Nyankopɔn kãa ntam no no do: Na mbom ɔkyee no kɔn, na opiriim n’akoma, dɛ ɔbɛsan aba Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no nkyɛn.
Nkyii so asɔfo no mu etsitsir nyinara, na ɔman no, foom kɛsenara dɛ mbrɛ wiadze ekyiwadze no tsetsee; na woguu Ewuradze ne fi no a ɔayɛ no krɔnkrɔn wɔ Jerusalem no ho fi.
Na Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no, nam n’abɔfoe do somae ma wɔbaa hɔn nkyɛn, ɔsoɛɛr ahanamakye na ɔsomae; osiandɛ ohun ne man, na ne tsenabew mbɔbɔr:
Na hɔndze wosii Nyankopɔn abɔfoe no atwetwe, na wobuu ne nsɛm no enyimtsia, na wɔsesaar no nkɔnhyɛfo no, kodur dɛ Ewuradze n’ebufuhyew no soɛree wɔ ne man do, kodur dɛ ɔyarsa nnyi hɔ bio.

Dɛm ntsi na ɔdze Chaldeafo hen no baa hɔn do, ɔno na ɔdze afõwa kunkum hɔn mberantsɛ wɔ hɔn krɔnkrɔn-bea ofi no mu, na woennya ayamuhyehye wɔ aberantsɛ anaa akataasia, akɔdaa anaa ɔtsetsenyi ho; ɔdze hɔn nyinara hyɛɛ ne nsa.
Nyankopɔn fie ndzɛmba no nyinara, akɛse na nkakraba, na Ewuradze fie akoradze no, na ɔhen no, na n'asafohemfo akoradze no: Iyinom nyinara ɔdze baa Babylon.
Na wɔhyeew Nyankopɔn ne fi no, na wodwuruuw Jerusalem fasu no, na wɔdze ogya hyeew no mu aban no nyinara, na wɔsɛɛ no mu ndzɛmba fɛɛfɛw no nyinara.
Na hɔn a wofii afõ`wa anomu guanee, ɔsosoo hɔn kor Babylon; na wɔkɛyɛɛ nkowaa maa ɔno na ne mba araa dze kodur Persia ahendziber no:
Ma wɔdze aama Ewuradze n’asɛm a ɔnam Jeremiah anomu no ahyɛ mã, ekodu dɛ asaase no benyan n'ahomgyenda no edzi: Na mber tsentsen a ɔda hɔ amanfõ no nna n’ahomgyeda no dze ewie mfe eduosuon dzi.

Afei Persiahen Cyrus n’afe a odzi kan mu no, mbrɛ Ewuradze n’asɛm a ofi Jeremiah n’anomu no bɛba mu ntsi, nna Ewuradze bɔɔ Persiahen Cyrus no sunsum nkenyan, ma ɔmaa wɔkɔbɔɔ dawur dze kyiin n’ahenman nyinara mu, na ɔmaa wɔkyerɛwee so, dɛ,

Mbrɛ Persiahen Cyrus se nye yi, asaase do ahendzi nyinara nna Ewuradze, ɔsor Nyankopɔn no, ɔdze ama me; na ɔnoara na ɔdze ahyɛ me dɛ minsi no ofi wɔ Jerusalem a ɔwɔ Judah no. Obiara a ɔwɔ hom mu a ofi man nyinara mu no, Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn ndzin’ekyir, na wɔmma ɔmfow nkɔ.

1: Paul a ɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ do yɛ Christ Jesus ɔsomafo, nye onua Timothy, dze kɛma Nyankopɔn asɔr a ɔwɔ Corinth, nye ahotsewfo a wɔwɔ Achaea nyina:
Adom nkã hom nye asomdwee a ofir hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Christ.
Nhyira nkã hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ ne Nyankopɔn nye n’Egya a ɔyɛ ehumbɔbɔr Egya nye awerɛkyekyer nyina Nyankopɔn a,
ɔkyekye hen werɛ wɔ hɛn ahohia nyina mu, ma yeetum nam awerɛkyekyer a Nyankopɔn dze kyekye hɛn werɛ no do akyekye hɔn a wɔwɔ ahohia biara mu werɛ.
Na dɛ mbrɛ Christ amandzehu bu do ma hɛn no, dɛmara na hɛn awerɛkyekyer so nam Christ mu bu do.
Na sɛ wohiahia hɛn ho a, ɔyɛ ma hom awerɛkyekyer a ɔyɛ edwuma dze ma abotar wɔ amandze kor no ara a hɛn so yehu mu;
na hɛn enyidado a ɔwɔ hom ho otsim dɛ yenyim dɛmbrɛ hom yɛ awerɛkyekyer no mu bi so nye no.
Na, enuanom, yɛmmpɛ dɛ yesiw hom hɛn ahohia a ɔbaa hɛn do wɔ Asia no do, dɛ ɔhyɛɛ hɛn do mbordo traa hɛn ahoɔdzen, ma hɛn enyi fii hɛn nkwa do mpo:
Na hɛnankasa yɛtsee hɛn owu ne mfar wɔ hɛn mu, amma yaammfa hɛn werɛ anntwer hɛnho, na mbom yɛdze atwer Nyankopɔn a onyan ewufo no:
Ɔno na oyii hɛn fii dɛm owu kɛse yi mu, na ɔda ho yi hɛn, na yɛwɔ no enyidado dɛ ɔbɛda ho eyi hɛn;
hom so dze hom nkotoserɛ roboa hɛn bi a, ma akyɛdze a wɔnam dodow do dze ama hɛn no ntsi, nyimpa pii aada ase ama hɛn.
Na hɛn ahohyehyɛ nye yi, hɛn tsibowa ne dasedzi, dɛ Nyankopɔn krɔnkrɔnyɛ nye botooyɛ mu, nnyɛ honam mu nyansa mu, na mbom Nyankopɔn adom mu, na yɛnam bɔɔ hɛn bra wɔ wiadze, nkanka wɔ hom mu.
Na yɛnnkyerɛw biribi mmbrɛ hom kyɛn dza hom kenkan anaa mpo hom gye pen do, na m'enyi da do dɛ hom bɛgye apen do dze ekesi ewiei;
dɛ mbrɛ so hom peen hɛn do fã-na-fã dɛ yɛyɛ hom hɛndze wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus da no mu.
Na dɛm werɛ yi mu na mepɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ mebɛba hom nkyɛn ana, ma hom eenya adom mbɔho,
na mabɛfa hom nkyɛn makɔ Macedonia, na mefi Macedonia aba hom nkyɛn bio, na hom eegya me kwan ma maakɔ Judæa.
Dɛm ntsi mobɔɔ me tsirmu dɛm no, midzii adwenharsɛm anaa? Anaa me tsirmu a mobɔ no, mobɔ no honam mu na m'asɛm kor no ara ayɛ nyew, nyew, nye oho, oho anaa?
Na dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔnyɛ nokwafo no, hɛn asɛm a yɛkã kyerɛ hom nnyɛ nyew nye oho.
Na Nyankopɔn ba Jesus Christ a yɛbɛkãa no hoasɛm wɔ hom mu no, emi nye Silvanus nye Timothy, ɔnnyɛ nyew nye oho, no mu na nyew wɔ,
Na Nyankopɔn abɔ anohoba dodow dɛn ara a, no mu na nyew wɔ, na iyi ntsi na no mu na Amen wɔ ma wɔnam hɛn do hyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
Na nyia oetsim hɛn nye hom wɔ Christ mu, na ɔasera hɛn, nye Nyankopɔn:
Ɔno so na ɔasɔw hɛn ano, na ɔama hɛn Sunsum no ne nsewhyɛ wɔ hɛn akoma mu.
Na mefrɛ Nyankopɔn dɛ ombedzi me kra dase dɛ memmpɛ Corinth bio.
Nnyɛ dɛ yɛyɛ hom gyedzi do ahyɛdofo, na mbom yɛyɛ hom enigye aboafo, na gyedzi na hom dze gyina hɔ.
2: Na mobɔɔ me tsirmu pɔw dɛ meremmfa awerɛhow mmba hom nkyɛn bio.
Na sɛ mohow hom werɛ a, woana mbɔ na ɔma m'enyi gye, dɛ nyia mohow no werɛ no ara?
Na mekyerɛw hom yiara amma meba a meemmbenya awerɛhow wɔ hɔn a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔma me enyigye no ho, na mo werɛ wɔ hom nyina mu dɛ m'enyigye yɛ hom nyina so hom enyigye.
Na mifi akoma mu ahohia nye ahoguan pii mu menam nyinsu pii mu kyerɛɛw hom, nnyɛ dɛ hom werɛ nhow bi a, na mbom ama hom eehu ɔdɔ a modɔ hom mbordo no.
Na sɛ obi eyi awerɛhow a, nnyɛ emi na ɔahow mo werɛ na n'afa bi mu ɔahow hom nyina hom werɛ (amma maannsoa hom dza ɔyɛ dur dodow).
Na nkaenyim a dodow no dze akã nyimpa no enyim no dɔɔ sõ ma no,
ma afei mbom ɔse dɛhom dze kyɛ no na hom kyekye no werɛ, na aannyɛ mma obi a ɔtse dɛm no n'awerɛhow dodow ammen no.
Dɛm ntsi meserɛ hom, hom mma hom dɔ nsi pi mma no.
Na iyi ntsi mekyerɛwee, ama meehu hom ho dase yie dɛ hom yɛ setsie wɔ adze nyina mu anaa.
Onyia hom dze biribi kyɛ no no, mo so medze kyɛ no, na sɛ mo so medze biribi akyɛ a, hom ntsi na medze akyɛ wɔ Christ enyim;
ma Satan eenndzi ewuramim; na ne tsirmnsɛm nnhuntsa hɛn.
Na eso mebaa Troas wɔ Christ asɛmpa ntsi na Ewuradze buee abow maa me no,
mennya ahomgye amma mo sunsum, osiandɛ mennhu mo nua Titus; na mekraa hɔn fii hɔ kɔr Macedonia,
Na ndaase nkã Nyankopɔn a ɔdze hɛn to no nkonyinisantsen wɔ Christ mu daa, na ɔnam hɛn do yi ne nyimdzee hūa kyerɛ wɔ mbea nyina.
Na yɛyɛ Christ Jesus huam ma Nyankopɔn wɔ hɔn a wɔewgye hɔn nkwa nye hɔn a wɔre hera mu:

Binom, yɛyɛ owu hūa dze kɔ owu mu ma hɔn; na binom so, yɛyɛ nkwa hūa dze kɔ nkwa mu ma hɔn. Na woana dɛ pii a wɔdze Nyankopɔn asɛm dzi bata, na mbom ofi botooyɛ mu, ofi Nyankopɔn mu, na yɛkasa wɔ Christ mu wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
3: Ana yɛahyɛ ase bio riyi hɛnho ayɛw anaa? Anaa yehia ayɛyinwoma a yɛdze brɛ hom, anaa ofi hom nkyɛn ba, dɛ binom?
Hom nye hɛn nwoma a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ hɛn akoma mu a nyimpa nyina hu na wɔkenkean;
na hom da edzi dɛ hom yɛ Christ Jesus nwoma a ɔnam hɛn som do a wɔammfa dubir, na mbom wɔdze Nyankopɔn tseasefo no Sunsum kyerɛwee, nnyɛ abopon do, na mbom nyimpa n'akomapon do a.
Na dɛm awerɛtwer yi na yɛnam Christ do enya no Nyankopɔn afamu:
Nnyɛ dɛ hɛnara yɛsõ yɛ, dɛ yebu biribi dɛ ofi hɛnankasa hɛn mu; na mbom hɛn sõ a yɛsõ yɛ no fi Nyankopɔn;
ɔno so na ɔama yetum yɛ ahyɛmu fofor no ho asomfo, nnyɛ nkyerɛwee ho dze bi a, na mbom sunsum nedze a: Na nkyerɛwee dze ɔma owu, na sunsum na ɔma nkwa.
Na sɛ owu som a wɔkyerɛwee krukyee no wɔ abo do no nyaa enyimnyam, ma Israelmba enntum anngyen enyi annhwɛ Moses enyim wɔ n'enyim enyimnyam a orutwa mu ntsi a,
ɔbɛyɛ dɛn mbɔ na sunsum som no rinnya enyimnyam?
Na sɛ afɔbu som no yɛ enyimnyam a, ɔtsenenee som no mbom bor do pii wɔ enyimnyam mu.
Mpo dza wɔahyɛ no enyimnyam no nnyi enyimnyam wɔ iyi afamu, wɔ enyimnyam no a ɔkyɛn no ntsi.
Na sɛ dza otwa mu no nam enyimnyam mu a, dza ɔka hɔ no mbom wɔ enyimnyam pii.
Na yɛwɔ dɛm enyidado ntsi, yɛyɛ ɔkasa mu ndam pii,
na yɛnnyɛ dɛ Moses a ɔdze nkataenyim kataa n'enyim ma Israelmba eenntum anngyen hɔn enyi annhwɛ enyimnyam a orutwa mu no n'ewiei:
Na mbom hɔn adwen pirimii, na ɔdze bodu ndɛ nkataenyim kor no ara da ho wɔ ahyɛmu dadaw no ne kenkan do a wonnya nnyi, osiandɛ Christ mu na woyi.
Na ɔdze bodu ndɛ, sɛ aber biara wɔkenkan Moses a, nkataenyim da ho wɔ hɔn akoma do.
Na sɛ aber biara wɔdam ba Ewuradze nkyɛn a, woyi nkataenyim no.
Na afei Ewuradze nye Sunsum no, na mbrɛ Ewuradze Sunsum wɔ na fahodzi wɔ.
Na hɛn nyina, yɛdze enyim a wɔnnkataa do rekyerɛ Ewuradze enyimnyim dɛ ahwehwɛ no, wɔsakyer hɛn kɔ subea kor no ara bi mu, fi enyimnyam mu kɔ enyimnyam mu.
4: Dɛm ntsi, yɛwɔ dɛm som yi, dɛ mbrɛ yenyaa ehumbɔbɔr no, yɛmmpa abaw:
Na mbom yɛapow enyiwudze a ohuntae, yɛnnantsew enyifir mu, eso yɛmmfa ndaadaa mmfora Nyankopɔn asɛm mu, na yɛnam nokwar no ne nyikyerɛ do yi hɛnho kyerɛ nyimpa nyina tsibowa wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na sɛhɛn asɛmpa no do kata a, ɔkata wɔ hɔn a wɔrehera no mu,
hɔn mu na wiadze yi nyame efura hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi enyi, amma woeennhu Christ Jesus a, dɛ Ewuradze, na hɛnankasa dze dɛ hom nkowaa wɔ Jesus ntsi.
Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn a ɔkãa dɛ kan mfi sum mu nhyerɛn no na ɔahyerɛn wɔ hɛn akoma mu dɛ ɔmma Nyankopɔn enyimnyam a ɔwɔ Jesus Christ enyim no no ho nyimdzee ne kan no.
Na yɛwɔ akoradze yi wɔ dɛtse nkuraba mu, na tum no ne kɛseyɛ a ɔtra do no eefir Nyankopɔn na eemmfir hɛn:
wofi mbeambea hiahia hɛn ho, na wɔmmem hɛn; hɛn ho kyer hɛn, na hɛn enyidado mmpa;
wɔtaa hɛn do, na eso wɔmmpa hɛn ekyir; woekruw hɛn ahwe ase, na eso wɔnnsɛɛ hɛn:
daa yɛso Jesus no wu wɔ hɛn nyimpadua mu nam, ama Jesus no nkwa so aada edzi wɔ hɛn nyimpadua mu.
Na hɛn a yɛtse ase yi, woyi hɛn ma owu daa, ama Jesus no nkwa so aada edzi wɔ hɛn wu honam yi mu.
Dɛm ntsi owu dzi dwuma wɔ hɛn mu, na nkwa so dzi dwuma wɔ hɛn mu,
Na yɛwɔ gyedzi sunsum kor no ara, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ, megyee dzii ntsi na mekasae yi, hɛn so yɛgye dzi na ne ntsi so yɛkasa;
na yenyim dɛ nyia onyaan Ewuradze Jesus no; obenyan hɛn so nye Jesus, na oeyi hɛn nye hom akyerɛ.
Na iyi nyina hom ntsi a, na adom no aadɔɔ sõ edua nyimpa pii do ama ndaase a ɔbor do aakã Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
Dɛm ntsi yɛmmpa abaw; na mbom sɛ hɛn enyido nyimpa yi resɛɛ a, hɛn mu-nyimpa no dan fofor daa daa.
Na hɛn sesei ahohia harhar yi, orisiesie onnyiewiei enyimnyam a ɔsõ tra do pii ma hɛn,
ber a yɛnnhwɛ ndzɛmba a wohu, na mbom yɛhwɛ dza wonnhu no: Na ndzɛmba a wohu no nnkyɛr mu twa, na dza wonnhu no na onnyi ewiei.
5: Na yenyim dɛ sɛ wonya gura hɛn asaase ntamadan fi yi a, yɛwɔ ofi a ofir Nyankopɔn, ɔdan a wɔammfa nsa ennsi, ɔwɔ hɔ daa, wɔ sor.
Na iyi mu so na yesi nkrum na hɛn enyi gyina dɛ wɔdze hɛn fi a ofi sor bɛhyɛ hɛn:
Sɛ ɔba dɛ yenya hyɛ a wonnkohu hɛn dɛ yedzi adagyaw.
Na hɛn a yɛtsetse ntamadan yi mu, yesi nkrum na ɔhyɛ hɛn do: Nnyɛ dɛ yɛpɛ dɛ wɔpa hɛn ho tam bi a, na mbom dɛ yɛbɛhyɛ egu do a, ama nkwa aamen dza owu.
Na nyia oesiesie hɛn ama iyiara nye Nyankopɔn a ɔama hɛn Sunsum no ne nsewhyɛ.
Na yɛwɔ akokodur daa, na yenyim dɛ yɛtse fie wɔ nyimpadua no mu yi yɛadɔ mu efi Ewuradze nkyɛn
(na yɛnantsew gyedzi mu, na nnyɛ ohu mu a);
medɛ yɛhyɛ dzen na mbom yɛpɛ dɛ yɛdɔ mu fi nyimpadua yi mu, na yɛkɔ fie wɔ Ewuradze nkyɛn.
Dɛm ntsi na yɛbɔ mbɔdzen dɛ yɛdɔ mu o, yɛwɔ fie o, yɛbɔsɔ n'enyi.
Na otwar dɛ hɛn nyina wobeyi hɛn akyerɛ Christ atsɛmbu gua no enyim hɔ, ama obiara eenya dza ɔayɛ no nyimpadua yi mu, papa o, bɔn o.
Na yenyim Ewuradze ho suro ntsi, yɛhyɛ nyimpa ntsirmu, na Nyankopɔn dze, yɛada edzi ama no, na m'enyi da do dɛ yɛada edzi ama hom tsibowa so.
Na yennyi hɛnho ayɛw nnkyerɛ hom bio, na mbom yɛrema hom dza hom nam do bɛhyehyɛ homho wɔ hɛn afamu, na hom eenya biribi ebua hɔn a wɔhyehyɛ hɔnho enyiwado, na nnyɛ akoma mu a.
Na sɛ yeeegyim a, yeegyim ama Nyankopɔn, na sɛ hɛn enyi da hɔ a, ɔda ma hom.
Na Christ dɔ hyɛ hɛn, osiandɛ yebu no dɛ, sɛ ɔbaako wui maa hɔn nyina, nna hɔn nyina wui;
na owui maa hɔn nyina ma hɔn a wɔtse ase aannda ho anntsena ase amma hɔnankasa hɔnho, na mbom wɔaatsena ase ama nyia osiaan hɔn ntsi owui na ɔsoɛɛr bio no.
Dɛm ntsi ofir ndɛ yennyim obiara wɔ honam afamu, na sɛ yeehu Christ wɔ honam afamu mpo a, afei dze yennyim no dɛm bio.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ obi wɔ Christ mu a, ɔyɛ abɔdze fofor: ndɛmba adadaw no etwa mu, na hwɛ, ndzɛmba nyina ayɛ fofor.
Na iyi nyina fir Nyankopɔn a ɔnam Christ do akã hɛn nye nankasa noho abɔ mu, na ɔdze nkabɔmu som no ama hɛn no;
ɔno nye dɛ Nyankopɔn nam Christ mu kaa wiadze nye nankasa bɔɔ mu, na oemmbu hɔn mfom enngu hɔn do, na ɔdze nkabɔmu asɛm no ahyɛ hɛn nsa.
Dɛm ntsi yɛyɛ ahembɔfo ma Christ, ɔtse dɛ Nyankopɔn nam hɛn do rototɔ hom: Yegyina Christ ananmu serɛ hom dɛ, hom nye Nyankopɔn mbɔ mu.
Na nyia onnyim bɔn no, ɔyɛɛ no ɔbɔn maa hɛn, ama wɔaayɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn tsenenee wɔ no mu.
6: Na Hɛn a yɛnye no bɔ mu yɛ edwuma no totɔ serɛ hom dɛ mma hom nngye Nyankopɔn adom no kwa.
(na ɔdɛ, Enyisɔ ber mu na mitsiee wo, na nkwagye da na moboaa wo: Hwɛ, sesei nye enyisɔ ber; hwɛ, sesei nye nkwagye da):
na mma yɛnnto fintsidua biara wɔ biribiara mu, na woeennum ɔsom no;
na mbom adze nyina mu hom mma yenyi hɛnho nkyerɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn asomfo, wɔ abotar pii mu, wɔ ahohia mu, wɔ ahohyer mu, wɔ ahomtsew mu,
ɔhwe mu, efiadzenda mu, etutuw mu, ndwumadzen mu, epesi mu, mbuadadzi mu,
ahotsew mu, nyimdzee mu, penkyɛr mu, ayamuyie mu, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu, ɔdɔ a ndabraba nnyi mu mu,
nokwasɛm no mu, Nyankopɔn tum mu, tsenenee akodze mu wɔ bankum nye nyimfa,
wɔ enyimnyam nye enyimguase mu, wɔ atsenka bɔn nye atsenka pa mu; dɛ esisifo naaso nokwafo;
dɛ hɔn a wonnyim hɔn, naaso wonyim hɛn yie; dɛ hɔn a woruwu, na hwɛ, yɛtse ase; dɛ hɔn a wɔtsēa hɔn, naaso wonnku hɛn;
dɛ awerɛhofo naaso hɛn enyi gye daa; dɛ ehiafo naaso yɛma pii nya hɔnho; dɛ wonnyi hwee, naaso yɛwɔ adze nyina.
O Corinthfo, hɛn ano ebue ama hom, hɛn akoma mu atserɛw.
Nnyɛ hɛn mu na hom kyer, na mbom hom-ankasa hom akɔndo mu na hom kyer.
Na hom so (mekã kyerɛ hom dɛ mba) hom ntserɛw hom mu mfa ntua kaw dɛmara.
Mma hom nye hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi nntwe kɔndua kor: Na nkitahodzi bɛn na tsenenee nye emumuyɛ wɔ? Anaa anyɛnkoyɛ bɛn na kan nye sum wɔ?
Na nsaa bɛn na Christ nye Belial saa? Anaa kyɛfa bɛn na ɔgyedzinyi nye dza ɔnngye nndzi wɔ?

Na edziesie bɛn na Nyankopɔn asɔrfi nye abosom wɔ? Na hɛndze, yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn tseasefo n'asɔrfi; dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn akã dɛ, mebɛtsena hɔn mu, na manantsew hɔn mu, na mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn, na hɔn so ayɛ me man.
Dɛm ntsi Hom mfi hɔn mu mbra, na hom ntsew homho, Ewuradze na ɔse, na mma hom nnkã efifidze, na mebɛgye hom,
Na mayɛ Egya mama hom, na hom ayɛ me mbabanyin nye mbabaa, Ewuradze Tumfo na ɔse.
7: Yɛwɔ dɛm anohoba yi ntsi, adɔfo, hom mma yɛnhohor hɛnho mfi honam nye sunsum mu fi nyina mu, yenwie krɔnkrɔn yɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn suro mu.
Hom mma hɛn hom akoma mu kwan: yɛannyɛ obiara bɔn, yɛannsɛɛ obiara, yeenndzi obiara emim.
Mennkã yi mmbu hom fɔ, na makã dada dɛ, yewu o, yɛtse ase o, hom wɔ hɛn akoma mu.
Me kasaa mu ndam a ɔwɔ hom afamu sõ, m'ahohyehyɛ a ɔwɔ hom afamu sõ, awerɛkyekyer ahyɛ me mã, me dɛw bu do pii wɔ hɛn ahohia nyina mu.
Na yɛbaa Macedonia mpo, hɛn honam ennya ahomgye bi, na wohiahiaa hɛn ho afã nyina: guado a, ɔkõ a; imu a, ihu a.
Naaso nyia ɔkyekye abrɛfo werɛ no, ɔnye Nyankopɔn, ɔnam Titus ne mbae do kyekyee hɛn werɛ:
Na nnyɛ ne mbae nko, na awerɛkyekyer a no werɛ kyekyee wɔ hom mu so; ɔkãa hom fe nye hom nkɔmbɔdzi nye hom mbɔdzembɔ a ɔwɔ mo ho kyerɛɛ me maa m'enyi gyee pii.
Na sɛ medze nwoma bɔhoow hom werɛ a, munnu moho, sɛ munnu moho mpo a; na muhu dɛ nwoma no hoow werɛ, sɛ mber tsiabaa bi mpo a.
Na afei dze, midzi dɛw, nnyɛ dɛ hom werɛ howee kɔr mfihoekyir mu; na hom werɛ hoow Nyankopɔn kwan do, amma hom aannhwer hɛn ho biribi.
Na Nyankopɔn kwan do awerɛhow dze, ɔyɛ mfihoekyir a wɔdze kɔ nkwagye mu a wonnu ho wɔ ho, na wiadze awerɛhow dze, ɔma owu.

Na hwɛ, hom werɛ a ɔhoow Nyankopɔn do yi ara, ebɛn nhwɛyie na ɔayɛ wɔ hom mu, ebɛn anoyi, ebɛn ebufuwyi, ebɛn ehubɔ, ebɛn fe, ebɛn mbɔdzembɔ, ebɛn awerdzi! Adze nyina mu hom kyerɛɛ dɛ hom ho tsew wɔ asɛm no mu.
Na sɛ mekyerɛwee brɛɛ hom a, nnyɛ nyia ɔyɛɛ bɔn no ntsi a, eso nnyɛ nyia wɔyɛɛ no bɔn no ntsi a, na mbom ɔno nye dɛ hom nhwɛyie a hom hwɛ hɛn ho bɛda edzi ama hom wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Dɛm ntsi hɛn werɛ akyekye, na hɛn awerɛkyekyer mu hɛn enyi gyee mbordo wɔ Titus n'enyigye no ho, osiandɛ hom nyina adwedwe no sunsum.
Osiandɛ sɛ medze hom hyehyɛɛ moho kyerɛɛ no a, m'enyi ennwu, na mbom, mbrɛ yɛkãa asɛm nyina kyerɛɛ hom nokwar mu no, dɛmara na hɛn ahohyehyɛ a yɛhyehyɛɛ hɛnho wɔ Titus enyim ayɛ nokwar.
Na n'akoma wɔ hom do pii, dɛ ɔkaa hom nyina hom setsie, mbrɛ hom dze hu nye ahopopo gyee no no.
Midzi dɛw dɛ adze nyina mu mowɔ hom ho werɛ.
8: Na eso enuanom, yɛma hom ehu Nyankopɔn adom a ɔdze adom Macedonia asɔrasɔr:
mbrɛ hɔn ahohia nsɔhwɛ kɛse mu hɔn dobodoo no buu do kyerɛɛ hɔn ayamuyie ahonya.
Na wɔmaa dɛ mbrɛ wobotum midzi dase, dza ɔtra hɔn tum mpo, na wɔdze hɔnara hɔn pɛ,
na wɔdze kotow pii serɛɛ hɛn wɔ som a wɔdze som ahotsewfo no adom nye fɛkuwbɔ ho;
na iyi nnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ hɛn enyi daa do a, na mbom wodzii kan dze hɔnankasa hɔnho maa Ewuradze, na wɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ do dze maa hɛn so.
Na iyi ntsi yɛserɛɛ Titus dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhyɛɛ ase kan no, onwie adom yi wɔ hom so mu.
Na dɛ mbrɛ hom bor do wɔ adze nyina mu, gyedzi, nye asɛm, nye nyimdzee, nye mbɔdzembɔ, nye hom dɔ a ɔwɔ hɛn do no, hom nhwɛ dɛ hom bɔbor do wɔ adom yi so mu.
Na mennkã yi nnhyɛ do, na mbom medze binom mbɔdzembɔ rosɔ hom dɔ no nokwar ahwɛ.
Na hom nyim hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ n'adom, dɛ ɔyɛ ɔhonyanyi, naaso hom ntsi ɔbɛyɛɛ ohianyi, ama hom nam ne hia do aayɛ ahonyafo.
Na m'adwen na mekyerɛ wɔ yi mu, dɛ iyi na ɔfata hom a, nnyɛ ɔyɛ nko bi, na ɔpɛ mu so, hom dzii kan hyɛɛ ase mfeda.
Na afei hom nwie ɔyɛ no so ma, dɛ mbrɛ hom ayɛ krado wɔ ɔpɛ mu, no wie so aayɛ dɛmara, dɛ mbrɛ hom botum.
Na sɛ ɔpɛ mu dze obi yɛ krado a, enyisɔ wɔ mu dɛ mbrɛ obi wɔ, na nnyɛ mbrɛ onnyi bi a.
Na mennkã yi ma binom ho aadwe hɔn, na hom dze hom ho eeguan hom,
na dɛ ɔnyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛr ntsi a: Ma dɛm ber yi mu hom mbordo aakɔhwɛ hɔn hia, na hɔn so hɔn mbordo aabɔhwɛ hom hia, na aayɛ pɛpɛɛpɛr:
dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ, onyia ɔtasee pii ennya biribi aammbor do, na nyia ɔtasee kakrabaa, annka no biribi.
Na ndaase nkã Nyankopɔn a ɔdze hom ho mbɔdzembɔ kor yi ara ahyɛ Titus n'akoma mu.
Na otsiee hɛn afotu dze, na noara no mbɔdzembɔ kyɛn dɛm ntsi, ɔnam nankasa ne pɛ do baa hom nkyɛn.
Na yɛsomaa ɔno nye onua no a n'ayɛyi wɔ asɛmpa no mu atahye wɔ asɔr nyina mu no:
na nyyɛ dɛm nko, na ɔno na asɔrmba eyi no dɛ ɔnye hɛn nnantsew wɔ adom yi a yɛrosom ho mfa nkyerɛ Ewuradze enyimnyam nye hɛnara so hɛn ntsɛmpɛ:
Na yɛda hɛnho do mma obi eennum hɛn wɔ adze dodow a yɛrosom ho yi ho:
Na yɛdwen dza ɔyɛ enyidzi ho sie, nnyɛ Nyankopɔn enyim nko, na mbom nyimpa enyim so.
Na yɛasoma hɛn nua a yeenya no nhunii dɛ ɔbɔ mbɔdzen wɔ ndzɛmba pii mu, na afei osian werɛ kɛse a oenya no hom mu ntsi, ɔbɔ mbɔdzen bor do.
Titus ho a, ɔyɛ me nyɛnko nye me nyɛnkodwumadzifo ma hom: Hɛn nuanom ho a, wɔyɛ asɔr asomafo, Christ enyimnyam.
Dɛm ntsi hom nyi hom dɔ nye ahohyehyɛ a yɛhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ hom ho ne dasee nkyerɛ hɔn wɔ asɔr enyim.
9: Na ahotsewfo som no ho dze, onnhia dɛ mekyerɛw mebrɛ hom;
na minyim hom ntsɛmpɛ a medze hyehyɛ moho kyerɛ Macedoniafo dɛ Achaia siesiee hɔnho afrenhyia nye yi, na hom mbɔdzembɔ enunu hɔn mu piinara.
Na masoma enuanom no, ama hɛn ahohyehyɛ a ɔwɔ hom ho aannyɛ kwa wɔ iyi afamu, na dɛ mbrɛ mekãa no, hom oesiesie homho;
na ibi a Macedoniafo ni nye hɛn ba, na wɔbɔto hom dɛ hom nnsiesiee homho a, hɛn (yɛnnkã dɛ hom), hɛn enyi aanntõ wɔ dɛm werɛ yi mu.
Dɛm ntsi modween dɛ ohia dɛ meserɛ enuanom no dɛ wondzi kan wɔ hom nkyɛn mbɔboaboa hom akyɛdze a wɔabɔ hom nkaa esie no nto hɔ, na ɔaada hɔ dɛ akyɛdze na nnyɛ epoobɔdze.
Na dza mekã nye dɛ, nyia odua no kyenkyen mu no, obobu no kyenkyen mu, na nyia odua no bafuu no obobu no bafuu.
Dɛ mbrɛ obiara esusu wɔ n'akoma mu, nnyɛ nkɔmpewdo, anaa nhyɛdo; na Nyankopɔn dɔ nyia ɔtsew n'enyim ma.
Na Nyankopɔn botum dɛ ɔma adom nyina bor do ma hom eenya dza ɔdɔɔ sõ nyina, na hom aabor do wɔ edwuma pa nyina mu:
dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, ɔatow apetse, ɔama ehiafo; ne tsenenee tsene hɔ daa.
Na nyia ɔdze aba ma duafo, na ɔma paanoo dɛ edziban no, ɔbɛma hom aba a hom dua no adɔɔ sõ, na ɔama hom tsenenee eduaba adɔr;
na hom eenya homho wɔ ayamuyie nyina mu, dza ɔnam hɛn do yɛ ndaase ho edwuma ma Nyankopɔn.
Osiandɛ baguasom yi no som dze, nnyɛ dɛ wɔdze kɛhyɛ ahotsewfo no sintɔ mã nko, na ɔnam ndaase pii do bu do so ma Nyankopɔn;
na ɔnam ɔsom yi no nsɔhwɛ do wɔhyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ setsie a hom kã dɛ hom wɔ ma Christ asɛmpa no, na ayamuyie ntoboa a hom yi boa hɔn nye nyimpa nyina ntsi;
na hɔn so woyi mpaa ama hom na wɔfe hom wɔ Nyankopɔn adom a ɔbor do wɔ hom do ntsi.
Ndaase nkã Nyankopɔn wɔ n'akyɛdze a onnyi akasu no ntsi.
10: Na emi Paul mankasa menam Christ no dwe nye ne tsema do meserɛ hom, emi a enyido mebrɛ adze wɔ hom enyim, na minnyi hom nkyɛn a, meyɛ paapaamuse ma hom.
ɛhɛɛ, meserɛ hom na meba hom nkyɛn a, maammmfa werɛ mannyɛ ndam a mubu dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ meyɛ ndam wɔ hɔn a wobu hɛn dɛ yɛnam honam afamu no do.
Na kaansa yɛnam honam mu a, yɛnnyɛ ɔsa wɔ honam mu,
(na hɛn asayɛ akodze nnyɛ honam dze, na mbom ɔyɛ dzen wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim dɛ yɛdze bodwuruw akobanɔ;
yedwuruw adwen nye adze a ɔkrɔn biara a wɔma do tsia Nyankopɔn nyimdzee, na yɛfa adwen nyina ndɔmmum ba Christ setsie ase;
na yeesiesie hɛnho dɛ, sɛ hom setsie wie mã yɛ a, yebotua asoɔdzen nyina wer.
Enyido na hom hwɛ. Sɛ obi dze ne tsir twer noho dɛ ɔyɛ Christ dze a, wɔnima onsusu yi so wɔ nankasa no mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔno yɛ Christ dze no, mbrɛ hɛn so yɛ Christ dze ara nye no.
Na sɛ mehyehyɛ moho mbordo wɔ tum a Ewuradze maa hɛn wɔ hom ntowdo na nnyɛ hom dwuruw ntsi no ho a, m’enyi runnwu;
na mannyɛ dɛ medze nwoma riyi hom hu.
Osiandɛ wɔse, No nwoma dze ɔyɛ dur, na no mu yɛ dzen, na ne nyimpanyim dze yɛ mberɛw, ne kasaa nnsɛ hwee.
Wɔmma onyia no nsusu dɛ, mbrɛ yennyi hɔ a yɛtse wɔ nwoma mu wɔ asɛm mu no, yɛwɔ hɔ so a mbrɛ yɛtse wɔ nyɛe mu ara nye no.
Na yennsi hɛn bo mmfa hɛn ho mmfora, anaa yɛmmfa hɛn ho nnto hɔn a wɔkamfo hɔnankasa hɔnho no ho; na hɔndze wɔdze hɔnho bu hɔnho, na wɔdze hɔnho to hɔnankasa hɔnho ntsi, wonnyim adze.
Na hɛndze yɛrennhyehyɛ hɛnho atra do, na mbom dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn susudua esusu ama hɛn ntoaado, dɛ susudze yi odu hom nkyɛn.
Na yɛnntwe hɛn mu nntra do dɛ gyama yenndu hɛn nkyɛn, na yɛdze Christ asɛmpa no ebodu hom nkyɛn mpo:
Na yɛnnhyehyɛ hɛnho nntra do wɔ binom hom edwuma mu, na mbom yɛwɔ enyidado dɛ, hom gyedzi nyin a, wɔbɛyɛ hɛn kɛse mbordo wɔ hom mu dɛ mbrɛ hɛn susudua pa,
na yɛakɛkã asɛmpa no wɔ hom ekyir noho, na yɛannhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ mbrɛ obi no dwumadzi pa wɔ dza woewie yɛ dada no ho.
Na nyia ɔhyehyɛ noho, ma ɔnhyehyɛ noho Ewuradze mu:
na nnyɛ nyia ɔkamfo noho na wɔapen no, na nyia Ewuradze kamfo no a.
11: Nkyɛ me pɛ dɛ hom gye me nkwaseasɛm kakra; ɛhɛɛ, hom nhu mma me.
