Na medze Nyankopɔn nyinkun twe hom ho nyinkun, na magye hom awar ama ɔbarimba baako, dɛ medze hom dɛ ɔbaabun krɔnn rekɛma Christ.
Na musuro dɛ bɛyɛ na oedua biribi do mbrɛ ɔwɔ no dze enyitsew daadaa Eve no, dɛmara so wɔasɛɛ hom adwen efi botooyɛ nye krɔnnyɛ a hom wɔ wɔ Christ afamu.
Na sɛ nyia ɔba no kã Jesus fofor bi ho asɛm a yɛnnkãe, anaa hom nya sunsum fofor bi a hom nnyae, anaa asɛmpa fofor bi a hom nngyee a, ɔnodze hom hu ma no a, oye.
Na mubu dɛ mennka asomafo etsitsir no ekyir wɔ biribiara mu.
Kaansa meyɛ kutsirboo wɔ kasa mu a, mennyɛ dɛm wɔ nyimdzee mu, na adze nyina mu yɛada yi edzi wɔ nyimpa nyina mu wɔ hom afamu.
Anaa bɔn na mayɛ dɛ mabrɛ moho adze ma wɔaama hom do, osiandɛ mebɛkãa hom Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no kwa?
Mofoom asɔr binom adze, megyee akatua dɛ medze robɔsom hom;

na mowɔ hom nkyɛn na mihiae no, mannyɛ adzesoa amma obi, na dza ohiaa me no, enuanom a wofi Macedonia bae no maa ɔkaa me nsa; na adze nyina mu mohwɛɛ moho dɛ mennkɛyɛ dur ama hom, na dɛmara so na mobɔhwɛ.
Christ no nokwar wɔ mo mu yi, obiara rinnsiw me kwan wɔ ahohyehyɛ yi ho wɔ Achaiaman no mu hɔ.
Ebɛn ntsi a? Osiandɛ monndɔ hom ntsi a? Nyankopɔn nyim.
Na dza meyɛ no, mebɛyɛ, na maamma hɔn a wɔrohwehwɛ mo ho kwan no kwan, na woeehu hɔn dza wɔdze hyehyɛ hɔnho no mu dɛ hɛnara.
Na dɛm nyimpa no, wɔyɛ asomafo atorfo, ndaadaa dwumadzifo, wɔdandan hɔnho Christ asomafo.
Na ɔnnyɛ nwanwa, na Satan mpo dan noho dɛ kan ɔbɔfo.
Dɛm ntsi ɔnnyɛ adze kɛse bi dɛ n’asomfo so bɛdan hɔnho dɛ tsenenee asomfo: Hɔn na hɔn ewiei bɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ hon ndwuma tse.
Mekã bio dɛ, Mma obi mmbu me ɔkwasea, na sɛ ɔtse dɛm mpo a, hom ngye me dɛ ɔkwasea, na mo so menhyehyɛ moho kakra.
Dza mekã no, mennkã no Ewuradze ekyir, na mbom ɔtse dɛ nkwaseasem, wɔ ahohyehyɛ werɛ yi mu.
Osiandɛ piinara hyehyɛ hɔnho wɔ honam afamu ntsi, mo so mebɛhyehyɛ moho bi.
Na hom dze enyigye hu ma nkwasea, hom a hom yɛ enyitsewfo.
Sɛ obi dze hom ba nkowaasom ase, sɛ ɔmen hom, sɛ ɔfa hom, sɛ ɔma noho dɛ, sɛ ɔbɔ hom enyi do a, hom hu ma no.
Mekã no fɛr mu, dɛ gyama hɛndze yɛyɛ mberɛw. Naaso dza obi yɛ ndam wɔ mu, (mekã no nkwasea mu) mo so meyɛ ndam bi.
Wɔyɛ Hebrewfo? Mo so meyɛ bi. Wɔyɛ Israelfo? Mo so meyɛ bi. Wɔyɛ Abraham asefo? Mo so meyɛ bi.
Wɔyɛ CHrist asomfo? (Mekasa dɛ ogyimfo) mekyɛn dɛm; ndwumadzen mu a, mbordo; efiadzenda mu a, mbordo; ɔhwe mu a, ntrado; owu mu a, mpɛn pii.
Jewfo nsamu mpɛn enum na magye mbaa eduanan a woyi do kor.
Wɔkãa me mpire mprɛnsa, wosiiw me abo prɛko, mesiw nsu mu mprɛnsa, medzi bun mu adzekyee nye adzesaa;
akwantu pii mu, esutsen mu esian, edwotwafo nsamu esian, amanyifo nsamu esian, amanamamfo nsamu esian, kurow mu esian, wiramu esian, po mu esian, enuanom atorfo mu esian;
edwumayɛ nye ɔberɛ, epesi pii mu, ɔkɔm nye nsukɔm mu, akɔnkyen pii mu, awɔw nye adagyaw mu.
Dza ɔkeka ho nkaa a, dza ɔhyɛ mo do daa nye asɔr nyina ho akɔdaadwen:
woana na ɔyɛ mberɛw na mennyɛ bi? Woana na wɔato no fintsidua na ɔnnhyehye me?
Sɛ ɔse dɛ me hyehyɛ moho a, mebɛhyehyɛ moho wɔme mberɛwdze ho.
Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus ne Nyankopɔn nye n'Egya a wohyira no afebɔɔ no, nyim dɛ minndzi ator.
Damascus, ɔhen Aretas n'ambrado weɔɔn Damascusfo kurow no dɛ ɔpɛ me akyer me;
na wɔdze me too birefi mu duaa tokura mu gyaagyaa me ban ho sii famu, na mifii ne nsa.
12: Ohia dɛ mehyehyeɛ moho, (naaso ɔmmfata) na mebɛba Ewuradza enyido-adzehu nye nyikyerɛ mu.
Minyim nyimpa bi wɔ Christ mu, mfe duanan nye yi (sɛ ɔwɔ honam mu o, onnyi honam mu o, minnyim, Nyankopɔn na onyim), dɛm nyimpa no wohwiim no kɔr ɔsor a otsia ebiasa.
Na minyim dɛm nyimpa no (sɛ ɔwɔ honam mu o, okwetsi honam o, minnyim, Nyankopɔn na onyim),
dɛ wohwiim no kɔr Paradise, na ɔkɛtsee nsɛm a wɔnnkã a nyimpa biara nnyi ho kwan dɛ ɔkã.
Dɛm nyimpa no afamu na mebɛhyehyɛ moho, na mankasa m'afamu dze a, merennhyehyɛ moho, gyesɛ me mberɛw mu.
Na sɛ mepɛ dɛ mehyehyɛ moho mpo a, nkyɛ mennkɛyɛ kwasea, na mebɛkaa nokwar; naaso migyaa yɛ, ma obi eemmbu me annkyɛn mbrɛ ohu dɛ metse, anaa ɔtse wɔ m'anomu.
Na nyikyerɛ ntrado no ntsi amma maamma moho do anntra do, wɔmaa me honam mu nsoɛ, Satan no bɔfoe, dɛ ɔbobɔ me ekutuku, amma maamma moho do anntra do.
Na iyi ntsi meserɛɛ Ewuradze mpɛn ebiasa dɛ ɔmma omfi mo do.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, m'adom dɔɔ sõ ma wo: Na m'ahoɔdzen dzi mu wɔ mberɛw mu. Dɛm ntsi medze enyigye pii hyehyɛ moho mbom wɔ me mberɛw mu, na Christ ahoɔdzen aabɔsoɛ mo do.
Dɛm ntsi minya enyika wɔ mberɛw mu, ahorohoraa mu, ahokyer mu, ntanenyi mu, ahomtsɛw mu, wɔ Christ ntsi: Na meyɛ mberɛw a, nna mbom meyɛ dzen.
Mayɛ kwasea, na homara na hom ahyɛ me. Ne emidze, ɔsɛ dɛ homara kamfo me, osiandɛ mennsɛ hwee mpo a, mennka asomafo tsitsir no ekyir wɔ biribiara mu.
Ampaara ɔsomafo nsɛnkyerɛdze nye abotar nyina mu, wɔ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze nye tum ndwuma mu.
Na ebɛn mu na hom tɔɔ sin kyɛɛn asɔr nkaa no, gyedɛ gyama mankasa mannyɛ adzesoa amma hom? Hom mfa bɔn yi nkyɛ me!
Hwɛ, iyi nye mpɛn ebiasa a mesiesie moho reba hom nkyɛn, na meremmbɛyɛ adzesoa ama hom: Na nnyɛ hom adze na morohwehwɛ na mbom homankasa a: Na nnyɛ mba na ɔsɛ dɛ wɔkora ma mba;
na medze enyigye pii mobɔhwer adze, na mama wɔahwer me ama hom akra. Sɛ modɔ hom mbordo dɛm a, iyi ntsi na hom dɔ me dɔ a osuar?
Na bi a ɔwɔ mu dɛm: mannyɛ adzesoa amma hom, naaso meyɛ onyitsewfo ntsi medze nyansa mekyeer hom.
Aso menam hɔn a mosomaa hɔn no bi do medzi hom emim anaa?
Meserɛɛ Titus, na mosomaa onua no mekaa no ho. Ana Titus bedzii hom emim bi? Ana nnyɛ Sunsum kor no ara mu na yɛnantsewee? Nnyɛ anamɔn kor no ara mu anaa?
Mber yi nyina hom dwen dɛ yeriyi hɛn ano akyerɛ hom. Yɛkasa Christ mu wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim. Na, adɔfo, iyi nyina homankasa hom ntowdo ntsi a.

Na musuro dɛ bɛyɛ na meba a, mammbɔto hom dɛ mbrɛ mepɛ, na hom so ennhu me dɛ mbrɛ mepɛ, na hom so ennhu me dɛ mbrɛ hom pɛ: bɛyɛ na ibi a aperper, nyinkun, ebufuw, mpaapaamu nsekubɔ, awasawasa, ɔhoran, etutuw wɔ hom mu;
bɛyɛ so bio na meba a, Nyankopɔn abrɛbrɛ me adze wɔ hom afamu, na megyam piinara a wɔyɛɛ bɔn nkan no, na wonnuu hɔnho wɔ hɔn efifidze nye ndwamanyɛ, nye ahoɔdɛw a wɔyɛɛ no ho.
13: Mpɛn ebiasa nye yi a mereba hom nkyɛn. Adasefo beenu anaa baasa anomu na asɛm nyina begyina.
Makã ana na merekã bio yi: mbrɛ mpɛn ebien a mowɔ hom nkyɛn mekãe no, dɛmara na sesei a minnyi hom nkyɛn yi mekã kyerɛ hɔn a wɔaka no nyina dɛ, meba bio a, minnkegyaa hom;
osiandɛ hom rohwehwɛ Christ a ɔkasa mo mu no ho biribi ehu, ɔno na ɔnnyɛ mberɛw wɔ hom afamu, na mbom ɔyɛ tumfo wɔ hom mu:
Na ɔnam mberɛw mu na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu dze, naaso ɔnam Nyankopɔn tum do tse ase. Na hɛn so yɛyɛ mberɛw wɔ no mu dze, naaso ɔnam Nyankopɔn tum do yɛnye no bɛtsena ase wɔ hom ntsi.
Hom mpɛnsapɛnsa hom mu nhwɛ dɛ hom wɔ gyedzi no mu anaa; hom nnunu homho nhwɛ. Anaa hom nnyim dɛ Jesus Christ tse hom mu? Gyedɛ gyama hom mmfora.
Na m'enyi da do dɛ hom bohu dɛ hɛndze yɛnnyɛ nyimpa a wɔmmfora.
Na yeyi Nyankopɔn mpaa dɛ mma hom nnyɛ bɔn bi; nnyɛ dɛ ama woeehu hɛn dɛ yɛfora, na mbom dɛ ama hom aayɛ dza ɔyɛ fɛw, na hɛndze yaayɛ dɛ hɔn a wɔfora mpo.
Na yenntum nnyɛ hwee nntsia nokwar no, na mbom yɛyɛ ma nokwar no.
Na sɛ yɛyɛ mberɛw ma hom yɛ dzen a, yedzi dɛw; iyiara so ntsi na yeyi mpaa, hom emudzi a.
Iyiara ntsi na minnyi hom nkyɛn yi mekyerɛw yi mebrɛ hom, na sɛ meba a, menye hom eemmbedzi no pasaa, dɛ mbrɛ tum a Ewuradze dze maa me wɔ ntowdo na nnyɛ dwuruw bi ntsi no tse.
Nkaa no dze, enuanom, hom ndzi dɛw; hom ndzi mu; hom werɛ nkyekye; hom nyɛ adwenkor; hom ntsena asomdwee mu; na ɔdɔ nye asomdwee Nyankopɔn nye hom bɛtsena.
Hom mfa mfewamo krɔnkrɔn nkyiakyia homho.
Ahotsewfo nyina kyiakyia hom.
Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ adom, Onyankopɔn dɔ, nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn anyɛnkoyɛ nkã hom nyina.

1: Ɔpanyin no dze kɛma ewuraba a wɔsan mu eyi no nye ne mba a modɔ hɔn nokwar mu no; na nnyɛ mo nko, na hɔn a wonyim nokwar no nyina so;
wɔ nokwar no a ɔtse hɛn mu, na ɔnye hɛn bɛtsena daa ntsi:
Adom, ehumbɔbɔr, asomdwee mfi Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Christ, Egya no ne Ba no hɔ, mbra hɛn do wɔ nokwar nye dɔ mu.
Midzi dɛw kɛse, dɛ mehu wo mba dɛ wɔnam nokwar mu, dɛ mbrɛ yeenya ahyɛdze wɔ Egya no hɔ no.
Na afei, Ewuraba, meserɛ wo, nnyɛ dɛ merekyerɛw wo ahyɛdze fofor, na mbom dza ofi ahyɛse no yenyae no a, dɛ yɛndodɔ hɛnho.
Na iyi nye dɔ, dɛ yɛbɛnantsew dɛ mbrɛ n'ahyɛdze no tse. Iyi nye ahyɛdze no dɛ, mbrɛ hom fi ahyɛse tsee no, hom bɛnantsew do.
Na ndaadaafo pii aba wiadze, hɔn a wɔmmpaa mu nnkã dɛ Jesus Christ aba wɔ honam mu. Oyi nye ɔdaadaafo nye antichrist no nye no.
Hom nhwɛ homho yie, na yaannyew dza yɛayɛ edwuma enya no, na mbom yeenya akatua mu wɔ mu.
Obiara a odzi kan na ɔnntsena Christ nkyerɛkyerɛ mu no, onnyi Nyankopɔn: Nyia ɔtse Christ nkyerɛkyerɛ mu no, ɔno na ɔwɔ Egya no nye ɔba no.
Sɛ obi ba hom nkyɛn na ommfua nkyerɛkyerɛ yi a, mma hom nngye no nnkɔ hom fie, eso mma hom nnkyia no;
na nyia okyuia no, ɔyɛ no dwuma bɔn no ho fafafo.
Mowɔ ndzɛmba pii a nkyɛ mekyerɛw mebrɛ hom dze, na memmpɛ dɛ medze krataa nye dubir mekyerɛw: Na m'enyi do dɛ mebɛba hom nkyɛn, na yɛdze ano na ano akasa na hɛn dɛw aahyɛ mã.
Wo nuabaa a wɔasan mu eyi no ne mba no kyia wo.
Na Ahab no wu ekyir no Moab tseew etūa wɔ Israel do.
Na Ahaziah nam n'abansor pia a ɔwɔ Samaria n'atenatokura mu bɔhwee famu, na ɔyaree: Na otuu abɔfo, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nkɔ, wonkebisa Ekron nyame Baal-zebub no kyerɛdɛ mobɔbɔ esu wɔ yarba yi mu.

Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no see Tishbinyi Elijah dɛ, soɛr, fow kɔ kehyia Samariahen n'abɔfoe no, na se hɔn dɛ, ana osiandɛ Nyankopɔn bi nnyi Israel ntsi, na hom rokɔ ekebisa Ekron nyame Baal-zebub no hɔ adze yi?
Dɛm ntsi afei mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, mpa no a afow no rimmfi do nnsian, na owu ara na ibowu. Na Elijah sii mu kɔree.
Na abɔfo no sanee baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom asan yi?

Na wɔsee no dɛ, ɔbarimba bi fowee behyiaa hɛn, na ɔsee hɛn dɛ, hom nsan nkɔ ɔhen a ɔsomaa hom no nkyɛn bio, na wɔnse no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, ana osiandɛ Nyankopɔn bi nnyi Israel ntsi, na asoma dɛ wonkebisa Ekron nyame Baal-zebub no hɔ adze yi? Dɛm ntsi mpa no a afow no irimmfi do nnsian famu, na owu ara na ibowu.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔbarimba a ɔfowee bae behyiaa hom no, na ɔkãa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ hom no tse dɛn?
Na wobuaa no dɛ, ɔyɛ nyimpa a no ho yɛ nhwi nhwi, na nwoma abɔdo bɔ n'asen. Na ɔsee dɛ, Tishbinyi Elijah a.
Nna ɔhen no somaa eduonum do safohen nye n'aduonum no wɔ no hɔ. Na ɔfowee kɔr ne nkyɛn: Na, hwɛ, ɔtse koko no n'etsifi. Na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, Nyame nyimpa ɔhen se dɛ, sian bra.
Na Elijah buae see eduonum do ɔsafohen no dɛ, sɛ Nyame nyimpa nye me a, ogya mfi sor nsian mbɛhyew ɔwo na w'eduonum. Na ogya fi sor sianee bɛhyeew ɔno na n'eduonum no.
Na ɔsomaa eduonum do safohen fofor so nye n'eduonum wɔ no hɔ bio. Na obuae see no dɛ, Nyame nyimpa, mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, yɛ ntsɛm sian bra.
Na Elijah buae see hɔn dɛ, sɛ Nyame nyimpa nye me a, ogya mfi sor nsian mbɛhyew ɔwo na w'eduonum. Na Nyame gya fi sor sianee bɛhyeew ɔno na n'eduonum no.

Na bio ɔsomaa eduonum do safohen a otsīa ebiasa nye n'eduonum bio. Na eduonum do ɔsafohen a otsīa ebiasa no fowee kɔree, na ɔkɔkotoow n'anankoroma enyim wɔ Elijah n'enyim, paa no kyɛw, na ɔsee no dɛ, Nyame nyimpa, meserɛ wo, ma mo nkwa, na wo nkowaa eduonum yi hɔn nkwa nsom bo wɔ w'enyi do.
Hwɛ, ogya fi sor sianee bɛhyeew nkan no eduonum do asafohemfo beenu no nye hɔn eduonum eduonum no: Na afei ma mo nkwa nsom bo wɔ w'enyi do.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no see Elijah dɛ, enye no nsian nkɔ: Mma nnsuro no. Na ɔsoɛree, na ɔnye no sianee kɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn.

Na ɔsee no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, susuampa dɛ ɔwo asoma abɔfo dɛ wonkebisa Ekron nyame Baal-zebub hɔ ndze no, nna nnyɛ siantsir nye dɛ Nyankopɔn bi nnyi Israel a wokebisa n'asɛm bi a? Dɛm ntsi mpa no a afow no irimmfi do nnsian, na owu ara na ibowu.
Nna owuii dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm no a Elijah kãe no tse. Na Jehoram hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu wɔ Judahhen Jehoshaphat ne ba Jehoram n'afe a otsīa ebien no mu; osiandɛ onnyi ba.
Afei Ahaziah no ho nsɛm nkaa no, dza ɔyɛe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
2: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ewuradze rebɛfa Elijah ehum mu akɔ sor no, Elijah nye Elisha fi Gilgal sii mu kɔree.
Na Elijah see Elijah dɛ, meserɛ wo, tsintsim ha; na Ewuradze asoma me wɔ Beth-el. Na Elisha see dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase, na wo kra tse ase yi, mirinngya wo hɔ. Na wosii mu kɔr Beth-el.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo mba a wɔwɔ Beth-el no fiir edzi baa Elisha nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, ana inyim dɛ ndɛ Ewuradze rebɛfa wo wura efi wo tsir do akɔ a? Na ɔsee dɛ, nyew, minyim; hom nyɛ komm.
Na Elijah see no dɛ, Elisha, meserɛ wo, tsintsim ha; na Ewuradze asoma me Jericho. Na ɔsee dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase, na wo kra tse ase yi, mirinngya wo hɔ. Nna wɔbaa Jericho.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo mba a wɔwɔ Jericho no twee piin Elisha nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, ana inyim dɛ ndɛ Ewuradze rebɛfa wo wura efi wo tsir do akɔ a? Na obuaa dɛ, nyew, minyim; hom nyɛ komm.
Na Elijah see no dɛ, meserɛ wo, tsintsim ha; na Ewuradze asoma me Jordan do. Na ɔsee dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase, na wo kra tse ase yi, mirinngya wo hɔ. Na hɔn beenu no sii mu kɔree.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo mba no mu nyimpa eduonum sii mu kɔree kegyinagyinaa hɔn tsentsendo wɔ ekyirkyir: Na hɔn beenu no gyina Jordan ho.
Na Elijah faa n'egukɔnmu no, na ɔbobɔwee dze bɔɔ nsu no mu, na ɔpaae kɔr ha na ha, na hɔn beenu no nam asaase kɛsɛɛ do twae.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wotwae no, Elijah see Elisha dɛ, bisa dza menyɛ memma wo, ansaana wɔafa me efi wo nkyɛn akɔ. Na Elisha see dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma wo sunsum kyɛfa mbɔho mbra mo do.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ebisa adze a ɔyɛ dzen: Naaso sɛ ihu me aber a wɔrefa me efi wo nkyɛn a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛm ama wo; na sɛ annyɛ dɛm a, ɔnnkɛba dɛm.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔda ho ara nam rokɔ, na wɔrekasa no, hwɛ, ogya tseaseanam, na ogya mpɔnkɔ a ɔbɛpaa hɔn beenu nyina ntamu no puei; na Elijah nam ehum mu fowee kɔr sor.
Na Elisha hunii, na ɔtsēatsea mu dɛ, m'egya e, m'egya e, Israel ntseaseanam na no mpɔnkɔdofo e! Na oennhu no bio: Na osuoo nankasa ne ntar mu, na ɔtsetseew mu esinesin ebien.
Ɔfaa Elijah n'egukɔnmu no a ofi no ho gui no so, na ɔsaan n'ekyir begyinaa Jordan nsukɔn do.
Na ɔfaa Elijah n'egukɔnmu a ofi no ho gui no, dze bɔɔ nsu no mu, see dɛ, na Ewuradze, Elijah Nyankopɔn no wɔ hen? Na aber a ɔno so bɔɔ nsu no mu no, na ɔpaae kɔr ha na ha: Na Elisha twae.
Na aber a nkɔnhyɛfo mba a wɔwɔ Jericho wɔ ne tsentsendo hun no no, wɔsee dɛ, Elijah no sunsum edwir Elisha do. Na wɔbae behyiaa no, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze butuuw famu wɔ n'enyim.

Na wɔsee no dɛ, afei, hwɛ, mbarimba a wɔyɛ dzen eduonum wɔ wo nkowaa nkyɛn; yɛserɛ wo, ma wɔnkɔ nkɔhwehwɛ wo wura: Bɛyɛ na ibia Ewuradze no sunsum no ama no do kɔ dze no akɔto bepɔw bi do, anaa ɔbɔn bi mu. Na ɔsee dɛ, mma hom nnsoma.
Na aber a wɔhyɛɛ no ara ma ɔyɛɛ ahomtsew no, ɔsee dɛ, hom nsoma ɛ. Dɛm ntsi wɔsomaa mbarimba eduonum; na wɔkɔhwehwɛe ara ndaansa, na woennhu no.
Na wɔsanee baa ne nkyɛn, mber a otsintsimii wɔ Jericho no; na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ana mannse hom dɛ, mma hom nnkɔ?
Na Kurow no mu mbarimba no see Elisha dɛ, hwɛ, yɛserɛ wo, kurow yi ne dabea yɛ fɛw, dɛ mbrɛ mo wura hu yi: Na nsu no dze onnye, na asaase no pon mba.
Na ɔsee dɛ, hom mbrɛ me pɔr fofor, na wɔmfa nkyen ngu mu. Na wɔdze brɛɛ no.
Na ofiir edzi kɔr nsu no no nsunyiwa no ho, na ɔtoow nkyen guu mu, na ɔsee dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, masa nsu yi yarba; owu anaa mbapon bi rimmfi mu mmba bio.
Na wɔsaa nsu no yarba dze bodu ndɛ da yi, dɛ Elisha n'asɛm a ɔkãe no ara.
Na ofii hɔ sii mu kɔr Beth-el: Na aber a ɔnam kwan no do rofow akɔ no, mbofra nkakraba fi kurow no mu puei besii no atwetwe see no dɛ, fow ɛ, otsipaa; fow ɛ, otsipaa.
Na ɔhwɛɛ n'ekyir na ohun hɔn. Na ɔdze Ewuradze ne dzin paa hɔn. Na nsisiber beenu fi kwar no mu bae bɛtsetseew hɔn mu mbofra eduanan ebien.
Na ofii hɔ kɔr bepɔw Carmel do, na ofii hɔ so sanee kɔr Samaria.
3: Afei Judahhen Jehoshaphat n'afe a otsīa duawɔtwe no mu na Ahab ne ba Jehoram hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Samaria, na odzii hen mfe duebien.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do; na so ɔnntse dɛ n'egya, na ɔnntse dɛ ne nã: Osiandɛ oyii Baal n'edum no a n'egya yɛe no wɔ hɔ.
Naaso ɔdze noho bataa Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no ho; oemmfi ho emmfi.
Afei Moabhen Mesha yɛ nguannyɛmfo; na ɔmaa Israelhen no nguambaa mpem ɔha no nhwi, na ndwanyin mpem ɔha ho nhwi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ahab wui no, na Moabhen no tseew etūa wɔ Israelhen no do.
Na no mu no ɔhen Jehoram fiir edzi fii Samaria, na ɔkɛkaan Israel nyinara.

Na ɔkɔree kɔsomae ma wɔkɔr Judahhen Jehoshaphat nkyɛn, dɛ, Moabhen no atsew mo do etūa: Nna enye me bɔkɔ enye Moab akɔkõ a? Na ɔsee dɛ, mobɔkɔ: Metse dɛ ɔwoara, na me man tse dɛ wo man, mo mpɔnkɔ tse dɛ wo mpɔnkɔ.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ɔkwan mmuana do na yɛbɛfa akɔ? Na obuaa dɛ, Edom sar no do kwan no do a.
Nna Israelhen, na Judahhen, na Edomhen no sii mu kɔree: Na wokyiin nda esuon kwan: Na nsu nnyi hɔ mma dɔm no, na so mbowa a wodzi hɔn ekyir no.
Na Israelhen no see dɛ, annyɛ yie! Osiandɛ Ewuradze afrɛ ahemfo baasa yi ehyia dɛ oriyi hɔn akɛhyɛ Moab nsa.

Na Jehoshaphat see dɛ, ana Ewuradze nkɔnhyɛnyi bi nnyi ha a yebodua no do ebisa Ewuradze hɔ adze? Na Israelhen no no nkowaa no mu baako buae see dɛ, Shaphat ne ba Elisha a ohuee nsu guu Elijah ne nsa do no, na ɔwɔ ha.
Na Jehoshaphat see dɛ, Ewuradze n'asɛm wɔ ne nkyɛn. Nna Israelhen na Jehoshaphat na Edomhen no sianee kɔr ne nkyɛn.

Na Elisha see Israelhen no dɛ, ebɛnadze na menye wo wɔ yɛ? Kɔ w'egya no nkɔnhyɛfo no, na wo nã no nkɔnhyɛfo no nkyɛn. Na Israelhen no see no dɛ, dabida: Osiandɛ Ewuradze afrɛ ahemfo baasa yi ehyia dɛ oriyi hɔn akɛhyɛ Moab nsa.
Na Elisha see dɛ, dɛ dɔm Ewuradze a migyina n'enyim yi tse ase yi, ampa, sɛ nnyɛ Judahhen Jehoshaphat n'enyim na mohwɛ a, nkyɛ merennkyea m'enyi wɔ wo do, na so moronnhwɛ wo.
Na afei hom mfa ɔsankubɔfo mbrɛ me. Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔsankubɔfo no robɔ no, nna Ewuradze ne nsa baa no do.
Na ɔsee dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hom nyɛ ɔbɔn yi amona amona.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hom runnhu mframa, nkyii so hom runnhu nyankom, naaso nsu bɛhyɛ ɔbɔn no mã: Na hom anom, hom na hom fiembowa na hom adzesoambowa.
Na iyi so yɛ Ewuradze enyi do adze tootooba: Obeyi Moabfo no so ahyɛ hom nsa.
Na hom mbɔ kurow biara a wɔagye ho ban, na kurow biara a ɔyɛ fɛw, na wɔntow dua pa biara, na wonsisiw nsunyiwa nyinara, na hom mfa abo nsɛɛ asaase no tɔw pa biara.
Na ɔbaa dɛ anapa, bɛyɛ afɔrbɔber no, na, hwɛ, nsu fii Edom kwan do bae, na nsu hyɛɛ ɔman no mã.
Afei aber a Moabfo nyinara tsee dɛ ahemfo no wɔafow aba dɛ wɔnye hɔn robɔkõ no, wɔpoon hɔnho boaa ano, hɔn a wobotum emia akodze nyinara, na hɔn a wɔbor dɛm, na obegyinaa ɔhe do.
Na wɔsoɛɛr anapaatu, na ewia gyegyee nsu no do, na Moabfo no hun nsu no wɔ hɔn enyim tsentsendo dɛ ɔber dɛ bɔgya:
Na wɔsee dɛ, Iy bɔgya a; ampa ahemfo no nye hɔn edzi no dɔmpata, na woekuku hɔnho: Dɛm ntsi afei, Moab, hom nkɔ asadze no ho ɛ.
Na aber a wodur Israel nseraban ho no, Israelfo no soɛree kunkum Moabfo no, ma woguanee wɔ hɔn enyim: Na wɔhoom do kɔr kan wɔ asaase no mu dɛ worukuku Moabfo no.

Na wodwuruuw nkurow no; na nyimpa biara toow no ho kyeen asaasetɔw pa biara do hyɛɛ no mã; na wosisiiw nsunyiwa biara, na wotwitwaa ndua pa no nyinara: Kyerɛ Kirhareseth nko na wogyaa n'abo; naaso tsiabotofo no kotwaa ho hyiae, na wɔbɔɔ no.
Na aber a Moabhen hun dɛ ɔkõ no mu ayɛ dzen dodow ama no no, ɔfaa mbarimba ahaesuon a wɔtwe mfõwa kãa noho, dɛ ɔretsew mu akɔ Edomhen no nkyɛn: Na woenntum.
Nna ɔfaa ne ba panyin a nkyɛ ebedzi hen wɔ n'ananmu no, na ɔdze no bɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr wɔ fasu no do. Na ebufuw kɛsenara baa Israel do: Na wofii ne nkyɛn kɔree, na wɔsanee baa hɔnankasa hɔn asaase do.
4: Afei nkɔnhyɛfo mba yernom no mu ɔbaa bi kekaa mu frɛɛ Elisha, dɛ, w'akowaa mo kun no oewo: Nna ɔwoara inyim dɛ w'akowaa suro Ewuradze: Na ɔdzefirfo no aba rebɛfa me mba beenu akɛyɛ no nkowaa.
Na Elisha see no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na menyɛ memma wo? Kã kyerɛ me; ebɛnadze na ewɔ no wɔ wo fie? Na ɔsee dɛ, w'afonabaa nnyi adze biara wɔ fie dɛ ngo ehina ara.
Nna ɔsee dɛ, kɔ, kɛfemfɛm nkuraba ehuw mu wɔ wo mfɛfo nyinara hɔ, mekyerɛ nkuraba pan; femfɛm nnyɛ kuma.
Na kɔ dan no mu, kɔtow ɔwo na wo mba abow mu, na huehue gugu nkuraba no nyinara mu; na fa dza ɔayɛ mã no sisi nkyɛn.
Na ofii ne nkyɛn kɔree, na ɔkɔtoow ɔno na ne mba no abow mu; wɔdze nkuraba no brɛɛ no, na ohuehuei.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a nkuraba no yeyɛɛ amaama no, nna ɔsee ne ba dɛ, fa kuraba bi so brɛ me. Na ɔsee no dɛ, kuraba nnyi hɔ bio. Na ngo no twae.
Nna ɔbae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ Nyame nyimpa no. Na ɔsee dɛ, kɔ kɔtɔn ngo no, na tua wo kaw, na ɔwo na wo mba ndzi ne nkaa no ntsena ase.
Na ɔbaa da bi dɛ, Elisha twaa mu kɔr Shunem, mbrɛ ɔbaa kɛse wɔ; na ɔhyɛɛ no dɛ ondzidzi. Na ɔbaa dɛ, daa orutwa mu a, ɔman hɔ kedzidzi.
Na ɔsee no kun dɛ, afei hwɛ, mehu dɛ nyia otwa mu wɔ hɛn nkyɛn daa yi Nyame nyimpa krɔnkrɔn a.
Meserɛ wo, ma yɛnyɛ pia kakraba bi wɔ fasu no do; na ma yɛmfa mpa, na ɔpon, na egua, na kandzeadua nsisi mu hɔ mma no; na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ɔba hɛn nkyɛn a, ɔaman akɔ hɔ.
Na ɔbaa da bi dɛ ɔbaa hɔ, na ɔmanee kɔr pia no mu kɛdaa hɔ.
Na ɔsee n'akowaa Gehazi dɛ, kɛfrɛ Shunamnyi no ma ɔmbra. Na ɔkɛfrɛɛ no ma ɔbae no, ogyinaa n'enyim.

Na ɔsee no dɛ, afei se no dɛ, hwɛ, ɔwo edze ɔhaw yi nyinara ahaw woho ama hɛn; ebɛnadze na wɔnyɛ mma wo? Ebɛpɛ dɛ wɔkã wo ho asɛm kyerɛ ɔhen, anaa dɔm safohen no? Na obuaa dɛ, metse mankasa mo nkorɔfo mu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ebɛnadze mbɔ na wɔnyɛ mma no? Na Gehazi buaa dɛ, ampa onnyi ba, no kun so ayɛ akɔdaa.
Na ɔsee dɛ, kɛfrɛ no ma ɔmbra. Na ɔkɛfrɛɛ no ma ɔbae no, obegyinaa abow no ano.
Na ɔsee dɛ, afedan siseber yi mu no, ebɛyɛ ɔba etuu. Na ɔsee dɛ, dabida, mo wura, Nyame nyimpa, mma nndzi ator nnkyerɛ w'afonabaa.
Na ɔbaa no nyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin afedan no mu aber no ara mu, dɛ mbrɛ Elisha see no ara.
Na aber a abofra no nyinii no, da bi ɔbaa dɛ ofiir edzi kɔr n'egya nkyɛn etwitwafo no nkyɛn.
Na ɔsee n'egya dɛ, me tsir o, me tsir o. Na ɔsee n'akowaa dɛ, ma no do kɛma ne nã.
Na aber a ɔmaa no do no, na ɔdze no brɛɛ ne nã no, ɔkoo n'anankoroma do kodur wigyinae, na nkyii owui.
Na ofowee kɔree dze no kɔtoo Nyame nyimpa no ne mpa no do, na ɔtoow no abow mu, na ofiir edzi.
Na ɔkɛfrɛɛ no kun no, na ɔsee dɛ, meserɛ wo, kɛma me nkowaa no mu kor, na nsoaso mu kor, ma muntutu mbirika monkɔ Nyame nyimpa no nkyɛn, na mensan membra.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na epɛ dɛ ekɔ ne nkyɛn ndɛ da yi? Ɔnnyɛ bosoom fofor na ɔnnyɛ ahomgyeda so. Na ɔsee dɛ, oye.
Nna ɔhyehyɛɛ asoaso, na ɔsee n'akowaa dɛ, kã no kɔ kan; mma nngow mbirikatu no mu mma me, gyedɛ mese wo.
Nna osii mu kɔree, na obodur Nyame nyimpa no nkyɛn wɔ bepɔw Carmel do. Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Nyame nyimpa no hun no ekyirkyir no, nna ɔsee n'akowaa Gehazi dɛ, hwɛ Shunamnyi no na ɔwɔ noho no:
Afei meserɛ wo, tu mbirika hyia no kwan, na se no dɛ, ana wo ho ye? Ana wo kun ho ye? Ana abofra no ho ye? Na obuaa dɛ, oye.

Na aber a odur Nyame nyimpa no nkyɛn wɔ koko no do no, nna obosusuoo n'ananmu. Na Gehazi twee piin no dɛ orubosun no; na Nyame nyimpa no see dɛ, gyaa no: Na ne kra werɛ ahow wɔ no mu; na Ewuradze dze esuma me, na ɔannkã annkyerɛ me.
Nna ɔsee dɛ, ana mibebisaa mo wura hɔ ɔba bi? Ana mannse dɛ, mma nndaadaa me?

Nna ɔsee Gahazi dɛ, bɔ w'asen do, na fa mo poma no kitsa wo nsamu, na kɔ wo kwan: Sɛ ihyia nyimpa biara a, mma nnkyia no; na sɛ obiara so kyia wo a, mma nngye no do: Na fa mo poma no kɔto abofra no n'enyim.
Na abofra no ne nã no see dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase, na wo kra tse ase yi, merenndan wo nngya. Na ɔsoɛree dzii n'ekyir.
Na Gehazi twaa mu dzii hɔn enyim kɔree, na ɔdze poma no kɔtoo abofra no n'enyim; na ndze bi nnyi hɔ, na asoyɛ so nnyi hɔ. Dɛm ntsi ɔsanee kehyiaa no, na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, abofra no nnyanee.
Na aber a Elisha dur ofi no mu no, hwɛ, nna abofra no ewu, na wɔdze no ato ne mpa do.
Dɛm ntsi ɔkɔr dan mu, na ɔtoow hɔn beenu no abow mu, na ɔbɔɔ mpaa maa Ewuradze.
Na ɔfowee kɔree kobutuuw abofra no do, na ɔdze n'ano faam n'ano ho, na ɔdze n'enyiwa butuuw n'enyiwa do, na ɔdze ne nsa totoo ne nsamu: Na ɔkotoow no do; na abofra no no honam yɛɛ hyew.
Nna ɔsanee bae bɛnantseew ɔdan no mu dzii akɔnaaba prɛko; na ɔfowee kɔree, na ɔkɔkotowee wɔ no do: Na abofra no huntsii mpɛn esuon, na abofra no buee n'enyiwa.
Na ɔfrɛɛ Gehazi na ɔsee dɛ, kɛfrɛ Shunamnyi no ma ɔmbra. Nna ɔkɛfrɛɛ no. Na ɔbaa ne nkyɛn no, ɔsee dɛ, ma wo ba do.
Nna ɔkɔree kotwae hwee n'anan ho, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ famu; na ɔmaa ne ba do, na ofiir edzi.
Na Elisha baa Gilgal bio: Na ɔkɔm aba asaase no do; na nkɔnhyɛfo mba no tsetse n'enyim: Na ɔsee n'akowaa dɛ, Fa ɔsɛn kɛse no si do, na noa edziban ma nkɔnhyɛfo mba no.
Na ɔbaako fiir edzi kɔr haban mu dɛ ɔrekɛtsew fan, na okohun hamu haban bi, na ɔtsetseew do hamu efer ne tam mã, na ɔdze bae botwitwaa mu guu ɔsɛn a edziban wɔ mu no mu: Osiandɛ wonnyim.
Nna wohuei maa nyimpa no dɛ wondzi. Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a woridzi edziban no bi no, wɔkekaa mu see dɛ, Nyame nyimpa e, owu wɔ ɔsɛn no mu. Na woenntum enndzi bi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, nna wɔmfa isiam mbra ɛ. Na ɔtowee guu ɔsɛn no mu; na ɔsee dɛ, hue ma nkorɔfo no, ma wondzi. Na biribi bɔn bi nnyi ɔsɛn no mu.
Na ɔbarimba bi fi Baal-shalishah bae, na ɔdze nduadzewakan boodoo, atoko ntɔwmu eduonu, na eburow fofor wɔ no kotoku mu. Na ɔsee dɛ, fa ma nkorɔfo no, ma wondzi.
Na akowaa no see no dɛ, ebɛnadze a, aso memfa iyi minsi nyimpa ɔha enyim? Na ɔnodze ɔsee dɛ, fa ma nkorɔfo no ma wondzi; na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, wobedzi, na woegya bi.
Nna ɔdze sii hɔn enyim, na wodzii, na wogyaa bi, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm no tse.
5: Afei Syriahen no dɔm do ɔsafohen Naaman, ɔyɛ nyimpa kɛse wɔ no wura enyim, na ɔyɛ onyimnyamfo, osiandɛ ɔno na Ewuradze nam no do dzii konyim maa Syria: Na eso ɔyɛ nyimpa katakyi a ɔyɛ ndam, na mbom ɔyɛ kwatanyi.
Na Syriafo no efir edzi ekuwekuw mu akɔ, na wɔakɛfa abaawa kakraba bi ndɔmmum wɔ Israel asaase do aba; na ɔsom Naaman ne yer no.
Na ɔsee no wuraba dɛ, kɛtseankyɛ mo wura wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi a ɔwɔ Samaria no nkyɛn! Ɔno nkyɛ ɔbɛsa no kwata ma no.
Na obi kɔree kɛkãa kyerɛɛ no wura, dɛ, dɛm na dɛm abaawa a ofi Israel asaase do no se.
Na Syriahen no see dɛ, kɔ bra, kɔ na mobɔsoma ma wɔdze nwoma akɛma Israelhen no. Na osii mu kɔree, na ɔfaa dwetɛ talent du, na sika shekel mpem esia, na ntar hyɛpɛn du kitsae.
Na ɔdze nwoma no brɛɛ Israelhen dɛ, na afei nwoma yi du wo nsamu a, hwɛ, masoma m'akowaa Naaman wɔ wo hɔ ma aasa no kwata no ama no.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Israelhen no kenkaan nwoma no no, nna ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔsee dɛ, ana Nyankopɔn nye me, dɛ muboku na mama nkwa, na nyimpa yi rosoma ma ɔaaba mo hɔdɛ mensa nyimpa no kwata yi? Na, meserɛ hom, hom ndwen ho, mbrɛ oesi rohwehwɛ manso etsia me.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Nyame nyimpa Elisha tsee dɛ Israelhen atsetsew ne ntar mu no, nna ɔsomae ma wɔkɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn, dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na atsetsew wo ntar mu yi? Ma ɔmbra me nkyɛn ɛ, na obohu dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi wɔ Israel.
Nna Naaman nye no mpɔnkɔ ɔnye ne ntseaseanam bae, na obegyinaa Elisha ne fi abowano.
Na Elisha somaa abɔfo ma wɔnkɔr ne nkyɛn, dɛ, kɔ na koguar Jordan mu mpɛn esuon, na wo honam bɛsan aba wo ho, na wo ho efir.
Na Naaman no bo fuwii, na osii mu kɔree, na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, modween dɛ, obopue aba me nkyɛn ampa, na oebegyina hɔ abɔ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn ne dzin, na ɔdze ne nsa aserasera, na ɔasa kwatanyi no.
Ana Damascus esutsen, Abanah na Pharpar, nnye nnsen Israel nsu nyinara? Aso nkyɛ munnguar mu ma mo ho mfir? Nna ɔdaan noho na ɔdze ebufuw sii mu kɔree.
Na no nkowaa no twee pinii bɛkasaa kyerɛɛ no, see dɛ, m'egya, ana sɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi no kãa kyerɛɛ wo dɛ yɛ adze kɛse bi a, aso nkyɛ annyɛ bi a? Na mendze nkyii, sɛ ɔse wo dɛ, Koguar, na wo ho mfir a?
Nna osianee kɔree na ɔdze noho kɔbɔɔ Jordan mu, mpɛn esuon, dɛ mbrɛ Nyame nyimpa no n'asɛm no tse: Na no honam sanee baa dɛ abofra kakraba no honam, na no ho firii.

Na ɔsanee baa Nyame nyimpa no nkyɛn, ɔno na no kuw nyinara, na ɔbae begyinaa n'enyim: Na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ afei mehu dɛ Nyame bi nnyi asaase nyinara do, dɛ Israel nko: Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, gye w'akowaa ne nsamu akyɛdze.
Na ɔsee dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze a migyina n'enyim tse ase yi, merenngye bi. Na ɔhyɛɛ no dɛ ɔngye; na ɔpowee.

Na Naaman see dɛ, sɛ ɔnntse dɛm a, ɔno meserɛ wo, ma wɔmfa dɛtse asoaso-mpɔnkɔ beenu ndzesoa mma w'akowaa; osiandɛ ɔdzekɔr yi w'akowaa rommbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr anaa okum-afɔr mma enyame biara, dɛ Ewuradze nko.

Asɛm yi mu nko na Ewuradze mfa mfir w'akowaa; sɛ mo wura rokɔ Rimmon fie akɔsɔr wɔ hɔ, na ɔtwer me nsa do, na mobɔ mo mu adze wɔ Rimmon fie, sɛ mobɔ mo mu adze wɔ Rimmon fie a, Ewuradze mfa mfir w'akowaa wɔ asɛm yi mu.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, kɔ asomdwee mu. Nna osii mu fii ne nkyɛn kɔ kan kakra.
Na Nyame nyimpa Elisha n'akowaa Gehazi, see dɛ, hwɛ, mo wura egyaa Syranyi Naaman yi, dɛ ɔaangye ne nsamu dze ɔdze bae: Dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi, mubotu mbirika mafã no, na makɛgye no hɔ biribi.
Nna Gehazi tsiiw Naaman. Na aber a Naaman hun dɛ obi dze mbirika refã no no, ofii tseaseanam no mu dwirii behyiaa no, na ɔsee dɛ, asomdwee mu anaa?

Na ɔsee dɛ, asomdwee mu a. Mo wura asoma me dɛ, hwɛ, seseiara nkɔnhyɛfo mba no mu mberantsɛ beenu fi Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu aba me nkyɛn; meserɛ wo, ma hɔn dwetɛ talent kor, na ntar hyɛpɛn ebien.
Na Naaman see dɛ, pen na gye talent ebien. Na ɔhyɛɛ no, na ɔkyekyeer dwetɛ talent ebien wɔ nkotoku ebien mu, nye ntar hyɛpɛn ebien kã ho, na ɔdze soaa no nkowaa no mu beenu; na wɔsoso dzi n'enyim.
Na aber a odur koko no ho no, ɔgyee wɔ hɔn nsamu, na ɔdze maa esie wɔ fie: Na ogyaa mbarimba no kwan, na wosii mu kɔree.
Na ɔnodze ɔkɔree kegyinaa no wura enyim. Na Elisha see no dɛ, Gehazi, ifi hen nam? Na ɔsee dɛ, w'akowaa nnkɔr beebiara.

Na ɔsee no dɛ, ana aber a ɔbarimba no fi ne tseaseanam mu sanee dɛ oribehyia wo no, m'akoma nye wo annkɔ bi a? Ana aber a wɔgye sika, na wɔgye ntar, na olive nture na wenyin nture, na nguan na anantwi, na nkowaa na mfonabaa nye yi a?
Dɛm ntsi Naaman no kwata no bɛtakyer ɔwo, na w'asefo daa. Na ofii n'enyim kɔree dɛ kwatanyi fitaa dɛ esukwankyɛba.
6: Na nkɔnhyɛfo mba no see Elisha dɛ, afei hwɛ, beebi mbrɛ yɛtse wɔ w'enyim yi ɔyɛ heahea dodow ma hɛn.
Yɛserɛ wo, ma yɛnkɔ Jordan nkyɛn, na nyimpa biara nkɛfa mpuna wɔ hɔ, na yɛnyɛ beebi wɔ hɔ a yɛbɛtsena mma hɛnho. Na obuaa dɛ, hom nkɔ ɛ.
Na obi see dɛ, meserɛ wo, pen, na enye wo nkowaa nkɔ. Na obuaa dɛ, Mobɔkɔ.
Nna ɔnye hɔn sii mu kɔree. Na aber a wodur Jordan nkyɛn no, wɔtotoow ndua.
Na aber a ɔbaako rotow mpuna no, ekumatsir no hɔree kɔtɔɔ nsu no mu: Na ɔkekaa mu see dɛ, ewuo, mo wura! Wɔkɛfɛmee o.
Na Nyame nyimpa no see dɛ, ɔtɔɔ hen? Na ɔkyerɛɛ no fakor no. Na otwaa dua bi towee kyeen mu hɔ, na ɔyɛɛ dadze no ma ɔboree.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ma do fa. Nna ɔtseen ne nsa maa do.
Afei Syriahen no nye Israel bedzii akõ; na ɔnye no nkowaa faa apam, dɛ, dɛm na dɛm bea no do na mebɛkyer me nseraban.
Na Nyame nyimpa no somae ma wɔkɔr Israelhen no ne nkyɛn, dɛ, hwɛ yie ma innkotwa mu wɔ dɛm bea yi do; osiandɛ hɔ na Syriafo no risian aba.
Na Israelhen no somae ma wɔkɔr beebi mbrɛ Nyame nyimpa no kãa kyerɛɛ no na ɔbɔɔ noho wɔ hɔ, ɔnnyɛ prɛko na ɔnnyɛ mprɛnu so.
Na Syriahen no n'akoma tuu dodow wɔ asɛm yi ho; na ɔfrɛɛ no nkowaa no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ana hom nnkɛkyerɛ me hɛn mu nyia ɔwɔ Israelhen no n'afã?
Na no nkowaa no mu baako see dɛ, dabida, mo wura ɔhen: Mbom nkɔnhyɛnyi Elisha a ɔwɔ Israel no na ɔkã nsɛm a ɔwo ekã no wɔ w'adankyir no no, kyerɛ Israelhen ho.
Na ɔsee dɛ, kɔhwɛ mbrɛ ɔwɔ, ma monsoma ma wɔnkɛfa no mbra. Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, hwɛ, ɔwɔ Dothan.
Dɛm ntsi ɔsomaa mpɔnkɔ, na ntseaseanam, na dɔm kɛsenara ma wɔkɔr hɔ: Na wodur anago, na wotwaa kurow no ho hyiae.
Na aber a Nyame nyimpa no n'akowaa no soɛɛr ahanamakye na ofiir edzi no, hwɛ, dɔm nye mpɔnkɔ na ntseaseanam abɔ kurow no ho aprɔw. Na n'akowaa no see no dɛ, ao, mo wura! Na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn?
Na obuaa dɛ, mma nnsuro: Osiandɛ hɔn a wɔkã hɛn ho wɔdɔɔ sõ sen hɔn a wɔkã hɔn ho no.
Na Elisha bɔɔ mpaa see dɛ, Ewuradze, meserɛ wo, bue n'enyiwa ma onhu. Na Ewuradze buee aberantsɛ no n'enyiwa; na ohunii: Na, hwɛ, ogya mpɔnkɔ na ntseaseanam ayɛ mbepɔw no do mã abɔ Elisha ho aprɔw.
Na aber a wosianee baa ne nkyɛn no, Elisha bɔɔ mpaa maa Ewuradze, see dɛ, meserɛ wo, fa enyifura bɔ nkorɔfo yi. Na ɔdze enyifura bɔɔ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ Elisha n'asɛm no tse.
Na Elisha see hɔn dɛ, nnyɛ ɔkwan no bi nye yi, nkyii so nnyɛ kurow no bi nye yi: Hom ndzi m'ekyir, na memfa hom nkɔ ɔbarimba no a hom rohwehwɛ no no nkyɛn. Na ɔdze hɔn kɔr Samaria.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wodur Samaria no, nna Elisha see dɛ, Ewuradze, bue nyimpa yi hɔn enyiwa, ma wonhu. Na Ewuradze buee hɔn enyiwa na wohunii; na hwɛ, wɔwɔ Samaria finimfin.
Na aber a Israelhen no hun hɔn no, ɔsee Elisha dɛ, m'egya, ana mombɔ hɔn? Ana mombɔ hɔn?
Na obuaa dɛ, Mma mmbɔ hɔn: Ana epɛ dɛ ebɔ hɔn a edze w'afõwa na w'egyen afa hɔn ndɔmmum a? Fa edziban na nsu sisi hɔn enyim, ma wonndzi na wɔnnom, na wɔnkɔ hɔn wura nkyɛn.
Na ɔtoo pon kɛse maa hɔn: Na aber a wodzidzii na wɔnomee no, ogyaa hɔn kwan, na wosii mu kɔr hɔn wura nkyɛn. Na Syria ekuwekuw no wɔammba Israel asaase no do bio.
Na ɔbaa dɛ iyi n'ekyir, Syriahen Ben-hadad boaa no dɔm nyinara ano, na osii mu kɔree kotuaa Samaria.
Na ɔkɔm kɛse sii Samaria: Na, hwɛ, wotuaa no araa ma ɔdze kodur dɛ wɔtɔɔn asoaso ne tsir gyee ndwetɛbona eduowɔtwe, na aborɔnoma n'egyanan kab ebupɛn anan mu kor gyee ndwetɛbona enum.
Na aber a Israelhen no rutwa mu wɔ fasu no do no, ɔbaa bi tsēaa mu frɛɛ no, dɛ, mo wura ɔhen e, boa me.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ Ewuradze ammboa wo a, mibefi hen maboa wo? Ewuporowee no mu, anaa nsãtwer no mu a?
Nna ɔhen no see no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ɔyɛ wo? Na obuaa dɛ, ɔbaa yi see me dɛ, fa wo ba ma ma yendzi no ndɛ, na yeedzi mo so me ba ɔkyena.
Nna yɛnoa me ba no dzii: Na n'adzekyee mesee no dɛ, fa wo ba ma ma yendzi: Na ɔdze ne ba esuma.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen no tsee ɔbaa no ne nsɛm no, na ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu; (afei orutwa mu wɔ fasu no do); na nkorɔfo no hwɛe, na, hwɛ, ofura eyitam kata no honam enyi.
Nna ɔsee dɛ, Nyame nyɛ dɛm mma me, na bi so nkã ho, sɛ Shaphat ne ba Elisha ne tsir toa no do ndɛ da yi a.

Na Elisha dze ɔtse ne fie, na mpanyimfo no tsetse ne nkyɛn; na ɔhen no somaa nyimpa bi dzii n'enyim: Na ansaana ɔbɔfo no rudu ne nkyɛn no, ɔnoara see mpanyimfo no dɛ, ana hom ehu dɛ owudzifo ne ba yi asoma dɛ wombeyi me tsir wɔ do? Hom nhwɛ, sɛ ɔbɔfo no ba a, hom ntow abow no mu, na wompia no nkɔ abowano: Ana nnyɛ no wura n'ananadze tsim tsim na odzi n'ekyir no?
Na aber a ɔda ho nye hɔn rekasa no, hwɛ, ɔbɔfo no sianee baa ne nkyɛn: Na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, mbusu yi ofir Ewuradze hɔ; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mobɔtweɔn Ewuradze bio?
7: Na Elisha see dɛ, hom ntsie Ewuradze n'asɛm: Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, ɔkyena siseber yi wɔbɔtɔn isiam pa etwadze kor agye shekel kor, na atoko etwadze kor ebien agye shekel kor, wɔ Samaria kuropon ano.

Nna ɔsafohen no a ɔhen no twer ne nsa do no buaa Nyame nyimpa no see dɛ, hwɛ, sɛ Ewuradze reyɛ ntokura wɔ ɔsor mpo a, ana nkyɛ dɛm asɛm yi bɛba mu a? Na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, edze w'enyiwa bohu, na mbom innkedzi bi.
Afei akwatafo baanan wɔ kuropon no n'ahɛnee: Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na yɛretsenatsena ha araa dze ewuwu yi?

Sɛ yɛse dɛ, yɛbɛhɛn kurow no mu a, ɔnodze ɔkɔm no wɔ kurow no mu, na yebowuwu wɔ hɔ: Na sɛ yɛda ho tsetse ha a, eso yebowuwu. Dɛm ntsi afei hom mbra ma yɛnkɔhwe Syria dɔm no mu: Sɛ wɔgye hɛn nkwa a, yɛbɛtsena ase; na sɛ woku hɛn so a, nna yeewu ara.
Na wɔsoɛɛr adansaber no, dɛ wɔrokɔ Syriafo nsera mu: Na aber a wodur Syriafo nsera no ne patsia no, hwɛ, nna nyimpa biara nnyi hɔ.

Osiandɛ Ewuradze ayɛ ma Syriafo dɔm no atse ntseaseanam, na mpɔnkɔ, mekyerɛ dɔm kɛse nka: Na wɔasese hɔnho dɛ, hwɛ, Israelhen no akɔbɔ Hittifo ahemfo, na Egyptfo ahemfo ɔkopaa etsia hɛn, dɛ wɔmbra hɛn do.
Dɛm ntsi wɔasoɛr eguan adansaber no, na woegya hɔn asesee, na hɔn mpɔnkɔ, na hɔn nsoaso, mekyerɛ nsera no dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse no ara, na woeguan wɔ hɔn nkwa ntsi.

Na aber a akwatafo yi dur nsera no ne patsia no, wɔkɔr asese kor mu kedzidzii nomee, na wɔfaa dwetɛ, na sika, na ntar, na wɔkɔree dze kosumae; na wɔsanee bae bɛhɛɛn asese kor so mu, na wɔfaa hɔ so adze na wɔkɔree dze kosumae.

Nna wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, yɛrennyɛ no yie: Ndɛ da yi ɔyɛ nsɛmpa da, na yɛayɛ komm yi: Sɛ yɛtweɔn ma okodu anapa enyimtsetsewee a, sõ bi bɛda hɛn do: Dɛm ntsi afei hom mbra ma yɛnkɔ nkɛkã nkyerɛ ɔhen ne fifo.

Nna wɔbae bɛfrɛɛ kurow no n'abowanoahwɛfo no: Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, yɛkɔr Syriafo nsera mu, na, hwɛ, nyimpa biara, na nyimpa ndze biara so nnyi hɔ, gyedɛ mpɔnkɔ a wɔamontamontan hɔn, na nsoaso a wɔamontamontan hɔn, na asese no dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse no ara.
Na ɔfrɛɛ abowanoahwɛfo no; na wɔkɛkãa no wɔ ɔhen no ne fidua no mu.

Na ɔhen no soɛɛr anago no, an ɔsee no nkowaa dɛ, afei mebɛkyerɛ hom dza Syriafo dze ayɛ hɛn yi. Wonyim dɛ ɔkɔm dze hɛn; dɛm ntsi na woefi nsera no mu kɔ, dɛ wɔdze hɔnho rukosuma haban mu, dɛ, sɛ wofi kurow no mu pue a, yɛbɛkyekyer hɔn enyikan, na yɛakɛhɛn kurow no mu.

Na no nkowaa no mu baako buae see dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma binom mfa mpɔnkɔ nkaa a wɔaka wɔ kurow mu ha no mu enum, (hwɛ, wɔtse dɛ Israel nyimpadodow a wɔaka mu no nyinara; hwɛ, wɔtse dɛ Israel nyimpadodow a wɔahyew no nyinara): Na ma yɛnsoma ma yɛnhwɛ.
Dɛm ntsi wɔfaa ntseaseanam ebien kãa mpɔnkɔ ho; na ɔhen no somae ma wodzii Syriafo dɔm no ekyir, dɛ, hom nkɔ nkɔhwɛ.
Na wodzii hɔn ekyir kodur Jordan do: Na, hwɛ, ntar na ndzɛmba a Syriafo no atotow egu wɔ hɔn ntsɛmpɛ no mu ayɛ ɔkwan no nyinara do mã. Na abɔfo no sanee bae bɛkãa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no.
Na nkorɔfo no fiir edzi, na wɔkɔfoow Syriafo nsera no. Nna wɔtɔɔn isiam pa etwadze kor gyee shekel kor, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm no tse.

Na ɔhen no yii ɔsafohen no a ɔtwer no nsa do no dɛ ɔnhwɛ kuropon no ano: Na nkorɔfo no tsiatsiaa no do wɔ kuropon no mu, na owui dɛ mbrɛ Nyame nyimpa no see no, nyia ɔkasae wɔ aber a ɔhen no sianee baa ne nkyɛn no a.
Na obuaa no dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ Nyame nyimpa no kãa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no, dɛ, atoko etwadze ebien bɔsom shekel, na isiam pa etwadze kor bɔsom shekel, ɔkyena siseber yi wɔ Samaria kuropon ano;
na ɔsafohen no buaa Nyame nyimpa no see dɛ, hwɛ, sɛ Ewuradze reyɛ ntokura wɔ ɔsor mpo a, ana nkyɛ dɛm asɛm yi bɛba mu a? Na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, edze w'enyiwa bohu, na mbom irinndzi bi:
Na ɔbaa mu dɛmara maa no; osiandɛ nkorɔfo no tsiatsiaa no dɔ wɔ kuropon no mu, na owui.
8: Afei Elisha akã akyerɛ ɔbaa no a onyaan ne ba ma ɔbaa nkwa mu no, dɛ, soɛr, na ɔwo na wo fifo nkɔ, na kɛyɛ ɔhɔho wɔ beebiara a ibotum ayɛ ɔhɔho no: Osiandɛ Ewuradze afrɛ ɔkɔm; na ɔno so ɔbɛba asaase no do mfe esuon.
Na ɔbaa no soɛree, na ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Nyame nyimpa no n'asɛm no tse: Na ɔnye ne fifo sii mu kɔree, na ɔkɛyɛɛ ɔhɔho wɔ Philistiafo asaase do mfe esuon.
Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe esuon no n'ewiei no, nna ɔbaa no fii Philistiafo asaase do sanee bae: Na ofir edzi kosūi tɔɔ ɔhen no do dɛ ɔregye ne fi na n'asaase.
Afei na ɔhen no nye Nyame nyimpa no n'akowaa Gehazi rekasa, dɛ, meserɛ wo, kã ndzɛmba akɛseakɛse a Elisha ayɛ no nyinara kyerɛ me.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔrekã mbrɛ osii nyaan nyia owui ma ɔbaa nkwa mu no kyerɛ ɔhen no, nna, hwɛ, ɔbaa no a onyaan ne ba ma ɔbaa nkwa mu no, sūi tɔɔ ɔhen no do dɛ ɔregye ne fi na n'asaase. Na Gehazi see dɛ, mo wura, ɔhen, ɔbaa no nye yi, na ne ba a Elisha nyaan no ma ɔbaa nkwa mu no nye yi.
Na aber a ɔhen no bisaa ɔbaa no no, ɔkãa kyerɛɛ no. Nna ɔhen no yii ɔhwɛdofo bi maa no, dɛ, dan dza ɔyɛ nedze nyinara, na haban mu nduadzewa nyinara a ofi da a ogyaa asaase yi dze bodu sesei ma no.
Na Elisha baa Damascus; na Syriahen Ben-hadad yar; na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Nyame nyimpa no aba ha.
Na ɔhen no see Hazael dɛ, fa akyɛdze kitsa wo nsamu, na kɔ kehyia Nyame nyimpa no, na kodua no do bisa Ewuradze hɔ adze, dɛ, ana mobɔbɔ esu wɔ yarba yi mu a?

Nna Hazael sii mu kɔree kehyiaa no, na ɔfaa akyɛdze kitsae, mekyerɛ Damascus adze pa biara mu bi, efumpɔnkɔ eduanan hɔn adzesoa, na ɔbae begyinaa n'enyim see dɛ, wo ba Syriahen Ben-hadad, na ɔsomaa me wɔ wo nkyɛn, dɛ, ana mobɔbɔ esu wɔ yarba yi mu a?
Na Elisha see no dɛ, kɔ, kɛse no dɛ, esu dze ebɔbɔ ampa; naaso Ewuradze eyi akyerɛ me dɛ owu ara na ibowu.
Na ɔdze n'enyi tsiim no do hann kodur dɛ ɔyɛɛ no ahomtsew: Na Nyame nyimpa no sūi.

Na Hazael see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mo wura rusū yi? Na obuaa dɛ, osiandɛ minyim mbusu a edze bɔbɔ Israelmba: Ebɔtoto hɔn akoban mu gya, na edze afõwa bokuku hɔn mberantsɛ, na abobɔ hɔn nkɔkowaba egu famu, na apaapaa hɔn enyinsemfo mu.
Na Hazael see dɛ, na w'akowaa nye bɛn, ɔkraman yi a, dɛ ɔbɛyɛ adze kɛse yi? Na Elisha buaa dɛ, Ewuradze eyi akyerɛ me dɛ ɔwoara na ebɛyɛ Syria do hen.
Nna ofii Elisha nkyɛn sii mu kɔree na ɔbaa no wura nkyɛn; ɔno na ɔsee no dɛ, na Elisha see wo dɛn? Na obuaa dɛ, ɔkãa kyerɛɛ me dɛ, esu dze ebɔbɔ ampa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ n'adzekyee no, nna ɔfaa mpadotam no bɔɔ nsu mu dze kataa n'enyim, ma owui: Na Hazael dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Na Israelhen Ahab ne ba Joram n'afe a otsīa enum no mu, aber no a Jehoshaphat dzii Judahhen no, Judahhen Jehoshaphat ne ba Jehoram hyɛɛ ase dzii hen.
Aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii hen no nna oedzi mfe eduasa ebien; na odzii hen mfe awɔtwe wɔ Jerusalem.
Na ɔnantseew Israel ahemfo kwan do, dɛ mbrɛ Ahab fi yɛe no: Osiandɛ onyaa Ahab ne babaa yɛɛ ne yer: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do.
Naaso Ewuradze ammpɛ dɛ ɔsɛɛ Judah, osian n'akowaa David ntsi, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ no anohoba dɛ ɔbɛma no ne mba mu kandzea daa no.
Ne nda mu na Edom tseew etūa fii Judah ne nsaadze, na wɔkɛhyɛɛ hɔnara hɔn do hen.
Nna Joram twaa mu kɔr Zair, na ne ntseaseanam nyinara kã no ho: Na ɔsoɛɛr anago, na okunkum Edomfo a woetwa no ho ehyia, na ntseaseanam do asafohemfo no: Na nkorɔfo no guanguanee kɔr hɔn asesee mu.
Nna Edom tseew etūa fii Judah ne nsaadze, dze bodu ndɛ da yi. Nna Libnah so tseew etūa mber no ara mu.
Na Joram ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judahahemfo hɔn mber do nsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Joram nye n'egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no kaa n'egyanom ho wɔ David kurow mu: Na ne ba Ahaziah dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Israelhen Ahab ne ba Joram n'afe a otsīa duebien no mu, na Judahhen Jehoram ne ba Ahaziah hyɛɛ ase dzii hen.
Aber a Ahaziah hyɛɛ ase dzii hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu ebien: Na odzii hen afrenhyia wɔ Jerusalem. Na ne nã ne dzin dze Athaliah, Israelhen Omri ne babaa a.
Na ɔnantseew Ahab fi kwan do, na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ Ahab fi yɛe no: Osiandɛ ɔyɛ Ahab fie asew.
Na ɔnye Ahab ne ba Joram tuu sa wɔ Syriahen Hazael do wɔ Ramoth-gilead: Na Syriafo piraa Joram.

Na ɔhen Joram sanee baa Jezreel dɛ ɔrebɛyɛ n'epirakur a, aber a ɔnye Syriahen Hazael rokõ no a, Syriafo no piraa no wɔ Ramah no edur. Na Judahhen Jehoram ne ba Ahaziah sii mu kɔr dɛ ɔrokɔhwɛ Ahab ne ba Joram wɔ Jezreel, osiandɛ ɔyar.
9: Na nkɔnhyɛnyi Elisha frɛɛ nkɔnhyɛfo mba no mu baako na ɔsee no dɛ, bɔ w'asen do, na fa ngotoaba yi kitsa wo nsamu, na kɔ Ramoth- gilead.
Na sɛ idu hɔ a, hwehwɛ Nimshi ba Jehoshaphat ne ba Jehu wɔ hɔ, na kɔ dan mu, na ma ɔnsoɛr mfi no nuanom mu, na fa no kɔ mpiakyir pia mu.
Na nkyii fa ngotoaba no, na hue gu n'etsifi, na se dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, masera wo mahyɛ wo Israel do hen. Na Afei bue abow no, na guan, na mma nndzi gyina.
Nna aberantsɛ no, mekyerɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi aberantsɛ no, sii mu kɔr Ramoth-gilead.
Na aber a odurii no, nna, hwɛ, dɔm do asafohemfo no tsetse hɔ; na ɔsee dɛ, ɔsafohen, mowɔ nkra bi dze ma wo. Na Jehu see dɛ, edze ma hɛn nyinara mu woana? Na ɔsee dɛ, ɔsafohen, ɔwoara a.
Na ɔsoɛree, na ɔkɔr dan no mu; na ohuee ngo no guu n'etsifi, na ɔsee no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, se nye yi, masera wo mahyɛ wo Ewuradze ne man do hen, mekyerɛ Israel do a.
Na ɔwo bɔbɔ wo wura Ahab ne fi, ma meedzi mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no hɔn bɔgyaa, na Ewuradze no nkowaa no nyinara hɔn bɔgyaa ho wer wɔ Jezebel nsamu.
Osiandɛ Ahab ne fi nyina bɛsɛɛ: Na mubotwa Ahab mu abofra ɔbanyin biara akyen, na Israel mu nyia wɔatow no mu na nyia woegyaa no.
Na mebɛyɛ Ahab fi dɛ Nebat ne ba Jeroboam fi, na dɛ Ahijah ne ba Baasha fi.
Na nkraman bedzi Jezebel wɔ Jezreel asaase do, na obi nnyi hɔ a obesie no. Nna obuee abow no, na oguanee.
Nna Jehu fiir edzi baa no wura no nkowaa no nkyɛn: Na obi see no dɛ, asomdwee mu anaa? Ebɛnadze ntsi na ɔbɔdamfo yi ba wo nkyɛn yi? Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, homara wonyim ɔbarimba no na mbrɛ ne nsɛnkeka tse.
Na wɔsee dɛ, akɔhwi a; kã kyerɛ hɛn ɛ, na ɔsee dɛ, dɛm na dɛm nna ɔkãa kyerɛɛ me, dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, masera wo mahyɛ wo Israel do hen.
Nna wɔyɛɛ ntsɛm yiyii hɔn ntar dze hyehyɛɛ n'ase wɔ atwer no no ara do, na wɔhɛɛn abɛn, dɛ Jehu dzi hen.
Nna Nimshi ba Jehoshaphat ne ba Jehu paam Joram ne tsir do. (Afei Joram, noara na Israel nyinara, rohwɛ Ramoth-gilead do, osian Syriahen Hazael ntsi:

Na ɔhen Joram dze, ɔasan aba Jezreel dɛ ɔrebɛyɛ n'epirakur a, aber a ɔnye Syriahen Hazael rokõ no, Syriafo no piraa no no edur). Na Jehu see dɛ, sɛ hom adwen nye yi a, ɔno mma hom mma obiara mmfir edzi mmfi nsa nnguan mmfi kurow yi mu nnkɔ nnkɛkã no wɔ Jezreel.
Nna Jehu tsenaa tseaseanam mu sii mu kɔr Jezreel; osiandɛ hɔ na Joram da. Na Judahhen Ahaziah esian aba dɛ ɔrobɔhwɛ Joram.
Afei ɔweɔmfo gyina Jezreel abantsentsen no do, na ohun Jehu no kuw no dɛ ɔreba, na ɔsee dɛ, muhu kuw bi. Na Joram see dɛ, fa ɔpɔnkɔdonyi soma no ma onkehyia hɔn, na ma ɔnnkɛse dɛ, asomdwee anaa?

Nna obi tse ɔpɔnkɔ do sii mu kɔree kehyiaa no, na ɔsee dɛ, mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, asomdwee anaa? Na Jehu see dɛ, ebɛnadze na ɔwo nye asomdwee ewɔ yɛ? Dan woho kedzi m'ekyir. Na ɔweɔmfo no kãa dɛ, ɔbɔfo no ekodu hɔn nkyɛn, na ɔnnsan mmba.
Nna ɔsomaa nyia otsīa ebien so a ɔtse ɔpɔnkɔ do a okodur hɔn nkyɛn no, ɔsee dɛ, mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, asomdwee anaa? Na Jehu see dɛ, ebɛnadze na ɔwo nye asomdwee ewɔ yɛ? Dan woho kedzi m'ekyir.
Na ɔweɔmfo no kãa dɛ, ɔno so ekodu hɔn nkyɛn, na ɔnnsan mmba; na hɛnka no tse dɛ Nimshi ne ba Jehu ne hɛnka; na ɔkãa no abɔdam mu.

Na Joram see dɛ, hom nsiesie. Na wosiesiee ne tseaseanam. Na Israelhen Joram, na Judahhen Ahaziah fiir edzi, ɔbaako wɔ ne tseaseanam mu, na wofiir edzi dɛ worikehyia Jehu, na wokohun no wɔ Jezreelnyi Naboth n'asaase no mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Joram hun Jehu no, nna ɔsee dɛ, Jehu, asomdwee anaa? Na obuaa dɛ, ebɛn asomdwee a, dɛ wo nã Jezebel n'ehuhubra na n'abayidze ayɛ pii yi a?
Na Joram daan ne nsa, na oguanee, na ɔsee Ahaziah dɛ, Ahaziah e, nkɔnkɔnsa wɔ mu o.
Na Jehu dze n'ahɔdzen nyina twee n'egyen mu towee bɔɔ Joram wɔ n'abasa ntamu, na egyen-menaba no hwiraa n'akoma mu puei, na ɔhwee ne tseaseanam mu.

Nna Jehu see ne safohen Bidkar dɛ, ma no do, na kɔtow no kyen Jezreelnyi Naboth ne haban mu asaase no do: Na kaa aber a emi na ɔwo tse mpɔnkɔ do abɔ mu dzi n'egya Ahab ekyir no, mbrɛ Ewuradze sii na ɔdze atsɛmbusɛm yi too no do, dɛ;

Ampa mehu Naboth no bɔgyaa, na ne mba hɔn bɔgyaa ndeda ara, Ewuradze na ɔse; na mebɛhyɛ wo ananmu wɔ asaasetɔw yi do, Ewuradze na ɔse. Dɛm ntsi afei ma no do kɔtow no kyen asaasetɔw no do, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm no tse.

Na aber a Judahhen Ahaziah hun iyi no, ɔfaa ture mu dan kwan do guanee. Na Jehu tsiiw no, na ɔsee dɛ, wɔmbɔ ɔno so wɔ tseaseanam no mu: Na wɔbɔɔ no Gur afowee a ɔwɔ Ibleam ho no. Na oguanee kɔr Megiddo, na okowui wɔ hɔ.
Na no nkowaa no dze no nam tseaseanam mu kɔr Jerusalem, na wokesiee no wɔ n'asamandan mu kaa n'egyanom ho wɔ David kurow mu.
Na Ahab ne ba Joram n'afe a otsīa dubiako no mu na Ahaziah hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Judah do.
Na aber a Jehu baa Jezreel no, Jezebel tsee; na ɔkekãa n'enyiwa ho edur, na ɔkyekyeer ne tsir, na ɔhwɛɛ tokura mu.
Na aber a Jehu hɛɛn kuropon no mu no, nna ɔsee dɛ, asomdwee anaa? Ɔwo Zimri, wo wura no kumfo?
Na ɔmaa n'enyi do wɔ tokura no mu, na ɔsee dɛ, woana na ɔwɔ m'afã? Woana a? Na asaa beenu anaa baasa fi hɔ hwɛɛ no.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom ntow no nkyen famu. Nna wɔtoow no kyeen famu: Na no bɔgyaa no petsee fasu no, na mpɔnkɔ no ho: Na wɔdze anamɔn tsiatsiaa no do.
Na odur mu no, odzidzii na ɔnomee; na ɔsee dɛ, afei hom nkɔhwɛ ɔbaa a wɔapaa no no, na wonsie no; osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔhen ne babaa.
Na wɔkɔr dɛ worikesie no: Na woennhu no ho biribiara dɛ ne tsirdwerba, na n'anansa, na ne nsakum.
Dɛm ntsi wɔsanee bae bɛkãa kyerɛɛ no. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze n'asɛm a ɔnam n'akowaa Tishbinyi Elijah do kãe no nye yi, dɛ, Jezreel asaase do na nkraman bedzi Jezebel ne nam:
Na Jezebel no fun ayɛ dɛ efikyir wɔ haban enyi wɔ Jezreel asaase no do; amma wɔaannse dɛ, Jezebel nye yi.
10: Afei Ahab wɔ mbabanyin eduosuon wɔ Samaria. Na Jehu kyerɛɛw nwoma, na ɔsomae ma wɔdze kɔr Samaria dze kɛmaa Jezreel asafohemfo, mekyerɛ amampanyin no, na hɔn a wɔnyɛɛn Ahab ne mba no, dɛ,
Na afei sɛ nwoma yi du hom nkyɛn a, ɔnam dɛ hom wura ne mba wɔ hom nkyɛn, na ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔ, kurow a wɔabɔ ho ban so, na akodze wɔ hom nkyɛn no yi;
hom nhwehwɛ hom wura ne mba no mu nyia oye na ɔfata na wɔmfa no nsi n'egya n'ahengua no do, na hom nkõ mma hom wura fi.
Na wosuroo mbordo, na wɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, ahemfo beenu no enngyina n'enyim, na hɛndze yɛbɛyɛ dɛn egyina?

Na nyia ɔhwɛ fidua no do, na nyia ɔhwɛ kurow no do no, amampanyin no so, na hɔn a wɔnyɛɛn mba no, somae ma wɔkɔr Jehu nkyɛn, dɛ, yɛyɛ wo nkowaa, na dza ebɛhyɛ hɛn no nyinara yɛbɛyɛ; yɛrennyɛ nyimpa biara ɔhen: Ɔwoara yɛ dza oye wɔ w'enyi do.

Nna ɔkyerɛɛw hɔn nwoma a otsīa mpɛn ebien, dɛ, sɛ hom wɔ m'afã, na hom betsie me ndze a, hom mfa mbarimba no, hom wura ne mba no, hɔn etsir mbrɛ me nkyɛn ɔkyena siseber yi wɔ Jezreel. Afei ɔhen ne mba no a wɔyɛ nyimpa eduosuon no wɔwɔ kurow no mu nyimpa akɛse no a wɔnyɛn hɔn no nkyɛn.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a nwoma no dur hɔn nkyɛn no, nna wɔkyeer ɔhen ne mba no, na wokunkum hɔn, mekyerɛ nyimpa eduosuon no, na wɔdze hɔn etsir guguu nkɛntsɛn mu, na wɔsomae ma wɔdze kɛmaa no wɔ Jezreel.
Na ɔbɔfo bi bae bɛkãa kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, wɔdze ɔhen ne mba no hɔn etsir no aba. Na ɔsee dɛ, hom ngu no ekuw ebien wɔ kuropon ahɛnee no ano nkodu anapa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, anapa no, ofiir edzi kegyinae, na ɔsee ɔman no nyinara, dɛ, hom dzi bem: Hwɛ emi na mepaam mo wura ne tsir do, na mukum no: Na woana na okunkum woyinom nyinara?
Afei hom nhu dɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm a Ewuradze kãe no wɔ Ahab fi ho no mu biara ronntɔ famu: Na Ewuradze ayɛ dza ɔnam n'akowaa Elisha do kãe no.
Nna Jehu kum Ahab fie hɔn a wɔkae nyinara wɔ Jezreel, na ne nyimpa akɛse nyinara, na n'anyɛnko brɛbo, na n'asɔfoe, kodur dɛ oenngyaa no obiara ma ɔaannka.
Na ɔsoɛree fii hɔ sii mu dɛ ɔrokɔ Samaria. Na aber a ɔwɔ nguanhwɛfo dan a wosusua nguan ho wɔ ɔkwan no mu no,
Jehu nye Judahhen Ahaziah no nuanom no hyiae, na ɔsee dɛ, Woananom nye hom? Na wobuaa dɛ, Ahaziah no nuanom nye hɛn, na yerisian akɔ ekekyiakyia ɔhen ne mba, na ɔhembaa ne mba no.
Na ɔsee dɛ, hom nkyer hɔn enyikan. Na wɔkyekyeer hɔn enyikan, na wokunkum hɔn nguansusua dan no ho mona no ho, mekyerɛ nyimpa eduanan ebien; na oenngyaa hɔn mu biara.

Na aber a ofi hɔ sii mu rokɔ no, ohun Rechab ne ba Jehonadab dɛ ɔreba ebehyia no kwan: Na okyiaa no, na ɔsee no dɛ, ana w'akoma tsen, dɛ mbrɛ m'akoma tse wɔ w'akoma ho no? Na Jehonadab buaa dɛ, ɔtse dɛm. Sɛ ɔtse dɛm a, fa wo nsa ma me ɛ. Na ɔdze ne nsa maa no; ma ɔmaa no do kɔr ne nkyɛn wɔ tseaseanam no mu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Enye me nkɔ, na kɔhwɛ mo mbɔdzembɔ a mobɔ ma Ewuradze. Nna wɔmaa ɔnye no tsenaa ne tseaseanam no mu.
Na aber a odur Samaria no, okum hɔn a wɔkae maa Ahab wɔ Samaria no nyinara, kodur dɛ ɔsɛɛ no, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ Elijah no tse.
Na Jehu poon ɔman no nyinara hyiae, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ahab soom Baal kakra; na Jehu dze, ɔbɔsom no dodow.

Dɛm ntsi afei hom mfrɛ Baal nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara, n'asomfo nyinara, na n'asɔfoe nyinara, ma wɔmbra me nkyɛn; mma obiara nnka: Osiandɛ mowɔ afɔr kɛse mobɔ mema Baal; obiara a ɔbɛka no ɔrenntsena ase. Na Jehu dze, ɔyɛɛ no bradato mu ama ɔaasɛɛ Baal n'asomfo no.
Na Jehu see dɛ, hom ntsew ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn ho mma Baal. Na wɔpaae.
Na Jehu somae ma wokekyiin Israel nyinara mu: Na Baal n'asomfo no nyinara bae, ma nyimpa biara annka a ɔammba. Na Wɔbaa Baal fie; na Baal fi no yɛɛ mã fi tsir kɔ tsir.
Na ɔsee nyia ɔhwɛ ntardan do no dɛ, fa ntar brɛ Baal n'asomfo no nyinara. Na ɔdze ntar brɛɛ hɔn.
Na Jehu na Rechab ne ba Jehonadab sii mu kɔr Baal fie; na ɔsee Baal n'asomfo no dɛ, hom nhwehwɛ mu nhu mma Ewuradze no nkowaa mu obiara aammbɛka hom ho wɔ ha, gyedɛ Baal n'asomfo no nko.

Na wosii mu kɔr mu dɛ wɔrokɔbɔ hɔn okum-afɔr na ɔhyew-afɔr. Afei na Jehu ahyɛ mbarimba eduowɔtwe ama noho wɔ dan ekyir, dɛ, sɛ mbarimba a medze hɔn rehyɛ hom nsa yi mu biara fi nsa guan a, nyia ɔbɛma wɔakɔ no, no nkwa bɛhyɛ no nkwa ananmu.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, ntsɛmara a owiee ɔhyew-afɔr no bɔ no, nna Jehu see brampafo na asafohemfo no dɛ, hom nkɔ mu nkokuku hɔn; ma hom mma obiara mmfir edzi. Na wɔdze afõwa anomu kunkum hɔn; na brampafo na asafohemfo no totoow hɔn gui, na wosii mu kɔr Baal fie kurow no mu.
Na wɔdze Baal fie edum no puei bɛhyeew no.
Na wodwuruuw Baal no dum no guu famu, na wodwuruuw Baal ne fi no guu famu, na ɔyɛɛ no tseafi dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Dɛm na Jehu sɛɛ Baal fii Israel.
Naaso Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no dze, Jehu emmfi ekyir emmfi, ɔnye dɛ sika anantwimba a wɔwɔ Beth-el na Dan no.

Na Ewuradze see Jehu dɛ, osiandɛ ayɛ no yie dɛ ayɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ m'enyi do, na ayɛ Ahab fi dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔwɔ m'akoma mu nyinara tse no ntsi, wo mbabanyin a wofi wo mbasantsen a otsīa anan no mu bɛtsena Israel ahengua do.
Na Jehu annhwɛ yie dɛ ɔdze n'akoma nyinara bɛnantsew wɔ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn ne mbra do: Oemmfi Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no ho emmfi.
Nda no mu na Ewuradze hyɛɛ ase dɛ orukuw Israel do: Na Hazael kunkum hɔn wɔ Israel ntoaado nyinara;
ofi Jordan boka afamu, Gilead asaase no nyinara, Gadfo, na Reubenfo, na Manassehfo dze, ofi Aroer a ɔwɔ Arnon bɔnsa nkyɛn, mekyerɛ Gilead na Bashan.
Afei Jehu no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na ne mbanyinndam nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma mu?
Na Jehu nye n'egyanom kɛdae: Na wosiee no wɔ Samaria. Na ne babanyin Jehoahaz na odzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Na mber a Jehu dze dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Samaria no ɔyɛ mfe eduonu awɔtwe.
11: Afei aber a Ahaziah ne nã Athaliah hun dɛ ne ba ewu no, nna ɔsoɛree na ɔsɛɛ adehye asefo no nyinara.

Na ɔhen Joram ne babaa Jehosheba, Ahaziah n'akyerɛbaa no, ɔfaa Ahaziah ne ba Joash, na owiaa no fii ɔhen ne mba no a wokum hɔn no mu, mekyerɛ ɔno na ne gyegyefo, na ɔdze hɔn kɛhyɛɛ mpiakyir; na wɔdze no sumaa Athaliah, ma dɛm ntsi woennku no.
Na ɔnye no sumaa Ewuradze ne fie mfe esia: Na Athaliah yɛɛ ɔhembaa wɔ asaase no do.

Na afe a otsīa esuon no mu no Jehoiada somae ma wɔkɛfaa Carifo na brampafo mu ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no, na wɔdze hɔn baa ne nkyɛn wɔ Ewuradze fie; na ɔnye hɔn dzii ahyɛmu, na ɔmaa wɔkekãa ntam kyerɛɛ no wɔ Ewuradze fie, na ɔdze ɔhen ne ba no kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn, dɛ, adze a hom nyɛ nye yi: Hom mu nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor a ɔba mu ahomgyeda no, na wɔnyɛ ɔhen ne fi do hwɛ no n'ahwɛfo;
na nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor ntsena sur kuropon ano; na nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor ntsena brampafo ekyir kuropon no ano: Dɛm na hom nhwɛ ofi no do hwɛ no, na wɔnyɛ pampi.
Na hom mu ekuw ebien no, mekyerɛ hɔn a wofir edzi ahomgyeda no nyinara no, wɔnhwɛ Ewurazde ne fi do hwɛ no wɔ ɔhen no ho.
Na hom mbɔ ɔhen no ho aprɔw, nyimpa biara mfa n'akodze nkitsa ne nsamu; na nyia ɔbɛba akyerɛpɛn no mu no, wɔmma wonku no: Na hom ndzi ɔhen no nkyɛn aber a orupue, na aber a ɔreba fie.

Na ɔha ɔha do ɔsafohemfo no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɔfo Jehoiada hyɛe no nyinara: Na wɔfefaa nyimpa biara ne nyimpa, hɔn a wɔwɔ dɛ wɔba mu ahomgyeda no, kãa hɔn a wɔwɔ dɛ wofir edzi ahomgyeda no ho, na wɔbaa ɔsɔfo Jehoiada nkyɛn.
Na ɔsɔfo no yiyii mpeaa na akyɛm a ɔyɛ ɔhen David dze no a ɔwɔ Ewuradze fie no, memaa ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no.
Na brampafo no gyinagyinae, nyimpa biara n'akodze kitsa ne nsamu, ofi ɔdan no n'enyimfa afamu kodu ɔdan no n'abankum afamu, wɔ afɔrmbukyia no na dan no ho, bɔɔ ɔhen no ho aprɔw.
Na ɔdze ɔhen ne ba no fiir edzi, na ɔdze ahenekyɛw no soaa no, na ɔdze dase no maa no; na wɔhyɛɛ no hen, na wɔseraa no; na wɔbobɔɔ hɔn nsamu see dɛ, Nyame ngye ɔhen nkwa.
Na aber a Athaliah tsee brampafo na ɔman no hɔn gyigyeegye no, nna ɔbaa ɔman no nkyɛn wɔ Ewuradze fie:

Na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, ɔhen no gyina dum no ho, dɛ mbrɛ amambu no tse, na asafohen no na mbɛn no wɔ ɔhen no nkyɛn; na asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyinara enyi gyee, na wɔhɛɛn mbɛn. Nna Athaliah tsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔkekaa mu dɛ, nkɔnkɔnsa o, nkɔnkɔnsa o.

Na ɔsɔfo Jehoiada hyɛɛ ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no a wɔhwɛ dɔm no do no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mfa no mfa akyerɛpɛn no ntamu; na hom mfa afõwa nku nyia obedzi n'ekyir no: Na ɔsɔfo no see dɛ, mma mma wonnku no wɔ Ewuradze fie.
Nna wɔmaa no kwan; na ɔfaa ɔkwan a mpɔnkɔ nam do ba ɔhen no ne fie no do: Na hɔ na wokum no.
Na Jehoiada dze ahyɛmu too Ewuradze na ɔhen no na ɔman no ntamu, dɛ wɔnyɛ Ewuradze ne man; na ɔdze too ɔhen no na ɔman no so ntamu.

Na asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyinara sii mu kɔr Baal fie kobubuu no gui; n'afɔrmbukyia na n'ehonyi no, wobubuu no esinesin pasapasa, na wokum Baal no sɔfoe Mattan wɔ afɔrmbukyia no enyim. Na ɔsɔfo no hyehyɛɛ Ewuradze ne fi do ahwɛdofo.
Na ɔfaa ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo, na Carifo, na brampafo, na asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyinara; na wɔdze ɔhen no fi Ewuradze fie sianee bɛfaa brampafo kuropon ano ɔkwan no do baa ɔhen no ne fie.
Nna asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyinara enyi gyee, na kurow no mu dwee: Na wɔdze afõwa kum Athaliah wɔ ɔhen no ne fie.
Aber a Jehoash hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe esuon.
12: Jehu n'afe a otsīa esuon no mu na Jehoash hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen; na odzii hen mfe eduanan wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã dzin dze Zibiah a ofi Beer-sheba.
Na Jehoash yɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do, wɔ ne nda a ɔsɔfo Jehoiada kyerɛkyerɛɛ no wɔ mu nyinara.
Naaso mbea sorɔnsorɔm no dze woennyi no hɔ: Ɔman no daa ho bɔɔ afɔr na wɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do.

Na Jehoash see asɔfo no dɛ. Ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn ho sika nyinara a wɔdze ba Ewuradze fie kan mu sika, nkorɔfo a woetwa hɔn mu nyimpa baako ne tsibo hɔn sika, na sika a ɔba nyimpa biara n'akoma mu dɛ ɔdze bɛba Ewuradze fie nyinara no,
wɔmma asɔfo no hɔnara wɔngyegye, nyimpa biara ne manyimfo hɔ: Na wɔmpempam ofi no n'agow no, beebiara a wobohu hɔ gow bi no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, ɔhen Jehoash n'afe a otsīa eduonu ebiasa no mu no nna ɔsɔfo no mmpempaam ofi no n'agow no.

Na ɔhen Jehoash kɛfrɛɛ ɔsɔfo Jehoiada, na asɔfo nkaa no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom mmpempaam ofi no n'agow no yi? Dɛm ntsi afei mma hom nngyegye sika wɔ hom amanyimfo hɔ bio, na hom nyi mma ma wɔmfa mpempam ofi no n'agow no.
Na asɔfo no peen dɛ wɔrenngyegye ɔman no hɔ sika bio, nkyii so wɔremmpempam ofi no n'agow no.

Na ɔsɔfo Jehoiada faa adaka bi, na ofitsii n'ebuado no mu otokur, na ɔdze sii afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn, enyimfa afamu dɛ obi reba Ewuradze fie no: Na asɔfo a wɔhwɛ abow no ano no wɔdze sika a wɔdze ba Ewuradze fie no nyinara guu mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ wohu dɛ sika pii aba adaka no mu a, nna ɔhen ne kyerɛwnyi no na ɔsɔfopanyin no afow aba, na woebohue egu nkotoku mu na wɔakan sika a wohun no wɔ Ewuradze fie no.
Na wɔdze sika a woeker no hyɛɛ hɔn a wɔyɛɛ edwuma no a wɔyɛɛ hɔn Ewuradze fi do ahwɛdofo no nsa: Na woyii tuatuaa nduadwimfo na adansifo a wɔyɛɛ Ewuradze ne fi no ho edwuma no,
na abantofo na abotwafo, kaw, na dɛ wɔdze bɔtɔ ndua na abo a woetwa dɛ wɔdze bɛpempam Ewuradze fi no n'agow no, na adze a wɔhweer no wɔ ofi no ho dɛ wɔdze pempamee nyinara.
Na wɔammfa sika a wɔdze baa Ewurazde fie hɔ no mu bi annyɛ Ewuradze fie dwetɛmpokuwa, nsompokuwa mbɛɛsen, mbɛn, sika ndzɛmba biara anaa dwetɛ ndzɛmba:
Na wɔdze maa hɔn a wɔyɛɛ edwuma no, na wɔdze pempaam Ewuradze fi no.
Nkyii so wɔnnye nyimpa a wɔdze sika no hyɛɛ hɔn nsa dɛ wɔmfa mma hɔn a wɔyɛɛ edwuma no emmbu nkontaa: Osiandɛ wɔyɛɛ no nokwar mu.
Asodzi afɔr sika, na bɔn ho afɔr sika no dze, wɔaamfa ammba Ewuradzefie: Ɔyɛ ɔsɔfo no dze.
Nna Syriahen Hazael sii mu kɔree, na ɔnye Gath kɔkõe, na ɔfae: Na Hazael dze sii n'enyi do dɛ ɔrokɔfow akɔ Jerusalem.

Na Judahhen Jehoash faa ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn nyina a n'egyanom Judah ahemfo Jehoshaphat, na Jehoram, na Ahaziah yɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn no, na nankasa ne ndzɛmba a otui sii hɔ no krɔnkrɔn, na sika a wohun no wɔ Ewuradze fie, na ɔhen no ne fie ndzekoradze mu nyinara, na ɔsomae ma wɔdze kɛmaa Syriahen Hazael: Na ofii Jerusalem ho sii mu kɔree.
Afei Joash no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judah ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma mu?
Na no nkowaa soɛree, na wɔkɔr ne tsir do apam, na wokum Joash wɔ Millo dan ho, ɔkwan a ɔdze risian kɔ Silla no mu.
Na no nkowaa Shimeath ne ba Jozacar, na Shomer ne ba Jehozabad, bobɔɔ no, na owui; na wokesiee no kãa n'egyanom ho wɔ David kuruw mu: Na ne babanyin Amaziah dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
13: Judahhen Ahaziah ne ba Joash n'afe a otsīa eduonu ebiasa no mu no, na Jehu ne ba Jehoahaz hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Samaria, na odzii hen mfe duesuon.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, na odzii Nebat ne ba Jeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no no bɔn ekyir; oemmfi ho emmfir.
Na Ewuradze n'ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ Israel do, na oyii hɔn hyɛɛ Syriahen Hazael nsa, na Hazael ne ba Ben-hadad nsa daa.
Na Jehoahaz paa Ewuradze kyɛw, na Ewuradze tsiee no: Osiandɛ ohun Israel hɔn atseetsee, mbrɛ Syriahen no sii tseetsee hɔn.
(Na Ewuradze maa Israel ɔgyefo bi ma wofii Syriafo nsa ase firii: Na Israelmba no tsenatsenaa hɔn asesee mu, dɛ mbrɛ nkan no ɔtse.
Naaso woemmfi Jeroboam fi no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no ho, na wɔnantsewee wɔ mu: Na ɔkaa Asherah so wɔ Samaria).
Osiandɛ oenngyaa ɔman no mu bi amma Jehoahaz gyedɛ mpɔnkɔdofo eduonum, na ntseaseanam du, na anamɔnmufo mpemdu; na Syriahen no see hɔn, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn dɛ ewuporowee do huntuma.
Afei Jehoahaz no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na ne mbabanyindze, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Jehoahaz nye n'egyanom kɛdae; na wosiee no wɔ Samaria: Na ne babanyin Joash dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Judahhen Joash n'afe a otsīa eduasa esuon no mu nna Jehoahaz ne ba Jehoash hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Samaria na odzii hen mfe duesia.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do: Oemmfi Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn nyinara a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no ho emmfi: Na ɔnantsewee wɔ mu,
afei Joash no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na ne mbanyinndam a ɔdze nye Judahhen Amaziah kõe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Joash nye n'egyanom kɛdae; na Jeroboam tsenaa n'ahengua do: Na wokesiee Joash wɔ Samaria kãa Israel ahemfo no ho.
Afei na Elisha yar ne yarba a ɔdze wui no: Na Israelhen Joash sianee baa ne nkyɛn bosūu no, see dɛ, m'egya e, m'egya e, Israel ntseaseanam na no mpɔnkɔdofo e!
Na Elisha see no dɛ, kɛfa egyen na egyen-menaba: Na ɔkɛfaa egyen na egyɛn-menaba brɛɛ no.
Na ɔsee Israelhen no dɛ, fa wo nsa to egyen no do: Na ɔdze ne nsa too do. Na Elisha dze ne nsa guu ɔhen no ne nsa do.

Na ɔsee dɛ, bue boka afamu tokura no: Na obuei. Nna Elisha see dɛ, Tow: Na ɔtowee. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze no konyim egyen-menaba, mekyerɛ Syria do konyimdzi egyen-menaba: Osiandɛ ebɔbobɔ Syriafo wɔ Aphek araa ma ahyew hɔn ana.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Tase egyen-menaba no: Na ɔtasee. Na ɔsee Israelhen no dɛ, tow bɔ famu: Na ɔtowee bɔɔ famu mprɛnsa, na ogyaae.
Na Nyame nyimpa no no bo fuuw no, na ɔsee dɛ, nkyɛ ɔsɛ dɛ etow mpɛn enum anaa esia; ɔno na nkyɛ ebɔbɔ Syria araa ma ahyew no ana: Na afei dze mprɛnsa ara pɛr na ebɔbɔ Syria.
Na Elisha wui, na wosiee no. Afei afe no bae no Moabfo ekuwekuw botuaa asaase no.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a worikesie nyimpa bi no, nna, hwɛ, wohun kuw bi; na wɔtoow nyimpa no kyeen Elisha ne nda no no mu: Na ntsɛmara a nyimpa no kɛkãa Elisha ne mbiew no, nna onyanee, na ɔsoɛree gyinaa n'anan do.
Na Syriahen Hazael tseetsee Israel wɔ Jehoahaz ne nda nyinara mu.
Na Ewuradze doom hɔn, na ohun hɔn mbɔbɔr, na n'enyi sɔɔ hɔn, osian n'ahyɛmu a ɔnye Abraham, Isaac, na Jacob dzii ntsi, na ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔsɛɛ hɔn, nkyii so ɔanntow hɔn emmfi n'enyim enngu araa nye ndɛ.
Na Syriahen Hazael wui; na ne babanyin Ben-hadad dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Na Jehoahaz ne ba Jehoash kɛgyee Hazael ne ba Ben-hadad ne nsamu nkurow no a ɔdze akodzi gyee no wɔ n'egya Jehoahaz ne nsamu no. Mpɛn ebiasa na Joash bɔɔ no, na ɔdaan Israel nkurow no bae.
14: Israelhen Joahaz ne ba Joash n'afe a otsīa ebien no mu nna Judahhen Joash ne ba Amaziah hyɛɛ ase dzii hen.
Aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu enum; na odzii hen mfe eduonu akron wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Jehoaddin a ofi Jerusalem.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do, naaso ɔnntse dɛ n'egya David: Ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ n'egya Joash yɛe no nyinara.
Naaso mbea sorɔnsorɔm no woennyiyi no hɔ: Ɔman no daa ho bɔɔ afɔr na wɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, ntsɛmara a ahendzi no tsintsimii wɔ ne nsamu ara, nna okunkum no nkowaa a wokum n'egya ɔhen no:

Na ewudzifo no hɔn mba no dze oennku hɔn: Dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses ne mbra nwoma no mu tse a Ewuradze hyɛe no, dɛ, mma wonnku egyanom wɔ mba ntsi, nkyii so wonnku mba wɔ egyanom ntsi; na mbom nyimpa biara bowu wɔ nankasa no bɔn ntsi.
Ɔno na okum Edom mu mpemdu wɔ Nkyen Bɔnsa no mu, na ɔnam akodzi do gyee Sela, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Joktheel, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Nna Amaziah somaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Jehu ba Jehoahaz ne ba, Jehoash, Israelhen no nkyɛn, dɛ, bra, ma yendzi enyimhun.

Na Israelhen Jehoash somae ma wɔkɔr Judahhen Amaziah nkyɛn, dɛ, kɔkrɔnsoɛ a ɔwɔ Lebanon do no somae ma wɔkɔr cedar a ɔwɔ Lebanon do no nkyɛn, dɛ, fa wo babaa ma me babanyin ayewar: Na abowa bɔyafo bi a ɔwɔ Lebanon do bɔtwaa mu, na otsiatsiaa kɔkrɔnsoɛ no do.
Ampa ɔwoara na eku Edom, na w'akoma ama wo do: Fa tuw, na tsena fie; na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edze woho bɛgyegye me ama wo mbusu, ma aahwe ase, mekyerɛ ɔwo, na Judah kã wo ho?
Na Amaziah enntsie. Nna Israelhen Jehoash sii mu kɔree; na ɔno na Judahhen Amaziah wodzi enyimhun wɔ Beth-shemesh a ɔyɛ Judah dze no.
Na Judah gui wɔ Israel enyim; na woguaneguanee, nyimpa biara kɔr n'asesee mu.

Na Israelhen Jehoash kyeer Judahhen Amaziah, Ahaziah ba Jehoash ba no, wɔ Beth-shemesh, na ɔbaa Jerusalem bobubuu Jerusalem fasu no fi Ephraim kuropon ho dze kodur kutuwdo kuropon no ho, basafa ahaanan.
Na ɔfaa sika na dwetɛ nyinara, na ndzɛmba-ndzɛmba a wohun no wɔ Ewuradze ne fie, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze mu no nyinara, ɔnye dɔmhobafo no so, na ɔsanee kɔr Samaria.
Afei Jehoash ho nsɛm nkaa no, dza ɔyɛe, na ne mbanyinndam, na mbrɛ osii na ɔnye Judahhen Amaziah kõe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Jehoash nye n'egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no wɔ Samaria kãa Israel ahemfo no ho; na ne babanyin Jeroboam dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Na Judahhen Amaziah, Joash ba no, dzii hen mfe duenum wɔ Israelhen Jehoash, Jehoahaz ne ba no, no wu ekyir.
Afei Amaziah no ho nsɛm nkaa no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judah ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na wɔpaam ne tsir do wɔ Jerusalem; na oguanee kɔr Lachish: Na wɔsomae ma wotsiiw no kɔr Lachish, na wokokum no wɔ hɔ.
Na wɔdze no too mpɔnkɔ do bae: Na wosiee no wɔ Jerusalem kãa n'egyanom ho wɔ David kurow mu.
Na Judah ɔman no nyinara faa Azariah a oedzi mfe duesia no, na wɔhyɛɛ no hen wɔ n'egya Amaziah n'ananmu.
Ɔno na ɔkyekyeer Elath, na ɔdanee maa Judah, n'ekyir no ɔhen no nye n'egyanom kɛdae.
Judahhen Amaziah, Joash ba no, n'afe a otsīa duenum no mu no nna Joash ne ba Jeroboam Israelhen no hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Samaria, na odzii hen mfe eduanan biako.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do: Oemmfi Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no nyinara ho.

ɔno na ɔadan Israel he mae dze fi Hamath ahɛnee dze bodu Arabah mpoano, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn, n'asɛm a ɔnam n'akowaa, Amittai ne ba Jonah, nkɔnhyɛnyi a ofi Gath-hepher n'abaw do kãe no tse.
Na Ewuradze hun Israel ahohiahia, dɛ ɔyɛ wen dodow: Osiandɛ obiara nnyi hɔ a wɔatow no mu, anaaso woegyaa no, nkyii so ɔboafo bi nnyi hɔ ma Israel.
Na Ewuradze annse dɛ ɔbɛpepa Israel ne dzin efi ɔsor ase: Mbom ɔdze nam Joash ne ba Jeroboam n'abaw do gyee hɔn nkwa.

Afei Jeroboam no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na ne mbanyinndam, mbrɛ osii yɛɛ sa, na mbrɛ osii kɛgyee Damascus, na Hamath a ɔyɛ Judah dze no sanee maa Israel no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Jeroboam nye n'egyanom kɛdae, mekyerɛ Israel ahemfo no; na ne babanyin Zechariah dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
15: Israelhen Jeroboam n'afe a otsīa eduonu esuon no mu nna Judahhen Amaziah ne ba Azariah hyɛɛ ase dzii hen.
Aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii hen no nna oedzi mfe duesia; na odzii hen mfe eduonum wɔ Jerusalem; na ne nã ne dzin dze Jecoliah a ofi Jerusalem.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ dza n'egya Amaziah yɛe no nyinara tse no.
Naaso woennyi mbea sorɔnsorɔm no wɔ hɔ: Ɔman no daa ho bɔɔ afɔr na wɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do.
Na Ewuradze bɔɔ ɔhen no, ma ɔyɛɛ ɔkwatanyi dze kodur no wu da, na ɔkɛtsenaa nkyɛn ofi bi mu. Na ɔhen no ne ba Jotham na ɔhwɛɛ fidua no do, na obuu asaase no do nkorɔfo no atsɛn.
Afei Azariah no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judah ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Azariah nye n'egyanom kɛdae; na wosiee no kãa n'egyanom ho wɔ David kurow mu: Na ne babanyin Jotham dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Judahhen Azariah n'afe a otsīa eduasa awɔtwe no mu, na Jeroboam ne ba Zechariah dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Samariah abosoom esia.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ n'egyanom yɛe: Oemmfi Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no ho.
Na Jabesh ne ba Shallum paam ne tsir do, na ɔbɔɔ no wɔ ɔman no enyim kum no, na odzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Afei Zechariah no ho nsɛm nkaa no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu.
Iyi nye Ewuradze n'asɛm no a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ Jehu no, dɛ, wo mba dze kodu mbasantsen a otsīa anan do wɔbɛtsena Israel ahengua do. Na ɔbaa dɛm.
Jabesh ne ba Shallum hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Judahhen Uzziah n'afe a otsīa eduasa akron no mu; na odzii hen bosoom ara wɔ Samaria.
Na Gadi ne ba Menahem fi Tirzah sii mu baa Samaria, na ɔbɔbɔɔ Jabesh ne ba Shallum wɔ Samaria kum no, na odzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Afei Shallum no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na ne tsirdopam a ɔpamee no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu.
Nna Menahem fi Tirzah kɔbɔɔ Tiphsah, na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara, na n'ahe do: Osiandɛ woemmbue amma no no, dɛm ntsi ɔbɔɔ no; na mbaa a wɔwɔ mu a wonyinsenyinsen nyinara ɔpaapaae.
Judahhen Azariah n'afe a otsīa eduasa akron no mu nna Gadi ne ba Menahem hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do, na odzii hen mfe du wɔ Samaria.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do: Oemmfi Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no ho ne nda nyinara.
Assyriahen Pul soɛree baa asaase no do; na Menahem maa Pul dwetɛ talent apem, ma ne nsa aakã no akã no ho ma ɔaahyɛ ahendzi no dzen wɔ ne nsamu.

Na Menahem gyegyee Israel hɔ sika no tow, mekyerɛ mbarimba akatakyi ahonyafo no nyinara hɔ, ɔbarimba baako hɔ dwetɛ shekel eduonum, dɛ ɔdze rekɛma Assyriahen no. Nna Assyriahen no peem adze, na oenngyina asaase no do hɔ.
Afei Menahem no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Menahem nye n'egyanom kɛdae, na ne babanyin Pekahiah dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Judahhen Azariah n'afe a otsīa eduonum mu na Menahem ne ba Pekahiah hyɛɛ ase dzii Israel do hen wɔ Samaria, na odzii hen mfe ebien.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do: Oemmfi Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no ho.

Na ne safohen Pekah, Remaliah ne ba no, ɔpaam ne tsir do, na ɔbɔɔ no wɔ Samaria, wɔ ɔhen no ne fie aban no mu, ɔnye Argob na Arieh; na Gileadfo mu mbarimba eduonum kã no ho: Na okum no, na odzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Afei Pekahiah no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu.
Judahhen Azariah n'afe a otsīa eduonum ebien no mu na Remaliah ne ba Pekah hyɛɛ ase dzii Israel do hen wɔ Samaria, na odzii hen mfe eduonu.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do: Oemmfi Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no ho.

Israelhen Pekah ne nda no mu na Assyriahen Tiglath-pileser bae bɛgyee Ijon, na Abelbeth-maacah, na Janoah, na Kedesh, na Hazor, na Gilead, na Galilee, Naphtali asaase no nyinara; na ɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔr Assyria.
Na Elah ne ba Hoshea paam Remaliah ne ba Pekah ne tsir do, na ɔbɔɔ no kum no, na odzii hen wɔ n'ananmu, wɔ Uzziah ne ba Jotham n'afe a otsīa eduonu no mu.
Afei Pekah no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu.
Israelhen Pekah, Remaliah ne ba no, n'afe a otsīa ebien no mu na Judahhen Uzziah ne ba Jotham hyɛɛ ase dzii hen.
Aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii hen no na oedzi mfe eduonu enum; na odzii hen mfe duesia wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Jerusha, Zadok ne babaa a.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsɛn wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do: Ɔyɛɛ dɛ dza n'egya Uzziah yɛe no nyinara.
Naaso oennyiyi mbea sorɔnsorɔm no wɔ hɔ: Ɔman no daa ho ara bɔɔ afɔr na wɔhyew eduhuam wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do. Ɔno na osii Ewuradze fi abotsen sor dze no.
Afei Jotham no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔannkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judah ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Nda no mu na Ewuradze hyɛɛ ase dɛ ɔrosoma Syriahen Rezin, na Remaliah ne ba Pekak wɔ Judah do.
Na Jotham nye n'egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no kaa n'egyanom ho, wɔ n'egya David kurow mu: Na ne babanyin Ahaz dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
16: Remaliah ne ba Pekah n'afe a otsīa duesuon no mu na Judahhen Jotham ne ba Ahaz hyɛɛ ase dzii hen.
Aber a Ahaz hyɛɛ ase dzii hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu; na odzii hen mfe duesia wɔ Jerusalem: Na ɔannyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ n'Ewuradze Nyankopɔn enyiwa do, dɛ n'egya David.
Mbom ɔnantseew Israel ahemfo kwan do, nyew, na ɔmaa ne ba mpo faa gya mu, dɛ mbrɛ amanamamfo a Ewuradze tuu hɔn fii Israelmba enyim no hɔn ekyiwadze no tse.
Na ɔbɔɔ afɔr na ɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do, na akoko do, na dua momon biara ase.
Nna Syriahen Rezin na Israelhen Pekah, Remaliah ne ba no fowee baa Jerusalem dɛ wɔrobɔkõ: Na wɔkɔr Ahaz ntuae, na mbom woenntum enndzi no do nyim.
Aber no mu na Syriahen Rezin gyee Elath sanee maa Syria, na ɔpaam Jewfo no fii Elath: Na Syriafo no baa Elath, na wɔtsenaa hɔ, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Nna Ahaz tuu abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Assyriahen Tiglath-pileser nkyɛn, dɛ, meyɛ w'akowaa na wo ba: Fow bra bɛgye me fi Syriahen, na Israelhen a wɔasoɛr mo do yi nsamu.
Na Ahaz faa dwetɛ na sika a wohun no wɔ Ewuradze ne fie, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze mu, na ɔsomae ma wɔdze kɛmaa Assyriahen no dɛ ayɛyɛdze.
Na Assyriahen no tsiee no: Na Assyriahen no sii mu kɔr Damascus do, na ɔkɛgyee, na ɔfaa no mu nkorɔfo no ndɔmmum kɔr Kir, na okum Rezin.

Na ɔhen Ahaz sii mu kɔr Damascus dɛ orikehyia Assyriahen Tiglath-pileser kwan, na ohun afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ Damascus no: Na ɔhen Ahaz somae ma wɔdze afɔrmbukyia no su, na no nsusudo dɛ mbrɛ ne yɛbea nyinara tse, kɛmaa ɔsɔfo Urijah.
Na ɔsɔfo Urijah sii afɔrmbukyia: Dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔhen Ahaz somae ma wɔdze fi Damascus no tse no, dɛmara so na ɔsɔfo Urijah yɛe dze tweɔɔn ɔba a ɔhen Ahaz fi Damascus bae no.
Na Aber a ɔhen no fi Damascus bae no, nna ɔhen no bohun afɔrmbukyia no: Na ɔhen no twee piin afɔrmbukyia no ho, na ɔbɔɔ do afɔr.
Na ɔhyeew ne hyew-afɔr na n'edziban-afɔr, na ohuee no nom-afɔr, na ɔdze n'asomdwee afɔr bɔgyaa no petsee afɔrmbukyia no do.
Na boran afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ Ewuradze enyim no, oyii fii ɔdan no enyim dze fii n'afɔrmbukyia no na Ewuradze ne dan no ntamu, na ɔdze kesii afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn wɔ kwaamu afamu.

Na ɔhen Ahaz hyɛɛ ɔsɔfo Urijah, dɛ, Afɔrmbukyia kɛse no do na hyew anapa hyew-afɔr, na ewimbir edziban-afɔr, na ɔhen ne hyew-afɔr, na n'edziban-afɔr, kã asaase yi do ɔman nyinara hɔn ɔhyew-afɔr, na hɔn edziban-afɔr, na hɔn nom-afɔr ho; na fa ɔhyew-afɔr bɔgyaa no nyinara petse do: Na boran afɔrmbukyia no dze nsi hɔ mma me ma memfa nhwehwɛ adze.
Dɛm na ɔsɔfo Urijah yɛe, dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔhen Ahaz hyɛe no tse nyinara.
Na ɔhen Ahaz twitwaa ndaka no ne nhyehyɛmu no, na oyiyii eguarsɛn bo fii do; na oyii po no fii boran anantwi no a wɔwɔ n'ase no do, na ɔdze kesii abosɛwee bi do.
Na ahomgyeda ɔkwan a wɔakata do a wɔyɛe no ɔdan no mu, na ɔhen no n'ahɛnee a ɔwɔ guado no, ɔdanee kɔr Ewuradze ne fi no nkyɛn, osian Assyriahen no ntsi.
Afei Ahaz no ho nsɛm nkaa no, dza ɔyɛe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judah ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Ahaz nye n'egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no kãa n'egyanom ho wɔ David kurow mu: Na ne babanyin Hezekiah dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
17: Judahhen Ahaz n'afe a otsīa duebien no mu na Elah ne ba Hoshea hyɛɛ ase dzii Israel do hen wɔ Samaria, na odzii hen mfe akron.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do; naaso ɔnntse dɛ Israel ahemfo a wodzii n'enyim kan no.
Ɔno na Assyriahen Shal-maneser fowee baa no do; na Hoshea bɛyɛɛ n'akowaa, na ɔdze ayɛyɛdze brɛɛ no.

Na Assyriahen no hun tsirdopam wɔ Hoshea mu; osiandɛ ɔasoma abɔfo ma wɔakɔ Egypthen So nkyɛn, na ɔammfa ayɛyɛdze annkɛma Assyriahen no, dɛ mbrɛ nkyɛ ɔyɛ no afrenhyia afrenhyia no: Dɛm ntsi Assyriahen siankaa no, na ɔkyekyeer no kɔtoo efiadze.
Nna Assyriahen no fowee bae bɛfaa asaase no nyinara do, na osii mu kɔr Samaria, na obotuaa no mfe ebiasa.
Hoshea n'afe a otsīa akron no mu, na Assyriahen no gyee Samaria, na ɔfaa Israel kɔr Assyria, na ɔdze hɔn koguu Halah, na Habor, Gozan esutsen ho, na Mediafo nkurow mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛm, osiandɛ Israelmba ayɛ bɔn etsia Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn a oyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do, wɔ Egypthen Pharaoh ne nsaadze bae no, na woekosuro enyame fofor,
na wɔannantsew amanaman a Ewuradze tuu hɔn fii Israelmba enyim no hɔn ahyɛdze, na Israel ahemfo dza wɔyɛe no mu.

Na Israelmba no nam no nsumaa mu yɛɛ ndzɛmba a ɔnntsen tsiaa Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn, na wosisii mbea sorɔnsorɔm wɔ hɔn nkurow nyinara mu maa hɔnho, ofi aweɔmfo abantsentsen do kodu kurow a wɔagye ho ban do.
Na wosisii edum na Asherim wɔ koko tsentsen biara do, na dua momon biara ase;
na hɔ na wɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no nyinara do dɛ mbrɛ amanaman a Ewuradze tutuu hɔn fii hɔn enyim no yɛe; na wɔyɛɛ ndzɛmba fun dze yii Ewuradze ebufuw:
Na wɔsoom abosom a Ewuradze akã hɔn ho asɛm dɛ, mma hom nnyɛ dɛm adze yi no.

Naaso Ewuradze nam nkɔnhyɛfo nyinara, na adzehufo nyinara abaw do dzii Israel na Judah dase, dɛ, hom nsan mfi hom akwan bɔn ho, na wondzi me mbransɛm na m'ahyɛdze do, dɛ mbra a mehyɛɛ hom egyanom no nyinara a menam mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no abaw do mosomae ma wɔdze brɛɛ hom no.
Naaso wɔammpɛ dɛ wotsie, mbom wɔkyee hɔn kɔn, dɛ hɔn egyanom a wɔanngye Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn enndzi no hɔn kɔn.

Na wɔpoow n'ahyɛdze, na n'ahyɛmu a ɔnye hɔn egyanom dzii no, na ne dasee a odzii hɔn no; na wokedzii egyangyandze ekyir yɛɛ gyan, na wokedzii amanaman a wɔabɔ hɔn ho aprɔw no a Ewuradze ahyɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn ho dɛ mma wɔnnyɛ dɛ hɔn no ekyir.
Ma wɔpoow Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn ne mbransɛm nyinara, na wɔyɛɛ ogu ehonyi, mekyerɛ anantwimba ebien, na wɔyɛɛ Asherah, na wɔsɔɔr ɔsor dɔm nyinara, na wɔsoom Baal.
Na wɔmaa hɔn mbabanyin na hɔn mbabaa fefaa gya mu, na wɔdze bunkɔ na nkaberkyer yɛe, na wɔtɔɔn hɔnho dɛ wɔbɛyɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, dze eyi no ebufuw.
Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze no bo fuuw Israel dodoodow, na oyii hɔn fii n'enyi do: Obiara annka gyedɛ Judah ebusuakuw nko.
Judah so enndzi Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn ne mbransɛm do, na wɔnantseew Israel ahyɛdze a wɔyɛe no mu.
Na Ewuradze poow Israel asefo nyinara, na ohiahiaa hɔn ho, na oyii hɔn hyɛɛ asɛɛfo nsa, kodur dɛ ɔtoow hɔn fii n'enyi do gui.
Na ɔtseew Israel fii David fi ho; na wɔhyɛɛ Nebat ne ba Jeroboam hen: Na Jeroboam twee Israel fii Ewuradze n'ekyir dzi, na ɔmaa wɔyɛɛ bɔn kɛse.
na Israelmba nantseew Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔyɛe nyinara mu; woemmfi ho;
kodur dɛ Ewuradze yii Israel fii n'enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔnam no nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara abaw do kãe no. Nna wɔfaa Israel fii hɔnankasa hɔn asaase do kɔr Assyria, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.

Na Assyriahen no kɛfaa nyimpa fii Babylon, na Cuthah, na Avva, na Hamath na Sepharvaim bae, na ɔdze hɔn boguu Samaria nkurow mu hyɛɛ Israelmba no ananmu: Na wɔfaa Samaria, na wɔtsenatsenaa no nkurow no mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ hɔn hɔ ntsenae n'ahyɛse no mu no, woennsuro Ewuradze: Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze somaa ngyata wɔ hɔn mu a wokunkum hɔn mu binom.

Dɛm ntsi wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Assyriahen no, dɛ, amanaman a eyiyi na edze hɔn ebogu Samaria nkurow mu yi, wonnyim asaase no do Nyankopɔn n'amambra: Dɛm ntsi ɔasoma ngyata wɔ hɔn mu, na, hwɛ, worukuku hɔn, osiandɛ wonnyim asaase no do Nyankopɔn n'amambra.
Na Assyriahen no hyɛɛ dɛ, hom mfa asɔfo a hom dze hɔn fi hɔ bae no mu baako nkɔ hɔ; na hom mma wɔnkɔ nkɛtsena hɔ, na ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn asaase no do Nyankopɔn n'amambra.
Nna asɔfo no a wɔdze hɔn fi Samaria bae no mu baako bae bɛtsenaa Beth-el, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn mbrɛ wonsi na wonsuro Ewuradze.
Naaso ɔman biara yeyɛɛ hɔnankasa hɔn enyame, na wɔdze hɔn sisii mbea sorɔnsorɔm do adan a Samariafo yeyɛe no mu, ɔman biara wɔ hɔn nkurow a wɔtse mu no mu.
Na Babylonfo no yɛɛ Succoth-benoth, na Cuthfo no yɛɛ Nergal, na Hamathfo no yɛɛ Ashima,
na Avvafo no yɛɛ Nibhaz na Tartak, na Sepharvaimfo hyehyeew hɔn mba wɔ gya mu dze maa Adrammelech na Anammelech, Sepharvaim enyame no.
