Nna wosuroo Ewuradze, na wɔdze hɔn ara hɔn mu bi hyehyɛɛ mbea sorɔnsorɔm do asɔfo a wɔbɔɔ afɔr maa hɔn wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do adan no mu maa hɔnho.
Wosuroo Ewuradze, na wɔsoom hɔnankasa hɔn enyame, dɛ mbrɛ amnaman a wɔfaa hɔn fii hɔn mu bae no hɔn amambra tse.

Ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi ara wɔyɛ nkan no ndzeyɛɛ no: Wonnsuroo Ewuradze, nkyii so wɔnnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ahyɛdze, anaa hɔn mmom, anaa mbra no anaa mbrasɛm a Ewuradze hyɛɛ Jacob a ɔtoo no dzin Israel no ne mba no tse no;
hɔn na Ewuradze nye hɔn dzii ahyɛmu, na ɔbraa hɔn, dɛ, mma hom nnsuro enyame fofor, nkyii so wɔmmbɔ hom mu adze mma hɔn, na wɔnnsom hɔn, na wɔmmbɔ afɔr mma hɔn:
Mbom Ewuradze a ɔdze tum kɛse na abasa a wɔatsɛw mu yii hom fii Egypt asaase do bae no, ɔno na hom nsuro no, na ɔno na hom mbɔ hom mu adze mma no, na ɔno na hom mbɔ no afɔr:
Na ahyɛdze na mmom, na mbra na mbrasɛm a ɔkyerɛwee maa hom no, hom ndwen do nyɛ no daapem; na mma hom nnsuro enyame fofor:
Na ahyɛmu a menye hom edzi no mma hom werɛ mmfir; nkyii so mma hom nnsuro enyame fofor:
Mbom hom Ewuradze Nyankopɔn na hom nsuro no; na ɔno na obeyi hom efi hom atamfo nyinara nsamu.
Naaso woenntsie, na mbom wɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ nkan no hɔn amambra tse no ara.
Nna amanaman yi suroo Ewuradze, na wɔsoom hɔn sian ehonyi; hɔn mba so, na hɔn mba so mba, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom yɛe no, dɛmara so na wɔyɛ dze ebodu ndɛ da yi.
18: Afei ɔbaa dɛ Israelhen Hoshea, Elah ba no n'afe a otsīa ebiasa no mu no, nna Judahhen Ahaz ne ba Hezekiah hyɛɛ ase dzii hen.
Aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu enum; na odzii hen mfe eduonu akron wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Abi, Zechariah ne babaa a.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ dza n'egya David yɛe no tse nyinara.

Ɔno na oyiyii mbea sorɔnsorɔm, na obubuu edum no, na otwitwaa Asherah no gui: Na obubuu boran abowatsena a Moses yɛe no mu esinesin; osiandɛ ɔdze bodu nda no mu no nna Israelmba hyew eduhuam ma no; na ɔfrɛɛ no Nehushtan.
Ɔdze no werɛ hyɛɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no no mu; ma n'ekyir obiara nntse dɛ ɔno wɔ Judah ahemfo nyinara mu, nkyii so wɔ hɔn a wodzii n'enyim no mu.
Osiandɛ ɔdze noho bataa Ewuradze ho, oenngyaa n'ekyir dzi, mbom odzii ne mbransɛm a Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no do.
Na Ewuradze dzii n'ekyir; beebiara a ofiir edzi kɔree no ɔyɛɛ prɔmprɔm: Na ɔtseew etūa wɔ Assyriahen no do, na ɔannsom no.
Ɔno na ɔbɔɔ Philistiafo no kodur Gaza na n'ahe do, ofi aweɔmfo abantsentsen ho dze kodu kurow a wɔagye no ban no do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔhen Hezekiah n'afe a otsīa anan no a ɔyɛ Israelhen Hoshea, Elah ne ba no n'afe a otsia esuon no mu no, na Assyriahen Shalmaneser fowee baa Samariah do, na obotuaa no.
Na mfe ebiasa n'ewiei no nna wɔgyee: Mekyerɛ Hezekiah n'afe a otsīa esia no a ɔyɛ Israelhen Hoshea n'afe a otsia akron no mu no, nna wɔgyee Samaria.
Na Assyriahen no faa Israel kɔr Assyria, na ɔdze hɔn koguu Halah, na Habor, esutsen Gozan ho, na Mediafo nkurow mu:
Osiandɛ woenntsie hɔn Ewuradze Nyankopɔn ne ndze, mbom wɔtõo n'ahyɛmu, mekyerɛ dza Ewuradze n'akowaa Moses hyɛe no nyinara, na wɔammpɛ dɛ wotsie, na so wɔaayɛ.
Afei ɔhen Hezekiah n'afe a otsīa duanan no mu no na Assyriahen Sennacherib fowee baa Judah nkurow a wɔagyegye ho ban no nyinara do, na ɔbɛgyee.

Na Judahhen Hezekiah somae ma wɔkɔr Assyriahen no hɔ wɔ Lachish, dɛ, mayɛ bɔn; san fi mo do: Dza edze bɔto mo do no mobɔsoa. Na Assyriahen no twae maa Judahhen Hezekiah dɛ ontua dwetɛ talent ahaasa na sika talent eduasa.
Na Hezekiah dze dwetɛ a wohun no wɔ Ewuradze ne fie nyinara maa no.
Aber no mu na Hezekiah twitwaa Ewuradze n'asɔrfi no mbobow ho, na edum a Judahhen Hezekiah duraduraa ho no, no ho sika, na ɔdze maa Assyriahen no.

Na Assyriahen no somaa Tartan na Rab-saris na Rabshakeh ma wofi Lachish nye dɔm kɛsenara kɔr ɔhen Hezekiah nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalem. Na wɔfowee baa Jerusalem. Na aber a wɔfowee bae no, nna wɔbae begyinaa etsifi nsutaae a ɔwɔ ɔtanhofo haban no ne tsempɔn do, nsukã ho.
Na aber a wokehyiia ɔhen no, nna Hilkiah ne ba Eliakim a ɔhwɛ fidua no do no, ɔkyerɛwfo Shebnah, na Asaph ne ba ɔsɛnkaafo Joah, fiir edzi baa hɔn nkyɛn.
Na Rabshakeh see hɔn dɛ, afei hom nkã nkyerɛ Hezekiah dɛ, mbrɛ ɔhen kɛse, Assyriahen no se nye yi, awerɛhyɛmu bɛn nye iyi a edze wo werɛ ahyɛ mu yi?
Ɔwo ekã dze na ɔyɛ nsɛnhun, dɛ ɔsa ho egyinatu na ahoɔdzen wɔ wo hɔ. Afei woana na etwer no, ma atsew mo do etūa yi?
Afei, hwɛ, ɔwo etwer ndzɛmbir a ebu yi no poma do, mekyerɛ Egypt do a; ɔno no do na nyimpa bi twer a, ɔwɔ ne nsamu, na ohwira mu: Mbrɛ Egypthen Pharaoh tse dze ma hɔn a wɔtwer no nyinara nye no.

Na sɛ hom se me dɛ, yɛtwer Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn a: Ana nnyɛ ɔno na Hezekiah eyiyi ne mbea sorɔnsorɔm na n'afɔrmbukyia, na ɔase Judah na Jerusalem dɛ, afɔrmbukyia yi enyim wɔ Jerusalem na hom nsɔr no?
Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, enye mo wura Assyriahen no nkyiakyia, na memma wo mpɔnkɔ mpemebien, kyerɛ dɛ w'afamu ibotum ama nyimpa atsenatsena hɔn do.
Na ibodua dɛn mbɔ na etum adan mo wura no nkowaa nketseaba mu ɔsafohen kor n'enyi, na osian ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo ntsi, edze woho akɔtwer Egypt?
Ana afei mekwetsir Ewuradze na maba bea yi do dɛ merebɛsɛɛ no? Ewuradze na ɔsee me dɛ, fow kɔ asaase yi do, na kɛsɛɛ no.

Na Hilkiah ne ba Eliakim, na Shebnah, na Joah, see Rabshakeh dɛ, meserɛ wo, kasa kyerɛ wo nkowaa wɔ Syria kasa mu; na yɛtse: Na mma nnye hɛn nnkasa wɔ Judahfo kasaa mu, wɔ nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ fasu do no asomu.

Na Rabshakeh see hɔn dɛ, ana mo wura somaa me dɛ membɛkã asɛm yi nkyerɛ wo wura, na ɔwo a? Ana nnyɛ mbarimba a wɔtsetse fasu do no nkyɛn na ɔsomaa me bi a, dɛ wɔnye hom ndzi hɔnankasa hɔn egyanan, na wɔnnom hɔnankasa hɔn ho nsu?
Nna Rabshakeh gyinae, na ɔdze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu wɔ Judahfo kasaa mu, na ɔkãa dɛ, Hom ntsie ɔhen kɛse no, Assyriahen no, n'asɛm.
Mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, mma hom mma Hezekiah ndaadaa hom; na orunntum nngye hom mmfi ne nsamu:
Nkyii so mma mma Hezekiah mma hom nntwer Ewuradze, dɛ, ɔgye na Ewuradze bɛgye hom, na wɔremmfa kurow yi nnhyɛ Assyriahen nsa.

Mma hom nntsie Hezekiah: Na mbrɛ Assyriahen no se nye yi, hom nye me ndzi no hom abodweesɛm mu; na hom mfir edzi mbra me nkyɛn; na hom mu obiara ndzi no wenyindua, na n'adɔmbadua do bi, na hom mu obiara nnom nankasa no bura mu nsu;

nkodu dɛ mebɛba m'abɛfa hom akɔ asaase a ɔtse dɛ homankasa hom asaase yi do, eburow na nsã asaase, edziban na wenyin nture asaase, ngo-dua na ewo asaase, ma hom aatsena ase, na hom eennwu: Na mma hom nntsie Hezekiah, aber a ɔredaadaa hom, dɛ, Ewuradze bɛgye hɛn no.
Ana amanaman enyame no mu biara agye n'asaase efi Assyriahen nsamu pɛn?
Hamath na Arpad enyame no wɔwɔ henfa? Sepharvaim, hena, na Ivvah enyame no wɔwɔ henfa? Ana wɔagye Samaria efi me nsamu a?
Amanaman enyame nyinara mu woananom na wɔagye hɔn man efi me nsamu, ma Ewuradze rebɛgye Jerusalem efi me nsamu yi?
Na ɔman no kãa hɔn ano too mu, na woemmbua no asɛm biara: Osiandɛ ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm nye dɛ, mma wommbua no.
Nna Hilkiah ne ba Eliakim a ɔhwɛ fidua no do no, na ɔkyerɛwfo Shebna, na Asaph ne ba ɔsɛnkaafo Joah, dze hɔn ntar a wɔatsetsew mu baa Hezekiah nkyɛn, na wɔbɛkãa Rabshakeh ne nsɛm no kyerɛɛ no.
19: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen Hezekiah tsee no, nna ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔdze eyitam kataa no do, na osii mu kɔr Ewuradze ne fie.
Na ɔsomaa Eliakim a ɔhwɛ fidua no do no, na ɔkyerɛwfo Shebnah, na asɔfo no mu mpanyin no, wɔdze eyitam akatakata hɔn do, ma wɔkɔr Amoz ne ba nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah nkyɛn.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, mbrɛ Hezekiah se nye yi, ndɛ da yi ɔyɛ afona, na nkaenyim, na ebufuw da: Osiandɛ mba edu akõe mu, na ahoɔdzen nnyi hɔ a wɔdze bɔwo.

Annyɛ a w'Ewuradze Nyankopɔn bɛtse Rabshakeh a no wura Assyriahen no asoma no dɛ ɔmbɔsopa tseasefo Nyankopɔn no, ne nsɛm no nyinara, na ɔakã n'enyim wɔ nsɛm a w'Ewuradze Nyankopɔn atse no ntsi: Dɛm ntsi ma wo mpaabɔ do ma nkaa a wɔaka no.
Nna ɔhen Hezekiah no nkowaa no baa Isaiah nkyɛn.
Na Isaiah see hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ hom nkã nkyerɛ hom wura nye yi, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, mma nnsuro asɛm a atse no a Assyriahen no nkowaa dze abɛyeyaw me no.
Hwɛ, medze sunsum bi mebɛhyɛ no mu, na ɔbɛtse atsesɛm bi, na ɔasan akɔ nankasa n'asaase do; na mebɛma ɔatɔ wɔ afõwa ano wɔ nankasa n'asaase do.
Nna Rabshakeh sanee, na okohun dɛ Assyriahen reyɛ Libnah do sa: Osiandɛ ɔatse dɛ oetu efi Lachish.
Na aber a ɔtsee dɛ wɔrekã no wɔ Ethiopiahen Tirhakah ho dɛ, hwɛ, oefir edzi dɛ ɔnye wo robɔkõ no: Ɔsomaa abɔfo bio ma wɔkɔr Hezekiah nkyɛn, dɛ,
mbrɛ hom nkɛkã nkyerɛ Judahhen Hezekiah nye yi, dɛ, mma mma wo Nyankopɔn a edze wo werɛ atwer no no nndaadaa wo, dɛ, wɔremmfa Jerusalem nnhyɛ Assyriahen nsa.
Hwɛ, ɔwoara atse dza Assyria ahemfo dze ayɛ asaase nyinara, dɛ wɔasɛɛ hɔn pasapasa: Na ɔwo na wɔbɛgye wo anaa?
Ana amanaman a m'egyanom asɛɛ hɔn no enyame no agye hɔn, dɛ Gozan, na Haran, na Rezeph, na eden mba a wɔwɔ Telassar no?
Henfa na Hamathhen, na Arpadhen, na Sepharvaim kurow, na Hena, na Ivvahhen no wɔ?
Na Hezekiah gyee nwoma no wɔ abɔfo no nsamu, na ɔkenkanee: Na Hezekiah sii mu kɔr Ewuradze fie, na ɔkɛtsɛɛw mu wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na Hezekiah bɔɔ mpaa wɔ Ewuradze enyim, see dɛ, Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn a etse Cherubfo do, ɔwo nkotoo ara nye asaase do ahendzi nyinara do Nyankopɔn; ɔwo na ayɛ ɔsor na asaase.
Ewuradze e, brɛ w'aso adze, na tsie; Ewuradze e, bue w'enyiwa, na hwɛ; na tsie Sennacherib ne nsɛm a ɔdze asoma dɛ wɔmfa mbɔsopa tseasefo Nyankopɔn no.
Nokwar, Ewuradze, Assyria ahemfo asɛɛ amanaman na hɔn asaase,
na wɔatotow hɔn enyame egu ogya mu: Osiandɛ wɔnnyɛ enyame, na nyimpa nsaano edwuma a, dua na abo; dɛm ntsi na wɔasɛɛ hɔn.
Dɛm ntsi afei, hɛn Ewuradze Nyankopɔn e, mototɔ meserɛ wo, gye hɛn fi ne nsamu, ma asaase do ahenman nyinara nhu dɛ ɔwo nye Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, mekyerɛ ɔwoara nkotoo.
Nna Amoz ne ba Isaiah somae ma wɔkɔr Hezekiah nkyɛn dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi, susuampa dɛ abɔ me mpaa wɔ Assyriahen Sennacherib ho no, metsie wo.
Iyi nye asɛm a Ewuradze akã wɔ no ho: Ɔbaabun Zion babaa no ebu wo enyimtsia esi wo atwetwe; na Jerusalem babaa no awosow ne tsir wɔ wo do.
Woana na asopa no na ayeyaw no? Na woana do na ama wo ndze do na ama w'enyiwa do wɔ sor etsia no? Mense edze etsia Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no.

Ɔwo nam w'abɔfoe do asopa Ewuradze, na ase dɛ, medze me ntseaseanam dodow no na mobɔfow maba mbepɔw etsifi, akɔ Lebanon mu nohonoho ara; na mubotwitwa ne cedar atsentsen, na no kupresi ndua a wɔapa no megu: Na makɛhɛn n'etsiwatsiwa mu asoɛe, ne haban-ber kwaa no mu.
Emi na metutu mbura na manom amanandze nsu, na medze m'ananadze mobɔwew Egypt esutsen nyinara.
Ana enntsee mbrɛ medua na mayɛ no dadaada, na mifi tsetseberdo na mehyehyɛe? Afei na mebɛma aba mu dɛ ɔwo esɛɛ nkurow a wɔagyegye ho ban ma wɔadandan ekurofõ ekuwekuw.
Dɛm ntsi ekuromfõ no hɔn tum suar ntsi, hɔn akoma tui na hɔn enyim guu ase; wɔtse dɛ haban mu efuw, na haban momon, dɛ adantsifi efuw, na eburow a ɔahyew ansaana orutu mpon.
Na minyim w'asetsena, na wo mfiredzi, na wo mbamu, na wo dam a ebɔ wɔ mo do no.
Osian wo dam a ebɔ wɔ mo do, na w'enyimenamsɛm a afow ebodu m'asomu ntsi, medze nkwaba mebɛhyɛ wo hwen mu, na medze menyiamfrɛ mato w'ano, na mebɛsan wo ekyir afa ɔkwan a enam do bae no do akɔ.

Na iyi bɛyɛ wo asɛnkyerɛdze: Afe yi mu hom bedzi dza noara efifir, na afe a otsīa ebien no mu dza obefir noara mu epue; na afe a otsīa ebiasa no mu no hom ndua, na wombu, na wɔntsetsew wenyin nture, na wondzi mu aba.
Na Judah ofi mu nkaa a woefi nsa no wɔbɛgye ndwow akɔ famu bio, na wɔasow aba akɔ sor.
Osiandɛ Jerusalem ne nkaase bi befir edzi efi, na hɔn a wobefi nsa so efi bepɔw Zion do; Ewuradze ho mbɔdzembɔ na ɔbɛyɛ iyi.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze kã no wɔ Assyriahen ho nye yi, ɔremmba kurow yi mu, na ɔronntow hɔ egyen-menaba so, nkyii so ɔremmfa kyɛm mmba n'enyim, na so ɔronnhɔr pempe wɔ no do.
Ɔkwan a ɔnam do bae no, ɔnoara so na ɔnam do bɛsan akɔ, na ɔremmba kurow yi mu, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na mebɛper kurow yi na magye no nkwa, wɔ mankasa me ntsi, na m'akowaa David ntsi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ anago no ara, Ewuradze no bɔfoe fiir edzi kokunkum Assyriafo nseraban do nyimpa mpemɔha eduowɔtwe enum: Na aber a nyimpa soɛɛr anapaatu no, nna, hwɛ, hɔn nyinara ayɛ efun ewufo.
Nna Assyriahen Sennacherib fii hɔ, sii mu sanee, na ɔkɛtsenaa Nineveh.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔrosɔr wɔ ne nyame Nisroch fie no, nna Adrammelech na Sharezer dze afõwa kum no: Na wofii nsa guanee kɔr Ararat asaase do. Na ne babanyin Esar-haddon dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
20: Nda no mu na Hezekiah yaar owuyar. Na Amoz ne ba nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, siesie wo fie yie; na ibowu, na erenntsena ase.
Nna ɔdaan n'enyim kɔr ban ho, na ɔbɔɔ mpaa maa Ewuradze, dɛ,
ao Ewuradze, mototɔ serɛ wo, afei kaa, mbrɛ mesi na manantsew w'enyim nokwar na akoma a odzi mu mu, na mayɛ dza oye wɔ w'enyi do. Na Hezekiah sūu pii.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, ansaana Isaiah rifir edzi akɔ kurow no ne finimfin afamu no, Ewuradze n'asɛm baa ne nkyɛn, dɛ,

San bio, na kɛse me man do ɔpanyin Hezekiah dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze, w'egya David ne Nyankopɔn no, se nye yi, matse wo mpaabɔ, mehu wo nyinsuwa: Hwɛ, mebɛsa wo yarba: Da otsīa ebiasa no ebɔsoɛr akɔ Ewuradze ne fie.
Na medze mfe duenum mubogu wo nda do; na mebɛgye ɔwo na kurow yi mefi Assyriahen no nsamu; na mobɔbɔ kurow yi ho ban wɔ mankasa me ntsi, na m'akowaa David ntsi.
Na Isaiah see dɛ, Hom mfa adɔmba tɔw mbra. Na wɔfae dze bɔtoo pɔmpɔ no do, na ɔbɔɔ esu.
Na Hezekiah see Isaiah dɛ, ebɛnadze bɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze dɛ Ewuradze bɛsa me yarba, na dɛ mobɔkɔ Ewuradze ne fie da a otsīa ebiasa no?
Na Isaiah see dɛ, Iyi nyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze a ofi Ewuradze hɔ mma wo, dɛ Ewuradze bɛyɛ adze a ɔakã no: Ana sunsuma nkɔ enyim ntwerba du, anaa ɔnsan ekyir ntwerba du?
Na Hezekiah buaa dɛ, ɔyɛ har ma sunsuma dɛ ɔpem adze ntwerba du: Dabida, mbom ma sunsuma nsan ekyir afamu ntwerba du.
Na nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah tsēaa mu frɛɛ Ewuradze: Na ɔmaa sunsuma no baa ekyir afamu ntwerba du, wɔ Ahaz n'ewiadɔn do ntwerba a oesian dada no do.
Aber no mu na Babylonhen Berodach-baladan, Baladan ne ba no, somae ma wɔdze nwoma na ayɛyɛdze kɛmaa Hezekiah na ɔtsee dɛ Hezekiah yaree.

Na Hezekiah tsiee hɔn, na ɔkyerɛɛ hɔn ne ndzɛmba a ɔsom bo da no nyinara, dwetɛ, na sika, na nduhuam na ngo a ɔsom bo, na n'akodze dan, na dza wohun no wɔ n'akoradze nyinara mu: Biribi nnyi ne fie, na n'ahenman mu so a Hezekiah ammfa annkyerɛ hɔn.
Na nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah baa ɔhen Hezekiah nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, mbarimba yi se dɛn? Na wofi hen baa wo nkyɛn? Na Hezekiah see dɛ, wofi ekyirkyir ɔman bi mu wɔbae, mekyerɛ Babylon a.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ebɛnadze na woehu wɔ wo fie? Na Hezekiah buaa dɛ, dza ɔwɔ me fie nyinara woehu: Biribi nnyi m'akoradze mu a mammfa mannkyerɛ hɔn.
Na Isaiah see Hezekiah dɛ, Tsie Ewuradze n'asɛm.
Hwɛ, nda reba a dza ɔwɔ wo fie nyinara, na dza w'egyanom akora dze ebodu ndɛ da yi, wɔbɔsoa akɔ Babylon: Biribiara rennka, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na wo mba a wobefi wo mu a ebɔwo hɔn no mu binom wɔbɛfa hɔn akɔ; na wɔakɛyɛ Babylonhen no n'ahemfie asaa.
Nna Hezekiah see Isaiah dɛ, Ewuradze n'asɛm a akã no oye. Nkyii so ɔsee dɛ, ɔnntse dɛm bi a, dɛ asomdwee na nokwar bɛba me nda mu a?
Afei Hezekiah no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na ne mbanyinndam nyinara, na mbrɛ osii yɛɛ nsutaae, na nsukã, na ɔdze nsu baa kurow no mu no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judah ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma noo mu?
Na Hezekiah nye n'egyanom kɛdae: Na ne babanyin Manasseh dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
21: Aber a Manasseh hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no na oedzi mfe duebien, na odzii hen mfe eduonum enum wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Hephzi-bah.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ wiadzefo a Ewuradze tuu hɔn fii Israelmba enyim no hɔn ekyiwadze no tse.
Osiandɛ osii mbea sorɔnsorɔm a n'egya Hezekiah sɛɛ no no bio; na osisii afɔrmbukyia dze maa Baal, na ɔyɛɛ Ashera, dɛ mbrɛ Israelhen Ahab yɛe no, na ɔsɔɔr ɔsor dɔm nyinara, na ɔsoom hɔn.
Na osisii afɔrmbukyia wɔ Ewuradze fie a Ewuradze kãa ho asɛm dɛ, Jerusalem na medze me dzin mobɔto hɔ no mu.
Na osisii afɔrmbukyia dze memaa ɔsor dɔm nyinara wɔ Ewuradze fie abangua ebien no do.
Na ɔmaa ne babanyin faa gya mu, na ɔyɛɛ akɔmfodze, na ɔkyeer nkaber, na ɔnye asamamfrɛfo, na abayifo yɛe: Ɔbɔɔ mbusu pii wɔ Ewuradze enyi do dze yii no ebufuw.

Na ɔdze Asherah no siaan honyi a ɔyɛe no, sii ofi no mu, dza Ewuradze kãa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ David na ne ba Solomon dɛ, ofi yi mu, na Jerusalem a masan mu meyi no wɔ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu no mu na medze me dzin mobɔto daa no a:

Nkyii so meremma Israel hɔn anan nntu mmfi asaase a medze memaa hɔn egyanom no do nkekyin bio; sɛ wɔrodwen do ara reyɛ dɛ mbrɛ dza medze mahyɛ hɔn no nyinara tse, na dɛ mbrɛ mbra a m'akowaa Moses dze hyɛɛ hɔn no nyinara tse dze a.
Na woenntsie: Na Manasseh daadaa hɔn ma wɔyɛɛ dza omuo seen dza amanaman a Ewuradze sɛɛ hɔn wɔ Israelmba enyim no yɛe.
Na Ewuradze nam no nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no do kãa dɛ,
Osiandɛ Judahhen Manasseh ayɛ ekyiwadze yi, na ɔayɛ bɔn asen dza Amorifo a wodzii n'enyim no yɛe nyinara, na ɔdze n'abosom ama Judah so ayɛ bɔn no:
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi, hwɛ, medze mbusu mereba Jerusalem na Judah do a obiara a ɔbɛtse no, n'aso ebien nyina mu bɛyɛ no weɔɔ.
Na mobɔtwe Samaria esusuhoma mu, na Ahab fie promo mu maba Jerusalem do: Na mebɛpepa Jerusalem mu dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa pepa nkwansɛn mu, ɔpepa na ɔdan no butuw.
Na mubopuw m'egyapadze nkaa no, na meyi hɔn mahyɛ hɔn atamfo nsa; na wɔabɛyɛ afonam na asadze ama hɔn atamfo nyinara;
osiandɛ wɔayɛ dza omuo wɔ m'enyi do, na woeyi me ebufuw araa ofitsi da a hɔn egyanom fi Egypt bae, dze bodu ndɛ da yi mpo.
Nkyii so Manasseh kãa bɔgya a odzi bem piigyan gui, araa dze kodur dɛ ɔhyɛɛ Jerusalem mã fi ano kor kɛpeem kor so; ɔsor no bɔn a ɔdze maa Judah yɛɛ bɔn, dɛ wɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do.
Afei Manasseh no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na no bɔn a ɔyɛe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judah ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Manasseh nye n'egyanom kɛdae, na wosiee no wɔ nankasa ne fie ture no mu, wɔ Uzza no ture no mu: Na ne babanyin Amon dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Aber a Amon hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu ebien; na odzii hen mfe ebien wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Meshullemeth, Haruz a ofi Jotbah ne babaa a.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ n'egya Manasseh yɛe.
Na ɔnantseew ɔkwan a n'egya nantseew mu no nyinara mu, na ɔsoom abosom no a n'egya somee no, na ɔsɔɔr hɔn:
Na ɔpoow Ewuradze, n'egyanom Nyankopɔn no, na ɔannantsew Ewuradze no kwan mu.
Na Amon no nkowaa paam ne tsir do, na wokum ɔhen no wɔ nankasa ne fie.
Na asaase no do nkorɔfo no kunkum hɔn a wɔpaam ɔhen Amon ne tsir do nyinara; na asaase no do ɔman no hyɛɛ ne babanyin Josiah ɔhen wɔ n'ananmu.
Afei Amon no ho nsɛm nkaa no, dza ɔyɛe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judah ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na wosiee no wɔ n'asamandan no mu wɔ Uzza no ture no mu: Na ne babanyin Josiah dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
22: Aber a Josiah hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no na oedzi mfe awɔtwe; na odzii hen mfe eduasa biako wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Jedidah, Adaiah a ofi Bozkath ne babaa a.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze n'enyiwa do, na ɔnantseew n'egya David no kwan nyinara mu, na ɔanndan ammfa nkyɛn annkɔ enyimfa anaa abankum.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔhen Josiah n'afe a otsīa duawɔtwe no mu no, nna ɔhen no somaa ɔkyerɛwfo Shaphan, Meshullam ne ba Azaliah ne ba no, ma ɔkɔr Ewuradze ne fie, dɛ,
Fow kɔ ɔsɔfopanyin Hilkiah nkyɛn, ma ombu sika a wɔdze ba Ewuradze fie a abowanoahwɛfo no aboa ano efi ɔman no hɔ no ano:
Na ma wɔmfa nhyɛ adwumayɛfo a wɔhwɛ Ewuradze fie do no nsa: Na ma wɔmfa mma edwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ Ewuradze fie no ma wɔmpempam ofi no n'agow no;
wɔmfa mma nduadwimfo, na adansifo, na abantofo: Na wɔmfa ntotɔ ndua na abo a woetwa mfa mpempam ofi no.
Naaso wɔnnye hɔn emmbu sika a wɔdze hyɛɛ hɔn nsa no ho nkontaa; osiandɛ wɔyɛɛ no nokwar mu.
Na ɔsɔfopanyin Hilkiah see ɔkyerɛwfo Shaphan dɛ, mehu mbra nwoma no wɔ Ewuradze fie. Na Hilkiah dze nwoma no maa Shaphan, na ɔkenkanee.
Na ɔkyerɛwfo Shaphan baa ɔhen no nkyɛn, na ɔdze asɛm brɛɛ ɔhen no bio, see dɛ, wo nkowaa ehue sika no a wohun no ofi no mu no, na woeyi ahyɛ edwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ Ewuradze fi do ahwɛdofo no nsa.
Na ɔkyerɛwfo Shaphan kãa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no, dɛ, ɔsɔfo Hilkiah dze nwoma bi ama me. Na Shaphan kenkaan no wɔ ɔhen no enyim.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen no tsee mbra nwoma no mu nsɛm no, nna ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu.
Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ ɔsɔfo Hilkiah, na Shaphan ne ba Ahikam, na Micaiah ne ba Achbor, na ɔkyerɛwfo Shaphan, na ɔhen n'akowaa Asaiah, dɛ,

hom nkɔ nkebisa Ewuradze mma emi, na ɔman no, na Judah nyinara, wɔ nwoma a woehu yi mu nsɛm no ho: Na Ewuradze n'ebufuw a ɔadzɛw wɔ hɛn do no ɔsõ, osiandɛ hɛn egyanom enntsie nwoma yi mu nsɛm no, dɛ wɔbɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no hɛn ho no nyinara tse.

Nna ɔsɔfo Hilkiah, na Ahikam, na Achbor, na Shaphan, na Asaiah, sii mu kɔr ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Huldah, ntardohwɛfo Shallum, Tikvah ba no, Harhas ba no, ne yer no nkyɛn; (nna ɔtse Jerusalem ne nkyɛmu afã a otsīa ebien no mu); na wɔnye no twetwee nkɔmbɔ.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hom nkɛkã nkyerɛ ɔbarimba a ɔsomaa hom wɔ me nkyɛn no dɛ,
mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ, medze mbusu mebɛba bea yi, na no do atsefo do, mekyerɛ nwoma a Judahhen akenkan no mu nsɛm nyinara:
Osiandɛ wɔapow me, na wɔakɛhyew eduhuam ama enyame fofor, ma wɔdze hɔn nsaano edwuma nyinara eyi me ebufuw; dɛm ntsi m'ebufuhyew bɛdzɛw wɔ bea yi do, na wonnkodum no.
Na Judahhen no a ɔsomaa hom dɛ wombebisa Ewuradze hɔ adze no dze, mbrɛ hom nse no nye yi, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Ɔwɔ nsɛm a atse no ho dze,

osiandɛ w'akoma yɛɛ mberɛw, na ebrɛɛ woho adze wɔ Ewuradze enyim aber a etsee dza mekãe mitsiaa bea yi, na no do atsefo, dɛ wɔbɛyɛ amamfõ na ndom no, na atsetsew wo ntar mu, na esū wɔ m'enyim ntsi; mo so metsie wo, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, mobɔboaboa wo makɔ w'egyanom nkyɛn, na wɔbɔboaboa wo akɔ w'adakamaa mu asomdwee mu, nkyii so w'enyiwa nnkohu mbusu a medze mereba bea yi do no nyinara. Na wɔdze asɛm brɛɛ ɔhen no bio.
23: Na ɔhen no somae ma wokehyiaa Judah na Jerusalem amanmpanyin no nyinara ma wɔbaa ne nkyɛn.

Na ɔhen no sii mu kɔr Ewuradze fie, na Judah mbarimba nyinara na Jerusalem atsefo nyinara kã no ho, na asɔfo no, na nkɔnhyɛfo no, na ɔman no nyinara, nkakraba na akɛse nyina: Na ɔkenkaan ahyɛmu nwoma no a wohun no wɔ Ewuradze fie no no mu nsɛm no nyinara guu hɔn asomu.

Na ɔhen no kegyinaa dum no ho, na odzii ahyɛmu wɔ Ewuradze enyim, dɛ ɔdze n'akoma nyinara, na ne kra nyinara, bedzi Ewuradze ekyir, na oedzi ne mbransɛm, na ne dasee, na n'ahyɛdze do, dɛ ɔbɛma ahyɛmu yi no mu nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma yi mu no etsim: Na ɔman no nyinara gyinaa ahyɛmu no do.

Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ ɔsɔfopanyin Hilkiah, na asɔfo a wodzi do hɔ no, na abowanoahwɛfo no, dɛ wonyiyi ndzɛmba nyinara a wɔyɛe maa Baal, na Asherah, na ɔsor dɔm nyinara, mfi Ewuradze n'asɔrfi no mu mpue: Na ɔkɛhyeew no Jerusalem ekyir wɔ Kidron ho haban mu, na ɔfaa no ho nso no kɔr Beth-el.

Na otutuu asɔfo huhuw no a Judah ahemfo hyehyɛe a wɔhyew eduhuam wɔ Judah nkurow mu, mbea sorɔnsorɔm do, na mbeambea a abɔ Jerusalem ho aprɔw no otutuu hɔn do; hɔn so a wɔhyew eduhuam ma Baal, na ewia, na bosoom, na nworaba mu ekunyin, na ɔsor dɔm no nyinara.
Na oyii Asherah no fii Ewuradze ne fie, Jerusalem ekyir, kɔr ɔwora Kidron ho, na ɔhyeew no wɔ ɔwora Kidron ho, na osiiw no nketsenketse dɛ huntuma, na ɔkɔtoow no huntuma guu nkorɔfo mba adakamaa do.
Na obubuu sodomfo adan a ɔwɔ Ewuradze fie, mbrɛ mbaa no ween nsensɛnho maa Asherah no.

Na ɔdze asɔfo no nyinara fi Judah nkurow no mu bae, na oguu mbea sorɔnsorɔm mbrɛ asɔfo no hyeew hɔ eduhuam no ho fī, fi Geba kodu Beer-sheba; na odwuruuw nkuropon ano mbea sorɔnsorɔm a ɔwɔ kurow no mu ambrado Joshua no kuropon ahɛnee mu a ɔwɔ nyimpa n'abankum afamu mber a ɔrehɛn kurow no no kuropon no mu no.
Naaso mbea sorɔnsorɔm do asɔfo no wɔammfow ammba Ewuradze n'afɔrmbukyia no do wɔ Jerusalem, mbom wodzii epitsi no bi wɔ hɔn nuanom mu.
Na oguu Topheth a ɔwɔ Hinnommba ɔbɔn no mu no ho fī, ma nyimpa bi aamma ne babanyin anaa ne babaa ammfa gya mu ammba Molech bio.
Na ɔfaa mpɔnkɔ a Judah ahemfo dze esisi hɔ ama ewia no, wɔ Ewuradze ne fi ahɛnee no, ɔdze kɔ opianyi Nathan-melech ne dan a ɔwɔ asɔrdan no nkyɛn no ho; na ɔdze gya hyeew ewia ne ntseaseanam no.

Na afɔrmbukyia a ɔwɔ Ahaz abansor dan etsifi a Judah ahemfo yɛe, na afɔrmbukyia a Manasseh yɛe no wɔ Ewuradze ne fie aban-paa ebien no do no, ɔhen no dwuruuw no, na odwuwii fii hɔ, na ɔdze no huntuma no guu ɔwora Kidron mu.

Na mbea sorɔnsorɔm no a ɔwɔ Jerusalem enyim no a ɔwɔ ɔsɛɛ-bepɔw no enyimfa a Israelhen Solomon sii maa Zidonfo ekyiwadze Ashtoreth, na Moab ekyiwadze Chemosh, na Ammonmba ekyiwadze Milcom no, ɔhen no guu ho fī.
Na obubuu edum no mu esinesin, na otwitwaa Asherim no, na ɔdze nyimpa mbiew hyehyɛɛ hɔn ananmu.

Nkyii so afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ Beth-el, na bea sorɔnsorɔm no a Nebat ne ba Jeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no, yɛe no, afɔrmbukyia no na bea sorɔnsorɔm no mpo so odwuruuw no; na ɔhyeew bea sorɔnsorɔm no na osiiw no nketsenketse dɛ huntuma, na ɔhyeew Asherah no.

Na Josiah daan noho no, nna ohun asamandan a ɔwɔ bepɔw no mu no; na ɔsomae, na wɔkɛfaa mbiew no wɔ asamandan no mu bɛhyeew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, na oguu ho fī, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm a Nyame nyimpa no a ɔkã nsɛm yi no paa mu kãe no tse.
Nna ɔsee dɛ, ebɛn nkaabɔdze na muhu yi? Na ekuromfo no kãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Nyame nyimpa no a ofi Judah bae, na ɔbɛkãa nsɛm a edze ayɛ Beth-el afɔrmbukyia yi no, n'asamandan a.
Na ɔsee dɛ, hom mma ɔnko hɔ: Mma mma nyimpa biara nnkã ne mbiew. Nna wɔmaa ne mbiew, na nkɔnhyɛnyi a ofi Samaria bae no ne mbiew koo hɔ.
Na mbea sorɔnsorɔm adan nyinara so a ɔwɔ Samaria nkurow mu a Israel ahemfo yeyɛɛ dɛ wɔdze riyi Ewuradze ebufuw no, Josiah yiyii kɔree, na ɔkɛyɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ ndzeyɛɛ a ɔyɛe no Beth-el no nyinara tse.
Na okunkum mbea sorɔnsorɔm do asɔfo no a wɔwɔ hɔ no nyinara wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, na ɔhyeew nyimpa mbiew wɔ do; na ɔsanee baa Jerusalem.
Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ ɔman no nyinara, dɛ, hom ndzi apaho no mma hom Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ ahyɛmu nwoma yi mu no.
Ampa woenndzi apaho bi a ɔtse dɛm ofi atsɛmbuafo a wobuaa Israel atsɛn no nda do, na Israel ahemfo, na Judah ahemfo nda nyinara mu;
gyedɛ ɔhen Josiah n'afe a otsīa duawɔtwe no mu na wodzii apaho yi maa Ewuradze wɔ Jerusalem.

Nkyii so hɔn a wɔyɛ asamamfrɛfo, na abayifo, na ekum, na abosom, na ekyiwadze nyinara wohun no wɔ Judah asaase do na Jerusalem no, Josiah yiyii no hɔ, ma ɔaama nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma a ɔsɔfo Hilkiah kohun no wɔ Ewuradze ne fi no mu no etsim.

Na ɔhen biara enndzi n'enyim a ɔtse dɛ ɔno a ɔdze n'akoma nyinara, na ɔnye ne kra nyinara, na ɔnye n'ahoɔdzen nyinara danee baa Ewuradze nkyɛn dɛ mbrɛ Moses mbra no nyinara tse; nkyii so ɔno n'ekyir obiara nnsoɛree a ɔtse dɛ ɔno.
Naaso Ewuradze anndan emmfi n'ebufuhyew kɛse a ɔdzɛwee wɔ Judah do, osian abohur nyinara a Manasseh dze huur no bo no nyina ntsi no ho.
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, mibeyi Judah so mefi m'enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ meyi Israel no, na matow kurow a masan mu eyi yi, mekyerɛ Jerusalem, na ofi a mesee dɛ, me dzin bɛtsena hɔ no, makyen.
Afei Josiah no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judah ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Ne nda no mu na Egypthen Pharaoh-necoh sii mu kɔr Assyriahen do, wɔ esutsen Euphrates ho: Na ɔhen Josiah sii mu kɔr no do; na okum no wɔ Megiddo, aber a ohun no no.

Na no nkowaa no twee no fun wɔ tseaseanam mu fii Megiddo, na wɔdze no baa Jerusalem besiee no wɔ nankasa n'asamandan mu. Na asaase no do ɔman no faa Josiah ne ba Jehoahaz seraa no, na wɔhyɛɛ no hen hyɛɛ n'egya n'ananmu.
Aber a Jehoahaz hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no na oedzi mfe eduonu ebiasa; na odzii hen abosoom ebiasa wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Hamutal, Jeremiah a ofi Libnah ne babaa a.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ dza n'egyanom yɛe nyinara tse.
Na Pharaoh-necoh too no nkyehoma mu wɔ Riblah wɔ Hamath asaase do, amma oeenndzi hen wɔ Jerusalem; na ɔdze dwetɛ talent ɔha, na sika talent kor tow too asaase no do.
Na Pharaoh-necoh hyɛɛ Josiah ne ba Eliakim hen hyɛɛ n'egya Josiah n'ananmu, na ɔdaan ne dzin Jehoiakim: Na Jehoahaz dze ofaa no kɔree; na ɔbaa Egypt, na obowuu hɔ.

Na Jehoiakim dze dwetɛ na sika no maa Pharaoh; na ɔpaa tow maa asaase no dɛ wɔmma sika no dɛ mbrɛ Pharaoh ne mbrasɛm no tse: Ɔgyegyee dwetɛ na sika no wɔ asaase no do nkorɔfo no hɔ, obiara dɛ mbrɛ no tow tse, dɛ ɔdze rekɛma Pharaoh-necoh.
Aber a Jehoiakim hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu enum; na odzii hen mfe dubiako wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Zebidah, Pedaiah a ofi Rumah ne babaa a.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ dza n'egyanom yɛe no nyinara tse.
24: Ne nda no mu na Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar fowee bae, na Jehoiakim bɛyɛɛ n'akowaa mfe ebiasa: Nna ɔdanee na ɔtseew no do etūa.

Na Ewuradze somaa Chaldeafo ekuwekuw, na Syriafo ekuwekuw, na Moabfo ekuwekuw, na Ammonmba ekuwekuw wɔ no do, na ɔsomaa hɔn wɔ Judah do dɛ wɔnkɛsɛɛ no, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm a ɔnam no nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no abaw do kãe no tse.
Ampa ɔnam Ewuradze ne mbrasɛm do na iyi baa Judah do, dɛ orutu hɔn efi n'enyi do, osian Manasseh no bɔn ntsi, dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔyɛe nyinara tse;
na so osian bɔgya a odzi bem a ɔkãe gui ntsi; osiandɛ ɔdze bɔgya a odzi bem hyɛɛ Jerusalem mã: Na Ewuradze ammpɛ dɛ ɔdze fir.
Afei Jehoiakim no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Judah ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Nna Jehoiakim nye n'egyanom kɛdae: Na ne babanyin Jehoiachin dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu.
Na Egypthen no annda ho ara emmfi n'asaase do ammba bio: Osiandɛ Babylonhen agye, fi Egypt ɔwora ho kodu esutsen Euphrates ho, dza ɔyɛ Egypthen dze nyinara.
Aber a Jehoiachin hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe duawɔtwe; na odzii hen abosoom ebiasa wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Nehushta, Elnathan a ofi Jerusalem ne babaa a.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ n'egya yɛe no nyinara.
Aber no mu na Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar no nkowaa tui baa Jerusalem, na wotuaa kurow no.
Na Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar baa kurow no do, aber a no nkowaa no worutua no no;
na Judahhen Jehoiachin fiir edzi kɔr Babylonhen no nkyɛn, ɔnoara, na ne nã, na no nkowaa, na n'asafohemfo na ne mpanyimfo: Na Babylonhen no faa no wɔ n'ahendzi mu afe a otsīa awɔtwe no mu.

Na ɔsoaa Ewuradze ne fie akoradze nyinara, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze fii hɔ kɔree, na otwitwaa sika ndzɛmba a Israelhen Solomon yɛe no wɔ Ewuradze n'asɔrdan no mu no nyinara mu esinesin, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze see no ara.

Na ɔsoaa Jerusalem nyinara, na asafohemfo no nyinara, na mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam no nyinara, kɔree, mekyerɛ ndɔmmum mpemdu, na edwimfo na atomfo nyinara; obiara annka gyedɛ asaase no do nkorɔfo ehiafo buroburo no nko.
na ɔfaa Jehoiachin kɔr Babylon; na ɔhen no ne nã, na ɔhen no ne yernom, na ne mpanyimfo, na asaase no do nyimpa tsitsir no, ɔsoaa hɔn fi Jerusalem kɔr Babylon ndɔmmum mu.
Na mbarimba akatakyi nyinara, mekyerɛ nyimpa mpemesuon, na edwimfo na atomfo nyimpa apem, hɔn nyinara dɔm mbarimba a wɔfata ɔsa kor, mekyerɛ hɔn na Babylonhen no dze hɔn ndɔmmum dze kɔr Babylon.
Na Babylonhen no hyɛɛ n'egya no nua Mattaniah ɔhen wɔ n'ananmu, na ɔdaan ne dzin Zedekiah.
Aber a Zedekiah hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu biako; na odzii hen mfe dubiako wɔ Jerusalem na ne nã ne dzin dze Hamutal, Jeremiah a ofi Libnah no ne babaa a.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, dɛ dza Jehoiakim yɛe no nyinara.
Na ɔnam Ewuradze n'ebufuw do na ɔbaa dɛm wɔ Jerusalem na Judah, dze kodur dɛ ɔtoow hɔn fii n'enyim gui: Na Zedekiah tseew Babylonhen no do etūa.
25: Na ɔbaa dɛ n'ahendzi mu afe a otsīa akron no mu, bosoom a otsīa du no mu, bosoom no ne da a otsīa du no mu no, nna Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar, bae, ɔnoara na no dɔm nyinara, baa Jerusalem do, bɛkyeer do nsera; na wɔtotoow ho akoban bɔɔ aprɔw.
Nna kurow no wotuaa no kodur ɔhen Zedekiah n'afe a otsīa dubiako no mu.
Bosoom a otsīa anan no mu, da a otsīa akron no nna ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ kurow no mu, ma edziban bi nnyi hɔ mma asaase no do nkorɔfo no.

Nna wotuu otokur wɔ kurow no mu na mbarimba akofo no nyinara guaan anago faa afasu ebien no a ɔwɔ ɔhen no ture ho no ntamu kuropon mu ɔkwan do kɔree; (afei Chaldeafo etwa kurow no ho ehyia): Na ɔhen no faa Arabah ɔkwan do kɔree.
Na Chaldeafo dɔm no wotsiiw ɔhen no, na wɔkɔtoo no wɔ Jericho tɛtɛr mu: Na no dɔm nyinara fii no ho petsee.
Nna wɔkyeer ɔhen no, na wɔdze no kɛmaa Babylonhen wɔ Riblah; na wobuaa no atsɛn.
Na wokunkum Zedekiah ne mbabanyin wɔ n'enyim, na wotutuu Zedekiah n'enyiwa, na wɔtoo no mpokyerɛ mu, na wɔdze no kɔr Babylon.

Afei bosoom a otsīa enum no mu, wɔ bosoom no ne da a otsīa esuon no a, ɔyɛ ɔhen Nebuchadnezzar, Babylonhen no, n'afe a otsīa duakron no mu, nna abrafohen Nebuzaradan, Babylonhen akowaa bi, ɔbaa Jerusalem:
Na ɔbɛhyeew Ewuradze ne fi, na ɔhen ne fi, na Jerusalem efi nyinara, mekyerɛ efi akɛse nyinara ɔdze gya hyeew no.
Na Chaldeafo dɔm a wɔkã abrafohen no ho no nyinara dwuruuw Jerusalem afasu no guu famu hyiae.
Na nkorɔfo no nkaa a wɔkaa kurow no mu, na hɔn a wɔwaae no a, wɔwaae kɔr Babylonhen nkyɛn no, na nyimpadodow nkaa no, nna abrafohen Nabuzaradan faa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree.
Na abrafohen no gyaa asaase no do ehiafo no bi dɛ wɔnyɛ wenyin tureahwɛfo na ekuafo.
Na boran edum a ɔwɔ Ewuradze ne fie no, na eguarsɛn ase ndaka na boran po a ɔwɔ Ewuradze ne fie no, nna Chaldeafo bubuu mu esinesin, na wɔfaa no ho boran no kɔr Babylon.
Na asɛn, na nsofi, na nsompokuwa, na ntser, na boran ndzɛmba a wɔdze som no nyinara, wɔfae kɔree.
Na ogyasɛn no, na mbɛɛsen no; dza ɔyɛ sika no, sika a, na dza ɔyɛ dwetɛ no, dwetɛ a, abrafohen no fae kɔree.
Edum ebien no, po kor no, na eguarsɛn ase ndaka a Solomon yɛe maa Ewuardze ne fie no; ndzɛmba yi nyinara ho boran no woennker.

Idum kor ne tsentsen yɛ basafa duawɔtwe, na boran ntaadotsir wɔ no do: Na ntaadotsir no ne tsentsen yɛ basafa ebiasa; atenadwuma na pomegranate-ekutu wɔ ntaadotsir no do bɔ aprɔw, ne nyinara boran a: Na idum a otsīa ebien no so tse dɛ iyinom, atenadwuma wɔ ho.
Na abrafohen no faa ɔsɔfo tsitsir Seraiah, na ɔsɔfo a odzi do, Zephaniah, na abowanoahwɛfo baasa no:

Na kurow no mu so ɔfaa ɔpanyin a wɔdze no sii akofo no do no; na hɔn a wɔhwɛ ɔhen enyim no mu mbarimba beenum a wohun hɔn wɔ kurow no mu, na ɔkyerɛwfo, dɔmhen a ɔpon asaase no nkorɔfo kɔ ɔsa no; na asaase no do nkorɔfo no mu mbarimba eduosiaa wohun hɔn wɔ kurow no mu no.
Na abrafohen Nebuzaradan faa hɔn, na ɔdze hɔn brɛɛ Babylonhen wɔ Riblah.
Na Babylonhen bobɔɔ hɔn na okunkum hɔn wɔ Riblah wɔ Hamath asaase do. Dɛm na wɔfaa Judah ndɔmmum fii n'asaase do kɔree.
Na nkorɔfo a wɔkaa Judah asaase do a Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar maa wɔkae no dze, mekyerɛ hɔn na ɔdze Shaphan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedaliah dzii hɔn do ambrado.

Afei aber a dɔm no hɔn asafohemfo no nyinara, hɔn na hɔn mbarimba no, tsee dɛ Babylonhen dze Gedaliah ayɛ ambrado no, wɔbaa Gedaliah nkyɛn wɔ Mizpah, mekyerɛ Nethaniah ne ba Ishmael, na Kareah ne ba Johanan, na Netophahnyi Tanhumeth ne ba Seraiah, na Maacahnyi ba Jaazaniah, hɔn na hɔn mbarimba.
Na Gedaliah suae kyerɛɛ hɔn na hɔn mbarimba no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, mma hom nnsuro osian Chaldeafo nkowaa no ntsi: Hom ntsena asaase yi do, na wɔnsom Babylonhen, na ɔbɔkɔ hom yie.

Na ɔbaa dɛ bosoom a otsīa esuon no mu no, nna Elishama ba Nethaniah ne ba Ishmael a ofi adehyemba no mu bae, na mbarimba du kã no ho, na ɔbɔbɔɔ Gedaliah ma owui, na Judahfo na Chaldeafo a wɔkã no ho wɔ Mizpah no.
Na nkorɔfo no nyinara, nkakraba na akɛse nyina, na dɔm no hɔn asafohemfo, wɔsoɛree na wɔbaa Egypt: Osiandɛ wosuro Chaldeafo no.

Na ɔbaa dɛ Judahhen Jehoiachin no ndɔmmumyɛ afe a otsīa eduasa esuon no mu bosoom a otsīa duebien no mu, bosoom no ne na a otsīa eduonu esuon no, nna Babylonhen Evil-merodach, wɔ afe a ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ mu no mu no, ɔmaa judahhen Jehoiachin ne tsir do fii efiadze;
na ɔkasaa ayamuyie mu kyerɛɛ no, na ɔdze n'ahengua no sii ma ɔkrɔnee kyɛɛn ahemfo a wɔkã no ho wɔ Babylon no hɔn ahengua no.
Na ɔsakyeer n'efiadze ntar no, na odzidzii wɔ n'enyim daa wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu daa.
Na dza wɔdze ma no no, ofi ɔhen no hɔ na wɔdze ma no daa, da biara na ne kyɛpɛn, no nkwa nda nyinara.

1: Simon Peter, Jesus Christ akowaa nye somafo, dze kɛma hɔn a wɔnye hɛn enya gyedzi a ɔsom bo yi bi, wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn nye hɛn Agyenkwa Jesus Christ tsenenee no mu:
Adom nkã hom na asomdwee ndɔɔ sõ mma hom wɔ Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus ho nyimdzee mu;
dɛ mbrɛ ne Nyame ahoɔdzen dze ndzɛmba nyina a ɔfa nkwa nye nyamesom ho ama hɛn, wɔ nyia yieyɛ do afrɛ hɛn no no ho nyimdzee mu;
ɔnoara do na ɔnam akyɛ hɛn n'anohoba a ɔsõso akɛse akɛse a ɔsom bo; dɛ hom enya eguan mprɔwee a ɔnam akɔndɔ do wɔ wiadze mu no a, hom eedua iyinom do enya Nyame suban no bi.
Ampaara iyiara ntsi, hom mfa mbɔdzen nyina nkã ho wɔ hom afamu, na hom mfa mbanyinyɛ nkã hom gyedzi ho; na nyimdzee nkã mbanyinyɛ ho;
na enyidahɔ nkã nyimdzee ho; na abotar nkã enyidahɔ;
na nyamesompa nkã abotar ho; na enuadɔ nkã nyamesompa ho; na dɔ mapa nkã enuadɔ ho.
Na sɛ iyinom wɔ hom mu, na ɔdɔɔ sõ a, ɔremma hom nnyɛ enyihafo, anaaso hɔn a wɔnnsow aba wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ ho nyimdzee afamu.
Na nyia iyinom abɔ no yɛ onyifurafo, na onntum nnhu ekyir, no werɛ efir no bɔn dadaw no ho hohor no.
Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, hom mbɔ mbɔdzen mma hom frɛ nye hom pa nsi pi: Na sɛ hom yɛ yinom a, hom rimmfintsiw da:
na dɛm na wɔbɛma hom kwan mbordo akɔ hɛn Ewuradze nye hɛn Agyenkwa Jesus Christ ahendzi a onnyi ewiei no mu.
Dɛm ntsi meremma m'enyi mmpa do dɛ mebɛkaa hom yinom ho daa, kaansa hom nyim dada, na hom etsim nokwar a ɔwɔ hom hɔ no mu a.
Na mubu no dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ metse ntamadan yi mu yi, medze nkaabɔ mikenyan hom;
dɛ minyim dɛ mo ho ntamadan ne yigu reba ntsɛm, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ so eyi akyerɛ me.
ɛhɛɛ, mobɔbɔ mbɔdzen, na mo kɔ ekyir no, hom eetum akaa yinom dabaa.
Na nnyɛ okodzi a wɔma no nyansamu, na yeedzi ekyir akã hom hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ ahoɔdzen nye ne mbae, na yɛyɛɛ no nkukurii hoadasefo a hɛn enyiwa tuaa ho.
Na onyaa enyimnyam nye enyidzi fir Egya Nyankopɔn nkyɛn ber a ndze bi fi abɔso enyimnyam no mu fiir dɛ, oyi nye no dɔba a ɔsɔ m'enyi no:
Na dɛm ndze yi, hɛn a yɛnye no wɔ koko krɔnkrɔn no do no, yɛtsee dɛ ofi sor bae.
Na yɛwɔ nkɔnhyɛsɛm a ogyina hɔ pintsinn kyɛn dɛm, ɔno na sɛ hom hwɛ no yie, dɛ kandzea a ɔhyerɛn beebi a ɔyɛ sunkamm dze kesi dɛ adze bɛkye, na adzekyeeworaba no epue wɔ hom akoma mu a, hom yɛ yie:
Dɛ hom dzi kan hu yi, dɛ kyerɛw mu nkɔhyɛsɛm biara nndua nyimpa nkyerɛase do.
Na nkɔnkyɛ bi nndua nyimpa pɛ do mmbaa pɛn: Na nyimpa fi Nyame mu kasaa dɛ mbrɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn kãa hɔn
2: Na nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo so soɛɛr ɔman no mu, dɛ mbrɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo atorfo bɛba hom so mu a wɔdze ɔsɛɛ fɛkuwsɛm bɛba abɛhyɛ mu nsumaa mu, dɛ wɔbɔpow Ewuradze a ɔtɔɔ hɔn no mpo, na wɔdze ntsɛntsɛm sɛɛ aba hɔn do.
Na dodowara bedzi hɔn ehuhubra ekyir; na osian hɔn ntsi wɔbɛkã nokwar no ho nsɛmbɔn.
Na wɔnam enyiber mu dze ndaadaasɛm bɛpɛ hom ho adze: Hɔn na ofi tsetse hɔn atsɛmbu nnkyinkyim dabiarada, na hɔn sɛɛ nntɔ nkom.
Na sɛ Nyankopɔn enngyaa abɔfo a wɔyɛɛ bɔn no, na ɔdze hɔn guu amandzehu-kurow no mu, na ɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ mona sunkamm mu dɛ wɔmfa hɔn nsie atsɛmbu a;
na sɛ oenngyaa tsetse wiadze no, na ɔkoraa Noah a ɔyɛ tsenenee sɛnkafo nye beesuon bi so, ber a ɔdze nsuyirii bɛkataa emumuyɛfo wiadze do no;
na ɔdaan Sodom nye Gomorrha nkurow nso buu hɔn fɔ butuuw hɔn, dze hɔn yɛɛ asɛndahɔ maa hɔn a ekyir wɔbɛyɛ emumuyɛ;
na oyii ɔtseneneenyi Lot a emumuyɛfo dze hɔn ehuhubra haaw no no:
(Na dza nyimpa tsenenee no tse hɔn mu hunii na ɔtsee no, mbrato ndwuma no yii ne kra ahomtsew daa nyina):
Ewuradze nyim mbrɛ oyiyi nyamesurofo fi nsɔhwɛ mu, na osie hɔn a wɔnntsen wɔ ntsēa ase dze kɔ atsɛmbu da no;
na nkanka hɔn a wodzi honam ekyir efifidze ho akɔndɔ mu, na wobu tumdzi tootooba. Wɔyɛ enyiɔdzenfo, ahopɛfo, hɔn ho mmpopo dɛ wɔbɛkã etumfo ho nsɛmbɔn:
Naaso abɔfo a wɔsõ wɔ tum nye ahoɔdzen mu wɔmmfa nsɛmbɔn mmbu hɔn atsɛn wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na yinom dze, dɛ abɔdze a wonnyi adwen, wɔawo hɔn dɛ mbowa a wɔkyer hɔn sɛɛ hɔn, wɔkã nsɛmbɔn wɔ dza wonnyim ho, wɔbɛsɛɛ hɔn wɔ hɔnankasa hɔn sɛɛ mu;
wobenya dza ɔnntsen ho akatua; dza wobu no enyigye nye dɛ wɔgor asakasakagor ewia, nkekaa nye dzɛm, wɔbɔ akɔhwibra ber a wɔnye hom ridzi ɔdɔ edzidzi;
wɔwɔ enyiwa a awarto ahyɛ no mã a ɔronndwe wɔ bɔn ho da; wɔdaadaa akra a hɔn ase nntsimii; wɔwɔ akoma a wɔaben enyiber mu; ndom mba;
woegya akwantsen akɔfom kwan, woekedzi Boer ba Balaam kwan ekyir; ɔno na ɔdɔɔ nyɛe bɔn akatua;
na eso onyaa ne mbrato ho nkaenyim: Asoaso-pɔnkɔ a onntum nnkasa dze nyimpa ndze kasae siankaa nkɔnhyɛnyi n'egyimsɛm.
Iyinom yɛ mbura a nsu nnyi mu, ehuhubɔw a ehum rutu no kɔ; hɔn na wɔdze sum kebikebi esie hɔn daa.
Wɔkeka ekromponsɛm huhuw, nam honam akɔndɔ mu dze ahoɔdɛw daadaa hɔn a wofii hɔn a wɔbɔ mfom mu bra nsa nnkyɛree;
wɔbɔ hɔn adehyedzi ho anohoba, naaso hɔnara wɔyɛ prɔwee nkowaa; na nyia obi edzi n'enyim kogu no, ɔnoara na ɔdze no kɔ nkowaasom.
Na sɛ wɔnam Ewuradze nye Agyenkwa Jesus Christ do efi wiadze efifidze nsa ekyir no, wɔkɔtoto mu bio dzi kogu a, hɔn ekyir asetsena dan hɔn bɔn kyɛn kan no.
Na nkyɛ oye ma hɔn dɛ woennhu tsenenee kwan no, kyɛn dɛ woehu ekyir no, wɔbɛdan efi ahyɛdze krɔnkrɔn no a wɔdze ahyɛ hɔn nsa no ho.
Na ayɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ nokwar bɛ no se, ɔkraman asan akɔ nankasa no fe ho bio, na prekober a woeguar no akɔ no dɔtɔnyan a ɔyankam wɔ mu no mu.
3: Adɔfo, iyi nye nwoma a otsīa ebien a makyerɛw mabrɛ hom; no mu na mikenyan hom adwen gyenengyenen wɔ nkaabɔ mu;
dɛ hom nkaa nsɛm a nkɔnhyɛfo krɔnkrɔn akã ato hɔ, nye Ewuradze nye Agyenkwa ahyɛdze a ɔnam hom asomafo do no:
Hom nhu yi kan dɛ, nda a odzi ekyir no mu atwetwesifo dze atwetwesi bɛba a wɔnantsew hɔnankasa hɔn akɔndɔ ekyir,
na wɔkã dɛ, ne mbae anohoba no wɔ hen? Osiandɛ ofi da a egyanom dedae yi adze nyina tse mbrɛ ɔtse fi abɔdze ahyɛse.
Na wɔboapa werɛ fir dɛ, ofi tsetse na ɔsor wɔ hɔ, nye asaase a ofi nsu mu, na ofi nsu finimfin betsiim hɔ wɔ Nyankopɔn asɛm do:
Ɔno no do na ɔnam na wiadze a ɔwɔ ber no mu no, nsu kataa do sɛɛ no:
Na sor a ɔwɔ hɔ sesei, nye asaase no wɔdze n'asɛm kor no ara akora do ama ogya, esie atsɛmbu nye nyimpa emumuyɛfo sɛɛ da no.
Na mma hom werɛ mmfir adze kor yi, adɔfo, dɛ da kor yɛ Ewuradze dɛ mfe apem, na mfe apem yɛ no dɛ da kor.
Ewuradze nnyɛ n'anohoba ho ekyim dɛ mbrɛ binom bu no ekyimyɛ, na mbom penkyɛr na ɔyɛ no wɔ hom do, ɔmmpɛ dɛ obiara bɛhera, na mbom ɔpɛ dɛ hɔn nyina bɛba mfehoekyir mu.
Na Ewuradze da no bɛba dɛ owifo; no mu na sor dze dede kɛse botwa mu akɔ, na wimuadze dze ɔhyew a ɔyɛ dzen bɛnan, na asaase nye no mu ndwuma wɔbɛhyew no.
Ntsi sɛ iyinom nyina bɛsɛɛ dɛm a, nyimpa su bɛn na ɔsɛ dɛ hom yɛ, wɔ abrabɔ krɔnkrɔn nye nyamesompa mu,
ber a hom rohwɛ kwan na hom repɛ Nyankopɔn da no ne mbae ntsɛm; no mu na ɔsor gya bɔtɔ mu asɛɛ no, na wimuadze dze hyew a ɔyɛ dzen bɛnan no?
Na dɛ mbrɛ n'anohoba tse, hɛn enyi da sor fofor nye asaase fofor a tsenenee tse mu kwan.
Dɛm ntsi, adɔfo, osiandɛ hom enyi da yinom kwan ntsi, hom mbɔ mbɔdzen, ma woeehu hom asomdwee mu, dɛ nkekaa anaa dzɛm nnyi hom ho wɔ n'enyim.
Na hom mbu dɛ Nyankopɔn penkyɛr yɛ nkwagye, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn nua dɔfo Paul so ɔdze nyansa a wɔdze maa no kyerɛw hom no;

dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛe wɔ no nwoma nyina a ɔkã iyinom ho nsɛm wɔ mu no mu so; no mu na asɛm a n'ase yɛ tse-na wɔ a, hɔn a wonnyim adze, na hɔn ase ntsimii, wɔtoto no dɛ mbrɛ wɔyɛ kyerɛwsɛm nkaa no so dze ma hɔnankasa hɔn sɛɛ.
Dɛm ntsi, adɔfo, hom nyim yinom dada ntsi, hom nhwɛ yie, mma wɔaammfa emumuyɛ ndaadaasɛm annsoa hom annkɔ, na hom eemmfi homankasa hom tsintsim mu annhwe ase.
Na mbom hom nnyin wɔ adom nye hɛn Ewuradze nye Agyenkwa Jesus Christ nyimdzee mu. Ɔno na enyimnyam nkã no sesei nye daa. Amen.

1: Na ɔbaa dɛ, Saul no wu ekyir no a David asan efi Amalekfo kum mu aba no, na David dzii nda ebien wɔ Ziklag no;
nna ɔbaa dɛ da a otsīa ebiasa no, na hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi fi nsera mu wɔ Saul nkyɛn baa a ne ntar atsetsew, na dɛtse gu n'etsifi; na ɔbaa dɛ aber a odur David nkyɛn no ,nna ɔhwee famu, nna ɔyɛɛ enyidzi.
Na David see no dɛ, henfa na ifi reba yi? Na ɔsee no dɛ, Israel nsera mu na mefi nsa efir yi.
Na David see no dɛ, asɛm no tse dɛn? Meserɛ wo, kã kyerɛ me. Na obuaa dɛ, ɔman no efi akono eguan, na ɔman no mu so pii ahwehwe ase atotɔr; na Saul na ne ba Jonathan so woewuwu.
Na David see aberantsɛ no a ɔkãa kyerɛ no no dɛ, eyɛ dɛn ihun dɛ Saul na ne ba Jonathan atotɔr?
Na aberantsɛ no a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ no see dɛ, Mikefiir Gilboa bepɔw do awerɛfirmu no, hwɛ, nna Saul ɔtwer ne peaa no ho; na, hwɛ, ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo no taa no do dzendzenndzen.
Na ɔhwɛɛ n'ekyir no, ohun me na ɔfrɛɛ me. Na megyee do dɛ, emi nye yi.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, woana nye wo? Na mubuaa no dɛ, Amaleknyi nye me.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, meserɛ wo, begyina me nkyɛn na ku me, na owu yaw ekitsa me, osiandɛ mo nkwa da ho yɛ imu wɔ mo mu.
Nna migyinaa ne nkyɛn, na mukum no, osiandɛ minyim dɛ n'asehwe ekyir no yi orinnya nkwa: Na mefaa ahenkyɛw a ɔbɔ ne tsir no, na nsakɔnadze a ɔhyɛ ne nsa no, na medze mabrɛ mo wura wɔ ha yi.
Nna David suoo ne ntar mu, na ɔtsetseew mu; na mbarimba a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no nyinara yeyɛɛ dɛm ara:
Na wogyamee, na wosūi, na wɔkyeen kɔm araa ma okodur ewimbir, dze maa Saul, na ne ba Jonathan, na Ewuradze ne man no na Israel fi; osiandɛ wɔatotɔr wɔ afõwa ano ntsi.
Na David see aberantsɛ no a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ no no dɛ, ifi hen? Na obuaa dɛ, Amaleknyi ɔhɔho bi ne ba nye me.
Na David see no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ennsuro dɛ ebɛtsen wo nsa asɛɛ nyia Ewuradze asera no no?
Na David frɛɛ mberantsɛ no mu baako, na ɔsee dɛ, twe pin, na tu hyɛ no do. Na ɔbɔɔ no ma owui.
Na David see no dɛ, Wo bɔgyaa ngu w'etsifi; na w'ano na woedzi atsia wo dɛ, mara na meku nyia Ewuradze asera no no.
Na David twaa Saul na ne ba Jonathan ho kwadwom yi:
Na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa nkyerɛkyerɛ Judahmba Egyen-ndwom: Hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Jashar nwoma no mu.
Israel e, w'enyimnyam no atotɔr mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do; mbrɛ akatakyi esi atotɔr a!
Mma wɔnnkã no wɔ Gath, mma wɔmmbɔ no dawur wɔ Ashkelon abrɔn mu; amma Philistiafo mbabaa eenndzi ehurusi, amma monomonomfo mbabaa eennhuruw anntenan.

Hom Gilboa mbepɔw, mma ɔbɔsu na nyankom so nntɔ hom do, nkyii so ayɛyɛdze haban mmba hom do: Na ehɔ na wɔatow akatakyi kyɛm no akyen enyimguase mu, Saul kyɛm no a, dɛ gyama obi a wɔammfa ngo annsera no.
Atɔfo bɔgyaa, akatakyi seradze, Jonathan n’egyen annsan emmfi ho, na Saul n’afõwa annsan emmfi ho pan.
Saul na Jonathan hɔn ho yɛɛ akɔndɔ na ahomka wɔ hɔn nkwaber mu, na hɔn wu mu so wɔammpaapaa mu; hɔn ho yɛɛ har sen nkɔr, hɔn ho yɛɛ dzen sen ngyata.
Hom Israel mbabaa, wonsū Saul, ɔno na ofuraa hom adaaben dehyedehye, ɔno na ɔdze sika ndwindze hyehyɛɛ hom ntar do.
Mbrɛ akatakyi esi atotɔr wɔ ɔkõ mu a; Jonathan atɔr wɔ wo nkokwaa do.
Ɔwo ntsi mo ho ehiahia me, mo nua Jonathan: Wo ho yɛɛ me ahomka dodoodow: Wo dɔ a edze dɔɔ me no yɛ nwanwa, otwar mbaa hɔn dɔ.
Mbrɛ akatakyi esi atotɔr, na ɔsa akodze esi asɛɛ a!
2: Na iyi ekyir no ɔbaa dɛ, David bisaa Ewuradze dɛ, ana momfow monkɔ Judah nkurow no bi mu a? Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, fow kɔ. Na David see dɛ, henfa na momfow monkɔ? Na ɔsee no dɛ, Hebron a.
Nna David sii mu kɔr hɔ, ɔnye ne yernom beenu no so, Jezreelnyi Ahinoam, na Carmelnyi Nabal yer Abigail.
Na David dze ne mbarimba a wɔkã no ho so bae, ɔbarimba biara ɔnye ne fifo na wɔbɛtsenatsenaa Hebron nkurow no mu.
Na Judah mbarimba bae, na ehɔ na wɔseraa David hyɛɛ no hen wɔ Judah fi do. Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ David dɛ, Jabesh-gileadfo nye hɔn a wosiee Saul.
Na David somaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Jabesh-gileadfo hɔ kɛsee hɔn dɛ, Ewuradze nhyira hom, dɛ hom akyerɛ hom wura do ayamuyie yi, mekyerɛ Saul, na hom esie no.
Na afei Ewuradze nkyerɛ hom do ayamuyie na nokwar: Na mo so mebɛyɛ hom dɛm ayamuyie yi bi, osiandɛ hom ayɛ dɛm adze yi ntsi.
Dɛm ntsi afei wɔmma hom nsa nhyɛ dzen, na hom nyɛ ndam: Na hom wura Saul ewu, na eso Judah fi asera me ahyɛ me hen wɔ hɔn do.
Afei Abner, Ner ba no, Saul no dɔm do safohen no, faa Saul ne ba Ish-bosheth na ɔdze no twae baa Mahanaim;
na ɔhyɛɛ no Gilead, na Ashurfo, na Jezreel, na Ephraim, na Benjamin, na Israel nyinara do hen.
Aber a Saul ne ba Ish-bosheth hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do no nna oedzi mfe eduanan, na odzii hen mfe ebien. Na Judah fi dze, wodzii David ekyir.
Na mber a David dze dzii hen wɔ Judah fi do wɔ Hebron no ɔyɛ mfe esuon na abosoom esia.
Na Abner, Ner ba no, na Saul ne ba Ish-bosheth no nkowaa no, tui fii Mahanaim baa Gibeon.
Na Zeruiah ba Joab, na David no nkowaa no tui kɔree, na wokehyiaa hɔn wɔ Gibeon nsutaae no ho; na wɔtsenatsenaa famu hɔ, ekor wɔ nsutaae no ne nkyɛn fakor, na ekor so wɔ nsutaae no ne nkyɛn fakor so.
Na Abner see Joab dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma mberantsɛ no nsoɛr ngor wɔ hɛn enyim. Na Joab see dɛ, ma wɔnsoɛr ɛ.
Nna wɛsoeree kaan hɔnho kɔree; Benjamin, na Saul ne ba Ish-bosheth dze, duebien, na David nkowaa mu duebien.
Na hɔn mu obiara suoo ne nyɛnko ne tsir mu, na ɔdze n’afõwa wɔɔ ne nyɛnko ne mfemu; ma wɔbɔɔ mu hwee ase: Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bea no Helkath-hazzurim a ɔwɔ Gibeon.
Na ɔkõ no mu yɛɛ dzen dodoodow da no; na wɔkãa Abner na Israel mbarimba no gui wɔ David no nkowaa no enyim.
Na Zeruiah ne mbabanyin baasa no wɔwɔ hɔ, Joab na Abishai, na Asahel: Na Asahel n’anan ho yɛ har dɛ hamu adoa.
Na Asahel otsiiw Abner; na ɔrokɔ no oemmfi Abner ekyir anndan ammfa enyimfa anaa abankum.
Nna Abner hwɛɛ n’ekyir, na ɔsɛɛ dɛ, Asahel, ɔwo nye no a? Na obuaa dɛ, mara nye no.
Na Abner see no dɛ, Dan woho wɔ nkyɛn kɔ w'enyimfa anaa abankum, na kɛkyer mberantsɛ no mu bi, na gye n'akodze. Na Asahel ammpɛ dɛ ɔbɛdan noho wɔ nkyɛn efi n’ekyir.
Na Abner see Asahel bio dɛ, dan woho wɔ nkyɛn fi m’ekyir: Ebɛnadze ntsi na mommbɔ wo monnhwe famu? Na mibesi dɛn metum mama m’enyi do mahwɛ wo nua Joab?

Naaso ɔammpen dɛ ɔdan noho wɔ nkyɛn: Dem ntsi Abner ɔdze peaa no no tun wɔɔ ne yafun mu, ma peaa no hwiraa mu puee n’ekyir; na ɔhwee ase wɔ hɔ, na owui wɔ bea no do hɔ ara: Na ɔbaa dɛ, dodow a wodur beebi mbrɛ Asahel hwee ase wui no, wogyinaa dzinn.
Na Joab na Abishai dze wotsiiw Abner: Na aber a wodur Ammah koko a ɔda Giah enyim wɔ Gibeon sar no do ɔkwan ho no, nna iwi tɔree.
Na Benjaminmba no poon hɔnho boaa ano bedzii Abner ekyir, na wɔbɛyɛɛ ikuw kor, na wokegyinaa koko bi etsifi.
Nna Abner frɛɛ Joab na ɔsɛɛ dɛ, ana afõwa ndzi nam daa? Ana ɔwo innyim dɛ n’ekyir no ɔbɛyɛ wenwen bi a? Na onkodu dabɛn ara ansaana ase ɔman no dɛ wongyaa hɔn nuanom ekyir dzi na wɔnsan?
Na Joab see dɛ, dɛ Nyankopɔn tse ase yi, sɛ ɔwoara annkasa a, ampaara nkyɛ anapa no ɔman no kɔree, na nkyɛ obiara enndzi no nua n’ekyir so.
Nna Joab hɛɛn abɛn, na ɔman no nyinara gyinaa dzinn, na woenntsiw Israel bio, nkyii so wɔannkõ bio.
Na Abner na ne mbarimba no sii mu anago no nyinara koduaa Arabah; na wokotwaa Jordan, na wokoduaa Bithron nyinara mu, dze bodur Mahanaim.
Na Joab hi Abner ekyir sanee: Na ɔpoon ɔman no nyinara boaa ano no nna aka David no nkowaa no mu nyimpa duakron na Asahel.
Na David no nkowaa no dze, woekuku Benjamin mu na Abner ne mbarimba no mu, na nyimpa ahaasa eduesia atotɔr.
Na wɔmaa Asahel do, na wokesiee no wɔ n’egya n’asamandan a ɔwɔ Beth-lehem no mu. Na Joab na ne mbarimba no sii mu anago no nyinara kɔree na adze kyee hɔn wɔ Hebron.
3: Afei akodzi daa Saul fi na David fi ntamu kyɛree: Na David dze dzen ara na ɔyɛ, Saul fi dze gow ara na ɔgow.
Na wɔwoo mbabanyin maa David wɔ Hebron: Na n’abakan nye Ammon a ɔnye Jezreelnyi Ahinoam woo no no;
na nyia otsīa ebien nye Chileab a ɔnye Abigail, Carmelnyi Nabal yer no woo no no; na nyia otsīa ebiasa nye Absalom, Geshurhen Talmai ne babaa Maacah ba no;
na nyia otsīa anan nye Adonijah, Haggith ba no; na nyia otsīa enum nye Shephatiah, Abital ba no;
na nyia otsīa esia nye Ithream a David yer Eglah woo no no. Woyinom na wɔwoo hon maa David wo Hebron.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a akodzi daa Saul fi na David fi ntamu no, Abner ɔyɛɛ no ho katabann wɔ Saul fi no mu.
Afei Saul wɔ nwewe bi a ne dzin dze Rlzpah, Aiah ne babaa a, na Ishbosheth see Abner dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ako m’egya no nwewe nkyɛn?

Nna Abner no bo fuuw dodoodow wɔ Ish-bosheth ne nsɛm no ntsi, na ɔsee dɛ, ana ɔkraman tsir a ɔyɛ Judah dze nye me a? Ndɛ da yi na meyɛ ayamuyie mema w’egya fie, no nuanom na ne mfɛfo, na minnyi wo mennhyɛ David nsa, nna ɔwo edze bɔn rudu me ndɛ da yi wɔ ɔbaa yi ho yi?
Nyankopɔn nyɛ Abner dɛm, na ebu mbu no, sɛ, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze akã ntam akyerɛ David no, mannyɛ dɛmara so mamma no;
dɛ wɔbɛdan ahendzi no efi Saul fie, na wɔdze David ahengua no esi Israel na Judah do, efi Dan ekodu Beer-sheba.
Na oenntum emmbua Abner asɛm bi bio, osiandɛ osuroo no.
Na Abner somaa abɔfo wɔ n’afamu ma wɔkɔr David nkyɛn dɛ, woana na asaase yi dzi wɔ no? Dɛ eso, enye me nkyekyer, na, hwɛ, mobɔboa wo ma aadan Israel nyinara aba wo nkyɛn.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Oye; menye wo bɛkyekyer: Na mbom adze kor na morohwehwɛ no wo hɔ, ɔno nye dɛ, sɛ ereba abɔhwɛ m’enyim a, gyedɛ idzi kan edze Saul babaa Michal ba ana, ɔno innkohu m’enyira.
Na David somaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Saul ba Ish-bosheth hɔ dɛ. Fa me yer Michal a medze Philistiafo hɔn mbarimba anower ɔha megyee no ayewar no brɛ me.
Na Ish-bosheth somae ma wɔkɛfaa no wɔ no kun no nkyɛn, mekyerɛ Laish ba Paltiel nkyɛn a.
Na no kun no nye no kɔree, mbrɛ ɔrokɔ na orusū, na odzii n’ekyir ara kodur Bahurim. Nna Abner see no dɛ, kɔ, san w’ekyir: Na ɔsaan n'ekyir.
Na Abner nye Israel mpanyimfo no twetwee nkɔmbɔ dɛ, mber bi a abɛsen hom hwehwɛɛ David dɛ nkyɛ ombedzi hom do hen:
Na afei hom nyɛ ɛ: Osiandɛ Ewuradze akã no David ho dɛ, m’akowaa David nsa do na menam mebɛgye me man Israel wɔ Philistiafo nsamu, na hɔn atamfo nyinara nsamu.
Na Abner ɔkasaa so kyerɛɛ Benjamin: Na Abner kɔree so dɛ ɔrekɛkã dza ɔhwɛ a oye nyinara dze ma Israel, na Benjamin fidua nyina, egu David n'asomu wɔ Hebron.
Nna Abner baa David nkyɛn wɔ Hebron, na mbarimba eduonu kã no ho. Na David too Abner na mbarimba a wɔkã no ho no pon.

Na Abner see David dɛ, mobɔsoɛr na makɔ, na makɔboaboa Israel nyinara ano mabrɛ mo wura ɔhen, ma wɔnye wo edzi ahyɛmu, ma edzi hen wɔ dza wo kra pɛ nyinara do. Na David gyaa Abner kwan; na ɔkɔr no asomdwee mu.
Na hwɛ David no nkowaa no na Joab wofi afo bae, na wɔdze asadze kɛsenara bae: Na Abner nnyi David nkyɛn wɔ Hebron; na oegya no kwan, ma ɔkɔ no asomdwee mu.
Aber a Joab na dɔm a wɔkã no ho no nyinara wɔbae no, wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Joab, dɛ, Abner, Ner ba no ɔbaa ɔhen nkyɛn, na oegya no kwan, ma ɔkɔ no asomdwee mu.
Nna Joab kɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, ebɛnadze na ayɛ yi? Hwɛ, Abner aba wo nkyɛn; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na egya no kwan ma ɔkɔ koraa yi?
Woara nyim Abner, Ner ba no dɛ ɔbae bɛdaadaa wo, na oehu wo nkɔree na wo mbae, na oehu dza ereyɛ nyinara.
Na aber a Joab fi David nkyɛn puei no, ɔsomaa abɔfo ma wɔfãa Abner, na wɔdze no fi Sirah bura ho sanee bae: Na David dze onnyim.
Na aber a Abner sanee baa Hebron no, Joab faa no faa nkyɛn kɔr kuropon no mu dɛ ɔnye no rukotu egyina, na ɔkowɔɔ ne yafun mu wɔ hɔ ma owui, wɔ no nua Asahel no bɔgyaa no ntsi.
Na n’ekyir no a David tsee no, ɔsee dɛ, emi na m’ahenman yenndzi fɔ wɔ Ewuradze enyim daa wɔ Abner, Ner ba no, no bɔgyaa ho:
Wɔmma ongu Joab n’etsifi, na n’egya fie nyinara do; na mma nyia ɔwɔ ahosen, anaa ɔyɛ kwatanyi, anaa ɔtwer poma, anaa ɔtɔr afõwa ano, anaa edziban abɔ no mmpa Joab fie ara da.
Nna Joab na no nua Abishai wokum Abner, osiandɛ okum hɔn nua Asahel wɔ ɔkõ no mu wɔ Gibeon.
Na David see Joab, na ɔman no a wɔka no ho no nyinara dɛ, hom nsunsuan hom ntar mu, na hom mfa eyitam mbobɔ do, na wontwa kwadwom ndzi Abner enyim. Na ɔhen David dzii ifun-bonto no ekyir,
Na wosiee Abner wɔ Hebron: Na ɔhen no maa ne ndze do sūi wɔ Abner nda do: Na ɔman no nyinara sūi.
Na ɔhen twaa Abner ho kwadwom see dɛ, aso Abner ewu dɛ mbrɛ ɔkwasea wu?
Wɔannkyekyer wo nsa, na wɔannto w’anan mpokyerɛ so: Dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa tɔr emumuyɛfo mba enyim no, dɛmara so na atɔr yi. Na ɔman no nyinara sūu no bio.

Na ɔman no nyinara baa dɛ wɔrebɛyɛ David ma oedzi edziban bi wɔ mber a ewia da ho wɔ do no; na David kãa ntam, dɛ, Nyankopɔn nyɛ me dɛm, na ebu mbu me, sɛ midzi edziban, anaa biribiara so kã m'ano, ansaana iwi akɔtɔ a.
Na ɔman no nyinara hyɛɛ no nsew, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn enyisɔ: Dɛ adze biara a ɔhen no yɛe no ɔyɛɛ ɔman no nyinara enyisɔ no.
Nna ɔman no nyinara na Israel nyinara tsee ase da no dɛ ommfir ɔhen no na wokum Abner, Ner ba no.
Na ɔhen no see no nkowaa dɛ. Ana hom nnyim dɛ ɔsafohen na nyimpa kɛse atɔr ndɛ da yi wɔ Israel?
Na ndɛ da yi mayɛ mberɛw, kaansa wɔasera me ahyɛ me hen mpo a; na mbarimba yi, Zeruiah mbabanyin yi, wɔyɛ dzen dodow ma me: Ewuradze ntua ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi kaw dɛ mbrɛ ne ndzebɔn tse.
4: Na aber a Ish-bosheth, Saul ne ba no, ɔtsee dɛ Abner ewu wɔ Hebron no, n'abaw gowee, na Israelfo no nyinara hɔn akoma tui.

Na Ish-bosheth, Saul ne ba no ɔwɔ mbarimba beenu a wɔyɛ ekuw ekuw do asafohemfo: Ɔbaako ne dzin dze Baanah, na ɔbaako so ne dzin dze Rechab, Beerothnyi Rimmon a ofi Benjaminmba no mu no ne mbabanyin a: (Osiandɛ wɔkan Beerothfo so fora Benjamin:
Na Beeroth no guanee kɔr Gitthai, na wɔakyɛyɛ amamforafo ara dze ebodu ndɛ da yi)

Afei Jonathan, Saul ne ba no, ɔwɔ ɔbabanyin bi a ɔyɛ ebubua. Aber a Saul na Jonathan ho nsɛm fi Jezreel bae no nna oedzi mfe enum, na ne gyegyefo no maa no do guanee: Na ɔbaa dɛ, ɔrepɛ ntsɛm eguan no, ɔhwee famu na ɔbɛyɛɛ ebubua. Na ne dzin dze Mephibosheth.
Na Beerothyni Rimmon ne mba no, Rechab na Baanah, wosii mu baa bodur Ish-bosheth fie ewia ketee, aber a ɔno ɔregye n'ahom ewiaber no.
Na wɔbae bodur ofi no ne finimfin hɔ, dɛ gyama wɔrebɛfa ewifua; na wɔwɔɔ ne yafun mu peaa: Na Rechab na no nua Baanah fii nsa guanee.
Afei aber a wodur ofi no mu, na ɔno so ɔda ne mpa do wɔ ne pia mu no, wɔbɔɔ no kum no, na wotwaa ne tsir, na wɔfaa ne tsir no, na wɔdze sii mu faa Arabah ɔkwan do anago no nyinara kɔree.

Na wɔdze Ish-bosheth ne tsir brɛɛ David wɔ Hebron, na wɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, hwɛ, wo tamfo Saul a ɔhwehwɛɛ wo nkwa no, ne ba Ish-bosheth ne tsir nye yi; na ndɛ da yi Ewuradze edzi Saul, na n’asefo wer ama mo wura ɔhen.
Na David buaa Rechab na no nua Baanah, Beerothnyi Rimmon ne mba no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze a oyii me kra fii ahohiahia nyinara mu ɔtse ase yi,
aber a obi bɛkãa kyerɛɛ me dɛ, hwɛ Saul ewu, na ɔdween dɛ ɔdze nsɛm pa aba no, mekyeer no, na mukura no wɔ Ziklag, dza ɔyɛ akatua a medze memaa no wɔ ne nsɛm ntsi nye no.
Na burbur aber a nyimpa bɔn ekum nyimpa tsenenee wɔ nankasa ne fie wɔ ne mpa do, ana afei monkɔhwehwɛ no bɔgyaa wɔ hom nsamu, na meyi hom efi asaase do bi a?

Na David hyɛɛ ne mberantsɛ no, na wokum hɔn, na wotwitwaa hɔn nsa na hɔn anan, na wɔdze hɔn kɛsensɛɛn nsutaae a ɔwɔ Hebron no nkyɛn. Na Ish-bosheth ne tsir dze wɔfae, na wokesiee no wɔ Abner ne nda no mu wɔ Hebron.
5: Nna Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara wɔbaa David nkyɛn wɔ Hebron, na wɔbɛkãa dɛ, Hwɛ, yɛyɛ wo biew na wo honam.
Mber a etwa mu asen no a Saul dzii hɛn do hen no, ɔwo nye nyia ɔdze Israel fiir edzi na ɔdze hɔn baa mu: Na Ewuradze see wo dɛ, ɔwo na ebɛnyɛn me man Israel, na ɔwo na ibedzi Israel do ɔpanyin.
Dɛm ntsi na Israel mpanyimfo no nyinara aba ɔhen nkyɛn wɔ Hebron yi; na ɔhen David nye hon dzii ahyɛmu wɔ Ewuradze enyim wɔ Hebron; na wɔseraa David ngo hyɛɛ no hen wɔ Israel do.
Aber a David hyɛɛ ase dzii hen no nna oedzi mfe eduasa, na odzii hen mfe eduanan.
Odzii Judah do hen mfe esuon na abosoom esia wɔ Hebron; na odzii Israel na Judah nyinara do hen mfe eduasa ebiasa wɔ Jerusalem.

Na ɔhen no na ne mbarimba no sii mu kɔr Jerusalem, Jebusfo no do, asaase no do nkorɔfo no a wɔkãa kyerɛɛ David, dɛ, eremmba mu ha, gyedɛ iyiyi enyifurafo na mpakye no fi ha no a: Wɔdween dɛ David runntum nnkɔ mu hɔ.
Naaso David gyee Zion akoban no; ɔnoara so nye David kurow no.

Na David kãa no da no dɛ, obiara a ɔbɔbɔ Jebusfo no, wɔmma ɔmafow nkɔ nsukã no ho, na ɔnkɔbɔ mpakye na enyifurafo a David ne kra kyir hɔn no. Dɛm ntsi na wɔsee dɛ, enyifurafo no nye no; orunntum mmba ofi no mu.
Na David tsenaa akoban no mu, na ɔfrɛɛ no David kurow. Na David toow fasu hyiae fi Millo na no mu afamu.
Na David daa ho yɛɛ kɛse ara; osiandɛ Ewuradze, dɔm Nyankopɔn no dzii n’ekyir.
Na Tyrehen Hiram tuu abɔfo ma wɔbaa David nkyɛn, na nkyindurndua, na nduadwimfo, na abodwimfo: Na wosii ofi maa David.
Na David hun dɛ Ewuradze etsintsim no dze no ahyɛ Israel do hen, na dɛ osian ne man Israel ntsi ɔama n'ahendzi do.
Na David fi Hebron bae no ekyir no, ɔwarwaar nwewefo na yernom bi so fi Jerusalem: Na wɔwowoo mbabanyin na mbabaa bi so maa David.
Na hɔn a wɔwoo hɔn maa no wɔ Jerusalem no hɔn edzin nye yi; Shammua, na Shobab, na Nathan, na Solomon,
na Ibhar na Elishua; na Nepheg, na Japhia;
na Elishama, na Eliada, na Eliphelet.
Na aber a Philistiafo tsee dɛ wɔasera David ahyɛ no hen wɔ Israel do no, Philistiafo no nyinara sii mu kɔr dɛ wɔrokɔhwehwɛ David; na David tsee, na osianee kɔr akoban no mu.
Nna Philistiafo no wɔaba abɛtserɛw hɔn mu wɔ Rephaim bɔnsa no mu.
Na David bisaa Ewuradze, dɛ, ana momfow monkɔ Philistiafo no do a? Ana ibeyi hɔn ahyɛ me nsa a? Na Ewuradze see David dɛ, Fow kɔ: Na ampaara mibeyi Philistiafo ahyɛ wo nsa.
Na David baa Baal-perazim, na David kunkum hɔn wɔ hɔ; na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze atsew m’atamfo mu wɔ m’enyim, dɛ nsu ntsewee. Dɛm ntsi ɔfrɛɛ bea no dzin dɛ Baal-perazim.
Na wɔdaan hɔn ehonyi no gyaa hɔ, na David na ne mbarimba no fae kɔree.
Na Philistiafo no fowee baa bio, na wɔdze hɔnho bɛtserɛɛw Rephaim bɔnsa mu.
Na David bisaa Ewuradze no, ɔsee dɛ, mma mmfow nnkɔ: Kɔ aprɔw kesi hɔn ekyir, na bra hɔn do wɔ bakandua no ne tsentsendo.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ etse nantsew ndze wɔ bakandua no etsifi a, ɔno keka woho: Osiandɛ nna Ewuradze epue dzi w’enyim dɛ orukoku Philistiafo dɔm no.
Na David yɛɛ dɛm, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ no no; na okunkum Philistiafo no fi Geba araa dze kodur dɛ edze rebɛba Gezer no.
6: Na David kehyiahyiaa Israel mbarimba a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn no nyinara bio, mpemeduasa.

Na David soɛree na ɔnye nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no nyinara wosii mu kɔr Baale Judah, dɛ wɔrekɛfa Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no a wɔbɔ do dzin no efi hɔ aba, mekyerɛ dɔm Ewuradze a ɔtse cherubfo do no ne dzin no a.
Na wodze Nyankopon n’adakaa no sii tseaseanam fotor do, na wɔdze fi Abinadab fi a ɔwɔ koko no do no mu puei: Na Uzzah na Ahio, Abinadab ne mbabanyin no, na wɔtwee tseaseanam fofor no.
Na wɔdze Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no fi Abinadab ne a ɔwɔ koko no do no puei: Na Ahio dzii adaka no enyim kɔree.
David na Israel fi nyinara wɔdze kupresidua ahorow, na ɔnye asankutsen, na ɔnye bɛnta-asanku, na ɔnye mpintsin, na ɔnye mfirekyiwa, na ɔnye akasaa goree wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na aber a wodur Nacon ewuporowee no, Uzzah tseen ne nsa kɛkãa Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no, na osuoo mu, osiandɛ anantwi no fintsiwii.
Na Ewuradze n’ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ Uzzah do; na Nyankopɔn bɔɔ no hɔ wɔ no mfom no ntsi, na owui wɔ Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no nkyɛn hɔ.
Na David ammpɛ, osiandɛ Ewuradze ebu afa Uzzah do ntsi: Na ɔfrɛɛ bea no Perez-uzzah dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na David suroo Ewuradze da no; na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze n'adakaa no besi dɛn aba me nkyɛn?
Dɛm ntsi David ammpɛ dɛ oyi Ewuradze n'adakaa no dze kɔ ne nkyɛn wɔ David kurow no mu: Na David dze maan nkyɛn kɔr Gittinyi Obed-edom fie.
Na Ewuradze n'adakaa no ɔkaa Gittinyi Obed-edom fie abosoom ebiasa: Na Ewuradze hyiraa Obed-edom, na ne fi nyinara.

Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ ɔhen David dɛ, Ewuradze ehyira Obed-edom fi, na dza ɔwɔ nyinara, osian Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no ntsi. Na David dze enyigye sii mu kɔree keyii Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no fii Obed-edom fie dze baa David kurow no mu.
Na mbrɛ ɔyɛe nye dɛ, sɛ hɔn a wɔso Ewuradze n’adakaa no tu anamɔn esia a, nna ɔdze ɔnantwi na abowa a ɔadɔ seradze abɔ afɔr.
Na David ɔdze n’ahoɔdzen nyinara sawee wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Nna David ɔdze ndwera ephod abɔ do.
Nna David na Israel fi nyinara wɔdze esebɔ, na abɛnhɛn ndze, dze Ewuradze n’adakaa no fowee bae.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ewuradze n’adakaa no dur David kurow mu no, Saul ne babaa Michal hwɛɛ tokura mu, na ohun ɔhen David dɛ oruhuruhuruw na ɔresaw wɔ Ewuradze enyim; na obuu no enyimtsia wɔ n'akoma mu.
Na wɔdze Ewuradze n’adakaa no bae, na wɔdze besii ne sibew wɔ asese a David abɔ ama no ne finimfin: Na David bɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr na asomdwee afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na David wiee ɔhyew-afɔr na asomdwee afɔr no bɔ no, ɔdze dɔm Ewuradze ne dzin hyiraa ɔman no.

Na ɔdze akyɛdze maa ɔman no nyinara, mekyerɛ Israel nyimpadodow nyina, mbarimba na mbaa nyina, ɔmaa obiara boodoo ntɔwmu, na nankum, na esikyireamba a wɔabɔ no etɔw. Nna ɔman no nyinara mu obiara sii mu kɔr ne fie.

Nna David sanee baa dɛ oribehyira ne fiefo. Na Saul ne babaa Michal puei behyiaa David, na ɔsee dɛ, mbrɛ Israelhen n'enyim duae baa nyam ndɛ a, dɛ ɔpaa no ho tam wɔ no nkowaa hɔn mfonabaa enyim, dɛ mbrɛ ehuhufo no mu bi pa no ho tam adapaa mu!
Na David see Michal dɛ, Ewuradze a, nyia ogyaa w’egya, na ne fi nyinara hɔ, na ɔsaan mu yii me hyɛɛ me ɔpanyin wɔ Ewuradze ne man, Israel do no a; dɛm ntsi na mobɔgor wɔ Ewuradze enyim
Na mo ho bɛda ho ayɛ nkɔw asen dɛm, na mebɛyɛ mankasa m’enyi do famufamunyi: Na mfonabaa a akasa hɔn ho no mu mbom na wɔbɛhyɛ me enyimnyam.
Na Saul ne babaa Michal oennya ɔba dze kodur no wu da.
7: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen no tsenaa ne fi mu, na Ewuradze maa no ahomgye wɔ n’atamfo a woetwa no ho ehyia no nyinara nsamu,
ɔhen no see nkɔnhyɛnyi Nathan dɛ, Afei hwɛ, emi metse cedar ofi mu, na Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no si ntamadan ho atam mu.
Na Nathan see ɔhen no dɛ, kɔ, kɛyɛ dza ɔwɔ w’akoma mu nyinara; na Ewuradze dzi w’ekyir.
Na ɔbaa dɛ anago no ara, Ewuradze n’asɛm baa Nathan hɔ dɛ,
Kɔ na kɛkã kyerɛ m’akowaa David dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi. Ana ɔwo na ibesi ofi ama me ma maatsena mu a?
osiandɛ ofitsi da a miyii Israelmba mifii Egypt bae ara dze bodu ndɛ da yi, menntsenaa ofi mu da, mbom asese na ntamadan ara na manantsew wɔ mu.

Mbeambea nyinara a menye Israelmba no nyinara anantsew no no mu no, ana menye Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu biara a mehyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnnyɛn me man Israel no kãa asɛm bi dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom nnsii me cedar ofi?
Dɛm ntsi afei mbrɛ kã kyerɛ m’akowaa David nye dɛ, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi, emi na miyii wo mifii nguamban mu fii nguan ekyir dzi, ma aabɛyɛ ɔpanyin wɔ me man Israel do:
Na midzii w’ekyir wɔ beebiara mbrɛ ekɔree na metwitwa w’atamfo nyinara mefi w'enyim; na mebɛma enya dzin kɛse, dɛ asaase do akɛsefo hɔn dzin.
Na mibesiesie beebi mama me man Israel, na matsɛw hɔn, ma wɔaatsena hɔnankasa hɔn tsenabew, na woeenntutu hɔn bio; nkyii so emumuyɛ mba no annhaw hɔn bio, dɛ nkan no.
Na dɛ ofi da a mehyɛɛ atsɛmbuafo dɛ wɔnhwɛ me man Israel do no; na mebɛma ahom efi w’atamfo nyinara ho. Nkyii so Ewuradze kã kyerɛ wo dɛ Ewuradze na ɔbɛkyekyer ofi ama wo.
Sɛ wo nda sõ, na enye w’egyanom kɛda a, medze w’asenyi a obedzi w’ekyir no a obefi wo nson mu no, mibesi hɔ, na mama n’ahendzi etsim.
Ɔno na obesi ofi ama me dzin, na mebɛma n’ahendzi ahengua no etsim hɔ daa.
Emi na mebɛyɛ n’egya, na ɔno ayɛ me ba: Se ɔyɛ bɔn a, medze nyimpa poma, na ɔnye nyimpa mba mbaa mebɛtsēa no;
na m’ehumbɔbɔr dze orimmfi no ho, dɛ mbrɛ miyii no wɔ Saul a mutuu no wɔ w’enyim no ho no.
Na wo fi na w’ahendzi besi pi daa wɔ w’enyim: W’ahengua betsim hɔ daa.
Dɛ mbrɛ nsɛm yi nyinara tse, na enyido-adzehu yi nyinara tse no, dɛmara so na Nathan kãa kyerɛɛ David.
Nna ɔhen David sii mu kɔree, na ɔkɛtsenaa Ewuradze enyim; na ɔsee dɛ, emi nye woana, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, na me fi nye ebɛn, na edze me aba ebodu ha yi?
Naaso, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, iyi yɛ w’enyi do adze ketseaba: Na ɔwo akã w’akowaa ne fi so ho asɛm dze ama mber tsentsen bi a ɔreba; na iyi so dɛ mbrɛ adasa wɔyɛ no nye yi, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn!
Na David botum ase wo dɛn bio? Osiandɛ ɔwoara inyim w’akowaa, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn.
Osian w’asɛm ntsi, na dɛ mbrɛ wankasa w’akoma tse no, nna ayɛ adze kɛse yi nyinara, dɛ erema w'akowaa ehu.
Dɛm ntsi ɔwo esõ, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn: Osiandɛ obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo, nkyii so Nyankopɔn biara nnyi hɔ ka wo ho, dɛ mbrɛ dza yɛdze hɛn aso atse no nyinara tse no.

Na ɔman kor mmuana na ɔwɔ asaase do a ɔtse dɛ wo man, ɔtse dɛ Israel a Nyankopɔn sii mu kɔree kɔpoon hɔn dze gyee ɔman maa noho, na ɔdze gyee dzin, na ɔdze yɛɛ ndzɛmba akɛse maa hom, na ndzɛmba a ɔyɛ hu maa w’asaase, wɔ wo man a epoon hɔn fii Egypt maa woho, wɔ amanaman na hɔn enyame nsamu no enyim?
Na ɔwoara dze wo man Israel tsiim hɔ maa woho dɛ ɔnye ɔman mma wo daa; na ɔwo, Ewuradze, bɛyɛɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn.
Na afei, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, asɛm a akã wɔ w'akowaa ho na ne fi ho no, hyɛ no dzen daa, na yɛ dɛ mbrɛ akã no.
Na ma wɔntonton wo dzin daa, dɛ, dɔm Ewuradze nye Israel do Nyankopɔn: Na w’akowaa David fi ntsim wɔ w’enyim.
Na ɔwo, dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, na ada no edzi akyerɛ w’akowaa, dɛ mebɛkyekyer ofi mama wo: Dɛm ntsi na w’akowaa ehu no wɔ n’akoma mu dɛ ɔbɔ mpaa yi ma wo yi.
Na afei, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, ɔwoara nye Nyankopɔn, na wo nsɛm yɛ nokwar, na ɔwoara na edze adze pa yi abɔ w’akowaa anohoba:
Dɛm ntsi afei ma ɔnyɛ wo fɛw dɛ ibehyira w’akowaa ne fi, ama ɔaako hɔ Wɔ w’enyim daa: Na ɔwo, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, na akã: Na wo nhyira na ma wɔmfa nhyira w’akowaa ne fi daa.
8: Na iyi ekyir no ɔbaa dɛ David kãa Philistiafo no gya, na ɔbrɛɛ hɔn adze: Na David gyee Philistiafo nsamu ahenkurow menyiamfrɛ no.
Na ɔkãa Moab so gya, na ɔdze susuhoma susuu hɔn ma wɔdedaa famu; na osusuu ahoma ebien a wonku hɔn, na ahoma mã kor a wɔntsena ase. Na Moabfo no bɛyɛɛ nkowaa maa David, na wɔdze ayɛyɛdze bae.
David kãa Zobahhen Hadadezer, Rehob ba no so gya, aber a osii mu kɔr dɛ ɔrokɔhwehwɛ n’ahendzi ekyir kwan wɔ Esutsen no ho no mu.
Na David kyeer no dɔm mu mpɔnkɔdofo apem ahaesuon, na anamɔnmufo mpemeduonu: Na David twitwaa tseaseanam mpɔnkɔ nyinara hɔn anantsir ntsin na ogyaa hɔn mu ntseaseanara ɔha ho dze.
Na aber a Damascus Syriafo no baa dɛ wɔrobɔboa Zobahhen Hadadezer no, David kum Syriafo no mn nyimpa mpemeduonuebien.
Nna David dze bansifo kɛtsenaa Damascus Syria: Na Syriafo no bɛyɛɛ nkowaa maa David, na wɔdze ayɛyɛ dze bae. Na Ewuradze maa David konyimdzi wɔ beebiara mbrɛ ɔkɔree.
Na David gyegyee sika akyɛm a ɔwowɔ Hadadezer no nkowaa ho no, na ɔdze baa Jerusalem.
Na Hadadezer no nkurow Betah na Berothai mu na ɔhen David faa boran mbordo.
Na aber a Hamathhen Toi tsee dɛ David aka Hadadezer no dɔm nyinara gya no,

nna Toi somaa ne ba Joram ma ɔbaa ɔhen David nkyɛn bekyiaa no, na ohyiraa no, dɛ ɔnye Hadadezer akõ, na ɔakã no gya ntsi: Osiandɛ Hadadezer nye Toi dzii akõ. Na Joram ɔdze dwetɛ ndzɛmba. Na sika ndzɛmba, na boran ndzɛmba bae:
Iyinom so na ɔhen David tui sii nkyɛn maa Ewuradze, dze kaa dwetɛ na sika a ofi amanaman nyinara a ɔbrɛɛ hɔn adze no mu no mu a otui sii nkyɛn no ho;
ofi Syria, na Moab, na Ammonmba, na Philistiafo, na Amalek, na Zobahhen Hadadezer, Rehob ba no, asadze mu.
Na aber a David sanee fii ne Syriafo kum no mu wɔ nkyen bɔnsa no mu no mekyerɛ nyimpa mpemduawɔtwe no, ɔgyee dzin.
Na ɔdze bansifo tscnaa Edom: Edom mu nyinara na ɔdze bansifo tsenatsenae, na Edomfo nyinara bɛyɛɛ nkowaa maa David. Na Ewuradze maa David konyimdzi wɔ beebiara mbrɛ ɔkɔree.
Na David dzii hen wɔ Israel nyinara do; na David dzii atsɛmbu na teeneneesɛm maa ne man nyinara.
Na Zeruiah ba Joab na ɔhwɛ dɔm no do; na Ahilud ba Jehoshaphat nye ɔsɛnkaafo:
Na Ahitub ba Zadok, na Abiathar ba Ahimelech nye asɔfo; na Seraiah nye ɔkyerɛwfo;
na Jehoiada ba Benaiah na ɔhwɛ Cherethfo na Pelethfo no do; na David mba no na wɔyɛ asomfompanyin.
9: Na David see dɛ, ana obi da ho wɔ hɔ a ɔaka wɔ Saul fie, ma menyɛ no ayamuyie wɔ Jonathan ntsi?
Na Saul fie akowaa bi wɔ hɔ a ne dzin dze Ziba, na wɔkɛfrɛɛ no ma ɔkor David nkyɛn; na ɔhen no see no dɛ, ana ɔwo nye Ziba a? Na ɔsee dɛ, w'akowaa nye no.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, ana obi nnyi hɔ bio wɔ Saul fie, ma me dze Nyankopɔn ayamuyie mebɛye no? Na Ziba see ɔhen no dɛ, Jonathan na ɔda ho wɔ ɔbabanyin bi a ɔyɛ ebubua.
Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, ɔwɔ hen? Na Ziba see ɔhen no dɛ, hwɛ, ɔwɔ Machir, Ammiel ba ne fie, wɔ Lo-debar.
Nna ɔhen David somae ma wɔkɛfaa no wɔ Machir, Ammiel ba no ne fie, wɔ Lo-debar bae.
Na Saul ne ba Jonathan ne ba Mephibosheth baa David nkyɛn, ɔdze n’enyim boom famu, na ɔyɛɛ enyidzi. Na David see dɛ, Mephibosheth. Na obuaa dɛ, hwɛ, w'akowaa nye yi.
Na David see no dɛ, Mma nnsuro: Na ampaara w'egya Jonathan ntsi mebɛyɛ wo ayamuyie, na madan w’egya Saul n’asaase nyinara mama wo; na ibedzidzi mo pon do daa.
Na ɔyee enyidzi, na ɔsee dɛ, w’akowaa nye bɛn, ma ebɔhwɛ ɔkraman fun a ɔtse dɛ emi yi?
Nna ɔhen no frɛɛ Ziba, Saul n’akowaa no, na ɔsee no dɛ, adze nyinara a ɔyɛ Saul na ne fi nyinara dze no medze mama wo wura ne ba no.

Na dɔw asaase no ma no, ɔwo, na wo mba, na wo nkowaa; na fa no do nduadzewa bra, ma wo wura ne ba nnya edziban ndzi: Na wo wura ne ba Mephibosheth dze ondzidzi mo pon do daa. Afei Ziba wɔ mbabanyin duenum na nkowaa eduonu.
Nna Ziba see ɔhen no dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ mo wura ɔhen hyɛ w’akowaa no nyinara no, dɛmara so na w’akowaa bɛyɛ. Na Mephibosheth dze, ɔhen no na ɔse, obedzidzi mo pon do dɛ ɔhen ne mba no mu bi.
Na Mephibosheth ɔwɔ babanyin kakraba bi a ne dzin dze Mica. Na hɔn a wɔtse Ziba fie nyinara wɔyɛ nkowaa dze ma Mephibosheth.
Nna Mephibosheth tsenaa Jerusalem: Na odzidzii ɔhen no no pon do daa; na ɔyɛ ebubua.
10: Na iyi ekyir no ɔbaa dɛ Ammonmba hɔn hen no wui, na ne ba Hanun bedzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.

Na David see dɛ, mebɛyɛ Nahash ba Hanun ayamuyie, dɛ mbrɛ n'egya yɛɛ me ayamuyie no. Nna David dze nam no nkowaa do somaa de wɔnkɛkyekye no werɛ wɔ n’egya ho. Na David no nkowaa no baa Ammonmba asaase no do.

Nna Ammonmba asafohemfo no see hɔn wura Hanun dɛ, ana edwen dɛ David odzi w’egya nyi ntsi na ɔasoma akyekyewerɛfo wɔ wo nkyɛn yi? Ana David annsoma no nkowaa wɔ wo nkyɛn dɛ wɔmbɔhwehwɛ kurow yi mu, na wɔnserasera mu, na wombutuw no bi a?
Nna Hanun ɔfaa David no nkowaa no, na oyiyii hɔn mbɔdwesa fã fã, na otwitwaa hɔn ntar mu finimfin finimfin araa dze bodur hɔn nsera ekyir, na ogyaa hɔn kwan.
Na wɔbɛkãa kyerɛɛ David no, ɔsomae ma wokehyiaa hɔn kwan; osiandɛ woegu mbarimba no enyim ase kɛse. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, hom ntsintsim wɔ Jericho ma onkodu dɛ hom mbɔdwesa bofuw ana nkyii hom asan aba.

Na aber a Ammonmba no wohun dɛ hɔn ho abɔn David no, Ammonmba no somaa ma wɔkɔbɔɔ Beth-rehob Syriafo, na Zobah Syriafo paa, anamɔnmufo mpemeduonu na Maacahhen no nye mbarimba apem, na Tobfo mbarimba mpemduebien.
Na David tsee no, ɔsomaa Joab, na mbarimba akatakyi dɔm no nyinara ma wɔkɔree.
Na Ammonmba no puei, na wɔbaabaa mpasuar wɔ kuropon no n’ahɛnee: Na Zobah, na Rehob Syriafo, na Tob na Maacah mbarimba no, hɔnara nko wogyinae wɔ haban no mu.
Afei aber a Joab hun dɛ ɔkõ no wɔ n’enyim na n’ekyir no, ɔpaa Israel mu mbarimba a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn no mu bi, na ɔmaa wɔbaae kehyiaa Syriafo no:
Na nkorɔfo nkaa no ɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ no nua Abishai nsa, na ɔmaa wɔbaae kehyiaa Ammonmba no.
Na ɔsee dɛ, sɛ Syriafo no yɛ dzen dodow ma me a, ɔno bɔboa me: Na sɛ Ammonmba no yɛ dzen dodow ma wo a, ɔno mebɛba mabɔboa wo.
Nya akokodur, na ma yɛnyɛ hɛnho mbarimba mma hɛn man, na hɛn Nyankopɔn no nkurow no: Na Ewuradze nyɛ dza oye wɔ n’enyiwa do.
Nna Joab na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no twee pinii nye Syriafo no dze bɔɔ enyim: Na woguanee wɔ n’enyim.
Na aber a Ammonmba no wohun dɛ Syriafo no eguan no, nna hɔn so woguanee wɔ Abishai n’enyim, na wɔkɛhɛɛn kurow no mu. Nna Joab fii Ammonmba no ho sanee, na ɔbaa Jerusalem.
Na aber a Syriafo no hun dɛ woegu wɔ Israel enyim no, wɔpoon hɔnho hyiae.
Na Hadarezer somae ma wɔkɛfaa Syriafo no a wɔwɔ Esutsen no egya no puei bae: Na wɔbaa Helam, dɛ Hadarezer no dɔm safohen panyin Shobach na odzi hɔn enyim.
Na wɔbɛkãa kyerɛɛ David; na ɔpoon Israel nyinara hyiae, na okotwaa Jordan kɔr Helam. Na Syriafo no baa mpasuar hyiaa David, na wɔnye no kõe.
Na Syriafo no guanee wɔ Israel enyim; na David kunkum Syriafo no ntseaseanam ahaesuon mu nyimpa, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemeduanan, na ɔkaa hɔn dɔm safohen panyin Shobach gya, ma owui wɔ hɔ.
Na aber a ahemfo a wɔyɛ nkowaa ma Hadarezer no nyinara hun dɛ woegu wɔ Israel enyim no, wɔnye Israel siesiei, na wɔsoom hɔn. Nna Syriafo no suroo dɛ wɔbɔboa Ammonmba no bio.
11: Na ɔbaa dɛ, mfedan no durii no, aber a ahemfo wotu sa mu no, David somaa Joab, na no nkowaa ka no ho, na Israel nyinara; na wɔkɛsɛɛ Ammonmba no, na wokotuaa Rabbah. Na David dze otsintsimii wɔ Jerusalem.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ewimbir bi, David soɛree fii ne mpa do, na ɔpasapasaar ɔhen no ne dan no etsifi: Na ofi ɔdan no etsifi na ohun ɔbaa bi a oruguar; na ɔbaa no ehwɛ no a, no ho yɛ fɛw dodow.
Na David somae ma wokebisaa ɔbaa no n’ekyir kwan. Na obi see dɛ, ana nnyɛ Eliam ne babaa Bath-sheba, Hittinyi Uriah ne yer no nye yi bi a?
Na David somaa abɔfo ma wɔkɛfaa no; na ɔbaa ne nkyɛn, na ohun no; (osiandɛ oeguar noho efi n’ahoɔfi no mu); na ɔsanee kɔr ne fie.
Na ɔbaa no nyinsenii na ɔsomae ma wɔkɛkãa kyerɛɛ David dɛ, minyinsen.
Na David somae ma wɔkɔr Joab hɔ, dɛ, gya Hittinyi Uriah kwan ma ɔmbra me nkyɛn. Na Joab gyaa Uriah kwan ma ɔkɔr David nkyɛn.
Na aber a Uriah baa ne nkyɛn no, David bisaa no mbrɛ Joab na ɔman no hɔn ho tse, na mbrɛ ɔsa no ayɛ yie apa.
Na David see Uriah dɛ, sian kɔ wo fie, na kɔhohor w’anan ho. Na Uriah fii ɔhen no ne fie kɔree, na wɔdze ayɛyɛdze fi ɔhen hɔ kaa no do.
Na Uriah dze, ɔnye no wura no nkowaa no nyinara kɛdaa ɔhen no ne fie abowano, na oennsian annkɔ ne fie.
Na aber a wɔkãa kyerɛɛ David, dɛ. Uriah oennsian annkɔ ne fie no. David see Uriah dɛ, ana immfi kwan nam bi a? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ennsian annkɔ wo fie?

Na Uriah see David dɛ, adaka no, na Israel, na Judah, tsetse asese mu; na mo wura Joab, na mo wura no nkowaa, wɔakyer nsera wɔ haban petee mu; na emi nna monkɔ me fie, minkedzidzi na monnom, na menye me yer nda anaa? Dɛ etse ase, na wo kra tse ase yi, merennyɛ dɛm adze yi.
Na David see Uriah dɛ, tsintsim ha ndɛ so, na ɔkyena mebɛma akɔ. Nna Uriah tsenaa Jerusalem da no, na n’adzekyee no.
Na aber a David frɛɛ no no, odzidzii na ɔnomee wɔ n’enyim; na ɔmaa ɔbowee: Na ewimbir no osii mu kɔree kɛdaa ne mpa do ɔnye no wura no nkowaa no, na mbom oennsian annkɔ ne fie.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, anapa no, David kyerɛɛw nwoma dze kɛmaa Joab, na ɔdze nam Uriah nsa do kɔree.
Na ɔkyerɛwee wɔ nwoma no mu, dɛ, hom mma Uriah nkedzi mbrɛ ɔkõ no asaasaa do no ano, na hom mfi ne nkyɛn mpem adze, ma wɔmbɔ no ma ɔntɔr.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Joab rohwɛ kurow no no, ɔdze Uriah kedzii beebi mbrɛ onyim dɛ mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam wɔ.
Na kurow no mu mbarimba fiir edzi, na wɔnye Joab bɔkõe: Na nkorɔfo no mu bi totɔree, mekyerɛ David no nkowaa no a; na Hittinyi Uriah so tɔree.
Nna Joab somae ma wɔkɛkaa ɔsa no mu nsɛm nyinara kyerɛɛ David;
na ɔhyɛɛ ɔbɔfo no, dɛ, sɛ iwie ɔsa no mu nsɛm nyinara kã dze kyerɛ ɔhen no,
na ɔba dɛ, sɛ ɔhen no n'ebufuw soɛr, na ɔse wo dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom bɛɛn kurow no dɛm kɔkõe? Hom nnyim dɛ wobefi fasu no do atotow?

Woana na okum Jerubbesheth ne ba Abimelek? ana nnyɛ ɔbaa bi na ofi fasu do ɔtoow ewuyamboba bɔɔ no, ma ɔtɔree wo Thebez no bi a? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom bɛɛn kurow no dɛm yi? A; ɔno se dɛ, w’akowaa Uriah, Hittinyi no so atɔr.
Nna ɔbɔfo no sii mu kɔree, na ɔbaa bɛkãa dza Joab dze somaa no no nyinara kyerɛɛ David.
Na ɔbɔfo no see David dɛ, mbarimba no hyɛɛ hɛn do, na wopuei baa hɛn do wɔ haban no mu, na yɛkɔr hɔn do araa dze kodur kuropon n’ahɛnee no mu.
Na atowfo no fi fasu no do totowee guu wo nkowaa do; na ɔhen no nkowaa no binom atotɔr, na w’akowaa Uriah, Hittinyi no so atɔr.

Nna David see ɔbɔfo no dɛ, dɛm na kɛkã kyerɛ Joab, mma mma asɛm yi nnyɛ wo awerɛhow, na afõwa otwa obi dɛ mbrɛ otwa obi so: Ma wo kõ no mu nyɛ dzendzen wɔ kurow no do, na dwuruw no: Na ɔwoara hyɛ no dzen.
Na aber a Uriah ne yer tsee dɛ no kun Uriah oewu no, ogyaam no kun no.
Na aber a eyiyɛ no twaa mu no, David somae ma wɔkɛfaa no baa ne fie, na ɔbɛyɛɛ ne yer, na ɔwoo babanyin maa no. Na adze a David yɛɛ no ɔyɛɛ Ewuradze ebufuw.
12: Na Ewuradze somaa Nathan ma ɔkɔr David hɔ. Na ɔbaa ne nkyɛn, na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, mbarimba beenu wɔwɔ kurow kor mu; ɔbaako obirɛmpɔn a, na ɔbaako so ohianyi a.
Obirɛmpɔn no ɔwɔ nguan na anantwikuw dodoodow mbordo:

Na ohianyi no dze, onnyi hwee dɛ gyama eguambaaber kakraba kor a ɔtɔɔ no na ɔnyɛɛn no: Na ɔnye ɔno, na ɔnye ne mba bɔɔ mu nyinii; odzii nankasa no trɔma bi, na ɔnoom nankasa no kuraba ano, na ɔdaa no bo mu, na ɔyɛɛ no dɛ ɔbabaa.

Na ɔnantsennyi bi baa obirɛmpɔn no nkyɛn, na ɔkaa mu dɛ ɔfa nankasa no nguan, na n'anantwi no bi siesie dze ma ɔkwantsennyi no a ɔbɔsoɛɛ no no, na mbom ɔkɛfaa ohianyi no n’eguambaa no, na osiesiei dze maa ɔbarimba no a ɔbaa no hɔ no.
Na David n’ebufuw dzɛɛw kɛsenara wɔ ɔbarimba no do; na ɔsee Nathan dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi, ɔbarimba a ɔayɛ iyi no ɔfata dɛ owu:
Na ɔnhyɛ eguambaa no ananmu mbɔho anan, osiandɛ ɔayɛ dɛm adze yi, na ɔannkyerɛ tsimbɔbɔr ntsi.
Na Nathan see David dɛ, ɔwoara nye ɔbarimba no. Mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, se nye yi, mara na meseraa wo mehyɛɛ wo ɔhen wɔ Israel do, na mara na megyee wo Saul nsamu;
