na medze wo wura ne fi memaa wo, na medze wo wura ne yernom muguu wo bo mu, na medze Israel na Judah fi memaa wo; na sɛ osuar dodow a, nkyɛ medze dɛm na dɛm so mebɛkã wo ho.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ebu Ewuradze n’asɛm enyimtsia, na ereyɛ dza omuo wɔ n’enyi do yi? Ɔwo edze afõwa ekum Uriah, Hittinyi no, na afa ne yer ayɛ wo yer, na edze Ammonmba afõwa ekum no.
Dɛm ntsi afei, afõwa rimmfi wo fie mmfir ara da; osiandɛ ebu me enyimtsia, na afa Uriah, Hittinyi no ne yer ayɛ wo yer.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ, mebɛma mbusu efi wankasa wo fie asoɛr wo do, na magye wo yernom wɔ w’enyim, na medze hɔn mama wo nyɛnko, na ɔnye wo yernom adeda wɔ wi yi enyim.
Na ɔwo yɛɛ no nsumaa mu: Na emidze mebɛyɛ adze yi wɔ Israel nyinara enyim, na iwi enyim.
Na David see Nathan dɛ, mayɛ bɔn etsia Ewuradze. Na Nathan see David dɛ, Ewuradze so ama wo bɔn etwa mu; innkowu.
Naaso, osiandɛ edze nyɛe yi ama Ewuradze n'atamfo enya ho kwan kɛse dɛ wɔkã ebususɛm no ntsi, abofra no a wɔawo no ama wo no so owu ara na obowu.
Na Nathan kɔr ne fie. Na Ewuradze bɔɔ abofra no a Uriah ne yer no woo no maa David no, ma ɔyaar dzendzenndzen.
Dɛm ntsi David paa Nyankopɔn kyɛw maa abofra no; na David dzii mbuada, na ɔkɔr dan mu kɛdaa famu anago no nyinara.
Na ne fie mpanyimfo no soɛree, na wokegyinaa no do, dɛ wɔrema no do efi famu: Na ɔammpen, nkyii so ɔnye hɔn enndzidzi.

Na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsīa esuon no abofra no wui. Na David no nkowaa no suroo dɛ wɔbɛkã akyerɛ no dɛ abofra no ewu: Na wɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, aber a abofra no da ho tse ase no, yɛkasaa kyerɛɛ no, na oenntsie hɛn ndze: Na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn mbɔ akã akyerɛ no dɛ abofra no ewu ma ɔnnkɛyɛ noho bɔn bi?
Na aber a David hun dɛ no nkowaa no abɔ mu rowesawesa no, David hun dɛ abofra no ewu: Na David see no nkowaa no dɛ, ana abofra no ewu a? Na wɔsee dɛ, oewu.
Nna David soɛree fii famu, na ɔhohoor noho, na ɔserae, na ɔsakyeer n’atar; na ɔkɔr Ewuradze ne fie, na ɔkɔsɔree: Na nkyii ɔbaa nankasa ne fie; na obisae no, wɔdze edziban besii n'enyim, ma odzii.
Nna no nkowaa no see no dɛ, ebɛnadze na ayɛ yi? Ɔwo idzii mbuada na isūi maa abofra no, aber a ɔtse ase no; na mbom aber a abofra no wui no asoɛr na edzidzi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Aber a abofra no da ho tse ase no, midzii mbuada na musūi: Na mesee dɛ, woana na onyim dɛ ibia Ewuradze bɔdom me ma abofra no atsena ase?
Na afei dze oewu yi, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mindzi mbuada? Ana mubotum medze no asan aba bio? Emi na mobɔkɔ ne nkyɛn, na ɔnodze, ɔrennsan mmba me nkyɛn.
Na David kyekyee ne yer Bath-sheba no werɛ, na ɔkɔr ne nkyɛn, na ohun no; na ɔwoo babanyin, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Solomon. Na Ewuradze dɔɔ no;
na ɔdze nam nkɔnhyɛnyi Nathan nsa do somae ma ɔkɔtoo no dzin Jedidiah wɔ Ewuradze ntsi.
Afei Joab nye Ammonmba Rabbah kõe, na ɔgyee ahenkurow no.
Na Joab tuu abɔfo ma wɔkɔr David nkyɛn kɛsee dɛ, menye Rabbah akõ, nyew, magye nsukurow no.
Dɛm ntsi afei, pon nkorɔfo nkaa no hyia, na bɛkyer kurow no ho nsera na gye: Ɔno bɛyɛ na magye kurow no na wɔdze me dzin ato no.
Nna David poon nkorɔfo no nyinara hyiae, na osii mu kɔr Rabbah, na ɔnye no kɔkõe, na ɔgyee.
Na oyii hɔn hen n'ahenkyɛw no wɔ ne tsir; na no dur yɛ sika talent, na no mu wɔ aboɔdzenabo; na wɔdze hyɛɛ David ne tsir. Na ɔdze kurow no mu asadze piigyan mbordo puei bae.

Na ɔdze nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ mu no puei bae, na ɔdze hɔn kɛhyɛɛ nseradaa, na dadze dɛtseporoweeadze, na dadze nkuma ase, na ɔmaa wokoduaa ntayaa fononoo mu: Na mbrɛ ɔdze yɛɛ Ammonmba nkurow no nyinara nye no. Na David na ɔman no nyinara sanee baa Jerusalem.
13: Na ɔbaa dɛ iyi ekyir no, David ne ba Absalom wɔ akyerɛbaa fɛɛfɛw bi a ne dzin dze Tamar; na David ne ba Amnon ɔpɛ no.
Na Amnon no ho hiahiaa no dodow ma ɔyaree, osian n'akyerɛbaa Tamar ntsi; na ɔyɛ ɔbaabun; na ɔyɛɛ dzen maa Amnon dɛ ɔbɛyɛ no biribi.
Na Amnon wɔ nyɛnko bi a ne dzin dze Jonadab, David no nua Shimeah ba a: Na Jonadab yɛ nyimpa a n’enyi atsew dodow.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, ao, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔhen ne ba efɔn dɛm daa daa yi? Ana ennkɛkã akyerɛ me? Na Amnon see no dɛ, mepɛ mo nua Absalom n’akyerɛbaa Tamar.

Na Jonadab see no dɛ, kɛda wo mpa do, na petuw yar: Na sɛ w’egya ba dɛ ɔrobɔhwɛ wo a, ase dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma m’akyerɛbaa Tamar mbra, na ɔmbɛma me edziban ma mindzi, na ɔnyɛ edziban no wɔ m’enyim, ma mara munhu, na mindzi no wɔ ne nsamu.

Nna Amnon kɛdae, na opetuwii yaree: Na aber a ɔhen no baa dɛ ɔrobɔhwɛ no no, Amnon see ɔhen no dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma m’akyerɛbaa Tamar mbra, na ɔmbɛyɛ tatar ebien bi wɔ m’enyim mma me, ma mindzi wɔ ne nsamu.
Nna David somae ma wɔkɔr Tamar hɔ wɔ fie, dɛ, kɔ wo nua Amnon fie seseiara, na kɛyɛ edziban ma no.
Nna Tamar sii mu kɔr no nua Amnon ne; nna ɔda. Na ɔfaa mbɔr fetsewee, na ɔyɛɛ tatar wɔ n’enyim, na ɔkyɛɛw tatar no.
Na ɔfaa kyesɛn no na ohuee no wɔ n’enyim; na ɔammpɛ dɛ odzi. Na Amnon see dɛ, ma nyunpa nyinara mfi me nkyɛn mpue. Na wopuei, nyimpa biara fii ne nkyɛn.
Na Amnon see Tamar dɛ. Fa edziban no bra pia mu, ma mindzi no wɔ wo nsamu. Na Tamar faa tatar no a ɔyɛe no, na ɔdze brɛɛ no nua Amnon wɔ pia mu.
Na aber a ɔdze piin ne nkyɛn dɛ ondzi no, osuoo no mu, na ɔsee no dɛ, m'akyerɛbaa, bra bɛnye me nda.
Na obuaa no dɛ, oho, mo nua, mma nnhyɛ me; na wɔnnyɛ dɛm adze wɔ Israel: Mma nnyɛ nkwaseadze yi.
Na emidze, henfa na morosoa m'enyimguase mafa? Na ɔwodze, ebɛyɛ dɛ Israel mu nkwasea no bi. Dɛm ntsi afei meserɛ wo, kɛkã kyerɛ ɔhen; na ɔnnkɛfa me akam wo.
Naaso ɔammpɛ dɛ otsie ne ndze: Na ɔnam dɛ no ho yɛ dzen ne ntsi, ɔhyɛɛ no, na ohun no.
Nna Amnon dze tan kɛse mbordo taan no; na tan a ɔdze taan no no yɛɛ kɛse sen ɔdɔ a ɔdze dɔɔ no no. Na Amnon see no dɛ, soɛr, fi ha kɔ.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, dabida, osiandɛ bɔn kɛse a edze repam me yi omuo sen kor no a edze yɛɛ me no. Na ɔammpɛ dɛ otsie no.
Nna ɔfrɛɛ n'akowaa a ɔsom no no, na ɔsee dɛ, yi ɔbaa yi edzi fi me nkyɛn pue, na tow no abow no ekyir krɔkrɔw.
Na ɔhyɛ asaasaaba atar bi: Na dɛm mbataker na ɔhen ne mbabaa a wɔyɛ mbaabun no no wɔhyehyɛe. Na n’akowaa no dze no puei, na ɔtoow no abow no ekyir krɔkrɔw.
Na Tamar tuu nso guu n’etsifi, na osunsuaan n’asaasaaba atar a ɔhyɛ no no mu; na ɔdze ne nsa guu n’etsifi, na ɔkɔr no kwan, mbrɛ ɔrokɔ no nna ɔrekeka mu.
Na no nua Absalom see no dɛ, ana wo nua Amnon aba wo nkyɛn anaa? Na afei m’akyerɛbaa, mua w’ano: Ɔyɛ wo nua; mma mmfa asɛm yi nnto w’akoma mu. Nna Tamar tsenaa no nua Absalom fie bɔmm.
Na aber a ɔhen David tsee nsɛm nyinara no, no bo fuuw dodow.
Na Absalom annkasa papa anaa bɔn annkyerɛ Amnon: Na Absalom taan Amnon, osiandɛ ɔahyɛ n’akyerɛbaa Tamar ntsi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe ebien imu ekyir no, nna Absalom wɔ nguan-susuafo wɔ Baal-hazor a ɔwɔ Ephraim nkyɛn mu: Na Absalom hyiaa ɔhen ne mbabanyin no nyinara.
Na Absalom baa ɔhen no nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, afei hwɛ, w’akowaa wo nguan-susuafo; meserɛ wo, ma ɔhen, na no nkowaa wɔnye w’akowaa nkɔ.
Na ɔhen no see Absalom dɛ, oho, me ba, mma mma hɛn nyinara yɛnnkɔ, ɔno bɛyɛ na yɛaayɛ adzesoa ama wo. Na ɔhyɛɛ no: Naaso oennya no ma ɔannkɔ, mbom ohyiraa no.
Nna Absalom see dɛ, sɛ annyɛ dɛm a, meserɛ wo, ma mo nua Amnon nye hɛn nkɔ. Na ɔhen no see no dɛ. Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔnye wo nkɔ?
Na Absalom hyɛɛ no araa ma ɔmaa Amnon na ɔhen ne mbabanyin no nyinara nye no kɔree.

Na Absalom hyɛɛ no nkowaa no, dɛ, afei hom nhyɛ no nsew, sɛ Amnon n'ako ma nya nsã mu enyigye, na sɛ mese hom dɛ, hom mbɔ Amnon a, ɔno hom nku no, mma hom nnsuro: Ana nnyɛ mara na mahyɛ hom bi? Hom nyɛ akokodur, na wɔnyɛ mbanyindze.
Na Absalom no nkowaa no yɛɛ Amnon dɛ mbrɛ Absalom hyɛe no ara. Nna ɔhen no mbabanyin no nyinara soɛrsoɛree, na nyimpa biara fowee tsenaa n’asoaso do guanee.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔwɔ ɔkwan mu no, nna nsɛm no dur David nkyɛn, dɛ, Absalom eku ɔhen ne mbabanyin no nyinara, na hɔn mu baako mpo annka.
Nna ɔhen no soɛree, na ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔdaa famu; na no nkowaa no nyinara atsetsew hɔn ntar mu gyinagyina hɔ.

Na Jonadab, David no nua Shimeah ba no, buae see dɛ, mma mma mo wura nsusu dɛ woekum ɔhen ne mbabanyin mberantsɛ no nyinara; na Amnon nko na oewu: Na ɔnam Absalom ne nhyehyɛɛ do na iyi wɔabɔ no pɔw fi da no a ɔhyɛɛ n’akyerɛbaa Tamar no.
Dɛm ntsi afei mma mma mo wura ɔhen mmfa asɛm no nnto n'akoma mu, dɛ ɔbɔdwen dɛ ɔhen ne mbabanyin no nyinara ewuwu: Na Amnon nko na oewu.
Na Absalom dze oguanee. Na aberantsɛ a ɔweɔn no maa n’enyi do, na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, nyimpa pii nam ɔkwan a ɔwɔ koko nkyɛnmu wɔ n’ekyir no mu reba.
Na Jonadab see ɔhen no dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔhen ne mbabanyin no reba: Mbrɛ w’akowaa see no, mbrɛ ɔtse ara nye no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ owiee kasa no ara, nna, hwɛ, ɔhen no ne mbabanyin no bae, na wɔmemaa hɔn ndze do, na wosūi: Na ɔhen no so na no nkowaa no nyinara sūu pii.
Na Absalom dze oguanee na osii mu kɔr Geshurhen Talmai, Ammihur ne babanyin no nkyɛn. Na David gyaam ne ba no daa nyina.
Nna Absalom guanee, na osii mu kɔr Geshur, na odzii hɔ mfe ebiasa.
Na ɔhen David ne kra no kɔn dɔɔ dɛ obefir akɔ Absalom nkyɛn: Osiandɛ no werɛ akyekyer wɔ Amnon ho, ɔnam dɛ oewu ntsi.
14: Afei Zeruiah ba Joab hun dɛ ɔhen no n’akoma wɔ Absalom ho.

Na Joab somaa ma wɔkɔr Tekoa, na wɔkɛfaa ɔbaa onyansafo bi fi hɔ bae, na ɔsee no dɛ, meserɛ wo, petuw ara yɛ woho dɛ eyiyɛnyi, na hyɛ eyiyɛ atar, na mma mmfa ngo nnsera woho, na yɛ dɛ ɔbaa a ogyaam ewufo akyɛr:
Na kɔ ɔhen no nkyɛn, na kɛkã no dɛm kyerɛ no. Nna Joab dze nsɛm hyɛɛ n’ano.
Na aber a ɔbaa no a ofi Tekoa no baa ɔhen no nkyɛn no, ɔdze n’enyim boom famu, na ɔyɛɛ enyidzi, na ɔsee dɛ, ao ɔhen, boa me.
Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ɔyɛ wo? Na obuaa dɛ, ampa meyɛ ɔbaa kunafo, na mo kun ewu.
Na w’afonabaa wɔ mbabanyin beenu, na hɔn beenu no dzii aperper wɔ haban mu, na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔpata hɔn, na ɔbaako bɔɔ ɔbaako no, ma ɔtɔree.

Na, hwɛ, ebusua no nyina asoɛr wɔ w’afonabaa do, na wɔse dɛ, yi nyia ɔbɔɔ no nua no ma, ma yenku no wɔ no nua no a okum no no nkwa ntsi, na dɛm na yɛbɛsɛɛ ɔdzedzifo no so: Na wɔdze dɛm rubodum me gyansenama a aka no, na woenngyaa dzin anaa okyirkafo so amma mo kun wɔ asaase enyi.
Na ɔhen no see ɔbaa no dɛ, Kɔ wo fie, na mebɛhyɛ mbra wɔ wo ho.
Na ɔbaa no a ofi Tekoa no see ɔhen no dɛ, mo wura ɔhen, asodzi no nda mo do, na m’egya ne fi do: Na ɔhen na n’ahengua no ndzi bem.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, obiara sɛ wo biribiara a, fa no brɛ me, na ɔrennkã wo bio.
Nna ɔsee dɛ, meserɛ wo, wɔmma ɔhen nkaa Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, na bɔgya ho werdzifo no annsɛɛ bi bio, ɔno bɛyɛ na wɔaasɛɛ me ba. Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi, wo ba no nhwi kor ronntɔ famu.
Nna ɔbaa no see dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma w’afonabaa nkã asɛm kor nkyerɛ mo wura ɔhen. Na ɔsee dɛ, kã ɛ.
Na ɔbaa no see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na esusu dɛm adze etsia Nyankopɔn ne man yi? Osiandɛ asɛm yi ne nkãa mu no ɔhen yɛ dɛ obi a odzi fɔ, ɔhen rennkɛfa ne nyimpa a wɔapam no no mmba fie bio.
Na owu ara na yebowu, na yɛtse dɛ nsu a woehue egu famu a wɔboaboa ano bio a ɔnnyɛ; nkyii so Nyankopɔn nnyi nkwa, mbom osusu ɔkwan, ma nyia wɔapam no no ɔaannyɛ ɔkwankwannyi oemmfi ne nkyɛn.

Dɛm ntsi afei ɔnam dɛ maba dɛ merebɛkã asɛm yi makyerɛ mo wura ɔhen no, nna ne siantsir nye dɛ ɔman no ayɛ me ma mesuro: Na w’afonabaa see dɛ, afei mebɛkasa makyerɛ ɔhen; annyɛ a ɔhen bɛyɛ n’abaawa n’ebisadze no.
Osiandɛ ɔhen betsie na oeyi n’abaawa efi nyimpa no a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔsɛɛ emi na me ba nyina fi Nyankopɔn egyapadze ho no ne nsamu.

Nna w'afonabaa see dɛ, meserɛ wo wɔmaa mo wura ɔhen n'asɛm nyɛ awerɛkyekyer: Na dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn no bɔfoe tse no, dɛmara so na mo wura ɔhen tse, dɛ ohu papa na bɔn mu: Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ndzi w'ekyir.
Nna ɔhen no buae see ɔbaa no dɛ, meserɛ wo, mma nnsiw me biribiara a mibebisa wo no do. Na ɔbaa no see dɛ, wɔmma afei mo wura ɔhen nkasa ɛ.

Na ɔhen no see dɛ, ana Joab ne nsa kã wo ho wo iyi nyinara mu a? Na ɔbaa no buae see dɛ, mo wura ɔhen, dɛ wo kra tse ase yi, obi runntum nndan mmfi asɛm a mo wura ɔhen akã no ho mmfa enyimfa anaa abankum: Na w’akowaa Joab, na ɔhyɛɛ me, na ɔnoara na ɔdze nsɛm yi nyinara hyɛɛ w’afonabaa n’ano:
Dɛ ɔbɛdan asɛm no n’enyi ntsi na w’akowaa Joab ayɛ adze yi: Na mo wura yɛ onyansafo, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoe ne nyansaa tse, dɛ obohu dza ɔwɔ asaase do nyinara.
Na ɔhen no see Joab dɛ, afei hwɛ, mayɛ adze yi: Dɛm ntsi kɔ, kɛfa aberantsɛ Absalom san bra.
Na Joab dze n’enyim boom famu, na ɔyɛɛ enyidzi, na ohyiraa ɔhen no: Na Joab see dɛ, ndɛ na w’akowaa ehu dɛ menya w’enyim enyimnyam, mo wura ɔhen, wɔ dɛ ɔhen ayɛ n’akowaa n’ebisadze no.
Nna Joab soɛree na osii mu kɔr Geshur, na ɔkɛfaa Absalom baa Jerusalem.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, wɔmma ɔmman nkɔ nankasa ne fie, na mma wɔmma onnhu m’enyim. Nna Absalom manee kɔr nankasa ne fie, na oennhu ɔhen no enyim.
Afei obi nnyi Israel nyinara mu a wɔkamfo n’ahoɔfɛw dodow dɛm dɛ Absalom: Ofi n’ananadze araa dze kodu n’etsifi pampamu no dzɛm biara nnyi no ho.
Na sɛ oyi ne tsir a, (afei afrenhyia biara n’ewiei oyi: Osiandɛ nhwi no ɔyɛ no do dur, dɛm ntsi na oyi): Oker ne tsinhwi no ma ɔtow shekel ahaenu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen n’abrambo tse.
Na wɔwoo mbabanyin baasa maa Absalom, na ɔbabaa kor a ne dzin dze Tamar: Ɔyɛ ɔbaa a n’enyim yɛ fɛw.
Na Absalom tsenaa Jerusalem mfe pɔrpɔr ebien; na oennhu ɔhen no n’enyim da.
Nna Abasalom somae ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ Joab, dɛ ɔrosoma no wɔ ɔhen nkyɛn; na ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔba ne nkyɛn: Na ɔsomaa bio ne mpɛn ebien, na ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔba.
Dɛm ntsi ɔsee no nkowaa dɛ, hom nhwɛ, Joab ne haban ɔbɛn medze, na ɔwɔ atoko wɔ hɔ; hom nkɔ nkɔto mu gya
Nna Joab soɛree na ɔbaa Absalom nkyɛn wɔ ne fie, na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wo nkowaa akɔto me haban mu gya yi?

Na Absalom buaa Joab dɛ, hwɛ, mosomae ma wɔbaa wo hɔ, dɛ, bra ha, ma monsoma wo wɔ ɔhen hɔ, dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mifi Geshur mebae? Oye ma me dɛ nkyɛ meda ho mowɔ hɔ: Dɛm ntsi afei ma munhu ɔhen no n’enyim; na sɛ emumuyɛ bi wɔ mo mu a, wɔmma onku me.
Nna Joab baa ɔhen no nkyɛn, na ɔbɛkãa kyerɛɛ no: Na wɔkɛfrɛɛ Absalom no, ɔbaa ɔhen no nkyɛn, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze dze n’enyim boom famu wɔ ɔhen no enyim: Na ɔhen no feew Absalom n’ano.
15: Na ɔbaa dɛ iyi ekyir no Absalom siesiee tseaseanam na mpɔnkɔ maa noho, na mbarimba eduonum a wɔbɛyɛ n’enyim abrampɔfo.

Na Absalom soɛɛr ahanamakye, na okegyinaa kuropon ano kwan ho: Na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ nyimpa biara nya asɛm bi a ɔgye dɛ ɔba ɔhen nkyɛn bedzi a, nna Absalom afrɛ no, ase dɛ, ifi ebɛn kurow do? Na ɔsee dɛ, w’akowaa fi Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw no mu bi mu.
Nna Absalom see no dɛ, hwɛ wo nsɛm ye na ɔtsen; na nyimpa bi nnyi hɔ a ɔhen etu no dɛ ontsie wo.
Nkyii so Absalom see dɛ, ao kɛtseankyɛ wɔaahyɛ me asaase yi do ɔtsɛmbuafo, ma nyimpa biara a ɔwɔ ebisadze bi anaa asɛm bi ɔaaba mo hɔ, na meebu no atsɛntsenenee.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ nyimpa bi twe pin dɛ ɔbɛyɛ no enyidzi a, ɔtsen ne nsa, na osuo no mu, na ofew n’ano.
Na dɛm yi ara na Absalom dze yɛɛ Israel nyinara a wɔbaa ɔhen nkyɛn asɛndzi: Nna Absalom dze wiawiaa Israel mbarimba no hɔn akoma.
Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe eduanan sõe wiei no, Absalom see ɔhen no dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma monkɔ monkɔpon m’anohoba a mabɔ mama Ewuradze no, wɔ Hebron.
Osiandɛ aber a metse Geshur wɔ Syria no w’akowaa bɔɔ anohoba dɛ, sɛ Ewuradze dze me san ba Jerusalem ara ampa a, ɔno mobɔsom Ewuradze.
Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, Kɔ asomdwee mu. Nna ɔsoɛree, na osii mu kɔr Hebron.
Na Absalom somasomaa aserafo ma wɔkɔr Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu, dɛ, sɛ hom tse abɛn ndze ara a, ɔno hom nse dɛ, Absalom dzi hen wɔ Hebron.
Na mbarimba ahaenu a wohyiaa hɔn ma wofi Jerusalem kãa Absalom ho ma wɔkɔree, na hɔndze wɔkɔr no dɛ hɔn tsirmu faa; na wonnyim ho biribiara.

Na Absalom somae ma wokehyiaa Ahithophel, Gilohnyi no, David ne pamfo no, wɔ no kurow mu, mekyerɛ Giloh a, mber a ɔrobɔ afɔr no. Na tsirdoapam no mu yɛɛ dzen; osiandɛ ɔman no da ho ara dɔree wɔ Absalom nkyɛn.
Na ɔbɔfo bi baa David nkyɛn, dɛ, Israel mbarimba akoma dzi Absalom ekyir.

Na David see no nkowaa a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalem no nyinara dɛ, hom nsoɛr ma yenguan; ɔno bɛyɛ na hɛn mu biara emmfi Absalom nsa emmfi: Hom nyɛ ntsɛm nsi mu nkɔ, amma no ho aannyɛ har ɔammbɔto hɛn, na ɔaammfa bɔn bi ammba hɛn do, na ɔaammfa afõwa anomu ammbɔbɔ kurow yi.
Na ɔhen no nkowaa no see ɔhen dɛ, hwɛ, wo nkowaa ayɛ krado dɛ yɛbɛyɛ biribiara a mo wura ɔhen bɛpɛ nyinara.
Na ɔhen no fiir edzi, na ne fiefo nyinara dzi n'ekyir. Na ɔhen no gyaa mbaa du a wɔyɛ nwewefo, de wɔnhwɛ ofi no.
Na ɔhen no fiir edzi, na no nkowaa nyinara dzi n’ekyir; na woketsintsimii wɔ Beth-merhak.
Na no nkowaa no nyinara twaa mu wɔ ne nkyɛn kɔree; na Cherethfo nyinara, na Pelethfo nyinara, na Gittifo nyinara, mbarimba ahaesia a wofi Gath bae bedzii n'ekyir no botwaa mu wɔ ɔhen no n’enyim.
Nna ɔhen no see Ittai, Gittinyi no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wo so enye hɛn rokɔ? San kɔ, na kɛtsena ɔhen no nkyɛn: Na ɔwo yɛ ɔhɔho, na ɔmantunyi so; san kɔ wankasa wo man mu.
Naaso ɔwo ndeda yi ara na ebae, na ndɛ memma enye hɛn nkɔ nkekyin, hwɛ no dɛ morokɔ beebiara a mibenya makɔ yi? San na fa wo nuanom no san ekyir kɔ; mbɔbɔrhu na nokwar ndzi w’ekyir.
Na Ittai buaa ɔhen no see dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase, na mo wura ɔhen tse ase yi, ampa beebiara mbrɛ mo wura ɔhen bɛtsena no, sɛ owu mu o, nkwa mu o, mekyerɛ hɔ ara so na w’akowaa bɛtsena.
Na David see Ittai dɛ, kɔ kotwa. Na Ittai, Gittinyl no, kotwaa mu, ɔnye ne mbarimba nyinara, na mbofraba a wɔkã no ho nyina.
Na ɔman no nyinara dze ndze kɛse sūi, na nkorɔfo no nyinara twaa mu kɔree: Ɔhen no ankasa so twaa ɔwora Kidron no, na nkorɔfo no nyinara twae kɛfaa sar no do kwan no do afamu.

Na hwɛ, Zadok so, na Levifo a wɔkã no ho no nyinara, wɔso Nyankopɔn n'ahyɛmudaka no bae; na wɔsoɛɛ Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no sii famu, na Abiathar fowee ma ɔman no nyinara fii kurow no mu twaa mu wiei ana.
Na ɔhen no see Zadok dɛ, soa Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no san kɔ kurow no mu: Sɛ minya Ewuradze enyim enyimnyam a, ɔdze me bɛba bio, na ɔakyerɛ me ɔno, na ne tsenabew nyina:
Na sɛ mbom ɔse dɛm dɛ, minnyi enyigye wɔ wo mu a; hwɛ, emi nye yi, ma ɔnyɛ me dɛ mbrɛ oye wɔ n’enyiwa do.
Eso ɔhen no see ɔsɔfo Zadok dɛ, ana nnyɛ adzehunyi nye wo bi a? San kɔ kurow no mu dwudwoodwo, na hom mbabanyin beenu no nkã hom ho, wo babanyin Ahimaaz, na Abiathar ne babanyin Jonathan.
Hwɛ, mibetsintsim wɔ sar no do esutwaree no, ma ekodu dɛ asɛm befi hom hɔ ebesi no pi ama me.
Dɛm ntsi Zadok na Abiathar soaa Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no baa Jerusalem: Na wɔtsenaa hɔ.

Na David nam Ngo Bepɔw no afowee kɔree; na mbrɛ ɔrokɔ no na orusū; na ɔakata ne tsir do, na ɔnantseew anamɔnkwaa mu: Na nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no nyinara mu nyimpa biara kataa ne tsir do, na wɔfowee kɔree, mbrɛ wɔrofow no na worusū.
Na obi kãa kyerɛɛ David, dɛ, Ahithophel wɔ Absalom nkyɛn tsirdo-apamfo no mu. Na David see dɛ, Ewuradze, meserɛ wo dan Ahithophel n’apam nkwaseasɛm.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a David dur afowee no etsifi mbrɛ wɔsɔr Nyankopɔn no, hwɛ, Hushai, Archinyi no bae behyiaa no, ɔatsetsew no sortar mu, na dɛtse gu n’etsifi:
Na David see no dɛ, sɛ ɔwo enye me twa kɔ a, ɔno ebɛyɛ adzesoa ama me:
Na mbom sɛ esan kɔ kurow no mu, na ekɛse Absalom dɛ, ɔhen, mebɛyɛ w’akowaa dɛ mbrɛ nkan no meyɛɛ w’egya n’akowaa no, dɛmara so na afei mebɛyɛ w’akowaa a: Ɔno na ebɛsɛɛ Ahithophel n’apam no ama me.
Na ana innyi asɔfo Zadok na Abiathar wɔ wo nkyɛn hɔ bi a? Dɛm ntsi ɔmbra dɛ asɛm biara a ebɛtse no wɔ ɔhen no ne fie no, kã kyerɛ asɔfo Zadok na Abiathar.
Hwɛ, wɔwɔ hɔn mbabanyin beenu no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn hɔ, Zadok ne babanyin Ahimaaz, na Abiathar ne babanyin Jonathan; na asɛm biara a hom bɛtse no, hom nsoma ma wɔmfa ndua hɔn do ndu me nkyɛn.
Nna David ne nyɛnko Hushai baa kurow no mu; na Absalom baa Jerusalem.
16: Na David twaa mu fii afowee no etsifi kakra no, hwɛ, Mephibosheth n’akowaa Ziba behyiaa no, ɔdze nsoaso ebien a wɔahyehyɛ hɔn, na boodoo ntɔwmu ahaenu, na esikyireamba siaw ɔha, na hyewber nduadzewa ɔha, na wenyin bɔdambɔ soso hɔn.

Na ɔhen no see Ziba dɛ, iyinom ekyerɛ asɛ dɛn? Na Ziba see dɛ, nsoaso no wɔmfa mma ɔhen ne fiefo ma wɔntsena do; na boodoo na hyewber eduadzewa yi wɔmfa mma mberantsɛ no ma wondzi; na wenyin yi wɔmfa mma hɔn a wɔatɔ bitsi wɔ sar no do no ma wɔnnom.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, na wo wura ne ba no wo hen? Na Ziba see ɔhen no dɛ, hwɛ, ɔtse Jerusalem: Na ɔsee dɛ, ndɛ na Israel fi bɛdan m’egya n’ahendzi no ama me.
Nna ɔhen no see Ziba dɛ, hwɛ, dza ɔyɛ Mephibosheth dze no nyinara yɛ wodze. Na Ziba see dɛ, w’adaworom a; ma minya mo wura ɔhen enyim enyimnyam.
Na aber a ɔhen David dur Bahurim no, hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi fi hɔ bae a ofi Saul fie ebusua mu a ne dzin dze Shimei, Gera ba a: Opuei, na mbrɛ ɔreba no ara na ɔrodom.
Na ɔpraa David, na ɔhen David no nkowaa nyinara abo: Na ɔman no nyinara na mbarimba akatakyi no nyinara wodzi n’abanyimfa na n’abankum.
Na Shimei rodom no mbrɛ ɔsee nye yi fi hɔ kɔ, fi hɔ kɔ, ɔwo bɔgya nyimpa, na Belial nyimpa:

Ewuradze adan Saul a ebɛhyɛɛ n’ananmu dzii hen no, ne fie bɔgya nyinara aba wo do; na Ewuradze dze ahendzi no ahyɛ wo ba Absalom nsa: Na, hwɛ, wɔakyer wo wɔ wankasa w’emumuyɛ mu, osiandɛ ɔwo yɛ bɔgya nyimpa.
Nna Abishai, Zeruiah ba no ɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔkraman fun yi dom mo wura ɔhen yi? Meserɛ wo, ma monkɔ minkeyi ne tsir wɔ do.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, ebɛnadze na menye hom wɔ yɛ, hom Zeruiah mba? Wɔmma ɔndom ɛ, osiandɛ Ewuradze ase no dɛ, dom David; na woana na nkyii ɔbɛse dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ayɛ dɛm?

Na David see Abishai, na no nkowa no nyinara dɛ, hwɛ, me ba a ofi mo nson mu bae na ɔrohwehwɛ mo nkwa yi: Na afei Benjaminnyi yi na ɔnnkɛyɛ abor do? Wongyaa no ma ɔndom; na Ewuaradze na ɔakã akyerɛ no.
Annyɛ a Ewuradze bɔhwɛ bɔn a wɔdze ayɛ me, na Ewuradze dze papa ahyɛ me no ndom a ɔrodom me ndɛ da yi ananmu.
Nna David na ne mbarimba no faa ɔkwan no do kɔree: Na Shimei faa koko noho afamu wɔ ne tsentsendo kɔree; na mbrɛ ɔrokɔ no na ɔrodom, na ɔpraa no abo, na otuu huntuma petsee.
Na ɔhen no, na ɔman no a wɔkã no ho no nyinara, dur dɛ wɔaberɛ; na ɔgyee n’ahom wɔ hɔ.
Na Absalom, na Israel mbarimba ɔman no nyinara, baa Jerusalem, na Ahithophel kã no ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Hushai, Archnyi no, David ne nyɛnko no, baa Absalom nkyɛn no, nna Hushai see Absalom dɛ, Nyame ngye ɔhen nkwa, Nyame ngye ɔhen nkwa.
Na Absalom see Hushai dɛ, ana w’ayamuyie a edze yɛ wo nyɛnko nye yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na enye wo nyɛnko no annkɔ?
Na Hushai see Absalom dɛ, dabida; mbom nyia Ewuradze, na ɔman yi, na Israel mbarimba no nyinara asan mu eyi no no, ɔno na mebɛyɛ nedze, na ɔno so na menye no bɛtsena.
Bio so, woana na mobɔsom no? Ana monnkɔsom wɔ ne ba enyim bi a? Dɛ mbrɛ masom wɔ w’egya enyim no, dɛmara so na mebɛyɛ wɔ w’enyim.
Nna Absalom see Ahithophel dɛ, hom mfa hom apam mbra wɔ dza yɛnyɛ ho.
Na Ahithophel see Absalom dɛ, kɔ w’egya no nwewefo a ɔadan hɔn egya dɛ wɔnhwɛ ofi no do no nkyɛn; na Israel nyinara ntse dɛ w'egya ekyir wo kɔkɔɔkɔ: Nna hɔn a wɔwɔ wo nkyɛn nyinara nsa bɛyɛ dzen.
Nna wosii Absalom buw wɔ ɔdan no etsifi; na Absalom kɔr n’egya no nwewefo no nkyɛn wɔ Israel nyinara enyim.
Na Ahithophel n’apam a ɔdze pamee wɔ nda no mu no, tse dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa bi ekebisa Nyankopɔn asɛm hɔ adze: Dɛmara na Ahithophel n’apam nyinara tse dze maa David na Absalom.
17: Nkyii so Ahithophel see Absalom dɛ, afei ma mensan mu minyi mbarimba mpemduebien, na monsoɛr minketsiw David anago yi:
Na monkɔ no do aber a ɔaberɛ na ne nsamu agow yi, na minkeyi no hu: Na ɔman a wɔkã no ho nyinara boguan; na muboku ɔhen no nko:
Na memfa ɔman no nyinara mensan mbrɛ wo: Nyimpa a erohwehwɛ no no tse dɛ ɔman no nyinara asan aba: Nna ɔman no nyinara bɛyɛ komm.
Na asɛm no sɔɔ Absalom, na Israel mpanyimfo no nyinara enyi papaara.
Nna Absalom see dɛ, afei wɔmfre Hushai, Archnyi no so ma ɔmbra, na wɔmma yentsie dza ɔno so wo se, dɛmara.
Na aber a Hushai baa Absalom nkyɛn no, Absalom kãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, mbrɛ Ahithophel akã nye yi: Ana yendzi n’asɛm no do a? Sɛ oho a, wo so kasa.
Na Hushai see Absalom dɛ, apam a Ahithophel dze ama aber yi dze onnye.
Nkyii so Hushai see dɛ, ɔwoara nyim w’egya na ne mbarimba, dɛ wɔyɛ mbarimba akatakyi, na hɔn enyi aber dɛ osisi a woewia ne mba wɔ haban mu: Na w’egya so yɛ ɔsa barimba, na ɔnye nkorɔfo no renntsena.
Hwɛ, sisei oekosuma noho wɔ maa bi mu, anaa beebi: Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ hɔn mu binom totɔr asɔpon no a, obiara a ɔbɛtse no bɛse dɛ, ɔkogu esi nkorɔfo a wodzi Absalom ekyir no mu.
Na nyia ɔyɛ ndam a n’akoma tse dɛ gyata akoma no mpo, ɔbɛnan koraa: Osiandɛ Israel nyinara nyim dɛ w’egya yɛ ɔbarimba katakyi, na hɔn a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no wɔyɛ mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam.
Mbom mepam dɛ wɔmboaboa Israel nyinara ano wɔ wo nkyɛn, ofi Dan araa dze kodu Beer-sheba, dɛ mpoano anhwea wɔ dodow mu; na wankasa kɔ akono.
Nna yebopue no do wɔ beebiara mbrɛ wobohu no, na yeedwir no do dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔsu tɔ gu famu: Yerinngyaa mma ɔno na mbarimba a wɔkã no ho mu baako mpo mma ɔnnka.
Nkyii so ɔtwe noho kɔ kurow bi mu a, ɔno Israel nyinara dze ntampee bɛba kurow no ho, na yɛatwe no akɔ esutsen mu ma ekodu dɛ worunnhu ɔbo kakraba kor mpo wɔ hɔ.

Na Absalom na Israel mbarimba no nyinara see dɛ, Hushai, Archinyi no, n'apam no oye sen Ahithophel n'apam no. Na Ewuradze na ɔahyehyɛ dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ Ahithophel n'apam papa no, ama Ewuradze dze mbusu aaba Absalom do.
Nna Hushai see asɔfo Zadok na Abiathar dɛ, dɛm na dɛm na Ahithophel dze apam Absalom na Israel mpanyimfo no: Na dɛm na dɛm na mo so mapam.
Dɛm ntsi afei hom nsoma ntsɛm, ma wɔnkɛkã nkyerɛ David, dɛ, mma nntsena sar no do nsutwaree hɔ anago yi, na otwa ara na twa kɔ; ɔno bɛyɛ na wɔabɛmen ɔhen, na nkorɔfo a wɔkã no ho no nyinara.
Afei Jonathan na Ahimaaz tsena En-rogel ho; na abaawa bi na ɔtɔ dɛ ɔkɛkã kyerɛ hɔn; na hɔn so wosi mu kɔ kɛkã kyerɛ ɔhen David; na oonyi dɛ wohu hɔn dɛ wɔaba kurow no mu.
Na abanyimbasiaba bi kohun hɔn, na ɔkɛkãa kyerɛɛ Absalom; na hɔn beenu nyina kɔr ntsɛm ara, na wokodur ɔbarimba bi fie wɔ Bahurim, na ɔwɔ bura bi wɔ ne paado; na wosiaan mu hɔ.
Na ɔbaa no faa nkataano no na ɔtserɛɛw mu kataa bura no ano, na ɔdze eburow siwii tserɛtserɛɛw do: Na woennhu ho hwee.

Na Absalom no nkowaa no baa ɔbaa no nkyɛn wɔ fie hɔ; na wɔsee dɛ, hen na Ahimaaz na Jonathan wɔwɔ? Na ɔbaa no see hɔn dɛ, woetwa ɔwora no kɔ. Na wɔhwehwɛɛ hɔn na woennhu hɔn no, wɔsanee baa Jerusalem.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔkɔree no ekyir no, wofii bura no mu puei, na wosii mu kɔree kɛkãa kyerɛɛ ɔhen David; na wɔsee David dɛ, hom nsoɛr, na wonkotwa nsu no ntsɛm: Na dɛm na Ahithophel apam etsia hom.
Nna David, na nkorɔfo a wɔkã no ho no nyinara soɛree, na wokotwaa Jordan; na anapa enyimtsetsewee no na hɔn mu baako mpo nnkae a onnyae nnkotwaa Jordan.
Na Ahithophel hun dɛ wɔammfa n'apam do no, ɔhyehyeɛɛ n'asoaso, na ɔsoɛree kɔr fie wɔ no kurow mu na osiesiee ne fie, na ɔkɛsɛɛn ne men: Na owui, na wosiee no wɔ n'egya n'asamandan mu.
Nna David baa Mahanaim. Na Absalom kotwaa Jordan, ɔnoara na Israel mbarimba a wɔkã no ho no nyinara.
Na Absalom dze Amasa hyɛɛ Joab n'anamu wɔ dɔm no do. Na Amasa ɔyɛ ɔbarimba bi a ne dzin dze Ithra ne ba, ɔno Israelnyi a ɔkɔr Nahash ne babaa Abigal, Joab ne nã Zeruiah no nua no nkyɛn no,
na Israel na Absalom kɛkyeer nsera wɔ Gilead asaase do,
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a David baa Mahanaim no, Shobi, Nahash ne ba a ofi Ammonmba Rabbah no, na Machir, Ammiel ne ba a ofi Lo-debar no, na Barzillai, Gileadnyi a ofi Rogelim no,
wɔdze mpa na mbɛɛsen, na dɛtse asɛn, na ewifua, na atoko, na isiam, na eburow kyewee, na eduwa, na asaduwa, na efan kyenkyenee,
na ewo, na buter, na nguan, na anantwi kyiis, brɛɛ David, na nkorɔfo a wɔkã no ho no, dɛ wondzi: Na wɔsee dɛ, ɔkɔm dze nkorɔfo no, na wɔaberɛ, na nsukɔm dze hɔn, wɔ sar no do.
18: Na David kaan nkorɔfo a wɔkã no ho no, na ɔdze mpem do asafohemfo na aha aha do asafohemfo sisii hɔn do.

Na David gyaa nkorɔfo no kwan, ɔdze ebupɛn ebiasa mu kor hyɛɛ Joab nsa, na ebupɛn ebiasa mu kor hyɛɛ Zeruiah ne ba Abishai, Joab no nua no nsa, na ebupɛn ebiasa mu kor so hyɛɛ Ittai, Gittinyi no nsa. Na ɔhen no see nkorɔfo no dɛ, ampa emi mara so menye hom rifir edzi akɔ.

Na nkorɔfo no see dɛ, ɔwo mma mmfir edzi nnkɔ; osiandɛ sɛ yeguan a, wɔronndwen hɛn do; nkyii so sɛ hɛn mu fã totɔr a, wɔronndwen hɛn do: Na ɔwodze tse dɛ hɛn mu ɔpedu: Dɛm ntsi afei oye dɛ ebɛyɛ krado efi kurow no mu abɔboa hɛn.
Na ɔhen no see hɔn dɛ, dza oye wɔ hom enyi do no, mebeyɛ. Na ɔhen no gyinaa kuropon nkyɛn, na ɔman no nyinara puei kɔr no aha aha mu, na mpem mpem mu.

Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ Joab na Abishai na Ittai, dɛ, hom nye aberantsɛ no ndzi no berɛww wɔ me ntsi, mekyerɛ Absalom a. Na aber a ɔhen no rehyɛ asafohemfo no nyinara mbra wɔ Absalom ho no, nkorɔfo no nyinara tsee.
Na ɔman no fiir edzi kɔr haban mu kehyiaa Israel: Na ɔkõ no wɔkõo no Ephraim kwaa mu.
Na Israel ɔman no wɔbɔɔ hɔn hɔ gui wɔ David no nkowaa no eyim, na okum kɛse sii hɔ da no a ɔfaa nyimpa mpemeduonu.
Na ɔkõ no mu tserɛwee wɔ hɔ kataa asaase no nyinara enyi: Na kwaa no seen hɔn a afõwa sɛɛ hɔn.

Na Absalom hyiaa David no nkowaa no awerɛfir mu. Na Absalom tse n'asoaso do, na asoaso no dze kɛfaa esudur kɛse bi n'abaw kusuww ase, na ne tsir kɛhyɛɛ esudur no mu, ma wɔmaa no do ma ɔsensɛɛn ɔsor na asaase ntamu; na asoaso a ɔwɔ n'ase no nam do kɔree.
Na ɔbarimba bi kohunii, na ɔkɛkãa kyerɛɛ Joab see dɛ, hwɛ, muhun Absalom dɛ ɔsɛn esudur mu.
Na Joab see ɔbarimba no a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ no no dɛ, na, hwɛ, ɔwoara ihunii, na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ammbɔ no hɔ annhwe famu? Na nkyɛ mebɛma wo dwetɛbona du na abɔdo.

Na ɔbarimba no see Joab dɛ, sɛ mibenya dwetɛbona apem mpo wɔ me nsamu a, nkyɛ mennkɛtsen me nsa makã ɔhen ne ba no: Na hɛn asomu na ɔhen hyɛɛ ɔwo na Abishai na Ittai mbra, dɛ, hom nhwɛ yie ma obiara annkã aberantsɛ Absalom no.
Anaaso sɛ mutwa no nkwa ho nkontompɔ a (na asɛm biara nnyi hɔ a osuma ɔhen), ɔnodze nkyɛ ɔwo kor yi ara ebɔtwe woho ekegyina nkyɛn.
Nna Joab see dɛ, Minnkekyinkyim wo ho dɛm. Na ɔfaa mpeaa ebiasa kitsaa ne nsamu, na ɔtowee hwiraa Absalom n’akoma mu, aber a nkwa da ho wɔ no mu wɔ esudur no mu no.
Na mberantsɛ du a wɔso Joab n’akodze no twaa ho hyiae na wɔbobɔɔ Absalom kum no.
Na Joab hɛɛn abɛn, na nkorɔfo no gyaa Israel tsiw sanee: Osiandɛ Joab twee nkorɔfo no ekyir.
Na woyii Absalom kɔtoow no kyeen kwaa no mu maa kɛse bi mu, na wɔhyɛɛ abo isiw kɛsenara wɔ no do: Na Israel nyinara guanee obiara kɔr n’asesee mu.

Na Absalom tse ase no osii nkaa-dum bi a ɔwɔ ɔhen no bɔn mu no dze maa noho: Na ɔsee dɛ, minnyi babanyin a wɔdze no bɛkaa me dzin: Na ɔdze nankasa ne dzin too dum no: Na wɔfrɛɛ no Absalom ne nkaa-dum, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Nna Ahimaaz, Zadok ba no see dɛ, afei ma muntu mbirika monkɔbɔ ɔhen amandzɛɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze esi na oedzi n’atamfo wer ama no.
Na Joab see no dɛ, mma ɔwo nnyɛ amandzɛɛ-bɔfo ndɛ da yi, mbom ebɔkɔbɔ amandzɛɛ da bi: Na ndɛ da yi dze mma nnkɔbɔ amandzɛɛ, osiandɛ ɔhen ne ba atɔr.
Nna Joab see Cushnyi no dɛ, kɔ kɛkã dza ɔwoara ehu kyerɛ ɔhen. Na Cushnyi no bɔɔ no mu adze maa Joab, na otuu mbirika.

Nna Ahimaaz, Zadok ba no da ho see Joab bio dɛ, meserɛ wo, dza ɔbɛba biara mbra, ma mo so muntu mbirika memfã Cushnyi no. Na Joab see dɛ, me ba, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na epɛ dɛ itu mbirika yi, hwɛ no dɛ irinnya akatua bi wɔ amandzɛɛ no ntsi yi?
Na ɔsee dɛ, dza ɔbɛba biara mbra, mubotu mbirika. Na ɔsee no dɛ, tu mbirika ɛ. Nna Ahimaaz tuu mbirika dze faa Tɛtɛrmu kwan no do, na ɔkɛpaa Cushnyi no ho.
Na David tse nkuropon ebien no ntamu: Na ɔweɔmfo no fowee kɔr kuropon nkurii no do wɔ fadum no ho, na ɔmaa n’enyiwa do, na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi nankotoo dze mbirika.
Na ɔweɔmfo no tsēaa mu na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, sɛ nankotoo a nna amandzɛɛ bi wɔ n’anomu. Na ɔdze ba ara, na ɔbɛnee.

Na ɔweɔmfo no hun ɔbarimba kor so dɛ ɔdze mbirika reba: Na ɔweɔmfo no tsēaa mu frɛɛ abowanohwɛfo no, na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, ɔbarimba kor so nankotoo dze mbirika reba. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, ɔno so dze amandzɛɛ reba.
Na ɔweɔmfo no see dɛ, emi modwen dɛ odzikamfo no ne mbirikatu tse dɛ Ahimaaz, Zadok ba no ne mbirikatu. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, ɔno ɔyɛ nyimpa pa, na ɔdze amandzɛɛ pa reba.

Na Ahimaaz frɛe, na ɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, bɔkɔɔ. Na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ ɔhen no enyim dze n’enyim boom famu, na ɔsee dɛ Nhyira nkã Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn a oeyi nyimpa a wɔma hɔn nsa do tsia mo wura ɔhen no ama.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, ana aberantsɛ Absalom no ho ye? Na Ahimaaz buaa dɛ, aber a Joab rosoma ɔhen n’akowaa no, mekyerɛ mara w’akowaa a, muhun gyigyeegye kɛse bi, na minnyim n’adzeban.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, dan woho, gyina ha. Na ɔdaan noho kegyinaa dzinn.
Na, hwɛ, Cushnyi no bae; na Cushnyi no see dɛ, mo wura ɔhen, amandzɛɛ nye yi. Ewuradze edzi hɔn a wɔsoɛree tsiaa wo nyinara wer ama wo ndɛ da yi.
Na ɔhen no see Cushnyi no dɛ, ana aberantsɛ Absalom no ho ye? Na Cushnyi no buaa dɛ, wɔmma mo wura ɔhen n’atamfo, na hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia wo dɛ wɔbɛyɛ wo bɔn no nyinara, nyɛ dɛ mbrɛ aberantsɛ no ayɛ.

Na ɔhen no ho popoo dodow, na ɔfowee kɔr kuropon no do pia no mu, na osūi: Na aber a ɔrokɔ no mbrɛ ɔsee nye yi, me ba Absalom e, me ba e, me ba Absalom e! Ao nkyɛ Nyame mma munwu mma wo, Absalom e, me ba e, me ba e!
19: Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Joab dɛ, hwɛ, ɔhen rusū na origyam Absalom.
Na da no konyimdzi no daan ɔman no nyinara nkɔmbɔdzi: Na ɔman no tsee no da no dɛ wɔrese dɛ, ɔhen ridzi yaw ma ne ba.
Na ɔman no wiawiaa hɔnho baa kurow no mu da no, dɛ mbrɛ nkorɔfo a woguan ɔkõ mu gu hɔn enyim ase no, wiawia hɔnho no.
Na ɔhen no kataa n’enyim, na ɔhen no dze ndze kɛse kekaa mu dɛ, me ba Absalom e, Absalom e, me ba e, me ba e!

Na Joab baa ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ fie, na ɔsee dɛ, ndɛ da yi egu wo nkowaa nyinara a ndɛ da yi wɔagye wo nkwa, na wo mbabanyin na wo mbabaa hɔn nkwa, na wo yernom hɔn nkwa, na wo nwewefo hɔn nkwa no enyim ase;

wɔ dɛ ɔwo edɔ hɔn a wɔtan wo, na etan hɔn a wɔdɔ wo. Osiandɛ ɔwo ada no edzi ndɛ da yi, dɛ asafohemfo na nkowaa nnyɛ hwee mma wo: Na ndɛ da yi muhu dɛ, sɛ Absalom tsenaa ase, na hɛn nyinara wuwuu ndɛ da yi a, nkyɛ ɔsɔ w’enyi papaara.

Dɛm ntsi afei soɛr, fir edzi, na kɛkasa awerɛkyekyer mu kyerɛ wo nkowaa: Na meka Ewuradze dɛ, sɛ immfir edzi a, ɔbarimba biara rennka wo nkyɛn anago yi: Na ɔno mbom bomuo ama wo ma ɔasen mbusu a ofitsi wo mberantsɛber dze ebodu sesei aba wo do nyinara.

Nna ɔhen no soɛree, na ɔkɛtsenaa kuropon no mu. Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinara dɛ, hwɛ, ɔhen no tse kuropon no mu: Na ɔman no nyinara baa ɔhen no enyim. Afei na Israel eguanguan, nyimpa biara kɔ n’asesee mu.
Na ɔman no nyinara hamee wɔ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu, dɛ, ɔhen na oyii hɛn fii hɛn atamfo nsamu, na ɔno na ɔgyee hɛn fii Philistiafo nsamu; na afei Absalom ntsi oeguan efi asaase yi do.
Na Absalom a yɛseraa no hyɛɛ no hen wɔ hɛn do no, ɔatɔr wɔ akono. Dɛm ntsi afei ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom nnkã asɛm bi a wɔdze bɛkɛfa ɔhen asan aba yi?

Na ɔhen David somae ma wɔkɔr asɔfo Zadok na Abiathar nkyɛn, dɛ, hom nkasa nkyerɛ Judah mpanyimfo, dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom aka ekyir dɛ wɔdze ɔhen bɛsan akɔ ne fie yi? Hwɛ dɛ Israel nyinara hɔn asɛm edu ɔhen nkyɛn, dɛ wɔdze no bɔkɔ ne fie.
Hom nye mo nuanom, hom nye me biew na mo honam: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na hom aka ekyir dɛ wɔdze ɔhen bɛsan akɔ?
Na hom nse Amasa dɛ, ana ɔwo nnyɛ me biew na mo honam bi a? Nyankopɔn nyɛ me dɛm, na bi so nkã ho, sɛ ɔwo enndzi dɔm no do ɔsafohen wɔ m’enyim daa nyina annhyɛ Joab n’ananmu a.
Na ɔbrɛɛ Judah mbarimba no nyinara hɔn akoma adze, dɛ nyimpa baako n'akoma; ma dɛm ntsi wɔsomae ma wɔkɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn, dɛ, san bra, ɔwo na wo nkowaa nyinara.
Nna ɔhen no sanee, na ɔbaa Jordan do. Na Judah baa Gilgal, dɛ wɔrokɔ ekehyia ɔhen no, na wɔdze ɔhen no etwa Jordan.
Na Shimei, Gera ba no, Benjaminnyi a ofi Bahurim no, yɛɛ ntsɛm na ɔnye Judah mbarimba no sianee baa dɛ woribehyia ɔhen David.
Na Benjamin mbarimba apem kã no ho, na Ziba, Saul ne fie akowaa no, na ne mbabanyin duenum na no nkowaa eduonu kã no ho bae; na wotwaa Jordan baa ɔhen no enyim.
Na esutwahɛn twae kɔr dɛ wɔdze rekɛfa ɔhen ne fiefo etwa, na wɔayɛ dza ɔdwen dɛ oye. Na Shimei, Gera ba no, boom ɔhen no n’enyim famu, aber a otwaa Jordan bae no.
Na ɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, mma mma mo wura mmbu emumuyɛ mma me, nkyii so mma nnka dza w'akowaa yɛe no nkɔnkɔnsa mu wɔ da a mo wura ɔhen fii Jerusalem no, dɛ ɔhen bɛfa ato n'akoma mu.
Osiandɛ w'akowaa nyim dɛ mayɛ bɔn; dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, emi na medzi Joseph fi nyinara ne kan maba ndɛ da yi dɛ mirisian mekehyia mo wura ɔhen.
Na Abishai, Zeruiah ne ba no, buae see dɛ, ana worunnku Shimei wɔ iyi ntsi, osiandɛ ɔadom nyia Ewuradze asera no no?
Na David see dɛ, ebɛnadze na mowɔ menye hom yɛ, hom Zeruiah mba, dɛ hom bɛyɛ atamfo ama me ndɛ da yi? Ana ndɛ da yi wonku nyimpa wɔ Israel a? Ana minnyim dɛ ndɛ da yi midzi hen wɔ Israel do bi a?
Na ɔhen no see Shimei dɛ, Innkowu. Na ɔhen no kãa ntam kyerɛɛ no.

Na Mephibosheth, Saul ne ba no, sianee baa dɛ oribehyia ɔhen no; ɔnnyɛɛ n'anan ho yie, nkyii so onnsiesiee n'abɔdwesa ho, na ɔannhor ne ntar so ara ofi da no a ɔhen sii mu kɔree no bodur da a ɔbaa fie asomdwee mu no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔbaa Jerusalem dɛ oribehyia ɔhen no, ɔhen see no dɛ, Mephibosheth, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ennye me annkɔ?
Na obuaa dɛ, Ao mo wura ɔhen, m’akowaa na ɔdaadaa me: Na w’akowaa see dɛ, mebɛhyehyɛ asoaso, na nkyɛ matsena do, na menye ɔhen akɔ, osiandɛ w'akowaa yɛ ebubua.
Na oebotwir w’akowaa ama mo wura ɔhen; na mo wura ɔhen dze ɔtse dɛ Nyankopɔn no bɔfoe: Dɛm ntsi yɛ dza oye wɔ w'enyiwa do.
Osiandɛ m’egya fie nyinara yɛ ewufo ara wɔ mo wura ɔhen enyim: Naaso ɔwodze w’akowaa hyɛɛ hɔn a wodzidzi wankasa wo pon do mu. Dɛm ntsi ebɛn kwan na mowɔ bio dɛ medze mebɛkeka mu afrɛ ɔhen bio?
Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na eda ho kasa wo nsɛm yi ho bio yi? Mese dɛ, ɔwo na Ziba wɔnkɛkyɛ asaase no mu.
Na Mephibosheth see ɔhen dɛ, mpo, ma ɔmfa ne nyinara, susuampa dɛ mo wura ɔhen aba nankasa ne fie asomdwee mu yi.
Na Barzillai, Gileadnyi no, sianee fi Rogelim bae; na ɔnye ɔhen twaa Jordan, dɛ orikegya no Jordan egya.
Afei Barzillai ɔyɛ nyimpa a oenyin dodow, oedzi mfe eduowɔtwe: Na ɔno na ɔbɔɔ ɔhen akɔhoma mber a ɔda Mahanaim no; osiandɛ ɔyɛ nyimpa kɛse dɛ.
Na ɔhen no see Barzillai dɛ, Bra bɛnye me ntwa nkɔ, na mobɔhwɛ wo me nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalem.
Na Barzillai see ɔhen no dɛ, mo nkwa mfe mu nda yɛ ahen, na menye ɔhen mfow nkɔ Jerusalem yi?

Ndɛ da yi medzi mfe eduowɔtwe: Ana mubotum ehu papa na bɔn mu? Ana w’akowaa botum atse dza midzi anaa dza monom? Ana mubotum atse mbarimba adwontofo na mbaa adwontofo ndze bio a? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na w’akowaa bɛda ho ara ayɛ adzesoa ama mo wura ɔhen yi?
W’akowaa nye ɔhen botwa Jordan ara: Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔhen dze dɛm akatua botua me kaw?
Meserɛ wo, ma w’akowaa nsan ekyir bio, ma munkowu wɔ mankasa mo kurow mu, wɔ m’egya na me nã nda nkyɛn. Mbom hwɛ, w'akowaa Chimham; ma ɔnye mo wura ɔhen ntwa nkɔ; na dza ehwɛ oye ma wo no fa yɛ no.
Na ɔhen buaa dɛ, Chimham nye me botwa akɔ, na mebɛyɛ no dza oye wɔ w’enyi do: Na biribiara a ebɔhwehwɛ wɔ mo hɔ no, mebɛyɛ mama wo.
Na ɔman no nyinara twaa Jordan, na ɔhen no so twae: Na ɔhen no feew Barzillai n’ano, na ohyiraa no; na ɔsanee kɔr nankasa ne tsenabew.
Nna ɔhen no sii mu kɔr Gilgal, na Chimham nye no sii mu kɔree: Na Judah ɔman no nyinara, na so Israel ɔman no ne fã, na wɔdze ɔhen no twae bae.

Na, hwɛ, Israel mbarimba no nyinara baa ɔhen no nkyɛn, na wɔbɛsee ɔhen no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hɛn nuanom Judah mbarimba ewia wo kɔ, na wɔdze ɔhen, na ne fiefo, na David ne mbarimba a wɔkã no ho nyinara etwa Jordan aba yi?
Na Judah mbarimba no nyinara buaa Israel mbarimba no dɛ, osiandɛ ɔhen yɛ obusuanyi a ɔbɛn hɛn: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom bo bofuw wɔ asɛm yi ntsi yi? Ana yeedzi ɔhen ho biribi? Ana ɔama hɛn akyɛdze bi?

Na Israel mbarimba no buaa Judah mbarimba no see dɛ, yɛwɔ kyɛfa du wɔ ɔhen mu, na eso yɛwɔ David mu ɔkwan sen hom: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na hom bu hɛn enyimtsia, dɛ hɛn apam enndzi kan ammba mu dɛ wɔdze hɛn hɛn bɛsan aba? Na Judah mbarimba no hɔn nsɛm no ɔyɛɛ dzen seen Israel mbarimba no hɔn nsɛm no.
20: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔbarimba Belialnyi bi kopuee hɔ a ne dzin dze Sheba, Bichri ne ba a, Benjaminnyi a: Na ɔhɛɛn abɛn see dɛ, yenyi kyɛpɛn wɔ David mu, nkyii so yennyi egyapadze wɔ Jesse ne ba no mu: Israel e, nyimpa biara nkɔ n’asesee mu oo.
Nna Israel mbarimba no nyinara wofii David n'ekyir na wɔkɔree kedzii Sheba, Bichri ne ba no n’ekyir: Na Judah mbarimba no dze wɔtakyeer hɔn hen ho, fi Jordan do araa baa Jerusalem.

Na David baa ne fie wɔ Jerusalem; na ɔhen no faa no nwewefo mbaa du no a ogyaa hɔn dɛ wɔnhwɛ ofi no, na ɔdze hɔn koguu efiadze, na ɔbɔɔ hɔn akɔhoma, na hɔn nkyɛn dze ɔannkɔ. Nna wɔtoow hɔn mu araa ma okodur hɔn wu da, dɛ wɔtse ekunayɛ mu.
Nna ɔhen no see Amasa dɛ, kehyiahyia Judah mbarimba no ma me ma wonhyia ndaansa mu, na ɔwoara so bra begyina ha.
Nna Amasa sii mu kɔr dɛ orikehyiahyia Judah mbarimba no ma woeehyia: Nna ɔkyɛree ma ɔseen aber a wɔdze hyɛɛ no no.

Na David see Abishai dɛ, afei na Sheba, Bichri ne ba no, bɛyɛ hɛn bɔn asen dza Absalom yɛe no: Ɔwoara fa wo wura no nkowaa no, na tsiw no, ɔno bɛyɛ na oenya nkurow a wɔagye ho ban mu afa, na oefi nsa oeguan efi hɛn enyi do.
Na Joab ne mbarimba no, na Cherethfo, na Pelethfo, na mbarimba akatakyi no nyinara tui dzii n’ekyir: Na wotui fii Jerusalem dɛ woritsiw Bichri ne ba Sheba.

Aber a wodur ɔbo kɛse no a ɔwɔ Gibeon no ho no, Amasa bae behyiaa hɔn. Na Joab ɔabɔ n’akontar a ɔhyɛ no do, na ɔno do na wɔdze abɔdo afõwa a ɔhyɛ no bɔha mu wɔ do akyekyer n’asen; na orifir edzi no ɔworɔwee tɔɔ famu.
Na Joab see Amasa dɛ, mo nua, ana wo ho ye? Na Joab dze ne nsa enyimfa suoo Amasa n’abɔdwesa mu dɛ orifew n’ano.
Na Amasa dze ɔannhwɛ afõwa no a ɔdze Joab ne nsamu no: Dɛm ntsi ɔdze wɔɔ ne yafun mu, na otuu no nson guu famu, na ɔammfee no do; na owui. Na Joab na no nua Abishai tsiiw Bichri ne ba Sheba.
Na Joab ne mberantsɛ no mu baako gyinaa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, nyia ɔpɛ Joab n’asɛm, na ɔwɔ David afã no, wɔmma ondzi Joab n’ekyir.

Na Amasa yankayankaam no bɔgyaa mu wɔ tsempɔn no mu. Na ɔbarimba no hun dɛ nkorɔfo no nyinara gyinaa hɔ dzinn no, ɔsoaa Amasa fii tsempɔn no mu kɔtoo haban mu, na ohun dɛ obiara a obodu ne nkyɛn no ogyina dzinn ntsi, ɔdze atar kɛkataa no do.
Aber a woyii no fii tsempɔn no do no, nkorɔfo no nyinara kɔree kedzii Joab n'ekyir, dɛ woritsiw Bichri ne ba Sheba.
Na ɔdze faa Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu twaa mu kɔr Aber, na Bethmaacah, na Berifo nyina mu: Na wɔboaboaa ano, na wɔkɔree so kedzii n ekyir.
Na wɔbae botuaa no wɔ Abel a ɔwɔ Beth-maacah, na wɔtotoow kurow no ho pampi, na ogyinaa akoban no ne tsentsendo: na nkorɔfo a wɔkã Joab ho nyinara pempeem fasu no, dɛ worudwuruw no egu.
Nna ɔbaa nyansafo bi fii kurow no mu tsēaa mu dɛ, wontsie oo, wontsie oo; meserɛ hom, hom nse Joab dɛ, twe pin ha ma menye wo nkasa.
Na ɔtwee piin ne nkyɛn; na ɔbaa no see dɛ. Ana ɔwo nye Joab a? Na obuaa dɛ, mara a. Nna ɔsee no dɛ, tsie w’afonabaa nɛ nsem. Na obuaa dɛ, Miritsie.
Nna, ɔkãa dɛ, tsetseber no wɔtɔ dɛ wɔkã no dɛ, bisa na wombisa apam wɔ Abel: Na dɛm no nna woetwa asɛm no do.
Modɔm Israel mu hɔn a wɔpɛ asomdwee na nokwar: Ɔwo rohwehwɛ asɛɛ Israel mu kurow na nã: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na erebɛmen Ewuradze n’egyapadze yi?
Na Joab buae see dɛ, ɔmpar me, ɔmpar me dɛ mebɛmen anaa mebɛsɛɛ.

Asɛm no nntse dɛm: Mbom ɔbarimba bi a ofi Ephraim nkokodo nkurow mu a ne dzin dze Sheba, Bichri ne ba no, na ɔama ne nsa do etsia ɔhen, mekyerɛ David a: Hom nyi no nkotoo mma, na mibefi kurow no ho makɔ. Na ɔbaa no see Joab dɛ, hwɛ, wɔbɔtow ne tsir akyen fasu no ekyir.

Nna ɔbaa no dze ne nyansaa mu kɔr ɔman no nyinara nkyɛn. Na wotwaa Bichri ne ba Sheba ne tsir, na wɔtowee kyeen Joab. Na ɔhɛɛn abɛn, na wofii kurow no ho petsee, nyimpa biara kɔr n’asesee mu. Na Joab sanee baa ɔhen nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalem.
Afei Joab na odzi Israel dɔm nyinara do: Na Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah, na ɔhwɛ Cherethfo na Pelethfo do:
Na Adoram na ɔhwɛ edwumayɛ tow no do: Na Ahilud ne ba Jehoshaphat na ɔyɛ ɔsɛnkaafo:
Na Sheva nye ɔkyerɛwfo: Na Zadok nye Abiathar nye asɔfo:
Na Ira, Jairnyi no so yɛ David no sɔfoe.
21: Na ɔkɔm bi baa David aber do mfe ebiasa, afe toa afe do; na David kɔhwehwɛɛ Ewuradze enyim. Na Ewuradze see dɛ, Saul ntsi a, na no bɔgya fi no ntsi a, osiandɛ okum Gibeonfo no.

Na ɔhen no frɛɛ Gibeonfo no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ; (na Gibeonfo no wɔnnyɛ Israelmba no mu bi, na mbom Amorifo nkaase no mu bi a; na Israelmba no akã ntam akyerɛ hɔn; na Saul hwehwɛɛ dɛ oku hɔn wɔ no mbɔdzen a ɔbɔ wɔ Israel na Judahmba no ho):
Na David see Gibeonfo no dɛ, ebɛnadze na menyɛ memma hom? Na ebɛnadze na memfa mempata, ma hom eehyira Ewuradze n'egyapadze?

Na Gibeonfo no see no dɛ, nnyɛ dwetɛ anaa sikasɛm bi na ɔda hɛn na Saul, anaa ne fi ntamu; nkyii so nnyɛ hɛnara bi na yeruboku Israel mu nyimpa biara. Na ɔsee dɛ, dza hom bɛse no, ɔnoara na mebɛyɛ mama hom.
Na wɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, ɔbarimba no a ɔhyeew hɛn, na ɔpaam hɛn tsir do, dɛ wɔnsɛɛ hɛn ma yaannka Israel ahe do beebiara no,
ma wonyi ne mbabanyin mu nyimpa beesuon mma hɛn, na yɛnsensɛn hɔn mma Ewuradze, wɔ Saul a Ewuradze saan mu faa no ne Gibeah no mu. Na ɔhen no see dɛ mibeyi hɔn ama.
Na ɔhen no gyee Saul ne ba Jonathan ne ba Mephibosheth nkwa, osian Ewuradze ne ntam a ɔda hɔn ntamu ntsi, ɔda David na Saul ne ba Jonathan ntamu no a.

Mbom ɔhen no faa Aiah ne babaa Rizpah ne mbabanyin beenu no a ɔwoo hɔn maa Saul no, Armoni na Mephibosheth; na Saul ne babaa Michal ne mbabanyin beenum no a ɔwoo hɔn maa Meholathnyi Adriel, Barzillai ne ba no:

Na oyii hɔn hyɛɛ Gibeonfo no nsa, na wɔsɛɛn hɔn bepɔw no do wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na hɔn beesuon no nyinara bɔɔ mu totɔree: Na wokum hɔn wɔ twaber nda no mu, nda a odzi kan no mu a, atoko twaber ahyɛse no mu a.

Na Aiah ne babaa Rizpah faa eyitam, na ɔtsɛɛw mu kataa ɔbotan no do maa noho, fi twaber ahyɛse no ara kodur dɛ nsu fi sor guguu hɔn do ana; na ɔamma kwan ma wimu nnoma ammbɛgyegye hɔn do adzekyee, na hamu mbowa so ammba hɔn do adzesaa.
Na wɔkɛkãa dza Aiah ne babaa Rizpah, Saul no nwewe no, ayɛ no kyerɛɛ David.

Na David sii mu kɔree kɛgyee Saul ne mbiew na ne ba Jonathan ne mbiew no wɔ Jabeshgileadfo hɔ, hɔn a wokowiaa hɔn wɔ Beth-shan abɔntsen do mbrɛ Philistiafo no dze hɔn sensɛnee, wɔ da a Philistiafo kum Saul wɔ Giiboa no.
na ɔdze Saul ne mbiew na ne ba Jonathan ne mbiew no fii hɔ bae, na wɔboaboaa hɔn a wɔsensɛɛn hɔn no hɔn mbiew no ano.
Na wosie Saul na ne ba Jonathan hɔn mbiew no wɔ Benjamin asaase do wɔ Zela, wɔ n'egya Kish n’asamandan mu; na wɔyɛɛ dza ɔhen no hyɛe no nyinara. Na ɔno n’ekyir no Nyankopɔn tsiei maa asaase no.
Na Philistiafo no wɔnye Israel nyaa kõ bio; na David na no nkowaa kã no ho sianee kɔree, na wɔnye Philistiafo no kɔkõe: Na David tɔɔ bahaw.
Ishbi-benob a, ɔyɛ ɔkraban no ne mba no mu bi a ne peaa no dur wɔker a, ɔtow boran shekel ahaasa no, na ɔdze afõwa fofor abɔ ntsi, ɔdween dɛ nkyɛ oboku David.
Na Zeruiah ba Abishai boaa no, na ɔbɔɔ Philistianyi no, na okum no. Nna David ne mbarimba no kãa ntam guu no do, dɛ, mma nnye hɛn mmfir edzi nnkɔ nkɔkõ bio, mma enndum Israel kandzea no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ iyi n’ekyir no, wɔnye Philistiafo no nya ɔkõ bio wɔ Gob; nna Hushathnyi Sibbecai kum Saph a ɔyɛ ɔkraban no ne mba no mu bi no.
Na wɔnye Philistiafo no nyaa ɔkõ bio wɔ Gob; na Beth-lehemnyi Elhanan, Jaare-oregim ne ba no, okum Gittinyi Goliath a ne peaa no kura tse dɛ ɔtanwemfo n’asadua.
Na ɔkõ baa bio wɔ Gath, mbrɛ ɔbarimba pankor bi a ɔwɔ nsakum do nsatseaba esia esia, na anansa do anansɔba esia esia ma no dodow yɛ eduonu anan; na ɔno so wɔwoo no maa ɔkraban.
Na aber a orutwitwa Israel mpoa no, David no nua Shimei ne ba Jonathan kum no.
Woyinom baa nan yi wɔwowoo hɔn maa akraban no wɔ Gath; na wɔtotɔree wɔ David, na no nkowaa no hɔn nsaano.
22: Na David kãa ndwom yi mu nsɛm kyerɛɛ Ewuradze wɔ da a Ewuradze yii no fii n’atamfo nyinara nsamu, na Saul nsamu no:
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze nye mo botan, na m’akoban, na me gyefo, mara medze a;
mo botantsim Nyankopɔn a, no mu na muguan modɔ; m’akokyɛm, na mo nkwagye ambɛn, m’abantsentsen, na mo guansumabew; m’agyenkwa, ɔwo na egye me fi akakabensɛm mu.
Mubosū afrɛ Ewuradze, ɔno a ɔsɛ dɛ woyi no ayɛw no: Nna wɔbɛgye me efi m’atamfo nsamu.
Na owu asorɛkye twaa mo ho hyiae, mbusubɔ nsuyirii maa mo bo tui.
Samanadze ahoma brabraa mo ho: Owu ne mfir baa mo do.
M’ahokyer mu musūi frɛɛ Ewuradze, nyew, me Nyankopɔn na mekaa mu frɛɛ no: Na ofi n’asɔrfi mu tsee me ndze, na me nkekamu kodur n'asomu.
Nna asaase hihimii na ɔwosowee, ɔsor fapem tutui. Na wohihimii, osiandɛ no bo fuwii ntsi.
Wusiw fi n’ahwentokura mu firii, na ogya fi n’anomu hyeew adze: Ɔmaa ibiriw sɔe.
Ɔkontoom ɔsor so, na odwirii; na isum kebikebi dzi n’ananadze.
Na ɔtsena cherub do, na otui: Nyew, wohun no wɔ mframa ntsaban do.
Ɔdze isum yɛɛ asese bɔɔ noho aprɔw, nsu mboaboano, iwimu mununkum kusuww.
Hyerɛn a odzi n’enyim ntsi ogyabiriw sɔe.
Ewuradze bobɔɔ mu wɔ sor, na ɔsorsornyi no maa wɔtsee ne ndze.
Na ɔtotoow ngyen-menaba, na ɔhotsee hɔn; enyinam, na ɔdze kãa hɔn gui.
Nna epo mu esukaã yiyii hɔnho, wiadze fapem ho dedaa hɔ, wɔ Ewuradze ne nkaenyim no ntsi, n'ahwentokura mu ehuhuw huuhuw no ntsi.
Ɔsomae fi sor bɛfaa me; ɔtwee me fii nsu pii mu;
ɔgyee me fii me tamfo ɔhoɔdzenfo no, na hɔn a wokyiir me no nsa; osiandɛ wɔyɛɛ dzen dodow maa me.
Wɔbɔtoatoaa me wɔ m’amandzehu da no mu: Na Ewuradze nye me kyirtaafo.
Na ɔdze me so baa mbrɛ ɔtsɛw: Ɔgyee me, osiandɛ n’enyi gyee mo ho,
Ewuradze tuaa me kaw dɛ mbrɛ me tsenenee tse: Dɛ mbrɛ me nsa ho tsew pa na ɔahyɛ me ananmu.
Na mesie Ewuradze n’akwan no, na mommbɔɔ ehuhubra mimmfii me Nyankopɔn ho.
Na n’atsɛmbu nyinara wɔ m’enyi do: Na n’ahyɛdze so mimmfii ho.
Midzii mu so wɔ n’afamu, na misiee moho fii m’emumuyɛ ho
Dɛm ntsi na Ewuradze ahyɛ me ananmu dɛ mbrɛ me tsenenee tse; dɛ mbrɛ m'ahofir wɔ n'enyiwa mu tse.
Mbɔbɔrhufo na enye no bedzi no mbɔbɔr mu, nyia odzi mu na enye no bedzi no emudzi mu;
Nyia no ho tsew, na ebɛtsew woho akyerɛ no; na nyia ɔyɛ nkɔntɔnkye dze ebɛkyea woho akyerɛ no.
Na ɔman amandzehufo no, ɔwo ebɛgye hɔn: Na w’enyi sã nkontompɔfo, ma aabrɛ hɔn adze.
Na ɔwo Ewuradze, na eyɛ me kandzea: Na Ewuradze bɛhyerɛn mo sum mu.
Na ɔwo na medze wo mutu mbirika tsew edɔm mu: Me Nyankopɔn na medze no huruw tra fasu.
Nyankopɔn dze, no kwan dzi mu: Ewuradze n’asɛm wɔasɔ ahwɛ; ɔyɛ akokyɛm ma hɔn a woguan toa no nyinara.
Na woana nye Nyankopɔn, gyedɛ Ewuradze nko? Na woana yɛ ɔbotan, gyedɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn nko?
Nyankopɔn nye m’akoban dzendzen: Na ɔgye nyia odzi mu no wɔ no kwan mu.
Ɔyɛ ne nan dɛ adoa anan: Na ɔdze me si me mbea sorɔnsorɔm do.
Ɔkyerɛ me nsa akodzi; ma m’abasa tum kontom boran egyen.
Eso edze wo nkwagye akokyɛm no ama me: Na w’ahobrɛadze ama mayɛ kɛse.
Ɔwo atserɛw m’anamɔn mu wɔ m’ase, na m’anan mmpatserewee.
Metsiw m’atamfo, na masɛɛ hɔn: Nkyii so mannsan bio dze kodur dɛ wowiee sã.
Na mahyew hɔn, na mabɔ hɔn ehwira mu, ma wonnkotum soɛr; nyew, wɔatotɔr wɔ m'ananadze.
Na ɔwo na edze ahoɔdzen abɔ me do ama akodzi: Ɔwo abrɛ hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia me no adze ahyɛ m'ase.
Ɔwo na ama m'atamfo so adan hɔn ekyir ama me, ma metwa hɔn a wɔtan me no egu.
Wɔhwɛe, na ɔgyefo bi nnyi hɔ: Wɔhwɛɛ Ewuradze mpo, na oemmbua hɔn.
Nna moboor hɔn anhweanhwea dɛ famu huntuma, mitsiatsiaa hɔn do dɛ abɔntsen do dɛtse, na mesaaw hɔn petsee.
Eso ɔwo eyi me fi me man hɔn akokoeko mu: Ɔwo ahwɛ me edze me ayɛ amanaman do tsitsir: Ɔman a minnyim hɔn no wɔbɔsom me.
Ananaben bɛbrɛ hɔnho adze ama me: Wɔtse me nka ara a, wobetsie me.
Ananaben bɛkyenkyen, na wɔdze ahohim fi hɔn sumabea aba.
Ewuradze tse ase; na nhyira nkã mo botontsim no; na abɔso nye mo nkwagye botan Nyankopɔn no:
Mekyerɛ Nyame a odzi wer ma me no, na ɔbrɛ aman adze hyɛ m'ase no,
Na ɔdze me efi m'atamfo mu aba: Nyew, ɔwo na ema me do bɔ hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia me no do: Ɔwo na iyi me fi nyimpa kakaben no nsamu.
Dɛm ntsi, Ewuradze, mebɛda wo ase wɔ amanaman mu, Na matow ayɛyindwom ama wo dzin.
Nkwagye kɛse na ɔdze ma ne hen: Na ɔyɛ adɔyɛ ma nyia wɔasera no no, David na n'asefo no daa.
23: Afei iyinom nye David ne nsɛm a odzi ekyir. Jesse ne ba David se dɛ, na ɔbarimba a wɔama no do wɔ sor no se dɛ, nyia Jacob no Nyankopɔn no asera no no a, na Israel ɔdwontofo pa no a:
Ewuradze no sunsum nam mo do kasae, na n'asɛm wɔ me gyirama do.
Israel Nyankopɔn no see, Israel ɔbotan no kasaa kyerɛɛ me: Nyia odzi adasa do hen tsenenee mu, nyia odzi hen Nyankopɔn no suro mu,
ɔbɛyɛ dɛ anapa kan, aber a wi rupue, anapa a mununkum nnyi mu; aber a nkyɛkyɛr nomanoma fifir asaase do, wɔ nyankom ekyir ewia hyerɛn mu.
Ampaara me fi nntse dɛm wɔ Nyame nkyɛn; naaso ɔnye me edzi daa ahyɛmu, oesiesie ndzɛmba nyinara mu, na oesi no pi: Na mo nkwagye nyinara, na m’apɛdze nyinara nye no, kaansa ɔremma ɔmmfefɛw mpo a.
Na emumuyɛfo dze hɔn nyinara bɛyɛ dɛ nsoɛ a wɔrotow egu, na wonnkotum dze nsa esuo mu:
Na nyimpa a orusuo mu no Ohia dɛ ɔdze dadze na peaa-dua mia; na wɔdze ogya bɛhyew no dwɛɛ wɔ hɔn ananmu hɔ ara.

Iyinom nye mbarimba akatakyi a David nyae no hɔn edzin: Josheb-basshebeth, tahchemonnyi no, na odzi asafohemfo no mu tsitsir; ɔnoara so nye adino, Ezninyi no, na ɔmaa ne peaa do wɔ nyimpa ahaawɔtwe a okum hɔn prɛko do no.

Na ɔno n’ekyir nye Eleazar, Dodai ba Ahohinyi bi ne ba no, mbarimba akatakyi baasa a wɔkã David ho a aber a wotwaa Philistiafo a wɔaboaboa ano dɛ wɔrobɔkõ no mpowa, na Israel mbarimba no wɔafow kɔ no mu baako a:
Ɔno na ɔsoɛree na okunkum Philistiafo no ara ma okodur dɛ ne nsa gyenee, na ne nsa kaa afõwa no ho: Na Ewuradze dzii konyim kɛse da no; na ɔman no sanee kedzii n’ekyir dɛ adze ara nko na wɔrokɔfom.
Na ɔno n’ekyir nye Shammah, Agee Hararnyi no ne ba. Na Philistiafo no boaboaa ano yɛɛ dɔm, wɔ mbrɛ asaase tɔw bi a asadua ayɛ do mã wɔ; na ɔman no guanee fii Philistiafo no enyim.
Na ɔnodze ogyinaa asaasetɔw no ne finimfin, na ɔperee, na okum Philistiafo no: Na Ewuradze dzii konyim kɛse.
Na etsitsir eduasa no mu baasa siaan famu, na wɔbaa David nkyɛn twaber mu wɔ Adullam ɔbo-tu no mu; na Philistiafo dɔm no akyer nsera wɔ Rephaim ɔbɔn no mu.
Aber no nna David wɔ itu no mu, na Philistiafo bansifo no so wowɔ Beth-lehem aber no mu.
Na David no kɔn dɔe, na ɔsee dɛ, ao kɛtseankyɛ obi aama me Bethlehem nsubura a ɔwɔ kuropon no ho no mu nsu bi ma maanom!

Na mbarimba akatakyi baasa no bɔe faa Philistiafo dɔm no mu, na wɔkɛsaaw Beth-lehem nsubura a ɔwɔ kuropon no ho no mu nsu bi, na wɔfae dze brɛɛ David: Na ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔnom, na mbom ohuei gui maa Ewuradze.

Na ɔsee dɛ, ɔmpar me koraa, Ewuradze, dɛ mebɛyɛ iyi: Ana monnom mbarimba a wɔdze hɔn nkwa kitsaa hɔn nsamu sii mu kɔree no hɔn bɔgyaa? Dɛm ntsi ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔnom. Iyinom na mbarimba akatakyi baasa no yɛe.
Na Zeruiah ne ba, Joab no nua Abishai na ɔyɛ baasa no mu otsitsir. Na ɔmaa ne peaa do wɔ ahaasa do kunkum hɔn, na onyaa dzin wɔ baasa no mu.
Ana ɔnnyɛ onyimnyamfo dodow wɔ baasa no mu bi a? Dɛm ntsi wɔyɛɛ no hɔn safohen: Naaso ɔannto asɔpɔn baasa no.
Na Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah, ɔbarimba bi a ɔyɛ ndam a ofi Kabzeel ne ba no a ɔyɛɛ akatakyidze no, ɔno na okum Moab nyimpa gyatasɛfo beenu: Na osianee so kokum gyata wɔ maa bi mu wɔ esukwankyɛbaber mu:

Na ɔnoara so kokum Egyptnyi bi, ɔbarimba kokroko bi: Na Egyptnyi no kitsa peaa wɔ ne nsamu; na ɔnodze ɔdze poma sianee kɔr ne nkyɛn, na okohwiim peaa no wɔ Egyptnyi no nsamu. Na ɔdze nankasa ne peaa no kum no.
Ndzɛmba iyinom na Jehoiada ne ba Benaiah yɛe, na onyaa dzin wɔ mbarimba akatakyi baasa no mu.
Ɔyɛɛ onyimnyamfo dodow seen eduasa no, na mbom ɔannto asɔpɔn baasa no. Na David dze no sii n’annkɔbeafo do.
Joab no nua Asahel ɔyɛ eduasa no mu baako; Dodo ne ba Elhanan a ofi Beth-lehem;
Harodnyi Shammah, Harodnyi Elika;
Paltinyi Helez, Tekonyi Ikkesh ba Ira;
Anathothnyi Abiezer, Hushathnyi Mubunnai;
Ahohnyi Zalmon, Netophathnyi Maharai;
Baanah ne ba Heleb, Netophathnyi, Ribai a ofi Benjaminmba Gibeah ne ba Ittai;
Benaiah, Pirathbyi, Hiddai a ofi Gaash nwora mu;
Abialbon Arbathnyi, Azmaveth, Barhumnyi;
Eliahba, Shaalbonnyi, Jashenmba, Jonathan;
Shammah, Hararinyi, Sharar ne ba Ahiam, Ararinyi
Eliphelet, Ahasbai ne ba, Maacathnyi ne ba, Ahithophel ne ba Eliam Gilonnyi;
Hezro Carmelnyi, Paarai, Arbinyi;
Nathan a ofi Zobah ne ba Igal, Bani, Gadnyi;
Zelek, Ammonnyi, Naharai, Beerothnyi, Joab, Zeruiah ne ba, n’akodzesoafo;
Ira, Ithrinyi, Gareb, Ithrinyi;
Uriah, Hittinyi: Hɔn nyinara yɛ eduasa esuon.
24: Na Ewuradze n'ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ Israel do bio, na onuu David mu wɔ hɔn do, dɛ, kɔ, kɛkan Israel na Judah.
Na ɔhen no see dɔm no do safohen Joab a ɔkã no ho no dɛ, afei kɔ kekyin wɔ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu, fi Dan araa kodu Beer-sheba, na hom nkan ɔman no, ma munhu ɔman no hɔn dodow.
Na Joab see ɔhen no dɛ, afei Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nkã ɔman no ho dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse biara mbɔho ɔha, na mo wura ɔhen mfa n’enyiwa nhu: Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mo wura ɔhen repɛ dɛm adze yi?
Naaso ɔhen no n’asɛm yɛɛ dzen wɔ Joab do, na dɔm no mu asafohemfo no do. Na Joab na dɔm no mu asafohemfo no fii ɔhen no enyim sii mu kɔr dɛ wɔrekɛkan Israel ɔman no.
Na wokotwaa Jordan, na wɔ kɔbɔɔ asese wo Aroer, kurow a ɔda Gad ɔbɔn no ne finimfin, na odzi kɔ Jazer no, n’enyimfa:
Na nkyii wɔbaa Gilead, na Tahtim-hodshi asaase do; na wɔbaa Dan-jaan, na wɔponee sii Zidon,
na wɔbaa Tyre akoban no, na Hivifo, na Canaanfo nkurow nyinara rau: Na wopuei kɔr Judah epomu afamu, wɔ Beer-sheba.
Dɛm ntsi aber a wokyiin asaase no nyinara do no, nna wɔbaa Jerusalem abosoom akron na adaduonu n’ewiei.
Na Joab dze ɔman no hɔn anobu no dodow no brɛɛ ɔhen no: Na Israel mu mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam a wɔtwe afõwa wɔyɛ mpem ahaawɔtwe; na Judah mbarimba no wɔyɛ ahanum.
Na David kaan ɔman no n'ekyir no, n'akoma bɔɔ no paa. Na David see Ewuradze dɛ, mayɛ bɔn kɛsenara wɔ dza mayɛ yi mu: Na afei, Ewuradze, meserɛ wo, yi w'akowaa no bɔn kɔ; na mayɛ nkwaseadze dodow.
Na David soɛɛr anapa no, Ewuradze n'asɛm baa nkɔnhyɛnyi Gad, David n'adzehunyi no, nkyɛn, dɛ,
kɔ na kɛkã kyerɛ David dɛ, Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, nsɛm ebiasa na medze risi w'enyim; fa no mu kor, ma menyɛ memma wo.

Nna Gad baa David nkyɛn, na ɔbɛkãa kyerɛɛ no, na ɔsee no dɛ, ana mfe esuon kɔm mbra wo do wɔ w’asaase do a? Anaa iboguan wɔ w’atamfo enyim abosoom ebiasa mber a woritsiw wo? Anaa ɔyardɔm mbra w’asaase do ndaansa? Afei hwɛ na hu mbuae kor a memfa mensan menkɛma nyia ɔsomaa me no.
Na David see Gad dɛ, Mo ho akyer me papaara: Afei ma yɛnhwe Ewuradze nsamu; na n’ehumbɔbɔr dɔɔ sõ: Na mma mma monnhwe nyimpa nsamu.
Nna Ewuradze maa ɔyardɔm baa Israel do fi anapa araa dze kodur mber a ɔhyɛe no: Na ɔman a ofi Dan araa dze kodu Beer-sheba no, no mu nyimpa mpemeduosuon wuwui.

Na ɔbɔfo no tseen ne nsa wɔ Jerusalem do dɛ ɔresɛɛ no no, Ewuradze nuu noho wɔ mbusu no ho, na ɔsee ɔbɔfo no a ɔsɛɛ ɔman no dɛ, ayɛ yie; afei gyina wo nsa. Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no wɔ Jebusnyi Araunah n’ewuporowee no ho.

Na David hun ɔbɔfo no a okunkum nkorɔfo no, ɔkãa kyerɛɛ Ewuradze dɛ, hwɛ, mara na mayɛ bɔn, na mara na metwa nkontompɔ: Na nguan yi dze, ebɛnadze na wɔayɛ? Meserɛ wo, ma wo nsa mbra emi na m'egya fi do.
Na Gad baa David nkyɛn da no, na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, Fow kɔ, na kesi afɔrmbukyia ma Ewuradze wɔ Jebusnyi Araunah n’ewuporowee hɔ.
Na David fowee kɔree dɛ mbrɛ Gad n’asɛm no tse, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛe no.
Na Araunah hwɛe, na ohun ɔhen no na no nkowaa no dɛ wɔreba ne nkyɛn: Na Araunah fiir edzi, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ ɔhen no enyim dze n’enyim boom famu.
Na Araunah see dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na mo wura ɔhen reba n'akowaa nkyɛn yi? Na David see dɛ, morobɔtɔ wo hɔ ewuporowee no mesi afɔrmbukyia mama Ewuradze, ma woeesianka yardɔm noefi ɔman no do.
Na Araunah see David dɛ, wɔmma mo wura ɔhen mfa na ɔmbɔ afɔr dɛ mbrɛ oye wɔ n’enyi do: Hwɛ, anantwi a wɔdze bɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr, na ewuporowee ndzɛmba na anantwi ahyehyɛdze a wɔdze bɛyɛ nyina nye yi:
Iyi nyinara, ɔhen, Araunah dze ma ɔhen. Na Araunah see ɔhen no dɛ, Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn mpen wo do.

Na ɔhen no see Araunah dɛ, oho; mbom ɔtɔ ara na mobɔtɔ no wo hɔ ama bo: Nkyii so morommbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr mma Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn a ɔnnsom me hwee. Nna David tɔɔ ewuporowee no na anantwi no maa dwetɛ shekel eduonum.
Na David sii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ maa Ewuradze, na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr na asomdwee afɔr. Nna Ewuradze tsiei maa asaase no, na wosiankaa ɔyardɔm no fii Israel do.

1: Paul nye Silvanus nye Timothy dze kɛma Thessalonica asɔrasɔr a wɔwɔ hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuardze Jesus Christ mu;
adom nye asomdwee a ofir Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Christ hɔ nkã hom.
Ɔsɛ hɛn dɛ yɛda Nyankopɔn ase daa wɔ hom ntsi, enuanom,dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata, wɔ dɛ hom gyedzi rinyin mbor do, na dɔ a hom nyina dze dodɔ homho nkokor no adɔɔ sõ;
na ɔma hɛnankasa so yɛhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ hom mu wɔ Nyankopɔn asɔrasɔr mu wɔ abotar nye gyedzi a ɔwɔ hom ahohia nye amandzehu a hom rosɔw nyina mu ntsi;
ɔno na ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn atsɛn tsenenee sɛnkyerɛdze a ɔda gua, ama woeebu hom dɛ hom sɛ Nyankopɔn ahendzi a hom ruhu ho amandze no.
Osiandɛ ɔtsen wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim dɛ ɔdze ahohia tua hɔn a worihiahia hom ho no kaw,
na hom aworihiahia hom ho dze, ɔnam hom nye hɛn ahomgye, wɔ da bi a Ewuradze Jesus Christ beyi noho efi sor, nye no tum abɔfo,
wɔ gyaframee mu, na oebotua hɔn a wonnyim Nyame na wonntsie hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ asɛmpa no wer:
hɔn na wobenya akatua bɔn, ɔsɛɛ a onnyi ewie, efi Ewuardze enyim, nye n'ahoɔdzen enyimnyam no ho,
ber a ɔbɛba ma wɔaahyɛ no enyimyam wɔ n'ahotsewfo mu, na wɔaahwɛ no dɛ anwanwadze wɔ hɔn a wɔgye dzi nyina mu(osiandɛ wɔagye hɛn dasee a yedzii no wɔ hom mu no edzi wɔ da no mu.
Dɛm ntsi so na yɛsɔr ma hom daa dɛ, hɛn Nyankopɔn mbu hom dɛ hom sɛ hom frɛ, na ɔmma n'ayamuyie enyisɔ, nye gyedzi ewuma no nyɛ mã wɔ hom mu;
na wɔaahyɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus dzin enyimnyam wɔ hom mu, nye hom so wɔ no mu, dɛmbrɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Ewuardze Jesus Christ n'adom tse.
2: Afei yɛkotow serɛ hom, enuanom, wɔ Jesus Christ ne mbae nye hɛn mboa a yɛbɔboa hɛn ano wɔ ne nkyɛn no ho;
dɛ, mma hom mma wɔnnwosow hom ntsɛm mmfi hom adwen mu nndua sunsum anaa asɛm, anaa nwoma a wɔdɛ ofi hɛn hɔ do nntu hom bo dɛ gyama Christ da no enya edu;
mma obiara nndaadaa hom wɔ biribiara ho, osiandɛ da no nnkɛba, gyesɛ gyedzi ho asehwe no aba ana, na woeyi bɔn nyimpa no edzi, ɔsɛɛ ba no a,
ɔhoran noho ɔmema noho do tsia dza wɔfrɛ no Nyame, anaa dza wɔsɔr no nyina, ma ɔtsena Nyankopɔn asɔrdan mu dze noho kyerɛ dɛ ɔno nye Nyame.
Ana hom nkaa dɛ mowɔ hom nkyɛn no mekãa yinom nyina kyerɛɛ hom?
Na afei hom nyim dza osiw kwan, ama woeeyi no akyerɛ wɔ nankasa n'aber do.
Na mbrato esumasɛm no enya reyɛ eduma, na obi na orisiw kwan ma ekodu dɛ wobeyi no hɔ.
Nna nkyii wobeyi nyia onndzi mbra biara do no akyerɛ, ɔno na Ewuradze Jesus dze n'anomu ehuhuw boku no, na ɔdze ne mbae mfifrii ama ɔahera;
ɔno ne mbae no ɔnam abɔnsam edwuma do ba, wɔ tum nye nsɛnkyerɛdze nye ator anwanwadze nyina mu,
nye dza ɔnntsen ndaadaa nyina mu ma hɔn a wɔrehera no, osiandɛ wɔanngye nokwar no dɔ no, ma wɔaagye hɔn nkwa.
Iyi ntsi na Nyankopɔn soma ndaadaa ndwumadzi ba hɔn mu ma wɔaagye atorsɛm edzi:
na woeebu hɔn a wɔanngye nokwar no enndzi na mbom hɔn enyi sɔ dza ɔtsen no nyina atsɛn.
Na hɛndze ɔsɛ hɛn dɛ yɛda Nyankopɔn ase daa wɔ hom ntsi, enuanom a Ewuradze dɔ hom, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn fir ahyɛse paa hom kɔr nkwagye mu wɔ Sunsum ahosan nye nokwar gyedzi a.
Ɔnam hɛn asɛmpa no do afrɛ hom aba mu, ma hom eenya Christ Jesus enyimnyam no.
Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, hom ngyina pintsinn na hom nsuo atsetsesɛm a yɛnom asɛm anaa nwoma do kyerɛkyerɛɛ hom no mu.
Afei hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ nankasa nye Egya Nyankopɔn a ɔdɔɔ hɛn na ɔmaa hɛn onnyiewie awerɛkyekyer nye enyidado pa a ɔnam adom do no,
ɔnkã hom akoma ntɔ mu na ontsim hom wɔ asɛm nye edwuma pa nyina mu.
3: Dza ɔaka no, enuanom, hom nsɔr mma hɛn ma Ewuradze asɛm ntu ntsɛn ma Ewuradze asɛm ntu ntsɛn na wɔnhyɛ no enyimnyam dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse wɔ hom nkyɛn no;
ma wɔngye hɛn mfi nyimpa akwasampafo nye emumuyɛfo nsamu, na nnyɛ nyimpa nyina na wɔwɔ gyedzi no.
Na ɔnokwafo nye Ewuradze a ɔbɛma hom etsim, na ɔahwɛ hom do wɔ ɔbɔn no ho no.
Na yɛwɔ hom ho werɛ wɔ Ewuradze mu dɛ hom yɛ, eso hom bɛyɛ dza yɛhyɛe no.
Na Ewuradze ndan hom akoma nkɔ Nyankopɔn dɔ nye christ abotar no mu.
Afei yɛhyɛ hom, enuanom wɔ Jesus Christ dzin mu, dɛ hom ntwehomho mfi onua biara a ɔnantsew basabasa, na onndzi atsetsesɛm a hom nyae wɔ hɛnho no do ho.
Na homankasa hom nyim dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ hom sūasua hɛn; osiandɛ yɛannyɛ hɛnho basabasa wɔ hom mu;
eso yenndzi obiara nsamu edziban kwa, na mbom mbɔdzembɔ mu nye ɔberɛ mu na yɛyɛ edwuma adzekyee nye adzesaa, amma yaannyɛ adzesoadze amma hom mu biara:
Nnyɛ dɛ yennyi ho kwan bi a, na mbom yɛdze hɛnho aayɛ fasusu ma hom eesūa hɛn.
Na yɛwɔ hom nkyɛn no yɛhyɛɛ hom dɛ, sɛ obi mmpɛ dɛ ɔyɛ edwuma a, na eso mma onndzidzi.
Na yɛtse dɛ binom wɔ hɔ a wɔnantsew basabasa wɔ hom mu, wɔnnyɛ edwuma na mbom wɔyɛ apɛsɛmedzifo.
Na hɔn a wɔtse dɛm no, yɛhyɛ hɔn na yetu hɔn fo wɔ Ewuradze Jesus mu dɛ wɔnyɛ fõo nyɛ edwuma na wondzi hɔnankasa hɔn edziban.
Na homdze, enuanom, mma hom mmberɛ wɔ papyɛ mu.
Na sɛ obi enntsie hɛn asɛm a ɔwɔ nwoma yi mu no a, hom nhyɛ no nsew na mma hom hom nnye no mmbɔ fɛkuw, na n'enyi ntõ.
Naaso mma hom mmbu no ɔtamfo, na hom ntu no fo dɛ onua.
Na afei asomdwee Ewuradze nankasa ɔmma hom asomdwee daa wɔ adze nyina mu. Ewuradze nye hom nyina ntsena.
Emi Paul me nkyia a medze mankasa me nsa mekyerɛw no nye yi.
Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus adom nkã hom nyinara.

1: Paul, Christ Jesus somafo ɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ do, dɛ mbrɛ nkwa a ɔwɔ Christ Jesus mu anohoba tse,
dze kɛma no dɔba Timothy: Adom, mbɔbɔrhu, asomdwee, mfi Egya Nyankopɔn nye hɛn Ewuradze Christ Jesus hɔ nkã wo.
Meda Nyankopɔn a mifi me nananom do som no tsibowa krɔnn mu no ase, dɛ minngyaa wo nkaa wɔ mo nkotoserɛ mu adzesaa nye adzekyee,
na mekaa wo nyinsuwa a mefe dɛ mubohu wo na dɛw aahyɛ me mã:
dɛ ama makaa gyedzi a abra nnyi mu a ɔwɔ wo mu a odzii kan tsenaa wo nana Lois nye wo nã Eunice mu; na megye dzi dɛ ɔwɔ wo so mu.
Ɔno ntsi mekaa wo dɛ kūa Nyankopɔn ahyɛdze a ɔnam me nsa a medze guu wo do no do wɔ wo mu no mu.
Na Nyankopɔn amma hɛn suro sunsum, na mbom ahoɔdzen nye dɔ nye adwenmutsew dze a.
Dɛm ntsi mma w'enyi nntõ hɛn Ewuradze adasedzi no, anaa emi a meyɛ ne daduanyi no ho; na mbom sɔw asɛmpa no ho akotorka no bi, dɛ mbrɛ Nyame ahoɔdzen tse;
ɔno na ɔgyee hɛn, na ɔdze ɔfrɛ krɔnkrɔn no frɛɛ hɛn, nnyɛ hɛn ndwuma do a, na mbom nankasa ne tsirmpɔw nye n'adom a ɔdze doom hɛn wɔ Christ Jesus mu fir tsetseetse,
na afei wɔnam Christ Jesus ne mfifii do eyi no edzi no do a; ɔno a oeyi owu efi hɔ, na ɔnam asɛmpa no do dze nkwa nye bɛkyebo aba kan mu,
no ho nna wɔahyɛ me ɔsɛnkafo, nye somafo, nye kyerɛkyerɛfo.
Ɔno ntsi so, na muruhu amandze yi: Naaso m'enyi nntõ; osiandɛ minyim nyia magye no medzi, na megye dzi dɛ obotum akora dza medze mahyɛ ne nsa no esie da no.
Suo nsɛm pa esusudo a etsee no me nkyɛn no mu yie,
wɔ gyedzi nye ɔdɔ a ɔwɔ Christ Jesus mu no mu. Akoradze pa a wɔdze hyɛɛ wo nsa no dua Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a ɔtse hɛn mu no do kora do.
Inyim yi, dɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ Asia nyina danee fii me nkyɛn; 16 hɔn mu bi nye Phygelus nye Hermogenes. Ewuradze nhu Onesiphorus fie mbɔbɔr, na ɔtɔ dɛ ɔma mo ho dwe me, na n'enyi anntõ mo nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn ho.
Na ɔbaa Rome no, ɔdze mbɔdzen hwehwɛɛ me, na ohun me,
(Ewuradze mma onnya Ewuradze hɔ ehumbɔbɔrwɔ da no mu); Na dodow a ɔsomee wɔ Ephesus, woara nyim no papaapa.
2: Dɛm ntsi ɔwo, me ba, hyɛ dzen wɔ adom a ɔwɔ Christ Jesus mu no mu.
Na dza etsee no m'anomu wɔ adasefo pii enyim no, ɔnoara na fa hyɛ nyimpa anokwafo a wobotum akyerɛkyerɛ binom so nsa.
Na ɔwo so sɔw akotorka bi dɛ Christ Jesus sordaanyi pa.
Ɔsordaanyi a ɔwɔ som mu biara mmfa noho nntõto ɔbra asetsena mu ma ɔaasɔ nyia ɔfaa no yɛɛ sordaanyi no enyi.
Na sɛ so obi dzi agor mu esi a, wɔmmbɔ no konyim abɔtsir, gyesɛ odzi esi dɛ mbrɛ ho mbra tse.
Okuafo a ɔyɛ edwuma nna otwar dɛ odzi kan nya aba no bi.
Dwen dza merekã yi ho; na Ewuradze bɛma wo adze nyina mu ntseasee.
Kaa Jesus Christ a ɔasoɛr efi ewufo mu, ofi David asefo, dɛ mbrɛ me nsɛmpa tse no,
no mu na mosɔw akotorka dze besi mpokyerɛ asɛm dze, wɔnnkyer no.
Dɛm ntsi na mosɔw yinom nyina wɔ hɔn a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn no ntsi, ma hɔn so woeenya nkwagye no a ɔwɔ Christ mu no, nye enyimnyam a onnyi ewiei.
Nokwasɛm nye yi: Sɛ yɛnye no wui a, yɛnye no bɛtsena ase so:
Sɛ yɛsɔw a, yɛnye no bedzi hen; sɛ yɛpa no a, ɔno so bɛpa hɛn:
Sɛ yɛnnyɛ nokwarfo a, ɔnodze ɔtse nokwardzi mu ara; osiandɛ onntum mmpa noho ekyir.
Iyinom ho na kaa hɔn kasa kyerɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn enyim, dɛ mma wonntwa noko a mfaso bi nnyi mu nndan etsiefo aso.
Bɔ mbɔdzen yi woho kyerɛ dɛ nyia Nyame apen no, odwumayɛnyi a ɔnngye dɛ ɔfɛr, ɔdze nokwasɛm no mu tsenn.
Na nsɛm huhuw dze, yi woho fo ho: Na wɔbɔkɔ enyim ara wɔ mbusubɔ mu,
na hɔn kasaa bɛtserɛw dɛ kuprɔwee: Hɔn mu bi nye Hymenæus nye Philetus;
nkorɔfo a wɔatser nokwar no ho kã dɛ wusoɛr no etwa mu dada, na woebutuw binom hɔn gyedzi.
Naaso Nyankopɔn fapem tsim hɔ pintsinn kura nsɔwano yi, Ewuradze nyim hɔn a wɔyɛ nedze: Na ma obiara a ɔbɔ Ewuradze dzin ntwe noho mfi dza ɔnntsen ho.
Na ofi kɛse mu nnyi sika nye dɛtse so; na wobu bi bi, bi so wommbu no.
Na sɛ obi tsew noho fi iyinom ho a, ɔbɛyɛ adze a wobu no bi, wɔatsew ho, owura dze yɛbiribi a ɔyɛ yie, na woesiesie dze ama edwuma pa biara.
Guan mberantsɛber mu akɔndɔ, na nye hɔn a wofi akoma a no mu tsew mu frɛ Ewuradze ndzi tsenenee, gyedzi, ɔdɔ, nye asomdwee ekyir.
Na mbatam hɔn nkwasea ekyingye dze, pow, dɛ inyim dɛ ɔdze noko ba ntsi.
Na Ewuradze akowaa ɔnnsɛ no nokotwa, na mbom ɔsɛ no dɛ ɔdwe ma nyimpa nyina, ohu kyerɛkyerɛ, ɔto no bo ase,
ɔkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn a wɔnye hɔnho dzi esi wɔ ɔdwe mu; dɛ bi a Nyankopɔn bɛma hɔn nnho akɔ nokwar no ho nyimdzee mu,
na hɔn enyi do aatsew hɔn efi abɔnsam a ɔafa hɔn adɔmmum no efir mu ama Nyankopɔn apɛdze.
3: Na hu yi dɛ nda a odzi ekyir no mu awerɛhow ber bɛba.
Na nyimpa bɛyɛ ahopɛfo, sikapɛfo, ahohyehyɛfo, ahoramfo, ndzebɔfo, awofo do asoɔdzenfo, bɔnyiayɛfo, hɔn a hɔn ho nntsew,
hɔn a wonnyi dɔ, asɛnkadofo, nsekubɔfo, hɔn a wonnyi ahohyɛdo, abɔyafo, hɔn a wɔmmpɛ papa,
yimafo, etsiɔdzenfo, enyimenamfo, hɔn a wɔdɔ enyigye sen Nyame;
hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛ wɔwɔ nyamesompa, na wɔpow n'ahoɔdzen no: woyinom na dan woho fi hɔn nkyɛn.
Na woyinom bi na wɔweawea hɛn efiefi mu, kɛfa mbaa nkwasea a bɔn ahyɛ hɔn do ndɔmmum,
hɔn a akɔndɔ horow dze hɔn rokɔ a wosūa daa, naaso wonntum nndu nokwar nyimdzee ho da no.
Na dɛ mbrɛ Jannes na Jambres nye Moses sii no, dɛmara so na woyinom nye nokwar no si; nyimpa a hɔn adwen mu aprɔw a wɔmmfora wɔ gyedzi afamu.
Na wɔronnkɔ hɔn enyim dodow biara: Na hɔn nkwaseasɛm bɛda edzi wɔ nyimpa nyina enyim dɛ mbrɛ hɔndze so yɛe.
Na ɔwodze, idzii me nkyerɛkyerɛ, me bra, me tsirmsɛm, me gyedzi, me penkyɛr, mo dɔ, m'abotar,
m'ahohia, m'amandzehu ekyir; dza ɔbaa mo do wɔ Antioch, Iconium, nye Lystra; ahohia a mosɔwee; na Ewuradze gyee me fii ne nyinara mu.
Ɛhɛɛ, hɔn a wɔpɛ dɛ wɔdze nyamesompa tsena ase wɔ Christ Jesus mu nyina bɔsɔw ahohia.
Na nyimpa bɔn nye esisifo dze, wɔbɔkɔ hɔn enyim wɔ bɔn mu, wɔdaadaa, na wɔdaadaa hɔn.
Na ɔwodze, tsena dza esūa na ehu no no nokwar no mu, na inyim hɔn a esūa no hɔn ho.
Na ofitsi wo mbafobermu inyim kyerɛw krɔnkrɔn no a obotum edua Christ Jesus mu gyedzi ama eehu nyansa akɔ nkwagye mu no.
Kyerɛwsɛm biara fi Nyame ahom mu, na oye ma nkyerɛkyerɛ, nkaenyim, ntsēa, nye tsenenee mu ntsetsee:
Na Nyame nyimpa no eedzi mu, woeesiesie no koraa ama edwuma pa biara.
4: Midzi wo adanse wɔ Nyankopɔn nye Jesus Christ a obodua atseasefo nye ewufo atsɛn, wɔ ne mfirii nye n'ahendzi no mu no enyim dɛ,
kã asɛmno, fua mu ber a edu ano nye dza onndu ano mu; yi atsɛn, kã enyim, tu fo, wɔ penkyɛr nye nkyerɛkyerɛ nyina mu.
Na ber bɛba a worinntsie nkyerɛkyerɛ pa, na hɔn asowamu hen ntsi wobedzi hɔn akɔndɔ ekyir aprapra akyerɛkyerɛfo aboa hɔn do;
na wɔbɛdan hɔn aso efi nokwar no ho, na wɔaman akɔ anansesɛm ho.
Na ɔwodze, gyen w'enyi wɔ adze nyina mu, sɔw akotorka, yɛ asɛmpakafo edwuma no, wie wo som koraa.
Na emidze, woruhue me egu dada, na mo kɔber edu.
Makõ ɔkõ pa no, mewie mbirika no tu, mesuo gyedzi no mu esie,
ɔdzekɔr yi dza ɔda hɔ ma me nye tsenenee ahenkyɛw a Ewuradze tsɛmbuafo tsenenee no dze bɛma me da no, na nnyɛ mo nko, na hɔn a wɔadɔ na mfirii nyina.
Bɔ mbɔdzen bra me nkyɛn ntsɛm:
Na Dɛmas adɔ sesei wiadze yi egya me hɔ esi mu kɔ Thessalonica; Crescens kɔ Galatia, Titus kɔ Dalmatia.
Luke nko na ɔnyɛ me wɔ ha. Fa Mark ka woho bra: Na oye ma me wɔ ɔsom mu.
Tychius dze, masoma no Ephesus.
Sɛ ereba a, fa m'gudotar a medanee gyaa Troas wɔ Carpus nkyɛn no bra, nye mbuukuu no, nkanka nwoma mpompo no.
Aleɛander kɔɔberdwimfo no yɛɛ me bɔn pii: Ewuradze botua no kaw dɛ mbrɛ no ndwuma tse:
Ɔno na wo so hwɛ yie wɔ no ho, na osiiw hɛn asɛm kwan pii.
M'anoyi a odzi kan no mu no, obiara enndzi m'afã, na hɔn nyina daan me gyae: Meserɛ dɛ mma wommbu nngu hɔn do.
Naaso Ewuradze gyinaa m'ekyir, na ɔhyɛɛ me dzen, na wɔnam mo do eewie asɛnka no, na amanamanfo nyina aatse: Na wɔgyee me fii gyata anomu.
Ewuradze bɛgye me efi ndwuma bɔn nyina mu, na ɔaagye me akɔ no sor ahendzi no mu: Ɔno na enyimnyam nkã no mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
Kyia Prisca nye Aɔuila, nye Onesiphorus fiefo.
Erastus tsenaa Corinth: Na Trophimus yar, na madan no egya Miletus.
Bɔ mbɔdzen bra ansaana awɔwber edu, Eubulus nye Pudens, nye Linus, nye Claudia, nye enuanom no nyina kyia wo.
Ewuradze nye wo sunsum ntsena. Adom nkã wo.

1: Ɔpanyin no dze kɛma ɔdɔfo Gaius a modɔ no nokwar mu.
Ɔdɔfo, miyi mpaa dɛ, adze nyina mu onsi wo yie, na nya ahonamudzen, wɔ adze nyina mu, dɛ mbrɛ esi wo kra yie.
Na enuanom no bae bedzii wo nokwardzi ho dase, mbrɛ enam nokwar no mu no, midzii dɛw dɛ.
Minnyi dɛw a ɔkyɛn yi, dɛ metse dɛ me mba nam nokwar no mu.
Ɔdɔfo, dza eyɛ ma enuanom nye ahɔho no, yɛ no nokwar mu;
hɔn na woedzi wo dɔ ho dase wɔ asɔr enyim, na sɛ igya hɔn kwan dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim a, ebɛyɛ yie:
Osiandɛ, osian Dzin no ntsi na wofiir edzi, na wɔanngye Amanamamfo hɔ biribi.
Dɛm ntsi na ɔsɛ hɛn dɛ yɛgye dɛm nkorɔfo, na yaayɛ mfɛnom-dwumayɛfo ama nokwar no.
Mekyerɛwee kɛmaa asɔr no, na Diotrephes a ɔpɛ hɔn mu panyin edzi no anngye hɛn.
Iyi ntsi sɛ meba a, mebɛkaa ne nyɛe a ɔyɛ, ɔdze nsɛmbɔn kasakasa tsia hɛn: Na n'enyiwa nnsɔ yi mpo, na nankasa ɔnngye enuanom no, na osiw hɔn a wɔpɛ so kwan, na oyi hɔn edzi fi asɔr mu.
Ɔdɔfo, mma nndzi bɔn ekyir, na mbom dzi papa ekyir. Nyia ɔyɛ papa na ofir Nyankopɔn mu, nyia ɔyɛ bɔn dze, onnhun Nyankopɔn.
Na Demetrius dze, hɔn nyinara, nye nokwar nankasa edzi no dase, na hɛn so yedzi no dase; na inyim dɛ hɛn dasee yɛ nokwar.
Mowɔ ndzɛmba pii nkyɛ mekyerɛw wo, na memmpɛ dɛ medze dubir nye kyerɛwdua mekyerɛw brɛ wo:
na m'enyi da dɛ mubohu wo ntsɛm, na yɛdze ano na ano akasa. Asomdwee nkã wo. Mfɛfo no kyiakyia wo. Bobɔ mfɛfo no edzin nkorkor kyiakyia hɔn.
Mobɔɔ me kan kasee no, O Theopilus, wɔ ndzɛmba nyina a Jesus fiir ase yɛe na ɔkyerɛkyerɛe no ho,
dze kodur da a ɔnam Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn do dze n'ahyɛdze maa n'esuafo a ɔpaa hɔn no wiei no, wɔfaa no kɔr sor no:
hɔn so na n'amandzehu ekyir no, ɔnam dasehyɛ pii mu yii noho kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ ɔtse ase, ɔmaa wohun no adaduanan mu, na ɔkãa Nyankopɔn a'ahendzi ho nsɛm.
Na ɔnye hɔn dzii ehyia no, ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ mma wommfi Jerusalem nnkɔ, na mbom wɔntweɔn Egya n'anohoba a ɔse, hom tsee wɔ m'anomu no:
Na John dze, ɔdze nsu numae, na homdze, wɔdze Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn bonuma hom, orinndzi nda dodow biara.
Na ɔnye hɔn hyiae no, wobisaa no dɛ, Ewurzde, ana ber yi mu ebɛhyɛ ahendzi no ananmu ama Isreal?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔnnyɛ homdze dɛ hom bohu mber anaa mber nkyekyɛmu a Egya ahyɛ ato hɔ wɔ nankasa no tum mu.
Na mbom Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no nya ba hom do a, hom benya ahoɔdzen; na hom bɛyɛ n'adasefo wɔ Jerusalem, nye Judæa nyina nye Samaria dze ekodu asaase ano noho.
Na owiee yinom kã, na nsuwusiw gyee no fii hɔn enywa do.
Na ɔrokɔ no na wɔrohwɛ sor hann no, hwɛ, mbarimba beenu bi hyɛ ntar fufuw begyinaa hɔn nkyɛn,
na wɔkãe so dɛ, Galilee mbarimba, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom gyina rohwɛ sor yi? Jesus yi ara a wɔafa no efi hom nkyɛn kɔ sor yi, ɔbɛba dɛmara dɛ hom ehu dɛ ɔrokɔ sor yi.
Nna wofi koko a wɔfrɛ no Ngo Bepɔw a ɔbɛn Jerusalem bɛyɛ ahomgyeda kwan no do sanee baa Jerusalem.
Na wɔhɛɛn mu no, wɔkɔr abansor hɔ: Peter nye John nye James nye Andrew, Philip nye Thomas, Bartholomew nye Matthew, Alphæa ba James, Simon Zealot no nye James ba Judas ka ho.
yinom nyina bɔɔ ɔnosɛɛ suoo mpaabɔ ntotɔserɛ mu, wɔnye mbaa no, nye Jesus ne nã Mary, nye no nuanom.
Na nda no mu na Peter gyinaa enuanom no finimfin, na nyimpadodow a wohyiaa fakor bɛyɛ nyimpa ɔha eduonu, na ɔsee dɛ,
Enuanom, otwar dɛ kyerɛwsɛm a Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no nam David anomu dzii kan kãe wɔ Judas a ɔyɛɛ kwankyerɛfo maa hɔn a wɔkyeer Jesus no ho no, ɔbaa mu.
Na wɔkaan no foraa hɛn, na no so tɔɔ ɔsom yi ne fã bi somee.
(Oyi na ɔdze n'emumuyɛ ho akatua nyaa asaase, na ɔwɔɔ akɔmfo, na no mu paae, ma n'ayamudze nyina tui gui;
na hɔn a wɔtse Jewrusalem nyina tsee, ma dɛm ntsi asaase no wɔfrɛ no hɔnankasa hɔn kasaa mu dɛ, Akeidama: Ɔnye dɛ, Bɔgya Asaase no).
Na wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Ndwom nwoma no mu dɛ, wɔmma ne tsenabea nyɛ amamfõ, na mma obiara nntsena mu: na, no nhwɛdo-edwuma no so obi mfa.
Dɛm ntsi mbarimba a wɔnye hɛn nam kɔ ba wɔ ber a Ewuradze Jesus dzii hɛn mu ndɔfir nyina mu,
ofitsi John enuma do dze besi da a wɔfaa no hɛn nkyɛn kɔr sor no, otwar dɛ hɔn mu baako nye hɛn yɛ no wunyan no ho adasefo.
Na woyii beenu sii hɔ, Joseph a wɔfrɛ no Barsabbas a wɔtoo no Justus, nye Mattias.
Na wɔsɔree see dɛ, ɔwo Ewuradze a inyim nyimpa akoma mu, kyerɛ beenu yi mu baako a eyi no
dɛ ɔmfa som nye asomafodwuma a Judas fii ho hwee ase, ma ɔaakɔ nankasa ne tsenabea mu, ne fã bi nsom.
Na wɔtwee hɔnho tonto, na tonto no bɔɔ Matthias; na wɔkaan no fofor asomafo dubiako no.
2: Na Pentecost da no nyae durii no, nna hɔn nyina ehyia fakor.
Na awerɛfir mu ara na dede a ɔtse dɛ mframa a n'ano yɛ dzen a ɔrobɔ fi sor ba, na ɔbɛhyɛɛ dan no a wɔtse mu no nyian mã.
Na ntsɛkyerɛma a wɔapaapaa mu a ɔtse dɛ gya yiyii hɔnho kyerɛɛ hɔn, na wobesisii hɔn etsifi nkorkor.
Na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn bɛhyɛɛ hɔn nyina amaama, na wɔhyɛɛ ase kasaa kasa fofor dɛ mbrɛ sunsum no dze maa hɔn dɛ wɔnkã.
Na Jewfo bi tse Jersulem, nyimpa nyameasurofo a wofir amanaman wɔwɔ wiadze nyinana.
Na ndze yi bae no, nyimpadodow bae behyiae, na bobor boor hɔn dɛ obiara tse dɛ wɔrekasa no kurow mu kasa.
Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn nyina ahobow, nye nwanwa, na wɔsesee dɛ, Ana hɔn a wɔrekasa yi nyina nnyɛ Galileefo bi a?
Na ɔyɛ dɛn na hɛn nyina yɛretse hɛnankasa hɛn kasaa a wɔwoo hɛn wɔ mu yi?
Parthiafo nye Mediafo nye Elamfo, nye hɔn a wɔtse Mesopotamia nye Judas nye Cappadocia, Pontus nye Asia,
Phrygia nye Pamphylia, Egypt nye Libya fã a ɔfa Cyrene, nye ahɔho a wofi Rome, Jewfo nye hɔn a wɔadan Jewfo.
Cretefo nye Arabiafo, yɛtse dɛ wɔdze hɛn kasaa rekã Nyankopɔn n'etumdze.
Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn nyina ahobow, na wɔsesee hɔnho nkorkor dɛ, Iyi ase nye dɛn?
Na binom sii atwetwe see dɛ, nsã fenemfenem abow hɔn.
Na Peter nye dubiako no soɛree gyinae, na ɔmaa ne ndze do see hɔn dɛ, Judæa mbarimba, nye hom a hom tse Jerusalem nyina, hom nhu yi, na hom mma m'asɛm yi nkɔ hom asomu.
Na iyinom mmbobowee, dɛ mbrɛ hom susu yi, osiandɛ adzekyee mu dɔn a otsia ebiasa nye yi;
na yi nye dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Joel kãe no:
Nyankopɔn se, ɔbɛba dɛ nda a odzi ekyir no mu no, Mubohue mo Sunsum egu honam nyina do: Na hom mbabanyin nye hom mbabaa bɛhyɛ nkɔm, na hom mberantse bohu enyidoadzehu, na hom nkɔdaa bɔsoso adaa:
Na mo nkowaa nye mo mfona baa so do na nda no mu, Mubohue mo Sunsum egu na wɔbɛhyɛ nkɔm.
Na mebɛma anwanwadze aba wɔ wienyi sor, nye nsɛnkyerɛdze wɔ asaase yi do ase; bɔgya nye gya nye wusiw kumbɔɔ:
Ewia bɛdan sum, na bosoom adan bɔgya, Ansaana Ewuradze ne da kɛse no a ɔda edzi no aba:
Na ɔbɛba dɛ obiara a ɔbɔbɔ Ewuradze ne dzin no, wɔbɛgye no nkwa.
Isreal mbarimba, hom ntsie nsɛm yi: Jesus Nazarethnyi no, ɔbarimba a Nyankopɔn dze ahoɔdzendze a ɔnam no do yɛe wɔ hom mu yii no kyerɛɛ hom, dɛ mbrɛ homankasa so hom nyim no;
ɔno na wɔnam Nyankopɔn apam a ɔpamee na ne nyim a onyim dada no do yii no mae, na hom faa no, na hom nam hɔn a wonnyi mbra nsa do bɔɔ no mbeamudua mu kum no;
ɔno na Nyankopɔn nyaan no, ɔasan owuyaw no, osiandɛ ɔnnkɛyɛ dɛ owu botum etsintsim no do.
Na David ka wɔ no ho dɛ, muhun Ewuradze wɔ m'enyim daa, osiandɛ ɔwɔ me nsa nyimfa amma meennhim:
Dɛm ntsi m'akoma tɔɔ me yamu, na me tɛkyerɛma dzii dɛw, Na mo honam so bɔhom enyidado mu;
Osiandɛ irinngyaa me kra wɔ samanadze, eso eremma wo Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ehu mpɔtɔwee.
Akyerɛ me nkwa akwan no: Edze w'enyim bɛma enygye amee me.
Enuanom, mowɔ kwan dɛ mekã egyapanyin David ho asɛm kofee mekyerɛ hom, dɛ oewu na woesie no, na ne nda wɔ hɛn nkyɛn ha dze bodu ndɛ.
Na dɛ ɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi na onyim dɛ Nyankopɔn akã tam akyerɛ no dɛ n'asen mu aba mu bi na ɔbɛma ɔatsena n'ahengua do ntsi,
ohunii siei, na ɔkãa Christ no wuuyan ho asɛm dɛ oenngyaa ne kra wɔ samanadze, eso no honam ennhu mpɔtɔwee.
Jesus yi na Nyankopɔn nyaan no, na hɛn nyina yɛ ho adasefo.
Na afie wɔdze Nyankopɔn abanyimfa maa no do no, na onyaa Egya no hɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no anohoba no ntsi na oehue dza hom ruhu na hom retse yi egu.
Na David ammfow sor, naaso noara kã dɛ, Ewuradze see mo wura dɛ, tsena m'abanyimfa,
Kodu dɛ medze w'atamfo me bɛyɛ w'ananadzegua.
Dɛm ntsi wɔmma Isreal fie nyina nhu ampa dɛ Jesus yi a hom bɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no, ɔno na Nyankopɔn ayɛ no Ewuradze nye Christ.
Na wɔtsee no hɔn akoma mu wowɔɔ hɔn, na wɔsee Peter nye asomafo nkaa no dɛ, Enuanom, yɛnyɛ dɛn?
Na Peter see hɔn dɛ, Hom nnu homhu, na wonnuma hom nyina wɔ Jesus Christ ne dzin mu nkɔ bɔnfakyɛ mu, na hom benya Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no akyɛdze no.
