Osiandɛ anohoba no yɛ hom nye hom mba nye hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyirkyir a Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn bɛfrɛ hɔn aba ne nkyɛn nyina dze.
Na ɔdze nsɛm pii kaa ho dzii hɔn dase, na otuu hɔn fo dɛ, hom ngye homho mfi mbasantsen kɔntɔnkye yi ho.
Na hɔn a wɔgyee n'asɛm no, wonumaa hɔn, na da no ara akra bɛyɛ mpensa bɛkaa hɔn ho.
Na wɔdaa ho suoo asomafo no hɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ nye hɔn fɛkuwbɔ, nye paanoo bubu no nye mpaabɔ mu ara.
Na hu baa akra nyina do, na asomafo no yɛɛ anwanwadze nye nsɛnkyerɛdze pii.
Na hɔn a wɔgyeee dzii nyina boaa ano na wɔwɔ hɔn adze nyina dɛ kwasafodze;
na wɔtɔɔn hɔn ahodze nye hɔn ndzɛmba, na wɔkyɛe maa hɔn nyina, dɛ mbrɛ obiaa obiara.
Na daa wɔdaa ho bɔɔ ɔnosɛɛ wɔ efiefi mu, na wɔdze ahosɛpɛw nye komakor dzii hɔn ezdiban,
woyii Nyankopɔn ayɛw na wonyaa enyimpa wɔ ɔman no nyina enyim. Na Ewuradze dze hɔn a wɔregye hɔn nkwa no kaa hɔn ho daa daa.
3: Na Peter nye John siaan anan kɔr asɔrfi no mu, na ɔrokɔ dɔn a otsia akron a wɔsɔr mu no.
Na wɔsoaa ɔbarimba bi a ɔyɛ obubuafo fi ne nã yamu a daa wɔdze no bɔtoo asɔrfi abow a wɔfrɛ no fɛɛfɛw no ano, dɛ ɔnserɛ hɔn a wɔrokɔ asɔrfi no mu no adze;
ɔno na ohun Peter nye John dɛ wɔrekɛhɛn asɔrfi mu no, obisaa dɛ obenya akyerɛdze.
Na Peter dze n'enyiwa tsiim no do, ɔnye John so, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ hɛn.
Na ɔhwɛɛ hɔn komm, osusu dɛ oribenya biribi wɔ hɔn hɔ.
Na Peter see no dɛ, Sika nye dwɛɛtɛɛ dze, minnyi bi, na dza mowɔ na medze rema wo yi. Nazarethnyi Jesus Christ ne dzin mu, nantsew.
Na osuoo ne nsa nyimfa mu maa no do, na amonmu hɔ ara n'anansa nye n'anandwɛ yɛɛ dzen.
Na ohuruwii gyinae, na ɔnantsewee; na ɔnye hɔn kɔr asɔfi no mu, ɔnam na oruhuruhuruw, na oriyi Nyankopɔn ayɛw.
Na ɔman no nyina hun no dɛ ɔman na oriyi Nyankopɔn ayɛw;
na wonyim no dɛ ɔno nye nyia adzekyɛ ntsi ɔtsena Abow Fɛɛfɛw ano no; na dza ɔayɛ no no ntsi nwanwa nye ahobow hyɛɛ hɔn mã.
Na ɔdze Peter nye John mu no, nkorɔfo nyina tutuu mbirika behyiaa hɔn nkyɛn wɔ abrandaa a wɔfrɛ no Solomon dze no no do, na wɔbɔɔ mbubuw kɛse.
Na Peter hunii no, obuaa nkorɔfo no dɛ, Isreal mbarimba, ɔyɛ dɛn na iyi yɛ hom nwanwa, anaadɛ ɔyɛ dɛn na hom hwɛ tum anaa hɛn sompa na yɛdze maa ɔnamtsewee yi?
Abraham nye Isaac nye Jocab hɔn Nyankopɔn, hɛn egyanom Nyankopɔn, na ɔahyɛ n'Akowaa Jesus enyimnyam; ɔno a hom yii no mae, na hom paa no wɔ Pilate a obuu atsɛn dɛ obegyaa no no enyim.
Na hom paa Krɔnkrɔnnyi nye Tseneneenyi no, na wɔserɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa owudzifo nkyɛ hom,
na nkwa Hen no dze, hom kum no; ɔno na Nyankopɔn nyaan no fi ewufo mu: ɔho adasefo nye hɛn.
Na ɔnam ne dzin mu gyedzi do na ne dzin ayɛ oyi a hom hu no na hom nyim no yi dzen: Ɛhɛɛ, gyedzi a ɔnam no do na ɔama no ahosan koraa yi wɔ hom nyina enyim.
Na afei, enuanom, minyim dɛ onyim a hom nnyim ntsi na hom yɛe, dɛ hom etsitsir so.
Na dza Nyankopɔn nam no nkɔnhyɛfo nyina anomu kãe too hɔ dɛ otwar dɛ ne Christ no bohu amandze no, ɔyɛɛ no dɛm.
Dɛm ntsi hom nnu homhu, na hom ndan homho, ma wɔaapepa hom bɔn efi hom ho, ma dɛm no ahodwee nda eefi Ewuarzde enyim aba,
na ɔaasoma Christ a woeyi no esi hɔ ama hom dada no, mekyerɛ Jesus a;
ɔno na ɔsɛ dɛ ɔsor gye no sie, dze kodu ndzɛmba nyina ahyɛnanmu ber a Nyankopɔn nam no nkɔnhyɛfo Krɔnkrɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ fi tsetse no hɔn anomu kãe no.
Na Moses kãa dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi bi na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn bɛma no do ama hom wɔ hom enuanom mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔmaa emi so do: Ɔno na hom ntsie no wɔ dza ɔbɛkã akyerɛ hom nyina mu.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ ɔkra biara a onnketsie nkɔnhyɛnyi no, wɔbɛsɛɛ no efi ɔman no mu.
Ɛhɛɛ, nkɔnhyɛfo nyina a wofi do no dodow a wɔkasae no, hɔn so kãa nda yi ho asɛm.
Hom nye nkɔnhyɛfo no nye ahyɛmu a Nyankopɔn nye hom egyanom dzii no mba, na ɔsee Abraham dɛ, w'asefo mu na wobehyira asaase do mbusua nyina.
Hom na Nyankopɔn nyaan n'Abofra a odzii kan somaa no hom nkyɛn dɛ ombehyira hom, dɛ ɔbɛdan hom nyina efi hom emumuyɛ mu.
4: Na wɔrekasa kyerɛ nkorɔfo no, asɔfo nye asɔrfo safohen, nye Sadduceefo no baa hɔn do,
na ɔyɛɛ hɔn ehi dɛ wɔnam, Jesus do rekã ewufo mu soɛr ho asɛm.
Na wɔdze nsa suoo hɔn mu dze hɔn kesiee dɛ adze nkye: Na oedu anafua.
Na hɔn a wɔtsee asɛm no dodowara gyee dzii; na mbarimba hɔn dodow bɛyɛɛ mpemenum.
Na ɔbaa dɛ adze kyee no, hɔn etsitsir nye mpanyimfo nye kyerɛwfo no behyiae wɔ Jerusalem,
wɔnye ɔsɔfopanyin Annas, nye Caisphas, nye John, nye Aleɛander, nye dodowara a wofi sɔfopanyin ebusua mu.
Na wɔdze hɔn begyinaa finfimfin bisaa hɔn dɛ, ebɛn tum anaadɛ ebɛn dzin mu na hom yɛɛ yi?
Nna Peter a Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ahyɛ no mã no see hɔn dɛ, ɔman mu etsitsir, nye mpanyimfo,
sɛ dza wɔrepɛnsa hɛn mu ndɛ wɔ yie a wɔayɛ ama ɔyarfo yi ho, nye dɛ, ɔnam ebɛnadze do na wɔagye no nkwa a;
hom nyina nye Isrealman nyina nhu dɛ Nazarethnyi Jesus Christ a hom bɔɔ no mbeamudua mu a Nyankopɔn nyaan no fi ewufo mu no, ne dzin mu a; no mu na oyi no ho asan gyina hom enyim ha yi.
Ɔno nye ɔbo a hom adantofo emmbu no bi, na wɔayɛ no kutuwdo-bo.
Na nkwagye nnyi obiara so mu: Eso dzin fofor biara nnyi wi yi ase a wɔdze ama wɔ nyimpa mu a otwar dɛ wɔgye hɛn nkwa wɔ mu.
Na wohun Peter nye John hɔn ndam no, na wɔtsee ase dɛ wɔyɛ nyimpa a wonnsūaa nwoma na wɔyɛ ntsetsekwaa no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn nwanwa; na wohun dɛ wɔnye Jesus atsena pɛn.
Na wɔhwɛɛ nyimpa a wɔasa no yarba no a ɔnye hɔn gyinaa hɔ no, woenntum annkã hwee enntsia hɔn.
Na wɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ womfi bagua mu hɔ nkɔ nkyɛn no, wotuu hɔn mu egyina,
dɛ, Yɛnyɛ nyimpa yi dɛn? Na dɛ wɔnam hɔn do ayɛ asɛnkyerɛdze a ɔnnkã dze, ɔda edzi ma hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalem nyina, na yenntum nnsan.
Na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma ɔnnkɛda ho atahye ɔman mu no, hom mma yɛmbɔ hɔn empuw dɛ mma wɔnnkã dzin yi ho asɛm nnkyerɛ nyimpa biara bio.
Na wɔfrɛɛ hɔn hyɛɛ hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnkã asɛm, eso mma wɔnnkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ Jesus dzin mu koraa.
Na Peter nye John buae see hɔn dɛ, sɛ ɔtsen wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim dɛ yetsie hom kyɛn Nyankopɔn a, hom mbua atsɛn:
na hɛndze, yerunntum gyedɛ yɛkã dza yeehu na yɛatse.
Nahɔndze, wopupuuw hɔn bio no, wɔmaa wɔkɔree, na woennhu mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ atsea hɔn wɔ ɔman no ntsi osiandɛ hɔn nyina hyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ dza ayɛ no ntsi.
Na nyimpa no a wɔkyerɛɛ ɔyarsa asɛnkyerɛdze yi wɔ no do no, oedzi bɔbor mfe eduanan.
Na wogya hɔn no, wɔbaa hɔn mfɛfo nkyɛn, na wɔbɛkãa dza asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfa no see hɔn nyina kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na wɔtsee no, wɔbɔɔ ɔnosɛɛ maa hɔn ndze do maa Nyankopɔn see dɛ, yewura, ɔwo a eyɛɛ ɔsor nye asaase nye po nye no mu dza ɔwɔ mu nyina
a enam Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn do kãe wɔ w'akowaa David anomu dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na amanaman reyɛ gyigyeegye, na amanamanfo rususu adze gyangyan yi?
Asaase do ahemfo baa mpasuar etsitsir boaa ano tsiaa Ewuradze nye ne Christ no:
ampaara w'Akowaa Krɔnkrɔn Jesus asera no no, na Herod nye pontius Pilate nye amanamanfo nye Israelmba hyiae tsiaa no, wɔ kurow yi mu,
dɛ wɔrebɛyɛ dza wo nsa nye w'apam hyɛe too hɔ dɛ onsi no nyina.
Na afei, Ewuradze, hwɛ hɔn empuw, na ma wo nkowaa mfa ndam nyina nkã w'asɛm.
dɛ ebɛtsen wo nsa asa yarba, ma wɔnam w'Akowaa Krɔnkrɔn Jesus ne dzin do aayɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze.
Na wowiee nkotoserɛ no, beebi mbrɛ woehyia hɔ no wosowee, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn hyɛɛ hɔn nyina mã, na wɔdze ndam kãa Nyankopɔn asɛm.
Na nyimpododow a wɔgyee dzii no, wɔyɛɛ akoma kor, nye ɔkra kor; na hɔn mu biara annse dɛ ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ yɛ nankasa nedze, na ne nyina yɛɛ hɔn kwasafodze.
Na ahoɔdzen kɛse na asomafo no dze gyee Jesus no wunyan ho dase, na adom kɛse baa hɔn nyina do.
Eso obiara nnyi hɔn mu a ohiaa no, na hɔn a wɔwɔ nsaase nye adan tontɔnee, na wɔdze dza wɔtɔnee ne tsibo bae,
na wɔdze boguu asomafo no ananadze, na wɔkyɛe maa obiara dɛ mbrɛ woehia no.
Na Joseph a asomafo no too no Barnasbas (ne nkyerɛase nye dɛ Awerɛkyekyer Ba no) a ɔyɛ Levinyi a ofi Cyprusman mu no,
ɔwɔ asaase, na ɔtɔnee, na ɔdze ne sika bae boguu asomafo no ananadze.
5: Na ɔbarimba bi a ne dzin dze Ananias nye ne yer Sapphira kɔtɔɔn asaase bi,
na ɔdze ne tsisika bi siei, ne yer so nyim mu, na ɔdze fa bi bae bɔtoo asomafo no ananadze.
Na Peter see dɛ, Ananias, ɔyɛ dɛn na Satan ahyɛ w'akoma mã dɛ ibotwa apaw akyerɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no, na edze asaase no ne tsisika bi esuma?
Ana ɔwɔ hɔ no,nnyɛ wankasa wodze bi a? Na wɔtɔnee no, onnyi wankasa wo nsamu bi? Ɔyɛ dɛn na adwen adze yi wɔ w'akoma mu? Nnyɛ nyimpa na etwa apaw akyerɛ hɔn, na Nyankopɔn a.
Na Ananias tsee nsɛm yi no, ɔhwee ase wui, na hu kɛse baa hɔn a wɔtsee yinom nyina do.
Na mberantsɛ no soɛree bɔboaboaa no, na wɔdze no kɔree kesiee no.
Na n'ekyir bɛyɛ ndɔnhwer ebiasa na ne yer a onnyim dza oesi ni bae.
Na Peter buaa no dɛ, kã kyerɛ me, ana hom tɔɔn asaase no gyee dɛmara? Na ɔsee dɛ, nyew, dɛmara.
Na Peter see no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom ayɛ kor dɛ hom robɔsɔ Ewuradze Sunsum no ahwɛ yi? Hwɛ, hɔn a wokesiee wo kun anan wɔ abowano, na wɔbɔsoa wo so efir edzi.
Na ɔhwee n'ananadze amonmu hɔ ara wui; na mberantsɛ no bae bohun dɛ oewu no, wɔsoaa no fiir edzi kesiee no no kun nkyɛn.
Na hu kɛse baa asɔr mu no nyina, nye dodow a wɔtsee yinom nyina do.
Na wɔnam asomafo no nsa do na wɔyɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanawadze pii wɔ ɔman no mu, na hɔn nyina yɛɛ adwenkor wɔ Solomon abrandaa mu.
Na nkaa no mu obiara ennsi no bo dɛ ɔdze noho bɔ hɔn ho, na ɔman no dze huhoor hɔn.
Na dodow bɛkaa hɔn ho a wɔgyee Ewuradze dzii, mbarimba nye mbaa pii,
ma wɔsoaa ayarfo fiir edzi baa abrɔn mu so bɔtotoo mpikyi nye nkɛtɛ do, ma Peter resen a no sunsuma aakata hɔn mu bi do.
Na nkurow a o twa ho ehyia no mu nyimpadodow so dze ayarfo nye hɔn a esunsum fi rehyɛ hɔn amen baa Jerusalem, na wɔyɛɛ hɔn nyina edur.
Na ɔsɔfopanyin nye hɔn a wɔka no ho a wofi Sadduceefo fɛkuw no soɛree, na nyinkun hyɛɛ hɔn mã,
na wɔdze hɔn nsa suoo asomafo no mu, na wɔdze hɔn koguu kwasafo efiadze.
Na Ewuradze bɔfoe bobuee efiadze no no mbobow no na ɔdze hɔn fiir edzi, na ɔsee dɛ,
Hom nkɔ nkegyina asɔrfi no mu nkɛkã Nkwa yi ne nsɛm no nyina nkyerɛ ɔman no.

Na wɔtsee no, wɔkɔr asɔrfi no mu anapaatu kɛkyerɛkyerɛe. Na ɔsɔfopanyin no nye hɔn a wɔka no ho no bae, na wɔbɛfrɛɛ baguafo nye Isrealmba mpanyimfo nyina boaa ano, na wɔsomae kɔr efiadze hɔ dɛ wɔnkɛfa hɔn mbra.
Na asomfa no kɔr hɔ, na woennhu hɔn efiadze hɔ no, wɔsanee bɛkãa dɛ,
Efiadze no dze, yekohun dɛ wɔatow mu yie pɛ, na ahwɛfo no gyina ekyir wɔ abowano, na yebuei no yeennhu obiara wɔ mu.
Na asɔrfi safohen no nye asɔfompanyin no tsee nsɛm yi no, na hɔn tsirmu yɛɛ hɔn konsee wɔ ho dɛ, iyi bɛyɛ dɛn nye yi.
Na obi bae bɛkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, hwɛ, mbarimba a hom dze hɔn guu efiadze no gyina asɔrfi no mu rekyerɛkyerɛ ɔman no.
Nna safohen no nye asomfo no kɔree kɛfaa hɔn bae, nnyɛ akataban do bi a, na wosuroo ɔman no, amma woeennsiw hɔn abo.
Na wɔdze hɔn bae no, wɔdze hɔn begyinaa bagua mu, na ɔsɔfopanyin no bisaa hɔn dɛ,
Yɛbraa hom ketsee dɛ mma hom nnkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ dzin yi mu; na hwɛ, hom dze hom nkyerɛkyerɛ ahyɛ Jerusalem nyina mã, na hom pɛ dɛ hom dze nyimpa yi no bɔgyaa ba hɛn do.
Na Peter bye asamafo no buae see dɛ, otwar dɛ yetsie Nyankopɔn asɛm mbom kyɛn nyimapa dze.
Hɛn egyanom Nyankopɔn nyaan Jesus a hom sɛɛn no dua d kum no no.
Ɔno na Nyankopɔn dze ne nsa nyimfa maa no do dɛ Safohen nye Agyenkwa, dɛ ɔmma Isreal nnuhu nye bɔnfakyɛ.
Na hɛn na yɛyɛ nsɛm yi ho adasefo, nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no so a Nyankopɔn dze ama hɔn a wotsie no no.
Na hɔndze wɔtsee yi no, hɔn akoma mu twitwaa hɔn, na wɔkɔr apam dɛ woboku hɔn.
Na baguafo no mu baako a ɔyɛ Pharisenyi a ne dzin dze Gamaliel a ɔyɛ mbrakyerɛfo a ɔman no nyina buu no bi no soɛree, na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa nyimpa no mfir edzi kakra.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Isreal mbarimba, hom nhwɛ homho yie wɔ nyimpa yi ho, mber yi ho, dza hom rebɛyɛ.

Na ansaana mber yi rebɛba no na Theudas a ɔhyehyɛɛ noho dɛ ɔyɛ obi soɛree, na mbarimba a hɔn dodow bɛyɛ dɛ ahaanan dze hɔnho kɔbɔɔ no ho; ɔno na wokum no, na hɔn a wotsiee no nyina hotsee, na wɔyɛɛ gyan.
Na oyi ekyir, Judas Galileenyi soɛɛr ɔkankyerɛw nda no mu, na ɔno so herae, na hɔn a wotsiee no nyina petsee.
Na afei mese hom dɛ, Hom nyi homho wɔ nyimpa yi ho, na hom ngyaa hɔn: Na sɛ apam yi anaa edwuma yi fir nyimpa mu a, obobutuw;
na sɛ ofir Nyankopɔn a, hom runntum mmbutum no, mma hom aammbɛyɛ dɛ hom nye Nyankopɔn mpo rokõ.
Na wotsiee no na wɔfrɛɛ asomafo no bae, na wɔhwee hɔn na wɔbraa hɔn dɛ mma wɔnkasa wɔ Jesus dzin mu, na wogyaa hɔn.
Na hɔndze, wɔdze dɛw fiir baguafo no enyim hɔ kɔree, dɛ woebu hɔn bi dɛ wɔsɛ dɛ wɔbɔ hɔn adapaa wɔ Dzin no ntsi.
Na daa nyina asɔrfi mu nye ofie woenngyaa dɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ na wɔkã asɛmpa wɔ Jesus ho, dɛ ɔno nye Christ no.
6: Na nda yi mu no a esuafo no dodow rodɔɔ sõ no, ehwinhwin baa Hellenistfo no mu tsiaa Hebrewfo no, osiandɛ wobuu hɔn enyi guu hɔn ekunafo do wɔ daadaa som no mu.
Na duebien no frɛɛ esuafo kuw no nyina baa hɔn nkyɛn, na wɔsee dɛ ɔmmfata dɛ hɛn yɛbɛdan Nyankopɔn asɛm egya, na yɛakɔsom apon do.
Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, hom nhwehwɛ hom mu mbarimba beesuon a wɔwɔ dzin pa a Sunsum nye nyansa ahyɛ hɔn mã, na yenyi hɔn nsi edwuma yi do.
Na hɛndze, yɛbɛda ho esuo asɔryɛ nye asɛm no som mu dzen.

Na asɛm no sɔɔ dɔm no nyina enyi; na woyii Stephen, ɔbarimba a gyedzi nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ahyɛ no mã, nye Prochorus, nye Nicanor, nye Timon, nye Parmenas, nye Nicanor a ofir Antioch a ɔadan Jewnyi no;
hɔn na wɔdze hɔn gyinaa asomafo no enyim, na wɔsɔree dze hɔn nsa guu hɔn do.
Na Nyankopɔn asɛm dɔree, na esuafo no dodow yɛɛ pii wɔ Jerusalem, na asɔfo no so hɔn mu okuw kɛsenara maa gyedzi no aso.
Na Stephen a adom nye ahoɔdzen ahyɛ no mã, yɛɛ anwanwadze nye asɛnkyerɛdze akɛse wɔ ɔman no mu.
Na binom a wofi nhyiamudan a wɔfrɛ no Libertinefo nye Cyrenefo nye Aleɛandriafo nye hɔn a wofi Cilicia nye Asia dze no mu soɛre, nye Stephen gyee ekyingye.
Na woenntum enngyina nyansa nye Sunsum a ɔdze kasae no ano.
Nna wɔnye nyimpa bi dzii nkɔtɔkɔr ma wɔsee dɛ, yɛatse dɛ ɔkã ebususɛm tsia Moses nye Nyankopɔn.
Na wɔbɔɔ ɔman no nye mpanyimfo, nye kyerɛwfo no nkenyan, ma wɔbaa no do bɛkyeer no dze no kɔr bagua mu;
na wɔdze adasekrumfo begyinaa hɔ a wɔsee dɛ, nyimpa yi nngyaa dɛ ɔkasa tsia Krɔnkrɔn-bae yi nye mbra no.
Na yɛatse dɛ ɔkã dɛ Jesus Nazarethnyi yi bobutuw bea yi, na ɔasakyer amambra a Moses dze maa hɛn no.
Na hɔn a wɔtse bagua mu hɔ nyina dze hɔn enyiwa tsiim no do no, wohun n'enyim dɛ ɔtse dɛ ɔbɔfo enyim.
7: Na ɔsɔfopanyin no see dɛ, Ana yinom tse dɛm?
Na ɔsee dɛ,Enuanom nye egyanom, hom ntsie: Enyimnyam Nyankopɔn yii noho kyerɛɛ hɛn egya Abraham, ber a ɔwɔ Mesopotamia no, ansaana ɔrebɛtsena Haran,
na ɔsee no dɛ, fi w'asaase do nye w'ebusuafo mu, na bra asaase a mebɛkyerɛ wo no do.
Nna ofii Chaldeafo asaase no do bɛtsenaa Haran; na n'egya wu ekyir no, Nyankopɔn maa ofii hɔ bɛtsenaa asaase a hom tse do sesei yi do;
na ɔamma no egypadze wɔ mu, nnyɛ anamon mpo; na ɔbɔɔ no anohoba dɛ ɔdze bɛma ɔno nye n'asefo a woedzi n'ekyir ma aayɛ hɔndze: naaso nna onnyae nnyaa ba.
Na mbrɛ Nyankopɔn kãe nye dɛ n'asefo bɛyɛ ahɔho wɔ anan asaase do, na wɔdze hɔn ayɛ nkowaa, na wɔayɛ hɔn bɔn mfe ahaanan.
Na ɔman no a wɔbɔkɔ hɔn mu nkowaasom no, mubobu hɔn atsɛn, Nyankopɔn na ɔsee: Na n'ekyir no wobefi hɔ na wɔabɔsom me wɔ bea yi mu.
Na ɔmaa no twatsia ahyɛmudzi no; na ɔdze dɛm woo Isaac, na ne ndaawɔtwe no otwaa no twatsia; na Isaac woo Jacob, na Jacob woo egyanom mpayin no.
Na egyanom mpanyin no dze nyinkun tɔɔn Joseph kɔr Egypt; na Nyankopɔn nye no dzii n'ekyir,
na oyii no firr n'amandzehu nyina mu, Egypthen Pharaoh enyim, na ɔyɛɛ no otsitsir wɔ Egypt nye ne fie nyina do.
Na ɔkɔm sii Egypt nyina nye Canaan, nye amandzehu kɛse, na hɛn egyanom ennya eadziban.
Na Jacob tsee dɛ edziban wɔ Egypt no, ɔsomaa hɛn egyanom kan.
Na dza otsia ebien no, Joseph yii noho kyerɛɛ no nuanom no, na Pharaoh so bohun Joseph n'ebusuafo no.
Na Joseph somae ma wɔkɛfaa n'egya Jacob nye n'busuafo no baa ne nkyɛn.
Na Jacob kɔr Egypt; na ɔno nye hɛn egyyanom wuwui:
na wɔdze hɔn kɔr shechem, na wɔdze hɔn kɔtotoo nda a Abraham dze dwɛɛtɛɛ tɔɔ no wɔ Shechem Hamor mba no hɔ no mu.
Na anohoba a Nyankopɔn kãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ Abraham n'aber rudu no, ɔman no dɔree na wɔyɛɛ pii wɔ Egypt,
dze kodur dɛ Egypthen bi soɛree a onnyim Joseph.
Ɔno na ɔnye hɛn ebusua dzii no enyifir mu, na ɔyɛɛ hɛn egyanom bɔn, na ɔmaa wɔtotoow hɔn nkɔkowaba gui mma woeennya nkwa.
Na aber no ara mu na wɔwoo Moses, na no ho yɛɛ fɛw mɔ Nyankopɔn enyim; na wɔnyɛɛn no abosoom ebiasa we n'egya fie,
na wɔtoow no kyenee no, Pharaoh babaa kɛfaa no, na ɔnyɛɛn no dze yɛɛ ne ba.
Na wɔkyerɛɛ Moses Egyptfo nyansaa nyina, na ɔyɛɛ tumfo wɔ ne nsɛm nye ne ndzeyɛɛ nyina mu.
Na onyae dzii mfe eduanan no, ɔbaa n'akoma mu dɛ ɔbɔkɔ akɔhwɛ no nuanom Isrealmba no.
Na ohun bi a wɔreyɛ no bɔn no, ɔgyee ne tsir, na ɔtɔɔ nyia wɔrehyɛ no do no no wer kum Egyptnyi no;
na osusuu dɛ no nuanom tse ase dɛ Nyankopɔn nam ne nsa do rebɛgye hɔn: Na wɔanntse ase.
Na adze kyee no, obopuee hɔn do dɛ wɔrokõ, na ɔpɛɛ dɛ ɔka hɔn bɔ mu dɛ, mbarimba, hom yɛ enuanom: Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom reyɛ homho bɛn yi?
Na nyia ɔreyɛ ne nyɛnko bɔn no suun no dɛ, woana yɛɛ wo ɔpanyin nye ɔtsɛmbuafo wɔ hɛn do?
Epɛ dɛ iku me dɛ mbrɛ ikum Egyptnyi no ndeda no?
N aasɛm yi ntsi Moses guanee, na ɔkɛyɛɛ hɔho wɔ Midian asaase do, na ɔwoo mbabanyin beenu wɔ hɔ.
Na mfe eduanan durii no, Ewuradze bɔfoe yii noho kyerɛɛ no wɔ Sibai kokwaa ho sar no do, wɔ gyaframee a ofi haban bi mu.
Na Moses hunii no, ɔyɛɛ no nwanwa wɔ n'enyi do, na ɔtwee pinii dɛ ɔrokɔhwɛ no, Ewuradze ndze baa dɛ,
Emi nye w'egyanom Nyankopɔn, Abraham nye Isaac nye Jacob hɔn Nyankopɔn. Na Moses ho popoe na oennsi no bo annhwɛ.
Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, San w'anan nsokota: Na bea a igyina do yi yɛ asaase Krɔnkrɔn.
Ohu na mehu me man a ɔwɔ Egypt amandzehu, na matse hɔn apempen, na mesian dɛ merebɛgye hɔn: Na afei bra ma monsoma wo wɔ Egypt.
Moses yi ara a wɔpoow no dɛ, woana na ɔyɛɛ wo ɔpanyin nye ɔtsembuafo wɔ hɛn do no? Ɔnoara na Nyankopɔn nam bɔfo a oyii noho kyerɛɛ no haban mu no ne nsa do asoma no dɛ ɔpanyin nye ɔgyefo.
Oyi na ɔdze hɔn fiir edzi, yɛɛ anwanwadze nye asɛnkyerɛdze wɔ Egypt, nye Po Memen mu, nye sar no do mfe eduanan.
Oyi nye Moses a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ Isrealmba no dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi bi na Nyankopɔn bɛma ɔasoɛr ama hom wɔ hom enuanom mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔmaa me so.
Oyi nye nyia ɔwɔ asɔr a ɔwɔ sar no do no mu a ɔnye abɔfo a ɔkasaa hɛn egyanom wɔ hɔ, na onyaa nkwasɛm a nkwa wɔ mu dɛ ɔmfa mma hɛn no;
na hɛn egyanom ammpɛ dɛ wotsie no na wosuun no, na wɔdze hɔn akoma sanee kɔr Egypt,
see Aaron dɛ, yɛ hɛn enyame a wobedzi hɛn enyim, na Moses yi a ɔdze hɛn firr Egypt bae no dze, yennyim dza ayɛ no.
Na wɔyɛɛ nantwiba wɔ nda no mu, na wɔbɔɔ afɔr maa honyi no na wodzii ehurusi wɔ hɔn nsaano edwuma ho.
Na Nyankopɔn danee, na ɔdze hɔn maa dɛ wɔnsom ɔsor dɔm, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ nkɔnhyɛfo nwoma no mu dɛ, Isreal fifo, aso hom bɔɔ okumafɔr na afɔr horow maa me Mfe eduanan wɔ sar no do?
Na mbom hom faa Moloch ntamadan, nye ɔbosom Rephan nworaba, Ehonyi a hom yɛɛ dɛ hom bɔsom hɔn; Na mobɔsoa hom akɔ Babylon ekyir noho.
Hɛn egyanom nyaa adasehyɛ ntamadan no wɔ sar no do, dɛ mbrɛ nyia ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ Moses no hyɛɛ dɛ ɔnyɛ no dɛ mbrɛ nsusudo a ohunii no tse.
Ɔno so na hɛn egyanom, hɔn afamu, wɔfaa amanaman a Nyankopɔn paamu hɔn fii hɛn egyanom enyim no yɛɛ hɔndze no, wɔnye Joshua dze baa mu, dze besi David nda do;
ɔno na onyaa Nyankopɔn enyim adom, na ɔserɛɛ dɛ obenya tsenabew ama Jacob Nyankopɔn.
Na solomon sii dan maa no.
Naaso nyia ɔwɔ sorsor no ɔnntse dza nsa ayɛ mu; dɛ mbrɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi no kã dɛ,
Ɔsor nye m'ahengua, na asaase nye m'anandzegua: Ɔdan bɛn na hom besi ama me? Ewuradze na ɔse, anaadɛ henfa nye m'ahomgyebea?
Ana nnyɛ me nsa na ɔyɛɛ yinom nyina?
Hom akɔnkyefo a wonntwaa hom tsia wɔ akoma nye asomu, daa hom siw Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no kwan: Mbrɛ hom egyanom yɛe, mbrɛ hom so yɛ nye no.
Nkɔnhyɛfo no mu woana na hom egyanom ennhiahia no ho? Na wokum hɔn a wodzii kan kãa ɔtseneneenyi no ne mbae; ɔno na hom ayɛ no ho yimafo nye ewudzifo;
hom a hom gyee mbra no dɛ abɔfo ahyɛdze, na hom enndzi do.
Na wɔtsee yinom no, otwitwaa hɔn wɔ akoma mu, na wɔtwɛɛr hɔn sē guu no do.
Na ɔnodze, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ahyɛ no mã no, ɔhwɛɛ sor hann, na ohun Nyankopɔn n'enyimnyam, nye Jesus dɛ ogyina Nyankopɔn enyimfa,
na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, muhu dɛ ɔsor ebue, na nyimpa Ba no gyina Nyankopɔn enyimfa.
Na wɔdze ndze kɛse tsēatseaa mu, na wosisiiw hɔn aso, wɔdze adwenkor kotui hyɛɛ no do;
Na woyii no edzi fiir kurow no mu kesiiw no abo: Na adasefo no dze hɔn ntar guu aberantsɛ bi a wɔfrɛ no Saul n'ananadze.
Na worisiw Stephen abo no, ɔfrɛɛ dɛ, Ewuradze Jesus, gye mu sunsum.
Na obuu ntwɛr, na ɔdze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu dɛ, Ewuradze, mma mmfa bɔn yi nnto hɔn do. Na ɔkãa yi no, ɔtɔɔ nda.
8: Na Saul so peen no ku no do. na da no ahohiahia kɛse baa asɔr a ɔwɔ Jerusalem no do; na hɔn nyina petsee kɔr Judæa nye Samaria asaase do, gyedɛ asomafo no nko.
Na mbarimba nyamesurofo siee Stephen, na wosūu no pii.
Na Saul dze, ɔbɔɔ asɔrmba no ntanenyi hɛnhɛɛn efiefi twetwee mbarimba nye mbaa, ma wɔdze hɔn koguu efiadze.
Na hɔn a wɔpetsee no kekyinii kɛkãa asɛmpa no.
Na Philip kɔr Samaria kurow mu kɛkãa Christ ho asɛm kyerɛɛ hɔn,
Na nyimpadodow yɛɛ adwen kor maa aso wɔ nsɛm a Philip kãa kyerɛɛ hɔn no do, wɔstee, na wohun nsɛnkyerɛdze a ɔyɛe no.
Na esunsum fi a wɔwɔ dodowara mu dze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu fiir edzi, na mbubuifo nye mbubua pii so wɔna mbubuifo nye mbubua pii so wɔyɛɛ hɔn edur.
Na dɛw kɛse baa kurow no mu hɔ.
Ma ɔbarimba a ne dzin dze Simon wɔ kurow no mu a kan no odzi esumansɛm, na ɔmaa Samariaman no ho boow hɔn, na ɔyɛɛ noho dɛ obi a ɔyɛ kɛse bi:
Ɔno na hɔn nyina, fir nketseaba do kɛpem akɛse do maa no aso see dɛ, Oyi nye Nyankopɔn ahoɔdzen a wɔfrɛ no Kɛse no.
Na wɔmaa no aso osiandɛ ɔdze esumansɛm maa hɔn ho boow hɔn akyɛr.
Na wɔgyee Philip a ɔkãa Nyankopɔn ahenman nye Jesus Christ ne dzin ho asɛmpa no dzii no, mbarimba nye mbaa so wonumaa hɔn.
Na Simon nankasa gyee dzii, na wonumaa no no, ɔdze noho bɔɔ Philip ho, na ohun asɛnkyerɛdze nye tum ndwuma kɛse a wɔyɛe no, ɔyɛɛ no ahobow.
Na asomafo a wɔwɔ Jerusalem tsee dɛ Samaria agye Nyankopɔn asɛm no, wɔsomaa Peter nye John wɔ hɔn nkyɛn;
na wɔbae no, wɔsɔree maa hɔn dɛ wonnya Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn:
osiandɛ onnyae mmbaa hɔn mu biara do, na enuma ara nko na woenuma hɔn ahyɛ Ewuradze Jesus dzin mu.
Nna wɔdze hɔn nsa guu hɔn do, na wonyaa Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn.
Na Simon hun dɛ ɔnam asomafo no nsa a wɔdzew guu do no do na wɔdze Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn rema no, ɔdze sika brɛɛ hɔn dɛ,
Hom mma me so tum yi bi, ma obiara a medze nsa bogu no do no, oeenya Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn.
Na Peter see no dɛ, wo sika nye wo nhera, osiandɛ isusuu dɛ Nyankopɔn akyɛdze wɔdze sika nya.
Innyi kyɛfa anaa egyapadze wɔ asɛm yi mu, osiandɛ w'akoma nntsen wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Dɛm ntsi, nu woho wɔ wo bɔn yi ho, na kotow serɛ Nyankopɔn kyerɛdɛ wɔdze w'akoma adwen bɛkyɛ wo.
Na mehu dɛ ewɔ bɔwen wenwen, nye emumuyɛ nkyehoma mu.
Na Simon buae see dɛ, Hom nserɛ Ewuradze mma me mma dza hom akã yi mu biara aammba mo do.
Na hɔndze, wɔgyee dase na wɔkãa Ewuradze asɛm no wɔsanee wɔ Samariafo nkuroba pii mu.
Na Ewuradze bɔfoe kasaa kyerɛɛ Philip dɛ, soɛr, no kɔ pomu afamu kwan a ofi Jerusalem sian kɔ afamu kwan a ofi Jerusalem sian kɔ Gaza no a ɔyɛ sar no do.
Na ɔsoɛree kɔree; na hwɛ, ɔbarimba Ethiopianyi, ɔsaa tumfo a ɔyɛ Ethiopiafo ɔhembaa Candace pianyi a ɔhwɛ ne sikakorabea nyina do nye yi, ɔaba Jerusalem abɔsɔr;
na ɔresan akɔ, na ɔtse ne tseaseanam mu rekenkan nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah no.
Na Sunsum no see Philip dɛ, twe bɛn, na fa woho kɔbɔ tseaseanam yi ho.
Na Philip tutuu mbirika kɔr ne nkyɛn, na ɔtsee dɛ ɔrekenkan nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah, na obisaa no dɛ, Ana etse dza erekenkan yi ase?
Na ɔsee no dɛ, mebɛyɛ dɛn etum, gyedɛ obi kyerɛ me kwan? Na ɔserɛɛ Philip dɛ ɔmfow mbɛtsena ne nkyɛn.
Na kyerɛw no mu beebi mbrɛ ɔrekenkan nye yi: Wɔdze no dɛ oguantsen kɔr ekumii; na dɛ mbrɛ eguambaa tɔ ne yifo enyim mmum, dɛmara na ommbue n'ano;
N'ahobrɛadze mu woyii n'atsɛmbu: N'ebusuasantsen woana na ɔbɛkã? Osiandɛ woeyi no nkwa efi asaase do.
Na ɔsaa no buae see Philip dɛ, meserɛ wo, woana ho asɛm na nkɔnhyɛnyi no rekã yi? Nankasa ho anaa obi ho a?
Na Philip buee n'ano, na ofi kyerɛw no ara do kãa Jesus ho asɛmpa kyerɛɛ no.
Na wɔrokɔ hɔn kwan no, wodur nsu bi do; na ɔsaa no see dɛ, hwɛ, nsu nye yi: Ebɛnadze na osiw m'enuma ho kwan?
Na Philip see dɛ, sɛ edze w'akoma nyina gye dzi a, ewɔ ho kwan. Na obuaa dɛ, megye midzi dɛ Jesus Christ yɛ Nyankopɔn ne ba?
Na ɔhyɛe ma tseaseanam no gyinae, na hɔn beenu nyina sianee kɔr nsu no mu, Philip nye ɔsaa no, na onumaa no.
Na wo fiinsu no hwiim Philip, na ɔsaa no ennhu no bio. Na ɔdze dɛw kɔr no kwan.
Na Philip dze, wohun no wɔ Azotus; na orutwa mu no, ɔkãa asɛmpa no wɔ nkurow nyina mu, dze bɛpeem dɛ odur Cæsarea.
9: Na Saul ɔda ho ara rugu mpuw nye okum ahom gu Ewuardze esuafo no do no, ɔkɔr ɔsɔfopanyin ne nkyɛn,
na okebisaa no hɔ nwoma dɛ ɔdze rokɔ Damascus akɔ nhyiamudan no mu, ma sɛ ohu binom a wɔwɔ ɔkwan no mu a, mbarimba o, mbaa o, ɔdze hɔn nkyehoma mu aaba Jerusalem.
Na ɔnam no ɔbɛbɛɛn Damascus, na awerɛfir mu kan fiir sor bɛhyerɛnee twaa no ho hyiae;
na ɔhwee daadze, na ɔtse ndze bi a ɔsee no dɛ, Saul Saul ɔyɛ dɛn na etaa mo do yi?
Na ɔsee dɛ, woana nye wo, Ewuradze? Na ɔsee dɛ, emi nye Jesus a etaa no do no:
na soɛr kɔ kurow no mu, na wɔbɛkã dza ɔsɛ wo dɛ eyɛ akyerɛ wo.
Na mbarimba a wɔnye no nam no totɔɔ mmum gyinagyinaa hɔ, wɔtsee ndze dze, naaso woennhu obiara.
Na Saul soɛree fii famu, na n'enyiwa tsetsewee no, oennhu obiara, na wɔdzedze no nsa dze no baa Damascus.
Na ndaansa na onnhu adze, eso onndzidzi na ɔnnom.
Na osuanyi bi wɔ Damascus a ne dzin dze Ananias; ɔno na Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ no wɔ enyidoadzehu mu dɛ, Ananias. Na ɔsee dɛ hwɛ, emi nye yi, Ewuradze.
Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, Soɛr kɔ ɔbrɔn a wɔfrɛ no Tɔɔtsenn no mu, na kebisa wɔ Judas fie obi a ne dzin dze Saul a ofi Tarsus no n'ekyir kwan, na hwɛ, ɔrosɔr,
na oehu n'enyiwa do dɛ ɔbarimba a ne dzin dze Ananias reba ne nkyɛn, na ɔdze ne nsa ato no do dɛ onhu adze.
Na Ananias buaa dɛ, Ewuradze, matse ɔbarimba yi ho asɛm wɔ nyimpa pii anomu, bɔn dodow a ɔdze ayɛ w'ahotsewfo no wɔ Jerusalem;
na ha yi so ɔwɔ tum wɔ asɔfompanyin no nsamu dɛ ɔnkyer hɔn a wɔbɔ wo dzin nyina.
Na Ewuaradze see no dɛ, kɔ ara, na oyi nye adze a meyi no dɛ ɔnsoa me dzin nkɔ amanaman nye ahemfo, nye Isrealmba enyim;
na mebɛkyerɛ no amandze pii a otwar dɛ ohu wɔ me dzin ntsi.

Na Ananias kɔree, na ɔkɛhɛɛn ofi no mu, na ɔdze ne nsa too no do see no dɛ, Onua Saul, Ewuradze Jesus a oyii noho kyerɛɛ wo wɔ ɔkwan a enam do reba no mu no, ɔasoma me dɛ hu adze, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn nhyɛ wo mã.
Na ntszɛmara na biribi tse dɛ abon fii n'enyiwa do gui, na ohun adze; na ɔsoɛree ma wonumaa no;
na ɔgyee edziban dzii ma no ho yɛɛ no dzen. Na odzii esuafo a wɔwɔ Damascus no nkyɛn nda kakra.
Na ntsɛmara ɔkãa Jesus ho asɛm wɔ nhyiamudan no mu dɛ ɔno yɛ Nyankopɔn Ba.
Na hɔn a wɔtsee nyina hɔn ho boow hɔn, na wɔsee dɛ, ana nnyɛ oyi nye nyia ɔsɛɛ hɔn a wɔbɔ dzin yi wɔ Jerusalem no, na iyi ntsi na ɔbaa ha dɛ ɔrebɛfa hɔn nkyehoma mu akɛma asɔfompanyin no bi?
Na mbom Saul n'ahoɔdzen dɔɔ sõ kɛse, na ɔmaa Jewfo a wɔwɔ Damascus ho hyehyee hɔn, na ɔkyerɛɛ mu kofee dɛ oyi nye Christ no ara.
Na nda pii durii no Jewfo no paam ne tsir do dɛ woboku;
na hɔn apam no Saul tsee. Na wɔweɔn mbobow no ano ewia nye anago dɛ woboku no;
na n'esuafo no faa no anago dze no too birefi mu duaa fasu mu gyaagyaa no too famu.
Na odur Jerusalem no, ɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ ɔdze noho kɔbɔ esuafo no ho; na hɔn nyina suroo no, na wɔanngye enndzi dɛ ɔyɛ osuanyi.
Na Barnabas faa no dze no kɔr asomafo no nkyɛn, na ɔkyerɛɛmu kyerɛɛ hɔn mbrɛ ohun Ewuradze wɔ kwan no mu, na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ no, na mbrɛ ɔnam Jesus dzin mu kãa asɛm ndamdo wɔ Damascus.
Na ɔnye hɔn dzii ndɔfir wɔ Jerusalem,
Na ɔdze ndam kãa asɛm wɔ Ewuradze dzin mu; na ɔnye Hellenistfo no kasae na wɔgyee ekyingye; na wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ woku no.
Na enuanom no tsee no, wɔdze no kɔr Cæsarea, na wɔsomaa no fii hɔ kɔr Tarsus.
Nna asɔrman a ɔwɔ Judæa nye Galilee nye Samaria nyina nyaa asomdwee, na wonyaa ntowdo na wɔnam Ewuradze no suro nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no awerɛkyekyer do dɔree.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Peter rikyin hɔn nyina do no, ɔbaa ahotsewfo a wɔwɔ Lydda no so nkyɛn.
Na obohun hɔ nyimpa bi a ne dzin dze Eneas a ɔada ne kɛtɛ do mfe awɔtwe a ɔyar mbubui.
Na Peter rikyin hɔn nyina do no, ɔbaa ahotsewfo a wɔwɔ Lydda no so nkyɛn.
Na hɔn a wɔwɔ Lydda nye Sharon nyina hun no, na wɔdanee baa Ewuradze hɔ.
Na osuanyi bi wɔ Joppa a ne dzin dze Tabitha a ne nkyerɛase nye Dorcas (ɔdabɔ): Ɔbaa yi na ndwuma pa nye adɔyɛ a ɔyɛe ahyɛ no ma.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu ɔyaree na owui; na wowiee no eguar no wɔdze no kɔtoo sordan bi mu.
Na Lydda bɛn Jopppa ntsi, esuafo no tsee dɛ Peter wɔ hɔ no, wɔsomma mbarimba beenu wɔ no hɔ bɛserɛɛ no dɛ, mma nnyɛ ekyim dɛ ebɛba hɛn nkyɛn.
Na Peter soɛree nye hɔn kɔree. Na odurii no, wɔdze no kɔr sordan no mu, na ekunafo no nyina begyinaa ne nkyɛn rusū na wɔdze ntar nye atam a Dorcas nye hɔn wɔ hɔ no ɔyɛe no rekyerɛ no.
Na Peter yii hɔn nyina edzi, na obuu ntwɛr sɔree; na ɔdaan noho baa fun no do see dɛ, Tabitha, soɛr. Na ɔtseew n'enyiwa na ohun Peter no, ɔsoɛree tsenaa famu.
Na ɔdze ne nsa maa no, na ɔmaa no do, na ɔfrɛɛ ahotsewfo no nye ekunafo no dze no enyikan kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na wɔtsee no wɔ Joppa nyina, na dodowara gyee Ewuradze dzii.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔtsenaa Joppa nda dodow wɔ Simon nwomahyɛfo bi nkyɛn.
10: Na ɔbarimba bi wɔ Cæsarae a ne dzin dze Cornelius, ɔyɛ ɔhamupanyin wɔ asafo a wɔfrɛ no Italiafo dze no mu,
nyimpa nyamesuronyi a ɔye ne fifo nyina suro Nyankopɔn na ɔyɛ adɔyɛ pii ma nkorɔfo no, na ɔyɛ nkotoserɛ asɔr ma Nyankopɔn daa.
Na ohun n'enyido-adze petee bɛyɛ dɔn a otsiã akron no mu dɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoe baa ne nkyɛn na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, Cornelius.
Na ɔhwɛɛ no hann no, na hu kãa no no, ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, ebɛnadze a? Na ɔsee no dɛ, wo mpaabɔ nye w'adɔyɛ no aba sor abɛyɛ nkaa wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na afei soma mbarimba ma wɔnkɔ Joppa nkehyia Siman a wɔfrɛ no Peter no:
ɔsoɛ Simon a ɔyɛ nwomahyɛfo bi a ne fie wɔ mpoano.
Na bɔfo no a ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ no kɔree no, ɔfrɛɛ ne fienyimpa beenu nye sordaanyi nyamesuronyi bi a ofi hɔn a wɔsom no daa no mu.
Na ɔkãa ne nyina kyerɛɛ hɔn no, ɔsomaa hɔn wɔ Joppa.
Na adze kyee no, na wɔnam kwan do rebɛn kurow no, Peter kɔr sor asantsifi kɔsɔree, bɛyɛ dɔn a otsia esia no mu;
na ɔkɔm dzee no, na ɔpɛɛ dɛ odzidzi: na worisiesie no ne kra tɔɔ gon.
Na ohun dɛ sor ebue, na adze bi fir sor risian ɔtse dɛ abradaa kɛse a wɔakyerkyer no etwaaanan, na worigyaa mu to famu:
no mu na asaase mbowa a wotsia ntwɛrnan, nye hɔn a wɔweawea, nye wimu ntumbowa nyina bi wɔ.
Na ndze bi baa no hɔ dɛ, Peter, soɛr: Ku dzi.
Na Peter see dɛ, dabida, Ewuradze, osiandɛ minndzii biribi a ɔyɛ ekyiwadze anaadɛ no ho nntsew da
Na ndze no baa no hɔ bio ne mprɛnu dɛ, dza Nyankopɔn asan ho no, mma mmfrɛ no ekyirwadze.
Na wɔyɛɛ yi mprɛnsa, na wɔfaa adze no kɔr sor bio.
Na Peter regye no mu ekyingye dɛ n'enyido-adze a ohunii no nye dɛn no, hwɛ, mbarimba a Cornelius somaa hɔn no ebisabisa Simon fie kwan ebegyinagyina abowano
refrɛ, na woribisa dɛ Simon a wɔfrɛ no Peter soɛ hɔ anaa.
Na Peter rodwendwen enyido-adzehu noho no, Sunsum no see no dɛ, hwɛ, mbarimba baasa rohwehwɛ wo.
Na soɛr sian nye hɔn nkɔ, mma ɔnnyɛ wo konsee, na mara masoma hɔn.
Na Peter sianee kɔr mbarimba no nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, emi nye nyia hom rohwehwɛ no no: Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom bae?
Na wɔsee dɛ, ɔhamupanyin Cornelius, ɔbarimba tsenee a osuro Nyankopɔn, na ɔwɔ dzin pa wɔ Jewfo man nyina mu no, na bɔfo Krɔnkrɔn beyii kyerɛɛ no dɛ ombehyia wo nkɔ ne fie, ma onketsie w'anomu nsɛm.
Na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn baa dan mu, na ɔsoom hɔn hɔho. Na adze kyee no Peter nye hɔn fii hɔ kɔree, na enuanom a wofi Joppa no bi kegyaa no.
Na adze kyee no wodur Cæsarea. Na Cornelius rotweɔn hɔn, na ɔafrɛ n'ebusuafo nye ne mfɛfo a wɔbɛn aboa ano.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Peter rehɛn mu no, nna Cornelius kehyiaa no hwee n'ananadze kotoow no.
Na Peter maa no do see no dɛ, soɛr: Na mo so meyɛ nyimpa.
Na ɔnye no rekasa no, ɔkɔr mu kohun nyimpa pii a woehyia;
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nyim mbrɛ Jewnyi nnyi ho kwan dɛ ɔdze noho kɔbɔ ɔnanaben ho, anaadɛ ɔkɔ ne nkyɛn; na Nyankopɔn akyerɛ me dɛ mma memmfrɛ nyimpa biara ekyiwadze anaadɛ no ho nntsew:
Ntsi na hom somae ma wobehyiaa me no, mennyiyi ano, na maba yi. Nkyii mibisa hom asɛm kor a osian ntsi ma hom behyiaa me.
Na Cornelius see dɛ, Ndaanan nye yi na mubodur dɔn yi mu rosɔr wɔ me fie ɔnye asɔr a wɔyɛ no dɔn a otsia akron no, na hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi beginaa m'enyim hyɛ atar fitaa,
na ɔsee dɛ, Cornelius, wɔatse w'asɔr na wɔakaa w'adɔyɛ no wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Dɛm ntsi soma ma wɔnkɔ Joppa nkehyia Simon a wɔfrɛ no so dɛ Peter: ɔsoɛ Simon nwomahyɛfo no fie wɔ mpoano.
Dɛm ntsi ntsɛmara mosomae ma wɔbaa wo nkyɛn; na wo so ayɛ no yie dɛ aba. Ntsi nkyii hɛn nyian ehyia wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim ha dɛ yeribetsie dza Nyankopɔn ahyɛ wo nyina.
Na Peter buee n;ano see dɛ, nokwar ara mehu dɛ Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ nyimpa enyim:
na mbom ɔman biara mu nyia osuro no na ɔyɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee no, ɔpɛ dɛ ɔgya no.
Asɛm no a ɔsomae brɛɛ Israelmba ma ɔkãa asomdwee a ɔnam Jesus Christ do ho asɛmpa no (ɔno nye nyimpa nyina wura)
homara hom nyim asɛm a wɔdze tahyee Judæa nyina a ɔhyɛɛ ase wɔ Galilee wɔ enuma a John kãe no ekyir:
Mekyerɛ Jesus a ofi Nazareth, mbrɛ Nyankopɔn dze Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn nye ahoɔdzen seraa no, na okyinii yɛɛ yie, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn a abɔnsam dzi hɔn do tum no nyinaa edur osiandɛ Nyankopɔn ka no ho,
Na hɛn nye adasefo wɔ ndzɛmba a ɔyɛe wɔ Jewfo asaase do nye Jerusalem mu no ho; ɔno so na wɔsɛɛn no wɔ dua do kum no.
Na Nyankopɔn nyaan no da a otsia ebiasa no mu, na oyii no kyerɛɛ petee,
nnyɛ ɔman no nyina a, na dasefo a Nyankopɔn eyi ato hɔ dada no a, hɛn a ɔsoɛree fii ewufo mu no ekyir no yɛnye no dzidzii nomee no.
Na ɔhyɛɛ hɛn dɛ yɛnkã nkyerɛ ɔman no, na yendzi dase dɛ ɔno nye nyia Nyankopɔn ahyɛ no atseasefo nye ewufo ɔtsɛmbuafo.
Ɔno na nkɔnhyɛfo nyina dzi no dase dɛ obiara a ɔbegye no edzi no ɔnam no dzin mu benya bɔnfakyɛ.
Na Peter da do rekã nsɛm yi no, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no boguu hɔn a wɔtsee asɛm no nyina do.
Na agyedzifo a wofi etwatsiafo no mu a wɔnye Peter bae no, hɛn ho boow hɔn dɛ woehue Sunsum krɔnkrɔn no akyɛdze no egu amanamanmba so do.
Na wɔtsee dɛ wɔrekasa kasa fofor, na woriyi Nyankopɔn ayɛw. Nna Peter buae see dɛ,
Aso obi botum esiw nsu ho kwan dɛ wonnkonuma yinom a woenya Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no dɛ hɛnara so yi?
Na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wonnuma hɔn wɔ Jesus Christ ne dzin mu. Nna wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔntsena hɔn nkyɛn nda kakra.
11: Na asomafo nye enuanom a wɔwɔ Judæa no tsee dɛ amanamamfo so agye Nyankopɔn asɛm no.
Na Peter baa Jerusalem no, hɔn a wofi etwatsiafo mu no nye no kasakasaa dɛ,
ɔwo akɔ mbarimba a wɔnnyɛ etwatsiafo mu, na nye hɔn ekedzidzi.
Na Peter hyɛɛ asɛm no ase kãa no esiado kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ,
Mowɔ Joppa kurow mu rosɔr, na me kra tɔɔ gon no, muhuu m'enyido-adze, adze bi a orisian a ɔtse dɛ abradaa kɛse a wɔakyerkyer no etwaanan rigyaa mu fi sor, na ɔbaa me nkyɛn;
na megyeen m'enyi mohwɛɛ mu no, muhun asaase mbowa a wotsia ntwernan nye hambowa nye hɔn a wɔweawea nye wimu ntumbowa nyina wɔ mu.
Na metsee ndze bi a ɔsee me dɛ, Peter, soɛr: Ku dzi.
Na mesee dɛ, Dabida, Ewuradze: Osiandɛ biribiara a ɔyɛ ekyirwadze anaadɛ no ho nntsew nnkɔr m'anomu da.
Na ndze no fi sor buaa ne mprɛnu dɛ, dza Nyankopɔn asan ho no, mma mmfrɛ no ekyiwadze.
Na yi wɔyɛɛ no mprɛnsa, na wɔtwetwee ne nyina kɔr sor bio.
Na hwɛ, amonmu hɔ ara na mbarimba baasa aba ofi a yɛwɔ mu no ano a wɔsomaa hɔn fii Cæsarea baa me nkyɛn.
Na Sunsum no see me dɛ menye hɔn nkɔ, na mma mennyɛ nyinyi mu. Eso enuanom beesia yi kegyaa me, na yɛkɛhɛɛn ɔbarimba ne fi mu;
na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɛn mbrɛ ohun ɔbɔfo no wɔ ne fie, dɛ ogyina hɔ rese no dɛ, soma nyimpa kɔ Joppa kehyia Simon a wɔfrɛ no Peter so:
Ɔno na ɔbɛkã wo nsɛm a ɔwɔ nye w'efifo nyina nam do benya nkwa.
Na Mehyɛɛ ase rekasa no, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no boguu hɔn do dɛ mbrɛ ahyɛse no oguu hɛn so do.
Na mekãa Ewuradze asɛm a ɔkãa dɛ, John dze, ɔdze nsu numae; na homdze, wɔdze Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn bonuma hom.
Dɛm ntsi, sɛ Nyankopɔn akyɛ hɔn akyɛdze kor no ara dɛ hɛn so a yɛgyee Ewuradze Jesus Christ dzii no a, emi nye woana na mubotum mesiw Nyankopɔn kwan?
Na wɔtsee yinom no, wɔyɛɛ komm, na wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam see dɛ, nna Nyankopɔn ama amanamanmba so nnuho a ɔdze kɔ nkwa mu.
Na hɔn a ahohia a ɔbaa Stephen do no ntsi wɔpetsee no, wokyinii kodur Phœnicia nye cyprus nye Antioch, na wɔannkã asɛm no annkyerɛ obiara dɛ Jewfo nko.
Na hɔn mu binom yɛ Cyprusfo nye Cyernefo; hɔn a wɔbaa Antioch no, wɔkasaa kyerɛɛ greekfo no so kãa Ewuradze Jesus ho asɛmpa no.
Na Ewuarzdene nsa nye hɔn nam, na nyimpa pii a wɔgyee dzii no wɔdanee baa Ewuradze hɔ.
Na yinom ho nsɛm dur asɔr a ɔwɔ Jerusalem asomu, na wɔsomaa Barnabas dɛ onkekyin nkodu Antioch;
ɔno na ɔbae, na obohun Nyankopɔn adom no, n'enyi gyee, na otuu hɔn nyina fo dɛ wɔmfa akoma mu sua ntakyer Ewuradze ho:
osiandɛ ɔyɛ nyimpa pa, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn nye gyedzi ahyɛ no mã; na nyimpadodow pii bɛkaa Ewuradze ho.
Na ofii hɔ kɔr tarsus kɔhwehwɛɛ Saul,
na ohun no no, ɔdze no baa Antioch. Na ɔbaa dɛ wɔnye asɔrmba no dzii ehyia ara afrenhyia, na wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ nyimpadodow pii. Na esuafo no wodzii kan too hɔn Christianfo wɔ Antioch.
Na nda no mu no nkɔnhyɛfo fii Jerusalem baa Antioch.
Na hɔn mu kor a ne dzin dze Agabus gyinae nam Sunsum no do kyerɛɛ dɛ ɔkɔm kɛse bi rebɛba asaase nyina do: Ɔno na ɔbae wɔ Claudius ber do.
Na esuafo no, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu biara botum no, wɔbɔɔ hɔn tsirmu dɛ wɔdze biribi bɔmona enuanom a wɔtse Judæa dze akɔhwɛ hɔn:
Ɔno na wɔyɛe, na wɔnam Barnabas nye Saul nsa do dze kɛmaa mpanyimfo no.
12: Na ber no mu Herod ɔhen no tseen ne nsa hiahiaa asɔrmba no binom ho.
Na ɔdze afõwa kum James, John no nua no.
Na ohun dɛ ɔyɛɛ Jewfo enyi do fɛw no ntsi, ɔtoaa do kɛfaa Peter so: na ɔyɛ epitsi nda.
Na ɔkyeer no no, ɔdze no kɔtoo efiadze, na ɔdze no hyɛɛ nsordaafo anan horow anan nsa dɛ wɔnweɔn no, na ɔdween dɛ apaho afahyɛ no ekyir obeyi no abrɛ ɔman no.
Dɛm ntsi wɔdze Peter kesiee efiadze hɔ dze, naaso asɔrmba no yɛɛ asɔr enyiberdo ara maa Nyankopɔn maa no.
Na Herod ribeyi no akɔ no, anago na ara Peter daa nsordaafo beenu ntamu, wɔdze nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn ebien ato no: Na aweɔmfo gyinagyina abowano roweɔn efiadze no.
Na hwɛ, Ewuradze bɔfoe baa ne nkyɛn na kan hyerɛɛn efiadzedan no mu, na ɔbɔɔ Peter ne nkyɛnmu nyaan no see dɛ, soɛr ntsɛm. Na no nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no fii ne nsa gui.
Na ɔbɔfo no see no dɛ, bɔ woho do, na kyerkyer wo mpaboa. Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm. Na ɔsee no dɛ, fura wo tam yie na ka mo do.
Na ofir edzi kaa no do, na onnyim dɛ dza ɔbɔfo no yɛe no yɛ nokwar, na ɔdween dɛ ohun n'enyido-adze.
Na wɔtraa aweɔmfo no a wodzi kan, nye dza otsia ebien no, wɔbaa dadze abow a ɔdze kɔ kurow no mu ho, na noara buie maa hɔn, na wofir edzi na wɔtraa ɔbrɔn kor, na ntsɛmara ɔbɔfo no gyaa no hɔ.
Na Peter n'enyi baa no ho do no, ɔsee dɛ, afei na mehu ampa dɛ Ewuradze asoma no bɔfoe na oeyi me efi Herod nsamu, nye dza Jewfo man hɔn enyiwa da kwan nyina mu.
Na ɔdween ho no, ɔbaa John a wɔfrɛɛ no Mark so no ne nã Mary fie, mbrɛ dodwara aboa ano rosɔr.
Na ɔbɔɔ abowano pon no mu no, abaawa bi a ne dzin dze Rhoda bae betsiei;
na ɔtsee Peter ndze no, dɛw ntsi oemmbue abow no, na otutuu mbirika kɔr mu kɛkãa dɛ Peter gyinaa abow ekyir.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, ɔwo egyim. Na ɔdaa ho ara kãa dɛ ɔtse dɛm. Na wɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ no bɔfoe.
Na Peter daa ho ara bɔɔ mu; na wobuei no, wohun no, na hɔn ho boow hɔn.
Na ɔdze ne nsa paa hɔn do dɛ wommua hɔn ano, na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn mbrɛ Ewuradze duae yii no fii efiadze no; na ɔsee dɛ, hom nkɛkã nsɛm yi nkyerɛ James nye enuanom no. Na ofii hɔ kɔr beebi.
Na adze kyee no, wentwiwentwi nnyɛ kumaabi na ɔbaa nsordaafo no mu dɛ, ebɛn ara na ayɛ Peter.
Na Herod hwehwɛɛ no, na oennhu no no, ɔpɛɛ nsordaafo no mu, na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wonkoku hɔn. Na ofii Judæa kɔr Cæsarea kɛtsenaa hɔ.
Na Herod nyaa Tyrefo nye Sidonfo ebufuw; na wɔyɛɛ adwenkor baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔbɛfaa ɔhen pianyi Blastus adamfo no, wɔbɛserɛɛ amandwee, osiandɛ hɔn asaase wofi ɔhen dze do nyɛn no.
Na da bi a ɔhyɛɛ no, Herod hyɛɛ n'ahentar na ɔtsenaa asɛndzii egua do, na ɔkãa asɛm kyerɛɛ ɔman no.
Na ɔman no bɔɔ ose dɛ, Nyame bi ndze nye yi, na nnyɛ nyimpa dze bi a.
Na ntsɛmara Ewuradze bɔfoe bɔbɔɔ no, osiandɛ ɔammfa enyimmyam amma Nyankopɔn: Na nsaamaa dzii no honam ma owui.
Na Nyankopɔn asɛm nyinii, na ɔtserɛwee.
Na Barnabas nye Saul wiee hɔn som no, wɔsanee fii Jerusalem na wɔfaa John a wɔtoo no Mark so no kaa hɔn ho.
13: Na asɔr a ɔwɔ Antioch no, nkɔnhyɛfo nye akyerɛkyerɛfo bi wɔ mu, hɔn nye Barnabas nye symeon a wɔfrɛ no Niger (obibinyi) nye Lucius Cyrenenyi no nye Manaen ɔnye ɔmansinhen Herod nuum enumfo kor no, nye Saul.
Na wɔrosom Ewuradze, na woridzi mbuada no, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no see dɛ, hom nyi Barnabas nye Saul mma me ma wɔnkɛyɛ edwuma a osian ntsi ma mfrɛ hɔn no.
Nna wodzi mbuada, na wɔsɔree dze hɔn nsa guu hɔn do, na wogyaa hɔn kwan.
Na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no somaa hɔn dɛm no, wosii mu kɔr Seleucia, na wofii hɔ nam hɛn mu kɔr Cyprus.
Na wodur Salamis no, wɔkãa Nyankopɔn asɛm wɔ Jewfo nhyiamudan mu; na wobyaa John so dɛ hɔn somfo.
Na wotwaa mu wɔ supɔw no mu kodur Paphos no, wokohun osumannyi nkɔnhyɛnyi torfo, Jewnyi bi a ne dzin dze Bar-Jesus a
ɔwɔ ambrado Seguis Paulus a ɔyɛ ɔbadwembafo no nkyɛn. Ɔno na ɔfrɛɛ Barnasbas nye Saul, na ɔpɛɛ dɛ otsie Nyankopɔn asɛm.
Na Elymas osumannyi no (mbrɛ ne dzin ase tse no) siiw hɔn kwan, na ɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ ɔdan ambrado no fi gyedzi no ho.
Na Saul a wɔfrɛ no Paul so no a Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ahyɛ no mã no, dze n'enyi tsiim no do,
na ɔsee dɛ, Wo a ndaadaa nye emumuyɛ nyina ahyɛ wo mã, abɔnsam ba, tsenenee nyina tamfo, ana innkegyaa Ewuradze no kwan a ɔtsen yi kontom?
Na afei, hwɛ, Ewuradze nsa da wo do, na w'enyi bofura, na irunnhu ewia dze ekesi da bi. Na amonmu hɔ ara na fua nye sum dwiir no so, na okyinii hwehwɛɛ binom a wobosuo ne nsamu akyerɛ no kwan.
Nna ambrado no, ohun dza ayɛ no, ɔgyee dzii, na Ewuradze ne nkyerɛkyerɛ no yɛɛ no ahobow.
Na Paulnom tui fii Paphos, na wɔbaa Perga a ɔwɔ Pamphylia: Na John fii hɔn nkyɛn sanee kɔr Jerusalem.
Na hɔndze, wotwaa mu wɔ Perga no, wɔbaa Antioch wɔ Pisidia; na wɔkɔr nhyiamudan ahomgyeda kɛtsenaa famu.
Na wowiee mbra no nye nkɔnhyɛfo kenkan no, nhyiamudan mu mpanyimfo no somae ma wɔbɛsee hɔn dɛ, Enuanom, sɛ hom wɔ afotusɛm bi kã kyerɛ nkorɔfo no a, hom nkã.
Na Paul soɛree gyinae, na onyinaam ne nsa kyerɛɛ hɔn see dɛ, Israel mbarimba, nye hom a hom suro Nyankopɔn, hom ntsie.
Isrealman yi hɔn Nyankopɔn no saan mu yii hɛn egyanom, na ɔman no tsenaa Egypt asaase do dɛ ahɔho no, ɔmaa hɔn do, na ɔdze nsa a ɔkrɔn yii hɔn fii hɔ.
Na bɛyɛ mfe eduanan na osiee hɔn ho abotar wɔ sar no do.
Na ɔbɔɔ amantɔw esuon wɔ Canaan asaase do no, ɔdze hɔn asaase maa hɔn dɛ egyapadze, bɛyɛ mfe ahaanan edunum;
na n'ekyir no ɔmaa hɔn atsɛmbuafo dze bodur nkɔnhyɛnyi Samuel do.
Na nkyi wobisaa ɔhen; na Nyankopɔn dze saul kish ba no a ofi Benjamin ebusuakuw mu maa hɔn mfe eduanan.
Na otuu no no, ɔmaa David do hyɛɛ no hen maa hɔn, ɔno so na ɔgyee no ho dase dɛ, mehu David Jesse ba no, ɔbarimba a mankasa m'akoma da no ho: ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ m'apɛdze nyina.
Oyi n'asefo mu na Nyankopɔn nam anohoba do eyi Jesus ayɛ Agyenkwa ama Isreal;
John dzii kan kãa nnuho enuma ho asɛm kyerɛɛ Isrealman nyina ansaana ɔbae.
Na John reyɛ ewie no dwuma dzi no, ɔsee dɛ, hom susu dɛ emi nyee woana? Nnyɛ emi nye no. Na hwɛ, obi dzi m'ekyir reba a mennsɛ dɛ mesan n'ananadze nsokota.
Enuanom, Abraham asefo, nye hom mu obiara a osuro Nyankopɔn, hɛn na wɔasoma nkwagye asɛm yi abrɛ hɛn.
Na hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalem nye hɔn etsitsir, osiandɛ wonnyim ɔno nye nkɔnhyɛfo na ndze a wɔkenkan no ahomgyeda nyina ntsi, wobuu no fɔ ma ɔbaa mu.
Na woennhu biribiara a ɔfata wu wɔ no mu, naaso wɔserɛɛ Pilate dɛ onku no.
Na wowiee dza wɔakyerɛw wɔ no ho nyina mã hyɛ no, woyii no fii dua no ho dze no kɔtoo nda mu.
Na Nyankopɔn nyaan no fii ewufo mu;
na oyi noho nda pii kyerɛɛ hɔn a wɔnye no fii Galilee baa Jerusalem: Hɔn nye n'adasefo ma ɔman no.
Na hɛndze, yɛkã hom anohoba a wɔbɔɔ egyanom no no ho asɛmpa,
dɛ Nyankopɔn ama aba mu ama hɛn mba, dɛ oenyan Jesus; dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ ndwom a otsia ebien no mu dɛ, ɔwo nye me Ba, ndɛ mawo wo.
Na dɛ onyaan no fii ewufo mu ma ɔronnkɔ mpɔtɔwee mu bio no, ɔkãa no dɛm dɛ, mebɛma hom David adom krɔnkrɔn a osi pi no.
Dɛm ntsi so ɔkã wɔ krɔnkrɔnnyi no ehu mpɔtɔwee.
Na David dze, ɔsoom Nyankopɔn n'apɛdze wɔ nankasa ne santsen mu wiei no, ɔdae, na wɔdze no kɔtoo n'egyanom nkyɛn, na ohun mpɔtɔwee:
na nyia Nyankopɔn nyaan no no dze, oennhu mpɔtɔwee.
Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, hom nhu dɛ ɔnam oyi do na wɔkã bɔfakyɛ kyerɛ hom;
na ɔnam Moses mbra do a hom enntum enndzi ho na ndzɛmba nyina a ɔnam Moses mbra do a hom enntum enndzi ho bem.
Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie mma dza wɔkãa no nkɔnhyɛfo, na ɔnyɛ hom nwanwa, na hom nhera: Osiandɛ mereyɛ edwuma bi wɔ hom nda mu, edwuma a obi kã kyerɛ hom a hom renngye nndzi.
Hom nhwɛ, hom mpeepeeanofo na ɔnyɛ homhom nwanwa, na hom nhera: Osiandɛ mereyɛ edwuma bi wɔ hom nda mu, edwuma a obi kã kyerɛ hom a, hom renngye nndzi.
Na wofir edzi no, wɔserɛɛ hɔn dɛ ahomgyeda bi so wɔmbɛkã nsɛm yi nkyerɛ hɔn.
Na wɔpoon nhyiamudan mu som no, Jewfo nye nyamesurofo a wɔdan Jewfo no mu pii kaa Paul nye Barnabas do: na hɔndze, wɔkasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn tuu hɔn fo dɛ wɔntsena Nyankopɔn adom no mu.
Na ahomgyeda a odzi do no durii no, ɔka kuma ma kurow mu no nyina ebehyia dɛ woribetsie Nyankopɔn asɛm.
Na Jewfo no hun nyimpadodow no, nyinkun hyɛɛ hɔn mã, na wɔkasae tsiaa ndzɛmba a Paul rekã ho asɛm no gyee kyim, na wɔkãa ebususɛm.

Na Paul nye Barnabas dze ndam kãa dɛ, ohia dɛ wodzi hom kan kã Nyankopɔn asɛm no kyerɛ hom. Na osiandɛ hom sun kyen, na hom bu homho dɛ hom nnsɛ onnyuiewei nkwa no ntsi, hwɛ; yɛdan kɔ amanamamfo no hɔ.
Na dɛmara na Ewuradze ahyɛ hɛn dɛ, medze wo mesi hɔ dɛ kandzea ama amanamamfo, ma aayɛ nkwagye kodu asaase ano noho.
Na amanamamfo no tsee yi no, wodzii dɛw na wɔhyɛɛ nyankopɔn asɛm no enyimnyam no dodow a woeyi hɔn ama onnyiewiei nkwa no wɔgyee dzii.
Na Ewuradze n'asɛm no tserɛwee wɔ asaase no nyina do.
Na Jewfo no tuu mbaa nyamesurofo a wɔwɔ dzin, nye kurow no mu etsitsir no aso sumae, na wɔmaa ahohia baa Paul nye Barnabas do, na wɔpaam hɔn fii hɔn ntoaado.
Na hɔndze, wɔporoporoow hɔn anan ho huntuma guu hɔn do, na wɔbaa Iconium.
Na esuafo no dze, dɛw nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn hyɛɛ hɔn mã.
14: Na ɔbaa dɛ Iconium so wɔkɔr Jewfo nhyiamudan no mu, na wɔkɛkãa asɛm ma Jewfo nye Greekfo nyiampadodow pii gyee dzii.
Na Jewfo asoɔdzenfo no kenyaan amanamamfo no, na wɔmaa hɔn adwen yɛɛ bɔn wɔ enuanom no do.
Na dɛm ntsi wɔtsenaa hɔ kyɛree, na wɔkasaa ndamdo wɔ Ewuradze mu, na no so dzii n'adom asɛm no ho dase, na ɔnam hɔn nsa do yɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze.
Na kurow no mu nyimpadodow no mu paae, na ɔfã dzii Jewfo no afã, na ɔfã so dzii asomafo no afã,
Na amanamamfo nye Jewfo nye hɔn etsitsir bɔɔ kyirididi baa dɛ wɔrobɔbɔ hɔn adapaa na woesiw hɔn abo no,
wohunii na woguanee kɔr Lycaonia nkurow Lystra nye Derbe nye asaase a oehyia hɔ no do:
na hɔ na wɔkɛkãa asɛmpa no.
Na Lystra hɔ ɔbarimba bi tse hɔ a ne nan mu nnyɛ dzen, ɔyɛ obubuafo fi ne nã yamu a ɔnnatseew da.
Ɔnoara na ɔtsee dɛ Paul rekasa, na ɔnodze, ɔdze n'enyi tsiim no do, na ohun dɛ ɔwɔ gyedzi dɛ no ho bɛsan no,
ɔdze ndze kɛse tsêaa mu dɛ, soɛr gyina wo nan do nkyire mben. Na ohuruhuruwii na ɔnantsewee.
na nyimpadodow no hun dza Paul ayɛ no, wɔmaa hɔn ndze do kãe wɔ Lycaonia kasa mu dɛ, enyame eyiyi hɔnho dɛ nyimpa esiansian aba hɛn nkyɛn.
Na wɔfrɛɛ Barnabas Zeus, nye Paul Hermes, osiandɛ ɔno nye ɔsɛnkafo tsitsir no.
Na Zeus a ɔwɔ kurow no enyim no sɔfoe dze anantwinyin nye nhyiren katraka baa kurow no n'abowano, dɛ ɔnye nyimpadodow no robɔbɔ afɔr.
Na asomafo Barnabas nye Paul tsee no, wosunsuan hɔn ntar mu, na wɔntutuu mbirika kɔdɔɔ nyimpa dodow no mu,

tsēaa mu dɛ, mbarimba, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom reyɛ yinom yi? Hɛn so yɛyɛ hom saso nyimpa dɛ homara, na yɛkã asɛmpa kyerɛ hom dɛ hom ndan mfi egyangyandze yi ho nkɔ tsease Nyankopɔn nkyɛn: Ɔno na ɔbɔɔ sor nye asaase nye po, nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyina
ɔno na mbersantsen a oebotwa mu no. Ɔmaa amanamam nyina kwan dɛ wɔnnantsew hɔnankasa hɔn akwan mu.
Naaso oenngyaa no ho adasedzi, dɛ ɔyɛɛ yie, na ɔdze nsu fii sor maa hom, nye ndɔbaaber, na ɔdze edziban nye abotɔyamu hyɛɛ hom akoma mã.
Na wɔkãa nsɛm yi no, wɔfonae ansaana worisiw nyimpadodow no kwan dɛ mma wɔmmbɔbɔ afɔr mma hɔn.
Na Jewfo bi fii Antioch nye Iconim baa hɔ, na wotuu nyimpadodow no aso sumae no, wosiiw Paul abo, na wɔtwee no fiir kurow no mu susuu dɛ oewu.
Na esuafo no begyinaa no ho hyiae no, ɔsoɛree na ɔkɔr kurow no mu; na adze kyee no ɔnye Barnabas fii hɔ kɔr Derbe.
Na wɔkãa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ kurow no no, na wɔyɛɛ dodowara esuafo no wɔsanee baa Lystra nye Iconium nye Antioch,
bɛhyehyɛɛ esuafo no akra dzen, na wotutuu hɔn fo dɛ wɔntsena gyedzi no mu, na dɛ so otwar dɛ yɛnam ahohia pii mu kɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu.
Na wɔhyehyɛɛ mpanyimfo wɔ asɔr nyina mu, na wodzii mbuada yɛɛ asɔr nyina mu, na wodzii mbuada yɛɛ asɔr no, wɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ Ewuradze a wɔgyee no dzii no ne nsa.
Na wotwaa mu wɔ Pisidia no, wɔbaa Pamphylia.
Na wɔkãa asɛm no wɔ Perga no, wosianee bodur Attalia;
ofi hɔ na wɔfaa nsuenyi baa Antioch mbrɛ wɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ Nyankopɔn adom nsa maa edwuma a woekowie dzi no.
Na wɔbae no, wɔfrɛfrɛɛ asɔrmba no boaa ano, na wɔkãa dza Nyankopɔn dze hɔn akɛyɛ nyina, na mbrɛ oebue gyedzi abow no ama amanamamfo no.
Na wɔnye esuafo no tsenaa hɔ ma ɔkyeree.
15: Na nkorɔfo bi fii Judæa bae bɛkyerɛkyerɛɛ enuanom no dɛ, sɛ woenntwa hom twatsia dɛ mbrɛ Moses amambra tse a, worunntum nngye hom nkwa.
Na akasakasa nye ekyingye nnyɛkuma baa Paul nye Barnabas nye hɔn ntamu no, wɔhyɛɛ dɛ Paul nye Barnabas nye hɔn mu binom nkɔ asomafo no nye mpanyimfo no hɔ wɔ Jerusalem wɔ asɛm no ntsi.
Na asɔrmba no begyaa hɔn kwan no, wokotwaa mu wɔ Phœnicia nye Samaria kãa amanaman hɔn ndanee no ho asɛm; na wɔmaa enuanom nyina dzii dɛw kɛse.
Na wodur Jerusalem no, asɔrmba nye asomafo nye mpanyimfo no maa hɔn akɔaba, ma wɔkãa dza Nyankopɔn dze hɔn ayɛ nyina kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na binom a wofi Phariseefo fɛkuw no mu a wɔagye edzi, wɔsoɛree na wɔsee dɛ, ɔsɛ dɛ wotwa hɔn twatsia na wɔhyɛ hɔn ma wodzi Moses mbra no do.
Na asomafo nye mpanyimfo no tuu egyina dwendween asɛm yi ho.
Na wɔgyee kyim pii wɔ ho no, Peter soɛree, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Enuanom, homankasa hom nyim mbrɛ Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi hom mu bi dadaada, dɛ amanamamfo nnam m'ano do ntsie asɛmpa no, na wɔgye ndzi.
Na Nyankopɔn a onyim akoma mu edzi hɔn dase, ɔama hɔn Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔdze maa hɛn so;
na ɔamma sori ammba yɛnye hɔn ntamu, na ɔnam gyedzi do atsew hɔn akoma mu.
Na afie ɔyɛ dɛn na hom rosɔ Nyankopɔn hwɛ, dɛ hom dze kɔndua a hɛn egyanom nye hɛn enntum annsoa bɔto esuafo no kɔn do?
Na yɛgye dzi dɛ ɔnam Ewuradze Jesus n'adom do na wɔbɛgye hɛn dɛ hɔn so.
Na nyimpadodow no nyina yɛɛ dzinn: Na wotsiee Barnabas nye Paul a wɔrekã nsɛnkyerɛdze nam hɔn do ayɛ wɔ amanaman no mu.
Na womuaa hɔn ano no, James buaa dɛ, enuanom hom ntsie me:
Symeon akã mbrɛ Nyankopɔn asɔpɔn no bɔhwɛɛ amanaman, dɛ oribeyi hɔn mu ɔman ama ne dzin.
Na yi so na nkɔnhyɛfo no nsɛm nye no saa, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ,
Yinom ekyir no, mebɛsan Mebesi David ntamadan a ɔahwe ase no bio: Na mesi dza oedwruw no bio. Na mama do mesi
Ma nyimpa nkaa no aahwehwɛ Ewuradze ekyir kwan, nye amanaman a wɔabɔ me dzin wɔ hɔn do nyina,
Ewuradze a ofi wiadze ahyɛse yi yinom kyerɛ a wonyim no na ɔse.
Dɛm ntsi m'asɛm a mowɔ kã nye dɛ mma yɛnnhaw hɔn a wofi amanaman mu adan aba Nyankopɔn hɔ no;
na mbom yɛnkyerɛw nkɛma hɔn dɛ wonyi hɔnho wɔ ehonyi efifidze, nye ndwamansɛm nye mbowa a wɔahyɛ hɔn fõ, nye bɔgya ho.
Na ofi tsetse mber san tsen na Moses wɔ hɔn a wɔkã no ho asɛm wɔ nkurow nyina mu, wɔkenkan no wɔ nhyiamudan mu ahomgyeda daa.
Nna ɔsɔɔ asomfa nye mpanyimfo nye asɔrmba no nyina enyi dɛ wɔpa hɔn aka Paul nye Judas a wɔfrɛ no Barsabbas nye Silas, enuanom no mu etsitsi bi:
na wɔkyerɛɛw nwoma hyɛɛ hɔn nsa dɛ, Asomafo nye enuanom mpanyimfo no kyia enuanom a wofi amanaman mu wɔ Antioch nye Syria nye Cilicia:
Susumpa dɛ yɛatse dɛ binom a wofii hɛn mu kɔree dze nsɛm abɛtan hom enyi ebikyiw hom akra, na yɛannhyɛ hɔn dɛm ntsi,
ɔyɛɛ hɛn dɛ oye dɛ yɛayɛ anokor ntsi, yɛpa mbarimba na yɛsoma hɔn nye hɛn adɔfo Barnabas nye Paul a wɔyɛ
nyimpa a hɛn Ewuradze Jesus christ ntsi wɔdze hɔn nkwa ama no ba hom nkyɛn.
Dɛm ntsi yɛasoma Judas nye Silas a wɔdze hɔn ano so bɛkã hom nsɛm no ara.
Na ɔhwɛɛ yie maa Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no nye hɛn so dɛ yɛmmfa adzesoa biara nnto hom do dɛ dza ohia yi ara.
dɛ hom nyi homho mfi nam a wɔdze abɔ afɔr ama ehonyi, nye bɔgya, nye mbowa a wɔahyɛ hɔn fõ nye ndwambowa ho: Ɔno na sɛ hom yi homho fi ho a, obowie hom yie. Onsi hom yie.
Na afei wogyaa hɔn kwan no wɔbaa Antioch, na wɔboaboaa nyimpadodow no ano no, woyii nwoma no mae.
Na wɔkenkanee no, wodzii dɛw wɔ awerɛkyekyer no ntsi.
Na Judas nye Silas hɔnaraso yɛ asɛnkafo no, dze nsɛm pii tuu enuanom no fo, na wɔhyɛɛ hɔn dzen.
Na wɔkyɛɛr hɔ kakra no, enuanom no gyaa hɔn kwan dwudwoodwo ma wɔkɔr hɔn a wɔsomaa hɔn no hɔ.
Naaso Silas pɛɛ dɛ ɔbɛtsena hɔ ara.
Na Paul nye Barnabas tsenaa Antioch, wɔkyerɛkyerɛe na wɔkãa Ewuradze asɛmpa.
Na nda bi twaa mu no, Paul see Barnabas dɛ, ma yɛnsan nkɛsera enuanom no wɔ nkurow a yɛkãa Ewuradze asɛm wɔ hɔ nyina mu, nkɔhwɛ mbrɛ wɔtse.
Na Barnabas pɛɛ dɛ wɔtse John a wɔfrɛ no Mark no aka hɔnho.
Na Paul anndwen dɛ oye dɛ wɔbɛfa nyia ɔtwee noho fii hɔn ho wɔ Pamphylia, na ɔnye hɔn annkɔ annkɛyɛ edwuma no, aka hɔnho.
Na akasakasa a ɔyɛ dzen bae, ma wɔpaapaa hɔnho mu, na Barnabas faa Mark faa nsuenyi kɔr Cyprus;
Paul dze ɔfaa Silas, na enuanom no dze no hyɛɛ Ewuradze adom nsa no, osii mu kɔree.
Na okotwaa mu wɔ Syria nye Cilicia hyɛɛ asɔrasɔr no dzen.
16: Na okodur Derbe nye Lystra so: Na hwɛ, Osuanyi bi wɔ hɔ a ne dzin dze Timothy ɔyɛ Jewnyi ɔbaa bi a ɔgyee dzii no ba, na n'egya yɛ Greeknyi.
Ɔno na enuanom a wɔwɔ Lystra nye Iconium no bɔɔ no dzin paa.
Na Paul pɛɛ dɛ ɔnye no kɔ, na ɔfaa no twaa no twatsia wɔ Jewfo a wɔwɔ apaa mu hɔ ntsi, osiandɛ hɔn nyina nyim dɛ n'egya yɛ Greeknyi.
Na worutwa mu wɔ nkurow no mu no, wɔdze, mbra a asomafo nye mpayimfo a wɔwɔ Jerusalem hyɛe no maa hɔn dɛ wondzi do.
Nna asɔr horow no yɛɛ dzen wɔ gyedzi no mu, na hɔn dodow yɛɛ kɛse daa.
Na wokotwaa mu wɔ Phrygia nye Galatia asaase do, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no braa hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnkã asɛm no wɔ Asia;
na wɔbaa Mysia tsetsendo no, wɔsɔe hwɛɛ dɛ wɔrokɔ Bithynia; na Jesus no Sunsum no amma hɔn kwan;
na wɔpaa Mysia ho baa Troas.
Na anago no enyido-adze yii noho kyerɛɛ Paul: Macedonia ɔbarimba bi gyina hɔ reserɛ no dɛ, twa bra Macedonia bɔboa hɛn.
Na ohun enyido-adze no, ntsɛmara yɛhwehwɛɛ dɛ yesi mu kɔ Macedonia, yɛfaa no ampa dɛ Ewuradze afrɛ hɛn dɛ yɛnkɛkā asɛmpa no nkyerɛ hɔn.
Dɛm ntsi yetui fii Troas tseen hɛnho baa Samothrace, na adze kyee no yɛbaa Neapolis;
na yefii hɔ Macedonia a odzi kan wɔ apaamu hɔ no na ɔyɛ Rome etubradfo kurow; na yedzii kurow yi mu nda kakra.
Na ahomgyeda no yefii ekuropon no mu kɔr esutsen ho wɔ mbrɛ yɛdween dɛ asɔryɛbea bi wɔ, na yɔ, tsenaa ase na yɛkasaa kyerɛɛ mbaa a woebehyia hɔ no.
Na ɔbaa bi a ne dzin dze Lydia a ɔtɔn tam memen, nyamesuronyi a ofi Thyatira kurow mu, ɔtsee: Ɔno na Ewuradze buee n'akoma dɛ ontsie dza Paul kãe no.
Na wonumaa ɔno nye ne fifo no, ɔserɛɛ dɛ, sɛ hom ebu me dɛ megye Ewuradze midzi ara ampa a, hom mbra me fie mbɛtsena hɔ. Na ɔhyɛɛ hɛn.
Na ɔbaa dɛ yɛrokɔ asɔryɛbea no, abaawa bi a ɔwɔ akɔm sunsum behyiaa hɛn, ɔno na ɔdze akɔm ama no wuranom enya adze pii.
ɔno na odzii Paul nye hɛn ekyir, na ɔtsēaa mu dɛ, nyimpa yi yɛ ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn nkowaa a wɔkyerɛ hom nkwagye kwan.
Na ɔyɛɛ yi nda pii. Na ɔyɛɛ Paul yaw na ɔdaan noho see sunsum no dɛ, mehyɛ wo wɔ Jesus Christ dzin mu dɛ fi no mu fi. Na ofiir edzi dɔn no ara mu.
Na no wuranom hun dɛ hɔn adzenya enyidado asã no wosusuoo Paul nye Silas mu twee hɔn kɔr gua do etsitsir no enyim,
na wɔdze hɔn kɛmaa asɛndzifo no dɛ, nyimpa yi a wɔyɛ Jewfo yi, wɔretan hɛn kurow yi enyi,
na wɔrekyerɛkyerɛ amambra a yennyi ho kwan dɛ yɛgye anaadɛ yɛyɛ, ofir dɛ yɛyɛ Romefo ntsi.
Na nyimpadodow no soɛree tsiaa hɔn; na asɛndzifo no tsetseew hɔn ntar mu fii hɔnho, na wɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmbɔ hɔn mbaa.
Na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mbaa pii no, wɔdze hɔn koguu efiadze, na wɔhyɛɛ efiadzehwɛnyi no dɛ ɔmfa hɔn nsie ysie;
na ɔnodze, ɔgyee dɛm ahyɛdze yi no, ɔdze hɔn koguu efiadze a ɔwɔ ekyir no mu, na ɔbɔɔ hɔn anan dua mu.
Na esuom no Paul nye Silas yii mpaa na wɔtoow ndwom maa Nyankopɔn, na adaduafo no tsiee hɔn.
Na awerɛfir mu ara asaasewosow kɛse bae ma efiadze no fapem hihimii, na amonmu hɔ ara mbobow no nyina buebuei, na hɔn nyina hɔn nkyehoma sansanee.
Na efiadzehwɛ nyi no nyanee fii nda mu, na ohun dɛ efiadze mbobow no ebuebue no, ɔtwee n'afõwa dɛ oribedzi noho ewu, ɔdween dɛ adaduafo no eguanguan.
Na Paul dze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu dɛ, Mma nnyɛ woho bɔn bi, na hɛn nyina wɔ ha.
Na obisaa kandzea huruhuruwii baa mu, na ɔdze ahopopo bɔhwee Paul nye Silas enyim,
na ɔdze hɔn fiir edzi, na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuranom, ebɛnadze na menyɛ ma wɔngye me nkwa?
Na wɔsee no dɛ, Gye Ewuradze Jesus dzi, na wɔbɛgye wo nye wo fifo nkwa.
Na wɔkãa Ewuradze asɛm no kyerɛɛ ɔno nye hɔn a wɔwɔ ne fie nyina.
Na ɔfaa hɔn anago dɔn no ara mu hohoor hɔn mbaa no ano, na ɔmaa wonumaa ɔno nye hɔn a wɔyɛ nedze nyina amonmu hɔ ara.
Na ɔdze hɔn baa ne fie, na ɔtoo hɔn pon, na no ho sɛpɛɛw no, ɔnye ne fifo nyina, dɛ ɔagye Nyankopɔn edzi ntsi.
Na adze kyee no, asɛndzifo no somaa nsordaafo baa dɛ, Gyaa nyimpa no ma wɔnkɔ.
Na efiadzehwɛnyi no kãa asɛm no kyerɛɛ Paul dɛ, asɛndzifo no asoma dɛ wongyaa hom ma hom nkɔ: Dɛm ntsi afei yi, hom mfir edzi nkɔ dwudwoodwo.
Na Paul see hɔn dɛ, woemmbu hɛn atsɛn, na wɔahwe hɛn a yɛyɛ romefo wɔ gua do, na wɔdze hɛn egu efiadze, na afei woriyi hɛn edzi wɔ nsumaa mu anaa? Dabida! Na ma hɔnara mbra mbeyi hɛn.
Na nsordaafo no kɛkãa asɛm no kyerɛɛ asɛndzifo no, na wɔtsee dɛ wɔyɛ Romefo no, wosuroi;
na wɔbae bɛserɛɛ hɔn, na woyii hɔn na wɔserɛɛ hɔn dɛ womfi kurow no mu nkɔ.
Na wofi efiadze hɔ kɔr Lydia fie na wohun enuanom no, wɔkyekyee hɔn werɛ, na wofii hɔ kɔree.
17: Na wokotwaa mu wɔ Amphipolis nye Apollonia no, wɔbaa Thessalonica mbrɛ Jewfo nhyiamudan bi wɔ:
na Paul, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtɔ yɛ no, ɔkɔr mu wɔ hɔn nkyɛn, na ɔnye hɔn kãa kyerɛwnsɛm no ho asɛm ahogyeda ebiasa,
na obuee do kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn mu kofee dɛ otwar dɛ Christ no hu amandze, na ɔsoɛr fi ewufo mu; na eso dɛ, Jesus a ɔsee dɛ, mekã hom no ho asɛm yi ara, ɔno nye Chirst no.
Na hɔn mu binom gyee dzii, na wɔnye Paul nye Silas bɔɔ awɛ, na Greekfo nyamesurofo nyimpadodow pii, nye mbaa mpanyin no mu bi nnyɛkuma.
Na Jewfo no dze, nyinkun kãa hɔn, na wɔfaa ehuhufo no mu nyimpa bɔn bi kaa hɔn ho, na wɔmaa kurow no mu yɛɛ wentwiwentwi, na wɔkɛkyeer Jason dan ho hwehwɛɛ dɛ woyi hɔn fir edzi kɛma nkorɔfo no.
Na woennhu hɔn no wotwuuw Jason nye enuanom no bi adze kɛmaa kurow no mu etsitsir no, na wɔtsēatseaa mu dɛ, Yinom a wɔadan wiadze tsir esi famu yi, wɔaba ha so:
Hɔn na Jason agye hɔn esie, na hɔn nyina yɛ dza otsia Cæsar mbransɛm no, dɛ ɔhen bi so wɔ hɔ, Jesus bi.
Na wɔhaaw nyimpadodow no nye kurow no mu etsitsir a wɔtsee yinom no.
Na wɔgyee Jason nye nkaa no hɔ egyinamudze no, wɔmaa wɔkɔree.
Na ntsɛmara enuanom no gyaa Paul nye Silas kwan anago kɔr Beroea, na wodur hɔ no, wɔkɔr Jewfo nhyiamudan no mu.
Na yinom yɛ enyimdzefo sen hɔn a wɔwɔ Thessalonica, wɔ dɛ wosiesiee hɔn adwen mu tsiee asɛm no, na wɔhwehwɛɛ kyerɛwnsɛm no mu daa, kyerɛdɛ ndzɛmba yi tse dɛm anaa.
Dɛm ntsi hɔn mu dodowara gyee dzii, nye Greekfo mbaa a wɔwɔ dzin, nye mbarimba no bi wɔwɔ dzin, nye mbarimba no bi nnyɛkuma.
Na Jewfo a wɔwɔ Thessalonica tsee dɛ Paul akɛkã Nyankopɔn asɛm no wɔ Beroea so no, wɔbaa hɔ so na wobohur nyimpadodow no na wɔhaaw hɔn.
Na afie ntsɛmara enuanom no gyaa Paul kwan dɛ ɔnkɔ po ho, na Silas nye Timothy dze, wɔtsenaa hɔ.
Na hɔn a wɔkegyaa Paul kwan no dze no kɔree kodur Athens, na wɔgyee nkra dɛ Silas nye Timothy mbra ne nkyɛn ntsɛntsɛm no, wosii mu kɔree.
Na Paul rotweɔn hɔn wɔ Athens no, na ohun dɛ kurow no abosom ahyɛ no mã no, no sunsum nyaa ebufuw wɔ no mu.
Dɛm ntsi nhyiamudan mu ɔnye Jewfo nye nyamesurofo no kasae, na guado so daa nyina ɔnye hɔn a wɔbɔtoo no kasae.

Na Epicurusfo nye Stoafo enyansapɛfo bi nye no dzii anokɔnkɔn. Na binom see dɛ, ɔkasakasafo yi se dɛn nye yi? Binom so see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛ ɔkã anana abosom bi ho asɛm: Osiandɛ dɛ ɔkãa Jesus nye wusoɛr no ho asɛmpa no.
Na wosuoo no mu dze no kɔr Areopagus dɛ, Ana yebotum ehu nkyerɛkyerɛ fofor a erekyerɛ yi?
Na edze nsɛm fofor bi aba hɛn asomu: Dɛm ntsi yɛpɛ dɛ yehu ndzɛmba yi ase.
(Osiandɛ Athensfo nye ahɔho a wɔabɛtsena hɔ nyina, wonnya biribiara ho adagyer ka dɛ wɔbɛkã anaadɛ wobetsie asɛm fofor bi).
Na Paul gyinaa Areopagus finimfin, na ɔsee dɛ, Athens mbarimba, mehu dɛ ndzɛmba nyina mu hom yɛ abosompɛ papa.
Na murutwa mu, na mohwɛɛ hom adze a hom sɔr no, muhun afɔrmbukyia so a wɔakyerɛw do dɛ, NYAME A WONNYIM NO DZE A. Dɛm ntsi nyia hom nnyim na hom sɔr no no, ɔno na mekã no ho asɛm mekyerɛ hom yi.
Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛɛ wiadze nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyina, ɔno a ɔyɛ sor nye asaase wura no ntsi ɔnntie asɔrdan awɔdze nsa ayɛ mu;
eso wɔnndze nyimpa nsa nnsom no, dɛ gyama ohia no biribi, osiandɛ ɔno na ɔma nyimpa nyina nkwa nye ahom nye adze nyina:
na ofi adze kor mu yɛɛ nyimpa amanaman nyina, dɛ wɔntsena asaase enyi nyina, na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn hyɛber, nye hɔn tsenabea he too hɔ,
dɛ wɔnhwehwɛ Nyankopɔn, dɛ bi a hɔn nsa bɛkã no, na woehu no, naaso ɔnye hɛn mu biara ntamu kwan nnwar:
Na no mu na yɛtse ase, na yɛkeka hɛnho, na yɛwɔ hɔ; dɛ mbrɛ homankasa hom ndwomkyerɛwfo binom akã dɛ, Hɛn nyinara so yɛ ne mbanana.
Na osiandɛ yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn mbanana ntsi, ɔnnsɛ dɛ yesusu dɛ Nyame suban tse dɛ sika anaa dwetɛ, anaa ɔbo, edwin a nyimpa dze ne nyansaa nye n'adwen edzi.
Na mber a wonnyim no dze, Nyankopɔn buu enyi guu do, na afei dze, ɔhyɛ nyimpa nyina wɔ mbea nyina dɛ wonnu hɔnho,
osiandɛ ɔahyɛ da bi a ɔnam ɔbarimba bi a oeyi no esi hɔ no do bobu wiadze atsɛn wɔ tsenenee mu; ɔno na ɔama ɔasoɛr efi ewufo mu dze esi no pi ama nyimpa nyina dɛ wɔmfa ndzi dase.
Na wɔtsee ewufo soɛr no, binom sii atwetwe, na binom so see dɛ, yebetsie wo wɔ asɛm yi hɔn mu kɔree nye no.
Na mbrɛ Paul fii hɔn mu kɔree nye no.
Naaso nyimpa bi dze hɔnho bɔɔ no ho na wɔgyee dzii: Hɔn mu bi nye Dionysius Areopagusnyi no, na ɔbaa bi a ne dzin dze Damaris, nye binom a wɔka hɔn ho.
18: Na yinom ekyir no, Paul fii Athens baa Corinth.
Na ne dzin dze Aɔuila a wɔwoo no wɔ nye ne yer Priscilla, osiandɛ Claudius ahyɛ dɛ Jewfo nyina mfi Rome nkɔ: na ɔbaa hɔn nkyɛn;
na dɛ ɔnye hɔn yɛ edwuma kor ntsi, ɔtsenaa hɔn nkyɛn, na wɔyɛɛ edwuma; na hɔn edwuma nye dɛ wɔyɛ ntamadanyɛfo.
Na daa ahomgyeda ɔbɛkãa asɛm wɔ nhyiamudan mu, dɛ ɔrema Jewfo nye Greekfo agye edzi.
Na Silas nye Timothy fii Macedonia sianee bae no, asɛm no hyɛɛ Paul do, na odzii dase kyerɛɛ Jewfo no dɛ Jesus nye Christ no.
Na wɔyɛɛ kyikyiikyi, na wɔkãa ebususɛm no, ɔpopoo n'atar mu kãa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom bɔgyaa ngu homankasa etsifi: emidze mo ho asan; ofi ndɛ morokɔ Amanamamfo no hɔ.
Na ofii hɔ kɔr obi a ne dzin dze Titus Justus a ɔyɛ nyamesuronyi a ne fi bɔ nhyiamudan ho no ne fie.
Na Crispus, nhyiamudan mu panyin nye ne fifo nyia gyee Ewuradze dzii; na Corinthfo no pii tsee no wɔgyee dzii, ma wonumaa hɔn.
Na Ewuradze see Paul wɔ enyido-adzehu mu anago dɛ, mma nnsuro, na kasa, na mma mmua w'ano:
na emi mara meka wo ho na obiara rennkã wo mmbɛyɛ wo bɔn bi; osiandɛ mowɔ nkorɔfo pii wɔ kurow yi mu.
Na ɔtsenaa hɔ afrenhyia abosoom esia kyerɛkyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm wɔ hɔn mu.
Na Gallio dzii Achaea ambrado no, Jewfo no yɛɛ adwenkor soɛɛr Paul do, na wɔdze no baa asɛndzii egua enyim dɛ,
Oyi otu nyimpa aso suma dɛ wɔnsom Nyankopɔn mbrɛ otsia mbra no.
Na Paul reyɛ ebue n'ano no, Gallio see Jewfo no dɛ, Jewfo, sɛ ɔyɛ mfom anaa ehuhusɛm bi a omuo a nkyɛ ɔsɛ dɛ misie hom ho abotar tsie hom;
na sɛ ɔyɛ asɛm nye edzin nye hom mbra ho asɛmbisa a, ɔnodze, homara hom nhwɛ: Na emidze, memmpɛ dɛ meyɛ dɛm asɛm yi ho ɔtsɛmbuafo.
Na ɔpaam hɔn fii asɛndzii egua enyim hɔ.
Na hɔn nyina suoo nhyiamudan mu panyin Sosthenes mu hwee no asɛndzii egua enyim hɔ. Na Gallio dze, ɔammfa yinom biara annyɛ hwee.
Na Paul daa ho tsenaa hɔ nda kakra ara no, ɔkraa enuanom no, na ofii hɔ faa nsuenyi kɔr Syria, na Priscilla nye Aɔuila ka no ho; na ɔpaa ne tsir wɔ Cenchreæ; osiandɛ oedzi nsew bi.
Na wɔbaa Ephesus, na ogyaa hɔn hɔ; na nankasa dze ɔkɔr nhyiamudan mu nye Jewfo kɛkasae.
Na wɔserɛɛ no dɛ, sɛ Nyankopɔn pɛ a, mebɛsan maba hom nkyɛn bio no, ofii Ephesus sii nsuenyi.
Na odwiir daadze wɔ Cæsarea no, ɔkɔree kekyiaa asɔrmba no, na osianee kɔr Antioch.
Na odzii hɔ ber kakra no, ofii hɔ kekyiin Galatia nye Phrygia nkurow mu esiado esiado, hyɛɛ esuafo no nyina dzen.
Na Jewnyi bi a ne dzin dze Apollos a wɔwoo no wɔ Aleɛandria na ɔyɛ nyimpa hotsewnyi, baa Ephesus, na onyim kyerɛwnsɛm no yie.
Nyimpa yi na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ no Ewuradze kwan no mu; na ɔyɛ hyew wɔ sunsum mu no, ɔkãe na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ dza ɔfa Jesus ho no pɛpɛɛpɛ, naaso John enuma nko na na onyim;
na ɔhyɛɛ ase dze ndam kasae wɔ nhyiamudan mu. Ɔno na Priscilla baa hɔn nkyɛn, na woyi Nyankopɔn kwan no kyerɛɛ no yie ara.

Na onyaa adwen dɛ obotwa mu akɔ Achaea no, enuanom no hyɛɛ no dzen na wɔkyerɛɛw nwoma kɛmaa esuafo no dɛ wɔngye no; na ɔbae no, ɔboaa hɔn a wɔnam adom do agye edzi no wɔ bagua mu, na ɔnam kyerɛwnsɛm no do kyerɛɛ mu kofee dɛ Jesus nye Christ no.
19: Na ɔbaa dɛ Apollos wɔ Corinth no, Paul kotwaa mu wɔ amantsifi asaase no do no ɔbaa Ephesus, na obohun esuafo bi;
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom gyee dzii no, hom nyaa Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn? Na wɔsee no dɛ, Yɛnntsee pɛn mpo dɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn bi wɔ beebi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze mbɔ na wonumaa hom hyɛɛ mu? Na wɔsee dɛ, John enuma no mu a.
Na Paul see dɛ, John dze nnuho enuma no numae see nkorɔfo no dɛ wɔngye nyia odzi n'ekyir reba no ndzi, ɔno nye Jesus.
Na wɔtsee no, wɔmaa wonumaa hɔn hyɛɛ Ewuradze Jesus dzin mu.
Na Paul dze ne nsa guu hɔn do no, Sunsum krɔnkrɔn no baa hɔn do, na wɔdze kasa fofor kasae, na wɔhyɛ nkɔm.
Na hɔn nyina bɛyɛ mbarimba duebien.
Na ɔkɔr nhyiamudan mu, na ɔdze ndam kãa asɛm ara abosoom ebiasa, ɔnye hɔn rekasa na ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ mu ma wɔaagye dza ɔfa Nyankopɔn ahendzi no ho edzi.
Na binom akoma epirim, na woenntsie, na wɔkasaa ɔkwan no ho bɔn wɔ nyimpadodow no enyim no, ofii hɔn nkyɛn na oyii esuafo no fii hɔn mu; na daa ɔnye hɔn kasae wɔ Tyrannus ne nkyerɛkyerɛbea hɔ.
Na iyi kɔr do ara kodur mfe ebien, ma dɛm no hɔn a wɔwɔ Asia nyina tsee Ewuradze asɛm, Jewfo nye Greekfo nyina.
Na Nyankopɔn nam Paul nsa do yɛɛ tum ndwuma a ɔnnkã:
ma woyiyii no ho nduukuu anaa nsamenyim mpo koguu ayarfo do, ma yarba fii hɔn do, na esunsum bɔn so fii hɔn mu.
Na Jewfo akwankwamfo bi a wɔyɛ mbɔnsantutufo sii hɔn bo dɛ, mekã Jesus a Paul kã no ho asɛm no gu hom do.
Na Jewnyi sɔfopanyin bi Sceva ne mba beesuon bi wɔ hɔ a wɔyɛɛ dɛm.
Na sunsum bɔn no buae see hɔn dɛ, Jesus na minyim, na Paul so minyim, na homdze hom so nye woananom?
Na nyimpa no a sunsum bɔn wɔ no do no huruwii baa hɔn do, na ɔtsewee faa hɔn do ma otuum hɔn, na wɔdze adagyaw nye fɛr fii ofi no mu guanguanee.
Na Jewfo nye Greekfo a wɔwɔ Ephesus nyina tsee yi, na hu kaa hɔn nyina, na wohuhoor Ewuradze Jesus ne dzin.
Na hɔn a wɔagye edzi no mu pii so bae bɛkae na wɔbeyii hɔn ndzeyɛɛ kyerɛe.
Na hɔn a wɔyɛɛ esumandze mu nnyɛkuma dze hɔn nwoma bae bɛhyeew no wɔ nyimpa nyina enyim; na wobuu no bo ano no wohun dɛ osii ndwetɛbona apeduonum.
Mbrɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm nam ahoɔdzen do nyinii na odzii nyim nye no.
Na wowiee yinom no Paul bɔɔ tsirmpɔw wɔ sunsum mu dɛ sɛ otwa mu wɔ Macedonia nye Achaea a, ɔbɔkɔ Jerusalem, na ɔsee dɛ, mudu hɔ a, otwar dɛ mubokohu Rome so.
Na ɔsomaa hɔn a wɔsoom no mu beenu, Timothy nye Erastus, kɔr Macedonia, na nankasa dze, ɔkyɛree wɔ Asia kakra.
Na ber no ara mu na sakasaka nnyɛkuma bae wɔ ɔkwan no ho.
Na dwetɛ-dwimfo bi a ne dzin dze demetrius a ɔyɛ artemis asɔrdan no dwetɛ ehonyi, nnyɛ mfaso kakra na ɔma edwimfo no nya,
na ɔboaa hɔn nye hɔn a wɔyɛ edwuma kor no ara bi ano, na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuranom, hom nyim dɛ edwuma yi mu na yenya hɛn ahonya.
Na hom ehu na hom atse dɛ nnyɛ Ephesus ha nko, na aka kakra na ayɛ Asia nyina, na Paul yi etu nyimpadodow pii hɔn aso esuma, na ɔadan hɔn enyi dɛ dza wɔdze nsa ayɛ hɔn no nnyɛ enyame,
na nnyɛ hɛn edwin yi nko na ɔreyɛ ayɛgyan, na nyamebaa Artemis kɛse n'asɔrfi rebɛyɛ dɛ wommbu no hwee bio, na woetu ɔno a Asia nyina nye wiadze nyina sɔr no no efi n'akɛseyɛ mu.
Na wɔtsee yi no, ebufuw hyɛɛ hɔn mã, na wɔtsēatseaa mu dɛ, Ephesusfo Arttemis yɛ kɛse!
Na sakasaka hyɛɛ kurow no mã, na wɔkɛkyeer Macedoniafo Gaius nye Aristarchus a wɔka Paul ho wɔ n'akwantu mu no, ahwɛɛbea no mu.
Na Paul pɛɛ dɛ ɔkɛhɛn nkorɔfo no mu no, esuafo no amma no kwan.
Na Asia mpanyimfo bi so a wɔyɛ n'adɔfo somae ma wɔkɔr no hɔ kɛserɛɛ no dɛ mma ɔnnkɔ ahwɛɛbea no mu hɔ.
Na afei binom retsēa mu dɛm, binom so retsēa mu dɛm; na nhyiamu no ayɛ sakasaka; na ɔfã ara yie nnyim dzekor a osian ntsi ma wobehyiae.
Na wɔtwee Aleɛander fii nyimpadodow no mu, na Jewfo no sunsum no too kan. Na Aleɛander dze ne nsa nyamee, na ɔpɛɛ dɛ oyi n'ano kyerɛ nkorɔfo no.
Na wohhun dɛ ɔyɛ Jewnyi no, hɔn nyina dze ndze kor tsēaa mu bɛyɛ ndɔnhwer ebien dɛ, Ephesusfo Artemis yɛ kɛse!
Na ɔmankyerɛwfo no dwedwee nyimpadodow no, ɔsee dɛ, Ephesus mbarimba, nyimpa bɛn na onnyim dɛ Ephesusfo kurow no yɛ Artemis kɛse nye honyi a ofir Zeus bodwirii no hɔn asɔrfihwɛfo?
Dɛm ntsi obiara runntum nnkasa nntsia yinom no, ɔse hom dɛ hom yɛ komm, na hom nnyɛ biribi gyigyeegye.
Na hom dze mbarimba yi a wɔnnyɛ asɔrfi ewifo, eso wɔnnkã hɛn nyamebaa ho ebususɛm yi aba ha.
Na afei, sɛ demetrius nye edwimfo a wɔka no ho no wɔ obi ho asɛm bi a, asɛndzibea wɔ hɔ, ambradofo wɔ hɔ: Hom mma wombeyi atsɛn.
Na sɛ hom rohwehwɛ biribi wɔ nsɛm afofor bi ho a, wobedzi no bagua mu dɛ mbrɛ mbra tse.
Na yɛreyɛ enya amandze so ndɛ, dɛ wɔbɔkɔtõa hɛn wo ndɛ tutuw yi biribiara a yɛ!dze botum eyi hɛn ano wɔ nguabɔ yi ho.
Na ɔkãa dɛm no, ɔmaa bagua no tui.
20: Na sakasaka no bɔɔ adze no, Paul frɛɛ esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn, na otuu hɔn fo no, ɔkraa hɔn, na ofii hɔ dɛ ɔrokɔ Macedonia.
Na otwaa mu wɔ afã mu hɔ, na ɔmaa hɔn afotu pii no, ɔbaa Greece.
Na ɔbɛtsenaa hɔ abosoom ebiasa, na ɔreyɛ etu akɔ syria no, Jewfo no retsɛw no ntsi, ɔyɛɛ n'adwen dɛ ɔbɛfa Macedonia asan akɔ.
Na Berœanyi Sopater, Pyrrhus ne ba, na Thessalonicafo no mu Aristarchus nye Timothy, nye Asiafo Tychicus nye Trophimus kaa no ho kɔr Asia.
Yinom dzii kan kɔtweɔɔn hɛn wɔ Troas.
Na hɛn so, epitsi nda twaa mu no, yɛfowee fii Philippi dze nda enum baa hɔn nkyɛn wɔ Troas; na yedzii hɔ nda esuon.
Na dapɛn no mu da a odzi kan no a yebehyiaa mu dɛ yerubobu paanoo no, Paul nye hɔn kasae dɛ adze rebɛkye ma ɔaakɔ ntsi, na ɔtoaa asɛm araa kodur esuom.
Na nkandzea pii wɔ abansor mbrɛ yeehyia mu hɔ.
Na aberantsɛ bi a ne dzin dze Eutychus tse tokura ano n'enyi akom kɛse, na Paul kãa asɛm kyɛree no, ɔtɔɔ nkom fii asaansa no do bɔhwee ase, na wɔmaa no do na oewu.
Na Paul sianee kobutuuw no do, na ɔyɛɛ no etuu, na ɔsee dɛ, mma hom nnyɛ begyabegya: na no nkwar wɔ no mu.
Na ɔbaa sor bio no, na obubuu paanoo, na odzii no, ɔdaa ho kasae araa kodur adzehyee, na ofii hɔ dɛm kɔree.
Na wɔdze aberantsɛ no baa enyikan, na awerɛkyekyer a ɔyɛɛ hɔn nnyɛ kuma.
Na yedzii kan kɔr hɛn mu no, yetui kɔr Assos dɛ yɛrekɛfa Paul ato mu wɔ hɔ; na mbrɛ ɔhyɛɛ hɛn nye no, na ɔnodze, ɔdween dɛ obesi daadze.
Na ɔnye hɛn hyiae wɔ Assos no, yɛfaa no too mu, na yɛbaa Mitylene.
Na yetui fii hɔ, na adze kyee no, yebodur Chios tsentsendo; na adze kyee bio no, yɛbaa Samos, na adze kyee no yedur Miletus.
Na Paul akã ato hɔ dɛ ɔbɛpa Ephesus ho, amma ɔaannkɛkyer wɔ Asia; na ɔpɛɛ ntsɛm ma sɛ ɔbɛyɛ a, oeekodu Jerusalem Pentecost da no.
Na ofii Miletus somae kɔr Ephesus kɛfrɛɛ asɔr mpanyimfo no.
Na wɔbaa ne nkyɛn no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, homankasa hom nyim mbrɛ ofitsi da a odzi kan a mebaa Asia no, menye hom tsenae wɔ aber no nyina mu,
medze adwen mu ahobrɛadze nye nyinsu pii mosoom Ewuradze, nye nsɔhwɛ a ɔbaa mo do ɔnam Jewfo pempɛn a wɔpempɛɛn me no do:
mbrɛ mannwodow ho dɛ mekɛkã hom biribiara a ɔyɛ hom mfaso na mekãe na mekyerɛkyerɛɛ hom guado nye efiefi,
na midzii dase maa Jewfo nye Greekfo so wɔ nnuho a ɔkɔ Nyankopɔn do, nye gyedzi a ɔkɔ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ do no ho.
Na afei, hwɛ, morokɔ Jerusalem dɛ woekitsa me wɔ sunsum mu, na minnyim dza ɔbɛba mo do wɔ hɔ,
gyedɛ dase a Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no dzi wɔ nkurow nyina mu dɛ ɔkyer nye amanzde rotweɔn me.
Na memmfa mo nkwa nnyɛ biribi dɛ ɔsom mo do, ama medze dɛw meewie m'akwantu, nye ɔsom a minyaa no Ewuradze Jesus hɔ, dɛ mindzi Nyankopɔn adom asɛmpa no ho dase no.
Na afei, hwɛ, minyim dɛ hom a muboduaa hom mu mekãa ahenman no ho asɛm no nyina runnhu m'enyim bio.
Dɛm ntsi, ndɛ midzi hom dase dɛ mo ho san hom nyina hom bɔgyaa ho.
Na mannwodow ho dɛ mebɛkã Nyankopɔn apam nyina makyerɛ hom.
Hom nhwɛ homho yie, nye nguankuw a Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ahyɛ hom hɔn do ahwɛfo no nyina, dɛ hom bɛnyɛn Nyankopɔn asɔr a ɔdze nankasa no bɔgyaa enya no.
Na minyim dɛ, mokɔ ekyir no, mpataku abɔyafo bɛba hom do, na wonnkegyaa nguankuw no;
eso homankasa hom mu nyimpa bɔsoɛr a wɔbɛkã nsɛnkyɛw dze atwe esuafo no edzi hɔn ekyir.
Dɛm ntsi hom nweɔn, na hom nkaa dɛ mfe ara ebiasa anago nye ewia minngyaa dɛ medze nyinsu tu hom mu biara fo.
Na nkyii, esnuanom, medze hom hyɛ Nyankopɔn nsa nye n'adom asɛm a otum dɛ ɔtow hom do, na ɔma hom egyapadze wɔ hɔn a wɔatsew hɔn ho nyina mu no.
M'enyi ammber obiara no dwɛɛtɛɛ anaa ne sika anaa n'atar.
Homankasa hom nyim dɛ dza ohiaa me nye hɔn a wɔka mo ho no,nsa yi ano edwuma na medze minyae.
Adze nyina mu makyerɛ hom dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ hom yɛ edwuma dze hwɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw no, na hom kaa Ewuradze Jesus asɛm a ɔkãa dɛ, ɔma yɛ nhyira kyɛn ɔgye.
Na ɔkãa dɛm no, obuu ntwɛr nye hɔn nyina yɛɛ asɔr.
Na hɔn nyina sūu pii, na wɔtɔɔ Paul kɔn ho fifeew n'ano,
na dza ɔyɛɛ hɔn yaw kɛse nye asɛm a ɔakã dɛ worunnhu n'enyim bio no. Na wokegyaa no wɔ hɛn no mu.
21: Na ɔbaa dɛ yɛtwee hɛnho fii hɔn nkyɛn na yetui no, yɛnam tsenn baa Kos, na n'adzekyee no yedur Rhodes, na yefii hɔ baa Patara;
na yehun hɛn a orutwa mu kɔ Phœnicia no, yɛkɔr mu na yetui.
Na yehun Cyprus no, yegyaa no bankum, na yɛkɔr Syria, na yebodwiir Tyre: Na hɔ na hɛn no rukotu n'adzesoa egu.
Na yekohun esuafo no no, yɛtsenaa hɔ nda esuon: Hɔn na wɔnam Sunsum no mu kãa kyerɛɛ Paul dɛ mma onntu anan nnsi Jerusalem.
Na ɔbaa dɛ yewiee nda no dzi no, yesii mu kɔr hɛn kwan; na hɔn nyina nye hɔn yernom nye hɔn mba begyaa hɛn kwan bodur ntwer wɔ mpoano hɔ sɔree,
na yɛkrakraa hɛnho no, yɛkɔr hɛn mu, na hɔn so wɔsanee kɔr hɔn efiefi.
Na yewiee ɔkwan a ofi Tyre twa no, yekodur Ptolemais na yekekyiaa enuanom no, na yedzii hɔn nkyɛn da kor.
Na adze kyee no, yefii hɔ na yɛbaa Cæsarea; na yɛkekyiaa enuanom no, na yɛkɛhɛɛn asɛmpakafo Philip a ofi beesuon no mu no ne fie kɛtsenaa hɔ.
Ɔno na ɔwɔ mbabaa baanan, mbaabun a wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm.
Na yɛkyɛɛr hɔ nda kakra ara yie no, nkɔnhyɛnyi bi a ne dzin dze Aabus fii Judæa bae.

Na ɔbaa hɛn nkyɛn no, ɔfaa Paul n'abɔdo, na ɔdze kyekyeer nankasa ne nan nye ne nsa, na ɔsee dɛ, mbrɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no se nye yi, dɛmara na Jewfo a wɔwɔ Jerusalem no bɛkyekyer ɔbarimba a abɔdo yi yɛ nedze, na woeyi no ahyɛ amanamamfo nsa.
Na yɛtsee yinom no, yɛnye hɔn a wofi kurow no mu no serɛɛ no dɛ mma ɔnnkɔ Jerusalem.
Nna Paul buaa dɛ, hom reyɛ dɛn nye yi, na hom rusū rububu m'akoma yi? Na mesiesie moho dɛ, nnyɛ wɔbɛkyer me nko, na eso mubowu wɔ Jerusalem wɔ Ewuradze Jesus ne dzin ntsi.
Na ɔamma hɛn aso no, yegyaa dɛ, Ewuradze ne pɛ nyɛ hɔ.
Na nda no ekyir no, yɛboaboaa hɛnho kɔr Jerusalem.
Na Cæsarea esuafo no mu bi so nye hɛn kɔree, dze Mnason Cyprusnyi bi a ɔyɛ osuanyi dadaw so bae a yɛrebɛtsena ne nkyɛn.
Na yedur Jerusalem no, enuanom no gyee hɛn enyigyedo.
Na da a ɔkaa do no, Paul nye hɛn kɔr James nkyɛn; na mpanyimfo no nyina wɔ hɔ bi.
Na okyiaa hɔn no, ɔkãa ndzɛmba a Nyankopɔn nam no som do akɛyɛ wɔ amanaman mu nkorkor kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na wɔtsee no, wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam; na wɔsee no dɛ, onua, ehu mpempem a wɔagye edzi wɔ Jewfo mu, na hɔn nyina bɔ mbɔdzen wɔ mbra no ho;
na wɔatse wo ho asɛm dɛ ekyerɛkyerɛ Jewfo a wɔwɔ amanaman mu nyina dɛ wɔndan Moses ngya, na ekã kyerɛ hɔn dɛ mma wontwa hɔn mba twatsia, eso mma wonndzi amambra no do.
Na afei wɔyɛ no dɛn? ɔyɛ dɛn ara a wɔbɛtse dɛ aba.
Dɛm ntsi yɛ dza yɛrese wo yi: Yɛwɔ mbarimba baanan a woedzi nsew;
iyinom na fa hɔn na enye hɔn nkoguar homho, na tua kaw ma hɔn ma wonyi hɔn tsir; na hɔn nyina nhu dɛ nokwar biara nnyi wo ho asɛm a wɔtsee no mu, na mbom wankasa so enam pɛpɛɛpɛ idzi mbra no do.
Na amanamanfo a wɔagye edzi no ho dze, yɛkyerɛwee kobuu atsɛn dɛ wonyi hɔho mfi nam a wɔdze abɔ afɔr ama abosom, nye bɔgya, nye mbowa a wɔahyɛ hɔn fõ, nye ndwamansɛm ho.
Nna Paul faa mbarimba no, na n'adzekyee no ɔnye hɔn guaar hɔnho no, ɔkɔr asɔrfi no mu, dɛ ɔrekɛkyerɛ ahoguar nda no n; ewiei, na wɔakɔbɔ afɔr ama hɔn nyina nkorkor.

Na nda esuon reyɛ ewie sõ no, Jewfo a wofi Asia hun no asɔrfi mu no wɔbɔɔ nyi, padodow no nkenyan, na wɔdze nsa suoo no mu, 28., tsēaa mu dɛ, Isreal mbarimba, hom mboa: Oyi nye nyimpa no a ɔkyerɛkyerɛ nyimpa nyina wɔ mbea nyina tsia ɔman nye mbra nye bea yi: Na ɔdze fī abɛkã krɔnkrɔn-bea ha yi.
Nna woedzi kan ehu ephesusnyi Trophimus nye ɔno wɔ kurow mu hɔ, ɔno na wosusuu dɛ Paul dze no akɔ asɔrfi mu.
Na kurow no nyina bɔɔ twir, na nkorɔfo no dze mbirika bɔboaa ano; na wosuoo Paul mu, na wɔtwee no fii asɔrfi no mu; na ntsɛmara wɔtotoow mbobow no mu.
Na wɔrohwehwɛ eku no no, nsɛm no kodur nsordaafokuw no mu ɔsafohen panyin n'asomu dɛ Jerusalem nyina abɔ ebutuw;
ɔno na ntsɛmara ɔfaa nsordaafo nye ɔhamumpanyin, na ɔdze mbirika kɔr hɔn do; na wohun ɔsafohen panyin no nye nsordaafo no, wogyaa Paul hwe.
Nna ɔsafohen panyin no twee bɛnee, na obosuoo no mu, na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn ebien nto no; na obisaa ne nyimpa ban nye dza ɔayɛ.
Na binom tsēaa mu dɛm, binom so tsēaa mu dɛm, wɔ nyimpadodow no mu; na dede no ntsi onntum nnhu no nokwar no, ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa no mbra aban no mu.
Na odur mpombaa no do no, ɔbaa dɛ nyimpadodow no hɔn gyigyeegye ntsi nsordaafo no soaa no;
na ɔman no mu nyimpadodow dzii ekyir tsēatseaa mu dɛ, wɔmfa no nkɔ!
Na wɔdze Paul rekɛhɛn aban no mu no, ɔsee ɔsafohen panyin no dɛ, Ana mowɔ kwan dɛ menkã asɛm bi menkyerɛ wo? Na ɔsee no dɛ,
Ana inyim Greek kasa? Ana nnyɛ ɔwo nye Egyptnyi a ndaano yi ɔyɛɛ sakasaka na ɔdze mbarimba a wofi ewudzifo no mu mpemanan kɔr sar do no bi?
Na Paul see dɛ, Meyɛ Jewnyi a mifi Tarsus wɔ Ciliciaz, kurownyi a mimmfi kurows a onnyi dzin mu, na meserɛ wo dɛ ma me kwan ma menkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no.
Na ɔmaa no kwan no nyaam ne nsa kyerɛɛ nkorɔfo no; na wɔyɛɛ tsinkomm no, ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn wɔ Hebrew kasa mu dɛ,
22: Enuanom nye egyanom hom ntsi m'anyi a miriyi makyerɛ hom yi.
Na wɔtsee dɛ ɔrekasa kyerɛ hɔn wɔ Hebrew kasa mu no, wɔyɛɛ komm koraa: Na ɔsee dɛ,
Meyɛ Jewnyi a wɔwoo me wɔ Tarsus wɔ Cilicia, na wɔnyɛɛn me kurow yi mu, wɔ Gamaliel anan ho, wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ me egyanom mbra no mu ketsee, na mobɔɔ Nyankopɔn ho mbɔdzen, dɛ mbrɛ hom nyina yɛ ndɛ yi;
na metaa ɔkwan yi do kɔr owu mu, mekyerkyeer mbarimba nye mbaa, na miyii hɔn mae, ma wɔdze hɔn koguu efiadze;

dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɔfopanyin no so nye mpanyimfo nyina dzi me dase: Hɔn hɔ so na mekɛgyee nwoma dɛ medze rekɛma enuanom no, mokɔr Damascus dɛ merekɛfa hɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ no so aba Jerusalem wɔ nkyehoma mu, ma wɔaatsea hɔn.
Na ɔbaa dɛ menam na mebɛbɛɛn Damascus no, bɛyɛ wigyinae, awerɛfir mu na kan kɛse fi sor bɛhyerɛnee botwaa mo ho hyiae.
Na mohwee daadze, na metsee ndze bi a ɔsee me dɛ, Saul, Saul, ɔyɛ dɛn na etaamo do yi?
Na mubuaa dɛ, woana nye wo, Ewuradze? Na ɔsee me dɛ, emi nye Nazarethnyi Jesus a etaa no do no.
N ahɔɔn a wɔnye me nam no hun kan no dze, na wɔanntse nyia ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ me no ne ndze.
Na mesee dɛ, ebɛn adze na menyɛ, Ewuradze? Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, soɛr, na kɔ Damascus, na hɔ na wɔbɛkã wo dza wɔahyɛ wo dɛ yɛ nyina ho asɛm.
Na kan no ne hyerɛn kɛse no ntsi munnhu adze no, hɔn a wɔnye me nam no dzedze me nsa dze me baa Damascus.
Na Ananias bi a ɔyɛ nyamesuronyi dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse a Jewfo a wɔwɔ hɔ nyina bɔɔ no dzin pa,
baa mo hɔ begyinaa me nkyɛn see me dɛ, Onua Saul, hu adze. Na dɔn no ara mu na memaa m'enyi do hwɛɛ no.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Hɛn egyanom Nyankopɔn no eyi wo ato hɔ dɛ ihu ne pɛ, na ihu ɔtseneneenyi no, na etse ndze wɔ n'anomu.
Na ebɛyɛ ne dasefo ama nyimpa nyina wɔ dza ehu nye dza atse ho.
Na afei, ebɛnadze ntsi na irikyinkyim? Soɛr ma wonnuma wo nhohor wo bɔn, an bɔ ne dzin.
Na ɔbaa dɛ mesanee baa Jerusalem, na miriyi mpaa wɔ asɔrfi mu no, me kra tɔɔ gon,
na muhun no na ɔsee me dɛ, yɛ har fi Jerusalem ntsɛm, osiandɛ wɔrenngye wo dase a ibedzi wɔ mo ho no.
Na mesee dɛ, Ewuradze, hɔnankasa nyim dɛ hɔn a wɔgye wo dzi nyina medze hɔn guu efiadze, na mohwee hɔn nhyiamudan nyina mu;
na wɔreka wo dasefo stephen bɔgyaa egu no, mo so migyinaa hɔ bi, na mepeen no wu do, na mohwɛɛ hɔn a wokun no no hɔn ntar do.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, Kɔ, na morosoma wo mefi ha akɔ ekyirkyir wɔ amanaman mu.
Na wotsiee no besii asɛm yi do, na wɔmaa hɔn ndze do see dɛ, wonyi dɛm nyimpa yi mfi asaase do: Na ɔnnsɛ dɛ ɔbɛtsena ase.
Na woruhuro, na wɔrotow hɔn ntar gu, na worutu huntuma gu ehum eny no,
