safohen panyin no hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa no mbra aban mu, na ɔkãa dɛ wɔmfa mpire mbisa no, ma oeehu dzekor a osian ntsi ma woruhuro gu no do yi.
Na wɔdze ahoma nguahoma dweer ne nsa no, Paul see ɔhamupanyin a ogyinaa hɔ no dɛ, Ana hom wɔ kwan dɛ hom kã nyimap a ɔyɛ Romenyi na wommbuu no fɔ mpire?
Na ɔhamupanyin no tsee no, ɔkɔr safohen panyin no hɔ kɛkãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na erebɛyɛ yi? Osiandɛ nyimpa yi yɛ Romenyi.
Na safohen panyin no bae bɛsee no dɛ, sɛ eyɛ Romenyi a, kã kyerɛ me. Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyew.
Na ɔsafohen panyin no buaa dɛ, Medze sika kɛse na medze nyaa ɔmanyiyɛ yi. Na Paul see dɛ, emidze, wɔdze woo me.
Dɛm ntsi ntsɛmara hɔn a woribebisa no no fii ne nkyɛn, na ɔsafohen payin no so hun dɛ ɔyɛ Romenyi na dɛ ɔakyekyer no no, osuroi.

Na adze kyee no, na ɔpɛɛ dɛ ohu dzekor a osian ntsi ma Jewfo nye no robɔ nkuro no no nokwar no, ɔsaan no na ɔhyɛɛ asɔfompanyin nye baguafo no nyina dɛ wombehyia, na ɔdze Paul sianee bae begyinaa hɔn enyim.
23: Na Paul gyeen n'enyi hwɛɛ baguafo no, ɔsee dɛ, enuanom, tsibowa pa nyina na medze mabɔ me bra mama Nyankopɔn mebesi ndɛ yi.
Na ɔsɔfopanyin Ananias hyɛɛ hɔn a wogyinaa ne nkyɛn no dɛ wɔmbɔ n'ano.
Paul see no dɛ, Nyankopɔn bɔbɔ wo, wo fasu a wɔahoa: Na etse hɔ rubu me atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse, na ibu mbra no do hyɛ dɛ wɔmbɔ me?
Na hɔn a wogyinaa hɔ no see no dɛ, ereyaw Nyankopɔn sɔfopanyin?
Na Paul see dɛ, enuanom, minnyim dɛ ɔyɛ sɔfopanyin: na wɔakyerw dɛ, mma nnkasa wo man mu tsitsir ho bɔn.
Na Paul hun dɛ ɔfā yɛ Sadduceefo, na ɔfã yɛ Phariseefo no, ɔtsēaa mu wɔ guamu hɔ dɛ, enuanom, meyɛ Phariseenyi, nye Phariseefo ba: Ewufo no hɔn enyidado nye hɔn soɛr ntsi na worubu me atsɛn yi.
Na ɔkãa dɛm no, akasakasa baa Phariseefo no nye Sadduceefo no ntamu, na nyimpadodow no mu paae.
Na Sadduceefo no se dɛ owusoɛr anaa ɔbɔfo anaa sunsum biara nnyi beebi: Na Phariseefo no dze wɔkã ne nyina.
Na wɔtsēatseaa mu kɛse; na kyerɛwfo a wɔwɔ Phariseefo afamu no bi soɛree kãa dɛ, yennhu bɔn biara wɔ nyimpa yi mu: na sɛ sunsum anaa bɔfo akasa akyerɛ no a, ebɛn mbɔ a?
Na akasakasa pii soɛree no safohen panyin no suroo dɛ wɔbɛtsetsew Paul mu ntsi, ɔhyɛɛ nsordaafo no dɛ wonsian nkohwim no wɔ hɔn nsamu, na wɔmfa no nkɔ aban mu.
Na anago a odzi do no, Ewuradze begyinaa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, hyɛ dzen: Na dɛ mbrɛ edzi mo ho dase wɔ Jerusalem yi, dɛmara so na ɔse dɛ ikedzi dase wɔ Rome so.
Na adze kyee no, Jewfo no pamee bobɔɔ hɔnho ndua dɛ worinndzidzi, eso wɔronnom, gyedɛ woeku Paul anasaana.
Na hɔn a wodzii bɔtɔboa yi no bɔbor eduanan.
Na wɔbaa asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo no hɔ bɛsee dɛ, yɛabobɔ hɛnho ndua dɛ hwee rennkã hɛn ano gyedɛ yeeku Paul anasaana.
Na afei hom nye baguafo no nkɛkã nkyerɛ safohen panyin no dɛ ɔmfa no nsian mbra hom hɔ, dɛ gyama hom ribebisa no ho asɛm yie: Na hɛndze, ɔrotwe bɛn no, yeesiesie hɛnho dɛ yeboku no.
Na Paul no wɔfase ba tsee hɔn tsɛw no, ɔkɔree kɛhɛɛn aban no mu kɛkãa kyerɛɛ Paul.
Na Paul frɛɛ ɔhamupanyin kor baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, fa aberantsɛ yi kɛma safohen panyin no, na ɔwɔ asɛm bi kã kyerɛ no.
Na ɔfaa na dze no kɔr safohen panyin no nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Paul daduanyi no frɛɛ me baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔserɛɛ me dɛ memfa aberantsɛ yi membrɛ wo, na ɔwɔ asɛm bi kã kyerɛ wo.
Na safohen panyin no suoo ne nsamu nye no kɔr nkyɛn beebi, na obisaa no dɛ, ebɛnadze na ewɔ kã kyerɛ me.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ɔkyena fa Paul sian bra bagua mu, ma aayɛ dɛ woribebisa no ho asɛm yie.
Na mma nntsie hɔn: Na hɔn mu bɔbor eduanan retsɛw no a wɔabobɔ hɔnho ndua dɛ worinndzidzi, eso wɔronnom gyedɛ woeku no anasaana; na sesei yi woesie hɔnho rotweɔn wo hɔ anohoba.
Na safohen panyin no maa aberantsɛ no kɔree, na ɔbraa no dɛ, mma nnkã nnkyerɛ bi dɛ abɔ yi dzin akyerɛ me.
Na ɔfrɛɛ ɔhamumpayin no beenu baa ne nkyɛn see dɛ, Hom nsiesie nsordaafo ahaenu, nye mpɔnkɔfo eduosuon, nye peaatofo ahaenu, ma wɔnkɔ Cæsarea anago dɔn a otsia ebiasa no mu;
na wɔnhwehwɛ mbowa so, na wɔmma Paul ntsɛna do, na wɔmfa no nkɔ dwudwoodwo nkɛma ambrado Feliɛ.
Na ɔkyerɛɛw nwoma a ɔtse dɛm yi:
Claudsius Lysias kyia ambrado Feliɛ.
Ɔbarimba yi Jewfo no kɛfaa no dɛ nkyɛ woboku no, na menye nsordaafo kɔr hɔn do kɛgyee no, metsee dɛ ɔyɛ Romenyi ntsi.
Na mepɛe mehu dzekor a wɔdze too no do no, medze no baa hɔn bagua mu;
na muhun dɛ hɔn mbra ho nsɛmbisa ntsi na wɔnye no wɔ nkuro, na wɔammfa biriba a ɔsɛ wu anaaso nkyehoma annto no do.
Na wotuu me ehuntsi dɛ wɔretsɛw ɔbarimba no, ntsɛmara na mosomaa no wɔ wo nkyɛn, na mahyɛ n'atoafo no so dɛ wɔmbɛkã dza wɔwɔ wɔ no ho wɔ w'enyim.
Na nsordaafo no faa Paul dɛ mbrɛ wɔhyɛɛ hɔn no ara, na wɔdze no kɔr Antipatris anago no.
Na adze kyee no, wɔmaa mpɔnkɔfo no dze no kɔree, na wɔsanee baa aban mu;
na hɔndze wokodur Cæsarea, na woyii nwoma no maa ambrado no, wɔdze Paul so kegyinaa n'enyim.
Na ɔkenkaan nwoma no wiei no, obisaa ɔmansin kor a ofi mu; na ɔtsee dɛ ofi Cilicia no,
ɔsee dɛ, w'atoafo no ba a, nna mibetsie wo. Na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa no nsie Herod aban mu.
24: Na nda enum ekyir no, ɔsɔfopanyin Ananias nye mpanyimfo no binom nye ɔkyeame bi Tertullus sianee bae, na hɔn na wɔbɔbɔɔ Paul ho nkuro kyerɛɛ ambrado no.
Na wɔfrɛɛ no no, Tertullus hyɛɛ asebɔɔ nkuro dɛ, ofir dɛ yɛnam wo do enya asomdwee pii, nye ɔmansesɛw a ɔman wo nyimdzee do baa man yi mu,
okunyin Feliɛ, yinom nyina yɛdze ndaase nyina gye daa wɔ mbea nyina.
Na meremma asɛm no awar wo pii ntsi, meserɛ wo fa w'adom tsie hɛn kakra.
Na yeehu ɔbarimba yi dɛ ɔyɛ obusuyɛfo, na ɔdze mansotwe ba Jewfo nyina mu wɔ wiadze nyina, na ɔyɛ Nazareth fɛkufo no mu akɔtweaba;
na ɔsɔe hwɛe so dɛ ɔdze fi bɛkã asɔrfi no: Ɔno na yɛkɛkyeer no: na nkyɛ yɛpɛɛ dɛ yɛnam hɛn mbra no do bu no atsɛn;
na safohen panyin Lysias baa hɛn do, na ɔdze enyimpi bohwiim no wɔ hɛn nsamu kɔree, na ɔhyɛɛ n'atoafo dɛ wɔmbra wo hɔ;
na woara so epɛ no mu a, ibotum ehu dza osian ntsi a yɛnye no robɔ nkuro nyina.
Na Jewfo no so foaa no do dɛ ndzɛmba yi tse dɛm.
Na ambrado no too Paul nsa dɛ ɔnkasa no, Paul buaa dɛ, Susuampa dɛ minyim dɛ ifitsii eyɛɛ ɔman yi tsɛbuafo edzi mfe pii ntsi, medze akomatɔmu miyi m'ano:
na ibotum ehu dɛ ɔmmbor dodu ndaebein na mokɔr Jerusalem dɛ morokɔsɔr;
na woennhu me asɔrfi mu anaa nhyiamudan mu anaa kurow mu hɔ, dɛ menye bi rekasa anaadɛ meretan nyimpadodow enyi.
Eso worunntum nnkyerɛ ndzɛmba a wɔrotõatoa m'ano wɔ ho yi.
Na iyidze mepaa mu mekã kyerɛ wo dɛ, ɔkwan a wɔfrɛ no fɛkuwsɛm no mu na mosom m'egyanom Nyankopɔn, dɛ megye ndzɛmba a wɔakyerɛw wɔ mbra no nye nkɔnhyɛfo no mu midzi;
na mowɔ Nyankopɔn ho enyidado a hɔnara so hwɛ no kwan no, dɛ owusoɛr bi bɛba a hɔn a wɔtsen nye hɔn a wɔnntsen so bɔsoɛr.
Na iyi mu na mo so mobɔ bra dɛ mibenya tsibowa a ntotoanamu nnyi mu wɔ Nyankopɔn nye nyimpa afamu daa.
Na mfe pii ekyir no, mebaa dɛ medze ayɛyɛdze merebrɛ me man, nye afrɔbɔdze;
na iyi mu na wohun me wɔ asɔrfi mu dɛ meguar moho, eso menndzi nyimpadodow anaa gyigyeegye bi; na jewfo bi a wofi Asia,
hɔn na ɔsɛ dɛ nkyɛ wɔba w'enyim, sɛ wɔnye me wɔ asɛm bi a wɔnye me bɔbɔ nkuro.
Anaaso iyinom ara a wogyina ha yi nkã dɛ, migyinaa baguafo no enyim no, wohun bɔnyɛ bi wɔ mo ho
ka asɛm kor yi a migyinaa hɔn mu no metsēaa mu kãa dɛ, Ewufosoɛr ntsi na worubu me atsɛn ndɛ yi.
na Feliɛ nyim ɔkwan no ho asɛm yie no ntsi, ɔpeem hɔn adze dɛ, sɛ safohen panyin Lysais ba a, mubotwa hom asɛm yi do.
Na ɔhyɛɛ ɔhamupanyin no dɛ ɔmfa Paul nsie, na ɔmma ondzi noho, na dɛ mma onnsiw n'amanyimfo bi kwan dɛ wɔbɔsom no.
Na nda bi ekyir Feliɛ nye ne yer Drusilla a ɔyɛ Jewnyi bae, na ɔsomae kɛfrɛɛ Paul, na otsiee gyedzi a ɔwɔ Christ Jesus mu ho asɛm.
Na ɔrekã tsenenee, nye enyidahɔ, nye atsɛmbu a ɔreba ho asɛm no, Feliɛ bɔɔ hu na obuaa dɛ, sesei dze kɔ; na minya ho adagyer a, mebɛma wɔbɛfrɛ wo.
Na n'enyi daa kwan so dɛ Paul bɛma no sika: Dɛm ntsi daa ɔmaa wɔkɛfrɛɛ no, na ɔnye no twee nkɔmbɔ.
Na mfe ebien durii no, Porcius Festus bedzi Feliɛ ananmu; na Feliɛ pɛɛ dɛ ɔsɔ Jewfo enyi ntsi, ogyaa Paul wɔ nkyehoma mu.
25: Na afei Festus baa ɔmansin no mu no, ne ndaansa ekyir no ofii Cæsarea kɔr Jerusalem.
Na asɔfompanyin Jewfo etsitsir no kaa asɛm tsiaa Paul kyerɛɛ no, na wɔserɛɛ adom wɔ no hɔ dɛ,
ɔsoma ma wɔnkɛfa Paul mbra Jerusalem; na nkyɛ wɔaatsɛw no kwan mu eku no.
Na Festus dze, obuaa dɛ wɔdze Paul risie wɔ Cæsarea, na nankasa so ɔnnkɛkyɛr na ɔakɔ hɔ.
Na ɔsee dɛ, dɛm ntsi hom mma hom mu hɔn a wɔwɔ tum nye me nsian nkɔ, na sɛ biribi a ɔnnsɛ wɔ ɔbarimba yi mu a, wɔnye no nkɔbɔ nkuro.
Na odzii hɔn mu bɛyɛ nda awɔtwe anaa dadu no, osianee kɔr Cæsarea; na adze kyee no, na ɔkɛtsenaa asɛndzigua do no, ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa Paul mbra.
Na ɔbae no, Jewfo a woefi Jerusalem esian aba no bɔbɔɔ no ho taban, na wɔdze nsɛmbɔn pii a ɔyɛ dur tõatoaa no a hɔnara woenntum annkyerɛ mu;
na Paul yii n'ano dɛ, Jewfo mbra o, asɔrfi o, Cæsar o, mennyɛɛ bɔn biara minntsiae.
Na Festus pɛɛ dɛ onya Jewfo enyimpa ntsi, obuaa Paul see dɛ, Epɛ dɛ ekɔ Jerusalem ma woeebu wo ndzɛmba yi ho atsɛn wɔ m'enyim anaa?
Na Paul see dɛ, Migyina Cæsar asɛndzigua enyim, mbrɛ ɔsɛ dɛ wobu me astɛn: Jewfo dze, mennyɛɛ hɔn bɔn bi, dɛ mbrɛ woara so inyim yie.
Na sɛ mayɛ bɔn, anaa sɛ mayɛ biribi a ɔsɛ wu a, mommpow dɛ mubowu; na sɛ ndzɛmba a yinom rotõa m'ano wɔ ho yi nnyi mu a, obi nntum mmfa me nnkyɛ hɔn.Emidze medan Cæsar.
Nna Festus nye baguafo no tuu egyina no, obuaa dɛ, edze akɛdan Cæsar a: Cæsar hɔ na ebɔkɔ.
Na nda bi ekyir no, ɔhen Agrippa nye Bernice baa Cæsarea, na wobekyiaa Festus.
Na wodzii hɔ nda pii no, Festus dze Paul ho asɛm no too ɔhen no enyim dɛ, ɔbarimba bi wɔ hɔ Feliɛ gyaa no mpokyerɛ mu;
ɔno no mokɔr Jerusalem no, asɔfompanyin nye Jewfo mpanyin no kãa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ me serɛɛ me dɛ mumbu no atsɛn.
Na mubuaa hɔn dɛ ɔnnyɛ Romefo amambra dɛ wobeyi nyimpa bi ama, gyedɛ nyia wɔrobɔ no ho nkuro no nye no nkurobɔfo no edzi enyim na enyim, na onya kwan yi n'ano wɔ dza wɔdze ato no do ho ansaana.
Dɛm ntsi wobehyiaa ha no, mannyɛ ekyim, na adze kyee no mekɛtsenaa asɛndzigua do na mehyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa ɔbarimba no mbra.
Na no nkurobɔfo no begyinaa hɔ no, wɔannkã emmumyɛdze a mususui no mu biara ho asɛm annto no do,
na hɔnankasa hɔn nyamesosm ho ekyingye a wɔnye no gyee no ho, na Jesus bi a oewu a Paul se dɛ ɔtse ase no ho dze.
Na dɛ minnyim mbrɛ mebɛyɛ mabɔhwehwɛ iyinom mu ntsi, mibisaa no dɛ ɔpɛ dɛ ɔbɔkɔ Jerusalem ma woeekobu no atsɛn wɔ nsɛm yi ho anaa.
Na Paul dze asɛm no kɛdaan ɔhempɔn no dɛ wɔmfa no nsie ma onkodu n'enyim ntsi, mehyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa no nsie ma onkodu dɛ mobɔsoma ma wɔdze no akɛma Cæsar.
Nna Agippa see Festus dɛ, nkyɛ mo so mepɛ dɛ mitsie nyimpa no. Na ɔsee dɛ, ɔkyena ibetsie no.
Na afei adze kyee no, Agippa nye Bernice dze ahoka kɛse bae, na wɔnye asafohen mpanyin no binom, nye kurow no mu mbapɔmba no, kɔr mbrɛ wotsie asɛm hɔ, na Festus hyɛe no, wɔdze Paul bae.
Na Festus see dɛ, ɔhen Agippa, nye mbarimba a hom nye hɛn wɔ ha nyina, hom hwɛ nyimpa yi a Jewfo nyimpadodow nyina serɛɛ me tsiaa no wɔ Jerusalem nye ha, na wɔtsēatseaa mu dɛ ɔnnsɛ dɛ ɔtsena ase bio.
Na muhun dɛ ɔannyɛ biribi aɔsɛ wu; na nankasa dze asɛm no akɛdan ɔhempɔn no, mahyɛ dɛ mobɔsoma no hɔ.
Na minnyi biribi pa bi a mebɛkyerɛw makɛma mo wura wɔ no ho. Dɛm ntsi na medze no mbra hom enyim, nkanka ɔwo, ɔhen Agrippa, ama wowie mu pɛ a, meenya biribi a mebɛkyerɛw.
Na ɔyɛ me dɛ ɔnnyɛ nyansa dɛ medze daduanyi mobɔkɔ, na mennkɛkyerɛ asɛm kor a wɔdze ato no do.
26: Na Agrippa see Paul dɛ, wɔama wo kwan dɛ kã w'sɛm wo kwan dɛ kã w'asɛm. Nna Paul tseen ne nsa yii n;ano dɛ:
Mubu moho dɛ menya ahomka ɔhen Agrippa, dɛ miribeyi m'ano wɔ w'enyim ndɛ, wɔ ndzɛmba nyina a Jewfo dze tõatoa m'ano ho
na kɛse nye dɛ ɔwodze awea amambra nye ekyingyesɛm a ɔwɔ Jewfo mu nyina ho: dɛm ntsi meserɛ wo dɛ to wo bo adze tsie me.
M'asetsena ofi mo mbofra mu a ɔhyɛɛ ase wɔ mankasa me man mu, nye Jerusalem no, Jewfo nyina nyim:
Na wonyim me fi ahyɛse, sɛ wɔpɛ dɛ wodzi dase a, dɛ moforaa fɛkuw a wotua hɔn som no ho mobɔɔ me bra dɛ Phariseenyi.
Na afie migyina ha na worubu me atsɛn wɔ anohoba a Nyankopɔn dze maa egyanom no ho enyidado nsti yi:
Ɔno na hɛn mbusuakuw duebien no som enyiberdo adzesaa nye adzekyee, dze hɔn enyi to do dɛ wobenya. Na enyidado yi ho ntsi, ɔhen, na Jewfo rotõatoa m'ano yi.
Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom bu yi asɛm a wɔnngye nndzi, dɛ Nyankopɔn nyan ewufo?
Na ampaara mankasa so modween moho dɛ ɔsɛ me dɛ mebɛyɛ ndzɛmba pii metsia Jesus Nazarethnyi no ne dzin.
Na iyi so na meyɛe wɔ Jerusalem: Minyaa asɔfompanyin no hɔ tum no, medze ahotsewfo no pii guu efiadze, na sɛ woruku hɔn a, m'ano wɔ mu bi.
Na motɔɔ dɛ metsēa hɔn wɔ nhyiamudan nyina mu, na mehyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnkã ebususɛm; na mobɔɔ hɔn do dam koraa no metaa hɔn do kɔr ananaben nkurow do.
Ɔno mu na menam rokɔ Damascus na medze asɔfompanyin hɔn tum nye ho kwan no,
wigyinae, ɔhen, muhun kwan no do kan bi a ofi sor a ɔkyɛn ewia hyerɛn dɛ oebotwa emi nye hɔn a wɔnye me nam no ho ehyhia.
Na hɛn nyina hwehwee daadze no, metsee ndze bi a ɔrekasa kyerɛ me wɔ Hebrew kasa mu dɛ, Saul, Saul, ɔyɛ dɛn na etaa mo do yi? Ɔyɛ dzen ma wo dɛ na ebɔwɔ dadzepoma ano ntsia.
Na mesee dɛ, Woana nye wo, Ewuradze? Na Ewuradze see dɛ, emi nye Jesus a etaa no do no.
Na soɛr gyina w'anan do: Na iyi ntsi na meyi moho akyerɛ wo, dɛ mibeyi wo ato hɔ dɛ ndzɛmba a ehu yi nye dza miribeyi moho akyerɛ wo wɔ mu no ho somfo nye dasefo;
na mibeyi wo wɔ ɔman no nye amanaman a morosoma wo wɔ hɔn hɔ no nsamu,
dɛ kobue hɔn enyi na kɛdan hɔn fi sum mu bra kan mu, ma woeefi Satan tum mu aba Nyankopɔn hɔ, na woeenya bɔnfakyɛ nye egyapadze wɔ hɔn a wɔnam gyedzi a ɔwɔ mo mu do enya ahotsewee no mu.
Dɛm ntsi, ɔhen Agrippa, mannyɛ enyidoadzehu a ofi sor no ho asoɔdzen:
na midzii kan kyerɛɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ Damascus, nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Jerusalem so, nye Judæa asaase do nyina, nye amanaman no, dɛ wonnu hɔnho na wɔsan mbra Nyankopɔn hɔ, na wɔnye ndwuma a ɔfata nnuho.
Iyi ntsi na Jewfo no bɛkyeer me wɔ asɔrfi mu, hwehwɛɛ dɛ woku me.
Na dɛ minyaa Nyankopɔn hɔ mboa ntsi, na migyina hɔ dze ebodu ndɛ, na midzi dase kyerɛ akɛse nye nkakraba nyina, na mennkã asɛm biara gyedɛ dza nkɔhyɛfo nye Moses nyina kãa dɛ ɔbɛba mu nkotoo;
mbrɛ Christ otwar dɛ obohu amandze, na oedzi kan ho nam ewufosoɛr mu akã kan ho asɛm akyerɛ ɔman no nye amanamamfo.
Na oyii n'ano dɛm no, Festus dze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu dɛ, Paul, egyim: Nwomasua dodow robɔ wo dam,
Na Paul see dɛ, mommbɔɔ dam, obirɛmpɔn Festus, na mekã nokwar nye enyidahɔ nsɛm.
Na ɔhen a medze ndam kasa kyerɛ no yi nyim nsɛm yi mu: Na megye dzi dɛ yinom biara nnsuma no; wɔannyɛ yi wɔ kukua mu.
Ɔhen Agrippa, egye nkɔnhyɛfo no dzi anaa? Minyim dɛ egye dzi.
Na Agrippa see Paul dɛ, aka kuma na nkyɛ aama mayɛ Christain.
Na Paul see dɛ, mepɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn mu dɛ, aka kuma o, aka pii o, nkyɛ nnyɛ wo nko, na hɔn a woritsie me ndɛ nnyina aayɛ dɛ mara, gyedɛ nkyehoma yi nko.
Na ɔhen no, nye ambrado no, nye Bernice, nye hɔn a wɔnye hɔn tse hɔ no soɛree;
na wɔkɔr nkyɛn beebi no, wɔkãe wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, nyimpa yi nnyɛ biribi a ɔsɛ owu anaadɛ nkyehoma.
Na Agrippa see Festus dɛ, sɛ nyimpa yi ammmfa annkɛdan Caesar a, nkyɛ woegyaa no.
27: Na wɔkãa dɛ yɛmfa nsuenyi nkɔ Italy no, woyii Paul nye mpokyerɛfo bi maa ɔhamupanyin bi a wɔfrɛ no Julius a ofi Augusta asafokum mu no.
Na yɛkɔr Adramyttium hɛn bi a ɔrobɔkɔ Asia afamu mu no, yetui, na Aristarchus, Macedonianyi bi a ofi Thessalonica, ka hɛn ho.
Na da a odzi do no, yekegyinaa Sidon; na Julius maa Paul enyimpa maa no kwan dɛ ɔnkɔ ne mfɛfo nkyɛn ma wɔaahwɛ no.
Na yetui fii hɔ no, yekoduaa Cyprus ase, osiandɛ mframa sii hɛn enyim.
Na yetwaa cilicia nye Pamphyia po no, yɛbaa Lycia kurow myra ho.
Na ɔhamupanyin no hun Aleɛandria hɛn bi a ɔrokɔ Italy wɔ hɔ no, ɔdze hɛn guu mu.
Ndafua pii na yɛnam bɔkɔɔ, na yɛfonae ana yɛreben Cnidus, na mframa amma hɛn ho kwan no, yekoduaa Crete ase kɛpaa Salmone ho;
na yɛberɛ berɛe paa ho no, yɛbaa beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Ahɛgyinae fɛɛfɛw no a Lasea kurow bɛn ho no.
Na yɛsɛɛ mber pii na nsuenyidua yɛɛ hu, dɛ mbuadadzi ber etwa mu dada ntsi no, Paul tuu hɔn fo,
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ewuranom, muhu dɛ akwantu yi amandze nye adzesɛɛ pii bɛba mu, nnyɛ eguaadze nye hɛn yi nko na hɛnakasa hɛn nkwa so.
Na ɔhamupanyinno gyee akyerɛkwan no nye hɛn no wura dzii kyɛɛn dza Paul kãe no.

Na osiandɛ ahɛngyinae no nntsɛw yie dɛ wobedzi awɔwber wɔ hɔ ntsi, hɔn mu pii kãa dɛ wobotu wɔ hɔ kyerɛ wobenya kwan edu Phœniɛ, Crete ahɛngyinae a odzi kɔ anee-pomu nye anee-habanmu no, na woedzi awɔwber.
Na pomu mframa bɔɔ faafaa no, wosusuu dɛ hɔn nsa aka dza ɔwɔ hɔn tsirmu no, wotuu sekyɛ duaa anoano kɛbɛɛn Crete.
Na annakyer na aahow dzendzen bi a wɔfrɛ no Euraɔuilo bɔe;
na okitsaa hɛn no, ma oenntum ennhyia mframa no, yegyaa hɛnho ma ɔpaar hɛn.
Na yɛdze yerɛdɛdɛɛdɛ kɛfaa supɔw bi a wɔfrɛ no Cauda ase no, ɔyɛɛ dzen ana yerutum susuo hɛmba no mu;
na wɔmaa no do no, wɔdze ndzɛmba wowaaw hɛn no kyekyeree; na wosuroo dɛ wɔbɔkɔ akɔhwɛ Syrtis anhweatɛkyɛmm mu ntsi, wɔhohɔɔr abradaadua no ma ɔpaar hɔn dɛm.
Na ehum no bɔɔ dzendzen dze hɛn kyinkyinii no, adze kyee no wotuu hɛn no mu ndzɛmba bi gui;
na da a otsia ebiasa no wɔdze hɔnankasa hɔn nsa totoow hɛn no ho ndzɛkumba gui.
Na nda pii ewia anaa nworaba mmfir, na mframa nnyɛkuma na ɔda hɛn do no, afei hɔn enyidado dɛ wɔbɛgye hɛn nkwa nyina yewee.
Na edziban annkã hɛn ano ma ɔrekyɛr no, Paul soɛree gyinaa hɔn finimfin see dɛ, mbarimba, ɔsɛ dɛ nkyɛ hom tsiee me, na nkyɛ hom emmfi Crete emmbenya amandze yi nye adzesɛɛ yi.
Na afei dze, mutu hom fo dɛ hom mma hom akoma ntɔ hom yamu; na obiara no nkwa rennhera wɔ hom mu gyedɛ hɛn yi.
Na anago yi Nyankopɔn a meyɛ nedze, na mosom no no, no bɔfoe begyinaa me nkyɛn
see dɛ, Paul, mma nnsuro: Otwar dɛ ibegyina Cæsar enyim; na hwɛ, Nyankopɔn dze hɔn a enye hɔn nam nyina akyɛ wo.
Dɛm ntsi, ewuranom, hom mma hom akoma ntɔ hom yamu: Na megye Nyankopɔn dzi dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔakã akyerɛ me.
Naaso otwar dɛ yekogu supɔw bi do.
Na ne dadu ndaanan anago no, wɔrepra hɛn kɔ ba wɔ Adria po do no, bɛyɛ esuom na hɛn no mu edwumayɛfo no dween dɛ yɛrebɛn asaase bi;
na wɔtoow susuhoma no, wohun dɛ ɔyɛ abasamu eduonu; na wɔkɔr enyim kakra na wɔtoow bio no, wohun dɛ ɔyɛ abasamu duenum.
Na wosuroo dɛ bi a yɛbɔkɔhwe abotan bi do ntsi, wɔtoo nsekyɛ anan wɔ hɛntu tweɔn adzekyee.
Na hɛn no mu edwumayɛfo no hwehwɛɛ dɛ woguan fi hɛn no mu, na wogyaa hɛmba no mu too po mu yɛɛ dɛ wɔrokɔto sekyɛ wɔ hɛnkan no,
Paul see ɔhamupanyin no nye nsordaafo no dɛ, sɛ iyinom anntsena hɛn yi mu a, hom rinnya nkwa.
Nna nsordaafo no twaa hɛmba no ne ntampehoma no, ma ɔhwee ase.
Na adze rebɛkye no, Paul serɛɛ hɔn nyina dɛ wondzidzi, dɛ, Ndɛ dadu ndaanan kora nna hom atsena edzi mbuada a hom mmfa hwee nnkã hom ano.
Dɛm ntsi meserɛ hom dɛ hom ndzidzi, na yi fa hom nkwa ho: Na nhwi kor rimmfi hom mu biara ne tsir do nntɔ.
Na ɔkãa dɛm no, ɔfaa paanoo, naa ɔdaa Nyankopɔn ase wɔ hɔn nyina enyim; na obubui hyɛɛ ase dzidzii.
Na hɔn nyina bo tɔɔ hɔn yamu, na hɔnankasa so faa edziban dzii.
Na hɛn a yɛwɔ hɛn no mu nyina yɛ akra ahaenu eduosuon esia.
Na wodzidzii mee no, wɔbɔɔ hɛn no har totoow ewifua no guu po mu.
Na adze kyee no, wonnyim asaase no n'adaa no; na wohun ɔdɔndɔn bi a ɔwɔ mpoano hɔ no, wotuu egyina dɛ sɛ wobotum a, wɔbɔtwe hɛn no akɔ hɔ.
Na wotwaa nsekyɛ no ahoma mu no, wogyaa mu guu po mu, na wɔsaan kutow no n'ahoma so; na wosii hɛnkan abradaa no maa mframa, na wɔdze too mpoano.
Na wɔbɔtɔɔ beebi a apo ebien hyia no, wɔdze hɛn no wenee; na ne kan ketsimii, na ɔkaa hɔ pitsinn, na no tun dze, asorɛkye no ne dzendzen bubuu no.
Na nsordaafo no tuu egyina dɛ woboku adaduafo no, mma obi aammbor ennguan.
Na ɔhamupanyin no, ɔpɛɛ dɛ ɔgye Paul nkwa ntsi, osiiw hɔn dza wosusui no ho kwan; na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ hɔn a wobotum abor mfa hɔnho nkyɛn po mu ndzi kan nkɔ daadze;
na nkaa no, binom butubutuuw ntaabow do, binom butututuuw hɛn no ho ndzɛmba bi do kɔree. Na mbrɛ ɔyɛe ma hɔn nyina nyaa nkwa dur daadze nye no.
28: Na yenyaa nkwa no, nna yehun dɛ supɔw no wɔfrɛ no Melita.
Na apɔtɔfo no yɛɛ hɛn adɔyɛ a ɔnnkã: Na wokūaa gya na wɔgyee hɛn nyina wɔ nsu a ɔrotɔ nye awɔw no ntsi.
Na Paul boaboaa mbabaaba ano guu gya no do no, ehurutsia fi hyew no mu bae bɛbrabraa ne nsa ho.
Na apɔtɔfo no hun abowa no dɛ ɔsɛn ne nsa ho no, wɔsee hɔnho nkorkor dɛ, ampaara nyimpa yi yɛ owudzifo a oefi po mu enya nkwa dze, naaso Awerdzi amma no kwan dɛ ɔtsena ase.
Na ɔpetsee abowa no kyeen gya mu, naaso hwee annyɛ no.
Na hɔndze, hɔn enyi daa kwan dɛ ɔrobɔhonhon, anaa ɔrobɔhwe ase ewu awerɛfir mu; na wɔhwɛe hwɛe na wohun dɛ biribi annyɛ no no, wɔsakyeer hɔn adwen dɛ onyame bi a.
Na apaamu hɔ ara na supɔw no mu otsitsir a ne dzin dze Publius n'asaase wɔ; ɔno na ɔgyee hɛn yɛɛ hɛn hɔho ndaansa hwɛɛ hɛn yie.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Publius n'egya da hɔ yar papu nye akokɔr: Ɔno na Paul kɔr ne nkyɛn kɔsɔree, na ɔdze ne nsa too no do yɛɛ no edur.
Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm no, nkaa no so a wɔyar wɔ supɔw no mu no bae, na wɔyɛɛ hɔn edur;
hɔn so na wɔdze enyidzi pii dzii hɛn, na yerubotu no, wɔdze ndɛmba a ohia hɛn guu hɛn no mu.
Na abosoom ebisaa ekyir no yesii Aleɛandria hɛn bi a oedzi awɔwber wɔ supɔw no mu a n'asɛnkyerɛdze nye Ntafo no mu kɔree.
Na yedur Syracuse no, yedzii hɔ ndaansa.
Na hɔ na yefii yɛkwaae baa Rhegium; na da kor ekyir no,pomu mframa bɔe, na n'adzekyee no yekodur Puteoli;
hɔ na yehun enuanom bi a wɔserɛɛ hɛn dɛ yɛntsena hɔn nkyɛn nda esuon; na mbrɛ yɛdze kodur Rome nye no.
Hɔ na enuanom no, wɔtsee hɛn nka no fii behyiaa hɛn wɔ Appius Guado, nye Nsãdansa; na Paul hUn hɔn no, ɔdaa Nyankopɔn ase na ɔhyɛɛ dzen.
Na yedur Rome mu no, ɔhamupanyin no dze mpokyerɛfo no maa Annkɔbea Safohen no, na Paul dze ɔmaa no ho kwan dɛ ɔnye sordaanyi a ɔhwɛ no no nkɛtsena mbrɛ ɔpɛ.

Na ɔbaa dɛ ndaansa ekyir no, ɔfrɛfrɛɛ Jewfo etsitsir no boaa ano; na wobehyiae no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Enuanom, mannyɛ biribi menntsia ɔman no anaa hɛn egyanom amambra, naaso woyii me dɛ daduanyi fii Jerusalem hyɛɛ Romefo nsa;
hɔn na wɔpɛɛ mu no, wɔpɛɛ dɛ wogyaa me osiandɛ woennhu okum-adze biara wɔ mo mu.
Na Jewfo kasae tsiae no, ɔhyɛɛ me dɛ medze m'asɛm kɛdan Cæsar: nnyɛ dɛ mowɔ biribi a medze bɔtoã me man bi a.
Na iyi ntsi na meserɛɛ hom dɛ hom bohu me na meserɛɛ hom dɛ hom bohu e na hom akasa akyerɛ me: na osian Isreal enyidado ntsi na wɔdze nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn yi ato me yi.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, hɛndze yennyaa wo ho nwoma bi mmfii Judæa, eso enuanom no mu biara mmbaa ha mmbɔbɔɔ kasee anaa ɔmmbɛkãa wo ho asɛm bɔn bi.
Na yɛpɛ dɛ yetsie wo dza edwen: na fɛkuw yi ho dze, yeyim dɛ wɔkasa tsia no wɔ mbea nyina.

Na wɔhyɛɛ no da no, piinara baa ne nkyɛn wɔ mbrɛ ɔsoɛe no; hɔn na ɔkyerɛɛ hɔn ase dzii Nyankopɔn ahenman ho dase, na ofitsi Moses mbra nye nkɔnhyɛfo no do kyerɛɛ hɔn Jesus ho asɛm mu fii anapa kesii ewimbir.
Na binom gyee dza ɔkãe no dzii, na binom so anngye enndzi.
Na wɔannsaa hɔnankasa hɔn mu no, wɔkɔree, na Paul kãa asɛm kor bi dɛ, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no nam nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah do kãa no yie kyerɛɛ hɛn egyanom dɛ,
Kɔ ɔman yi hɔ na se dɛ, ɔtse dze hom bɛtse, na hom renntse ase; na ɔhwɛ dze hom bɔhwɛ, na hom runnhu:

Na ɔman yi akoma epirim, na hɔn aso esiw ɔtse ho, na woemuamua hɔn enyi; amma wɔaammfa hɔn enyi ennhu adze, na wɔaammfa hɔn aso anntse asɛm, na wɔaammfa hɔn akoma anntse ase, na wɔaanndan na maannsa hɔn yarba.
Dɛm ntsi, hom nhu dɛ wɔasoma Nyankopɔn nkwagye no akɛma amanamamfo: na hɔn so wɔbɛtse.
Na ɔkãa dɛm no, Jewfo no kɔree, na wɔgyegyee ekyingye wɔ hɔn mu.
Na Paul tsenaa nankasa ne fi a otua kaw mu mfe ebien, na ɔgyee hɔn a wɔbaa ne nkyɛn nyina,
kãa Nyankopɔn ahenman no ho asɛm, na ɔdze ndam nyina kyerɛkyerɛɛ ndzɛmba a ɔfa Ewuradze Jesus Chris ho, na obi ennsiw no kwan.

1: Amos a ɔwɔ Tekoa nguanhwɛfo mu nsɛm a ohunii wɔ Isreal ho wɔ Judahhen Uzziah ber do, na Isrealhen Joash ne ba Jeroboam ber do, mfe ebien ansaana asaasewosow no reba.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze fi Zion bɔpɔw, na oefi Jerusaiem ɔama ne ndze do; na nguanhwɛfo no hɔn nguandzidzibea bedzi awerɛhow, na Carmel etsifi etwintwam.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Damascus mbrato ebiasa ntsi, ɛhɛɛ, anan ntsi, merenndan ne ntsēa no; osiandɛ ɔdze dadze ewuporow adze adwerew Gilead:
Na mobɔto Hazael ofi mu gya, na ɔahyew Benhadad ahemfie.
Na mubobubu Damascus adaban, na metwa aven bɔnsa mu ɔtsefo mefi hɔ, na nyina no a okitsa ahempoma no mefi Eden fie: Na Syriaman bɔkɔ ndɔmmum mu wɔ kir, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Gaza mbrato ebiasa ntsi, ɛhɛɛ, anan ntsi, merenndan ne ntsēa no; osiandɛ wɔfaa ɔman no nyinara ndɔmmum dɛ wɔdze hɔn rekɛhyɛ Edom nsa:
Na mobɔto Gaza ɔfasu mu ogya, na ɔahyew n'ahemfi no:
Na mubotwa Ashdod ɔtsefo mefi hɔ, na nyia no a okitsa ahempoma no mefi Ashkeion: Na madan me nsa etsia Ekron, na Philistiafo nkaa no hera, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Tyre mbrato ebiasa ntsi, ɛhɛɛ, anan ntsi, merenndan ne ntsēa no; osiandɛ woyii ɔman no nyinara hyɛɛ Edom nsa, na wɔannkaa enuanom ahyɛmudzi no:
Na mobɔto Tyre ɔfasu mu gya, na ɔahyew n'ahemfi no.

Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Edom mbrato ebiasa ntsi, ɛhɛɛ, anan ntsi, merenndan ne ntēa no; osiandɛ ɔdze afõwa tsiiw no nua, na ɔtoow ayamuhyehye nyina gui, na n'ebufuw tsetseew mu daa, na odzii n'abohur ekyir daa:
Na mobɔto Teman mu gya, na ɔahyew Bozrah ahemfi no.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Ammonmba hɔn mbrato ebiasa ntsi, ɛhɛɛ, anan ntsi, merenndan ne ntsēa no; osiandɛ wɔapaapaa Gilead enyinsemfo mu, ma wɔdze aatrɛ hɔn he mu:
Na mobɔto Rabbah ɔfasu mu gya, na ɔahyew n'ahemfi no, ɔdze esebɔ wɔ nkoda mu, ɔdze ehum wɔ ekyinehyia-mframa da mu:
Na hɔn hen bɔkɔ ndɔmmum, ɔno na n'asafohemfo bɔbɔ mu akɔ, Ewuradze na ɔse.
2: Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Moabmbrato ebiasa ntsi, ɛhɛɛ, anan ntsi, merenndan ne ntsēa no; osiandɛ ɔdze Edomhen mbiew hyeew kaadow:
Na mobɔto Moab gya, na ɔahyew kerioth ahemfi no; na Moab dze weɔɔweɔɔyɛ, na esebɔ, na akasamu ne ndze bowu:
Na mubotwa no mu atsɛmbufo mefi hɔ, na mekuku n'asafohemfo nyina makã no ho, Ewuradze na ɔse.

Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Judah mbrato ebiasa ntsi, ɛhɛɛ, anan ntsi, merenndan ne ntsea no; osiandɛ wɔapow Ewuradze ne mbra, na woenndzi n'ahyɛdze do, na hɔn atofosɛm a hɔn egyanom dzii ekyir no ama wɔafomfom:
Na mobɔto Judah gya, na ɔahyew Jerusalem ahemfi no.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Isreal mbrato ebiasa ntsi, ɛhɛɛ, anan ntsi, merendan ne ntsēa no; osiandɛ wɔatɔn ohianyi agye dwɛɛtɛɛ, na wɔatɔn ohianyi agye nsokota ha-na-na:
Hɔn a hɔn kɔn dɔ ohianyi n'etsifi asaase do huntuma, na wɔkyea ɔbrɛfo no kwan: Na ɔbarimba na n'egya bɔkɔ ababaawa kor ho, dze ehura me dzin krɔnkrɔn no ho:
Na wɔda ahoba tam do wɔ afɔrmbukyia nkyɛnmu, na wɔnom hɔn a wɔabɔ hɔn kaw no nsã wɔ hɔn Nyankopɔn fie.
Naaso mesɛɛ hɔn enyim Amorinyi a ne tsentsen tse dɛ cedar atsentsen, na no ho yɛ dzen dɛ esudur naaso mesɛɛ no nduadzewa wɔ sor, na no ndwow wɔ ase.
Eso emi na medze hom fii Egypt asaase do firii, na migyaa hom mfe eduanan wɔ sar no do, dɛ wɔmfa Amorinyi n'asaase no.
Na memaa hom mba binom do hyɛɛ hɔn nkɔnhyɛfo, na hom mberantse no binom meyɛɛ hɔn Nazarifo. Ao Israelmba, aso nnyɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ara bi nye no? Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na mbom hom maa Nazarifo nsã ma wɔnomee; na hom hyɛɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no dɛ, mma hom nnhyɛ nkɔm.
Hwɛ, mobɔhom hom do wɔ hom bea hɔ, dɛ mbrɛ hwiir a efiefi ahyɛ no mã no ɔhom adze do.
Na enguantu bɔbɔ ahoɔdzen mudzen, eso ɔkatakyi runntum noho gye:
Eso nyia okitsa egyen no rinngyina; na nyia n'anan ho yɛ har no renngye noho: Eso nyia ɔtse pɔnkɔ do no ɔrenngye noho:
Na nyia ɔwɔ akokodur wɔ akatakyi no mu no, ɔdze adagyaw boguan wɔ da no mu, Ewuradze na ɔse.
3: Israelmba e, hom ntsie asɛm bi a Ewuradze akã wɔ hom ho, wɔ ebusua nyina a miyii hɔn Egypt asaase do bae no ho dɛ,
hom nko ara na mehu hom wɔ asaase do mbusua nyina mu: Dɛm ntsi medze hom emumuyɛ nyina bɛba abɛserɛ hom.
Aso beenu bɔbɔ mu anantsew, gyedɛ wɔasaa ana?
Aso ogyata bɔpɔw kwaa mu, ber a onnyaa afonam biara? Ana ogyatafɔr bɛma ne ndze do wɔ no bɔn mu, ber a ɔnnkyeer biribiara?
Aso anoma bi bɔtõ efir wɔ asaase do, mbrɛ efir bi nnsuaa hɔ mma no? Aso efir bohuan efi famu, na ɔmmpaa hweeara?
Aso wɔbɔbɔ akasamu mu akɔ kurow mu, na ɔman no bo nnkotu? Aso mbusu bɛba kurow bi do, na nnyɛ Ewuradze yɛe?
Ampaara dɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn rennyɛ biribi, gyedɛ oeyi n'esumasɛm akyerɛ no nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no ansaana.
Ogyata apɔw, woana na onnkosuro? Ewuradze Nyankopɔn akasa, woana na ɔnnkɛhyɛ nkɔm?
Hom mbɔ no dawur wɔ Ashdod ahemfie, na Egypt asaase do ahemfie, na hom nse dɛ, hom mboa hom ano wɔ Samaria mbepɔw do, na hom nhwɛ no mu weɔɔweɔɔyɛ pii no, na nhyɛdo a ɔwɔ mu no.
Na wonnyim dza ɔtsen yɛ, Ewuradze na ɔse, hɔn a wɔhyehyɛ hɔn ahemfie enyimpidze an nwuradandze amaama.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Ahohiahianyi bi bɛba ebotwa asaase no ho ehyia: Na ɔdze w'ahoɔdzen efi wo ho ahwe famu, na wɔafa w'ahemfi no afo.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Dɛ mbrɛ guanhwɛfo hwim anan ebien, anaa asowasin bi fi ogyata anomu no; dɛmaa so na wobohwim Isrealmba a wɔtsetse Samaria kootsi mu dodow mu, na mpa do serekye nsundze do no.
Hom ntsie na hom ndzi Jacob fie dase, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, dɔm Ewuradze, na ɔse.
Na da a medze Isreal mbrato bɛba abɛserɛ no no, mebɛserɛ Beth-ei afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn, na ɔahwe ase.
Na mobɔbɔ awɔwber fi makã ɔhyewber fi ho; na asombɛn efi no bɛhera, na efi akɛse no aba ewiei, Ewuradze na ɔse.
4: Hom ntsie asɛm yi, hom Bashan anantwiber a hom wɔ Samaria bepɔw do a hom hyɛ abɔbɔfo, hom dwerew ehiafo, na hom se hɔn wuranom dɛ, hom mfa mbra ma yɛnnom.
Ewuradze Nyankopɔn akã no krɔnkrɔnyɛ ho ntam, dɛ hwɛ, nda bɛba hom do a wɔdze dadze kɔtɔkorba bɔtwe hom akɔ, na wɔdze apofo nkwaba atwe hom nkaase so.
Na hom bodua ban ntokur mu epue, obiara afa n'enyim tsenn; na hom atow homho egu Harmon, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hom mbra Beth-el, mbɔtõ mbra; hom mbrɛ Gilgal, mbɛma mbrato ndɔɔ sõ; na hom mfa hom kum-afɔr mbra anapa anapa, na hom ebupɛn du du ndaansa ndaansa;
na hom mfa mbɔr kawee nhyew ndaaseafɔr, na hom nhyɛ ayamuyi ayɛyɛdze na hom mfa ntahye: Na iyi na hom pɛ, ao hom Israelmba, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
Na emi so memaa hom sē kwawee wɔ hom nkurow nyina mu, na edziban ho hia wɔ hom mbeambea nyina: Naaso hom nnsanee mmbaa me nkyɛn, Ewuradze na ɔse.

Na emi so makam hom nsutɔ ber a nkyɛ aka abosoom ebiasa na otwaber edu no: Na motɔɔ nsu guu kurow kor do, na mamma bi anntɔ emmgu kurow kor so do: Nsu tɔree guu kwaa bi do, na kwaa a nsu anntɔ enngu kwaa bi do, na kwaa ansu anntɔ enngu do no, ɔhyewee.
Dɛm ntsi nkurow ebien anaa ebiasa wonawonae kɔr kurow kor do kɔnoom nsu na wɔammee: Naaso hom nnsanee mmba me nkyɛn, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Medze ohuw na ɔpo mabɔ hom: Hom nture na hom wenyin ntur na hom adɔmbandua na hom ngondua dodow no efuse awe: Naaso hom nnsanee mmbaa me nkyɛn, Ewuradze na ɔse.

Medze ɔyardɔm aba hom mu dɛ Egypt dze no: Medze afõwa ekuku hom mberantsɛ, na masoa hom mpɔnkɔ kɔ; na mama hom nseraban mu bɔnee asoɛr adɔ hom nseraban mu mpo: Naaso hom nnsanee mmbaa me nkyɛn, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Mebutuw hom mu binom, dɛ mbrɛ Nyame butuuw sodom na Gomorrah, na hom yɛɛ dɛ ogyantsia a woetu efi ogya mu: Ewuradze na ɔse.
Dɛm ntsi, Israel e, mbrɛ medze mebɛyɛ wo nye yi oo: Na Isreal e, osiandɛ mebɛyɛ wo dɛm ntsi, siesie woho hyia wo Nyankopɔn.
Na, hwɛ, nyia ɔhyehyɛ mbepɔw, na ɔbɔ mframa, na ɔkyerɛ nyimpa dza ɔwɔ n'adwen mu, ɔno a ɔyɛ adzekyee sum, na otsiatsia asaaase no sorɔnsorɔmbea do no; Ewuradze, dɔm Nyankopɔn, nye ne dzin.
5: Ao Israel fifo, hom ntsie asɛm bi a mema do dɛ kwadwom wɔ hom ho.
Israel baabun ahwe ase; ɔronnsoɛr bio: Wɔatow no akyen wɔ n'asaase do: Obi nnyi hɔ a ɔma no do.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn se nye yi, kurow a ɔdze apem tui no, ɔbɛka no ɔha, na dza ɔdze ɔha tui no ɔbɛka no du, dze ama Isreal fifo.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se Isreal fifo nye yi, hom nhwehwɛ me, na hom enya nkwa:
Na mma nnhwehwɛ Beth-el, eso mma hom nnhɛn Gilgal, na hom nntwa mu nnkɔ Beersheba: Na ndɔmmum ara na Gilgal bɔkɔ, na Beth-el bɛyɛ gyan.
Hom nhwehwɛ Ewuradze, na hom enya nkwa; amma oeemmpue dɛ ogya wɔ Joseph fi mu, na ɔaannhyew na obi nnyi hɔ a obodum no wɔ Beth-el:
Hom a hom dan atsɛmbu bɔwen, na hom dze tsenenee hwehwe famu;
hwehwɛ nyia no a ɔyɛ Aberwa-na-mba na Etsekwagyan, na ɔfan sum kebii adzekyee, na ɔma adzekyee hyɛ anago sum; ɔno a ɔfrɛ po nsu, na ohue gu asaase enyi; Ewuradze nye ne dzin;
ɔno a ɔma ɔsɛɛ fir awora ba ɔhoɔdzennyi do, ma ɔsɛɛ ba abankɛse do.
Wɔtan nyia ɔka enyim wɔ abobokɛse mu, na woyir nyia ɔkasa tɔɔtsenn.
Dɛm ntsi susuampaara dɛ hom tsiatsia ɔbɔbɔfo do, na hom gye no hɔ apempem ewifua ntsi: Hom esisi abo twae adan, naaso hom renntsena mu; hom atsetsɛw wenyin nture fɛɛfɛɛ, na hom ronnom mu nsã.
Na minyim mbrɛ hom rmbrato dua dɔɔ sõ, na mbrɛ hom bɔn dua yɛ dzen; hom a hom hiahia ɔtseneneenyi ho, hom gye mboaba, na hom kyea ehiafo asɛm wɔ asɛndzii.
Dɛm ntsi ɔbadwembanyi no bɛyɛ komm wɔ dɛ ber no mu; osiandɛ ɔyɛ ber bɔn.
Hom nhwehwɛ papa, na nnyɛ bɔn a, na hom eenya nkwa: Nna Ewuradze, dɔm Nyankopɔn no, nye hom bɛtsena dɛ mbrɛ hom kã no.
Hom ntan bɔn, na hom ndɔ papa, na hom ntsintsim atsɛmbu wɔ asɛndzii: Na bi a Ewuradze, dɔm Nyankopɔn no, bohu Joseph nkaase no mbɔbɔr.

Dɛm ntsi Jehovah, dɔm Nyankopɔn, Ewuradze no, mbrɛ ɔse nye yi: Ewuotwa bɛba abɔntsen nyinara do; na wɔbɛkã wɔ abrɔn nyinara mu dɛ, ebei! Ebei! Na wɔbɛfrɛ okuafo ma oedzi nkɔmbɔ, na abefo ma woetwa ewuo.
Na ewuotwa bɛba wenyin nture nyina mu: Osiandɛ mubotwa mu edua wo mu, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hom a hom afe Ewuradze ne da no, hom ndua! Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom repɛ Ewuradze ne da no? Ɔyɛ sum, na nnyɛ kan a.
Ɔtse dɛ nyimpa bi ruguan ogyata, na osisi ehyia no anaa ɔrokɔ fie dze ne nsa akɔtwer ban, na ɔwɔ aka no.
Aso Ewuradze ne da no nnyɛ sum na ɔbɛyɛ, na nnyɛ kan a? Sum katoo a hyerɛn biara nnyi mu bi a?
Mikyir, mopow hom afahyɛ nda no, na meremmfa enyigye biara wɔ hom ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn no mu.
Ɛhɛɛ, sɛ hom dze hom ɔhyew-afɔr na edziban-afɔr brɛ me mpo a, m'enyi ronnsɔ: Eso murummbu hom mbowa a adɔ seradze no ho asomdwee afɔr no bi.
Fa w'adwontow ne dede no fi mo do; na mirinntsie w'asanku ne dɛɛdɛw no.
Mbom hom mma atsɛmbu mpem mbra dɛ nsu, na ndzeyɛtsenenee mbra dɛ nsu pramee.
Ao Isreal fifo, ana hom na wɔdze okum-afɔr na ayɛyɛdze brɛ me wɔ sar no do mfe eduanan no?
Ɛhɛɛ, hom asoa hom hen siccuth na hom ehonyi Chiun ɔbosom a hom yɛe maa homho no nworaba.
Dɛm ntsi na mebɛma hom akɔ ndɔmmum atra Damascus, Ewuradze a ne dzin dze dɔm Nyankopɔn no na ɔse.
6: Wondua, hɔn a wɔtse dwadwoodwo wɔ Zion, na hɔn a wɔayɛ sɔkyee wɔ Samaria bepɔw da, amanaman etsitsir mu dansewa a Isreal fifo kɔ hɔn nkyɛn no!
Hom mbɛsen nkɔ Calneh nkɔhwɛ, na hom mfi hɔ nkɔ Hamath kɛse: Na nkyii hom nsian nkɔ Philistiafo Gath: Aso woye kyɛn ahendzi yinom? Anaa aso hɔn he sõ kyɛn hom he?
Hom a hom tu mbusu da no kɔ ekyirkyir, na hom ma emimdzi egua no twe bɛn;
wɔdeba asombɛn mpa do, na wɔtsen hɔnho bebew nkootsi do, na wodzi nguambaa no fi nguankuw no mu, na wodzi anantwimba fi anatwiban mu;
hɔn a wɔtow enyihaw ndwon yi sanku ano; hɔn a wɔbɔ hɔn ndwom yi sanku ho adze ma hɔnho dɛ David;
hɔn a wɔnom nsã wɔ ndweraa mu, na mbom Joseph ahohia no dze ɔnnyɛ hɔn awerɛhow.
Dɛm ntsi afei wɔnye hɔn a wodzi kan kɔ ndɔmmum no bɔkɔ ndɔmmum mu, na hɔn a wɔtsetseen hɔn mu bebeew hɔ no hɔn nsãgua etwa mu.
Ewuradze Nyankopɔn akã no ho ntam, Ewuradze dɔm Nyankopɔn no na ɔse: Mikyir Jacob n'ahopɔw no, na metan n'ahemfi no: Dɛm ntsi mibeyi kurow no na dza ɔwɔ mu nyina mama.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ ɔka nyimpa du wɔ ofi kor mu a, wobowuwu.
Na sɛ obi no wɔfa, nyia ɔhyew no no, sɛ ɔma no do dɛ ɔdze ne mbiew rifi fie hɔ, na ɔse nyia ɔwɔ fi no ne mpiakyir mu no dɛ, kã w'ano to mu; na yerommbɔ Ewuradze dzin.
Na, hwɛ, Ewuradze ahyɛ, na wɔdze mpaapae abɔ ofi ketseaba no.
Aso mpɔnkɔ botu mbirika wɔ abotan do? Ana obi dze anantwi bofuntum hɔ? Nna hom adan atsɛmbu bɔwema, na hom adan ɔtsenenee no nsowee bɔwen:
Hom ahom gye hom enyi wɔ adze huhuw ho, na hom seb dɛ, ana nnyɛ ahoɔdzen an yɛdze agye mmbɛn ama hɛnho?
Na, hwɛ, ao Israel fi, mebɛma ɔman bi do etsia hom, Ewuradze, dɔm Nyankopɔn no na ɔse; na wofi Hamath ahɛnee behiahia hom ho araa ekodu ɔwora Arabah ho.
7: Dɛm na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn dze kyerɛɛ me: Na hwɛ, ɔyɛɛ mbɛbɛw wɔ ekyir mfuwii no ne fifir ahyɛse; na, hwɛ, ɔhen no ndɔwee n'ekyir mfuwii a.
Na ɔbaa dɛ wowiee asaase no do efuw nyina dzi no, nna mesee dɛ, ao Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, mokotow meserɛ wo, fa fir: Jacob bɛyɛ dɛn egyina? osiandɛ osuar.
Ewuradze nuu noho wɔ iyi ho: Ɔremmba no dɛm, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Dɛm na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn dze kyerɛɛ me: Na, hwɛ, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn frɛɛ ogya dze edzi esi; na ɔmeen bun dɔnkuronn no, na nkyɛ ɔpɛ edzi asaase no.
Nna mesee dɛ, ao Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, gyaa, mokotow meserɛ wo: Jacob bɛyɛ dɛn egyina? Osiandɛ osuar.
Ewuradze nuu noho wɔ iyi ho: Iyi so remmba no dɛm, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Dɛm na ɔdze kyerɛɛ me: Na, hwɛ, Ewuradze gyinaa ɔfasu a wɔdze promo towee no do, na promo kitsa ne nsamu.
Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, Amos, ebɛn na ihu yi? Na mesee dɛ, Promo a. Nna Ewuradze see dɛ, hwɛ, medze promo mibesi me man Israel finimfin; merennda ho mmpa hɔn ho bio:
Na Isaac sorɔnsorɔmbea bɛyɛ afõafo, na Israel krɔnkrɔnmbea bɛdeda apanapan; na medze afõwa bɔsoɛr Jeroboam fi do.
Nna Beth-el ɔsɔfo Amaziah somae kɔr Isrealhen Jeroboam nkyɛn, dɛ, Amos apam wo tsir do wɔ Isreal fi finifim: Asaase no nntum nnsoa n'asɛm nyina.
Na mbrɛ Amos kã nye yi, Jeroboam bowu afõwa ano, na wɔdze Israel befi n'asaase do akɔ ndɔmmum mu ara ampa.
Eso Amaziah see Amos dɛ, ao ɔdzehufo, bɔ wo ho eguaa kɔ Judah asaase do, na kedzidzi wɔ hɔ, na hyɛ nkɔm wɔ hɔ:
Na mma nnda ho nnhyɛ nkɔm bio wɔ Beth-el: Na ɔyɛ ɔhen no no krɔnkrɔn-bea, na ɔyɛ ahemfi so.
Nna Amos buae see Amaziah dɛ, mennyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi, eso mennyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi ba; mbom meyɛ mbowahwɛfo, na nyia osiesie sycomore ndua ho:
Na Ewuradze bɛfaa me fii nguan no ekyirdzi, na Ewuradze see me dɛ, kɔ kɛhyɛ me man Israel nkɔm.
Dɛm ntsi afei tsie Ewuradze n'asɛm: Ɔwo ekã dɛ, mma nnhyɛ nkɔm nntsia Israel, na mma w'asɛm nnsosɔw nngu Isaac fi do;

dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Wo yer bɛyɛ edwaman wɔ kurow no mu, na wo mbabanyin na wo mbabaa atotɔ afõwa ano, na wɔdze susuhoma akyɛ w'asaase; na wankasa so bowu wɔ asaase fifi do, na wɔdze Israel fi n'asaase do bɔkɔ ndɔmmum mu ara ampa.
8: Dɛm na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn dze kyerɛɛ me: Na, hwɛ, ɔpɛber eduaba kɛntsen mã.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Amos, ebɛn na ihu yi? Na mesee dɛ, ɔpɛber eduaba kɛntsɛn mã. Nna Ewuradze see me dɛ, ewiei no aba me man Israel do;merennda ho mmpa hɔn ho bio.
Na asɔrfi mu ndwom bɛdan ewuotwa wɔ da no mu, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn na ɔse: Efun bɔdɔɔ sõ; wɔnam dzinn bɔtotow hɔn egugu mbea nyina.
Hom ntsie yi, hom a hom pɛ amemen ehiafo, na wɔama abɔbɔfo asã asaase no do,
na hom kã dɛ, dabɛn na bosoom fofor no bɔkɔ, ma yaatɔn eburow? Na ahomgyeda no, ma yeetue ewifua ano? Na yaayɛ ephah ketseaba, na shekel kɛse, na yɛdze akɔhwi nsɛn eesisi;
ama yɛdze dwɛɛtɛɛ aatɔ ɔbɔbɔfo, na yɛdze nsokota ha-naha, aatɔ ohianyi, na yaatɔn ewifua ntɔmpamu no.
Ewuradze akã Jacob n'ahopɔw ho ntam, dɛ, ampaara mo werɛ rimmfir hɔn ndwuma no mu biara da.
Aso asaase no nnkɔwosow wɔ iyi ntsi, na obiara aɔtse do edzi nkɔmbɔ? Ɛhɛɛ, obeyir dɛ Esutsen nio; na wɔbɔfon no na ɔatwe bio, dɛ Esutsen no; na wɔbɔfon no na ɔatwe bio, dɛ Egypt Esutsen.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn na ɔse, dɛ mebɛma wi atɔ ewiabeer, na mahyɛ asaase sum adzekyee petee.
Na mebɛdan hom afahyɛ nkɔmbɔdzi na hom ndwom nyina ewuotwa; na mebɛma eyitam akyekyer asen nyina, na etsipaa aba tsir nyina do; na mebɛma ɔayɛ dɛ ɔbakor ho nkɔmbɔdzi, na n'ewiei ayɛ dɛ da a ɔyɛ wen.
Hwɛ, nda reba, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn na ɔse, dɛ mebɛma ɔkɔm aba asaase no do, nnyɛ edzibankɔm, anaa nsukɔm, na Ewuradze n'asɛntsie ho kɔm a.
Na wɔbɔwona fi po ho ekesi po ho naw ɔfi kwaamu afamu ekesi boka afamu; wobedzi akɔnaaba dɛ wɔrohwehwɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm ekyir kwan, na worunnhu.
Da no mu no mbaabun fɛɛfɛw na mberantsɛ bɔtotɔ bitsi wɔ nsukɔm ntsi.
Hɔn a wɔkã Samaria bɔn ne ntam, na wɔse dɛ, ao Dan, dɛ wo Nyankopɔn tse ase yi; na dɛ Beer-sheba kwan tse ase yi: Hɔn mpo wɔbɔtɔ, na wɔronnsoɛr bio ara da.
9: Muhun Ewuradze dɛ ogyina afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn: Na ɔsee dɛ, bɔ etsifi apɔw no ma mpondua no nwosow: Na bubu gu hɔn nyina etsifi; na medze afowa bokuku hɔn ekyirkafo no; hɔn mu ɔbaako ara runnguan, na hɔn mu ɔbaako ara rimmfi nsa.
Sɛ wɔbɔr kɔ Sheol a, me nsa bɛfa hɔn efi hɔ aba; na sɛ wɔfow kɔ sor a, mdze hɔn befi hɔ esian.
Na sɛ wokosuma hɔnho wɔ Carmel etsifi a, mobɔkɔ hɔn atwee makɛfa hɔn mefi hɔ; na sɛ wofi m'enyim kosuma po ase a, mebɛhyɛ ɔwɔ ma oefi hɔ akeka hɔn.
Na sɛ wɔkɔ hɔn atamfo enyim ndɔmmum a, mebɛhyɛ ma afõwa efi hɔ ekuku hɔn: Na medzew m'enyi betsim hɔn do wɔ mbusu ntsi, na nnyɛ papa a.
Na Ewuradze, dɔm Nyankopɔn no nye nyia ɔka asaase ma ɔnan, na hɔn a wɔtse do nyina dzi nkɔmbɔ; na ne nyina beyir dɛ Esutsen no; na ɔatwe bio dɛ Egypt Esutsen no;
ɔno na osi ne mpia wɔ sor, na ɔato ne samandan ase wɔ asaase; ɔno a ɔfrɛ po mu nsu na ohue gu asaase enyi; Ewuradze nye ne dzin.
Ao Israelmba, ana hom nnyɛ me dɛ Ethiopiafo mba? Ana nnyɛ emi na medzi Israel fii Egypt asaase no do, na Philistiafo fii Caphtor, na Syriafo fii kir?
Hwɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn enyi sã ahendzi bɔn no, na mebɛsɛɛ no efi asaase enyi; gyedɛ Jacob fifo nko na merennsɛɛ hɔn korakora, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na, hwɛ, mebɛhyɛ ma wɔaapo Israel do wɔ amanaman nyina mu, dɛ mbrɛ wɔpo ewu do wɔ mpododze mu, naaso ewifua kakraabi ronntɔ famu.
Me man mu ndzebɔnyɛfo nyina bowu afõwa anomu, hɛn, eso orunntwar hɛn ano no.
Da no mu na mebɛma David ntamadan a egura no do egyina, na mesisiw no ntokur no; na mama n'afasin no do, na matow no dɛ tsetse nda no:
Ama wɔaafa Edom nkaa no ayɛ hɔndze, na amanaman a wɔdze me dzin frɛ hɔn no nyina, Ewuradze a ɔyɛ iyi nyian na ɔse.
Hwɛ, nda reba, Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ nyia ofuntum boto nyia otwa na nyia otsiatsia wenyinaba na mbepɔw bɔsosɔw nsã fenemfenem, na akoko nyiara anan.
Na medze me man Isreal no ndɔmmum bɛsan aba, na wɔatsenatsena mu; na wɔanom ne nsã no bi; wɔbɛyɛ nture so, na woedzi mu aba.
Na mebɛtsetsɛw hɔn wɔ hɔn asaase do, na wonnkotutu hɔn efi hɔn asaase a medze ama hɔn noi do. Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn na ɔse.

1: Paul, Christ Jesus somafo a ɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ do, nye onua Timothy,
dze kɛma ahotsewfo nye enuanom a wɔyɛ Christ mu agyedzifo a wɔwɔ Colossae: Adom nye asomdwee a ofir hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn hɔ nkã hom.
Yɛda Nyankopɔn, hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ n'Egya no ase, daa yɛsɔr ma hom,
yɛtsee hom gyedzi a ɔwɔ Christ Jesus mu, nye dɔ a hom dze dɔ ahotsewfo nyina ntsi,
wɔ enyidado a ɔda hɔ ma hom wɔ sor a hom tsee nkan no wɔ asɛmpa no mu nokwasɛm no ntsi,
ɔno na aba hom hɔ; dɛ mbrɛ ɔwɔ wiadze nyina so rosɔw aba na ɔrodɔɔ sõ dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse wɔ hom so mu, ofitsi da a hom tsee na hom hun Nyankopɔn adom no nokwar mu no;
dɛ mbrɛ hom sūaa no wɔ hɛn ewurakowaa dɔfo Epaphras a ɔyɛ ɔsomfo nokwafo wɔ hɛn afamu no n'anomu,
ɔno so na oebeyi hom dɔ a ɔwɔ Sunsum no mu akyerɛ hɛn.
Iyi ntsi na hɛn so ofitsi da no a yɛtsee no yenngyaa dɛ yeyi mpaa, na yɛserɛ ma hom, dɛ ne pɛ ho nyimdzee nhyɛ hom mã, wɔ sunsum mu nyansa nye ntseasee nyina mu;
na hom aanantsew mbrɛ ɔfata Ewuradze na ɔsɔ enyi koraa, na hom aasow edwuma pa nyina mu aba, na hom eenyin Nyankopɔn ho nyimdzee mu;
na wɔdze tum nyina aahyɛ hom dzen, dɛ mbrɛ n'enyimnyam ahoɔdzen tumdzi no tse, dze aakɔ abotar, nye penkyɛr nye dɛW nyina mu;
na hom aada Egya no ase, ɔno a ɔama yɛase dɛ yɛyɛ ahotsewfo a wɔwɔ kan mu no hɔn egyapadze fafafo no;
ɔno na oyii hɛn fii sum no tum no ase, na ɔdze hɛn baa no Dɔba n'ahendzi no mu;
no mu na yeenya pon ɔnye bɔnfakyɛ:
Ɔnoara na ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn a wohu no a ɔnnyɛ ne saso, nye abɔdze nyina abakan;
osiandɛ no mu na wɔdɔɔ adze nyina, dza ɔwɔ sor nye dza ɔwɔ asaase do, dza wohu nye dza wonnhu, ahendzi o, wuradzi o, mpanyindzi o, tumdzi o, adze nyina wɔnam no do bɔe, na wɔbɔe maa no:
Na ɔno na odzi adze nyina kan, na no mu na adze nyina bɔ mu tse hɔ.
Na ɔno nye nyimpadua no, asɔr no, ne tsir: Ɔno nye ahyɛse, ewufo mu abakan: ma adze nyina mu ɔaayɛ abɔso.
Osiandɛ ɔsɔɔ Egya no enyi dɛ amayɛ nyina tsena no mu;
na ɔnam no do akã ɔno ankasa nye ndzɛmba nyina abɔ mu, ɔno nye dɛ, ɔnam ne mbeamudua bɔgyaa no do ayɛ asomdwee, mese dɛ, ɔnam no do akã ndzɛmba nyina abɔ mu, asaase dze o, ɔsor dze o.
Na hom so a nkyɛ mber a ɔabɛsen hom yɛ ananaben nye atamfo wɔ hom adwen mu wɔ ndwuma bɔn mu no,
afei ɔnam owu do akã ɔno nye hom abɔ mu wɔ no honam nyimpadua no mu, dɛ ɔdze hom befir n'enyim dɛ nyimpa krɔnkrɔn a wonndzii dzɛm a asɛm nnyi hom ho;
sɛ hom tsena gyedzi no mu, gyina hom fapem do, tsintsim, na wɔanntwe hom emmfi asɛmpa enyidado a hom tsee na wɔakãa kyerɛɛ abɔdze nyina a emi Paul meyɛ ho ɔsomfo no ho a.
Afei midzi dɛw wɔ amandze a muruhu wɔ hom ntsi no mu, na mo so m'afamu mehyɛ Christ amandzehu dza ɔaka no mã wɔ mo honam mu wɔ ne nyimpadua a ɔyɛ n'asɔr no ntsi;
ɔno ho na wɔayɛ me ɔsomafo, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn ofihwɛ-dwuma no tse, dza ɔdze ama me wɔ hom afamu, dɛ mehyɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm mã,
esumasɛm a ofitsi mbersantsen mbasantsen nyina mu osumae no a afei dze woebeyi akyerɛ n'ahotsewfo no a
Nyankopɔn pɛɛ dɛ ɔbɛma woehu esumasɛm yi ho enyimnyam ahonya wɔ amanaman mu, ɔnye Christ a ɔwɔ hom mu, enyimnyam no ho enyidado:
Ɔno na yɛbɔ no dawur, yetu nyimpa nyina fo wɔ nyansa nyina mu, dɛ yɛdze nyimpa nyina befir dɛ wodzi mu wɔ Christ mu:
Ɔno ho so na meyɛ edwuma meberɛ meper dɛ mbrɛ n'adzeyɛ a ɔyɛ mo mu edwuma tum do no tse.
2: Na mepɛ dɛ hom hu aper dzendzen a miridzi no wɔ hom nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Laodicea, nye hɔn a wonnhun m'enyim wɔ honam mu no ho;
dɛ wɔmma hɔn akoma ntɔ hɔn yamu, wɔntoatoa mu kor wɔ ɔdɔ mu nnya ntseasee a woesi no tadua ahonya nyina, na woeehu Nyankopɔn asumasɛm no, ɔnye Christ;
ɔno no mu na wɔdze nyansa nye nyimdzee ahonyadze nyina akora.
Na mekã yi mma obi aammfa adɛfɛdɛfɛsɛm anntõ hom brada.
Na kaansa minnyi hɔ honam mu a, menye hom wɔ hɔ wɔ sunsum mu, miridzi dɛw na morohwɛ hom nhyehyɛɛ nyɛbea, nye hom gyedzi a ɔwɔ Christ mu mbrɛ otsim pa.
Dɛm ntsi dɛ mbrɛ hom gyee Christ Jesus Ewuradze no, hom nnantsew no mu dɛmara:
hom agye ndwow, na wɔdze hom esi no mu, na hom etsim wɔ gyedzi mu dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛkyerɛɛ hom no, na hom abor do wɔ ndaase mu.
Hom nhwɛ yie mma obi aammfa nyansapɛ nye ndaadaa hun a ɔnam nyimpa tsetsesɛm, nye wiadze mfitsiasesɛm do, na ɔnnam Christ mu, ammbɛfa hom afo:
no mu na Nyameyɛsu n'amayɛ no tse wɔ nyimpadua mu,
na ɔno a ɔyɛ mpanyindzi nye tumdzi nyina hɔn tsir no mu na hom ayɛ mã:
Ɔno mu so na woetwa hom twatsia a wɔnndze nsa twae, wɔ hom nyimpadua ne nyigu mu, wɔ Christ twatsiatwa mu:
Dɛ woesie ɔno nye hom wɔ enuma mu, no mu so na ɔnam gyedzi a ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn a onyaan no fii ewufo mu no no tum do, hom so nye no asoɛr.
Na hom a nkyɛ hom ewu wɔ hom mfom nye hom honam monomomyɛ mu no, hom na ɔama hom nye no enya nkwa, dɛ ɔdze hɛn mfom nyina akyɛ hɛn;
na ɔapepa ahyɛdze no mu nkyerɛwee a otsīa hɛn no, na ɔdze akɔbɔ mbeamudua no ho eyi no wɔ kwan mu;
na oyi ɔworɔɔw mpanyindzi nye tumdzi gui no, oyii hɔn kyerɛɛ gua dzii hɔn do konyim wɔ mu.
Dɛm ntsi mma obi mmbu hom atsɛn wɔ edziban mu, anaa anondze mu, anaa afahyɛ da, anaa bosoom fofor, anaa ahomgyenda afamu:
Wɔyɛ ndzɛmba a ɔbɛba sunsuma, na frɔdɔɔ no yɛ Christ dze.
Mma obi nndua enyiwado ahobrɛadze nye abɔfosom do mma hom mbɔdzembɔ akyɛdze mmbɔ hom, dɛ ɔtsena ndzɛmba a onnhu mu, na ɔhoran kwa wɔ no honam adwen mu,
na onnsuo tsir no a ofi mu na nyimpadua no nyina nam akwaa nye ntsin biara do nya edziban no ɔtoatoa mu nyin wɔ Nyankopɔn nyin mu.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ hom nye Christ wui fi wiadze mfitseasedze no ho a, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom dze ahyɛdze no to hom do, dɛ hom da ho tse wiadze, dɛ,
Mma mmfa nsa nnsuo mu, nnsɔ nnhwɛ, nnkã,
(ndzɛmba yi nyina a wɔdze reyɛ adze a, ɔsɛɛ) wɔ nyimpa ahyɛdze nye nkyerɛkyerɛ afamu?
Ndzɛmba yi yɛ dɛ wɔakyerɛ nyansa wɔ ɔpɛsom nye ahobrɛadze nye etsiɔdzen a wɔyɛ no honam no dze; na ɔnnsom bo bi nntsia honam eyiayia.
3: Dɛm ntsi sɛ hom enya nye Christ asoɛr a, hom nhwehwɛ dza ɔwɔ sor mbrɛ Christ tse Nyankopɔn abanyimfa.
Hom mfa hom adwen ngyina dza ɔwɔ sor do, na nnyɛ dza ɔwɔ asaase a.
Na hom wui, na wɔdze hom nkwa aka Christ ho esuma Nyankopɔn mu.
Na ber a hom nkwa Christ befir no, hom so nye no befir enyimnyam mu.
Dɛm ntsi hom mma wiadze akɔndɔ a ɔwɔ hom mfafakuwa mu nnwu; ndwamansɛm, efifidze, akɔndɔ-nhyɛdo, akɔndɔ bɔn nye enyikaber a no so yɛ abonsonsɔr;
Iyinom ntsi na Nyankopɔn ebufuw ba seanntse mba do a;
nkan no a hom tse mu no hom nantseew mu.
Na afei hom so nyi yinom nyina ngu; ebufuw, ebufuhyew, ɔyamugya, etutuwpɛ, enyiwusɛm mfi hom anomu:
Mma hom nndzidzi ator nnkyerɛkyerɛ homho, osiandɛ hom eyi nyimpa dadaw no nye ne nyɛe no egu;
na hom ahyɛ nyimpa fofor a wɔayɛ no fofor aba nyimdzee mu, wɔ nyia ɔbɔɔ no no ne saso do no;
mbrɛ Greeknyi nye Jewnyi, twatsiatwa nye monomonomyɛ, pɔtɔfo nye Scythianyi, akowaa nye ɔdehye, bi nnyi hɔ, na mbom Christ nye adze nyina wɔ hɔn nyina mu no.
Dɛm ntsi hom a hom yɛ hɔn a Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi hom, ahotsewfo nye adɔfo no, hom nhyɛ ayamuhyehye, tsimbɔbɔr, ayamuyie, ahobrɛadze, ɔdwe, penkyɛr;
sɛ obi wɔ obi ho asɛm bi a, hom ntsetse mma homho, na hom mfa nkyekyɛ homho nkorkor; dɛ mbrɛ Christ dze akyɛ hom no, dɛmara na hom so nyɛ:
na iyinom nyina do no hom nhyɛ ɔdɔ a ɔyɛ emudzi abɔdo no.
Na hom mma Christ asomdwee no ndzi hen wɔ hom akoma mu, ɔno so na wɔafrɛ hom aba ho, wɔ nyimpadua kor mu; na hom nyɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ ayɛ.
Hom mma Christ asɛm ntsena hom mu pii, na hom mfa nsankundwom, nye ayɛyindwom, nye sunsum mu ndwom nkyerɛkyerɛ, na hom nkasa nkyerɛ homho nkorkor ntow ndwom adom do wɔ hom akoma mu mma Nyankopɔn.
Na biribiara a hom yɛ no, kasa mu o, nyɛe mu o, hom nyɛ ne nyina wɔ Ewuradze Jesus dzin mu, ndua no do nda Nyankopɔn Egya no ase.
Yernom, hom mbrɛ homho adze mma hom kunnom, dɛm na ɔsɛ wɔ Ewuradze mu.
Kunnom, hom ndɔ hom yernom na mma hom nnyɛ hɔn yerɛyerɛw.
Mba, hom ntsie hom awofo asɛm wɔ adze nyina mu na iyi na ɔsɔ enyi wɔ Ewuradze mu.
Egyanom, mma hom nnyɛ hom mba heihei amma hɔn abaw aanngow.
Nkowaa, hom ntsie hom honam afamu ewuranom asɛm; nnyɛ enyiwadosom mu, dɛ hom rosɔ nyimpa enyi, na mbom akoma kor mu, dɛ hom suro Ewuradze:
Na biribiara a hom yɛ no, hom mfi akoma mu nyɛ edwuma dɛ hom yɛ ma Ewuradze, na hom nnyɛ mma nyimpa;
osiandɛ hom nyim dɛ Ewuradze hɔ na hom benya egyapadze akatua no, na Ewuradze Christ na hom som no.
Na nyia ɔyɛ dza ɔnntsen no, dza ɔnntsen a ɔayɛ no ara na obenya bio: na nyimpa enyimhwɛ bi nnyi hɔ.
4: Ewuranom, hom mfa dza ɔtsen na ɔfa kwan mu nyɛ hom nkowaa, osiandɛ hom so wɔ owura wɔ sor.
Hom nkura asɔryɛ mu dzen ara, na hom mfa ndaase nweɔn wɔ mu;
na hom mbɔ mpaa mma hɛn so, ma Nyankopɔn mbue asɛm no ano mma hɛn; ma yɛnkã Christ esumasɛm a osian ntsi ma meda nkyehoma mu no;
ma meeyi ato gua dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ me dɛ mekasa.
Hom nnantsew nyansa mu wɔ hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyir no afamu, na hom mpon mber no.
Hom mma hom kasaa nyɛ dza adom nkyɛn wɔ mu daa, ama hom eehu dza ɔsɛ dɛ hom dze bua obiara.
Mo ho nsɛm nyina Tychicus bɛma hom ehu, onua dɔfo a ɔyɛ ɔsomfo nokwafo nye m'ewurakowaa wɔ Ewuradze mu no:
Ɔno na iyiara ntsi masoma no hom nkyɛn, ama hom eehu hɛn asetsena, na ɔaakã hom akoma ato hom yamu;
Onesimus, onua nokwafo dɔfo a ofi hom mu no ka no ho: hɔn a wɔbɛma hom ehu ha nsɛm nyina.
Aristarchus me nyɛnko pokyerɛnyi no kyia hom, ɔnye Mark, Barnabas wɔfase a hom enya no ho nkra dada dɛ, sɛ ɔba hom nkyɛn a, hom ngye no no;
nye Jesus a wɔfrɛ no Justus a wofi twatsiatwa mu no: yinom nko nye me ayɛ edwumayɛfo wɔ Nyankopɔn ahendzi no afamu a wɔayɛ akyekyewerɛ ama me.
Christ akowaa Epaphras a ofi hom mu no kyia hom, odzi aper ma hom daa wɔ asɔryɛ mu, dɛ hom ngyina hɔ pi, na hom nyɛ mã wɔ Nyankopɔn ne pɛ nyina mu.
Na midzi no dase dɛ ɔbɔɔ mbɔdzen pii maa hom nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Laodicea nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Hierapolis.
Luke, aduyɛfo dɔfo no, nye Demas kyia hom.
Hom nkyia enuanom a wɔwɔ Laodicea nye Nymphas nye asɔr a ɔwɔ ne fie no.
Na sɛ wɔkenkan nwoma yi wɔ hom mu wie a, hom mma wɔnkɛkenkan no Laodicea asɔr mu so, na hom so nkenkan dza ofi Laodicea.
Na hom nse Archippus dɛ, hwɛ ɔsom a wo nsa akã no Ewuradze mu no yie, na aahyɛ no mã.
Me nkyia a mara Paul medze me nsa kyerɛwee nye yi. Hom nkaa mo mpokyerɛ no. Adom nkã hom nyina.

1: Judahhen Jehiokim n'ahendzi afe a otsīa ebiasa no mu no, na Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar baa Jerusalem botuaa no.
Na Ewuradze dze Judahhen Jehiokim na Nyankopɔn fie nkurada no mu bi hyɛɛ ne nsa; na ɔsoae kɔr no bosom fie wɔ Shinar asaase do: Na ɔdze nkuraba no baa no bosom akoradzedan no mu.
Na ɔhen no kasaa kyerɛɛ epiafohen Ashpenaz, dɛ ɔmfa Iseralmba mu binom mbra, hɔn a wɔyɛ ahen asefo na ekunyin no;
mberantsewa a wonndzi dzɛm, na mbom hɔn ho yɛ fɛw, na hɔn enyi atsew nyansa nyina mu, na wɔnyim dze na wontum gyina ɔhen ne fi mu; na ɔnkyerɛ hɔn ma wonsua Chaldeafo nwoma na kasa.
Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ dɛ daa daa nyina wɔmma hɔn ahendziban, na ne nsã a ɔnom no bi, na wɔnnyɛn hɔn mfe ebiasa; na ɔno ekyir no wombegyina ɔhen no enyim.
Na hɔn mu bi a wofi Judahmba mu nye Daniel, Hananiah, Misheal, na Azariah.
Na epiafohen no totoo hɔn edzin: Ɔtoo Daniel dzin Belteshazzar; na ɔtoo Hananiah dzin Shadrach; na ɔtoo Misheal dzin Meshack; na ɔtoo Azariah dzin Abednego.
Na Daniel suae wɔ n'akoma mu dɛ ɔremmfa ahendziban anaa ne nsã a ɔnom no nngu no ho fī: Dɛm ntsi obisaa epiafohen no amma oeenngu no ho fi.
Na Nyankopɔn maa Daniel nyaa epiafohen no enyim enyimpa na ayamuhyehye.

Na epiafohen no see Daniel dɛ, musuro mo wora ɔhen a ɔahyehyɛ hom edziban na anondze: Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn ntsi na obohu hom enyim mbɔbɔmbɔbɔr akyɛn mberantsewa a wɔyɛ hom etsipɛfo no? Hom reyɛ ma me tsir atõ wɔ ɔhen enyim.
Nna Daniel see opiafopanyin a epiafohen dze no esi Daniel, Hananiah Misheal, na Azariah do no, dɛ:
Meserɛ wo, sɔ wo nkowaa hwɛ dadu: Na wɔmma hɛn fan ma yendzi, na nsu ma yɛnnom.
Nkyii so ma wɔnhwɛ hɛn enyim, na hɔn so a wodzi ahendziban bi no hɔn enyim wɔ w'enyim: Na mbrɛ ɔwoara ibohu no, enye wo nkowaa ndzi.
Nna otsiee hɔn wɔ asɛm yi mu, na ɔsɔɔ hɔn hwɛɛ dadu.
Na dadu ekyir no, hɔn enyim yeyɛɛ fɛɛfɛw, na hɔn honam yeyɛɛ abran seen mberantsewa a wodzii ahendziban bi no nyinara.
Nna opiafopanyin no yii hɔn edziban, na hɔn nsã a nkyɛ wɔwɔ dɛ wɔnom no fii hɔ, na ɔmaa hɔn fan.
Na mberantsewa baanan yi dze, Nyankopɔn maa hɔn nyimdzee, na nwomasua na nyansa nyina mu enyitsew: Na Daniel nyaa ntseasee wɔ enyido-adzehu na adaaso nyinara mu.
Na da ɔhen no hyehyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa hɔn mbra no durii no, epiafohen no dze hɔn baa Nebuchadnezzar enyim.
Na ɔhen no nye hɔn twetwee nkɔmbɔ; na hɔn nyinara mu woenhu obiara a ɔtse dɛ Daniel, Hananiah, Misheal, Azariah: Dɛm ntsi wogyinaa ɔhen no enyim.
Na asɛm biara a ɔfa nyansa na ntseasee ho a ɔhen no bisaa hɔn mu no, ohun hɔn dɛ woyɛ mpɛn du sen nkongyaayifo na nkaberkyerfo a wɔwɔ n'ahenman mu no nyinara.
Na Daniel tsenaa hɔ araa dze kodur ɔhen cyrus n'afe a odzi kan no mu.
2: Na Nebuchadnezzar n'ahendzi afe a otsia ebien no mu no, na Nebuchadnezzar sosõo adaa; na no werɛ howee, na ne nda fii no do kɔree.
Nna ɔhen no hyɛɛ dɛ wɔnkɛfrɛ nkogyaayifo, na nkaberkyerfo, na abayifo, na Chaldeafo dɛ wɔmbɛkyerɛ ɔhen n'adaaso no. Nnawɔbae begyinaa ɔhen no enyim.
Na ɔhen no see hɔn dɛ, masõ daa, na mo werɛ ahow dɛ mubohu daa no.
Nna Chaldeafo no kasaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no wɔ Syria kasa mu, dɛ, ɔhen ntsena ase daa: Kã daa no kyerɛ wo nkowaa, ma yɛnkyerɛ ase.
Ɔhen no buae see Chaldeafo no dɛ, asɛm no efi mo mu kɔ: Sɛ hom annkyerɛ me daa no na n'ase a, wobotwitwa hom mu esinesin, na wɔadan hom efi sumina.
Na sɛ hom kyerɛ daa no na n'ase a, hom benya mo hɔ akyɛdze na akatua na enyidzi kɛse: Dɛm ntsi hom nkyerɛ me daa no na n'ase.
Wobuaa no mpɛn ebien se dɛ, ma ɔhen nkã daa no nkyerɛ no nkowaa, ma yɛnkyerɛ ase.
Ɔhen no buae see dɛ, muhu no kotoo dɛ mber ara no hom regye, osiandɛ hom ehu dɛ asɛm no efi mo mu kɔ.

Na sɛ hom amma mennhu daa no a, mbra kor pɛ na ɔda hɔ ma hom: Osiandɛ hom ahyehyɛ atofosɛm na nsɛmfun dɛ hom rebɛkã no m'enyim, ekodu dɛ mber bɛsakyer: Dɛm ntsi hom nkã daa no nkyerɛ me, ma munhu dɛ hom botum akyerɛ me, ase.

Chaldeafo no buae wɔ ɔhen no enyim see dɛ, nyimpa biara nnyi asaase do a obotum akyerɛ ɔhen n'asɛm yi: Siantsir nye dɛ ɔhen, owura, anaa otumfo biara mmbisaa ɔkɔmfo, anaa nkaberkyernyi, anaa Chaldeanyi biara hɔ asɛm a ɔtse dɛm pɛn.
Na adze a ɔnnkã na ɔhen ribisa yi, na obiara nnyi hɔ a obotum akyerɛ wɔ ɔhen enyim, gyaedɛ abosom a hɔn tsenabea nnyi adasa mu no.
Iyi ntsi na ɔhen no no bo fuwii na n'enyi beer kɛse, na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔnsɛɛ Babyion enyansafo nyinara.
Nna wɔhyɛɛ ɔmom no dɛ wonku enyansafo no; na wɔhwehwɛɛ Daniel na ne mfɛfo no dɛ woboku hɔn.
Nna Daniel dze egyinatu na adwenmutsewee danee buaa ɔhen ne gyaasehen Arioch a oefir edzi dɛ orukoku Babylon enyansafo no;
obuae see ɔhen ne safohen Arioch, dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔmom a ɔyɛ dzen fir ɔhen no hɔ yi? Nna Arioch maa Daniel hun asɛm no.
Na Daniel kɔr dan mu kebisaa ɔhen no dɛ ɔmma no ber, na ɔbɛkyerɛ ase akyerɛ ɔhen no.
Nna Daniel kɔr ne fie, na ɔkɛdaa nsɛm no edzi kyerɛɛ ne mfɛfo Hananiah, Misheal, na Azariah:
Dɛ wɔnserɛ ɔsor Nyankopɔn hɔ; amma Daniel na ne mfɛfo wɔaannkã Babylon enyansafo nkaa no ho wɔannhera.
Nna woyii esumasɛm no kyerɛɛ Daniel wɔ anago enyido-adzehu mu. Nna Daniel hyiraa ɔsor Nyankopon.
Daniel buae see dɛ, nhyira nkã. Nyankopɔn dzin daa daa: Ɔno no nyansa na tum dzi wɔ no:
Na ɔno na ɔsakyer mber na hyɛber: Otu ahen, na ɔhyɛ ahen: Ɔma enyansafo nyansa, na ɔma hɔn a wɔwɔ ntseasee nyimdzee:
Ɔda ndzɛmba a no mu dɔ na osuma edzi: Onyim dza ɔwɔ sum mu, na kan nye no tse.
Meda wo ase, miyi wo ayɛw, ɔwo, m'egyanom Nyankopɔn a ama me nyansa na tum, na afie ama mehu dze yebisaa wo no: Na ɔwo na ama yeehu ɔhen no n'asɛm.
Dɛm ntsi Daniel kɔr Arioch a ɔhen no ahyɛ no dɛ ɔnsɛɛ Babylon enyansafo no nkyɛn: Mbrɛ ɔkɔree kɛsee no nye yi: Mma nnsɛɛ babylon enyansafo no: Fa me kɔ ɔhen no enyim, na mebɛkyerɛ ase akyerɛ ɔhen.
Nna Arioch yɛɛ ntsɛm dze Daniel baa ɔhen enyim, na mbrɛ ɔsee nye yi, mehu Judah ndɔmmumkɔfo no mu ɔbarimba bi a ɔbɛma ɔhen ehu nkyerɛaese no.
Ɔhen no buae see Daniel a ne dzin dze Beltehazzar no dɛ, ana ɔwo ibotum ama mehu daaa a masõ no, na ne nkyerɛase no?
Daniel buaa ɔhen no see dɛ, esumasɛm a ɔhen ebisa yi enyansafo, nkaberkyerfo, akɔmfo, anaa sebramufo runntum dze akyerɛ ɔhen;
na mbom Nyankopɔn bi wɔ sor a ɔda esumadze edzi, na ɔno na ɔama ɔhen Nebuchadnezzar ehu dza dakyee ɔbɛba no. Wo daa no, na wo tsirmu enyido-adzehu wɔ wo mpa do no, nye yinom:
Ɔwodze, ɔhen, w'adwen baa wo tsirmu wɔ wo mpa do, dze dakyee ɔbɛba: Na nyia ɔda esumadze edzi no na ɔama ehu dza ɔbɛba.
Na emidze, nnyɛ nyansa biara a mowɔ kyɛn atseasefo nyina ntsi na woeyi esumasɛm yi akyerɛ me, na mbom mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ a wɔbɛma ɔhen ehu w'akom mu adwen ntsi a.
Ɔwo, ɔhen, hunii, na hwɛ, ohonyi kɛse a. Ohonyi yi a ɔso, na ɔhyerɛn hyɛnn yi, begyina w'enyim; na n'enyim yɛ hu.
Ohonyi yi dze, ne tsir yɛ sika pa, n'akoko na n'abasa dwetɛ a, ne yafun na n'aserɛ boran a,
n'anantu dadze a, n'anansa dadze fã na dɛtse fã.
Ehwɛe araa kodur dɛ ɔbo bi a wɔnndze nsa twae tsewee bɔhwee ohonyi no n'anansa a ɔyɛ dadze na dɛtse no do, na obubuu no pɔsɔpɔsɔ.

Nna dadze no, dɛtse no, boran no, dwetɛ no, na sika no bɔɔ mu bubuu pɔsɔpɔsɔ dɛ ɔpɛber mu ewuporowee ntsɛw; na mframa soaa hɔn nyina kɔree, dɛ woennya bea bi amma hɔn: Na ɔbo a ɔbɔbɔɔ ohonyi no do no, bɛyɛɛ bepɔw kɛse, na ɔhyɛɛ asaase nyina do mã.
Iyi nye adaaso no; na yɛbɛkã ne nkyerɛase no so wɔ ɔhen enyim.
Ɔwo, ɔhen, eyɛ ahemfo hen a ɔsor Nyankopɔn dze ahendzi no, tum no, ahoɔdzen no, na enyimnyam no ama wo;
na beebiara mbrɛ adasamba, hambowa, na ɔsor ntumbowa wowɔe no, ɔdze hɔn ahyɛ wo nsa, na ɔayɛ wo dɛ idzi hɔn nyinara do tum: Ɔwo nye sika tsir no.
Na ɔwo w'ekir na ahendzi fofor bi so bɔsoɛr a ɔnnto wodze: Na ahendzi bi so a otia anan do tum.
Na ahendzi a otsīa anan no bɛyɛ dzen dɛ dadze: Susuampa dɛ dadze bubu adze nyinara pɔsɔpɔsɔ na ɔbrɛ no adze no: Na dɛ dadze a ɔdwerew yinom nyina no, na obobubu pɔsɔpɔsɔ na ɔadwerew.
Na dɛ mbrɛ ihun anansa na anansɔba dɛ fã yɛ ɔwemfo dɛtse na so yɛ dadze no, ahendzi no mu bɛpaapaa; na mbom dadze dzenyɛ bɛba mu hɔ, susuampa dɛ ihun dadze a wɔdze afora awendɛtse mu ntsi.
Na dɛ mbrɛ anansɔba no mu bi yɛ dadze, na bi so yɛ awendɛtse no, dɛmara so na ahendzi no mu fã bɛyɛ dzen, na fã so bɛyɛ mberɛw.
Na dɛ mbrɛ ihun dɛ wɔdze dadze afora awendɛtse mu no, wɔdze hɔn ho bɔfora adasa asefo mu; na wɔremmfefam hɔnho, dɛ mbrɛ dadze nnye awendɛtse nndzi afora no.
Na ahemfo no hɔn nda no mu na ɔsor Nyankopɔn bɛma ahendzi a wɔrennsɛɛ no da, eso wɔrenndan n'ahendzi nngya ɔman fofor bi do: Na obobu ahendzi yinom pɔsɔpɔsɔ na ɔama ɔasã, na ɔnodze begyina daa.

Susuampa dɛ ihun ɔbobi a wɔnndze nsa twae fii bepɔw no, mu tsewee, na obobubuu dadze no, na sika no pɔsɔpɔsɔ no: Nyankopɔn kɛse no ɔama ɔhen ehu dza dakye ɔbɛba: Na daa no yɛ nokwar, na ne nkyerɛase no si pi.
Nna ɔhen Nebuchadnezzar dze n'enyim boom famu, na ɔkotowee sɔɔr Daniel, na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmma no ayɛyɛdze-afɔr na nduhuam-afɔr.
Ɔhen no buaa Daniel, see dɛ, ampaara wo Nyankopɔn nye enyame mu onyame, na ahemfo wura, na esumasɛm yikyerɛ fo, ɔnam dɛ ɔwo etum ada esumasɛm yi edzi ntsi.
Nna ɔhen no yɛɛ Daniel ɔkɛse, na ɔmaa no akyɛdze akɛse pii, na ɔmaa odzii tum wɔ Babylon enyansafo nyinara do.
Na Daniel serɛɛ ɔhen no ma ɔyɛɛ Shadrach, Meshach, na Abed-nego Babylon asaase nu nsɛm do ahwɛfo: Na Daniel dze, ɔtsenaa ɔhen no n'aban mu.
3: Ɔhen Nebuchadnezzar yɛɛ sika honyi a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduosia, na ne tɛtɛr basafa esia: Ɔdze sii Dura tɛtɛr mu, wɔ Babylon asaase do.

Nna ɔhen Nebuchadnezzar somae ma wokehyiahyiaa amansinahemfo, abakomafo, ambradofo atasmbufo, afotosɛmfo, apamfo mbrakyerɛfo, na asaase no do etumfo nyinara dɛ wɔmbra honyi a ɔhen Nebuchadnezzar dze esi hɔ no no mpuei ase.

Nna amansinahemfo, na abakomafo, apamfo, mbrakyerɛfo, na asaase no do etumfo no nyinara boaa ano behyiaa dɛ worubopue honyi a ɔhen Nebuchadnezzar dze esi hɔ no; na wobegyinaa honyi a Nebuchadnezzar dze esi hɔ no enyim.
Nna ohuafo no tsēatseaa mu kɛse dɛ, aman, amanaman, na kasa horow, hom na wɔahyɛ hom,
dɛ, aber biara a hom bɛtse abɛn, dodogya, nsankutsen, sambuka, bɛntasanku, na bɔtɔwasanku, na nsanku horow nyina ne ndze no, hom nhwe ase nkotow nsɔr sika honyi a ɔhen Nebuchadnezzar dze esi hɔ no:
Na obiara a ɔanhwe ase annkotow annsɔr no, amonmu no ara wɔbɔtow no akyen fononoo gya framfram no mu.

Dɛm ntsi aber a aman no nyinara tsee abɛn, dodogya, nsankutsen, sambuka, bɛntasanku, na nsanku horow nyina ne ndze no, nna aman, amanaman, na kasa horow no nyinara hwehwee ase kotowee sɔɔr sika honyi a ɔhen Nebuchadnezzar dze esi hɔ no.
Dɛm ntsi aber no ara mu no, Chaldeafo binom twee bɛnee bɔtõatoaa Jewfo no ano.
Wobuae see ɔhen Nebuchadnezzar dɛ, ɔhen, tsena ase daa.
Ɔwo, ɔhen, na ahyɛ ɔmom dɛ nyimpa biara a ɔbɛtse abɛn, dodogya, nsankutsen, sambuka dɛtasanku, bɔtɔwasanku, na nsanku horow nyinara ne ndze no, ɔnhwe ase nkotow nsɔr sika honyi no:
Na obiara a ɔannhwe ase annkotow annsɔr no, wɔntow no nkyen fononoo gya frafram no mu.
Jewfo bi wɔ hɔ a ayɛ hɔn Babylon asaase mu nsɛm do ahwɛfo, Shadrach, Meshack, na Abed-nego; ɔhen, mbarimba yinom, woemmbu wo bi: Wɔnnsom w'abosom, eso wɔnnkotow nnsɔr sika honyi a edzi esi hɔ no.
Nna Nebuchadnezzar kãa no ebufum na ebufuhyew mu dɛ wɔmfa Sharach, Meshach, na Abed-nego mbra. Nna wɔdze mbarimba yinom begyinaa ɔhen enyim.
Nebuchadnezzar buae see hɔn dɛ, ao Sharach Mesharch no Abed-nego aso hom boapa ara na hom nnsom mo bosom, eso hom nnkotom nnsɔr sika ohonyi a medze esi hɔ no?

afie dze sɛ hom esiesie homho dɛ aber a hom bɛtse abɛn, dodogya, nsankutsen, sambuka, bɛntasanku, na bɔtɔwasanku, na nsanku horow nyina ne ndze no, hom annkotow annsɔr a, dɔnhwer no mu ara wɔbɔtow hom egu fononoo gya framfram no mu; na bosom kor a ɔbɛgye hom efi me nsamu no nye woana?
Shadrach, Meshach, na Abed-nego buae see ɔhen no dɛ, ao Nebuchadnezzar, onnhia hɛn dɛ yebobua wo asɛm yi mu bi.
Sɛ ɔba no dɛm a, hɛn Nyankopɔn a yɛsom no no obotum dɛ ɔgye hɛn fi fononoo gya framfram no mu; na ɔno na ɔbɛgye hɛn efi ɔwo, ɔhen, wo nsamu.
Na sɛ annyɛ dɛm mpo a, ɔhen, hu dɛ yɛronnsom w'abosom, yɛronnkotow nnsɔr ohonyi a edze esi hɔ no.
Nna ebufuhyew hyɛɛ Nebuchadnezzar mã, na n'enyim sakyeree tsiaa Shadrach, Meshach, na Abed-nego: Dɛm ntsi ɔkasae, na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmma fononoo no ndɔ mpɛn ara esuon nkyɛn mbrɛ ɔtɔ dɛ wɔma ɔdɔ.
Na ɔhyɛɛ mbarimba akatakyi bi a wɔwɔ no dɔm mu no dɛ wɔnkyekyer Shadrach, Meshach, na Abed-nego, na wɔnkɔtow hɔn ngu fononoo gya framfram no mu.
Nna wɔkyerkyeer mbarimba yinom wɔ hɔn ntwontwo, hɔn sorntar na hɔn egugudo, na hɔn ntar nkaa no mu, na wɔtoow hɔn ntar nkaa no mu, na wɔtoow hɔn guu fononoo gya framfram no mu.
Dɛm ntsi osiandɛ ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm no no mu yɛ dzen, na fononoo no adɔ huruhuru mbordo ntsi, ogyaframee no kun mbarimba a wɔdze Shadrach, Meshach, na Abed-nego kɔree no.
Na mbarimba baasa yi, Shadrach, Meshach, na Abed-nego a woakye kyer hɔn no kɔhwee fononoo gya framfram no mu.
Nna ohen Nebuchadnezzar no ho boow no, na ɔsoɛɛr ntsɛmara: Ɔkasae see n'apamfo dɛ, Ana nnyɛ mbarimba baasa a wɔakyerkyer hɔn na yɛtoow hɔn guu ogya no mu? Wobuae see ɔhen no dɛ, ɔhen ampaara.
Obuae see dɛ, hwɛ, muhu mbarimba baanan a wɔasan hɔn nenam ogya no mu, na hwee nnyɛɛ hɔn, na onyia otsia anan no no hwɛbea tse dɛ abosom mba bi.

Nna Nebuchadnezzar twee bɛɛn fononoo gya framfram no ano: Ɔkasea see dɛ, Shadrach, Meshach, na Abed-nego, hom ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn no nkowaa, hom mpue mbra ha. Nna Shadrach, Meshach, no Abed-nego fir ogya no mu puei.

Nna amansinahemfo, abakomfo, na ambradofo, na ɔhen apamfo a wobehyiae no, wohun mbarimba yi dɛ ogya no ennya hɔn nyimpadua do tum, eso hɔn tsinhwi ennhum, eso hɔn ntwontwo annsakyer, eso ogya hua ammfa hɔn do.

Nebuchadnezzar buae see dɛ, nhyira nkã Shadrach, Meshach, na Abed-nego hɔn Nyankopɔn a ɔasoma no bɔfoe ma ɔabɛgye no nkowaa a wɔdze hɔn werɛ tweer no, na ɔasakyer ɔhen n'asɛm no, na oegyaa hɔn nyimpadua mu ama, amma wɔaannsom ɔbosom biara anaa wɔaannkotow annsɔr no, gyedɛ hɔnankasa hɔn Nyankopɔn.

Dɛm ntsi mehyɛ ɔmom, dɛ ɔman, amanaman, na kasa horow biara a ɔbɛkã asɛmbɔn bi etsia Shadrach, Meshach, na Abed-nego hɔn Nyankopɔn no, wobotwitwa hɔn mu esinesn, na wɔayɛ hɔn efi dɛ sumia: Osiandɛ ɔbosom bi nnyi hɔ a otum gye nkwa dɛ iyi.
Nna ɔhen no maa Shadrach, Meshach, na Abed-nego hɔn dzibew krɔnee wɔ Babylon asaase do.
4: Ɔhen Nebuchadnezzar dze kɛma aman, amanaman, na kasa horow a wɔtse asaase do nyina; asomdwee ndɔɔ sõ mma hom.
Nsɛnkyerɛdze na anwanwadze a ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn ayɛ ama me no, mohwɛ a, oye dɛ mebɛkã akyerɛ hom
Mbrɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛdze no dua yɛ akɛse a! Na mbrɛ n'anwanwadze no dua yɛ dzen a! N'ahendzi yɛ daa ahendzi, na no tumdzi fi mbasantsen kesi mbasantsen do.
Emi Nebuchadnezzar metse dwudwoodwo wɔ me fie, na mo ho tɔɔ me wɔ m'aban mu.
Muhun adaaso bi a ɔmaa mo bo tui; na me mpa do adwendwen na me tsirmu enyidoadzehu haaw me.
Dɛm ntsi mehyɛɛ ɔmon dɛ wɔmfa Babylon enyansafo nyina mbra m'enyim, ma wɔmbɛkyerɛ me adaaso no ase.
Nna nkongyaayifo, nkaberkyerfo, Chaldeafo, na sebramufo bae; na mekãa adaaso no wɔ hɔn enyim; na wɔamma mennhu ne nkyerɛase.
Na n'ekyir no, Daniel a ne dzin nye Belteshazzar, dɛ mbrɛ mo bosom ne dzin tse no, na abosom krɔnkrɔn nyina hɔn sunsum wɔ no mu no, baa m'enyim: Na mekaã adaaso no wɔ n'enyim, dɛ,
Belteshazzar, nkongyaayifo wura, osiandɛ minyim dɛ abosom krɔnkrɔn no hɔn sunsum wɔ enyido-adzehu mu no na ne nkyerɛase no kyerɛ me.
Mbrɛ me tsimu enyido-adzehu wɔ me mpa do tse no nye yi: Muhunii, na hwɛ, dua bi si asaase finimfin a ne tsentsen war.
Dua no nyinii, na ɔyɛɛ dzen, na ne tsentsen kodur sor, na wohunii kodur asaase ewiei nyina.
Na n'ahaban yɛ fɛw, na no nsowee pii, na edziban wɔ mu ma nyimpa nyina: Hambowa gyee nwin wɔ ase, na wimu ntumbowa sisii n'abaw do, na adasa nyina dzidzii do.
Muhunii wɔ me tsirmu enyido-adzehu mu wɔ me mpa do, na, hwɛ, ɔweɔmfo kɔnkrɔnnyi bi fi sor dwirii.
Ɔtsēaa mu dzendzen see dɛ, hom ntow duaa no nto famu, na hom ntwitwa n'abaw no, hom mpo n'ahaban ngu, na hom mbɔ no nsowee mpetse: Wɔmma mbowa nguan mfi ase, na ntumbowa mfi m'abaw no do.
Naaso hom ngya no ndwow dusin wɔ asaase mu, wɔ dadze na boran mpokyerɛ mu, wɔ hamu nkyerɛkyɛr momon mu; na ɔsor bɔsu mfɔw no, na ɔnye mbowa ndzi asaase do efuw:
N'akoma nsakyer ngyaa nyimpa dze yɛ, na wɔmma no mbowa akoma; na mfe esuon ntwa n tsir do.
Aweɔmfo no ɔmom do na atsɛn do na adze yi sii: Ama atseasefo eehu dɛ ɔsorsornyi no dzi nyimpa ahendzi do tum, na ɔdze ma obiara a ɔpɛ, na ɔdze nyimpa mu ɔhobrɛadzenyi biara si do.

Adaaso yi na emi ɔhen Nebuchadnezzar mehu: Na ɔwo, Belteshazzar, kã nkyerɛase no kyerɛ, osiandɛ enyansafo a wɔwɔ m'ahendzi mu nyinara enntum amma mennhu nkyerɛase no; na ɔwodze, ibotum, osiandɛ abosom krɔkrɔn sumsum wɔ wo mu.

Nna Daniel a ne dzin dze Belteshazzar no no ho boow no kakraara sann, na n'adwen haaw no. Ɔhen no buae see dɛ, Belteshazzar, mma daa no, anaa ne nkyerɛase no nnhaw wo. Belteshazzar buae see dɛ, mo wura, nkyɛ adaaso no mfa hɔn a wokyir wo ho, nana ne nkyerɛase mfa w'ahohiahiafo ho.
Dua no a ihuniii a onyinii na ɔyɛɛ dzen a ne tsentsen kɛpeem sor, na wohun no wɔ wiadze nyina;
na n'ahaban yɛ fɛw, na no nsowee pii, na hambowa tsetse ase, na wimu nnoma sisi n'abaw do no:
Ɔnye ɔwo, ɔhen a enyin, na ekodu sor, na wo tumdzi ekodu asaase ewiei.

Na susuampa dɛ ɔweɔmfo krɔnkrɔnnyi bi fi sor dwirii bɛsee dɛ, hom ntow dua no nto famu, na hom nsɛɛ no; naaso hom ngyaa no ndwo duin wɔ asaase mu, wɔ dadze na boran mpokyerɛ mu, wɔ hamu nkyɛkyɛr momm mu; na ɔsor bɔsu mfɔw no, na ɔnye hambowa ndzidzi nkodu dɛ mber mber esuon botwa ne tsir do;
ɔhen, nkyerɛase no nye yi, na ɔyɛ ɔsorsornyi no no mom a ɔaba mo wura ɔhen do:
Dɛ wɔbɛtam wo efi nyimpa mu, na enye hambowa atsena, na wɔama awe efw dɛ anantwi, na ɔsor bɔsu afɔw wo, na mfe esuon etwa wo tsir do; ekodu dɛ ibohu dɛ ɔsorsornyi no ɔdze ma obiara a ɔpɛ.
Na dɛ mbrɛ wɔhyɛɛ dɛ wongyaa dua no ndwow dusin no; sɛ inya hu dɛ ɔsorsor dzi tum a w'ahendzi begyina ama wo.
Dɛm ntsi, ɔhen, ma m'afotu nsɔ w'enyi, na fa abɔbɔfo do mbɔbɔrhu pepa w'emumuyɛ; dɛ bi a wɔbɛma w'eyiedzi awar.
Iyi nyina baa ɔhen Nebuchadnezzar do
Abosoom duebien ekyir no, ɔnenam Babylon ahemfi no etsifi.
ɔhen no kasae see dɛ, ana nnyɛ Babylon kɛse a makyekyer mayɛ m'ahendzi tsenabea, ɔnam m'ahoɔdzen tum na mo tumdzi enyimnyam do no nye yi bi?
Ɔhen no n'ano da asɛm no do ara, nna ndze bi fi sor baa dɛ, ɔhen Nebuchadnezzar, ɔwo na wɔkã kyerɛ wo dɛ: Ahendzi no efi wo nsamukɔ.
Na wɔbɛpam wo efi nyimpa mu, na enye hambowa akɛtsena; wɔbɛma awe efuw dɛ anantwi, na mfe esuon etwa wo tsir do; ekodu dɛ ibohu dɛ ɔsorsornyi no dzi tum wɔ nyimpa ahendzi do, na ɔdze ma obiara aɔpɛ.

Dɔn no mu ara na asɛm no wɔ Nebuchadnezzar do: Na wɔpaam no fii nyimpa mu, na ɔwee efuw dɛ anantwi, na ɔsor bɔsu fɔɔw no honam, dze kodur dɛ ne tsinhwi fuuw dɛ ɔkɔrnntɛkuerɛ, na n'awerɛw yɛɛ dɛ nnoma dze.

Nanda no n'ewiei no, emi Nebuchadnezzar memaa m'enyi do hwɛɛ ɔsor, na me ntseasee sanee baa mo hɔ na mihyiraa ɔsorsornyi no, na miyii nyia ɔtse ase daa no ayɛw, mekamfoo no; na no tumdzi yɛ daa tumdzi, na n'ahendzi fi mbasantsen kesi mbasantsen:
Na asaase do atsefo nyina wommbu hɔn hwee: Na ɔyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ wɔ ɔsor dɔm mu, na asaase do atsefo mu: Na obi nnyi hɔ a obotum esianka ne nsa, anaa ɔase no dɛ, ebɛnadzen na ereyɛ yi?

Aber no ara na me ntseasee sanee baa mo hɔ; na m'ahendzi enyimnyam ntsi mo tumdzi na me hyerɛn sanee baa mo hɔ; na m'apamfo na m'birɛmpɔn bɔhwehwɛɛ me; na wotsintsiim me wɔ m'ahendzi mu, na wɔdze akɛseyɛ a ɔkyen kãa mo ho.
Afie emi, Nebuchadnezzar, miyii ɔsor Hen ayɛw, na muhuhor no, na mekamfo no; na no ndwuma nyinara yɛ nokwardzi, na n'akwan yɛ atsɛmbudze: Na hɔn a wɔnantsew ahopɔw do no, otum dɛ ɔbrɛ hɔn adze.
5: Ɔhen Belshazzar too n'ebirɛmpɔn apem pon kɛse, na ɔnoom nsã wɔ apem no enyim.

Belshazzar, ber a nsã no tɔɔ no dɛw mu no ɔhyɛɛ wɔmfa sika dwetɛ nkuraba a n'egya Nebuchadnezzar kɛfaa no asɔrdan a ɔwɔ Jersalem mu no mbra; ma ɔhen no na n'ebirɛmpɔn, ne yernom na no nwewefo nnom mu.
Nna wɔdze sika nkurada a wɔkɛfaa no Nyame fie asɔrdan a ɔwɔ Jerusalem mu no bae; na ɔhen no na n'ebirɛmpɔn, ne yernom na no nwewefo wɔnoom mu.
Wɔnoom nsã, na wɔkamfoo sika, na dwetɛ, boran, dadze, ndua, na abo abosom no.
Dɔn no ara mu na nyimpa nsa do nsatseba puei bae bɛkyerɛɛw ahemfie fasu no ne ban ho wɔ kandzeadua no ne tsesendo: Na ɔhen hun nsa a ɔkyerɛwee no ne fã bi.
Nna ɔhen no n'enyim danee, na n'adwen haaw no; na n'asen mu akwaa sansanee, na no nkotodwe sesɛɛ ho biribiri.

Ɔhen tsēaa mu dzendzen dɛ wɔmfa nkaberkyerfo, Chaldeafo, na sebramufo mbra. Ɔhen no kãa kyerɛɛ Babylon enyansafo no dɛ, obiara a ɔbɛkenkan kyerɛw yi, na wɔakyerɛ me n'ase no, wobofura no ɔberdum, na oenya sika ntweaban egu no kɔn mu, na ɔayɛ ahenman yinom tumdzifo a otsìa ebiasa.
Nna ɔhen no n'enyansafo no nyina bae: Na woenntum annkenkan kyerɛw no, eso wɔamma ɔhen no ennhu nkyerɛase no.
Nna ɔhen Belshazzar no ho guaan no kɛse, na n'enyim danee, n'ebirɛmpɔn no hɔn enyi bɔe.
Na osian ɔhen na n'ebirɛmpɔn hɔn kasaa no ntsi, ɔhembaa no kasae see dɛ, ɔhen, tsena ase daa; mma w'adwen nnhaw wo, eso mma w'enyim nndan:

Ɔbarimba bi wɔ w'ahenman mu a abosom krɔkrɔn sunsum wɔ no mu, na wohun no mu kan, na nyimdzee, na nyansa a ɔtse dɛ abosom nyansaa wɔ w'egya nda no mu: Na w'egya Nebuchadnezzar medɛ w'egya ɔhen noara, dze no sii nkongyaayifo, nkaberkyerfo, Chaldeafo na sebramufo do panyin;
osiandɛ wohun sunsum a ɔkyɛn, na nyimdzee, na ntseasee, adaaso asekyerɛ na anyanyan pɔw mu san, wɔ Daniel kor yi ara a ɔhen too no Belteshazzar no mu. Afei ma wɔnkɛfrɛ Daniel, na ɔbɛkyerɛ ase.
Nna wɔdze Daniel baa ɔhen enyim, ɔhen no kasae see Daniel dɛ, ana ɔwo nye Daniel a ifi Judah ndɔmmummba a m'egya dze hɔn fi Judah bae no mu no?
Matse wo nkã dɛ abosom no sunsum wɔ wo mu, na dɛ woehu kan na ntseasee na nyansa kyɛnee wɔ wo mu.
Na afie wɔdze enyansafo, nkaberkyerfo, aba m'enyim dɛ wɔmbɛkenkan kyerɛw no na wɔmma munhu ne nkyerɛase: Na woenntum asɛm no n'ase kyerɛ.

Na matse wo nka, dɛ itum asɛm ase kyerɛ, na esan anyanyan pɔw: Afei sɛ itum kenkan kyerɛw no, na ema muhu ne nkyerɛase a, wobofura wo ɔberdum, na enya sika ntweaban egu wo kɔn mu, na ayɛ ahenman no tumdzifo a otsia ebiasa.
Nna Daniel buae see wɔ ɔhen enyim dɛ, w'akyɛdze nko woara wo hɔ, na fa w'akatua ma obi; naaso mebɛkenkan kyerɛw no akyerɛ ɔhen, na mama oehu ne nkyerɛase.
Ɔwo ɔhen, ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn dze ahendzi no, na akɛseyɛ, na enyimnyam, na tumdzi, maa w'egya Nebuchadnszzar:
Na osian akɛseyɛ a ɔdze maa no ntsi, aman, amanaman, na kasa horow nyina ho popoe na wosuroi wɔ n'enyim: Nyia ɔpɛ na ɔmaa no do, na nyia ɔpɛ na ɔbrɛɛ no adze.
Na n'akoma maa noho do, na no sunsum sorowee ma ɔyɛɛ nkontompɔdze no, wotuu no fii n'ahengua no do, na wɔgyee n'enyimnayam fii ne nsamu:

Na wɔpaam no fii adasamba mu; na wɔyɛɛ n'akoma dɛ mbowa dze, na ɔnye sar do nsoaso kɛtsenae; wɔmaa ɔwee efuw dɛ anantwi, na ɔsor bɔsu fɔɔw no honam: kodur dɛ ohun dɛ ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn no dzi tum wɔ nyimpa ahendzi mu, na dɛ ɔnoara na ɔdze obiara aɔpɛ si do.
Na ɔwo ne ba, Belshazzar, inyim iyi nyinara dze, naaso ammbrɛ w'akoma adze;

na mbom ama woho do etsia ɔsor wura; na wɔdze ne fie nkuraba aba w'enyim na ɔwo na w'ebirɛmpɔn, wo yernom na wo nwewefo, anonom mu nsã; na ɔwo akamfa dwetɛ, na sika, boran, dadze, dua, na ɔbo abosom a wonnhu adze, eso wɔnntse asɛm, na wonnyim no: Na Nyankopɔn a w'ahom wɔ ne nsamu, na w'akwan nyina yɛ nedze no dze, annhyɛ no enyimnyam:
Ɔno ntsi na wɔsomaa nsakum no fi n'enyim bae, na kyerɛw yi wokrukyei.
Na kyerɛw a wokrukyie no nye: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.
Asɛm no ne nkyerɛase nye yi: MENE; Nyankopɔn akan w'ahendzi, na ɔdze aba ewiei.
TEKEL; woeker wo wɔ nsɛn mu, na woehu wo dɛ etɔ sin.
PERES; wɔakyɛ w'ahendzi mu na wɔdze ama Mediafo na Persiafo.
Nna Belshazzar hyɛe ma wofuraa Daniel ɔberdum, na wɔdze sika ntweaban guu no kɔn mu, na wɔbɔɔ no ho dawur dɛ ɔbɛyɛ ahendzi no mu tumdzifo a otsia ebiasa.
Anago no ara na wokum Chaldeahen Belsgazzar.
Na Medianyi Darius ne nsa kãa ahendzi no, nna oedzi mfe eduosia ebien.
6: Ɔsɔɔ Darius enyi dɛ ɔdze amansinahemfo ɔha eduonu sisi ahendzi no do wɔ ahenman no nyina mu;
na hɔn do etsitsir baasa a hɔn mu baako nye Daniel; dɛ amansinahemfo no mbu nkontaa nkyerɛ hɔn, amma ɔhen ne biribi aannsɛɛ.
Nna Daniel yi gyee dzin seen etsitsir na amansinahemfo no, osiandɛ sunsum kyɛnee bi wɔ no mu; na ɔhen no dween dɛ ɔdze no besi ahenman no nyina do.
Nna etsitsir na amansinahemfo no hwehwɛɛ dɛ wobenya asɛm bi etsia Daniel wɔ ahendzi no afamu; na woennya asɛm anaa bɔn biara; osiandɛ odzii nokwar, eso woennhu no ho mfom anaa bɔn biara.
Nna mbarimba yi kãa dɛ, yerinnya asɛm biara nntsia Daniel yi, gyesɛ yenya no wɔ ne Nyankopɔn mbra afamu.
Nna etsitsir na amansinahemfo yinom boaa hɔn ano baa ɔhen no nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛm, dɛ ɔhen Darius, tsena ase daa.

Ahenman yi mu etsitsir, abakomafo na amansinahemfo, apamfo na ambradofo, wɔabɔ muetu egyina dɛ wɔdze ɔhen ne mbra bɛhyɛ ɔmom, na wɔabra ketsee dɛ, obiara a obebisa bosom anaanyimpa bi hɔ biribi adaduasa yi, gyesɛ ɔwo, ɔhen, hɔ no, wɔbɔtow no akyen ngyata bɔn mu.
Afei, ɔhen, ma ɔmom no ntsim, na fa nsa hyɛ kyerɛwee no ase, ma wɔnnsakyer no, dɛ mbrɛ Mediafo na Persiafo mbra wɔnndan enyi no tse.
Dɛm ntsi ɔhen Darius dze nsa hyɛɛ kyerɛwee no na ɔmom no ase.

Na Daniel hun dɛ wɔdze nsa ahyɛ kyerɛwee no ase no, ɔkɔr ne fie; (eso ne pia no ntokura ebuebue kyerɛ Jerusalem do); na ɔkotoow n'anankoroma enyim mprɛnsa da kor, na oyii mpaa, na ɔdaa ase, wɔ ne Nyankopɔn enyim, dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ no nkwan no ara.
Nna mbarimba yi boaboaa hɔn ano, na wɔbɔtoo Daniel dɛ oribisa adze rokotow serɛ wɔ ne Nyankopɔn enyim.

Nna wɔtwee pinkyɛnee bɛkãa ɔhen no no mom no ho asɛm wɔ ɔhen no enyim dɛ; ana ɔwo ennhyɛɛ mom dɛ nyimpa biara a obebisa bosom anaa nyimpa hɔ adze adaduasa yi, gyesɛ ɔwo, ɔhen, hɔ no, wɔbɔtow no akyen agyata bɔn no mu? Ɔhen no buae see dɛ, asɛm no yɛ nokwar, dɛ mbrɛ Mediafo na Persiafo mbra a wɔnndan enyi no tse.
Nna wobuae see wɔ ɔhen no enyim dɛ, Daniel no a ofi Judahfo ndɔmmummba mu no ommbu ɔwo ɔhen na wo mom a ahyɛ bi, na obisa n'ebisadze mprɛnsa da kor.
Nna ɔhen no, ɔtsee asɛm yi no, ɔyɛɛ no awerɛhow dodow, na osuaa n'akoma mu dɛ ɔbɛgye no, na ɔbɔɔ mbɔdzen araa kodur dɛ ɔbɛgya no efi mu.
Nna mbarimba yi boaa hɔn ano baa ɔhen no nkyɛn na wɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, ɔhen, hu dɛ ɔyɛ Mediafo na Persiafo mbra dɛ, ɔmom anaa ahyɛdze biara a ɔhen ahyɛ no wɔnndan no.
Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ ma wɔdze Daniel bae, na wɔtoow no kyeen ngyata bɔn no mu. Na ɔhen no kasae see Daniel dɛ, wo Nyankopɔn a esom no daa no ɔnoara ɔbɛgye wo.
Nna wɔdze ɔbo bae, na wɔdze hiin bɔn no ano; na ɔhen no dze nankasa ne mpɛtsea na ebirɛmpɔmfo mpɛtsea sɔɔw ano; amma wɔaannsakyer Daniel ho adze biara.
Nna ɔhen no kɔr n'aban mu, na odzii mbuada anago no: Eso ɔamma wɔammfa sanku bi ammmba n'enyim: Na ne nda guanee fii no ho.
Nna ɔhen no soɛɛr anapahema, na ɔdze ntsɛntsɛm kɔr ngyata bɔn no ano.

Na ɔbɛɛn bɔn no wɔ Daniel nkyɛn no, ɔdze awerɛhow ndze tsēaa mu: Ɔhen no kasae see Daniel dɛ Daniel, Nyankopɔn tseasefo n'akowaa, wo Nyankopɔn a esom no daa daa no etum agye wo efi ngyata no anomu anaa?
Nna Daniel see ɔhen no dɛ, ɔhen, tsena ase daa.
Me Nyankopɔn asoma no bɔfoe, ma oebomua ngyata no ano, na wɔannyɛ me hwee: Osiandɛ oehu me dɛ midzi bem wɔ n'enyim; na ɔwo, ɔhen, w'emyim so mennyɛɛ bɔn bi.
Nna ɔhen no ɔyɛɛ no dɛw mbordo, na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wonyi Daniel mfi bɔn no mu mbra sor. Nna woyii Daniel fii bɔn no mu baa sor, na woenhu hweeara wɔ no ho, osiandɛ ɔdze no werɛ hyɛɛ ne Nyankopɔn mu.

Na ɔhen no hyɛe, na wɔdze mbarimba no a wɔtõatoaa Daniel no bae, na wɔtoow hɔn guu ngyata bɔn no mu, hɔn hɔn mba, na hɔn yernom; na ngyata no faa hɔn do, na wɔbobɔɔ hɔn mbiew mu, ansaana worudu bɔn noase.
Nna ɔhen Darius kyerɛwee kɛmaa aman, amanaman, na kasa horow nyina a wɔtsetse asaase nyina do no; asomdwee ndɔ sõ mma hom.
Mehyɛ mom dɛ, m'ahenman a midzi do tum nyina mu, adasa ho mpopo na wonsuro wɔ Daniel ne Nyankopɔn tseasefo, na otsim hɔ daa, na n'ahendzi dza wɔnnsɛɛ no da a, na no tumdzi bɛtsena hɔ ekodu ewiei:
Ɔno no ɔgye no oyi fi mbusu mu, na ɔyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze na anwanwadze wɔ sor na asaase; ɔno na oeyi Daniel efi ngyata tum nsa.
Dɛm ntsi Daniel yi dzii yie wɔ Darius ahendzi mu, na Persianyi Cyrus ahendzi mu.
7: Babylonhen Belshazzar afe a odzi kan mu no, Daniel sõo daa na ohun ne tsirmu enyido-adzehu wɔ ne mpa do: Nna ɔkyerɛɛw adaaso no na osii nsɛm no tam kãe.
Daniel kasae see dɛ, Muhunii wɔ m'enyidoadzehu mu anago, na, hwɛ, ɔsor mframa anan no tui bɔɔ po kɛse no do.
Na mbowa akɛse anan fi po no mu puei, ɔsor yi, ɔsor yi.
Dza odzi kan no ɔtse dɛ gyata, na ɔwɔ ɔkɔr ntsaban: Mohwɛe araa ma okodur dɛ wotutuu n'atsaban, na wɔmaa no do fii asaase do, na wɔmaa ogyinaa anan ebien do dɛ nyimpa, na wɔmaa no nyimpa akoma.
Na hwɛ, abowa bi so a otìa ebien a ɔtse dɛ osisi, na ogyinae tɔree kɔr fakor, na mparba ebiasa hyɛ n'anomu wɔ ne sē ntamu: Na wɔsee no dɛm dɛ, Soɛr, dzi bɔnam pii.
Iyi ekyir no mohwɛe, na hwɛ, fofor so a ɔtse dɛ ɔsebɔ a nnoma ntsaban anan sisi n'ekyir; abowa no wɔ etsir anan so; na wɔdze tumdzi maa no.
