Iyi ekyir no muhunii wɔ anago enyido-adzehu mu, na hwɛ, abowa a otsìa anan a no ho yɛ hu, yɛ nwanwa, yɛ dzen mbordo; na ɔwɔ dadze sē akɛse: Na ɔmemenee kekaaw mu esinesin, na ɔdze n'anan tsiatsiaa nkaa no do: No ɔsor ɔno na mbowa a wodzii enyim kan no nyina; na ɔwɔ mmbɛn du.

Modwendween mmbɛn no ho, na hwɛ, ambɛn kakraba fofor bi so puei wɔ hɔn ntamu, na mmbɛn a wodzii kan no mu ebiasa ase tutui wɔ n'enyim: No, hwɛ, enyiwa a ɔtse dɛ nyimpa enyiwa wɔ ambɛn no ho, na ano a ɔkekã nsɛm akɛse.

Mohwɛe ara kesii dɛ wɔdze ahenngua sisii hɔ, na obi a ne nda fir tsetse bɛtsenaa ase: N'atar hoa dɛ esukwaankyɛba, na ne tsir do nhwi tse dɛ oguannhwi fitafita; n'ahengua ogyaframee a, na no nhwiir ogyadzɛwee a.
Ogya esutsen fi enyim worae bae: Mpempem mpempem soom no, na pedu mbɔho pedu gyinagyinaa n'enyim: Wɔtsenaa ase rubu atsɛn, na wobuebuee nwoma no mu.
Aber no mohwɛe ara wɔ nsɛm, akɛse a ambɛn no kãe ntsi; mohwɛe ara ma okesii dɛ wokum abowa no, na wɔsɛɛ no honam, na wɔdze no maa ogyaframee.
Na mbowa nkaa no dze, wɔgyee hɔn tumdzi; naaso wɔhyɛɛ hɔn nda na ber a hɔn nkwa bɔtoa do ekodu.
Mohwɛe wɔ anago enyido-adzehu mu, na hwɛ, obi a ɔtse dɛ nyimpa ba dze ɔsor nsuwusiw reba, na ɔbaa nyia ne nda fir tsetse no nkyɛn, na wɔdze no pinkyɛɛn n'enyim.
na wɔmaa no tumdzi, na enyimnyam, na ahendzi, dɛ aman, amanaman, na kasa horow nyina nsom no: No tumdzi yɛ daa tumdzi a orunntwa mu da, na n'ahendzi yɛ dza wɔrennsɛɛ no.
Emi Daniel dze, mo sunsum bɔmee wɔ mo honam mu, na me tsirmu enyido-adzehu haw me.
Mipinkyɛɛn hɔn a wogyinaa hɔ no mu baako, na mibisaa no iyi nyina ho nokwar no. Nna ɔkãa kyewrɛɛ me, na ɔmaa muhun ndzɛmba no ne akyerɛase.
Mbowa akɛse a wɔyɛ anan yi wɔyɛ ahemfo baanan a wobefi asaase do asoɛr.
Na ɔsorsornyi no n'ahotseweefo no dze, wɔbɛgye ahendzi no, na woenya ahendzi no daa, mbersantsen mfesantsen.

Nna mohwehwɛɛ dɛ muhu nokwar no wɔ abowa a otsia anan a ɔsor ɔno na hɔn nyina no a no ho yɛ hu mbordo a ne sē yɛ dadze, na n'awerɛw yɛ boran a ɔmemenee ɔkekaaw mu esinesin na ɔdze n'anan tsiatsiaa nkaa no do no ho;
na ne tsir do mmbɛn du no, na ambɛn fofor biso a opuei na ebiasa tutui wɔ n'enyim; ambɛn no a ɔwɔ enyiwa, na ano a ɔkãa nsɛm akɛse, na ehwɛ a ɔsõ sen ne mfɛfo no ho dze'
mohwɛe, na ambɛn kor no ara nye ahotseweefo no dzii akõ, na odzii hɔn do nyim;
dze kesii dɛ nyia ne nda fir tsetse no bae, na wɔdze atsɛmbu maa ɔsorsornyi no n'ahotseweefo no; na ber baa dɛ ahotseweefo no nyaa ahendzi no.
Ɔkãa dɛm dɛ, Abowa a otsia anan no bɛyɛ ahendzi a otsia anan wɔ asaase do a ɔbɔsor ɔno wɔ ahendzi nyina mu, na ɔamen asaase nyina, na oetsiatsia do, na oebubu mu esinesin.
Na mmbɛn du no ho dze, ahendzi kor yi ara mu na ahemfo du bɔsoɛr; na ɔbɔsor ɔno na hɔn a wodzi kan no, na ɔbɛkã nsɛm ebiasa adze.
Na ɔbɛka nsɛm etsia ɔsorsornyi no na ɔamaa ɔsorsornyi no n'ahotseweefo no aberɛ: Na ɔbɔdwen dɛ ɔbɛsakyer mber na mbra; na wɔdze hɔn bɛhyɛ ne nsa ma ekodu ber bi na mber na ber fã.
Na wɔbɛtsena ase ebu atsɛn, na wɔbɛgye ne nsamu tumdzi no, dɛ wɔbɛsa no na wɔasɛɛ no dze ekesi ase.
Na ahendzi, na tumdzi, na ahenman a wɔwɔ wiadze nyina n'ahotseweefo man no: N'ahendzi yɛ daa ahendzi, na tumdzi nyina bɔsom no ayɛ setsie ama no.
Ha na asɛm no n'ase si. Emi Daniel dze, m'adwen haaw me pii, na m'enyim sakyeer me: Na medze asɛm no misiee m'akoma mu.
8: Ɔhen Belshazzar ahendzi a otsia ebiasa no mu no, enyido-adzehu bi yii noho kyerɛɛ emi mara Daniel, wɔ kan dza oyii kyerɛɛ me no ekyir.
Na muhunii wɔ enyido-adzehu mu; na ɔbaa dɛm dɛ, muhunii no, na mowɔ ahemfie Shushan a ɔwɔ Elam ɔmansin mu no mu; na muhunii wɔ enyido-adzehu mu, na mowɔ esutsen Ulai ho.
Nna memaa m'enyi do mohwɛe, na hwɛ, odwanyin a ɔwɔ mmbɛn ebien gyina esu no ano: Na mmbɛn ebien no wowar; na kor war sen kor, na dza ɔwar no na odzii ekyir firii.
Muhun odwanyin no dɛ ɔresesɛ kɔ anee, na kwaamu afamu na pomu afamy; na mbowa biara nntum n'enyim gyina, eso biara nnyi hɔ a otum gye obi fi ne nsamu; na ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ na ohuhoor noho.
Na morodwendwen ho no, hwɛ, apɔnkyenyi fi anee nam asaase enyi bae, na no ho nnkã famu: Na apɔnkye no wɔ ambɛn kɛse bi a osi n'enyiwa ntamu.
Na ɔbaa odwanyin a ɔwɔ mmbɛn ebien a muhun no dɛ ogyina esutsen no ano no nkyɛn, na ɔdze n'ahoɔdze ebufuhyew tutuu mbirika kɛhyɛɛ no do.

Na muhun dɛ opuaa odwanyin no nkyɛn, na n'enyi beer no do, na ɔsesɛɛ odwanyin no, na obubuu ne mmbɛn ebien no; na ahoɔdzen bi nnyi odwanyin no mu dɛ ɔdze begyina n'enyim; na ɔtoow no kyeen famu, na otsiatsiaa no do, na obi nnyi hɔ a otumii gyee odwanyin no fii ne nsamu.
Na apɔnkyenyin no huhoor noho mbordo: Na ɔyɛɛ dzen no, ambɛn kɛse no bui; na mmbɛn akɛse anan besisii ananmu kyerɛkyerɛ ɔsor mframa anan no do.
Na ambɛn kakraba kor bi fi hɔn mu firii a ɔyɛɛ kɛse mbordo kɔr pomu afamu, na boka afamu, na asaase fɛɛfɛw no no do.
Na ɔyɛɛ kɛse kɛpeem ɔsor dɔm mpo do; na ɔtoow dɔm no na nworaba no mu bi guguu famu, na otsitsiaa hɔn do.
Nyew, ɔmemaa noho do kodur dɔm no safohen no do mpo; na ɔgyee daa ɔhyew-afɔr no fii ne nsamu, na wɔtoow no krɔnkrɔn-bea no kyeen famu.
Na wɔdze dɔm no kãa daa ɔhyew-afɔr no ho maa no wɔ mbrato mu; na ɔtoow nokwar kyeen famu na ɔyɛɛ n'apɛdze na ɔyɛɛ prɔmprɔm.

Nna metsee dɛ ɔkrɔnkrɔnnyi bi rekasa; na ɔkrɔnkrɔnnyi fofor bi so see ɔbaako a ɔrekasa no dɛ, dabɛn na daa ɔhyɛw-afɔr na amamfoyɛ mbrato a wɔdze krɔnkrɔn-bae na dɔm no maa dɛ wɔfa anan ntsiatsia do no ho enyido-adzehu no bekesi?
Na ɔsee me dɛ, obekesi ewimbir na anapa mpenu ahaasa; ansaana wɔatsew krɔnkrɔn-bea no ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, emi mara Daniel muhun enyido-adzehu no, mohwehwɛɛ dɛ metse ase; na, hwɛ, obi enyinoho gyina m'enyim dɛ ɔbarimba.
Na metsee nyimpa ndze wɔ Ulai nsu kɔn do ntamu a ɔfrɛe see dɛ, Gabriel, ma ɔbarimba yi ntse enyido-adzehu no ase.
Nna ɔbɛɛn mbrɛ migyinae no; na ɔbae no, mobɔɔ hu, na medze m'enyim butuuw famu: Na ɔsee me dɛ, onyimpa ba, tse ase; na enyido-adzehu no ɔfa ewiei ber no ho.
Na ɔnye me rekasa no, motɔɔ nda heii, na m'enyim butum famu: Na ɔkãa me, na ɔdze me gyinaa tsentsen.
Na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, merema ehu dza ɔbɛba ekyir ebufuw ber no mu: Na ɔfa ewiei ber a wɔahyɛ no ho.
Odwanyin a ihunii a ɔwɔ mmbɛn ebien no, hɔn nye Media na Persia ahemfo.
Na apɔnkyenyin wirikyee no nye Greecehen: Na ambɛn kɛse a osi n'enyiwa ntamu no ɔnye ɔhen a odzi kan.
Na dza obui a anan besisii ananmu no, ahendzi anan bɔsoɛr efi ɔman no mu, na ɔnndze no tum.
Na hɔn ahendzi n'ekyir ber no a mbrato ewie mãyɛ no, ɔhen a n'enyim yɛ hu a ɔtse nsɛm a no mu yɛ sum ase, ɔbɔsoɛr.
Na no tum bɛyɛ dzen, naaso nnyɛ noara no tum a: Na ɔbɛsɛɛ adze nwanwa mu, na ɔbɛsɛɛ ahoɔdzenfo na akrɔnkrɔmfo no.
Na n'enyitsew ntsi ɔbɛma ndaadaa edzi yie wɔ ne nsamu; na ɔbɛmema noho do wɔ n'akoma mu, na hɔn sɔkyeeyɛ no mu, ɔbɛsɛɛ piinara: Ɔbɔsoɛr etsia ahen mu hen no so; na ɔnodze wobobu no dɛ wɔnndze nsa.
Na ewimbir ewimbir na anapa ananpa enyido-ahzehu a wɔkãe no, yɛ nokwar: Na ɔwodze, tow enyido-adzehu no mu; na ɔfa nda pii a ɔreba ho.
Na emi Daniel, adze bɔɔ mo do, na meyaar nda bi; nna mosoɛree, na meyɛɛ ɔhen n'edwuma: Na enyido-adzehu no yɛɛ me ahobow, na obiara anntse ase.
9: Ahasuerus ba Darius a n'ase fi Mediafo mu a wɔyɛɛ no Chaldeafo ahenman do ɔhen no, n'afe a odzi kan no mu;
n'ahendzi afe a odzi kan no mu na emi Daniel metsee ase wɔnwoma no mu, mfe dodow a Ewuradze asɛm baa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah hɔ dɛ ɔbɛma Jersaiem amamfoyɛ ewie du wɔ mfe eduosuon mu no.
Medze m'enyi misii Ewuradze Nyankopɔn do, dɛ medze mbuada, na eyitam, na nso mohwehwɛɛ mpaayi, na nkotoseɛ ekyir kwan.
Na miyii mpaa memaa Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn, na mekãa mo bɔn, mesee dɛ, ao Ewuradze, Nyankopɔn kɛse a no ho yɛ hu a osie ahyɛmudzi na mbɔbɔrhu ma hɔn a wɔdɔ noo na wosie ne mbransɛm;
yɛauyɛ bɔn, na yɛaybɔ ɔbrakyew, na yɛayɛ emumuyɛ, na yɛatsew etūa, dɛ yɛaman efi w'ahyɛdze na w'atsɛmbudze ho mpo;
na yenntsie wo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no a wɔdze wo dzin kasaa kyerɛɛ hɛn ahemfo, hɛn asafohemfo, na hɛn egyanom na asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyina no.

Ewuradze, ɔwo na ndzeyɛtsenenee dzi wɔ wo, na hɛndze, enyimguase dzi wɔ hɛn, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi; na Judahfo, na Jerusalem atsefo, na Isreal nyinara a wɔbɛn, na hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyir nkurow nkurow a hɔn mfom a wɔafom wo ntsi etu hɔn akɔ hɔ no do.
Ewuradze, hɛn na enyimguase dzi wɔ hɛn, hɛn ahemfo, hɛn asafohemfo, na hɛn egyanom, osiandɛ yɛayɛ bɔn etsia wo.
Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn na mbɔbɔrhu na fakyɛ dzi wɔ no; na hɛndze, yɛatsew no do etūa;
eso yeenntsie Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn ndze, dɛ yɛbɛnantsew ne mbra a ɔnam no nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo do dzi sii hɛn enyi no mu.

Nyɛw, Isreal nyina atõ wo mbra, na wɔaman nkyɛn, dɛ wɔrennyɛ setsie mma wo ndze; dɛm ntsi na woehue ndom no egu hɛn do, na ntam no a wɔakyerɛw no Nyankopɔn akowaa Moses mbra mu no; osiandɛ yɛayɛ bɔn etsia no.

Na ɔahyɛ ne nsɛm a ɔkasae tsiaa hɛn, na hɛn atsɛmbufo a wobuu hɛn atsɛn no dzen, dɛ ɔdze mbusu kɛse yi aba hɛn do: Na wɔnnyɛɛ bi pɛn wɔ wi ase nyina dɛ mbrɛ wɔayɛ no wɔ Jserusalem no. 13, Dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no Moses mbra mu no, na mbusu yi nyina aba hɛn do: Naaso yɛnnserɛɛ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn n'enyimtsewee, dɛ yɛbɛdan efi hɛn emumuyɛ ho, na yeenya nhumu wɔ wo nokwar no mu.
Dɛm ntsi na Ewuradze atsɛw emumuyɛ no, na ɔdze aba hɛn do: Na Ewuradze hɛn hɛn Nyankopɔn ɔtsen wɔ n'edwuma a ɔyɛ nyina mu, na yɛannyɛ setsie amma ne ndze.
Na afei, hɛn Ewuradze Nyankopɔn a edze wo nsa a ɔyɛ dzen yii wo man fii Egypt asaase do dze gyee dzin, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi: Yɛayɛ bɔn, yɛayɛ no emumuyɛ mu.

Ewuradze, dɛ mbrɛ wo tsenenee nyina tse no, meserɛ wo, ma w'ebufuw na w'ebufuhyew ndan mfi wo kurow Jersalem, wo bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do: Osian hɛn bɔn ntsi, na Jerusalem na wo man adan ahorohoraadze ama hɔn a wɔabɔ hɛn ho aprɔw yi.
Dɛm ntsi afei, hɛn Nyankopɔn, yɛ aso ma w'akowaa ne mpaabɔ, na no ntotoserɛ, na ma w'enyim nhyerɛn wo krɔnkrɔn-bea a ayɛ amamfõ no do, wɔ Ewuradze ntsi.
Me Nyankopɔn, brɛ w'aso adze tsie; bue w'enyim, na hwɛ hɛn amamfõ, na yɛmmfa hɛn nkotoserɛ mmbɔto w'enyim wɔ hɛn tsenenee ntsi, na mbom wo mbɔbɔrhu akɛse no ntsi a.
Ao Ewuradze tsie; ao Ewuradze, fa kyɛ; ao Ewuradze, yɛ aso no yɛ; mma nkyinkyim; ao me Nyankopɔn, osian ɔwoara ntsi, osiandɛ wo dzin na wɔbɔ frɛ wo kurow na wo man.
Na meda do merekasa, na miriyi mpaa, na merekã mo bɔn na me man Isreal hɔn bɔn, na medze mo nkotoserɛ roto Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn enyim mama me Nyankopɔn ne bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no;
nyew, meda do rekasa wɔ mpaabɔ mu no, ɔbarimba Gabriel a muhum no enyido-adzehu no mu ahyɛse no, otuu pãa bɛkãa me wɔ ewimbir afɔrbɔ ber mu.
Na ɔkerɛkyerɛɛn me, na ɔnye me kasae see dɛ, Daniel e, afei maba dɛ merebɛma awea ntseasee ho.
Wo nkotoserɛ ahyɛse no, mbrasɛm no fiir edzi, na maba rebɛkã akyerɛ wo; osiandɛ wɔdɔ wo kɛse dɛ: Dɛm ntsi dwendwen asɛm no ho, na tse enyido-adzehu no ase.
Wɔahyɛ adapɛn eduosuon mom wɔ wo man na wo kurow krɔnkrɔn no do, dɛ wonwie mbrato, wɔmma bɔn mbɔ adze, wɔmpata mma emumuyɛ, na wɔnsera akrɔnkrɔndze mu akrɔnkrɔndze no ngo.

Dɛm ntsi hu na hwɛ mu dɛ, ofitsi mbrasɛm a ɔkã dɛ wɔnsan nkyekyer Jerusalem nsi n'ananmu no dze kesi ɔhen a wɔasera no no do, ɔnyɛ adapɛn esuon: Na adapɛn eduosia ebien na wɔdze bɛkyekyer ɔbrɔn na ɔfasu no wɔ ahohiahia ber mu mpo.

Na adapɛn eduosia abien ekyir no, nyia wɔasera no no wobotwa no akyen, na onnkenya biribara: Na ɔhen a ɔbɛba no ne man bɛsɛɛ kurow na krɔnkrɔn-bea no; na n'ewiei bɛba wɔ nsuyirii mu, ɔkõ bɛba araa dze ekesi ase; woesua amamfoyɛ ato hɔ.

Na ɔnye pii bedzi ahyɛmu pintsinn dapɛn kor: Na dapɛn fã ne finimfin ɔbɛma okum-afɔr na edzibanafɔr abɔ adze; na ekyiwadze no etsifi na amamfoyɛfo besi; na ɔdze etsifi na amamfoyɛfo besi; na ɔdze ekowie, dɛ dza woesua ato hɔ no, woehue ebufuw egu amamfoyɛfo no do.
10: Persiahen Cyrus afe a otsia ebiasa no mu no, wɔdaa asɛm bi edzi kyerɛɛ Daniel a ne dzin dze Beltesshazzar no; na asɛm no yɛ nokwar, mekyerɛ ɔkõ kɛse a: Na ɔtsee asɛm no ase, na onyaa enyido-adzehu no ho ntseasee.
Nda no mu no emi Daniel mo werɛ hoow adapɛn pɔr pɔr ebiasa.
Minndzi edziban pa biara, eso nam anaa nsã annka m'ano, eso mannsera koraa, dze kesii dɛ dapɛn pɔr pɔr ebiasa no sõe.
Na bosoom a odzi kan ne da a otsia eduonu anan no mu no, ber a mowɔ esutsen a ɔyɛ Hiddekel ho no,
memaa m'enyi do mohwɛe, na hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi a ofura ndwera a Uphaz sika mapa bɔ n'asen wɔ hɔ:
Ne nyimpadua so tse dɛ beryi bo, n'enyim tse dɛ enyinam, na n'enyiwa tse dɛ kandzea gya, na n'abasa na n'anan tse dɛ ayewa awɔapɔw ho, na ne kasaa ndze tse dɛ nyimpadodow ndze.
Na emi Daniel nko na muhun enyido-adzehu no: Na mbarimba a wɔka mo ho no ennhu enyido-adzehu no; na ahopopo kɛsenara tɔɔ hɔn do, na woguanee dze hɔnho kosumae.
Nna ɔkaa mo nko ma muhun enyido-azdehu kɛse yi, na ahoɔdzen bi annka mo mu, na ahoɔfɛw daan prɔwee wɔ mo mu, na m'ahoɔdzen biara annka wɔ mo mu.
Naaso metsee n'asɛm ndze: Na metsee n'asɛm ndze no, nna m'enyim butuw famu matɔ nda heii, m'enyim si famu.
Na, hwɛ, nsa bi bɛkãa me a ɔmaa moweaweaa m'anankoroma enyim na me nsamu.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, Daniel e, nyimpa a wɔdɔ wo kɛse, tsie asɛm a merebɛkã makyerɛ wo yi na gyina tsentsen; na ɔwo na wɔasoma me wo nkyɛn yi: Na ɔkãa asɛm yi kyerɛɛ me no, medze ahopopo migyinae.
Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Daniel mma nnsuro; na ofitsi da a odzi kan a edze w'akoma sii do dɛ ebɛtse ase, na abrɛ woho adze wɔ wo Nyankopɔn enyim no, na wɔtsee wo nsɛm: Na wo nsɛm ntsi na maba.
Na Persia ahenman safohen no siiw me kwan adaduonu da kor; na, hwɛ, asafomfa etsitsir no mu baako, Michael bae bɔboaa me: Na mekaa hɔ wɔ Persia ahemfo no nkyɛn.
Afei maba dɛ merebɛma ehu dza ɔbɛba wo man do nda a odzi ekyir no mu: Na enyido-adzehu no da ho wɔ hɔ nda pii.
Na ɔkãa nsɛm yi dɛm kyerɛɛ me no, medze m'enyim sii famu, na motɔɔ mmum.

Na, hwɛ, obi a ɔtse dɛ nyimpa ba saso bɛkaa m'anofamfa: Nna mubuee m'ano mekasaa kyerɛɛ nyia ogyina m'enyim na dɛ, ao mo wura, enyido-adzehu no ntsi, m'awerɛhow adan ahyɛ mo do, na minnyi ahoɔdzen bi wɔ mo mu.
Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na mo wura n'akowaa yi ɔnye mo wura bɛkasa? Na emidze, amonmu no ara ahoɔdzen biara annka mo mu, eso ahom biara annka mo mu.
Nna obi a ɔtse dɛ nyimpa saso bɛkãa me bio, na ɔhyɛɛ me dzen.
Na ɔsee medɛ, ao nyimpa a wɔdɔ wo kɛse, mma nnsuro: Asomdwee nkã wo, hyɛ dzen, ɛhɛɛ, hyɛ dzen. Na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ me no, mehyɛɛ dzen, na mesee dɛ, ma mo wura nkasa; na ɔwo ahyɛ me dzen.
Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Ana inyim dza osian ntsi ma maba wo hɔ? Na afei na mebɛsan menye Persia safohen akɔkõ: Na misi mu kɔ a, hwɛ Greece safohen no bɛba.
Naaso mebɛkã dza woekrukye no wɔ nokwar kyerɛwee mu no akyerɛ wo; na obi nnyi hɔ a osuo mo mu tsia yinom, gyesɛ hom safohen Micheal.
11: Na emidze. Medianyi Darius n'afe a odzi kan no mu no migyinaa dɛ murusuo no mu mahyɛ no dzen.

Na afei na mebɛkyerɛ wo nokwar no. Hwɛ, ahemfo baasa bɛba ho asoɛr wɔ Persia; na dza otsia anan no benya noho asen nkaa no nyinara; na sɛ n'ahonya ma no ho yɛ dzen a, obekenyan adze nyina etsia Greece ahenman.
Na ɔhen tumfo bi bɔsoɛr a ɔdze tumdzi kɛse bedzi hen, na ɔayɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ.

Na da a ɔbɔsoɛr no n'ahendzi bɔbɔ, na wɔakyekyɛ mu afa ɔsor mframa anan afamu; na wɔremmfa mma n'asefo, eso ɔrennyɛ dɛ mbrɛ no tumdzi a ɔdze dzii hen no tse; na wobotutu n'ahendzi woekwetsi yinom wɔdze ama binom.
Na pomu afamu hen no no ho bɛyɛ dzen, na n'asafohemfo no mu baako; na no ho bɛyɛ dzen asen no, na oenya tumdzi; no tumdzi bɛyɛ tumdzi kɛse.

Na mfe bi ekyir no, wɔbɛfefa hɔnho anyɛnko; na pomu afamu hen ne babaa bɛba kwaamu afamu hen nkyɛn dɛ wɔrebɛkyekyer: Na ɔremma ne basa ahoɔdzen no nka no ho; na ɔna na ne basa rinngyina; na obeyi ɔbaa no, na hɔn a wɔdze no bae no, na nyia ɔwoo no no, na nyia ɔhyɛɛ no dzen wɔ mber no mu no, ama.
Na ɔbaa no no ndwow mu mfɛwee bi mu na obi bɔsoɛr esuo n'ananmu a ɔbɛba dɛm no nkyɛn, na ɔahɛn kwaamu afamu ɔhen n'abankɛse no mu, na ɔnye hɔn edzi, na oedzi konyim:
Na eso hɔn abosom, ɔnye hɔn gu-ehonyi, na hɔn dwetɛ na sika nkuraba fɛɛfɛw no, ɔbɔsoa no ndɔmmum akɔ Egypt; na ɔbɔtwe no ho mfe bi efi kwaamu afamu ɔhen no ho.
Na ɔbɛba pomu afamu ɔhen no n'ahenman mu dze, naaso ɔbɛsan akɔ nankasa n'asaase do.
Na ne mba bedzi akõ, na wɔaboa dɔm akɛse pii ano a wobeyir apram do, na woetwa mu akɔ: Na wɔbɛsan abedzi akõ ekodu n'abankɛse no ho mpo.
Na pomu afamu hen n'enyibɛber, na oefir edzi abɛnye no akõ, mekyerɛ kwaamu afamu hen no; na ɔdze nyimpadodow no bɛhyɛ ne nsa.
Na nyimpadodow no bɔsoɛr, na n'akoma ama noho do: Na ɔbɛkã mpɛm du du egu famu, naaso orinndzi nyim.
Na kwaamu afamu hen no bɛsan dze nyimpadodow no a wɔdɔɔ sõ sen kan no dze no ebegyina; na ɔdze rokɔ mber n'ewiei, mfe bi no, ɔdze dɔm kɛse na ahodze pii bɛba.
Na mber no mu no, pii bɔsoɛr etsia pomu afamu hen no; nkyii so wo man mu akakabemfo mba bɛmema hɔnho do dɛ wɔbɛma enyido-adzehu no etsim; na wɔbɔhwehwe ase.
Nna kwaamu afamu hen no bɛba abɔhɔr pempe, na ɔafa kurow a ɔagye ho ban dzendzen no: Na pomu afamu mbasa, anaa ne man a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn runntum nngyina.
Na nyia ɔbɛba no do no ɔbɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ nankasa ɔpɛ, na obiara nnkotum n'emyim gyina. na obegyina asaase fɛɛfɛɛw no do, na ɔdze ne nsa asɛɛ.
Na ɔdze besi n'enyim dɛ ɔdze n'ahenman ahoɔdzen nyina reba, na tɔɔtsennyɛfo kã no ho; na ɔbɛyɛ n'apɛdze: Na ɔdze mbaa babaa no ama no, dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ no; na orinngyina, eso ɔronnko hɔ mma no.
Iyi ekyir no ɔbɛdan n'enyi akɔ nsupɔw do, na ɔafa dodowara: Na ɔsafohen bi bɛma oegyaa ahorohoraa a ɔhyɛ no hyɛ; naaso mpo, ɔbɛma n'ahorohoraa no adan ebua nankasa n'etsifi.
Nna ɔbɛdan n'enyi akɔ nankasa n'asaase do akoban no do: Naaso obefintsiw ahwe ase, na worunnhu no.
Na obi bɔsoɛr egyina n'ananmu a ɔbɛma towgyegyenyi pempensinyi bi edua ɔman no n'enyimanyam mu; na wɔbɛsɛɛ no nda kumaabi mu, nnyɛ ebufuw mu, anaa okõ mu a.
Na ɔkwasampanyi bi bɔsoɛr n'ananmu a wɔmmfa ahendzi no n'enyimnyam mma no: Na ɔbɛba no ahodweber mu, ɔdze adzɛfɛdzɛfɛsɛm ebosuo ahendzi no mu.
Na ɔdze nsuyirii abasa bɛpram hɔn efi n'enyim, na woebubu hɔn; nyew, ahyɛmu safohen no so.
Na nkyekyer a wɔnye no bɛkyekyer no ekyir, ɔbɛyɛ no ndaadaa mu: Na ɔbɔfow aba, na ɔde dɔm kakraba bi bɛba abɛyɛ dzen.

Ahodweber mu na obotu aba asaase no do mbrɛ ɔyɛ fɔɔfɔɔ; na ɔbɛyɛ dza n'egyanom, anaa n'egyanom hɔn egyanom nnyɛɛ pɛn; ɔbɛpetse afodze, na asadze, na ahodze ama hɔn. nyew, ɔbɛhyehyɛ ne tsirmu nhyehyɛɛ wɔ akoban no mu ma ekodu ber bi.
Na ɔdze dɔm kɛse bekenyan no tum na ne ndam etsia pomu afamu hen no; na pomu afamu hen dze dɔm a ɔyɛ dzen pii pa boyu sa abɔkõ: Naaso orinngyina, osiandɛ wɔbɔkɔ ne tsir do apam.
ɛhɛɛ, hɔn a wodzi n'edziban na wɔbɛsɛɛ no, na no dɔm no bɛpram do na atɔfo pii ahwehwe ase.
Na ahemfo beenu no dze, hɔn akoma bɛyɛ emumuyɛ, na wɔbɛkã atofosɛm wɔ edzidzipon kor do: Na orunnwie yie: Na ewiei no bokodu ber a wɔahyɛ.
Nna ɔdze ahodze kɛse bɛsan akɔ nankasa n'asaase do; na n'akoma betsia ahyɛmu krɔnkrɔn no, na ɔayɛ n'apɛdze, na ɔasan akɔ nankasa n'asaase do.
Ber a wɔahyɛ no mu na ɔbɛsan aba pomu afamu; na ekyir dze no rennyɛ dɛ kan dze no.
Na Kittim ahɛn bɛba no do; na no werɛ ahow na ɔasan, na oenya abohur wɔ ahyɛmu krɔnkrɔn no do, na ɔayɛ n'apɛdze: Ɔbɛsan mpo, na n'enyi aba hɔn a wɔapow ahyɛmu krɔnkrɔn no do
Na abasa begyina n'afamu, na wobohura krɔnkrɔn-bea no ho, mekyerɛ abankɛse no mpo, na woeyi daa ɔhyewafɔr no wɔ hɔ, na wɔdze amamfoyɛ ekyiwadze no ebesi hɔ.
Na hɔn a wɔbɔ ahyɛmu no ho mbusu no, ɔdze adzɛfɛdzɛfɛw bɛsɛɛ hɔn: Na ɔman a wonyim hɔn Nyankopɔn no dze, hɔn ho bɛyɛ dzen, na wɔayɛ adze.
Na ɔman no mu hɔn a wonyim nyansa no, wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ nyimpa pii: Naaso wɔbɔtotɔ afowa ano na ogyaframee mu, ndɔmmumfa na afõfa mu, nda pii.
Na sɛ wɔbɔhwehwe ase a, wɔdze mboa kakraba bi bɔboa hɔn: Na nyimpa pii dze adzɛfɛdzɛfɛw dze hɔnho bɛbata hɔn ho.
Na hɔn mu binom a wɔyɛ enyansafo no, wɔbɔtotɔ, dɛ wɔrsɔ hɔn ahwɛ, na wɔapɔw hɔn ho, na wɔahoa hɔn ho fitaa, ekesi ewiei aber no do: Osiandɛ ɔbɛkyɛr ekodu aber a wɔahyɛ no.

Na ɔhen no bɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ; na ɔbɛma noho do, na oedzi bosom biara do ekuroponsɛm, na wɔakã anwanwasɛm etsia enyame mu Nyame: Na obesi no yie ara ekodu dɛ ebufuhyew no bɛsã; na dza woesua apaa do no, wɔbɛyɛ.
Eso orummbu n'eegyanom abosom anaa mba hɔn ahwehwɛdze no bi, eso orummbu bosom biara bi. Na obohuhor noho wɔ adze nyina do.
Na n'ananmu na obedzi abankɛse bosom no nyi: Na bosom a n'egyanom nnyim no no na ɔdze sika, na dwetɛ, na aboɔdzembo, na afɛfɛdze bedzi no nyi.
Na ɔdze bosom nanaben no mboa bɛyɛ abankɛse dzendzenndzen no ho adze; obiara a obu no bi no, ɔdze enyimnyam bɛyɛ no kɛse: Na ɔbɛma woedzi dodowara do tum, na wɔakyɛ asaase no ayɛ akatua.

Na ewiei ber no mu na pomu afamu hen no ɔnnye no befimfen: Na kwaamu afamu hen no dze ntseaseanam, na mpɔnkɔdofo, na ahɛn pii bɛba no do dɛ kyinehyiamframa; na ɔbɛkɛhɛn nkurow nkurow no mu, na oeyir aseram do.
Ɔbɛhɛn asaase fɛɛfɛɛ no so do, na wobobutuw nkurow nkurow pii: Na yinom dze, wɔbɛgye hɔn efi ne nsamu: Edom, na Moab, na Ammonmba mu etsitsir no.
Ɔbɛtsen ne nsa so wɔ nkurow nkurow no do; na Egypt asaase nnkefi nsa.
Na obenya sika na dwetɛ akoradze na Egypt ndzɛmba a ɔsom bo nyinara edzi do tum: Na Libyafo na Ethiopiafo bedzi n'anamɔn ekyir
Na nsɛm a ofi boka na kwaamu afamu bɛhaw no: Na ɔdze enyiber kɛse efir edzi akɔ dɛ ɔrekɛsɛɛ na ɔadwerew nyimpa pii huntuhuntu.
Na ɔdze n'ahemfi ntamadan no besi po na enyimnyam bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no ntamu; naso ɔbɛba n'ewiei, na obiara rommboa no.
12: Ber no na Micheal, ɔsafohen bɔsoɛr egyina: Na ahohiaber bɛba a ofitsi dɛ aman bɔbɔɔ adze besi ber no mu ɔmmbaa da: Ber no na wɔbɛgye wo man no, obiara a wobohu no dɛ wɔakyerɛw ne dzin wɔ nwoma no mu.
Na hɔn mu piinara a wɔadeda famu wɔ dɛtse mu no, wobenyan, binom akɔ daa nkwa mu, na binom akɔ enyimguasew na daa sesar mu.
Na hɔn a wonyim nyansa no, wɔbɛhyerɛn dɛ wimu hyerɛn; na hɔn a wɔdan piinara kɔ tsenenee mu no, wɔbɛhyerɛn dɛ nworaba afebɔɔ.
Na ɔwo daniel dze, tow nsɛm no mu, na sɔw nwoma no ano, na onkodu ewiei ber no: Piinara boguan edzi akɔnaaba, na nyimdzee adɔɔ sõ.
Nna emi Danie mohwɛe, na, hwɛ, mbarimba fofor beenu gyina hɔ, ɔbaako so wɔ esutsen kɔn do ha, na ɔbaako so wɔ esutsen kɔn do noho.
Na ɔbaako see nyimpa a ofura ndwera no a ɔwɔ esutsen etsifi no dɛ, ɔbɛkyɛr ahen ana ekodu anwanwadze yinom ewiei?

Na metsee nyimpa a ofura ndwera no a ɔwɔ esutsen etsifi no, na ɔmaa ne nyimfa na ne bankum do kyerɛɛ sor, na ɔkãa nyia ɔtse ase daa no ntam dɛ obodu ber, mber, na fã; na sɛ wowie ɔman krɔnkrɔn no n'ahoɔdzen mu bubu a, nna wobowie ndzɛmba yinom nyina.
Na metsee, na manntse ase: Nna mesee dɛ, ao mo wura, ndzemba yi ewiei bɛyɛ dɛn?
Na ɔsee me dɛ, Daniel, kɔ wo kwan: Na wɔatotow nsɛM no mu, wɔasɔw ano, dze rikesi ewiei ber.
Piinara bɛtsew hɔnho, ahoa hɔnho, apɔw hɔnho; na emumuyɛfo biara renntse ase: Na hɔn a wɔyɛ enyansafo no na wɔbɛtse ase.
Na ofitsi ber a wobeyi daa ɔhyew-afɔr no wɔ hɔ, na wɔdze amamfoyɛ ekyiwadze no esi hɔ no, ɔyɛ nda apem ahaenu eduokron.
Osiarfo nye nyia ɔrotweɔn ekodu nda apem ahaasa eduasa enum do no.
Na ɔwodze kɔ wo kwan kodu ewiei: Na ebɔkɔhom, na egyina wo kyɛfa mu, wɔ nda no ewiei.

1: Iyinom nye nsɛm a Moses kãa kyerɛɛ a Moses kãa kyerɛɛ Israel nyinara Wɔ Jordan egya sar no do, wɔ Paran, nye Tophel, nye Laban, nye Hazeroth, nye Dizahab ntamu.
Ofi Horeb wɔ bepɔw Seir kwan do kɔ Kadesh-barnea ɔyɛ nda dubiako kwan.

Na ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsīa eduanan no mu, bosoom a otsīa eduanan no mu, bosoom a otsīa dubiako no mu, bosoom no mu da a odzi kan no, Moses asaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba no, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ no dɛ ɔnkã nkyrɛ hɔn no nyinara;
Oeku Amorifo hen Sihon a ɔtse Heshbon, nye Bashanhen Og a ɔtse Ashtaroth, wɔ Edrei no ekyir no;
Jordan egya wɔ Moab asaase do, na Moses hyɛɛ ase kyerɛkyerɛɛ mbra yi mu dɛ,
Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn kasaa kyerɛɛ hɛn wɔ Horeb dɛ, hom atsena bepɔw yi ho akyɛr sann:

Hom ndan, na hom ntu nkɔ Amorifo nkokodo nkurow mu, nye mbeambea a ɔbɛn ho hɔ nyinara, wɔ Araban, nkokodo nkurow mu, nye tɛtɛr mu, nye Pomu, nye Lebanon do, nkodu esutsen kɛse no, esutsen Eupherates no ho.
Hwɛ, medze asaase no mato hom enyim: Hom nkɔ nkɛfa asaase a Ewuradze Kãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hom egyanon, Abraham, Isaac, nye Jacob, dɛ ɔdze bɛma hɔn nye hɔn asefo a wodzi hɔn ekyir no.
Na mekasaa kyerɛɛ hom aber no mu dɛ, mara nko murunntum monnkora hom:
Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn ama hom adɔr na hwɛ, ndɛ da yi hom dodow tse dɛ ɔsor nworaba.
Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn, nyɛ hom dɛ mbrɛ hom tse yi mbɔho apem so nka ho, na onhyira hom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔabɔ hom anohoba no!
Mebɛyɛ dɛn mara nko metum masoa hom haw, nye hom adzesoa, nye hom aperper?
Hom nyiyi mbanyin enyansafo, nye enyimdzefo, na wɔda nsew, dɛ mbrɛ hom ebusuakuw no tsetsee, na menyɛ hɔn etsitsir wɔ hom do.
Na hom buaa me see dɛ, dza akã no oye ma hɛn dɛ yɛyɛ.

Nna mefaa hom ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu etsitsir no, mbanyin enyansafo, na wɔda nsew, na meyɛɛ hɔn etsitsir wɔ hom do, apem apem do asafohemfo, nye ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo, nye du du do asafohemfo, nye ahwɛdofo, dɛ mbrɛ hom ebusuakuw tsetsee.
Na mehyɛɛ hom atsɛmbuafo mbra aber no mu dɛ, Hom ntsie hom nuanom ntamu nsɛm, na hom mbu ntsɛn tsenenee wɔ nyimpa nye no nua, nye ɔhɔho a ɔnye no wɔ hɔ ntamu.

Mma hom nnhwɛ nyimpa enyim wɔ atsɛmbu mu; hom ntsie aketseaba nye ɔkɛse nyina pɛ; mma hom nnsuro nyimpa enyim; na atsɛmbu yɛ Nyankopɔn dze: Na asɛm a ɔyɛ dzen dodow ma hom no na hom mfa mmbrɛ me, na mintsie.
Na mehyɛɛ hom adze a hom nyɛ no nyinara ho mbra aber no mu.
Na yetui fii Horeb, na yɛnantsewee faa sar kɛse a ɔyɛ hu a hom hunii no nyinara do wɔ Amorifo nkokodo nkurow kwan do, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ hɛn no; na yedur Kadesh-barnea.
Na mesee hom dɛ, hom edu Amorifo nkokodo nkurow a Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn dze rema hɛn no ho.
Hwɛ, Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze asaase no ato w'akoma nntu.
Na hom baa me nkyɛn, hom nyinara; na wɔsee dɛ, ma yɛnsoma mbanyin ma wondzi hɛn enyim nkɛsera asaase no mma hɛn, na wɔmbɛkã ɔkwan kor a yɛbɛfa do, nye nkurow kor a yebodu do ho asɛm nkyerɛ hɛn.
Na asɛm no yɛɛ me enyisɔ dɛ: Na mefaa hom mu nyimpa duebien, ebusuakuw biara mu nyimpa kor:
Na wɔdanee kɔfoow bepɔw no, na wokodur Eshcol ɔbɔn mu, na wɔserae.
Na wɔfaa asaase no do aba bi kitsae, na wɔdze sanee baa hɛn nkyɛn, na wɔbɛkãa hɛn asɛm see dɛ, asaase a Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn dze rema hɛn no oye.
Naaso hom ammpɛ dɛ hom fow kɔ, nahom tseew Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn mbrasɛm do etūa:
Na hom hwinhwinii wɔ hom asesee mu see dɛ, osiandɛ Ewuradze tan hɛn ntsi na oyii hɛn wɔ Egypt asaase do, dɛ ɔdze hɛn rebɛhyɛ Amorifo nsa, ma wɔaasɛɛ hɛn.
Henfa na yɛmfa nkɔ? Hɛn enuanom etutu hɛn akoma, dɛ, ɔman no wɔsõso na wɔwowar sen hɛn; nkurow no yɛ akɛse na wɔatotow ho afasu akɔ sor; na nkyii so yehun Anakfo mbabanyin wɔ hɔ.
Nna mesee hom dɛ, mma hu nnkãa hom, nkyii so mma hom nnsuro hɔn.
Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn a odzi hom enyim rokɔ no, ɔno na ɔbɔkõ ama hom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛe maa hom wɔ Egypt wɔ hom enyiwa mu no nyinara;
nye sar no do, mbrɛ ihun mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn sii tuur wo, dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa tur ne babanyin, wɔ kwan a hom nantsewee no nyinara mu araa dze bodur dɛ hom dur ha yi.
Naaso iyi mu hom anngye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn enndzi,
ɔno a odzi hom enyim wɔ ɔkwan no mu dɛ ɔrokɔhwehwɛ hom beebi ma wɔabɔ hom asesee, wɔ gya mu adzesaa, dɛ ɔkyerɛ hom ɔkwan a hom mfa do, nye mununkum mu adzekyee.
Na Ewuradze tsee hom nsɛm ndze, na bo fuwii, na ɔkãa ntam dɛ,
ampaara ebusuasantsen bɔn yi mu nyimpa yi mu biara runnhu asaase pa a mekãa ho ntam dɛ medze mebɛma hom egyanom no,
gyedɛ Jephunneh ne babanyin Galeb, ɔno na obohu; na ɔno na medze asaase a oetsia do no bɛma no, nye ne mba; osiandɛ oedzi Ewuradze ekyir koraa.
Eso hom ntsi Ewuradze nyaa me ebufuw, dɛ, Wo so ronnkɔ hɔ:
Nun ne babanyin Joshua a ogyina w'enyim no, ɔno na ɔbɔkɔ hɔ: Hyɛ no dzen; na ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ ma Israel enya edzi.
Nkyii so hom mbofraba no a hom se dɛ wɔbɛyɛ afonam no, nye hom mba no a ndɛ da yi wonnyi papa anaa bɔn ho nyimdzee no, hɔn na wɔbɔkɔ hɔ, na hɔn na medze mebɛma hɔn, na wɔafa.
Na homdze, hom ndan homho, na hom ntu nkɔ sar no do wɔ Epo Memen kwan do.

Nna hom buae na wɔsee me dɛ, yɛayɛ bɔn etsia Ewuradze yɛbɔfow akɔ akɔkõ, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ hɛn no nyinara. Na hom mu nyimpa biara dze n'akodze miamiae, na wodzii kan dɛ wɔrokɔfow akɔ bepɔ no do.
Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, se hɔn dɛ, mma wɔmmfow, nkyii so mma wɔnnkõ; na minnyi hom mu; bɛyɛ na hom akɔtotɔr wɔ hom atamfo enyim.
Na mekasaa mekyerɛɛ hom, na hom enntsie; na hom tseew Ewuradze mbrasɛm do etūa, na hom tsitsii hom enyi ho ara fowee kɔr bepɔw no do.
Na Amorifo a wɔtse bepɔw no do no fiir edzi behyiaa hom, na wotsiiw hom, dɛ mbrɛ ndowa yɛ, na wokunkum hom wɔ Seir araa kodur Hormah.
Na hom sanee na wobosūi wɔ Ewuradze enyim na enntsie hom ndze, na ɔannyɛ aso amma hom.
Nna hom tsenaa Kadesh dzii nda pii, dɛ mbrɛ nda a hom dze tsenaa hɔ tse no.
2: Nna yɛdanee, na yetuu hɛn kwan kɔr sar no do wɔ Epo Memen kwan do, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze kãaa kyerɛɛ me no: Na yekyiin Seir bepɔw ho nda pii.
Na Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ me dɛ,
Hom ekyin bepɔw yi ho akyɛr sann: Hom ndan homho wɔ kwaamu afamu.
Na hyɛ ɔman no dɛ, hom rubotwa mu wɔ hom nuanom Esau mba a wɔtse Seir no ntoaado; na wobosuro yie papa:
mma wɔnnye hɔn nndzi aper; na meremmfa hɔn asaase no memma hom, oho nnyɛ mbrɛ ɔnamɔn mpo betsia a: Osiandɛ medze Seir bepɔw mama Esau dɛ ɔmfa.
Hom mfa sika ntɔ hɔn hɔ edziban, na hom eedzi; na hom mfa sika ntɔ hɔn hɔ nsu so, na hom aanom.
Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ehyira wo wɔ wo nsaano edwuma nyinara mu: Oehu wo nantsew wɔ sar kɛse yi do: Mfe eduanan yi Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn edzi w'ekyir; onnhia wo biribiara.
Nna yetwae fi hɛn nuanom Esaumba a wɔtse Seir no ho, fi Arabah kwan do fi Elath nye Eziongeber. Na yɛdanee, na yekotwaa mu wɔ Moab sar no do kwan do.
Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, mma nnhiahia Moab ho, nkyii so mma nnye hɔn nndzi aper nnkõ: Na meremmfa n'asaase mu bi memma wo mma emmfa; osiandɛ medze Ar mama Lotmba dɛ wɔmfa.
Emfo no na wɔtsenaa do nkan no, ɔman kɛse a wɔdɔɔ sõ, na wɔwowar dɛ Anakfo:
Iyinom so na wobu hɔn Rephafo, dɛ Anakfo; na Moabfo dze wɔnfrɛ hɔn Emfo.
Horfo so na nkyɛ nkan no wɔtsenaa Seir, na Esaumba no hyɛɛ hɔn ananmu; na wɔsɛɛ hɔn wɔhɔn enyim na wɔtsenaa hɔn ananmu dɛ mbrɛ Israel yɛɛ n'enyadze asaase a Ewuradze dze maa hɔn no.
Afei hom nsoɛr, na hom nkotwa ɔwora Zered no. Na yekotwaaa ɔwora Zered.

Na nda dodow a yɛdze nantsewee fi Kadesh-barnea bodur dɛ yebotwaa ɔwora Zered no, ɔyɛ mfe eduasa awɔtwe; obodur dɛ akofo ebusuasantsen no nyinara wɔhyeew wɔ nseraban no mu, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze kãa ho ntam no.
Nkyii so Ewuradze nsa tsiaa hɔn, dɛ ɔresɛɛ hɔn efi nseraban no mu, ekodu dɛ wɔbɛhyew.
Nna ɔbaa dɛ aber a akofo no nyinara hyewee na wowuwui fii ɔman no mu no,
Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ me dɛ,
Ndɛ da yi na irubotwa mu wɔ Ar, Moab ntoaado no:
Na sɛ ibodu Ammonmba tsentsendo a, mma nnhiahia hɔn ho, na nnye hɔn nndzi aper so: Na meremmfa Ammonmba asaase mu bi memma wo mma emmfa: Osiandɛ medze mama Lotmba dɛ wɔmfa.
ɔno so wobu no Rephafo asaase; Rephafo tsenaa do nkan no: Na Ammonmba dze wɔfrɛ hɔn Zamzummfo;
ɔman kɛse a, wɔdɔɔ sõ, na wɔwowar dɛ Anakfo; na Ewuradze sɛɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn enyim; na wɔhyɛɛ hɔn ananmu:
dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛe mma Esaumba a wɔtse Seir, aber a ɔsɛɛ Horfo wɔ hɔn enyim; na wɔhyɛɛ hɔn ananmu, naa wɔtsenaa hɔn ananmu araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi;
na Avvifo a wɔtsenatsenaa nkuroba araa araa ɔdze kodu Gaza mu no, Caphtorfo a, wofi Caphtor bae no, bɛsɛɛ hɔn, na wɔtsenaa hɔn ananmu.
Hom nsoɛr, wontu hom kwam, na wonkotwa Arnon bɔnsa; hwɛ, medze Amornyi Sihon, Heshbon hen no, nye n'asaase mahyɛ wo nsa: Hyɛ ase fa na nye no adi aper nkõ.
Ndɛ da yi na mebɛhyɛ ase medze wo ho suro nye wo hohu megu amanaman a wɔwɔ ɔsor nyinaa ase a wɔbɛtse wo nka do, na hɔn ho apopo, na hɔn ho apopo, na hɔn ho eguan hɔn wɔ wo ntsi.
Na Kedamoth sar do na mifi mosomaa abɔfo ma wɔdze asomdwee nsɛm kɔr Heshbon hen Sihon nkyɛn dɛ,
Ma muntwa mu wɔ w'asaase do: Ɔtsempɔn do ara na mebɛfa akɔ, merenndan mmfa enyimfa anaa abankum.
Tɔn me edziban gye sika, ma mindzi; na ma me nsu gye sika ma monnom: Ma memfa m'anan kwa mumbotwa mu:
dɛ mbrɛ Esaumba a wɔtse Seir, na Mboabfo a wɔtse Ar, yɛɛ me no; ma onkodu dɛ mubo twa Jordan makɔ asaase a Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn dze rema hɛn no do.
Na Heshbon hen sibon amma hɛn kwan dɛ yentwa mu wɔ ne nkyɛn: Osiandɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ no sunsum dzen, na opiriim n'akoma, ma ɔdze no aahyɛ wo nsa, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, hwɛ, mahyɛ ase meyi Sihon nye n'asaase mama wɔ w'enyim: Hyɛ ase fa, na enya n'asaase no edzi.
Nna Sihon fir edzi behyiaa hɛn, ɔno nye ne man nyinara, dɛ ɔrobɔkõ wɔ Jahaz.
Na Ewuradze hɛn Nyankoɔn yii no mae wɔ hɛn enyin; na yekunkum ɔno, nye ne mbabanyin, nye ne man nyinara.
Na yɛfaa no nkurow nyinara aber no mu, na yɛsɛɛ kurow biara a nyi mpa tse mu no pasapasa, dze kaa mbaa nye mbofraba ho; yeenngyaa biara mma ɔannka:
Ofiembowa nko na hɛn ara yɛfaa no afonam, dze kaa nkurow a yɛfae no mu asadze ho.
Ofi Aroer a ɔwɔ Arnon ɔbɔn no mu no do, araa dze kɔ Gilead, kurow biara nnyi hɔ a ɔyɛɛ dzen dodow maa hɛn:
Ammonmba asaase no nko na ɔwɔ nkokodo nkurow nkurow mu no, nye beebiara a Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn braa hɛn no.
3: Nna yɛdanee, na yɛfowee kɔr Bashan kwan do: Na Bashan hen Og fiir edzi behyiaa hɛn, ɔno nye ne man nyinara, dɛ ɔrobɔkõ wɔ Edrei.
Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, mma nnsuro no: Na meyi ɔno, nye ne man nyinara, nye n'asaase, mahyɛ wo nsa; na yɛ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ Amorifo hen Sihon a ɔtsenaa Heshbon no.
Dɛmara na Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn yii Bashan hen Og so, nye ne man nyinara, hyɛɛ hɛn nsa: Na yekum no araa kodur dɛ woenngyaa biara mma wɔannka amma no.
Na yɛgyee no nkurow nyinara aber no mu; kurow biara nnyi hɔ a yɛanngye no hɔn hɔ; nkurow eduosia, Argob mbew nyinara, Og n'ahenman a ɔwɔ Bashan.
Iyinom nyinara yɛ nkurow a no ho wɔ afasu atsentsen, mbotsen, nye adaban; ɔsor nkurow a ɔdɔɔ sõ piigyan a no ho nnyi afasu.
Na yɛsɛɛ hɔn pasapasa, dɛ mbrɛ yɛyɛɛ Heshbon hen Sihon no,yɛsɛɛ kurow biara a nyimpa tse mu no pasapasa, dze kaa mbaa nye mbofrabaho.
Na ofie mbowa nyinara, na nkurow no mu asadze no dze, hɛnara yɛfaa no afonam.
Na yɛgyee asaase no wɔ Amorifo ahemfo beenu no a wɔwɔ Jordan egya no nsamu aber no mu, fi Arnon ɔbɔn mu kodur bepɔw Hermon ho;
(Hermon no zidonfo frɛ no Sirion, na Amorifo frɛ no Senir;)
tɛtɛr mu nkurow nyinara, nye Gilead nyinara, nye Bashan nyinara, kodur Salecah nye Edrei, Og n'ahenman nkurow a ɔwɔ Bashan.
(Na Bashan hen Og nko na ɔkae wɔ Rephafo nkaa no mu; hwɛ, ne mpadua yɛ dadze mpadua; ana onny Ammonmba Rabbah bi a? Ne tsentsen yɛ basada akron, ne ne tɛtɛr basafa anan, dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa basaa tse.)

Na asase yi na yɛfae wɔ aber no mu: Ofi Aroer a ɔwɔ Arnon ɔbɔn ho, nye Gilead nkokodo nkurow ɔfã, nye no nkurow, na medze memaa Manasseh ebusuakuw ɔfã no; Argob mbew nyinara, mekyerɛ Bashan nyinara. (ɔnoara na wɔfrɛ no Rephaim asaase no.
Manasseh ne babanyin Jair faa Argob mbew nyinara, kodur Geshurfo nye Maacathfo ntoado, na ɔtoo no dzin, mekyrɛ Bashan a, dɛ mbrɛ ne dzin tse, Havvoth-jair, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.)
Na medze Gilead memaa Machir.
Na Reubenfo nye Gadfo na medze ofi Gilead araa dze kodu Aron ɔbɔn ho, ɔbɔn no ne finimfin, nye no ntoaado memaa hɔn; mekyerɛ dze kodu esutsen Jabbok a ɔyɛ Ammonmba ɔhe no do;
Arabah so, nye Jordan nye no ntoaado, ofi Chinnereth araa dze kodu Arabah epo ho, nkyen Epo no, wɔ Pisgah ntserɛwee ase boka afamu.
Na mehyɛɛ hom aber no mu dɛ, Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn dze asaase yi ama hom dɛ hom mfa: Hom mmia ntwa mu ndzi hom nuanom Israelmba enyim, mbanyin a wɔyɛ ndam nyinara.
Hom yernom, nye hom mbofraba, nye hom fiembowa dze (minyim dɛ hom wɔ fiembowa piigyan) wɔntsena hom nkurow a medze mama hom no mu;

nkodu dɛ Ewuradze bɛma hom nuanom ahomgye, dɛ hom, na hɛn so wɔaakɛfa asaase a Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn dze rema hɔn wɔ Jordan egya no: N'ekyirno na hom mu nyimpa biara nsan mbra n'enyadze do, dza medze mama hom no a.
Na mehyɛɛ Joshua aber no mu dɛ, w'enyiwa ehu dza Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn dze ayɛ ahemfo beenu yi nyinara: Na Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn, ɔno nye nyia ɔrokõ ma hom.
Na meserɛɛ Ewuradze aber no mu dɛ,
Ao Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, ɔwo na ahyɛ ase dze wo kɛseyɛ, nye wonsa dzendzen no akyerɛ w'akowaa: Na onyame bɛn na ɔwɔ ɔsor anaa asaase do a obotum ayɛdɛ mbrɛ wo ndwuma, nye mbrɛ w'akatakyidze tsetse?
Mepa wo kyɛw, ma muntwa nkɔ, na monkɔhwɛ asaase pa a ɔwɔ Jordan egya no, nye Lebanon.
Na hom ntsi Ewuradze no bofuuw me, na oenntsie me: Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, ma ɔndɔɔ wosõ; mma nnye me nnkasa asɛm yi ho bio.
Fow kɔ Pisgah etsifi, na ma w'enyiwa do wɔ anee afamu nye kwaamu afamu, nye pomu afamu nye boka afamu, na fa w'enyiwa hyɛ; na ɔwo runntwa Jordan yi.
Mbom hyɛ Joshua, na hyɛ nsi, na hyɛ no dzen: Na ɔno na obedzi ɔman yi enyim etwa, na ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ ma woeenya asaase a ibohu no edzi.
Nna yɛtsenaa ɔbɔn no mu wɔ Beth-peor tsentsendo.
4: Na afei, Israel, hom ntsie ahyɛdze nye atsɛmbu a mɛkyerɛkyerɛ hom dɛ hom nyɛ no; na hom eenya nkwa, na wɔaakɔ akɛfa asaase a Ewuradze, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn dze rema hom no.
Mma hom mmfa hwee nnkã asɛm a merehyɛ hom yi ho, nkyii so mma hom nyi do bi, na hom eedzi Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn mbransɛm a merehyɛ hom yi do.
Hom enyiwa ehu dza osian Baal-peor ntsi Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn asɛɛ hɔn efi wo mu.
Na hom a hom takyeer Ewuradze hom nyinara tse ase ndɛ da yi.
Hwɛ, makyerɛkyerɛ hom ahyɛdze nye ntsɛmbu, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ me no ara, dɛ hom nyɛ dɛm wɔ asaase a hom rokɔ do akɛfa no mu.
Dɛm ntsi hom ndzi do na hom nyɛ; na iyi nye hom nyansaa nye hom ntseasee wɔ aman a wɔbɛtse ahyɛdze yi nyinara enyim, na wɔbɛse dɛ, ampaara ɔman kɛse yi yɛ nyansa nye nyimdzee ma.
Na ɔman kɛse bɛn na ɔwɔ hɔ a ɔwɔ nyame a ɔbɛn hɔn dɛm, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn tse wɔ aber biara a yɛfrɛ no no?
Na ɔman kɛse bɛn na ɔwɔ hɔ a ɔwɔ ahyɛdze nye atsɛmbu tsenenee dɛ mbrɛ mbra yi nyinara a medzi risi hom enyim ndɛ da yi tse?
Wo ho yie ra na hwɛ, na sie wokra yie, bɛyɛ na wo werɛ efir ndzɛmba a w'enyiwa hunii no, na bɛyɛna woeefi w'akoma mu wo nkwa nda nyinara mu; mbom ma wo mba nye wo mba hɔn mba nhu;

da a igyinaa Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim wɔ Horeb, aber a Ewuradze see me dɛ, boaboa ɔman no ano ma me, na memma wontsie me nsɛm, na woeesūasua dɛ wosuro me wɔ nda a wɔdze tse ase wɔ asaase do nyinara, na wɔdze akyerɛkyerɛ hɔn mba no.
Na hom twee pinii na wobegyinaa bepɔw no ase; na bepɔw no do dzɛɛw gya kɔr sor tonn, sum, mununkum, nye sum kebii.
Na Ewuradze fi gya no mu kasaa kyerɛɛ hom: Hom tsee nsɛm ndze, na su dze hom ennhu; ndze nko na hom tsee.
Na ɔkãa n'ahyɛmu a ɔhyɛɛ hom dɛ hom nyɛ no kyerɛɛ hom, mekyerɛ mbransɛm du no: Na ɔkyerɛw no wɔ abopon ebien do.
Na Ewuradze hyɛɛ me aber no mu dɛ menkyerɛkyerɛ hom ahyɛdze nye ntsɛmbu, na hom rutwa mu akɛfa no do.
Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ homho yie papa; osiandɛ hom ennhu su biara da no a Ewuradze fi ogya no mu kasaa kyerɛɛ hom wɔ Horab no:
bɛyɛ na hom asɛɛ homho, na hom ayɛ ohonyi a woesian wɔ adze biara nu su mu ama homho, ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa saso,
abowa biara a ɔwɔ asaase do ne saso, etubowa biara a otu wɔ wimu ne saso,
adze biara a ɔwea famu ne saso, nam biara a ɔwɔ nsu mu wɔ asaase ase ne saso:

Na bɛyɛ na ama w'enyiwa do wɔ sor, na sɛ ihu ewia nye bosoom, nye nworaba, mekyerɛ ɔsor dɔm no nyinara a, wɔatwe wo ma akɔsɔr hɔn, na asom hɔn, dza Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ahyehyɛ ama aman nyinara wɔ sor ase nyina no.
Mbom Ewuradze afa hom, na Oeyi hom efi dadze fononoo mu, efi Egypt, dɛ hom mbɛyɛ owungyaman mma no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
Nkyii so hom ntsi Ewuradze nyaa me ebufuw, na ɔkãa ntam dɛ murunntwa Jordan, na moronnkɔ asaase pa no a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze no do:
mbom muruwu wɔ asaase yi do, murunntwa Jordan: Na homdze wobotwa, na wɔakɛfa asaase pa no.
Hom nhwɛ homho yie, bɛyɛ na hom werɛ efir Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn ahyɛmu a ɔnye hom dzii no, na hom ayɛ ohonyi a woesian wɔ adze bi a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn abra wo no su do ama woho.
Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn yɛ ogya a ɔmen, Nyame nyinkufo a.
Sɛ ewowo mba, nye mba hɔn mba, na hom kyɛr wɔ asaase no do, na wɔsɛɛ homho, na wɔyɛ ohonyi a woesian wɔ adze biara no su do, na wɔyɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyiwa do, dze yi no ebufuw a:
mefrɛ sor nye asaase dɛ wondzi hom dase ndɛ da yi, dɛ ɔhera na hom bɛhera ntsɛmara wɔ asaase a hom rutwa Jordan akɛfa no do; hom nda ronnwar wɔ do, mbom ɔsɛɛ na hom bɛsɛɛ pasapasa.
Na Ewuradze bɔbɔ hom apetse aman mu, na ɔbɛka hom nyimpa kakrabaabi wɔ amanaman mu mbrɛ Ewuradze begya hom akɔ no.
Na hɔ na hom bɔsom enyame, nyimpa nsaano edwuma, ndua nye abo a wonnhu, wɔnntse, wonndzidzi, wonnhūa.
Na sɛ hom fi hɔ hwehwɛɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn a, ibohu no, sɛ edze w'akoma nyinara nye wo kra nyinara hwehwɛ n'ekyir kwan a.
Sɛ ewɔ ahohia mu, na ndzɛmba yi nyinara ba wo do a, nda a odzi ekyir no mu no san bra Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na tsie ne ndze:
Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn yɛ mbɔbɔrhufo Nyankopɔn; ɔremmpa wo, nkyii so ɔrennsɛɛ wo, no werɛ rimmfir w'egyanom ahyɛmu a ɔkãaho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn no so.

Na afei bisa nda a etwa mu kɔ no a odzi w'enyim no, ofitsi da a Nyankopɔn bɔɔ nyimpa wɔ asaase do, na ofi ɔsor n'ano kor kodu kor so, kyerɛdɛ biribi esi a ɔtse dɛ mbrɛ adze kɛse yi tse, anaa wɔatse dza onye ɔnye no sɛ?

Ana Nyankopɔn asɔ ahwɛ dɛ ɔbɔkɔ akɛfa ɔman bi efi ɔman kor so bi mu afa, wɔ nsɔhwɛ, nsɛnkyerɛdze, nye anwanwadze, nye abasa a wɔatsɛw wu, nye nketsenketse akɛse mu, dɛ mbrɛ dza Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn yɛe maa hom wɔ Egypt wɔ hom enyiwa mu no nyinara tsetsee a?
Ɔwo na wɔdze kyerɛɛ wo, ma eehu dɛ Ewuradze nye Nyankopɔn; obi nnyi hɔ bio ka no ho.
Ofi sor maa etsee ne ndze, ma ɔaakyerɛkyerɛ wo: Na asaase do na ɔmaa ihun ne gya kɛse no; na ofi gyan no mu na etsee ne nsɛm.
Na osiandɛ ɔdɔɔ w'egyanom ntsi, na ɔpaa hɔn asefo a wodzi hɔn ekyir no na ɔdze n'enyin nye no tum kɛse no, yii wo fii Egypt;
dɛ orubotutu amanaman a wɔyɛ akɛse na wɔyɛ dzen sen wo efi w'enyim, dɛ ɔdze wo rokɔ mu, dze hɔn asaase akɛma wo dɛ ewungyadze, dɛ mbrɛ otse ndɛ da yi, na fa to w'akoma mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
Dɛm ntsi hu ndɛ da yi, na fa to w'akoma mu, dɛ Ewuradze ny Nyankopɔn wɔ sor ɔsor nye asaase do famu: Obi nnyi hɔ bio.
Na dzi n'ahyɛdze, nye ne mbransɛm a merehwɛ wo ndɛ da yi do, na oeesi wo yie, na ɔnye wo mba a wodzi w'ekyir, na wo nda aawar wɔ asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no daa.
Nna Moses yiyii nkurow ebiasa wɔ Jordan egya a odzi ba wipuei no;
dɛ onyimpakumfo a okum no nyɛnko awerɛfir mu, na ɔnntan no dada bi no, nguan nkɔ hɔ; na oguan kɔ nkurow yi kor mu a, oeenya nkwa:
Ɔno nye yi, oyii Bezer wɔ sar no do, wɔ ɔman tɛtɛr no mu maa Reubenfo; na Ramoth wɔ Gilead, maa Gadfo; na Golan wɔ Bashan maa Manassehfo.
Na iyi nye mbra a Moses Dze too Israelmba enyim:
Iyinom nye dase, nye ahyɛdze, nye ntsɛmbu a Moses kãa kyerɛɛ Israelmba, wɔ aber a wofii Egypt bae no;
Wɔ Jordan egya, Beth-peor tsentsendo ɔbɔn no mu, wɔ Amorifo hen Sihon a ɔtsena a Heshbon a Moses nye Israelmba kum no, wɔ aber a wofii Egypt bae no, n'asaase do:
Na wɔfaa n'asaase no yɛɛ hɔndze, na Bashan hen Og asaase no Amorifo ahemfo beenu no a wɔwɔ Jordan egya a odzi ba wipuei no;
ofi Aroer a ɔwɔ Arnon ano no araa dze kodu bepɔw Sihon ho (Ɔnoara nye Hermon), nye Arabah nyinara wɔ Jordan egya boka afamu, mekyerɛ ɔdze kodu Arabah epo ho, wɔ Pisgah ntserɛwee ase.
5: Na Moses frɛɛ Israel nyinara, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Israel hom ntsie ahyɛdze nye atsɛmbu a merekã no hom asomu ndɛ da yi, na hom eesūa, na wɔaadwen do ayɛ.
Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn nye hɛn dzii ahyɛmu wɔ Horeb.
Nnyɛ hɛn egyanom na Ewuradze nye hɔn dzii ahyɛmu yi, mbom hɛn a, hɛnara a ndɛ da yi hɛn nyinara tsetse ase ha yi a.
Ewuradze fii agya no mu nye hom kasaa enyim nye enyim wɔ bepɔw no ho.
(Migyinaa Ewuradze nye hom kasaa enyim nye hom ntama aber no mu, dɛ merekyɛr hom Ewuradze asɛm; na osian gya no ntsi hom suroi, na wɔammfow bepɔw no;) see dɛ,
Emi nye Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn a miyii wo fii Egypt asaase do, wɔ nkowaasom ofi mu no.
Mma nnya enyame bi so nnka mo ho.
Mma nnyɛ ohonyi bi, adze a ɔwɔ wimu ɔsor, anaa dza ɔwɔ asaase do famu, anaa dza ɔwɔ nsu mu wɔ asaase ase no su biara ne saso mma woho:
Mma mmbɔ wo mu adze mma hɔn, na nnsom hɔn: Na emi Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn meyɛ Nyame nyinkufo a medze egyanom hɔn emumuyɛ mohwɛ mba kodu ebusuasantsen ebiasa nye anan a wɔtan me do;
na muhu mpempem a wɔdɔ me na wodzi me mbransɛm do mbɔbɔr.
Mma mmbɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dzin gyangyan na Ewuradze nnkɛma nyia ɔbɔ ne dzin gyangyan afa noho tɔtrɔtɔ.
Dwen ahomgyeda no do sie no krɔnkrɔn, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ wo no.
Nda esia na yɛ edwuma na dzi wo dwuma nyinara:

Na da a otsīa esuon no yɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ahomgyeda: Mma nnyɛ edwuma biara wɔ mu, ɔwo o, wo babanyin o, wo babaa o, w'akowaa o, w'afonabaa o, wo nantwi o, w'asoaso o, wo fiembowa mu biara o, wo hɔhoe a ɔwɔ wo kuropon mu o; ama w'akowaa nye w'afonabaa aahom dɛ ɔwo.
Na kaa dɛ ɔwo yɛɛ akowaa wɔ Egypt asaase do, na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ wo dɛ sie ahomgyeda no.
Dzi w'egya nye wo nã nyi, dɛ mbrɛ wo Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ wo nda aawar, na eesi wo yie, wɔ asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do.
Mma nndzi ewu.
Nkyii so nntõ awar.
Nkyii so nnwia adze.
Nkyii so nngye wo nyɛnko ho dasewia.

Nkyii so mma w'enyi mmber wo nyɛnko yer; nkyii so mma wo kɔn nndɔ wo nyɛnko fi, ne haban, anaa n'akowaa, anaa n'akowaa, anaa n'afonabaa, ne nantwi, anaa n'asoaso, anaa adze biara a ɔyɛ wo nkyɛnko dze.
Nsɛm yi na Ewuradze fi ogya, mununkum nye sum kebii no mu, dze ndze kɛse kãa kyerɛɛ hom baguaa no nyinara wɔ abopon ebien do, na ɔdze maa me.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a hom tsee ndze no wɔ sum no mu, wɔ aber a bepɔw no dzɛɛw gya no, hom twee piin me nkyɛn, mekyerɛ hom ebusuakuw mu etsir nyinara, nye hom mpanyimfo;
na hom see dɛ, hwɛ, Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn eyi n'enyimnyam nye ne keseyɛ akyerɛ hɛn, na yɛatse no ndze wɔ gya no mu: Ndɛ da yi na yeehu dɛ Nyankopɔn nye nyimpa kasa, na ɔtse ase.
Dɛm ntsi afei ebɛn ntsi na yenwu? Na gya kɛse yi bɛhyew hɛn: Sɛ yɛtse Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn ndze bio a, ɔno yebowuwu.
Na honam nyinara mu woana na ɔatse ase Nyankopɔn tseasefo ndze dɛ ofi ogya mu rekasa, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn yɛatse yi, na ɔtsenaa ase?
Woara twe pin, na tsie dza Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɛn bɛse nyinara: Na woara bɛkã akyerɛ wo nyinara kyerɛ hɛn; na yebetsie, na yɛayɛ.
Na Ewuradze tsee hom nsɛm ndze, aber a hom kasaa kyerɛɛ me no; na Ewuardze see me dɛ, matse ɔman yi nsɛm no a wɔakã no Nyinara, wɔase no yie.
Ao kɛtseankyɛ woeenya dɛm akoma wɔ hɔn mu, dɛ wɔdze bosuro me, na woedze me mbransɛm nyinara do daa!
Kɔ kɛse hɔn dɛ, Hom nsan nkɔ hom aseseemu.
Na ɔwodze, gyina me nkyɛn ha, na menkã mbrasɛm, nye ahyɛdze, nye atsɛmbu a edze bɛkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn no nyinara menkyerɛ wo, na wɔnyɛ no wɔ asaase a medze rema hɔn dɛ wɔmfa no do.
Dɛm hom ndwen do nyɛ dɛ brɛ Ewuradze hom nndan mmfa enyimfa anaa abankum,
Hom nnantsew kwan no a Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn ahyɛ hom no nyinara mu, na hom aatsena ase, na eesi hom yie, na hom nda aawar wɔ asaase a hom rekɛfa no do.
6: Afei iyi nye mbrasɛm, ahyɛdze, nye ntsɛmbu a Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa nkyerɛkyerɛ hom, na hom nyɛ no wɔ asaase a hom rutwa mu akɛfa no do:
na eesuro Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, eedzi n'ahyɛdze nye ne mbransɛm a merehyɛ wo yi nyinara do, ɔwo, nye wo babanyin, nye wo babanyin ne babanyin, wo nkwa nda nyinara; na wo nda aawar.
Dɛm ntsi, Israel tsie, na dwen do yɛ; na eesi wo yie, na hom aadɔr pii, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze, w'egyanom Nyankopɔn abɔ wo anohoba no, wɔ asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no do.
Israel, tsie: Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ Ewuradze kor:
na fa w'akoma nyinara, na ɔnye wo kra nyinara, na ɔnye w'ahoɔdzen nyinara dɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn.
Na nsɛm yi a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi, ɔnko w'akoma do;
na fa kyerɛkyerɛ wo mba yie, na twetwe ho nkɔmbɔ aber a etse wofie, nye aber a enam ɔkwan mu, nye aber a ereda, nye aber a erosoɛr.
Na fa yɛ asɛnkyerɛdze bɔ w'abaw do, na ɔnyɛ w'enyiwa ntamu nkaakyekyeree
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze wo du asaase a ɔkãa ho ntan kyerɛɛ w'egyanom, Abraham, Isaac nye Jacob, dɛ ɔdze rema wono do; nkurow akɛse fɛɛfɛw a nnyɛ ɔwo na ekyekyeree.
Nye adan a ndzepa nyinara ahyɛno amaama a nnyɛ ɔwona edze hyɛɛ mu, nye mbura a woetutu a nnyɛ ɔwo na itutui, wenyin nture nye olive ndua a nnyɛ ɔwo na etsetsɛwee, na idzidzi na emee a;
ɔno hwɛ yie bɛyɛ na wo were efir Ewuradze a oyii wo fii Egypt asaase do, wɔ nkowaasom ofi mu no.
Suro Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn; na ɔno na som no, na kã ne dzin ho ntam.
Mma hom nndzi enyame fofor a wofi aman a woetwa hom ho ehyia no enyame mu ekyir;
na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn a ɔwɔ wo mu no yɛ Nyame nyinkofo; bɛyɛ na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ebufuw adzew wɔ wo do, na ɔasɛɛ wo efi asaase enyi.
Mma hom nnsɔ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ, dɛ mbrɛ hom sɔɔ no hwɛe wɔ Massah no.
Hom ndzi Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn ne mbransɛm, nye ne dasensɛm, nye n'ahyɛdze a ɔdze ahyɛ wo no do yie.
Na yɛ dza ɔtsen na oye wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do; na eesi wo yie, na aakɔ akɛfa asaase pa a Ewuradze kãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w'egyanom no,
na eetu w'atamfo nyinara efi w'enyim, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze akã no.
Sɛ daakyee bi wo babanyin bisa wo dɛ, dasesɛm nye ahyɛdze, nye atsɛmbu a Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn dze hyɛɛ hom yi ase nye dɛn a?
Ɔno se wo babanyin no dɛ, yɛyɛɛ Pharaoh nkowaa wɔ Egypt; na Ewuradze dze nsa a ɔyɛ dzen yii hɛn fii Egypt:
Na Ewuradze kyerɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze, akɛse yayaayaw, wɔ Egypt, Pharoh, nye ne fi nyinara do, wɔ hɛn enyiwa mu:
na oyii hɛn fii hɔ dɛ ɔdze hɛn reba, dze asaase a ɔkãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɛn egyanom abɛma hɛn.
Na Ewuradze hyɛɛ hɛn dɛ yɛnyɛ ahyɛdze yi nyinara, yensuro Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn, wɔ hɛn yie ntsi, na ɔaagye hɛn nkwa, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse dɛ da yi.
Na ɔbɛyɛ tsenenee ama hɛn, sɛ yɛdwen do dzi mbrasɛm yi nyinara do wɔ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn enyim, dɛ mbrɛ ɔahyɛ hɛn no a.
7: Sɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze wo du asaase a erokɔ akɛfa no do, na ɔpam amanaman pii wɔ w'enyim, Hittifo, nye Gergashfo, nye amorifo, nye Canaanfo, nye Perizfo, nye Canaanfo, nye Perizzfo, nye Hivifo, nye Jebusfo, amanaman esuon a wɔyɛ akɛse na wɔyɛ dzen sen wo;
na sɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn yi hɔn ma wɔ w'enyim,na iku hɔn a; ɔno sɛɛ hɔn pasapasa; mma nnye hɔn mbɔbɔr so:
Nkyii so mma nnye hɔn nndzi awarwar; mma mmfa wo babaa mma ne babanyin, na nngye ne babaa so awar mma wo babanyin.
Na ɔbɛdan wo babanyin n'enyi ma oeegyaa m'ekyir dzi, na ɔaakɔsom enyame fofor; ma Ewuradze ebufuw adzɛw wo do, na ɔasɛɛ wo ntsɛm.
Mbom mbrɛ hom nye hɔn ndzi no nye yi; hom ndwuruw hɔn afɔrmbukyia na wombubu hɔn edum mu esinesin, na wɔmfa gya nhyew hɔn ehonyi a woesian no.
Na ɔwo yɛ ɔman krɔn ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn: Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi wo dɛ ebɛyɛ nankasa no soronko ɔman wɔ aman a wɔwɔ asaase enyi nyinara mu.
Nnyɛ dɛ hom dodow sõ sen ɔman biara ntsi na Ewuradze dze no dɔ sii hom do, na eso ɔsaan mu yii hom: Na hom suar dodow wɔ aman nyinara mu.
Mbom osiandɛ Ewuradze dɔ hom, na ɔpɛ dɛ ɔdze ne ntam a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hom egyanom no do ntsi, na Ewuradze dze nsa a ɔyɛ dzen eyi hom, na ɔapon hom efi no mu, wɔ Egypt hen Pharaoh nsamu.
Dɛm ntsi hu dɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, ɔno nye Nyankopɔn; Nyame nokwafo a osie ahyɛmu nye mbɔbɔrhu ma hɔn a wɔdɔ no na wodzi ne mbransɛm do dze kodu ebusuasantsen apem do;
na otua hɔn a wɔtan no kaw dze bɔ hɔn enyim, dze sɛɛ hɔn: Ɔrennyɛ nyaa mma nyia ɔtan no, obotua no kaw dze abɔ enyim.
Dɛm ntsi dzi mbrasɛm, nye atsɛmbu a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi do, na yɛ.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, osiandɛ hom tsie atsɛmbu yi, na wodzi do, na wɔyɛ no, Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn so bedzi ahyɛmu nye mbɔbɔrhu a ɔkãaho ntam kyerɛɛ w'egyanom no do ama wo:

Na ɔbɔdɔ wo, na oehyira wo, na ɔama adɔr: Na so oehyira wo honam mu aba, na w'asaase mu aba, wo eburow nye wo nsa nye wo ngo, w'anantwi mu ngu mu nye wo nguankuw mu mburwa, wɔ asaase a ɔkãa ho ntam kerɛ w'egyanom dɛ ɔdze bɛma wo no do.
Wobehyira wo asen aman nyinara: Ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa rennyɛ ɔbɔnyin wɔ hom mu, anaa hom fiembowa mu.
Na Ewuradze beyi yarba nyinara efi wo do; na ɔremmfa Egypt yarba bɔn a inyim no bi nnto wo do na ɔdze bɔto hɔn a wɔtan wo nyinara do.
Na ebɛhyew aman a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn beyi hɔn ama wo no nyinara; mma w'enyi nnhu hɔn mbɔbɔɔr: Nkyii so mma nnsom hɔn enyame; na ɔno bɛyɛ efir ama wo.
Sɛ ese wɔ w'akoma mu dɛ, amanaman yi dɔɔ sõ sen me; meyɛ dɛn na meetum etu hɔn? A
mma nnsuro hɔn: Kaa dza Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze yɛɛ Pharaoh, nye Egypt nyinara no yie;

nsɔhwɛ akɛse no a w'enyiwa hunii, nye nsɛnkyerɛdze, nye anwanwadze, nye nsa a ɔyɛ dzen, nye abasa a wɔatsɛw mu a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze yii wo no: Dɛmara na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛyɛ aman a isuro hɔn no nyinara.
Nkyii so Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɔsoma nkotokrodo wɔ hɔn mu, ekodu dɛ hɔn a wɔaka, na woesuma hɔnho no, bɛhera wɔ w'enyim.
Mma hɔn ho nnyɛ wo hu: Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn wɔ wo finimfin, Nyame kɛse a no ho yɛ hu no.
Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛpam amanaman no efi w'enyim nkakrankakra: Mma nnhyew hɔn prɛko, bɛyɛ na haban mu mbowa adɔɔ sõ wɔ wo do.
Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn beyi hɔn ama wɔ w'enyim, na ɔdze adɔngu kɛse bɛka hɔn egu, ekodu dɛ wɔbɛsɛɛ.
Na obeyi hɔn ahemfo ahyɛ wo nsa, na ɔwo aama hɔn dzin ayera efi ɔsor ase: Nyimpaa biara runntum nngyina w'enyim, ekodu dɛ asɛɛ hɔn.
Hom mfa gya nhyew hɔn enyame ehonyi a woesian no: Mma w'enyi mmber hɔn ho dwetɛ anaa sika, na so nnyiyi mmfa, bɛyɛ na woesua wo efir wɔ mu: na ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn:
na mma mmfa ekyiwadze nnkɔ wo fie, na aannyɛ ebusudze dɛ ɔno: Ma ɔnyɛ wo tantan koraa, na kyir no koraa: Na ɔyɛ ebusudze.
8: Mbransɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara hom ndwen do nyɛ, na hom aatsena ase, na wɔaadɔr, na wɔaakɔ akɛfa asaase a Ewuradze kãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hom egyanom no.
Na kaa ɔkwan nyinara a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn egya wo wɔ mu mfe eduanan yi wɔ sar no do, dɛ ɔrebrɛ wo adze, asɔ wo ahwɛ, ehu dza ɔwɔ w'akoma mu, dɛ ibedzi ne mbransɛm do, anaa oho.

Na ɔbrɛɛ wo adze, na ɔmaa ɔkɔm dzee wo, na ɔdze manna a ɔwo nnyim, na w'egyanom so nnyim nyɛɛn wo; na ɔaama ehu dɛ nnyɛ edziban nko bi na nyimpa nam do tsena ase, na asɛm biara a ofi Ewuradze anomu so nyimpa nam do tsena ase.
W'akataho ennsuw wɔ wo ho, nkyii so w'anan annhohon mfe eduanan yi mu.
Na dwen wɔ w'akoma mu dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa tsēa ne ba no, dɛmara so na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn tsēa wo.
Na dzi Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ne mbransɛm do, dɛ ebɛnantsew n'akwan do, na esuro no.
Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze wo rokɔ asaase pa do, asaase a no do wɔ nworansu, nsunyiwa nye ebun a ofifi abɔn nye akoko mu pem no;
asaase a ewifua nye atoko, nye wenyinndua nye adɔmbandua nye pomegranate-ekutu wɔ do; asaase a olive na ewo wɔ do no;
asaase a irinndzi edziban-na wɔ do, adze biara so rinnhia wo wɔ do; asaase a n'abo yɛ dadze, na n'akokoe mu na ibotu boran.
Na ibedzidzi amee, na ehyira Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn wɔ asaase pa a ɔdze ama wo no ntsi.
Hwɛ yie ɔno bɛyɛ na wo werɛ efir Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dɛ irinndzi ne mbransɛm, nye ne ne ntsɛmbu nye n'ahyɛdze a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi do:
bɛyɛ so na edzidzi amee, na esisi adan fɛɛfɛw, na atsena mu;
na sɛ w'anantwikuw nye wo nguankuw adɔr, na wo dwɛɛtɛɛ nye wo sika adɔɔ sõ, na adze a ewɔ nyinara adɔɔ sõ a;
nkyɛ w'akoma ama no ho do, na wa werɛ efir Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn a oyii wo fii Egypt asaase do, wɔ nkowaasom ofi mu no;
nyia ogyaa wo faa sar kɛse huhuhuhu no do, mbrɛ mbowatsena a wɔhyehye nye nyankoma-nketse-bowa wɔ, nye asaase kwawee mbrɛ nsu nnyi; nyia oyi nsu fii ɔtwerɛbo botan mu maa wo;
nyia ɔdze manna a w'egyanom nnyim nyɛɛn wo wɔ sar no do; dɛ ɔdze rebrɛ wo adze, na ɔasɔ wo ahwɛ, na ɔayɛ wo yie wɔ w'ewiei ekyir no mu:
Na ese wɔ w'akoma mu dɛ, mo tum nye me nsa ne dzen na wɔama menya ahonya yi.
Na kaa Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, na ɔno na ɔmaa wo tum dɛ fa nya woho; na ɔaama n'ahyɛmu a ɔkãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w'egyanom no etsim, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wo werɛ fir Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, na ikedzi enyame fofor ekyir, na esom hɔn, na esɔr hɔn a, midzi hom dase ndɛ da yi, dɛ ɔsɛɛ na hom bɛsɛɛ.
Dɛ mbrɛ amanaman a Ewuradze ma wɔsɛɛ fi hom enyim no, dɛmara na hom bɛsɛɛ; osiandɛ hom enntsie Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn ndze no.
9: Israel, tsie: irubotwa Jordan ndɛ da yi, akɔ akɛfa amanaman a wɔyɛ akɛse na wɔyɛ dzen sen ɔwoara, nkurow akɛse a wɔatotow ho afasu edu sor,
ɔman a wɔyɛ akɛse na wɔwowaree, Anakfo mbabanyin a inyim hɔn, na atse dɛ wɔkã no hɔn ho dɛ, woana na obotum egyina Anak mbabanyin no enyim?

Dɛm ntsi hu ndɛ da yi, dɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nye nyia odzi w'enyim rukotwa dɛ ogya a ɔmemen; ɔbɛsɛɛ hɔn, na ɔabrɛ hɔn adze wɔ w'enyim ma eetu hɔn, na ama wɔaasɛɛ ntsɛm, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze akã akyerɛ wo no.

Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enya etu hɔn efi w'enyim egu no, mma nnkã wɔ w'akoma mu dɛ, me ndzeyɛtsenenee ntsi na Ewuradze dze me aba dɛ mebɛfa asaase yi: Naaso na amanaman yi hɔn ndzebɔnyɛ ntsi na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn rutu hɔn efi w'enyim.

Nnyɛ wo ndzeyɛtsenenee, anaa w'akoma ne tsenenee ntsi na erokɔ akɛfa hɔn asaase; mbom amanaman yi hɔn ndzebɔnyɛ ntsi na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn rutu hɔn efi w'enyim, na ɔaama asɛm a Ewuradze kãaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w'egyanom, Abraham, Isaac, nye Jacob no etsim.
Dɛm ntsi hu dɛ nnyɛ wo ndzeyɛtsenenee bi nsti na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze asaase pa yi rema wo dɛ fa; na ɔman akɔnkyefo nye wo.
Kaa, mma wo werɛ mmfir, mbrɛ isii yii Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ebufuw wɔ sar no do; ofi da a ifii Egypt asaase do edze bodur dɛ hom baa bea yi do yi, hom atsew etūa wɔ Ewuradze do.
Na Horeb so hom yii Ewuradze ebufuw, na Ewuradze no bo fuuw hom dɛ nkyɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ hom.
Aber a mofoow bepɔw no dɛ merekɛgye abopon no, mekyerɛ ahyɛmu a Ewuradze nye hom dzii n'apon no nna metsenaa bepɔw no do adaduanan adzekyee nye adzesaa; menndzi edziban mannomn su so.
Na Ewuradze dze abopon ebien a wɔdze Nyankopɔn nsatseaba akyerɛw do no maa me; na no do na wɔakyerɛw nsɛm no nyinara a Ewuradze fi gya mu wɔ bepɔw no do nye hom kasae wɔ nguabɔ da no mu no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ adaduanan adzekyee nye adzesaa n'ewiei no Ewuradze dze abopon ebien no, mekyerɛ ahyɛmu apon no, maa me.
Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, soɛr, fi ha sian ntsɛm; na wo man a ikeyii hɔn wɔ Egypt no asɛɛ hɔnho; wɔadan efi ɔkwan a mehyɛɛ hɔn no do ntsɛm; wɔayɛ ohonyi a woegu ama hɔnho.
Nkyii so Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ me dɛ, mehu ɔman yi, na hwɛ, wɔyɛ ɔman akɔnkyefo:
Gyaa me ma mensɛɛ hɔn, na menyɛ wo ɔman a ɔyɛ dzen na ɔsõ sen hɔn.
Nna medanee na mifii bepɔw no do sianee, na bepɔw no dzɛɛw gya: Nna ahyɛmu apon ebien no kitsakitsa me nsamu.
Na mohwɛe, na, hwɛ, hom Nyankopɔn; hom ayɛ ɔnantwiba a woegu ama homho: Hom adan efi ɔkwan a Ewuradze hyɛɛ hom no do afa nkyɛn ntsɛm.
Na musuoo apon ebien no mu, na motowee fii me nsa ebien no mo gui, na mobobɔɔ no wɔ hom eyim.

Na mohwɛɛ ase wɔ Ewuradze enyim, dɛ ahyɛse no, adaduanan adzekyee nye adzesaa; menndzi edziban, mannom nsu so; osian hom bɔn nyinara a hom yɛe no ntsi, dɛ wɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, dze yii no ebufuw.
Na mu suroo ebufuwhyew a Ewuradze dze fuuw hom no. Na Ewuradze tsiee me aber no mu so.
Na Ewuradze nyaa Aaron ebufuw dodoodow dɛ nkyɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ no; na mepaa kyɛw memaa Aaron so aber no ara mu.
Na mefaa hom bɔn, ɔnantwiba no a hom yɛe no, ma medze gya hyeew no, na misiwii, yaam no mokomoko kodur dɛ ɔyɛɛ fekɔfekɔ dɛ huntuma: Na motoow no huntuma no guu ɔwora no a ofi bepɔw no do pem no mu.
Na Taberah, nye Massah, nye Kibroth-hattaavah so hom yii Ewuradze ebufuw.
Na aber a Ewuradze somaa hom fi Kadesh-barnea, dɛ, hom mfow nkɛfa asaase a medze mama hom no, nna hom tseew etūa wɔ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn mbrasɛm do, na hom anngye no enndzi,na woenntsie ne ndze so.
Hom ayɛ Ewuradze do etuatsewfo ara fi da a muhun hom no.
Dɛm ntsi na mohwee ase wɔ Ewuradze enyim adekyee eduanan nye adzesaa eduanan no a mohwee ase no; osiandɛ Ewuradze ase dɛ ɔrebɛsɛɛ hom.
Na mepaa Ewuradze kyɛw, see dɛ, Ao Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, mma nnsɛɛ wo man nye w'egyapadze a enam wo kɛseyɛ do apon hɔn a edze nsa a ɔyɛ dzen eyi hɔn wɔ Egypt no.
Kaa wo nkowaa, Abraham, Isaac, nye Jacob; mma nnhwɛ ɔman yi hɔn asoɔdzen, nye hɔn ndzeyɛbɔn, nye hɔn bɔn so:

Ɔno bɛyɛ na asaase a iyii hɔn fii do no ase dɛ, osiandɛ Ewuradze enntum ammfa hɔn annkɔ asaase a ɔbɔɔ hɔn annkɔasaase a ɔbɔɔ hɔn ho anohoba no do, na osi ɔtan hɔn ntsi, na ɔdze hɔn efir edzi dɛ orukokuku hɔn wɔ sar no do.
Naaso wɔyɛ wo man nye w'egyapadze a enam wo tum kɛse nye w'abasa a wɔatsɛw mu do eyi hɔn.
10: Aber no mu na Ewuradze see me dɛ, Sinsian abopon ebien a ɔtse dɛ kan dze no ma woho, na fow bra me nkyɛn wɔ bepɔw no do, na yɛ duadaka ma woho.
Na mebɛkyerɛw nsɛm a ɔwɔ nkan no apon a ebobɔɔ no do no, wɔ apon a ebobɔɔ no no do no, wɔ apon no do, na fa hyɛ adaka no mu.
Nna meyɛɛ acacia duadaka, na misinsiaan abopon ebien a ɔtse dɛ kan dze no, na mofoow bepɔw no, na apon ebien no kitsa me nsamu.
Na ɔkyerɛɛw apon no do, dɛ mbrɛ kaan no nkyerɛwee no tse, mbransɛm du no a Ewuradze fi gya no mu kãa kyerɛɛ hom wɔ bepɔw no do nguabɔ da no: na Ewuradze dze ma me.
Na medaane fii bepɔw no do sianee, na medze apon no bɛhyɛɛ adaka a meyɛe no mu; na hɔ na ɔwɔ dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛme no.
(Na Israel-mba tuifiiBeeroth Bene-jaakan kɔr Moserah: Hɔ na Aaron wui, na hɔ na wosiee no; na ne babanyin Eleazar hyɛɛ n'ananmu dzii ɔsɔfo.
Wofi hɔ tui kɔr Gudgodah; na wofi Gudgodah kɔr Jotbathah, asaase a nworansu wɔ do.
Aber no mu na Ewuradze yii Levi ebusuakuw, dɛ wɔnsoa Ewuradze ahyɛmudaka no, wongyina Ewuradze enyim nsom no, na wonhyira wɔ ne dzin mu, dze ebodu ndɛ da yi.
Dɛm ntsi na Levi ennya kyɛfa nye egyapadze wɔ no nuanom mu; Ewuradze nye n'egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyakopɔn kãa kyerɛɛ no no.)
Na misiankae wɔ bepɔw no do, dɛ asɔpɔn no, adzekyee eduanan nye adzesaa eduanan: Na Ewuradze tsiee me aber no mu so; Ewuradze ammpɛ dɛ ɔsɛɛ wo.
Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, Soɛr, tu wo kwan kedzi ɔman no enyim; ma wɔnkɔ nkɛfa asaase a mekãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn no.

Na afei, Israel ebɛnadze na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn rohwehwɛ wɔ wo hɔ, dɛ gyama ibosuro Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, ebɛnantsew n'akwan nyinara do, na adɔ no, na edze w'akoma nyinara nye wo kra nyinara asom Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn,
na edze Ewuradze mbransɛm, nye n'ahyɛdze a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi do wɔ wo yie tsi?
Hwɛ, ɔsor dzi wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, nye ɔsor no sor, asaase, nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara.
W'egyanom nko na Ewuradze nyaa hɔn ho enyika dɛ ɔbɔdɔ hɔn, na ɔsaan mu yii hɔn asefo a wodzi hɔn asefo a wodzi hɔn ekyir no, mekerɛ homara, wɔ aman nyinara mu,dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
Dɛm ntsi hom ntwitwa hom akoma twatsia na mma wɔnnyɛ akɔnkye bio.
Na Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn, ɔno nye enyame mu Nyame, nye Ewuradze mu Ewuradze, Nyame kɛse no, otumfo a no ho yɛ hu a ɔnnhwɛɛ nyimpa enyim, na onndzi mboaba.
Obu egyanka nye okunafo hɔn ntsɛn, na ɔdɔ ɔhɔho, ɔma no edziban nye akataho.
Dɛm ntsi hom ndɔ ɔhɔho: Na hom yɛɛ ahɔho wɔ Egypt asaase do.
Suro Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn; ɔno na som no; na ɔno na takyer no ho,na ne dzin ho na kã ntam.
ɔno nye w'ayɛyi, na ɔno nye wo Nyankopɔn a ɔayɛ ndzɛmba akɛse a ɔyɛ hu w'enyiwa ehu yi ama wo.
Nyimpa eduosuon na w'egyanom dze sianee kɔr Egypt; na afei Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ayɛ wo ɔdodow dɛ ɔsor nworaba.
11: Dɛm ntsi dɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, na sie n'ahwɛdodze, nye n'ahyɛdze nye ne atsɛmbu nye ne mbransɛm dabaa.
Na hom nhu ndɛ da yi: Na mennksa nnkyerɛ hom mba a wonnyim, na wonnhun Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn ntsea, ne kɛseyɛ, ne nsa a ɔyɛ dzen, nye n'abasa a wɔatsɛw mu,
nye ne nsɛnkyerɛdze, nye no ndwuma a ɔyɛe no wɔ Egypt tsia Egypt hen Pharaoh nye n'asaase nyinara;
nye dza ɔdze yɛɛ Egypt dɔm, nye hɔn mpɔnkɔ, nye hɔn ntseaseanam; mbrɛ ɔmaa Epo Memen nsu praam hɔn do aber a woritsiw hom, na mbrɛ Ewuradze asɛɛ hɔn ebodu ndɛ da yi;
nye dzaa ɔdze yɛɛ hom wɔ sar no do, bodur dɛ hom baa bea yi do;

na dza ɔdze yɛɛ Dathan nye Abiram, Reuben ne babanyin Eliab mbabanyin no; mbrɛ asaase buee n'ano, na ɔmeen hɔn, nye hɔn efifo, nye hɔn asesee, nye enyikandze biara a odzii hɔn ekyir, wɔ Isreal nyinara finimfin no:
na hom enyiwa ehu edwuma kɛse a Ewuradze yɛe no Nyinara.
Dɛm ntsi hom ndzi mbrasɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara do, na hom ho aayɛ dzen, na hom aakɛfa asaase a hom rutwa mu akɔ do akɛfa no;
na hom nda aawar wɔ asaase a Ewuradze kãa ho ntam kyerɛ hom egyanom dɛ ɔdze bɛma hɔn na hɔn asefo no do, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do.
Na asaase no, mbrɛ irutwa mu akɔ do akɛfa no, ɔnntse dɛ Egypt asaase, mbrɛ hom fi bae no, mbrɛepe w'aba, na edze w'anan petse do nsu, dɛ fan ture no:
na asaase no, mbrɛ hom rutwa mu akɛfa no, yɛ akoko nye abɔn asaase, na ɔnom ɔsor nyankom mu nsu;
asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn hwɛ do; Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn n'enyiwa wɔ do dabaa, ofi afe n'ahyɛse araa kodu afe n'ewiei.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ hom tsie me mbransɛm a merehyɛ hom ndɛ da yi yie, dɛ hom dze akoma nyinara nye hom kra nyinara bɔdɔ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn, na hom asom no a,
ɔno mebɛba hom asaase do nyankom atɔ wɔ n'aber mu, esusow nye ɔbɛsɛ, ma aaboaboa w'eburow, nye wo nsã, nye wo ngo ano.
Na mebɛma wo haban mu aba nkyɛkyɛr ama wo fiembowa, na eedzidzi amee.
Hom nhwɛ homho yie, ma wɔanndaadaa hom akoma, na hom aannkɔsom enyame fofor, na hom aannkɔsom enyame fofor, na hom aannsɔr hɔn;
na Ewuradze n'ebufuw aanndzɛw wɔ hom do, na ɔaanntow ɔsor mu, dɛ nyankom nntɔ, na asaase mma no ndɔbaa; na hom aannhera ntsɛmara wɔ asaase pa a Ewuradze dze rema hom no do.
Dɛm ntsi hom mfa me nsɛm yi nsie hom akoma nye hom kra mu; na hom mfa nyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze mbɔ hom abaw do, na ɔnyɛ nkaankyekyeree wɔ hom enyiwa ntamu.
Na hom mfa nkyerɛkyerɛ hom mba, twetwe ho nkɔmbɔ aber a etse wo fie, nye aber a enam ɔkwan mu, nye aber a ereda, nye aber a erosoɛr.
Na kyerɛw no wɔ wo fi mpondua ho, na wo mbotsen ho:
Ama hom nda, nye hom mba nda aadɔɔ sõ wɔ asaase a Ewuradze kãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hom egyanom dɛ ɔdze bɛma hon no do, dɛ ɔsor nda wɔ asaase do.
Na sɛ hom bɔdɔ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn, hom anantsew n'akwan nyinara do, na hom atakyer no ho a;
ɔno dze Ewuradze botutu amanaman yi nyinara efi hom enyim, na hom afa amanaman akɛse a woyɛ dzen sen homara.
Beebiara a hom anamɔn betsia no bɛyɛ homdze: Ofi sar no do, nye Lebanon, ofi esutsen no, esutsen Euphrates ho ara kodu ekyirkyir epo no ho bɛyɛ hom he.
Nyimpa biara runntum nngyina hom enyim: Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn dze hom ho hu bogu asaase a hom betsia do nyinara do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔakã akyerɛ hom no.
Hwɛ, medze nhyira nye ndom mirisi hom enyim ndɛ da yi;
nhyira no, sɛ hom tsie Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn mbransɛm a merehyɛ hom ndɛ da yi a;
na ndom no, sɛ hom enntsie Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn mbransɛm, na hom dan fi ɔkwan a merehyɛ hom ndɛ da yi do fa nkyɛn dɛ worikedzi enyame fofor a hom nnyim hɔn ekyir a.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze wo du asaase a erokɔ do akɛfa no do a, ibesi nhyira no wɔ bepɔw Gerizim do, na ndom no wɔ bepɔw Ebal do.
Ana wonnyi Jordan egya, witɔree kwan no ekyir, wɔ Canaanfo a wɔtse Arabah do no asaase do, Gilgal tsentsendo, wɔ Moreh nsudur ho bi a?
Na hom rubotwa Jordan akɔ akɛfa asaase a Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn dze rema hom no, na hom bɛfa, na hom atsena do.
Na hom ndwen do nyɛ ahyɛdze nye atsɛmbu a medze mirisi hom enyim ndɛ da yi nyinara.
12: Iyinom nye ahyɛdze nye ntsɛmbu a hom ndwen do nyɛ wɔ asaase a Ewuradze, w'egyanom Nyankopɔn dze ama wo dɛ fa noo do, nda a hom dze tse asaase do nyinara.
ɔsɛɛ na hom mbeambea nyinara a amanaman a hom rekɛfa no som hɔn enyame, mbepɔw atsentsen do, nye akoko do, nye dua momon biara ase;
na hom ndwuruw hɔn afɔrmbukyia, na wombubu hɔn edum mu esinesin, na wɔmfa gya nhyew hɔn Asherim; na hom ntwitwa hɔn enyame ehonyi a woesinsian no mu ngu, na hom nsɛɛ ɔn dzin mfi bea no do.
Mma hom nnyɛ dɛm mma Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Mbom beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi wɔ hom edusukuw nyinara mu dɛ ɔdze ne dzin bɔto hɔ no, mekyerɛ ne tsenabew no na hom nhwehwɛ, na hɔ na kɔ;
na hɔ na hom mfa hom ɔhyew-afɔr, nye hom okum-afɔr, nye hom ebupɛn du du nye hom nsamu ɔmado-afɔr, nye hom anohobadze, nye hom ayamuyi-afɔr nye hom anantwikuw nye hom nguankuw mu mbakan nkɔ:
Na hɔ na hom ndzidzi wɔ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn enyim, na hom nye hom efifo, hom enyi ngya wɔ adze nyinara a hom dze hom nsa kã a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ehyira wo wɔ mu no mu.
Mma hom nnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ndzɛmba a yɛreyɛ wɔ ha ndɛ da yi mu biara tse, nyimpa biara yɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ nankasa n'enyiwa do no:
Na hom nnyae nndur aahomgye nye egyapadze a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no mu.
Mbom sɛ hom nya twa Jordan, na hom kɛtsena asaase a Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn rema hom ahomgye fi hom atamfo nyinara a woetwa hom ho ehyia ho, na hom tsena dwudwoodwo a;

ɔno ɔbɛba dɛ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi ma ne dzin atsen hɔ no, hɔ na hom mfa dza merehyɛhom no nyinara nkɔ; hom ɔhyew-afɔr, nye hom okum-afɔr, hom ebupɛn du du, nye hom nsamu ɔma do-afɔr, nye hom soronko anohobadze a hom bɔ ma Ewuradze no nyinara:

na hom mma hom enyi ngye wɔ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn enyim, hom, nye hom mbabanyin, nye hom mbabaa, nye hom nkowaa, nye hom mfonabaa, nye Levinyi a ɔwɔ hom kuropon mu, susuampa dɛ onnyi kyɛfa anaa egyapadze wɔ hom mu no.
Hwɛ woho yie mma aammbɔ wo hyew-afɔ wɔ beebiara a ihu;
gyedɛ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze bɛsan mu eyi wɔ w'ebusuakuw kor mu, hɔ na bɔ wo hyew-afɔr, na hɔ na yɛ dza merehyɛ wo nyinara.

Naaso ku na dzi nam wɔ wo kuropon nyinara mu, dɛ mbrɛ wo kra no kɔn dɔ nyinara mu, dɛ mbrɛ nyinara a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze ehyira wo no tse: Nyia no ho nntsew nye nyia no ho tsew ndzi bi, dɛ adoa, nye dɛ ɔtrɔm.
Bɔgya no nko na mma hom nndzi; hue gu famu dɛ nsu.

Mma nndzi w'eburow, anaa wo nsã, anaa wo ngo mu ebupɛn du du wɔ wo kuropon mu, anaa wɔanantwikuw anaa wo nguankuw mu mbakan, nye w'anohobadze biara a ebɔ ho anohoba, nye w'ayamuyi-afɔr, nye wo nsamu ɔmado-afɔr:

Mbom dzi no wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim wɔ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi no, ɔwo, nye wo babanyin, nye w'afonabaa, nye Levinyi a ɔwɔ wo kuropon mu: Na ma w'enyi ngye wɔ Ewuradze wo nsa kã nyinara ho.
Hwɛ woho yie amma aammpow Levinyi aber tsentsen nyinaa a edze tse w'aseesa do nyinara mu.
Sɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn trɛ wo he mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔabɔ wo anohoba no, na ese dɛ, mibedzi nam, osiandɛ wo kra no kɔn dɔ dɛ obedzi nam a, dzi nam, dɛ mbrɛ wo kra no kɔn dɔ nyinara.

Sɛ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi dze ne dzin ato hɔ no ɔnye wo ntamu twe dodow a, ɔno ku w'anantwikuw nye wo nguankuw a Ewuradze dze ama wo no mu bi, dɛ mbrɛ mahyɛ wo no, na dzi wɔ wo kuropon mu, dɛ mbrɛ wo kra no kɔn dɔ nyinara.
Mekyerɛ dɛ mbrɛ wodzi adoa nye ɔtrɔm no, dɛmara so na dzi bi: Nyia no ho nntsew nye nyia no ho tsew nyina ndzi bi.
Nsew ara na hyɛ mma enndzi bɔgya no nye nkwa: Na mma mmfa nam no nnka nkwa no ho nndzi.
Mma nndzi; hue gu famu dɛ nsu.
Mma nndzi; ma onsi ɔwo, nye wo mba a wodzi w'ekyir yie, aber a ereyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do no.
Wo ndzɛmba krɔkrɔn a ewɔ no nko, nye w'anohobadze, na fa kɔ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze bɛsan mu eyi no:
na bɔ wo hyew-afɔr, nam nye bɔgya no, wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn afɔrmbukyia no do: Na wo kum afɔr bɔgyaa no wonhue ngu Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn afɔrmbukyia no do, na nam no na dzi.
Dwen do tsie nsɛm a merehyɛ wo yi nyinara, ma oeesi ɔwo, nye wo mba a wodzi w'ekyir yie daa, aber a ereyɛ dza oye na ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyiwa do no.
Sɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn twitwa amanaman fi w'enyim, mbrerokɔ akɛfa hɔn no, na efa hɔn, na etsenaa hɔn asaase do a;
hwɛ woho yie amma wɔasɛɛ hɔn efi w'enyim n'ekyir no, hɔn ekyirdzi aannyɛ wo efir; na eemmbisa hɔn enyame ekyir kwan, dɛ, Amanaman yi dua dɛn som hɔn enyame? Na mo so menyɛ dɛmara.
Mma nnyɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dɛm: Na Ewuradze n'ekyiwadze a okyir no nyinara na wɔayɛ ama hɔn enyame; na hɔn mbabanyin nye hɔn mbabaa mo na wɔdze gya hyew hɔn ma hɔn enyame.
Adze biara a merehyɛ hom no, na hom ndwen do nyɛ: Mma mmfa bi nnka ho, na mma nnyi do bi so.
13: Sɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi bi, anaa ɔdaa sonyi bi soɛr wɔ wo mu, na ɔma wo asɛnkyerɛdze anaa anwanwadze bi,
na asɛnkyerɛdze anaa anwanwadze a ɔkasaa ho kyerɛɛ wo no ba mu, dɛ, ma yɛnkɔ nkedzi enyame fofor a ɔwo nnyim hɔn no ekyir, na yɛnkɔsom no a;
mma nntsie nkɔnhyɛnyi no anaa ɔdaasonyi no nsɛm no: na Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn rosɔ hom ahwɛ, dze ehu kyerɛdɛ hom dze hom akoma nyinara dɔ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Hom nnantsew ndzi Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn ekyir, na hom nsuro no, na hom ndzi ne mbransɛm do, na hom ntsie ne ndze, na hom nsom no; na hom ntakyer no ho.

Na nkɔnhyɛni no, anaa ɔdaasonyi no, wonku no; osiandɛ wɔakã etuatsew ho asem etsia Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn a oyii hom fii Egypt asaase do, na ɔpoon wo fii nkowaasom ofi mu no, dɛ ɔdze rotwetwe wo efi ɔkwan a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ wo dɛ nantew mu no do esi nkyɛn. Ama eetu bɔn no efi wo mu.

Sɛ wo nuabanyin, wo nã ne babanyin, anaa wo babanyin, anaa wobabaa, anaa wo yer a ɔda wo bo mu, anaa wo nyɛnko a ɔtse dɛ wankasa wo kra, ɔdaadaa wo nsumaa mu, dɛ, ma yɛnkɔ nkɔsom enyame fofor a ɔwo nye w'egyanom nnyim no;
aman a woetwa homho ehyia a wɔbɛn wo, anaa wɔnye wo ntamu twe, ofi asaase ano kor ara kodu asaase ano kor so hɔn enyame mu bi a;
mma mmpem no, na nntsie no so; nkyii so mma w'enyiwa nnhu no mbɔbɔr, na nkora no do, na nnhuntsa no do so;
na oku na ku no; wo nsa na ondzi kan ntɔno do dɛ woboku no, na n'ekyir no na ɔman no nyinara nsa.
Na siw no abo ma onwu; osiandɛ ɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ ɔtwetwe wo fi Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn a yii wo fii Egypt asaase do, wɔ nkowaasom ofi mu no ho.
Na Israel nyinara ntse, na wonsuro, na wɔannda ho ara annyɛ dɛm ndzebɔn a ɔtse dɛ mbrɛ iyi tse yi wɔ wo mu.
Na sɛ etse dɛ wɔrekã wɔ wo nkurow a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ tsena mu hɔ no kor bi ho, dɛ,
Ebusuyɛfo bi efi wo mu asoɛr, na wɔadaadaa hɔn kurow mu atsefo dɛ. Hom mma yɛnkɔ nkɔsom enyame fofor a hom nnyim hɔn a;
ɔno pepɛ mu, na hwehwɛ mu, na bisabisa mu yie; na hwɛ, sɛ ɔyɛ nokwar, na asɛm no yɛ ampa, dɛ dɛm ekyiwadze yi wɔayɛ no wɔ wo mu a:
Oku na fa nkrantsee ano ku kurow no mu atsefo no, na fa nkrantsee ano sɛɛ no nye dzaa ɔwɔ mu nyinara nye no mu fiembowa so pasapasa.
Na boaboa no mu asadze nyinara ano wɔ no brɔn finimfin, na fa gya hyew kurow no, nye no mu asadze no nyinara dɛ ɔhyew-afɔr mu, fa ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn: Na ɔnyɛ ɔmamfo daa; wɔnnkyekyer bio.
Na mma ebusudze no mu bi mmfam wo nsa ho: Na Ewuradze aadan efi n'ebufuhyew no ho, na oeehu wo mbɔbɔr, na oennya ayamuhyehye ama wo, na ɔaama adɔr dɛ mbrɛ ɔakã ntam akyerɛ w'egyanom;
aber a itsie Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ndze, dɛ idzi ne mbransɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara do, na eyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyiwa do.
14: Hom yɛ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn ne mba: Mma hom nnyiyi hom enyiwa ntamu mma ewufo.
Na ɔwo yɛ ɔman krɔnkrɔn ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, na Ewuradze asan mu eyi wo dɛ ebɛyɛ noara no soronko ɔman, wɔ aman a wɔwɔ asaase enyi nyinara mu.
Mma nndzi ekyiwadze biara.
Iyinom nye mbowa a hom ndzi: Ɔnantwi, ɔkɔsɔw, nye apɔnkye,
ɔtrɔm, nye adoa, nye ɔwansan, nye iwi, nye ɔtwe, nye eko, nye ɔwɛr.
Na abowa biara a ɔwɔ anansa a no mu apae, na n'anansa no mu apae ebien koraa, na ɔkosa adzepuwii, wɔ mbowa mu no, ɔno na hom ndzi.

Naaso iyinom na mma hom nndzi wɔ hɔn a wɔkosa adzepuwii mu, anaa hɔn a hɔn anansa mu apae koraa mu: Efupɔnkɔ, nye asokɛtɛ, nye etwabowa, osiandɛ wɔkosa adzepuwii dze na hɔn anansa mu mmpae, hɔn ho nntsew mma hom:
Na preko, osiandɛ n'anansa mu apae dze na ɔnnkosa adzepuwii, no ho nntsew mma hom: Hɔn nam no mma hom nndzi bi, na hɔn efun no mma hom nnkã.
Iyinom na hom ndzi wɔ dza ɔwɔ nsu mu nyinara mu: Dza ɔwɔ nsu mu nyinara mu: Dza ɔwɔ tɛterɛ nye abon no hom ndzi:
Na biara a onnyi tɛterɛ nye abon no mma hom nndzi; no ho nntsew mma hom.
Nnoma a hɔn ho tsew no nyinara hom ndzi.
Na iyinom nye hɔn a mma hom nndzi bi: Ɔkɔr, nye ɔkɔrbia, nye nsu-kɔr;
nye ɔkom-pɛtɛ, nye ɔkom, nye ɔsansaa n'ahorow;
nye akonkoran biara n'ahorow;
nye sohor, na anago-krɔma, nye epo-akokɔ, nye akrɔma n'ahorow;
patu-ketseaba, nye patu-kɛse, nye ambɛn-patu;
na opoku, nye ɔpɛtɛ, nye epo-akonkoran;
nye esukɔkɔn, nye bakanoma n'ahorow, nye esuakwa nye apan.
Na ntumbowa a wɔwea nyinara hɔn ho nntsew mma hom: Mma wonndzi.
Ntumbowa a hɔn ho tsew no nyinara hom ndzi.
Mma hom nndzi biribi a noara oewu: Fa ma ɔhɔho a ɔwɔ wo kuropon mu, ma ondzi; anaa tɔn ma ɔnanaben: Na ɔwo yɛ ɔman krɔnkrɔn ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn. Mma nnoa apɔnkyeba wɔ ne nã no numfonsu mu.
W'aba a idua no ndɔbaa a ofi wo haban mu ba afrenhyia afrenhyia no, yiyi do ebupɛn du du.

Na dzi wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim, wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔbɛsan mu eyi dɛ ne dzin ntsena hɔ no, w'eburow, nye wo nsã, nye wo ngo do ebupɛn du du, nye w'anantwikuw, nye wo nguankuw mu mbakan; ama eesūa dɛ isuro Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dabaa.

Na sɛ ɔkwan no war dodow ma wo, ma irunntum nnsoa, osiandɛ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi dɛ ɔdze ne dzin bɔto no nye wo ntamu twe dodow, na kyekyer sika no kitsa. Na kɔ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn hyira wo a:
Ɔno dan no sika mu, na kyekyer sika no kitsa, na kɔ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi no;

na fa sika no tɔ adze biara a wo kra no kɔn dɔ, ɔnantwi, anaa oguan, anaa wenyin, anaa nsã dzendzen, anaa adze biara a wo kra pɛ no: Na dzi no wɔ hɔ ara wo Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim, na ma w'enyi ngye. Ɔwɔ nye wo fifo.
na Levinyi a ɔwɔ wo kuropon mu no, mma nngya no ekyir; na onnyi kyɛfa nye egyapadze ka wo ho.
Mfe ebiasa biara n'ewiei no, yiyi wɔ afe no ara mu ndɔbaa do ebupɛn du du no nyinara, na fa gu wo kuropon mu:

Na Levinyi no osiandɛ onnyi kyɛfa nye egyapadze ka wo ho, na ɔhoho, nye egyanka, nye okunafo a wɔwɔ wo kuropon mu, mbra, na wombedzi mmee; na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn eehyira wo wɔ nsaano edwuma a eyɛ nyinara mu.
15: Mfe esuon biara n'ewiei no yɛ akwangya.
Na mbrɛ wonsi ngya kwan nye yi: Ɔdzefɛmfo biara dza ɔdze fɛm ne nyɛnko no ongya no kwan; mma ɔnnkyɛ ne nyɛnko nye no nua no nngye.
Ɔnanaben dze hyɛ no gye: Na adze biara a ewɔ wɔ wo nua hɔ dze wo nsa ngya no kwan.
Naaso mma ohianyi bi mmba wo mu; (na nhyira na Ewuradze behyira wo wɔ asaase a Ewurade wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze a kɛfa no do;)
sɛ iritsie Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ndze ara yie, dɛ erodwen do ayɛ ahyɛdze yi a merehyɛ wo da yi nyinara a.
Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn behyira wo, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ wo anohoba no: Na edze afemfɛm amanaman pii, na ɔwodze erennkɛfɛm: Na ɔwo bɔhom amanaman pii do, na hɔndze wɔronnhom wo do.
Sɛ wo nuanom mu obi yɛ ohianyi wɔ wo nkyɛn, wɔ wo kuropon biara mu wɔ asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do a, mma mmpirim w'akoma, na mma mmua wo nsa so wɔ wo nua ohianyi no do:
Na obue na bue wo nsa ma no, na ɔfɛm na fɛm no adze ɔbɔsõ ne hia a ehia no no.

Hwɛ yie ma adwen huhuw ammba w'akoma mu dɛ, afe a otsīa esuon no, akwangya afe no, abɛn; na w'enyiwa annyɛ bɔn enntsia wo nua ohianyi no, dɛ eremma no hwee; ma ɔaanntsēa mu ammfrɛ Ewuradze enntsia wo, na aannyɛ bɔn amma wo.
ɔma na ma no, na mma ɔnnyɛ w'akoma mu yaw dɛ ebɛma no: Osiandɛ dɛm adze yi ntsi na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn behyira wo wɔ w'edwuma nyinara mu, nye dza edze wo nsa bosuo mu nyinara mu.
Na ohianyi remmpa wɔ asaase no do: Dɛm ntsi na merehyɛ wo dɛ, Obue na bue wo nsa ma wo nua, wo kɔhweaban, nye wo hianyi, wɔ w'asaase do.
Sɛ wo nua, Hebrewnyi ɔbanyin, anaa Hebrewnyi ɔbaa, wɔtɔn no ma wo, na ɔsom wo mfe esia a; ɔno afe a otsia esuon no gya no kwan na omfi wo nkyɛn mfa noho ndzi nkɔ.
Na sɛ irigya no kwan ma oeefi wo nkyɛn afa noho edzi akɔ a, mma ɔmmfa nsapan nnkɔ:
fa wo nguankuw mu bi, nye w'ewuporowbea do bi, nye wo wenyintwer mu bi ma no kwa: Dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ehyira wo no na ma no.
Na kaa dɛ eyɛɛ akowaa wɔ Egypt asaase do, na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn poon wo: Dɛm ntsi na merehyɛ wo asɛm yi ndɛ.
Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ɔse wo dɛ, mirimmfi wo nkyɛn nnkɔ; osiandɛ ɔdɔ wo nye wo fi ntsi, wɔ dɛ ɔtse no yie wɔ wo nkyɛn ntsi a;
ɔno fa fitsii, na fa fitsi n'asowa mu suo abow mu, na ɔnyɛ w'akowaa daa. Na w'afonabaa no so yɛ no dɛmara.
Mma ɔnnyɛ dzen mma wo, dɛ ibegya no kwan ma oeefi wo nkyɛn afa noho edzi akɔ; na ɔasom wo mfe esia ayɛ ɔpaanyi akatua mbɔhoebien ho adze: Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn behyira wo wɔ dza eyɛ nyinara mu.
W'anantwikuw nye wo nguankuw mu mbakan enyin a wɔbɔwo hɔn no tu hɔn si nkyɛn ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn: Mma mmfa wo nantwi abakan nnyɛ edwuma, na nnsusua wo nguankuw mu abaka ho nhwi so.
Dzi no wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim afrenhyia afrenhyia wɔ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi no, ɔwo nye wo fifo.
Na sɛ ɔwɔ dzɛm bi wɔ no ho dɛ ɔyɛ apakye anaa n'enyi efura, dzɛm bɔn biara wɔ no ho a, mma mmfa mmbɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn afɔr.
Dzi no wɔ wo kuropon mu: Nyia no ho nntsew nye nyia no ho tsew nyina ndzi, dɛ adoa nye ɔtrɔm.
No bɔgyaa nko na mma nndzi; hue gu famu dɛ nsu.
16: Hyɛ bosoom abib nsew, na dzi apaho no ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn; na bosoom Abib mu na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn yii wo wɔ Egypt anago.
Na bɔ apaho okum-afɔr no ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, nguankuw nye anantwikuw mu, wɔ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze bɛsan mu eyi dɛ ne dzin ntsena hɔ no.

Mma mmfa mbɔrkaw boodoo nnka ho nndzi; nda esuon na fa epitsi boodoo ka ho dzi, mekyerɛ amandzehu boodoo no; osiandɛ ɔhar mu na ifiir fii Egypt asaase do: Ama aakaa da a edze fiir edzi fii Egypt asaase do no wo nkwa nda nyinara.
Na mma wonnhu wo nkyɛn mbɔrkaw wɔ w'ahe nyinara do nda esuon; nkyii so mma nam a iku hɔn da a odzi kan ewimbir no bi nnka anago no nyinara mma onnkodu anapa.
Mma nku apaho no wɔ wo kuropɔn dze rema wo no biara mu:
