Gyedɛ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi dɛ ne dzin ntsena hɔ no, hɔ na ku apaho no ewimbir, wi rokɔtɔ no, wɔ wo Egypt fi aber no mu.
Na toto na dzi no wɔ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi no: Na anapa no san, na kɔ w'asesee mu.
Nda esia na dzi epitsi boodoo: Na da a otsīa esuon no nyɛ nguabɔ a no mu yɛ win mma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn; mma nnyɛ edwuma wɔ mu.
Adapɛn esuon na kan ma woho: Da a erehyɛ ase dze kantankrankye akã eburow a osisi hɔ no na fi kan adapɛn esuon.
Na hyɛ adapɛn afahyɛ no ma Ewurdze wo Nyankopɔn fa ka wo nsa mu ayamuyi-afɔr ntoboa a edze rema no no ho, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ehyira wo no:

Na ma w'enyi ngye wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim, ɔwo, nye wo bababyin, nye wo babaa, nye w'akowaa, nye w'afonabaa, nye Levinyi a ɔwɔ wo kuropon mu, nye ɔhɔho, nye egyanka, nye okunafo a wɔwɔ wo mu, wɔ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi dɛ ne dzin ntsena nɔ no.
Na kaa dɛ eyɛɛ akowaa wɔ Egypt: Na dwen do yɛ ahyɛdze yi.
Hyɛ ntamadan afahyɛ nda esuon, aber a aboaboa w'ewuporowbea do nye wo wenyintwer mu adze ano no;
na ma w'eny ngye wɔ w'afahyɛ no mu, ɔwo, nye wo babanyin, nye wo babaa, nye w'akowaa, nye w'afonabaa, nye Levinyi nye ɔhɔho, nye egyanka, nye okunafo a wɔwɔ wo kuropon mu.
Nda esuon na hyɛ fa ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn wɔ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze bɛsan mu eyi no: Osiandɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn behyira wo wɔ wo ndɔbaa nyinara mu, na wonsaano edwuma nyinara, na w'enyi bɛgye ara.

Afrenhyia kor mu mpɛn ebiasa na wo mbanyin nyinara nkefir Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔbɛsan mu eyi no; wɔ epitsi boodoo afahyɛ no mu, nye adapɛn afahyɛ no mu, nye ntamadan afahyɛ no mu: Na mma wɔmmfa nsapan mmbefir Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nhyira a ɔdze ehyira wo no tse.
Hyɛ ntsɛmbuafo nye mpanyimfo wɔ wo nkuropon a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ mbrɛ w'ebusuakuw tsetsee nyinara mu: Na wɔmfa ntsɛm tsenenee mbu ɔman no ntsɛn.
Mma nndan atsɛmbu enyi; mma mmfɛr nyimpa: Nkyii so mma nngye akyɛdze; na akyɛdze fura enyansafo enyi, na ɔdan atseneneefo nsɛm enyi.
Dza ɔtsen ara na dzi ekyir, ama eenya nkwa, na eenya asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no edzi.
Mma nntsɛw dua biara mmfa nnyɛ Asherah wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn afɔrmbukyia a ebɛyɛ ama woho no nkyɛn.
Nkyii so mma nnsi dum a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn kyir mma woho.
17: Mma mmfa ɔnantwi, anaa oguan a no ho wɔ dzɛm, anaa adzebɔn biara, mmbɔ okum-afɔr mma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn na ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn.
Sɛ wohu wɔ wo mu, wɔ wo nkuropon a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no biara mu, ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa bi a ɔyɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyi do dɛ ɔto n'ahyɛmu,
na ɔkɔ kɔsom enyame fofor, na ɔsɔr hɔn, ewia, anaa bosoom, anaa ɔsor dɔm no mu biara a mennhyɛ ho mbra no,
na wɔkã kyerɛ wo ma etse a, ɔno hwehwɛ mu yie, na, hwɛ, sɛ ɔyɛ nokwar, na asɛm no wɔ mu ampa, dɛ ɔayɛ dɛm ekyiwadze yi wɔ Israel;
ɔno fa ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa no a ɔayɛ dɛm adze bɔn yi fir edzi kɔ wo kuropon ho, mekyerɛ ɔnanyin anaa adasefo baasa anomu do na wɔmfa nku nyia ɔsɛ owu no; mma wɔmmfa ɔdasefo kor anomu do nnku no.
Adasefo beenu, anaa adasefo baasa anomu do na wɔfa nku nkyia ɔsɛ owu no; mma wɔmmfa ɔdaasefo kor anomu do nnku no.
Adasefo no nsa na ondzi kan wɔ no do nku no, na n'ekyir no ɔman no nyinara hɔn nsa. Ama eeyi mbusu no efi wo mu.

Sɛ asɛm bi ho atsɛmbu yɛ dzen dodow ma wo, wɔ bɔgya nye bɔgya ntamu, asɛm nye asɛm ntamu, asɛm nye asɛm antamu, na ɔbɔ nye ɔbɔ ntamu, dɛ ɔyɛ akasakasa nsɛm wɔ wo kuropon mu a, ɔno soɛr, na kɔ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi no;
na kɔ asɔfo Levifo, nye nda no mu ɔtsɛmbufo a ɔwɔ do no nkyɛn na kebisa; na wɔnkyerɛ wo asɛm no n'atsɛmbu:
na yɛ dɛ mbrɛ asɛm a wɔbɛkyerɛ wo wɔ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze bɛsanmu eyi no tseno ara; na dwen do yɛ dɛ mbrɛ wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo no nyinara:
dɛ mbrɛ mbra a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo, na mbrɛ mbrɛ atsɛmbu a wɔbɛkã akyerɛ wo no tse no ara, na yɛ; mma nndan mmfi asɛm a wɔbɛkyerɛ wo no ho nnkɔ enyimfa anaa abankum.
Na nyimpa a obedzi nkontompɔsɛm, dɛ orinntsie ɔsɔfo a ogyina hɔ som wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyi, anaa ɔtsɛmbufo no, dɛm nyimpa no onwu: Na yi mbusu no fi Israel.
Na ɔman no nyinara ntse, na wonsuro, na wonndzi nkontompɔsɛm bio.
Sɛ idu asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do, na efa, na etsena do, na ese dɛ, mibesi mo do hen, dɛ amanaman a wotwa mo ho hyia nyinara no a;
nyia Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi no no noara na fa no si wo do hen: Wo nuanom mu bi na fa no si wo do hen: Mma mmfa ɔnanaben bi a ɔnnyɛ wo nua nnsi wo do.
Mpɔnkɔ ara na mma ɔmma wɔnndɔɔ sõ mma no, nkyii so mma ɔmma ɔman no nnsan nnkɔ Egypt, dɛ ɔbɛma no mpɔnkɔ adɔɔ soõ: Susuampa dɛ Ewuradze ase hom dɛ ɔdzekɔr yi mma hom nnsan mmfa ɔkwan no do bio.
Nkyii so mma ɔmma ne yernom nndɔɔ sõ.
Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ɔtse n'ahendzi ahengua do a, onsusu mbra yi a ɔwɔ asɔfo Levifo no enyim no do nkyerɛ wo bi wɔ nwoma mu mma noho:
na ɔnko ne nkyɛn, na ɔnkenkan mu no nkwa nda nyinara: Na oeesūa dɛ osuro Ewuradze no Nyankopɔn, na odzi mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara nye ahyɛdze yi do, na ɔyɛ:
na n'akoma aamma noho do annsen no nuanom, na ɔaanndan emmfi mbrasɛm no ho ammfa enyimfa, anaa abankum: Ama ne nda aawar wɔ n'ahendzi mu, ɔno nye ne mba wɔ Israel.
18: Asɔfo Levifo, mekyerɛ Levi ebusuakuw nyinara rinnya kyɛfa nye egyapadze wɔ Israel mu: Ewuradze ogya-afɔr nye n'egyapadze na wondzi.
Na worinnya egyapadze wɔ hɔn nuanom mu: Ewuradze nye hɔn egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔakã akyerɛ hɔn no.
Na iyi nyɛ asɔfo no hɔn ndzinoa mfi ɔman no hɔ, mfi hɔn a wɔbɔ afɔr no hɔ, ɔnantwi o, oguan o, wɔfa abasa, nye adadaw ebien no, nye efur no mma ɔsɔfo no.
W'eburow, wo nsã, nye wo ngo mu nduadzewakan, nye wo nguan ho nhwi a woesusua no kan no, fa ma no.
Osiandɛ ɔno na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi no wɔ w'ebusuakuw nyinara mu, dɛ ongyina nsom wɔ Ewuradze ne dzin mu, ɔno nye ne mbabanyin daa nyina.
Na sɛ Levinyi bi fi wo nkuropon no biara mu, fi Israel mu beebiara mbrɛ ɔakɔsoɛ, na ɔdze ne kra ne pɛ nyinara ba beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze asan mu eyi no a;
ɔno ɔnsom wɔ Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn ne dzin mu, dɛ mbrɛ no nuanom Levifo no a wogyina Ewuradze enyim hɔ no nyinara yɛ no.
Wonnya kyɛfa dɛ hɔndze no ndzi, mfa nkaa dza ofi n'egyanom adzetɔn mu ba no ho.
Sɛ inya du asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze Rema wo no do a, mma nnsūa amanaman no hɔn ekyiwadze no yɛ.
Mma wonnhu wo mu obi a ɔma ne babanyin anaa ne babaa fa ogya mu, nyia ɔhyɛ mbusunkɔm, nyia ɔyɛ abayidze, anaa ɔdzeafo, anaa osumantutunyi,
anaa kaberkyernyi, anaa ɔsamangyinatunyi, anaa ayɛn, anaa ɔsamamfrɛnyi.
Na obiara a ɔyɛ iyinom no yɛ ekyiwadze ma Ewuradze: Na osian ekyiwadze yi ntsi na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn tutuu hɔn fii w'enyim yi.
Enye Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ntsena no emudzi mu.
Na amanaman yi a erekɛfa yi wotsie hɔn a wɔyɛ abayidze, na mbusunkɔnhyɛfo: Na ɔwodze, Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn mmaa wo kwan dɛ yɛ dɛm.
Nkɔnhyɛnyi a ofi wo mu, ofi wo nuannom mu a ɔtse dɛ emi, na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛma no do ama wo; ɔno na hom ntsie no;
dɛ mbrɛ dza idisae wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn hɔ wɔ Horeb, wɔ nguabɔ da no tse nyinara, dɛ mma menntse Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn ndze nio, nkyii so mma munnhu ogya kɛse yi bio, na meennwu.
Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, Dza wɔakã no yie.
Mebɛma nkɔnhyɛnyi do mama hɔn wɔ hɔn nuanom mu tse dɛ ɔwo; na medze me nsɛm mebɛhyɛ n'anomu, na ɔakã dza mebɛhyɛ n'anomu na ɔakã dza mebɛhyɛ no nyinara akyerɛ hɔn.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ obiara a onnketsie me nsɛma ɔbɛkã wɔ me dzin mu a, mennhyɛ no dɛ ɔnkã no, anaa nyia ɔbɛkasa wɔ enyame fofor bi dzin mu no, nkɔnhyɛnyi bi kasa wɔ Ewuradze ne dzin mu, na sɛ asɛm a Ewuradze nnkãa no nye no: Nkɔnhyɛnyi no akã no nkontompɔ mu, mma nnsuro no.
19: Sɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn twitwa amanaman a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze hɔn asaase rema wo gu, na itu hɔn, na etsena hɔn nkurow, nye hɔn adan mu a;
yiyi nkurow ebiasa si hɔ ma woho wɔ asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ fa no mu.
Siesie ɔkwan no ma woho, na paapaa asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn rema enya edzi no n'ahe mu akyɛkyɛ ebiasa na onyimpakufo biara eeguan akɔ hɔ.
Na onyimpakumfo a onguan nkɔ hɔ na onnya nkwa no n'asɛm nye yi: Nyia oku ne nyɛnko awerɛfir mu, na ɔnntan no dada bi;
dɛ nyimpa nye ne nyɛnko kɔ kwa mu ekotwa dua, na ne nsa ma abɔndua do dze eetwa dua no, na ne tsidadze no hɔn fi no kura mu, na ɔkã ne nyɛnko no, ma owu a; onguan nkɔ nkurow yi kor mu na onnya nkwa:
amma bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no eenntsiw nyimpakumfo no, aber a n'akoma ayɛ hyew no, na osiandɛ ɔkwan no war ntsi ɔaannkɔto no, na ɔaammbɔ no ɔbɔtɔr; naaso na ɔnnsɛ wu, susuampa dɛ ɔnntan no dada bi no.
Dɛm ntsi na merehyɛ wo dɛ yiyi nkurow ebiasa si hɔ ma woho.
Na sɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn tsew wo he mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔakã ntam akyerɛ w'egyanom, na ɔdze asaase no a ɔbɔɔ anohoba dɛ ɔdze asaase no a ɔbɔɔ anohoba dɛ ɔdze bɛma w'agyanom no nyinara ma wo:
sɛ idzi mbrasɛm yi nyinara a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi do eyɛ, dɛ ebɔdɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, na anantsew n'akwan do daa a; ɔno yiyi nkurow ebiasa so ka ebiasa yi ho si hɔ ma woho:
na wɔaannka bɔgya a onndzi sõ enngu wɔ w'asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze no mu, na bɔgya eengu wo do.
Na sɛ nyimpa bi tan ne nyɛnko, na ɔkɔ no atsɛwee, na ɔsoɛr no do, na ɔbɔ no ɔbɔtɔr ma owu; na oguan kɔ nkurow yi kor mu a:
Ɔno no kurow no mu mpanyimfo nsoma ma wɔnkɛfa no wɔ hɔ na wɔmfa no nhyɛ bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no nsa, ma onwu.
Mma w'enyiwa nnhu no mbɔbɔr, na yi bɔgya a onndzi sõ fi Israel, na eesi wo yie.
Mma nntwe wo nyɛnko n'asaasehe a tsetsefo no dze esi, wɔ w'egyapadze a ibenya edzi wɔ asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ fa no do.
Ɔdasefo baako nnsoɛr nntsia nyimpa bi wɔ emumuyɛ biara, anaa bɔn biara ho, wɔ bɔn biara a ɔyɛ ho: Adasefo beenu anomu, anaa adasefo baasa anomu na wɔmfa do nsi asɛm gyinae.
Sɛ ɔdasekrumfo bi soɛr tsia nyimpa bi dzi no mfom ho dase a;
ɔno nyimpa beenu nyina a ɔham no da hɔn ntamu no, mbegyina Ewuradze enyim, wɔ asɔfo nye ntsɛmbufo a wɔwɔ hɔ nda no mu no enyim;
na ntsɛmbufo no nhwehwɛ mu yie: Na, hwɛ, sɛ ɔdasefo no yɛ ɔdasekrumfo, na oedzi no nua dasekrum a;
ɔno hom nyɛ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔdween dɛ nkyɛ ɔbɛyɛ no nua no: Ama eeyi mbusu no efi wo mu.
Na hɔn a wɔaka no ntsi, na wonsuro na ɔdzekɔr yi wɔaammbɔ mbusu biara a ɔtse dɛm wɔ wo mu bio.
Na mma w'enyiwa nnhu mbɔbɔr; nkwa nhyɛ nkwa ananmu, enyiwa nhyɛ enyiwa ananmu, esē nhyɛ esē ananmu, nsa nhyɛ nsa ananmu, anan nhyɛ anan ananmu.
20: Sɛ itu ɔsa nye w'atamfo aakɔkõ, na ihu mpɔnkɔ, nye ntseaseanam, nye ɔman a wɔdɔɔ sõ sen wo a, mma nnsuro hɔn: Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn a ɔdze wo fi Egypt asaase do bae no ka wo ho.
Na ɔmbra dɛ sɛ hom rehɛn akono a, ɔsɔfo no ntwe mpin na ɔmbɛkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no,
na ɔnse hɔn dɛ, Israel, hom ntsie, hom rebɛn akono ndɛ da yi nye hom atamfo akɔkõ: Mma hom akoma mmpa, mma hom nnsuro, na hom ho mmpopo, nkyii so mma hɔn ho nnyɛ hom hu;
na Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn nye nyia ɔnye hom rokɔ, nye hom atamfo rokɔkõ ama hom, na ɔaagye hom nkwa.
Na ahwɛdofo no nkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no, dɛ, nyimpa mmuana na oesi dan fofor, na ommbuei? Wɔmma ɔnsan nkɔ ne fie, m ɔaanntɔ wɔ ɔkõ mu, na nyimpa fofor eennkobue.
Na nyimpa mmuana na ɔatsew wenyin ture, na onnyae nnyii n'aba bi? Wɔmma ɔnsan nkɔ ne fie, na ɔaanntɔ wɔ ɔkõ mu, na nyimpa fofor eennkeyi n'aba no.
Na nyimpa mmuana na ɔagye yer, na onnyae nnhyia no? Wɔmma ɔnsan nkɔ ne fie, ma ɔaanntɔ wɔ ɔkõ mu, na nyimpa fofor eennkehyia no.
Na ahwɛdofo no nwɔw do nkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no, na wɔnse dɛ, nyimpa mmuana na osuro na n'akoma apa? Wɔmma ɔnsan nkɔ ne fie, amma no nuanom hɔn akoma aannan dɛ n'akoma.
Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ahwɛdofo no wie ɔman no kasa kyerɛ a, wɔnhyehyɛ asafohemfo wɔ ɔman no ne tsir.
Sɛ ebɛn kurow bi dɛ enye no rokɔkõ a, ɔno bɔ asomdwee ho dawur kyerɛ no.
Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ɔma wo asomdwee mbuae, na obue wo a, ɔno ɔmbra dɛ, nkorɔfo a ibohu hɔn wɔ mu no nyinara mbɛyɛ ɔtowyiman mma wo, na wɔnsom wo.
Na sɛ ɔnnye wo ennsiesie, na otu wo do saa a, ɔno kɔ no ntoa:
Na sɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn yi no hyɛ wo nsa a, ɔno fa nkrantsee ano bobɔ no mu mbanyin nyinara:
na mbaa nye mbofraba, nye ofiembowa, nye dza ɔwɔ kurow no mu nyinara, fa no afonam fa ma woho; na dzi w'atamfo asadze a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze ama wo no.
Dɛm na yɛ nkurow a wɔnye wo ntamu twe dodow nyinara a wɔnnyɛ amanaman yi nkurow bi no.
Na aman yi nkurow a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze no dze, mma nngye biribiara a ogu ahom no nkwa:
mbom sɛɛ hɔn pasapasa; Hethfo, nye Amorifo, Canaanfo, nye Perizzfo, nye Hivifo, nye Jebusfo; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ wo no:
mma wɔaannhyerɛ wo mma aannyɛ hɔn ekyiwadze nyinara a wɔyɛ ma hɔn enyame no bi; na hom aannyɛ bɔn enntsia Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn,
Sɛ itua kurow bi ma ɔkyɛr, dɛ ereyɛ ho sa afa a, mma mmfa abɔndua nnsɛɛ no ho ndua; na no do aba bi na ibedzi, na mma nntwitwa nngu; ana haban mu dua yɛ nyimpa, na ɔregye dɛ itua no?
Ndua a inyim dɛ ɔnnyɛ ndua a wodzi no nkõ, na sɛɛ no na twitwa gu; na sisi nduaban wɔ kurow a ɔnye wo dzi akõ no ho araa ma onkodu dɛ ɔbɔhwe ase.
21: Sɛ wohu obi a woeku no da haban mu, wɔ asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ fa no do, na wonnyim nyia okum no a:
Ɔno wo mpanyimfo nye wo ntsɛmbufo mfir edzi, na wonkosusu nkodu nkurow a etwa ehyia nyia woeku no no ho no do:
Na ɔmbra dɛ, kurow a ɔbɛn nyimpa pa a woeku no no nkyɛn no, mekyerɛ kurow no mu mpanyimfo no mfa anantwikuw mu ɔnantwiber a wɔ mmfaa no nnyɛɛ edwuma, na ɔnntwee kɔndua pɛn;
na kurow no mu mpanyimfo no mfa ɔnantwiber no nsian nkɔ ɔbɔn a nsu pem wɔ do a wɔnndɔwee na wonnduaa mu adze mu, na wombu ɔnantwiber no no kɔn wɔ ɔbɔn no mu:

na asɔfo no Levi mbabanyin no mbra ho; na hɔn na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi hɔn dɛ wɔnsom no, na wonhyira wɔ Ewuradze ne dzin mu; na hɔn anomu asɛm do na wɔmfa ndzi ɔhan biara nye ɔbɔ biara ho asɛm:
na kurow no mu mpanyimfo a wɔbɛn nyimpa a woku no no, nhohor hɔn nsa ho ngu ɔnantwiber a wobuu no kɔn mu wɔ ɔbɔn no mu no do:
Na wombua nse dɛ, nnyɛ hɛn nsa bi kãa bɔgya gui, nkyii so hɛn enyiwa ennhu.
Ewuradze, fa fir wo man Israel a apon hɔn no, na mma bɔgya a onndzi sõ nnkã wo man Israel mu. Na bɔgya no wɔdze befir hɔn.
Ama eeyi bɔgya a onndzi sõ no efi wo mu, aber a ereyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do no.
Sɛ itu sa nye w'atamfo aakɔkõ, na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn yi hɔn hyɛ wo nsa, na efa hɔn ndɔmmum,
na ihu ndɔmmum no mu ɔbaa fɛɛfɛw bi, na inya no ho akɔndɔ, na epɛ afa no ayɛ wo yer a;
ɔno fa no bra fie w'efitsii do; na onyi ne tsir, na ombubu n'awerɛw;
na onyi no ndɔmmum akataho no mfi noho, na ɔnka wo fie, na ongyam n'egya nye ne nã bosoom ara mu: Na n'ekyir no akɔ ne nkyɛn, na ayɛ no kun, na ɔayɛ wo yer.
Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ emmpɛ no a, ɔno ma ɔnkɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔpɛ; na ɔtɔn dze, mma nntɔn no nngye sika, mma nnye no nndzi dɛ onyimfo, osiandɛ abrɛ no adze.
Sɛ ɔbanyin bi wɔ yernom beenu, ɔdɔ kor, na ɔtan kor, na nyia ɔdɔ no nye nhyia ɔtan no nyina awowo mba ama no; na sɛ abakan no nye nyia ɔtan no ne babanyin a:
Ɔno ɔmbra dɛ, da a ɔkyɛ n'adze a ɔwɔ mu ma ne mbabanyin no mma ɔmmfa nyia ɔdɔ no no ne babanyin nnyɛ abakan nndzi nyia ɔtan no ne babanyin a ɔyɛ abakan no enyim:
mbom ɔngye abakan no nto mu, nyia ɔtan no no ne babanyin no, ɔmma no dza ɔwɔ nyinara mu kyɛfa mbɔho ebien: Na ɔno nye n'ahoɔdzen ahyɛse; abakan ndzinoa yɛ nedze.
Sɛ nyimpa wɔ babanyin ɔsoɔdzennyi nye etuatsewnyi a onntsie n'egya ne ndze, anaa ne nã ne ndze, na wɔtsēa no so, na onntsie hɔn a:
Ɔno n'egya nye ne nã nkyer no, na wɔmfa no mfir edzi nkɔ no kurow mu mpanyimfo nkyɛn wɔ no kuropon ano;
na wɔnse no kurow no mu mpanyimfo no dɛ, hɛn babanyin yi yɛ ɔsoɔdzennyi nye etuatsewnyi, onntsie hɛn ndze. Ɔyɛ ɔkɔhwii, nye ɔsabokwanyi.
Na no kurow no mu mbanyin nyinara nsiw no abo, ma ɔntɔ: Ama eeyi mbusu no efi wo mu; na Israel nyinara ntse, na wonsuro.
Na sɛ nyimpa bi yɛ bɔn a ɔsɛ owu, na woku no, na edze no sɛn dua bi do a;
mma ne nyimpadua no nnka dua no do anago no nyinara, na osie na sie no da no ara; na nyia wɔasɛn no no Nyame apa no; mma eenngu w'asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze no ho fi.
22: Mma nnhu wo nua ne nantwi anaa no guan dɛ ɔatɔ gon, na mmfi hɔn ho nnkosuma: Ɔsan na fa hɔn san bra wo nua.
Na sɛ wo nua no mmbɛn wo, anaa sɛ innyim no a, ɔno fa no bra fie w'efitsii do, na ɔnko wo nkyɛn nkodu dɛ wo nua no bɔhwehwɛ no, na aadan no ama no bio.
Na dɛmara so na fa yɛ n'asoasa; na dɛmara so na fa yɛ n'atar; na dɛmara so na fa yɛ wo nua n'adze biara a ɔayew no a ehu no: Mma mmfa woho nnkosuma.
Mma nnhu wo nua n'asoaso anaa ne nantwi dɛ ɔahwe ase wɔ ɔkwan mu, na mmfi hɔn ho nnkosuma: Mboa na boa no ma ɔmma hɔn do bio.
Mma ɔbaa nnhyɛ adze a ɔyɛ ɔbanyin dze, nkyii so ɔbanyin nnhyɛ ɔbaa n'atar: Na obiara a ɔyɛ iyinom no ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma Ewuradze ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn.
Sɛ anoma ne birebuw befir w'enyim awerɛfir mu wɔ ɔkwan mu, wɔ dua biara do anaa famu, mba anaa nkyirefuwa no do wɔ mu, na nã no butuw mba no, anaa nkyiefuwa no do a, mma nnkyer nã no nnka mba no ho;
ɔno ma nã no nkɔ na fa mba no; na eesi wo yie, na ama wo nda aawar.
Sɛ isi dan fofor a, ɔno gye wo dan etsifi ban, ama sɛ obi fi do hwe ase a, aammfa bɔgya ammba wo dan no do.
Mma mmfa aba horow ebien nndua wo wenyin ture mu: Amma aannhwer nduadzewa no nyina, aba a edua no, nye wenyin ture no ndɔbaa no.
Mma mmfa ɔnantwi nye asoaso mmbɔ mu mmfuntum.
Mma mmfura tam a wɔdze kuntu nye ndwera afora awen.
Tu wo tam a edze kata wo do no ntoado anan no do ndwow.
Sɛ ɔbanyin bi hyia yer, na ɔkɔ ne nkyɛn, na ɔtan no,
na ɔdze enyimguasesɛm to no do, na ɔbɔ no dzin bɔn, se dɛ, mihyiaa ɔbaa yi, na mokɔr ne nkyɛn no, mennhu no ho mbaabunyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze no a:
Ɔno akatasia no n'egya nye ne nã mfa akataasia no n'egya nye no ne mbaabunyɛ nsãnkyerɛdze no na wɔmfa mbra kurow no mu mpanyimfo nkyɛn wɔ kropon no mu;
na akatasia no n'egya nse mpanyimfo no dɛ, medze me babaa memaa ɔbanyin yi awar, na ɔtan no;
na, hwɛ, ɔdze enyimguasesɛm ato no do, dɛ, mennhu mbaabunyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze wɔ wo babaa yi ho; naaso me babaa ne mbaabunyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye yi. Na wɔntsɛw tam no mu wɔ kurow no mu mpanyimfo no enyim.
Na kurow no mu mpanyimfo no mfa ɔbanyin no na wɔntwe n'aso;
na wɔngye no mbratodze dwetɛ skekel ɔha, na wɔmfa mma akataasia no n'egya osiandɛ ɔabɔ Israel ɔbaabun dzin bɔn: Na ɔnyɛ ne yer; mma ɔnnkõ no wɔ ne nda nyinara mu.
Na sɛ asɛm yi yɛ nokwaar, dɛ woennhu mbaabunyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze wɔ akatasia no ho dze a:
Ɔno wonyi akataasia no mbra n'egya ne fi abowano, na no kurow no mu mbanyin nsiw no abo ma onwu: Osiandɛ ɔayɛ nkwaseadze wɔ Israel, dɛ ɔagor ndwamangor wɔ n'egya fie: Ama eeyi mbusu no efi wo mu.
Sɛ wohu ɔbanyin bi dɛ ɔnye ɔbaa a ɔwɔ kun da a, ɔno hɔn emu ebien nyina nwu, ɔbanyin a ɔnye ɔbaa no dae no, nye ɔbaa no: Ama eeyi mbusu no efi Israel.
Sɛ wɔdze akatasia bi a ɔyɛ ɔbaabun ma okun bi awar, na ɔbanyin bi hu no wɔ kurow mu, na ɔnye no da a;

ɔno hom mfa hɔn emu ebien nyina mfir edzi nkɔ kurow no n'abotsen ekyir, na hom nsiw hɔn abo ma wonwuwu; akatasia no, dɛ ɔwɔ kurow mu na ɔannkeka mu ntsi; na ɔbanyin no, dɛ ɔabrɛ ne nyɛnko ne yer adze ntsi: ama eeyi mbusu no efi wo mu.
Na sɛ ɔbanyin hu akataasia a wɔagye no yer no wɔ haban mu, na ɔbanyin no kyer no, na ɔnye no da a; ɔno ɔbanyin a ɔnye no dae no nko na onwu:
Na akataasia no no dze mma nnyɛ no hwee; bɔn a ɔsɛ owu nnyi akataasia no do: Na dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa soɛr ne nyɛnko do, na oku no no, mekyerɛ dɛmara so na asɛm yi tse:
Na haban mu na ohun no: Na akataasia a wɔagye no yer no kekaa mu, na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔbɛgye no.
Sɛ ɔbanyin bi hu akataasia a ɔyɛ ɔbaabun a wɔnngye no yer, na ɔkyer no, na ɔnye no da, na wohu hɔn a;
ɔno ɔbanyin a ɔnye no dae no, mfa dwetɛ shekel eduonum mma akataasia no n'egya, na ɔnyɛ ne yer, osiandɛ ɔabrɛ no adze; mma ɔnnkõ no ne nda nyinara.
ɔbanyin bi nnwar n'egya ne yer, na onnyi n'egya n'akatado.
23: Nyia no ntɔhwɛbo abɔ, anaa ne banyin etwa no, mma ɔnnhɛn Ewuradze ne baguaa mu.
Sɔnmuba bi nnhɛn Ewuradze ne baguaa mu; n'ebusuasantsen a otsīa du mpo mu biara nnhɛn Ewuradze ne baguaa mu.
Ammonnyi anaa Moabnyi nnhɛn Ewuradze ne bagua mu; hɔn ebusuasantsen a otsīa du mpo mu biara nnhɛn Ewuradze ne baguaa mu ara da:
osiandɛ wɔammfa edziban na ɔnye nsu emmbehyia hom wɔ ɔkwan no mu, aber a hom fi Egypt reba no; na dɛ wɔkɔbɔɔ Beer ne babanyin Balaam a ofi Pethor a ɔwɔ Mesopotamia no paa dɛ ɔmbɔdom wo ntsi.
Naaso Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ammpɛ dɛ otsie Balaam; na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn daan ndom no nhyira maa wo, osiandɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dɔɔ wo.
Mma nnhyehwɛ hɔn asomdwee nye hɔn eyiedzi wo nda nyinara daa.
Mma nnkyir Edomnyi; na ɔyɛ wo nua: Mma nnkyir Egyptnyi; osiandɛ ekɛyɛɛ n'asaase do ɔhɔho.
Ebusuasantsen a otsīa ebiasa mba a wɔbɔwo hɔn ama hɔn no na wɔnhɛn Ewuradze ne baguaa mu.
Sɛ ifir edzi kɛkyer w'atamfo ho nsera a, ɔno sie woho yie wɔ adze bɔn biara ho.
Sɛ ɔbanyin bi wɔ hom mu a no ho nntsew wɔ dza ɔba no da anago bi ntsi a, ɔno omfi nseraban no mu;
na ɔmbra dɛ orudu ewimbir no, onguar noho wɔ nsu mu: Na sɛ wi kɔtɔ a, ɔmbra nseraban no mu.
Nya beebi so wɔ nseraban no ekyir, mbrɛ ibefir edzi akɔ:
Na nya ɔsɔsɔw wɔ wo ndadzedze mu; na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ekɔtotow ekyir hɔ a, edze eefun, na aasan ekyir akata dza ofi wo mu ba no do:
na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nenam wo nseraban mu, dɛ ɔregye wo, na ɔdze w'atamfo ama wɔ w'enyim; dɛm ntsi wo nseraban nyɛ krɔnkrɔn: Amma oeennhu efifidze bi wɔ wo mu, na ɔaanndan emmfi wo nkyɛn.
Mma nnyi akowaa a oefi no wura nkyɛn eguan aba wo hɔ mma no wura:
Ma ɔnye wo ntsena, wɔ wo mu, wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔbɛsan mu eyi no wɔ wo nkuropon no kor mu, mbrɛ ɔpɛ no dodow no: Mma nnhyɛ no do.
Mma Israel mbabaa mu biara nnyɛ edwuaman, nkyii so mma Israel mbabanyin mu biara nndan sodomnyi.
Mma mmfa edwuman apaabɔdze, anaa ɔkraman akatua, mmba Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn fie wɔ anohoba biara mu: Na emu ebien yi nyina yɛ ekyiwadze ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn.
Mma mmbɔ wo nua bosa nngye nsiho:
Ɔnanaben na bɔ no bosa gye nsiho; na wo nua dze, mma mmbɔ no bosa nngye nsiho: Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn eehyira wo dze a edze wo nsa bɛkã nyinara mu, wɔ asaase a erokɔ akɛfa no do.
Sɛ ebɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn anohoba a, mma nnyɛ nyaa dɛ ebɔpon: Na ampaara Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɔhwehwɛ no wɔ wo hɔ; na ɔbɛdan wo bɔn.
Na sɛ ema anohoba no ka a, ɔnnyɛ bɔn mma wo.
Dza efi w'anofamfa do epue no dwen do na yɛ; dɛ mbrɛ abɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn anohoba, ayamuyi-afɔr a edze w'ano akã no.
Sɛ idu wo nyɛnko no wenyin ture mu a, ɔno dzi esikyireamba no bi mee; mbom mma mmfa bi nngu w'adze mu.
Sɛ idu wo nyɛnko n'eburow a osisi hɔ mu a, ɔno fa wo nsa pempan mbɛtsem no bi; mbom mma mma kantankrakye do wɔ wo nyɛnko n'eburow a osisi hɔ do.
24: Sɛ ɔbanyin bi fa ɔbaa, na ɔwar no a, ɔno ɔba dɛ, sɛ onnya n'enyiwa do enyimnyam, osiandɛ oehu no ho enyitodze bi ntsi a, ɔnkyerɛw ɔkonwoma mma no, na ɔmfa nhyɛ ne nsa, na ongya no kwan ma omfi ne fie nkɔ.
Na sɛ ofi ne fie kɔ a, ɔnkɔ nkɛyɛ ɔbanyin fofor bi ne yer.
Na sɛ nkyinkyirii kun no so tan no, na ɔkyerɛw ɔkonwoma ma no, na ɔdze hyɛ ne nsa, na ogya no kwan ma ofi ne fie kɔ; anaa sɛ nkyinkyirii kun no a ɔfaa no yɛɛ ne yer no wu a;

mma no kun kankan no a ogyaa no kwan no, mmfa no nnyɛ ne yer bio, wɔ no ho fi-gu ekyir no; na ɔyɛ ekyiwadze wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Na mma nnyɛ ma asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze no do nnyɛ bɔn.
Sɛ ɔbanyin bi hyia yer fofor a, mma ɔnnkɔ sa, nkyii so mma wɔmmfa edwuma biara nnto no do: Ondzi noho wɔ fie afrenhyia, na ɔmma ne yer a oehyia no no akomatɔmu.
Mma nyimpa bi nngye ewuyambo anaa ewuyambobaa a ɔda do no ahoba:
Sɛ wohu nyimpa a owia no nuanom Israel mu bi, na ɔyɛ no dɛ onyimfo, anaa ɔtɔn no a; ɔno owifo no nwu; ama eeyi mbusu no efi wo mu.
Hwɛ yie wɔ kwata owuyar ho, na aadwen do yie ayɛ dɛ mbrɛ asɔfo Levifo no bɛkyerɛkyerɛ hom no nyinara: Dɛ mbrɛ mehyɛɛ hɔn no, dɛmara so na hom ndwen do nyɛ.
Kaa dza Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze yɛɛ Miriam wɔ ɔkwan no mu aber a hom fi Egypt reba no.
Sɛ ebɔ wo nyɛnko bosa biara a, mma nnkɔ ne fie nnkɛgye n'ahobadze.
Abowenyim na gyina, na nyimpa a ebɔ no bosa no mfa ahobadze no mfir edzi mbrɛ wo wɔ abowenyim.
Na sɛ ɔyɛ ohianyi a, mma mmfa n'ahobadze no nnda:
Sɛ wi kɔtɔ a, fa ahobadze no san kɛma no, na ɔnda wɔ n'atar mu, na onhyira wo: Na ɔnyɛ tsenenee mma wo wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim
Mma nnhyɛ ɔpaanyi a ɔyɛ ɔbɔbɔnyi nye ohianyi no do, sɛ ofi wo nuanom mu o, ofi w'ahɔhoe a wɔwɔ w'asaase do wɔ wo nkuropɔn mu o:
ne da mu na ma no n'apaadze, nkyii so mma wi nnkɔtɔ do; osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔbɔbɔnyi, na ɔdze n'akoma esi do: Amma ɔaannka mu ammfrɛ Ewuradze enntsia wo, na aanyɛ bɔn amma wo.
Mma wonnku egyanom wɔ mba ntsi, nkyii so mma wonnku mba wɔ egyanom ntsi: Nyimpa biara nankasa no bɔn ntsi na wonku no.
Mma nndan ɔhɔho, anaa egyanka n'atsɛmbu enyi na nngye okunafo akataho ahoba:
Na kaa dɛ eyɛɛ akowaa wɔ Egypt, na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn poon wo wɔ hɔ: Dɛm ntsi na merehyɛ wo dɛ iyi yi.
Sɛ itwa wo ndɔbaa wɔ wo haban no mu a, mma nnsan nnkɔ nnkɛfa mmba: Ma ɔnyɛ ɔhɔho, egyanka, nye okunafo dze: Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn eehyira wo wɔ wo nsaano edwuma nyinara mu.
Sɛ eporow wo ngodua a, mma nnkɔ n'abaw no do bio: Ma ɔnyɛ ɔhɔho, egyanka, nye okunafa dze.
Sɛ etsew wo wenyin ture mu esikyireamba a, mma nnkedzi w'ekyir mpɛpɛw: Ma ɔnyɛ ɔhɔho, egyanka, nye okunafo dze.
Na kaa dɛ eyɛɛ akowaa wɔ Egypt asaase do: Dɛm ntsi na merehyɛ wo dɛ yɛ iyi yi.
25: Sɛ ɔham ba mbanyin ntamu, na wɔba asɛndzii, na ntsɛmbuafo rubua hɔn ntsɛm a; ɔno wombu ɔtseneneenyi no bem, na wombu ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi no fɔ;
na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi no sɛ hwe a, ɔtsɛmbuafo no mma ɔnda famu, na wɔnhwe no wɔ n'enyim, dodow dɛ mbrɛ no bɔn no tse.
Mbaa eduanan na ɔmma no, mma ɔmmbor: Ɔno bɛyɛ na sɛ ɔbor, na ɔhwe no mbaa pii sen iyi a, wo nua adan w'enyi do ɔhorohoraanyi.
Mma nnkata ɔnantwi ano aber a oritsia ewu.

Sɛ enuanom bɔ nu tsena, na hɔn mu baako wu, na onnyi ɔbabanyin a, mma owufo no ne yer nnkɔ ehuw mu nnkɔwar ɔhɔho: no kun no no nua na ɔnkɔ ne nkyɛn, na ɔmfa no nyɛ ne yer, na ɔnyɛ okun no nua ayɛdze no mma no.
Na ɔmbra dɛ, abakan a ɔbɔwo no no nhyɛ no nua a oewu no ne dzin ananmu, na ne dzin aammpepa emmfi Israel.
Na sɛ ɔbanyin no mmpɛ dɛ ɔfa no nua yer no a, ɔno no nua yer no nkɔ mpanyimfo nkyɛn wɔ kuropon no ano, na ɔnse dɛ, Mo kun no nua wɔ Israel, ɔmmpɛ dɛ ɔyɛ kun no nua ayɛdze no ma me.
Ɔno no kurow no mu mpanyimfo no mfrɛ no, na wɔnkasa nkyerɛ no: Na sɛ ogyina hɔ, na ɔse dɛ, Memmpɛ dɛ mefa no a;
ɔno no nua yer no mbra ne nkyɛn wɔ mpanyimfo no enyim, na ɔnsan ne nan mpaboa na onhina n'enyi do ntafi; na ombua nse dɛ, dɛm na wɔnyɛ ɔbanyin a ɔnnkyekyer no nua fi.
Na wɔmfrɛ ne dzin wɔ Israel dɛ, nyia ne mpaboa asan ne fi.
Sɛ mbanyin bɔ mu rokã, kor nye kor so, na ɔbaako ne yer twe bɛn dɛ ɔrebɛgye no kun efi nyia ɔrohwe no ne nsamu, na ɔtsen ne nsa suo ne banyin mu a:
Ɔno twa ne nsa, mma w'enyi nnhu no mbɔbɔr.
Mma nnya wo foto mu abrambo ahorow, kɛse nye kakraba.
Mma nnya wo fi mu esusudze ahorow, kɛse nye kakraba.
Abrambo kwan mu a ɔtsen na nya; esusudze kwan mu a ɔtsen na nya: na wo nda aawar wɔ asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do.
Na hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛm ndzɛmba nyinara, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ dza ɔmmfa kwan mu nyinara, yɛ ekyiwadze ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn.
Kaa dza Amalek dze yɛɛ wo wɔ ɔkwan no mu aber a hom fi Egypt reba no;
mbrɛ osii behyiaa wo wɔ ɔkwan no mu, na ɔbɔɔ w'ekyirfo, hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw wɔ w'ekyir nyinara, aber a atɔ bahaw na aberɛ; na oennsuro Nyankopɔn.

Dɛm ntsi ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ma wo ahomgye fi w'atamfo a woetwa wo ho ehyia nyinara nsamu wɔ asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ fa yɛ egyapadze no do a, pepa Amalek nkaa fi ɔsor ase; mma wo werɛ mmfir.
26: Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ idu asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze no do, na efa, na etsena do a;

fa asaase no do nduadzewa a ibenya no wɔ asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do no, no nduadzewa a odzi kan no nyinara mu bi; na fa gu kɛntsɛn mu, na fa kɔ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi dɛ ne dzin ntsena hɔ no.
Na kɔ ɔsɔfo a ɔbɛtsena hɔ nda no mu no nkyɛn, na se no dɛ ndɛ da yi mepaa mu mekã kyerɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, dɛ medu asaase a Ewuradze kãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɛn egyanom dɛ ɔdze rema hɛn no do.
Na ɔsɔfo no ngye kɛntsɛn no wɔ wo nsamu, na ɔmfa nsi Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn n'afɔrmbukyia no enyim.
Na bua na kã no wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim dɛ, Syrianyi a ɔreyɛ ahera nye m'egya, na osianee kɔr Egypt, na ɔkɛtsenaa hɔ, ne nyimpa kumaabi; na ɔyɛɛ ɔman kɛse a wɔyɛ dzen, na wɔdɔree wɔ hɔ:
Na Egyptfo no yɛɛ hɛn bɔn, na wo hiahiaa hɛnho, na wɔdze nkowaasom dzendzen too hɛn do;
na yɛkekaa mu frɛɛ Ewuradze, hɛn egyanom Nyankopɔn, na Ewuradze tsiee hɛn ndze, na ohun hɛn ahohiahia, nye hɛn fona, nye hɛn suhia:
Na Ewuradze dze nsa a ɔyɛ dzen, nye abasa a wɔatsew mu, nye nketsenketse akɛse, nye nsɛnkyerɛdze, nye anwanwadze yii hɛn fii Egypt firii:
Na ɔdze hɛn aba bea yi do, na ɔdze asaase yi ama hɛn, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do.
Na afei, hwɛ, medze asaase a ɔwo, Ewuradze, dze amame no do nduadzewa a odzi kan no maba. Na fa si Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim, na sɔr wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim:
na gye w'enyi wɔ adzepa a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze ama ɔwo, nye wo fi, nyinara mu, ɔwo, nye Levinyi, nye ɔhɔho a ɔwɔ wo mu no.
Sɛ iwie wo ndɔbaa mu ebupɛm du du nyinara yiyi wɔ afe a otsīa ebiasa no a ɔyɛ ebupɛn du du yi yi afe no mu a, ɔno fa ma Levinyi, nye ɔhɔho, nye egyanka, nye ekunafo, ma wondzi wɔ wo kuropon mu, mmee;

na se wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim dɛ, meyi ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn no efi me fie, na so medze mama Levinyi, nye ɔhɔho, nye egyanka, nye okunafo, dɛ mbrɛ wo mbrasɛm a edze ahyɛ me no nyinara tse monntõo wo mbransɛm mu biara, mkyii so mo werɛ mmfirii:
Minndzii bi nnkyenee dɛ no ho nntsew ntsi, na memmfaa bi memmaa ewufo so: Metsie Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn ndze, mayɛ dɛ mbrɛ edze ahyɛ me no nyinara.
Fi wo tsenabew krɔnkrɔn no, wɔ ɔsor, hwɛ famu, na hyira wo man Israel, nye asaasea edze ama hɛn no, dɛ mbrɛ ekãa ntam kyerɛɛnhɛn egyanom no, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no.
Ndɛ da yi Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn rehyɛ wo dɛ yɛ ahyɛdze nye atsɛmbu yi: Dɛm ntsi fa w'akoma nyinara nye wo kra nyinara dzi dona yɛ.
Ndɛ da yi, akã ato gua dɛ edze Ewuradze bɛyɛ wo Nyankopɔn, n'ahyɛdze, nye ne mbransɛm, nye ne ntsɛmbu do, na etsie ne ndze:
Na Ewuradze akã ato gua ndɛ da yi dɛ ebɛyɛ nankasa no soronko man, dɛ mbrɛ ɔabɔ wo anohoba no, na eedzi ne mbransɛm nyinara do;
na ɔaama wo do akyɛn amanaman aɔayɛ nyinara, wɔ ayɛyi mu, nye dzin mu, nye enyidzi mu; na aayɛ ɔman krɔnkrɔn ama Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, dɛ mbrɛ ɔakã no.
27: Na Moses nye Israel mpanyimfo no hyɛɛ ɔman no dɛ, hom ndzi mbrasɛm a merehyɛ hom ndɛ da yi nyinara do.
Na ɔmbra dɛ, da a hom botwa Jordan akɔ asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do, fa abo akɛse sisi hɔ, na fa ntarho tetar ho:

na kyerɛw mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara wɔ do, aber a etwa no; na aakɔ asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze, w'egyanom Nyankopɔn, abɔ wo anohoba no.
Na ɔmbra dɛ aber a hom etwa Jordan no, hom mfa abo yi a merehyɛ hom ndɛ da yi, nsisi hɔ wɔ bepɔw Ebal do, na fa ntarho tetar ho.
Na hɔ na si afɔrmbukyia ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, abo afɔrmbukyia a: mma emma dadze edwindze do wɔ do.
Abo a wonntwae na fa si Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn afɔrmbukyia no: na bɔ ɔhyew-afɔr wɔ do ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn:
Na bɔ asomdwee afɔr, na dzidzi wɔ hɔ; na gye w'enyi wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na kyerɛw mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara petee wɔ abo no do.
Na Moses nye asɔfo Levifo no kasaa kyerɛɛ Israel nyinara dɛ, Israel, hom nyɛ dzinn, na hom ntsie; ndɛ da yi abɛyɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ne man.
Dɛm ntsi tsie Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ne ndze, na dzi ne mbransɛm na n'ahyɛdze a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi do.
Na Moses hyɛɛ ɔman no da no ara, dɛ,
Iyinom na wongyina bepɔw Gerizim do nhyira ɔman no, aber a hom etwa Jordan no; Simeon, nye Levi, nye Issachar nye Joseph, nye Benjamin:
na iyinom ngyina bepɔw Ebal do mpaa; Reuben, Gad nye Asher, nye Zebulun, Dan, nye Naphtali.
Na Levifo no mfa ndze kɛse mbua, na wɔnse Israelfo no nyinara dɛ,
Mpaa nkã nyimpa a ɔbɛyɛ ohonyi a woesian anaa woegu, Ewuradze ekyiwadze, odwimfo nsaano edwuma, na ɔdze besi kokoa mu. Na ɔman no nyinara mbua nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nkã nyia ɔyaw n'egya anaa ne nã. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nkã nyia ɔtwe ne nyɛnko n'asaasehe. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nkã nyia ɔma onyifurafo fi ɔkwan do kyin. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nkã nyia ɔdan ɔhɔho, egyanka, nye okunafo atsɛmbu enyi. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nkã nyia ɔnye n'egya yer da; osiandɛ oeyi n'egya n'akataho. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ. Amen.
Mpaa nkã nyia ɔnye abowa biara da. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nkã nyia ɔnye n'akyerɛbaa da, n'egya ne babaa, anaa ne nã ne babaa. Na ɔman no Nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nkã nyia ɔnye n'asew da. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nkã nyia ɔbɔ ne nyɛnko adze nsumaa mu. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nkã nyia ɔgye mboaba dɛ oboku nyimpa a odi bem. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nkã nyia ɔnnhyɛ mbra yi mu nsɛm dzen dɛ ɔbɛyɛ. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
28: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ itsie Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ne ndze yie, dɛ ebɔdwen do ayɛ ne mbransɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara a, Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛma wo do akɔ sor asen asaase do amanaman nyinara:
Na nhyira yi nyinara bɛba wo do, na wɔabɔto wo, sɛ itsie Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ndze a.
Nhyira bɛkã wo wɔ kurow mu, na nhyira akã wo wɔ haban mu.
Nhyira bɛkã wo honam mu aba, na w'asaase do aba, w'anantwi ndɔree, nye wo nguankuw mu mburwa.
Nhyira bɛkã wo kɛntsen nye wo mbɔrkorow.
Nhyira bɛkã wo wɔ wo fie ba mu, na nhyira bɛkã wo wɔ w'edzifir mu.
Ewuradze bɛma w'atamfo a wɔsoɛr wo do egu ebiritsi wɔ w'enyim: Wɔnam ɔkwan kor do bɛba wo do, na wɔnam akwan esuon do eguan wɔ w'enyim.
Ewuradze bɛhyɛ ma nhyira aba wo do wɔ w'asan do, na dza edze wo nsa bɛkã nyinara mu; na obehyira wo wɔ asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do.
Ewuradze dze wo betsim hɔ ma aayɛ ɔman krɔnkrɔn ama noara, dɛ mbrɛ ɔakã ntam akyerɛ wo no: Sɛ idzi Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ne mbransɛm do, na enantsew n'akwan do a.
Na asaase do man nyinara bohu dɛ wɔdze Ewuradze dzin afrɛ wo; na wobosuro wo.
Na Ewuradze bɛma yie ebu wo do, wɔ wo honam mu aba mu, nye wo fiembowa aba mu, mye w'asaase aba mu, wɔ asaase a Ewuradze kãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w'egyanam dɛ ɔdze bɛma wo no do.
Ewuradze bobue ɔsor n'adzepa korabea no ama wo na ɔaama w'asaase do nyankom atɔ wɔ n'aber mu, na oeehyira wo nsaano edwuma nyinara do: Na edze bɛfɛm amanaman pii, na ɔwo remmfɛm.
Na Ewuradze bɛyɛ wo tsir, na nnyɛ dua a; na ɔwo bɔbɔ do ara nko, na eremmba ase; sɛ itsie Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn mbransɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi; dɛ ebɔdwen do ayɛ:
na erenndan mmfi nsɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi ho, mmfa enyimfa, anaa abankum, nnkɔ nnkedzi enyame fofor ekyir nnkɔsom hɔn a.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ enntsie Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ne ndze dɛ ebɔdwen do ayɛ ne mbransɛm nye n'ahyɛdze a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara a; mpaa yi nyinara bɛba wo do, na wɔabɔto wo.
Mpaa bɛkã wo wɔ kurow mu, na mpaa akã wo wɔ haban mu.
Mpaa bɛkã wo kɛntsɛn, nye wo mbɔkorow.
Mpaa bɛkã wo honam mu aba, nye w'asaase mu aba, nye w'anantwi mu ndɔree, nye wo nguankuw mu mburwa.
Mpaa bɛkã wo wɔ wo fie ba mu, na mpaa bɛkã wo wɔ w'edzifir mu.
Ewuradze bɛma mpaa, adɔngu, nye adapaabɔ aba wo do, wɔ dza edze wo nsa bɛkã ayɛ nyinara mu, dze ekodu dɛ ebɛsɛɛ, na ahera ntsɛm; osian wo ndzeyɛɛ a enam do apow me ntsi.
Ewuradze bɛma ɔyardɔm afam wo ho, dze ekodu dɛ ɔahyew wo efi asaase a erokɔ do akɛfa no do.
Ewuradze dze asasawaw, nye etsiridii, nye ahohur, nye ɔhow, nye ɔpo bɔbɔ wo; na wobetsiw wo araa ekodu dɛ ebɛhera.
Na wo sor a ɔwɔ w'etsifi bɛdan boran, na asaase a ɔwɔ w'ase adan dadze.
Ewuradze bɛyɛ w'asaase do nyankom etudur nye huntuma: Ɔsor na obefi atɔ egu wo do araa ekodu dɛ wɔbɛsɛɛ wo.
Ewuradze bɛma w'atamfo enyim ɔkogu: Enam ɔkwan kor do befir edzi ekehyia hɔn, na enam akwan esuon do eguan wɔ hɔn enyim: Na wobedzi wo akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do ahendzi nyinara mu.
Na wo fun bɛyɛ wimu ntumbowa nyinara, nye asaase do mbowa edziban, na obiara rennka hɔn.
Ewuradze dze Egypt pɔmpɔ, nye tukuruw, nye satwem, nye ntwem a worunntum wo eduyɛ bɔbobɔ wo.
Ewuradze dze abɔdam, nye enyifura, nye akoma mu ahodwuruw bɔbɔ wo; nye akoma mu ahodwuruw bɔbɔ wo;
na ebɛkekã ewiaber ketee, dɛ ofurafo rekekã wɔ sum mu, na w'akwan mu rennyɛ wo yie: Na ɔhyɛ nko na wɔbɛhyɛ wo na wɔafow wo dabaa, na obiara renngye wo.
Ebɛgye ayewar, na ɔbanyin fofor bi nye no ada: Ibesi ɔdan, na erenntsena mu: Ebɛtsɛw wenyin ture, na erenntsew n'aba bi.
Woboku wo nantwi wɔ w'enyim, na irinndzi bi: Wɔbɛfa w'asoaso enyimpi do wɔ w'enyim, na wɔrenndan mma wo: Wɔdze wo nguan bɛma w'atamfo na irinnya obi ma ɔaagye wo.
Wɔdze wo mbabanyin nye wo mbabaa bɛma ɔman fofor bi na w'enyiwa bɔhwɛ, na hɔn ho enyigyinae egura wo daa nyinara: Na tum biara nnyi wo nsamu.
W'asaase do aba, nye w'edumadze nyinara, na ɔmaan a innyim hɔn bedzi; na ɔhyɛ nko na wɔbɛhyɛ wo na wɔadwerew wo dabaa:
dɛm ntsi w'enyiwa do adze a ibohu no bɔbɔ wo dam.
Ewuradze dze pɔmpɔ bɔn bɔbɔ wo wɔ anankoroma, nye aserɛ do a worunntum wo eduyɛ, efi w'ananadze ekodu w'etsifipampamu.
Ewuradze dze dze ɔwo, nye wo hen a ibesi no wo do no, bɔkɔ ɔman a ɔwo nye w'egyanom nnyim no mu; na hɔ na ebɔsom enyame fofor, ndua nye abo.
Na ebɛdan ahodwuruwdze, akasabɛbu, nye ifen, wɔ aman mbrɛ Ewuradze bɛgye wo akɔ no nyinara mu.
Ebɔsoa aba pii akɔ haban mu, na kumaabi ba ebɔboa ano aba fie; na mbɛbɛw bedzi.
Ebɛtsetsɛw wenyin nture na esiesie mu, na ne nsã dze eronnom, na erenntsew esikyireamba no so; na mbowaba bedzi.
Ibenya ngodua wɔ wo ntoado nyinara, na ngo no dze erennsera woho bi; na wo ngodua no bɔporow n'aba.
Ebɔwo mbabanyin nye mbabaa, na wɔrennyɛ wodze; na wɔbɔkɔ ndɔmmum mu.
Wo ndua nyinara nye w'asaase do aba no mbɛbɛw bɛfa.
Ɔhɔho a ɔwɔ wo mu bɛkyɛn wo akɔ sorsorsor; na ɔwodze ibesian aba famufamufamu.
Ɔno na ɔdze bɛfɛm wo, na ɔwodze irinnya mmfɛm no: Ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ tsir, na ɔwo ayɛ dua.
Na mpaa yi nyinara bɛba wo do, na woetsiw wo, na wɔato wo, ekodu dɛ ebɛsɛɛ; osiandɛ enntsie Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ndze, dɛ ibedzi ne mbransɛm nye n'ahyɛdze a ɔhyɛ wo no do:
Na ɔbɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze, wɔ ɔwo nye w'asefo do daa:
Osiandɛ ammfa enyigye, nye akoma pa annsom Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, wɔ adze nyinara no dodow mu ntsi:
Dɛm ntsi ebɔsom w'atamfo a Ewuradze bɔsoma hɔn ma wɔaaba wo do no, wɔ ɔkɔm, nye nsukɔm, nye adagyaw, nye ndzɛmba nyinara ho hia mu: Na ɔdze dadze kɔndua bɔto wo kɔn do, ekodu dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ wo.
Ewuradze ɔman bi befi ekyirkyir efi asaase ano aba wo do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkɔr tu; ɔman a enntse hɔn kasaa;
ɔman a hɔn enyim yɛ hu a wɔmmfɛr akɔdaa enyim, na wɔnnkyerɛ enyimtsewee wɔ aberantsɛ do so:
Na obedzi wo fiembowa mu aba, na w'asaase do aba, ekodu dɛ wɔbɛsɛɛ wo: Eso orinngya wo eburow, nsã, anaa ngo, w'anantwi mu ndɔree, anaa wo nguankuw mu mburwa, ekodu dɛ ɔbɛma ahera.

Na ɔbɔkɔ wo ntua wɔ wo nkuropon nyinara mu, ekodu dɛ w'afasu atsentsen a ɔyɛ dzen no a edze wo werɛ hyɛ mu no bɛba famu, wɔ w'asaase nyina do: Na ɔbɔkɔ wo ntua wɔ wo nkuropon nyinara a ɔwɔ w'asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze ama wo no nyinara do.
Na ibedzi woara wo honam mu aba, wo mbabanyin nye wo mbabaa a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze ama wo no hɔn nam; wɔ ntua nye ahokyer a w'atamfo bɛma wo ho akyer wo no mu.
Ɔbanyin a ɔyɛ mberɛw wɔ hom mu, na ɔkõko no ho no, n'enyiwa bɛyɛ bɔn wɔ no nua, nye ne yer a ɔda no bo mu, nye ne mba nkaa a wɔama wɔaka no ho:
Dɛ ɔremma hɔn mu biara ne mba nam a oridzi no bi, osiandɛ biribiara nnka amma no; wɔ ntua nye ahokyer a wo tamfo bɛma wo ho akyer wɔ wo wɔ nkuropon nyinara mu no mu.
Hom mu ɔbaa a ɔyɛ mberɛw na ɔkõko no ho a ahokokõ nye mberɛwyɛ ntsi ɔnnsɔe nnhwɛɛ pɛn dɛ ɔdze n'ananadze bɛkõ famu, n'enyi bɛyɛ bɔn wɔ no kun a ɔda no bo mu, nye ne babanyin, nye ne babaa ho;
Na n'abɔtoaba a ofi n'anan ntamu, nye adze nyinara ho hia ntsi obedzi hɔn wɔ nsumaa mu: Wɔ ntua nye ahokyer a wo tamfo bɛma wo ho akyer wo wɔ wo nkuropon mu ntsi.
Sɛ eronndwen do nnyɛ mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma yi mu, na ennsuro enyimnyam dzin a no ho yɛ hu yi, EWURADZE WO Nyankopɔn no a,
ɔno Ewuradze bɛma wo yardɔm, nye w'asefo yardɔm ayɛ nwanwa; mekyerɛ ɔyardɔm ayɛ nwanwa; mekyerɛ ɔyardɔm akɛse a ɔkyɛr, nye yarba bɔn a ɔkyɛr.
Na ɔdze Egypt yarba no a isuro no nyinara bɛba wo do bio; na ɔabɛfemfam wo ho.
Eso yarba biara, nye ɔyardɔm biara a wɔnnkyerɛw no wɔ mbra yi no nwoma mu no, ɔno na Ewuradze dze bɛba wo do, ekodu dɛ wɔbɛsɛɛ wo.
Na ɔbɛka hom nyimpa kakrabaabi, naaso na nkyɛ hom dodow tse dɛ ɔsor nworaba; osiandɛ enntsie Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ne ndze.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'enyi gye hom ho dɛ ɔbɛyɛ hom yie, na ɔama hom adɔr no; dɛmara so na Ewuradze n'enyi bɛgye hom ho dɛ ɔbɛma hom ahera, na ɔasɛɛ hom: na wɔbɛpempan hom efi asaase a hom rokɔ do akɛfa no do.
Na Ewuradze bɔbɔ wo apetse aman nyinara mu, efi asaase ano kor araa ekodu asaase ano kor so; na hɔ na ebɔsom enyame fofor a ɔwo nye w'egyanom nnyim hɔn, mekyerɛ ndua nye abo.
Na amanaman iyinom mu irinnya ahobaa, na w'ananadze rinnya ahomgye: Na Ewuradze bɛma wo ahopopo akoma, nye enyiwa a ayɛ siamoo, nye ɔkra a etwintwan wɔ hɔ:
Na wo nkwa bɛsɛn ehihim wɔ w'enyim; na ibosuro adzesaa nye adzekyee, na irinnya wo nkwa ho gyedzi biara:
anapa ebɛse dɛ, kɛtseankyɛ ewimbir a: Wɔ w'akoma mu suro a ibosuro, nye w'enyiwa do adze a ibohu no ntsi.
Na Ewuradze dze ahɛn dze wo bɛsan akɔ Egypt, wɔ ɔkwan a mekãa wo ho asɛm dɛ irunnhu bio no do: Na hɔ na hom bɔtontɔn homho ama hom atamfo ayɛ nkowaa nye mfonabaa, na nyimpa biara ronntɔ hom.
29: Iyi nye ahyɛmu a Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses dɛ ɔnye Israelmba ndzi wɔ Moab asaase do, nka ahyɛmu a ɔnye hɔn dzii wɔ Horeb no ho no, no mu nsɛm.
Na Moses frɛɛ Israel nyinara, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom ehu adze nyinara a Ewuradze dze yɛɛ Pharaoh, nye no nkowaa nyinara, nye n'asaase nyinara, wɔ hom enyiwa mu, wɔ Egypt asaase do;
nsɔhwɛ akɛse a w'enyiwa hunii, nsɛnkyerɛdze, nye anwanwadze akɛse no:
na Ewuradze mma wo akoma a wɔdze hu, nye enyiwa a wɔdze hwɛ, nye asowa a wɔdze tsie dze ebodu ndɛ da yi.
Na megya hom mfe eduanan wɔ sar no do; hom ntar nnsuwii wɔ hom ho, na wo mpaboa nntsetsewee wɔ w'ananadze.
Hom nndzii paanoo, nkyii so hom nnoom wenyin anaa nsã dzendzen: Ama hom eehu dɛ emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Na aber a hom dur bea yi do no, Heshbonhen Sihon, nye Bahenhen Og, fir edzi baa hɛn do nye hɛn bɔkõe, na yekum hɔn;
na yɛfaa hɔn asaase, na yɛdze maa Reubenfo, nye Gadfo, nye Manassehfo ebusuakuw ɔfã no, dɛ egyapadze.
Dɛm ntsi hom ndzi ahyɛmu yi mu nsɛm do, na ho nyɛ, na hom aayɛ prɔmprɔm wɔ dza hom yɛ nyinara mu.
Ndɛ da yi hom nyinara hom ngyina Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn enyim; hom etsitsir, hom ebusuakuw ebusuakuw, hom mpanyimfo, nye hom ahwɛdofo, mekyerɛ Israel mbanyin nyinara,
hom mbofraba, hom yernom, nye wo hɔhoe a ɔwɔ wo nsereban mu, ofi wo duatwafo do dze kodu wo nsusafo do:
Ama aahɛn Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn n'ahyɛmu, nye ne nsew a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nye wo ridzi ndɛ da yi mu:
Ama ɔdze wo eesi hɔ ndɛ da yi dɛ ɔman ama noho, na ɔno so aayɛ Nyankopɔn ama wo, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkãa kyerɛɛ wo, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔkãa ntam kyerɛɛ w'egyanom, Abraham, Isaac, nye Jacob no.
Nkyii so nnyɛ hom nko na menye hom ridzi ahyɛmu yi nye nsew yi:
Mbom menye nyia ɔnye hɛn gyina Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn enyim ha ndɛ da yi, na so menye nyia ɔnnye hɛn nnyi ha ndɛ da yi:
(na hom nyim mbrɛ yesii tsenaa Egypt asaase do; na mbrɛ yesii twaa mu wɔ amanaman a hom faa hɔn mu baa mu;
na hom ehu hɔn ekyiwadze, na hɔn abosom, ndua nye abo, dwetɛ nye sika a ɔwɔ hɔn mu no:)

Amma hom mu aammba ɔbanyin bi, anaa ɔbaa bi, anaa ebusua bi, anaa ebusuakuw bi a n'akoma redan ndɛ da yi efi Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn ho, dɛ ɔrokɔ akɔsom amanaman no hɔn enyame no: Na ndwow bi aammba hom mu a ɔsow bɔr nye ɔbɔwen;
na aammba dɛ, sɛ ɔtse mpaa yi mu nsɛm a, oeennhyira noho wɔ n'akoma mu, dɛ, mibenya asomdwee, kaansa menam m'akoma no sorow mu mpo a, mma wɔaannsɛɛ dza afɔw annka dza awow ho:
Ewuradze remmfa mmfir no, na mbom Ewuradze n'ebufuw nye ne nyinkuntwe bopun nyimpa no, na mpaa a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma yi mu no nyinara bodwir no do, na Ewuradze bɛpepa ne dzin efi ɔsor ase.
Na Ewuradze beyi no efi Israel ebusuakuw nyinara mu esi hɔ ama mbusu, dɛ mbrɛ ahyɛmu a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mbra nwoma yi mu mpaa no tse nyinara.

Na ebusuasantsen a wɔbɛba no, hom mba a wɔbɔsoɛr edzi hom ekyir no, nye ɔnanaben a ofi ekyirkyir asaase do bɛba no, sɛ wohu asaase no do yardɔm, nye nyarbanyarba a Ewuradze dze ama wɔayar no a, wɔbɛse dɛ;

n'asaase nyinara ayɛ sufre nye nkyen, nye nkyewee, wonndua do adze, ɔnnsow, nkyɛkyɛr mmfir do, ɔtse dɛ Sodom nye Gomorah, Admah nye Zeboiim mbutuwii a Ewuradze nam n'ebufuw nye n'ebufuhyew mu butuwii no:
Mekyerɛ amanaman nyinara bɛse dɛ, ebɛn ntsi na Ewuradze ayɛ asaase yi dɛm yi? Ebufuw kɛse hyeehyew yi ase nye dɛn?
Nna nkorɔfo bɛse dɛ, osiandɛ wɔpoow Ewuradze hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn ahyɛmu a oyii hɔn wɔ Egypt asaase do no a ɔnye hɔn dzii no;
na wɔkɔree kɔsoom enyame fofor, na wɔsɔɔr hɔn, enyame a wonnyim hɔn, na ɔammfa hɔn amma hɔn:
Dɛm ntsi na Ewuradze ebufuw dzɛɛw wɔ asaase yi do, ma ɔdze mpaa a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma yi mu nyinara aba do;
na Ewuradze tutuu hɔn ase fii hɔn asaase do wɔ ebufuw, nye ebufuwhyew, nye ahohur kɛse mu, na wɔatow hɔn egu asaase bi so do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
Ndzɛmba a osuma yɛ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn dze; na ndzɛmba wɔada no edzi no dze ɔyɛ hɛn nye hɛn mba dze daa, ama yeedzi mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara do.
30: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ ndzɛmba iyinom nyinara ba wo do, nhyira nye mpaa a, medze mesi w'enyim yi, na ekaakaa no wɔ amanaman nyinara mu mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn apam wo akɔ no,
na esan ba Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na itsie ne ndze dɛ mbrɛ merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara, ɔwo nye wo mba, edze w'akoma nyinara, na ɔnye wo kra nyinara a;
ɔno na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛdan wo ndɔmmummkɔ no, na oenya ayamuhyehye ama wo, na aboa w'ano efi aman nyinara mu, mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn abɔ wo apetse no.
Sɛ wo nyimpa a wɔapam hɔn no bi wɔ ɔsor ano no ho a, ofi hɔ na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɔboa w'ano, na ofi hɔ na ɔbɛfa wo:
Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze wo bɛba asaase a w'egyanom nyaa no do, na aafa; na ɔbɛyɛ wo yie, na ɔama adɔr akyɛn w'egyanom nyaa no do, na aafa; na ɔbɛyɛ wo yie, na ɔãma adɔr akyɛn w'egyanom.
Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn botwa w'akoma, nye w'asefo akoma twatsia, na edze w'akoma nyinara, na ɔnye wo kra nyinara, aadɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, na aatsena ase.
Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze mpaa yi nyinara bogu w'atamfo, nye hɔn a wokyir wo a wohiahia wo ho no do.
Na ebɛsan ebetsie Ewuradze ndze, na edzi ne mbransɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara do.

Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛma yie ebu wo do wɔ wo nsaano edwuma nyinara mu, wɔ wo nsaano edwuma nyinara mu, wɔ wo honam mu aba mu, nye wo fiembowa aba mu, nye w'asaase do aba mu, wɔ wo yie ntsi: na Ewuradze bɛsan agye n'enyi wɔ wo do wɔ wo yie ntsi, dɛ mbrɛ ɔgyee n'enyi wɔ w'egyanom do no:

Sɛ itsie Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ndze, dɛ ibedzi ne mbransɛm nye n'ahyɛdze a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mbra nwoma yi mu no do, dɛ edze w'akoma nyinara, na ɔnye wo kra nyinara san ba Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn a.
Na mbrasɛm yi a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi, ɔnnyɛ dzendzen dodow mma wo, nkyii so onnyi ekyirkyir.
Onnyi ɔsor, na aase dɛ, woana na ɔbɔfow akɔ sor ama hɛn, na ɔakɛfa abrɛ hɛn, na ɔama yɛatse, na yɛayɛ?
Nkyii so onnyi po n'egya, na aase dɛ, woana na obotwa po ama hɛn, na ɔakɛfa abrɛ hɛn, na ɔama yɛatse, ma yaayɛ?
Na asɛm no bɛn wo dodoodow, ɔwɔ w'anomu, na ɔwɔ w'akoma mu, ama aayɛ.
Hwɛ, ndɛ da yi medze nkwa nye papa, nye owu nye bɔn, mesi w'enyim;

wɔ dɛ merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi dɛ dɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, nantsew n'akwan do, na dzi ne mbransɛm nye n'ahyɛdze nye ne ntsɛmbu do, na aatsena ase na aadɔr, na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ehyira wo wɔ asaase mbrɛ erokɔ do akɛfa no do.
Mbom sɛ w'akoma dan, na enntsie, na ema wɔtwe wo kɔ, na ɔkɔsɔr enyame fofor, na esom hɔn a;
mepaa mu mekã kyerɛ hom ndɛ da yi, dɛ ɔhera na hom bɛhera; hom remma hom nda nnwar wɔ asaase mbrɛ irutwa Jordan akɔ do akɛfa no do.
Mefrɛ ɔsor nye asaase dɛ wondzi hom dase ndɛ da yi, dɛ medze nkwa nye owu, nhyira nye mpaa mesi w'enyim: Dɛm ntsi fa nkwa, ma ɔwo, nye w'asefo nnya nkwa:

na dɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, tsie ne ndze, na takyer no ho: Na ɔno nye wo nkwa, nye wo nda ne tsentsen: Ama aatsena asaase a Ewuradze kãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w'egyanom, Abraham, Isaac, nye Jacob dɛ ɔdze bɛma hɔn no do.
31: Na Moses kɔree kɛkãa asɛm yi kyerɛɛ Israel nyinara.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ndɛ da yi medzi mfe ɔha eduonu; murunntum mimmfir edzi na memmba mu bio: Na Ewurazde ase me dɛ, irunntwa Jordan yi.
Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, ɔno na odzi w'enyim rukotwa; ɔno na ɔbɛsɛɛ amanaman yi efi w'enyim, na afa hɔn: Na Joshua na oridzi w'enyim ekotwa, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze akã no.
Na Ewuradze bɛyɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ Amorifo ahemfo, Sihon nye Og a ɔsɛɛ hɔn, nye hɔn asaase no.
Ewuradze beyi hɔn ama wɔ hom enyim, na hom ayɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ mbransɛm a manhyɛ hom nyinara tse.
Hom nhyɛ dzen na hom nnya akokodur, mma hom nnsuro, mma hɔn ho nnyɛ hom hu so; na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn no, ɔno na ɔnye wo rokɔ, ɔremmpa wo, na ɔrommpow wo so.

Na Moses frɛɛ Joseph, na ɔsee no wɔ Israel nyinara enyim dɛ, hyɛ dzen na nye akokodur; na ɔwo na edze ɔman yi bɔkɔ asaase a Ewuradze akã ho ntam akyerɛ hɔn egyanom dɛ ɔdze bɛma hɔn no do; na ɔwo na ebɛma woenya edzi.
Na Ewuradze, ɔno nye nyia oridzi w'enyim akɔ; obedzi w'ekyir, ɔremmpa wo; nkyii so ɔrommpow wo; mma nnsuro, nkyii so mma w'akoma nntu.
Na Moses kyerɛɛw mbra yi, na ɔdze maa asɔfo Levi mbabanyin no a wɔsoa Ewuradze ahyɛmudaka no, nye Israel mpanyimfo nyinara.
Na Moses hyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, mfe esuon biara n'ewiei, akwangya afe n'aber a wɔahyɛ no mu, ntamadan afahyɛ no mu,
aber a Israel nyinara aba ribefir wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔbɛsan mu eyi no, kenkan mbra yi wɔ Israel nyinara enyim ma wɔntse.
Boaboa ɔman no ano, mbanyin nye mbaa nye mbofraba, nye wo hɔhoe a ɔwɔ wo nkuropon mu, ma wontsie, na wonsūa, na wonsuro Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn, na wɔndwen do ndzi mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara do;
na hɔn mba a wonnyim no ntsie, na wonsūa dɛ wonsuro Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn, aber tsentsen nyina a hom tse asaase no do mbrɛ hom rukotwa Jordan akɛfa no.

Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, hwɛ, wo nda a ibowu abɛn: Frɛ Joshua, na wonkeyi homho nkyerɛ wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, ma menhyɛ no mbra. Na Moses nye Joshua kɔree, na wokeyii hɔnho kyerɛe wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu.
Na Ewuradze nam mununkum dum mu yii noho edzi wɔ Buw no mu: Na mununkum dum no begyinaa Buw no n'abowano.

Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, hwɛ, ɔwo nye w'egyanom bɛkɛda; na ɔman yi bɔsoɛr, na woekedzi asaase no do enyamenana ekyir ehuhugor mu, wɔ mbrɛ wɔrokɔ akɔforafora hɔn mu no, na wɔbɔpow me na wɔatõ m'ahyɛmu a menye hɔn edzi no.

ɔno na m'ebufuw bɛdzɛw wɔ hɔn do wɔ da no mu, na mapow hɔn, na medze m'enyim mesuma hɔn, na wɔamen hɔn, na mbusu nye ɔfona pii bɛba hɔn do; ama wɔaase wɔ da no mu dɛ, Ana nnyɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn a onnyi hɛn mu ntsi na mbusu yi aba hɛn do bi a?
Na suma ara na medze m'enyim mubosuma wɔ da no mu wɔ mbusu a wɔabɔ no nyinara ntsi, wɔ dɛ wɔadan akɔ enyame fofor nkyɛn ntsi.
Dɛm ntsi afei hom nkyerɛw ndwom yi mma homho, na fa kyerɛkyerɛ Israelmba: Fa hyɛ hɔn anomu, ma ndwom yi ndzi me dase ntsia Israelmba.

Na aber a medze hɔn mubodu asaase a mekãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom no a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no do; na wobedzidzi amee, na wɔayɛ abran no; nna wɔbɛdan akɔ enyame fofor nykɛn, na wɔakɔsom hɔn, na woebu me enyimtsia, na wɔatõ m'ahyɛmu.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, aber a mbusu nye ɔfona pii aba hɔn do no, ndwom yi bɛyɛ dɛ ɔdasefo edzi dase wɔ hɔn enyim; osiandɛ ɔnnkɛpa hɔn asefo anomu: na minyim hɔn adwendwen a wɔrodwendwen no seseira mpo, ansaana medze hɔn morokɔ asaase a mekãa ho ntam no do.
Nna Moses kyerɛɛw ndwom yi da no ara, na ɔdze kyerɛkyerɛɛ Israelmba.
Na ɔhyɛɛ Nun ne babanyin Joshua mbra, na ɔsee dɛ, hyɛ dzen na nya akokodur: Na ɔwo na edze Israelmba bɔkɔ asaase a mekãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn no do; na mibedzi w'ekyir.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Moses wiee mbra yi mu nsɛm kyerɛw wɔ nwoma mu dze kodur dɛ ɔsãe no,
Moses hyɛɛ Levifo a wɔsoa Ewuradze n'ahyɛmudaka no, dɛ,
Hom mfa mbranwoma yi, na hom mfa nto Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn n'ahyɛmudaka no ho, ma ɔnko hɔ nyɛ dase ntsia wo.
Na minyim w'etuatsew, nye w'akɔnkye: Hwɛ, meda ho ara menye hom tse ase ndɛ da yi mpo, na hom ayɛ etuatsewfo wɔ Ewuradze do yi; na sosoa mo wu ekyir ɛ?
Hom mboaboa hom ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu mpanyimfo nyinara, nye hom ahwɛdofo ano mbra me nykɛn, ma menkã nsɛm yi wɔ hɔn aso mu, na memfrɛ ɔsor nye asaase ma wondzi hɔn dase.

Na minyim dɛ mo wu ekyir no ɔsɛɛ na hom bɛsɛɛ homho, na hom adan efi ɔkwan a mahyɛ hom no do; na mbusu bɛba hom do nda a odzi ekyir no mu; osiandɛ hom bɛyɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, dze nam hom nsaano edwuma do eyi no ebufuw.
Na Moses kãa ndwom yi mu nsɛm wɔ Israel bagua no nyinara asomu dze kodur dɛ ɔsãe.
32: Ɔsor, hom nyɛ aso, na merebɛkasa; na wɔmma asaase ntsie m'anomu nsɛm:
Me nkyerɛkyerɛ bɔsosɔ dɛ nyankom, me kasaa bogugu dɛ ɔbɔsu; dɛ nkyɛkyɛr do nsumpetsema, nye haban do nsutɔree:
Na mobɔbɔ Ewuradze dzin akyerɛ: Hom mfa kɛseyɛ mma hɛn Nyankopɔn,
ɔbotan no, n'edwuma dzi mu; na n'akwan nyinara yɛ atsɛmbu: Nyankopɔn nokwardzifo a, na onnyi emumuyɛ, ɔyɛ pɛrpɛr na ɔtsen.
Woedzi no asɛmbɔn, wɔnnyɛ ne mba, hɔn dzɛmdzi a; ebusuasantsen kɔntɔnkye a wɔakyea a.
Ana Ewuradze na hom nye no dzi no dɛm yi, ɔman nkwasea a wɔnnyɛ enyansafo? Ana nnyɛ ɔho nye w'egya a ɔawo wo bi a? Ɔno na ɔayɛ wo na oetsintsim wo.
Kaa tsetsentserde nda no, dwen ebusuasantsen pii no hɔn mfe ho: Bisa w'egya, na ɔnkyerɛ wo; wo mpanyimfo, na wɔnkã nkyerɛ wo.
Aber a ɔsorsornyi no memaa amanaman hɔn egyapadze no, aber a ɔpaapaa nyimpa mba mu no, osisii aman hɔn ahe, dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba hɔn dodow tse.
Na Ewuradze ne kyɛfa nye ne man; Jacob nye n'egyapadze kyɛfa.
Ohun no wɔ sar asaase do, na kwaa tuntun sar predede do nkekabowa mu; otwaa no ho hyiae, ɔhwɛɛ no do yie, ɔkoraa no do dɛ n'enyiwa kyesua:
Dɛ mbrɛ ɔkɔr huenyan ne birebuw, na otu bɔ ne ba do faafaa no, ɔtsɛɛw ne ntsaban mu, ɔfaa hɔn no, ɔsoaa hɔn wɔ ne ntɛkyerɛ do no:
Ewuradze nkotoo na ogyaa no na Onyame nanaben bi annka no ho,
ɔmaa ɔfaa asaase mbea sorɔnsorɔm do tutui kɔree, na odzii haban mu ndɔbaa; na ɔmaa ohwieew ewo fii ɔbotan mu, nye ngo fii ɔtwerɛbo botan mu;
Anantwi numfonsungo, nye nguan numfonsu, nye nguambaa seradze, nye Bashan nnyɛmbowa mu ndwanyin, nye mpɔnkye, nye ewifua ntan mu seradze; na enoom esikyireamba mu bɔgya wenyin.
Na Jeshurun yɛɛ ɔbran, na ɔtoow ntsia: Ayɛ bran, ayɛ kɛse, wo mu ayɛ dur: Nna ɔpoow Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛɛ no no, na obuu no nkwagye botan no tootooba.
Wɔdze enyame nanaben yii no nyinkun, wɔdze ekyiwadze yii no ebufuw.
Wɔbɔɔ afɔr maa abosom a wɔnnyɛ Nyame, dze maa enyame a wonnyim hɔn, dze maa enyame fofor a wɔbaa nkyinkyirii, dza hom engyanom ennsuro hɔn no.
Ɔbotan a ɔwoo wo no anndwen no do, na wo werɛ efir Nyame a ɔkyeem wo no.
Na Ewuradze hunii, na okyiir hɔn, wɔ ne mbabanyin nye ne mbabaa ho ehi ntsi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, mibeyi m'enyim esuma hɔn, mobɔhwɛ mbrɛ hɔn ewiei bɛyɛ: Na wɔyɛ ebusuasantsen kɔntɔnkye, mba a hɔn mu nnyi gyedzi.
Wɔdze dza ɔnnyɛ Onyame eyi me nyinkun: Wɔdze hɔn egyangyandze eyi me ebufuw: Na medze hɔn a wɔnnyɛ ɔman mibeyi hɔn nyinkun; medze ɔman nkwasea bi mibeyi hɔn ebufuw.
Na ogya adzɛw wɔ m'ebufuw mu, na ɔrehyew ekodu samanadze ase, na ɔremen asaase nye no ndɔbaa, na ɔato mbepɔw mfapem mu ogya.
Mobɔboa mbusu ano megu hɔn do; mobɔhwer m'egyen-menaba wɔ hɔn do:
Ɔkɔm bɔfɔn hɔn, na ahohur hyeredede nye ɔsɛɛ wenwen bɛmen hɔn; na mobɔsoma mbowa sē ma wɔaaba hɔn do, nye huntuma mu nweaweambowa bɔr.
Abɔntsen do na nkrantsee bohwim, Adankyir so nketsenketse a; ɔbɛsɛɛ aberantsɛ nye ɔbaabun nyina, Enumfoanoba nye nyimpa a oefuw gon nyina.
Mesee dɛ nkyɛ mobɔbɔ hɔn apetse ekyirkyir, nkyɛ mebɛma hɔn nkaa tun do etwa efi nyimpa mu:
Sɛ nnyɛ ɔtamfo ehiyi na musuroi a, bɛyɛ na hɔn ayɛfo afom me ndwenee, bɛyɛ na wɔase dɛ, hɛn nsa na akrɔn, na nnyɛ Ewuradze na ɔayɛ iyi nyinara.
Na wɔyɛ aman a egyinatu abɔ hɔn, na ntseasee bi nnyi hɔn mu.
Ao kɛtseankyɛ woeehu nyansa, na wɔaatse iyi ase, na nkyɛ wɔaadwen hɔn ewiei ekyir no ho!
Ɔbaako bɛyɛ dɛn etsiw apem, na beenu akã mpemdu egu, gyedɛ hɔn ɔbotan atɔn hɔn ana, na Ewuradze eyi hɔn ama ana?
Na hɔn ɔbotan nntse dɛ hɛn ɔbotan, na hɛn atamfo ankasa mpo nye atsɛmbuafo.
Na hɔn wenyindua fi Sodom wenyindua mu, na ofi Gomorrah haban mu: Hɔn esikyireamba yɛ bɔr esikyireamba, hɔn esiaw yɛ wenwen:
Hɔn nsã yɛ dragon bɔr, nye nhurutsia owubɔr dzendzen.
Ana wɔnnkora iyi do wɔ me nkyɛn, wɔnnsɔw ano wɔ m'akoradze mu bi a?
Awerdzi yɛ medze, akatua so, aber a hɔn anan bɛpatser: Na hɔn mbusu da abɛn, na ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ dɛ ɔba hɔn do no bɛba ntsɛntsɛm.
Na Ewuradze bobu ne man atsɛn, na oenu noho wɔ no nkowaa ntsi; aber a obohu dɛ hɔn ahoɔdzen asã, na nyia woesianka no anaa woegyaa no bi nnyi hɔ bio,
Na ɔbɛse dɛ, henfa na hɔn enyame no wɔ, ɔbotan a wɔdze hɔn werɛ hyɛɛ mu no;
Hɔn a wodzi hɔn okum-afɔr seradze, na wɔnom hɔn ɔnom-afɔr nsã no a? Ma monsoɛr mbɔboa hom, ma wɔnyɛ hom ntwitwagye.
Afei hom nhu dɛ emi, mara nye no, na onyame bi nnka mo ho: Emi na muku, na mema nkwa; mipira, na mesa yarba: Na obi nnyi hɔ a obotum agye efi me nsamu.
Na mema me nsa do wɔ ɔsor, na mese dɛ, dɛ metse ase daa yi,
Sɛ mesew me nkrantsee nyinamnyinam no, na me nsa suo atsɛmbu mu a; mibedzi m'atamfo do wer, na metua hɔn a wɔtan me kaw.
Mebɛma bɔgya abow m'egyenmenaba, na me nkrantsee edzi nam; atɔfo nye ndɔmmumfo bɔgyaa, ofi ɔtamfo edzikamfo itsir do.
Amanaman, hom nye ne man ndzi dɛw: Na obedzi no nkowaa bɔgyaa ho wer, na ɔdze awerdzi etua n'ayɛfo kaw, na ɔapata ama n'asaase ama ne man.
Na Moses baa bɛkãa ndwom yi mu nsɛm nyinara wɔ ɔman no asomu, ɔno, nye Nun ne babanyin Hoshea.
Na Moses wiee nsɛm yi nyinara kã kyerɛɛ Israel nyinara:
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mfa hom akoma nsi nsɛm a miridzi hom ho dase ndɛ da yi nyinara do; ɔno na hom mfa nhyɛ hom mba, dɛ wɔndwen do ndzi mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara do.
Na ɔnnyɛ asɛnhun mma hom; osiandɛ ɔyɛ hom nkwa, na asɛm yi do na hom nam bɛma hom nda awar wɔ asaase, mbrɛ hom rukotwa Jordan akɛfa no do.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses da no ara dɛ,
Kɔfow bepɔw Abarim yi, kɔ bepɔw Nebo a ɔwɔ Moab asaase do, wɔ Jericho tsentsendo no; na hwɛ Canaan asaase a medze merema Israelmba dɛ enyadze no:
na wu wɔ bepɔw no a erofow akɔ no do, na wɔmboaboa wo nkɔ wo nkorɔfo nkyɛn; dɛ mbrɛ wo nua Aaron wui wɔ bepɔw Horeb do, na wɔboaboaa no kɔr no nkorɔfo nkyɛn no:
osiandɛ hom foom me wɔ Israelmba mu wɔ Meribah nsu a ɔwɔ Kadesh, wɔ Zin sar do no ho; osiandɛ hom annyɛ me krɔnkrɔn wɔ Israelmba mu.
Na ibohu asaase no wɔ w'enyim; na mbom eronnkɔ asaase a medze merema Israelmba no do hɔ.
33: Na iyi nye nhira a Onyame nyimpa Moses dze hyiraa Israelmba ansaana oruwu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze fi Sinai bae, na ɔsoɛree fi Seir maa hɔn; ɔhyerɛnee fi bepɔw Paran do, na ofi akrɔnkrɔmfo mpedu mpedu mu bae. Na n'enyimfa wɔ ogyahye mbra ma hɔn.
Nyew, ɔdɔ aman; n'ahotseweefo nyinara wɔ wo nsamu: Na wɔtsenatsenaa famu wɔ w'anan ho; obiara bɛgye wo nsɛm ato mu.
Moses hyɛɛ hɛn mbra, Jacob bagua egyapadze.
Na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen wɔ Jeshurun, aber a ɔman no mu etsitsir hyiae, Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara bɔ mu no.
Ma Reuben nnya nkwa, na mma onnwu; naaso ma ne mbanyin nyɛ ketseaba.
Na iyi nye Judah nhyira: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, tsie Judah ne ndze, na fa no kɔ fie no nkorɔfo nkyɛn: Ma ne nsa nsõ no so.
Na Levi ho dze ɔsee dɛ, wo Thummim nye wo Urim wɔ wo nyamesuronyi no hɔ, nyia esɔɔ no hwɛe wɔ Massah no, nye no hamee wɔ Meribah nsu ho no;
Nyia ɔsee wɔ n'egya, nye ne nã ho dɛ, munnhun no; nkyii so ɔmmpen no nuanom do no, na onnyim nankasa ne mba so no, na onnyim nankasa ne mba so no, na wɔadwen w'asɛm do: Na woedzi w'ahyɛmu do.
Wɔdze w'atsɛmbu bɛkyerɛ Jacob, na wo mbra akyerɛ Israel: Wɔdze eduhuam bɔto w'enyim, na ɔhyew-afɔr mu ato w; afɔrmbukyia do.
Ewuradze, hyira n'ahoɔdzen, na ma me ne nsaano edwuma nsɔ w'enyi: Bobɔ hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia no no hɔn ndwonku, na hɔn a wɔtan no, mma wɔaannsoɛr bio.
Benjamin ho dze ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze no dɔfo bɛtsena ne nkyɛn dwudwoodwo; ɔkata no do adzekyee tsentsen nyinara, na ɔtse n'abatsir ntamu.
Na Joseph ho dze, ɔsee dɛ Ewuradze nhyira n'asaase; ɔmma ɔsor ndzepa, ɔbɔsu, nye bun a ɔda daadzetsirmu nedze,
Nye ewia no nduadzewa mu ndzepa, nye dza abosoom ma ofifir mu ndzepa, nye tsetse mbepɔw do adze tsitsir.
Nye daa nkoko do ndzepa,
Nye asaase nye ne mãyɛ mu ndzepa, nye nyia ɔtsenaa kwaa mu n'enyisɔ: Ma nhyira no ɔmbra Joseph n'etsifi, nye no nuanom mu nyia woeyi no esi nkyɛn no n'etsifi pampamu.

Ne nantwisaa abakan, tumdzi dzi wɔ no; na n'ambɛn yɛ ɔnantwibɔyafo ambɛn: ɔno na ɔdze bosunsun aman nyinara, mekyerɛ asaase n'ano n'ano: Na hɔn nye Ephraim mpedu mpedu no, na hɔn nye Manasseh mpempem no, na hɔn nye Manasseh mpempem no,
Na Zebulun, ma w'enyi ngye wɔ w'edzifir mu; na, Issachar, wɔ w'asesee mu.
Wɔbɛfrɛ aman akɔ bepɔw do; ehɔ na wɔbɔbɔ tsenenee okumafɔr: Na woehwiew epo no mbordo no, Nye anhwea mu akoradze a ohuntsa no.
Na Gad ho dze mu: Ɔsee dɛ, nhyira akã nyia ɔtsew Gad ɔtsetsew abasa, nyew, etsifi pampamu.
Na osiesiee dza odzi kan no maa noho, na hɔ na wɔakora mbrahyɛfo ne kyɛfa; na ɔnye ɔman no mu etsitsir bae, na ɔyɛɛ Ewuradze ne tseneneedze, nye ne ntsɛmbu wɔ Israel nkyɛn.
Na Dan ho dze ɔsee dɛ, Dan yɛ ogyata ne ba a ohuruw fi Bashan.
Na Naphtali ho dze ɔsee dɛ, Naphtali a enyisɔ amee no, Ewuradze ne nyira ahyɛ no mã: Fa anee nye pomu afamu asaase no fa,
Na Asher ho dze ɔsee dɛ, wɔmfa mba nhyira Asher; wɔmma ɔnyɛ nyia ɔsɔ enyi mma no nuanom, na wɔmma ɔmfa n'anan mbɔ ngo mu.
W'adaban nyɛ dadze nye boran; na dɛ mbrɛ wo nda tse no, dɛmara so na w'ahoɔden nyɛ.
Jeshurun, obi nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ onyame a otutu nam sor dzi boa wo, na n'akɛseyɛ wɔ wimu.
Ɔdomankoma Nyankopɔn nye wo tsenabew: Na ase na daa daa abasa wɔ: Na ɔpaam ɔtamfo no wɔ w'enyim, Na ɔsee dɛ, sɛɛ hɔn.
Na Israel retsena dwudwoodwo, Jacob nsubura no ankotonoo, wɔ eburow nye nsã asaase do; nyew, no sor so sosɔw ɔbɔsu.

Osiarfo nye wo, Israel: Woana ne ɔnye wo sɛ, ɔman a Ewuradze agye no nkwa, woana na ɔnye wo sɛ, ɔman a Ewuradze agye no nkwa, wo mboa akokyɛm, na ɔno wo kɛseyɛ nkrantsee! Na w'atamfo bɛbrɛ hɔnho adze ama wo; na ibetsiatsia hɔn mbea sorɔm no do.
34: Na Moses fii Moab tɛtɛr mu fowee kɔr bepɔw Nebo do, wɔ Pisgah etsifi a ɔwɔ Jericho tsentsendo. Na Ewuradze kyerɛɛ no Gilead asaase nyinara, ɔdze kodu Dan:
nye Naphtali nyinara, nye Ephraim nye Manasseh asaase, nye Judah asaase nyinara, ɔdze kodu ekyirkyir epo no ho;
nye Epomu, nye Tɛtɛrmu, nkyiresua kurow Jericho ɔbɔn no, ɔdze kodu Zoar.
Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, iyi nye asaase a mekãa ho ntam mekyerɛɛ Abraham, Isaac, nye Jacob dɛ, w'asefo na medze mebɛma hɔn no: Mama wo kwan dɛ fa w'enyiwa hwɛ, na hɔ dze eronnkɔ.
Nna Ewuradze n'akowaa Moses wuu hɔ wɔ Moab asaase do, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm tse.
Na osiee no wɔ ɔbɔn no mu wɔ Moab asaase do wɔ Beth-peor tsentsendo na n'adakamaa dze nyimpa biara nnyim dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na aber a Moses wui no na oedzi mfe ɔha eduonu: N'ahoɔdzen so do ennhuan.
Na Israelmba sūi maa Moses wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu osū nda no bɔɔ adze.
Na nyansa sunsum hyɛɛ Nun ne babanyin Joshua mã: Na Israelmba tsiee no, na wɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
Na ofitsi aber no nkɔnhyɛnyi biara nnsoɛree wɔ Israel mu a ɔtse dɛ Moses a Ewuradze nyim no enyim nye enyim;
wɔ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze nyinara, a Ewuradze somaa no dɛ ɔmfa nkɛyɛ Pharaoh, nye no nkowaa nyinara, nye n'asaase nyinara wɔ Egypt asaase do no afamu:
Nye nsa a ɔyɛ dzen nyinara, nye nketsenketse a ɔsõ nyinara a Moses yɛe no wɔ Israel nyinara enyim no mu.

1: Ɔsɛnkafo, Dayid ba, Jerusalemhen no, ne nsɛm.
Egyangyandze mu egyangyandze, ɔsɛnkafo no na ɔse; egyangyandze mu egyangyandze, ne nyinara egyangyandze a.
Mfaso bɛn na ɔdasanyi nya wɔ ne berɛ a ɔberɛ wɔ wi ase mu?
Ebusuasantsen kor kɔ, na ebusuasantsen kor so ba; na asaase tsim hɔ daa.
Ewia so pue, na ewia kɔtɔ, na ɔgye ntsɛm kɔ bea a ofi do pue no do.
Mfar bɔ kɔ pomu afamu, na ɔdan dze fa kwaamu afamu; odzi adandan daa wɔ ne nkyekyɛmu mu: Na mfar san bio kɔ n’aprɔwbɔmu.
Esutsen nyinara pem kɔ po mu, naaso po nnyɛ mã; fakor a esutsen pem kɔ no, hɔ ara so na ɔkɔ bio.
Adze nyinara mu wɔ ɔberɛ mã; ɔdasanyi nnkotum kã: Enyiwa mmee adzehwɛ, na asowa so nnhyɛ otsie mã.
Dza aba noara na ɔbɛba; na dza wɔayɛ noara na wɔbɛyɛ: Na adze fofor biara nnyi wi ase.
Ana biribi wɔ hɔ a adasa wɔkã wo ho dɛ, hwɛ, iyidze fofor a? Ɔaba dada ana, wɔ tsetseber a odzi hɛn enyim no mu.
Nkaa bi nnyi hɔ ma ebusuasantsen ebusuasantsen kandzifo no; na ebusuasantsen ebusuasantsen ekyirdzifo a wɔbɛba no so, wonnkenya nkaa, wɔ hɔn a wobedzi hɔn ekyir no mu.
Emi, mara ɔsɛnkafo, midzii Israel do hen wɔ Jerusalem.
Na medze m’akoma mae dɛ mobɔhwehwɛ na mehu dza wɔyɛ no ɔsor ase nyinara mu: Ɔyɛ ɔberɛ-dwuma a Nyankopɔn ama adasamba dɛ wɔmfa nsūasua yɛ.
Mehu dwuma a wodzi no wi ase nyinara; na, hwɛ, ne nyinara yɛ egyangyandze nye aahowko.
Dza akyea no, wonnkotum atsen no: Na dza efi mu no, wonnkotum dze afora akan.
Menye m'akoma twetwee nkɔmbɔ, dɛ, hwɛ menya nyansa kɛse akyɛn hɔn a wodzii m'enyim nyinara wɔ Jerusalem: Nyew, m'akoma enya nyansa nye nyimdzee nhunii.
Na medze m'akoma maa dɛ mubohu nyansa, na mehu abɔdam nye nkwaseasɛm: Iyi so muhun dɛ ɔyɛ aahowko.
Na nyansa dodow mu wɔ awerɛhow dodow: Na nyia ɔdɔr nyimdzee no, ɔdɔr awerɛhow.
2: Mesee wɔ m’akoma mu dɛ. Afei bra ma memfa enyigye monsɔ wo monhwɛ ɛ; na ibenya wo ndzepa edzi: Na, hwɛ, iyiara so egyangyandze a.
Mesee serew ho dɛ, ɔabo dam: Na enyigye ho dɛ, ebɛnadze na ɔreyɛ yi?

Mepɛnsapɛnsaa m’akoma mu mbrɛ medze nsã mebɛgye mo honam enyi, m’akoma da ho ara dze nyansa rekyerɛ me kwan, na meesuo nkwaseasɛm mu araa ekodu dɛ mubohu dza oye ma adasamba dɛ wɔbɛyɛ no wi ase hɔn nkwa nda nyinara mu.
Meyɛɛ mo ndwuma akɛse akɛse; misisii adan mefae; metsetsɛɛw wenyin nture mefae;
meyeyɛɛ nture na enyigyekwaa mefae, na metsetsɛɛw mu ndua a ɔsow eduaba horow nyinara;
meyeyɛɛ nsutaae mefae, dɛ medze no mu nsu bi mubogugu kwaa a wɔnyɛn ndua wɔ mu no do:
Mototɔɔ nkowaa nye mfonabaa, na minyaa fienyimpa; eso minyaa anantwi nye nguan ekuwekuw akɛsenara seen hɔn a wodzii m’enyim kan wɔ Jerusalem nyinara:
Moboaboaa dwetɛ nye sika so ano mefae, na ahemfo nye amansin akoradze soronko: Minyaa mbarimba nye mbaa adwontofo, na adasamba hɔn enyigyedze, nwewefo burigyaa.
Nna meyɛɛ ɔkɛse, na meyɛɛ ɔkɛse mbordo seen hɔn a wodzii m’enyim wɔ Jerusalem nyinara: Eso me nyansaa tsenaa mo mu.
Na dza m’enyiwa hwehwɛe biara, mammfa mennsuma no: Mammfa enyigye biara mannkam m’akoma, na m’akoma dzii ehurusi wɔ me berɛ nyinara ntsi; na iyi nye me berɛ nyinara ho kyɛfa.
Ɔno na mohwɛɛ ndwuma a me nsa yɛe nyinara, na ɔberɛ a meberɛe meyɛe no: Na, hwɛ, ne nyinara yɛ egyangyandze nye aahowko, na mfaso biara nnyi wi ase.
Na medaan moho dɛ morohwɛ nyansa, na abɔdam nye nkwaseasɛm: Na ebɛn na nyimpa a obedzi ɔhen kyir beba no botum yɛ? Mekyere adze a woewie yɛ dada no.
Nna muhun dɛ sãa nyansa mu wɔ mfaso sen nkwaseasɛm, dɛ mbrɛ kan mu wɔ mfaso sen sum no.
Onyansafo n'enyiwa wɔ ne tsir mu, na ɔkwasea nantsew sum mu: Na muhunii so dɛ esian kor no ara na osian hɔn nyinara.

Ɔno na mekãe wɔ m’akoma mu dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ oba kwasea do no, mbrɛ ɔbɛba mo so mo do ara nye no; na ebɛnadze ntsi mbɔ na muhun nyansa meseen binom? Ɔno na mekãe wɔ m’akoma mu, dɛ iyiara mpo egyangyandze a.
Na nkaa biara nnyi hɔ daa mma onyansafo, dɛ ɔkwasea ara so; ɔnam dɛ nda a ɔbɛba no mu na werɛ efir hɔn dada. Na hwɛ mbrɛ onyansafo dua wu dɛ ɔkwasea ara so!
Dɛm ntsi na mikyiir nkwa; osiandɛ edwuma a wodzi no wɔ wi ase no ɔyɛɛ me awerɛhow: Osiandɛ ne nyinara yɛ egyangyandze nye aahowko.
Na mikyiir me berɛ nyinara a meberɛe wo wi ase: Ɔnam dɛ otwar dɛ medan migya nyimpa a obedzi m’ekyir aba no.
Na woana nyim dɛ sɛ ɔbɛyɛ onyansafo o, anaa ɔkwasea o? Naaso obedzi me berɛ nyinara a maberɛ na makyerɛ mu nyansa wɔ wi ase no no do. Iyiara so egyangyandze a.
Hɔn nyinara wɔkɔ bea kor do; hɔn nyinara wofi huntuma mu, na hɔn nyinara wɔsan kɔ huntuma mu bio.
Na nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a ɔdze nyansa, nye nyimdzee, nye enyigye berɛ; naaso nyimpa a ɔmmberɛ mu bi na ɔbɛdan egya no dɛ ne kyɛfa. Iyiara so egyangyandze nye mbusu kɛse a.
Na ebɛnadze ara na nyimpa nya no wɔ ne berɛ nyinara, n’akoma n'aperdzi a ɔdze berɛ wɔ wi ase mu?
Na ne nda nyinara awerɛhow ara nko, na ne berɛ-edwuma yaw a; ampaara, anago mpo n’akoma nntɔ ne yamu. Iyiara so egyangyandze a.
Biribi papa biara nnyi hɔ ma nyimpa sen dɛ obedzidzi na ɔanom, na ɔama ne kra edzi ndzepa wɔ ne berɛ mu. Iyiara so muhunii, dɛ Nyankopɔn nsamu na ofi.
Na woana ara na obenya edzi, na woana ara na n'enyi bɛgye asen emi mara?

Na Nyankopɔn dze nyansa, nye nyimdzee, nye dɛw ma nyia ɔsɔ n'enyi no: Na ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi dze, ɔma no ɔberɛ-edwuma a ɔdze bɔboaboa na ɔahyɛ no kuw, ama ɔdze aama nyia ɔsɔ n'enyi no. Iyiara so egyangyandze na aahowko a.
3: Adze biara wɔ ne hyɛber, na asɛm biara wɔ n’aber, wɔ wi ase:
Awoo n’aber, na owu n'aber; aber a wɔtsɛw, na aber a wotu dza wɔtsɛw no;
aber a woku, na aber a wɔsa yarba; aber a wobubu gu famu, na aber a wɔma do si;
aber a wosū, na aber a wɔserew; aber a wogyam, na aber a wɔsaw;
aber a wɔtotow abo gu, na aber a wɔboaboa ano; aber a wɔyɛ etuu, na aber a wogyaa etuuyɛ mu;
aber a wɔhwehwɛ adze, na aber a wɔyew adze; aber a wosie adze, na aber a wɔtow kyen;
aber a wosunsuan mu, na aber a wɔpempam; aber a wɔyɛ komm, na aber a wɔkasa;
aber a wɔdɔ, na aber a wɔtan; ɔsa n’aber, na asomdwee n’aber.
Mfaso bɛn na nyia ɔyɛ edwuma nya no wɔ dza ɔberɛ mu no mu?
Mehu ɔberɛ-edwuma a Nyankopɔn dze ama adasamba dɛ wɔmfa nsūasua yɛ.
Ɔayɛ adze nyina fɛɛfɛw wɔ ne ber mu: Eso ɔdze esumadze ahyɛ hɔn akoma mu, ama nyimpa nntum nnhu edwuma a Nyankopɔn ayɛ mu, ofitsi ahyɛse dze kodu ewiei mpo.
Minyim dɛ biribi papa biara nnyi hɔ ma hɔn, sen dɛ wobedzi ehurusi, na wɔayɛ dza oye aber a wɔdze tse ase nyina.
Na eso dɛ nyimpa biara bedzidzi na ɔanom, na oenya ne ber nyinara mu ndzepa oedzi no, ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn akyɛdze.
Minyim dɛ biribiara a Nyankopɔn yɛ no, ɔnoara na ɔbɛtsena hɔ daa: Wɔnnkɛfa hweeara akã ho, eso wonnkeyi do biribiara, na Nyankopɔn na ɔayɛ, ama adasa eesuro wɔ n’enyim.
Dza ɔwɔ ho yi, ɔwɔ hɔ dadaada ana; na dza ɔbɛba no, oenya aba dadaada ana: Na Nyankopɔn hwehwɛ dza etwa mu asen no bio.
Na nkyii so muhun wɔ wi ase, wɔ atsɛmbu bea do, dɛ emumuyɛ wɔ hɔ; na ndzeyɛtsenenee bea do, dɛ emumuyɛ wɔ hɔ.
Mekãe wɔ m’akoma mu dɛ, osian adasamba ntsi a, ama Nyankopɔn aasɔ hɔn ahwɛ, na ama woeehu dɛ hɔnankasa wɔtse dɛ mbowa ara.
Mekãe wɔ m’akoma mu dɛ, Nyankopɔn bobu atseneneefo na emumuyɛfo atsɛn, osiandɛ ɔahyɛ da ma tsirmpow na ndzeyɛɛ biara.

Na dza ɔba adasamba do no ara na ɔba mbowa do; adze kor pɛr ara na ɔba hɔn do: Mbrɛ ɔbaako wu no, mbrɛ ɔbaako so wu ara nye no; nyew, ahom kor na hɔn nyinara wɔwɔ; na nyimpa nnyi ɔkyɛn biara a ɔdze kyɛn mbowa: Na ne nyinara egyangyandze a.
Hɔn nyinara wɔkɔ bea kor do; hɔn nyinara wofi huntuma mu, na hɔn nyinara wɔsan kɔ huntuma mu bio.
Woana nyim ɔdasanyi no sunsum dɛ ɔfow kɔ sor na abowa sunsum dɛ osian kɔ asaase do famu?
Dɛm ntsi muhun dɛ papa biara nnyi hɔ, sen dɛ dasanyi bedzi n'edwuma mu ehurusi; na ne kyɛpɛn ara nye no: Na woana dze no bɛsan aba ebohu dza obedzi n’ekyir aba?
4: Nna mesanee na muhun haw nyina a wɔyɛ no wɔ wi ase: Na hwɛ, hɔn a wɔhaw hɔn no hɔn nyinsuwa, na wonnyi ɔwerɛkyekyefo biara; na hɔn nhyɛdofo no nsamu wo tum, na wonnyi ɔwerɛkyekyefo.
Dɛm ntsi mekamfoo ewufo a woewuwu dada no seen enyikamfo a wɔda ho tse ase no;
nyew, nyia mubuu no bi seen beenu yi nyina nye nyia onnyae mmbae, onnyae nnhun edwuma bɔn a wɔyɛ no wɔ wi ase.
Nna muhun ɔberɛ nye yieyɛ edwuma, dɛ sãa iyi ntsi na nyimpa n’enyi ber ne nyɛnko. Iyiara so egyangyandze na aahowko a.
Ɔkwasea pompon ne nsa hyehyɛ mu, na odzi nankasa no honam.
Nsapuw mã a asomdwee kã ho no, oye sen nsapuw amaama ebien a ɔberɛ nye aahowko kã ho.
Nna mesanee na muhun egyangyandze a ɔwɔ wi ase.

Obi wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ ankonam, na onnyi obi kã no ho; nyew, onnyi ba anaa nua; naaso ne berɛ nyinara nnyi ewiei, na ahonya so mmee n’enyiwa. Ɔkã dɛ, woana mbɔ na meberɛ na mekam me kra ndzepa mama no? Iyiara so egyangyandze a; nyew, ɔyɛ oberɛ-edwuma dzendzen.
Beenu ye sen ɔbaako; osiandɛ wonya hɔn berɛ mu akatua pa.
Na sɛ wɔhwe ase a, ɔbaako bɛma ne nyɛnko do: Na ɔbaakofo a ɔhwe ase a onnyi obi a ɔbɛma no do no, ondue.
Bio so, sɛ wɔnam beenu nye no bedzi esi, na ahoma a ɔpam ho ebiasa no, ɔnntsew ntsɛntsɛm.
Ɔfanyim aberantsɛ hianyi onyansafo, sen ɔhen akɔdaa ɔkwasea a onnhu mbrɛ onsi ntsie afotu bio.
Na ofi efiadze na obedzii hen; nyew, n’ahenman mu ara mpo na wɔwoo no hianyi.
Muhun atseasefo nyinara a wɔnenam wi ase, dɛ wɔnye aberantsɛ a otsia ebien a obegyinaa n’ananmu no wɔ hɔ.
Ɔman no nyinara, mpo hɔn a odzii hɔn do hen no nyinara, wonnyi ewiei, naaso hɔn a wobedzi n’ekyir aba no hɔn enyi renngye no ho. Ampaara iyiara so egyangyandze na aahowko a.
5: Sɛ erokoɔNyame fie a, weɔn w’anan; na erebɛn eketsie, oye sen dɛ ebɔbɔ nkwasea afor: Na hɔndze, wonnyim dɛ wɔbɔ mbusu.
Mma mma w’ano nuyɛ tobɛrtobɛr, na mma mma w’akoma mmpɛ ntsɛm nnkasa Nyame enyim; na Nyame wɔ sor, na ɔwo so ewɔ ase: Dɛm ntsi ma wo kasaa nyɛ nkumankuma.
Na adaaso dze edwuma dodow ba; na ɔkwasea ne ndze dze nsɛm dodow ba.
Sɛ ebɔ Nyame anohoba a, mma nnkyinkyim no tua ho: Tua dza ebɔ anohoba no.
Ɔfanyim dɛ ennkɔbɔ anohoba, sen dɛ ebɔbɔ anohoba na innkotua.
Mma mma w’ano kwan ma ɔmma wo honam nnyɛ bɔn; eso mma nnse ɔbɔfo no dɛ mfom a: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na Nyame no bo bofuw wo ndze, na ɔasɛɛ wo nsaano edwuma?
Na dɛm na ɔnam adaaso dodow na egyangyandze na nsɛm pii do ɔba: Nyame mbom na ɔwo edze suro no.
Sɛ ihu ɔbɔbɔfo ne haw, na atsɛmbu na pɛrpɛr enyidan enyiber mu wɔ ɔmansin biara mu a, mma mma dɛm adze no nnyɛ wo nwanwa: Na obi a ɔbɔ abɔso no do no, noara ɔrohwɛ; na abɔso bi wɔ hɔ sen hɔn.
Nkyii so asaase do mfaso wɔ hɔ ma nyimpa nyinara: Asaase som ɔhen nankasa.
Nyia ɔpɛ dwɛɛtɛɛ no, dwɛɛtɛɛ nnkɛmee no; na nyia ɔpɛ adze dodow no, ndɔbaa nnkɛmee no: Iyi so egyangyandze a.
Aber a ndzepa adɔɔ so no, hɔn a wodzi no so dɔɔ sõ: Na mfaso bɛn na ɔwɔ hɔ ma ndzɛmba no wura, dɛ ɔdze n’enyiwa bɔhwɛ ara?
Odwumayɛfo ne nda yɛ dɛw, sɛ odzidzi kakra o, kɛse o: Na obirempɔn ne mee dze, ɔnnkɛma no kwan ma ɔada.
Mbusu yayaw bi wɔ hɔ a mehu no wɔ wi ase, ɔno nye yi; ahonya a no wura kora do ma nankasa no mbusu:
Na eguadzi bɔn ma ahonya no sɛɛ; na sɛ ɔawo ɔba a biribiara nnka ne nsamu.
Dɛ mbrɛ ofi ne nã ne yamu bae no, adagyaw ara so na ɔdze bɛsan akɔ dɛ mbrɛ ɔbae no, na onnkenya ne berɛ mu hweeara, dɛ ɔdze bekitsa akɔ.
Na iyi so mbusu yayaw a, dɛ mbrɛ ɔnam bae no ara pɛr, dɛmara so na ɔbɔkɔ: Na mfaso bɛn na ɔyɛ ma no dɛ ɔberɛ ɔberɛhun?
Na ne nda nyinara mu so odzidzi wɔ sum mu, na no bo fuw dodow na onya yarba na yamugya.
Hwɛ, dza mehu dɛ oye na ɔyɛ fɛw nye dɛ obi bedzidzi na ɔanom, na oenya edziyie wɔ ne berɛ a ɔaberɛ wɔ wi ase nymara mu, no nkwa nda nyinara a Nyame dze ama no no: Na iyi nye ne kyɛpɛn.
Nyimpa biara so a Nyame ama no ahonya na ahodze, na ɔama no tum a ɔdze dzi bi, na ɔfa ne kyɛfa, na odzi ne berɛ mu ehurusi; iyi nye Nyame akyɛdze.
Na ɔnnkɛkaa no nkwa nda pii; osiandɛ Nyame ebua no wɔ n’akoma ne dɛw mu.
6: Mbusu bi wɔ hɔ a mehu wɔ wi ase, na ɔhyɛ adasa do:
Nyimpa a Nyame ma no ahonya, ahodze, na enyidzi, na dza ɔyɛ no akɔndo mu biara mmbɔ ne kra, naaso Nyankopɔn mma no tum a ɔdze bedzi bi, mbom ɔhɔho na odzi; iyi egyangyandze a, na oyɛ yarba bɔn.
Sɛ nyimpa wo ɔha, odzi mfe pii ara ma ne mfe dɔɔ sõ, na mbom papa ammee ne kra, na nkyii so onnya efunsie a; mekã, dɛ ɔpon-ba ye sen no:
Na ɔnodze, ɔba no egyangyandze mu, na ɔkɔ no sum mu, na sum akata ne dzin do;
nkyii so onnhun ewia na onnyim so; iyi ɔwɔ ahomgye sen kor no:
Nyew, kaansa odzi mfe apem mbɔho mpo a, onnya mu yiedzi biara: Aso nnye fakor na hɔn nyinara wɔkɔ?
Nyimpa ne berɛ nyinara, n'anomu ntsi a, naaso n’akɔndɔ mmee.
Na mfaso bɛn na onyansafo wɔ ma ɔkyɛn ɔkwasea? Anaadɛ ebɛn na hianyi a onyim atseasefo enyim nantsew wɔ?
Ɔfanyim enyiwa n’adzehu sen akɔndɔ a okyin. Iyi so egyangyandze na aahowko.
Dza ɔaba biara, wɔato no dzin dada ana, na wonnyim no dɛ nyimpa a: Eso onnkotum ɔnye nyia no ho yɛ dzen sen no efimfen.
Ɔnam dɛ ndzɛmba pii wɔ hɔ a wɔma egyangyandze dɔr ntsi, nyimpa ne mfaso wɔ hen?
Na woana na onyim dza oye ma nyimpa wɔ no nkwa mu, no nkwa huhuw ne nda a ɔhwer no dɛ sunsuma? Na woana botum akã akyerɛ nyimpa dza obesi n’ekyir wɔ wi ase?
7: Dzin pa ye sen ngo a ɔsom bo; na owu da sen obi n’awoda.
Eyiadze no kɔ ye sen aponto ase: Na adasa dze bɛhyɛ n’akoma mu.
Awerɛhow ye sen ɔserew: Na ɔnam enyim a ɔayɛ mbɔbɔmbɔbɔr no do na akoma enyi gye.
Enyansafo akoma wɔ eyiadze; na nkwasea akoma dze ɔwɔ enyigye fi mu.
Enyansafo enyimka ne tsie ye sen dɛ nyimpa betsie nkwasea hɔn adwontow.
Na mbrɛ nsoɛ no turuturu tse wɔ kutu ase no, dɛmara so na ɔkwasea ne serew tse: Iyi so egyangyandze a.
Ampaara apempensi ma onyansafo dan kwasea; na akyɛdze sɛɛ ntseasee.
Adze n'ewiei ye sen n’ahyɛse: Na sunsum mu abotarnyi no, oye sen sunsum mu nkontomponyi.
Mma mmpe ntsɛm wɔ wo sunsum mu mmfa ebufuw: Na ebufuw tse nkwasea hɔn akoko mu.
Mma woara ennkã dɛ, ɔye dɛn ntsi na nkan no nda no oye sen iyinom yi? Na ɔwoara ehwehwɛ yi mu nyansa mu?
Nyansa ye dɛ egyapadze ara so: Nyew, oye dodow ma hɔn a wohu ewia.
Na nyansa yɛ akoban, dɛ mbrɛ sika so yɛ akoban: Na nyimdzee n’abɔso nye yi, dɛ nyansa kora nyia ɔwɔ no no no nkwa.
Dwendwen Nyame n’edwuma ho: Na woana botum atsentsen dza ɔakyeakyea no no?
Eyiedzi da mu, ma w’enyi ngye, na ahohiahia da mu, dwendwen: Mpo Nyame ayɛ iyi afam ɔno ho, amma nyimpa biara ennhu n’ekyir biribiara a ɔbɛba.
Iyinom nyinara mehu wɔ m’egyangyandze nda no mu: Ɔtseneneenyi wɔ hɔ a ɔhera wɔ ne ndzeyɛtsenenee mu, na omumuyɛfo wɔ hɔ a ɔkyē wɔ n’emumuyɛ mu.
Mma nnyɛ woho tseneneenyi nntra do; eso mma nnyɛ onyansafo nntra do: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ebɛsɛɛ woara woho?
Mma nnyɛ omumuyɛfo nntra do, eso mma nnyɛ kwasea. Ɔyɛ dɛn na ibotwar wo mber ano ewu?
Oye dɛ ibosuo iyiara mu; nyew, ɔno so, mma nnyi wo nsa mmfi ho: Na nyia osuro Nyame no, obefi ne nyinara mu efi.
Nyansa yɛ ahoɔdzen ma onyansafo sen kuropɔn mu ahemfo du.
Ampaara, ɔtseneneenyi nnyi asaase do a ɔyɛ papa na ɔnnya bɔn.
Eso mm a mmfa nsɛm a wɔkekã nyinara nnyɛ asɛm; amma anntse dɛ w’akowaa rodom wo:
Na wankasa w’akoma so hu no mpɛn pii dɛ ɔwoara so adom binom dɛmara.
Iyinom nyinara medze nyansa mosɔe mohwɛe: Mesee dɛ, mubohu nyansa; na ɔno so ɔnye me ntamu waree.
Dza ɔwɔ hɔ yi, ɔwɔ ekyirkyir, na ɔyɛ dɔnkuronn: Woana botum ehu?
Medaan moho, na musuaa m’akoma mu dɛ mubohu na mapɛnsapɛnsa, na mahwehwɛ yansa na ndzɛmba ase, na mehu dɛ mumuyɛ yɛ nkwaseadze, na nkwaeasɛm yɛ abɔdam:
Na mehu adze i a ɔyɛ wenwen sen owu, mekyerɛ ɔbaa a ɔyɛ mfir, na n’akoma yɛ asawu, na ne nsa tse dɛ mpokyerɛ: Nyia ɔsɔ Nyame enyi no, obefi ne nsa efi; na ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi dze, ɔbɛkyer no.
Hwɛ, dza mehu nye yi, ɔsɛnkafo no na ɔse, ɔdze adze kor rekã so ho, dze ahwehwɛ ne siantsir:
Ɔno na me kra da ho hwehwɛ, naaso munnhunii: Ɔbarimba baako na mehu no wɔ apem mu; na ɔbaa dze, munnhunii wo hɔn nyinara mu.
Hwɛ, iyiara nko na mehu dɛ Nyame bɔɔ dasanyi tɔɔtsenn; na hɔnara na wɔakohwehwɛ tsirmu nhyehyɛɛ pii.
8: Woana na ɔtse dɛ nyansafo? Na woana na onyim nkyerɛkyerɛ ase? Nyimpa ne nyansaa ma n'enyim hyerɛn, na n'enyim pirim sakyer.
Mepam wo, dɛ, dzi ɔhen ne mbrasɛm do, mekyerɛ Nyankopɔn ne ntam no a.
Mma mmpɛ ntsɛm mmfi n’enyi nkɔ; mma nnsi nketse wɔ ndzebɔn mu: Na dza ɔsɔ n’enyi na oye.
Osiandɛ ɔhen n’asɛm mu wɔ tum; na woana bɛse no dɛ, ebɛnadze na ereyɛ yi?
Obiara a odzi mbrasɛm no do no, onnkohu ebusudze biara; na nyansafo n’akoma hu aber na atsɛmbu mu:
Na aber na atsɛmbu wɔ hɔ ma asɛm biara; osiandɛ nyimpa no mbusu sõ wɔ no do:
Na onnyim dza ɔbɛba; na woana botum akyerɛ no mbrɛ obesi bɛba?
Nyimpa biara nnyi hɔ a ɔwɔ sunsum do tum dɛ ɔdze besianka sunsum; eso onnyi tum wɔ owu-da do; na akwanma bi nnyi ɔsa no mu: Na emumuyɛ nnkegyaa ne yɛfo.
Iyi nyinara mehu, na medze m'akoma mato edwuma biara a wodzi no wɔ wi ase no do: Aber bi wɔ hɔ a nyimpa dzi ne nyɛnko no do tum dze ma noara no mbusu.
Na dɛmara so na muhun emumuyɛfo a wosiee hɔn, na wɔhɛɛn adakamaa mu; na hɔn a wɔayɛ dza ɔfata no so, wofii krɔnkrɔn-bea hɔ kɔree, na werɛ fiir hɔn wɔ kurow no mu: Iyi so egyangyandze a.
Osiandɛ wɔmmpɛ ntsɛm mmbu emumuyɛ ho atsɛn ntsi, na adasamba dze esi hɔn akoma mu pɔkyee dɛ wɔbɔbɔ mbusu.
Kaansa dzebɔnyɛnyi bɔbɔ mbusu mpɛn ɔha, na ɔama ne nda awar mpo a, ɔyɛ dɛn ara a minyim dɛ obesi yie ama hɔn a wosuro Nyame, wosuro n’enyim no:
Na onnkesi yie ama omumuyɛfo, eso ɔnnkɛma ne nda a ɔtse dɛ sunsuma no awar; osiandɛ onnsuro Nyame enyim.

Egyangyandze bi wɔ hɔ a wɔyɛ no asaase do; dɛ atseneneefo wɔ hɔ a adze to hɔn dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata emumuyɛfo edwuma; bio, emumuyɛfo wɔ hɔ a adze to hɔn dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata atseneneefo edwuma: Mesee dɛ iyi so egyangyandze a.
