Ɔno na mekamfoo enyigye, osiandɛ nyimpa nnyi papa biara wɔ wi ase, dɛ obedziazi, na ɔanom, na n’enyi agye: Na ɔno ɔbɛfam no ho ne berɛ mu wɔ no nkwa nyinara a Nyame dze ama no wi ase no mu.
Aber a medze m’akoma memaa dɛ mubohu nyansa, na mehu edwuma a wodzi no wɔ asaase do no: (Na eso obi nnyi hɔ a n’enyiwa nnda adzekyee na adzesaa):

Nna mohwɛɛ Nyame edwuma nyina, dɛ nyimpa nntum nnhu dwuma a wodzi no wi ase no: Osiandɛ sɛ ɔberɛ bɛn na nyimpa bɛberɛ ahwehwɛ a, orunnhu; ampaara so bio dɛ, sɛ nyansafo dwen dɛ obohu a, orunntum nnhu ara da.
9: Na iyi nyinara na medze too m'akoma mu, dɛ nkyɛ mebɛpɛ iyi nyinara mu; dɛ atseneneefo, na enyansafo, na hɔn ndwuma, wɔ Nyame nsamu: Sɛ ɔdɔ o, ɔtan o, nyimpa nnyim; ne nyinara da hɔn enyim.

Adze nyina ba nyimpa nyinara do per: Esian kor na ɔwɔ hɔ ma atseneneefo na emumuyɛfo; ɔwɔ hɔ ma nyia ɔbɔ afɔr na nyia ɔmmbɔ afɔr: Mbrɛ nyimpa papa tse no, mbrɛ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi so tse ara nye no; na nyia ɔkã ntam, dɛ nyia osuro ntanka.

Iyi yɛ mbusu wɔ dza wɔyɛ no wɔ wi ase nyinara mu, dɛ esian kor wɔ hɔ ma hɔn nyinara: Ampaara so, adasamba akoma ahyɛ mbusu mã, na abɔdam wɔ hɔn akoma mu ber a wɔtse ase, na ɔno n'ekyir no, wɔkɔ ewufo nkyɛn.
Na enyidado wɔ hɔ ma nyia ɔdze noho abɔ atseasefo nyinara ho no: Na bɔdɔm nyikan ye sen awendadze wufo.
Na atseasefo nyim dɛ wobowu ara: Na ewufo dze wonnyim biribiara, eso wonnyi akatua bio; na werɛ efir hɔn ho nkaa.
Hɔn dɔ o, hɔn enyitan na hɔn enyiber o, ahera dada; eso wonnyi kyɛfa biara bio ara da wɔ dza wɔyɛ no wɔ ase no mu.
Tu wo kwan, fa enyigye dzi w’edziban, na fa enyigye akoma nom wo nsa, na Nyankopɔn enyi asɔ wo ndwuma dada.
Ma wo ntar nhoa daa; na mma mma seradze mmpa wo tsirmu.

Enye wo yer a edɔ no no ntsena enyigye mu wɔ w’egyangyandze nkwa nda nyinara a ɔdze ama wo wi ase no mu, wo w’egyangyandze nda nyinara mu: Na ɔno nye wo kyɛfa wɔ nkwa mu, na wo berɛ a eberɛ wɔ wi ase mu.
Biribiara a wo nsa bɛkã dɛ ɔreyɛ no, fa w’ahoɔdzen yɛ; na edwuma, anaa nhyehyɛɛ, anaa nyimdzee, anaa nyansa nnyi adakamaa a erokɔ mu no mu.

Medaan moho, na muhun wɔ wi ase, dɛ empiresi nndzi nnwɔ ahoɔharfo, na dɛ ɔkõ nndzi nnwɔ ahoɔdzenfo, na boodoo nndzi nnwɔ enyansafo na so enyimpa nndzi nnwɔ edwimfo; na mber na esian ba hɔn nyinara do.
Na nyimpa nnyim ne mber so: Dɛ nam a wɔfa hɔn asawu bɔn mu no, na dɛ nnoma a wɔpa hɔn efir mu no, dɛmara so na wosua adasamba efir wɔ mber bɔn a ɔba hɔn do awerɛfir mu no mu.
Dɛmara so na mehu nyansa wɔ wi ase, na ɔyɛɛ kɛse wɔ m’enyiwa do:
Kurow kakraba bi wɔ hɔ, na nyimpa kumaabi na wɔwɔ mu; na ɔhen kɛse bi soɛɛr do, na obotuaa no, na ɔtotoow ho abantsentsen akɛse:
Afei wohun mu hɔ onyansafo hianyi bi, na ɔnam ne nyansaa do ɔgyee kurow no; naaso nyimpa biara annkaa ohianyi no.
Nna mesee dɛ, nyansa ye sen ahoɔdzen: Naaso woebu nyimpa hianyi ne nyansaa no enyimtsia, na ne nsɛm so wɔnntse.
Enyansafo nsɛm a wɔkã no komm no, wɔtse no yie sen nyia odzi nkwasea do tum ne nkekamu no.
Nyansa ye sen akondadze: Na dzebɔnyɛnyi kor sɛɛ papa pii.
10: Nwansema fun ma eduforafo ne seradze yi nka sonn: Dɛmara so na nkwaseadze ketsewabaa yɛ dur ma nyansa na enyidzi.
Nyimpa nyansafo n’akoma wɔ n’abanyimfa; na ɔkwasea n’akoma wɔ n’abankum.
Ampaara so, sɛ ɔkwasea fa kwan biara do a, ne ntseasee bɔ no, na ɔse biara dɛ ɔkwasea a.
Sɛ otumfo no sunsum soɛr tsia wo a, mma mmfi w’ananmu; na ngyaamu dwedwe mfom pii.
Mbusu bi wɔ hɔ a mehu no wɔ wi ase a ɔtse dɛ mfom a ofir otumfo hɔ ba.
Wɔama nkwaseadze do ɔsorsor, na ahonyafo tsetse famu.
Mehu nkowaa a wɔtsetse mpɔnko do, na ahenmba a wɔnenam dɛ nkowaa wɔ asaase do.
Nyia otu maa no, ɔbɔtɔ mu; na obiara a obubu ban mu no, abowatsena bɔsɔw no.
Obiara a opue abo no, wɔdze bepira no; na nyia ɔpaa ndua no, ɔdze bɔ noho mbusu.
Sɛ dadze n’ano kum, na obiara annsew ano a, ɔnodze ɔwɔ dɛ wɔma no ahoɔdzen kɛse: Na nyansa yɛ mfaso ma akwankyerɛ.
Sɛ abowatsena sɔw ansaana wɔadzea no a, nna mfaso biara nnyi ɔdzeafo no mu.
Nyimpa nyansafo n’anomu nsɛm ye adom; na ɔkwasea dze, n’anofamfa bɛmen narankasa.
N’anomu nsɛm ahyɛse nkwaseasɛm a: Na ne kasaa n’ewiei abɔdam bɔn a.
Ɔkwasea ma asɛm so dɔɔ sõ: Naaso nyimpa nnyim dza ɔbɛba; na dza obesi n’ekyir aba no, woana botum akã akyerɛ no?
Nkwasea hɔn berɛ haw hɔn mu obiara, na onnyim mbrɛ onsi nkɔ kurow no mu.
Asaase e, due! Aber a wo hen yɛ abofra, na w’asafohemfo dzidzi anapa!
Asaase e, siarfo nye wo oo! Ber a wo hen yɛ ekunyin ba, na w’asafohemfo dzidzi ber a ɔsɛ, wɔ ahoɔdzen ntsi, onnyɛ asabow ntsi a!
Akwadwer ara ntsi na nkurii pa bɔ mu; na nsamugow na ɔma ɔdan win.
Asereserew ntsi na wɔto pon, na nsã ma ɔbra mu enyigye: Na sika bua adze nyinara.
Mma nndom ɔhen, dabida, mma nnye wɔ w’adwen mu mpo; na mma nndom obirɛmpɔn wɔ w’adankyir: Na wimu anoma dze ndze no bɔkɔ, na dza otuatua ntɛkyerɛ bɛkɛkã asɛm no.
11: Totow w'edziban gugu nsu enyi: Na daakye biara ibohu.
Fa bi ma beesuon, nyew, fa ma baawɔtwe mpo; na innyim mbusu kor a ɔbɛba asaase do.
Sɛ nsu hyɛ nsuwusiw mã a, otue gu asaase do; na sɛ dua kɔhwe pomu afamu, anaa kwaamu afamu a, fakor a dua no ahwe no, mbrɛ ɔbɛda ara nye no.
Nyia ɔhwɛ mframa enyim no, onnkodua; na nyia ɔhwɛ nsuwusiw no, onnkobu,
Dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo innyim mbrɛ mframa no kwan da, anaaso innyim mbrɛ mbiew si nyin wɔ onyinsɛmfo ne yamu no; dɛmara so mpo na ɔwo innyim Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛ adze nyina no n'edwuma.
Dua w'aba anapa, na ewimbir so mma nnyi wo nsa mmfi ho: Na ɔwo innyim no mu dza ɔbɛyɛ prɔmprɔm, sɛ iyi o, ɔno o, anaa beenu nyma na wɔbɔbɔ mu ayɛ yie o.
Ampaara dɛ kan yɛ dɛw, na ɔyɛ enyiwa fɛw dɛ obohu ewia.
Nyew, sɛ nyimpa dzi mfe pii a, wɔmma n’enyi ngye ne nyinara mu; na wɔmma ɔnkaa sum nda no, na wɔbɔdɔɔ sõ. Dza ɔbɛba nyinara egyangyandze a.

Aberantsɛ e, ma w’enyi ngye wo mberantsɛber mu oo; na ma w’akoma ntɔ mu wɔ wo mberantsɛber mu, na fa wankasa w’akoma n’a kwan do, na dza woara w’enyiwa tua mu: Na hu dɛ iyi nyinara ntsi Nyankopɔn dze wo bɔkɔ atsɛmbu mu.
Dɛm ntsi yi awerɛhow fi w’akoma mu, na ma emumuyɛ mpar wo honam: Na mbafober na mberantsɛber yɛ egyangyandze
12: Eso kaa wo bɔfo wɔ wo mberantsɛber mu, ansaana mbusu da no aba, na mfe a ebɛse dɛ, minnyi mu enyigye no, edu;
ansaana ewia, na kan, na bosoom, na nworaba ahyehyɛ sum, na nsuwusiw agye nyankom ekyir:
Da a he aweɔmfo ho bɔpopo, na mbarimba ahoɔdzenfo mu bɔkonkom, na ewunyamfo begyaa osiandɛ hɔnho esuar ntsi, na hɔn a wodua atena-ntokura mu hwɛ adze, hɔn enyiwa do bɛyɛ kusuww,
na wɔatotow abɔntsen do mbobow no mu; ber a ewuyam ne dede abrɛ adze wɔbɔsoɛr anoma no sū ano, na mbaa adwontofo nyinara wɔbɛbrɛ hɔn adze;
nyew, wobosuro dza ɔkrɔn biara na ehuyi bɛba kwan mu; na almond dua bɔbɔ nhyiren, na abɛbɛw ayɛ adzesoa, na akɔndɔ tū etwa: Osiandɛ dasanyi rokɔ ne daa fie, na eyiyɛfo rikyin abrɔn do:
Ansaana dwetɛ ahoma bɛtsew, anaa sika toa bɛpaa, na ehina no abɔ nsubura ho, anaa supi hwiir ebubu;
na dɛtse bɛsan akɔ asaase mu dɛ mbrɛ nkyɛ ɔtse, na sunsum bɛsan akɔ Nyankopɔn a ɔdze mae no ho.
Egyangyandze mu egyangyandze, ɔsɛnkafo no na ɔse; ne nyinara egyangyandze a.
Na bio so, osiandɛ ɔsɛnkafo no ɔyɛ onyansafo ntsi, ɔdaa ho ara kyerɛkyerɛɛ ɔman no nyimdzee; nyew, ɔdwendween ho, na ɔpɛɛ mu, na obubuu mbɛbusɛm pii.
Ɔsɛnkafo no hwehwɛɛ dɛ obohu nsɛm a ɔyɛ enyigye, na dza wɔakyerɛw no tɔɔtsennyɛ mu, mekyerɛ, nokwar nsɛm.
Onyansafo ne nsɛm tse dɛ ɔnantwikafo ndadzepoma; na dɛ mbrɛ mprɛgow a wɔdze etsintsim yie tse no, mbrɛ eso nhyiamu ekunyin nsɛm a guanhwɛfo kor na ɔkã no tse ara nye no.
Na nkyii so bio, me ba, tsie afotu; nwoma pii ne yɛ nnyi ewiei; na sūa dodow mu wɔ honamberɛ.
Asɛm no n’ewiei nye yi, ne nyinara wɔatse: Suro Nyankopɔn, na dzi ne mbransɛm do; na iyiara nye nyimpa no dwuma nyina.
Na Nyankopɔn dze dwuma biara bɛba asɛndzii, ɔnye esumasɛm biara, sɛ oye o, sɛ omuo o.

1: Paul a ɔnam Naynkopɔn ne pɛ do yɛ Christ Jesus no somafo dze kɛma ahotsewfo a wɔwɔ Ephesus a wɔyɛ Christ Jesus mu agyedzifo:
Adom nkã hom nye asomdwee a ofir Nyankopɔn hɛn Egya nye Ewuradze Jesus Christ.
Nhyira nkã hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ ne Nyankopɔn nye n'egya a ɔdze sunsum mu nhyira nyina ehyira hɛn wɔ sorsor wɔ Christ Jesus mu:
Dɛ mbrɛ ɔsaan mu yii hɛn wɔ dɔ mu ansaana wɔrehyɛ wiadze ase, dɛ yɛnyɛ ahotsewfo nye hɔn a wonndzi dzɛm biara wɔ n'enyim;
na oyii hɛn too hɔ dɛ ɔnam Jesus Christ do bɛfa hɛn abayɛ ama noho,
dɛ mbrɛ ne pɛ enyisɔ tse, ma woeeyi n'adom a ɔdze adom hɛn no Dɔda no mu no n'enyimnyam ayɛw;
no mu na yɛnam no bɔgyaa do enya hɛn pon yi, mekyerɛ bɔnfakyɛ a ɔnam n'adom ahonya do a,
ɔama abor do ama hɛn wɔ nyansa nye nyimdzee nyina mu,
na oeyi ne pɛ n'esumasɛm akyerɛ hɛn dɛ mbrɛ n'enyisɔ a osusui wɔ no mu no tse,
dze ekodu efisiesie mber pa amayɛ a wɔbɛkã ndzɛmba nyina abɔ mu kor wɔ Christ mu, ɔsorsor ndzɛmba o, asaase do ndzɛmba o; mese, wɔ no mu,
na no mu so na wɔyɛɛ hɛn so egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ nyia ɔnam ne pɛ apam do yɛ ndzɛmba nyina no nam ne tsirmpɔw do hyehyɛɛ too hɔ;
dɛ hɛn a hɛn enyi daa Christ do kan no mbɛyɛ n'enyimnyam ho ayɛyi:
No mu so, na hom tsee nokwar asɛm no, hom nkwagye ho asɛmpa no, no mu ara, na hom gyee dzii no, wɔdze Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a wɔbɔɔ anohoba wɔ ho no a.
Ɔyɛ hɛn kyɛfa ho nsewhyɛ no, asɔw hom ano ama nankasa nedze a onyaa no no pon no, ama n'enyimnyam ayɛyi.
Dɛm ntsi, mo so metsee hom Ewuradze Jesus mu gyedzi a ɔwɔ hom mu no, ɔnye ɔdɔ a hom kyerɛɛ no ahotsewfo nyina do no,
minngyaa dɛ meda ase wɔ hom ntsi, mobɔ hom dzin wɔ me mpaabɔ mu;
dɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ ne Nyankopɔn no, enyimnyam Egya no, ɔmma hom nyansa nye nyikyerɛ sunsum wɔ no ho nyimdzee mu;
dɛ hom adwen enyi ntsew, na hom nhu ne frɛ no ho enyidado no, nye n'egyapadze enyimnyam ahonya wɔ ahotsewfo no mu,
nye no tum kɛseyɛ mbordo a ɔwɔ hɛn a yɛgye dzi no do, dɛ Mbrɛ no tum ahoɔdzen adzeyɛe tse a.
Ɔdze yɛɛ adze wɔ Christ mu nyaan no fii ewufo mu, na ɔdze no tsenaa n'enyimfa wɔ sorsor,
wɔ mpanyindzi, nye tumdzi, nye ahoɔdzen, nye ahendzi nyina do, nye dzin a wɔbɔ nyina do, nnyɛ wiadze mber yi mu nko, na mbom dza ɔreba no no so mu:
Na ɔabrɛ adze nyina adze aba n'ananadze, na ɔdze no ayɛ adze nyina do tsir ama asɔr no a,
ɔnye ne nyimpadua, nyia ɔyɛ adze nyina mã wɔ adze nyina mu no n'amayɛ.
2: Na hom so ɔama hom enya nkwa, hom a nkyɛ hom yɛ ewufo wɔ hom mfom nye ndzebɔn mu a,
nkan no hom nantseew mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔfa wiadze yi mber do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔfa wimu tum panyin no afamu, sunsum a ɔyɛ edwuma sesei wɔ asoɔdzenmba no mu a;
nkyɛ hɛn nyina so tse hɔn mu bɔ hɛn bra wɔ honam akɔndo mu, na yɛyɛɛ dza honam nye adwen pɛ, na yɛyɛɛ awoso mu ebufuwmba dɛ nkaa no so:
na Nyankopɔn a n'ehumbɔbɔr dɔɔ sõ no, osian no dɔ kɛse a ɔdze dɔɔ hɛn,
wɔ ber a yɛyɛ ewufo wɔ mfom mu ntsi. Ɔama yɛnye Christ enya nkwa, (adom do na wɔnam agye hom nkwa);
na oenyan hɛn aka no ho, na ɔama yɛnye no atsena sorsor hɔ wɔ Christ Jesus mu;
ama mbersantsen a ɔreba no mu oeeyi n'adom ahonya mbordo no akyerɛ, wɔ ayamuyie a ɔayɛ hɛn wɔ Chrsit Jesus mu:
na adom na wɔdze nam gyedzi do agye hom nkwa; na ommfir homankasa: Nyankopɔn akyɛdze a:
ommfir ndwuma mu, mma obiara aannhyehyɛ noho. 1o. Na yɛyɛ n'edwinsa a ɔbɔɔ hɛn Christ Jesus mu maa ndwuma pa a Nyankopɔn siesie too hɔ dɛ yɛnnantsew mu no.
Dɛm ntsi hom nkaa dɛ nkyɛ nkan no hom a hom yɛ Ananamamfo wɔ honam mu a hɔn a wɔfrɛ hɔn Twatsiatwafo a wɔdze nsa twa no honam mu no frɛ hom Monomonomfo;
dɛ ber no nna hom nnyi Christ nkyɛn, na hom yɛ ananaben a hom mmfora Isreal amanmba, nye ahɔho wɔ anohoba ahyɛmu horow no ho, hom nnyi enyidado, eso hom nnyi Nyankopɔn bi wɔ wiadze.
Na afei dze, Christ Jesus mu, hom a nkyɛ hom wɔ ekyirkyir no, nam Christ bɔgyaa do abɛn.
Na ɔno nye hɛn asomdwee a ɔayɛ ebien nyina kor, na oedwuruw fasu a otwa ntamu no egu famu;
na oegura nyitan no egu wɔ no honam mu, mbra nsɛnhorow a ɔwɔ ahyɛdze mu no; na ɔdze hɔn beenu aabɔ nyimpa fofor kor wɔ nankasa no mu, ma aayɛ asomdwee;
na ɔnam ne mbeamudua no do aapata aka ebien nyina abɔ mu ayɛ nyimpadua kor ama Nyankopɔn, wɔ dɛ oeku nyitan no wɔ mu ntsi:
Na ɔbae bɛkãa asomdwee ho nsɛmpa kyerɛɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyir, nye hɔn a wɔbɛn:
Na ɔnam no mu na hɛn beenu nyina enya nkwa wɔ Sunsum kor mu kɔ Egya no nkyɛn.
Na afei hom nnyɛ ahɔho nye amamforafo bio, hom yɛ ahotsewfo no kuromamfo nye Nyankopɔn fifo;
wɔdze hom esi asomafo nye nkɔnhyɛfo no fapem do a Christ Jesus nankasa nye kutuwdo-bo tsitsir;
no mu na dza woesi no nyina kūakua enyim a, orinyin akɛyɛ Nyankopɔn asɔrdan krɔnkrɔn wɔ Ewuradze mu;
ɔno no mu na hom so woesi ayɛ Nyankopɔn tsenabea wɔ Sunsum mu.
3: Iyi ntsi na emi Paul a meyɛ Nyankopɔn pokyerɛnyi ma hom amanamamfo,
sɛ hom atse adom ofihwɛ-dwuma a wɔdze ama me wɔ hom afamu no ho asɛm a;
Mbrɛ wɔnam nyikyerɛ do yii esumasɛm no kyerɛɛ me, dɛ mbrɛ nkan no mekyerɛɛw no nsɛm tsiabaa bi mu no,
ɔno na, sɛ hom kenkan a, hom dze bohu me ntseasee a ɔwɔ Christ esumasɛm no mu a
mbersantsen bi mu wɔamma nyimpa mba ennhu, dɛ mbrɛ afei woeyi akyerɛ n'asomafo nye nkɔnhyɛfo krɔnkrɔn wɔ Sunsum mu,
dɛ amanamamfo so bɛyɛ adzedzifo bi, nye nyimpadua kor ara bi, nye anohoba no fafafo bi, wɔ Christ mu, ɔnam asɛmpa no do;
ɔno no ho ɔsomfo na mebɛyɛe, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn adom akyɛdze a wɔdze akyɛ hɛn dɛ mbrɛ no tum edwumayɛ tse no.
Emi a musuar sen ahotsewfo nyina no na wɔdze adom yi adom me, dɛ menkã Christ ahonya a onnyi nhwehwɛmu no ho asɛm menkyerɛ amanamamfo;
na memma nyimpa nyina nhu esumasɛm no ho dwumadzi a mbersantsen nyina mu osumaa Nyankopɔn a ɔbɔɔ ndzɛmba nyina no mu no;
Ma afei ɔnam asɔr no do mpanyindzi nye etum horow a wɔwɔ sor eehu Nyankopɔn nyansaa horow pii no,
dɛ mbrɛ tsetse tsirmpɔw a ɔbɔe wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Christ Jesus mu no tse:
no mu na yɛnam no ho gyedzi do enya ndamyɛ nye kwan wɔ awerɛhyɛmu mu.
Dɛm ntsi meserɛ dɛ mma hom abaw mmpa wɔ amandze a muruhu wɔ hom ntsi a ɔyɛ hom enyimnyam no ho.
Iyi ntsi na mubu ntwɛr ma Egya no a,
wofi no mu na egya-mba a wɔwɔ sor nye asaase nyina no nya hɔn dzin,
dɛ mbrɛ n'enyimnyam ahonya tse no, ɔmma hom ndua no Sunsum do nnya tum mu ahoɔdzen wɔ mu-nyimpa no mu;
ma Christ ndua gyedzi do ntsena hom akoma mu; na hom gye ndwow na hom tsintsim wɔ dɔ mu a,
hom eenya ahoɔdzen nye ahotsewfo no nyina eehu tɛtɛr no nye tsentsen nye krɔn no, nye bun no,
na hom eehu Christ dɔ a ɔtra nhuma no, na Nyankopɔn amayɛ nyina aahYɛ hom mã.
Na afei, onyia no a otum dɛ ɔyɛ ma ɔtra mbordo kyɛn adze nyina a yebisa anaa yɛdwen, dɛ mbrɛ tum a ɔyɛ hɛn mu edwuma tse na,
ɔno na enyimnyam nkã no asɔr mu wɔ Christ mu, nkɔ mbersantsen mfesantsen nyina mu. Amen.
4: Dɛm ntsi, emi a meyɛ Ewuradze no pokyerɛnyi mutu hom fo dɛ hom nnantsew dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata ɔfrɛ a wɔdze afrɛ hom,
wɔ ahobrɛadze nye ɔdwe nyina mu, nye penkyɛr, hom nkurakura homho nkorkor wɔ dɔ mu,
hom mbɔ mbɔdzen nkura Sunsum koryɛ mu wɔ asomdwee homa mu.
Nyimpadua kor nye Sunsum kor, dɛ mbrɛ wɔafrɛ hom wɔ hom frɛ enyidado kor mu;
Ewuradze kor, gyedzi kor, enuma kor,
hɛn nyina hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Egya kor a ɔbɔ hɛn nyina do, ɔnam hɛn nyina mu, ɔwɔ hɛn nyina mu,
Na wɔdze adom adom hɛn nyina nkorkor dɛ mbrɛ Christ akyɛdze nsusui tse.
Dɛm ntsi ɔse, ɔfowee kɔr sor, ɔdze ndɔmmum kɔr ndɔmmum, Na ɔdze akyɛdze kyɛɛ nyimpa.
(Na dza ɔdɛ, ɔfowee kɔr sor no nye dɛn, gyedɛ osianee so kɔr asaase ase?
Nyia osianee no, ɔnoara so nye nyia ɔfowee bɔɔ asorsor nyina do, ma ɔaahyɛ ndzɛmba nyina mã).
Na ɔama binom ayɛ asomafo, binom nkɔnhyɛfo, binom asɛmpakafo, binom ahwɛfo nye akyerɛkyerɛfo;
wɔ ahotsewfo mudzi ntsi, wɔ ɔsom edwuma no ntsi, wɔ Christ nyimpadua ne si ntsi:
ma ekodu dɛ hɛn nyina yebohu Nyankopɔn Ba no ho gyedzi nye no ho nyimdzee mu koryɛ mu, ayɛ nyimpa a oewie nyin, yeedu Christ amayɛ esusudze no pɛn do:
Mma yaannda ho annyɛ mbɔtoaba a nkyerɛkyerɛ mframa biara yɛ hɛn begyabegya dze hɛn dzi akɔnaaba wɔ nyimpa bradato nye enyifir a ɔfa ndaadaa dzɛfɛdzɛfɛW mu;
na mbom yeedzi nokwar wɔ dɔ mu, na yeenyin ndzɛmba nyinara mu akɔto Christ a ɔyɛ hɛn tsir no;
ofir no mu, na nyimpadua no nyina, ɔnam dza akwaa nyina dze ma no do, atoatoa mu na akõakoa mu ayɛ kor, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu biara n'adzeyɛ nsusui tse no, nyimpadua no nyina nyin nya no ho esiyie wɔ dɔ mu.
Dɛm ntsi yi na mekã na midzi dase wɔ Ewuradze mu, dɛ mma hom nnantsew bio dɛ mbrɛ amanamamfo nantsew wɔ adwen hunyɛ mu no,
sum ahyɛ hɔn adwen mu, wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn nkwa no ho anana, osian nkwaseasɛm a ɔwɔ hɔn mu, nye hɔn akoma a epirim ntsi;
adze nntsɛ hɔn ntsi, wɔdze hɔnho ama ahoɔdɛw na wɔreyɛ afifidze nyina anyiberdo.
Na homdze hom ennsūa Christ dɛm;
sɛ ɔtse sa ampa dɛ hom atse no ho asɛm, na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ hom dɛ mbrɛ Christ mu nokwar no tse no a:
hom nyi hom nkan no abrabɔ afamu nyimpa dadaw no a ɔroprɔw wɔ ndaadaa akɔndɔ mu no ngu;
na mbom wɔnyɛ hom fofor wɔ hom adwen sunsum mu,
na hom nhyɛ nyimpa fofor no a wɔabɔ no Nyame do wɔ tsenenee nye ahotsew mu no.
Dɛm ntsi hom nyi atorsɛm ngu, na obiara nkasa nokwar nkyerɛ ne nyɛnko; osiandɛ yɛyeyɛ akwaa ma hɛnho nkorkor.
Mma hom mmfa abufuw nnyɛ bɔn. Mma wi nntɔ hom ebufuw do:
eso mma hom mma abɔnsam kwan.
Mma owifo nnwia adze bio: Na mbom ɔmbɔ mbɔdzen mfa ne nsa nyɛ edwuma pa, na oeenya dza ɔdze bɛkyɛ nyia oehia.
Mma kasa fun biara mmfi hom anomu, na mbom dza oye ma ntowdo a ohia a ɔdze adom bɛma hɔn a wɔtse.
Na mma hom nnhow Nyankopɔn Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a wɔdze asɔw hom ano ama ɔgye da no no werɛ.
Hom mma wonyi anoɔwen nyina, nye komabɔn, nye ebufuw, nye ndzebɔ, nye engyaa nye ɔyamugya nyina mfi hom nkyɛn:
na hom nyɛ ayamuyie nye ayamuhyehye mma homho nkorkor; hom mfa nkyekyɛ homho dɛ Nyankopɔn so dze akyɛ hom wɔ Christ mu.
5: Dɛm ntsi hom nyɛ Nyankopɔn esuafo dɛ dɔmba;
na hom nnantsew ɔdɔ mu, dɛ mbrɛ Christ so dɔɔ hom, na ɔdze noho mae maa hɛn, ayɛyɛdze nye afɔrbɔdze a wɔbɔ ma Nyankopɔn a oyi nka huahuam.
Na ndwamansɛm anaa efifidze anaa enyikaber dze, mma wɔmmbɔ dzin wɔ hom mu mpo, dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ ahotsewfo;
anaaso atantandze anaa nkwasea kasa, anaa afɛdzisɛm a ɔnnyɛ mfaso: Na mbom hom nda ase.
Na hom nyim yi tsenene dɛ edwaman biara anaa ofififo anaa onyikaberfo a ɔyɛ bosonsɔrnyi nnyi egyapadze wɔ Christ nye Nyankopɔn ahendzi no mu.
Mma obi mmfa nsɛnhun nndaadaa hom: Na dɛm ndzɛmba yi ntsi na Nyankopɔn ebufuw reba seanntse mba do.
Dɛm ntsi mma hom nnyɛ bɔn fafafo:
na nkyɛ nkan no hom yɛ sum, na afei dze, hom yɛ kan wɔ Ewuardze mu; hom nnantsew dɛ kan mba:
(na kan no n'aba wɔ papayɛ nye tsenenee nye nokwar nyina mu),
hom nsɔ dza ɔsɔ Ewuradze enyi yie nhwɛ;
na mma hom nnyɛ sum edwuma a ɔnnsow aba no nnyɛ nyɛnko, na mbom hom ntsia;
na dza wɔyɛ no nsumaa mu no ɔyɛ enyiwu dɛ wɔbɔ dzin mpo.
Na ndzɛmba nyina sɛ woyi ho atsɛn a, kan no yi no edzi: Na adze biara a woeyi no edzi no yɛ kan.
Dɛm ntsi ɔse, nyan, ɔwo a ada, soɛr fi ewufo mu, na Christ bɛhyerɛn wo do.
Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie mbrɛ hom dua nantsew, nnyɛ dɛ nkwasea na mbom dɛ enyansafo;
hom mpon aber no, osiandɛ nda no yɛ ndabɔn.
Dɛm ntsi mma hom nnyɛ nkwasea, na mbom hom nhu dza Ewuradze pɛ.
Na mma hom nnom nsã a asakasakayɛ wɔ mu, na mbom hom nyɛ mã wɔ Sunsum mu;
hom mfa nsankudwom, nye ayɛyindwom nye sunsum ndwom nkasa nkyerɛ homho, na hom mbɔ nsanku ntow ndwom wɔ hom akoma mu mma Ewuradze;
hom nda Nyankopɔn Egya no ase daa wɔ adze nyina mu, wɔ Jesus Christ dzin mu;
hom mbrɛbrɛ homho adze mmema homho nkorkor wɔ Christ suro mu.
Yernom, hom mbrɛ homho adze mma homankasa hom kunnom dɛ hom dze ma Ewuradze.
Na okun no yɛ yer no ne tsir dɛ mbrɛ Christ so yɛ asɔr ne tsir, ɔnoara nye nyimpadua no agyenkwa.
Na dɛ mbrɛ asɔr brɛ noho adze ma Christ no, dɛmara na yernom no nyɛ mma hɔn kunnom wɔ adze nyina mu.
Kunnom hom ndɔ hom yernom dɛ mbrɛ Christ so dɔɔ asɔr no, na ɔdze noho maa no:
Ma ɔdze asɛm no no nsuguar no atsew ho ayɛ no krɔnkrɔn,
ama oeetu asɔr no esi hɔ ama nankasa noho, dɛ enyimnyam asɔr a onnyi nkekaa anaa mpomponee, anaa dɛm adze biara, na mbom ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn na onndzi dzɛm.
Dɛmara na ɔsɛ dɛ kunnom dɔ hɔnankasa hɔn honam. Nyia ɔdɔ nankasa no yer no, ɔdɔ nankasa noho:
Osiandɛ obiara nntan nankasa no honam pɛn, na mbom ɔnyɛn no na ɔhwɛ no yie, dɛ mbrɛ Christ so yɛ ma asɔr no;
Iyi ntsi na ɔbarimba begya n'egya nye ne nã, na ɔdze noho akɛbata ne yer ho, na beenu no akɛyɛ honankor.
Esumasɛm yi sõ: Na emidze makã no Christ nye asɔr no ho.
Naaso hom nkorkor so ndodɔ obiara nankasa ne yer dɛ nankasa noho, na ɔyer dze, ɔmfɛr no kun.
6: Mba, hom ntsie hom awofo wɔ Ewuradze mu: Na iyi na ɔtsen.
Dzi w'egya nye wo nã nyi (ɔno nye mbra a odzi kan a anohoba ka ho),
ma eewie yie, na eenyin akyɛr asaase do.
Na hom egyanom, mma hom nnyi hom mba ahomtsew; na hom nnyɛn hɔn Ewuradze setsie nye kasakyerɛ mu.
Nkowaa, hom mfa suro nye ahopopo ntsie hom honam afamu wuranom asɛm, wɔ hom akomakor mu, dɛ hom yɛ ma Ewuradze;
nnyɛ enyiwado som a, dɛ hɔn a wɔsɔ nyimpa enyi, na mbom dɛ Christ nkowaa pa a wofi akoma mu reyɛ Nyankopɔn pɛ;
na wɔdze ɔpɛ pa rosom dɛ wɔdze ma Ewuradze na nnyɛ nyimpa a:
Na hom nyim dɛ papa a obiara bɛyɛ no, ɔdehye o, akowaa o, ɔnoara na obenya bio wɔ Ewuradze hɔ.
Na, hom wuranom, hom nyɛ dɛmara mma hɔn, na hom ngyaa mpuwbɔ; na hom nyim dɛ hɔn wura nye homdze wɔ sor, na nyimpa enyimhwɛ nnyi n'afamu.
Nkyii, enuanom, hom nhyɛ dzen wɔ Ewuradze nye no tum ahoɔdzen no mu.
Hom nhyɛ Nyankopɔn akodze no nyina, na hom eetum egyina abɔnsam ndaadaa no enyim.
Osiandɛ nnyɛ yɛnye honam nye bɔgya na enya ntokwadzi, na yɛnye mpanyindzi, tumdzi, nye sum yi mu wiadze ahemfo, nye emumuyɛ esunsuma a wɔwɔ sorsor.
Dɛm ntsi, hom mfa Nyame akodze no nyina, na hom eetum egyina enyim wɔ da bɔn no mu, na hom wie ne nyina yɛ a, hom eegyina.
Dɛm ntsi hom ngyina hɔ dɛ hom dze nokwar abɔ hom asen, na hom ahyɛ tsenenee akatabo no,
na hom dze asomdwee asɛmpa no ho ahosiesie ahyehyɛ hom anan;
na ɔka ne nyina ho, hom nkura gyedzi kokyɛm no a hom dze botum edum ɔbɔn no n'egyenndua a ogya wɔ ano no.
Na hom mfa nkwagye dadzekyɛw no, nye Sunsum afõwa a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm no:
Na hom mfa asɔr nye nkotoserɛ nyina nsɔr ber nyina wɔ Sunsum mu, na hom nweɔn no ara ntsi, mbɔ mbɔdzen mfua nkotoserɛ mu mma ahotsewfo no nyina,
nye mo so, dɛ sɛ mubue m'ano a, wɔma me ɔkasahom ma memfa ndam minyi asɛmpa no esumasɛm no menkyerɛ,
ɔno ho ahembɔfo na meyɛ wɔ mpokyerɛ mu, na maakasa ndam do wɔ mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ dɛ mekasa.
Na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ na hom ehu mo ho asɛm no, onua dɔfo nye Ewuradze mu somfo nokwafo, Tychicus, bɛma hom ehu ne nyina:
Ɔno na iyiara ntsi masoma no hom nkyɛn, ma hom eehu atsena na ɔaama hom akomatɔmu.
Asomdwee nkã enuanom no, nye dɔ nye gyedzi a ofir Nyankopɔn Egya nye Ewuradze Jesus Christ.
Adom nkã hɔn a wɔdɔ Ewuradze Jesus Christ wɔ kotooyɛ mu no nyina.

1: Afei ɔbaa dɛ Ahasuerus ber do, (oyinye Ahasuerus a odzii hen fitsi India araa dze kodu Ethiopia, wɔ amansin ɔha eduonu esuon do no);
dɛ nda no mu no a ɔhen Ahasuerus tse n’ahendzi ahengua a ɔwɔ Shushan ahemfie no do no,
wɔ n’ahendzi mu afe a otsīa ebiasa mu no, ɔtoo pon maa n’asafohemfo nyinara na no nkowaa; Persia na Media etumfo, ekunyin na amansin no mu asafohemfo no, wɔ n’enyim:
Aber no na oyii n'enyimnyam ahendzi mu adzedodow na n'abɔso tumdzi mu enyidzi kyerɛe wɔ nda pii, mekyerɛ ndafua ɔha eduowɔtwe.
Na aber a nda yi sõe no, nna ɔhen no too pon dze maa nkorɔfo a wohun hɔn wɔ Shushan ahemfie no nyinara, akɛse na nkakraba nyina, nda esuon, wɔ ɔhen n’ahemfie ture no mu abangua no do;

hɔ na atam efufuw, mbɔwema, na bibiri sensɛnee a wɔdze ndwera fɛɛfɛw a ɔberdum ahoma esusuo mu akyekyer dwetɛ nkaba na marble ɔbo fufuw edum ho: Sika na dwetɛ kootsi sisi marble abo amemen, na efufuw, na bufua, na etuntum abonsɛwee do.
Na wɔhyehyɛɛ hɔn nsã wɔ sika ndzɛmba no nkuraba mu (nkuraba no so ɔsor bi na ɔsor bi na ɔhen nsã no dɔɔ sõ dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no n’ayamuyie tse.
Na ɔnom no wɔyɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse; wɔannhyɛ obiara: Na dɛm na ɔhen no ahyɛ ne fie mpanyimfo no nyinara dɛ wɔnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa biara ne pɛ tse.
Ɔhembaa Vashti so too pon dze maa mbaa wɔ ahemfi a ɔyɛ ɔhen Ahasuerus dze no mu.
Da a otsīa esuon no a ɔhen no n’akoma nyaa nsã ho enyigye no, ɔhyɛɛ Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, na Abagtha, Zethar, na Carcas, epiafo beesuon a wɔsom wɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus enyim no,
dɛ wɔnkɛfa ɔhembaa Vashti mbra ɔhen no enyim wɔ ahendzi no ahenkyɛw no mu, ma ɔmfa n’ahoɔfɛw mbɛkyerɛ aman na asafohemfo no, osiandɛ no ho yɛ fɛw.
Na ɔhembaa Vashti poow dɛ ɔbɛba wɔ ɔhen ne mbrasɛm a ɔnam epiafo no do no do: Dɛm ntsi ɔhen no no bo fuuw dodoodow, na n’ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ no mu.
Nna ɔhen no see mbarimba enyansafo a wonyim mbermunsɛm no, (osiandɛ mbrɛ ɔhen n’asɛm si ba hɔn a wonyim mbra na atsɛmbusɛm nyinara nye no;

na hɔn a wodzi no do hɔ nye Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, na Memucan, Persia na Media mbapɔmba beesuon no a wohu ɔhen no enyim no. Na wodzi kan tsena famu wɔ ahendzi no mu no):
Dɛ, ebɛnadze na yendua mbra do mfa nyɛ ɔhembaa Vashti, osiandɛ oenndzi ɔhen Ahasuerus n’asem a ɔnam epiafo no do hyɛe no do ntsi?
Na Memucan buae wɔ ɔhen na mbapɔmba enyim, dɛ, nnyɛ ɔhen nko na ɔhembaa Vashti ayɛ no bɔn, na mbom ɔafom mbapɔmba nyinara, na aman nyinara a wɔwɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus n’amansin nyinara mu no so.

Osiandɛ ɔhembaa yi ne nyɛe yi obefir edzi ekodu mbaa nyinara nkyɛn, na wobobu hɔn kunnom enyimtsia wɔ hɔn enyiwa do, aber a wɔbɛkã no dɛ, ɔhen Ahasuerus hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa ɔhembaa Vashti mbra n’enyim, na ɔammba.
Na ndɛ da yi Persia na Media ahenmbabaa a wɔatse ɔhembaa no ne nyɛe no nkã no bɛsese ɔhen ne mbapɔmba nyinara dɛmara. Nna enyimtsiabu na ebufuhyew dodow bɔsoɛr.

Sɛ ɔhen bɛpɛ a, ɔno ma ahendzi mu mbrasɛm mfi no hɔ mfir edzi, na wɔmma wɔnkyerɛw no wɔ Persiafo na Mediafo mbra no mu, mma wɔaanndan no, dɛ Vashti mmba ɔhen Ahasuerus enyim bio: Na wɔmma ɔhen mfa n’ahembaa dze no mma obi so a oye sen no.
Na sɛ ɔhen no mom a ɔbɛhyɛ no tahye n’ahendzi nyinara mu a, (osiandɛ ɔsõ) yernom nyinara bɛma hɔn kunnom enyidzi, akɛse na nkakraba nyina.
Na asɛm no yɛɛ ɔhen no na ne mbapɔmba no enyisɔ; na ɔhen no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Memucan n’asɛm no tse:

Osiandɛ ɔsomae ma wɔdze nwoma kɔrɔhen n’amansin nyinara mu, wɔdze kɔr ɔmansin biara mu dɛ mbrɛ ne kyerɛwee tse, na wɔdze kɔr ɔman biara mu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kasaa tse, dɛ ɔbarimba biara ondzi nankasa ne fi do ɔpanyin na ɔmfa ntahye dɛ mbrɛ ne man kasaa tse.
2: Nsɛm yi ekyir no, aber a ɔhen Ahasuerus n’ebufuhyew ano dwee no, nna ɔkãa Vashti na dza ɔyɛe no, na dza wɔhyɛɛ no mom tsiaa no no.
Nna ɔhen no nkowaa a wɔsom no no see dɛ, wɔmma wɔnhwehwɛ mbaabun a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw mma ɔhen:

Na wɔmma ɔhen nhyehyɛ ahwɛdofo wɔ ahendzi mu amansin nyinara mu ma wonhyiahyia mbaabun nkakraba a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw nyinara ma wɔmbra Shushan ahemfie, mbaa fi no mu, mfa nhyɛ ɔhen ne pianyi Hegai, mbaa weɔmfo no nsa: Na wɔmma wɔmfa hɔn ahofir ndzɛmba mma hɔn:
Na wɔmma ababaawa a ɔhen bɛpɛ no nyɛ ɔhembaa ndzi Vashti n’ananmu. Na asɛm no yɛɛ ɔhen enyisɔ; na ɔyɛɛ dɛm.
Afei Judahnyi bi wɔ Shushan ahemfie a ne dzin dze Mordecai, Jairiba no, Shimei ba no, Kish ba no, Benjaminnyi bi a
wɔfaa no fi Jerusalem kãa ndɔmmumfo a wɔfaa hɔn kãa Judahhen Jeconiah a Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar faa hɔn kɔree no ho.

Na ɔnyɛɛn no wɔfa ne babaa Hadassah, ɔno nye Esther: Osiandɛ onnyi egya na nã so, na ababaawa no no bɔfoma yɛ fɛw na n’enyim wɔ nyam; na aber a n’egya na ne nã wowui no, nna Mordecai faa no yɛɛ nankasa ne babaa.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔtsee ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm na no mom no, na aber a wohyiahyiaa mbabaawa pii baa Shushan ahemfie, bɛhyɛɛ Hegai nsa no, nna wɔfaa Esther so baa ɔhen no ne ne, dze no bɛhyɛɛ Hegai, mbaa weɔmfo no nsa.

Na ababaawa no sɔɔ n’enyi, na onyaa no hɔ ayamuyie; na ɔdze n’ahofir ndzɛmba, nye akyɛpɛn maa no ntsɛmara, na ɔdze mbabaawa beesuon a wɔfata dɛ wɔdze ma no, fi ɔhen ne fie maa no: Na oyii ɔno na ne mbabaawa no kɔr mbaa fi no mu beebi mbrɛ oye dodow.
Nna Esther nnkyerɛɛ ne man na n ebusuafo so. osiandɛ Mordecai abra no dɛ mma ɔnnkyerɛ.
Na da biara Mordecai kɛpasapasar mbaa fi no n'abangua no enyim, ma oeehu mbrɛ Esther apɔw mu tse, na dza wɔdze no bɛyɛ.

Afei aber a odur ababaawa biara no do dɛ ɔkɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus nkyɛn, dɛ ɔayɛ no dɛ mbrɛ mbaa mbra no tse abosoom duebien ekyir no (na mbrɛ hɔn ahofir nda no sõe, ɔnye dɛ wɔdze myrrh ngo dzi abosoom esia, na wɔdze nduhuam na ɔnye mbaa ahofir ndzɛmba dzii abosoom esia so);
nna ababaawa no dze no dɛm baa ɔhen nkyɛn, biribiara a ɔhwehwɛ no wɔdze ma no ma ɔdze fi mbaa fi no mu kɔ ɔhen no fie.
Ewimbir no na ɔkɔ, na anapa no ɔsan kɔ mbaa fi no a otsīa ebien no mu, wɔ ɔhen ne pianyi Shaashgaz a ɔhwɛ nwewefo no nsamu: Na ɔnnkɔ ɔhen no nkyɛn bio; gyedɛ ɔhen no pɛ n’asɛm na wɔbɔ ne dzin frɛ no.

Afei aber a odur Esther, Mordecai n'egya no nua Abihail ne babaa a ɔafa no ayɛ ne babaa no do dɛ ɔbɔkɔ ɔhen no nkyɛn no, oemmbisa hwee gyedɛ dza ɔhen pianyi Hegai, mbaa weɔmfo no hyɛe no. Na Esther nyaa enyimpa wɔ hɔn a wohun no nyinara enyi do.
Nna wɔfaa Esther kɔr ɔhen Ahaseurus nkyɛn wɔ n'ahemfie wɔ bosoom a otsia du no a ɔno nye bosoom Tebeth no mu, wɔ n’ahendzi mu afe a otsia esuon no mu.
Na ɔhen no dɔɔ Esther seen mbaa no nyinara, na onyaa adom na enyimpa wɔ n’enyim seen mbaabun no nyinara; ma ɔdze ahendzi no abɔtsir no bɔɔ ne tsir, na ɔyɛɛ no ɔhembaa dzii Vashti n’ananmu.
Nna ɔhen no too pon kɛsenara maa ne mbapɔmba na no nkowaa nyinara, mekyerɛ Esther aponto; na ɔmaa amansin no ahomgye, na ɔkyekyɛɛ adze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no n’ayamuyie tse.
Na aber a wohyiahyiaa mbaabun no otsia ebien no, nna Mordecai tse ɔhen no kuropon no mu.
Nna Esther nnyae nnkyerɛɛ n’ebusuafo na ne man so: Dɛ mbrɛ Mordecai abra no no: Osiandɛ Esther dzii Mordecai ne mbrasɛm do, dɛ aber a ɔrenyɛn no no.

Nda no mu no, mber a Mordecai tse ɔhen no kuropon no mu no, ɔhen n’epiafo no mu beenu, Bigthan na Teresh a wofi hɔn a wɔhwɛ abowano no mu no, hɔn bo fuwii, na wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔdze nsa to ɔhen Ahasuerus do.
Na asɛm no Mordecai tsee, na ɔno na ɔkɛkãa kyerɛɛ ɔhembaa Esther; na Esther dze Mordecai ne dzin dze kɛkãa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no.
Na aber a wɔhwehwɛɛ asɛm no mu, na wohun dɛ ɔtse dɛm no, wɔsɛɛn hɔn beenu nyinara wɔ dua do na wɔkyerɛew no wɔ mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu wɔ ɔhen no enyim.
3: Iyinom ekyir no ɔhen Ahasuerus yɛɛ Agagnyi Haman, Hammedatha ba no kɛse, na ɔmaa no do, na ɔdze n’egua sii ma ɔtraa mbapɔmba a wɔka no ho nyinara.
Na ɔhen no nkowaa a wɔtse ɔhen no kuropon no mu nyinara wɔbɔ hɔn mu adze, na wɔyɛ Haman enyidzi: Osiandɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no ɔahyɛ wɔ no ho nye no. Na Mordecai dze, ɔammbɔ no mu adze na ɔannyɛ no enyidzi.
Nna ɔhen no nkowaa a wɔtse ɔhen no kuropon no mu no, see Mordecai dɛ, ɔyɛ den ntsi na ɔwo etõ ɔhen ne mbrasɛm yi?
Afei ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔkãa kyerɛɛ no daa, na onntsie hɔn no, nna wɔkɛkãa kyerɛɛ Haman, dɛ wɔrohwɛ kyerɛ Mordecai ne nsɛm no begyina anaa: Osiandɛ ɔakã akyerɛ hɔn dɛ ɔyɛ Jewnyi.
Na aber a Haman hun dɛ Mordecai mmbɔ no mu adze, na eso ɔnnyɛ no enyidzi no, nna ebufuw hyɛɛ Haman mã.

Na obuu no ahobrɛadze dɛ ɔdze nsa bɔto Mordecai nko do, osiandɛ ɔakyerɛ no Mordecai ne man: Dɛm ntsi Haman hwehwɛɛ dɛ ɔsɛɛ Judahfo nyinara a wɔwɔ Ahasuerus n'ahenman nyinara mu, mekyerɛ Mordecai ne mamfo no.

Na bosoom a odzi kan a ɔno nye bosoom Nisan no, wɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus n’afe a otsīa duebien no mu no, wɔtwee Pur, ɔnye dɛ, tonto, wɔ Haman enyim ofi da si da do, na ofi bosoom si bosoom do, dze kodu bosoom a otsīa duebien no a ɔno nye bosoom Adar no do.

Na Haman see ɔhen Ahauerus dɛ, ɔman bi wɔ hɔ a wɔabɔ apetse na wɔatse hɔnho efi aman mu wɔ w’ahendzi n'amansin nyinara mu; na hɔn mbra yɛ soronko wɔ ɔman biara dze mu; nkyii so wonndzi ɔhen ne mbra do; dɛm ntsi onnye mma ɔhen dɛ ɔbɛma hɔn kwan.
Sɛ ɔhen bɛpɛ a, ɔmma wɔnkyerɛw ma wɔnsɛɛ hɔn: Na mibeker dwetɛ talent mpemdu mahyɛ hɔn a wɔhwɛ ɔhen n’edwuma do no nsa, dɛ wɔmfa mbogu ɔhen n'adzekoradze no mu.
Na ɔhen no yii ne mpɛtsea wɔ ne nsa, na ɔdze maa Agagnyi Haman, Hammedatha ba no, Jewfo tamfo no.
Na ɔhen no see Haman dɛ, dwetɛ no wɔdze ama wo, ɔman no so, dɛ yɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ ehwɛ w’enyi do dɛ oye no ara.

Nna wɔfrɛfrɛɛ ɔhen n’akyerɛwfo no wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu, wɔ ne da a otsia duebiasa no mu, na wɔkyerɛɛw no dɛ mbrɛ Haman hyɛe no nyinara dze kɛmaa ɔhen n'amansindo-ahwɛfo, na ambradofo a wɔhwɛ ɔmansin biara do, na ɔman biara mu mbapɔmba; ɔmansin biara dɛ mbrɛ ne kyerɛw tse, na ɔman biara, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kasaa tse; ɔhen Ahasuerus dzin mu na wɔdze kyerɛwee, na wɔdze ɔhen no ne mpɛtsea sɔɔw ano.

Na wɔdze nwoma no somasomae ma embirikatufo dze kɔr ɔhen n’amansin nyinara mu dɛ, wɔnsɛɛ, wonkuku, na wɔnhera Jewfo nyinara, mberantsɛ na nkɔdaa nyina, mbofra nkakraba na mbaa so da kor mu, mekyerɛ bosoom a otsia duebien no a ɔno nye bosoom Adar no, ne da a otsia duebiasa no, na wɔmfa hɔn asadze nyɛ afonam.
Kyerɛw no no nsusudo a wɔdze kɛhyɛɛ mom no wɔ ɔmansin biara mu no, wɔdaa no edzi maa ɔman nyinara, dɛ wonsiesie hɔnho nsie da no.
Embirikatufo no nam ɔhen ne mbrasɛm do fiir edzi ntsɛmara na wɔhyɛɛ mom no wɔ Shushan ahemfie; na ɔhen no na Haman tsenatsenaa famu dɛ wɔrobɔnom nsã; na Shushan kurow no mu dze ayɛ bisibisibasaa.
4: Afei aber a Mordecai hun dza wɔayɛ nyinara no, nna Mordecai tsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔdze eyitam ɔnye nso kataa noho, na ofiir edzi kɔr kurow no ne finimfin, na ɔdze nkekamu dzendzen a ɔyɛ wen sūi:
Na ɔkɔr ɔhen no no kuropon no enyim mpo: Osiandɛ obiara nnyi ho kwan dɛ ofura eyitam dze hɛn ɔhen no no kuropon mu.
Na ɔmansin biara mu beebiara mbrɛ ɔhen ne mbrasɛm na no mom no durii no, nkɔmbɔdzi kɛse baa hɔ wɔ Jewfo no mu, na mbuadadzi, na osū, na osukwadwom, na dodowara deda eyitam na nso mu.
Na Esther ne mbabaawa na ne mpiafo no bae bɛkãa kyerɛɛ no; na ɔhembaa no no werɛ hoow mbordo: Na ɔsomaa dɛ wɔmfa atar nkɛhyɛ Mordecai, na wonyi eyitam wɔ no ho: Na ɔanngye.
Nna Esther kɛfrɛɛ Hathach, ɔhen n’epiafo no mu baako a woeyi no dɛ ɔnhwɛ no no, na ɔsomaa no dɛ ɔnkɔ Mordecai nkyɛn.
Nna Hathach fiir edzi kɔr Mordecai nkyɛn wɔ kurow no ne bea tɛtɛr no a ɔwɔ ɔhen no kuropon enyim no do.
Na Mordecai kãa dza aba no do nyinara kyerɛɛ no, na sika dodow a Haman abɔ anohoba dɛ osian Jewfo ntsi obeker egu ɔhen n'akoradze mu, ma wɔaasɛɛ hɔn no.

Eso ɔdze mom no a wɔhyɛɛ no wɔ Shushan dɛ wɔnsɛɛ hɔn no ne kyerɛw saso maa no, dɛ ɔmfa nkyerɛ Esther na ɔnkã nkyerɛ no; na ɔnhyɛ no dɛ ɔnkɔ ɔhen nkyɛn, nkɔtotɔ nserɛ no na ombisa adze wɔ n’enyim mma ne man.
Na Hathach bae bɛkãa Mordecai ne nsɛm no kyerɛɛ Esther.
Nna Esther kasaa kyerɛɛ Hathach, na ɔmaa no nkra wɔ Mordecai nkyɛn, dɛ;

ɔhen no nkowaa nyinara, na ɔhen n’amansin nkorɔfo nyinara, nyim dɛ obiara, ɔbarimba o, ɔbaa o, ɔbɛba ɔhen nkyɛn wɔ fie afamu abanguado a wɔammfrɛ no no, mbra kor pɛr na ɔwɔ hɔ ma no, dɛ wonku no, gyedɛ nyia ɔhen bɛtsen sika ahempoma akyerɛ no dɛ ɔntsena ase no: Na wɔmmfrɛ me dɛ monkɔ ɔhen nkyɛn adaduasa yi.
Na wɔkɛkãa Esther ne nsɛm no dze kyerɛɛ Mordecai.
Nna Mordecai hyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔmfa mbuae nsan nkɛma Esther dɛ, mma nsusu wo tsirmu dɛ ɔwo befi mu efi wɔ ahem fie, asen Jewfo no nyinara.

Na sɛ ɔwo imua w’ano koraa wɔ aber yi mu a, ɔnodze mboa na ɔgye bɔsoɛr efi beebi fofor so ama Jewfo, na ɔwo na w’egya fi dze wɔbɛsɛɛ: Na woana na onyim dɛ aber a ɔtse dɛm yi ntsi na wo nsa akã ahendzi no?
Nna Esther kãa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ wonkobua Mordecai dɛ,

kɔ, kɔpon Jewfo a wohu hɔn wɔ Shushan nyinara hyia, na hom ndzi mbuada wɔ me ntsi, na mma hom nndzidzi na wɔnnom so ndaansa, adzesaa na adzekyee: Emi so na me mbabaawa so bedzi mbuada dɛmara; na medze no dɛm makɔ ɔhen nkyɛn a ɔnnam mbra kwan do: Na sɛ mehera a, mahera.
Nna Mordecai sii mu kɔr no kwan, na ɔkɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Esther hyɛɛ no no nyinara.
5: Afei ɔbaa dɛ da a otsīa ebiasa no, nna Esther hyɛɛ ahembaa ntar, na okegyinaa ahemfie fie afamu abanguado, wɔ ɔhen ne dan no ne tsentsendo.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen no hun ɔhembaa Esther dɛ ogyina abangua no do no, nna onyaa n’enyim enyimnyam: Na ɔhen no tseen sika anempoma a ɔdze ne nsamu no kyerɛɛ Esther. Nna Esther twee pinii, na obosuoo ahempoma no tsir.
Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, ɔhembaa Esther, erohwehwɛ bɛn na w’ebisadze nye bɛn? Na sɛ oduahendzi no ne fã mpo a, wɔdze bɛma wo.
Na Esther see dɛ, sɛ oye wɔ ɔhen enyi do a, wɔmma ɔhen na Haman mbra pon a moroto ama no ho ndɛ da yi.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, hom mma Haman mbra ntsɛm, na wɔnyɛ no dɛ mbrɛ Esther akã no. Nna ɔhen no na Haman baa pon a Esther ato no ho.
Na ɔhen no see Esther wɔ nsã aponto no ho dɛ, w'adzeserɛ nye bɛn? na wɔmfa mma wo: Na w’ahwehwɛdze nye bɛn? Odu ahendzi no ne fã mpo a, wɔbɛyɛ.
Nna Esther buae see dɛ, m’adzeserɛ na m’ahwehwɛdze nye dɛ;
sɛ menya ɔhen enyim enyimpa, na sɛ ɔhen pɛ dɛ ɔbɛma m’adzeserɛ, na ɔayɛ m'ahwehwɛdze a, wɔmma ɔhen na Haman mbra pon a morobɔto hɔn no ho, na ɔkyena mebɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen ase no.
Nna da no Haman dze enyigye na akoma pa fiir edzi: Na aber a Haman hun Mordecai wɔ ɔhen no kuropon no mu, dɛ ɔannsoɛr enngyina, na eso oennhima noho amma no no, nna ebufuw hyɛɛ no mã wɔ Mordecai ho.
Naaso Haman konkoom noho do, na osii mu kor ne fie, na ɔsomae ma wɔkɛfrɛfrɛɛ ne mfɛfo na ne yer Zeresh ma wɔbae.
Na Haman kãa n’ahonya enyimnyam, na ne mba dodow, na ndzɛmba nyinara a ɔhen no ayɛ no kɛse wɔ mu, na mbrɛ oesi na ɔama no do abɔ mbapɔmba na ɔhen no nkowaa no do no, kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Nkyii so Haman see dɛ, nyew, ɔhembaa Esther ɔamma nyimpa biara annkã ɔhen ho am mba pon a ɔtoe no ho gyedɛ mara; na ɔkyena so oehyia emi na ɔhen wɔ ne nkyɛn.
Naaso iyi nyinara nndɔɔ sõ mma me, aber tsentsen ara a muhu Jewnyi Mordecai no dɛ ɔtse ɔhen no kuropon mu yi.

Nna ne yer Zeresh na ne mfɛfo no nyinara see ne dɛ, ma wɔnyɛ asɛndua ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonum, na ɔkyena anapa kã kyerɛ ɔhen ma wɔnsen Mordecai wɔ do: Na nkyii ɔwo nye ɔhen nkɔ aponto no ho enyigye mu. Na asɛm no yɛɛ Haman enyisɔ; na ɔmaa wɔyɛɛ asɛndua no.
6: Anago no ɔhen no ne nda fii no do, na ɔhyeɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa mbermunsɛm nkaanwoma no mbra, na wɔkenkaan no wɔ ɔhen no enyim.
Na wohun dɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ Mordecai na ɔbɛkãa Bigthana na Teresh, ɔhen n’epiafo beenu no a wofi hɔn a wɔhwɛ abowano no mu no a wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔdze nsa to ɔhen Ahasuerus do no, ho asɛm no.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ ebɛn enyidzi na kɛseyɛ na wɔdze ayɛ Mordecai wɔ iyi ho? Nna ɔhen no nkowaa a wɔsom no no see dɛ, wɔnnyɛ hwee mma no.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Woana na ɔwɔ abangua no do? Afei na Haman aba ɔhen ne fie no ekyir abangua no do, dɛ ɔrebɛkã akyerɛ ɔhen ma wɔaasɛn Mordecai wɔ asɛndua no a oesi ama no no do.
Na ɔhen no nkowaa no see no dɛ, hwɛ, Haman gyina abangua no do. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, wɔmma ɔmbra dan mu.
Nna Haman baa dan mu. Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, ebɛnadze na wɔmfa nyɛ nyimpa a ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi no? Afei Haman see wɔ n’akoma mu dɛ, woana mpo na ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi sen mara?
Na Haman see ɔhen no dɛ, nyimpa a ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi no,
ma wɔmfa ahentar a ɔhen tɔ dɛ ɔhyɛ no mbra, na ɔpɔnkɔ a ɔhen tɔ dɛ ɔtsena do no a wɔdze ahendzi abɔtsir abɔ ne tsir no,

na ma wɔmfa a tar na ɔpɔnkɔ no nhyɛ ɔhen ne mbapɔmba ekunyin no mu baako ne nsa, ma wɔmfa nhyɛ nyimpa a ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi no, na wɔmma ɔntsena ɔpɔnkɔ no do mfa kurow no n’abɔntsen do, na wɔmpaa ndzi n’enyim dɛ, mbrɛ wɔdze bɛyɛ nyimpa a ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi no, nye yi oo.
Nna ɔhen no see Haman dɛ, ka woho kɛfa atar na ɔpɔnkɔ no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔwoara ase no, na yɛ dɛmara ma Jewnyi Mordecai no a ɔtse ɔhen no kuropon mu no: Mma mma nngyaa dza akã no nyinara mu biara.

Nna Haman faa atar no na ɔpɔnkɔ no, na ɔdze hyehyɛɛ Mordecai, na ɔmaa ɔtsenaa ɔpɔnkɔ do dze faa kurow no n’abɔntsen do, na wɔpaae dzii n’enyim dɛ, mbrɛ wɔdze bɛyɛ nyia ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi no nye yi oo.
Na Mordecai sanee baa ɔhen no kuropon no mu bio. Na Haman dze, ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm dze nkɔmbodzi na ne tsir do a wɔakata, kɔr ne fie.

Na Haman kãa dza aba no do no nyinara kyerɛɛ ne yer Zeresh na ne mfɛfo no nyinara. Nna n'enyansafo no na ne yer Zeresh see no dɛ, sɛ Mordecai a ɔwo ahyɛ ase rohwe famu wɔ n’enyim yi, ofi Jewfo asefo mu a, ɔno irunntum nndzi no do nyim, mbom ase ara na ebɔhwe wɔ n’enyim.
Aber a wɔnye no da do rekasa no, nna ɔhen n’epiafo no bae, na wɔpɛɛ ntsɛm dɛ wɔdze Haman bɔkɔ pon no a Esther ato no ho.
7: Nna ɔhen no na Haman baa dɛ wɔnye ɔhembaa Esther robɔto pon.
Na ɔhen no see Esther da a otsia ebien no mu so, wɔ nsã aponto no ho dɛ, ɔhembaa Esther w’adzeserɛ nye bɛn? Na wɔmfa mma wo: Na w’ahwehwɛdze nye bɛn? Odu ahendzi yi ne fã mpo a, wɔbɛyɛ.
Nna ɔhembaa Esther buae see dɛ ɔhen, sɛ menya w’enyim enyimpa, na sɛ ɔhen pɛ a, ma wɔmfa mo nkwa mma me wɔ adzeserɛ yi do, na me man wɔ adzeserɛ yi do:
Na wɔatɔn hɛn, emi na me man, dɛ wɔnsɛɛ hɛn, nkuku hɛn. Na sɛ wɔtontɔɔn hɛn yɛɛ nkowaa na mfonabaa a, nkyɛ memua m'ano, naaso ɔyɛfo no runntum nnhyɛ ɔhen n’adze a ɔbɛsɛɛ no ananmu.
Nna ɔhen Ahasuerus buae see ɔhembaa Esther dɛ, woana nye no, na hen na ɔwɔ, na n’akoma ara ahyɛ no mu ma dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dɛm no?
Na Esther see dɛ, ɔyɛfo na ɔtamfo bi a, mekyerɛ Haman otsiɔdzennyi yi a. Nna Haman n’akoma tui wɔ ɔhen no na ɔhembaa no enyim.

Na ɔhen no soɛree wɔ n’ebufuw no mu fii nsã aponto no ho, na osii mu kɔr ahemfi ture no mu; na Haman soɛree gyinaa dɛ ɔrepa no nkwa ho kyɛw wɔ ɔhembaa Esther hɔ, osiandɛ ohun dɛ ohen no abɔ no ho pɔw bɔn.

Nna ɔhen no sanee fii ahemfie ture no mu baa beebi mbrɛ nsã pon no wɔ no; nna Haman ahwe kootsi a Esther wɔ do no do. Nna ɔhen no see dɛ, ana ɔrebɛhyɛ ɔhembaa mpo so wɔ m’enyim wɔ ofi yi mu? Aber a asɛm no fii ɔhen no n’anomu puei ara, nna wɔkataa Haman n’enyim.

Nna Harbonah, epiafo a wɔwɔ ɔhen no n’enyim no mu baako no, see dɛ, eso hwɛ, asɛndua a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonum a Haman ayɛ ama Mordecai a ɔkãa ɔhen ho asempa no, osi Haman fie, ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonum. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, hom nkɛsɛn no wɔ do.
Nna wɔsɛɛn Haman wɔ asɛndua a oesiesie ama Mordecai no do. Nna ɔhen no n’ebufuw ano dwee.
8: Da no ara na ɔhen Ahasuerus dze Haman, Jewfo tamfo no, ne fi maa ɔhembaa Esther. Na Mordecai baa ɔhen no n’enyim; osiandɛ Esther akã mbrɛ ɔnye ne ntamu tse.
Na ɔhen no worɔɔw ne mpɛtsea a ɔgyee no Haman nsamu no, na ɔdze maa Mordecai. Na Esther dze Mordecai sii Haman fi no do.
Na Esther kasae wɔ ɔhen no n’enyim, na otwae hwee n'ananadze, na ɔdze nyinsuwa totɔe serɛɛ no dɛ onyi Agagnyi Haman no mbusu na ne tsirmpɔw a ɔbɔɔ no wɔ Jewfo no ho no.
Nna ɔhen no tseen sika ahempoma no kyerɛɛ Esther. Nna Esther soɛree, na ogyinaa ɔhen no enyim.

Na ɔsee dɛ, sɛ ɔhen pɛ, na sɛ menya n’enyim enyimpa, na asɛm no tsen wɔ ɔhen enyim, na mo so miye wɔ n’enyiwa do a, ɔno ma wɔnkyerɛw nkɛsan nwoma no a Agagnyi Haman, Hammedatha ba no, bɔɔ no pɔw a ɔkyerɛɛw dɛ ɔdze rekɛsɛɛ Jewfo a wɔwɔ ɔhen n'amansin no nyinara mu no;
na mebɛyɛ dɛn na metum atsena hɔ mahwɛ mbusu a ɔbeba me man do? Na mebeyɛ dɛn na metum atsena hɔ mahwɛ m’ebusuafo hɔn nsɛɛe?
Nna ɔhen Ahasuerus see ɔhembaa Esther na Jewnyi Mordecai no dɛ, hwɛ medze Haman fi mama Esther na ɔnoara so wɔasɛn no wɔ asɛndua no do, osiandɛ ɔdze ne nsa too Jewfo no do ntsi.

Hom so nkyerɛw nkɛma Jewfo no, dɛ mbrɛ homara wɔpɛ, wɔ ɔhen no ne dzin mu, na wɔmfa ɔhen no ne mpɛtsea no nsɔw ano: Osiandɛ kyerɛw a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ ɔhen ne dzin mu, na wɔdze ɔhen ne mpɛtsea asɔw ano no, nyimpa biara nndan no.

Nna wɔfrɛfrɛɛ ɔhen n’akyerɛwfo no aber no mu, bosoom a otsīa ebiasa no a, ɔno nye bosoom Sivan no, na da a otsīa eduonu ebiasa no mu: Na wɔkyerɛɛw no dɛ mbrɛ Mordecai hyɛe no nyinara dze kɛmaa Jewfo no, na amansin do ahwɛfo na ambradofo na amansin mu mbapɔmba no a wɔwɔ India dze kodu Ethiopia, amansin ɔha eduonu esuon, ɔmansin biara dɛ mbrɛ ne nkyerɛwee tse, na ɔman biara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kasaa tse, na Jewfo no so dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkyerɛwee na hɔn kasaa tse.

Na ɔdze ɔhen Ahasuerus ne dzin na ɔdze kyerɛwee na ɔdze ɔhen no ne mpɛtsea sɔɔw ano, na ɔdze nwoma no somasomaa embirikatufo a wɔtsetse mpɔnkɔ do, na wɔtsetse nsoasompɔnkɔ a hɔn ho yɛ har a wɔdze hɔn yɛ ɔhen n’edwuma no a wɔanyɛn hɔn mpɔnkɔban mu do:

No mu na ɔhen no maa Jewfo a wɔwɔ kurow biara mu kwan dɛ wɔmpon hɔnho nhyia, na hɔn nkwa ntsi wongyina hɔ, na wɔnsɛɛ, wonkuku na wɔmma ɔman na ɔmansin a wobehiahia hɔn ho no, hɔn tum nyinara nhera, hɔn mbofraba na mbaa, wɔmfa hɔn asadze nyɛ afonam,
da kor mu wɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus n'amansin nyinara mu, ɔnye dɛ, wɔ bosoom a otsīa duebien no a ono nye bosoom Adar no, ne da a otsia duebiasa no mu.
Nkyerɛwee no no nsusudo a wɔdze kɛhyɛɛ mom no wɔ ɔmansin biara mu no, wɔdaa no edzi maa aman nyinara, dɛ Jewfo no nsiesie hɔnho nsie da no ma woeedzi hɔn atamfo wer.
Nna embirikatufo a wɔtsetse asoaso mpɔnkɔ a hɔn ho yɛ har a wɔdze hɔn yɛ wɔ ɔhen n’edwuma no do no, wɔnam ɔhen ne mbrasɛm do sii mu kɔree; na ɔmom no wɔhyɛɛ no wɔ Shushan ahemfie.
Na Mordecai fiir edzi fii ɔhen no enyim dɛ ɔhyɛ ahentar bibir na fufuw, na ɔnye sika ahenkyɛw kɛse, na ɔnye ndwera fɛɛfɛw na ɔberdum bataker: Na Shushan kurow no dzii ehurusi na hɔn enyi gyee.
Na Jewfo no nyaa kan na enyigye, na ahosɛpɛw na enyidzi.

Na kurow biara mu, beebiara mbrɛ ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm na no mom no durii no, Jewfo no nyaa enyigye na ahosɛpɛw, aponto na da-pa-dzi. Na asaase no do aman no mu nyimpa dodo war a bɛyɛɛ Jewfo; osiande Jewfo no ho suro akã hɔn.
9: Afei bosoom a otsia duebien no a ɔno nye bosoom Adar no, ɔnoara mu da a otsia duebiasa no a ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm na no mom no dur dɛ wodzii do no, da no ara a Jewfo hɔn atamfo enyi daa kwan dɛ wobedzi hɔn do tum; naaso ɔdaan dɛ Jewfo no mbom na wonyaa hɔn a wɔtaan hɔn no do tum no.

Jewfo poon hɔnho hyiaa hɔn nkurow mu, wɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus n’amansin nyinara mu, dɛ wɔdze nsa rubogu hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ hɔn nsɛɛe no do: Na nyimpa biara enntum ennsiw hɔn kwan; osiandɛ hɔn ho suro akã ɔman no nyinara.
Na amansin no mu mbapɔmba, na amansin do ahwɛfo, na ambradofo, na hɔn a wɔyɛ ɔhen n’edwuma no nyinara, boaa Jewfo no; osiandɛ Mordecai ho suro akã hɔn.
Na Mordecai yɛɛ nyimpa kɛse wɔ ɔhen no ne fie, na ne nka tahyee amansin no nyinara mu: Na ɔbarimba Mordecai no ɔdze no akɛseyɛ ara.
Na Jewfo no dze afõwa ano, na oku na ɔsɛɛ dze kãa hɔn atamfo nyinara gya, na wɔyɛɛ hɔn a wɔtan hɔn no dza wɔpɛ.
Na Shushan ahenfie mu no Jewfo no kumii na wɔsɛɛ mbarimba ahaenum.
Na Parshandatha, na Dalphon, na Aspatha,
na Poratha, na Adalia, na Aridatha,
na Parmashta, na Arisai, na Aridai, na Vaizatha,
Jewfo tamfo Haman, Hammedatha ba no ne mbabanyin du no so, wokunkum hɔn; na asadze no dze wɔammfa hɔn nsa annkã.
Da no ara hɔn a wokunkum hɔn wɔ Shushan ahemfi no mu no dodow no wɔdze bɔtoo ɔhen no enyim.

Na ɔhen no see ɔhembaa Esther dɛ, Jewfo no woekuku na wɔasee mbarimba ahaenu wo Shushan ahemfi no mu, na Haman ne mbabanyin du; na ebɛnadze so na wɔayɛ no wɔ ɔhen no n’amansin nkaa no mu? Afei w’adzeserɛ nye bɛn? Na wɔmfa mma wo.
Nna Esther see dɛ, sɛ ɔhen pɛ a, ɔmma wɔmma Jewfo a wɔwɔ Shushan no kwan ma ɔkyena so wɔnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ndɛ da yi ɔmom no tse, na ma wɔnsensɛn Haman mbabanyin du no wɔ asɛndua no do.
Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ dɛ wɔnyɛ no dɛm: Na wɔhyɛɛ mom wɔ Shushan; na wɔsensɛn Haman ne mbabanyin du no.
Na Jewfo a wɔwɔ Shushan no poon hɔnho hyiae wɔ bosoom Adar ne da a otsīa duanan no mu so, na wokunkum mbarimba ahaasa wɔ Shushan: Na asadze no dze, wɔammfa hɔn nsa annkã.

Na Jewfo nkaa no a wɔwɔ ɔhen no n’amansin mu no poon hɔnho hyiae, na hɔn nkwa ntsi wogyinae, na wonyaa hɔn atamfo ho ahomgye, na wokunkum hɔn a wokyiir hɔn no mu nyimpa mpemeduosuon enum; na asadze no dze, wɔammfa hɔn nsa annkã.
Iyi wɔyɛɛ no wɔ bosoom Adar ne da a otsīa duebiasa no mu, na ɔnoara ne da a otsīa duanan no mu, na wɔgyee hɔn ahom, na wɔyɛɛ no aponto na enyigye da.
Na Jewfo a wɔwɔ Shushan no boaa ano hyiae wɔ ne da a otsia duebiasa no, na ne da a otsia duanan no; na ɔnoara ne da a otsia duenum no na wonyaa ahomgye, na wɔyɛɛ no aponto na enyigye da.
Dɛm ntsi na Jewfo a wɔwɔ nkurobaase no a wɔtse tse nkuroba a wɔammbɔ ho ban no mu no, wɔyɛɛ bosoom Adar ne da a otsia duanan no enyigye na aponto da, na da pa, na da a wɔdze adze metna hɔnho nkorkor.
Na Mordecai kyerɛɛw nsɛm yi, na ɔsomasomae ma wɔdze nwoma kɛmemaa Jewfo nyinara a wɔwɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus n’amansin nyinara mu no, hɔn a wɔbɛn na hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyirkyir nyina,
dɛ ɔdze rehyɛ hɔn dɛ wondzi bosoom Adar ne da a otsia duanan na ɔnoara ne da a otsia duenum no, afrenhyia afrenhyia,

dɛ nda a Jewfo nyaa mu ahomgye wɔ hɔn atamfo nsamu, na bosoom a wɔdaan no fi awerɛhow mu kɔr enyigye mu, na ofi nkɔmbɔdzi mu kɔr da pa mu maa hɔn no: Dɛ wɔmfa nyɛ aponto na enyigye, na ɔbaako na ɔbaako adzema, na ehiafo adzekyɛ nda.
Na Jewfo no suoo mu dɛ wɔbɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ Mordecai akyerew akɛma hɔn no;
osiandɛ Agagriyi Haman, Hammedatha ba no, Jewfo no nyinara tamfo no, bɔɔ Jewfo no ho pɔw dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ hɔn, na ɔtwee Pur, ɔnye dɛ, tonto, dɛ ɔbɛhyew hɔn, na ɔasɛɛ hon;
na aber a asɛm no dur ɔhen no enyim no, nna ɔnam nwoma do hyɛɛ dɛ no pɔw bɔn a ɔbɔɔ no wɔ Jewfo no ho no ɔnsan mbobua nankasa n’etsifi; na dɛ wɔnsɛn ɔno na ne mba wɔ asɛndua no do no.
Dɛm ntsi osian nwoma yi mu nsɛm no nyinara, na dza wohun no wɔ asɛm yi mu, na dza aba hɔn do no ntsi,

Jewfo no hyehyɛe, na wɔgyee too hɔn do, na hɔn asefo do, na hɔn a wɔdze hɔnho kɔbɔɔ hɔn ho no nyinara do, dɛ orunntwa mu, dɛ wobedzi nda ebien yi dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kyerɛw, na hɔn mber a wɔahyɛ no tse, afrenhyia biara mu;
na dɛ wɔnkaa nda yi, na wondzi no wɔ mbasantsen biara, ebusua biara, ɔmansin biara, na kurow biara mu, na dɛ Purim nda yi mma ɔmmpa wɔ Jewfo no mu, na ne nkaa so mmbɔ adze wɔ hɔn asefo mu.
Nna ɔhembaa Esther, Abihail ne babaa no, na Jewnyi Mordecai, wɔdze tum nyinara kyerɛwee dɛ wɔdze Purim nwoma a otsia ebien yi etsim.
Na ɔsomae ma wɔdze nwoma kɛmemaa Jewfo nyinara, dze kɔr Ahasuerus n’ahendzi amansin ɔha eduonu esuon no mu, wɔdze asomdwee na nokwardzi nsɛm,

dɛ wɔdze rema Purim nda yi etsim wɔ ne mber a wɔahyehyɛ no mu, dɛ mbrɛ Jewnyi Mordecai na ɔhembaa Esther ama etsim hɔn mu no, na dɛ mbrɛ wɔama mbuadadzi na hɔn sufrɛ ho asɛm no mu, ama hɔnho na hɔn asefo no.
Na Esther ne mbrasɛm no maa Purim nsɛm yi tsi mii; na wɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ nwoma no mu.
10: Na ɔhen Ahasuerus dze asaasetow too asaase no na po mu nsupɔw no do.
Na no tum na ne mbanyindze ho asɛm nyinara, na Mordecai n'akɛseyɛ a ɔhen no maa ɔyɛe no no ho asɛm no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Media na Persia ahemfo hɔn mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?

Osiandɛ Jewnyi Mordecai no nye nyia otsia ebien a odzi ɔhen Ahasuerus n’ekyir, na ɔyɛ nyimpa kɛse wɔ Jewfo mu, na no nuanom nyimpadodow no penee no; ɔhwehwɛɛ ne man ne yieyɛ, na ɔkãa asomdwee kyerɛɛ n’asefo nyinara.

1: Na Israel mbabanyin a wɔbaa Egypt no hɔn edzin nye yi; ɔbanyin biara nye ne fifo kaa Jacob ho bae.
Reuben, Simoen, Levi, nye Judah;
Issachar, Zebulun, nye Benjamin;
Dan nye Naphtali, Gad nye Asher.
Na akra a wofi Jacob asen mu nyinara wɔyɛ akra eduodun: Na Joseph wɔ Egypt dada.
Na Joseph, nye no nuanom nyinara, wuwuii.
Na Israelmba no wowoe, na wɔdɔɔr menyamenya, na hɔn dodow dɔɔ sõ, na hɔn ho yɛɛ dzen papaara; na wɔhyɛɛ asaase no do mã.
Na ɔhen forfor bi soɛree wɔ Egypt a onnyim Joseph.
Na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ ne man dɛ, hwɛ, Israelmba man no dɔɔ sõ, na hɔn ho yɛ dzen sen hɛn:
Hom mbra ma yɛnye hɔn ndzi no nyansa mu, amma wɔaanndɔɔ sõ, na aammba dɛ sɛ ɔsa bi ba a, wɔaannkɛka hɛn atamfo ho nye hɛn ammbɔkõ, na woeenntu emmfi asaase yi do annkɔ.
Dɛm ntsi wɔhyehyɛɛ abɔmbaafo wɔ hɔn do dɛ wɔmma hɔn ndzesoadze nhyɛ hɔn do. Na wɔkyekyeer adzekora nkurow, Pithom nye Raamses, maa Pharaoh.
Na dodow a wɔtseetsee hɔn no, dodow a wɔdɔree na dodow a wɔtrɛe nye no. Na Israelmba ho nketsenketse kyeer hɔn.
Na Egyptfo yɛɛ Israelmba ma wodzii sohia:
Na wɔmaa hɔn asetena foon hɔn wɔ ndwumadzen mu, wɔ dɛtse nye ntayaa, nye hamudwuma ahorow nyinara mu, hɔn som a wɔmaa wodzii mu sohia nyinara mu.
Na Egypthen no kasaa kyerɛɛ Hebrewfo awogyefo a hɔn mu kor ne dzin dze Shiphrah, na ɔbaako so ne dzin dze Puah no:
Na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ hom hu wɔ awoo-egua no do dɛ ɔyɛ ɔbanyin a, ɔno hom nku no; na sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbabaa a, ɔno ɔntsena ase.
Na awogyefo no suroo Nyankopɔn, na wɔannyɛ dɛ mbrɛ Egypthen no hyɛɛ hɔn no, na mbom wɔgyee mbanyimba no nkwa.
Na Egypthen no frɛɛ awogyefo no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom ayɛ dɛm adze yi, na hom agye mbabanyimba no nkwa yi?
Na awogyefo no see Pharaoh dɛ, osiandɛ Hebrewfo mbaa no wɔnntse dɛ Egyptfo mbaa; na hɔndze wɔyɛ pirim pirim, na awogyefo nnyae nndur hɔn nkyɛn ara na wɔawo dada.
Na Nyankopɔn nye awogyefo no dzii no yie: Na nkorɔfo no hɔn dodow dɔɔ sõ, na hɔn ho yɛɛ dzin pii.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, awogyefo no suroo Nyankopɔn ntsi, ɔkyekyeer efi maa hɔn.
Na Pharaoh braa no nkorɔfo nyinara dɛ, ɔbabanyin biara a wɔbɔwo no no, hom nkɔtow no nkyen esutsen no mu, na ɔbabaa biara hom mma ɔntsena ase.
2: Na ɔbanyin bi fi Levi fir kɔwaar Levi babaa bi.
Na ɔbaa no nyinsenii, na ɔwoo ɔbabanyin: Na ohun dɛ ɔyɛ abofra a no ho yɛ fɛw no, ɔdze no sumaa obosoom ebisa.
Na ɔdze no suma bio a ɔnnyɛ no, ɔfaa mbɛw adakaba, na ɔdze hua na ɔnye aman seraam no maa no: Na ɔdze abofra no too mu, na ɔdze kesii atsen no mu wɔ esutsen no no nkɔkɔnoa.
Na n'akyerɛbaa gyinaa ekyirkyir, dɛ ɔrohwɛ dza ɔbɛyɛ no.
Na Pharaoh babaa sianee baa esutsen no ho dɛ oruboguar; na ne mbaawa pasaar esutsen no nkyɛn; na ohun adaka no wɔ atsen no mu, na ɔsomaa n'abaawa dɛ ɔnkɛfa mbra.
Na obuee do, na ohun abofra no: Na, hwɛ, akɔkowaba no suii. Na ohun no mbɔbɔr, na ɔsee dɛ, Hebrewfo mba no kor nye yi.
Nna n'ekyerɛbaa no see Pharaoh babaa no dɛ, Ana monkɔ menkɛfrɛ Hebrewfo mbaa no mu onufomafo mbrɛ wo, ma ɔmma abofra no enumfo mma wo anaa?
Na Pharaoh babaa no see no dɛ, kɔ. Na akataasia no kɔree kɛfrɛɛ abofra no ne nã.
Na Pharaoh babaa no see no dɛ, Fa abofra yi kɔ, na kɛma no enumfo ma me, na medze w'akatua bɛma wo. Na ɔbaa no faa abofra no, na ɔkɛmaa no enumfo.
Na abofra no nyinii, na ɔdze no brɛɛ Pharaoh babaa no, na ɔbɛyɛɛ ne babanyin. Na ɔtoo no dzin Moses, na ɔsee dɛ, Osiandɛ mefaa no nsu mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu no, aber a Moses nyinii no, afiir edzi kɔr no nuanom nkyɛn, na ɔkɔhwɛɛ hɔn ndzesoadze: Na ohun dɛ Egyptnyi bi robɔ Hebrewnyi bi, no nuanom mo baako.
Na ɔhwɛɛ ha hwɛɛ ha, na ohun dɛ nyimpa bi nnyi hɔ no, ɔbɔɔ Egyptnyi no, na ɔdze no hyɛɛ anhwea mu.
Na n'adzekyee no ofiir edzi, na, hwɛ, Hebrewfo beenu rokõ: Na ɔsee nyia odzi fɔ no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ebɔ wo nyɛnko yi?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Woana yɛɛ wo ɔpanyin nye ɔsɛndzifo wɔ hɛn do? Edwen dɛ iruboku me dɛ mbrɛ ikum Egyptnyi no anaa? Na Moses suroi, na ɔsee dɛ, Ampara asɛm no epue.
Na afei Pharaoh tsee asɛm yi no, ɔhwehwɛɛ Moses eku no. Na Moses guanee fii Pharaoh enyim, na ɔkɛtsenaa Midian asaase do: Na ɔkɔkoo nsubura bi ho.
Afei so Midian ɔsɔfo no wɔ mbabaa beesuon; na wɔbae bɔtoow nsu, na wɔdze hyehyɛɛ ndaasee no amaama dɛ wɔrema hɔn egya nguan anom.
Na nguanhwɛfo bae beyii hɔn edzi: Na Moses soɛree boaa hɔn, na ɔmaa hɔn nguan no nomee.
Na wɔbaa hɔn egya Reuel nkyɛn no, ɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na ndɛ hom aba ntsɛm dɛm yi?
Na wɔsee dɛ, Egyptnyi bi na oyii hɛn fii nguanhwɛfo no nsamu, na ɔtoow nsu mpo maa hɛn, na ɔmaa nguan no nomee.
Na ɔsee ne mbabaa no dɛ, Na ɔwɔ hen? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom adan ɔbanyin no egya yi? Wɔkɛfrɛɛ no ma ombedzidzi.
Na Moses peen dɛ ɔnye ɔbanyin no bɛtsena: Na ɔdze ne babaa zipporah maa Moses.
Na ɔwoo ɔbabanyin, na ɔtoo no dzin Gershom: Na ɔsee dɛ, mayɛ ɔmamforanyi wɔ ananaben asaase do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nda pii guu mu no, Egypthen no wui: Na nkowaasom no ntsi Israelmba pempenee na wosūi, na hɔn sū fowee kɔr Nyankopɔn nkyɛn wɔ nkowaasom no ntsi.
Na Nyankopɔn kaa n'ahyɛmu a ɔnye Abraham, nye Isaac, na ɔnye Jacob dzii no.
Na Nyankopɔn hwɛɛ Israelmba no, na Nyankopɔn hun hɔn.
3: Afei Moses rohwɛ n'asew Jethro, Midian ɔsɔfo no, no nguan: Na ɔkaa nguan no dze hɔn kɔr sar no ekyir noho, na odur Nyankopɔn bepɔw Horeb ho.
Na Ewuradze bɔfoe beyii noho edzi kyerɛɛ no wɔ haban bi finimfin gyaframeemu: Na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, haban no redzɛw ogya, na haban no nnhyew.
Na Moses see dɛ, iyidze, mebɛ man akɔhwɛ adzehu kɛse yi, siantsir a haban no nnhyew.
Na Ewuradze hun dɛ ɔaman rohwɛ no, Nyankopɔn fii haban no mu frɛɛ no, na ɔsee dɛ, Moses, Moses. Na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye yi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, mma nntwemmpin ha: Yiyi w'ananadze mpaboa no, na bea a igyina do no yɛ asaase krɔnkrɔn.
Nkyii so ɔsee dɛ, emi nye w'egya ne Nyankopɔn no, Abraham Nyankopɔn, Isaac Nyankopɔn, nye Jacob Nyankopɔn no. Na Moses dze n'enyim sumae; osiandɛ osuroo dɛ ɔbɔhwɛ Nyankopɔn.
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, ampaara mehu me man a wɔwɔ Egypt hɔn amandzehu, na matse hɔn sū a hɔn abɔmbaafo no ntsi wosū no; na minyim hɔn awerɛhow no;

na mesian dɛ miribeyi hɔn wɔ Egyptfo nsamu, na, metutu hɔn mefi asaase no do makɔ asaase pa a ɔsõ do, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do; Canaanfo nye Hittifo, nye Amorifo, nye Perizzfo, nye Hivifo nye Jebusfo hɔn tsenabew no.
Na afei, hwɛ, Israel hɔn sū edu m'enyim: Nkyii so mehu ɔhaw a Egyptfo dze haw hɔn no.
Dɛm ntsi afei bra, na morosoma wo Pharaoh hɔ, ma eekeyi me man Israelmba no efi Egypt efir.
Na Moses see Nyankopɔn dɛ, Woana nye emi, na maakɔ Pharaoh nkyɛn mekeyi Israelmba mefi Egypt efir?
Na ɔsee dɛ, ampaara mibedzi w'ekyir; na iyi bɛyɛ wo asɛnkyerɛdze dɛ mara na masoma wo: Sɛ inya yi ɔman no fi Egypt ba a, hom bɔsom Nyankopɔn wɔ bepɔw yi do.
Na Moses see Nyankopɔn dɛ, hwɛ, sɛ mudu Israelmba nkyɛn, na mese hɔn dɛ, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn na ɔasoma me hom hɔ; na wɔse me dɛ, Ne dzin dze dɛn? a, menkã dɛn menkyerɛ hɔn?
Na Nyankopɔn see Moses dɛ, MARA NYE MARA NO: Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛm na kã kyerɛ Israelmba, Mara no na ɔasoma me hom hɔ.

Na nkyii so Nyankopɔn see Moses dɛ, Dɛm na kã kyerɛ Israelmba, Ewuradze, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn no, Abraham Nyankopɔn, Isaac Nyankopɔn, nye Jacob Nyankopɔn no. Na ɔasoma me hom hɔ: Iyi nye me dzin daa, na iyi nye me nkaadze kɔ ebuasuasantsen nyinara mu.

Kɔ, na kɔboa Israel mpanyimfo ano, na kã kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Ewuradze, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn no, Abraham, Isaac, nye Jacob Nyankopɔn no, eyi noho akyerɛ me, dɛ, ɔsera na mabɛsera hom, na mehu dza wɔdze reyɛ hom wɔ Egypt no:
Na mase dɛ, mibeyi hom mefi Egypt amandzehu no mu makɔ Canaanfo, nye Hittifo, nye Amorifo, nye Perizzfo, nye Hivifo, nye Jebusfo asaase do, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do.

Na wobetsie wo ndze: Na ɔwo, nye Israel mpanyimfo nkɔ Egypthen no nkyɛn, na hom nse no dɛ, Ewuradze, Hebrewfo Nyankopɔn no, nye hɛn ehyia mu: Na afei yɛserɛ wo, ma yɛnkɔ sar do ndaansa kwan nkɔbɔ afɔr mma Ewuradze, hɛn Nyankopɔn
Na minyim dɛ Egypthen remma hom kwan ma wɔnnkɔ, dabi, nnyɛ nsa a ɔyɛ dzen mpo do a.
Na mebɛtsen me nsa, na medze anwanwadze a mebɛyɛ wɔ no mu hɔ no mabɔ Egypt: Na ɔno n'ekyir na ɔbɛma hom akɔ.
Na mebɛma ɔman yi enyim aba nyam wɔ Egyptfo enyim: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ hom rokɔ a, hom nnkɔkɔ no nsapan:
Na ɔbaa biara bebisa ne fisamenanyi, na ne fie ɔmamforanyi dwɛɛtɛɛ edwindze, nye atam: Na hom dze ahyehyɛ hom mbabanyin nye hom mbabaa; na hom mfa Egyptfo no afo.
4: Na Moses buea see dɛ, na, hwɛ, wɔnnkɛgye me edzi, eso wonketsie me ndze: Na wɔbɛkã dɛ, Ewuradze nnyii noho nnkyerɛɛ wo.
Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ɔdze wo nsamu no? Na ɔsee dɛ, Poma a.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Tow kyen famu. Na ɔtowaa kyeen famu, na ɔdaan abowatsena; na Moses fii n'enyim guanee.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, tsen wo nsa, na suo no dua mu: (Na ɔtseen ne nsa na osuoo mu, na ɔdaan poma wɔne nsa mu:)
Ama wɔaagye edzi dɛ Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn, Isaac Nyankopɔn, nye Jacob Nyankopɔn no, eyi noho akyerɛ wo.
Na nkyii so Ewuradze see no dɛ, afei fa wo nsa hyɛ wo bo mu. Na ɔdze ne nsa hyɛɛ no bo mu: Na oyii puei no, hwɛ, nna ne nsa ho egu kwata fitaa dɛ esukwankyɛba.
Na ɔsee dɛ, fa wo nsa hyɛ wo bo mu bio. (Na ɔdze ne nsa hyɛɛ no bo mu bio; na oyii fii no bo mu no, hwɛ, nna adan dɛ no honam ara bio.)
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔanngye wo enndzi, nkyii so woen ntsie asɛnkyerɛdze a odzi kan no ne ndze a, wɔbɛgye asɛnkyerɛdze a otsīa ebien no ne ndze edzi.

Na obɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔanngye nsɛnkyerɛdze ebien yi mpo enndzi, nkyii so woenntsie wo ndze a, ɔno kɛsaw esutsen no mu nsu bi, na hue gu asaase kɛsɛɛ do: Na nsu a ebɛsaw no wɔ esutsen no mu no ɔbsɛdan bɔgya wɔ asaase kɛsɛɛ no do.
Na Moses see Ewuradze dɛ, Ao, Ewuradze, m’ano nntsew, nkan no o, ofitsi aber a ɔwo enye w’akowaa kasae yi o: Osiandɛ m’ano yɛ dur, na me tɛkyerɛma yɛ pembɔɔ.
Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, Woana na ɔyɛɛ nyimpa ano? anaa woana na ɔyɛ nyimpa mmuin, anaa otsitsifo, anaa ɔdzehufo, anaa onyifurafo? Ana nnyɛ emi Ewuradze bi a?
Dɛm ntsi afei kɔ, na mibedzi w’ano ekyir, na makyerɛ wo dza enkã.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ao Ewuradze, mepa wo kyɛw, dua nyia woara epɛ dɛ esoma no, ne nsa do soma.

Na Ewuradze n’ebufuw dzɛɛw wɔ Moses do, na ɔsee dɛ, Ana wo nua Aaron Levinyi no nnyi hɔ bi a? Minyim dɛ obotum akasa yie. Na eso, hwɛ, orifir edzi nye wo ebehyia: Na sɛ ohu wo a, n’akoma bɔtɔ ne yamu.
Na kasa kyerɛ no, na fa nsɛm no hyɛ n’ano: Na mibedzi w’ano, na ɔnye n’ano ekyir, na makyerɛ hom dza hom nyɛ.
Na ɔbɛyɛ wo kyeame ama ɔman no: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ ano ama wo, na ɔwo aayɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn ama no.
Na fa poma yi a edze bɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze no kitsa wo nsamu.

Na Moses kɔree na ɔsanee kɔr n’asew Jethro nkyɛn, na okɛsee no dɛ, mepa wo kyɛw, ma monkɔ, na mensan monkɔ mo nuanom a wɔwɔ Egypt no nkyɛn, na monkɔhwɛ kyerɛ wɔda ho tse ase anaa. Na Jethro see Moses dɛ, kɔ no asomdwee mu.
Na Ewuradze see Moses wɔ Midian dɛ, kɔ, san kɔ Egypt: Na nyimpa a wɔhwehwɛ wo nnkwa no nyinara ewuwu.
Na Moses faa ne yer nye ne mbabanyin no, na ɔdze hɔn tsenatsenaa asoaso do, na ɔsanee dɛ ɔrokɔ Egypt asaase do: Na Moses faa Nyankopɔn no pomo no kitsaa ne nsamu.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Sɛ esan kɔ Egypt a, hwɛ na anwanwadze a medze mahyɛ wo nsa no nyinara yɛ no wɔ Pharaoh enyim: Na mibepirim n’akoma, na ɔnnkɛma ɔman no akɔ.
Na se Pharaoh dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, Israel yɛ me babanyin, m'abakan a:
Na mase wo dɛ, ma me ba nkɔ nkɔsom me; na ɔwo a mmpen ma ɔannkɔ: hwɛ, muboku wo babanyin, w’abakan no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔkwan do asoɛe no, Ewuradze hyiaa no, na ɔpɛ eku no.
Nna Zipporah faa ɔtwerɛbo, na ɔdze twaa ne babanyin no twatsia, na ɔtowee kyeen n’ananadze; na ɔsee dɛ, ampaara ɔwo yɛ bɔgya okumfor dze ma me.
Nna ogyaa no. Nna osian twatsiatwa no ntsi ɔsee dɛ Bɔgya okumfor nye wo.
Na Ewuradze see Aaron dɛ, Kɔ sar no do kehyia Moses. Na ɔkɔree, na okehyiaa no wɔ Nyankopɔn ne bepow no ho, na ofeew n’ano.
Na Moses kãa nsɛm a Ewuradze dze somaa no no nyinara, nye nsɛnkyerɛdze a ɔdze hyɛɛ no no nyinara kyerɛɛ Aaron.
Na Moses nye Aaron kɔree na wɔkɔboaboaa Israelmba mpanyimfo nyinara ano.
Na Aaron kãa nsɛm a Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ Moses no nyinara, na ɔyɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze no wɔ ɔman no enyim.
Na ɔman no gyee dzii: Na aber a wɔtsee dɛ Ewuradze abɛsera Israelmba, na ɔahwɛ hon amandzehu no, nna wobobɔɔ hɔn tsir adze na wɔsɔree.
5: Na n’ekyir no Moses nye Aaron bae, na wɔbɛsee Pharaoh dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no ɔse nye yi, Ma me man nkɔ, na wɔnkɛhyɛ fa mma me wɔ sar no do.
Na Pharaoh see dɛ, woana nye Ewuradze a mibetsie ne ndze na mama Israel akɔ? Minnyim Ewuradze, na nkyii so meremma Israel nnkɔ.
Na wɔsee dɛ, Hebrewfo Nyankopɔn nye hɛn ehyia: Yɛpa wo kyɛw, ma yɛnko sar no do ndaansa kwan, na yɛnkɔbɔ afɔr mma Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn; mma ɔaammfa ɔyardɔm, anaa afõwa emmbotua hɛn.
Na Egypthen no see hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na, Moses nye Aaron, hom robɔ ɔman no ko wɔ hɔn ndwuma ho yi? Hom nkɔ hom ndzesoadze ho.
Na Pharaoh see dɛ, hwɛ, afei asaase no do nkorɔfo no adɔɔ sõ, na hom ma wɔhom fi hɔn ndzesoadze ho yi.
Na da no ara Pharaoh hyɛɛ ɔman no hɔn abɔmbaafo, nye hɔn ahwɛdofo no dɛ,
Mma hom mma ɔman no sar a wɔdze bɛyɛ ntayaa no bio dɛ nkan no: Wɔmma hɔnara wɔnkɔ na wɔnkɔboaboa sar ano mma hɔnho.
Na ntayaa dodow a wɔyɛ no dada no, hom ngye hɔn; mma hom nnyi do bi: Na wɔyɛ enyihaw; dɛm ntsi na wosū dɛ, Wɔmma yɛnkɔ nkɔbɔ afɔr mma hɛn Nyankopɔn a.
Hom mma edwuma durdur nda nkorɔfo no do, ama wɔaayɛ mu edwuma aberɛ; na mma wonntsie nsɛnhun.
Na ɔman no hɔn abɔmbaafo, nye hɔn ahwɛdofo no fiir edzi, na wɔbɛkãa kyerɛɛ ɔman no dɛ, mbrɛ Pharaoh se nye yi, Meremma hom sar bio.
Homara nkɔ nkɛfa sar wɔ mbrɛ hom benya bi: Na worinnyi hom edwuma do biribiara.
Nna ɔman no petsee Egypt asaase nyinaa do kɔboaboa mburonan ano dze yɛɛ sar.
Na abɔmbaafo no piapiaa hɔn dɛ, hom nwie hom da kor edwuma wɔ ne da mu, dɛ aber asar wɔ hɔ no ara.
Na wɔhwee Israelmba ahwɛdofo no a Pharaoh n'abɔmbaafo no dze hɔn esisi hɔn do no, na wobisaa dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom ennwie ntayaa a wɔahyɛ hom no yɛ ndeda nye ndɛ dɛ nkan no yi?
Nna Israelmba ahwɛdofo no bae bosūi tɔɔ Pharaoh do dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na enye wo nkowaa dzi no dɛm yi?
Wɔmmaa wo nkowaa sar, na wɔse hɛn dɛ, hom nyɛ ntayaa: Na, hwɛ, wɔahwɛ wo nkowaa dze, na wankasa wo man na wɔayɛ bɔn.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Enyihafo nye hom, enyihafo nye hom: Dɛm ntsi na hom se dɛ, Ma yɛnkɔ nkɔbɔ afɔr mma Ewuradze a.
Dɛm ntsi afei hom nkɔ nkɛyɛ edwuma; na sar dze wɔremma hom, naaso ntayaa no dodow dze hom mma.
Na Israelmba ahwɛdofo no hun dɛ wɔwɔ amandzenya mu wɔ aber a wɔkãa dɛ, mma hom nnyi hom da kor edwuma mu ataaya no do dabiarada no.
Na wofi Pharaoh nkyɛn reba no, wɔbɔtoo Moses nye Aaron dɛ wogyina ɔkwan no mu hɔ:
Na wɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ewuradze nhwɛ hom, na Ombua; dɛ hom ama hɛn ho abɔn wɔ Pharaoh enyim, nye no nkowaa enyim, na hom dze afõwa ahyɛ hɔn nsa dɛ wɔmfa nku hɛn ntsi.
Na Moses sanee kɔr Ewuradze nkyɛn kɛsee dɛ, Ewuradze, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na enye ɔman yi edzi no bɔn dɛmyi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na esomaa me yi?
Na ofitsi aber ara a mabaa Pharaoh nkyɛn dɛ medze wo dzin menye no kasae no, ɔayɛ ɔman yi bɔn; nkyii so enngyee wo man koraa.
6: Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Afei na irubohu dza medze merebɛyɛ Pharaoh: Na nsa a ɔyɛ dzen do na ɔbɛpam hɔn efi n'asaase do.
Na Nyankopɔn kasae kyerɛɛ Moses, na ɔsee no dɛ, Emi nye JEHOVAH:
Na miyii moho mekyerɛɛ Abraham, Isaac, nye Jacob, dɛ Nyankopɔn Otumfo, na me dzin JEHOVAH no dze mamma wɔammfa ennhu me.
Na eso mama m'ahyɛmu a menye hɔn dzii no etsim, dɛ medze Canaan asaase a ɔyɛ hɔn ahɔhobea asaase no a wɔyɛ do ahɔho no mebɛma hɔn.
Na nkyii so matse Israelmba a Egyptfu dzii hɔn nya no, hɔn apempen; na makaa m'ahyɛmu no.
Dɛm ntsi se Israelmba dɛ, Emi nye Jehovah, na mibeyi hom mefi Egyptfu ndzesoadze no ase, na meyi hom mefi hɔn nkowaasom no mu, na medze abasa a wɔatsɛw mu, nye ntsɛmbu akɛse magye hom:
Na mafa hom mayɛ me man, na mayɛ hom Nyankopɔn: Na hom ehu dɛ emi nye Jehovah hom Nyankopɔn a oyii hom fii Egyptfo ndzesoadze ase no.
Na medze hom bɔkɔ asaase a memaa me nsa do wɔ ho dɛ medze mebɛma Abraham, Isaac nye Jacob no do, na medze mebɛma hom dɛ egyapadze: Emi nye Jehovah.
Na Moses kãa dɛm kyerɛɛ Israelmba no: Na ahomtsew nye nkowaasom dzendzen ntsi woentsie Moses.
Na Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kɔ, kɛkã kyerɛ Egypthen Pharaoh, dɛ, ɔmma Israelmba mfi asaase no do nkɔ.
Na Moses kasae wɔ Ewuradze enyim see dɛ, Hwɛ, Israelmba enntsie me; na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na Pharaoh betsie emi a wonntwaa m'anofamfa twatsia yi?
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron, na ɔdze hyɛɛ hɔn nsa dɛ wɔnkɔ Israelmba, nye Egypthen Pharaoh nkyɛn, nkeyi Israelmba no mfi Egypt asaase do.
Iyinom nye hɔn egyanom efi mu etsitsir: Israel n'abakan Reuben ne mbabanyin; Hanoch, nye Pallu, Hezron, nye Carmi: Iyinom nye Reuben n'ebusuafo.
Na Simoen ne mbabanyin; Jemuel, nye Jamin, nye Ohad, nye Jachin, nye Zohar nye Shaul Canaannyi ɔbaa bi ne babanyin a: Iyinom nye Simeon n'ebusuafo.
Na iyinom nye Levi ne mbabanyin no hɔn edzin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mbusuasantsen tsetsee; Gershon, nye Kohath, nye Merari: Na Levi no nkwaber mu mfe yɛ mfe ɔha eduasa esuon.
Gershon ne mbabanyin; Libni nye Shimei, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuafo tsetsee.
Na Kohath ne mbabanyin; Amram, nye Izhar, nye Hebron, nye Uzziel: Na Kohath no nkwamber mu mfe yɛ mfe ɔha eduasa ebiasa.
Na Merari ne mbabanyin; Mahli nye Mushi. Iyinom nye Levifo ebusuafo dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuasantsen tsetsee.
Na Amran faa n; egya akyerɛbaa Jochebed waar no; na ɔnye no woo Aaron nye Moses: Na Amram no nkwaber mu mfe yɛ mfe ɔha eduasa esuon.
Na Izhar ne mbabanyin; Korah, nye Nepheg, nye Zichri.
Na Uzziel ne mbabanyin; Mishael, nye Elzaphan, nye Sithri.
Na Aaron faa Elisheba, Aminadab ne babaa no, Nahshon n'akyerɛbaa no waar no; na ɔnye no woo Nadab nye Abihu, Eleazer nye Ithamar.
Na Korah ne mbabanyin; Assir, nye Elkanah, nye Abiasaph; iyinom nye Korahfo ebusuafo.
Na Aaron ne babnyin Eleazer faa Putiel ne mbabaa mu baako waar no; na ɔnye no woo Phinehas. Iyinom nye Levifo egyanom efi mu etsitsir dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuafo tsetsee.
Iyinom nye Aaron nye Moses no a Ewuradze see hɔn dɛ, Hom nyi Israelmba mfi Egypt asaase do dɛ mbrɛ hom dɔm tsetsee no.
Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔkasaa kyerɛɛ Egypthen Pharaoh dɛ wobeyi Israelmba efi Egypt akɔ no: Iyinom nye Moses nye Aaron no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ da no a Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses wɔ Egypt asaase do no,
Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ, emi nye Ewuradze: Kã dza mekã kyerɛ wo nyinara kyerɛ Egypthen Pharaoh.
Na Moses kãe wɔ Ewuradze enyim dɛ, hwɛ, emi wonntwaa m'anofamfa twatsia, na Pharaoh bɛyɛ dɛn etsie me?
7: Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Hwɛ, mayɛ wo onyame mama Pharaoh: Na wo nua Aaron bɛyɛ wo nkɔnhyɛnyi.
Ɔwo bɛkã dza mehyɛ wo nyinara: Na wo nua Aaron bɛkã akyerɛ Pharaoh ma ɔaama Israelmba efi n'asaase do akɔ.
Na mibepirim Pharaoh n'akoma, na mama me nsɛnkyerɛdze nye m'anwanwadze adɔɔ sõ wɔ Egypt asaase do.
Na Pharaoh rinntsie hom, na medze me nsa bɔto Egypt do, na meyi mo dɔm, me man Israelmba no, mefi Egypt asaase do wɔ atsɛmbu akɛse mu.
Na Egyptfo bohu dɛ emi nye Ewuradze, sɛ metsen me nsa wɔ Egypt do, na miyi Israelmba fi hɔn mu fir a.
Na Moses nye Aaron yɛɛ dɛm; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ hɔn no, dɛmara so na wɔyɛe.
Aber a wɔkasaa kyerɛɛ Pharaoh no, nna Moses edzi mfe eduowɔtwe, na Aaron mfe eduowɔtwe ebiasa.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ,
Sɛ Pharaoh kã kyerɛ hom dɛ, hom nyi hom anwanwadze bi nkyerɛ a, ɔnodze kã kyerɛ Aaron dɛ, yi wo poma no, na tow kyen famu wɔ Pharaoh enyim, ma ɔndan abowatsena.
Na Moses nye Aaron kɔr Pharaoh nkyɛn, na wɔyɛɛ dɛm, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛe no: Na Aaron toow no poma kyeen famu wɔ Pharaoh enyim nye no nkowaa enyim, na ɔdaan abowatsena.
Nna Pharaoh so frɛɛfrɛɛ enyansafo no, na abayifo no: Na hɔn so, Egypt akɔmfo no, dze hɔn nkaber yɛɛ dɛmara.
Na hɔn nyinara totoow hɔn mpoma guu famu, na ɔdandaan mbowatsena: Na Aaron no poma no memeen hɔn mpoma no.
Na Pharaoh n'akoma pirimii, na oenntsie hɔn; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze kãe no.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Pharaoh n'akoma asorow, ɔmmpen dɛ ɔman no kɔ.
Kɔ Pharaoh nkyɛn ampa: Hwɛ, orupue akɔ nsu mu: na ɔwo kegyina esutsen no no nkɔnkɔnoa hɔ hyia no; na poma no a ɔdaan abowatsena no fa kitsa wo nsamu.
Na se no dɛ, Ewuradze, Hebrewfo Nyankopɔn no, na ɔasoma me wo hɔ dɛ, ma me man nkɔ nkɔsom me wɔ sar no do: Na, hwɛ, enntsie ara dze ebodu sesei.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, iyi mu na ibohu dɛ emi nye Ewuradze: Hwɛ, medze poma a ɔdze me nsamu yi mobɔbɔ esutsen yi mu nsu, na ɔbɛdan bɔgya.
Na nam a wɔwɔ esutsen no mu bowuwu, na esutsen no bɔbɔn; na Egyptfo bekyir dɛ wɔbɔnom esutsen no mu nsu.

Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, se Aaron dɛ, Fa wo poma, na tsen wo nsa wɔ Egypt esuesu do, hɔn esutsen do, hɔn nsubansuba do, nye hɔn mbakansu nyina do, ma ɔndandan bɔgya; na bɔgya bɛba Egypt asaase nyinara do, ndua-esupi nye abo-esupi nyina mu.
Na Moses nye Aaron yɛɛ dɛm, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ no; na ɔmaa poma no do, na odze bɔɔ nsu a ɔwɔ esutsen no mu no wɔ Pharaoh enyim, nye no nkowaa enyim; na nsu a ɔwɔ esutsen no mu nyinara daan bɔgya.
Na nam a wɔwɔ esutsen no mu wuwui, na esutsen no bɔnee, na Egyptfo entum annom esutsen no mu nsu; na bɔgya no wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do.
Na Egyptakɔmfo no dze hɔn nkaber no yɛɛ dɛmara: Na Pharaoh n'akoma pirimii, na oenntsie hɔn; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze kãe no.
Na Pharaoh daan noho na ɔkɔr ne fie, na ɔammfa iyi so mpo annto n'akoma mu.
Na Egyptfo nyina tutuu amona wɔ esutsen no ho dɛ wobenya nsu anom; osiandɛ wonntum nnom esutsen no mu nsu.
Na Ewuradze bɔɔ esutsen no ekyir no, nda esuon botwaa mu.
8: Na Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ, kɔ Pharaoh nkyɛn, na se no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, Ma me man nkɔ, na wɔnkɔsom me.
Na sɛ ammpen ma wɔaannkɔ a, hwɛ medze ntwɛr bofura wo ntoaado nyinara:
na esutsen no bɔdɔ ntwɛr menyamenya, na wɔbɔfofow aba wo fie, nye w'adankyir, nye wo mpa do, nye wo nkowaa fie, nye wo ma do, nye wo mfononoo mu, nye wo mbɔrnkutu mu:
Na ntwɛr no bɔfow aba ɔwo, nye wo mamfo, nye wo nkowaa nyinara do.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, sɛ Aaron dɛ, fa wo poma tsen wo nsa wɔ esutsen, nye nsubansuba, nye nsutaae do, na ma ntwɛr mbra Egypt asaase do.
Na Aaron tseen ne nsa wɔ Egypt nsu do; na ntwɛr no fowee bae, na wobofuraa Egypt asaase do.
Na akɔmfo no dze hɔn nkaber no yɛɛ dɛmara, na wɔmaa ntwɛr fowee baa Egypt asaase do.
Nna Pharaoh frɛɛ Moses nye Aaron, na ɔsee dɛ, hom mpa Ewuradze kyɛw ma onyi ntwɛr no mfi emi, nye me man do; na mebɛma ɔman no akɔ, ma wɔaakɔbɔ afɔr ama Ewuradze.
Na Moses see Pharaoh dɛ, w'adaworom: Ebɛn aber na mempa kyɛw memma ɔwo, nye wo nkowaa, nye wo man, ma wɔnsɛɛ ntwɛr no mfi ɔwo nye w'efi do, na wɔnka esutsen no nko mu?
Na ɔsee dɛ, ɔkyena a. Na ɔsee dɛ, ɔnyɛ dɛ dza akã no ara: Ama eehu dɛ obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn.
Na ntwɛr no befi ɔwo, nye w'efi, nye wo nkowaa, nye wo man do; esutsen no mu nko na wɔbɛka.
Na Moses nye Aaron fii Pharaoh nkyɛn kɔree: Na Moses sūi frɛɛ Ewuradze wɔ ntwɛr no a ɔdze baa Pharaoh do no ho.
Na Ewuradze yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Moses kãe no: Na ntwɛr no wuwui wɔ efi mu, nye abangua do, nye haban mu.
Na wɔboaboaa hɔn ano akuwekuw: Na asaase no do bɔnee.
Na Pharaoh hun dɛ ahotɔ aba mu no, opiriim n'akoma, na oenntsie hɔn: Dɛ mbrɛ a Ewuradze kãe no.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, se Aaron dɛ, tsen wo poma no, na fa bɔ asaase do huntuma, ma ɔndan dwuw wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do.
Na wɔyɛɛ dɛm; na Aaron dze no poma no tseen ne nsa, na ɔdze bɔɔ asaase do huntuma, ma dwuw fɔɔr nyimpa nye mbowa: Asaase no do huntuma nyinara daan dwuw wo Egypt asaase nyinara do.
Na akɔmfo no dze hɔn nkaber yɛɛ dɛmara dɛ wɔrema dwuw ana na woenntum: Na dwuw no wɔ nyimpa nye mbowa ho.
Nna akɔmfo no see Pharaoh dɛ, Nyankopɔn nsatseaba nye yi: Na Pharaoh n'akoma pirimii, na oenntsie hɔn; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze kãe no.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Soɛr anapaatu, na kegyina Pharaoh enyim; hwɛ, ɔreba nsu no ho; na se no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, Ma me man nkɔ, ma wɔnkɔsom me.
Na sɛ ennkɛma me man akɔ a, hwɛ, mebɛma atsɛn menyamenya aba ɔwo, nye, wo nkowaa, nye wo man, nye w'efi do: Na Egyptfo efiefi mu, na asaase a wɔtse do no so atsɛn menyamenya bɛyɛ amaama.
Na da no mubotwa Goshen asaase a me man tse do no agya, ma atsɛn menyamenya aannkɔ hɔ, ama eehu dɛ emi nye Ewuradze wɔ asaase finimfin.
Na medze ɔhe mobɔto me man nye wo man ntamu: Ɔkyena na asɛnkyerɛdze yi bɛba.
Na Ewuradze yɛɛ dɛm; na atsɛn menyamenya a hɔn ano yɛ yaw baa Pharaoh fi mu, nye no nkowaa efi mu: Na osian atsɛn menyamenya no ntsi Egypt asaase no nyinara do asaase do sɛɛe.
Na Pharaoh frɛɛ Moses nye Aaron, na ɔsee dɛ, hom nkɔ nkɔbɔ afɔr mma hom Nyankopɔn wɔ asaase no do.
Na Moses dɛ, ɔnnsɛ dɛ wɔyɛ no dɛm; osiandɛ Egyptfo ekyiwadze na yɛdze bɔbɔ afɔr ama Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn no: Hwɛ, ana yɛmfa Egyptfo ekyiwadze mbɔ afɔr wɔ hɔn enyiwa mu, na wonnkesiw hɛn abo bi a?
Yebotu ndaansa kwan akɔ sar no do, na yɛakɔbɔ afɔr ama Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɛhyɛ hɛn no.
Na Pharaoh see dɛ, mebɛma hom akɔ, ama hom aakɔbɔ afɔr ama Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn no wɔ sar no do; na ekyir nko na hom nnkɔ: Hom mpa kyɛw mma me.

Na Moses see dɛ, Hwɛ, mirifi wo nkyɛn makɔ, na makɛpa Ewuradze kyɛw ma atsɛn menyamenya no eefi Pharaoh, nye no nkowaa, nye ne man do ɔkyena: Na abrasɛm nko na mma Pharaoh nndzi bio, dɛ ɔnnkɛma ɔman no akɔ akɔbɔ afɔr ama Ewuradze.
Na Moses fii Pharaoh nkyɛn kɔree, na ɔkɛpaa Ewuradze kyɛw.
Na Ewuradze yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Moses kãe no; na oyii atsɛn menyamenya no fii Pharaoh piriim n'akoam aber yi so, na ɔamma ɔman no annkɔ.
9: Nna Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, kɔ Pharaoh nkyɛn, na kã kyerɛ no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze Hebrewfo Nyankopɔn se nye yi, ma me man nkɔ, ma wɔnkɔsom me.
Na sɛ ammpen ma wɔaannkɔ, na eda ho ara tsintsim hɔn do a,
hwɛ, Ewuradze nsa wɔ wo mbowa a wɔwɔ haban mu do, na ɔdze mbowawu yayaayaw bɛba mpɔnkɔ, anantwikuw, nye nguankuw do.
Na Ewuradze dze sorbi bɔto Isreal mbowa nye Egypt mbowa ntamu na dza ɔyɛ Isrealmba dze no nyinara mu biara nnkowu.
Na Ewuradze hyɛɛ aber, dɛ, ɔkyena na Ewuradze bɛyɛ adze yi wɔ asaase no do.
Na adze kyēe no Ewuradze yɛɛ adze no, na Egypt mbowa nyinara wuwui: Na Isrealmba mbowa dze no mu kor mpo ennwu.
Na Pharaoh somae, na hwɛ, nna Isrealfo mbowa mu kor mpo nnwui. Na Pharaoh n'akoma sorowee, na ɔamma ɔman no annkɔ.
Na Ewuradze see Moses nye Aaron dɛ, hom mfa fononoo mu nso nsama nsama, na Moses ntow mpetsɛ wimu wɔ Pharaoh enyim.
Na ɔbɛdan tutuw wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do, na ɔayɛ pɔmpɔ a ɔpaapaa tutu ekur wɔ nyimpa nye mbowa ho, wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do.
Na wɔfaa fononoo mu nso, na wokegyinaa Pharaoh enyim; na Moses towee petsee wimu; na ɔdaan pɔmpɔ a ɔpaapaa tutu ekur wɔ nyimpa nye mbowa ho.
Na osian pɔmpɔ no ntsi akɔmfo no enntum enngyina Moses enyim; osiandɛ mpɔmpɔ no abobɔ akɔmfo no, Egyptfo nyinara.
Na Ewuradze piriim Pharaoh n'akoma, na oenntsie hɔn; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ Moses no.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, soɛr anapaatu, na kegyina Pharaoh enyim, nase no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Hebrewfo Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, Ma me man nkɔ, ma wɔnkɔsom me.
Na afei dze merema me yardɔm nyinara aba w'akoma do, nye wo nkowaa aba w'akoma do, nye wo nkowaa do, nye wo man do; ama eehu dɛ obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ emi wɔ asaase nyinara do.
Na afei sɛ matsen me nsa, na medze owuyar mabɔ ɔwo nye wo man a, nkyɛ woetwa wo efi asaase do:
Na ampaara iyi ntsi na mama egyina hɔ, dɛ mebɛkyerɛ wo mo tum, na wɔaabɔ me dzin akyerɛ wɔ asaase nyinara do.
Eda ho ara rema woho do wɔ me man do, dɛ eremma wɔnnkɔ anaa?
Hwɛ ɔkyena siseber yi mebɛma ɔsorbo a n'ano yɛ dur dodoodow a ne saso mmbaa Egypt pɛn ofi da a wɔkyekyeree dze bodu ndɛ yi atɔ.
Dɛm ntsi afei soma na wɔnkɛfa wo mbowa nye biribiara a ewɔ wɔ haban mu nyina mbra ntsɛm; na nyimpa biara nye abowa biara a wobohu hɔn ammba fie no, ɔsorbo no bɔhwe hɔn, na wobowuwu.
Pharaoh nkowaa mu nyia osuroo Ewuradze n'asɛm no maa no nkowaa nye ne fiembowa guanee baa fie.
Na nyia oemmbu Ewuradze n'asɛm bi no gyaa no nkowaa nye ne fiembowa wɔ haban mu.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, tsen wo nsa wɔ sor, ma ɔsorbo mbra Egypt asaase nyinara do, nyimpa, nye abowa, nye haban mu efuw biara do, wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do
Na Moses tseen no poma no wɔ sor: Na Ewuradze maa senaman nye ɔsorbo bae, na ogya porowee guu asaase do; na Ewuradze tɔɔ ɔsorbo guu Egypt asaase do.
Nna ɔsorbo no bae, na ogya a ɔdzɛw brambram toatoa mu a ɔfora ɔsorbo no mu a n’ano yɛ dzen dodoodow a ne saso mmbaa Egypt asaase nyinara do pɛn on da a ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔman no.
Na ɔsorbo no hwee Egypt asaase nyinara do dza ɔwɔ haban mu nyinara, nyimpa nye abowa nyina; na ɔsorbo no hwee haban mu efuw nyinara, na obubuu haban mu ndua nyinara.
Goshen asaase do mbrɛ Israelmba wɔ no nko na ɔsorbo no bi ammba.
Na Pharaoh somae ma wɔkefrɛɛ Moses nye Aaron, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, afei dze mayɛ bɔn: Ewuradze dzi bem, na emi nye me man yɛyɛ afɔdzifo.
Hom mpa Ewuradze kyɛw; na asenaman dzendzen yi nye ɔsorbo no adɔɔ sõ; na mebɛma hom akɔ, na hom renntsena ha bio.
Na Moses see no dɛ, mefi kurow mu akɔ ara a, nkyɛ matsɛw me nsamu akyerɛ Ewuradze; asenaman no begyaa, nkyii so ɔsorbo biara nnkɛba bio; ama eehu de asaase yɛ Ewuradze dze.
Na ɔwo nye wo nkowaa dze, minyim dɛ hom nnyae nnsuroo Ewuradze Nyankopɔn bi.
Na ɔhwee asaaba nye atoko; osiandɛ atoko no ayɛ mbetsem, na asaaba no so abɔ nkukuduuduw.
Na ewifua nye ewu dze wɔannhwe hɔn: Osiandɛ wonntu mpon biara.
Na Moses fi Pharaoh nkyɛn fii kurow no mu, na ɔkɛtsɛɛw ne nsamu kyerɛɛ Ewuradze, na nsenaman nye ɔsorbo no gyaae, na nyankom no woennhue enngu asaase no do.
Na Pharaoh hun dɛ nyankom, nye ɔsorbo, nye asenaman no gyaae no, ɔyɛɛ bɔn bio, na opiriim n’akoma, ɔno nye no nkowaa.
Na Pharaoh n’akoma pirimii, na ɔamma Israelmba annkɔ; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze nam Moses do kãe no.
10: Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, kɔ Pharaoh nkyɛn: Na mepirim n’akoma, nye no nkowaa akoma, ama meeyi me nsɛnkyerɛdze yi akyerɛ no wɔ hɔn mu:
Na aakã no wo ba, nye wɔ ba ne ba asomu, ndzɛmba a mayɛ no wɔ Egypt do, na me nsɛnkyerɛdze a mayɛ no wɔ hon mu; ama hom eehu dɛ emi nye Ewuradze.
Na Moses nye Aaron kɔr Pharaoh nkyɛn, na wɔkɛsee no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Hebrewfo Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, eropow dɛ ebrɛ woho adze wɔ m'enyim ma ekodu dabɛn? Ma me man nkɔ, na wɔnkɔsom me.
Na sɛ ammpen ma me man aannkɔ a, hwɛ, ɔkyena medze mbɛbɛw mebɛba wo ntoaado:
Na wɔbɛkata asaase enyi, dɛ obi nnkotum ehu asaase: Na wobedzi edzinkaa a ɔsorbo no gyaae ma ɔkae maa hom no, na wobedzi dua biara a ɔrerefɛw wɔ haban mu ama hom no:

Na wɔbɛhyehyɛ w’efi mu, nye wo nkowaa nyinara efi mu, nye Egyptfo nyinara efi mu amaama; dɛ mbrɛ w’egyanom, nye w’egyanom hon egyanom nnhun bi pɛn ofi daa wɔdze baa asaase do dze bodu ndɛ da yi. Na ɔdaan noho, na ofii Pharaoh nkyɛn puei.
Na Pharaoh no nkowaa see no dɛ, nyimpa yi bɛyɛ efir ama hɛnara ma ekodu dabɛn? Ma nkorɔfo no nkɔ, ma wɔnkɔsom Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn: Ana Egypt asɛɛ yi innhu bi a?
Na wɔdze Moses nye Aaron baa Pharaoh nkyɛn bio: Na ɔsee hon dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɔsom Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn: Na woananom ara na wɔbɔkɔ?
Na Moses see dɛ, yɛnye hɛn mbofra nye hɛn mpanyin bɔkɔ, yɛnye hɛn mbabanyin na ɔnye hen mbabaa, yɛnye hɛn nguan na onye hɛn anantwi bɔkɔ; osiandɛ otwar dɛ yɛhyɛ fa ma Ewuradze.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ewuradze ndzi hom ekyir, dɛ mebɛma hom, nye hom mbofraba no akɔ: Hom nhwɛ; bɔn na ɔwɔ hom enyi do.
Dabida: Hom a wɔyɛ mbanyin no ara nkɔ, na wɔnkɔsom Ewuradze; na ɔnoara nye dza hom rohwehwɛ. Na woyii hɔn edzi fii Pharaoh enyim.
