Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, tsen wo nsa wɔ Egypt asaase do, wɔ mbɛbɛw no ntsi, ma wɔmbra Egypt asaase do, na wɔmbɔwe asaase no do efuw nyinara, mekyerɛ dza ɔsorbo no egyaa no nyinara.
Na Moses tseen no poma no wɔ Egypt asaase do, na Ewuradze dze boka mframa bɔɔ asaase no do da no nyinara, na anago no nyinara; na anapa no, boka mframa dze mbɛbɛw no bae.
Na mbɛbɛw no kɔr Egypt asaase nyinara do, na wɔkɛgyegyee Egypt ntoaado nyinara; wɔdɔɔ sõ dodow; mbɛbɛw biara a ɔtse dɛm mbaa pɛn, na hɔn ekyir si bi nnkɛba dɛm da.

Na wɔkataa asaase no nyinara enyi, ma isum gyee asaase no do; na wɔwee asaase no do efuw nyinara, nye ndua a ɔsorbo no gyaae no do aba nyinara: Na adze momon biara annka a ɔyɛ dua anaa haban mu efuw, wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do.
Nna Pharaoh maa wɔkɛfrɛɛ Moses nye Aaron ntsɛmara; na ɔsee dɛ, mayɛ bɔn etsia Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn, nye hom.
Dɛm ntsi afei, mepa wo kyɛw, fa mo bɔn fir me prɛko yi ara, na hom mpa Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn kyɛw, ma onyi owu yi ara mfi mo do.
Na ofii Pharaoh nkyɛn kɔree, na ɔkɛpaa Ewuradze kyɛw.
Na Ewuradze dze daan anee mframa dzendzen mbordo a ɔbɛfaa mbɛbɛw no, na ɔdze hɔn koguu Epo Memen no mu; abɛbɛw kor mpo annka wɔ Egypt ntoaado nyinara.
Na Ewuradze piriim Pharaoh n'akoma, na ɔamma Israelmba no annkɔ.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, tsen wo nsa wɔ sor, ma sum mbra Egypt asaase do, mekyerɛ sum a wosuo mu a ɔbɛyɛ a.
Na Moses tseen ne nsa wɔ sor; na sum kebii hyɛɛ Egypt asaase nyinara do nda ebiasa;
obiara ennhu ne nyɛnko, nkyii so obiara annsoɛr emmfi ne tsenabew nda ebiasa: Na Israelmba nyinara wonyaa kan wɔ hɔn efiefi.
Na Pharaoh frɛɛ Moses, na ɔsee dɛ, hom nkɔ nkɔsom Ewuradze; hom nguan nye hom anantwi nko na wɔmma wɔnka: Wɔmma hom mbofraba no so nye hom nkɔ.
Na Moses see dɛ, ohia dɛ edze okum-afɔrbɔdze nye ɔhyew-afɔrbɔdze so hyɛ hɛn nsa ama yaabɔ afɔr ama Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn.
Hɛn mbowa so nye hɛn bɔkɔ; ɔnnkɛka abowanamɔn mpo wɔ ekyir; na ɔno mu bi na otwar dɛ yɛkɛfa som Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn; na yennyim dza ɔregye dɛ yɛdze bɔsom Ewuradze, gyedɛ yɛdu hɔ ana.
Na Ewuradze pirim Pharaoh n'akoma, na ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔma wɔkɔ.
Na Pharaoh see no dɛ, fi mo do kɔ, hwɛ woho yie, mma nnhu m'enyim bio; na da a ibohu m'enyim no ibowu.
Na Moses see dɛ, akã no yie; munnkohu w'enyim bio.
11: Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, mebɛma ɔyardɔm kor so aba Pharaoh, nye Egypt do bio; na n'ekyir no ɔbɛma hom efi ha akɔ: Aber a ɔbɛma hom akɔ no, ampaara, ɔbɛpam hom efi ha koraa.
Afei kasa wɔ ɔman no asomu, na ma ɔbanyin biara mbisa wɔ ne nyɛnko hɔ, na ɔbaa mbisa wɔ ne nyɛnko hɔ, dwɛɛtɛɛ ndwindze, nye sika ndwindze.
Na Ewuradze maa ɔman no enyimpa wɔ Egyptfu enyim. Nkyii so nna ɔbarimba Moses no yɛ kɛse paara wɔ Egypt asaase do, wɔ Pharaoh nkowaa enyim, nye ɔman no enyim.
Na Moses see dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, bɛyɛ esuoankɔnmu na mibefir edzi mafa Egypt mu:
Na Egypt asaase do mbakan nyinara bowuwu, ofi Pharaoh n'abakan a ɔtsena n'ahengua do do, dze kodu afonabaa mpo a ɔwɔ ewuyambo ekyir n'abakan do; nye ofiembowa mbakan nyinara.
Na sū kɛse bɛba Egypt asaase nyinara do a ne saso bi mbaa da, eso ne saso bi nnkɛba bio.
Na Israelmba nyinara dze ɔkraman mpo nnkɔtwe ne tɛkyerɛma ahyɛ hɔn, ɔnnkɛhye nyimpa anaa abowa: Ama hom eenhu mbrɛ Ewuradze si dze ɔhe to Egyptfo nye Israel ntamu.

Na wo nkowaa yi nyinara besian aba mo hɔ, na wɔabɔbɔ hɔn mu adze ama me dɛ, Fir edzi kɔ, ɔwo nye ɔman a wɔka wo do nyinara: Na ɔno ekyir no na mibefir edzi makɔ. Na ɔdze ebufuhyew fii Pharaoh nkyɛn kɔree.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Pharaoh nnketsie hom; ama m'anwanwadze aadɔɔ sõ wɔ Egypt asaase do.
Na Moses nye Aaron yɛɛ anwanwadze yi nyinara wɔ Pharaoh enyim; na Ewuradze piriim Pharaoh n'akoma, na ɔamma Israelmba emmfi n'asaase do annkɔ.
12: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron wɔ Egypt asaase do dɛ,
Bosoom yi bɛyɛ abosoom ahyɛse ama hom: Ɔbɛyɛ afrenhyia mu abosoom ahyɛse ama hom: Ɔbɛyɛ afrenhyia mu bosoom a odzi kan ama hom.
Hom ankasa nkyerɛ Israel mboanofo no nyinara dɛ, bosoom yi ne da a otsīia du no mu, wɔmfefa nguambaa nkorkor, dɛ mbrɛ hom egyanom efiefi tsetsee, ofi kor eguambaa kor:
Na sɛ ofidua no suar dodow dze ma eguambaa kor a, ɔno wɔmma ɔnye ne nyɛnko a ɔbɛn ne fi mfa kor dɛ mbrɛ akra no hɔn dodow tse; dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa biara n’edzidzi tse no, na hom mfa mbu eguambaa no ano.
Hom eguambaa nyɛ dza onndzi dzɛm, onyin a oedzi afrenhyia a: Hom nyi no wɔ nkɔsɔw anaa mpɔnkye mu:
Na hom mfa no nsie ma onkodu bosoom kor no ara ne da a otsīa duanan no: Na Israel mboanofo kuw no nyina nkuku hɔn ewimbir.
Na wɔmfa bɔgya no bi, na wɔmfa nsera efi a wobedzi no wɔ mu no n’apondua ebien no nye mpondua etsifi no ho.
Na wondzi nam no anago no ara, wɔmfa gya ntoto, na wɔmfa epitsi boodoo, nye fan wenwen ndzi.
Mma wonndzi no amon, nkyii so mma wɔmmfa nsu nnoa, mbom wɔmfa gya ntoto; ne tsir nye no ntwɛr na ɔnye n’ayamudze no.
Na mma hom mma no ho biribiara nnka ma adze nnkyē do; na dza ɔbɛka ma adze akyē do no hom mfa gya nhyew.
Na mbrɛ hom ndzi no nye yi; hom mbobɔ hom asen do, hom mpaboa nhyehyɛ hom anan, na hom mpoma nkitsakitsa hom nsamu: Na hom ndzi no ɔhar do: Ɔyɛ Ewuradze apaho.
Osiandɛ mubotwa mu wɔ Egypt asaase do anago no, na muboku Egypt asaase do mbakan nyinara, nyimpa nye mbowa nyina; na mubobu Egypt enyame nyinara ntsɛn: Emi nye Ewuradze.
Na bɔgya no bɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze ama hom wɔ efi a hom wɔ mu no ho: Na sɛ muhu mbɔgya no a, mebɛpa hom ho, na ɔyardɔm bi nnkɛba hom do abɛsɛɛ bom, sɛ morobɔbɔ Egypt asaase no a.
Na da yi nyɛ nkaa mma hom, na hom nhyɛ no fa mma Ewuradze: Hom nnam ɔmom do nyɛ no afahyɛ wɔ hom ebusuasantsen mu daa.

Nda esuon na hom ndzi epitsi boodoo; da a odzi kan no ara na hom nyi mbɔrkaw mfi hom efiefi: Na hom biara a obedzi mbɔrkaw boodoo ofitsi da a odzi kan no do dze kodu da a otsīa esuon no do no, ɔkra no wobotwa no efi Israel.
Na da a odzi kan no hom nyɛ no nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn, na da a otsīa esuon no so nhyia mu krɔnkrɔn; wɔnnyɛ edwuma biara wɔ mu, gyedɛ dza nyimpa biara, bedzi, ɔno nko na hom nyɛ.
Na hom ndwen epitsi afahyɛ no do; na dɛm da yi ara so na miyii hom dɔm no mifii Egypt asaase do: Dɛm ntsi hom ndwen da yi do wɔ hom ebusuasantsen mu nyɛ no ɔmom daa.
Bosoom a odzi kan no mu, bosoom no mu da a otsia duanan ewimbir no, na hom ndzi epitsi ma onkodu bosoom no mu da a otsīa eduonu biako ewimbir.
Nda esuon na mma mma wonnhu mbɔrkaw wɔ hom efi mu: Na obiara a obedzi dza ɔaka no, ɔkra no wobotwa no efi Israel mboanofo mu, sɛ ɔyɛ ɔmamforanyi o, obi a wɔwoo no wɔ asaase no do o.
Mma hom nndzi biribiara a akaw; hom ndzi epitsi wɔ hom tsenabew nyinara.
Nna Moses frɛɛ Israel mpanyimfo nyinara, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nkɔ nkeyiyi nguambaa dɛ mbrɛ hom ebusua tsetsee, na hom nku apaho no.

Na hom mfa hyssop siaw, na hom mfa mbɔ bɔgya a ɔwɔ bɛɛsen no mu no mu, na hom mfa bɔgya a ɔwɔ bɛɛsen no mu no bi, mfa mpetse mpondua etsifi nye apondua ebien no ho; na mma hom mu obiara mmfir edzi mmfi ne fie ɔponano ma onkodu anapa.
Na Ewuradze botwa mu abɔbɔ Egyptfo; na sɛ ohu bɔgya no wɔ mpondua etsifi, nye apondua ebien no ho a, Ewuradze bɛpa ɔpon no ho, na ɔnnkɛma osɛɛfo no kwan ma ɔaaba hom efi mu abɔbobɔ hom.
Na hom ndwen iyi do ma ɔnye ɔmom mma ɔwo nye wo mba daa.
Na ɔbeba dɛ, sɛ hom du asaase a Ewuradze dze bɛma hom no do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔabɔ anohoba no a, ɔno hom ndzi ɔsom yi do.
Na obɛba dɛ, sɛ hom mba se hom dɛ, hom som yi ase nye dɛn? a,
ɔno hom nse dɛ, ɔyɛ Ewuradze n’apaho afɔrbɔdze, nyia ɔpaa Israelmba hɔn efi ho wɔ Egypt, wɔ aber a ɔbɔɔ Egyptfo, na oyii hɛn efi fii mu no. Na ɔman no bɔɔ hɔn tsir adze na wɔsɔree.
Na Israelmba kɔree kɛyɛɛ dem; dɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses nye Aaron no no, dɛmara so na wɔyee.
Na ɔbaa dɛ esuoankɔnmu no, Ewuradze bɔbɔɔ Egypt asaase do mbakan nyinara, ofi Pharaoh n’abakan a ɔtsena n’ahengua do no do dze kodu adaduadan mu ndɔmmum n’abakan do; nye ofiembowa mbakan nyinara.
Na Pharaoh soɛɛr anago no ara, ɔno, nye no nkowaa nyinara, nye Egyptfo nyinara: Na sū kese baa Egypt; osiandɛ ofi biara nnyi hɔ a obi ennwu wɔ mu.
Na ɔfrɛɛ Moses nye Aaron anago, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nsoɛr, hom fi me man mu mfir, hom nye Israelmba no nyina; na hom nkɔ nkɔsom Ewuradze, dɛ mbrɛ hom akã no.
Hom mfa hom nguan nye hom anantwi so, dɛ mbrɛ hom ãka no, na hom nkɔ; na hom nhyira mo so.
Na Egyptfo no piapiaa ɔman no dɛ wɔrepam hɔn ntsɛm efi asaase no do; na wɔsee dɛ, hɛn nyinara ayɛ ewufo ara nye no.
Na ɔman no fefaa hɔn mbɔransaana ɔrekaw, hɔn mbɔrakorow no wɔakyekyer no wɔ hɔn atam mu sisi hɔn kɔn ho.
Na Isrealmba no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Moses kãe no; na wobisabisaa dwɛɛtɛɛ ndwindze, nye sika ndwindze, nye atam wɔ Egyptfo hɔ:
na Ewuradze maa ɔman no enyimpa wɔ Egyptfo no enyim, ma wɔmaa hɔn nsa kaa dza wobisae no. Na wɔfoom Egyptfo.
Na Israelmba no sii mu fii Rameses kɔr Succoth, mbanyin ara a wɔnam anamɔn mu wɔbɛyɛ mpem ara ahaesia, ka mbofraba ho.
Na aforafora dɔm so nye hɔn kɔree; na nguan, na anantwi, mekyerɛ ofiembowa piigyan
Na wɔdze mbɔr a wɔdze fi Egypt bae no totoo epitsi tatar, na ɔnnkawee; osiandɛ wɔpaam hɔn fii Egypt, na woenntum enntsintsim, nkyii so woennsiesie edzidzidze biara amma hɔnho.
Afei tsena a Israelmba wɔdze tsenaa Egypt no, ɔyɛ mfe ahaanan eduasa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe ahaanan eduasa no n'ewiei mno, mekyerɛ da kor no ara, ɔbaa dɛ, Ewuradze no dɔm nyinara tui fii Egypt asaase do.
Ɔyɛ anago a ɔwɔ dɛ wɔhyɛ no nsew ma Ewuradze dɛ oyiii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do: Iyi nye Ewuradze n'anago no a wɔhyɛ no nsew wɔ Isrealmba nyinara mu wɔ hɔn ebusuasantsen nyina mu no.
Na Ewuradze see Moses nye Aaron dɛ, iyi nye apaho no ho ɔmom no: Ɔnanaben biara nndzi bi:
Na nyimpa biara n'akowa a ɔdze sika atɔ no no dze, sɛ etwa no twatsia a, ɔno ondzi bi.
Mma ɔmamforanyi nye akowaa ɔpaanyi nndzi bi.
Ofi kor muna wondzi; mma mmfa nam no bi mmfi ofi no mu mmpue; nkyii so mma hom mmbu ne biew bi.
Israel mboanofo nyinara nndzi do.

Na sɛ ɔhɔho bi bɛnye wo tsena, na ɔpɛ dɛ odzi apaho no ma Ewuradze a, ma wontwa ne mbarimba nyinara twatsia, na nkyii ɔntwe mbɛn na ombedzi; na ɔnyɛ dɛ nyia wɔawo no asaase no do: Monomonomnyi biara dze mma onndzi bi.
Mbra kor na ɔnda hɔ mma nyia ɔyɛ okuromnyi, nye ɔhɔho a ɔtsena hom mu.
Na Israelmba nyinara yɛɛ dɛm; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses nye Aaron no, dɛmara so na wɔyɛe.
Na ɔbaa dɛ da kor no ara, Ewuradze yii Israelba no fii Egypt asaase do dɛmbrɛ hɔn dɔm tsetsee.
13: Na Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Tu mbakan nyinara si nkyɛn ma me, adze biara a obue yafun mu, wɔ Israelmba mu, wɔ onyimpa nye abowa mu nyinara ɔyɛ medze.
Na Moses see ɔman no dɛ, Hom nkaa da yi a hom dze fii Egypt firii, fii nkowaasom fi mu no; na nsa a ɔyɛ dzen na Ewuradze dze yii hom fii bea no do: Mma wonndzi mbɔrkaw boodoo.
Ndɛ da yi na hom rifir edzi wɔ bosoom Abib mu.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ Ewuradze nya dze wo du Canaanfo, nye Hittifo, nye Amorifo, ye Hivifo, nye Jebusfo asaase a ɔkãa ho ntam kyerɛ w'egyanom dɛ ɔbɛma wo no, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no do a, ɔno som ɔsom yi wɔ bosoom yi mu.
Nda esuon na dzi epitsi boodoo, na da a otsia esuon no bɛyɛ afahyɛ ama Ewuradze.
Wondzi epitsi boodoo wɔ wo nkyɛn, nkyii so mma wonnhu mbɔrkaw wɔ wo nkyɛn, wɔ wo ntoaado nyinaramu.
Na da no bɔ dzin kyerɛ wo ba dɛ, osian dza mifii Egypt bae a Ewuradze dze yɛɛ me no ntsi a.
Na ɔbɛyɛ wo wo nsa do asɛnkyerɛdze, na w'enyiwa ntamu nkaadze, ama Ewuradze mbra no aako w'anomu: Na nsa a ɔyɛ dzen na Ewuradze eyi wo efi Egypt.
Dɛm ntsi dzi ɔmom yi do wɔ ne ber mu afrenhyia daa.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ Ewuradze dze wo du Canaanfo asaase do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa ntam kyerɛɛ ɔwo nye w'egyanom no, na ɔdze ma wo a,
Ɔno yi dza obue yafun mu nyinara si nkyɛn ma Ewuradze, na abakan biara a ewɔ a ofi abowa mu: Enyin no nyɛ Ewuradze dze
Na asoaso abakan biara fa eguambaa sesa; na sɛ annsesa a, ɔno bu no kɔn mu; na nyimpa mbakan a wɔwɔ wo mbabanyin mu nyinara dze sesa.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ ndaamba bi wo ba bisa wo dɛ, Ebɛn adze nye yi? A, ase no dɛ, Nsa a ɔyɛ dzen na Ewuradze dze yii hɛn fii Egypt, fii nkowaasom fi no mu:

na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Pharaoh ɔmmpen dɛ ɔbɛma yaakɔ no, Ewuradze kunkum Egypt asaase do mbakan nyinara, nyimpa abakan, nye mbowa abakan nyina dɛm ntsi na mo so medze enyin nyinara a wobue ɔyafun mu no mobɔ Ewuradze afɔr; na me mbabanyin mu mbakan nyinara dze mesesa.
Na ɔbɛyɛ wo nsa do asɛnkyerɛdze, nye w'enyiwa ntamu nkaadze: Na nsa a ɔyɛ dzen na Ewuradze dze yii hɛn fii Egypt.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, Pharaoh maa ɔman no kwan no, Nyankopɔn ammfa hɔn annkɛfa Philistiafo asaase do kwan do, kaansa ɔno ɔbɛn mpo a; na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Bi a bɛyɛ na ɔman no ekohu ɔsa, na woenu hɔnho, na wɔasan akɔ Egypt:
Mbom Nyankopɔn dze ɔman no danee faa Epo Memen no ho sar do ɔkwan do; na Israelmba no miae fii Egypt asaase do kɔree.
Na Moses faa Joseph mbiew no kaa no ho: Osiandɛ ɔakã Israelmba ntam dɛ, ampaara Nyankopɔn bɛba abɛsera hom; na hom mfa me mbiew nka hom ho mfi ha nkɔ.
Na wotuu hɔn kwan fii Succoth, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Etham, wɔ sar no ano.
Na Ewuradze dzii hɔn enyim ewimbir wɔ mununkum dum mu, dɛ ɔrekyerɛ hɔn kwan; na anago wɔ gya dum mo, dɛ ɔrema hɔn kan; ama wɔaanantsew ewiaber nye anago:
Ewiaber mununkun dum no, nye anago gya dum no, wɔanntwe hɔnho emmfi ɔman no enyim.
14: Na Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kã kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ wɔnsan hɔn ekyir na wɔnkɛkyer nsera Pi-hahiroth enyim, wɔ Migdol nye po ntamu, wɔ Baalzephon enyim: Ne tsentsendo na hom nkyer nsera no wɔ po ne nkyɛn.
Na Pharaoh bɛse wɔ Israelmba ho dɛ, wɔatotõ wɔ asaase no do, sar no ntow hɔn mu.
Na mibepirim Pharaoh n'akoma, na obetsiw hom; na mebɛhyɛ m'enyim nyam wɔ Pharaoh nye no dɔm nyinara do; na Egyptfu bohu dɛ emi nye Ewuradze. Na wɔyɛɛ dɛm.
Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Egypthen no dɛ ɔman no eguan kɔ: Na Pharaoh nye no nkowaa no hɔn akoma sakyeree wɔ ɔman no ho, na wɔsee dɛ, ebɛnadze na yɛayɛ yi, dɛ yɛama Israel egyaa hɛn som kɔ yi?
Na ɔhyehyɛɛ ne tseaseanam, na ɔfaa ne man kaa no ho;
Na ɔfaa ntseaseanam a wɔasan mu eyi ahaesia, na Egypt ntseaseanam nyinara, na hɔn nyinara hɔn do asafohemfo.
Na Ewuradze piriim Egypthen Pharaoh n'akoma, na otsiiw Israelmba no: Na Israelmba no dze ahosɛpɛw kɛse fiir edzi kɔree.
Na Egyptfo tsiiw hɔn, Pharaoh no mpɔnkɔ nye ne ntseaseanam nyinara, nye no mpɔnkɔdofo, nye no dɔm no, na wɔbɔtoo hɔn dɛ wɔakyer nsera wɔ po no ano, Pi-hahiroth nkyɛn, wɔ Baal-zephon enyim.
Na aber a Pharaoh bɛnee no, Israel memaa hɔn enyi do, na, hwɛ, Egyptfo etu dzi hɔn ekyir reba; na wosuroo dodow; na Israelmba no sūi frɛɛ Ewuradze.
Na wɔsee Moses dɛ, osiandɛ ndakamaa nnyi Egypt ntsi, na eyi hɛn hɔ ma yerubowuwu wɔ sar do yi?
Ana nnyɛ yi nye asɛm a yɛkãa kyerɛɛ wo wɔ Egypt no, dɛ, Gyaa hɛn ma yɛnsom Egyptfo no? Osiandɛ nkyɛ obeye ama hɛn dɛ yɛbɔsom Egyptfo mbom sen dɛ yɛbowuwu wɔ sar do.
Na Moses see ɔman no dɛ, mma hom nnsuro, hom ngyina dzinn, na hom nhwɛ Ewuradze no nkwagye a ɔrebɛyɛ akyerɛ hom ndɛ da yi: Na Egyptfo a hom ehu hɔn ndɛ da yi, hom nnkohu hɔn bio dabiarada.
Ewuradze bɔkõ ama hom, na hom nkã hom ano nto mu.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na isū frɛ me yi? Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, ma wɔnkɔ kan.
Na ma wo poma no do, na paa mu: Na Israelmba nnantsew mfa po no ne finimfin wɔ daadze kɛsɛɛ do.
Na emi, hwɛ, mibepirim Egyptfo akoma, na wobedzi hɔn ekyir: Na mebɛhyɛ m'enyim nyam wɔ Pharaoh do, nye no mpɔnkɔdofo do.
Na Egyptfo no bohu dɛ emi nye Ewuradze, aber a mahyɛ m'enim nyam wɔ Pharaoh do, ne ntseaseanam do, nye no mpɔnkɔdofo do no.
Na Nyankopɔn no bɔfoe a odzi Israel nseraban enyim no, ɔtwee noho na okedzii hɔn ekyir; na mununkum dum no twee fii hɔn enyim, na okegyinaa hɔn ekyir:
Na ɔbaa Egypt nseraban no nye Israel nEzraban no ntamu; na ɔyɛɛ mununkum nye sum, naaso ɔmaa kan anago: Na kor ammba kor nkyɛn anago nyinara.
Na Moses tseen ne nsa wɔ po no do; na Ewuradze dze boka mframa dzendzen maa po no kɔr ekyir anago no nyinara, na ɔyɛɛ po no asaase kɛsɛɛ, na nsu no mu paae.
Na Israelmba no nantsewee faa po no ne finifim wɔ daadze kɛsɛɛ no do: Na nsu no yɛɛ hɔn fadum wɔ hɔn nsa enyimfa, nye hɔn abankum.
Na Egyptfo no tsiiw hɔn, na wodzii hɔn ekyir kɔr po no ne finimfin, Pharaoh no mpɔnkɔ, ne ntseaseanam, nye no mpɔnkɔdofo nyinara.
Na ɔbaa dɛ anapa dasu mu no, Ewuradze nam ogya nye mununkum dum no mu hwɛɛ Egyptfo dɔm no, na ɔkaa Egyptfo dɔm no gui.
Na ohuhuaan hɔn ntseaseanam n'anan-hwiir ma no ntwee mu yɛ dzen: Ma dɛm ntsi Egyptfo no see dɛ, Hom mma yemfi Israel enyim nguan; na Ewuradze nye Egyptfo roko dze ma hɔn.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, tsen wo nsa wɔ po no do, ma nsu no mbra bio wɔ Egyptfo do, hɔn ntseaseanam do, nye hɔn mpɔnkɔdofo do.
Na Moses tseen ne nsa wɔ po no do, na adze kyee anapano po no saan n'ekyir peem dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse no ara, na Egyptfo guanee behyiaa no; na Ewuradze toow Egyptfo guu po no ne finimfin.
Na nsu no saan n'ekyir, na ɔbɛkataa ntseaseanam, nye mpɔnkɔdofo no, mekyerɛ Pharaoh no dɔm a wɔdzii hɔn ekyir kɔr po no ne finimfin no nyinara do; hɔn mu kor mpo annka.
Na Israelmba no dze, wɔnantseew asaase kɛsɛɛ do wɔ po no ne finimfin; na nsu no yɛɛ fadum maa hɔn wɔ hɔn nsa enyimfa, nye hɔn abankum.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze sii gyee Israel nkwa da no fii Egyptfo no dɛ woewuwu gu po no ano.
Na Israel hun dwuma kɛse a Ewuradze dzii no wɔ Egyptfo do, na ɔman no suroo Ewuradze: Na wɔgyee Ewuradze, nye n'akowaa Moses dzii.
15: Nna Moses nye Israelmba no toow ndwom yi maa Ewuradze, na wɔkaa dɛ, Mobɔtow ndwom mama Ewuradze, na ɔatenan enyimnyam mu: Ɔpɔnkɔ nye no do tsefo no ɔatow hɔn egu po mu.
Ewuradze nye m'ahoɔdzen nye mo ndwom, na ɔabɛyɛ mo nkwagye: Oyi nye me Nyankopɔn a, na mubohuhor no.
Ewuradze yɛ ɔsabarimba: Ewuradze nye ne dzin.
Pharaoh ne ntseaseanam nye no dɔm no ɔatow hɔn egu po mu: Na n'asafohemfo a wɔasan mu eyi no wɔamemem Epo Memen no mu.
Ebun akata hɔn do: Wɔamemem kɔ ase too dɛ ɔbo.
Ewuradze, wo nsa enyimfa yɛ tum mu onyimnyamfo, Ewuradze, wo nsa enyimfa dwerew ɔtamfo no.
Na w'abɔso akɛseyɛ no mu ara na edze butuw hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia wo no: Ɔwo soma w'ebufuhyew ba, ɔhyew hɔn dɛ eburonan.
Na wo hwen mu ehuw mu na nsu no ano boae, nsuyirii no gyinaa bantsenn dɛ kuw: Ebun no kyekyeer wɔ po akoma mu.
Ɔtamfo no see dɛ, mibetsiw hɔn, mobɔto hɔn, mebɛkyɛ asadze no mu: Wobɛmee me kra; mobɔtwe m'afowa, nsa bɛsɛɛ hɔn.
Ɔwo dze wo mframa huwii, epo no kataa hɔn do: Wɔmeem dɛ sumbui wɔ nsu kɛse no mu.
Ewuradze, woana na ɔtse dɛ ɔwo, wɔ enyame mu? Woana na ɔtse dɛ ɔwo, wɔ enyame mu? Woana na ɔtse dɛ ɔwo, krɔnkrɔnyɛ mu onyimnyamfo, Ayɛyi mu ɔhoyifo, anwanwadzeyɛfo?
Ɔwo tseen wo nsa enyimfa, Asaase meen hɔn.
ɔwo wo mbɔbɔrhu mu na egya ɔman a apon hɔn no kwan: Ɔwo w'ahoɔdzen mu na egya hɔn akɔ wo tsenabew krɔnkrɔn no.
Aman atsetse, hɔn ho rihim: Ahopopo aka hɔn a wɔtse Philistia.
Nna Edom asafohen-mpanyin bɔɔ hu; Moab akatakyi no, ahohim aka hɔn: Hɔn a wɔtse Canaan nyinara ananan.
Nketsenketse nye suro ekitsa hɔn; w'abasa ne kɛseyɛ ntsi wɔayeyɛ dzindzinn dɛ ɔbo; kodu dɛ wo man a enya hɔn no botwa mu.
ɔwo dze hɔn bɛba, na abɛtsɛw hɔn wɔ w'egyapadze bepɔw no do, Bea a, Ewuradze, edze ayɛ wo tsenabew no a, Krɔnkrɔn-bea a, Ewuradze, edze wo nsa dze etsim hɔ no a.
Ewuradze bedzi hen daa.

Na Pharaoh no mpɔnkɔ nye ne ntseaseanam na ɔnye no mpɔnkɔdofo na wɔkɔr po no mu, na Ewuradze maa po no mu nsu no saane bɛkataa hɔn do; na Israelmba no dze wɔnantseew asaase kɛsɛɛ do wɔ po ne finimfin.
Na nkɔnhyɛyɛnyi Miriam, Aaron n'akyerɛbaa no, faa mfuaba kitsae: Na mbaa no nyinara dze mfuaba na ɔnye asaw puei dzii n'ekyir.
Na Miriam gyee hɔn do dɛ, hom ntow ndwom mma Ewuradze na ɔatenan enyimnyam mu; ɔpɔnkɔ nye no do tsefo no ɔatow hɔn egu po mu.
Na Moses gyaa Israel fii Epo Memen no ho kɔr kan, na wɔkɔr Shur sar do, na wɔnantseew sar no do ndaasa,na woennhu nsu.
Na wɔbaa Marah no, woenntum annom Marah nsu no bi, osiandɛ ɔyɛ wen: Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Marah.
Na ɔman no hwinhwiin Moses ho dɛ, ebɛnadze na Yɛnnom?
Na osui frɛɛ Ewuradze; na Ewuradze kyerɛɛ no dua bi, na ɔtowee kyeen nsu no mu, na nsu no yɛɛ dɛw. Hɔ na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn ahyɛdze nye ɔmom, na hɔ so na ɔsɔɔ hɔn hwɛe;

na ɔsee dɛ, sɛ ibetsie Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ne ndze yie, na ayɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ n'enyiwa mu, na ama aso wɔ ne mbransɛm do, na edzi n'ahyɛdze nyinara do a, ɔnodze mennkɛfa yarba biara a medze megu Egyptfo do no bi megu wo do: Na emi nye Ewuradze a ɔsa wo yarba no.
Na wɔbaa Elim, mbrɛ nsunyiwa duebien, nye mbɛdua eduosuon wɔ: Na wɔkyeer nsera wɔ hɔ wɔ nsu no ho.
16: Na wotui fii Elim, na Israel mboanofo no nyinara baa Sin sar a ɔda Elim nye Sinai ntamu no do, nna wofii Egypt asaase do no, no bosoom a otsia ebien no mu da a otsia duenum nye no.
Na Israelmba mboanofo man mu nyinara hwinhwiin Moses nye Aaron ho wɔ sar no do:

Na Israelmba no see hɔn dɛ, mbom nkyɛ Ewuradze mma yenwuwu ne nsaano wɔ Egypt asaase do, aber a yɛtsetse nam nkutu ho no, aber a yedzi edziban mee no; osiandɛ hom dze hɛn efir edzi aba sar yi do, dɛ hom dze hɛn akɔmfun rubokuku mboanofo man mu yi nyinara.

Nna Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, hwɛ, mebɛma edziban efir sor atɔ ama hom; na ɔman no befir edzi akɛtase dza ɔbɔson hɔn ano da kor wɔ ne da mu, ma maasɔ hɔn mahwɛ kyerɛ dɛ wobedzi me mbra do anaa wonnkedzi do.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ da a otsia esia no, wobesiesie dza wɔdze ba no, na ɔbɛyɛ dza wɔtase no daa no no mbɔho ebien.
Na Moses nye Aaron see Israelmba no nyinara dɛ, ewimbir nna hom bohu dɛ Ewuradze eyi hom efi Egypt asaase do:
Na anapa nna hom bohu Ewuradze n'enyimnyam; osiandɛ ɔtse hom ehwimhwin a hom hwinhwim Ewuradze ho no: Na hɛndze ebɛnadze nye hɛn, na hom hwinhwim hɛn ho?

Na Moses dɛ, iyi bɛba, Ewuradze bɛma hom nam ewimbir ma woeedze, na edziban anapa ma wɔaamee, osiandɛ Ewuradze tse hom ehwinhwin a hom dze hwinhwin no ho: Na ebɛnadze nye hɛn? Nnyɛ hɛn ho na hom hwinhwin, mbom Ewuradze ho a.
Na Moses see Aaron dɛ, se Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara dɛ, hom ntwe mpin Ewuradze enyim: Na ɔatse hom ehwinhwin no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Aaron rekasa kyerɛ Israelmba mboanofo nyinara no, wɔdandaan hɔn enyi kɔr sar no do, na hwɛ, Ewuradze enyimnyam puei wɔ mununkum no mu.
Na Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Matse Israelmba ehwinhwin no: Kã kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Ewimbir hom bedzi nam, na anapa hom edzi edziban amee; na hom ehu dɛ emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ewimbir no nkokɔhwerɛw bae, na wɔbɛkataa nseraban no do: Na anapa no ɔbɔw tɔr nseraban no ho hyiae.
Na ɔbɔw a ɔtɔree no kɔr sor no, hwɛ, adze bi nkorkorba nkentsenketse deda sar no enyi, nketsenketse dɛ famu ɔbɔsu kyenkyenee
Na aber a Israelmba hunii no, wɔsesee hɔnho nkorkor dɛ, Ebɛnadze nye yi? Osiandɛ wo nnyim adze kor no. Na Moses see hɔn dɛ, iyi nye edziban a Ewuradze ama hom dɛ hom ndzi.
Iyi nye adze a Ewuradze ahyɛ, Hom ntase bi dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa biara n'edzidzi tse; omer nkorkor, dɛ mbrɛ hom nyimpa dodow tse, nna hom mfefa, nyimpa biara mfa mma hɔn a wɔwɔ n'asesee mu no.
Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dɛm, na wɔtaasee, binom dze sõ, binom dze suar.
Na wɔdze omer susui no, nyia ɔtaase pii no oennya bi ammbor do, na nyia ɔtaase kumaabi no annka no bi: Wɔtaasee dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa biara n'edzidzi tse.
Na Moses see hɔn dɛ, mma obi nngya bi ma adze nnkyē do.
Naanso woenntsie Moses; mbom hɔn mu binom gyaa bi ma adze kyēe do, na ɔdɔɔ mbowaba, na ɔbɔnee; na Moses no bo fuuw hɔn.
Na wɔtaase no anapa anapa, nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ n'edzidzi tse: Na ewia ano yɛɛ dzen no, ɔnanee.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, da a otsīa esia no wɔtaase edziban no mbɔho, ɔbaako dze yɛ omer ebien: Na mboanofo no mu mpanyinfo nyinara baa bɛkãa kyerɛɛ Moses.

Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, iyi nye da Ewuradze akã no, ɔkyena yɛ awɔse ahomgye, ahomgyeda krɔnkrɔn ma Ewuradze: hom ntõ dza hom bɔtõ, na hom nnoa dza hom bɔnoa; na dza ɔka no nyinara hom mfa nsie ma adze nkyē do.
Na wɔdze siee ma akodur anapa, dɛ mbrɛ Moses hyɛɛ no: Na ɔammbɔn, nkyii so abowaba bi nnyi mu.
Na Moses see dɛ, Hom ndzi ɔno ndɛ; na ndɛ ɔyɛ ahomgyeda ma Ewuradze: Ndɛ hom nnkohu bi wɔ haban mu.
Nda esia na hom ntase; na da a otsīa esuon no dze ɔyɛ ahomgyeda, ɔno mu bi nnkɛba hɔ.
Na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsīa esuon no, ɔman no mu bi fiir edzi dɛ wɔrekɛtase, na woennhu bi.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Hom ropow dɛ wodzi me mbransɛm nye me mbra do ma ekodu dabɛn?

Hom nhwɛ, osiandɛ Ewuradze ama hom ahomgyeda ntsi, na da a otsīa esia no ɔma hom nda ebien edziban: Hom mu nnyimpa biara ntsena ne tsenabew, mma obiara mmfir edzi mmfi ne ntsenabew wɔ da a otsīa esuon no mu.
Nna ɔman no hoom da a otsīa esuon no.
Na Israel fi frɛɛ ne dzin Manna: Na otse dɛ coriander aba, fitaa, na ne dɛw tse dɛ tatar-ntrɛtraba a wɔdze ewo ayɛ.
Na Moses see dɛ, iyi nye adze a Ewuradze ahyɛ, Wɔmfa bi nhyɛ omer mã mfa nsie hom ebusuasantsen; ama woeehu edziban a medze menyɛɛn hom wɔ sar no do, aber a miyii hom fii Egypt asaase do no.
Na Moses see Aaron dɛ, Fa kutu bi, na fa manna omer kor gu mu, na fa si Ewuradze enyim, ma wɔmfa nsie hom ebusuasantsen.
Dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no, dɛmara so na Aaron dze sii Adansehyɛdze no enyim, ma wɔdze eesie.
Na Israelmba no dzii manna no mfe eduanan, dze kodur dɛ wɔbaa Canaan asaase no ntoaado.
Afei omer ɔyɛ ephah mu ebupɛn du mu kor.
17: Na Isrealmba mboanofo no nyinara tui fii Sin sar no do, wɔ hɔn akwantu mu, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze mbrasɛm tse, na wɔkɛkyekyeer nsera wɔ Rephidim: Na nsu nnyi hɔ mma ɔman no dɛ wɔbɔnom.
Dɛm ntsi ɔman no nye Moses hamee, na wɔsee dɛ, Ma hɛn nsu ma yɛnnom. Na Moses see hɔn dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na hom nye me reham? Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom rosɔ Ewuradze ahwaɛ?
Na nsukɔm dzee ɔman no wɔ hɔ; na ɔman no hwinhwiin Moses ho, na wɔsee dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na iyii hɛn fii Egypt bae, dɛ edze nsukɔm ruboku hɛn nye hɛn mba nye hɛn mbowa yi?
Na Moses sūi frɛɛ Ewuradze see dɛ, ebɛnadze na menyɛ memma ɔman yi? Aka kuma ma woeesiw me abo.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Pa ho kedzi ɔman no enyim, na fa Israel mpanyin no bi ka woho; na wo poma a edze boo esutsen no, fa kitsa wo nsamu, na kɔ.
Hwɛ, mibegyina w’enyim wɔ hɔ wɔ Horeb ɔbotan no do; na bɔ ɔbotan no, na nsu befi mu aba, ma ɔman no aanom. Na Moses yɛɛ dɛm wo Israel mpanyin no enyim.
Na ɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Massah, nye Meribah, osian Israelmba hɔn ham no ntsi, na Ewuradze a wɔsɔɔ no hwɛe see dɛ, Ana Ewuradze wɔ hɛn mu, anaa onnyi mu ntsi a?
Nna Amalek bae, na ɔnye Israel bɔkõe wɔ Rephidim.
Na Moses see Joshua dɛ, San mu yiyi mbanyin ma hɛn, na fir edzi kɔ, nye Amalek nkɔkõ: Ɔkyena medze Nyankopɔn poma no bekitsa me nsamu mekegyina koko no etsifi.
Nna Joshua yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Moses see no no, na ɔnye Amalek kɔkõe: Na Moses, Aaron, nye Hur fowee kɔr koko no etsifi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ Moses ma ne nsa do a, nna Israel edzi nyim: Na sɛ ɔto ne nsa famu a, nna Amalek edzi nyim.
Na Moses ne nsa gyenee; na wɔfaa ɔbo, na wɔdze too n’ase, na ɔtsenaa do; na Aaron nye Hur susuoo ne nsamu gyinaa, ɔbaako dze afã, na ɔbaako so dze afã so; na ne nsa gyinaa dzinn kodur witɔree.
Na Joshua dwereew Amalek nye ne man afõwa ano.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, kyerew iyi wɔ nwoma mu fa yɛ nkaa, na kã hye Joshua n’asomu: Dɛ pepa ara na mebɛpepa Amalek ho nkaa mefi ɔsor ase.
Na Moses sii afɔrmbukyia, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Jehovah-nissi;
na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze esua; Ewuradze nye Amalek bedzi akõ fi ebusuasantsen do ekodu ebusuasantsen do.
18: Afei Jethro, Midian ɔsɔfono, Moses n’asew no, tsee dza Nyankopɔn ayɛ ama Moses, nye ne man Israel no nyinara, mbrɛ Ewuradze esi eyi Israel efi Egypt.
Na Jethro, Moses n’asew no, faa Zipporah, Moses yer a ɔama ɔasan kɔ no,
nye ne mbabanyin beenu a ɔbaako ne dzin dze Gershom; na ɔkãa dɛ, Mayɛ amanandze hɔho:
Na kor no so ne dzin dze Eliezer, na ɔsee dɛ, m’egya ne Nyankopɔn mo mboa, na oyii me fii Pharaoh n'afõwa anomu:
na Jethro, Moses n'asew no, dze ne mbabanyin no nye ne yer no baa Moses nkyɛn wɔ sar no do mbrɛ ɔkɛkyeer nsera no, wɔ Nyankopɔn bepɔw no ho:
Na ɔsee Moses dɛ, Emi w’asew Jethro, nye wo yer, nye ne mbabanyin beenu no ka no ho, aba wo nkyɛn.
Na Moses fiir edzi kehyiaa n’asew, na ɔkotowee, na ofeew n’ano; na wobisabisaa hɔn apɔwmu; na wɔbaa asese mu.
Na Moses kãa dza osian Israel ntsi Ewuradze dze ayɛ Pharaoh nye Egyptfo nyinara kyerɛɛ n’asew, awoko a ɔbaa hɔn do wɔ ɔkwan no mu nyinara, na mbrɛ Ewuradze sii yii hɔn no.
Na Jethro dzii dɛw wɔ papa a Ewuradze ayɛ ama Israel, wɔ dɛ oyii hɔn fii Egyptfo nsamu no nyinara ho.
Na Jethro see dɛ, nhyira nkã Ewuradze a oeyi hom efi Egyptfo nsamu, na woefi Pharaoh nsamu; ɔno a oeyi ɔman no efi Egyptfo nsaadze.
Afei na mehu dɛ Ewuradze yɛ kɛse kyɛn enyame nyinara: Nyew, adze a wɔdze dzi hɔn do nkontompɔsɛm no ara mu a.
Na Jethro, Moses n’asew no, faa ɔhyew-afɔr nye okumfɔr kɛmaa Nyankopɔn: Na Aaron nye Israel mpanyin nyinara baa dɛ wɔnye Moses n’asew no ribedzidzi wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na ɔbaa de adze kyēe no, Moses tsenaa famu dɛ orubu ɔman no ntsɛn: Na ɔman no gyinaa Moses do tsentsen fi anapa kodur ewimbir.

Na aber a Moses n’asew hun dza ɔyɛe maa ɔman no nyinara no, ɔsee dɛ, ebɛnadze na ereyɛ ma ɔman yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na woara nko etse hɔ, na ɔman no nyinara gyinagyina wo do tsentsen fi anapa ebodu ewimbir yi?
Na Moses see n’asew no dɛ, osiandɛ ɔman no ba me nkyɛn Nyankopɔn hɔ ebisa:
Sɛ wonya asɛm bi a, wɔba me nkyɛn; na mubu nyimpa nye ne nyɛnko ntamu ntsɛn, na mema wohu Nyankopɔn n’ahyɛdze, nye ne mbra.
Na Moses n’asew no see no dɛ, adze a eyɛ yi onnye,
Ampa ebɛberɛ, ɔwo nye ɔman a wɔka wo ho yi nyina, osiandɛ adze no yɛ dur dodow ma wo; ɔwo woara nko irunntum nnyɛ.
Afei tsie me ndze, mebɛma wo apam, na Nyankopɔn ndzi w’ekyir; ɔwo gyina Nyankopɔn afamu ma ɔman no, na fa nsɛm no brɛ Nyankopɔn:
Na kyerɛkyerɛ hɔn ahyɛdze no nye mbra no, na ma wonhu ɔkwan kor a wɔwɔ dɛ wɔnantsew mu, na edwuma a wɔwɔ dɛ wɔyɛ.

Afei so yiyi ɔman no nyinara mu mbanyin a wotum a wosuro Nyankopɔn a wɔyɛ anokwafo a wokyir enyikaber, na fa hɔn sisi hɔn do, ma wɔnye apem apem do mpanyin, ɔha ɔha do mpanyin, eduonum eduonum do mpanyin, nye du du do mpanyin;
na ma wombu ɔman no ntsɛn aber nyinara mu: Na ɔmbra dɛ asɛnkɛse biara dze wɔmfa mbrɛ wo, na nsɛnketseaba nyinara dze, hɔnara wondzi: Ama aayɛ wo do har, na wɔnye wo aasoa adzesoa no.
Sɛ eyɛ dem adze yi, na Nyankopɔn hyɛ wo dɛm a, ɔno na ibotum asɔw, na ɔman yi nyinara so bɔkɔ hɔn tsenabew dwudwoodwo.
Nna Moses tsiee n’asew ne ndze, na ɔyee dza ɔsee no nyinara.
Na Moses yiyii Israel nyinara mu nyimpa a wotum, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn etsitsir wɔ ɔman no do, apem apem do mpanyin, ɔha ɔha do mpanyin, eduonum eduonum do mpanyin, nye du du do mpanyin.
Na wobuu ɔman no ntsɛn aber nyinara mu: Nsɛm a ɔye dzen no wɔdze brɛɛ Moses, na nsɛnketseaba dze hɔnara wodzii.
Na Moses gyaa n’asew no kwan; na ɔfaa no kwan kɔr nankasa n’asaase do.
19: Bosom a otsia ebiasa a Israelmba sii mu fii Egypt asaase do no, da no ara na wɔbaa Sinai sar do.
Na aber awotui fii Rephidim, na wɔbaa Sinai sar do no, wɔkyeer nsera wɔ sar no do; na hɔ na Israel kyeer nsera wɔ bepɔw no enyim.
Na Moses fowee kɔr Nyankopɔn nkyen, na Ewuradze fii bepɔw no do frɛɛ no see dɛ, dɛm na se Jacob fi, na kã kyere Israelmba;
Hom ehu dza medze mayɛ Egyptfo, na mbrɛ mosoaa hom nkɔr ntsaban do, na medze hom baa mara me nkyɛn.
Dɛm ntsi afei, sɛ hom betsie me ndze ara ampa, na woedzi m'ahyɛmu do a, ɔnodze hom bɛyɛ soronko egyapadze efi aman me: Osiandɛ asaase nyinara yɛ medze:
Na hom bɛyɛ asɔfo ahendzi, nye ɔman krɔnkrɔn ama me. Iyinom nye nsɛm a fa kã kyerɛ Israelmba no.
Na Moses bae na ɔbɛfrɛɛ ɔman mpanyimfo, na ɔdze nsɛm yi a Ewuradze dze hyɛɛ no nyinara too hɔn enyim.
Na ɔman no nyinara bɔɔ mu buae, na wɔsee dɛ. Dze Ewuradze akã nyinara, yɛbɛyɛ. Na Moses kɛkãa ɔman no hɔn nsɛm no kyerɛɛ Ewuradze.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, hwɛ, mereba wo nkyɛn wɔ mununkum kebii mu, ama sɛ menye kasa a ɔman no aatse, na eso wɔaagye wo edzi daa. Na Moses kãa ɔman no hɔn nsɛm no kyerɛɛ Ewuradze.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, kɔ ɔman no nkyɛn, na tsew hɔn ho ndɛ nye ɔkyena, na ma wɔnhohor hɔn ntar,
na wonsiesie hɔnho nsie da a otsia ebiasa no: Na da a otsia ebiasa no Ewuradze besian wɔ ɔman no nyinara enyim aba bepɔw Sinai do.
Na bɔ ɔman no ho ɔheban hyia, se dɛ, hom nhwɛ homho yie, ma hom aammfow bepɔw no, anaa hom annkekã ne he: Obiara a ɔbɛkã bepɔw no oku na woboku no:
Nsa biara nnkã no, mbom abo na wonsiw no, anaa tow na wɔntow no ma onhwira mu; sɛ abowa o, nyimpa o, orinnya nkwa: Sɛ abɛn no hɛn kyer a, wɔmfow bepɔw no.
Na Moses sianee fi bepɔw no do kɔr ɔman no nkyɛn, na ɔtseew oman no ho; na wɔhohoor hɔn ntar.
Na ɔsee ɔman no dɛ, Hom nsiesie homho nsie da a otsia ebiasa no: Mma wɔnnkɔ ɔbaa biara ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsia ebiasa no, anapa no, asenaman nye enyinam, nye mununkum kebii baa bepɔw no do, na abɛn ndze dzendzen mbordo; na ɔman a wowo nseraban no mu nyinara ho popoe.
Na Moses dze ɔman no fir edzi fii nseraban no mu dɛ worikehyia Nyankopɔn; na wokegyinagyinaa bepɔw no ase afamu.
Na bepɔw Sinai no nyinara rupun wusiw, osiandɛ Ewuradze nam gya mu sianee baa do: Na no wusiw no tui kɔr sor dɛ fononoo mu wusiw, na bepɔw no nyinara wosoow kesenara.
Na abɛn no ne ndze yɛɛ dzendzenndzen dodow no, Moses kasae, na Nyankopɔn dze ndze gyee no do.
Na Ewuradze sianee baa bepɔw Sinai do, wɔ bepɔw no etsifi: Na Ewuradze frɛɛ Moses dɛ ɔnkɔ bepɔw no etsifi: Na Moses fowee kɔree.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Sian famu behyia ɔman no, amma wɔaanntsetsew mu ammba Ewuradze nkyɛn ammbɔhwɛ, ma hom mu pii aanntotɔ.
Na ma asɔfo no so a wɔba Ewuradze nkyɛn no ntsew hɔnho, amma Ewuradze eenntu annhyɛ hɔn do.
Na Moses see Ewuradze dɛ, ɔman no runntum mmfow mmba bepɔw Sinai do: Osiandɛ woara hyɛɛ hɛn dɛ, bɔ bepɔw no ho ɔheban hyia, na tsew ho.
Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, kɔ, sian famu; na fow bra, ɔwo, nye Aaron ka wo ho: Na ma asɔfo no nye ɔman no nntsetsew mu mmfow mmba Ewuradze nkyɛn, amma oeenntu annhyɛ hɔn do.
Nna Moses sianee kɔr ɔman no nkyɛn, na ɔkɛkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn.
20: Na Nyankopɔn kãa nsem yi nyinara, see dɛ,
Emi nye Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn a miyii wo wɔ Egypt asaase do, wɔ nkowaasom fi mu no.
Mma nnya enyame fofor nnka mo ho.
Mma nnyɛ ohonyi bi, anaa adze a ɔwo wimu wɔ sor, anaa dza ɔwɔ asaase do wɔ famu, anaa dza ɔwɔ nsu mu wɔ asaase ase, ne saso mma woho:
Mma mmbɔ wo mu adze mma hɔn, na nnsom hɔn: Na emi Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn meyɛ Nyame nyinkufo a medze egyanom hɔn emumuyɛ bɔhwɛ mba, ekodu ebusuasantsen ebiasa nye anan a wɔtan me do;
Na muhu mpempem a wɔdɔ me na wodzi me mbransɛm do mbɔbɔr.
Mma mmbɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dzin gyangyan, na Ewuradze nnkɛma nyia no a ɔbɔ ne dzin gyangyan afa noho tɔtrɔtɔ.
Kaa ahomgyeda no na sie no krɔnkrɔn.
Nda esia na yɛ edwuma, na dzi wo dwuma nyinara:
Na da a otsia esuon no yɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ahomgyeda: Mma nnyɛ edwuma biara wɔ mu, ɔwo o, wo babanyin o, wo babaa o, w’akowaa o, w’afonabaa o, wo mbowa o, wo hɔho a ɔwo wo kuropon mu o:
Na nda esia na Ewuradze bɔɔ sor nye asaase, po, nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara, na ɔhoom da a otsia esuon no: Dɛm ntsi na Ewuradze hyiraa ahomgyeda no, na ɔyɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn.
Dzi w’egya nye wo nā nyi: Ama wo nda aawar wo asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do.
Mma nndzi ewu.
Mma nntõ awar.
Mma nnwia adze.
Mma nngye wo nyɛnko ho dasewia.
Mma w’enyi mmber wo nyɛnko fi, mma w’enyi mmber ne yer, anaa n'akowaa, anaa n’afonabaa, anaa ne nantwi, anaa n’asoaso, anaa birira a ɔyɛ wo nyenko dze.
Na ɔman no nyinara hun asenaman no, nye enyinam no, nye abɛn ndze no, nye bepɔw a orupun wusiw no: Na aber a ɔman no hunii no, hɔn ho popoe, na wokegyinaa ekyirkyir.
Na wɔsee Moses dɛ, woara nye hɛn nkasa, na yebetsie: Na mma Nyankopɔn nnye hɛn nnkasa, ɔno yebowuwu.
Na Moses see ɔman no dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro: Na Nyankopɔn aba dɛ ɔrobɔsɔ hom ahwɛ, ama no ho suro aaba hom enyi do, ma hom aannyɛ bɔn.
Na ɔman no gyinaa ekyirkyir, na Moses twee bɛɛn sum kadoo no mbrɛ Nyankopɔn wɔ no.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, mbrɛ se Israelmba nye yi, homara hom ehu dɛ mifi ɔsor na menye hom akasa.
Mma hom nnyɛ me saso enyame bi; dwɛɛtɛɛ enyame, anaa sika enyame, mma hom nnyɛ mma homho.
Dɛtse afɔrmbukyia na yɛ ma me, na dze wo hyew-afɔr, nye w’asomdwee-afɔr, wo nguan, nye w’anantwi no bɔ do afɔr: Beebiara a mebɛma wɔakaa me dzin no, mebɛba wo nkyɛn na mebehyira wo.
Na sɛ ereyɛ abo afɔrmbukyia ama me: Mma mmfa abo a woetwa nnsia osiandɛ sɛ ema w’edwindadze do bɔ do a, egu ho fī.
Nkyii so mma mmfow atwer nnkɔ afɔrmbukyia do, mma w’adagyaw aannda edzi wɔ do.
21: Na iyinom nye ntsɛmbusem a fa to hɔn enyim.
Sɛ etɔ akowaa a ɔye Hebrewnyi a, mfe esia na ɔnsom: Na dza otsia esuon no mu ɔmfa no ho ndzi nkɔ kwa.
Sɛ noara nko na ɔbae a, noara nko nkɔ: Sɛ ɔawar a, ɔno ne yer nye no nkɔ.
Sɛ no wura ma no yer, na ɔwo mbabanyin anaa mbabaa ma no a, yer no nye ne mba nye ɔbaa no no wura dze, na noara nko nkɔ.
Na sɛ akowaa no kã no petee dɛ, modɔ mo wura, me yer, nye me mba; mennkɛfa moho edzi akɔ a:
Ɔno no wura no mfa no mbra Nyankopɔn enyim, na ɔmfa no mbra ɔpon ho, anaa ɔpon dua ho; na no wura no mfa fitsii mfitsi n'asomu; na ɔnsom no daa.
Na sɛ ɔbanyin bi tɔn ne babaa ma ɔkɛyɛ afonabaa a, ɔnodze mma ɔmmfa noho nndzi nnkɔ dɛ mbrɛ akowaa no yɛ.
Sɛ ɔnnsɔ no wura a noara ɔagye no aye war no enyi a, ɔnodze wɔmma wɔmbɔpon no: Onnyi tum dɛ ɔtɔn no ma ɔnanaben bi, osiandɛ ɔadaadaa no.
Na sɛ ɔgye no ayewar ma ne babanyin a, ɔnyɛ no dɛ mbrɛ wɔdze yɛ mbabaa.
Sɛ ɔgye yer fofor ma no a; mma onnkuw n'edziban, n'akataho, nye n'awar edwuma do.
Na sɛ ɔannyɛ iyinom ebiasa yi amma no a, ɔnodze ɔmfa noho ndzi nkɔ kwa, sika bi nnyi mu.
Nyia ɔbɔ nyimpa ma owu no, oku na wonku no.
Na sɛ nyimpa annkɔ atsɛwee, na Nyankpɔn na ɔama ne nsa apa dze a; ɔno mibeyi beebi mama wo na oeeguan akɔ hɔ.
Na sɛ nyimpa bi ba ne nyɛnko do enyidaho mu dze ndaadaa ku no a; yi no fi m'afɔmbukyia ho, ma onwu.
Na nyia ɔbɔ n'egya, anaa ne nã no, oku na wonku no.
Na nyia owia nyimpa, na ɔtɔn no no, anaa sɛ wohu no wɔ ne nsamu a, oku na wonku no.
Na nyia ɔdom n'egya, anaa ne nã no, oku na wonku no.
Na sɛ nyimpa woridzi aper, na kor bɔ kor no abɔ, anaa kutuku, na oennwu, na ɔka no to ne mpa do a:
Sɛ ɔsoɛr bio, na osuo no poma mu nantsew fir edzi a, ɔnodze nyia ɔbɔɔ no no no ho nyɛ no tɔtrɔtɔ: Ne mber a asɛɛ no nko na ontua kaw, na ɔmma wɔnsa no yarba koraa.
Na sɛ nyimpa bobɔ n'akowaa, anaa n'afonabaa abaa, ma owu ne nsaano a; ɔno wondzi no wer.
Naaso sɛ ɔtsena hɔ da kor anaa nda ebien a, mma wonndzi no wer osiandɛ ɔyɛ ne sika.
Na sɛ mbanyin rokõ, na wopira onyinsemfo, ma ɔpon ɔba, na mbusu bi ammba ekyir dze a: Brabo na wɔngye no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbaa no no kun dze bɔto no do no; na ontuaa no dɛ mbrɛ ntsɛmbuafo no bɛkyerɛ no.
Na sɛ mbusu bi ba ekyir a, ɔnodze fa nkwa hyɛ nkwa ananmu,
enyiwa hyɛ enyiwa ananmu, sē hyɛ sē ananmu, nsa hyɛ nsa ananmu, anan hyɛ anan ananmu,
hyehyew hyɛ hyehyew ananmu, ɔkam hyɛ ɔkam ananmu, mfemfem hyɛ mfemfem ananmu.
Na sɛ obi bɔ n'akowaa enyiwa, anaa n'afonabaa enyiwa na ɔsɛɛ no a, n'enyiwa no ntsi ɔmma ɔmfa noho ndzi nkɔ.
Na sɛ ɔbɔ n'akowaa ne sē tu no, anaa n'afonabaa ne sē a; ne sē no ntsi ɔmma ɔmfa noho ndzi nkɔ.
Na sɛ ɔnantwi sɛ ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa, ma owu a, ɔno ɔnantwi no wonsiw no ano, na mma wonndzi ne nam; na ɔnantwi no wura dze wongyaa no.
Na sɛ ɔnantwi no ɔtɔ sesɛ dada na wɔama no wura atse, na oennsie no fie, na oekoku ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa dze a; ɔnantwi no wonsiw no abo, na no wura no so wonku no.
Sɛ wɔbɛgye no mpata a, ɔno ɔmma adze biara a wɔbɛgye no no mfa ntɔ no nkwa.
Sɛ ɔbabanyin na ɔasɛ no o, ɔbabaa na ɔasɛ no o, atsɛmbu yi ara na wɔmfa mbu no.
Sɛ ɔnantwi no sɛ akowaa anaa afonabaa a, ɔno ɔmma hɔn wura dwɛɛtɛɛ shekel eduasa, na wonsiw ɔnantwi no abo.
Na sɛ nyimpa bi kobue maa do, anaa sɛ nyimpa bi kotu maa na ɔannkata do, na ɔnantwi anaa asoaso kɔhwe mu a,
ma no wura no nhyɛ ananmu; ɔmfa sika mma hɔn wura no, na mbowafun no nyɛ nedze.
Na sɛ nyimpa kor bi ne nantwi pira kor nedze ma owu a; ɔno wɔntɔn nantwi nyikan no, na wɔnkyɛ ne tsiadze no; na fun no so wɔnkyɛ.
Anaa sɛ wonyim dɛ ɔnantwi no ɔtɔ sesɛ dada, na no wura no ennsie no fie a; ɔno ɔmfa ɔnantwi nhyɛ ɔnantwi ananmu, na abowafun no nyɛ noara nedze.
22: Sɛ nyimpa bi kowia nantwi, anaa guan, na oku no, anaa ɔtɔn no a; ɔmfa anantwi enum nhyɛ nantwi kor ananmu, na nguan anan nhyɛ guan kor ananmu ntua kaw.
Sɛ wohu owifo no dɛ oebubu mu reba, na wɔbɔ no adze ma owu a, bɔgyã-sõ nnyi ho ma no.
Sɛ ewia pue no do a, bɔgya-sõ wɔ hɔ ma no: Ahyɛnanmu na ɔnyɛ; sɛ onnyi hwee a, ɔno n'adzewia ntsi wɔntɔn no.
Sɛ wohu adzewiadze no wɔ ne nsamu enyikan a, sɛ ɔyɛ ɔnantwi o, asoaso o, oguan o, ontua kaw mbɔho.

Sɛ nyimpa bi ma wodzi haban anaa wenyim ture mu adze, na ogyaa n'abowa ma okedzi nyimpa kor so ne haban mu adze a, ɔmfa nankasa ne haban mu ndzepa, nye nankasa no wenyim ture mu ndzepa bi nhyɛ ananmu.
Sɛ ogya pue, na ɔkɔsɔ nsoɛ mu ma eburow ekuwekuw, anaa eburow a ogynagyina hɔ, anaa haban no hyew a; ɔhyɛ na nyia ɔsɔɔ gya no nhyɛ ananmu.
Sɛ nyimpa bi dze sika anaa efidze ma ne nyɛnko esie, na wowia no wɔ nyimpa no ne fie a; sɛ wohu owifo no a; ontua kaw mbɔho.
Sɛ woennhu owifo no a, ɔno ofiwura no ntwe mbɛn Nyankopɔn nhwɛ kyerɛ dɛ ɔnntsen ne nsa nnkã ne nyɛnkon'adze no a.

Na mbrato ho asɛm biara, sɛ ɔyɛ ɔnantwi dze o, asoaso dze o, oguan dze o, anaa adze a ayew biara a obi bɛse wɔ ho dɛ, ɔno nye yi o, wɔmfa hɔn beenu nyina hɔn asɛm mbra Nyankopɔn enyim; nyiaa Nyankopɔn bobu no fɔ no, ontua kaw mbɔho mma ne nyɛnko no.
Sɛ nyimpa bi dze asoaso, anaa nantwi, anaa guan, anaa abowa biara ma ne nyɛnko esie, na owu anaa opira, anaa wɔkã no to hamu, na nyimpa bi ennhu a:
Ewuradze ntam mbra hɔn beenu no ntamu, kyerɛ dɛ ɔnntsen ne nsa nnkã ne nyɛnko no n'adze no a; na adze no wura no ɔmpen do, na mma ɔnnhyɛ ananmu.
Sɛ wowia no wɔ ne nkyɛn dze a, ɔnhyɛ adze no wura ananmu.
Sɛ wɔatsetsew no esinesin a, ɔmfa mbra mbedzi dase; dza wɔatsetsew no no mma ɔnnhyɛ ananmu.
Na sɛ nyimpa bi kɛfɛm biribi wɔ ne nyɛnko hɔ a, na ɔsɛɛ, anaa owu, dɛ adze no wura no no ho nnyi mu a, ɔhyɛ na ɔnhyɛ ananmu.
Sɛ adze no wura no no ho wɔ mu a, mma ɔnnhyɛ ananamu: Sɛ ɔyɛ apaabɔ adze a, na ogyina n'apaabɔdze do.
Na sɛ nyipa bi kɛdaada ɔbaabun a wɔnngye no yer, na ɔnye no da a, ɔno ɔmma ne tsiadze ma ɔnyɛ ne yer.
Sɛ n'egya pow koraa dɛ ɔdze no ma a, onker sika mma, dɛ mbrɛ mbaabun tsiadze tse.
Mma mma ɔbaanyɛn kwan ma ɔntsena ase.
Obiara a ɔnye abowa bɛda no, oku na wonku no.
Nyia ɔbɔbɔ afɔr ama onyame biara, na nnyɛ Ewuradze nko no, wɔsɛɛ no koraa.
Na ɔhɔho dze mma nnyɛ no bɔn, nkyii so mma nnhaw no: Osiandɛ hom yɛɛ ahɔho wɔ Egypt asaase do.
Mma hom nntseetsee ɔbaa-kunafo biara, anaa egyankaba.
Sɛ etseetsee hɔn ɔkwan biara mu, na wosū frɛ me dze a, otsie ara na mibetsie hɔn sūfrɛ no;
na m'ebufuw ano bɛyɛ dzen, na medze afõwa boku hom; na hom yernom bɛyɛ ekunafo na hom mba ayɛ ngyanka.
Sɛ efɛm me man mu ohianyi biara a ɔnye wo wɔ hɔ sika a, mma nnyɛ dɛ ɔpempensinyi; nkyii so mma hom nngye no nsiho.
Sɛ egye wo nyɛnko tam ahoba a, wi rotɔ no fa san ma no:
Osiandɛ ɔnoara nko nye n'akataho, no hanam ho tam a: Ebɛnadze na ɔmfa nda? Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ osū frɛ me a, mibetsie: Osiandɛ mbɔbɔrhufo nye me.
Mma nnyeyaw Nyankopɔn, anaa nndom wo man mu ɔpanyin.
Mma nnkyinkyim dɛ edze wo ndɔbaa anaa wo nsã mu bi bɔbɔ afɔr. Wo mbabanyin mu abakan no fa ma me.
Dɛmara na yɛ w'anantwi, na ɔnye wo nguan: Nda esuon na ɔnye ne nã ntsena; da a otsīa awɔtwe no fa no brɛ me.
Na hom bɛyɛ nyimpa krɔnkrɔn ama me: Dɛm ntsi mma hom nndzi bɔnam bi a abowa atsetsew mu wɔ haban mu; hom ntow nkyen nkraman.
23: Mma nntsie atorsɛm: mMma nnye omumuyɛfo nndzi nsawosow dɛ ebɛyɛ ɔdasefo nkontompɔnyi.
Mma nndzi ɔdodow ekyir nnkɛyɛ bɔn; nkyii so mma nnkasa asɛm bi mu nnkedzi ɔdodow ekyir nndan atsɛmbu enyi:
Nkyii so mma nndzi nnkɔ ohianyi afã wɔ n'asɛm mu.
Sɛ ekɔto wo tamfo ne nantwi anaa n'asoaso dɛ ɔatɔ gon a, fa no san ekyir brɛ no bio.
Sɛ ihu nyia okyir wo n'asoaso dɛ ɔhyɛ n'adzesoa ase, na nkyɛ annkɛpɛ dɛ eboa no a, boa na nye no mboa no.
Mma nndan wo hianyi n'atsɛmbu enyi wɔ n'asɛm mu.
Twe woho fi atorsɛm ho kɔ ekyirkyir; na mma nnku nyia odzi bem na ɔtsɛn: Osiandɛ murummbu omumuyɛfo bem.
Na mma nngye akyɛdze: Osiandɛ akyɛdze ma hɔn a wɔwɔ enyiwa fura, na ɔkyeakyea atseneneefo nsɛm.
Na mma nnhaw ɔhɔho: Osiandɛ hom nyim ɔhɔho n'akoma, ɔnam dɛ hom yɛɛ ahɔho wɔ Egypt asaase do ntsi.
Na mfe esia na pe w'asaase do amba, na boaboa no ndɔbaa no sie:
Na afe a otsīa esuon no dze ma ɔngye n'ahom na ɔnda hɔ kwa; ma wo man mu ehiafo ndzi: Na dza wobegya no, hamu abowa ebedzi. Dɛmara na yɛ wo wenyin ture, nye wo ngodua ture.
Nda esia na fa yɛ w’edwuma, na da a otsia esuon no fa hom: Na wo nantwi nye w’asoaso eenya ahomgye: Na w’afonabaa ba, nye ɔhɔho no woeenya ahom.
Na hom nhwɛ yie wɔ ndzɛmba a maka akyerɛ hom nyinara ho: Na mma hom mmbobɔ enyame afofor bi dzin, nkyii so mma mma wɔnntse no wɔ w’anomu.
Mpɛn ebiasa na hyɛ fa ma me wɔ afrenhyia mu.
Sie epitsi afahyɛ no: Nda esuon na dzi epitsi boodoo, dɛ mbrɛ mehyɛɛ wo no, wɔ mber a wɔahyɛ no wo bosoom Abib mu no (Osiandɛ no mu na ifii Egypt bae); na mma obiara mmfa nsapan mmbefir m’enyim:
na otwaber afahyɛ no, w’edwumadze a eyɛ no wɔ haban mu no mu nduadzewakan no: Na anoboaboa afahyɛ no wɔ afe no ewiei, aber a eboaboa wo ndwumadze ano fi haban mu no.
Wo mbanyin nyinara mbefir Ewuradze Nyankopɔn enyim mpɛn ebiasa wɔ afrenhyia mu.
Mma mmfa mbɔrkaw nnka m’afɔrbɔ bɔgya no ho mmbɔ afɔr; nkyii so mma m’afahyɛ mu seradze no ɔnnko hɔ anago nyinara ma onnkodu adzekyee.
Wo daadze mu nduadzewakan mu kan dze no fa bra Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn fie. Mma nnoa apɔnkyeba wɔ ne nã no numfonsu mu.
Hwɛ, morosoma ɔbɔfo ma oeedzi w’enyim akɔhwɛ wo wɔ ɔkwan no mu, na ɔdze wo ekodu bea a mesiesie no do.
Hom nhwɛ yie wɔ no ho, na wontsie ne ndze; mma wonnyi no ebufuw: Na ɔnnkefa hom mbrato akyɛ hom; osiandɛ me dzin wɔ no mu.
Na sɛ itsie ne ndze ara ampa, na eyɛ dza mekã nyinara a; ɔnodze mebɛyɛ ɔtamfo mama w’atamfo, nye ɔhohiahianyi mama w’ahohiahiafo.
Na mo bɔfoe no bedzi w enyim akɔ, na ɔdze wo ekodu Amoriro, nye Hittifo, nye Perizzfo, nye Canaanfo, Hivifo, nye Jebusfo nkyɛn: Namubotwa hɔn egu.
Mma mmbɔ wo mu adze mma hɔn enyame, na nnsom hɔn, na nnyɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ so: Na butuw na butuw hɔn, na bubu hɔn edum mu esinesin.
Na hom nsom Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn, na obehyira w'edziban, nye wo nsu do; na mibeyi yarba mefi wo mu.
Obiara nnkɔpon ɔba, na ɔnnkɛyɛ ɔbɔnyin so, wɔ w'asaase do: Mebɛma wo nda no dodow ano edu.
Mebɛma mo ho hu edzi w'enyim, na mebɛka aman a ebɛba hɔn do nyinara megu, na mama w'atamfo nyinara adan hɔn ekyir ama wo.
Na mobɔsoma nkotokurodo ma woeedzi w'enyim, apam Hivifo Canaanfo, nye Hittifo no wɔ w’enyim.
Mennkɛpam hɔn wɔ w’enyim wɔ afe kor mu; ɔno bɛyɛ na asaase no adan amamfo, na hamu mbowa adɔɔ sõ wɔ wo do.
Nkakrankakra na mebɛpam hɔn wɔ w’enyim ekodu dɛ ebɔdɔr, na enya asaase no.
Na mubotwa wo he efi Epo Memen no ho araa ekodu Philistiafo po no ho, na medze mefi sar no ano ekodu Esutsen no ho: Na mibeyi asaase no do mba mahyɛ wo nsa; na ebɛpam hɔn wɔ w’enyim.
Mma nnye hɔn nye hɔn enyame so nndzi ahyɛmu.
Mma wɔnntsena w’asaase do, ɔno bɛyɛ na wɔama ayɛ bɔn etsia me: Na sɛ esom hɔn enyame a, ampaara ɔbɛyɛ efir ama wo.
24: Na ɔsee Moses dɛ, Fow bra Ewuradze nkyɛn, ɔwo, nye Aaron, Nadab, nye Abihu, nye Israel mpanyimfo mu eduosuon; na hom nkɔsɔr wɔ ekyirkyir:
na Moses nko ntwe mbɛn Ewuradze; na hɔndze mma wɔnntwe mmbɛn; nkyii so mma ɔman no nnye no mmfow nnkɔ.
Na Moses bae bɛkãa Ewuradze ne nsɛm no nyinara kyerɛɛ ɔman no, na atsɛmbu no nyinara: Na ɔman no nyinara dze ndze kor buae, na wɔsee dɛ, Nsɛm a Ewuradze akã no nyinara yɛbɛyɛ.
Na Moses kyerɛɛw Ewuradze ne nsɛm no nyinara, na ɔsoɛɛr anapaatu, na osii afɔrmbukyia wɔ bepɔw no ase, nye edum duebien, dɛ mbrɛ Israel ebusuakuw duebien no ano tse.
Na ɔsomaa Israelmba no mu mberantsɛ a wɔdze anantwi kɔbɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr, nye asomdwee-afɔr maa Ewuradze.
Na Moses faa bɔgya no ne fã guguu mbɛɛsen mu, na ɔdze bɔgya fã no petsee afor­mbukyia no do.
Na ɔfaa ahyɛmu nwoma no, na ɔkenkaan no wɔ ɔman no asomu: Na wɔsee dɛ, dza Ewuradze akã no nyinara yɛbɛyɛ, na yɛayɛ setsie.
Na Moses faa bɔgya no, na ɔdze petsee ɔman no do, na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ ahyɛmu a Ewuradze nye hom edzi wɔ nsɛm yi nyinara ho no no bɔgyaa nye yi.
Nna Moses, nye Aaron, Nadab, nye Abihu, nye Israel mpanyimfo mu eduosuon no fowee kɔree:
Na wohun Israel Nyankopɔn no; n’anan ase tse dɛ wɔdze sapphire ɔbo ataa hɔ, na n’enyi tsew dɛ ɔsor noara.
Na ɔammfa ne nsa annto Israelmba mu ekunyin no do: Na wɔhwɛɛ Nyankopɔn, na wodzidziina wɔnomee.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Fow bra me nkyɛn wɔ bepɔw no do, na tsena hɔ: Na medze abopon, nye mbrasɛm a makyerɛw no mebɛma wo, ma aakyerɛkyerɛ hɔn.
Na Moses soɛree, ɔnye no somfo Joshua: Na Moses fowee kɔr Nyankopɔn ne bepɔw no do.
Na ɔsee mpanyimfo no dɛ, Hom ntsintsim ha ntweɔn hɛn ma onkodu dɛ yɛbɛba hom nkyɛn bio: Na hwɛ, Aaron nye Hur nye hom wɔ ha: Obiara a ɔwɔ asɛm bi no, wɔmma ɔntwe mbɛn hɔn.
Na Moses fowee kɔr bepɔw no do, na mununkum no bɛkataa bepɔw no do.
Na Ewuradze n’enyimnyam bɛtsenaa bepɔw Sinai do, na mununkum no kataa do nda esia: Na da a otsia esuon no, ofi mununkum no mu frɛɛ Moses.
Na Ewuradze n’enyimnyam no hwɛbea ɔtse dɛ gya a ɔhyew adze wɔ bepɔw no etsifi wɔ Israelmba no enyiwa mu.
Na Moses kɛhɛɛn mununkum no ne finimfin, na ɔfowee kɔr bepɔw no do: Na Moses dzii bepɔw no do adaduanan adzekyee nye adzesaa.
25: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kã kyerɛ Israelmba ma wɔmfa ayɛyɛdze mbrɛ me: Nyimpa biara a n’akoma pɛ no no hɔ na hom ngye m’ayɛyɛdze.
Na iyi nye ayɛyeɛze a hom ngye no wɔ hɔn hɔ; sika, nye dwɛɛtɛɛ, nye boran;
nye bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw, nye mpɔnkyenhwi;
nye ndwanyin nwoma a wɔahye no memen, nye nsukraman nwoma; nye acacia-dua;
kandzea ho ngo, ɔserango ho nduhuam, nye nduhuam a wɔhyew ho edur;
onyɛ abo, nye abo a wɔdze besisi egugudo no, nye akatabo no mu no.
Na ma wɔnye kronkronbea mma me; ma maatsena hɔn mu.
Dɛ mbrɛ merekyerɛ wo no nyinara, ntamadan no saso, nye no mu ndzɛmba nyinara ne saso, dɛmara pɛ na hom nye no.
Na wɔnyɛ acacia-dua adaka: Ne tsentsen nyɛ basafa ebien nye fã, na ne tɛtɛr basafa kor nye fã, na no krɔn basafa kor nye fã.
Na fa sika mapa dura ho, no mu nye n'ekyir na fa dura, na yɛ ho sika hankra twa ho hyia.
Na gu no ho sika nkaba anan, na fa tuatua n'anan anan no ho; na nkaba ebien ndzi n'afã fakor, na nkaba ebien ndzi n'afã no ho.
Na fa acacia-dua sian mpoma, na fa sika dura ho.
Na fa mpoma no hyehyɛ nkaba no mu wɔ adaka no ne nkyɛn mu, ma wɔmfa nsoa adaka no.
Mpoma no nhyehyɛ adaka no ne nkaba no mu: Mma wonnyiyi mmfi mu.
Na fa dase a medze mebɛma wo no to adaka no mu.
Na fa sika mapa yɛ mbɔbɔrhu-egua: Ne tsentsen nyɛ basafa ebien nye fã, na ne tɛtɛr basafa kor nye fã.
Na yɛ sika cherubfo ebien; ɔbor-edwuma na fa yɛ, wo mbɔbɔrhu-egua ne tsir ebien no do.
Na yɛ cherub kor wɔ ne tsir kor, nye cherub kor wɔ ne tsir kor so: Mbɔbɔrhu-egua no mu na hom mma cherub ebien no mfi wɔ ne tsir ebien no do.
Na cherubfo no ntserɛtserɛw hɔn ntsaban mu wɔ ɔsor, mfa hɔn ntsaban no nkata mbɔbɔrhu-egua no do, hɔn enyim ndzi abɔnyim; mbɔbɔrhu-egua no do na cherubfo no hɔn enyim mbedzi.
Na fa mbɔbɔrhu-egua no si adaka no do sor; na adaka no mu na fa dase a medze mebɛma wo no to.
Na ehɔ na menye wo behyia, na mefi mbɔbɔrhu-egua no do wɔ cherubfo ebien a wɔwɔ dasedaka no do no ntamu makã wo ndzemba a mebɛhyɛ wo dɛ fa kyerɛ Israelmba no nyinara ho nsɛm.
Na fa acacia-dua pon: Ne tsentsen nyɛ basafa ebien, ne tɛtɛr basafa, na no krɔn basafa kor nye fã.
Na fa sika mapa dura ho, na yɛ ho sika hankra hyia.
Na yɛ ho ntotoano a ɔbɛye nsatseama hyia, na yɛ ntotoano no ho sika hankra hyia
Na yɛ ho sika nkaba anan, na fa nkaba no sisi nkutuw anan a ɔwowɔ n'anan anan no ho no do.
Ntotoano no nkyɛn papaapa na nkaba no ndzi, ma ɔnyɛ beebi mbrɛ wɔdze mpoma no bɛhyehyɛ dze asoa ɔpon no.
Na fa acacia-dua sinsian mpoma no, na fa sika duradua ho, ma Wɔdze aasoa ɔpon no.
Na yɛ do mboyaa, nye ntser, nye nkuraba, nye nkorbaa a wɔdze bohue: Sika mapa na fa yɛ.
Na fa kyerɛpaanoo si pon no do wɔ m’enyim daa.
Na fa sika mapa ye kandzeadua: Ɔbor-edwuma na fa yɛ kandzeadua no, n’anan, nye no dua; no ho mpokuwa, no nkukuduuduw, nye ne nhyiren, mfi sin kor no ara mu:
Na abaw esia mfifi ne nkyen mu; kandzeadua n’abaw ebiasa mfi n’afã fakor, na kandzeadua no n’abaw ebiasa so mfi n’afa kor so:

mpokuwa ebiasa a wɔayɛ no de almond-nhyiren wɔ abaw kor ho, kukuduuduw nye nhyiren; na mpokuwa ebiasa a wɔayɛ no dɛ almond-nhyiren wɔ abaw kor no so ho, kukuduuduw nye nhyiren: Dem na ye wɔ abaw esia a efifir wo kandzeadua no ho no ho:
Na kandzeadua no ho mpokuwa anan a wɔayɛ no dɛ almond-nhyiren, no kukuduuduw nye ne nhyiren:
Na kukuduuduw nhyɛ abaw ebien a otuatua ho no ase, na kukuduuduw nhyɛ abaw ebien a otuatua ho no ase, na kukuduuduw nhye abaw ebien a otuatua ho no ase wɔ abaw esia a efifir kandzeadua no mu no ase.
No ho nkukuduuduw nye no ho abaw no mfi mu ara, ne nyinara sika mapa na wɔmfa nyɛ no ɔbor-edwuma kor.
Na yɛ ne nkandzea no esuon: Na wɔnsosɔ ne nkandzea no, ma ɔngyegye wɔ n’enyim.
Na no ho adabaa, nye no ho nso-mpokuwa nyɛ sika mapa.
Sika mapa talent kor na womfa nyɛ, ɔnyɛ no ho ndzɛmba yi nyinara.
Na hwɛ na yɛ no dɛ mbrɛ no nsusudo a wodze akyerɛ wo wɔ bepɔw no do no tse.
26: Nkyii so fa nsensɛnho-atam du yɛ ntamadan no; ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira, nye bibiri, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa na fa yɛ me cherubfo a ɔyɛ odwimfo pa edwinsa.
Nsensɛnho-tain kor ne tsentsen nyɛ basafa eduonu awɔtwe, na nsensenho-tam kor ne tɛtɛr nyɛ basafa anan: Nsensɛnho-atam no nyinara no nsusui ngyina kor.
Wɔmfa nsensɛnho-atam enum ntoatoa do kor ntoa kor so do; na nsensɛnbo-atam enum no so ntoatoa do kor btoa kor so do.
Na fa biribi bobɔ nsensɛnho-tam kor mbuano do etokur wɔ ano wɔ ntoae no do; na dɛmara na yɛ wɔ nsensɛnho-tam a odzi ekyir no no mbuano do wɔ ntoae a otsia ebien no do.
Etokur eduonum na bobɔ wɔ nsensɛnho-tam tor mu, na etokur eduonum so na bobɔ wɔ nsensɛnho-tam a ɔwɔ ntoae a otsia ebien no so ano; etokur no ndzi abɔnyim nkorkor
na yɛ nkɔtɔkorba eduonum, na fa nkɔtɔkorba no yɛ ma nsensɛnho-tam no kor ntoae kor so do: Na ntamadan no nyɛ kor.
Na fa mpɔnkyenhwi yɛ nsensɛnho-atam fa si buw wɔ ntamadan no do: Yɛ no nsensɛnho-atam dubiako.
Nsensɛnho-tam kor ne tsentsen nyɛ basafa eduasa, na nsensɛnho-tam kor ne tɛtɛr nyɛ basafa anan: Nsensɛnho-atam dubiako no no nsusui ngyina kor.
Na fa nsensɛnho-atam enum toatoa yɛ no kor, na yɛ nsensɛnho-atam esia so kor, na boka nsensɛnho-tam a otsia esia no ma ɔnkata buw no do wɔ n’enyim.
Na yɛ etokur eduonum wo nsensɛnho-tam kor a odzi ekyir no mbuano do wɔ ntoae no do, nye etokur eduonum so wɔ ntoae a otsia ebien no ne nsensɛnho-tam no mbuano do.
Na yɛ mboran nkɔtɔkorba eduonum, na fa nkɔtɔkorba no susuo etokur no mu, na yɛ ma buw no ntoae mu, ma ɔnyɛ kor.
Na buw no ne nsensɛnho-atam a aka sensɛn hɔ no, nsensɛnho-tam fã no a aka no, nsensen ntamadan no ekyir.
Na buw no ne nsensɛnho-atam no ne tsentsen mu basafa kor a abor do wɔ afã ha, nye basafa kor a abor do wɔ afã hɔ no nsensɛn ntamadan no ne nkyɛn nkyɛn wo afã ha nye afã ha nkata do.
Na fa ndwanyin nwoma a wɔahyɛ no memen yɛ buw no ne nkatado; na fa nsukraman nwoma yɛ no sor akatado.
Na fa acacia-dua yɛ ntamadan no ne ntaabow a osisi hɔ.
Basafa du nyɛ taabow ne tsentsen, na basafa kor nyɛ fã nye taabow kor ne tɛtɛr.
Anan ebien ntuatua taabow kor mu, nsusuo kor mu mfam kor so ho: Dɛm na yɛ ma ntamadan no ne ntaabow nyinara.
Na yɛ ntamadan no ne ntaabow no, ntaabow eduonu ndzi pomu afamu nkyerɛ pomu.
Na yɛ ntaabow eduonu no n'ase dwɛɛtɛɛ ngyinado eduanan; ngyinado ebien nhyehye taabow kor ase mma anan ebien no, na ngyinado ebien nkyehyɛ kor so ase mma n'anan ebien no:
Na ntamadan no n'afa a otsīa ebien no, odzi kwaamu afamu no, ntaabow aduonu:
Na no dwɛɛtɛɛ ngyinado eduanan no; ngyenado ebien nhyehyɛ taabow ase, na ngenado ebien nhyehyɛ taabow kor so ase.
Na ntamadan no n'ekyir a odzi anee afamu no yɛ hɔ ntaabow esia.
Na yɛ ntaabow ebien ma ntamadan no no kutuw do wɔ n'ekyir afamu.
Na ɔmpam ho wɔ ase, na ɔnyɛ mu dɛmara nkodu no sor nkaba kor ho: Dɛm na n'ebien nyina nyɛ; wondzi kutuw ebien no do.
Na ɔnnyɛ ntaabow awɔtwe, nye no dwɛɛtɛɛ ngyinado, ngyinado duesia; ngyinado ebien nhyehyɛ taabow kor ase, na ngyinado ebien nhyehyɛ taabow kor so ase.
Na fa acacia-dua yɛ mbeabeamu; enum nye ntamandan no ne nkyɛn kor ntaabow no dze,
na mbeabeamu enum so nyɛ ntamadan no ne nkyɛn kor no ne ntaabow no dze, na mbeabeamu enum so nyɛ ntamandan no ne nkyɛn ekyir wɔ anee afamu ntaabow no dze.
Na finimfin mbeamu a ɔwɔ ntaabow no ne finimfin no twa mu mfi tsir nkodu tsir.
Na fa sika duradura ntaabow no ho, na fa sika yɛ no ho nkaba no ma ɔnyɛ mbeabeamu no hyehyɛbea: Na fa sika duradura mbeabeamu no ho.
Na si ntamadan no dɛ mbrɛ ne nyɛbea a woeyi akyerɛ wo wɔ bepɔw no do no tse.
Na fa bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira yɛ ntwamutam: Yɛ me cherubfo a ɔyɛ odwimfo pa edwinsa:
Na fa sensɛn acacia edum anan a woeduradura ho sika do, no nkwaba nyɛ sika, nsisi dwɛɛtɛɛ ngyinado anan do.
Na fa ntamutam no sensɛn nkɔtɔkorba no ase, na fa dasedaka no bra ntamutam no mu: Na ntwamutam no twa bea krɔnkrɔn no nye krɔnkrɔn-mu-krɔnkrɔn no mu mma wo.
Na fa mbɔbɔrhu-egua no si dasedaka no do wɔ krɔnkrɔn-mu-krɔnkrɔn-bea no mu.
Na da ɔpon no si ntwamutam no ekyir, na kandzeadua no ndzi ɔpon no ntsentsendo wɔ ntamadan no nkyɛn mu wɔ pomu afamu: Na fa ɔpon so si kwaamu afamu.
Na fa bibiri, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira, wen nkyermu fa yɛ ntamadan no n'abowano nkataano.
Na yɛ acacia edum enum fa ma nkataano no, na fa sika duradura ho; no nkwaba nyɛ sika: Na gu boran ngyinado enum wɛ ase.
27: Na fa acacia-dua yɛ afɔrmbukyia no, ne tsentsen basafa enum, na ne tɛtɛr basafa enum; afɔrmbukyia no nyɛ etwaanan: Na no krɔn nyɛ basafa ebiasa.
Na yɛ no ho mmbɛn sisi no kutuw anan no do: Ne mmbɛn no nye no mfi sin kor no ara mu: Na fa boran dura ho.
Na yɛ n'asɛn a wɔdze no nso bogu mu, nye no nsofi, nye no nkuraba, nye n'edzinam, nye ne gyansenama kukuwa: No ho ndzɛmba nyinara boran na fa yɛ.
Na fa boran wen no ho serɛnkye dɛ erowen atena; na yɛ atena no do boran nkaba anan wɔ no kutuw anan no do.
Na fa si afɔrmbukyia no ne bamba no ho wɔ ase, ma atena no ndu afɔrmbukyia no ne finimfin.
Na sinsian afɔrmbukyia no ho mpoma, acacia-dua mpoma, na duradura ho boran.
Na wɔmfa no mpoma no nwurawura nkaba no mu, na mpoma no nhyehyɛ afɔrmbukyia no ne nkyɛn nkyɛn ebien no, na wɔdze aasoa.
Fa ntaabow yɛ, na no mu nda kwan: Dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛ wo wɔ bepɔw no do no, dɛmara na wɔnyɛ no.
Na yɛ ntamadan no ne dampan: Pomu afamu a ɔkyerɛ pomu na dampan nsensɛnho a wɔdze ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira awen a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa ɔha ndzi wɔ afã fakor:
Na n'edum nyɛ eduonu, na ne ngyinado eduonu a wɔdze boran ayɛ: Edum no no nkwaba nye no mbɔtsir nyɛ dwɛɛtɛɛ.
Na dɛmara so na kwaamu afamu ne tsentsen mu na nsensɛnho a ne tsentsen basafa ɔha ndzi hɔ, na n'edum eduonu, nye ne ngyinado eduonu a wɔdze boran ayɛ, edum no no nkwaba nye no mbɔtsir nyɛ dwɛɛtɛɛ.
Na dampan no ne tɛtɛr a odzi anee afamu no nnya nsensɛnho basafa eduonum: N'edum du, nye ne ngyinado du.
Na dampan no ne tɛtɛr a odzi boka afamu a ɔkyerɛ boka no nyɛ basafa eduonum.
Ɔponkɛse no afã fakor nsensɛnho no nyɛ basafa duenum: N'edum ebiasa, nye ne ngyinado ebiasa.
Na nkyɛn fakor so nsensɛnho no nyɛ basafa duenum: N'edum ebiasa, nye ne ngyinado ebiasa.
Na dampan no ano pon-kɛse no, wɔmfa bibiri, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira ayɛ nkyermu, nyɛ ne nkataano: N'edum anan, nye ne ngyinado anan.
Edum a otwa dampan no ho hyia nyinara wɔmfa dwɛɛtɛɛ mbobɔ no mbɔtsir; no nkwaba nyɛ dwɛɛtɛɛ, na ne ngyinado nyɛ boran.
Dampan no ne tsentsen nyɛ basafa ɔha, na ne tɛtɛr mu beebiara eduonum, na no krɔn basafa enum, ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira, na no boran ngyinado.
Ntamadan no ho som nyinara mu ndzemba nyinara, nye no mbɔfondua nyinara, nye dampan no ho mbofondua nyinara nyɛ boran.
Na hyɛ Israelmba no ma wɔmbrɛ wo olive ngo gyenengyenen a woesiw a wɔdze sɔ gya, ma ɔmma kandzea nsi do daa.

Ehyiadzibuw no mu, ntwamutam a ɔwɔ dase no enyim no n’ekyir, na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no nsiesie mfi ewimbir nkodu anapa wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ Israelmba afamu wɔ hon ebusuasantsen nyina mu.
28: Na ma wo nua Aaron, nye ne mbabanyin no nka no ho, mfi Israelmba no mu mbrɛ wo nkyɛn, ma oeedzi mo sɔfoe, mekyerɛ Aaron, Nadab nye Abihu, Eleazar nye Ithamar, Aaron ne mbabanyin no.
Na pam ntar krɔnkrɔn ma wo nua Aaron, wɔ enyimnyam nye ahoɔfɛw ntsi.
Na kasa kyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ abadwembafo a medze nyansa sunsum mahyɛ hɔn mã nyinara, ma wɔmpam Aaron ntar no mfa ntsew no ho, ma ondzi mo sɔfoe.
Na ntar a wɔmpam. Nye yi; akatabo, nye egugudo, nye bataker, nye sortar a wɔawen no dam dam, asɔfokyɛw, nye abɔdo: Na wɔmpam ntar krɔnkrɔn mma wo nua Aaron, nye ne mbabanyin, ma oeedzi mo sɔfoe.
Na wɔmfa sika no, nye bibiri no, nye ɔberdum no, nye serdaa no, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw no nyɛ.
Na wɔnyɛ egugudo no sika, bibiri. Nye ɔberdum, serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira, odwimfo pa edwinsa.
Onnya abatsir-nkonaba ebien a otuatua n'ano ebien no; ma wɔdze aabɔ mu atoa.
Na nkyermu abɔdo a wɔawen a ɔwɔ no do, ma wɔdze aabɔ ne nyinara do no, nyɛ dɛ n'edwinsa a ofi konaba kor no ara mu; sika, bibiri, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira.
Na fa onyɛ abo ebien, na kyerɛw Israelmba hɔn edzin wɔ do:
Hɔn edzin esia ndzi ɔbo kor do, na esia a wɔaka no hɔn edzin ndzi ɔbo kor no so do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn awoe mu tse.
Ɔbosiam fo edwinsa, ɔtse dɛ nsɔwanokaba nkyerɛwee, na fa kyerɛw abo ebien no do, dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba hɔn edzin tsetsee: Yɛ no ma sika mbraho ntwa ho nyia.
Na fa abo ebien no bobɔ egugudo no n'abatsir-nkonaba no do, ma ɔnyɛ nkaa abo mma Israelmba no do: Na Aaron nsoa hɔn edzin wɔ n'abatsir ebien no do wɔ Ewuradze enyim mfa nyɛ nkaa.
Na yɛ sika mbraho:
Nye sika mapa ntweaban ebien; yɛ no dɛ ahoma, mbɛsawɔw edwuma: Na fa ntweaban a wɔawɔw no mbɛsa no hyehyɛ mbraho no do.
Na yɛ atsɛmbu akatabo, odwimfo pa edwinsa; dɛ mbrɛ egugudo edwuma no tse na yɛ no; sika, bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira na fa yɛ.
ɔnyɛ etwaaanan mbɔhɔ; ne tsetsen nyɛ nsatseama, na ne tɛtɛr nyɛ nsatseama, na ne tɛtɛr nyɛ nsatseana.
Na fa nsisimu abo sisi mu, abo akyerɛpɛn anan: Kyerɛpen a odzi kan no nyɛ sardius, topaz, nye carbuncle kyerɛpɛn;
na kyerɛpɛn a otsīa ebien no nyɛ emerald, sapphire, nye dɛnkyɛmbo;
na kyerɛpɛn a otsia ebiasa no nyɛ jacinth, agate, nye amethyst;
Na kyerɛpɛn a otsia anan no nyɛ beryl, nye onyɛ, nye jasper: Ne nsisimu no sika ntwa ho nhyia.
Na abo no nyɛ dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba hɔn edzin tsetsee, duebien, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn edzin tsetsee; dɛ nsɔwanokaba nkyerɛwee, dɛ mbrɛ baako biara ne dzin tse, wɔmfa mma ebusuakuw duebien no.
Na fa sika mapa yɛ akatabo no do ntweaban dɛ ahoma, mbɛsawɔw edwuma.
Na yɛ akatabo no do sika nkaba ebien, na fa nkaba ebien no hyehyɛ akatabo no n’ano ebien no do.
Na fa sika ntweaban a wɔawɔw no mbɛsa ebien no hyehyɛ akatabo no n’ano nkaba ebien no mu.
Na ntweaban a wɔawɔw no mbɛsa ebien no n’ano ebien a aka no fa toatoa mbraho ebien no mu, na fa hyehyɛ egugudo no n’abatsir-nkonaba no do wɔ n’enyim afamu.
Na yɛ sika nkaba ebien, na fa hyehyɛ akatabo no n’ano ebien no do, wɔ ne mfɛn. No mu afamu a ɔba egugudo no he no.
Na yɛ sika nkaba ebien, na fa hyehyɛ egugudo no n’abatsir-nkonaba ebien no do wɔ ase, wɔ n’enyim afamu, no ntoatoa no ne nkyɛn, wɔ egugudo no ne nkyermu abɔdo a wɔawen no do.
Na wɔmfa bibir ahoma nkyekyer akatabo no ne nkaba no nsusuo egugudo no ne nkaba no mu, ma ɔmfam egugudo no ne nkyermu abɔdo a wɔawen no do, amma akatabo no aannsan emmfi egugudo no ho.
Na sɛ Aaron rokɔ bea krɔnkrɔn no do a, ɔnsoa Israelmba no hɔn edzin wɔ atsɛmbu akatabo no mu wɔ n’akoma do, mfa nyɛ nkaa wɔ Ewuradze enyim daa.
Na fa Urim nye Thummim no hyɛ atsembu akatabo no mu: Na sɛ Aaron rokɔ Ewuradze enyim a, aako n’akoma do: Na Aaron nsoa Israelmba hɔn atsɛmbu wɔ n’akoma do wɔ Ewuradze enyim daa.
Na fa bibir ara nko yɛ egugudo no ne bataker no.
Na onnya otokur wɔ ne finimfin mfa mma tsir: Na wɔmfa ɔtamban a wɔawen mban otokur no n’ano nhyia, ɔtse dɛ dadze atar no tokur, amma oeennsuan.
Na no mbuano do no fa bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa yɛ pomegranate fa twa no mbuano no ho hyia; na sika ndɔndɔmba nsensɛn ne ntamu ne ntamu hyia:
Sika adɔmba nye pomegranate, sika adɔmba nye pomegranate, ntwa bataker no no mbuano no ho nhyia.
Na Aaron mfa nhyɛ nsom: Ama wɔaatse ne ndze wɔ aber a ɔrehɛn bea krɔnkrɔn no mu wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na aber a orifir edzi, amma oeennwu.
Na fa sika mapa yɛ tɛrba, na kyerɛw do, dɛ nsɔwanokaba nkyersɛwee, dɛ KRƆNKRƆN MA EWURADZE.
Na fa fam bibir ahoma do, na ɔnko asɔfokyɛw no ho; asɔfokyɛw no n’enyim na ɔmfam.

Na ɔmfam Aaron no momapɔw do, na Aaron nsoa nyi krɔnkrɔndze a Israelmba bɛtsew ho wɔ hɔn ayɛyɛdze krɔnkrɔn nyinara mu no ho mbusu; na ɔnko no momapɔw do daa, ama aayɛ enyisɔ ama hɔn wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na fa ndwera fɛɛfɛw wen sortar no dam dam, na fa ndwera fɛɛfɛw yɛ asɔfokyɛw no, na yɛ abɔdo, nkyermuwemfo edwinsa.
Na yɛ sortar ma Aaron ne mbabanyin, na yɛ abɔdo ma hɔn, na yɛ mbɔtsir bi ma hɔn, wɔ enyimnyam nye ahoɔfɛw ntsi.
Na fa hyehyɛ wo nua Aaron ne mbabanyin no ka no ho; na sera hɔn ngo, na tu hɔn si nkyɛn, na tsew hɔn ho, ma wondzi m’asoɔoe.
Na yɛ ndwera nfwontwo ma hɔn, ma ɔnkata hɔn adagyaw do, mfi asen nkodu nserɛ ekyir:

Na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no, sɛ wɔrokɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, anaa sɛ wɔreba afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn abɔsom wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn no mu a, wɔnhyehyɛ, ma woeenndzi mbusu, na woeennwu: Ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze mma ɔno nye n'asefo a wobedzi n'ekyir no.
29: Na iyi nye adze a fa yɛ hɔn fa tsew hɔn hɔ, na wondzi m'asɔfoe: Fa nantwisaa eburwa kor nye ndwanyin ebien a wonndzi dzɛm,
nye epitsi bodoo, nye epitsi tatar a wɔdze ngo atorɔw, na epitsi tatar-ntrɛtraba a wɔasera ho ngo: Ewifua pa isiam na fa yɛ.
Na fa gu kɛntsɛn kor mu, na ongu kɛntsɛn no mu ma fa bra, ɔnye nantwisaa no nye ndwanyin ebien no.
Na fa Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no bra ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano, na fa nsu hohor hɔn ho.
Na fa ntar no, na fa sortar no, nye egugudo no, nye akatabo no hyɛ Aaron, na fa egugudo ne bataker no, nye egugudo no, nye akatabo no hyɛ Aaron, na fa egugudo abɔdo a wɔawen no nkyermu no bɔ no mu:
Na fa asɔfokyɛw no soa no, na fa kyɛw krɔnkrɔn no si asɔfokyɛw no do.
Na nkyii fa ɔserango no, na hue gu ne tsir do, na fa sera no,
Na fa ne mbabanyim no bra, na hyehyɛ hɔn ntar.
Na fa abɔdo bobɔ hɔn mu, Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no, na bobɔ hɔn mbɔtsir: Na wonnya asɔfodzi no nyɛ hɔndze dɛ daa ahyɛdze; na tu Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no si nkyɛn.
Na fa ɔnantwisaa no bra ehyiadzibuw no enyim: Na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no mfa hɔn nsa ngu nantwisaa no etsifi.
Na ku nantwisaa no wɔ Ewuradze enyim, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano.
Na fa nantwisaa no no bɔgyaa bi, na fa wo nsatseaba bɔ mu sera afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn ho; na hue bɔgya no nyinara gu afɔrmbukyia no ase.
Na yi seradze a ɔkata ayamudze no ho nyinara, nye dza ɔsensɛn berɛbo no ho no, nye nsɛbea ebien no, nye seradze a ɔwɔ do no, na hyew no wo afɔrmbukyia no do
Na ɔnantwisaa no ne nam, nye no nwoma, nye n’egyanan dze, fa gya hyɛw no wɔ nseraban no ekyir: Ɔyɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
Eso fa odwanyin kor; na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no mfa hɔn nsa ngu n'etsifi.
Na ku odwanyin no, na fa no bɔgyaa, na fa petse afɔrmbukyia no ho hyia.
Na twitwa odwanyin no esinesin, na hohor n'ayamudze, nye no ntwɛr ho, na fa ka n'esinesin, na ɔnye ne tsir o ho.
Na hyew odwanyin no no nyinara wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: Ɔyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr ma Ewuradze: Ɔyɛ adze huanhuam, afɔr a wɔdze gya bɔ ma Ewuradze a.
Na fa odwanyin kor no so; na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no mfa hɔn nsa ngu odwanyin no etsifi.

Na nkyii ku odwanyin no,na fa no mbɔgyaa bi, na fa ka Aaron n'aso nyimfa ano, nye ne mbabanyin no hɔn aso nyimfa ano, nye hɔn nsa nyimfa kokrobetsir ano, nye hɔn anan nyimfa kokrobetsir ano, na fa bɔgya no petse afɔrmbukyia no ho hyia.

Na fa afɔrmbukyia no do bɔgya no bi, nye ɔserango no bi, a fa petse Aaro do, nye ne ntar do, nye ne mbabanyin no do, nye ne mbabanyin no hɔn ntar do ka no ho, ma ɔntsew ɔno nye ne ntar, nye ne mbabayin no, nye ne mbabanyin no hɔn ntar ho nka no ho.

Nkyii so fa odwanyin no ne seradze, nye ne seradze dua no, nye seradze a ɔkata n'ayamudze ho no, nye adze a ɔsensɛn ne mberɛbo ho no, nye nsɛbea ebien no, nye no do seradze no, nye aserɛ nyimfa dze no; osiandɛ ɔyɛ etuhoakyɛ odwanyin:
Na boodoo ntɔwmu kor, nye boodoo tatar a woegu mu ngo kor, nye tatar-trɛtraba kor, fa fi epitsi kɛntsɛn no a osi Ewuradze enyim no mu:
Na fa ne nyina gu Aaron nsamu, nye ne mbabanyin no nsamu; na hihim no yɛ Ewuradze enyim ohimafɔr.
Na gyegye no wɔ hɔn nsamu, na hyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do wɔ ɔhyew-afɔr no do, ma ɔnyɛ Ewuradze enyim adze huanhuam: Ɔyɛ afɔr wɔdze gya bɔ ma Ewuradze.
Na fa Aaron n'etuhoakyɛ odwanyin no ne nyan, na hihim yɛ Ewuradze enyim ohim-afɔr: Na ɔnyɛ wo kyɛpɛn.
Na ohim-afɔr nyan no, na ɔmado-afɔr aserɛ no a wɔdze fi Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no hɔn etuhoakyɛ odwanyim no a woehihim no, na wɔama do no mu no tsew ho:

Na ɔnyɛ dɛ daa ndzinoa mfi Israelmba nsamu mma Aaron nye ne mbabanyin: Na ɔyɛ ɔmado-afɔr: Na ɔnyɛ ɔmado-afɔr mfa mfi Israelmba hɔn asomdwee-afɔr n'afɔrbɔdze mu, mekyerɛ hɔn ɔmado-afɔr a wɔbɔ ma Ewuradze.
Na Aaron ne ntar krɔnkrɔn no nyɛ ne mba a wodzi n'ekyir dze, ma wɔnsera hɔn ngo wɔ mu, na wontu hɔn nsi nkyɛn wɔ mu.
Nda esuon na ɔbabanyin a odzi ɔsɔfo wɔn'ananmu no nhyɛ, aber a ɔreba ehyiadzibuw no mu abɔsom wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn no.
Na fa etuhoakyɛ odwanyin no, na noa ne nam no wɔ bea a ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no ndzi odwanyin no ne nam, nye boodoo a ɔwɔ kɛntsɛn no mu no, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano.
Na wondzi ndzɛmba no a wɔdze yɛɛ mpata, ma wɔdze eetu hɔn esi nkyɛn, na wɔaatsew hɔn ho no: Mbom ɔhɔho na onndzi bi, osiandɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Na sɛ etuhoakyɛ nam no, anaa boodoo no bi ka ma adze kyē do a ɔno fa gya hyew dza aka no: Mma wonndzi, osiandɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Na dɛm na fa yɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no dɛ mbrɛ mahyɛ wo no nyinara: Nda esuon na tu hɔn si nkyɛn.
Na daa nyina fa nantwisaa bɔ bɔn ho afɔr no ma ɔnyɛ mpatadze: Na tsew afɔrmbukyia no ho, aber a erepata wɔ ne tsir no; na sera ho ngo, fa tsew ho.
Nda esuon na pata wɔ afɔrmbukyia no ne tsir na tsew ho: Na afɔrmnukyia no nyɛ krɔnkrɔn mu krɔnkrɔn; biribiara a ɔka afɔrmbukyia no ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Afei iyi nye dza fa bɔ afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do; daa daa nyina nguambaa ebien a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia.
Eguambaa kor na fa bɔ afɔr anapa; na eguambaa kor so fa bɔ afɔr ewimbir:
Na fa isiam pa ephah ebupɛn du mu kor a wɔdze ngo siwii hin ebupɛn anan mu kor aforɔw; na wenyim hin ebupɛn anan mu kor a ɔyɛ nom-afɔr, ka eguambaa kor ho.
Na eguambaa kor no so fa bɔ afɔr ewimbir, na yɛ no dɛ mbrɛ anapa edzidzi-afɔr no, na mbrɛ no nom-afɔr no tse, ma ɔnyɛ adze huanhuam, afɔr a wɔdze gya bɔ ma Ewuradze.
ɔnyɛ daa ɔhyew-afɔr wɔ w'ebusuatsen mu wɔ ehuyiadzibuw no n'abowano wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Mbrɛ menye hom behyia, makasa wɔ hɔ makyerɛ wo.
Na ehɔ na menye Israelmba behyia ; na m'enyimnyam atsew Buw no ho.
Na mebɛtsew ehyiadzibuw no, nye afɔrmbukyia no ho: Aaron so nye ne mbabanyin no mebɛtsew hɔn ho, ma woeedzi m'asɔfoe.
Na mebɛtsena Israelmba no mu, na mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn.
Na wobohu dɛ emi nye Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn a miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do bae, dɛ mebɛna hɔn mu no; emi nye Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn.
30: Na yɛ afɔrmbukyia a wɔhyɛw do eduhuam: Acacia-dua na fa yɛ.
Ne tsentsen nyɛ basafa, na ne tɛtɛr nyɛ basafa, ɔnyɛ etwaanan: Na no krɔn nyɛ basafa ebien; ne mmbɛn mfi sin kor no ara mu.
Na fa sika mapa dura ho, n'etsifi, nye ne nkyɛn-nkyɛnmu hyia, nye ne mmbɛn no; na yɛ ho sika hankra fa hyia.
Na yɛ ho sika nkaba ebien wɔ ne hankra no ase, wɔ ne mparba ebien do, ne nkyɛnmu ebien no na yɛ no wɔ do; na ɔnyɛ mpoma anan mu na wɔdze aasoa.
Na fa acacia-dua sinsian mpoma no, na duradura ho sika.
Na fa si ntwamutam a ɔwɔ dase adaka no ho no enyim, wo mbɔbɔrhu-egua no a ɔwɔ dase no do no enyim, mbrɛ menye wo behyia no.
Na Aaron nhyew do eduhuam: Anapa nyinara, sɛ orisiesie nkandzea no ho a, ɔnhyew.
Na sɛ Aaron sosɔ nkandzea no ewimbir a, ɔnhyew, ɔnyɛ daa eduhuam wɔ Ewuradze enyim nkɔ hom mbasantsen nyina mu.
Mma hom nnhyew do eduhuam fofor bi, anaa ɔhyew-afɔr, anaa edzidzi-afɔr; na mma hom nnhue nom-afɔr nngu do.
Na Aaron mpata wɔ ne mmbɛn do afrenhyia mu prɛko: Bɔn ho afɔr mpata bɔgyaa no na ɔmfa mpata ne tsir afrenhyia mu prɛko wɔ hom mbasantsen nyina mu: Ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn-mu-krɔnkrɔn ma Ewuradze.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,

Sɛ erohwehwɛ Israelmba hɔn dodow ano ebu, dɛ mbrɛ hon mu hɔn a wɔkan hɔn no tse a, ɔno nyimpa biara mma ne kra tsir apondze mma Ewuradze, sɛ erekan hɔn a; ama sɛ erekan hɔn a, ɔyardɔm bi eennsi hɔn mu.
Iyi na wɔmma, obiara a otwa mu kɔ hɔn a wɔkan hɔn no mu no, shekel fã dɛ krɔnkrɔn bea shekel: (Shekel yɛ gerah eduonu:) shekel fã nyɛ Ewuradze afɔrbɔdze.
Obiara a otwa mu kɔ hɔn a wɔkan hɔn no mu no, oedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir no, ɔmma Ewuradze afɔrbɔdze no:
Obirɛmpɔn mma kɛse, na ohianyi mma kakraba, nnkyɛn shekel fã no, sɛ wɔrema Ewuradze afɔrbɔdze no dze aayɛ hom akra tsir mpatadze no a.
Na gyegye mpata sika no wɔ Israelmba no hɔ, na fa ma ehyiadzibuw no mu som no; ma ɔaayɛ nkaa ama Israelmba no wɔ Ewuradze enyim, dze aayɛ hɔn akra tsir mpatadze.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Fa boran yɛ eguarsɛn so, na n'ase nyɛ boran, ma wɔdze eeguar; na fa si ehyiadzibuw no nye afɔrmbukyia no ntamu, na fa nsu gu mu.
Na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no mfa nhohor hɔn nsa ho nye hɔn anan ho wɔ hɔ:
Sɛ wɔrekɛhɛn ehyiadzibuw no mu a, wɔmfa nsu nhohor hɔnho, mma woeennwuwu; anaa sɛ wɔrebɛn afɔrmbukyia no ho abɔsom, ma wɔaahyew afɔrbɔdze a wɔdze gya hyew ma Ewuradze a:
dɛm na wɔnhohor hɔn nsa ho nye hɔn anan ho, mma woeennwuwu: Na ɔnyɛ ahyɛdze mma hɔn daapem, mekyerɛ ɔno nye n'asefo wɔ hɔn mbasantsen nyina mu.
Nkyii so Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Wo so fa nduhuam mu etsitsir ma woho, myrrh a ɔsosɔw shekel ahaenum, nye cinnamon huanhuam dɛmara ne fã, mekyerɛ ahaenu eduonum, nye calamus huanhuam ahaenu eduonum,
nye cassia ahaenum, dɛ krɔnkrɔn-bea shekel no, nye olive ngo hin kor:
Na fa yɛ ɔserango krɔnkrɔn, eduhuam a wɔafora no oduhuamforafo nyansa mu: Na ɔnyɛ ɔserango krɔnkrɔn.
Na fa sera ehyiadzibuw no, nye dasedaka no,
na ɔpon no nye no ho ndzɛmba no nyinara, nye kandzeadua no nye no ho ndzeɛmba no, nye eduhuamhyew afɔrmbukyia no,
nye ɔhyew-afɔr afɔrmbukyia no nye no ho ndzɛmba no nyinara, nye eguarsɛn no nye ne ntaease.
Na tsew ho ma ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn-mu-krɔn-krɔn: Biribiara a ɔka no nyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Na sera Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no ngo, na tsew hɔn ho, ma wondzi m'asɔfoe.
Na kasa kyerɛ Israelmba no dɛ, Iyi nyɛ ɔserango krɔnkrɔn mma me wɔ hom mbasantsen nyina mu.
Nyimpa honam do na mma wonnhue nngu, nkyii so mma hom nnyɛ bi a ɔtse dɛm, dɛ mbrɛ no mforafora mu tse: Ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn, na ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma hom.
Obiara a ɔbɔforafora bi dɛm no, anaa obiara a ɔdze bi bɛka ɔhɔho ho no, wobotwa no efi no nkorɔfo mu akyen.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Fa nduhuanhuam ma woho, stacte, nye onycha, nye galbanum; nduhuanhuam a krɔbɔw gyenengyenen ka ho: Ne nyina no durdur nyɛ per per;
na fa yɛ eduhuam hyewee, eduhuam a wɔafora no eduhuamforafo nyansa mu a wɔaposa a oye gyenengyenen nye krɔnkrɔn:
Na siw no fekɔfekɔ, na fa bi gu dase no enyim wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, mbrɛ menye wo behyia no; ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn-mu-adzekrɔnkrɔn mma hom.
Na eduhuam hyewee a erebɛyɛ no, mma hom nnsusu no mforaforae do nnye bi mma homankasa homho: Ɔnyɛ wo krɔnkrɔn mma Ewuradze.
Obiara a ɔbɛyɛ bi a ɔtse dɛm, ehūa ahwɛ no, wobotwa no efi no nkorɔfo mu akyen.
31: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Hwɛ, mabɔ Bezalel, Uri ba no, Hur ba no a ofi Judah ebusuakuw mu no ne dzin mafrɛ no:
Na medze Nyankopɔn sunsum ahyɛ no mã, wɔ nyansa, nye ntseasee, nye nyimdzee, nye edwindzi ahorow nyinara mu,
Dɛ ɔmfa ndwen ne tsir mu ndzi sika, nye dwɛɛtɛɛ, nye boran,
nye nsisimu abo ntwitwae, nye ndua sian mu edwin, ma oeedzi edwin horow nyinara.
Na, hwɛ, mara mafa Oholiab, Ahisamach ba a ofi Dan ebusuakuw mu, aka no ho; na hɔn a wɔwɔ nyansa akoma nyinara medze nyansa ahyɛ hɔn akoma mu ma wɔaaye dza mahyɛ wo nyinara:
Ehyiadzibuw no, nye dasedaka no, nye mbɔbɔrhu-egua a ɔwɔ do no, nye Buw no no ho ndzɛmba nyinara;
na ɔpon no nye no ho ndzɛmba, nye kandzeadua mapa no ɔnye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, nye eduhuamhyew afɔrmbukyia no;
na ɔhyew-afɔr afɔrmbukyia no ɔnye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, nye eguasɛn no nye ne ntaease no;
na ntar fɛɛfɛw a wɔapempam no, nye ɔsɔfo Aaron ne ntar krɔnkrɔn no, nye ne mbabanyin no hɔn ntar no a wɔdze bedzi m'asɔfoe no;
nye ɔserango no, nye bea krɔnkrɔn nduhunhuam a wɔahyew no: Wɔnyɛ no dɛ mbrɛ mahyɛ wo no nyinara.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Eso kasa kyerɛ Israelmba no dɛ, Ampaara, m'ahomgyenda no na hom nsie: Osiandɛ ɔyɛ emi nye hom ntamu asɛnkyerɛdze wɔ hom mbasantsen nyina mu; ma hom eehu dɛ emi nye Ewuradze a metsew hom ho no.
Dɛm ntsi hom nsie ahomgyeda no; osiandɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn ma hom: Obiara a ohura ho no oku na wonku no: Na obiara a ɔyɛ edwu wɔ mu no, wobotwa dɛm ɔkra no efi no nkorɔfo mu akyen.
Nda na wɔmfa nyɛ edwuma; na da a otsia esuon no ɔyɛ ahomgye mu ahomgyeda a ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn ma Ewuradze: Obiara a ɔyɛ edwuma biara wɔ ahomgyeda no mu no, oku na wonku no.
Dɛm ntsi Israelmba no nsie ahomgyeda no, dɛ wɔrodwen ahomgyeda no do wɔ hɔn mbasantsen nyina mu, dɛ daa ahyɛmu.
Ɔyɛ emi nye Israelmba ntamu daa daa asɛnkyerɛdze: Na nda esia na Ewuradze dze yɛɛ ɔsor nye asaase, na da a otsīa esuon no ɔhomee na ɔdwedwee noho.
Na aber a ɔnye Moses wiee nkoɔmbɔ twetwe wɔ bepɔw Sinai do no, ɔdze dasepon ebien no maa no, abopon a, wɔdze Nyankopɔn nsatseaba akyerɛw do.
32: Na aber a ɔman no hun dɛ Moses ekyinkyim dɛ obesian efi bepɔw no do aba no, ɔman no boaa hɔn ano wɔ Aaron nkyɛn, na wɔsee no dɛ, Soɛr, yɛ enyame ma hɛn, ma wondzi hɛn enyim; na Moses yi, nyimpa a ɔdze hɛn fi Egypt asaase do bae no dze, yennyim dza ayɛ no.
Na Aaron see hɔn dɛ, Hom nyiyi sika nkaba a ɔhyehyɛ hom yernom, hom mbabanyin, nye hom mbabaa asowa mu no, na wɔmfa mbrɛ me.
Na ɔman no nyinara yiyii sika nkaba a ɔhyehyɛ hɔn asowa mu no, na wɔdze brɛɛ Aaron.
Na ɔgyee no wɔ hɔn nsamu, na ɔdze edwindadze huorii, na ɔyɛɛ no nantwiba a woegu: Na wɔsee dɛ, Israel, iyinom nye w’enyame a woyii wo fii Egypt asaase do bae.
Na aber a Aaron hun iyi no, osii afɔrmbukyia wɔ n’enyim; na Aaron bɔɔ dawur, na ɔsee dɛ, ɔkyena nye Ewuradze afahyɛ.
Na wɔsoɛɛr ahanamakye, na wɔbobɔɔ ɔhyewafɔr, na wɔdzedze asomdwee-afɔr bae; na ɔman no tsenaa famu dzidzii, na wɔnomee, na wɔsoɛree goree.
Na Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ, Sian famu, kɔ; na wo man a edze hɔn fi Egypt asaase do bae no, asɛɛ hɔnho:

Wɔadan efi kwan a mekyerɛɛ hɔn no do ntsɛmara afa nkyɛn: Wɔayɛ nantwiba a woegu ama hɔn ho, na wɔasɔr no, na wɔabɔ afɔr ama no, na wɔase dɛ, Israel, iyinom nye w'enyame a woyii wo wɔ Egypt asaase do bae.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Mehu ɔman yi, na, hwɛ, wɔyɛ ɔman akɔnkyefo.
Dɛm ntsi afei gyaa me, ma m'ebufuw nhur nhye hɔn, na menhyew hɔn; na menyɛ wo ɔman kɛse.
Na Moses paa Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn kyɛw see dɛ Ewuradze, ebɛnadze ntsi na w’ebufuw nhur nhye wo man a edze ahoɔdzen kɛse nye tum nsa yii hɔn wɔ Egypt asaase do bae no yi?

Ebɛnadze ntsi na Egyptfo nkã dɛ, Bɔn ntsi na okeyii hɔn fiir edzi, ma oeekoku hɔn wɔ mbepɔw no mu, na ɔahyew hɔn efi asaase enyi yi? Dan fi w’ebufuhyew no mu, na ma bɔn yi a edze rebɛyɛ wo man yi nyɛ wo yaw.

Kaa Abraham, nye Isaac, nye Israel, nye w’akowaa a ekãa hɔn wankasa wo ho ntam, na esee hɔn dɛ, Mebɛma hom asefo adɔr dɛ ɔsor nworaba, nye asaase a makã ho asɛm yi nyinara medze mebɛma hom asefo, na wobenya edzi daapem.
Na bɔn a Ewuradze see dɛ ɔdze rekɛyɛ ne man no yɛɛ no yaw.
Na Moses daan noho, na ɔdze dase apon ebien no kitsa ne nsamu, fii bepɔw no do sianee; apon a wɔakyerɛw no afanu a; wɔakyerɛw do ha na ha.
Na apon no yɛ Nyankopɔn edwinsa, na nkyerɛwee no yɛ Nyankopɔn nkyerɛwee a wɔakyerɛw no apon no do.
Na aber a Joshua tsee ɔman no hɔn dede dɛ wɔrobɔ ose no, ɔsee Moses dɛ, ɔkõ ne dede esi nsera no mu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Nnyɛ hɔn a woedzi konyim esebɔ ndze, nkyii so nnyɛ hɔn a wɔakõ egu ntseatseamu ndze: Mbom hɔn a wɔrotow ndwom ne dede na metse.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, ɔbɛɛn nsera no ara pɛ, nna ohun nantwiba nye asaw no: Na Moses no bo fuwii, na ɔtoow ne nsamu apon no gui, na ɔbobɔɔ no wo bepɔw no enyiadze.
Na ɔfaa nantwiba no a wɔyɛe no, na ɔdze gya hyeew no, na ɔyaam no mokomoko, na ɔdze pee nsu enyi, na ɔmaa Israelmba no nomee.
Na Moses see Aaron dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ɔman yi yɛɛ wo, na edze bɔn aba hɔn do yi?
Na Aaron see dɛ, Mma mo wura no bo mmfuw: Woara nyim ɔman yi dɛ bɔn ara na osi hɔn enyi do.
Na wɔsee me dɛ, Yɛ hɛn enyame a wobedzi hɛn enyim: Na Moses yi, nyimpa a ɔdze hɛn fi Egypt asaase do bae no dze, yennyim dza ayɛ no.
Na mesee hɔn dɛ, Obiara a ɔwɔ sika biara no, wɔmma wonyi; nna wɔdze maa me: Na motowee guu gya mu, na ɔnantwiba yi fii mu bae.
Na aber a Moses hun dɛ ɔman no ayɛ bisibisibasaa no; osiandɛ Aaron ama wɔayɛ bisibisibasaa abɔ adapaa wɔ hɔn atamfo mu:
Nna Moses gyinaa nseraban no ano, na ɔsee dɛ, Obiara a ɔwɔ Ewuradze afã ɔmbra me nkyɛn. Na Levi mbabanyin nyinara boaboaa hɔnho ano baa ne nkyɛn.

Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi, Hom mu nyimpa biara mfa n'afõwa mbɔ n'asen, na ondzi akɔnaaba, mfi nseraban no ano nkɔ n'ano, na nyimpa biara ne nyɛnko, nye nyimpa biara ne nyɛnko, nye nyimpa biara nku no nua, nye nyimpa biara ne nyɛnko, nye nyimpa biara ne fisamenanyi.
