Na wɔdze hɔn nsa maa dɛ wobegyaa hɔn yernom no: Na wodzi fɔ ntsi, wɔdze nguankuw mu dwanyin bɔbɔɔ hɔn afɔdzi ho afɔr.
Na Immermba mu; Hanani na Zebadiah.
Na Harimmba mu; Maaseiah, na Elijah, na Shenaiah, na Jehiel, na Uzziah.
Na Pashhurmba mu; Elioensi, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, na Elasah.
Na Levifo mu; Jozabad, na Shimei, na Kelaiah (Ɔnoara nye Kelitaɔ, Pethahiah, Judah, na Eliezer.
Na adwontofo no mu; Eliashib: Na mbobowanoahwɛfo no mu; Shallum, na Telem, na Uri.
Na Israel mu: Paroshmba mu; Ramiah, na Izziah, na Malchijah, na Benaiah.
Na Elammba mu; Mattaniah, Zechariah, na Jehiel, na Abdi, na Jeremoth, na Elijah.
Na Zattumba mu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, na Jeremoth, na Zabad, na Aziza.
Na Bebaimba mu; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.
Na Banimba mu; Meshullam, Malluch, na Adaiah, Jashub, na Sheal, Jeremoth.
Na Pahath-moabmba mu, Adna, na Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, na Binnui, na Manasseh.
Na Harimmba mu; Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon;
Benjamin, Malluch, Shemariah.
Hashummba mu; Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.
Banimba mu; Maadai, Amram, na Uel;
Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi;
Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib;
Mattaniah, Mattenai, na Jaasu;
na Bani, na Binnui, Shimei;
na Shelemiah, na Nathan, na Adaiah;
Machnadebai, Shashai, Sherai;
Azarel, na Shelemiah, Shemariah;
Shallum, Amariah, Joseph.
Nebomba mu; Jeiel, Mattithaih, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, na Joel, Benaiah.
Woyinom nyinara wɔawarwar mbaa ananaben: Na hɔn mu binom wowɔ yernom a wɔnye hɔn awowo mba.

1: Paul a ɔyɛ ɔsomafo (a ommfir nyimpa, eso ɔnnam nyimpa do na mbom ɔnam Jesus Christ nye Nyankopɔn Egya a onyaan no fii ewufo mu no do),
nye enuanom nyina a wɔwɔ me nkyɛn, dze kɛma Galatia asɔrasɔr nyina:
Adom nkã hom, nye asomdwee a ofir Nyankopɔn Egya, nye hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ a
ɔdze noho mae wɔ hɛn bɔn ntsi, ma oeeyi hɛn ofi sesei wiadze bɔn yi mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn ne pɛ tse,
ɔno na enyimnyanm nkã no mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
Ɔyɛ me ahodow dɛ hom redan homho ntsɛm dɛm efi nyia ɔfrɛɛ hom wɔ Christ Jesus adom mu no ho akɔ asɛmpa fofor bi mu a,
ɔnnyɛ asɛmpa fofor bi ampa, naaso binom wɔ hɔ a wɔretan hom enyi, na wɔpɛ asakyer Christ asɛmpa no.
Na sɛ mpo hɛn anaa abɔfo bi fi sor bɛkã hom asɛmpa fofor bi aka dza yɛakã akyerɛ hom no ho a, wɔmma ondzi mbusu.
Dɛ mbrɛ yeedzi kan akã, mekã dɛm bio, sɛ obi bɛka hom asɛmpa fofor bi aka dza hom agye no ho a, wɔmma ondzi mbusu.
Na afei nyimpa na meredzɛfɛw no anaa Nyankopɔn a? Anaa morohwehwɛ dɛ mosɔ nyimpa enyi? Sɛ meda ho mosɔ nyimpa enyi a, nkyɛ mennyɛ Christ akowaa.
Na, enuanom, merema hom ehu wɔ asɛmpa no a mekãa no ho dɛ, ɔnntse dɛ nyimpa adze.
Na manngye no nyimpa hɔ, eso wɔannkyerɛkyerɛ me, na mbom ɔnam Jesus Christ nyikyerɛ do na minyae.
Na hom atse nkan no m'abrabɔ wɔ Jewfo som no mu, mbrɛ mihihiahiaa Nyankopɔn asɔr ho ntrado, na mesɛɛ no no.
Na okɔr kan wɔ Jewfo som mu kyɛɛn m'etsipɛmfo dodowara, wɔ mankasa me man mu, na mobɔɔ m'egyanom atsetsesɛm ho mbɔdzen pii ma ɔtraa do.
Na ɔsɔɔ Nyankopɔn a ofi me nã yamu yii me sii nkyɛn an ɔnam n'adom do frɛɛ me no, n'enyi,
dɛ obeyi ne ba akyerɛ wɔ mo mu, ma maakɛkã no ho asɛmpa akyerɛ amanamamfo no, ntsɛmara menya honam nye bɔgya enntu egyina:
Eso mannkɔ Jerusalem wɔ hɔn a wodzii me kan yɛɛ asomafo no nkyɛn, na mokɔr Arabia na mesanee baa Damascus bio.
Na n'ekyir mfensa apa ho no, mokɔr Jereusalem kohun Peter enyim, na midzii ne nkyɛn dadu ndaenum.
Na asomafo nkaa no dze, mennhu hɔn mu biara dɛ Ewuradze no nua James.
Dza merekyerɛw hom yi hwɛ, Nyankopɔn enyim a, minndzi ator.
N'ekyir na mebaa Syria nye Cilicia afamu.
Na Judæa asɔrasɔr a wɔwɔ Christ mu da ho nnyim m'enyim:
Na ɔtse nko na wɔtsee dɛ, nyia nkan no ohiahiaa hɛn ho no, nkyii ɔrekã gyedzi a nkan no ɔsɛɛ no no ho asɛmpa;
na woyii Nyankopɔn ayɛw wɔ mo mu.
2: Na n'ekyir mfe duanan no, mokɔr Jerusalem bio, emi nye Barnabas, na mefaa Titus so kaa hɛn ho.
Na menam nyikyerɛ do mokɔree: Medze asɛmpa no a mekãa no amanaman mu no too hɔn enyim, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ dzin, wɔ nsumaa mu, mma mbirika a murututu anaadɛ mututui no aannyɛ kwa.
Na Titus a ɔka mo ho a ɔyɛ Greeknyi mpo, wɔannhyɛ no dɛ ontwa twatsia:
na enuanom atorfo a wɔaba mu awerɛfir mu no ntsi a, hɔn a wowiawiaa hɔnho aba mu rebɛserɛ hɛn adehyedzi a yɛwɔ no Christ mu, na wɔdze hɛn aaba nkowaasom mu no:
Hɔndze, yɛammbrɛ hɛnho adze amma hɔn kwan dɔnhwer kor mpo ma asɛmpa no no nokwar no aatsena hɔ wɔ hom afamu.
Na hɔn a wɔwɔ dzin no (sɛ wɔtse dɛn ara a, ɔmmfa mo ho hwee, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ nyimpa enyim) na hɔn a wɔwɔ dzin no ammfa biribiara annkã mo ho:
Na mbom wohun dɛ wɔdze monomonomfo mu asɛmpaka ahyɛ me nsa, dɛ, mbrɛ wɔdze twatsiafo mu dze ama Peter;
(na nyia ɔnam Peter do yɛɛ edwuma maa twatsiafo mu asomafosom no, ɔnam mo so do yɛɛ edwuma maa amanamamfo no);
na wohun adom a wɔdze adom me no, James, Cephas, nye John a wobuu hɔn dɛ wɔyɛ fadum no, wɔtseen anyɛnkoyɛ nsa nyimfa maa me nye Barnabas, dɛ hɛn yɛnkɔ amanamamfo hɔ, na hɔn so wɔnkɔ twatsiafo hɔ;
na mbom ehiafo nko na yɛnkaa hɔn; na ɔno so ara na mobɔɔ mbɔdzen yɛe.
Na Cephas baa Antioch no, megyee enyim tsiaa no osiandɛ ɔfoom no nyɛe.
Na ansaana binom a wofi James hɔ rebɛba no, ɔnye amanamamfo no dzidzi, na wɔbae no, ɔtwee noho tseew noho fii hɔn nkyɛn, osuro hɔn a wofi twatsiafo mu no ntsi.
Na Jewfo nkaa no so nye no yɛɛ nkɔnkɔnsa no, na hɔn nkɔnkɔnsa no twee Barnabas so kɔree.

Na muhun dɛ wɔrennantsew tɔɔtsenn dɛ mbrɛ asɛmpa nokwar no tse no, mekãa kyerɛɛ Peter wɔ hɔn nyina enyim dɛ, sɛ ɔwo a eyɛ Jewnyi ebɔ wo bra dɛ amanamannyi a, na ennyɛ dɛ Jewnyi a, ɔyɛ dɛn na ehyɛ amanamamfo dɛ wɔnyɛ dɛ Jewfo?
Hɛn a yefi hɛn awosu mu yɛ Jewfo, na yɛnnyɛ amanaman mu ndzebɔnyɛfo,

yenyim dɛ wɔnnam mbra ndwuma do na wobu nyimpa bem, na mbom ɔnam Jesus Christ gyedzi mu no, hɛn mpo yɛgyee Jesus Christ dzii, ma wɔnam Christ mu gyedzi do eebu hɛn bem, na nnyɛ mbra ndwuma mu do ebu nyimpa biara bem.
Na sɛ yɛrohwehwɛ dɛ wobu hɛn bɛm wɔ Christ mu no, wohun hɛn dɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo a, nna Christ yɛ bɔn somfo nye no? Atserkwa.
Na sɛ motow dza mudwurawii no bio a, nna mekyerɛ moho dɛ mbratonyi.
Na emidze ɔnam mbra do muwui maa mbra, ma maatsena ase mama Nyankopɔn.
Wɔabɔ emi nye Christ mbeamudua mu; naaso metase ase; na nnyɛ emi a, na Christ na ɔtse mo mu: Na ase a metse wɔ honam mu yi, metse no Nyankopɔn Ba a ɔdɔɔ me na ɔdze noho maa me no ne gyedzi mu.
Memma Nyankopɔn adom no nnyɛ kwa: Sɛ tsenenee nam mbra do ba a, ɔno Christ wuu gyan.
3: O Galatiafo nkwasea, woana dzeaa hom, hom a wɔdze Jesus Christ esi hom enyim pɔkyee dɛ wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu?
Iyi nko na mepɛ dɛ metse fi hom anomu, hom nam mbra ndwuma no do nyaa Sunsum no, anaa hom yɛ nkwasea dɛm?
Ana hom yɛ nkwasea dɛm? Hom hyɛɛ ase wɔ Sunsum mu a, afei hom dze honam ruwie?
Hom ehu amandze pii yi gyan? Sɛ enya ayɛ gyan ampa a.
Nyia ɔdze Sunsum no ma hom, na ɔyɛ tum dwuma wɔ hom mu no, ɔnam gyedzitsie do?
Dɛ mbrɛ Abraham gyee Nyankopɔn dzii, na wobuu no tsenenee ma no.
Dɛm ntsi hom nhu dɛ hɔn a wofi gyedzi mu no, hɔnara nye Abraham mba.
Na kyerɛwsɛm no dzii no ehukan dɛ Nyankopɔn nam ntsi, odzii kan kãa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ Abraham dɛ, wo mu na wobehyira amanaman nyina.
Dɛm ntsi hɔn a wofi gyedzi mu no woehyira hɔn aka ɔgyedzinyi Abraham ho.
Na dodow a wofi mbra ndwuma mu no, wɔwɔ ndom ase, na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, ndom akã obiara a ɔtsena adze nyina a wɔakyerɛw no mbra nwoma no mu nnyɛ no.
Na ɔyɛ pefee dɛ, mbra mu dze, obi nndzi bem wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim; osiandɛ, ɔtseneneenyi nam gyedzi do bɛtsena ase.
Na mbra no dze, ommfi gyedzi mu, na nyia ɔyɛ no na ɔnam mu benya nkwa.
Christ poon hɛn fii mbra no no ndom maa hɛn: Na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, ndom akã obiara a ɔsɛn dua do:
ma Abraham nhyira no aaba amanamamfo no do, wɔ Jesus Christ mu, na ɔnam gyedzi do hɛn nsa aaka Sunsum anohoba no.
Na enuanom, mekã no nyimpa mu: Nyimapa ahyɛmu mpo a wɔahyɛ no dzen, obi mmfa nnsi nkyɛn, eso ɔmmfa bi nnka ho.
Na Abraham nye n'asenyi na wɔbɔɔ hɔn anohoba no. Ɔnnse dɛ, nye asefo, dɛ gyama pii; na mbom dɛ, nye w'asenyi, dɛ ɔbaako, ɔno nye Christ.
Na dza mese nye dɛ, ahyɛmu a Nyankopɔn dzii kan hyɛɛ no dzen no, mbra no a n'ekyir mfe ahaanan eduasa ansaana ɔbae no nngura no, ma anohoba no nnyɛ gyan.
Na sɛ egyapadze no fi mbra mu a, nna ommfi anohoba mu bio: Na Abraham dze kyɛɛ no.
Nna mbra no nye bɛn mbɔ? Mbrato ntsi na wɔdze kaa ho dze kesii dɛ asenyi no a wɔdze anohoba no bɔɔ no no bɛba; na wɔnam abɔfo do hyɛe wɔ ntamugyinafo nnyɛ ɔbaako dze, na Nyankopɔn dze ɔyɛ ɔbaako.
Na ntamugyinafo nnyɛ ɔbaako dze, na Nyankopɔn dze ɔyɛ ɔbaako.
Nna mbra no tsia Nyankopɔn anohoba nye no? Atserkwa. Na sɛ wɔhyɛɛ mbra bi a obotum ama nkwa a, nkyɛ tsenenee nam mbra do.
Na kyerɛwsɛm no apata adze nyina ahyɛ bɔn ase, ma anohoba no a ɔnam Christ mu gyedzi do no, wɔdze aama hɔn a wɔgye dzi.
Na ansaana gyedzi rebɛba no, wɔdze hɛn siee mbra no weɔn mu, ma wɔtoow hɛn mu maa gyedzi a woribeyi akyerɛ no.
Dɛm ntsi mbra no yɛ hɛn kyerɛfo dze hɛn ba Christ nkyɛn, ma wɔnam gyedzi do eebu hɛn bem.
Na nkyii gyedzi enya aba yi, yɛnnda ho nnyi ɔkyerɛfo ase bio.
Na hom nyina nam gyedzi do yɛ Nyankopɔn mba wɔ Christ Jesus mu.
Na hom mu dodow a woenuma hɔn akɔ Christ mu no wɔahyɛ Christ,
Jewnyi anaa Greeknyi nnyi beebi, akowaa anaa ɔdehye nnyi beebi: Na hom nyina ayɛ kor wɔ Christ Jesus mu.
Na sɛ hom yɛ Christ dze a, na hom yɛ Abraham asefo, na hom nam anohoba no do yɛ adzedzifo.
4: Na mekã dɛ owungyinyi no yɛ abofra yi, kaansa ɔno nye adze nyina wura mpo a, ɔnnsor ɔno nye akowaa;
na ɔwɔ ahwɛdofo nye efihwɛfo ase, dze kesi ber a egya no ahyɛ.
Dɛmara so na hɛn so yɛyɛ mbofra no, yɛyɛɛ nkowaa wɔ wiadze ahyɛsedze no ase:
Na aber no nyae durii no, Nyankopɔn somaa ne Ba a ɔbaa woo no, wɔwoo no mbra no ase,
dɛ ɔbɔpon hɔn a wɔwɔ mbra no ase, ma hɛn nsa aakã abayɛ no,
Na osiandɛ hom yɛ mba ntsi, Nyankopɔn asoma ne Ba no Sunsum aba hom akoma mu a ɔtsēa mu dɛ, Abba, Egya.
Dɛm ntsi ennda ho nnyɛ akowaa na eyɛ ɔba, na sɛ eyɛ ɔba a, nna enam Nyankopɔn do yɛ owungyanyi.
Naaso ber no, hom nnyim Nyankopɔn ntsi, hom kɔr nkowaasom mu ma hɔn a hɔn su mu nkowaasom mu ma hɔn a hɔn su mu wɔnnyɛ enyame.
Na afei hom ebohu Nyankopɔn, anaa mpo dɛ Nyankopɔn ehu hom yi, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom dan bio kɔ ahyɛsedze a wɔyɛ mberɛw na wodzi hia a hom pɛ dɛ hom kɔ nkowaasom mu ma hɔn bio no ho?
Hom dzi nda, nye abosoom, nye mber, nye mfrenhyia.
Musuro wɔ hom ho dɛ bi a maberɛ moho ama hom kwa.
Enuanom, meserɛ hom, hom nyɛ dɛ emi, osiandɛ mo so metse dɛ hom. Hom annyɛ me bɔn bi:
na hom nyim dɛ honam mberɛw ntsi na mekãa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ hom nkan no:
na dza ɔyɛɛ hom nsɔhwɛ wɔ mo honam mu no, hom ammpee ho, eso hom ennkyir, na mbom hom gyee me dɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoe, dɛ Christ Jesus mpo.
Na afei hom ahotɔ no wɔ hen? Osiandɛ megye hom dase dɛ sɛ ɔbɛyɛ a, nkyɛ hom tutuu hom enyiwa mpo maa me.
Na afei osiandɛ mekã nokwar no mekyerɛ hom ntsi, madan hom tamfo nye no?
Wɔbɔ hom ho mbɔdzen hwehwɛ hom, na nnyɛ papa bi mu a, na mbom wɔpɛ esiw hom hɛn mu kwan, ma hom aabɔ mbɔdzen ahwehwɛ hɔn.
Na oye dɛ wɔbɔ hom ho mbɔdzen hwehwɛ wɔ dza oye mu daa, nnyɛ ber a menya hom wɔ hɔ nko bi.
Me mba nkakraba a morokõ hom awo bio ekesi dɛ wobowie Christ suban yɛ wɔ hom mu,
nyew, mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ mowɔ hom nkyɛn sesei, na maasakyer me ndze, osiandɛ me tsirmu yɛɛ me konsee wɔ hom ho.
Hom a hom rohwehwɛ mbra no ase akɔ, hom nkã nkyerɛ me, hom nntse mbra no anaa
Na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ Abraham woo mbabanyin beenu, ɔbaako yɛ afonabaa ba, ɔbaako yɛ ɔdehye ba.
Na nyia ɔyɛ afonabaa ba no, wɔwoo no honam do, na ɔdehye ba no dze wɔnam anohoba no do na wɔwoo no.
Na nsɛm no yɛ ntoho ara: Na mbaa beenu yi yɛ ahyɛmu horow ebien no, ɔbaako fi bepɔw Sinai do woo mba guu nko waasom mu, ɔno nye Hagar.
Na iyi nye Hagar, bepɔw Sinai ne dzin a ɔwɔ Arabia, na ɔno gyina ma ndɛ Jerusalem yi: Na ɔnye ne mba wɔ nkowaasom mu.
Na Jerusalem a ɔwɔ sor no dze, odzi noho, ɔno nye hɛn nyina hɛn nã.
Na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, ɔbɔnyin a ennwoo, dzi dɛw; ɔwo a ennkõ awo, bɔ ose na tsēatsēa mu: Na osigyanyi no mba adɔɔ sõ akyɛn nyia ɔwɔ kun nedze.
Na hɛndze, enuanom, dɛ mbrɛ Isaac tse no, yɛyɛ anohoba no mba.
Na dɛ mbrɛ ber no, nyia wɔwoo no honam do no taan nyia wɔwoo no Sunsum do no enyi no, mbrɛ ɔtse seseiara so nye no.
Naaso kyerɛw no se dɛn? Pam afonabaa no nye ne ba no, na afonabaa ba no nye ɔdehye ba no rinndzi adze.
Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, yɛnnyɛ afonabaa mba, na yɛyɛ ɔdehye no mba.
5: Adehyedzi mu na Christ ama yeedzi hɛnho; dɛm ntsi hom ngyina dzen, na mma hom mmfa homho nntoto nkowaasom kɔndua no mu bio.
Hwɛ, emi Paul mese hom dɛ, sɛ hom gye twatsiatwa no a, Christ nnyɛ hom mfaso bi.
Na midzi dase bio kyerɛ obiara a ɔgye twatsiatwa no dɛ, ɔyɛ kafonyi, dɛ odzi mbra no nyina do.
Hom a hom pɛ dɛ wobu hom bem wɔ mbra no mu, wɔatsetsew hom efi Christ mu; hom efi adom ho ahwe ase.
Na hɛndze, yɛnam Sunsum mu dua gyedzi do tweɔn tsenenee enyidado no.
Na Christ Jesus mu dze, nnyɛ twatsiatwa, anaa monomonomyɛ, na ɔyɛ biribi, na mbom gyedzi a ɔnam ɔdɔ do yɛ edwuma a.
Hom tutuu mbirika yie, na woana na oesiw hom kwan dɛ mma hom nntsie nokwar no.
Etsidan yi mmfir nyia ɔfrɛ hom no.
Mbɔrkaw kakra na ɔkaw mbɔr nyina.
Mowɔ werɛ wɔ hom ho wɔ Ewuradze mu dɛ hom ronndwen biribi fofor bi: Na nyia ɔretan hom enyi no, woana nye no ara a, obenya n'atsɛmbu.
Na emidze, enuanom, sɛ meda ho kã twatsiatwasɛm a, nkyɛ ɔyɛ dɛn na wɔda ho hiahia mo ho yi? Ɔnodze na mbeamudua ho fintsidua no asa.
Mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ hom basabasa no woetwitwa hɔnho egu.
Na homdze, enuanom, wɔafrɛ hom ama adehyedzi, na adehyedzi no mma ɔnnyɛ kwan mma honam, na mbom hom ndua ɔdɔ do nsonsom homho.
Na mbra no nyina ahyɛ mã wɔ asɛm kor mu, ɔno nye yi; dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa woho.
Na sɛ hom keka, na hom memen homho nkorkor a, hom nhwɛ yie mma hom aannsɛɛ homho.
Na mese, Hom nnantsew Sunsum mu, nna hom rennhyɛ honam akɔndɔ mã.
Na honam kɔn dɔ tsia Sunsum, na Sunsum tsia honam, na ndzɛmba ebien yi nnka, mma hom aannyɛ ndzɛmba a hom pɛ.
Na sɛ Sunsum no kyerɛ hom kwan a, nna hom nnyi mbra no ase.
Na honam ndwuma no da edzi pefee, ɔnye yinom: ndwamanyɛ, efifidze, ahoɔdɛw,
abosonsɔr, abayisɛm, ɔtan, mansotwe, ahoɔyaw, ebufuw, etutuwpɛ, mpaapaamu, ekuwbɔ,
enyitan, asabow, asakasakagor, nye dza ɔtsetse dɛm a meka kyerɛ hom kotoo, dɛ mbrɛ makã akyerɛ hom dada, dɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛm ndzɛmba no rinnya Nyankopɔn ahendzi no.
Na Sunsum no aba nye ɔdɔ, dɛw, asomdwee, penkyɛr, ayamuyie, papayɛ, gyedzi,
ɔdwe, ahohyɛdo; mbra bi nnyi hɔ tsia yinom.
Na hɔn a wɔyɛ Christ Jesus dze no, wɔabɔ honam nhyɛdodze nye n'akɔndɔ nyina mbeamudua mu.
Sɛ yɛtse ase wɔ Sunsum mu a, hom mma yɛnnantsew Sunsum mu so.
Mma yɛnnyɛ enyimnyampɛ hun nnyiyi hɛnho ebufuw, nntentan hɛnho.
6: Enuanom, sɛ mfom bɔto obi awerɛfir mu a, hom a hom yɛ sunsummufo no hom ndan nyia ɔtse dɛm no wɔ ɔdwe sunsum mu, na hwɛ noho, mma wɔaannsɔ wo so annhwɛ.
Hom nsoasoa dza ɔyɛ durdur mma homho nkorkor, na dɛm no hom edzi Christ mbra do.
Na sɛ obi dwen noho dɛ ɔyɛ biribi, na ɔnnyɛ hwee a, ɔdaadaa noho.
Na hom mma obiara nsɔ nankasa n'edwuma nhwɛ, nna obenya no nko ho biribi ahyehyɛ noho, na nnyɛ obi ho a.
Na obiara bɔsoa nankasa n'adzesoa.
Hom mma nyia wɔrekyerɛkyerɛ no asɛm no mu no mmema nyia ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ no wɔ adzepa nyina mu.
Mma hom nndaadaa homho; Onyankopɔn wonnsi no atwetwe; dza nyimpa dua no, ɔnoara na obobu.
Na nyia odua ma nankasa no honam no, ofi honam mu bobu prɔwee, na nyia odua ma Sunsum no fi Sunsum mu bobu onnyiewiei nkwa.
Mma hom mma yɛmmberɛ wɔ papayɛ mu, na sɛ yɛanntɔ bahaw a, yebobu no ne ber ano.
Dɛm ntsi, sɛ yenya ber a ɔsɛ a, hom mma yɛnyɛ papa mma nyimpa nyina, nkanka hɔn a wɔyɛ gyedzi fifo no.
Hom nhwɛ kyerɛw akɛse a medze mankasa me nsa akyerɛw rebrɛ hom.
Dodow a wɔpɛ dɛ hɔn enyim ba nyam wɔ honam mu no, hɔn na wɔhyɛ hom dɛ hom ntwa twatsia, ama wonnkehiahia hɔnho wɔ Christ mbeamudua ho nko ntsi a.
Na hɔn a wɔagye twatsiatwa no mpo hɔnankasa nndzi mbra no do, na wɔrohwehwɛ dɛ hom twa twatsia, na wɔaahyehyɛ hɔnho wɔ hom honam mu.
Na emidze ɔmmpar me dɛ mebɛhyehyɛ moho, gyesɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ mbeamudua no mu, ɔno do na wɔnam abɔ wiadze mbeamudua mu ama me, na wɔabɔ mo so mbeamudua mu ama wiadze.
Na nnyɛ twatsiatwa anaa monomonomyɛ na ɔyɛ biribi, na mbom abɔdze fofor a.
Na dodow a wɔnam susuhoma yi do no, asomdwee nye ehumbɔbɔr mbra hɔn nye Nyankopɔn Israel do.
Ofi ha kɔ yi, mma obi mmfona me: Na moso Jesus akam wɔ me nyimpadua mu.
Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ adom nkã hom sunsum, enuanom. Amen.

1: Ahyɛse no Nyankopɔn bɔɔ sor nye asaase
Na asaase da hɔ hun eso pan; na isum agye bun enyi: Na Nyankopɔn no sunsum butuuw nsu ni enyi.
Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Ekan mbra: Na ekan bae.
Na Nyankopɔn hun kan no dɛ oye: Na Nyankopɔn tseew kan no fii sum no ho.
Na Nyankopɔn frɛɛ ekan no Adzekyee, na isum no ɔfrɛɛ no Adzesaa. Na adzesaa nye adzekyee, da kor.
Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, wɔmma wimu mbra nsu no finimfin, na wɔmma ɔntse nsu no ho.
Na Nyankopɔn yɛɛ wimu no, na ɔtsee nsu a ɔwɔ wimu no n'ase no fii nsu a ɔwɔ wimu no no sor no ho: Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm.
Na Nyankopɔn frɛɛ wimu no ɔsor. Na adzesaa nye adzekyee, da a otsia ebien.
Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Wɔmma nsu a ɔwɔ ɔsor n'ase no ɔmpra nkɔboa fakor na wɔmma wewewdo nyi noho: Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm.
Na Nyankopɔn frɛɛ wewewdo no Asaase; na nsu no no mboano no ɔfrɛɛ no Epo: Na Nyankopɔn hun dɛ oye.
Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Asaase mfifir efuw, nhaban a ɔsow aba, na dua a ɔsow eduaba dɛ mbrɛ no su tse a n'aba wɔ mu, wɔ asaase do: Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm.
Na asaase fifiir efuw, haban a ɔsow aba dɛ mbrɛ no su tse: Na Nyankopɔn hun dɛ oye.
Na adzesaa nye adzekyee, da a otsia ebiasa.
Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Nkandzea mbra ɔsor wimu no mu mbeyi adzekyee mfi adzesaa ho: Na onye nsɛnkyerɛdze, nye mbernkyekyɛmu, nye nda nye mfe:
Na ɔnyɛ nkandzea wɔ osor wimu no mu nhyerɛn asaase do: Na oyee dɛm.
Na Nyankopon yɛɛ nkandzea akɛse ebien no; kandzea kɛse no dɛ ɔnhwɛ adzekyee do, kandzea kakraba no dɛ ɔnhwɛ adzesaa do: Oyɛɛ nworaba so.
Na Nyankopɔn dze sisii ɔsor wimu no mu dɛ wɔnhyerɛn asaase do,
na wɔnhwɛ adzekyee nye adzesaa do, na onyi kan mfi sum ho: Na Nyankopɔn hun dɛ oye.
Na adzesaa nye adzekyee, da a otsia anan.
Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Nsu no ndɔ mbowa a wɔkeka hɔnho a nkwa wɔ hɔn mu menyamenya na ntumbowa nkyin asaase do wɔ ɔsor wienyi.

Na Nyankopɔn bɔɔ esumbowa akɛse no, na mbowa a nkwa wɔ hɔn mu a wɔkeka hɔnho a nsu no dɔɔ hɔn menyamenya nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn su tsetsee, na ntumbowa nyinara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn su tsetsee: Na Nyankopɔn hun dɛ oye.
Na Nyankopɔn hyiraa hɔn see dɛ, hom nwo, na wɔndɔr, na wɔnhyɛ po mu nsu mu ma, na ntumbowa ndɔr wɔ asaase.
Na adzesaa nye adzekyee, da a otsia enum.
Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, asaase nwo mbowa a nkwa wɔ hɔn mu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn su tsetsee, ofiembowa, nye nketsebowa, nye asaase mbowadoma dɛ mbrɛ hɔn su tsetsee: Na oyɛɛ dɛm.
Na Nyankopɔn yɛɛ asaase mbowadoma dɛ mbrɛ hɔn su tsetsee, na mbowa a wɔtsen famu nyinara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn su tsetsee: Na Nyankopɔn hun dɛ oye.

Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Womma yɛnyɛ nyimpa wɔ hɛn su do, wɔ hɛn saso do: Na wonnya tum wɔ po mu nam do, nye wimu ntumbowa do, nye ofiembowa do, nye asaase nyinara, nye nketsebowa a wɔtsen asaase do nyinara do.
Na Nyankopɔn bɔɔ nyimpa wɔ nankasa no su do, Nyankopɔn no su do na obɔɔ no; obɔɔ hɔn ɔbanyin nye ɔbaa.

Na Nyankopɔn hyiraa hɔn: Na Nyankopɔn see hɔn dɛ, hom nwo, na wɔndɔr, na wɔnhye asaase ma, na wɔnhom do; na wonnya tum wɔ po mu nam do, nye wimu ntumbowa do, nye mbowa a nkwa wɔ hɔn mu a wɔkeka hɔnho wɔ asaase do nyinara do.
Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, hwɛ, mama hom haban a ɔsow aba nyinara a ɔwɔ asaase nyinara enyi, nye ndua nyinara a ɔsow eduaba a n’aba wɔ mu; onyɛ edziban mma hom
na asaase mbowadoma nyinara, nye wimu ntumbowa nyinara, nye mbowa a wɔtsen asaase do a nkwa wɔ hɔn mu nyinara, hɔn mfunoma nyinara dɛ wondzi: Na ɔyɛɛdɛm.
Na Nyankopɔn hun adze a ɔayɛ nyinara, na hwɛ, oye papa. Na adzesaa nye adzekyee, da a otsia esia
2: Na wowiee ɔsor nye asaase nye hɔn mu dɔm nyinara yɛ.
Na da a otsia esuon no Nyankopɔn wiee n’edwuma a aayɛ no yɛ; na ɔgyee n’ahom da a otsia esuon no wɔ n'edwuma a ɔayɛ nyinara mu.
Na Nyankopɔn hyiraa da a otsia esuon no na otseew ho: Osiandɛ ɔno mu na ɔgyee n’ahom wɔ n’edwuma a Nyankopɔn ɔabɔ na ɔayɛ nyinara mu.
Iyinom nye ɔsor nye asaase hɔn santsen wɔ aber a wɔbɔɔ hɔn no, wɔ da a Ewuradze Nyankopɔn yɛɛ asaase nye ɔsor no.
Na hamu dua biara nnyae mmbaa asaase do, na hamu ahaban biara nnyae mmfirii: Osiandɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn nntɔɔ nsu nnguu asaase do, na nyimpa nnyi hɔ a obɔdɔw;
na nsuwusiw fi asaase do bɔfɔɔw asaase enyi nyinara.
Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn dze asaase huntuma bɔɔ nyimpa, na oguu nkwahwea guu n’ahwentokura mu; na nyimpa bɛyɛɛ ɔkra tseasefo.
Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn yɛɛ ture wɔ Eden, wɔ boka afamu; na hɔ na ɔdze nyimpa a ɔayɛ no no toe.
Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn maa ndua a wɔhwɛ a ɔye fɛw, na oye dɛ wodzi, nyinara fifirii; nkwadua no so wɔ ture no ne finimfin, na papa nye bɔn ho nyimdzee dua no.
Na esutsen bi fi Eden kɔree kɔfɔɔw ture no; na ofi hɔ na no mu paapaae, na obɛyɛɛ nsutsir anan.
Dza odzi kan no ne dzin dze Pishon: Ɔno na otwa Havilah asaase nyinara ho hyia no, mbrɛ sika wɔ no,
na asaase no do sika ye; bdellium nye onyɛ bobaa wɔ hɔ. 1ɛ. Na esutsen a otsia ebien no ne dzin dze Gihon: Ɔno na otwa Cush asaase nyinara ho hyia.
Na esutsen a otsia ebiasa no ne dzin dze Hiddeekel: Ɔno na otwa mu wɔ Assyria enyim no. Na esusen a otsia anan no nye Euphrates.
Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn faa nyimpa no, na ɔdze no kɔtoo Eden ture no mu dɛ onsiesie hɔ, na ɔnhwɛ hɔ.
Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ nyimpa no mbra dɛ, Ture yi mu ndua nyinara dzi bi:
Na papa nye bɔn ho nyimdzee dua no dze, mma nndzi bi; na da a ibedzi bi no,ampara dɛ ibowu.
Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn see dɛ, onnye dɛ nyimpa no nko tsena hɔ; mebɛyɛ boafo a ɔfata no mama no.

Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn dze dɛtse yɛɛ hamu mbowadoma nyinara, nye wimu ntumbowa nyinara; na ɔdze hɔn brɛɛ nyimpa no dɛ ɔnhwɛ mbrɛ obɛfrɛ hɔn: Na adze biara a nyimpa no dze frɛɛ abɔdze biara a okwa wɔ no mu no, ɔnoara nye ne dzin.
Na nyimpa no totoo ofiembowa nyinara, nye wimu ntumbowa, nye hamu mbowadoma nyinara edzin; na nyimpa dze woennhu boafo a ɔfata no amma no.
Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn maa nda heii tɔɔ nyimpa no do, na ɔdae; na oyii ne mparba mu kor, na ɔdze nam hyɛɛ n’ananmu.
Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn dze aparba a oyii no nyimpa no mu no yɛɛ ɔbaa, na ɔdze no brɛɛ nyimpa no.
Na nyimpa no see dɛ, afei oyi nye me mbiew mu obiew, na mo honam mu nam: Wɔbɛfrɛ no ɔbaa, osiandɛ woyii no wɔ ɔbarimba mu.
Dɛm ntsi na ɔbarimba bɛgya n’egya nye ne na wɔ hɔ, na ɔdze noho akɛfam ne yer ho, na wɔaye honan kor.
Na hɔn beenu no nyinara dzi adagyaw, ɔbarimba no nye ne yer no, na hɔn enyi nnto.
3: Afei abowatsena no yɛ onyitsɛwfo kyɛn hamu abowa biara a Ewuradze Nyankopɔn ayɛ. Na ɔsee ɔbaa no dɛ, Ampaara dɛ Nyankopɔn ase dɛ, Mma hom nndzi ture yi mu ndua nyinara bi?
Na ɔbaa no see abowatsena no dɛ, Ture yi mu ndua n'eduaba no yɛwɔ ho kwan dɛ yedzi bi:
Na dua a osi ture finimfin no n'eduaba no na Nyankopɔn ase dɛ, Mma hom dzi, nkyii so mma hom mmfa hom nsa nnka, amma hom eennwuwu.
Na abowatsena no see ɔbaa no dɛ, Hom nnkowu ara ampa bi:
Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn nnyim dɛ da a hom bedzi bi no, hom enyi bobue, na hom ayɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn woehu papa nye bɔn.
Na ɔbaa no hun dɛ dua no ye dɛ wodzi, na ɔyɛ enyiwa do fɛw, na dua no yɛ akɔndɔ dɛ ɔbɛtsew enyi no, ɔtseew n’aba no bi, na odzii.
Na hɔn beenu no nyinara hɔn enyiwa buei, na wohun dɛ wodzi adagyaw; na wɔpempaam adɔmbadua n’ahataw, na wɔyɛɛ nsamenyim maa hɔn ho.
Na wɔtsee Ewuradze Nyankopɔn ne nka de ɛnam ture no mu ewimbibaamu: Na barimba no nye ne yer no sumae fii Ewuradze Nyankopɔn n’enyim wɔ ture no mu ndua no mu.
Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn frɛɛ barimba no na ɔsee no dɛ, Ewɔ hen?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Metsee wo ndze wɔ ture no mu, na musuroi, osiandɛ midzi adagyaw; na musumaa moho.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Woana kaa kyerɛɛ wo de idzi adagyaw? Ana edzi dua a mehyɛɛ wo ho mbra dɛ mma nndzi bi no bi?
Na barimba no see dɛ, ɔbaa no a edze no bɛkaa mo ho no, ɔno na ɔmaa me dua no bi, na midzii.
Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn see ɔbaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ayɛ yi? Na ɔbaa no see dɛ, Abowatsena no daadaa me, na midzii.
Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn see abowatsena no dɛ, osiandɛ ayɛ iyi ntsi, wɔadom wɔ wo ofiembowa nyinara mu, na hamu mbowadoma nyinara mu; wo yafun do na ebɛnantsew, na huntuma na ibedzi wo nkwa nda nyinara:
Na medze ɔtan mobɔto ɔwo nye ɔbaa no ntamu, na w’asefo nye n’asefo ntamu: Obɔbɔ wo tsir, na wo so abɔ n’anantsir.
Osee ɔbaa no dɛ, mebɛma w’awoko mu amandzehu adɔɔ so kɛse; ɔfona mu na ebɔwo mba; na ebɛdan wo kun, na ɔbɔhwɛ wo do.
Na osee Adam dɛ, osiandɛ etsie wo yer ne ndze, na edzi dua a mehyɛɛ wo ho mbra dɛ, mma nndzi bi no bi ntsi, wɔadom asaase wɔ wo ntsi; awerehow mu na ibedzidzi do wo nkwa nda nyinara;
nhwirom nye nsoɛ so na obefifir ama wo; na ibedzi hamu ahaban;
w’enyim mfifir mu na ibedzidzi kɛpem dɛ ebɛsan akɔ daadze; osiandɛ ɔno mu na woyii wo fii. Na huntuma nye wo, na huntuma mu na ebɛsan akɔ.
Na barimba no too ne yer no dzin Eve, osiandɛ ɔno na ɔye atseasefo nyinara hɔn na.
Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn yɛɛ nwoma ntar maa Adam nye ne yer, na ɔdze hyɛɛ hɔn.
Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Hwɛ, nyimpa no abɛyɛ dɛ hɛn mu kor, ohu papa nye bɔn; na afei bɛyɛ na ɔatsen ne nsa, na ɔatsew nkwadua no so bi, na oedzi, na ɔastena ase daa;
dɛm ntsi Ewuradze Nyankopɔn tuu no fii Eden ture no mu dɛ ɔnkɔdɔw daadze a woyii no fii mu no.
Na oyii nyimpa no edzi; na ɔdze Cherubim, nye gya nkrantsee a onyinanyinam, sii Eden ture no enyim boka, dɛ wɔnweɔn nkwadua no ho kwan.
4: Na banyin no hun ne yer Eve na onyinsenil; na ɔwoo Cain, na ɔsee dɛ, medze Ewuradze no mboa enya banyin.
Na bio ɔwoo no nua Abel. Na Abel yɛ oguanhwɛfo na Cain yɛ okuafo.
Na nda guu mu no, ɔbaa dɛ Cain dze ekuadze bɔbɔɔ Ewuradze afɔr.
Na Abel ɔno so dze no nguan mu mbakan na dza wɔadodɔ seradze mu bi bae. Na Ewuradze n’enyi sɔɔ Abel nye n'afɔrbɔ:
Na Cain nye n’afɔrbɔ dze n'enyi annsɔ. Na Cain no bo fuuw kɛsenara, na no ntɔn himae.
Na Ewuradze see Cain dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wo bo efuw yi? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wo ntɔn ehima yi?
Sɛ ɛyɛ papa a nkyɛ w’enyim nnkɛba nyam? Na sɛ annye papa a, bɔn kotow abowano: Na w’ekyir kwan na ɔbɔhwehwɛ, na ɔwodze ahom no do.
Na Cain kaa kyerɛɛ no nua Abel. Na ɔbaa dɛ wɔwɔ hamu no, Cain soɛɛr no nua Abel do, na okum no.
Na Ewuradze see Cain dɛ, Wo nua Abel wɔ hen? Na osee dɛ, Minnyim: Ana emi nye mo nua no hwɛfo?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na aye yi? Wo nua no bɔgyaa ne ndze fi famu keka mu frɛ me.
Na afei wofi asaase a ɔahan n’anomu regye wo nua no bɔgyaa wɔ wo nsamu no, wɔadom wo:
Sɛ edɔw asaase a, ɔdzekɔr yi onnkeyi n’ahoɔdzen ama wo; ɔkobɔfo nye ɔwonawonafo na ebɛyɛ wɔ asaase do.
Na Cain see Ewuradze dɛ, Mo bɔn ho akatua so kyɛn dɛ mubotum asoa.
Hwɛ, ndɛ eyi me edzi wɔ asaase enyi; na mubosuma mefi w’enyim; na mebɛyɛ kobɔfo nye wonawonafo wɔ asaase do; na ɔbɛba dɛ, obiara a obohu me no oboku me.
Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, Dɛm ntsi obiara a oboku Cain no wobedzi no wer mpɛn esuon. Na Ewuradze hyɛɛ asɛnkyerɛdze bi maa Cain, amma obi hu no a, oeennku no.
Na Cain fii Ewuradze n’enyim kɔree, na ɔkɛtsenaa Nod asaase do wɔ Eden no boka.
Na Cain hun ne yer: Na onyinsenii, na ɔwoo Enoch: Na ɔkyekyeer kurow, na ɔfrɛɛ kurow no ne dzin Enoch, dɛ mbrɛ ne ba no ne dzin tse.
Na wɔwoo Irad maa Enoch; na Irad woo Medujael: Na Mehujael woo Methushael: Na Methushael woo Lamech.
Na Lamech waar yernom beenu: Baako ne dzin dze Adah, na baako ne dzin Zillah.
Na Adah woo Jabal: Ɔno nye hɔn a wɔtsena asese mu na wɔwɔ fiembowa no, hɔn egya.
Na no nua no dzin dze Jubal: Ɔno nye asankubɔfo nye mbɛnhɛmfo nyinara hɔn egya.
Na Zillah, ɔno so woo Tubal-cain a ɔton kɔɔber nye dadze ndzemba a wɔdze twa adze nyinara; na Tubal-cain n'akyerɛbaa nye Naamah.
Na Lamech see ne yernom dɛ: Hom ntsie me ndze, Adah nye Zillah; Hom nyɛ aso mma ne kasaa, Lamech yernom: Na meku ɔbarimba dɛ opiraa me, Na meku aberantsɛ dɛ ɔboor me
Sɛ wobedzi Cain ho wer mpɛnesuon a, ampa, Lamech dze, mpɛn eduosuon esuon.
Na Adam hun ne yer bio; na ɔwoo babayin, na ɔtoo no dzin Seth: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn dze ba fofor ahyɛ me Abel n'ananmu; osiandɛ Cain kum no.
Na Seth, ɔno so wɔwoo babayin maa no; na ɔtoo no dzin Enosh: Nna afei adasa hyɛɛ ase frɛɛ Ewuradze ne dzin.
5: Adam n'ebusuasantsen nwoma nye yi. Da a Nyankopɔn bɔɔ nyimpa no, Nyankopɔn ne saso do na ɔyɛɛ no;
ɔbanyin nye ɔbaa na ɔbɔɔ hɔn; na ohyiraa hɔn, na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn Adam wɔ da a wɔbɔɔ hɔn no.
Na Adam dzii mfe ɔha eduasa, na ɔwoo babanyin ne saso mu, wɔ no suban do; na ɔtoo no dzin Seth:
Na Adam woo Seth no n'ekyir ne nda yɛɛ mfe ahaawɔtwe: Na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
Na nda a Adam dzii nyinara ɔyɛ mfe ahaakron eduasa; na owui.
Na Seth dzii mfe ɔha enum, na ɔwoo Enosh:
Na Seth woo Enosh no n'ekyir odzii mfe ahaawɔtwe nye esuon, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbaabaa:
Na Seth ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaakron duebien: Na owui.
Na Enosh dzii mfe eduokron, na ɔwoo Kenan:
Na Enosh woo Kenan no n'ekyir odzii mfe ahaawɔtwe duenum, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa:
Na Enosh ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaakron nye enum na owui.
Na Kennan dzi mfe eduosuon, na ɔwoo Mahalalel:
Na Kenan woo Mahalalel no n'ekyir odzii mfe ahaawɔtwe eduanan, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa:
Na Kenan ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaakron nye du: Na owui
Na Mahalalel dzii mfe eduosia enum, na ɔwoo Jared:
Na Mahalalel woo Jared no n'ekyir odzii mfe ahaawɔtwe eduasa, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa:
Na Mahalalel ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaawɔtwe eduokron enum: Na owui.
Na Jared dzii mfe ɔha eduosia ebien, na ɔwoo Enoch:
Na Jared woo Enoch no n'ekyir odzii mfe ahaawɔtwe, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa:
Na Jared ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaakron eduosia ebien: Na owui
Na Enoch dzii mfe eduosia enum, na ɔwoo Methuselah:
Na Enoch woo Methuselah no n'ekyir ɔnye Nyankopɔn nantsewee mfe ahaasa, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa:
Na Enoch ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaasa eduosia enum:
Na Enoch nye Nyankopɔn nantsewee: Na onnyi hɔ: Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn faa no.
Na Methusela dzii mfe ɔha eduawɔtwe esuon, na ɔwoo Lamech:
Na Methusela woo Lamech no n'ekyir odzii mfe ahaesuon eduowɔ twe ebien, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa:
Na Methusela ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaakron eduosia akron: Na owui.
Na Lamech dzii mfe ɔha eduowɔtwe ebien, na ɔwoo babanyin:
Na ɔtoo no dzin Noah, dɛ, oyiara na ɔbɛkyekye hɛn werɛ wɔ hɛn edwuma nye hɛn nsaano berɛ mu, osian asaase a Ewuradze apaa no ntsi.
Na Lamech woo Noah no ekyir odzii mfe ahaenum eduokron enum, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
Na Lamech ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaesuon eduosuon esuo: Na owui.
Na Noah dzii mfe ahaenum: Na Noah woo Shem, Ham, nye Japheth
6: Na ɔbaa dɛ nyimpa hyɛɛ ase dɔree wɔ asaase enyi, na wɔwoo mbabaa maa hɔn no,
Nyankopɔn ne mba hun nyimpa mbabaa no dɛ hɔn ho yɛ fɛw; na wɔwarwaar hɔn mu dza wɔpɛ nyinara.
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, mo sunsum nnkɛnye nyimpa edzi aper daa, osiandɛ ɔyɛ no honam no ara: Naaso ne nda nyɛ mfe ɔha eduonu.
Nda no mu no na Nephilfo wɔ asaase do, na eso n'ekyir no a Nyankopɔn ne mba kɔr nyimpa mbaabaa na wɔwoo mba maa hɔn: Woyiara nye tsetse etumfo no, nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ dzin no.
Na Ewuradze hun dɛ nyimpa n'emumuyɛ ayɛ kɛse wɔ asaase do, na dɛ n'akoma mu adwen nyinara yɛ bɔn ara nko daa.
Na Ewuradze nuu noho dɛ ɔyɛɛ nyimpa wɔ asaase, na ɔyɛɛ no yaw wɔ n'akoma mu.
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, mebɛsɛɛ nyimpa a mabɔ no no efi asaase enyi: Nyimpa,nye mbowa, nye nketsebowaa, nye wimu ntumbowa nyinara; na menu moho dɛ mayɛ hɔn.
Na Noah dze, onyaa enyimnyam wɔ Ewuradze n'enyim.
Iyinom nye Noah n'ebusuasantsen, Noah yɛ nyimpa tseneneenyi na odzi mu wɔ n'ebusuasantsen mu:
Na Noah woo mbanyin baasa, Shem, Ham, nye Japheth.
Na asaase sɛɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn n'enyim, na enyiɔdzen ahyɛ asaase ma.
Na Nyankopɔn hun asaase, na, hwɛ, asɛɛ; osiandɛ honam nyinara asɛɛ no kwan wɔ asaase do.
Na Nyankopɔn see Noah dɛ, honam nyinara n'ewiei edu m'enyim; osiandɛ ɔnam hɔn do ma enyiɔdzen ahyɛ asaase ma; na, hwɛ, medze asaase mebɛka hɔn hon masɛɛ hɔn.
Fa gopher dua pam hɛn fa ma woho; yɛ adan wɔ hɛn no mu, na fa ihua tar no mu nye n'ekyir.
Na beebi mbrɛ si yɛ nye yi: Ehɛn no ne tsentsen basafa ahaasa ne tɛtɛr basafa eduonum, na no krɔn basafa eduasa.
Yɛ ntokrura wɔ hɛn no ho, na wie no basafa wɔ sor; na hɛn no n'abow no fa si ne nkyɛnmu; yɛ no nsamdo, dza odzi ase, dza otsia ebien, nye dza otsia ebiasa.
Na emi, hwɛ, medze nsuyirii reba asaase mabɛsɛɛ honam a nkwahom wɔ mu nyinara efi sor ase: Adze a ɔwɔ asaase do nyinara bowu.
Na menye wo bedzi ahyɛmu: Na aba hɛn no mu, ɔwo, nye wo mba, nye wo yer, nye wo mba hɔn yernom ka wo ho.
Na fa honam nyinara mu adze a nkwa wɔ mu n'ahorow nyinara mu ebien ebien bra hɛn no mu, ma wonnya nkwa nka wo ho; fa hɔn onyin nye ɔber.
Ntumbowa hɔn ahorow, nye fiembowa hɔn ahorow, nye daadze nketsebowa nyinara hɔn ahorow, hɔn nyinara hɔn mu ebien ebien mbra wo nkyɛn; ama woeenya nkwa.
Na fa edziban a wodzi nyinara bi ma woho, na boa ano kɔ wo nkyɛn; ama ɔaayɛ edziban ama ɔwo nye hɔn.
Dɛm na Noah yɛe; dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no nyinara, dɛmara na ɔyɛe.
7: na Ewuradze see Noah dɛ, ɔwo nye wo fi nyinara wɔnkɔ hɛn no mu; na ɔwo na mehu wo dɛ etsen wɔ m'enyim wɔ satsen yi mu.
Mbowa a hɔn ho tsew nyinara fa hɔn mu esuon esuon, onyin na ne ber;
wimu ntumbowa mu so, esuon esuon, enyin nye aber; ama hɔn ase eenya nkwa wɔ asaase nyinara enyi.
Na aka nda esuon na maama nsu atɔ egu asaase do adaduanan adzekyee nye adzesaa; na adze a nkwa wɔ mu a mayɛ nyinara mebɛsɛɛ no efi asaase enyi.
Na Noah yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ no no nyinara.
Na aber a nsuyirii baa asaase do no na Noah edzi mfe ahaesia.
Na Noah, nye ne mba, nye ne yer nye ne mba hɔn yernom, kɔr hɛn no mu, osian nsuyirii no ntsi.
Mbowa a hɔn ho tsew, nye mbowa a hɔn ho nntsew, nye nkumbowa, nye mbowa a wɔwea wɔ daadze nyinara mu.
Ebien ebien kɔr Noah nkyɛn wɔ hɛn no mu enyin nye aber, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ Noah no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nda esuon no ekyir no, nsuyirii no baa asaase do.
Noah no nkwa mu afe a otsia ahaesia no mu, bosoom a otsia ebien no mu, bosoom no ne da a ostsia duesoun no, da no ara na bun kɛse no no nsunyiwa nyinara paapaae; na ɔsor ntokura buebuei.
Na nsu tɔree guu asaase do adaduana adzekyee nye adzesaa.
Da no ara na Noah, nye Shem, nye Ham, nye Japheth, Noah ne mba no, nye Noah ne yer, nye ne mba hɔn yernom baasa no ka hɔn ho, kɔr hɛn no mu;
Hɔn, nye mbowa nyinara hɔn ahorow, nye fiembowa nyinara hɔn ahorow, nye nketsebowa a wɔwea asaase do nyinara hɔn ahorow, nye ntumbowa nyinara hɔn ahorow, nnoma ahorow nyinara.
Na wɔkor Noah nkyɛn wɔ hɛn no mu; honam a nkwahom wɔ mu nyinara mu ebien ebien
Na hɔn a wɔkɔr mu no honam nyinara mu enyin nye aber na wɔkɔr mu, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no: Na Ewuradze toow no mu.
Na nsuyirii no baa asaase do adaduanan, na nsu no yirii, na ɔsoaa hɛn no, na ɔmaa do fii asaase do.
Na nsu no boor do, na oyiyirii kɛsenara wɔ asaase do; na hɛn no nam nsu no enyi.
Na nsu no boor do pii wɔ asaase do; na nkokwaa atsentsen nyinara a ɔwɔ ɔsor nyina ase do katae.
Nsu no boor do kor sor basafa duenum; na nkokwaa do katae.
Na honam a ɔkeka noho wɔ asaase do nyinara wui, ntumbowa, nye fiembowa, nye mbowadoma, nye nketsebowa a wɔwea asaase do nyinara, nye nyimpa nyinara
Dza ɔwɔ wewewdo nyinara mu, hɔn a nkwa sunsum ahom wɔ hɔn ahwentokura mu nyinara, wuwui.
Na adze a nkwa wɔ mu a ɔwɔ asaase emyi nyinara wɔsɛɛ no, nyimpa, nye fiembowa, nye nketsebowa, nye hɔn a wɔnye no wɔ hɛn no mu no.
Na nsu no boor do wɔ asaase do nda ɔha eduonum.
8: Na Nyankopɔn kaa Noah, na adze a nkwa wɔ mu nyinara, na fiembowa a wɔnye no wɔ hɛn no mu no nyinara: Na Nyankopɔn maa mframa bɔe faa asaase do, na nsu no huamee;
bun no no nsunyiwa so nye ɔsor ntokura ano sisiwii, na nsu a ofi sor gyaa tɔ;
na nsu no daa ho ara twee fii asaase do: Na nda ɔha eduonum n'ekyir na nsu no do kuwii
Na ehɛn no kɛfaa Ararat nkokwaa do wɔ bosoom a otsia esuon no mu, bosoom no ne da a otsia duesuon no mu.
Na nsu no daa ho twee ara dze kodur bosoom a otsia du no mu no, bosoom no ne da a odzi kan no mu, na nkokwaa etsifi dedaa hɔ.
Na ɔbaa dɛ adaduanan n’ekyir no, Noah buee hɛn no no tokura a ɔyɛe no;
na ɔsomaa akonkoran, na ofiir edzi kɛkyinii araa ma ɔdze kɛpeem dɛ nsu wewewee fi asaase do.
Na ɔsomaa ebubur fi ne nkyɛn, dɛ ɔnkɔhwɛ kyerɛ nsu no ehuam efi asaase enyi;
na ebubur no ennya ne nan sibew, na ɔsanee baa no hɔ wɔ hɛn no mu, osiandɛ nsu no wɔ asaase nyinara enyi: Na ɔtseen ne nsa suoo no mu, na ɔdze no baa ne nkyɛn wɔ hɛn no mu.
Na ɔtweɔɔn nda esuon so bio, na ɔsomaa ebubar no fiihɛn no mu bio;
na ebubur no sanee baa no hɔ ewimbir no; na, hwɛ olive ahataw momon a ɔatsew tua n'ano nna Noah, hun dɛ nsu no atwe efi asaase do.
Na ɔtweɔɔn nda esuon so bio, na ɔsomaa ebubur no; na ɔannsan ammba no hɔ bio.
Na ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsia ahaesia biako no mu, bosoom a odzi kan no mu, bosoom no ne da a odzi kan no, nsu no wewewee fii asaase do; na Noah yii hɛn no ne nkatado no, na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ asaase enyi awow.
Na bosoom a otsia ebien no mu, bosoom no ne da a otsia eduonu esuon no, na asaase do wewee.
Na Nyankopɔn kasaa kyererɛɛ Noab dɛ,
Fi hɛn no mu pue, ɔwo nye wo yer, nye wo mba, nye wo mba, nye wo mba hɔn yernom no ka wo ho

Fa adze a nkwa wo hɔn mu a wɔnye wo wɔ hɔ nyinara a ɔwɔ honam nyinara mu ka wo ho pue, ntumbowa, nye fiembowa, nye nketsebowa a wɔwea asaase do nyinara; ama wɔaawo wɔ asaase do menyamenya, na wɔaawowo, na wɔaadɔr wɔ asaase do.
Na Noah, nye ne mba, nye ne yer, nye ne mba hɔn yernom ka no ho fiir edzi:
Mbowadoma nyinara, nketsebowa nyinara, nye ntumbowa nyinara, adze biara a ɔkeka noho wɔ asaase dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mbowa ban tsetsee, fii hɛn no mu puei.
Na Noah sii afɔrmbukyia maa Ewuradze; na ɔfaa mbowa a hɔn ho tsew nyinara mu bi, na ɔdze bobɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.

Na Ewuradze tsee afɔr no no huam; na Ewuradze kaa wɔ n’akoma mu dɛ, monnkɔdom asaase bio ara da wɔ nyimpa ntsi, osiandɛ nyimpa n’akoma mu adwen muo dze fitsi no mbofra mu; nkyii so mennkɛsɛe adze a nkwa wɔ mu biara bio ara da, dɛ mbrɛ mayɛ yi.
Mber tsentsen ara a asaase wɔ hɔ yi, duaber nye buber, nye awɔw nye ahohur, nye ɔhyewber nye awɔwber, nye adzekyee nye adzesaa nnkegyaa da
9: Na Nyankopɔn hyiraa Noah nye ne mba, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nwo, na wɔndɔr, na wɔnyɛ asaase do ma.
Na hom ho suro nye hom ho hu mbra asaase do mbowadoma nyinara do, nye wimuu ntumbowa nyinara do; adze a ɔyɛ daadze menyanmenya nyinara, na po mu nam nyinara, wɔdze ahyɛ hom nsa.
Adze a ɔkeka noho a nkwa wɔ mu nyinara ɔnyɛ edziban mma hom; dɛ mbrɛ medze mfunoma mama hom no na medze ne nyinara mama hom.
Na nam a no nkwa wɔno mu, ɔnye dɛ no bɔgyaa, mma hom nndzi.
Na ampaara, hom bɔgyaa, hom nkwa no bɔgyaa mobɔhwehwɛ: Abowa biara nsamu na mobɔhwehwɛ: Na nyimpa nsamu, mekyerɛ nyimpa biara no nua nsamu na mobɔhwehwɛ nyimpa no nkwa.
Obiara a ɔka nyimpa no bɔgyaa gu no, nyimpa na bɛka no bɔgyaa egu: Na Nyankopɔn no suban mu na ɔyɛɛ nyimpa
Na hom, hom nwo, wɔndɔr; wɔnwo menyamenya wɔ asaase, na wɔdɔr wɔ mu.
Na Nyankopɔn kasaa kyerɛɛ Noah, nye ne mba a wɔka no ho no dɛ.
Na emi, hwɛ, merema m'ahyɛmu etsim ama hom, nye hom asefo a wodzi hom ekyir;
na mbowa a nkwa wɔ hɔn mu nyinara a wɔka hom no no, ntumbowa, fiembowa, nye asaase mbowadoma a wɔka hom ho no nyinara; hɔn a wofi hɛn no mu puie nyinara, mekyerɛ asaase mbowadoma nyinara.
Na mebɛma menye hom hɛn ahyɛmu etsim; nkyii so nsuyirii nnkotwa honam nyinara efi hɔ bio; nkyii so nsuyirii nnkɛba bio abɛsɛɛ.
Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, iyi nye ahyɛmu a merema ɔada emi nye hom nye abɔdze a nkwa wɔ hɔn mu a wɔka hom ho nyinara ntamu, dze ama ebusuasantsen a ɔmmbɔ adze no ho asɛnkyerɛdze;
medze me nyankontɔn mabew mununkum mu, na ɔbɛyɛ emi nye asaase ntamu ahyɛmu ho asɛnkyerɛdze.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ medze mununkum meba asaase do a, wobohu nyankontɔn no wɔ mununkumno mu,
na mebɛkaa m'ahyɛmu a ɔda emi nye hom nye honam nyinara mu abɔdze a nkwa wɔ mu nyinara ntamu; na nsu no nnkɛyɛ nsuyirii bio asɛɛ honam nyinara
Na nyankontɔn no bɛbew mununkum no mu; na mobɔhwɛ, ama maakaa da a ahyɛmu a ɔda Nyankopɔn nye honam nyinara mu abɔdze a nkwa wɔ mu a ɔwɔ asaase do nyinara ntamu.
Na Nyankopɔn see Noah dɛ, iyi nye ahyɛmu a medze mitsim hɔ wɔ emi nye honam a ɔwɔasaase do nyinara ntamu no no asɛnkyerɛdze
Na Noah ne mba a wofii hɛn mu puie nye Shem, nye Ham, nye Japheth: Na Ham nye Canaan n'egya
Woyinom baasa yi nye Noah ne mba no: Na woyinom mu na nyimpa fi petsee asaase nyinara do.
Na Noah hyɛɛ ase yɛɛ okuafo, na ɔyɛɛ wenyim ture.
Na ɔnoom wenyin no bi, na ɔbowee; na no ho daa hɔ wɔ n'asesee mu.
Na Canaan n'egya Ham hun n'egya n'adagyaw, na ɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ no nuanom beenu no wɔ abowano.
Na Shem nye Japheth faa tam, na hɔn beenu no dze guu hɔn batsir, na wɔnam nkyirnkyir dze kɛkataa hɔn egya n'adagyaw do; na hɔn enyim wɔ ekyir, na woennhu hɔn egya n'adagyaw.
Na Noah no wenyim no fii n'enyi do, na ohun dza ne ba kuma no dze ayɛ no.
Na ɔsee dɛ Mpaa nka Canaan; Nkowaa mu akowaa na ɔbɛyɛ ama no nuanom.
Na ɔsee dɛ, nhyira nka Ewuradze, Shem ne Nyankopɔn; na wɔmma Canaan nyɛ n'akowaa.
Nyankopɔn nyɛ Japheth kɛse, na wɔmma ɔntsena Shem n'asesee mu; na wɔmma Canaan nyɛ n'akowaa.
Na nsuyirii no n'ekyir no Noah dzii mfe ahaasa eduonum.
Na Noah ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaakron eduonum: Na owui.
10: Afei iyinom nye Noah ne mba, Shem, Ham nye Japheth hɔn ebuasuasantsen: Na nsuyirii no n'ekyir no wɔwowoo mba maa hɔn.
Japheth ne mba nye Gomer, nye Magog, nye Madai, nye Javan, nye Tubal, nye Meshech, nye Tiras.
Na Gomer ne mba nye Ashkenas, nye Riphath, nye Togarmah.
Na Javan ne mba nye Elishah, nye Tarshish, Kittim, nye Dodanim.
Woyinom hɔn mu na nsupruw do amanaman fi petsee hɔn asaase do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nyinara hɔn kasaa tse; dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, wɔ hɔn amanaman mu.
Na Ham ne mba nye Cush, nye Mizram, nye Put, nye Canaan.
Na Cush ne mba nye Seba, nye Havilah, nye Sabtah nye Raamah, nye Sabteca: Na Raamah ne mba nye Sheda, nye Dedan.
Na Cush woo Nimrod: Ɔno Na ɔhyɛɛ ase yɛɛ otumfo wɔ asaase do.
Ɔyɛɛ ɔbɔfo a ɔwɔ tum wɔ Ewuradze n'enyim: Ma dɛm ntsi wɔse dɛ, ɔbɔfo a ɔwɔ tum wɔ Ewuradze n'enyim a ɔtse dɛ Nimrod.
Na n'ahendzi n'ahyɛse nye Babel, nye Erech, nye Accad, nye Calneh wɔ Shinar asaase do.
Asaase no do na ofi kɔr Assyria, na ɔkɛkyekyeer Nineveh, nye Rehoboth-Ir, nye Calah,
na Resen a ɔda Nineveh nye Calah ntamu no (Ɔnoara nye Pathrusum, nye kuromampɔn no).
Na Mizraim woo Ludim, nye Anamim, nye Lehabim nye Naphtuhim,
nye Pathrusim, nye Casluhim (a Philistiafo fiir hɔn mu no), nye Caphtorim.
Na Canaan woo n'abakan Zidon nye Heth;
na Jebusfo, nye Amorfo, nye Girgashfo;
nye Hivifo, nye Arkifo, nye Sinfo:
Nye Arvadfo, nye Zemarfo, nye Hamathfo: Na n'ekyir no na Canaanfo ebusua ebusua petsee.
Na Canaanfo hɔn he fi Zidon, dze nam Gerar, dze kodu Gaza; dze nam Sodom nye Gomorrah nye Admah nye Zeboiim, dze kodu Lasha.
Woyinom nye Ham ne mba, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kasaa tsetsee, wɔ hɔn asaase do, wɔ hɔn amanaman mu.
Na Shem, Eber mba nyinara hɔn egya no, Japheth no nua panyin no, ɔno so wɔwoo mba no.
Shem ne mba nye Elam, nye Asshur, nye Arpachshad, nye Lud, nye Aram.
Na Aram ne mba nye Uz, nye Hul, nye Gether, nye Mash.
Na Arpachshad woo Shelah; na Shelah woo Eber
Na wɔwoo mba beenu maa Eber: Baako ne dzin dze Peleg; osiandɛ ɔno ne nda mu na mpaapaamu baa asaase; na no nua ne dzin dze Joktan.
Na Joktan woo Almodad, nye Sheleph, nye Hazarmaveth, nye Jerah;
na Hadoram, nye Uzal, nye Diklah;
nye Obal, nye Ablimael, nye Sheba;
na Ophir, nye Havilah, nye Jobab: Woyinom nyinara Joktan mba a.
Na hɔn tsenabew fi Mesha, rokɔ Sephar, boka kokwaa no ho no.
Woyinom nye Shem ne mba dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kasaa tsetsee, wɔ hɔn asaase do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn amanaman tsetsee.
Woyinom nye Noah ne mba hɔn ebusua ebusua, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuasantsen tsetsee, wɔ hɔn amanaman mu; na woyinom hɔn mu na nsuyirii no n'ekyir no amanaman fi petsee asaase do.
11: Na asaase nyinara hɔn kasaa kor, na hɔn asɛm kor.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, wotuu kwan rokɔ boka no, wohun asaase tɛtɛr bi wɔ Shinar asaase do; na wɔtsenaa hɔ
Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, wɔmbra, wɔmma yengu ntayaa, na yɛnto ma ɔmben. Na ntayaa no yɛɛ hɔn mbobaa, na hua yɛɛ hɔn dɛtse.
Na wɔsee dɛ, wɔmbra, wɔmma yɛnkyekyer kurow, na yɛntow abantsentsen a n'etsifi bodu sor, na wɔmma yɛmfa ngye dzin; amma yaammpetse asaase nyinara enyi.
Na Ewuradze sianee bɔhwɛɛ kurow no nye abantsetsen no a adasamba rotow no.
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, hwɛ, wɔyɛ ɔman kor na hɔn nyinara hɔn kasaa kor; na dza wɔahyɛ ase reyɛ nye yi: Na afei biribiara a wosusu dɛ wɔbɛyɛ no worinnsiw hɔn kwan.
Wɔmbra, wɔmma yensian, na yɛnkɔtoto hɔn kasaa wɔ hɔ, ama obi aannkɛtse ne nyɛnko ne nsɛm ase.
Na Ewuradze fi hɔ bɔɔ hɔn petsee asaase nyinara enyi: Na wogyaa kurow no kyekyer
Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Babel, osiandɛ hɔ na Ewuradze fi bɔɔ hɔn petsee asaase nyinara enyi.
Iyinom nye Shem n'ebusuasantsen: Shem dzii mfe ɔha na ɔwoo Arpachshad nsuyirii no n'ekyir mfe ebien:
Na Shem woo Arpachshad no n'ekyir odzii mfe ahaenu, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
Na Arpachshad dzii mfe eduase enum, na ɔwoo Shelah:
Na Arpachshad woo Shelah no n'ekyir odzii mfe ahaanan ebiasa na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
Na Shelah dzii mfe eduasa, na ɔwoo Eber:
Na Shelah woo Eber no n'ekyir odzii mfe ahaanan ebiasa na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
Na Eber dzii mfe eduasa anan, na ɔwoo Peleg:
Na Eber woo Peleg no n'ekyir odzii mfe ahaanan eduasa, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
Na Peleg dzii mfe eduasa, na ɔwoo Reu:
Na Peleg woo Reu no n'nkyir odzii mfe ahaenu akron, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mababaa.
Na Reu dzii mfe eduasa ebien, na ɔwoo Serug:
Na Reu woo Serug no n'enyir odzii mfe ahaenu esuon, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa
Na Serug dzii mfe eduasa, na ɔwoo Nahor:
Na Serug woo Nahor no n'ekyir odzii mfe ahaenu, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa
Na Nahor dzii mfe eduonu akron, na ɔwoo Terah;
Na Nahor woo Terah no n'ekyir odzii mfe ɔha duakron, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
Na Teran dzii mfe eduosuon, na ɔwoo Abram, Nahor, nye Haran.
Afei iyinom nye Terah n'ebusuasantsen. Terah woo Abram, Nahor, nye Haran; na Haran woo Lot.
Na Haran wui wɔ n'egya Terah enyim wɔ asaase wɔwoo no do no do, wɔ Chaldefo Ur.
Na Abram nye Nahor warwaree: Abram ne yer ne dzin dze Sarai; na Nahor ne yer ne dzin dze Milcah. Hran a ɔyɛ Milcah n'egya, nye Iscah n'egya no ne babaa a.
Na Sarai yɛ ɔbɔnyin; onnyi ba.
Na Terah faa ne ba Abram yer no; na wɔnye hɔn sii mu fi Chaldefo Ur, dɛ wɔrokɔ Canaan asaase do; na wɔbaa Haran, na wɔbɛtsenaa hɔ.
Na Terah ne nda yɛ mfe ahaenu enum: Na Terah wui wɔ Haran.
12: Afei Ewuradze see Abram dɛ, fi wo man mu, na fi w’ebusua mu, na fi w’egya fie, kɔ asaase a mebɛkyerɛ wo no do:
Na mebɛyɛ wo ɔman kɛse, na mibehyira wo, na mama wo dzin ayɛ kɛse: Na aye nhyira:
Na mibehyira hɔn a wohyira wo, na nyia ɔdom wo no mobɔdom no: Na wo mu na wobehyira asaase ebusua ebusua nyinara.
Nna Abram kɔr dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ no no: Na Lot nye no kɔree: Na Abram fii Haran no nna odzi mfe eduosuon enum.
Na Abram faa ne yer Sarai, nye no nua ba Lot, na hɔn ahodze a wonyaa nyinara; na nyimpa a wonyaa no wɔ Haran no nyinara;,na wosii mu dɛ wɔrokɔ Canaan asaase do: Na Canaan asaase do na wobae.
Na Abram twaa mu wɔ asaase no do kor beebi a wofrɛ hɔ Shechem, kɔr Moreh esudur no ho. Na aber no nna Canaanfo wo asaase no do.
Na Ewuradze yii kyerɛɛ Abram, na ɔsee dɛ, w'asefo na medze asaase yi mebɛma hɔn: Na hɔ na osii afɔrmbukyia maa Ewuradze a oyii noho kyerɛɛ no no.
Na ofii hɔ kɔr bepɔw a ɔwɔ Bethel no boka no do, na ɔbɔɔ n'asesee, dɛ Bethel dzi anee, na Ai dzi boka: Na osii afɔrmbukyia maa Ewuradze wɔ hɔ, na ofrɛɛ Ewuradze ne dzin.
Na Abram tuu kwan, dɛ ɔda ho ara rokɔ Pomu afamu.
Na ɔkɔm baa asaase no do: Na Abram kɔr Egypt kɛtsenaa hɔ ahɔhotsena; osiandɛ ɔkɔm no yɛɛ dzen wɔ asaase no do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aka kakra ma ɔahɛn Egypt no, ɔsee ne yer Sarai dɛ, minyim dɛ eyɛ ɔbaa a wo ho yɛ fɛw:
Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ Egyptfo no hu wo a, wɔbɛse dɛ, ne yer nye yi: Na woboku emi, na wɔagye ɔwo nkwa.
Meserɛ wo, se dɛ, m’akyerɛbaa nye wo: Ama osian wo ntsi eesi yie ama me, na osian wo ntsi me kra aatsena ase.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Abram baa Egypt no, Egyptfo no hun ɔbaa no dɛ no ho yɛ fɛw papa.
Na Pharaoh ne mbapɔmba no hun no, na wɔbɛkamfoo no kyerɛɛ Pharaoh: Na wobɛfaa ɔbaa no kɔr Pharaoh fie.
Na ɔyɛɛ Abram yie wɔ ne ntsi: Na onyaa nguan, nye anantwi, nye nsoasonyin, nye nkowaa, nye mfonabaa, nye nsoasober, nye efumpɔnkɔ.
Na osian Abram yer Sarai ntsi Ewuradze dze ɔyardom akɛse haaw Pharaoh nye ne fi.
Na Pharaoh frɛɛ Abram, na ɔsee dɛ, ebɛnadze na edze ayɛ me yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na annka annkyerɛ me dɛ wo yer a?
Ɔye dɛn ntsi na esee dɛ, m’akyerɛbaa a? Ma dɛm ntsi mefaa no nkyɛ morowar no: Dɛm ntsi afei, hwɛ, wo yer nye no, fa no, na kɔ wo kwan.
Na Pharaoh hyɛɛ nkorɔfo wɔ no ho; na wobegyaa ɔno, nye ne yer, nye dza ɔwo nyinara wo ɔkwan do.
13: Na Abram fii Egypt, ɔno, nye ne yer, nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara, nye Lot ka no ho, kɔr Pomu afamu.
Na Abram nyaa noho kɛsenara wɔ fiembowa, nye dwɛɛtɛɛ, nye sika mu.
Na otuu no kwan fi Pomu afamu araa kodur Bethel, beebi mbrɛ ahyɛse no n'asesee wɔ mu no, wɔ Bethel nye Ai ntamu:
Beebi mbrɛ afɔmbukyia a asɔpɔn no ɔyɛɛ no wɔ hɔ no wɔ no: Na hɔ na Abram frɛɛ Ewuradze ne dzin.
Na Lot a ɔnye Abram nam no so ɔwɔ nguan, nye anantwi, nye asese.
Na asaase no nnso hɔn dɛ wɔbɛtsena fakor: Na hɔn ahodze dɔɔ sõ, ma dɛm ntsi wɔhɔ mu tsena a ɔnnyɛ.
Na aperper baa Abram no mbowahwɛfo nye Lot no mbowahwɛfo ntamu: Na ber no nna Canaanfo nye Perizzifo tsetse asaase no do.
Na Abram see Lot dɛ, meserɛ wo, mma emma aperper mmba emi nye ɔwo ntamu, na mo mbowahwɛfo nye wo mbowatwɛfo ntamu; osiandɛ yɛyɛ enuanom.
Ana nnyɛ asaase no nyinara na ɔda w'enyim yi bi? Meserɛ wo, tse woho fi mo ho: Sɛ abankum na ebɛfa ɔno moso mbɔkɔ enyimfa: Anaa sɛ enyimfa ebɛfa ɔno moso mobɔkɔ abankum.
Na Lot maa n'enyi do na ɔhwɛɛ Jordan Tɛtɛrmu nyinara, dɛ no do beebiara wɔ nsu papaapa, ansaana Ewuradze no ture, ɔtse dɛ Egypt asaase, edze rokɔ Zoar.
Nna Lot faa Jordan Tɛtɛrmu nyinara; na Lot tui faa boka afamu: Na ɔbaako paa noho fii ne nyɛnko ho.
Abram tsenaa Canaan asaase do, na Lot tsenaa Tɛtɛrmu kurow no mu, na ɔdze n'asesee tutui araa dze kodur Sodom.
Afei Sodomfo yɛ ehuhufo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo kɛsenara tsia Ewuradze.
Na Lot paa noho wɔ Abram ho n'ekyir no, Ewuradze see Abram dɛ, Afei ma w'enyi do, na fi beebi mbrɛ ewɔ no hwɛ kwaamu afamu nye pomu afamu nye boka afamu nye anee afamu:
Na asaase a ihu no nyinara, medze bɛma ɔwo, nye w'asefo daa.
Na mebɛma w'asefo ayɛ dɛ asaase do huntuma: Na sɛ obi tum kan asaase do huntuma a, ɔno dze nna wobotum akan w'asefo no.
Soɛr, fa asaase no do wɔ ne tsentsen nye tɛtɛr mu; na ɔwo na medze bɛma wo,
Na Abram tutuu n'asesee, na ɔbae bɛtsenaa Mamre nsudur a ɔwɔ Hebrɔn no ne nkyɛn, na osii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ maa Ewuradze.
14: Na ɔbaa dɛ Shinarhen Amraphel, Ellasarhen Arioch, Elamhen Chedorlaomer, nye Goifo hen Tidal aber do no,
wɔnye Sodomhen Bora, nye Gomorrahhen Birsha, Admahhen Shinab, nye Zeboifo hen Shemeber, nye Belahen (Ɔnoara nye Zoar) yɛɛ ɔsa.
Woyinom nyinara bɔɔ mu wɔ Siddim bɔnsa mu (Ɔnora nye Nkyen Po no)
Mfe duebien na wɔsoom Chedorlaomer, na afe a otsia duebiasa no mu no wɔtseew etua.
Na afe a otsia duanan no mu na Cherdorlaomer n'ahemfo a wɔka no ho no bae, na wobokum Rephafo wɔ Ashteroth-karnaim, nye Zuzfo wɔ Ham, nye Emfo wɔ Shaveh-kiriathaim.
Na Horfo wɔ hɔn bepɔw Seir do, dze kodu Elparan a ɔwɔ sar no ho no.
Na wɔsanee, na wɔbaa En-mishpat (Ɔnoara nye Kadesh), na wɔbobɔɔ Amalekfo man nyinara, nye Amorifo so a wɔtse Hazazon-tamar no.
Na Sodomhen, nye Gomorrahhen, nye Admahhen, nye Zeiboifo hen, nye Belehen (Ɔnoara nye Zoar) fiir edzi; na wɔnye hɔn kɔbɔɔ enyim wɔ Siddim bɔnsa mu;
Elamhen Chedorlaomer, nye Goifo hen Tidal, nye Shinarhen Amraphel, nye Ellasarhen Arioch; ahemfo baanan no wotsia beenum.
Na hua amona wɔ Sodom nye Gomorrah ahemfo no guanee, na wɔtotɔree wɔ hɔ, na hɔn a wɔkae no guanee kɔr bepow no do.
Na wɔfaa Sodom nye Gomorrah ndzɛmba nyinara, na hɔn edzidzidze nyinara, na wɔkɔr hɔn kwan.
Na wɔfaa Lot, Abram no nua ba a ɔtse Sodom no, nye ne ndzɛmba, na wosii mu kɔree.
Na obi a ofii nsa bi bae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ Hebrewnyi Abram: Aber yi na ɔtse Amorinyi Mamre, Eshcol no nua, nye Aner no nua no no nsudur ho: Na woyinom wɔnye Abram akyekyer.
Na aber a Abram tsee dɛ wɔafa no nua ndɔmmum no, ɔdze no nkorɔfo a wɔatsetse hɔn a wɔwoo hɔn wɔ ne fie, ahaasa duawɔtwe tui, na wotsiiw hɔn araa kodur Dan.
Na ɔno nye no nkowaa kyɛɛ hɔnho mu baa hɔn do anafua, na wɔbɔɔ nɔn gui, na wotsiiw hɔn kodur Hobah a ɔwɔ Damascus n'abankum no.
Na ndzɛmba no nyinara sanee bae, naaso ɔdze no nua Lot, nye ne ndzɛmba nye mbaa no so, nye nkorɔfo no sanee bae.

Na ɔsanee fi Chedorlaomer nye ahemfo a wɔka no ho no hɔn kum no reba no, Sodomhen puel kehyiaa no kwan wɔ Shaveh bɔnsa mu (Ɔnoara no Bɔnsa mu) l8. Na Salemhen Melchizedek dze paanoo nye wenyin bae: Na ɔye Abɔso Nyankopɔn no sɔfoe.
Na ohyiaa no, na ɔsee dɛ, nhyira mfi Abɔso Nyankopɔn a ɔsor nye asaase yɛ nedze no hɔ nka Abram;
na nhyira nkã Abɔso Nyankopɔn a ɔdze w'atamfo ahyɛ wo nsa. Na ɔmaa ndzɛmba no nyinara mu ebupɛn dudu
Na Sodomhen see Abram dɛ, Fa nyimpa. No ma me, na woara fa ndzɛmba no.
Na Abram see Sodomhen no dɛ, mama me nsa do makyerɛ Ewuradze, Abɔso Nyankopɔn a osɔr nye asaase yɛ nedze no,
dɛ mennkɛfa ahoma anaa mpaboa-ahoma anaa biribiara a ɔyɛ wodze, amma aannka dɛ, Mayɛ Abram birɛmpɔn:
Gyedɛ dza mberantsɛ no edzi no nko, na nkorɔfo a wɔnye n kɔree no hɔn kyɛpɛn; Aner, Eshcol nye Mamre, ma wɔmfa hɔn kyɛpɛn.
15: Iyinom ekyir no Ewuradze n’asɛm baa Abram hɔ wɔ enyiwado-adzehu mu dɛ, mmannsuro, Abram: Emi nye wo kokyer nye w’akatua a ɔbor do.
Na Abram see dɛ, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, ebɛn adze na edze bɛma me, hwɛ dɛ minnyi ba na menam, na dza obedzi m’adze nye Eliezer a ofi Dammesek?
Na Abram see dɛ, hwɛ; emidze emmaa me asefo: Na, hwɛ, nyia wɔawo no wɔ me fie nye mo wungyanyi.
Na, hwɛ, Ewuradze n’asem baa no hɔ dɛ, nnyɛ oyi bi na ɔbɛyɛ wo wungyanyi; na dza ofi woara wo nson mu bɛba no, ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ wo wungyanyi.
Na ɔdze no puei, na ɔsee dɛ, Afei hwɛ ɔsor, na kan nworaba no kyerɛ dɛ ibotum akan a: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ w’asefo bɛyɛ nye no.
Na ɔgyee Ewuradze dzii; na obuu no ndzeyetsenenee maa no.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Emi nye Ewuradze a medze wo fi Chaldefo Ur wo Chaldea bae, dɛ medze asaase yi merebɛma wo ma edze aayɛ egyapadze.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, medze ebɛnadze na medze mubohu dɛ obɛyɛ me egyapadze?
Na ɔsee no dɛ, fa nantwiba a oedzi mfe ebiasa nye apɔnkyeber a oedzi mfe ebiasa nye odwanyin a oedzi mfe ebiasa, nye atamram, nye aborɔnomaba brɛ me
Na ɔdze iyinom nyinara brɛɛ no, na ɔpaapaa hɔn mu ebien ebien, na ɔdze afa-afa no totoo hɔn afa-afa no pɛn do: Na nnoma no dze ɔammpaapaa hɔn mu.
Na nnoma a wodzi nam bɛgyegyee mbowa fun no do, na Abram kaa hɔn.
Na aber a wi rokɔtɔ no, nda heii tɔɔ Abram do; na, hwɛ, sum kesɛnara no hu tɔɔ no do.
Na ɔsee Abram dɛ, Hu ampaara dɛ w'asefo bɛyɛ ahɔho wɔ asaase a ɔnnyɛ hɔndze do, na wɔasom hɔn; na wɔbɛtseetsee hɔn mfe ahaanan
Na ɔwodze ebɔkɔ w'egyanom nkyɛn asomdwee mu; wobesie wo wɔ nkɔdaaber pa mu.
Na mbasantsen a otsia anan no mu na wɔbɛba ha bio: Osiandɛ Amorfo emumuyɛ nnyae nnyɛɛ ma.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber am iwi kɔtɔree, na ɔyɛɛ sum no, hwɛ, fononoo a orunpun wusiw, nye ɔtsɛn a ɔredzɛw botwaa mu wɔ afa-afa no ntamu.
Da no ara mu na Ewuradze nye Abram dzii ahyɛmu see dɛ, W’asefo na medze asaase yi mama hɔn, ofi Egypt esutsen no ho kodu esutsen kɛse no, Euphrates esutsen no ho:
Kenfo, nye Kenizzfo, nye Kadmonfo,
nye Hethfo, nye Perizzfo, nye Rephafo,
nye Amorfo, nye Canaanfo, nye Girgashfo, nye Jebusfo.
16: Afei Abram ne yer Sara ɔnnwo mma no: Na ɔwɔ afonabaa Egyptnyi bi a ne dzin dze Hagar.
Na Sarai see Abram dɛ, Afei hwɛ, Ewuradze esiw me awoo kwan: Meserɛ wo, kɔ m’afonabaa nkyɛn: Annyɛ a mibenya no ho mba. Na Abram tsiee Sarai ne ndze.
Na Abram tsenaa Canaan asaase do mfe du n’ekyir no, Abram ne yer Sarai faa n’afonabaa Hagar, Egyptnyi no na ɔdze no maa no kun Abram awar
Na ɔkɔr Hagar nkyɛn, na onyinsenii: Na aber a ohun dɛ onyinsen no obuu no wuraba enyimtsia.
Na Sarai see Abram dɛ, Mo mfom da wo do; medze m’afonabaa motoo wo bo mu, na aber a ohun dɛ onyinsen no, nna obuu me enyimtsia: Ewuradze mbua emi nye ɔwo ntamu atsɛn.
Na Abram see Sarai dɛ, Hwɛ w’afonabaa wɔ wo nsamu, yɛ woara mbrɛ ehwɛ a oye no ara. Na Sarai nye no dzii no dzendzenndzen, na ofii n’enyim guanee.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe hun no wɔ nsunyiwa bi ho wɔ sar do, shur kwan munsunyiwa no ho a.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Sarai n'afonabaa Hagar, ifi henfa bae? Na ɔsee dɛ, mifi mo wuraba Sarai n'enyim na muruguan.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no see no dɛ, san kɔ wo wuraba hɔ, na kɛbrɛ woho adze wɔ n'ase.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no see no dɛ, mebɛma w'asefo adɔr menyamenya, ma hɔn dodow ntsi wɔkan hɔn ɔnnkɛyɛ.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no see no dɛ, hwɛ, enyinsen, na ɔbɔwo babanyin; na ebɛfrɛ ne dzin Ishmael, osiandɛ Ewuradze atse w'amandzehu.
Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛ asoaso-bɔyafo wɔ adasa mu; ne nsa betsia nyimpa nyinara, na nyimpa nyinara nsa etsia no; na ɔbɛtsena no nuanom nyinara hɔn enyim.
Na ɔfrɛɛ Ewuradze a ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ no no ne dzin, ɔwo yɛ Nyankopɔn a ihu: Na ɔkaa dɛ, Aso oha ara mpo mehu nyia ohu me yi?
Dɛmara ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bura no Beer-lahai-roi; hwɛ, ɔwɔ Kadesh nye Bered ntamu.
Na Hagar woo babanyin maa Abram: Na Abram frɛɛ ne babanyin a Hagar woo no no ne dzin Ishmael.
Na aber a Hagar woo Ishmael maa Abram no, nna Abram edzi mfe eduowɔtwe esia.
17: Na aber a abram dzii nfe eduokron akron no, Ewuradze yii noho kyerɛɛ Abram na ɔsee no dɛ, Emi nye Nyankopɔn Tumfo; nantsew m'enyim na dzi mu.
Na mebɛma m'ahyɛmu ada emi nye ɔwo ntamu, na mebɛma adɔr mbordo.
Na Abram dze n'enyim boom famu: Na Nyankopɔn nye no kasae see dɛ,
Emidze, hwɛ, m'ahyɛmu wɔ hɔ ma wo, na ebɛyɛ amanaman pii hɔn egya.
Nkyii so wɔnnkɛfrɛ wo dzin abram bio, na wobɛfrɛ wo dzin Abraham; osiandɛ amanaman pii hɔn egya na mayɛ wo.
Na mebɛma awo mbordo, na mayɛ wo amanaman, na ahemfo, efi wo mu epue.
Na mebɛma m'ahyɛmu etsim wɔ emi nye ɔwo nye w'asefo a wodzi w'ekyir no ntamu wɔ hɔn mbasantsen mu, na ɔayɛ daa ahyɛmu, dɛ mebɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ama ɔwo nye w'asefo a wodzi w'ekyir no.
Na medze asaase a etsenatsena do, yɛ do hɔho yi, Canaan asaase nyinara, mebɛma ɔwo nye w'asefo a wodzi w'ekyir, dɛ daa enyadze; na mebɛye hɔn Nyankopɔn.
Na Nyankopɔn see Abraham dɛ, na ɔwodze, sie m'ahyɛmu, ɔwo nye w'asefo a wodzi w'ekyir, wɔ hɔn mbasantsen mu.
Iyi nye emi nye hom nye w'asefo wodzi w'ekyir no ntamu ahyɛmu a hom nsie; hom mu mbabanyin nyinara wontwitwa hɔn twatsia.
Na wontwitwa hɔn twatsia; na ɔbɛyɛ ahyɛmu a ɔda emi nye hom ntamu asɛnkyerɛdze.
Na nyia oedzi nda awɔtwe no, wontwa no twatsia wɔ hom mu, mbabanyin nyinara wɔ hom mbasantsen mu, nyia wɔawo no wɔ fie, anaa wɔdze sika atɔ no wɔ hɔho biara hɔ a ɔmmfora w'asefo no.
Nyia wɔawo no wɔ fie no, nye nyia wɔdze wo sika atɔ no, wontwitwa hɔn honam mu dɛ daa ahyɛmu.
Na ɔbanyin a wonntwa no twatsia no, dɛm nyimpa no wontwa no mfi no nkorɔfo mu; ɔato m'ahyɛmu.
Na Nyankopɔn see Abraham dɛ, wo yer Sarai dze, mma mmfrɛ ne dzin Sarai, na Sarah nyɛ ne dzin.
Na mibehyira no, sɛnkyirii so me bɛma enye no awo babanyin: Nyew, mibehyira no, na ɔbɛyɛ amanaman hɔn na; aman ahemfo befi no mu apue.
Nna Abraham dze n'enyim boom famu, na ɔserewee, na ɔsee n'akoma mu dɛ, Aso wɔbɔwo ba ama nyia oedzi mfe ɔha? Na aso Sarah a oedzi mfe eduokron yi bɔwo?
Na Abraham see Nyankopɔn dɛ, Ao nkyɛ Ishmael eenya nkwa wɔ w'enyim:
Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Ampaara ampa, wo yer Sarah bɔwo babanyin ama wo; na ebɛfrɛ ne dzin Isaac: Na menye no bedzi ahyɛmu ma aayɛ daa ahyɛmu ɔdze ama n'asefo a wodzi n'ekyir.
Na Ishmael ho dze metsie wo; hwɛ, mehyira no, na mebɛma ɔawo, na ɔadɔr mbordo; ɔbɔwo etsitsir duebien, na mebɛyɛ no ɔman kɛse.
Na m'ahyɛmu dze mebɛma oetsim wɔ emi nye Isaac a Sarah bɔwo no ama wo afedan sisie ntamu.
Na ɔnye no gyaa kasa no na Nyankopɔn fii Abraham nkyɛn kɔr sor.

Na abraham faa ne ba Ishmael, nye hɔn a wɔwoo hɔn wɔ ne fie nyinara, nye hɔn a ɔdze ne sika tɔɔ hɔn nyinara, Abraham ne fifo mu mbanyin nyinara, na otwitwaa hɔn twatsia da no ara, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn kaa kyerɛɛ no no.
Na aber a wotwaa abraham twatsia no, nna oedzi mfe eduokron akron.
Na aber a ne ba Ishmael wotwaa no twatsia no nna oedzi mfe du ebiasa.
da no ara na wotwitwaa Abraham nye ne ba Ishmael twatsia.
Na ne fie mbanyin nyinara, hɔn a wɔwoo hɔn wɔ fie, nye hɔn a wɔdze sika totɔɔ hɔn ahɔho hɔ, wɔka no ho ma wotwitwaa hɔn twatsia.
18: Na Ewuradze yii noho kyerɛɛ no wɔ Mamre nsudur nkyɛn, ewia ketee a ɔtse n'asesee abowano no;
na ɔmaa n'enyi do, na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, mbarimba baasa gyina ne tsentsendo: Na aber a ohun hɔn no, otutuu mbirika fii n'aseesee abowano kehyiaa hɔn kwan, na ɔkotoow famu,
na ɔsee dɛ, Mo wura, sɛ afei menya w'enyim enyimnyam a, meserɛ wo, mma mmpa w'akowaa ho nnkɔ:
Na afei wɔmma wɔnkɛfa nsu kakra mbra, na hom nhohor hom anan ho, na wɔngye hom ahom wɔ dua yi ase:
Na monkɔ menkɛfa edziban trɔma bi membra, ma hom mfa nhyɛ hom akoma dzen; na n'ekyir no hom akɔ: Susuampa dɛ hom aba hom akowaa nkyɛn yi. Na wɔsee dɛ, Yɛ dɛ mbrɛ aka no ara.
Na Abraham kaa noho kɔr asese no mu Sarah hɔ, na ɔsee dɛ, Yɛ isiam pa etwadze ebiasa krado ntsɛntsɛm, fetsew, na to tatar.
Na Abraham tutuu enguan kɔr no mbowakuw mu, na ɔkɛfaa nantwiba a ɔyɛ mberɛw na oye, na ɔdze maa ɔsomfo; na ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm kɛyɛɛ edziban.
Na ɔfaa buter, nyɛ numfonsu, nye ɔnantwiba a ɔdze ayɛ ediban no, na ɔdze besii hɔn enyim: Na ogyinaa hɔn nkyɛn wɔ dua no ase, na wodzidzii.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, Wo yer Sarah wɔ hen? Na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ ɔwɔ asese no mu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Amopara dɛ mebɛsan maba wo nkyɛn afeda sisei; na, hwɛ wo yer Sarah benya babanyini. Na Sarah tsee wɔ asese abow a ɔwɔ n'ekyir no mu.
Afei Abraham nye Sarah enyin, na woedzi mfe ara yie; na adze a ɔyɛ mbaa no, etwa wɔ Sarah ho.
Na Sarah sereew noara no mu see dɛ, Aso mayɛ aberwa yi n'ekyir na mibenya enyigye, mo wura so ayɛ akɔdaa yi a?
Na Ewuradze see Abraham dɛ, ɔyɛ den ntsi na Sarah serewee see dɛ, Aso ampaara dɛ mayɛ aberwa yi mobɔwo ba?
Ana biribiara yɛ dzen ma Ewuradze a? Aber a mahyɛ no mebɛsan maba wo nkyɛn afedan sisei, na Sarah benya babanyin.
Na sarah sanee see dɛ, Mannserew bi; osiandɛ osuroi. Na ɔsee dɛ, Dabida, na eserewee.
Na mbarimba no soɛree fii hɔ, na wɔdaan hɔn enyi kɔr sodom so: Na Abraham nye hɔn kɔree kegyaa hɔn kwan.
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, Ana medze dza merebɛyɛ no mubosuma Abraham;
hwɛ dɛ ampaara dɛ Abraham ɔbɛyɛ ɔman a ɔso na ɔwɔ tum, na no mu wobehyira asaase amanaman nyinara?
Na mehu no, ama ɔaahye ne mba nye ne fifo a wodzi n'ekyir, ma woeesie Ewuradze no kwan, wɔayɛ pɛrpɛr nye atsɛmbu; ama Ewuradze dze dza ɔaka no wɔ Abraham ho no aaba no do.
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, osiandɛ sodom nye Gomorrah nkekamu ayɛ kɛse ntsi; na osiandɛ hɔn bɔn ayɛ dur dodow ntsi;
Afei mibesian makɔhwɛ kyerɛ dɛ ɔayɛ dɛ mbrɛ ne nkekamu a oedu me nkyen no tse no ewie; na sɛ ɔnntse dɛm so a, mubohu.
Na mbarimba no daan hɔnho fii hɔ dɛ wɔrokɔ Sodom: Na Abraham dze, ɔdaa ho ara gyinaa Ewuradze n'enyim.
Na Abraham twe piini, na ɔsee dɛ, Ana edze atseneneefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo nyinara bɔbɔ mu ahyew hɔn?
Egyangyabiara atseneneefo eduonum wɔ kurow no mu ɛ: Onnkesian atseneneefo eduonum a wɔwɔ mu no ntsi ma edze efir kurow no, na ebɛhyew no?
Iyi mpar wo dɛ ebɛyɛ no dɛm, dɛ edze atseneneefo bɛka ndzebɔnyɛfo ho eku hɔn, ma atseneneefo ayɛ dɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo; iiyi mpar wo: Nna asaase nyinara ɔtsɛmbuafo nnkɛyɛ dza ɔtsen bi a?
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, sɛ muhu atseneneefo eduonum wɔ Sodom kurow no mu a, ɔno osian hɔn ntsi medze mibefir bea no nyinara,
Na Abraham buaa na ɔsee dɛ, afei hwɛ, emi a meyɛ dɛtse nye nso, na mesi mo bo dɛ mebɛkasa akyerɛ Ewuradze yi:
Egyangyanbiara atseneneefo eduonum no hɔn mu enum fi mu ɛ: Ana osian enum a efi mu no ntsi ebɛsɛɛ kurow no nyinara? Na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ muhu eduanan enum wɔ hɔ a, mennkɛsɛɛ no.
Na ɔdaa ho ara kasaa kyerɛɛ no bio, na ɔsee dɛ, Egyagyanbiara eduanan na wobohu hɔn wɔ hɔ ɛ. Na ɔsee dɛ, Osian eduanan no ntsi mennkɛyɛ.
Na ɔsee dɛ, mma mma Ewuradze no bo mmfuw, na menkasa: Egyangyanbiara eduasa na wobohu hɔn wɔ hɔ. Na ɔsee dɛ, sɛ muhu eduasa wɔ hɔ a, mennkɛyɛ.
Na ɔsee dɛ, afei hwɛ, mesi mo bo dɛ mebɛkasa akyerɛ Ewuradze: Egyangyanbiara eduonu na wobohu hɔn wɔ hɔ ɛ: Na ɔsee dɛ, Osian eduonu no ntsi mennkɛsɛɛ no.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ao mma mma Ewuradze no bo mmfuw, na menkasa prɛko pɛ yi ara: Egyangyanbiara du na wobohu hɔn wɔ hɔ ɛ; na ɔsee dɛ, Osian du no ntsi mennkɛsɛɛ no.
Na Ewuradze wiee dɛ Nnye Abraham sanee baa ne tsenabea.
19: Na sor abɔfo beenu no baa Sodom ewimbir; na Lot tse Sodom abotsen abo: Na Lot hun hɔn, na ɔsoɛree kehyiaa hɔn kwan; na ɔkotowee dze n'enyim boom famu;

Na ɔsee dɛ, Afeii hwɛ, mo wuranom, meserɛ hom, wɔmman hom akowaa fie, na wɔnkɔsoɛ hɔ anafua yi nyinaraa, na hom nhohor hom anan ho, na hom bɔsoɛr anapaatu akɔ hom kwan. Na wɔsee dɛ, dabida; na yɛbɛtsena gua do anafua yi nyinara.
Na ɔserɛɛ hɔn ɔdzendo ara, na wɔmaan ne nkyɛn, na wɔkɔr ne fie; na ɔtoo hɔn pon, na ɔtoo epitsi ma wodzii.
Na wonnyae nnkɛdae no, nna kurow no mu mba, mekyerɛ Sodomfo no, wobotwaa ɔdan no ho hyiae, mbofra nye mpanyin, apaa nyinara mu nkorɔfo nyinara;
Na wɔfrɛɛ Lot na wɔsee no dɛ, mbarimba a wɔbaa wo nkyɛn anafua yi no wɔ hen? Yi hɔn brɛ hɛn,ma yenhu hɔn.
Na Lot puei kɔr hɔn nkyɛn wɔ abow no ano, na ɔtoow abow no mu wɔ n'ekyir.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Mo nuanom, meserɛ hom, mma wɔnnyɛ enumuyɛ a ɔtse dɛm.

Afei hwɛ, mowɔ mbabaa beenu a wonnhun banyin; meserɛ hom, wɔmma minyi hɔn mbrɛ hom, na dza homara hwɛ a oye no ara hom nyɛ hɔn: Mbarimba yi na mma wɔnnyɛ hɔn biribiara; susuampa dɛ wɔaba me hatsɛw no nwin ase yi.

Na wɔsee dɛ, gyina nkyɛn. Na wɔsee dɛ, Akowaa kor yi ɔbaaa hɛn amanyɛ, na ɔrohwehwɛ ɔayɛ ɔsɛndzifo: Afei yɛnye wo bedzi no bɔn akyɛn hɔn. Na wɔhyɛɛ ɔbarimba no do dzendzenndzen, mekyerɛ Lot, na wɔtwee pinii dɛ worubobubu abow no.
Na mbarimba no tseen hɔn nsa, na wɔtwee Lot baa hɔn nkyɛn wɔ dan mu na wɔtoow abow no mu.
Na wɔdze enyifua baa nkorɔfo a wogyinagyina ofi no n'abow n'ano no hɔn do, nkakraba nye akɛse nyina: Ma wɔfonaa dɛ wobohu abow no n'ano kwan.
Na mbarimba no see Lot dɛ, Ana ewɔ obiara so wɔ ha? Asew, na wo mbabanyin, na wo mbabaa, na obiara a ewɔ no wɔ kurow yi mu; yi hɔn fi ha.
Na yɛrebɛsɛɛ ha, osiandɛ hɔn nkekamu ayɛ kɛse wɔ Ewuradze n'enyim; na Ewuradze asoma hɛn dɛ yɛmbɛsɛɛ no.
Na Lot puei, na ɔkɛkasaa kyerɛɛ ne sewnom a wɔawarwar ne mbabaa no, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nsoɛr mfi ha; Ewuradze rebɛsɛɛ kurow yi. Na ɔyɛɛne sewnom no enyiwa do dɛ obi a oridzi fɛw.
Na adze kyee no, nna sor abɔfo no guu Lot do, dɛ, Soɛr, fa wo yer nye wo mbabaa beenu awɔwɔ ha yi kɔ; amma aannhyew wɔ kurow yi n'enumuyɛ mu.
Na okyinkyimii; na nkorɔfo no suoo ɔno nye ne yer nye ne mbabaa beenu no hɔn nsa mu; Ewuradze hun no mbɔbɔr ntsi: Na wɔdze no puei na wɔdze no besii kurow no n'ekyir.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔdze hɔn puei no, na ɔsee dɛ, Guan wɔ wo nkwa ntsi; mma mmbu wo kɔn ekyir, mma nngyina Tɛttɛr yi mu beebiara so; guan kɔ bepɔw no do, ɔno bɛyɛ na ahyew.
Na Lot see hɔn dɛ, Ao! ɔnntse dɛm, mo wura:
Afei hwɛ, w'akowaa enyaa w'enyim enyimpa, na ama w'ehumbɔbɔr a edze ehu me adɔɔ so, wɔ dɛ agye me nkwa; na munnkotum meguan makɔ bepɔw no do, ɔno bɛyɛ na mbusu no ato me ma meewu:
Afei hwɛ, kurow yi ɔbɛn dɛ muguan kɔ mu, na osuar: Ao, ma muguan nkɔ hɔ (Ana ɔnodze onnsuar bi?) na me kra benya nkwa.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, hwɛ, metsie wo wɔ adze kor yi so mu, dɛ monnkɔbɔ kurow a aka ho asɛm no.
Ka woho ɛ, guan kɔ hɔ; na mutunntum biribiara yɛ, gyedɛ edu hɔ ana. Dɛm nsti wɔfrɛɛ kurow no ne dzin Zoar.
Na aber a Lot dur Zoar no, nna ewia epue asaase do.
Nna Ewuradze tɔɔ brestɔn nye ogya fi Ewuradze hɔ wɔ sor guu Sodom nye Gomorrah do;
na ɔbɔɔ nkurow no, nye Tɛtɛr no nyinara, nye hɔn a wɔtse nkurow no mu nyinara, nye dza ofifir asaase no do no.
Na ne yer buu no kɔn ekyir wɔ n'ekyir, na ɔdaan nkyensiw.
Na Abraham soɛɛr anapaatu kɔr mbrɛ ogyinae wɔ Ewuradze n'enyim no?
Na ɔdaan n'enyi kɔr Sodom nye Gomorrah, nye Tɛtɛr no mu asaase no nyinara do na, hwɛ, asaase no do wusiw oow sor du fononoo wusiw.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, abor a Nyankopɔn sɛɛ Tɛtɛr no mu nkurow no, Nyankopɔn kaa Abraham, na aber a ɔbaa nkurow a Lot tse mu no, oyii Lot wɔ ɔsɛɛ no mu.
Na Lot fii Zoar fowee, na ɔkɛtsenaa bepɔw no do, na ne mbabaa beenu no ka no ho: Osiandɛ osuro dɛ ɔbɛtsena Zoar: Na ɔtsenaa ɔbo-tu mu. Ɔno nye ne mbabaa beenu no.
Na abakan no see ekumaba no dɛ, hɛn egya ayɛ akɔdaa, na ɔbanyin biara nnyi asaase do a ɔbɛba hɛn nkyɛn dɛ mbrɛ asaase nyinara yɛ no:
Bra, ma yɛmma hɛn egya nnom nsa, na yɛnye no nkɛda, ama yeenya hɛn egya no ho mba.
Na wɛmaa hɔn egya noom nsa anafua no: Na abakan no kɔr mu, na ɔnye n'egya kɛdae, na oennhu ne ndaa mu, eso no nsoɛree mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ n'adzekyeenyim no, abakan no see ekumaba no dɛ. Hwɛ, menye m'egya daa anafua yi: Ma yɛmma ɔnnom nsa anafua yi so; na kɔ mu, na egye no nkɛda, ama yeenya hɛn egya no ho mba.
Na wɔmaa hɔn egya noom nsa anafua no so; na ekumaba no soɛree, na ɔnye no kɛdae; na oennhu ne ndaa mu, eso ne nsoɛree mu.
Dɛm na Lot ne mbabaa beenu no nyina wɔnye hɔn egya nyinsenii.
Na abakan no woo babanyin, na ɔtoo no dzin Moab; ɔnoara nye Moabfo hɔn egya ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na ekumaba no, ɔno so ɔwoo babanyin, na ɔtoo no dzin Benammi: Ɔnoara nye Ammonfo hɔn egya ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi.
20: Na Abraham tuu kwan fi hɔ kɔr Pomu Afamu Asaase do, na ɔkɛtsenaa Kadesh nye Shur ntamu: Na ɔkɛyɛɛ hɔho wɔ Gerar.
Na Abraham kaa no wɔ ne yer Sarah ho dɛ, m'akyerɛbaa a: Na Gerarhen Abimelech somae ma wɔkɛ faa Sarah.
Na Nyankopɔn baa Abimelech hɔ wɔ anafua adaaso mu, na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, hwɛ, ɔbaa a akɛfa no ntsi ayɛ owufo ara nye no: Na ɔbarimba yer a.
Afei Abimelech nnyae nnkaa no: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, aso iboku ɔman tsenenee so?
Ana ɔno noara annse me dɛ. M'akerɛbaa a? Na noara, mekyerɛ ɔnoara so see dɛ. Mo nua a: M'akoma mu tsewee, nye me nsa ho no krɔnkrɔnyɛ mu, na mayɛ yi
Na Nyankopɔn see no adaaso mu, dɛ. Ɛhɛɛ, minyim dɛ w'akoma mu tsewee mu amma aannyɛ bɔn enntsia me: Dɛm ntsi na mamma annka no a.
Dɛm na afe fa ɔbarima no ne yer san kɛma no: Na ɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi, na ɔbɔsɔr ama wo, ma eenya nkwa na sɛ ammfa no annsan amma no a, hu no ampaara dɛ ibowu, ɔwo, nye dza ɔyɛ wodze nyinara.
Na Abimelech soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔfrɛɛ no nkowaa nyinara, na ɔkaa nsɛm yi nyinara wɔ hɔn aso mu: Na nkorɔfo no hɔn akoma tuu kɛsenara.
Nna Abimelech frɛɛ Abraham, na ɔsee no dɛ, ebɛnadze na ayɛ hɛn yi? Na ebɛnadze mu na mayɛ bɔn metsia wo ma edze bɔn kokroko aba emi nye m'ahenman do yi? Adze a ɔnnsɛ dɛ wɔyɛ na edze ayɛ me yi.
Na Abimelech see Abraham dɛ, ebɛnadze na ihunii, ma ayɛ dɛm adze yi?
Na Abraham see dɛ, osiandɛ modween dɛ, ampaara Nyankopɔn no suro nnyi ha: Na me yer ntsi woboku me.
Na ɔyɛ m'akyerɛbaa so ampa m'egya ba a, na nnyɛ me ni ba bi a: Na ɔbɛyɛɛ me yer.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Nyankopɔn maa mifii m'egya fie mikekyinii no, nna mesee no dɛ. Ayamuyie a fa yɛ me nye yi: Beebiara mbrɛ yebodu no, ka no wɔ mo ho dɛ, Mo nua a.
Na Abimelech faa nguan, nye anantwi, nye nkowaa, nye mfonabaa, na ɔdze maa Abraham, na ɔdze ne yer Sarah sanee maa no.
Na Abimelech see dɛ, hwɛ, m'asaase na ɔwɔ w'enyim yi: Tsena beebiara mbrɛ woara epɛ.
Na Sarah dze, ɔsee no dɛ, hwɛ, mama wo nua ndwetɛbona apem: Hwɛ ɔyɛ nkataenyim dze ma wo wɔ hɔn a wɔka wo ho nyinara hɔn mu; na enya dza ɔtsen wɔ nyimpa nyinara hɔn enyim.
Na Abraham sɔree maa Nyankopɔn: Na Nyankopɔn yɛɛ Abimelech nye ne yer, nye no mfonabaa edur: Na wɔwowoo mba.
Osiandɛ Ewuradze oesiw Abimelech ne fie efur nyinara mu kwan petsee wɔ Abraham ne yer Sarah ntsi.
21: Na Ewuradze bɛseraa Sarah dɛ mbrɛ ɔsee no, na Ewuradze yɛɛ Sarah dɛ mbrɛ ɔkae no.
Na Sarah nyinsenii, na ɔwoo baba nyin maa Abraham wo no nkɔdaaber mu, wɔ aber a Ewuradze kaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ no no mu.
Na Abraham too ne babanyin a wɔwoo no maa no no, nyia Sarah woo no maa no no, ne dzin Isaac.
Na Abraham ne ba Isaac dzii nda awɔtwe no, otwaa no twatsia, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no.
Na aber a wɔwoo ne ba Isaac maa no no, nna Abraham edzi mfe ɔha.
Na Sarah see dɛ, Nyankopɔn ama maserew; hɔn a wɔbɛtse nyinara nye me bɛserew.
Na ɔsee dɛ, woana na nkyɛ ɔbɛka akyerɛ Abraham dɛ, Sarah bɛma mba enumfo? Na mawo babanyin ama no wɔ no nkɔdaaber mu.
Na abofra no nyinii, na wotwaa no enumfo: Na da a wotwaa Isaac enumfo no, Abraham too pon kɛsenara.
Na Sarah hun Egyptnyi Hagar ne ba a ɔwoo no maa Abraham no, dɛ orisi atwetwe.
Dɛm ntsi ɔsee Abraham dɛ, yi afonabaa yi nye ne ba no edzi: Na afonabaa yi ne ba nnkɛnye me ba edzi adze, mekyerɛ Isaac.
Na asɛm no yɛɛ Abraham yaw papaara, osian ne ba no ntsi.
Na Nyankopɔn see Abraham dɛ, mma mma ɔnnyɛ wo yaw, osian abofra no ntsi, na osian w’afonabaa no ntsi; dza Sarah ka kyerɛ wo no nyinara mu, tsie ne ndze; na Isaac mu na wobɛfrɛ w'asefo.
Na afonabaa no ne ba no so mebɛyɛ no ɔman, osiandɛ oyɛ w’asenyi.
Na Abraham soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔfaa edziban nye nsu bɔdambɔ, na ɔdze maa Hagar, ɔdze sii no kɔn ho, nye abofra no, na ogyaa no kwan: Na osii mu, na okekyiin Beer-sheba sar do.
Na nsu a ɔwɔ bɔdambɔ no mu no sae, na ɔdze abofra no too ndua no bi ase.
Na ɔkɔree, na ɔkɛtsenaa ne tsentsendo wɔ ekyir kakra, bɛyɛ dɛ mbrsɛ wɔtow egyen a obodu: Na ɔsee dɛ, mma mma monnhwɛ abofra yi no wu. Na otsenaa ne tsentsendo, na ɔmaa ne ndze do, na osui.
Na Nyankopɔn tsee abofra no ne ndze; na Nyankopɔn no bɔfoe fi sor frɛɛ Hagar, na ɔsee no dɛ, ebɛnadze yɛ wo, Hagar? Mma nnsuro; na Nyankopɔn atse abofra no ne ndze wɔ mbrɛ ɔwɔ no.
Soɛr, kɛma abofra no do, na fa wo nsa suo no mu; na mebɛyɛ no ɔman kɛse.
Na Nyankopɔn buee n'enyiwa, na ohun nsubura bi; na ɔkɔree, na ɔkɛhyɛɛ bɔdambɔ no nsu ma, na omaa abofra no nsu ma, na ɔmaa abifra no nsu ma ɔnomee
Na Nyankopɔn dzii abofra no ekyir, na onyinii; na ɔtsenaa sar do, na ɔyɛɛ egyentonyi.
Na ɔtsenaa Paran sar do; na ne na kɔwaar yer wɔ Egypt asaase do brɛɛ no
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber no no mu na Abimelech nye ne safohentsitsir Phicol kasaa kyerɛɛ Abraham dɛ Nyankopɔn dzi w’ekyir wɔ dza eyɛ nyinara mu:
Dɛm ntsi afei, fa Nyankopɔn dzi nsew kyerɛ me wo ha dɛ ennkɛdaadaa emi, nye me ba, nye me mbanana: Na dɛ mbrɛ ayamuyie a medze mayɛ wo no tse no ara, ebɛyɛ ama emi, nye asaase a aba do ahɔhoyɛ yi.
Na Abraham see dɛ, mibedzi nsew.
Na Abraham twuuw Abimelech n’enyim, wɔ nsubura a Abimelech no nkowaa dze enyimpi gyee no ntsi.
Na Abimelech see dɛ, minnyim nyia ɔyɛɛ iyi: Na wo so annka annkyerɛ me, na nkyii so menntsee pɛn dɛ ndɛ.
Na Abraham faa nguan, nye anantwi, na ɔdze maa Abimelech; na hɔn beenu no dzii ahyɛmu.
Na Abraham yii nguankuw mu nguambaa aber esuon dze hɔn sii nkyɛn.
Na Abimelech see Abraham dɛ, na nguambaa aber esuon a eyi hɔn esi nkyɛn yi ase nye dɛn?
Na ɔsee dɛ, nguambaa aber esuon yi na ebɛgye no wɔ me nsamu ama ɔaayɛ dase ama me, dɛ mara na mutuu bura yi.
Dɛm ntsi ofrɛɛ hɔ Beer-sheba; osiandɛ hɔ na hɔn beenu nyina wodzii nsew.
Nna wodzii ahyɛmu wo Beer-sheba: Na Abimelech soɛree, nye ne safohentsitsir Phicol, na wɔsanee ba Philistiafo asaase do.
Na Abraham tsɛɛw tamarisk dua wɔ Beer-sheba, na ɔfrɛɛ Ewuradze, ɔdomankoma Nyankopɔn no, ne dzin wɔ hɔ.
Na Abraham yɛɛ hɔho wo Philistiafo asaase do nda pii.
22: Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom n’ekyir no Nyankopɔn sɔɔ Abraham hwɛe, na ɔsee dɛ, Abraham; na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye yi.
Na, ɔsee dɛ, Afei fa wo ba, wo ba kortonoo a edɔ no, mekyerɛ Isaac no, na kɔ Moriah asaase do; na fa no kɔbɔ ɔhyew-afor wɔ hɔ, wo mbepɔw no mu kor a mebɛkyerɛ wo no do.
Na Abraham soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔhyehyɛɛ n’asoaso, na ɔfaa ne mberantsɛ mu beenu kaa no ho, nye ne ba Isaac; na ɔpaa ɔhyew-afor ne nyena no, na ɔsoɛree, na ɔkɔr mbrɛ Nyankopɔn kaa kyerɛɛ no no.
Na ne ndaansa no Abraham maa n'enyiwa do, na ohun bea no wɔ ekyir noho ara.
Na Abraham see ne mberantsɛ no dɛ, hom nye asoaso yi ntsena ha, na yɛakɔsɔr, na yɛasan aba hom nkyɛn.
Na Abraham faa ɔhyew-afɔr no ne nyinaa no, na ɔdze soaa ne ba Isaac; na ɔfaa gya no nye sekan no kitsae; na hɔn beenu nyina bɔɔ mu kɔree.
Na Isaaac kasaa kyerɛɛ n'egya Abraham, na ɔsee dɛ, m'ɛgya; na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye yi, me ba. Na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, ogya nye enyena nye yi: Na eguambaa a wɔdze rokɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr no wɔ hen?
Na Abraham see dɛ, Me ba, Nyankopɛn noara bɛkyerɛ eguambaa a wɔdze no bɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr: Na hɔn meenu nyinaa bɔɔ mu kɔree.
Na wodur mbrɛ Nyankopɔn kaa kyerɛɛ no no; na Abraham sii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ, na osiesiee nyina no yie, na ɔkyekyeer ne ba Isaac, na ɔdze no too afoɔrmbukyia no do wɔ nyena no do.
Na Abraham tseen ne nsa, na ɔfaa sekan no dɛ ɔdze ruboku ne ba no.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe fii sor frɛɛ no, na ɔsee dɛ, Abraham, Abraham: na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye yi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Mma mmfa wo nnsa nnka abofra no, nkyii so mma nnyɛ no biribiara: Na afei na mehu dɛ isuro Nyankopɔn, susuampa dɛ ɔwo annkam me wo ba, wo ba kortonoo ntsi.
Na Abraham maa n'enyiwa do, na ɔhweɛ, na hwɛ, odwanyin a n'ambɛn ekosuo mbirikisi mu wɔ n'ekir: Na Abraham kɔre kɛfaa odwanin no, na ɔdze no hyɛɛ ne ba n'ananmu ɔdze no bɔɔ hyew-afɔr.
Na Abraham frɛɛ bea no ne dzin Jehovah-Jireh: Dɛ mbrɛ ebodu ndɛ ara wɔka se dɛ, Ewuradze ne bepɔw do na wɔbɛkyerɛ.
Na Ewurade no bofoe no fri sor frɛɛ Abraham bio,
na ɔsee dɛ, Maka moho ntam, Ewuradze na ose, osiandɛ ayɛ dɛm adze yi, na amfa wo ba, wo ba kortonoo no, annkam me nts:
dɛ nhyira mu a, mebɛma w'asefo adɔr dɛ ɔsor nworaba, na dɛ mpoano annhwea; na w'asefo bɛfa hɔn atamfo hɔn abotsen;
na w'asefo mu na wobehyira asaase amanaman nyinara; osiandɛ etsie me ndze.
Nna Abraham sanee baa ne mberantsɛ no nkyɛn, na wɔsoɛree, na wɔbɔɔ mu kɔr Beersheba; na Abraham tsenaa Beersheba.
Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom ekyir no, wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Abraham dɛ, hwɛ, Milcah so awo ama wo nua Nahor.
N'abakan Uz, nye no nua Buz, nye Aram n'egya Kemuel;
nye Chesed, nye Hazo, nye Pildash, nye Jidlaph, nye Bethuel.
Na Bethuel woo Rebekah: Baawɔtwe yi na Milcah woe maa Abraham no nua Nahor.
Na no nwewe a ne dzin dze Reumah no, ɔno so ɔwoo Tebah, nye Gaham, nye Tahash, nye Maacah.
23: Na Sarah no nkwaber yɛ mfe ɔha eduanu esuon; Sarah no nkwaber mu mfe nye yi.
Na Sarah wui wɔ Kiriath-arba (Ɔnoara nye Hebron), wɔ Canaan asaase do; na Abraham bae begyaam Sarah, na obosuu no.
Na Abraham soɛree fii no fun no enyim, na ɔkɛkasaa kyerɛɛ Hethmba no, dɛ,
Meyɛ ɔhɔho nye ɔmamforanyi wɔ hom nkyɛn, ma minsie mo fun mfi m'enyido.
Na Hethmba no buaa Abraham see no dɛ,
Mo wura, tsie hɛn: Eyɛ okunyin katakyi hwɛ hɛn mu: Hɛn asamandan mu dza woara epɛ no, sie wo fun wɔ mu; hɛn mu biara nnkam wo n'asamandan, na sie wo fun.
Na Abraham soɛree, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze maa asaase no do nkorɔfo no, mekyerɛ Hethmba no.
Na ɔnye hɔn kasae see dɛ, sɛ hom adwen nye dɛ misie mo fun fi m'enyi do a, wontsie me, na wɔnserɛ Zohar ne ba Ephron mma me,
ma ɔmfa Mechpelah ɔbu-tu a ɔwɔ no a ɔwɔ ne haban ano no mma me; ɔngye bo a odu ano ara pɛ, na ɔmfa mma me ma minnya efunsiebea wɔ hom finimfin.
Afei Ephron tse Hethmba no hɔn finimfin: Na Hethnyi Ephron buaa Abraham wɔ Hethmba no asomu, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔhɛn no kurow n'abotsen mu no nyinara asomu dɛ,
Dabida, wo wura, tsie me: Haban no medze mema wo, na ɔbo-tu a ɔwɔ mu no medze mema wo; wɔ me man mba hɔn enyim medze mema wo: Sie wo fun.
Na Abraham bɔɔ no mu adze wɔ asaase no do nkorɔfo no hɔn enyim.
Na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ Ephron wɔ asaase no do nkorɔfo no hɔn asomu dɛ, Mbom sɛ ibetsie a, ɔno, meserɛ wo, tsie me: Mebɛma haban no ne tsibo; gye no wɔ mo hɔ, na minsie mo fun wɔ hɔ
Na Ephron buaa Abraham see no dɛ,
Mo wura, tsie me: Dwɛɛtɛɛ shekel ahaanan asaase ɔnye ebɛn wɔ emi nye ɔwo ntamu? dɛm ntsi sie wo fun.
Na Abraham tsiee Ephron; na Abraham keer dwɛɛtɛɛ a Ephron bɔɔ dzin wɔ Hethmba no asomu no maa no, dwɛɛtɛɛ shekel ahaanan a ɔyɛ eguadzifo sika a wodzi no.
Nna Ephron ne haban a ɔwɔ Machpelah a ɔwɔ Mamre enyim no, haban no, nye ɔbo-tu a ɔwɔ mu no, nye nduaa a ɔwɔ haban no mu no nyinara a ɔwɔ ne hanoa nyinara bɔ aprɔw no, wosii no
maa Abraham dɛ enyadze wɔ Hethmba no hɔn enyim, wɔ hɔn a wɔhɛn no kurow n'abotsen mu nyinara enyim.
Na iyi n'ekyir no, Abraham siee ne yer Sarah wɔ Machpelah haban no mu ɔbo-tu mu wɔ Mamre enyim (Ɔnoara nye Hebron), wɔ Canaan asaase do.
Na haban no, nye obotu a ɔwo mu no Hethmba no sii no pi dɛ enyadze maa Abraham dɛ efunsiebea.
24: Na Abraham ayɛ akɔdaa, na oedzi mfe ara yie: Na Ewuradze hyiraa Abraham wɔ adze nyinara mu.
Na Abraham see n'akowaa, ne fie panyin a ɔhwɛ adze a ɔwɔ nyinara do no, dɛ, Meserɛ wo, fa wo nsa to m'aserɛ ase:
na mebɛma adze Ewurade, ɔsor Nyankopɔn nye asaase Nyankopɔn no, edzi nsew, dɛ ennkɛgye Canaanfo a metse hɔn mu yi, hɔn mbabaa mu bi yer ama me ba:
Na ebɔkɔ mo kurow mu, na akɛgye yer wɔ m'ebusua mu abrɛ me ba Isaac.
Na akowaa no see dɛ Ibi a ɔbaa no nnkɛpɛ dɛ ɔbɛka mo do aba asaase yi do: Ɔno dze memfa wo ba nsan nkɔ asaase a ifi do bae no do bio a?
Na Abraham see no dɛ hwɛ woho yie mma aammfa me ba annkɔ hɔ bio.

Ewuradze, ɔsor Nyankopɔn no a ɔfaa me fii m'egya fie, nye asaase a wɔwoo me do no, na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ me, dɛ, w'asefo na medze asaase yi mebɛma hɔn no; ɔbɔsoma no bɔfoe ma oeedzi w'enyim, na akɛgye yer wɔ hɔ abrɛ me ba.
Na sɛ ɔbaa no ammpɛ dɛ ɔbɛka wo do a, ɔno na wo ho efi me ntam yi mu: Me ba no ara na mma mmfa no nnkɔ hɔ bio.
