Na akowaa no dze ne nsa too nu wura Abraham ne serɛ ase, na odzii nsew kyerɛɛ no wɔ asɛm yi ho.
Na akowaa no faa no wura n'efumpɔnkɔ du, na osii mu kɔree; osiandɛ no wura ne ndzɛmba papa nyinara wɔ ne nsamu: Na ɔsoɛree na ɔkɔr Mesopotamia, ɔkɔr Nahor kurow mu.
Na ɔmaa efumpɔnkɔ no butubutuuw kurotsia nsubura no ho ewimbibaamu, aber a mbaa pue kɛsaw nsu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, mo wura Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, meserɛ wo, ma minhyia yie ndɛ, na yɛ mo wura Abraham ayamuyie.
Hwɛ, migyina nsubura yi ho; na kurow nu mu mba mbabaa pue bɛsaw nsu:

Na ma ɔmbra dɛ, akataasia a mebɛse no dɛ, Meserɛ wo, soɛ wo kuraba, ma monnom bi; na ɔbɛse dɛ, Nom bi, na mebɛma w'efumpɔnkɔ no nsu ma wɔaanom no: Ɔnoara na ma ɔnyɛ nyia eyi no ama w'akowaa Isaac; na ɔnam dɛm no do na mubohu dɛ ayɛ mo wura ayamuyie.
Na ɔbaa dɛ onnyae nnwiee kasa no, hwɛ, Rebekah a wɔwoo no maa Bethel a ɔyɛ Abraham no nua Nahor ne yer Milacah ne ba no, puei, na no kuraba si no kɔn ho.
Na akataasia no no hon yɛ fɛw dodow, ɔyɛ obaabun, nkyii so ɔbanyin biara nnhun no pɛn: Na osianee kɔr bura no mu, na ɔkɛshyɛɛ no kuraba ma, na ɔbaa sor.
Na akowaa no tutuu mbirika kehyiaa no kwan, na ɔsee dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma monnom wo kuraba mu nsu kakra.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Nom bi, mo wura: Na ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm soɛɛ kuraba no taa ne nsamu, na ɔmaa no nsu ma ɔnomee.
Na aber a owiee no nsu ma ma ɔnomee no, ɔsee dɛ, mebɛsesaw bi mabrɛ w'efumpɔnkɔ no so, dze ekudu dɛ wobowie nom.
Na ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm, na ohuee no nkuraba mu nsu guu ɔdaasee mu, na otutu mbirika kɔr bura no mu bio kɛsawee, na ɔsawee ma n'efumpɔnkɔ no nyinara.
Na obarimba no hwɛɛ no haa dɛ obohu kyerɛ Ewuradze ama n'akwantu no ayɛ prɔmprɔm anaa ɔnnyɛe.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, efumpɔnkɔno wiee nsu nom no, nna ɔbarimba no faa sika mpɛtsea a n'ano tow shekel fa, nye ne nsakɔnadze ebien a n'ano tow sika shekel du dze hyɛɛ ne nsa;
na ɔsee dɛ, Woana babaa nye wo? Meserɛ wo, ka kyerɛ me. Ana ɔkwan wɔ w'egya fie ma hɛn dɛ yɛbɔsoɛ hɔ?
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Bethuel a ɔyɛ Milcah ne babanyin a ɔwoo no maa Nahor no, ne babaa nye me me.
Nkyii so ɔsee no dɛ, yɛwɔ efuw nye mbowa edziban sann, nye dan a wɔsoɛ mu.
Na ɔbarimba no bɔɔ ne tsir adze, na ɔsɔɔr Ewuradze.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Nkyira nka Ewuradze, mo wura Abraham ne Nyankopɔn a ɔammpow n'ehumbɔbɔr nye no nokwar no wɔ mo wura ho: Emidze Ewuradze egya me kwan aba mo wura no nuanom fie.
Na akataasia no tuu mbirika kɔree, na ɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ ne na ne fifo dɛ mbrɛ nsɛm yi tse ara.
Na Rebekah wɔ nuabanyin, na ne dzin dze Laban: Na Laban fiir edzi tutuu mnirika kɔr ɔbarimba no nkyɛn wɔ bura no do.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ohun mpɛtsea nye nsakɔnadze wɔ n'akyerɛbaa ne nsa, na aber a ɔtsee n'akyerɛbaa Rebekah ne nsɛm no, dɛ, Mbrɛ ɔbarimba no kaa kyerɛɛ me no nye yi no no: Nno ɔbaa ɔbarimba no nkyɛn wɔ bura no do.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Bra fie, ɔwo a Ewuradze ehyira wo; ɔyɛ dɛn nsti na igyina kurotsia yi? Na mesiesie dan no, nye kwan ama efumpɔnkɔ no.
Na ɔbarimba no baa ofi no mu, na oyiyii efumpɔnkɔ no hɔn do ndzɛmba, na ɔmaa efuw nye edziban ma wɔdze maa efumpɔnkɔ no, na nsu dɛ ɔno nye mbarimba a wɔka no ho no dze ahohor hɔn anan h0.
Na wɔdze edziban besii n'enyim dɛ ondzi: Na ɔsee dɛ, minnkedzi, gyedɛ mabɔ m'amandzɛɛ ana. Na ɔsee dɛ, Bɔ ɛ,
Na ɔsee dɛ, meyɛ Abraham akowaa.
Na Ewuradze ehyira mo wura kɛsenara; na ɔayɛ kɛsɛ: Na ɔama no nguan nye anantwi, na dwɛɛtɛɛ nye sika, na nkowaa nye mfonabaa na efumpɔnkɔ nye nsoaso.
Na aber a mo wura ne yer yɛɛ aberwa no, nna ɔwoo babanyin maa mo wura: Na ɔno na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara ama no.
Na mo wura maa midii nsew dɛ, mma nngye yer wɔ Canaanfo a metse hɔn asaase do yi hɔn mbabaa mu mma me ba,
na kɔ m'egya fie, nye m'ebusua mu, na kɛgye yer ma me ba.
Na mesee mo wura dɛ. Ibi a ɔbaa no nnkɛka mo do.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, Ewuradze a menam n'enyim no, ɔbɔsoma no bɔfoe ma ɔaabɛka wo ho, na ɔama wo kwan do ayɛ dwudwoodwo; na ebɛgye yer wɔ m'ebusua mu, nye m'egya fie ama me ba:
nna wo ho befi me ntam mu, sɛ ekɔ m'ebusua mu a: Na sɛ wɔammfa no amma wo a, ɔno dze na wo ho efi me ntam mu.
Na mebaa bura no do ndɛ, na mesee dɛ, Ewuradze, mo wura Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, sɛ afei erema mo kwan a morokɔ yi ayɛ dwudwoodwo a:
Hwɛ migyina nsubura yi ho; na ma ɔmbra dɛ akataasia a obopue abɛsaw bi a mebɛse no dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma me wo kuraba mu nsu kakra ma monnom.
Na ɔbɛse me dɛ, ɔwoara nom bi, na mebɛkɛsaw bi mama w'efumpɔnkɔ so no: Ɔnoara na ma ɔnyɛ ɔbaa a Ewuradze eyi no ama mo wura ne ba.
Na ansaana murubowie kasa wɔ mo koma mu no, hwɛ, Rebekah puei na no kuraba si no kɔn ho; na osianee kɔr bura no mu, na ɔkɛsawee; na mesee no dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma monnom bi.
Na ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm soɛɛ no kuraba fii no kɔn ho, na ɔsee dɛ, nom bi, na mebɛma w'efumpɔnkɔ so bi ma wɔaanom: Nna monomee, na ɔmaa efumpɔnkɔ no so bi ma wɔnomee.
Na mibisaa no dɛ, Woana babaa nye wo? Na ɔsee dɛ, Nahor ba Bethuel a Milcah woo no maa no no, ne babaa nye me; na medze mpɛtsea no hyɛɛ no hwen na medze nsakɔnadze no hyehyɛɛ ne nsa.
Na mobɔɔ me tsir adze, na mosɔɔr Ewuradze, na mihyiraa Ewuradze, mo wura Abraham ne Nyankopɔn no a ogyaa me wɔ ɔkwan pa mu dɛ mebɛfa mo wura no nua ne babaa nkɛma ne ba.
Na afei sɛ hom bɛnye mo wura edzi no ayamuyie mu nye nokwar mu a, ɔno wɔnka nkyerɛ me: Oho so a, wɔnka nkyerɛ me: Ama maadan mafa enyimfa anaa abankum.
Nna Laban nye Bethuel buae na wɔsee dɛ, asɛm no fii Ewuradze hɔ: Yennkotum aka bɔn anaa papa akyerɛ wo.
Hwɛ, Rebekah na ɔwɔ w'enyim yi, fa no kɔ ma ɔnkɛyɛ wo wura ne ba ne yer, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze aka no ara.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Abraham n'akowaa no tsee hɔn nsɛm no, ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ famu maa Ewuradze.
Na akowaa no yii dwɛɛtɛɛ egudze, nye sika egudze, nye atar, na ɔdze maa Rebekah: Ɔmaa no nua nye ne na so ndzɛmba a ɔsom bo.
Na wodzidzii na wɔnomee, ɔno nye mbarimba a wɔka no ho no, na wotsintsiim hɔ anafua no nyinara: Na wɔsoɛɛr anapa no, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom ngya me kwan ma monkɔ mo wura hɔ,
Na no nua nye ne na see dɛ, ma akataasia no nye hɛn ntsena nda kakra, bɛyɛ dɛ dadu: Na n'ekyir no ɔaakɔ.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mma wonnsiw no kwan, osiandɛ Ewuradze ama mo kwan ayɛ prɔmprɔm; hom ngya me kwan ma monkɔ mo wura hɔ.
Na wɔsee dɛ, yɛbɛfrɛ akataasia no, na yeebisa n'anomu.
Na wɔfrɛɛ Rebekah, na wɔsee no dɛ, ana enye ɔbarimba yi bɔkɔ? Na ɔsee dɛ, Mobɔkɔ.
Na wɔgyee hɔn akyerɛbaa Rebekah, nye ne gyegyefo, nye Abraham akowaa no, nye no nkorɔfo no kwan.
Na wohyiraa Rebekah, na wɔsee dɛ, hɛn akyerɛbaa, yɛ na ma ɔpedu horow mpempem, na w’asefo ya hɔn a wokyir hɔn hɔn mbobow mfa.
Na Rebekah nye ne mbaawa soɛree, na wɔtsenatsenaa efumpɔnkɔ no do, na wɔkaa barimba no: Na akowaa no faa Rebekah, na ɔkɔr no kwan.
Na Isaac fi Beer-lahai-roi kwan do bae; osiandɛ ɔtse Pomu Afamu Asaase no do.
Na Isaac puee ewimbir kɔr haban mu kɔdwendwenee: Na ɔmaa n’enyiwa do, na ɔhwɛe, na hwɛ, efumpɔnkɔ reba.
Na Rebekah maa n’enyiwa do, na aber a ohun Isaac no, ofii efumpɔnkɔ no do dwirii.
Na ɔsee akowaa no dɛ, ebɛn ɔbarimba na ɔnam haban mu ribehyia hɛn yi? Na akowaa no see dɛ. Mo wura a: Na ɔfaa ne nkataenyim dze kataa noho.
Na akowaa no kaa adze a ɔyee nyinara kyerɛɛ Isaac.
Na Isaac dze no baa ne nã Sarah n’asesee mu; ɔfaa Rebekah, na ɔbɛyɛɛ ne yer; na ɔdɔɔ no: Na Isaac no werɛ kyekyeree wɔ ne nã no wu no ekyir.
25: Na Abraham waar yer kor so, ne dzin dze Keturah.
Na ɔwoo Zimran, nye Jokshan, nye Medan, nye Midian, nye Ishbak, nye Shuah maa no.
Na Jokshan woo Sheba, nye Dedan. Na Dedan ne mba nye Asshurim, nye Letushim, nye Leummim.
Na Midian ne mba nye Ephah, nye Epher, nye Hanoch, nye Abida, nye Eldaah. Woyinom nyinara ye Keturah ne mba.
Na Abraham dze dza ɔwɔ nyinara maa Isaac
Na nwewefo no mba a Abraham wɔ no dze, Abraham kyɛɛ hɔn adze; na ogyee hon kwan, boka afamu, fii ne ba Isaac ho, ber a ɔda ho tse ase no, ma wɔkɔr boka asaase no do
Na Abraham no nkwaber mu mfe a odzii nye yi, mfe ɔha eduosuon enum.
Na Abraham gyaa no sunsum mu, na owuu nkɔdaaber pa mu, akɔdaa a, na oedzi mfe pii, na wɔdze no kɛkaa no nkorɔfo ho.
Na ne mba Isaac: Nye Ishmael wosiee no wɔ Machpelah ɔbo-tu mu, wɔ Hethnyi; Zohar ne ba Ephron ne haban no mu, wɔ Mamre n’enyim;
haban no a Abraham tɔɔ no wɔ Hethmba nsamu no mu: Hɔ na wosiee Abraham nye ne yer Sarah.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Abraham no wu ekyir no, Nyankopɔn hyiraa ne ba Isaac; na Isaac tsenaa Beer-lahai-roi ho.
Afei iyinom nye Abraham ne ba Ishmael a Egyptnyi Hagar, Sarah n’afonabaa no, woo no maa Abraham no n’ebusuasantsen:
Na iyinom nye Ishmael ne mba hɔn edzin a wɔdze frɛɛ hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mbasantsen tsetsee: Nebaioth, Ishmael n'abakan; nye Kedar, nye Adbeel, nye Mibsam,
nye Mishma, nye Dumah, nye Massa;
Hadad, nye Tema, Jetur, Naphish, nye Kedemah:
Iyinom nye Ishmael ne mba, na iyinom nye hɔn edzin, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkuroba, nye hɔn nseraban notsetsee; etsitsir duebien dɛ mbrɛ hɔn aman tsetsee.
Na Ishmael no nkwaber mu mfe a ɔdzii nye yi, mfe ɔha eduasa esuon: Na ogyaa no sunsum mu na owui; na wɔdze no kɛkaa no nkorɔfo ho.
Na wɔtsenaa fi Havilah kodur Shur a ɔwɔ Egypt enyim no, edze roko Assyria afamu no: Ɔtsenaa no nuanom nyinara enyim.
Na iyinom nye Abraham ne ba Isaac n’ebusuasantsen: Abraham woo Isaac;
na Isaac dzii mfe eduanan no, nna ɔwaar Rebekah, Syrianyi Bethuel ne babaa a ofi Paddan-aram, Syrianyi Laban n’akyerɛbaa no.
Na Isaac serɛɛ Ewuradze maa ne yer, osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔbɔnyin: Na Ewuradze tsiee no nkotoserɛ no, na ne yer Rebekah nyinsenii.
Na mbofra no dzii aper wɔ no mu; na ɔsee dɛ, sɛ ɔtse dem a, ebɛnadze ntsi na metse ase? Na ɔkɔree kebisaa Ewuradze.
Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, Aman ebien na wɔwɔ wo yamu, Na nkorɔfo ahorow ebien na wɔbɛpaa hɔnho mu efi wo yafun mu; na ɔman no mu kor beyɛ dzen asen kor; na opanyin no bɔsom ekumaba no.
Na aber a ne nda dur dɛ ɔbɔwo no, nna hwɛ, nta wɔ ne yamu.
Na nyia odzi kan no ɔbae, no ho memennmen; no ho nyinara wɔ nhwi futuww dɛ nhwiatar; na wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Esau.
Na ɔno n'ekyir no no nua bae, na ne nsa dze Esau ne nantsir; na wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Jacob: Na bera wɛwoo hɔn no, na Isaac edzi mfe edusia.
Na bofra no nyinii: Na Esau yɛɛ ɔbɔmbɔfo a onyim ahayɛ papaapa, ɔhamunyi a; a Jacob dze ɔyɛɛ nyimpa brɛfo a ɔtsetse asese mu.
Afei Isaac dɔɔ Esau, osiandɛ odzii ne hanam no bi: Na Rebekah dɛɛ Jacob.
Na Jacob yɛɛ edziban bi: Na Esau fi hamu bae, na ɔatɔ bitsi:
Na Esau see Jacob dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma me adze memen yi bi na mindzi; na matɔ bitsi: Dɛm ntsi wɔdze to no dzin Edom.
Na Jacob see dɛ, Tɔn wo panyin ma me ndɛ da yi.
Na Esau see dɛ, hwɛ, migyina wuso: Na ebɛn mfaso na panyin yi; bɛyɛ ama me?
Na Jacob see dɛ, dzi nsew kyerɛ no: Na ɔtɔɔn ne panyin maa Jacob.
Na Jacob maa Esau boodoo nye lentil noae, na odzii na ɔnomee, na ɔsoɛree, na ɔkɔr no kwan: Dɛmara na Esau oemmbu ne panyin no hwee.
26: Na ɔkɔm sii asase no do, ɔsor nkan no no ɔkɔm a Abraham n'aber do no osii no. Na Isaac kɔr Philistiafo hɔn en Abimelech nkyɛn wɔ Gerar.
Na Ewuradze yii noho kyerɛ no, na ɔsee dɛ, mma nnkɔ Egypt; tsena asaase a mebɛkyerɛ wo no do:
Tsena asaase yi do dɛ, ɔhɔho, na menye wo bɛtsena, na mehyira wo; na ɔwo, nye w'asefo, na medze asaase yi nyinara mebɛma ntam a mekaa kyerɛɛ w'egya Abraham no etsim;
na mebɛma w'asefo adɔr dɛ ɔsor nworaba, na medze asaase yi nyinara mama w'asefo; na w'asefo; na w'asefo mu na asaase do aman nyinara wobehyira hɔn;
osiandɛ Abaraham tsiee me ndze, na odzii m'ahwɛdodze,me mbransɛm, m'ahyɛdze, nye me bra do.
Na Isaac tsenaa Gerar.
Na ehɔfo no bisaa no wɔ ne yer ho; na ɔsee dɛ, M'akyerɛbaa a: Osiandɛ osuroo dɛ ɔbɛse dɛ, Me yer a; na ɔsee dɛ, ɔbɛyɛ na osian Rebekah ntsi ehɔfo no eku me: Osiandɛ no ho yɛ fɛw.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔkyerɛɛr hɔno Philistiafo hen Abimelech hwɛɛ tokura mu, na ohunii, na, hwɛ, Isaac nye ne yer Rebekah woridzi agor.
Na Abimelech frɛɛ Isaac na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, ampaara wo yer a: Na ɔyɛ dɛn tsi na ekaa dɛ, ɔyɛ m'akerɛbaa yi? Na Isaac see no dɛ, osiandɛ mesee dɛ, bɛyɛ na mewu wɔ ne ntsi.
Na Abimelech se dɛ, ebɛnadze na ayɛ hɛn yi? Nkyɛ erebɛyɛ ma nkorɔfo yi mu bi nye wo yer ada, ma nkyɛ edze afɔdzi aba hɛn do.
Na Abimelech hyɛɛ nkorɔfo no nyinara, dɛ, nyia ɔbɛtsen ne nsa aka ɔbarimba yi anaa e yer no ampaara dɛ woboku no.
Na Isaac duaa wɔ asaase no do, no onyaa ɔha mbɔho wɔ afe no ara mu: Na Ewuradze hyiraa no.
Na ɔbarimba no yɛɛ kɛse, na oyinii ara kodur dɛ ɔyɛɛ kɛsenara:
Na onyaa nguankuw, nye anantwikuw, nye fifo kɛsenara: Na Philistiafo hɔn enyi beer no.
Afei mbura a n'egya Abraham n'aber do no n'egya no nkowaa tutui no nyinara Philistiafo no sisiiw no, na wɔdze dɛtse hyehyɛɛ mu amaama.
Na Abimelech see Isaac dɛ, fi hɛn nkyɛn kɔ; na ɔwo ewɔ tum dodow sen hɛn.
Na Isaac fii hɔ kɔree, na ɔkɔbɔɔ asese wɔ Gerar bɔnsa mu, na ɔtsenaa hɔ.
Na Isaac tutuu mbura a n'egya aber do no wotutui no fofor; osiandɛ Abraham wui n'ekyir no Philistiafo no sisiiw no: Na ɔfrɛfrɛɛ hɔn edzin dɛ mbrɛ n'egya dze frɛfrɛɛ hɔn no ara.
Na Isaac no nkowaa tuu bɔnsa no mu, na wɔkɔtoo mbasu bura wɔ hɔ.
Na Gerar mbowahwɛfo wɔnye Isaac no mbowahwɛfo perperee, dɛ, Nsu no hɛndze a: Na ɔfrɛɛ bura no ne dzin Esek; osiandɛ wɔnyɛ perperee.
Na wɔtuu bura fofor, na wɔperpeer ɔno so ho; na ɔfrɛɛ be dzin Sitnah.
Na ofii hɔ na okotuu bura fofor; na ɔnodze wɔamperper ho: Na ɔfrɛ nr dzin Rehoboth, na ɔsee dɛ, Na afei Ewuradze ama hɛn bea, na yɛbɔwowo wɔ asaase yi do.
Na ofii hɔ kɔr Beer-sheba.
Na Ewuradze yii noho kyerɛɛ no anafua no ara, na ɔsee dɛ, emi nye w'egya Abraham ne Nyankopɔn: Mma nsuro, na menye wo nam, na mibehyira wo, na osian m'akowaa Abraham ntsi mebɛma w'asefo adɔr.
Na osii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ, na ɔfrɛɛ Ewuradze ne dzin, na ɔbɔɔ n'asesee wɔ hɔ: Na hɔ na Isaac no nkowaa tuu bura.
Nna Abimelech nye ne nyɛnko Ahuzzath, nye ne safohen-tsitsir Phicol, wofi Gerar kɔr ne nkyɛn.
Na Isaac see hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom aba mo hɔ yi, hwɛ dɛ hom tan me, na hom eyi me edzi wɔ wɔ hom nkyɛn?
Na wɔsee dɛ, Yeehu no kotoo dɛ, Ewuradze nye wo nam: Na yɛsee dɛ, Ma ntam nda hɛn ntamu, mekyerɛ ɔno nye ɔwo ntamu a, na ma yɛnye wo ndzi ahyɛmu;
dɛ ennkɛyɛ hɛn bɔn bi, osiandɛ yɛnntsen hɛn nsa nnka wo, na yeegya wo kwan wɔ asumdwee mu: Afei ɔwo nye nyia Ewuradze ehyira no.
Na ɔtoo hɔn pon, ma wodzidzii na wɔnomee.
Na wɔsoɛɛr anapahema, na wodzii nsew kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔnho: Na Isaac gyaaa hɔn kwan, na wɔdze asomdwee fii ne nkyɛn kɔree.
Na ɔbaa dɛ da no ara, na Isaac no nkowa bae, na wɔbɛkaa no bura a wotui no ho asɛm, na wɔsee no dɛ Yɛato nsu.
Na ɔfrɛɛ no Shiba: Dɛm ntsi kurow no no dzin dze Beer-sheba ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na aber a Esau dzii mfe eduanan no, ɔwaar Hethnyi Beeri ne babaa Judith, nye Hethnyi Elon ne babaa Basemath:
Na wɔyɛɛ Isaac nye Rebekah awarɛhow.
27: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Isaac yɛɛ akɔdaa, na n'enyi do yɛɛ no kusukusu, na onnhu adze yie no, ɔfrɛɛ ne ba panyin Esau, na ɔsee no dɛ, Me ba: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Emi nye yi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, afei hwɛ, mayɛ akɔdaa, minnyim mo wu da.
Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, fa w'ahayɛdze, w'egyen-kotoku nye w'egyen, na kɔ hamu kɛfa hanam brɛ me;
na yɛ me edziban a ɔyɛ huam, dɛ mbrɛ mepɛ, na fa brɛ me, ma mindzi; na me kra nyhira wo ana mewu.
Na aber a Isaac rekasa kyerɛ ne ba Esau no, Rebekah tsee. Na Esau kɔr hamu dɛ orukoku abowa, na ɔdze aba
Na Rebekah kãa kyerɛ ne ba Jacob dɛ, hwɛ, metsee dɛ,
Kɛfa hanam brɛ me, na yɛ me edziban a ɔyɛ huam, ma mindzi, na minhyira wo wɔ Ewuradze enyim ansaana mewu.
Dɛm ntsi afei, me ba, tsie me ndze dɛ mbrɛ merehyɛ wo yi ara.
Kɔ nguankuw no mu, na kɛkyer mpɔnkyemba a woye ebien wɔ hɔ brɛ me: Na medze mebɛyɛ edziban a ɔyɛ huam mama w'egya, dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ:
Na edze akɛma w'egya, ma oeedzi, na eehyira wo ansaana oewu.
Na Jacob see ne nã Rebekah dɛ, hwɛ, mo nua Esua no ho wɔ nhwi, na emi mo ho yɛ monomonom.
Ibi a m'egya bɛkakã mo ho ahwɛ, na mebɛyɛ n'enyi do dɛ ɔdaadaafo; na medze mpaa mbra mo do, na nnyɛ nhyira a.
Na ne nã see no dɛ, Wo mpaa mbra mo do, me ba: Ɔwo tsie me ndze ara, na kɔ kɛfa hɔn brɛ me.
Na ɔkɔree na ɔkɛfae, na ɔdze yɛɛ edziban a ɔyɛ huam, dɛ mbrɛ n'egya pɛ.
Na Rebekah faa ne ba panyin Esau ne ntar fɛɛfɛw a ɔwɔ ne nkyɛn Wɔ fie, na ɔdze hyɛɛ ne ba kuma Jacob:
Na ɔdze mpɔnkyemba no hɔn nwoma duraduraa ne nsa ho, nye no kɔn monomonom no ho:
Na ɔdze edziban a ɔyɛ huam no nye boodoo a woesiesie no dze hyɛɛ ne ba Jacob nsa.
Na ɔbaa n'egya hɔ, na ɔsee dɛ, m'egya: Na ɔsee dɛ, emi nye yi; woana nye wo, me ba?
Na Jacob see n'egya dɛ, Emi nye w'abakan Esau; mayɛ dɛ mbrɛ ekyerɛɛ me no: Soɛr, meserɛ wo, tsena hɔ na dzi me hanam bi, ama wo kra ehyira me.
Na Isaac see ne ba dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn a wo nsa kaa no ntsɛm dɛm, me ba? Na ɔsee dɛ, osiandɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn maa mehyiaa yie.
Na Isaac see Jacob dɛ, pin ha, meserɛ wo, ma menkekã wo monhwɛ, me ba, kyerɛ dɛ me ba Esau noara nye wo anaa oho.
Na Jacob piin n'egya Isaac nkyɛn; na ɔkekãa no hwɛe, na ɔsee dɛ, ndze no yɛ Jacob ne ndze, na nsa no na ɔyɛ Esau ne nsa.
Na oennhu no, osiandɛ ne nsa ho wɔ nhwi, dɛ mbrɛ no nua Esau ne nsaho tse: Nna ohyiraa no.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye me ba Esau ara? Na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye no.
Na ɔsee dɛ, fa pin me nkyɛn, ma mindzi me ba ne hanam bi, ma me kra nhyira wo. Na ɔdze piin ne nkyɛn, ma odzii: A ɔdze nsã brɛɛ no, ma ɔnomee.
Na n'egya Isaac see no dɛ, Afei pin ha, na befew m'ano, me ba.
Na ɔtwee pinii, na ofeew n'ano: Na ohūaa n'atar no huam, na ohyiraa no, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, me ba ho hūa Tse dɛ haban a Ewuradze ehyira do no mu hūa:
Na Nyankopɔn mma wo sor bɔsu bi, Nye asaase ne seradze bi, Nye eburow nye nsa pii:
Aman nsom wo, Na amanaman nkotow wo: Yɛ wo nuanom do wura, Na wo na mba nkotow wo: Ndom nka hɔn a wɔdom wo nyinara, Na nhyira nka hɔn a wohyira wo nyinara.
Na obaa dɛ, Isaac wiee Jacob nhyira no, na Jacob fi n'egya nkyɛn firii ara pɛ nna no nua Esau fi n'ahayɛ baa fie.
Na ɔno so ɔyɛɛ edziban a ɔyɛ huam, na ɔdze brɛɛ n'egya; na ɔsee n'egya dɛ, Wɔmma m'egya nsoɛr, na ondzi ne ba ne hanam bi, ma wo kra nhyira me
Na n'egya Isaac see no dɛ, woana nye wo? Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mara wo ba, w'abakan Esau a.
Na Isaac no ho popoo kɛsenara. Na ɔsee dɛ, woana mbɔ na ɔakɛfa hanam, na ɔdze abrɛ me, ma medzi ne nyinara bi ansaana ereba, na mehyira no yi? Ampa, wobehyira no.
Aber a Esau tsee n'egya ne nsɛm no, osūu su kɛse a ɔyɛ wen, na ɔsee n'egya dɛ, Hyira mo so, mo so bi, ao m'egya.
Na see dɛ, Wo nua dze ndaadaa aba abɛgye wo nhyira kɔ.
Na ɛsee dɛ, Ana ɔno wɔmmfrɛ no Jacob bi? Iyi ka ho a ɔedzi me emim mpɛn ebien nye yi: Ɔagye me panyin; na, hwɛ, afei ɔagye me nhyira. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ana enngyaa me nhyira biara?
Na Isaac buae na ɔsee Esau dɛ. Hwɛ mayɛ no wo wura, na medze no nuanom nyinara mayɛ no nkowaa; na eburow nye nsã nna medze mawowaa no: Na ɔwodze, ebɛnadze na menyɛ memma wo, me ba?
Na Esau see n'egya dɛ, Aso nhyira kor pɛ na ewɔ, m'egya? Hyira mo so, mo so bi, ao m'egya. Na Esau maa ne ndze do na osūi.
Na n'egya Isaac buae na ɔsee no dɛ, hwɛ, mbrɛ asaase seradze nnyi no na ɔbɛyɛ wo tsenabea, Na mbrɛ ɔsor ɔbɔsu yɛ hɔ nã;
Na edze w'afõwa bɛtsena ase na ebɔsom wo nua; na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ egye woho a, ɔno beyi no kɔndua wɔ wo kɔn ho.
Na Esau taan Jacob wɔ nhyira a n'egya dze hyiraa no ntsi: Na Esau see n'akoma mu dɛ, Nda a wɔdze bosū m'egya no abɛn; afei muruboku mo nua Jacob.
Na ne ba panyin Esau ne nsɛm no wɔkɛkãa kyerɛɛ Rebekah; na ɔsomae ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ ne ba kuma Jacob, na ɔsee no dɛ, hwɛ, wo nua Esau ɔkyekye no werɛ, wɔ wo ho, dɛ oreboku wo.
Dɛm ntsi afei, me ba, tsie me ndze; na soɛr, guan kɔ mo nua Laban nkyɛn wɔ Haran;
na Kɛtsena ne knyɛn nda kakra, kɛpem dɛ wo nua n'ebufuw befi no mu;
kɛpem dɛ wo nua n'ebufuw bɛdan efi wo do, na no werɛ befir dza edze ayɛ no no; nna mobɔsoma ma wɔaabɛfa wo wɔ hɔ aba: Bɛyɛ dɛn ntsi na mobɔhwer hom beenu nyina da kor?
Na Rebekah see Isaac dɛ, mo nkwa afon me, osian Heth mbabaa ntsi: Sɛ Jacob war yer wɔ Heth mbabaa mu, dɛ woyinom a, wɔ asaase yi do mbabaa mu a, ebɛn yie na mo nkwa bɛyɛ ama me?
28: Na Isaac frɛɛ Jacob, na ohyiraa no, na ɔhyɛɛ no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Mma nnwar yer wɔ Canaan mbabaa mu.
Soɛr, kɔ Paddan-aram, kɔ wo nã n'egya Bethuel fie; na kɔwar yer wɔ hɔ wɔ wo nã no nua Laban ne mbabaa no hɔn mu.
Na Nyankopɔn Otumfo nhyira wo, na ɔmma wo, na ɔmma dɔr. Ama aayɛ aman asafo;
na ɔmfa Abraham nhyira nhyira ɔwo nye w'asefo a wɔka wo ho; ama eenya asaase a eyɛ do hɔho a Nyankopɔn dze maa Abraham yi.
Na Isaac gyaa Jacob kwan: Na ɔkɔr Syrianyi Bethuel ne ba Laban a ɔyɛ Jacob nye Esau hɔn nã Rebekah no nuabanyin no nkyɛn wɔ Paddan-aram.
Afei Esau hun dɛ Isaac ehyira Jacob, na oegya no kwan dɛ ɔnkɔ Paddan-aram nkɔwar yer wɔ hɔ; na orihyira no no ɔhyɛɛ no dɛ, mma nnwar yer wɔ Canaan mbabaa hɔn mu;
na Jacob etsie n'egya nye ne nã, na ɔkɔ Paddan-aram:
Na Esau hun dɛ Canaan mbabaa no nnyɛ n'egya Isaac enyisɔ no;
nna Esau sii mu kɔr Ishmael nkyɛn, na ɔkɔwaar Abraham ba Ishmael ne babaa Mahalath a ɔyɛ Nebaioth n'akyerɛbaa, kaa ne yernom no ho.
Na Jacob fii Beer-sheba, na osii mu kɔr Haran afamu.
Na ɔsoɛɛ bea bi do, na ɔtsenaa hɔ anafua no nyinara, osiandɛ iwi akɔtɔ, na ɔfaahɔ abo no kor, na osunii, na ɔdaa hɔ.
Na ɔsoo daa, na hwɛ atwer si asaase do, na n’etsifi pem sor; na hwɛ Nyankopɔn n’abɔfoe ridzi do mfowsian.
Na, hwɛ, Ewuradze gyina n’etsifi, na ɔsee dɛ, emi nye Ewuradze, w’egya Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, na Isaac ne Nyankopɔn: Asaase a eda do no, medze mebɛma ɔwo, nye w’asefo;
na w’asefo bɛyɛ dɛ asaase do huntuma, na ebɛtrɛ akɔ anee, nye boka, nye kwaamu, nye pomu: Na ɔwo nye w’asefo mu na wobehyira asaase do ebusua ebusua nyinara.
Na, hwɛ, menye wo nam, na mobɔhwɛ wo do wɔ beebiara a ebɔkɔ, na medze wo maba asaase yi do bio; na minnkegya wo hɔ, ekodu de mebɛma dza maka makyerɛ wo yi ayɛ hɔ.
Na Jacob fii ne nda mu nyanee, na ɔsee dɛ, ampaara, Ewuradze wɔ ha; na mennhu.
Na m’akoma tui, na ɔsee dɛ, nna ha yi yɛ hu ampa ɛ! Ha nnyɛ beebiara dɛ Nyankopɔn ne fie a, na ha nye hɛben abotsen no.
Na Jacob soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔfaa ɔbo no a osunii no, na ɔdze yɛɛ idum sii hɔ, na ohuee ngo guu do.
Na ɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Bethel: Na asɔpon no nkyɛ kurow no ne dzin dze Luz.
Na Jacob bɔɔ anohoba see dɛ, sɛ Nyankopɔn dzi m’ekyir, na ɔhwɛ mo do wɔ ɔkwan yi a murutu yi mu, na ɔma me edziban na midzi, nye atar ma mehyɛ,
ma meba m’egya fie bio wɔ asomdwee mu a, ɔno Ewuradze bɛyɛ me Nyankopɔn,
na ɔbo yi a medze mayɛ idum mesi hɔ yi, bɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ne fi: Na dza ebɛma me nyinara mebɛma wo mu ebupen du-du.
29: Nna Jacob sii no kwan do, na ɔbaa bokamba hɔn asaase do.
Na ɔhwɛe no, nna ɔnkɔhwɛ a, bura bi wɔ haban no mu, na, hwɛ, nguankuw ebiasa gugu ho wɔ hɔ; osiandɛ bura no no mu nsu na wɔsaw ma nguankuw no wɔnom; na ɔbo a ɔda bura no n’ano no so.
Na hɔ na nguankuw no nyinara wohyia: Na wopirew ɔbo no fi bura no n’ano, na wɔma nguan no nsu ma wɔnom, na wopirew ɔbo no hin bura no n’ano bio wɔ ne dabew hɔ.
Na Jacob see hɔn dɛ, Mo nuanom, hom fi hen? Na wɔsee dɛ, Yefi Haran.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nyim Nahor ne ba Laban a? Na wɔsee dɛ, Yenyim no,
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, No ho ye? Na wɔsee dɛ, No ho ye: Na, hwɛ, ne babaa Rachel na ɔnye nguan rɛba yi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, adze nnyae nsae, nkyii so aber a wɔka mbowa nnyae nndurii: Hom mma nguan no nsu ma wɔnnom, na hom nkɔ nkɛma hɔn edziban.
Na wɔsee dɛ, yennkotum, kyerɛ wɔaboaboa nguankuw no nyinara ano, na woepirew ɔbo efi bura no n’ano; nnsaana yeama nguan no nsu ma wɔaanom.
Na ɔnye hɔn da do rekasa no, nna Rachel ɔnye n’egya no nguan wɔbae: Na ɔno na ɔhwɛ hɔn.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jacob hun ne nã no nua Laban ne babaa Rachel, na ne nã no nua Laban no nguan no, nna Jacob twēe pinii, na okepireew ɔbo no fii bura no n’ano, na ɔmaa ne nã no nua Laban no nguan no nsu ma wɔnomee.
Na Jacob feew Rachel n’ano, na omaa ne ndze do, na osūi.
Na Jacob kãa kyerɛɛ Rachel dɛ, n’egya no nua nye no, na ɔye Rebekah ne ba: Na otutuu enguan na ɔkekãa kyerɛɛ n'egya.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Laban tsee n’akyerɛbaa ba Jacob ne nka no, nna otutuu enguan kehyiaa no kwan, na ɔyɛɛ no etuu, na ofeew n’ano, na ɔdze no baa ne fie. Na ɔkãa nsera yi nyinara kyerɛɛ Laban.
Na Laban see dɛ, ampaara, eyɛ me biew nye mo honam. Na ɔtsenaa ne nkyɛn bosoom.
Na Laban see Jacob dɛ. Ana osiandɛ mo nua nye wo ntsi, ebɔsom me kwa? Kã kyere me, ebɛnadze na ɔnyɛ w’akatua?
Na Laban wɔ mbabaa beenu: Panyin dze no ne dzin dze Leah, na ekumaba no ne dzin dze Rachel.
Na Leah n’enyiwa yɛ meamea; na Rachel dze no ho yɛ fɛw na n’enyim wɔ nyam.
Na Jacob dɔɔ Rachel; na ɔsee dɛ, wo ba kuma Rachel ntsi mobɔsom wo mfe esuon.
Na Laban see dɛ, Oye dɛ medze no mebɛma wo sen dɛ medze no mebɛma ɔbarimba bi: Enye me ntsena.
Na Rachel ntsi Jacob soom mfe esuon; na ɔdɔ a ɔdɔ no ntsi, ɔyɛɛ n’enyi do dɛ nda kumaabi.
Na Jacob see Laban dɛ, fa me yer ma me, na me nda asõ, ma monkɔ ne nkyɛn.
Na Laban hyiahyiaa ekuromfo nyinara, na ɔtoo pon.
Na ɔbaa dɛ anafua no nna ɔfaa ne babaa Leah, na ɔdze no brɛɛ no; na ɔkɔr ne nkyɛn.
Na Laban dze n’abaawa Zilpah maa no babaa Leah abaawa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ adze kyee no, nna nkɔhwɛ a saana leah a: Na ɔsee Laban dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ayɛ me yi? Nnyɛ Rachel nsti na mosoom wo bi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na adandaa me yi?
Na Laban see dɛ, Hɛn ha wɔnnyɛ no dɛm; wɔmmfa ekumaba no mma awar ana wɔdze abakan no ama.
ma oyi ne dapɛn nsõ, na yɛdze ɔno so bɛma wo wɔ ɔsom a ebɔsom me mfe esuon fofor bio ntsi.
Na Jacob yɛɛ dɛm, na ɔmaa ne dapɛn kɔsõe: Na ɔdze ne babaa Rachel so maa no awar.
Na Laban dze n’abaawa Bilhah maa ne babaa Rachel abaawa.
Na ɔkɔr Rachel so nkyɛn, na ɔdɔɔ Rachel so seen Leah na ɔsoom no mfe esuon fofor bio.
Na Ewuradze hun dɛ wɔtan Leah no, nna obuee n’awookwan: Na Rachel dze, ɔbɔnyin a.
Na Leah nyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Reuben: Na ɔsee dɛ, Osiandɛ Ewuradze ahwɛ m’amandzehu; na afei dze mo kun bɔdɔ me.
Na onyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin; na ɔsee dɛ, osiandɛ Ewuradze atse dɛ wɔtan me ntsi, na ɔdze ɔba yi so ama me: Na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Simeon.
Na onyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin; na ɔsee dɛ, afei na mo kun nye me bɛka, osiandɛ mawo mbabanyin baasa ama no: Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Levi.
Na onyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin: Na ɔsee dɛ, afei mibeyi Ewuradze ayɛw: Dɛm ntsi ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Judah; na ogyaa awoo.
30: Na Rachel hun dɛ ɔnnwo ba mma Jacob no, rachel n'enyi beer no nua no; na ɔsee Jacob dɛ, ma me mba, ɔno mubowu.
Na Jacob no bo fuuw Rachel: Na ɔsee dɛ, ana midzi Nyankopɔn a ɔakam wo yamu mba no ananmu?
Na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, m’abaawa Bilhah nye yi, kɔ ne nkyɛn; ama ɔaawo egu me serɛ do, na mo so menam no do meenya mba.
Na ɔdze n’abaawa Bilhah maa no awar: Na Jacob kɔr ne nkyɛn.
Na Bilhah nyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin maa Jacob.
Na Rachel see dɛ, Nyankopɔn edzi m'asɛm ama me, na eso oetsie me ndze, na ɔama me babanyin: Dɛm ntsi ofrɛɛ ne dzin Dan.
Na Rachel n’abaawa Bilhah nyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin a otsía ebien maa Jacob.
Na Rachel see dɛ, Menye m’akyerɛbaa edzi aper a no mu yɛ dzen, na medzi nyim: Na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Naphtali.
Na aber Leah hun dɛ oegyaa awoo no, ɔfaa n'abaawa Zilpah, na ɔdze no maa Jacob awar.
Na Leah n'abaawa Zilpha woo babanyin maa Jacob.
Na Leah see dɛ, Siar aba! Na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Gad.
Na Leah n'baawa Zilpah woo babanyin a otsía ebien maa Jacob.
Na Leah see dɛ, ahomkanyi nye me! Na mbabaa bɛfrɛ me ɔhomkanyi: Na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Asher.
Na ewifua twaber mu no, Reuben kɔr hamu kohun mandrake, na ɔdze brɛɛ ne nã Leah. Nna Rachel see Leah dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma me wo ba ne mandrake yi bi.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ana ɔyɛ asɛm ba dɛ egye mo kun? Na me ba ne mandrake yi so erebɛgye? Na Rachel see dɛ, naa ma ɔnye wo nda anafua yi osian wo ba ne mandrake no nsti.
Na Jacob fi hamu ewimbir ɔreba no, nna Leah puei kehyiaa no kwan, na ɔsee dɛ, bra me nkyɛn na ampaara medze me ba ne mandrake mabɔ wo paa. Na ɔnye no daa anafua no.
Na Nyankopɔn tsiee Leah, na onyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin a otsìa enum maa Jacob.
Na Leah see dɛ, Nyankopɔn dze m'apaabɔdze ama me, osiandɛ medze m'abaawa memaa mo kun awar: Na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Issachar.
Na Leah nyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin a otsìa esia maa Jacob.
Na Leah see dɛ, Nyankopɔn ama me bɛtsena, osiandɛ mawo mbabanyin beesia mama no; na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Zebulun.
Na n'ekyir no ɔwoo babaa, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Dinah.
Na Nyankopɔn kaa Rachel, na Nyankopɔn tsiee no, na obuee n'awoo kwan.
Na onyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn eyi m'ahorohoraa:
Na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Joseph, see dɛ, Ewuradze mma me ɔba kor so nka ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Rachel woo Joseph no, nna Jacob see Laban dɛ, gya me kwan ma monkɔ mbrɛ mifi, na me man mu.
Fa me yernom nye me mba a hɔn ntsi masom wo no ma me, na ma monkɔ: Na ɔwoara nyim mo som a medze masom wo.
Na Laban see no dɛ, Sɛ afei menya w'enyim enyimnyam a, tsintsim: Na mehu dɛ ɔwo ntsi na Ewuradze ehyira me.
Na ɔsee dɛ, kyerɛ me w'akatua, na mebɛma.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, ɔwoara nyim beebi mbrɛ mesi na mason wo, na beebi mbrɛ wo mbowakuw esi na wɔaye wɔ me nsamu.
Na mebae no, nna kumaabi na ewɔ, nna ɔador ɔayɛ pii yi; na Ewuradze ehyira wo wɔ beebiara a mefae: Na afei aber bɛn na mobɔhwɛ mara me fie so?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na memma wo? Na Jacob see dɛ, mma mma me hwee: Sɛ ebɛyɛ iyi ama me a, ɔno mebɛnyɛn wo nguan bio, na mahwɛ hɔn.

Ndɛ mebɛfa wo nguan nyinara mu, na meyiyi nguan a hɔn ho yɛ woranworan nye ntokowa etuntum a wɔwɔ nguantsen no mu nyinara, nye mpɔnkye no dza hɔn ho yɛ ntokowa nye woranworan no afi mu; na hɔn a wɔtse dɛm no na ɔnyɛ m'apaabɔdze.

Ama dakyee aba m'apaabɔdze a ɔda w'enyim yi do a, me ndzeyɛtseenee eebua ama; mpɔnkye no mu dza hɔn ho nnyɛ woranworan nye ntokowa ntokowa no, na nguantsen no hɔn mu dza wɔnnyɛ etuntum no nyinara, ɔno na sɛ wohun wɔ wɔ mo hɔ a wombu no adzewiadze.
Na Laban see dɛ, hwɛ, ka mo nko a nkyɛ dza aka no ara ɔbɛyɛ dɛmara.

Na da no ara oyiyii mpɔnkyenyin a hɔn ho yɛ nsensanee nsensanee nye ntokowa no; nye mpɔnkyeber a hɔn ho yɛ woranworannye ntokowa ntokowa no nyinara, dza fufuw wɔ hɔn ho no nyinara, nye ndzeyɛtseenee no hɔn mu etuntum no nyinara, na ɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ ne mbabanyin nsa;
na ɔmaa ndaansa kwan daa ɔnoara nye Jacob ntamu: Na Jacob ayɛɛn Laban no nguan nkaa no.
Na Jacob faa poplar dua nye almond dua nye plane dua mbaa momon, na oyiyii ho nsema efufuw, na ɔmaa mbaa no ho efufuw no puepuei.
Na ɔdze mbaa no a oyiyii ho no guu nguan no hɔn tsentsen do wɔ nsuka a ɔwɔ mbowa nsu ndaasee mu mbrɛ nguan no ba hɔ bɔnom nsu no mu; na wɔba bɔnom nsu a nna wonyinsenyinsen.
Na nguan no nyinsenyinsenii wɔ mbaa no emyim, na nguan no wowoo nsensanee nsensanee, woranworan, nye ntokowa ntokowa.

Na Jacob paa nguambaa no, na ɔmaa nguan no hɔn enyim kɔr Laban nguan no mu nsensanee nsensanee nye etuntum no nyinara hɔn do; na ɔyɛɛ narankasa no nguankuw wɔ nkyɛn, na ɔammfa ammfora Laban no nguan no mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber biara sɛ nguan a hɔn ho yɛ dzen no wonyinsenyinsen a, nna Jacob dze mbaa no ekogu nguan no hɔn enyim wɔ nsuka no mu, ama woeenyinsenyinsen mbaa no do;
na sɛ nguan no wɔyɛ mberɛw dze a, ɔno ɔmmfa nngu mu: Dɛm ntsi hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw no nye Laban dze, na hɔn a hɔn ho yɛ dzen no nye Jacob dze.
Na ɔbarimba no yɛɛ kɛsenara, na onyaa nguan pii, nye mfonabaa nye nkowaa, nye efumpɔnkɔ nye nsoaso.
31: Na ɔtsee Laban ne mbabanyin nsɛm a wɔkae, dɛ, Jacob afa dza ɔyɛ hɛn egya dze nyinara; na dza ɔyɛ hɛn egya dze na ɔdze enya enyimnyam yi nyinara.
Na Jacob hwɛɛ Laban no ntɔn mu, na hwɛ, ɔnntse dɛ mbrɛ nkyɛ nkan no ɔtse wɔ no do so.
Na Ewuradze see Jacob dɛ, san kɔ w'egyanom asaase do, na w'ebusua mu, na mibedzi w'ekyir.
Na Jacob somae na wɔkɛfrɛɛ Rachel nye Leah ma wɔbaa hamu wɔ no nguan no nkyɛn,
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, muhu hom egya no ntɔn mu dɛ ɔnntse me dɛ nkan no; na m'egya ne Nyankopɔn na oedzi m'ekyir.
Na homara nyim dɛ m'ahoɔdzen nyinara na medze masom hom egya.
Na hom ogya adaadanme, na ɔasakyer m'akatua mpɛn du; na Nyankopɔn na ɔamma no kwan ma ɔannyɛ me bɔn.

Sɛ ɔse dɛ, Hɔn a bɔn ho yɛ woranworan no na ɔnyɛ w'akatua a, ɔno nguan no nyinara wowo woranworan: Na sɛ ɔse dɛ, Hɔn a hɔn ho yɛ nsensanee nsensanee na ɔnyɛ w'akatua a, ɔno nguan no nyinara wowo nsensanee nsensanee.
Dɛm na Nyankopɔn agye hom egya no mbowa, na ɔdze hɔn ama me.

Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a nguan no nyinsenyinsenii no, nna memaa m'enyiwa do, na muhun no wɔ adaaso mu, na, hwɛ, ndwanyin a wɔfow nguan no nyinara hɔn ho yɛ nsensanee nsensanee, woranworan, nye ntokowa ntokowa.
Na Nyankopɔn no bɔfoe see me wɔ adaaso mu dɛ, Jacob: Na mesee dɛ, emi nye yi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, afei ma w'enyiwa do, na hwɛ, ndwanyin a wɔfow nguan no nyinara hɔn ho yɛ nsensanee nsensanee, woranworan, nye ntokowa ntokowa: Na mehu dza Laban reyɛ wo nyinara.
Emi nye Bethel Nyankopɔn, beebi mbrɛ eseraa idum ho no a, beebi mbrɛ ebɔɔ me anohoba no a; afei soɛr fi asaase yi do, na san kɔ w'awobea asaase do.
Na Rachel nye Leah buae na wɔsee no dɛ, ana kyɛpɛn anaa egyapadze da ho wɔ hɔ ma hɛn wɔ hɛn egya fie a?
Ana ommbuu hɛn ahɔho bi a? Osiandɛ ɔatɔn hɛn, na eso oedzi hɛn tsisika koraa.
Osiandɛ ahonyadze a Nyankopɔn agye no hɛn agya hɔ nyinara hɛn nye hɛn mba dze a: Na afei, dza Nyankopɔn akã akyerɛ wo no nyinara, yɛ.
Nna Jacob soɛree, na ɔfaa ne mba nye ne yernom tsenatsenaa efumpɔnkɔ do;
na ɔfaa no mbowa nyinara, nye n'ahodze a onyae nyinara, mbowa a onyae wɔ Paddan-aram no, sii mu dɛ ɔrokɔ n'egya Isaac nkyɛn wɔ Canaan asaase do.
Nna Laban kɔ rukotwitwa no nguan ho nhwi: Na Rachel wiaa n'egya no kum.
Na Jacob wiaa noho guanee; wɔ dɛ ɔaankã annkyerɛ Laban, Syrianyi no.
Nna ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara guanee; na ɔsoɛree, na otwaa Esutsen no, na ɔmaa n'enyi kɔr Gilead bepɔw do.
Na ne ndaansa no wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Laban dɛ Jacob eguan.
Na ɔfaa no nnuanom kaa noho, na otsiiw no nda esuon kwan; na ɔbɔtoo no Gilead bepɔw do.
Na Nyankopɔn baa Laban, Syrianyi no hɔ wɔ anafua adaasa mu, na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ wo ho yie amma aankasa papa anaa bɔn annkyerɛ Jacob.
Na Laban too Jacob. Nna Jacob abɔ n'asesee wɔ bepɔw no do: Na Laban ɔnye no nuanom so bobɔɔ hɔndze wɔ Gilead bepɔw do.
Na Laban see Jacob dɛ, ebɛnadze na ayɛ yi, na ewia woho guan me, na asoa me mbabaa dze hɔn rokɔ dɛ hɔn a wɔdze mfõwa afa hɔn ndɔmmum yi?
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na isumae guanee, na iwiaa woho fii me nkyɛn; na annkã annkyerɛ me, ma maammfa enyigye na ɔnye ndwom, mpintsin na ɔnye nsanku menngya wo kwan;
na amma meemmfew me mbabanyin nye me mbabaa hɔn ano? Afei dze ayɛ nkwaseadze.
Mowɔ tum dɛ nkyɛ menye wo dzi no bɔn: Na ndeda anafua w'egya ne Nyankopɔn kasaa kyerɛɛ me dɛ, Hwɛ woho yie, mma aannkasa papa anaa bɔn annkyerɛ Jacob.
Na afei kaansa afe w'egya fie dodoodow ma ehia dɛ ekɔ mpo a, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ewia m'enyame yi?
Na Jacob buae na ɔsee Laban dɛ, osiandɛ musuroi: Na mesee dɛ, ɔbɛyɛ na eregye wo mbabaa wɔ me nsamu enyimpi do.
Nyimpa biara a ibohu w'enyame wɔ no hɔ no, onyii no ɔnnkɛtsena ase: Hɛn nuanom hɔn enyim na yi ara hwehwɛ dza ɔyɛ wodze wɔ me nkyɛn, na fa w'adze. Na Jacob nnyim dɛ Rachel na oewia.
Na Laban kɔr Jacob n'asesee mu, nye Leah n'asesee mu, nye mbaawa beenu no hɔn asesee mu; na oennhu. Na ofii Leah n'asesee mu, na ɔkɛhɛɛn Rachel n'asesee mu.
Afei Rachel afa kum no, na ɔdze ahyhyɛ efumpɔnkɔ n'adze a wɔdze hyehyɛ no mu, na ɔatsena do. Na Laban kekãa asese no no ho nyinara, na oennhu.
Na ɔsee n'egya dɛ, mma mma ɔnnyɛ mo wura ebufuw dɛ munntum monnsoɛr wɔ w'enim; na mayɛ mbaadze. Na ɔhwehwɛe na oennhu kum no.
Na Jacob no bo fuwii, na ɔnye Laban hamee: Na Jacob buae see Laban dɛ, mo mfom nye mmuana? Mo bɔn nye mmuana, ma etsiw me ɔhyew do dɛm yi?
Ekekã me ndzɛmba nyinara yi, wo fie ndzɛmba nyinara mu ebɛnadze na ehu no wɔ mu? Fa si mo nuanom nye wo nuanom hɔn enyim ha, ma wombu hɛn beenu ntamu atsɛn.
Matsena wo nkyɛn mfe eduonu nye yi; wo nguamber nye wo mpɔnkyeber ammpon mba da, na wo nguan mu ndwanyin so, menndzi bi.
Hɔn a mbowa kum hɔn no, mammfa ammbrɛ wo; ɔyɛɛ mara me kaw. Dza wowiaa no ewia o, dza wowiaa no anafua o, egyee no mo hɔ.
Mbrɛ meyɛe nye yi; adzekyee a nna ewia rehyew me, adzesaa a nna awɔw resar me; na m'enyi so kokwae.
Mfe eduonu nye yi na matsena wo fie; wo mbabaa beenu ntsi mosoom wo mfe duanan, na wo mbowakuw so ntsi mfe esia: na asakyer m'akatua mpɛn du.
Sɛ m'egya ne Nyankopɔn, Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, nye Isaac no Suro, enndzi m'ekyir a, nkyɛ ndɛ egya me kwan nsapan. Nyankopɔn ehu m'amandzehu nye me nsaano edwumayɛ, na anago yi ɔaka w'enyim.

Na Laban buae na ɔsee Jacob dɛ, mbabaa yi me mbabaa a, na mba yi me mba a, na nguan yi mo nguan a, na dza ihu yi nyinara medze a: Na ebɛnadze na mubontum mayɛ me mbabaa yi, anaa hɔn mba a wɔawo hɔn yi ndɛ?
Na afei bra, ma yendzi ahyɛmu, mi nye ɔwo na ma ɔnyɛ dase wɔ emi nye ɔwo ntamu
Na Jacob faa ɔbo, na ɔdze yɛɛ idum sii hɔ.
Na Jacob see no nuanom dɛ, hom mboaboa abo ano; na wɔtasee abo, na wɔhɔɔr no isiw: Na wodzidzii iw no ho hɔ.
Na Laban frɛ no Jegar-sahadutha: Na Jacob dze ɔfrɛɛ no Galeed.
Na Laban ee dɛ, Isiw yi nyɛ emi nye ɔwo ntamu dase ndɛ. Dɛm ntsi ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Galeed:
na Mizpah osiandɛ ɔsee dɛ, yɛpaapaa mu a, Ewuradze nhwɛ emi nye ɔwo ntamu.
Sɛ ebɛtseetsee me mbabaa ho a, obi nnka hɛn ho; hwɛ, Nyankopɔn nye emi nye ɔwo ntamu dasefo.
Na Laban see Jacob dɛ, hwɛ siw yi, na hwɛ idum mama do mesi emi nye ɔwo ntamu yi.
Isiw yi yɛ dase, na idum yi yɛ dase, dɛ mennkɛtra siw yi maba wo nkyɛn, na wo so ennkɛtra siw yi nye idum yi aba me nkyɛn, abɛyɛ bɔn.
Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, nye Nahor ne Nyankopɔn, hɔn egya ne Nyankopɔn, ombu hɛn ntamu atsɛn. Na Jacob dze n'egya Isaac no Suro no dzii nsew.
Na Jacob bɔɔ afɔr wɔ bepɔw no do, na ɔfrɛɛ no nuanom dɛ wombedzidzi: Na wodzidzii, na wotsintsimii wɔ bepɔw no do anafua no nyinara.
Na Laban soɛrr anapaatu, na ofeew ne mbabanyin nye ne mbabaa no hɔn ano, na ohyiraa hɔn: Na Laban sanee kɔr no kurow mu
32: Na Jacob sii no kwan do, na Nyankopɔn n'abɔfoe behyiaa no.
Na Jacob hun hɔn no nna ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn no dɔm nye yi: Na ɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Mahanaim.
Na Jacob tu abɔfo ma wodzii n'enyim kan kɔr no nua Esau hɔ wɔ Seir asaase do, Edom haban mu.
Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, hom nkɛse mo wura Esau dɛm; dɛ, mbrɛ w'akowaa Jacob se nye yi, menye Laban akɛtsena, na makyɛr hɔ ara ma ebodundɛ.
Na menya anantwi, na nsoaso nye nguan, na nkowaa nye mfonabaa: Na masoma dɛ wɔmbɛkã nkyerɛ mo wura, ama meenya w'enyim enyimnyam.
Na abɔfo wɔsanee baa Jacob hɔ, dɛ, yɛkɔr wo nua Esau hɔ na mbom ɔnoara so reba ebehyia wo kwan, na mbarimba ahaanan ka no ho.
Nna Jacob n'akoma tuu kɛsenara, na no oho hiahiaa no: Na obuee nkorɔfo a wɔnye no nam no, nye nguan no, nye anatwi no, nye efumpɔnkɔ no hɔn mu ekuw ebien;
na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ Esau ba kuw kor do, na oboku hɔn a, ɔno ikuw a ɔaka no oefi nsa.
Na Jacob see dɛ, Ao, m'egya Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, na m'egya Isaac ne Nyankopɔn, ao, Ewuradze a esee me dɛ, san kɔ wo man mu, nye w'ebusua mu, na mebɛyɛ wo yie:
ehumbɔhɔr nye nokwar a eyi akyerɛ w'akowaa no mennsɛ no mu biara; osiandɛ mo pomaa ara na medze mutwaa Jordan yi; na afei mayɛ ekuw ebian
Meserɛ wo, gye me fi mo nua nsamu, fi Esau nsamu: Na musuro no, bɛyɛ na ɔaba eboku emi, nye enanom nye mbofra yi.
Na esee dɛ, Ampaara dɛ mebɛyɛ wo yie, na mama w'asefo ayɛ dɛ mpoana anhwea a no dodow ntsi wɔkan a ɔnnyɛ.
Na ɔsoɛɛ hɔ anafua no; na oyii dza ɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no mu bi dɛ ɔdze rekɛkyɛ no nua Esau;
mpɔnkyenyin eduonu, nguamber ahaenu nye ndwanyin eduonu,
efumpɔnkɔ a wɔma enumfo eduasa nye hɔn mba, anantwiber eduanan nye anantwinyin du, nsoasober eduonu nye nsoasomba du.
Na ɔdze no ekuwekuw hyɛɛ no nkowaa no nsa; na ɔsee no nkowaa no dɛ, Hom ntwa mu ndzi m'enyim, na hom mma ikuw ye ikuw ntamu mbra kwan.
Na ɔhyɛɛ dza odzi kan no dɛ, sɛ mo nua Esau nye wo hyia, na obisa wo dɛ, woana n'abofra nye wo? Na erokɔ henfa? Na dza wodzi w'enyin yi woana dze a?
ɔno se dɛ, w'akowaa Jacob dze a; ɔyɛ akyɛdze a wɔdze rekɛma mo wura Esau: Na hwɛ, ɔnoara so dzi hɛn ekyir.
Na ɔhyɛɛ dza otsia ebien no so, nye dza otsia ebiasa no, nye hɔn a wɔka mbowakuw no do no nyinara dɛ, sɛ hom hu Esau a, wɔnkã nkyerɛ no dɛm;
na hom nse dɛ, nkyii so, hwɛ w'akowaa Jacob so dzi hɛn ekyir. Osiandɛ ɔsee dɛ, medze akyɛdze a odzi m'enyim yi mobɔkɔwedwe no, na n'ekyir no mehu n'enyim; bi a no bo bɔdwe me.
Nna akyɛdze no twaa mu dzii n'enyim: Na ɔnoara dze, ɔtsenaa dɔm no mu anafua no.
Na ɔsoeɛr anafua no, na ɔfaa ne yernom beenu no, nye ne mbaawaa beenu no, nye ne mba dubiako no, na okotwaa Jabbok esutwaree.
Na ɔfaa hɔn, na ɔmaa wotwaa esutsen no, na ɔmaa dza ɔwɔ nyinara twae.
Na ɔkaa Jacob no nko; na ɔbarimba bi nye do dzii aper wɔ hɔ ara ma okodur adzekyee.
Na ohun dɛ, onndzi no do konyim no, nna ɔkãa n'aserɛ tokur mu; na Jacob no ndwonku huanee wɔ aperper a ɔnye no dzii no mu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ma monkɔ, na adze rekye. Na ɔsee dɛ, mennkɛma akɔ, gyedɛ ehyira me ana.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Wo dzin dze dɛn? Na ɔsee dɛ, Jacob.
Na ɔsee dɛ, wɔnnkɛfrɛ wo dzin Jacob bio, na mbom, Israel: Osiandɛ ɔwo enye Nyankopɔn na ɔnye nyimpa akõ, na edzi konyim.
Na Jacob bisaa no, na ɔsee dɛ, meserɛ wo, bɔ wo dzin kyerɛ me. Na ɔsee dɛ, na iribisa me dzin ayɛ dɛn? Na ohyiraa no wɔ hɔ.
Na Jacob frɛɛ bea no ne dzin Peniel; osiandɛ, ɔsee dɛ, mehu Nyankopɔn mpu-na-mpu, na hwee annyɛ me.
Na orutwa mu wɔ Penuel no nna ewia puei, nna ohuan n'aserɛ mu.
Dɛm nsti ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi ara Israelmba wonndzi ntsin a ɔwɔ ndwonku mu no: Osiandɛ ɔkāa Jacob no ndwonku wɔ mbrɛ ntsin no wɔ no.
33: Na Jacob mma n'enyiwa do, na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, nna Esau reba, na mbarimba ahaanan ka no ho. Na ɔkyɛɛ mbofra no mu maa Leah, nye Rachel,nye mbaawa beenu no.
Na ɔdze mbaawa no nye hɔn mba no dzii kan, na ɔdze Leah nye ne mba no dzii hɔ, na ɔdze Rachel nye Joseph dzii ekyir.
Na ɔnoara ɔpaa ho kedzii hɔn enyim, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze mpɛn esuon, dze kodur dɛ ɔbɛɛn no nua no.
Na Esau tutuu enguan hyiaa no kwan, na ɔyɛɛ no etuu; na ɔdze ne nsa too no kɔn mu, na ofeew n'ano: Na wosūi.
Na ɔmaa n'enyiwa do, na ohun mbaa no nye mbofra no; na ɔsee dɛ, Woananom na wɔka wo ho yi? Na ɔsee dɛ, Mbofra a Nyankopɔn dze adom w'akowaa a.
Nna mbaawa no twee pinii, hɔn nye hɔn nye hɔn mba, na wɔbɔɔ hɔ mu adze
Na Leah nye ne mba so wɔtwee pinii, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze: Na n'ekyir no nna Joseph nye Rachel twee pinii, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Na ekuw a menye hɔn hyiae yi nyinara n'ase nye dɛn? Na ɔsee dɛ, medze robɔhwehwe mo wura n'enyim enyimnyam.
Na Esau see dɛ, Dza mowo no ara dɔɔ so; mo nua, ma w'adze nko ho mma wo.
Na Jacob see dɛ, dabida, meserɛ wo, sɛ afei menya w'enyim enyimyam a, nna gye me nsamu akyɛdze; susuampa dɛ mehu w'enyim ara dɛ mbrɛ obiara bohu Nyankopɔn enyim, na masɔ w'enyi yi.
Meserɛ wo gye m'akyɛdze a wɔdze abrɛ wo yi; osiandɛ Nyankopɔn adom me, na eso osiandɛ dza mowɔ no dɔɔ sõ. Na ɔhyɛɛ no ma ɔgyee.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ma yensi mu, na yɛnkɔ, na mibedzi w'enyim.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mo wura nyim dɛ, mbofra yi yɛ mberɛw, na eso nguan nye anantwi a wɔnye me nam yi wɔma enumfo: Na sɛ wɔka hɔn dodow ada kor a, nguan no nyinara bowuwu.
Meserɛ wo, wɔmma mo wura mpa ho nkedzi n'akowaa enyim: Na emi mobɔdwe m'enyi ara manantsew dɛ mbrɛ mbowa a wodzi m'enyim yi botum, na dɛ mbrɛ mbofra no botum, ekodu dɛ mubodu mo wura nkyɛn wɔ Seir.
Na Esau see dɛ, nna ma memfa nyimpa a wɔka mo ho yi bi mingya wo mbɔ. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ma ɔnyɛ dɛn? Wɔmma minnya mo wura n'enyim enyimnyam.
Nna Esua saan da no ara faa no kwan do kɔr Seir.
Na Jacob sii mu kor Succoth, na okesii dan maa noho, na osisii mpata maa no mbowa: Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Succoth.
Na Jacob baa Shechem kurow a ɔwɔ Canaan asaase do no mu asomdwee mu, wɔ ber a ofii Paddan-aram bae no; na ɔbɔbɔɔ asese wɔ kurow no n'enyim.
Na ɔtɔɔ asaase kakraba a ɔbɔɔ n'asesee wɔ do no, wɔ Shechem n'egya Hamor ne mba no hɔ, maa kesitah ɔha.
Na osii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ, na ɔfrɛɛ no El-elohe-Israel.
34: Na Dianah, Leah ne babaa a ɔwoo no maa Jacob no, opuei dɛ ɔrokɔhwɛ asaase no do mbabaa.
Na Hamor, hivinyi no, no asaase no do hen no ne ba Shechem ohun no; na ɔfaa no, na ɔnye no dae, na ɔbrɛɛ no adze.
Na no werɛ kitsaa Dinah Jacob ne babaa no, na ɔdɔɔ akataasia no na ɔkasa ayamuyie mu kyerɛɛ akataasia no.
Na Shechem kãa kyerɛɛ n'egya Hamor dɛ, kɛgye akataasia yi yer ma me.
Afei Jacob tsee dɛ oegu ne babaa Dinah ho fi; na ne mbabanyin wɔ no mbowa nkyɛn wɔ hamu: Na Jacob yɛɛ komm ma wɔbae ana
Na Shechem n'egya puei kɔr Jacob nkyɛn dɛ, ɔrekɛnye no atwetwe nkɔmbɔ.
Na Jacob ne mababanyin no wɔtsee no, nna wofi hamu baa fie: Na ɔyɛɛ mbarimba no yaw, na hɔn bo fuuw kɛsenara, osiandɛ ɔayɛ nkwasiadze wɔ Isreal dɛ ɔnye Jacob ne babaa ada; adze a wɔnnyɛ.
Na Hamor nye hɔn twetwee nkɔmbɔ see dɛ, me ba Shechem no werɛ ekitsa hom babaa: Meserɛ hom, wɔmfa no mma no awar.
Na hom nye hɛn ndzi awarwar; hom mfa hom mbabaa mma hɛn, na hom so mfa hɛn mbabaa.
Na hom nye hɛn ntsena: na asaase no bɛda hom enyim; hom ntsena do na hom ndzi gua wɔ do, na hom nnya adze wɔ do.
Na Shechem see n'egya nye no nuanom no dɛ, wɔmma minnya hom enyi, enyimnyam, na dza hom bɛse me no mebɛma.
Hom mbisa me tsiadze nye akyɛdze kɛse biara, na dza mo bɛse me no ara mebɛma: Na hom mfa akataasia no mma me awar.
Na Jacob ne mbabanyin no buaa Shechem nye n'egya Hamor ndaadaa mu, na wɔkasae, osiandɛ oegu hɔn akyerɛbaa Dinah ho fi ntsi.
Na wɔsee hɔn dɛ, yɛyɛ dɛm adze yi a ɔnnkɛyɛ, dɛ yɛdze hɛn akyerɛbaa bɛma obi a wonntwaa no twatsia; na dɛm no yɛ enyimguase ma hɛn:
Dza ogyina do a yɛbɛ gye hom pen ara nye yi: Dɛ sɛ hom bɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ yɛtse, na woetwa hom mu mbanyin nyinara twatsia a;
nna yɛdze hɛn mbabaa bɛma hom, na hɛn so yɛafa hom mbabaa, na yɛnye hom atsena, na yɛayɛ ɔman kor.
Na sɛ hom nnketsie hɛn, na hom etwitwa twatsia a; ɔno yɛbɛfa hɛn babaa, na yɛakɔ.
Na hɔn nsɛm no yɛɛ hamor, nye Hamor ne ba Shechem hɔn pɛ.
Na aberantsɛ no ennkyinkyim dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dɛm adze no, osiandɛ ɔpɛ Jacob ne babaa no: Na wodzi no nyi sen n'egya ne fifo nyinara.
Na Hamor nye ne ba Shechem wɔbaa hɔn kurow n'abotsenano, na wɔnye hɔn kuorw mu mbabanyin no twetwee nkɔmbɔ, dɛ,

Mbarimba yi wɔnye Hɛn tse no asomdwee mu; dɛm ntsi hom mma wɔntsena asaase yi do, na wondzi mu gua; na, hwɛ, asaase yi dɔɔ soara yie ma hɔn; hom mma yɛmfa hɔ mbabaa nwar hɔn, na wɔmma hɛn so yɛmfa hɔn mbabaa mma hɔn.
Na dza ara a ogyia do a mbarimba no bɛgye hɛn pen a wɔnye hɛn atsena, ma yaayɛ ɔman kor, ɔnye dɛ, hɛn mu mbanyin nyinara botwitwa twatsia, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn woetwitwa no.
Ana nkyɛ hɔn anyɛmbowa nye hɔn ahodze nye hɔn mbowa nyinara nnkɛyɛ hɛmndze bi a? Hom mma yɛngye hɔn pen ara, na wɔnye hɛn bɛtsena.
Na hɔn a wɔnam Hamor no kurow n'abotsenano pue nyinara, wotsiee ɔno na ne ba Shechem; na mbanyin a wɔnam no kurow n'abotsenano pue nyinara wotwitwa hɔn twatsia.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ne ndaansa no a ne yaw kitsaa hɔn no, nna Jacob ne mbabanyin beenu, Simeon nye Levi, Dinah no nuanom no, wɔfefaa hɔn mfõwa, na wokefiir kurow no awora, na wokunkum mbanyin no nyinara.
Na wɔdze afõwa anomu kum Hamor nye ne ba Shechem, na wɔfaa Dinah fii Shechem ne fie, na wɔdze no kɔree.
Jacob ne mbabanyin no baa atɔfo no do na wɔbɔfoom kurow no mu ndzɛmba, osiandɛ woegu hɔn akyerɛbaa no ho fi.
Wɔfaa hɔn nguan nye hɔn anantwi, nye hɔn nsoaso nye dza ɔwɔ kurow no mu na dza ɔwɔ haban mu;
na hɔn ahodze nyinara, na wɔfaa hɔn mbofraba nyinara nye hɔn yernom ndɔmmum, na wɔfoom hɔn, mekyerɛ dza ɔwɔ fie nyinara.

Na Jacob see Simeon nye levi dɛ, hom afona me, dɛ hom ama mo ho abɔn wɔ hɔn a wɔtse asaase yi do hɔn mu, wɔ Canaanfo nye Perizzfo hɔn mu: Na mo ho suar ntsi, wɔbɔboaboa hɔn ano aba mo do, na woeboku me; na wɔbɛsɛɛ me, emi nye me fi.
Na wɔsee dɛ, Na nkyɛ ɔnyɛ hɛn akyerɛbaa dɛ ohuhunyi a?
35: Na Nyankopɔn see Jacob dɛ, Soɛr, kɔ Beth-el, na kɛtsena hɔ: Na yɛ afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ ma Nyankopɔn a oyii noho kyerɛɛ wo wɔ aber a ifii wo nua Esau n'enyim guanee no.
Nna Jacob see ne fifo nye hɔn a wɔnye no wɔ hɔ nyinara dɛ, Hom ntow enyame ananaben a ɔwɔ hom mu no ngu, na hom ntsew homho, na hom nsesa hom ntar:
Na hom mma yɛnsoɛr, na yɛnkɔ Beth-el: Na mebɛyɛ afɔrmbuyia wɔ hɔ mama Nyankopɔn a m'ahohia da no ɔgyee me do, na odzii m'ekyir wɔ kwan a mutui no mu no.
Na wɔdze hɔn enyame ananaben a ɔwɔ hɔn nsa mu nyinara, nye nkaba a ɔhyehyɛ hɔn asomu no maa Jacob: Na Jacob dze hyɛɛ esudur no a ɔwɔ Shechem ho no ase.
Na wɔkɔree: Na ihu kɛsenara tɔɔ nkurow a wɔabɔ hɔn ho aprɔw no do, ma woenntsiw Jacob ne mbabanyin no.
Nna Jacob baa Luz a ɔwɔ Canaan asaase do no, (Ɔnoara nye Beth-el), ɔno nye nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho nyinara.
Na osii afɔrmbuyia wɔ hɔ, na ɔfrɛɛ bea no Elbeth-el: Osiandɛ hɔ na Nyankopɔn yii noho kyerɛɛ no wɔ aber a ofii no nua enyim guanee no.
Na Deborah, Rebekah no hwɛfo no wui, na wosiee no Beth-el anaafo, wɔ esudur no ase; na wɔtoo ne dzin Allo-bacuth.
Na aber a Jacob fi Paddan-aram bae no, Nyankopɔn yii noho kyerɛɛ no bio, na ohyiraa no.
Na Nyankopɔn see no dɛ, Wo dzin dze Jacob: Wɔnnkɛfrɛ wo dzin Jacob bio, na Israel bɛyɛ wo dzin: Na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Israel.
Na Nyankopɔn see no dɛ, Emi nye Nyankopɔn Otumfo: Wo mba na dɔr; ɔman nye amanaman asafo befi wo mu aba, na ahemfo befi w'asen mu epue;
na asaase a medze memaa Abraham nye Isaac no, ɔwo na medze mebɛma wo, na w'asefo a wodzi w'ekyir no na medze asaase no mebɛma hɔna
Na Nyankopɔn fii ne nkyɛn wɔ mbrɛ ɔnye no kasae no kɔr sor.
Na Jacob sii idum wɔ mbrɛ ɔnye no kasae no; ɔbo dum a: Na ohuee ɔnom-afɔr guu do, na ohuee ngo guu do.
Na Jacob frɛɛ bea no a Nyankopɔn nye no kasae wɔ hɔ no ne dzin Beth-el,
Na wofii Beth-el sii mu: Na aka ɔkwan bi so ma nkyii woedu Ephrath: Na awoo kaa Rachel, na n'awoo no mu yɛ dzen.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a n'awoo no mu yɛɛ dzen no, nna awogyefo no see no dɛ, Mma nnsuro: Ibenya babanyin kor so afei.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, ne kra rifi no mu no (osiandɛ owui). Nna ɔtoo no dzin Ben-oni; na n'egya dze ɔfrɛɛ no Benjamin,
Na Rachel wui, na wosiee no wɔ Ephrath kwan mu (Ɔnoara nye Bethlehem).
Na Jacob sii ne nda do idum: Ɔnoara nye Rachel ne nda do idum dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na Israel tui, na ɔkɔbɔɔ n'asesee wɔ Eder abantsentsenekyir noho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, Israel tse asaase no do no, nna Reuben kɔree na ɔnye n'egya n'abaawayer Bilhah kɛdae: Na Israel tsee. Afei Jacob ne mbabanyin yɛ duebien:
Leah ne mba: Jacob n'abakan Reuben, nye Simeon, nye Levi, nye Judah nye Isaachar, nye Zebulun;
Rachel ne mab: Joseph nye Benjamin:
Na Rachel n'baawa Bilhah ne mba: Dan nye Naphtali:
Na Leah n'abaawa Zilpah ne mba: Gad nye Asher; woyinom nye Jacob ne mbabanyin a wɔwoo hɔn maa no wɔ Paddan-aram.
Na Jacob baa n'egya Isaac nkyɛn wɔ Mamre, wɔ Kiriath-arba (Ɔnoara nye Hebron), mbrɛ Abraham nye Isaac bɛtsenae no.
Na Isaac ne nda yɛ mfe ɔha eduowɔtwe.
Na Isaac gyaa no sunsum mu, na owui, na wɔdze no kɛkaa no nkorɔfo ho, na ɔayɛ akɔdaa na oedzi nda pii: Na ne mba Esau nye Jacob siee no.
36: Afei iyinom nye esau (Ɔnoara nye Edom) n'ebusuasantsen.
Esau waar ne yernom wɔ Canaan mbabaa mu: Hethnyi Elon ne babaa Adah, nye Hivinyi Zibeon ne babaa Anah ne babaa Oholibamah;
Nye Ishmael ne babaa Basemath, Nebaioth n'akyerɛbaa no.
Na Adah woo Eliphaz maa Esau; na Basemath woo Reuel;
na Oholibamah woo Jeush, nye Jalam, nye Korah: Woyinom nye Esau ne mba a wɔwoo hɔn maa no wɔwoo hɔn maa no wɔ Canaan asaase do no,
Na Esau faa ne yernom, nye ne mbabanyin, nye ne mbabaa, nye ne fie nyimpa nyinara, nye n'enyadze a onyaa no wɔ Canaan asaase do nyinara: Na ɔtwee noho wɔ no nua Jacob ho kɔr asaase bi do.
Osiandɛ hɔn ahodze so dodow ma hɔn dɛ wɔbɛtsena fakor; na asaase a wɔtse do no wɔnnsen do wɔ hɔn mbowa no ntsi.
Na Esau tsenaa Seir bepɔw do: Esau nye Edom.
Na iyinom nye Esau, Edomfo a wɔtse Seir bepɔw do hɔn egya no, n'ebusuasantsen:
Esau ne mbabanyin hɔn edzin nye yi; Eliphaz, Esau ne yer Adah ne ba no, Reuel, Esau ne yer Basemath ne ba no.
Na Eliphaz ne mba nye Teman, Omar, Zepho nye Gatam, nye Kenaz.
Na Esau ne ba Eliphaz no nwewe nye Timna; na ɔwoo Amlek maa Eliphaz: Wonyinom nye Esau ne yer Adah ne mba.
Na Reuel ne mba nye woyinom; Nahatt, nye Zerah, Shammah, nye Mizzah; woyinom nye Esau ne yer Basemath ne mba.
Na woyinom nye Esau ne yer Oholibamah, Zibeon ne babaa Anah ne babaa no, ne mba; na ɔwoo Jeush nye Jalam nye Korah maa Esau.
Woyinom nye Esau ne mba mu ekunyin; Esau n'abakan Eliphaz ne mba; okunyin Teman, okunyin Omar, okunyin Zepho, okunyi Kenaz.
Okunyin Korah, okunyin Gatam, okunyin Amalek: Woyinom nye ekunyin a wofi Eliphaz no mu puei wɔ Edom asaase do; woyinom nye Adah ne mba.

Na Esau ne ba Rueuel ne mba nye woyinom; okunyin Nahath, okunyin Zerah, okunyin Shammah, okunyin Mizzah: Woyinom nye ekunyin a wofi Reuel mu puei wɔ Edom asaase do; woyinom nye Esau ne yer Basemath ne mba.
Na woyinom nye Esau ne yer Oholibamah ne mba; okunyin Jeush, okunyin Jalam, okunyin Korah: Woyinom nye ekunyin a wofi Esau ne yer Oholibamah, Anah ne babaa no no mu puei.
Woyinom nye Esau ne mba, na woyinom nye hɔn ekunyin: Ɔnoara nye Edom.
Woyinom nye Hornyi Seir ne mba, asaase-no-do-fo no; Lotan nye Shobal nye Zibeon nye Anah,
nye Dishon nye Ezer nye Dishan: Woyinom nye ekunyin a wofi Horfo, Seir ne mba no hɔn mu puei, wɔ edom asaase do.
Na Lotan ne mba nye Hori nye Heman; nye Lotan n'akyerɛbaa nye Timna.
Na Shobal ne mba nye woyinom; Alvan nye Manahath nye Ebal, Shepho nye Onam.
Na woyinom nye Zibeon ne mba; Aiah nye Anah: Oyi nye Anah a, mber a ɔhwɛ n'egya Zibeon no nsoaso no a okohun nsuhyew mpumpunadze wɔ sar do no.
Na woyinom nye Anah ne mba; Dishon nye Oholibaham, Anah ne babaa no.
Na woyinom nye Dishon ne mba; Hemdan nye Eshban nye Ithran nye Cheran.
Ezer ne mba nye woyinom; Bilhan nye Zaavan nye Akan.
Dishon ne mba nye woyinom: Uz nye Aran.
Ekunyi a wofi Horfo mu puei nye woyinom; okunyin Lotan, okunyin Shobal, okunyin Zibeon, okunyin Anah,
okunyin Dishon, okunyin Ezer, okunyin Dishan: Ekunyin a wofi Horfo mu puei nye woyinom dɛ, mbrɛ hɔn ekunyin tsetsee wɔ seir asaase do.
Na ahemfo a wodzi hen wɔ Edom asaase do, ansaana obiara ridzi Israelmba do hen no nye woyinom.
Na Boer ne Bela dzii hen wɔ Edom; na no kurow dzin dze dinhabah.
Na Bela wui, na Zerah a ofi Bozrah ne ba Jobab bedzii n'adze.
Na Jobab wui, na Husham a ofi Temanfo hɔn asaase do bedzii n'adze.
Na Husham wui, na Hadad, Bedad a okum Midian wɔ Moab haban mu no, ne ba no bedzii n'adze: Na no kurow ne dzin dze Avith.
Na Harad wui, na Samlah a ofi Masrekah bedzii n'adze.
Na Samlah wui, na Shaul a ofi Rehoboth a ɔwɔ Esutsten no ho no bedzii n'adze.
Na Shaul wui, na Achbor ba Baal-hanan bedzii n'adze.
Na Achbor ne ba Baal-Hanan wui, na Hadar bedzii n'adze: Na no kurow ne dzin dze Pau; na ne yer ne dzin dze Mehetabel, Me-zahab ne babaa Matred ne babaa a.
Na ekunyin a wofi esau mu puei hɔn ebusua ebusua, hɔn tsenabew, nye hɔn edzin tsetsee; okunyi Timna, okunyi Alvah, okunyi Jepheth;
okunyin Oholibamah, okunyi Elah, okunyi Pinoon;
okunyi Kenaz, okunyi Teman, okunyi Mibzar;
okunyi Magdiel, okunyi Iram: Woyinom nye Edom ekunyi, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn tsenabew tsetse wɔ asaase a ɔyɛ hɔn enyadze no do. Oyi nye Esae, Edomfo hɔn egya no.
37: Na Jacob tsenaa asaase a n'egya tsenaa do no do, Canaan asaase do.
Woyinom nye Jacob n'ebusuasantsen. Joseph dzii mfe duesuon no, na ɔyɛ abofra a ɔnye n'egya ne yernom Bilhah nye Zilpah hɔn mba na wɔwɔ hɔ; na Joseph dze hɔn ho asɛmbɔn bɛkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn egya.
Afei Israel ɔdɔ Joseph sen ne mba nyinara, osiandɛ ɔno nye no nkɔdaa ba; na ɔyɛɛ asaasaaba atar maa no.
Na no nuanom hun dɛ hɔn egya dɔ no sen no nuanom nyinara; na wɔtaan no, na woenntum annkasa abodwee do annkyerɛ no.
Na Joseph soo daa, na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ no nuanom na nkyii wɔtaan no kɛse.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, meserɛ hom, hom ntsie daa a maso yi:
Na hwɛ, yɛrekyekyer afiefi wɔ haban mu, na, hwɛ, me fi no soɛree, na so ogyinaa tsentsen; na, hwɛ, hom efi no botwaa me fi no ho hyiae, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze maa no.
Na no nuanom see no dɛ, nna tserɛ ampaara dɛ ibedzi hɛn do hen nye no? Ana tserɛ ampaara dɛ ibenya hɛn do tum nye no? Na nkyii wɔtaan no kɛse wɔ ne daa no nye ne nsɛm no ntsi.
Na ɔsoo daa kor so, na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ no nuanom, na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, maso daa bio; na, hwɛ, ewia nye bosoosm nye nworaba dubiako robɔ hɔn mu adze ma me.
Na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ n'egya nye no nuanom; na n'egya twuuw n'enyim, na ɔsee no dɛ, ebɛn daa na aso yi? Nna tserɛ ampaara dɛ emi nye wo nã nye wo nuanom bɛba abɔbɔ hɛn mu adze wɔ famu ama wo nye no?
Na no nuanom enyi beer no do; na n'egya dze ɔdze asɛm no too ne tsirmu.
Na no nuanom kɔree kɔhwɛɛ hɔn agya no nguan wɔ Shechem.
Na Israel see Joseph dɛ, Ana wo nuanom nnyɛn nguan wɔ Shechem bi a? Bra ma monsoma wo hɔn hɔ. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Emi nye yi.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Afei kɔ, kɔhwɛ kyerɛ wo nnuanom, nye nguan no hɔn ho ye; na san bɛkã kyerɛ me. Nna ofi Hebron bɔnsa mu somaa no ma ɔbaa Shechem.
Na ɔbarimba bi hun no, na, hwɛ, orikyin haban mu: Na ɔbarimba no bisaa no dɛ, Erohwehwɛ ebɛn?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Morohwehwɛ mo nuanom: Mmeserɛ wo ara, kyerɛ me mbrɛ wɔwɔ rohwɛ nguan no.
Na ɔbarimba no see dɛ, Woefi ha kɔ: Na metsee dɛ wɔrekã dɛ, Wɔmma yɛnkɔ Dothan. Na Joseph fãa no nuanom, na okohun hɔn wɔ Dothan.
Na wohun no ekyirkyirkyir, na ansaana oripinkyɛn hɔn no, nna wɔrkɔr ne tsir do apam dɛ woboku no.
Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, wɔnhwɛ, ɔdaasofo no na ɔreba no.
Dɛm ntsi afei wɔmbra, wɔmma yenku no, na yɛntow no nkyen mona yi bi mu, na yɛnkɛse dɛ, Abowa bɔn bi na ɔatsetsew no mu: Na nkyii yɛnhwɛ mbrɛ n'adaaso no bɛyɛ.
Na Reuben tsee, na ɔgyee no wɔ hɔn nsamu; na ɔsee dɛ, mma wɔmma yennku no.
Na Reuben see dɛ, mma hom nnkã bɔgya: Wɔmfa no nto sar do ha mona yi mu, na mma wɔmmfa nsa nnkã no: Ama nkyɛ ɔaagye no wɔ hɔn nsamu dze no asan akɛma n'egya.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, Joseph dur no nuanom nkyɛn no, nna wɔpɔɔr Joseph n'atar no, asaasaaba atar a ɔhyɛ no no;
na wɔfaa no, na wɔdze no kɔtoo mona mu: Na mona no epar, nsu nnyi mu,
Na wɔtsenaa famu dɛ woridzidzi: Na wɔmaa hɔn enyiwa do na wɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, Ishmaelfo akwantufo kuw bi wofi Gilead reba, wɔnye hɔn efumpɔnkɔ a wɔsoso eduhuam nye balm nye myrrh, wɔdze rokɔ Egypt.
Na Judahsee no nuanom no dɛ, sɛ yeku hɛn nua na yesiw no bɔgyaa do a, ebɛn mfaso na ɔwɔ mu?
Hom mbra ma yɛntɔn no mma Ishmaelfo yi, na mma wɔmma yɛmmfa hɛn nsa nnkã no; osiandɛ hɛn nua a, hɛn honam a. Na no nuanom no tsiee no.
Nna Midianfo, eguadzifo rutwa mu; na wɔtwee Joseph maa no do fii mona no mo, na wɔtɔɔn Joseph maa Ishmaelfo no gyee ndwetɛbona eduonu. Na wɔdze Joseph kɔr Egypt.
Na Reuben sanee baa mona no do; na, hwɛ, Joseph nnyi mona no mu; na osunsuaan ne ntar mu.
Na ɔsanee baa no nuanom no nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Abofra no nnyi hɔ; na iyi mara merefa hen?
Na wɔfaa Joseph n'atar no, na wokum apɔnkyenyin, na wɔdze atar no bɔɔ bɔgya no mu;
na wɔdze asaasaaba atar no samae ma wɔdze brɛɛ hɔn egya, bɛsee no dɛ, Adze a yeehu nye yi: Hwɛ kyerɛ dɛ wo ba n'atar a anaa oho.
Na ɔhwɛe, na ɔsee dɛ, Me ba n'atar a; abowa bɔn bi na ɔakyer no; na wɔatsetsew Joseph no mu.
Na Jacob sunsuaan n'atar mu, na ɔdze kɔben-tam bɔɔ n'asen, na osuu ne ba nda pii.
Na ne mbabanyin nye ne mbabaa nyinara wɔsoɛree dɛ wɔrekyekye no werɛ; na ɔsee dɛ, Mibedzi yaw ara na makɔ samanadze, me ba nkyɛn. Na n'egya suu no.
Na Midianfo no kɔtɔɔn no wɔ Egypt maa Potiphar, Pharaoh no somfo bi, abrafohen no.
38: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber no ara mu na Judah fii no nuanom nkyɛn kɔree, na ɔkɛtsena Adullamnyi bi a ne dzin dze Hirah ne nkyɛn.
Na Judah hun Canaannyi bi a ne dzin dze Shua ne babaa bi wɔ hɔ; na ɔfaa no, na ɔkɔr ne nkyɛn.
Na onyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin; na ɔfrɛɛ ne ndzin Er.
Na onyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin; na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Onan.
Na ɔwoo babanyin bio, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Shelah: Na aber a ɔwoo no no nna ɔwɔ Chezib.
Na Judah gyee yer maa n'abakan Er, na ne dzin dze Tamar.
Na Judah n'abakan Er yɛɛ bɔn wɔ Ewuradze enyim; na Ewuradze kum no.
Na Judah see Onan dɛ, kɔ wo nua ne yer nkyɛn, na fa no Kunabaa, na wo mba ma wo nua.
Na Onan nyim dɛ mba no nnkɛyɛ nedze; na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔkɔr no nua ne yer nkyɛn no, nna ɔmaa oguu famu, amma ɔaamma no nua mba.
Na dza ɔyɛe no ɔyɛ bɔn wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Na okum no so.
Nna Judah see ne sew Tamar dɛ Tsena ekunayɛ mu wɔ w'egya fie kɛpem dɛ me ba Shelah benyin: Na ɔkãa dɛ, Bohu na no so ewu dɛ no nuanom no. Na Tamar kɔree na ɔkɛtsenaa n'egya fie.
Na ɔwɔ hɔ wɔ hɔ nna Shua ne babaa, Judah ne yer no, owui; na Judah no werɛ kyekyeree, na ɔkɔr no nguansusuafo nkyɛn wɔ Timnah, ɔno ye ne nyɛnko Adullamnyi Hirah.
Na wɔkãa yerɛ Tamar dɛ, hwɛ, w'asew rokɔ Timna ekosusua no nguan ho nhwi.
Na oyii no kuna ntar wɔ no ho, na ɔdze ne nkata-enyim kataa n'enyim, na ɔkataa no ho, na ɔkɛtsenaa Enaim abotsenano, wɔ Timanh kwan nkyɛn; osiandɛ ohun dɛ Shelah enyin, na wɔmmfa no mma no awar.
Na Judah hun no no, obuu no dɛ ohuhunyi a, osiandɛ ɔakata n'enyim.
Na ɔmanee kɔr ne nkyɛn wɔ kwan no ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, bra, meserɛ wo, ma membra wo nkyɛn: Na onnyim dɛ n'asew no a. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na edze bɛma me, na aba me nkyɛn?
Na ɔsee dɛ, mebɛma wɔdze apɔnkyeba fi nguan no mu abrɛ wo. Na ɔsee dɛ, ebɛma me ahobadze bi ma ɔdze ekodu dɛ ebɛma wɔdze aba?
Na ɔsee dɛ, ebɛn ahobadze na memfa memma wo? Na ɔsee dɛ, wo nsɔwanokaba nye w'ahoma, nye wo poma a okitsa wo nsamu no. Na ɔdze maa no, na ɔkɔr ne nkyɛn, na ɔnye no nyinsenii.
Na ɔsoɛree, na ɔkɔree, na oyii ne nkataenyim wɔ no ho, na ɔfaa no kuna ntar hyɛe.
Na Judah dze apɔnkyeba no maa ne nyɛnko Adullamnyi no, dɛ ɔmfa nkɛgye ahobadze no wɔ ɔbaa no nsa mu: Na oennhu no.
Nna obisaa no kuromufo no dɛ, ohuhunyi a ɔtse Enaim kwan nkyɛn no wɔ hen? Na wɔsee dɛ, ohuhunyi biara mmbaa ha.
Na ɔsanee baa Judah hɔ, na ɔbɛsee dɛ, mennhu no; na so ekuromfo no see dɛ, ohuhunyi biara mmbaa ha.
Na Judah see ɛ, ma ɔmfa, ɔno bohu na hɛn enyim egu ase: Hwɛ, memaa wɔdze apɔnkyeba yi kɔree, na ennhu no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ odzii bɛyɛ abosoom ebiasa n'ekyir no, nna wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Judah dɛ, w'asew Tamar agor, na hwɛ, ɔnam n'agor mu enyinsen so Na Judah see dɛ, Hom nkɛfa no mbra ma wɔhyew no.
Na wɔkɛfaa no bae no, nna ɔsomae ma wɔkɛsee n'asew dɛ, ɔbarimba a ndzɛmba yi yɛ nedze, nsɔwanokaba, nye ahoma, nye poma yi.
Na Judah hun dɛ noara nedze a, na ɔsee dɛ, ɔtsen sen me; susuampa dɛ mammfa no amma me ba Shelah ntsi. Na oennhu no bio.
Na ɔbaa n'awoo durii no, na, hwɛ, nta na wɔwɔ ne yamu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a ɔrowo no, nna kor dze ne nsa puei; na awogyefo no faa ahoma memen, na ɔdze kyekyeer ne nsa dɛ, oyi na odzii kan puei.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, ɔtwee ne nsa kɔdɔ mu, na, hwɛ, no nua puei; na ɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na atsew mu aba yi? Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Perez.
Na n'ekyir no nanua a ahoma memen kyekyer ne nsa no bae: Na wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Zerah.
39: Na wɔdze Joseph kɔr Egypt, na Potiphar, Pharaoh no somfo bi, abrafohen no, Egyptnyi no, ɔtɔɔ no wɔ Ishmaelfo a wɔdze no kɔr hɔ no, hɔn nsamu.
Na Ewuradze dzii Joseph n'ekyir na ɔyɛɛ nyimpa prɔprɔm; na ɔwɔ no wura Egyptnyi no ne fie.
Na no wura hun dɛ Ewuradze nye no nam, na Ewuradze maa dza ɔyɛɛ no nyinara yɛɛ prɔmprɔm wɔ ne nsamu.
Na Joseph bnyaa n'enyim enyimnyam, na ɔsoom no: Na ɔyɛɛ no panyin wɔ ne fie, na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara hyɛɛ ne nsa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ofitsi aber a ɔyɛɛ no panyin wɔ ne fie, na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara hyɛɛ ne nsa no, nna Joseph ntsi Ewuradze hyiraa Egyptnyi no ne fie; na Ewuradze ne nyhira baa dza ɔwɔ haban mu.
Na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara hyɛɛ Joseph ne nsa; na noara nnyim dza ɔwɔ no hɔ gyedɛ edziban a ɔnoara odzi na Joseph no ho yɛ fɛw, na n'enyim wɔ nyam.
Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom ekyir no, na no wura ne yer ɔdze n'enyi sii Joseph do; na ɔsee dɛ, enye me nda.
Na ɔpowee, na ɔsee no wura ne yer no dɛ hwɛ, mo wura nnyim dza ɔwɔ mo hɔ wɔ fie ha, na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara ahyɛ me nsa;
Obiara nnyɛ kɛse nnkyɛn me fie ha; nkyii so ɔnnkam me biribiara ka wo ho, osiandɛ eyɛ ne yer: Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na mebɛyɛ emumuyɛ kɛse yi, na mayɛ bɔn metsia Nyankopɔn?
Na ɔbaa dɛ, daa daa nyinara ɔka kyerɛ Joseph, na ɔanngye no pen, dɛ ɔnye no bɛda, anaa ɔnye no bɛtsena.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber yi mu no ɔkɔr fie hɔ dɛ ɔrekɛyɛ n'edwuma; na ofi no mu nyimpa no biara nnyi hɔ.
Na ɔtaae suoo n'atar mu, dɛ, enye me nda: Na ogyaa n'atar no wɔ ne nsamu, na oguan puei.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, ohun dɛ oegya n'atar no wɔ ne nsamu, na oeguan epue no,
nna ɔfrɛfrɛɛ no nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ ne fie no, na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, wɔnhwɛ, ɔakɛfa Hebrewnyi aba ma oribesi hɛn atwetwe; ɔbaa me nkyɛn dɛ ɔnye me rebɛda, na medze ndze kɛse mekekaa nu:
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a ɔtsee dɛ memaa me ndze do na mekekaa mu no, nna ɔdaan n'atar gyaa me nkyɛn, na oguanee puei.
Na ɔdze n'atar no guu ne nkyɛn ara ma okodur dɛ no wura baa fie.
Na ɔkaa no dɛmara kyerɛ no dɛ, Akowaa Hebrewnyi a edze no brɛɛ hɛn no, ɔbaa me nkyɛn dɛ oribesi me atwetwe:
Na ɔbaa dɛ, memaa me ndze do, na mekekaa mu no, nna ɔdaan n'atar gyaa me nkyɛn na oguanee puei.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a no wura tsee ne yer ne nsɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, mbrɛ w'akowaa ayɛ me nye yi no; nna no bo fuww kɛsenara.
Na Joseph no wura faa no, na ɔdze no kɔtoo efiadze, beebi mbrɛ ɔhen n'adaduafo gu o; na ɔdaa efiadze hɔ.
Na Ewuradze dzii Joseph n'ekyir, na ɔdoom no, na ɔmaa onyaa efiadzehwɛfo no n'enyimnyam.
Na efiadzehwɛfo no ɔdze adaduafo a wɔwɔ efiadze hɔ no nyinara hyɛɛ Joseph ne nsa; na biribiara a wɔyɛɛ no wɔ hɔ no, ɔnoara na ɔyɛe.
Efiadzehwɛfo no annhwɛ dza ɔwɔ ne nsa mu no mu biara, osiandɛ Ewuradze nye no nam; na biribiara a ɔyɛe no, Ewuradze maa ɔyɛɛ prɔmprɔm.
40: Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom ekyir no, nna Egypthen ne nsahyɛfo nye ne paanootofo wɔfoom hɔn wura Egypthen no.
Na Pharaoh no bo fuuw n'asomfo beenu no, nsahyɛfo panyin no, nye paanootofo panyin no.
Na ɔdze hɔn koguu efiadze wɔ abrafohen no ne fie, wɔ efiadze beebi mbrɛ Joseph da no no mu.
Na abrafohen no dze hɔn hyɛɛ Joseph ne nsa, na ɔsoom hɔn: Na wɔkyɛɛr efiadze hɔ mber kakra.
Na hɔn beenu nyina sosoo daa, anafua da kor, oyi ne daa, nye ne nkyerɛase, na oyi ne daa, nye ne nkyerɛase, Egypthen no ne nsahyɛfo no nye ne paanootofo no a wogu efiadze hɔ no.
Na Joseph baa hɔn nkyɛn anapa na obohun hɔn, na, hwɛ, wɔabombɔm.
Na obisaa Pharaoh n'asomfo a wɔnye no gu efiadze wɔ no wura ne fie no dɛ, ɔye dɛn na ndɛ ahombɔn dɛm yi?
Na wɔsee no dɛ, yɛasoso daa, na yennya obi ma ɔnnkyerɛ hɛn ase. Na Joseph see hɔn dɛ, Ana nnyɛ Nyankopɔn na nkyerɛase dzi wɔ no bi a? meserɛ hom, hom nka nkyerɛ me.
Na nsahyɛfo panyin no kaa n'adaaso kyerɛɛ Joseph, na ɔsee no dɛ, m'adaso mu, hwɛ, wenyindua si m'enyim;
na nkorbata ebiasa wɔ wenyindua no ho: Na ɔyɛ dɛ ɔafefɛw, na ɔabɔ nhyiren; na no do nsiansiaw asow wenyinamba a ɔaber:
na Pharaoh no kuraba kitsa me nsamu, na metsetseew wenyinamba no, na mikyii muguu Pharaoh no kuraba mu, na medze kuraba no mehyɛɛ Pharaoh ne nsa.
Na Joseph see no dɛ, ne nkyerɛase nye yi; nkornd, a ebiasa no ɔyɛ ndaansa;
aka dansa ma Pharaoh ama wo tsir do na ɔama ekedzi wo dzibew bio: Na edze Pharaoh no kuraba bɛhyɛ ne nsa, dɛ nkyɛ kan no a eyɛ ne nsahyɛfo no.
Na sɛ inya beebi si a, ɔno kaa me, na yɛ me ayamuyie, meserɛ wo, na bɔ me dzin kyerɛ Pharaoh, na beyi me wɔ dan yi mu:
Na owia na wowiaa me wɔ Hebrewfo asaase do: Na ha so mennyɛ biribiara a ɔse dɛ wɔdze me to nkurufi mu.
Na aber a paanootofo panyin no hun dɛ nkyerɛase no ye no, ɔsee Joseph dɛ, Mo so m'adaaso mu no, na, hwɛ, paanoo fufuw nkɛntsɛn ebiasa sisi m'etsifi:
na kɛntsɛn a odzi sor no adɔkɔdɔkɔdze a wɔto ma Pharaoh nyinara bi wɔ mu; na nnoma ridzi no kɛntsɛn no mu wɔ m'etsifi.
Na Joseph buae na ɔsee dɛ, ne nkyerɛase nye yi: Nkɛntsɛn ebiasa no yɛ ndaansa:
na aka ndaansa ma Pharaoh eyi wo tsir wɔ wo do, na wɔasɛn wo wɔ dua do; na nnoma edzi wo nam efi wo ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ne ndaansa no a ɔyɛ Pharaoh n'awoda no, nna ɔtoo pon maa no nkowaa nyinara: Na ɔmaa nsahyɛfo panyin no nye paanootofo panyin no hɔn tsir do wɔ no nkowaa mu.
Na ɔmaa nsahyɛfo panyin no saan ne nsãhyɛdwuma mu bio; na ɔdze kuraba no hyɛɛ Pharaoh ne nsa:
Na paanootofo panyin no dze, ɔsɛɛn no: Dɛ mbrɛ Joseph kyerɛɛ hɔn ase no: Ara.
Naaso nsahyɛfo panyin no ɔannkaa Joseph, na no werɛ fiir no.
41: Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe ebien soe wiei no, nna Pharaoh soo daa: Na, hwɛ, ogyina esutsen no ho.
Na, hwɛ, anantwiber esuon a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw na wɔadɔ seradze, fi esutsen no mu puei; na wobedzidzii sar no do.
Na, hwɛ, anantwiber esuon afofor so fi esuten no mu dzi hɔn ekyir puei a hɔn ho yɛ tantan na wɔafomfɔn; na wobegyinaa anantwiber esuon no nkyɛn wɔ esuten no no kɔn do.
Na anatwiber esuon a hɔn ho yɛ tantan na wɔafomfɔn no, wodzii anantwiber esuon a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw na wɔadɔ seradze no. Nna Pharaoh nyanee.
Na ɔdae na ɔsoo daa bio: Na hwɛ, eburow mbɛtsem esuon efifir eburownan kor do, amaama na oye.
Na, hwɛ, mbɛtsem esuon a ɔyɛ nkɔkɔr na boka mframa enyinam no fifirii dzii hɔn ekyir.
Na mbɛtsem nkɔkɔr no memeen mbɛtsem esuon a eburow wɔ mu na ɔyɛ amaama no. Na Pharaoh nyanee, na, hwɛ, adaaso a.

Na ɔbaa dɛ anapa no, n'ahomannka noho; na ɔsomae ma wɔkɛfrɛfrɛɛ Egypt nkongyaayifo nyinara, nye enyansafo a wɔwɔ hɔ nyinara ma wɔbae: Na Pharaoh kaa n'adaaso no kyerɛɛ hɔn; na obiara enntum annkyerɛ ase annkyerɛ Pharaoh.
Nna nsahyɛfo panyin no kaa kyerɛ Pharaoh dɛ, mekaa mo mfom ndɛ:
Pharaoh no bo fuuw no nkowaa, na ɔdze me kɔtoo efiadze wɔ abrafohen fie, emi nye paanootofo panyin no:
Na yɛsosoo daa anafua da kor, emi nye ɔno; yɛsosoo daa dɛ mbrɛ ɔbaako ne daa nye ne nkyerɛase tse.
Na Hebrewnyi aberantsɛ bi, abrafohen no n'akowaa, ɔnye hɛn wɔ hɔ; na yɛkaa kyerɛɛ no, na ɔkerɛɛ no ase.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔyɛɛ hɔ dɛ mbrɛ ɔkyerɛɛ hɛn ase no ara; emi ɔmaa mekedzii me dzibew, na ɔno ɔsɛɛn no.
Na Pharaoh somae ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ Joseph, na wɔyɛɛ ntsɛm dze no fii nkurufi no mu hɔ puei: Na oyii n'abɔdwe, na ɔsesaa n'atar, na ɔbaa Pharaoh hɔ.
Na Pharaoh see Joseph dɛ, maso daa, na obiara nnyi hɔ a otum ase kyerɛ: Na ɔwo na matse wo nka dɛ, etse daa a, ekyerɛ ase.
Na Joseph buaa Pharaoh dɛ, onnyi mo mu: Nyankopɔn ɔbɛma Pharaoh asomdwee mbuae.
Na Pharaoh kaa kyerɛ Joseph dɛ, M'adaaso mu, hwɛ, migyina esutsen no no kɔn do:
na, hwɛ, anantwiber esuon a wɔadɔ seradze na hɔn ho yɛ fɛw fi nsu no mu bae; na wobedzidzii sar no do:
Na, hwɛ, anantwiber esuon afofor so dzi hɔn ekyir bae a wɔyɛ mbɔbɔr na hɔn ho tantanntan nkamfenkamfe a, munnhun hɔn ho ne tantan ne saso pɛn wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do:
Na anantwiber a wɔyɛ nkamfenkamfe na hɔn ho tantan no wodzii anantwiber esuon a wɔadɔ seradze a wodzii kan no:
Na aber a wowiee hɔn dzi no, obi ennhu dɛ woewie hɔn dzi no, obi ennhu dɛ woewie hɔn dzi: Na hɔn ho da ho ara yɛ tantan dɛ nkan no ara so bio. Nna minyanee.
Na muhun wɔ m'adaaso mu, na, hwɛ, mbɛtsem esuon efifir eburonan kor do, amaama na oye:
Na, hwɛ, mbɛtsem esuon a enyinyam, na ɔyɛ nkɔkɔr, na boka mframa ama woetwintwam fifirii, dzii hɔn ekyir:
na mbɛtsem esuon nkɔkɔr no memeen mbɛtsem esuon a oye no: Na mekaa mekyerɛɛ nkongyaayifo no; na obiara nnyi hɔ a otumii kyerɛ me ase.
Na Joseph see Pharaoh dɛ, Pharaoh n’adaaso no kor: Dza Nyankopɔn rebɛyɛ na oeyi akyerɛ Pharaoh no.
Anantwiber pa esuon no ɔyɛ mfe esuon; na mbɛtsem pa esuon no oyɛ mfe esuon: Daa no yɛ kor.
Na anantwiber esuon a wɔafomfɔn na hɔn ho yɛ tantan no a wodzii hɔn ekyir bae no, ɔyɛ mfe esuon, mbɛtsem esuon nkɔkɔr a boka mframa ama enyinyam no so dɛmara; ɔbɛyɛ ɔkɔm mfe esuon.
ɔno nye asɛm a mekãa mekyerɛɛ Pharaoh no; dɛ dza Nyankopɔn rebɛyɛ nna oeyi akyerɛ Pharaoh no.
Hwɛ, mfe esuon reba a edziban piinara bɛba Egypt asaase nyinara do:
Na ɔno n’ekyir no nna ɔkɔm mfe esuon bɔsoɛr; na edziban pii no nyinara werɛ befir wɔ Egypt asaase do; na ɔkɔm no bɛhyɛw asaase no;
na osian ɔkɔm a odzi ekyir no ntsi wɔnnkɛkaa edziban pii no wɔ asaase no do; osiandɛ no mu bɛyɛ dzen dodow.
Na sɛ adaaso no ɔyɛɛ mbɔho ebien maa Pharaoh a, nna ne siantsir nye dɛ, Nyankopɔn esi no pi, na Nyankopɔn ɔbɛma ɔayɛ hɔ ntsɛntsɛm.
Dɛm ntsi afei wɔmma Pharaoh nhwehwɛ nyimpa a ɔyɛ ɔbadwembanyi nye onyansafo, na ɔnyɛ no panyin wɔ Egypt asaase do.
Wɔmma Pharaoh nyɛ yi, na ɔnhyehyɛ ahwɛdofo wɔ asaase no do, na wɔngyegye Egypt asaase do edziban no mbumu enum-enum wɔ mfe esuon a edziban pii wɔ mu no mu.
Na wɔmma wɔmboaboa mfe pa a ɔreba yi no mu edziban nyinara ano, na wɔmfa eburow nhyehyɛ asan do wɔ Pharaoh ne nsa ase, ma ɔnyɛ edziban wo nkurow no mu, na wɔmfa nsie.
Na edziban no bɛyɛ dza wɔakora ama asaase no dze esie ɔkɔm mfe esuon a ɔbɛba Egypt asaase do no; amma asaase no aannsɛɛ wɔ ɔkɔm no mu.
Na asɛm no yɛɛ Pharaoh nye no nkowaa nyinara dɛw.
Na Pharaoh see no nkowaa dɛ, Ana yebenya nyimpa a ɔtse dɛ oyi, nyimpa a Nyankopɔn no sunsum wɔ no, mu yi?
Na Pharaoh see Joseph dɛ, Susuampa dɛ Nyankopɔn dze yi nyinara akyerɛ wo yi, obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔyɛ ɔbadwembanyi nye onyansafo dɛ ɔwo:
ɔwo na ebɔhwɛ me fi yi do, na dza ebɛkã no, dza me man nyinara bedzi do nye no; ɔyɛ ahengua no nkotsee na medze me bɛsen wo.
Na Pharaoh see Joseph dɛ, hwɛ, mayɛ wo Egypt asaase nyinara do panyin.
Na Pharaoh worɔɔw no nsɔwanokaba wɔ ne nsa, na ɔdze hyɛɛ Joseph ne nsa, na ɔhyɛɛ no ndwera pa ntar, na ɔdze sika ntweaban too no kɔn mu;
na ɔmaa ɔtsenaa ne tseaseanam a otsia ebien no mu; na wohuae wɔ n'enyim dɛ, wombu nkotodwe; na ɔyɛɛ no Egypt asaase nyinara do.
Na Pharaoh see Joseph dɛ, emi nye Pharaoh, na obiara nnkokwetsir wo ɔama ne nsa anaa ne nan do wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do.
Na Pharaoh frɛɛ Joseph ne dzin Zaphenath-paneah; na odze osofo Potiphera ne babaa Asenath maa no awar. Na Joseph puei kekyimaa Egypt asaase do.
Na aber a Joseph gyinaa Egypthen Pharaoh n'enyim no, nna oedzi mfe eduasa. Na Joseph fii Pharaoh n’enyim, na okekyimaa Egypt asaase nyinara do.
Na bafuu mfe esuon no mu no, asaase no baa edziban ma obuu do.
Na ɔboaboaa mfe esuon a ɔbaa Egypt asaase do no mu edziban nyinara ano, na ɔdze edziban no siesiee nkurow no mu: Nhaban a wɔabɔ nkurow nyinara aprɔw no, no mu edziban na ɔdze siesiee nkurow no mu.
Na Joseph boaboaa eburow ano dɛ mpoano anhwea; ɔdɔɔ sõ dodow, ma nkyii ogyaa kan mpo; osiandɛ onnyi anobu.
Na wɔwoo mba beenu maa Joseph ansaana ɔkɔm afe no rudu, dza On ɔsɔfo Poti-phera ne babaa Asenath woo hɔn maa no no a.
Na Joseph frɛɛ abakan no ne dzin Manasseh: Na, ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn ama mo werɛ efir me berɛ nyinara, nye m’egya fie nyinara.
Na nyia otsia ebien no ofrɛɛ ne dzin Ephraim: Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn ama mawo wɔ amandzehu asaase no do.
Na ndɔbaa pii a ɔbaa Egypt asaase do mfe esuon no bɔɔ adze.
Na ɔkɔm mfe esuon hyɛɛ ase dɛ ɔreba, dɛ mbrɛ Joseph see no ara; na ɔkɔm baa asaase nyinara do: Na Egypt asaase nyinara do dze edziban wɔ hɔ.
Na okom kãa Egypt asaase nyinara no, ɔman no sūi tɔɔ Pharaoh do gyee edziban, na Pharaoh see Egyptfo no nyinara dɛ, Hom nkɔ Joseph hɔ: Dza ɔbɛse hom no, hom nyɛ.
Na ɔkɔm no baa asaase do nyinara, na Joseph buebuee mbrɛ edziban wɔ no nyinara, na ɔtɔnee maa Egyptfo no; na ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ Egypt asaase do.
Na aman nyinara baa Egypt Joseph hɔ bɔtɔɔ eburow, osiandɛ ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ asaase nyinara do.
42: Afei Jacob hun dɛ eburow wɔ Egypt, na Jacob see ne mbabanyin no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom hwehwɛɛhwɛ hom enyim nkorkor yi?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nhwɛ, matse dɛ eburow wɔ Egypt: Hom nkɔ hɔ na wɔnkɔtɔ bi wɔ hɔ nbrɛ hɛn; ama yaatsena ase, na yeennwu.
Na Joseph no nuanom du no kɔr Egypt dɛ wɔrokɔtɔ eburow;
na Joseph no nua Benjamin dze, Jacob amma ɔannye no nuanom no annkɔ; na ɔsee dɛ, bɛyɛ na ibi a mbusu bi ato no.
Na Israel ne mba no foraforaa hɔn a wɔbae no hɔn mu baa atɔ; osiandɛ ɔkɔm no esi Canaan asaase do,
Na Joseph na ɔyɛ asaase no do ambrado, ɔno na ɔtɔn ma asaase no do nkorɔfo nyinara: Na Joseph no nuanom no bae, na wɔbɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze maa no dze hɔn enyim bumboom famu.
Na Joseph n'enyi hun no nuanom no, ohun hɔn, na ɔyɛɛ noho ɔhɔho wɔ hɔn enyim, na ɔnye hɔn kasaa ebufuw do; na ɔsee dɛ, hom fi hen bae? Na wɔsee dɛ, Yefi Canaan asaase do bɔtɔɔ edziban.
Na Joseph hun no nuanom no, na hɔndze woennhu no.
Na Joseph kaa daa a ɔsosoo no hɔn ho no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom yɛ aserafo; asaase yi n'adagyaw na hom bae bɔhwee.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, dabida, mo wura, na wo nkowaa bae dɛ wɔrobɔtɔ edziban.
Hɛn nyinara yɛ nyimpa kɔr mba; yɛyɛ anokwafo, wo nkowaa nnyɛ aserofo bi.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, dabida, na asaase yi n'dagyaw na hom bae bɔhwɛɛ.
Na wɔsee dɛ, Wo nkowaa yɛyɛ enuanom duebien, nyimpa baako mba wɔ Canaan asaase do; na, hwɛ, ɔkaekyir no ɔwɔ hɛn egya nkyɛn ndɛ ara, na ɔbaako na onnyi hɔ.
Na Joseph see hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ ɔtse ma mekaa kyerɛɛ hom dɛ, Hom yɛ aserafo nye no:
Dza wɔdze bɔsɔ hom ahwɛ nye yi; dɛ Pharaoh tse ase yi hom nnkefi ha akɔ, gyedɛ hom nua kuma no aba ha ana.

Hom nsoma hom mu baako ma ɔnkɛfa hom nua no mbra, na homdze wɔbɔbɔ hom ndua mu ama wɔaasɔ hom nsɛm ahwɛ, dɛ nokwar wɔ hom mu anaa; annyɛ dɛm dze a, na ɔno dɛ Pharaoh tse ase yi ampaara hom yɛ aserafo.
Na ɔdze hɔn nyinara koguu efiadze ndaansa.
Na ne ndaansa no Joseph see hɔn dɛ, hom nyɛ yi, na hom ntsena ase; osiandɛ musuro Nyankopɔn:
Sɛ hom yɛ anokwafo a, ɔno wɔmma wɔnkyekyer hom nuanom mu baako wɔ efiadze mbrɛ hom da yi; na homdze hom nkɔ, hom nkɔsoa eburow nkɔ, wɔ hom efiefi kɔm ntsi:
Na wɔnkɛfa hom nua kuma no mbrɛ me; na hom bɛyɛ nokwafo, na hom nnkowu. Na wɔyɛɛ dɛm.
Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, yedzi hɛn nua no ho fɔ ampaara, dɛ hɛnara yehun ne kra n'ahohiahia wɔ aber a ɔrototɔ serɛ hɛn no, na yeeenntsie; dɛm ntsi na dɛm ahohiahia yi aba hɛn do yi.
Na Reuben buaa hɔn dɛ, Mannka mannkyerɛ hom dɛ, Mma hom nnyɛ bɔn nntsia abofra no; na hom enntsie? Dɛm ntsi so, hwɛ, no bɔgyaa na wɔrohwehwe yi.
Na wonnyim dɛ Joseph tse; osiandɛ oyianofo gyina hɔn ntamu.
Na ɔdaan no ho fii hɔn nkyɛn, na okosui; na ɔsanee baa hɔn nkyɛn, na ɔbɛkasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn, na oyii Simein wɔ hɔn mu, na ɔkyekyeer no wɔ hɔn enyim.
Na Joseph hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa eburow nhyehyɛ hɔn nkotoku amaama, na wɔndan hɔn nyinara hɔn sika nhyehyɛ hɔn nkotoku mu nkorkor, na wɔmma hɔn kwan mu edziban: Na wɔyɛɛ hɔn dɛm.
Na wɔdze hɔn eburow no soasoaa hɔn nsoaso, na wosii mu fii hɔ.
Na hɔn mu baako saan no kotoku dɛ ɔrema n'asoaso edziban wɔ asoɛe no, ohun ne sika no; na, hwɛ, ɔhyɛ no kotoku ano.
Na ɔsee no nuanom no dɛ, wɔdze me sika asan ama me; na, hwɛ, ɔhyɛ mo kotoku mu: Na hɔn akoma tutui, na wɔdze ahopopo sesee hɔnho dɛ, Ebɛnadze na Nyankopɔn ayɛ hɛn yi?
Na wɔbaa hɔn egya Jacob hɔ wɔ Canaan asaase dɔ, na wɔbɛkaa dza ɔbaa hɔn do nyinara kyerɛɛ no dɛ,
ɔbarimba no, asaase no wura no, ɔnye hɛn kasaa ebufuw do, na ɔfaa hɛn dɛ yɛyɛ ɔman no ho aserafo:
na yɛsee no dɛ, yɛyɛ anokwafo; yɛnnyɛ aserafo:
Yɛyɛ enuanom duebien, egyamba; baako nnyi hɔ, na ekumaba no wɔ hɛn egya nkyɛn wɔ Canaan asaase do ndɛ ara.
Na ɔbarimba no, asaase wura no, see hɛn dɛ, Dza medze mubohu dɛ hom yɛ anokwafo nye yi; hom ndan hom nuanom baako ngya me nkyɛn, na hom mfa eburow nkɔ, wɔ hom efiefi kɔm ntsi, na hom nkɔ hom kwan:
Na hom nkɛfa hom nua kuma no mbrɛ me: Nna mubohu dɛ hom nnyɛ aserafo, na dɛ hom yɛ anokwafo: Nna mibeyi hom nua no medze no mama hom, na hom edzi gua wɔ asaase yi do
Na ɔbaa dɛ wohuehuee hɔn nkotoku mu eburow no, nna, hwɛ nyimpa biara ne sika-boa wɔ no kotoku mu: Na aber a hɔn nye hɔn egya wohun hɔn sika-mboa no, hɔn akoma tui.
Ma hɔn egya Jacob see hɔn dɛ, emi na hom ama mahwer me mba: Joseph nnyi hɔ, na Simeon nnyi hɔ, na hom rebɛfa Benjamin so akɔ; iyi nyinara aba mo do.
Na Reuben kaa kyerɛɛ n'egya dɛ, sɛ mammfa no mammbrɛ wo a, ku me mbabanyin beenu no: Fa no hyɛ me nsa, na medze no mebɛbrɛ wo bio.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Me ba nnkyɛnye hom akɔ; osiandɛ no nua ewu, na aka no nko: Sɛ mbusu bi ba na do wɔ kwn a wɔnam mu rokɔ no mu a, ɔno hom dze mo gon nam awerɛhow mu bɔkɔ nda mu.
43: Na ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ asaase no do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a wowiee eburow a wɔdze fi Egypt bae no dzi no, hɔn egya see hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ bio, hom nkɔtɔ edziban kakra mbrɛ hɛn.
Na Judah kãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, ɔbarimba no paa mu ara kaa kyerɛɛ no dɛɛ, hom runnhu m'enyim, gyedɛ hom nua no ka hom ho.
Sɛ ebɛma hɛn nua no nye hɛn akɔ a, nna yɛbɔkɔ na yɛakɔtɔ edziban abrɛ wo:
Na sɛ ennkɛma ɔaka hɛn ho dze a, ɔno yɛronnkɔ: Osiandɛ ɔbarimba no see hɛn dɛ, Mma hom nnhu m'enyim, gyedɛ hom nua no ka hom ho.
Na Isreal see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom nye me dzi no bɔn dɛm, dɛ hom kaa kyerɛɛ ɔbarimba no dɛ hom wɔ nua bi so?

Na wɔsee dɛ, ɔbarimba no bisaa hɛn ebusuafo ho, dɛ, Ana hom egya da ho tse ase? Hom wɔ nua bi so a? Na mbrɛ nsɛm yi tse no ara na hɛn so yeyii no ano: Ana hɛn so yenyim dɛ ɔreyɛ na ɔase dɛ, wɔnkɛfa hom nua no mbra?
Na Judah see n'egya Isreal dɛ, Ma abofra no nye me nkɔ, na yɛbɔsor na yɛakɔ, ama yeenya nkwa, na yeennwu, hɛn nye ɔwo nyina, nye hɛn mbofraba so.
Mibedzi no ho egyinamu; hwehwɛ no me nsamu: Sɛ mammfa no ammbrɛ wo, na mammfa no emmbegyina w'enyim a, ɔno wɔmma asodzi no ɔnka mo kɔn mu daa:
Sɛ yennkyinkyim a nkyɛ ebodu sisei, ɔyɛ dɛn ara a yɛakɔ aba mpɛn ebien.

Na hɔn egya Israel see hɔn dɛ, sɛ mbrɛ ɔtse nye yi a, ɔno hom nyɛ yi; hom mfa asaase yi do nduadzewa a oye bi ngu hom ndzemba mu, na hom mfa akyɛdze nkɛma ɔbarimba no, balm kakra, nye ewo kakra, eduhuam nye myrrh, pistachio, nye almond,
na hom mfa sika fofor nsian ho; na sika a wɔdze sanee maa hom a wɔdze hyehyɛɛ hom nkotoku ano no ɔno so wɔmfa nkitsa bio; sisei a enyi na oduaa do;
hom mfa hom nua no so, na wɔnsoɛr nkɔ ɔbarimba no hɔ bio:
Na Otumfo Nyankopɔn mma ɔbarimba no nhu hom mbɔbɔr, ama oeegyaa hom nua kor no nye Benjamin ama hom. Na sɛ emi me mba fi me nsa a, nna woefi me nsa.
Nna nkorɔfo no faa akyɛdze no, na wɔfaa sika fofor siaan ho, nye Benjamin so; na wɔsoɛree kɔr Egypt, na wokegyinaa Joseph n'enyim.
Na aber a Joseph hun dɛ Benjamin ka hɔn ho no, ɔsee ne fi piafo no dɛ, fa mbarimba yi kɔ fie, na koku mbowa, na yɛ edziban; na mbarimba yi nye me bedzidzi ewiaber yi.
Na ɔbarimba no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Joseph see no ara; na ɔbarimba no dze nkorɔfo no kɔr Joseph fie.

Na nkorɔfo no hɔn akoma tui, osiandɛ wɔdze hɔn akɔ Joseph fie ntsi; na wɔsee dɛ, Sika a wɔsanee dze hyehyɛɛ hɛn nkotoku mu nkankan no ntsi na wɔdze hɛn aba fie yi; ama ɔaahwehwɛ biribi egyina do, na oeesuo hɛn mu, na ɔaafa hɛn ayɛ nkowaa, nye hɛn nsoaso.
Na wopiin Joseph ne fie piafo no nkyɛn, na wɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ no wɔ fi no n'abowano.
Na wɔsee dɛ, Ao mowura, yɛbaa ha bɔtɔɔ edziban nkankan no ampa:
