Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a yedur asoɛe, na yɛsansaan hɛn nkotoku ano no, nna, hwɛ, hɛn nyinara hɛn sika hyehyɛ hɛn nkotoku ano, hɛn sika mbrɛ ɔtow ara pɛ: Na yɛdze asan aba.
Na yɛdze robɔtɔ edziban: Yennyim nyia ɔdze hɛn sika no hyehyɛɛ hɛn nkotoku mu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, asomdwee nka hom, mma hom nnsuro: Hom Nyankopɔn, nye hom egya ne Nyankopɔn, na ɔama hom ehutudze wɔ hom nkotoku mu: Me nsa kaa hom sika no. Na okeyii Simeon brɛɛ hɔn.
Na barimba no dze nkorɔfo no kɔr Joseph fie, na ɔmaa hɔn anan ho; na ɔmaa hɔn nsoaso edziban.
Na wɔyɛɛ akyɛdze no krado dze tweɔɔn Joseph ne mbae a ɔbaa ewiaber no: Osiandɛ wɔtsee dɛ woribedzidzi wɔ hɔ.
Na Joseph baa fie no, wɔdze akyɛdze a okitsa hɔn nsamu no kɔr dan mu kɛmaa no, na wɔkɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze wɔ famu maa no
Na obisaa hɔn honam mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Ana hom egya akɔdaa a hom kaa no ho asɛm no, no ho ye? Ana ɔda ho tse ase?
Na wɔsee dɛ, w'akowaa hɛn egya no ho ye, ɔda ho tse ase. Na wɔbɔɔ hɔn tsir adze, na wɔkotoow no.
Na ɔmaa n'enyiwa do, na ohun no nua Benjamin, ne na ba no, na ɔsee dɛ Ana hom nua kuma a hom kaa no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ me no, ɔno nye yi a? Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn ndom wo, me ba.
Na Joseph yɛɛ ntsɛm; osiandɛ ne yamu hyehyee no maa no nua no; na ɔhwehwɛɛ beebi oekosu; na ɔkɔr ne pia mu, na okosui wɔ hɔ.
Na ɔhohoor n'enyim, na opuei; na ɔkonkoom noho do, na ɔsee dɛ, wɔmfa edziban mbesisi hɔ.
Na wɔdze ɔnoara nedze sii fa, na wɔdze hɔndze sisii fa, na wɔdze Egyptfo a wɔnye no dzidzi no hɔndze sisii fa; osiandɛ Egyptfo nnye Hebrewfo nndzidzi; na ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma Egyptfo.
Na wɔtsenatsenaa n'enyim, abakan no dɛ mbrɛ ne panyin tse. Nye ekumaba no dɛ mbrɛ n'ekumaba tse: Na ɔyɛɛ nkorɔfo no nwanwa wɔ hɔn mu.
Na oyiyii edziban ma wɔdze fii n'enyim kyɛɛn hɔn: Na Benjamin dze n'edziban ɔbor hɔn nyinara hɔndze do mpɛn enum. Na wɔnomee, na wɔnye no hɔn enyi gyee.
44: Na ɔhyɛɛ ne fie piafo no dɛ, fa edziban dodowara a nkorɔfo no botum asoa hyehyɛ hɔn nkotoku mu, na fa nyimpa biara ne sika hyɛ no kotoku ano.
Na fa mo kɔɔpow no, dwɛɛtɛɛ kɔɔpow no, hyɛ hɔn mu ekumaba no no kotoku ano, nye n'eburow sika no. Na ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Joseph kae no ara.
Enyim tsetse wee ara na wɔgyee nkorɔfo no kwan, hɔn nye hɔn nsoaso.
Na wofii kurow no mu kɔree, na wonnyae nndur ekyirkir no, Joseph see ne piafo no dɛ, Soɛr, tsiw nkorɔfo no; na sɛ eto hɔn a, se hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hɔm dze bɔn etua papa kaw yi?
Ana nnyɛ iyi na mo wura nom mu, na ɔdze hyɛ nkɔm ma ɔba mu no bi? Hom ayɛ bɔn dɛ hom ayɛ dɛm.
Na ɔtoo hɔn, na ɔkaa nsem yi kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mo wura ka nsɛm a ɔtse dɛm yi? Nyankopɔn mpa ngu dɛ wo nkowaa bɛyɛ dɛm adze.
Hwɛ, sika a yehun no hɛn nkotoku mu no, yɛdze fii Canaan asaase do brɛɛ wo bio: Ɔbɛyɛ dɛn mbɔ na yebowia dwɛɛtɛɛ anaa sika wɔ wo wura ne fie?
Wo nkowaa hɛn mu biara a ibohu no wɔ no hɔ no, ma onwu, na hɛn so yɛbɛyɛ mo wura nkowaa.
Na ɔsee dɛ, nna afei wɔmma ɔnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ hom aka yi ara: Nyia wobohu no no hɔ no ɔbɛyɛ m'akowaa; na hom wonndzi so.
Nna wɔyɛɛ no ntsɛm, na nyimpa biara soɛɛ no kotoku too famu, na nyimpa biara saan no kotoku ano.
Na ɔhwehwɛe, ofitsi panyin no do, na ɔdze kɛpeem ekumaba no do: Na wohun kɔɔpow no wɔ Benjamin no kotoku mu.
Nna wosunsuaan hɔn ntar mu, na obiara dze n'adze soaa n'asoaso, na wosanee kɔr kurow no mu.
Na Judah nye no nuanom no baa Joseph fie; nna ɔda ho wɔ n'enyim.
Na Joseph see hɔn dɛ, ebɛnadze na hom ayɛ yi? Ana hom nnyim dɛ nyimpa a ɔtse dɛ emi yi mubotum dɛ mehyɛ nkɔm ma ɔba mu bi a?
Na Judah see dɛ, yɛnse mo wura dɛn? Yɛnka dɛn? Anaadɛ yerudua dɛn asan hɛnho? Nyankopɔn eyi wo nkowaa hɛn emumuyɛ edzi: Hwɛ, yɛyɛ mo wura no nkowaa, hɛn nye nyia wohun kɔɔpow no wɔ ne nsamu nyinara.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn mpa ngu dɛ mebɛyɛ dɛm: Nyia woehu kɔɔpow no wɔ ne nsamu no, ɔnoara na ɔbɛyɛ m'akowaa; na homdze hom nkɔ hom egya nkyɛn wɔ asomdwee mu.
Nna Judah piin ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Ao mo wura, mesɛrɛ wo, ma w'akowaa nka asɛm kor wɔ mo wura n'asomu, na mma wo bo mmfuw w'akowaa: Osiandɛ tserɛ woara nye Pharoah.
Mo wura bisaa no nkowaa dɛ, Ana hom wɔ egya, anaa nua bi?
Na yɛsee mo wura dɛ, Yɛwɔ egya, akɔdaa bi, na no nkɔdaa ba kakraba bi; na no nua ewu na ne ba a aka ara nye no nko, na n'egya dɔ no.
Na esee wo nkowaa dɛ, wɔnkɛfa no mbrɛ me, ma monhwɛ no.
Na yɛsee mo wura dɛ, abofra no fi n'egya nkyɛn a ɔnnkɛyɛ: Na sɛ ofi n'egya nkyɛn a, n'egya bowu.
Na esee wo nkowaa dɛ, gyedɛ hom nua kuma no nye hom ba, ɔno hom nnkohu m'enyim bio.
Na ɔbaa dɛ yɛkɔr w'akowaa, m'egya nkyɛn no, nna yɛkãa mo wura ne nsɛm no kyerɛɛ no.
Na hɛn egya see dɛ, hom nkɔ bio nkɔtɔ edziban kakra mbrɛ hɛn.
Na yɛsee dɛ, yɛkɔ a ɔnnkyɛyɛ: Sɛ hɛn nua kuma no ka hɛn ho a, ɔno yɛbɔkɔ: Osiandɛ sɛ hɛn nua kuma no nnka hɛn ho a, ɔno yennkohu barimba no n'enyim.
Na w'akowaa, m'agya no see hɛn dɛ, homara nyim dɛ me yer woo mba benu maa me:
na baako fii me nkyɛn kɔree, na mesee dɛ, ampaara wɔatsetsew no mu, na munnhun no araa ɔdze ebodu ndɛ yi:
na sɛ hom yi oyi so wɔ me nkyɛn, na mbusu bi ba no do a, ɔno hom dze mo gon nam awerɛhow mu bɔkɔ nda mu.
Dɛm ntsi afei sɛ mokɔ w'akowaa, m'egya no nkyɛn, na sɛ abofra no nnka hɛn ho a, ɔnam dɛ no nkwa fam abofra no no nkwa ho ntsi,
ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛohu dɛ abofra no nnka hɛn ho a, ɔno obowu na wo nkowaa dze w'akowaa, hɛn egya no, no gon nam awerɛhow mu bɔkɔ nda mu.
Osiandɛ w'akowaa midzii abofra no ho egyinamu maa m'egya dɛ, sɛ mammfa no mammbrɛ wo a, ɔno mibedzi sõ wɔ m'egya n'enyim daa.
Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, ma w'akowaa mindzi abofra no ananmu menyɛ mo wura ɔsomfo; na ma abofra no ɔnye no nuanom nkɔ.
Na mibesinno dɛn na makɔ m'egya nkyɛn, na abofra no nnka mo ho? Bɛyɛ na mehu mbusu a ɔbɛba m'egya no do.
45: Na afei Joseoh ɔkom noho do a ɔnnyɛ yie, wɔ hɔn a wogyinagyina ne nkyɛn no nyinara hɔn enyim; na ɔkaa mu dɛ, wɔmma nkorɔfo nyinara mfi me nkyɛn mfi, na mber a Joseph riyi noho edzi akyerɛ no nuanom no, nna obiara nngyina ne nkyɛn.
Na ɔmaa ne ndze do sūi; na Egyptfo no tsee, na Pharaoh fiefo tsee.
Na Joseph see no nuanom no dɛ, emi nye Joseph; ana m’egya da ho tse ase? Na no nuanom no enntum emmbua no; osiandɛ hɔn ho popoe wɔ n’enyim.
Na Joseph see no nuanom no dɛ, meserɛ hom, wompin me nkyɛn. Na wopinii. Na ɔsee dɛ, emi nye hom nua Joseph a hom tɔɔn no baa Egypt no.
Na afei mma ɔnnyɛ hom yaw, na mma hom bo mmfufuw homho so, dɛ hom tɔɔn me baa ha: Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn na ɔsomaa me ma midzii hom enyim kan, ama maabɛgye nkwa.
Osiandɛ ɔkɔm esi asaase yi do mfe ebien nye yi: Na mfe enum so aka a adɔw nye buber so nnyi mu.
Na Nyankopɔn somaa me ma midzii hom enyim kan ama maabɔkora edzinkaa bi ama hom wɔ asaase do, na medze ɔgye kɛsenara maagye hom nkwa.
Dɛm ntsi afei, nnyɛ hom bi na wɔsomaa me wɔ ha, na Nyankopɔn a: Na ɔayɛ me Pharaoh n’egya, na ne fi nyinara wura na Egypt asaase nyinara do panyin.
Hom nka hom ho nkɔ m’egya hɔ, na wɔnkɛse no dɛ, Mbrɛ wo ba Joseph se nye yi, Nyankopɔn ayɛ me Egypt nyinara wura: Bra me nkyɛn, mma nnkyinkyim:
Na bɛtsena Goshen asaase do, na bɛn me, ɔwo, nye wo mba, nye wo mbanananom, nye wo nguan, nye w’anantwi, nye dza ewɔ nyinara:
Na mobɔhwɛ wo wɔ hɔ; na aka ɔkɔm mfe enum so; bohu na ehia, ɔwo, nye wo fidua, nye dza ewɔ nyinara.
Na, hwɛ, hom enyiwa tua, na mo nua Benjamin n’enyiwa tua, dɛ m'ano na ɔrekasa kyerɛ hom yi.
Na hom nkɛkã m’enyimnyam a mowɔ no wɔ Egypt nyinara no ho asem nkyerɛ m’egya, na dza hom ehu no nyinara; na hom nyɛ ntsɛm nkɛfa m’egya mbra ha.
Na ɔbaar no nua Benjamin no kɔn, na osūi; na Benjamin so sūi wɔ no kɔn ho.
Na ofifeew no nuanom nyinara hɔn ano, na ɔdzedze hɔn mu sūi: Na n’ekyir no no nuanom no nye no kasae.
Na wɔtsee nka wɔ Pharaoh fie dɛ, Joseph no nuanom aba: Na Pharaoh nye no nkowaa wɔpɛe ara papa.
Na Pharaoh see Joseph dɛ, Se wo nuanom no dɛ, iyi na hom nyɛ: Wɔnsoasoa hom mbowa adze, na hom nkɔ, wɔnkɔ Canaan asaase do;
na hom nkɛfa hom egya nye hom fifo, na wɔmbra me nkyɛn: Na mebɛma hom Egypt asaase no mu dza oye, na bedzi asaase no do adze pa.
Afei wɔahyɛ wo, iyi na hom nyɛ; hom mfa ntseaseanam wɔ Egypt asaase do nkɛfa hom mbofraba, nye hom yernom, na wɔnkɛfa hom egya, na wɔmbra.
Eso mma wɔmma hom ndzɛmba ho nnhia hom; na dza oye wɔ Egypt asaase do nyinara yɛ homdze.
Na Israel ne mba no yɛɛ dɛm: Na Joseph maa hɔn ntseaseanam, dɛ mbrɛ Pharaoh hyɛe no ara, na ɔmaa hɔn kwan mu edziban.
Hɔn nyinara ɔmaa hɔn ntar nsakyerho nkorkor; na Benjamin dze, ɔmaa no ndwetɛbona ahaasa, riye ntar nsakyerho enum.
Na dza ɔdze kɛmaa n’egya nye yi; nsoaso du a wɔsoso Egypt ndzɛmba pa, nye nsoasober du a wɔsoso eburow, nye boodoo, nye edzidzidze a ɔyɛ n’egya no kwan mu dze.
Nna ogyaa no nuanora no kwan, na wosii mu na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ mma hom aannka yaw wɔ kwan mu.
Na wofii Egypt kɔree, na wɔbaa hɔn egya Jacob nkyɛn wɔ Canaan asaase do.
Na wokãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Joseph da ho tse ase, na ɔno nye Egypt asaase nyinara do panyin. Na ogurae, osiandɛ ɔanngye hɔn enndzi.
Na wɔkãa Joseph ne nsɛm a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn no nyinara kyerɛɛ no: Na aber a ohun ntseaseanam a Joseph maa wɔdze kɔree dɛ womfa nkɛfa no no, nna hɔn egya Jacob no sunsum hyɛɛ dzen:
na Israel see dɛ, ɔdɔɔ sõ; me ba Joseph da ho tse ase: Mobɔkɔ mekohu no ana mewu.
46: Na Israel dze dza ɔwɔ nyinara sii mu. Na ɔbaa Beer-sheba, na ɔbɔɔ afɔr maa n'egya Isaac ne Nyankopɔn.
Na Nyankopɔn kasaa kyerɛɛ Israel wɔ anafua nyikyerɛ mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Jacob, Jacob, na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye yi.
Na ɔse dɛ, Emi nye Nyankopɔn, w'gya ne Nyankopɔn: Mma nsuro dɛ ebɔkɔ Egypt; na mebɛyɛ wo ɔman kɛse wɔ hɔ.
menye wo bɔkɔ Egypt; na medze wo mefi hɔ maba bio so ampaara: Na Joseph dze ne nsa bɛka w'enyiwa emua do.
Na Jacob soɛree fii Beer-sheba: Ba Israel ne mba wotwuuw hɔn egyan Jacob, nye hɔn mbofraba, nye hɔn yernom, wɔ ntseaseanam a Pharaoh maa wɔdze baa dɛ wɔmfa mbɛfa no no mu.
Na wɔfaa hɔn mbowa, nye hɔn ahodze a wonyaa no wɔ Canaan asaase do no, na wɔbaa Egypt, Jacob nye n'asefo nyinara a wɔka no ho:
ne mbambanyin, nye ne mbabanyin hɔn mbabanyin ka no ho, ne mbabaa nye ne mbabanyin hɔn mbabaa, nye n'asefo nyinara na wɔka no ho na ɔnye hɔn baa Egypt.
Na Israel ne mba a wɔbaa Egypt no hɔn edzin nye yi, Jacob nye ne mbabanyin: Jacob n'abakan Reuben.
Na Reuben ne mbabanyin; Hanoch nye Pallu, nye Hezron, nye Carmi.
Na Simeon ne mbabanyin; Jemuel nye Jamin, nye Chad, nye Jachin nye Zohar, nye Shaul, Canaannyi ɔbaa bi ne ba no.
Na Levi ne mbabanyin; Gershon, Kohath, nye Merari.
Na Judah ne mbabanyin; Er, nye Onan, nye Shelah, nye Perez, nye Zerah: Na Er nye Onan dze, wowuu Canaan asaase do. Na Perez ne mbabanyin nye Hezron nye Hamul.
Na Isaachar ne mbabanyin; Tola, nye Puvah, nye lob, nye Shimron.
Na Zebulun ne mbabanyin; Sered, nye Elon, nye Jaleel.
Woyinom nye Leah no mbabanyin a ɔwoo hon maa Jacob wɔ Paddanaram ɔnye ne babaa Dinah: Ne mbabanyin nye ne mbabaa nyinara wɔyɛ akra eduasa ebiasa.
Na Gad ne mbabanyin; Ziphion, nye Haggi, Shuni, nye Ezbon, Eri, nye Arodi, nye Areli.
Asher ne mbabanyin; Imnah, nye Ishvah, nye Ishvi, nye Beriah, nye hɔn akyerɛbaa Serah: na Beriah ne mbabanyin; Heber, nye Malchiel.
Woyinom nye Zilpah a Laban dze no maa ne babaa Leah no ne mbabanyin, na woyinom na ɔwoo hɔn maa Jacob; wɔyɛ akra duesia.
Jacob ne yer Rachel ne mbabanyin; Joseph nye Benjamin.
Na wɔwoo Manasseh nye Ephraim wɔ Egypt asaase do maa Joseph, On ɔsɔfo Potiphera ne babaa Asenath woo hɔn maa no.
Na Benjamin ne mbabanyin; Bela, nye Becher, nye Ashbel, Gera, nye Naaman, Ehi, nye Rosh, Muppim, nye Huppim, nye Ard.
Woyinom nye Rachel ne mbabanyin a wɔwoo hɔn maa Jacob: Hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ akra duanan.
Na Dan ne mbabanyin; Hushim.
Na Naphtali ne mbabanyin; Jahzeel, nye Guni, nye Jezer, nye Shiliem.
Woyinom nye Bilhah a Laban dze no maa ne babaa Rachel no ne mbabanyin; na woyinom na ɔwoo hɔn maa Jacob: Hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ akra esuon.
Akra a wɔnye Jacob kɔr Egypt a; wofi n'asen mu nyinara, Jacob ne mbabanyin yernom nnka ho a, akra no nyinara wɔyɛ eduesia esia;
Na Joseph ne mbabanyin a wɔwoo hɔn maa no wɔ Egypt no wɔyɛ akra beenu: Jacob ne fie akra a wɔbaa Egypt no nyinara, wɔyɛ eduosuon.
Na ɔsomaa Judah ma odzii n'enyim kan kɔr Joseph hɔ, ama oeebedzi n'enyim akyerɛ no Goshen kwan; na wɔbaa Goshen asaase do.
Na Joseph yɛɛ ne tseaseanam krado, na ɔkɔree kehyiaa n'egya Israel kwan wɔ Goshen; na ɔdze noho kyerɛɛ no, na ɔbaar no kɔn, na osūi wɔ no kɔn ho ara ma ɔkyɛɛr kakra.
Na Israel see Joseph dɛ, menya mehu dɛ eda ho ara etse ase yi, afei ma munwu.
Na Joseph see no nuanom, nye n’egya ne fifo dɛ, morokɔ na makɛkã makyerɛ Pharaoh, na mase no dɛ, Mo nuanom, nye m’egya ne fifo a wɔwɔ Canaan asaase do no aba me nkyɛn:
Na nkorɔfo no wɔyɛ nguanhwɛfo, na mbowa na wɔnyɛn; na wɔdze hon nguan, nye hɔn anantwi, nye dza wɔwɔ nyinara aba.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ Pharaoh frɛ hom, na ɔse dɛ, wɔyɛ ebɛn edwuma a?

Ɔno hom nse dɛ, Ofitsi hɛn mbofra mu ɔdze bɛpem ndɛ ara wo nkowaa mbowa ara na yɛnyɛn, hɛn, nye hɛn egyanom nyinara: Ama hom aatsena Goshen asaase do; osiandɛ oguanhwɛfo biara ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma Egyptfo.
47: Nna Joseph sii mu kɔr fie na ɔkɛkãa kyerɛɛ Pharaoh, na ɔsee dɛ, m'egya nye mo nuanom, nye hɔn nguan, nye hɔn anantwi, nye dza wɔwɔ nyinara, fi Canaan asaase do aba; na, hwɛ, wɔwɔ Goshen asaase do.
Na ɔfaa no nuanom no hɔn mu beenum, na ɔdze hɔn kɛkyerɛɛ Pharaoh.
Na pharaoh see no nuanom no dɛ, wɔyɛ ebɛn edwuma? Na wɔsee Pharaoh dɛ, wo nkowaa yɛyɛ nguanhwɛfo, hɛn nye hɛn egyanom nyina.

Na wɔsee Pharaoh dɛ, yɛaba dɛ yɛrebɛtsena asaase yi do; na wo nkowaa hɔn nguan nnya edzidzibea; osiandɛ ɔkɔm no mu ayɛ dzen wɔ Canaan asaase do: Dɛm ntsi afei, yɛserɛ wo, ma wo nkowaa ntsena Goshen asaase do.
Na Pharaoh kãa kyerɛɛ Joseph dɛ, w'egya nye wo nuanom aba wo nkyɛn:
Egypt asaase da w’enyim; asaase no mu mbrɛ oye no na ma w’egya nye wo nuanom ntsena; ma wɔntsena Gosnen asaase do: Na sɛ inyim hɔn mu bi a wɔyɛ mbɔdzembɔfo a, ɔno yɛ hɔn mo mbowa do ahwɛfo.
Na Joseph dze n’egya Jacob baa fie, na ɔdze no begyinaa Pharaoh n’enyim: Na Jacob hyiraa Pharaoh.
Na Pharaoh see Jacob dɛ, wo nkwa mu mfe nda yɛ ahen?
Na Jacob see Pharaoh dɛ, m’akwantu ne mfe nda yɛ mfe ɔha eduasa: Mo nkwa ne mfe nda kumaabi na mbusu nko, na ɔnntoo m’egyanom hɔn nkwa ne mfe nda wo hɔn akwantu ber no mu.
Na Jacob hyiraa Pharaoh, na ofii Pharaoh n’enyim kɔree.
Na Joseph maa n’egya nye no nuanom no tsenabew, na ɔmaa hɔn beebi wo Egypt asaase do, wɔ asaase no do mbrɛ oye, wɔ Rameses asaase do, dɛ mbrɛ Pharaoh hyɛe no ara.
Na Joseph bɔɔ n’egya, nye no nuanom, nye n’egya ne fifo nyinara akɔhoma, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na edziban nnyi asaase no do beebiara; na ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen dodoodow, ma Egypt asaase nye Canaan asaase tɔɔ bitsi wɔ ɔkɔm no ntsi.
Na Joseph boaboaa sika a wonyaa no Egypt asaase do, nye Canaan asaase do no, eburow a wɔtɔe no ne sika no nyinara ano: Na Joseph dze sika no baa Pharaoh fie.
Na aber a sika nyinara sãe wɔ Egypt asaase do, nye Canaan asaase do no, Egyptfo no nyinara baa Joseph hɔ, na wɔbɛsee dɛ, ma hɛn edziban: Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn ntsi na yebowu w’enyim? Na hɛn sika asa.
Na Joseph see dɛ, wɔmfa hom mbowa mma; na mebɛgye hom mbowa na mama hom bi, sɛ sika asã a.
Na wɔdze hɔn mbowa brɛɛ Joseph: Na Joseph maa hɔn edziban dze gyee mpɔnkɔ, nye nguan, nye anantwi, nye nsoaso: Na ɔmaa hɔn edziban dze gyee hɔn mbowa nyinara wɔ afe no mu.

Na afe no bɛsenee no, wɔbaa no hɔ afe a otsīa ebien no, na wɔbɛsee no dɛ, yɛnnkɛfa esuma mo wura dɛ, hɛn sika nyinara asã; na mbowa nyinara yɛ mo wura dze; biribiara nnyi hɔ a ɔaka wɔ mo wura n’enyim, ka hɛn honam nye hɛn asaase ho;

ebɛnadze ntsi na yebowu w’enyim, hɛn nye hɛn asaase nyina? Fa edziban tɔ hɛn nye hɛn asaase, na hɛn nye hɛn asaase bɛyɛ asomfo ama Pharaoh: Na ma hɛn amba, ama yaatsena ase, na yeennwunu, na amma asaase yi aannda pan.
Nna Joseph tɔɔ Egypt asaase nyinara maa Pharaoh; na Egypt fo nyinara tontɔɔn hɔn haban, osiandɛ ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ hɔn do: Na asaase no bɛyɛɛ Pharaoh dze.
Na nkorɔfo no dze, otuu hɔn hɔ ma wɔkɛtsenatsenaa nkurow a ofi Egypt ɔhe ne patsia kɛpem ne patsia no mu.
Asɔfo no hɔn asaase nko na ɔanntɔ: Osiandɛ Pharaoh maa asɔfo no kyɛfa bi, na wodzii hɔn kyɛfa a pharaoh dze maa hɔn no; dɛm ntsi wɔanntɔn hɔn asaase.
Nna Joseph see nkorɔfo no dɛ, hwɛ matɔ hom nye hom asaase ndɛ mama Pharaoh: Hwɛ, hom amba nye yi, na hom nkoduadua no wɔ asaase no do.
Na ɔmbra dɛ ahadze yi mu no, hom dze mu mbumu enumenum bɛma Pharaoh, na anan no ayɛ homankasa homdze, ma wɔdze bi edua haban mu, na ɔayɛ edziban ama hom mbofraba.
Na wɔsee dɛ, Agye hɛn nkwa: Ma yɛnnya mo wura n'enyim enyimnyam, na yɛbɛyɛ Pharaoh n'Ndwuma.
Na Joseph dze yɛɛ mbra too hɔ wɔ Egypt asaase do ɔdze bɛpem ndɛ ara, dɛ wɔmfa mbumu enum-enum mma Pharaoh; gyedɛ asɔfo no hɔn asaase nkotoo na ɔannyɛ Pharaoh dze.
Na Israel tsenaa Egypt asaase do, wɔ Goshen asaase do; na wonyaa adze wɔ mu, na wɔwowoe, na wɔdɔɔr pii.
Na Jacob tsenaa Egypt asaase do mfe dueson: Na Jacob ne nda, no nkwa ne mfe, ɔyɛ mfe ɔha eduanan esuon.

Na mber a Israel dze bowu no ɔbɛnee: Na ɔfrɛɛ ne ba Joseph, na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ afei menya w,enyim enyimnyam a, meserɛ wo, fa wo nsa to m'aserɛ ase, na enye me ndzi no ayamuyie mu nye nokwar mu; maserɛ wo, mma nsie me wɔ Egypt:
Na sɛ menye m'egyanom da a, ɔno soa me fa me fi Egypt, na kesie me wɔ hɔn esiei. Na ɔsee dɛ, Mebɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ akã no ara.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Dzi nsew kyerɛ me: Nna odzii nsew kyerɛɛ no. Na Israel bɔɔ no mu adze wɔ mpa no n'etsifi.
48: Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom ekyir no, obi see Joseph dɛ, hwɛ, w'egya yar: Na ɔfaa ne mbabanyin beenu no, Manasseh nye Ephraim kaa no ho.
Na obi kaã kyerɛɛ Jacob dɛ, hwɛ, wo ba Joseph reba wo nkyɛn: Na Isreal miaa n'enyi, na ɔtsenaa mpa do.
Na Jacob see Joseph dɛ, Otumfo Nyankopɔn yii noho kyerɛɛ me wɔ Luz wɔ Canaan asaase do, na ohyiraaa me,
na ɔsee me dɛ, hwɛ, mebɛma awo, na mama adɔr, na mebɛyɛ wo aman asafo; na medze asaase yi ama w'asefo a wobedzi w'ekyir ma wɔdze ayɛ daa enyadze.
Na afei wo mba beenu a wɔwoo hɔn maa wo wɔ Egypt asaase do ansaana mereba wo nkyɛn wɔ Egypt no, wɔyɛ medze; Ephraim nye Manasseh, wɔbɛyɛ edze, dɛ Reuben nye Simeon ara so bio.
Na wo mba a hɔn ekyir ebɔwo hɔn no, na wɔbɛyɛ wodze; wɔdze hɔn nuanom dzin bɛfrɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn egyapadze mu.
Na emidze, mifi Paddan mebae no, Rachel wuu me nkyɛn wɔ kwan mu wɔ Canaan asaase do, aber a aka ɔkwan kakra bi ma edu Ephrath no: Na misiee no Ephrath kwan mu hɔ (Ɔnoara nye Beth-lehem).
Na Israel hun Joseph ne mba no, na ɔsee dɛ Woananom nye yi?
Na Joseph see n'egya dɛ, me mba a Nyankopɔn dze hɔn ama me wɔ ha a. Na ɔsee dɛ, meserɛ wo, fa hɔn brɛ me, ma minhyira hɔn.
Na nyin dodow ntsi Israel n'enyiwa do ayɛ no wantawanta, ma onntum nnhu adze. Na ɔdze hɔn piin ne nkyɛn; na ofeew hɔn ano, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn etuu.
Na Israel see Joseph dɛ, Manndwen dɛ nkyɛ mubohu w'enyim: Na, hwɛ, Nyankopɔn ama mehu wo mba so.
Na Joseph yii hɔn wɔ n'anan ntamu bae; na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze dze n'enyim boom famu.
Na Joseph faa hɔn beenu nyana, ne nsa enyimfa dze Ephraim mu wɔ Israel n'abankum, na ne nsa abankum dze Manasseh mu wɔ Israel n'enyimfa, na ɔdze hɔn piin ne nkyɛn.
Na Israel tseen ne nsa enyimfa, na ɔdze too Ephraim a ɔyɛ ekumaba no n'etsifi, na ɔdze ne nsa abankum too Manasseh n'etsifi, ɔboapa ara yɛɛ ne nsa dɛm; osiandɛ Manasseh nye abakan.
Na ohyiraa Joseph, na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn no a m'egyanom Abraham nye Isaac Wɔnantsew n'enyim no, Nyankopɔn no a ɔahwɛ me mo nkwaber nyinara mu ma ɔdze abɛpem ndɛ no,
sor abɔfo no a oeyi me efi mbusu nyinara mu no, onhyira mbo fra yi: Na wɔmma wɔmfa me dzin nye m'egyanom Abraham nye Isaac hɔn dzin mfrɛ hɔn; na wɔmma wonnyin wɔnyɛ ɔdodow wɔ asaase ne finimfin
Na aber a Joseph hun dɛ n'egya dze ne nsa enyimfa ato Ephraim n'etsifi no, ɔannyɛ no abodwe: Na osuoo n'egya ne nsa mu dɛ oriyi no wɔ Ephraim n'etsifi ato Manasseh n'etsifi.
Na Joseph see n'egya dɛ, ɔnntse dɛm, m'egya: Na abakan no nye yi; fa wo nsa enyimba to n'etsifi.
Na n'egya powee, na ɔsee dɛ, minyim, me ba, minyim: Ɔno so bɛyɛ ɔman, na ɔno so bɛyɛ kɛse: Naaso no nua kuma bɛyɛ kɛse asen no, na n'asefo bɛyɛ amanaman pii.
Na ohyiraa hɔn da no see dɛ, ɔwo na Isreal dze wo behyira dɛ, Nyankopɔn ɔmma yɛ dɛ Ephraim nye dɛ Manasseh: Na ɔdze Ephraim dzii Manasseh ne kan.
Na Isreal see Joseph dɛ, Hwɛ, muruwu: Na Nyankopɔn bedzi hom ekyir, na ɔdze hom akɔ hom egyanom hɔn asaase do bio.
Nkyii so medze kyɛpɛn kor a ɔbor wo nuanom do a medze m'afowa nye me m'egyen megyee no wɔ Amorifo nsamu no mama wo.
49: Na Jacob frɛɛ ne mbabanyin, na ɔsee dɛ: Hom mboa hom ano, na na menka dza ndaamba ɔbɛba hom do menkyerɛ hom.
Hom nhyia, na wontsie, hom Jacob mba; na wontsie hom egya Isreal.
Reuben, ɔwo nye m'abakan, mo tum, nye m'ahoɔdzen ahyɛse; nyia ɔkyɛn wɔ enyidzi mu na nyia ɔkyɛn wɔ tum mu.
Ihim dɛ nsu, ennkɛkyɛn; osiandɛ efoow w'egya ne mpa: Nna iguu ho fi: Ɔfoow m'adae.
Simeon nye Levi wɔyɛ enuanom; hɔn mfowa yɛ enyiber akodze.
Ao me kra, mma mmba hɔn apam mu; m'enyimnyam, mma mmfora hɔn mboano mu; osiandɛ hɔn ebufuw mu na wokum nyimpa, na hɔn ahopɔw mu na wotwitwaa nantwi anantsir.
Ndom nka hɔn ebufuw, osiandɛ ɔyɛ hyew; na hɔn enyiber, osiandɛ no mu yɛ dzen: Mebɛpaapaa hɔn mu wɔ Jacob mu, na mabɔ hɔn apetse wɔ Isreal mu.
Judah, ɔwo na wo nuanom beyi wo ayɛw: Wo nsa bɛhyɛ w'atamfo hɔn kɔn do; w'egya mba bɔbɔ hɔn mu adze wɔ w'enyim.
Judah yɛ ogyata ba; Abɔgyanam ara na edze enyin, me ba: Ɔkotowee, obutuuw hɔ dɛ ogyata, na dɛ ogyataber; woana na obekenyan no?
Ahempoma nnkefi Judah nsa, nna mbrahyɛfo poma nkefi n'anan ntamu, kɛpem dɛ Shikoh bɛba; Na ɔno na aman bɛyɛ setsie ama no.
Ɔdze n'asoasoba amontan wenyindua, na n'asoasoberba wɔ wenyindua pa ho; ɔahor ne ntar wɔ wenyin mu, na n'akataho wɔ wenyinamba bɔgya mu:
Wenyin bɛgye n'enyiwa do dɛnn, na numfonsu bɛma ne se ho ahoa fitaa.
Zebulun bɛtsena po berekyir: Na ɔbɛyɛ mbrɛ ahɛn gyinagyina; na ɔnye Zidon bɔbɔ ɔhe.
Issachar yɛ asoaso a no ho yɛ dzen, obutuw nguamban ntamu: Na asaase no dɛ ɔyɛ fɛw, na ɔbrɛɛ n'abatsir adze asoa, Na ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔsomfo wɔ edwumadzen mu.
Dan bobua no nkorɔfo atsɛn, dɛ Isreal mbusuakuw mu kor.
Dan bɛyɛ ɔwɔ a ɔbew kwan mu, Ehurutsia a ɔda akwantsen, ɔsɔw ɔpɔnkɔ nantsir, man no do atsefo no obu dua n'ekyir.
Gad, dɔm bɛhyɛ no do: Na ɔno so bɛhyɛ hɔn etsia hɔn anantsir.
Asher n'edziban fi no mu bɔtɔ angoa. Na ɔbɛma ahen-dɛkɛdɛkɛdze.
Naphtali yɛ ɔtrɔmber a woegyaa no: Ɔka ahomkasɛm.
Joseph yɛ abaw a ɔsow, Abaw a ɔsow wɔ nsunyiwa ho; No nkorbata tratra ban.
Egyentofo no eyi no awerɛhow kɛsenara, na wɔatotow no, na wɔayɛ no enyienyi:
Na n'egyen dze ɔwɔ hɔ pintsinn, na ne nsa n'abasa no mu yɛ dzen, ɔnam Jacob no Tumfo Kor no ne nsa do, (Hɔ na oguanhwɛfo no, Isreal no bo no ofi)
Mekyerɛ w'egya ne Nyankopɔn a ɔbɔboa wo no, na Otumfo a ɔdze ɔsor nhyira, bun a ɔda daadzetsirmu ne nhyira, enumfo mu, nye yafun mu nhyira, Behyira wo no,
W'egya ne nhyira Akyɛn me nananom hɔn nhyira ɔdze kodu tsetse mbepɔw no n'nano no ho ara: Ɔbɛtsena Joseph n'etsifi, nye nyia wɔtsee no fi no nuanom ho no n'etsifi pampamu.
Benjamin ɔyɛ pataku a ɔtsetsew mbowa mu: Obedzi abɔgyanam anapa, Na ewimbir no ɔakyɛ asadze.
Woyinom nyinara nye Isreal mbusuakuw duebien no: Na iyi na hɔn egya kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn na ɔdze nhyira hɔn no; hɔn nyinara mbrɛ hɔn nhyira tsetsee nkorkor, na ohyiraa hɔn.
Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔwɔ dɛ wɔdze me kɛka mo nkorɔfo ho: Wonsie me m'egyanom nkyɛn wɔ ɔbo-tu a ɔwɔ Ephron Hethnyi no, ne haban mu no mu,
wɔ ɔbo-tu a ɔwɔ Machpelah haban mu no a, wɔ Mamre enyim, wɔ Canaan asaase do no a Abraham ɔdze kaa haban no ho tɔe no wɔ Hethnyi Ephron hɔ, ɔdze yɛɛ efunsiebea no no mu:
Hɔ na wosiee Abraham nye ne yer Sarah; hɔ na wosiee Isaac nye ne yer Rebakah; na hɔ na misiee Leah:
Haban no nye ɔbo-tu a ɔwɔ mu no a wɔtɔɔ no wɔ Hethmba hɔ no a.
Na Jacob wiee ne mba mbra hyɛ ara, nna ɔkaa n'anan boaa ano ɔdze guu mpa no do, na ogyaa no sunsum mu, na wɔdze no kɛkaa no nkrɔfo ho.
50: Na Joseph twae hwee n'egya n'enyim, na osui guu no do, na ofeeww n'ano.
Na Joseph hyɛɛ no nkowaa enunsimfo no dɛ wɔnhyɛ n'egya akyenkyendur: Na enuasimfo no hyɛɛ Isreal akyenkyendur.
Na wowiee adaduanan dzi wɔ no do: Na nda a wɔdze wie akyenkyendur hyɛ nye no: Na Egyptfo no suu no nda eduosuon.
Na nda a wɔdze suu no no twaa mu no, Joseph kaa kyerɛɛ Pharaoh ne fifo, dɛ, Sɛ afei menya hom enyim enyimnyam a, meserɛ hom, wɔnka no wɔ Pharaoh n'asomu, dɛ,
M'egya maa midzii nsew, dɛ hwɛ, muruwu: Me nda a mabɔ mama moho wɔ Canaan asaase do no, ɔno mu hɔ na kesie me. Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, ma monkɔ, na minkesie m'egya, na membra bio.
Na Pharaoh see dɛ, kɔ, na kesie w'gya, dɛ mbrɛ ɔmaa idzii nsew no ara.
Na Joseph kɔree dɛ orikesie n'egya: Na Pharaoh no nkowaa nyinara, ne fie mpanyimfo nyinara,
nye Joseph ne fifo nyinara, nye no nuanum, nye n'egya ne fifo, wɔnye no kɔree: Hɔn mbofraba, nye hɔn nguan, nye hɔn anantwi, nko na wɔdaan hɔn gyaa Goshen asaase do.
Na ntseaseanam nye mpɔnkɔdofo nyina nye no kɔree: Na ɔyɛɛ kuwkɛsenara.
Na wɔbaa Atad ewuporoweebea a ɔwɔ Jordan egya no, na hɔ na wotwaa kwadwom kɛse a no mu yɛ dzen papaara: Na osuu n'egya nda esuon.
Na hɔn a wɔtse asaase no do no, Canaanfo no, wohum osu a wosuu no wɔ Atad ewoporoweebea no, wɔsee dɛ, Iyi ɔyɛ eyi kɛse ma Egyptfo: Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ no dzin Abel-mizraim a ɔwɔ Jordan egya.
Na ne mba yɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔhyɛɛ hɔn no ara:
Na ne mba soaa no kɔr Canaan asaase do, na wokesiee no wɔ Machpelah haban mu ɔbo-tu no mu, dza Abraham dze kaa haban no ho tɔɔ no wɔ Hethnyi Ephron hɔ, dze yɛɛ efusiebea, wɔ Mamre enyim no a.
Na Joseph wiee n'egya sie ekyir no, ɔsanee kɔr Egypt, ɔnoara nye no nuanom no, nye hɔn a wɔnye no kɔree kesiee n'egya no nyinara.
Na Joseph no nuanom no wohum dɛ hɔn egya ewu no, wɔsee dɛ, Bohu na Joseph atan hɛn, na bɔn a yɛdze yɛɛ no no nyinara oesusu mbrɛ ɔtse no ara oedzi hɛn ho wer.
Na Wɔsomae ma wɔkɛsee Joseph dɛ, Ansaana w'egya ruwu no ɔhyɛɛ dɛ,

Dɛm na hom nkã nkyerɛ Joseph, Afei meserɛ wo, fa wo nuanom hɔn mbrato, nye hɔn hɔn fir hɔn, dɛ wɔyɛɛ wo bɔn: Na afei yɛserɛ wo, fa w'egya ne Nyankopɔn no nkowaa hɔn mbrato fir hɔn. Na Joseph sūi wɔ aber a wɔkãa kyerɛɛ no no.
Na no nuanom no so wɔkɔree, na wokotwitwae hwehwee n'enyim; na wɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, yɛyɛ wo nkowaa.
Na Jaseph see hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro: Na ana migyina Nyankopɔn ananmu?
Na homdze hom dween dɛ wɔreyɛ me bɔn; na Nyankopɔn dze ɔdween dɛ oye, ma ɔaayɛ dɛ mbrɛ ndɛ ɔayɛ yi, ma wɔaagye nkorɔfo piinara nkwa.
Dɛm ntsi afei, mma hom nnsuro: Mobɔhwɛ hom, nye hom mbofraba. Na ɔkaa hɔn akoma too hɔn yamu, na ɔkasaa ayamuyie mu kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na Joseph tsenaa Egypt, ɔnoara nye n'egya ne fifo: Na Joseph dzii mfe ɔha du.
Na Joseph hun Ephraim ne mbanana a otsìa ebiasa; Manasseh ne babanyin Machir ne mba so wɔwoo hɔn guu Joseph n'asarɛ do.
Na Joseph see no nuanom no dɛ, Muruwu: Na ampara Nyankopɔn bɛba abɛsera hom, na oebeyi hom efi asaase yi do akɔ asaase a ɔkãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ Abraham, Isaac nye Jacob no no do.
Na Joseph maa Israelmba dzii nsew dɛ, ampaara, Nyankopɔn bɛba abɛsera hom, na hom nsoa me mbiew mfi ha nkɔ.
Nna Joseph wui, nna oedzi mfe ɔha du: Na wɔhyɛɛ no akyenkyendur, na wɔtoo no adaka mu wɔ Egypt.

1: Atsɛmbusɛm a nkɔnhyɛnyi Habakkuk hunii.
Ao Ewuradze, menkeka mu ma ɔnkyer dɛn ara, na ɔwo irinntsie? Musū mefrɛ wo wɔ enyimpisɛm ntsi, na ɔwo eenngye nkwa.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ekyerɛ me emumuyɛ, na ehwɛ ɔbrakyew yi? Na ɔsɛɛ na emimdzi wɔ m'enyim: Na aperper wɔ hɔ, na mansotwe soɛr.
Dɛm ntsi mbra no mu atow, na atsɛmbu mmfir edzi nnkɔ: Na omumuyɛfo twa ɔtseneneenyi ho hyia; dɛm ntsi atsɛmbu fir edzi a, nna ɔakyea.
Hom nhwɛ amanaman mu, na hom nhu, na hom ho mbow hom bow paara: Na mibedzi dwuma bi wɔ hom nda mu a, sɛ wɔkã kyerɛ hom mpo a, hom renngye nndzi.
Na, hwɛ, merema Chaldeafo do, ɔman ayamuɔwemfo horopohoropofo a wɔnantsew asaase no ne tɛtɛr mu dɛ wɔrekɛfa tsenambea a ɔnnyɛ hɔndze edzi.
Hɔn ho yɛ abowiriw ɔnye hu: Hɔn atsɛmbu na hɔn enyimnyam fi hɔnankasa hɔn mu.
Hɔn mpɔnkɔ so ho yɛ har sen nsebɔ, na wɔyɛ abɔyafo sen anago mpataku; nahɔn mpɔnkɔdofo twitwi hɔn mu kɔ kan: Nyew, hɔn mpɔnkɔdofo fi ekyirkyir; wotu dɛ ɔkɔr a ɔpɛ ntsɛm akɛmemen adze.
Hɔn nyinara reba emimdzi; hɔn enyi hyehyeehyew dɛ boka mframa; na wɔboaboa ndɔmmunum ano dɛ anhwea.
Ɛhɛɛ, osi ahemfo atwetwe, na asafohemfo ho yɛ no serew: Ɔserew akoban biara; na ɔhɔr dɛtse pempe, na ɔfa.
Nna obotwa mu dɛ mframa, na ɔasen akɔ, na oekedzi sõ: Mekyerɛ onyia no a no bosom nye n’ahoɔdzen no.
Ao Ewuradze, me Nyankopɔn, mo Krɔnkrɔnnyi, ɔwo immfir tsetsentserde? Yennkowuwu. Ao Ewuradze, ɔwo na ahyɛ no ama atsɛmbu; na ɔwo, ao ɔbotan, edze no etsim hɔ wɔ ntsēa ntsi.
Ɔwo a w’enyi do tsew kyɛn dɛ ebɔhwɛ ndzebɔn, na inntum nnhwɛ ɔbrakyew, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ehwɛ hɔn a wotwa nkontompɔ, na imua w'ano ber a omumuyɛnyi remen nyimpa a ɔtsen sen no no;
na eyɛ nyimpa dɛ po mu nam, dɛ aweaweambowa a obi nndzi hɔn do panyin?
Ɔdze nkwaba twe hɔn nyina, na ɔdze no boa fa hɔn, na ɔboaboa hɔn no twuwii mu; dɛm ntsi odzi ehurusi na n’enyi gye.
Dɛm ntsi ɔbɔ okum-afɔr ma no boa, na ɔhyew huam ma no twuwii; osiandɛ hɔn na wɔma ne kyɛfa tɔ angoa, na n’edziban yɛ pii.
Aso dɛm ntsi ɔnto no boa pan, na orennkam dɛ obokuku amanaman daa?
2: Mibegyina m’aweɔmbea do, na medze moho mesi abantsentsen no do, na matsɛw mahwɛ dza ɔnye me bɛkã, na dza mubobua wɔ no nkɔmbɔ ho.
Na Ewuradze buaa me, na ɔsee dɛ, kyerɛw enyido-adzehu, na ma ɔnyɛ kofee wɔ abopon do, ma nyia ɔdze mbirika mpo oeenya no akenkan yie.
Na enyi-do-adzehu da ho wɔ ho ma ber a wɔahyɛ, na ɔrehaahaw ekodu ewiei, na orinndzi ator: Sɛ ɔkyɛr mpo a, tweɔn, na ɔbɛba ampaara, orinnkyim.
Hwɛ, ne kra ahoran, ɔnntsen wɔ no mu: Na ɔtseneneenyi nam ne gyedzi do benya nkwa.

Ɛhɛɛ, nkyii so nsã yɛ osisifo, ɔbarimba ɔhokyerɛnyi, na nyia ɔnntsena fie; ɔno na ɔtserɛw n’akɔndɔ mu dɛ Sheol, na ɔtse dɛ owu, na ɔmmee da, na ɔboaboa amanaman nyina ba ne nkyɛn, na otsiatsia aman nyina ba ne nkyɛn.
Aso iyinom nyina nnkobubu no mbɛ, na woedzi no nkasaetwuw, dɛ, nyia ɔma dza ɔnnyɛ nedze dɔɔ sõ no, ondue! Onkodu dabɛn? Na ɔma ahobadze yɛ no do dur!
Aso hɔn a Wɔbɛka wo no nnkɔsoɛr awerɛfir mu, na hɔn a wobedzi wo akɔnaaba enyan, na ayɛ hɔn asadze?
Osiandɛ afa amanaman pii afo ntsi, aman mu nkaa no nyina bɛfa wo afo; Osian nyimpa bɔgyaa ntsi, na ewurkadze a wɔdze ayɛ asaase no, na kurow no na no mu atsefo nyina ntsi.
Onyia no a onya mfaso bɔn ma ne fi, dɛ ɔdze ne berɛbuw risi sorsor, ama woeeyi no efi mbusu nsa no, ondue!
Ɔwo enye enyito etu egyina ama wo fie, dɛ etwitwa aman pii egu na ayɛ wo kra bɔn.
Na ɔbo befi fasu no ho atsēa mu, na mpuna efi ndua mu agye do.
Nyia ɔdze bɔgya kyekyer kurow, na ɔdze emumuyɛ tsintsim kuropɔn no, ondue!
Hwɛ, ana ommfir dɔm Ewuradze na aman berɛ ma ogya, na amanaman fona hɔnho ma egyangyandze?
Na Ewuradze n’enyimnyam ho nyimdzee bɛhyɛ asaase mã, dɛ mbrɛ esu kata po do.
Nyia ɔma ne nyɛnko anondze, na ɔdze bɔr ka ho, na ɔma ɔbow so, na ɔahwɛ n’adagyaw no, ondue!
Enyito ahyɛ wo mã sen enyimnyam: Ɔwo so nom, na yɛ dɛ monomonomnyi: Ewuradze n’abanyimfa kuraba no bɛdan aba wo do, na enyimguase tantan bɛba w'enyimnyam do.
Na ewurkadze a edze yɛɛ Lebanon, na mbowa hɔn sɛɛe a ɔmaa wɔbɔɔ piriw no bobua w’etsifi; wɔ adasa hɔn bɔgyaa ntsi, na ewurkadze a wɔdze ayɛ asaase no, kurow no na no mu atsefo nyina ntsi.
Ebɛn mfaso na asen-honyi yɛ, dɛ no dwimfo asen no; gu-honyi, na ator kyerɛkyerɛfo no, dɛ dwimfo a odzi no edwin no dze no werɛ twer no, dɛ ɔreyɛ abosom mmum?
Nyia ɔse dua dɛ, nyan; na ɔse ɔbo mmum dɛ, soɛr, no, ondue! Aso iyi bɛkyerɛkyerɛ? Hwɛ, wɔdze sika na dwetɛ egu ho, na ahom biara nnyi no mu koraa.
Na Ewuradze wɔ n’asɔrfi krɔnkrɔn no mu: Asaase nyina ntaa dzinn wɔ n’enyim.
3: Nkɔnhyɛnyi Habakkuk ne mpaayi, wɔ Shigionoth do.
Ao Ewuradze, matse wo nka, na mesuro: Ao Ewuradze, nyan w'edwuma wɔ mfe finimfin, mfe ne finimfin na ma wonhu; ebufuw mu kaa mbɔbɔrhu.
Onyankopɔn fi Teman bae, na ɔkrɔnkrɔnnyi no fi Paran bepɔw do. (Selah) N'enyimnyam kataa sorsor, na asaase yɛɛ n’ayɛyi ma.
Na ne hyerɛn tse dɛ ewia; na nsenamba fi ne nsamu sesãe: Na hɔ nye n’ahoɔdzen no nsumae.
Ɔyardɔm dzi n’enyim, Na gyaframee dzi n’ananadze.
Ogyinae, na osusuu asaase; ɔhwɛe, na ɔmaa amanaman wosowee. Na ɔdomankoma mbepɔw hwetsee, tsetse akoko bɔɔ hɔn mu adze; ne nantsew tse dɛ tsetse dze.
Muhun Cushan asese wɔ ahohia mu; Midian asaase ho ntwamutam no popoe.
Aso Ewuradze no bo fuuw esutsen no? Aso w’ebufuw dzɛɛw esutsen no do, anaa po na wo bo huur no do, nna etsenaa wo mpɔnkɔ do, wo nkwagye ntseaseanam do yi?
W’egyen ho daa hɔ koraa; ebusuakuw ebusuakuw ntam no yɛɛ asɛm a osi pi. (Selah) Epaapaa esutsen totoo asaase mu.
Mbepɔw hun wo, na wosuroi; nsu n’ehum twaa mu senee: Bun maa ne ndze do, na ɔmaa ne nsa do wɔ sor.
Ewia na bosoom gyinagyina hɔn tsenabea; wɔ w’egyen-menaba a wɔnenamee ne kan ntsi, wɔ wo peaa nyinatn nyinam ne hyerɛn ntsi.
Ebufuhyew mu na etsenee faa asaase no do, Abohur mu na eposee amanaman.
Ɔwo ipuei wɔ wo man no nkwagye ntsi. Wɔ wo nyia wɔasera no no nkwagye ntsi; ɔwo ipirapiraa mumuyɛnyi no ne fi no etsifi, emaa fapem no ho daa hɔ kodur kɔn ho mpo. (Selah.)
Edze nankasa n’apɔtsimbaa hwiraa n’akofo tsir: Wɔbaa dɛ ekyinehyia-mframa abɔbɔ me apetse: Hɔn ehurusi nye dɛ wɔbɛmemen ɔbɔbɔfo nsumaa mu.
Ɔwo edze wo mpɔnkɔ etsiatsia po do, esu akɛse a ahohɔr no do.

Metsee, na me yafun wosowee, m’anofamfa hiim biribiriw wɔ ndze no ntsi; ɔprow hɛɛn me mbiew mu, na mo ho wosowee wɔ me tsenabea: Dɛ nkyɛ mobɔhom wɔ ɔfona da mu, ber a ɔreba ɔman a wɔdze dɔm tukutuku rubotua no do.
Na kaansa adɔmbadua remmpaa nhyiren, eso wenyindua ronnsow aba a; ngodua ne berɛ yɛ gyan, na nhaban mma edziban; nguan tun twa nguamban mu, na anantwi bi nnyi anantwiban mu mpo a;
emidze, mibedzi ehurusi wɔ Ewuradze mu, mo ho bɛsɛpɛw me wɔ mo nkwagye Nyankopɔn mu.
Jehovah, Ewuradze no, nye m’ahoɔdzen, na ɔma m’anan yɛ dɛ adoa dze, na ɔbɛma manantsew mo nsorɔnsorɔmbea. Wɔdze kɛma ɔdwontofo Panyin no, wɔ m'ahoma asanku do.

1: Ɔhen Darius afe a otsīa ebien no mu, bosoom a otsīa esia no mu, da a odzi bosoom no ne kan no, Ewuradze n'asɛm nam nkɔnhyɛnyi Haggai do baa Judah ambrado, Shealtiel ne ba Zerubbabel, na ɔsɔfopanyin Jehozadak ne ba Joshua hɔ, dɛ,
mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze kasa se nye yi dɛ, ɔman yi kã dɛ, onndur ber a yɛba, ber a yɛdze besi Ewuradze fi.
Nna Ewuradze n'asɛm nam nkɔnhyɛnyi Haggai do bae, dɛ,
aso homdze, ber edu ama hom dɛ hom tsena hom efi a wɔasesɛw enyi mu, ber a ofi yi da hɔ pan yi?
Dɛm ntsi afei mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Hom ndwendwen hom akwan ho.

Hom edua pii, na ketseabaa bi na hom dze ba fie; hom dzidzi, naaso hom mmee; hom nom nsã, naaso hom mmbow; hom furafura atam, naaso hom hom ho nnyɛ hom hyew; na nyia onya akatua gye akatua gu foto ntokurntokur mu.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Hom ndwendwen hom akwan ho.
Hom mfow mbepɔw no nkɛfa ndua mbesi ofi no: Na ɔbɛyɛ me fɛw na mahyɛ mo ho enyimnyam wɔ mu, Ewuradze na ɔse.

Hom hwɛɛ pii kwan, na hwɛ, obowiee ketseabaa bi; na hom dze baa fie no, muhuwii muguu do, ebɛnadze ntsi a? Dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse: Osian me fi a ɔada pan, na homdze hom tutu mbirika kokɔ hom efiefi ntsi.
Dɛm ntsi hom ntsi na ɔsor esianka dɛ ɔbɔsu nntɔ, na asaase esianka no ndɔbaa.
Na mefrɛɛ kwaweeyɛ mebaa asase do, na mbepɔw do, na eburow do, na nsã do, na ngo do, na dza asaase dze ba do, na nyimpa do, na anyɛmbowa do, na nsaano edwuma nyina do.

Nna Shealtiel ba Zerubbabel, na ɔsɔfopayin Joshua, Jehozadak ba no, wɔnye ɔman ne nkaa no nyina, wotsiee Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn ne ndze, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Haggai ne nsɛm no, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn somaa no no; na ɔman no suroi wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Nna Haggai, Ewuradze bɔfoe no, bɔɔ Ewuradze n'amandzɛɛ no kyerɛɛ ɔman no, dɛ. Mowɔ hom nkyɛn, Ewuradze na ɔse.

Na Ewuradze kenyaan Shealtiek ba Zerubbabel, Judah ambrado no no sunsum, na ɔsɔfopanyin Joshua, Jebozadak ba no, no sunsum na ɔman ne nkaa no nyina hɔn sunsum; na wɔbɛyɛɛ edwuma wɔ wɔ dɔm Ewuradze, hɔn Nyankopɔn fie,
wɔ bosoom a otsia esia no, bosoom no ne da a otsia eduonu anan no mu, wɔ ɔhen Darius n'afe a otsīa ebien no mu.
2: Bosoom a otsia esuon no, bosoom no ne da a otsia eduonu biako no, Ewuradze n'asɛm nam nkɔnhyɛnyi Haggai do baa dɛ,
Afei kasa kyerɛ Shealtiel ba Zerubbabel, Judah ambrado no, na ɔsɔfopanyin Joshua, Jehozadak ba no, na ɔman ne nkaa no, dɛ,
woana aka wɔ hom mu a ohun dan yi wɔ n'enyimnyam a odzi kan no mu? Na hom hu no dɛn sesei? Aso ɔnntse dɛ biribi a ɔnnyɛ hwee wɔ hom enyiwa mu?

Naaso afei, Zerubbabel, hyɛ dzen; Ewuradze na ɔse; na ɔsɔfopanyin Joshua, Jehozadak ba e, hyɛ dzen; na hom asaase do nkorɔfo nyina, hom nhyɛ dzen, na hom nyɛ edwuma, Ewuradze na ɔse: Na mowɔ hom nkyɛn, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Ɔnam asɛm a menye hom dzii ahyɛmu, ber a hom fii Egypt bae no, na mo sunsum tsenaa hom mu no ntsi: Mma hom nnsuro.
Na mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze kã nye yi: Prɛko bio, aka kuma, ma maawosow ɔsorsor, na asaase, na po, na asaasewewew;
na mobɔwosow amanaman nyina, na amanaman nyina ahwehwɛdze bɛba, na medze enyimnyam bɛhyɛ ofi yi mã, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Dwetɛ yɛ medze, na sika yɛ medze, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Ofi yi ne nkyinkyirii enyimnyam no bɔsõ asen nkan no dze no, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse: Na bea yi mu na mebɛma asomdwee, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Bosoom a otsīa akron no mu da a otsīa eduonu ana no, Darius n'afe a otsīa ebien no mu, na Ewuradze n'asɛm nam nkɔnkyɛnyi Haggai do bae, dɛ,
mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Afei bisa asɔfo bisa asɔfo no wɔ mbra no ho, dɛ,
sɛ obi dze nam krɔnkrɔn wɔ n'atarse mu, na sɛ ɔdze n'atarse kɛka paanoo, anaa ɔsɛnmudziban, anaa nsã, anaa ngo, anaa edziban biara a, aso ɔbɛyɛ krɔnkrɔn? Na asɔfo no buae see dɛ, oho.
Nna Haggai see dɛ, sɛ obi a fun ama no ho ekum kɛKã iyinom a, no ho kum? Na asɔfo no buae see dɛ, no ho ekum.
Nna Haggai buae see dɛ, mbrɛ nkorɔfo yi tse nye no, na mbrɛ ɔman yi tse wɔ m'enyim nye no, Ewuradze na ɔse; mbrɛ hɔn nsaano edwuma nyina tse nye no; na dza wɔdze bɔ afɔr wɔ hɔ no no ho ekum.
Na afei, meserɛ hom, hom ndwendwen mfitsi da yi do nkɔ nda a wonnyae mmfaa ɔbo nntoo ɔbo do wɔ Ewuradze asɔrfi mu:
Ofitsi nda no, sɛ obi baa esusudze ekuw eduonu ho a, nna du pɛ; sɛ obi baa nsatwer ho rebɛsaw etwadze eduonum a, nna eduonu pɛ.
Medze ohuw na ɔpo na ɔsorbo mobɔɔ hom wɔ hom nsaano edwuma nyina mu; naaso hom annsan ammba me nkyɛn, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hom ndwendwen ho, meserɛ hom, mfitsi da yi do mfa nkɔ, bosoom a otsīa akron no mu da a otsīa eduonu anan no a wɔtoow Ewuradze asɔrdan no ne fapem wɔ mu no, hom ndwendwen ho.

Aso aba bi da ho wɔ ɔsan do? Ɛhɛɛ, wenyindua, na adɔmbadua, na pomegranate-ekutu, na ngodua nnsowee; ofitsi da yi do na mibehyira hom. 20 Na Ewuradze n'asɛm baa Haggai hɔ ne mpɛn ebien wɔ bosoom no ne da a otsīa eduonu ana no mu, dɛ,
kasa kyerɛ Zerubbabel, Judah ambrado no, dɛ, mobɔwosow ɔsorsor na asaase:

Na mubobutuw ahenman ahengua, na masɛɛ amanaman ahendzi n'ahoɔdzen; na mubobutuw ntseaseanam, na hɔn a wɔtsetse mu no; na mpɔnkɔ na hɔn do atsenafo bɔhwehwe ase, obiara atɔ no nua dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, na mayɛ wo dɛ nsɔwanodze: Na ɔwo na masan mu meyi wo, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.

1: Nyankopɔn a tsetse no ɔdze no nkakrankakra nye akwan horow mu kasaa kyerɛɛ egyanom wɔ nkɔnhyɛfo no mu,
nda a odzi ekyir yi mu ɔakasa akyerɛ hɛn wɔ ne Ba mu; ɔno na ɔahyɛ no adze nyina odzifo a ɔnam no do so yɛɛ wiadze;
ɔno a ɔyɛ n'enyimnyam ne hyerɛn, na no subea saso, na ɔdze no tum asɛm suo ndzɛmba nyina mu no; na ɔyɛɛ bɔn ho ahoguar wiei no, ɔkɛtsenaa Enyimnyam Hen no enyimfa wɔ sorsor:
Na ɔakyɛn abɔfo dodow dɛ oenya dzin kunyin a ɔkyɛn hɔndze.
Na abɔfo no mu woana na ɔsee no pɛn dɛ, me Ba nye wo, ndɛ na mawo wo? Na bio, mebɛyɛ no Egya? Na ɔayɛ me ɔba?"
Na bio, onya dze abakan no ba wiadze a, ɔse, ma Nyankopɔn abɔfoe nyina nkotow no.
Na abɔfo no ho dze ɔse, ɔyɛ n'abɔfoe mframa, na n'asomfo gyaframee:
Na ɔba no ho dze ɔse, Nyankopɔn w'ahengua wɔ hɔ daa; na tsenenee poma nye w'ahempoma.
Adɔ tsenenee na ekyir emumuyɛ ntsi Nyankopɔn, wo Nyankopɔn, dze ahosɛpɛw ngo asera wo asen wo mfɛfo.
Na, ɔwo, Ewuradze, ahyɛse no na etoo asaase fapem, na ɔsor yɛ wo nsaano edwuma;
Hɔndze wɔbɛsɛɛ; na ɔwodze ewɔw do dɛmara daa; na hɔn nyina bosuw dɛ atar;
Ebɔbobɔw hɔn dɛ efuratam, dɛ atar mpo, na wɔasakyersakyer; na ɔwodze, etse mbrɛ etse ara, na wo mfe rennsã da.
Na abɔfo no mu woana ho na ɔakã dɛ, tsena m'enyimfa, ma onkodu dɛ medze w'atamfo mebɛyɛ w'ananadzegua?
Ana hɔn nyina nnyɛ esunsum asomfo a hɔn a wɔbɛyɛ nkwagye no edzifo no ntsi wɔsoma hɔn ma wɔbɔsom bi?
2: Dɛm ntsi ɔsɛ dɛ yɛhwɛ ndzɛmba a yɛatse no yie papaara, amma da bi yaanntser ho.
Na sɛ asɛm a wɔnam abɔfo no do kãe no tsimii, na mbrato nye asoɔdzen biara nyaa n'akatua a ɔsɛ a.
hɛndze, sɛ yebu enyi gu nkwagye kɛse a ɔtse dɛm yi do a, yɛbɛyɛ dɛn efi nsa? Iyi na Ewuradze dzii kan kãe, na hɔn a wɔtsee no hyɛɛ no dzen maa hɛn
na Nyankopɔn so nam nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwandze nye tum ndwuma horow nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ne kyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔnoara ɔpɛ no, hyɛɛ hɔn dasedzi no mã.
Na nnyɛ abɔfo no ase na ɔdze wiadze a ɔreba a yɛkã ho asɛm no ahyɛ.
Na obi dzii dase wɔ beebi dɛ, ɔdasanyi nye woana, na ekaa no? Nyimpa ba nye woana, na esera no?
Ama ɔkra kakra ma ɔato abɔfo; edze enyimnyam nye enyidze abɔ no abɔtsir, na edze no esi wo nsaano edwuma do: Edze adze nyina ahyɛ n'ananadze.
Na dɛ ɔdze nyina ahyɛ n'ase no, oenngyaa biribiara a wɔmmfa nnhyɛ n'ase. Na afei dze yennyae nnhun dɛ wɔdze ndzɛmba nyina ahyɛ n'ase.

Na yɛhwɛ onyia no a wɔbrɛɛ no adze ma ɔaka kakra ama ɔato abɔfo no, Jesus no, dɛ osian owu amandzehu ntsi wɔdze enyimnyam nye enyidzi abɔ no abɔtsir, na ɔnam Nyankopɔn adom do aasɔ owu ahwɛ ama nyimpa biara.
Na ɔfata onyia no a ndzɛmba nyina wɔ hɔ ma no na ndzɛmba nyina nam no do wɔ hɔ no dɛ, ɔdze mba pii reba enyimnyam mu a, ɔmaa hɔn nkwagye dzikamfo no nam amandzehu mu dzii mu.
na nyia ɔsan ho nye hɔn a wɔsan hɔnho no nyina fir ɔbaako, na dɛm ntsi ɔnnyɛ no enyiwu dɛ ɔbɛfrɛ hɔn enuanom,
dɛ, mobɔbɔ wo dzin makyerɛ mo nuanom; mboanofo finimfin na mobɔtow ayɛyindwom mama wo.
Na bio, medze mo werɛ mobɔtwɛr no, na bio, hwɛ, emi nye mba a Nyankopɔn dze hɔn ama me.
Na ofir dɛ mba no wɔ bɔgya nye honam bi no, dɛmara na no so faa mu bi, ama ɔnam owu do aama onyia no a ɔwɔ owu tum a (ɔno nye abɔnsam no) ayɛ kwa;
na ɔaagye hɔn a owu ho suro ntsi wɔwɔ nkowaasom mu hɔn nkwaber nyina no.
Na ampaara nnyɛ abɔfo na osuo hɔn mu, na Abraham asefo na osuo hɔn mu.
Dɛm ntsi ohiaa dɛ ɔsɛ no nuanom wɔ adze nyina mu, na ɔaayɛ ɔsɔfopanyin mbɔbɔrhufo nye nokwafo wɔ dza ɔfa Nyankopɔn ho no mu, na ɔaayɛ ɔman no hɔn bɔn ho mpatadze.
Na dɛ wɔsɔɔ no hwɛe ma nankasa so hun amandze ntsi, otum boa hɔn a wɔsɔ hɔn hwɛ no.
3: Dɛm ntsi, enuanom krɔnkrɔn a hom fora sor frɛ no mu, hom nhwɛ gyedzi a yegyina do kã asɛm no ho Somafo nye Sɔfopanyin Jesus a
odzi nokwar maa nyia ɔdze no sii hɔ no, dɛ mbrɛ Moses so dzii wɔ ne fi nyina do.
Na ɔno na woebu no dɛ enyidzi pii fata no kyɛn Moses, dɛ mbrɛ nyia osii ofi wɔ enyidzi sen ofi no.
Na ofi biara obi na osi; na nyia osii adze nyina nye Nyankopɔn.
Na Moses dze, odzii nokwar wɔ ne fi nyina do dɛ ɔsomfo, ma ɔaayɛ nsɛm a wɔrebɛkã no ekyir yi ho adasehyɛ.
Na Christ dze, odzii ne fi do dɛ ɔba; na ofi no nye hɛn, sɛ yesuo enyidado no ho ndam nye ahohyehyɛ no mu dzen kesi ewiei a.
Dɛm ntsi, dɛ mbrɛ Sunsum krɔnkrɔn no se, ndɛ, sɛ hom tse ne ndze a,
Mma hom mmpirim hom akoma, dɛ ehiyi no mu, dɛ nsɔhwɛ da no mu wɔ sar no do hɔ,
Mbrɛ hom egyanom dze gyegyee me sɔɔ me hwɛe, na wohun mo ndwuma mfe eduanan no.
Dɛm ntsi mbasantsen no ho yɛɛ me ehi, na mesee dɛ, wɔfom hɔn akoma mu daa: Ba woennhu m'akwan;
Mbrɛ mekãa m'ebufuw mu ntam dɛ, wɔrennhɛn m'ahomgye mu.
Hom nhwɛ yie, enuanom, na ekyingye koma bɔn bi aammba hom mu biara mu, na ɔaannwaa emmfi Nyankopɔn tseasefo ho:
na mbom hom ntutu homho fo nkorkor daa nyina, mber tsentsen a hom kã dɛ, ndɛ no; amma bɔn ndaadaa aannsorow hom mu biara:
na yɛafora Christ mu, sɛ yesuo hɛn awerɛtwer ahyɛse no mu pintsinn kodu ewiei a:
Dɛ mbrɛ wɔkã dɛ, Ndɛ da yi, sɛ hom betsie me ndze a, mma hom mmpirim hom akoma, dɛ ehiyi no mu.
Na woananom na wɔtsee a, woyii ehi? Ana nnyɛ hɔn a wɔnam Moses do fii Egypt nyina a?
Na woananom ho na ɔyɛɛ no ehi mfe eduanan no? Ana nnyɛ hɔn a wɔyɛɛ bɔn a hɔn efun gugu sar do no a?
Na woananom na ɔkãa ntam dɛ wɔrennhɛn n'ahomgye no mu dɛ hɔn a wɔyɛɛ asokyew no?
Na yehu dɛ ekyingye ntsi na woenntum annhɛn mu.
4: Dɛm ntsi, hom mma yensuro, ma sɛ woegya hɛn n'ahomgye no mu kɔ ho anohoba a, hom mu biara aannyɛ dɛ ɔaka ekyir.
Na wɔakã asɛmpa no akyerɛ hɛn dɛ hɔn so; na asɛm a wɔtsee no annyɛ hɔn mfaso, osiandɛ ɔnye gyedzi enndzi afora wɔ hɔn a wɔtsee no mu.
Na hɛn a yɛagye edzi no yɛkɔ ahomgye no mu: Dɛ mbrɛ ɔakã dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ mekãa m'ebufuw mu ntam dɛ, wɔrennhɛn m'ahomgye mu: Naaso na wofi wiadze ahyɛse ewie ndwuma no dada.
Na ɔakã no beebi wɔ da a otsīa esuon no ho dɛ, Nyankopɔn gyee n'ahom da a otsīa esuon no mu wɔ no ndwuma ho;
na ha ɔkã dɛ, wɔrennhɛn m'ahomgye mu.
Na ofir dɛ aka dɛ binom bɔkɔ mu, na hɔn a wodzii kan kãa asɛmpa kyerɛɛ hɔn no annkɔ mu wɔ asoɔdzen ntsi no,
ɔhyɛ da bi so bio, nam David mu kã mber pii ekyir, dɛ, ndɛ, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakã dada no, ndɛ, sɛ hom tse ne ndze a, mma hom mmpirim hom akoma.
Na sɛ Joshua maa hɔn ahomgye a nkyɛ ekyir yi ɔammbɔ da fofor bi dzin bio.
Dɛm ntsi ahomgyedadzi aka ama Nyankopɔn man.
Na nyia ɔahɛn n'ahomgye mu no, nankasa so ahom efi no ndwuma ho, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn homee fii nedze ho no.
Dɛm ntsi hom mma yɛmbɔ mbɔdzen nhɛn ahomgye no mu, amma obi eenndzi asoɔdzen kor ara ekyir annhwe ase.
Na Nyankopɔn asɛm wɔ nkwa, ahoɔdzen wɔ mu, na ɔyɛ ndam sen nkrantsee anofanu, na ohwira mu kodu dɛ ɔpaapaa ɔkra nye sunsum, akwaa nye ehuon mu, na no ho yɛ har hwehwɛ akoma mu adwen nye nsusui mu.
Na abɔdze biara nnyi hɔ a ɔnnda edzi wɔ n'enyim, na ɔdze nyina dzi adagyaw na no do bue wɔ nyia yɛnye no wɔ yɛ no enyim.
Na yɛwɔ sɔfopanyin kɛse a oetwa sor mu, Jesus Nyankopɔn Ba no yi, hom mma yensuo dza yɛpaa mu kã no mu dzen.
Na yennyi sɔfopanyin a hɛn mberɛwyɛ nntum nntsɛ no, na mbom nyia wɔasɔ no adze nyina mu ahwɛ dɛ hɛnara a, naaso onnyi bɔn.
Dɛm ntsi hom mma yɛmfa ndam mbra adom ahengua no enyim na yeenya ahumbɔbɔr na yeehu adom a ɔboa hɛn ber a ohia mu.
5: Na sɔfopanyin biara a woyi no wɔ nyimpa mu, wɔhyɛ no ma nyimpa wɔ dza ɔfa Nyankopɔn ho no ho, ma ɔaama ayɛyɛdze nye afɔrbɔdze dze wɔ hɔn ntsi,
dɛ nyia otum hu ma hɔn a wonnyim dze na wɔfom, osiandɛ nankasa so mberɛwyɛ mmpar no;
na iyi ntsi otwar dɛ ɔbɔ afɔr ma noho dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔ ma ɔman no.
Na obiara mmfa dɛm enyidzi mma noho gyedɛ Nyankopɔn afrɛ no dɛ Aaron so.
Dɛmara so na Christ annhyehyɛ noho dɛ ɔbɛyɛ sɔfopanyin; na mbom nyia ɔkãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, ma Ba nye wo, ndɛ na mawo wo:
Dɛ mbrɛ ɔkã no beebi so dɛ, ɔwo eyɛ daa sɔfopanyin wɔ Melchizedec mbron do.
Ɔno na ber a ɔtse no honam mu no ɔdze nkekamu a ɔyɛ dzen nye nyinsu yɛɛ asɔr nye nkotoserɛ maa nyia obotum dɛ oyi no fi owu mu, na ne nyamesuro ntsi wotsiee no;
ɔyɛ ɔba dze, naaso esúaa amandze a, ohunii no mu setsie,
na onyae dzii mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ onnyiewiei nkwagye farbaa ma hɔn a wotsie no nyina:
Nyankopɔn bɔ ne dzin frɛ no Melchizedec mbron do sɔfopanyin.
Ɔno ho na yɛwɔ nsɛm pii kã a ne nkyerɛase yɛ dzen so, osiandɛ hom asowa esiw.
Na mber aba a ɔsɛ dɛ hom yɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo yi, ehia hom bio dɛ obi kyerɛkyerɛ hom Nyankopɔn ho nsɛm ahyɛse ne mfitsiasesɛm, na hom ayɛ dɛ hɔn a ohia hɔn numfonsu no, na onnhia hɔn edziban dzen.
Na obiara a onum numfunsu no nna onnya tsenenee nsɛm no ho nhumu, na ɔyɛ abɔtoaba.
Na edziban dzen sɛ hɔn a woenyin a ntɔyɛɛ ntsi hɔn nkãtsedze akokwaa yie ma wotum hu papa nye bɔn.
6: Dɛm ntsi hom mma yengya Christ ahyɛsesɛm no na yɛnhom do nkɔ emudzi mu: Na mma yɛmmfa ndwuma a nkwa nnyi mu ho nnuho, nye Nyankopɔn ho gyedzi,
nye esubɔ horow ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, nye nsagudo, nye ewufosoɛr, nye onnyiewiei atsɛmbu nnto hɛn fapem bio.
Na iyi sɛ Nyankopɔn ma kwan a, yɛbɛyɛ.
Na hɔn a wonyaa kan pɛn, na wɔasɔ ɔsor akyɛdze no ahwɛ, na woenya Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no bi,
na wɔasɔ Nyankopɔn asɛm mbrɛ ɔyɛ papa nye wiadze a ɔreba no mu tum ndwuma horow ahwɛ,
Na woefi no ahwe ase, ɔnnkɛyɛ dɛ wɔbɛdan hɔn bio akɔ nnuho mu; osiandɛ wɔbɔ Nyankopɔn Ba no mbeamudua mu bio ma hɔnho, na wɔhyɛ no bagua mu fɛr.
Na asaase a ɔnam nsu a ɔtɔ dɛ ɔtɔ gu do, na ofir ezdiban a ɔsɛ hɔn a hɔn ntsi so na wɔdɔwee no, onya Nyankopɔn hɔ nhyira.
Na sɛ ofiir nsoɛr nye nhwirom a, wɔpow no na ɔbɛn ndom, n'ewiei nye ɔhyew.
Na, adɔfo, yɛkasa dɛm dze, naaso hɛn enyi da ndzɛmba a oye kyɛn kwan wɔ hom ho, nye ndzɛmba a ɔnye nkwagye nam:
Na Nyankopɔn nnyɛ nyia ɔnntsen na no werɛ efir hom ndwuma nye ɔdɔ no a hom kyerɛe wɔ ne dzin ho, dɛ hom soom ahotsewfo no na hom da ho som.
Na yɛpɛ dɛ hom nyina nkorkor hom kyerɛ mbɔdzembɔ yi ara ma hom enyidado aahyɛ ma dze ekodu ewiei:
amma hom aannyɛ wantann, na mbom hom aayɛ hɔn a wɔnam gyedzi nye abotar do nya anohoba no hɔn esuafo.
Na Nyankopɔn bɔɔ Abraham anohoba, na onnyi obi asõ sen no a ɔbɛkã ne tam ntsi ɔkãa nankasa no ho ntam
dɛ, ampaara, ohyira na mibehyira wo, na ɔdɔr na mebɛma wo adɔr.
Na ɔtɔɔ no bo ase tweɔn dɛm no, ne nsa kãa anohoba no.
Na adasa kã nyia ɔsõ sen hɔn ntam; na ekyingyebra nyina ewiei nye ntam a wɔdze si do.
Ntsi na Nyankopɔn pɛɛ dɛ oyi sakyer a ne tsirmsɛm nnsakyer kyerɛ anohoba no edzifo no kotoo a, odze ntam gyinaa mu;
ma, ɔnam adze ebien a ɔnnsakyer a Nyankopɔn dua mu dzi ator a ɔnnyɛ no do, hɛn a yeeguan abɔdɔ dɛ yerubosuo enyidado a wɔdze esi hɛn enyim no mu no yeenya awerɛkyekyer a ɔyɛ dzen;
enyidado a yɛwɔ no dɛ ɔkra ne se kyɛ a ɔnntsɛw na otsim na ɔhɛn mu kodu dza ɔwɔ ntwamutam mu no mu:
Hɔ na Jesus hɛɛn hɔ maa hɛn dɛ ɔkandzifo a wɔayɛ no Melchizedec mbron do sɔfopanyin.
7: Na Melchizedec yi, Salemhen, ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn no sɔfopanyin, ohyiaa Abraham dɛ oekoku Ahemfo no na ɔresan no, na ohyiraa no;
ɔno so na Abraham maa no ndzɛmba nyina mu ebupɛn du no (ne nkyerɛase asɔpɔn no nye dɛ tsenenee Hen, na nkyii so Salemhen, ɔno nye dɛ asomdwee hen:
onnyi egya, onnyi nã, onnyi nanakan, onnyi nda ahyɛase, anaa nkwa ewiei, na wɔdze no to Nyankopɔn Ba no ho), ɔsɔfo a ɔwɔ hɔ daa.
Na hom nhwɛ nyimpa yi a egya panyin Abraham maa no asadze a ɔsom bo no mu ebupɛn du no sõ a ɔsõ.
Na hɔn a wofi Levimba mu nya asɔfodwuma no wɔ ahyɛdze bi dɛ wɔgye ebupɛn du du, dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse, wɔ ɔman no hɔ, ɔnye dɛ hɔn nuanom hɔ, naaso hɔn nyina fir Abraham asen mu bae:
na mbom nyia ne nanakan wommfitsi hɔn do kan no, ɔgyee Abraham hɔ ebupɛn du du na ohyiraa nyia ɔwɔ anohoba no.
Na ekyingye biara nnyi ho dɛ nyia ɔsõ kyɛn na ohyira ekuma.
Na nyimpa a wowu na wɔgye ebupɛn du du, na hɔ dze obi a wɔgye no ho dase dɛ ɔtse ase no a.
Na sɛ yɛrekã a, Levi a ɔgye ebupɛn du du no nam Abraham do maa ebupɛn du du no bo;
na ber a Melchizedec kehyiaa n'egya no na ɔda ho wɔ n'asen mu.
Na sɛ emudzi wɔ Levi asɔfodzi mu a (no mu na ɔman no nyaa mbra no), nkyɛ hia bɛn na ohia dɛ fofor bi bɔsoɛr dɛ Melchizedec mbron do sɔfopanyin; na wɔnnkan no dɛ Aaron mbron do a?
Na wɔsakyer asɔfodzi no a, otwar dɛ wɔsakyer mbra no so.
Na nyia wɔkã no ho yinom yi ofi ebusuakuw fofor bi a obi mmfiir mu mmbɔsoom afɔrmbukyia no ho pɛn.
Na ɔda hɔ petee dɛ Judah mu na hɛn Ewuradze fir puei; ebusuakuw a Moses ammbɔ dzin annkã hwee wɔ asɔfodzi ho.
Na dza ɔma ɔda hɔ petee koraa nye dɛ, sɛ Melchizedec mbron do sɔfopanyin bɔsoɛr a,
ɔnnam honam ahyɛzde do, na mbom ɔnam nkwa a ɔmmbɔ adze ahoɔdzen do yɛ sɔfo:
na wodzi no ho dase dɛ, ɔwo eyɛ ɔsɔfo daa Wɔ Melchizedec mbron do.
Na wogu ahyɛdze a odzi kan no, osiandɛ ɔyɛ mberɛw na ho nnyi mfaso ntsi,
(na mbra no amma biribi enndzi mu), na eso wɔdze enyidado a oye kyɛn a yɛnam do twe pin Nyankopɔn esi ananmu.
Na susuampa dɛ woennkwetsi ntanka annyɛ yi no:
(Na hɔnzde wokwetsii ntanka dzii asɔfo, na ɔnodze wɔdze ntanka hyɛɛ no ɔsɔfo ɔnam nyia ɔse wɔ no ho dɛ, Ewuradze akã ntam, orunnu noho, ɔwo eyɛ ɔsɔfo daa);
mbrɛ Jesus nam bɛyɛɛ ahyɛmudzi a oye kyɛn no ho egyinamu so nye no.
Na hɔndze dodowara ayɛ asɔfo osiandɛ wɔnam owu do siw hɔn kwan dɛ wɔnntwena hɔ daa;
na ɔnodze ɔtsena hɔ daa ntsi, ɔwɔ asɔfodzi a ɔnnsakyer.
Dɛm ntsi so otum gye hɔn a wɔnam no do ba Nyankopɔn hɔ no koraa, dɛ ɔtse ase daa dɛ odzi ma hɔn ntsi.
Na dɛm sɔfopanyin no fata hɛn; no ho tsew, onndzi abra, ho nnyi nkekaa, woeyi no efi ndzebɔnyɛfo ho, na wɔama no do akyɛn ɔsorsor;
onnhia no daa dɛ asɔfompanyin no, dɛ odzi kan bɔ afɔr wɔ nankasa no bɔn ho ansaana ɔabɔ wɔ ɔman no nedze ho: Na ɔyɛɛ yi prɛko, ber a ɔdze noho bɔɔ afɔr no.
Na mbra no hyɛ nyimpa a hɔn ho yɛ mberɛw asɔfompanyin, na ntanka asɛm a odzi no ekyir no dze, ɔhyɛ ɔba a oedzi mu daa no.
8: Na nsɛm a yɛrekã yi no mu tsitsir nye yi: dɛm sɔfopanyin na yɛwɔ, nyia ɔakɛtsena Enyimnyam Hen n'ahengua no enyimfa wɔ sorsor no,
Krɔnkrɔn-bea no nye nokwar ntamadan a Nyankopɔn nankasa, na nnyɛ nyimpa bi sii no no somfo.
Na sɔfopanyin biara wɔhyɛ no ma ɔdze ayɛyɛdze nye afɔrbɔdze aama: Dɛm ntsi otwar dɛ oyi so onya biribi a ɔdze bɛma.
Na sɛ ɔwɔ asaase ha a, nkyɛ ɔnnyɛ ɔsɔfo koraa, osiandɛ hɔn a wɔdze ayɛyɛdze ma dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse no, wɔ hɔ dada;
hɔn na wɔsom sor ndzɛmba no susudo nye no sunsum; dɛ mbrɛ Moses wɔbɔɔ no nkaa ber a oribesi ntamadan no: Na ɔse dɛ, hwɛ dɛ eyɛ adze nyina dɛ mbrɛ nsusudo a wɔdze kyerɛɛ wo wɔ koko no do no tse.
Na afei ne nsa akã asɔfodzi a ɔkyɛn, dɛ ɔayɛ ntamugyinafo wɔ ahyɛmu a oye kyɛn a wogyina anohoba a oye kyɛn no do hyɛe no ho.
Na sɛ dza odzi kan no ho nnyi asɛm a, nkyɛ wɔannhwehwɛ gyinabew bi amma dza otsīa ebien no.
Na onya hɔn ho asɛm bi no, ɔkãa dɛ, hwɛ, na bi reba, Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ menye Israel fi nye Judah fi bedzi ahyɛmu fofor;
ɔnntse dɛ ahyɛmu a menye hɔn egyanom dzii wɔ da a mususuoo hɔn nsamu yii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do; na hɔndze wɔanntsena m'ahyɛmu no mu, na mo so manndwen hɔn do, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na ahyɛmu a menye Israel fi bedzi nye yi, nda no ekyir no, Ewuradze se; medze me mbra mebɛhyɛ hɔn adwen mu, na makyerɛw no hɔn akoma do so; na mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn na hɔn so wɔayɛ me ɔman;
Na obi rennkyerɛ no kuromnyi, obi rennkyerɛ no nua dɛ, hu Ewuradze: Na hɔn nyina bohu me, ofitsi hɔn mu ekumaba do kesi kɛse do.
Na mubohu hɔn emumuyɛ mbɔbɔr, na hɔn bɔn merennkaa bio.
Dza ɔkã dɛ, fofor, no, ɔdze ayɛ kan dze no dadaw. Na dza ɔayɛ dadaw na ɔreyɛ akɔdaa no nna ɔreyɛ ahera.
9: Na ahyɛmu a odzi kan no wɔ nyamesom ho ahyehyɛdze, nye ne wiadze ha krɔnkrɔn-bea.
Na wosii ntamadan bi, dza odzi kan a wɔfrɛ no Krɔnkrɔn-bea, mbrɛ kandzeadua no, nye ɔpon no, nye kyerɛpaanoo no wɔ.
Na ntwamutam a otsīa ebien no ekyir na ntamadan a wɔfrɛ no Krɔnkrɔn mu Krɔnkrɔn no wɔ;
ɔwɔ sika eduhuamhyew mbukyia, nye ahyɛmudaka no a wɔdze sika edura ho nyina a sika kutu a manna wɔ mu, nye Aaron poma a ɔfefɛwee no, nye Ahyɛmuapon no wɔ mu no:
na no do na enyimnyam cherubfo a wɔtserɛw mpatagua no do si; ndzɛmba yi yenntum nnkã ho asɛm nkorkor sesei.
Na woesiesie ndzɛmba yi dɛm no, asɔfo no kɔ ntamadan a odzi kan no mu daa kɛyɛ ɔsom ho edwuma,
na dza otsīa ebien no dze, sɔfopanyin no na afe du a, ɔkɔ hɔ prɛko, onngyaa bɔgya a ɔdze bɔ afɔr wɔ nankasa nye ɔman no hɔn mfom ntsi:
Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn dze yi kyerɛ dɛ, ntamadan a odzi kan no da ho si hɔ yi, wonnyae nnyii kwan a wɔdze kɔ krɔnkrɔn-bea mu no edzi;
na ɔyɛ nsɛntoho ma sesei ber a ɔwɔ hɔ yi; dɛ mbrɛ wɔdze ayɛyɛdze nye afɔrbɔdze a onntum mma nyia ɔsom no nndzi mu wɔ tsibowa afamu,
osiandɛ ɔnye edziban nye anondze nye eguaree horow yɛ honam afamu ahyehyɛdze ara a wɔhyɛ dɛ wɔnyɛ nkodu sesɛw ber no.
Na Christ dze, ɔbaa dɛ ndzepa a ɔrebɛba no ho sɔfopanyin no ɔnam ntamadan a asõ na odzi mu kyɛn do a wɔammfa nsa ennsi no do, ɔnye dɛ ommfi abɔdze yi mu,
na eso ɔnnam mpɔnkye nye anantwimba bɔgyaa mu, na ɔnam nankasa no bɔgyaa do kɛhɛɛn krɔnkrɔn-bea no mu prɛko kenyaa onnyiewiei ɔgye.
Na sɛ mpɔnkye nye anantwinyin bɔgyaa nye anantwiber nso a wɔdze petse hɔn a hɔn ho egu fī do, ɔtsew hɔn kɔ honam ahosan mu a,
mpɛn ahen ara na Christ a ɔnam onnyiewiei Sunsum no do yɛɛ noho afɔrbɔdze a nkekaa nnyi ho maa Nyankopɔn no, no bɔgyaa nnkɛtsew hom tsibowa ho efi ndwuma a nkwa nnyi mu ho akɔsom Nyankopɔn tsetsefo.
Na iyi ntsi ɔyɛ ahyɛmu fofor ntamugyinafo, dɛ owu a owui dze yɛɛ nkan ahyɛmu no no tõ ho ɔgye ntsi, hɔn a wɔafrɛ hɔn no enya onnyiewiei egyapadze ho anohoba no.
Na mbrɛ Samansew wɔ no otwar dɛ wɔkyerɛ nyia ɔhyɛe no no wu.
Na owu ba a nna samansew wɔ ahom; na nyia ɔhyɛe no tse ase a, onnyi ahom da.
Ɔno ntsi na woennkwetsi bɔgya annhyɛ ahyɛmu a odzi kan no so.

Na Moses kãa ahyɛdze no nyina kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyina, dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse no, ɔfaa anantwimba no nye mpɔnkye no bɔgyaa, nye nso, nye kuntu memen nye hyssop, na ɔdze petsee nwoma no nankasa nye ɔman no nyina do,
na ɔsee dɛ, iyi nye ahyɛmu a Nyankopɔn ahyɛ wɔ hom ho no no bɔgyaa.
Bio so, ntamadan no nye asɔfodwuma no ho ndzɛmba nyina ɔdze bɔgya petsee ho dɛmara.
Na aka kakra na maakã dɛ adze nyina, dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse, wɔdze bɔgya tsew ho, na bɔgya enngu a, fakyɛ bi nnyi hɔ.
Dɛm ntsi otwar dɛ sor ndzɛmba no n'esusudo no wɔdze yinom tsew ho; na sor ndzɛmba no nankasa dze, wɔdze afɔr a oye kyɛn yinom.
Na Christ annhɛn krɔnkrɔn-bea a wɔdze nsa yɛe a ɔyɛ nokwar dze no ho ntoho no mu; na mbom ɔhɛɛn ɔsor ankasa dɛ afei worikeyi no edzi wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim ama hɛn;
na eso nnyɛ dɛ ɔdze noho bɔbɔ afɔr mpɛn pii dɛ mbrɛ sɔfopanyin no ɔdze bɔgya a ɔnnyɛ nankasa dze hɛn krɔnkrɔn-bea afrenhyia afrenhyia no;
ɔnodze na nkyɛ otwar dɛ ofi wiadze asefir hu amandze mpɛn pii: na afei dze mbersantsen ruwie du yi, woeyi no edzi prɛko dɛ ɔnam noho afɔrbɔ do beyi bɔn akɔ.
Na dɛ mbrɛ wɔahyɛ ama nyimpa dɛ owu prɛko, na ɔno ekyir atsɛmbu bɛba no,
dɛmara na Christ so a wɔdze no bɔɔ afɔr prɛko dɛ ɔnsoa nyimpa pii bɔn no, obokwetsi bɔn eyi noho edzi ne mpɛn ebien akyerɛ hɔn a wɔtweɔn no dze hɔn akɔ nkwagye mu.
10: Na mbra no wɔ ndzepa a ɔbɛba no no sunsuma na nnyɛ ndzɛmba no suban ankasa ntsi, wonntum mmfa afɔr kor no ara a wɔbɔ no afrenhyia afrenhyia no mma hɔn a wɔba no nndzi mu da.
Nkyɛ woengyaa afɔr bɔ, osiandɛ nkyɛ hɔn a wɔba asɔr no a wɔatsew hɔnho prɛko no, ana wonnyi bɔn ho tsibowa bio?
Na mbom wɔbɔ bɔn ho nkaa wɔ mu afrenhyia biara.
Na onntum nnyɛ dɛ anantwinyin nye mpɔnkye bɔgyaa beyi bɔn akɔ.
Dɛm ntsi ɔba wiadze a, ɔkã dɛ, afɔr nye ayɛyɛdze ammpɛ, na honam na esiesie ama me;
hyew-afɔr mu nye bɔn ho dze annsɔ w'enyi:
Nna mesee dɛ, hwɛ, maba (wɔakyerɛw no mo ho wɔ nwoma mbobɔwee no mu) dɛ merebɛyɛ ɔwo Nyankopɔn wo pɛ.
ɔkãa no hɔ dɛ, afɔr nye ayɛyɛdze nye hyew-afɔr nye bɔn ho dze ammpɛ, eso w'enyi annsɔ no (ɔnye dza wɔnam mbra do dze ma no) no,
nkyii ɔkãa dɛ, maba merebɛyɛ wo pɛ. Oyi dza odzi kan no hɔ, na ɔdze dza otsia ebien no eesi hɔ.
Dɛm pɛ no do na wɔnam Jesus Christ honam a ɔdze bɔɔ afɔr prɛko maa hɛn no do atsew hɛn ho.
Na ɔsɔfo biara dze ogyina som daa daa bɔ afɔr kor no ara a onntum nnyi bɔn nnkɔ da no:
na ɔnodze onyae bɔɔ bɔn ho afɔr kor no, ɔkɛtsenaa Nyankopɔn nyimfa daa;
ɔdzekɔr yi n'enyi da kwan dɛ wɔdze n'atamfo bɛyɛ n'ananadzegua.
Na ɔnam afɔr kor do ama hɔn a wɔatsew hɔn ho no edzi mu daa.
Na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn so dzi hɛn dase: na odzi kan kã dɛ,
Iyi nye ahyɛmu a menye hɔn bedzi nda no ekyir no, Ewuradze na ɔse: Medze me mbra bɛhyɛ hɔn akoma mu, na makyerɛw no hɔn adwen mu so; nna ɔkã so dɛ,
Na hɔn bɔn nye hɔn mbrato merennkaa bio.
Na mbrɛ yinom ho fakyɛ wɔ no, bɔn ho afɔr bi nnyi hɔ bio.
Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, yɛnam Jesus bɔgyaa do enya ndam dɛ yɛdze bɛhɛn krɔnkrɔn-bea no,
ɔnam ɔkwan a woebue ato hɛn hɔ no mu, kwan fofor a ɔwɔ nkwa a ɔnam ntwamutam a ɔnye no honam mu,
na yɛwɔ sɔfo kɛse a odzi Nyankopɔn fi do ntsi,
hom mma yɛmfa nokwar akoma ntwe mpin wɔ gyedzi amãyɛ mu, dɛ wɔapetse hɛn akoma ho efi tsibowa bɔn mu, na woeguar hɛn nyimpadua wɔ nsu krɔnkrɔn mu.
Hom mma yensuo hɛn enyidado a yɛpaa mu kã no mu twem, mma oeennhihim, na nyia ɔbɔɔ anohoba no ɔyɛ nokwafo;
na hom mma yɛndwendwen hɛnho do, nnunu hɛnho nkɔ dɔ nye ndwuma pa mu;
hɛn werɛ mmfir hɛnho ehyiadzi, dɛ mbrɛ binom hɔn ntɔyɛɛ tse, na yentutu hɛnho fo dodoodow dɛ hom nyim dɛ da no rebɛn.
Na yeenya nokwar no ho nyimdzee ekyir yi, sɛ yɛboapa kɛyɛ bɔn a, bɔn ho afɔrbɔ nnyi hɔ bio,
na mbom atsɛmbu ho akwanhyɛ a ɔyɛ hu bi, nye ogyaframee bi a ɔbɛhyew atamfo no.
Nyimpa a ɔpow Moses mbra wokwetsi ehumbɔbɔr gyina adasefo beenu anaa baasa anomu asɛm do ku no:
Akatua a ɔyɛ dzen bɛn na hom susu dɛ wobobu dɛ ɔsɛ nyia oetsiatsia Nyankopɔn Ba no do, na oebu ahyɛmu bɔgyaa a wɔdze tseew no ho no ehuhudze, na ɔabɔ adom Sunsum adapaa?
Na yenyim nyia ɔkã dɛ, Awerdzi yɛ medze, na mubotwa kaw; na bio so, Ewuradze bobua ne man atsɛn.
Adze a ɔyɛ hu nye dɛ abɔtɔ Nyankopɔn tseasefo no abaw mu.
Na hom nkaa nkan nda a hom nyaa kan ekyir no hom sɔɔw amandzehu kõ kɛse no;
bi nye dɛ hom nam ahorohoraa nye ahohia do yɛ guasohwɛdze, na bi so nye dɛ hom yɛ hɔn a wɔayɛ hɔn dɛm no mfɛfo.
Na hom nyaa ayamuhyehye wɔ ndaduafo no ho, na hom dze enyigye peen hom ahodze no fow, dɛ hom nyim dɛ homankasa wɔ ahodze a oye kyɛn, na eso ɔtsena hɔ.
Dɛm ntsi mma hom nntow hom ndam a ɔwɔ akatua pii no nnkyen.
Na ohia hom abotar, na sɛ hom wie Nyankopɔn apɛdze yɛ a, hom nsa aakã anohoba no.
Na aka kakraba dɛm, na nyia ɔreba na aba, na ɔrennkyɛr.
Na me tseneneenyi no nam gyedzi do benya nkwa, na sɛ ɔtwe ekyir a, me kra enyi ronnsɔ no.
Na hɛndze yɛmmfora hɔn a wɔtwe hɔnho ekyir kɔ sɛɛ mu, na mbom yɛfora hɔn a wɔgye dzi dze gye hɔn kra nkwa.
11: Na afei gyedzi nye adze a hɛn enyi da do ho awerɛhyɛmu a osi pi, adze a enyi nntua ho no nokwar ho ngyetomu.
Na no mu na tsetsefo no nyaa dase a wɔgyee no hɔn ho.
Gyedzi na yɛdze tse ase dɛ wiadze horow wɔdze Nyankopɔn asɛm siesie, ma dza enyi tua ho yi emmfi dza ɔda hɔ mu na wɔyɛe.
Gyedzi na Abel dze bɔɔ afɔr a oye kyɛn Cain dze maa Nyankopɔn na ɔnam do nyaa dase a wodzii no no ho dɛ ɔtsen, Nyankopɔn gye n'ayɛyɛdze ho dase: na ɔnam do na owui a, ɔda ho kasa.
Gyedzi ntsi na wɔfaa Enoch kɔree na oennhu owu; na woennhu no ana Nyankopɔn abɛfa no kɔ ntsi, na ansaana wɔfaa no kɔree no, onyaa dase dɛ ɔasɔ Nyankopɔn enyi:
na gyedzi nnyi mu a, obi nntum nnsɔ n'enyi; na nyia ɔba Nyankopɔn nkyɛn no otwar dɛ ɔgye dzi dɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na ɔyɛ hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ n'ekyir kwan katuafo.
Gyedzi ntsi na wɔbɔɔ Noah nkaa wɔ dza wonnyae nnhunii ho a, nyamesuro tuu no do, na osiesiee hɛn dze gyee ne fifo nkwa, na ɔnam do buu wiadze atsɛn na ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔdzedzifo maa gyedzi ho tsenenee no.
Gyedzi ntsi na Abraham, wɔfrɛɛ no a, otsiei dɛ ɔbɔkɔ beebi a daakye obenya no dɛ egyapadze, na osii mu nna onnyim mbrɛ ɔrokɔ.
Gyedzi ntsi na ɔkɛyɛɛ hɔho wɔ anohoba asaase no do dɛ dza ɔnnyɛ nedze, na ɔnye Isaac nye Jacob a wɔyɛ anohoba kor no ara edzifo no kɛtsenaa asese mu;
na n'enyi tua kurow no a ɔwɔ fapem no a ne kyekyefo nye yɛfo nye Nyankopɔn no.
Gyedzi so na Sarah dze, onyaa ahoɔdzen dze nyinseen ɔba wɔ aber a ɔtra ne nyin, osiandɛ obuu nyia ɔbɔɔ no anohoba no nokwafo:
ntsi na ɔbaako a ɔyɛ dɛ oewu mpo, ɔwoo hɔn a wɔdɔɔ sõ dɛ sor nworaba, na wɔtse dɛ mpoano anhwea a wonntum nnkan.
Gyedzi mu na iyinom nyina wui, hɔn nsa annkã anohoba no na ekyirkyir paa mu kãa dɛ wɔyɛ anana nye akwantufo wɔ asaase do.
Na hɔn a wɔkã dɛm no woyi kyerɛ dɛ wɔrohwehwɛ hɔn kurow bi.
Na sɛ hɔn adwen wɔ dza wofii mu kɔree no do a, nkyɛ wɔwɔ kwan dɛ wɔbɛsan akɔ.
Na afei wɔhwehwɛ dza oye kyɛn, ɔno nye sor dze no: Dɛm ntsi hɔn ho nnyɛ Nyankopɔn enyiwu dɛ wɔbɛfrɛ no hɔn Nyankopɔn, osiandɛ oesiesie kurow bi ama hɔn.
Gyedzi ntsi na Abraham wɔsɔɔ no hwɛe no, ɔdze Isaac kɔbɔɔ afɔr: Na nyia ɔgyee anohoba no dze ne ba kor no kɛmae;
ɔno na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Isaac mu na wɔbɛfrɛ w'asefo:
obuu dɛ Nyankopɔn botum enyan no efi ewufo mu mpo; hɔ so na onyaa no bio wɔ abɛbu mu.
Gyedzi ntsi na Isaac hyiraa Jacob nye Esau wɔ ndzɛmba a ɔreba ho mpo.
Gyedzi ntsi na Jacob ruwu a, ohyiraa Joseph mba beenu no, na ɔkoom no poma tsir do sɔree.
Gyedzi ntsi na Joseph n'ewiei rebɛn no, ɔbɔɔ ofir a Israelmba ribefir akɔ no dzin: na ɔhyɛɛ ne mbiew ho samansew.
Gyedzi ntsi na wɔwoo Moses no n'awofo dze no sumaa abosoom ebiasa, osiandɛ wohun dɛ ɔyɛ abofra a no ho yɛ fɛw: Na woennsuro ɔhen mbra no.
Gyedzi ntsi na Moses nyinii a, ɔpoow dɛ wɔbɛfrɛ no Pharaoh babaa ba;
na ɔfaa dɛ ɔnye Nyankopɔn man bohu amandze mbom kyɛn dɛ obedzi bɔn ho dɛw ber tsiabaa bi;
na obuu Christ ahorohoraa no ahonya kɛse kyɛn Egypt ahonyadze, na ɔhwɛɛ akatua no.
Gyedzi ntsi na ɔdaan Egypt gyae na oennsuro ɔhen ebufuw no: Na ɔsɔɔw no dɛ n'enyi tua nyia wonnhu no.
Gyedzi ntsi na odzii apaho no, nye bɔgyaa petse no, ma mbakan asɛfo no aannkã hɔn.
Gyedzi ntsi na wotwaa epo memen no dɛ wefa do; ɔno na Egyptfo reyɛ bi ahwɛ a, ɔmeen hɔn.
Gyedzi ntsi na Jericho afasu no wɔbɔɔ ho aprɔw nda esuon a, obui.
Gyedzi ntsi na edwaman Rahab gyee akwanserafo no asomdwee mu, na ɔammfora asokyewfo no annhera.
Na menkã dɛn bio? Sɛ merekã Gideon, Barak, Samson nye Jephthah, David nye Samuel nye nkɔnhyɛfo no ho asɛm a, nkyɛ mber bɔbɔ me:
hɔn na wɔnam gyedzi do dzii ahendzi horow do konyim, yɛɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee, nyinyaa anohoba, siiw ngyata ano,
duum gya ahoɔdzen, guaan nkrantsee ano, nyaa ahoɔmberɛw mu ahoɔdzen, yɛɛ ɔkõ mu mbayinndam, kãa ananafo dɔm gui.
Mbaa nsa kãa hɔn efun a wɔsoɛree, na binom so wɔhyɛɛ hɔn amen, na wɔammpɛ ɔgye, ma woeenya owusoɛr a oye kyɛn.
Na binom so nyaa atwetwesi nye ɔhwe, nye mpokyerɛ nye efiadzenda so.
Wosiiw hɔn abo, wɔpaa hɔn seradaa, wɔsɔɔ hɔn hwɛe, wɔdze nkrantsee kum hɔn; wokyinii wɔ nguan nwoma nye mpɔnkye nwoma mu, ohiaa hɔn, hɔn ho guaan hɔn, wohun amandze:
Hɔn na wiadze mmfata hɔn: wokyinkyiin sar nye mbepɔw do, abodan nye asaase etu mu.
Na iyinom nyina a wɔnam gyedzi do nyaa dase no, hɔn nsa annkã anohoba no,
osiandɛ Nyankopɔn esiesie biribi a oye kyɛn esie hɛn dɛ wokwetsi hɛn a worinndzi mu.
12: Dɛm ntsi hɛn so yɛwɔ adasefo mununkum kɛse a ɔtse dɛm a oetwa hɛn ho ehyia ntsi, hom mma yɛmfa dza osiw kwan nyina nto nkyɛn, nye bɔn a ɔnnkyɛr na ɔatõto hɛn ananmu no, na yɛmfa abotar ntutu empire a osi hɛn enyim no mu mbirika,
nhwɛ gyedzi ne dzikamfo nye no wiefo Jesus a osian dɛw a wɔdze sii n'enyim ntsi ɔsɔɔw mbeamudua no, obuu enyiwu adzeba, na ɔakɛtsena ase wɔ Nyankopɔn ahengua no enyimfa.
Na hom mma hom adwen nkɔ nyia ɔyɛɛ abotar tsiee ndzebɔnyɛfo hɔn nyiyiano tsiaa no ho no, amma hom aammberɛ anntɔ bitsi wɔ hom akra mu.
Akõ a hom nye bɔn ridzi, hom nnyae nnsiiw kwan nnkodu bɔgya mu;
na hom werɛ efir afotu a ɔkasa kyerɛ hom dɛ mba no dɛ, me na, mma mmbu Ewuradze ntsēa no adzeba, eso sɛ ɔkã w'enyim a, mma mmpa abaw:
Na nyia Ewuradze dɔ no na ɔtsēa no, na ɔhwe ɔba biara a ɔgye no.
Dza hom sow no, ntsēa ntsi a; Nyankopɔn nye hom dzi dɛ mba; na ɔba bɛn na n'egya nntsēa no?
Na sɛ hom nnyi ntsēa a hɔn nyina nya bi no a, nna hom yɛ sɔnmumba, na nnyɛ mba pa a.
Bio so, yenyaa hɛn honam mu egyanom a wɔatsēaa hɛn, na yɛfɛɛr hɔn: aso mbom yɛnnkɛfa hɛnho ahyɛ hɛn sunsum mu Egya no ase na yɛatsena ase?
Na hɔndze, ampaara wɔtsēaa hɛn nda kakraabi dɛ mbrɛ wɔhwɛ a oye ma hɔn: Na ɔnodze ɔyɛ hɛn mfaso na yeenya n'ahotsew no bi.
Na sesei dze ntsēa nyina nnyɛ enyigye, na mbom awerɛhodze a; na n'ekyir no ɔsow asomdwee aba dze ma hɔn a wɔdze asɔ hɔn ahwɛ no, mekyerɛ tsenenee aba.
Dɛm ntsi hom mma abaw a ɔsensɛnee do, nye nkotodwe a ɔadwe no;
na hom nsiesie akwan tsenenee mma hom anan, amma dza ɔtow apakye no oeennhuan adwonku, na mbom wɔaasa no yarba.
Hom ndzi asomdwee ekyir wɔ nyimpa nyina afamu, nye ahotsewee a obi kwetsi a orunnhu Ewuradze no:
Hom nhwɛ yie amma obi eemmfi Nyankopɔn adom ho annka ekyir: amma bɔwen ndwow bi eemmfir annhaw hom, na eenndua do ma ɔdodow ho eenngu fī;
amma obi aannyɛ edwaman anaa huhunyi bi, dɛ Esau a ɔtɔɔn n'abakan ndzinoa gyee edziban dzipɛn kor.
Na hom nyim mbrɛ ekyir no ɔpɛɛ dɛ onya nhyira no a, wɔpoow no, na nnhuhu kwan no dze, kaansa ɔdze nyinsuwa hwehwɛe a, oennhu.
Na hom mmbaa koko no a wɔdze nsa kã, na ɔredzɛw ogya no ho, nye mununkum, nye sum, nye ehum,
nye totorobɛnto nye gyegye, nye ndze a hɔn a wɔtsee no wɔserɛɛ dɛ mma wɔnnkã asɛm bi nnkyerɛ hɔn bio no ho.
Na woenntum annsɔw dza wɔhyɛe no, sɛ abowa mpo ho kã koko no a, wonsiw no abo;
na dza opuei yɛ hu piintsi Moses kãa dɛ, musuro dodow na mo ho popo.
Na mbom hom aba bepɔw Sion, nye Nyankopɔn tseasefo kurow no, ɔsor Jerusalem no ho, nye ɔsor abɔfo mpempem,
nye mbakan a wɔakyerɛw hɔn edzin wɔ sor no hɔn asafo nye baguabɔ, nye Nyankopɔn, nyimpa nyina tsɛmbuafo no, nye tseneneefo a woedzi mu esunsum,
nye ahyɛmu fofor ho ntamugyinafo Jesus, nye ɔpetse-bɔgya no a ɔkasa yie kyɛn Abel dze no ho.
Hom nhwɛ na hom aammpow nyia ɔkasa no. Na sɛ hɔn a wɔpoow nyia ɔkasaa asaase do no emmfi nsa a, hɛn mbom sɛ yɛdan fi nyia ofi sor kasa no ho a, yerimmfi nsa.
ɔno na ber no mu ne ndze wosoow asaase, na afei dze ɔabɔ anohoba dɛ, mebɛma awosow prɛko bio, na nnyɛ asaase nko bi na sor so.
Na, Prɛko bio yi, ɔkyerɛ ndzɛmba a wɔwosow no ne nyii, dɛ ndzɛmba a wɔayɛ, na ndzɛmba a wɔnnwosow no aakɔ hɔ.
Dɛm ntsi, dɛ yeenya ahenman a ɔnnwosow yi, hom mma yennya ndaase ndua do nsom Nyankopɔn nsɔ n'enyi wɔ enyidzi nye hu mu:
Na hɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ gya a ɔhyew.
13: Hom mma enuadɔ ntsena hɔ.
Mma hom enyi mmpa ahɔhoyɛ do: Na ɔno do na binom nam ayɛ abɔfo a woennhu hɔn dɛm no ahɔho.
Hom nkaa hɔn a wɔda nkurufi mu, dɛ dza hom nye hɔn da mu, nye hɔn a wohu amandze biara, dɛ homankasa so da ho wɔ honam mu.
Hom ndzi awar nyi wɔ adze nyina mu, na mma hom nngu awarmpa ho fī: Na ndwaman nye awartofo dze, Nyankopɔn bobua hɔn atsɛn.
Mma sika enyiber mma hom abrabɔ mu; hom bo ndwe dza hom wɔ no ara: Na nankasa akã dɛ, Mirinngya wo da, eso meremmpa wo da biara da.
Ntsi yɛdze ndam kã dɛ, Ewuradze nye mo boafo; murunnsuro: Nyimpa botum ayɛ me dɛn?
Hom nkaa hɔn a wɔhwɛɛ hom do a wɔkãa nyamesɛm kyerɛɛ hom no; hom nhwɛ hɔn abrabɔ ewiei, na hom nsūa hɔn gyedzi.
Jesus Christ tse dɛmara ndeda, nye ndɛ, nye daapem nyina.
Mma hom mma nkyerɛkyerɛ horow fofor bi mmfa hom nnkyinkyin: na oye dɛ wɔdze adom hyɛ akoma dzen mbom, na nnyɛ edziban a hɔn a wɔnantsew mu ennya mfaso bi no a.
yɛwɔ afɔrmbukyia a hɔn a wɔsom ntamadan no nnyi kwan dɛ wodzi ho biribi.
Na mbowa a sɔfopanyin no dze hɔn bɔgyaa kɔ krɔnkrɔn-bea mu wɔ bɔn ntsi no, hɔn efun wɔhyew no nseraban no ekyir.
Ntsi na Jesus so, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ na ɔdze no bɔgyaa atsew ɔman no ho no, ohun amandze wɔ kuropon no ekyir.
Dɛm ntsi hom mma yemfir nkɔ ne nkyɛn wɔ nseraban no ekyir, dɛ yɛso n'ahorohoraa.
Na yeenyi kurow a ɔtse hɔ daa wɔ ha, na mbom dza ɔreba no na yɛhwehwɛ n'ekyir kwan.
Ɔno ntsi hom mma yendua no do mbɔ ayɛyi-afɔr mma Nyankopɔn daa, ɔnye anofamfa a ɔbɔ no abɔdzin aba.
Na yieyɛ nye adzekyɛ mma hom werɛ mmfir, na dɛm afɔrbɔdze yi na ɔsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi.
Hom ntsie hɔn a wɔhwɛ hom do na hom mbrɛ homho adze: na hɔn na wɔweɔn hom akra, dɛ hɔn a wobubu nkontaa; na wɔdze enyigye aayɛ yi na nnyɛ krumsi a: na yi nnyɛ mfaso mma hom.
Hom nsɔr mma hɛn: na yɛwɔ werɛ dɛ yɛwɔ tsibowa pa, dɛ yɛpɛ dɛ yɛbɔ hɛn bra yie wɔ adze nyina mu.
Na mutu hom fo papaapa dɛ hom nyɛ yi, na wɔaadan me ama hom ntsɛmara.
Afei asomdwee Nyankopɔn a ɔnam onnyiewiei ahyɛmu no bɔgya do dze nguan no hɔn hwɛfo kɛse, hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ, fi ewufo mu baa bio no,
ɔmma hom ndzi mu wɔ edwuma pa nyina mu, na hom nyɛ ne pɛ, na ɔnnam Jesus Christ do nyɛ hɛn mu dza ɔsɔ n'enyi, ɔno na enyimnyam nkã no mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
Na mutu hom fo, enuanom, hom ntsie afotusɛm yi: Na makyerɛw nsɛntsia bi mamona hom.
Hom nhu dɛ woegyaa hɛn nua Timothy; na sɛ ɔba ntsɛm a, menye no bɛba ebohu hom.
Hom nkyiakyia hɔn a wɔhwɛ hom do no nyina, nye ahotsewfo no nyina. Hɔn a wofi Italy no kyiakyia hom.
Adom nkã hom nyina. Amen.

1: Ewuradze n’asɛm a ɔbaa Beeri ba Hosea hɔ, wɔ Judah ahemfo Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, na Hezekiah nda mu, na Israelhen, Joash ba Jeroboam nda mu no.
Ber a Ewuradze nam Hosea do kasaa asɔpɔn no, Ewuradze see Hosea dɛ, kɔ, kɛfa ɔbaa edwaman na ndwaman mba war: Na asaase no efi Ewuradze nkyɛn rogor ndwamangor kɛse.
Nna ɔkɔree kɛfaa Diblaim ba Gomer; na onyinsenii woo babanyin maa no.
Na Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, to no dzin Jezreel; na aka kakra ma meebedzi Jezreel no bɔgyaa ho wer wɔ Jehu fi do, na maama Israel fi ahendzi no abɔ adz e.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no mubobubu Israel egyen mu wɔ Jezreel bɔnsa mu.
Na onyinseen bio na owoo babaa. Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, to no dzin Lo-ruhamah: Na merennda ho nnhu Israel fi mbɔbɔr, na medze efir hɔn bio.
Na mubohu Judah fi mbɔbɔr na magye hɔn nkwa, wo Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn no mu, na menndze egyen, anaa afõwa, anaa akõdze, mpɔnkɔ, anaa mpɔnkɔdo- fo.
Na otwaa Lo-ruhamah enumfo no, onyinsenii, na ɔwoo baba nyin.
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, to no dzin Lo-ammi: Osiandɛ hom nnyɛ me man, na mo so mennyɛ hom Nyankopɔn.
Naaso Israelmba hɔn dodow bɛyɛ dɛ mpoano anhwea a wonnsusu eso wɔnnkan; na ɔbɛba dɛ fakor a wɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nnyɛ me man no, wɔbɛse hɔn dɛ, hom yɛ Nyame tseasefo mba.
Na Judahmba na Israelmba bɔbɔ mu ehyia na wɔahyɛ otsitsir kor ama hɔnho, na wɔafow efi asaase no do akɔ: Na Jezreel da no bɛyɛ da kɛse.
2: Hom nse hom enuanom dɛ, Ammi; na hom nkyerɛbaa dɛ, Ruhamah.
Hom nye hom nã nkekã, hom nye no nkekã; na ɔnnyɛ me yer, na mo so mennyɛ no kun: Na hom mma onyi no ndwamanyɛ no mfi n’enyi do, na n’awarto mfi n’enumfo ntamu;
amma maammpa no ho tam ma oeenndzi adagyaw, na maammfa no mennsi hɔ dɛ da a wɔwoo no no, na maannyɛ no dɛ sar do, na maammfa no mennsi hɔ dɛ asaase kɛsɛɛ, na maammfa nsukɔm mennku no;
nyew, murunnhu ne mba mbɔbɔr; na wɔyɛ ndwaman mba.
Na hɔn nã akɔgor ndwamangor: Nyia onyin seen hɔn no ayɛ enyitodze: Na ɔkã dɛ, mibedzi mo nwewefo ekyir. Hɔn a wɔma me m'edziban na mo nsu mo nguannhwi na m’asaaba, mo ngo na me nsã.
Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, medze nsoɛ mibesi wo kwan do ban, na matow ɔfasu esiw n’enyim, na onnkohu n’akwan.
Na obetsiw no nwewefo, na ɔronnto hɔn; na ɔbɔhwehwɛ hɔn ekyir kwan, na onnkohu hɔn: Nna ɔbɛse dɛ, mebɛsan m’ekyir makɔ mo kun kankan no nkyɛn; na aber no mu no nna oye ma me sen afei.
Na oennhu dɛ emi na memaa no eburow, na nsã, na ngo, na memaa dwetɛ na sika dɔree maa no a wɔhweree maa Baal no.
Dɛm ntsi mebɛsan mabɛgye m’eburow wɔ n’aber mu, na me nsã wɔ ne hyɛber mu, na meyi mo nguannhwi na m’asaaba a nkyɛ ɔbɛkata n’adagyaw do no.
Na afei mebɛda no ndwamandze edzi wɔ no nwewefo enyim, na obiara renngye no mmfi me nsamu.
Eso mebɛma n’enyigye nyina abɔ adze, n’afahyɛ, n'abosoom fofor, na n’ahomgyenda, na n’ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn nyina.
Na mebɛsɛɛ no wenyinndua na n’adɔmbandua a ɔaka wɔ ho dɛ, yinom nye m’apɛdze a mo nwewefo dze ama me: Na mebɛyɛ no kwaa, na hamu mbowa bedzi.

Na medze nda a ɔdze maa Baalim a ɔhyeew afɔr maa no, ber a ɔdze asowamuadze na ndwindze hyehyɛɛ noho, na okedzii no nwewefo ekyir, na emidze, no werɛ fiir me no, bɛba abɔhwe n’etsifi, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, mebɛdzɛfɛdzɛfɛw no, na medze no aba sar no do, na makã no awerɛkyekyesɛm.
Na mifi hɔ medze no wenyin nture mebɛma no, na Achor mbɔnsa no na ɔayɛ enyidado abow, na ɔbɛgye wɔ hɔ, dɛ ne nkataasiaber nda mu, dɛ da a ofi Egypt asaase do bae no mu.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no mu, Ewuradze na ɔse, ɔwo ebɛfrɛ me Ishi; na eremmfrɛ me Baali bio.
Na mibeyi Baalim dzin mefi n'anomu, na wɔremmfa hɔn edzin mmfrɛ hɔn bio.
Na da no mu menye hambowa bedzi ahyɛmu ama hɔn, na wimu ntumbowa, na famu aweaweambowa: Na mubobubu afõwa na egyen akõdzi mu efi asaase no do, na mama wɔatsena hɔ dwudwoodwo.
Na mebɛgye wo ayewar mama moho afebɔɔ; ampaara mebɛgye wo ayewar wɔ tsenenee, na atsɛmbu, na adɔyɛ, na mbɔbɔrhu mu.
Mebɛgye wo ayewar koraa mama moho wɔ nokwardzi mu: Na ɔwo ehu Ewuradze.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no, mebɛgye do, Ewuradze na ɔse, mebɛgye ɔsor do, na hɔn so agye asaase do;
na asaase agye eburow, na nsã, na ngo do: Na hɔn so agye Jezreel do.
Na mubodua no asaase no do mama moho; na mehu nyia wonnhu no mbɔbɔr no mbɔbɔr; na mase hɔn a nkyɛ wɔnnyɛ me man no dɛ, me man nye wo; na hɔn so wɔase me dɛ, me Nyankopɔn.
3: Ewuradze see me dɛ, kɔ bio kɔdɔ ɔbaa a no kun dɔ no naaso ɔyɛ ɔbaa awartofo, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze adɔ Israelmba, naaso na wɔdan kɔ abosom fofor hɔ, na wɔdɔ esikyireamba tatar no.
Dɛm ntsi medze dwetɛbona duenum, na atoko homer kor, na atoko homer fã motɔɔ no:
Na mesee no dɛ, tsena hɔ ma me nda pii; mma nngor ndwamangor, eso mma nnyɛ ɔbarimba bi yer: Dɛm na mo so mebɛyɛ mama wo.
Na Israelmba bɛtsena hɔ nda pii dɛ wonnyi hen, na wonnyi safohen, na wonnyi okum-afɔr, na wonnyi dum, na wonnyi ephod anaa teraphim:
N’ekyir no Israelmba bɛsan, na wɔabɔhwehwɛ Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn n’ekyir kwan, na hɔn hen David; na wɔdze suro aba hɔn Ewuradze na n’ayamuyie nkyɛn wɔ ekyir nda no mu.
4: Israelmba, hom ntsie Ewuradze n’asɛm: Na Ewuradze nye asaase no do atsefo enya asɛm, osiandɛ nokwar, na mbɔbɔrhu, na Nyankopɔn ho nyimdzee nnyi asaase no do.
Hwee nnyi hɔ dɛ ntanka, na mbrato, na ewudzi, na adzewia, na awarto; wɔtoto ara a, nna bɔgya kã bɔgya.
Dɛm ntsi asaase no bedzi awerɛhow, na obiara a ɔtse do no n’enyim bosuam, ɔnye hambowa na wimu ntumbowa; nyew, po mu nam so bɛsã
Naaso mma nyimpa biara nndzi aper, anaa nyimpa biara nntwuw enyim; na wo man tse dɛ hɔn a wɔnye ɔsɔfo no dzi aper.
Na ibefintsiw ewiaber, na nkɔnhyɛnyi no so nye wo befintsiw anago; na mebɛsɛɛ wo nã.
Nyimdzee a onnyi hɔ ntsi, wɔresɛɛ me man: Osiandɛ apow nyimdzee ntsi, mo so mobɔpow wo, dɛ ennda ho nndzi mo sɔfoe: Wo werɛ efir wo Nyankopɔn ne mbra ntsi, mo so mo werɛ befir wo mba.
Wɔmaa wɔdɔree ntsi nna wɔyɛɛ bɔn tsiaa me a: Mebɛdan hɔn enyimnyam enyimguase.
Wodzidzi me man no bɔn ho, na wɔdze hɔn akoma si hɔn emumuyɛ do.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, mbrɛ ɔman tse no, mbrɛ ɔsɔfo so tse ara nye no: Na mɛbɛtsēa hɔn wɔ hɔn abrabɔ ho, na metua hɔn kaw wɔ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ ho.
Na wobedzidzi, na wɔremmee; wɔbɛye ndwaman, na wɔronndɔr: Osiandɛ! Woegyaa dɛ! Wobu Ewuradze bi.
Ndwamanyɛ na nsã na nsã fofor yi ntseasee fi hɔ.
Me man bisa hɔn ndusin hɔ apam, na hɔn poma kã asɛm kyerɛ hɔn. Na hɔn ndwamanyɛ sunsum ama wɔafom, na woefi hɔn Nyankopɔn ase akɛyɛ ndwamandze.
Wɔbɔ afɔr wɔ mbepɔw etsifi, na wɔhyew nduhuam wɔ akoko do, wɔ esudur na nduahen na terebinth ase, osiandɛ no nwin ye: Ntsi na hom mbabaa gor ndwamangor, na hom nyefor totõ awar a.
Sɛ hom mbabaa gor ndwamangor, na hom nyefor totõ awar a, merenntsėa hɔn; na hɔnara so nye ndwaman man nkyɛn, na wɔnye a bosom mfonabaa bɔ afɔr: Na ɔman a wonnyi ntseasee no wobobutuw no.
Kaansa ɔwo, Israel, gor ndwamangor mpo a, mma Judah nndzi sõ. Na mma hom mmba Gilgal, eso mma hom mmfow nnkɔ Beth-aven, anaa mma hom nnkã ntam dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi.
Na Israel ayɛ asoɔdzendze, dɛ nantwiburwa ɔsoɔdzenfo: Afei na Ewuradze bɛnyɛn hɔn dɛ eguambaa wɔ bea tɛtɛr do.
Ephraim dze noho akɔbɔ abosom ho; hom ngyaa no.
Hom nsanom atra do: Wɔgor ndwamangor daa; hɔn etsitsir pɛ enyimguase pa ara.
Mframa edura no ho ahyɛ ne ntsaban mu; na hɔn enyi bɔtõ hɔn okum-afɔr ho.
5: Hom asɔfo e, hom ntsie yi, na hom Israel fi hom nkyɛn aso, na ɔhen ne fifo e, hom nyɛ ayɛ efir wɔ Mizpah, na eboa a wɔatserɛw mu wɔ Tabor etsifi.
Na etuatsewfo no enya ewu ndzii; na emi na meka hɔn nyina hɔn enyim.
Minyim Ephraim, na Israel so nnsuma me; na afei, ao Ephraim, ayɛ ndwamandze, Israel no ho egufi.
Hɔn ndzeyɛɛ remma wɔnnsan mmba hɔn Nyankopɔn nkyɛn: Na ndwamanyɛ sunsum wɔ hɔn mu, na wonnyim Ewuradze.
Na Israel ahopɔw dzi n'enyim dase dɛm ntsi Israel na Ephraim befintsiw wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ mu: Judah so nye hɔn befintsiw.
Wɔdze hɔn nguan na hɔn anantwi bɔkɔ akɔhwehwɛ Ewuradze: Na worunnhu no, ɔatwe noho efi hɔn nkyɛn.
Woetwa Ewuradze nkontompɔ; na wɔawowo anana mba: Afei bosoom fofor bɛmen hɔn nye hɔn kyɛfa.
Hom mbɔ abɛn no mu wɔ Gibeah, na akasamu no mu wɔ Ramah: Hom mbɔ ehuu wɔ Beth-aven; Benjamin e, w’ekyir a.
Ephraim bɛyɛ amamfõ wo nkaenyim da no mu: Dza ɔbɛba ara ampa na mama woehu wo Israel mbusuakuw mu.
Judah asafohen ayɛ dɛ hɔn a wɔtwe ɔhe pin ekyir: Mubohue m’ebufuw egu hɔn do dɛ nsu.
Ephraim tseetsee, wɔadwerew no atsɛmbu mu; osiandɛ no bo dwee dɛ obedzi mbransɛm no do.
Dɛm ntsi na mayɛ dɛ awebowa mama Ephraim, na dɛ nhuhunii mama Judah fi.
Ber a Ephraim hun ne yarba, na Judah hun n’epirakur no, nna Ephraim sii mu kɔr Assyria, na ɔsomae kɔr ɔhen Jareb nkyɛn: Na orunntum nnsa wo yarba, eso ɔremma wo pirakur no nnsa.
Na emidze, mebɛyɛ dɛ gyata mama Ephraim, na dɛ gyatafɔr mama Judah fi emi, emi mara, na mebɛtsetsew mu na makɔ; mebɛfa makɔ, na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔbɛgye nkwa.
Mebɛsan makɔ me beebi, ekodu dɛ wobohu hɔn mfom, na wɔbɔhwehwɛ m'enyim: Hɔn ahohia mu na wɔbɔhwehwɛ me enyiberdo.
6: Hom mbra ma yɛnsan nkɔ Ewuradze nkyɛn: Na ɔatsetsew mu a, ɔbɛsa hɛn yarba; ɔabobɔ hɛn a, ɔbekyekyer hɛn.
Ndaenu ekyir no, ɔbɛma yeenya nkwa bio: Da a otsia ebiasa no, ɔbɛma yɛasoɛr, na yɛatsena ase wɔ n'enyim.
Na hom mma yenhu, hom mma yɛnka do nhu Ewuradze; no mpuei si pi dɛ adzekyee: Na ɔbɛba hɛn nkyɛn dɛ nyankom, dɛ ekyir nyankom a ɔfɔw asaase.
Ao Ephraim, na menyɛ wo dɛn? Ao Judah, na menyɛ wo dɛn? Na hom papayɛ tse dɛ anapa fua, na dɛ ɔbɔsu a ɔpɛ ntsɛm wew.
Dɛm ntsi na medze nkɔnhyɛfo no etwitwa hɔn egu; na medze m'anomunsɛm mekuku hɔn: Na w'atsɛmbu tse dɛ kan a opue.
Na morohwehwɛ ehumbɔbɔr, na nnyɛ okum-afɔr a; na Nyame ho nyimdzee sen ɔhyew-afɔr.
Na hɔndze, wɔtse dɛ Adam a wɔatõ ahyɛmu no: Hɔ na woetwa me nkontompɔ.
Gilead yɛ emumuyɛfo kurow, bɔgya akeka no ho.
Mbrɛ edwotwafo dɔm tsɛw nyimpa no, dɛmara na asɔfokuw no dzi ewu wɔ Shechem afamu kwan no mu: Nyew, wɔayɛ ndwamandze.
Mehu enyinyandze wɔ Israel fi mu: Hɔ na wohu ndwamandze wɔ Ephraim, Israel ho egu fi.
Judah e, hɔ ara so na wɔahyɛ otwaber ama wo, ber a medze me man ndɔmmumkɔ bɛba bio no.
