7: Ber a nkyɛ mepɛ dɛ mesa Israel yarba no, nna Ephraim emumuyɛ na Samaria ndzebɔn ada edzi; na wodzi atofosɛm: Na owifo hɛn mu, na edwotwafo dɔm fa afo wɔ gua do.
Na wɔnndwen hɔn akoma mu dɛ mekaa hɔn ndzebɔn nyina: Afei hɔnankasa hɔn ndzeyɛɛ etwa hɔn ho ehyia; m’enyim na wɔwɔ,
wɔdze hɔn ndzebɔn ma ɔhen n’enyi gye, na wɔdze hɔn atofosɛm ma mbapɔmba no so enyi gye.
Hɔn nyina wɔyɛ awartofo; wɔtse dɛ fononoo a boodootofo ekūa mu gya; ogyaa gya no mu kūa fi mbɔrfetsew do kesii ne kawee do.
Hɛn hen ne da no mu asafohen no maa nsãhyew maa wɔyaree; ɔnye atwetwesifo tseen nsa.
Na woesiesie hɔn akoma dɛ fononoo, ber a wɔda atsɛwee mu no: Hɔn boodootofo da anago nyina; anapa no ɔdzɛw dɛ ogya framee.
Hɔn nyinara adɔ dɛ fononoo. Na wɔmemen hɔn atsɛmbufo, hɔn ahemfo nyinara ahwehwe ase: Obi nnyi hɔn mu a ɔfrɛ me.
Ephraim, ɔdze noho aforafora aman mu; Ephraim yɛ tatar a wɔnndanee:
Anana edzi n'ahoɔdzen, na onnyim: Nyew, gon so apetse ne tsirmu na ɔnodze onnyim.
Na Israel ahopɔw dzi n’enyim dase: Naaso wɔnnsanee mmbaa Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn hɔ, eso wɔnnhwehwɛ no, wɔ iyi nyina ntsi.
Na Ephraim tse dɛ ebubur kotobonyi a onnyi ntseasee: Wɔfrɛ Egypt, wɔkɔ Assyria.
Wɔrokɔ a, mebɛheran mo boa mu akata hɔn do; mubodwir hɔn dɛ wimu ntumbowa: Mebɛtsēa hɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mboanofo no atse no.
Wondue! Osiandɛ woefi me nkyɛn abɔ ko; ɔsɛɛ nto hon! Osiandɛ wɔatõ me mbra: Sɛ nkyɛ mobɔpon hɔn mpo a, woedzidzi mo ho atofosɛm.
Na wonnsūi mmfrɛɛ me hɔn akoma mu, na wɔkeka mu wɔ hɔn mpa do: Eburow na nsã ntsi na wohyia, wɔtsew mo do etūa.
Kaansa makyerɛkyerɛ hɔn abasa na mahyɛ no dzen mpo a, wosusu mo ho mbusu.
Wɔsan dze, na nnyɛ ɔsorsornyi no ne nkyɛn bi a; wɔtse dɛ egyen daadaafo: Hɔn asafohen bɔtotɔ afõwa ano wɔ hɔn tɛkyerɛma nsɛmpii ntsi: Iyi bɛyɛ hɔn atwetwesi wɔ Egypt asaase do.
8: Fa akasamu no tua w’ano. Ɔbɛba Ewuradze fi no do dɛ ɔkɔr: Osiandɛ wɔafomfom m’ahyɛmu, na wɔatõ me mbra.
Wobosū afrɛ me dɛ, me Nyankopɔn, hɛn Israelfo yenyim wo.
Israel atow dza oye akyen ɔtamfo no betsiw no.
Woesisi ahen, na ommfir emi; wɔahyehyɛ asafohen, na minnyim: Wɔdze hɔn dwetɛ na hɔn sika ayeyɛ abosom amema hɔnho, ama woeetwa hɔn akyen.
Ao Samaria, wɔatow wo nantwiburwa no akyen; m’ebufuw asɔ etsia hɔn: Onkodu dabɛn ara ana woetum ɔbra a no ho tsew bɔ?
Na Israel mu na iyi so fi; odwimfo yɛe, na ɔnnyɛ Nyame bi: Nyew, Samaria nantwiburwa no wobobubu no pɔsɔpɔsɔ.
Na wodua mframa, na wobobu ekyinehyia-mframa: Onnyi eburow a ogyinae; bɛtsem no remma isiam; na sɛ ɔma bi mpo a, ananaben bedzi.
Wɔamen Israel: Afei wɔtse amanaman mu dɛ kuraba a enyi bi nnsɔ no.
Na wɔafow kɔ Assyria, dɛ sar do asoaso a no nko atse noho: Ephraim abɔ adɔfo paa,
Nyew, kaansa wɔbobɔ apaa wɔ amanaman mu mpo a, afei na mobɔboa hɔn ano; na wɔahyɛ ase hɔn ho rusuar wɔ ahemfo mu hen no n’adzesoa ntsi.
Osiandɛ Ephraim ama afɔrmbu-kyia adɔɔ sõ dze ayɛ bɔn ntsi, afɔrmbukyia adan no bɔnyɛ.
Kaansa makyerɛw me mbra wɔ ahyɛdze mpemdu mu ama hɔn mpo a, wobu no ananadze.
Na m’ayɛyɛdze okum-afɔr no ho dze, wɔdze nam bɔ okum-afɔr, na wodzi; na Ewuradze enyi nnsɔ: Afei na ɔbɛkaa hɔn emumuyɛ, na ɔabɛsera hɔn bɔn; wɔbɛsan akɔ Egypt.
Na Israel no werɛ efir no bɔfo, na oesisi ahemfi, na Judah ama nkurow a wɔabɔ ho ban no adɔɔ sõ; na mobɔto no nkurow no mu ogya, na ɔamemen n'aban no
9: Israel e, mma nndzi ehurusi wɔ enyigye ntsi, dɛ aman no; na efi wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn akɛyɛ ndwamandze, adɔ apɛdze wɔ ewuporow pia nyina do.
Ewuporow na nsãtwer rennyɛn hɔn, na nsã fofor no bɔbɔ hɔn.
Wɔrenntsena Ewuradze n’asaase do; na Ephraim bɛsan akɔ Egypt, na wobedzi edziban a ho nntsew wɔ Assyria.

Wonnkohue nsã afɔrbɔdze egu ama Ewuradze, eso hɔn ho nnkɛyɛ no enyisɔ: Hɔn kum-afɔr bɛyɛ hɔn dɛ awerɛhofo edziban; hɔn a wodzi bi nyina hɔn ho bogu fi: Na hɔn edziban no wɔdze bɛsa hɔn kɔm; ɔremmba Ewuradze fie.
Ebɛnadze na hom bɛyɛ no wɔ ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn da no, na Ewuradze afahyɛ da no mu?
Na, hwɛ, woefi ɔsɛɛ nkyɛn kɔ, naaso Egypt bɛtase hɔn, Memphis besie hɔn: Hɔn dwetɛ edwindze fɛɛfɛw no nsason bɛfa: Nsoɛ bɛba hɔn asesee mu.
Ɔsera nda no edu, ahyɛnanmu nda no edu; Israel bohu: Nkɔnhyɛnyi no yɛ ɔkwasea, nyimpa a ɔwɔ sunsum no egyim, wɔ emumuyɛ dodow ntsi, na manso pii no ntsi.
Ephraim yɛɛ ɔweɔmfo wɔ me Nyankopɔn nkyɛn: Nkɔnhyɛnyi no dze, anomasuafo efir wɔ n’akwan nyina mu, na manso wɔ ne Nyankopɔn fie.
Woegu hɔnho fi pɔtɔɔ, dɛ Gibeah nda no mu: Ɔbɛkaa hɔn emumuyɛ, ɔbɛsera hɔn bɔn.

Muhun Israel dɛ sar do wenyinaba: Muhun hom egyanom dɛ adɔmbadua abakan wɔ ne beree ber a odzi kan no mu: Na hɔndze, wɔkɔr Baal-peor nkyɛn, na wohyiraa hɔnho do maa enyitodze, na wɔdandaan ekyiwadze dɛ dza wɔdɔɔ no no.
Ephraim dze, hɔn enyimnyam botu akɔ dɛ anoma; abawoo, na abatur, na nyinsen nnkɛba hɔ.
Na sɛ wɔhwɛ hɔn mba ma wonyin mpo a, mebɛma woedzi awo-mba-ewu, ma nyimpa biara aannka; nyew, sɛ motwe moho fi hɔn nkyɛn so a, wondue!
Ephraim, dɛ mbrɛ mehu Tyre, wɔatsɛw no asaase fɛɛfɛw do: Naaso Ephraim dze ne mba befir akɛma okumfo no.
Ewuradze e, fa ma hɔn ɛ: Ebɛnadze na edze bɛma? Ma hɔn awotoa a ɔpon ɔba, na numfo a atwentwem
Hɔn emumuye nyina wɔ Gilgal na hɔ na mikyiir hɔn: Osian hɔn ndzeyɛɛ n’emumuyɛ ntsi, mibeyi hɔn edzi efi me fie: Moronndɔ hɔn bio, hɔn asafohen nyina etuatsewfo a
Wɔabo Ephraim adze, hɔn ndwow akyenkyen, wɔronnsow aba: Ɛhɛɛ, se wosow mpo a, mebɛsɛɛ hɛn yafim mu aba a wodo no no.
Me Nyankopon botow hɔn egu, osiandɛ woannyɛ aso amma no: Na wobɛyɛ awonawonafo wɔ amanaman mu.
10: Isreal yɛ wenyindua prɔmprɔm a oyiyi n’aba: Mbrɛ n’aba dodow tse no, mbrɛ ɔama n’afɔrmbukyia adɔɔ sõ nye no: Mbrɛ n’asaase ne yie tse no, mbrɛ ɔayɛ abosondum fɛɛfɛw nye no.
Hɔn akoma mu apaa; afei na wobohu dɛ wodzi fɔ: Obodwuruw hɔn afɔrmbukyia no, ɔbɛsɛɛ hɔn abosondum no.
Ampaara afei na wɔbɛse dɛ, yennyi ɔhen: Na yennsuro Ewuradze; na ɔhen no dze, obotum ayɛ bɛn ama hɛn?
Wɔkã nsɛnhun, wɔkã ntanhun dzidzi ahyɛmu: Dɛm ntsi na atsɛmbu fifir dɛ bɔr wɔ kwã mu akɔfi mu.
Beth-aven anantwimba ho hu bɛkã Samaria atsefo: Na ne mamfo, na asɔfo a wodzi ho ehurusi no, bedzi nkɔmbɔ wɔ n’enyimnyam ho, osiandɛ oetu kɔ.
No so wɔdze bɔkɔ Assyria akɛkyɛ ɔhen Jareb: Enyito bɛka Ephraim, na Israel enyi atõ wɔ n’apam ho.
Na Samaria dze, woetwa ne hen akyen dɛ nsuenyi ehur.
Aven nsorɔnsorɔmbea so a ɔyɛ Israel hɔn bɔn no, wɔbɛsɛɛ no: Nsoɛ na nkɔkrɔw befifir hɔn afɔrmbukyia do; na wɔbɛse mbepɔw dɛ, hom nkata hɛn do; na akoko dɛ, hom nhwe hɛn do.
Ao Israel, ifitsi Gibeah nda do na ayɛ bɔn: Hɔ na wogyinae; amma ɔsa a wotuu no wɔ emumuyɛfo mba do no aannto hɔn wɔ Gibeah.
Ber a mepɛ no, mebɛtsēa hɔn; na wobehyiahyia aman aba hɔn do, ber a wɔdze hɔn ase hɔn emumuyɛ ebien no.
Na Ephraim yɛ nantwifɔr a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ no a ɔpɛ ewuporow; na emidze, matra aba no kɔn fɛɛfɛw no do: Medze ɔpɔnkɔdofo bɛba Ephraim do; Judah bofuntum, Jacob bɔbobo n’afapo.
Hom ndua aba mma homho wɔ tsenenee mu, hom mbu no mbɔbɔrhu mu; hom ndɔw hom epe: Na edu ber a wɔdze hwehwɛ Ewuradze kwan, ekesi dɛ ɔbɛba abɔtɔ ndzeyɛ tsenenee nsu egu hom do.
Hom efuntum ndzebɔn, hom ebu emumuyɛ; hom edzi ator aba: Na ɔwo edze woho tweer wo kwan no do, wo mbarimba akatakyi no hɔn dodow.
Dɛm ntsi weɔɔweɔɔyɛ bɔsoɛr, wɔ wo man no mu, na wɔbɛsɛɛ w'abankɛse no nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ Shalman sɛɛ Betharbel wɔ nkõda no mu: Wɔtsetseew nã nye ne mba mu esinesin.
Dɛmara so na Beth-el dze bɛyɛ hom wɔ hom emumuyɛ pii no ntsi: Adze rebɛkye no, wobotwa Isralehen akyen koraa.
11: Ber a Israel yɛ abofra no, nna modɔɔ no na mefrɛɛ me ba fiir Egypt.
Mbrɛ wɔfrɛɛ hɔn no, mbrɛ wofii hɔn nkyɛn kɔree nye no: Wɔbɔɔ okum-afɔr maa Baalim, na wɔhyeew eduhuam maa egu-honyi.
Naaso emi na megyee Ephraim taataa: Mutuur hɔn me basa do; na woennhu dɛ emi na mesaa hɔn yarba.
Onyimpa ahoma na medze twee hɔn, ɔdɔ ntampehoma a: Na meyɛɛ dɛ hɔn a woyi kɔndua fi adadaw do maa hɔn, na medze edziban sisii hɔn enyim.
Ɔrennsan nnkɔ Egypt asaase do bio; na Assyrianyi no bɛyɛ ne hen, osiandɛ wɔpoow dɛ wɔbɛsan.
Na afõwa bɛba no nkurow do, na ɔasɛɛ ne ndaban, na ɔamen hɔn, osian hɔnankasa hɔn apam ntsi.
Ekyir ara na me man wɔpɛ dɛ wosan fi me nkyɛn: Sɛ wɔfrɛ hɔn ɔsorsornyi no nkyɛn mpo a, obiara mma noho do koraa.
Ephraim, mebɛyɛ dɛn meyi wo mama? Israel, mebɛyɛ dɛn meyi wo mama? Mebɛyɛ dɛn mayɛ wo dɛ Admah? Mebɛyɛ dɛn medze wo mesi dɛ Zeboim? M’akoma adan wɔ mo mu, m’ayamuhyehye abɔ mu redzɛw.
Minnkedzi m ebufuw ne hyeehyew no ekyir, merennsan mmbɛsɛɛ Ephraim: Na meyɛ Onyame, na nnyɛ nyimpa; Krɔnkrɔnnyi a ɔwɔ wo finimfin: Na merennhɛn kurow no mu.
Wobedzi Ewuradze ekyir, ɔno a ɔbɔpɔw dɛ gyata; na ɔnodze ɔbɔpɔw, na mbofra no dze ahopopo fi anee aba.
Wɔdze ahopopo fi Egypt bɛba dɛ anoma, na woefi Assyria asaase do aba dɛ ebubur: Na medze hɔn matsena hɔn efi mu, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Ephraim dze atofosɛm, na Israel fi dze ndaadaa etwa mo ho ehyia: Naaso mbom Judah da ho dze Nyame dzi hen, na odzi nokwar ma Krɔnkrɔnnyi no.
12: Ephraim dzi aahow, na odzi boka aahow ekyir: Dabaa ɔma atofosɛm ɔnye amamfoyɛ dɔɔ sõ; na wɔnye Assyria dzi ahyɛmu, na wɔsoa ngo kɔ Egypt.
Na Ewuradze nye Judah enya asɛm, na ɔbɛtsēa Jacob dɛ mbrɛ n’akwan tse; mbrɛ ne ndzeyɛɛ tse ara na ɔbɛhyɛ no ananmu.
Yafun mu na osuoo no nua anantsir: Na n’ahoɔdzen mu, na ɔnye Nyankopɔn tetaree:
Nyew, onyaa ɔbɔfo no do ahoɔdzen; na odzii nyim: Osūi, na ɔkotowee serɛɛ no: Ohun no wɔ Beth-el, na hɔ na ɔnye hɛn kasae;
mekyerɛ Ewuradze, dɔm Nyankopɔn no a; ne nkaa dzin dze Ewuradze.
Dɛm ntsi san bra wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn: Suo mbɔbɔrhu na atsɛmbu mu, na tweɔn wo Nyankopɔn daa.
Ɔyɛ ɔbatanyi, nsisi nsɛn kitsa ne nsamu: Ɔpɛ emimdzi.
Na Ephraim see dɛ, Ampaara menya moho, menya adze: M’edwuma nyina mu worunnhu mo mu emumuyɛ biara a ɔyɛ bɔn.
Naaso emi nye Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze fitsi Egypt asaase do; mebɛma ada ho atsena asese mu bio, dɛ afahyɛ krɔnkrɔn nda no mu.
Makasa akyerɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no so, na mama enyido-adzehu adɔɔ sõ; na menam nkɔnhyɛfo som do mebubu mbɛ.
Ana Gilead yɛ emumuyɛdze a? Wɔadan egyangyandze koraa; Gilgal mu na wɔdze anantwi bɔ okum-afɔr: Ɛhɛɛ, hɔn afɔrmbukyia tse dɛ kwã mu akɔfi mu esiwesiw.
Na Jacob guanee kɔr Aram haban mu, na Israel somee wɔ ɔyer ntsi, na ɔyer ntsi ɔhwɛɛ nguan.
Na Ewuradze nam nkɔnhyɛnyi do dze Israel fii Egypt bae, na ɔnam nkɔnhyɛnyi do ɔkoraa no do.
Ephraim eyi ebufuw yerɛyerɛyerɛw: Dɛm ntsi wɔbɛma no bɔgyaa ebua n’etsifi, na n’Ewuradze adan n’ahorohoraa egu no do.
13: Ephraim kasae no, ɔyɛɛ ahohim; ɔmemaa noho do wɔ Israel: Na odzii sõ wɔ Baal mu no, owui.

Na afei wɔyɛ bɔn mbordo ara, na wɔdze hɔn dwetɛ ayeyɛ egu-honyi amema hɔnho, ayeyɛ abosom dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ntseasee tse, ne nyinara odwimfo edwuma a: Wɔkã no wɔ hɔn ho dɛ, nyimpa a wɔbɔ okum-afɔr no mfew anantwi- mburwa no ano.
Dɛm ntsi wɔbɛyɛ dɛ anapa nsuwusiw, na dɛ ɔbɔsu a ɔsen ahema kɔ, dɛ ntsɛw a ekyinehyia-mframa tu no fi ewuporowee do, na dɛ wusiw tokura mu.
Naaso emi nye Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn fitsi Egypt asaase do; na mma nnhu ɔbosom fofor bi nnka mo ho, eso ɔgyefo bi nnyi hɔ ka mo ho.
Sar no do, nsukɔm asaase no do, nna muhun wo ampa.
Mbrɛ hɔn edzidzibea tse no, dɛmara so na wɔmee; wɔmee, na hɔn akoma maa noho do. Dɛm ntsi na hɔn werɛ efir me a.
Dɛm ntsi na mayɛ dɛ gyata mama hɔn, mebɛtsɛw kwan nkyɛn dɛ sebɔ:
Mobɔtotɔr hɔn dɛ sisi a wɔagye ne mba, na matsetsew hɔn akoma toa mu na hɔ na mobɔwe hɔn dɛ gyata; abowa bɔyafo bosunsuan hɔn mu.
Ao Israel, ɔyɛ wo sɛɛe dɛ enye emi, wo boafo, ridzi esi.
Na afei wo hen no wɔ hen, ma ɔaagye wo wɔ wo nkurow nyina mu? Na w’atsɛmbuafo a ekã wɔ hɔn ho dɛ, ma me ɔhen na asafohen no?
Mama wo ɔhen wɔ m’ebufuw mu, na meyi no kɔ wo m'abohur mu.
Wɔakyekyer Ephraim emumuyɛ; wɔdze no bɔn esie fiadze.
Ɔbaa awokõfo n’awerɛhow bɛka no: Ɔyɛ ɔba a onnyim nyansa; na mber asõ dɛ onnkyinkyim beebi mbrɛ mba dua mu pue kɔ.
Mebɛsa hɔn tsir efi adakamaa no tum nsa; mobɔpon hɔn efi owu nsa: Owu e, w’ayardɔm wɔ hɛn no? Ɔdakamaa e, wo sɛɛe wɔ hen o? Nnuhu bosuma efi m’enyi do.
Kaansa ɔbɔsow aba wɔ no nuanom mu mpo a, boka aahow bɔbɔ, Ewuradze n'aahow fi sar do botu, na ne mbasu awew, na no nsunyiwa kɔ atwee; ɔno na ɔbɛfa akoradzedan mu nkuraba fɛɛfɛw no asadze.
Samaria ne tsir bɔtõ; osiandɛ ɔatsew ne Nyankopɔn do etūa: Wɔbɔtotɔ afõwa anomu: Wɔbɛtsetsew hɔn nkɔkowaba mu esinesin, na wɔapaapaa hɔn enyinsemfo mu.
14: Ao Israel, san bra Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn; na woara w’emumuyɛ dze wo ahwe ase.
Hom mfa nsɛm nsan mbra Ewuradze hɔ: Hom nse no dɛ, yi emumuyɛ nyina kɔ, na gye dza oye: Nna yɛdze hɛn anofamfa bɛyɛ anantwi abɔ wo afɔr.
Asshur renngye hɛn nkwa; yɛrenntsena mpɔnkɔ do nnantsew: Eso yɛrennse hɛn nsaano edwuma bio dɛ, hom nye hɛn abosom: Na ɔwo wo mu na egyanka nya ehumbɔbɔr.
Mebɛsa hɔn ekyirsan no yarba, mebɛpra me yamu madɔ hɔn: Osiandɛ m'ebufuw adan efi no do.
Mebɛyɛ dɛ obosu mama Israel; ɔbɔbɔ nhyiren dɛ esukookoo, na ɔatsentsen no ndwow dɛ Lebanon.
N'abaw bɛtserɛw, na ne fɛw ayɛ dɛ ngodua, na oeyi huam dɛ Lebanon.
Hɔn a wɔtse no nwin ase bɛsan aba; wobenya nkwa bio dɛ eburow, na wɔabɔ nhyiren dɛ wenyindua: Ne nka bɛyɛ dɛ Lebanon nsã.
Ephraim bɛse dɛ, ebɛnadze na menye abosom wɔ yɛ bio? Magye do, na m'enyi bɛkã no ho: Metse dɛ kupresi frɔmfrɔm; emi mo do na wobohu wo nsowee.
Woana nye onyansafo a ɔbɛtse ndzɛmba yinom ase? Ɔbadwembanyi a obohu? Na Ewuradze n'akwan tsen, na atseneneefo bɛnantsew do; na mbratofo dze wɔbɔhwehwe ase wɔ do.

1: Amoz ne ba Isaiah n’enyido- adzehu a ohunii wɔ Judah na Jerusalem ho wɔ Judah ahemfo Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, na Hezekiah nda mu.
Ɔsorsor, hom ntsie, asaase, yɛ aso, na Ewuradze akasa: Manyɛn mba na matsetse hɔn, na hɔndze wɔatsew mo do etūa.
Ɔnantwi nyim no wura, na asoaso nyim no wura n’edzidzidaka: Na Israel dze wonnyim, na me man wɔnndwen.
Ao, ɔman ndzebɔnyɛfo, nkorɔfo a wɔdze emumuyɛ asoa hɔn, emumuyɛfo asefo, mba a hɔn bra aprɔw: Wɔapow Ewuradze, woebu Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no enyimtsia, wɔapaa hɔnho na wɔasan ekyir.
Wɔnda ho mbɔ hom nyɛ dɛn, dɛ hom da ho ara retsew etūa yi? Tsir mu nyinara yar, na akoma mu nyinara apa.
Ofitsi ananadze kesi etsifi mpo apɔwmudzen biara nnyi mu: Na mbom epirakur, na nsoasoae na ekur mpɔtɔwee: Wɔnnsaae, eso wɔnnkyekyeree, eso wɔmmfaa ngo nndwedwee no.
Hom kurow ayɛ amamfõ; wɔdze gya ahyew hom nkurow; hom asaase ananaben asɛɛ no wɔ hom enyim, na ɔayɛ amamfõ, dɛ ananaben ebutuw no.
Na Zion babaa aka dɛ asese a ɔwɔ wenyin ture mu, dɛ efer ture mu asoɛe, dɛ kurow a woetua.
Sɛ dɔm Ewuradze enngyaa hɛn nkaa kakraabi a, nkyɛ yɛayɛ dɛ Sodom, nkyɛ yɛayɛ dɛ Gomorrah.
Sodom mpanyimfo, hom ntsie Ewuradze asɛm; Gomorrah ɔman hom nyɛ aso mma hɛn Nyankopɔn mbra.
Hom afɔrbɔdze dodow yɛ me ebɛn? Ewuradze na ɔse: Ndwanyin ɔhyew-afɔr, na anyɛmbowa seradze afon me na minnyi enyigye wɔ nantwi anaa nguambaa, anaa mpɔnkye bɔgyaa mu.
Sɛ hom ba befir m'enyim a, woana ahwehwɛ iyi wɔ hom nsamu, dɛ wobetsiatsia m'abanguado?
Mma hom mmfa ayɛyɛdze hun bi so nnda ho mmba; eduhuam hyewee yɛ me ekyiwadze; bosoom fofor na ahomgyeda, baguabɔ meremmpen emumuyɛ na ehyiadzi nwinwin no do.
Hom abosoom fofor na hom afahyɛ no me kra kyir: Ɔyɛ me ɔhaw; maberɛ no soa.
Na sɛ hom tserɛw hom nsamu a, mibeyi m’enyiwa ehuntsa hom: Nyew, sɛ hom yi mpaa mpo a, mirinntsie: Bɔgya ayeyɛ hom nsa amaama.
Hom nhohor homho, hom ntsew hom ho nyi hom emumuyɛdze no mfi m’enyiwa do; hom ngyaa bɔn yɛ:
Hom nsūa papa yɛ; hom nhwehwɛ atsɛmbu, hom ngye nyia wɔhaw no no, hom ndzi mma egyanka, hom nkasa ngye okunafo.
Afei hom mbra ma yɛnkekã ɛ, Ewuradze na ɔse: Kaansa hom bɔn tse dɛ adaaben mpo a, ɔbɔhoa dɛ esukwankyɛba; kaansa ɔber dɛ bɔgyaben mpo a, ɔbeyɛ dɛ guannhwi.
Sɛ hom pen do na hom yɛ setsie a, hom bedzi asaase no do ndzepa:
Na sɛ hom pow na hom tsew etūa a, wɔdze afõwa bɛsɛɛ hom: Na Ewuradze n’ano na ɔakã.
Ɔyɛ dɛn na kurow nokwafo adan edwaman yi! Ɔno a nkyɛ atsɛntsen ahyɛ no mã! Ndzeyɛtsenenee tsenaa no mu, naafei dze ewudzifo a.
Wo dwetɛ adan ifi, wo nsã wɔdze nsu afora mu.
W’asafohen yɛ etuatsewfo, na nwuradan ndamfo; hɔn mu biara pɛ mboaba, na odzi akatua ekyir: Wonndzi mma egyanka, eso okunafo asɛm nndu hɔn enyim.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Tumfo no, se nye yi: Aa, mebɛma mo ho adwe me wɔ m’ahohiahiafo ho, na medzi mo wer wɔ m’atamfo do:
Na madan me nsa maba wo do, na medze semina metu wo fi, na meyi wo mforaforaa nyinaa:
Na mebɛdan w'atsɛmbufo mama wo dɛ asɔpɔn no, w'apamfo dɛ ahyɛse no: N'ekyir no wɔbɛfrɛ wo ɔtsenenee kurow, kurow nokwafo.
Wɔdze atsɛmbu bɔpon Zion, na wɔdze tsenenee apon ne mba a wɔasakyer.
Na mbratofo na ndzebɔnyɛfo hɔn sɛɛe bɔbɔ mu aba prɛko, na hɔn a wɔdan Ewuradze gya no wɔbɛ hyew hɔn.
Na hɔn enyi bowu wɔ nsudur a hom hwehwɛɛ no ho, na hom enyim egu ase wɔ nture a hom asan mu afa no ho.
Na hom bɛyɛ dɛ osudur a n'ahaban apo, ba ture a nsu nnyi mu.
Na ɔhoɔdzenfo bɛyɛ dɛ otuw, na n'edwuma ayɛ dɛ ogyansenama, na ebien nyina abɔ mu ahyew, na obi runndum.
2: Asɛm a Amoz ba Isaiah hunii wɔ Judah na Jerusalem ho.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ nda a odzi ekyir no mu no, na wɔdze Ewuradze fi bepɔw no bɔbɔ mbepɔw no do, na wɔbɛma no do abɔ akoko nyina do, naamanaman bɛpem aba ho.

Na am an pii bɛkɛse dɛ, hom mbra ma yɛnkɔ Ewuradze bepɔw no do, yɛnkɔ Ewuradze Jacob Nyankopɔn fie; na ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ hɛn n’akwan, na yɛanantsew n’atsempɔn mu: Na Zion na mbra befir aba, na Ewuradze asɛm efi Jerusalem.
Na obobu amanaman mu atsɛn, na wɔakã aman pii enyim: Na wɔdze hɔn mfõwa abobɔ nsɔw, na wɔdze hɔn mpeaa abobɔ nsɔsɔw: Ɔman bi remma afõwa do nntsia ɔman bi, eso worunnsūa akodzi bio.
Ao Jacob fifo, hom mbra ma yɛnnantsew Ewuradze kan no mu.
Na ɔwo adan wo man, Jacob fi, egya, osiandɛ atɔrmuadze a ofi bokã ahyɛ hɔn mã, na wɔayɛ ɔsebramufo dɛ Philistiafo, na wɔnye ananamba kyiakyia.
Hɔn asaase so ayɛ dwetɛ na sika mã; hɔn akoradze so onnyi ewiei; hɔn asaase so ayɛ mpɔnkɔ mã, na hɔn ntseaseanam nnyi ewiei.
Hɔn asaase so ayɛ abosom mã; wɔsɔr hɔnankasa hɔn nsaano edwuma, dza hɔnankasa hɔn nsatseaba ayɛ.
Na ɔdasanyi bɔ no mu adze, nyimpa brɛ noho adze: Dɛm ntsi mma mmfa mmfir hɔn.
Kɛhɛn ɔbotan mu, na huntsa woho wɔ huntuma mu, fi Ewuradze ho hu no enyim, nye no tumdzi enyimnyam no enyim.
Nyimpa enyiwa a ɔtra no ntɔn no bɛbrɛ adze, na nyimpa n’ahopɔw bɛba famu, na Ewuradze nko ara na wobohuhor no da no mu.
Na dɔm Ewuradze ne da bi wɔ hɔ a ɔbɛba nkontompɔfo na ahopɔwfo nyina do, na ahomemadonyi biara do; na wɔabrɛ no adze:
Na ɔbɛba Lebanon cedar a ɔwowar sonkosonko, na Bashan nsudur nyinara do;
na mbepɔw sorɔnsorɔm nyinara, na akoko a amema do nyinara do;
na abantsentsen biara, na ɔfasu a wɔaban ho biara do;
na Tarshish ahɛn nyinara, na ahwɛdze a ɔyɛ fɛw nyinara do.
Na wɔbɛbrɛ nyimpa n’ekromponsɛm adze, na adasa ahopɔwsɛm bɛba famu: Na Ewuradze nko ara na wobohuhor no da no mu.
Na abosom botwa mu akɔ koraa.
Na nkorɔfo bɛhɛn abotan ntokur mu, na famu etu mu, efi Ewuradze no ho hu, na no tumdzi enyimnyam enyim, ber a ɔbɔsoɛr abɔwosow asaase berdzedzeedze no.
Da no mu na nyimpa bɔtow no dwetɛ abosom, na ne sika abosom a wɔyɛe maa no dɛ ɔnsɔr no no akyen, ama nkusi na mpan;
ama wɔaakɛhɛn abotan ntokur na abo mpaapaae mu, efi Ewuradze ho hu ho, na no tumdzi enyimnyam enyim, ber a ɔbɔsoɛr abɔwosow asaase berdzedzeedze no.
Hom ngyaa nyimpa a n’ahom wɔ n’ahwentokura mu no ekyir dzi: Na ebɛnadze mu ara na wobu no bi?
3: Na, hwɛ Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze otutu petua ɔnye dua fi Jerusalem na Judah, edziban petua nyina, na nsu petua nyina:
Ɔkatakyi, na ɔsabarimba; ɔtsɛmbufo, na ɔkɔnhyɛnyi, ɔdzeyifo, na ɔtsetsenyi:
Eduonum do safohen, na onyimdzefo, na ɔpamfo, na edwindzi mu onyifirfo, na ɔdzeafo a adzea abra no.
Na mebɛma mbofraba ayɛ hɔn asafohemfo, na mbɔtoaba edzi hɔn do mpanyin.
Na nkorɔfo behaw hɔnho, oyi na oyi, na obi na ne nyɛnko: Akɔkowaba bɛhyehyɛ noho wɔ akɔdaa do, na atsetsekwaa so wɔ onyimnyamfo do.
Sɛ obi suo no nua a ɔwɔ n’egya fie mu, dɛ, ɔwo ewɔ atar, bedzi hɛn do panyin, na ma odwuruw yi mbra w’abaw do a:
Da no mu na ɔbɛma ne ndze do, dɛ, merennyɛ ɔyarsafo; na edziban anaa atar bi nnyi me fie: Mma hom nnyɛ me ɔman panyin.
Na Jerusalem edwuruw, na Judah ahwe ase: Osiandɛ hɔn gyirama na hɔn nyɛe tsia Ewuradze, dɛ wɔdze riyi n’enyimnyam ehi.
Hɔn enyimsu dzi dase tsia hɔn; na wɔkã hɔn bɔn dɛ Sodomfo, wɔmmfa nnsuma. Hɔn kra ndue! na wɔdze bɔn etua hɔnho kaw.
Hom nkã wo ɔtseneneenyi ho dɛ obesi no yie: Na wobedzi hɔn ndɔdze.
Omumuyɛnyi ndue! Obowie no mbusu: Na ne nsaano akatua na wɔdze bɛma no.
Me man dze, mbofraba nye hɔn ahyɛdofo, na mbaa dzi hɔn do mpanyin. Ao me man, hɔn a wogya wo kwan dze wo fom, na wɔsɛɛ w’atsempɔn kwan.
Ewuradze egyina ridzi asɛm, oegyina rubu aman atsɛn.
Ewuradze nye me man mu mpanyimfo na no mu asafohemfo bɔkɔ asɛndzii: Homara na hom edzi wenyin ture no; abɔbɔfo asadze wɔ hom efiefi mu:
Ase nye dɛn na hom dwerew me man, na hom hyɛ abɔbɔfo amen yi? Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Ewuradze see bio dɛ, osiandɛ Zion mbabaa yɛ ahopɔw, na wɔtoto hɔn kɔn na wɔdeda hɔn enyi ekyir nantsew; na wɔnam dedadeda ma hɔn nansa nkaba nka gyegye:
Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze bɛma satwem egu Zion mbabaa etsifi pampamu, na Ewuradze bɛda hɔn adagyaw edzi.
Da no na Ewuradze beyi hɔn anantuadze fɛɛfɛw no, na itsiratena na abosoom-fã;
asowamuadze na nsakɔnadze, nkataenyim;
abɔtsir, na anandwe ntweaban, na abɔdo, na nduhuam mpakyiwa, na nsɛbɛ;
mpɛtsea, na hwenmuadze;
afahyɛ ntar, na egugudo, na nkatakɔnmu, na mbɔtɔwa;
nhwehwɛmba, na ndwera pa, akyekyetsir na nkataenyim.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ bɔnee bedzi ohuam ananmu; na ntampehoma edzi abɔdo ananamu; na etsipaa edzi takuwa a wocsi no yie ananmu; na eyitam abɔdo edzi abɔyamu ananmu: Ɔhyewtua edzi ahoɔfɛw ananmu.
Wo mbarimba bɔtotɔ afõwa ano, na w’akatakyi atotɔ ɔsa mu.
Na n’aponkɛse botwa ewuo na oegyam; na ɔbɛda hɔ pan na ɔatsena famu.
4: Na mbaa beesuon bosuo ɔbarimba baako mu wɔ da no mu, dɛ, yebedzi hɛnara hɛn edziban, yeefura hɛnara hɛn atam: Yi hɛn enyimguase wɔ hɛn do.
Da no mu na Ewuradze dubaa no bɛyɛ fɛɛfɛw na enyimnyam, na asaase no do aba bɛyɛ abɔso na enyisɔ ama Israel mu hɔn a woefi nsa no.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ nyia wɔgye no wɔ Zion, na nyia ɔka wɔ Jerusalem no, wɔbɛfrɛ hɔn krɔnkrɔn, mekyerɛ obiara a wɔakyerɛw ne dzin afora atseasefo mu wɔ Jerusalem:
Ber a Ewuradze enya ahohor Zion mbabaa ho fi, na ɔdze atsɛmbu sunsum na ɔhyew sunsum ebeyi Jerusalem bɔgya efi kurow no mu no.
Na Ewuradze bɛyɛ nsuwusiw na wusiw adzekyee, na ogyaframee hyerɛn anago dze akata Zion bepɔw do tsenabea nyina, na n'ehyiadzi nyina do: Na enyimnyam no nyina benya nkatado.
Na ɔbɛ yɛ ntamadan a ɔma nwim ewiaber fi ɔhyew mu, na ɔayɛ guandɔbea na huntsabea wɔ ehum na nsutɔ mu.
5: Ma montow mo dɔfo pa ndwom a ɔfa no wenyin ture ho. Mo dɔfo pa nyaa wenyin ture bi wɔ asaaseber koko bi do:
Na otwaa ho nsukã, na ɔtasee mu abo, na ɔtsetsɛɛw mu wenyindua pa, na ɔtoow abantsentsen wɔ mu, na otuu nsãtwer so wɔ mu: Na n’enyi daa kwan dɛ ɔbɔsow wenyinaba, na ɔsoow kwaa mu wenyinaba.
Na afei, ao Jerusalem atsefo, nye Judah mbarimba, meserɛ hom, hom mbu emi na mo wenyin ture ntamu atsɛn.
Ebɛnadze na aka dɛ nkyɛ meyɛ mema mo wenyin ture bio a mennyɛe? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na m’enyi daa kwan dɛ ɔbɔsow wenyinaba a, ɔsoow kwaa mu wenyinaba yi?
Na afei, hom mbra; mebɛkã dza medze mebɛyɛ mo wenyin ture makyerɛ hom: Mibeyi no ho ban, ma mbowa eedzi; mubobubu no ho ɔfasu ma woeetsiatsia do:
Na mobɔto no pan; wonnkotwitwa ho, eso wɔnnkɔdɔw ho; na obofuw nkɔkrɔw na nsoɛ: Na mebɛhyɛ nsuwusiw so dɛ ɔnntɔ nyankom nngu do.
Na dɔm Ewuradze no wenyin ture nye Israel fi, na Judah mbarimba nye no kwã a n’enyi gye ho: Na ɔhwɛɛ atsɛmbu kwan, na hwɛ, emimdzi nye yi; ndzeyɛtsenenee kwan, na hwɛ, nkekamu a.
Wondue, hɔn a wɔdze ofi toa ofi do, wɔdze kwã kã kwa kwã ho, kodu dɛ ɔkwan bi nnyi hɔ, na hom ankotsee tsena asaase do!
M'asomu dze, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, ampaara, adan pii bɛyɛ afõ, dza ɔsõsoe na ɔyɛ fɛw, dɛ obi nntsena mu.
Na wenyin ture acre du bɛma bath kor pɛr, na aba homer kor bɛma ephah kor pɛr.
Wondue, hɔn a wɔsoɛr anapahema kedzi nsãdzen ekyir; na wɔ kyɛr anago bersae, ma nsã fram hɔn!
Na nsankutsen na bɛnta, na mpintsin, na atɛntɛbɛn, na wenyin nsã, wɔ hɔn aponto ase; na wɔmmfɔ Ewuradze ne nyɛe nnyɛ dze, ne nsaano edwuma so wɔnndwendwen ho.
Dɛm ntsi na me man etu kɔ ndɔmmum, wɔ nyimdzee a wonnyi ntsi: Na ɔkɔm dze hɔn enyimnyamfo, na nsukɔm rehyew hɔn nyimpadodow.
Dɛm ntsi na Sheol atrɛ n’akɔndɔ mu, na ɔahan n’anomu petoo: Na hɔn enyimnyam, na hɔn nyimpadodow, na hɔn apɔmpɔmpɛ, na nyia n’enyi gye mu, worisian kɔ mu yi.
Na onyimfo aba famu, na nyimpa kɛse abrɛ noho adze, na enyimnyamfo enyi akã famu:
Na dɔm Ewuradze dze, wohuhor no wɔ atsɛmbu mu, na Nyame, krɔnkrɔnnyi no dze, wɔtsew no ho wɔ ndzeyɛtsenenee mu.
Ɔno na nguambaa bedzidzi dɛ hɔn edzidzibea do, na akobɔfo bedzi hɔn a wɔatɔ angoa no hɔn asaasefõ no.
Wondue, hɔn a wɔdze egyangyandze homa twe emumuyɛ, na wɔdze hwiir ntampee twe bɔn:
Hɔn a wɔkã dɛ, wɔmma ɔnyɛ no har, ɔnyɛ n’edwuma ntsɛm ma yɛnhwɛ, na ma Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no n’apam mbɛn na ɔmbra ma yenhu!
Wondue, hɔn a wɔfrɛ bɔn dɛ papa, na papa dɛ bɔn; hɔn a wɔdze sum yɛ kan, na wɔdze kan yɛ sum; hɔn a wɔdze wenwen yɛ fenemfenem, na fenemfenem yɛ wenwen!
Wondue, hɔn a wɔyɛ hɔnankasa hɔn enyi do enyansafo, na wɔyɛ hɔnankasa hɔn enyi do abadwembafo!
Wondue, hɔn a wɔyɛ akatakyi wɔ nsãnom mu, na ahoɔdzenfo wɔ nsãdzen no fora mu:
Hɔn a wobu omumuyɛnyi bem gye mboaba, na wɔgye ɔtseneneenyi ne nsamu tsenenee!

Dɛm ntsi dɛ mbrɛ ogya tɛkyerɛma dzi mburonan, na gyaframee hyew nkyɛkyɛr guanee no, dɛmara so na hɔn ndwow bɔprɔw, na hɔn nhyiren botu afa sor dɛ huntuma: Osiandɛ wɔapow dɔm Ewuradze ne mbra, na woebu Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi n'asɛm enyimtsia.

Dɛm ntsi na Ewuradze n'ebufuw redzɛw ne man do, na ɔatsen ne nsa etsia hɔn, na ɔabɔ hɔn, ma akoko ho ebim, na hɔn efun ayɛ dɛ abɔntsen do wura. Iyi nyinara mu, n'ebufuw nntɔree, na ne nsa da ho ara tsen.
Na ɔbɛma frankaa do ama amanaman a wɔwɔ ekyirkyir, na ɔabɔ nhwiroma afrɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ asaase ano noho no: na, hwɛ, wɔdze ahoɔhar bɛba ntsɛmara:
Hɔn mu obiara remmberɛ, eso orimmfintsiw; obiara ronntɔ nkom anaa ɔnnda; eso hɔn asen mu abɔdo rennsan, eso hɔn mpaboa ho ahoma renntsew:
Hɔn a hɔn egyen-menaba ano yɛ hwironhwirom, na hɔn egyen nyinara akonkom; wobobu hɔn mpɔnkɔ ananadze dɛ ɔtweerɛbo, na hɔn nhwiir dɛ ekyinehyia-mframa:
Hɔn pɔw bɛyɛ dɛ ogyata dze, wɔbɔpɔw dɛ ngyatafɔr: Nyew wɔbɔpɔw dɛ ngyatafɔr: Nyew wɔbɔpɔw, na wɔatɔ afonam, na wɔdze akɔ sɔnn, na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔbɛgye.
Na wɔbɔpɔw ahyɛ hɔn do da no dɛ po rowor: Na sɛ obi hwɛ asaase a, hwɛ, sum na ahoguan, na kan ahyɛ sum wɔ wimu hɔ.
6: Afe a ɔhen Uzziah wui no, muhun Ewuradze dɛ ɔtse ahengua bi a ɔkrɔn na wɔama do do, na n’atar-ekyir-ntoado hyɛɛ asɔrfi no ma.
Seraphfo gyinagyina no do: Ɔbaako wɔ ntsaban esia; ɔdze ebien kata n’enyim, na ɔdze ebien kata n’anan ho, na ɔdze ebien tu.
Na ɔbaako tsēaa mu kyerɛɛ ɔbaako dɛ, krɔnkrɔn, krɔkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, nye dɔm Ewuradze: Asaase nyina ahyɛ n’enyimnyam mã.
Na apondua no ase wosowee wɔ nyia ɔtsēaa mu no ne ndze ntsi, na wusiw hyɛɛ ofi no mã.
Nna mesee dɛ, mundueɛ! Mewie abra; osiandɛ meyɛ nyimpa a m’ano ho nntsew, na metse ɔman a hɔn ano ho nntsew mu: Na m’enyiwa ehu ɔhen, dɔm Ewuradze no.
Nna Seraphfo no mu ɔbaako tui baa me nkyɛn, okura ogya nsenama a ɔdze ɔdabaa kɛfae wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do:
Na ɔdze kãa m’ano, na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, iyi akã w’ano; na woeyi w'emumuyɛ no kɔ, na wɔapo wo ho bɔn.
Na metsee Ewuradze ndze dɛ ɔrese dɛ, woana na mobɔsoma no, na woana na ɔbɔkɔ ama hɛn? Nna mesee dɛ, emi nye yi; soma me ɛ.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Kɔ, kɛse ɔman yi dɛ, ɔtse ara nna hom ntse, na mma hom nntse ase; na ohu ara nna hom nhu, na mma hom nnhu mu.
Ma ɔman yi n’akoma mpirim, na ma hɔn asowa nyɛ durdur, na muamua hɔn enyiwa; amma wɔaammfa hɔn enyiwa ennhu, na wɔaammfa hɔn asowa anntse, na wɔaannsan, na wɔaannsa hɔn yarba.
Nna mesee dɛ, Ewuradze, onkodu dabɛn? Na obuaa dɛ, onkodu dɛ nkurow no ayɛ afoafo ma obi nntsena mu, efiefi ayeyɛ efitɔw a nyimpa nntsetse mu, na asaase no ayɛ afõ koraa,
na Ewuradze akã nyimpa akɔ ekyirkyirkyir, na mbea a wɔadan egya no adɔɔ sõ wɔ asaase no do.
Na sɛ ebupɛn du mu kor da ho wɔ mu a, wɔbɛsan asɛɛ no bio: Dɛ mbrɛ terebinth na dɛ mbrɛ osudur no dusin si hɔ, ber a wɔatow akyen famu no, dɛmara so na asefo krɔnkrɔn no yɛ no dusin.
7: Na obaa de Uzziah ba Jotham, ne ba Ahaz, Judahhen no n’aber do, na Syriahen Rezin, na Remaliah ba Pekah Israelhen no wɔfowee kɔr Jerusalem dɛ wɔnye no rokɔkõ; na woenntum no.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Dayid fi dɛ, Syria abɔbɔ Ephraim mu, na n’akoma wosowee, nye ne man akoma, dɛ mbrɛ kwaa mu ndua wosow wɔ mframa enyim.
Nna Ewuradze see Isaiah dɛ, afei si mu kɔ kehyia Ahaz, ɔwo, na wo ba Shear-jashub, wɔ etsifi nsutaae no ano a ɔwɔ ɔtanhofo kwã tsempɔn mu no;
na se no dɛ, hwɛ yie, na yɛ komm; mma nnsuro, eso mma w’akoma nntu, wɔ ngyantsia ebien a opun wusiw yi no ndua ebien no ntsi, wɔ Rezin na Syria na Remaliah ba no hɔn ebufuhyew no ntsi.
Osiandɛ Syria apam wo do mbusu, Ephraim so, ɔnye Remaliah ba no, dɛ,
hom mma yɛnkɔ Judah do, na yɛnkɛhaw no, na yembubu mu mfa, na yɛnhyɛ Tabeel ba no hen wɔ mu:
Mbrɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn se nye yi, orinngyina eso ɔremmba mu.
Osiandɛ Syria tsir nye Damascus, na Damascus tsir nye Rezin: Na obodu mfe eduosia enum na woebubu Ephraim posoposo dɛ ɔnnyɛ ɔman bi bio:
Na Ephraim tsir nye Samaria, na Samaria tsir nye Remaliah ba no. Sɛ hom renngye nndzi a, ampaara hom rinntsintsim.
Na Ewuradze kasaa bio kyerɛɛ Ahaz, dɛ,
bisa Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn hɔ asɛnhyerɛdze bi; osian kɔ bun mu o, ɔkrɔn kɔ sor o.
Na Ahaz see dɛ, mirimmbisa, eso moronnsɔ Ewuradze nnhwɛ.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Dayid fi, afei hom ntsie, aso ɔyɛ adze ketseaba ma hom dɛ hom haw nyimpa, na hom bɛhaw me Nyankopɔn so yi?
Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze nankasa bɛma hom asɛnkyerɛdze. Hwɛ, ɔbaabun benyinsen awo ɔbabanyin, na wɔato no dzin Immanuel.
Numfonsu na ewo na obedzi, ber a ohu dɛ ɔpow bɔn, na ɔsan mu yi papa no.
Na ansaana abofra no bohu dɛ ɔpow bɔn na ɔsan mu yi papa no, wɔbɛpa asaase no a hɔn ahemfo beenu ho yɛ wo nkɔw no egya
Ewuradze dze nda bi bɛba ɔwo, na wo man, na w’egya fi do a ofitsi nda a Ephraim tsewee fii Judah ho no ɔmmba da; mekyerɛ Assyriahen no.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no, Ewuradze bɔbɔ nhwiroma afrɛ wansema a ɔwoɔ Egypt nsutsen ano noho no, na adowa a ɔwɔ Assyria asaase do no.
Na wɔbɛba, na hɔn nyina abɛgyegye bɔnsa kekakeka no mu, nye abotan mpaapaae mu, na nsoɛ nyina do, na nhaban nyina do.
Da no na Ewuradze dze oyindam a wɔabɔ no paa wɔ esuegya noho no a ɔnye Assyriahen beyi tsir ɔnye anan ho nhwi, na oeyi abɔdwesa so.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no obi bɛnyɛn ɔnantwiburwa na nguan ebien bi;
na ɔbɛba dɛ, numfonsu dodow a wɔbɛma no ntsi, obedzi numfonsudaa: Na numfonsudaa ɔnye ewo na obiara a ɔaka ɔman no mu no bedzi.
Na da no mu no ɔbɛba dɛ, beebiara mbrɛ nkyɛ wenyinndua apem a odzi ndwetɛbona apem wɔ, bɛdan nkɔkrɔw ɔnye nsoɛ ara nko.
Egyen menaba ɔnye egyen na wɔdze bɛba hɔ.
Na akoko a nkyɛ wɔdze asɔw dɔw do nyina no, ennkɔkɔ ho bio, wɔ nkɔkrɔw ɔnyɛ nsoɛ ho hu ntsi, na wobegya anantwi akɔ do na nguan etsiatsia do.
8: Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, fa ɔpon kɛse, na fa ɔdasanyi ne nsaano kyerɛw do dɛ, Maher-shalal-hash-baz a;
na mebɛma adasefo anokwafo edzi me dase, ɔsɔfo Uriah, na Jeberchiah ba Zechariah.
Na mokɔr nkɔnhyɛnyibaa no ho; na onyinsenii woo ɔbabanyin. Nna Ewuradze see me dɛ, to no dzin Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
Na ansaana abofra no benya nyimdzee afrɛ, m'egya, na, me nã no, wɔbɔsoa Damascus ahonya na Samaria asadze edzi Assyriahen enyim akɔ.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ me bio dɛ,
susuampa dɛ ɔman yi apow Shiloah nsu a ɔpem nyaa, na hɔn ho asɛpɛw Rezin nye Remaliah ba no ho yi;
dɛm ntsi, afei, hwɛ, Ewuradze esutsen no mu nsu a ɔyɛ dzen na ɔdɔɔ sõ no reba hɔn do, Assyriahen ɔnye n enyimnyam nyina, na ɔbɛba abɔfow n esuka nyina na ɔatra n’esukɔn nyina do;
na ɔbɛpram akɔ Judah do, na oeyir etwa mu ako; obodu kɔn ho mpo; na n’atsaban mu ban bɛhyɛ w asaase ne tɛtɛr nyina mã, ao Immanuel.
Aman, hom nyɛ weɔɔ weɔɔ, na wɔbɔdwerew hom ara; ekyirkyir asaasedofo nyina, hom nyɛ aso: Hom mmia, na wɔbɔdwerew hom.
Hom mbɔ mu nkɔ apam, na ɔbɛyɛ kwa; hom nkã asɛm no, na orinngyina: Na Onyame nye hɛn tse.
Na Ewuradze dze nsa dzendzen kasaa dɛm kyerɛɛ me, na ɔdze kyerɛkyerɛɛ me, dɛ mma mennantsew ɔman yi no kwan do, dɛ,
mma hom mmfrɛ dza ɔman yi frɛ no Tsirdoapam nyina dɛ Tsirdoapam a; eso mma hom nnsuro hɔn suro, eso mma hom akoma nntu.
Dɔm Ewuradze no, ɔno na hom mbu no krɔnkrɔn; na ɔno na ɔnyɛ hom suro, na ɔnyɛ hom akomatu.
Na ɔbɛyɛ krɔnkrɔn-bea ama hom, na ɔayɛ fintsiw bo, na patatsir botan ama Israel efiefi ebien nyina, na ɔayɛ apafir na efir ama hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalem nyina.
Na dodowara befintsiw do, na wɔahwehwe ase, na woebubu, na wɔatotɔ efir mu, ma wɔakyekyer hɔn.
Ɔwoara kyekyer dase no, sɔw nkyerɛkyerɛ no ano wɔ m'esuafo mu.
Na emidze mobɔtweɔn Ewuradze a ɔdze n’enyim suma Jacob fi, na mahwɛ no kwan.
Hwɛ, emiɔnye mba a Ewuradze dze ama me yɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze wɔ Israel mu, ofi dɔm Ewuradze a ɔtse Zion bepɔw do no hɔ.
Na sɛ wɔse hom dɛ, hom mbisa asamamfrɛfo ɔnye esumamfo a wosū twɔtwɔw na wɔyɛ huhuhuhu no a: Aso onntwar dɛ ɔman bi wobisa hɔn Nyame hɔ adze? Aso wombisa atseasefo ho asɛm wɔ ewufo hɔ?

Wɔnkɔ mbra ɔnye adasesɛm no hɔ! Sɛ wɔannkasa dɛ asɛm yi a, ɔnodze hɔn, na ɔkɔm adze hɔn: Na ɔbɛba dɛ ɔkɔm nya dze hɔn a, hɔn ahom bɛtsew hɔn, na wɔdze hɔn hen na hɔn Nyankopɔn adom, na wɔadandan hɔn Nyankopɔn adom, na wɔadandan hɔn enyi akɔ sor.
Na wɔbɔhwɛ famu so, na hwɛ, ahohyer nye sum nye ahoguan kusuu yɛ nye yi; na wobosun hɔn egu sumpɔrwa no mu.
9: Na kusuwwyɛ no ronnko hɔ mma nyia ɔwɔ ahoguan mu no. Mber a odzi kan no, oemmbu Zebulun asaase na Naphtali asaase bi, na ekyirii dze ɔahyɛ no enyimnyam, po kwan do, Jordan egya, amanaman Galilee.
Ɔman a wɔnantseew sum mu no, woehu kan kɛse, hɔn a wɔtsenaa owu sunsuma asaase do no, kan ahyerɛn hɔn do.
Ɔwo ama ɔman no adɔr, ɔwo ama hɔn enyigye adɔɔ sõ: Hɔn enyi gye w’enyim dɛ otwaber mu enyigye, dɛ mbrɛ adasa dzi ehurusi ber a wɔrekyɛ asadze.
Na n’adzesoa kɔndua no, na ne batsir poma no, na ne hyɛdofo abaa no, ebubu mu dɛ Media da no.
Na ɔkofo n’akodze a ɔwɔ gyigyeegye no mu nyina, na ntar a wɔdze efuntanfuntam bɔgya mu, ɔbɛyɛ adze a wɔhyew, ɔnye ogya nyena.
Na wɔawo ɔba ama hɛn, wɔama hɛn ɔbabanyin; na ahendzi no bɛda ne batsir do: Na wɔbɛfrɛ ne dzin ɔpamfo nwanwanyi, Onyame Katakyi, ɔdomankoma Egya, asomdwee Hen.

Na n’ahendzi na n’asomdwee ne trɛ nnkodu ewiei, wɔ Dayid ahengua do na n’ahendzi do, dɛ obetsim no, na ɔdze atsɛmbu na tsenenee awowaw no ofitsi ndɛ dze ekesi mbersantsen. Dɔm Ewuradze no mbɔdzembɔ bɛyɛ yi.
Ewuradze dze asɛm bi kraa Jacob, na oebodwir Israel do.
Na ɔman no nyinara bohu, Ephraim na Samariafo a wɔkã wɔ nkontompɔ na hɔn akokodur mu dɛ,
ntaayaa egu famu, na yɛdze abo a wɔasen besi: Wɔatotow sycamore-ndua, na yɛdze cedar bɛhyɛ ananmu.
Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze bɛma Rezin ahohiahiafo do ahyɛ no do, na oekenyan n’atamfo;
Syriafo dzi enyim, na Philistiafo dzi ekyir, na wɔdze anomu petoo amen Israel. Iyi nyinara mu n’ebufuw nntɔree, na ne nsa da ho ara tsen.
Naaso ɔman no nnsanee mmbaa nyia ɔbɔɔ hɔn no nkyɛn, eso wɔnnhwehwee dɔm Ewuradze n’ekyir kwan.
Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze botwa Israel mu tsir ɔnye dua, berɛw ɔnye mbɛw da kor.
Ɔtsetsenyi ɔnye onyimnyamfo, ɔno nye tsir no na nkɔnhyɛnyi atorkyerɛnyi no, ɔno nye dua no.
Na hɔn a wɔkyerɛ ɔman yi kwan no dze hɔn fom; na hɔn a wokyerɛ hɔn kwan, wɔsɛɛ hɔn.

Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze rinnya hɔn mberantsɛ ho enyigye, eso orunnhu hɔn ngyanka nye hɔn ekunafo mbɔbor: Na obiara ayɛ ɔhohurafo na omumuyɛnyi, na ano biara kã nkwaseasɛm. Iyi nyina mu n’ebufuw nntɔree, ne nsa da ho ara tsen.
Na emumuyɛ hyew dɛ ogya; ɔmen nkɔkrɔw ɔnye nsoɛ: Ampaara, ɔsɔ wɔ kwaa mu adɔtɔ mu, na opun wusiw kumbɔɔ fow kɔ sor.
Na ɔnam dɔm Ewuradze n’ebufuw do na asaase no ahyew tumm: Na ɔman no so ayɛ dɛ ogya nyena; obiara nnkam no nua do.
Na obi bohwim enyimfa edzi, naaso ɔkɔm adze no; na obedzidzi wɔ bankum, na wɔremmee: Wɔbɔwewe hɔnara hɔn nsa ho nam:
Manasseh bɔwe Ephraim, na Ephraim awe Manasseh: Na hɔn beenu asoɛr ahyɛ Judah do. Iyi nyina mu n’ebufuw nntɔree na ne nsa da ho ara tsen.
10: Wondue, hɔn a wɔhyehyɛ mmom a ɔnntsen, na kyerɛwfo a wɔkyerɛw dza ɔkyea;
dɛ wɔredan ohianyi efi atsɛmbu ho, ma woeehwim me man abɔbɔfo hɔn ndzinoa, ma ekunafo aayɛ hɔn asadze, na wɔdze ngyanka aayɛ hɔn afonam!
Na hom bɛyɛ dɛn wɔ ɔsera da no mu, na ɔsɛɛ a ofi ekyirkyir reba no mu? Woana hɔ na hom boguan akɛgye mboa? Na henfa na hom bɛdan hom enyimnyam egya?
Adaduafo ase nko ara na wɔbɔbɔ hɔn mu adze, na wɔahwehwe atɔfo ase. Na iyi nyina mu n'ebufuw nntɔree, na ne nsa da ho ara tsen.
Assyria, due, m'ebufuw abaa, wo nsamu poma nye m'ebufuhyew!
Ɔman ahohurafo mu na mobɔsoma no makɔ, m'ebufuw man no ho na mebɛhyɛ no mbra, dɛ ɔnkɔfow asadze, na ɔnkɛfa afonam, na onketsia hɔn do dɛ abrɔn mu dɛtse.
Naaso ɔnndwen dɛm, eso n'akoma nnsusu dɛm; na dza ɔwɔ n'akoma mu nye dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ, na oetwitwa amanaman a wɔdɔɔ sõ egu.
Na ɔkã dɛ, ana m'asafohen nyinara nnyɛ ahemfo bi a?
Aso Caino nntse dɛ Carchemish bi a? Aso Hamath nntse dɛ Arpad? Aso Samaria nntse dɛ Damascus bi a?
Dɛ mbrɛ me nsa akã abosom ahendzi no a hɔn egu-ehonyi kyɛn Jerusalem ɔnye Samaria dze no;
aso nnyɛ mbrɛ mɛdze mayɛ Samaria ɔnye n’abosom, dɛmara so na medze mebɛyɛ Jerusalem ɔnye n’abosom bi a?
Dɛm ntsi ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ Ewuradze wie n’edwuma nyina yɛ wɔ bepɔw Zion ɔnye Jerusalem do a, mebɛtsēa Assyriahen n’akokodur aba no, nye n’enyimenam enyimnyam no.
Na ɔakã dɛ, me nsamu ahoɔdzen ɔnye me nyansaa na medze mayɛ; na meyɛ ɔbadwembafo: Na matwe aman no hɔn ahe no, na mafom hɔn akoradze, na mesun hɔn a wɔtsetse nhengua do megu dɛ ɔkakaben:
Na me nsa akã amanaman ahonya no dɛ berɛbuw; na dɛ mbrɛ woɔtase nkyirefuwa a wɔadan egya no, dɛmara na matase asaase nyina: Na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔbɔɔ atsaban mu, eso ɔhaan anomu, anaaso osūu twɔtwɔw.
Aso ekuma bɛhyehyɛ noho wɔ nyia ɔdze twa adze no do? Anaa seradaa bɛhyehyɛ noho wɔ nyia ɔtwetwe no do? Dɛ gyama abaa bi him nyia ɔma do no do, anaadɛ poma bɛma nyia ɔnnyɛ dua no no do
Dɛm ntsi na Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze, ɔbɛma ɔfɔn aba n’abran do; na ɔasɔ n’enyimnyam ase ogya a ɔredzɛw.
Na Israel kan no bɛdan ogya, na ne krɔnkrɔnnyi noadan gyaframee: Na ɔbɛhyew amen no nsoɛ nye no nkɔkrɔw nyina da kor.
Na ɔbɛma no kwaa ɔnye no mfuwa enyimnyam asã, ofitsi ɔkra do kcsi nyimpadua do: Na ɔayɛ dɛ aber a frankaakitsafo rotɔ bitsi.
No kwaa mu ndua nkaa no bosuar, dɛ abofra botum akan.
Na ɔbɛba da no mu dɛ, Israel nkaa no ɔnye Jacob fi mu hɔn a woefi nsa no nnkɔtwer nyia ɔbobɔɔ hɔn no bio: Na wɔbɔtwer Ewuradze,
Nkaa no bɛsan aba, Jacob nkaa no bɛba Onyame katakyi no nkyɛn.
Na kaansa wo man Israel tse dɛ mpoano anhwea mpo, a, nkaa ara na wɔbɛsan aba: Wɔahyɛ ɔhyew a ɔbɛpem ndzeyɛtsenenee.
Na ndzɛmba ewiei a wɔakyɛ na Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze, dze bɛba asaase nyina mu.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze, se nye yi, ao me man a etse Zion, mma nnsuro Assyria: Sɛ abaa na ɔdze bɔhwe wo, na ɔama no poma do wɔ wo do, dɛ Egypt dze no mpo a.
Na aka kakrabaabi na ebufuhyew no abɔ adze, na n’ebufuw adan ayɛ hɔn sɛɛe.
Na dɔm Ewuradze behim mpirebi wɔ no do, dɛ Midian ekumii wɔ Oreb botan do no: Na n’abaa bɛkyerɛ po no do, ɔama do dɛ Egypt dze no.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ n’adzesoa beyi efi wo batsir do, na kɔndua efi wo kɔn ho, na kɔndua no asɛɛ wɔ seradze no ntsi.
Ɔaba Aiath, oetwa mu wɔ Migron, ɔdze no ndɔsoaba rugu Michmash:
Wɔafa akoko ntainu; wɔakoɔoɛ Geba: Ramah ho popo; Saul Gibeah eguan.
Gallim babaa, ma wo ndze do tsēa mu! Laishah e, tsie ɛ! Na ɔwo Anathoth ɔbɔbɔfo!
Madmenah ayɛ oguamfo; Gebim atsefo aboa hɔn ano ruguan.
Ndɛ da yi ara wobesianka Nob: Ɔpopo ne nsa ho gu Zion babaa ne bepɔw no do, Jerusalem koko no a.
Hwɛ, Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze, dze hu bɛpempan ndubaa no: Na ndupɔn atsentsen no wɔwowaree no abrɛ adze.
Na ɔdze dadze etwitwa kwaa mu adɔtɔ, na Lebanon nam ɔkatakyi nsa dp ahwe ase.
11: Na mfɛwee bi befi Jesse dusin no mu afɛw, na odubaa efi no ndwow mu efir asow aba:
Na Ewuradze no sunsum besi no do, nyansa ɔnye ntseasee sunsum, apam ɔnye ahoɔdzen sunsum, na nyimdzee ɔnye Ewuradze suro sunsum;
na Ewuradze ho suro mu na ɔbɛfa n’enyika: Na onnkedzi dza n’enyiwa hu no ekyir ebu atsɛn, eso onnkedzi dza n’asowa tse no ekyir akã enyim:
Tsenenee mbom na ɔdze bobu ɔbɔbɔfo atsɛn, na ɔdze atsɛntsenenee akã enyim wɔ asaase no do abrɛfo no ntsi: Na ɔdze n’anomu abaa abobɔ asaase no, na ɔdze n’anomu ahom eku omumuyɛnyi.
Na ndzeyɛtsenenee bɛyɛ n'asen abɔdo, na nokwardzi ayɛ n'abɔyamu.
Na pataku nye eguambaa bɛtsena, na ɔsebɔ nye apɔnkyeba ada hɔ; na nantwiba nye ogyataba na nantwiba a ɔadɔ seradze atsena fakor; na abɔdomaba egya hɔn.
Na ɔnantwiber nye osisi bedzidzi, na hɔn mba abɔ mu ada fakor: Na ogyata bɔwe efuw dɛ ɔnantwi.
Na enumfoanoba bɔgor ehurutsia tu ano, na ɔba a oetwa enumfo dze ne nsa ato ɔkyerben no bɔn mu.
Wɔnnkɛyɛ bɔn eso wɔnnkɛsɛɛ wɔ me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn nyina do: Na Ewuradze ho nyimdzee bɛhyɛ asaase mã, dɛ mbrɛ esu kata po do.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ Jesse ndwow a osi hɔ dɛ frankaa ma aman no, n’ekyir kwan na amanaman bɔhwehwɛ; na n’ahomgyebea bɛyɛ enyimnyam.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ, Ewuradze dze ne nsa bosuo mu bio ne mprɛnu agye ne man nkaase efi Assyria na Egypt, na Pathros, na Cush, na Elam, na Shinar, na Hamath, na po mu nsupɔw no.
Na obesi frankaa ama amanaman, na ɔapon Israel tokyemfo no aboa ano, na ɔama Judahfo a wɔapetse no wofi asaase mfɛndzanan mu ebehyia.
Ephraim n’enyitan so befi hɔ akɔ, na hɔn a wohiahia Judah ho no, wobotwa hɔn efi hɔ: Ephraim n’enyi nnkɛber Judah, Judah so nnkehiahia Ephraim ho.
Na wobotu ekesi Philistiafo kɔn ho wɔ anee; wɔbɔbɔ mu akɔ bokamba afo: Wɔdze hɔn nsa bɔto Edom ɔnye Moabmba do; na Ammonmba ayɛ setsie ama hɔn.
Na Ewuradze bɛsɛɛ Egypt po ɔdoɛɛ no huntuhuntu; na ɔdze ne hyew mframa apopo ne nsa ho egu Esutsen no do, na ɔabɔ no ma ɔadan nsubansuba esuon, ma nkorɔfo dze nsokota edua mu wesee.
Na ɔtsempɔn bi bɛda hɔ ama me man nkaa a wɔaka efi Assyria; dɛ mbrɛ odaa hɔ maa Israel wɔ da a ofii Egypt asaase do bae no.
12: Na da no ebɛse dɛ, ao Ewuradze, medze ndaase mebɛma wo; na kaansa wo bo fuuw me a, w’ebufuw no adan kɔ, na ekyekye mo werɛ.
Hwɛ, Nyame nye mo nkwagye; mobɔtwer, na munnkosuro: Na Ewuradze Jehoyah nye m’ahoɔdzen nye mo ndwom: Na ɔno na ɔabɛyɛ mo nkwagye.
Dɛm ntsi enyigye na hom dze bɔtow nsu efi nkwagye bura no mu.
Na da no hom bɛkã dɛ, hom nda Ewuradze ase, hom mbɔ ne dzin, hom mbɔ ne nyɛe dawur nkyerɛ aman, hom mbɔ dzin dɛ wɔama ne dzin do.
Hom ntow ndwom mma Ewuradze; na ɔayɛ adze kyɛnee: Hom mma wonhu yi wɔ asaase nyina.
Keka mu na bɔ ose, ɔwo a etse Zion: Na Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi a ɔtse wo mu no ɔsõ.
13: Babylon ho atsɛmbusɛm a Amoz ba Isaiah hunii.
Hom nsi frankaa wɔ bepɔw petee no do, hom mma ndze do mma hɔn, hom nnyam nsa, ama wɔaakɛhɛn ekunyin mbobotsen no mu.
Mahyɛ mo nkorɔfo a woetu hon esi nkyɛn no, nyew, mafrɛ me mbarimba akatakyi ama m’ebufuw, mekyerɛ hɔn a wodzi mo tumdzi mu ehurusi no.
Nyimpadodow hɔn dede wɔ mbepɔw no do dɛ gyama ɔman kɛse bi dze! Amanaman a wɔaboa ano hɔn ahendzi horow ne gyigyeegye dede a! Dɔm Ewuradze rotwe no dɔm aboa ano akɔkõ.
Wofi ekyirkyir asaase do, na wimu n’etsiwa mu no ho reba, Ewuradze, na n’ebufuhyew akodze no a, dɛ ɔrebɛsɛɛ asaase no nyina.
Hom ntwa ewuo; na Ewuradze da no abɛn; ɔbɛba dɛ ɔsɛɛ a ofi otumfo ho.
Dɛm ntsi nsa nyina mu bɔgow, na nyimpa akoma biara anan:
Na hɔn bo botu; nketsenketse nye awerɛhow bekitsa hɔn; ɔyaw bɛba hɔn do dɛ ɔbaa a ɔrokõ awoo: Obiara ne nyɛnko ho bɛyɛ no ahobow; hɔn enyim bɛyɛ gyaframee enyim.
Hwɛ, Ewuradze ne da reba, etsirmɔdzen, nye ebufuw, nye ebufuhyew; dɛ ɔrebɛyɛ asaase no afõ, na ɔasɛɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo efi mu.
Na ɔsor nworaba ɔnye hɔn nworaba ekuwekuw nnkɛma hɔn kan: Ewia bɛhyɛ sum wɔ ne mfirii mu, na bosoom so nnkɛma ne kan ahyerɛn.
Na mebɛtsēa wiadze wɔ hɔn bɔn ntsi, na emumuyɛfo wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi; na mama ntsɛntsɛnnyi ne ntsɛn abɔ adze, na mama ɔhoɔhunyi n’ahokyerɛ abrɛ adze.
Mebɛma nyimpa no ho ayɛ na asen sika mapa, ɔdasanyi bɛsen Ophir sika mpɔkowa mpo.
Dɛm ntsi mebɛma ɔsorsor apopo, na wɔawosow asaase efi ne sibea, wɔ dɔm Ewuradze n’ebufuw no mu, na n’ebufuhyew da no mu.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, dɛ ɔwansan a woritsiw no, na nguan a obi mmboa hɔn ano, na wɔbɛdandan hɔnho akokɔ hɔn nkorɔfo nkyɛn, na woeguanguan akokɔ hɔn asaase do.
Obiara a wobohu no wobohwira no mu; na obiara a wɔbɛkyer no no, ɔbɔtɔ afõwa ano.
Na hɔn mbɔtowaba so woboposow hɔn wɔ hɔn enyim; wɔbɔfow hɔn efi na wɔabobɔ hɔn yernom adapaa.
Hwɛ, mebɛhyɛ Mediafo ntsirmu metsia hɔn, hɔn a wonnkobu dwetɛ bi, na sika dze, wɔnnkɛfa mu enyika.
Hɔn ngyen bɛtsetsew mberantsɛ mu esinesin, na worinnya yafun mu aba tsimbɔbɔr; hɔn enyi bɛsã mbofraba.
Na Babylon, ahendzi horow mu onyimnyamfo, Chaldeafo hɔn ahopɔw n’ahoɔfɛw no, ɔbɛyɛ dɛ ber a Nyame butuuw Sodom nye Gomorrah no.
Wɔrenntsena mu ara da, eso wɔrenntsena hɔ ofi ebusuasantsei kesi ebusuasantsen: Eso Arabnyi nnkɔbɔ asese wɔ hɔ; eso nguanhwɛfo nnkɛma hɔn nguankuw ebutubutuw hɔ.
Na sar do mbowa abɔyafona wɔbɛdeda hɔ, na mpatu ebusufu bɛhyehyɛ hɔn adan amaama; na nsohor bɛtsena hɔ, na satyr asaw wɔ hɔ.
Na mpataku bosū wɔ hɔn aban mu, na sardo nkraman so, wɔ hɔn enyigye nhemfi no mu: Na ne ber abɛn dɛ ɔbɛba, na ne nda nnkɛkyɛr bio.
14: Na Ewuradze benya ayamuhyehye wɔ Jacob ho, na ɔasan mu eyi Israel bio, na ɔdze hɔn esi hɔnankasa hɔn asaase do; na ɔnanaben dze noho abɔ hɔn ho, na wɔatakyer Jacob fi ho.
Na aman no bɛfa hɔn, na wɔdze hɔn aba hɔn tsenabea, na Israel fi afa hɔn ayɛ nkowaa na mfonabaa wɔ Ewuradze asaase no do, na wɔafa hɔn ndɔmmumafo no ndɔmmum; na wɔahom hɔn ahyɛdofo do.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ da a Ewuradze bɛma wo ahomgye efi wo yaw, na wo fona, na wo sohia a wɔdze wo kɔr mu no mu no,
edze bɛ yi bobu Babylon hen, na ase dɛ, mbrɛ ɔhyɛdofo esi egyaa a! Sika kurow no edua abɔ adze a!
Ewuradze ebubu omumuyɛnyi n’abaa, mpanyindzifo ahempoma;
nyia ɔdze ebufuw bobɔɔ amanbobɔ a onngyaa, ɔdze ebufuw hoom amanaman do hyɛɛ hɔn amen a obi ennsianka.
Asaase nyina adwe, na ɔayɛ dzinn: Wɔfa ehurusi ndwom.
Ɛhɛɛ, kupresindua so nya wo enyigye, na Lebanon cedar, dɛ, ɔnam dɛ wɔdze wo ato famu yi, ɔtowfo biara mmfowee mmbaa hɛn do.
Sheol fir ase akã noho ama wo dɛ oribehyia wo mbae; okenyan ewufo ma wo; asaase do etsitsir nyinara no a; ɔama amanaman ahemfo nyinara asoɛrsoɛr efifi hɔn ahengua do.
Hɔn nyinara bɛgye do akã akyerɛ wo dɛ, ɔwoara so na egura dɛ hɛn yi?
W'akɛseyɛ wɔabrɛ no adze akɔ Sheol, na wɔ mbɛntaasanku dede no; wɔasɛw nsaamaa wɔ w'ase, na nsaamaa kata wo do.
Mbre edua ifi in Sor ahwe ase a, ao adzekyee nworaba, anapa ba! Mbrɛ woetwa wo ato famu a, ɔwo a ebrɛ amanaman adze!
Na ekãe wɔ w’akoma mu dɛ, mobɔfow makɔ sor, mebɛma m’ahengua do atra Nyame nworaba; na matsena mboanofo bepɔw no do wɔ kwaamu afamu n’etsiwa mu no ho:
Mobɔfow matra nsuwusiw n’etsifi no ho ara; mebeyɛ dɛ abɔso no.
Naaso wɔbɛbrɛ wo adze akɔ Sheol ekodu mona no n’ase noho ara.
Hɔn a wohu wo bɔhwɛ wo kann adwen wo ho dɛ, aso nyimpa a ɔmaa asaase wosowee, na ɔmaa ahendzi hihimii nye yi;
nyia ɔmaa wiadze yi yɛɛ dɛ sar, na obutuuw no mu nkurow; na oenngyaa n’adaduafo ma wɔaannkɔ fie nye yi?
Amanaman ahemfo nyinara, hɔn nyinara, wɔdeda enyimnyam mu, obiara wɔ nankasa ne fie.
Na ɔwodze, wɔatow wo efi w’asamandan mu akyen dɛ odubaa a wokyir, atɔfo a afõwa ehwirahwira hɔn mu na wosian kɔ mona no n’abo ho na wɔakata wo do; dɛ fun a ɔnamɔn etsiatsia do.
Wɔnnkɛfa wo akã hɔn ho wɔ efunsie mu, osiandɛ asɛɛ w’asaase, ekukum wo manmba; emumuyɛfo asefo, wɔnnkɔbɔ hɔn dzin dabiarada bio.
Hom nsiesie ekumii mma mba no wɔ hɔn egyanom emumuyɛ ntsi; ma wɔaannsoɛr wɔammfa asaase no enndzi do, na wɔaammfa nkurow annhyɛ wiadze mu mã.
Na mobɔsoɛr metsia hɔn, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na mebɛyɛ no nkɔtɔkɔ enyadze so, na nsu ntaataae na medze ɔsɛɛ mena mapra no, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Dɔm Ewuradze akã ntam, dɛ, ampaara, dɛ mbrɛ madwendwen ho no, dɛmara no ɔbɛba mu, na dɛ mbrɛ mobɔɔ tsirmpow no, dɛmara na obegyina:
Dɛ mubobubu Assyrianyi wɔ m’asaase do, na medze m'anamɔn metsiatsia no do wɔ me mbepɔw nna no kɔndua befi hɔn do akɔ, n’adzesoa efi hɔn abatsir.
Iyi nye tsirmpow a wɔabɔ no wo asaase nyina ho; na iyi nye nsa a wɔatsen no wɔ amanaman nyina do.
Na dɔm Ewuradze abɔ tsirmpɔw, na woana bɛma ɔayɛ gyan? Na ne nsa na woana na obopon mu?
Afe a ɔhen Ahaz wui no mu, na atsɛmbusɛm yi bae.
Mma nndzi ehurusi, ɔwo Philistia nyina, dɛ abaa a ɔhwee wo no ebu ntsi: Na ɔwɔ no ndwow mu na ɔkyerben befir aba, na n’aba bɛyɛ dɛ ogya abowatsena a otu.
Na ɔbɔbɔfo n’abakan bedzidzi, na ohianyi ada hɔ dwudwoodwo: Na medze ɔkɔm boku wo ndwow, na wo nkaasefo so wobokuku hɔn.
Abobokɛse e, twa ewuo; kurow e, keka mu; wɔanan wo egu, ɔwo Philistia nyina; na wusiw fi kwaamu afamu reba, na obiara nnkegyina ekyir wɔ ne mber a wɔhyehyɛ no mu.
Ebɛn mbɔ na wɔdze bobua amanaman Ndwuma no? Dɛ Ewuradze dze Zion etsim hɔ, na no mu na ne man mu amandzehufo benya guandɔbew.
15: Moab ho atsɛmbusɛm. Anago da kor na wɔasɛɛ Moab Ar, na ɔabɔ; anago da kor na wɔasɛɛ Moab Kir, na ɔabɔ.
Ɔafow kɔ Bayith, na Dibon, nsorɔnsorɔmbea no do, ekosū: Moab rutwa ewuo gu Nebo do, na Medeba do: Hɔn nyinara hɔn etsifi apepa, abɔdwesa biara woetwitwa.
Wofurafura eyitam wɔ abrɔn mu: Hɔn adan etsifi, na hɔn eguabirim, obiara rutwa ewuo, rusū pii.
Na Heshbon rekeka mu, na Elealeh; wɔtse hɔn ndze ara kodu Jahaz mpo: Dɛm ntsi na Moab akofo rekeka mu dzendzen; ne kra ho him wɔ no mu.
M’akoma keka mu ma Moab; n’ekunyin guan kɔ Zoar, wɔkɔ Eglath-shelishiyah: Na Luhith afowee no, na wɔdze osū fow; na Horonaim kwan mu na wɔma ɔsɛɛ ewuotwa do.
Na Nimrim esu bɛyɛ kwawee: Na sar no eguan, na mfunoma no asã, na ha momon biara nnyi hɔ.
Dɛm ntsi adze pii a woenya, na dza wɔapɛ esie, na wɔbɔsoa akɔ esukɔnndua no wora no ho.
Na nkeka mu no abɔ Moab he do aprɔw ehyia; na ewuotwa edu Eglaim, na ewuotwa edu Beer- elim.
Na Dimon esu ayɛ bɔgya mã: Na medze bi so beka Dimon ho, ogyata bɔtɔ nyia ofi Moab guan, ɔnye asaase no do nkaa no so.
16: Hom mfa asaase no do ɔpanyin no nguambaa no mfi Sela mfa sar do afamu, nkɔ Zion babaa bepɔw no do.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ Moab mbabaa bɛyɛ dɛ nnoma a worikyin, ɔnye berɛbuw a wɔaho tse mu, wɔ Arnon esutwae.
Ma apam, bua atsɛn; yɛ wo nwinwin dɛ anago wɔ ewiaber ketee: Fa hɔn a wɔapam hɔn huntsa; mma nnkyerɛ ɔkobɔfo do kwan.
Ma m’atokyemfo ntsena wo nkyɛn; Moab dze, yɛ huntsabea ma no wɔ ɔsɛɛfo no enyim: Na ɔpempensifo no ayɛ kwa, afo abɔ adze, ahyɛdofo asã wɔ asaase no do.
Na wooetsim ahengua bi wɔ mbɔbɔrhu mu, na obi atsena do wɔ nokwar mu wɔ Dayid ntamadan mu a obu atsɛn, na ɔhwehwɛ atsɛmbu, na no ho yɛ har dɛ ɔyɛ ɔtsenenee.
Yɛatse Moab horan a ɔahoran dodow no nka; n’ahopɔw, na no nkontompɔ, na n’ebufuw: N’ahohyehyɛ ayɛ kwa.
Dɛm ntsi Moab botwa Moab ho ewuo, obiara botwa ewuo: Kir-hareseth esikyireamba tatar ntsi na hom bɛka mmɔn dɛ wɔabobɔ hom pasaa.
Na Heshbon mfuwa akyenkyen, Sibmah wenyindua no so; amanaman ewuranom ebubu n’abaw fɛɛfɛw no; wokodur Jazer mpo, wokyinii kɔr sar no do, n’abaw tserɛwee, wokotwaa po.
Dɛm ntsi medze Jazer osū mubosū Sibmah wenyindua: Medze me nyinsuwa bogugu wo do nsu, ao Heshbon, na Elealeh: Na wo pɛber nduaba ɔnye wo twaber do na asafo ose no abɔhwe.

Na woeyi enyigye efi hɔ, na dɛw no efi nhaban-ber no mu; na adwontow anaa ehurusi dede biara nnkɛba wenyin nture no mu: Na okyifo biara nnkekyi wenyin wɔ etwer mu; mama esikyireambatsew dede abɔ adze.
Iyi ntsi na mo nson mu gyegye sanku wɔ Moab ho, na m’ayamudze so wɔ Kir-heres ho.
Na ɔbebɛ dɛ, sɛ Moab yi noho edzi, sɛ ɔberɛ wɔ sorɔnsorɔmbea hɔ, na ɔba no krɔnkrɔn-bea hɔ ebeyi mpaa a, orinndzi nyim.
Iyi nye asɛm a Ewuradze kãe wɔ Moab ho aber a ɔabɛsen.
Na afei dze Ewuradze akasa, dɛ, mfensa mu, dɛ ɔpaanyi mfe, na Moab ɔnye ne nyimpadodow pii no nyinara hɔn enyimnyam ahyɛ ahoraa; na nkaa no bɛyɛ ketsewabaa a wommbu no hwee
17: Damascus ho atsɛmbusɛm. Hwɛ, woeyi Damascus efi hɔ, dɛ ɔyɛ kurow, na ɔbɛyɛ ndamfo.
Wɔadan Aroer nkurow egya, na wɔbɛyɛ mbowakuw dze a wobobutuw hɔ, na obi rinnyi hɔn hu.
Akoban so bɛpa wɔ Ephraim, na ahendzi wɔ Damascus; na Syria nkaa bɛyɛ dɛ Israelmba enyimnyam, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na da no, ɔbɛba dɛ Jacob enyimnyam bɛyɛ haharba, na no honam a ɔatɔ angoa no, ɔafɔn.
Na ɔbɛyɛ, dɛ otwafo pempan eburow a osisi hɔ, na ɔdze n’abasa bubu mbɛtsem no; ɛhɛɛ, ɔbɛyɛ dɛ aber a obi ridzi mbɛtsem mpɛpɛw wɔ Ephraim bɔnsa mu.
Naaso wobegya mpɛpɛw wɔ mu dɛ ngodua roporow aba, ebien anaa ebiasa wɔ nkɔnmu abaw do, anan anaa enum wɔ dua a ɔsow yie n'ekyirkyir ndubaa no do, Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
Da no mu na nyimpa bɔhwɛ ne yɛfo, na n’enyl asɔ Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no.
Na ɔronnhwɛ afɔrmbukyia, ne nsaano edwuma no, eso n’enyi ronnsɔ dza ne nsatseaba ayɛ, Asherim, anaadɛ ewia-ehonyi no.
Da no mu na no nkurow a ɔyɛ dzen bɛyɛ dɛ mbea a wɔadan egya wɔ kwaa mu na mbepɔw etsifi a wɔdanee gyae wɔ Israelmba enyim no: Na ayɛyɛ ekurofõ.
Osiandɛ ɔwo wo werɛ efir nkwagye Nyankopɔn no, na w’adwen ammba w'ahoɔdzen ɔbotan no do; dɛm ntsi na eyeyɛ mfuwa fɛɛfɛw, na etsetsɛw mu amanandze atsɛndua:
Wo ntsewee da no mu, egye ho ban, na anapa no ema w’aba no bɔ nkukuduuduw: Na twaber no boguan wɔ yaw na awerɛhow a onnyi suobea da no mu.
Ao, aman pii a wɔwor yɛ dede dɛ po no wor; na amanaman weɔɔyɛ ne dede a ɔyɛ dɛ nsu dzendzen no weɔɔyɛ!
Amanaman bɛyɛ weɔɔ dɛ esu pii no weɔɔyɛ: Na ɔbɔbɔ hɔn ham, na woeguan akɔ ekyirkyir, na woetsiw hɔn dɛ mbepɔw do ntsɛw wɔ mframa no mu, na dɛ ekyinehyia huntuma wɔ ehum enyim.
Ewimbibaamu no, hwɛ, hu nye yi; na ansaana adze bɛkye nna wonnyi hɔ. Iyi nye hɔn a wɔfa hɛn afo hɔn kyɛfa, nye hɔn a wotwa hɛn dwo hɔn afamudze.
18: Aa, ntsaban worakaworaka asaase a ɔwɔ Ethiopia nsutsen egya no ho:

Nyia otu ahembɔfo nam po do a, wɔtsetse ndzɛm ahɛn wɔ nsu enyi, dɛ, abɔfo a hom ho yɛ har, hom ho yɛ har, hom nkɔ ɔman a wɔyɛ apankor trontrom no nkyɛn, nkorɔfo a hɔn ho yɛ hu fir hɔn ahyɛse dze rokɔ no; ɔman bi a wosusu ma na wotsiatsia do a nsutsen etwitwa hɔn asaase mu no!
Hom wiadzemba nyinara, na hom asaase doatsefo, sɛ wosi frankaa wɔ mbepɔw do a, hom nhwɛ; na sɛ wɔbɔ akasamu mu a, hom ntsie.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze akã akyerɛ me nye yi, mebɛyɛ komm, na mahwɛ wɔ me tsenabea; dɛ ewiaber ketee mu ahohur, dɛ ɔbɔsu nsuwusiw wɔ otwaber ahohur mu.
Na onnyae nndur otwaber na nkukuduuduw apaa, na nhyiren robɔ wenyinaba a ɔregyegye mu no, ɔdze botwitwa nsasar no egu, na oeyi ndubaa a ɔatsentsen no etwitwa mu egu.
Wobegya ne nyinara ama mbepɔw do nnoma edzinam, ɔnye asaase do mbowa: Na nnoma edzinam bedzi ɔpɛber wɔ do, na asaase mbowa nyinara edzi do awɔwber.

Ber no mu na nkorɔfo apankor trontrom no a wofi nkorɔfo a hɔn ho yɛ hu fir hɔn ahyɛse dze rokɔ no no bɛyɛ akyɛdze abrɛ dɔm Ewuradze; wɔdze ɔman a wosusu na na wotsiatsia do a nsutsen etwitwa hɔn asaase mu no mu, bɛba dɔm Ewuradze ne dzin tsenabea, bepɔw Zion no do.
19: Egypt ho atsɛmbusɛm. Hwɛ, Ewuradze tse nsuwusiw ano yɛ har do nam, na ɔreba Egypt: Na Egypt abosom botutu wɔ n’enyim, na Egypt akoma anan wɔ no mu.
Na mibekenyan Egyptfo metsia Egyptfo: Na wɔnye hɔnho akokõ, obiara nye no nua, na obiara nye ne nyɛnko; kurow nye kurow, na ahenman nye ahenman.
Na Egypt no sunsum bɔtɔ pan wɔ no mu; na mebɛsɛɛ n’egyinatu; na wobekebisa adzeafo, asamamfrɛfo, na abayifo.
Na medze Egyptfo bɛhyɛ owura tsiɔdzennyi bi nsa; na ɔhen a no ho yɛ hu edzi hɔn do tum, Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze, na ɔse.
Na po mu nsu bohuam, na esutsen no bɛsã na ɔawew.
Na nsutsen no bɔbɔn; na Egypt nwora bɔtwe na wɔawewew; na ndzɛmbir ɔnye atsen no bɛkyenkyen.
Nile ho, ɔnye Nile no kɔn do efuw, ɔnye dza woedua no wɔ Nile ho nyina boguan, ahotse efi hɔ.
Na apofo so bɛka mmɔn, na hɔn a wɔtotow Nile mu nyina edzi nkɔmbɔ, na hɔn a wogu no enyi asawu no, wɔbɛyeyɛ kadwoo.
Nkyii so asaabaserɛwfo na hɔn a wɔwen ndwera enyi bɔtõ.
Na n’edum nyina bobubu esinesin, na apaadzifo nyina werɛ bɔhow.
Zoan asafohen yɛ nkwasea koraa; Pharaoh n’apamfo mu enyansafo hɔn apam adan mbowasɛm: Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom se Pharaoh dɛ, meyɛ enyansafo ba, tsetse ahemfo ba?
Henfa mbɔ na afei w’enyansafo wɔ? Afei ma wɔnkã nkyereɛ wo ɛ; ma wonhu tsirmpɔw a dɔm Ewuradze abɔ no wɔ Egypt ho.
Zoan asafohen adan nkwasea, wɔadaadaa Noph asafohen; na hɔn a wɔyɛ no mbusuakuw kutuwdo-bo, wɔama Egypt atɔ dɔnsuar.
Ewuradze dze akɔnkyew sunsum afora Egypt mu: Na wɔama Egypt atɔ dɔnsuar wɔ n’edwuma biara mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔsabokwafo to ntentan wɔ ne fe mu.
Eso edwuma bi remmba ama Egypt a tsir anaa dua, berɛw anaa mbɛw bɛyɛ.
Da no mu Egypt bɛyɛ dɛ mbaa; na no ho bɔpopo na oesuro wɔ dɔm Ewuradze nsahim a obehim no wɔ do ntsi.
Na Judah asaase bɛyɛ Egypt hu, obiara a wɔbɔ ne dzin kyerɛ no bosuro, wɔ dɔm Ewuradze tsirmpɔw a ɔabɔ etsia no ntsi.
Da no mu nkurow enum bɛba Egypt asaase do a wɔkasa Canaan kasa, na wɔkã ntam kyerɛ dɔm Ewuradze; wɔbɛfrɛ kor ɔsɛɛ kurow.
Da no mu afɔrmbukyia besi Egypt finimfin ama Ewuradze, na odum besi ne he do ama Ewuradze.
Na ɔbɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze ɔnye dase ama dɔm Ewuradze wɔ Egypt asaase do, na wobosū akyerɛ Ewuradze wɔ ahyɛdofo no ntsi, na ɔgyefo ɔnye twitwagyefo abrɛ hon, na ɔabɛgye hɔn.
Na Ewuradze beyi noho akyerɛ Egypt, na Egyptfo Ewuradze wɔ da no mu; wɔdze afɔr ɔnye ayɛyɛdze bɔsom no, na wɔabɔ Ewuradze anohoba, na wɔayɛ.
Na Ewuradze bɔbɔ Egypt, ɔbɔbɔ hɔn na ɔayɛ hɔn edur; na wɔbɛsan aba Ewuradze nkyɛn, na obetsie hɔn ntotɔe na ɔayɛ hɔn edur.
Da no mu ɔtsempɔn kwan bɛda hɔ fi Egypt akɔ Assyria, na Assyrianyi aba Egypt, na Egyptnyi akɔ Assyria; na Egyptfo nye Assyriafo abɔ mu asom.
Da no mu na Israel bokua Egypt ɔnye Assyria ho otsīa ebiasa, ayɛ nhyira wɔ asaase finimfin:
Osiandɛ dɔm Ewuradze ehyira hɔn, dɛ, nhyira nkã me man Egypt, na me nsaano edwuma Assyria, na m'egyapadze Israel.
20: Afe a Tartan baa Ashdod, ber a Assyriahen Sargon somaa no, na ɔnye Ashdod bɔkõe na ɔfae no;
ber no mu nna Ewuradze nam Amoz ba Isaiah do kãa dɛ, kɔ, kɛpa eyitam no fi w’asen mu, na san mpaboa no fi w’anan. Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm dze adagyaw ɔnye anamɔnkwaa nantsewee.
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ m’akowaa Isaiah nam adagyaw ɔnye anamɔnkwaa ma ɔaayɛ ɔnye anwanwadze ama Egypt na Ethiopia mfensa yi;
dɛmara na Assyriahen bɛka Egyptfo ndɔmmumfo na Ethiopiafo amantufo akɔ, mbofra na mpanyin, adagyafo na anamɔnkwaafo a hɔn etū deda hɔ, ma Egypt enyi atõ.
Na hɔn bo botu na hon enyi atõ, wo hɔn enyidado Ethiopia ho, na hɔn enyimnyam Egypt ho.
Na nsuano kuromnyi no bɛkã wɔ da no mu dɛ, hwɛ, mbrɛ hɛn enyidado a yeguanee kɔdɔɔ hɔ dɛ wɔnkɛgye hɛn mfi Assyriahen nsamu tse nye yi: Na hɛndze, yɛyɛ dɛn fi nsa?
21: Po ho sar do atsɛmbusɛm. Dɛ ekyinehyia-mframa a ofi pomu afamu ɔbɔ ba no, ofi sar no do ba, ofi asaase a ɔyɛ hu do.
Enyido-adzehu a ɔyɛ awerɛhow na woeyi akyerɛ me; ɔkontompɔtwafo rutwa nkontompɔ, na afofafo refa afo. Elam, fow kɔ; Media, kɔ no ntuae; n’apensi nyina mama abɔ adze.
Dɛm ntsi na m’asen mu guan me yerɛyerɛw; ɔkyem akã me, dɛ ɔbaa awokofo kyɛm; ɔyɛ me yayaw ma menntse asɛm; mabɔ hu ara ma munnhu adze.
M’akoma tow pɛmpɛm ahodwiriw eyi mo hu: Ewimbir kan a mo kɔn dɔe adan ahopopo ama me.
Wɔto pon, wosi aweɔmfo, wodzidzi, wɔnom: Asafohen, hom nsoɛr, hom nsera kyɛm no ho.
Na mbre Ewuradze akã akyerɛ me nye yi, kɔ, fa aweɔmfo kegyina hɔ; ma ɔnkã dza ohu nkyerɛ:
Na sɛ ohu dɔm, mpɔnkɔdofo beenu beenu, nsoaso dɔm na efumpɔnkɔ dɔm a, ɔnkyɛn n’aso pɛnn ara ntsie.
Na ɔbɔɔ mu dɛ ogyata dɛ; Ewuradze, migyina aweɔnee aban do adzekyee, na misi m’atsɛwee anago nyina:
Na hwɛ, nyimpa dɔm mpoɔkɔdofo beenu beenu na wɔreba yi. Na obuae see dɛ, Babylon ahwe ase, ɔahwe ase; na n’abosom eguhonyi nyina ebubu egu famu.
Ao ɔwo m’aporowee, na m’aporoweebea do eburow: Dza matse wɔ dɔm Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn anomu na makã makyerɛ hom yi.
Dumah ho atsɛmbusɛm. Obi fi Seir bɔn mu se me dɛ, ɔweɔmfo, anago ber bɛn nye yi? Ɔweɔmfo, anago ber bɛn nye yi?
Ɔweɔmfo no see dɛ, orudu anapa, na adzesaa so reba; sɛ hom bebisa a, hom mbisa: Hom nsan, hom mbra.
Arabia ho atsɛmbusɛm. Dedanfo akwantufo kuw, kwaa a ɔwɔ Arabia no mu na hom bɔsoɛ.
Obi a osuk0m dzee no no, wɔbrɛɛ no nsu; Tema asaase do atsefo dze hɔn edziban behyiaa eguamfo no.
Osiandɛ mfõwa ano na wofi guanee, afõwa a wɔatwe, na egyen a wɔapon, na ɔkõ dzendzen ano a.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze akã akyerɛ me nye yi, afe kor mu, dɛ ɔpaanyi mfe, na Kedar enyimnyam nyina apa:
Na egyentofo hɔn dodow nkaa no, Kedarmba akatakyi no, hɔn ho bosuar: Na Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na ɔakã.
22: Enyido-Adzehu bɔnsa ho atsɛmbusɛm. Ebɛn yɛ wo na afei eguan akɔ adantsifi koraa yi?
Ɔwo a esebɔ ahyɛ wo mã, weɔɔweɔɔyɛ kurow, ahosɛpɛw man; w'atɔfoe wɔanntotɔ afõwa ano, eso woennwuwu wɔ akono.
Wo mpanyimfo nyina bɔɔ mu guanguanee kɔree, egyentofo no kyekyeer hɔn: Hɔn a ihun hɔn no nyina wɔkyekyeer hɔn, woguanee kɔr ekyirkyir.
Dɛm ntsi na mesee dɛ, hom nyi hom enyi mfi mo do, na munsū wenwenwen; mma hom mmper nnkyekye mo werɛ, wɔ me man babaa ne sɛɛe no ho.
Na ɔyɛ ɔkogu, na ntsiatsiado, na enyibɔ da a ofi Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze hɔ, wɔ enyido-adzehu bɔnsa no mu; ɔfasu no ndwuruwii na mbepɔw ho sufrɛ.
Na Elam kitsaa egyen-kotoku, ɔnye ntseaseanammufo na mpɔnkɔdofo; na Kir maa kyɛm no ho daa hɔ.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ntseaseanam yɛɛ wo mbɔnsa fɛfɛɛfɛw mu amaama na mpɔnkɔdofo totoo nkuropon no ano.
Na oyii Judah akataho no fii hɔ; na ehwɛɛ akodze a ɔwɔ kwaa mu fi no mu no da no.
Na hom hun Dayid kurow no ne mpaapae no, dɛ wɔayɛ pii: Na hom boaboaa ase nsutaae no no nsu ano.
Na hom kaan Jerusalem adan, na hom bubuu adan no dɛ hom dze rowowaw afasu no.
Hom yɛɛ korabea so wɔ afasu ebien no ntamu dze maa nsutaae dadaw no no nsu; naaso hom annhwɛ nyia no a ɔyɛɛ adze yi, eso hom emmbu nyia no a ɔhyehyɛɛ no dadaada no bi.
Na da no mu, Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze no, ɔmaa nsu, na ewuotwa, na etsipra, na eyitam fura bae:
Na hwɛ, enyigye na ahosɛpɛw, anantwi menetwa na nguan kum, namdzi ɔnye nsanom: Hom mma yendzidzi nnom, na ɔkyena yebowuwu.
Na dɔm Ewuradze yii noho kyerɛɛ m’aso dɛ, ampaara emumuyɛ yi wɔronnhor mmfi hom ho ma ekodu dɛ hom bowuwu, Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze no, na ɔse.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze no, se nye yi, kɔ fotosamfo Shebna yi a odzi ofi no do no nkyɛn kɛse dɛ,
ereyɛ dɛn wɔ ha? na woana na ewɔ no wɔ ha, na etwa asamandan wɔ ha yi? Irutwa asamandan ama no wɔ sor, irututu tsenabea ama no wɔ botan mu yi!
Hwɛ, Ewuradze bɔtow wo akyen enyiberdo dɛ ɔkatakyi, nyew, ɔbɛkata wo do munum.
Ampaara ɔbɛdandan wo atow wo sor dɛ etɔw akyen ekyirkyir asaase do: Hɔ na ibokowu, na hɔ na w'enyimnyam ntseaseanam bɔkɔ, ɔwo a ɛyɛ wo wura fie enyimguase.
Na mubosun wo efi wo dzibew, na obodwuruw wo efi wo gyinabea.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ mebɛfrɛ m’akowaa Eliakim, Hilkiah ba no:
Na medze w’atar no mahyɛ no, na medze w’abɔdo memia no, na medze w’ahendzi mpanyindzi mahyɛ ne nsa: Na ɔayɛ egya ama Jerusalem atsefo, na Judah fi.
Na medze Dayid fie saafee bɔto ne batsir; obobue, na obi nnkɔtow mu; na ɔbɔtow mu, na obi bokobue.
Na mebɛpaa no do dɛ prɛgow a ɔwɔ mbrɛ hɔ yɛ dzen, na ɔbɛyɛ enyimnyam ahengua ama n’egya fie.
Na wɔdze n'egya fie enyimnyam nyina bɛsensɛn no do, n’asefo ɔnye hɔn a wofi no mu nyina, kuraba ketseaba biara, ofi kukuwa do kesi asahina do.
Da no mu, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, prɛgow a wɔdze bɔɔ mbrɛ hɔ yɛ dzen no bɔhɔr; na woetwa ma ɔato famu, na adzesoa a ɔsensɛn do no atsew atɔ; na Ewuradze na ɔakã.
23: Tyre ho atsɛmbusɛm. Hom ntwa ewuo, Tarshish ahɛn; osiandɛ wɔayɛ no afõ ma ofi nnyi mu bio, obi nnhɛn mu bio; wofi Kittim asaase do eyi akyerɛ hɔn.
Hom mpoanofo, hom ntaa dzinn; ɔwo a Zidon eguadzifo a wotwa po no wɔama ahyɛ mã.
Na wɔnam esu akɛse do dze Shihor aba, Nile ho ndɔbaa, nyaa hɔn amandze; na ɔyɛɛ amanaman guadzibea.
Ao Zidon, ma w’enyi ntõ: Na po, po mu abankɛse no, akasa dɛ, monnkõo awoo, na monnwoo mba, eso mennyɛɛn mberantsɛ, na menntsetsee mbaabun.
Sɛ asɛm no kodu Egypt a, wobedzi yaw wɔ Tyre ho.
Hom ntwa nkɔ Tarshish; hom mpoanofo, hom ntwa ewuo.
Ana hom enyigye kurow a ofi tsetse bɔbɔɔ adze, n’anan dze no dɔɔ mu kɔr ekyirkyir kɛtsenae no nye yi?
Woana abɔ ne tsirmpɔw yi etsia Tyre, ahenhyɛ kurow a n’eguadzifo yɛ mbapɔmba, na n’abatafo yɛ asaase do enyimnyamfo no?
Dɔm Ewuradze abɔ ne tsirmpɔw dɛ obogu enyimnyam nyina ahopɔw ho fi, ma ɔdze asaase do enyimnyamfo nyina aba enyimguase mu.
Tarshish babaa, kotwa mu wɔ w’asaase do dɛ Nile; abɔdo biara mmbɔ wo do bio.
Ɔatsen ne nsa wɔ po do, ɔawosow nhenman: Ewuradze ahyɛ Canaan ho mbra, dɛ wɔnsɛɛ n’aban kɛse.
Na ɔkãa dɛ, erennda ho nndzi eburusi bio, ɔwo Zidon ba ɔbaabun a woehiahia wo ho: Soɛr, kotwa kɔ Kittim; hɔ so mpo irinnya ahomgye.
Hwɛ, Chaldeafo asaase; ɔman yi wonnyi hɔ bio; Assyrianyi no kyekyeree maa sar do mbowa: Wosisii hɔn abantsentsen, wodwuruuw n’ahemfi; ɔmaa ɔyɛɛ amamfõ.
Hom ntwa ewuo, Tarshish ahɛn, na hom akoban ayɛ afoõ.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no mu werɛ befir Tyre mfe eduosuon, dɛ mbrɛ ohen kor nda tse: Na mfe eduosuon ewiei no wɔbɛyɛ Tyre dɛ edwaman no no ndwom no.
Fa sanku kyin kurow no mu, edwaman a werɛ efir wo; bɔ sanku dɛɛdɛw, tow ndwom pii, ama wɔaakaa wo.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, mfe eduosuon ewiei no, Ewuradze bɛserɛɛ Tyre, na ɔasan enya n’apaadze, na ɔnye wiadze ahendzi horow a ɔwɔ asaase enyi nyina agor ndwamangor.
Na n'eguadze ɔnye n'apaadze bɛyɛ krɔnkrɔndze ama Ewuradze: Wɔrommbɔ no kokora, eso worinntsia; na n’eguadze bɛyɛ hɔn a wɔtse Ewuradze enyim no dze, na woedzi amee, na wɔayɛ efuradze a ɔkyɛr.
24: Hwɛ, Ewuradze reyɛ asaase no pan, na ɔama ɔayɛ afõ na ɔadan no ebutuw, na ɔabɔ no do atsefo no apetse.

Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ ɔman no tse no, mbrɛ ɔsɔfo tse ara nye no; mbrɛ akowaa tse no, mbrɛ no wura tse ara nye no; mbrɛ afonabaa tse no, mbrɛ no wuraba tse ara nye no; mbrɛ ɔtɔfo tse no, mbrɛ ɔtɔmfo tse ara nye no; mbrɛ ɔdzefɛmfo tse no, mbrɛ ɔdzefirfo tse ara nye no; mbrɛ nsihogyefo tse no, mbre nsihomafo tse ara nye no.
Asaase no wɔbɔto no pan koraa na wɔafa no afo koraa: Na Ewuradze na ɔakã asɛm yi.
Asaase ridzi mmɔn, na oenyam, wiadze abotow na oenyam, asaase do ekrompomfo enyinyam.
Asaase so aprɔw wɔ no do atsefo ase; osiandɛ woetsiatsia mbra no do, wɔasakyer ahyɛdze no, wɔatõ daa ahyɛmu no.
Dɛm ntsi na ndom no amen asaase no; na no do atsefo woebu hɔn fɔ: Dɛm ntsi na asaase no do atsefo no ahyew woegya nyimpa kakrabaabi yi!
Nsã fofor ridzi mmɔn, wenyindua enyam, akomamu enyigyefo risi nkrum.
Mpintsin ehurusidzi egyaa, ahosɛpɛwfo dede abɔ adze, sanku enyigye egyaa.
Wɔnnkɛfa adwontow anom nsa nsã dzendzen bɛYɛ wen ama hɔn a wɔnom.
Woedwuruw asakrabutuw kurow no: Wɔatow ofi biara mu, amma obiara aannkɔ mu.
Osū wɔ mbɔntsen do wɔ wenyin ntsi; enyigye nyina ahyɛ sum, asaase no do ehurusidzi etu kɔ.
Kurow no mu dza ɔaka nye amamfoyɛ, wɔdze ɔsɛɛ abɔ kuropon no.
Na dɛm na ɔbɛba asaase do wɔ aman mu, dɛ ngodua no wosow, dɛ wenyin abatsew ekyir mpɛpɛwdzi.
Woyi na wɔbɛma hɔn naze do abɔ ose: Ewuradze akɛseyɛ ntsi wofi po afamu bɛtsēatsea mu.
Dɛm ntsi hom nhyɛ Ewuradze enyimnyam wɔ boka, mekyerɛ Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn ne dzin no, wɔ po nsupɔw mu.
Ofi asaase ano noho na yɛatse ndwom, ɔtseneneenyi n’enyimnyam no. Na mekãa dɛ, morofɔn, morofɔn, mundue! Nkontompɔtwafo etwa nkontompɔ; nyew, nkontompɔtwafo etwa nkontompɔ paara.
Osuro, na maa no, na efir no, da wo do, ɔwo asaase do tsefo.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ nyia oruguan osuro ne nka no, ɔbɔtɔ maa no mu; na nyia obefi maa no mu epue no, efir no bɛpa no: Na woebuebue ɔsor ntokura na asaase fapem rowosow.
Asaase edwuruw koraa, asaase anan krɔngyenn, asaase ehim mbordo.
Asaase bɔto ntentan dɛ ɔsãbofo, na oehimahima dɛ suaba; na ne mbrato bɛyɛ no do dur, na ɔahwe ase a, ɔronnsoɛr bio.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ Ewuradze bɛtsēa sor dɔm wɔ sor, na asaase ahemfo wɔ famu.
Na wɔaboaboa hɔn ano, dɛ mbrɛ wɔboaboa mpokyerɛfo ano wɔ maa no mu, na wɔatow hɔn efiadze mu, na nda pii ekyir no wɔakɔ akɛsera hɔn.
Ɔno na bosoom enyim bogu ase, na ewia enyi atõ; osiandɛ dɔm Ewuradze bedzi hen wɔ Zion bepɔw do, na Jerusalem, na ne tsetsefo enyim enyimnyam mu.
25: Ewuradze, ɔwo nye me Nyankopɔn; mubohuhor wo, mibeyi wo dzin ayɛw; na ɔwo na ayɛ anwanwadze apam dadaw wɔ ɔsɛnkordzi na nokwar mu no a.
Na ɔwo na ayɛ kurow ndamfo; kurow ndamfo; kurow a wɔbɔ ho ban ayɛ kurofo, ananaben aban annyɛ kurow bi; wɔronntow dabiarada.
Dɛm ntsi na ɔman a ɔyɛ dzen bɛhyɛ wo enyimnyam, amanaman a hɔn ho yɛ hu kurow no bosuro wo.
Osiandɛ ɔwo ayɛ akoban ama ɔbɔbɔnyi, akoban ama ohianyi wɔ n'ahohia mu, ehum ano guandɔbew, ɔhyew mu nwinwin, ber a ahoɔhufo no ehuhuw ayɛ dɛ ehum a ɔbor fasu.
Ɔwo bɛbrɛ ananaben weɔɔweɔɔyɛ no adze dɛ ahohur wɔ bea kwawee do; wɔbɛbrɛ ahoɔhufo adwontow adze dɛ nsuwusiw nwinwin ase ahohur.
Na bepɔw yi do na dɔm Ewuradze bɔto aman nyina pon: Edziban a angoa wɔ mu, wenyin a ɔagyen atɔ mu, angoadze a ehuor ma, wenyin a ɔagyen atɔ mu a wɔasɔn do krɔnn.
Na bepɔw yi do na ɔbɛsɛɛ akatado a ɔkata aman nyina do no enyim; na akataenyim a wɔatserɛw no amanaman nyina do no.
Ɔamen owu daa; na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn bɛpepa enyi nyina ho nyinsuwa; na oeyi ne man ahorohoraa efi asaase nyina do akɔ: Na Ewuradze na ɔakã.
Na wɔbɛkã wɔ da no mu dɛ, hwɛ, hɛn Nyankopɔn nye yi; yɛatweɔn no, na ɔbɛgye hɛn nkwa: Ewuradze nye yi; yɛatweɔn no, hɛn enyi bɛgye na yeedzi ehurusi wɔ no nkwagye no mu.
Na bepɔw yi do na Ewuradze nsa bɛda, na wobetsiatsia Moab do wɔ n’afamu, dɛ mbrɛ wotsiatsia nkyɛkyɛr do wɔ suminado nsu mu.
Na ɔbɛtserɛw ne nsamu wɔ hon finimfin, dɛ mbrɛ nyia ɔrobor tserɛw ne nsamu bor: Na ɔbɛbrɛ no nkontompɔ no adze ɔnye ne nsaano edwin no nyina.
Na w’aban dzendzen afasu a ɔkrɔn no ɔbɛbrɛ no adze, edwuruw no, na ɔama aka famu, ma adan huntuma mpo.
26: Da no mu na wɔbɔtow ndwom yi wɔ Judah asaase do dɛ: Yɛwɔ kurow a ɔyɛ dzen; ɔdze nkwagye bɛyɛ afasu na ntuae ban.
Hom mbuebue aponkɛse no, ma ɔman tsenenee a odzi nokwar no nhɛn mu.
Nyia n’adwen etsim wo do no, ebɔkora no asomdwee a odzi mu mu: Osiandɛ ɔdze no werɛ hyɛ wo mu.
Hom ntwer Ewuradze daa daa: Na Ewuradze Jehovah mu na ɔdomankoma ɔbotantsim wɔ.
Na ɔdze hɔn a wɔtsetse sor, kurow a ɔkrɔn no, aba daadze: Ɔbrɛ no adze, ɔbrɛ no adze kɛka famu mpo; ɔma ɔkã huntuma mpo.
Anan betsiatsia do, ɔbɔbɔfo anan, ohianyi anamɔn no.
Pɛrpɛr kwan yɛ tɔɔtsennyɛ; ɔwo a eyɛ tɔɔtsenn na ekyerɛ pɛrpɛrnyi no kwantsempɔn.
Ɛhɛɛ, w’atsɛmbu kwan do, Ewuradze, na yɛahwe wo kwan: Hɛn kra akɔndɔ gyina wo dzin ɔnye wo nkaa do.
Me kra na medze mafe wo anago; nyew, mo sunsum a ɔwɔ mo mu na medze mobɔhwehwɛ wo ahema: Na sɛ w’atsɛmbu ba asaase do a, wiadzemba bosūa ndzeyɛtsenenee.
Wɔyɛ omumuyɛnyi yie dɛn ara a, onnsūa ndzeyɛtsenenee; tɔɔtsennyɛ asaase do na odzi afomfonsɛm, na onnhu Ewuradze no tumdzi.
Ewuradze, ama wo nsa do, naaso wonnhu; na wobohu wo mbɔdzembɔ wɔ wo man ho, na hɔn enyi atõ: Nyew, ogya bɛhyew w’atamfo.
Ewuradze, ɔwoara bɛhyehyɛ asomdwee ama hɛn: Na ɔwoara na edzi hɛn dwuma nyina so ama hɛn.
Ewuradze, hɛn Nyankopɔn, ewuranom bi so edzi hɛn do tum akã wo ho; na ɔwo nko wo do na yɛnam bɔbɔ wo dzin.
Woewuwu, wɔnnkɛtsena ase; wɔakeka beebi, wɔronnsoɛr: Dɛm ntsi na asera hɔn na asɛɛ hɔn, na ama hɔn ho nkaa nyina ahera.
Ama ɔman no adɔr, Ewuradze, ama ɔman no adɔr; wɔahyɛ wo enyimnyam: Atrɛ asaase no n'ahe nyinara mu.
Ewuradze, ahohia mu na wɔabɛsera wo, wo ntsēa baa hɔn do no, na wɔworaa mpaayi.
Dɛ mbrɛ ɔpemfo a ɔrebɛn n’awoo odzi yaw na ɔkeka mu wɔ n’awoko mu no; mbrɛ yɛayɛ wɔ w’enyim ara nye no, Ewuradze.
Yeenyinsen, yeedzi yaw, ɔyɛ dɛ yeawo mframa; yɛannyɛ ɔgye bi ho edwuma wɔ asaase do; eso wiadze do atsefo nnhwehwe ase.
W’ewufo bɛtsena ase; m’efun bɔsoɛr. Hom a hom tse huntuma mu, hom nnyan ntow ndwom: Na wo bɔsu tse dɛ mfuwa ɔbɔsu, na asaase beyi n’ewufo egu.
Me man, hom mbra, hom mbɛhɛn hom adankyir mu, na hom ntotow homho mbobow mu: Hom nhuntsa ber kakra, ma onkodu dɛ ebufuhyew no etwa mu kɔ.
Na hwɛ, Ewuradze fi ne tsebea rifir edzi abɛtsēa asaase do atsefo wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi: Asaase so bɛda no bɔgyaa edzi, na ɔrennkata n’atɔfoe do bio.
27: Da no mu na Ewuradze dze n’afõwa kɛse dzendzen ndam ndam no bɛtsēa leyiathan ɔwɔ ɔhoɔharfo no, na leyiathan ɔwɔ mpomponee no; na oeku dragon a ɔwɔ po mu no.
Da no mu: Nsã wenyin ture, hom ntow ho ndwom.
Emi mara Ewuradze na mohwɛ do; mugugu do nsu aber nyina: Mohwɛ do adzesaa na adzekyee ma biribi aansɛɛ no.
Abohur nnyi mo mu: Sɛ nkɔkrɔw na nsoɛ nye me ridzi esi wɔ akono a, nkyɛ mobɔbɔ afa hɔn do; mahyew hɔn nyina.
Annyɛ dɛm a wɔmma onsuo m’ahoɔdzen mu, na ɔnye me nsiesie; nyew, ɔnye me nsiesie.
Nda a ɔreba no mu, Jacob bɛgye ndwow; Israel bɔbɔ nhyiren abɔ nkukuduuduw: Na wɔdze aba ahyɛ wiadze enyi mã.
Ana ɔabɔ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ hɔn a wɔbɔɔ no no? Anaadɛ aso woeku no dɛ hɔn a okunkum hɔn no hɔn kum no?
Nsusui mu sɛ iyi no edzi a, enye no dzi aper; ɔdze aahow dzendzen eyi hɔn efi hɔ wɔ boka mframa da no mu.
Dɛm ntsi iyi na wɔdze bɔhor Jacob emumuyɛ; na no bɔnyi no ho aba nyina nye yi; aber a oenya ayɛ afɔrmbukyia abo no nyina dɛ kaadow-bo a wɔabor efurufuruw, ma Asherim na ewiaehonyi ronnsoɛr bio no.
Na kurow a wɔagye ho ban no aka no nko ayɛ tsenabea a woetu do na wɔadan egya dɛ sar do; hɔ na nantwiba no bedzidzi, na hɔ na obobutuw ewie n’abaw no we.
Sɛ no ndubaa no guan a, wobobu akyen; mbaa bɛba abɛfa hɔn asɔ gya: Na wɔyɛ ɔman a wonnyi ntseasee; dɛm ntsi nyia ɔyɛɛ hɔn no ne yamu rennhyehye no mma hɔn, na nyia ɔween hɔn no runnhu hɔn mbɔbɔr.
Na ɔbɛba da no mu dɛ Ewuradze bɔporow n’aba efi esutsen no ne yir ho ekesi Egypt ɔwora no ho, na wɔatase hom nkorkor, ao Israelmba.

Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ wɔbɔbɔ akasamu kɛse bi mu; na hɔn a aka dɛ nkyɛ wɔhera wɔ Assyria asaase do, na hɔn a wɔyɛ tokyemfo wɔ Egypt asaase do no aba; na wɔbɔsɔr Ewuradze wɔ bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do wɔ Jerusalem.
28: Ephraim asabokwafo ahopɔw abɔtsir ndue, na n’ahoɔfɛw enyimnyam nhyiren a ɔromonsom no a ɔwɔ hɔn a nsã ato hɔn ntentan wɔ hɔn angoa bɔnsa no etsifi no!
Hwɛ, Ewuradze wɔ ahoɔdzenfo na ɔkatakyi bi; ɔtse dɛ ɔsorbo a orugu, ehum a ɔsɛɛ, dɛ esu dzendzen a oeyir repram n’ehum, na ɔdze nsa bɛka egu famu.
Ephraim asabokwafo ahopɔw abɔtsir wobetsiatsia do wɔ ananadze
na n’ahoɔfɛw enyimnyam nhyiren a amonsom no a ɔwɔ angoa bɔnsa no etsifi no, ɔbɛyɛ dɛ adɔmba a odzi kan ber ansaana ɔpɛber edur a obiara a ohu no, ne nsa ka ara a, na oewie dzi.
Da no mu na dɔm Ewuradze bɛyɛ enyimnyam abɔtsir na aboɔfɛw ahenkyɛw ama ne man nkaa no.
Ɔnye atsɛmbu sunsum ama onyia no a ɔatsena rubu atsɛn no, na ahoɔdzen ama hɔn a wɔdan ɔkõ kɔ kuropon ano no.

Na woyinom so wɔnam nsã do ato ntentan, wɔnam nsadzen do wɔatɔ dɔnsuar; ɔsɔfo na nkɔnhyɛnyi wɔnam nsadzen do ato ntentan, nsã amen hɔn, nsadzen ama wɔatɔ dɔnsuar, wɔfom wɔ enyidoadzehu mu, wofintsiw wɔ atsɛmbu mu.
Na fe ɔnye fi ayeyɛ edzidzipon nyina do mã, ma bea biara do nntsew.
Woana na ɔbɛkyerɛ no nyimdzee? Na woana na ɔbɛma ɔatse amandzɛɛ no ase? Hɔn a woetwa hɔn enumfo, na wɔatsew hɔn efi numfo ano no a?
Na ahyɛdze tsia ahyɛdze, ahyɛdze tsia ahyɛdze; nsensaneeba tsia nsensaneeba, nsensaneeba tsia nsensaneeba; ha kakra, hɔ kakra.
Dabida, mbom apɔtɔfo ano ɔnye gyirama fofor na ɔdze bɛkasa akyerɛ ɔman yi:
Hɔn a ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ahomgye nye yi, hom mma nyia ɔaberɛ ahomgye; na ahotɔ nye yi: Naaso wɔammpɛ dɛ wotsie.

Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze asɛm bɛyɛ hɛn ahyɛdze tsia ahyɛdze, ahyɛdze tsia ahyɛdze; nsensaneeba tsia nsensaneeba, nsensaneeba tsia nsensaneeba; ha kakra, ho kakra; ma wɔaako na woeekotutu ahwe hɔn ekyir, na woeebubu, na wɔaatotɔ mfir mu, na wɔaakyer hɔn.
Dɛm ntsi hom ntsie Ewuradze asɛm, hom atwetwesifo a hom dzi ɔman yi a ɔwɔ Jerusalem do mpanyin:
Osiandɛ hom akã dɛ, yɛnye owu edzi ahyɛmu, na yɛnye Sheol edzi esie; mbusu a ɔpram do no, sɛ orutwa mu a ɔrennkã hɛn; osiandɛ yɛdze atofosɛm ayɛ hɛn guandɔbew, na akɔhwisɛm ase na yehuntsa hɛnho:
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn se nye yi, hwɛ, medze ɔbo bi mato fapem wɔ Zion, ɔbɔ a wɔasɔ ahwɛ, kutuwdo-bo a ɔsom bo a wɔato no fapem pintsinn: Nyia ɔgye dzi no ɔremmpɛ ntsɛm.
Na medze atsɛmbu no bɛyɛ susuhoma, na medze tsenenee ayɛ promo; na ɔsorbo no bɛpra ator guandɔbew no nyina akɔ, na esu no apram huntsabea no do.
Na hom nye owu ntamu ahyɛmu no wɔbɛtsetsew mu, na hom nye Sheol edziesie no rinngyina; sɛ mbusu a ɔpram do no rutwa mu a, obetsiatsia hom do.
Mpɛn dodow a orutwa mu no, ɔbɛfa hom: Na anapa anapa na obotwa mu, adzekyee na adzesaa: Na amandzɛɛ no ne ntseasee bɛyɛ bu ara nko.
Na mpa no yɛ tsia dɛ obi bɛtsen no ho ato do; na akatado tam no ɔyɛ heahea dɛ obi dze bobua no do.
Na Ewuradze bɔsoɛr dɛ bepɔw Perazim do dze no, no bo bofuw dɛ Gibeon bɔnsa mu dze no: Ama ɔaayɛ n’edwuma, n’anwanwa dwuma no, na ɔaayɛ ne nyɛe no, ne nyee nwanwa no.
Afei dɛm ntsi mma hom nnyɛ atwetwesifo, ma hom nkyehoma aannyɛ dzen; na ɔsɛɛ pasapasa a woesua ato hɔ na matse no wɔ Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze no hɔ, dɛ ɔreba asaase nyina do.
Hom nyɛ aso na hom ntsie me ndze, hom nkyɛn aso na hom ntsie me kasaa.
Ana daa nyina na ofuntumfo funtum dɛ orudua? Anaa daa nyina na otutu n’asaase enyi, ɔbobɔ no do nkotowa?
Sɛ ɔyɛ enyi dɛfɛɛ a, ana ɔmmpe mē na ɔmmpetse cummin, na onndua ewifua akyerɛpɛn akyerɛpɛn, ɔnye atoko wɔ mbrɛ wɔahyɛ, ɔnye ewi wɔ ano ano?
Na ne Nyame kyerɛ no n’enyiwado, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ no.
Na wɔmmfa porowdze ndam ndam mmporow mē, eso wɔnndan tseaseanam a nan mmfa cummin do; na wɔdze aborbaa bor mē, na wɔdze poma bor cummin.
Wɔdwow edziban eburow; na ɔnnkɛda ho aporow no daapem: Na kaansa ne ntseaseanam anan na no mpɔnkɔ na wɔpē mpo a, ɔnndwow.
Iyi so fi dɔm Ewuradze hɔ ba, apam mu ɔnwanwanyi, na nyansa mu abɔso.
29: Due, Ariel, Ariel, kurow a Dayid kyeer mu nsera no! Hom mfa afe nka afe ho; hom mma afahyɛ mbɔ aprɔw mbra:
Nna mebɛma Ariel ho akyer no, na nkɔmbɔdzi ɔnye sukwadwom aba hɔ: Na ɔayɛ dɛ Ariel ama ne.
Na mebɛkyer nsera etwa wo ho kɔntɔnkrɔn, na medze aban abɔ wo ho kɔntɔnkrɔn, na medze aban abɔ wo ho dantaban, na mahohɔr pempe esiw wo kwan.
Na wɔbɛbrɛ wo adze, na efi famu akasa na wo kasaa efi huntuma mu ayɛ huhuhuhu; na wo ndze bɛyɛ dɛ ɔsamamfrɛfo ndze efi famu, na wo kasaa efi huntuma mu awasa.
Na w’atamfo dodow bɛyɛ dɛ huntuma wekoweko, na ahoɔhufo dodow no bɛyɛ dɛ ntsɛw a ɔresen kɔ: Ɛhɛɛ, ɔbɛba dɛm amonmu awerɛfir mu.
Dɔm Ewuradze dze ɔsenaman, na asaase-wosow, na dede kɛse, na ekyinehyia-mframa, na ehum, na ogya a ɔmemen ne gyaframee bɛba abɛsera no.
Na amanaman nyina a wɔnye Ariel dzii akõ hɔn nyimpadodow, hɔn a wɔnye ɔno na n’akoban kõ, na wɔma no ho kyer no nyina, wɔbɛyɛ dɛ adaaso, anago enyido-adzehu.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ mbrɛ nyia ɔkɔm dze no sõ daa, na, hwɛ, oridzidzi; na onyan, na ne kra da pan no: Anaadɛ mbrɛ nyia nsukɔm dze no sõ daa, na hwɛ, ɔronom; na onyan, na hwɛ, ɔtɔ bitsi, na ne kra kɔn dɔ nsu ara no: Dɛmara na amanaman mu nyimpadodow nyinara a wɔnye bepɔw Zion dzi akõ no, wɔbɛyɛ.
Hom nkyinkyim, na ɔnyɛ hom nwanwa; hom enyi ngye na hom mfura hom enyi: Wɔabobow, na nnyɛ nsã ntsi a; wɔto ntentan, na nnyɛ nsadzen ntsi a.
Na Ewuradze na oehue nda heii sunsum egu hom do, na oemuamua hom enyi, nkɔnhyɛfo no; na hom etsir, adzehufo no, ɔakata hɔn do.
Na enyido-adzehu nyina ayɛ hom dɛ nwoma a wɔasɔw ano mu nkyerɛwee a adasa dze ma nyia onyim nwoma dɛ, meserɛ wo, kenkan yi: Na ɔkã dɛ, murunntum, osiandɛ wɔasɔw ano:
Na wɔdze nwoma no maa nyia onnyim nwoma dɛ, meserɛ wo, kenkan yi: Na ɔkã dɛ, minnyim nwoma.

Na Ewuradze see dɛ, susuampa dɛ ɔman yi twe bɛn me, na wɔdze hɔn ano ɔnye hɔn anofamfa dzi me nyi, na hɔn akoma dze woeyi efi me nkyɛn kɔ ekyirkyir, na hɔn suro a wosuro me yɛ nyimpa ahyɛdze a wɔdze akyerɛkyerɛ hɔn no:
Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, mobɔwɔw do mayɛ ahobowdze wɔ ɔman yi mu, ahobowdze ɔnye anwanwadze bi a: Na hɔn enyansafo nyansaa no ahera, na hɔn abadwembafo ntseasee ehuntsa hɔn.
Wondue, hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ dɛ wɔdze hɔn apam huntsa Ewuradze fee, na hɔn edwuma wo sum mu na wɔkã dɛ, woana na ohu hɛn? Na woana na na onyim hɛn?
Hom si ndzɛmba tsir adze! Aso wobobu ɔwemfo dɛ awendɛtse; adze a wɔyɛe no bɛse nyia ɔyɛɛ no no dɛ, nnyɛ ɔno yɛɛ me; anaa dza wɔahyehyɛ bɛse nyia ɔhyehyɛɛ dɛ, innyim dze?
Ana ɔnnka kakra bi ma Lebanon adan mfuwa prɔmprɔm, na mfuwa prɔmprɔm no woebu no dɛ kwaa?
Na da no mu na etsitsifo bɛtse nwoma mu asɛm no, na efurafo enyi efi kusukusuyɛ na sum no mu ehu adze.
Abrɛfo so bɛma hɔn enyigye adɔɔ sõ wɔ Ewuradze mu, na adasa mu ehiafo asɛpɛw hɔnho wɔ Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no mu.
Na ɔhoɔhufo no ayɛ kwa, na ɔtwetwesifo egyaa, na hɔn a wɔtsɛw emumuyɛ nyina woetwa hɔn akyen:
Hɔn asɛndzii mu wɔma nyimpa yɛ mbratonyi, na wosua nyia ɔkã enyim wɔ kuropon ano efir, na wɔdze nsɛnhuhuw dan ɔtseneneenyi fa nkyɛn.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze a ɔpoon Abraham no ɔkã wɔ Jacob fifo ho nye yi: Afei Jacob enyi ronntõ, eso n’enyim ronntow fitaa bio.
Na sɛ ohu ne mba a, ne nsaano edwuma wɔ no mu a, wɔbɛtsew me dzin ho; nyew, wɔbɛtsew Jacob Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ho, na wɔabɔ hu wɔ Israel Nyankopɔn ho.
Hɔn a wɔfomfom wɔ sunsum mu so benya ntseasee, na ehwinhwimfo bosūa nkyerɛkyerɛ.
30: Mba etuatsewfo a wɔgye apam, na ommfi mo hɔ, wondue, Ewuradze na ɔse; na wɔdze ebuado bua do, na ommfir mo sunsum, ama wɔdze bɔn aaka bɔn ho:
Hɔn a wotsia anamɔn kɔ Egypt, na wommbisa m’anomu; dɛ wɔrɛkɛhyɛ hɔnho dzen wɔ Pharaoh ahoɔdzen mu, na wɔdze hɔn werɛ kɛhyɛ Egypt nwinwin mu!
Dɛm ntsi Pharaoh ahoɔdzen bɛhyɛ hom fɛr, na Egypt nwinwin mu awerɛ hyɛmu ayɛ hom enyimguase.
Na ne mbapɔmba wɔ Zoan, na ahembɔfo edu Hanes.
Hɔn nyinara enyi bɔtõ ɔman a worunntum nnyɛ hɔn mfaso bi, wɔnnyɛ mboa anaa mfaso biara, na mbom enyimguase, ɔnye ahorohoraa ara so no ho.
