Pomu afamu mbowa ho atsɛmbusɛm. Wɔnam ɔfona na ahoguan asaase no do, mbrɛ ogyataber na ogyatanyin, enurutsia na ogya ɔwɔ a otu fir ba no, na wɔdzedze hɔn ahonya gugu nsoasomba abatsir, na wɔdze hɔn akoradze atoto efumpɔnkɔ ekyir efu no do, dze rekɛma ɔman a wɔrennyɛ hoɔ mfaso no.
Na Egypt ma mboa kwa, na ɔmmfa nnsi beebi: Dɛm ntsi na mafrɛ no Rahab a ɔtse hɔ dzinn no.
Afei kɔ, kyerɛw no wɔ pon do wɔ hɔn enyim, na krukye no wɔ nwoma mu, ama ɔaako hɔ ekesi mber a ɔreba afebɔɔ.
Na wɔyɛ ɔman etuatsewfo, mba atorfo, mba a wɔmmpɛ dɛ wotsie Ewuradze mbra no:
Hɔn a wɔse adzehufo dɛ, mma hom nnhu adze; na wɔse nkɔnhyɛfo dɛ, mma hom nnhyɛ dza ɔtsen ho nkɔm nkyerɛ hɛn, hom nkã hɛn adɛfɛdɛfesɛm, hom nhyɛ ndaadaasɛm ho nkɔm:
Hom mfi ɔtsempɔn no mu, hom nyi ɔkwan no akwa, hom mma Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ngyaa hɛn enyim gyina.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no se nye yi, osiandɛ hom bu asɛm yi tootooba, na hom twer ahyɛdo ɔnye akɔnkyew, na hom dze homho wowaw no no;
dɛm ntsi emumuyɛ yi bɛyɛ hom dɛ mpaapae a ɔrohwe ase a ɔwɔ ɔfasu a ɔkrɔn a oepuhuw mu a no bu ba awerɛfir mu amonmu.
Na obobubu no dɛ mbrɛ wɔbobɔ ɔwemfo sɛn a wɔbobɔ no posoposo dɛ bi nnka; amma wonnya n’esinesin mu efɛr a wɔdze suo mbukyia mu ogya, anaa wɔdze saw supi mu nsu.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no, see nye yi, ɔsan-ba na ahomgye mu na wɔbeɛye hom nkwa; kommyɛ na awerɛhyɛmu mu na hom ahoɔdzen befir: Na hom ammpɛ.
Mbom hom see dɛ, oho, na yɛbɛtsena mpɔnko do eguan; ntsi eguan ara na hom boguan: Na, yɛbɛtsena mbowa ahoɔharfo do akɔ; dɛm ntsi hɔn a wotsiw hom no ho bɛyɛ har.
Apem boguan ɔbaakofo mpuw ano; beenu mpuw ano na hom boguan: Ma ekodu dɛ hom bɛka dɛ bepɔw etsifi nkaabɔ gya, na frankaa a osi koko do.
Dɛm ntsi na Ewuradze bɔtweɔn, ama ɔaayɛ adom ama hom, dɛm ntsi na wɔbɛma no do, ama oeehu nom mbɔbɔr: Na Ewuradze yɛ atsɛmbu Nyankopɔn; esiarfo nye hɔn a wɔtweɔn no nyinara.
Na ɔman no bɛtsena Zion wɔ Jerusalem: Ɔwo innkosū ara bio; ɔnam wo nkekamu ndze no do ɔbɔdom wo ara ampa; sɛ ɔtse a, ɔbɛgye wo do.
Na Ewuradze bɛma hom amandzehu edziban na ahohiahia nsu dze, naaso w'akyerɛkyerɛfo remmfa hon ho nnhuntsa bio, na w’enyiwa bohu w'akyerɛkyerɛfo:
Na w'asowa bɛtse w'ekyir asɛm, dɛ, ɔkwan no nye yi, hom nnantsew mu; sɛ hom dze fa hom nsa nyimfa, na sɛ hom dze fa hom abankum a.
Na hom bogu wo dwetɛ kyerɛw-ehonyi nduraho, ɔnye wo sika egu-ehonyi nkataho no ho fi: Ebɔtow hɔn egu dɛ adze a no ho nntsew; ebɛse no dɛ, Fi ha fir.
Na ɔbɔtɔ nsu egu w’aba a edze bodua famu no do; na ɔama asaase ndɔbaa edziban, na ɔayɛ sɔɔsɔɔ bafuu: Da no mu na w’anyɛmbowa bedzidzi edzidzibea a ɔtserɛw do.
Anantwi no so ɔnye asoasomba a wɔyɛ asaase mu edwuma no, wɔbɔwe efuw pa a wɔdze sofi ɔnye apaawa apo do.
Na bepɔw sorɔnsorɔm biara do, na koko a ɔkrɔn biara do, nna nsutsen na esu a ɔworawora bɛpem, wɔ oku kɛse da no mu a abantsentsen bɔhwehwe ase no.
Nkyii so bosoom ne kan bɛyɛ dɛ ewia ne kan, na ewia ne kan ayɛ mbɔho esuon, dɛ ndaesuon ne kan, wɔ da a Ewuradze bɛkyekyer ne man ne pira, na ɔasa hɔn mbaa ano kur no.
Hwɛ, Ewuradze ne dzin fir ekyirkyir reba, n’ebufuw redzɛw, na orupun wusiw kumbɔɔ: N’anomu ahyɛ ebufuhyew mã, na ne tɛkyerɛma tse dɛ ogya a ɔhyew adze:
Na n'ahom tse dɛ esu a oeyir kã kɔn mpo, dɛ ɔdze egyangyandze sɔnee bɔsɔn amanaman do: Na menyamfrɛ a ɔma akwamfom bɛda aman adadaw mu.
Hom benya ndwom dɛ anago a wodzi afahyɛ krɔnkrɔn; na akoma mu enyigye, dɛ obi nam atɛntɛbɛn ano rokɔ Ewuradze bepɔw do, wɔ Israel Botan no nkyɛn.
Na Ewuradze bɛma wɔatse n’enyimnyam ndze no, na ɔakyerɛ ne nsa ne sian, nye n’ebufuw ne hyeehyew, na ogya a ɔhyew adze ne gyaframee, ɔnye ehuw, na ehum, na ɔsorabo.
Na ɔnam Ewuradze ne ndze do na Assynanyi a ɔdze abaa hwe no, wobubu no mu esinesin.
Na hyɛber poma biara a Ewuradze dze besi no do no, wɔbɛka no mpintsin na asanku: Na ɔwosow akodzi mu na ɔnye hɔn bɔkõ.
Na wofir tsetseetse na woesiesie Topheth ato hɔ; nyew, wɔayɛ no krado ama ɔhen no; ɔayɛ no dɔnkuronn tɛtɛɛtɛr: Ne ntanaa yɛ ogya na nangyantsia pii; Ewuradze n’ehuhuw dzɛw no dɛ brimstone a ɔrepem.
31: Wondue, hɔn a wosian kɔ Egypt kɔhwehwɛ mboa, na wɔdze hɔnho dan mpɔnkɔ; na wɔtwer ntseaseanam, osiandɛ wɔdɔɔ sõ ntsi, na mpɔnkɔdofo, osiandɛ hɔn ho yɛ dzen dodow ntsi; na mbom wɔnnhwɛ Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no, eso wɔnnhwehwɛ Ewuradze ekyir kwan!
Naaso ɔno so onyansafo a, na ɔdze mbusu bɛba, na ɔnnkɛsan ne nsɛm: Na ɔbɔsoɛr etsia ndzebɔnyɛfo fi, na emumuyɛfo mboa.

Afei Egyptfo no nyimpa a, na nnyɛ Nyame bi a; hɔn mpɔnkɔ so enam a, na nnyɛ sunsum bi a: Na sɛ Ewuradze nya tsen ne nsa a, ɔboafo na obefintsiw, na nyia wɔboa no so ahwe ase, na hɔn nyina wɔabɔ mu ayɛ gyan.

Na mbrɛ Ewuradze ase me nye yi, dɛ mbrɛ ogyata na ogyatafɔr pɔw wɔ n’afonam do, sɛ wɔfrɛ nguanhwɛfo dodow dɛn ara ba no do a, hɔn ndze remma ɔmmbɔ hu, na hɔn dede remma ɔrambrɛ noho adze: Dɛmara so na dɔm Ewuradze besian abɔkõ Zion bepɔw, na no kokwaa do.
Dɛ nnoma a worutu, na dɔm Ewuradze botwitwa agye Jerusalem; obotwitwa egya no na oeyi no efi mu, obotwa mu asen na ɔakora no do.
Ao Israelmba, hom nsan mbra nyia hom fi no hɔ atsew etūa kɛsekɛse no nkyɛn.
Na da no mu hɔn mu nyimpa biara bɔtow ne dwetɛ ehonyi, na ne sika ehonyi a homankasa hom nsa ayɛ ama hom bɔn egu.
Ɔno na Assyrianyi bɔtɔ afõwa a ɔnnyɛ nyimpa dze no ano, na afõwa a ɔnnyɛ adasa dze no edzi ne nam: Na obefi afõwa enyim eguan, na ɔdze ne mberantsɛ eyi amantow.
Na no botan botwa mu akɔ ɔnam hu ntsi, na n’asafohen bo etutu wɔ frankaa no ntsi, Ewuradze a ne gya wɔ Zion, na no fononoo wɔ Jerusalem no na ose.
32: Hwɛ, ɔhen bi bedzi hen wɔ tsenenee mu, na mbapɔmba edzi tum wɔ atsɛmbu mu.
Na nyimpa bi bɛyɛ dɛ huntsabea wɔ mframa ano, na guandɔbea wɔ ehum ano; dɛ asaase kwawee do esuesu, dɛ ɔbotan kɛse ase nwinwin wɔ asaase a oetwie do.
Na hɔn a wohu adze enyi nnkɛyɛ kusukusu, na hɔn a wɔtse asɛm aso bɛkyɛn.
Nhoropohoropofo akoma bɛtse nyimdzee ase, na adodopofo gyirama bɛkasa trɔdɔdɔ.
Ogyangyantwi wɔa nnkɛfrɛ no oyamuyiefo bio, na otsiafo wɔnnkɛse no dɛ ɔyɛ odɔyɛfo bio.

Na ogyangyantwi bɛkã egyangyantwisɛm, na n’akoma bɛyɛ emumuyɛdze, dɛ obedzi egyangyansɛm, na ɔakã afomfonsɛm etsia Ewuradze, na ɔama nyia ɔkɔm dze no ne kra atɔ pan, na ɔama anondze abɔ nyia nsukɔm dze no no.
Na otsiafo edwindadze so muo: Ɔhyehyɛ ne tsirmu nhyehyɛɛ bɔn dɛ ɔdze atofosɛm bɛsɛɛ ɔbɔbɔnyi, sɛ ohianyi kasa tsenenee mpo a.
Ɔyamuyiefo dze, ɔhyehyɛ ne tsirmu ayamuyiedze; na ayamuyiedze mu na obegyina.
Hom nsoɛr, hom mbaa a hom ho adwe hom, na hom ntsie me ndze; hom mbabaa a hom twer homho, hom nyɛ aso mma m’asɛm.
Afrenhyia ekyir nda bi mu na wɔbɔfona hom, hom mbaa a hom twer homho: Na wenyin-abatsew bɛsã, na n’anoboa no so remmba bio.
Hom ho mpopo, hom mbaa a hom ho adwe hom; hom a hom twer homho, hom ho ntsitsi hom: Hom nyiyi homho efuradze, na hom nyeyɛ kwatserkwaa, na hom mfa eyitam mbobɔ hom asen.
Wɔbɛpempem hɔn akoko wɔ mfuwa fɛɛfɛw no ntsi, wɔ wenyindua a ɔsow wosowoso no ntsi.
Nsoɛ na nkɔkrɔw befifir me man asaase no do; nyew, wɔ enyigye kurow no mu enyigye adan nyinara do mpo:
Na wɔbɛdan ahemfi no egya; wɔbɔto kurow a nyimpa bitsibitsi wɔ mu no pan; ɔkoko no na aweɔmfo aban no bɛdan etu ara daa, sar do nsoaso enyikadze, mbowakuw edzidzibea;
dze ekesi dɛ wobefi sor ehue sunsum no egu hɛn do, ma sar do adan asaaseber a ɔma ndɔbaa, na woebu asaaseber a ɔma ndɔbaa no dɛ kwaa.
Ɔno na atsɛmbu bɛt eaa sar do, na ndzeyɛtsenenee atsena nsaaseber a ɔma ndɔbaa mu.
Na ndzeyɛtsenenee edwuma bɛyɛ asomdwee; na ndzeyɛtsenenee no nsusuando ayɛ kommyɛ na awerɛhyɛmu daa.
Na me man bɛtsena asomdwee tsenabea, na efiefi a osi pi. Na anomgye mbea komm mu.
Na ɔsorbo bogu wɔ kwaa n’asehwe mu; na kurow no wɔbɛbrɛ no adze koraa.
Esiarfo nye hom a hom pē aba wɔ esu nyina ho, na hom to ɔnantwi na asoaso anan kwan.
33: Due, ɔwo a efa afo, na wɔmmfaa wo afo bi; na itwa nkontompɔ, na wonntwaa wo nkontompɔ bi! Ber a egyaa afo fa no, wɔbɛfa wo afo; na ber a ama nkontompɔtwa abɔ adze no, wobotwa wo nkontompɔ.
Ewuradze, yɛ adom ma hɛn; ɔwo na yɛahwɛ wo kwan: Ɔwo yɛ hɔn abasa adzekyee nyina, hɛn nkwagye so wɔ ɔfona ber mu.
Weɔɔweɔɔyɛ ne dede ntsi na aman eguanguan; w’ahomado ntsi na amanaman apetse.
Na wɔbɔboa hom asadze ano dɛ mbrɛ esã boaboa ano; dɛ mbrɛ mbɛbɛw tutu na wobotutu esi do.
Woehuhor Ewuradze; osiandɛ ɔtse sor noho: Ɔdze atsɛmbu ɔnye tsenenee ahyɛ Zion mã.
Na otsintsiɛn bɛba wo ber mu, nkwagye, nyansa, na nyimdzee mbordo: Ewuradze ho suro nye n’akoradze.
Hwɛ, hɔn akatakyi retsēa mu wɔ guado: Asomdwee ho ahembɔfo rusū osū wen.
Akwantsempɔn atɔ pan, ɔkwantsemfo egyaa mu twa: Ɔato ahyɛmu no, oebu nkurow no enyimtsia, ommbu ɔdasanyi bi.
Asaase no dzi nkɔmbɔ, ɔfɔn: Lebanon enyi atõ na oetwintwam koraa: Sharon ayɛ dɛ sar pradada; na Bashan na Carmel popo hɔn haban.
Afei na mobɔsoɛr, Ewuradze na ɔse; afei na mebɛma moho do; afei na wobohuhor me.
Hom benyinsen ntsɛw, na hom awo mburonan: Hom ehuhuw yɛ ogya a ɔbɛhyew hom.
Na aman bɛyɛ dɛ kaadow nhyewee: Dɛ nsoɛ a woetwa a wɔhyew wɔ ogya mu.
Hom a hom wɔ ekyirkyir, hom ntsie dza mayɛ; na, hom a hom bɛn, hom ngye mo tum nto mu.
Zion mu ndzebɔnyɛfo bo etutu; ahohim afa hɔn a wonnyi Nyame mprase. Hɛn mu woana ba ɔnye ogya a ɔhyew bɛtsena? Hɛn mu woana na ɔnye daa nhyewee no bɛtsena?
Nyia ɔnantsew ndzeyɛtsenenee mu, na ɔkasa tɔɔtsenn mu; nyia okyir apempensi ho mfaso, ɔpopo ne nsa ho wɔ mboabadzi ne kã ho, osisiw n'aso wɔ abɔgyasɛm ne tsie ho, na omuamua n'enyi wɔ bɔn no hwɛ ho;
ɔno na ɔbɛtsena ɔsorsor: No twitwagye bea bɛyɛ abotan aban: Ɔdze n'edziban bɛma no; no nsu nnkɔbɔ no.
W'enyiwa bohu ɔhen no wɔ n'ahoɔfɛw mu; wɔbɔhwɛ asaase a ɔtrɛ kɔ ekyirkyir.
W'akoma bɔdwendwen ehudze no ho: Nyia ɔkan no wɔ hen, nyia oker ntoboa no wɔ hen? Nyia ɔkaan abantsentsen no wɔ hen?
Innkobu ɔman yereyerɛw no, ɔman a hɔn kasaa mu dɔ a innkotum ehu mu no; apɔtɔfo a innkotum atse hɔn ase no.
Hwɛ Zion, hɛn afahyɛ kurow no: W’enyiwa bohu Jerusalem tsenabea komm no, ntamadan a orunntutu, wɔronnhohɔr no mbɔfodua no ara pɛn, no ho ahoma so mu biara renntsetsew.
Na hɔ na Ewuradze nye hɛn bɛtsena tumdzi mu, esutsen atɛtɛr na nwora bea; hɔ na ntabon ahen biara nnkɔkɔ, na ahɛn akɛse so nnkotwa mu wɔ hɔ.
Na Ewuradze nye hɛn tsɛmbuafo, Ewuradze nye hɛn mbrahyɛfo, Ewuradze nye hɛn hen; ɔbɛgye hɛn nkwa.
Wo ntampeehoma mu agogow; woenntum ennsusuo hɔn hɛndua no ase dzen, woenntum anntserɛw abrada no mu: Ɔno na ɔkyekyɛɛ asadze kɛse a wɔfae no mu; mpakye mpo na wɔfaa afo.
Na ɔmamfo no mu bi nnkɛse dɛ, Meyar: Na wɔdze ɔman a wɔtse mu no hɔn emumuyɛ befir hɔn.
34: Amanaman, hom ntwe mbɛn mbetsie; na aman, hom nyɛ aso: Wɔmma asaase ɔnye ne mãye ntsie; wiadze, ɔnye ndzɛmba nyinara a wofi mu ba.
Na Ewuradze wɔ ebufuhyew wɔ amanaman nyinara do, na ebufuw wɔ hɔn dɔm nyinara do: Ɔasɛɛ hɔn huntuhuntu, oeyi hɔn ama okum.
Hɔn atɔfoe so wɔbɔtow hɔn egu, na hɔn efun no bɔnee bɔfow sor, na wɔdze hɔn bɔgyaa a nan mbepɔw.
Na ɔsor dɔm nyinara wɔbɛnan, na wɔa-bobɔw ɔsorsor dɛ nwoma: Na hɔn dɔm nyinara bɔpo egu, dɛ mbrɛ ahaban fi wenyindua do po, na dɛ mbrɛ adɔm-hadua do haban a ɔpo.
Na m’afõwa anom amee wɔ ɔsɔr: Hwɛ, obesian aba Edom, na ɔman a madom no no do, ebobu atsɛn.
Ewuradze afõwa ho ayɛ bɔgya mã, wɔdze seradze asera ho, wɔdze nguambaa ɔnye ndwanyin bɔgyaa, wɔdze ndwanyin nsɛbɛ ho seradze: Na Ewuradze wɔ ɔhyew-afɔr wɔ Bozrah, na okum kɛse wɔ Edom asaase do.
Na anantwi abɔyafo dze hɔn bɔhwehwe famu, na bɔgya bɔbow asaase, na seradze ayɛ huntuma sɔɔsɔɔ.
Na ɔyɛ Ewuradze n'awerdzi da, nhyɛananmu afe a obedzi ama Zion.
Na no nwora bɛdan ihua, na no huntuma adan brimstone, na n’asaase adan ihua a ɔdzɛw.
Worunndum no adzesaa anaa adzekyee; no wusiw bɔfow ɔsor daapem: Ɔbɛyɛ amamfõ ofitsi ebusuasantsen akɛpem ebusuasantsen; obiara nnkotwa mu dabiarada.
Na opoku na kɔtɔkɔ na wɔbɛfa; na patu na akonkoran atsena mu hɔ; na ɔdze asakrabutuw ahoma, na amamfoyɛ promo bɛsã do.
Wɔbɛfrɛ n’ekunyin no akɔ ahenman no mu, na obiara nnkɛba hɔ; na ne mbapɔmba nyinara nnkɛsɛ hwee.
Na nsoɛ befifir ne nhemfie, nsason na nkɔkrɔw wɔ n’akoban mu: Na ɔbɛyɛ mpataku tsenabea, nsohor adampan.
Na sar do mbowa abɔyafo na mpataku behyia hɔ, na apɔnkyenyin bɛka mu afrɛ ne nyɛnko; nyew, anago sunsum bɔn bɛtsena hɔ, na oenya ahomgyebea.
Hɔ na ɔkyerben bɛyɛ no buw, na ɔatow, na oesuow mba, na ɔaka aboa ano wɔ no nwinwin ase: Nyew, hɔ na nsansaa bɔboa hɔn ano, obiara ɔnye ne tsīafo.
Hom nhwehwɛ Ewuradze nwoma no mu, na hom nkenkan: Iyinom mu biara nnkɛyew, obiara ne tsiafo nnkɔbo no: Na m’ano na ɔahyɛ, na no sunsum na ɔapra hɔn aboa ano.
Na ɔatwe hɔn ho tonto, na ne nsa na ɔdze susuhoma akyekyɛ mu ama hɔn: Wobenya ayɛ hɔndze daa, na wɔatsena mu fitsi mbasantsen do ekodu mbasantsen do.
35: Sar do na asaase bɔɔ do bɛyɛ enyigye; na sar pradada edzi ehurusi, na oahan de rose-nhyiren.
Ɔbɛhanhan mbordo ara, na ɔdze dɛw na adwontow mpo edzi ehurusi; wɔdze Lebanon enyimnyam, Carmel na Sharon abɔsoyɛ no bɛma no: Wobohu Ewuradze n’enyimnyam, hɛn Nyankopɔn n’abɔsoyɛ no.
Hom nhyɛ nsa a ɔayɛ mberɛw no dzen, na hom mraiamia anankoroma a egura no mu.
Hom nse hɔn a hɔn akoma yɛ pretupretu no dɛ, hom nhyɛ dzen, mma hom nnsuro: Wɔnhwɛ, hom Nyame dze awerdzi, ɔnye Nyame ne nhyɛananmu bɛba; ɔbɛba abɛgye hom nkwa.
Ɔno na efurafo enyiwa bobuebue, na etsitsifo asowa mu ebuebue.
Nna ebubua bohuruhuruw dɛ ɔtwe, na omum ne tɛs kyerɛma atow ndwom: Na esueu-botuetue wɔ sar do, na nwora wɔ sar pradada do.
Na anhwea huruhuruw no bɛdan nsutaae, na asaase kwawee no adan mbansu: Mpataku tsenabea, mbrɛ nkyɛ wobutubutuwii no, nkyɛkyɛr befifir hɔ aka ndzɛmbir na mbɛw ho.
Na ɔtsempɔn bɛda hɔ, na ɔkwan, na wɔbɛfre no Krɔnkrɔn kwan; ɔhoɔfifo nnkɛfa do; na ɔno na wɔdze bɛma hɔn: Akwantsemfo, nyew nkwasea, wɔnnkɔfom kwan wɔ mu.
Ogyata biara nnkɛba hɔ, eso abowa dzifodzipɛfo biara nnkɔfow afa do, wonnkohu hɔn wɔ hɔ; na hɔn a wɔapon hɔn no na wɔbɛnantsew hɔ:
Na hɔn a Ewuradze abɔ hɔn tsir werdam no, wɔbɛsan, na wɔdze adwontow aba Zion; na daa enyigye bɛtsena hɔn etsifi: Wobenya ahomka na dew, na awerehow na nkrumsi eguan akɔ.
36: Afei ɔbaa dɛ ɔhen Hezekiah n’afe a otsīa duanan no mu no, nna Assyriahen Senna­cherib fowee baa Judah nkurow a wɔagyegye ho ban nyinara do, na ɔbɛgyee.
Na Assyriahen somaa Rabshakeh ma ofi Lachish ɔdze dom kese baa ohen Hezekiah nkyɛn wo Jerusalem. Na obegyinaa etsifi nsutaae a ɔwɔ otanhofo haban ne tsempɔn no do sukan no ho.
Nna Hilkiah ba Eliakim a ɔhwe fidua no do no, na ɔkyerɛwfo Shebna, na Asaph ne ba ɔsɛnkaafo Joah, wofiir edzi baa ne nkyɛn.
Na Rabshakeh see hɔn dɛ, afei hom nkã nkyerɛ Hezekiah dɛ, mbrɛ ɔhen kɛse, Assyriahen no, ɔse nye yi, awerɛhyɛmu bɛn nye yi a edze wo werɛ hyɛ mu yi?
Mekã dɛ, w’egyinatu na w’ahoɔdzen wɔ ɔsa ho no, ɔyɛ nsɛnhun kwa: Afei woana na etwer no, ma atsew mo do etūa yi?
Hwɛ, ɔwo etwer ndzɛmbir a ebu yi no poma do, mekyerɛ Egypt do a: Ɔno no do na sɛ nyimpa biara twer a, ɔwɔ ne nsamu, na ohwira mu: Mbrɛ Egypthen Pharaoh tse dze ma hɔn a wɔtwer no do nyinara nye no.
Na sɛ ese me dɛ, yɛtwer Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn a: Ana nnyɛ ɔno na Hezekiah eyiyi ne mbea sorɔnsorɔm na n afɔrmbukyia, na ɔase Judah na Jerusalem dɛ, afɔrmbukyia yi enyim na hom nsɔr no?
Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, enye mo wura Assyriahen no nkyiakyia, na memma wo mpɔnkɔ mpemebien, kyerɛ dɛ w’afamu ibotum ama nyimpa atsenatsena hɔn do.
Na ibodua dɛn mbɔ etum adan m wura no nkowaa nketseaba mu ɔsafohen baako n’enyi, na osian atseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo ntsi edze woho akɔtwer Egypt?
Ana afei mekwetsir Ewuradze na maba asaase yi do dɛ merebɛsɛɛ no? Ewuradze na ɔsee me dɛ, fow kɔ asaase yi do, na kɛsɛɛ no.
Nna Eliakim na Shebna na Joah see Rabshakeh dɛ mesere wo, kasa kyerɛ wo nkowaa wɔ Syria kasa mu; na yɛtse, na mma nnye hɛn nnkasa wɔ Judahfo kasaa mu wɔ nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ ɔfasu no do no asomu.

Na Rabshakeh see dɛ, ana mo wura asoma me dɛ membɛkã nsɛm yi nkyerɛ wo wura, na ɔwo a? Ana nnyɛ nkorɔfo a wɔtsetse ɔfasu do no nkyɛn na wɔasoma me, dɛ wɔnye hom ndzi hɔnankasa hɔn egyanan, na wɔnye hom nnom hɔnankasa hɔn dwansee?
Nna Rabshakeh gyinae na ɔdze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu wo Judahfo kasaa mu, na ɔsee dɛ, hom ntsie ɔhen kɛse no, Assyriahen no, ne nsɛm.
Mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, mma hom mma Hezekiah ndaadaa hom; na orunntum nngye hom:
Nkyii so mma hom mma Hezekiah mma hom nntwer Ewuradze, dɛ, ɔgye ara na Ewuradze bɛgye hɛn; wɔremmfa kurow yi nnhyɛ Assyriahen nsa.

Mma hom nntsie Hezekiah: Na mbrɛ Assyriahen se nye yi, hom nye me nsiesie na hom mfir edzi mbra me nkyɛn; na hom mu obiara ndzidzi no wenyindua do, na obiara n’adɔmbadua do bi na hom mu obiara nnom nankasa no supi mu nsu:
Nkodu dɛ mebɛba mabɛfa hom makɔ asaase a ɔtse dɛ homankasa hom asaase yi do, eburow na wenyin asaase, edziban na wenyin nture asaase.
Hom nhwɛ yie ma Hezekiah anndɔkɔdɔkɔw hom, dɛ, Ewuradze bɛgye hɛn. Ana amanaman enyame efi Assyriahen ne nsamu pɛn?
Hamath na Arpad enyame no wɔwɔ henfa? Sepharyaim enyame no wɔwɔ henfa? Na aso wɔagye Samaria efi me nsamu a?
Amanaman yi mu enyame nyinara mu woana mu na wɔagye hɔn asaase efi me nsamu, ma Ewuradze rebɛgye Jerusalem efi me nsamu yi?
Na wɔkaa hɔn ano too mu, na woemmbua no asɛm biara: Osiandɛ ɔhen no me mbrasɛm nye dɛ, mma hom mmbua no.
Nna Hilkiah ne ba Eliakim a ɔhwɛ fidua no do no, na ɔkyerɛwfo Shebna, na Asaph ba ɔsɛnkaafo Joah, dze hɔn ntar a wɔatsetsew mu baa Hezekiah nkyɛn, na wɔkãa Rabshakeh ne nsɛm no kyerɛɛ no.
37: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen Hezekiah tsee no, na ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔdze eyitam kataa noho, na ɔkɔr Ewuradze ne fie.
Na ɔsomaa Eliakim a ɔhwɛ fidua no do no, na ɔkyerɛwfo Shebna, na asɔfo no mu mpanyin, wɔdze eyitam akata hɔn do, ma wɔkɔr Amoz ne ba nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah nkyɛn.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, mbrɛ Hezekiah se nye yi, ndɛ da yi ɔyɛ ɔfona, na nkaenyim, na ɔsesar da: Osiandɛ mba edu awoko mu, na ahoɔdzen nnyi hɔ a wɔdze bɔwo hɔn.

Annyɛ a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn bɛtse Rabshakeh a no wura Assyriahen asoma no dɛ ɔmbɔsopa tseasefo Nyankopɔn no, ne nsɛm no nyinara, na ɔakã n’enyim wɔ nsɛm a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn atse no ntsi: Dɛm ntsi ma wo mpaabɔ do ma nkaa no a wɔaka no.
Nna ɔhen Hezekiah no nkowaa no baa Isaiah nkyɛn.
Na Isaiah see hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ hom nkɛkã nkyerɛ hom wura nye yi, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, mma nnsuro nsɛm a atse no a Assyriahen no nkowaa dze akã mo ho ebususɛm no.
Hwɛ, medze sunsum bi mebɛhyɛ no mu, na ɔbɛtse adɛadɛsɛm bi, na ɔansan ankɔ nankasa n’asaase do; na mebɛma ɔatɔ wɔ afõwa ano wɔ nankasa n’asaase do.
Nna Rabshakeh sanee na okohun dɛ Assyriahen reyɛ Libnah do sa: Osiandɛ ɔatse dɛ oetu efi Lachish.
Na ɔtsee dɛ wɔrekã wɔ Ethiopiahen Tirhakah ho dɛ, Oefir edzi dɛ ɔnye wo robɔkõ. Na aber a ɔtsee no, ɔsomaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Hezekiah nkyɛn, dɛ,
mbrɛ hom nkɛkã nkyerɛ Judahhen Hezekiah nye yi, dɛ, mma mma wo Nyankopɔn a edze wo werɛ twer no no ndaadaa wo, dɛ, wɔremmfa Jerusalem nnhyɛ Assyriahen nsa.
Hwɛ, ɔwoara atse dza Assyria ahemfo dze ayɛ asaase nyinara, dɛ wɔasɛɛ hɔn pasapasa: Na ɔwo na wɔbɛgye wo nkwa anaa?
Ana amanaman a m'egyanom asɛɛ hɔn no hɔn enyame no egya hɔn, dɛ Gozan, na Haran, na Rezeph, na Edenmba a wɔwɔ Telassar no?
Henfa na Hamathhen na Arpadhen, na Sepharyaim kurow, na hena na Iyyahhen no wɔ?
Na Hezekiah gyee nwoma no wɔ abɔfo no nsamu, na ɔkenkanee: Na Hezekiah sii mu kɔr Ewuradze fie, na ɔkɛtserɛw mu wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na Hezekiah bɔɔ mpaa wɔ Ewuradze enyim, see dɛ,
Dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn a etse cherubfo do, ɔwo woankotoo ara nye asaase do ahenman nyinara do Nyankopɔn, ɔwo na ayɛ ɔsor na asaase.
Ewuradze e, brɛ w’aso adze, na tsie; Ewuradze e, bue w’enyiwa, na hwɛ: Na tsie Sennacherib ne nsɛm a ɔdze asoma dɛ wɔmfa mbɔsopa tseasefo Nyankopɔn no.
Nokwar Ewuradze, Assyria ahemfo asɛɛ am ana man na hɔn asaase,
na wɔatotow hɔn enyame egu ogya mu: Osiandɛ wɔnnyɛ enyame, na nyimpa nsanno edwuma a, dua na ɔbo; dɛm ntsi na wɔasɛɛ hɔn.
Dɛm ntsi afei, hɛn Ewuradze Nyankopɔn e, gye hɛn fi ne nsamu, ma asaase do ahenman nyinara nhu dɛ ɔwo nye Ewuradze, mekyerɛ ɔwoara nkotoo korɛ.
Nna Amoz ne ba Isaiah somaa ma wɔkɔr Hezekiah hɔ, dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi, susuampa dɛ abɔ mpaa etsia Assyriahen Sennacherib no,
iyi nye nsɛm a Ewuradze akã wɔ no ho: Ɔbaabun Zion babaa no ebu wo enyimtsia na oesi wo atwetwe; Jerusalem babaa no awosow ne tsir wɔ wo do.
Woana na asopa no akɛ no ho ebususɛm? Na woana do na ama wo ndze do na ama w’enyiwa do wɔ sor etsia no? Nsɛ edze etsia Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no.

Ɔwo nam w’abɔfoe do asopa Ewuradze, na ase dɛ, medze me ntseaseanam dodow na mobɔfow maba mbepɔw etsifi, akɔ Lebanon mu noho noho ara; na mubotwitwa ne cedar atsentsen, na no nkupresindua a wɔapa no megu: Na makɛhɛn n'etsifi tõo, ne haban-ber kwaa no mu.
Emi na metutu mbura na manom nsu, na medze m'ananadze mobɔwew Egypt esutsen no nyinara.
Ana enntsee mbrɛ medua mayɛ no dadaada, ma mifi tsetseberdo na mehyehyɛe? Afei na mama aba mu, dɛ ɔwo esɛɛ nkurow a wɔagyegye ho ban, na wɔadandan ekurofõ ekuwekuw.
Dɛm ntsi ekuromfo no hɔn tum suar ntsi, hɔn akoma tui na hɔn enyim guu ase; wɔtse dɛ haban mu efuw, dɛ eburow kwã a onnyae nnyinii.
Na minyim w’asetsena na wo mfiredzi na wo mbamu, na wo dam a ebɔ wɔ mo do no.

Osian wo dam a ebɔ wɔ mo do, na w’enyimenamsɛm a afow ebodu m’asomu ntsi, dɛm ntsi medze mo nkwaba mebɛhyɛ wo hwen mu, na medze me menyiamfrɛ mato w’anomu, na mebɛsan wo ekyir afa ɔkwan a enam do bae no do akɔ.

Na iyi bɛyɛ wo asɛnkyerɛdze; afe yi mu hom bedzi dza noara efifir, na afe a otsīa ebien no mu dza obefir noara mu epue; na afe a otsīa ebiasa mu no hom ndua, na wombu, na wɔntsetsɛw wenyin nture, na wondzi no mu aba.
Na Judah ofi mu nkaa a woefi nsa no wɔbɛgye ndwow akɔ famu bio, na wɔasow aba akɔ sor.
Na Jerusalem na nkaase bi befir edzi efi, na hɔn a wobefi nsa so efi bepɔw Zion do: Dɔm Ewuradze ho mbɔdzembɔ na ɔbɛyɛ yi.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze kã wɔ Assyriahen ho nye yi, ɔremmba kurow yi mu, na ɔronntow hɔ egyen-menaba so, nkyii so ɔremmfa kyem mmba n’enyim, eso ɔronnhɔr pempe wɔ do.
Ɔkwan a ɔnam do bae no, ɔnoara so na ɔnam do bɛsan akɔ, na ɔremmba kurow yi mu, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na mebɛper kurow yi magye no nkwa, wɔ mankasa me ntsi, na m’akowaa Dayid ntsi.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe fiir edzi kokunkum Assyriafo nserabando nyimpa mpemɔha eduowɔtwe enum: Na aber a nyimpa soɛɛr anapaatu no, nna hwɛ, hɔn nyinara ewuwu efui.
Nna Assyriahen Sennacherib fii hɔ na osii mu sanee, na ɔkɛtsenaa Nineyeh.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔrosɔr wɔ no bosom Nisroch fie no, nna ne mbabanyin Adrammelech na Sharezer dze afõwa kum no: Na wofii nsa guanee kɔr Ararat asaase do. Na ne babanyin Esar-haddon dzii hen wɔ n'ananmu
38: Nda no mu no na Hezekiah yaar owuyar. Na Amoz ne ba nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze ne nye yi, siesie wo fie yie; na ibowu, da irinnya nkwa.
Nna Hezekiah saan n'enyim kɔr ban ho, na ɔbɔɔ mpaa maa Ewuradze,
na ɔsee dɛ, ao Ewuradze, mototɔ serɛ wo, afei kaa mbrɛ mesi na manantsew w’enyim wɔ nokwar na akoma a odzi mu mu, na mayɛ dza oye wɔ w’enyi do. Na Hezekiah sūu yayaayaw.
Nna Ewuradze n’asɛm baa Isaiah nkyɛn, dɛ,
kɔ, na kɛse Hezekiah dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze w’egya Dayid ne Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, matse wo mpaabɔ, mehu wo nyinsuwa: Hwɛ medze mfe duenum mubogu wo nda do.
Na mebɛgye ɔwo na kurow yi mefi Assyriahen nsamu: Na mobɔbɔ kurow yi ho ban.
Na iyi nyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze a ofi Ewuradze hɔ mma wo, dɛ Ewuradze bɛyɛ adze a ɔakã yi:
Hwɛ, mebɛma ntwerba no do sunsuma a ewia ama esian wɔ Ahaz n’ewia-dɔn do no, ɔasan ekyir ntwerba du. Nna ewia saan ekyir ntwerba du wɔ ewia-dɔn a oesian dada no do.
Kyerɛw a Judahhen Hezekiah, aber a ɔyaree na ɔbɔɔ esu fii ne yarba no mu no ɔkyerɛwee no nye yi.
Mekaa dɛ, me nda no wigyinae mu no, mebɛkɛhɛn samanadze aponkɛse no mu: Wɔagye me mfe nkaa wɔ me nsamu.
Mekãa dɛ, munnkohu Ewuradze, mekyerɛ Ewuradze, wɔ atseasefo asaase do; murunnhu nyimpa bio wɔ wiadze mu atsefo no mu.
Wɔama me mfe efi hɔ, na woeyi no me nkyɛn kɔ dɛ oguanhwɛfo ntamadan: Mabobɔw no nkwa dɛ ɔtanwemfo; obotwa me efi nsadua mu akyen: Da kor adzesaa na ibowie me.
Modwedwee moho kodur anapa; mbrɛ ogyata yɛ no, mbrɛ obubu me mbiew nyinara mu ara nye no: Da kor adzesaa na ibowie me.
Mokrɔɔw dɛ akyemfowa anaa dɛ opoku; midzii nkɔmbɔ dɛ ebubur; mohwɛɛ sor ma m'enyi bui; Ewuradze, mo ho akyer me, ɔwoara yɛ me okyirtaafo.
Menkã dɛn o? Ɔnoara na ɔakasa akyerɛ me, na ɔnoara so na ɔa; mebɛnantsew berɛberɛ me mfe nyinara wɔ me kra n'ahoguan mu.
Ewuradze, ndzɛmba yinom do na adasa nam tseba ase. Na no mu koraa na mo sunsum no nkwa wɔ: Dɛm ntsi bɔ me esu, na ma minnya nkwa.
Hwɛ, m’asomdwee ntsi na minyaa ahoguan kɛse: Na ɔwo na me kra ho dɔ ntsi eyi no efi mprɔwee maa no mu; osiandɛ ɔwo atow mo bɔn nyina egu w’ekyir.
Na samanadze runntum nnyi wo ayɛw, owu runntum nntonton wo: Hɔn a wosian kɔ maa no mu no runntum nnhwɛ wo nokwar no kwan.
Ɔtseasefo, ɔtseasefo, ɔno na obeyi wo ayɛw, dɛ mbrɛ mereyɛ ndɛ da yi: Egya bɛda wo nokwar no edzi akyerɛ mba.
Ewuradze ayɛ krado dɛ ɔbɛgye me nkwa: Dɛm ntsi yɛbɔtow mo ndwom wɔ nsankutsen ano hɛn nkwa nda nyinara wɔ Ewuradze fie.
Afei na Isaiah akã dɛ, wɔmma wɔmfa adɔmba etɔw kor, na wɔmbɔ no boa ntar pɔmpɔ no do, na ɔbɔbɔ esu.
Hezekiah so akã dɛ, asɛnkyerɛdze dɛ mobɔkɔ Ewuradze fie nye bɛn?
39: Aber no mu no, Babylonhen, Baladan ne ba Merodach-baladan, somae ma wɔdze nwoma na akyɛdze brɛɛ Hezekiah: Osiandɛ ɔtsee dɛ ɔyaree, na ɔabɔ esu.

Na Hezekiah nyaa ho ahomka, na ɔdze n’adɔnadze dan, dwetɛ, sika, nduhuam, ngo pa, na n'akodze dan, na dza wohunii wɔ n’akoradze bea mu hɔ nyinara kyerɛɛ kɔn: Biribiara nnyi ne fie, anaa n’ahenman nyinara mu a Hezekiah ammfa annkyerɛ hɔn.
Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah baa ɔhen Hezekiah nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, nyimpa yinom bɛkãa dɛn? Na wofi henfa baa wo nkyɛn? Na Hezekiah see dɛ, wofi ekyirkyir asaase do baa me nkyɛn, Babylon a.
Nna ɔsee dɛ, woehu bɛn wɔ wo fie? Na Hezekiah buaa dɛ, dza ɔwɔ me fie nyinara woehu: Biribiara nnyi m'adzekoradze mu a memmfae mennkyerɛɛ hɔn.
Nna Isaiah see Hezekiah dɛ, tsie dɔm Ewuradze ne nsɛm.
Hwɛ, nda reba a dza ɔwɔ wo fie nyinara, na dza w'egyanom akora do ebodu ndɛ da yi nyinara wɔbɔsoa akɔ Babylon: Hweeara rennka, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na wɔbɛfa wo mba a wobefi wo mu a ebɔwo hɔn no mu binom akɔ, na wɔakɛyɛ asaa wɔ Babylonhen n’ahemfie.
Nna Hezekiah see Isaiah dɛ, Ewuradze asɛm a akã yi, oye. Ɔkãa bio so dɛ, na asomdwee na nokwar bɛba wɔ me nda mu.
40: Hom nkyekye, hom nkyekye me man werɛ, hom Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
Hom nkasa akomatɔmu kasa nkyerɛ no dɛ n'akodzi abɔ adze, wɔdze n'emumuyɛ efir; oenya Ewuradze ne nsamu mbɔho wɔ no bɔn nyinara ntsi.
Obi ndze tsēa mu dɛ, hom mbɔ Ewuradze no kwan wɔ sar do, hom ntsen sar pradada do tsempɔn no mma hɛn Nyankopɔn.
Wɔbɛma bɔnsa biara do, na bepɔw na koko biara wɔbɛbrɛ no adze: Na wɔatsentsen dza akyeakyea, na mbrɛ ɔyɛ kekakeka no ayɛ dɛfɛɛ:
Na wɔbɛda Ewuradze n’enyimnyam edzi, na adasa nyina abɔ mu ehu: Na Ewuradze ano na ɔakã.
Obi ne ndze kã dɛ, Tsēa mu. Na mesee dɛ, mentsēa mu dɛn? Honam nyina yɛ nkyɛkyɛr, na ne fɛw nyina tse dɛ hamu nhyiren:
Nkyɛkyɛr kyenkyen, nhyiren pa; osiandɛ Ewuradze n’ahom huw fa do: Ampaara ɔman no yɛ nkyɛkyɛr.
Nkyɛkyɛr kyenkyen, nhyiren pa: Na hɛn Nyankopɔn asɛm dze, obetsim hɔ daa.
Ɔwo a ekã nsɛmpa kyerɛ Zion, kɔ bepɔw a ɔkrɔn no do; ɔwo a ekã nsɛmpa kyerɛ Jerusalem, fa ahoɔdzen ma wo ndze do; ma do, mma nnsuro; se Judah nkurow dɛ, hom nhwɛ, hom Nyankopɔn nye yi!
Hwɛ, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn bɛba dɛ ɔkatakyi, na ne basa bedzi nyim ama no: Hwɛ, n’akatua wɔ ne nkyɛn, nan’ahyɛnanmu wɔ n’enyim.
Ɔbɛnyɛn no nguankuw dɛ oguanhwɛfo, ɔbɔboaboa no nguambaa ano wɔ n'abaw mu, na oetur hɔn no bo mu, na ɔaka nguan a wɔma enumfo berɛberɛ.
Woanana oesusu esuesu wɔ ne nsayamu, na ɔato ɔsor nsatseama, na ɔahyɛ asaase huntuma wɔ etwadze mu, na oeker mbepɔw wɔ nsɛn mu, na akoko wɔ apa do?
Woana na ɔakyerɛ Ewuradze no sunsum kwan, anaa ɔakyerɛkyerɛ no dɛ ɔyɛ ne pamfo?
Woana na ɔnye no tuu egyina, na woana kyerɛkyerɛɛ no, na ɔkyerɛɛ no atsɛmbu kwan mu, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ no nyimdzee, na ɔdze ntseasee tsempɔn kyerɛɛ no?
Hwɛ, amanaman tsetse dɛ bokitsi mu nsosɔe, na woebu hɔn dɛ nsɛn mu huntuma ba: Hwɛ, ɔmema nsupɔw no do dɛ adze ketseaba.
Na Lebanon nnsõ hyew, no mu mbowadoma so nnsõ ɔhyew-afɔr.
Amanaman nyinara mmfata hwee wɔ n’enyim; wobu hɔn dɛ adze a ɔnnsɛ hwee, na egyangyandze.
Woana ho mbɔ na hom dze Nyame bɔto? Anaa suban bɛn na hom dze bosusu no?
Ohonyi a woesian no, odwimfo na ɔnanee, na sikadwinnyi dze sika dura ho, na ogugu ho dwetɛ ntweaban.
Nyia oehia dodow ama dɛm ayɛyɛdze no, ɔsan mu yi dua a ɔmmprɔw; ɔhwehwɛ odwimfo nyansafo ma noho, ma ɔaayɛ osian-honyi a onnkotutu.
Aso hom nnhunii? Aso hom nntsee? Aso wommfii ahyɛse nnkãa nnkyerɛɛ hom? Aso hom mmfii asaase ne fapem ase nntsee ase?
Ɔno nye nyia ɔtse asaase no kɔntɔnkrɔn no do, na no mu atsefo tsetse dɛ mbɛbɛw; ɔno a ɔtserɛtserɛw osorsor mu dɛ ɔtam, na ɔtserɛtserɛw mu dɛ ntamadan a wɔtsena mu:
Ɔno a ɔma mbapɔmba wɔyɛ dɛ wonnsɛ hwee; ɔma asaase do atsɛmbuafo yɛ dɛ egyangyandze.
Nyew, wɔnntsetsɛɛw hɔn; nyew, wɔmmfaa hɔn nnduaduae; nyew, hɔn dua nngyee asaase do ndwow: Nkyii so ohuw gu hɔn do, na wɔkyenkyen, na ekyinehyia-mframa tu hɔn kɔ dɛ ntsɛw.
Woana ho mbɔ na hom dze me bɔto, ma menye no asɛ? Ɔkrɔnkrɔnnyi no na ɔse.

Hom mma hom enyi do wɔ sor, na hom nhwɛ nyia ɔbɔɔ iyinom, ɔno a obu hɔn dɔm ano dze hɔn fir: Ɔbobɔ hɔn nyinara edzin frɛfrɛ hɔn: N'ahoɔdzen ne kɛseyɛ ntsi, na osiandɛ ɔyɛ dzen wɔ tum mu ntsi, no mu kor ara nnka.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔwo Jacob, ekã, na Israel, ekasa, dɛ, mo kwan ehuntsa Ewuradze, na m'atsɛmbu etwa me Nyankopɔn ho kɔ?
Aso innhunii? Aso enntsee? Ɔdomankoma Nyankopɔn, Ewuradze, asaase n'ewiei ɔbɔfo no, ɔnntɔ bitsi, eso ɔmmberɛ; ne ntseasee mu nnyi nhwe hwɛmu.
Ɔno na ɔma nyia ɔtɔ bitsi ahoɔdzen; na nyia onnyi ahom no, ɔto n’ahoɔdzen mu.
Mbofra mpo wɔbɔtɔ bitsi na wɔaberɛ, na mberantsɛ wɔahwehwe ase koraa
Na hɔn a wɔtweɔn Ewuradze dze, wobonu hɔn ahoɔdzen mu fofor; wɔdze ntsaban botu afow sor dɛ nkɔr; wobotu mbirika, na wɔnnkɛberɛ; wɔbɛnantsew, na wɔnnkɔtɔ bitsi.
41: Nsupɔw, hom nka hom ano nto mu wɔ m’enyim; na aman nnu hɔn ahoɔdzen mu fofor: Wompinkyɛn; na wɔnkasa: Hom mma yɛmbɔ mu nhyia asɛndzii.
Woana na ɔama obi do efi boka a ɔfrɛ no ɔtsenenee mu ba n’ananadze? Ɔdze amanaman dzi n’enyim, na ɔma odzi ahemfo do tum; odze hon ma n’afowa dɛ huntuma, dɛ mburonan a wobo no ko ma n’egyen.
Otsiw hɔn, na otwa mu sen sɔnn; wɔ ɔkwan a n’anan nnsi do da mu mpo.
Woana na oedzi dwuma na ɔayɛ, ɔrefrɛfrɛ mbasantsen fir ahyɛse yi? Emi mara Ewuradze, ɔkandzifo a ɔnye ekyidzifo nam, Emi nye no.
Nsupɔw hunii, na wosuroi; asaase ewiei ho popoe: Wɔtwee bɛnee, na wɔbae.
Wɔkɔr hɔn ho mboa nkorkor; na obiara kãa kyerɛɛ no nua dɛ, hyɛ akokodur.
Nna duadwinnyi hyɛɛ sikadwinnyi dzen, na nyia ɔdze hamɛr koraa ho yɛɛ nyia ɔbor tombo do dɛmara, ɔrekã wɔ ɔsɔw no ho dɛ, oye: Na ɔdze mprɛgow bobɔɔ mu dzen amma onntutu.
Na ɔwo, Israel, m’akowaa, Jacob a masan mu meyi wo, me nyɛnko Abraham asefo;
ɔwo a mifi asaase ano noho mesuo wo mu, na mifi me mfɛndzanan mafrɛ wo maba, na mase wo dɛ, m’akowaa nye wo, masan mu meyi wo na monntoow wo nnkyenee;
mma nnsuro, na menye wo nam, mma wo bo nntu, na emi nye wo Nyankopɔn: Mebɛhyɛ wo dzen; nyew, mobɔboa wo; nyew, medze me ndzeyɛtsenenee abanyimfa bosuo wo mu egyina.
Hwɛ, hɔn a woe nya wo ebufuw nyinara bɛfɛr na hɔn enyim egu ase; hɔn a wɔnye wo fimfen bɛyɛ gyan, na wɔahera.
Ebɔhwehwɛ hɔn, na innkohu hɔn, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔnye wo dzi aper no a: Hɔn a wotu wo do ɔsa no bɛyɛ gyan, dɛ ɔhweewa.
Na emi mara Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn mubosuo wo nsa nyimfa mu, dɛ, mma nnsuro, mobɔboa wo.
Mma nnsuro, ɔwo abowaba Jacob, na hom Israelmba; mobɔboa wo, Ewuradze na ɔse, na wo pomfo nye Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no.
Hwɛ, mebɛyɛ wo ɔporow-dadze fofor ndam ndam a ɔwɔ sē pii: Ebɔporow mbepɔw na ayam hɔn wekowekoweko, na ayɛ nkoko dɛ ntsɛw.
Ibohuw hɔn, na mframa asoa hɔn akɔ, na ekyinehyia-mframa abɔ hɔn apetse: Na ɔwodze ibedzi Ewuradze mu ehurusi, ebɛhyehyɛ woho wɔ Israel krɔnkrɔnnyi no mu.
Abɔbɔfo na ehiafo hwehwɛ nsu na bi nnyi hɔ, na nsukɔm ntsi, hɔn tɛkyerɛma do wow; emi Ewuradze mara na mubobua hɔn, emi Israel Nyankopɔn mennkɛpa hɔn.
Mubotuetue nsutsen wɔ mpampaa pataa do, na nsunyiwa wɔ mbɔnsa finimfin: Mebɛma sar ayɛ nsutaae, na asaase kɛsɛɛ ayɛ nsubaa.
Mebɛtsɛw ceder, acacia, myrtle, na ngodua wɔ sar do; medze kupresi na ɔsɛsɛw na ɔpapaadua bɔbɔ mu esisi sar pradada do:
Ama wɔaahwɛ, na woeehu, na wɔaadwendwcn ho, na wɔaatse ase prɛko, dɛ Ewuradze nsa na ɔayɛ iyi, na Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no na ɔabɔ.
Hom mfa hom amandzɛɛ mbra, Ewuradze na ɔse; hom mbɔ hom nkurow a ɔyɛ dzen biara, Jacob ne hen na ɔse.
Wɔmma wɔmfa mbra, na wɔmbɛkyerɛ hɛn dza obesi: Hom nda adadadze no edzi, mbrɛ wɔtse, ama yaadwendwen ho, na yeehu hɔn ewiei; anaadɛ hom nkyerɛ hɛn ndzɛmba a ɔreba.
Hom nda ndzɛmba a daakyee ɔbɛba edzi ma yenhu dɛ hom yɛ abosom: Nyew, hom nyɛ papa, anaa hom nyɛ bɔn, ma yɛmbɔ hwea, na yɛmbɔ mu nhu.
Hwɛ, hom fi adze a ɔnnyɛ hwee mu, na hom ndwuma yɛ adze gyan: Ekyiwadze nye nyia ɔsan mu yi hom.
Mama obi do fi kwaamu afamu, na ɔaba; obi a ɔbɔ me dzin fitsi wipuei a: Na ɔbɛba ambradofo do dɛ oritsia dɛtse do, na dɛ ɔwemfo ritsia awendɛtse.

Woana na ɔada no edzi fir ahyɛse, ama yeehu? Ɔnye kankankyerkyerew no, ama yaase dɛ, ɔyɛ ndzeyɛtseneneenyi? Nyew, obi nnyi hɔ a ɔoda no edzi nyew, obi nnyi hɔ a ɔkyerɛ, nyew, obi nnyi hɔ a, otsie hom nsɛm.
Emi na mibedzi kan mase Zion dɛ, hwɛ, hwɛ hɔn; na mebɛma Jerusalem obi a ɔdze nsɛm pa ba.
Na sɛ mohwɛ a, nyiinpa bi nnyi hɔ; hɔn mu ɔpamfo bi nnyi hɔ a, se mibisa hɔn ho asɛm a, obobua me asɛm kor mpo.
Hwɛ, hɔn nyinara, hɔn ndwuma yɛ egyangyandze na adzehun: Hɔn eguhonyi yɛ mframa na enyimguase.
42: Hwɛ m’akowaa a mesuo no mu egyina; me nyia masan mu meyi no a me kra enyi ka no ho: Medze mo sunsum ahyɛ no; ɔdze atsɛmbu befir akɛma Amanamamfo.
Ɔrenntsēa mu, eso ɔremma ne ndze do, anaaso ɔremma wɔnntse ne ndze wɔ ɔbrɔn mu.
Ndzɛmbir a akontom no, orummbu no, na asaaba a orupun wusiw no, orunndum no: Obeyi atsɛmbu edzi wɔ nokwar mu.
N’ano ronndwe eso ɔremmpa abaw, ekodu dɛ ɔdze atsɛmbu esi asaase do; na nsupɔw bɔtweɔn ne mbra.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn se nye yi, ɔno a ɔbobɔɔ ɔsorsor, na ɔtserɛtserɛɛw mu; ɔno a ɔyeyeer asaase na dza ofi mu ba; ɔno a ɔdze nkwahwea ma no do nkorɔfo, na ɔdze sunsum ma hɔn a wɔnenam mu:
Emi mara Ewuradze na mafrɛ wo wɔ ndzeyɛtsenenee mu, na mubosuo wo nsamu, na makora wo, na medze wo mayɛ ɔman ahyɛmu, ayɛ amanamamfo kandzea;
ma oebuebue enyiwa a efurafura, oeyi ndaduafo efi efiadze, na hɔn a wɔtsetse sum mu efi mpokyerɛ dan mu.
Emi mara nye Ewuradze; me dzin nye no: Na meremmfa m’enyimnyam mma obi, na m’ayɛyi so meremmfa mma ehonyi a woesian.
Hwɛ, ndadaw dze no aba mu, na ndzɛmba afofor na meda no edzi: Mekã ho asɛm kyerɛ hom, ansaana woefifir.
Hom ntow ndwom fofor mma Ewuradze, na hom mfi asaase ano noho ntow n’ayɛyindwom; hom a hom sian kɔfow po, na dza ɔwɔ mu nyina, nsupow, na no mu atsefo.
Wɔmma sar na no do nkurow no mma hɔn ndze do, nkuroba a Kedar tse do no; wɔmma Selafo ntow ndwom, wɔmma womfi mbepɔw etsifi mbɔ ose.
Wɔmma wɔnhyɛ Ewuradze enyimnyam, na wɔnda n’ayɛyi edzi wɔ nsupɔw mu.
Ewuradze befir edzi dɛ ɔkatakyi; obekenyan nyinkun dɛ ɔsabarimba: Ɔbɛtsēa mu, nyew, ɔbɔbɔ ose; obedzi n’atamfo do akatakyisɛm.
Maka m’ano ato mu akyɛr; mayɛ komm, na mesianka moho: Afei dze mebɛtsēa mu dɛ ɔbaa a ɔrokõ awoo; mebɛkyem na megu ahom prɛko.
Mebɛma mbepɔw na akoko afomfɔn, na mama hɔn do ha nyinara egunguan; na madan nsutsen no nsupɔw, na mawewew nsutaae no.

Na medze efurafo afa ɔtsempɔn a wonnyim do no do aba; ɔkwan a wonnyim mu no mu na mibegya hɔn afa: Mebɛma sum ayɛ kan wɔ hɔn enyim, na mbrɛ ɔyɛ nkyeakyeae no, matsentsen no. Ndzɛmba iyinom na mebɛyɛ, na meremmpa hɔn.
Wɔbɛsan ekyir, hɔn enyi bɔtõ kɛsenara, hɔn a wɔtwer ehonyi a woesian wɔse egu-ehonyi dɛ, hɛn abosom nye hom no.
Etsitsifo, hom ntsie; na enyifurafo, hom nhwɛ, ma hom eehu.
Woana yɛ ofurafo, dɛ m’akowaa nko? Anaa otsitsifo, tse dɛ mo bɔfoe a mosoma no no? Woana na oefura tse dɛ nyia ɔnye me tse asomdwee mu no, na oefura tse dɛ Ewuradze n'akowaa no?
Ɔwo ihu ndzɛmba pii, na ennhyɛ no nsew; n’aso ebue, na ɔnntse asɛm.
Ɔsɔɔ Ewuradze enyi dɛ, ne ndzeyɛtsenenee ntsi, ohuhor ne mbra, na ɔma onya enyidzi.

Na woyidze wɔyɛ aman a woetwa hɔn dwo na wɔafa hɔn afo; woesuasua hɔn nyinara mfir wɔ etu mu, na wɔdze hɔn esumasuma mpokyerɛfo dan mu: Wɔayɛ afonam, na obi nngye nkwa; wɔayɛ asadze, na obi nnkã dɛ, fa san ma.
Hom mu woana na ɔbɛma iyi aso? Ɔbɛkyɛn aso etsie ndaamba asɛm?
Woana na ɔdze Jacob maa dɛ afonam, na ɔdze Israel maa edwotwafo no? Ana nnyɛ Ewuradze bi a? Ɔno a yɛayɛ bɔn etsia no, na n’akwan no, wɔammpɛ dɛ wɔnantsew mu, eso wɔannyɛ setsie amma ne mbra.
Dɛm ntsi na ohuee n’ebufuhyew na ɔkõ ne dzendzen guu no do; na ɔtoo no gya hyiae, naaso oennhu; na ɔhyeew no, naaso ɔammfa annhyɛ no werɛ mu.
43: Na afei mbrɛ Ewuradze a ɔbɔɔ wo, Jacob, na ɔno a ɔween wo, Israel, ɔse nye mma nnsuro, na mapon wo; mabɔ wo dzin afrɛ wo, eyɛ medze.
Sɛ irutwa esu a, menye wo nam; sɛ idua esutsen mu a, orummunam wo: Sɛ enam ogya mu a, ennkɛhyew; eso ogyaframee rennhyew wo.
Na emi nye Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi, w’agyenkwa no; medze Egypt ayɛ w’asatsir, medze Ethiopia na Seba esi w’ananmu.
Osiandɛ asom bo wɔ m’enyi do, na enya enyidzi, na madɔ wo no, ntsi na medze nyimpa besi w’ananmu na medze aman besi wo nkwa ananmu.
Mma nnsuro; menye wo nam: Medze w’asefo befi boka aba, na maboa wo ano efi anee;
mebɛse kwaamu afamu dɛ, fa ma; na pomu afamu dɛ, mma nnkam do; fa me mba fi ekyirkyir, na me mbabaa fi asaase ano noho bra;
obiara a wɔbɔ me dzin frɛ no, na mabɔ no mama m’enyimnyam no, emi na mahyehyɛ no; ampaara emi na mayɛ no.
Hom mfa ɔman furafo a wɔwɔ enyiwa no, na etsitsifo a wɔwɔ aso no mbra.

Amanaman nyinara mboaboa hɔn ano fakor, na aman nhyia mu: Hɔn mu woana botum ada iyi edzi, na ɔakyerɛ nkankan no ndzɛmba? Wɔmma wɔmfa hɔn adasefo mbra, ma wondzi bem: Anaa wɔmma wontsie, na wɔnkã dɛ, ɔyɛ nokwar.

Homara nye m'adasefo, Ewuradze na ɔse, na m’akowaa a masan mu meyi no: Ama hom eehu na wɔaagye me edzi, na wɔaatse ase dɛ emi nye ɔno; wɔnnhyehyɛɛ Onyame bi nndzi m’enyim da, eso m’ekyir obi remmba pɛn.
Emi, emi mar a, nye Ewuradze; na agyenkwa bi nnyi hɔ ka mo ho.
Emi na mada no edzi, na magye nkwa, na makyerɛ, na an anana bosom bi emmpue hom mu: Dɛm ntsi hom nye m’adasefo, Ewuradze na ɔse, na emi nye Nyankopɔn.
Nyew, ofitsi da n’ahyɛse emi nye ɔno; na obi nnyi hɔ a obotum agye efi me nsamu: Mibedzi dwuma, na woana besi me ngyama?
Mbrɛ Ewuradze, hom pomfo, Israel Krɔnkrɔn no, ɔse nye yi: Hom ntsi na masoma akɔ Babylon, na medze hɔn nyinara besian aba dɛ eguamfo, Chaldeafo no mpo, wɔ hɔn ehurusi ahɛn no mu.
Emi nye Ewuradze, hom Krɔnkrɔnnyi, Israel Bɔfo, hom hen no.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, ɔno a ɔma ɔtsempɔn da po mu, na ɔma ɔkwan da esu akɛse mu;
ɔno a ɔdze ntseaseanam na pɔnkɔ, dɔm na tum fir edzi no; hɔn nyina bɔ mu deda famu, wɔronnsoɛr; wɔasã, woedundum dɛ asaaba:
Mma hom nkaa nkan no ndzɛmba, eso mma hom ndwendwen tsetse ndzɛba ho.
Hwɛ, merebɛyɛ adze fofor; afei na oribefir; aso hom runnhu? Mobɔbɔ ɔkwan ato sar do mpo, na esutsen wɔ sar pradada do.
Hamu mbowa bedzi me nyi, mpataku na nsohor: Osiandɛ mema nsu ba wɔ sar mu, na esutsen ba wɔ sar pradada mu, ma me man a masan mu meyi hɔn no wɔaanom:
Ɔman no a mehyehyɛɛ hɔn memaa mankasa moho no, ma woeeyi m'ayɛyi akyerɛ.
Naaso ɔwo, Jacob, emmfrɛɛ me; na mbom ɔwo, Israel, mo ho afon wo.
Ɔwo emmfaa wo hyew-afɔr anantwimba no mmbrɛɛ me; eso emmfraa w;afɔrbɔdze nndzii me nyi. Memmaa emmfaa w'edziban-afɔr nnsoom me, eso memmfaa nduhuam memma emmberɛe.
Ɔwo emmfaa sika nntɔɔ ahwer mmaa me, eso emmaa w'afɔrbɔ seradze mmee me: Mbom edze wo bɔn ama masom, edze a'emumuyɛ ama maberɛ.
Emi, emi mankasa, nye nyia ɔpepa wo mbrato wɔ emi mankasa me ntsi; na merennkaa wo bɔn.
Kaakaa me ɛ; ma yenyi atsɛn: Sina w'asɛm, ma eedzi bem.
W'egya a odzi kan no yɛɛ bɔn, na wo ntamugyinafo atõ mbra etsia me.
Dɛm ntsi mubohura krɔnkrɔn-bea mbapɔmba no ho, na mayɛ Jacob ndom, na Israel asesardze.
44: Naaso afei, m'akowaa Jacob, tsie; na Israel a masan mu meyi wo:
Mbrɛ Ewuradze a ɔyɛɛ wo, na ɔhyehyɛɛ wo fii yafun mu no a ɔbɔboa wo no, se nye yi: M'akowaa Jacob, mma nnsuro; na ɔwo, Jerusalem a masan mu meyi wo.
Na mubohue nsu megu nyia nsukɔm dze no no do, na nsubansuba megu daadze kɛsɛɛ do; mubohue mo sunsum megu w'asefo do, na me nhyira megu hɔn a wofi wo mu do:
Na wobefifir nkyɛkyɛr ntamu, dɛ esukã do ndua.
Obi bɛse dɛ, meyɛ Ewuradze dze; na obi so bio ɔdze ne nsa akyerɛw dɛ ɔyɛ Ewuradze dze, na ɔdze Israel ne dzin ato no do
Mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Hen, na no pomfo, dɔm Ewuradze no, ɔse nye yi: Emi nye ɔkandzifo, na emi nye okyidzifo; na Onyame nnyi hɔ ka mo ho.
Na woana na ɔtse dɛ emi a ɔbɛfrɛ, na ɔakã akyerɛ, na oesiesie ama me, ofitsi ber a medze tsetse man misii hɔ no? Na ndzɛmba a ɔreba, na dza ɔbɛba mu no, wɔmma wɔnka nkyerɛ.
Mma hom nnsuro, eso mma hom bo nntu: Ana mimmfi tsetse na mekãa kyerɛɛ hom, na medze kyerɛe? Na homara nye m’adasefo. Aso Onyame bi wɔ hɔ kɔ mo ho? Ɛhɛɛ, ɔbotan bi nnyi hɔ; minnyim biara.
Hɔn a wɔyɛ ohonyi a woesian nyinara yɛ egyangyandze; na hɔn enyigyedze ho nnkɛba mfaso: Na hɔnankasa hɔn adasefo runnhu adze, eso wonnyim adze; ama hɔn enyi aatõ.
Woana na ɔayɛ bosom, anaa oegu ohonyi a woesian a mfaso bi nnyi ho?
Hwɛ, nsɛfo nyinara enyi bɔtõto; na edwimfo no, adasamba yi ara bi a: Wɔmma hɔn nyinara wɔmboa ano fakor, wɔmma wongyinagyina hɔ; wobosuro, hɔn enyi bɔtõ prɛko.
Ɔtomfo bɔ ekuma, na ɔyɛ ngyabiriw mu edwuma, na ɔdze nhamɛr bor no, na ɔdze n’abaw dzendzen yɛ ho edwuma: Nyew, ɔkɔm dze no, na n’ahoɔdzen pa; ɔnnom nsu, na ɔtɔ bitsi.
Duaawimfo dze ahoma to; ɔdze ntwoma sensan; ɔdze twerɛw-ndadze siesie ho, na ɔdze kɔmpase sensan ho, na osian no nyimpa saso, dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa n’ahoɔfɛw tse, ma ɔaatsena dan no mu.
Ɔtow cedar, na ɔfa abrɔwi na osudur, na ɔhyɛ kwaa mu ndua bi dzen ma noho: Ɔtsɛw kupresidua, na nyankonsu nyɛn no.
Nna nkyii ɔyɛ mbrɛ nyimpa dze kūa ogya; na ɔfa bi, na ɔtõ; nyew, okūa, na ɔtõ boodoo: Nyew, ɔyɛ bosom, na ɔsom no; ɔyɛ no ohonyi a woesian, na ɔkotow no.
Ɔtoa ne fã bi ogya mu; ɔdze ne fã bi so dzi nam; ɔkyew nam, na odzidzi mee: Nyew, ɔtõ so, ma ɔkã dɛ, yɛɛ, mo ho ayɛ me hyew ae, ogya na mehu yi:
Na ne nkaa no ɔdze yɛ bosom bi, no honyi a woesian no a: Ɔkotow no, na ɔsɔr no, na oyi no mpaa, na ɔkã dɛ, gye me; na ɔwo nye mo bosom.
Wonnyim, eso wɔnndwen ho: Osiandɛ ɔaseram hɔn enyi, ma wonntum nnhu; na hɔn akoma, ma wonntum nntse ase.

Na obiara nnkaa, eso nyimdzee anaa ntseasee bi nnyi hɔ a ɔdze bɛse dɛ, matoa ne fã bi wɔ ogya mu; nyew, medze ne gyabiriw bi matõ boodoo; makyew nam na medzi: Na aso medze ne nkaa no mebɛyɛ ewurkadze? Aso mobɔkotow duasin?
Nso na odzi: Akoma a wɔadaadaa no no dze no aman nkyɛn, na onntum nngye ne kra, anaa ɔnnkadɛ de, aso nnyɛ ator na ɔwɔ me nsa nyimfa mu yi?
Ao Jacob, kaa ndzɛmba yinom; na Israel, na ɔwo nye m’akowaa: Emi na mahyehye wo; owo nye n’akowaa. Ao Israel, mo werɛ nnkefir wo.
Mapepa wo mbrato, dɛ mununkuin kumbɔɔ, na wo ndzebon, dɛ nsuwusiw: San bra me nkyɛn; na mapon wo.

Ɔsorsor, hom ntow ndwora, na Ewuradze na ɔayɛ; asaase ase noho, hom mbɔ ose; mbepɔw, kwaa, na ndua a ɔwɔ mu nyinara, hom mfa ehurusi ndwom: Na Ewuradze apon Jacob, na obehye noho enyimnyam wɔ Israel mu.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze, wo pomfo, na nyia ɔhyehyɛɛ wo fu yafun mu no, ɔse nye yi: Emi nye Ewuradze a ɔyɛ ndzɛmba nyinara no; no nko ara ɔtwe ɔsorsor mu; ɔtserɛw asaase mu; woana ka mo ho?
Nyia ɔma atorfo nsɛnkyerɛdze yɛ gyan, na ɔma sebramufo bobɔ adam; nyia ɔma enyansafo san nkyirkyir, na ɔyɛ hɔn nyimdzee nkwaseasɛm:
Nyia ɔhyɛ n’akowaa n’asɛm dzen, na ɔma n’abɔfoe hɔn apam ba mu; nyia ɔkã wɔ Jerusalem ho dɛ, wɔbɛtsena no mu; na wɔ Judah nkurow no ho dɛ, wɔbɛkyekyer, na mamema n’ekurofõ no do:
Nyia ɔse bun no dɛ, wew, na mebɛma w’esutsen awewew:
Nyia ɔkã wɔ Cyrus ho dɛ, mo guanhwɛfo nye no, na ɔbɛma m’enyisɔdze nyina ayɛ hɔ: Ɔbɛkã wɔ Jerusalem ho mpo dɛ, wɔbɛkyekyer; na asɔrfi no ho dɛ, wɔbotow wo fapem.
45: Dɛm na Ewuradze kã kyerɛ ne nyia ɔasera no, Cyrus a mesuo ne nsa nyimfa mu dɛ mebɛbrɛ amanaman adze wɔ n'enyim, na masansan ahemfo asen; dɛ mubobuebue mbobow wɔ n'enyim, na aponkɛse no wɔanntotow mu;
emi mara mibedzi w’enyim akɔ, na mama mbea a ayɛ kekakeka no ayɛ dɛfɛɛ: Mubobubu boran mbobow no mu esinesin, na metwitwa adaban no mu:
Na medze sum mu akoradze, na ehuntsambea ahonyadze a wɔdze esuma mebɛma wo, ama eehu dɛ emi nye Ewuradze a medze wo dzin mefrɛ wo, Israel Nyankopɔn no a.
Osian m’akowaa Jacob, na me mpamunyi Israel ntsi, medze wo dzin mafrɛ wo: Mato wo ebusuadzin, kaansa ɔwo nnhun me mpo a.
Emi nye Ewuradze, na obi nnyi hɔ bio; Onyame bi nnyi hɔ ka mo ho: Mobɔbɔ wo abodo, kaansa ɔwo nnhun me, mpo a:
Ama wofi wipuei ɔnye anee eehu, dɛ obi nnyi hɔ ka mo ho: Emi nye Ewuradze, na obi nnyi hɔ bio
Emi na mehyehyɛ kan, na mobɔ sum; emi na meyɛ asomdwee, mobɔ mbusu; emi nye Ewuradze ɔyɛ ndzɛmba yinom nyinara.
Ɔsorsor, hom mfi ɔsor nsosɔw, na hom mma wimu ntɔ ndzeyɛtsenenee ngu: Asaase mbuebue, ma wɔmma nkwagye mbra, na ɔmma ɔnye ndze-yɛtsenenee mbɔ mu mfifir; emi Ewuradze na mabɔ.
Nyia ɔnye no Bɔfo dzi esi no, ondue! Asaase do ntankofɛr mu ɔtankofɛr! Aso awendɛtse bɛse nyia ɔwen no no dɛ, ereyɛ dɛn nye yi? Anaa w'edwuma ase dɛ, onnyi nsa?
Nyia ɔse n’egya dɛ, ebɛnadze na awo no yi? Anaa ɔbaa dɛ, ebɛn na ekõ no awoo yi no? Ondue!
Mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi, na no bɔfo, ɔse nye yi: Hom mbisa me ndzɛmba a ɔbɛba ho asɛm; hom nhyɛ me mbra wɔ me mbabanyin ho, na me nsaano edwuma ho.
Emi na mayɛ asaase, na mabɔ nyimpa wɔ do: Emi, me nsa ara a, na matwetwe ɔsorsor mu, na hɔn dɔm nyinara emi na mahyɛ.
Emi na mama no do wɔ ndzeyɛtsenenee mu, na mebɛtsentsen n’akwan nyinara: Ɔno na obɛkyekyer mo kurow, na ɔama m'amantufo afa hɔn ho tɔtrɔtɔ, nnyɛ tsibo bi anaa akatua bi ntsi, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.

Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, Egypt edwumadze, na Ethiopia eguadze, na Sabeafo, mbarimba akraban, wobotwa mu aba wo nkyɛn, na wɔbɛyɛ wodzi; wobedzi w’ekyir; mpokyerɛ mu na wobotwa mu aba: Na wɔbɔkotow wo, wobedzi wo nkotoserɛ, dɛ Ampaara, Onyame ni nnyi hɔ.
Nokwar ara, ɔwo nye Nyankopɔn a ihuntsa woho, Israel Nyankopɔn Agyenkwa.
Hɔn nyinara, hɔn enyi bɔtõ, nyew, hɔn enyim bogu ase: Hɔn a wɔyɛ ehonyi nyina bɔbɔ mu ahyɛ ahoraa.
Na Israel dze, Ewuradze dze ɔdomankoma nkwagye bɛgye no nkwa: Hom enyi ronntõ, eso hom enyim runngu ase ara daapem.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze a ɔbɔɔ ɔsorsor no se nye yi; ɔno nye Nyankopɔn; nyia ɔhyehyɛɛ asaase na ɔyɛe; ɔno na ɔdze tsiim hɔ, ɔammbɔ no pan, ɔhyehyɛe ma wɔaatsena mu: Emi nye Ewuradze; na obi nnyi hɔ bio.
Nnyɛ nsumaa mu, sum mu asaase beebi, na makasa; mannse Jacob asefo dɛ, hom nhwehwɛ me kwa: Emi Ewuradze, mekasa ndzeyɛtsenenee, mekã ndzɛmba a ɔtsen kyerɛ.
Hom nhyiahyia homho na hom mbra; hom mbɔ mu ntwe mbɛn, hom a hom efi nsa wɔ amanaman mu: Hɔn a wɔsoso hɔn ehonyi a woesian no ndua, na woyi mpaa ma ɔbosom a onntum nngye nkwa no, wonnyim dze.

Hom nkã nkyerɛ, na wɔmma ompue, nyew, wɔmma wɔmbɔ mu ntu egyina; woana na ofi tsetseberdo ɔakyerɛ iyi? Woana na ɔakã yi akyerɛ dadaada? Aso nnyɛ emi Ewuradze a? Na Onyame bi nnyi hɔ ka mo ho; pɛrpɛr Nyankopɔn na Agyenkwa; obi nnyi hɔ ka mo ho.
Asaase ewiei nyinara, hom nhwɛ me, na hom nnya nkwa: Osiandɛ emi nye Nyankopɔn, na obi nnyi hɔ bio.
Makã mara moho ntam, asem no efi m’anomu kɔ wɔ ndzeyɛtsenenee mu, na ɔnnkɛsan, dɛ emi na anankororaa nyinara bɔkotow me, na tɛkyerɛma nyinara bɛkã me ntam.
Obi bɛse me dɛ, Ewuradze mu ara nko na ndzeyɛtsenenee na ahoɔdzen wɔ: Ne nkyɛn ara na adasa bɛba, na hɔn a hɔn bo fuuw no nyinara hɔn enyi bɔtõ.
Ewuradze mu na Israel asefo nyinara bedzi bem, na wɔahyehyɛ hɔnho.
46: Bel butuw, Nebo kotow; hɔn ehonyi soso adzesoambowa, na fiembowa: Ndzɛmba a hom soasoaa no ayɛ akyekyedze, adzesoa ama mbowa a wɔaberɛ.
Wɔkotow, wɔbɔ mu butuw; woenntum ennyi adzesoa no, na hɔnankasa wɔkɔ ndɔmmum mu.
Jacob fifo, hom nyɛ aso mma me, na Israel fie nkaa nyinara a metur hɔn fi yafun mu, masoa hɔn fi awotoa mu:
Na ɔdze kodu nkɔdaayɛ mu mpo, emi nye no, na ɔdze kodu gomfuw mu mpo, mobɔbɔ wo akɔnkɔn emi na mayɛ wo, na mubotur wo, nyew, mobɔbɔ wo akɔnkɔn, na magye wo,
woana na hom dze me bɔto no ho, ma menye no ayɛ pɛr, na hom dze me bosusu, ma yaasɛ?
Hɔn a wohue sika fi foto mu, na woker dwetɛ wɔ nsɛn mu, wɔma sikadwinnyi apɛnsa, na ɔdze yɛ ɔbosom; wɔkotow, nyew, wɔsɔr.
Wɔbɔ no akɔnkɔn, wɔsoa no, na wɔdze no kesi ne sibea, na ogyina hɔ; onnkefi ne sibea efi: Nyew, obi bɛtsēa mu afrɛ no, naaso onnkotum ebua, anaaso ɔagye no efi no fona mu.
Hom nkaa iyi, na hom nkyerɛ homho mbarimba: Mbratofo, hom nkaakaa,
hom nkaakaa kankankyerkyerew ndzɛmba no: Na emi nye Nyankopɔn, na obi nnyi hɔ bio; emi nye Nyankopɔn, na obi nnyi hɔ tse dɛ emi a,
mifi ahyɛse mekã ewiei no mekyerɛ, na mifi tsetsebaado mekã dza wonnyae nnyɛe no mekyerɛ; dɛ, m'apam begyina, na mebɛyɛ m'enyisɔdze nyinara:
Mebɛfrɛ anoma edzinam bi mefi boka, m'apam mu barimba mefi ekyirkyir asaase do; ɛhɛɛ, makasa, mebɛma aba mu so; mabɔ tsirmpɔw, mebɛyɛ so
Akokobirfo a hom ntamu nye ndzeyɛtsenenee twe, hom ntsie me:
Medze me tsenenee mabɛn, ɔronnkɔ ekyirkyir bio, na mo nkwagye rinnkyinkyim; na medze nkwagye bɔto Zion ama m'enyimnyam Israel.
47: Babylon babaa ɔbaabun, sian na tsena huntuma mu; Chaldeafo babaa kwetsir ahengua tsena daadze: Na wɔnnkɛda ho afrɛ wo bɔkɔbɔkɔnyi na ɔhosɔrnyi bio.
Fa ewuyambo no, na yam ewu: Yi wo nkataenyim, pɔr w’asensɛnekyir no gu, pata w'anantu ho, twa nsutsen.
W’adagyaw bɛda edzi, nyew, wobohu w'anoto: Mibedzi wer, merenngye nylmpa blara.
Hɛn pomfo no, ne dzin dze dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no.
Chaldeafo babaa, tsena hɔ komm, na kɔ sum no mu: Na wɔnnkɛda ho afrɛ wo Ahendzi horow ewuraba bio.
Mo bo fuuw me man, muguu m’egyapadze ho fi, na medze hɔn mehyɛɛ wo nsa: Ɔwo ennhu hɔn mbɔbor biara; edze wo kɔndua ato nkɔdaa do durduudur.
Na ekãa dɛ, mebɛyɛ ewuraba daa: Ma dɛm no ammfa ndzɛmba yinom annto w’akoma mu, eso annkaa n’ewiei.
Dɛm ntsi afei tsie iyi, ɔwo a edze woho ama agofɛw, emmfa dze nnyɛ dze, ekã no w’akoma mu dɛ, emi mara a, na obi nnyi hɔ ka mo ho; merenntsena dɛ okunafo, eso mirinndzi awo-mba-ewu:
Na ndzɛmba ebien yi bɛba wo do awora da kor, awo-mba-ewu na ekunayɛ: Wɔbɛba wo do mã ara tɔ, wɔ w’abayisɛm dodow, na w’adzeafosɛm a ɔdɔɔ sõ pii no mu.
Na ɔwo edze wo werɛ atwer w’emumuyɛ; akã dɛ, obi nnhu me; wo nyansaa na wo nyimdzee akyea w’adwen: Na akã wɔ w’akoma mu dɛ, Emi mara a, na obi nnyi hɔ ka mo ho.
Dɛm ntsi mbusu bɔto wo; innkohu ne mbae; na ebu bobu wo; irunntum nnyi nngu: Na ɔsɛɛ bɛba wo do awora a innyim.
Afei fa w’adzeafosɛm soɛr gyina ɛ, ɔnye w’abayifosɛm dodow a ifi wo mbatobermu aberɛ mu no; egyangyanbiara ibotum dze enya mfaso bi, egyangyanbiara edze bedzi nyim bi.
Aberɛ wɔ w’egyinatu dodow mu: Afei ma ɔsorenyi nkyekyɛmufo, nworabahwɛfo, abosoom horow ho adzekyerɛfo no nsoɛr na wɔngye wo nkwa mfi ndzɛmba a ɔbɛba wo do no mu.
Hwɛ, wɔbɛyɛ dɛ eburonan; ogya no bɛhyew hɔn; wɔrenngye hɔnho mmfi ogyaframee no n’ahoɔdzen nsa: Ɔrennyɛ ogyabiriw a wɔtõ bi, anaa ogya a wɔko ho.
Dɛm na ndzɛmba a aberɛ wɔ mu no bɛyɛ ama wo: Hɔn a ofitsi wo mbafobermu wɔnye wo edzi gua no bekyin akokɔ hɔn abrɔn mu; obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔbɛgye wo nkwa.
48: Hom ntsie iyi, Jacob fifo a wɔato hom dzin Israel, na hom fi Judah esu mu epue; hom a hom dze Ewuradze dzin kã ntam, na hom bɔ Israel Nyankopɔn ne dzin, naaso nnyɛ nokwar mu, anaa tsenenee mu.
Na wɔfrɛ hɔnho dɛ wofi kurow krɔnkrɔn no mu, na wɔdze hɔnho twer Israel Nyankopɔn; ne dzin dze dɔm Ewuradze.
Mifi tsetse na makã kan ndzɛmba no makyerɛ; ampaara, wofi m’anomu firii, na medze kyerɛe: Awerɛfir mu ara na meyɛe, na wobaa mu.
Osiandɛ minyim dɛ eyɛ ntsintsiman, na wo kɔn yɛ dadze ntsin, na wo momapɔw yɛ boran;
ntsi na mifi tsetse makã makyerɛ wo a; medze kyerɛɛ wo ansaana ɔaba mu: Amma ɔwoara aannkã dɛ, mo honyi na ɔayɛ, na mo honyi a woesian, na m'egu-honyi na ɔhyɛe.
Ɔwoara atse; hwɛ iyi nyina; na hom, ana hom nnkɛkã akyerɛ? Makyerɛ wo ndzɛmba afofor ofitsi ndɛ, mekyerɛ esumadze a innhunii.
Afei na wɔabɔ hɔn, na ommfi tsetse; na ɔdze bodu ndɛ, enntsee da; amma aannkã dɛ, hwɛ minyim.
Nyew, anntse; nyew, ennhu; nyew, w’asowa emmbue emmfi tsetse: Muhun dɛ ɔwo itwaa nkontompɔ papaara, na wɔfrɛɛ wo mbratonyi fir yafun mu.
Me dzin ntsi na mibekyinkyim m’ebufuw, na m’ayɛyi ntsi na mobɔbɔ wo ho esianka, amma meennkruw w’ase.
Hwɛ, manan wo, na nnyɛ dɛ dwetɛ; masan mu meyi wo wɔ ahohiahia fononoo mu.
Mara me ntsi a, mara me ntsi a, na mebɛyɛ; na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn bɛyɛ dɛ wobohura me dzin ho? Na meremmfa m’enyimnyam mma obi.
Jacob, tsie me ɛ, na Israel a mafrɛ wo: Emi nye ɔno; emi nye ɔkandzifo, emi ara so nye okyidzifo.
Nyew, me nsa na ɔdze asaase ne fapem towee, na me nsa enyimfa na ɔtserɛɛw ɔsorsor mu: Sɛ mefrɛ hɔn a, wɔsoɛr gyina prɛko.
Hom nyinara, hom mboa hom ano, na hom ntsie; hɔn mu woana na ɔakã ndzɛmba yinom akyerɛ? Ewuradze adɔ no: Ɔbɛyɛ n’enyisɔdze wɔ Babylon do. Na n’abaw bɛda Chaldeafo do.
Emi, emi mara, na makasa; nyew, emi na mafrɛ no: Medze no aba, na ɔbɛyɛ no kwan prɔmprɔm.
Hom ntwe mbɛn me, hom ntsie iyi; ofitsi ahyɛse ara mennkasaa nsumaa mu; ofitsi ber a ɔbae ara, na mowɔ hɔ: Na afei Ewuradze Nyankopɔn asoma emi, nano sunsum.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze, wo pomfo, Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no, ɔse nye yi: Emi nye Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn a ɔkyerɛkyerɛ wo ma wo mfaso, na ogya wo wɔ ɔkwan a ewɔ dɛ efa do no mu.
Ao kɛtseankyɛ eyɛɛ aso maa me mbransɛm! Nkyɛ w’asomdwee ayɛ dɛ esutsen, na wo tsenenee ayɛ dɛ po asorɛkye:
Nkyɛ w’asefo so ayɛ dɛ anhwea, na wo nson mu aba so ayɛ dɛ anhweaabo: Worunntwa ne dzin nnkyen; eso wɔrennsɛɛ no mmfi m’enyim.
Hom mfi Babylon mfi, hom nguan mfi Chaldeafo mu; hom mfa adwontow ndze nkã nkyerɛ, hom nkã iyi, hom mbɔ dzin nkodu asaase ewiei mpo: Hom nse dɛ, Ewuradze apon n'akowaa Jacob.
Na nsukɔm anndze hɔn ber a ogyaa hɔn duaa sar pradada do no; ɔmaa esu fii ɔbotan mu pemee maa hɔn: Ɔpaa ɔbotan mu so, na esu no gyee punkum.
Asomdwee bi nnyi hɔ mma emumuyɛfo, Ewuradze na ɔse.
49: Esupɔw hom ntsie me; na aman a wofi ekyirkyir, hom nyɛ aso: Ewuradze afrɛ me fitsi awotoa mu; ofi me nã no nson mu na ɔabɔ me dzin:
Na ɔayɛ m’ano dɛ afõwa ndam ndam, ne nsaano nwinwin mu na ɔdze me ehuntsa; na ɔdze me ayɛ egyen a wɔapɔw ho, n’egyen kotoku mu na ɔdze me esie;
na ɔsee me dɛ, m'akowaa nye wo; Israel a mebɛhyɛ moho enyimnyam wɔ wo mu.
Na mekaa dɛ, maberɛ kwa, mahwer m’ahoɔdzen ama adzehun na egyangyandze: Naaso m’atsɛmbu wɔ Ewuradze nsamu, na me nhyɛananmu wɔ me Nyankopɔn nsamu.

Na afei Ewuradze a ɔhyehyɛɛ me fii awotoa mu dɛ mebɛyɛ n’akowaa, memfa Jacob nsan mbra no, na dɛ wɔmboaboa Israel a no mbrɛ no no, ɔse: (Na menya enyidzi wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, na me Nyankopɔn abɛyɛ m’ahoɔdzen:

Nyew, ɔdɛ, ɔyɛ tootooba dɛ ebɛyɛ m'akowaa a ɔbɛma Jacob mbusuakuw do, na ɔdze Israel mu hɔn a wɔakora hɔn do no asan aba: Eso medze wo bɛma Amanamamfo dɛ hɔn kandzea, ama aayɛ mo nkwa ekesi asaase ewiei.

Mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel pomfo, na no Krɔnkrɔnnyi no, ɔkã kyerɛ nyia ɔdasanyi bu no enyimtsia, na ɔman no kyir no, ahyɛdofo akowaa no nye yi: Ahemfo bohu na wɔasoɛrsoɛr; mbapɔmba, na wɔasɔr; osian Ewuradze a odzi asɛnkor, mekyerɛ Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi a ɔasan mu eyi wo ntsi.

Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, aber a ɔsɛ mu na magye wo do, na nkwagye da mu na maboa wo: Na mobɔkora wo do, na medze wo ama dɛ ɔman ahyɛmudzi, ma aama asaase no do esi hɔ, ma aama woenya egyapadze a wɔayeyɛ afo ao edzi;
ma ase hɔn a wogugu nkyehoma mu no dɛ, hom mfir nkɔ; na hɔn a wɔwɔ sum mu no, dɛ, hom nyi homho nkyerɛ. Wobedzidzi akwan do, na mpampaa pataa nyinara do na ɔbɛyɛ hɔn edzidzibea.
Ɔkɔm anaa nsukɔm renndze hɔn; eso ɔhyew anaa ewia rennkã hɔn; na nyia ohu hɔn mbɔbɔr no obegya hɔn kwan, mbrɛ mbasu wɔ mpo na obegya hɔn afa.
Na mebɛyɛ me mbepɔw nyinara ɔkwan, na m'atsempɔn akrɔnkrɔn.
Hwɛ, woyinom wofi ekyirkyir bɛba: Na, hwɛ, woyinom wofi kwaamu afamu na anee; na woyinom wofi Sinim asaase do.
Ɔsorsor, hom ntow ndwom; asaase, dzi ehurusi; na mbepɔw, hom mfa ehurusi ndwom: Na Ewuradze akyekye ne man hɔn werɛ, ne yamu bɛhyehye no wɔ n'amandzehufo ho.
Naaso Zion see dɛ, Jehovah apow me, na Ewuradze no werɛ efir me.
Aso ɔbaa no werɛ befir no numfoanoba ara ma ne yamu nnkɛhyehye nowɔ ba a ofi n'awotoa mu no ho? Nyew, annyɛ a woyinom hɔn werɛ befir, na emidze mo werɛ nnkefir wo da.
Hwɛ, mekrukye wo wɔ me nsayamu; w'afasu wɔ m'enyim daa.
Wo mba hɔn ho yɛ har; w'asɛɛfo na hɔn a wɔyɛɛ wo afo no wobefi wo mu efir.

Ma w'enyi do bɔ aprɔw, na hwɛ: Woyinom nyinara wɔboa hɔn ano kor, na wɔba wo nkyɛn. Dɛ metse ase yi, Ewuradze na ɔse, ɔhyehyɛ ara na edze hɔn bɛhyehyɛ woho dɛ ahyehyɛdze, na edze hɔn abɔ woho do, dɛ ayefor.
Na, w'amamfõ na wo nkurow a abobɔ na w'asaase a wɔasɛɛ no dze, ampaara afei ebɛyɛ kyekyerbaa ama no do atsefo, na hɔn a wɔmemen wo no bɔkɔ ekyirkyir.
Mba a wofi wo nsa no benya akã wɔ w'asomu dɛ, bea no yɛ kyekyerbaa ma me: Ma me beebi ma mentsena.

Ɔno na ebɛkã no w'akoma mu dɛ, woana na ɔawo woyinom ama me, ber a wɔagye me mba efi me nsa, na mayɛ ankonam, ɔmantunyi a morowona kɔ ba? Na woana na ɔatsetse woyinom? Hwɛ, ɔkaa mankotsee; woyinom, henfa na nkyɛ wɔwɔ?
Mbrɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn se nye yi, hwɛ, mebɛma me nsa do makyerɛ amanaman, na mesi me frankaa akyerɛ aman: Na wobotur wo mbabanyin wɔ hɔn bo mu aba, na wɔabɔ wo mbabaa akɔnkɔn.

Na ahemfo bɛyɛ egyanom a wɔgyegye mba ama wo, na hɔn ahembaa ayɛ nanom a wɔgyegye mba ama wo wɔdze hɔn enyim ebutubutuw famu, na wɔatafer w'anan ho huntuma; na ibohu dɛ emi nye Ewuradze, na hɔn a wɔtweɔn me no hɔn enyim runngu ase.
Aso wɔbɛgye ɔkatakyi no ndɔmmum mpo wɔbɛgye akɔ, na ahoɔhufo n'afonam befi nsa: Na emidze menye hɔn a wɔnye wo si besi, na magye wo mba nkwa.

Na mebɛma hɔn a wɔtseetsee wo no edzi hɔnankasa hɔn honam; na wɔanom hɔnankasa hɔn bɔgyaa abow, dɛ nsã fenemfenem; na adasa nyinara bohu dɛ emi Ewuradze nye w'agyenkwa na wo pomfo, Jacob ne Katakyi no.
50: Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, Awarko nwoma a medze kõo hom nã awar no wɔ henfa? Anaa m’adzefirfo mu woana na matɔn hom mama no? Hwɛ, hom emumuyɛ ntsi na wɔtɔɔn hom, na hom mbrato ntsi na wɔkõo hom nã awar.

Ebɛn ntsi na mebae a, obi nnyi hɔ? Mefrɛe a, obi nnyi hɔ a ɔgye do? Aso me nsa yɛ tsia biara, ma onnkotum apon? Anaa minnyi tum a wɔdze gye nkwa? Hwɛ, meka enyim a, mema po wew, mema nsutsen dandan sar: Hɔn mu nam bombɔn, osiandɛ nsu nnyi hɔ ntsi, na wowuwu wɔ nsukɔm ntsi.
Medze tuntum mefura ɔsorsor, na medze eyitam ayɛ hɔn nkataenyi.
Ewuradze Nyankopɔn ama me hɔn a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ hɔn no hɔn tɛkyerɛma, ma meehu mbrɛ medze nsɛm bɔwowaw nyia ɔaberɛ: Onyan anapa anapa, onyan m’aso ma maatse asɛm dɛ hɔn a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ hɔn.
Ewuradze Nyankopɔn ebue m’aso, na manntsew etūa, eso mannsan m’ekyir.
Medze m’ekyir memaa abobɔfo, na medze m’afon memaa hɔn a wotutu nhwi: Mennhuntsa m’enyim memmfi fɛr na ntafi ho.
Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn bɔboan me; dɛm ntsi na m’enyim nngu ase yi: Dɛm ntsi na mepirim m’enyim dɛ ɔtwerɛbo yi, na minyim dɛ m’enyim runngu ase.
Nyia obu me bem no, ɔbɛn; woana na ɔnye me bedzi esi? Wɔmma yɛmbɔ mu ngyina: Woana na ɔyɛ me tamfo? Ma ɔntwe mpin me.
Hwɛ, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn bɔboa me; woana nye nyia obobu me fɔ? Hwɛ, hɔn nyinara bosuw dɛ atar; nkakraka bɔwe hɔn.
Woana wɔ hom mu a osuro Ewuradze, otsie n’akowaa ne ndze? Nyia ɔnantsew sum mu, na onnyi kan no, ma ɔmfa no werɛ nhyɛ Ewuradze ne dzin mu, na ɔndan ne Nyankopɔn.
Hwɛ, hom a hom kūakua gya, hom dze ngyantsia yɛyɛ abɔdo nyinara: Hom nnantsew hom gya ne framee, ɔnye ngyantsia a hom asosɔ no mu. Iyi na hom benya no wɔ me nsamu; hom bɛdeda hɔ awerɛhow mu.
51: Hom a hom dzi ndzeyɛtsenenee ekyir, hom a hom hwehwɛ Ewuradze, hom nyɛ aso mma me: Hom nhwɛ ɔbotan a wɔpaa, hom fi mu, na maa a wotuu hom fii mu no no tokur no.
Hom nhwɛ hom egya Abraham, na Sarah a ɔwoo hom no: Na ber a ɔyɛ ɔbaakofo no na mefrɛɛ no, na mihyiraa no, na meyɛɛ no ɔdodow.
Na Ewuradze akyekye Zion no werɛ, na ɔama ne sar do ayɛ dɛ Eden, na ne sar pradada ayɛ dɛ Ewuradze no ture; enyigye na ahosɛpɛw, ndaase, na adwontow ndze bɛba hɔ.
Mo nkorɔfo, hom ntsie me; me man, hom nyɛ aso mma me: Na mbra bi befi me nkyɛn akɔ, na mama m’atsɛmbu etsim hɔ ayɛ kan ama aman.
Me tsenenee abɛn, mo nkwagye efir edzi, na m’abasa bobu aman atsɛn; nsupɔw bɔtweɔn me, na m’abasa do na wɔbɔtwer.

Hom mma hom enyi do nhwɛ ɔsorsor, na hom nhwɛ asaase do wɔ famu: Na ɔsorsor bɛhera dɛ wusiw, na asaase bosuw dɛ atar, na hɔn a wɔtsetse do no ewuwu dɛmara: Na mo nkwagye dze, ɔbɛtsena hɔ daa, na me tsenenee wɔrennsɛɛ no.
Hom a hom nyim tsenenee, ɔman a me mbra wɔ hom akoma mu, hom nyɛ aso mma me; mma hom nnsuro adasa hɔn ahorhoraa, eso mma hɔn ntom mma hom akoma nntu.
Na nkakraka bɔwe hɔn dɛ atar, na abowaba awe hɔn dɛ kuntu: Na me tsenenee dze, ɔbɛtsena hɔ daa na mo nkwagye edu mbasantsen nyinara do.
Ewuradze ne basa e, nyan ɛ, nyan ɛ, fa ahoɔdzen hyɛ; nyan, dɛ mpanyin ber no mu, tsetsebaado mbusuasantsen no mu. Ana nnyɛ ɔwo na itwitwaa Rahab mu esinesin, ihwiraa dragon no mu no?
Ana nnyɛ ɔwo na eweew po, bun kɛse n'esu no; edze po n’ebun no yɛɛ kwan maa hɔn a wɔapon hɔn no dɛ wontwa no?
Na hɔn a Ewuradze atɔ hɔn tsir no, wɔbɛsan, na wɔdze adwontow aba Zion; na ɔdomankoma dɛw ɔtsena hɔn etsifi: Wobenya ahosɛpɛw na enyigye, na awerɛhow na nkrumsi eguan akɔ.
Emi, mara, nye nyia ɔkyekye hom werɛ: Ɔwo nye woana, na isuro ɔdasanyi a obowu, na ɔdasanyi ne ba a wɔbɛma ɔayɛ dɛ nkyɛkyɛr;

na wo werɛ efir Ewuradze wo Yɛfo a ɔtserɛɛw ɔsorsor mu, na ɔdze asaase ne mfapem totoe; na eda ho suro daa wɔ ɔhyɛdofo no n’ebufuhyew ntsi ber a osiesie noho dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ? Na ɔhyɛdofo no n’ebufuhyew wɔ hen?
Wɔbɛsan ɔmantunyi mpokyerɛnyi no ntsɛntsɛm; na onnkowu na oesian akɔ maa no mu, eso n’edziban nnkɔbɔ no.
Na emi nye Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn a onunu po mu, ma n’asorɛkye wor: Dɔm Ewuradze nye ne dzin.
Na medze me nsɛm ahyɛ w’ano, na medze me nsa ho no nwinwin akata wo do, ama maatsetsɛw ɔsorsor, na maatoto asaase ne mfapem, na maase Zion dɛ, ɔwo nye me man.
Nyan ɛ, nyan ɛ, gyina ɛ, Jerusalem a anom Ewuradze nsamu n’ebufuhyew kɔɔpow no; ɔwo na anom ntentanto kuraba no, na ehwiew mu no.
Obi nnyi ne mba a ɔawo hɔn nyinara mu a ogya no kwan; eso obi nnyi mba a ɔatsetse hɔn nyinara mu a osuo ne nsamu.
Ndzɛmba ebien yi na aba wo do; woana begyam wo? Amamfõ na ɔsee, ɔnye ɔkɔm na afõwa; minsi dɛn menkyekye wo werɛ?
Wo mbabanyin atotɔ bitsi, wɔdeda abrɔn nyinara etsifi, dɛ adoa a ɔda efir mu; Ewuradze n'ebufuhyew, wo Nyankopɔn no ntwuwenyim ayeyɛ amaama.
Dɛm ntsi afei tsie iyi, ɔwo ɔmandzehunyi a abow, naaso nnyɛ nsã bi a;
mbrɛ w’Ewuradze Jehoyah, na wo Nyankopɔn a odzi ma ne man no, ɔse nye yi, hwɛ, magye ntentan kɔɔpow no, mekyerɛ m’ebufuhyew kuraba no efi wo nsamu; erennda ho nnom ara bio:
Na medze mebɛhyɛ hɔn a wohiahia wo ho no hɔn nsamu; hɔn a wɔase wo kra dɛ, bɔ wo mu adze, ma yendua do: Na ɔwo na edze w’ekyir ato hɔ dɛ famu, na dɛ ɔbrɔn ama hɔn a wodua do no.
52: Zion, nyan ɛ, nyan ɛ, fa w'ahoɔdzen hyɛ, fa wo ntar fɛɛfɛw hyɛ: Na ofitsi ndɛ dze kɔ yi, monomonomfo na ahoɔfifo nnkɛhɛn wo mu bio.
Popo woho huntuma gu; Jerusalem, soɛr ɛ, tsena ase: Zion babaa ndɔmmum, sansan wo kɔn mu nkyehoma no.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, wɔtɔɔn hom kwa; na wɔnndze sika na wɔdze bɔpon hom.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn se nye yi, me man sianee kɔr Egypt asɔpɔn no kɛyɛɛ anana wɔ hɔ: Na Assyrianyi no hyɛɛ hɔn do kwa.
Dɛm ntsi afei, mereyɛ ha bɛn, Ewuradze na ɔse, ber a wɔdze me man kɔ kwa yi? Hɔn a wodzi hɔn do tum no tsēatsea mu, Ewuradze na ɔse, na wɔkã me dzin ho ebususɛm daa nyina.
Dɛm ntsi me man bohu me dzin: Dɛm ntsi da no mu wobohu dɛ emi mara nye nyia ɔkasa; hwɛ, emi mara a.
Nyia ɔdze nsɛmpa ba no n’anan mbrɛ odua yɛ fɛw wo mbepɔw do a, nyia ɔdze asomdwee tahye, nyia ɔdze papa ho nsɛmpa ba, nyia ɔdze nkwagye tahye; nyia ɔse Zion dɛ, wo Nyame dzi hen!
W’aweɔmfo ndze nye no! Wɔma ndze do, wɔbɔ mu tow ndwom; na wobohu; enyiwa tua enyiwa, ber a Ewuradze bɛsan aba Zion no.
Jerusalem amamfõ, hom ntsew ntɔ enyigye mu, hom mbɔ mu ntow ndwom; na Ewuradze akyekye ne man hɔn werɛ, ɔapon Jerusalem.
Ewuradze eyi ne basa krɔnkrɔn no ho wɔ amanaman nyinara enyim; na asaase ewiei nyinara bohu hɛn Nyankopɔn no nkwagye.
Hom ntwe homho, hom ntwe homho, hom mfi hɔ nkɔ, mma hom nkã efifidze biara; hom mfi no mu nkɔ; hom ho ntsew, hom a hom soso Ewuradze no nkuraba.
Na hom rimmfi ho nnko ɔhardo, na hom nndze enguan na hom bɔkɔ: Na Ewuradze bedzi hom enyim; na Israel Nyankopɔn abɔ hom nkyidɔm.
Hwɛ, m’akowaa bedzi no nyansa mu, wobohuhor no na wɔama no do, na ɔakron kɛsekɛse.
Dɛ mbrɛ dodowara hɔn ho dwuruuw hɔn wɔ wo ho no, (osiandɛ n’enyim sɛɛe seen nyimpa biara, na ne nyimpa su seen adasamba ntsi), dɛm na ɔbɛma amanaman pii abɔ piriw;
ahemfo bɛka hɔn ano ato mu wɔ no ho: Na dza wɔnnkãa nnkyerɛɛ hɔn pɛn no na wobohu; na dza wɔnntsee pɛn no na wɔbɛtse ase.
53: Woana na ɔagye hɛn amandzɛɛ edzi? Na woana na woeyi Ewuradze ne basa akyerɛ no?
Na onyiin dɛ dua fɔr wɔ n'enyim, na dɛ ndwow a ofi asaase mu: Onnyi frɔdɔɔ anaa enyimnyam; na sɛ yehu no a, onnyi ahoɔfɛw a ɔbɛma no ho ayɛ akɔndɔ.
Adasa buu no enyimtsia, na wɔpoow no; awerɛhow nyimpa a ɔyaw abra no: Na wobuu no enyimtsia dɛ obi a adasa dze hɔn enyim huntsaa no, na yeemmbu no hwee.
Ampaara ɔasɔw hɛn yaw, na ɔasoa hɛn awerɛhow: Naaso yebuu no dɛ nyia wɔahwe no, Nyame abɔ no, na woehiahia no ho.
Na mbom wopiraa no wɔ hɛn mbrato ntsi, woposoow no wɔ hɛn emumuyɛ ntsi; wɔdze hɛn asomdwee ho ntsēa too no do; na ne mbaa ano na wɔdze asa hɛn yarba.
Hɛn nyinara yeatotɔ dɔnsuar dɛ nguan; yɛamanman obiara afa noara no kwan do; na Ewuradze dze hɛn nyinara hɛn emumuyɛ ato no do.
Wɔhyɛɛ no ahoɔyaw, naaso ɔbrɛɛ noho adze na oemmbue n’ano; dɛ eguambaa a wɔdze no rokɔ ekumii, na dɛ oguan a ɔatɔ mmum wɔ no nhwitwitwafo enyim; nyew, oemmbue n’ano.
Nhyɛdo na atsɛmbu ntsi na wɔfaa no kɔree; na n’etsipɛmfo dze, hɔn mu woana na ɔdwen dɛ woetwa no efi atseasefo asaase do? Mo nkorɔfo hɔn mbrato ntsi na wɔhwee no.
Na wɔbɔɔ ne nda wɔ emumuyɛfo nkyɛn, na ahonyafo nkyɛn wɔ no wu mu; naaso na oenndzi akatabansɛm biara, eso woennhu ndaadaa bi wɔ n’anomu.
Naaso ɔsɔɔ Ewuradze enyi dɛ ɔhyɛ no amen; ɔahyɛ no ɔyaw: Ber a edze ne kra bɛyɛ bɔn ho afɔrbɔdze no, obohu n’asefo, ɔbɛma ne nda awar, na Ewuradze n’enyisɔ bɛyɛ prɔmprɔm wɔ ne nsamu.
Obohu ne kra n’awokodzi, na ɔamee: Ɔnam ne nyimdzee do na m’akowaa tseneneenyi bobu piinara bem: Na ɔbɔsoa hɔn emumuyɛ.
Dɛm ntsi mebɛkyɛ adze mama ɔno ɔnye akɛsefo, na ɔnye ahoɔdzenfo bɛkyɛ asadze; osiandɛ ohuee ne kra maa owu, na wɔkaan no foraa mbratofo: Naaso ɔsoaa dodowara hɔn bɔn, na odzii maa mbratofo.
54: Ɔbɔnyin, ɔwo a annwo, tow ndwom; ɔwo a ennkyeem ɔba da, fa ehurusi ndwom, na tsēa mu: Na osigyanyi no ne mba adɔɔ sõ asen ɔbaa ɔwarfo no ne mba Ewuradze na ɔse.
Tserɛw wo ntamadan bea no mu, na ma wɔntserɛtserɛw wo tsenabea ho nkataho tam no mu; mma nnkam do: Twetwe wo ntampeehoma no mu na tsintsim wo bɔfondua no.
Na ebɛtserɛw akɔ enyimfa na abankum; na w’asefo bɛfa amanaman no ayɛ hɔndze wɔama wɔatsenatsena ekurofõ no do.
Mma nnsuro; na w’enyi ronntõ eso mma w’enyim nngu ase; na wɔrennhyɛ wo enyito: Na wo werɛ befir wo mbafobermu enyito, na ennkɛkaa w’ekunayɛ mu adapaabɔ ara bio.
Na wo yɛfo nye wo kun; ne dzin dze dɔm Ewuradze: Na Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no nye wo pomfo: Wɔbɛfrɛ no asaase nyinara Nyankopɔn.
Na Ewuradze afrɛ wo dɛ ɔyer a wɔapow no na ɔyaw ekitsa no wɔ sunsum mu, mekyerɛ mbafobermu yer, aber a wɔatow no akyen, wo Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
Mber tsia kakrabaabi na madan wo egya; na ehumbɔbɔr kɛse na medze bɔboa w’ano.
Ebufuw mbudo mu na medze m’enyim huntsaa wo kakra; na ɔdomankoma ayamuyie na medze mubohu wo mbɔbɔr, wo pomfo Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na iyi yɛ me dɛ Noah esu no; na dɛ mbrɛ makã ntam dɛ Noah esu no remmpram asaase do bio no, dɛmara so na makã ntam dɛ mo bo nnkofuw wo, eso merennkã w’enyim.
Na mbepɔw botutu akɔ, na akoko atwetwe hɔnho; na m’ayamuyie dze, orunntutu mmfi wo nkyɛn, eso m'asomdwee ahyɛmudzi no ɔronntwe noho, Ewuradze a ohu wo mbɔbɔr no na ɔse.
Ao ɔwo amandzehunyi a ehum etu wo, na wɔnnkyekyee wo werɛ, hwɛ, medze w'abo mibesisi wo ntɔnka dubir mu, na medze sapphire atow wo fapem.
Na medze bɔgyaabo mayɛ wo abantsifi, na medze carbuncle mayɛ w’aponkɛse, na medze abo fɛɛfɛw mayɛ wo kurotsia nyina.
Na wo mba nyinara Ewuradze bɛkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn; na wo mba hɔn asomdwee bɔdɔɔ sõ.
Ndzeyɛtsenenee mu na wobetsim wo: Enye nhyɛdo ntamu bɔtwe, osiandɛ innkosuro; enye ehuyi ntamu sõ, osiandɛ ɔnnkɛbɛn wo.
Hwɛ, wɔbɛkã hɔnho aboa, na ɔnnam mo do: Obiara a ɔbɔboaboa ano etsia wo no, ɔbɔhwe ase wɔ wo ntsi.
Hwɛ, emi na mabɔ ɔtomfo a ohutsa ogyabiriw mu, na oyi n'edwuma ho dadze pue; na emi na mabɔ ɔsɛɛfo dɛ ɔnsɛɛ no.
Dadze biara a wɔbɔ tsia wo no, ɔrennsaa: Na tɛkyerɛma biara a ɔbɔsoɛr etsia wo atsɛmbu mu no, ibohu no fɔ. Iyi nye Ewuradze nkowaa hɔn egyapadze, na hɔn tsenenee a ofi emi mara, Ewuradze na ɔse.
55: Ao o, obiara a nsukɔm dze no no, hom mbra esu no ho, na nyia onnyi sika; hom mbra mbɔtɔ, na hom ndzi; nyew, hom mbra mbɔtɔ wenyin na numfonsu a wɔnndze sika na wonntwa bo so.
Ebɛn ntsi na hom hwer sika ma dza ɔnnyɛ edziban? Na hom berɛ ho enyadze ma dza ɔmmee? Hom nyɛ aso mma me yie, na hom ndzi dza oye, na hom mma angoanam nyɛ hom kra dɛw.
Hom nkyɛn hom aso, na hom mbra me nkyɛn; hom ntsie, na hom akra bɛtsena ase: Na menye hom bedzi ɔdomankoma ahyɛmu. Dayid n'ehumbɔbɔr a osi pi no a.
Hwɛ, medze no mama dɛ am an hɔn dasefo, aman hɔn kwankyerɛfo na ɔsafohen.
Hwɛ, ebɛfrɛ ɔman a innyim hɔn, na ɔman a wonnyim wo no, wɔdze mbirika bɛba wo nkyɛn, osian Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, na Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ntsi; na ɔno na ɔahyɛ wo enyimnyam.
Hom nhwehwɛ Ewuradze ber a wobohu no yi, hom mfrɛ no ber a ɔbɛn yi:
Hom mma omumuyɛnyi ndan no kwan ngya, na ɔbrakyewuyi ndan n’adwen ngya: Na ɔnsan mbra Ewuradze nkyɛn, na obohu no mbɔbɔr; na hɛn Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na ɔdze befir mbordo.
Na nnyɛ m’adwen nye hom ad wen, eso nnyɛ hom akwan nye m’akwan, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na dɛ mbrɛ ɔsorsor krɔn bɔ asaase do no, dɛmara na m’akwan krɔn bɔ hom akwan do, na m’adwen bɔ hom adwen do.
Na dɛ mbrɛ nsu na esukwankyɛba fi sor gu famu, na ɔnnsan hɔ bio, na mbom ɔfɔw asaase, na ɔma ofifir aba na ɔbɔ nhyiren, na ɔdze aba ma oduafo, na edziban ma edzifo no;
mbrɛ asɛm a ofi m’anomu fir no ɔbɛyɛ ara nye no: Ɔrennsan mmba mo hɔ kwa, gyedɛ oewie dza mepɛ yɛ, na ɔayɛ prɔmprɔm wɔ dza osian ntsi ma mosomaa no no mu.
Na hom dze enyigye befir akɔ, na wɔdze asomdwee agye hom kwan: Mbepɔw na akoko bɛfa ehurusi ndwom edzi hom enyim, na hamu ndua nyinara abobɔ hɔn nsamu.
Kupresidua befir nsoɛ ananmu, na myrtle dua efir kɔkrɔw ananmu; na ɔbɛyɛ dzin ama Ewuradze, ayɛ daa asɛnkyerɛdze a worunntwa nnkyen.
56: Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hom nsie atsɛmbu, na hom nyɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee: Na mo nkwagye abɛn reba, na me tsenenee wɔrebeyi akyere.
Osiarfo nye nyimpa a ɔyɛ iyi, na nyimpa ba a osuo mu dzen; nyia osie ahomgyeda no dɛ onngu ho fi, na osie ne nsa fi mbusu biara no bɔ ho.
Eso mma ɔhɔho a ɔdze noho abɔbɔ Ewuradze ho no, nnkasa, dɛ, ɔtse ara na Ewuradze bɛtse me efi ne man ho: Eso mma ɔsaa nnse dɛ, hwɛ, emidze meyɛ dua wui.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se wɔ asaa no a wosie m’ahomgyenda, na wɔsan mu yi ndzɛmba a ɔsɔ m'enyi, na wosuo m’ahyɛmudzi mu pintsinn no ho nye yi:
Hɔn na medze me fie na m’afasu mu nkaadze ɔnye dzin a oye sen mbabanyin na mbabaa bɛma; mebɛma hɔn ɔdomankoma dzin a worunntwa nnkyen.
Nkyii so ananaben a wɔdze hɔnho bɔ Ewuradze ho, dɛ wɔrosom no, na wɔadɔ Ewuradze ne dzin dɛ wɔbɛyɛ no nkowaa no, obiara a osie ahomgyeda a onngu ho fi, na osuo m'ahyɛmudzi mu pintsinn no;

hɔnara so mpo na medze hɔn bɛba me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do, na mama hɔn enyi agye wɔ m’asɔrfi no mu; hɔn hye-wafɔr na hɔn kum-afɔr bɛyɛ enyiso wo m’afɔrmbukyia no do: Na me fie wɔbɛfrɛ no asɔrfi ama aman nyinara.
Ewuradze Nyankopɔn a ɔboaboa Israel atokyemfo no ano no ɔse dɛ, mebɛda ho ara maboa binom so ano abrɛ no, maka nankasa ne dza wɔaboa ano no ho.
Hom hambowa nyinara, nyew, hom kwaa mu mbowadoma nyinara, hom mbra mbɛmemen.
N’aweɔmfo enyi efurafura, hɔn nyinara wonnyim dze; hɔn nyinara akraman mmum a, wonntum mmpuow; wɔsõso adaa, wɔdeda hɔ, wɔpɛ nkontɔ.
Nyew, akraman no etumfur a, wɔremmee da; na woyinom nye nguanhwɛfo a wonntum nntse adze ase: Hɔn nyinara amanman afa hɔnankasa hɔn kwan do, obiara rohwehwɛ nc mfaso wɔ kwan biara do.
Wɔse dɛ, hom mbra, medze nsã bɛba ma yɛawe nsãdzen; na ɔkyena bɛyɛ dɛ ndɛ, da kɛse a ɔdɔɔ sõ mbordo.
57: Ɔtseneneenyi hera, na obiara mmfa nnto no werɛ mu; na wɔfa mbɔbɔrhufo kɔ, obiara nndwen ho dɛ mbusu a ɔreba no mu na woeyi ɔtseneneenyi efi ho.
Ɔkɛhɛn asomdwee mu; wɔhom wɔ hɔn mpa do, obiara obiara a ɔnantsew no tɔɔtsennyɛ mu no.
Na hom ɔbayifo ne mbabanyin, awartonyi na edwaman asefo, hom ntwe mbɛn ha.
Woana na hom kyerɛ homho wɔ no do yi? Woana na hom hanhan hom anomu, na hom worɔworɔw tɛkyerɛma wɔ no do yi? Aso hom nnyɛ mbrato mba, akɔhwi asefo,
hom a hom bɔ homho hyew wɔ nsudur mu, wɔ dua ebun ebun ase; hom a hom kuku mbofraba wɔ mbɔnsa no mu, wɔ abotan no ne mpaapae no ase?
Mbɔnsa no mu abo tortor no mu na wo kyɛfa wɔ; hɔn, hɔnara nye w’afamudze: Hɔnara mpo na ehue ehuensã egu hɔn do, abɔ hɔn edziban-afɔr. Aso mo bo bɔdwe wɔ iyinom ho?
Bepɔw sorɔnsorɔm a ɔkron etsifi na akɔtow wo kɛtɛ: Hɔ ara so na efowee kɔree kɔbɔɔ okum-afɔr.
Na mbobow na apondua ekyir na edze wo nkaadze esi: Na apa m’ekyir eyi woho akyerɛ obi so, na afow kɔ; ɔwo atserɛw wo kɛtɛ mu, na enye hɔn edzi ahyɛmu; epɛɛ hɔn kɛtɛ no wɔ mbrɛ ihunii no.
Na edze seradze sii mu kɔr ɔhen ne nkyɛn, na emaa w’eduhuam dɔɔ sõ, na esomaa w’ahembɔfo ekyirkyir, na etoo woho adze ara kɔr Sheol mpo.
Wo kwan ne tsentsen maa eberɛe; naaso annkã dɛ, enyidado nnyi hɔ: Inyaa w’ahoɔdzen no nkwa; dɛm ntsi na anntɔ bitsi.
Na woana na w’akoma etu no ho na esuro no, ma idzi ator, na annkaa me, eso ammfa annto w’akoma mu yi? Ana ommfir tsetse na maka m’ano ato mu komm, na ɔwo innsuro me yi?
Mebɛkã wo tsenenee akyerɛ; na wo ndwuma dze, ɔrennyɛ wo mfaso bi.

Sɛ etsēa mu a, ma hɔn a aprapra hɔn aboa ano no wɔngye wo; na mframa bɛfa hɔn akɔ, chuw bɔsoa hɔn nyinara akɔ: Na nyia ɔdze no werɛ twer me no, obenya asaase no edzi, na oenya me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no atsena do.
Na ɔbekã dɛ, hom ntow ngu sor, hom ntow ngu sor, hom nsiesie kwan no, hom nyiyi mfintsidua no wɔ me man hɔn kwan mu.

Na mbrɛ nyia ɔkrɔn na ɔyɛ abɔso a ɔtse onnyiewiei mu a ne dzin nye krɔnkrɔn no ɔse nye yi: Metse bea a ɔkrɔn na ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn do, wɔ nyia no sunsum abobɔ na abrɛ adze nkyɛn so, dɛ mebɛhyɛ ahobrɛadzefo sunsum nkwa, na mahwɛ hɔn a hɔn akoma abobɔ nkwa.
Na mirinndzi esi ara afebɔɔ, eso mo bo rummfuw daa: Na otwar dɛ sunsum na akra a mara mayɛ no, wɔtɔ bahaw wɔ m’enyim.
N’enyikaber emumuyɛ ntsi na mo bo fuwii na mobɔɔ no, muhuntsaa m’enyim na mo bo fuwii: Na ɔdaa ho ara nantseew akɔnkyew mu wɔ n’akoma no kwan mu.
Mehu n’akwan, mebɛsa no yarba: Mibegya no kwan so, na madan awerɛkyekyer mama ɔno ɔnye no nkɔmbɔdzifo.
Emi na mobɔ anofamfa n’aba: Asomdwee, asomdwee, nkã nyia ɔwɔ ekyirkyir na nyia ɔbɛn, Ewuradze na ɔse; na mebɛsa no yarba.
Na emumuyɛfo tse dɛ po a ɔapram; na ɔda a ɔnnyɛ, na n’esu puw dɛtsebir na nwura gu.
Asomdwee bi nnyi hɔ mma emumuyɛfo, me Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
58: Tsea mu, mma nnkam do, ma wo ndze do dɛ akasamu, na kã me man hɔn mbrato kyerɛ hɔn, na kã Jacob fifo hɔn bɔn kyerɛ hɔn.
Naaso wɔhwehwɛ me daa daa, na wɔpɛ dɛ wohu m’akwan: Dɛ ɔman bi a wɔyɛɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee, na wɔanndan hɔn Nyankopɔn nhyehyɛɛ enngya, wobisa me nhyehyɛɛ tsenenee, wɔpɛ dɛ wopinkyɛn Nyame.
Wɔdɛ, ebɛn ntsi na yeedzi mbuada, na ɔwo innhu? Ebɛn ntsi na yeehiahia hɛn kra ho, na ɔwo mmfa nnyɛ dze? Hwɛ, hom mbuadadzi da no mu, hom nya homankasa hom enyigye, na hom tseetsee hom edwumayɛfo.
Hwɛ, mansotwe na etutuwpɛ ntsi na hom dzi mbuada, na hom awowɔ emumuyɛ ekutuku: Hom nndzi mbuada ndɛ da yi, ama wɔaatse hom ndze wɔ sor.

Aso iyi nye mbuada a masan mu meyi no? Aso da a nyimpa hiahia ne kra ho nye yi? Aso ɔno nye dɛ ɔbɔbɔ ne tsir adze dɛ mbew, na ɔdze eyitam na nso asɛw n’ananadze? Aso ebɛfrɛ iyi dɛ mbuadadzi, na da a ɔso Ewuradze enyi?
Ana nnyɛ iyi nye mbuadadzi a masan mu meyi? Dɛ hom bɛsansan nhoma no, na na wɔama hɔn a wɔatseetsee hɔn no wɔaafa hɔnho edzi akɔ, na hom eebubu kɔndua nyina mu?
Ana nnyɛ ɔno nye dɛ ibubu w'edziban ma nyia ɔkɔm dze no, na dɛ edze abɔbɔfo a woeyi hɔn tokyen no ba wo fie? Sɛ ihu ɔdagyanyi a, ekata no ho; na dɛ emmfa woho nnhuntsa woara wo busuanyi.
Ɔno na wo kan bɛgyegye dɛ adzekyee, na wo yarsa efifir ntsɛm: Na wo tsenenee bedzi w'enyim; Ewuradze n'enyimnyam bɔbɔ wo nkyidɔm.
Ɔno na ebɛfrɛ, na Ewuradze bɛgya do; ebɛtsēa mu, na ɔbɛse dɛ, emi nye yi oo. Sɛ iyi kɔndua no, nsatseaba ne tsen, na ehuhukasa fi wo mu;
na sɛ edze dza wo kra no kɔn dɔ ma nyia ɔkɔm dze no, na ma ɔkra a oruhu amandze mee a; nna wo kan bopue wɔ sum mu, na wo kusuww ayɛ dɛ ewiaber ketee:
Na Ewuradze begya wo kwan daa, na ɔama wo kra amee wɔ mbrɛ hɔ yɛ kwawee, na ɔama wo mbiew ayɛ dzen; na ebɛyɛ dɛ ture a woegugu mu nsu, na dɛ mbasu a no nsu nntwe.
Na hɔn a wobefi wo mu no bɛkyekyer tsetse ekurofõ no: Na wɔbɛfrɛ wo Osiw tokur, nyia ɔsesɛw akwan a wɔtsena mu.

Sɛ iyi w’anan fi ahomgyeda no ho, na annyɛ wo pɛ ho edwuma wɔ me da krɔnkrɔn no mu; na efrɛ ahomgyeda no enyigyedze, na Ewuradze n’akrɔnkrɔndze no dɛ enyimnyamdze; na idzi no nyi, na annyɛ woara wo kwan do adze, na annhwehwɛ woara w’enyika, na annkã woara wo nsɛm a:
Ɔno na ebɛgye w’enyi wɔ Ewuradze mu; na mama anantsew asaase nsorɔnsorɔmbea do; na mama edzi w’egya Jacob n'egyapadze: Na Ewuradze ano na ɔakã.
59: Hwɛ, Ewuradze ne basa nntwaa tsia, dɛ onntum nkwa gye; eso n'aso nnyɛ dzen, dɛ ɔnntse asɛm;
na mbom hom emumuyɛ na apaa hom nye hom Nyankopɔn ntamu, na hom bɔn na oehuntsa n'enyi efi hom do, ma onnketsie.
Na bɔgya egu hom nsa ho fi, na emumuyɛ ehura hom nsatseaba ho; hom anofamfa akã atofosɛm, hom tɛkyerɛma hwinhwin ehuhusɛm.
Obiara nnsaman tsenenee mu, na obiara nndzi n'asɛm wɔ nokwar mu: Wɔdze hɔn werɛ hyɛ egyangyandze mu, na wɔkã atofosɛm; wonyinsen ewurkadze, na wɔwo emumuyɛ.
Wosuow akyerben nkyirefuwa, na wɔwen anansetotuan: Nyia odzi hɔn nkyirefuwa bi no, owu, na dza wɔbobɔ no, ɔpaa ehurutsia.
Hɔn etotuan no renndan atar, eso wɔremmfa hɔn ndwuma nnkata hɔnho: Hɔn ndwuma yɛ emumuyɛ ndwuma, na akakabensɛm wɔ hɔn nsamu.
Hɔn anan tutu mbirika kɔ mbusu mu, na wɔyɛ ntsɛm kɛka nyia onndzi fɔ no bɔgyaa: Hɔn adwen yɛ emumuyɛ adwen; amamfoyɛ na ɔsɛɛ wɔ akwan mu.
Asomdwee ɔtsempɔn no dze wonnyim; na atsɛmbu biara nnyi hɔn mu: Wɔabɔ hɔn akwan akyewakyew; obiara a ɔfa mu no onnyim asomdwee.
Dɛm ntsi na atsɛmbu nye hɛn ntamu atwe, eso ndzeyɛtsenenee nnto hɛn: Yɛhwɛ kan kwan, na hwɛ, sum nye yi; ɔhyerɛn so, na mbom yɛnam sunkamm mu.
Yɛkeka ban ho dɛ ofurafo, nyew, yɛkeka dɛ hɔn a wonnyi enyiwa: Yefintsiw ewiaber ketee dɛ wantawanta ber mu; yɛayɛ dɛ ewufo wɔ hɔn a wɔyɛ atwentwemfo mu.
Hɛn nyinara yɛpopɔw dɛ nsisi, na yɛkã mmɔn pii dɛ mbubur: Yɛhwɛ atsɛmbu kwan, na bi nnyi hɔ; nkwagye so, na ɔnye hɛn ntamu atwe koraa.
Na hɛn mbrato adɔɔ sõ pii wɔ w’enyim, na hɛn bɔn gye dase tsia hɛn: Osiandɛ hɛn mbrato wɔ hɛn nkyɛn, na hɛn emumuyɛ dze, yenyim:
Wɔ mbrato na Ewuradze do nkontompɔtwa mu, na ɔsan a yɛasan efi hɛn Nyankopɔn n’ekyirdzi mu, nhyɛdo na etuatsew ne kã, atofosɛm a yɛadwendwen ho na yeefi akoma mu akã.
Na wɔadan atsɛmbu asan ekyir, na ndzeyɛtsenenee ekegyina ekyirkyir noho: Osiandɛ nokwar ahwe ase wɔ abɔntsen do, na tɔɔtsennyɛ nntum nnhɛn mu.
Nyew, nokwar asã; na nyia otwa noho fi mbusu ho no, ɔyɛ noho afonara: Na Ewuradze hunii, na ɔannyɛ no abodwe dɛ atsɛmbu bi nnyi hɔ.
Na ohun dɛ nyimpa biara nnyi hɔ, na ɔyɛɛ no nwanwa dɛ odzimafo bi nnyi hɔ: Dɛm ntsi nankasa ne basa na ɔdze nkwagye brɛɛ no; na ne ndzeyɛtsenenee no, osuoo no mu gyinae.
Na ɔdze ndzeyɛtsenenee hyɛɛ dɛ akatabo, na nkwagye kyew so ne tsir; na ɔhyɛɛ awerdzi ntar dɛ akataho, na ɔhyɛɛ mbɔdzembɔ dɛ atar-egugudo.
Mbrɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ tse no, dɛmara na ɔbɛhyɛ ananmu, ɔdze ebufuhyew ama n’ahohia-hiafo, akatua ama n’atamfo; nsupow no ɔdze akatua bɛhyɛ hon ananmu.
Dɛm no wofi anee wobosuro Ewuradze ne dzin, na wofi wipuei esuro n’enyimnyam: Na ɔbɛba dɛ ɔwora a ɔrepem hwew hwew a Ewuradze ehuhuw ripia no.
Na ɔpomfo bɛba Zion, na hɔn a wɔsan fi mbrato ho wɔ Jacob mu no nkyɛn, Ewuradze na ɔse.

Na emidze, menye hɔn ntamu ahyɛmu no nye yi, Ewuradze na ɔse: Mo sunsum a ɔwɔ wo do, na me nsɛm a medze mahyɛ w'ano no rimmfi w'anomu, anaa w'asefo hɔn asefo so anomu, ofitsi ndɛ dze kesi daa, Ewuradze na ɔse.
60: Soɛr, hyerɛn; na wo kan aba, na Ewuradze n’enyimnyam asoɛr wo do.
Na, hwɛ, sum bɛkata asaase do, na sum kebii akata aman do: Na Ewuradze befir wo do, na n’enyimnyam woehu no wo do.
Na amanaman bɛba wo kan ho, na ahemfo aba wo mfirii ne hyerɛn ho.
Ma w'enyi do bɔ aprɔw, na hwɛ; hɔn nyinara wɔboa hɔn ano, wɔba wo nkyɛn: Wo mbabanyin fi ekyirkyir bɛba, na wo mbabaa so woetutur hɔn abaw mu.
Ɔno na ibohu na w’enyim atsew, na w’akoma behihim na ɔayɛ kɛse; osiandɛ adze-dodow fi po mu bɛdan aba wo hɔ, amanaman ahonya bɛba wo hɔ.
