Efumpɔnkɔ menyamenya bɛkata wo do, Midian na Ephah efumpɔnkɔfor; hɔn nyinara wofi Sheba bɛba, wɔdze sika na nduhuam, na wɔbɔbɔ Ewuradze n’ayɛyi dawur.
Kedar mbowa ekuwekuw nyina bɔboa ano aba wo nkyɛn, Nebaioth ndwanyin bɔsom wo; wɔbɔfow aba m’afɔrmbukyia no do enyisɔ mu, na mahyɛ m’enyimnyam fi no enyimnyam.
Woananom nye woyi a wotu dɛ nsuwusiw, na dɛ mbubur a wɔrokɔ hɔn ntokura mu yi?

Ampaara nsupɔw bɔtweɔn me, na Tarshish ahɛn dzi kan, dɛ wɔdze wo mbabanyin fi ekyirkyir rɛba, hɔn dwetɛ na hɔn sika ka hɔn ho, wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ne dzin ntsi, na Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ntsi, osiandɛ ɔno na ɔahyɛ wo enyimnyam.
Na ananaben bɔtow w’afasu, na hɔn ahemfo bɔsom wo: Na m’ebufuw mu na mobɔɔ wo, na m’enyimpa mu na mehu wo mbɔbɔr.
W’aponkɛse so bɛda hɔ daa; wɔronntotow mu adzekyee na adzesaa; ama adasa wɔdze amanaman ahonya aabrɛ wo, na wɔaaka hɔn ahemfo aka hɔn ho aba.
Na ɔman na ahenman biara a ɔnnkɔsom wo no, ɔbɛhera; nyew, amanaman no bɔbɔ huntuhuntu.
Lebanon n'enyimnyam bɛba wo hɔ, kupresidua, ɔsɛsɛw, na ɔpapaadua bɔbɔ mu, dze abɛyɛ mo krɔnkrɔnbea hɔ fɛɛfɛw, na maahyɛ m'anan tsiabea no enyimnyam.

Na hɔn a wohiahiaa wo ho no hɔn mbabanyin dze akotokotow bɛba wo nkyɛn; na hɔn a wobuu wo enyimtsia nyinara dze hɔn enyim bobom w’ananadze; na wɔbɛfrɛ wo Ewuradze no kuropon, Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ne Zion.
Susuampaara dɛ wɔadan wo egya na woekyir wo, na nyimpa biara ammfa wo mu ntsi, medze wo mebɛyɛ daa ataso, mbasantsen pii enyigye.
Eso ebɔnom amanaman numfonsu, na enum ahemfo hɔn enumfo: Na ibohu dɛ emi Ewuradze nye w’agyenkwa, na wo pomfo, Jacob ne Katakyi no.

Boran ananmu na medze sika mebɛba abɛhyɛ, na dadze ananmu na medze dwetɛ mebɛba abɛhyɛ, na dua ananmu na medze boran mebɛhyɛ, na abo ananmu medze dadze mebɛhyɛ: Eso mebɛma asomdwee ayɛ w’ahwɛdofo, na ndzeyɛtsenenee ayɛ wo bɔmbafo.
Wɔnnkɛtse akatabansɛm nka wɔ w’asesee mu bio, amambɔe anaa ɔsɛɛ nka wɔ w’ahe do; na ebɛfrɛ w’afasu Nkwagye, na w’aponkɛse Ayɛyi.
Ewia nnkɛyɛ wo kan adzekyee bio; eso bosoom nnkɛyɛ ɔhyerɛn ahyerɛn ama wo: Na Ewuradze bɛyɛ ɔdomankoma kan ama wo, na wo Nyankopɔn ayɛ w’enyimnyam.
W’ewia ronntɔ bio, eso wo bosoom ronntwe noho: Na Ewuradze bɛyɛ wo domankoma kan, na wo nkɔmbɔdzi da abɔ adze.
Wo man so nyinara bɛyɛ atseneneefo, wobenya asaase no edzi afebɔɔ; me ntsetsɛwee mu dubaa, me nsaano edwuma, ama wɔaahyɛ me enyimnyam.
Aketsewaba no bɛdaa apem, na ekumaba no adan ɔman dzendzen: Emi Ewuradze na mebɛyɛ no har wɔ ne ber mu.
61: Ewuradze no sunsum Wɔ mo do; osiandɛ Ewuradze asera me dɛ menkã nsɛmpa no menkyerɛ abɔbɔfo; ɔasoma me dɛ membɛkyekyer hɔn a hɔn akoma ebubu, mõmbɔbɔ fahodzi dawur menkyerɛ ndɔmmumfo, na efiadze n mbuei menkyerɛ hɔn a wɔakyekye hɔn;
mombɔbɔ Ewuradze n'enyisɔ afe no, na hɛn Nyankopɔn n'awerdzi da no dawur; dɛ menkyekye hɔn a wodzi nkɔmbɔ nyinara werɛ;

dɛ menhyehyɛ mma hɔn a wodzi nkɔmbɔ wɔ Zion, memma hɔn abɔtsir nhyɛ nso ananmu, enyigye ngo nhyɛ nkɔmbɔdzi ananmu, ayɛyi atar nhyɛ awerɛhow sunsum ananmu; ama wɔaafrɛ hɔn ndzeyɛtsenenee ndua, Ewuradze n'atsɛndua, ma wɔaahyɛ no enyimnyam.
Na wɔbɛkyekyer tsetse amamfõ no do egyinagyina, na wɔayeyɛ nkurow a egugu, mbasantsen pii amamfõ no yie.
Na ahɔho begyina na wɔanyɛn hom mbowakuw, na amamforafo ayɛ hom ekuafo na hom wenyin ntureahwɛfo.
Na homdze, wɔbɛfrɛ hom Ewuradze asɔfoe: Adasa bɛfrɛ hom hɛn Nyankopɔn n asomfo: Hom bedzi amanaman ahonya, na hɔn enyimnyam mu na hom bɛhyehyɛ homho.
Hom benya mbɔho ahyɛ hom enyito no anamnu; na wobedzi ehurusi wɔ hɔn kyɛfa mu ahyɛ hɔn enyimguase ananmu: Dɛm ntsi wo benya mbɔho wɔ hɔn asaase no do: Ɔdomankoma dɛw bɛyɛ hɔndze.
Na emi Ewuradze modɔ atsɛmbu, mikyir edwotwadze a emumuyɛ ka ho; na medze hɔn akatua mebɛma hɔn nokwar mu, na menye hɔn edzi ɔdomankoma ahyɛmu.
Na wobohu hɔn asefo wɔ amanaman mu, na hɔn mba wɔ aman mu: Hɔn a hɔn enyi bɔ hɔn do nyinara bohu dɛ hɔn nye asefo a Ewuradze ehyira hɔn.

Mibedzi ehurusi kɛse wɔ Ewuradze mu, me kra enyi bɛgye me Nyankopɔn mu; na ɔdze nkwagye ntar ahyɛ me, ɔdze tsenenee bataker ewuna me, dɛ mbrɛ ayeforkun dze abɔtsir bɔ, na dɛ mbrɛ ayefor dze h’edwindze hyehyɛ.
Na dɛ mbrɛ asaase dze no nkukuduuduw pue, na dɛ mbrɛ ture ma dza woedua no wɔ mu no fifir no; dɛmara so na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn bɛma tsenenee na ayɛyi efifir wɔ amanaman nyinara enyim.
62: Zion ntsi mennkɛka m'ano ato mu, na Jerusalem ntsi mennkɛgye m'ahom, ekodu dɛ ne tsenenee befir edzi dɛ kan hyɛnhyɛn, na no akwagye dɛ kandzea a ɔdzɛw.
Na amanaman bohu wo tsenee, na ahemfo nyinara ehu w'enyimnyam: Na wɔbɔto wo dzin fofor bi a Ewuradze n'ano bɔbɔ dzin.
Ebɛyɛ ahoɔfɛw abɔtsir wɔ Ewuradze nsamu so, na ahenkyɛw wɔ wo Nyankopɔn nsamu.
Wɔnnkɛda ho bio afrɛ wo Nyia wɔapow no; eso w'asaase wɔnnkɛfrɛ no Amamfõ bio: Na mbom wɔbɛfrɛ wo Hephzi-bah, na w'asaase so Beulah: Osiandɛ Ewuradze dze wɔ wo ho enyika, na wɔbɔwar w'asaase no.
Na dɛ mbrɛ aberantse war ɔbaabun no, dɛmara so na wo mbabanyin bɔwar wo: Na mbrɛ ayeforkun no ho sɛpɛw no ayefor ho no, dɛmara so na wo Nyankopɔn no ho bɛsɛpɛw no wo ho.
Jerusalem, mesisi aweɔmfo wɔ w'afasu do; wɔrennka hɔn ano nnto mu adzekyee anaa adzesaa: Hom a hom yɛ akaakaafo ma Ewuradze, mma hom nngye hom ahom,
na mma hom mma no ahomgye, ma onkodu dɛ obetsim Jerusalem, na ɔama ɔayɛ ayɛyi wɔ asaase do.
Ewuradze dze n’abanyimfa na n’ahoɔdzen basa akã ntam dɛ, ampaara mennkɛfa w’eburow mama w’atamfo dɛ edziban bio: Na ahɔho nnkɔnom wo wenyin a aberɛ ho no bio:
Na hɔn a wɔdze ahyɛ san do no na wobedzi eyi Ewuradze ayɛw; na hɔn a wɔatsew no na wɔbɔnom no wɔ mo krɔnkrɔn-bea abangua do.
Hom ndua mu, hom ndua aponkɛse no mu; hom mbo ɔman no hɔn kwan no; hom ntutu nhɔr, hom ntutu nhor nyɛ ɔtsempɔn; hom ntase mu abo no, hom mma frankaa do mma aman no.
Hwɛ, Ewuradze abɔ dawur edu asaase ewiei noho dɛ, hom nse Zion babaa dɛ, hwɛ, wo nkwagye reba; hwɛ ɔdze n’akatua nam, na n’ahyɛnanmu dzi n’enyim.
Na wɔbɛfrɛ hɔn ɔman krɔnkrɔn, hɔn a Ewuradze apon hɔn: Na wɔbɛfre wo Nyia-wɔahwehwɛ-no-ehu-no, kurow-a-wɔmmpow-no.
63: Woana nye oyi a ofi Edom reba a ohyɛ Bozrah bogyaben ntar yi? Oyi a oyɛ onyimnyam-fo wɔ n’afadze mu, ɔrekyea wɔ n’ahoɔdzen akeseye mu yi? Emi a mekasa ndzeyetsenenee mu a, otumfo a ɔgye nkwa a.
Oye dɛn ntsi na w’afadze aber dɛm, na wo ntar ayɛ dɛ nyia otsiatsia wenyintwer mu nedze yi?

Mo nko ara na metsiatsia wenyintwer no do; na aman no mu nyimpa biara nnka mo ho: Nyew, mitsiatsiaa hon do wɔ m’ebufuw mu, na misiiw hɔn wɔ m’ebufuhyew mu; na hɔn mu bɔgya abɔ apetse me ntar mu, na wɔama m’efuradze nyinara mu ayɛ nkekãa.
Na awerdzi da baa m’akoma mu, na mo nkorɔfo a mapon hɔn no hɔn afe no aba.
Na mohwɛe, na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔboa; na ɔyɛɛ me nwanwa dɛ obi nnyi hɔ a osuo mu gyina: Dɛm ntsi mankasa m’abasa na ɔdze nkwagye brɛɛ me; na m’ebufu-hyew na osuoo mo mu gyinae.
Na mitsiatsiaa aman no do wɔ m’ebufuw mu, na memaa wɔbobowee wɔ m’ebufuhyew mu, na muhuee hɔn mu bɔgya muguu asaase do.

Mobɔbɔ Ewuradze n’adɔyɛdze, na Ewuradze n’ayɛyi dzin, dɛ mbrɛ dza Ewuradze dze ama hɛn nyinara tse; na yieyɛ kɛse a ɔdze ayɛ Israel fifo a ɔdze ama hɔn dɛ mbrɛ no mbɔbɔrhu tse, na dɛ mbrɛ n’adɔyɛ no dodow tse.
Na ɔkãa dɛ, ampaara, wɔyɛ me man, mba a worunntwa abra: Ntsi na ɔyɛɛ hɔn agyenkwa.
Hɔn ahohia nyinara mu no ho hiaa no bi, na n’enyim ɔbɔfo no gyee hɔn nkwa: No dɔ na ne tsimbɔbɔr mu na ɔpoon hɔn; na otuur hɔn, na ɔsoaa hɔn tsetsenda no nyinara mu.
Na hɔndze, wɔtseew etūa, na wɔhoow no sunsum krɔnkrɔn no werɛ: Dɛm ntsi na ɔdanee bɛyɛɛ hɔn tamfo, na noara ɔnye hɔn dzii akõ.
Nna ɔkaa tsetsenda no, Moses, na ne man no, dɛ, nyia ɔdze hɔn ɔnye no mbowakuw ahwɛfo no fii po mu bae no wɔ hen? Nyia ɔdze no sunsum krɔnkrɔn hyɛɛ hɔn finimfin no wɔ hen?
Nyia ɔmaa n’enyimnyam basa dzii Moses n’abanyimfa kɔree no? Nyia ɔpaa nsu no mu wɔ hɔn enyim dze gyee ɔdomankoma dzin maa noho no?
Nyia ɔgyee hɔn duaa ebun no mu, dɛ pɔnkɔ nam sar do, na woemmfintsiw no?
Dɛ anantwi a wosiansian kɔ bɔnsa mu, na Ewuradze no sunsum maa wɔhomee: Dɛmara so na igyaa wo man kwan, dze gyee enyimnyam dzin maa woho.
Fi sor hwɛ famu, na fi wo krɔnkrɔnyɛ na w’enyimnyam tsenabea hɔ hwɛ: Wo mbɔdzembɔ na w’akatakyidze no wɔ henfa? Wo nson mu pɔtɔw na w’ayamuhyehye no woesianka no wɔ mo do.
Na ɔwoara nye hɛn egya, sɛ Abraham nnyim hɛn, na Israel nngye hɛn nnto mu mpo a: Ewuradze, ɔwoara nye hɛn egya; hɛn pomfo nye wo dzin fir tsetseetse.
Ewuradze, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ema yɛfom fi w'akwan do na ipirim hɛn akoma fi wo suro ho? Wo nkowaa, w'egyapadze mbusuakuw no ntsi, san bra.
Wo man krɔnkrɔn nyaa no mber ketseabaa bi: Hɛn ahohiahiafo etsiatsia wo krɔnkrɔn-bea no do.
Yɛabɛyɛ dɛ hɔn a inndzii hɔn do tum da; dɛ hɔn a wɔammfa wo dzin ammfrɛ hɔn no.
64: Ao, kɛtseankyɛ esunsuan ɔsorsor mu, nkyɛ esian famu, ma mbepɔw apem asen wɔ w’enyim;
dɛ mbrɛ ogya ma mbabaaba dzɛw, na ogya no ma esu hur: Ma w’atamfo eehu wo dzin, na amanaman ho aapopo wɔ w’enyim!
Ber a eyɛɛ ndzɛmba huhuhuhu a hɛn enyi annda kwan no, ɔwo isianee, mbepɔw nanee senee wɔ w’enyim.
Ofi tsetse adasa nntsee, aso mmbɔɔ do, enyiwa so nnhun Nyankopɔn bi ka wo ho a odzi dwuma ma nyia ɔtweɔn no no.
Ɔwo na ihyia nyia odzi ehurusi na ɔyɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee, hɔn a wɔkaa wo wɔ w’akwan mu: Hwɛ, ɔwo wo bo fuwii, na hɛn yɛyɛɛ bɔn: Hɔn mu na yɛwɔ dadaada, na aso wɔbɛgye hɛn nkwa?
Na hɛn nyinara ayeyɛ dɛ obi a no ho egu fi, na hɛn tsenenee nyinara tse dɛ atar fi pɔtɔɔ: Na hɛn nyinara yɛpa dɛ ahataw; na hɛn emumuyɛ soa hɛn kɔ dɛ mframa.
Na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔbɔ wo dzin, anaa okenyan noho a obosuo wo mu: Na ɔwo eyi w’enyim ehuntsa hɛn, na enam hɛn emumuyɛ do ama yɛahyew.
Na afei, Ewuradze, ɔwoara nye hɛn egya; awendɛtse no nye hɛn, na ɔwemfo no nye woara; na hɛn nyinara yɛyɛ wo nsaano edwuma.
Ewuradze, mma wo bo mmfuw pii, eso mma nnkaa emumuyɛ daa: To enyi hwɛ, yɛtotɔ serɛ wo, hɛn nyinara yɛyɛ wo man.
Wo nkurow krɔnkrɔn no adan sar, Jerusalem adan amamfõ.
Hɛn fi krɔnkrɔn fɛɛfɛw a hɛn egyanom yii wo ayɛw wɔ mu no, wɔdze ogya ahyew no; na hɛn afɛɛfɛdze nyinara ayɛ amamfõ.
Ewuradze, aso iyinom ntsi ebɛkam woho? Aso ebɛyɛ komm, na ahaw hɛn kɛse pii?
65: Hɔn a woemmbisa me ahwehwɛ m'ekyir kwan; hɔn a wɔannhwehwɛ me ehu me; mesee ɔman a wɔammfa me dzin ammfrɛ hɔn no dɛ, wɔnhwɛ, me, wɔnhwɛ me.
Matserɛw m'abaw mu adzekyee nyina mama ɔman etuatsewfo a wɔnantsew ɔkwan a onnye mu dzi hɔnanakasa hɔn adwen ekyir;
ɔman a woyi me ehi wɔ m'enyim daa nyina, wɔbobɔ okumafɔr wɔ nture mu, na wɔhyew nduhuam wɔ ntaayaa do;
hɔn a wɔtsenatsena nda ho, wɔsoɛsoɛ asa mandan mu; wodzi mprekonam ekyiwadze nkwan wɔ hɔn asɛn'mu;
wɔkã dɛ, tse woho gyina, mma mmbɛn me nkyɛn, na mo ho tsew sen wo: Iyinom yɛ wusiw wɔ m’ahwen mu ogya a ɔdzɛw adzekyee nyina.
Hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ m'enyim: Murummua m’ano na mbom mebɛhyɛ ananmu, nyew, mebɛbyɛ ananmu egu hɔn bo mu,
homara hom emumuyɛ na hom egyanom hɔn emumuyɛ ka ho, dɛ wɔahyew nduhuam wɔ mbepɔw do, na wɔakã mo ho asɛm bɔn wɔ akoko do, Ewuradze na ɔse: Dɛm ntsi mibedzi kan mesusu hɔn edwuma megu hɔn akoko mu.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, dɛ mbrɛ wohu nsã fofor wɔ wenyinaba siaw mu, na obi kã dɛ, mma nnsɛɛ no, na nhyira wɔ mu no: Dɛmara so na mebɛyɛ wɔ mo nkowaa ntsi, amma mannsɛɛ hɔn nyinara.
Na medze asefo befi Jacob mu aba, na me mbepɔw adzedzinyi efi Judah aba: Na me mpamufo benya edzi, na mo nkowaa bɛtsena hɔ.
Na Sharon bɛyɛ nguamban na Achor bɔnsa ayɛ anantwikuw dabea, ama me man a wɔhwehwɛɛ m’ekyir kwan no.
Na hom a hom dan Ewuradze gya, hom werɛ fir me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn, hom to pon ma Isiar, na hom hyɛ aforafora nsã ma Nkrabea;
mebɛhyɛ hom mama afõwa, na hom nyinara bɔkotow ama oku: Osiandɛ mefrɛe no, hom emmbua; mekasae no, hom anntse; na mbom hom yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ m’enyi do, na hom saan mu yii dza minnyi enyigye wɔ mu.

Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn se nye yi, hwɛ, mo nkowaa bedzidzi, na homdze, ɔkɔm bɛdze hom: Hwɛ, mo nkowaa bɔnom, na homdze, nsukɔm bɛdze hom: Hwɛ, mo nkowaa bedzi ehurusi, na homdze hom enyi bowu:
Hwɛ, mo nkowaa bɔtow ndwom wɔ akoma mu enyigye ntsi, na homdze, hom bɛkeka mu wɔ akoma mu awerɛhow ntsi, na hom aka mmɔn wɔ sunsum n'ahomtsew ntsi.
Na hom begyaa hom dzin aayɛ ndom ama me mpamufo, na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn boku wo; na ɔbɔto no nkowaa dzin fofor:

Ama nyia ohyira noho wɔ asaase do no, oeehyira noho wɔ nokwar Nyankopɔn mu; na nyia ɔkã ntam wɔ asaase do no, ɔdze nokwar Nyankopɔn akã ntam; osiandɛ werɛ efir nkan no fona no, na osiandɛ oehuntsa efi m’enyi do.
Na, hwɛ, mobɔ ɔsorsor fofor na asaase fofor: Na nkan no ndzɛmba no wɔrennkaa, eso wɔremmfa mmba adwen mu bio.
Na mbom hom nnya ahomka na hom ndzi ehurusi daa daa wɔ dza morobɔ no ntsi: Na, hwɛ, morobɔ Jerusalem ma aayɛ ehurusi, na ne man ma aayɛ dɛw.
Na mibedzi ehurusi wɔ Jerusalem ho, na m’enyi agye wɔ me man ho: Na wɔnnkɛtse ne nka wɔ no mu bio, anaa nkekamu nka.
Ofitsi hɔ dze kɔ no, abɔtoaba a ne nda suar, anaa akɔdaa a onnwiee ne nda dzi remmba hɔ bio: Na abofra bedzi mfe ɔha ana oewu, na ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi a oedzi mfe ɔha no bɛyɛ obusunyi.
Na wobesisi adan, na wɔatsenatsena mu; na wɔatsɛw wenyin nture, na woedzi no mu aba.
Wonnkesi, na obi atsena mu; wɔnnkɛtsɛw, na obi edzi: Na mbrɛ dua ne nda tse no, mbrɛ me man hɔn nda bɛyɛ ara nye no, na me mpamufo bedzi hɔn nsaano edwuma akyɛr.
Wɔnnkɛberɛ kwa, eso wɔronnwo mba mma mbusu; na wɔyɛ Ewuradze n’esiarfo hɔn asefo, na hɔn mba ka hɔn ho.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, ansaana wɔrefrɛ no, nna magye do; na wɔda do rekasa no, nna matse.
Ɔpataku na eguambaa bedzidzi fakor, na ogyata awe efuw dɛ ɔnantwi: Na huntuma na ɔbɛyɛ abowatsena n’edziban. Wɔnnkɛyɛ obi bɔn, eso wɔrennsɛɛ wɔ me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn nyina do, Ewuradze na ɔse.
66: Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, Ɔsor yɛ m’ahengua, na asaase yɛ m’ananadzegua: Ɔdan a ɔtse dɛn na hom besi ama me? Na henfa na ɔbɛyɛ m’ahomgyebea?

Na ndzɛmba iyinom nyinara me nsa na ɔayɛ, na mbrɛ ndzɛmba iyinom nyinara yɛe bae nye no, Ewuradze na ɔse: Na nyimpa a mobɔhwɛ no nye oyi, mekyerɛ onyia no a ɔyɛ ɔbɔbɔfo na sunsum a ɔabɔbɔ, na no ho popo wɔ m’asɛm ntsi no.

Nyia oku ɔnantwi ɔtse dɛ nyia oku nyimpa ara so; nyia oku eguambaa bɔ afɔr no, ɔtse dɛ nyia obu kraman no kɔn mu; nyia ɔbɔ edziban-afɔr no, ɔtse dɛ nyia ɔbɔ preko bɔgyaa afɔr; nyia ɔhyew eduhuam no, ɔtse dɛ nyia ohyira ohonyi: Nyew, hɔn nyinara asan mu eyiyi hɔnankasa hɔn akwan na hɔn kra enyi gye hɔn ekyiwadze mu;

emi so mebɛsan mu meyi hɔn ndaadaa, na medze hɔn suro aba hɔn do; osiandɛ mefrɛe a, obi anngye do; mekasae a, wɔanntse: Na mbom wɔyɛɛ dza ɔyɛ mbusu wɔ m’enyi do, na wɔsaan mu yii dza minnyi mu enyigye.

Hom ntsie Ewuradze n’asɛm, hom a hom ho popo wɔ n’asɛm ho: Hom nuanom a wɔtan hom, wɔtow hom kyen wɔ me dzin ntsi no, wɔkã dɛ, wɔnhyɛ Ewuradze enyimnyam, ma yenhu hom enyigye; na hɔndze, hɔn enyi bɔtõ.
Dede weɔɔ fi kurow no mu, dede fi asɔrdan no mu, Ewuradze ne ndze a ɔdze ahyɛnanmu hyɛ n’atamfo no a.
Onnyae nnkyemee no, ɔwoe; awooyaw nnyae nnkaa no no, nna ɔawo ɔbabanyin.
Woana atse iyi bi da? woana ehu iyinom bi pɛn? Aso wɔkyem wo asaase da kor? Aso wɔwo ɔman prɛko? Na Zion dze, ɔkyemee ara, nna ɔwoo ne mba.
Aso emidze, medze bɛba awotoa ano, na meremma wɔnnwo? Ewuradze na ɔse: Aso emi a mema wɔwo no, mibesiw awotoa ano? Wo Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
Hom nye Jerusalem ndzi ehurusi, na hom ho nsɛpɛw hom wɔ no ho, hom a hom dɔ no nyinara: Hom nye no ndzi ehurusi wɔ enyigye ntsi, hom a hom dzi no ho nkɔmbɔ nyinara:
Ama hom eenum n’awerɛbaa enumfo no amee; ama hom eekyi numfonsu, na hom enyi agye n’enyimnyam mbordo no ho.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ, mebɛtsen asomdwee mama no dɛ esutsen, na amanaman enyimnyam no dɛ ɔworaba a oeyir, na hom bonum bi; wobotur hom nkyɛmfa mu, na wɔagyegye hom anankoroma do.
Dɛ obi a ne nã kyekye no werɛ no, dɛmara na mebɛkyekye hom werɛ; na hom werɛ bɛkyekye wo Jerusalem.
Na hom bohu, na hom akoma edzi ehurusi, no hom mbiew bowuna dɛ aha ban fɔr: Na wobohu Ewuradze ne nsa wɔ no nkowaa afamu, na obenya n'atamfo ho ebufuhyew.
Na, hwɛ, Ewuradze dze ogya bɛba, na ne ntseaseanam bɛyɛ dɛ ekyinehyia-mframa; dɛ ommbobu n’ebufuw ama wɔ ebufuhyew mu na ne nkaenyim wɔ ogyaframee mu.
Na Ewuradze dze ogya na afõwa na ɔnye adasa nyinara bedzi: Na Ewuradze n’atɔfoe bɔdɔɔsõ.
Hɔn a wɔtsew hɔnho na woguar hɔnho dɛ wɔbɔkɔ nture mu a, wodzi ɔbaako a odzi finimfin no n’ekyir, woridzi prekonam, na ekyiwadze, na okura no; wɔbɔbɔ mu aba ewiei, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na minyim hɔn ndwuma na hɔn adwen: Mber reba a mobɔboaboa amanaman na kasa horow nyinara ano; na wɔbɛba, na woebohu m’enyimnyam.

Na medze asɛnkyerɛdze besi hɔn mu, na masoma hɔn mu hɔn a wobefi nsa no ako amanaman no hɔ, Tarshish, Pul na Lud a wɔkontom egyen no, Tubal na Jayan, nsupɔw a wɔwɔ ekyirkyir a wɔnntsee me nka, eso wonnhun m’enyimnyam no; na wɔbɛkã m’enyimnyam akyerɛ wo amanaman mu.

Na wɔdze hom nuanom nyinara befi amanaman nyinara mu aba dɛ ayɛyɛdze ama Ewuradze, wɔ mpɔnko do, na ntseaseanam mu, na nsako mu, na nsoasompɔnkɔ do, na mbowa a hɔn ho yɛ har do, aba me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn Jerusalem do, Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba dze hɔn ayɛyɛdze wɔ kuraba a no ho tsew mu ba Ewuradze fie.
Na hɔn mu binom so na mebɛfa mayɛ asɔfo Levifo, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na dɛ mbrɛ ɔsorsor afofor na asaase fofor a mebɛyɛ no, bɛka wɔ m’enyim no, Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛmara so na hom asefo na hom dzin bɛka.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ ofi bosoam fofor kor do kodu kor so do, na ofi ahomgyeda kor do kodu kor so do no, nyimpa nyinara bɛba abɔsɔr wɔ m’enyim Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na wobefir edzi akɔ akɔhwɛ nyimpa a wɔatõ mbra etsia me no hɔn efun: Na hɔn abowaba nnkowu, eso hɔn gya nnkodum; na wɔbɛyɛ ekyiwadze ama adasa nyinara.

1: James, Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Christ akowaa, kyia mbusuakuw duebien a wɔapetse.
Mo nuanom, sɛ hom hwɛ nsɔhwɛ horow mu a, hom mbu no dɛw koraa;
na hom nhu dɛ hom gyedzi no nsɔhwɛ yɛ abotar ho edwuma.
Na hom mma abotar nwie n'edwuma yɛ pɛ, na hom eedzi mu pirim a ɔnnka hom hweeara.
Na sɛ hom mu biara ne nyansaa tɔ sin a, ombisa Nyankopɔn a ɔdze ma nyimpa nyina kwa na ɔnnkã enyim no, na ɔdze bɛma no.
Na gyedzi mu na ma ombisa, ɔnnyɛ hwee ho ekyingye: Na nyia ɔgye kyim no tse dɛ po asorɛkye a mframa ridzi no akɔnaaba.
Na mma dɛm nyimpa no nndwen dɛ obenya Ewuradze hɔ biribi;
nyimpa a n'adwen ebien ebien, ohihim n'akwan nyina mu.
Na wɔmma onua a ɔbrɛ adze ndzi dɛw wɔ ɔma a wɔama no do no mu;
na ɔdze so, wɔ brɛ a wɔabrɛ no adze no mu; osiandɛ ɔbɛsen akɔ dɛ nkyɛkyɛr nhyiren.
Na ewia dza ne hyehye fir na ɔhyew nkyɛnkyɛ, na ne nhyiren po, na no su ne fɛw sɛɛ; dɛmara so na ɔdzefo bɛpa wɔ n'akwan mu.
Siarfo nye nyimpa a ɔsɔw nsɔhwɛ; na sɛ otum gyina enyim a, obenya nkwa ahenkyɛw a Ewuradze dze abɔ hɔn a wɔdɔ no no anohoba no.
Sɛ wɔsɔ obiara hwɛ a, mma ɔnnkã dɛ, Nyankopɔn na ɔsɔ me hwɛ: Na bɔn bi nntum nnsɔ Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ, na ɔno so nnsɔ obiara nnhwɛ:
na obiara wɔsɔ no hwɛ, ɔnam dɛ nankasa n'akɔndɔ twe no kɔ na ɔdaadaa no.
Na akɔndɔ no nyinsen a, ɔwo bɔn; na bɔn no wie nyin a, ɔwo owu.
Mo nuanom adɔfo, mma wɔnndaadaa hom.
Akyɛdze pa nye adom adze odzi mu nyina fi sor, ofir kan Egya no nkyɛn na osian ba, ɔno na nsakyer nye sunsum a ɔadandan dze ba nnyi no ho.
Ɔnam nankasa ne pɛ do na ɔdze nokwasɛm woo hɛn, ma yaayɛ n'abɔdze mu abakan bi.
Hom nyim yi, mo nuanom adɔfo. Ntsi wɔmma nyimpa biara nyɛ ntsɛm ntsie, nyɛ nyaa nkasa, nyɛ nyaa mfa ebufuw:
na nyimpa ebufuw nnyɛ Nyankopɔn tsenenee ho edwuma.
Dɛm ntsi hom nyi atantandze nye bɔn mbordo nyina ntow ngu, na hom mfa ɔdwe ngye asɛm a wɔatsɛw no hom mu a obotum agye hom akra nkwa no.
Na hom nyɛ asɛm no ayɛfo, na mma hom nnyɛ etsiefo nko nndaadaa homho.
Na sɛ obi yɛ asɛm no ne tsiefo, na sɛ ɔnnyɛ ne yɛfo a, ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a ɔhwɛ n'enyim bɔfoma wɔ ahwehwɛ mu:
Na ɔhwɛ noho na ɔkɔ, na ntsɛmara na no werɛ efir nyimpa su kor a ɔyɛ.
Na nyia ɔhwɛ adehyedzi mbra a odzi mu no mu, na ogyina do, na ɔnnyɛ otsiefo werɛfirnyi na ɔyɛ edwuma no yɛfo no, ɔno na wobehyira no n'adzeyɛ mu.
Sɛ obi dwen noho dɛ ɔyɛ nyamesomnyi na ɔannto ne tɛkyerɛma ndabraka na ɔdaadaa nankasa n'akoma a, dɛm nyimpa no ne nyamesom yɛ kwa.
Nyamesom a ho tsew na ho nnyi fi wɔ hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn, enyim nye dɛ, ebɔhwɛ ngyanka nye ekunafo wɔ hɔn ahohia mu, na eyi woho efi wiadze nkekaa mu.
2: Mo nuanom, mma hom mmfa nyimpa enyim nyiyimu nnsuo enyimnyam Wura no, ne gyedzi no mu,
Na sɛ nyimpa a ɔhyɛ sika pɛtsea nye atar fɛɛfɛɛ ba hom hyiamudan mu, na sɛ hianyi a ɔhyɛ atar tantan bi so ba hɔ,
na sɛ hom nya enyidzi ma nyia ɔhyɛ atar fɛɛfɛw no, na hom se no dɛ, tsena tsenabea pa ha, na hom se hianyi no dɛ, gyina noho, anaa, tsena m'ananadzegua ho ha a,
ana nnyɛ nyiyimu na hom ayɛ wɔ hom mu, na hom ayɛ adwen bɔn tsɛmbuafo?
Mo nuanom adɔfo, hom ntsie: Ana Nyankopɔn mmfaa wiadze ehiafo dɛ wɔnyɛ gyedzi mu ahomyafo nye adzeadzifo wɔ ahenman a ɔdze bɔɔ hɔn a wɔdɔ no no anohoba no?
Naaso hom ebu ohianyi enyimtsia. Ana nnyɛ ahonyafo na wɔhyɛ hom do, na hɔnankasa wɔtwe hom kɔ asɛndzii no?
Ana nnyɛ hɔn na wɔkã dzin pa a wɔdze frɛ hom no ho asɛmbɔn?
Naaso sɛ hom hyɛ mbra kunyin no mã, dɛ mbrɛ kyerɛw no kã dɛ, dɔ wo nyɛko dɛ woara wo ho no a, hom yɛ papa;
na sɛ hom yɛ nyimpa enyim nyiyimu a, hom yɛ bɔn, na mbra no yi hom atsɛn dɛ mbratofo.
Na obiara a obedzi mbra mu no nyina do na ɔatõ kor no, odzi ne nyina ho fɔ.
Na nyia ɔsee dɛ, mma nntõ awar no, ɔkãe so dɛ, mma nndzi ewu. Na sɛ anntõ awar na idzi ewu a, ayɛ mbra no tõfo.
Hom nkã dɛm, na hom nyɛ dɛm, dɛ nyimpa a wɔnam adehyedzi mbra no do rubobu hom atsɛn.
Na atsɛmbu nnyi ehumbɔbɔr mma nyia oennhu mbɔbɔr no: Ehumbɔbɔr hyehyɛ noho tsia atsɛmbu.
Mo nuanom, sɛ obi kã dɛ ɔwɔ gyedzi na onnyi ndwuma a, ebɛn mfaso na ɔyɛ? Aso dɛm gyedzi no bɛgye no nkwa?
Sɛ onua anaa akyerɛbaa dzi adagyaw, na anomu adzidzi abɔ hɔn,
na sɛ hom mu bi se hɔn dɛ, hom mfa asomdwee nkɔ, hom ho nyɛ hom hyew, na hom mmee, na sɛ hom amma hɔn dza ehia nyimpadua no a, ebɛn mfaso na ɔyɛ?
Dɛmara na sɛ gyedzi so nnyi ndwuma a, nna oewu wɔ nankasa no mu.
Nyew, obi bɛse dɛ, ɔwo ewɔ gyedzi, na mo so mowɔ ndwuma: Kyerɛ me wo gyedzi a ndwuma nnyi ho, na mo so menam mo ndwuma do bɛkyerɛ wo me gyedzi.
Egye dzi dɛ Nyankopɔn kortoo: Noara nye no: Mbɔnsam so gye dzi na hɔn ho popo.
Na ɔwo, nyimpa huhuw, epɛ dɛ ihu dɛ gyedzi a ndwuma nnkã ho nnsow aba.
Ana nnyɛ ndwuma mu na wɔnam buu hɛn egya Abraham bem, wɔ dɛ ɔdze ne ba Isaac bɔɔ afɔr wɔ afɔrpata no do?
Ihu dɛ ne gyedzi nye no ndwuma yɛɛ adze, na ɔnam ndwuma do na ne gyedzi dzii mu;
na kyerɛwsɛm no hyɛɛ mã, dza ɔkã dɛ, Abraham gyee Nyankopɔn dzii na wɔban no tsenenee maa no na wɔfrɛ no Nyankopɔn nyɛnko.
Na hom hu dɛ ɔnam ndwuma do na wobu nyimpa bem, na ɔnnam gyedzi nko do.
Ana nnyɛ dɛmara so na wɔnam ndwuma do buu edwaman Rahab bem, wɔ dɛ ɔgyee abɔfo no, na ɔmaa wɔfaa kwan fofor do kɔree?
Na dɛ mbrɛ nyimpadua nnyi sumsum a, nna oewu no, dɛmara na gyedzi so nnyi ndwuma a, nna oewu.
3: Mo nuanom, mma hom nnyɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo pii, na hom nyim dɛ yebenya afɔdzi kɛse mbom.
Na hɛn nyina yɛfom ndzɛmba pii mu. Sɛ obi mmfom asɛm mu a, ɔno na ɔyɛ nyimpa a odzi mu a otum dɛ ɔto ne nyimpadua nyinara so ndabraka.
Na sɛ yɛdze ndabraka to mpɔnkɔ anomu ma woeetsie hɛn a, yɛdandan hɔn abowamu nyina so.
Hom nhwɛ ahɛn no, wɔsõso dze, na mframa a ano yɛ dzen pia hɔn, naaso wɔdze kutow kakraba dandan hɔn kɔ beebiara a hɛnkitsafo no pɛ.
Dɛmara na tɛkyerɛma yɛ honam ho adze kakraba, na ɔhyehyɛ noho wɔ adze kɛse ho. Hom nhwɛ ogya ketseaba ndua pii a ɔhyew no!
Na tɛkyerɛma so yɛ ogya: Emumuyɛ wiadze mu, mbrɛ tɛkyerɛma tse wɔ hɛn apɔw mu nye no, na ogu nyimpadua nyina ho fi, na ɔsɔ ɔbra kwan nyina gya.
Na mbowadoma horow nye dza ɔwɔ po mu, wɔdwedwe hɔn, na nyimpa dze hɔn su adwedwe hɔn:
na tɛkyerɛma dze, nyimpa biara nntum nndwedwe no; ɔyɛ adzebɔn a ɔnnhom, owu bɔr ahyɛ no mã.
Ɔno na yɛdze hyira Egya Nyankopɔn, na ɔno so na yɛdze dom nyimpa a wɔayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn suban mu:
Ano kor no ara na nhyira nye ndom fi mu ba. Mo nuanom, ɔnnsɛ dɛ iyinom yɛ dɛm.
Aso nsuburo bi puw nsu dɛɛdɛw nye wenwen fi nsunyiwa kor mu?
Mo nuanom, ana adɔmbadua botum asow ngodua aba? Anaaso wenyindua botum asow adɔmba? Dɛmara na nsu nkyenkyen runntum mmba nsu pa.
Hom mu woana na ɔyɛ nyansafo nye nyimpadzefo? Wɔmma ɔmfa ɔbra pa nkyerɛ no ndwuma wɔ nyansa dwe mu.
Na sɛ hom wɔ nyinkun wenwen nye mansotwe wɔ hom akoma mu a, mma hom nnhyehyɛ homho, na hom nndzi ator nntsia nokwar no.
Nnyɛ yi nye nyansa a ofi sor, na mbom dza ofi asaase nye honam nye abɔnsam no a.
Na mbrɛ nyinkun nye mansotwe wɔ no, hɔ na sakasaka nye adze a ɔyɛ tan nyina wɔ.
Na nyansa a ofi sor na dze, odzi kan no ho tsew, na ɔwɔ asomdwee, ɔdwe, ɔwɔ asoɔmberɛw, ehumbɔbɔr nye aba pa ahyɛ no mã, ɔnnyɛ ekyingye, ɔnnyɛ ndabraba.
Na tsenenee aba wodua no tsenenee mu ma hɔn a wɔyɛ asomdwee dze.
4: Hen na ɔsa nye ɔkõ fi ba hom mu? Ana ommfi hom akɔndɔ a ɔkõ wɔ hom mfafakuma mu no?
Hom kɔn dɔ na hom nnya; hom ku na hom enyi ber, na hom nsa nnkã; hom kõ na hom tu sa, naaso hom nnya, osiandɛ hom mmbisa.
Hom bisa na hom nsa nnkã, osiandɛ hom bisa no bɔn, ma hom aahwer no hom akɔndɔdze ho.
Hom mbaa awartofo, ana hom nnyim dɛ wiadze anyɛnkoyɛ nye Nyankopɔn tan? Dɛm ntsi obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔyɛ wiadze anyɛnkoyɛ nye Nyankopɔn tamfo.
Ana hom dwen dɛ kyerɛw no kasa kwa? Ana sunsum a ɔmaa ɔbɛtsenaa hɛn mu no, no kɔn dɔ nyitan?
Na ɔma adom pii mbom. Dɛm ntsi kyerɛwsɛm no se, Nyame siw ahopɔwfo kwan na ɔma ahobrɛdzefo adom.
Dɛm ntsi hom mfa homho nhyɛ Nyankopɔn ase; hom nsiw abɔnasam kwan, na oboguan efi hom nkyɛn.
Hom ntwe mpin Nyankopɔn na ɔbɔtwe epin hom. Hom nhohor hom nsa, hom ndzebɔnyɛfo; hom ntsew hom akoma mu, hom a hom adwen ebien ebien.
Hom nka mmɔn, na hom werɛ nhow, na hom nsū: Hom mma hom serew ndan awerɛhow, na hom ahosɛpɛw ndan ahonambubu.
Hom mbrɛ homho adze wɔ Ewuradze enyim na ɔbɛma hom do.

Enuanom, mma hom nnkekã homho asɛmbɔn. Nyia ɔkã no nua ho nsɛmbɔn, anaa obu no nua atsɛn no, ɔkasa tsia mbra no, na obu mbra no atsɛn; na sɛ ibu mbra no atsɛn a, nna ennyɛ mbra no yɛfo, na eyɛ ne tsembuafo.
Mbrahyɛfo nye tsɛmbuafo korto na ɔwɔ hɔ, ɔno nye nyia otum dɛ ɔgye nkwa na ɔsɛɛ no: Na ɔwo woana nye wo na ibu wo nyɛnko atsɛn?
Na afei hom ɛ, hom a hom kã dɛ, ndɛ anaa ɔkyena yɛbɔkɔ kurow yi mu ekedzi afrenhyia, na yeedzi bata enya mfaso:
naaso hom nnyim dza ɔbɛba ɔkyena. Hom nkwa nye bɛn? Hom tse dɛ ehubɔw a oyi noho kakra na nkyii ɔhera.
Na hom nnkã mbom dɛ, sɛ Ewuradze pɛ, na yɛtse ase a, yɛbɛyɛ yi anaa yɛbɛyɛ yi.
Na afei hom hyehye homho wɔ hom ahopɔw mu; na dɛm ahohyehyɛ yi nyina yɛ bɔn.
Na nyia onyim papa yɛ na ɔnnyɛ no, ɔyɛ bɔn ma no.
5: Na afei hom ahonyafo e, hom nsū na hom nkã mmɔn, wɔ hom amandzehu a ɔreba hom do ntsi.
Hom ahonya aprɔw na hom ntar mbowa awe.
Hom sika nye hom dwetɛ adɔ nkandar; na hɔn nkandar no bedzi hom dase, na woedzi hom nam dɛ ogya. Hom aboaboa ahonya ano wɔ nda a odzi ekyir yi mu.
Hom nhwɛ, edwumayɛfo a wɔboaboa hom ekuadze ano ma hom no, hɔn akatua a hom dze nsisi fae siei no rekeka mu, na hɔn a wobui no hɔn nkekamu akɔ sor dɔm Ewuradze asomu.
Hom atsena asaase do fɛfɛɛfɛw, na hom enya enyigye huhuw; hom anyɛn hom akoma wɔ okum do mu;
hom ebu ɔtseneneenyi fɔ eku no; onnsiw hom kwan.
Dɛm ntsi enuanom hom nyɛ abotar nkodu Ewuradze ne mbae. Hwɛ, okuafo a ɔrotweɔn asaase aba a ɔsom bo, ɔyɛ ho abotar kodu dɛ ne nsa kã esusow nye ɔbɛsɛ.
Hom so nyɛ abotar; hom nhyɛ hom akoma dzen, osiandɛ Ewuradze ne mbae abɛn.
Enuanom, mma hom nnyɛ huhuhuhu nntsiatsia homho, na woeemmbu hom atsɛn: Hwɛ, ɔtsembufo no gyina abow ekyir.
Enuanom, hom mfa nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔkasae wɔ Ewuradze dzin mu no nyɛ amandzehu nye abotar ho fasusu.
Hwɛ, yɛfrɛ hɔn a wotsimii sɔwee no esiarfo: Hom atse Job abotar, na hom ehu Ewuradze ewie, mbrɛ Ewuradze dua yɛ tsimbɔbɔr nye ehumbɔbɔr.
Na, mo nuanom, dza ɔkyɛn adze nyina nye dɛ, mma hom nnkã ntam, mma hom nnkã ɔsor anaa asaase anaa ntam biara: Na mbom hom mma hom nyew nyɛ nyew na hom oho nyɛ oho, amma hom aannhwe atsɛmbu ase.
Ana hom mu bi ruhu amandze? Wɔmma ɔnsɔr. Ana obi n'akoma atɔ ne yamu? Wɔmma ɔntow ayɛyindwom.
Ana hom mu bi yar? Wɔmma ɔmfrɛ asɔr mpanyimfo, na wonyi ne tsir mpaa, na wɔnsera no ngo wɔ Ewuradze dzin mu:
Na gyedzi mpaayi no ɔbɛgye nyia ɔyar no nkwa, na Ewuardze bɛma no do; na sɛ ɔayɛ bɔn bi a, wɔdze bɛkyɛ no.
Dɛm ntsi hom nkekã hom bɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ homho, na hom nyeyɛ asɔr mma homho na wɔaasa hom yarba. Nyimpa tsenenee no nkotoserɛ dzi nyim pii wɔ n'adzeyɛ mu.
Elijah yɛ nyimpa a ɔwɔ hɛn su kor yi ara bi, naaso ɔsɔɔr dɛ mma nsu nntɔ no, nsu anntɔ asaase do mfe ebiasa abosoom esia.
Na ɔsɔɔr bio, na ɔsor tɔr nsu na asaase soow n'aba.
Mo nuanom, sɛ hom mu bi fom fi nokwar no ho, na obi dan no a,
hom mma onhu dɛ nyia ɔdan dzebɔnyɛnyi fi no mfom kwan do no, ɔbɛgye ɔkra efi owu mu, na ɔakata bɔn pii do.

1: Hilkiah ba Jeremiah a ofi asɔfo a wɔwɔ Anathoth wɔ Benjamin asaase do no hɔn mu no ne nsɛm nye yi:
Ɔno na Ewuradze n'asɛm baa no hɔ wɔ Amon na Josiah, Judahhen no,ne nda no mu, wɔ n'ahendzi afe a otsīa duebiasa no mu.

Ɔbae so wɔ Josiah ba Jehoiakim, Judahhen no, ne nda mu, dze kesii Josiah ba Zedekiah, Judahhen no, n'afe a otsīa duebien no n'ewiei; dze bodur ɔsoakɔr a wɔsoaa Jerusalem kɔr ndɔmmum wɔ bosoom a otsīa enum no mu.
Afei Ewuradze n'asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
ansaana moween wo yafun mu no, nna minyim wo, na ansaana irifi awotoa mu efir no, nna metseew wo ho; mahyɛ wo nkɔnhyɛnyi mama amanaman.
Nna mesee dɛ, ao Ewuradze Nyankopɔn! Hwɛ, munntum nnkasa: Na meyɛ abofra.
Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, mma nnse dɛ, meyɛ abofra: Na obiara a mobɔsoma wo no hɔ no, ebɔkɔ, na biribiara a medze mebɛhyɛ wo no, ebɛkã.
Mma onnsian hɔn ntsi mma innsuro: Na mowɔ wo nkyɛn dɛ mibeyi wo, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Nna Ewuradze tseen ne nsa dze kãa m'ano; na Ewuradze see me dɛ, hwɛ, medze me nsɛm mahyɛ w'ano:
Hwɛ, ndɛ da yi medze wo mesi amanaman do na ahendzi do, dɛ tutu na bubu gu famu, na sɛɛ na butuw; si, na tsɛw.
Ewuradze n'asɛm baa me nkyɛn dɛ, Jeremiah, ihu bɛn? Na mesee dɛ, muhu almond dua bi n'aba.
Nna Ewuradze see me dɛ, ehu no yie: Na moroweɔn m'asɛm na mayɛ.
Na Ewuradze n'asɛm baa mo hɔ otsīa mpɛn ebien, dɛ, ihu bɛn? Na mesee dɛ muhu dadzesɛn a oruhur na n'enyim fi kwaamu afamu.
Nna Ewuadze see me dɛ, kwaamu afamu na mbusu befir etue aba asaase no do atsefo nyinara do.
Na, hwɛ, mebɛfrɛ kwaamu ahendzi mbusua nyinara, Ewuradze na ɔse; na wɔbɛba na hɔn mu biara dze n'ahengua ebesi Jerusalem aponkɛse ano, ɔnye n'afasu nyinara ho ehyia, na Judah nkurow nyina.
Na mubobua m'atsɛn etsia hɔn wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ nyina ntsi; wɔ dɛ wɔapow emi, na wɔahyew nduhuam ama abosom afofor bi, na wɔasɔr hɔnankasa hɔn nsaano edwuma.
Dɛm ntsi ɔwodze bɔ w'asen do, na soɛr na kã dza mahyɛ wo nyinara kyerɛ hɔn: Mma wo bo nntu wɔ hɔn enyim, mma maamma wo bo enntu wɔ hɔn enyim.
Na, hwɛ, ndɛ da yi mayɛ wo akoban kurow na dadze fadum, na boran afasu, metsia asaase no nyina, Judah ahemfo, hɔn mbapɔmba, hɔn asɔfoe, na asaase no do nkorɔfo.
Na wɔnye wo bedzi akõ; naaso wonnkotum wo: Osiandɛ menye wo nam, Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ mibeyi wo.
2: Na Ewuradze n'asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
kɔ kɛpaa mu wɔ Jerusalem asomu dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, mekaa wo mbafobermu adɔyɛ ɔnye ayegyeber mu dɔ no mema wo; mbrɛ idzii m'ekyir wɔ sar no do, asaase a wonnduaa do adze no.
Israel yɛɛ adze krɔnkrɔn maa Ewuradze, no ndɔbaa mu nduadzewakan no: Hɔn a wɔmemen no no nyinara wobobu hɔn fɔ; mbusu bɛba hɔn do, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Jacob fifo, na Israel fi mu mbusua nyinara, hom ntsie Ewuradze n'asɛm:
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, ɔbrakyew bɛn na hom egyanom ehu wɔ mo mu, ma woefi me nkyɛn kɔ ekyirkyir, na woekedzo egyangyandze ekyir, na wɔayɛ gyan yi?

Eso wɔannse dɛ, Ewuradze a ɔdze hɛn fii Egypt asaase do bae no wɔ henfa; ɔno a ɔgyee hɛn duaa sar no do, nsarpradada, na amaa asaase do, kwaweeyɛ nye owu sunsuma asaase do, asaase a obi nnduaa mu, na nyimpa biara nntsenaa do no?
Na medze hom baa asaaseber do, dɛ hom ndzi no do aba na no do ndzepa; na mbom hom baa mu no, hom guu m'asaase ho fī, na hom yɛɛ m'egyapadze ekyiwadze.

Na asɔfo no annse dɛ, Ewuradze wɔ henfa? Na hɔn a mbra no dze hɔn nsamu no ennhu me: Na ahwɛdofo no so fomee tsiaa me, na nkɔnhyɛfo no nam Baal do hyɛɛ nkɔm, na wokedzii ndzɛmba a ɔnnyɛ mfaso bi ekyir.
Dɛ ntsi menye hom beyi atsɛn, Ewuradze na ɔse, na menye hom mba hɔn mba so meyi atsɛn.
Na hom ntwa mu nkɔ Kittim esupɔw do nkɔhwɛ; na hom nsoma nkɔ Kedar nkɛpɛ mu kofekofe; na hom nhwɛ kyerɛdɛ adze a ɔtse dɛm yi bi aba pɛn ana.
Aso ɔman bi asesa hɔn abosom a wɔnnyɛ abosom bi no? Na me man dze wɔdze hɔn enyimnyam asesa dza mfaso biara nnyi ho.
Hom ɔsorsor, hom mma yi nyɛ hom nwanwa, na ahomdwuruw nkitsa hom, nketsenketse nkyer hom dzendzenndzen, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na me man abɔ mbusu ebien: Wɔapow emi a meyɛ nkwa nsu no nsunyiwa no, na woesinsian esupi ama hɔnho, esupi bobɔe a nsu nngyina mu.
Ana Israel yɛ somfo a? Ana ɔyɛ ofienyimpa ba? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔayɛ afonam yi?
Ngyatafɔr apɔw no, na wɔabobɔ hɔn ndze mu; wɔama n'asaase ayɛ amamfõ; na wɔahyehyew no nkurow, dɛ obi nntse do.
Noph nye Tahpanhes hɔn mba ama w'etsifi apaa.
Aso nnyɛ ɔwoara na akɛfa iyi aba wo do, wɔ dɛ apow Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, aber a origya wo ɔkwan no.
Na afei ebɛn na ewɔ yɛ Egypt kwan no do, dɛ ebɔnom Shihor nsu? Anaadɛ ebɛn na ewɔ yɛ wɔ Assyria kwan no do, dɛ ebɔnom Esutsen no n'esu?

Woara w'emumuyɛ bɛtsēa wo, na ɔwoara w'ekyirsan botwuw w'enyim; dɛm ntsi hu na hwɛ dɛ ɔyɛ ebusudze nye adze wenwen, dɛ apow Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, na dɛ mo ho suro nnyi wo mu, Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na ofir tsetse na mebubu wo kɔndua mu, na matsetsew wo nkyehoma mu; na ɔwo ekãa dɛ, monnkɔsom; na koko sorɔnsorɔm biara do no dua ebun ebun biara ase na ebɔɔ wo mu adze, egoor ndwamangor.
Naaso na matsɛw wo wenyindua soronko, aba pa turododo: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na adan amanandze wenyindua n'aba ahomaahoma ama me yi?
Na kaansa edze hyɛ guar, na efa semina pii mpo a, w'emumuyɛ no dze ne nsensanee da ho wɔ m'enyim, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Ebɛyɛ dɛn etum kã dɛ, mo ho nnguu fi, minnkedzii Baalim ekyir? Hwɛ wo kwan wɔ bɔnsa no mu, hu dza ayɛ: Eyɛ efumpɔnkɔ ɔhoɔharfo a ɔwonawona wɔ n'akwan do;
hamu asoaso a ɔakokwaa sar do a ɔto mfar wɔ n'akɔndɔ hyeehyew mu; n'aber du a, woana besianka no? Hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ no nyinara nnkɛberɛ hɔnho; no bosoom mu na wɔdze bohu no.
Siw wo nan kwan ma no ho annda hɔ, na wo kɔmɛr ma nsukɔm anndze wo: Na ɔwo esee dɛ, enyidado biara nnyi hɔ: Dabida; na madɔ ananaben, na hɔn ekyir na mibedzi.
Dɛ mbrɛ owifo wɔkyer no a, n'enyi tõ no, dɛmara so na Israel fifo hɔn enyi atõ; hɔn, hɔn ahemfo, hɔn mbapɔmba, na hɔn asɔfoe, nye hɔn mbapɔmba, na hɔn asɔfoe, nye hɔn nkɔnhyɛfo a
wɔse dusin dɛ, ɔwo nye m'egya; na ɔbo dɛ, ɔwo na awo me, no: Na hɔn ekyir na wɔadandan ama me, na nnyɛ hɔn enyim a: Na hɔn fonaber mu dze wɔbɛse dɛ, soɛr na gye hɛn nkwa.
Na w'abosom a ayɛ ama woho no wɔ henfa? Ma wɔnsoɛr ɛ, sɛ wobotum agye wo nkwa wɔ wo fonaber mu a: Na Judah, w'abosom hɔn dodow tse dɛ wo nkurow dodow ano.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom nye me beyi atsɛn? Hom nyinara hom afomfom etsia me, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Ɔkwa ara nna mabobɔ hom mba; wɔanngye ntsēa biara: Homankasa hom afõwa na ɔamemen hom nkɔnhyɛfo dɛ ogyata a ɔsɛɛ adze.
Mbasantsen, hom nhwɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm, aso madan sar mama Israel? Anaa sumpɔrwa asaase? Ebɛn ntsi na me man se dɛ, yɛatsew ahoma; yɛnnkɛba wo nkyɛn ara bio yi?
Aso ɔbɛyɛ dɛ ababaawa no werɛ befir n'ahyehyɛdze, anaa ayefor no werɛ befir n'efuradze? Naaso me man hɔn werɛ efir me nda a wɔkan a ɔnnyɛ.
Mbrɛ isiesie wo kwan kɔhwehwɛ ɔdɔ a! Dɛm ntsi na mbaa emumuyɛfo mpo ekyerɛkyerɛ hɔn wo kwan yi.
Eso w'atarano na wohu abɔbɔfo a woedzi bem hɔn akra bɔgyaa; nnyɛ mbrɛ woebubu mu nna mehu, na mbom yinom nyinara do a.
Naaso ese dɛ, midzi bem; ampaara n'ebufuw adan efi mo do. Hwɛ, menye wo bedzi asɛm, osiandɛ ese dɛ, mennyɛɛ bɔn.
Ɔye dɛn ntsi na ebɔ awonama pii dɛm dɛ ebɛsesa wo kwan? W'enyi tõ Egypt ho so, dɛ mbrɛ atõ Assyira ho no.
Me nkyɛn so na ibefir edzi akɔ, dɛ wo nsa bɔ w'etsifi: Na Ewuradze apow w'awerɛhyɛmu, na innkowie yie wɔ hɔn mu.
3: Wɔdɛ, sɛ ɔbarimba kõ ne yer, na ɔbaa no fi ne nkyɛn kɔ, na ɔkɛyɛ ɔbarimba bi so dze a, aso ɔbarimba no bɛsan akɔ ne nkyɛn bio? Aso nkyɛ asaase no ho nnkogu fi pɔtɔɔ? Na ɔwo enye nwewefo pii agor ndwamangor dze; naaso san bra mo hɔ bio, Ewuradze ne ɔse.
Ma w'enyi do kɔ mpampaa pataa no do, na hwɛ; henfa na wɔnye wo nndaa hɔ? Akwan nkyɛn na atsena atweɔn hɔn, dɛ Arabianyi wɔ sar no do; na edze wo ndwamandze nye w'emunmuyɛ egu asaase no ho fi.
Dɛm ntsi na wɔatwe esusow nsu asɛn, a ɔbɛsɛ nsu so nntrɔree; naaso na nkyɛ ɔwo ewɔ edwaman monapɔw, epoow dɛ w'enyi bɔtõ.
Aso innkefitsi ndɛ ber yi aka mu afrɛ me dɛ, m'egya, ɔwoara nye me mbafobermu gyafo.
Aso ɔdze n'ebufuw besia daa? Hwɛ, akasa na ayɛ ebuusudze, na ayɛ dza woara epɛ.

Nkyii so Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ me wɔ Ɔhen Josiah ne nda no mu dɛ, ana ehu dza okyirsamfo Israel ayɛ yi? Ɔakɔ bepɔw sorɔnsorɔm biara do, nye dua ebun ebun biara do, nye dua ebun ebun biara ase akɔgor ndwamangor.
Na ɔyɛɛ iyinom nyinara ekyir no, mesee dɛ, ɔbɛsan aba me nkyɛn ara: Na ɔnodze ɔannsan: Na n'akyerɛbaa ɔkɔnkɔnsanyi Judah hunii.
Na muhunii, dɛ, ber a osian awar a okyirsannyi Israel atõ no ntsi, megyaa no awar na mama no awarko nwoma no, naaso na n'akyerɛbaa ɔkɔnkɔnsanyi Judah ennsuro; na mbom no so kɔree kɔgoor ndwanmangor.
Na ɔbaa dɛ osian no ndwamangor ne nka ntsi, na asaase no ho guu fi, na ɔnye abo nye ndusin tõo awar.
Naaso na iyinom nyinara n'ekyir yi, n'akyerɛbaa ɔkɔnkɔnsanyi Judah mmfaa n'akoma nyina nnsanee mmbaa mo hɔ, na mbom akɔhwi mu, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, ekyirsannyi Israel akyerɛ noho dɛ ɔtsen kyɛn ɔkɔnkɔnsanyi Judah.
Kɔ, kɔbɔ nsɛm yi dawur kyerɛ kwaamufo, se dɛ, ekyirsannyi Israel e, san bra o, Ewuradze na ɔse; moronnhwɛ wo ebufuw mu: Na meyɛ ehumbɔbɔr, Ewuradze na ɔse, minnkesie ebufuw daa.
Hu w'emumuyɛ nko ara, dɛ atõ mbra etsia Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, na awonawona wo kwan ekefir ananaben hɔ wɔ dua ebun ebun biara n'ase, na hom enntsie me ndze, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Mba ekyirasamfo e, hom nsam mbra o, Ewuradze na ɔse; na meyɛ okun ma hom: Na mebɛfa hom ɔbaako efi kurow bi mu, na beenu efi ebusua bi mu, na medze hom aba Zion:
Mebɛma hom nguanhwɛfo dɛ mbrɛ m'akoma pɛ a wɔdze nyimdzee nye ntseasee bɛnyɛn hom.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ hom dɔɔ sõ na hom dɔr asaase no do wɔ nda no mu a, Ewuradze na ɔse, ɔno wɔnnkɛkaa bio dɛ, Ewuradze ahyɛmudzi adaka; eso ɔremmba adwen mu: Eso wɔrennka; eso wɔrennkɛsera no; eso wɔrennyɛ dɛm no bio.
Aber no wɔbɛfrɛ Jerusalem dɛ Ewuradze ahengua; na amanaman nyinara bɔboa ano wɔ ne nkyɛn, ama Ewuradze ne dzin wɔ Jerusalem: Eso worinndzi hɔn akoma bɔn ne ntsintsiman ekyir bio.
Nda no mu no Judah fi nye Israel fi bɛnantsew, na wɔabɔ mu efi kwaamu afamu asaase no do aba asaase a medze maa hom egyanom dɛ egyapadze no do.
Na mesee dɛ, minsi dɛn memfa wo mfora mba mu, ma memma wo asaase a ɔyɛ fɛw, amanaman dɔm egyapadze fɛfɛɛfɛw no? Na mesee dɛ hom bɛfrɛ me, m'egya, na hom rennsan mmfi m'ekyir dzi mu.
Ampaara dɛ mbrɛ ɔbaa twa nkontompɔ fi no nkun nkyɛn no, mbrɛ hom so etwa me nkontompɔ ara nye no, Israel fifo Ewuradze na ɔse.
Wɔtse ndze bi wɔ mpampaapataa no do, Israelmba hɔn osū na ntotɔserɛ; wɔ dɛ wɔakyea hɔn kwan, hɔn werɛ efir Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn.
Mba ekyirsamfo e, hom nsan mbra o, na mebɛyɛ hom ekyirsan no edur. Hwɛ, yɛaba wo hɔ; na ɔwo nye Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn.
Ampaara ɔkwa ara na enyi da akoko do mboa no kwan, mbepɔw do weɔɔweɔɔyɛ no: Ampaara Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn mu na Israel nkwagye wɔ.
Na enyitodze amen hɛn egyanom berɛ a ofir hɛn mbafose no; hɔn nguankuw nye hɔn anantwikuw, hɔn mbabanyin nye hɔn mbabaa.

Wɔmma yɛndeda famu wɔ hɛn enyito mu, na wɔmma hɛn enyimguase nkata hɛn do: Na yɛayɛ bɔn etsia Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn, hɛn nye hɛn egyanom, ofitsi hɛn mbafose dze besi ndɛ da yi mpo: Na yenntsie Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn ne ndze.
4: Israel, sɛ ebɛsan w'ekyir a, Ewuradze na ɔse, me nkyɛn na san bra: Na sɛ ibeyi w'ekyiwadze efi m'enyi do a, ɔnodze wonnkeyi wo efi hɔ,
na akã ntam, wɔ nokwar, atsɛmbu, nye ndzeyɛtsenenee mu dɛ, Ewuradze tse ase yi; nna amanaman bɛyɛ esiarfo wɔ no mu, na wɔahyehyɛ hɔnho wɔ no mu.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se Judah mbarimba nye Jerusalem nye yi, Hom ndɔw hom epe, na mma hom nndua wɔ nsoɛ mu.

Judah mbarimba nye Jerusalem atsefo, hom ntwitwa homho twatsia mma Ewuradze, na hom nyiyi hom akoma ho wer no: Amma m'ebufuw eemmfir dɛ ogya ammbɛhyew mbrɛ obi nntum nndum no, osian hom ndzeyɛɛ no mbusu ntsi.

Hom mpaa mu nkã wɔ Judah, na hom mfa ntahye wɔ Jerusalem; na hom nse dɛ, hom mbɔ akasamu no mu wɔ asaase no do: Hom ntseã mu wɔ dzendzen na hom nse dɛ, hom mboa hom ano na yɛnkɔ nkurow a wɔabemban ho no mu.
Hom nsi frankaa nkyerɛ Zion do; hom mbɔ homho eguaa, mma hom nngyina: Na medze mbusu fi kwaamu afamu reba, ɔnye ɔsɛɛ kɛse.
Ogya ta efi no dɔtɔ mu epue, ɔnye amanaman ɔsɛɛfo bi; oesi no kwan mu, oetu efi ne tsenabea; dɛ ɔrebɛyɛ w'asaase amamfõ, na wo nkurow ayɛ ekurofõ a obi nntse mu.
Iyi ntsi hom mfa eyitam mbɔ homho do, hom ntwa sukwadwom, hom ntwa ewuo: Na Ewuradze n'ebufuw hyeehyew no nndanee mmfi hɛn do.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu, Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ Ɔhen n'akoma; bɛhera na asɔfo ho bɔbow hɔn, na nkɔnhyɛfo no ayɛ hɔ nwanwa.
Nna mesee dɛ, ao Ewuradze Nyankopɔn ampaara ɔwo adaadaa ɔman yi nye Jerusalem dodow dɛ, hom benya asomdwee: Naaso na afõ wo ato ɔkra.
Ber no mu wɔbɛse ɔman yi nye Jerusalem dɛ, mframa hyeehyew befi sar do mpampaa do abɛfa me man ne babaa do, nnyɛ orubohuw anaa ɔrebɛtsew ho;
ehum fi hamo yi ara botu ama me: Afei na mo so mebɛkã atsɛmbu etsia hɔn.
Hwɛ, ɔbɔfow aba dɛ ekyinehyia-mframa: No mpɔnkɔ ho yɛ har sen nkɔr. Yendue! na wɔafa hɛn afo.
Jerusalem, hohor w'akoma ho fi emumuyɛ mu, ma wɔaagye wo nkwa. Ehuhu dwen bɛtsena wo mu akyer ahen nko ara?
Na ndze bi tsēa mu fi Dan, na ɔdze mbusu fi Ephrain akoko do tahye:
Hom mbɔ dzin nkyerɛ amanaman; hwɛ, hom ntahye ntsia Jerusalem, dɛ wɔrema hɔn ndze do wɔ Judah nkurow do.
Wɔakyer no ho etetwa ehyia dɛ mfuwa ahwɛdofo; osiandɛ ɔatsew mo do etūa, Ewuradze na ɔse.
W'akwan nye wo nyɛe na wɔatwetwe ndzɛmba iyinom ama wo; w'emumuyɛ nye iyi; ampaara ɔyɛ wen, ampara odu w'akoma ho.
Me yamu o, me yamu o! m'akoma ara yɛ me yaw, m'akoma per mo mu: Munntum mmua m'ano; osiandɛ me kra atse akasamu no ne ndze. Ɔkõ ho ehuwbɔ no.
Wɔtsēa mu dɛ ɔsɛɛ da ɔsɛɛ do; awerɛfir mu ara nna wɔafa me ntamadan afo, nye me nkataho amon mu.
Dabɛn na munhu frankaa no, na mentse akasamu no ne ndze nkodu?
Na me man yɛ nkwasea, wonnyim me; wɔyɛ mbatam, na wonnyi ntseasee: Wɔyɛ enyansafo wɔ emumuyɛ ho, na papayɛ ho dze, wonnyi nyimdzee.
Mohwɛɛ asaase, na hwɛ, ayɛ afoafo nye pan: Na ɔsorsor so, na wonnyi na bi.
Mohwɛɛ mbepɔw, na hwɛ, wɔrowosow, na akoko nyinara rihi dzi akɔnaaba.
Mohwɛe, na, hwɛ, nyimpa bi nnyi hɔ, na wimu nnoma nyinra etutu kɔ.
Mohwɛe, na, hwɛ, asaaseber adandansar, na no mu nkurow nyinara edwurudwuruw wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Asaase no nyinara bɛyɛ amamfõ; naaso murunnwie korakora.
Iyi ntsi na asaase bedzi mbɔɔ, na ɔsor ebir wɔ wimu: Osiandɛ emi na makã, emi na mesua, na munnuu moho, eso mennkɛsan efi ho.
Kurow no nyinara ruguan wɔ mpɔnkɔdofo nye egyentofo hɔn dede ntsi; wɔhɛnhɛn adɔtɔ mu, na wɔfofow abotan: Kurow biara wɔadan egya, na nyimpa biara nntsena mu.

Na ɔwo, sɛ wɔfa wo afo a, ebɛn na ebɛyɛ? Kaansa ifura ɔdaabe, kaansa edze sika ahodze hyehyɛ woho, kaansa edze dubir hohɔr w'enyiwa mpo a, eyɛ woho fɛɛfɛw kwa; w'adɔfo bu wo enyimtsia, wɔhwehwɛ wo nkwa.
Na matse ndze bi a ɔtse dɛ ɔbaa a ɔrokõ awoo nedze, ahoguan a ɔtse dɛ ɔbaa a ɔrowoabakan nedze, ɔtserɛw ne nsamu dɛ, afei mundue! na me kra atɔ bitsi wɔ ewudzifo enyim.
5: Hom ntutu mbirika ndzi akɔnaaba wɔ Jerusalem abrɔn mu, na afei hom nhwɛ, na hom nhu, na hom nhwehwɛ n'abɔntsen do, kyerɛdɛ hom bohu nyimpa bi, dɛ obi wɔ hɔ a odzi atsɛntsenenee, na ɔhwehwɛ nokwardzi; na medze befir no.
Na kaansa wɔkã dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi mpo a; ampaara ntanhun ara na wɔkã.
Ewuradze, aso w'enyi mmbɔ nokwar do bi a? Ɔwo abobɔ hɔn, na anntsɛ hɔn, ɔwo ahyew hɔn, na wɔapow ntsēa: Wɔayeyɛ hɔn enyim kataguann sen ɔbotan, wɔapow dɛ wɔbɛsan.
Nna mesee dɛ, ampaara woyinom wɔyɛ abɔbɔfo, wɔyɛ nkwasea; na wonnyim Ewuradze no kwan, anaa hɔn Nyankopɔn n'atsɛmbu no:
Mobɔkɔ nyimpa akɛse no nkyɛn, na makasa makyerɛ hɔn; na wonyim Ewuradze no kwan no, nye hɔn Nyankopɔn n'atsɛmbu no. Na woyinom dze wɔayɛ kor ebubu kɔndua no, na wɔatsetsew nkyehoma no.
Dɛm ntsi ogyata fi kwaa mu bokuku hɔn, sar do pataku bɛfa hɔn afo, ɔsebɔ bɛtsɛw hɔn nkurow ho biara a ofi mu hɔ fir no, wɔbɛtsetsew no esinesin: Osiandɛ hɔn mbrato ayɛ dodow, na hɔn ekyirsan adɔɔ sõ.
Ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na medze befir wo? Wo mba adan me egya, na wɔakɛkã hɔn a wɔnnyɛ abosom hɔn ntam: Memaa wodzidzii wɔmee no, wɔtõtoo awar, na wɔboaboaa hɔn ano ekuwekuw wɔ ndwaman efiefi mu.
Wɔtsetse dɛ mpɔnkɔnyin a wɔameemee anapa: Obiara robɔ no hwen mu dzi ne nyɛnko ne yer ekyir.
Aso mennkɛsera wɔ ndzɛmba yinom ntsi? Ewuradze na ɔse: Aso me kra nnkedzi wer wɔ ɔman a ɔtse dɛm yi do?
Hom mfow n'afasu na hom nsɛɛ; na mma hom nnwie korakora: Hom mpempan n'abaw: Na wɔnnyɛ Ewuradze dze.
Na Israel fifo nye Judah fifo woetwa me nkontompɔ yerɛyerɛw, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Wɔapa Ewuradze na wɔase dɛ, nnyɛ ɔno bi a; eso mbusu bi nnkɛba hɛn do; eso yennkohu afõwa anaa ɔkɔm:
Na nkɔnhyɛfo no bɛdan mframa, na asɛm no nnyi hɔn mu: Mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ama hɔn nye no.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze, dɔm Nyankopɔn no, se nye yi, osiandɛ hom kã dɛm asɛm yi ntsi, hwɛ, mebɛma me nsɛm ayɛ ogya wɔ w'anomu, na mayɛ ɔman yi nyena, na ɔahyew hɔn.
Hwɛ, medze ɔman bi fir ekyirkyir bɛba hom do, Israel fifo, Ewuradze na ɔse: Ɔmantsimadze a, tsetse man a, ɔman a hɔn kasaa innyim, na dza wɔkã so enntse ase a.
Hɔn egyen-kotoku yɛ asamandan a n'ano da hɔ, hɔn nyinara yɛ mbarimba akatakyi.

Na wobedzi wo ndɔbaa, na w'edziban a ɔsɛ dɛ wo mbabanyin nye wo mbabaa dzi: Wobedzi wo nguan nye w'anantwi; woebedzi wo wenyinndua nye w'adɔmbandua: Wɔdze afõwa bɔdwerew wo nkurow a wɔaban ho a edze wo werɛ twer no no.
Naaso nda no mu mpo, Ewuradze na ɔse, murunnwie wo yɛ koraa.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔse dɛ, ebɛn ntsi na Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn ayɛ hɛn dɛm ndzɛmba yinom nyina a? Ɔno na wo so se dɛ, mbrɛ hom adan me egya, na wɔakɔsom anana abosom wɔ hom asaase do no, dɛmara na hom bɔsom anana wɔ ɔman bi a ɔnnyɛ homdze mu.
Hom nkã iyi nkyerɛ wɔ Jacob fie, na hom mfa ntahye wɔ Judah, dɛ,
hom ntsie yi, ɔman kwasea a wonnyi ntseasee; wɔwɔ enyiwa, na wonnhu adze: Wɔwɔ asowa, na wɔnntse asɛm.

Aso hom nnsuro me? Ewuradze na ɔse: Aso hom ho nnkɔpopo wɔ m'enyim, emi a medze anhwea mabɔ po n'ano ban, dɛ daa mom, na onntum nntra? Na kaansa n'asorɛkye bu mpo a, onntum nntra, na wɔyɛ hurututu mpo a, wonntum nntra.
Na ɔman yi dze, wɔwɔ etuatsew nye mansotwe akoma; wɔatsew etūa wɔkɔ.
Eso wɔnnkã wɔ hɔn akoma mu dɛ, afei wɔmma yensuro Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn a ɔma nsu, esusow nye ɔbɛsɛ nyina tɔ wɔ ne ber mu; na ɔkora adapɛn a wɔahyɛ ama otwaber no do ma hɛn.
Hom emumuyɛ na ɔama ndzɛmba yinom adandan, na hom bɔn ama ndzepa abɔ hom.
Na wohu emumuyɛfo wɔ me man mu: Wɔweɔn, dɛ mbrɛ efirsuafo tsɛw; wosua efir, wɔpa nyimpa.
Mbrɛ nnoma hyɛ buw mu mã no, mbrɛ hɔn efi ahyehyɛ nsisi mã ara nye no: Dɛm ntsi na wɔayeyɛ akɛse na woenyinya hɔnho.
Wɔatotɔ angoa, wɔyɛ senasena: Nyew, wɔtra do wɔ emumuyɛ dze mu: Wonndzi asɛm, wonndzi ngyanka asɛm, na woeewie yie; na ohianyi ne ndzinoa wɔmmfa mma no.
Aso merennkɛsera wɔ iyinom ntsi? Ewuradze na ɔse: Aso me kra nnkedzi wer wɔ ɔman a ɔtse dɛm yi do?
Anwanwadze na adze a ɔyɛ hu aba asaase yi do;
nkɔnhyɛfo no hyɛ nkɔm akɔhwi mu, na asɔfo nam hɔn ahodze do dzi tum; na me man so pɛ no dɛmara: Na n'ewiei no hom bɛyɛ dɛn?
6: Benjaminba, hom mbɔ homho eguaa mfi Jerusalem mu, na hom nhɛn akasamu no wɔ Tekoa, na hom nsi frankaa no wɔ Bethhaccherem do: Na mbusu fi kwaamu afamu rupue, ɔnye ɔsɛɛ kɛse.
Zion babaa, ɔhoɔfɛfo a ɔyɛ hea no na mubotwa no makyen.
Nguanhwɛfo dze hɔn mbowakuw bɛba ne nkyɛn; na wɔabobɔ hɔn asesee wɔ no ho ehyia; hɔn nyinara wobedzidzi wɔ hɔn ananmu.
Hom nkyer no do sa; hom nsoɛr, na yɛmfow nkɔ ewiaber. Yendue! Na adze resã, ewimbir sunsunma mu atwe.
Hom nsoɛr, na yɛmfow nkɔ anago, na yɛnkɛsɛɛ n'ahemfie.
Na mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze ase nye yi, hom ntow no ndua ngu famu, na hom nhɔr Jerusalem ho pempe: Kurow a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔkɛsera no nye yi; nhyɛdo ara nko na ɔw no mu.
Dɛ mbrɛ bura bi puw no nsu ba no, mbrɛ opuw n'emumuyɛ ba ara nye no: Wɔtse akakabensɛm nye afofa nka wɔ no mu; ɔyar nye pirakur wɔ n'enyim daa.
Jerusalem, ma wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ wo, amma me kra aanntwe emmfi wo ho: Amma maannyɛ wo amamfõ, asaase a wɔnntsena do.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi, wobedzi Israel nkaa ho mpɛpɛw kofee dɛ wenyindua ho: Dan wo nsa bio kɔ mbirefi no mu dɛ wenyinabatsewnyi
Woananom na menkasa na mindzi dase menkyerɛ hɔn, ma wontsie? Hwɛ, hɔn asowa wonntwaa no twatsia, na wonntum nnkyɛn aso: Hwɛ, Ewuradze n'asɛm adan ahorohorasɛm ama hɔn; wonnyi enyika bi wɔ mu.
Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze n'ebufuhyew ahyɛ me mã, mesuo mu aberɛ: Hom nhue ngu mbofra no do wɔ ɔbrɔn mu, na mberantsɛ a wɔaboa ano ehyia no do: Na wɔbɛkyer okun nye ne yer so, akɔdaa ɔnye nyia oedzi nda pii.
Na hɔn efi bɛdandan binom dze, hɔn mfuwa nye hɔn yernom nyinara: Na mebɛtsen me nsa akã asaase no do atsefo no, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na ofi hɔn mu ekumaba do kesi hɔn mu ɔkɛse mpo do, hɔn nyina dze hɔnho ama enyikaber; na ofi nkɔnhyɛnyi do kesi ɔsɔfo mpo do, hɔn nyina twa nkontompɔ.
Wɔayɛ me man ne pira no edur ɔhardo, dɛ, asomdwee, asomdwee; ber a asomdwee biara nnyi hɔ.
Aso hɔn enyi tõo ber a wɔyɛɛ ekyiwadze no? Dabida, hɔn enyi anntõ koraa, eso wɔammfɛr: Dɛm ntsi na wɔbɔtotɔ hɔn a wɔtotɔ mu; ber a mebɛsera hɔn no, wobosun hɔn egu famu, Ewuradze na ɔse.

Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hom ngyinagyina atsempɔn mu, na hom nhwɛ, na hom mbisa akwan dadaw no, mbrɛ ɔkwan pa no wɔ, na hom nnantsew mu, na hom benya ahomgye ama hom akra: Na hɔndze wɔsee dɛ, yɛrennantsew mu.
Na misisii hom do aweɔmfo, dɛ, hom ntsie akasamu no ne ndze no; na hɔndze wɔsee dɛ, yerinntsie.
Dɛm ntsi amanaman, hom ntsie, na mboanofo, hom nhu dza ɔwɔ hɔn mu.
Asaase, tsie: Hwɛ, medze mbusu bɛba ɔman yi do, mekyerɛ hɔn adwen aba no, osiandɛ wɔannyɛ aso amma me nsɛm, na me mbra dze, wɔapow.
Ebɛn na eduhuam a ofi Sheba nye calamus a ofi ekyirkyir asaase do no, yɛ ma me? Hom hyew-afɔr nnsɔ m'enyi, na hom kum-afɔr nnyɛ me fɛw.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ, medze fintsindua mobɔto ɔman yi enyim: Na egyanom ɔnye mba nyina abɔ mu efintsifintsiw do; ɔmanyimfo nye ne nyɛnko nyina bɛhera.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ ɔman fi kwaamu afamu asaase do reba: Na wobekenyan ɔman kɛse bi efi asaase etsiwa mu no ho.
Wokurakura egyen ɔnye mpeaa; wɔyɛ etsiɔdzenfo, na wonnyi ehumbɔbɔr; hɔn ndze wor dɛ po, wɔtsetse mpɔnkɔ do; hɔn mu biara abaa mpasuar wɔ wo do, Zion babaa, dɛ nyimpa a ɔrokɔ akono.
Yeatse ne nka; hɛn abaw agow: Ahokyer ekitsa hɛn, na awoko a ɔtse dɛ ɔbaa a ɔrokõ awoo nedze.
Mma mmfir edzi nnkɔ haban mu, eso mma nnantsew kwan no mu; na ɔtamfo n'afõwa wɔ hɔ, na ehuyi etwa ehyia.
Me man ne babaa, fa eyitam bɔ woho do, na yankayankam nso mu: Tsena eyiyɛ mu bɔ mbubuw yayaw dɛ edze rema ɔba kor; na afofanyi no bɛba hɛn do awerɛfir mu ara.
Mayɛ wo abantsentsen nye akoban wɔ me man mu; ama eehu na aasɔ hɔn kwan ahwɛ.
Hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ etuatsewfo ehiyifo a wɔkasakasa sɛɛ nkorɔfo edzin; boran nye dadze na wɔyɛ: Hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ Ewuradze.
Afa no bɔ hyehyeehyew; sumbui no rehyew gya mu: Ɔkwa ara na wɔda ho nan; osiandɛ wonnhwinhwiim emumuyɛfo no nnkɔree.
Adasa bɛfrɛ hɔn dwetɛ ho fi, osiandɛ Ewuradze apow hɔn.
7: Asɛm a ofi Ewuradze nkyɛn baa Jeremiah hɔ, dɛ,

gyina Ewuradze fie ɔponkɛse no mu, na bɔ asɛm yi dawur wɔ hɔ, na se dɛ, hom Judahfo nyinara a hom hɛn ɔponkɛse yi dawur wɔ hɔ, na se dɛ, hom Judahfo nyinara a hom hɛn ɔponkɛse yi mu dɛ wɔrobɔsɔr Ewuradze, hom ntsie Ewuradze n'asɛm.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no ɔse ny e yi, hom nsakyer hom akwan nye hom ndzeyɛɛ, na mebɛma hom atsena bea yi do ha.
Mma hom nntwer atorsɛm, dɛ, Ewuradze n'asɔrdan, Ewuradze n'asɔrdan, Ewuradze n'asɔrdan nye yinom.
Na sɛ hom sakyer hom bu nyimpa nye ne nkyɛnko ntamu atsɛn kotoo;
sɛ hom anntseetsee hɔho, egyanka, nye kunafo, na hom annka onndzifɔ bɔgyaa enngu wɔ bea yi do, eso hom ennkedzi abosom afofor bi ekyir annyɛ homankasa homho bɔn a,
ɔno na mebɛma hom atsena bea yi do, asaase a medze maa hom egyanom, ofir tsetse kesi daa no.
Hwɛ, hom twer atorsɛm a ɔnnyɛ mfaso bi o.
Aso hom bowia adze, edzi ewu, atom edzi abosom a hom nnyim hɔn no ekyir,
na hom aba abegyina m'enyim wɔ ofi yi a wɔdze me dzin ato no yi mu na hom ase dɛ, wɔagye hɛn nkwa: Ama hom aayɛ ekyiwadze yinom nyinara?
Aso ofi a wɔdze me dzin ato no yi adan edwotwafo tu wɔ hom enyiwa mu? Hwɛ, emi mara mehu, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na afei hom nkɔ me bea a ɔwɔ Shiloh a memaa wɔkyerɛɛw me dzin wɔ hɔ asɔpɔn no, na hom nkɔhwɛ dza medze yɛɛ no wɔ me man Israel emumuyɛ ntsi.
Na afei osiandɛ hom ayɛ nyɛe yinom nyina, Ewuradze na ɔse, na mekasaa mekyerɛɛ hom, mosoɛɛr ahema mekasae, na hom anntse; na mefrɛɛ hom, na hom anngye do;
dɛm ntsi na mebɛyɛ ofi a wɔdze me dzin ato no a hom dze hom werɛ twer no, ɔnye bea a medze memaa hom nye hom egyanom no, dɛ mbrɛ mayɛ Shiloh.
Na mobɔtow hom efi m'enyim akyen, dɛ mbrɛ matow hom nuanom, mekyerɛ Ephraim asefo nyinara, makyen.
Dɛm ntsi mma nnsɔr mma ɔman yi, eso mma mmpegya osū anaa mpaabɔ wɔ hɔn ntsi, eso mma nndzi nkotoserɛ nnkyerɛ me: Na mirinntsie wo.
Ana innhu dza wɔreyɛ no Judah nkurow nye Jerusalem abrɔn mu?
Mbofra tase nyena, na egyanom kūa gya, na mba fetsew mbɔr, dɛ wɔreyɛ tatar ama ɔsor hembaa, na woehue ɔnom-afɔr ama abosom afofor bi, ama wɔdze eeyi me ebufuw.
Aso emi na woyi me ebufuw? Ewuradze na ɔse; aso wonnyi hɔnankasa hɔnho ebufuw, dze gu hɔnankasa enyim ase?
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Hwɛ, m'ebufuw na m'ebufuwshew bohue egu bea yi do, nyimpa, abowa, na eduaba do; na ɔbɛdzɛw, na orunndum.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi: Hom mfa hom ɔhyew-afɔr nka hom okum-afɔr ho, na hom ndzi nam.
Na mannkasa annkyerɛ hom egyanom, eso mannhyɛ hɔn mbra da no a miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase no do no, wɔ ɔhyew-afɔr na okum-afɔr ho:
Na adze yi ho na mehyɛɛ hɔn mbra, dɛ, hom ntsie me ndze, na mebɛyɛ hom Nyankopɔn, na hom so ayɛ me man: Na hom nnantsew ɔkwan a manhyɛ hom nyina mu, ama eesi hom yie.
Na woenntsie, eso wɔammbrɛ hɔn aso adze, na mbom wɔnantseew hɔnankasa hɔn akoma bɔn n'egyinatu na ne ntsintsiman do, na wɔsaan ekyir na wɔannkɔ kan.
Ofits, da a hom egyanom fiir Egypt asaase do bae dze bodu ndɛ, masoma mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara maba hom nkyɛn, mosoɛr ahema daa, na mosoma hɔn:
Naaso woenntsie me, eso wɔankyɛn aso, na mbom wɔkyee hɔn kɔn: Wɔyɛɛ bɔn seen hɔn egyanom.
Na ɔwo so ebɛkã nsɛm yinom nyinara akyerɛ hɔn; na wɔremma wo aso; ebɛfrɛ hɔn so; na wɔnnkɛgye wo do.
Na ebɛkã akyerɛ hɔn dɛ, woyi nye ɔman a wo, ntsie Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn ne ndze, eso wɔanngye ntseã: Nokwar ahera, na woetwa efi hɔn anomu.
Jerusalem, pra wo tsinhwi gu, na twa ewuo wɔ mpampaa pataa do; na Ewuradze apow n'ebufuw mbasantsen na ɔadan hɔn egya.
Na Judahmba ayɛ dza omuo wɔ m'enyim, Ewuradze na ɔse: Wɔdze me dzin ato no no mu, ɛ worubu ho fi.
Na woesi Tophetha ɔwɔ Hinnom ba no bɔnsa no mu nsorɔnsorɔmbea, dɛ wɔbɛhyew hɔn mbabanyin na hɔn mbabaa wɔ gya mu; dza nnyɛ emi n mehyɛe, eso ɔmmbaa m'adwen mu.
Dɛm ntsi hwɛ, nda reba a, Ewuradze na ɔse, wɔremmfrɛ no Topheth bio, anaa Hinnom ba no bɔnsa, na mbom okum bɔnsa: Na wobesie efun wɔ Topheth ara ma ekodu dɛ wonnya siebew bio.
Na ɔman yi hɔn efun bɛyɛ edziban ama ɔsor nnoma, nye asaase mbowa: Na obiara remmpam hɔn.
Nna mebɛma ahosɛpɛw ndze na ayefor ndze, abɔ adze wɔ Judah nkurow, na Jerusalem abrɔn mu: Na asaase no bɛdan amamfõ.
8: Aber no, Ewuradze na ɔse, wɔbɛsaw Judah ahemfo hɔn mbiew, na ne mbapɔmba hɔn mbiew, na asɔfo hɔn mbiew, na nkɔnhyɛfo hɔn mbiew, na Jerusalem atsefo hɔn mbiew,efi hɔn ndakamaa no mu aba:

Na wɔahata hɔn wɔ ewia, na bosoom, na ɔsor dɔm nyina a wɔdɔ hɔn, na wɔsom hɔn, na wodzi hɔn ekyir, na wɔhwehwɛ hɔn, na wɔsɔr hɔn no, enyim: Wɔrennkã hɔn mmboa ano, eso worummfua hɔn; wɔbɛyɛ efikyir wɔ asaase enyi.
Na ebusua bɔn yi mu nkaa a wɔbɛka no nyinara bɛsan mu eyi owu asen nkwa; hɔn a wɔbɛka no wɔ mbea a metwuw hɔn adze akɔ mu nyinara, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Nkyii so ebɛkã akyerɛ hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Aso adasa bɔhwe ase na ɔnnkɔsoɛr bio? Aso obi bɛdan noho, na ɔnnkɛsan aba?
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na Jerusalem man yi asan ekyir wɔ daa ekyirsan mu yi? Wɔtakyer ndaadaa ho, wɔpow dɛ wɔbɛsan.
Mekyɛɛn aso na metsee, na wɔannkasa tsenenee mu: Nyimpa biara nnu noho wɔ n'emumuyɛ ho, dɛ, ebɛn na mayɛ yi? Obiara dan noho wɔ no kwan do, dɛ pɔnkɔ a ɔrobɔ twitwi kɔ akono.
Nyew, ɔkompɛtɛ a ɔwɔ wimu onyim ne hyɛber; na atamram na akyemfowa na opoku hyɛ hɔn baber nsew; na me man dze, wonnyim Ewuradze n'ahyɛdze.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom kã dɛ, yɛyɛ enyansafo, na Ewuradze ne mbra wɔ hɛn hɔ? Na, hwɛ, akyerɛwfo ator kyerɛwdze no wɔama wɔayɛ atofodze.
Enyansafo no enyi atõto, wɔabɔ hu na wɔakyer hɔn: Hwɛ, wɔapow Ewuradze n'asɛm; na nyansa bɛn na ɔwɔ hɔn mu?

Dɛm ntsi na medze hɔn yernom bɛma wobinom na medze hɔn mfuwa bɛma hɔn a wobenya edzi: Na hɔn mu biara ofi ekumaba do kesi ɔkɛse do mpo wɔdze hɔnho ama enyikaber, ofi nkɔnhyɛnyhi do kesi ɔsɔfo do mpo, obiara dzi akɔhwisɛm.
Na wɔayɛ me man ne babaa ne pira no edur ɔhardo, dɛ, asomdwee, asomdwee; ber a asomdwee biara nnyi hɔ.
Aso hɔn enyi tõ ber a wɔyɛ ekyiwadze no? Dabida, hɔn enyi anntõ koraa, eso wɔammfɛr, dɛm ntsi na wɔbɔtotɔ hɔn a wɔtotɔ mu: Hɔn seraber no mu wobosun hɔn egu famu, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Mebɛma wɔasã koraa, Ewuradze na ɔse: Aba remmba wenyindua do, eso adɔmba remmba adɔmbadua do, na ahataw bɔpo; na ndzɛmba a medze ama hɔn no befi hɔn nsa akɔ.

Ebɛn ntsi na yɛtsetse hɔ dzindzinn yi? Hom mboa hom ano ma yɛnkɔ nkurow a wɔaban ho no mu, na yɛnkɛyɛ komm wɔ hɔ: Na Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn ama yɛayɛ komm, na ɔama hɛn ɔbɔwema nsu dɛ yɛnnom, oisandɛ yɛayɛ bɔn etsia Ewuradze.
Yɛhwɛɛ asomdwee kwan, na papa biara ammba; na ɔyarsaber kwan, na hwɛ ehubɔ ara nko!
Wɔtse no mpɔnkɔ hwen mu huuhuuyɛ fi Dan: N'abran no hɔn sū ne dede ntsi, asaase no nyinara ho popo; na wɔaba, na wɔabɛmemen asaase no na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara.
Na, hwɛ, mobɔsoma nwɔ, akyerben a wonntum hɔn dwedwe, aba hom mu; na wɔbɛkeka hom, Ewuradze ne ɔse.
Ao, kɛtseankyɛ maakyekye mo werɛ wɔ m'awerɛhow mu! M'akoma atɔ bitsi wɔ mo mu.

Tsie, me man ne babaa ne nkekamu ndze na ɔda mu fi ekyirkyir asaase do no: Aso Ewuradze nnyi Zion? Ɔna ne Hen nnyi no mu? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔdze hɔn ehonyi a woesian, na ananandze egyangyandze eyi me ebufuw yi?
Otwaber etwa mu, ɔhyewber asã, na hɛndze wɔnngyee hɛn nkwa.
Me man ne babaa ne pira ntsi na mepira: Mayɛ kusuww; ahobow ekitsa me.
Aso edur bi nnyi Gilead? Ana onunsinnyi bi nnyi hɔ? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na me man ne babaa nnyaa n'apɔwmudzen yi?
9: Ao, sɛ me tsir yɛɛ esuesu, na m'enyiwa yɛɛ nyinsuwa nyinsuwa a, nkyɛ mubosu me me man ne ne babaa n'atɔfoe no adzekyee na adzesaa!
Ao, nkyɛ meenya akwantsefo asoɛe wɔ sar do ɛ; nkyɛ mebɛdan me man egya na mefi hɔn nyinara yɛ awartofo, na nkontompɔfo mboanofo.
Na wɔkontom hɔn tɛkyerɛma dze yɛ dɛ hɔn egyin dzi ator; na wodzi tum wɔ asaase no do, na wonndzi nntaa nokwar; na wofi mbusu mu kɔ mbusu mu, na wonyim me, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hom mu biara nhwɛ yie wɔ ne nyɛnko ho, na mma hom nntwer nua biara: Na nua biara bedzi emim pasaa, na nyɛnko biara akasakasa asɛɛ nkorɔfo edzin.
Na hɔn nyinara bɛdaadaa hɔn asɛfo, na wɔrennkasa nokwar; wɔakyerɛkyerɛ hɔn tɛkyerɛma atofosɛm dzi; wɔberɛ hɔn ho wɔ emumuyã ne yɛ ho.
Wo tsenabea wɔ ndaadaa finimfin; ndaadaa ntsi na wɔpow dɛ wobohu me, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ, mebɛnan hɔn, na masɔ hon ahwɛ; na mebɛyɛ ni dɛn mbɔ wɔ me man babaa no ho?
Hɔn tɛkyerɛma yɛ ewudzi egyen menaba; ɔkasa ndaadaa: Obi dze n'ano kasa asomdwee mu kyerɛ ne nyɛnko, na n'akoma mu dze na ɔretsew no.
Aso mennkãsera hɔn wɔ ndzɛmba yinom ntsi? Ewuradze na ɔse: Aso me kra rinndzi wer wɔ dɛm man yi do?
Mbepɔw no ntsi mubotue osū na maka mbɔɔ, na sar do dzidzibea ntsi, metwa ewuo, osiandɛ wɔahyew ma obi nndua hɔ; eso adasa nntse anatwi ndze; wimuwimu noho nnoma na mbowa nyinara eguanguan, wɔkɔ.
Na mebɛyɛ Jerusalem amamfõ, mpataku tsenabea; na mebɛma Judah nkurow ayɛ nkurofõ a ɔtsefo nnyi mu.
Woana nye onyansafo, ma ɔaatse iyi ase? Woana nye nyia Ewuradze n'ano akasa akyerɛ no, ma ɔaakã akyerɛ? Eben ntsi na asaase no asɛɛ na ɔahyew dɛ sar, ma obiara nndua do yi?
Na Ewuradze se dɛ, osiandɛ wɔadan me mbra a medze sii hom enyim no egya, na woenntsie me ndze, eso wɔannantsew mu;
na mbom woekedzi hɔnankasa akoma ne ntsintsiman ekyir, na Baalim a hɔn egyanom kyerɛkyerɛ hɔn no ekyir:
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, hwɛ, medze ɔbɔwen mebɛnyɛn hɔn, ɔman yi ara, na mama hɔn ɔbɔ hɔn ɔbɔwema nsu ma wɔaanom.
Mobɔbɔ hɔn so mapetse amanaman a hɔn anaa hɔn egyanom nnyim hɔn mu: Na mebɛma afõwa aka hɔn do, ekodu dɛ mama wɔasã.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi, hom ndwemdwen ho, na hom mfrɛ mbaa abefo ma wɛmbra; na hom nsoma ma wɔnkɛfrɛ mbaa enyansafo ma wɔmbra:
Na wɔnyɛ ntsɛm ntu sukwadwom mma hɛn, na hɛn enyisoatsew mporow nsu.
Na yɛatse sukwadwom ndze fi zion dɛ, mbrɛ woedua afa hɛn afo a! hɛn enyim egu ase koraa, osiandɛ yãadan asaase no egya, osiandɛ woedwuruw hɛn tsenabew egu famu.
Naaso hom mbaa, hom ntsie Ewuradze n'asem, na hom nkyekyerɛ mbabaa sukwadwom, na obiara nykerɛkyerɛ mbabaa sukwadwom, na obiara nyekyerɛkyerɛ ne nyɛnko ewuotwa.
Na owu afow aba hɛn ntokura mu, ɔahɛn hɛn nhemfie; dɛ obotwa mbofra efi gua do na mbrantsɛ efi abɔntsen do.
Kasa dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nyi yi adasa efun bogugu dɛ mfuwa pradada do efikyir, na dɛ eburotwafo ekyir nsama na obi nnkɔboa ano.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, mma onyansafo nnhyehyɛ noho wɔ ne nyansa mu, eso mma ɔhoɔdzenfo nnhyehyɛ noho wɔ n'ahoɔndzen mu, na ɔhonyanfo nnhyehyɛ noho wɔ n'ahonya mu:

Na mbom nyia ɔhyehyɛ noho no, ɔnnhyehyɛ noho wɔ iyi mu, dã ɔtse me ase, na onyim me, dɛ emi nye Ewuradze a meyɛ adɔyã, atsɛmbu, na tsenenee wɔ asaase do: Na nzɛmba iyinom mu na m'enyinka wɔ, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hwɛ, nda bi reba, Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ mebɛba abɛtsē hɔn a wɔyɛ twatsiafo wɔ hɔn monomonomyɛ mu;
Egypt, na Judah, na Edom, na Ammonmba, na Moab, na hɔn a woetwtwa ntakuwa a wɔtsetse sar do: Na amanaman nyinara yã monomonofo, na Israel fifo nyinara yɛ akoma mu monomonofo.
10: Israel fifo, hom ntsie nsɛm a Ewuradze kasa kyerɛ hom;
mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, mma hom nsūansua amanaman hɔn kwan no, na mma hom bo nntutu, wɔ ɔsor nsɛn kyerɛdze ho; na amanaman na hɔn bo tutu wɔ ho.
Na amanaman no hɔn atɔremuadze yɛ egyangyandze: Na obi twa dua wɔ kwaa mu, odwinfo ne nsaano edwma a wɔdze ekuma yɛ.
Wɔdze dwetɛ na sika hyehyɛ no; wɔdze mprɛgow na nhamɛr bobɔ mu, amma oeenhihim.
Wɔtse dɛ abɛdua a woetsia edzi no akyē, na wɔnnkasa: Otwar dɛ wɔsoa hɔn, osiandɛ wonntu nntu namɔn. Mma nnsuro hɔn na wonntum mmbɔ mbusu, eso papayɛ bi nnyi hɔn mu.
Ewuradze, obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo; ɔwo na eyɛ ɔkɛse, na wo dzin so sõ wɔ tum mu.
Amanaman Hen, woana na onnkosuro wo? Na ɔwo na odzi wɔ wo: Susuampaara dɛ amanaman enyansafo nyinara mu na hɔn ahendzi nyinara mu, obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo.
Na wɔyɛ mbowadze na nkwanseadze prɛko: Ehonyi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ, duasin ara a.
Dwetɛ wɔ hɔ a Wɔbor no trɛtrɛ fi Tarshish ba, na sika a ofi Uphaz a ɔyɛ odwimfo na osikadwimfo ne nsaano edwuma; bibiri na ɔberdum nye hɔn efuradze; ne nyinara edwimfi enyansafo edwuma a.
Na Ewuradze nye nokwar Nyankopɔn; ɔno nye Nyankopɔn tseasefo. Na ɔdomankoma hen; no bo fuw a, asaase wosow, naamanaman nntum n'ebufuhhyew enim gyina.
Iyi na hom nkã nkyerɛ hɔn abosom a nnyɛ hɔn bi na wɔyɛɛ ɔsor na asaase no, wɔbɛhera efi asaase do, na ɔsorsor ase.
Ɔno na ɔdze no tum ayɛ asaase, ɔno na ɔdze nyansa etsintsim wiadze, ne ntseasee atserɛw ɔsorsor mu:
Sɛ ɔbɔ ne ndze mu a, esuesu no weɔɔyɛ ba ɔsorsor, na ɔma ehubɔhubɔw tu fi assase ano fa sor; ɔno na ɔyɛ enyinam na nyankom, na ɔdze mframa fi n'adzekorabea ba.
Nyimpa biara adan kwasea na onnyim dze; sikadwinnyi biara ne sian-honyi hyɛ no enyito: Na no guhonyi no yɛ ator, na ahom biara nnyi hɔn mu.
Wɔyɛ egyangyanadze, ndaadaa edwuma a; hɔn seraber mu no wɔbɛhera.
Jacob ne kyɛfa nntse dɛ iyinom; na Israel nye n'egyapadze ebusuakuw: Dɔm Ewuradze nye ne dzin.
Ɔwo a etse ntuae mu, boaboa w'ahodze ano fi asaase no do.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ, mobɔtow asaase no do atsefo no tsiabo makyerɛkyerɛ aber yi mu, na meguan hɔn ho, ma wɔaatse.
Mundue wɔ me pira ntsi! Me pirakur yɛ yayaw; na mesee dɛ ampaara iyi nye me yaw, na otwar dɛ mosɔw.
Me ntamadan asɛɛ, na me mba efi me nkyɛn kɔ, ma wonnyi hɔ. Obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtserɛw me ntamadan mu bio, na ɔasese me ntamadan ho nkata ho no.
Na nguanhwɛfo no adan nkwasea, na wommbisa Ewuradze ekyir kwan: Dɛm ntsi na woennwie yie, na hɔn mbowakuw nyinara apetse yi.
Adɛadɛsɛm ne nka, hwɛ ɔreba, na asakrabutuw kɛse bi a ofi kwaamu afamu asaase do, dɛ ɔrebɛma Judah nkurow ayɛ nkurofõ mpataku tsenabea.
Ewuradze, mi nyim dɛ ɔdasanyi no kwan nnyi nankasa ne nsamu mbrɛ obodua etu tu n'anamɔn.
Ewuradze, tseã me, na mbom atsɛmbu mu a; nnyɛ ebufuw mu a, ma amma maanhera.
Hue w'ebufuhyew gu abosonsɔrfo a wonnyim wo no do, na mbusua a wɔmmbɔ wo dzin no do: Osiandɛ wɔamen Jacon, nyew, wɔamen no seranseram, na wɔama ne tsenabea ayɛ amamfõ.
11: Asɛm a ofi Ewuradze nkyɛn baa Jeremiah hɔ, dɛ,
hom ntsie ahyɛmu yi ne nsɛm no, no hom nkã nkyerɛ Judah mbarimba, na Jerusalem atsefo;
na se hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Mpaa nkã nyimpa a onntsie ahyɛmu yi ne nsɛm a,
me hyɛɛ hom egyanom wɔ da a miyii hɔn Egypt asaase do, fii dadze, fononoo no mu, dɛ, hom ntsie me ndze, na hom nyɛ dɛ mbrɛ mahyɛ hom nyinara; ɔno na hom Nyankopɔn:
Ma maama ntam a mekãa mekyerɛ hom egyanom no etsim, dɛ mebɛma hɔn asaase bi a numfonsu na ewo pem wɔ do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi, nna mbuae mesee dɛ, Ewuradze, Amen.
Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, bɔ nsɛm yi nyinara dawur wɔ Judah nkurow mu, na Jerusalem abrɔn mu, dɛ hom ntsie ahyɛmu yi ne nsɛm no, na hom nyɛ.
Na mepaa mu mekaa no enyiberdo ara mekyerɛɛ hom egyanom wɔ da a miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do, dze besi ndɛ, morosoɛr ahema merepaa mu merekã, dɛ, hom ntsie me ndze.
Naasa woenntsie, eso wɔambmrɛ hɔn asowa adze, na mbom obiara nantseew n'emumuyɛ akoma ne ntsintsiman mu: Dɛm ntsi medze ahyɛmu yi ne nsɛm a mehyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnyɛ, na wɔannyɛ no, nyinara baa hɔn do.
Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, woehu tsirdoapam bi wɔ Judah mbarimba, na Jerusalem astefo mu.
Wɔasan ekyir akɔ hɔn nananom a wɔpoow dɛ wobetsie me nsɛm no hɔn emumuyɛ ho; na woekedzi abosom afofor ekyir rokɔsom hɔn; Israel fifo na Judah fifo ato m'ahyɛmu a menye hɔn egyanom dzii no.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ, medze mbusu bɛba hɔn do a worunntum mmfi nsa: Na wobosū afrɛ me, na mirinntsie hɔn.
Ɔno na Judah nkurow na Jerusalem atsefo bɔkɔ ekosū afrɛ abosom a wɔhyew nduhuam ma hɔn no; na hɔn ngye hɔn nkwa koraa wɔ hɔn fona ber mu.
Na Judah, mbrɛ wo nkurow hɔn dowdow ano si ara nye no; na mbrɛ Jerusalem abrɔn hɔn dowdow ano si no, na hom esisi afɔr mbukyia ama enyitodze no, afɔrmbukyia a wɔhyew do nduhuam ma Baal na a.
Dɛm ntsi mma nnsɔr mma ɔman yi, eso mma mmpegya osū anaa mpaabɔ wɔ hɔn ntsi; na mirinntsie hɔn wɔ ber a wobosū afrɛ me wɔ ɔfona ntsi no.
Ebɛn na mo dɔfo wɔ yɛ wɔ me fie, ber a ɔnyɛ dodowara ayɛ ehuhudze, na honam krɔnkrɔn no efi wo nkyɛn asen kɔ yi? Sɛ ebɔ mbusu a, nna iridzi ehursi.
Ewuradze too wo dzin dɛ, ngodua ebun ebun a aba pa ama ɔayɛ fɛɛfɛw; ɔdze weɔɔyɛ kɛse ne dede ekūa gya wɔ do, na n'abaw ebubu.
Na dɔm Ewurdze a ɔtsɛɛw wo no, ɔakasa mbusu etsia wo, osian Israel fifo mbusu na Judah fifo mbusu a wɔabobɔ ama hɔnho wɔ dɛ wɔahyeyhɛ nduhuam ama Baal dze eyi me ebufuw no ntsi.
Na Ewuradze maa me ho nyimdzee, na muhunii nna ekyerɛɛ me hɔn ndzeyɛɛ.
Na meyɛɛ dɛ eguambaa brɛfo a wɔdze no rokɔ ekumii; na minnyim dɛ saa wɔadwendwen mo ho adwen, dɛ hom mma yetwɛ no mfi atseasefo asaase do, ma wɔaankaa ne dzin bio.
Na, dɔm Ewuradze a ibu atsɛn tsenenee, na esɔ nsɛbɛ na akoma hwɛ, ma munhu w'awerdzi wɔ hɔn do;
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze se wɔ Anathoth mbrarimba a wɔrohwehwɛ wo nkwa no nye dɛ, mma nnhyɛ nkɔm wɔ Ewuradze dzin mu, ma eennwu wɔ hɛn nsaano.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ mebɛtsēa hɔn; ɔkɔm bokuku hɔn mbapanyin na hɔn mbambaa;
Na nkaa bi nnkɛka ama hɔn: Na medze mbusu mebɛba Anathoth mbarimba do, mekyerɛ hɔn ser afe no mu.
12: Ewuradze, sɛ menye wo bɔ nkuro a, bem ara na idzi; naaso mneyɛ wo beyi atsɛn ara; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na emumuyɛfo kwan yɛ prɔmprɔm? Ɔyɛ dɛn na hɔn ho dwe hɔn a wotwa nkontompɔ nyinara hɔn ho dwe hɔn yi?
Ɔwoara na astɛw hɔn, nyew, woagye ndwow; wonyin nyew, wɔsow aba; ɔwo ebɛn hɔn ano, na enye hɔn nsɛbɛ ntamu twe.
Na ɔwo Ewuradze, inyim me; ɔwo ihu me, na esɔ m'akoma hwɛ wɔ wo ho: Twetwe hɔn pue dɛ nguan a wɔdze hɔn rokɔ ekumii, na siesie hɔn ma okum da no.
Onkodu dabɛn na asaase no ndzi nkɔmbɔ, na asaase nyinara do nhaban nkyenkyen? Hɔn a wɔtse mu no hɔn emumuyɛ nsti mbowa na nnoma asã; osiandɛ wɔsee dɛ, onnkohu hɛn ewiei.
Sɛ enye anamɔnmufo etutu mbirika, na wɔama aberɛ a, ebɛyɛ dɛn mbɔ etum enye mpɔnkɔ esi empire? Na kaana asomdwee asaase do idzi woho tɔtrɔtɔ a, ebɛyɛ dɛn wɔ Jordan ne yir mu?
Na wo nuanom, na w'egya fi mpo hɔnara mpo woetwa wo nkontompɔ; hɔnara mpo wɔatsēatsea mu edzi w'ekyir; kaansa wɔkasa dɔkɔdɔkɔ kyerɛ wo mpo a, mma nngye hɔn nndzi.
Madan me fi egya, matow m'egyapadze akyen; medze me kra no dɔfo pa ara mama n'atamfo.
M'egyapadze adan me dɛ kwaa mu ogyata; ɔabɔ ne ndze mu etsia me; dɛm ntsi matan no.
Aso m'egyapadze ayɛ me dɛ anoma edzinam ntokowa ntokowa? Aso nnoma edzinam etwa ayer me? Hom nkɔ nkɔboa hamu mbowadoma nyinara ano, na hom mfa hɔn mbra ma wombedzidzi.
Nguanhwɛfom pii asɛɛ mo wenyin ture na wo etsiatsia me kyɛfa do, wɔama me kyɛfa fɛɛfɛw no ayɛ sar pradada.
Wɔayɛ na amamfo; orusū nkɔmbɔ kyerɛ me, dɛ ɔayɛ afoafo; asaase no nyina ayɛ amamfo, osiandɛ obiara mmfae nntoo n'akoma mu.
Mfoafo aba sar mu mpampaa pataa nyina do; na Ewuradze afõwa no ridzi nam fi asaase no ne tsir pem tsir; ɔdasaanyi biara nnya asomdwee.
Wɔapo ewifua, na woetwa nsoɛ; wɔafona hɔnho, na woennya mu hwee; na hom enyiwa bɔtõ ndɔbaa ho, osian Ewuradze n'ebufuhyew ntsi.

Mbrɛ Ewuradze se wɔ efisamenafo emumuyɛfo nyinara a wɔdze nsa ka egyapadze a medze mama me man Israel dɛ wondzi do no ho nye yi; hwɛ, mubotutu hɔn mefi hɔn asaase no do, na metutu Judah fifo mefi hɔn mu.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ mewie hɔn tu ekyir no, mebɛsan ebohu hɔn mbɔbɔr no, na medze hɔn bɛsan aba obiara n'egyapadze mu, na obiara n'asaase do
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔdze mbɔdzen sūa me man hɔn akwan, dɛ wɔkã me dzin ntam, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi; dɛ mbrɛ mpo wɔkãa Baal ntam no a; ɔnodze wɔdze hɔn besisi me man finimfin.
Na sɛ woentsie a, ɔnodze mubotutu ɔman no, mubotutu na masɛɛ no, Ewuradze na ose.
13: Mbrɛ Ewuradze see me nye yi, kɔ na kɔtɔ ndwera pa abɔdo, na fa bɔ w'asen, na mma mmfa nnkã nsu.
Nna motɔɔ abɔdo dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm tse, na me dze bɔɔ m'asen.
Na Ewuradze n'asɛm baa mo hɔ otsia ebien no dɛ.
Fa abɔdo a atɔ no a ɔbɔ w'asen no na soɛr, kɔ Euphrates ho, na fa kosuma ɔbotan no no tokur bi mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nda pii ekyir no, Ewuradze see me dɛ, soɛr, si mu kɔ Euphrates ho, na keyi abɔdo a mehyɛɛ wo dɛ fakosuma hɔ no fi hɔ.
Nna mokɔr Euphrates ho, mokɔree, na miyii abɔdo no fii beebi mbrɛ medze sumae no: Na, hwɛ, abɔdo no esuw, onnye mma hwee.
Nna Ewuradze n'asɛm baa mo hɔ dɛ,
mbrɛ Euphrates se nye yi, dɛm yi ara na mibesi masɛɛ Judah ne ntsɛm, na Jerusalem ne ntsɛn berebe no.
Ɔman bɔn yi a wɔpow dɛ wobɛtsie me nsɛm, wɔnantsew hɔn akoma na ntsitsiman mu na woekedzi abosom afofor ekyir, dɛ wɔrokɔsom hɔn, na wɔasor hɔn no, wɔbɛyɛ dɛ abɔdo yi ara a onnye mma hwee no no.

Na dɛ mbrɛ abɔdo fam nyimpa n'asɛm no, dɛmara na mama Israel fifo nyina na Judah fifo nyinaa affam mo ho nye no, Ewuradze na ɔse; ama wɔaayɛ me ɔman, na dzin, na ayeyi, na enyimnyam;na wɔammpɛ dɛ wotsie.
Dɛm nsti kã asɛm yi kyerɛ hɔn: Mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi, nsɛtoa biara wɔbɛyɛ na nsã mã?
Ɔno na wo so se hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ, mebɛma asaase yi do atsefo nyinara, mekyerɛ ahemfo a wɔtsetse Dayid akɔngua do, na asɔfo, na nkɔhyɛfo, na Jerusalem atsefo nyinara wɔabobow nsã.
Na medze hɔn besisi hɔnho nkorkor, egyanom a wonnyi mba mpo, Ewuradze na ɔse eso; munnkohu mbɔrbɔr, eso mennkɛkam do, eso mennkɛsɛɛ hɔn.
Hom ntsie, na hom mma aso; mma hom nnyɛ ntsɛntsɛn radze akasa.
Hom mfa enyimnyam mma Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn no, ansaana sum agye, ansaana hom ana efintsiw mbepɔw kusuww no do; na, ber a hom rohwɛ kwan no, ɔadan no owu sunsuma, na ɔayɛ no sum kebikebi.
Na sɛ hom rinntsie a, me kra bosõ nsumaa mu wɔ hom ntsɛn ntsi; na m'enyiwa bosuu kɛse, na oekyi nyinsuwa pii, osiandɛ wɔafa Ewuradze no nguankuw no adɔmmum.
Sɛ ɔhen nye ɔhen ne nã dɛ, hom mbrɛ homho adze, ho, atsena ase; na hom tsir nsiesieho no, mekyerɛ hom enyimnyam abɔ tsir no egu famu.
Wɔatotow pomu afamu nkurow no mu, na obi nnyi hɔ a obuebue: Woetu Judah manmu nyina ndɔmmum kɔ; woetu ndɔmmum korakora.
Hom mma hom enyi do, na ho nhwɛ hɔn a wofi kwaamu afamu reba; wo mbowakuwa, wo mbowakuwa fɛɛfɛw a wɔdze kyɛɛ wo no wɔ hen?
Sɛ ɔdze wo nsɛfo dzi wo do panyin a ebɛka dɛn, ber a ɔwoara akyerɛkyerɛ hɔn etsia woho yi? Aso yaw nnkekitsa wo dɛ ɔbaa a ɔrokõ awoo?
Na sɛ ese wɔ w'akoma mu dɛ ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ndzɛmba iyinom aba mo do a? W'emumuyɛ ne kɛse ntsi wɔada w'aatarse ho edzi, na w'anantsir rufu amandze.
Aso Ethiopianyi botum asakyer no wer, anaa ɔsebɔ no ho nsisii? Ɔno na hom a mbusubɔ akokwaa hom yi botum ayɛ papa.
Dɛm ntsi na mobɔbɔ hɔn apetse, dɛ ntsɛw a sar do mframa ma otu kɔ.
Iyi nye w'afamudze, wo kyɛfa na mesusu mama wo, werɛ efir me, na edze woho atwer atofosɛm.
Dɛm ntsi mo so mibeyi w'atarse ebua w'enyim na w'enyito ada edzi.
Mehu w'ekyiwadze, mekyerɛ w'a warto na wo hwenmubɔ, wo ndwamangor n'atatandze, wɔ haban mu akoko do. Jerusalem, due! Emmpɛ dɛ wɔtsew wo ho; ɔnkyɛr ahen ara ana?
14: Ewuradze, n'asɛm a ɔbaa Jeremiah hɔ wɔ nsu-na no ho.
Judah reka mbɔɔ, na n'aponkɛse eguragura, wofurafura eyitam tsetse daadze; na Jerusalem ne nkekamu a afow kɔ sor.
Na hɔn ekunyin no soma hɔn mbɔdomaba no esukɔ; wɔba mburaba do, na wonya nsu; wɔdzedze hɔn ahyera pan san ba; hɔn enyi atõ
Osiandɛ daadze egyingyam wɔ nyankom a ɔnntɔ nngu asaase do ntsi, ekuafo enyi atoto. Wɔkatakata hɔn etsir do.
Nyew, kwaa mu ɔwansan so ɔwo na ɔdan ne mba egya, osiandɛ efuw bi nnyi hɔ.
Na sar do nsoaso gyinagyina mpampaa pataa no do, wɔhaahaw mframa ho dɛ mpataku; hɔn enyiwa ayeyɛ meamea, osiandɛ efuw nnyi hɔ.
Kaansa hɛn emumuyɛ dzi dase tsia hɛn mpo a, Ewuradze, ɔwoara wo dzin ntsi, yɛ ho bi; na hɛn ekyirsan adɔɔ sõ; yɛayɛ bɔn etsia wo.
Ɔwo Israel enyidado, hɔn agyenkwa wɔ ɔfona ber mu, ebɛn ntsi na eyɛ dɛ ɔmamforanyi wɔ asaase no do, dɛ ɔkwantsennyi a ɔman kɔsoɛ anago da kor yi?
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ayɛ dɛ barimba a no bo etu, dɛ katakyi a onntum nkwa gye yi? Naaso ɔwo, Ewuradze, ewɔ hɛn finimfin, na wɔdze wo dzin frɛ hɛn; mma nndan hɛn nngya.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se ɔman yi nye yi, dɛmara na wɔapɛ dɛ wɔbɔ awonnama; woennsianka hɔn anan; dɛm ntsi na Ewuradze nngye hɔn anan; afei na ɔbɛkaa hɔn emumuyɛ na ɔabɛsera hɔn hɔn.
Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, mma nnyi mpaa mma ɔman yi mma hɔn yie.
Sɛ wodzi mbuada a, minnketsie hɔn sufrɛ; na sɛ wɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr na edziban-afɔr a, m'enyi ronnsɔ; na ɔyardɔmamforanyina medze afõwa, na ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm na medze mebɛ hyew hɔn.
Nna mesee dɛ, ao Ewuradze Nyankopɔn! Hwɛ, nkɔnhhyɛfo no see hɔn dɛ, hom nnkohu, eso hom rinndzi kɔm; mbom mebɛma hom asomdwee a osi pi wɔ bea yi do.

Nna Ewuradze see me dɛ, nkɔnhyɛfo no hyɛ nkɔntɔr wɔ me dzin mu: Nnyɛ emi bi mosomaa hɔn, eso mennhyɛɛ hɔn, eso meenkasaa mennkyerɛɛ hɔn: Ator enyiwado-adzehu, na mbusu nkɔm, na adze gyangyan, na hɔn akoma mu ndaadaa na wɔhyɛ ho nkɔm kyerɛ hom.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze se wɔ nkɔmhyɛfo a wɔdze me dzin hyɛ nkɔm, na nnyɛ emi bi mosomaa hɔn, naaso wɔkã dɛ, afõwa na ɔkɔm remmba asaase yi do no, nye yi: Afõwa na ɔkɔm na wɔdze bɛhyew nkɔnhyɛfo no.
Na ɔman a wɔhyɛ nkɔm kyerɛ hɔn no wɔbɔtotow hɔn egugu Jerusalem abrɛn no mu wɔ ɔkɔm na afõwa no ntsi; na wonnkenya obi ama woesie hɔn hɔnara, hɔn emumuyɛ megu hɔn etsifi.
Na ɔwo bɛka akyerɛ hɔn dɛ, wɔmma me'enyiwa mporopow nyinsuwa anago na adzekyee, na mma wonngyaa; na me man ne babaa ɔbaabun no wɔdze ɔbobɔ kɛse ebubu no, woepirapira no yayaw dɛ.
Sɛ mifir edzi mokɔ hamu a, nna hwɛ afõwa ano atɔfo! na sɛ mekɛhɛn kurow mu a, nna hwɛ hɔn a wɔyaryar ɔkɔm! Na nkɔkhyeni na ɔsɔfo nyina wokyin asaase no do, na wonnyi ho nyimdzee.
Aso apow Judah korakora? Aso Zion ho ayɛ wo kra nkɔw? Ɔyɛ dɛn na abɔ hɛn, na ɔyarsa bi nnyi hɔ ma hɛn yi? Yɛhwee asomdwee kwan, na papa biara ammba; na ɔyarsa ber kwan, na hwɛ akomatu nye yi!
Ewuradze, yɛgye hɛn ndzenbɔn na hɛn egyanom ememuyɛ to mu: Na yɛayɛ bɔn estia wo.
Wo dzin ara ntsi, mma nnkyir hɛn; mma nngu w'enyimnyam ahengua no enyim ase; kaakaa, mma nnto w'ehyɛmu a ɔda yɛnye wo ntamu no.

Aso abosonsɔrfo hɔn egyangyandze mu bi wɔ hɔ a obotum ama nsu atɔ? Ana aso ɔsorsor botum ama esusow etue? Ewuradze, hɛn Nyankopɔn, ana nnyɛ ɔwo a? Dɛm ntsi yɛbɔtweɔn wo, na ɔwo na ayɛ ndzɛmba yinom nyinara.
15: Nna Ewuradze see me dɛ, Kaansa Moses na Samuel begyina m'enyim mpo a, nkyɛ m'adwen nnkɔtɔ akɔ ɔman yi do; hom nyi hɔn edzi mfi m'enyim, na wɔmma womfi hɔ nkɔ.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔse wo dɛ, henfa na yemfir edzi nkɔ a? Ɔno kã kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi; hɔn a wɔfata owu no, wɔnkɔ owu mu; na hɔn a wɔfata afõwa ano no, wɔnkɔ afõwa ano; na hɔn a wɔfata ɔkɔm no, wɔnkɔ ɔkɔm mu; na hɔn a wɔfata ndɔmmum no,
Na ndzɛmba borow anan na mebɛma wɔaba hɔn do, Ewuradze na ɔse; afõwa a wɔdze boku hɔn, na nkraman a wɔbɛtsetsew hɔn mu, na wimu nnoma, ma asaase mbowa a wɔbɛmemen na wɔasɛɛ hɔn.
Na wɔbɛma woedzi hɔn akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do, ahendzi horow nyinaa mu, osian dza Judahhen Hezekiah ne ba Manessah yɛe wɔ Jerusalem ntsi.
Na woana bɛtse ama wo, ao Jerusalem? Anaa woana bosu wo nkɔmbɔ? Anaa woanna bɛman nkyɛn ekebisa wo yieyɛ?
Ɔwo apow me, Ewuradze na ɔse, akɔ ekyir; dɛm ntsi na matsen me nsa wɔ wo do, na masɛɛ wo; maberɛ nnuho.
Na medze apaawa mehuw hɔn do wɔ asaase no n'aponkɛse no mu; magye hɔn nsamu mba, na masɛɛ me man; wɔnnsanee mmfii hɔ akwan do.
Hɔn ekuafo adɔɔ sõ ama me asen mpoano anhwea; medze nyia ɔfa afo maba mberantsɛ no hɔn nã do ewiaber ketee; mama ahoguan na hu atɔ no do awerɛfir mu.
Ɔbaa a ɔawo esuon no, oegura; oegyaa no sunsum mu; no wi atɔ ber a adzekyee da ho wɔ do no; n'enyin egu ase; atɔ no do awerɛfir mu.
Me nã, mundue, dɛ awo me ɔkõ nyimpa na mansotwe nyimpa dze ama adasa nyinara! Mommbɔɔ bosɛ minsii apemapem, eso obi mmbɔɔ me bosa nsii apempem, naaso hɔn mu obiara biara dom me.
Ewuradze see dɛ, ampara mebɛma ɔtamfo no akotow aserɛ wo wɔ mbusuber na ahohia ber mu.
Aso obi tum bu dadze, mekyerɛ dadze a ofir kwaamu afamu, na boraa mu?
Mebɛma wɔafa w'akoradze afo dɛ wonntwa bo, wɔ wo bɔn nyinara ntsi, wɔ w'ahe nyinara do mpo.
Na mebɛma wɔnye w'atamfo etwa mu akɔ asaase a innyim no no do; osiandɛ ogya bi asɔ wɔ m'ebufuw mu a ɔbɛdzew wɔ hom do.
Ewuradze, ɔwoara inyim, kaa me, na bɛsera me, ne bedzi m'ahohiahia wer me; mma mmfa me nnkɔ wɔ wo penkyɛr mu; hu dɛ ɔwo ntsi na masɔw ahorohoraa.
Wo hun wo nsɛm, na m'akoma ehurusi; osiandɛ, dɔm Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, wɔdze wo dzin ato me.
Manntsena hɔn a wɔregye hɔn enyi, anaa wodzii ehurusi hɔn bagua mu; osian wo nsa ntsi mankotsee metsenae; na ɔwo edze ebufuhyew ahyɛ me ma.
Ɔyɛ dɛn nsti na me yaw wɔ hɔ daa. Na me pirakur ayɛ koannkɔ a ɔpow dɛ no edur yi? Aso ampaara dɛ ɔwo bɛyɛ ɔwora a ɔdaadaa, dɛ esu a ɔwew ama me?
Dɛm ntsi mbre Ewuradze se nye yi, sɛ esan a, ɔno na medze wo bɛba bio, ma eebegyina m'enyim; na sã iyi dza ɔsom bi finimfin dza ɔyɛ huhuw no mu a, nkyɛn, na ɔwodze, ennkɛsan akɔ hɔn nkyɛn.
Na mebeyɛ wo boran afasu a wɔaba ho ban mama ɔman yi; na wonye bedzi ako na wɔrunntum nnkã wo nngu; na mowɔ wo nkyɛn dɛ meregye wo nkwa na meyi wo. Ewuradze na ose.
Na mibeyi wo mefi omumuyɛnyi no ne nsamu, na mapon wo mefi ɔhoɔhunyi no ne nsamu.
16: Ewuradze n'asem baa mo hɔ so, dɛ,
mma nnwar yer, eso mma nya mbabanyin na mbabaa wɔ bea yi do ha.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se wɔ mbabaanyin na mbabaa a wɔwo hɔn bea yi do ho, na hɔn nanom a wɔwoo hɔn, na hɔn egyanom a wɔwoo hɔn wɔ asaase yi do ho no nye yi;
wobowuwu awerɛhow wu; wonnkosū hɔn, eso wonnkesie hɔn; wɔbɛyɛ dɛ efikyir wɔ daadze enyi; na afõwa na ɔkɔm bɛkyew hɔn; na hɔn efun bɛyɛ edziban ama ɔsor nnoma, na asaase mbowa.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, mma hom nnkosū, eso mma hom mmkenyan hɔn; na meyi m'asomdwee efi ɔman yi ho kɔ, Ewuradze na ɔse, adɔyɛ na ayamuhyehye mpo.
Akɛse na nkakraba nyinara bowuwu wɔ asaase yi do; worinnsie hɔn, eso nyimpa runnsū hɔn, eso wɔrommbɔ hɔnho akam, eso wɔremmpɛ hɔn estir mma hɔn.
Eso wɔrennkyɛ edziban mmena hɔn eyiyɛ mu mmfa nnkyekye hɔn werɛ wɔ ewufo no ntsi, eso wɔremma hɔn awerɛkyerkyer kuraba dɛ wɔnnom wɔ hɔn egya na hɔ nã ho.
Na mma nnye hɔn nnkɔ aponto fi mu nnkɛnye hɔn nntsena ase nndzidzi na nnom.
