Na mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi; hwɛ, mebɛma ahosɛpɛw ndze, na enyigye ndze, okumfor ndze na ayefor ndze egyaa, wɔ bea yi do ha, wɔ hom enyiwa mu na hom nda mu.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ iyi, nsɛm yinom nyinara kyerɛ ɔman yi, na wɔse wo dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na Ewuradze akã mbusu kɛse yi nyina egu hɛn do yi?
Ɔnodze se hɔn dɛ, osiandɛ hom egyanom adan me egya, Ewuradze na ɔse, na woekedzi abosom afofor bi ekyir, na wɔasom hɔn, na wɔakotow hɔn na wɔadan me egya, na woenndzi me mbra do;
na hom so abɔ mbusu asen hom egyanom; na, hwɛ, hom mu obiara dzi nankasa n'akoma bɔn ne ntsintsiman ekyir, ma dɛm ntsi na hom mma me aso.
Dɛm nsti na mobɔtow hom mefi asaase yi do ekogu asaase bia hom na hom bɔsom abosom afofor adzekyee na adzesaa; osiandɛ merennyɛ adom biara mma hom.
Dɛm nsti, hwɛ, nda bi reba a, Ewuradze na ɔse, wɔnnkɛse bio dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze a oyii Israelmba fii Egypt asaase no do tse ase yi
na mbom, dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze a oyii Israelmba fii kwaamu afamu asaase do, tse ase yi; na medze hɔn bɛba assase a medze maa hɔn egyanom no do bio.
Hwɛ, mobɔsoma mekehyia apofo pii, Ewuradze na ɔse, na wobonu hɔn; na n'ekyir no masoma ekehyia abɔmbɔfo pii, ma wɔbɔtwe hɔn efi bepɔw biara na koko biara do, na abotan mu etu mu.
Osiandɛ m'enyi wɔ hɔn akwan nyinara do: Wonnsuma wɔ m'enyi do, eso wommbuabua hɔn emumuyɛ do wɔ m'enyiwa do.
Na mibedzi kan metua hɔn emumuye na hɔn bɔn kaw mbɔho" osiandɛ wɔdze hɔn atantandze n'efun egu m'asaase ho fi, na wɔdze hɔn ekyiwadze ahyɛ m'egyapadze do mã.

Ewuradze, m'ahoɔndzen, na m'akoban, na mo guandɔbea wɔ ahohia da mu, ɔwo na amanaman fi asaase ano bɛba wo nkyɛn abɛse dɛ, hɛn egyanom ennya ewungyadze biara dɛ atofosɛm nko, mekyerɛ egyangyandze na ndzɛmba a mfaso bi nnyi mu.
Aso dasanyi bɛyɛ abosom bi ama noho, naaso na wɔnnyɛ abosom bi?
Dɛm nsti, hwɛ, mebɛma woehu, prɛko yi ara dze mebɛma woehu me nsa na m'ahoɔndzen; na wobohu dɛ me dzin dze Jehovah.
17: Judah no bɔn wɔdze dadze kyerɛwdze na dɛnky3mbo hwinsti akyerɛw: Woekrukye no wɔ hɔn akoma pon, na hɔn afɔrmbukyia mmbɛn do;
ber a hɔn mba kã hɛn afɔrmbukyia na hɔn Asherim a ɔwowɔ ndua ebun ebun ase wɔ akoko sorɔnsorɔm do no.
Me bepɔw a ewɔ wiramu, medze w'ahodze na w'akoradze nyina mebɛma ma wɔaafa no afo, na wo nsorɔnsorɔmbea no, wɔ bɔn ntsi, wɔ bɔn ntsi, wɔ w'ahe nyinara do.
Na ɔwo, ɔwoara wo mu no, ibegyaa egyapadze a medze maa wo no mu ato hɔ; na mebɛma akɔsom w'atamfo wɔ asaase a innyim no do: Osiandɛ hom asɔ gya wɔ m'ebufuw mu a ɔbɛdzɛw daa.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Ndom nkã ɔdasanyi biara a ɔtwer ɔdasanyi, na ɔdze ɔhonam yɛ n'akodadze, na n'akoma twe fi Ewuradze ho.
Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛ sar do duaba, na sɛ yie ba a oruunhu; na ɔbɛtsena mbea a ayɛ kɛsɛɛ no do wɔ sar no do, nkyen asaase a obi nntse do.
Osiarfo nye nyimpa a ɔdze noho twer Ewuradze, na Ewuradze yɛ n'enyidado.
Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛ dua a wɔatsɛw no wɔ nsu ho, na ɔtsentsen no ndwow kɔ esutsen no nkyɛn, na sɛ ɔhyew ba a, ɔnnyɛ no hu, na mbom n'ahaban bɛyɛ ebun ebun, na nsu-na afe nnkɛyɛ no asɛm, eso orinngyaa aba sow.
Akoma yɛ ɔdaadaafo kyɛn adze nyina, na ɔye otsiɔdzenfo pasaa, woana botum ehu?
Emi mara Ewuradze na mohwehwɛ akoma mu, mosɔ nsɛbɛ mohwɛ, ama maama obiara, dɛ mbrɛ n'akwan tse, dɛ mbrɛ ne nyɛe n'aba tse
mbrɛ akokɔhwerɛw da nkyiresua a nnyɛ ɔno bi towee do tse no, mbrɛ nyia onya ahonya, na ɔnnam tsenenee mu tse ara nye no; ne nda ne finimfin no wobegya no hɔ, na ewiei no ɔbɛyɛ ɔkwasea.
Enyimnyam ahengua a wɔakrɔn no fir tsetse nye hɛn krɔnkrɔn-bea ha.
Ewuradze, Israel enyidado, hɔn a wɔdan wo gya nyina enyi bɔtõ; hɔn a wofi me nkyɛn kɔ no, wɔbɛkyerɛw hɔn ahyɛ famu osiandɛ wɔadan Ewuradze, nkwa nsunyiwa no egya.
Ewuradze, sa me yarba, na mo ho bɛsan; gye me nkwa, na mibenya nkwa: Na ɔwo nye m'ayɛyi.
Hwɛ, wɔse me dɛ, Ewuradze n'asɛm no wɔ hen? Ma ɔmbra ɛ!
Emidze memmpɛ ntsɛm minngyaae dɛ neyɛ oguanhwɛfo dzi w'ekyir: Eso memmpɛɛ mbusu da no; ɔwoara inyim; dza ofiir m'ano no, ɔdaa w'enyim.
Mma nnyɛ ohuyifo mma me; ɔwo nye mo guandɔbea wɔ mbusu da no mu.
Ma hɔn a wohiahia mo ho no hɔn enyi ntõ, na emidze, mma m'enyi nntõ; ma hɔn bo ntu, na emidze, mma mo bo nntu: Fa mbusu da no bra hɔn do, na fa ɔsɛɛ mbɔho sɛɛ hɔn.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze see me nye yi: Kɔ, kegyina ɔman no ne mba hɔn aponkɛse a Judah ahemfo dzi mu akɔnaaba, ɔnnye Jerusalem aponkɛse no nyinara mu;
na se hɔn dɛ, hom Judah ahemfo, na Judah nyinara na Jerusalem atsefo nyinara a wodua aponkɛse yi mu kɛhɛn mu, hom ntsie Ewuradze n'asɛm;
mbrɛ Ewuradze dze se nye yi; hom nhwɛ homho yie, na mma hom nnsoa adzesoa ahomgyeda anaaso wɔmmfa nndua Jerusalem aponkɛse mu mmba mu;
eso mma hom nnsoa adzesoa mmfifi hom efiefi mu ahomgyeda, eso mma hom nnyɛ edwuma biara; na mbom hom nyɛ ahomgyeda no krɔnkrɔn, dɛ mbrɛ mehyɛɛ hom egyanom no;
naaso woenntsie, eso wɔammbrɛ hɔn aso adze, na wɔkyeē hɔn kɔn, amma wɔaanntse na wɔaanngye nkyerɛkyerɛ.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ hom tsie me enyiberdo, Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ hom nnkɛfa adzesoa biara edua kurow yi n'aponkɛse mu ahomgyeda, na mbom hom yɛ ahomgyeda no krɔnkrɔn, dɛ hom nndzi dwuma biara wɔ mu a,
ɔnodze ahemfo na mbapɔmba a wɔtsetse Dayid akɔngua do no, wobodua kurow yi aponkɛse mu ahɛn mu a wɔtsenatsena nseaseanam mu na mbapɔmba, Judah mbarimba ɔnye Jerusalem atsefo: Na kurow yi besi hɔ daa.

Na wofi Judah kurow, na mbeambea a abɔ Jerusalem ho aprɔw, na Benjamin asaase, na bɔnsa mu, na mbepɔw do, na pomu afamu bɛba, dze ɔhyew-afɔr, na okum-afɔr, na edziban-afɔr, na nduhuan aba, na wɔdze ndaase afɔrbɔdze aba Ewuradze fie.

Na sɛ hom amma me aso dɛ hom bɛyɛ ahomgyeda no krɔnkrɔn, na hom nnkɔsoa adzesoa akɛhɛn Jerusalem aponkɛse no mu ahomgyeda a, ɔnodze mobɔsɔ gya wɔ aponkɛse no mu, na ɔahyew Jerusalem ahemfie no na worunndum no.
18: Asɛm a ofi Ewuradze hɔ baa Jeremiah nkyɛn, dɛ,
soɛr, na sian kɔ ɔwenfo no fie, na hɔ na mebɛma atse me nsɛm.
Nna misianee mokɔr ɔwemfo no fie, na, hwɛ nna ɔreyɛ n'edwuma wɔ nhwiir do.
Na ber a ɔsen a ɔdze awendɛtse yɛe no, ɔyɛɛ no ɔsɛn fofor bio, dɛ mbrɛ ɔwemfo no hwɛ a oye no.
Nna Ewuradze n'asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
Israel fifo, aso murunntum mmfa hom nnyɛ dɛ ɔwemfo yi? Ewuradze na ɔse. Hwɛ, mbrɛ awendɛtse wɔ ɔwemfo nsamu ara nye no, Israel fifo.
Aber biara a mebɛkasa wɔ ɔman bi ho, na ahendzi bi ho, dɛ mubotutu no, na medwuruw no, na masɛɛ no no;
sɛ ɔman no a makasa hɔm ho no wɔsan fi hɔn emumuyɛ ho a, mubonu moho wɔ mbusu a modween dɛ medze bɔbɔ hɔn no ho.
Na aber biara a mebɛkasa ɔman bi ho na ahendzi bi ho, dɛ mibesi na mastew no;
sɛ ɔbɔ mbusu wɔ m'enyi do, dɛ ɔnntse me ndze a, ɔnodze mubonu moho wɔ papa a mekãa dɛ medze bɛyɛ hɔn mfaso nyinara ho.

Na afei kɔ ɛ, kɛkã kyerɛ Judah mbarimba, na Jerusalem atsefo, dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi; hwɛ, merehyehyɛ mbusu bi metsia hom, afei hom mu biara nsan mfi no mbusu kwan ho, na hom nyɛ ho, akwan no hom ndzeyɛɛ yie.
Na hɔndze, wɔse dɛ, enyidado bi nnyi hɔ; na yebedzi hɛnankasa hɛn tsirmsɛm ekyir, na hɛn mu biara akã n'akoma bɔn ne ntsintsin do.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Afei hom mbisa amanaman mu dɛ woana atse dɛm ndzɛmba yi bi da; Israel ne baabun no ayɛ adze a ɔyɛ hu papaara.
Aso Lebanon esukwankyɛba bɛsã wɔ kwaa mu ɔbotan do? Anaa aso amanandze nsubansuba nwinwin a ɔrepem sian na ɔbɛba abɔwew?
Na me man werɛ efir me, wɔahyew nduhuam ama egyangyandze; na wɔama mefintsiw hɔn akwan mu, tsetse atsempɔn no do, dɛ wɔbɛnantsew akwamfo a wɔmmbɔe do;
dɛ wɔnyɛ hɔn asaase amanfõ na daa asesardze; obiara a ɔbɛfa do no ho bɔbɔw no, na ɔawosow ne tsir.
Mobɔbɔ hɔn apetse wɔ atamfo enyim dɛ menndze boka mframa; hɔn ekyir na mobɔhwɛ na nnyɛ hɔn eenyim bi a, wɔ hɔn mbusu da no mu.

Nna wɔkãa, hom mbra ma yɛnkɛpam Jeremiah ne tsir do; na mbra no rennhera mmfi ɔsɔfo hɔ, na afotu efi onyansafo hɔ anaa asɛm no efi nkɔnhyɛnyi hɔ. Hom mbra ma yɛmfa tɛkyerɛma mbɔ no, na mma yenntsie ne nsɛm mu biara.
Ewuradze, yɛ aso ma me ɛ, na tsie hɔn a wɔnye me ridzi esi no hɔn ndze.
Aso wɔdze mbusu botua papa kaw? Na hɔndze woefun mona ama me kra. Kaa mbrɛ migyinaa w'enyim dɛ merekã papa mama hɔn dɛ meredan w'ebufuw efi hɔn do no.
Dɛm ntsi yi hɔn mba ma ɔkɔm, na gyaa hɔn mu hyɛ afõwa no tum nsa; na ma hɔn yernom ndzi mba ho nsaansa, na wɔnyɛ ekunafo; na ma owu nku hɔn mbarimba, na hɔn mberantsɛ no.
Ma wɔntse osū nka wɔ hɔn efiefi mu, ber a edze dɔm bɛba hɔn do awerɛfir mu no; na woefun mona dɛ wɔdze rekyer me, na woesuasua m'anamɔn mfir.
Naaso, Ewuradze, inyim hɔn apam a wɔpam mo do dze eboku me nyinara; mma mmfa hɔn bɔn mmfi w'enyi do: Na mbom ma wombutuw hɔn wɔ w'enyim; ɔwoara enye hɔn ndzi wɔ w'ebufuw ber no mu.
19: Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, kɔ kɔtɔ ɔwemfo ne dɛtse toa bi, na fa ɔman mu mpanyimfo, na asɔfo no mu mpanyimfo no bi;
na si mu kɔ Hinnom ba no bɔnsa a ɔwɔ ɔponkɛse Harsith n'ahɛnee no nkyɛn no, na bɔ nsɛm a mebɛkã akyerɛ wo no dawur wɔ hɔ:

Na se dɛ, Judah ahemfo na Jerusalem atsefo, hom ntsie Ewuradze n'asɛm; mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi, hwɛ, medze mbusu mebɛba bea yi do a obiara a ɔbɛtse no, n'asomu bɛyɛ no gyengyenngyen.

Osiandɛ wɔadan me egya, na wɔayɛ bea yi ananabea, na wɔahyew eduhuam wɔ mu ama abosom afofor bi a wonnyim hɔn, hɔn na hɔn egyanom na Judah ahemfo; na wɔdze hɔn a wodzi bem hɔn bɔgyaa ahyɛ bea yi do mã;
na woesi Baal no nsorɔnsorɔmbea dɛ wɔbɛhyew hɔn mba wɔ gya mu dze abɔ ɔhyew-afɔr ama Baal; dza mennhyɛɛ hɔn, eso mennkãe, eso ɔmmbaa m'adwen mu:
Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, nda reba a, Ewuradze na ɔse, wɔnnkɛda ho afrɛ bea yi Topheth, anaa Hinnom ba no bɔnsa bio, na mbom dɛ, Ekumii Bɔnsa.
Na mebɛma Judah na Jerusalɛm egyinatu ayɛ kwawɔ bea yi do; na mebɛma wɔatotɔ afõwa ano wɔ hɔn nkwa no nsamu: Na medze hɔn efun mebɛma ɔsor nnoma na asaase mbowa ma woeedzi.
Na mebɛma kurow yi ayɛ amamfõ, na asesardze; obiara a obotwa mu wɔ hɔ no, no ho bɔbow no na ɔabɔ nhwiroma wɔ ne yardɔm nyinara ntsi.
Na mebɛma woedzi hɔn mbabanyin nam, na hɔn mbabaa nam, na hɔn mu obiara bedzi ne nyɛnko ne nam, wɔ ntuae na ahokyer a hɔn atamfo na hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ hɔn nkwa no dze bɛkyer hɔn ho no ntsi.
Ɔno na ebɔbɔ toa no wɔ mbarimba a ɔnye wo rokɔ no enyim,
na ase hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi na nkurow yi, dɛ mbrɛ obi bɔ ɔwemfo ne sɛn a wobesie hɔn wɔ Topheth, ma ekodu dɛ siebea bi nnyi hɔ bio.
Mbrɛ medze bɛyɛ kurow yi na no mu atsefo nye yi, Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ mebɛyɛ kurow yi dɛ Topheth:

Na Jerusalem efiefi na Judah ahemfo efiefi a woegu ho fi no, bɛyɛ dɛ Topheth bea no, mekyerɛ adan nyinara a wɔahyehyew nduhuam wɔ n'etsifi ama ɔsor dɔm nyinara, na woehue ɔnomafɔr ama abosom afofor no so.
Nna Jeremiah fii Topheth, mbrɛ Ewuradze somaa no ma ɔkɔhyɛɛ nkɔm wɔ hɔ no, bae; na obegyinaa Ewuradze fi abangua no do, na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ oman no nyinara dɛ:
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, hwɛ, medze mbusu a makã egu kuropɔn yi ɔnye no nkurow nyinara do no, mebɛba no do; osiandɛ wɔakyē hɔn kɔn, dɛ worinnsie m'asɛm.
20: Afei ɔsɔfo Immer ba Pashhur a ɔyɛ Ewuradze fie ɔsomfo otsitsir no, ɔtsee dɛ Jeremiah rehyɛ yinom ho nkɔm.
Nna Pashhur bɔɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah, na ɔdze no too dua mu, wɔ Benjamin ɔponkɛse a odzi sor wɔ Ewuradze fie no mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ adze kyēe no, Pashhur tuu Jeremiah fii dua mu. Nna Jeremiah see no dɛ, Ewuradze mmfrɛɛ wo dzin Pashhur, na mbom Magor-missabib.

Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ, mebɛma ayɛ ehudze ama wankasa woho na wo nsɛfo nyinara: Na wɔbɔtotɔ hɔn atamfo afõwa ano, na w'enyiwa bohu: Na medze Judah nyina bɛhyɛ Babylonhen nsa, na ɔbɔsoa hɔn akɔ ndɔmmum wɔ Babylon, na ɔdze afõwa ekuku hɔn.

Bio so medze kurow yi no mu ahonya nyina na n'enyadze nyina, na ne ndzɛmba a ɔsom bo nyina, mebɛma, nyew, medze Judah ahemfo akoradze nyinara mebɛhyɛ hɔn atamfo nsa, na wɔafa hɔn afo, na wɔafa, na wɔasoa akɔ Babylon.
Na ɔwo Pashhur na hɔn a wɔtse wo fie nyinara bɔkɔ ndɔmmum: Na ebɛba Babylon, na hɔ na ibowu, na hɔ na wobesia wo, ɔwo, na wo nsɛfo nyinara a ahyɛ nkɔntor akyerɛ hɔn no.
Ewuradze, adaadaa me, na mennhu ekyir: Wo ho yɛ dzen sen me, na edzi nyim; mayɛ asereserewdze adzekyee nyina, obiara si me atwetwe.
Na mekasa ara apem a metsēa mu: Metsēa mu dɛ, akakabensɛm na afofa; osiandɛ wɔama Ewuradze n'asɛm adan me ahorohoraa na atwetwesi adzekyee nyina.
Na sɛ mekã dɛ, morommbɔ ne dzin, anaa merennkasa wɔ ne dzin mu bio a, nna ɔyɛ m'akoma mu dɛ ogya a ɔredzɛw a wɔatow mu wɔ me mbiew mu, na maberɛ penkyɛr, na munntum nnsɔw.

Na matse nyimpa pii hɔn dzinsɛɛ kasa, hu wɔ mbea nyina. Kasa tsiatsia, na yɛbɛkasa etsia no bi; me nsɛfo a menye hɔn bɔ awɛ na wɔse, hɔn a wɔrotweɔn m'esianka bɔn no a; dɛ, egyangyanbiara wɔbɛdaadaa no, na yeedzi no do nyim, na yeedzi hɛn wer wɔ no do.

Na Ewuradze wɔ me nkyɛn dɛ ɔkatakyi a no ho yɛ hu: Dɛm ntsi m'ahohiahiafo befintsiw, na wonnkedzi nyim; hɔn enyi bɔtõ kɛsenara, osiandɛ woenndzi enyansasɛm, mekyerɛ daa enyimguase a werɛ nnkefir ara da no.
Na dɔm Ewuradze, ɔwo a esɔ ɔtseneneenyi hwɛ, ihu w'awerdzi wɔ hɔn do; na ɔwo na meyi m'asɛm makyerɛ wo.
Hom ntow ndwom mma Ewuradze, hom nyi Ewuradze ayɛw; na oeyi ohianyi ne kra efi emumuyɛfo nsamu.
Ndom nkã da a wɔwoo me wɔ mu no: Mma nhyira nnkã da me nã woo me wɔ mu no.
Ndom nkã nyimpa a ɔdze amandzɛɛ brɛɛ brɛɛ m'egya, dɛ, wɔawo ɔbabanyin ama wo; ma ɔmaa n'enyi gyee pii no.
Na wɔmma nyimpa no nyɛ dɛ nkurow a Ewuradze butuuw hɔn, na onnu noho no: Na wɔmma ɔntse osū anapa, na nkekamu ewiaber;
osiandɛ oennku me yafun mu; na nkyɛ me nã aadan m'adakamaa, na ne yafun aayɛ kuntuw daa.
Ɔyɛ dɛn na mifii yafun mu mifirii, dɛ murubohu ɔberɛ na awerɛhow, na me nda asã enyito mu?
21: Asɛm a ofi Ewuradze hɔ baa Jeremiah nkyɛn, ber a Ɔhen Zedekiah somaa Malchijah ba Pashhur, na ɔsɔfo Maaseiah ba Zephaniah wɔ ne nkyɛn dɛ,
meserɛ wo, bisa Ewuradze hɔ ma hɛn; na Babylonhen Nebuchednezzar nye hɛn ridzi akõ: Egyangyanbiara Ewuradze nye hɛn bedzi no dɛ mbrɛ n'anwanwa ndwuma no nyina tse, ma oeefi hɛn do afow akɔ.
Nna Jeremiah see hɔn dɛ, dɛm na hom nkɛkã nkyerɛ Zedekiah:

Mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi, hwɛ, mebɛdan hom nsamu akodze a hom dze nye Babylonhen na Chaldeafo a woebotua hom rokõ, wɔ afasu ekyir no, na mobɔboa hɔn ano aba kurow yi ne finimfin.
Na emi mankasa medze nsa a atsen na basa a ɔyɛ dzen, mekyerɛ ebufuw, na ebufuhyew, na enyiber kɛse menye hom bɔkõ.
Na mobɔbɔ kurow yi mu atsefo, nyimpa na mbowa nyina: Na ɔyardɔm kɛse bɛma woewuwu.

Na n'ekyir no, Ewuradze na ɔse, mibeyi Judahhen Zedekiah, na no nkowaa, na ɔman no, na hɔn a wɔaka kurow yi mu a woefi ɔyardɔm, na afõwa, na ɔkɔm mu no mahyɛ Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar nsa, na hɔn atamfo nsa, na ɔdze afõwa anomu ekuku hɔn; ɔrennkam hɔn do, eso ɔrenntse mma hɔn, na onnuhu hɔn mbɔbɔr.
Na kã kyerɛ ɔman yi dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Hwɛ, medze nkwa no kwan na owu no kwan misi hom enyim.
Nyia ɔbɛtsena kurow yi mu no, obowu afõwa, na ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm ano: Na nyia obefir edzi na ɔakɔtɔ Chaldeafo a woetwa hom ho mu no, ɔbɛtsena ase, na no nkwa bɛyɛ afonam ama no.
Na medze m'enyim mesi kurow yi do wɔ mbusu ntsi, na nnyɛ papa ntsi bi a, Ewuradze na ɔse: Wɔdze bɛhyɛ Babylon hen ne nsa, na ɔdze ogya ahyew no.
Na Judahhen ne fie ho dze, hom ntsie Ewuradze n'asɛm no:

Dayid fifo, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hom mbu atsɛn anapa, na hom ngye dza wɔafa no afo no mfi ɔhyɛdofo no ne nsamu amma m'ebufuhyew eemmfir edzi dɛ ogya, na ɔaanhyew mbrɛ obi nntum nndum no, wɔ hom nyɛe no mbusu ntsi.
Hwɛ, menye wo enya, ɔwo a etse bɔnsa mu, na asaase tɛtɛr mu botan do, Ewuradze na ɔse; hom a hom kã dɛ, woana besian aba hɛn do? Anaa woana na ɔbɛba hɛn tsenabea mu?
Na mebɛtsēa hom dɛ mbrɛ hom ndzeyɛɛ no nsowee tse, Ewuradze na ɔse: Na mobɔsɔ gya wɔ no kwaa mu ma ɔahyew dza ɔabɔ no ho aprɔw nyinara.
23: Ndom nkã nguanhwɛfo a wɔsãã m'edzidzibea do nguan na wɔbɔ hɔn petse no! Ewuradze na ɔse.

Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopon no kã dze tsia nguanhwɛfo a wɔnyɛn me man no nye yi: Hom abɔ mo nguankuw apetse, na hom apam hɔn, na hom annsera hɔn; hwɛ, medze hom ndzeyɛɛ no mbusu mebɛba abɛsera hom, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na emi mara mobɔboa mo nguankuw nkaa no ano mefi asaase nyina a mapam hɔn makɔ hɔ no do, na medze hɔn aba hɔn nguambmban mu bio; na wɔawowo na wɔadɔr.
Na mibesisi hɔn do nguanhwɛfo a wɔbɛnyɛn hɔn; na worunnsuro bio, eso wɔrommbɔ hu, eso hɔn mu obiara rennka, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hwɛ, nda reba a, Ewuradze na ɔse, mebɛma odubaa tsenenee bi do mama Dayid, na obedzi hen dɛ ɔhen a ɔyɛ enyansadze, na ɔayɛ atsɛmbu na pɛrpɛr wɔ asaase no do.
Ne nda no mu na wɔbɛgye Judah nkwa, na iyi nye dzin a wɔdze bɛfrɛ no Ewuradze hɛn tsenenee.
Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ nda reba a, Ewuradze na ɔse, wɔrennse bio dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze a oyii Israelmba fii Egypt assase do tse ase yi;
na mbom, dɛ, Dɛ Ewuradze a okeyii Isreal fi asefo fii kwaamu afamu mbew do bae no tse ase yi; na wɔbɛtsena hɔnankasa hɔ asaase do.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo no ho dze. M'akoma a ɔda mo mu ebubu, me mbiew nyinara him biribiw; mayɛ dɛ ɔsãbofo, na dɛ nyimpa a nsã etum no; wɔ Ewuradze ntsi, na ne nsãm krɔnkrɔn ntsi.
Na awartofo ayɛ asaase no mã; na ntaka ntsi, asaase dzi awerɛhow; sar do edzidzibea akyenkyen; na hɔn anamɔnkwan yɛ mbusu, hɔn mbɔdzen so nntsen.
Na nkɔnhyɛnyi na ɔsɔfo nyina ho ekum; nyew, me fie na mehu hɔn emumuyɛ, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Dɛm ntsi hɔn kwan bɛyɛ hɔn dɛ mbea a ɔyɛ tortor wɔ sum mu: Wɔbɔtwe hɔn akɔ ma wɔakahwehwe ase wɔ mu: Na medze mbusu mebɛba hɔn sera afe no, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na mehu nkwaseasɛm wɔ Samaria nkɔmhyɛfo no mu; wɔdze Baal hyɛɛ nkɔm na wɔmaa me man Israel fomee.

Jerusalem nkɔnhyɛfo no mu so, mehu adze a ɔyɛ hu bi; wɔtõ awar, na wɔnantsew ator mu, na wɔhyɛ emumuyɛfo nsa dzen, ma obiara emmfi n'emumuyɛ mu annsan: Hɔn nyinara ayɛ me dɛ Sodom, na hɔn mu atsefo no ayɛ dɛ Gomorrah.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se wɔ nkɔnhyɛfo no ho nye yi: Medze ɔbɔwen bɛyɛn hɔn, na mama wɔanom ɔbɔwema nsu: Na ahokum fi Jerusalem nkɔnhyɛfo no nkyɛn akɔ asaase no nyina do.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi, mma hom nntsie nkɔnhyɛfo na a wɔhyɛ hom nkɔm no hɔn nsɛm no; wɔkyerɛkyerɛ hom adze huhuw: Hɔnankasa hɔn akoma enyido-adzehu na wɔkã, na ommfi Ewuradze anomu.
Wɔkã daa kyerɛ hɔn a wommbu me dɛ, Ewuradze na ɔse, hom benya asomdwee; na obiara a ɔnantsew noara n'akoma ne ntsintsiman mu no so wɔse no dɛ, mbusu bi nnkɛba hom do.
Na woana na oegyina Ewuradze n'egyinamu, ama oeehu na ɔaatse n'asɛm?
Hwɛ, Ewuradze n'ehum, mekyerɛ n'ebufuhyew no, efir edzi, nyew, ekyinehyia ehum a ɔbɔbo ebesi emumuyɛfo etsifi.
Ewuradze n'ebufuhyew rennsan, ma ekodu dɛ oewie na ɔayɛ n'akoma adwen: Nda a odzi ekyir mu na hom bɛtse ase kofee.
Nnyɛ emi mosomaa nkɔnyhɛfo no, naaso wotuu mbirika: Emi mankasa mannkyerɛ hɔn, naaso wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm.
Na sɛ wogyinaa m'egyinatu mu a, nkyɛ wɔmaa me man tsiee me nsɛm, na wɔsaan hɔn fii hɔn kwan bɔn na hɔn ndzeyɛɛbɔn no ho
Aso meyɛ Nyankopɔn a ɔbɛn, Ewuradze na ɔse, na nnyɛ Nyankopɔn a ɔwɔ ekyirkyir.
Aso obi botum ehuntsa noho wɔ huntsabea bi a emi murunnhu no? Ewuradze na ɔse. Ana mennhyɛ ɔsor na asaase mã? Ewuradze na ɔse.
Matse dza nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛ ator nkɔm wɔ me dzin mu akã, dɛ, masõ daa, masõ daa.
Ɔnkyɛr nkodu dabɛn ara na iyi bɔko nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛ ator nkɔm no akoma mu; nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛ hɔnankasa hɔn akoma mu ndaadaa nkɔm na a?
Wɔdwen dɛ wɔbɛma me man werɛ efir me dzin wɔ hɔn adaaso a hɔn mu nyimpa biara kã kyerɛ ne nyɛnko no ntsi, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom werɛ fiir me dzin wɔ Baal ntsi no.
Nkɔnhyɛnyi a ɔwɔ adaaso bi, ma ɔnkã n'adaaso; na nyia ɔwɔ m'asɛm, ma ɔnkã m'asɛm nokwar mu. Ebɛn na ntsɛw nye ewifua wɔ yɛ? Ewuradze na ɔse.
Ana m'asɛm nntse dɛ ogya? Ewuradze na ɔse; na dɛ hamɛr a opuepue ɔbotan mu esinesin?
Dɛm ntsi hwɛ, menye nkɔmhwɛfo no enya, Ewuradze na ɔse, hɔn a wowiawia m'asɛm wɔ hɔn nsɛfo nkyɛn no.
Hwɛ, Ewuradze na ɔse, menye nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔdzee hɔn tɛkyerɛma kã dɛ, ɔno na ɔse, no enya.

Hwɛ, menye hɔn a wɔhyɛ ator adaa ho nkɔm no enya, Ewuradze na ɔse, na wɔkekã kyerɛ, na wɔdze hɔn atofosɛm na hɔn ntuw hun ma me man wɔfom: Naaso mannsoma hɔn, eso mannhyɛ hɔn; eso wɔrennyɛ mfa so bi mma ɔman yi, koraa, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na sɛ ɔman yi, anaa nkɔnhyɛnyi no, anaa ɔsɔfo bi bisa wo dɛ, Ewuradze adzesoa nye bɛn a? Ɔno se hɔn dɛ, adzesoa bɛn a? Mobɔtow hom egu, Ewuradze adzesoa na ɔse.
Na nkɔnhyɛnyi, na ɔsɔfo, na ɔman a wɔbɛkã dɛ, Ewuradze n'adzesoa no, dze, mebɛtsēa nyimpa no na ne fi mpo.
Mbrɛ hom mu obiara nkã nkyerɛ ne nyɛnko, na obiara nkã nkyerɛ no nua nye yi, ebɛnadze adze na Ewuradze ebua? Na, ebɛn asɛm na Ewuradze akã?
Na Ewuradze adzesoa no dze, mma hom mmbɔ dzin bio, na obiara nora n'asɛm bɛdan no adzesoa; osiandɛ hom esi tsease Nyankopɔn dɔm Ewuradze, hɛn Nyankopɔn no ne nsɛm tsir adze.
Dɛm na hom nse nkɔnhyɛnyi no, ebɛn na Ewuradze dze ebua wo? Na, Asɛm bɛn na Ewuradze akã?
Na sɛ hom se dɛ, Ewuradze n'adzesoa a; dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi; osiandɛ hom kã asɛm yi, dɛ, Ewuradze n'adzesoa, na emi na masoma wɔ hom nkyɛn, dɛ, mma hom nnkã dɛ, Ewuradze n'adzesoa;
dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, mo werɛ befir hom korakora, na matow hom kurow a medze maa ho, na hom egyanom no efi m'enyim akyen:
Na medze daa ahorohoraa, na daa enyito a werɛ nnkefir da, mebɛba hom do.
24: Ewuradze dze kyerɛɛ me, na, hwɛ, adɔmba mbirefi sisi Ewuradze n'asɔrdan enyim; ofitsi ber a Babylonhen Nebuchadrezzar nyaa Judahhen Jehoiakim ne ba Jeconiah, na Judah mbapɔmba na edwimfo, na atomfo fii Jerusalem, na ɔdze hɔn kɔr Babylon ndɔmmum ekyir no.
Birefi kor mu wɔ adɔmba a oye dɛ biribi, dɛ adɔmba a oedzi kan aber: Na birefi kor no do mu wɔ adɔmba a omuo dɛ biribi a wodzi a ɔnnyɛ yie, omuo dodow.
Nna Ewuradze see me dɛ, Jeremiah, ihu ebɛn? Na mesee dɛ, adɔmba a; adɔmba papa no, oye dodow; na dza omuo no, omuo koraa.
Na Ewuradze n'asɛm baa me nkyɛn, dɛ,
mbrɛ Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi; mbrɛ adɔmba papa yi tse no, dɛmara so na mubobu Judah ndɔmmumfo a memaa wofii bea yi do kɔr Chaldeafo asaase no do no bi, mama hɔn yie.
Na medze m'enyi mibesi hɔn do wɔ yie ntsi, na medze hɔn aba asaase yi do bio: Na medze hɔn mibesisi hɔ, na murunndwuruw hɔn.
Na mebɛma hɔn akoma ma wɔdze ehu me, dɛ emi nye Ewuradze: Na wɔbɛyɛ me man, na mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn: Na wɔdze hɔn akoma nyina bɛsan aba me nkyɛn.

Na dɛ mbrɛ adɔmba a omuo a wodzi a ɔnnyɛ tse no, womuo dodow; ampaara mbrɛ Ewuadze se nye yi, dɛmara na mibeyi Judahhen Jedekiah, na ne mbapɔmba, na Jerusalem nkaa a wɔaka asaase no do, na hɔn a wɔtse Egypt asaase do mama:

Mpo mibeyi hɔn mama ma wɔatow hɔn edzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do nhenman nyinaa mu ayɛ hɔn mbusu; ma wɔayɛ ahorohoraa na kasabɛbu, asesardze na ndom, wɔ mbeambea nyina a mebɛpam hɔn mu, ma ekesi dɛ wɔbɛsã koraa wɔ asaase a medze maa hɔn na hɔn egyanom no do.
25: Asɛm a ɔbaa Jeremiah hɔ wɔ Judah man nyina ho wɔ Josiah ba Jehoiakem n'afe a otsīa anan no mu; ɔnoara nye Babylonhen Nebuchadrezzar n'afe a odzi kan no;
ɔno na nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah kasaa kyerɛɛ Judah man no nyina na Jerusalem atsefo nyinara, dɛ,

ofi Ammon ba Josiah, Judahhen no, n'afe otsīa duebiasa no mu, dze bodu ndɛ, mfe eduonu ebiasa nye yi, na Ewuradze n'asɛm aba mo do, na makasa makyerɛ hom, morosoɛr ahema na merekasa; na mbom hom enntsie.
Na Ewuradze asoma mo nkowaa nkɔnkyɛfo no nyina wɔ hom nkyɛn, ɔsoɛr ahema na ɔsoma hɔn, na hom enntsie, eso homm ammbrɛ hom aso adze,
wɔrekã dɛ, hom nsesan mfifi hom mu obiara no kwan bɔn do, na hom ndzeyɛɛ bɔn mu, na hom ntsena asaase a Ewuradze dze ama hom egyanom, ofir tsetse kesi daapem no do mpo:
Na mma hom nnkedzi abosom aforfor ekyir nnkɔsom hɔn, na wɔnnsɔr hɔn, na hom mmfa hom nsaano edwuma nnyi me ebufuw; na mennkɛyɛ hom bɔn bi.
Naasa hom enntsie me, Ewuradze na ɔse; ama hom dze hom nsaano edwuma eeyi me ebufuw ayɛ homara homho bɔn.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Osiandɛ hom enntsie me nsɛm ntsi,

hwɛ, mobɔsoma ma wɔakɛfa kwaamu afamu mbusua nyina, Ewuradze na ɔse, na masoma hɔn akɛma Babylonhen Nebuchadrezzar m'akowaa no, na medze hɔn maba asaase yi, na no mu atsefo nyina do, na amanaman a wɔabɔ ho aprɔw nyina do, na masɛɛ hɔn huntuhuntu, na mama wɔadan ahobowdze, na asesardze, na daa amamfõ.
Bio so mibeyi ehurusi ndze na enyigye adze, ayeforkun ndze na adze, ewuyambo nka, na kandzea ne kan mefi hɔn mu.
Na asaase yi nyina bɛyɛ amamfõ na ahobowdze; na amanaman yi bɔsom Babylonhen mfe eduosuon.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ no wie sõ a, mebɛtsēa Babylonhen na ɔman no, Ewuradze na ɔse. Wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi, na Chaldeafo asaase no; na mebɛyɛ no amamfõ afebɔɔ.
Na mebɛma me nsɛm a makã etsia amanaman nyina no aba mu, mekyɛrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no buukuu yi mu no nyina a Jeremiah ahyɛ ho nkɔm etsia amanaman nyina no.
Na amanaman pii na ahemfo akɛse dze hɔn bɔsom hɔnho, mekyerɛ hɔnara a; na mebɛhyɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ na hɔn nsaano edwuma tse.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn se me nye yi: Gye ebufuw yi ne nsa kɔɔpow no wɔ me nsamu, na ma amanaman nyinaa morosoma wo hɔn nhyɛn no wɔnnom.
Na wɔbɔnom, na wɔato ntentan, na woegyinagyim, osian afõwa a mobɔsoma no aba hɔn mu no ntsi.
Nna megyee kɔɔpow no wɔ Ewuradze nsamu, na memaa amanaman a Ewuradze somaa me hɔn nkyɛn no nyina nomee:
Mekyɛrɛ, Jerusalem, na Judah nkurow, na n'ahemfo, na ne mbapɔmba, na wɔaayɛ amamfõ ahobowdze, asesardze, na ndom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse, ndɛ yi.
Egypthen Pharoah, na no nkowaa, na ne mbapɔmba, na ne man nyinara;
na amamforafo nyinara na Uz asaase do ahemfa nyina, na Philistiafo asaase do nyina, na Ashkelon, na Gaza, na Ekron, na Ashdod nkaa no;
Edom, na Moab, na Ammonmba no;
na Tyre ahemfo nyina, na Zidon ahemfo nyina, na nsupɔw a ɔwɔ po no egya no do ahemfo;
Dedan, na Tema na Buz, na hɔn a woetwitwa ntakuwa nyina;
na Arabia ahemfo nyina, na aforaforafo a wɔtse sar do no hɔn ahemfo nyina;
na Zimri ahemfo nyina na Elam ahemfo nyina na Media ahemfo nyina;
na kwaamu afamu ahemfo nyina, hɔn a wɔbɛn na hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyirkyir wɔnye hɔnho nkorkor, na wiadze nhenman horow a wɔwɔ assase enyi nyina; na Sheshachhen bedzi hɔn ekyir anom.
Na kã kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hom nnom, na hom mbobow, na hom mpuw ngu, na hom nhwehwe ase, na mma hom nnsoɛr bio, wɔ afõwa a morosoma aba hom mu no ntsi.
Na sɛ ɔba dɛ, wɔpow dɛ wɔgye kɔɔpow no wɔ wo nsamu nom a, ɔnodze kã kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Ɔnom ara na hom bɔnom.

Na, hwɛ, kurow a wɔdze me dzin ato no na mefitsi ase morobɔ no mbusu yi, na aso hom dze hom bɛfa homho edzi koraa? Hom ho nndzi: Osiandɛ mebɛfrɛ afõwa maba assase do atsefo nyina do: Dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.

Dɛm ntsi hyɛ nsɛm yinom nyina ho nkɔm tsia hɔn, na se hɔn dɛ, Ewuradze fi sor bɔpɔw, na oefi no krɔnkrɔn tsenabea no do abɔ ne ndze mu; ɔbɔpɔw ɔdzendo wɔ no nguamban do; ɔbɔbɔ ose tse dɛ wenyinaba wɔwfo wɔ asaase do atsefo nyina do,
Debi bokodu asaase ano noho mpo; na Ewuradze nye amanaman enya ɔham, ɔnye adasa nyina enya atsɛn; na emumuyɛfo dze, obeyi hɔn ama afõwa, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye, hwɛ mbusu befi ɔman do akɔ ɔman do, na ehum kese etu efi asaase etsiwamu noho.
Na da no Ewuradze n'atɔfoe bɛdeda hɔ fi asaase ne tsir ekesi asaase ne tsir kor do: Worinngyam hɔn, eso wɔrommboaboa hɔn ano, eso worinnsie hɔn; wobɛyɛ dɛ efikyir egugu assase enyi.
Nguanhwɛfo e, hom mbɔ mbubuw na hom nkekamu ɛ, na hom nguankuw me etsitsir, hom nyankanyankam nso mu; na hom okum nda no enya edu; na mobɔbobɔ hom posoposo, na hom abobɔ famu dɛ kuraba a ɔyɛ fɛw.
Na nguanhwɛfo no nnkenya kwan eguan, eso nguankuw mu estitsir no nnkefi nsa.
Nguanhwɛfo no hɔn sū ne ndze bi, na nguankuw mu etsitir mbubuwbɔ osiandɛ Ewuradze asɛɛ hɔn edzidzibea.
Na asomdwee nguamban no mu ayɛ komm wɔ Ewuradze n'ebufuhyew ntsi.
Ɔadan ne dabew ahobowdze wɔ nhyɛdo afõwa no ne hyeehyew, na n'ebufuhyew ntsi.
26: Josiah ba Jehoiakim, Judahhen no, n'ahendzi ahyɛse no, na asɛm yi fii Ewuradze nkyɛn bae, dɛ,
mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Kegyina Ewuradze fie abangua, na Judah nkurow nyinara a wɔba bɔsɔr Ewuradze fie no kã kyerɛ hɔn; mma mmfa asɛm biara nnsuma ekyir.
Annyɛ a wobetsie, na hɔn mu nyimpa biara adan efi n'akwan bɔn wɔ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ bɔn ntsi no ho.
Na kã kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Sɛ hom enntsie me, dɛ hom bedzi me mbra a medze esi m'enyim no do,
dɛ hom betsie mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo a mosoma hɔn hom nkyɛn a, mosoɛr ahema mpo na mosoma hɔn, na hom enntsie me nsɛm a;
ɔnodze mebɛyɛ ofi yi dɛ Shiloh, na mayɛ kurow yi ndom mama asaase do amanaman nyina.
Na asɔfo na nkɔnhyɛfo na ɔman no nyina tsee dɛ Jeremiah rekã nsɛm yi wɔ Ewuradze fie.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Jerimiah wiee dze Ewuradze hyɛɛ no dɛ ɔnkã nkyerɛ ɔman na asɔfo no, na nkɔnhyfo no, na ɔman no nyinaa suoo no mu dɛ, owu ara na obowu.
Ebɛn ntsi na edze Ewuradze dzin ahyɛ nkɔm, dɛ ofi yi Bɛyɛ dɛ Shiloh na kurow yi ayɛ ekurofõ a obi nntsena do? Na ɔman no nyinara behyiaa Jeremiah nkyɛn wɔ Ewuradze fie.
Na Judah mbapɔmba tsee ndzemba yinom no, wofii ahemfie foweebaa Ewuradze fie ɔponkɛse fofor no ano.
Nna aɔfo no na nkɔnhyɛfo no kasaa kyerɛɛ mbapɔmba na ɔman no nyina, dɛ, ɔbarimba yi sɛ owu; osiandɛ ɔahyɛ nkɔm etsia kurow yi, dɛ mbrɛ hom aso atse yi.
Nna Jeremiah kasaa kyrɛɛ mbapɔmba nyinara na ɔman no nyinara, dɛ, Ewuradze na ɔsomaa me dɛ membɛhyɛ asɛm a hom atse yi nyina ho nkɔm ntsia ofi yi na kurow yi.
Dɛm ntsi afei hom nyeyɛ hom akwan na hom nyɛe yie. Nahom ntsie Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn ndze; na Ewuradze bonu noho wɔ mbusu a ɔakã etsia hom no ho.
Na emidze, hwɛ mowɔ nsamu; hom nyɛ me dɛ mbrɛ oye na ɔtsen wɔ hom enyi do.

Ohu ara na hom nhu no ampa dɛ, sɛ hom ku me a, hom dze bɔgya a odzi bem bɛba homankasa, na kurow yi, na no mu atsefo nyina do: Na nokwar mu ara, Ewuradze na ɔsaoma me hom nkyɛn dɛ membɛkã nsɛm yi nyina wɔ hom asomu.
Nna mbapɔmba na ɔman no nyina kãa kyerɛɛ asɔfo na nkɔnhyɛfo no dɛ: Ɔbarimaba yi nnsɛ wu; osiandɛ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn dzin mu na ɔakasa akyerɛ hɛn.
Na binom fi asaase no do mpanyimfo no mu soɛree na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ ɔman baguafo no, dɛ,

Morashtnyi Micaiah hyɛɛ nkɔm wɔ Judahhen Heɛekiah ne nda mu; na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ Judah man no nyina dɛ, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Wobofuntum zion dɛ mfuwa, na Jerusalem adan ekrofõ na ofi no bepɔw no ayɛ dɛkwaa mu nsorɔnsorɔmbea.

Aso Judahhen Hezekiah na Judahfo nyina kum no? Ana nnyɛ Ewuradze na osuroo no, na ɔdze nkotoserɛ bisaa Ewuradze n'enyimpa, na Ewuradze so nuu noho wɔ mbusu a ɔkãe tsiaa hɔn no ho. Dɛm na yɛdze bɔbɔ mbusu kɛse etsia hɛnankasahɛn akra.
Na ɔbarimaba bi so wɔ hɔ a ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm wɔ Ewuradze dzin mu, Shemaiah a ofi Kiriath-Jeremiah no ne ba Uriah; na ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm tsiaa kurow yi na asaase yi dɛ mbrɛ Jeremiah ne nsɛm nyina tse:
Na Ɔhen Jehoiakim, na ne mbarimba akatakyi nyinara, na mbapɔmba nyinara, wɔ dɛ oku ni; na Uriah tsee ne, osuroi, na oguanee, na ɔkɔr Egypt:
Na Ɔhen Jehoiakim somaa mbarimba bi kɔr Egypt, mekyerɛ Achor ne ba Elnathan na mbarimba bi wɔkã no hor kɔ Egypt:
Na wɔkɛfaa Uriah fii Egypt, na wɔdze no brɛɛ Ɔhen Jehoiakim; ɔno na ɔdze afõwa kum no na ɔtow no fun kyeen amansuon esiei.
Na Shaphan ba Ahikam ne nsa wɔ Jeremiah afã, dɛ mma wonyi no nnhyɛ ɔman nsa mma wonnku no.
27: Josiah ba Jehoiakim Judahhen no. N'ahendzi ahyɛse no na asɛm yi fi Ewuradze nkyɛn baa Jeremiah hɔ, dɛ,
mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Yɛ nkyehoma na adaban ma woho, na fa hyɛ wo kɔn;
na fa mona Edomhen, na Moabhen na Ammonmba hɔn hen na Tyrehen, na Sidonhen, wɔ aboɔfo a wɔba Judahhen Zedekiah hɔ wɔ Jerusalem ne nsamu:
Na hyɛ hɔn ma wɔnkɛka nkyerɛ hɔn wuranom, dɛ mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, senye yi: Mbrɛ hom nkɛkã nkyerɛ hom wuranom nye yi:
Emi na medze m'hoɔden kɛse na ma basa a atsen mayɛ asaase, nyimpa na mbowa a wɔwɔ asaase eyi nyina; na medze ma obiara dɛ mbrɛ ɔtsen wɔ m'enyi do.
Na afei medze asaase yi nyina mahyɛ m'akowaa Nebuchadnezzer, Babylonhen no, ne nsa: Na wiramu mbowa so medze ama no dɛ wɔnsom no.
Na amanaman nyina bɔsom no na ne ba, na ne ba ne ba, ma ekudu dɛ noara so n'asaaseber bɔsõ: Nna nkyii amanaman pii na ahemfo akɛse dze no bɔsom hɔnho.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, ɔman na ahendzi a wɔronnsom ɔno Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzer, na wɔremmfa hɔn kɔn nnyɛ Babylonhen no kɔndua ase no, medze afõwa na ɔkɔm na ɔyardɔm mebɛtsēa ɔman no, ma ekodu dɛ menam nsa do mama wɔasã.
Na homdze, mma hom mbusu nkɔnhyɛfo, na hom abayifo a wɔkasa kyɛrɛ hom, dɛ hom ronnsom Babylonhen no:
Na nkɔntor na wɔhyɛ hom, ama ekyirkyir, na maapam hom na hom aahera,
Na ɔman a wɔdze hɔn kɔn bɛhyɛ Babylonhen hen kɔnase, na wɔ asoam no no, ɔman no na mebɛma wɔaka hɔnankasa asaase do, Ewuradze na ɔse; na wɔadcw do, na wɔatsena do.
Na mekasaa kyerɛɛ Judahhen Zedekiah dɛ, mbrɛ nsm yi nyina tse, dɛ hom mfa hom kɔn nhyɛ Babylonhen no kɔndua no ase, na hom nsom ɔno na ne man, na hom atsena ase.
Ebɛn ntsi na hom bowu ɔwo na wo man, wɔ afõwa, ɔkɔm na ɔyardɔm ano, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze akã wɔ ɔman a wɔronnsom Babylonhen ho no?
Na mma hom nntsie nsɛm a nkɔmhyɛfo no ka kyɛrɛ hom, dɛ, hom ronnsom Babylonhen no: Na nkɔntorna wɔhyɛ hom.
Na nnyɛ emi na masoma hɔn, Ewuradze na ɔse, na wɔdze me dɛin hyɛ ator nkɔm; amamaapam hom, na hom ahera, homna nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛ hom nkɔm no nyina.

Eso mekaa mekyerɛɛ asɔfo no, na ɔman yi nyina, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Mma hom nntsie nsɛm a hom nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛ hom nkɔm no kã dɛ, hwɛ, ɔrennkyɛr na wɔdze Ewuradze fie nkuraba no efi Babylon asan aba no: Na nkɔntor na wɔhyɛ hom.
Mma hom nntsie hɔn; hom nsom Babylonhen, na hom ntsena ase: Ebɛn ntsi na kurow yi ndan amamfõ?
Na sɛ wɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛfo, na Ewuradze asɛm wɔ hɔn nkyɛn a ma wɔnkotow nserɛ dɔm Ewuradze dɛ mma nkuraba no a aka Ewuradze fie, na Judahhen fie, na Jerusalem o, aannkɔ Babylon.
Na mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se wɔ edum no na po no na afɔrmbukyia no na nkuraba nkaa a woegya no kurow yi mu ho nye yi,
dza Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzer ammfa annkɔ ber a ɔsoaa Jehoiakim ba Jeconiah, Judahhen no na Judah na Jerusalem mbapɔmba kɔr Babylon no;
nyew, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn se wɔ nkuraba a aka Ewuradzefie, na Judahhen fie, na Jerusalem ho nye yi;
wɔbɔsoa akɔ Babylon, na hɔ na ɔbɛtsena ekodu da a mebɛkesera no, Ewuradze na ɔse, ɔno na medze no bɛsanaba bea yi do bio.
28: Na ɔbaa afe no ara mu, Judahhen Zedekiah n'ahendzi ahyɛse, afe a otsīa anan no bosoom a otsīa enum no mu dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi azzur ba Hannaiah a ofi Gibeon no, ɔsee me wɔ Ewuradze fie, wɔ ascfo no na ɔman no nyinaa enyim, dɛ,
mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn kã nye dɛ, mebubu Babylonhen no kɔndua no.
Mfe ebien mu ara pɛr na medze Ewuradze fie nkuraba a Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzer bɛfae fii bea yi do kɔr Babylon no nyinara bɛsan aba bea yi do bio:
Na medze Jehoiakim ba, Jeconiah, Judahhen no, na judah ndɔmmumfo a wɔkɔr Babylon no nyinaa mebɛsan aba bea yi do bio, Ewuradze na ɔse: Na mubobubu Babylonhen no Kɔndua no.
Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah see nkɔnhyɛnyi Hananiah wɔ asɔfo no enyim, na ɔman a wogyinagyina Ewuradze fie no nyinaa enyim.
mekyerɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah see dɛ, amen: Ewuradze nyɛ sa: Ewuradze mma wo nsɛm a ahyɛ nkɔm akã dɛ wɔdze Ewuradze fie nkuraba, na ndɔmmumfono nyina befi Babylon asan aba bea yi do mbramu.
Naaso afei tsie asɛm yi a merekã wɔ w'asomu, na ɔman yi nyina asomu yi:
Nkɔnhyɛfo a wodzi m'enyim na w'enyim fi tsetse no, wɔhyehyɛɛ asaase pii, na ahendzi akɛse, akodzi na musu, na ɔyardɔm ho nkɔm.
Nkɔnhyɛnyi a ɔhyɛ asomdwee ho nkɔm no, sɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi no n'asɛm no ba mu a nna wɔdze hu nkunhyɛnyi a Ewuradze asoma no nokwar mu.
Na nkɔnhyɛyi Hananiah yii ɔdaban no fii nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah no kɔn mu, na obubuu mu.

Na Hananiah kãe wɔ ɔman no nyina enyim, dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Dɛmara na mubobubu Babylonhen Nebuchadnezar no kɔndua no mefi amanaman nyina hɔn mu mfe ebien ara pɛr mu. Na nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah kɔr no kwan.
Na nkɔnhyɛnyi Hananiah bubuu ɔdaban no fii nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah kɔn mu no ekyir no, nna Ewuradze asɛm baa Jeremiah nkyɛn, dɛ,
kɔ kɛse Hananiah, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Ebubu dua adaban no; na ebɛyɛ dadze adaban ahyɛ ananmu.
Na mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, se nye yi: Medze dadze kɔndua mato amanaman yi nyina kɔn mu, dɛ wɔnsom Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar: Na wɔbɔsom no: Na medze wiramu mbowa so mama no.
Nna mkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah see nkɔnhyɛnyi Hananiah dɛ, Hananiah, afei tsie; Ewuradze annsoma wo; na ɔwo ema ɔman yi dze hɔnho twer atofosɛm.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ, mubotu wo efi asaase enyi: Afe yi ibowu, osiandɛ akõ etuatsewsɛm estsia Ewuradze.
Dɛmara na nkɔnhyɛnyi Hananiah wuu afe no ara mu bosoom a otsīa esuon no mu.
29: Na iyinom nye nsɛm a ɔwɔ nwoma a nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah fi Jerusalem dze monaa ndɔmmumfo no mu mpanyimfo no nkaa no, na asɔfo no, na nkɔhyɛfo no na nkorɔfo nyinaa a Nebuchadnezzar soaa hɔn fii Jerusalem kɔr Babylon ndɔmmum no:
(Ber a Ɔhen Jeconiah, na ɔhen ne na, nã epiafo no na Judah na Jerusalem mbapɔmba no, na edwimfo no, na atomfo no fi Jerusalem kɔree no:
Ɔdze nam Shaphan ba Elasah na Hilkiah ba Gemariah (a Judahhen Zedekiah somaa no kɔr Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar hɔ wɔ Babylon no, ne nsa do dɛ,
mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn se ndɔmmumfo nyina a do nheman nyina a mama wɔasoa hɔn akɔ Babylon ndɔmmum no nye yi:
Hom nsisi adan ntsenatsena mu; na hom ntsetsɛw nture, na hom ndzi hɔn mu aba;
hom nwarwar, na hom nwowo mbabanyin na mbabaa; na hom ngyegye nyernom mma hom mbabanyin, na hom mfa hom mbabaa mma kunnom na wɔnwowo mbabanyin na mbabaa; na hom ndɔr wɔ hɔ, na hom ho eennsuar.
Na hom nhwehwɛ ho kurow a mama wɔaso hom akɔ hɔ ndɔmmum no n'amandwee, na hom nyi Ewuradze mpaa mma no: Na n'amandwee mu na hom benya asomdwee.
Na mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn see nye yi: Mma hom mma nkɔhyɛfo a wɔwɔ hom mu no, na mbusunkɔnhyɛto no ndaadaa hom eso mma hom, eso mma hom nntsie adaaso a hom ma wɔso no.
Na ator mu na wɔdze me dzin hyɛ hom nkɔm: Monnsomaa hɔn, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, mfe eduosuon nya du ma Babylon a mebɛserɛ hom, na mama m'asɛmpa aba mu ama hom, dɛ mebɛma hom asan aba ama bio,
na minyim adwen a modwen wɔ hom ho, Ewuradze na ɔse, asomdwee adwen a, na nnyɛ mbusu adwen bi a, dɛ mebɛma hom enyidado wɔ hom ewiei.
Na hom bɛfrɛ me, na hom akɔ nahom eyi mpaa ama me, na metsie hom.
Na hom bɔhwehwɛ me na hom ehu me, ber a hom bɔhwehwɛ me, na hom ehu me, ber a hom dze hom akoma nyina bɔhwehwɛ m'ekyir kwan no.

Na mebɛma hom ehu me, Ewuradze na ase, na medze hom ndɔmmum masan maba, na maboa hom ano efi amanaman nyina mu, na mbea nyina a mapam hom makɔ hɔ no mu, Ewuradze na ɔse; na medze hom aba mbea a memaa wɔsoaa hom fir kɔr ndɔmmum mo bio.
Na hom akã dɛ. Ewuradze ama nkɔnhyɛfo no do ama hɛn wɔ Babylon.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze kã wɔ ɔhen a ɔtse Dayid akɔngua do, na ɔman no nyina a wɔtse kurow yi mu, hom nuanom a wɔnnye hom ronnkɔ ndɔmmum ho nye yi
mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Hwɛ mebɛma afõwa, ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm aba hɔn do, na mayɛ hɔn dɛ ɔyardɔm prɔwee a, muo a omuo dodow ntsi, wodzi a ɔnnyɛ.

Na medze afowã, ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm betsiw hɔn, na meyi hɔn ama ma wɔatow hɔn edzi akɔnaaba wɔ assase do nhenman nyina mu, na mayɛ ekyiwadze na ahobowdze, na asereserewdze, na ahorohoraadze wɔ amanaman nyina a mapam hɔn makɔ hɔ nyina mu:
Osiandɛ woenntsie me nsɛm a, Ewuradze na ɔse, medze mosomaa mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo nobaa hɔn nkyɛn, mosoɛɛr ahema na mosomaa hɔn; na hom enntsie, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Dɛm ntsi hom ndɔmmumfo a mama hom efi Jerusalem akɔ Babylon nyinara, hom ntsie Ewuradze n'asem.

Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn se wɔ Kolaiah ba Ahab, na Maaseiah ba Zedekiah a wɔdze me dzin hyɛɛ nkɔntor ho nye yi: Hwɛ, mibeyi hɔn ahyɛ Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzer nsa: Na woeku hɔn wɔ hom enyim:
Na hɔn na ndɔmmumfo a wɔwɔ Babylon nyinaa anomu, dɛ, Ewuradze nyɛ wo dɛ Zedekiah na Ahab a Babylonhen hoow hɔn wɔ ogya mu no:
Osiandɛ woedzi nkwaseasɛm wɔ Israel, na wɔafefa hɔn nsɛmfo yernom, na wɔdze me dzin aka atofosɛm a nnyɛ na mehyɛɛ hɔn; na emi na minyim, na emi nye ɔdasefo, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na kã wɔ Nehelamnyi Shemaiah ho, dɛ,
mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi; dɛ osiandɛ amona nwoma wɔ wankasa wodzin mu akɛma ɔman a wɔwɔ Jerusalem nyina, na ɔsɔfo Zephania Maaseiah ba no, na ɔsɔfo no nyinara, dɛ,
Ewuradze ahyɛ wo ɔsofo wɔ ɔsɔfo Jehoiada ananmu, dɛ hom nyɛ asomfo wɔ Ewuradze fie mma nyimpa biara a ɔabɔ dam, na ɔyɛ noho nkɔnhyɛnyi, na edze no ato dua mu na mpokyerɛ mu,
na afei, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na enntwuw Anathothnyi Jeremiah a ɔyɛ noho hom nkɔnhyɛnyi no n'enyim,
susuampaa dɛ ɔasoma aba hɛn nkyɛn wɔ Babylon dɛ, ndɔ mmum no akyɛr: Hom nsisi adan, na hom ntsena mu; na hom ntsetsɛw nture, na hom ndzi mu aba?
Na ɔsɔfo Zephaniah kenkaan nwoma yi wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah asomu.
Nna Ewuradze n'asem baa Jeremiah hɔ, dɛ,
soma ma wɔnkɔ ndɔmmumfo no nyina hɔ, dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se wɔ Nehelamnyi Shemaiah ho nye yi: Osiandɛ Shemaiah ahyɛ hom nkɔ, na mannsoma no, na ɔama hom atwer atofosɛm ntsi;

dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ, mebɛtsea Nehelamnyi Shemaiah na n'asefo; orinnya barimba biara ma ɔnntsena ɔman yi mu, eso orunnhu yie medze mebɛyɛ ɔman yi, Ewuradze na ase: Osiandɛ ɔakã etuatsewsɛm etsia Ewuradze.
30: Asɛm a ofi Ewuradze nkyɛn baa Jeremiah hɔ, dɛ,
mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi, dɛ, kyerɛw nsɛm a makã makyerɛ wo nyina wɔ nwoma mu.
Na, hwɛ, nda reba a, Ewuradze na ɔse: Na mama wɔasan asaase a medze memaa hɔn egyanom no do, na woenya edzi.
Na yinom nye nsɛm a Ewuradze kae wɔ Israel ho na Judah ho,
na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Yɛatse ahopopo ndze, bi a.
Afei hom mbisa na hom nhu kyerɛdɛ ɔbarimba kõ awoo anaa: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na muhu ɔbarimaba biara dɛ ne nsa dze ne sisiw mu dɛ ɔbaa a ɔrokõ awoo na enyimenyim nyinara atotow fitaa yi?
Due! na da no sõ a biara nntse dɛ ɔno: Jacob no fona ber ara mpo a; na wɔbɛhye no nkwa efi mu,
na ɔbɛba dɛ da no mu no. Dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, na matsetsew wo nkyehoma no mu; na ananaben nnkedzi no nya bio:
Na wɔbɔsom Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn, na hɔn hen Dayid a mebɛma nodo ama hɔn no.

Dɛm ntsi m'akowaa Jacob, mma nnsuro, Ewuradze na ɔse; eso, Israel, mma wo bo nntu: Na, hwɛ, mebɛhye wo nkwa mefi ekyirkyir na w'asefo mefi hɔn ndɔmmumfafo asaase do; ma Jacob bɛsan aba, na ɔabɛyɛ fõo na no ho atɔ no, na obiara rinnyi no hu.

Na menye wo nam, Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ, mebɛhye wo nkwa: Na mebɛma amanaman a mabɔ wo apetse hɔ nyina asa koraã, na ɔwoaradze, meremma ennsan koraa mbom medze atsɛmbu mebɛtsēa wo, na meremma emmfa woho tɔtrɔtɔ ara da.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, wo pira nnyi edur, na wo pirakaur adzen wo.
Obi nnyi hɔ a odzi w'asɛm ma wo a ɔbekyekyer ama wo; innyi biara.
W'adɔfo nyinarawerɛ efir wo; wɔnnhwehwɛ wo: Na medze ɔtamfo epirakur mepira wo, medze otsiɔdzennyi ntsēa matsēa wo; wɔ w'emumyɛ ne kɛse ntsi, osiandɛ wo bɔn adɔɔ sõ ntsi.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na erekeka mu wɔ wo pira ntsi? Wo kur nnyi edur: Wɔ w'emumuyɛ ne kɛse ntsi, osiandɛ wo bɔn adɔɔ sõ ntsi na medze ndzemba yinom mama wo.
Dɛm ntsi hɔn a wɔmemen wo nyina wɔbɛmen hɔn; na w'atamfo no nyinara, hɔn mu obiara, bɔkɔ ndɔmmum; nahɔn a wotwa wo dwo no wobotowa wo hɔn dwo; na hɔn a wɔfa wo afo mebɛma wo wɔbefa hɔn afo.
Na mebɛma wo apɔwmudze bio, na masa w'epirakur, Ewuradze na ɔse; osiandɛ wɔafrɛ wo nyia woeyi no tokyen, dɛ, Zion a obi nnhwehwɛ n'ekyir kwan a.

Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Hwɛ, medze Jacob ntamadan mu ndɔmmum mebɛsan aba bio, na menya ayamuhyehye wɔ ne tsenabea ho; na wɔbɛkyekyer kurow no wɔ ne ndamfo no ara do, na ahemfi no besi hɔn dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse no ara.
Na ndaase na hɔn enyi agye ndze befir edzi wɔ mu: Na mebɛma wɔadɔr, na worunnsuar; mebɛgyɛ hɔn enyimnyam so, na wɔrennyɛ ketseaba.
Hɔn mba so bɛyɛ dɛ asɔpɔn no, na hɔn mboanofo etsim wɔ m'enyim, na matsēa hɔn a wɔ haw hɔn no nyinara.
Na hɔn safohen bɛyɛ hɔnɛnkasa hɔn bi, na hɔn hwɛdofo efir hcn mu; na mɛbɛma woepinkyɛn, na wɔbɛbɛn me nkyɛn: Na woana nye nyia wosesi no bo dɛ ɔbɛbɛn me? Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na hom bɛyɛ me man, na emi mayɛ hom Nyankopɔn.
Hwɛ, Ewuradze ehum, mekyerɛ n'ebufuhhyew no, etu, ekyinehyia ehum a: Obotu abɔ emumuyɛfo etsifi.
Ewuradze n'ebufuw hyeehyew no rennsan, gyedɛ oewie yɛ, na ɔama n'akoma mu esusudze aba ansaana: Nda a odzi ekir no mu na hom bɛtse ase
31: Aber no mu no, Ewuradze na ɔse, mebɛyɛ Israel mbusuakuw no nyina hɔn Nyankopɔn na hɔn so wɔayɛ me man.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, ɔman afõwa daan hɔn hyae no, enya adom wɔ sar no do; mekyerɛ onyaa ahomhye no a.
Ewuradze yii noho kyerɛɛ me tsetse, dɛ, ampaara, madɔ wo ɔdomankoma dɔ: Dɛm ntsi na medze adɔyɛ matwe wo.
Mibesi wo bio, na esi hɔ, Israel ɔbaabun: Wɔdze mpintsin bɛhyehyɛ wo bio, na efir edzi wɔ agofo asaw mu.
Ebɛtsetsɛw wenyin nture wɔ Samaria mbepɔw do bio: Atsetsɛwfo bɛtsetsew, na woedzi n'aba bi.
Na ba bi bɛba a aweɔmfo bɛtsēa mu wɔ Ephraim mbepɔw do, dɛ Hom nsoɛr ma yɛmfow nkɔ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn nkyɛn Zion.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hom mfa enyigye ntow ndow wɔ Jacob ho, na hom mbɔ amanaman estitir ho ose: Hom mfa ntahye, hom nyi ayɛw, na hom nse dɛ Ewuradze gye wo man, Israel nkaa no nkwa.
Hwɛ, medze hɔn fi kwaamu asaase do mebɛba, na makɔboa hɔn ano efi asaase ano noho, na enyifurafo na mpakye, ɔpemfo, na ɔbaa a ɔrokõ awoo nyinaa kã ho bi: Okuw kukuankoma na wɔbɛsan aba ha.
Wɔdze osū bɛba, na nkotoserɛ na medze bɛgye hom nkwa: Mebɛma wɔanantsew esutsen ho, wɔ ɔkwan tsenee mu a worimmfintsiw: Na meyɛ egya ma israel, na Ephraim nye m'abakan.

Amanaman, hom ntsie Ewuradze n'asɛm, na hom nkã nkyerɛ wɔ esupɔw a ɔwɔ ekirkrir no mu; na hom nse dɛ, nyia ɔbɔɔ Israel petsee no, ɔbɔboaboa n'ano, na wɔahwɛ no do, dɛ mbrɛ oguanhwɛfo hwɛ no nguankum do no.
Na Ewuradze asa Jacob ne tsir, na ɔapon no efi nyia ɔkyɛn no ahoɔdzen no nsamu.

Na wɔbɛba abɔtow ndwom wɔ Zion sorɔnsorɔmbea, na wɔapem akɔ Ewuradze ne yieyɛ ho, eburo, na saã, na ngo, na hɔn nguan na anantwimba ho: Na hɔn kra bɛyɛ dɛ ture a woegugu mu nsu na worinndzi awerɛhow bio koraa.
Nna akataasia enyi bɛgye asaw mu, na mberantsɛ na nkɔdaa nyinara abɔmu enyi agye: Na mebɛdan hɔn nkɔmbɔdzi ahosɛpɛw, na makyekye hɔn werɛ na mama woefi hɔn awerɛhow mu edzi ehurusi.
Na mebɛma angoanam amee meman asɔfo hɔn kra, na me yieyɛ ame man, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Wɔtse ndze bi nka wɔ Ramah, osukwadwom, na osū wenwen, Rachel rusū ne mba; na ɔmmpen dɛ wɔbɛkyekye no werɛ wɔ ne mba ntsi; osiandɛ wonnyi hɔ.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Sianka wo ndze wɔ osū ho, na w'enyiwa wɔ nyinsuwa ho: Na wobotua w'edwuma kaw, Ewuradze na ɔse: Na wobefi ɔtamfo no asaase do aba bio,
Na enyidado wɔ hɔ ma w'ewiei Ewuradze na ɔse na wo aba bɛsan aba hɔn ankasa hɔn ahe do bio.
Ɔtse ara na matse dɛ Ephraim ridzi nkɔmbɔ, dɛ, ɔwo atsēa me na wɔatsēa me dɛ ɔnantwiba a ɔnnweaa kɔndua ho: San me ekir, na mebɛsan ekyir na ɔwo nye Ewuradze Nyankopɔn.
Ampaara wɔsaan me ekyir no, munuu moho; na wonyae wɔkyerɛkyrɛɛ me no, mohwee me serɛ do ame: M'enyi tõe, nyew, m'enyim guu ase mpo, osiandɛ mosoaa me mbreantsɛber mu ahorohoraa.
Aso Ephraim yɛ me ɔdɔ ba? Aso ɔyɛ ɔba fɛɛfɛw? Na dodow ara a mekasa mitsia no no, dɛm ntsi mo nson mu burbur me wɔ no ho; mubobu no mbɔbɔr ampaara, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Sisi ɔkwanmu-nsewhyɛ ma woho, sisi ɔkwankyerɛ-edum ma woho: Fa w'akoma si tsempɔn no no do, ɔkwan a efaa mu no a: San bra, Israel ɔbaabun, san bra wo nkurow yi mu bio.
Ɔwo ekyirsannyi babaa, ibedzi akɔnaaba ekodu dabɛn ara? Na Ewuradze abɔ fofor wɔ asaase do, ɔbaa botwitwa ahye barimba.

Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, se nye yi: Wɔbɛda ho akã asɛm yi bio wɔ Judah asaase do na no nkurow mu, ber a medze hɔn ndɔmmum bɛsan aba no: Pɛrpɛr tsenabea, krɔnkrɔnye bepɔw, Ewuradze nhyira wo.
Na Judah na no nkurow nyinara bɔbɔ mu atsena mu; ekuafo na hɔn a wɔye mbowakuw kyinkyin.
Na mama ɔkra a ɔaberɛ amee, na ɔkra werɛhofo biara mahyɛ no mã bio.
Iyi do na minyanee, na mohwɛe; na me nda tɔɔ me dɛw mu.
Hwɛ, nda reba a, Ewuradze na ɔse, medze ɔdasanyi n'asefo, na abowa n'asefo mubodua Israel fi na Judah fi.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ m'enyi asã hɔn do dɛ mubotutu na mebubu, mebutuw na m'asasɛɛ, na mehiahia ho no; dɛmara na menyi bɔka dɛ mibesi na matsɛw, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Nda no mu no wɔnnkɛkã bio dɛ, egyanom atwer ebuntwirede yerɛyerɛw, na mba hɔn sē afemfem.
Na mbom obiara bowu wɔ nankasa n'emumyɛ ntsi: Nyimpa biara a obedzi ebuntwirede yerɛyerɛw no, ne sã bɛfem.
Hwɛ, nda reba a, Ewuradze na ɔse, menya Immer fi ma Judah fi bedzi ahyɛmu fofor:
Ɔnntse dɛ ahuɛmu a menya hɔn egyanom dzii wɔ da a musuoo hɔn nsamu no, miyii hɔn Egypt asaase do no; m'ahyɛmu a wɔtõe, naaso na emidze na ɔse.
Na iyi nye nye ahuyɛmu a menye hɔnkun no, Ewuradze na ɔse; medze me mbra bɛhyɛ hɔn mu, na hɔn akoma mu na mebɛkyerɛw mu; na emi mebɛyɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn na hɔn so wɔayɛ me man:
Na obiara nnkɛkyerɛ no nua bio dɛ, hu Ewuradze: Na hɔn ninara wobohu no, ofi hɔn mu aketseaba do kesi hɔn mu kɛse do, Ewuradze na ɔse: Na medze hɔn emumuyɛ mebɛkyɛ hɔn, na hɔn bɔn so merennkaa bio.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze a ɔma ewia hyerɛn adzekyee, na ɔhyehyɛ bosoom na nworaba ma wɔhyerɛn anago, onunu po mu ma n'asorɛkye hur a, ne dzin dze dɔm Ewuradze no, ɔse nye yi:
Sɛ ahyehyɛdze yinom fi m'enyim fir a Ewuradze na ɔse, ɔnodze na Israel asefo so begyaa ɔman yɛ wɔ m'enyim daa nyina.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Sɛ wotum susu ɔsor wimu, na wɔbɔr hwehwɛ asaase ne fapem wɔ n'ase noho a, ɔnodze na mo so mobɔtow Israel asefo akyen wɔ dza wɔayɛ nyina ntsi, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hwɛnda reba a, Ewuradze na ɔse, wɔbɛkyeker kurow no ama Ewuradze, efi Hananel abantsentsen ho ekodu nkyɛnmu ɔponkɛse no ho.
Na susuhoma no befi hɔ ara nam tsentsendo ekodu Gareb koko ho, na oedu adan ekesi Goah.

Na efun na nso bɔnsa no nyina, na mfuwa nyina a okodu ɔwora Kidron ho, dze kodu pɔnkɔ ɔponkɛse no nkyɛn no wɔboka afamu, wɔbɛyɛ krɔnkrɔn ama Ewuradze; worunntutu, eso worunndwuruw nngu famu dabiarada.
32: Asɛm a ofi Ewuradze nkyɛn baa Jeremiah hɔ wɔ Judahhen Zedekiah n'afe a otsīa du no a, ɔyɛ Nebuchadnezzar n'afe a otsīa duawɔtwe no mu no.
Aber no na nkyii Babylonhen no dɔm kotuaa Jerusalem; na wɔdze nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah too efiadze wɔ ɔweɔmfo bagua no a ɔwɔ Judahhen ne fie no mu.
Na Judahhen Zedekiah dze no too efiadze, dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ehyɛ nkɔm, na ekã dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ, medze kurow yi mebɛhyɛ Babylonhen nsa, ma ɔagye;
na Judahhen Zedekiah rimmfi Chaldeafo nsa, na oyi ara na wobeyi no ahyɛ Babylonhen nsa, na ɔnye no akasa ano na ano, na n'enyi ehu n'enyi;
na obegya Zedekiah akɔ Babylon, na hɔ na ɔbɛtsena ekodu dɛ mebɛsera no, Ewuradze na ɔse: Kaansa hom nye Chaldeafo kõ mpo a, hom runnwie yie.
Na Jeremiah see dɛ, Ewuradze n'asɛm baa hɔ, dɛ,
hwɛ, wo wɔfa Shallum ne ba Hanamel bɛba wo nkyɛn, dɛ, tɔ mo mfuwa a ɔwɔ Anathoth no; na ɔwo na no pon ho kwan dzi wɔ wo dɛ ebɔtɔ.

Nna mo wɔfa ba Hanamel baa me nkyɛn wɔaweɔmfo abangua no do, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm, tse no ɔsee me dɛ, meserɛ wo, tɔ mo mfuwa a ɔwɔ Anathoth a ɔwɔ Benjamin asaase do no na ɔwo na adze no ne dzi dzi wɔ wo. Nna muhun dɛ Ewuradze asɛm no nye no.
Na motɔɔ asaase a ɔwɔ Anathoth no wɔ mo wɔfa ba Hanamel hɔ, na mikeer dwɛɛtɛ no memaa no, mekyerɛ dwetɛ shekel duesuon.
Na mekyerɛɛw no wɔ nwoma mu na mosɔɔw ano, na mefrɛɛ adasefo, na mikeer dwɛɛtɛɛ no wɔ nsɛn mu memaa no.
Nna mefaa ɔtɔ nwoma no, dza wɔsɔɔw ano, dɛ mbrɛ mbra na atɔrmuadze se no, na dza m'anoda hɔ no nyina:

Na medze ɔtɔ nwoma no mehyɛɛ Mahseiah ba Neriah ne ba Baruch nsa, wɔ no wɔfa ba Hanamel n'enyim na adasefo a wɔdze hɔn nsa hyɛɛ ɔtɔ nwoma no asewɔ Judah a wɔtsetse ɔweɔmfo abanguado hɔ nyina no enyim.
Na mehyɛɛ baruch wɔ hɔn enyim, dɛ,
mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi, fa nwoma iyinom, ɔtɔ nwoma yi, dza wɔasɔw ano, na nwoma yi a n'ano da hɔ nyinara na fa hyɛ dɛtsesɛn bi mu; na ɔaakɛr nda pii.
Na mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi: Wɔbɛda ho atotɔ adan, na mfwa, na wenyin nture wɔ asaase yi do bio.
Afei medze ɔtɔ nwoma no memaa Neriah ba Baruch n'ekyir no miyii mpa maa Ewuradze, dɛ,
ao Ewuradze Nyankopɔn! Hwɛ, ɔwo na edze wo tum kɛse na wo basa a ttsen yɛɛ ɔsor na asaase; biribiara nnyɛ wo yɛ-na:
Ɔwo a ekyerɛ mbɔbɔrhu ma mpempem, na itua egyanom hɔn emumuyɛ kaw gu hɔn mba a wodzi hɔn ekyir hɔn bo mu: Ne dzin dze ɔkɛse, Onyankopɔn katakyi, dɔm Ewuradze:
Apam mu ɔkɛse, ndwuma mu ɔkatakyi: Ɔwo w'enyiwa bue wɔ adasamba akwan nyina do; dɛ edze bɛma obiara dɛ mbrɛ n'akwan tse:
Ɔwo emaa nsɛnkyerɛdze na anwanwadze sii Egypt asaase do, dze bodu ndɛ da yi mpo, wɔ Israel na amanaman nyina mu; na edze gyee dzin maa woho, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi;
na edze nsɛnkyerɛdze na anwanwadze, na nsa a ɔyɛ dzen, na basa atsen na ehuduze kɛse, yii wo man Israel fii Egypt asaase do;
na ema hɔn asaase yi a ekãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn no asaase a ɔpem numfonsu na ewo;
na wɔbae bɛfae dzii, na woenntsie wo ndze, eso wɔannantsew wo mbra do; wɔannyɛ dza ehyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnyɛ no nyinara mu biara: Dɛm ntsi na ama mbusu yi nyina aba hɔn do yi:
Hwɛ, mpempe no wɔaba kurow no hodɛwɔrebɛgye; na wɔdze kurow no ahyɛ Chaldeafo a wɔnye no rokõ nsa, na afõwa, na ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm no ntsi na dza ekãe no aba mu; na hwɛ w'enyi tua.
Na ɔwo, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, esee me dɛ, fa dwɛɛtɛɛ tɔ mfuwa no wɔdze ahyɛ: Chaldeafo nsa.
Nna Ewuradze m'asɛm baa Jeremiah hɔ, dɛ
hwɛ, emi nye Ewuradze, adasa nyinara Nyankopɔn: Aso biribiara wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ dzen ma me?
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Hwɛ, medze kurow yi bɛhyɛ Chaldeafo nsa, na Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar nsa, ma ɔagye:

Na Chaldeafo a wɔnye kurow yi rokõ no, wɔbɛba abɔto kurow yi mu ogya, na wɔahyew no, ɔnye efifi a wɔahyehyew n'etsifi nduhuam ama Baal, na woehue ɔnom-afɔr ama abosom afofor, dɛ wɔdze riyi me ebufuw no.
Na Israelmba na Judahmba wɔayɛ dza ɔyɛ mbusu ara wɔm'enyim ofir hɔn mbafobermu: Na Israelmba wɔdze hɔn nsaano edwuma eyi me ebufuw ara, Ewuradze ɔse.
Na kurow yi eyi me ebufuw na ebufuhyew ara ofi da a wɔkyekyeree dze bodu ndɛ da yi mpo; ma meeyi no efi m'enyi do:
Wɔ Israelmba na Judahmbahɔn mbusu nyinara a wɔabɔ dze eyi me ebufuw no ntsi hɔn hɔn ahemfo, hɔn mbapɔmba hɔn asɔfoe, na hɔn nkɔnhyɛfo, na Judah mbarimba, na Jerusalem atsefo
Na wɔadandan hɔn ekir ama me, na nnyɛ hɔn enyim a: Na kaansa makyerɛkyerɛ hɔn mpo a, woenntsie dɛ wɔbɛgye nkyerɛkyerɛ.
Na wɔdze hɔn ekyiwadze sisii ofi a wɔdze me dzin ato no no mu, dɛ wongu ho fī.
Na wosisii Baal no nsorɔnsorɔmbea wɔremma hɔn mbabanyin na hɔn mbabaa edua ogya mu ama Molech a nnyɛ emi na mehyɛɛ hɔn no mu, eso wɔammba m'adwen mu, dɛ wɔyɛ dɛm ekyiwadze yi; ma Judah aayɛ bɔn.
Na afei dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn, se wɔ kurow yi a hom hã wɔ ho dɛ, wɔdze ahyɛ Babylonhen ne nsa, wɔ afõwa, na ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm mu no ho nye yi:
Hwɛ, emi mara mobɔboa hɔn makɔ do wɔ m'enyiber kɛse mu no; na medze hɔn bɛsan aba bea yi do bio, na mama wɔatsena dwudwoodwo:
Na wɔbɛyɛ me man, na emi so mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn:
Na mebɛma hɔn akoma kor na ɔkwan kor, ama woeesuro me afebɔɔ; wɔ hɔnara na hɔn mba a wobedzi hɔn ekyir hɔn yie ntsi:
Na mirinngyaa hɔn ekyir dzi, dɛ mebɛyɛ hɔn yie; na medze me suro bɛhyɛ hɔn akoma mu, mma woeemmfi me nkyɛn annkɔ.
Ampaara, m'enyi bɛgye hɔn ho dɛ mebɛyɛ hɔn yie, na medze m'akoma nyina na me kra nyina matsɛw hɔn asaase yi do nokwar mu.
Na mbrɛ medze mbusu kɛse yi: Dɛ mbrɛ medze mbusu kɛse yi nyinara maba ɔman yi do no, dɛmara so na medze yie a mabɔ hɔn ho anohoba nyina mebɛba hɔm do.
Na wɔbɔtotɔ mfuwa wɔ asaase yi a hom kã wɔ ho dɛ, ɔyɛ amamfõ, nyimpa anaa abowa nnyi do: Wɔdze ahyɛ Chaldeafo nsa no mu.

Nkorɔfo wɔdze sika bɔtotɔ mfuwa, na wɔdze hɔn nsa ahyehyɛ nwoma ase na wɔasosɔw ano, na wɔafrɛfrɛ adasefo, wɔ Benjamin asaase do, na mbeambea a etwa Jerusalem ho ehyia na Judah nkurow mu, na kokodo nkurow mu, na ɔbɔn mu nkurow mu, na Pomu-afamu nkurow mu: Na medze hɔn ndɔmmum mebɛsan maba, Ewuradze na ɔse.
33: Bio so Ewuradze n'asɛm baa Jeremiah nkyɛn otsīa ebien no, ber a ɔda ho da efiadze wɔ ɔweɔmfo abangua mu hɔ no dɛ,
mbrɛ Ewuradze a ɔyɛ adze yi, Ewuradze a ɔhyehyɛ ma otsim hɔ no; ne dzin dze Ewuradze no, ɔse nye yi:
Frɛ me, na mebɛgye wo do, na makyerɛ wo ndzɛmba akɛse a ɔyɛ yɛ-na a ɔwo innyim.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn ɔse wɔ kurow yi mu adan, na Judah ahemfo adan a mpempe na afõwa ntsi woeduruw egu famu no ho nye yi:

Wɔreba wɔnye Chaldeafo abɔkõ, na mbom wɔdze nyimpa a mekuku hɔn wɔ m'ebufuw na m'ebufuhhyew mu na osian hɔn emumuyɛ nyinara ntsi ma medze m'enyim ehuntsa efi kurow yi ho no, hɔn efun abɛhyekyɛ no amaama.
Hwɛ, emi mara mebɛbrɛ no apɔwmudzen na edur, na masa hɔn yarba; na meyi asomdwee na nokwar pii makyerɛ hɔn,
na mebɛma Judah ndɔmmum na Israel asan aba, na medze hɔn mesi hɔ dɛ asɔpɔn no.
Na mebɛtsew hɔn ho efi hɔn emumuyɛ nyina a wɔdze ayɛ etsia me noho, na medze hɔn emumuyɛ nyinara a wɔdze ayɛ bɔn etsia me no na wɔdze afom me no mefir hɔn.

Na kurow yi bɛdan me ahosɛpɛw dzin, ayɛyi na enyimnyam wɔ asaase do amanaman nyina a wɔbɛtse yie a medze reyɛ hɔn no nyinara enyim, na woesuro na hɔn ho apopo wɔ yie nyina na asomdwee nyina mirinya mama hɔn no ntsi.
Bea yi a hom kã wɔ ho dɛ, ɔayɛ amamfõ nyimpa na abowa biara nnyi hɔ, Judah nkurow mu no, na wɔbɛda ho atse

ehurusi ndze na ahosɛpɛw ndze, na ayeforkun ndze, hɔn a wɔse dɛ, hom mfa ndaase mma dɔm Ewuradze dze, na n'ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa, na hɔn a wɔdze ndaase okum-afɔr ba Ewuradze fie no, hɔn ndze. Na mebɛma asaase no no ndɔmmumfo no wɔasan dɛ asɔpɔn no, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Bea yi a ɔabɔ a nyimpa na abowa biara nnyi, na no nkurow nyinara mu, ɔbɛyɛ tsenabea bio ama nguanhwɛfo a wɔbɛma hɔn nguan ebutubutuw hɔ.
Kokodo nkurow, bɔnsamu nkurow, na Pomu-afamu nkurow, na Judah nkurow mu, na nguankuw bodua nyia ɔkan hɔn no nsa ase etwa mu bio, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hwɛ, nda reba a, Ewuradze na ɔse, mebɛma asɛmpa no a mekãa no Israel fifo ho na Judah fifo ho no aba mu.
Nda no mu no, na aber no, nna mebɛma ɔtsenenee odubaa afefɛw ama Dayid; na ɔayɛ atsɛmbu na tsenenee wɔ asaase no do.
Nda no mu na Jerusalem atsena ase dwudwoowo: Na iyi nye dzin a wɔdze bɛfrɛ no, Ewuradze nye hɛn tsenenee.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Ɔbarimba a ɔrommbɔ Dayid;
eso ɔbarimba ɔbɔbɔ ɔhyewafɔr, na ɔahyew edziban-afɔr, na ɔabɔ okum-afɔr daapem wɔ m'enyim no, ɔrommbɔ asɔfo Leyifono.
Na Ewuradze n'asɛm baa Jeremiah hɔ, dɛ,
mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Sɛ hom botum atõ m'adzekyee ahyɛmu na m'adzesaa ahyɛmu bio wɔ n'aber mu a;
ɔnodze na wɔbɔtõ menye m'akowaa Dayid ntamu ahyɛmu no, ma onnkenya ɔbabanyin a ɔbɛtsena ne akɔngua do edzi hen; na ɔnye Leyifo asɔfo a wɔsom me no.
Dɛ mbrɛ wonntum nnkan ɔsor dɔm, eso wonnsusu mpoano anhwea no; dɛmara na mebɛma m'akowaa Dayid asefo na Leyifo a wɔsom me no wɔadɔr.
Na Ewuradze n'sɛm baa Jeremiah hɔ, dɛ,
ana enndwen dza ɔman yi akaã no ho, dɛ, mbusu ebien a Ewuradze saan mu yii hɔn no, wɔatow hɔn akyen? Mbrɛ wobu me man enyimtsia nye yi, dɛ wɔnnyɛ hɔn enyi do dɛ ɔman bio.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Sɛ m'adzekyee na adzesaa ahyɛmu bo enngyina a, sɛ mannhyɛ: Ɔsor na asaase ahyɛdze no a:
Ɔnodze na mo so mobɔtow Jacob, na, makowaa Dayid asefo akyen, dɛ mennkɛfa n'asefo mu bi ma woeedzi Abraham, Isaac, na Jacob asefo do mpanyin: Na mebɛma hɔn ndɔmmumfo asan, na mehu hɔn mbɔbɔr.
34: Asɛm a ofi Ewuradze nkyɛn baa Jeremiah hɔ, aber a Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar, na no dɔm nyina, na asaase do ahendzi a wɔwɔ no tumdzi ase nyina, na aman nyina, bɛnye Jerusalem, na no nkurow nyinara kõe dɛ:
Mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi kɔ kɛkasa kyerɛ Judahhen Zedekiah, na se no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ, medze kurow yi bɛhyɛ Babylonhen nsa, na ɔdze ogya ahyew no:
Na ɔwoara so irimmfi ne nsa, na ɔkyer ara na wɔbɛkyer wo nsa, na woeyi wo ahyɛ ne nsa; na w'enyiwa bohu Babylonhen enyi, na ɔnye wo akasa ano, na akɔ Babylon.
Naaso Judahhen Zedekiah, tsie Ewuradze n'asɛm: Mbrɛ Ewuradze kã wɔ wo ho nye yi, Innko wu afõwa ano:
Ibowu asomdwee mu; na mbrɛ: Wɔhyehyeew adze maa w'egyanom, ahemfo nkankan no a wodzii w'enyim no: Nawobegyam wo, dɛ Ao ewural na emi na makã asɛm no, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah kãa nsɛm yinom wɔ Jerusalem,
ber a Babylonhen no dɔm wɔnye Jerusalem, na Judah nkurow a ka no, Lachish na Azekah, ridzi akõ no: Na iyinom nye nkurow a wɔagye ho ban a wɔkae wɔ Judah nkurow no mu.
Asɛm a ofi Ewuradze nkyɛn baa Jeremiah hɔ, aber a wɔwɔ Jerusalem nyinara dzii ahyɛmu no dɛ wɔmbɔ fahodzi dawur mma hɔn no ekyir no;
dɛ nyimpabiara mma n'akowaa na nyimpa biaraa mma n'afonabaa a ɔyɛ Hebrewnyi banyin anaa Hebrwnyi basia mmfa noho ndzi; dɛ mma biara nndzi hɔn nya, mekyerɛ, no nua Hebrewnyi no a:
Na asafohen no nyinara na ɔman no nyinara a wodzii ahyɛmu no tsiei, dɛ biara mma n'akowaa, na biara mma n'afonabaa mfa noho ndzi, na mma biara nndzi hɔn nya bio; wotsiei na wɔmaa wɔfaa hɔnho dzii;
na n'ekyir no wotwaa hɔnho, na wɔmaa nkowaa na mfonabaa awɔama wɔafa hɔnho edzi no, sanee bae bɛyɛɛ nkowaa na mfonabaa bio:
Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze n'asɛm fi Ewuradze nkyɛn baa Jeremiah bɔ, dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi:
Menye hom egyanom dzii ahyɛmu wɔ da a medze hɔn mifii Egypt asaase do, fii nkowaasom fo no mu no, dɛ,

mfe esuon ewiei no, hom mu nyimpa biara mma no nua a ɔyɛ Hebrewnyi a wɔatɔn no ama wo no, na ɔasom wo mfe esia no, ɔnkɔ nkɛfa noho ndzi mfi wo nkyɛn: Na hom egyanom enntsie me, eso wɔammbrɛ hɔn aso adze.
Na homdze ndaenu yi hom sanee, na hom yɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ m'enyi do, dɛ hom mu nyimpa biara bɔɔ fahodzi dawur maa ne nyɛnko; na hom enya edzi ahyɛmu wɔ m'enyim wɔfi a wɔdze me dzin ato no no mu:
Na hom sanee boguu me dzin ho fī, na hom maa nyimpa biara n'akowaa, na nyimpa biara n'fonabaa a hom maa wɔfa hɔnho dzii dɛ mbrɛ wɔpɛ no, sanee bae; na hom dzii hɔn nya dɛ nkowaa na mfonabaa.

Dɛm nsti mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Hom wur nyimpa biara dze ama no nua, na nyimpa biara dze ama ne nyɛnko: Hwɛ, mo so morobɔ fahodzi dawur, Ewuradze na ɔse, medze hom mama afõwa, ɔyardom, na ɔkɔm; na mebɛma wɔatow hom edzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do ahendzi horow nyina mu.
Na medze mbarimba a wɔatõ m'ahyɛmu, wɔannyɛ ahyɛmu a wodzii no m'enyim no mu nsɛm no, ber a wɔpaa ɔnantwiba mu ebien no, ha woduaa n'afãaafa ntamu no;
Judah asafohen, na Jerusalem asafohen, epiafo no na sɔfo no, na asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyinaara a woduaa ɔnantwiba na afãaafa ntamu no;
ɔhyɛ ara na medze hɔn mebɛhyɛ hɔn atamfo nsa, na hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ hɔn nkwa no nsa: Na hɔn efun bɛyɛ edziban ama sor nnoma, na asaase mbowa.
Na Judahhen Zedekiah na n'asafohen no so medze hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ hɔn atamfo nsan na hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ hɔn nkwa nsa na Babylonhen no dɔm a woefi hom enyim kɔ no nsa.
Hwɛ, mebɛhyɛ, Ewuradze na ɔse na mama wɔasan aba kurow yi ho; na wɔnye no bɔkõ, na mebɛyɛ Judah nkurow amamfõ a ɔtsefo nnyi mu.
35: Asɛm a ofi Ewuradze nkyɛn baa Jeremiah hɔ wɔ Judahhen Josiah ne ba Jehoiakim ne nda no mu dɛ,
kɔ Rechabfo fie, na kɛkasa kyerɛ hɔn, na fa hɔn bra Ewuradze fie mpia no kor mu, na ma hɔn nsã ma wɔnnom.
Nna mefaa Habazziniah ba Jerimiah ne ba Jaazaniah, na no nuanom, na ne mbabanyin nyinara, na Rechabfo fie nyinara;
na medze hɔn mebaa Ewuradze fie, wɔ Nyame nyimpa Igdaliah ba Hanan ne mbabanyin hɔn pia no a ɔwɔ abowanohwɛfo Shalum ba Maaseiah ne pia etsifi no mu:
Na medze kuraba a nsã ahyehyɛ no amaama, na nkɔɔpow sisii hɔn enyim, na mesee hɔn dɛ, hom nnom nsã ɛ.
Na wɔkãa dɛ, hom nnom nsã biara: Na hɛn egya Rechab neba Jonadab hyɛɛ hɛn, dɛ hom o, hom mbambayin o mma hom nnom nsã dabiarada:
Eso mma hom nnsi dan, na wonndua aba, anaa wɔnnya bi: Na mbom hom ntsena asese mu hom nda nyina; ama hom aatsena ase nda pii wɔ asaase a hom yɛ do amamforafo no mu.
Na yɛayɛ setsie ama hɛn egya Rechab ne ba Jonadab wɔ dza ɔdze hyɛɛ hɛn nyinara ho dɛ mma yanom nsa hɛn nda nyinara, na hɛn yernom, hɛn mbabanyi, na hɛn mbabaa;
anaaso yennsisi adan yɛnntsena mu: Eso yennyi weyin ture, na mfuwa, na aba:
Mbom yɛatsenatsena asese mu, na yɛayɛ setsie, na yɛayɛ dɛ mbrɛ hɛn egya Jonadab hyɛɛ hɛn no nyinara.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, ber a Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar tui baa asaase yi do no, nna yɛsee dɛ, hom mbra ma yɛnkɔ Jerusalem wɔ Chaldeafo dɔm hom hu ntsi; nna yɛtse Jerusalem yi.
Nna Ewuradze n'asɛm baa Jeremiah hɔ, dɛ,
mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi: Kɔ, na kɛse Judah mbarimba na Jerusalem atsefo dɛ, aso hom betsie mensɛm bi a? Ewuradze na ɔse.

Nsɛma Rechab ba Jonadab dze hyɛɛ ne mbanyin dɛ mma wɔnnom nsã no, woedzi do na ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi wɔnnoom bi, osiandɛ wodzi hɔn egya ne mbrasɛm do: Na emidze, makasa makyerɛ hom, mosoɛr ahema na mekasa; na hom enntsie me.

Masoma mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara aba hom nkyɛn, eso mosoɛr ahema na mosoma hɔn, dɛ, afie hom mu nyimpa biara nsan mfi no kwan bɔn no do, na ɔyɛ ne nyɛe yie, na mma onnkedzi abosom afofor bi ekyir nnkɔsom hɔn, na hom atsena asaase a medze mama hom na hom egyanom no do na mbom hom enntsie me.
Susuampaara dɛ Rechab na Jonadab ne mba woedzi mbrasɛm a hɔn egya dze hyɛɛ hɔn no do no, na ɔman yi dze, woenntsie me yi;

dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze, dɔm Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyamkopɔn, ɔse nye yi: Hwɛ, medze mbusu nyina a makã etsia Judah na Jerusalem atsefo nyinara no mebɛba hɔn do: Osiandɛ makasa akyerɛ hɔn, na woenntsie; mafrɛ hɔn so, na wɔanngye do.
Na Jeremiah see Rechabfo fi no dɛ, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, senye yi: Osiandɛ hom etsie hom egya Jonadab ne mbrasɛm, na hom ayɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔhyɛɛ hom nhinara ntsi;
dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi: Ɔbarimaba a ogyina m'enyim nnkɔbɔ Rechab ba Jonadab ara da.
36: Na ɔbaa dɛ Josiah ba Jeroiakim, Judahhen no, n'afe a otsīa anan no mu no nna asɛm yi fi Ewuradze nkyɛn baa Jeremiah hɔ, dɛ,
fa nwom mbobɔwee, na kyerɛw nsɛm nyina a makã akyerɛ wo etsia Israel, na Judah na amanaman nyina wɔ mu, ofi da a mekasaa kyerɛɛ wo fi Josiah ber do dze besi ndɛ da yi mpo.
Bi a Judah fi bɛtse mbusu nyina a mesua me tsir mu dɛ medze bɛye hɔn ama hɔn mu nyimpa ɔaasan efi no kwan bɔn do ama medze hɔn emumye na hɔn bɔn aakyɛ hɔn.
Nna Jeremiah frɛɛ Neriah ba Baruch kyerɛɛ Ewuradze nsɛm a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ Jeremiah nyina fir n'anomu hyɛɛ nwoma mbobɔwee no mu.
Na Jeremiah hyɛɛ Baruch, dɛ wɔatow me mu; murunntum nnkɔ Ewuradze fie:
Dɛm ntsi ɔwora kɔ, na kɛkenkan Ewuradze nsɛm a ekyerɛwee no wɔ Ewuradze fie, wɔ mbuadadzi da no mu: Na kenkan no wɔ Judahfo nyina wɔ fi hɔn nkurow deba roso asomu.
Bi a wɔdze hɔn nkotoserɛ bogu Ewuradze enyim, na hɔn mu biara bɛsan efi no kwan bɔn no do: Na ebufuw na ebufuhyew a Ewuradze akã egu ɔman yi do no ɔsõ.
Na Neriah ba Baruch yɛɛ dɛ dza nkɔnhyɛyi Jeremiah hyɛɛ no do nyina, na ɔkenkan Ewuradze nsɛm no a ɔwɔ nwoma no mu no wɔ Ewuradze fie.

Afie ɔbaa dɛ Joshua, ba Jehoiakim, Judahhen no n'afe a otsīa enum no wɔ bosoom a otsīa akron no, nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ Jerusalem nyina, na nkorɔfo a wofi Judah mu baa Jerusalem nyina, wɔbɔɔ mbuadadzi ho dawur wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Nna Baruch kenkaan Jeremiah ne nsɛm a ɔwɔ nwoma no mu wɔ Ewuradze fie, wɔ ɔkyerɛwfo Shaphan ne ba Gemariah ne pia a ɔwɔ etsifi abanguaa no mu wɔ Ewuradze fie ɔponkɛse no ano, wɔ ɔman no nyina asomu.
Na Shaphan ba Gemariah ne ba Miciah tsee Ewuradze nsɛm a ɔwɔ nwoma no mu no nyina no,

osianee kɔr Ɔhen ne fie, ɔkɔr ɔkyerɛwfo no pia no mu: Na hwɛ, asafohen no nyina tsetse hɔ, mekyerɛ ɔkyerɛwfo Elishama, na Shemaiah ba Delaiah, na Achor ba Elnathan, na Shaphan ba Gemariah, na Hananiah ba Zedekiah, na asofohen no nyinara.
Nna Micaiah kãa nsɛm a ɔtsee no ber a Baruch Kenkaan nwoma no wɔ ɔman no asomu nyina kyerɛɛ hɔn.

Dɛm ntsi asafohen no somaa Cushi ba Shelemiah ne Nethanaih ne ba Jehudi wɔ Baruch hɔ, dɛ, fa nwoma mbobɔwee no a akenkan mu nsɛm wɔ ɔman no asomu no kitsaa wo ne nsamu bra. Nna Neriah ba Baruch faa nwoma mbobɔwee no kitsaa ne nsamu na ɔbaa hɔn nkyɛn.
Na wɔsee no dɛ tsena ase ɛ, na kenkan no hɛnasomu. Nna Baruch kenkaan no hɔn asomu.
Afei ɔbaa dɛ, wonyae tsee nsɛm no nyinara no dɛ wɔdze akomatu danee hwehwɛɛ hɔnho, na wɔsee Baruch dɛ, ɔkã ara na yɛbɛkã nsɛm yi nyina akyerɛ ɔhen.
Na wobisaa Baruch dɛ, afeikã kyerɛ hɛn, isii dɛn kyerɛɛw nsɛm yi nyina fii n'anomu?
Nna Baruch buaa hɔn dɛ, ɔdze n'ano kãa nsɛm yi nyinara kyerɛɛ me, na mo so medze dubir mekyerɛɛw no nwoma mu.
Nna asafohen no see Baruch dɛ, kɔ, kɔsoma, ɔwo na Jeremiah; mma obiara nnhu mbrɛ hom wɔ.
Na wɔkɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ abangua no do; nna nwoma mbobɔwee no dze, wɔdze esie ɔkyerɛwfo Elishama ne pia no mu; na wɔkãa nsɛm no nyina wɔ ɔhen no asomu.
Nna Ɔhen somaa Jehudi dɛ ɔnkɛfa nwoma mbobɔwee no mbra: Na okeyii no ɔkyerɛwfo Elishama ne pia no mu. Na Jehudi kenkaan no Ɔhen no asomu, na asafohen a wogyinagyina Ɔhen no nkyɛn nyinara asomu.
Nna Ɔhen tse awɔwber dan no mu, wɔbosoom a otsīa akron no mu: Na mbukyia mu ogya a ɔredzɛw taa n'enyim.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jehudi wiee nkrataa ebiasa anaa anan kenkan no, Ɔhen no dze sekamba twitwae na ɔdze guu gya a ɔwɔ mbukyia mu no mu kesii dɛ nwoma mbobɔwee no nyina hyewee wɔ ogya a ɔwɔ mbukyia mu no.
Na woennsuro, eso woennsunsuan hɔn ntarmu, Ɔhen no, na no nkowaa biara.
nkyii so na Elnathan na Delaiah na Gemariah atotɔ aserɛ Ɔhen no dɛ nkyɛ mma ɔnnhyew nwoma mbobɔwee no: Na oenntsi hɔn.
Na Ɔhen no hyɛɛ Ɔhenba Jerahmeel, na Azriel ba Seraiah, na Abdeel ba Shelemiah, dɛ wɔnkɛkyer ɔkyerɛwfo Baruch na nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah: Na Ewuradze dze hɔn sumae.
Nna Ɔhen hyeew nwoma mbobɔwee no na nsɛm a Baruch kyerɛwee fii Jeremiah anomu no ekyir no, Ewuradze n'asɛm baa Jeremiah hɔ, dɛ,
fa nwoma mbobɔwee fofor so bio, na kyerɛw nkan nsɛm a ɔwɔ nwoma mbobɔwee a odzi kan no a Judahhen Jehoiakim ahyew no no, wɔ mu.

Na kã wɔ Judahhen Jehoiakim ho dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze senye yi: Ɔwo ahyew nwoma mbobɔwee yi, dɛ ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na akyerɛw no wɔ mu dɛ, Babylonhen bɛba abɛsɛɛ asaase yi ampaara, na ɔama nyimpa na abowa abɔ adze wɔdo?
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze kã wɔ Judahhen Jehoiakim ho nye yi: Onnkenya obi a ɔbɛtsena Dayid akɔngua do: Na no fun so wɔbɔtow akyen ma ɔhyew afa do ewia, na awɔw afa do anago.
Na mebɛtsēa ɔno na n'asefo na no nkowaa wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi, na medze mbusu nyina a makã etsia hɔn no, na woenntsie no, bɛba hɔn na Jerusalem atsefo, na Judah mbarimba do.

Nna Jeremiah faa nwoma mbobɔweefofor so, na ɔdze maa ɔkyerɛwfo Baruch, Neriah ba no; ɔno na ɔkyerɛwfo Baruch, Neriah ba no; ɔno na ɔkyerɛɛw nwoma a Judahhen Jehoiakim hyeew no wɔ gya mu no no mu nsɛm nyina fii Jeremiah anomu hyɛɛmu: Na wɔdze nsɛm a ɔtsetse dɛm pii kekãa ho.
37: Na Josiah ba Zedekiah dzii hen wɔ Jehiakim ba Coniah a Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar hyɛɛ no hen wɔ Judah asaase no do no ananmu.
Na ɔno o, no nkowaa o, asaase no do nkorɔfo o, woenntsie Ewuradze ne nsɛm a ɔnam nkɔnhyɛnyi Jerimiah do kãe no.
Na Ɔhen Zedekiah somaa Shelemiah ba Jehucal, na ɔsɔfo Maasieah ba Zephaniah wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah nkyɛn, dɛ afei yi mpaa ma Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn ma hɛn.
Afei Jeremiah dzii ɔman no mu ndɔfir: Osiandɛ naa wonnyae mmfaano nntoo efiadze.
Na Pharaoh no a Chaldeafo a wobotuaa Jerusalem no tsee hɔn nsɛm no, wotui fii Jerusalem.
Nna Ewuradze nsɛm baa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah hɔ, dɛ,
mbrɛ Ewuardze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi: Mbrɛ hom nkɛse dɛ hom mbebisa mo hɔ adze no, nye yi. Hwɛ, Pharaoh no dɔm a woefir edzi robɔboa hom no, wɔbɛsan akɔ Egypt hɔnankasa hɔn asaase do
Na Chaldeafo no bɛba bio, na wɔnye kurow yi abɔkõ, na wɔbɛgye na wɔdze gya ahyew no.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Mma hom nndaada homho, dɛ, ɔkɔara na Chaldeafo befi hɛn nkyɛn akɔ: Na wɔronnkɔ.
Na kaansa hom kuku Chaldeafo dɔm a wɔnye hom rokõ nyina, na ɔka hɔn mu epirafo nko mpo a, nkyɛ hɔn mu nyimpa biara bɔsoɛr efi n'asesee mu, na wɔdze gya ahyew kurow yi.
Ɔbaa dɛ Chaldeafo dɔm tui fii Jerusalem wɔ Pharaoh no dɔm ho hu ntsi no,
nna Jeremiah fii Jerusalem dɛ ɔrokɔ Bemjamin asaase do akɛgye ne kyɛfa wɔ hɔ ɔman no ne finimfin.
Na odur Benjamin ɔponkɛse no mu na aweɔmfo panyin bi wɔ hɔ a ne dzin dze Irijah, Hananiah ba Shelemiah ne ba a; na osuoo nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah mu, see dɛ, ɔwo awaa rokɔ Chaldeafo nkyɛn.
Nna Jeremiah see dɛ, eboa; mennyɛ nyia ɔawaa rokɔ Chaldeafo nkɛn; na oenntsie no: Nna Irijah suoo Jeremiah mu, na ɔdze no brɛɛ asafohen no.
Na asafohen no bo fuuw Jeremiah na wɔhwee no na wɔdzen kɔtoo efiadze wɔ kyerɔwfo Jonathan fie na hɔ na wɔdze no kɔtoo efiadze wɔdze ayɛ efiadze.
Na Jeremiah kɔr mona efiadze no mu, na etu no mu, na Jeremiah dzii hɔ nda pii no,

nna Ɔhen Zedekiah somae ma wɔkɛfaa no bae: Na Ɔhen no bisaa no wɔ ne fie nsumaa mu, dɛ, ana asɛm bi a ofi Ewuradze nkyɛn wɔ hɔ? Na Jeremiah see dɛ, bi wɔ hɔ. Ɔkãe so dɛ, wobeyi wo ahyɛ Babylonhen ne nsa.
Bio so Jeremiah see Ɔhen Zedekiah dɛ, ebɛnadze mu na mayɛ bɔn metsia ɔwo, anaa wo nkowaa, anaa wo man, ma hom dze me ato efiadze yi?
Hom nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛɛ hom nkɔm dɛ, Babylonhen remmba hom do, anaa asaase yi do no, wɔwɔ henfa?
Na afei, mo wura Ɔhen, meserɛ wo, tsie ɛ: Meserɛ wo ma mo nkotoserɛ nsɔ w'enyi; na mma wɔmmfa me nnsan ɔkyerɛwfo Jonathan fie, ɔno bɛyɛ na mewu wɔ hɔ.

Nna Ɔhen Zedekiah hyɛe ma wɔdze Jeremiah kesiee aweɔmfo abangua no mu, ma daa wofi boodootofo brɔn no mu ma no boodoo ntɔwmu kor, dze kodur dɛ kurow no mu boodoo nyina sãe. Mbrɛ Jeremiah tsenaa aweɔmfo abangua no mu nye no.
38: Na Mattan ba Shephatiah, na Pashhur ba Gedaliah, na Shelemiah ba Jucal, na Malchijah ba Pashhur tsee nsɛm a Jeremiah kãa kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyina, dɛ
mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, nyia ɔbɛtsena kurow yi mu no, obowu afõwa, ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm ano: Na nyia obefir edzi akɔ Chaldeafo nkyɛn no dze, ɔbɛtsena ase, na no nkwa bɛyɛ no dɛ afonam, na ɔbɛtsena ase.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, wɔdze kurow yi bɛhyɛ Babylonhen no dɔm nsa ara ampa, na wɔagye.

Nna asafohen no see Ɔhen no dɛ, yɛserɛ wo, ma wonku ɔbarimba Yi: Susampaara dɛ ɔgow akõfo a wɔaka wɔ kurow yi mu nsa, na ɔman no nyinara nsa, wɔ dɛ ɔka dɛm nsɛm yi kyerɛ hɛn ntsi na ɔbarima yi ɔnnhwehɛ ɔman yi ne yie, na mbom no mbusua.
Na Ɔhen Zedekiah see dɛ, hwɛ, ɔwɔ hom nsamu: Na nnyɛ Ɔhen nye nyia obotum ayɛ biribi etsia hom.

Nna wɔfaa Jeremiah, na wɔkotowoow no no kyeen Ɔhenba Malchijah mona efiadze a ɔwɔ aweɔmfo abanguado no mu: Na wɔdze ntampeehoma hyaagyaa Jeremiah siaan mu. Na mona efiadze no hɔ nnyi nsu, dɛ adɛtsebir nko: Na Jeremiah homee kɔr adɛtsebir no mu.
Afei ber a Ethiopianyi Ebedmelech, opianyi a ɔwɔ ahemfie no, tsee dɛ wɔdze Jeremiah akɔto mona afiadze no, nna Ɔhen no so tse Benjamin ɔponkɛse mu no,
Ebedmelech fir edzi fii ahemfie, kɛkasaa kyreɛɛ Ɔhen no, dɛ,
mo wura Ɔhen, mbarimba yi wɔabɔ mbusu wɔ dza wɔdze nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah a wɔakɔtow no akyen mona efiadze no mu nyinara; na ɔkɔm ntsi ɔreyɛ oewu wɔ mbrɛ ɔwɔ no: Osiandɛ edziban bi nnyi kurow no mu bio.
Nna Ɔhen no hyɛɛ Ethiopianyi Ebedmelech, dɛ, fa mbarimba eduasa fi ha kã wo ho, na keyi nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah fi mona efiadze no mu, ansaana oewu.

Nna Ebedmelech faa mbarimba no kãa no ho, na ɔkɔr ahemfie adzekoradan no ase, na ɔkɛfaa ntangow dadaw a atsetsew na esusuw, na ɔdze ntampeehoma kyekyeree gyaagyaa mu siaan mona efiadze no mu maa Jeremiah.
Na Ethiopianyi Ebedmelech see Jeremiah dɛ, fa ntagow dadaw a atsetsew na wɔ ntampeehoma no ase. Na Jeremiah yɛɛ dɛm.
Nna wɔdze ntampeehoma no twee Jeremiah baa sor, na woyii no fii mona efiadze no mu na Jeremiah tsenaa aweɔmfo abangua no mu.
Na Ɔhen Zedekiah somae ma wɔkɛfaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah baa ne nkyɛn wɔ Ewuradze fie abow a otsīa ebiasa no ano: Na Ɔhen no see Jeremiah dɛ, Miribebisa wo asɛm bi; na mma nnsiw me biribiara do.
Nna Jeremiah see Zedekiah dɛ, aso mepaa mu kã kyerɛ wo a, ana nnyɛ oku ara na woboku me bi? Na sɛ mema wo apam a, irinntsie me.
Nna Zedekiah kãa ntam nsumaa mu kyerɛɛ Jeremiah, dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze a ɔyɛɛ hɛn kra yi tse yi, murunnku wo, eso meremmfa wo nhyɛ mbarimba yi wɔrohwehwɛ wo nkwa yi nsamu.

Nna Jeremiah see Zedekiah dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze dɔm Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi: Sɛ ibefir edzi akɔ Babylonhen n'asafohen no nkyɛn a, nkyɛ ɔnodze wo kra bɛtsena ase, na kurow yi so, wɔnnkɛfa gya ahyew no; na ɔwo na wo fifo bɛtsena ase:
Na sɛ irimmfi edzi nnkɔ Babylonhen n'asafohen no nkyɛn a, ɔnodze wɔdze kurow yi bɛhyɛ Chaldeafo nsa na wɔddze gya ahyew no, na ɔwoara so irimmfi hɔn nsa efi.
Na Ɔhen Zedekiah see Jeremiah dɛ musuro Judah a wɔawaa wɔkɔ Chaldeafo no nkyɛn no, bi a wobeyi me ahyɛ hɔn nsa, na woesi me atwe twe.
Na Jeremiah see dɛ, wonnkeyi wo ama. Meserɛ wo ara, tsie Ewuradze ne ndze wɔ dza merekã kyerɛ wo yi mu: Dɛm na obesi wo yie, na wo kra atsena ase.
Na sɛ epow dɛ ibefir edzi akɔ a, asɛm a Ewuradze dze akyerɛ me nye yi:

Hwɛ mbaa a wɔaka wɔ Judahhen ne fie nyina wɔdze hɔn befir edzi akɔ Babylonhen n'asafohen no nkyen na mbaa no bɛse dɛ w'anyɛnko brɛbo na wɔadaadaa wo, na woedzi wo do nyim: Afei a w'ananatɔ adɛtsebir mu yi, wɔasan ekir.
Na wɔdze wo yernom na wo mba nyinara befir edzi akɔ Chaldeafo nkyɛn: Na ɔwoara nnkefi hɔn nsa efi, na mbom Babylonhen ne nsa bɛkã wo: Na ɔwoara na ebɛma wɔdze gya ahyew kurow yi.
Nna Zedekiah see Jeremiah dɛ, mma nyimpa biara nntse asɛm yi, na innkowu.

Na iyi sɛ sasfohen no tse dɛ menye wo akasa a, na wɔba wo nkyɛn, na wɔbɛse wo dɛ, Afei kã dza akã akyerɛ Ɔhen no kyerɛ hɛn; mma nnsiw hɛn biribiara do, na ywrunnku wo: Eso dza Ɔhen kãa kyreɛɛ wo no, a:
Ɔnodze se hɔn dɛ, mo nkotoserɛ na medze koguu Ɔhen no enyim dɛ mma ɔmma me nnsan nnkɔ Jonathan fie munnkowu wɔ hɔ.
Nna asafohen no nyinara baa Jeremiah nkyɛn bebisaa no: Na ɔkãa nsɛm yi a Ɔhen no hyɛɛ no no nhyinara kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛmara. Nna wogyaa dɛ wɔnye no kasa; osiandɛ woennhu asɛm no.
Nna Jeremiah tsenaa aweɔmfo abangua no mu ara adze kodur dɛ wɔgyee Jerusalem.
39: Na ɔbaa dɛ wɔgyee Jerusalem (wɔ Judahhen Zedekiah afe a otsīa akron no mu, bosoom du no mu no, Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar na no dɔm nyinara wɔbaa Jerusalem, na wobotūaa no;
Zedekiah afe a otsīa dubiako no, bosoom a otsīa anan no, na bosoom no mu da a otsīa akron no mu, na wotofiir kurow no mu:

Ma Babylonhen n'asafohen no nyinara bɛhɛɛn kurow no mu, na wɔtsenatsenaa finimfin abow kɛse no mu, mekyerɛ Nergal-sharezer, Samgar-nebo, Sarsechim, Rab-saris, Nergal-sharezer, Rab-mag, wɔnye Babylonhen n'asafohen nkaa no nyinara.

Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Judahhen Zedekiah, na mbarimba akofo no nyinara wohun hɔn no, nna woguanguanee, na wofii kurow no mu fiir anago, duaa Ɔhen no ture mu kwan do, dze faa abow kɛse mu wɔ afasu ebien ntamu: Na ɔdze faa Arabah kwan do kɔree.
Na Chaldeafo hɔn dɔn no tsiiw hɔn, na wɔkɔtoo Zedekiah wɔ Jericho tɛtɛr mu: Na wɔkyeer no no, wɔdze no baa Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar nkyɛn wɔ Riblah wɔ Hamath asaase do, na obuaa no atsɛn.
Nna Babylonhen kunkum Zedekiah ne mba wɔ Riblah wɔ n'enyim: Eso Babylonhen kunkum Judah ekunyin no nyinara.
Afei so otutuu Zedekiah n'enyiwa, na ɔtoo no mpokyerɛ dɛ wɔmfa no nkɔ Babylon.
Na Chaldeafo dze gya hyeew ahemfi no, na ɔmanfo no efiefi no, guu famu.
Nna aweɔmfo safohen Nebuchadnezzar faa ɔman no nkaa a wɔkaa kurow no mu no; na awaafo a wɔwaae kɔr ne nkɛn no so, na ɔman no nka a wɔkae no nyinara ndɔmmum kɔr Babylon.
Na aweɔmfo safohen Nebuchadnezzar gyaa ɔman no mu ehiafo a wonnyi hwee no wɔ Judah asaase do, na ɔdze wenyin nture na mfuwa memaa hɔn da no ara.
Afei Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar hyɛɛ aweɔmfo safohen Nebuchadnezzer wɔ Jeremiah ho dɛ,
fa no, na hwɛ no yie, na mma nnyɛ no bɔn biara; na dza ɔbɛse wo nyina yɛ ma no.
Nna aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan, na Nebushazban, Rab-saris, na Nergal-sharezer, Rab-mag, na Babylonhen n'asafohen etsitir ma nyinara wɔsomae;
wɔsomae ma wɔkɛfaa Jeremiah fii wɔdze no hyɛɛ Shaphan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedaliah nsa, dɛ ɔmfa no nkɔ fie: Nna ɔkɛtsenaa ɔman no mu.
Afei Jeremiah da ho da efiadze wɔ aweɔmfo abangua no no mu no, nna Ewuradze n'asɛm baa no hɔ dɛ,
kɔ, na kɛse Ethiopianyi Ebedmelech, dɛ, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no ase nye yi: Hwɛ, mebɛma me nsɛm aba mu wɔ kurow yi do ayɛ mbusu, na nnyɛ papa bi a; na ɔbɛba mu wɔ w'enyim da no.
Na da no mebɛgye wo, Ewuradze na ɔse: Na wɔremmfa wo nnhyɛ mbarimba a isuro hɔn no nsa.
Na mkwa na mebɛgye wo, na eronntɔ afõwa ano, na wo nkwa bɛyɛ afonam ama wo: Osiandɛ ɔwɔ edze wo werɛ atwer me, Ewuradze na ɔse.
40: Asɛm a ofi Ewuradze nkyɛn baa Jeremiah hɔ, aber a weɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan gyaa no wɔ Rama n'ekir no, ber a ɔfaa no dɛ ɔda nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu wɔ Jerusalem na Judah ndɔmmumfo a wɔdze hɔn rokɔ Babylon ndɔmmum no mu no.
Na aweɔmfo safohen no faa Jeremiah, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn na ɔkãa mbusu yi baa bea yi do:
Na Ewuradze na ɔama aba mu na ɔayɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔkãe no: Osiandɛ hom ayɛ bɔn etsia Ewuradze, na hom enntsie ne ndze, dɛm ntsi na adze yi aba hom do yi.

Na afei, hwɛ, masan wo ndɛ da yi mefi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsn a ɔda wo nsa no mu. Sɛ ehwɛ na oye ma wo dɛ enya me bɔkɔ Babylon a, bra, na mobɔhwɛ wo yie; na sɛ ehwɛ na omuo ma wo dɛ enye me bɔkɔ Babylon a, ma ɔnka: Hwɛ asaase no nyina da w'enyim; beebiara a ehwɛ a oye na ɔyɛ ahomka ma wo dɛ ebɔkɔ no.

Na onnyae nnsane no, ɔsee dɛ san mbɔ na kɔ Shaphan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedaliah a Babylonhen ahyɛ no ambrado wɔ Judah nkurow do no mu: Anaa kɔ beebiara a ehwɛ a ibenya ahomka dɛ ebɔkɔ no. Nna aweɔmfo safohen no maa no ogyaa no kwan.
Nna Jeremiah kɔr Ahikam ba Gedaliah nkyɛn wɔ ɔman a wɔaka asaase no do no mu.

Afei ber a dɔm no hɔn asafohen a wɔwɔ nhaban mu no, mekyerɛ hɔn na hɔn mbarimba no, wɔtsee dɛ Babylonhen ahyɛ Ahikam ba Gedaliah ambrado wɔ asaase no do, na ɔdze mbarimba, na mbaa, na mbofraba, na asaase no do akɔhweaban a wɔammfa hɔn ndɔmmum annkɔ Babylon no mu bi ahyɛ n'ase no;
nna wɔbaa Gedaliah nkyɛn wɔ Mizpah, mekyerɛ Nethanaih ba Ishmael, na Kareah mba Johanan na Jonathan, na Tanhumeth ba Seraiah, na Netophanyi Jezaniah, hɔn na hɔn mbarimba.
Na Shaphan ba Ahikam ne ba Gebaliah kãa ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn na hɔn mbarimba no, dɛ, mma hom nnsuro dɛ hom bɔsom Chaldeafo no: Na hom ntsena asaase no, na obesi hom yie.
