Emidze, hwɛ, mebɛtsena Mizpah megyina Chaldeafo wɔbɛba hɛn nkyɛn no nyim: Na homdze, hom mboaboa nsã na ɔpɛber nduadzewa na ngo ano, na hom ntsenatsena hom nzɛmba mu, na mfa nguguhom ndzɛmba mu, na hom afefa no mu.

Dɛmara so na Judafo a wɔwɔ Moab, na Ammonmba mu, na Edom, na hɔn a wɔwɔ asaase no nyina do nyinara, wɔtsee dɛ Babylonhen egya Judah nkaa, na dɛ ɔdze Shaphan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedaliah edzi hɔn do ɔpanyin no;
nna Judafo no kɔree no do bae, na wɔbaa Judah asaase do, Gedaliah nkyɛn, wɔ Mizpah, na wɔboaboaa nsã na ɔpɛber nduadzewa piigyan ara ano.
Nkyii so Kareah na Johanan, na dɔm a wɔwɔ haban mu n'asafohenno, wɔbaa Gedaliah nkyɛn wɔ Mizpah,
na, wɔsee no dɛ, ana inyim dɛ Ammonmba ba Ishmael dɛ omboku wo? Na Ahikam ba Gedaliah annhye hɔn enndzi.

Nna Kareah ba Johanan see Gedaliah wɔ Mizpah wɔ nsumaa mu, dɛ meserɛ wo, ma monkɔ, na munkoku Nethaniah ba Ishmael, na nyimpa biara runnhu: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na oboku wo ma Judahfo a wɔaboa ano aba wo nkyɛn no nyinara mbɔ mpetse, na Judah nkaa no nhera?
Na Ahikam ba Gedaliah see Kareah ba Johanan, dɛ mma nnyɛ dɛm adze yi: Na atofosɛm na ekã no Ishmael ho yi.
41: Afei ɔbaa dɛ bosoom a otsīa esuon no mu, Elishama ba Nethaniah ne ba Ishmael, a ofi Ɔhen asefo, na Ɔhen n'etsitsir no mu no, na mbarimba du a wɔkã no ho no, wɔbaa Ahikam ba Gedaliah nkyɛn wɔ Mizpah: Na Mizpah hɔ na wɔbɔɔ mu dzidzii.
Nna Nethaniah ba Ishmael, na mbarimba du a wɔkã no ho no, wɔsoɛree, na wɔdze afõwa no ho no, twitwaa Shaphan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedaliah, na wokum nyia Babylonhen hyɛɛ no ambrado wɔ asaase no do no.
Ishmael so kunkum Jewfo na Chaldeafo a wohun hɔn wɔ hɔ no, mbarimba akofo no a.
Na ɔbaa dɛ oeku Gediliah ekyir ndaenu no a obiara nntsee no,

mbarimba bi eduowɔtwe fi Shechem, Shiloh, na Samaria bae a woeyiyi hɔn abɔdwesa na woesunsuan hɔn ntar mu, na wɔatotow hɔnho akan, na edzibanafɔr na nduhuam kitsakitsa hɔn nsamu, dɛ wɔdze reba Ewuradze fie.
Na Nethaniah ba Ishmael fiir edzi fii Mizpah kehyiaa hɔn kwan, ɔrokɔ nyina nna, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mbra Ahikam ba Gedaliah nkyɛn.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔbaa kurow no ne finimfin no Nethaniah ba Ishmael, ɔnoara na mbarimba a wɔkã no ho no, wokunkum hɔn, na wɔtoow hɔn guu mona no mu.
Na wohun hɔn mu mbarimba du a, wɔsee dɛ, mma nnku hɛn: Na yɛwɔ edzidzidze suma haban mu, ewifua na atoko, na ngo na ewo. Na ogyaae, na oennku hɔn ammfora hɔn nuanom no.

Afei mona a Ishmael toow hɔn a okunkum hɔn kãa Gedaliah ho hɔn efun guu mu no, (ɔnoara nye dza Ɔhen Asatui wɔ Israelhen Baasha ho suro ntsi no na Nethaniah ba Ishmael dze hɔn a wokunkum hɔn no hɔn efun hyɛɛ no mã

Nna Ishmael faa ɔman nkaa a wɔwɔ Mizpah no nyinara kɔr ndɔmmum, mekyerɛ Ɔhen ne, mbabaa no, na nkorɔfo a wɔkaa Mizpah aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan dze hyɛɛ Ahikam ba Gedaliah n'ase no nyina. Nethaniah ba Ishmael soaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree, na osii mu dɛ orukotwa mu akɔ Ammonmba no nkyɛn.
Na Kareah ba Johanan, na dɔm asafohemfo a wɔwɔ ne nkyen no nyina, wɔtsee mbusu nyina a Nethaniah ba Ishmael abɔ no,
nna wɔfaa mbarimba no nyina, na wɔkɔr dɛ wɔnye Nthaniah ba Ishmael rokɔkõ, na wɔkɔtoo no wɔ esu kɛse a ɔwɔ Gibeon no ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nkorɔfo nyina a wɔwɔ Ishmael nkyɛn no wohun Kareah ba Johanan, na dɔm asafohemfo nyina a wɔkã no ho no, hɔn enyi gyee.
Nna nkorɔfo a Ishmael soaa hɔn ndɔmmum fii Mizpah kɔree no, wɔdandaan hɔnho, na wɔsensansee, na wɔkɔr Kareah ba Johanan nkyɛn.
Na Nethaniah ba Ishmael ɔnye mbarimba baawɔtwe fii Kareah nsa kɔr Ammonmba no nkyɛn.

Nna Kareah ba Johanan na dɔm no mu asafohemfo no nyina faa ɔman no nkaa no nyina a ɔkɛgyee hɔn fii Nethaniah ba Ishmael a okum Ahikam ba Gedaliah wɔ Mizpah no nsamu no: Mba akofo, na mbaa, na mbofraba, na epiafo a ɔdze hɔn fi Gideon sanee bae no:
Na wosii mu kɔree, na wɔkɛtsenaa Geruth Chimham a ɔwɔ Beth-le-Chaldeafo no ntsi: Osiandɛ wosuroo hɔn, wɔ dɛ Nethaniah ba Ishmael eku Ahikam ba Gedaliah a Babylonhen hyɛɛ no ambrado wɔasaase no do
42: Nna dɔm no mu asafohen no nyinara na Kareah ba Johanan, na Hoshaiah ba Jezaniah, na ɔman no nyinara, ofi ekumaba do kesi ɔkɛse do, wɔtwee bɛnee,
bɛsee nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah dɛ, yɛserɛ wo, ma hɛn nkɔtoserɛ yi nsɔ w'enyi na yi Ewuradze, wo Nyankopɔn mpaa ma hɛn, nkaa yi nyinara; na hɛn nye kakraabi a yɛaka wɔ pii no mu, dɛmbrɛ w'enyiwatua hɛn yi:
Ama Ewuradze, wo Nyankopɔn ɔaakyerɛ hɛn kwan kor a yɛnnantsew mu na adze kor a yɛnyɛ.

Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia see hɔn dɛ, matse hom asɛm: Hwɛ mibeyi Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn mpaa dɛ mbrɛ hom akã yi; na ɔbɛba dɛ asɛm biara a Ewuradze dze bobua hom no, mebɛpaa mu akã ahyerɛ hom; mirinnsiw hom biribiara do.
Nna wɔsee Jeremiah dɛ, Ewuradze nyɛ nokwar dasefo turododo wɔ hɛn ntamu, sɛ yɛannyɛ dɛ mbrɛ asɛm nyina a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze bɔsoma wo wɔ hɛn nkyɛn no tse a.
Sɛ oye o, sɛ omuo o yebetsie Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn ne ndze a oeesi hɛn yie
Na ɔbaa dɛ dadu sõe ekyir no, Ewuradze n'asɛm baa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah, hɔ.
Nna ɔfrɛɛ Kareah ba Johanan, na dɔm no mu asafohen a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no nyina, na ɔman no nyinara ofi ekumaba do kesi ɔkɛse do,
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn a hom somaa me ne nkyɛn dɛ memfa hom nkotoserɛ nkɔto n'enyim no, ɔse nye yi:
Sɛ hom bɛda ho atsena asaase yi do a, ɔnodze mibesi hom, na murunndwuruw hom nngu famu,na matsɛw hom, na menntutu hom ase: Na menu moho, na menntutu hom ase: Na menu moho wɔ mbusu a mabɔ hom no ntsi.
Mma hom nnsuro Babylonhen a hom suro no no: Mma hom nnsuro no, Ewuradze na ɔse: Na mowɔ hom nkyɛn dɛ mebɛgye hom nkwa, na meyi hom efi ne nsamu.
Na mibenya mbɔbɔhu ama hom, na oehu hom mbɔbɔr, na ɔama hom asan akɔ hom ankasa hom asaase do.
Na sɛ hom kã dɛ, yɛrenntsena asaase yi do; ma dɛm no hom enntsie Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn ne ndze;
dɛ, oho; na yɛbɔkɔ Egypt asaase do, mbrɛ yennkohu asayɛ, eso yɛnnkɛtse ne ndze, eso yennkedzi edzibankɔm; na yɛatsena hɔ a;
ɔnodze afei, Judah nkaasefo, hom ntsie Ewuradze n'asɛm: Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, sɛ hom dze si hom enyi do pɛpɛɛpɛ dɛ Egypt ara na hom bɔkɔ akɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ a:
Ɔnodze ɔbɛba dɛ, afõwa a hom suro no bɔto hom Egypt asaase ho hɔ, na ɔkɔma hom suro no betsiw hom dzendzenndzen wɔ Egypt hɔ; na hɔ na hom bowuwu.

Dɛm na ɔbɛyɛ hɔn mbarimba nyinara a wɔdze esi hɔn enyi do pɛpɛɛpɛ dɛ Egypt ara na wɔbɔkɔ akɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ no nye yi; wobowuwu afõwa, na ɔkɔm,na ɔyardɔm ano: Na hɔn mu biara rennka anaa oefi mbusu a medze bɛba hɔn no mu.

Na mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye nye yi: Dɛ mbrɛ m'ebufuw na m'ebufuhyew ehue egu Jerusalem atsefo do no, dɛmara so na, sɛ hom kɛhɛn Egypt a, m'ebufuhyew bohue egu hom do; na hom bɛyɛ ekyiwadze na ahobowdze, na ndom, na ahorohoraadze; na hom nnkohu bea yi bio.
Judah nkaasefo, Ewuradze akã wɔ hom do dɛ, mma hom nnkɔ Egypt: Hom nhu no kotoo dɛ medzi hom dase ndɛ da yi.

Na hom adaadaa hom ankasa hom akra; osiandɛ hom somaa me Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn pɔn ne nkyɛn, dɛ, yi Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn mpaa ma hɛn; na dza Ewuradze, hɛn Nyankopɔn bɛse nyina, dɛmara na kã kyreɛ hɛn, na yɛbɛyɛ:
Na ndɛ da yi mapa mu akã akyerɛ hom; na hom enntsie Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn ne ndze, wɔ dza ɔdze somaa me hom nkyɛn no mu biara mu.
Dɛm ntsi afei hom nhu no ampaara dɛ hom bowuwu afõwa, ɔkɔm, na ɔyardom ano, wɔ bea a hom kɔn dɛ hom bɛyɛ hɔ amamforafo no mu.
43: Na ɔbaa dɛ Jeremiah kãa ɔman no nyina hɔn Ewuradze Nyankopɔn dze somaa no hɔn nkyɛn no nyina wiei no, mekyerɛ nsɛm nyinaa no,

Hoshaiah ba Azariah, na Kareah ba Johanan, na ahopɔwfo no nyina kasaa kyerɛɛ Jeremiah, dɛ Ekã atofosɛm: Ewuradze dze hɛn Nyankopɔn no ɔnnsomaa wo dɛ bɛse dɛ, mma hom nnkɔ Egypt nnkɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ;
na Neriah ba Baruch opiapa wo tsia hɛn, ma oeyi hɛn ahyɛ Chaldeafo nsa, ma woeekuku hɛn, na wɔaasoa hɛn ndɔmmum akɔ Babylon.
Na Kareah ba Johanan, na dɔm no mu asafohemfo no nyina, na ɔman no nyina, woenntsie Ewuradze ne ndze dɛ wɔbɛtsena Judah asaase do.
Na Kareah ba Johanan, na dɔm no mu asafohen no nyina wɔfaa Judah:

Mbarimba, na mbaa, na mbofraba, na Ɔhen ne mbaabaa no, na nyimpa biara a aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan daan no gyaa Shaphan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedaliah ne nkyɛn no, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah, na Neriah ba Baruch;
na wɔbaa Egypt asaase do; na woenntsie Ewuradze ne ndze: Na wɔbaa Tahpanhes mpo.
Nna Ewuradze n'asɛm baa Jeremiah nkyɛn wɔ Tahpanhes, dɛ,
fa abo akese wɔ wo nsamu, na fa hyehyɛ ntaayaa nsɛwee a ɔwɔ Pharaoh fie abowano wɔ Tahpanhes no mu mu wɔ Judah mbarimba no enyim;

na se hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hwɛ, mobɔsoma akɛfa Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar m'akowaa no, na medze n'akɔngua esi abo a medze ahyehyɛ ha yi na ɔaheran n'akatamanso do wɔ do.
Na ɔbɛba abɔbɔ Egypt asaase; hɔn a wɔsɛ owu no, wobowu, na hɔn a wɔsɛ ndɔmmum kɔno, wɔakɔ ndɔmmum, na hɔn a wɔsɛ afõwa no, afõwa aka hɔn.
Na mobɔsɔ gya wɔ Egypt abosom efi mu, na ɔbɛhyew hɔn, na ɔasoa hɔn akɔ ndɔmmum: Na ɔdze Egypt asaase bofura dɛ mbrɛ oguanhwɛfo dze n'atar hyɛ na ofi hɔ befir edzi asomdwee mu.
Obobu Beth-shemesh a ɔwɔ Egypt asaase do no n'edum no; na ɔdze gya ahyew Egypt abosom efi no nyina.
44: Asɛm a ɔbaa Jeremiah hɔ wɔ Jewfo nyina a wɔtse Egypt asaase do a wɔtsetse Migdol, na Tahpanhes, na Noph, na Pathros asaase do no ho, dɛ,
mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hom ehu mbusu a medze maba Jerusalem do nyina, na Judah nkurow nyinara do; na hwɛ, ndɛ da yi wɔayeyɛ amamfõ, na nyimpa biara nntse do:
Osiandɛ hɔn emumuyɛ a wɔayɛ dze eyi me ebufuw ntsi, wɔ dɛ wɔkɔree kɛhyeew nduhuam, na wɔkɔsoom abosom afofor a hom nnyim hɔn ntsi, hɔn o, hom o, hom egyanom o.
Naaso mosomaa mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara baa hom nkyɛn, mosoɛɛr ahema na mosomaa hɔn, dɛ, ao, mma hom nnyɛ ekyiwadze a mikyir no.
Na woenntsie, eso wɔammbrɛ hɔn aso adze dɛ wɔbɛsan efi hɔn emumuyɛ ho, dɛ wɔnnkɛhyew nduhuam ama abosom afofor.
Dɛm ntsi na m'ebufuhyew na m'ebufuw huei gui, na ɔdzɛwee wɔ Judah nkurow na Jerusalem abrɔn mu; ma ayeyɛ ekurofõ na amamfõ, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.

Dɛm ntsi afei Ewuradze, dɔm Nyankopɔn, Israel no se nye yi: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom bɔ, mbusu yi tsia homankasa hom akra, dɛ hom botwitwa hom mu ɔbarimaba na ɔbaa, abɔdomaba na enumfoanoba efi Judah mu dɛ mma wonngyaa hom nkaa bi;

wɔ dɛ hom dze hom nsaano edwuma yi me ebufuw, dɛ hom rehyew nduhuam ama abosom afofor wɔ Egypt asaase a hom akɔ do akɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ no do; amam woeekuruw hom ase, na hom aayɛ ndom na ahorohoraadze wɔ asaase do amanaman nyinara mu?
Ana hom werɛ efir hom egyanom emumuyɛ na Judah ahemfo emumuyɛ, na hɔn yernom emumuyɛ, homankasa hom emumuyɛ, na hom yernom emumuyɛ a wɔyɛɛ no Judah asaase do, na Jerusalem abrɔn no mu?
Wɔmmbrɛɛ hɔnho adze ara dze bodu ndɛ da yi mpo, eso wonnsuroi, eso wɔnnantseew me mbra, anaa m'ahyɛdze a medze mesi hom enyim.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hwɛ, medze m'enyi bɛsã hom do, ma aayɛ hom mbusu, mekyerɛ dɛ wobokuruw Judah nyinara ase.

Na mebɛfa Judah nkaase a wɔdze esi hɔn enyim dɛ wɔbɔkɔ Egypt asaase do akɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ no, na hɔn nyinara wɔasã: Egypt asaase do na ɔkɔm ano; wɔbɛnyew wɔ afõwa na ɔkɔm ano; wobowuwu, ofi ekumaba do kesi ɔkɛse do, wɔafõwa na ɔkɔm ano: Na wɔbɛyɛ ekiwadze, na ahobowdze, na ndom, na ahorohoraa.
Na mebɛtsēa hɔn a wɔtse Egypt asaase dono, dɛ mbre medze afõwa, ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm matsēa Jerusalem no:
Na Judah nkaase wɔkɔ Egypt aakɛyɛ hɔ amamforafo, no mu obi rimmfi nsa anaaso ɔnnka, dɛ wɔbɛsan aba Judah asaase a hom enya akɔndɔ dɛ hom bɛtsena do: Na obiara rennsan, gyedɛ hɔn a wobefi nsa no.

Nna mbarimba no a wonyim dɛ hɔn yernomhyeew eduhuam maa abosom afofor bi no, na mbaa a wogyinagyina nkyɛn no nyina, kuw kɛse pa a, mekyerɛ nkorɔfo a wɔtse Egypt asaase do, wɔ Pathros no nyina, wobuaa Jeremiah, dɛ.
Ɔfa asɛm a akã akyerɛ hɛn wɔ Ewuradze dzin mu no dze, yerinntsie wo.

Na mbom ɔyɛ ara na yɛbɛyɛ asɛm biara a oefi hɛn anomu efir, dɛ yɛbɛhyew eduhuam ama ɔsor ɔhembaa no, na yɛabɔ ɔnom-afɔr ama no, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn na hɛn egyanom, hɛn ahemfo na mbapɔmba, yɛayɛ wɔ Judah nkurow mu, na Jerusalem abrɔn mu: Na ber no na yenyaa edziban baafuu, na yedzii yie, na yeennhu mbusu biara.
Na ofitsi ber a yegyaa dɛ yɛhyew eduhuam ma ɔsor ɔhembaa, na yɛbɔ ɔnom-afɔr ma no no, adze nyina abɔ hɛn, na yeewie sã wɔ afõwa na ɔkɔm ano.
Na yɛhyeew eduhuam maa ɔsor ɔhembaa, na yɛbɔɔ ɔnom-afɔr maa no no, aso yɛyɛɛ tatar maa no dɛ yɛdze rosɔr no, na yekwetsii hɛn kunnom bɔɔ ɔnom-afɔr maa no?
Nna Jeremiah see ɔman no nyina, mbarimba, na mbaa,mekyerɛ nkorɔfo a wobuaa no no nyina, dɛ
eduhuam a hom na hom mbapɔmba, na asaase no do nkrɔfo, hom hyewee wɔ Judah nkurow, na Jerusalem abrɔn mu no, aso Ewuradze annkaa, na ɔammba n'adwen mu a?
Ma dɛm no Ewuradze enntum annsɔw bio, osiandɛ hom emumuyɛ, na ekyiwadze a hom ayɛ no ntsi; dɛm ntsi na hom asaase adan amamfõ, na ahobowdze, na ndom a ɔtse da yi.

Osiandɛ hom ahyew eduhuam, na osiandɛ hom ayɛ bɔn etsia Ewuradze, na hom enntsie Ewuradze ne ndze, eso wɔannantsew ne mbra, na n'ahyɛdze, na n'adasesɛm do ntsi; dɛm ntsi na mbusu yi ato hom dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
Bio so Jeremiah see ɔman no nyina, na mbaa no nyina dɛ, Judah a hom wɔ Egypt asaase do nyina, hom ntsie Ewuradze n'asɛm:

Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nyeyi, dɛ hom na hom yernom dze hom ano akã, na hom dze hom nsa ahyɛ no mã, dɛ, ɔba ara na yɛbɛma hɛn nsūu a yesūu no aba mu, dɛ yɛbɛhyɛw eduhuam ama ɔsor ɔhembaa no, na yɛabɔ ɔnom-afɔr ama no: Hom mma hom nsuūu mbra mu ɛ.
Dɛm ntsi hom Judahfo a hom tse Egypt asaase do nyina, (hom ntsie Ewuradze n'asɛm: Hwɛ, makã me dzin kɛse no ho ntam, Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ, dɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn tse ase yi:
Hwɛ, moroweɔn hɔn wɔ mbusu ho, na nnyɛ papa a: Judah mbarimba a wɔwɔ Egypt asaase do nyinara bɛhyew afõwa na ɔkɔm ano, dze ekodu dɛ woewie sã.
Na hɔn a wofi afõwa nsa no, wɔbɛsan efi Egypt asaase do, hɔn dodow kumaabi, na Judah nkaa awɔkɔ Egypt asaase so akɛyɛ amamforafo wɔhɔ no nyina, wobohu nyia n'asem begyina, sɛ medze o, hɔndze o.
Na iyi bɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze ama hom, Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ mebɛtsēa hom bea yi do ha, ama hom eehu dɛ me nsɛm begyina ara ampa ayɛ mbusu etsia hom:
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Hwɛ, medze Egypthen Pharaoh Hophra bɛhyɛ n'atamfo nsa; dɛ mbrɛ medze Judahhen Zedekiah mehyɛɛ ne tamfo, na nyia ɔhwehwɛɛ no nkwa, Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar no, ne nsa no.
45: Asɛm a nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah kãa kyerɛɛ Neriah ba Baruch, ber a ɔkyerɛɛw nsɛm yi fii Jeremiah anomu hyɛɛ nwoma mu wɔ Josiah ba Jehoiakim n'afe atsīa anan no mu, dɛ,
mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, kã kyerɛ ɔwo, Baruch, nye yi:
Ekã dɛ, afei mundue! Na Ewuradze dze awerɛhow akã me yaw ho; maberɛ na m'apensi, na minnya ahomgye biara.
Dɛm na kã kyerɛ no dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Hwɛ, dza mesi no, mubodwuruw, na dza matsɛw no, metutu; na iyi besi asaase no nyinara do.
Na erohwehwɛ ndzɛmba akɛse ama woho anaa? Mma nnhwehwɛ: Na, hwɛ, medze mbusu bɛba adasamba nyinara do, Ewuradze na ɔse: Na, medze no nkwa bɛma wo ayɛ afonam wɔ mbea a erokɔ do nyinara do.
46: Ewuradze asɛm a ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah hɔ wɔ amanaman ho:
Egypt dze: Wɔ Egypthen Pharaoh-neco no dɔm a wɔwɔ esutsen Euphrates ho wɔ Carchemish a Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar bɔɔ no wɔ Josiah ba Jehoiakim, Judahhen no, n'afea otsīa anan no mu no ho.
Hom nkra nkataenyim na kyɛm, na hom ntwe mbɛn akono.
Mpɔnkɔdofo, hom nhyehyɛ mpɔnkɔ no, na hom ntsenatsena do na hom nsa hom dadzenkyɛw ngyinagyina hɔ; hom mpɔw hom dadzentar.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mehu yi? Hɔn bo etutu, na wɔadan hɔn ekir; na hɔn akatakyi no wɔadan hɔn egu, na woeguan ntsɛntsɛm, na wommbu hɔn kɔn ekir: Hu wɔ mbea nyina, Ewuradze na ɔse,
Mma ɔhoɔharfo nnhuan nnkɔ, eso ɔkataki mmfi nsa; kwaamu afamu esutsen Euphrates ho na woefintsiw na wɔahwehwen ase.
Woana na na ɔsoɛr dɛ Nile, na n'esu rubu asorɛkye begyabegya dɛ nsutsen: Na ɔdɛ, mibeyir, mebɛkata saase no do; mebɛsɛɛ kurow no na no mu atsefo no.
Egypt aorɛkye begyabegya dɛ nsutsen: Na ɔdɛ, mibeyir, mebɛkataasaase no do; mebɛsɛɛ kurow no na no mu atsefo no.
Mpɔnkɔ, hom mbɔ mfa mu; na ntseaseanam, hom mbɔ kyirdidi; na hom mma akatakyi mfir edzi: Cush na Put a wokurakura kyɛm; na Ludfo a wokurakura egyen, na wɔkontokontom no.

Na da no yɛ Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze, ne da awerdzi da, ama oeedzi n'atamfo wer: Na afõwa bedzidzi amee, na ɔanom hɔn bɔgyaa ɔbow: Na Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze, wɔ okumafɔr bi wɔ kwaa mu asaase do wɔ esutsen Euphrates ho.
Egypt ne babaa ɔbaabun, fow kɔ Gilead kɛgye edur: Eyɛ edur pii kwa; ɔyarsabiara nnyi hɔ mma wo.
Amanaman atse w'enyimguase, na wo nkekamu ahyɛ asaase mã tɔ: Na ɔkatakyi asoasoa ɔkatakyi do, hɔn beenu no abɔ mu ahwe ase.
Asɛm a Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah, mbrɛ Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar bɛba abɔbɔ Egypt asaase no.
Hom mpaa mu nkã no Egypt, na hom mfa ntahye Migdol, na hom nkã dɛ, gyina kan, na siesie woho ;na afõwa no edzidzi etwa wo ho ehyia.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w'ahoɔdzenfo wɔapra hɔn kɔ yi? Woenngyina, osiandɛ Ewuradze paam hɔn kɔree.
Ɔmaa pii fintsifintsiwii, nyew, wɔhwehwee ase dedaa hɔnho do: Na wɔsee dɛ, hom nsoɛr awobea no do hɔ, mfi afõwa a ɔrehyɛ hɛn no ano.
Wɔkekaa mu wɔ hɔ dɛ, Egypthen Pharaoh yɛ dede ara kwa; ɔama hyɛber no etwa mu asen.
Metse ase yi, Ɔhen a ne dzin dze dɔm Ewuradze no na ɔse, amapaara mbrɛ Tabor tse wɔ mbepɔw mu, na mbrɛ Carmel tse wɔ po ho no, dɛmara na no so bɛba.
Ɔwo babaa a etse Egypt, siesie woho kɔ amamfõ, na wɔahyew a, obi renntsena do bio.
Egypt yɛ ɔnantwiber a no ho yɛ fɛw; na ɔsɛɛ fi kwaamu afamu aba no do.
N'apaafo so a wɔtse no mu wɔtse dɛ nantwibuw mu anantwimba; na hɔn so wɔadandan hɔnho, na wɔabɔ mu ehuanguan, woenngyina: Osiandɛ hɔn mbusu da, hɔn sera ber no, aba hɔn do.
Ne ndze bɛgyegye dɛ ɔwɔ dze; na wɔdze dɔm nam reba, na wɔdze nkuma aba no do, dɛ nduatowfo.
Wobobu no kwaa, Ewuradze na ɔse, naaso worunntum nnhwehwɛ mu; osiandɛ wɔdɔɔ sõ sen mbɛhɛw, na wɔkan hɔn dodow a ɔnnyɛ.
Wɔbɛma Egypt babaa n'enyi atõ; wobeyi no ahyɛ kwaa mu ɔman no nsa.
Dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse dɛ: Hwɛ mebɛtsēa Amon a ɔwɔ No, na Pharaoh. Na Egypt ɔnye n'abosom, na n'ahemfo; mekyerɛ Pharaoh na hɔn a wɔtwer no no:
Na mibeyi hɔn mahyɛ hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ hɔn nkwa no nsa, na n'akowaa nsa: Na n'ekyir no wɔbɛtsena do dɛ tsetse nda no, Ewuradze na ɔse.

Na ɔwo m'akowaa Jacob, mma nnsuro, na Israel so, mma wo bo nntu: Na hwɛ, me bɛgye wo nkwa mefi ekyirkyir na w'asefo mefi ndɔmmum asaase do na Jacob bɛsan, na ɔbɛtena ase dwudwoodwo, na obiara remma onnsuro.

M'akowaa Jacob, mma nnsuro, Ewuradze na ɔse; na mowɔ wo nkyen: Na mebɛma amanaman a mabɔ hɔn apetse do no woewie sã na ɔwodze, meremma innwie sã; na mbom mebɛtsēa wo dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata, na meremma emmfa woho tɔtrɔtɔ ara da.
47: Ewuradze asɛm a ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah hɔ wɔ Philistiafo ho ansaana Pharaoh robɔ Gaza.

Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Hwɛ, esu rema noho do efi kwaamu afamu, na ɔabɛyɛ ɔwoara a oeyir, na ɔaseram asaase no na dza ɔwɔ mu nyina do, kurow no na hɔn a wɔtse mu do na nyimpa bɛkeka mu, na asaase no do atsefo no nyina abɔ mbubuw.
Na mpɔnkɔ hɔn ntɔtse a osisi famu pipi no ne gyegye, ne ntseaseanam ne nkyirdidi, no nhwiir no kurduduyɛ ntsi, egyanom nndan hɔn enyi nnhwɛ hɔn mba wɔ hɔn nsa a agow ntsi;
Osian da a ɔreba abɛsɛɛ Philistiafo nyina, ebotwitwa Tyre na Zidon ɔboafo a ɔka biara efi hɔ ntsi: Na Ewuradze bɛsɛɛ Philistiafo, Caphtor nsupɔw mu nkaa no.
Etsipaa aba Gaza do; Ashkelon na hɔn bɔnsa mu nkaa no asɛɛ pasaa: Ebɔtotow woho akam ekesi dabɛn?
Ɔwo Ewuradze n'afõwa, onkodu dabɛn ara na ayɛ komm? Fa woho kɛhyɛ wo bɔha mu; gye w'ahom, na taa dzinn.
Ibesi dɛn ayɛ komm, ber a Ewuradze dze asodzi bi ahyɛ wo nsa yi? Ashkelon, na mpoano hɔ na ɔahyɛ dɛ ɔmbra.
48: Moab dze, Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Nebo ndue! Osiandɛ wɔabɔ no; woegu Kiriathaim n'enyim ase, wɔagye: Woegu Misgab n'enyim ase na wɔagye wɔadwerew no.
Nkamfo nnyi hɔ bio mmba Moab; woetu no ho egyina bɔn wɔ Heshbon dɛ, hom mbra, ma yentwa no nkyen mma ɔaannyɛ ɔman bio. Madmen, ɔwo so wɔbɛma ayɛ fõo; afõwa betsiw wo.
Nkekamu ndze fi Horonaim, afofa na ɔsɛɛ kɛse!
Wɔasɛɛ Moab; no nkɔkowaba ama wɔatse nkekamu.
Na Luhith afowee na wɔdze osū araa bɔfow akɔ sor; na Horonaim esianee na wɔatse ɔsɛɛ ne nkekamu ho mbubuwbɔ.
Hom nguanguan, hom ngye dɛ sar do duaba.
Na osiandɛ ɔwo atwer wo ndwuma na w'akoradze ntsi, wo so wɔbɛfa wo: Na Chemosh oefir edzi akɔ ndɔmmum, n'asɔfoe na n'asafohen kã ho.
Na afofanyi no bɛba kurow biara do, na kurow biara rimmfi nsa; bɔnsa so bɛhera, na asaase taae asɛɛ; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze akã no.
Hom mma Moab ntsaban, ma ontu nkɔ: Na no nkurow bɛyɛ amamfõ, dɛ biara nntsena mu.
Ndom nkã nyia ɔyɛ Ewuradze n'edwuma akwadwer mu, na ndom nkã nyia osianka n'afõwa fi bɔgya mu.

Moab atsena ase ahodwe mu fi ne mbafose, na ɔagyen ataa n'ase nsã no do, na wonnhuee no mmfii adze kor mu nnkɔr adze kor mu, eso ɔnnkɔr ndɔmmum da: Dɛm ntsi na ne dɛw aka no mu nnkɔr adze kor mu, eso ɔnnkɔr ndɔmmum da: Dɛm ntsi na ne dɛw aka no mu, na no huam asakyer.
Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, nda reba a, Ewuradze na ɔse, mobɔsoma hɔn a wohue gu ma wɔaaba no do, ma woeehue no egu, na wɔaabobɔ hɔn mbɔdambɔ no.
Na Moab n'enyi bɔtõ Chemosh ho, dɛ mbrɛ Israel fifo hɔn enyi tõo hɔn awerɛhyɛmu Beth-el ho no.
Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom se dɛ, yɛyɛ akatakyi na akofo a yɛbotum ɔkõ no?
Moab abɔ, na wɔafow kɔ no nkurow mu, na ne mberantsɛ mpamufo no esian kɔ ekumii, Ɔhen a ne dzin dze dɔm Ewuradze no na ɔse.
Moab no mbusu bɛn reba, na n'amandzehu reba ntsɛntsɛm.
Hom a hom abɔ no ho aprɔw nyina, hom ngyam no, na hom a hom nyim n'edzin nyina hom nse dɛ mbrɛ poma a ɔyɛ dzen, abaa a ɔyɛ fɛw no, edua ebu a!

Ɔwo babaa a etse Dibon, fi w'enyimnyam mu sian, na tsena nsukɔm mu, na nyia ɔfa Moab afo no aba wo do, ɔasɛɛ w'aban dzendzen no. 19 Aroer ɔtsefo, kegyina akwan nkyɛn, na tsɛw: Bisa nyia oruguan, na nyia ofi nsa no; se dɛ, wɔyɛ no dɛn?
Woegu Moab n'enyim ase; osiandɛ woedwuruw no egu famu: Hom mbɔ mbubuw na hom nkekamu; hom nkã wɔ Arnon dɛ, Moab abɔ.
Na atsɛmbu aba asaase taae no do; ɔaba Holon, na Jahzah, na Mephaath;
na Dibon, na Nebo, na Beth-gamul, na Bozrah, na Moab asaase do nkorɔfo wɔwɔ ekyirkyir, na dza wɔbɛn nyina do.
Woetwa Moab n'ambɛn, na woebu n'abasa, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hom mma ɔmbow nsã; osiandɛ okunkoom noho wɔ Ewuradze do: Na Moab bɛyankayankam ne fe mu, na ɔno so wɔdze o esi atwetwe.
Na aso Israel annyɛ atwetwe amma wo? Aso wohun no ewifo mu? Na ɔwo ekã no ho asɛm ara apem a, ewosow wo tsir.
Moab atsefo, hom ndan nkurow bo ngya, na hom nyɛ dɛ ebubur a ɔyɛ no buw wɔ itu no ano no.
Yɛatse Moab no nkontompɔ, dɛ ɔyɛ nkontompɔ dodow; n'ahopɔw, Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ ne nyinara gyan; n'ahohyehyɛ enntum hwee yɛ.
Dɛm ntsi namobɔbɔ Moab nyina ho: Na Kirheres mbarimba ntsi wobedzi nkɔmbɔ.
Sibmah wenyindua, medze dza ɔkyɛn Jazer no sū na mubosū wo: W'abaw atra po ekodu Jazer po ho mpo: Ɔsɛɛfo no ebotu ahyɛ wo hyewber nduadzewa na wo wenyin nduadzewa do.
Na woeyi enyigye na dɛw efi mfuwa prɔmprɔm a Moab asaase no do; na mama nyin atwee wɔ wenyinnntwer no mu: Obiara remmfa esebɔ tsia esebɔ no rennyɛ esebɔ bi.
Ofi Heshbon nkekamu no do dze kesi Elealeh mpo, dze kesi Jahaz mpo, na wɔama hɔn ndze do, ofi Zoar dze kesi Horonaim mpo, dze kesi Eglath-shelishiyah: Na Nimrim esuesu bɛdan asaase kɛsɛɛ.
Bio so mebɛma nyia ɔbɔ afɔr wɔ no mu sorɔnsorɔmbea, na nyia ɔhyew nduhuam ma n'abosom no abɔ adze wɔ Moab.
Dɛm ntsi m'akoma gyegye ma Moab dɛ atsɛntsɛbɛn, na m'akoma gyegye dɛ astsɛtsɛbɛn ma Kir-heres mbarimba: Dɛm ntsi adze pii a woenya no ahera.
Ne tsir nyina apepa, na n'abɔdwesa nyina ekukuw: Nsa nyina ho ayɛ akamakam, na eyitam sisi asen.
Moab adan nyina etsifi na n'abrɔn do sukwadwom wɔ mbea nyina: Na mabɔ Moab dɛ senaba a enyigye nnyi mu, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Mbrɛ woesi edwuruw no a! Mbrɛ wodua bɔ mbubuw a! Mbrɛ Moab edua dze enyito adan n'ekyir a! Dɛm na Moab bɛyɛ atwetwesi na akomatu ama hɔn a wɔabɔ no ho aprɔw nyina.
Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Hwɛ, obotu dɛ ɔkɔr, na ɔatserɛw ne ntsaban mu aba Moab do.
Kerioth wɔagye, na wɔaka n'akoban no ntuae, na da no mu, Moab mbarimba akatakyi hɔn akoma bɛyɛ dɛ ɔbaa a ɔrokõ awoo n'akoma.
Na wɔbɛsɛɛ Moab ma ɔaannyɛ ɔman bio, osiandɛ oekunkon noho wɔ Ewuradze do.
Moab ɔtsefo, suro, na mona, na efir, aba wo do Ewuradze na ɔse.

Nhyia obefi suro enyim eguan no ɔbɔkɔtɔ mona no mu; na nyia ɔbɔfow efi mona no mu no, efir no bɛpa no: Na medze hɔn sera afe mebɛpa no: Na medze hɔn sera afe mebɛba ɔno noara Moab no do, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hɔn a woguanee a wonnyi ahoɔdzen no gyinagyina Heshbon nwinwin ase: Na gyaframee fi Sihon ne finimfin, na ɔahyew Moab no kutuwdo, na weɔɔweɔɔyɛfo no hɔn etsifi pampamu.
Moab, due! Chemosh man annyɛ yie: Na wɔafa wo mbabanyin no ndɔmmum, na wɔdze wo mbabaa kɔ nndɔmmumkɔ.
Naaso medze Moab ndɔmmum mebɛsan maba wɔ nda a odzi ekyir no mu, Ewuradze na ɔse. Mbrɛ Moab atsɛmbu pa nye ha.
49: Ammonmba dze. Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Aso Israel nnyi mbabanyin? Aso onnyi owuodzi? Ɔyɛ dɛn mbɔ na Malcam enya Gad, na no nkorɔfo tsenatsena no nkurow mu yi?

Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, nda reba a, Ewuradze na ɔse, mebɛma wɔatse ɔkõ na esebɔ etsia Rabbah a ɔyɛ Ammonmba dze no; na ɔbɛdan amamfõ isiw, na wɔdze ogya ahyew ne mbabaa; nna Israel benya hɔn a wonyae no, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Heshbon, bɔ mbubuw, na Ai asɛɛ; Rabbah mbabaa; hom nkeka mu, hom mfura eyitam: Hom ntwa sukwadwom, na hom ndzi akɔnaaba wɔ mban mu; na Malcam bɔkɔ ndɔmmum, n'asɔfoe na n'asafohemfo nyina.
Ɔbabaa ekyirsannyi, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ehyehyɛ woho wɔ mbɔnsa, wo bɔnsa a ɔrepem no mu? Ɔwo a edze wo werɛ hyɛɛ ewurkadze mu, dɛ, woana bɛba me nkyɛn?
Hwɛ, medze hu fi hɔn a woetwa wo ho ehyia nyina nkyɛn mebɛba wo do, Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse; na wɔbɛpam hom mu nyimpa biara nnkɛba hɔ ama ɔkwankwambɔnyi no.
Na n'ekyir no medze Ammonmba hɔn ndɔmmum no bɛsan maba, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Edom dze. Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Aso nyansa nnyi Teman bio? Aso apam ahera abadwembafo? Aso hɔn nyansaa etu?
Deban atsefo, hom nguan, hom nsan ekyir, hom ntsena mbrɛ ɔdɔ; na medze Esau no mbusu mebɛba mabɛsera no no!
Sɛ wenyin abatsewfo baa wo do a, aso nkyɛ wonnkegya wenyinaba mpɛpɛw? Sɛ ewifo baa anago a, aso nkyɛ wɔnnkɛsɛɛ ara ekodu dɛ wobenya dza ɔbɔsõ hɔn?
Na mama Esau no ho ada hɔ, mama no sumambea ada edzi; na orunntum nnsuma noho: N'asefo asɛɛ, na no nuanom, na n'efisamenafo, na onnyi hɔ.
Dan wo ngyanka mba no gya, mobɔkora hɔn do enyikan; na ma w'ekunafo mfa hɔn werɛ ntwer me.

Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Hwɛ, hɔn a ɔmmfa hɔn ho dɛ wɔbɔnom kɔɔpow no mu no, wɔbɔnom ara ampa; na aso ɔwo na ebɛfa woho edzi sɔnn? Eenkɛfa woho edzi sɔnnn? Ennkɛfa woho edzi sɔnn, na ɔnom ara na ebɔnom.
Na makã moho ntam, Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ Bozrah bɛdan ahobowdze, ahorohoraadze, amamfõ, na ndom, na no nkurow nyinara bɛyɛ amamfõ daa
Matse amandzɛɛ bi wɔ Ewuradze nkyɛn, na wɔasoma ahembɔfo wɔ amanaman mu, dɛ, hom mboa hom ano, na hom mbra no do, na hom nsoɛr mbra akono.
Na, hwɛ, mayɛ wo amanaman mu aketseaba, na adasa mu nyia woebu no enyimtsia.
Na w'ahoɔhu ho dze, w'akoma no nkontompɔ adaadaa wo, ɔwo a akoko a ɔkrɔn kitsa wo nsamu: Kaansa eyɛ wo buw wɔ ɔsorsor dɛ ɔkɔr mpo a, medze wo befi hɔ mesi famu, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na Edom bɛdan ahobowdze: Obiara a otwa mu wɔ ho no no ho bɔbow no, na ɔabɔ no mu ayardɔm nyina ho nhwiroma.

Dɛ mbrɛ Sodom na Gomorrah na nkurow a wɔdeda ho no hɔn mbutuwii tse no, Ewuradze na ɔse, dasanyi biara renntsena hɔ, eso ɔdasanyio biara renntsena hɔ, eso ɔdasanyi ne ba biara rennyɛ ɔmamforanyi wɔ hɔ.

Hwɛ ɔbɔfow aba dɛ gyata fi Jordan ne ntsɛn no mu aba tsenabea a ɔyɛ dzen no do: Na mebɛma oefi ne nkyɛn eguan awerɛfir mu; na obiara a wɔsan mu yi no no, ɔnoara na medze no besi no do: Na woana na ɔtse dɛ emi? Na woana bɛhyɛ me ber? Na woana nye oguanhwɛfo a obotum m'enyim gyina?
Dɛm ntsi hom ntsie Ewuradze n'apam a ɔrepam wɔn Edom ho; na ne tsirmpɔw a ɔabɔ wɔ Teman atsefo ho:
Hɔn asehwe ne dede ntsi, asaase no popo; nkekamu heei wɔ hɔ a wɔtse ne nka wɔ Epo memen no ho.
Hwɛ, ɔbɔfow aba na oetu dɛ ɔkɔr, na ɔatserɛw ne ntsaban mu wɔ Bozrah do: Na da no Edom mbarimba akatakyi hɔn akoma bɛyɛ dɛ ɔbaa a ɔrokõ awoo n'akoma.
Damascus dze. Hamath n'enyi atoõ, na Arpad; osiandɛ wɔatse nsɛm bɔn, wɔananan: Po do awerɛhow; wonntum nntaa dzinn.
Damascus ayɛ mberɛw, ɔadan noho ruguan, na ahopopo ekitsa no: Ahoguan na awerɛhow ekitsa no, dɛ ɔbaa a ɔrokõ awoo.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ayɛyi kurow no, m'enyigye kurow no wɔnndaan no nngyae?
Dɛm ntsi ne mberan tsɛ bɔtotɔ wɔ n'abrɔn no mu, na n'asambarimba nyinara ayeyɛ dzindzinn wɔ da no mu, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na mobɔsɔ gya wɔ Damascus fasu no mu, na ɔahyew Benhadad n'ahemfi no.
Kedar, na Hazor n'ahenman a Babylonhen Nebuchadrezzar bɔɔ no ho dze. Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Hom nsoɛr, hom nkɔ kedar, na hom nkɛsɛɛ bokamba no.
Wɔbɛfefa hɔn asesee na hɔn nkuraba, na hɔn nkuraba, na hɔn efumpɔnkɔ akɔ akɛfa: Na wɔbɛtsēa mu akyerɛ hɔn dɛ, hu wɔ afã nyina.
Hazor atsefo, hom nguan, hom nkyin nkɔ ekyirkyir, hom nkɛtsena mbrɛ hɔ dɔ, Ewuradze na ɔse; na Babylonhen Nebuchadrezzar akɔ hom tsir do apam na ɔabɔ hom ho tsirmpɔw bi.
Hom nsoɛr nkɔ ɔman a hɔn a wɔtse hɔ dwudwoodwo no do, Ewuradze na ɔse; hɔn ho adwe hɔn a wɔtse hɔ a wonnyi mbobotsen na adaban a hɔn nko ara na wɔtse.
Na hɔn efumpɔnkɔ bɛyɛ asadze, na hɔn anantwi dodow ayɛ afonam: Na mobɔbɔ hɔn a woetwitwa ntakuwa ma apetse mframa nyina mu; na medze hɔn mbusu mefi mbea nyina maba, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na Hazor bɛyɛ mpataku tsenabea, amamfõ daa: Ɔdasanyi biara rennyɛ ɔmamforanyi wɔ mu.
Ewuradze n'asɛm a ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah hɔ wɔ Elam ho wɔ Judahhen Zedekiah n'ahwendzi ahyɛse, dɛ,
mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Hwɛ, mubobubu Elam egyen, hɔn tum ne tsitsir mu.
Na medze mframa anan no mu nyinara; na ɔman biara nnyi hɔ a Elam tokyemfo no wonnkodu hɔ.

Na mebɛma Elam hɔn akoma etu hɔn atamfo, na hɔn atamfo, na hɔn a worohwehwɛ hɔn do, mekyerɛ m'ebufuw hyeehyew no a, Ewuradze na ɔse; na mebɛma hɔn do, mekyerɛ m'ebufuw hyeehyew no a, Ewuradze na ɔse; na mebɛma afõwa etsiw hɔn ekodu dɛ mewie hɔn sã:
Na medze m'ahengua mibesi Elam, na masɛɛ Ɔhen na mbapɔmba mefi hɔ, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ nda odzi ekyirno mu no, medze Elam ndɔmmum bɛsan aba, Ewuradze na ɔse.
50: Asɛm a Ewuradze nam nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah do kãa tsiaa Babylon wɔ Chaldeafo asaase ho no.

Hom mpaa mu nkã wɔ amanaman mu na hom mfa ntahye, na hom nsi frankaa; hom mfa ntahye, na mma hom nnsiw do: Hom nse dɛ, wɔafa Babylon, woegu Bel n'enyim ase. Merodach no bo etu; woegu n'ehonyi enyim ase, n'abosom bo etutu.
Na ɔman bi fii kwaamu afamu rutu no do ɔsa a wɔbɛma n'asaase ayɛ amamfõ, na obiara renntsena do: Woeguanguan, wɔkɔ, nyimpa na mbowa nyina.
Nda no mu na aber no mu, Ewuradze na ɔse, Israelmba bɛba, hɔn na Judahmba nyina; wɔdze osū botu hɔn kwan wɔakɔhwehwɛ Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn.
Wɔbɛdan hɔn enyim akyerɛ Zion do, woebisa ekyir kwan, dɛ, hom mbra mfa homho mbɔbɔ Ewuradze ho, wɔ daa ahyɛmudzi a werɛ rimmfir no mu.
Me man ayɛ nguan a wɔayew: Hɔn nguanhwɛfo ama wɔatotɔ gon, na wɔama wɔafomfom kwan wɔ mbepɔw no do; woefi bepɔw do kɔ koko do, hɔn werɛ efir hɔn ahomgyebea.
Hɔn a wɔtoo hɔn nyina amemen hɔn: Na hɔn atamfo see dɛ, yɛmmfom, osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom enyidado no.
Hom nguan mfi Babylon finimfin, na hom mfir edzi mfi Chaldeafo asaase do nkɔ, na hom nyɛ dɛ mpɔnkyenyin a wodzi nguankuw enyim.

Na, hwɛ, mibekenyan amanaman akɛse mboanofo ma wofi kwaamu afamu asaase do aba Babylon do; na wobotwa no ho mpasuar; na nkyii wɔbɛfa kurow no: Hɔn egyen-menaba tse dɛ ɔbarimba katakyi nedze; no mu biara nnsan ekyir kwa.
Na Chaldea bɛyɛ afonam: Hɔn a wɔfa no afo nyinara bɛmee, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hom a hom buma m'egyapadze, osiandɛ hom enyi agye ntsi, osiandɛ hom ridzi ehurusi ntsi, osiandɛ hom adodɔ seradze dɛ nantwifɔr a ɔroporow eburow, na hom sū dɛ mpɔnkɔ abran ntsi;
hom nã n'enyi bɔtõ papaara; nyia ɔwoo hom no n'enyim bogu ase: Hwɛ, ɔbɛyɛ amanaman mu ekyirkafo, sar, asaase kɛsɛɛ, na sar pradada.
Osian Ewuradze n'ebufuw ntsi wɔrenntsena do, na ɔbɛyɛ amamfõ koraa; obiara a otwa mu wɔ Babylon no no hobɔbow no, na ɔabɔ nhwiroma wɔ n'amandzehu nyinara ntsi.
Hom a hom kontom egyen nyinara, hom mbaa mpasuar ntwa nhyia Babylon ho; hom ntotow mbobɔ no, mma hom nnkam hom egyenmenaba do: Na ɔayɛ bɔn etsia Ewuradze.
Hom mbɔ se ngu no do ntwa nhyia; ɔdze noho ama; n'aban ahwehwe ase, n'afasu edwuruw; na Ewuradze n'awerdzi nye no; hom ndzi no wer; dɛ mbrɛ ɔayɛ no, hom so nyɛ no bi.

Hom ntwa duafo no mfi Babylon, na nyia osuo kantankrankye no mu wɔ twaber mu no: Ahyɛdo afõwa no ho suro ntsi, hɔn mu biara bɛdan noho akɔ no nkorɔfo hɔ, na hɔn mu obiara eguan akɔ nankasa n'asaase do.
Israel yɛ nguantsen a wɔabɔ apetse; ngyata no apam no kɔ; asɔpɔn no Assyriahen bɛtsetseew no mu; na ekyirii Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzer yi bobubuu ne mbiew mu.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hwɛ, mebɛtseēa hen na n'asaase, dɛ mbrɛ matsēa Assyriahen yi.
Na medze Israel bɛsan aba n'edzidzibea, na oedzidzi wɔ Carmel na Bashan, na me kra amee wɔ Ephraim akoko do na Gilead.
Nda no mu, na aber no mu, Ewuradze na ɔse, wɔbɔhwehwɛ Israel emumuyɛ ekyir kwan, na wonnkohu: Na medze befir hɔn a mebɛdan hɔn megya dɛ nkaasefo no.
Tu Merathaim asaase no do sa, ɔnora no do a, na Pekod atsefo no do: Kuku na sɛɛ nkaasefo no korakora, Ewuradze na ɔse, na yɛ dɛ mbrɛ mahyɛ wo nyinara.
Ɔkõ ne dede gyegye asaase no do, na ɔsɛɛ kɛse so dze.
Mbrɛ woetwitwa na woebubu asaase nyina hamɛr no mu esinesin a! Mbrɛ Babylon edua adan amamfõ wɔ amanaman mu a!
Babylon, mesua wo efir na wɔapa wo so, na ɔwoara ennhu: Woehu wo, na wɔakyer wo so, osiandɛ enye Ewuradze edzi aperper.
Ewuradze n'ebufuhyew akodze epue: Osiandɛ Ewuradze no, wɔ dwuma bi dzi wɔ Chaldeafo asaase do.
Hom mfir mfɛdzanan mbra no do, hom mbuebue n'eburosan no: Hom ntutu no ngu dɛ efiefi, na hom nsɛɛ no huntuhuntu: Mma hom mma no mu biribi nnka.
Hom nkuku n'anantwinyin nyina; hom mma wɔnsan nkɔ ekumii; wondue! Osiandɛ hɔn da edu, hɔn sera aber no a.
Hom ntsie hɔn a woguan na wofi nsa fi Babylon asaase do, dɛ wɔrekɛpaa mu akã Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn n'awerdzi, n'asɔrfi ho awerdzi akyerɛ no hɔn ndze.

Hom mfrɛ egyentofo no nyinara nkɔtoatoa Babylon, hɔn a wɔkontom egyen no nyinara; hom mbɔ nseraban ntwa no ho nhyia; mma hom mma no mu obiara mmfi nsa: Hom nsusu n'edwuma do nhyɛ no ananmu; dɛ mbrɛ ɔno ɔayɛ nyinara no, hom so nyɛ no bi: Osiandɛ ɔayɛ Ewuradze no do nkontompɔ, Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no do a.
Dɛm ntsi na ne mberantsɛ bɔtotɔ n'abrɔn do, na wɔbɛma ne mbarimba akofo nyinara wɔayɛ foõ wɔ da no mu, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hwɛ, ɔwo nkontompɔnyi, menye wo enya, Ewuradze, dɔm Ewuradze no na ɔse: Osiandɛ wo da no edu, ber a mebɛsera wo no a.
Na ɔkontompɔnyi no befintsiw na ɔahwe ase, na obiara remma no do: Na mubokūa gya wɔ no kurow no mu, na ɔahyew dza abɔ no ho aprɔw nyinara.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Wɔatseetsee Israelmba na Judah prɛko: Na hɔn a wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum nyina dzedze hɔn mu dzen; wɔpow dɛ wɔbɛma wɔakɔ.
Hɔn pomfo yɛ dzen; ne dzin dze dɔm Ewuradze: Obedzi hɔn asɛm kofekofe ama hɔn, na ɔama asaase no ahomgye, na ɔahyɛ Babylon atsefo no ahomtsew.
Afõwa wɔ Chaldeafo do, Ewuradze na ɔse, na Babylon atsefo no do, na n'asafohen do, na n'enyansafo no do.
Afõwa wɔ ahohyehyɛfo no do, na wɔbɛyɛ akwasampafo: Afõwa wɔ hɔn mbarimba akatakyi no do, na hɔn bo botutu.
Afõwa wɔ hɔn mpɔnkɔ do, na hɔn ntseaseanam do, na aforaforafo a wɔwɔ no mu no nyina do, na wɔbɛyɛ dɛ mbaa: Afõwa wɔ n'akoradze do, na wobowia.
Weseeyɛ wɔ n'esu do, na wɔbɔwewew: Na ɔyɛ esian ehonyi asaase, na wɔabobɔ adam wɔ abosom ho.
Dɛm ntsi sar do mbowa abɔyafo wɔnye nɛtsena hɔ, na nsohor bɛtsena mu: Na wɔrenntsena do bio dabiarada; eso wɔrenntsena do bio ofi ebusuasantsen kɛpem ebusuasuatsen.
Dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn butuuw Sodom na Gomorrah na hɔn ho nkurow no, Ewuradze na ɔse; dɛmara so na nyimpa biara rennyɛ ɔmamforanyi wɔ hɔ.
Hwɛ, ɔman bi fi kwaamu afamu reba; na wobekenyan ɔman kɛse, na ahemfo pii efi asaase ne mfɛndzenan noho.
Wokurakura egyen na peaa; hɔn tsir yɛ dzen, na wonnyi ehumbɔbɔr; hɔn ndze wor dɛ po, na wɔtsetse mpɔnkɔ do; obiara etwa mpasuar, dɛ ɔbarimba a ɔrokɔ akono wɔ wo do, Babylon babaa.
Babylonhen atse hɔn nka, na n'abaw eguru: Nketsenketse akyer no, na yaw a ɔtse dɛ ɔbaa a ɔwɔ awoko mu.

Hwɛ, ɔbɔfow dɛ gyata fi Jordan ne ntsɛn no mu abɛtsena bea a ɔyɛ dzen no do, na mebɛma woeguan efi me nkyɛn awerɛfir mu; na obiara a wɔasan mu eyi no no, ɔno na medze no besi no do: Na woana na ɔtse dɛ emi? na woana na ɔbɛhyɛ me mber? Na woana nye oguanhwɛfo no a obegyina m'enyim no?

Dɛm ntsi hom ntsie Ewuradze n'apam a ɔapam etsia Babylon no; na ne tsirmpɔw a ɔabɔ etsia Chaldeafo asaase no: Ampaara wobotwuw hɔn adze akɔ, mekyerɛ nguankuw hɔn nkakraba no; ampaara ɔbɛma hɔn tsenabea ayɛ amamfõ ama hɔn.
Babylon ne gye ne dede ntsi, asaase wosow, na wɔtse nkekamu no wɔ amanaman mu.
51: Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Hwɛ, mobɔbɔ ɔsɛɛ mframa aba Babylon do, na hɔn a wɔtse Leb-kamai do.
Na mobɔsoma ahɔho akɔ Babylon, na woekohuw no; na wɔbɔto n'asaase no pan: Na ɔfona da no mu wobotwa no ho ehyia etsia no.
Mma ogyentonyi no nnkontom n'egyen, na mma ɔmmema noho do wɔ ne dadzetar no mu: Na mma hom nngyaa ne mberantsɛ no; hom nsɛɛ no dɔm nyinara huntuhuntu.
Na wɔbɔtotɔ ahwehwe ase wɔ Chaldeafo asaase do, na woe hwirahwira hɔn mu wɔ n'abrɔn mu.
Na Israel anaa Judah hɔn Nyankopɔn, dɔm Ewuradze no, ɔnndaan hɔn nngyae; kaansa afɔdzi ahyɛ hɔn asaase do mã etsia Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no mpo a.
Hom nguan mfi Babylon mu, na nyimpa biara ngye noho nkwa; mma wonntwa hom nkyen wɔ n'emumuyɛ mu; na Ewuradze n'awerdziber nye no; obotua no n'ahyɛnanmu kaw no.
Babylon ayɛ sika kɔɔpow wɔ Ewuradze nsamu a ɔmaa asaase nyinara bowee: Amanaman anom ne nsã bi, dɛm ntsi na amanaman abobɔ adam.
Babylon ahwe ase awerɛfir mu asɛɛ: Hom ntwa ewuo mma no; hom mfa ne yaw n'ano edur mbra, bi a wɔsa no yarba a ɔbɛyɛ yie.
Nkyɛ yɛasa Babylon yarda dada, na ɔnnsae: Hom ndan no ngya, na hom mma hɛn mu biara nkɔ nankasa no kurow mu: Osiandɛ n'atsɛmbu edu ɔsor, na wɔama do ekodu wimu wimu mpo.
Ewuradze eyi hɛn tsenenee edzi: Hom mbra, ma yɛnkɛkã Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn n'edwuma nkyerɛ wɔ Zion.
Hom nsew egyen-menaba no ano; hom nsuo akokyɛm no mu dzen: Ewuradze ekenyan Media ahemfo hɔn sunsum; osiandɛ wɔabɔ Babylon ho tsirmpɔw dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ no: Na Ewuradze n'awerdzi, n'asɔrfi ho awerdzi nye no.
Hom nsi frankaa ntsia Babylon afasu, hom mma aweɔn mu nyɛ dzen, hom mfa aweɔmfo nsisi, hom nsiesie atsɛwfo: Na Ewuradze ahyehyɛ wɔ ne tsirmu, na eso ɔayɛ dza ɔkãe wɔ Babylon atsefo no bo no.
Ao ɔwo a etse esu pii do, w'akoradze dɔɔ sõ, w'ewiei aba, w'enyikaber esusudze no a.
Dɔm Ewuradze akã noho ntam, dɛ, ampaara medze nyimpa mebɛhyɛ wo mã, dɛ mbɛbɛw; na wɔabɔ wo do ose.
Ɔno na ɔdze no tum ayɛ asaase, ɔno na ɔdze ne nyansaa etsintsim wiadze, na ɔdze ne nteasee atserɛw ɔsorsor mu:
Sɛ ɔbɔ ne ndze mu a, esu no weɔɔyɛ ba ɔsorsor, na ɔma ehubɔhubɔw tu fi asaase ano fa sor; ɔno na ɔyɛ enyinam na nyankom, na ɔdze mframa fi n'adzekorabea ba.
Nyimpa biara abɛyɛ dɛ abowa na onnyim dze; osikadwinnyi biara ne sian-honyi hyɛ no enyito: Na no guhonyi yɛ ator, na ahom biara nnyi hɔn mu.
Wɔyɛ egyangyandze, ndaadaa dwuma a; hɔn seraber mu wɔbɛhera.
Jacob ne kyɛfa nntse dɛ iyinom; na ɔno nye adze nyinara ne yɛfo; na Israel nye n'egyapadze ebusuakuw; dɔm Ewuradze nye ne dzin.
Ɔno nye m'ekuma na m'akonda dze; na medze ɔwo mubobubu amanaman mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mebɛsɛɛ ahendzi;
na medze ɔwo mubobubu pɔnkɔ na nyia ɔtse no do no mu esinesin;

na medze ɔwo mubobubu tseaseanam na nyia ɔtse mu no mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mubobubu ɔbarimba ba ɔbaa mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mubobubu akɔdaa na abofra mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mubobubu aberantsɛ na ababaawa no mu esinesin;
na medze ɔwo mubobubu oguanhwɛfo na no nguankuw no mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mubobubu ɔnantwi na ne mpamho no mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mubobubu ambradofo na amampanyin no mu esinesin.
Na mubotua Babylon na Chaldea atsefo no nyinara kaw wɔ hɔn mbusu a wɔabɔ no hom enyim wɔ Zion no nyinara ho, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hwɛ, menye wo enya, bepɔw sɛɛfo, Ewuradze na ɔse, ɔwo esɛɛ asaase nyinara: Na mebɛtsen me nsa wɔ wo do, na mepirepirew wo mefi abotan no do, na mayɛ wo bepɔw hyewee.
Na wɔremmfa wo mu ɔbo bi nnto kutuwdo, anaa ɔbo bi nnto fapem; na ebɛyɛ amamfõ daa, Ewuradze na ɔse.

Hom nsi frankaa wɔ asaase no do, hom nhɛn akasamu no wɔ amanaman mu, hom nsiesie amanaman nkyer no ho sa, hom nhyia Arafat, Minni, na Ashkenaz ahendzi nyinara mbra no do; hom mfa mpɔnkɔ mbra dɛ abɛbɛw wirikyee.
Hom nsiesie amanaman ntu no do ɔsa, Media ahemfo hɔn ambradofo, na hɔn amampanyin nyinara, na no tumdzi asaase no nyinara.
Na asaase no ho popo na ɔtseetsee: Osiandɛ Ewuradze ne tsirmpɔw a ɔwɔ Babylon do no osi pi, dɛ ɔbɛyɛ Babylon amamfõ a ɔtsefo nnyi mu.
Babylon akatakyi no woegyaa kõ, wɔaka hɔn akoban no mu; hɔn ahoɔdzen apa; wɔayɛ dɛ mbaa; wɔato ne tsenebea mu ogya; woebubu n'adaban mu.
Mbirika ekehyia ɔbaako so akɔbɔ amandzɛɛ akyerɛ Babylonhen dɛ wɔagye no kurow no wɔ mbea nyinara:
Na wɔagye etwae no, na wɔdze ogya ahyew ndzɛmbir no, na mbarimba akofo no bo etutu.
Na mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Babylon babaa tse dɛ ewuporoweebea ber a wotsiatsia do no; aka kakra, ma twaber edu ama no.
Babylonhen Nebuchadrezzar awe me, ɔadwerew me, ɔayɛ me dɛ kuraba pan, ɔamen me dɛ dragon, ɔdze m’akɔndɔdze ahyɛ ne yafun mã; ɔatow me akyen.
Zion ɔtsefo bɛkã dɛ, Etsirmɔdzendze a wɔdze ayɛ emi na mo honam no ɔmbra Babylon do; na Jerusalem bɛkã dɛ, mo bɔgyaa ngu Chaldea atsefo do.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Hwɛ, mibedzi w’asɛm ama wo, na medzi wer ama wo; na mobɔwew no po, na mama no nsunyiwa ayɛ wesee.
Na Babylon bɛdan amamfõ, mpataku tsenabea, ahobowdze, na asesardze a ɔtsefo nnyi mu.
Hɔn nyinara bɔbobɔ mu awor dɛ ngyatafɔr; wɔbɔpɔw dɛ ngyatamba.
Sɛ hɔn ho hyehye hɔn a, mobɔto hɔn pon, na mama wɔabobow, na woedzi ehurusi, na wɔada nda prɛko, na wonnkenyan, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Medze hɔn besian dɛ nguambaa makɔ ekumii, dɛ ndwanyin ɔnye mpɔnkyenyin.
Mbrɛ woedua agye Sheshach a! na asaase nyina ayɛyi wɔfa no mprase a! Mbrɛ Babylon edua adan amamfõ wɔ amanaman mu a!
Po abɛseram Babylon do: N’asorɛkye dodow akɛtaa no do.
No nkurow adan afõ, asaase kɛsɛɛ, na sar, asaase a ɔdasanyi biara nntsena do, eso nyimpa ne ba biara nntwa mu wɔ hɔ.
Na mubobu atsɛn megu Be! do wɔ Babylon, na meyi dza ɔamemen no mefi n’anomu mepue; na amanaman nnkɔbɔ mu apem akɔ ne nkyɛn ara bio: Nyew, Babylon ɔfasu bɔhwe ase!
Me man, hom mfi no mu mfir, na hom mu nyimpa biara ngye noho mfi Ewuradze n’ebufuhyew mu.

Eso mma hom akoma nntu, eso mma hom nnsuro wɔ akwansosɛm a hom bɛtse wɔ asaase no do no ho; na akwansosɛm bɛba afe kor mu, na n’ekyir afe kor so mu akwansosɛm, na akatabansɛm aba asaase no do, nyia odzi turn oetsia nyia odzi tum.
Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, nda reba a mubobubu atsɛn megu Babylon sian-ehonyi do, na n'asaase no nyina n’enyi bɔtõ; na n'atɔfoe nyina bɔhwehwe ase wɔ ne finimfin.
Nna enyigye ntsi ɔsor na asaase, na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara botow Babylon ho ndwom na afofafo befi kwaamu afamu aba no do, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Dɛ mbrɛ, Babylon maa Israel atɔfo hwehwee ase no, dɛmara so Babylon na asaase nyina hɔn atɔfoe bɔhwehwe ase wɔ hɔ.
Hom a hom efi afõwa anomu hom nduom, na mma hom nngyina komm; hom mfi ekyirkyir nkaa Ewuradze, na hom mma Jerusalem mbra hom adwen mu.
Hɛn enyi atõ, osiandɛ yɛatse ahorohoraa nka; enyimguase akata hen enyim: Osiandɛ ananaben aba Ewuradze ne fie krɔnkrɔn-mbea no do.
Ɔno ntsi, hwɛ, nda reba a, Ewuradze na ɔse, mubobu ne sian-ehonyi nyina atsɛn; na epirafo besi nkrum wɔ n'asaase nyina do.
Sɛ Babylon fow kɔ sor mpo, na ɔkyekyer n’ahoɔdzen sorɔnsorɔmbea no akoban mpo a me nkyɛn ara na afofafo befir aba no do, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Nkekamu a ofi Babylon, na ɔsɛɛ kɛse a ofi Chaldeafo asaase do ne ndze na ɔda mu no!
Osiandɛ Ewuradze refa Babylon afo, na ɔma no mu ndze kɛse no sɛɛ fi mu; na hɔn asorɛkye wor dɛ esu pii na hɔn ndze gyegye huoo:
Na afofanyi no aba no do, Babylon do a, na wɔafa ne mbarimba akatakyi no, woebubu hɔn ngyen mu esinesin: Na Ewuradze yɛ ahyɛnanmu Nyankopɔn, tua ara na obotua kaw.
Na mebɛma n’asafohen na n’enyansafo, n’ambradofo na n’amampanyin na n’akatakyi no wɔabobow; na wɔbeda nda prɛko, na wonnkenyan, Ɔhen a ne dzin dze dɔm Ewuradze no na ɔse.

Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Babylon afasu atɛtɛr no, wobodwuruw no pasaa, na wɔdze ogya ahyew no mbobotsen atsentsen no; na ɔman no bɛberɛ ama egyangyandze, na amanaman no aberɛ ama ogya; na wɔbɔtɔ bahaw.
Asɛm a nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah dze hyɛɛ Mahseiah ba Neriah ne ba Seraiah, ber a ɔnye Judahhen Zedekiah kɔr Babylon wɔ n'ahendzi afe a otsia anan no mu nye yi. Afei na Seraiah yɛ gyaasehen.
Na Jeremiah kyerɛɛw mbusu a ɔbɛba Babylon do nyina hyɛɛ nwoma mu, mekyerɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Babylon ho yi nyina.
Na Jeremiah see Seraiah, dɛ, sɛ idu Babylon a, ɔno hwɛ na kenkan nsɛm yi nyina,
na se dɛ, Ewuradze, ɔwo na akasa bea yi ho dɛ ibotwa no akyen, amma obiara aanntsena mu, nyimpa o, abowa o, na mbom dɛ ɔnyɛ amamfõ ara daa.
Na ɔmbra dɛ sɛ iwie nwoma yi kenken a, fa ɔbo kyekyer ho, na tow kyen Euphrates mu:
Na kã dɛ, dɛm na Babylon bɔdɔ, na onnkopue bio wɔ mbusu a medze mebɛba do no ntsi: Na wɔbɔtɔ bahaw. Mbrɛ Jeremiah nsɛm pem nye ha
52: Zedekiah bedzii hen no nna oedzi hen mfe eduonu biako; na odzii hen mfe dubiako wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã dzin dze Hamutal, Jeremiah a ofi Libnah ne babaa a.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ Jehoiakim yɛe no nyinara.
Na ɔnam Ewuradze n’ebufuw do na ɔbaa dɛm wɔ Jerusalem na Judah, dze bodur dɛ ɔtoow hɔn fii n'enyim kyenee: Na Zedekiah tseew Babylonhen no do etūa.

Na ɔbaa dɛ n’ahendzi afe a otsia akron no mu no, bosoom a otsia du no, nna Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar botuaa Jerusalem, ɔno na no dɔm nyinara, na wɔkyeer do nsera; na wɔtoo w aban bɔɔ ho aprɔw tsiaa no.
Nna wotuaa kurow no kodur Ɔhen Zedekiah n'afe a otsia dubiako no.
Bosoora a otsia anan no mu, bosoom no ne nda akron no mu no, ɔkɔm yɛɛ dzendzenndzen wɔ kurow no mu ara, ma wonnyaa edziban biara mma asaase no do nkorɔfo no.

Nna wotuetuee kurow no ho, na mbarimba akofo no nyina guanguanee fi kurow no mu anago dze faa afasu ebien no ntamu, abobow kɛse no a ɔwɔ Ɔhen no ture no ho no kɔree; (afei na Chaldeafo etwa kurow no ho ehyia): Na wɔdze faa Arabah kwan no do kɔree.
Na Chaldeafo dɔm no tsiiw Ɔhen no, na wɔkɔtoo Zedekiah wɔ Jericho tɛtɛr mu; na no dɔm nyina fii ne nkyɛn petsee.
Nna wɔkyeer Ɔhen no, na wɔdze no kɛmaa Babylonhen wɔ Riblah a ɔwɔ Hamath asaase do no; na obuaa no atsɛn.
Na Babylonhen kum Zedekiah ne mbabanyin no wɔ n’enyim: Okunkum Judah asafohen nyinara so wo Riblah.
Na otutuu Zedekiah n’enyiwa; na Babylonhen dze no too mpokyerɛ mu. Na ɔdze no kɔr Babylon, na ɔdze no too efiadze kodur dɛ owui.

Afei bosoom a otsia enum no mu no, bosoom no ne dadu a ɔyɛ Ɔhen Nebuchadrezzar, Babylonhen no n’afe a otsia duakron no mu no, aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan a ogyina Babylonhen no n’enyim no, ɔbaa Jerusalem:
Na ɔhyeew Ewuradze ne fi na Ɔhen no ne fi; na Jerusalem efi nyinara, ofi kɛse biara mpo na ɔdze ogya hyeew no.
Na Chaldeafo dɔm a wɔka aweɔmfo safohen no ho nyinara dwuruuw Jerusalem afasu no nyina hyiae.
Nna aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan soaa ɔman no mu ehiafo neminemi no bi kɔr ndɔmmum, na ɔman no mu nkaa a wɔkaa kurow no mu, na awaafo a wɔwaae kɔr Babylonhen nkyɛn na nyimpadodow no mu nkaa no.
Na aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan daan asaase no mu ehiafo neminemi no bi gyae dɛ wɔnyɛ wenyin tureahwɛfo na ekuafo.
Na boran edura no a ɔwɔ Ewuradze fie no, na ngyinado na boran do a ɔwɔ Ewuradze fie no, Chaldeafo no bubuu mu esinesin, na wɔsoaa boran a ɔwɔ ho no nyina kɔr Babylon.
Nsenaba so, na nsofi, na edumgya, na mbɛɛsen, na ntser, na boran nkuraba a wɔdze som nyina, wɔfae kɔree.
Na nkɔɔpow, na ogyaasɛn, na mbɛɛsen, na nsenaba, na nkandzeadua, na ntser, na nkuraba; dza ɔyɛ sika dze no, wɔ sika mu, dza ɔyɛ dwetɛ dze no, wɔ dwetɛ mu, na aweɔmfo safohen no fae kɔree.
Edum ebien, po kor no, na boran anantwi duebien a ɔwɔ ngyinado no a Ɔhen Solomon yɛe maa Ewuradze fi no n’ase no: Nkuraba yinom nyinara no boran no woenntum ennker.
Na ɔyɛ edum no dze, odum kor no krɔn yɛ basafa duawɔtwe; na ahoma basafa duebien twa ho hyia; na ne peperepee nsatseaba anan: Na tu da mu.
Na ne tsir no boran a; na tsir kor no kron yɛ basafa enum, na atena na pomegranate-ekutu wɔ tsir no bo hyia, ne nyinara boran a: Na odum a otsia ebien no, no ho wo dɛmara bi, na pomegranaft-ekutu so.
Na pomegranate-ekutu eduokron esia wɔ afã na afã; na pomegranate-ekutu a ɔwɔ atena no ho hyia nyina yɛ ɔha.
Na aweɔmfo safohen no faa ɔsɔfopayin Seraiah, na ɔsɔfo edziekyir Zephaniah, na abowanoahwɛfo baasa:

Na kurow no mu na ɔfaa ɔpanyin a wɔdze no sii mbarimba akofo no do; na hɔn a wohun Ɔhen no enyim, beesuon a wohun hɔn wɔ kurow no mu no; na ɔsahen ne kyerɛwnyi a ɔpon asaase no do nkorɔfo kɔ ɔsa; na asaase no do nkorɔfo no mu mbarimba eduasia a wohun hɔn kurow no mu no.
Na aweɔmfo afohen Nebuzaradan faa hɔn, dze hɔn kɛmaa Babylonhen wɔ Ribiah.
Na Babylonhen bobɔɔ hɔn, na okunkum hɔn wɔ Ribiah a ɔwɔ Hamath asaase do no do. Dɛm na wɔfaa Judah ndɔmmum fii n'asaase do kɔree.
Nkorɔfo a Nebuchadnezzer soaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree no nye woyinom: Afe a otsia esuon no mu Judahfo mpensa eduonu ebiasa:
Nebuchadnezzer n'afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu no ɔsoaa nyimpa ahaawɔtwe eduasa ebien ndɔmmum fii Jerusalem:
Nebuchadnezzer n'afe a otsia eduonu ebiasa no mu na aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan soaa Judahfo ahaesuon eduanan enum ndɔmmum kɔree: Nyimpa nyinara wɔyɛ mpemanam ahaesia.

Na ɔbaa dɛ Judahhen Jehoiachin no ndɔmmumkɔ afe a otsia eduasa esuon no mu, bosoom a otsia duebien no mu, bosoom no ne da a otsia eduonu enum no mu, na Babylonhen Eyil-merodach, n'ahendzi afe a odzi kan no mu, ɔmaa Judahhen Jehoiachin ne tsir do, na oyii no fii efiadze puei;
na ɔnye no kasaa kasa pa, na ɔmaa n'akɔngua kyɛɛn ahemfo a wɔnye no wɔ Babylon no hɔn akɔngua.

Na ɔsesaa n'efiadzenda atar no, na odzidzii wɔ n'enyim daa akɔhomabɔdze no, wɔdze ne daa akɔhomabɔdze no maa no fii Babylonhen no ne nkyɛn, da biara n'afamudze wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu, dze kodur no wu da.

1: Ɔbarimba bi wo Uz asaase do anedzin dze Job; na ɔbarimba no dzi mu na ɔtsen, na obi a osuro Nyankopon na okyir bɔn a.
Na wɔwoo mbabanyin beesuon na mbabaa baasa maa no.
N’ahodze so yɛ nguan mpemesuon na efumpɔnkɔ mpemebiasa, na anantwi mpamho ahaenum, na nsoasober ahaenum, na fidua kɛsenara; ma dɛm ntsi barimba yi na ɔyɛ ɔkɛse wɔ boka mba no nyinara mu.
Na ne mbabanyin no kɔ kɔto pon wɔ ɔbaako biara ne fie wɔ ne da mu; na wɔsoma ma wɔkɛfrɛfrɛ hɔn nkyerɛbaa baasa no ma wɔba dɛ wɔnye hɔn mbedzidzi na wɔnnom.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ hɔn aponto nda no kɔ aprɔw wie a, nna Job asoma ma wɔakɛtsew hɔnho, na ɔsoɛr ahanamakye, na ɔkɔbɔ hyew-afɔr dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nyinara hɔn dodow tse: Na Job see dɛ, annyɛ a me mba no ayɛ bɔn, na wɔapow Nyankopɔn wɔ hɔn akonia mu. Dɛm na Job yɛɛ no daa.
Afei da bi wɔ hɔ a Nyame mba no bae beyii hɔnho edzi wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na Satan so dzi hɔn mu bae.
Na Ewuradze see Satan dɛ, ehen na ifi reba yi? Nna Satan buaa Ewuradze na ɔsee dɛ, mifi asaase do akɔnaabadzi na no do apasapasar mu na mereba.
Na Ewuradze see Satan dɛ, ana adwen m’akowaa Job ho a? Na obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔno wɔ asaase no do, ɔbarimba a odzi mu na ɔtsen, obi a osuro Nyankopɔn na okyir bɔn a.
Nna Satan buaa Ewuradze, na ɔsee dɛ, aso gyan ara na Job suro Nyankopɔn?
Ana nnyɛ ɔwoara na abɔ ɔno, na ne fi, na dza ɔwɔ nyinara ho ban ehyia bi a? Ɔwo ehyira ne nsaano edwuma do, na n'ahodze adɔɔ sõ wɔ asaase no do.
Na afei tsen wo nsa kã dza ɔwɔ nyinara, kyerɛ dɛ ɔnnkɔdom wo w’enyim.
Na Ewuradze see Satan dɛ, hwɛ, dza ɔwɔ nyinara wɔ wo nsamu; ɔno noara nko no do mma mmfa wo nsa nnto. Nna Satan fii Ewuradze enyim kɔree.
Na ɔbaa da bi dɛ aber a ne mbabanyin no na ne mbabaa no woridzidzi na wɔronom nsã wɔ hɔn nua panyin no fie no,
nna ɔbɔfo bi baa job nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, anantwi no rufuntum, na nsoaso no so ridzidzi wɔ hɔn nkyɛn:
Na Sabeafo ebotu ahyɛ hon do, na wɔafa hɔn kɔ; nyew, wɔdze afõwa ano ekuku nkowaa no; na emi ara nkotoo korɛ na mefi nsa dɛ merebɛkã makyerɛ wo.
Aber a n'ano da do rekasa no, nna fofor so bae, na ɔsee dɛ, Nyame gya fi sor atɔ, na ɔabɛhyew nguan no, na nkowaa no, na ɔamen hɔn; na emi ara nkotoo korɛ na mefi nsa dɛ merebɛkã makyerɛ wo.

Aber a n'ano da do rekasa no, nna fofor so bae, na ɔsee dɛ, Chaldeafo abɔ kuw ebiasa, na woebotu ahyɛ efumpɔnkɔ no do, na wɔafa hɔn kɔ, nyew, wɔdze afõwa ano ekuku nkowaa no; na emi ara nkotoo korɛ na mefi nsa dɛ merebɛkfã makyerɛ wo.
Aber a n’ano da do rekasa no, nna fofor so bae na ɔsee dɛ, wo mbabanyin no na wo mbabaa no woridzidzi na wɔronom nsã wɔ hɔn nua panyin no fie:
Na, hwɛ, mframa kɛse fi sar no do aba na ɔabɔbɔ dan no n’etwaanan no, ma ebu egu mberantsɛ no do, na woewuwu; na emi nkotoo korɛ na mefi nsa, dɛ merebɛkã makyerɛ wo.
Nna Job soɛree, na ɔtsetseew n’atar mu, na oyii ne tsir, na otwae hwee famu, na ɔkotowee:
Na ɔsee dɛ, adagyaw na medze mifi me nayamumebae. Na adagyaw na medze mbɛsan makɔ hɔ: Ewuradze dze mae, na Ewuradze afa ko: Nhyira nka Ewuradze dzin.
Iyi nyinara mu no Job annyɛ bɔn, na so oemmbu nkwaseadze amma Nyame.
2: Na da bi baa bio a Nyame mba no bae dɛ wɔrebɛda hɔnho edzi wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na Satan so dzi hɔn mu bae dɛ ɔrebɛda noho edzi wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na Ewuradze see Satan dɛ, ehen na in reba yi? Na Satan buaa Ewuradze, na ɔsee dɛ, mifi asaase akɔnaaba dzi, na no do apasapasar mu na mereba.

Na Ewuradze see Satan dɛ, ana adwen m’akowaa Job ho a? Na obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔno wɔ asaase no do, ɔbarimba a odzi mu na ɔtsen, obi a osuro Nyankopɔn, na okyir bɔn a: Na ɔda ho ara dze n’emudzi no mu, kaansa ɔwo enunu me etsia no dɛ mensɛɛ no kwa.
Na Satan buaa Ewuradze, na ɔsee dɛ, wer hyɛ wer ananmu, nyew, dza nyimpa wɔ nyinara ɔdze ma per no nkwa.
Na afei tsen wo nsa, na kã ne biew na no honam, kyerɛdɛ ɔnnkɔdom wo wo w’enyim.
Na Ewuradze see Satan dɛ, hwɛ, ɔwɔ wo nsamu; ne kra nko na gyaa no.
Nna Satan fii Ewuradze enyim kɔree, na ɔdze mpɔmpɔ yayaayaw kɔbobɔɔ Job fi n’ananadze kodu n’etsifi pampamu.
Na ɔfaa tankofeɛ bi dɛ ɔdze rotwerɛw noho; na ɔtse nso mu.
Nna ne yer see no dɛ, ana eda ho dze w’emudzi mu ara? Dom Nyame, na wu.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, ɔwo ekasa dɛ mbrɛ mbaa egyangyantwi no mu bi kasa. Ebɛna? Aso yɛngye Nyame ne nsamu adze pa, na adze bɔn na mma yɛnngye anaa? Iyi nyinara mu no Job ammfa n’anofamfa annyɛ bɔn.

Afei aber a Job ne mfɛfo baasa tsee mbusu a ɔaba no doyi nyinara no, nna hɔn mu obiara fi nankasa ne tsenabew bae; Temannyi Eliphaz, na Shuhinyi Bildad, na Naamathnyi Zophar; na wobehyiaa dɛ woribegyam no na wɔaakyekye no werɛ.
Na aber a wɔmemaa hɔn enyi do wɔ ekyirkyir, na woennhu no no, nna wɔmemaa hɔn ndze do sūi; na hɔn mu obiara tsetseew n'atar mu, na wɔtotoow huntuma wɔ sor guguu hɔn etsifi.
Nna wɔnye no tsena famu hɔ nda esuon, adzekyee na adze saa, na obiara annkã no asɛm bi: Na wohun dɛ n'awerɛhow no sõ dodow.
3: Iyi n'ekyir no Job buee n'ano, na ɔdoom ne da.
Na Job buae see dɛ.
Wɔmma da a wɔwoo me wɔ mu no nhera, na anago a wɔsee dɛ, woenyinsen babanyin no.
Wɔmma da no nyɛ sum; mma mma Nyankopɔn mmfi sor mmbisa ekyir kwan, nkyii so mma kan nnhyerɛn wɔ do.
Wɔmma sum na wu no nwinwin ngye nyɛ hɔnankasa hɔndze; wɔmma mununkum ntsena do; wɔmma dza ɔhyɛ adzekyee sum nyinara nyi no hu.
Na adzesaa no dze, wɔmma sum kebii nkitsa no: Mma mma ɔmmba abosoom no dodow mu.
Hwɛ, wɔmma anago no nyɛ kɔnn; mma mma ehurusi ndze mmba mu.
Wɔmma hɔn a wɔdom da wɔndom no, hɔn a wɔaben dɛ wopusuw dɛnkyɛmnyin no.
Wɔmma adansaber nworaba nhyɛ sum: Wɔmma ɔntweɔn kan, na mma onnya bi; nkyii so mma onnhu adzekyee enyisoatsɛw:
Osiandɛ ɔanntow me nã n'awotoa abow no mu, na ɔammfa awerɛhow ennhuntsa m'enyi so.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mennwu wɔ awotoa mu? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na menngyaa mo sunsum me aber a mifi yafun mu firii no?
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na anankoroma gyee me? Anaa ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na motoo enumfo na munumii?
Na nkyɛ sisei meda hɔ mayɛ komm; nkyɛ mada; ɔnodze nkyɛ menya ahomgye:
Menye ahemfo na asaase do apamfo a, wɔkyekyer amamfõ ma hɔnho no;
Anaa menya mbapɔmba a wɔwɔ sika a, wɔdze dwetɛ hyehyɛ hɔn efiefi amaama:
Anaa metse dɛ ɔpon-ba a wɔakora no a nkyɛ minnyi hɔ; dɛ nkɔkowaba a wonnhun kan pɛn.
Ehɔ na nyimpa bɔn gyaa haw; na hɔ na hɔn a wɔaberɛ: Wɔhom.
Ehɔ na adaduafo nyinara hɔn ho dwe hɔn; wɔnntse bɔmbaanyi ndze.
Ehɔ na nkakraba na akɛse wɔ; na nkowaa dzi noho fi no wura nsamu.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔdze kan ama nyia ɔwɔ awerɛhow mu, na wɔdze nkwa ama hɔn a hɔn kra mu ayɛ wenwen;
hɔn a hɔn kɔn dɔ wu, na ɔmmba; na wɔbor hwehwɛ no kyɛn egyapadze a ohuntsa;
hɔn a hɔn enyi gye mbordo, na hɔn ho sɛpɛw hɔn, dɛ wobenya adakamaa?
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔdze kan amanyimpa a wɔdze no nkwa ehuntsa, na Nyankopɔn abɔ no ho ban?
Na m’apensi ebedzi m’edziban ananmu, na mo sufrɛ hue gu dɛ nsu.
Na adze a musuro aba mo do, na dza n’akoma tu wɔ ho ato me.
Minnya ahodwe, nkyii so mennyɛ komm, nkyii sominnya ahomgye; mbom ahoguan ara na ɔba.
4: Nna Temannyi Eliphaz buae see dɛ.
Sɛ obi sɔ hwɛ dɛ ɔnye wo bedzi nkɔmbɔ a, ɔbɛyɛ wo ahomtsew anaa? Naaso woano na obotum akam noho wɔ kasa ho?
Hwɛ, ɔwo etu dodowara fo, na ɔwo ahyɛ nsa a agow dzen,
Wo nsɛm ama nyia ɔrohwe ase egyina, na ɔwo ahyɛ anankoroma a egura no dzen,
Na afei ato wo yi dze, na ɔwo atɔ bahaw, enya akã wo yi, na wo bo tu.
Ana nnyɛ wo Nyame suro nye w'awerɛhyɛmu, na w'enyidado nye w'akwan n'emudzii?
Meserɛ wo, kaã, woana na odzi bem na ɔahera pɛn? Anaa ehen na woetwa atseneneefo egu?
Dɛ mbrɛ menya nhunii, hɔn a wofuntum emumuyɛ, na wodua mbusu no, ɔnoara so na wobu.
Nyankopɔn n'ahomgu ma wɔhera, na n'ebufuw mframa ma wɔhyew.
Gyata no pɔw, na gyata bɔyafo ne ndze, na ngyata eburwa hɔn sē ebubu.
Afonam abɔ gyata ntsi ɔahera, na gyataber ne mba abɔ apetse
Afei wɔdze asɛm bi baa me nkyɛn nsumaa mu, na m'aso tsee no ho wasawasa bi.
Adwendwen a ofi anago enyidoadzehu mu mu, Aber a nda heii atɔ nyimpa do no,
Suro na ahopopo baa mo do a ɔmaa me mbiew nyinara wosowee.
Nna sunsum twaa mu wɔ m'enyim; mo ho nhwi soɛree gyinagyinae.
Ogyinaa hɔ komm, naaso mennhu no su; suban bi gyinagyinaa m'enyi do. Ehɔ yɛɛ dzinn, na metsee ndze bɔkɔɔ bi, see dɛ,
ana dasanyi bɛtsen asen Nyankopɔn? Ana nyimpa ho bɛtsew asen ne yɛfo?
Hwɛ, no nkowaa mpo ɔmmfa werɛ nnhyɛ hɔn mu; na n'abɔfoe no ɔdze nkwaseasɛm dze du hɔn;
na menndze hɔn a wɔtse dɛtse adan mu a, hɔn fapem wɔ huntuma mu a, wɔfetsew hɔn dɛ abowaba?
Ana wɔnntsew hɔn asese-homa wɔ hɔn mu? Wowuwu, na nnyɛ nyansa mu bi a.
5: Afei frɛ, kyerɛ obi wɔ hɔ a obobua wo? Na ahotseweefo mu woana na edze bɛkɛdan no?
Osiandɛ ehisɛm ku kwasea, na nyinkuntwe ku kotobonyi.
Muhun kwasea dɛ ɔregye ndwow: Na amonmu ara na modoom ne tsenabew
Ne mba nye nkwagye ntamu twe, na wɔpɔtɔw hɔn wɔ kuropon mu, nkyii so obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔgye hɔn so.
Nyia ɔkɔm dze no bedzi no ndɔbaa, na nsoɛ mu mpo na obeyi efi, na efir da hɔ petoo dze ma hɔn ahodze.
Na ahohia mmfi huntuma mu mmfi, nkyii so fona mmfi famu mmfifir;
Na wɔwo nyimpa ma fona, dɛ mbrɛ gyansenamba tutu fa sor.
Na emidze, mobɔhwehwɛ Nyame ekyir kwan, na medze m’asɛm mahyɛ Nyame nsa:
Ɔno a ɔyɛ ndzɛmba akɛse a onnyi nhwehwɛmu; anwanwadze a onnyi anobu:
Ɔno a ɔma nyankom tɔ gu asaase do, na ɔma nsu gugu ahaban do:
Na ɔdze hɔn a wɔbrɛ adze esisi mbrɛ ɔkrɔn; na hɔn a wodzi nkɔmbɔ no asoɛr kɔ eyiedzi mu.
Ɔno na ɔma enyitseweefo adwenadwen yɛ kwa, ma hɔn nsa nntum nnyɛ hɔn esusudze.
Ɔno na ɔkyer enyansafo wɔ hɔnankasa hɔn enyitsew mu; na osi nkontompɔfo apam tsir adze.
Wotɔ sum mu ewiaber, na wɔkekã ewiaketee dɛ anago.
Na ɔno na ɔgye nkwa fi afõwa a ofi hɔn anomu no ano, mekyerɛ kɔhweaban no fi katakyi no nsamu.
Dɛm ntsi hianyi no wɔ enyidado, na emumuyɛ mua n’ano.
Hwɛ, homkanyi nye nyimpa a Nyankopɔn kã n’enyim: Dɛm ntsi mma mmbu otumfo ne ntsēa no enyimtsia.
Na ɔtow kam, na ɔkyekyer; Opira, na ne nsa ma ɔsã.
Obeyi wo wɔ ahohia esia mu; nyew, dza otsīa esuon no mu mpo mbusu bi rennkã wo.
Akɔmfun mu ɔbɛgye wo efi wu mu; na akodzi mu so ɔagye wo efi afõwa ano;
Obohuntsa wo efi tɛkyerɛma mpire ano; nkyii so irunnsuro ɔsɛɛ a ɔreba.
Ebɛserew sɛɛ na kɔm; nkyii so irunnsuro asaase do mbowadoma.
Na enye haban mu abo bɛyɛ nkyekyeree; na haban mu mbowadoma nye wo benya asomdwee.
Na ibohu dɛ w'asesee wɔ asomdwee mu; na ebɛsera wo nguamban, na erennyew hwee.
Ibohu so dɛ w’asefo adɔɔ sõ, na wo mbanananom bɛyɛ dɛ asaase do nkyɛkyɛr.
Edze mfe dodow ebɔkɔ w’adakamaa mu, dɛ mbrɛ wɔdze ewi efiefi ba wɔ ne ber mu no.
Hwɛ, iyi na yɛahwehwɛ ehu, mbrɛ ɔtse nye yi; tsie, na ɔwo so hu fa ma woho.
6: Nna Job buae see dɛ,
ao, kɛtseankyɛ woeeker m’awerɛhow, na wɔdze m’amandzehu eegu nsɛn mu!
Na afei nkyɛ ɔbɛyɛ dur asen mpoano anhwea: Dɛm ntsi na me nsɛm ayɛ yerɛyerɛw.
Na Otumfo no n’egyen-menaba tuatua mo mu, mo sunsum ronom no mu bor: Nyankopɔn ho hu aba mo do mpasuar.
Ana hamu asoaso paapaa mu aber a ɔwɔ efunoma? Anaa nantwi bobɔ mu sū wɔ n’aforafora edziban do?
Anaa edziban tabrabaa wokwetsi nkyen dzi? Anaa dɛw bi wo nkyirefuwa mu fufuw mu?
Me kra pow dɛ ɔdze nsa bɛkã; ɔtse dɛ edziban a ɔyɛ nkɔw dze ma me.
Ao, kɛtseankyɛ meenya m’ebisadze; na nkyɛ Nyankopɔn dze adze a mo kɔn dɔ no aama me.
Sɛ Nyankopɔn bɛpɛ dɛ ɔdwerew me; na ogyaa ne nsamu, na otwa me kyen mpo a!
Ɔno nkyɛ mibenya awerɛkyekyer ara; nyew, nkyɛ mibedzi ehurusi wɔ yaw a ɔnnkam noho: Na minnsiiw Krɔnkrɔnnyi kor no ne nsɛm do.
M’ahoɔdzen nye bɛn, dɛ medze mobɔtweɔn? Na m’ewiei nye bɛn, dɛ mebɛyɛ ho abotar?
Ana m’ahoɔdzen yɛ abo ahoɔdzen? Anaa mo honam yɛ boran?
Ana nnyɛ mboa bi na minnyi no wɔ mo mu, na woetu nyansa pa efi mo mu koraa?
Nyia ɔrotɔ bitsi ɔsɛ dɛ onya ne nyɛnko nsamu ayamuyie; mekyerɛ nyia ɔpow Otumfo no no suro no.
Mo nuanora etwa nkontompɔ dɛ ɔwora, dɛ sukã mu nwora a ɔsen twa mu kɔ a
Nsudaa ntsi n’enyi ebir, na esukwankyɛba suma noho wɔ mu:
Mber a ɔhyew kã no no, ɔhera: Ahohur ber mu ɔsã wɔ n’ananmu.
Akwantsemfo a wodua n’akwan mu dan fa nkyɛn: Wɔkɔ framfram no mu, na wɔhera.
Tema akwantsemfo no hwehwɛe. Sheba akwantsemfo ekuwekuw no dze enyi too do.
Hɔn enyi wui dɛ wɔdze hɔn enyi too do; wokodur hɔ, na hɔn enyim guu ase.
Na afei hom nnyɛ hwee; hom hu ehuyidze, na hom suro.
Ana mase dɛ, hom mma me biribi? Anaa, emi ntsi hom mfa hom ahodze mu bi nkyɛ?
Anaa, hom ngye me mfi ɔyɛfo nsamu? Anaa, hom mpon me mfi ahyɛdofo nsamu?
Hom nkyerɛkyerɛ me, na mubomua m’ano: Na hom mma munhu dza mafom wɔ mu.
Mbrɛ nsɛm tsenenee dua na ɔyɛ dzen a: Na hom atsɛnyiyi yi dze otwuw ebɛnadze enyim?
Ana hom susu dɛ wobotwuw nsɛm enyim? Ofir dɛ nyia n’enyi aber no ne nsɛm tse dɛ mframa.
Nyew, hom twe tonto wɔ egyanka do, na hom dze hom nyɛnko yɛ eguadze.
Dɛm ntsi afei hom mpɛ dɛ wɔbɛgyen enyi ahwɛ me; Na ampaara mirinndzi ator wɔ hom enyim.
Meserɛ hom, hom nsan, mma mma ntɛnkyew bi mmba; nyew, hom nsan bio, m’asem tsen.
Ana ntɛnkyew bi wɔ me gyirama do? Ana m’adzesɔ nntum nnhu ebusudze mu?
7: Ana akodzi bi nnyi hɔ mma dasanyi wɔ asaase do? Na ne nda nntse dɛ paanyi nda bi a?
Dɛ mbrɛ akowaa hwehwɛ nwinwin enyiberdo, na dɛ mbrɛ paanyi hwɛ n’apaabɔdze no:
Dɛmara so na wɔama menya abosoom gyangyan, na wɔahyehyɛ berɛ anago dze ama me.
Sɛ mekɛda hɔ a, mese dɛ, aber bɛn na mobɔsoɛr? Na adzesaa mu atwe; na adafatwitwa fon me dze kodu enyimtsetsewee.
Mo honam fura mbowaba na dɛtse atɔwatɔw; mo wer twintwam na otuetue fofor.
Me nda ho yɛ har sen ɔwemfo n’akrokroba, na ɔhwer dɛ enyidado bi nnyi ho.
Ao, kaa dɛ mo nkwa yɛ mframa: M’enyiwa runnhu papa bio.
Nyia ohu me n’enyiwa ronnhwɛ me bio: W’enyiwa bɛba mo do, na minnyi hɔ.
Dɛ mbrɛ mununkum sã na ɔhera no, dɛmara so na nyia osian kɔ Sheol rommfow mmba bio.
Ɔrennsan mmba ne fie bio, nkyii so ne tsenabew runnhu no bio.
Dɛm ntsi mirinnsiw m’ano kwan, mebɛkasa wɔ mo sunsum n’ahoguan mu;
ana meyɛ po, anaa po mu abowapɔn, ma ɔwo edze aweɔmfo sisi mo do?
Sɛ mese dɛ, me mpa bɛkyekye mo werɛ, m’adae bɔdwedwe mo nkɔmbɔdzi no a;
Nna ɔwo edze adaaso riyi me hu. Na enam enyido-adzehu mu robɔ me piriw:
Ma me kra pɛ menebabɔ, na wu mbom sen me mbiew.
Mo nkwa afon me; memmpɛ dɛ metsena ase daa; gyaa me; na me nda yɛ egyan-gyandze.
Dasanyi nye woana na ɔwo ihuhor no, na ɔwo edze w’akoma si no do,
Na ɔwo esera no anapa nyinara, na esɔ no hwɛ aber nyinara?
Ɔwo rinnyi w’enyi mmfi mo do ara ma ekodu dabɛn, na eso irinngyaa me ma ekodu dɛ mamen me ntafi?
Sɛ mayɛ bɔn a, ebɛnadze na mayɛ wo, ɔwo nyimpa weɔmfo? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edze me esi hɔ dɛ wo botae, ma mayɛ adzesoa mama moho?
Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na emmfa me mbrato nnkyɛ, na innyi m’emumuyɛ nnkɔ? Na afei mebɛda huntuma mu; na ɔwo bɔhwehwɛ me enyiberdo, na minnyi hɔ.
8: Nna Shuhinyi Bildad buae, na ɔsee dɛ,
Aber bɛn na ebɛkã iyinom ekodu? Na aber bɛn na w’anomu nsɛm bɛyɛ dɛ mframa dzendzen ekodu?
Ana Nyame kyeakyea atsɛmbu? Anaa Otumfo no bɛkyea pɛrpɛr.
Sɛ wo mba ayɛ bɔn etsia no, na oegyaa hɔn ahyɛ hɔn mbrato nsamu a:
Sɛ ɔwoara hwehwɛ Nyame ekyir kwan enyiberdo, na edze wo ntotɔserɛ kyere Otumfo no a;
sɛ wo ho tsew na etsen a; ampa nkyɛ afei obekenyan noho ama wo, na ɔama wo tsenenee tsenabew ayɛ prɔmprɔm.
Na kaansa w'ahyɛse yɛ kakraba mpo a, w'ewiei bɔdɔɔ sõ kɛsenara.
Meserɛ wo, bisa tsetse mpanyin, na ma w'enyi mbra dza hɔn egyanom ahwehwɛ mu ehu no do:
(Na hɛndze yefi ndeda yi ara, yennyim hwee, osiandɛ hɛn nda tse dɛ nwinwin wɔ asaase do
Ana nnyɛ hɔn na wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo, na wɔakã akyerɛ wo, na woeyiyi nsɛm efi hɔn akoma mu?
Ana ntɔn begyina mbrɛ atɛkyɛ nnyi? Ana atsen begyina mbrɛ nsu nnyi?
Mber a ɔda ho wɔ no frɔmfrɔmyɛ mu a wonntwae nnkyenee no, ɔkyenkyen ansaana efuw biara akyenkyen:
Mbrɛ hɔn a hɔn werɛ fir Nyankopɔn nyinara hɔn akwan tse nye no; na nyaatwomnyi a n’enyidado bɛhera:
N’enyidado botwitwa, na no werɛhyɛmu tse dɛ anansetotuan.
Ɔbɔtwer ne dan, na orinngyina: Obosuo mu dzen, na ɔronnko hɔ.
Ɔyɛ frɔmfrɔm wɔ ewia enyim, na n’abaw toto kata no ture do.
No ndwow mantamanta abo kuw ho, ɔhen abo ntamu mpo.
Sɛ wɔsɛɛ no wɔ ne tsenabew a, ɔno ɔbɛpa no, dɛ, munnhun wo.
Hwɛ, no kwan ahosɛpɛw nye yi, na asaase no mu na fofor fi befifir.
Hwɛ, Nyame ronntow nyimpa a odzi mu nnkyen, nkyii so orunnsuo ebusuyɛfo no mu nngyina.
Ɔdze serew ara bɛhyɛ w’anomu mã, na ɔdze esebɔ ahyɛ w’anofamfa mu.
Hɔn a wokyir wo bofura enyito; na nyimpa bɔn asesee ronnko hɔ bio.
9: Nna Job buae na ɔsee dɛ,
nokwar ara, minyim dɛ ɔtse dɛm: Na dasanyi bɛyɛ dɛn atsen wɔ Nyame enyim?
Sɛ ɔpɛ dɛ ɔnye no yiyi ano a, orunntum mmbua no apem kor mpo.
Ɔyɛ nyansafo wɔ akoma mu, katakyi wɔ ahoɔdzen mu: Woana na ɔakye no kɔn wɔ no do, na oewie yie?
Ɔno na otutu mbepɔw, na wonnyim, aber a obutuw hɔn wo n’ebufuw mu no.
Ɔno na ɔwosow asaase fi ne sibew, na n’edum ho popo.
Ɔno na ɔhyɛ ewia, ma ommpue; na ɔsosɔw nworaba ano.
Ɔno nko na ɔtserɛw ɔsor mu, na otsiatsia po asorɛkye do.
Ɔno na ɔyɛɛ ɔbɔɔ-nda-esuon, etsekwagyan, na aberwa-namba, na pomu afamu mpia no.
Ɔno na ɔyɛ ndzɛmba akɛse a ɔtra nhwehwɛmu; nyew, ndzɛmba nwanwa a onnyi anobu.
Hwɛ, ɔnam me nkyɛn sen, na munnhu no: Otwa mu kɔ so, na mennhyɛ no nsew.
Hwɛ, okukur afonam no, woana na ɔbɛsan no ekyir? Woana na ɔbɛse no dɛ, ebɛnadze na ereyɛ yi?
Nyankopɔn ronntwe n’ebufuw nnsan; Rahab aboafo brɛ hɔnho adze wɔ n’ase.
Na burbur ayɛ dɛ emi na mubobua no; na mibeyiyi me nsɛm dɛ menye no bɛsensan?
Ɔno na sɛ metsen mpo a, nkyɛ murummbua no; mibedzi ntotɔserɛ akyerɛ me tamfo.
Sɛ mefrɛ na ɔgye me do mpo a; nkyɛ merenngye nndzi dɛ ɔayɛ aso ama me ndze.
Osiandɛ ɔdze ehum pusuw me, na ɔma m’epirakur dɔɔ sõ ara kwa.
Ɔremma me kwan ma munngu ahom, na ɔdze bɔwema ahyɛ me matɔ.
Sɛ yɛrekã no akatakyi ahoɔdzen do a, hwɛ, ɔwɔ hɔ! Na sɛ atsɛmbua so do a, nkyɛ woana bɛhyɛ me mber?
Sɛ metsen mpo a, nkyɛ mankasa m’ano bobu me fɔ: Sɛ midzi mu mpo a, ɔbɛma makyea.
Midzi mu; mummbu moho bi, mo nkwa afon me.
Ne nyinara kor; dɛm ntsi na mese dɛ, ɔsee nyia odzi mu, na dzebɔnyɛnyi no.
Sɛ mpire no kum awerɛfirmu a, osi hɔn a wodzi bem hɔn amandzehu atwetwe.
Wɔdze asaase ahyɛ nyimpa bɔn nsa: Ɔno na ɔkatakata n’atsɛmbuafo enyi; sɛ ɔnnyɛ ɔno a, nna ayerɛmbɔa woana a?
Afei me nda ho yɛ har sen mbirika-tufo: Wotu kɔ, wonnhu papa biara.
Wotwa mu kɔ dɛ ndzɛmbir ahɛn: Dɛ korpɔn a ɔtow fa afonam do.
Sɛ mese dɛ mo werɛ befir mo nkɔmbɔdzi, mibegyaa m’enyim botooyɛ, na m’enyim atsew a:
Me yaw nyinara yɛ me hu, minyim dɛ irummbu me bem.
Wobobu me fɔ, ebenadze ntsi mbɔ na mebɛberɛ gyan yi?
Sɛ medze esukwankyɛba nsu hohor moho, na meyɛ me nsa ho wansawansa dɛn ara mpo a:
Ɔwo edze me bɔbɔ maa no mu, na mankasa me ntar mpo bekyir me.
Na ɔnnyɛ nyimpa dɛ emi, na meebua no, ma hɛn beenu yeehyia asɛndzii.
Hɛn ntamu sɛntwamunyi bi nnyi hɔ a, ɔdze ne nsa bɔto hɛn beenu nyina do.
Ma onyi n’abaa mfi mo do, na mma mma no ho hu nnkitsa me:
Nna nkyii nkyɛ mebɛkasa, na murunnsuro no; osiandɛ menntse dɛm wɔ man kasa m'afamu.
10: Mo nkwa afon me kra; mebɛma mo nkɔmbɔdzi kwan; mebɛkasa wɔ me kra no wenwen mu.
Mebɛse Nyame dɛ, mma mmbu me fɔ; kyerɛ me adze kor a osian ntsi ma enye me ridzi esi yi.
Ana oye ma wo dɛ ɔwo etseetsee obi, dɛ ɔwo ibu wo nsaano edwuma enyimtsia, na ehyerɛn nyimpa bɔn n'apam do?
Ana ɔwo wɔ honam enyiwa, anna ɔwo ehwɛ adze dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa hwɛ?
Ana wo nda tse dɛ dasanyi nda? Anaa wo mfe tse dɛ dasanyi nda,
ma ɔwo erohwehwɛ m'emumuyɛ ekyir kwan, na idzi mo bɔn ekyir atwee,
naaso ɔwoara Inyim dɛ mennyɛ nyimpa bɔn; na obi nnyi hɔ a obotum agye efi wo nsamu?
Wo nsa na ɔyɛɛ me na ɔween me nyimpamu nyina hyiae; nna woara resɛɛ me yi.
Meserɛ wo, kaa dɛ ɔwo na eween me dɛ awemdɛtse: Na aso edze me bɛba huntuma mu bio?
Ana ɔwoara innhuee me nngu dɛ numfonsu, na emma mimmpiw dɛ numfonsudaa?
Ɔwo na edze wer na honam edura mo ho, na edze mbiew na ntsin ewurawura mo mu.
Ɔwo na adom me nkwa na enyimpa, na wo sera no so akora mo sunsum do.
Naaso iyinom na edze siee w’akoma mu; minnyim dɛ iyi na ɔwɔ wo nkyɛn:
Sɛ meyɛ bɔn a, ɔno ɔwoara na ebɔ me nyikam, na ɔwo rummbu me bem wɔ m'emumuyɛ ho.
Sɛ meyɛ nyimpa bɔn a, mundue; na sɛ meyɛ tseneneenyi mpo a, meremma me tsir do; enyimguase ahyɛ me mã Na ɔwoara hwɛ m’amandzehu.
Na sɛ me tsir ma noho do a, ɔwo ibetsiw me dɛ gyata: Na ɔwo asan nye me ebedzi anwanwasɛm.
Ɔwo edze w'adasefo afofor ba mo do, na ema w'ebufuhyew dɔɔ sõ wo mo do; nsakyer na akodzi esi m’enyim.
Ebɛnadze ntsi mbɔ na iyii me fii awotoa mu bae? Ao, sɛ migyaa mo sunsum mu, enyiwa bi ennhu me ɛ.
Kɛtseankyɛ meyɛɛ dɛ mammba bra; nkyɛ wɔdze me fii yafun mu kɔr adakamaa mu.
Ana me nda nnyɛ kakrabaabi bi? Ayerɛmbɔa sianka, na gyaa me, ma minnya akomatɔmu kakra.
Ansaana makɔ beebi mbrɛ merennsan mmba, mekyerɛ sum na wu no nwinwin asaase no do.
Sum kebii asaase a, ɔtse dɛ sum noara; owu no nwinwin asaase a nhyehyɛɛ biara nnyi hɔ, na beebi mbrɛ kan no tse dɛ sum.
11: Nna Naamathnyi Zophar buae, na ɔsee dɛ
Aso nsɛm dodow yi worinnyi ano? Na aso nyimpa anobɛrbɛrnyi yi ndzi bem?
Ana wo ntuw bɛma nyimpa akã hɔn ano ato mu? Na sɛ ɔwo si atwetwe a, aso nyimpa biara nnkɛhyɛ wo fɛr?
Na ɔwo ese dɛ, me nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛ gyenengyenen, na mo ho tsew wɔ w'enyiwa mu.
Ao kɛtseankyɛ Nyankopɔn aakasa, na oeebue n'ano wɔ wo do;
Na nkyɛ ɔaakyerɛ wo nyansa n'esumansɛm, dɛ ɔyɛ mbɔho wɔ dza ɔwɔ hɔ no ho ɛ! Dɛm ntsi hu dɛ Nyankopɔn gye wo kakraba sen dza w'emumuyɛ regye.
Ana ɔwo ibotum nam nhwehwɛmu do ehu Nyankopɔn? Ana ɔwo ibotum ehu Otumfo no ewie per?
Ɔkrɔn sen sor; ibotum ebɛnadze yɛ? Ɔdɔ sen Sheol; ebɛnadze na inyim?
No nsusui war sen asaase, na ɔtre sen po.
Sɛ ɔtsew mu ba, na ɔtow mu, na ɔfrɛ asɛndzii a, ɔno woana na obotum esiw no kwan?
Na ɔno na onyim nyimpa huhuw: Ohu emumuyɛ so, kaansa ɔnndwen ho mpo a.
Na nyimpa huhuw dze onnyi ntseasee, nyew, nyimpa wɔwo no dɛ hamu asoasoba.
Sɛ ɔwo isiesie w'akoma yie, na etsen wo nsa wɔ no do a;
sɛ emumuyɛ wɔ wo nsamu a, yi kɔ ekyir, na mma mma ɔbrakyew natsena w’asesee mu;
ampa ɔno na ebɛma w'enyi do dɛ nkekaa nnyi ho; nyew, ibetsim hɔ pintsinn, na innkosuro:
Na wo werɛ befir w'awerɛhow; ebɛkaa no dɛ esu a oetwa mu kɔ:
Na wo nkwaber bɛyɛ ketee dɛ wigyinae; kaansa sum gye mpo a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛ adzekyee.
Na wo ho bɛyɛ sɔkyee, osiandɛ enyidado wɔ hɔ; nyew, ebɔhwehwɛ woho ehyia, na agye w’ahom dwudwoodwo.
Eso ɔwo ebɛda, na obiara rinnyi wo hu; na dodowara bedzi w'enyim ntotɔserɛ.
Na ndzebɔnyɛfo dze, hɔn enyiwa do besiw hɔn, na wonnkenya kwan biara afa do eguan, na hɔn enyidado bɛyɛ dɛ kra ne ngyaamu.
12: Nna Job buae na ɔsee dɛ,
Ampaara dɛ hom nye ɔman, na nyansa nye hom bowu.
Na mbom mo so mowɔ ntseasee dɛ homara; monntɔ mu wɔ hom enyim: Nyew, woana na onnyim ndzɛmba a ɔtse dɛm yi?
Metse dɛ obi a ɔyɛ sesɛba dze ma ne nyɛnko, nyimpa a ɔfrɛ Nyankopɔn, na ɔgye no do, nyimpa tsenenee a odzi mu no, ɔyɛ sesɛba.
Nyia no ho adwe no no ommbu amandze bi wɔ n’adwen mu; woesiesie ama hɔn a hɔn anan retserew.
Edwotwafo asesee yɛ prɔmprɔm; na hɔn a woyi Nyame ebufuw tse hɔ komm; Nyame ma adze pii ba hɔn nsamu.
Na afei bisa mbowa, na wɔbekyerɛkyerɛ wo, na wimu ntumbowa, na wɔbɛkã akyerɛ wo:
Anaa kasa kyerɛ asaase, na ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo; na po mu nam bɛda no edzi akyerɛ wo.
Woana na onnyim wɔ yinom nyinara mu, dɛ Ewuradze ne nsa na ɔayɛ yi?
Ɔno ne nsamu na atseasefo nyinara hɔn kra wɔ. Na adasa nyinara hɔn ahom wɔ.
Ana nnyɛ asowa na ɔsɔ asɛm hwɛ, dɛ mbrɛ adadaw so sɔ n’edzi ban hwɛ bi a?
Nkɔdaa mu na nyansa wɔ, na nda tsentsen mu na ntseasee wɔ.
Ɔno no mu na nyansa na tum wɔ, ɔno na ɔwɔ apam na ntseasee.
Hwɛ, ɔno na odwuruw, na wonntum nntow bio; ɔno na ɔtow nyimpa mu, na wonntum mmbue.
Hwɛ, na ɔkam nsu na ɔwew; eso, ɔno na egyaa mu na obutuw asaase.
Ɔno no mu na ahoɔdzen na nyansa wɔ; nyia wɔdaadaa no na ɔdaadaafo nyina yɛ nedze.
Ɔto apamfo pan dze hɔn kɔ, na ɔma atsɛmbuafo yɛ nkwasea.
Ɔno na ɔsansan ahemfo nkyehoma, na ɔdze abɔdo kyekyer hɔn asen.
Ɔto asɔfo pan dze hɔn kɔ, na obutuw akatakyi.
Ɔno na oyi nokwafo ano kasa kɔ, na ɔgye mpanyimfo nyimdzce.
Ɔno na ohue enyimtsiabu gu mbapɔmba do, na ɔsansan ahoɔdzenfo abɔyamu.
Ɔno na oyi adze a no mu dɔ edzi fi sum mu, na ɔdze wu no nwinwin fir edzi ba kan mu.
Ɔno na ɔma amanaman dɔɔ sõ, na ɔsɛɛ hɔn: Ɔno na ɔbɔ amanaman mu, na ogya hɔn kɔ.
Ɔno na ɔgye asaase do ɔman mu etsitsir hɔn akoma, na ɔma wokyin wɔ sar do mbrɛ ɔkwan bi nnyi hɔ.
Wɔkekã wɔ sum a kan nnyi hɔ mu, na ɔma wokyin dɛ sabokwanyi.
13: Hwɛ, m'enyiwa ehu yi nyinara, m'aso atse na ɔatse ase.
Dza hom nyim no, ɔnoara na mo so minyim: Monntɔ mu wɔ hom enyim.
Ampa mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ menye otumfo no bɛkasa, na morohwehwɛ dɛ menye Nyame yi atsɛn.
Na homdze, hom yɛ atofosɛmmafo, hom nyinara hom yɛ ayarsafo a wɔnntow bo.
Ao, kɛtseankyɛ hom mua hom ano koraa! Na nkyɛ mbom hom nyansaa nye no.
Afei hom ntsie m’atsɛnyi, na hom nyɛ aso mma m’ano nyiano.
Ana hom bɛkã no dza ɔnntsen mu ama Nyame, na hom akasa ndaadaa mu ama no a?
Ana hom bɛgye ne tsir? Ana hom bɛham ama Nyame?
Ana oye dɛ nkyɛ ɔbɔhwehwɛ hom mu ehu? Anaa dɛ mbrɛ obi daadaa nyimpa no, hom so bɛdaadaa no?
Ɔbɛkã hom enyim ampa, sɛ hom hwɛ nyimpa enyim nsumaa mu a.
Ana n’akɛseyɛ nnkɛma hom akoma etu, na no ho hu nnkɔtɔ hom do?
Hom akasabɛbu yɛ nso mbɛbusɛm, hom akoban yɛ awendɛtse akoban.
Hom mmua hom ano, hom ngyaa me, ma menkasa, na wɔmma dza ɔbɛba mo do mbra.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mebɛfa no honam etua me sē mu, na mafa mo nkwa ekitsa me nsamu?
Hwɛ oruku me; mohwɛ ɔnoara: M’akwan ara nko na mebɛper ho wɔ n’enyim.
Iyi so na ɔbɛyɛ mo nkwagye, dɛ ɔkɔnkɔnsanyi remmba n’enyim.
Hom ntsie me kasaa enyiberdo, na wɔmma m’asɛm a mepaa mu kã nkɔ hom asomu.
Afei hwɛ, mahyehyɛ m’asɛm; minyim dɛ midzi bem.
Woana nye nyia ɔnye me bedzi esi? Na afei mubomua m’ano, na megyaa mo sunsum mu.
Adze ebien nko na mma mmfa nnyɛ me, ɔno na meremmfa moho nnhuntsa wɔ w'enyim:
Twe wo nsa fi mo do kɔ ekyirkyir: Na mma mma wo ho hu nnkitsa me.
Na nkyii frɛ, na mebɛgye Wo do: Anaa ma menkasa, na ɔwoara bua me.
M'emumuyɛ na mo bɔn yɛ ahen ara? Ma munhu me mbrato na mo bɔn
Ɔye dɛn ntsi na ihuntsa w’enyim Na ibu me wo tamfo?
Ana ibobu ahataw a ɔrobɔ kyin? Na etsiw eburonan a eguan?
Na ɔwo ekyerɛw nsɛm wenwen dze tsia me, na ema midzi me mbafobermu emumuyɛ ho adze:
Ɔwo na edze m’anan so hyehyɛ apo mu, na ebɔ m’akwan nyinara nyikam; ɔwo na itwa m’ananadze ho he:
Naaso metse dɛ adze prɔwee a ohi, dɛ atar a mbowaba awewe.
14: Nyimpa a ɔbaa wo no, ne nda kumaabi, na ɔfona mã.
Ɔba sor dɛ nhyiren, na wotwa to famu: Oguan so dɛ nwinwin, na ɔnnko hɔ.
Na aso ɔwo ibue w’enyiwa wɔ obi a ɔtse dɛm do, na edze me kɔ w’enyim atsɛmbu mu?
Woana na obotum dze adze a no ho tsew efi dza no ho nntsew mu aba? Obiara runntum.
Osiandɛ no nda wɔahyɛ ato hɔ, n’abosoom no dodow wɔ wo hɔ, na ɔwo etwa no he a orunntum nntra;
yi w’enyi fi no do, ma ɔnhom. Nkodu dɛ obowie ne da dɛ paanyi.
Na enyidado wɔ hɔ wɔ dua ho, dɛ sɛ wotwa kyen a, ɔbɛfefɛw bio, na no nkorbata fɔr no remmpa.
Kaansa no ndwow yɛ dadaw wɔ dɛtse mu, na no dusin wu wɔ famu mpo a.
Ɔnam nsu na hua do ɔbɛfefɛw, na oeyiyi abaw dɛ dua a wɔatsɛw.
Na nyimpa dze owu na ɔbea hɔ, nyew, nyimpa gyaa no sunsum mu, na ɔwɔ hen?
Dɛ mbrɛ nsu fi po mu kɔ no, na esutsen huam, na ɔwew no,
Dɛmara so na nyimpa da hɔ na ɔnnsoɛr: Ɔsor nnya nntwa mu yi worinnyan, na eso worummpusuw hɔn mmfi hɔn nda mu.
Ao, kɛtseankyɛ ɔwoara edze me eehuntsa ekodu Sheol, nkyɛ ɔwoara edze me eesuma ekodu dɛ w’ebufuw etwa mu Nkyɛ ɔwoara aahyɛ me mber, na aakaa me!
Sɛ nyimpa wu a, ana ɔbɛtsena ase bio? M’akodzi nda nyinara mobɔtweɔn, ekodu dɛ me nsakyeree bɛba.
Ɔwo ebɛfrɛ, na emi so magye wo do: Ibenya akɔndɔ wɔ wo nsaano edwuma ho.
Na afei dze ɔwo kan m’anamɔn: Ana ɔwo erenntsɛw mo bɔn?
Wɔasɔw me mbrato ano ahyɛ kotoku mu. Na ɔwo akyekyer m’emumuyɛ ano.
Na ampa bepɔw a orutu ahwe ase, ohi, na botan twe fi n’ananmu;
Nsu hi abo; Ne nyirii hohor famu huntuma kɔ: Na ɔwo na esɛɛ dasanyi n’enyidado;
Ɔwo idzi no do nyim koraa, na otwa mu kɔ; ɔwo esakyer n’enyim, na igya no kwan ma ɔkɔ.
Ne mba ba enyidzi mu, na onnyim; na wɔbrɛ hɔn adze, na onnhu mma hɔn.
Nankasa no honam a otua no no dze ɔyɛ no yaw, na ne kra a ɔwɔ no mu so dzi nkɔmbɔ.
15: Nna Temannyi Eliphaz buae, na ɔsee dɛ,
ana nyansafo dze nyimdzee huhuw bobua, na ɔdze boka mframa ahyɛ ne yafua mã?
Ana ɔdze kasa a mfaso nnyi ho beyi atsɛn, anaa asɛnka a orunntum mmfa nnyɛ papa bi a?
Nyew, ɔwo etow suro kyen, na isiw mpaabɔ kwan wɔ Nyame enyim.
Na w’ano kyerɛ w'emumuyɛ, na ɔwo asan mu afa enyitseweefo tɛkyerɛma.
Wankasa w’ano na obu wo fɔ, na nnyɛ emi bi a; nyew, wankasa w’anofamfa na odzi dase tsia wo.
Ana ɔwo nye nyimpa a wodzii kan woo no? Anaa wɔwoo wo ansaana wɔrowo akoko?
Ana atse Nyankopɔn no nsumaa mu egyinatu? Na isianka nyansa dze ma woho?
Ebɛnadze na ɔwo inyim a yennyim? Ebɛnadze na ɔwo etse ase a onnyi hɛn mu?
Etsigonfo na nkɔdaa posoposo nyina wɔ hɛn mu a woyɛ mpanyin koraa sen w’egya.
Aso Nyame n’awerɛkyekyer suar dodow ma wo, na asɛm a wɔnye wo kã no bɔkɔɔ no?
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w’akoma soa wo kɔ? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w’enyiwa bubu pɛrpɛr?
Dɛ ɔwo edan wo sunsum tsia Nyame, na ema dɛm nsɛm fi w’anomu.
Dasanyi nye bɛn, na no ho bɛtsew? Nyia ɔbaa awo no, dɛ ɔbɛtsen?
Hwɛ, ɔmmfa werɛ nnhyɛ n’akrɔnkrɔmfo mu; nyew, sorsor mpo ho nntsew wɔ n’enyi do.
Na bubur nyia no ho yɛ nkɔw na ɔaprow, nyimpa a ɔanom emumuyɛ dɛ nsu:
Mebɛkyerɛ wo, ɔwo tsie me; na dza mehu no mebɛkã akyerɛ:
Dza enyansafo akã akyerɛ a ofi hɔn egyanom hɔ, na wɔammfa ennsuma no;
hɔnara nko na wɔdze asaase no maa hɔn, na ɔhɔho biara enntwa mu wɔ hɔn mu:
Nyimpa bɔn dze yaw kõ awoo ne nda nyinara, na wɔdze mfe a wɔakan esie ama hyɛdofo.
Ihu ne nka gyegye n’aso mu; prɔmprɔmyɛ mu na ɔsɛɛfo no bɛba no do:
Ɔnngye nndzi dɛ ɔbɛsan efi sum mu, na afõwa da hɔ rotweɔn no:
Okyima hwehwɛ edziban, ɔse dɛ, ɔwo henfa? Onyim dɛ sum da bɛn ne nkyɛn:
Ahohia na ahoguan yi no hu; wɔdzi no do nyim, dɛ ɔhen a oesiesie noho ama kõ:
Osiandɛ ɔatsen no nsu etsia Nyame, na odzi nkontompɔsɛm tsia Otumfo no:
Ɔdze kɔn a ɔasensen tutu kɔ no do, ɔnye n’akyɛm ho apɔwapɔw a no mu yɛ dur no:
Osiandɛ ɔdze ne seradze akata n'enyim, na ɔayɛ seradze nankum wɔ ne nkyɛnmu:
Na ɔakɛtsena ekurow a woegu do, efi a nyimpa biara nntsena mu a ɔaka no dɛ ɔdan efitu.
Orinnya noho, nkyii so n’ahodze rinngyina, nkyii so hɔn nsowee ronnkontom mmba famu.
Orimmfi sum mu mmfi. Ogyaframee bɛma no ndubaa eguan, na n’anomu ehuw mu na ɔdze bɔkɔ.
Mma mma ɔnntwer egyangyandze, nndaadaa noho: Na egyangyandze ara na ɔbɛyɛ n'akatua.
Ɔbɛyɛ ho ansaana ne mber asõ, na no dubaa rennyɛ frɔmfrɔm.
Ɔboporow n'esikyireainba bun dɛ wenyindua, na ɔapo ne nhyiren dɛ ngodua.
Na ndabrabafo fɛkuw bɛyɛ abɔnyin, na gya bɛhyew mboabadzi asesee.
Wonyinsen ewurkadze, na wɔwo emumuyɛ, na hɔn yamu siesie ndaadaa.
16: Nna Job buae, na ɔsee dɛ,
matse nsɛm a ɔtsetse dɛm pii. Hom nyinara hom yɛ nkɔmbɔdɔmdzifo.
Aso nsɛm huhuw yi bɔbɔ adze nye yi? Anaa ebɛnadze na ohur wo bo ma ibua?
Mo so mubotum akasa dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛ; sɛ hom kra wɔ me kra ananmu a, nkyɛ mubotum ahɔr nsɛm egu hom do, na mawosow me tsir wɔ hom do.
Nkyɛ medze m'ano mebɛhyɛ hom dzen, na m'anofamfa do akyekyewerɛ ama hom awerɛhow aabotow.
Sɛ mekasa a, m’awerɛhow rommbotow: Na sɛ migyaa so mpo a, ebɛnadze na ofi mo ho kɔ?
Na afei dze, ɔama maberɛ: Ɔwo ama me fɛkuw nyinara egu
Ɔwo edze mpomponee ahyɛ me mã a odzi me dase: Na mo fɔn asoɛr etsia me, ordizi dase wɔ m’enyim.
