Ɔatsetsew me wɔ n’ebufuw mu, na ɔyɛ me enyienyi; ɔatwer ne sē egu mo do: Me tamfo no poɛ n’enyi hwɛ me.
Wɔahanhan hɔn anomu wɔ mo do; wɔabobɔ m’asomu ahorohoraa mu: Wɔkã hɔnho boa ano tsia me.
Nyame dze me ahyɛ hɔn a wonnyim Nyame nsa, na ɔatow me akyen ndzebɔnyɛfo nsamu.
Mo ho dwe me, na oebubu mo mu, nyew, oesuo mo kɔn, na ɔabobɔ me posoposo: Ɔdze me esi hɔ so ayɛ no botae.
N’egyentofo etwa mo ho ehyia, ɔpaa me nsɛbɛ mu, na onngyaa; ɔhue no bɔwema gu famu.
Ɔdwerew me dze dwerew paa dwerew do: Otutu ba mo do dɛ ɔbran katakyi.
Mapam eyitam akata mo wer do, na medze m’ambɛn ato huntuma mu.
Osū ntsi m’enyim ayɛ nkɔnkɔw, na owu nwinwin wɔ m’enyisoatsɛw do;
naaso enyiber bi nnyi me nsamu, na me mpaabɔ yɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Asaase e, mma nnkata mo bɔgyaa do, na mma mma mo sufrɛ nnya ahomgyebea.
Seseiara mpo, hwɛ, me dasefo wɔ sor, na nyia ɔkã ma me wɔ mbrɛ ɔkrɔn.
Me mfɛfo si me atwetwe: Na Nyame na m’enyiwa porow nyinsuwa kyerɛ no;
dɛ ɔdze dasanyi ne bem bɛma wɔ Nyame enyim, na nyimpa ba wɔ ne nyɛnko enyim:
Na sɛ mfe kumaabi ba a, mobɔkɔ kwan a merennsan memmba no.
17: Mo sunsum asã, me nda ehi, adakamaa wɔ hɔ ma me.
Ampaara atwetwesifo wɔ me nkyɛn, na m'enyiwa tua hɔn ehiyi.
Afei ma ahobadze, fa woho dzi me egyinamu; woana na ɔwɔ hɔ a ɔnye me bɔbɔ nsamu?
Na ɔwo na eyi hɔn akoma efi ntseasee ho esuma: Dɛm ntsi irunnhuhor hɔn.
Nyia oyi ne mfɛfo ma afonam no, ne mba enyiwa mpo bofura.
Ɔayɛ mo so ɔman akasabɛbu; na madan obi a wohinahina n'enyi do ntafi.
Awerɛhow ntsi m'enyiwa so ayɛ kusukusu; na m'akwaa nyinara ayɛ dɛ nwinwin.
Nyimpa a wɔtsen na hɔn ho bɔbow hɔn wɔ yi ho, na nyia odzi bem no bekenyan noho etsia dabrabanyi.
Naaso tseneneenyi bosuo no kwan mu ara, na nyia ne nsa ho tsew no benya ahoɔdzen aka ho:
Na hom nsam, hom nyinara, na afei hom mbra: Na murunnhu nyansafo biara wɔ hom mu.
Me nda etwa mu, me tsirmpɔw ebubu, m'akoma mu adwen mpo so.
Wɔdan adzesaa adzekyee: Wɔse dɛ, kan bɛn sum ho.
Sɛ mobohwɛ Sheol kwan dɛ ɔyɛ me fie; sɛ matow me mpa wɔ sum mu;
Sɛ mebɛse mpɔtɔwee dɛ, ɔwo nye m'egya; abowaba dɛ, ɔwo nye me nã, na m'akyerɛbaa a;
Na ayerɛmbɔa m'enyidado wɔ henfa? Na m'enyidado dze, woana na obohu?
Obesian akɔ Sheol adaban no mu, aber ara a ahomgye bɛBa huntuma mu no.
18: Nna Shuhinyi Bildad buae, na ɔsee dɛ,
Na hom rusuasua nsɛm mfir ara ma ekodu dabɛn? Hom ndwen ho, na n'ekyir no yɛakasa.
Ebɛnadze ntsi na ibu hɛn dɛ mbowa, na yɛayɛ dɛ ahoɔfifo wɔ w'enyi do yi?
Ɔwo a etsetsew woho gu wɔ w'ebufuw mu, aso wɔbɔpow asaase wɔ wo ntsi? Anaa wobotutu abotan efi n'ananmu?
Nyew, dzebɔnyɛnyi ne kandzea wobodum no, na ne gyansenama rennhyerɛn.
Kan bɛdan sum wɔ n'asesee mu, na ne kandzea edum wɔ no do.
N'ahoɔdzen anamɔn bomua, na nankasa n'apam ahwe no ase.
Na nankasa n'anan dze no akɔtoto eboa mu, na ɔanantsew wɔ ngor do.
Bɛmba bosuo n'anantsir, na efir ata esuo no mu
Wɔdze ahoturoho ehuntsa no wɔ famu, na woesua no apafir wɔ kwan mu.
Ihu bɛma n'akoma wɔ nkyɛnkyɛn nyina, na woetsiw no wɔ n'anantsir.
N'ahoɔdzen bɔtɔ bitsi, na mbusu ayɛ krado ama ne ngyinae.
Obedzi ne nyimpadua n'akwaa no, nyew, owu n'abakan bedzi n'akwaa.
Wobotu no efi n'asesee a no werɛ hyɛ mu no mu; na wɔdze no abrɛ hu hen no.
Nyia ɔnnyɛ nedze mu bi na ɔbɛtsena n'asesee mu: Wɔbɔbɔ brimstone apetse ne tsenabew.
No ndwom bɛkyenkyen wɔ ase, na woetwitwa n'abaw wɔ sor.
Ne nkaa bɛhera efi asaase do, na orinnya dzin wɔ abɔntsen do.
Wɔbɛpam no efi kan mu akɔ sum mu, na wɔatam no efi wiadze.
Onnkenya ba na banana so wɔ ne manmu, nkyii so onnkenya kyirkafo biara wɔ mbrɛ ɔkɛtsenae no.
Hɔn a wobedzi ekyir no hɔn ho bɔbow hɔn wɔ ne da no ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wodzii kan no nke tsenketse kyeer hɔn no.
Ampaara dɛm na abrakyewfo tsenabew tsetsee, na yi nye nyia onnyim Nyame no ne gyinabew
19: Na Job buae, na ɔsee dɛ,
hom beyi me kra ahomtsew, na wɔdze nsɛm ebubu me pasaa ara ma ekodu dabɛn?
Mpɛn ara du nye yi na hom asopa me: Hom enyi nntõ dɛ hom nye me dzi no dzendzen.
Na sɛ ampaara mpo dɛ mafom a, mo mfom da mara mo do.
Sɛ ampa dɛ hom bɛmema homho do etsia me, na hom eyi me m’ahorohoraa ho atsɛn a:
Ɔnodze hom nhu dɛ Nyame ebutuw no am a me, na ɔdze no boa etwa moho ehyia.
Hwɛ, metsēa mu dɛ, Akatabansɛm o, na wɔnngye me do: Musū mefrɛ mboa, na atsɛmbu bi nnyi hɔ.
Ɔno na oesi mo kwan do ban ma munntum munntwa mu, na ɔama sum ahyehyɛ m’atsempɔn do.
Ɔno na ɔapa m'enyimnyam efi mo ho, na oeyi me tsir abɔtsir.
Ɔno na oebubu me afã nyina, na minnyi hɔ: Na oetu m’enyidado dɛ dua.
Ɔno na eso ɔama n’ebufuw dzɛw wɔ mo do, na obu me dɛ n'atamfo no mu bi.
No dɔm horow bɔɔ mu bae, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn kwan baa mo do, na wɔkyeer nsera bɔɔ m’asesee ho aprɔw.
Ɔno na oeyi mo nuanom efi mo ho akɔ ekyirkyir, na m’amanyimfo adandan me ananaben koraa.
M’ebusuafo atwe ase, na m’anyɛnko berɛbo werɛ efir me.
Hɔn a wɔtsetse me fi mu, na me mbabaa, wobu me ɔhɔho: Meyɛ nanaben wɔ hɔn enyi do.
Mefrɛ m’akowaa, na ɔnngye me do, kaansa medze m’ano mepa no kyɛw mpo a.
M’ahomgu adan adze hɔho ama me yer, na mo sufrɛ ama me nã yamu mba.
Mbofraba nkakraba mpo wobu me enyimtsia; sɛ mosoɛr a, wɔkasa tsiatsia me.
Me mbarimba apamfo nyinara kyir me kɔkɔɔkɔ: Na hɔn a modɔ hon adan hɔnho etsia me.
Me biew afam mo wer na mo honam ho, na medze me sē ho wer na mefi nsa.
Ao hom me mfɛfo, hom nhu me mbɔbɔr, hom nhu me mbɔbɔr; na Nyame ne nsa na akã me.
Ɔye dɛn ntsi na hom tsiw me dɛ Nyame, na mo honam ara mmee hom yi?
Ao kɛtseankyɛ afei wɔaakyerɛw me nsɛm! Ao kɛtseankyɛ wɔdze aahyɛ nwoma mu!
Dɛ nkyɛ wɔdze dadze kyerɛwdze na sumbui Woeekrukye no wɔ botan mu ako hɔ daa:
Na minyim dɛ mo pomfo tse ase, na dɛ obegyina asaase do ekyir n.
Na mo wer asɛɛ dɛm ekyir no, mpo mifi mo honam mu mubohu Nyankopɔn:
Ɔno na mobɔhwɛ no ama moho, na m’enyiwa bohu, na nnyɛ obi a. Me nsɛbɛ resã wɔ mo mu.
Sɛ hom se dɛ, yebesi dɛn etsiw no, osiandɛ woehu asɛm no no ndwow wɔ mo mu a;
hom nsuro afõwa no: Na ebufuhyew na ɔdze afõwa ne ntsēa ba, ama hom eehu dɛ atsɛmbu bi wɔ hɔ.
20: Nna Naamathnyi Zophar buae, na ɔsee dɛ,
dɛm ntsi na m'adwen yɛ me dɛ mo mbuae, me ntsɛmpɛ a ɔwɔ mo mu ntsi.
Matse nkaenyim a ogu m'enyim ase, na me nteasee mu sunsum bua me.
Ana ɔwo innyim yi a ofi tsetseberdo, ofitsi dɛ wɔdze nyimpa too asaase do,
dɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo eyiedzi yɛ tsia, na ndabrabafo ehurusidzi nnkyɛr.
Kaansa n'akɛseyɛ fow kɔ sor, na ne tsir kɛkã mununkum mpo a;
Ɔbɛhera daapem dɛ nankasa n’efikyir: Hɔn a woehu no no bɛse dɛ, ɔwo hen?
Obotu akɔ dɛ adaaso, na worunnhu no, nyew, wobetsiw no dɛ anago enyido-adzehu.
Enyiwa a ohun no no orunnhu no bio; nkyii so ne tsenabew runnhu no bio.
Ne mba bɔhwehwɛ abɔbɔfo hɔ enyimpa, na ne nsa eyi n’ahonyadze asan ama.
Ne mberantsɛber mu ahonamudzen ahyɛ ne mbiew amaama. Na mbom ɔnye no bɛda wɔ huntuma mu.
Kaansa ndzebɔnyɛ yɛ fenemfenem wɔ n’anomu, kaansa ɔdze suma ne tɛkyerɛma ase;
kaansa ɔkora do, na oenngyaa mu ma ɔannkɔ, na mbom ɔda ho ara sie no wɔ n’adadaw mu a;
n'edziban asakyer wɔ no nson mu, ɔyɛ nhurutsia bɔwema wɔ no mu.
Ɔamen ahonya, na ɔbɛfe bio: Nyame beyi efi ne yamu akyen.
Obohwew nhurutsia bɔr: Ɔparabir tɛkyerɛma boku no.
N’enyi nnkɔbɔ esutsen no do, ewo na buter nsupemee no.
Dza ɔaberɛ ho no, ɔbɛdan ama, na ɔnnkɛmen: Dɛ mbre n’ahodze a oenya tse no, orinndzi ho ehurusi.
Na ɔatseetsee ehiafo na ɔapow hɔn; ɔafa ofi bi enyimpido, na orinnsi.
Osiandɛ oennhu n’akɔndɔ mu mee ntsi, ɔronnkora dza n’enyigye wɔ mu mu biribiara do.
Hweeara annka a oenndzi, dɛm ntsi n’eyiedzi nnkɛka hɔ.
N'adze dodow mãyɛ no mu no ho behiahia no: Obiara a ɔwɔ amandzehu mu ne nsa bɛba no do.
Sɛ ɔrebɛyɛ ɔahyɛ ne yafun mã a, Nyame bɔtow n’ebufuhyew no egu no do, na ɔbɔtɔ no nsu egu no do mber a oridzidzi no.
Oboguan efi dadze akodze ano, na boran egyen abɔ no ehwira mu.
Ɔtwe, na ofi ne nyimpadua mu pue: Nyew, n’ano dɛhyɛdɛhyɛ no fi no bɔwema mu pue; ihu wɔ no do.
Sum nyinara wɔdze esie ama n’akoradze: Gya a nyimpa bi nnhutsa na ɔbɛmen no; ɔbɛhyew dza aka wɔ n’asesee mu.
Sor bɛda n’emumuyɛ edzi, na asaase bɔsoɛr etsia no.
Ne fie ndɔbaa befi hɔ akɔ, n’adze bɛpem akɔ wɔ n’ebufuw da no mu.
Iyi nye nyimpa dzebɔnyɛnyi ne kyɛfa a ofi Nyame hɔ, na egyapadze a Nyame ahyɛ ama no.
21: Na Job buae na ɔsee dɛ,
hom ntsie me kasaa yie; na wɔmma yi nyɛ hom awerɛkyekyer.
Hom mma me kwan, ma mo so menkasa; na mekasa muwie a, hom esi atwetwe.
Emidze, ana nyimpa na midzi mo nkɔmbɔ mekyerɛ no? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mennkɛyɛ hurutuhurutu?
Hom ngyen me, na hom ho mbow hom, na hom mfa hom nsa ntoto hom ano.
Sɛ mekã mpo a, m'akoma tu, na nketsenketse kitsa mo honam.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ndzebɔnyɛfo tsena ase, wɔkyē, nyew, wɔyɛ tum mu akatakyi?
Hɔn asefo tsintsim wɔ hɔn enyim ka hɔn ho, na hɔn mba wɔ hɔn enyiwa do.
Hɔn efi mu dwe, suro bi nnyi mu, nkyii so Nyame n'abaa bi nnyi hɔn do.
Hɔn nantwinyin wo, na ɔyɛ kago, hɔn nantwiber yɛ awoyie, na ɔmmpon ba.
Wɔto hɔn mbofraba kwan dɛ nguankuw, na hɔn mba so huruhuruw.
Wɔma hɔn ndze do wɔ mpintsin na nsankutsen mu, na hɔn enyi gye wɔ atɛntɛbɛn ndze ho.
Wɔhwer hɔn nda wɔ eyiedzi mu, na ntsɛmara na woesian kɔ Sheol.
Naaso wɔse Nyame dɛ, fi hɛn do kɔ; na yɛronnhwehwɛ w’akwan ho nyimdzee.
Otumfo no nye bɛn ma yɛnsom no? Na sɛ yɛbɔ mpaa ma no a, ebɛn mfaso na yebenya?
Hwɛ, hɔn ndzepa nnyi hɔn nsamu: Ndzebɔnyɛfo apam apar me.
Mpɛn ahen na ndzebɔnyɛfo kandzea dum? Na hɔn ebu so bu hɔn. Na Nyame kyɛ awerɛhow ma hɔn wɔ n’ebufuw mu?
Na wɔyɛ dɛ eburonan wɔ mframa enyim, na dɛ ntsɛw a ehum soa kɔ?
Hom sɛ dɛ, Nyame dze n'emumuyɛ to hɔ ma ne mba, ma ontua ɔnoara kaw, ma onhu.
Ma nankasa n’enyiwa nhu ne sɛɛe, na ma ɔnnom Otumfo no n’ebufuhyew no bi.
Na ebɛn yie na onya wɔ ne fi a ɔwɔ n’ekyir no ho, aber a n’abosoom no dodow do etwa wɔ finimfin no?
Ana obi bɛkyerɛ Nyame nyimdzee? Ofi dɛ ɔno na obu hɔn a wɔkrɔn atsɛn.
Obi wu wɔ n’ahoɔdzen mu mu, aber a no ho baa no na n’asomu dwe no koraa no:
Enumfonsu ayɛ ne ndaasee mu amanma, ma ne mbiew mu ehor yɛ fɔɔfɔɔ.
Na obi so wu wɔ ne kra awerɛhow mu. Na ɔnnsɔ ndzepa no bi nnhwɛ da.
Wɔdeda pɛr wɔ huntuma mu, ma mbowaba kata hɔn do.
Hwɛ, minyim hom adwen, na tsirmpɔw a hom susu no bɔn mu tsia me no.
Osiandɛ hom se dɛ, Bapɔmba no ne fi wɔ henfa? Na hen na dzebɔnyɛnyi no ne tsenabew asesee no wɔ?
Ana hom mmbisaa hɔn a wɔfa kwan no do no? Na hom nnyim hɔn nsɛnkyerɛdze so?
Na wɔagye nyimpa bɔn do ekodu sɛɛ da no?
Woana na ɔbɛkã n’abrabɔ akyerɛ wɔ n'enyim? Na dza ɔayɛ no, woana na obotua no ho kaw?
Nkyii so wɔdze no bɛkɛma adakamaa, na nda no do ara na ɔbɔweɔn.
Bɔnsa mu dɛtse tɔw bɛyɛ no dɛw, na nyimpa nyinara bɔtwe hɔnho ekedzi n’ekyir, dɛ mbrɛ n’enyim so onnyi anobu no.
Odua dɛn mbɔ na hom kyekye mo werɛ kwa, ofi dɛ hom nyiyiano yɛ nkɔnkɔnsa ara nko yi?
22: Nna Temanyi Eliphaz buae, na ɔsee dɛ,
aso nyimpa bi ye ma Nyame? Ampaara nyia onyim nyansa ye ma noho.
Ana ɔyɛ enyigye bi ma Otumfo no dɛ ɔwo etsen? Anaadɛ ɔyɛ mfaso ma no, dɛ ɔwo ema w’akwan dzi mu?
Ana wo suro a isuro no ntsi na ɔkã w’enyim, na ɔdze wo kɔ atsɛmbu mu?
Ana wo ndzebɔnyɛ nnyɛ kɛse? Nkyii so ewiei biara nnyi hɔ mma w’emumuyɛ.
Na ɔwo agye wo nua hɔ ahobadze kwa, na ape pa adagyafo hɔn atam.
Ɔwo amma abahatɔfo nsu ma wɔannom, na ɔwo akam nyia ɔkɔm dze no n’edziban.
Na ɔbarimba a ɔwɔ abasa na onyaa asaase no; na ɔbarimba nyimnyamfo no, ɔno na ɔtsena do.
Ɔwo na egya mbaa ekunafo kwan ma wɔdze nsapan kɔ, na ngyanka abasa so woebubum
Dɛm ntsi na mfir abɔ wo ho aprɔw, na awerɛfir suro rehaw wo yi.
Anaa ɔwo nnhu sum, na nsu piigyan a ɔkata wo do?
Ana nnyɛ Nyame na ɔwɔ sor krɔn mu no, na hwɛ nworaba etsifi, mbrɛ odua war a.
Na ɔwo ese dɛ, ebɛnadze na Nyame nyim? Ana obotum ebu atsɛn wɔ sum kebii no mu?
Mununkum kusuww na ɔyɛ akataho ma no, na onnhu adze: Na ɔnantsew wɔ sor no kɔntɔnkrɔn mu.
Ana ebɛfa tsetse kwan no do dza nyimpa bɔn anantsew do no?
Hɔn a wohwiim hɔn kɔree ansaana hɔn ber rudu no, hɔn fapem wohuei gui dɛ esutsen no.
Hɔn a wɔsee Nyame dɛ, fi hɛn do kɔ; na, ebɛnadze na Otumfo no botum ayɛ ama hɛn?
Naaso ɔdze ndzepa hyehyɛɛ hɔn efiefi amaama: Na mbom ndzebɔnyɛfo apam apar me koraa.
Atseneneefo no hu, na hɔn enyi gye; na hɔn a wodzi bem no sereserew hɔn.
Dɛ, ampaara hɔn a wɔsoɛree tsiaa hɛn no woetwitwa hɔn egu, na hɔn mu nkaa no gya no edzi.
Afei fa woho bɔ no ho, na wo ho ndwe wo: Ɔnam yi do na adzepa bɛba ama wo.
Meserɛ wo, gye n’anomu mbra no, na fa ne nsɛm sie w’akoma mu.
Sɛ ɔwo esan kɔ Otumfo no nkyɛn a, wɔdze wo besi hɔ; sɛ ɔwo ibeyi emumuyɛ ofi w’asesee mu akɔ ekyirkyirkyir.
Na fa w’egyapadze gu huntuma mu, na Ophir sika so gu wora mu mbosaabo mu;
Na Otumfo no bɛyɛ w’egyapadze, na dwetɛ a wɔahoa ho ama wo.
Na ɔno na wo ho bɛsɛpɛw wo wɔ Otumfo no ho, na ama w'enyi do akyerɛ Nyame.
Ɔwo bɔbɔ wo mpaa ama no, na obetsie wo; na ɔwo etua w’anohobadze.
Eso ɔwo ebɔbɔ adze bi ho tsirmpow, na ɔbeyɛ hɔ ama wo; Na ekan bɛhyerɛn w’akwan do.
Sɛ wɔtow wo kyen famu a, ebɛse dɛ, ahomado wɔ hɔ; na nyia ɔbrɛ adze no na ɔbɛgye no nkwa.
Ɔbɛgye nyia onndzi bem no mpo. Nyew, ɔnam wo nsa no ho ntsewee do wɔbɛgye no.
23: Nna Job buae na ɔsee dɛ,
ndɛ so mo nkɔmbɔdzi yɛ etuatsew: Me nsa yɛ m’apensi do durdur.
Ao kɛtseankyɛ minyim beebi mbrɛ mubohu no, na nkyɛ mekodu ne tsenabew:
Nkyɛ mibesiesie n’asɛm wɔ n’enyim, na medze nkyerɛase maahyɛ m’anomu mã:
Nkyɛ meehu nsɛm a ɔdze bobua me, na maatse dza obese me no ase.
Ana ɔnye me bɛham wɔ no tum kɛseyɛ no mu? Dabida; mbom ɔbɛyɛ aso ama me.
Ehɔ na tseneneenyi nye no beyi atsɛn; nna mibefi me tsɛmbuafo nsamu korakora.
Hwɛ, mokɔ enyim, na onnyi hɔ; na ekyir so, na munnhu no:
Abankum, mber a ɔreyɛ edwuma, na mohwɛ no a ɔnnyɛ: Osuma noho wɔ enyirafa, na munntum munnhu no.
Na onyim kwan a mefa do: Sɛ ɔasɔ me ahwɛ a, nkyɛ mefir edzi de sika.
M’anan etsintsim n’anamɔn mu dzendzen: No kwan na mesie, na manndan ammfa nkyɛn.
Mennsaan ekyir mimmfii n’anomu mbrasɛm ho; mesie n’anomunsɛm ma ɔsen m'ahyɛdze.
Na ɔnodze, ogyina adwen kor do, na woana na ɔbɛdan no? Na dza me kra pɛ no, ɔnoara na ɔyɛ.
Na ɔno na ɔyɛ dza wɔahyɛ ama no no: Na ndzɛmba a ɔtsetse dɛm pii wɔ ne nkyɛn.
Dɛm ntsi morofona wɔ n’enyim; sɛ modwendwen a, m’akoma tu wɔ no ho.
Na Nyame ama m’akoma etu, na Otumfo no afona me.
Osiandɛ woenntwa me annkyen wɔ sum no enyim, nkyii so ɔannkata sum kebii no do wɔ m’enyim.
24: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na Otumfo no nnhyɛ mber nnsie? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hɔn a wonyim no nnhwɛ ne nda no?
Wobi wɔ hɔ a wɔtwe asaase he; wɔfa nguankuw enyimpido, na wɔnyɛn hɔn.
Wɔkã egyanka asoaso ma ɔkɔ, wɔgye baa kunafo nantwi ahoba.
Woyi ɔkɔhweaban edzi wɔ kwan mu: Asaase do ehiafo bɔ mu suma hɔnho.
Hwɛ, wofir edzi kɔ hɔn dwumadzi mu; dɛ sar do hamu nsoaso a wɔhwɛhwɛ edziban mbɔdzen do ara; sar no so ma hɔn edziban ma wɔdze ma hɔn mba.
Haban mu na wotwa hɔn mbowa edziban; na wodzi ndzebɔnyɛfo wenyin ture mu mpɛpɛw.
Anago nyinara wodzi adagyaw da dɛ wonnyi adzefuradze, na wonnyi akataho wɔ awɔw mu.
Mbepɔw do nsutɔree fɔw hɔn, na wonnyi guansumabew ntsi wɔyɛ ɔbotan etu.
Wobi wɔ hɔ a wɔtsew ngyanka fi enumfo ano, na wɔgye hianyi hɔ ahobadze
Na wɔnenam no adagyaw mu wonnyi adzefuradze, na ɔkɔm dze hɔn ntsi, wɔsoasoa efiefi no;
wɔyɛ ngo wɔ mbarimba yi hɔn afasu mu; wotsiatsia hɔn nsãtwer, na wodzi nsukɔm.
Kurow a nyimpa dɔɔ sõ wɔ mu mu na mbarimba si apen. Na pirafo ne kra sū frɛ; naaso Nyame mmbu mma dɛ nkwaseadze a.
Woyinom na wofi hɔn a wɔtsew etūa wɔ kan do no mu; wonnyim n’akwan, na so wɔnntsena n'atsempɔn do.
Wudzifo dzi kan soɛr, oku hianyi na kɔhweaban; na anago ɔyɛ dɛ wifo.
Ɔyefafo enyiwa so tweɔn adansabɛr, ɔsɛ dɛ, enyiwa bi nnkohu me: Na ɔdze akataho kata enyim.
Sum mu na wohwira adan mu: Wɔtotow hɔnho mbobow mu ewiaber, wonnyim kan.
Na hɔn nyinara anapa yɛ hɔn dɛ wu nwinwin, osiandɛ wonyim wu nwinwin ehuyidze.
No ho yɛ har wɔ nsu enyi; wɔdom hɔn kyɛfa wɔ asaase do: Ɔnndan mmfa wenyin ture kwan do
Nsukɔm na ahohur twe esukwankyɛba nsu: Dɛmara na Sheol so yɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ bɔn no.
Awotoa werɛ befir no; abowaba bedzi ne nam; wɔrennkaa no bio: Na ndzeyɛɛkyew bobubu dɛ dua.
Ɔmemen bɔnyin a ɔnnwo: Na ɔnnyɛ baa kunafo yie no.
Ɔno na ɔdze turn ma akatakyi so fi hɔ: Ɔno na osoɛr, na nyimpa biara n’enyi nnda nkwa do.
Nyame ma hɔn ma wɔyɛ dwudwoodwo, na wɔdze hɔnho twer do; na n’enyiwa wɔ hɔn akwan do.
Woehuhor hɔn; naaso mber kakrabaabi na wonnyi hɔ; nyew, wɔabrɛ hɔn adze, woeyi hɔn efi kwan no mu dɛ nyimpa nyinara, na wotwitwa hɔn gu dɛ ewi mbɛtsem etsifi.
Na sɛ afei ɔnntse dɛm a, woana na ɔbɔto me ɔtorfo, na ɔayɛ m’asɛm dɛ ɔnnsɛ hwee?
25: Nna Shuhinyi Bildad buae, na ɔsee dɛ,
tumdzi na suro wɔ no bo; ɔno na ɔyɛ asomdwee wɔ ne mbea sorɔnsorɔm mu.
Ana no dɔm ano wɔ ebuyie? Na woana na ne kan nnsoɛr no do?
Dasanyi besi dɛn mbɔ atsen wɔ Nyame enyim? Anaa ɔbɛyɛ dɛn ma nyia ɔbaa awo nono no ho bɛtsew?
Hwɛ, bosoom mpo nnyi hyerɛn, na nworaba ho nntsew wɔ n'enyi do:
Na akantam dasanyi a ɔyɛ nsaamaa yi! Na nyimpa ba a ɔyɛ abowaba yi!
26: Nna Job buae na ɔsee dɛ,
mbrɛ ɔwo esi na aboa nyia onnyi tum a! Mbrɛ ɔwo esi na agye abasa a onnyi ahoɔdzen nkwa a!
Mbrɛ ɔwo esi na apam nyia onnyi nyansa, na eyi nyimdzee mu a ɔdɔɔ sõ akyerɛ:
Na woana na ɔwo akã nsɛm akyerɛ no, na woana sunsum na ofi wo mu puei yi?
Hɔn a woewuwu ho popo wɔ nsu na no mu atsefo no ase.
Sheol dzi adagyaw wɔ n’enyim. Na ɔsɛɛ nnyi akataho.
Ɔno na ɔtserɛw kwaa mu kata bea kwawee do, na ɔdze asaase sɛn mbrɛ hwee nnyi.
Ɔno na ɔkyekyer nsu hyɛ no mununkum kebii mu; na mununkum mpaae wɔ n’ase.
Omunum ahengua enyim, na ɔtserɛw no mununkum mu kata ho.
Ɔno na oetwa he wɔ nsu enyi dze ekodu kan na sum ehyiae.
Ɔsor edum ho popo na hɔn ho bow hɔn wɔ ne nkaenyim ano.
Ɔno na ɔdze no tum nu po mu, na ɔnam ne ntseasee do bobɔ Rahab.
Ɔnam no sunsum do na sor hyehyɛ; ne nsa na oehwira abowatsena a no ho yɛ har no mu.
Hwɛ, iyinom nye n’akwan n’anoano: Na mbrɛ huhuhuhu a yɛtse no wɔ no ho dua suar a! Na no tum asenaman no dze, woana na obotum ase tse?
27: Na Job maa n’abɛbusɛm do bio, na ɔsee dɛ,
Dɛ Nyame a oeyi m’eyiedzi kɔ, na Otumfo no a oeyi me kra awerɛhow no, tse ase yi;
(Osiandɛ nkwa da ho yɛ mu wɔ mo mu, na Nyame nkwahwea wɔ m'ahwentokura mu;)
ampaara m’anofamfa rennkã nsɛmfun, nkyii so me tɛkyerɛma nnkɔbɔ ndaadaa dzin.
Nyame mpa ngu dɛ mubobu hom bem: Mirinnyi m’emudzi mmfi moho araa ma ekodu dɛ mubowu.
Medze me ndzeyɛtsenenee mu dzendzenndzen, na mirinngyaa mu: M’akoma nnsopa me mber tsentsen a metse ase yi.
Wɔmma me tamfo nyɛ dɛ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi, wɔmma nyia ɔsoɛr tsia me no nyɛ dɛ brakyewnyi.
Na dabrabanyi n’enyidado nye bɛn, aber a Nyame etwa no do, aber a oeyiyi ne kra kɔ no?
Ana Nyame betsie no sufrɛ, aber a ɔfona bɛba no do no?
Ana no ho bɛsɛpɛw no wɔ Otumfo no ho, na ɔafrɛ Nyame mber nyinara mu?
Mebɛkyerɛkyerɛ hom Nyame nsa do; dza ɔwɔ Otumfo ho no mirinnsiw do.
Hwɛ, hom nyinara homara woehu; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na hom ayɛ gyan dɛm yi?
Iyi nye nyimpa dzebɔnyɛnyi ne kyɛpɛn a onya no wɔ Nyame hɔ, na ahyɛdofo egyapadze a wonya no wɔ Otumfo no hɔ.
Sɛ ne mba dɔr a, wɔdɔr ma afõwa; na ne yafumba no edziban remmee hɔn.
Hɔn a wofi mu bɛka no wobesie hɔn wɔ owu mu, na ne mbaa ekunafo runntwa sukwadwom.
Sɛ ɔpra dwetɛ hyɛ kuw dɛ huntuma, na osiesie ntar dɛ dɛtse mpo a;
Ɔnodze obesiesie, na mbom ɔtseneneenyi na ɔdze bɛhyɛ, na nyia odzi bem no na ɔbɛkyɛ dwetɛ no mu.
Osi ne dan dɛ ebubumbaba, na ɔtse dɛ pata a ɔweɔmfo bɔ.
Ɔda hɔ dɛ ɔdzefo, na wɔrommboaboa no; obue n’enyiwa; na onnyi hɔ.
Ihu fa no dɛ nsu; anago na ehum wia no kɔ.
Boka mframa soa no kɔ, na ofi hɔ kɔ; na ɔpra no fi ne tsenabew.
Na Nyame bɔtow egu no do, na ɔrenngye no nkwa: Onya pɛ dɛ oguan fi ne nsamu.
Nkorɔfo bɔbobɔ hɔn nsamu egu no do, na wɔabobɔ no do nhwiroma etu no efi ne tsenabew akɔ.
28: Ampaara maa bi wɔ hɔ ma dwetɛ, na bea bi wɔ hɔ ma sika a wɔhor.
Dadze wotu no wɔ famu, na boran wɔnan fi ɔbo mu.
Wɔma sum wie: Na wɔhwehwɛ kodu ekyirkyirkyir sum kebii na owu no nwinwin mu abo.
Na otu maa kronn wɔ mbrɛ nyimpa tsetsee; anamɔn a otwa mu no werɛ fir hɔn; woefi nyimpa nkyɛn sensɛn ekyirkyir, woridzi adande.
Asaase dze, edziban fi mu ba: Na n’ase so wɔdan ba sor dɛ gya.
N’abo no mu nye sapphire-bo ne dabew, na ɔwɔ sikamfutuw so wɔ hɔ.
Ɔkwan no anoma edzinam bi nnyi mu, nkyii so ɔkom enyiwa nnhunii.
Ahantan mbowa nntsiatsiaa do, na so gyata bɔyafo nntwa mu hɔ.
Ɔtsen ne nsa kã ɔtwerɛbo botan; obutuw mbepɔw wɔ no ndwow mu.
Ɔno na otwitwa abotan mu akã; na n’enyiwa hu adze a ɔsom bo biara.
Ɔno na osisiw esutsen kwan ma ɔnnsosɔw; na adze a osuma no, ɔno na oyi pue kan mu.
Na nyansa dze, hen na wobohu? Na ntseasee ananmu so wɔ hen?
Dasanyi nnyim no bo; nkyii so wonnhu no wɔ atseasefo asaase do.
Bun dɔnkuronn no se dɛ, onnyi mo mu: Na po se dɛ, onnyi me nkyɛn.
Wɔmmfa sika mapa nnya, nkyii so wonnker dwetɛ mma ne tsibo.
Wɔmmfa Ophir sika nntwa ne tsibo, wɔmmfa onyɛ-bo a ɔsom bo, anaa sapphire-bo.
Sika na ahwehwɛ nnye no nnsɛ: Nkyii so wɔmmfa sika mapa n’edwindze nnsesa.
Wɔmmbɔ nankyenema anaa crystal dzin: Nyew, nyansa no bo sen mbota dze.
Ethiopia topaz-bo nnye no nnsɛ, nkyii so wɔmmfa sika mapa nntwa ne tsibo.
Henfa mbɔ na nyansa fi ba? Na ntseasee ananmu so wɔ henfa?
Ofir dɛ wɔdze esuma atseasefo nyinara enyiwa, na wɔdze akam sor ntumbowa.
Ɔsee na owu se dɛ, yɛdze hɛn aso atse ne nka.
Nyame na ɔtse no kwan ase, na ɔno na onyim ne tsenabew.
Na ɔno na ɔhwɛ asaase ewiei, na ohu sor nyina ase:
Aber a ɔhyɛɛ mframa dur too hɔ: Nyew, osusu nsu dɛ mbrɛ no nsusui tse no.
Aber a ɔhyɛɛ nyankom mom, na ɔyɛɛ kwan maa senaman n’enyinam no:
Nna ohunii, na ɔdaa no edzi; otsintsiim no, nyew, na ɔhwehwɛe puei.
Na ɔsee nyimpa dɛ, hwɛ, Ewuradze no suro, ɔno nye nyansa; na irifi mbusu ho nye ntseasee.
29: Na Job maa n’abɛbusɛm do bio, na ɔsee dɛ,
ao kɛtseankyɛ metse no dɛ nkan no abosoom no mu, dɛ nda no a Nyame hwɛɛ mo do wɔ mu no;
Aber a ne kandzea hyerɛnee wɔ m’etsifi, na medze ne kan menantsewee wɔ sum mu no;
dɛ mbrɛ metse wɔ me beree nda no mu, aber a Nyame n’esumadze wɔ m’asesee do no;
aber a Otumfo no da ho wɔ me nkyɛn, na me mba so bɔ mo ho aprɔw no;
aber a medze buter fɔw m’anan ho, na botan hue ngo esutsen dze me no!
Aber a mifiir edzi mokɔr kuropon ano, aber a misiesiee m’egua wɔ abɔntsen do a,
mberantsɛ hun me na wɔdze hɔnho sumae, na nkɔdaa soɛree gyinagyinae;
mbapomba gyaa kasa, na wɔdze hɔn nsa totoo hɔn ano;
mbakomba ndze taa dzinn, na hɔn tɛkyerɛma femfaam hɔn anomu.
Na aber a asowa tsee no, nna ohyiraa me; na aber a enyiwa hun me no. nna odzii me dase;
osiandɛ megyee ohianyi a osū frɛ, egyanka no so a onnyi bi a ɔbɔboa no no.
Nyia ɔreyɛ ahera no ne nhyira baa mo do: Na memaa ɔbaa kunafo n’akoma toow ehurusi ndwom.
Mufuraa ndzeyɛtsenenee, na ɔkataa mo ho, me pɛrpɛr tse dɛ ahentar na abɔtsir.
Meyɛɛ enyiwa dze maa onyifurafo, na meyɛɛ anan dze maa apakye.
Meyɛɛ egya dze maa hianyi: Na nyia minnyim no no n’asɛm mohwehwɛɛ mu.
Na mubuu brakyewnyi adadaw, na muhwiim afonam no fii ne sē mu
Nna mesee dɛ, mubowu wɔ me berɛbuw mu, na mebɛma me nda adɔɔ sõ dɛ anhwea:
Mo ndwow atsen kɔ nsu ho, na bɔsu so tɔ gu m’abaw do anago nyinara.
M’enyimnam yɛ fofor wɔ mo mu, na m’egyen dan fofor wo me nsamu.
Emi na nkorɔfo yɛɛ aso maa me, na wɔtweɔnee, na wɔyɛɛ komm tsiee m’apam.
Me nsɛm ekyir wɔannkasa bio, na me kasaa tɔɔ hɔn do.
Na wɔtweɔɔn me dɛ wɔrotweɔn nyankom; na wobuee hɔn anomu tɛtɛɛtɛr dɛ wɔregye bɛsɛ nsu.
Sɛ meserew mekyerɛ hɔn a, wɔnngye nndzi; na m’enyim ne ntsewee no wɔnntow nnkyen famu.
Mesaan mu yii hɔn kwan, na metsenaa dɛ tsitsir, na metsenaa dɛ ɔhen wɔ dɔm mu, dɛ obi a ɔkyekye nkɔmbɔdzifo werɛ.
30: Na afei hɔn a wɔyɛ mbofra sen me sereserew me, hɔn a mopoow hɔn egyanom dɛ medze hɔn mebɛhyɛ mo nguankuw nkraman mu no,
nyew, hɔn nsamu tum no, ebɛn mfaso na ɔbɛyɛ me? Nyimpa a hon mu ahoodzen asã.
Hia na kɔm ntsi wɔafomfɔn; wɔwewe asaase kɛsɛɛ do wɔ sɛɛ na amamfõ kusuw mu.
Wɔtsetsew nkyen-haban wɔ ndua do: Na sar do mfuwamfuwa ndwow nye hɔn edziban.
Woetu hɔn efi nyimpa mu; wɔpɔw dzi hɔn ekyir dɛ wodzi wifo ekyir.
Bɔnsa mu a hɔ yɛ hu na wɔtsetsee, wɔ asaase na abotan etu mu.
Ndua ntamu na wosū dɛ asoaso, nsason ase na wɔsam.
Wɔyɛ dɛ egyangyantwimba, nyew, nyimpa a wonnyi dzin mba a; wɔpaam hɔn fii asaase no do.
Na afei mabeyɛ hɔn ndwom, nyew, mabeyɛ fen mama hɔn.
Mo ho yɛ hɔn nkɔw, wɔbɔ me kyɛ kegyina nkyɛn, na wɔnnkam dɛ wɔbɔto m’enyim ntafi mpo.
Osiandɛ ɔasan m’ahoma na oehiahia mo ho, na wɔatow menyiamfrɛ no akyen wɔ m’enyim.
M’enyimfa do na nkusiwa no soɛr wosun m’anan fa nkyɛn, na woyi hɔn sɛɛ akwan ba mo do.
Wɔseɛɛ mo kwan, wɔyɛ ma mo mbusu da edzi, mekyerɛ nyimpa a wonnyi aboafo.
Wɔba dɛ wɔnam tokur a ɔtrɛ mu: Wopirew hɔnho ba mo do wɔ efitu no mu.
Hu adan aba mo do, wɔpam m’enyidzii dɛ mframa; na me yieyɛ etwa mu kɔ dɛ mununkum.
Na afei me kra ehue egu mo mu; ahohiahia nda esusuo mo mu.
Anagober me mbiew mu wɔ mo mu, na yaw no a ɔwewe me no nngyaa.
Me yarba ne dzendzen ntsi m’atar asakyer: Ɔkyekyer mo ho dɛ sortar no kɔn.
Ɔatotow me akyen adɛtsebir mu, na madan dɛ dɛtse na nso.
Musū mefrɛ wo, na ɔwo nngye me do: Migyina hɔ, na ɔwo ehwɛ me hann.
Ɔwo adan ayɛ etsiɔdzen wɔ mo do; ɔwo edze wo nsa a ɔyɛ dzen nye me dzi esi.
Ɔwo na ama me do ma mframa, ɔwo na ema metsena do tutu kɔ; na ɔwo na enan me wɔ ehum mu.
Na minyim dɛ ɔwo edze me bɛma owu, na fi a wɔahyɛ ama atseasefo nyinara mu.
Ampaara ɔrenntsen ne nsa nnkã efitu ahyɛmukuw; kaansa ɔyɛ ne sɛɛ mpo a, osian iyinom ntsi obi bosū afrɛ.
Ana mennsū mamma nyia ɔwɔ fona mu? Ana me kra werɛ annhow wɔ hianyi ntsi?
Aber a m’enyi da papa kwan no, nna bɔn aba; na aber a morotweɔn kan no, nna sum aba.
M’ayamudze hur, na ɔnnhom; ahohiahia nda aba mo do
Mebir tumm nenam na ommfir ewia: Migyina bagua no mu, na metsēa mu frɛ mboa.
Mayɛ nua ama mpataku, na damfo ama nsohor.
Mo wer ebir, na orifi mo ho, na ahohur rehyew me mbiew.
Dɛm ntsi me nsankutsen adan nkɔmbɔdzi, na m’atɛntɛbɛn adan hɔn a wosū ndze.
31: Menye m'enyiwa dzii ahyɛmu; ɔbɛyɛ dɛn mbɔ na mobɔhwɛ ababaawa?
Na ebɛnadze nye Nyame ne kyɛfa a ofi sor, na Otumfo no n’egyapadze a ofi sorsor?
Ana ɔnnyɛ mbusu mma brakyewnyi. Na amandzehu so mma emumuyɛfo?
Ana nnyɛ ɔno na ohu m’akwan, na ɔkan m’anamɔntutu nyinara?
Sɛ medzi egyangyandze ekyir, na m’anan apɛ ntsɛm wɔ ndaadaa ho a;
(Wɔmma wonker me wɔ nokwar nsɛn mu, ma Nyame eehu me tsenenee;ɔ
Sɛ m'anamɔn adan efi kwan no do, na m'akoma dzi m’enyi ekyir nantsew, na sɛ nkekaa bi fam me nsa ho a:
Ɔnodze wɔmma mundua, na bi so ndzi, nyew, womma wontutu me haban mu ndɔbaa ngu.
Sɛ wɔadaadaa m’akoma akɔ baa bi ho, na makɛtsɛw me nyɛnko abowano a:
Ɔnodze wɔmma me yer nyam mma obi, na wobi so mbutuw no do.
Na ɔno na ɔyɛ ewudzisɛm kɛse; nyew, ɔno na ɔyɛ emumuyɛ a ntsɛmbuafo tua ho kaw bɔn.
Na ɔno na ɔyɛ gya a ɔhyew kɔ ɔsɛɛ mu, na nkyɛ obotutu mo ndɔbaa nyinara.
Sɛ mubuu m'akowaa anaa m’afonabaa asɛm enyimtsia, nber a wɔnye me kasakasae a:
Ebɛnadze mbɔ na sɛ Nyame soɛr a mebɛyɛ? Na sɛ ɔbɛsera a, ebɛn mbuae na medze mubobua no?
Ana nnyɛ nyia ɔyɛɛ me wɔ yafun mu no na ɔyɛɛ no? Ana nnyɛ obi na osinsiaan hɛn wɔ yafun mu?
Sɛ mesianka ehiafo efi hɔn ahwehwɛdze ho, anaa mama ɔbaa kunafo enyi ebu;
anaa mankotoo medzi mo trɔma, na egyanka enndzi mu bi a;
(Dabida, ofi me mbafober mu na ɔnye me nyiin dɛ n’egya, na mifi me nã yamu na mayɛ no kwankyerɛfo);
Sɛ mehu obi a tam abɔ no ntsi ma ɔrehera, anaadɛ ɔkɔhweaban dɛ onnyi akataho a;
sɛ n’asen mu ennhyira me, na sɛ nnyɛ mo nguan ho nhwi na wɔdze bɔɔ no hyew a,
sɛ mama me nsa do etsia egyanka, osiandɛ muhun mo mboa wɔ kuropon mu a:
Ɔnodze wɔmma m’abatsir nhuan mfi abatsir biew no mu, na m’abasa mbubu mfi ne biew do.
Na amandzehu a ofi Nyame hɔ yɛɛ hu dze maa me, na ne kɛseyɛ ntsi, menntum hwee yɛ
Sɛ medze sika mayɛ m'enyidado, na mase sika mapa dɛ, ɔwo nye m'awerɛhyɛmu;
sɛ m'enyi gyee dɛ m'ahodze yɛɛ kɛse ntsi, na dɛ me nsa kãa no dodow ntsi;
sɛ mohwɛɛ ewia wɔ ber a ɔhyerɛnee, anaa ɔbosoom dɛ ɔnam ne hyerɛn mu;
na wɔadaadaa m’akoma nsumaa mu, na m’ano efew me nsa ho a:
Iyi so yɛ emumuyɛ bi a atsɛmbuafo tua ho kaw, na nkyɛ mibedzi ator akyerɛ Nyame a ɔwɔ sor no,
sɛ m’enyi gyee nyia okyir me no ne sɛɛ ho, anaa memaa moho do wɔ aber a mbusu too no a;
(Nyew, mamma m’ano kwan ma ɔannyɛ bɔn, Dɛ medze ndom mibebisa no nkwa);
sɛ m’asesee mu nyimpa annse dɛ, woana na obotum ehu obi a no honam ammee no?
Ɔhoho no annsoɛ abɔntsen do; mbom mubuebuee mo mbobow maa kwantsennyi;
sɛ mekataa me mbrato do dɛ Adam, dɛ medze m’emumuyɛ musumaa mo bo mu;
osiandɛ musuroo nyimpadodow kɛse no ntsi, na ebusua ebusua enyimtsiabu yii me hu, ma meyɛɛ komm, na memmfir edzi emmpue abowano
Ao kɛtseankyɛ meenya obi a obetsie me: (Hwɛ, me nsewhyɛdze nye yi, wɔmma Otumfo no mbua me); na nkyɛ me nsa nka odunwoma no a me tamfo no akyerɛw no!
Ampaara nkyɛ medze bɔto me batsir do; nkyɛ medze mebɛkyekyer moho dɛ abɔtsir.
Nkyɛ mebɛkã m’anamɔn nododow akyerɛ no; nkyɛ mobɔtwe mepin no dɛ ɔhenba.
Sɛ m'asaase tsēatsea mu tsia me, na n’akɔfikã bɔ mu sū a;
sɛ mekwetsir sika medzi n'amba bi, anaa mama no wuranom ahwer hɔn nkwa a:
Wɔmma nsoɛ mfifir nhyɛ ewifua ananmu, na nkyɛkyɛr nhyɛ atoko ananmu. Job ne nsɛm no abɔ adze.
32: Nna mbarimba baasa yi gyaa Job bua, osiandɛ ɔyɛ tseneneenyi wɔ nankasa n’enyi do.
Nna Buzinyi Barachel ba Elihu a ofi Ram ebusua mu no, n’ebufuw dzɛwee: Job na n’ebufuw dzɛɛw no do, osiandɛ obuu noho tseneneenyi seen Nyankopɔn.
Na no bo fuuw ne mfɛfo baasa no so; osiandɛ woennya mbuae biara bio, naaso na woebu Job fɔ.
Afei na Elihu atweɔn na ɔaakasa akyerɛ Job, osiandɛ hɔn wɔyɛ mpanyin sen ɔno.
Na aber a Elihu hun dɛ mbuae nnyi mbarimba baasa no anomu bio no, nna n'ebufuw dzɛwee,
Nna Buzinyi Barachel ba Elihu buae na ɔsee dɛ, meyɛ abofra, na homdze wɔyɛ nkɔdaa; dɛm ntsi na mikyinkyimii, na mammper dɛ mebɛkyerɛ hom m’adwen.
Mesee dɛ, ndafua bɛkasa, na mfe dodow bɛkyerɛkyerɛ nyansa.
Mbom sunsum bi wɔ nyimpa mu, na Otumfo no no honhom na ɔma hɔn ntseasee.
Nnyɛ akɛsefo na wɔyɛ enyansafo, nkyii so nnyɛ hɔn a woenyin na wɔtse atsɛmbusɛm ase.
Dɛm ntsi na mesee dɛ, hom ntsie me; mo so mebɛkyerɛ m’adwen.
Hwɛ, motweɔɔn hom nsɛm, meyɛɛ aso memaa hom ntsɛnyiyi, mber a hom rohwehwɛ dza wɔbɛse no.
Nyew, mekyɛɛn aso memaa hom, na hwɛ, obiara nnyi hɔ a n’ano bɔɔ Job.
Hom nhwɛ yie ma hom annse dɛ, yeehu nyansa; Nyame na ɔbɔ no gu, nnyɛ nyimpa a:
Na ɔnnhyehyɛɛ ne nsɛm nntsiaa me; nkyii so meremmfa hom nsɛm mu mbua no.
Hɔn ho abow hɔn, wommbua bio: Wonnyi asɛm kor mpo kã.
Na montweɔn, osiandɛ wɔnnkasa ntsi, osiandɛ wogyina hɔ dzinn, na wommbua bio ntsi?
Emi so mubobua m’afamu dze, emi so mebɛkyerɛ m’adwen.
Na nsɛm ahyɛ me mã; sunsum a ɔwɔ mo mu no hyɛ me.
Hwɛ, me yafun tse dɛ nsã a wonntuu ano; ɔtse dɛ nsã nwoma-nkotoku afofor a ɔreyɛ apaapaa.
Mebɛkasa, ma mo ho atɔ me; mubobue m'anofamfa na mebua.
Meserɛ hom, mma mma monnhwɛ nyimpa biara enyim; nkyii so meremmfa abɔdzin ndzɛfɛdzɛfɛw memma nyimpa biara.
Na minnyim abɔdzin ndzɛfɛdzɛfɛw ma, ɔnodze nkyɛ me yɛfo bɛfa me akɔ ntsɛmara.
33: Naaso, meserɛ wo, Job, tsie me kasaa, na yɛ aso ma me nsɛm nyinara.
Afei hwɛ, mebue m'ano, me tɛkyerɛma rekasa wɔ m'adadaw mu.
Me nsɛm bɛkã m'akoma ne tsenyɛ: Na dza m'anofamfa nyim no wɔbɛkã no kotoo.
Nyame no sunsum na ɔyɛɛ me, na Otumfo no no honhom na ɔmaa me nkwa.
Sɛ ibotum a, bua me; siesie wo nsɛm yie wɔ m'enyim, soɛr gyina.
Hwɛ, mowɔ Nyame afamu dɛ woara: Mo so awendɛtse na wɔdze yɛɛ me.
Hwɛ, m'ahohu remma innsuro, nkyii so mo nkomdo rennyɛ wo do dur.
Ampaara ɔwo akasa wɔ m'asomu, na matse wo nsɛm ndze, dɛ,
mo ho tsew, mbrato nnyi mo ho; midzi bem, nkyii so emumuyɛ bi nnyi mo mu:
Hwɛ, ɔhwehwɛ mansosɛm bi etsia me, obu me dɛ ne tamfo;
ɔdze m'anan ahyehyɛ mpokyerɛ mu, ɔhyɛ m'akwan nyinara nsew.
Hwɛ, murubua wo, iyi mu na enntsen: Osiandɛ Nyame sõ sen dasanyi.
ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔwo nye no perper? Osiandɛ ommbu ne nsɛm biara ho nkontaa.
Osiandɛ Nyame kasa prɛko, nyew mprenu, sɛ nyimpa nndwen ho mpo a.
Adaaso mu, anago enyido-adzehu mu, aber a nda heii atɔ adasa do, mpa do nkomtɔ mu;
nna obue adasa aso, na ɔsɔw hɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ ano,
ama ɔaatwe nyimpa aasan efi ne ndzeyɛɛ ho, na oeeyi nkontompɔ efi nyimpa ho esuma;
Ɔno na ɔtwe ne kra ekyir fi mona mu, na no nkwa so fi afõwa ano wu mu.
Wɔdze yaw so tsia no wɔ ne mpa do, na ne mbiew mu daa aperper:
Na no nkwa kyir edziban, na ne kra kyir adɔkɔdɔkɔ edziban.
No honam wew, ma wonnhu; na ne mbiew a wonnhu no puepue.
Nyew, ne kra twe bɛn mona no, na no nkwa so bɛn asɛɛfo no.
Sɛ bɔfo bi wɔ ne nkyɛn, ɔkyeame bi, apem mu ɔbaako bi, dɛ ɔrekyerɛ nyimpa dza ɔtsen ma no a;
nna ɔhu no mbɔbɔr, na ɔse dɛ, gye no fi maa no mu nkɔree mu, mehu apondze.
No honam bɛyɛ fɔrfɔr asen abofra dze; ɔsan kɔ ne mberantsɛber nda mu:
Ɔbɔ Nyame mpaa, na n'enyi sɔ no: Ma ɔdze ehurusi hu n'enyim: Na ɔdan dasanyi ne tsenenee ma no.
Ɔno na ɔtow ndwon wɔ nyimpa enyim, na ɔse dɛ, mayɛ bɔn, na makyeakyea dza ɔtsen, na ɔannyɛ me mfaso:
Ɔno na ɔagye me kra efi maa no mu nkɔree mu. Na mo nkwa bɔhwɛ kan.
Hwɛ, yinom nyinara na Nyame yɛ, mprɛnu, nyew mprɛnsa, wɔ nyimpa ho,
dɛ ɔdze ne kra bɛsan ofi maa no ho, ma wɔdze nkwa kan aadan no kan.
Hyɛ no nsew yie, Job, tsie me: Mua w'ano, na menkasa.
Sɛ ewɔ asɛm bi kã a, bua me: Kasa, na mepɛ dɛ mubu wo bem.
Sɛ ɔnntse dɛm a, ɔno tsie mara: Mua w'ano, na menkyerɛ wo nyansa.
34: Nkyii so Elihu buae na ɔsee dɛ,
enyansafo, hom ntsie me nsɛm; na hom a wɔwɔ nyimdzee, hom mma me aso.
Na asowa na ɔsɔ nsɛm hwɛ, dɛ mbrɛ adadaw so sɔ edziban hwɛ no.
Wɔmma yɛnsan mu nyi dza ɔtsen mma hɛnho: Wɔmma yenhu dza oye wɔ hɛnara hɛn mu.
Osiandɛ Job ase dɛ, metsen, na Nyame agye me bem kɔ:
Naaso me bem mu ara na woebu me torfo; m’epirakur nnyi edur, kaansa mbrato nnyi mo mu mpo a.
Ɔbarimba bɛn na ɔtse dɛ Job a ɔnom emumuyɛ de nsu?
Nyia ɔkɔ emumuyɛ anyɛnkoyɛ mu, na ɔnye nyimpa bɔn nantsew.
Osiandɛ ɔase dɛ, ɔnnyɛ mfaso biara mma nyimpa; dɛ ɔnye Nyame bɔbɔ awɛ.
Dɛm ntsi mbarimba a hom wɔ ntseasee, hom ntsie me: Ɔmpar Nyame, dɛ ɔbɛyɛ ndzebɔnyɛ; na Otumfo no, dɛ ɔbɛyɛ emumuyɛ.
Osiandɛ nyimpa n’edwuma ho kaw na otua no, na ɔma nyimpa biara nya no dɛ mbrɛ n’akwan tse.
Nyew, ampaara, Nyame rennyɛ adzebɔn. Nkyii so Otumfo no rennkyea atsɛmbu.
Woana na ɔdze asaase hyɛ ne nsa? Anaa woana na oesiesie wiadze nyina?
Sɛ ɔdze n’akoma si noara no do, sɛ ɔtwe no sunsum na n’ahom ba noara ne nkyɛn a;
nkyɛ honam nyinara bɔbɔ mu ahera; na nyimpa asan akɔ huntuma mu bio
Afei sɛ ewɔ ntseasee a, tsie yi: Yɛ aso ma me nsɛm ndze.
Aso obi a okyir pɛrpɛr bɔhwɛ aman do? Na ɔwo ibobu nyia ɔtsen na ɔyɛ katakyi no fɔ?
Ana ɔfata dɛ wɔbɛse ɔhen dɛ, ohuhunyi nye wo? Anaa ekunyin dɛ, ndzebɔnyɛfo nye hom.
Na burbur nyia ɔmnmfer mbapɔmba enyim, na so ommbu obirɛmpon bi nnsen kɔhweaban? Na hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ ne nsaano edwuma.
Amonmu ara na wowu, mekyerɛ esuom a; ɔman no hihim na wɔsen kɔ, na akatakyi no wɔpra hɔn kɔ, wɔnndze nsa.
Na n’enyiwa wɔ nyimpa n’akwan do, na ohu no nkɔree nyinara.
Sum bi nnyi hɔ, na owu nwinwin bi so nnyi hɔ, mbrɛ emumuyɛfo dze hɔnho bosuma.
Na onnhia no biara dɛ ɔbɔdwen nyimpa ho bio, ma ɔaakɔ Nyame enyim atsɛmbu mu.
Obubu akatakyi mu esinesin wɔ akwan a wɔnnhwehwɛ no mu, na odze wobinom hyehyɛ hɔn ananmu.
Dɛm ntsi ɔhyɛ hɔn ndwuma nsew; na obutuw hɔn anago, ma wɔsɛɛ.
Ɔbobɔ hɔn dɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo; wɔ nyimpa enyi do petee;
osiandɛ wofii n’ekyir danee faa nkyɛn, na wɔammpɛ dɛ wobu n’akwan biara bi.
Ma wɔama hianyi ne nkekamu edu ne nkyɛn, na ɔatse amandzehufo nkekamu.
Sɛ ɔno ma ahodwe a, woana mbɔ na obotum ebu fɔ? Na sɛ ɔdze n’enyim suma a, woana mbɔ na obotum ahwɛ no? Sɛ wɔreyɛ ama man o, nyimpa baako o, pɛr:
Ma ennsuro-nyame nyimpa no eenndzi hen, ma obi eennsua man no efir.
Na aso obi see Nyame dɛ, masɔw ntsēa, na morommfom bio:
Dza munnhu no, woara kyerɛkyerɛ me: Sɛ mayɛ emumuyɛdze a, merennyɛ bio.
Aso n’akatua bɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ woara epɛ, ma eropow yi? Osiandɛ ɔwo na ewɔ dɛ esan mu yi, na nnyɛ emi a: Dɛm ntsi dza woara inyim no, kã.
Nyimpa a wɔwɔ ntseasee no bɛse me dɛ, nyew, nyimpa nyansafo a otsie me no bɛse me dɛ:
Job kwetsir nyimdzee kasa, na nyansa nnyi ne nsɛm mu.
Kɛtseankyɛ wɔaasɔ Job ahwɛ ekodu ewiei, osian mbuae a ɔtse dɛ emumuyɛfo dze ntsi.
Osiandɛ ɔdze etuatsew kã no bɔn ho, ɔbɔ ne nsamu wɔ hɛn mu, na ɔma ne nsɛm dɔɔ sõ tsia Nyame.
35: Nhyii so Elihu buae na ɔsee dɛ,
ana ɔwo edwen yi dɛ wo ndzinoa, anaa ese dɛ, me tsenenee sen Nyame dze,
ma ɔwo ese dɛ, ebɛn yie na ɔbɛyɛ ama wo? Na, ebɛn mfaso na mibenya, asen dɛ meyɛɛ bɔn?
Mubobua wo, na wo mfɛfo a wɔkã wo ho no.
Hwɛ sor, na hu; na hwɛ wimu a ɔkrɔn sen wo no.
Sɛ ayɛ bɔn a, ebɛnadze na eyɛ tsia no? Na sɛ wo mbrato dɔɔ sõ a, ebɛnadze na edze yɛ no?
Sɛ ɔwo etsen a, ebɛnadze na edze ma no? Anaa ebɛnadze na ɔgye no wɔ wo nsamu?
Nyimpa a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo na wo ndzeyɛɛbɔn bɛkã no; na nyimpa ba na wo tsenenee bɛyɛ no mfaso.
Ahohiahia dodow ntsi na ɔma wosū frɛ; akatakyi basa ntsi na ɔma wosū frɛ mboa.
Naaso obi nnse dɛ, ehen na mo Bɔfo Nyame wɔ, nyia ɔma ndwom anago;
nyia ɔkyerɛkyerɛ hɛn sen asaase do mbowa, na ɔyɛ hɛn enyansafo sen sor ntumbowa?
Ehɔ na wosū frɛ, na obi nngye do, osian nyimpa bɔn hɔn nkontompɔ ntsi.
Ampaara Nyame rinntsie egyangyansɛm, nkyii so Otumfo no rummbu no hwee.
Na akantam mber a ɔwo erese dɛ ɔwo nnhu no no, asɛm no da n'enyim, na ɔwo etweɔn noara.
Na afei, osiandɛ ɔmmbɛserae wɔ n'ebufuw mu, nkyii so ommbu ahopɔw hweeara no;
Dɛm ntsi na Job bue n'ano wɔ egyangyansɛm mu; okwetsir nyimdzee ɔma nsɛm dɔɔ sõ.
36: Elihu kɔr enyim so, na ɔsee dɛ,
ma me kwan kakra, na menkyerɛ wo; osiandɛ mowɔ asɛm bi so kã wɔ Nyame afamu.
Mebɛfa me nyimdzee wɔ ekyirkyir, na mebu mo Bɔfo no bem.
Na nokwar, me nsɛm nnyɛ akɔhwi: Obi a odzi mu wɔ nyimdzee mu nye wo wɔ hɔ.
Hwɛ, Nyame yɛ ɔkɛse na ommbu biara enyimtsia; ɔyɛ katakyi wɔ ntseasee anoɔdzen mu.
Ɔnnkora ndzebɔnyɛfo hɔn nkwa do: Mbom ɔdze ahohiahiafo bem ma hɔn.
Onnyi n'enyiwa mmfi atseneneefo do: Mbom wɔnye ahemfo wɔ ahengua do, na ɔma wɔtsena do daa, na wɔama hɔn do.
Na sɛ wogu hɔn wɔ mpokyerɛ mu, na wɔdze ahohiahia ahoma kyer hɔn a;
nna ɔkyerɛ hɔn hɔn edwuma, na hɔn mbrato, dɛ wɔamena hɔnho do.
Obue hɔn aso so dze ma nkyerɛkyerɛ, na ɔhyɛ dɛ wɔnsan mfi emumuyɛ mu.
Sɛ wotsie na wɔsom no a, wobedzi hɔn nda wɔ prɔmprɔmyɛ mu, na hɔn mfe so wɔ enyigye mu.
Na woekwetsir nyimdzee ewuwu.
Na hɔn a wɔyɛ akoma mu ennsuronyamefo boaboa ebufuw ano: Sɛ ɔkyekyer hɔn a, wonnsū mmfrɛ mboa.
Wowu wɔ mberantsɛber mu, na hɔn nkwa hera wɔ ahoɔfifo mu.
Ɔnam n ahohiahia do oyi ahohiahiafo, na obue hɔn aso wo atseetsee mu.
Nyew, ɔpɛɛ dɛ ogya wo fi ahohia mu; kɔ bea tɛtɛr bi do, mbrɛ ahokyer nnyi hɔ; na seradze ayɛ dza wɔdze si wo pon do no mã.
Na mbom ndzebɔnyɛfo atsɛmbu ayɛ wo mã: Atsɛmbu na pɛrpɛr ata esuo wo mu.
Osiandɛ ebufuw wɔ hɔ ntsi, hwɛ yie ɔno bɛyɛ na w’ahonya egya wo kɔ; nkyii so mma mma mpatadze ne kɛseyɛ nndan wo mmfa nkyɛn.
Ana w’ahonya bɔsõ mu, dɛ ɔwo nnkɔkɔ ahohia mu, anaa w’ahoɔdzen tum nyinara?
Mma mmper anago ho, sɛ worutwitwa aman efi hɔn ananmu a.
Hwɛ yie, mma nngye emumuyɛ enyi: Na yi na ɔwo asan mu eyi mbom ma asen ahohiahia.
Hwɛ, Nyame yɛ no tum mu akɛsedze: Woana na ɔyɛ kyerɛkyerɛfo tse dɛ ɔno?
Woana na ɔdze no kwan ahyɛ no do? Anaa woana botum ase dɛ, ɔwo ayɛ emumuyɛ?
Kaa dɛ ebɛkamfo n'edwuma, dza nyimpa atow ho ndwom no.
Nyimpa nyinara ahwɛ ara; dasanyi hwɛ no ekyirkyir.
Hwɛ, Nyame sõ, na yennyim no; ne mfe no dodow nnyi nhwehwɛmu.
Na ɔno na ɔtwe nsu atɔw atɔw a ofi n’ehubɔhubɔw mu sosɔw tɔ nyankom:
Dza wimu hue gu famu na ɔsosɔw gu nyimpa do pii.
Nyew, ana obi botum atse mununkum ne ntserɛwmu ase, n’ehuntae mu asenaman no?
Hwɛ, ɔtserɛw ne kan mu; na ɔkata po n’ase do.
Na ɔnam yinom do na obu aman atsɛn; ɔno na ɔdze edziban piigyan ma.
Ɔdze enyinam katakata ne nsa ho; na ɔhyɛ no mbra ma ɔtow bɔ botae no.
No mbobɔmu no kã no ho asɛm, mbowakuw so kã asɛm wɔ ehum a ɔreba ho.
37: M'akoma popo wɔ iyi ho, na otutu fi n'ananmu.
Hom ntsie ne ndze ne dede, na ndze a ofi n'anomu fir no.
Ɔnoara na ogyaa mu wɔ sor nyina ase, na n'enyinam kodu asaase ewiei.
N'ekyir no na ndze bi bobɔ mu; ɔdze no tumdzi ndze no tow asenaman: Na sɛ wɔtse ne ndze a, onnsianka hɔn.
Nyame dze ne ndze tow asenaman nwanwa mu; ndzɛmba akɛseakɛse na ɔyɛ a yenntum nntse ase.
Na ɔse esukwankyɛba dɛ, tɔ asaase do; nyankom no nsutɔree, na n'ahoɔdzen nyankom nsu akɛse no so dɛmara.
Ɔno na ɔsɔɔw nyimpa biara ne nsaano: Ama nyimpa a ɔayɛ hɔn no nyinara eehu.
Nna mbowadoma kɔ hɔn sumabew, na wɔtsenatsena hɔn etu mu.
Pomu afamu pia no mu na ehum ba: Na awɔw so fi kwaamu afamu.
Ɔnam Nyame n'ehuhuw do na wɔdze nsubo ma; na nsu no ne tɛtɛr no ada.
Nyew, fɔɔfɔɔ ara na ɔdze soa mununkum kebii no. Ɔtsɛw n'enyinam mununkum no mu tɛtɛr:
Na ɔnam no kwankyerɛ do dandan bɔ aprɔw, ama wɔaayɛ biribiara a ɔhyɛ hɔn, wɔ wiadze a wɔtsena mu a ɔyɛ no n'enyi:
Sɛ ɔdze ma nkyerɛkyerɛ o, ɔdze ma asaase o, ɔdze ma adɔyɛ o, ɔyɛ ma ɔba.
Job, tsie iyi: Gyina dzinn, na dwen Nyame n'anwanwa dwuma ho.
Ana ɔwo inyim mbrɛ Nyame dze ne mbra soa hɔn, na ɔma no mununkum mu enyinam hyerɛn?
Ana ɔwo inyim mununkum nkerii, nyia odzi mu wɔ nyimdzee mu no n’anwanwa dwuma no?
Mbrɛ wo ntar mu si yɛ hyew, aber a osian pomu afamu mframa ntsi, ma asaase ayɛ dzinn no?
Ana ɔwo ibotum enye no atsɛw wimu a ɔyɛ dzen dɛ ahwehwɛ a woegu?
Kyɛre hɛn dza yɛnkã nkyereɛno; na osian sum ntsi yerunntum nnhyehyɛ hɛn kasaa.
Ana wɔnkã nkyerɛ no dɛ mepɛ maakasa? Anaa nyimpa bi pɛ dɛ wɔmen no?
Na afei nyimpa nntum nnhwɛ kan aber a ɔayɛ hyɛnn wɔ wimu no: Aber a mframa etwa mu, na ɔama hɔ atsew no.
Kwaamu afamu na sika senasena fi ba: Nyame wɔ tumdzi a ɔyɛ hu wɔ no do.
Otumfo no ho dze, yerunntum nnhu no; ɔyɛ abɔso wɔ tum mu: Na ɔrenntseetsee wɔ atsɛmbu na pɛrpɛr dodow mu.
Dɛm ntsi nyimpa suro no: Ommbu hɔn a wɔyɛ akoma mu enyansafo bi.
38: Na Ewuradze fi ehum no mu buaa Job, na ɔsee dɛ,
woara nye nyia obir apam enyi, ɔnam nsɛm a nyimdzee nnyi mu do yi?
Afei bɔ w’asen do dɛ barimba; na mibebisa wo, na kã kyerɛ me.
Aber a motoo asaase ne fapem no na ɔwo ewɔ hen? Sɛ ewɔ ntseasee a, kã ɛ.
Woana na ɔdze no nsusui too hɔ, sɛ inyim a? Anaa woana na ɔtseen ahoma mu wɔ do?
Ebɛnadze do na wɔdze ne fapem tsintsimii? Anaa woana na ɔdze kutuwdobo no toe?
Aber a adzekyee nworaba bɔɔ mu toow ndwom, na Nyame mba nyinara bɔɔ ose wɔ enyigye ntsi no?
Anaa woana na ɔtotoow po mbobow mu. Aber a obui faa do, dɛ gyama ofi yafun mu rupue no;
Aber a medze mununkum meyɛɛ n’akataho; na sum kebii so meyɛɛ n’abɔyamu no,
na mehyehyɛɛ mo mom maa no, na misisii adaban na mbobow,
na mesee dɛ, eha yi na bra bodu, na enntra, na eha ara na w’asorɛkye ntsɛnntsɛn no mbegyina, no?
Ana ofitsi dɛ wo nda hyɛɛ ase yi ahyɛ anapa do pɛn, na ama adzekyee ehu ne dzibew;
ama ɔaata esuo asaase n’atsaban mu, na wɔaapopo ndzebɔnyɛfo efi do?
Ɔadan dɛ dɛtse a ɔhyɛ nsɔwano ase; na ndzɛmba nyinara sisi hɔ dɛ ntar:
Na hɔn kan no wɔdze akam ndzebɔnyɛfo, na abasa a wɔama do no woebu mu.
Ana akɛhɛn po no nsunyiwa mu? Anaa anantsew bun adɔdoadɔdowmu?
Ana woeyi wu no mbobotsen do akyerɛ wo? Anaa ehu wu no nwinwin mbobotsen no?
Ana ehu asaase ne tɛtɛr mu? Sɛ inyim ne nyinara a, kã ɛ.
Ehen na kwan a wɔdze kɔ kan tsenabew wɔ, na sum so, n'ananmu wɔ hen?
Ma ɔwo edze bɔkɔ ne he do, na ɔwo ahyɛ ne fi ho akwan no nsew?
Ampa, ɔwoara inyim, na mber do na wɔawo wo, na wo nda no dodow sõ!
Ana akɛhɛn esukwankyɛba no korabea, nnaa ehu sorbo no korabea no,
dza makora do mesie fona mber, mama kõ na sa da no?
Ebɛn kwan na kan nam do hyerɛn, dza ɔdze boka mframa bɔ asaase do no?
Woana na oeyiyi akã ama nsuyirii, anaa kwan ama senaman n'enyinam no;
dɛ ɔbɛma nyankom atɔ mbrɛ nyimpa nnyi no do; sar a nyimpa nnyi mu no do,
dɛ ɔbɛma daadzehun amamfõ no amee; na ɔama mfunoma no afefɛw?
Ana nyankom wɔ egya? Anaa woana na ɔawo bɔsu a ɔsosɔw no?
Woana ne yafun mu na nsubo fi ba? Na sor bɔsu kyenkyenee no, woana na ɔwoo no?
Nsu da dɛ ɔbo, na bun no n’enyi apam.
Ana ɔwo ibotum akyekyer Aber-wa-na-mba no n’ahoma, anaa asan Etsekwagyan n’abɔyamu?
Ana ɔwo botum eyi Mazzaroth no epue wɔ ne ber mu? Anaa egya ɔbɔɔ-nda-esuon nye ne mba?
Ana ɔwo inyim sor mmom? Ana ɔwo ibotum ahyehyɛ no tumdzi wɔ asaase do?
Ana ɔwo ibotum ama wo ndze do ekodu mununkum mu, ama nsu pii aabɛkata wo do?
Ana ɔwo ibotum asoma enyinam, ma wɔaakɔ, na wɔaase wo dɛ, Hɛn nye yi?
Woana na ɔdze nyansa ahyɛ ayamudze mu? Anaa woana na ɔdze ntseasee ama adwen?
Woana na ɔdze nyansa botum akan mununkum? Anaa woana na ohue sor nsunkotoku mu,.
Aber a huntuma no pem yɛ sinsim, na dɛtse atɔw atɔw no abo mu afemfam ho no?
Ana ɔwo na eyɛ ha inya afonam ma gyataber, anaa ema ngyatamburwa akɔndɔ mee,
aber a wobutubutuw hɔn etu mu, na wɔtsetse dɔtɔ mu dɛ wɔretsɛw?
Woana na osiesie akonkoran n’edziban ma no, aber a ne mba sū frɛ Nyame, na wokyin wɔ edziban ho na ntsi?
39: Ana ɔwo inyim mber a botan do nwi dze wo? Anaa ɔwo ehyɛ aber a ndoa dze kõ awoo nsew?
Ana ɔwo ekan abosoom dodow a hɔn efur dze nyin? Anaa ɔwo inyim mber a wɔdze wo?
Wɔkotow wɔwo hɔn mba, wɔtow hɔn yaw kyen.
Hɔn mba kokwa, wonyin wɔ haban mu; wofir edzi kɔ, na wɔnnsan mmba bio.
Woana na oegyaa hamu asoaso dɛ ɔmfa noho ndzi? Anaa woana na ɔasan hamu asoaso nkyehoma?
Nyia medze sar no mayɛ ne fi, na nkyen-asaase no yɛ ne tsenabea.
Ɔsereserew kurow ne gyigyegyigye, nkyii so ɔnntse ɔkãfo ntseantseamu no.
Mbepɔw do nkyinii nye n’edzidzibea, na odzi adze momon biara ekyir.
Aso ɔnantwi boyafo bepen de osom wo? Anaa obetsena wo mbowa edzidzidaka ho?
Ana ɔwo edze ahoma bɛsã ɔnantwi bɔyafo wɔ funtumka ho? Anaa obofuntum abon no edzi w’ekyir?
Ana ebɔtwer no, osiandɛ n’ahoɔdzen sõ ntsi? Anaa ibegyaa w’edwuma mu ama no?
Ana ebɛgye no edzi dɛ ɔno na ɔdze w’aba bɛba fie, na ɔaboa w’ewuporoweebea eburow no ano?
Sohor n’atsaban mu bɔ ehurusidzi mu; nna ne ntsaban na ne ntɛkyerɛ tse dɛ esukɔnkɔn dze anaa?
Osiandɛ ogyaa ne nkyirefuwa wɔ asaase do, na ɔbɔ no hyew wɔ huntuma mu.
Na no werɛ fir dɛ anan bɔdwerew no, anaa abowa bɔyafo betsiatsia do.
Ɔyɛ etsiɔdzen wɔ ne mba do, dɛ gyama wɔnnyɛ nedze: Kaansa ne berɛ yɛ gyan mpo a, onnsuro;
osiandɛ Nyame ama nyansa abɔ no, nkyii so ɔamma no ntseasee.
Aber a ɔma noho do wɔ sor no, ɔsereserew pɔnkɔ na no do tsefo.
Ana ɔwo edze pɔnkɔ n’ahoɔdzen ama no? Anaa ɔwo edze ndarwa ahyehyɛ no kɔn?
Ana ɔwo ayɛ no ma ohuruw dɛ abɛbɛw? No hwenmubɔ ne dzenyɛ yɛ hu.
Ɔtwerɛw bɔnsa mu, na odzi ehurusi wɔ n’ahoɔdzen mu: Ofir edzi kehyia mbarimba a woemia.
Osi suro atwetwe, na n’abaw mu nntu; nkyii so ɔnnsan ekyir mmfi afõwa enyim.
Egyen-kotoku wosow wɔ no do, Peaa na egyen-menaba gyaframee so.
Ɔdze enyiber gyigyeegye men asaase no; nkyii so ɔnngye nndzi dɛ ɔyɛ abɛn ndze.
Mpɛn dodow a abɛn hɛn no, ɔse dɛ, yɛɛ! Na otse kõ hua wɔ ekyirkyir, asafohemfo mbobɔmu, na esebɔ.
Ana ɔnam wo nyansaa do na akrɔma tu, na ɔtsɛw ne ntsaban mu wɔ pomu afamu?
Ana ɔnam w’anosɛm do na ɔkɔrpɔn ma noho do, na ɔyɛ no buw wɔ sor?
Ɔtse botan do, na ɔwɔ ne dabew wɔ hɔ, botan ano hwironhwirora, na akoban do.
Ehɔ na ofi serasera afonam; n’enyiwa hu no ekyirkyir.
Ne mba so hwiew bɔgya: Na mbrɛ atɔfo wɔ no, hɔ na ɔwɔ.
40: Nkyii so Ewuradze buaa Job, na ɔsee dɛ,
Aso nyia ɔyɛ nyiyiano no ɔnye Otumfo no bɛham? Nyia ɔnye Nyame gye kyim no, wɔmma ombua.
Nna Job buaa Ewuradze, na ɔsee dɛ,
hwɛ, musuar; mumbua wo dɛn? Me nsa na medze moto m’ano.
Makasa prɛko, na murummbua; hyew, mprɛnu, na moronnkɔ kan bio.
Nna Ewuradze fi ehum no mu buaa Job, na ɔsee dɛ,
afei bɔ w’asen do dɛ barimba: Mibebisa wo, na ɔwo akã akyerɛ me.
Ana ɔwo bogura m'atsɛmbu no so? Ibobu me fɔ, ma ɔwo edzi bem.
Anaa ewɔ abasa a ɔtse dɛ Nyadze? Na edze ndze a ɔtse dɛ nedze bɔbɔ mu?
Afei fa akɛseyɛ na tumdzi hyehyɛ woho; na fa enyimnyam na ahoɔfɛw kata woho.
Hue w’ebufuw mbordo no gu: Na hwɛ biara a ɔyɛ ntsɛn na brɛ no adze.
Hwɛ biara a ɔyɛ ntsɛn, na fa no bra famu; na tsiatsia ndzebɔnyɛfo do wɔ mbrɛ wogyinaa no.
Fa hɔn bɔ mu suma huntuma mu, kyekyer hɔn enyim wɔ nsumaa bea no do.
Nna emi so mebɛka no wo ho dɛ wankasa wo nsa enyimfa na ɔbɛgye wo.
Afei hwɛ esuson a meyɛɛ no no kaa wo ho no; odzi efuw dɛ nantwi.
Afei hwɛ, n’ahoɔdzen wɔ ne sisiw mu, na no tum wɔ ne yafun mu ntsin mu.
Ohim no dua dɛ cedar: Ne nserɛ mu ntsin so pempam ho.
Ne mbiew yɛ dɛ boran a woehun mu; n’akwaa tse dɛ adaban.
Ɔno nye Nyame akwan no mu tsitsir: Nyia ɔyɛɛ no no nkotonoo na obotum ama n’afõwa akã no.
Ampaara mbepɔw fa edziban ma no; hɔ na hamu mbowadoma nyinara gor.
Nsoɛndua ase na ɔda, ndzɛmbir na atakyɛ nsumaa mu
Nsoɛndua dze no nwinwin kata no do, esukɔn do ndua bɔ no aprɔw.
Hwɛ, sɛ esutsen yir a, no mmpopo: Sɛ Jordan yir gu n’anomu mpo a, no bo da mu.
Aso obi bɛkyer no aber a ɔwɔ atsɛwee no, anaa wɔdze efir bohwira no hwen mu?
41: Ana ɔwo ibotum edze nkwaba atwe dɛnkyɛmnyin? Anaa edze ahoma bɛkyekyer ne gyirama?
Ana ɔwo ibotum edze ntampeehoma ahyɛ no hwen mu? Anaa edze kɔtɔkorba bɔbɔ n’afon mu?
Ana obedzi wo ntotɔserɛ pii? Anaa ɔbɛkasa kasa mberɛw akyerɛ wo?
Ana ɔnye wo bedzi ahyɛmu, dɛ ɔwo ebɛfa no ayɛ akowaa daa?
Ana ɔwo enye no bɔgor dɛ mbrɛ enye anoma gor? Anaa ebɛkyer no ama wo mbabaawa?
Ana apofo ekuwekuw dze no bedzi bata? Ana wɔbɛkyɛ no mu wɔ abatafo mu?
Ana edze dadze nsoɛ bɛhyɛ no wer mã, anaa edze nam mpeaa bɔwɔ ne tsir?
Fa wo nsa to no do; kaa kõ no, na mma nnyɛ dɛm bio.
Hwɛ, no ho enyidado yɛ gyan: Ana nnyɛ no hwɛ mpo na ɔma obi hwe ase?
Obiara n’enyi nnyɛ dzen dɛ ɔbɔbɔ no nkenyan; woana mbɔ nye nyia obotum m'enyim gyina?
Woana na oedzi kan ama me biribi, ma menhyɛ no ananmu? Adze biara a ɔwɔ sor nyina ase medze a.
Merennyɛ komm wɔ n'akwaa ho, na n’ahoɔdzen tum, na n’ahoɔfɛw so ho.
Woana na ɔbɛpa no ho akataho? Woana na obɛba ne menyiamfrɛ mbɔho no mu?
Woana na obobue n’enyim mbobow no? Ne sē ho nyina ho yɛ hu.
No ho abon dzendzen no nye n’ahohyehyɛ, wɔatotow mu dɛ wɔdze nsɔwanodze ayɛ.
Kor bɛn kor so dodow, ma mframa nntum mmfa hɔn ntamu.
Wɔfemfam ho nkorkor; woesuo mu kor, ma wɔtsetsew hɔn mu a ɔnnkɛyɛ.
No huntsii pa gya, na n’enyiwa tse dɛ adzekyee enyisoatsɛw.
Atsɛn a ɔdzɛw fi n'anomu pue, na gyansenama tutu fi mu.
Wusiw fi n'ahwentokura mu pue, dɛ mbrɛ ofi sɛn a oruhur na nkyɛkyer a ɔrehyew mu,
N’ahonhom sɔ gyabiriw, na ogyaframee fi n’anomu pue.
Ahoɔdzen wɔ no kɔn mu, na hu huruhuruw wɔ n’enyim.
No honam a ɔsensɛn hɔ femfam ho twer: Wotsintsim no do, wɔtwetwe a ɔnnyɛ.
N’akoma tsim hɔ dɛ ɔbo; nyew, otsim hɔ dɛ famu ewuyambo.
Sɛ ɔma noho do a, akatakyi akoma tu: Na ahobow ntsi wɔbobɔ adam.
Sɛ obi dze afõwa tow no a, onntum no; nnyɛ peaa, egyen-menaba, na dadze-akodze mpo so.
Obu dadze dɛ nkyɛkyɛr, na boran dɛ dua-wui.
Egyen-menaba remma onnguan: Itseabo-mu-abo ɔyɛ no dɛ mburo-nan.
Obu mpɔtsibaa dɛ mburonan: Ɔserew nkambaa no huuyɛ.
N’ase tse dɛ ntankofɛr a n’ano yɛ ndam: Ɔtwe no dɛ ewuporow-tseasea-nam wɔ adɛtsebir do.
Ɔye bun ma ohur dɛ ɔsɛn mu: Ɔye epo dɛ ngo.
Ɔma ɔkwan hyerɛn dze n’ekyir; obi bobu bun no dɛ oehura gon.
Ne saso nnyi asaase do a, wokwetsiir suro yɛɛ no.
Ɔhwɛ adze biara a ɔkrɔn: Ɔyɛ hen wɔ ahokyerɛ mba nyinara do.
42: Nna Job buaa Ewuradze, na ɔsee dɛ,
minyim dɛ ɔwo itum adze nyinara yɛ, na dɛ wo tsirmpɔw biara worunntum nnsiw no kwan.
Woana nye nyia okwetsir nyimdzee huntsa apam enyi yi? Dɛm ntsi na mekã dza menntse ase yi. Ndzɛmba a ɔyɛ nwanwa dodow ma me a minnyim.
Meserɛ wo, tsie, na menkasa; mibebisa wo, na akã akyerɛ me.
Ɔnam asowa ne ntsee do na metsee wo nkã; na afei dze m’enyiwa tua wo.
Dɛm ntsi na mopow moho, na munu moho wɔ dɛtse na nso mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Ewuradze kãa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Job n’ekyir no, Ewuradze see Temannyi Eliphaz dɛ, mo bo efuw wo, na wo mfɛfo beenu no: Osiandɛ hom annkã mo ho asɛm a ɔtsen, dɛ mbrɛ m’akowaaa Job ayɛ.

Dɛm ntsi hom mfa anantwinyin esuon na ndwanyin esuon, na hom nkɔ m’akowaa Job nkyɛn, na hom nkɔbɔ hyewafɔr mm a homho: Na m’akowaa Job mbɔ hom tsir mpaa; na ɔno na mebɛpen no, ma menye hom enndzi dɛ mbrɛ hom nkwaseasɛm tse; osiandɛ hom annkã mo ho asɛm a ɔtsen, dɛ mbrɛ m’akowaa Job ayɛ.
Nna Temannyi Eliphaz na Shuhinyi Bildad na Naamathnyi Zophar sii mu kɔree kɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ hɔn no: Na Ewuradze peen Job.
Na aber a Job bɔɔ ne mfɛfo no hɔn tsir mpaa no, Ewuradze daan no ndɔ mmumyɛ no: Na Ewuradze maa Job adze dodow a nkyɛ ɔwɔ mbɔho ebien.

Nna no nuanom nyinara, na ne nkyerɛbaa nyinara, na hɔn a nkyɛ wɔyɛ ne mfɛfo no nyinara, baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔnye no bedzidzii wɔ ne fie: Na wogyaam no, na wɔkyekyee no werɛ wɔ mbusu a Ewuradze maa ɔbaa no do no nyinara ho: Nyimpa biara so maa no sika, na obiara so sika nkaba kor.
Nna Ewuradze hyiraa Job n'ewiei ma ɔseen n’ahyɛse: Na onyaa nguan mpemduanan, na efumpɔnkɔ mpemesia, na anantwi mpamho apem, na nsoasober apem.
Onyaa mbabanyin beesuon na mbabaa baasa so.
Na ɔfrɛɛ nyia odzi kan no ne dzin Jemimah; na nyia otsia ebien no ne dzin Keziah; na nyia otsia ebiasa no ne dzin Keren-happuch.
Na woennhu mbaa a wɔyɛ fɛw dɛ Job ne mbabaa no wɔ asaase no nyinara do: Na hɔn egya memaa hɔn egyapadze wɔ hɔn nuanom mu.
Na yi ekyir no Job dzii mfe ɔha eduanan, na ohun ne mba, na ne mba so hɔn mba, mekyerɛ mbasantsen anan.
Nna Job wui, nna ɔayɛ akɔdaa, oedzi nda pii.

1: Ewuradze n'asɛm a ɔbaa Pethuel ba Jeol hɔ no.
Hom nkɔdaa, hom ntsia yi, na hom asaase do atsefo nyina, hom nyɛ aso. Aso iyi bi aba pɛn wɔ hom nda mu, anaaso hom egyanom nda mu?
Hom nkã ho asɛm nkyerɛ hom mba na hom mba nkã nkyerɛ hɔn mba, na hɔn so hɔn mba nkã nkyerɛ mbasantsen a odzi do.
Efuse ndzikaa no, abɛbɛw edzi; na abɛbɛw ndzikaa no, konyinko edzi; na konyinko ndzikaa no, esã edzi.
Asabokwafo, hom nnyan na hom nsū; na hom nsãnomfo nyina, hom ntwa ewuo, wɔ nsã fenemfenem ntsi, osiandɛ woetwa efi hom anomu.
Na ɔman bi etu aba m'asaase do, hɔn ho yɛ dzen, na hɔn dodow nnyi ano; hɔn sē tse dɛ gyata sē, na wɔwɔ gyata kɛse ne ngyepi sē.
Ɔasɛɛ mo wenyidua, na ɔawaawaa m'adɔmba dua ho: Ɔapɔr ho ahon egu, na ɔatow akyen; n'abaw ho ayɛ sakosako.
Twa ewuo dɛ ɔbaabun a ofura eyitam ma ne nkataasiaber mu kun.
Woetwa edziban-afɔr na ɔnom-afɔr efi Ewuradze fie; asɔfo, Ewuradze asomfo no, ridzi nkɔmbɔ.
Kwaa asɛɛ, asaase ridzi nkɔmbɔ; na eburow asɛɛ, nsã fofor awew, ngo akɔ atwee.
Ao ekuafo, hom enyi nwu, ao wenyin turehwɛfo, hom nka mbɔɔ, wɔ ewifua na atoko no ntsi; na haban mu ndɔbaa no ahera.
Wenyindua akyenkyen, na adɔmbadua enyinyam; pomegranate-ekutudua, abɛdua so, na aperdua, mekyerɛ haban mu ndua nyinara akyenkyen; osiandɛ enyigye ho atõ wɔ adasamba; mu.

Asɔfo, hom mfa eyitam mbɔ homho do, na hom nka mbɔɔ; afɔrmbukyia ho asomfo, hom ntwa ewuo; hom me Nyankopɔn n'asomfo, hom mbra mbɛda eyitam mu anago yi nyina: Na edziban-afɔr na ɔnom-afɔr egyaa wɔ hom Nyankopɔn fie ba.
Hom ntu mbuadadzi nsi nkyɛn, hom mfrɛ baguabɔ krɔnkrɔn, hom mboa nkɔdaa na asaase no do atsefo nyina ano mbra Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn fie, na hom nsū ntɔ Ewuradze do.
Ao da no a! Na Ewuradze ne da no abɛn, na ɔbɛba dɛ ɔsɛɛ a ofi otumfo no nkyɛn.
Ana wonntwaa edziban mmfii hɛn enyim, ɛhɛɛ enyigye na ahosɛpɛw mmfii hɛn Nyankopɔn fie?
Aba aprɔw n'akɔfi ase; mputu adeda apanapan, asan ebubu; osiandɛ eburow akyenkyen.
Mbrɛ mbowa dua si apen a! Anyɛbowakuw reberɛ, osiandɛ wonnyi edzidzibea; ɛhɛɛ, nguankuw ruhu amandze.
Ao Ewuradze ɔwo na musū frɛ wo: Na ogya ahyew sar do edzidzimbea, na ogyaframee ahyew hamu ndua nyinara.
Ɛhɛɛ hambowa rehaahaw kyerɛ wo: Osiandɛ nsu nwora nyina awewew, na ogya ahyew sar do edzidzimbea.
2: Hom mbɔ akasamu no mu wɔ Zion, na hom mbɔ ehuu wɔ me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do; hom mma asaase no do atsefo nyina ho mpopo: Na Ewuradze da no rudu, na ɔabɛn;
sum na kusuww da, fua na sum kebii da, dɛ ahanamakye a ayerɛw mbepɔw do; ɔman bi a ɔsõ na no ho yɛ dzen ane saso mmbaa da, eso n'ekyir bi remmba, dze ekesi mbasantsen pii mfe do mpo.
Ogya hyew dzi hɔn enyim; ogyaframee dzɛw dzi hɔn akyir: Hɔn enyim asaase tse dɛ Eden ture, na hɔn ekyir dze, sar huntuhuntu a; nyew, obi mmfi hɔn nsa.
Hɔn hwɛbea tse dɛ mpɔnkɔ hɔn hwɛbea; na wotu mbirika dɛ mpɔnkɔdofo.
Wohuruhuruw dɛ ntseaseanam kyirdidi wɔ mbepɔw do, dɛ gyaframee a ɔrehyew mburonan hurududuudu, dɛ dɔm a hɔn ho yɛ dzen a wɔatoto hɔn wɔ akono.
Aman ho guan hɔn wɔ hɔn enyim: Enyim nyina atotow.
Wotu mbirika dɛ mbarimba akatakyi; wɔfow afasu dɛ akombarimba; na wɔtsen fa hɔn akwan do, na wɔnntsew hɔn santsen mu.
Eso ɔbaako nnsun ne nyɛko; hɔn nyina nenam hɔn mpasuar do: Wɔbɔ hwira akodze mu a, wonnhuenyan.
Wɔyɛ kurow no mu menyamenya; wotutu afasu do mbirika; wɔfow kɔ efi mu; wɔnam ntokura mu hɛn mu dɛ owifo.
Asaase wosow wɔ hɔn enyim; ɔsor hihim: Ewia na bosoom hyɛ sum, na nworaba yi hɔn hyerɛn fi hɔ:
Na Ewuradze ma ne ndze do wɔ no dɔm enyim; na ne nseraban sõ dɛ; na nyia odzi n'asɛm ekyir no no ho yɛ dzen: Na Ewuradze da no sõ na ɔyɛ hu dɛ; na woana botum enyim gyina?
Naaso seseiara mpo, Ewuradze na ɔse, hom mfa hom akoma nyina, na mbuadadzi, na osū, na ewuotwa nsan mbra me nkyɛn:
Na hom nsunsuan hom akoma mu, na nnyɛ hom ntar a, na hom ndan mbra Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn nkyɛn: Na ɔyɛ ɔdomfo, na mbɔbɔrhufo, ɔfa ebufuw nyaa, na n'adɔyɛ sõ, na onu noho wɔ mbusu ho.
Woana nyim dɛ ɔrennsan nnu noho, na oegya nhyira wɔ n'ekyir a, ɔyɛ edziban-afɔr na ɔnom-afɔr a wɔdze bɛma Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn?
Hom mbɔ akasamu no mu wɔ Zion, hom ntu mbuadadzi nsi nkyen, hom mfrɛ ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn:
Hom mboa ɔman no ano, hom ntsew mboanofo no ho, hom nhyira nkɔdaa, hom mboa mbofraba ano, na enumfoanomba: Hom mma ayeforkun mfi ne pia mu mfir, na ayefor mfi n'adankyir.

Hom mma asɔfo no, Ewuradze asomfo no, nsū wɔ nkrandaa na afɔrmbukyia no ntamu, na hom mma wɔnsew dɛ, kam wo man, ao Ewuradze, na mma m, fa w'egyapadze mma ahorahoraa, ma amanaman eenndzi hɔn do tum: Ebɛn ntsi na wɔkã no aman mu dɛ, hɔn Nyankopɔn wɔ hen?
Nna Ewuradze yɛɛ n'asaase ho nyinkun, na ohun ne man mbɔbɔr.
Na Ewuradze buae see ne man dɛ, hwɛ, merebrɛ hom eburow, na nsã, na ngo, na ɔama hom amee: Na merennyɛ hom ahorohoraa wɔ amanaman mu boi:

Na mibeyi kwaamu afamu dɔm no mefi hom nkyɛn akɔ, na metwuw hɔn adze akɔ asaase kwawee na amamfõ do, na hɔn twafo dɔm no akɔ boka afamu po no mu, na hɔn nkyidɔm akɔ anee afamu po no ho; na hɔn bɔnee bɔsoɛr, na hɔn nyaanyan bɔsoɛr, osiandɛ wɔayɛ ndzɛmba akɛse.
Asaase e, mma nnsuro, w'enyi ngye na dzi ehurusi; osiandɛ Ewuradze ayɛ ndzɛmba akɛse.
Hambowa, mma hom akoma nntu; na sar do mfunoma refefɛw, na dua rosow n'aba, adɔmbadua na wenyindua riyi hɔn ahoɔdzen ma.
Zionmba, hom enyi ngye mbɔ, na hom ndzi ehurusi wɔ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn mu: Na ɔrema hom esusow nsu wɔ ɔtsenenee mu, na ɔrema nsu atɔ ama hom, esusow na ɔbɛsɛ nsu, wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu.
Na ewifua bɛyɛ poroweebea amaama, na nsã na ngo bɛyɛ nkorbaa amaama ebu do.
Na mebɛhyɛ hom mfe a mbɛbɛw, nkonyinko, na esã, na efuse, mo dɔm a mosomaa hɔn baa hom do no dzii no, ananmu.
Na hom bedzidzi bafuu na hom amee, na hom eyi Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn a ɔnye hom edzi no nwanwa mu no ne dzin ayɛw: Na me man n'enyim runngu ase dabiarada.
Na hom bohu dɛ mowɔ Isreal finimfin, na dɛ emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn, na obi nnyi hɔ bio: Na me man enyim runngu ase dabiarada.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ n'ekyir no, mubohue mo sunsum egu adasa nyina do; na hom mbabanyin na hom mbabaa bɛhyɛ nkɔm, na hom nkɔdaa asoso adaa, hom mberantse ehuhu enyidoadze:
Na eso hom nkowaa no hom mfonabaa do na mu mubohue mo sunsum megu wɔ nda no mu.
Na mebɛkyerɛ anwanwadze wɔ sor na asaase, bɔgya, na ogya wusiw kumbɔɔ.
Ewia bɛdan sum, na bosoom adan bɔgya ansaana Ewuradze ne da kɛse a ɔyɛ hu no aba.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ obiara a ɔbɔbɔ Ewuradze ne dzin no, wɔbɛgye no nkwa: Na Zion bepɔw do na Jerusalem na hɔn a wobefi nsa no wɔbɛtsena, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze akã no, ɔnye hɔn a Ewuradze refrɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn a wɔka no mu.
3: Na hwɛ, nda na ber no mu a medze Judah na Jerusalem ndɔmmum bɛsan aba bio no,
mobɔboa amanaman nyina ano, na medze hɔn aba Jehoshaphat bɔnsa no mu; na menye hɔn edzi asɛm wɔ me man na m'egyapadze Isreal ntsi, dɛ wɔabɔ hɔn apetse amanaman, na wɔakyɛ m'asaase mu.
Na wɔakyɛ me man ho tonto: Na wɔdze abanyimbasiaba apɛ edwaman, na wɔatan akataasia agye nsã anom.
Nyew, hom yɛ me dɛn, ao Tyre, na Zidon, na Philistia amantɔw nyina? Ana hom bɛyɛ me biribi ahyɛ me ananmu a, ɔhardo ntsɛmara na mebɛdan hom ahyɛnanmu no egu hom etsifi.
Osiandɛ hom afa mo dwetɛ na me sika, na hom dze m'afɛɛfɛdze papa no nyina kɔ hom asɔrdan no mu;
hom atɔn Judahmba so na Jerusalem mba ama Greekfo mba, ama hom eeyi hɔn efi hɔn he do akɔ ekyirkyir:
Hwɛ, mibekenyan hɔn mefi mbrɛ hom tontɔɔn hɔn kɔree no, na madan hom ahyɛnanmu no mebua homankasa hom etsifi;
na mobɔtɔn hom mbabanyin na hom mbabaa ahyɛ Judahmba nsa, na wɔbɔtɔn hɔn ama Shaba mba, ɔman awɔwɔ ekyirkyir; na Ewuradze na ɔakã.
Hom mbɔ yi dawur wɔ amananaman mu; hom nkyer ɔsa: Hom nkenyan mbarimba akatakyi no; hom mma akofa nyina ntwe mbɛn wɔmfow mbra.
Hom mfa hom nsɔw mbobɔ mfõwa, na hom mfa hom ndar mbobɔ mpaeaa: Onyia ɔyɛ mberɛw nkã dɛ, meyɛ dzen.
Hom nyɛ ntsɛm mbra, hom amanaman a woetwa ehyia nyina, na hom mboa hom ano mbehyia: Ao Ewuradze, hɔ na ma w'akatakyi no wonsian mbra.
Amannaman nkenyan hɔnho, na wontu mbra Jehshaphat bɔnsa no mu: Na hɔ na mebɛtsena ase mebu amanaman a woetwa ehyia nyinara atsɛn.
Hom mfa kantankrankye no nto mu, na ekuadze no aber: Hom mbra, hom mbetsiatsia; na nsãtwer no ayɛ mã, nkorbaa no ebubu do; na hɔn emumuyɛ adɔɔ sõ.
Nyimpawiww, nyimpawiww wɔ atsɛmbu bɔnsa no mu! Na Ewuradze ne da no abɛn wɔ atsɛmbu bɔnsa no mu.
Ewia na bosoom ahyɛ sum; na nworaba egyaa hyerɛn.
Na Ewuradze befi Zion apɔw, na oefi Jerusalem ama ne ndze do; na ɔsorsor na asaase awosow: Na Ewuradze bɛyɛ guansumabea ama ne man, na akoban ama Israelmba.
ɔno na hom Nyankopɔn a metse Zion, me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do: Nna Jerusalem bɛyɛ krɔnkrɔnbea, na ananaben biara runntwa mu wɔ hɔ bio.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ mbepɔw bɔsosɔw nsã fenemfenem, na akoko no do apem numfonsu, na nsu ebu Judah nworaba nyina do; na nsunyiwa befi Ewuradze fie apem akɔfow Shittim bɔnsa no.
Egypt bɛyɛ amamfõ, na Edom ayɛ sar kwawee, wɔ etsirmɔdzen a wɔdze yɛɛ Judahmba ntsi, osinadɛ wɔakã bɔgya a odzi bem egu wɔ hɔn asaase do ntsi.
Na Judah dze, ɔbɛtsena hɔ daa, na Jerusalem fi mbasantsen ekesi mbasantsen.
Na mebɛtsew hɔn bɔgyaa ho a menntsewee no: Na Ewuradze tse Zion.

1: Ahyɛse no na Asɛm no wɔ hɔ, na Asɛm no nye Nyankopɔn wɔ hɔ, na Asɛm no yɛ Nyame.
Ɔnoara na ahyɛse no ɔnye Nyankopɔn wɔ hɔ.
Wɔnam no do yɛɛ adze nyina na woeennkwetsi no annyɛ biribiara a wɔyɛe.
No mu na nkwa wɔ, na nkwa no nye nyimpa ne kan.
Na kan no hyerɛn wɔ sum mu, na sum no annkyer no.
Nyimpa bi bae a Nyankopɔn somaa no a ne dzin dze John.
Ɔnoara na ɔbaa adasedzi, dɛ oribedzi kan no ho dase, ma nyimpa nyina eedua no do agye edzi.
Nnyɛ ɔno nye kan no, na obedzii kan no ho dase.
Nokwar kan no a ɔma nyimpa nyina mu yɛ kan na ɔreba wiadze.
Ɔwɔ wiadze na wɔnam no do yɛɛ wiadze, na wiadze ennhu no.
Ɔbaa dza ɔyɛ nedze hɔ, na hɔn a wɔyɛ nedze anngye no.
Na dodow a wɔgyee no no, ɔmaa hɔn tum dɛ wɔnyɛ Nyankopɔn mba, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔgye ne dzin dzi no a,
ommfi bɔgyaa anaa honam ne pɛ anaa ɔbarimba ne pɛ mu, na ofi Nyankopɔn mu na wɔwoo hɔn.
Na Asɛm no bɛyɛɛ honam, na ɔbɔsoɛɛ hɛn mu, na yehun n'enyimnyam dɛ Egya no ne Ba kortoo no n'enyimnyam a adom nye nokwar ahyɛ no mã.
John dzii no dase na ɔtsēaa mu dɛ: Oyi nye nyia mekãa dɛ, nyia odzi m'ekyir reba no, ɔapa mo ho, osiandɛ odzii me kan.
Na n'amayɛ no hɛn nyina enya bi, na adom esi adom ananmu;
na mbra no dze, wɔnam Moses do dze mae, na adom nye nokwar no dze, ɔnam Jesus Christ do na ɔbae.
Obi nnhun Nyankopɔn pɛn; ɔba a wɔwoo no kor no a ɔwɔ Egya no bo mu no, ɔno na oeyi no akyerɛ.
Na aber a Jewfo fi Jerusalem somaa asɔfo nye Levifo dɛ wombebisa no dɛ, Woana nye wo? No, nna John dzii dase yi.
Ɔpaa mu kãe na ɔannsan; ɔpaa mu kãa dɛ, nnyɛ emi nye Christ no.
Na wobisaa no dɛ, ebɛn mbɔ a? Elijah nye wo a? Na ɔsee dɛ, nnyɛ emi nye no. Nkɔnhyɛnyi no nye wo a? Na obuaa dɛ, Oho.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, woana nye wo? Ma yeenya bi ekobua hɔn a wɔsomaa hɛn. Ekã dɛn wɔ woho?
Ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye obi ne ndze a ɔretsēa mu wɔ sar no do dɛ, hom ntsen Ewuradze no kwan, dɛ mbrɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah kãe no.
Na hɔn a wɔsomaa hɔn no fi Phariseefo mu.
Na wobisaa no see no dɛ, sɛ nnyɛ wo nye Christ anaa Elijah anaa nkɔnhyɛnyi no a, ebɛn ntsi na inuma?
John buae see dɛ, emidze, munuma hom nsu mu, na obi gyina hom finimfin a hom nnyim no,
ɔno nye nyia odzi m'ekyir reba no a no nsokota ho ahoma mennsɛ dɛ mesan mpo.
Yinom wɔyɛɛ no wɔ Bethany Jordan egya mbrɛ John runuma no.
Na adze kyee no, John hun Jesus dɛ ɔreba ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, Nyankopɔn Eguambaa a oyi wiadze bɔn kɔ.
Oyi nye nyia mekãe wɔ no ho dɛ, ɔbarimba bi dzi m'ekyir reba a ɔapa mo ho, osiandɛ odzii me kan.
Na emidze minnyim no, na dɛ wobeyi no akyerɛ Israel ntsi na mebae mubonumae wɔ nsu mu.
Na John dzii dase dɛ, muhun Sunsum no dɛ ofi sor sianee dɛ ebubur na ɔbɛtsena no do.
Na emidze minnyim no, na nyia ɔsomaa me ma mubonumae wɔ nsu mu no, ɔnoara na ɔsee me dɛ, nyia ibohu dɛ Sunsum no besian abɛtsena no do no, ɔno nye nyia onuma wɔ Sunsum krɔnkrɔn mu.
Na mehu na medzi dase dɛ ɔno nye Nyankopɔn Ba no.
Na adze kyee bio no, John nye n'esuafo beenu gyina hɔ;
na ɔhwɛɛ Jesus dɛ ɔnenam hɔ no, ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, Nyankopɔn Eguambaa a.
Na ɔrekasa no n'esuafo beenu tsee na wɔkaa Jesus do.
Na Jesus daan noho, na ohun dɛ wɔka no do no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom rohwehwɛ bɛn? Na wɔsee no dɛ, Rabbi, (ase nye dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo) etse hen?
Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mbra mbɔhwɛ. Na wɔbae bohun mbrɛ ɔtse, na wɔnye no tsenaa hɔ da no; na oedu bɛyɛ dɛ dɔn a otsīa du no.
Na beenu a wɔtsee John n'asɛm na wɔkaa no do no, hɔn mu kor nye Andrew, Simon Peter no nua no.
Na odzii kan bohu no nua Simon, na ɔsee no dɛ, yeehu Messiah no, (ne nkyerɛase nye Christ, anaadɛ, nyia wɔasera no).
Ɔdze no baa Jesus nkyɛn. Jesus hwɛɛ no see no dɛ, ɔwo nye Simon, John ne ba no: Wɔbɛfrɛ wo Cephas (ne nkyerɛase nye Peter anaadɛ ɔbo).
Adze kyee no, Jesus pɛɛ dɛ ɔkɔ Galilee, na ohun Philip. Na Jesus see no dɛ, Ka mo do.
Na Philip fi Bethsaida, Andrew nye Peter kurow mu.
Philip kohun Nathaniel, na ɔsee no dɛ, nyia Moses wɔ mbra no mu ɔnye nkɔnhyɛfo no so kyerɛɛw no ho asɛm no yeehu no. Nazareth Jesus, Joseph ba no.
Na Nathaniel see no dɛ, Aso biribi pa bi botum efi Nazareth aba da? Philip see no dɛ, Bra bɔhwɛ.
Jesus hun Nathaniel dɛ ɔreba ne nkyɛn, na ɔkãa no ho asɛm dɛ, hwɛ, ampaara Israelnyi nye yi a ndaadaa bi nnyi no mu.
Nathaniel see no dɛ, inyim me wɔ hen? Jesus buaa see no dɛ, ansaana Philip frɛɛ wo a ewɔ adɔmbadua no ase no, nna muhun wo.
Nathaniel buae see no dɛ, Rabbi, ɔwo nye Nyankopɔn ba, ɔwo nye Israel Hen no.
Jesus buae see no dɛ, mesee wo dɛ muhun wo adɔmbadua no ase ntsi na egye dzi yi? Ibohu ndzɛmba akɛse a ɔsen yinom.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, hom bohu dɛ ɔsor ebue na Nyankopɔn abɔfo rofow sian wɔ nyimpa Ba no do.
2: Na da a otsīa ebiasa no wohyiaa ayefor wɔ Cana a ɔwɔ Galilee, na Jesus ne nã wɔ hɔ;
na wɔfrɛɛ Jesus nye n'esuafo so baa ayefor ase.
Na wenyin no annsõ no, Jesus ne nã see no dɛ, wonnyi wenyin.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, ɔbaa, menye wo wɔ ebɛn yɛ?
Ne nã see asomfo no dɛ, biribiara a ɔbɛse hom, hom nyɛ.
Na abo esupi esia sisi hɔ, dɛ mbrɛ Jewfo hɔn ahoguar tse, kor bedzi etwahina ebien anaa ebiasa.
Jesus see hɔn dɛ, hom mfa nsu nhyehyɛ esupi no amaama. Na wɔhyehyɛɛ no amaama tɛntɛn.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, afei hom nsesaw nkɛma edzidziase panyin no. Na wɔdze kɔree.
Na edzidziase panyin no kãa n'ano nsu a ɔadan wenyin no hwɛe no, na onnyim mbrɛ ofir no (na asomfo no a wɔsesaw nsu no dze nyim), ɔfrɛɛ ayeforkun no,
na ɔsee no dɛ, nyimpa biara dze wenyin papa no dzi kan besisi hɔ, na wɔanom abobow no, nna wɔdze dza onnye no ba, na ɔwodze, edze wenyin papa no esie ebodu sesei.
Nsɛnkyerɛdze ahyɛse yi Jesus yɛe wɔ Cana a ɔwɔ Galilee, na oyii n'enyimnyam kyerɛe; na n'esuafo no gyee no dzii.
Iyi ekyir no, Jesus sianee kɔr Capernuam, ɔno nye ne nã nye no nuanom nye n'esuafo, na wɔtsenaa hɔ nda kakra ara.
Na Jewfo apaho no bɛnee; na Jesus kɔr Jerusalem.
Na okohun asɔrfi no mu hɔn a wɔtɔn anantwi, nye guan, nye mbubur, nye sikasesafo dɛ wɔtsetse hɔ;
na ɔdze ahoma yɛɛ mpire paam hɔn nyina, nguan no nye anantwi no, na ohuee sikasesafo sika gui, na ɔkãa hɔn apon butubutuwii;
na hɔn a wɔtɔn mbubur, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mfa yinom mfi ha; mma hom nnyɛ m'Egya fie eguadzi fie.
Na n'esuafo kaa dɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ, wo fie ho mbɔdzembɔ bɛmen me.
Iyi ntsi Jewfo buae see no dɛ, ebɛn asɛnkyerɛdze na edze kyerɛ hɛn, na ereyɛ yinom yi?
Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, hom ndwuruw asɔrdan yi, na ndaansa mu mebɛma do bio.
Nna Jewfo no see no dɛ, mfe eduanan esia mu na wɔtoow asɔrdan yi, na ɔwo ebɛma do nda ebiasa mu?
Na ɔnodze, ɔkãa no honam asɔrdan no ho.
Dɛm ntsi ɔsoɛree fii ewufo mu no, n'esuafo no kaa dɛ ɔkãa yi kyerɛɛ hɔn, na wɔgyee kyerɛwsɛm no ɔnye asɛm no a Jesus kãe no dzii.
Na ɔwɔ Jerusalem apaho afahyɛ no mu no dodowara hun ne nsɛnkyerɛdze a ɔyɛe no, wɔgyee ne dzin dzii;
na Jesus dze, ɔammfa no ho amma hɔn, osiandɛ onyim nyimpa nyina,
na onnhia no dɛ obi dzi nyimpa ho dase, na nankasa nyim dza ɔwɔ nyimpa mu.
3: Nyimpa bi fi Phariseefo no mu wɔ hɔ a ne dzin dze Nicodemus a ɔyɛ Jewfo panyin bi;
ɔnoara na ɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn anago, na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, Rabbi, yenyim dɛ ifi Nyankopɔn nkyɛn na aba dɛ kyerɛkyerɛfo; osiandɛ obi nntum nnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze a eyɛ yi, gyedɛ Nyankopɔn ka no ho.
Jesus buae see no dɛ, nokwar, nokwar, mese wo dɛ, sɛ wɔannwo nyimpa fofor a, orunntum nnhu Nyankopɔn ahenman no.
Nicodemus kãa kyerɛ no dɛ, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na nyimpa a oenyin no, wobotum awo no, obotum akɔ ne nã yamu bio na wɔawo no anaa?
Jesus buaa dɛ, nokwar, nokwar, mese wo dɛ, sɛ woemmfi nsu nye Sunsum mu annwo nyimpa a, orunntum nnhɛn Nyankopɔn ahenman mu.
Nyia wofi honam mu awo no ɔyɛ honam; na nyia wofi Sunsum mu awo no ɔyɛ Sunsum.
Mma ɔnnyɛ wo nwanwa dɛ mese wo dɛ, otwar dɛ wɔwo hom fofor.
Mframa bɔ wɔ mbrɛ ɔpɛ, na etse ne ndze, na innyim mbrɛ ofi ba, na mbrɛ ɔkɔ. Mbrɛ obiara a wofi Sunsum mu awo no tse nye no.
Nicodemus buae see no dɛ, yinom besi dɛn ayɛ?
Jesus buae see no dɛ, Ana eyɛ Israel kyerɛkyerɛfo na innyim yinom?
Nokwar, nokwar, mese wo dɛ, yɛkã dza yenyim na yedzi dza yeehu ho dase; na hom nngye hɛn dasee no.
Sɛ mekã hom asaase afamu ndzɛmba na hom nngye nndzi a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na sɛ mekã ɔsor ndzɛmba kyerɛ hom a, hom bɛgye edzi.
Na obi mmfoow sor, gyedɛ nyia ofi sor sianee no, nyimpa Ba no.
Na dɛ mbrɛ Moses maa ɔwɔ no do wɔ sar no do no, dɛmara na otwar dɛ wɔma nyimpa Ba no do,
Ma obiara a ɔgye no dzi no oeenya onnyieweie nkwa wɔ no mu.
Na mbrɛ Nyankopɔn dɔɔ wiadze nye yi, dɛ ɔdze ne Ba a ɔwoo no kor no mae, ama obiara a ɔgye no dzi no ɔaannhera, na oeenya onnyiewiei nkwa.
Na Nyankopɔn annsoma ne Ba wɔ wiadze dɛ ombobu wiadze atsɛn, na dɛ wondua no do ngye wiadze nkwa.
Nyia ɔgye no dzi no, wommbu no atsɛn; nyia ɔnngye no nndzi no, woebu no atsɛn dada; osiandɛ ɔnngyee Nyankopɔn ne Ba kortoo no ne dzin nndzii.
Na iyi nye atsɛmbu no, dɛ kan no aba wiadze, na nyimpa adɔ sum akyɛn kan no; osiandɛ hɔn ndwuma muo.
Na obiara a ɔyɛ dza ɔmmfata no, okyir kan, eso ɔmmba kan no ho, amma woeennyi no atsɛn wɔ no ndwuma ho.
Na nyia ɔyɛ nokwar no, ɔba kan no ho, ma no ndwuma aada edzi dɛ Nyankopɔn mu na ɔayɛ.
Iyi ekyir no Jesus nye n'esuafo baa Judæa asaase do, na ɔnye hɔn tsenaa hɔ, na onumae.
Na John so runuma wɔ Aenon a ɔbɛn Salim, osiandɛ nsu pii wɔ hɔ; na wɔbaa hɔ ma onumaa hɔn.
Nna wonnyae mmfaa John nntoo efiadze.
Na nhwehweɛmu bi baa John n'esuafo nye Jewnyi bi afamu wɔ ahoguar ho.
Na wɔbaa John nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, Rabbi, nyia ɔkaa wo ho wɔ Jordan egya no a egyee no ho dase no, hwɛ, ɔno so runuma na nyimpa nyina reba no hɔ.
John buae na ɔsee dɛ, nyimpa runntum nnya biribi, gyedɛ wɔdze fi sor ma no.
Homankasa gye me dase dɛ mekãa dɛ, nnyɛ emi nye Christ no, na wɔsomaa me dzii n'enyim.
Nyia ɔwɔ ayefor no nye ayeforkun; na ayeforkun ne nyɛnko a ogyina hɔ na otsie no, n'enyi gye kɛse wɔ ayeforkun no ne ndze ntsi; afei na m'enyigye yi ahyɛ mã.
Ɔnodze, otwar dɛ ɔdɔr, na emidze, otwar dɛ mo do huan.
Nyia ofi sor bae no kyɛn nyimpa nyina; nyia ofi famu no, ɔyɛ famunyi, na ɔkasa dɛ famunyi. Nyia ofi sor bae no kyɛn nyimpa nyina;
dza oehu na ɔatse no na ɔgye ho dase, na obiara nngye ne dasee nndzi.
Nyia ɔagye ne dase no, ɔasɔw ano dɛ Nyankopɔn yɛ nokwafo.
Na nyia Nyankopɔn somaa no no, ɔkã Nyankopɔn ne nsɛm, na onnsusu Sunsum no na ɔdze ma no.
Egya no dɔ ɔba no, na ɔdze ndzɛmba nyina ahyɛ ne nsa.
Nyia ɔgye ɔba no fie dzin dzi no, ɔwɔ oennyiewiei nkwa; nyia onndzi ɔba no asɛm do no, orunnhu nkwa, na Nyankopɔn ebufuw tsena no do.
4: Afei Ewuradze hun dɛ Phariseefo atse dɛ Jesus reyɛ esuafo pii na orunuma nyimpa sen John no,
(naaso Jesus nankasa ennuma na n'esuafo a),
ofii Judæe na osii mu kɔr Galilee bio.
Na otwar dɛ ɔfa Samaria.
Na afei ɔbaa Samaria kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Sychar a ɔbɛn asaase a Jacob dze kyɛɛ ne ba Joseph no ho;
na Jacob bura so wɔ hɔ. Na Jesus afona n'akwantu mu ntsi, otsenaa bura no do dɛmara; ɔbɛyɛ dɔn a otsīa esia no.
Na ɔbaa bi a ofi Samaria bae bɔtoow nsu. Jesus see no dɛ, ma me bo monnom.
Na n'esuafo no kɔ kurow mu akɔtɔ edziban.
Na Samarianyi ɔbaa no see no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔwo a eyɛ Jewnyi ibisa emi a meyɛ Samarianyi ɔbaa hɔ nsu anom? Na Jewfo nye Samariafo nnkã.
Jesus buae see no dɛ, sɛ inyim Nyankopɔn akyɛdze no, nye nyia ɔse wo dɛ, ma me bi monnom yi a, nkyɛ ibebisa no ma ɔaama wo nsu a nkwa wɔ mu.
Ɔbaa no see no dɛ, innyi adze a edze rotow, na bura no mu so dɔ; hen mbɔ na inya nsu a nkwa wɔ mu no?
Ana ɔwo esõ kyɛn hɛn egya Jacob a ɔkyɛɛ hɛn bura yi, na nankasa nye ne mba nye no mbowa noom bi?
Jesus buae see no dɛ, obiara a ɔbɔnom nsu yi bi no, nsukɔm bɛdze no bio.
Na nyia ɔbɔnom nsu a mebɛma no nom nsukɔm nnkɛdze no da, na nsu a mebɛna no no bɛyɛ no mu nsubura a opuw nsu kɔ onnyiewiei nkwa mu.
Ɔbaa no see no dɛ, ma me dɛm nsu yi ɛ, ma nsukɔm nndze me ma munntu kwan mommbɔtow nsu yi bi.
Jesus see no dɛ, kɔ kɛfrɛ wo kun na bra ha.
Ɔbaa no buae see no dɛ, minnyi kun. Jesus see no dɛ, Akã no yie dɛ, minnyi kun:
na awar kunnom beenum; na nyia ewɔ no sesei yi, nnyɛ wo kun bi a; ɔnodze, akã no nokwar.
Ɔbaa no see no dɛ, mo wura, muhu dɛ eyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi.
Hɛn egyanom sɔree wɔ bepɔw yi do, na homdze, hom se dɛ Jerusalem nye bea a ɔsɛ dɛ nyimpa sɔr wɔ hɔ.
Jesus see no dɛ, ɔbaa, gye me dzi dɛ da no reba a nnyɛ bepɔw yi do, eso nnyɛ Jerusalem na hom bɔsɔr Egya no.
Hom sɔr dza hom nnyim; hɛndze, yɛsɔr dza yɛnyim, osiandɛ nkwagye fi Jewfo mu.
Na dɔn no reba, na oenya edu, dɛ nokwar asɔrfo bɔsɔr Egya no wɔ sunsum nye nokwar mu: na yinom dɛm na Egya no hwehwɛ dɛ n'asɔrfo yɛ.
Ɔbaa no see no dɛ, minyim dɛ Messiah no a wɔfrɛ no Christ no reba; na ɔnodze, sɛ ɔba a, ɔbɛpaa mu akã adze nyina akyerɛ hɛn.
Jesus buae see no dɛ, emi a menye wo rekasa yi, emi nye no.
Na iyi do na n'esuafo bae; na ɔyɛɛ hɔn ahobow dɛ ɔnye ɔbaa no rekasa, naaso obi annse no dɛ, erohwehwɛ ebɛn, anaa, ɔyɛ dɛn na enye no rekasa yi?
Na ɔbaa no gyaa n'ehina hɔ na osii mu kɔr kurow no mu, na ɔsee nyimpa no dɛ,
Hom mbra mbɔhwɛ nyimpa a ɔakã dza mayɛ nyina akyerɛ me. Nnyɛ oyi nye Christ no anaa?
Wofii kurow no mu dɛ wɔreba ne nkyɛn.
Na ne ntamu no, n'esuafo bisaa no dɛ, Rabbi, dzidzi.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, mowɔ edziban midzi a hom nnyim.
Dɛm ntsi n'esuafo sesee hɔnho dɛ, ana obi abrɛ no biribi ma oedzi?
Jesus see hɔn dɛ, m'edziban nye dɛ meyɛ nyia ɔsoma me no pɛ na muwie n'edwuma.
Ana hom nnkã dɛ aka abosoom anan na twaber edu? Hwɛ! mese hom dɛ, hom mma hom enyi do nhwɛ nhaban no, dɛ oenya ahoa edu twaber mu.
Na nyia otwa no gye akatua na ɔboaboa aba no ano kɔ onnyiewiei nkwa mu, na nyia oduae nye nyia otwae nyina aabɔ mu edzi dɛw.
Na iyi mu asɛm no yɛ nokwar dɛ obi dua na obi twa.
Mosomaa hOm dɛ hom nkotwa dza hom nnyɛɛ ho edwuma; binom ayɛ, na homdze, hom aba hɔn edwuma mu.
Na Samariafo a wɔwɔ kurow yi mu dodowara gyee no dzii wɔ ɔbaa no a ɔgyee dase dɛ, ɔakã dza mayɛ nyina akyerɛ me no n'asɛm ntsi.
Dɛm ntsi Samariafo baa ne nkyɛn no, wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔnye hɔn ntsena. Na ɔtsenaa hɔ nda ebien.
Na dodow a ɔkyɛn nkan no gyee no dzii wɔ n'asɛm ntsi,
na wɔsee ɔbaa no dɛ, afei nnyɛ w'asɛm ntsi na yɛgye dzi, na hɛnankasa yɛatse na yenyim dɛ oyi nye wiadze Agyenkwa.
Na nda ebien twaa mu no, ofii hɔ sii mu kɔr Galilee.
Na Jesus noara gyee dase dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi nnyi enyidzi wɔ nankasa no kurow mu.
Na odur Galilee no, Galileefo gyee no too mu, osiandɛ wohun dza ɔyɛe wɔ Jerusalem wɔ afahyɛ no ase nyina; na hɔn so kɔr afahyɛ no ase bi.
Na Jesus baa Cana a ɔwɔ Galilee mbrɛ ɔdaan nsu wenyin no bio. Na ahenkowaa bi wɔ hɔ a ne ba yar wɔ Capernuam.
Na ɔtsee dɛ Jesus fi Judæa aba Galilee no, ɔkɔr ne nkyɛn kɛserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmbra mbɛsa ne ba ne yarba, na ɔreyɛ ewu.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Sɛ hom nnhu nsɛnkyerɛdze nye awanwandze a, hom nnkɛgye edzi da.
Ahenkowaa no see no dɛ, Mo wura, sian bra ansaana me ba no ewu.
Jesus kãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Kɔ, wo ba no atse apɔw. Na nyimpa no gyee asɛm a Jesus kãa kyerɛɛ no no dzii, na ɔkɔree.
Na ɔresan akɔ no, no nkowaa behyiaa no kãa dɛ ne ba no atse apɔw.
Na obisaa hɔn dɔn kor a no ho hyɛɛ ase yɛɛ no dzen; na wɔsee no dɛ, ndeda dɔn a otsīa esuon no mu na papu no gyaae.
Na egya no hun dɛ dɔn no ara a Jesus see no dɛ, wo ba no atse apɔw no mu a, na ɔgyee no dzii, ɔnye ne fifo nyina.
Iyi so nye asɛnkyerɛdze a otsīa ebien a Jesus fi Judæe baa Galilee no ɔyɛe.
5: Iyi ekyir no Jewfo afahyɛ bi durii, na Jesus kɔr Jerusalem.
Na Jerusalem nguantsen abobow no ho nsutaae bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no wɔ Hebrew kasa mu Bethesda a ɔwɔ nkrandaa enum.
Na iyinom mu na ayarfo nyimpakuw pii, enyifurafp, mpakye, nye hɔn a wɔakyenkyen dedae rotweɔn nsu no no nwosowee.
Na odu ber a abɔfo sian nsutaae no mu bɔfon no; na obiara a nsu no fon ekyir no odzi kan kɔtɔ mu no, yarba biara a ɔyar no wɔbɔ no esu.
Na nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a oedzi mfe eduasa awɔtwe wɔ n'ahoɔmberɛw mu;
na Jesus hun dɛ ɔda hɔ, na onyim dɛ ɔakyɛr no, ɔsee no dɛ, Epɛ dɛ wo ho yɛ wo dzen anaa?
Ɔyarfo no buaa dɛ, Ewuradze, minnyi nyimpa bi a sɛ wɔbɔfon nsu no a ɔdze me to nsutae no mu: na mereba a, nna obi etwa m'ano akesi mu.
Jesus see no dɛ, soɛr, fa wo kɛtɛ na nantsew.
na amonmu no ara nyimpa no ho yɛɛ no dzen, na ɔfaa ne kɛtɛ, na ɔnantsewee. Na da no ara yɛ ahomgyeda.
Dɛm ntsi Jewfo no see nyia wɔsaa no yarba no dɛ, ndɛ yɛ ahomgyeda, innyi ho kwan dɛ esoa wo kɛtɛ.
Obuae see hɔn dɛ, nyia ɔmaa mo ho yɛɛ me dzen no, ɔnoara na ɔsee me dɛ, fa wo kɛtɛ na nantsew.
Wobisaa no dɛ, woana nye nyimpa a ɔsee wo dɛ, fa na nantsew, no?
Na nyia wɔsaa no yarba no nnyim nyimpa kor no, na nyimpadodow wɔ hɔ ntsi Jesus atwe noho efi hɔ.
N'ekyir no Jesus hun no asɔrfi mu na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, wo ho ayɛ wo dzen: Mma nnyɛ bɔn bio, mma dza omuo kyɛn yi aammba wo do.
Nyimpa no sii mu kɛkãa kyerɛɛ Jewfo no dɛ Jesus na ɔmaa no ho yɛɛ no dzen.
Dɛm ntsi na Jewfo hiahiaa Jesus ho, osiandɛ ɔayɛ ndzɛmba yi ahomgyeda.
Na Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, m'Egya yɛ edwuma bodu sesei na mo so meyɛ edwuma.
Na dɛm ntsi kɛse na Jewfo hwehwɛɛ no eku no, osiandɛ nnyɛ ahomgyeda nko na ɔatõ, na eso ɔfrɛɛ Nyankopɔn nankasa n'Egya, dze yɛɛ noho dɛ ɔnye Nyankopɔn sɛ.
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, ɔba no nankasa nntum nnhyɛ noho nnyɛ hwee, gyedɛ dza ohu Egya no dɛ ɔyɛ; na biribiara a ɔno yɛ no, ɔnoara ɔba no so yɛ no dɛmara.
Na Egya no dɔ ɔba no, na ɔkyerɛ no dza nankasa yɛ no nyina, na ɔbɛkyerɛ no ndwuma a ɔkyɛn yinom, na aayɛ hom ahobow.
Na dɛ mbrɛ Egya no nyan ewufo na ɔma hɔn nkwa, dɛmara so na ɔba no dze nkwa ma hɔn a ɔpɛ.
Na eso Egya no mmbu biara atsɛn, na ɔdze atsɛmbu nyina ahyɛ ɔba no nsa,
ma obiara eedzi ɔba no nyi, dɛ mbrɛ wodzi Egya no nyi. Nyia onndzi ɔba no nyi no, onndzi Egya a ɔsomaa no no nyi.
Nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, nyia ɔtse m'asɛm, na ɔgye nyia ɔsomaa me no dzi no, ɔwɔ onnyiewiei nkwa, na ɔremmba atsɛmbu mu, na mbom oetwa mu efi owu mu aba nkwa mu.
Nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ dɔn no reba na enya edu a ewufo bɛtse Nyankopɔn Ba ne ndze, na hɔn a wɔbɛtse no benya nkwa.
Na dɛ mbrɛ Egya no wɔ nkwa wɔ nankasa no mu no, dɛmara so na ɔdze maa ɔba no dɛ onnya nkwa wɔ nankasa no mu.
Na ɔmaa no tum dɛ ombu atsɛn so, osiandɛ ɔyɛ nyimpa Ba.
Mma yi nnyɛ hom nwanwa: na dɔn no reba a hɔn a wɔwɔ nda mu nyina bɛtse me ndze,
na woefir edzi; hɔn awɔayɛ papa no, akɔ nkwa wunyan mu; hɔn a wɔayɛ dza omuo no, akɔ afɔdzi wunyan mu.
Mankasa munntum mennhyɛ moho nnyɛ hwee; dɛ mbrɛ metse na mubu atsɛn, na m'atsɛmbu tsen, osiandɛ monnhwehwɛ dza mankasa mepɛ, na dza nyia ɔsomaa me no pɛ a.
Sɛ mankasa midzi moho dase a, me dasee nnyɛ nokwar.
Obi wɔ hɔ a odzi mo ho dase, na minyim dɛ ne dasee a odzi wɔ mo ho no yɛ nokwar.
Hom somae kɔr John hɔ, na ɔagye nokwar no ho dase:
na emidze, menngye nyimpa hɔ dase, na mekã yinom ma hom eenya nkwa.
Ɔno nye kandzea a ɔdzɛw na ɔhyerɛn, na hom pɛɛ dɛ hom enyi gye wɔ ne kan mu mber kakra.
Na emidze, mowɔ dasefo a ɔkyɛn John, na ndwuma a Egya no dze ama me dɛ munwie no, ndwuma a meyɛ noara gye mo ho dase dɛ Egya no na ɔasoma me.
Na Egya no a ɔasoma me no nankasa agye mo ho dase. Hom nntsee ne ndze da, eso hom nnhun no su,
na hom nnyi n'asɛm tse hom mu, osiandɛ nyia ɔsomaa no no, hom nngye no nndzi.
Hom hwehwɛ kyerɛwsɛm no mu, osiandɛ hom susu dɛ yinom mu na hom wɔ onnyiewiei nkwa; naaso yinom nye dza wɔgye mo ho dase,
na hom mmpɛ dɛ hom ba me nkyɛn ma hom eenya nkwa.
Menngye enyimnyam wɔ nyimpa hɔ.
Na minyim hom dɛ hom nnyi Nyankopɔn no dɔ wɔ hom mu.
Emidze, menam m'Egya dzin do maba, na hom nngye me; sɛ obi nam nankasa ne dzin do ba a, ɔno na hom bɛgye no.
Hom bɛyɛ dɛn etum agye edzi, hom a hom gye enyimnyam wɔ homho nkorkor, na hom nnhwehwɛ enyimnyam a ofi Nyankopɔn hɔ ba no?
