Mma hom nsusu dɛ emi na mobɔkɔtõa hom ama Egya no, na nyia ɔtõa hom wɔ hɔ, mekyerɛ Moses a hom dze hom werɛ atwer no no.
Na sɛ hom agye Moses edzi a, nkyɛ hom bɛgye mo so edzi; osiandɛ mankasa na ɔkyerɛɛW mo ho nsɛm.
Na sɛ hom nngye ne kyerɛw no nndzi a, hom bɛyɛ dɛn etum agye m'asɛm edzi?
6: Iyinom ekyir no, Jesus sii mu kɔr Galilee po a ɔyɛ Tiberias po no egya.
Na nyimpadodow pii dzii n'ekyir, osiandɛ wohun nsɛnkyerɛdze a ɔyɛe wɔ hɔn a wɔyar ho.
Na Jesus kɔr koko no do na ɔnye n'esuafo kɛtsena hɔ.
Na apaho no, Jewfo afahyɛ no, abɛn.
Na afei, Jesus maa n'enyi do, na ohun dɛ nyimpadodow kɛse reba ne nkyɛn no, ɔsee Philip dɛ, Hen na yɛbɔkɔtɔ paanoo ma yinom eedzi?
Na iyi ɔkãe dze sɔɔ no hwɛe, na nankasa nyim dza ɔrebɛyɛ.
Philip buaa no dɛ, Paano denare ahaenu nnkɔsõ hɔn dɛ hɔn nyina benya nkakrankakra.
Na n'esuafo mu baako, Andrew a ɔyɛ Simon Peter no nua no, see no dɛ,
Abanyimba bi wɔ ha a ɔwɔ atoko-paanoo enum na esunam nkakraba ebien; na iyidze yɛ ebɛn ma nyimpa pii yi?
Na Jesus see dɛ, Hom mma nyimpa no ntsenatsena famu. Eso sar pii wɔ hɔ. Na mbarimba no tsenatsenaa famu ma hɔn dodow bɛyɛ mpemenum.
Na Jesus faa paanoo no, na ɔdaa ase no, ɔkyɛe maa hɔn a wɔtsetse hɔ no, ɔnye esunam no so dɛmara dze maa dodow a wɔpɛ.
Na wɔmee no, ɔsee n'esuafo dɛ, hom mboaboa mporoporoba a ɔaka no ano, na biribiara annyɛ gyan.
Na wɔboaboaa ano, na wɔdze atoko-paanoo enum no no mporoporoba a ɔkae ma hɔn a wodzidzii no hyɛɛ mbirefi duebien amaama.
Na nyimpa no hun asɛnkyerɛdze a ɔyɛe no, wɔkãa dɛ, ampa, oyi nye nkɔnhyɛnyi a ɔreba wiadze no.
Na Jesus hun dɛ wɔreba abɛfa no ahyɛ no dze no akedzi hen ntsi, ɔno nko twee noho kɔr koko no do bio.
Na odur anafua no, n'esuafo kɔr mpoano;
na wɔkɔr hɛn mu twaa po no rokɔ Capernuam. Na sum agye, na Jesus nnyae mmbaa hɔn nkyɛn,
na po no hurii wɔ mframa kɛse a ɔbɔe no ntsi.
Na wɔkwaan bɛyɛ akwansimba eduonu enum anaadɛ eduasa no, wohun Jesus dɛ ɔnam po no do, na ɔrotwe abɛn hɛn no, na wosuroi.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mara a, mma hom nnsuro.
Nna wɔpɛɛ dɛ wɔgye no ba hɛn no mu, na ntsɛmara na hɛn no dur asaase a wɔrokɔ do no do.
Adze kyee no, nyimpadodow a wogyinagyina po no egya no hun dɛ hɛn nnyi hɔ dɛ kor ara, naaso Jesus annka n'esuafo ho annkɔ hɛn no mu, na n'esuafo nko na wɔkɔree.
(Naaso ahɛn bi fii Tiberias baa mbrɛ Ewuradze daa ase no wodzii paanoo wɔ hɔ no),
na nyimpadodow no hun dɛ Jesus nnyi hɔ na esuafo no nnyi hɔ no, hɔn so wɔkɔr hɛn mu na wɔba Capernaum bɔhwehwɛɛ Jesus.
Na wobohun no wɔ po no egya no, wɔsee no dɛ, Rabbi, aber bɛn na ebaa ha?
Jesus buaa hɔn, na ɔsee dɛ, nokwar, nokwar mese hom dɛ, nnyɛ hom hun nsɛnkyerɛdze ntsi na hom rohwehwɛ me, na hom dzii paanoo na hom mee no ntsi a.
Mma hom nnyɛ edwuma wɔ edziban a ɔsɛɛ ho, na mbom wɔ edziban a ɔtsena hɔ kodu onnyiewiei nkwa mu a nyimpa Ba dze bɛma hom no ho; na ɔno na Egya Nyankopɔn asɔw n'ano.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, ebɛn na yɛnyɛ na yaayɛ Nyankopɔn ndwuma.
Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, iyi nye Nyankopɔn edwuma, dɛ hom bɛgye nyia ɔnoara somaa no no edzi.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, asɛnkyerɛdze bɛn na eyɛ ma yeehu na yaagye wo edzi? Ebɛn edwuma na eyɛ?
Hɛn egyanom dzii manna no wɔ sar no do, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, ɔmaa hɔn paanoo fi sor ma woeedzi.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, nnyɛ Moses na ɔmaa hom paanoo a ofi sor no, na m'Egya na ɔma hom paanoo pa a ofi sor no;
na Nyankopɔn paanoo nye nyia ofi sor sian ba na ɔma wiadze nkwa no.
Nna wɔse no dɛ, Ewuradze, ma hɛn paanoo yi bi daa.
na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, emi nye nkwa paanoo no: Nyia ɔba mo hɔ, ɔkɔm renndze no da, na nyia ɔgye me dzi nsukɔm renndze no da.
Na mesee hom dɛ, Hom ehu me naaso hom nngye nndzi.
Dza Egya no dze ama me biara bɛba mo hɔ; na nyia ɔbɛba mo hɔ no moronntow no nnkyen da,
osiandɛ mifi sor misianee mebae, nnyɛ dɛ merebɛyɛ mankasa me pɛ, na mbom nyia ɔsomaa me no ne pɛ a.
Na iyi nye nyia ɔsomaa me no ne pɛ, dɛ dza ɔdze ama me nyina mennyew no mu hwee, mebɛma no do wɔ da a odzi ekyir no mu.
Na iyi nye m'Egya ne pɛ, dɛ obiara a ɔhwɛ Ba no na ɔgye no dzi no, onnya onnyiewiei nkwa, na mebɛma no do wɔ da a odzi ekyir no mu.
Nna Jewfo no hwinhwinii wɔ no ho dɛ ɔkãa dɛ, mmi nye paanoo a ofi sor bae no,
na Wɔsee dɛ, Ana nnyɛ oyi nye Jesus, Joseph ne ba a yenyim n'egya nye ne nã no? na ɔyɛ dɛn na afei ɔse dɛ, Mesian mefi sor maba?
Jesus buae na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, mma hom nnhwinhwin hom mu.
Obiara nntum mmba mo hɔ, gyedɛ Egya no na ɔsomaa me no twe no, na mebɛma no do wɔ da a odzi ekyir no mu.
Wɔakyerɛw wɔ Nkɔnhyɛfo no mu dɛ, na hɔn nyina Nyankopɔn bɛkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn. Obiara a ɔatse wɔ Egya no nkyɛn na oesūa no, ɔba mo hɔ.
Nnyɛ dɛ obiara ehu Egya no, gyedɛ nyia ofi Nyankopɔn nkyɛn no, ɔno na oehu Egya no.
Nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, nyia ɔgye dzi no wɔ onnyiewiei nkwa.
Emi nye nkwa paanoo no.
Hom egyanom dzii manna no wɔ sar no do na wowuwuii;
Iyi nye paanoo a ofi sor sian ba no, na nyimpa eedzi bi na oeennwu.
Emi nye paanoo tseasenyi a ofi sor sianee bae no; sɛ obi dzi paanoo yi bi a, ɔbɛtsena ase daa; na ampaara paanoo a medze bɛma nye mo honam wɔ wiadze nkwa ntsi.
Na Jewfo peer wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na nyimpa bi botum dze no honam ama hɛn ma yeedzi?
Jesus see hɔn dɛ, nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, sɛ hom enndzi nyimpa Ba no honam na hom annom no bɔgyaa a, hom nnyi kwa wɔ hom mu.
Nyia odzi mo honam na ɔnom mo bɔgyaa no, ɔwɔ onnyiewiei nkwa, na da a odzi ekyir no mu mebɛma no do.
Na mo honam yɛ edziban ampa, na mo bɔgyaa yɛ anondze ampa.
Nyia odzi mo honam na ɔnom mo bɔgyaa na ɔtse mo mu, na mo so metse no mu.
Dɛ mbrɛ Egya tseasenyi no somaa me, na mudua Egya no do metse ase no, nyia odzi mo honam no, nankasa so bodua mo do atsena ase.
Iyi nye paanoo a ofi sor sianee bae no: Nnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ hom egyanom dzii manna no na wowuwui no; nyia obedzi paanoo yi no, ɔbɛtsena asa daa.
Ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ wɔ Capernuam wɔ nhyiamudan mu no, nna ɔkãa asɛm yi.
Dɛm ntsi n'esuafo pii tsee no, wɔsee dɛ, Asɛm yi yɛ dzen: woana botum etsie?
Na Jesus hun wɔ nankasa no mu dɛ n'esuafo ruhwinhwin asɛm no ho no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, iyi ma hom fintsiw anaa?
Na ayerɛmbɔa hom bohu nyimpa Ba dɛ ɔrofow kɔ sor mbrɛ nkan no ɔwɔ dze ɛ?
Sunsum nye dza ɔma nkwa, mfaso biara nnyi honam mu: Nsɛm a makã akyerɛ hom no yɛ sunsum, na ɔyɛ nkwa.
Na hom mu binom wɔ hɔ a wɔnngye nndzi. Na Jesus fir ahyɛse no nyim hɔn a wɔanngye no enndzi na nyia obeyi no ama no.
Na ɔsee dɛ, iyi ntsi na mase hom dɛ obi nntum mmba mo hɔ gyedɛ Egya no ma no kwan ana.
Ofir yi do n'esuafi pii saan ekyir, na wɔnnye no annantsew bio.
Dɛm ntsi Jesus see duebien no dɛ, Ana hom so hom pɛ dɛ hom kɔ a?
Simon Peter buaa no dɛ, Ewuradze, woana hɔ na yɛbɔkɔ? Ɔwo na ewɔ onnyiewiei nkwa ho nsɛm;
na hɛndze, yɛagye edzi na yenyim dɛ ɔwo nye Nyankopɔn no Hotseweenyi no.
Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Ana nnyɛ emi na mepaa hom duebien yi? Na hom mu baako yɛ abɔnsam.
Judas, Simon Iscariot ne ba no, ɔno na ɔrekã no ho asɛm no: Na ɔno na oribeyi no ama; eso ɔyɛ duebien no mu baako.
7: Na iyinom ekyir no, Jesus koduaduaa Galilee, na ɔmmpɛ dɛ oduadua Judæa, osiandɛ Jewfo no rohwehwɛ no eku no.
Na Jewfo no asese-afahyɛ no abɛn.
Na no nuanom see no dɛ, fi ha kɔ Judæa ama w'esuafo so aahwɛ wo ndwuma a ereyɛ yi.
Na obi nnyɛ biribi wɔ nsumaa mu, na ɔnnhwehwɛ dɛ nankasa dze, wobohu no bagua mu. Sɛ eyɛ yinom a, yi woho kyerɛ wiadze.
Na no nuanom mpo anngye no enndzi.
Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Emidze, me ber nnyae nndurii, na homdze, hom ber wɔ hɔ daa.
Wiadze nntum nntan hom, na emidze, ɔtan me, osiandɛ megye no ho dase dɛ no ndwuma muo.
Hom nkɔ afahyɛ no ase; emidze, minnyae monnkɔr afahyɛ yi ase, osiandɛ me ber nnyae nndurii.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛm no ɔtsenaa Galilee.
Na no nuanom kɔree no, nna ɔno so kɔr afahyɛ no ase, nnyɛ guado, na mbom ɔtse dɛ nsumaa mu.
Na Jewfo no hwehwɛɛ no afahyɛ no ase, na wɔsee dɛ, ɔwɔ hen?
Na huhuhuhu pii baa nyimpadodow no mu wɔ no ho: Binom se, ɔyɛ nyimpa pa; binom se, Dabi, na ɔdaadaa nkorɔfo no.
Naaso, Jewfo ho hu ntsi, obi anngye enyim annkã no ho asɛm.
Na odur afahyɛ no finimfin no, Jesus kɔr asɔrfi mu kɛkyerɛkyerɛe.
Na ɔyɛɛ Jewfo no nwanwa na wɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na onnsūa nwoma, na onyim yi?
Na Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, me nkyerɛkyerɛ nnyɛ medze, na nyia ɔsomaa me no dze a.
Sɛ obi pɛ dɛ ɔyɛ ne pɛ a, obohu nkyerɛkyerɛ no dɛ ofi Nyankopɔn anaadɛ ofi mankasa me tsirmu na mekã.
Nyia ɔbɔ nakasa ne tsirmu kasa no hwehwɛ nankasa n'enyimnyam; na nyia ɔhwehwɛ nyia ɔsomaa no no n'enyimnyam, ɔno na ɔyɛ nokwafo, na dza ɔnntsen nnyi no mu.
Ana nnyɛ Moses na ɔmaa hom mbra no, na hom mu obiara nnyɛ mbra no? Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom hwehwɛ me eku me?
Nyimpadodow no buaa dɛ. Ewɔ abɔnsam: Woana rohwehwɛ wo eku wo?
Jesus buaa na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, edwuma kor pɛ na meyɛe na ɔyɛ hom nyina nwanwa.
Dɛm ntsi na Moses ama hom twatsia-nnyɛ dɛ ofir Moses, na ofir egyanom no-na ahomgyeda hom twa nyimpa twatsia.
Sɛ nyimpa nya twatsiatwa ahomgyeda ma wɔanntõ Moses mbra a, hom bo efuw me dɛ mama nyimpa ho nyina ayɛ no dzen ahomgyeda?
Mma hom mmbu atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ enyiwa do tse, na hom mbu atsɛn tsenenee.
Na Jerusalemfo no mu binom see dɛ, ana nnyɛ yi nye nyia wɔrohwehwɛ no eku no no?
Na hwɛ, ɔgye enyim kasa na wɔnnse no hwee. Gyama mpanyimfo no ehu ampa dɛ oyi nye Christ no anaa? 27 Naaso, oyidze, yenyim mbrɛ ofi, na Christ no dze, sɛ ɔba a, obi runnhu mbrɛ ofi.
Na Jesus rekyerɛkyerɛ wɔ asɔrfi mu no, ɔtsēaa mu na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nyim me, na eso hom nnyim mbrɛ mifi; na mankasa mannhyɛ moho mebae, na nyia ɔsomaa me no nye nokwafo a hom nnyim no.
Emidze, minyim no, osiandɛ mifi no hɔ, na ɔno na ɔsomaa me.
Na wɔhwehwɛɛ no akyer no, na obi ammfa ne nsa ennsuo no mu, osiandɛ no dɔn nnyae nndurii.
Na nyimpadodow no mu pii gyee no dzii na wɔsee dɛ, ana Christ no, sɛ ɔba a, ɔbɛyɛ nkɛnkyerɛdze pii akyɛn dza oyi ayɛ yi?
Phariseefo no tsee nyimpadodow no dɛ woruhwinhwin yinom wɔ no ho, na asɔfompanyin no nye Phariseefo no somaa asomfo dɛ wɔnkɛkyer no.
Na Jesus see dɛ, aber kakrabaabi na mowɔ hom nkyɛn, na morokɔ nyia ɔsomaa me no nkyɛn.
Hom bɔhwehwɛ me na hom nnkohu me, na mbrɛ mowɔ hom runntum hɔ ba.
Na Jewfo no kãa kyerɛɛ hɔnho dɛ, hen na ɔrobɔkɔ na yennkohu no? Ɔbɔkɔ hɔn a wɔapetse Greekfo mu no mu akɛkyerɛkyerɛ Greekfo no anaa?
Asɛm bɛn na ɔkã yi dɛ, hom bɔhwehwɛ me na hom nnkohu me, na mbrɛ mowɔ hom runntum hɔ ba?
Na da a odzi ekyir no a ɔyɛ afahyɛ no ne dapɔn no Jesus gyinae tsēaa mu dɛ, sɛ nsukɔm dze obi a, wɔmma ɔmbra me nkyɛn mbɔnom.
Nyia ɔgye me dzi no, dɛ mbrɛ kyerɛwsɛm no akã no, nkwa esutsen befi ne yamu apem.
Na iyidze, ɔkãe wɔ Sunsum a hɔn a wɔgyee no dzii no wɔribenya no ho, na Sunsum no nnyae mmbae, osiandɛ wonnyae nnhyɛɛ Jesus enyimnyam.
Ntsi nyimpadodow no mu binom, wɔtsee nsɛm yi no, wɔkãa dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi no nye yi ampa.
Binom kãa dɛ, Christ no nye yi; na binom so kãa dɛ, Ana Christ no befi Galilee aba?
Ana kyerɛwsɛm no annkã dɛ, David asefo mu, nye Bethlehem kurow a David tsenaa mu no mu, na Christ no befi aba?
Na mpaapaamu baa nyimpadodow no mu,
na hɔn mu binom pɛɛ dɛ wɔkyer no, naaso obiara ammfa ne nsa ennsuo no mu.
Na asomfo no baa asɔfompanyin no nye Phariseefo no nkyɛn, na wobisaa hɔn dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na hom ammfa no ammba?
Asomfo no buaa dɛ, nyimpa bi nnkasaa dɛ nyimpa yi pɛn.
Na Phariseefo no buaa hɔn dɛ, ana hom so wɔadaadaa hom?
Ana mpanyimfo anaadɛ Phariseefo bi gyee no dzii?
Na nyimpadodow a wonnyim mbra no, wɔadom hɔn.
Nicodemus a nkan no ɔbaa ne nkyɛn a ɔyɛ hɔn mu baako no kãa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ,
Ana hɛn mbra so onndzi kan nntsie nyimpa, na onnhun dza ɔayɛ a, obu no atsɛn?
Wobuaa no dɛ, Ana wo so ifi Galilee? Hwehwɛ mu hwɛ, na hu dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi mmpuei wɔ Galilee mu da.
(Na hɔn nyina kokɔr hɔn efiefi;
8: na Jesus kɔr Ngo Bepɔw no do.
Na ahamanakye no ɔbaa asɔrfi no mu bio, na ɔman no nyina baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔtsenaa ase kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na kyerɛwfo no nye Phariseefo no dze ɔbaa bi a wɔakyer no awarto mu bae, na wɔdze no sii finimfin no, wɔsee no dɛ,
Kyerɛwkyerɛwfo, wɔakyer ɔbaa yi wɔ awarto mu, wɔ do ara.
Eso Moses wɔ mbra no mu hyɛɛ hɛn dɛ wonsiw dɛmfo abo: ɔwo ese dɛn?
Na iyidze, wɔkãe dze sɔɔ no hwɛe, ma woeenya biribi dze akɔtõa no. Na Jesus brɛɛ no mu adze dze ne nsatseaba kyerɛwkyerɛɛw daadze.
Na wɔda ho ara ribisa no no, ɔtseen no mu kãa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, hom mu nyia bɔn nnyi no ho no, wɔmma ɔntow no bo kan.
Na ɔbrɛɛ no mu adze bio, na ɔdze ne nsatseaba kyerɛwkyerɛɛw daadze.
Na hɔndze, wɔtsee na hɔn tsibowa yii hɔn atsɛn no, wofiir edzi nkorkor fitsi mpanyimfo do besi hɔn a wodzi ekyir do, na ɔkaa Jesus nko nye ɔbaa no a ogyina finimfin no.
Na Jesus tseen no mu na oennhu obiara dɛ ɔbaa no nko no, ɔsee dɛ, ɔbaa, w'atoafo no wɔ hen? Ana obi emmbu wo fɔ?
Ɔsee no dɛ, Mo Wura, obi emmbu me fɔ. Jesus see no dɛ, mo so mummbu wo fɔ: ɔ na mma nnkɛyɛ bɔn bio).
Na Jesus kasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn bio dɛ, emi nye wiadze kan no: Nyia odzi m'ekyir no rennantsew sum mu, na obenya nkwa kan no.
Phariseefo no see no dɛ, ɔwodze, idzi wankasa woho dase: Wo dasee nnyɛ nokwar.
Jesus buaa na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, sɛ midzi mankasa moho dase mpo a, me dasee yɛ nokwar, osiandɛ minyim mbrɛ mifi bae na mbrɛ morokɔ; na homdze, hom nnyim mbrɛ mifi bae anaa mbrɛ morokɔ.
Homdze, hom bu honam enyi atsɛn, na emidze, mummbu obi atsɛn.
Na sɛ mubu atsɛn mpo a, nkyɛ m'atsɛmbu yɛ nokwar, osiandɛ nnyɛ mo nko na mowɔ hɔ, na emi nye Egya no a ɔsomaa mo no.
Na wɔakyerɛw wɔ hom mbra no mu so dɛ nyimpa beenu hɔn dasee yɛ nokwar.
Emi nye nyia odzi mankasa moho dase, na Egya a ɔsomaa me no so dzi me dase.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, hen na w'Egya wɔ? Jesus buaa dɛ, hom nnyim me, eso hom nnyim m'Egya; sɛ hom nyim me a, nkyɛ hom nyim m'Egya so dɛmara.
ɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ asɔrfi no mu na ɔkãa nsɛm yi wɔ sikakorabea hɔ; na obi ammfa ne nsa ennsua no mu, osiandɛ no dɔn nnyae nndurii.
Jesus see hɔn bio dɛ, morokɔ, na hom bɔhwehwɛ me, na hom bowu wɔ hom bɔn mu: mbrɛ morokɔ no, hom runntum mmba hɔ.
Na Jewfo no see no dɛ, Oribedzi noho ewu anaa, na ɔse, mbrɛ morokɔ no, hom runntum mmba hɔ?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, homdze, hom fi famu dze mu; emidze, mifi ɔsor dze mu; homdze, hom fi wiadze yi mu; emidze, mimmfi wiadze yi mu.
Dɛm ntsi mesee hom dɛ hom bowu wɔ hom bɔn mu: Sɛ hom nngye nndzi dɛ emi nye ɔno a, hom bowu wɔ hom bɔn mu.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, woana nye wo? Jesus see hɔn dɛ, dza mifi ahyɛse makã akyerɛ hom no a.
Na mowɔ hom ho nsɛm pii a mekã na mubu hom atsɛn; na nyia ɔsomaa me no yɛ nokwafo, na dza matse wɔ no hɔ na mekã kyerɛ wiadze.
Wɔanntse ase dɛ Egya no ho asɛm na ɔrekã kyerɛ hɔn no.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, sɛ hom nya ma nyimpa Ba no do a, nna hom bohu dɛ emi nye no, na dɛ mennhyɛ mankasa moho nnyɛ biribi, na dɛ mbrɛ Egya no kyerɛkyerɛ me na mekã nsɛm yi.
Na nyia ɔsomaa me no nye me tse: Onngyaa mo nko, osiandɛ meyɛ dza ɔsɔ n'enyi daa.
Na ɔrekasa dɛm no, dodowara gyee no dzii.
Na Jesus kãa kyerɛɛ Jewfo a wɔgyee no dzii no dɛ, sɛ hom tsena m'asɛm mu a, nna hom yɛ m'esuafo ampa;
na hom bohu nokwar no, na nokwar no bɛyɛ hom adehye.
Wobuaa no dɛ, yɛyɛ Abraham asefo, yɛnnyɛ obi nkowaa da: Ɔyɛ dɛn na ese dɛ, hom bɛyɛ adehye?
Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, obiara a ɔyɛ bɔn no, ɔyɛ bɔn akowaa;
na akowaa nnka fie daa, na ɔba dze, ɔtsena hɔ daa.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ ɔba no yɛ hom adehye a, hom bɛyɛ adehye ampa.
Minyim dɛ hom yɛ Abraham n'asefo, naaso hom rohwehwɛ me eku me, osiandɛ m'asɛm hɛn hom mu a ɔnnyɛ.
Dza mehu wɔ m'Egya nkyɛn na mekã na hom so hom yɛ dza hom atse wɔ hom egya nkyɛn.
Wobuaa no see dɛ, hɛn egya nye Abraham. Jesus see hɔn dɛ, sɛ hom yɛ Abraham mba a, nkyɛ hom bɛyɛ Abraham ndwuma;
na afei dze, hom rohwehwɛ me eku me, nyimpa a makasa nokwar a metsee no Nyankopɔn nkyɛn makyerɛ hom: Iyidze, Abraham annyɛ.
Hom yɛ hom egya ndwuma. Wɔsee no dɛ, nnyɛ ndwumanyɛ mu na wɔwoo hɛn: Egya kor na yɛwɔ, ɔno nye Nyankopɔn.
Jesus see hɔn dɛ, sɛ hom egya nye Nyankopɔn a, nkyɛ hom bɔdɔ me, osiandɛ mifi Nyankopɔn mu na maba; eso mannhyɛ moho na maba, na ɔno na ɔsomaa me.
Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom nntse me kasa ase? Osiandɛ hom nntum nntsie m'asɛm.

Hom fi hom egya abɔnsam no mu, na hom egya n'akɔndɔdze na hom pɛ dɛ hom yɛ. Ɔno na ɔyɛ owudzifo fie ahyɛse no, na ɔnntsena nokwar mu, osiandɛ nokwar no nnyi no mu. Sɛ ɔkã atofosɛm a, ofi nankasa n'adze mu na ɔkã, osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔtorfo nye atofosɛm n'egya.
Na emidze, meka nokwar no ntsi, hom nngye me nndzi.
Hom mu woana na obu me bɔn ho fɔ? Sɛ mekã nokwar a, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom nngye mre nndzi?
Nyia ofi Nyankopɔn mu no, otsie Nyankopɔn nsɛm: iyi ntsi na hom nntsie, osiandɛ hom mmfi Nyankopɔn mu.
Na Jewfo no buae see no dɛ, yɛnnkã no yie dɛ eyɛ Samarianyi na ewɔ abɔnsam?
Jesus buaa dɛ, minnyi abɔnsam, na midzi m'Egya nyi, na homdze, hom nndzi me nyi.
Na emidze monnhwehwɛ mankasa m'enyimnyam, na obi wɔ hɔ a ɔhwehwɛ na obua atsɛn.
Nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, sɛ obi dzi m'asɛm do a, orunnhu wu ara da.
Na Jewfo no see no dɛ, afei na yeenya ehu dɛ ewɔ abɔnsam. Abraham nye nkɔnhyɛfo no wui, na ɔwodze ese dɛ, sɛ obi dzi m'asɛm do a, ɔronnsɔ owu nnhwɛ da.
Ana ɔwo sõ kyɛn hɛn egya Abraham a owui no? Na nkɔnhyɛfo no so wui: Eyɛ woho dɛn nye yi?
buaa dɛ, sɛ mehyɛ moho enyimnyam a, m'enyimnyam nnhyɛ hwee: m'Egya na ɔhyɛ me enyimnyam, ɔno a hom kã dɛ ɔyɛ hom Nyankopɔn no;
Naaso hom nnyim no; na emidze, minyim no; na sɛ mekã dɛ minnyim no mpo a, mebɛyɛ ɔtorfo dɛ hom; na minyim no na midzi n'asɛm do.
Hom egya Abraham dzii dɛw dɛ obohu me da; na ohunii, na n'enyi gyee.
Na Jewfo no see no dɛ, innyae nndzii mfe eduonum, na ehu Abraham?
Jesus see hɔn dɛ, nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, ansaana Abraham rebɛba no, nna mowɔ hɔ.
Nna wɔtasee abo dɛ wɔbɔtow abɔ no; na Jesus huntaa noho na ofiir edzi fii asɔrfi no mu. Na ɔfaa hɔn finimfin twaa mu kɔree.
9: Na orutwa mu no, ohun nyimpa bi a ɔyɛ onyifurafo fi n'awoo mu.
Na n'esuafo bisaa no dɛ, Rabbi, woana na ɔyɛɛ bɔn, nyimpa yi anaa n'awofo a, dɛ wɔwoo no onyifurafo?
Jesus buaa dɛ, nnyɛ nyimpa yi na ɔyɛɛ bɔn, eso nnyɛ n'awofo a, na mbrɛ Nyankopɔn ndwuma bɛda edzi wɔ no mu ntsi a.
Otwar dɛ, edzekyee wɔ do yi, yɛyɛ nyia ɔsomaa me no no ndwuma; na adzesaa reba ma obi nntum nnyɛ edwuma.
Mowɔ wiadze yi, emi nye wiadze ne kan.
Ɔkãa dɛm yi no, ɔtoo ntafi guu dadze, na ɔdze ntafi no yɛɛ dɛtse seraa n'enyiwa do,
na ɔsee no dɛ, kɔ kɔhohor wɔ nsutaae Siloam mu (ne nkyerɛase nye, nyia wɔasoma no). Na osii mu kɔree kɔhohoree, na ɔbae no nna ohu adze.
Dɛm ntsi no sɔnmufo nye hɔn a nkan no wohun no dɛ ɔyɛ ohuafo no see no dɛ, Ana nnyɛ oyi na ɔtse hɔ serɛserɛ adze no?
Binom see dɛ, ɔno nye yi; binom so see dɛ, dabi, na ɔnye no sɛ, na nankasa dze ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye no.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, woduaa dɛn mbɔ buee w'enyi?
Obuaa dɛ, nyimpa a wɔfrɛ no Jesus no yɛɛ dɛtse dze seraa m'enyi do, na ɔsee me dɛ, kɔ nsutaae Siloam mu kɔhohor; na mokɔree kɔhohoree nna muhu adze yi.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, ɔno ɔwɔ hen? Ɔsee dɛ, minnyim.
Wɔdze nyia nkan no ɔyɛ onyifurafo no brɛɛ Phariseefo no.
Na da a Jesus yɛɛ dɛtse na obuee n'enyiwa no yɛ ahomgyeda.
Dɛm ntsi Phariseefo no so bisaa no bio, mbrɛ osii hun adze. Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, dɛtse na ɔdze guu m'enyiwa do, na mohohoree, na muhun adze.

Na Phariseefo no mu binom see dɛ, nyimpa yi mmfi Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, osiandɛ onnsie ahomgyeda; binom so see dɛ, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na nyimpa dzebɔnyɛnyi botum ayɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze a ɔtse dɛm yi? Na mpaapaamu baa hɔn mu.
Na wɔsee onyifurafo no bio dɛ, na ɔwo dze, ekã dɛn wɔ no ho, dɛ obuee w'enyiwa? ɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi.
Na Jewfo no anngye no ho asɛm no no enndzi, dɛ nkyɛ ɔyɛ onyifuranyi na afei ohu adze, dze kodur dɛ wɔfrɛɛ nyia ohun adze no n'awofo.
Na wobisaa hɔn dɛ, Ana hom ba a hom se wɔwoo no onyifurafo no nye yi? Afei ɔyɛ dɛn na ohu adze yi?
N'wofo no buaa see hɔn dɛ, yenyim dɛ hɛn ba nye yi, yenyim so dɛ wɔwoo no onyifurafo;
na mbrɛ ɔyɛe na afei ohu adze yi dze, yennyim; na nyimpa kor a obuee n'enyiwa no so, yennyim; ɔnoara oenyim; hom mbisa no, na nakasa bɛkã noho asɛm.
N'awofo kãa yi, osiandɛ wosuroo Jewfo no, na Jewfo no apam dada dɛ, sɛ obi paa mu kã dɛ ɔno nye Christ no a, wɔbɛpam no efi nhyiamudan mu.
Dɛm ntsi na n'awofo kãa dɛ, Oenyin: Hom mbisa no.
Na wɔfrɛɛ nyimpa a nkan no ɔyɛ onyifurafo no ne mpɛn ebien, na wɔsee no dɛ, fa enyimnyam ma Nyankopɔn, na hɛndze, yenyim dɛ nyimpa yi yɛ dzebɔnyɛnyi.
Na obuaa dɛ, Sɛ ɔyɛ dzebɔnyɛnyi a, minnyim. Adze kor na minyim, dɛ nkyɛ meyɛ onyifurafo, na afei dze muhu adze.
Wɔsee no dɛ, ɔyɛɛ wo dɛn? Oduaa dɛn buee w'enyiwa?
Obuaa hɔn dɛ, makã akyerɛ hom dada, na hom enntsie; ebɛnadze ntsi na hom pɛ etsie bio? Hom so pɛ dɛ hom dan n'esuafo anaa?
Na wɔyaw no na wɔsee dɛ, ɔwo na eyɛ no suanyi, na hɛndze, Moses esuafo nye hɛn.
Yenyim dɛ Nyankopɔn akasa akyerɛ Moses, na oyidze, yennyim mbrɛ ofi.
Onyimpa no buae see hɔn dɛ, iyi mu na ɔyɛ nwanwa, dɛ hom nnyim mbrɛ ofi, naaso obuee m'enyiwa.
Yenyim dɛ Nyankopɔn nntsie ndzebɔnyɛfo, na sɛ obi yɛ Nyankopɔn no somfo na ɔyɛ n'apɛdze a, ɔno na otsie no.
Ofitsi dɛ wiadze hyɛɛ ase wɔnntse dɛ obi ebue nyia wɔawo no onyifurafo no n'enyiwa pɛn:
sɛ oyi mmfi Nyankopɔn nkyɛn a, nkyɛ onntum nnyɛ hwee.
Wobuae see no dɛ, ɔwo, bɔn mu koraa na wɔwoo wo, na ɔwo na erekyerɛkyerɛ hɛn yi? Na wɔpaam no fiir edzi.
Jesus tsee dɛ wɔapam no efi edzi, na ohun no no, ɔsee no dɛ, Ana egye Nyankopɔn Ba no dzi?
Na obuae see no dɛ, mo wura, ɔno nye woana, ma mengye no mindzi?
Jesus see no dɛ, ehu no na eso nyia ɔnye wo rekasa yi nye ɔno.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, mo wura, megye midzi; na ɔkotowee sɔɔr no.
Na Jesus see dɛ, atsɛmbu ntsi na mebaa wiadze yi mu: ma hɔn a wonnhu adze no woeehu, na hɔn a wohu adze no wɔaadan enyifurafo.
Na Phariseefo no mu bi a wɔnye no wɔ hɔ tsee nsɛm yi, na wɔsee dɛ, aso hɛn so yɛyɛ enyifurafo?
Jesus see hɔn dɛ, sɛ hom yɛ enyifurafo a, nkyɛ hom nnyi bɔn; na afei hom se dɛ, yehu adze: Ntsi na hom bɔn aka hɔ.
10: Nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, nyia onndua abowano nnkɔ nguamban no mu, na ɔfow fa beebi no, ɔyɛ owifo nye adwotwafo;
na nyia odua abowano kɔ mu no nye nguan no hwɛfo.
Ɔno na abowanohwɛfo no bue ma no, na nguan no tse ne ndze, na ɔbɔ nankasa no nguan dzin frɛ hɔn, na ɔdze hɔn fir edzi.
Na ɔdze nankasa no nguan nyina fir edzi a, odzi hɔn enyim, na nguan no dzi n'ekyir, osiandɛ wonyim ne ndze.
Na ɔnana dze, worinndzi n'ekyir, na woboguan efi ne nkyɛn, osiandɛ wonnyim anana ndze.
Abɛbusɛm yi na Jesus kãa kyerɛɛ hɔn, na hɔndze, woennhu asɛm kor a Jesus rekã kyerɛ hɔn no.
Dɛm ntsi Jesus see hɔn bio dɛ, nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, emi nye nguan no abow no.
Hɔn a wodzii me kan bae no nyina yɛ ewifo nye edwotwafo; naaso nguan no enntsie hɔn.
Emi nye abow no; emi na sɛ obiara nam mo do kɔ mu a, wɔbɛgye no nkwa, na ɔbɔkɔ mu befir, na obenya edzidzibea.
Owifo no mmba gyedɛ orubowia, na oeku, na ɔasɛɛ; emidze, mebae ma woeenya nkwa, na woennya no mbordo.
Emi nye oguanhwɛfo pa no: Oguanhwɛfo pa no dze no nkwa to hɔ ma nguan no.
Na ɔpaanyi no a ɔnnyɛ oguanhwɛfo a nguan no nnyɛ nankasa nedze no, ohu dɛ pataku reba a, ogya nguan no hɔ na oguan; na pataku no ba bɔtotɔr hɔn na ɔhotse hɔn gu.
Ɔpaanyi guan, osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔpaanyi na ɔnndwen nguan no do.
Emi nye oguanhwɛfo pa no: Minyim medze, na medze nyim me,
dɛ mbrɛ Egya no nyim me na minyim Egya no; na medze mo nkwa moto hɔ ma nguan no.
Na mowɔ nguan bi so a wommfi ban yi mu; hɔn so otwar dɛ medze hɔn meba, na wobetsie me ndze, na wɔaayɛ okuw kor nye oguanhwɛfo kor.
Dɛm ntsi na Egya no dɔ me, osiandɛ medze mo nkwa moto hɔ na maafa no bio.
Obi nngye no me nsamu; na mbom mankasa na medze moto hɔ: Mowɔ tum dɛ medze moto hɔ, na mowɔ tum dɛ mefa no bio. Akyɛdze yi na minyaa no m'Egya hɔ.
Na mpaapaamu bi baa Jewfo no mu bio wɔ asɛm yi ntsi.
Na hɔn mu pii see dɛ, ɔwɔ abɔnsam, na ɔabɔ dam: Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom ritsie no?
Binom see dɛ, iyi nnyɛ nyia ɔwɔ abɔnsam ne nsɛm a. Aso abɔnsam botum ebue onyifurafo enyiwa anaa?
Afei asɔrfi ne ntsewho afahyɛ no edu wɔ Jerusalem: Awɔwber so aba.
Na Jesus nenam asɔreba no mu wɔ Solomon abrandaa mu.
Na Jewfo no botwae hyiaa no, ma wɔsee no dɛ, ebɛma hɛn enyi ada kwan ekesi dabɛn bio? Sɛ ɔwo nye Christ no a, kã kyerɛ hɛn kotoo.
Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, makã makyerɛ hom, na hom nngye nndzi; ndwuma a menam m'Egya ne dzin do meyɛ no, ɔnoara na odzi me dase.
Na homdze hom nngye me nndzi, osiandɛ hom mmfi mo nguan mu.
Mo nguan tsie me ndze, na minyim hɔn, na wodzi m'ekyir:
na mema hɔn onnyiewiei nkwa, na wɔrennhera da, eso obi runnhwim hɔn wɔ me nsamu.
M'Egya a ɔdze hɔn ama me no, ɔyɛ kɛse kyɛn adze nyina na obi runntum ehwim hɔn m'Egya ne nsamu.
Emi nye Egya no yɛ kor.
Jewfo no faa abo bio dɛ wɔdze besiw no.
Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, ndwuma pa pii na mifi m'Egya nkyɛn dze akyerɛ hom: ndwuma yi mu dza ɔwɔ hen ntsi na hom ribesiw me abo yi?
Jewfo no buaa dɛ, nnyɛ edwuma pa bi ntsi na yeribesiw wo abo, na ebususɛm ntsi a; na osiandɛ ɔwo a eyɛ nyimpa yi, eyɛ woho Nyankopɔn ntsi a.
Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Ana wɔnnkyerɛwee wɔ hom mbra mu dɛ, mekãa dɛ hom yɛ enyame?
Sɛ ɔfrɛ hɔn a Nyankopɔn asɛm baa hɔn ho no enyame a (na kyerɛwsɛm no wonntum nnsan no),
ana hom kã wɔ nyia Egya no etu no esi hɔ na ɔasoma no wiadze no ho, ekã ebususɛm; osiandɛ mekãa dɛ, emi nye Nyankopɔn Ba ntsi?
Sɛ mennyɛ m'Egya ndwuma a, mma hom nngye me nndzi;
na sɛ meyɛ a, kaansa hom nngye emi ara nndzi mpo a, hom ngye ndwuma no ndzi, ma hom aatse ase na hom eehu dɛ Egya no wɔ mu na mo so mowɔ no mu.
Na wɔhwehwɛɛ bio dɛ wɔkyer no, na ofii hɔn nsamu kɔree.
Na osii mu kɔr Jordan egya noho bio, mbrɛ nkan no John runuma no; na ɔkɛtsenaa hɔ.
Na dodowara baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔsee dɛ, John dze, ɔannyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze biara: na dza John kãe wɔ oyi ho nyina yɛ nokwar.
Na dodowara gyee no dzii wɔ hɔ.
11: Na ɔyarfo bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no Lazarus a ofi Bethany, Mary nye no nuabaa Martha hɔn kurow mu.
Mary a ɔdze ngohuam seraa Ewuradze na ɔdze ne tsinhwi pepaa n'anan ho no na no nuabanyin Lazarus yaree no.
Dɛm ntsi ne kyerɛbaa no somae baa no hɔ bɛsee dɛ, Ewuradze, hwɛ, nyia edɔ no no yar.
Na Jesus tsee no ɔsee dɛ, yarba yi nnyɛ wuyarba, na Nyankopɔn enyimnyam ntsi a, ama wɔnam do aahyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba no enyimnyam.
Na Jesus dɔɔ Martha nye no nuabaa nye Lazarus.
Na afei ber a ɔtsee dɛ ɔyar no ɔtsenaa mbrɛ ɔwɔ no ara ndaenu.
Nna n'ekyir no, ɔsee n'esuafo no dɛ, hom mma yɛnkɔ Judæa bio.
Esuafo no see no dɛ, Rabbi, ɔnnkyɛree biara na Jewfo no hwehwɛɛ wo esiw wo abo, na erokɔ hɔ bio?
Jesus buaa dɛ, Ana nnyɛ ndɔnhwer duebien na ɔwɔ adzekyee mu? Sɛ obi nam ewia a, ommfintsiw, osiandɛ ohu wiadze yi kan no.
Na sɛ obi nam anago a, ofintsiw, osiandɛ kan nnyi no mu.
Ɔkãa yinom, na n'ekyir no ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hɛn nyɛnko Lazarus ada, na morokɔ mekenyan no.
Na esuafo no see no dɛ, Ewuradze, sɛ ɔada dze a, nna obenya nkwa.
Na Jesus dze ɔkãa no wɔ no wu ho, na hɔndze, wosusu dɛ eregye ahom wɔ nda mu ho asɛm na ɔreka.
Na Jesus kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn kotoo dɛ, Lazarus ewu;
na ɔyɛ me dɛw wɔ hom ntsi dɛ minnyi hɔ, ama hom aagye edzi: naaso hom mma yɛnkɔ ne nkyɛn.
Na Thomas a wɔfrɛ no Didymus (Ata) no see ne mfɛfo esuafo no dɛ, hom mma hɛn so yɛnye no nkɔ na yɛnye no eewu.
Na Jesus bae no obohun dɛ oedzi ndaanan wɔ nda no mu dada.
Eso Bethany bɛn Jerusalem ho bɛyɛ akwansimba duenum.
Na Jewfo no pii aba Martha nye Mary nkyɛn dɛ wobegyam hɔn wɔ hɔn nua ntsi.
Martha tsee dɛ Jesus reba no, ɔkɔree kehyiaa no; na Mary dze, ɔdaa ho tsenaa ase wɔ fie.
Na Martha see Jesus dɛ, Ewuradze, sɛ ewɔ ha a, nkyɛ mo nuabanyin ennwu.
Na seseiara mpo, minnyim dɛ biribiara a ibebisa Nyankopɔn no, Nyankopɔn dze bɛma wo.
Jesus see no dɛ, wo nuabanyin bɔsoɛr bio.
Martha see no dɛ, minyim dɛ da a odzi ekyir wunyan no mu, ɔbɔsoɛr.
Jesus see no dɛ, emi nye wunyan no nye nkwa no: Nyia ɔgye me dzi no, owu mpo a, ɔbɛtsena ase.
na obiara a ɔtse ase na ɔgye me dzi no, onnkowu da. Ana egye yi dzi?
ɔsee no dɛ, nyew, Ewuradze, magye medzi dɛ ɔwo nye Christ no, Nyankopɔn Ba no a ɔreba wiadze no.
Na ɔkãa dɛm no, osii mu kɔree kɛfrɛɛ no nuabaa Mary nsumaa mu dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛwfo no aba, na ɔfrɛ wo.
Na ɔno so ɔtsee no, ɔsoɛɛr ntsɛmara na ɔbaa ne nkyɛn.
Na Jesus nnyae mmbaa kurow no mu, na ɔwɔ mbrɛ Martha kehyiaa no hɔ no.
Na Jewfo a wɔnye no wɔ fie rigyam no no, wohun Mary dɛ ɔasoɛr ntsɛm epue no, wodzii n'ekyir, na wosusu dɛ ɔrokɔ nda no do ekosū wɔ hɔ.
Na Mary dze, odur mbrɛ Jesus wɔ no, na ohun no no, ɔhwee n'ananadze see dɛ, Ewuradze, sɛ ewɔ ha a, nkyɛ mo nuabanyin ennwu.
NA Jesus hun dɛ orusū na Jewfo a wɔnye no bae no so rusū no, osii nkrum wɔ no sunsum mu na ɔyɛɛ no awerɛhow,
na ɔsee dɛ, hom dze no ato hen? Wɔsee no dɛ, Ewuradze, bra bɔhwɛ.
Jesus sui.
Nna Jewfo no see dɛ, hwɛ mbrɛ ɔdɔ no.
Na hɔn mu binom see dɛ, oyi a obuee onyifurafo no enyiwa no, oenntum amma dɛ nkyɛ oyi so oennwu anaa?
Na Jesus sii nkrum wɔ no mu bio, na ɔbaa nda no do: Ɔbodan a, na ɔbo hin ano.
Jesus see dɛ, hom nyi ɔbo no. Nyia owui no nuabaa Martha see no dɛ, Ewuradze, sesei dze ɔasɛɛ, na oedzi ndaanan.
Jesus see no dɛ, Ana mannse wo dɛ, sɛ egye dzi a, ibohu Nyankopɔn enyimnyam?
Na woyii ɔbo no. Na Jesus maa n'enyiwa do na ɔsee dɛ, Egya, meda wo ase dɛ itsie me:
na emidze, minyim dada dɛ itsie me daa, na nyimpadodow a wogyinagyina ho yi ntsi na mesee dɛm, ama wɔaagye edzi dɛ ɔwo na esomaa me.
Na ɔkaa dɛm no, ɔdze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu dɛ, Lazarus, fir bra!
Nyia owui no firii bae: Nda mu atam kyekyer ne nan nye ne nsa, na duukuu kyerkyer n'enyim: na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom nsan no, na hom mma ɔnkɔ.
Na Jewfo no mu pii a wɔbaa Mary nkyɛn na wohun dza ɔyɛe no, wɔgyee no dzii;
na hɔn mu binom sii mu kɔr Phariseefo nkyɛn kɛkãa dza Jesus yɛe no kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛfo no maa wokehyiaa baguafo no, na wɔsee dɛ, yɛreyɛ dɛn? Na nyimpa yi reyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze pii.
Sɛ ye gyaa no dɛm a, nyimpa nyina bɛgye no edzi, na Romefo afa hɛn bea nye hɛn man yi.
Na hɔn mu baako bi, Caiaphas a odzi afe noara mu sɔfopanyin, see hɔn dɛ, hom nnyim hwee,
na eso hom nndwen dɛ oye ma hɛn dɛ nyimpa kor bowu ama ɔman no, na ɔman no nyina aannhera.
Na iyi, nnyɛ nankasa na ɔkãe, na odzi afe noara mu sɔfopanyin ntsi, ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm dɛ Jesus rubowu ama ɔman no,
na nnyɛ ɔman no nko ntsi, na dɛ ɔrebɛka Nyankopɔn mba a wɔapetse nyina so abɔ mu ayɛ kor.
Nna ofitsi da no ara wɔfaa apam dɛ woboku no.
Dɛm ntsi Jesus annantsew petee wɔ Jewfo no mu bio; na ofii hɔ kɔr asaase a ɔbɛn sar no ho no do, wɔ kurow a wɔfrɛ no Ephraim mu, na ɔnye n'esuafo kɛtsenaa hɔ.
Na Jewfo apaho no abɛn, na dodowara fiir asaase no do kɔr Jerusalem ansaana apaho no edu dɛ worukoguar hɔnho.
Na wɔhwehwɛɛ Jesus, na wogyinaa asɔrfi no mu sesee hɔnho dɛ, hom dwen dɛn? Ɔremmba afahyɛ yi ase anaa?
Na asɔfompanyin no nye Phariseefo no ahyɛ mbra dɛ, obi nyim mbrɛ ɔwɔ a, ɔnkɛkyerɛ ma wɔnkyer no.
12: Afei aka nda esia ma apaho no edu no Jesus baa Bethany, mbrɛ Lazarus a onyaan no fii ewufo mu no wɔ.
Na wɔtoo no pon wɔ hɔ, na Martha somee, na Lazarus dze, ɔyɛ hɔn a wɔnye no tsenaa edzidzi no mu baako.
Na Mary faa nard ngohuam krɔngyenn a ɔsom bo pɔɔn kor dze bɛseraa Jesus n'anan ho; na ɔdze no nhwi pepaa n'anan ho; na ngo no no huam hyɛɛ dan no mã.
Na n'esuafo no mu baako, Judas Iscariot a oribeyi no ama no, see dɛ,
ɔyɛ dɛn na wɔanntɔn ngohuam yi anngye denare ahaesia, na wɔammfa amma ehiafo?
Ɔkãa yi no, nnyɛ dɛ ɔdwen ehiafo do ntsi a, na osiandɛ ɔyɛ owifo, na okura kotoku no, na ɔfefa dza wɔdze gu mu no.
Na Jesus see dɛ, hom ngyaa no: ɔayɛ yi dze ama me sei-da no;
na ehiafo dze, hom wɔ hɔn hom nkyɛn daa, na emidze, hom nnyi me daa.
Na Jewfo mu nyimpadodow no tsee dɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na wɔbae, nnyɛ Jesus ntsi nko, na dɛ wobohu Lazarus so a onyaan no fii ewufo mu no.
Na asɔfompanyin no faa apam dɛ woboku Lazarus so,
osiandɛ ne ntsi na Jewfo pii rokɔ na wɔrekɛgye Jesus edzi.
Adze kyee no nyimpadodow pii a wɔbaa afahyɛ no ase no tsee dɛ Jesus reba Jerusalem no,
wɔfefaa berɛw na wofiir edzi dɛ worikehyia no kwan, na wɔtsēatseaa mu dɛ, Hosanna, nhyira nye nyia ɔnam Ewuradze dzin mu reba no, Israel Hen no a!
Na Jesus hun asoasoba bi no, ɔtsenaa no dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ,
Mma nnsuro, Sion babaa: hwɛ, wo Hen reba, ɔtse asoasoba do!
Iyinom n'esuafo no anntse ase kan no, na wɔhyɛɛ Jesus enyimnyam no, nna wɔkaa dɛ wɔakyerɛw yinom wɔ no ho, na wɔayɛ ama no.
Na nyimpadodow a wɔnye no wɔ hɔ na ɔfrɛɛ Lazarus fiir nda mu na onyaan no fii ewufo mu no dzii dase.
Iyi ntsi na nyimpadodow no kehyiaa no kwan, osiandɛ wɔtsee dɛ wɔayɛ dɛm nsɛnkyerɛdze yi.
Na Phariseefo no kãe wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, hom hu dɛ hom nnya hwee: hwɛ, wiadze etu edzi n'ekyir.
Na Greekfo bi wɔ hɔn a wɔaba dɛ wɔrobɔsɔr wɔ afahyɛ no ase no mu.
Woyi na wɔpaa Philip a ofir Bethsaida a ɔwɔ Galilee ne nkyɛn, na wobisaa no dɛ, Owura, yɛpɛ dɛ yehu Jesus.
Philip bae bɛkãa kyerɛɛ Andrew, na Andrew nye Philip bɛkãa kyerɛɛ Jesus.
Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, dɔn no edu a wɔbɛhyɛ nyimpa Ba no enyimnyam.
Nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, sɛ ewifua anntɔ famu ennwu a, no nko na ɔda hɔ; na sɛ owu a, ɔsow aba pii.
Nyia ɔdɔ no nkwa no, ɔyew no, na nyia ɔtan no nkwa wɔ wiadze yi mu no, ɔbɔkora no akɔ ennyiewiei nkwa mu.
Sɛ obi som me a, ma ondzi m'ekyir, na mbrɛ mowɔ no, hɔ na mo somfo no bɛba; sɛ obi som me a, ɔno na m'Egya no bedzi no nyi.
Afei na me kra ho guan no, na mense dɛn? Egya, gye me fi dɔn yi mu? Naaso iyi ntsi na mebaa dɔn yi mu.
Egya, hyɛ wo dzin enyimnyam. Na ndze bi fi sor bae dɛ, mahyɛ no enyimnyam dada, na mebɛhyɛ no bio.
Na nyimpadodow a wogyinagyina hɔ tsee no, wɔkãa dɛ ɔsenaman abɔ mu; binom see dɛ, ɔbɔfo akasa akyerɛ no.
Jesus buae see dɛ, nnyɛ emi ntsi na ndze yi bae, na hom ntsi a.
Afei nye wiadze atsɛmbu; afei na wɔbɔtow wiadze yi hen akyen.
Na emidze, sɛ wonya ma mo do fi asaase do a, mobɔtwe nyimpa nyina aba me nkyɛn.
Na iyidze ɔkãe dze kyerɛɛ owu kor a orubowu.
Na nyimpadodow no buaa dɛ, Yɛatse wɔ mbra no mu dɛ Christ no tse hɔ daa, na ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔwodze ese dɛ otwar dɛ wɔma nyimpa Ba do yi? Woana nye nyimpa Ba yi?
na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Aka aber kakra na kan no wɔ hom mu: Ber a hom wɔ kan no, hom nnantsew na sum no aammbɔto hom; na nyia ɔnantsew sum mu nnyim mbrɛ ɔrokɔ.
Ber a hom wɔ kan no, hom ngye kan no ndzi, na hom aayɛ kan mba.
Na ɔayɛ dɛm nsɛnkyerɛdze pii yi wɔ hɔn enyim dze, naaso wɔanngye no enndzi,
ma Isaiah nkɔnhyɛnyi n'asɛm a ɔkãe no aaba mu dɛ, Ewuradze, woana agye hɛn asɛnka edzi? Woana na woeyi Ewuradze abasa akyerɛ no?
Iyi ntsi na woenntum anngye enndzi, osiandɛ Isaiah kã bio dɛ,
Oefura hɔn enyiwa, na oepirim hɔn akoma, ma wɔaammfa hɔn enyiwa ennhu na wɔammfa hɔn akoma anntse ase, na wɔaanndan hɔn ho na nannsa ton yarba.
Iyinom Isaiah hun n'enyimnyam ntsi na ɔkãe, na ɔkãa no ho asɛm.
Naaso mpanyimfo no so mu pii gyee no dzii. Na osian Phariseefo no ntsi wɔammpaa mu annkã, mma wɔaanntan hɔn emmfi nhyiamudan mu;
na wɔdɔɔ nyimpa enyimnyam seen Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
Na Jesus tsēaa mu see dɛ, nyia ɔgye me dzi, nnyɛ emi na ɔgye me dzi, na nyia ɔsomaa me no a.
Na nhia ohu me no, ohu nyia ɔsomaa me no.
Maba wiadze dɛ kan, ma obiara a ɔgye me dzi no anntsena sum mu.
Na sɛ obi tse me nsɛm na ɔammfa ennsie a, emidze, mummbu no atsɛn; na mammba dɛ murubobu wiadze atsɛn, na mbom dɛ merebɛgye wiadze nkwa.
Nyia ɔpow me, na ɔnngye me nsɛm no, ɔwɔ nyia obu no atsɛn: Asɛm no a mekãe no, ɔnoara na obobu no atsɛn wɔ da a odzi ekyir no mu.
Osiandɛ emidze, mannhyɛ moho annkasa, na Egya no a ɔsomaa me no, ɔno na ɔama me mbrasɛm dza mense nye dza menkã.
Na minyim dɛ ne mbrasɛm yɛ onnyiewiei nkwa. Ntsi dza mekã no, mbrɛ Egya no akasa akyerɛ mo no, dɛmara na mekã.
13: Na ansaana apaho afahyɛ no rubodu no, Jesus nyim dɛ no dɔn edu dɛ oribefi wiadze yi mu akɔ Egya nkyɛn no, ɔdɔɔ nankasa nedze a wɔwɔ wiadze no, ɔdɔɔ hɔn kesii ewiei.
Na woridzidzi no, na abɔnsam enya dze ahyɛ Judas Iscariot, Simon ne ba, n'akoma mu dɛ onkeyi no mma,
Na Jesus nyim dɛ Egya no dze ndzɛmba nyina ahyɛ ne nsa, na dɛ ofir Nyankopɔn nkyɛn bae, na ɔrokɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn no,
ɔsoɛree fiir edzidzi na oyii ne ntam guu nkyɛn, na ɔfaa entuho bɔɔ noho do.
Na afei ohuee nsu guu guarsɛn mu, na ɔhyɛɛ ase hohoor n'esuafo no anan ho, na ɔdze entuho no a ɔbɔ noho do no pepae.
Na obodur Simon Peter do. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ewuradze, ɔwo rohohor emi m'anan ho?
Jesus buae see no dɛ, dza mereyɛ yi, innyim sesei, na daakye ibohu.
Peter see no dɛ, Ennkɔhohor m'anan ho da! Jesus buaa no dɛ, sɛ mannhohor wo ho a, innyi m'afã.
Simon Peter see no dɛ, Ewuradze, nnyɛ m'anan nko, na me nsa nye me tsir ho so.
Jesus see no dɛ, nyia oeguar, onnhia no gyedɛ n'anan ho hohor, na no ho nyina efir. Na hom ho efir, na nnyɛ hom nyina.
Na onyim nyia oribeyi no ama: Dɛm ntsi na ɔsee dɛ, nnyɛ hom nyina na hom ho efir.
Na owiee hɔn anan ho hohor, na ɔfaa n'atar, ɔtweer hɔ bio no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom ehu dza mayɛ hom yi?
Hom frɛ me Kyerɛkyerɛfo nye Ewuradze, na hom kã no yie, osiandɛ meyɛ dɛm.
Na sɛ emi, Kyerɛkyerɛfo nye Ewuradze, manhohor hom anan ho a, hom so ɔsɛ dɛ hom hohor hom anan ho nkorkor.
Na mama hom mfatoho, ama hom so aayɛ dɛ mbrɛ mayɛ hom yi.
Nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, akowaa nnkyɛn no wura, eso ɔsomafo nnkyɛn nyia ɔsomaa no.
Sɛ hom nyim yinom a, hom dzi do a, nhyira akã hom.
Mennkã no wɔ hom nyina ho: Minyim hɔn a mapa hɔn; na dɛ kyerɛw no bɛba mu dɛ, nyia ɔnye me dzidzi no na ɔama n'anantsir do etsia me no.
Afei mekã mekyerɛ hom ansaana aba mu, na sɛ ɔba mu a, hom aagye edzi dɛ emi nye no.
Nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, nyia ɔgye obiara a mosoma no no, ɔgye me; na nyia ɔgye me no, ɔgye nyia ɔsomaa me no.
Jesus kãa dɛm no, no sunsum ho guaan no, na ɔgyee dase dɛ, nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, Hom mu baako beyi me ama.
Esuafo no hwehwɛɛ hɔn enyim nkorkor, na woennhu nyimpa kor a ɔrekyerɛ.
Na esuafo no mu baako a Jesus dɔɔ no twer no bo mu.
Dɛm ntsi Simon Peter too ne nsa dɛ ombisa nyia ɔrekã no ho asɛm no.
Na ɔpae tweer Jesus no bo mu no ɔsee no dɛ, Ewuradze, woana a?
Jesus buaa dɛ, ɔno nye nyia medze trɔma mobɔbɔ mu mama no no. Na ɔdze trɔma no bɔɔ mu no, ɔdze maa Judas Iscariot, Simon ne ba no.
Na trɔma no ekyir no, nna abɔnsam kɛhɛɛn no mu. Na Jesus see no dɛ, Dza ereyɛ no, yɛ no ntsɛm.
Na hɔn a wɔtsetse pon no ho mu biara ennhu dza osian ntsi ma ɔsee no dɛm.
Na binom dween dɛ Judas kura kotoku no ntsi na Jesus see no dɛ, Kɔtotɔ dza ohia hɛn sie afahyɛ no, anaadɛ ɔmfa biribi mma ehiafo.
Na ɔnodze ɔgyee trɔma no, ntsɛmara na ofiir edzi; na ɔyɛ anafua.
Na ofiir edzi no, Jesus see dɛ, afei wɔahyɛ nyimpa Ba no enyimnyam, na wɔahyɛ Nyankpɔn enyimnaym wɔ no mu.
Na Nyankopɔn so bɛhyɛ no enyimnyam wɔ nankasa no mu, na ɔbɛhyɛ no enyimnyam ntsɛm.
Mbofraba, aka kakrabaabi na menye hom wɔ hɔ: Hom bɔhwehwɛ me, na dɛ mbrɛ mesee Jewfo no, mbrɛ morokɔ hom runntum hɔ ba no, dɛmara na mese hom so sesei.
Mbrasɛm fofor na medze mema hom, dɛ hom ndodɔ homho nkokor: Dɛ mbrɛ madɔ hom no, hom so ndodɔ homho dɛmara.
Ɔnam yi do na nyimpa nyina bohu dɛ hom yɛ m'esuafo, sɛ hom wɔ ɔdɔ wɔ homho nkorkor a.
Simon Peter see no dɛ, Ewuradze, erokɔ hen? Jesus buaa dɛ, mbrɛ morokɔ irunntum mo do ka sesei, na n'ekyir no dze, ebɛka mo do.
Peter see no dɛ, Ewuradze, ebɛnadze ntsi an murunntum wo do ka sesei: Medze mo nkwa mobɔto hɔ mama wo.
Jesus buaa dɛ, Edze wo nkwa bɔto hɔ ama me? Nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, Akokɔ rommbɔn na apa me mprɛnsa.
14: Mma hom akoma ntutu: Hom ngye Nyankopɔn ndzi, hom ngye mo so ndzi.
M'Egya fie wɔ tsenabew pii; sɛ ɔnntse dɛm a, nkyɛ makã akyerɛ hom. Morokɔ ekesiesie beebi mama hom.
Na sɛ mokɔ, na mikesiesie beebi ma hom a, mebɛba bio mabɛfa hom akɔ mankasa me nkyɛn, na mbrɛ mowɔ no, hom so aaba hɔ.
Na mbrɛ morokɔ no, hom nyim kwan no.
Thomas see no dɛ, Ewuradze yennyim mbrɛ erokɔ, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ehu kwan no?
Jesus see no dɛ, emi nye ɔkwan no, nye nokwar no, nye nkwa no; obi mma Egya no hɔ, gyedɛ ɔnam mo do.
Sɛ hom enya ehu me a, nkyɛ hom ehu m'Egya no so; na ofitsi ndɛ hom nyim no, na hom ehu no.
Philip see no dɛ, Ewuradze, kyerɛ hɛn Egya no na ɔdɔɔ hɛn sõ.
Jesus see no dɛ, Ana menye hom wɔ daadaada yi, innyim me, Philip? Nyia oehu me no, oehu Egya no; na ɔyɛ dɛn na ese dɛ, kyerɛ hɛn Egya no?
Ana enngye nndzi dɛ wowɔ Egya no mu, na Egya no so wɔ mo mu? Nsɛm a mekã kyerɛ hom yi, mennhyɛ moho mekã, na Egya no a ɔtse mo mu no, ɔno na ɔyɛ ndwuma no.
Hom ngye me ndzi dɛ wowɔ Egya no mu, na Egya no so wɔ mo mu; na annyɛ dɛm a, ndwuma noara ntsi hom ngye me ndzi.
Nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, nyia ɔgye me dzi no, ndwuma a meyɛ no, no so bɛyɛ, na dza ɔkyɛn yinom na ɔbɛyɛ, osiandɛ morokɔ Egya no hɔ.
Na biribiara a hom bɛserɛ wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔno na mebɛyɛ, ama Egya no eenya enyimnyam wɔ Ba no mu.
Sɛ hom serɛ biribi wɔ me dzin mu a, mebɛyɛ.
Sɛ hom dɔ me a, hom ndzi me mbrasɛm do.
Na mibebisa Egya no, na ɔama hom okyigyinafo fofor, ma ɔnye hom aabɛtsena daa:
nokwar Sunsum no a: ɔno na wiadze nntum nngye no; osiandɛ onnhu no, na eso onnyim no: Na homdze, hom nyim no; osiandɛ ɔtse hom nkyɛn, na ɔbɛtsena hom mu.
Mirinngya hom ngyanka, mebɛba hom nkyɛn.
Aka kakrabaabi na wiadze nnhu me bio, na homdze, hom hu me; osiandɛ metse ase yi, hom so bɛtsena ase.
Da no hom bohu dɛ mowɔ Egya no mu na hom wɔ no mu, na mo so mowɔ hom mu.
Nyia ɔwɔ me mbransɛm na odzi do no, ɔno nye nyia ɔdɔ me, na nyia ɔdɔ me no, m'Egya bɔdɔ no, na mo so mobɔdɔ no, na mibeyi moho makyerɛ no.
Judas (nnyɛ Iscariot bi a) see no dɛ, Ewuradze, ebɛn na aba, na iribeyi woho akyerɛ hɛn na nnyɛ wiadze a?
Jesus buae see no dɛ, sɛ obi dɔ me a, obesie m'asɛm: na m'Egya bɔdɔ no, na yɛbɛba ne nkyɛn, na yɛbɛyɛ hɛn tsenabew wɔ ne nkyɛn.
Nyia ɔnndɔ me no, onnsie me nsɛm: Na asɛm a hom tse yi, ɔnnyɛ medze, na ɔyɛ Egya no a ɔsomaa me no dze.
Ndzɛmba yinom na makã akyerɛ hom, ber a metse hom nkyɛn yi.
Na Okyigyinafo no a ɔyɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no a Egya no bɔsoma no wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔno na ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ hom ndzɛmba nyina: Ɔbɛkaa hom dza makã akyerɛ hom nyina.
Asomdwee na medze gya hom; mara m'asomdwee na medze mema hom: Nnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ wiadze ma, na mema hom.
Hom tsee mbrɛ mekãa kyerɛɛ hom dɛ morokɔ na maba hom nkyɛn. Sɛ hom dɔ me a, nkyɛ hom bedzi dɛw dɛ morokɔ Egya no hɔ, osiandɛ Egya no sõ sen me.
Na afei makã akyerɛ hom ansaana aba mu, ma sɛ ɔba mu a, hom aagye edzi.
Menye hon nnkɛkasa pii bio, na wiadze hen no reba, na onnyi biribiara wɔ mo mu.
Na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma wiadze eehu dɛ modɔ Egya no, na dɛ mbrɛ Egya no hyɛɛ me no, dɛmara na meyɛ. Hom nsoɛr ma yemfi ha nkɔ.
15: Emi nye nokwar wenyindua no, na m'Egya nye okuafo no.
Mo ho abaw biara a ɔnnsow aba no, oyi no; na baira a ɔsow aba no, oyiyi ho ma ɔaasow aba pii.
Hom ho atsew dada wɔ asɛm a makã akyerɛ hom no ntsi:
hom ntsena mo mu, na mo so mentsena hom mu. Dɛ mbrɛ abaw nntum mmfi noara no mu nnsow aba, gyedɛ ɔtsena wenyindua no mu no, dɛmara so na hom runntum, gyedɛ hom tsena mo mu.
Emi nye wenyindua no; hom nye abaw no: Nyia ɔtse mo mu, na metse no mu no, ɔnoara na ɔsow aba pii, na hom kwetsi me a, hom nntum nnyɛ hwee.
Sɛ obi anntsena mo mu a, wotwa no kyen dɛ abaw, na ɔkyenkyen, na wɔboaboa ano kogu gya mu, na ɔhyew.
Sɛ hom tsena mo mu, na me nsɛm tsena hom mu a, hom mbisa biribiara a hom pɛ, na wɔbɛyɛ ama hom.
Iyi mu na wɔahyɛ m'Egya enyimnyam, dɛ hom sow aba pii, na hom bɛyɛ m'esuafo.
Dɛ mbrɛ Egya no dɔ me no, na mo so madɔ hom: hom ntsena mo dɔ mu.
Sɛ hom sie me mbransɛm a, hom bɛtsena mo dɔ mu, dɛ mbrɛ mo so mesie m'Egya ne mbrɛnsɛm na metsena no dɔ mu.
Makã yinom akyerɛ hom ama me dɛ aatsena hom mu, na hom dɛw aahyɛ mã.
Iyi nye me mbrasɛm, dɛ hom ndodɔ homho nkorkor, dɛ mmbrɛ madɔ hom.
Obi nnyi dɔ a ɔsõ kyɛn yi, dɛ obi dze no nkwa bɔto hɔ ama ne nsɛfo.
Sɛ hom yɛ dza mehyɛ hom a, hom yɛ me nsɛfo.
Mennda ho memmfrɛ hom nkowaa, osiandɛ akowaa nnyim dza no wura yɛ; na mafrɛ hom nsɛfo, osiandɛ ndzɛmba a metsee no m'Egya hɔ nyina makyerɛ hom mu.
Nnyɛ hom bi na hom yii me, na emi na meyii hom, na medze hom sii hɔ dɛ hom nkɔ nkɔsow aba, ma hom aba aatsena hɔ, na biribiara a hom bɛserɛ Egya no wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔdze aama hom.
Iyi na mehyɛ hom, dɛ hom ndodɔ homho.
Sɛ wiadze tan hom a, hom nyim dɛ ɔatan me ansaana ɔretan hom.
Sɛ hom fi wiadze mu a, nkyɛ wiadze bɔdɔ nankasa nedze; na osiandɛ hom mmfi wiadze, na miyii hom fii wiadze mu ntsi, na wiadze tan hom.
Hom nkaa asɛm no a mesee hom no, akowaa nnkyɛn no wura. Sɛ wohiahiaa mo ho a, wobehiahia hom so ho; sɛ wosiee m'asɛm a, wobesie homdze bi.
Na yinom nyina me dzin ntsi na wɔdze bɛyɛ hom, osiandɛ wonnyim nyia ɔsomaa me no.
Sɛ mammba mammbɛkasa annkyerɛ hɔn a, nkyɛ wonnyi bɔn; na afei dze, wonnyi hɔn bɔn do ebuado.
Nyia ɔtan me no, ɔtan m'Egya so.
Sɛ mannyɛ wɔ hɔn mu ndwuma a obiara annyɛ bi da a, nkyɛ wonnyi bɔn; na afei woehu na wɔatan emi nye m'Egya so.
Na iyi aba mu ma dza wɔakyerɛw no hɔn mbra mu no aahyɛ mã dɛ, Wɔatan me kwa.
Na Okyigyinafo no a mibefi Egya no nkyɛn masoma no hom hɔ no, nokwar Sunsum a ofir Egya no mu no, sɛ onya ba a, ɔno na obedzi mo ho dase.
Na hom so dzi me dase, osiandɛ hom fir ahyɛse ka mo ho.
16: Maka yinom akyerɛ hom amma hom aammfintsiw.
Wɔbɛtam hom nhyiamudan mu mpo: Dɔn no reba a obiara a oboku hom bɔdwen dɛ ɔdze rosom Nynakopɔn.
Na wɔbɛyɛ yinom osiandɛ wonnyim Egya no, anaaso emi.
Na makã yinom akyerɛ hom, ama sɛ dɔn no ba a, hom aakaa dɛ mesee hom dɛm. Na yinom memmfi ahyɛse mannkã annkyerɛ hom, osiandɛ menye hom wɔ hɔ.
Na afei dze, morokɔ nyia ɔsomaa me no nkyɛn; Na hom mu biara mmbisa me dɛ, Erokɔ hen?
Na osiandɛ makã yinom akyerɛ hom ntsi, awerɛhow ahyɛ hom akoma mã.
Naaso dza merekã yi yɛ nokwasɛm, dɛ oye ma hom dɛ mokɔ, osiandɛ sɛ mannkɔ a, Okyigyinafo remmba hom nkyɛn, na sɛ mokɔ a, mobɔsoma no wɔ hom nkyɛn.
Na ɔno sɛ ɔba a, obeyi wiadze atsɛn wɔ bɔn nye tsenenee nye atsɛmbu ho:
bɔn ho, osiandɛ wɔnngye me nndzi;
tsenenee ho, osiandɛ morokɔ Egya no nkyɛn, na hom nnhu me bio;
atsɛmbu ho, osiandɛ woebu wiadze hen atsɛn.
Mowɔ nsɛm pii kã kyerɛ hom, na hom runntum nngye no sesei.
Na sɛ ɔno, nokwar Sunsum no, nya ba a, obegya hom kwan akɔ nokwar nyina mu: Na ɔnnkɛhyɛ nankasa noho akasa, na biribiara a ɔbɛtse na ɔbɛkã, na dza ɔreba so abɛkyerɛ hom.
ɔno na ɔbɛhyɛ me enyimnyam, osiandɛ ɔbɛfa dza ɔyɛ medze no bi na ɔdze abɛkyerɛ hom.
Dza Egya no wɔ nyina yɛ medze: Iyi ntsi na mesee dɛ, ɔfa dza ɔyɛ medze no bi na ɔdze abɛkyerɛ hom.
Aka kakra na hom nnhu me, na bio aka kakra na hom bohu me, osiandɛ morokɔ Egya no nkyɛn.
Na n'esuafo no binom kekãe wɔ hom mu dɛ, ebɛn na ɔse hɛn yi? Aka kakra na hom nnhu me; na bio aka kakra na hom bohu me: na Osiandɛ morokɔ Egya no nkyɛn?
Na wɔsee dɛ, ebɛn nye dza ɔse yi, Aka kakra? Yennyim dza ɔrekã.
Na Jesus hun dɛ wɔpɛ ebisa no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana iyi ho na hom ribisabisa wɔ hom mu dɛ mesee dɛ, Aka kakra na hom nnhu me, na bio aka kakra na hom bohu me?
Nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, hom bosū na hom edzi nkɔmbɔ, na wiadze edzi dɛw; homdze, hom werɛ bɔhow, na hom awerɛhow bɛdan awerɛbea.
Ɔbaa rokõ awoo a, onya awerɛhow, osiandɛ no dɔn edu; na sɛ onya wo ba no a, ɔnnkaa n'ahoguan no bio, wɔ ne dɛw a odzi dɛ wɔawo nyimpa aba wiadze ntsi.
Na hom so sesei dze, hom enya awerɛhow; na mubohu hom bio, na hom akoma bedzi dɛw, na hom dɛw no abi renngye hom nsamu.
Na da no hom nnkebisa me hwee. Nokwar, nokwar, mese hom dɛ, biribiara a hom bɛserɛ Egya no wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔdze bɛma hom.
ɔdze bodu sesei hom nnserɛɛ hwee wɔ me dzin mu: hom nserɛ na hom benya, ma hom dɛw aahyɛ mã.
Yinom makã akyerɛ hom wɔ mbɛbu mu. Dɔn no reba a mennkɛkasa akyerɛ hom wɔ mbɛbu mu bio, na makã Egya no ho asɛm akyerɛ hom petee.
Da no hom bɛserɛ wɔ me dzin mu, na mennse hom dɛ mibebisa Egya no ama hom;
na Egya no ankasa dɔ hom, osiandɛ hom adɔ me na hom agye edzi dɛ mifi Nyankopɔn nkyɛn mebae.
Mifi Egya no nkyɛn na mebaa wiadze; bio meredan wiadze egya na makɔ Egya no nkyɛn.
N'esuafo no see no dɛ, hwɛ, afei ekasa kotoo, na immbu bɛ biara.
Afei yenyim dɛ inyim ndzɛmba nyina, na onnhia wo dɛ obi bisa wo: Iyi mu na yɛgye dzi dɛ ifi Nyankopɔn nkyɛn bae.
Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, afei hom gye dzi?
Hwɛ, dɔn no reba no oenya edu a hom nyina bɛpetse akɔ homankasa homdze mu, na hom adan mo nko egya. Naaso ɔnnka mo nko, osiandɛ Egya no wɔ me nkyɛn.
Yinom makã akyerɛ hom ma hom eenya asomdwee wɔ mo mu. Wiadze mu dze, hom wɔ ahohia; naaso hom nhyɛ dzen: Medzi wiadze do konyim.
17: Yinom na Jesus kãe na ɔmaa n'enyi do kɔr sor na ɔsee dɛ, Egya, dɔn no edu: hyɛ wo Ba enyimnyam, na Ba no so nhyɛ wo enyimnyam,
dɛ mbrɛ emaa no tum wɔ honam nyina do, dɛ biribiara a edze ama no no, ɔmma hɔn onnyiewiei nkwa.
Na iyi nye onnyiewiei nkwa, dɛ wobohu ɔwo, nokwar Nyame kor no, nye nyia esomaa no, mekyerɛ Jesus Christ.
Muwiee edwuma a edze ama me dɛ menyɛ no na mehyɛɛ wo enyimnyam wɔ asaase do;
na afei, Egya, fa enyimnyam a mowɔ no wɔ wo nkyɛn ansaana wiadze bɔɔ adze no hyɛ me enyimnyam wɔ wankasa wo nkyɛn.
Miyii wo dzin edzi mekyerɛɛ nyimpa a edze hɔn fi wiadze maa me no. Wɔyɛ wodze, na edze hɔn maa me, na woesie m'asɛm.
Afei woehu dɛ ndzɛmba a edze ama me nyina fir wo hɔ;
osiandɛ nsɛm a edze maa me no, medze ama hɔn, na hɔn so gyee na wohun ampa dɛ mifi wo nkyɛn mebae, na wɔgyee dzii dɛ ɔwoara na esomaa me.
Mibisa ma hɔn: mimmbisa memma wiadze, na hɔn a ezde hɔn ama me a, osiandɛ wɔyɛ wodze.
Na m'adze nyina yɛ wodze, na wodze so yɛ emi medze, na wɔahyɛ me enyimnyam wɔ hɔn mu.
Na afei minnyi wiadze bio, na yinom wɔ wiadze, na emidze, mereba wo nkyɛn. Egya krɔnkrɔn, fa hɔn sie wo dzin a edze ama me no mu, ama wɔaayɛ kor dɛ hɛn.
Mowɔ hɔn nkyɛn no, medze hɔn siei wɔ hɔn dzin a edze ama me no mu: Na moweɔɔn hɔn, na hɔn mu biara annhera, gyedɛ ɔhera ba no, ama kyerɛwsɛm no aaba mu.
Na afei dze, mereba wo nkyɛn, na mekã yinom wɔ wiadze ama woeenya me dɛw no ma wɔaahyɛ mã wɔ hɔn mu.
Medze w'asɛm ama hɔn, na wiadze taan hɔn, osiandɛ wommfi wiadze dɛ mbrɛ mo so mimmfi wiadze.
Mimmbisa dɛ yi hɔn fi wiadze, na dɛ yi hɔn fi bɔn no ho sie.
Wommfi wiadze dɛ mbrɛ mo so mimmfi wiadze.
San hɔn ho wɔ nokwar no mu: w'asɛm yɛ nokwar.
Dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo somaa me wiadze no, dɛmara na mo so mosomaa hɔn wiadze.
Na hɔn ntsi mesan moho, ama hɔn so hɔn ho aasan nokwar mu.
na nnyɛ yinom nkotoo ntsi na mibisa, na hɔn a wɔnam hɔn asɛm do gye me dzi no so ntsi bi,
ama hɔn nyina aayɛ kor, dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo, Egya, ewɔ mo mu, na mowɔ wo mu, hɔn so waayɛ kor wɔ hɛn mu, na wiadze aagye edzi dɛ ɔwo na esomaa me.
Na enyimnyam a edze ama me no, medze ama hɔn, dɛ wɔnyɛ kor dɛ mbrɛ yɛyɛ kor;
na emi mentsena hɔn mu, na wo so ntsena mo mu, na woeewie kor yɛ, na wiadze eehu dɛ ɔwo na esomaa me, na mbrɛ edɔɔ me no, edɔɔ hɔn so dɛmara.
Egya, dza edze ama me no, mepɛ dɛ mbrɛ mowɔ no, hɔn so bɛka mo ho na woeehu m'enyimnyam a edze ama me no, osiandɛ edɔɔ me ansaana wɔrehyɛ wiadze ase.
Egya tsenenee, wiadze ennhu, na emidze, muhun wo, na yinom hun dɛ ɔwo na esomaa me.
Na miyii wo dzin kyerɛɛ hɔn, eso mibeyi makyerɛ hɔn, ma ɔdɔ a edzi dɔɔ me no aatsena hɔn mu, na mo so maatsena hɔn mu.
18: Jesus kãa yinom no, ɔnye n'esuafo fiir edzi kotwaa ɔwora Kidron, mbrɛ ture bi wɔ, na ɔnye n'esuafo no kɔr mu.
Na Judas so a oriyi no ama no so nyim hɔ, osiandɛ Jesus nye n'esuafo no tɔɔ dɛ wokehyia hɔ.
Na Judas faa asafo no nye asomfo a wofi asɔfompanyin nye Phariseefo no nkyɛn no, ɔbaa hɔ, wokurakura nkandzea nye atsɛn nye akondze.
Na Jesus nyim dza ɔreba no do nyina no, ofiir edzi na ɔbɛsee hɔn dɛ, hom rohwehwɛ woana?
Na wobuaa no dɛ, Jesus Nazarethnyi no a. Obuaa hɔn dɛ, Emi nye no. Na Judas a oriyi no ama no so nye hɔn gyina hɔ.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Emi nye no no, wɔdze hɔn ekyir hɔn ekyir kɔhwee daadze.
Na obisaa hɔn bio dɛ, hom rohwehwɛ woana? Na wɔsee dɛ, Jesus Nazarethnyi no a.
Jesus buaa dɛ, mekãa kyerɛɛ him dɛ emi nye no; dɛm ntsi sɛ emi na hom rohwehwɛ me a, hom mma yinom nkɔ;
ama asɛm no a ɔkãe dɛ, hɔn a edze hɔn ama me mannyew mu biara no, aaba mu.
Na Simon Peter a ɔdze afõwa, twee, na ɔdze bɔɔ ɔsɔfopanyin no akowaa, na otwaa n'asowa nyimfa; na akowaa no ne dzin dze Malchus.
Na Jesus see Peter dɛ, fa nkrantee no hyɛ bɔha no mu: Kuraba a m'Egya dze ama me no, monnom anaa?
Na asafo no ɔnye safohen no ɔnye Jewfo asomfo no faa Jesus na wɔkyekyeer no,
na wɔdze no dzii kan kɔr Anna nkyɛn, osiandɛ Caiaphas a odze afe no mu sɔfopanyin no n'asew nye no.
Na Caiaphas nye nyia ɔmaa Jewfo no apam dɛ oye dɛ nyimpa baako bowu ama ɔman no no.
Na Simon Peter nye osuanyi baako dzii Jesus ekyir, na ɔsɔfopanyin no nyim osuanyi no, na ɔnye Jesus kɛhɛɛn ɔsɔfopanyin aban mu hɔ.
Na Peter dze, ogyinaa abow no ano guado. Na osuanyi no a ɔsɔfopanyin no nyim no no fiir edzi bɛkasaa kyerɛɛ abowanohwɛfo no na ɔdze Peter baa dan mu.
Na abaawa abowanohwɛfo no see Peter dɛ, Ana wo so immfi nyimpa yi n'esuafo no mu? ɔsee dɛ, Mimmfi mu.
Na nkowaa no nye asomfo no gyinagyina hɔ a wɔdze biriw abɔ gya, osiandɛ awɔw aba, na wɔroto gya; na Peter so gyina hɔ roto gya.
na ɔsɔfopanyin bisaa Jesus n'esuafo nye ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho asɛm.
Jesus buaa no dɛ, Makasa petee makyerɛ wiadze; daa mekyerɛkyerɛ wɔ nhyiamudan nye asɔrfi mu, mbrɛ Jewfo nyina hyia, na nsumaa mu mannkã hwee.
Emidze, ɔyɛ dɛn na ibisa me? Bisa hɔn a wɔtseee asɛm kor a mekãa kyerɛɛ hɔn: Hwɛ, hɔn na wonyim dza, mekãe.
Na ɔkasaa dɛm no, asomfo a wogyina hɔ no mu baako bɔɔ Jesus sotɔr see no dɛ, mbrɛ ibua ɔsɔfopanyin nye yi?
Jesus buaa no dɛ, sɛ makã bɔn a, gye bɔn no ho dase, na sɛ oye a, ɔyɛ dɛn na ebɔ me?
Dɛm ntsi Annas somaa no ahoma mu kɔr Caiaphas ɔsɔfopanyin no hɔ.
Na Simon Peter gyina hɔ roto gya. Na wɔsee no dɛ, Ana ɔwo so immfi n'esuafo no mu? Ɔsanee na ɔsee dɛ, Mimmfi mu.
ɔsɔfopanyin no no nkowaa mu baako a ɔyɛ nyia Peter twaa n'asowa no no busuanyi no see no dɛ, Ana mennhu wo wɔ ne nkɛn wɔ ture no mu?
Na Peter saan bio; na ntsɛmara akokɔ bɔnee.
Na wɔdze Jesus fii Caiaphas nkyɛn kɔr ambrado aban mu; na ahamanakye a, na hɔnara dze wɔannhɛn ambrado aban mu hɔ, amma hɔn ho ennkum na woeedzi apaho no.
Dɛm ntsi Pilate fiir edzi baa hɔn nkyɛn na ɔsee dɛ, ebɛn atsɛn na hom dze ba wɔ nyimpa yi ho?
Wobuae see no dɛ, sɛ oyi nnyɛ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi a, nkyɛ yɛammfa no ammbrɛ wo.
Na Pilate see hɔn dɛ, homara hom mfa no, na hom nkobu no atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ hom mbra tse. Jewfo no see no dɛ, hɛndze, yennyi ho kwan dɛ yeku obiara;
ma Jesus n'asɛm a ɔkãe dze kyerɛɛ owu kor a orubowu no aaba mu.
Na Pilate hɛɛn ambrado aban mu bio, na ɔfrɛɛ Jesus na ɔsee no dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye Jewfo hen no?
Jesus buaa no dɛ, wankasa rekã yi, anaa binom kãa no mo ho kyerɛɛ wo?
Pilate buaa dɛ, Ana mankasa meyɛ Jewnyi? Wankasa wo mamfo nye ɔsɔfopanyin no na wɔdze wo brɛɛ me. Ebɛnadze na eyɛe?
Jesus buaa dɛ, m'ahendzi mmfi wiadze yi mu: Sɛ m'ahendzi fi wiadze yi mu a, nkyɛ m'asomfo bɔkõ, mma wɔaammfa me annhyɛ Jewfo nsa; na afei m'ahendzi mmfi ha.
Pilate see no dɛ, nna eyɛ ɔhen nye no? Jesus buaa dɛ, Akã dɛ meyɛ ɔhen: Iyi ntsi na wɔwoo me, iyi ntsi na mebaa wiadze, ama maabɛgye nokwar no ho dase. Obiara a ofi nokwar no mu, otsie me ndze.
Pilate see no dɛ, nokwar nye bɛn? Na ɔsee dɛm no, ofiir edzi kɔr Jewfo no hɔ bio, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, emidze, munnhu afɔdze biara wɔ no mu.
Na hom wɔ atɔrmuadze dɛ apaho no mu migyaa baako mema hom: Dɛm ntsi, hom pɛ dɛ migyaa Jewfo hen no mema hom anaa?
Na hɔn nyina tsēaa mu bio dɛ, nnyɛ oyi a, na Barabbas a. Naaso Barabbas yɛ adwotwafo.
19: Na afei Pilate faa Jesus na ɔkãa no mpire.
Na nsordaafo no bɔɔ nsoɛ katraka na wɔdze hyɛɛ ne tsir, na wɔdze tam memen bi furaa no,
na wopimpiin ne nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, Jewfo Hen, abao! Na wɔbobɔɔr no asotɔr.
Na Pilate fiir edzi bio, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hwɛ, medze no mifir brɛ hom, ma hom eehu dɛ munnhu afɔdzi biara wɔ no mu.
Na Jesus fiir edzi bae, na ɔhyɛ nsoɛ katraka nye atar memen no, na Pilate see hɔn dɛ, Hwɛ, nyimpa no nye yi!

Na ɔsɔfompanyin no nye asomfo no hun no no, wɔtsēaseaa mu dɛ, bɔ no mbeamudua mu, bɔ no mbeamudua mu! Pilate see hɔn dɛ, hom ankasa hom mfa no nkɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu, na emidze munnhu afɔdzi biara wɔ no mu.
Jewfo no buaa no dɛ, yɛwɔ mbra, na hɛn mbra ntsi otwar dɛ owu, osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ noho Nyankopɔn ne Ba.
na Pilate tsee asɛm yi no, osuroo dodoodow,
na ɔkɔr aban no mu bio, na ɔsee Jesus dɛ, ifi hen? Na Jesus emmbua no.
Na Pilate see no dɛ, Ennkasa mo ho? Innyim dɛ mowɔ tum dɛ mobɔ wo mbeamudua mu, na mowɔ tum dɛ migyaa wo anaa?
Jesus see no dɛ, Sɛ woemmfi sor ammfa amma wo a, nkyɛ innyi mo do tum biara. Dɛm ntsi, nyia oyii me maa wo no ɔwɔ bɔn Kɛse no ara.
Na ofitsi hɔ no, Pilate hwehwɛɛ dɛ ogyaa no, na Jewfo no tsēaa mu dɛ, Sɛ igyaa oyi a, na ennyɛ Cæsar no dɔfo: Obiara a ɔyɛ noho ɔhen no ɔnyɛ Cæsar dzi esi.
Na Pilate tsee nsɛm yi no, ɔdze Jesus fiir edzi, na ɔbɛtsenaa atsɛmbu egua no do, wɔ beebi mbrɛ wɔfrɛ no Abo-nsɛwee no, na Hebrew kasa mu dze, wɔfrɛɛ no Gabbatha.
Na ɔyɛ apaho ne nsiesie da, na ɔbɛyɛ dɔn a otsīa esia: na ɔsee Jewfo no dɛ, Hwɛ, hom Hen nye yi!
Na wɔtsēaa mu dɛ, fa no kɔ, fa no kɔ, bɔ no mbeamudua mu! Pilate see hɔn dɛ, mombɔ hom Hen mbeamudua mu? Asɔfompanyin no buaa no dɛ, yennyi ɔhen biara dɛ Cæsar.
Na afei oyii no maa hɔn dɛ wɔnkɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu. Na wɔfaa Jesus dze no kɔree.
Na ɔso ne mbeamudua fiir edzi bodur beebi wɔfrɛ hɔ Nyitsirbea a Hebrew mu wɔfrɛ no Golgotha.
Hɔ na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu, na beenu kaa no ho, afã ha kor, afã ha kor, na Jesus wɔ finimfin.
Na Pilate kyerɛɛw ho asɛm so, na ɔdze faam mbeamudua no etsifi, na kyerɛw no nye dɛ, JESUS NAZARETHNYI, JEWFO HEN.
Na kyerɛw yi Jewfo pii kenkanee, osiandɛ mbrɛ wɔbɔɔ Jesus mbeamudua mu no ɔbɛn kurow no, na wɔkyerɛwee wɔ Hebrew nye Greek nye Romefo kasaa mu.
Na Jewfo asɔmpanyin no see Pilate dɛ, mma nnkyerɛw dɛ Jewfo Hen, na dɛ ɔno kãa dɛ, Emi nye Jewfo Hen.
Pilate buaa dɛ, dza makyerɛw no, makyerɛw.
Na nsordaafo no bɔɔ Jesus mbeamudua mu no, wɔfaa ne ntar no na wɔkyɛɛ mu anan, ma sordaanyi baako nyaa kor, ɔnye n'atar nhyɛase so. Na n'atar nkyɛase no, onnyi mpamee, na wɔawen fi sor pem ase.

Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, mma hom mma yennsunsuan mu, na hom mma yɛntwe ho tonto nhwɛ nyia ɔbɛyɛ nedze; ama kyerɛw no a ɔkã dɛ, Wɔkyɛɛ me tam mu maa hɔnho, Na m'atar so wɔtwee ho tonto no, aaba mu. Na nsordaafo no yɛɛ yinom.
Na Jesus ne nã, ɔnye ne nã-nua Clopas yer Mary, ɔnye Mary Magdalene gyina Jesus ne mbeamudua ho.
Na Jesus hun ne nã nye osuanyi a ɔdɔ no no dɛ ogyina hɔ no, ɔsee ne nã dɛ, ɔbaa, hwɛ, wo ba nye yi.
Na ɔsee osuanyi no dɛ, hwɛ, wo nã nye yi. Na ofitsi dɔn no ara mu na osuanyi no faa no kɔr nankasa ne fie.
Iyi ekyir no Jesus nyim dɛ woenya ewie ndzɛmba nyina, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma kyerɛw no aaba mu ntsi, ɔsee dɛ, Nsukɔm dze me.
Wenyin yerɛyerɛw adze bi mã si hɔ, na wɔdze wenyin yerɛyerɛw no bi hyɛɛ posaa mã, na wɔdze too hyssop do dze kãa n'ano.
Na Jesus gyee wenyin yerɛyerɛw no, ɔsee dɛ, woewie! Na ɔbɔɔ ne tsir adze, na ogyaa no sunsum mu.
Na Jewfo no, ɔyɛ Ahosiesieda no ntsi, amma efun no annko mbeamudua no do ahomgyeda no (na eso ahomgyeda no yɛ dapɔn ntsi), wobebisa Pilate dɛ wonkobubu hɔn ngyawa na wonnyi hɔn.
Na nsordaafo no bae bobubuu nyia odzi kan no ne ngyawa, ɔnye nyia no so wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no nedze.
Na wodur Jesus do na wohun dɛ oewu dada no, woemmbubu ne ngyawa;
na nsordaafo no baako dze peaa wɔɔ ne mfemu, na ntsɛmara na bɔgya nye nsu fii mu bae.
Na nyia oehu no oedzi dase, na ne dasee yɛ nokwar, na ɔno so nyim dɛ ɔkã nokwar, na hom aagye edzi.
Na wɔyɛɛ yinom ma kyerɛw aaba mu dɛ, wonnkobu ne biew bi.
Na bio kyerɛw fofor so se, wɔbɔhwɛ nyia wɔwɔɔ no no.

Na iyi ekyir no na Joseph a ofi Arimathæa a ɔyɛ Jesus no suanyi, na Jewfo ho hu ntsi ɔyɛɛ no kukua mu no, bɛserɛɛ Pilate dɛ ɔmma onyi Jesus no fun no, na Pilate maa no ho kwan; na ɔbae bɛfaa Jesus no fun no.
Na Nichodemus so a nkan no ɔbaa Jesus hɔ anago no, ɔdze myrrh nye aloe mforaforae bɛyɛ pɔɔn ɔha bae.
Na wɔfaa Jesus no fun na wɔdze no nye ndur no kyekyeer ndwera mu, dɛ mbrɛ Jewfo efunsie tse.
Na eso mbrɛ wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no, ture wɔ hɔ, na ture no mu ɔboda bi wɔ hɔ a wɔmmfaa obiara nntoo mu da.
Na hɔ, Jewfo Ahosiesieda ntsi, na osiandɛ nda no bɛn so ntsi, wɔdze Jesus toe.
20: Na da a odzi dapɛn no kan no anapatutu a ɔda ho yɛ sum no, Mary Magdalene baa nda no do, na obohun ɔbo no dɛ woeyi efi nda no ano.
Na otutuu mbirika baa Sinom Peter, ɔnye osuanyi baako no a Jesus dɔɔ no no hɔ na ɔsee dɛ, woeyi Ewuradze efi nda no mu, na yennyim mbrɛ wɔdze no akɔto.
Na Peter nye osuanyi baako no fiir edzi baa nda no do.
Na Hɔn beenu nyina tutuu mbirika: Na osuanyi baako no paa Peter ho, na odzii kan baa nda no do.
Na ɔbɔɔ no adze no, ohun ndwera no dɛ ogu hɔ, na ɔannkɔ mu.
Na Simon Peter dzii n'ekyir bae, na ɔkɔr nda no mu, na okohun ndwera no dɛ ogu hɔ,
ɔnye duukuu a wɔdze bɔɔ ne tsir no dɛ onngu ndwera no ho, na wɔabobɔw no nko gu nkyɛn beebi.
Na afei osuanyi baako a odzii kan baa nda no do no so kɔr mu, na okohunii, na ɔgyee dzii.
Nna wonnyae nnhun kyerɛw no dɛ otwar dɛ ɔsoɛr fi ewufo mu.
Na esuafo no sii mu kɔr hɔn fie bio.
Na Mary dze, ogyinaa nda no do rusū. Na orusū no, ɔbɔɔ no mu adze hwɛɛ nda no mu.
Na ohun abɔfo beenu wɔ ntar fufuw mu dɛ wɔtsetse hɔ: Ɔbaako tse etsifi, na ɔbaako tse anaafo wɔ mrɛ Jesus no fun daa hɔ.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, ɔbaa, ebɛnadze ntsi na erusū? Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, osiandɛ woeyi m'Ewuradze kɔ, na minnyim mbrɛ wɔdze no akɔto.
Na ɔsee dɛm no, ɔdaan noho hwɛɛ n'ekyir, na ohun Jesus dɛ ogyina hɔ, na onnyim dɛ Jesus a.
Jesus see no dɛ, ɔbaa, ebɛnadze ntsi na irusū? Erohwehwɛ woana? Na ɔnodze osusu dɛ ɔno nye turehwɛfo no, ɔsee no dɛ, mo Wura, sɛ ɔwo na afa no efi ha a, kyerɛ me mbrɛ edze no akɔto, na menkɛfa no.
Jesus see no dɛ, Mary! Na ɔno daan noho see no Hebrew kasa mu dɛ, Rabboni! (Ɔnye dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛwfo).
Jesus see no dɛ, mma nnkã me, na minnyae monnkɔr sor wɔ m'Egya nkyɛn; na kɔ mo nuanom no nkyɛn kɛse hɔn dɛ, Morobɔkɔ sor wɔ m'Egya nye hom Egya, me Nyankopɔn nye hom Nyankopɔn nkyɛn.
Mary bae bɛsee esuafo no dɛ, mehu Ewuradze; ɔnye mbrɛ ɔkãa yinom kyerɛɛ no.
Na da a odzi dapɛn no kan no ara ewimbir, na wɔatotow mbobow mu wɔ mbrɛ esuafo no ehyia, wɔ Jewfo ho hu ntsi no, Jesus bae bɛgyinaa finimfin, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Asomdwee nkã hom!
Na ɔsee dɛm no, ɔdze ne nsa nye ne mfemu kyerɛɛ hɔn. Na esuafo no hun Ewuradze no, wodzii dɛw.
Na Jesus see hɔn bio dɛ, Asomdwee nkã hom: Dɛ mbrɛ Egya no asoma me no, mo so mosoma hom.
Na ɔkãa yi no, oguu ahom guu hɔn do, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom ngye Sunsum krɔnkrɔn no:
hɔn a hom dze hɔn bɔn kyɛ hɔn no, wɔdze akyɛ hɔn, hɔn a hom ma hɔn bɔn ko hɔ no, wɔama ako hɔ.
Na Thomas, duebien no mu baako a wɔfrɛ no Didymus no, onnyi hɔn mu na Jesus bae.

Na esuafo nkaa no see no dɛ, yeehu Ewuradze! Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, sɛ mennhu ne nsa mu mprɛgow no ananmu, na mammfa me nsatseaba mannkã mprɛgow no ananmu, na mammfa me nsa annkã ne mfemu a, merenngye nndzi.
Na n'ekyir ndaawɔtwe no, esuafo no wɔ dan mu bio, na Thomas ka hɔn ho. Na Jesus bae, na mbobow no wɔatotow mu; na obegyinaa hɔn finimfin, na ɔsee dɛ, Asomdwee nkã hom!
Na ɔsee Thomas dɛ, Tsen wo nsatseaba bra ha bɔhwɛ me nsamu, na fa wo nsa bɛkã me mfemu, na mma nnyɛ okyingyefo, na mbom yɛ gyedzinyi.
Thomas buae see no dɛ, M'Ewuradze nye me Nyankopɔn!
Jesus see no dɛ, Thomas, osiandɛ ehu me ntsi, na egye dzi yi? Nhyira akã hɔn a woennhu me eso wɔagye edzi.
Nsɛnkyerɛdze pii na Jesus yɛe wɔ n'esuafo enyim a wɔnnkyerɛɛw yinom ama hom aagye edzi dɛ Jesus nye Christ no, Nyankopɔn ne Ba no, na hom gye dzi a, hom eenya nkwa wɔ ne dzin mu.
21: Iyinom ekyir no, Jesus yii noho kyerɛɛ n'esuafo wɔ Tiberias po ho; na mbrɛ oyii noho kyerɛe nye yi.
Simon Peter nye Thomas a wɔfrɛ no Didymus nye Nathaniel a ofi Cana a ɔwɔ Galilee, nye Zebedee ne mba no nye esuafo no mu beenu so wɔ hɔ.
Simon Peter see hɔn dɛ, morokɔ po. Wɔsee no dɛ, hɛn so yɛnye wo bɔkɔ. Na wofir edzi kɔr hɛn mu; na anago no ara woennya hwee.
Na adze rekye no Jesus begyinaa mpoano, naaso esuafo no nnyim dɛ Jesus a.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, mbofra, ana hom enya nam bi? Wobuaa no dɛ, Oho.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mfa asawu no ngu hɛn nyimfa na hom benya. Na wogui, na nam no dodow ntsi woenntum anntwetwe.
Na osuanyi a Jesus dɔɔ no no see Peter dɛ, Ewuradze a! na Simon Peter tsee dɛ ɔyɛ Ewuradze no, ɔdze no sortar kyekyeer noho (na odzi adagyaw) na ɔtoow no ho kyeen po no mu.
Na esuafo nkaa no nam hɛn kakraba mu bae (na wɔnye famu ntamu nnwar, ɔbɛyɛ basafa ahaenu) na wɔtwetwee asawa no nye nam no.
Na wofiir hɛn no mu siaan famu no, wohun ngyansenama wɔ hɔ, nye nam a ogu do, nye paanoo.
Jesus see hɔn dɛ, hom mfa nam a hom nyaa no sesei no bi mbra.
Na Simon Peter kɔree kɔtwetwee asawa no baa daadze, nam akɛse ma, ɔha eduonum ebiasa, naaso wɔdɔɔ sõ dɛm mpo a, asawu no anntsetsew.
Jesus see hɔn dɛ, hom mbɛkã hom ano. Esuafo no mu biara enntum emmbisa no dɛ, Woana nye wo; na wonyim dɛ Ewuradze a.
Jesus bae bɛfaa paanoo no maa hɔn, ɔnye nam no dɛmara.
Iyi nye ne mpɛn ebiasa a Jesus soɛree fii ewufo mu ekyir no, oyii noho kyerɛɛ n'esuafo.
Na wɔkãa hɔn ano wiei no, Jesus see Simon Peter dɛ, Simon, John ne ba, ana edɔ me sen yinom? Ɔsee no dɛ, nyew, Ewuradze, woara inyim dɛ modɔ wo. Ɔsee no dɛ, nyɛn mo nguambaa.
Ɔsee no mpɛn ebien dɛ, Simon, John ne bam ana edɔ me? Ɔsee no dɛ, nyew, Ewuradze, woara inyim dɛ modɔ wo. Ɔsee no dɛ, hwɛ mo nguan.

Ɔsee no bio ne mpɛn ebiasa dɛ, Simon, John ne ba, ana edɔ me? Ɔyɛɛ Peter awerɛhow dɛ ɔsee no mpɛn ebiasa dɛ, Ana edɔ me? na ɔsee no dɛ, Ewuradze, woara inyim adze nyina: inyim dɛ modɔ wo. Jesus see no dɛ, Nyɛn mo nguan.
Nokwar, nokwar, mese wo dɛ, eyɛɛ aberantsɛ no, ebɔɔ woho do, na enantseew mbrɛ woara epɛ; na sɛ inya yɛ akɔdaa a, ebɛtsen wo nsa na obi abɔ wo do na ɔdze wo akɔ mbrɛ emmpɛ.
Na ɔkãa yi no, ɔdze kyerɛɛ owu kor a ɔdze rebɛhyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam. Na ɔkãa yi no, ɔsee no dɛ, ka mo do.
Na Peter daan noho no, ohun osuanyi a Jesus dɔ no no dɛ odzi n'ekyir, ɔno so na ɔtweer no bo mu wɔ edzidziase na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, nyia oriyi wo ama no nye woana?
ɔno na Peter hun no no na ɔsee Jesus dɛ, Ewuradze, na oyi ɛ?
Jesus see no dɛ, sɛ mepɛ dɛ ɔtsena hɔ kodu dɛ mebɛba a, ɔfa wo ho bɛn? Ɔwodze, ka mo do.
Na asɛm yi tahyee wɔ enuanom no mu dɛ osuanyi yi runnwu: Naaso Jesus annse no dɛ orunnwu, na ɔsee no dɛ, sɛ mepɛ dɛ ɔtsena hɔ kodu dɛ mebɛma a, ɔfa wo ho bɛn?
Oyi nye osuanyi a odzi yinom ho dase, na ɔkyerɛɛw yinom no, na yenyim-dɛ ne dasee yɛ nokwar.
Na ndzɛmba pii wɔ hɔ a Jesus yɛe a, sɛ wɔkyerɛw ne nyina nkorkor a, nkyɛ mususu dɛ nwoma a wɔbɛkyerɛw no rennsen wiadze mpo.

1: Afei Ewuradze n’asɛm baa Amittai ba Jonah hɔ, dɛ,
soɛr, kɔ Nineveh, kurow kɛse no mu, na kɛpaa mu gu do: Na hɔn emumuyɛ afow aba m’enyim.
Na Jonah soɛɛr dɛ oruguan efi Ewuradze enyim akɔ Tarshish; na osianee kɔr Joppa, na ohun hɛn bi a ɔrokɔ Tarshish: Nna otuaa kaw, na ɔkɔr mu, dɛ orifi Ewuradze enyim nye hɔn akɔ Tarshish.
Na Ewuradze maa aahow kɛsenara bɔe wɔ po no do, na ehum dzendzen tui wɔ po no mu, na hɛn no yɛɛ dɛ ɔrobobɔ.
Nna asarfo no suroi, na obiara tsēatseaa am frɛfrɛɛ no bosom; na wɔtotoow hɛn no mu eguadze guguu po mu, ma ɔaayɛ har ama hɔn. Na Jonah dze, oesian akɔ hɛn no n’ase noho; na ɔakɛda heii.
Nna hɛnwura no baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, ɔdafo a ada, wodze yi ase ɛ? Soɛr, sū frɛ wo Nyankopɔn, bi a Nyankopɔn bɔdwen hɛn do, mma yaannhera.
Nna wɔsesee hɔnho, dɛ, hom bra ma yɛntwe tonto, na yenhu nyia osian ne ntsi ma mbusu yi aba hɛn do. Nna wɔtwee tonto, na tonto no bɔɔ Jonah.
Nna wɔsee dɛ, yɛserɛ wo ara, kyerɛ hɛn osian ne ntsi ma mbusu yi aba hɛn do; eyɛ ebɛn edwuraa? Na ifi hen bae? Ifi hen kurow mu? Na ifi ɔman bɛn mu?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, meyɛ Hebrewni; na musuro Ewuradze, ɔsor Nyankopɔn no a ɔyɛɛ po na asaase wewew no.
Nna nyimpa no suroo piinara, na wɔsee no dɛ, ebɛnadze na ayɛ yi? Na nyimpa no hun dɛ ofi Ewuradze enyim guanee, osiandɛ nna ɔakã akyerɛ hɔn.
Nna wɔsee no dɛ, ebɛnadze na yɛnyɛ wo, ma po yi n’ano ndwe mma hɛn? Na po no daa ho ara huur tutuutu.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mma me do, na hom ntow me nkyen po no mu; nna po no ano bɔdwe ama hom: Na minyim dɛ emi ntsi na ehum kɛse yi aba hom do.
Naaso nyimpa no kwaan dzendzen dɛ wɔresan ebodwir asaase wewew do; na woenntum: Osiandɛ po no daa ho huur tutuutu hyiaa hɔn.

Dɛm ntsi wɔkekaa mu frɛɛ Ewuradze, na wɔsee dɛ, yɛserɛ wo, Ewuradze, yɛserɛ wo, mma yɛnnhera wɔ nyimpa yi no nkwa ntsi, na mma mmfa bɔgya a onndzi fɔ ho sõ nnto hɛn do; na ɔwo, Ewuradze, na ayɛ dɛ mbrɛ epɛ.
Nna wɔmaa Jonah do, na wɔtoow no kyeen po no mu: Na po no gyaa ne begyabegya yɛ.
Nna nyimpa no suroo Ewuradze papaara; na wɔbɔɔ okum-afɔr maa Ewuradze, na wɔbobɔɔ anohoba.
Na Ewuradze siesiee nam kɛse bi dɛ ɔmmen Jonah; na Jonah dzii nam no ne yamu adzekyee ebiasa na adzesaa ebiasa.
2: Nna Jonah fi nam no ne yamu bɔɔ mpaa maa Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn.
Na ɔsee dɛ Mifi m'ahohia mu musūi frɛɛ Ewuradze, na ɔgyee me do; mifi Sheol ne yafun mu tsēaa mu, na ɔwo etsee me ndze.
Na ɔwo etoow me kyeen bun mu, wɔ po finimfin, na esuyirii twaa mo ho hyiae; w'asorɛkye na w'eminiminim nyina bui faa mo do.
Na mekaa dɛ, Wɔatow me efi w'enyim akyen; naaso mebɛda ho mahwɛ w'asɔrdan krɔnkrɔn no no kwan do.
Esu no twaa mo ho hyiae, bodur ɔkra ho mpo; bun no twaa mo ho kɔntɔnkrɔn sii; po mu efuw brabraa me tsir.
Misianee kɔr mbepɔw tunadze; asaase na n’adaban kãa me too ekyir kesii daapem: Naaso ɔwo edze mo nkwa efi mona mu, ao Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn.
Me kra tɔɔ bitsi wɔ mo mu no, me kaa Ewuradze: Na me mpaayi dur wo nkyɛn, wɔ w'asɔrdan krɔnkrɔn mu.
Hɔn a hɔn enyi sɔ ator ehuhudze no, wɔpɔw hɔnara hɔn adom.
Na emidze, medze ndaase ndze bɔbɔ wo okum-afɔr; mubotua dza medze abɔ anohoba no. Nkwagye dzi wɔ Ewuradze.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ nam no, na ɔkɛfee Jonah too asaase wewew do.
3: Na Ewuradze n’asɛm baa Jonah hɔ otsīa mprɛnu, dɛ,
soɛr, ko Nineveh, kurow kɛse no mu, na kɔbɔ asɛm a merekã makyerɛ wo yi dawur kyerɛ hɔn.
Nna Jonah soɛree, na ɔkɔr Nineveh, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm no tse. Na Nineveh yɛ kurow kɛse paara a wɔnantsew no ndaansa twa.
Na Jonah hyɛɛ ase hɛɛn kurow no mu da kor nantsew, na ɔbɔɔ dawur see dɛ, aka adaduanan, nna Nineveh ebutuw.
Na Nineveh gyee Nyankopɔn dzii; na wɔbɔɔ mbuadadzi ho dawur, na wofurafuraa eyitam fi hɔn mu akɛse do kesi nkakraba do mpo.
Na asɛm no kodur Ninevehhen asomu, na ɔsoɛree fii n’ahengua do, na oyii n’ahentar gui, na ofuraa eyitam, na ɔtsenaa nso mu.
Na ɔmaa wɔbɔɔ dawur tahyee Nineveh wɔ ɔhen na n’etsitsir no hɔn mom do, dɛ, mma nyimpa anaa abowa, anantwi anaa nguan mmfa hwee nnkã hɔn ano: Mma wɔnnkɔ edzidzi, eso mma wɔnnom nsu:
Na mbom womfurafura eyitam, nyimpa na mbowa nyina, na wɔnkeka mu dzendzenndzen mfrɛ Nyankopɔn; ɛhɛɛ, hɔn nyina nsan mfi hɔn kwan bɔn ho, na emimdzi a ɔwɔ hɔn nsamu no ho.
Sɛ bi a Nyankopɔn bɛdan noho na oenu noho, na ɔadan noho efi n’ebufuhyew ho, ma yaannhera a, woana nyim?
Na Nyankopɔn hun hɔn ndwuma dɛ wɔasan efi hɔn kwan bɔn no do; na Nyankopɔn nuu noho wɔ mbusu a ɔkãa dɛ ɔdze bɔbɔ hɔn no ho; na ɔannyɛ.
4: Na Jonah ammpɛ koraa, na no bo fuwii.

Na ɔbɔɔ mpaa maa Ewuradze, na ɔsee dɛ, ao Ewuradze, meserɛ wo, nnyɛ m’asɛm a mowɔ mo kurow mu no mekãe ara nye yi? Dɛm yi ara ntsi na meyɛɛ har muguaan dɛ morokɔ Tarshish no: Na minyim dɛ ɔwo eyɛ Nyame ɔdomfo, na mbɔbɔrhufo a efa ebufuw nyaa, na w’adɔyɛ sõ, na inu woho wɔ mbusu ho.
Dɛm ntsi afei, ao Ewuradze, mototɔ meserɛ wo, gye mo nkwa fi me nsamu, na oye ma me dɛ mubowu kyɛn dɛ mebɛtsena ase.
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, aso oye dɛ wo bo efuw?
Nna Jonah fii kurow no mu kɔree, na ɔkɛtsenaa kurow no no boka afamu, na ɔbɔɔ asese maa noho wɔ hɔ, na ɔtsenaa ase wɔ nwin mu, ma eekodu dɛ obohu dza ɔbɛba kurow no do.
Ma Ewuradze siesiee efer, na ɔmaa onyinii bɛkataa Jonah do, ama ɔaagye nwin wɔ n’etsifi, ama oeeyi no efi no mbusu asetsena no mu. Nna Jonah n’enyi gyee kɛse wɔ efer no ntsi.
Na n’adzekyee wipuei no, Nyankopɔn siesiee abowaba na ɔtoow efer no mu ma ɔkyenkyenee.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, wipuei no, Nyankopɔn siesiee boka mframa a n’ano yɛ hyew; na ewia sii Jonah n’etsifi, ma ɔtɔɔ akɔtɔmborɔnsa, na ɔserɛɛ dɛ wɔmma onwu, na ɔsee dɛ, oye ma me dɛ mubowu kyɛn dɛ mebɛtsena ase.
Na Nyankopɔn see Jonah dɛ, aso oye dɛ wo bo efuw wɔ efer no ntsi? Na ɔsee dɛ, oye dɛ mo bo fuw dze kɔ owu mu mpo.
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, ɔwo edzi yaw wɔ efer ennyɛɛ ho edwuma bi, eso nnyɛ ɔwo na emaa onyinii ho, ɔbaa anago da kor, na ɔheraa anago da kor;
na emi na Nineveh, kurow kɛse a no mu nyimpa bɔbor ɔpeduonu horow esia a wonntum nnku hɔn nsa nyimfa na hɔn nsa bankum; na anyɛmbowa pii so no, mma munnhu no mbɔbɔr?

1: Afei ɔbaa dɛ Ewuradze n’akowaa Moses wui n’ekyir no, Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Nun ne babanyin Joshua, Moses no somfo no, dɛ,
M’akowaa Moses ewu; dɛm ntsi afei soɛr, twa Jordan yi, ɔwo, nye ɔman yi nyinara, kɔ asaase a medze merema hɔn, mekyerɛ Israelmba no do.
Beebiara a hom anamɔn betsia no, medze mama hom, dɛ mbrɛ mekãa mekyerɛɛ Moses no.
Ofi sar no do, nye Lebanon yi ho araa dze kodu esutsen kɛse no, esutsen Euphrates no ho, Hittifo asaase nyinara, na ɔdze kodu po kɛse no ho wɔ witɔree afamu no, na ɔnye hom he.
Nyimpa biara runntum nngyina w’enyim wɔ wo nkwa nda nyinara mu: Dɛ mbrɛ midzii Moses ekyir no, dɛmara so na mibedzi w’ekyir: Meremmpa wo, morommpow wo so.
Hyɛ dzen na nya akokodur: Na ɔwo na ebɛma ɔman yi ekenya asaase a mekãa ho ntam mekyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom dɛ medze mebɛma hɔn no edzi.
Dzen ara na hyɛ na nya akokodur papaara, na dwen do dzi mbra a m’akowaa Moses hyɛɛ wo no nyinara do: Mma mmfi ho mmfa enyimfa anaa abankum, na eenya no yie wɔ beebiara a ebɔkɔ.
Mma mbra nwoma yi mmpa w’anomu, na mbom dwen ho adzekyee nye adzesaa, ama aadwen do ayɛ dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ mu no nyinara tse no: Na ɔno na ebɛma wo kwan ayɛ dwudwoodwo, na ɔno na ibenya no yie.
Ana mennhyɛɛ wo bi a? Hyɛ dzen na nya akokodur; mma mmbɔ hu, nkyii so mma w’abaw mu nntu: Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dzi w’ekyir wo beebiara a ebɔkɔ.
Nna Joshua hyɛɛ ɔman no hɔn ahwɛdofo no, dɛ,
Hom mfa ndɔ nseraban no mu na hom nhyɛ ɔman dɛ, hom nsiesie edzidzidze mma homho, na hom wɔ dɛ wotwa Jordan yi bɛyɛ ndaansa yi mu kɔ kɛfa asaase a Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn dze rema hom dɛ wɔnkɛfa no.
Na Joshua kasaa kyerɛɛ Reubenfo, nye Gadfo, nye Manasseh ebusuakuw ɔfã no dɛ,
Hom nkaa asɛm a Ewuradze n’akowaa Moses hyɛɛ hom no, dɛ, Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn rema hom ahomgye, na ɔdze asaase yi ama hom no.
Hom yernom, hom mbofraba, nye hom ofiembowa, ntsena asaase a Moses dze maa hom wɔ Jordan egya yi do; na homara dze hom mmia ndzi hom nuanom enyim ntwa, mbarimba akatakyi nyinara, na hom nkɔboa hɔn;

ma onkodu dɛ Ewuradze bɛma hom nuanom ahomgye, dɛ mbrɛ ɔdze ama hom yi, na hɔn so woeenya asaase a Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn dze rema hom no afa: Na n’ekyir no hom asan abɛfa hom enyadze asaase a Ewuradze n’akowaa Moses dze maa hom wɔ Jordan egya ɔdze kɔ wipuei no.
Na wobuaa Joshua, dɛ, dza edze ahyɛ hɛn nyinara yɛbɛyɛ, na beebiara a esoma hɛn no, yɛbɔkɔ.
Dɛ mbrɛ yetsiee Moses wɔ adze nyinara mu no, dɛmara so na yɛbetsie wo: W’ekyir ara na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ndzi, dɛ mbrɛ odzii Moses ekyir no.
Onyii biara a ɔbɛtsew etūa wɔ wo mbrasɛm do, na onnketsie wo nsɛm wɔ dza edze hyɛ no nyinara mu no, ɔtse dɛ woana ara a wonku no: Dzen ara na hyɛ na nya akokodur.
2: Na Nun ne babanyin Joshua somaa mbarimba beenu dɛ aserafo nsumaa ma fi Shittim, dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɔhwe asaase no, nye Jericho. Na wɔkɔree na wɔbaa ɔbaa huhunyi bi a ne dzin dze Rahab fie, na wɔkɔsoɛɛ hɔ.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Jerichohen no, dɛ, hwɛ, mbarimba bi fi Israelmba mu baa ha anago yi dɛ wɔrebɛsera asaase yi.
Na Jerichohen no somae ma wɔkɔr Rahab hɔ, dɛ, fa mbarimba no a wɔaba wo hɔ a wɔabɛhɛn wo fie no fir edzi: Na wɔaba rebɛsera asaase no nyinara.
Na ɔbaa no faa mbarimba beenu no, na ɔdze hɔn sumae; na ɔsee dɛ, ɛhɛɛ, mbarimba no baa me nkyɛn, na minnyim mbrɛ wofi:
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a wɔdze tow kuropon no mu no a ayɛ sum no, nna mbarimba no fiir edzi: Mbrɛ mbarimba no kɔree no minnyim: Hom ntsiw hɔn ntsɛm; na hom bɔto hɔn.
Nna ɔnoara dze hɔn akɔ ɔdan etsifi na ɔdze hɔn ekosuma asaaba a wɔmmpaae bi a ɔaboaboa no yie wɔ ɔdan etsifi no mu.
Na mbarimba no faa Jordan kwan do tsiiw hɔn araa dze kodur esutwaree: Na hɔn a wotsiiw hɔn no kɔree no ara, na wɔtoow kuropon no mu.
Na wonnyae nnkɛdae no, na ɔfowee kɔr hɔn nkyɛn wɔ ɔdan etsifi hɔ:
Na ɔsee mbarimba no dɛ, minyim dɛ Ewuradze dze asaase yi ama hom, na hom ho hu atɔ hɛn do, na asaase yi do atsefo nyinara hɔn ho mbowa eguan wɔ hom ntsi.

Na yɛatse mbrɛ Ewuradze sii ma Epo memen no no nsu wewee wɔ hom enyim, aber a hom fi Egypt firii no; na dza hom dze yɛɛ Amorifo ahemfo beenu a wɔwɔ Jordan egya no, Sihon nye Og, hom sɛɛ hɔn pasapasa no.
Na yɛtsee no ara na hɛn akoma tui, nkyii so ahom biara annka nyimpa biara mu bio, osian hom ntsi: Na Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn no, ɔno nye Nyankopɔn wɔ wimu ɔsor, nye asaase do famu.
Dɛm ntsi afei, mepa hom kyɛw, hom mfa Ewuradze ndzi nsew nkyerɛ me dɛ, ofir dɛ mayɛ hom yie yi, hom so bɛyɛ m’egya fie yie, na wɔama me nokwar asɛnkyerɛdze:
Na woagye m’egya, nye me nã, nye mo nuanom, mbanyin nye mbaa, na adze a wɔwɔ nyinara nkwa, na woeyi hɛn akra efi owu mu.
Na mbarimba no see no dɛ, hɛn nkwa nhyɛ homdze ananmu, sɛ hom annkã hɛn nsɛm yi annkyerɛ a; na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ Ewuradze dze asaase yi ma hɛn a, yɛnye wo bedzi no yie mu nye nokwar mu.
Nna ɔdze ntampee duaa tokura mu gogoow hɔn sisii famu: Osiandɛ ne dan si kurow no ho fasu no do, na fasu no do na ɔtse.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nɔ bepɔw no do, amma etsiwfo no aannto hom; na hom nsuma homho wɔ hɔ, ndaansa, nkodu dɛ etsiwfo no besan: Na n’ekyir no hom bɔkɔ hom kwan a, wɔaakɔ.
Na mbarimba no see no dɛ, yennkedzi sõ wɔ wo ntam a ama yɛakã yi ho.
Hwɛ, sɛ yɛreba asaase yi do a, fa serdaa ahoma yi kyekyer tokura a edze hɛn duaa mu sisii famu no mu: Na boa w'egya, nye ne fifo nyinara ano wɔ wo nkyɛn wɔ ofi no mu.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, obiara a obefi wo fi mbobow ano akɔ abɔntsen do no, no bɔgyaa bogu n'etsifi, na yɛnnkedzi sõ: Na obiara a ɔwɔ wo nkyɛn wɔ ofie no, sɛ obi dze ne nsa kã no a, no bɔ gyaa ngu hɛn etsifi.
Na sɛ ekã hɛn asɛm yi kyerɛ a, ɔnodze yennkedzi sõ wɔ wo ntam a ama yɛakã yi ho.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ hom nsɛm yi tse no ara, wɔmma ɔnyɛ hɔ. Na ɔgyaa hɔn kwan, na wosii mu kɔree: na ɔdze serdaa ahoma no kyekyeer tokura no mu.
Na wɔkɔree kodur bepɔw no do, na wɔtsenaa hɔ ndaansa, kodur dɛ etsiwfo no sanee: Na etsiwfo no hwehwɛɛ hɔn wɔ ɔkwan no mu nyina, na woennhu hɔn.
Nna mbarimba beenu no sanee, na wofii bepɔw no do sianee, na wotwae baa Joshua, Nun babanyin no, nkyɛn.
Na wɔsee Joshua dɛ, nokwar, Ewuradze dze asaase no nyinara ahyɛ hɛn nsa; na nkyii so asaase no do atsefo no nyinara hɔn ho mbowa eguan wɔ hɛn enyim.
3: Na Joshua soɛɛr ahanamakye, na wotui fii Shittim, na wɔbaa Jordan do, ɔno nye Israelmba nyinara; na wɔdaa hɔ ansaana woetwa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ odzii ndaansa no ahwɛdofo no tui dɔɔ nseraban no mu;
na wɔhyɛɛ ɔman no, dɛ, sɛ hom hu. Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn n’ahyɛmudaka no, na asofo Levifo a wɔso no a, ɔno hom ntu mfi hom ananmu na hom ndzi ekyir nkɔ.
Naaso wɔmma ɔkwan a wosusu a ɔbɛyɛ basafa mpemebien nda hom nye ɔno ntamu: Mma hom mmbɛn no, na hom eehu ɔkwan kor a hom wɔ dɛ wofa do; osiandɛ hom mmfaa ɔkwan yi do da nye-ndɛ.
Na Joshua see ɔman no dɛ, hom ntsew homho: Na ɔkyena Ewuradze bɛyɛ hom mu anwanwadze.
Na Joshua kãa kyerɛɛ asɔfo no, dɛ, hom mma ahyɛmudaka no do na hom ntwa mu nkedzi ɔman no enyim. Na wɔmaa ahyɛmudaka no do, na wokedzii ɔman no enyim,
Na Ewuradze see Joshua dɛ, ndɛ da yi na mebɛhyɛ ase mama wo do wɔ Israel nyinara enyi do, na woeehu dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ midzii Moses ekyir no, dɛm ara so na mibedzi w'ekyir.
Na hyɛ asɔfo a wɔso ahyɛmudaka no, dɛ, sɛ hom du Jordan nsu no no nkɔkɔnoa a, hom ngyina dzinn wɔ Jordan no mu.
Na Joshua see Israelmba no dɛ, hom mbra ha yi, na hom ntsie Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn nsɛm.

Na Joshua see dɛ, ɔnam iyi do na hom dze bohu dɛ tseasefo Nyankopɔn no wɔ hom mu, na dɛ ɔpam ara na ɔbɛpam Canaanfo, nye Hittifo, nye Hivifo, nye Perizzfo, nye Girgashfo, nye Amorifo nye Jebusfo no efi hom enyim.
Hwɛ, asaase nyinara wura ahyɛmudaka no rutwa mu edzi hom enyim akɔ Jordan mu.
Dɛm ntsi afei hom nyiyi Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu mbarimba duebien, ebusuakuw biara mu nyimpa baako.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, aber a asɔfo a wɔso Ewuradze, asaase nyinara wura no, n’adakaa no, hɔn anamɔn besi Jordan no nsu mu no, Jordan no nsu no botwa, mekyerɛ nsu a ɔpem fi etsifi ba no a; na wɔabɔ kuw kor egyina hɔ.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔman no tui fii hɔn asesee mu na asɔfo no a wɔso ahyɛmudaka no dzi ɔman no enyim no;
na aber a hɔn a wɔso adaka no dur Jordan do, na asɔfo a wɔso adaka no hɔn anan sii nsu no nkɔkɔnoa no, (Osiandɛ Jordan yir kata no nsukɔn nyinara do buber nyinara),

nna nsu a ɔpem fi etsifi ba no gyinae, na obɔɔ kuw kor, wɔ ekyirkyirkvir, wɔ Adam, kurow no a ɔwɔ Zarethan ne nkyɛn no noho: Na dza ɔpem kɔ Arabah po a ɔnoara nye nkyen Epo no mu no, otwaa koraa: Na ɔman no twae faa Jericho tsentsendo.
Na asɔfo a wɔso Ewuradze n’ahyɛmudaka no gyinaa daadze kɛsɛɛ do pintsinn wɔ Jordan ne finimfin, na Israel nyinara nam daadze kɛsɛɛ do twae araa dze kodur de ɔman no nyinara wowiee Jordan twa.
4: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔman no nyinara wowiee Jordan twa no, Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ Joshua dɛ,
Hom nyiyi ɔman no mu mbarimba duebien, ebusuakuw biara mu nyimpa baako,
na hom nhyɛ hɔn dɛ, hom mfa abo duebien wɔ Jordan mu wɔ mbrɛ asɔfo no hɔn anan gyinaa pintsinn no, na hom nsoa nkɔ, na wɔmfa nkogu asoɛe, mbrɛ hom bosoɛ anago yi no.
Nna Joshua frɛɛ mbarimba duebien no a oesiesie hɔn wɔ Israelmba no mu no, ebusuakow biara mu nyimpa baako:

Na Joshua see hɔn dɛ, hom ntwa mu nkedzi Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn n'adakaa no enyim nkɔ Jordan ne finimfin, na hom mu nyimpa baako mfa ɔbo kor nto no kɔn ho, dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw no dodow tse:
Ama iyi aayɛ hom mu asɛnkyerɛdze, ama sɛ ndaamba bi hom mba bisa dɛ, abo yi hom kyerɛ ase dɛn? A,
ɔno hom nse hɔn dɛ, Osiandɛ Jordan nsu no twae wɔ Ewuradze ahyɛmudaka no enyim; aber a otwaa Jordan no, Jordan no nsu no twae: Na abo yi nye nkaadze mma Israelmba daa.
