Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dɛm dɛ mbrɛ Joshua hyɛe no, na wɔfaa abo duebien wɔ Jordan mu, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ Joshua no, dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw no dodow tse; na wɔsoae dze kɔr beebi mbrɛ wɔkɔsoɛe no, na wɔdze guu hɔ.
Na Joshua dze abo duebien no sisii Jordan finimfin, wɔ beebi mbrɛ asɔfo a wɔso ahyɛmudaka no dze hɔn anan sisii no: Na ɔwɔ hɔ dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na asɔfo a wɔso adaka no gyinaa Jordan mu araa ma okodur dɛ wowiee adze biara a Ewuradze hyɛɛ Joshua dɛ ɔnkã nkyerɛ ɔman no yɛ, dɛ mbrɛ Moses dze hyɛɛ Joshua no nyinara: Na ɔman no yɛɛ ntsem twae.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔman no nyinara wowiee twa no, na Ewuradze n’adaaka no so twae, na asɔfo no wɔ ɔman no enyim.
Na Reubenmba, nye Gadmba, nye Manasseh ebusuakuw ɔfã no, miae twae kedzii Israelmba no enyim, dɛ mbrɛ Moses kãa kyerɛɛ hɔn no:
Bɛyɛ mpemeduanan a woemia prɛko dɛ wɔrokɔ sa twae kedzii Ewuradze enyim kɔr akono, wɔ Jericho tɛtɛr mu.
Da no ara na Ewuradze maa Joshua do wo Israel nyinara enyi do; na wosuroo no, dɛ mbrɛ wosuroo Moses no, wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu.
Na Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ Joshua, dɛ,
hyɛ asɔfo a wɔso dasedaka no, ma womfi Jordan mu mfow mbra.
Dɛm ntsi Joshua hyɛɛ asɔfo no, dɛ, hom mfi Jordan mu mfow mbra.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, asɔfo a wɔso Ewuradze n’ahyɛmudaka no fi Jordan mu fowee, na asɔfo no hɔn anamɔn tui besii daadze kɛsɛɛ do ara, na Jordan no nsu no sanee kɔr n’anamu, na ɔbɛkataa no nsukɔn nyinara do, dɛ mbrɛ nkan no ɔtse no.
Na ɔman no fii Jordan mu fowee wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu da a otsīa du no mu, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Gilgal, wɔ Jericho no boka afamu ɔhe do.
Na abo duebien no a woyiyii no wɔ Jordan mu no, Joshua dze hyɛɛ siw wɔ Gilgal.
Na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ Israelmba, dɛ, sɛ ndaamba bi hom mba bisa hɔn egyanom dɛ, abo yi ase nye dɛn? A,
ɔno hom mma hom mba nhu dɛ, asaase kɛsɛɛ do na Israel nam twaa Jordan yi.
Na Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn weew Jordan mu nsu no wɔ hom enyim, na hom twae ana, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn yɛɛ epo Memen no a ɔwewee no wɔ hɛn enyim, ma yɛtwae ana no:
Ama asaase do aman nyinara woeehu Ewuradze ne nsa dɛ ɔyɛ dzen; ama woeesuro Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn daa.
5: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Amorifo ahemfo a wɔwɔ Jordan egya anee afamu nyinara, nye Canaanfo ahemfo a wɔwɔ po ho no nyinara, wɔtsee mbrɛ Ewuradze sii na ɔweew Jordan no nsu wo Israelmba no enyim ma yetwae ana no, hɔn akoma tui, nkyii so ahom bi nnyi hɔn mu bio osian Israelmba no ntsi.
Aber no mu na Ewuradze see Joshua dɛ, ɔwoara yɛ ɔtwerɛbo asekan, na twitwa Israelmba no twatsia bio ne mprɛnu.
Na Joshua noara yɛɛ ɔtwerɛbo asekan, na otwitwaa Israelmba no twatsia.

Nadza osian ntsi ma Joshua twitwaa twatsia no nye yi: Ɔman no a wofi Egypt bae no nyinara a wɔyɛ mbanyin no, mekyerɛ mbarimba akofo no nyinara, wowuwuu kwan mu wɔ sar no do, wofi Egypt firii n’ekyir no.
Na ɔman no a wofiir edzi no nyinara woetwitwa hɔn twatsia: Na ɔman no a wofi Egypt firii no a wɔwoo hɔn kwan mu wɔ sar no do nyinara dze, wonntwitwaa hɔn twatsia.

Na Israelmba no nantsewee wɔ sar no do mfe eduanan, kodur dɛ oman no nyinara, mekyerɛ mbarimba akofo no a wofi Egypt firii no, hɔn ase kumii, osiandɛ woenntsie Ewuradze ne ndze: Woyinom na Ewuradze kãa ntam dɛ ɔnnkɛma woehu asaase a Ewuradze kãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom dɛ ɔdze bɛma hɛn no, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no.
Na hɔn mba no, hɔn a ɔman wɔsoɛree hyɛɛ hɔn ananmu no, hɔn na Joshua twitwaa hɔn twatsia: Na wɔyɛ monomonmfo, osiandɛ woenntwa hɔn twatsia wɔ kwan no mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wowiee ɔman no nyinara twatsia twitwaa no, wɔtsenatsenaa hɔn anannmu wɔ nseraban no mu, ma wɔtsee apɔw ana.
Na Ewuradze see Joshua dɛ, ndɛ da yi na meyi Egypt engyimguase no mefi hom do. Dɛm ntsi bea no ne dzin wɔfrɛɛ no Gilgal dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na Israelmba no kyeer nsera wɔ Gilgal, na wodzii apaho wɔ bossom no ne da a otsīa duanan no n'ewimbir wɔ Jericho tɛtɛr mu.
Na apaho no ekyir adze kyee no na wodzii asaase no do eburow dadaw, epitsi tatar nye eburow kyewee, da no ara.
Na wodzii asaase no do eburow dadaw ekyir no, adze kyee no na manna no siankae; nkyii so Israelmba no ennya manna bio; mbom wodzii Canaan asaase no do ndɔbaa wɔ afe no mu.

Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Joshua wɔ Jericho ho no, ɔmaa n'enyiwa do hwɛɛ, na, hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi ɔatwe n'afõwa kitsa ne nsamu gyina n'enyim tsentsendo: Na Joshua kɔr ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, ewɔ hɛn afã, anaa ewɔ hɛn atamfo afã?
Na ɔsee dɛ, oho; na dɛ Ewuradze no dɔm safohen panyin no na afei maba. Na Joshua dze n'enyim butuuw famu, na ɔsomee, na ɔsee no dɛ, na mo wura ese n'akowaa dɛn?
Na Ewuradze no dɔm safohen panyin no see Joshua dɛ, yiyi wo mpaboa wɔ w'anan; na beebi mbrɛ igyinae no yɛ krɔnkrɔn. Na Joshua yɛɛ dɛm.
6: (Afei wɔtoow Jericho mu twitwiitwi wɔ Israelmba no ntsi: Obi mmfi mu mmpue, na obi mmba mu).
Na Ewuradze see Joshua dɛ, hwɛ, medze Jericho, nye ne hen, nye ne mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, mahyɛ wo nsa.
Na hom nkyin kurow no ho, mbarimba akofo nyinara mbɔ kurow no ho aprɔw prɛko, yɛ no dɛm nda esia.
Na asɔfo beesuon mfa ndwanyin mmbɛn mbɛn esuon ndzi adaka no enyim: Na da a otsia esuon no hom nkyin kurow no ho mpɛn esuon, na asɔfo no nhɛn mbɛn no.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔhɛn odwanyin abɛn no ma no kwan war, na sɛ hom tse abɛn no ne ndze a, ɔman no nyinara mfa huro kɛse mbɔ ose; na kurow no ho fasu no bodwuruw egu famu dɛfɛɛ, na ɔman no obiara ndua n'enyim tsentsendo mfow nkɔ.
Na Joshua, Nun ne babanyin no, frɛɛ asɔfo no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mma ahyɛmudaka no do, na mmbɛn mbɛn esuon ndzi Ewuradze n'adakaa no enyim.
Na wɔsee ɔman no dɛ, hom ntwa mu nkɔbɔ kurow no ho aprɔw, na wɔmma mbarimba a woemia no ntwa mu nkedzi Ewuradze n’adakaa no enyim.
Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm, aber a Joshua kasaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no, asɔfo beesuon no a wɔdze ndwanyin mmbɛn mbɛn esuon dzi Ewuradze enyim no twaa mu. Na wɔhɛɛn mbɛn no: Na Ewuradze n’ahyemudaka no kaa hɔn do.
Na mbarimba a woemia no dzii asɔfo a wɔhɛn mbɛn no enyim, na nkyidɔm no dzi adaka no ekyir, asɔfo no wɔnam rokɔ no na wɔrehɛn mbɛn no.
Na Joshua hyɛɛ ɔman no dɛ. Mma hom mmbɔ ose, mma wɔnntse hom ndze so, mma asɛm bi mmfi hom anomu mmpue, kyerɛ da a mebɛse hom dɛ wɔmbɔ ose no; nna hom mbɔ ose.
Nna ɔmaa Ewuradze n’adakaa no kekyiin kurow no ho, kɔbɔɔ ho aprɔw prɛko: Na wɔbaa nseraban no mu, na wɔbɛdaa nseraban no mu.
Na Joshua soɛɛr anapaatu, na asɔfo no maa Ewuradze n’adakaa no do.

Na asɔfo beesuon no a wɔdzedze ndwanyin mmbɛn mbɛn esuon no dzi Ewuradze n'adakaa no enyim no nantsewee ara, na wɔhɛɛn mbɛn no: Na mbarimba a woemia no dzi hɔn enyim; na nkyidɔm no dzi Ewuradze n’adakaa no ekyir, asɔfo no wɔnam rokɔ no na wɔrehɛn mbɛn no.
Na da a otsia ebien no wokyiin kurow no ho prɛko, na wɔsanee kɔr nseraban no mu: Wɔyɛɛ dɛm ara nda esia.
Na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsia esuon no, wɔsoɛɛr ahanamakye a enyim rebaabae no, na wokekyiin kurow no ho dɛmara mpɛn esuon: Da no nko ara na wɔbɔɔ kurow no ho aprɔw mpɛn esuon:
Na ɔbaa dɛ otsīa mpɛn esuon no, aber a asɔfo no hɛɛn mbɛn no, Joshua see ɔman no dɛ, hom mbɔ ose; na Ewuradze dze kurow no ama hom.

Na kurow no nyɛ adze a wɔdze nsa ato do, mekyerɛ, ɔno nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara, mma Ewuradze: Ɔbaa huhuayi Rahab nko na ɔntsena ase, ɔno nye hɔn a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn wɔ fie no nyinara, osiandɛ ɔdze abɔfo a yɛsomaa hɔn no sumae.
Na hom, homho ara na hom nhwɛ no yie wɔ adze a wɔadom no ho, ɔno bɛyɛ na hom adom no, hom afa adze a wɔadom no bi; na hom ayɛ ma Israel nseraban ayɛ ebusudze, na hom ahaw no.
Na dwetɛ, nye sika, na boran nye dadze ndzɛmba nyinara dze, yɛ krɔnkrɔn ma Ewuradze: Wɔmfa mbra Ewuradze n’adzekorabea.

Nna ɔman no bɔɔ ose, na asɔfo no hɛɛn mbɛn no: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔman no tsee abɛn no ndze no, ɔman no dze huro kɛse bɔɔ ose, na fasu no dwuruwii guu famu dɛfɛɛ, ma ɔman no fowee kɔr kurow no mu, obiara duaa n’enyim tsentsendo, na wɔgyee kurow no.
Na wɔdze afõwa ano kunkum dza ɔwɔ kurow no mu nyinara pasapasa, obarimba nye ɔbaa, abofra nye ɔpayin nyina, nye ɔnantwi, nye oguan, nye asoaso.
Na Joshua see mbarimba beenu a wɔkɛseraa asaase no dɛ, hom nkɔ ɔbaa huhunyi no fie, na wɔnkɛfa ɔbaa no, nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara mfi hɔ mbra, dɛ mbrɛ hom kãa ntam kyerɛɛ no no.
Na mberantsɛ akwanserafo no kɔree, na wɔdze Rahab, nye n’egya, nye ne nã, nye no nuanora, nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara fiir edzi bae; na wɔdze hɔn kegyaa Israel nseraban no ekyir.
Na wɔdze ogya hyeew kurow no, nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara: Dwetɛ, nye sika, na boran nye dadze ndzɛmba no ara nko, na wɔdze kɔr Ewuradze ne fie adzekorabea no mu.

Na ɔbaa huhunyi Rahab, na n'egya ne fifo, nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara dze, Joshua gyee hɔn nkwa; na ɔtsenaa Israel mu araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi; osiandɛ ɔdze abɔfo a Joshua somaa hɔn dɛ wɔnkɛsera Jericho no sumae.
Na Joshua dze ntam braa hɔn aber no mu dɛ, nyimpa a ɔbɔsoɛr abɛkyekyer Jericho kurow yi, mpaa nkā no wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Ɔdze n’abakan bɔtow ne fapem, na ɔdze n’abakyiba banyin esisi n’ano mbobotsen.
Nna Ewuradze dzii Joshua ekyir; na ne nka tahyee asaase no nyinara do.
7: Na Israelmba tõo mbra wɔ adze a wɔadom no no ho: Osiandɛ Achan, Charmi babanyin no, Zabdi babanyin no, Zerah babanyim no a ofi Judah no, ɔfaa adze a wɔadom no no bi: Na Ewuradze n’ebufuw dzɛɛw wɔ Israelmba no do.
Na Joshua somaa mbarimba ma wofi Jericho kɔr Ai a ɔwɔ Beth-aven nkyɛn wo Beth-el no boka afamu, na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, hom mfow nkɔ nkesera asaase no. Na mbarimba no fowee koree keseraa Ai.

Na wɔsanee baa Joshua hɔ bɛsee no dɛ, mma mma ɔman no nyinara mmfow nnkɔ; mbom ma mbarimba bɛyɛ mpemebien anaa mpemebiasa mfow nkɔ nkɔbɔ Ai; mma nnyɛ ɔman no nyinara ma wɔmmfona hɔnho nnkefir hɔ: Osiandɛ hɔn ho suar.
Nna ɔman no mu mbarimba bɛyɛ mpemebiasa fowee kɔr hɔ: Na woguanee wɔ Ai mbarimba no enyim.
Na Ai mbarimba no kunkum hɔn mu mbarimba bɛyɛ eduasa esia: Na wotsiiw hɔn dze fi kuropon no ano araa kodur Shebarimf na wokunkum hɔn wɔ nsianee no mu: Na ɔman no hɔn akoma tutui, na abagura kaa hɔn.
Na Joshua sunsuaan ne ntar mu, na ɔdze n’enyim butuuw famu wɔ Ewuradze n'adakaa no enyim araa ma okodur ewimbir, ɔnoara ɔnye Israel mpanyimfo no; na wotuu huntuma guguu hɔn etsifi.
Na Joshua see dɛ, afei, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, ɔyɛ dɛn ara ntsi na edze ɔman yi etwa Jordan, dɛ edze hɛn rebɛhye Amorifo nsa, ma wɔaama yɛahyew yi? Yehunii a nkyɛ yɛnyɛ fõo ntsena Jordan egya noho!
Ao Ewuradze, na mense dɛn, Israel na wɔadan hɔn ekyir ama hɔn atamfo yi!
Na Canaanfo nye asaase no do atsefo no nyinara bɛtse nka, na woetwa hɛn ho ehyia, na woetwa hɛn dzin efi asaase do: Na ebɛyɛ dɛn ama wo dzin kɛse no?
Na Ewuradze see Joshua dɛ, Soɛr: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edze w’enyim ebutuw famu dɛm yi?
Israel ayɛ bɔn; nyew, woatõ m'ahyɛmu a mehyɛɛ hɔn ho mbra no mpo: Nyew, wɔafa adze a wɔadom no no so mpo bi; na woewia adze so, na wɔakata do so, na wɔdze akɛhyɛ hɔnankasa hɔn adze so mpo mu.
Dɛm ntsi na Israelmba no nntum nngyina hɔn atamfo enyim, wɔdan hɔn ekyir ma hɔn atamfo, osiandɛ wɔayɛ ebusufo: Minnkedzi hom ekyir bio, gyedɛ hom sɛɛ adze a wɔadom no no fi hom mu.

Soɛr, tsew ɔman no ho, na se dɛ, hom ntsew homho nsie ɔkyena: Na mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi, adze a wɔadom no no bi wɔ wo mu, Israel: Irunntum nngyina w'atamfo enyim, kyerɛ hom eyi adze a wɔadom no no efi hom ana.

Dɛm nsti anapa hom mfa no hom ebusuakuw mu ebusuakuw mu ntwe mpin: Na ɔmbra dɛ, ebusuakuw a Ewuradze beyi no ntwe mpin ebusua mu ebusua mu: Na ebusua a Ewuradze beyi no ntwe mpin no efibobow mu efibobow mu; na ofibobow a Ewuradze beyi no ntwe mpin no nyimpa nkorkor mu.
Na ɔmbra dɛ nyia adze a wɔadom no no besi no wɔdze ogya bɛhyew no, ɔnoara ɔnye dza ɔwɔ nyinara: Osiandɛ ɔatõ Ewuradze n’ahyɛmu no, na ɔayɛ ebusudze wɔ Israel.
Nna Joshua soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔdze Israel twee pinii wɔ ebusuakuw mu ebusuakuw mu; na woyii Judah ebusuakuw no:
Na ɔdze Judah ebusua no twee pinii; na oyii Zerafo ebusua no: Na ɔdze Zerafo ebusua no twee pinii wɔ nyimpa nkorkor mu; na woyii Zabdi:
Na ɔdze ne fibobow twee pinii wɔ nyimpa nkorkor mu: Na woyii Achan, Charmi babanyin no, Zerah babanyin no a ofi Judah ebusuakuw mu no.
Na Joshua see Achan dɛ, me babanyin, me kyɛw ara nye yi, fa enyimnyam ma Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na yi no ayɛw; na afei kã w’adze a ayɛ kyerɛ me; mma nnsiw me do.
Na Achan buaa Joshua see dɛ, nokwar mayɛ bɔn etsia Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na dza mayɛ nye yi:

Aber a muhun asadze no mu Babylon egugudo fɛɛfɛw bi, nye dwetɛ shekel ahaenu, nye sika ndamba a otow shekel eduonum no, nna m'enyi beree, na mefae; na, hwɛ, ɔhyɛ famu wɔ m’asesee no mu, na dwetɛ hyɛ ase.
Nna Joshua somaa abɔfo, na wɔdze mbirika kɔr asese mu; na, hwɛ, ɔhyɛ famu wɔ asee mu, na dwetɛ no hyɛ ase.
Na woyii no wɔ asese no mu, na wɔdze brɛɛ Joshua, nye Israelmba no nyinara; na wɔdze boguu Ewuradze enyim.

Na Joshua, nye Israel nyinara ka noho, faa Achan, Zerah babanyin no, nye dwetɛ no, nye egugudo no, nye sika ndamba no, nye ne mbabanyin, nye ne mbabaa, nye ne n'anantwi, nye no nsoaso, nye no nguan, nye n’asesee, nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara: Na wɔdze hɔn baa Achor ɔbon mu.
Na Joshua see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na afona hɛn yi? Ewuradze bɔfona wo ndɛ da yi. Na Israel nyinara siiw no abo; na wɔdze ogya hyeew hɔn, na wɔdze abo siiw hɔn.
Na wɔhɔɔr no do abosiw kɛsenara dze bodu ndɛ da yi: Na Ewuradze danee fii n'ebufuw ne hyeehyew no ho. Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin, Achor ɔbɔn, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
8: Na Ewuradze see Joshua dɛ, Mma nnsuro, nkyii so mma w'abaw mu nntu: Fa akofo no nyinara ka woho, na soɛr, fow kɔ Ai: Hwɛ, medze Aihen, nye ne man, nye no kurow, nye n'asaase mahyɛ wo nsa:
Na yɛ Ai ne hen dɛ mbrɛ eyɛɛ Jericho nye ne hen no: No mu asadze, nye no mu ofiembowa nko, na hom mfa no afonam mma homho: Hyɛ ma wɔnkɔ kurow no atsɛwee wɔ n'ekyir.
Nna Joshua, nye akofo no nyinara soɛree, dɛ wɔrokɔfow akɔ Ai: Na Joshua yiyii mbarimba no mpemeduasa, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, na ogyaa hɔn kwan anago.
Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, hwɛ, hom nkɔ kurow no atsɛwee, wɔ kurow no n’ekyir: Mma hom mmfi kurow no ho nnkɔ ekyirkyir pii, mbom hom nyinara nyɛ krado:
Na emi, nye ɔman a wɔka mo ho nyinara, bɔtwe epin kurow no: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wopue ba hɛn do dɛ asɔpɔn a, yebefi hɔn enyim eguan;
na wobefir edzi etsiw hɛn ekodu dɛ yɛbɔtwe hɔn efi kurow no mu; na wɔbɛse dɛ, wofi hɛn enyim ruguan, dɛ asɔpɔn no; na yebefi hɔn enyim eguan:
na hom nsoɛr mfi atsɛwee no mu, na wɔnkɛfa kurow no: Na Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn dze bɛhyɛ hom nsa.
Na ɔmbra dɛ, aber a hom afa kurow no, hom nto kurow no mu ogya; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n’asɛm tse no ara na hom nyɛ: Hwɛ, mahyɛ hom.
Na Joshua gyaa hɔn kwan: Na wɔkɔr atsɛwee no, na wɔtsenaa Beth-el nye Ai ntamu, wɔ Ai n’anee afamu: Na Joshua dze ɔdaa ɔman no mu anago no.
Na Joshua soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔpoon ɔman no hyiae, na ɔnoara nye Israel mpanyimfo no fowee dzii ɔman no enyim kor Ai.
Na ɔman no nyinara, mekyerɛ akofo no a wɔka no ho no, fowee, na wɔtwee pinii, na wɔbaa kurow no enyim, na wɔkyeer nsera wɔ Ai kwaamu afamu: Afei ɔbɔn bi da ɔno nye Ai ntamu.
Na ɔfaa mbarimba bɛyɛ mpemenum, na ɔdze hɔn kɔr atsɛwee wɔ Beth-el nye Ai ntamu, wɔ kurow no n'anee afamu.
Nna wɔtotoo ɔman no, mekyerɛ dɔm no nyinara a wɔwɔ kurow no no kwaamu afamu, na hɔn atsɛweefo no a wɔwɔ kurow no n’anee afamu no; na Joshua kɔr ɔbɔn no mu anago no ara.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Aihen no hunii no, wɔyɛɛ ntsɛm soɛɛr ahanamakye, na kurow no mu mbarimba no fiir edzi dɛ worikehyia Israel nye hɔn akõ, ɔno ɔnye ne man nyinara, wɔ aber a wɔahyɛ, wɔ Arabah no enyim; na ɔnodze onnyim dɛ wɔakɔ no atsɛwee wɔ kurow no ekyir.
Na Joshua nye Israel nyinara yɛɛ dɛ gyama woetutu hɔn wɔ hɔn enyim, na woguanee faa sar no do kwan no do.
Na wɔfrɛɛ nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ kurow no mu nyinara bɔɔ mu dɛ wontsiw hɔn: Na wotsiiw Joshua, na wɔtwee hɔn fii kurow no mu.
Na ɔbarimba biara annka wo Ai anaa Beth-el a oemmfir edzi enntsiw Israel: Na wɔdaan kurow no n’ano gyaa hɔ, na wotsiiw Israel.
Na Ewuradze see Joshua dɛ, tsen peaa no a ɔdze wo nsamu no wɔ Ai do; na medze mebɛhyɛ wo nsa. Na Joshua tseen peaa no a ɔdze ne nsamu no wɔ kurow no do.
Na atsɛweefo no soɛree fii hɔn ananmu ntsɛm, na ɔtseen ne nsa ara na wotutuu mbirika kɛhɛɛn kurow no mu, na wɔfae; na wɔyɛɛ no har too kurow no mu ogya.

Na aber a Ai mbarimba buu hɔn kɔn ekyir no, wohunii, na hwɛ, kurow no mu wusiw afow kɔ sor, na woennya ahoɔdzen a wɔdze guan fa ha anaa ha: Na nkorɔfo no a woguanee kɔr sar no do no daan hɔnho wo hɔn a woritsiw hɔn no do.
Na aber a Joshua nye Israel nyinara hun dɛ atsɛweefo no agye kurow no, na kurow no no wusiw afow kɔ sor no, nna wɔsaan hɔn ekyir bio bokunkum Ai mbarimba no.
Na kor no so fiir edzi fii kurow no mu baa hɔn do; ma wɔkaa Israel ntamu, binom wɔ afã ha, na binom so wo afa ha: Na wokunkum hɔn araa ma wɔamma hɔn mu biara annka anaa oemmfi nsa.
Na wɔkyeer Aihen no enyikan, na wɔdze no brɛɛ Joshua.

Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Israel wiee Aifo a wɔwɔ akoe mu, wɔ sar no do mbrɛ wotsiiw hɔn no kunkum, na hɔn nyinara totɔr wɔ afõwa anomu araa kodur dɛ hɔn ase kumii no, Israel nyinara sanee kɔr Ai, na wɔdze afõwa anomu kɔbɔɔ no.
Na hɔn a wɔtotɔr da no nyinara, mbarimba nye mbaa nyina, wɔyɛ mpemduebien, mekyerɛ Ai mbarimba nyinara.
Na Joshua anntwe ne nsa a ɔdze tseen peaa no annsan ekyir araa kodur dɛ ɔsɛɛ Aifo nyinara pasapasa.
Kurow no mu ofiembowa nye asadze nko na Israel faa no afonam maa hɔnho, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n’asɛm a ɔdze hyɛɛ Joshua no tse.
Nna Joshua hyeew Ai, na ɔyɛɛ no osiw a ɔwɔ hɔ daa, mekyerɛ amamfõ, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.

Na ɔdze Aihen no sɛɛn dua do araa ma okodur ewimbir: Na wi kɔtɔree no Joshua hyɛe ma wokeyii no fun no fii dua no do, na wɔkɔtowee kyeen kurow no no kuropon ano na wɔhɔɔr abosiw kɛsenara wɔ do, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Nna Joshua sii afɔrmbukyia maa Ewuradze. Israel Nyankopɔn no, wɔ bepɔw Ebal do.
dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses mbra nwoma no mu, afɔrmbukyia a wɔdze abo a wonntwae a nyimpa biara mmaa dadze biara do wɔ do pɛn sii: Na wɔbɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr wɔ do maa Ewuradze, na wokum asomdwee afɔr.
Na ɔkyerɛɛw Moses mbra no no nsusudo wɔ abo no do hɔ, ɔno na ɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israelmba enyim no.

Na Israel nyinara, nye hɔn mpanyimfo nye ahwɛdofo. Nye hɔn ntsɛmbuafo, gyinaa adaka no n'afã ha, nye n’afã ha, wa asɔfo Levifo a wɔso Ewuradze n’ahyɛmudaka no enyim, ɔhɔho nye okuromnyi nyinara: Hɔn mu fã so wɔ bepɔw Gerizim enyim, na hɔn mu fã so wɔ bepɔw Ebal enyim dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n’akowaa Moses hyɛɛ dɛ wondzi kan nhyira Israel ɔman no ana no.
Na n'ekyir no ɔkenkaan mbra no mu nsɛm nyinara, nhyira no nye mpaa no, dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mbra nwoma no mu nyinara tse.
Asem biara nnyi dza Moses hyɛe no nyinara mu a Joshua annkenkan no wɔ Israel bagua no nyinara, nye mbaa, nye mbofraba, nye ahɔho a wɔnye hɔn nam no enyim.
9: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a ahemfo a wɔwɔ Jordan egya, wɔ nkokodo nkurow, nye abɔnmu nkurow, nye po kɛse no no mpoano nyinara wɔ Lebanon tsentsendo no. Hittifo, nye Amorifo, Canaanfo, Perizzfo, Hivifo, nye Jebusfo, tsee nka no;
wɔpoon hɔnho hyiae, dɛ wɔdze ɔnokor nye Joshua nye Israel robɔkõ.
Na aber a Gibeonfo tsee dza Joshua dze yɛɛ Jericho nye Ai no,
hɔn so wɔyɛɛ no nyansa mu, na wosii mu kɔree kɛyɛɛ dɛ gyama wɔyɛ abɔfo, na wɔfaa mbɔtoa dadaw soasoaa hɔn nsoaso, nye nsã-nwoma nkotoku a wɔayɛ dadaw na wɔatsetsew na wɔapempam;
na mpaboa dadaw pokyipokyi a wɔasesa mu hyehyɛ hɔn anan, na ntar gow hyehyɛ hɔn; na hɔn edzidzidze mu edziban nyinara atwentwem na wɔabobɔ etur.
Na wosii mu kɔr Joshua hɔ wɔ nsera mu wɔ Gilgal, na wɔsee ɔno nye Israel mbarimba no dɛ, yefi ekyirkyir ɔman bi mu na yɛeba, dɛm ntsi afei hom nye hɛn nkyekyer,
Na Israel mbarimba no see Hivito no dɛ, annyɛ a hɛn mu na hom tse; na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn yɛnye hom akyekyer?
Na wɔsee Joshua dɛ, yɛyɛ wo nkowaa. Na Joshua see hɔn dɛ, woananom nye hom? Na hom fi hen bae?
Na wɔsee no dɛ, Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn ne dzin ntsi na wo nkowaa fi ekyirkyir ɔman bi mu aba: Na yɛatse ne nka, na dza ɔyɛe wɔ Egypt nyinara,
na dza ɔdze yɛɛ Amorifo ahemfo beenu a wɔwɔ Jordan egya nyinara, Heshbonhen Sihon, nye Bashanhen Og a ɔwɔ Ashtaroth no.
Na hɛn mpanyimfo nye hɛn man mu nkorɔfo nyinara kasaa kyerɛɛ hɛn dɛ, hom mfa ɔkwan do edzidzidze, na wɔnkɔ nkehyia hɔn, na wɔnse hɔn dɛ, yɛyɛ hom nkowaa na afei hom nye hɛn nkyekyer,
Hɛn boodoo yi da a yefiir edzi dɛ yɛreba hom nkyɛn no na yɛfaa no ɔhyew totoo hɛn edzidzidze mu; na afei, hwɛ, atwentwem, na ɔabɔ etur
na nsã-nwoma-nkotoku yi a yɛhyehyɛɛ no amaama yi, wɔyɛ afofor; na, hwɛ, wɔatsetsew; na hɛn ntar nye hɛn mpaboa yi ayɛ adadaw wɔ ɔkwan no no war a ɔwar dodow ntsi.
Na mbarimba no gyee hɔn edzidzidze no bi, na woemmbisa Ewuradze anomu apam.
Na Joshua nye hɔn siesiei, na ɔnye hɔn kyekyeer dɛ ɔbɛma wɔatsena ase: Na mboanofo no mu mbapɔmba no dzidzii nsew kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na ɔbaa dɛ wɔnye hɔn wiee kyekyer no n'ekyir nda ebiasa, nna wɔtsee dɛ wɔyɛ hɔn manmufo, na wɔtse hɔn mu.
Na Israelmba no tuu kwan, na wokodur hɔn nkurow mu da a otsia ebiasa no. Na hɔn nkurow nye Gibeon, nye Chephirah nye Beeroth nye Kiriath-Jearim
Na Israelmba ennkunkum hɔn osiandɛ mboanofo no mu mbapɔmba no dze Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, edzi nsew akyerɛ hɔn. Na mboa no fo no nyinara hwinhwinii tsiaa mbapɔmba no.
Na mbapɔmba no nyinara see mboanofo no nyinara dɛ, yɛdze Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, edzi nsew akyerɛ hɔn: Dɛm ntsi afei yennyi dɛ yɛdze nsa kã bon.
Iyi na yɛbɛyɛ hɔn, na yɛama wɔatsena ase; amma osian ntam a yɛakã akyerɛ hɔn no ntsi, ebufuw aammba hɛn do.
Na mbapɔmba no see hɔn dɛ, wɔmma wɔntsena ase: Nna wɔbɛyɛɛ nduatwafo nye nsusawfo maa mboanofo no nyinara; dɛ mbrɛ mbapɔmba no kãa kyerɛɛ hɔn no.
Na Joshua kɛfrɛɛ hɔn, na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn, dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na bom adaadaa hɛn, dɛ, yɛnye hom ntamu twe dodoodow; aber a hom tse hɛn mu yi?
Dɛm ntsi afei wɔapaa hom, na hom nnkegyaa nkowaa yɛ ara da, wɔbɛyɛ nduatwafo nye nsusawfo nyina ama me Nyankopɔn fie.

Na wobuaa Joshua, na wɔsee dɛ, osiandɛ wɔkãa no kotoo kyerɛɛ wo nkowaa, mbrɛ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn sii na ɔhyɛɛ n’akowaa Moses dɛ ɔmfa asaase nyinara mma hom, na ɔnsɛɛ asaase no do atsefo no nyinara mfi hom enyim; dɛm ntsi osian hom ntsi yesuroo dodoodow maa hɛn nkwa, na yɛayɛ iyi yi.
Na afei, hwɛ, yɛwɔ wo nsamu: Dza ehwɛ a oye na ɔtsen ma wo dɛ edze bɛyɛ hɛn no, yɛ.
Na dɛm na ɔyɛɛ hɔn, na ɔgyee hɔn fii Israelmba nsamu, ma woennkunkum hɔn.
Na da no ara Joshua yɛɛ hɔn nduatwafo nye nsusawfo dze maa mboanofo no, nye Ewuradze n’afɔrmbukyia no, dze bodu ndɛ da yi, wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔbɛsan mu eyi no.
10: Afei ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jerusalemhen Adonizedek tsee mbrɛ Joshua sii gyee Ai, na ɔsɛɛ no pasapasa; dɛ mbrɛ ɔdze yɛɛ Jericho nye ne hen no, dɛmara so na ɔdze yɛɛ Ai nye ne hen; na mbrɛ Gibeonfo sii nye Israel siesiei, na wɔtsenaa hɔn mu no;
wosuroo kɛsenara, osiandɛ Gibeon yɛ kurow kɛse, ɔtse dɛ ahenkurow no bi, na osiandɛ ɔsõ sen Ai, na no mu mbarimba nyinara yɛ ahoɔdzenfo.
Dɛm ntsi Jerusalemhen Adoni-zedek somae ma wɔkɔr Hebronhen Hoham hɔ, nye Jarmuthhen Piram hɔ, nye Lachishhen Japhia hɔ, nye Eglonhen Debir ho, dɛ,
Hom mbra me nkyɛn mbɔboa me, ma yenku Gibeon: Osiandɛ ɔnye Joshua, na ɔnye Israelmba no ekesiesie.

Dɛm ntsi Amorifoahemfo beenum no, Jerusalemhen no, Hebronhen no, Jarmuthhen no, Lachishhen no, Eglonhen no, poon hɔnho hyiae, na wɔfowee kɔree, hɔn nye hɔn dɔm nyinara, na wɔkɛkyeer Gibeon do nsera, na wɔyɛɛ no do sa.

Na Gibeon mbarimba no somae ma wɔkɔr Joshua nkyɛn wɔ nsera mu wɔ Gilgal, dɛ, mma nnyi wo nsa mmfi wo nkowaa do; bra hɛn nkyɛn ntsɛm bɛgye hɛn nkwa, na bɔboa hɛn: Na Amorifo ahemfo a wɔtsetse nkokodo nkurow mu nyinara apon honho ehyia abɛhyɛ hɛn do.
Nna Joshua fi Gilgal fowee kɔree, ɔnoara, ɔnye akofo a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn nyinara, nye mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam nyinara.
Na Ewuradze see Joshua dɛ, mma nnsuro hɔn: A meyi hon ahye wo nsa; hɔn mu nyimpa biara nnkegyina w’enyim.
Dɛm ntsi Joshua baa hɔn do awerɛfir mu; osiandɛ ɔdze anago no nyinara fowee fi Gilgal kɔree.
Na Ewuradze kaa hɔn gui wɔ Israel enyim, na ɔdze okum kɛse kunkum hɔn wɔ Gibeon, na wotsiiw hɔn wo Beth-horon n’afowee ɔkwan no do, na wokunkum hɔn kodur Azekah, nye Makkedah.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, woruguan efi Israel enyim, aber a wɔwɔ Beth-horon esianee no, Ewuradze totoow abo akɛse fi sor bobɔɔ hɔn dze kodur Azekah, ma wowuwui: Hɔn a wɔdze ɔsorbo no kunkum hɔn wɔdɔɔ sõ sen hɔn a Israelmba no wɔdze afowa kunkum hɔn.
Nna Joshua kasaa kyerɛɛ Ewuradze wɔ da a Ewuradze yii Amorifo mae wo Israelmba enyim no; na ɔsee wɔ Israel enyim dɛ, Iwi, gyina dzinn wɔ Gibeon do; Na ɔwo, ɔbosoom, wɔ Aijalon ɔbɔn mu.

Na iwi gyinaa dzinn, na ɔbosoom siankae, Kodur dɛ ɔman no dzii wer wɔ hɔn atamfo do. Ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw iyi wɔ Jashar nwoma no mu? Na wi siankae wɔ ɔsor finimfin, na ɔannyɛ ntsɛm annkɔtɔ bɛyɛ adzekyeekwansin mu.
Na da biara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔno wɔ n’enyim nye n’ekyir a Ewuradze etsie nyimpa ne ndze dɛm: Osiandɛ Ewuradze kõe maa Israel.
Na Joshua sanee, na Israel nyinara ka no ho, baa nseraban no mu wɔ Gilgal.
Na ahemfo beenum yi guanee, na wɔdze hɔnho kosumaa Makkedah ɔbo-tu no mu.
Na wɔkāa kyerɛɛ Joshua dɛ, ahemfo beenum no woehu hɔn dɛ wosuma Makkedah ɔbo-tu no mu.
Na Joshua see dɛ, hom mpirew abo akɛse nhin ɔbo-tu no ano, na wɔmfa nyimpa ngyina ho ma wɔnweɔn hɔn:
Na homdze mma wonnsianka; hom ntsiw hom atamfo no, na wonku hɔn mu edziekyifo no, mma hom mma hɔn kwan ma wɔnnkɛhɛn nkurow mu: Osiandɛ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn eyi hɔn ahyɛ hom nsa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Joshua nye Israelmba no dze okum kɛse pɔtɔɔ wiee hɔn kunkum ara ma wɔhyewee no, na hɔn mu nkaa a wɔkae no guaguanee kɛhɛnhɛɛn nkurow a wɔagyegye ho ban no mu no,
nna ɔman no nseraban no mu wɔ Makkedah dwudwoodwo: Obi anntwe ne gyirama annkā Israelmba mu obiara da.
Nna Joshua see dɛ, hom mbue ɔbo-tu no ano, na hom nyi ahemfo beenum no mfi ɔbo-tu no mu mbrɛ me.
Na wɔyɛɛ dɛm, na woyii ahemfo beenum no fii ɔbo-tu no mu brɛɛ no, Jerusalemhen no, Hebronhen no, Jarmuthhen, Lachishhen no, Eglonhen no.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔdze ahemfo no brɛɛ Joshua no, Joshua kɛfrɛɛ Israel mbarimba nyinara, na ɔsee mbarimba akofo a wɔnye no kɔree no hɔn asafohemfo no dɛ, hom ntwe mpin, mfa hom anan mbesisi hɔn kɔn do.
Na Joshua see hɔn dɛ, mma hom nnsuro, mma hom abaw mu nntu so; hom nhyɛ dzen na wonnya akokodur: Na dem na Ewuradze bɛyɛ hom atamfo a hom nye hɔn kõ nyinara.
Na n'ekyir no Joshua bobɔɔ hɔn kunkum hɔn, na ɔdze hɔn sensɛɛn ndua do: Na wɔsensɛn ndua no do araa kodur ewimbir.
Na ɔbaa dɛ witɔree ber no, Joshua hyɛe ma woyiyii hɔn fii ndua no do, na wɔkɔtoow hɔn guu ɔbo-tu no a wɔdze hɔnho kosumaa mu no mu, na wɔdze abo akɛse hiin ɔbo-tu no ano, dze bodu ndɛ da yi ara.

Na Joshua gyee Makkedah da no ara, na ɔdze afõwa anomu bɔɔ no, nye ne hen no; ɔsɛɛ hɔn nyinara nye akra a wɔwɔ mu no pasapasa, oenngyaa biara ma ɔaannka: Na ɔyɛɛ Makkedahhen no dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ Jerichohen no.
Na Joshua, nye Israel nyinara ka no ho, twa mu fi Makkedah, kɔr Libnah, na wɔnye Libnah kɔkõe:
Na Ewuradze yii ɔno so, nye ne hen no, hyɛɛ Israel nsa; na ɔdze afõwa anomu bɔɔ no, nye akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara: Oenngyaa biara ma ɔaannka wɔ mu; na ɔyɛɛ ne hen no dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ Jerichohen no.
Na Joshua, nye Israel nyinara ka no ho, twaa mu fi Libnah, kɔr Lachish, na wɔkɛkyeer no do nsera, na wɔnye no kõe:
Na Ewuradze yii Lachish hyɛɛ Israel nsa, na ɔgyee no da a otsīa ebien no, na ɔdze afõwa anomu bɔɔ no, nye akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔdze yɛɛ Libnah no tse nyinara.
Nna Gezerhen Horam fowee bae bɔboaa Lachish; na Joshua kum ɔno nye ne man, dze kodur dɛ oenngyaa no biara ma ɔaannka.
Na Joshua, nye Israel nyinara ka no ho, twaa mu fi Lachish, kɔr Eglon; na wɔkyeer no do nsera, na wɔnye no kõe;
na wɔgyee no da no ara, na wɔdze afõwa anomu bɔɔ no, na akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara ɔsɛɛ hɔn pasapasa da no ara, dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔdze yɛɛ Lachish no tse nyinara.
Na Joshua, nye Israel nyinara ka no ho, fi Eglon fowee kɔr Hebron: Na wɔnye no kõe:
Na wɔgyee, na wɔdze afõwa anomu bɔɔ no, nye ne hen no, nye no nkurow no nyinara; oenngyaa biara ma ɔaannka, dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔdze yɛɛ Eglon no tse nyinara; na ɔsɛɛ no pasapasa, nye akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara.
Na Joshua, nye Israel nyinara ka no ho, sanee baa Debir; na wɔnye no kõe:

Na ɔgyee, nye ne hen no, nye no nkurow no nyinara; na wɔdze afõwa anomu bobɔɔ hɔn, na wɔsɛɛ akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara pasapasa; oenngyaa biara ma ɔaannka: Dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ Hebron no, dɛmara so na ɔyɛɛ Debir, nye ne hen; dɛ mbrɛ eso ɔyɛɛ Libnah, nye ne hen no.

Nna Joshua bɔɔ asaase no nyinara, nkokodo nkurow, nye pomu afamu, nye ɔbɔnmu nkurow, nye nkokonyiadze, nye hɔn ahemfo nyinara; oenngyaa biara ma ɔaannka: Mbom ɔsɛɛ dza ogu ahom nyinara pasapasa, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no hyɛe no.
Na Joshua bobɔɔ hɔn fi Kadesh-barnea araa kodur Gaza, nye Goshen ɔman no nyinara mu, araa kodur Gibeon.
Na ahemfo yi nyinara nye hɔn asaase no Joshua gyee no aber kor mu, osiandɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, kõe maa Israel.
Na Joshua, na Israel nyinara ka no ho, sanee baa nseraban no mu wɔ Gilgal.
11: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Hazorhen Jabin tsee no, ɔsomae ma wɔkɔr Madonhen Jobab, nhye Shimronhen, nye Achshaphhen nkyɛn,
nye ahemfo a wɔwɔ kwaamu afamu wɔ nkokodo nkurow no mu, nye Arabah Chinneroth no pomu afamu, nye ɔbɔnmu nkurow no mu, nye Dor akoko do wɔ anee afamu,
Canaanfo a wɔwɔ boka nye anee, nye Amorifo, nye Hittifo, nye Perizzfo, nye Jebusfo a wɔwɔ nkokodo nkurow mu, nye Hivifo a wɔwɔ Hermon ase wɔ Mizpah asaase do no nkyɛn.
Na hɔn nye hɔn dɔm nyinara ka hɔn ho, sii mu kɔree, nkurow oii, hɔn dodow tse dɛ mpoano anhwea, ɔnye mpɔnkɔ nye ntseaseanam piigyan.
Na ahemfo yi nyinara kehyiae; na wɔbaa bɛkyeer nsera fakor wɔ Merom nsu no ho, dɛ wɔnye Israel robɔkõ.
Na Ewuradze see Joshua dɛ, mma onnsian hɔn ntsi ma w'akoma nntu: Na ɔkyena siseber yi na mibeyi hɔn nyinara atɔfun mama wɔ Israel enyim: Twitwa hɔn mpɔnkɔ anantsir, na fa ogya hyew hɔn ntseatseanam.
Nna Joshua, nye nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no nyinara baa hɔn do awerɛfir mu, na wotui hyɛɛ hɔn do

Na Ewuradze yii hɔn hyɛɛ Israel nsa, na wokunkum hɔn, na wotsiiw hɔn araa dze kodur Zidon kɛse no, nye Misrepoth-maim ho, nye Mizpeh ɔbɔn mu boka afamu; na wokunkum hɔn kodur dɛ woenngyaa hɔn mu biara ma ɔaannka.
Na Joshua yɛɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ no no: Otwitwaa hɔn mpɔnkɔ anatsir, na ɔdze ogya hyeew hɔn ntseaseanam.
Na Joshua saan ekyir aber no ara mu, na ɔbɛgyee Hazor, na ɔdze afõwa kum ne hen no: Na nkan no na Hazor na ɔyɛ ahenmen no ne tsir.
Na wɔdze afõwa anomu kunkum akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara, sɛɛ hɔn pasapasa: Woenngyaa biara a ogu ahom wɔ hɔ: Na ɔdze gya hyeew Hazor,
Na ahemfo no hɔn nkurow nyinara, nye no mu ahemfo nyinara Joshua gyee, na ɔdze afõwa anomu kunkum hɔn, na ɔsee hɔn pasapasa; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'akowaa Moses hyɛe no.
Na nkurow a wɔdeda hɔn apempee do no dze, Israel annhyew no mu biara, gyedɛ Hazor nko; ɔno na Joshua hyeew no.
Na nkurow yi mu asadze nyinara, nye ofiembowa no, Israelmba no faa no afonam maa hɔnho, nyimpa biara dze, wɔdze afõwa anomu kum no. Dze kodur dɛ wɔsɛɛ hɔn, nkyii so woenngyaa obiara a ogu ahom.
Dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ n'akowaa Moses no, dɛmara so na Joshua yɛe; oenngyaa dza Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no nyinara mu biara a ɔannyɛ.
Nna Joshua gyee asaase no nyinara, nkokodo nkurow no, nye pomu afamu nyinara, nye Goshen asaase nyinara, nye ɔbɔnmu nkurow no, nye Arabah no, nye Israel nkokodo nkurow no;
ofi bepɔw Halak a ɔfow kɔ Seir ho, mekyerɛ Baal-gad ho wɔ Lebanon ɔbɔn a ɔwɔ bepɔw Hermon ase no; na ɔfaa hɔn ahemfo nyinara, na ɔbobɔɔ hɔn kunkum hɔn.
Joshua nye ahemfo no nyinara dzii akõkyɛree.
Kurow bi nnyi hɔ a ɔnye Israelmba siesiei, gyedɛ Hivifo a wɔtse Gibeon no: Wɔkõe gyee ne nyinara.
Osiandɛ ofir Ewuradze dɛ opiriim hɔn akoma dɛ wonkehyia Israel wɔ ɔkõ mu, ama ɔaasɛɛ hɔn pasapasa, woeennhu hɔn mbɔbɔr, na mbom ɔaasɛɛ hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
Na Joshua baa aber no mu, na obotwitwaa Anakfo no gui wɔ nkokodo nkurow no mu, wɔ Hebron, wɔ Debir, wɔ Anab, nye Judah nkokodo nkurow nyinara mu: Joshua dze hɔn kaa hɔn nkurow ho sɛɛ hɔn pasapasa,
Woenngyaa Anakfo no mu biara wɔ Israelmba asaase do: Gaza, Gath, nye Ashdod mu nko, na binom kae.

Nna Joshua gyee asaase no nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze kāa kyerɛɛ Moses no nyinara; na Joshua dze maa Israel dɛ egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nkyekyɛmu tsetsee. Na asaase no do dwee wɔ ɔkõ ho.
12: Afei woyinom nye asaase no do ahemfo a Israelmba no kunkum hɔn, na wɔfaa hɔn asaase wɔ Jordan egya a ɔdze kɔ wipuei no, ofi Arnon ɔbɔnmu dze kodu bepɔw Hermon ho, nye Arabah nyinara boka afamu no:
Amorifo hen Sihon a ɔtsenaa Hesbon, na odzii hen fi Aroer a ɔda Arnon ɔbɔn ano, nye kurow a ɔwɔ ɔbɔn no ne finimfin, nye Gilead ɔfã no araa dze kodu esutsen Jabbok ho, Ammonmba he no do
nye Arabah dze kodu Chineroth po no ho, mekyerɛ nkyen epo no ho, boka afamu, Beth-jeshimoth ɔkwan do; nye pomu afamu, wɔ Pisgah no nkokonyiadze ase no:
Nye Bashanhen Og a ofi Rephafo nkaa no mu a ɔtsenaa Ashtaroth nye Edrei no ne he do,
na odzii hen wɔ bepɔw Hermon do, nye Salecah, nye Bashan nyinara, dze kodu Geshurfo nye Heshbon hen Sihon he do.
Ewuradze n'akowa Moses nye Israelmba no kunkum hɔn: Na Ewuradze n'akowaa Moses dze maa Reubenfo, nye Gadfo, nye Manasseh ebusuakuw ɔfā no dɛ enyadze.

Na woyinom nye asaase no do ahemfo a Joshua nye Israelmba no kunkum hɔn wɔ Jordan egya anee afamu, ofi Baal-gad wɔ Lebanon ɔbɔn no araa dze kodu bepɔw Halak a ɔfow kɔ Seir ho no; na Joshua dze maa Israel ebusuakuw ebuasuakuw dɛ enyadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkyekyɛmu no tsetsee;
wɔ nkokodo nkurow mu, nye ɔbɔnmu nkurow mu, nye Arabah, nye nkokonyiadze, nye sar no mu, nye Pomu afamu; Hittifo, Amorifo, nye Canaanfo, Perizzfo, Hivifo, nye Jebusfo;
baako nye Jerichohen; baako nye Ai a ɔwɔ Beth-el ne nkyɛn hen;
baako nye Jerichohen; baako nye Hebronhen;
baako nye Jarmuthhen; baako nye Lachishhen;
baako nye Eglonhen, baako nye Gezerhen;
baako nye Debirhen; baako nye Gederhen
baako nye Hormahhen; baako nye Aradhen;
baako nye Libnahhen; baako nye Adullamhen
baako nye Makkedahhen; baako nye Bethelhen;
baako nye Tappuahhen; baako nye Hepherhen;
baako nye Aphekhen; baako nye Lassharonhen;
baako nye Madonhen; baako nye Hazorhen;
baako nye Shimronmeronhen; baako nye Achshaphhen;
baako nye Taanachhen; baako nye Megiddohen;
baako nye Kedeshhem; baako nye Jokneam a ɔwɔ Carmehhen;
baako nye Dor a ɔwɔ Dor koko do hen; baako nye Goiim a ɔwɔ Gilgal hen;
baako nye Tirzahhen; ahemfo no nyinara wɔyɛ eduasa biako.
13: Afei Joshua ayɛ akɔdaa na oedzi mfe ara yie; na Ewuradze see no dɛ, ayɛ akɔdaa na edzi mfe ara yie, na asaase a aka so dɛ wɔkɛfa no dɔɔ sõ dodow.
Asaase a aka no so nye yi: Philistiafo mbew no nyinara, nye Geshurfo nyinara;

ofi Sihor a ɔwɔ Egypt n'enyim araa dze kodu Ekron kwaamu afamu he do a wɔkan ka Canaanfo ho: Philistiafp ahemfo beenum no; Gazafo dze, nye Ashdodfo dze, nye Ashkelonfo dze, Gittifo dze, nye Ekronfo dze; nye Avvifo so.
Wɔ pomu afamu: Canaanfo asaase no nyinara nye Mearah a ɔyɛ Zidonfo dze no, dze kodu Ashek dze kodu Amorifo he do:
Nye Gebalfo asaase, nye Lebanon nyinara, dze kɔ wipuei, fi Baal-gad wɔ bepɔw Hermon ase dze rekɛhɛn Hamath:

Hɔn a wɔtse nkokodo nkurow no mu nyinara, ofi Lebanon ho dze kodu Misrephoth-maim, mekyerɛ Zidonfo nyinara; mubotu hɔn efi Israelmba enyim: Kyɛ ara na twe tonto kyɛ ma ɔnyɛ egyapadze mma Israel, dɛ mbrɛ mahyɛ wo yi.
Dɛm nsti afei kyɛ asaase yi ma ɔnyɛ egyapadze mma ebusuakuw akron no, na Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no.
Reubenfo nye Gadfo ka no ho nyaa hɔn egyapadze a Moses dze maa hɔn wɔ Jordan egya boka afamu no, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'akowaa Moses dze maa hɔn no ara pɛ;
ofi Aroer a ɔwɔ Arnon ɔbɔn ano, nye kurow no a ɔwɔ ɔbɔn no finimfin, nye Medeba tɛtɛr mu nyinara dze kodu Dibon;
na Amorifo hen Sihon a odzi hen wɔ Heshbon no, no nkurow no nyinara, dze kodu Ammonmba he do;
nye Gilead, nye Geshurfo nye Maacathfo he do, nye bepɔw Hermon nyinara, nye Bashan nyinara dze kodu Salecah;
Og a odzii hen wɔ Ashtaroth nye Edrei n'ahenman a ɔwɔ Bashan no nyinara (Ɔnoara na ɔkae wɔ Rephaim nkaa no mu); na woyinom na Moses kum hɔn, na otuu hɔn.
Naaso Israelmba enntu Geshurfo no, nye Maacathfo no so: Mbom Geshur nye Maacth tsenaa Israel mu, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Levi ebusuakuw no nko na ɔamma no egyapadze bi; Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, n'afɔrbɔdze a wɔdze ogya bɔ no na ɔyɛ n'egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ ɔkãa kyerɛɛ no no.
Na Moses dze maa Reubenmba ebusuakuw no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na hɔn he fi Aroer a ɔwɔ Arnon ɔbɔn no ano, nye kurow a ɔwɔ ɔbɔn no finimfin no, nye Medeba ho tɛtɛr mu no nyinara;
Heshbon, nye no nkurow a ɔwɔ tɛtɛr mu no nyinara; Dibon, nye Bamoth-baal, nye Beth-baal-meon;
nye Jahaz, nye Kedemoth, nye Mephaath;
nye Kiriathaim, nye Sibmah, nye Zereth-shabar wɔ ɔbɔn no mu bepɔw do;
nye Beth-peor, nye Pisgah, nye Beth-jeshimoth.

nye tɛtɛrmu nkurow no nyinara, nye Amorifo hen Sihon a odzii hen wɔ Heshbon no n'ahenman nyinara, ɔno na Moses dze no kaa Midian asafohemfo no ho kum hɔn no, Evi, nye Rekem, nye Zur, nye Hur, nye Reba, Sihon ne mbapɔmba a wɔtsenaa asaase no do no.
Balaam, Beor ne babanyim, ɔsebramunyi no so, Israelmba dze afõwa kum no foraa hɔn atɔfun nkaa no mu.
Na Reubenmba no hɔn he nye Jordan, nye ne he. Iyi nye Reubenmba no hɔn egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow no nye no nkurobaase.
Na Moses dze maa Gad ebusuakuw no, Gadmba no, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na hɔn he nye Jazer, nye Gilead nkurow no nyinara, na Ammonmba asaase no ne fã, dze kodu Aroer a ɔwɔ Rabbah enyim no;
na ofi Heshbon dze kodu Ramth-mizpeh nye Betonim; na ofi Mahanaim dze kodu Debir he do;
nye ɔbɔn no mu, Beth-haram, nye Beth-nimrah, nye Succoth, nye Zaphon, Heshbonhen Sihon n'ahenman nkaa no, Jordan nye ne he, dze kodu Chinnereth po no n'ano noho Jordan egya boka afamu.
Iyi nye Gadmba no hɔn egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow no nye no nkurɔbaase.
Na Moses dze egyapadze maa Manessah ebusuakuw fã no: Na ɔyɛɛ Manassehmba ebusuakuw fã no dze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na hɔn he fi Mahanaim, Bashan nyinara, Bashanhen Og n'ahenman nyinara, nye Jair no nkurow a ɔwɔ bashan nyinara, nkurow eduosia:
Na Gilead ne fã, nye Ashtaroth, nye Edrei, Og n'ahenman mu nkurow a ɔwɔ Bashan no ɔyɛɛ Manasseh ne babanyim Machirmba no hɔn fã no a, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Iyi nye egyapadze a Moses kyɛɛ no Moab tɛtɛr mu, Jericho Jordan egya boka afamu.
Na Levi ebusuakuw dze, Moses amma hɔn egyapadze bi: Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, nye hɔn egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn no.
14: Na iyi nye egyapadze a Israelmba nyaa no wɔ Canaan asaase do a ɔsɔfo Eleazer, nye Nun ne babanyin Joshua, nye egyanom efiefi etsitsir no a wɔyɛ Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw no kyekyɛe maa hɔn,
nam hɔn egyapadze ho tontotwe do, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze nam Moses nsa do hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa mma ebusuakuw akron, nye ebusuakuw fã no.
Osiandɛ Moses dze ebusuakuw ebien nye ebusuakuw fã no hɔn egyapadze ama wɔ Jordan egya: Na Levifo no dze ɔamma hɔn egyapadze bi wɔ hɔn mu.
Na Josephmba yɛ ebusuakuw ebien, Manasseh nye Ephraim: Na wɔammfa kyɛfa biara amma Levifo no wɔ asaase no do, gyedɛ nkurow a wɔtsena mu, ɔnye ne mfikyisaase a wɔdze ma hɔn ofiembowa nye hɔn ahodze.
Dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no, dɛmara so na Israelmba no yɛe, na wɔkyekyɛɛ asaase no mu.
Nna Judahmba twee piin Joshua wɔ Gilgal: Na Caleb, Jephunneh ne babanyin no Kenizznyi no see no dɛ, ɔwoara nyim asɛm a Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ Nyame nyimpa Moses wɔ mo ho nye wo ho wɔ Kadeshbarnea.
Aber a Ewuradze n'akowaa Moses somaa me fi Kadeshbarnea dɛ menkɛsera asaase no, nna medzi mfe eduanan; na medze asɛm sanee brɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔwɔ m'akoma mu.
Naaso mo nuanom a wɔnye me fowee kɔree no maa ɔman no hɔn akoma tui: Na emidze midzii Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn ekyir korakorakora.
Na Moses kãa ntam da no ara dɛ, ampaara asaase a w'anan etsia do no nyɛ wo mba egyapadze daa, osiandɛ edzi Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn ekyir korakorakora.
Na afei, hwɛ, Ewuradze ama matsena ase, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkãe no mfe eduanan enum yi kyerɛɛ Moses, aber a Israel nam sar no do no: Na afei, hwɛ, medzi mfe eduowɔtwe enum ndɛ da yi.
Ndɛ da yi ara mo ho da ho yɛ dzen dɛ mbrɛ metse wɔ da a Moses somaa me no: Nkan no mbrɛ m'ahoɔdzen tse ara nye no, dze ma ɔkõ, nye nkɔree nye mbae.

Dɛm ntsi afei fa bepɔw yi a Ewuradze kãa ho asɛm da no mu no ma me; na ɔwoara tsee no wɔ da no mu dɛ Anakfo wɔ hɔ, na nkurow a ɔyɛ akɛse na wɔagyegye ho ban: Annyɛ a Ewuradze bedzi m'ekyir ma meetu hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze kãe no.
Na Joshua hyiraa no, na ɔdze Hebron maa Caleb, Jephunneh ne babanyin no dɛ n'egyapadze.
Dɛm ntsi Hebron bɛyɛɛ Caleb, Jephunneh ne babanyim Kenizznyi no, n'egyapadze dze bodu ndɛ da yi; osiandɛ odzii Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no n'ekyir korakorakora.
Afei Hebron nkan no nkyɛ ne dzin nye Kiriath-arba; Arba no nye Anakfo mu nyimpa kɛse. Na asaase no do dwee wɔ ɔkõ ho.
15: Na Judahmba ebusuakuw kyɛfa, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee no, osi Edom he do, mekyerɛ Zin sar do pomu afamu, wɔ pomu afamu ekyir noho ara.
Na hɔn pomu afamu he no, ofi Nkyen Epo no n'ano noho ara, wɔ ɔdoɛɛ a obu fa pomu afamu noho:
Na ɔdze nam Akrabbim no mfowee mu pomu afamu, na otwa mu kɔ Zin, na ɔfow kɔ Kadesh-barnea no pomu afamu, na otwa mu wɔ Hezron ho, na ɔfow kɔ Addar, na ɔdan kɔ Karka:
Na otwa mu kɔ Azmon, na ɔdze pue Egypt ɔwoara no do; na ɔhe no n'edzifir wɔ po ho: Iyi nyɛ hom pomu afamu he.
Na boka afamu he nye nkyen epo no, mekyerɛ ɔdze kodu Jordan ewiei. Na kwaamu afamu he no ofi po no doɛɛ no ho wɔ Jordan ewiei:
Na ɔhe no fow kɔ Beth-hoglah, na ɔtwa mu fa Beth-arabah no kwaamu afamu; na ɔhe no fow kɔ Reuben ne babanyin Bohan ɔbo no ho:

Na ɔhe no fi Achor ɔbɔn mu fow kɔ Debir, na ɔdze no dɛmara kɔ kwaamu afamu, dze hwɛ Gilgal a ɔwɔ Adummim mfowee a ɔwɔ esutsen no no pomu afamu no tsentsendo no: Na ɔhe no twa mu kɔ En-shemesh nsu no ho, na n'edzifir wɔ En-rogel:

Na ɔhe no fow fa Hinnom ne babanyin ɔbon no mu dze kodu Jebusfo nkyɛnmu wɔ pomu afamu (Ɔnoara nye Jerusalem): Na ɔhe no fow kɔ bepɔw a ɔda Hinnom ɔbɔn no enyim anee afamu a ɔwɔ Rephaim ɔbɔn no n'ano noho ara wɔ kwaamu afamu n'etsifi:
Na ɔhe no hima fi bepɔw no etsifi kɔ Nephtah nsu no no nsunyiwa ho, na ɔfow kɔ Ephron bepɔw do nkurow no ho; na ɔhe no hima kɔ Baalah (Ɔnoara nye Kiriath-jearim):
Na ɔhe no dze dan fi Baalah anee afamu kɔ bepɔw Seir ho, na otwa mu kɔ bepɔw Jearim ne nkyɛnmu wɔ kwaamu afamu (Ɔnoara nye Chesalom), na osian kɔ Beth-shemesh, na otwa mu wɔ Timnah ho:
Na ɔhe no dze pue kɔ Ekron nkyɛnmu kwaamu afamu: Na ɔhe no hima kɔ Shikkeron, na otwa mu kɔ bepɔw Baalah ho, na ɔdze oue wɔ Jabneel; na ɔhe no n'edzifi wɔ po no ho.
Na anee afamu ɔhe no nye po kɛse no, nye ne he. Iyi nye Judahmba he a otwa hyia dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na ɔmaa Jephunneh ba Caleb kyɛfa wɔ Judahmba no mu, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze ne mbrasɛm a ɔdze maa Joshua no tse, mekyerɛ Kiriath-arba Arda no a ɔyɛ Anak n'egya no a (Ɔnoara nye Hebron).
Na Caleb tuu Anak ne mbabanyin baasa no fii hɔ, Sheshai, nye Ahiman, nye Talmai, Anakmba no.
Na ofi hɔ fowee kɔr Debir nkorɔfo do: Afei nkan no na Debir ne dzin nye Kiriath-Sepher.
Na Caleb see dɛ, Nyia ɔbɔbɔ Kiriath-sepher, na ɔagye no, ɔno na medze me babaa Achsah mrbɛma no ayewar.
Na Kenaz ne babanyin Othniel, Caleb no nua no, kɛgyee: Na ɔdze ne babaa Achsah maa no ayewar.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a ɔbaa ne nkyɛn no, onunuu no dɛ ombisa n'egya hɔ haban bi; na ofi n'asoaso do dwirii; na Caleb see no dɛ, ebɛnadze na erohwehwɛ?
Na ɔsee dɛ, ma me nhyira; na edze me esi Pomu afamu asaase do a, na ma me mbasu so. Na ɔdze etsifi mbasu nye anaafo mbasu no maa no.
Iyi nye Judahmba ebusuakuw no hɔn egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na Judahmba ebusuakuw no hɔn ano noho ara nkurow a odzi kɔ Edom he do wɔ Pomu afamu nye Kabzeel, nye Eder, nye Jagur,
nye Kinah, nye Dimonah, nye Adadah
nye Kedesh, nye hazor, nye Ithnan;
Ziph, nye Telem, nye Bealoth;
nye Hazor-hadattah, nye Kerioth-hezron (Ɔnoara nye Hazor):
Amam, nye Shema, nye Moladah;
nye Hazor-gaddah, nye Heshmon, nye Beth-pelet;
nye Hazor-shual, nye Beer-sheba, nye Biziothiah;
Baalah, nye Iim, nye Ezem;
nye Eltolad, nye Chesil, nye Hormah;
nye Ziklag, nye Madmannah, nye Sansannah;
nye Lebaoth, nye Shilhim, nye Ain, nye Rimmon: Nkurow no nyinara yɛ eduonu akron, ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Ɔbɔnmu nkurow no, Eshtaol, nye Zorah, nye Ashnah;
nye Zanoah, nye En-gannim, Tappuah, nye Enam;
Jarmuth, nye Adullam, Socoh, nye Azekah;
nye Shaaraim, nye Adithaim, nye Gederah, nye Gederothaim; nkurow duanan ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Zenan, nye Hadashah, nye Migdal-gad;
nye Dilan, nye Mispeh, nye Joktheel;
Lachish, nye Bozkath, nye Eglon;
nye Cabbon, nye Lahman, nye Chithlish;
nye Gederoth, Beth-dagon, nye Naamah; nye Makkedah; nkurow duesia ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Ekron, ɔnye no ho nkurow nye no nkurobaase;
ofi Ekron araa dze kodu po no ho, dza ɔwɔ Ashdod nkyɛnnu nyinara, ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Ashdod, no ho nkurow nye no nkurobaase; Gaza, no ho nkurow nye no nkurobaase; dze kodu Egypt ɔwora, nye po kɛse no, nye ne he ho.
Nye nkokodo nkurow no, Shamir, nye Jattir, nye Socoh;
Nye Dannah, nye Kiriath-sannah (Ɔnoara nye Debir):
nye Anab, nye Eshtemoh, nye Anim;
Nye Goshen, nye Holon, nye Giloh; nkurow dubiako ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Arab, nye Dumah, nye Eshan;
Nye Janom, nye Beth-tappuah, nye Aphekah;
Nye Humtah, nye Kiriath-arba (Ɔnoara nye Hebron), nye Zior; nkurow akron ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Maon, Carmel, nye Ziph, nye Jutah;
Nye Jezreel, nye Jokdeam, nye Zanoah;
Kain, Gibeah, nye Timnah; nkurow du ɔnye no nkurobaase
Halhul, Beth-zur, nye Gedor;
Nye Maarath, nye Beth-anoth, nye Eltekon; nkurow esia ɔnye no nkurobaase
Kiriath-baal (Ɔnoara nye Kiriath-jearim), nye Rabaah; nkurow ebien nye no nkurobaase.
Sar no do, Beth-arabah, Middin, nye Secacah;
nye Nibshan, nye Nkyen Kuorow no nye Engedi; nkurow esia ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Na Jebusfo no dze, nkorɔfo a wɔtse Jerusalem no, Judahmba enntum enntu hɔn: mbom Jebusfo no wɔnye Judahmba no tsenaa Jerusalem dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
16: Na Josephmba kyɛfa no ɔdze pue fi Jericho Jordan, wɔ Jericho nsu ho wɔ boka afamu, mekyerɛ sar no a ɔdze fi Jericho fow kodua nkokodo nkurow no mu kɔ Beth-el no;
na ɔdze pue fi Beth-el kɔ Luz, na ɔtwa mu kɔ Archifo he do wɔ Ataroth;
na osian anee afamu kɔ Japhletfo he do, dze kodu anaafo Beth-horon he do, mekyerɛ ɔdze kodu Gezer: Na n'edzifir wɔ po no ho.
Na Josephmba no, Manasseh nye Ephraim, wonyaa hɔn egyapadze.
Na Ephraimmba no hɔn he, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee no nye yi; mekyerɛ hɔn egyapadze ne he wɔ boka afamu nye Ataroth-addar, dze kodu etsifi Beth-horon;
na ɔhe no dze pue anee afamu wɔ Michmethath wɔ kwaamu afamu; na ɔhe no dze dan fa boka afamu kɔ Tanaath-shiloh, na otwa mu wɔ ho wɔ Janoah no boka afamu;
na ofi Janoah sian kɔ Ataroth, nye Naarah, na okodu Jericho, na ɔdze pue Jordan ho.
Ɔhe no fi Tappuah nam anee afamu dze kɔ Kanah ɔwora no ho; na n'edzifir wɔ po no ho. Iyi nye Ephraimmba ebusuakuw egyapadze, dɛ nbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee;
dze ka nkurow a woyiyii ma Ephraimmba no wɔ Manassehmba egyapadze mu no ho, nkurow no nyinara ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Na woenntu Canaannfo no tsenaa Ephraim finimfin dze bodu ndɛ da yi na wɔbɛyɛɛ asomfo a wɔyɛ ɔtowyi edwuma.
17: Na iyi nye Manasseh n'ebusuakuw kyɛfa: Osiandɛ ɔyɛ Joseph n'abakan. Manasseh n'abakan Machir, Gilead n'egya no, onyaa Gilead nye Bashan.

Na kyɛfa no yɛ Manassehmba nkaa no dze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee; ɔyɛ Abiezermba, nye Helekmba, nye Asrielmba, nye Shechemmba no dze: Woyinom nye Joseph babanyin Manasseh ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na Zelophehad, Hepher babanyim no, Manasseh babanyin no, oennya mbambanyin dɛ mbabaa no hɔn edzin, Mahlah, nye Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, nye Tirzah.

Na wɔbaa ɔsɔfo Eleazer enyim, nye Nun babanyin Joshua enyim, nye mbapɔmba no enyim, dɛ, Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses dɛ ɔmma hɛn egyapadze wɔ hɛn nuanom mu; dɛm ntsi ɔmaa hɔn egyapadze wɔ hɔn egya no nuanom no mu dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze ne mbrasɛm no tse.
Na nkyekyɛmu du kɔr Manasseh afamu, ɔsor Gilead nye Bashan asaase a ɔwɔ Jordan egya no;
osiandɛ Manasseh mbabaa no nyaa egyapadze wɔ ne mbabanyin no mu: Na Gilead asaase no yɛɛ Manasseh mbabanyin nkaa no dze.
Na Manasseh ne he ofi Asher kɔ Michmethath a ɔwɔ Shechem enyim no: Na ɔhe no dze nam enyimfa araa kodu Entappuahfo ehyiae.
Tappuah asaase no yɛ Manasseh dze; na Tappuah a ɔwɔ Manasseh dze he do no dze ɔyɛ Ephraimmba no dze.
Na ɔhe no sian kɔ Kanah ɔwora no ho, wɔ ɔwora no no pomu afamu: Nkurow yi yɛ Ephraim dze wɔ Manasseh no nkurow no mu: Na Manasseh ne he no ɔwɔ ɔwora no no kwaamu afamu, na n'edzifir wɔ po no ho:
Pomu afamu no Ephraim dze a, kwaamu afamu no Manasseh dze a, na po no nye ne he; na okehyia Asher wɔ kwaamu afamu.

Na Manasseh nyae wɔ Issachar nye Asher mu Beth-shean nye no ho nkurow, nye Ibleam nye no ho nkurow, nye hɔn a wɔtse Dor nye no ho nkurow, nye hɔn a wɔtse En-dor nye no ho nkurow, nye hɔn a wɔtse Megiddo nye no ho nkurow, mekyerɛ akoko ebiasa no.
Naaso Manassehmba enntum eentu hɔn a wɔtsetse nkurow no mu no; na Canaanfo no pɛɛ dɛ wɔtsena asaase no do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, Israelmba no ho yɛɛ dzen no, wɔdze Canaanfo no hyɛɛ ɔtowyi edwuma mu, na woenntu hɔn korakora.
Na Josephmba no kãa kyerɛɛ Joshua dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edze egyapadze kyɛfa kor nye nkyekyɛmu kor pɛ ama me, w'enyiwa tua dɛ meyɛ ɔman kɛse, susuampa dɛ Ewuradze ehyira me araa dze ebodu ber yi?
Na Joshua see hɔn dɛ, sɛ eyɛ ɔman kɛse a, fow kɔ kwaa no mu, na kobu hɔ fa ma woho wɔ Perizzfo nye Rephafo asaase no do; ofir dɛ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no moa dodow ma wo no ntsi.

Na Josephmba no see dɛ, nkokodo nkurow no nndɔɔ sõ mma hɛn; na Canaanfo a wɔtsetse ɔbɔn no n'asaase do nyinara wɔwowɔ dadze ntseaseanam, hɔn a wɔwɔ Beth-shean nye no ho nkurow nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Jezreel ɔbɔn no mu nyina.
Na Joshua kasaa kyerɛɛ Joseph fie, mekyerɛ Ephraim nye Manasseh, dɛ, ɔwo yɛ ɔman kɛse, na ewɔ tum kɛse; nnyɛ kyɛfa kor pɛ bi na ibenya:
Mbom nkokodo nkurow no nyɛ wodze; osiandɛ ibotu Canaanfo no, kaansa wɔwowɔ dadze ntseaseanam, na wɔyɛ dzen mpo a.
18: Na Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara poon hɔnho kehyiae wɔ Shiloh, na wosii ehyiadzibuw no wɔ hɔ: Na asaase no wɔberɛɛ no adze wɔ hɔn enyim.
Na ɔkaa Israelmba mu ebusuakuw esuon a wonnyae nnkyɛɛ hɔn egyapadze.
Na Joshua see Israelmba no dɛ, hom rotwetwe homho araa ma ekodu aber bɛn ana hom akɔ akɛfa asaase a Ewuradze, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn, dze ama hom no?
Hom ntutu hom mu nyimpa, ebusuakuw nyinara mu baasa: Na monsoma hɔn, ma wɔnsoɛr nkekyima asaase no mu, na wɔnkyerɛw no nwoma mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ hɔn egyapadze; na wɔmbra mo hɔ.
Na wɔnkyɛ mu kyɛpɛn esuon: Judah ntsena ne he do wɔ kwaamu afamu.
Na hom nkyerɛw asaase no kyɛpɛn esuon, na hom mfa nkyerɛwee no mbrɛ me ha: Na montwe ho tonto mma hom wɔ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn enyim ha.

Na Levifo no nnyi kyɛpɛn wɔ hom mu; osiandɛ Ewuradze asɔfodzi no nye hɔn egyapadze: Na Gad nye Reuben nye Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no enya hɔn egyapadze wɔ Jordan egya boka afamu a Ewuradze n'akowaa Moses dze maa hɔn no.

Na mbarimba no soɛree, na wɔkɔree: Na Joshua hyɛɛ hɔn a wɔrokɔ akɛkyerɛw asaase no mu, Hom nkɔ nkekyima asaase no mu, na wɔnkyerɛw, na wɔnsan mbra mo hɔ bio, na montwe ho tonto mma hom wɔ Ewuradze enyim ha wɔ Shiloh.
Na mbarimba no kɔree koduaduaa asaase no mu, na wɔkyerɛw no dɛ dɛ mbrɛ nkurow no tsetsee kyɛpɛn esuon wɔ nwoma mu, na wɔbaa Joshua hɔ wɔ nsera mu wɔ Shiloh.
Na Joshua twee ho tonto maa hɔn wɔ Shiloh wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Na hɔ na Joshua kyɛɛ asaase no maa Israelmba no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkyekyɛmu tsetsee.
Na Benjaminmba ebusuakuw kyɛfa no baa dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Na hɔn kyɛfa ne he fir edzi wɔ Judahmba nye Josephmba ntamu.
Na hɔn he wɔ kwaamu afamu, na ɔfow kodu nkokodo nkurow no mu wɔ anee afamu; na n'edzifir wɔ Beth-aven sar do.
Na ɔhe no twa mu fi hɔ kɔ Luz, wɔ Luz ne nkyɛnmu (Ɔnoara nye Beth-el), pomu afamu; na ɔhe no dze sian kɔ Atarothaddar, wɔ bepɔw a ɔda anaafo Beth-horon no pomu afamu.

Na ɔhe no hima na ɔdze dan kɔ anee afamu pomu afamu, dze fi bepɔw a ɔda Beth-horon enyim wɔ pomu afamu: Na n'edzifir wɔ Kiriath-baal (Ɔnoara nye Kiriath-jearim), Judahmba kurow bi: anee afamu dze nye yi.
Na pomu afamu dze ofi Kiriath-jearim n'ano noho ara, na ɔhe no fir edzi wɔ anee afamu, na ɔdze fir kɔ Nephtoah nsu no no nsunyiwa ho:

Na ɔhe no sian kɔ bepɔw a ɔda Hinnom babanyin ɔbɔn no a ɔwɔ Rephafo ɔbɔn no no kwaamu afamu no n'enyim no n'ano noho ara: Na osian kɔ Hinnom ɔbɔn mu, wɔ Jebusfo nkyɛnmu pomu afamu, na osian kɔ En-rogel;
na ohima kɔ kwaamu afamu, na opue wɔ En-shemesh, na ofir edzi kɔ Geliloth a ɔwɔ Adummim mfowee ne tsentsendo; na osian kɔ Reuben babanyin Bohan ɔbo no no ho;
na otwa mu kesi nkyɛnmu wɔ Arabah tsentsendo kwaamu afamu; na osian kodu Arabah:
na ɔne no twa mu kɔ Beth-hoglah nkyɛnmu kwaamu afamu; na ɔhe no n'edzifir wɔ Nkyen Epo no no kwaamu afamu ewiei: Iyi nye pomu afamu he.
Na Jordan nye ne he wɔ boka afamu. Iyi nye Benjaminmba egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ n'ahe tsetsee dze hyia, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Afei Benjaminmba ebusuakuw nkurow dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee no nye Jericho, nye Beth-hoglah, nye Emek-keziz;
nye Beth-arabah, nye Zemaraim, nye Beth-el;
nye Avvim, nye Parah; nye Ophrah;
nye Chephar-ammoni, nye Ophni, nye Geba; nkurow duebien ɔnye no nkurobasaa:
Gibeon, nye Ramah, nye Beeroth;
nye Mizpeh, nye Chephirah, nye Mozah;
nye Rekem, nye Irpeel, nye Taralah;
nye Zelah, Eleph, nye Jebus (Ɔnoara nye Jerusalem), Gibeath, nye Kiriath; nkurow duanan ɔnye no nkurobaase. Iyi nye Benjaminmba no egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
19: Na kyɛfa a otsīa ebien no bae maa Simeon, mekyerɛ Simoenmba ebusuakuw no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Nye hɔn egyapadze wɔ Judahmba egyapadze no mu.
Na dza wonyae yɛɛ hɔn egyapadze nye Beer-sheba, anaadɛ Sheba, nye Moladah;
nye Hazarshual, nye Bethul, nye Ezem;
nye Eltolad, nye Bethul, nye Hormah;
nye Ziklag, nye Beth-marcaboth, nye Hazar-susah;
nye Beth-le-baoth, nye Sharuhen; nkurow duebiasa ɔnye no nkurobaase:
Ain, Rimmon, nye Ether, nye Ashan; nkurow anan ɔnye no nkurobaaase:
Nye nkurowba a ɔdeda nkurow yi ho hyia nyinara dze kodu Baalath-beer, Pomu afamu Ramah. Iyi nye Simeonmba ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Judahmba afamu dze no mu na Simeonmba egyapadze fi: Osiandɛ Judahmba kyɛpɛn no dɔɔ sõ dodow ma hɔn; dɛm ntsi Simeonmba nyaa egyapadze wɔ hɔn egyapadze no mu.
Na kyɛfa a otsīa ebiasa no bae maa Zebelunmba dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyapadze ne he okodu Sarid:
Na hɔn he fow kɔ anee afamu, mekyerɛ Maralah, na okodu Dabbesheth; na okodu ɔwora no a ɔwɔ Jokneam enyim no;
na ɔdze dan fi Sarid boka afamu wɔ wipuei afamu dze kodu Chisloth-tabor he do: Na ofir edzi kɔ Daberath, na ɔfow kɔ Japhia;
na hɔ na ofi kotwa mu wɔ boka afamu dze kɔ Gath-hepher dze kɔ Eth-kazin; na ofir edzi wɔ Rimmon a ɔtsen dze kɔ Neah;
na ɔhe no dan fa ho wɔ kwaamu afamu dze kɔ Hannathon: Na n'edzifir wɔ Iphtah-el ɔbɔn no mu;
nye Kattath, nye Nahalal, nye Shimron, nye Idalah, nye Beth-lehem: Nkurow duebien nye no nkurobaase.
Iyi nye Zebulunmba egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow yi ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Kyɛfa a otsīa anan no bae maa Issachar, mekyerɛ Issacharmba no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na hɔn he okodu Jezreel, nye Chesulloth, nye Shunem;
nye Hapharaim, nye Shion, nye Anaharath;
nye Rabbith, nye Kishion, nye Ebez;
nye Remeth, nye Beth-pazzez;
na ɔhe no dze kodu Tabor, nye Shahazumah, nye Beth-shemesh; nye hɔn he a n'edzifir wɔ Jordan; nkurow duesia ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Iyi nye Issacharmba ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow no ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Na kyɛfa a otsīa enum no bae maa Ashermba ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na hɔn he nye Helkath, nye Hali, nye Beten, nye Achshaph;
nye Allammelech, nye Amad, nye Mishal; na ɔdze kodu Carmel anee afamu, nye Shihor-Iibnath;
na ɔdze dan wipuei afamu kɔ Beth-dagon na okodu Zebulun, nye Iphtah-el ɔbɔn mu wɔ kwaamu afamu dze kɔ Beth-emek nye Neiel; na ofir edzi kɔ Cabul wɔ abankum afamu,
nye Ebron, nye Rehob, nye Hammon, nye Kanah, mekyerɛ ɔdze kɔ Zidon kɛse;
na ɔhe no dan kɔ Ramah, na okodu Tyre kurow a wɔagye ho ban no; na ɔhe no dan kɔ Hosah; na n'edzifir wɔ Achzib mbew ho po no ho:
Ummah so, nye Aphek, nye Rehob: Nkurow eduonu ebien ɔnye no nkurobaase,
Iyi nye Ashermba ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow yi ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Kyɛfa a otsīa esia no bae maa Naphtalimba, mekyerɛ Naphtalimba no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na hɔn he fi Zaanannim esudur no ho, nye Adami-nekeb, nye Jabneel, dze kɔ Lakkum; na n'edzifir wɔ Jordan
na ɔhe no dan fa anee afamu kɔ Aznoth-tabor, na ɔdze fi hɔ pue Hukkok; na okodu Zebulun wɔ pomu afamu, na okodu Asher wɔ anee afamu, na okodu Judah wɔ Jordan wipuei afamu.
Na nkurow a wɔagye ho ban no nye Ziddim, Zer, nye Hammah, Rakkath, nye Chinnereth;
nye Adamah, nye Ramah, nye Hazor;
nye Kedesh, nye Edrei, nye En-hazor;
nye Iron, nye Migdal-el, Horem, nye Beth-anath, nye Beth-shemesh; nkurow duakrom ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Iyi nye Naphtalimba ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow no ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Kyɛfa a otsīa esuon no bae maa Danmba ebusuakuw dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na hɔn egyapadze he nye Zorah, nye Eshtaol, nye Ir-shemesh;
nye Shaalabbin, nye Aijalon, nye Ithlah;
nye Elɔn, nye Timnah, nye Ekron;
nye Eltekeh, nye Gibbenthon, nye Baalath;
nye Jehud, nye Bene-berak, nye Gath-rimmon;
nye Me-jarkon, nye Rakkon, ɔnye ɔhe no a ɔwɔ Joppa tsentsendo no.

Na Danmba ɔhe no fir edzi tra hɔn: Osiandɛ Danmba no fowee kɔree nye Leshem kɔkõe, na wɔgyee, na wɔdze afõwa anomu bɔɔ no, na wɔfae, na wɔtsenaa mu, na wɔfrɛɛ Leshem dɛ Dan, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egya Dan ne dzin tse.
Iyi nye Danmba ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow yi ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Nna wowiee asaase no kyɛ dze yɛɛ egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ n'ahe no tsetse; na Israelmba no dze egyapadze bi maa Nun ne babanyin Joshua wɔ hɔn mu:
Dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze mbrasɛm tse no na wɔdze kurow a obisae no maa no, mekyerɛ Timnath-serah wɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu: Na ɔkyekyeer kurow no, na ɔtsenaa mu.

Iyi nye egyapadze a ɔsɔfo Eleazer, nye Nun ne babanyin Joshua, nye Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu egyanom efiefi etsitsir no, nam tontotwe do kyɛe no wɔ Shiloh wɔ Ewuradze enyim, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano. Nna wowiee asaase no kyɛ.
20: Na Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ Joshua dɛ.
Kã kyerɛ Israelmba no dɛ, hom nyiyi guansumabew nkurow a menam Moses nsa do mekãa kyerɛɛ hom no:
Ma onyimpakumfo a oboku nyimpa bi ntɔgon mu nye awerɛfir mu no nguan nkɔ hɔ: Na ɔnye hom guansumabew mfi bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinnyi no nsa.
Na onguan nkɔ nkurow no kor mu, na onkegyina kurow no n'abotsen ano, na ɔnkã n'asɛm wɔ kurow no ne mpanyimfo asomu; na wɔmfa no nkɔ hɔn nkyɛn wɔ kurow no mu, na wɔmma no beebi, ma ɔntsena hɔn mu
Na sɛ bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no tsiw ba a, ɔno mma wonnyi onyimpakumfo no nnhyɛ ne nsa; osiandɛ okum ne nyɛnko awerɛfir mu, na ɔnntan no dada bi.
Na ɔntsena kurow no mu, nkodu dɛ obegyina mboanofo no enyim agye atsɛmbu, nkodu dɛ ɔsɔfopanyin a ɔwɔ do nda no mu no no wu: na nkyii onyimpakumfo no nsan mbra nankasa no kurow a ofi mu guanee no mu.
Na woyiyii Kadesh wɔ Galilee wɔ Naphtali nkokodo nkurow no mu, nye Shechem wɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu, nye Kiriath-arba (Ɔnoara nye Hebron) wɔ Judah nkokodo nkurow no mu.
Na Jericho Jordan egya boka afamu no, woyii Bezer wɔ sar no do wɔ tɛtɛr no mu fii Reuben ebusuakuw mu, nye Ramoth wɔ Gilead fi Gad ebusuakuw mu, nye Golan wɔ Bashan fii Manasseh ebusuakuw mu.

Iyinom nye nkurow a woyiyii sisii hɔ maa Israelmba nyinara, nye ɔhɔho a ɔabɔsoɛ hɔn mu no, dɛ obiara a oku nyimpa bi ntɔgon mu no nguan nkɔ hɔ, na oeennwu wɔ bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no nsamu, nkodu dɛ obegyina mboanofo no enyim.
21: Nna Levifo egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir no twee piin ɔsɔfo Eleazer, nye nun ne babanyin Joshua, nye Israelmba ebusuakuw mu egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir no;
na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn wɔ Shiloh wɔ Canaan asaase do, dɛ, Ewuradze nam Moses nsa do hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmma hɛn nkurow ma yɛntsena mu, ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase mma hɛn ofiembowa.
Na Israelmba no dze hɔn egyapadze no mu nkurow yi ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase maa Levifo no, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze mbrasɛm no tse.
Na kyɛfa no bae maa Kohathfo ebusua ebusua na ɔsɔfo Aaronmba no a wofi Levifo mu no, nam tontotwe do nyaa Judah ebusuakuw mu, nye Simeon ebusuakuw mu, nye Benjamin ebusuakuw mu, nkurow duebiasa.
Na Kohathmba nkaa no nam tontotwe do nyaa Ephraim ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu, nye Dan ebusuakuw mu, nye Manasseh ebusuakuw fã nomu, nkurow du.
Na Gershonmba no nam tontotwe do nyaa Issachar ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu, nye Asher ebusuakuw mu, nye Naphtali ebusuakuw fã no a wɔ Bashan mu, nkurow duebiasa.
Merarimba dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee nyaa Reuben ebusuakuw mu, nye Gad ebusuakuw mu, nye Zebulun ebusuakuw mu, nkurow duebien.
Na Israelmba no nam tontotwe do dze nkurow yi ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase maa Levifo no dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze nam Moses nsa do hyɛe no.
Na wɔdze Judahmba ebusuakuw mu, nye Simeonmba ebusuakuw mu, nkurow a wɔabobɔ edzin yi mae:
Na ɔwɔ hɔ ma Aaronmba a wofi Kohath ebusua ebusua mu a wɔwɔ Levimba mu no: Na hɔndze nye kyɛfa a odzi kan no.
Na wɔdze Kiriath-arba maa hɔn, Arba no a ɔyɛ Anak n'egya no, (Ɔnoara nye Hebron), wɔ Judah nkokodo nkurow no mu, ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase a etwa ho ehyia no.
Na kurow no ho haban, nye no nkurobaase no dze, wɔdze maa Jephunneh babanyin Caleb dɛ n'enyadze
Na ɔsɔfo Aaronmba no, wɔdze onyimpakumfo guansumabew kurow, Hebron ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase maa hɔn, nye Libnah ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase;
na Jattir ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, nye Eshtemoa ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase;
nye Holon ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, nye Debir ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase;
nye Ain ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, nye Juttah ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, nye Beth-shemesh ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase; ebusuakuw ebien no mu nkurow akron.
Nye Benjamin ebusuakuw mu dze, Gibeon ɔnye ne mfikyisaase, Geba ɔnye ne mfikyisaase.
Anathoth ɔnye ne mfikyisaase, nye Almon ɔnye ne mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
Aaronmba, asɔfo no, hɔn nkurow nyinara yɛ nkurow duebiasa ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase.
Na Kohathmba, Levifo no, ebusua ebusua no, mekyerɛ Kohathmba nkaa no, wonyaa hɔn kyɛfa nkurow fi Ephraim ebusuakuw mu.
Na wɔdze onyimpakumfo guansumabew kurow Shechem ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase wɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu maa hɔn, nye Gezer ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase;
nye Kibzaim ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, nye Beth-horon ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
Na Dan ebusuakuw mu dze, Elteke ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, Gibethon ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase.
Aijalon ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, Gath-rimmon ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
Na Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no mu dze, Taanach ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, nye Gath-rimmon ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase; nkurow ebien.
Nkurow a ɔyɛ Kohathmba nkaa no hɔn ebusua ebusua no dze nyinara ɔyɛ du ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase.

Na Gershonmba a wofi Levi ebusua ebusua no mu no, wɔmaa hɔn Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no mu onyimpakumfo guansumabew kurow Golan wɔ Bashan ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase; nye Be-eshterah ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase; nkurow ebien.
Na Issachar ebusuakuw mu dze, Kishion ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, Daberath ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase;
Jarmuth ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, En-gannim ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
Na Aber ebusuakuw mu dze, Mishal ɔnye ne mfikyisaase, Abdon ɔnye ne mfikyisaase;
Helkath ɔnye ne mfikyisaase nye Rehob ɔnye ne mfikyisaase, nkurow anan.
Na Naphtali ebusuakuw mu dze, onyimpakumfo guansumabew kurow Kedesh wɔ Galilee, ɔnye ne mfikyisaase, nye Hammoth-dor ɔnye ne mfikyisaase, nye Kartan ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase; nkurow ebiasa.
Gershonfo nkurow nyinara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee ɔyɛ nkurow duebiasa ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase.
Na Merarimba ebusua ebusua, Levifo nkaa no, wɔmaa hɔn Zebulun ebusuakuw mu, Jokneam ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, nye Kartah ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase.
Dimnah ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, Nahalal ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
Na Reuben ebusuakuw mu dze, Bezer ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, nye Jahar ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase,
Kedemoth ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, nye Mephaath ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
Na Gad ebusuakuw mu dze, onyimpakumfo guansumabew kurow Ramoth wɔ Gilead ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, nye Mahanaim ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase;
Heshbon ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, Jazer ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase; ne nyinara nkurow anan.
Iyi nyinara nye Merarimba nkurow dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, mekyerɛ Levifo ebusua ebusua nkaa no: Na hɔn kyɛfa yɛ nkurow duebien.
Levifo nkurow a ɔwɔ Israelmba hɔn enyadze mu nyinara yɛ nkurow eduanan awɔtwe ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase.
Nkurow yi nyinara wowɔ mfikyisaase a abobɔ ho aprɔw: Nkurow yi nyinara mbrɛ ɔtsetsee ara nye no.
Nna Ewuradze dze asaase a ɔkãa ho ntam dɛ ɔdze bɛma hom egyanom no nyinara maa Isreal; na wɔfae, na wɔtsenaa do.
Na Ewuradze maa hɔn ahomgye hyiae, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkãa ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom no nyinara: Na hɔn atamfo nyinara mu obiara enngyina hɔn enyim; Ewuradze yii hɔn atamfo nyinara hyɛɛ hɔn nsa.
Asɛm pa biara a Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ Israel ofi no mu biribiara anntɔ famu: Ne nyinara baa mu.
22: Nna Joshua frɛɛ Reubenfo, nye Gadfo, nye Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ. Hom edzi dza Ewuradze n'akowaa Moses dze hyɛɛ hom no nyinara do, na hom etsie me ndze wɔ dza mehyɛɛ hom nyinara mu:
Hom nndaan hom nuanom nngyaa hɔ nda pii yi dze bodu ndɛ da yi, mbom hom edzi Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn ne mbrasɛm ahwɛdodze no do.

Na afei Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn dze ahomgye ama hom nuanom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn no: Dɛm ntsi afei hom ndzi ndan, na hom nkɔ hom asesee mu wɔ hom enyadze asaase a Ewuradze n'akowaa Moses dze maa hom wɔ Jordan egya no.

Yie nko ara na hom nhwɛ ndzi mbrasɛm nye mbra no a Ewuradze n'akowaa Moses dze hyɛɛ hom, dɛ hom ndɔ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn, na wɔnnantsew n'akwan nyinara mu, na wondzi ne mbransɛm nyinara do, na wɔntakyer no ho, na wɔmfa hom akoma nyinara nye hom kra nyinara nsom no.
Nna Joshua hyiraa hɔn, na ogyaa hɔn kwan: Na wosii mu kɔr hɔn asesee mu.

Afei Manasseh ebusuakuw fã kor no nna Moses ama hɔn egyapadze wɔ Bashan: Na ɔfã kor no so Joshua maa hɔn bi wɔ hɔn nuanom mu wɔ Jordan egya anee afamu. Nkyii so aber a Joshua rigya hɔn kwan ma wɔaakɔ hɔn asesee mu no, ohyiraa hɔn,
na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, ahonyadze pii na hom mfa nsan nkɔ hom asesee mu, na ɔnye dwetɛ, na ɔnye sika, na ɔnye boran, na ɔnye dadze, na ɔnye ntar piigyan; hom nye hom nuanom nkyɛ hom atamfo asadze.

Na Reubenmba ɔnye Gadmba nye Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no sanee, na wofi Israelmba no nkyɛn wɔ Shiloh a ɔwɔ Canaan asaase do sii mu kɔree, dɛ wɔrokɔ Gilead asaase do, wɔ hɔn enyadze asaase a woekenya no do, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze mbrasɛm a ɔnam Moses nsa do no tse no.
Na aber a wodur Jordan ho mbew a ɔwɔ Canaan asaase do no do no, Reubenmba nye Gadmba nye Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no sii hɔ afɔrmbukyia wɔ Jordan ho, afɔrmbukyia a wɔhwɛ a ɔsõ a.

Na Israelmba no tsee dɛ wɔdɛ, hwɛ, Reubenmba nye Gadmba nye Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no esi afɔrmbukyia wɔ Canaan asaase enyim tsentsendo, wɔ Jordan ho mbew no do, wɔ afã a ɔyɛ Israelmba afamu dze no do.
Na aber a Israelmba no tsee no, Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara poon hɔnho hyiae wɔ Shiloh, dɛ wontu hɔn do sa.
Na Israelmba no somaa ɔsɔfo Eleazer babanyin Phinebas ma ɔkɔr Reubenmba, nye Gadmba, nye Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no hɔ, wɔ Gilead asaase do;
na mbapɔmba du ka no ho, Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu egya fie ɔbapɔmba kor; na hɔn nyinara yɛ egyanom efiefi do etsitsir wɔ Israel mpempem no mu.
Na wɔbaa Reubenmba, nye Gadmba, nye Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no nkyɛn, nye Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no nkyɛn, wɔ Gilead asaase do, na wɔnye hɔn kasaa dɛ,

mbrɛ Ewuradze mboanofo nyina se nye yi, eben mfom na hom dze afom Israel Nyankopɔn yi, dɛ ndɛ da yi hom adan efi Ewuradze ekyir dzi, wɔ dɛ hom esi afɔrmbukyia ama homho, dze retsew Ewuradze do etūa ndɛ da yi?
Ana Peor emumuyɛ no a kaansa ɔhaw baa Ewuradze no mboanofo do mpo a, ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi ara hɛn ho nntsew wɔ mu no suar, dodoodow ma hɛn,
ma ndɛ da yi hom dan fi Ewuradze ekyir dzi yi? Na ɔbɛba dɛ ofir dɛ hom retsew Ewuradze do etūa ndɛ da yi ntsi, ɔkyena no bo bofuw Israel mboanofo no nyina.

Naaso sɛ hom enyadze asaase no ho nntsew a, ɔno hom ntwa mbra Ewuradze enyadze asaase a Ewuradze ntamadan si do no do, na wɔmbɛfa bi wɔ hɛn mu: Na mbom mma hom nntsew etūa wɔ hɛn do so, dɛ homara so risi afɔrmbukyia aka Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn n'afɔrmbukyia no ho.
Ana nnyɛ Achan, Zerah babanyin no, na ɔfoom wɔ adze a wɔadom no no mu, na ebufuw baa Israel mboanofo no nyinara do no bi? Na ɔbarimba no ankotoo ennwu wɔ n'emumuyɛ no mu.
Nna Reubenmba nye Gadmba nye Manasseh ebusuakuw fã no buae, na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Israel mpempem mu etsitsir no dɛ,
Ewuradze, enyame mu Onyame no, Ewuradze, enyame mu Onyame no, ɔnoara na onyim, na Israel ɔnoo so obohu; sɛ ɔyɛ etuatsew mu o, (mma ɔwo nngye hɛn nkwa ndɛ da yi),
dɛ yeesi afɔrmbukyia ama hɛnho dɛ yɛdze bɛdan efi Ewuradze ekyir dzi, anaadɛ yɛbɔbɔ do ɔhyewafɔr anaa edziban-afɔr, anaa yɛbɔbɔ do asomdwee okum-afɔr a, Ewuradze noara nnhwehwɛ;
na sɛ mbon nnyɛ ahwɛyie bi ntsi, na asɛm bi ntsi na yɛayɛ iyi a, dɛ, daakyɛ bi hom mba bɛkã akyerɛ hɛn mba dɛ, ebɛnadze na hom nye Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn wɔ yɛ?
Na Ewuradze dze Jordan ayɛ ɔhe ato hɛn nye hom, Reubenmba nye Gadmba ntamu; hom nnyi kyɛfa wɔ Ewuradze mu; dɛma na hom mba bɛyɛ hɛn mba ma woeegyaa Ewuradze suro.
Dɛm ntsi na yɛsee dɛ, wɔmma afei yensiesie hɛnho nsi afɔrmbukyia mma hɛnho, nnyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr, na nnyɛ okumafɔr so nstsi;

na mbom dɛ ɔnyɛ dase wɔ hɛn nye hom ntamu, nye hɛn mbasantsen a wobedzi hɛn ekyir no atamu, na yɛdze hɛn ɔhyew-afɔr, na ɔnye hɛn okum-afɔr, nye hɛn asomdwee afɔr, ayɛ Ewuradze edwuma no wɔ n'enyim; mma daakye bi hom mba annse hɛn mba dɛ, hom nnyi kyɛfa wɔ Ewuradze mu.

Dɛm ntsi na yɛsee dɛ, ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ daakye bi wɔse hɛn anaa hɛn mbasantsen dɛm a, yɛbɛse dɛ, hom nhwɛ Ewuradze afɔrmbukyia no ne saso a hɛn egyanom yɛe, nnyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr ntsi, na nnyɛ okum-afɔr so ntsi; mbom ɔyɛ dase wɔ hɛn nye hom ntamu.

Nyame mpa ngu dɛ yɛbɛtsɛw etūa wɔ Ewuradze dɔ, na yɛadan efi Ewuradze ekyir dzi ndɛ da yi, dɛ yebesi afɔrmbukyia abɔ do ɔhyew-afɔr, edziban-afɔr, anaa okum-afɔr, aka Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn afɔrmbukyia a ɔwɔ ne ntamadan no enyim no ho.
Na aber a ɔsɔfo Phinehas, nye mboanofo no mu mbapɔmba no, mekyerɛ mpempem mu etsitsir a wɔka no ho no, tsee nsɛm a Reubenmba nye Gadmba nye Manassehmba no kãe no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn enyisɔ dɛ.

Na ɔsɔfo Eleazer ne babanyin Phinehas see Reubenmba nye Gadmba, nye Manassehmba no dɛ, ndɛ da yi na yeehu dɛ Ewuradze wɔ hom finimfin, osiandɛ hom mmfa mfom yi mmfoom Ewuradze; afei na hom eyi Israelmba no efi Ewuradze nsamu.
Na ɔsɔfo Eleazer ne babanyin Phinehas, nye mbapɔmba no, sanee fi Reubenmba, nye Gadmba no nkyɛn wɔ Gilead asaase do, baa Canaan asaase do, Israelmba no nkyɛn, na wɔbɔbɔɔ hɔn amandzɛɛ.
Na asɛm no yɛɛ Israelmba enyisɔ; na Israel hyiraa Nyankopɔn, na wɔannkã bio dɛ wo rutu hɔn do sa, wɔakɛsɛɛ asaase a Reubenmba nye Gadmba tse do no.
Na Reubenmba nye Gadmba frɛɛ afɔrmbukyia no Ed: Na, wɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ hɛn ntamu dase dɛ Ewuradze nye Nyankopɔn.
23: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda pii n'ekyir no, aber a Ewuradze maa Israel ahomgye wɔ hɔn atamfo a woetwa hɔn ho ehyia nyinara nsamu no, na Joshua ayɛ akɔdaa na oedzi mfe pii no;
nna Joshua kɛfrɛɛ Israel nyinara, hɔn mpanyimfo nyɛ hɔn etsitsir, nye hɔn atsɛmbuafo nyɛ hɔn ahwɛdofo, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, mayɛ akɔdaa na medzi mfe pii;
na hom ehu dza osian hom ntsi Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn dze ayɛ amanaman yi nyinara; na Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn no, ɔnoara na ɔakõ ama hom.

Hom nhwɛ, medze tontotwe makyɛ amanaman a wɔaka yi mu mama hom, dɛ ɔnyɛ egyapadze mma hom ebusuakuw, ofi Jordan ho, ɔnye amanaman a metwitwa hɔn egu nyinara, mekyerɛ ɔdze kodu po kɛse no ho ɔdze kɔ witɔree no.
Na Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn, ɔno na obosunsun hɔn efi hom enyim, na oetu hɔn efi hom enyi do; na hom afa hɔn asaase dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn kãa kyerɛɛ hom no.
Dɛm nsti hom nnya akokodur papaara dɛ wɔbɔhwɛ na wɔayɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses mbra nwoma no mu nyinara, dɛ hom nndan mmfi ho nkɔ enyimfa anaa abankum;
dɛ hom nnkɔ amanaman yi a wɔakeka hom mu yi mu; nkyii so mma hom mmbɔ hɔn enyame dzin, na wɔmma wɔmmfa hɔn nndzi nsew so, nkyii so wɔnnsom hɔn, na wɔmmbobɔ hom mu adze mma hɔn so:
Mbom hom ntakyer Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn ho, dɛmbrɛ hom ayɛ ebodu ndɛ da yi.
Na Ewuradze etu amanaman akɛse a wɔyɛ dzen efi hom enyim: Na homdze, nyimoa bi nngyinaa hom enyim dze ebodu ndɛ da yi.
Hom mu nyimpa baako betsiw apem: na Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn no, ɔnoara na ɔkõ ma hom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hom.
Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie papaara, dɛ hom bɔdo Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Ɔnodze sɛ hom nam ɔkwan biara do san ekyir, na wɔdze homho kɛbata amanaman nkaa yi ho, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔakeka hom mu yi ho, na wɔnye hɔn dzi awarwar, na hom kɔ hɔn nkyɛn, na hɔn so ba hom nkyɛn a:

Ɔnodze hom nhu ara ampa dɛ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn rennda ho nntu amanaman yi mmfi hom enyi do; mbom wɔbɛyɛ efir nye apafir ama hom, nye mpire wɔ hom mfemu, na nsoɛ wɔ hom enyiwa mu, ekodu dɛ hom bɛsɛɛ efi asaase pa yi a Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn dze ama hom yi do.

Na, hwɛ ndɛ da yi morokɔ asaase nyinara kwan no: Na hom nyim wɔ hom akoma nyinara mu nye hom akra nyinara mu dɛ asɛm kor nntɔ famu wɔ asɛm pa a Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn kãe wɔ hom ho no nyinara mu; ne nyinara aba mu ama hom, no mu asɛm kor nntɔ famu.

Na ɔbeba dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ nsɛm pa nyinara a Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn kãa kyerɛɛhom no aba hom do no, dɛmara so na Ewuradze dze nsɛm bɔn nyinara bɛba hom do, ekodu dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ hom efi asaase pa yi a Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn dze ama hom yi do.

Sɛ hom tū Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn ahyɛmu a ɔdze hyɛɛ hom no, na hom kɔ kɔsom enyame fofor na hom bɔ hom mu adze ma hɔn a; ɔno Ewuradze n'ebufuw bɛdzɛw hom do, na hom asɛɛ ntsɛm efi asaase pa no a ɔdze ama hom no do.
24: Na Joshua poon Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara hyiaa Shechem, na ɔkɛfrɛɛ Israel mpanyimfo, nye hɔn etsitsir, nye hɔn ntsɛmbuafo, nye hɔn ahwɛdofo no; na wokeyii hɔnho kyerɛe wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.

Na Joshua see ɔman no nyinara dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, esu no n'egya na tsetseberdo no hom egyanom tsenae, mekyerɛ Terah, Abraham n'egya no, nye Nahor n'egya no: Na wɔsoom enyame bi.
Na miyii hom egya Abraham fii esu no n'egya na migyaa no faa Canaan asaase nyinara mu, na memaa n'asefo dɔree, na medze Isaac memaa no.
Na medze Jacob nye Esau memaa Isaac: Na medze bepɔw Seir memaa Esau, dɛ ɔmfa; na Jacob nye ne mba no sianee kɔr Egypt.
Na mosomaa Moses nye Aaron, na mehaw Egypt, dɛ mbrɛ dza meyɛe no wɔ mu no tse no: Na n; ekyir no miyii hom puei.
Na miyii hom egyanom fii Egypt: Na hom baa po no ho: Na Egyptfo dze ntseaseanam, na ɔnye mpɔnkɔdofo tsiiw hom egyanom baa Epo Memen no ho.
Na aber a wɔkekaa mu frɛɛ Ewuradze no, ɔdze sum hyɛɛ hom nye Egyptfo no ntamu, na ɔdze po no baa hɔn do bɛkataa hɔn do; na hom enyiwa hun dza meyɛe no wɔ Egypt na hom tsenaa sar no do nda pii.
Na medze hom mebaa Amorifo a wɔtse Jordan egya no asaase do; na wɔnye hom kãe: Na medze hɔn mehyɛɛ hom nsa, na hom faa hɔn asaase no fae; na mesɛɛ hɔn wɔ hom enyim.
Nna Zippor babanyin, Moabhen no, soɛree nye Israel kõe; na ɔsomae ma wokehyiaa Beor babanyin Balaam dɛ ɔmbɛpaa hom:
Na mammpɛ dɛ mibetsie Balaam; dɛm ntsi nhyira ara na ohyiraa hom: Nna miyii hom fii ne nsamu.
Na hom twaa Jordan, na wɔbaa Jericho: Na Jericho mbarimba nye hom kõe, Amorifo, nye Perizzfo nye Canaanfo, nye Hittifo, nye Jebusfo; na miyii hɔn mehyɛɛ hom nsa.
Na mosomaa nkotokrodo ma wodzii hom enyim, ma wɔpaam hɔn fii hom ehyim, mekyerɛ Amorifo ahemfo beenu no; nnyɛ w'afõwa a, nnyɛ w'egyen so a.
Na memaa hom asaase a ɔwoara annyɛ do edwuma, nye nkurow a nnyɛ hom bi kyekyeree, na hom tse mu; wenyin nture nye ngodua nture a ɔnnyɛ hom bi tsetsɛwee na hom dzi yi.
Dɛm ntsi afei hom nsuro Ewuradze, na wɔnsom no turododo nye nokwar mu: Na hom ntow enyame a hom egyanom somee wɔ esu no n'egya, nye Egypt no egu; na hom nsom Ewuradze.

Na sɛ ɔyɛ hom enyi do dɛ omuo dɛ hom bɔsom Ewuradze a, ɔno ndɛ da yi hom nsan mu nyi nyia hom bɔsom no; sɛ enyame a hom egyanom somee a wɔwɔ esu no n'egya no o, Amorifo a hom tse hɔn asasse do yi enyame o; na emi nye me fi dze, yɛbɔsom Ewuradze.
Na ɔman no buae na wɔsee dɛ, Nyame mpa ngu dɛ yɛbɔpow Ewuradze, akɔsom enyame bi;

na Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn ɔnoara nye nyia oyii hɛn nye hɛn egyanom wɔ Egypt asaase do, wɔ nkowaasom fi no mu, na ɔyɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze akɛse no wɔ hɛn enyiwa mu, na osiee hɛn wɔ ɔkwan a yɛnam mu no nyinara mu, nye aman a yetwaa mu wɔ hɔn mu no nyinara mu:
Na Ewuradze paam aman no nyinara wɔ hɛn enyim Amorifo a wɔtse asaase no do no mpo: Dɛm nsti hɛn so yɛbɔsom Ewuradze; na ɔno nye hɛn Nyankopɔn.
Na Joshua see ɔman no dɛ, hom runntum nnsom Ewuradze; osiandɛ ɔyɛ Nyame krɔnkrɔn; ɔyɛ Nyame nyinkufo; ɔremmfa hom mbrato nye hom bɔn so mmfir.
Sɛ hom pow Ewuradze, na wɔsom enyame ananaben a, ɔno ɔayɛ hom papa n'ekyir no, ɔbɛdan ayɛ hom bɔn, na ɔahyew hom.
Na ɔman no see Joshua dɛ, dabida; Ewuradze ara na yɛbɔsom no.
Na Joshua see ɔman no dɛ, homara nye hom ho adasefo dɛ hom ho adasefo dɛ hom asan mu afa Ewuradze dɛ hom bɔsom no. Na wɔsee dɛ, yɛyɛ adasefo.
Dɛm ntsi, ɔsee dɛ, afei hom ntow enyame ananaben a wɔwɔ hom mu no ngu, na hom ndan hom akoma mma Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn na yɛbɔsom no, na ne ndze na yebetsie.
Nna Joshua nye ɔman no dzii ahyɛmu da no ara na ɔdze ahyɛdze nye ɔmon hyɛɛ hɔn wɔ Shechem.
Na Joshua kyerɛɛw nsɛm yi wɔ Nyankopɔn ne mbra nwoma no mu: Na ɔfaa ɔbo kɛsɛ, na ɔdze sii hɔ wɔ esudur a osi Ewuradze no krɔnkrɔn bea no ho no ase.
Na Joshua see ɔman no nyinara dɛ, wɔnhwɛ o, ɔbo yi bɛyɛ hɛn ɔdasefo: Osiandɛ ɔatse Ewuradze ne nsɛm a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɛn no nyinara: Dɛm ntsi ɔnye hom ɔdasefo, amma hom ammpow hom Nyankopɔn.
Nna Joshua gyaa ɔman no kwan, ma nyimpa biara kɔr n'egyapadze ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom ekyir no. Joshua Nun ne babanyin no, Ewuradze n'akowaa no, wui, nna oedzi mfe ɔha du.
Na wosiee no wɔ n'egyapadze he do wɔ Timnathserah a ɔwɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow mu no wɔ bepɔw Gaash no kwaamu afamu.
Na Israel soom Ewuradze Joshua ne nda nyinara, nye mpanyimfo a Joshua wui gyaa hɔn, na wohum Ewuradze n'edwuma nyinara a ɔyɛe maa Israel no, hɔn nda nyinara.

Na Joseph mbiew a Israelmba dze fi Egypt bae no wosiee no wɔ Shechem, wɔ asaasetɔw a Jacob tɔɔ no wɔ Shechem n'egya Hamor ne mbabanyin no hɔ maa ndwetɛbona ɔha no mu: Na ɔbɛyɛɛ Josophmba no egyapadze.
Na Aaron ne babanyin Eleazer wui; na wosiee no wɔ ne babanyin Phinehas koko a wɔdze maa no wɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow mu no do.

1: Jude, Jesus Christ akoma, nye James nua, dze kɛma hɔn a wɔafrɛ hɔn, Nyankopɔn Egya mu adɔfo, na wɔakora hɔn ama Jesus Christ:
Mbɔbɔrhu nye asomdwee nye dɔ ndɔɔ sõ mma hom.
Adɔfo, morobɔ mbɔdzen nyina dze no ho asɛm abrɛ hom no, ohiaa me dɛ mekyerɛw hom botu hom fo dɛ hom ndzi aper enyiberdo mma gyedzi a wɔdze maa ahotsewfo no prɛko pɛr no.
Na nyimpa bi aweawea hɔnho abɛhyɛ mu a wofi tsetse dze hɔn esi hɔ ama dɛm atsɛmbu yi, emumuyɛfo a woesi hɛn Nyankopɔn adom no tsir adze bɔ ehuhubra, na wɔpa hɛn Wura kortoo nye Ewuardze Jesus Christ.
Na mepɛ dɛ mobɔ hom a hom nyim yi prɛko dada yi nkaa, dɛ Ewuradze gyee ɔman no fii Egypt asaase do no ekyir no ɔsɛɛ hɔn a wɔanngye enndzi no.
Na abɔfo a wɔannkora hɔnara hɔn mpanyindzi, na wɔdaan hɔnankasa hɔn tsenabea gyea no, ɔdze hɔn egu daa nkurufi mu wɔ sum mu ama da kɛse n'atsɛmbu no.
Dɛ Sodom nye Gomorrah nye nkurow a ɔdeda hɔn ho a wɔyɛɛ dɛ iyinom dze hɔnho maa adwamansɛm kedzii anana honam ekyir no, wɔdze hɔn esi hɔ dɛ asɛndahɔ ama ogya a onndum da ntsēa.
Naaso dɛmara na iyinom so hɔn adaaso mu wogu honam ho fi, na wommbu tumdzi hwee, na wɔyeyaw etumfo.
Naaso ɔbɔfopanyin Micheal nye abɔsam dzii esi kasakasa wɔ Moses fun ho no, oennsi no bo dɛ ɔyaw no bu no atsɛn, na mbom ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze nkã w'enyim.
Na iyinom dze wɔkã dza wofi abɔsu mu nyim no, dɛ mbowa a wonnyi adwen, iyinom mu na wɔsɛɛ hɔnho.
Wondue! Osiandɛ wɔfaa Cain kwan do, na wɔatow hɔnho akyen wɔ Balaam mfom mu wɔ akatua ntsi, na wɔahera wɔ Korah etuatsew mu.

Iyinom na wɔyɛ hom dɔ-edzidzi mu nkekaa, wɔnye hom dzidzi, nguanhwɛfo a wonnsuro adze dɛ wɔnyɛn hɔnho, nsuwusiw a nsu nnyi mu a mframa dze hɔn kyinkyin, ɔhyewber ndua a wonnyi aba a woewu mprɛnu, eso hɔn ndwow etutu;
po asorɛkye gyakagyaka a wohur hɔnara a wɔdze sum kebikebi esie ama hɔn daa.
Iyinom na Enoch a fi Adam no tsia esuon no hyɛɛ nkɔm kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, hwɛ, Ewuardze dze no krɔnkrɔmfo pedu reba,
ebobu hɔn nyina atsɛn, na oeyi emumuyɛfo nyina atsɛn wɔ hɔn emumuyɛdze a wɔyɛɛ nyina, nye nsɛm a ɔyɛ dzen a ndzɛbɔnyɛfo emumuyɛfo kãe dze tsiaa no nyina ho.
Iyinom yɛ! hwinhwimfo, ndzebɔfo a wodzi hɔn akɔndɔ ekyir (na hɔn ano kã ekromposɛm), na mfaso ntsi wɔhwɛ nyimpa enyim.
Na homdze, adɔfo, hom nkaa nsɛm a hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ asomafo kãe too hɔ no:
Mbrɛ wɔkãa kyerɛɛ hom dɛ, ber a odzi ekyir no mu atwertwesifo bɛba a wɔbɛnantsew hɔnara hɔn emumuyɛ akɔndɔ ekyir.
Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔdze mpaapaamu ba, honam ekyirdzifo a wonnyi Sunsum no.
Na homdze, adɔfo, hom mfa homho nsi hom gyedzi krɔnkrɔn no do nyɛ asɔr wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu;
hom nsie homho wɔ Nyankopɔn dɔ mu, ntweɔn Ewuardze Jesus Christ mbɔbɔrhu nkɔ onnyiewiei nkwa mu.
Na binom a wɔyɛ anyanyan, hom nhu hɔn mbɔbɔr;
