na binom so hom ngye hɔn nkwa, nhwim hɔn mfi gya mu; na binom so hom nkyir atar a honam nkekaa akã mu mpo.
Na afei nyia obotum akora hom ma hom eemmfintsiw, na ɔdze hom esi n'enyimnyam enyim dɛ hom nndzi dzɛm wɔ enyigye mbordo mu,
Nyankopɔn kortoo hɛn Agyenkwa, ɔnam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ do nna enyimnyam, ahendzi, ahoɔdzen nye tumdzi nkã no, ansaana mber reba, sesei, nye mbersantsen nyina.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Joshua no wu ekyir no, Israelmba bisaa Ewuradze dɛ, woana na ondzi kan ntu nkɔ Canaanfo do nye hon nkɔko mma hɛn?
Na Ewuradze see dɛ. Judah ntu nkɔ: Hwɛ medze asaase no mahyɛ ne nsa.
Na Judah see no nua Simeon dɛ, enye me nkɔ me kyɛfa mu, ma yɛnye Canaanfo nkɔkõ: Na mo so menye wo bɔkɔ wo kyɛfa mu. Nna Simeon nye no kɔree.
Na Judah tui kɔree: Na Ewuradze dze Canaanfo nye Perizzfo no hyɛɛ hɔn nsa: Na wokum hɔn mu nyimpa mpem du wɔ Bezek.
Na wohun Adoni-bezek wɔ Bezek: Na wɔnye no kõe, na wokum Canaanfo nye Perizzfo no.
Na Adonibezek guanee; na wotsiiw no, na wɔkyeer no, na wotwitwaa ne nsa-kokrobetsir na n’anansoba-ko-konyin.

Na Adonibezek see dɛ ahemfo eduosuon a hɔn nsa-kokro­betsir na hɔn anansɔba-kokonyin etwitwa no tasetasee hɔn edziban wɔ mo pon ase: Dɛ mbrɛ meyɛe no, dɛmara so na Nyankopɔn ahyɛ me ananmu. Na wɔdze no baa Jerusalem, na hɔ na owui.
Na Judahmba no nye Jerusalem kõe, na wɔgyee, na wɔdze afõwa anomu bɔɔ no, ma wɔtoo kurow no gya.
Na n’ekyir no Judahmba no kɔree kɛnyee Canaanfo a wɔtse nkokodo nkurow mu, na pomu afamu, na ɔbɔnmu nkurow mu no kõe.
Na Judab kɔr Canaanfo a wɔtse Hebron no do: (Afei Hebron nkyɛ nkan no ne dzin nye Kiriath-arba): Na wɔbɔɔ Sheshai, na Ahiman, na Talmai.
Na hɔ na ofi kɔr Debirfo do. (Afei Debir nkyɛ nkan no ne dzin nye Kiriath-sepher).
Na Caleb see dɛ, nyia ɔbɔbɔ Kiriath-sepher, na ɔbɛgye no. Medze me babaa Achsah mebɛma no ayewar.
Na Caleb no nua kuma Kenaz ne babanyin Othniel kɛgyee; na ɔdze ne babaa Achsah maa no ayewar.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔkɔr ne nkyɛn no, onunuu no dɛ ombisa n’egya hɔ haban bi: Na ofi n'asoaso do dwirii na Caleb see no dɛ. Erohwehwɛ ebɛn?
Na ɔsee no dɛ, ma me nhyira; na edze me esi pomu afamu asaase do a, ma me mbasu so ɛ. Na Caleb dze etsifi mbasu na anaafo mbasu maa no.
Na Moses n’akontangya, Keninyi no ne mba no nye Judahmba fi nkyiresua kurow no mu fowee kɔr Judah sar a ɔwɔ Arad pomu afamu no do; na wɔkɔree kɛnyee ɔman no tsenae.
Na Judah nye no nua Simeon kɔree, na wokokum Canaanfo a wɔtse Zephath no, na wɔsɛɛ no pasapasa. Na wɔfrɛɛ kurow no ne dzin Hormah.
Eso Judah kɛgyee Gaza nye ne he, na Ashkelon nye ne he, na Ekron nye ne he.
Na Ewuradze dzii Judah n’ekyir; na otuu nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ nkokodo nkurow mu no; na hɔn a wɔwɔ ɔbɔn no mu no dze, oenntum enntu hɔn, osiandɛ wɔwɔ dadze ntseaseanam.
Na wɔdze Hebron maa Caleb, dɛ mbrɛ Moses kãe no: Na otuu Anak mbabanyin baasa no fii hɔ.
Na Benjaminmba no enntu Jebusfo a wɔtse Jerusalem no: Mbom Jebusfo no nye Benjaminmba no tsenaa Jerusalem araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na Joseph fi no, hɔn so wɔfowee kor Beth-el do: Na Ewuradze dzii hɔn ekyir.
Na Joseph fi no somae ma wɔkɛseraa Beth-el. (Afei kurow no nkyɛ nkan no ne dzin nye Luz).
Na aserafo no hun ɔbarimba bi a ofi kurow no mu epue, na wɔsee no dɛ, yɛserɛ wo, kyerɛ hɛn kurow no mu kwan, na yɛnye wo bedzi no yie.
Na ɔkyerɛɛ hɔn kurow no mu kwan, na wɔdze afõwa anomu bɔɔ kurow no: Na ɔbarimba no na n'ebusuafo nyinara dze, wogyaa hɔn.
Na ɔbarimba no kɔr Hittifo asaase do, na ɔkɛkyekyeer kurow, na ɔtoo no dzin Luz: Ɔno nye ne dzin araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi.

Na Manasseh enntu nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ Beth-shean na no nkurobaase, na Taanach a wɔwɔ Dor na no nkurobaase, na hɔn a wɔwɔ Ibleam na no nkurobaase, na hɔn a wɔwɔ Megiddo na no nkurobaase: Na Canaanfo no dze, wɔpɛɛ dɛ wɔtsena asaase no do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Israel hɔn ho yɛɛ dzen no, wɔdze Canaanfo no hyɛɛ ɔtowyi edwuma mu, na woenntu hɔn korakora.
Na Ephraim enntu Canaanfo a wɔtse Gezer no; na Canaanfo no tsenaa hɔn mu wɔ Gezer.
Zebulun enntu Kitronfo, na Nahalolfo no so: Na Canaanfo no tsenaa hɔn mu na wɔbɛyɛɛ ɔman a woyi tow.
Asher enntu hɔn a wɔtsetse Acco, anaa hɔn a wɔtsetse Zidon, na Ahlab, na Achzib, na Helbah, na Aphik, na Rehob:
Na Asherfo no tsenaa Canaanfo no mu, asaase no do atsefo no a: Osiandɛ woenntu hɔn.

Naphtali enntu hɔn a wɔtsetse Beth-shemesh, anaa hɔn a wɔtsetse Beth-anath no; mbom ɔtsenaa Canaanfo no mu, asaase no do atsefo no a: Naaso hɔn a wɔtsetse Beth-shemesh na Beth-anath no beyee oman a woyi tow maa hon.
Na Amorifo no kaa Danmba no kɔr nkokodo nkurow no mu: Na wɔammpɛ dɛ wɔma hɔn kwan ma wosian ba ɔbɔn no mu:
Na Amorifo no pɛɛ dɛ wɔtsena bepɔw Heres do wɔ Aijalon, na Shaalbim: Naaso Joseph fi no ne nsa daa hɔn do, ma wɔbɛyɛɛ ɔman a woyi tow.
Na Amorifo he no fi Akrabbim mfowee, ofi ɔbotan no ho, ɔdze kɔ enyim no ho.
2: Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe fi Gilgal baa Bochim. Na ɔsee dɛ, mara na memaa hom fi Egypt firii na medze hom maba asaase a mekãa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hom egyanom no do, na mesee dɛ, moronntõ menye hom ntamu ahyɛmu no dabiarada:
Na mma hom nnye asaase yi do atsefo no nndzi ahyɛmu: Hom mbubu hon afɔrmbukyia no: Na hom enntsie me ndze: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom ayɛ iyi?
Dɛm ntsi na mo so mesee dɛ, murunntu hɔn mmfi hom enyim; mbom wɔbɛyɛ dɛ nsoɛ wɔ hom mfemu, na hon enyame ayɛ efir ama hom.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, aber a Ewuradze no bɔfoe no kãa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Israelmba no nyinara no, ɔman no maa hɔn ndze do na wosūi.
Na wɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Bochim: Na wɔbɔɔ okum-afɔr wɔ hɔ maa Ewuradze.
Afei aber a Joshua gyaa ɔman no kwan no, Israelmba mu nyimpa biara kɔr n’egyapadze do dɛ ɔrekɛfa asaase no.
Na ɔman no soom Ewuradze Joshua ne nda nyinara, na mpanyimfo a Joshua wui gyaa hɔn no a wohun ndwuma akɛse nyinara a Ewuradze yɛe maa Israel no hɔn nda nyinara.
Na Joshua Nun ne babanyin no, Ewuradze n’akowaa no wui, nna oedzi mfe ɔha du.
Na wokesiee no wɔ n’egyapadze he do wɔ Timnath-heres, wɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow mu, wɔ bepɔw Gaash no kwaamu afamu.
Na eso wɔboaboaa ebusuasantsen no nyinara ano kɛkaa egyanom ho: Na ebusuasantsen kor so soɛree dzii hɔn ekyir a wonnyim Ewuradze, na dwuma a odzii maa Israel no.
Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, na wɔsoom Baalim:

Na wɔpoow Ewuradze, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no a oyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do no, na wokedzii enyame fofor a wofi aman a wɔabɔ hɔn ho aprɔw no hɔn enyame no mu ekyir, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze maa hɔn, na woyii Ewuradze ebufuw.
Na wɔpoow Ewuradze, na wɔsoom Baal na Ashtaroth.
Na Ewuradze n’ebufuw dzɛɛw Israel do, na oyii hɔn hyɛɛ afowfo a wɔfoow hɔn nsa, na otɔɔn hɔn dze hyɛɛ hɔn atamfo a wɔabɔ hɔn ho aprɔw no nsa, ma woenntum enngyina hɔn atamfo enyira bio.
Beebiara a wopuei kɔree no, Ewuradze ne nsa nye hɔn dzii no bɔn, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze kae no, na dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze kãa ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn no: Na hɔn ho hiahiaa hɔn papaara.
Na Ewuradze maa atsɛmbuafo do, ma wɔgyee hɔn nkwa fii hɔn a wɔfoow hɔn no nsamu.

Naaso woenntsie hɔn atsɛmbuafo no, na wodzii enyame fofor ekyir ndwamanyɛ mu, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze maa hɔn: Ntsɛmara na wɔdanee fii ɔkwan a hɔn egyanom nantseew do tsiee Ewuradze mbransɛm no do; hɔndze wɔannyɛ dɛm.

Na sɛ Ewuradze ma atsɛmbuafo do ma hɔn a, nna Ewuradze edzi ɔtsɛmbuafo no ekyir, na ɔagye hɔn efi hɔn atamfo no nsamu wɔ otsɛmbuafo no ne nda nyinara mu: Na osian hɔn apensi a ɔnam hɔn a wɔhaaw hɔn na woyii hɔn ahomtsew do no ntsi ɔyɛɛ Ewuradze yaw.

Na ɔbaa dɛ sɛ ɔtsɛmbuafo no wu a, wɔdan san ekyir, na wɔsɛɛ sen hɔn egyanom, dɛ wokedzi enyame fofor ekyir som hɔn, na wɔbɔ hɔn mu adze ma hɔn; woenngyaa hɔn ndzeyɛɛ no, na woemmfi hɔn akɔnkye kwan do so.
Na Ewuradze n’ebufuw dzɛɛw wɔ Israel do; na ɔsee dɛ, osiandɛ ɔman yi atõ m’ahyɛmu a mehyɛɛ hɔn egyanom, na woenntsie me ndze no;
emi so ɔdzekɔr yi murunntu aman aman a Joshua wui daan hɔn gyae no mu biara:
Ma medze hɔn asɔ Israel ahwɛ, kyerɛ dɛ wɔbɔhwɛ Ewuradze no kwan no anantsew do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom hwɛe no, anaa oho.
Nna Ewuradze gyaa amanaman no, ɔammpɛ ntsɛm enntu hɔn; nkyii so oennyi hɔn annhyɛ Joshua ne nsa.
3: Afei iyinom nye amanaman a Ewuradze gyae dɛ ɔdze hɔn rosɔ Israel ahwɛ no, mekyerɛ dodow a wonnyim Canaan akodzi no nyinara no;
gyama mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma Israelmba ebusuasantsen no ehu, na wɔakyerɛ hɔn akodzi, mekyerɛ dodow a nkyɛ nkan no a wonnyim ho hwee no a;
hɔn nye Philistiafo ahemfo beenum no, na Canaanfo nyinara, na Zidonfo, na Hivifo a wɔtse bepɔw Lebanon do, ofi bepɔw Baal-hermon ho araa dze kodu Hamath ahɛnee.
Na wɔwɔ hɔ dɛ wɔdze hɔn rosɔ Israel ahwɛ, ehu kyerɛ dɛ wobetsie Ewuradze mbransɛm a ɔnam Moses ne nsa do dze hyɛɛ hɔn egyanom no anaa.
Na Israelmba no tsenaa Canaanfo, Hittifo, na Amorifo, na Perizzfo, na Hivifo, na Jebusfo no mu:
Na wɔfefaa hɔn mbabaa warwaar hɔn, na wɔdze hɔnankasa hɔn mbabaa memaa hɔn mbabanyin awar, na wɔsoom hɔn enyame no.
Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do, na hɔn werɛ fiir Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn, na wɔkɔsoom Baalim na Asheroth.
Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze n’ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ Israel do, na ɔtɔɔn hɔn dze hyɛɛ Mesopotamiahen Cushan-rishathaim nsa: Na Israelmba no soom Cushan-risba- thaim mfe awɔtwe.
Na aber a Israelmba no sūi frɛɛ Ewuradze no. Ewuradze maa ɔgyefo bi do maa Israelmba no, ma ɔgyee hɔn nkwa, mekyerɛ Othniel, Caleb no nua kuma Kenaz ne babanyin no a.
Na Ewuradze no sunsum baa no do, na obuu Israel atsɛn; na otuu sa na Ewuradze dze Mesopotamiahen Cushan-rishathaim hyɛɛ ne nsa: Na ne nsa daa Cushanrishathaim do.
Na asaase no dodwee araa mfe eduanan. Na Othniel Kenaz ne babanyin no wui.
Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dza omuo bio wɔ Ewuradze enyi do: Na Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moabhen Eglon dzen wɔ Israel do, osiandɛ wɔyɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do.
Na ɔboaboaa Ammon na Amalekmba ano wɔ ne nkyɛn; na ɔkɔree kokum Israel, na wɔkɛgyee nkyiresua kurow no.
Na Israelmba no soom Moabhen Eglon mfe duawɔtwe.
Na aber a Israelmba no sūi frɛɛ Ewuradze no, Ewuradze maa ɔgyefo bi do maa hɔn, Ehud Gera babanyin, Benjaminnyi, nyimpa ɔbankumnyi no a: Na Israelmba no dze akyɛdze nam no do kɛmaa Moabhen Eglon.
Na Ehud yɛɛ afõwa anofanu a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa; na ɔdze bɔɔ n’atar ase wɔ no ndwonku enyimfa do.
Na ɔdze akyɛdze no maa Moabhen Eglon; afei Eglon yɛ nyimpa bran paara.
Na aber a owiee dɛ ɔdze akyɛdze no ma no, ogyaa nkorɔfo a wɔsoasoaa ahyɛdze no kwan ma wɔkɔree.
Na ɔno noara dze ɔdanee fi abopuei a ɔwɔ Gilgal nkyɛn no ho sanee kɛsee dɛ, ɔhen, mowɔ esumasɛm bi mekã mekyerɛ wo. Na ɔsee dɛ, Wɔnyɛ komm. Na hɔn a wogyina ne nkyɛn nyinara wofii ne nkyɛn puei.
Na Ehud baa ne nkyɛn; na ɔno noara nkotonoo na ɔtse n’abansor mframadan mu. Na Ehud see dɛ, mowɔ amandzɛɛ bi fi Nyame hɔ mobɔ wo. Na ɔsoɛree fii n’egua do.
Na Ehud tseen ne nsa bankum, na ɔdze yii afowa no wɔ no ndwonku enyimfa no do, na ɔdze wɔɔ ne yafun mu:
Na afõwadua no so dzii dadze no ekyir kɔr mu; na seradze kataa dadze no do, na ɔanntwe afõwa no wɔ ne yafun mu; na opuei fiir ekyir.
Nna Ehud puei kɔr abrandaa no do, na ɔtotoow abansor dan mbobow no mu wɔ n’ekyir, na ɔtotoow ndaagow no mu.
Afei aber a opuei kɔree no, no nkowaa no bae; na wobohunii, na, hwɛ, abansor dan no no mbobow no wɔatotow mu ndaagow; na wɔsee dɛ, ampa ɔregye n’anan wɔ mframa-dan pia no mu.
Na wɔtweɔnee araa dze kodur dɛ hɔn enyi bui: Na, hwɛ, oemmbue abansor dan no no mbobow no; dɛm ntsi wɔfaa saafee no, na wɔdze buebuei: Na, hwɛ, hɔn wura ewu da famu.
Na Ehud guanee mber a wɔrotweɔn no, na otwaa mu wɔ abopuei no n’egya, na oguanee kɔr Seirah.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a odurii no, ɔhɛɛn totorobɛnto wɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu, na Israelmba no nye no fi nkokodo nkurow no mu sianee, na odzii hɔn enyim.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mbedzi m’ekyir: Na Ewuradze dze hom atamfo Moabfo ahyɛ hom nsa. Na wosianee kedzii n’ekyir, na wɔkɛgyee Jordan etwaree a wɔdze kɔ Moab no, na wɔamma nyimpa biara kwan ma oenntwa.
Na aber no mu wokum Moab mu mbarimba bɛyɛ mpemdu, mbarimba akɛse na mbarimba ahoodzenfo nyina; na ɔbarimba biara emmfi nsa.
Nna wɔbrɛɛ Moab adze da noara wɔ Israelmba nsa adze. Na asaase no do dwee araa mfe eduowɔtwe.
Na ɔno n'ekyir nye Shamgar, Anath ne babanyin no a ɔdze ɔnantwika-poma kum Philistiafo mu nyimpa ahaesia no: Na ɔno so ɔgyee Israel nkwa.
4: Na aber a Ehud wui no, Israelmba no yɛɛ dza omuo bio wɔ Ewuradze enyi do.
Na Ewuradze tɔɔn hɔn hyɛɛ Canaanhen Jabin a odzii hen wɔ Hazor no nsa; na no dɔm mu safohen panyin nye Sisera a ɔtse Amanamanfo Harosheth.
Na Israelmba no sūi frɛɛ Ewuradze: Osiandɛ ɔwɔ dadze ntseaseanam ahaakron; na ohiahiaa Israelmba no ho dzendzenndzen mfe eduonu.
Afei Deborah, ɔbaa-nkɔnhyɛnyi bi a ɔyɛ Lappidoth yer no, ɔno na obuu Israel atsɛn aber no mu.
Na ɔtse Deborah akyeresua a ɔwɔ Ramah na Beth-el ntamu wɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu no ase: Na Israelmba no fowee baa no hɔ bɛgyee atsɛmbua.

Na ɔsomae na wokehyiaa Abinoam ne babanyin Barak ma ofi Kedesh-naphtali bae, na ɔsee no dɛ, ana nnyɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na ɔahyɛ, dɛ, kɔ na kɔtwe kɔ bepɔw Tabor do, na fa Naphtalimba na Zebulunmba mu mbarimba mpem du ka wo ho?
Na mobɔtwe Jabin no dɔm mu safohen panyin Sisera, nye ne ntseaseanam na ne nyimpadodow no, maba wo nkyen wɔ esutsen Kishon ho; na medze no mahyɛ wo nsa.
Na Barak see no dɛ, sɛ ɔwoara nye me bɔkɔ a, ɔnodze mobɔkɔ: Na sɛ ɔwoara rennye me nnkɔ dze a, monnkɔkɔ.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ɔkɔr ara na menye wo bɔkɔ: Naaso akwantu a irutu yi ɔnnkɛyɛ woara w’enyimnyam; osiandɛ Ewuradze bɔtɔn Sisera ahyɛ ɔbaa bi nsa Na Deborah soɛree, na ɔnye Barak kɔr Kedesh.
Na Barak poon Zebulun na Naphtali nyina hyiae wɔ Kedesh; na mbarimba mpem du tsiaa anamon mu fowee kɔree: Na Deborah nye no fowee kɔree.
Afei Keninyi Heber atwe noho efi Kenifo no ho. Mekyerɛ Moses n’akontangya Hobab mba no ho, na ɔabɔ n’asesee ekodu osudur a ɔwɔ Zaanannim a ɔwoɔ Kedesh ho no ho.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Sisera dɛ, Abinoam ne babanyin Barak afow ko bepɔw Tabor do.
Na Sisera boaboaa ne ntseaseanam nyinara a no, mekyerɛ dadze ntseaseanam ahaakron no, na nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn nyinara, fi Amanamamfo Harosheth, baa esutsen Kishon ho.
Na Deborah see Barak dɛ, soɛr: Na ndɛ nye da a Ewuradze dze Sisera ahyɛ wo nsa: Ana Ewuradze nntui nndzii w’enyim kan? Nna Barak fi bepɔw Tabor do sianee, na mbarimba mpem du no dzi n’ekyir.
Na Ewuradze dze afõwa anomu yɛɛ Sisera, na ne ntseaseanam nyinara, na no dɔm nyinara basabasa wɔ Barak enyim; na Sisera fii ne tseaseanam mu dwirii, na oguanee wo n’anamɔn mu.
Na Barak tsiiw ntseaseanam no, na dɔm no kodur Amanamfo Harosheth: Na Sisera no dɔm nyinara totɔr wo afõwa anomu: Annka nyimpa kor mpo.
Nna Sisera guanee wɔ n’anamɔn mu kɔr Keninyi Heber ne yer Jael n’asesee mu: Osiandɛ asomdwee wɔ Hazorhen Jabin na Keninyi Heber fi ntamu.
Na Jael puei kehyiaa Sisera, na ɔsee no dɛ, man, mo wura, man me nkyɛn; mma nnsuro. Na omaan ne nkyɛn kɔr asese no mu, na ɔdze kuntu bi kataa no do.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma me nsu kakra ma monnom; na nsukɔm dze me. Na obuee numfonsu toa ano, na ɔmaa ɔnomee, na ɔkataa no do.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, gyina asese no n’abowano. Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ nyimpa bi ba na obisa wo dɛ, ana nyimpa bi wo ha? A, ɔno ase dɛ. Oho.

Nna Heber ne yer Jael faa asese ho bɔfodua, na ɔfaa dua-hamɛr kitsaa ne nsamu, na otsiaa dɔn dɔn kɔr ne nkyɛn, na ɔdze bɔfodua no kɔbɔɔ n’asonkyɛnmu, ma ohwiraa mu kitsaa famu; osiandɛ ɔada heii; nna ɔtɔɔ baha na owui.

Na, hwɛ, Barak ritsiw Sisera no, Jael fiir edzi kehyiaa no, na ɔsee no de, bra, na menkyerɛ wo ɔbarimba a erohwehwɛ no no. Na ɔbaa ne nkyɛn; na, hwɛ, Sisera ewu da hɔ, na asese ho bɔfodua no bɔ n’asonkyɛnmu.
Nna Nyankopɔn brɛɛ Canaanhen Jabin adze da noara wɔ Israelmba enyim.
Na Israelmba no nsa daa Canaanhen Jabin do araa dzi kodur dɛ wɔsɛɛ Canaanhen Jabin.
5: Nna Deborah na Abinoam ne babanyin Barak toow ndwom da noara, dɛ,
Israel mu mpanyimfo dzii kan ntsi, ɔman no praa hɔn yamu bae ntsi, hom nhyira Ewuradze.
Ahemfo, hom ntsie ɛ; ebirɛmpɔn hom nyɛ aso ɛ; emi, mara, mobɔtow Ewuradze ndwom; mobɔtow Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn ayɛyindwom.
Ewuradze, aber a ifi Seir reba no. Aber a enam fi Edom haban mu ɔkwan do no, asaase wosowee, ɔsor so sosɔe, nyew, mununkum sosɔɔ nsu.
Mbepɔw popoe wɔ Ewuradze enyim, mekyerɛ Sinai no wɔ Ewuradze. Israel Nyankopɔn no enyim.
Anath ne babanyin Shamgar nda mu, Jael nda mu, na atsɛmpɔn wɔnntsetse do, na akwantsemfo nantsew akwamfo do.
Ahwɛfo sãe wɔ Israel, wɔsãe, kodur dɛ emi Deborah mosoɛree, mosoɛɛr dɛ enã wo Israel.
Wɔsaan mu yiyii enyame fofor; nna dɔm baa kuropon ekyir: Ana wohun akokyɛm anaa nkambaa, wɔ Israel mpeduanan no mu a?
M’akoma da Israel ambradofo ho, ɔman no mu hɔn a wɔpraa hɔn yamu bae no a: Hom nhyira Ewuradze.
Hom a hom tsetse nsoaso efufuw do, hom a hom tsetse nkuntu pa do, na hom a hom nenam ɔkwan do, hom nkã.
Ekyirkyir mbrɛ egyentofo dede wɔ, wɔ asaae no. Hɔ ara na wɔnkã Ewuradze ne tsenenee esiado. No nhwɛdo tsenenee ndwuma wɔ Israel mu no a. Nna Ewuradze ne man sianee kɔr nkuropon mu.
Nyan, nyan, Deborah; Nyan, nyan, tow ndwom: Soɛr, Barak, na fa wo ndɔmmumfafo ndɔmmum, ɔwo Abinoam babanyin.
Nna etumfo nkaa no na ɔman no sianee; Ewuradze sianee ketsiaa akatakyi maa me.
Ephraim mu na hɔn a hɔn ndwow wɔ Amalek mu fii sianee; w’ekyir, na Benjamin bae, wɔ wo nkorɔfo mu; Machir mu na ambradofo fi sianee, na Zebulun mu na hɔn a wokitsa kyerɛwfo n’abaa.
Na Issachar asafohemfo ka Deborah ho; dɛ mbrɛ Issachar tse, dɛmara so na Barak tse; wɔbɔɔ kyirididi wɔ n’anan ho koguu ɔbɔn no mu. Reuben nsukã no ho hɔ na akoma mu pɔwbɔ akɛse wɔ.
Ebɛn ntsi na etsenaa nguamban ntamu, ritsie nguankuw no mu mbɛnhɛn? Reuben nsukã no do hɔ na akoma mu nhwehwɛɛ akɛse wo.
Gilead tsenaa Jordan egya. Na Dan dze, ebɛn ntsi na ɔkaa ahɛn mu? Asher tsenaa epo ahɛngyina komm, na no dɔndɔn no ho na ɔtsenae.
Zebulun yɛ ɔman a wɔdze hɔn nkwa sɔɔ owu hwɛe, na Naphtali so wɔ haban mu mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm.
Ahemfo bae bedzii akõ; Nna Canaan ahemfo bɔkõe, wɔ Taanach, Megiddo nsuwansuwa ho: Wɔammfa sika mfaso biara.
Wofi ɔsor bedzii akõ, nworaba fifii hɔn akwan do nye Sisera kõe.
Esutsen Kishon praa hɔn kɔree, tsetse esutsen no, esutsen Kishon, ao me kra, tsiatsia twem twem kɔ ɛ.
Nna mpɔnkɔ-namɔn pempeem famu wɔ mbirikatu ntsi, hɔn ahoɔdzenfo mbirikatu no a.
Hom ndom meroz, Ewuradze no bɔfoe no na ɔse, hom ndom no mu atsefo no yerɛyerɛyerɛw; osiandɛ woemmbedzi ammboa Ewuradze, wɔammbɔboa Ewuradze enntsia akatakyi no.
Nhyira nkã Jael nsen mbaa nyina, Keninyi Heber ne yer no a, nhyira nkã no nsen mbaa a wɔwɔ asese mu nyina.
Ɔserɛɛ nsu, na ɔmaa no numfonsu; ɔdze numfonsu-enyi-seradze wɔ ahensɛn mu brɛɛ no.
Ɔtoo ne nsa suoo prɛgow mu, na ne nsa enyimfa dze edwumayɛfo ɔbɔbo mu; na ɔdze ɔbɔbo kaa ho bɔɔ Sisera, ɔpotɔɔw ne tsir, nyew, ɔdze bɔɔ n’asonkyɛnmu hwiraa mu.
N’ananadze na ominkyimii, ɔhwee, ɔdae, n’ananadze na ominkyimii, ɔhwee: Mbrɛ ominkyimii no, hɔ ara na ɔhwee ase wui.
Tokura mu na ɔhwɛe, na ɔtsēaa mu, Sisera ne nã tsēaa mu wɔ atenatokura mu, ebɛn ntsi na ne tseaseanam akyɛr ne mbae mu dɛm yi? Ebɛn ntsi na ne ntseaseanam n’anan rikyinkyim?
Ne mbaampanyin enyansafo buaa no, nyew, noara so obuaa nankasa noho.

Ana wonnhunii, ana wɔnnkyɛɛ asadze? Ɔbanyin biara wɔmma no akataasia kor, anaa ebien; Sisera dze wɔmma no asaasaaba asadze, asaasaaba asadze a woedzi mu akye, asaasaaba a woedzi mu akye wɔ n'afanu nyina, wɔ ndɔmmum no kɔn ho?
Ewuradze, dɛm na ma w’atamfo nyinara nhera: Na hɔn a wɔdɔ no no dze ma wɔnyɛ dɛ ewia a oefir wɔ n’ahoɔdzen mu. Na asaase no do dwee araa mfe eduanan.
6: Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do: Na Ewuradze dze hɔn hyɛɛ Midian nsa mfe esuon.
Na Midian ne nsa daa Israel do: Na osian Midian ntsi Israelmba no yɛɛ etu a ɔwɔ mbepɔw mu no, na abo-tu no, na guansumabew maa hɔnho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ Israel dua a, nna Midianfo, na Amalekfo, na boka afamu mba no afow aba; wɔfowee baa hɔn do;
na wɔbɛkyeer hɔn do nsera, na wɔsɛɛ asaase no do ndɔbaa, kodur edze ebodu Gaza no, na woenngyaa akɔhomabɔdze biara wɔ Israel, dɛ oguan, anaa ɔnantwi, anaa asoaso.
Osiandɛ wɔdze hɔn ofiembowa na hɔn asesee bae, wɔbaa dɛ mbebɛw wɔ ɔdodow mu; hɔn na hɔn efumpɔnkɔ nyina wobu ano a ɔnnyɛ: Na wɔbaa asaase no do dɛ wɔrebɛsɛɛ no.
Na osian Midian ntsi wɔbrɛɛ Israel adze dodoodow; na Israelmba no sūi frɛɛ Ewuradze.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a osian Midian ntsi ma Israelmba no sūi frɛɛ Ewuradze no,
Ewuradze somaa nkɔnhyɛnyi bi wɔ Israelmba no hɔ: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi, emi na medze hom fi Egypt bae, na miyii hom fii nkowaasom fi mu no;
na megyee hom fii Egyptfo nsamu, na hɔn a wɔhaaw hom nyinara nsamu, na mutuu hɔn fii hom enyim, na medze hɔn asaase memaa hom;
na mesee hom dɛ, emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn; mma hom nnsuro Amorifo a hom tse hɔn asaase do no hɔn enyame: Na hom enntsie me ndze.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no bae, na ɔbɛtsenaa osudur a ɔwɔ Ophrah a ɔyɛ Abiezernyi Joash dze no n’ase: Na ne babanyin Gideon roporow ewu wɔ nsãtwer no mu, na ɔdze rusuma Midianfo no.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no yii noho kyerɛɛ no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ewuradze dzi w’ekyir, ɔwɔ ɔbarimba a eyɛ ndam.

Na Gideon see no dɛ, ao mo wura, sɛ Ewuradze dzi hɛn ekyir a, nkyɛ ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na iyi nyinara aba hɛn do yi? Na hen na n’anwanwa dwuma nyinara a hɛn egyanom kãa hɛn ho asɛm dɛ, ana nnyɛ Egypt na Ewuradze yii hɛn fii bae no, wɔ? Na afei Ewuradze atow hɛn akyen, na ɔdze hɛn ahyɛ Midian nsa.
Na Ewuradze hwɛɛ no, na ɔsee no dɛ, kɔ no w’abanyinndam yi ara mu, na kɛgye Israel fi Midian nsamu: Ana monnsoma wo bi a?
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ao Ewuradze, ebɛnadze na medze mebɛgye Israel nkwa? Hwɛ, m’ebusua na ɔye mbɔbɔr dodow wɔ Manasseh mu, na emi na musuar dodow wɔ m’egya fie.
Na Ewuradze see no dɛ. Ampa mibedzi w’ekyir, na iboku Midianfo dɛ nyimpa baako.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, sɛ afei menya w’enyim enyimnyam a, ɔno kyerɛ me asɛnkyerɛdze dɛ ɔwoara na enye me rekasa yi.
Meserɛ wo, mma mmfi ha nnkɔ, ma membra wo nkyɛn, memfa m’ayɛyɛdze mbɔto w’enyim ana. Na ɔsee dɛ, mibetsintsim ara ma asan aba ana.

Na Gideon kɔree, na okesiesiee apɔnkyeba, na isiam ephah kor n’epitsi tatar: Enam no ɔdze too kɛntsɛn mu, na ohuee nkwan no guu nkwansɛn no mu, na ɔdze fiir edzi baa ne nkyɛn wo osudur no ase, na ɔdze brɛɛ no.
Na Nyame no bɔfoe no see no dɛ, fa nam no na epitsi tatar no, na fa gu ɔbotan yi do, na hue nkwan no gu. Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm.

Nna Ewuradze no bɔfoe no tseen poma a ɔdze ne nsamu no n’ano, na ɔdze kãa nam no na epitsi tatar no; na ogya fi ɔbotan no mu puei, na obɛhyeew nam na epitsi tatar no; na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no fi n’enyi do kɔree.
Na Gideon hun dɛ ɔyɛ Ewuradze no bɔfoe; na Gideon see dɛ, ebei, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn! Asembra a mehu Ewuradze no bɔfoe enyim na enyim a.
Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, asomdwee nkã wo; mma nnsuro: Innkowu bi.
Nna Gideon sii afɔrmbukyia wo hɔ maa Ewuradze, na ɔfrɛɛ no Jehovah-shalom: Ɔda ho ara wɔ Abiezerfo Ophrah dze bodu ndɛ da yi.

Na ɔbaa dɛ anago noara, Ewuradze see no dɛ. Fa w’egya ne nantwisaa no, mekyerɛ ɔnantwisaa a otsìa ebien a oedzi mfe esuon no, na kodwuruw Baal n'afɔrmbukyia a w’egya wɔ no, na twa Asherah a osi ho no kyen:
Na si afɔrmbukyia ma Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn wo guansumabew yi etsifi, wɔ ne kyenan do, na fa ɔnantwisaa a otsīa ebien no, na fa ka Asherah a itwae no ne nyena no ho bɔ ɔhyew-afɔr.
Nna Gideon faa no nkowaa mu mbarimba du, na oyɛɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze kãa kyerɛɛ no no: Na ɔbaa dɛ, osiandɛ osuroo n’egya fifo, na ekuromfo no ntsi ma onnkotum ayɛ no ewia no, nna ɔyɛɛ no anago.
Na aber a ekuromfo no soɛɛr anapaatu no, hwɛ, Baal n'afɔrmbukyia no woedwuruw, na Asherah a osi ho no woetwa akyen, na ɔnantwisaa a otsīa ebien no wɔdze abɔ afɔr wɔ aformbukyia a woesi no do.
Na wɔsesee hɔnho nkorkor dɛ, woana na ɔyɛɛ dɛm adze yi? Na aber a wɔhwehwɛe na wobisabisae no, wɔsee dɛ, Joash ne babanyin Gideon na ɔyɛɛ dɛm adze yi.
Nna ekuromfo no see Joash dɛ, yi wo ba no bra, ma ombowu; osiandɛ oedwuruw Baal n’afɔrmbukyia, na osiandɛ oetwa Asherah a osi ho no akyen.

Na Joash see hɔn a wogyinagyina no do no nyinara dɛ, ana hom na woribedzi Baal n’asɛm ama no? Ana hom na wɔrebɛgye no? Nyia obedzi n’asem ama no no, wɔmma wonku no anapa yi ara: Sɛ ɔyɛ nyame a, wɔmma ondzi noara n’asɛm, osiandɛ obi edwuruw n’afɔrmbukyia.
Dɛm ntsi ɔfrɛɛ no Jerubbaal da noara, dɛ, wɔmma Baal ndzi ntsia no, dɛ oedwuruw n’afɔrmbukyia ntsi.
Nna Midianfo na Amalekfo na boka afamu mba no nyinara poon hɔnho hyiae; na wotwae, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Jezreel ɔbɔn mu.
Na Ewuradze no sunsum baa Gideon do, na ɔhɛɛn abɛn; na Abiezer boaa ano kedzii n’ekyir.
Na ɔsomaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Manasseh nyinara; na hɔn so wɔboaa ano kedzii n ekyir: Na ɔsomaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Asher, na Zebulun, na Naphtali hɔ; na wɔfowee bae behyiaa no.
Na Gideon see Nyankopɔn dɛ, sɛ enam me nsa do bɛgye Israel nkwa dɛ mbrɛ akã no a,
hwɛ, medze oguannhwi mebɛhata ewuporoweebea; sɛ ɔbɔsu tɔ gu oguannhwi no nko do, na famu hɔ yɛ wesee a, ɔno na mubohu dɛ ɔwo enam me nsa do ebɛgye Israel nkwa dɛ mbrɛ akã no.
Na ɔyɛɛ dem: Osiandɛ n’adzekyee no ɔsoɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔkaa nguannhwi no bɔɔ mu miae, na okyii ɔbɔsu no wo oguannhwi no mu, nsukora mã.

Na Gideon see Nyankopɔn dɛ, mma w’ebufuw nndzɛw mo do, na mebɛkasa prɛko yi ara bio: Meserɛ wo, ma memfa oguannhwi no monsɔ monhwɛ prɛko yi ara bio; afei ma ogaiannhwi no nko no do nyɛ wesee, na ɔbɔsu no ntɔ ngu famu hɔ nyinara.
Na Nyankopɔn yɛɛ dɛm anago no; na oguannhwi no nko no do yɛɛ wesee, na ɔbɔsu tɔe guu famu hɔ nyinara.
7: Nna Jerubbaal a ɔno nye Gideon no, na ɔman a wɔka no ho no nyinara, soɛɛr ahanamakye, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Harod nsunyiwa ho: Na Midian nseraban no odzi hɔn kwaamu afamu, wɔ Moreh koko ho, wɔ ɔbɔn no mu.
Na Ewuradze see Gideon dɛ, nkorɔfo a wɔka wo ho no dɔɔ sõ dodow dze ma me dɛ medze Midianfo mebɛhyɛ hɔn nsa, bɛyɛ na Israel rutuw hɔnho kyerɛ me dɛ, mankasa me nsa na ɔagye me.

Dɛm ntsi afei bɔ dawur wɔ ɔman no asomu dɛ, obiara a osuro na no ho popo no, wɔmma ɔnsan n’ekyir na ɔndan mfi bepɔw Gilead ho nkɔ. Na ɔman no mu nyimpa mpemeduonuebien saan hɔn ekyir kɔree; na ɔkaa mpemdu.

Na Ewuradze see Gideon dɛ, nkorɔfo no da ho dɔɔ sõ dodow; fa hɔn sian kɔ nsu no ho, na minyiyi hɔn mu me mma wo wɔ hɔ: Na ɔmbra dɛ, nyia mebɛse wo dɛ, oyi na ɔnye wo nkɔ no, ɔnoara na ɔnye wo nkɔ; na obiara so a mebɛse wo dɛ, oyi na mma ɔnnye wo nnkɔ no, ɔnoara ɔronnkɔ.

Nna ɔdze ɔman no sianee kɔr nsu no ho: Na Ewuradze see Gideon dɛ, obiara a ɔdze ne tɛkyerɛma bɛtafer nsu no bi, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkraman tafer no, fa no nko gyina nkyɛn; na dɛmara na obiara a ɔkotow n’anankroma enyim nom no so.
Na hɔn mu dodow a wɔtaferee no, dɛ wɔdze hɔn nsa totoo hɔn ano no, wɔyɛ nyimpa ahaasa: Na ɔman nkaa no nyinara kotoow hɔn anankroma enyim noom nsu.
Na Ewuradze see Gideon dɛ, mbarimba ahaasa a wɔtaferee no na medze mebɛgye wo nkwa, na medze Midianfo no ahyɛ wo nsa: Na ma ɔman no nyinara nyimpa biara nkɔ n’ananmu.

Nna ɔman no fefaa edziban na hɔn mbɛn kitsakitsaa hɔn nsamu: Na ogyaa Israel mbarimba no nyinara kwan ma wɔkɔr hɔn asesee mu, na osuoo mbarimba ahaasa noara mu: Na Midian nseraban no wɔ n’ase ɔbɔn no mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ anago noara, Ewuradze see no dɛ, soɛr, sian kɔ nseraban no mu; na medze mahyɛ wo nsa.
Na sɛ isuro dɛ ibesian akɔ a, ɔno nye w’akowaa Purah nsian nkɔ nseraban no mu:
Na ebɛtse dza worekã; na n’ekyir no wɔhye w’abaw dzen ma eesian akɔ nseraban no mu. Nna ɔnye n’akowaa Purah sianee kɔr nseraban no mu wɔ mbarimba a woemia no hɔn ano noho.
Na Midianfo na Amalekfo na boka afamu mba no nyinara boguu ɔbɔn no mu dɛ mbɛbɛw wɔ ɔdodow mu: Na hɔn efumpɔnkɔ nnyi mbuano, wɔtse dɛ mpoano anhwea wɔ ɔdodow mu.

Na aber a Gideon durii no, hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi wɔ hɔ a ɔrekã adaaso bi kyerɛ ne nyɛnko, na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ mosõo daa bi, na, hwɛ, atoko boodoo tatar bi pirewii baa Midian nseraban mu, na odur asese no ho, na ɔbɔɔ no ma ɔhwee famu, na obutuuw no koraa, na asese no daa hɔ.
Na ne nyɛnko no buae na ɔsee dɛ, iyi nnyɛ biribiara dɛ Joash ne babanyin Gideon, Israel ɔbarimba no n’afõwa a: Ne nsamu na Nyankopɔn dze Midian, na dɔm no nyinara ahyɛ.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Gideon tsee adaaso no ne nkāe, na ne nkyerɛasee no, nna ɔkotowee sɔree; na ɔsanee baa Israel nseraban mu, na ɔsee dɛ, hom nsoɛr; na Ewuradze dze Midian dɔm no ahyɛ hom nsa.
Na ɔpaapaa ne mbarimba ahaasa no mu ekuw ebiasa, na ɔdze mbɛn, na nkuraba pan, nye atsɛn a ɔhyehyɛ nkuraba no mu, hyehyɛɛ hɔn nyinara hɔn nsamu.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nhwɛ me, na wɔnyɛ dɛmara: Na, hwɛ, sɛ mudu nseraban no ano noho a, mbrɛ mebɛyɛ no, dɛmara so na hom nyɛ.
Sɛ emi na hɔn a wɔnye me wɔ hɔ no nyinara hɛn abɛn a, ɔno hom so nhɛn mbɛn wo nseraban no ne nkyɛn nyinara, na wɔnse dɛ, Ewuradze na Gideon dze nye yi oo.

Nna Gideon, na mbarimba ɔha a wɔka no ho no, kodur nseraban no ano noho wɔ ɔdasu a odzi finimfin no n’ahyɛse, aber a wɔdze aweɔmfo no sisii ara pɛr no: Na wɔhɛɛn mbɛn no, na wɔbobɔɔ nkuraba no a ɔdzedzo hɔn nsamu no.

Na ekuw ebiasa no hɛɛn mbɛn no, na wɔbobɔɔ nkuraba no, na wɔdze atsɛn no kitsakitsaa hɔn nsa bankum mu, na mbɛn no wɔ hɔn nsa enyimfa ama wɔdze ahɛn: Na wɔtsēatseaa mu dɛ, Ewuradze na Gideon afõwa nye yi oo.
Na nyimpa no nyinara gyinagyinaa hɔn ananmu twaa nseraban no ho hyiae: Na dɔm no nyinara guanguanee; na wɔbɔɔ ose, na wɔkãa hɔn gui.

Na wɔhɛɛn mbɛn ahaasa no, na Ewuradze maa ɔbarimba biara maa n’afõwa do wɔ ne nyɛnko do, na dɔm no nyinara do: Na dɔm no guanee araa kodur Beth-shittah wɔ Zererah afamu, dze kodu Abel-meholah he do, wɔ Tabbath ho.
Na Israel mbarimba wofi Naphtali, na Asher, na Manasseh nyinara mu boaboaa ano, na wotsiiw Midian.

Na Gideon somaa abɔfo wo Ephraim nkokodo nkurow nyinara mu, dɛ, hom nsian nkɔ Midian do, na wɔnkɛgye hɔn nsamu nsu no araa nkodu Beth-ba-rah, mekyerɛ Jordan do. Nna Ephraim mbarimba nyinara boaa ano, na wɔkɛgyee nsu no araa dze kodur Bethbarah, mekyerɛ Jordan do.

Na wɔkɛyeer Midian asafohemfo beenu no, Oreb na Zeeb; na wokum Oreb, wɔ Oreb ɔbotan no do, na Zeeb so wokum no wɔ Zeeb nsãtwer no ho, na wotsiiw Midian: Na wɔdze Oreb na Zeeb hɔn etsir no brɛɛ Gideon wo Jordan egya.
8: Na Ephraim mbarimba no see no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na enye hɛn edzi no dɛm yi, dɛ aber a enye Midian rokɔkõ no ammfrɛ hɛn yi? Na wɔkasaa no dzendzenndzen.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ebɛnadze na afei emi mayɛ a wɔdze to hom dze ho? Ana Ephraim n’esikyireamba mpɛpɛwdzi nnye nnsen Abiezer no wenyinamba-tsew bi a?
Nyankopɔn dze Midian asafohemfo Oreb na Zeeb, ahyɛ hom nsa: Na ebɛnadze na emi metum mayɛ a wodze to homdze ho? Na ɔsee dɛm no, nna hɔn bo dwee no.
Na Gideon bodur Jordan do, na otwaa ɔnoara, na mbarimba ahaasa a wɔka no ho no, wɔaberɛ, naaso wɔda ho tsiw.
Na ɔsee Succoth mbarimba no dɛ, meserɛ hom, hom mfa boodoo ntɔwmu bi mbrɛ nkorɔfo a wodzi m’ekyir yi, na wɔaberɛ, na miritsiw Zebah na Zalmunna, Midian ahemfo no.
Na Succoth etsitsir no see dɛ. Ana Zebah na Zalmunna afei wo nsa enya esuo hɔn nsamu, nna yɛmfa boodoo bi mma wo dɔm yi?
Na Gideon see dɛ, dɛm ntsi sɛ Ewuradze nya dze Zebah na Zalmunna hyɛ me nsa a, ɔno medze sar do nsoɛ na ɔnye nhwirom-nsoɛ mebɛtsetsew hom honam.
Na ofii hɔ kɔr Penuel, na ɔkɛkãa no dɛmara kyerɛɛ hɔn: Na Penuel mbarimba no buaa no dɛ mbrɛ Succoth mbarimba no buae no ara.
Na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ Penuel mbarimba no so dɛ, sɛ mesan meba no asomdwee mu a, mubodwuruw abantsentsen yi.

Afei Zebah na Zalmunna wɔwɔ Karkor, na hɔn dɔm ka hɔn ho, wɔbɛyɛ mbarimba mpem duenum, boka afamu dɔm no nyinara mu hɔn a wɔkae nyinara nye no: Osiandɛ mbarimba mpemɔhaeduonu a wɔtwe afõwa na wɔtotɔree.
Na Gideon fowee faa hɔn a wɔtsetse asese mu wɔ Nobah na Jogbehah boka afamu ɔkwan do, na okokum dɔm no; osiandɛ dɔm no tse hɔ sɔnn.
Na Zebah na Zalmunna guanee; na otsiiw hɔn; na ɔkɛkyeer Midian ahemfo beenu no, Zebah na Zalmunna, na ɔbɔɔ dɔm no nyinara gui.
Na Gideon, Joash babanyin no, sanee fi akono faa Heres afowee bae.
Na ɔkyeer aberantsɛ bi a ofi Succothmba no mu, na obisaa no: Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ Succoth etsitsir, na ne mpanyimfo no maa no, mbarimba eduosuon esuon.

Na ɔbaa Succothmba no nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ Zeba na Zalmunna no a hɔn ntsi hom sii me atwetwe dɛ, ana Zebah na Zalmunna afei wo nsa enya esuo hɔn nsamu, nna yɛmfa boodoo bi mma wo mbarimba a wɔaberɛ yi?
Na ɔfaa kurow no mu mpanyimfo, na sar do nsoɛ na nhwirom-nsoɛ, na ɔdze kyerɛɛ Succothmba no nyansa.
Na odwuruuw Penuel abantsentsen no, na okum kurow no mu mbarimba no.
Nna ɔsee Zebah na Zalmunna dɛ, mbarimba a hom kunkum hɔn wɔ Tabor no hɔn su tsetse dɛn? Na wobuaa dɛ, wɔtse dɛ mbrɛ etse ara; hɔn nyinara hon nyunpadua mu wɔtsetse dɛ ɔhen bi ne mba
Na ɔsee dɛ, wɔyɛ mo nuanom, me nã mba a: Dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi, sɛ hom maa wɔtsenaa ase a, nkyɛ murunnkum hom.
Na ɔsee n’abakan Jether dɛ, soɛr, na ku hɔn. Na aberantsɛ no anntwe n’afõwa: Na osuroi, osiandɛ ɔda ho yɛ abofra

Nna Zebah na Zalmunna see dɛ, ɔwoara soɛr, na tu hyɛ hɛn do ɛ: Na dɛ mbrɛ ɔbarimba no tse no, dɛmara so na n’ahoɔdzen tse. Na Gideon soɛree, na okum Zebah na Zalmunna, na ɔfaa bosoom-fã ndwindze a ɔhyehyɛ hɔn efumpɔnkɔ kɔn mu no.
Nna Israel mbarimba no see Gideon dɛ, dzi hɛn do hen, ɔwo, na wo ba, na wo ba ne ba so nyina: Osiandɛ owo na agye hɛn efi Midian nsamu.
Na Gideon see hɔn dɛ, minnkedzi hom do hen, nkyii so me ba rinndzi hom do hen.
Na Gideon see hɔn dɛ, mobɔhwehwɛ hom hɔ ebisadze bi, dɛ hom mu nyimpa biara mfa n'asadze mu nsowamuadze mbrɛ me. (Na osiandɛ wɔyɛ Ishmaelfo ntsi, wɔwowɔ sika nsowamuadze).
Na wobuaa dɛ, ɔma a, yɛdze bɛma. Na wɔdze ɔtam sɛɛw hɔ, na nyimpa biara kɔtoow n’asadze mu nsowamuadze guu do.

Na sika nsowamuadze a obisae no n’ano tow sika shekel apem ahaesuon ɔsor ɔbosoom-fã ndwindze, na ndwindze a wɔdze sensɛn, na ɔberdum atar a ɔhyehyɛ Midian ahemfo no, na ɔsor ntweaban a ɔhyehyɛ hɔn efumpɔnkɔ kɔn mu.
Na Gideon dze yɛɛ ephod, na ɔdze sii no kurow mu, mekyerɛ Ophrah mu a: Na Israel nyinara dzii ekyir ehuhudze mu wɔ hɔ: Na ɔbɛyɛɛ efir dze maa Gideon, na ne fi.
Nna wɔbrɛɛ Midian adze wɔ Israelmba enyim, na wɔamma hɔn tsir do ara bio. Na asaase no do dwee araa mfe eduanan wɔ Gideon ne nda mu.
Na Joash ne babanyin Jerubbaal kɔree kɛtsenaa nankasa ne fie. 3O. Na Gideon wɔ mbabanyin eduosuon a wofi no honam mu: Osiandɛ ɔwɔ yernom pii.
Na no nwewe a ɔwɔ Shechem no, ɔno so ɔwoo babanyin maa no, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Abimelech.
Na Gideon, Joash babanyin no, owui wɔ nkɔdaayɛ papaara mu, na wosiee no wɔ n’egya Joash n’asamandan mu, wo Abiezerfo Ophrah.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, Gideon wui ara, nna Israelmba no saan bio na wokedzii Baalim ekyir ehuhudze mu, na wɔdze Baal-berith yɛɛ hɔn nyame.
Na Israelmba no annkaa Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn a oyii hɔn fii hɔn atamfo nyinara nsamu wɔ nkyɛnkyɛn nyina no.
Nkyii so wɔannkyerɛ adɔyɛ amma Jerubbaal, ɔnoara nye Gideon no, ne fi, dɛ mbrɛ papayɛ a ɔkyerɛɛ no Israel do no nyinara tse.
9: Na Abimelech, Jerubbaal ne babanyin no sii mu kɔr Shechem ne nã no nuanom nkyɛn, na ɔkɛkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn, na ne nã n'egya fie ebusua nyinara dɛ,

Meserɛ hom, hom nkasa wɔ Shechemmba nyinara asomu dɛ, mmuana na oye ma hom, dɛ Jerubbaal mbabanyin nyinara a wɔyɛ nyimpa eduosuon no bedzi hom do hen, anaa dɛ kɔr bedzi hom do hen? Eso hom nkaa dɛ meyɛ hom biew na hom honam.
Na ne nã no nuanom no kaa no ho nsɛm yi nyinara wɔ Shechem mbarimba no asomu: Na hɔn akoma danee kedzii Abimelech ekyir: Na wɔsee dɛ, hɛn nua a.
Na woyii Baal-berith fie ndwetɛbona eduosuon dze maa no, ɔno na Abimelech dze bɔɔ nyimpa gyengyen akwasampafo bi paa ma wodzii n’ekyir.

Na osii mu kɔr n'egya fie wɔ Ophrah, na okokunkum no nuanom Jerubbaal ne mbabanyin a wɔyɛ nyimpa eduosuon no, wɔ ɔbo kɔr do: Jotham, Jerubbaal n’abakyiba banyin no nko na ɔkae; osiandɛ ɔdze noho sumae.
Na Shechem mbarimba nyinara, na Millo fie nyinara poon hɔnho hyiae, na wɔkɔree kɛhyɛɛ Abimelech hen wɔ dum a ɔwɔ Shechem no n’esudur no ho.
Na wɔkɛkãa kyerɛɛ Jotham no, ɔkɔree kegyinaa bepɔw Gerizim etsifi, na ɔmaa ne ndze do tsēaa mu see dɛ, Shechem mbarimba, hom ntsie me, ma Nyankopɔn so ntsie hom.
Aber bi ndua sii mu kɔr dɛ wɔrekɛsera obi ngo ahyɛ no hɔn do hen; na wɔsee ngodua dɛ, Dzi hɛn do hen.
Na ngodua no see hɔn dɛ, ana mingya me seradze a wɔnam mo do dze hyɛ Nyame na nyimpa enyimnyam no hɔ, na minkedzi dua do akɔ-na-ba anaa?
Na ndua no see adɔmbadua dɛ, ɔwoara bra, na bedzi hɛn do hen.
Na adɔmbadua no see hɔn dɛ, ana mingya me dɛɛdew, na m’aba pa no hɔ, na minkedzi ndua do akɔ-na-ba?
Na ndua no see wenyindua dɛ ɔwoara bra, na bedzi hɛn do hen
Na wenyindua no see hɔn dɛ, ana mingya me nsã a ɔgye Nyame na nyimpa enyi no hɔ, na minkedzi ndua do akɔ-na-ba?
Nna ndua no nyinara see kɔkrɔnsoɛ dɛ, ɔwoara bra, na bedzi hɛn do hen.
Na kɔkrɔnsoɛ no see ndua no dɛ, sɛ nokwar mu ara na hom resera me ngo ahyɛ me hom do hen a, ɔno hom mbra mbɛhyɛ mo nwin ase: Na sɛ ɔnntse dɛm a, ogya mfi kɔkrɔnsoɛ mu mbɛmen Lebanon nkyindur no.
Dɛm ntsi afei, sɛ hom ayɛ no nokwar mu tsenee, dɛ hom ahyɛ Abimelech hen, na sɛ hom nye Jerubbaal na ne fie edzi no yie, na sɛ mbrɛ ne nsaano edwuma regye na hom dze ayɛ no yi a;
(osiandɛ m’egya kõe maa hom, na ɔdze no nkwa kitsaa ne nsamu, na ɔdze gyee hom fii Midian nsamu:
Na ndɛ hom asoɛr wɔ m’egya fie do, na woekum ne mbabanyin, nyimpa eduosuon, wɔ ɔbo kɔr do, na hom ahyɛ n’afonabaa ba, Abimelech hen wɔ Shechem mbarimba do, osiandɛ ɔyɛ hom nua ntsi);
ɔnodze sɛ nokwar mu tsenee na hom nye Jerubbaal na ɔnye ne fie edzi no ndɛ da yi a, ɔno hom enyi ngye wɔ Abimelech ho, na ɔno so n’enyi ngye wɔ hom ho:
Na sɛ ɔnntse dɛm a, ogya mfi Abimelech mu mbra mbɛmen Shechem mbarimba no, na Millo fie; na ogya mfi Shechem mbarimba no, na Millo fie, mbra mbɛmen Abimelech.
Na Jothan twee noho, na oguanee kɔr Beer, na ɔkɛtsenaa hɔ, wɔ no nua Abimelech ho suro ntsi.
Na Abimelech yɛɛ hen wɔ Israel do mfe ebiasa.
Na Nyankopɔn maa sunsum bɔn bi baa Abimelech na Shechem mbarimba no ntamu; na Shechem mbarimba no twaa Abimelech nkontompɔ:
Ma etsirmɔ-dzendze a wɔdze yee Jerubbaal ne mbabanyin eduosuon no aba, na hɔn bɔgyaa ebua hɔn nua Abimelech a okum hɔn no, na Shechem mbarimba a wɔhyɛɛ ne nsa dzen ma okum no nuanom no hɔn etsifi.
Na Shechem mbarimba no kɔr no atsɛwee wɔ mbepow no etsifi, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn a wɔbɛfaa hon nkyɛn wɔ ɔkwan no do nyinara epoo: Na wɔkɛkāā kyerɛɛ Abimelech.
Na Gaal, Ebed ne babanyin no nye no nuanom bae, na wosii mu kɔr Shechem: Na Shechem mbarimba no dze hɔn werɛ hyɛɛ no mu.
Na wosii mu kɔr haban mu, na wɔkɛtsetseew hɔn wenyin ture mu aba, na wokyikyii wenyinamba no, na wɔgyee hɔn enyi, na wɔkɔr hɔn nyame fie, na wokedzidzii na wɔnomee, na wɔdoom Abimelech.

Na Gaal, Ebed ne babanyin no see dɛ, Abimelech nye woana, na Shechem nye woana, na yɛnsom no? Ana nnyɛ Jerubbaal ba nye no bi? na Zebul nye no hwɛdofo? Hom nsom Shechem n’egya Hamor ne mbarimba no: Na ɔbɛyɛ den na yɛbɔsom no?
Ɔka mo nko a nkyɛ ɔman yi wɔ me nsamu! Nkyɛ meetu Abimelech wɔ do. Na ɔsee Abimelech dɛ, ma wo dɔm nyɛ kɛse na pue bra.
Na aber a Zebul, kurow no do ɔhwefo no ɔtsee Gaal, Ebed ne babanyin no ne nsɛm no, n’ebufuw dzɛwee.
Na ɔsomaa abɔfo nyansa kwan bi do ma wɔkɔr Abimelech nkyɛn dɛ, hwɛ, Gaal, Ebed ne babanyin no na no nuanom aba Shechem, na, hwɛ, wɔrehyɛ kurow no ma wɔaasoɛr wo do.
Dɛm ntsi afei, soɛr anago, ɔwo na nkorɔfo a wɔka wo ho no, na kɛtsɛw wo haban mu:
Na ɔmbra dɛ, anapa, iwi pue a, soɛr ntsɛm, na kotua kurow no: Na, hwɛ, sɛ ɔno na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no pue ba wo do a, ɔno ayɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ ibenya n’ayɛyie no ara.
Na Abimelech, na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho nyinara soɛɛr anago, na wopaa hɔn mu ekuw anan kɛtsɛɛw Shechem.
Na Gaal, Ebed ne babanyin no puei, na okegyinaa kurow no n’abotsen ano: Na Abimelech, na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no soɛree fii atsɛwee hɔ.
Na aber a Gaal hun nkorɔfo no, ɔsee Zebul dɛ, hwɛ, nkorɔfo bi na wofi mbepɔw no etsifi risian no. Na Zebul see no dɛ, mbepɔw no no sunsuma na ihu a wɔyɛ dɛ nyimpa no.
Na Gaal kãa bio see dɛ, hwɛ, nkorɔfo bi nam asaase no fur mu risian ba, na ikuw kor nam Meonenim osudur ho kwan no do reba.
Nna Zebul see no dɛ, afei w’ano a edze kãa dɛ, Abimelech nye woana, na yɛnsom no no ɔwɔ hen? Ana nnyɛ nkorɔfo a ibuu hɔn enyimtsia no nye yi? Me kyɛw ara nye yi, afei pue, na nye hɔn nkɔkõ.
Na Gaal puei ndzii Shechem mbarimba no enyim, na ɔnye Abimelech kɔkõe.
Na Abimelech tsiiw no, na ofii n’enyim guanee, na epirafo pii hwehwee ase araa dze kodur kuropon no ano.
Na Abimelech tsenaa Arumah: Na Zebul yii Gaal na no nuanom no edzi dɛ mma wɔnntsena Shechem.
Na ɔbaa dɛ adze kyēe no, nkorɔfo no puei kɔr haban mu; na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Abimelech.
Na ɔfaa nkorɔfo no, na obuee hon mu ekuw ebiasa na ɔkɛtsɛwee wɔ haban mu; na ɔhwɛe, na nkɔhwɛ a nkorɔfo no rupue efi kurow no mu; na ɔsoɛɛr hɔn do, na okunkum hɔn.
Na Abimelech na ekuwkuw a wɔka no ho no bɔɔ kyirdidi kɔr kan, na wokegyinaa kurow no n’abotsen ano: Na ekuw ebien no bɔɔ kyirdidi kɔr hɔn a wɔwɔ haban mu no nyinara do, na wokunkum hɔn.
Na Abimelech nye kurow no kõo da no nyinara; na ɔgyee kurow no, na okum nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ mu no: Na ɔbɔɔ kurow no, na ɔdze nkyen guguu do.
Na aber a mbarimba a wɔwɔ Shechem abantsentsen mu nyinara tsee no, wɔkɛhɛɛn El-berith fie aban mu.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Abimelech dɛ Shechem abantsentsen mu mbarimba no nyinara wɔaboa ano.

Na Abimelech fowee kɔr bepɔw Zalmon do, ɔnoara na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho nyinara; na Abimelech faa ekuma kitsaa ne nsamu, na okotwaa dubaa wɔ ndua no do, na ɔmaa do dze too no kɔn ho: Na ɔsee nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no dɛ, dza hom ehu dɛ mayɛ yi, hom nka homho na wɔnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ mayɛ yi.

Na nkorɔfo no nyinara twitwaa ndubaa dze dzii Abimelech ekyir, na wɔdze boguu aban no ho, na wɔsosɔɔ aban no ho gya dze guu hɔn do; ma Shechem abantsentsen no mu nyimpa nyinara so wuwui, mbarimba na mbaa wɔbɛyɛ apem.
Nna Abimelech sii mu kɔr Thebez, ɔkɛkyɛɛr Thebez do nsera, na ɔgyee.
Na abantsentsen dzendzen bi wɔ kurow no mu, na ehɔ na mbarimba na mbaa nyinara, na kurow no mu mba nyinara guanee kɔree, na wɔtoow hɔnho mu, na wɔfowee kɔr abantsentsen no n’etsifi.
Na Abimelech baa abantsentsen no ho, na ɔnye no bɔkõe, na opiin abantsentsen no n’abow ho papaapa dɛ ɔdze gya rekɛhyew no.
Na ɔbaa bi toow ewuyambo-kuma bɔɔ Abimelech ne tsir, na obuu ne tsidwerba.
Nna ɔtsēaa mu frɛɛ aberantsɛ n’akodze-soanyi no ntsɛmara, na ɔsee no dɛ, twe w’afõwa, na ku me, na nkorɔfo aankã no wɔ mo ho dɛ, ɔbaa na okum no. Na n’aberantsɛ no wɔɔ no ma owui.
Na aber a Israel mbarimba no hun dɛ Abimelech ewu no, hɔn nyinara sii mu kɔr hɔn ananmu.
Mbrɛ Nyankopɔn sii tuaa Abimelech ne ndzeyebɔn a ɔdze yɛɛ n’egya, dɛ okunkum no nuanom eduosuon no kaw nye yi:
Na Shechem mbarimba hɔn ndzeyɛbɔn nyinara Nyankopɔn maa ɔsanee bɔɔ hɔn etsifi: Na Jerubbaal babanyin Jothan no ndom no baa hɔn do.
10: Na Abimelech n’ekyir no, Tola, Puah ba no, Dodo ba no, Issacharnyi no, na ɔsoɛree bɛgyee Israel; na ɔtsenaa Shamir wɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu.
Na obuu Israel atsɛn mfe eduonu ebiasa, na owui, na wosiee no wɔ Shamir.
Na ɔno n’ekyir no Gileadnyi Jair soɛree; na obuu Israel atsɛn mfe eduonu ebien.
Na ɔwɔ mbabanyin eduasa a wɔtsenatsenaa nsoasomba eduasa do, na wonyaa nkurow eduasa a wɔfrɛ no Havvoth-jair dze bodu ndɛ da yi a ɔwɔ Gilead asaase do.
Na Jair wui, na wosiee no wɔ Kamon.

Na Israelmba yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ Ewuradze enyi do bio, na wɔsoom Baalim, na Ashtaroth, na Syria enyame, na Zidon enyame, na Moab enyame, na Ammonmba enyame, na Philistiafo enyame; na wɔpɔɔw Ewuradze na wɔannsom no.
Na Ewuradze n’ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ Israel do, na ɔtɔɔn hɔn hyɛɛ Philistiafo, na Ammonmba nsa.
Na woyii Israelmba ahomtsew na wɔhaaw hɔn afe noara mu: Mfe duawɔtwe na wɔdze haaw Israelmba a wɔwɔ Jordan egya wɔ Amorifo asaase a ɔwɔ Gilead no nyinara do.
Na Ammonmba no botwaa Jordan dɛ wɔnye Judah, na Benjamin, na Ephraim fie so rokɔkõ; na dɛm ntsi Israel no ho hiahiaa no dodoodow.
Na Israelmba no sūi frɛɛ Ewuradze, dɛ, yɛayɛ bɔn etsia wo, mekyerɛ dɛ yeapow hen Nyankopɔn, na yɛasom Baalim.
Na Ewuradze see Israelmba no dɛ, ana manngye hom emmfi Egyptfo, na Amorifo, na Ammonmba, na Philistiafo nsamu?
Zidonfo na Amalekfo, na Moabfo so haaw hom; na hom sūi frɛɛ me, na megyee hom fii hɔn nsamu.
Naaso hom apow me na wɔakɔsom enyame fofor: Dɛm ntsi mennkɛgye hom bio.
Hom nkɔ nkosū mfrɛ enyame a hom asan mu eyiyi hɔn no; wɔmma wɔngye hom wɔ hom ahohiahia aber mu.
Na Israelmba no see Ewuradze dɛ, yɛayɛ bɔn: Biribiara a oye wɔ w’enyi do no fa yɛ hɛn: Ɔgye nko na yɛserɛ wo dɛ gye hɛn ndɛ da yi.
Na wɔtotoow enyame ananaben no fii hɔn mu gui, na wɔsoom Ewuradze: Na Israel amandzehu no yɛɛ ne kra awerɛhow.
Nna Ammonmba no boaa ano, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Gilead. Na Israelmba no poon hɔnho hyiae, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Mizpah.
Na ɔman no, Gilead etsitsir no, sesee hɔnho nkorkor dɛ, ɔbarimba mmuana na obekedzi kan nye Ammonmba no akõ? Ɔno na ɔnyɛ tsitsir wɔ Gileadfo nyinara do.
11: Afei Gileadnyi Jephthah ɔyɛ ɔbarimba katakyi a ɔyɛ ndam, na ɔyɛ ɔbaa huhunyi bi ne ba: Na Gilead woo Jephthah.
Na Gilead ne yer woo mbabanyin maa no, na aber a ne yer ne mbabanyin no nyinii no, wɔpaam Jephthah, na wɔsee no dɛ, mma nndzi adze wɔ hɛn egya fie; osiandɛ ɔsor ɔbaa a ne ba nye wo.
Nna Jephthah guanee fii no nuanom nkyɛn, na ɔkɛtsenaa Tob asaase do: Na akwasampafo bi boaa hɔn ano bɛkaa Jephthah ho, na wɔnye no puei.
Na ɔbaa dɛ n’ekyir mber kakra, nna Ammonmba tuu Israel do sa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ammonmba tuu Israel do sa no, Gilead mpanyimfo sii mu kɔree kɛfaa Jephthah wɔ too asaase no do;
na wɔsee Jephthan dɛ, bra bɛyɛ hɛn panyin, ma yɛnye Ammonmba nkɔkõ.
Na Jephthah see Gilead mpanyimfo no dɛ, ana nnyɛ homara na wokyiir me, wɔpaam me fii m’egya fie no bi a? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na afei a hom wɔ ahohia mu yi hom reba me nkyɛn yi?
Na Gilead mpanyimfo no see Jephthah dɛ, dɛm ntsi na afei yɛadan aba wo nkyɛn bio yi, ama enye hɛn aakɔ, ma yɛnye Ammonmba aakɔkõ, na ɔwoara yɛ hɛn tsitsir wɔ Giieadmba nyinara do.
Na Jephthah see Gilead mpanyimfo no dɛ, sɛ hom dza me san kɔ fie bio ma menye Ammonnba kɔkõ, na Ewuradze yi hɔn ma wɔ m‘enyima, emi na mebɛyɛ hom tsitsir anaa?
Na Gilead mpanyimfo no see Jephthah dɛ, Ewuradze nyɛ hɛn ntamu ɔdasefo; ampaara dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse no dɛmara so na yɛbɛyɛ.
Nna Jephthah nye Gilead mpanyimfo no sii mu kɔree, na ɔman no yɛɛ no hɔn do tsitsir na hɔn panyin: Na Jephthah kãa ne nsɛm nyinara wɔ Ewuradze enyim wɔ Mizpah.
Na Jephthah tuu abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Ammonmba ɔhen no hɔ, dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ewɔ nye me yɛ, na aba mo do nye m’asaase robɔkõ yi?
Na Ammonmba ɔhen no buaa Jephthah m’abɔfoe no dɛ, osiandɛ aber a Israel fi Egypt reba no, ɔfaa m’asaase, ofi Ammon araa dze kodu Jabbok, na Jordan do: Dɛm ntsi dan asaase no ma me fõo.
Na Jephthah tuu abɔfo bio ma wɔkɔr Ammonmba no hɔ:
Na ɔkɛsee no dɛ, mbrɛ Jephthah see nye yi: Israel ammfa Moab asaase, na Ammonmba asaase so bi:
Mbom aber a wofi Egypt bae no, na Israel nantseew sar no do kodur epo memen no ho, na wɔbaa Kadesh no;
nna Israel tuu abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Edomhen hɔ, dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma muntwa mu wɔ w’asaase do: Na Edomhen no enntsie. Na dɛmara so na ɔsomaa ma wɔkɔr Moabhen no so hɔ: Na ɔammpen na Israel tsenaa Kadesh.

Nna ɔnantseew sar no do, na ɔkɔbɔɔ Edom asaase, na Moab asaase ho aprɔw, na wobopuee Moab asaase no no boka afamu, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Arnon egya no ho; na wɔammba Moab he no mu, osiandɛ Arnon nye Moab he no.
Na Israel somaa abɔfo wɔ Amorifo hen Sihon, Heshbonhen no, hɔ; na Israel see no dɛ, yɛserɛ wo, ma yentwamu wɔ w’asaase do nkɔ m’asaase do.
Na Sihon ennya werɛ wɔ Israel mu dɛ ɔbɛma woetwa mu wɔ ne he do: Na Sihon poon ne man nyinara hyiae, na wɔbɛkyeer nsera wɔ Jahaz, na wɔnye Israel kõe.
Na Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, dze Sihon na man nyinara hyɛɛ Israel nsa, na wokunkum hɔn: Na Israel faa Amorifo asaase no nyinara, ɔman no mu mba no a.
Na wɔfaa Amorifo he nyinara, ofi Arnon do araa kodu Jabbok do, na ofi sar no do araa kodu Jordan do.
Nna afei a Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, etu Amorifo efi ne man Israel enyim yi, na ɔwo rebɛfa hɔn?
Ana ennkɛfaa dza wo nyame Chemosh dze maa wo dɛ fa no ara bi? Dɛm ntsi wobiara a Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn etu hɔn efi hɛn enyim no hɔn na yɛbɛfa.
Na afei ana ɔwo iye ara ma ɔsen Zippor babanyin Balak, Moabhen no a? Ana ɔnye Israel dzii aper pɛn, anaa ɔnye hɔn kõo pɛn?
Aber a Israel tsenaa Heshbon na no ho nkurow mu, na Aroer na no ho nkurow mu, na nkurow a ɔwɔ Arnon ho nyinara mu mfe ahaasa no; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom enngye no wɔ aber no mu?
Dɛm ntsi emi mennyɛ wo bɔn bi, mbom ɔwo na ereyɛ me bɔn dɛ irutu mo do sa: Ewuradze, ɔtsɛmbuafo no ɔnyɛ ɔtsɛmbuafo ndɛ da yi wɔ Israelmba na Ammonmba ntamu.
Naaso Ammonmba hen no enntsie Jephthah ne nsɛm a ɔdze somaa ma wɔkɛkãa kyerɛɛ no no.
Nna Ewuradze no sunsum baa Jephthah do, na otwaa mu wɔ Gilead na Manasseh, na otwaa mu kɔr Gilead-Mizpeh, na ofi Gilead-Mizpeh twaa mu kɔr Ammonmba no do.
Na Jephthah bɔɔ Ewuradze anohoba, na ɔsee dɛ, sɛ edze Ammonmba no hyɛ me nsa ampa a,
ɔnodze ɔbɛba dɛ, biribiara a obefi me fi mbobow mu ebehyia me aber a meresan men Ammonmba ho dwudwoodwo no, ɔbɛyɛ Ewuradze dze, na medze no mobɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr.
Nna Jephthah twaa mu kɔr Ammonmba no do dɛ ɔnye hɔn rokokõ; na Ewuradze dze hɔn hyɛɛ ne nsa.
Na ɔdze okum kɛse paara kunkum hɔn fi Aroer araa dze kodu Minnith, mekyerɛ nkurow eduonu, na edze kodu Abel-cheramin. Nna wɔberɛɛ Ammonmba no adze wɔ Israelmba no enyim.
Na Jephthah baa ne fie Mizpah, na, hwɛ, ne babaa dze mfuaba na asaw fiir edzi dɛ oribehyia no: Na ɔnoara nye ne ba kortoo; onnyi ɔbabanyin anaa ɔbabaa ka no ho.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ohun no no, osunsuaan ne ntar mu, na ɔsee dɛ, ebei, me babaa! Abrɛ me adze dodoodow, na ɔwo nye hɔn a wɔfona me no mu baako: Osiandɛ mebue m’ano mama Ewuradze, na murunntum nnsan m’ekyir.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, m’egya ebue w'ano ama Ewuradze yi; yɛ me dɛ mbrɛ efi w’anomu noara; susuampa dɛ Ewuradze edzi w’atamfo do wer ama wo yi, mekyerɛ Ammonmba no a.
Na ɔsee n’egya dɛ, ma wɔnyɛ iyi mma me: Gyaa me abɔsoom ebien, ma minsi mu minsian monkɔ mbepɔw do, na emi na me mfɛfo, nkegyam me mbaabunyɛ ho.
Na ɔsee dɛ, kɔ. Na ogyaa no kwan abosoom ebien: Na osii mu kɔree, ɔno na ne mfɛfo, na okegyaam ne mbaabunyɛ ho wɔ mbepɔw do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ abosoom ebien no n’ewiei no, ɔsanee baa n’egya hɔ, ma ɔyɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ n'anohoba a ɔbɔe no tse noara: Na oennhu ɔbarimba biara. Na oyɛɛ atɔrmuadze wɔ Israel,
dɛ afrenhyia pempem nyinara Israel mbabaa kɔ kɛka Gileadnyi Jephthah ne babaa no mmɔn afrenhyia mu nda anan.
12: Na Ephraim mbarimba bɔboaa ano, na wotwaa mu kɔr kwaamu afamu; na wɔsee Jephthah dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na itwae kɔree kɛnyee Ammonmba kõe, na ammfrɛ hɛn na Yɛnye wo annkɔ? Yɛdze ogya bɛhyew wo fi egu wo do.
Na Jephthah see hɔn dɛ, emi na me man yɛnye Ammonmba nyaa manso kɛse; na aber a mefrɛɛ hom no, hom anngye me emmfi hɔn nsamu.

Na aber a muhun dɛ hom anngye me no, medze mo nkwa kitsaa me nsamu, na mutwae kɔr Ammonmba do, na Ewuradze dze hɔn hyɛɛ me nsa: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na hom afow aba mo do ndɛ da yi, dɛ wɔnye me robɔkõ yi?
Nna Jephthah poon Gilead mbarimba hyiae, na ɔnye Ephraim kõe: Na Gilead mbarimba no kum Ephraim, osiandɛ wɔsee dɛ, hom yɛ Ephraim mu eguamfo, hom Gileadfo, wɔ Ephraim mu, na wɔ Manasseh mu.
Na Gileadfo twaa Ephraimfo kɛgyee Jordan etwaree no: Na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ Ephraim eguamfo no bi se dɛ, ma muntwa a, Gilead mbarimba no se no dɛ, Ana Ephraim nye wo? Sɛ ɔsɛ dɛ, oho a;
nna wɔase no dɛ, afei se dɛ, Shibboleth; na ɔse Shibboleth; na onntum nnkã no yie a; nna wɔakyer no, na woekum no wɔ Jordan etwaree hɔ, na aber no mu Ephraim mu nyimpa mpemeduananebien totɔree.
Na Jephthah buu Israel atsɛn mfe esia. Nna Gileadnyi Jephthah wui, na wosiee no wɔ Gilead nkurow no kor mu.
Na ɔno n’ekyir no Ibzan a ofi Beth-lehem buu Israel atsɛn.
Na ɔwɔ mbabanyin eduasa, na ogyaa mbabaa eduasa kwan wɔ mbeambea, na ɔdze moabaa eduasa fi mbeambea brɛɛ ne mbabanyin no. Na obuu Israel atsɛn mfe esuon.
Na Ibzan wui, na wosiee no wɔ Beth-lehem.
Na ɔno n’ekyir no Zebulunnyi Elon buu Israel atsɛn; na obuu Israel atsɛn mfe du.
Na Zebulunnyi Elon wui, na wosiee no wɔ Aijalon wɔ Zebulun asaase do.
Na ɔno n'ekyir no Pirathonnyi Hillel ne babanyin Abdon buu Israel atsɛn.
Na ɔwɔ mbabanyin eduanan na mbabanyin hɔn mbabanyin eduasa a wɔtsenaa asoasomba eduosuon do: Na obuu Israel atsɛn mfe awɔtwe.
Na Pirathonnyi Hillel ne babanyin Abdon wui, na wosiee no wɔ Pirathom wɔ Ephraim asaase do, wɔ Amalekfo nkokodo nkurow no mu.
13: Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dza omuo bio wɔ Ewuradze enyi do; na Ewuradze dze hɔn hyɛɛ Philistiafo nsa mfe eduanan.
Na ɔbarimba bi wɔ hɔ a ofi Zorah a ofi Danfo ebusua mu a ne dzin dze Manoah; na ne yer yɛ ɔbɔnyin, na ɔnnwo.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe yii noho kyerɛɛ ɔbaa no, na ɔsee no dɛ, afei hwɛ, ɔbɔnyin nye wo, na ennwo: Na ibenyinsen, na awo babanyin.
Dɛm ntsi afei meserɛ wo, hwɛ yie, na mma nnom wenyin anaa nsã dzendzen bi, na mma nndzi efifidze biara so:
Na, hwɛ, ibenyinsen, na awo babanyin; na oyindam bi rennkã ne tsir: Na abofra no fi yafun mu ara bɛyɛ Nazirnyi ama Nyankopɔn; na ono na ɔbɛhyɛ ase agye Israel en Philistiafo nsamu.
Nna ɔbaa no baa bɛkãa kyerɛɛ no kun no dɛ, nyimpa bi baa me nkyɛn, na n’enyim yɛ dɛ Nyame no bɔfoe enyim, oyɛ hu dɛ; na memmbisa no mbrɛ ofi, so ɔammbɔ ne dzin annkyerɛ me:

Na ɔsee me dɛ, hwɛ, ibenyinsen, na awo babanyin; na afei mma nnon wenyin anaa nsã dzendzen, na mma nndzi efifidzi biara so: Na abofra no fi yafun mu araa bɛyɛ Nazirnyi ama Nyankopɔn dze ekodu no wu da.
Nna Manoah totɔe serɛɛ Ewuradze, na ɔsee dɛ, ao Ewuradze, meserɛ wo ma Nyame nyimpa no a esomaa no no mbra hɛn nkyɛn bio, na ɔmbɛkyerɛ hɛn dza yɛmfa nyɛ abofra a wɔrobɔwo no no.
Na Nyankopɔn tsiee Manoah ne ndze; na Nyame no bɔfoe no baa ɔbaa no nkyɛn bio wɔ aber a ɔtse haban mu no: Nna no kun Manoah nnyi ne nkyɛn.
Na ɔbaa no yɛɛ ntsɛm tutuu mbirika kɛkãa kyerɛɛ no kun, na ɔsee no dɛ, hwɛ, ɔbarimba no a ɔbaa me nkyɛn daano bi no oebeyi noho akyerɛ me.
Na Manoah soɛree, na odzii ne yer no ekyir, na ɔbaa ɔbarimba no nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, ana ɔwo nye ɔbarimba a ekasaa kyerɛɛ obaa no? Na ɔsee dɛ, Mara a.
Na Manoah see dɛ, afei ma wo nsɛm mbra mu: Abofra no ne nyɛbea bɛyɛ dɛn? Na n'edwuma nye mmuana?
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no see Manoah dɛ, dza mesee ɔbaa no nyinara na ma ɔnhwɛ yie wɔ ho.
Adze biara a ofi wenyindua mu ba no mma onndzi bi, nkyii so mma ɔnnom wenyin anaa nsã dzendzen bi, na mma onndzi efifidze biara so: Dza mehyɛɛ no nyinara ma ondzi do.
Na Manoah see Ewuradze no bɔfoe no dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma yensianka wo, na yensiesie apɔnkyeba bi mma wo.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no see Manoah dɛ, sɛ isianka me mpo a, mirinndzi w’edziban no bi: Na sɛ ebɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr a, bɔ ma Ewuradze. Osiandɛ Manoah nnyim dɛ ɔyɛ Ewuradze no bɔfoe.
Na Manoah see Ewuradze no bɔfoe no dɛ, wo dzin dze dɛn, na se wo nsɛm no ba mu a yɛaahyɛ wo enyimnyam.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no see no dɛ, ɔye dɛn ntsi na iribisa me dzin a ɔyɛ nwanwa yi?
Nna Manoah faa apɔnkyeba no kaa edziban-afɔr no ho, na ɔdze bɔɔ afɔr maa Ewuradze wɔ ɔbotan no do: Na ɔbɔfo no yɛɛ anwanwadze, na Manoah na ne yer gyeen no.

Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a ogyaframee no fi afɔrmbukyia no do rokɔ sor no, Ewuradze no bɔfoe no fowee nam afɔrmbukyia no do ogyaframee no mu kɔr sor na Manoah na ne yer gyeen no; na wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no ennyi noho bio annkyerɛ Manoah anaa ne yer. Nna Manoah hun dɛ Ewuradze no bɔfoe a.
Na Manoah see ne yer, owu na yerubowuwu, osiandɛ yeehu Nyankɔpon.

Na ne yer no see no dɛ, sɛ Ewuradze pɛ dɛ oku hɛn a, nkyɛ ɔanngye hɛn nsamu ɔhyew-afɔr, na edziban-afɔr, nkyii so nkyɛ oennyi iyinom nyinara annkyerɛ hɛn, na so nkyɛ ɔannkã ndzɛmba a ɔtse dɛm yi annkyerɛ hɛn aber yi mu.
Na ɔbaa no woo babanyin, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Samson: Na abofra no nyinii, na Ewuradze hyiraa no.
Na Ewuradze no sunsum hyɛɛ ase kekãa no wɔ Mahaneh-dan, wɔ Zorah na Eshtaol ntamu.
14: Na Samson sii mu kɔr Timnah, na okohun ɔbaa bi wɔ Timnah a ofi Philistiafo mbabaa no mu.
Na ɔfowee baa bɛkãa kyerɛɛ n’egya na ne nã, na ɔsee dɛ, mekohu ɔbaa bi wɔ Timnah a ofi Philistiafo mbabaa no mu: Dɛm ntsi afei hom nkɛgye no yer mma me.

Nna n’egya na ne nã see no dɛ, ana ɔbaa biara nnyi wo nuanom mbabaa no mu, anaa mo nkorɔfo nyinara mu, na erokɔ akɔwar wɔ Philistiafo monomonomfo no mu? Na Samson see n’egya dɛ, kɛgye no ma me: Na ɔnoara na mepɛ no dodow.
Na n’egya na ne nã dze wonnyim dɛ ofir Ewuradze; osiandɛ ɔhwehwɛɛ ɔkwan bi wɔ Philistiafo no ho. Afei aber no mu na Philistiafo na wɔhyɛ Israel do.
Nna Samson, na n’egya na ne nã, sii mu kɔr Timnah, na woduur Timnah wenyin nture ho: Na, hwɛ, gyata eburwa bi pɔɔw no.
Na Ewuradze no sunsum baa no do dzendzenndzen, na ɔtsetseew no mu dɛ mbrɛ nkyɛ ɔbɛtsetsew apɔnkyeba mu, na hwee nndze ne nsamu: Na ɔannkã dza ɔyɛe no annkyerɛ n’egya anaa ne nã.
Na osii mu kɔree, na ɔnye ɔbaa no kɛkasae; na ɔsɔɔ Samson n’enyi dɛ.
Na n’ekyir mber kakra no ɔsanee kɔr dɛ orikehyia no, na ɔmanee dɛ ɔrokɔhwɛ gyata fun no: Na, hwɛ, ndowa menyamenya, na ewo wɔ gyata honandua no mu.
Na ɔfae kitsaa ne nsamu kɔree, na ɔrokɔ na oridzi, na okodur n’egya na ne nã nkyɛn, na ɔmaa hɔn bi, na wodzii: Na ɔannka annkyerɛ hɔn dɛ oyii ewo no wɔ gyata honandua mu.
Na n’egya sii mu kɔr ɔbaa no nkyɛn, na Samson too pon wɔ hɔ; na mbrɛ mberantsɛ no wɔtɔ dɛ wɔyɛ nye yi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wohun no no, wɔdze mfɛfo eduasa baa dɛ wɔmbɛka no ho.
Na Samson see hɔn dɛ, afei wɔ mma memma hom abrɔme bi: Sɛ hom tum kã kyerɛ me wɔ aponto nda esuon yi mu, na hom hu a, ɔno mebɛma hom ndwera ntar eduasa na nkatado asorɔtow eduasa:
Na sɛ hom ennhu annkã annkyerɛ me a, ɔno hom mma me ndwera ntar eduasa na nkatado asorɔtow eduasa. Na wɔsee no dɛ, fa w’abrɔme no bra, ma yentsie.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, odzidzifo no mu na edziban fi bae, na ɔhoɔdzenfo no mu na dɔkɔdɔkɔ fi bae. Na ndaansa na wonntum nnkyerɛ abrɔme no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsia esuon no, wɔsee Samson ne yer no dɛ, daadaa wo kun, ma ɔnkyerɛ hɛn abrɔme no, amma yaammfa ogya annhyew ɔwo na w’egya fi: Ana hom behyiaa hɛn aabɔ hɛn akwapaa? Ɔnntse dɛm bi a?

Na Samson ne yer no sūi tɔɔ no do, na ɔsee dɛ, ɔtan mbom na etan me, na enndɔ me bi: Ɔwo edze abrɔme ama me man mba, na ennkãa nnkyerɛɛ me. Na ɔsee no dɛ, hwɛ, m’egya na me nã mpo mennkãa mennkyereɛ hɔn, na ɔwo na menkã menkyerɛ wo anaa?
Na osūi tɔɔ no do nda esuon no, aber a hɔn aponto no si do no nyina: Na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsia esuon no, ɔkãa kyerɛɛ no, osiandɛ ɔhaaw no dodow na ɔkɛkãa abrɔme no kyerɛɛ ne man mba no.

Na da a otsia esuon no ansaana iwi rotɔ no kurow no mu mba no see no dɛ, ebɛnadze na ɔye dɔkɔdɔkɔ sen ewo? Na ebɛnadze na no ho yɛ dzen sen gyata: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, sɛ hom ammfa me nantwi emmfuntum a, nkyɛ hom ennhu m'abrɔme no.

Na Ewuradze no sunsum baa no do dzendzenndzen, na osii mu kɔr Ashkelon, na okokunkum hɔn mu mbarimba eduasa, na ɔfaa hɔn asadze, na ɔdze nkatado asorɔtow no maa hɔn a wɔkyerɛɛ abrɔme no. Na n’ebufuw dzɛwee, na osii mu kɔr n’egya fie.
Na Samson yer no dze, wɔdze no maa ne nyɛnko a ɔfaa no adamfo no.
15: Na ɔbaa dɛ n'ekyir no a ɔkyɛɛr kakra no, ewifua twaber mu no, Samson dze apɔnkyeba kɔree kɔhwɛɛ ne yer; na ɔsee dɛ, mobɔkɔ me yer nkyɛn wɔ pia mu. Na n’egya amma no kwan ma ɔannkɔ.
Na n’egya see dɛ, emidze modween dɛ ɔtan na etan no; dɛm ntsi medze no mama wo nyɛnko bi: Ana no nua kuma no no ho nnyɛ fɛw nnsen ɔno?
Na Samson see hɔn dɛ, afei dze ɔwɔ Philistiafo afamu no, sɛ meyɛ hɔn bɔn bi a, minnkedzi ho sõ.
Na Samson sii mu kɔree kɛkyeer nsɔ ahaasa, na ɔfaa ngyaabaa, na ɔdaan dua faam dua ho, na ɔdze gyaabaa hyɛɛ mu wɔ ndua ebien biara ntamu.
Na aber a ɔsosɔɔ ngyaabaa no ano gya no, ogyaa hɔn ma wɔkɔr Philistiafo eburow kwã mu, na wɔhyeew eburow ekuwekuw na eburow a osisi hɔ no nyina, na ngodua ture so.
Nna Philistiafo no see dɛ, Woana yɛɛ iyi? Na wɔsee dɛ, Timnahnyi no n’asew Samson a, osiandɛ ɔagye ne yer, na ɔdze no ama ne nyɛnko bi. Na Philistiafo fowee bae, na wɔdze gya bɛhyeew ɔno na n'egya.
Na Samson see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom ayɛ iyi mpo a, gyedɛ medzi hom wer ansaana n’ekyir no megyaa.
Na ɔbobɔɔ hɔn ndwonku na aserɛ do kunkum hɔn dwɛɛ: Na osianee kɔree kɛtsenaa Etam ɔbotan tokur mu.
Nna Philistiafo no sii mu kɔree, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Judah, na wɔtserɛɛw hɔn mu wɔ Lehi.
Na Judah mbarimba no see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom aba hɛn do yi? Na wɔsee dɛ, yɛbae yaabɛkyekyer Samson, yaayɛ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔdze ayɛ hɛn no.

Nna Judah mbarimba mpemebiasa sii mu kɔr Etam ɔbotan tokur no mu, na wɔsee Samson dɛ, ana ɔwo nnyira dɛ Philistiafo na wodzi hɛn do hen? Ebɛnadze mbɔ na edze ayɛ hɛn yi? Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ wɔdze yɛɛ me no, dɛmara so na medze mayɛ hɔn.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, yɛaba dɛ yɛrebɛkyekyer wo, ma yɛdze wo aakɛhye Philistiafo nsa. Na Samson see hɔn dɛ, hom nkã ntam nkyerɛ me dɛ homara runntu nnhyɛ mo do.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, dabida na kyekyer ara na yɛbɛkyekyer wo, na yɛdze wo akɛhyɛ hɔn nsa: Na oku dze yerunnku wo. Na wɔdze ntampehoma fofor ebien kyekyeer no, na wɔdze no fi ɔtan no mu bae.

Aber a odur Lehi no, Philistiafo no hyiaa no, wohuroo no: Na Ewuradze no sunsum baa no do dzendzenndzen, na ntampehoma a ɔwɔ n'abasa ho yɛɛ dɛ asaaba a wɔdze gya akã, na ne nkyehoma no fii ne nsa ho gui.
Na ohun asoaso n’adadaw fofor bi, na ɔtseen ne nsa fae, na ɔdze kunkum mbarimba apem.
Na Samson see dɛ, medze asoaso n'adadaw mehyɛɛ hɔn ekuwekuw, medze asoaso n’adadaw mekum mbarimba apem.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a owiee kasa no, ɔtoow adadaw no fii ne nsamu kyenee: Na bea no wɔfrɛɛ no Ramath-lehi.
Na nsukɔm dzee no dodow, na ɔfrɛɛ Ewuradze, na ɔsee dɛ, ɔwo nam w’akowaa nsa do edze nkwagye kɛse ama: Na afei nsukɔm nku me, ma monkɔtɔ monomonomfo nsamu?
Na Nyankopɔn paa otokur korkorba a ɔwɔ Lehi no mu, na nsu fi mu bae; na ɔnomee no, no sunsum sanee bae, na onyaa nkwa: Dɛm ntsi ne dzin wɔfrɛɛ no En-hakkore a ɔwɔ Lehi dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na obuu Israel atsɛn wɔ Philistiafo nda no mu mfe eduonu.
16: Na Samson sii mu kɔr Gaza, na okohun ɔbaa huhunyi bi wɔ hɔ, na ɔkɔr ne nkyɛn.

Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Gazafo no dɛ, Samson aba ha. Na wotwaa no ho hyiae, na wɔtsɛɛw no anago no nyinara wɔ kurow no mu kuropon ano, na wɔyɛɛ dzinn anago no nyinara, dɛ, wɔmma ɔnko hɔ na anapa enyim tsetsew a, ɔno yeeku no.

Na Samson dae ma okodur esuom, na osuoo kurow no no kuropon mbobow no, na apondua ebien no mu, na otutui, adaban na dza ɔka ho nyinara, na ɔdze guu no kɔn ho, na ɔsoae dze kor bepɔw a ɔwɔ Hebron enyim no etsifi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ n’ekyir no, ɔdɔɔ ɔbaa bi wɔ Sorek ɔbɔn mu a ne dzin dze Delilah.

Na Philistiafo ekunyin no fowee baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, daadaa no, na hwɛ adze kor a n ahoɔdzen kɛse no wɔ mu, na ɔkwan kor a yɛnam mu bɛhyɛ no do, ma yaakyekyer no ahyɛ no amen: Na ankorankor nyinara yɛbɛma wo ndwetɛbona ahadubiako ahadubiako.
Na Delilah see Samson dɛ, meserɛ wo, kã adze kor a w’ahoɔdzen kɛse no wɔ mu, na adze kor a wɔdze bɛkyekyer wo ahvɛ wo amen kyerɛ me.
Na Samson see no dɛ, sɛ wɔdze mpaahoma momon esuon a ɔnnwoe kyekyer me a, ɔnodze mubogura, na mayɛ dɛ nyimpa biara so.
Nna Philistiafo ekunyin no dze mpaahoma momon a ɔnnwowee esuon brɛɛ no, na ɔdze kyekyeer no.
Afei na ɔwɔ atsɛweefo hyɛ adankyir. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Samson, Philistiafo reba wo do oo. Na ɔtsetseew mpaahoma no, dɛ mbrɛ asaabahoma sɛ ɔkã gya a ɔtsetsew no. Dɛm ntsi woennhu n’ahoɔdzen no.
Na Delilah see Samson dɛ, hwɛ, esi me atwetwe, na akã akɔhwisɛm akyerɛ me: Afei meserɛ wo, kã dza wɔdze kyekyer wo a ɔbɛyɛ kyerɛ me.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, sɛ wɔdze ntampehoma fofor ara a wɔmmfaa nnyɛɛ edwuma pɛn kyekyer me a, ɔno na mubogura, na mayɛ dɛ nyimpa biara so.
Nna Delilah faa ntampehoma fofor, na ɔdze kyekyeer no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Samson, Philistiafo reba wo do oo. Na atsɛ, weefo no hyɛ adankyir. Na ɔtsetseew no wo n'abasa ho dɛ asaabahoma bi.

Na Delilah see Samson dɛ, esi me atwetwe ebodu ndɛ da yi, na akã akɔhwisɛm akyerɛ me: Kã dza wɔdze kyekyer wo a ɔbɛyɛ kyerɛ me. Na ɔsee no dɛ, sɛ edze me tsir mpɛsɛw esuon no fora ɔtanwendze no wen a.
Na ɔdze dadzeba no bɔɔ mu, na ɔsee no dɛ, Samson, Philistiafo reba wo do oo. Na ofii ne nda no mu nyanee, na otuu dza wɔawen no mu dadzeba no, na awendze no.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ebɛyɛ dɛn ase dɛ modɔ wo, wɔ aber a w’akoma nnyi mo ho yi? Esi me atwetwe mprɛnsa nye yi, na ennkãa adze kor a w’ahoɔdzen kɛse yi wɔ mu no nnkyerɛɛ me.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔdze ne nsɛm guaan no ho daa daa, na ohyɛɛ no no, ɔyɛɛ ne kra ahomtsew dze kɔr owu mu.

Na ɔkãa n’akoma mu asɛm nyinara kyerɛɛ no, na ɔsee no dɛ, oyindam ano nnkãa me tsir da; osiandɛ mifi me nã yamu araa na mayɛ Nazirnyi mama Nyankopɔn: Sɛ woyi me tsir a, nna m’ahoɔdzen befi mo ho, na megura, na mayɛ dɛ nyimpa biara so.

Na aber a Delilah hun dɛ ɔakã n’akoma mu asɛm nyinara akyerɛ no no, ɔsomae ma wɔkɛfrɛfrɛɛ Philistiafo ekunyin no, dɛ, hom mbra prɛko yi ara, na ɔakã n’akoma mu asɛm nyinara akyerɛ me. Nna Philistiafo ekunyin no baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔdzedze sika no wɔ hɔn nsamu bae.
Na ɔmaa ɔdaa n’anankroma do; na ɔfrɛɛ ɔbarimba bi ma obeyii ne tsir mpɛsɛw esuon nona ɔhyɛɛ ase hyɛɛ no amon, na n’ahoɔ; dzen no fii no ho kɔree.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Samson, Philistiafo reba wo do oo. Na ofii ne nda no mu nyanee, na ɔsee dɛ, mubopue dɛ nkan no, na mawosow moho. Na ɔnodze onnyim dɛ Ewuradze efi ne nkyɛn kɔ.
Na Philistiafo no kyeer no, na wotutuu n’enyiwa: Na wɔdze no baa Gaza, na wɔdze boran mpokyerɛ too no; na ɔyaam ewu wɔ adaduafo fi no mu.
Naaso woyii no n’ekyir no ne tsinhwi hyɛɛ ase fuuw bio.
Na Philistiafo ekunyin no poon hɔnho hyiae dɛ wɔrobɔbɔ afɔr kɛse ama hɔn nyame Dagon, na wɔagye hɔn enyi: Na wɔsee dɛ, hɛn nyame dze hɛn tamfo Samson ahyɛ hɛn nsa.
Na aber a ɔman no hun no no, woyii hɔn nyame ayɛw: Na wɔsee dɛ, hɛn nyame dze hɛn tamfo, na hɛn man ne sɛɛfo a oekuku hɛn mu piigyan no, ahyɛ hɛn nsa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a hɔn akoma tɔɔ hɔn yamu no, wɔsee dɛ, wɔnkɛfrɛ Samson ma ombeyi hɛn paserew. Na wɔkɛfrɛɛ Samson wɔ adaduafo fi no mu bae; na obeyii hɔn paserew: Na wɔdze no gyinaa edum no ntamu.
Na Samson see abofra no a ɔdze ne nsamu no dɛ, gyaa me ma munsusuo edum no a ɔdan no si do no mu, ma montwer ho.
Afei ɔdan no mbarimba na mbaa ahyɛ mã; na Philistiafo ekunyin no nyinara wɔwɔ hɔ; na mbarimba na mbaa bɛyɛ mpemebiasa wɔ ɔdan no etsifi a wɔrohwɛ Samson ne paserew.
Na Samson frɛɛ Ewuradze see dɛ, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, meserɛ wo, kaa me, na hyɛ me dzen, meserɛ wo, prɛko yi ara, Nyankopɔn, ma mindzi m’enyiwa ebien yi ho wer prɛko wɔ Philistiafo no do.
Na Samson susuoo finimfin edum ebien no a ofi no si do no mu, na ɔtweree, ne nsa enyimfa dze kor mu, na n’abankum dze kor so mu.

Na Samson see dɛ, ma menye Philistiafo no nwu. Na ɔdze n’ahoɔdzen nyinara bɔɔ no mu adze; na ofi no bui guu ekunyin na nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ mu no nyinara ao. Dɛm ntsi ewufo a okum hɔn wɔ no wu mu wɔdɔɔ sõ sen hɔn a okum hɔn wɔ no nkwaber mu.
Nna no nuanom na n’egya fie nyinara sii mu kɔree kɛfaa no, na wɔdze no fowee bae besiee no wɔ Zorah na Eshtaol ntamu wɔ n’egya Manoah n’esiei. Na obuu Israel atsɛn mfe eduonu.
17: Na ɔbarimba bi wɔ hɔ a ofi Ephraim nkokodo nkurow mu a dzin dze Micah.

Na ɔsee ne nã dɛ, dwetɛbona ahadubiako no a wɔfaa no wɔ wo nkyɛn no a epaae wɔ ho, na ekasaa ho so wɔ m'asomu no, hwɛ, dwetɛ no wɔ mo hɔ, mara na mefae. Na ne nã see dɛ, Ewuradze mma nhyira nkã me ba.

Na ɔdaan ndwetɛbona ahadubiako no dze maa ne nã, na ne nã see dɛ, otu na metu dwetɛ no efi me nsa mu esi nkyɛn mama Ewuradze dɛ wɔmfa mma me ba, ma ɔmfa nyɛ osian honyi na ogu honyi: Dɛm ntsi afei mebɛdan mama wo.
Na aber a ɔdaan sika no dze maa ne nã no, ne nã faa dwetɛbona ahaenu, na ɔdze maa ogufo a ɔdze yɛɛ osian honyi na ogu honyi: Na ɔwɔ Micah fie.
Na ɔbarimba Micah no ɔwɔ enyame fi, na ɔyɛɛ ephod, na teraphim, na ɔtseew ne mbabanyin no mu baako ho a ɔbɛyɛɛ no sɔfoe.
Nda no mu no na ɔhen bi nnyi Israel: Nyimpa biara yɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ nankasa n’enyi do.
Na aberantsɛ bi wɔ hɔ a ofi Beth-lehem-Judah, wɔ Judah ebusua mu a ɔyɛ Levinyi, na ɔkɛyɛɛ hɔho wɔ hɔ.
Na ɔbarimba no sii mu fii kurow no mu, ofii Beth-lehem-Judah, dɛ ɔrokɔ beebi mbrɛ obenya tsenabew: Na otuu kwan bodur Micah fie wɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu.
Na Micah see no dɛ, Ifi hen nam? Na ɔsee no dɛ, meyɛ Levinyi a mifi Beth-lehem-Judah, na morokɔ makɛtsena beebi mbrɛ mibenya tsenabew.
Na Micah see no dɛ, nye me ntsena, na yɛ egya na ɔsɔfo ma me, na mebɛma wo dwetɛbona du afrenhyia, na atar hyɛpɛn kor, na w’edziban. Nna Levinyi no kɔr fie.
Na Levinyi no peen dɛ ɔnyɛ barimba no bɛtsena; na aberantsɛ no yɛɛ no dɛ ne mbabanyin mu baako.
Na Micah tseew Levinyi no ho, na aberantsɛ no bɛyɛɛ no sɔfoe, na ɔtsenaa Micah fie.
Nna Micah see dɛ, afei n mehu dɛ Ewuradze bɛyɛ me yie, dɛ menya Levinyi ma odzi me sɔfo yi.
18: Nda no mu no na ɔhen bi nnyi Israel: Na nda no mu no so Danfo ebusuakuw no hwehwɛɛ egyapadze aatsena do osiandɛ ɔdze bodu da no nna hɔn nsa wɔ Israel ebusuakuw mu.

Na Danmba no somaa hɔn ebusua mu mbarimba beenum fi hɔn dodow nyinara mu, mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam, fi Zorah na Eshtaol, dɛ wɔnkɛsera asaase no, na wɔnhwehwɛ mu; na wɔsee hɔn dɛ Hom nkɔ nkɔhwehwɛ asaase no mu: Na wɔbaa Ephraim nkokodo nkurow mu wɔ Micah fie, na wɔsoɛɛ hɔ.
Aber a wɔwɔ Micah fi nkyɛn no, wɔtsee aberantsɛ Levinyi no ne ndze: Na wɔmaan hɔ na wɔsee no dɛ, woana dze wo baa ha? Na ebɛnadze na ereyɛ wɔ ha? Na ebɛnadze na ewɔ wɔ ha?
Na ɔsee dɛ, dɛm na dɛm na Micah nye me edzi, na ɔabɔ me paa, na mabɛyɛ no sɔfoe.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, yeserɛ wo, bisa Nyankopɔn ho apam, ma yɛnhu kyerɛdɛ hɛn kwan a yɛrokɔ yi beyɛ dwudwoodwo anaa?
Na ɔsɔfo no see hɔn dɛ, hom nkɔ no asomdwee mu: Ewuradze enyim na hom kwan a hom nam mu no da.

Nna mbarimba beenum no sii mu, na wɔbaa Laish, na wohun nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ mu hɔ no, mbrɛ woesi na wɔtsetse hɔ sɔnn, dɛ mbrɛ Zidonfo tse, komm na sɔnn; osiandɛ obiara nnyi asaase no do a ɔwɔ tum a ɔdze bogu hɔn enyim ase wɔ biribiara mu, na wɔnye Zidonfo no ntamu twe, na wɔnnye nyimpa biara nnyi hwee yɛ.
Na wɔbaa hɔn nuanom nkyɛn wɔ Zorah na Eshtaol: Na hɔn nuanom no see hɔn dɛ, hom amandzɛɛ ɛ?
Na wɔsee dɛ, Hom nsoɛr, na wɔmma yɛnkɔ hɔn do: Na yeehu asaase no, na, hwɛ, oye dodoodow: Na hom ayɛ dzinn yi ɛ? Mma hom nnyɛ akwadwer dɛ wɔbɔkɔ na wɔakɔdɔ mu afa asaase no.
Sɛ hom kɔ a, hom bɔkɔto ɔman a wɔtse no sɔnn, na asaase no sõ: Na Nyankopɔn dze ahyɛ hom nsa; beebi mbrɛ asaase do adze biara nnyɛ na wɔ hɔ a.
Na Danfo ebusua no mu mbarimba ahaesia a wɔdze akodze emiamia tui wɔ hɔ, fi Zorah na Eshtaol.
Na wosii mu kɔree, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Kiriath-jearim n’ekyir.
Na wɔtwaa mu wɔ hɔ kɔr Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu, na wɔbaa Micah fie.

Nna mbarimba beenum no a wɔkɔree kɛseraa Laish man no buae, na wɔsee hɔn nuanom no dɛ, ana hom nyim dɛ adan yi mu na ephod, na teraphim, na ohonyi a woesian, na ohonyi a woegu wɔ? Dɛm ntsi afei hom ndwen dza hom bɛyɛ ho.
Na wɔmaan hɔ, na wɔbaa Levinyi aberantsɛ no fie, mekyerɛ Micah fi no a, na wobisaa no honam mu.
Na mbarimba ahaesia no a woemia hɔn akodze a wɔn Danmba no mu no wogyinaa abotsen no ano.

Na mbarimba beenum no a wɔkɔree kɛseraa asaase no fowee, na wɔbaa hɔ, na wɔkɛfaa ohonyi a woesian, na ephod, na teraphim na ohonyi a woegu no: Na ɔsɔfo no nye mbarimba ahaesia no a wɔdze akodze emia no gyinaa abotsen no ano.
Na aber a woyinom kɛhɛɛn Micah fie, na wɔkɛfaa ohonyi a woesian, ephod, na teraphim na ohonyi a woegu no, ɔsɔfo no see hɔn dɛ, ebɛnadze na hom reyɛ yi?

Na wɔsee no dɛ, yɛ komm, fa wo nsa mua w’ano, na nye hɛn nkɔ, na kɛyɛ hɛn egya na ɔsɔfo: Ana oye ma wo dɛ ibedzi ɔsɔfo ama nyimpa baako ne fie, anaa dɛ ibedzi ɔsɔfo ama ebusuakuw na ebusua wɔ Israel mu?
Na ɔsɔfo no n’akoma tɔɔ ne yamu, na ɔfaa ephody na teraphim, na ohonyi a woesian no, na ɔdze kɔr nkorɔfo no mu.
Nna wɔdanee na wosii mu kɔree, na wɔdze mbofraba na ofiembowa na ahodze no dzii hɔn enyim.
Aber a wɔnye Micah fi ntamu twee kakra ara yie no, mbarimba a wɔwɔ efiefi a ɔbɛn Micah fi no mu no wɔboaa ano, na wokotuu Danmba no.
Na wɔtsēaa mu frɛɛ Danmba no. Na wɔdaan hɔn enyi, na wɔsee Micah dɛ, ebɛnadze na ɔyɛ wo, na edze dɛm asafo yi reba yi?
Na ɔsee dɛ, hom afa m’enyame a meyɛe, na ɔsɔfo no, na hom dze rokɔ, na ebɛnadze na mowɔ bio? Na odua dɛn mbɔ na hom se me dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ɔyɛ wo yi?
Na Danmba no see no dɛ, mma wɔnntse wo ndze wɔ hɛn mu, ɔno bɛyɛ na nkorɔfo a hɔn bo efuw ebotu ahyɛ hom do, na ɔwo ahwer wo nkwa, ɔnye wo fifo hɔn nkwa.
Na Danmba no faa hɔn kwan kɔree: Na Micah hun dɛ wɔyɛ dzen dodow ma no no, ɔdaan noho na ɔsanee kɔr ne fie.
Na wɔfaa dza Micah yɛe no, na ɔsɔfo a onyaa no no, na wɔbaa Laish, bɔtoo ɔman a wɔwɔ hɔ komm na wɔtse ho sɔnn no, na wɔdze afõwa anomu kunkum hɔn; na wɔdze gya hyeew kurow no.
Na ɔgyefo bi nnyi hɔ, osiandɛ ɔnye Zidon ntamu twe, na wɔnnye nyimpa biara nnyɛ; na ɔwɔ ɔbɔn a ɔda Beth-rehob mu. Na wɔkyekyeer kurow no, na wɔtsenaa mu.
Na wɔfrɛɛ kurow no ne dzin Dan, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egya Dan a wɔwoo no maa Israel no ne dzin tse: Naaso kurow no nkyɛ nkan no ne dzin dze Laish.

Na Danmba no dze ohonyi a woesian no sii hɔ maa hɔnho: Na Jonathan, Gershon ba no, Moses ba no, ɔno na ne mbabanyin na wodzii asɔfo maa Danfo esusuakuw no araa ma okodur da a asaase no kɔr ndɔmmum mu.
Nna wɔdze Micah no honyi a woesian a ɔyɛe no sii hɔ maa hɔnho, aber a Nyankopɔn ne fi no wɔ Shiloh no nyinara.
19: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu, aber a ɔhen bi nnyi Israel no, Levinyi bi wɔ hɔ a ɔkɔr ahɔhotsena wɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no ne nkyɛnmu no ho, ɔno na ɔfaa nwewe bi fi Beth-lehem-Judah.
Na no nwewe no bɔɔ ehuhubra dze tsiaa no, na ofii ne nkyɛn kɔr n'egya fie wɔ Beth-lehem-Judah na ɔwɔ hɔ ara bɛyɛ abosoom anan.

Na no kun no soɛree, na otsiiw no dɛ, ɔrekɛdɛfɛdɛfɛw no na ɔdze no asan aba, n'akowaa, na nsoaso ebien ka no ho: Na ɔdze no kɔr n'egya fie: Na aber a akataasia no n'egya hun no no, odzii dɛw dɛ oehu no.
Na n'asew, akataasia no n'egya no, siankaa no; na ɔtsenaa ne nkyɛn ndaasa: Nna wodzidzii na wɔnomee, na wɔdaa hɔ.
Na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsīa anan no, wɔsoɛree dɛ ɔrokɔ: Na akataasia no n'egya no see n'asew no dɛ, fa boodoo trɔma bi dwedwe w'akoma, na n'ekyir no hom nkɔ hom kwan.
Nna wɔtsenaa famu, na wodzidzii na wɔnomee, hɔn beenu nyina: Na akataasia no n'egya no see ɔbarimba no dɛ, meserɛ wo, pen, na tsintsim anago yi nyinara, na ma w'enyi ngye.
Na ɔbarimba no soɛree dɛ ɔrokɔ; na n'asew no hyɛɛ no, na ɔdaa hɔ bio.
Na da otsīa enum no ɔsoɛɛr ahanamakye no dɛ ɔrokɔ; na akataasia no n'egya see dɛ, meserɛ wo, ka w'akoma to mu, na tsintsim ma onkodu iwi-danee ana; na hɔn beenu nyina dzidzii.

Na aber a ɔbarimba no soɛree dɛ ɔrokɔ no, ɔnoara, na no nwewe no, na n'akowaa no, n'asew no, akataasia no n'egya no, ɔsee no dɛ, hwɛ, afei, nwin ano rodwe, adze resã, meserɛ hom, hom ntsintsim anago yi nyinara: Hwɛ, adze reyɛ asã, da ha, ma w'akoma ntɔ wo yamu; na ɔkyena asoɛr ahanamakye esi hom kwan do, na akɔ wo fie.
Na ɔbarimba no ammpɛ dɛ otsintsim anago no, na ɔsoɛree kɔree, na okodur Jebus (ɔnoara nye Jerusalem) ne tsentsendo: Na nsoaso ebien a wɔahyehyɛ hɔn ka no ho; no nwewe no so ka no ho.
Aber a wodur Jebus nkyɛn no, nna tserɛ adze asa; na akowaa no see no wura dɛ, meserɛ wo, bra, ma yɛmman nkɔ Jebusfo kurow yi mu, na yɛnkɛda hɔ.
Na no wura see no dɛ, yɛremman nnkɔ ɔnanaben a ommfi Israelmba mu no kurow mu; mbom yerutwa mu akɔ Gibeah.
Na ɔsee n'akowa no dɛ, bra ma yɛmbɛn nkurow yi mu kor; na yɛnkɛda Gibeah, anaa Ramah.
Nna wotwaa mu kɔr hɔn kwan; na iwi kɔtɔr hɔn wɔ Gibeah a ɔyɛ Benjamin dze no nkyɛn.
Na wɔmaan hɔ dɛ wɔrokɔ akɛda Gibeah: Na ɔkɔree, na ɔkɛtsenaa kurow no n'abɔntsen do: Osiandɛ nyimpa biara ammbɛfa hɔn annkɔ ne fie dɛ wɔnkɔsoɛ hɔ.
Na, hwɛ, akɔdaa bi fi n'edwumayɛ mu wɔ haban mu baa ewimbir no; na nyimpa no ofi Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no mu na ɔaba Gibeah ahɔhotsena: Na ekuromfo no dze wɔyɛ Benjaminfo.
Na ɔmaa n'enyiwa do, na ohun ɔbarimba ɔkwantsennyi no wɔ kurow no n'abɔntsen do; na akɔdaa no see dɛ, henfa na erokɔ? Na henfa so na ifi bae?

Na ɔsee no dɛ, yefi Beth-lehem-Judah rutwa mu akɔ Ephraim nkokodo nkurow no ne nkyɛnmu no ho; hɔ na mifi, na mokɔr Beth-lehem-Judah: Na afei morokɔ Ewuradze fie; na nyimpa biara mmbɛfaa me nnkɔsoɛɛ ne fie yi.
Naaso efuw na ezdiban nyina wɔ hɔ dze ma hɛn nsoasoa; na boodoo na nsã so wɔ hɔ ma emi, na w'afonabaa yi, na aberantsɛ yi a ɔka wo nkowaa ho yi: Biribiara nnhia hɛn.
Na akɔdaa no see dɛ, asomdwee nkã wo; ɔtse dɛn ara a ma w'ehyiadze nyinara nda mo do, abɔntsen do ara nko na mma nnda.
Nna ɔdze no kɔr ne fie, na ɔmaa nsoaso no edziban: Na wɔhohoor hɔn anan ho, na wodzidzii na wɔnomee.

Aber a wɔrema hɔn akoma atɔ hɔn yamu no, hwɛ, kurow mu hɔ mba, Belial mbabanyin bi, botwaa ofi no ho hyiae, bɔbobɔɔ abow no mu; na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ ofi no wura akɔdaa no, dɛ, fa ɔbarimba no a ɔbɔsoɛɛ wo fie no bra ma yenhu no.
Na ɔbarimba, ofi no wura no, puei kɔr hɔn nkyɛn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, dabida, mo nuanom, meserɛ hom, mma hom nnyɛ emumuyɛ a ɔtse dɛ; dɛ ɔbarimba yi enya abɔsoɛ me fie yi, mma hom nnyɛ nkwaseadze yi.

Hwɛ, me babaa akataasia nye yi, na no nwewe no nye yi; medze hɔn rifir edzi seseiara, na hom mbrɛ hɔn adze, na dza homara hwɛ a oye noara hom nyɛ hɔn: Na ɔbarimba yi dze mma hom nnyɛ no dɛm nkwaseadze yi.

Na mbarimba no ammpɛ dɛ wobetsie no: Nna ɔbarimba no suoo no nwewe no mu, na ɔdze no puei brɛɛ hɔn; na wohun no, na wɔbɔɔ no adapaa anago no nyinara ma okodur anapa: Na aber a adze rekyē no wogyaa no ma ɔkɔree.
Enyim rebaabaa no nna ɔbaa no bae, na obotwae hwee ɔbarimba no ne fi no a no wura wɔ mu no n'abowano, ma okodur enyim tsetsewee.
Na no wura no soɛɛr anapa, na obuebuee ofi no no mbobow, na ofiir ezdi dɛ ɔrokɔ no kwan: Na, hwɛ, ɔbaa no, no nwewe no, ɔda ofi no n'abowano, na ne nsa gu apondua ase dze no do.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Soɛr, na ma yɛnkɔ; na obiara anngye do: Nna ɔfaa no too asoaso no do; na ɔbarimba no soɛree, na ɔkɔr no kurow mu.
Na aber a ɔbaa ne fie no, ɔfaa sekan, na osuoo no nwewe no mu paapaa no, akwaamu akwaamu, esinesin duebien, na ɔsomaa ma wɔdze kɔr Israel ehyiado nyinara.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, hɔn a wohunii nyinara see dɛ, ofitsi da a Israelmba fi Egypt asaase do bae araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi adze a ɔtse dɛm yi wɔnnyɛɛ bi, nkyii so wonnhun bi da: Hom ndwen ho, wɔmfa ho apam, na hom nkasa.
20: Nna Israelmba nyinara fiir ezdi, na mboanofo no behyiaa dɛ nyimpa kor, ofi Dan araa kodu Beer-sheba, ɔnye Gilead asaase, na wɔkɔr Ewuradze hɔ wɔ Mizpah.
Na ɔman no nyinara, mekyerɛ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu etsitsir no beyii hɔnho kyerɛɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn ne man bagua no mu, mbarimba mpem ahaanan a wɔnam anamɔn mu a wɔtwe mfõwa.
(Afei Benjaminmba no tsee dɛ Israelmba esi mu kɔ Mizpah). Na Israelmba no see dɛ, kã kyerɛ hɛn, emumuyɛ a ɔtse dɛm yi duaa dɛn bae?
Na Levinyi no, ɔbaa a wodzii no ewu no no kun no, buaa na ɔsee dɛ, mebaa Gibeah a ɔyɛ Benjamin dze no mu, emi na mo nwewe dɛ yɛrobɔsoɛ hɔ.
Na Gibeahmba no soɛɛr mo do, na wotwaa ofi no ho hyia wɔ me ntsi anago no; emi na wɔdween dɛ woboku me, na mo nwewe no wɔhyɛɛ no nda araa ma owui.
Na musuoo mo nwewe no mu mutwitwaa no esinesin, na mosomaa ma wɔdze kɔr Israel egyapadze asaase nyinara do: Osiandɛ ɔayɛ ebusudze na ekyiwadze wɔ Israel mu.
Hwɛ hom Isrealmba, hom nyinara nye yi, hom nkyerɛ hom adwen na hom apam wɔ ha.
Na ɔman no nyinara gyee bom dɛ nyimpa kor, see dɛ, hɛn mu biara ronnkɔ n'asesee mu, nkyii so hɛn mu biara remman ne fie.
Na afei iyi nye adze a yɛdze bɛyɛ Gibeah; yɛbɔtwe tonto akɔ hɔn do;

na yeeyiyi Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu nyimpa mu du, na apem mu ɔha, na mpemdu mu apem, ma wɔaakɛfa edziban abrɛ ɔman no, na sɛ wɔba Benjamin Gilead a, wɔaabɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ nkwaseadze a wɔayɛ no wɔ Israel mu no nyinara tse.
Nna Israel mbarimba nyinara boaa ano kɔr kurow no do, wɔabɔ mu dɛ nyimpa kor.
Na Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw somaa nyimpa ma wɔkɔr Benjamin ebusuakuw nyinara mu, dɛ, ebɛn emumuyɛ nye dza wɔayɛ no wɔ hom mu yi?
Dɛm ntsi afei hom nyi mbarimba no, Belial mbabanyin a wɔwɔ Gibeah no mma, ma yenku hɔn, na yɛmfa nyi mbusu no mfi Israel. Na Benjamin ammpɛ dɛ wotsie hɔn nuanom Israelmba no ndze.
Na Benjaminmba a wofifi nkurow nkurow mu behyiaa Gibeah dɛ wɔrokɔ akɛnye Israelmba no akõ.
Na wɔkaan Benjaminmba a wofifi nkurow nkurow mu no da no ara ma wɔyɛɛ mbarimba a wɔtwe mfõwa mpemeduonuesia, na ɔsor Gibeahmba a wɔkan hɔn a wɔyɛ mbarimba a wɔapa hɔn ahaesuon.
Nkorɔfo yi nyinara mu mbarimba a wɔapa hɔn ahaesuon no wɔyɛ abankumfo; obiara tum tow nhwi itsiabo, na ɔmmfom.
Na Israel mbarimba, Benjamin nnka ho a, wɔkan hɔn mbarimba mpemahaanan a wɔtwe mfõwa: Woyinom nyinara wɔyɛ mbarimba akofo.

Na Israelmba no soɛree, na wosii mu kɔr Beth-el, na wokebisaa Nyankopɔn hɔ apam; na wɔsee dɛ, woana na ondzi kan mfow nkɔ nkɛnye Benjaminmba no nkõ mma hɛn? Na Ewuradze see dɛ, Judah ndzi kan mfow nkɔ.
Na Israelmba no soɛɛr anapa, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Gibeah do.
Na Israel mbabarimba no tui kɔr dɛ wɔnye Benjamin rokɔkõ; na Israel mbarimba no baa hɔn do mpasuar wɔ Gibeah.
Na Benjaminmba no puei fi Gibeah, na wɔbɛkaa Israelfo mu mbarimba mpemeduonuebien guu famu sɛɛ hɔn da noara.
Na nkorɔfo no, Israel mbarimba no, hyɛɛ hɔnho dzen, na wɔbaa mpasuar bio wɔ beebi mbrɛ da a odzi kan no wɔbaa hɔn mpasuar no ara.
(Na Israelmba no sii mu kɔree kosūi wɔ Ewuradze enyim araa ma okodur ewimbir; na wobisaa Ewuradze dɛ, ana montwe mbɛn bio menye mo nua Benjamin mba no nkɔkõ? Na Ewuradze see dɛ, hom mfow nkɔ no do).
Na Israelmba no twee bɛnee baa Benjaminmba no do da a otsīa ebien no.
Na Benjamin fiir ezdi fi Gibeah baa hɔn do da a otsīa ebien no, na wɔkaa Israelmba mu mbarimba mpemduawɔtwe guu famu bio sɛɛ hɔn; woyinom nyinara twe mfõwa.
