Nna Israelmba no nyinara, na ɔman no nyinara sii mu kɔr Beth-el, na wokosūii, na wɔtsenaa Ewuradze enyim hɔ, na wɔkyeen kɔm da no ma okodur ewimbir; na wɔbobɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr na asomdwee-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na Israelmba no bisaa Ewuradze, (Osiandɛ hɔ na nda no mu no Nyankopɔn n'ahyɛmudaka no wɔ,

na Phinehas, Eleazar ne mbabanyin, Aaron ne mbabayin no, na ogyina enyim wɔ nda no mu) dɛ, ana menda ho ara mimfir edzi bio menkɛnye mo nua Benjamin mba no nkɔkõ, anaa mingyaa? Na Ewuradze see dɛ, fow kɔ; na ɔkyena medze no mebɛhyɛ wo nsa.
Na Israel dze atsɛweefo hyɛhyɛe bɔɔ Gilead ho aprɔw.
Na Israelmba no sii mu kɔr Benjaminmba no do da a otsīa ebiasa no, na wɔbaa mpasuar wɔ Gibeah do, dɛ nkan no.

Na Benjaminmba no fiir edzi behyiaa nkorɔfo no, na wɔtwee hɔn fii kurow no mu; na wɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ wɔrobobɔ na worukuku nkorɔfo no mo bi dɛ nkan no, wɔ atsempɔn a ekor kɔ Beth-el, na kor so kɔ Gibeah, wɔ haban mu no do, Israel mu mbarimba bɛyɛ eduasa.
Na Benjaminmba no see dɛ, woridzi hɛn enyim adɔngu dɛ nkan no. Na Israelmba no see dɛ, wɔmma yenguan, na yɛntwe hɔn mfi kurow no mu mbra atsempɔn do.
Na Israel mbarimba no nyinara soɛree fii hɔn tsenabew, na wɔkɛbaa mpasuar wɔ Baal-tamar: Na Israel atsɛweefo no fii edzi fii hɔn ananmu, mekyerɛ Maareh-geba ho a.
Na mbarimba mpemdu a wɔapa hɔn wɔ Israel nyinara mu befiir Gibeah nkyɛnmu, na ɔkõ no mu yɛɛ dzen: Na hɔndze wonnyim dɛ mbusu bi abɛn hɔn.
Na Ewuradze kãa Benjamin gya wɔ Israel enyim: Na Israelmba no sɛɛ Benjamin mu mbarimba mpemeduonuenum na nyimpa ɔha da da no: Woyinom nyinara wɔtwe mfõwa.
Nna Benjaminmba no hun dɛ wɔabɔ hɔn egu: Na Israel mbarimba no maa Benjamin kwan, osiandɛ hɔn enyi daa atsɛweefo a wɔdze hɔn ahyehyɛ Gibeah do no do.
Na atsɛweefo no yɛɛ ntsɛm, na wokotui hyɛɛ Gibeah do; na atsɛweefo no twee hɔnho piin kan, na wɔdze afõwa anomu bɔɔ kurow no nyinara.
Afei asɛnkyerɛdze wɔakyɛ da Israel mbarimba no na atsɛweefo no ntamu nye dɛ, wɔmma wusiw kɛse kumbɔɔ mfi kurow no mu nsoɛr nkɔ sor.
Na Israel mbarimba no daan hɔnho wɔ ɔkõ no mu, na Benjamin hyɛɛ ase bobɔe na okunkum Israel mbarimba mu nyimpa bɛyɛ eduasa: Na wɔsee dɛ, ogu ara na woegu wɔ hɛn enyim dɛ nkan no ɔkõ no no mu.
Na aber a gyawusiw no hyɛɛ ase fi kurow no mu wɔ wusiw kumbɔɔ dum ho soɛree kɔr sor no, Benjaminfo hwɛɛ hɔn ekyir, na, hwɛ, kurow mu no nyina rupun wusiw rofow kɔ sor.
Na Israel mbarimba no daan hɔnho, na nketsenketse kyeer Benjamin mbarimba no: Na wohun dɛ mbusu ato hɔn.
Dɛm ntsi wɔdaan hɔn ekyir wɔ Israel mbarimba no enyim dze faa sar no do kwan do; na ɔkõ no kyeer hɔn do; na hɔn a wofi nkurow nkurow do bae no sɛɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn mu.
Wɔkaa Benjaminfo hyɛɛ mu bɔɔ aprɔw, na wotsiiw hɔn, na wɔpaam hɔn wɔ hɔn ahomgye bea, dze kodur Gibeah tsentsendo, wɔ iwi-puei afamu.
Na Benjamin mu mbarimba mpemduawɔtwe totɔree; woyinom nyinara wɔyɛ mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam.

Na wɔdaan hɔnho guanee faa sar no do afamu kɔr Rimmon ɔbotan no ho: Na wodzii hɔn atwee wɔ atsempɔn do kunkum mbarimba mpemenum; na wɔtaa hɔn do twetweetwe dze kodur Gidom, na wokunkum hɔn mu mbarimba mpemebien.
Dɛm ntsi da no Benjamin mu hɔn a wɔtotɔree nyinara wɔyɛ mbarimba mpemeduonuenum a wɔtwe mfõwa; woyinom nyinara wɔyɛ mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam.
Na mbarimba ahaesia ara na wɔdaan hɔnho guanee faa sar no do afamu kɔr Rimmon ɔbotan no ho, na wɔkɛtsenaa Rimmon ɔbotan no mu abosoom an an.
Na Israel mbarimba no saan hɔn ekyir bio baa Benjaminmba no do, na wɔdze afõwa anomu kunkum hɔn, kurow mu no, na anyɛmbowa nyinara: Nkyii so wɔtotoo nkurow nkurow a wohunii nyinara mu gya.
21: Afei Israel mbarimba no akekã ntam wo Mizpah, dɛ, hɛn mu obiara mmfa ne babaa mma Benjamin awar.
Na ɔman no baa Beth-el, na wɔbɛtsenaa Nyankopɔn enyim hɔ ma okodur ewimbir, na wɔmemaa hɔn ndze do sūu dzendzen.
Na wɔsee dɛ, Ao Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn, ɔye dɛn ntsi na iyi aba Israel yi, dɛ ndɛ ɔka Israel mu ebusuakuw kor yi?
Na ɔbaa dɛ adzekyee no, ɔman no soɛɛr ahanamakye, na wosii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ, na wɔbɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr na asomdwee afɔr.

Na Israelmba no see dɛ, woana na ɔwɔ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu a ɔno ɔammfow ammba bagua no mu wɔ Ewuradze nkyɛn? Osiandɛ wɔakã ntankɛse egu nyia ɔammfow ammba Ewuradze nkyɛn wɔ Mizpah no do, dɛ, oku na wonku no.
Na Israelmba no nuu hɔnho wɔ hɔn nua Benjamin ntsi, na wɔsee dɛ, ndɛ woetwa ebusuakuw kor efi Israel mu akyen.
Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ama hɔn a wɔaka no wɔ yernom ho afamu, ɔnam dɛ yɛdze Ewuradze akã ntam dɛ yɛremmfa hɛn mbabaa mu bi mma hɔn ayewar yi?
Na wɔsee dɛ, Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu woana ara na ɔwɔ hɔ a ɔno ɔammfow ammba Ewuradze nkyɛn wɔ Mizpah no? Na hwɛ obiara emmfi Jabesh-gilead ammba bagua no mu wɔ nseraban no.
Osiandɛ aber a wɔkaan ɔman no, hwɛ, nna Jabesh-gileadmba no mu biara nnyi hɔ.
Na mboanofo no tuu mbarimba a wɔye ndam papaara mpemduebien, na wɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, hom nkɔ na wɔmfa mfõwa anomu nkoku Jabesh-gileadmba no, nka mbaa na mbofraba ho.
Na iyi nye adze a hom nyɛ; ɔbanyin biar na ɔbaa biara a ɔbarimba nye no ada no, hom nsɛɛ hɔn pasapasa.
Na wohun Jabesh-gileadmba no mu mbaabun ahaanan a wonnyim ɔbarimba dɛ wɔnye no ada: Na wɔdze hɔn baa nseraban no mu wɔ Shiloh a ɔwɔ Canaan asaase do.
Na mboanofo no nyina somaa ma wɔkɛkasaa kyerɛɛ Benjaminmba a wɔwɔ Rimmon ɔbotan mu no, na wɔpaa mu kãa nsiesie ho asɛm kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na Benjamin sanee baa aber no mu; na wɔdze mbaa a wɔgyee hɔn nkwa wɔ Jabesh-gilead mbaa mu no maa hɔn: Na dɛm no mpo so annsõ hɔn ano.
Na ɔman no nuu hɔn ho wɔ Benjamin ntsi, osiandɛ Ewuradze ama ntsewmu aba Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu.
Nna mboanofo no mu mpanyimfo no see dɛ, yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ama hɔn a wɔaka no wɔ yernom ho afamu, ɔnam dɛ mbaa ase ekum wɔ Benjamin mu yi?
Na wɔsee dɛ, ɔregye dɛ egyapadze bi ko hɔ ma hɔn a wofii nsa wɔ Benjamin mu no, ma wɔammpepa ebusuakuw bi emmfi Israel mu.
Naaso yɛremmfa hɛn mbabaa mma hɔn ayewar: Osiandɛ Israelmba aka ntam dɛ, ndom nkã nyia ɔbɛma Benjamin yer.
Na wɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, wodzi Ewuradze n’afe afrenhyia afrenhyia wɔ Shiloh a ɔwɔ Beth-el kwaamu afamu, wɔ ɔtsempɔn a ofi Beth-el kɔ Shechem no no boka afamu, na Lebonah no pomu afamu.
Na wɔhyɛɛ Benjaminmba no dɛ, hom nkɔ nkɛtsetsɛw wenyin nture no mu;
na hom nhwɛ, na, hwɛ, sɛ Shiloh mbabaa no pue bɛsaw wɔ asaw no mu a, ɔno hom mfi wenyin nture no mu mpue, nã hom mbɛkyekyer yernom nkorkor wɔ Shiloh mbabaa no mu, na wɔmfa nkɔ Benjamin asaase do.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ hɔn egyanom anaa hɔn nuanom ba bedzi ho nkɔmbɔ kyerɛ hɛn a, yɛbɛse hɔn dɛ, hom mfa hɔn ndom hɛn: Osiandɛ yenngyaa yernom amma hɔn nkorkor wɔ ɔkõ no mu: Nkyii so nnyɛ hom bi na wɔdze hɔn maa hɔn: Ɔnodze nkyɛ hom bedzi sõ.

Na Benjaminmba yɛɛ dɛm, na wɔfefaa yernom dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse wɔ hɔn a wɔbɛsawee a wɔkyekteer hɔn a wɔbɛsawee a wɔkyekyeer hɔn no mu: Na wosii mu sanee kɔr hɔn egyapadze do, na wɔbɛkyekyeer nkurow, na wɔtsenatsenaa mu.
Na Israelmba no fii hɔ aber mu kɔree, nyimpa biara kɔr n'ebusuakuw na n'ebusua mu, na nyimpa biara fii hɔ kɔr n'egyapadze do.
Nda no mu no na ɔhen bi nnyi Israel: Nyimpa biara dza ɔtsen wɔ noara n'enyi do no na ɔyɛ.

1: Mbrɛ kurow a nkyɛ no mu nkorɔfo mã ayɛ bɔɔ a! Mbrɛ oedua ayɛ dɛ kunafo a! Nyia nkyɛ ɔyɛ kɛse wɔ amanaman mu, na ɔhembaa wɔ amantɔw mu no, mbrɛ oedua adan ɔsomfo a!
Osū ara na osū anago, na ne nyinsuwa eguar no; onnya n'adɔfo nyinara mu obiara a ɔkyekye no werɛ: Ne mfɛfo nyinara etwitwa no nkontompɔ, wɔadan n'atamfo.
Judah etu kɔ ndɔmmum mu wɔ amandzehu ntsi, na sonhia kɛse ntsi; ɔtse abosonsɔrfo mu, onnya ahomgye: Hɔn a wɔtaa no do no nyinara kɔtoo no dɛ oehin mu ahar mu.
Zion n'akwan ridzi nkɔmbɔ, osiandɛ obi mmba nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn no ase; no mbobokɛse nyinara mu ayɛ bɔɔ, n'asɔfoe risi nkrum: Ne nkataasia werɛ ahow, na noara so ayɛ no wenwen.
N'ahohiahiafo ebedzi tsir, n'atamfo ayɛ prɔmprɔm; na Ewuradze ahow no werɛ wɔ ne mbrato no dodow ntsi: Ne mba nkakraba edzi ahohiahiafo enyim kɔ ndɔmmum mu.
Na Zion babaa n'akɛseyɛ nyinara efi no ho kɔ: Ne mbapɔmba ayɛ dɛ ntwe a wonnya edzidzibea, na wodzi hɔn tsiwfo enyim kɔ dɛ wonnyi ahoɔdzen.

Jerusalem kaa wɔ n'awerɛhow na n'amandzehu nda no mu n'akɔndɔdze a ɔwɔ hɔ fir tsetse nda mu no nyinara: Ber a ne man kɔtɔɔ ahohiahiafo nsamu, na obiara ammboa no no, ahohiahiafo hun no no, wosii n'amamfoyɛ ho atwetwe.
Jerusalem ayɛ bɔn kɛsekɛse; dɛm ntsi na ɔayɛ dɛ efifidze yi: Hɔn a wodzii no nyi nyinara wommbu no bi, osiandɛ woehu n'adagyaw: Nyew, osi nkrum, na ɔsan ekyir.
Ne fī kekãa n'asetar mu; ɔannkaa n'ewiei dɛm ntsi na ɔabrɛ adze nwanwa mu; onnyi ɔwerɛkyekyefo: O Ewuradze, hwɛ m'amandzehu; osiandɛ ɔtamfo no ekunkon noho.
Ahohiahianyi no atserɛw ne nsamu akata n'akɔndɔdze nyinara do; osiandɛ oehu dɛ abosonsɔrfo ahɛn no krɔnkrɔn-bea, hɔn a ehyɛɛ hɔn ho mbra dɛ mma wɔnnhɛn wo mboanofo mu no.
Ne man nyinara si nkrum, wɔhwehwɛ edziban; wɔdze hɔn akɔndɔdze amema agye edziban a wɔdze bɔdwedwe ɔkra: Ewuradze e, hwɛ, na hu; na mo ho ayɛ nkɔw.
Hom a hom rutwa mu sen nyina, aso ɔnnyɛ hom ho asɛm? Hom nhwɛ, na hom nhu kyerɛ dɛ yaw bi wɔ hɔ a ɔtse dɛ me yaw a akã me a Ewuradze dze ahow mo werɛ wɔ n'ebufuw da mu yi.
Ofir ɔsor na ɔasoma ogya aba me mbiew mu, na odzi do nyim: Oesua m'anan efir, ɔasan me ekyir; ɔama mayɛ kyirpaanyi na matɔ bitsi adzekyee nyina.
Ɔdze ne nsa akyekyer me mbrato kɔndua no; wɔdze hɔn atoatoa mu, woedu mo kɔn ho; ɔama m'ahoɔdzen apa: Ewuradze eyi me ahyɛ hɔn a munntum hɔn enyim gyina nsa.
Ewuradze ammfa m'akatakyi a wɔtse mo mu no emmbu hwee; ɔafrɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn etsia me dɛ wɔmbɔdwerew me mberantsɛ: Ewuradze etsiatsia Judah babaa ɔbaabun no do dɛ wenyintwer mu.
Ndzɛmba yinom ntsi na musū; m'enyiwa, m'enyiwa kyi nyinsuwa gu famu; osiandɛ ɔwerɛkyekyefo a ɔbɔdwedwe me kra no, ɔnye me ntamu atwe: Me mba ayɛ ekyirpaafo, osiandɛ ɔtamfo no edzi nyim.
Zion tserɛw ne nsamu; obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔkyekye no werɛ; Ewuradze ahyɛ wɔ Jacob ho dɛ, hɔn a wɔabɔ no ho aprɔw nyinara wɔnnyɛ n'ahohiahiafo: Jerusalem wɔ hɔn mu dɛ efifidze.
Ewuradze yɛ tseneneenyi; na matsew ne mbrasɛm do etūa: Aman nyina, meserɛ hom, hom ntsie, na hom nhwɛ me yaw: Me nkataasia na me mberantsɛ kɔ ndɔmmum mu.
Mefrɛfrɛɛ me nwewefo, na hɔndze wɔdaadaa me: M'asɔfoe na me mpanyimfo gyaagyaa hɔn sunsum mu wɔ kurow no mu, ber a wɔrohwehwɛ edziban abɔbɔ hɔn akɔhoma no.
Ewuradze, hwɛ; mowɔ ahokyer mu; mo nson mu hyehye me; m'akoma etwa noho wɔ mo mu; osiandɛ matsew etūa kɛsekɛse ntsi: Guado ɛ, afõwa ruhwinhwim kɔ, fie so ɛ, owu dɛmara.
Wɔatse dɛ misi nkrum; obi nnyi hɔ a ɔkyekye mo werɛ; m'atamfo nyina atse mo fona; ɔyɛ hɔn dɛw dɛ ɔwo na ayɛ: Ebɛma da a akã ato hɔ no edu, na hɔn so wɔayɛ dɛ emi.
Ma hɔn emumuyɛ nyina mbra w'enyim; na yɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ edze ayɛ me wɔ me mbrato nyinara ntsi. Na mo nkrumsi adɔɔ sõ, na m'akoma atɔ bitsi.
2: Mbrɛ Ewuradze edua dze fua akata Zion babaa do wɔ n'ebufuw mu a! Ofi sor atow Israel n'ahoɔfɛw akyen asaase do, na ɔnnkaa n'ananadzegua wɔ n'ebufuw da no mu.
Ewuradze amen Jacob ne ntsenabea nyina, na oennhu mbɔbɔr; oedwuruw Judah babaa n'aban dzendzen wɔ n'ebufuw mu; ɔdze hɔn akã famu: Oegu ahendzi na no mu mbapɔmba no ho fī.
Oetwa Israel ambɛn nyina wɔ n'ebufuhyew mu; ɔatwe ne nsa nyimfa ekyir efi ɔtamfo no enyim: Na ɔahyew Jacob dɛ gyaframee a ɔhyew bɔ aprɔw.
Ɔakontom n'egyen dɛ ɔtamfo, ɔdze ne nsa nyimfa egyina dɛ ahohiahianyi, na oekuku dza ɔyɛ fɛw wɔ enyiwa do nyina oehue n'ebufuhyew egu dɛ ogya, wɔ Zion babaa n'asesee mu.
Ewuradze adan dɛ ɔtamfo, ɔamen Israel; ɔamemen n'ahemfi nyinara, ɔasɛɛ n'akoban: Na ɔama Judah babaa no nkɔmbɔdzi na sukwadwom adɔɔ sõ.

Na ɔdze enyimpi eyi ne ntamadan, dɛ gyama ture bi nedze; ɔasɛɛ no guabɔbea: Ewuradze ama werɛ efir nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn na ahomgyeda wɔ Zion. Na n'ebufuw ne hyeehyew no mu oebu ɔhen no na ɔsɔfo no enyimtsia.
Ewuradze atow n'afɔrmbukyia akyen, na no krɔnkrɔn-bea ho ayɛ no mfon, ɔdze n'ahemfie afasu no ahyɛ ɔtamfo no nsa; ɔayɛ dede wɔ Ewuradze fie, dɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn da mu.
Ewuradze esua ne tsir mu dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ Zion babaa n'afasu; ɔatwe ahoma no mu, ɔnntwee ne nsa ekyir nngyaa dɛ ɔresɛɛ adze: Na ɔama pampi na fasu etwa sukwadwom; wɔabɔ mu afomfɔn.
No mbobokɛse no amem famu; ɔasɛɛ n'adaban no na oebubu mu. Na hen na ne mbapɔmba wɔ amanaman a mbra nnyi mu no mu; nyew, no nkɔnhyɛfo nnya Ewuradze hɔ enyido-adzehu.
Zion babaa ne mpanyimfo tsetse famu, wɔayeyɛ kunkomm; woetu huntuma egugu hɔn etsifi, wɔdze enyitam esisi hɔn asen: Jerusalem mbaabun esisi hɔn etsir adze.
Nyinsuwa ama m'enyiwa resã, mo nson mu hyehye me, me mberɛbo ehue egu famu, wɔ me man ne babaa ne sɛɛe ntsi; osiandɛ mbofra nkakraba na enumfoanomba atotɔ bitsi wɔ kurow n'abrɔn no mu.
Wɔsese hɔn nanom dɛ, Henfa na eburow na wenyin wɔ? Ber a wɔatotɔ bitsi dɛ epirafo wɔ kurow n'abrɔn no mu, ber a woehue hɔn kra egu hɔn nanom hɔn bo mu.
Ebɛn dase na mindzi nkyerɛ wo? Jerusalem babaa, ebɛn na memfa monto wo ho? Zion babaa baabun, ebɛn na memma ɔnye wo nsɛ, mfa nkyekye wo werɛ? Na wo pira sõ dɛ po: Woana botum ayɛ wo edur?
Wo nkɔnhyɛfo ehu egyangyandze na nkwaseasɛm ho enyido-adzehu ama wo; na wommbuee w'emumuyɛ do, dɛ wɔdze wo ndɔmmumkɔ bɛsan aba; na mbom woehu egyangyandze ho nkɔnhyɛsɛm na ananadzeturtow.
Hɔn a wotwa mu sen nyina bɔ hɔn nsamu gu wo do; wɔsesar Jerusalem babaa na wɔwosow hɔn tsir gu no do, dɛ: Aso iyi nye kurow a adasamba frɛ no ahoɔfɛw a oedzi mu, asaase nyina enyigye no?
W'atamfo nyina ahanhan hɔn anomu wɔ wo do; wɔsesar na wɔtwɛr hɔn sē; wɔkã dɛ, yɛamemen no; ampaara da a yɛhwɛɛ no kwan no nye yi; yeenya, yeehu.
Ewuradze ayɛ dza osusui no; ɔama n'asɛm a ɔhyɛe wɔ tsetse nda mu no aba mu; oedwuruw egu famu, onnyaa tsimbɔbɔr: Na ɔama ɔtamfo edzi wo eduwa; ɔama w'ahohiahiafo ambɛn do.
Hɔn akoma kekaa mu frɛɛ Ewuradze: Zion babaa ne fasu, ma nyinsuwa mpem dɛ esutsen adzekyee na anago; mma nntuow mu, mma mma w'enyiwakyiresua nnda.
Soɛr, keka mu wɔ anago, wɔ adasu n'ahyɛse; hue w'akoma dɛ nsu gu wɔ Ewuradze n'enyim: Ma wo nsa do kyerɛ no do wɔ wo mbofra nkakraba no hɔn nkwa ntsi, ɔkɔm ntsi wɔtotɔ bitsi bɔ abrɔn biara etsifi.
Ewuradze e, hwɛ, na hu nyia ayɛ no dɛm yi! Aso mbaa bedzi hɔn yafun mu adze, mbofraba a wɔagyegye hɔn hɔn nsamu? Aso woboku ɔsɔfo na nkɔnhyɛnyi wɔ Ewuradze no krɔnkrɔnbea?
Aberantsɛ na akodaa wɔda famu wɔ abrɔn mu; me nkataasia na me mberantsɛ atotɔ afõwa anomu: Ekuku hɔn w'ebufuw da no mu; eku, na ennhu mbɔbɔr.
Ɔwo afrɛ m'hoyidze wɔ mbea nyina dɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn da no mu, na obiara nnyi hɔ a ofii nsa anaa ɔkae wɔ Ewuradze n'ebufuw da no mu: Hɔn a magyegye hɔn na manyɛn hɔn no, me tamfo ama wɔasã.
3: Emi nye barimba a mehu amandze wɔ n'ebufuw abaa no ano.
Oegya me na ɔama manantsew sum mu na nnyɛ kan mu a.
Ampaara emi ara na ɔdandan ne nsa tsiatsia me adzekyee nyina.
Ɔama mo honam na mo wer ayɛ dadaw; oebubu me mbiew.
Ɔatow esiw me kwan, na ɔdze bɔwema na awoko etwa mo ho ehyia.
Ɔama matsena mbea a ɔyɛ sum mu, dɛ hɔn a woewu akyɛr.
Ɔagye mo ho ban, na munntum mimmfir edzi; ɔama mo nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no ayɛ dur.
Nyew, sɛ musū mefrɛ mboa a, osiw me mpaayi kwan.
Ɔdze abo a woetwa ato m'atsɛmpɔn mu fasu, ɔakyeakyea m'akwan.
Ɔayɛ dɛ osisi a ɔretsɛw ama me, dɛ ogyata a ɔhyɛ mbea a osuma mu.
Ɔadan m'akwan akɔ nkyɛn, na ɔatsetsew mo mu esinesin; ɔama mayɛ kyirpaanyi.
Ɔakontom n'egyen, na ɔdze me esi hɔ dɛ botae ama egyen-menaba.
Ɔama n'egyen-kotoku mu egyen-menaba ahɛn me nsɛbɛ mu.
Madan ɔsesɛba mama me man nyina; na hɔn ndwom adzekyee nyina.
Ɔdze wenwen ahyɛ me mã, ɔama bɔwen afon me.
Eso ɔdze mbosabo ebubu me sē, ɔdze nso akata mo do.
Na ɔwo eyi me kra efi asomdwee ho kɔ ekyirkyir; mo werɛ fir prɔmprɔmyɛ.
Na mesee dɛ, m'ahoɔdzen ahera, na m'enyisundze a ofir Ewuradze hɔ no.
Kaa m'amandzehu na m'awerɛhow, ɔbɔwen na ɔbɔwema no.
Me kra da ho ara kaa, na ɔabrɛ adze wɔ mo mu.
Iyi na mefrɛ m'adwen wɔ do, dɛm ntsi na mowɔ enyidado yi.
Ewuradze n'ehumbɔbɔr ntsi na yennhyewee yi, osiandɛ n'ayamuhyehye mmpa da.
Wɔyɛ fofor anapa pem nyina; wo nokwardzi sõ.
Ewuradze nye me kyɛfã, me kra na ɔse; dɛm ntsi m'enyi da no do.
Ewuradze ye dze ma hɔn a wɔtweɔn no no, dze ma ɔkra a ɔhwehwɛ n'ekyir kwan no.
Oye ma ɔdasanyi dɛ n'enyi bɛda do na ɔayɛ komm atweɔn Ewuradze no nkwagye.
Oye ma ɔdasanyi dɛ ɔsoa no kɔndua wɔ ne mbafobermu.
Osiandɛ ɔdze ato no do ntsi, ma no nko ntsena hɔ na ɔnyɛ komm.
Ma ɔmfa n'ano mbutuw huntuma mu; sɛ bi a enyidado bi bɛba a.
Ma ɔmfa n'afon mma nyia ɔbɔ mu no; ma ahorohoraa nhyɛ no mā-tɔ.
Na Ewuradze nnkɔtow akyen ara afebɔɔ.
Na kaansa ɔhyɛ werɛhow mpo a, ne yamu bɛhyehye no wɔ no mbɔbɔrhu dodow ntsi.
Na onnhiahia ho ɔpɛdo, eso onnyi adasamba awerɛhow.
Dɛ wɔbɔdwerew asaase do adaduafo wɔ ananadze,
Dɛ wɔbɛdan ɔdasanyi ne ndzinoa ato nkyɛn wɔ ɔsorsornyi no enyim,
Dɛ wɔbɛdan ɔdasanyi n'asɛm enyi, Ewuradze mmpen do.
Woana na ɔkã ma ɔba mu, ber a Ewuradze nnhyɛe no?
Ana nnyɛ ɔsorsornyi no n'anomu na mbusu na siar fir ba?
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na nyimpa tseasenyi dzi nkɔmbɔ, nyimpa dzi nkɔmbɔ wɔ no bɔn ho ntsēa ho?
Wɔmma yɛnhwehwɛ hɛn akwan mu na yɛmpɛ mu, na yɛnsan nkɔ Ewuradze hɔ.
Wɔmma yɛmmema hɛn akoma ɔnye hɛn nsa do mma Nyame wɔ sorsor.
Hɛn na yɛatõ mbra na yɛatsew etūa; ɔwo emmfae nnkyɛe.
Edze ebufuw akata woho na etsiw hɛn; ekuku, ennhu mbɔbɔr.
Edze nsuwusiw akata woho, amma hɛn mpaabɔ eennhwira mu.
Ɔwo ayɛ hɛn nwurabanwuraba na ntɔmpamu wɔ aman finimfin.
Hɛn atamfo nyinara ahanhan hɔn anomu petopetoo wɔ hɛn do.
Suro na mona abɛda hɛn do, amamfõ na ɔsɛɛ.
M'enyiwa kyi nyinsuwa esutsen gu famu, wɔ me man ne babaa ne sɛɛe ntsi.
M'enyiwa wora nsu gu famu, na onngyaa, ɔnntow mu,
Ekodu dɛ Ewuradze bɔwɔ ne tsir adze na oefi ɔsor ahwɛ.
M'enyiwa kitsa me kra, wɔ mo kurow ne mbabaa nyinara ntsi.
Hɔn a wɔyɛ m'atamfo kwa no, woetsiw me dɛ anoma.
Woetwa mo nkwa do wɔ monaefiadze no mu, na woesun ɔbo ato mo do.
Esu no praam me tsir do; mesee dɛ, woetwa me akyen.
Ewuradze, mifi mona no n'ase noho noho mobɔɔ wo dzin.
Ɔwo itsiee me ndze; mma nnsiw w'aso wɔ me nkrumsi do, wɔ mo sufrɛ do.
Ɔwo etwee pinkyɛnee wɔ da a mefrɛɛ wo no: Ɔwo esee dɛ, Mma nnsuro.
Ewuradze, ɔwo edzi me kra n'asɛm ama no; ɔwo apon me kra.
Ewuradze, ɔwoara ehu mfom a wɔdze afom me; bua m'atsɛn ma me.
Ɔwo ehu hɔn awerdze nyina na hɔn tsirmpam nyina a wɔpam wɔ mo ho no.
Ewuradze, ɔwoara atse hɔn ahorohoraa, na hɔn tsirmpam nyina a wɔdze tsia me no;
hɔn a wɔsoɛree tsiaa me hɔn anofamfa, na hɔn adwendwen a wɔdwendwenee tsiaa me adzekyee nyina.
Hwɛ hɔn asetena, na hɔn soɛr; emi nye hɔn ndwom.
Ewuradze, ɔwoara bɛma hɔn ahyɛnanmu akatua, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nsaano edwuma tse.
Ebɛma hɔn akoma dzen, wo ndom nkã hɔn.
Ɔwo ibetsiw hɔn ebufuw mu, na asɛɛ hɔn efi Ewuradze no sorsor no ase.
4: Mbrɛ sika enyi edua ebisiw a! Mbrɛ sika mapa twann edua asakyer a! Krɔnkrɔn-bea abo no woehue egugu abrɔn biara ne tsir.
Zion mbabanyin a wɔsom bo a wɔdze hɔn to sika mapa ho no, mbrɛ woedua ebu hɔn dɛ dɛtse nsenaba, ɔwemfo ne nsaano edwuma a!
Mpataku mpo wɔtwe enumfo, wɔma hɔn mba wonum: Me man ne babaa adan otsirmɔdzennyi, dɛ sar do nsohor.
Akɔkowaba ne tɛkyerɛma fam n'anomu wɔ nsukɔm ntsi: Mbofra nkakraba bisa edziban, na nyimpa biara mmbu bi mma hɔn.
Hɔn a wodzii aberɛberɛdze ayeyɛ ekyirpaafo wɔ abrɔn mu: Hɔn a wɔnyɛɛn hɔn serdaa mu no wɔyɛ nsumina etuu.
Na me man ne babaa n'emumuyɛ sõ sen Sodom no bɔn, ɔno a wobutuuw no amonmu, na nsa biara ennsuo no mu.
N'ekunyin ho tsew sen esukwankyɛba, wɔhoa sen enumfonsu, hɔn honamenyi ber mu sen nankyenema, hɔn ho senasena dɛ sapphire bo:
Hɔn enyim bir sen ogyabiriw; wonnyim hɔn wɔ abrɔn mu: Hɔn honanwer femfam hɔn mbiew ho; ɔakyenkyen, ɔayɛ dɛ dua.
Hɔn a wɔtotɔ afowa ano no woye sen hɔn a ɔkɔm kuku hɔn; na woyinom woehwirahwira hɔn mu, ayeyɛ nkamfenkamfe, wɔ mfuwa mu nduadzewa a abɔ hɔn no ntsi.
Mbaa a wɔyɛ tsimbɔbɔr hɔn nsa anoa hɔnankasa hɔn mba; wɔyɛɛ hɔn edziban wɔ me man ne babaa ne sɛɛe ntsi.
Ewuradze awie n'abufuhyew fa, oehue n'ebufuw dzendzen no egu; na oekūa ogya bi wɔ Zion a ɔamemen ne mfapem no.
Asaase do ahemfo anngye enndzi, wɔnye wiadze do atsefo nyinara so, dɛ ɔhohiahianyi na ɔtamfo bɛba abɛhɛn Jerusalem mbobokɛse mu.
No nkɔnhyɛfo hɔn bɔn, na n'asɔfoe hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi a, na wɔakã atseneneefo bɔgyaa egu wɔ ne finimfim.
Wɔwonawona dɛ efurafo wɔ abrɔn mu, bɔgya egu hɔn ho fī, ma dɛm ntsi adasa nntum nnkã hɔn ntar.
Wɔtsēaa mu kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, hom mfi hɔ, ahoɔfifo! Hom mfi hɔ, hom mfi hɔ, mma hom mmfa hom nsa nnkã: Aber a woguanee kekyinkyinii no, adasa kãe wɔ amanaman mu dɛ, wɔnnkɛyɛ amamforafora wɔ ha bio.
Ewuradze n'ebufuw apaapaa hɔn mu; ɔnnkɛda ho ebu hɔn bi bio: Woemmbu asɔfo no enyim bi, mpanyimfo no ennya hɔn enyim enyimpa.
Hɛn enyiwa da ho bu dɛ ɔhwɛ hɛn mboa gyangyan kwan: Hɛn aweɔn mu yɛaweɔn ama ɔman bi a onnkotum nkwa gye.
Wɔtwee hɛn anamɔn, ma yenntum nnkɔ hɛn abrɔn mu: Hɛn ewie abɛn, hɛn nda asõ; osiandɛ hɛn ewiei aba.
Hɛn etsiwfo hɔn ho yɛ har se ɔsor nkɔr: Wotsiiw hɛn mbepɔw do, wɔtsɛɛw hɛn sar do.
Hɛn ahwentokura mu ahom, nyia Ewuradze asera no no, wɔkyeer no wɔ hɔn amona mu; ɔno na yɛkãe wɔ no ho dɛ, no nwin ase na yebenya nkwa wɔ amanaman mu.
Edom babaa a etse Uz asaase do, dzi ehurusi na ma w'enyi ngye: Kɔɔpow no botwa mu aba wo so wo hɔ; ebɔbow, na wɔato wo pan.
Zion babaa, w'emumuyɛ ho ntsēa no ewie; ɔrennda ho nnsoa wo nnkɔ ndɔmmum mu: Edom babaa, ɔbɛsera w'emumuyɛ; ɔbɛda wo bɔn edzi.
5: Ewuradze, kaa dza aba hɛn do: Hwɛ, na hu hɛn ahorohoraa.
Wɔadan hɛn egyapadze ama ahɔho, hɛn efi ama ananaben.
Yɛayɛ enyisaba na gyanka, hɛn nanom ayɛ dɛ ekunafo.
Yeetua sika anom hɛnankasa hɛn nsu; wɔdze hɛn nyena atɔn hɛn.
Hɛn etsiwfo dze hɛn kɔn ekyir: Yɛaberɛ, na yeennya ahomgye.
Yɛdze hɛn nsa ama Egyptfo, na Assyriafo, ma yeenya edziban amee.
Hɛn egyanom ayɛ bɔn, na wonnyi hɔ; na hɛndze yɛasoa hɔn emumuyɛ.
Nkowaa dzi hɛn do tum: Obi nnyi hɔ a ɔgye hɛn fi hɔn nsamu.
Hɛn nkwa kitsakitsa hɛn nsamu na yɛkɛfa hɛn edziban Wɔ sar do afõwa no ntsi.
Hɛn wer ahyew tumm dɛ fononoo wɔ ɔkɔm ne gyaframee ntsi.
Woguu Zion mbaa enyim ase, Judah nkurow mu mbabaawa no.
Wɔkyekyeer mbapɔmba nsa sensɛnee: Wɔannhwɛ mpanyimfo enyim emmbu hɔn bi.
Hɔn mberantsɛ soaa ewuyambo, na mbofra fintsiwii wɔ nyenafi ase.
Mpanyimfo egyaa abobotsen ano ba, mberantsɛ egyaa hɔn sanku bɔ.
Hɛn akoma n'enyigye abɔ adze; hɛn asaw adan nkɔmbɔdzi.
Abɔtsir no efi hɛn tsir egu: Yendue! Osiandɛ yɛayɛ bɔn.
Iyi ntsi na hɛn akoma atɔ bitsi; ndzɛmba yinom ntsi na hɛn enyiwa ayɛ kusukusu;
Zion bepɔw a ayɛ amamfõ ntsi; nsɔ nenam do.
Ewuradze, ɔwoara na etse hɔ daa; w'ahengua fir ebusuasantsen kodu abusuasantsen.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wo werɛ fir hɛn daa, na epa hɛn mber tsentsen dɛm yi?
Ewuradze, san hɛn bra wo nkyɛn na yɛbɛsan; yɛ hɛn nda fofor dɛ tsetse dze no.
Na ɔwo apow hɛn koraa, wo bo efuw hɛn dodoodow.

1: Na Ewuradze frɛɛ Moses, na ofii ehyiadzibuw no mu kasaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom mu nyimpa biara dze ayɛyɛdze rebrɛ Ewuradze a, fiembowa, mekyerɛ anantwi, nye nguan mu bi, na hom mfa nyɛ hom ayɛyɛdze mbra.
Sɛ n'ayɛyɛdze yɛ ɔhyew-afɔr a ofi anantwi mu a, ɔmfa onyin a onndzi dzɛm mbra; ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano na ɔmfa no mbra, ama aayɛ enyisɔ wɔ Ewuradze enyim ama no.
Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto ɔhyew-afɔr no n'etsifi; na ɔnsɔ enyi mma no ma ɔmpata mma no.
Na onku nanatwisaa no wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Na Aaron mbabanyin, asɔfo no, mfa bɔgya no mbɛkyerɛ, na wɔmfa bɔgya no mpetse afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano no do nhyia.
Na ɔnyɛr ɔhyewafɔr no, na ontwitwa no esinesin.
Na ɔsɔfo Aaron ne mbabanyin no mfa gya ngu afɔrmbukyia no do, na wonsiesie nyena wɔ gya no do;
na Aaron mbabanyin, asɔfo no, mfa esinesin no, tsir no, nye seradze no, nguyie wɔ nyena erma ɔsɔw gya no afɔrmbukyia no do no do;
n'ayamudze nye ne ntwɛr dze ɔmfa nsu nhohor ho: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew ne nyinara wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, ma ɔnyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr, makyerɛ ogya-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma Ewuradze.
Na sɛ n'ayɛyɛdze fi nguankuw mu, nkɔsɔw anaa mpɔnkye mu, na ɔdze ro bɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr a; ɔmfa onyin a onndzi dzɛm mbra.
Na onku no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no ne nkyɛn mu kwaamu afamu wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Na Aaron mbabanyin, asɔfo no, mfa no bɔgyaa mpetse afɔrmbukyia no do nhyia.
Na ontwitwa no esinesin, nka ne tsir nye ne seradze ho; na ɔsɔfo no nsiesie no yie ngu nyena no a ɔwɔ gya no a ɔwɔ afɔrmbukyia no do no do:
Ayamudze nye ntwɛr no dze ɔmfa nsu nhohor ho: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nyinara mbra, na ɔmbɛhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: Ɔyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr, mekyerɛ ogya-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma Ewuradze.
Na sɛ n'ayɛyɛdze fi nnoma mu a ɔdze robɔbɔ Ewuradze ɔhyew-afɔr a, ɔno ɔmfa ntamram, anaa mborɔnomamba bi nyɛ n'ayɛyɛdze mbra.
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa mbra afɔrmbukyia no ho, na ɔntsew ne tsir, na ɔnhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do; na no bɔgyaa no nkyi ngu afɔrmbukyia no ho:
Na onyi no totuaa nka no mu ifī no ho, na ɔntow nkyen afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn wɔ boka afamu, wɔ mbrɛ nso no gu no:
Na onsuan mu wɔ n'atsaban ho, na mma ɔnntsew mu: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, wɔ nyena no a ɔwɔ gya no do no do: Ɔyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr, mekyerɛ ogya-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma Ewuradze.
2: Na sɛ obiara dze edziban-afɔr ayɛyɛdze rebrɛ Ewuradze a, n'ayɛyɛdze no nyɛ isiam pa; na onhue ngo ngu do, na ɔmfa krɔbɔw nto do:

Na ɔmfa mbrɛ Aaron mbabanyin asɔfo no: Na ɔmfa isiam pa, nye no ngo no ne nsapuw, ɔnye no krɔbɔw no nyinara: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no dɛ nkaadze wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, ogya-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma Ewuradze:
Na edziban-afɔr no mu dza ɔbɛka no nyɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin dze: Ɔyɛ Ewuradze ogya-afɔr mu krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn.
Na sɛ edze edziban-afɔr ayɛyɛdze a wɔtõ no wɔ fononoo mu bi rebɛba a, fa isiam pa epitsi tatar a wɔafrɔw no ngo, anaa epitsi tatar-ntrɛtraba a wɔasera ho ngo.
Na sɛ w'ayɛyɛdze no yɛ ɔtosɛn mu edziban-afɔr a, ma ɔnyɛ isiam pa epitsi a w'afrɔw no ngo.
Bubu mu esinesin, na hue ngo ngo gu do: Ɔyɛ edziban-afɔr.
Na sɛ w'ayɛyɛdze no yɛ ɔkyesɛn mu edziban afɔr a, fa isiam pa nye ngo yɛ.
Na fa edziban-afɔr a wɔdze ndzɛmba yinom ayɛ no brɛ Ewuradze: Wɔmfa ma ɔsɔfo no, ma ɔmfa mbra afɔrmbukyia no ho.
Na ɔsɔfo no nyi edziban-afɔr no do nkaadze no, na ɔnhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: Ɔyɛ ogya-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma Ewuradze.
Na Edziban-afɔr no mu dza ɔbɛka no nyɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin dze: Ɔyɛ Ewuradze ogya-afɔr mu krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn.
Edziban-afɔr biara a hom dze bɛbrɛ Ewuradze no, mma wɔmmfa mbɔrkaw myɛ: Na mma hom nnhyew mbɔrkaw, anaa ewo biara, dɛ ogya-afɔr mma Ewuradze.
Hom mfa iyinom mbrɛ Ewuradze, dɛ nduadzewakan ayɛyɛdze: Na afɔrmbukyia no do dze, na mma bi mmba mmbeyi nka huanhuam.
Na w'edziban-afɔr ayɛyɛdze biara fa nkyen to mu; nkyii so mma wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛmu nkyen no mmpa w'edziban-afɔr mu: W'ayɛyɛdze nyinara mu fa nkyen ka ho bra.
Na sɛ edze nduadzewakan ayɛyɛdze rebrɛ Ewuradze a, fa eburow mbɛtsem a wɔatotõ no ogya mu, eburow mbɛtsem nomanoma a wɔapose, yɛ wo nduadzewakan mu ayɛyɛdze bra.
Na fa ngo gu do, na fa krɔbɔw to do: Ɔyɛ edziban-afɔr.
Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew ne nkaadze no, n'eburow mposee no bi, nye no ngo no bi, nye no krɔbɔw no nyinara; ɔyɛ ogya-afɔr ma Ewuradze.
3: Na sɛ n'ayɛyɛdze yɛ asomdwee-afɔr afɔrbɔdze; sɛ ofi anantwi mu, dɛ onyim o, ɔber o, na ɔdze reba o, dza onndzi dzɛm na ɔmfa no mbra Ewuradze enyim.
Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n'ayɛyɛdze no etsifi, na onku no wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano: Na Aaron mbabanyin asɔfo no mfa bɔgya no mpetse afɔrmbukyia no do nhyia.
Na onyi asomdwee-afɔr no mu bi mbra mbɛyɛ ogya-afɔr mma Ewuradze; seradze a ɔkata ayamudze do no, nye seradze a ɔwɔ do no,
nye nsɛbɛ ebien no, nye seradze a ɔwɔ do no, dza ɔwɔ sisiw mu, nye berɛbo do ntentan no, nye nsɛbɛ no, onyi mfi hɔ.
Na Aaron mbabanyin no hyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do ɔhyew-afɔr no a ɔwɔ nyena no a ɔwɔ ogya no do no do: Ɔyɛ ogya-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma Ewuradze.
Na sɛ n'ayɛyɛdze a ɔdze rebɛyɛ asomdwee-afɔr afɔrbɔdze ama Ewuradze no fi nguan mu a; onyin o, ɔber o, dza onndzi dzɛm na ɔmfa no mbra.
Sɛ ɔdze eguambaa rebɛyɛ n'ayɛyɛdze a, ɔno ɔmfa no mbra Ewuradze enyim:
Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n'ayɛyɛdze no etsifi, na onku no wɔ ehyiadzibuw no enyim: Na Aaron mbabanyin no mfa no bɔgyaa mpetse afɔrmbukyia no do nhyia.

Na onyi asomdwee-afɔr no bi mbra mbɛyɛ Ewuradze ogya-afɔr; ne seradze no, seradze dua mu no, ɔntwe no wɔ n'ekyir-kratse no ho; na seradze a ɔkata ayamudze no ho no, nye seradze a ɔwɔ ayamudze no do no nyinara,
nye nsɛbɛ ebien nu, nye no do seradze no a ɔwɔ sisiw mu no, nye berɛbo do ntentan no, nye nsɛbɛ no, onyi mfi hɔ.
Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: Ɔyɛ ogya-afɔr edziban ma Ewuradze.
Na sɛ n'ayɛyɛdze yɛ apɔnkye a, ɔno ɔmfa no mbra Ewuradze enyim:
Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n'etsifi, na onku no wɔ ehyiadzebuw no enyim; na Aaron ne mbabanyin no mfa no bɔgyaa mpetse afɔrmbukyia no do nhyia.
Na onyi mu bi mbra mbɛyɛ n'ayɛyɛdze, mekyerɛ ogya-afɔr mma Ewuradze; seradze a ɔkata ayamudze no ho no, nye seradze a ɔwɔ ayamudze no do no nyinara,
nye nsɛbɛ ebien no, nye no do seradze no a ɔwɔ sisiw mu no, nye berɛbo do ntentan no, nye nsɛbɛ no, onyi mfi hɔ.
Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: Ɔyɛ ogya-afɔr ezdiban a oyi nka huanhuam: Seradze no nyinara yɛ Ewuradze dze.
Ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ hom ebusuasantsen mu wɔ hom tsenabea nyinara mu, dɛ hom nndzi seradze anaa bɔgya biara.
4: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, dɛ, Sɛ obiara yɛ bɔn ntɔgonmu wɔ ndzɛmba biara a Ewuradze ahyɛ ho mbra dɛ wɔnnyɛ no mu, na ɔkɛyɛ no mu kor biara a:
Sɛ ɔsɔfo a wɔasera no no kɛyɛ bɔn ma ɔdze asodzi ba ɔman no do a: Ɔno no bɔn a ɔayɛ no ntsi, ma ɔmfa ɔnantwisaa eburwa a onndzi dzɛm mbrɛ Ewuradze mfa nyɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
Na ɔmfa nantwisaa no mbra ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano wɔ Ewuradze enyim; na ɔmfa ne nsa nto nantwisaa no n'etsifi, na onku nantwisaa no wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na ɔsɔfo a woasera no no mfa mfa nantwisaa no no bɔgyaa bi, na ɔmfa mbra ehyiadzibuw no mu:
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatseaba mbɔ bɔgya no mu, na ɔmfa bɔgya no bi mpetse mpɛn esuon wɔ Ewuradze enyim, wɔ krɔnkrɔn-bea no no ntwamutam no enyim.

Na ɔsɔfo no mfa bɔgya no bi nkeka eduhuamkyew afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ Ewuradze enyim no a ɔwɔ ehiadzibuw no mu no ne mbɛn no ho; na onhue nantwisaa no no bɔgyaa nyinara ngu ɔhyew-afɔr afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano no ase.
Na ɔnyi bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no ne seradze no nyinara mfi no ho; seradze a ɔkata ayamudze no ho no, nye ayamudze no do seradze no nyinara,
nye nsɛbɛ ebien no, nye no do seradze no a ɔwɔ sisiw mu no, nye berɛbo do ntentan no, nye nsɛbɛ no, onyi mfa hɔ,
dɛ mbrɛ woyi fi asomdwee-afɔr wyɛyɛdze nantwinyin ho: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no wɔ ɔhyew-afɔr afɔrmbukyia no do.
Na nantwisaa no no nwoma, nye ne nam nyinara, nye ne tsir, na ɔnye no ntwɛr, nye n'ayamudze, nye n'egyanan,
mekyerɛ ɔnantwisaa mu no nyinara na ɔnsoa nkɔ nseraban no ekyir beebi a ɔtsew, mbrɛ wohue nso gu no, na ɔmfa ogya nhyew no nyena do: Mbrɛ wohue nso gu no na wɔnhyew no.
Na sɛ Israel mboanofo nyinara fom, na asɛm no suma bagua no enyi no, na wɔyɛ ndzɛmba a Ewuradze ahyɛ ho mbra dɛ wɔnnyɛ no mu bi, na wodzi sõ;
na bɔn a wɔafom wɔ mu no wohu a, ɔno bagua no mfa nantwisaa eburwa mbra mbɛyɛ bɔn ho afɔr, na wɔmfa no mbra ehyiadzibuw no enyim.
Na mboanofo no mu mpanyimfo no mfa hɔn nsa ngu nantwisaa no n'etsifi wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Na wonku nantwisaa no wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na ɔsɔfo a wɔasera no no mfa nantwisaa no no bɔgyaa bi mbra ehyiadzibuw no mu.
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatseaba mbɔ bɔgyaa no mu, na ɔmfa mpetse mpɛm esuon wɔ Ewuradze enyim wɔ ntwamutam no enyim.
Na ɔmfa bɔgya no bi nkeka afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ Ewuradze enyim no a ɔwɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no ne mbɛn ho, na onhue bɔgya no nyinara ngu ɔhyew-afɔr afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano ho ase.
Na onyi ne seradze no nyinara mfi ho, na ɔnhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.
Dɛm na ɔnyɛ nantwisaa no; dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no, dɛmara na ɔnyɛ iyi: Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma hɔn, na wɔdze befir hɔn.
Na ɔmfa nantwisaa no mfir edzi nkɔ nseraban no ekyir, na ɔnhyew no dɛ mbrɛ ɔhyeew asɔpɔn nantwisaa no: Ɔyɛ bagua no hɔn bɔn ho afɔr.
Sɛ otsitsir bi yɛ bɛn, na ɔyɛ Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn ndzɛmba nyinara a wɔahyɛ dɛ mma wɔnnyɛ no mu kor bi ara ntɔgonmu, na odzi sõ;
sɛ no bɔn a ɔafom wɔ mu no, wɔma ohu a, ɔmfa n'ayɛyɛdze a ɔyɛ apɔnkye mbra, onyin a onndzi dzɛm;
na ɔmfa ne nsa nto apɔnkye no n'etsifi, na onku no wɔ beebi mbrɛ woku ɔhyew-afɔr no wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Ɔyɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne msatseaba mfa bɔn ho afɔr bɔgyaa no bi, na ɔmfa nkeka ɔhyew-afɔr afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn ho, na onhue no bɔgyaa no ngu ɔhyew-afɔr afɔrmbukyia no ase.
Na ɔnhyew ne seradze no nyinara wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, dɛ asomdwee-afɔr ayɛyɛdze seradze no: Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ no bɔn no ho, na wɔdze befir no.
Na Sɛ ɔman mba no bi yɛ bɔn ntɔgonmu, dɛ ɔyɛ ndzɛmba nyinara a Ewuradze ahyɛ ho mbra dɛ mma wɔnnyɛ no mu biara, na odzi sõ;
sɛ no bɔn a ɔafom no, wɔma ohu a, ɔno ɔmfa n'ayɛyɛdze, apɔnkyeber a onndzi dzɛm, mbra mbɛma, wɔ no bɔn a ɔayɛ no ntsi.
Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto bɔn ho afɔr no n'etsifi, na onku bɔn ho afɔr no wɔ ɔhyew-afɔr bea no do.
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatseaba mfa bɔgya no bi, na ɔmfa nkeka ɔhyew-afɔr afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn ho, na onhue no bɔgyaa no nyinara ngu afɔrmbukyia no ase.

Na onyi ne seradze no nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ woyi asomdwee-afɔr seradze no fi ho no; na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do ma onyi nka huanhuam mma Ewuradze; na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no, na wɔdze befir no.
Na sɛ ɔdze eguambaa ba dɛ n'ayɛyɛdze wɔ bɔn ho afɔr ntsi a, ɔmfa no ɔber a onndzi dzɛm mbra.
Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto bɔn ho afɔr no n'etsifi, na onku no bɔn ho afɔr wɔ beebi mbrɛ woku ɔhyew-afɔr no.
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatseaba mfa bɔn ho afɔr bɔgyaa no bi, na ɔmfa nkeka ɔhyew-afɔr afɔrmbukyia no ne mbɛn ho, na onhue no bɔgyaa no nyinara ngu afɔrmbukyia no ase:

Na onyi ne seradze no nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ woyi asomdwee-afɔr eguambaa seradze no fi ho no; na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, wɔ Ewuradze ogya-afɔr no do: Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ no bɔn a ɔayɛ no ho, na wɔdze befir no.
5: Na sɛ obiara yɛ bɔn, dɛ ɔtsɛ ntanka ndze, na ɔyɛ ho dasefo, sɛ ohunii o, ɔtsee o, sɛ ɔannkã a, ɔno ɔnsoa no mbusu:
Anaa sɛ obiara kã adze fi biara, sɛ abowa bi a no ho nntsew no fun o, fiebowa bi a no ho nntsew no fun o, aweaweabowa bi a no ho nntsew no fun o, na osuma no, na no ho gu fī a, ɔno odzi so:
Anaa sɛ ɔka nyimpa bi ne fī, wɔ adze fī biara a anyimpa dze gu no ho fī mu, na osuma no; na sɛ ohu a, ɔno odzi sõ:
Anaa sɛ obiara dze n'anofamfa kā ntanhun dɛ ɔbɛyɛ bɔn, anaa ɔbɛyɛ papa, wɔ asɛnhun a nyimpa dze ntam bɛka biara mu, na osuma no; na sɛ ohu a, ɔno odzi ndzɛmba iyinom mu biara ho sõ:
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ odzi ndzɛmba iyinom mu biara ho sõ a, ɔnkã dza ɔayɛ mu bɔn no:
Na no bɔn a ɔayɛ no ntsi ɔmfa n'asodzii ho afɔr mbra Ewuradze, nguan mu ɔber, eguambaa anaa apɔnkye, mfa nyɛ bɔn ho afɔr; na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ no bɔn ho.
Na sɛ ne nsa annsõ eguambaa do a, ɔno ɔmfa ntamram ebien, anaa mborɔnomamba ebien, mbrɛ Ewuradze mbɛyɛ dza ɔayɛ mu bɔn ho n'asodzii ho afɔr; kor nyɛ bɔn ho afɔr, na kor so nyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr.
Na ɔmfa mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no, ma ondzi kan mfa dza ɔyɛ bɔn ho afɔr no, na ɔntsew ne tsir wɔ no kɔn do, na mbom mma ɔmmpaa mu koraa:
Na ɔmfa bɔn ho afɔr bɔgyaa no bi mpetse afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn; na bɔgya no ne nkaa no ɔnsɔn ngu afɔrmbukyia no ase: Ɔyɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
Na ɔmfa dza otsīa ebien no nyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr, dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse: Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ no bɔn a ɔayɛ no ho, na wɔdze befir no.

Na sɛ ne nsa annsõ ntamram ebien, anaa mborɔnomamba ebien do a, ɔno ɔmfa esiam pa ephah ebupɛn du mu kor nyɛ no bɔn a ɔayɛ no ho ayɛyɛdze mbra mbɛyɛ bɔn ho afɔr; mma ɔmmfa ngo nngu do, nkyii so mma ɔmmfa krɔbɔw bi nnto do: Na ɔyɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
Na ɔmfa mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no, na ɔsɔfo no mfa mu ne nsapuw dɛ ne nkaadze, na ɔnhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, wɔ Ewuradze ogya-afɔr no do; ɔyɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ no bɔn a ɔayɛ no wɔ ndzɛmba iyinom mu biara mu no ho, na wɔdze befir no: Na nkaa no nyɛ ɔsɔfo no dze, dɛ edziban-afɔr no.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,

Sɛ ɔbiara tõ mbra, na ɔfom ntɔgonmu, wɔ Ewuradze ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn no mu a; ɔno ɔmfa n'asodzii ho afɔr mbra Ewuradze, nguan mu odwanyin a onndzi dzɛm, dɛ mbrɛ w'abotwa wɔ shekel mu wɔ dwɛɛtɛɛ mu tse, dɛ krɔnkrɔn-bea shekel, nyɛ asodzi ho afɔr:
Na ɔnyɛ ahyɛnanmu mma dza ɔayɛ no bɔn wɔ krɔnkrɔndze mu no, na ɔmfa abupɛm a otsīa enum no nka ho, na ɔmfa mma ɔsɔfo no; na ɔsɔfo no mfa asodzi ho afɔr odwanyin no mpata mma no, na wɔdze befir no.
Na sɛ obiara yɛ bɔn, na ɔyɛ ndzɛmba a Ewuradze ahyɛ ho mbra dɛ wɔnnyɛ no mu biara a; kaansa oennhu mpo a, odzi sõ, na ɔbɔsoa no mbusu.
Na ɔmfa nguan mu odwanin a onndzi dzɛm dɛ mbrɛ w'abotwa tse, nyɛ asodzi ho afɔr mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no: Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ adze a ɔafom wɔ mu ntɔgonmu na oennhu no no ho, na wɔdze befir no.
Ɔyɛ asodzi ho afɔr: Ampaara odzi Ewuradze enyim sõ.
6: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Sɛ obiara yɛ bɔn, na odzi Ewuradze afomfonsɛm, na odzi akɔhwi wɔ ne nyɛnko adzesiedze ho asɛm mu, anaa ahobadze, anaa afoadze, anaa oemim ne nyɛnko;
anaa oehu dza ɔyewee na odzi akɔhwi wɔ mu, na ɔkã ntanhun; na ɔyɛ bɔn wɔ iyinom mu biara a nyimpa yɛ no mu a,
ɔno ɔbɛba dɛ ɔayɛ bɔn, na odzi sõ a, ɔmfa adze a ɔfaa no afoadze mu, anaa adze a onyaa no emim mu, anaa adzesiedze a wɔdze hyɛɛ ne nsa, anaa adze a ɔyewee a ohunii,
anaa adze biara a ɔakã ho ntanhun no no nsan mbra; na ɔmbɛhyɛ ananmu ara pɛ, ma ɔmfa ebupɛn anum mu kor so nto do: Ɔmfa mma nyia adze no yɛ nedze no, wɔ da a woehu no dɛ odzi sõ ara mu.
Na ɔmfa n'asodzii ho afɔr mbrɛ Ewuradze, nguan mu odwanyin a onndzi dzɛm, dɛ mbrɛ w'abotwa tse, nyɛ asodzi ho afɔr, mfa mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no:
Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na wɔdze adze biara a ɔayɛ a odzi ho sõ no befir no.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Hyɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no dɛ, Iyi nye ɔhyew-afɔr ho mbra: Ɔhyew-afɔr no ɔnkɔ mbukyia no do wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do anago ara nkodu anapa; na afɔrmbukyia no do ogya no nsuo mu ndzɛw.
Na ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ no ndwera atar, na ɔnhyɛ no ndwera ntwontwo nkata noho; na ɔnsesa nso no a ogya no hyeew ɔhyew-afɔr no gyae wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do no, na ɔmfa ngu afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn.
Na onyi ne ntar no, na ɔnhyɛ ntar fofor, na ɔmfa nso no mfir edzi nkɔ nseraban no ekyir nkogu beebi mbrɛ ɔtsew.
Na afɔrmbukyia no do ogya no nda ho ndzɛw wɔ do, mma onndum ara da; na ɔsɔfo no nhyew do nyena anapa daa: Na onsiesie ɔhyew-afɔr no yie wɔ do, na ɔnhyew asomdwee-afɔr no seradze no wɔ do.
Ogya nda ho ndzɛw afɔrmbukyia no do daa, mma onndum ara da.
Na iyi nye edziban-afɔr ho mbra: Aaron ne mbabanyin no mfa mbra Ewuradze enyim, wɔ afɔrmbukyia no enyim.
Na ɔmfa mu ne nsapuw, edziban-afɔr isian pa no bi, nye no ngo no bi, nye edziban-afɔr no do nkrɔbɔw no nyinara, na ɔnhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, nyi nka huanhuam, dɛ ne nkaadze, mma Ewuradze.
Na ne nkaa no, Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no ndzi: Wondzi no epitsi wɔ mbrɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn; ehyiadzibuw no ne pampam mu na wondzi.
Mma wɔmmfa mbɔrkaw nnka ho nntõ. Hɔn kyɛfa a medze mama wɔ me gya-afɔr mu nye no; ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze-mu-adzekrɔnkrɔn, dɛ bɔn ho afɔr, na asodzi ho afɔr no.
Aaron ne mbaa mu banyin biara ndzi bi, dɛ Ewuradze Ogya-afɔr ho daa ahyɛdze, nkodu hom ebusuansantsen do: Obiara a ɔkã no no nyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Iyi nye Aaron nye ne mbabanyin ayɛyɛdze a wɔmfa mbrɛ Ewuradze wɔ da a wɔasera no ngo no mu; isiam pa ephah ebupɛn du mu kor nyɛ daa edziban-afɔr, anapa dze, fã, na ewimbir dze, fa.
wɔmfa ngo nka ho nyɛ no wɔ ɔtosɛn mu; sɛ ɔhun a, fa bra: Yɛ no dɛ edziban-afɔr a wɔatõ ebubu mu esienesin bra, ma onyi nka huanhuam mma Ewuradze.
Na ɔsɔfo no a wɔasera no ngo no a ɔbɛhyɛ n'ananmu wɔ ne mbabanyin mu no mfa mbra: Wɔ nhyew no mu nyɛ Ewuradze daa mmom.
Na ɔsɔfo no n'edziban-afɔr biara wɔnhyew no mu: Mma wonndzi bi.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no dɛ, iyi nye bɔn ho afɔr ho mbra: Beebi mbrɛ woku ɔhyew-afɔr no hɔ ara na wonku bɔn ho afɔr no wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn.
Ɔsɔso a ɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr no, ndzi: Wondzi no wɔ mbrɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn wɔ ehyiadzebuw no ne pampammu.
Biribiara a ɔka ne nam no nyɛ krɔnkrɔn: Na sɛ no bɔgyaa petse atar biara do a, hor dza apetse do no wɔ mbrɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Mbom dɛtsesɛn a wɔanoa no wɔ mu no wɔmbɔ no: Na sɛ wɔnoa no boransɛn mu a, wontwuw mu, na wɔmfa nsu nhohor mu.
Asɔfo no mu banyin biara ndzi bi: Ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn.
Na bɔn ho afɔr biara a wɔdze no bɔgyaa bi ba ehyiadzebuw no mu bɛpata wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn no, mma wonndzi: Wɔmfa ogya nhyew no.
7: Na iyi nye asodzi ho afɔr ho mbra: Ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn.
Beebi mbrɛ woku ɔhyew-afɔr no, hɔ ara so na wonku asodzi ho afɔr no; na ɔmfa no bɔgyaa mpetse afɔrmbukyia no ho nhyia.
Na onyi ne seradze nyinara mbra, seradze dua no, nye seradze a ɔkata ayamudze no ho no,
Nye nsɛbɛ ebien no, nye seradze a ɔwɔ ho wɔ sisiw mu no, nye berɛbo do ntentan no, nye nsɛbɛ no, onyi mfi hɔ:
Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia do nyɛ ogya-afɔr mma Ewuradze: Ɔyɛ asodzi ho afɔr.
Asɔfo no mu ɔbanyin biara ndzi bi: Wondzi no wɔ mbrɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn: Ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn
Dɛ mbrɛ bɔn ho afɔr tse no, dɛmara na asodzi ho afɔr tse: Mbra kor na ɔda ho: Ɔsɔfo no a ɔdze pata no, na ɔnyɛ nedze.
Na ɔsɔfo a ɔbɔ nyimpa biara ne hyew-afɔr no, ɔhyew-afɔr a ɔabɔ no no nwoma no nyɛ ɔsɔfo no dze.
Na edziban-afɔr biara a wɔtõ wɔ fononoo mu, nye dza wɔyɛ no wɔ kyesɛn mu, nye ɔtosɛn mu nyina, nyɛ ɔsɔfo a ɔdze ba no dze.
Na edziban-afɔr biara a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, anaa wesee no, nyɛ Aaron ne mbabanyin nyinara dze, baako nya dɛ mbrɛ baako so nya.
Na iyi nye asomdwee-afɔr a obi bɔ ma Ewuradze no ho mbra.
Sɛ ɔyɛ no aseda-afɔr a ɔdze ba no nyɛ epitsi tatar a wɔahon a wɔdze ngo afrɔw.
Mbɔrkaw boodoo tatar na ɔmfa nka n'ayɛyɛdze nye n'asomdwee-afɔr ho mbra mbɛyɛ aseda.
Na ɔmfa ayɛyɛdze biara mu kor mbrɛ mbɛyɛ ɔmado-afɔr mma Ewuradze; ɔsɔfo a ɔdze asomdwee-afɔr bɔgyaa petse no na ɔnyɛ nedze.
Na n'aseda asomdwee-afɔr no nam no wondzi no wɔ n'ayɛyɛdze da no ara; mma onngya mu bi ma onnkodu adzekyee.
Mbom sɛ n'ayɛyɛdze yɛ anohoba, anaa ayamuyi-afɔr a, wondzi no da no ara a ɔbɔ n'afɔr no: Na no mu dza ɔka ma adze kye do no wondzi:
Na mbom afɔr no ne nam a ɔbɛka ekodu da a otsia ebiasa no, wɔmfa gya nhyew no.
Na sɛ wodzi n'asomdwee-afɔr no ne nam biara da a otsia ebiasa no a, wɔremmpen do, nkyii so worummbu mma nyia ɔdze ba no: Ɔyɛ ekyiwadze, na ɔkra a obedzi bi no bɔsoa no mbusu.
Na nam a aka biribiara a no ho nntsew no, mma wonndzi; wɔmfa ogya nhyew no. Na nam no dze, obiara a no ho tsew ndzi bi:
Na ɔkra a odzi asomdwee-afɔr a ɔyɛ Ewuradze dze no ne nam bi, na n'efifidze wɔ no ho no, ɔkra no wobotwa no efi ne man mu akyen.

Na sɛ nyimpa biara ka biribiara a no ho nntsew nyimpa n'efifidze, anaa abowa a no ho nntsew, anaa ekyiwadze biara a no ho nntsew, na odzi asomdwee-afɔr a ɔyɛ Ewuradze dze no ne nam bi no, ɔkra no wobotwa no efi ne man mu akyen.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, ɔnantwi, anaa ɔkɔsɔw, anaa apɔnkye seradze no, mma hom nndzi.
Na dza noara ewu ne seradze, nye dza abowa atsetsew no ne seradze no, wɔmfa nyɛ edwuma biara: Mbom dzi na mma hom nndzi bi.
Na obiara a odzi abowa a adasa dze bi bɔ ogya-afɔr ma Ewuradze no ne seradze bi no, mekyerɛ ɔkra a odzi no wobotwa no efi ne man mu akyen.
Na mma hom nndzi bɔgya biara, anoma anaa aketsebowa dze, wɔ hom tsenabew biara,
Obiara a odzi bɔgya biara no, no wobotwa no efi ne man mu akyen.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Nyia ɔbɔ n'asomdwee-afɔr ma Ewuradze no ɔmfa n'asomdwee-afɔr no mu ayɛyɛdze mbrɛ Ewuradze:
Ɔmfa noara ne nsa mfa Ewuradze gya-afɔr no mbra: Seradze no nye nyan no na ɔmfa mbra, ama nyan no wɔaatow no ayɛ ɔtow-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew seradze no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: Na nyan no nyɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin dze.
Na aserɛ nyimfa no hom mfa nyɛ hom asomdwee-afɔr mu ɔmado-afɔr mma ɔsɔfo no.
Aaron ne mbabanyin mu nyia ɔdze asomdwee-afɔr no bɔgyaa, nye seradze ba no, nye aserɛ nyimfa no nyɛ ne kyɛfa.
Na ɔtow-nyan no nye ɔmado-serɛ no mafa wɔ Israelmba hɔn asomdwee-afɔr no mu, na medze mama ɔsɔfo Aaron nye ne mbabanyin dɛ daa ahyɛdze a ofi Israelmba hɔ.
Iyi nye Aaron no ngosera-kyɛfa, nye ne mbabanyin hɔn ngosera-kyɛfa a ofi Ewuradze ogya-afɔr mu, wɔ da a ɔdze hɔn bae dɛ wombedzi Ewuradze asɔfoe no a.
Ewuradze hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa mma hɔn wɔ a ɔseraa hɔn ngo fii Israelmba mu no. Ɔyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ hɔn ebusuasantsen mu.
Iyi nye mbra a ɔda hɔ ma ɔhyew-afɔr, edziban-afɔr, nye bɔn ho afɔr, nye asodzi ho afɔr, nye etuhoakyɛ-afɔr, nye asomdwee-afɔr a
Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses wɔ bepɔw Sinai do, wɔ da a ɔhyɛɛ Israelmba dɛ wɔmfa hɔn ayɛyɛdze mbrɛ Ewuradze, wɔ Sinai sar do no.
8: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Fa Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no ka no ho, na ntar no, nye ɔserango no, nye bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no, nye ndwanyin ebien no, nye epitsi boodoo kɛntsɛn no,
na mboanofo no nyinara mbɔ ngua wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano.
Na Moses yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ no no; na mboanofo bɔɔ ngua wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano.
Na Moses see mboanofo no dɛ, Iyi nye adze a Ewuradze ahyɛ dɛ wɔnyɛ.
Na Moses dze Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no bae, na ɔdze nsu hohoor hɔn ho.
Na ɔdze sortar no hyɛɛ no, na ɔdze abɔyamu no bɔɔ no do, na ɔdze bataker no hyɛɛ no, na ɔdze egugudo no guu no, na ɔdze egugudo ne nkyermu nkyekyermu bɔɔ no do, na ɔdze kyekyeer no.
Na ɔdze akatabo no hyɛɛ no: Na ɔdze Urim nye Thummim no hyɛɛ akatabo no mu.
Na ɔdze asɔfokyɛw no hyɛɛ ne tsir: Na ɔdze sika abɔtsir, abɔnyim krɔnkrɔn no, bɔɔ asɔfokyɛw no ho, wɔ n'enyim afamu; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
Na Moses faa ɔserango, na ɔdze seraa ntamadanno nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara, na ɔyɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn .
Na ɔdze bi petsee afɔrmbukyia no do mpɛn esuon, na ɔseraa afɔrmbukyia no nye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, nye eguarsɛn no nye ne ntaease no ngo dze yɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn.
Na ohuee ɔserango no bi guu Aaron n'etsifi, na ɔseraa no ngo dze yɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn.
Na Moses dze Aaron mbabanyin no bae, na ɔdze sorntar hyehyɛɛ hɔn, na ɔdze abɔyamu bobɔɔ hɔn; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
Na ɔdze bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no bae: Na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no dze hɔn nsa guu bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no n'etsifi.

Na okum no; na Moses dze ne nsatseaba faa mbɔgya no bi, na ɔdze kekaa afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn ho hyiae, na ɔtseew afɔrmbukyia no ho, na ohuee bɔgya no guu afɔrmbukyia no ase, na ɔyɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn, dze ayɛ mpatadze.
Na ɔfaa seradze a ɔwɔ ayamudze no ho no nyinara, nye berɛbo do ntentan no, nye nsɛbɛ ebien no, nye no ho seradze no, na Moses hyeew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.
Na ɔnantwisaa no, nye no nwoma, nye ne nam, nye n'egyanan, ɔdze ogya hyeew no wɔ nseraban no ekyir; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
Na ɔdze ɔhyew-afɔr odwanyin no bae: Na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin dze hɔn nsa guu odwanyin no etsifi.
Na okum no: Na Moses dze bɔgya no petsee afɔrmbukyia no do hyiae.
Na otwitwaa odwanin no mu esinesin; na Moses hyeew tsir no, nye esinesin no, nye seradze no.
Na ɔdze nsu hohoor ayamudze nye ntwɛr no ho; na Moses hyeew odwanyin mu no nyinara wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: Ɔyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam: Ɔyɛ Ewuradze ogya-afɔr; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
Na ɔdze odwanyin kor no so, etuhoakyɛ-afɔr odwanyin no, bae: Na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no dze hɔn nsa guu odwanyin no etsifi.
Na okum no; na Moses faa no bɔgyaa no bi, na ɔdze kaa Aaron n'aso nyimfa ano, na ne nsa nyimfa kokrobetsir, nye ne nan nyimfa kokonyin no ano.

Na ɔdze Aaron mbabanyin no bae, na Moses dze bɔgya no bi kekaa hɔn aso nyimfa ano, nye hɔn nsa nyimfa kokrobetsir, nye hɔn anan nyimfa kokonyin no ano: Na Moses dze bɔgya no petsee afɔrmbukyia no do hyiae.
Na ɔfaa seradze no, nye seradze dua no, nye nsɛbɛ ebien no, nye no ho seradze no, nye aserɛ nyimfa no:
Na ɔfaa epitsi boodoo kɛntsen a osi Ewuradze enyim no mu epitsi tatar kor, nye ngo boodoo tatar kor, nye tatar trɛtraba kor, na ɔdze guu seradze no nye aserɛ nyimfa no do:
Na ɔdze ne nyinara hyɛɛ Aaron nsa, na ne mbabanyin no nsa, na ɔtowee yɛɛ ɔtow-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na Moses gyee no wɔ hɔn nsamu, na ɔhyeew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do wɔ ɔhyew-afɔr no do: Dze yɛɛ etuhoakyɛ-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam: Ɔyɛ ogya-afɔr ma Ewuradze.
Na Moses faa nyan no, na ɔtowee yɛɛ ɔtow-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Ɔyɛ Moses ne kyɛfa wɔ etuhoakyɛ-afɔr odwanyin no mu; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no ara.

Na Moses faa ɔserango no bi, nye afɔrmbukyia no do bɔgya no bi, na ɔdze petsee Aaron, nye ne ntar, nye ne mbabanyin, nye ne mbabanyin ntar do, dze yɛɛ Aaron nye ne ntar, nye ne mbabanyin, nye ne mbabanyin ntar no, krɔnkrɔn.
Na Moses see Aaron, nye ne mbabanyin no dɛ, Hom nnoa nam no wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano: Na hom ndzi no wɔ hɔ ara ɔnye etuhoakyɛ-afɔr kɛntsɛn no mu boodoo no.
Na nam no nye boodoo no mu dza ɔbɛka no hom mfa gya nhyew no.
Na mma hom mfi ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano nda esuon, kyerɛ hom etuhoakyɛ-afɔr nda no asõ ana: Na nda esuon na ɔdze rutu hom akyɛ.
Dɛ mbrɛ wɔayɛ no ndɛ da yi no, dɛmara na Ewuradze ahyɛ dɛ wɔnyɛ mfa mpata mma hom.
Na hom ntsena ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano adzekyee nye adzesaa nda esuon, na hom nhwɛ Ewuradze ahwɛdze no, amma hom eennwuwu: Na dɛm na wɔdze ahyɛ me mbra.
Na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no yɛɛ ndzɛmba a Ewuradze nam Moses nsa do hyɛe no nyinara.
9: Na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsīa awɔtwe no, Moses frɛɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no, na Israel mpanyimfo no;
na ɔsee Aaron dɛ, Fa nantwibanyin a wɔdze bɛyɛ bɔn ho afɔr, nye odwanyin a wɔdze bɛyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr a wonndzi dzɛm, na fa bra Ewuradze enyim.
Na kasa kyerɛ Israelmba no dɛ. Hom mfa apɔnkyenyin mbɛyɛ bɔn ho afɔr; na nantwiba nye eguambaa a hɔn beenu nyina woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzi dzɛm, mbɛyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr;
na ɔnantwinyin nye odwanyin mbɛyɛ asomdwee-afɔr, mfa mbɔ afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim; na edziban-afɔr a wɔdze ngo afrɔw: Na ndɛ na Ewuradze yi noho kyerɛ hom.
Na wɔdze dza Moses hyɛe no baa ehyiadzibuw no enyim: Na mboanofo no nyinara twee bɛnee begyinaa Ewuradze enyim.
Na Moses see dɛ, Iyi nye adze a Ewuradze hyɛɛ dɛ hom nyɛ: Na Ewuradze enyimnyam nyi noho nkyerɛ hom.
Na Moses see Aaron dɛ, Twe bɛn afɔrmbukyia no ho, na bɔ wo bɔn ho afɔr, nye wo hyew-afɔr, na pata ma woho, nye ɔman no: Na fa ɔman no hɔn ayɛyɛdze bra, na pata ma hɔn; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛe no.
Nna Aaron twee bɛɛn afɔrmbukyia no ho, na okum bɔn ho afɔr nantwiba no a ɔyɛ nankasa nedze no.
Na Aaron ne mbabanyin no dze bɔgya no kɛmaa no; na ɔdze ne nsatseaba bɔɔ bɔgya no mu, na ɔdze kekaa afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn no, na ohuee bɔgya no guu afɔrmbukyia no ase:
Na bɔn ho afɔr no mu seradze no, nye nsɛbɛ no, nye berɛbo do ntentan no, ɔhyeew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
Na nam no nye nwoma no ɔdze gya hyeew no wɔ nseraban no ekyir.
Na okum ɔhyew-afɔr no; na Aaron ne mbabanyin no dze bɔgya no kɛmaa no, na ɔdze petsee afɔrmbukyia no do hyiae.
Na wɔdze ɔhyew-afɔr no esinesin, nye tsir no, kɛmaa no: Na ɔhyeew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.
Na ɔhohoor ayamudze nye ntwɛr no ho, na ɔhyeew no wɔ ɔhyew-afɔr no do wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.
Na ɔdze ɔman no hɔn ayɛyɛdze kɛmae, na ɔfaa bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkye a ɔyɛ ɔman no dze no, na okum no, na ɔyɛɛ no bɔn ho afɔr, dɛ asɔpɔn dze no.
Na ɔdze edziban-afɔr no kɛmae, na ɔyɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse no ara.
Na ɔdze edziban-afɔr no kɛmae, na ɔfaa mu ne nsapuw, na ɔhyeew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, dze kaa anapa ɔhyew-afɔr no ho.
Na eso okum nantwinyin nye odwanyin no asomdwee-afɔr a ɔyɛ ɔman no dze no: Na Aaron mbabanyin no dze bɔgya no kɛmaa no, na ɔdze petsee afɔrmbukyia no do hyiae,
na ɔnantwinyin nye ɔdwanyin no seradze no; seradze dua no, nye dza ɔkata ayamudze no ho, nye nsɛbɛ no, nye berɛbo do ntentan no:
Na wɔdze seradze no guu nyan no do, na ɔhyeew seradze no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do:
Na nyan no nye aserɛ nyimfa no Aaron towee dze yɛɛ ɔtow-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim; dɛ mbrɛ Moses hyɛe no.
Na Aaron memaa ne nsa do wɔ ɔman no do, na ohyiraa hɔn; na ɔbɔɔ bɔn ho afɔr nye ɔhyew-afɔr, nye asomdwee-afɔr wiee no, osianee.
Na Moses nye Aaron kɛhɛɛn ehyiadzibuw no mu, na wopuei, na wohyiraa ɔman no; na Ewuradze enyimnyam yii noho kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinara.
Na ogya fi Ewuradze enyim bae, na ɔbɛhyeew afɔrmbukyia no do hyew-afɔr nye seradze no: Na ɔman no nyinara hunii no, wɔbɔɔ ose, na wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu.
10: Na Aaron mbabanyin no, Nadab nye Abihu, fefaa hɔn nduhuamsɛn, na wɔdze ogya guu mu, na wɔdze eduhuam guguu do, na wɔdze ananagya a ɔnnhyɛɛ hɔn ho mbra, baa Ewuradze enyim.
Na ogya fi Ewuradze enyim bae, na ɔbɛmeen hɔn, na wowuwui wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Nna Moses see Aaron dɛ, Iyi nye dza Ewuradze kãe no, dɛ hɔn a wɔtwe bɛn me no mu na mebɛyɛ moho krɔnkrɔn, na ɔman no nyinara enyim na mebɛhyɛ moho enyimnyam. Na Aaron muaa n'ano.
Na Moses frɛɛ Mishael nye Elzaphan, Aaron no wɔfa Uzziel ne mbabanyin no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom ntwe mbɛn, hom nsoasoa hom nuanom mfi krɔnkrɔn-bea no enyim nkɔ nseraban no ekyir.
Nna wɔtwee bɛnee, na wɔsoasoa hɔn wɔ hɔn sorntar mu kɔr nseraban no ekyir; dɛ mbrɛ Moses kãe no.

Na Moses kãa kyerɛɛ Aaron, nye ne mbabanyin Eleazar nye Ithamar, dɛ, Mma hom mmbɔ hom tsinhwi mpɛsɛw, nhyii so wonnsunsuan hom ntar mu; amma hom eennwuwu, amma no bo eemmfuw mboanofo no nyinara, mbom hom mma hom nuanom, Israel fi nyinara, ngyam ɔhyew a Ewuradze ahyew yi.
Na mma hom mmfi ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano, amma hom eennwuwu: na Ewuradze ɔserango no wɔ hom do. Na wɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Moses kãe no.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Aaron dɛ,
Mma nnom wenyin anaa nsadzendzen, ɔwo nye wo mbabanyin nyinara, aber a hom rokɔ ehiadzibuw no mu no, amma hom eennwuwu: Ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ hom ebusuasantsen nyinara mu:
Na hom dze he aato adzekrɔnkrɔn nye adze a ɔka ntamu, nye adze a no ho nntsew nye dza no ho tsew ntamu;
na hom aakyerɛkyerɛ Israelmba ahyɛdze a Ewuradze nam Moses nsa do akã akyerɛ hɔn no nyinara.

Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ Aaron, na Eleazar nye Ithamar, ne mbabanyin a wɔkae no dɛ, Hom mfa edziban-afɔr a ɔka a ofi Ewuradze ogya-afɔr do no, na hom nkwetsi mbɔrkaw ndzi no wɔ afɔrmbukyia ho: na ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn:
Na hom ndzi no wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn do, osiandɛ ɔyɛ w'ahyɛdze, nye wo mbabanyin ahyɛdze, wɔ Ewuradze ogya-afɔr do: Na dɛn na wɔahyɛ.

Na ɔtow-nyan no nye ɔmado-aserɛ no hom ndzi no wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔtsew; ɔwo, nye wo mbabanyin, nye wo mbabaa a wɔka wo ho: Na wɔdze ama dɛ ɔyɛ w'ahyɛdze, na wo mbabanyin ahyɛdze a ofi Israelmba hɔn asomdwee-afɔr mu.

Ɔmado-aserɛ no nye ɔtow-nyan no wɔmfa nka ogya-afɔr seradze no ho mbra, mbɔtow no ɔtow-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim; na ɔnyɛ wodze, nye wo mbabanyin a wɔka wo ho no dze, dɛ daa ahyɛdze; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze ahyɛ no.
Na Moses hwehwɛɛ bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkye no enyiberdo, na hwɛ, wɔahyew no: Na no bo fuuw Eleazar na ɔnye Ithamar, Aaron ne mbabanyin a wɔkae no, dɛ,

Ebɛn ntsi na hom enndzi bɔn ho afɔr no wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔyɛ bea krɔnkrɔn no, osiandɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn, na ɔdze ama hom dɛ, hom nsoa mboanofo no hɔn mbusu, nyɛ mpata mma hɔn wɔ ewuradze enyim?
Hwɛ, wɔammfa no bɔgyaa no ammba krɔnkrɔn-bea no no mu: ampaara ɔsee dɛ nkyɛ hom ndzi no wɔ krɔnkrɔn-bea no do hɔ, dɛ mbrɛ mehyɛe no.

Na Aaron kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ, Hwɛ, ndɛ da yi na wɔdze hɔn bɔn ho afɔr nye hɔn ɔhyew-afɔr aba Ewuradze enyim; na ndzɛmba a ɔtsetse dɛm yi aba mo do yi: Na sɛ midzi bɔn ho afɔr ndɛ a, ana nkyɛ ɔbɛyɛ enyisɔ wɔ Ewuradze enyim?
Na Moses tsee no, ɔyɛɛ enyisɔ wɔ n'enyi do.
11: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron, see hɔn dɛ,
hom nkasa nkyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Iyinom nye mbowa a hom ndzi wɔ asaase do mbowa nyinara mu.
Anansambowa mu biara a wɔapaa n'anansa mu, na ɔyɛ anansapaae koraa, na ɔkosa adzepuwii no, ɔno na hom ndzi.
Naaso Iyinom na mma hom ndzi wɔ hɔn a wɔkosa adzepuwii, anaa hɔn a hɔn anansa mu apaa mu: Efupɔnkɔ, osiandɛ ɔkɔsa adzepuwii dze, naaso n'anansa mu mmpaae, no ho nntsewee mma hom.
Na etwabowa, osiandɛ ɔkosa adzepuwii dze, naaso n'anansa mu mmpaae, no ho nntsew mma hom.
Na asoaso, osiandɛ ɔkosa adzepuwii dze, naaso n'anansa mu mmpaae, no ho nntsew mma hom.
Na preko, osiandɛ n'anansa mu apaa, na ɔyɛ anansapaae koraa dze, naaso ɔnnkosa adzepuwii, no ho nntsew mma hom.
Mma hom ndzi hɔn nam bi, na hɔn efun no mma hom nnkã; hɔn ho nntsew mma hom.
Iyinom nye dza hom ndzi wɔ dza ɔwɔ nsu mu nyinara mu: Biara a ɔwɔ tɛterɛ nye abon wɔ nsu mu, pomu, nye esutsen mu no, iyinom na hom ndzi.
Na dza wonnyi tɛterɛ nye abon a wɔwɔ pomu, nye esutsen mu nyinara, nye dza wɔkeka hɔnho wɔ nsu mu nyinara mu, nye mbowa a nkwa wɔ hɔn mu wɔ nsu mu nyinara mu, wɔ yɛ ekyiwadze ma hom,
na ɔnyɛ hom ekyiwadze; mma hom nndzi hɔn nam, na hɔn efun no hom nkyir.
Adze biara a ɔnnyi tɛterɛ anaa abon wɔ nsu mu no, ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma hom.
Na iyinom na hom nkyir no Wɔ ntumbowa mu; mma wondzi, wɔyɛ ekyiwadze: Ɔkɔr, nye ɔkɔr-bia, nye nsu-kɔr;
na ɔsansaa, nye ɔkom n'ahorow;
akonkoran biara n'ahorow;
nye sohor, nye anago-akrɔma, nye po-akokɔ, nye akrɔma n'ahorow;
nye patu-bia, nye po-akonkoran, nye patu-kɛse;
nye ambɛn-patu, nye opoku, nye ɔpɛtɛ:
Nye esukɔnkɔn, bakanoma n'ahorow, nye esuaakɔ, nye apan.
Ntumbowa menyamenya a wɔnantsew anan anananan do nyinara yɛ ekyiwadze ma hom.
Naaso iyinom na hom ndzi no wɔ ntumbowa menyamenya a wɔnantsew anan anananan do nyinara mu, hɔn a wɔwɔ aperɛ wɔ hɔn anan do a wɔdze huruw wɔ asaase do no,
mekyerɛ hɔn mu iyinom na hom ndzi; mbɛbɛw n'ahorow, akyekyemawe n'ahorow, kukura n'ahorow, ɔhwedɔm n'ahorow.
Na ntumbowa menyamenya nyinara a wɔwɔ anan anananan no, yɛ ekyiwadze ma hom.
Na Iyinom na hom dze gu homho fi: Obiara a ɔkã hɔn hun no, no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir:
Na obiara a ɔsoa hɔn fun no ɔnhor ne ntar, na no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Anansabowa biara a wɔapaa n'anansa mu, na ɔnnyɛ anansapaae koraa, na ɔnnkosa adzepuwii no, no ho nntsew mma hom; obiara a ɔka hɔn no, no ho nntsew.
Na adze biara a ɔnantsew no werɛwano no wɔ mbowa a wɔnantsew anan anananan do nyinara mu no, hɔn ho nntsew mma hom: Obiara a ɔka hɔn fun no, no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Na nyia ɔsoa hɔn fun no ɔnhor ne ntar, na no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir: Hɔn ho nntsew mma hom.
Na iyinom nye hɔn a hɔn ho nntsew mma hom wɔ aweaweambowa a wɔwea wɔ asaase do no mu; obirebi, nye okura, nye ɔketsew n'ahorow,
nye ban-yer-abamba, nye ɔmampam, nye ɔsamanapa, nye anhwea-ketsew, nye abosomanktsew.
Iyinom nye hɔn a hɔn ho nntsew mma hom wɔ dza wɔwea nyinara mu: Sɛ wowu a, obiara a ɔka hɔn no, no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.

Na adze biara a hɔn mu dza oewu atɔ do no, no ho nntsew; dua adze o, atar o, nwoma o, bɔtɔ o, adze biara a wɔdze yɛ edwuma biara, wɔmfa nto nsu mu, na no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir; ansaana no ho atsew.
Na dɛtsesɛn biara a hɔn mu bi bɔtɔ mu no, adze biara a ɔwɔ mu no no ho nntsew, na adze no hom mbɔ no.
No mu ezdiban a wodzi biara a nsu bogu mu no, no ho nntsew: Na anondze nyinara a wɔnom wɔ dɛm adze biara mu no, no ho nntsew:
Na adze biara a hɔn fun no bi bɔtɔ do no no ho nntsew; fononoo o, mbukyia o, wombubu no esinesin: Hɔn ho nntsew, na hɔn ho nntsew mma hom.
Naaso nsubura anaa maa a nsu egyina mu no dze, no ho tsew: Mbom dza ɔka hɔn fun no, no ho nntsew.
Na sɛ hɔn fun bi tɔ ekuadze a woedua biara do a, no ho nntsew.
Mbom sɛ wɔdze nsu gu ekuadze no do a, na hɔn fun bi tɔ do a, no ho nntsew mma hom.
Na sɛ abowa biara a hom bedzi, owu a, nyia ɔkã no fun no, no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir:
Na nyia odzi no fun bi no, ɔnhor ne ntar, na no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir, nyia so a ɔsoa no fun bi no, nhor ne ntar, na no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimber.
Na aweaweabowa biara a ɔwea wɔ asaase do no, yɛ ekyiwadze; mma wonndzi.
Adze biara a ɔnam anan anan do, anaa adze biara a ɔwɔ anan pii, mekyerɛ aweaweambowa a wɔwea wɔ asaase do nyinara, mma hom nndzi; na wɔyɛ ekyiwadze.
Mma hom nnyɛ homho ekyiwadze wɔ aweaweambowa biara a ɔwea ho, nkyii so mma hom nnyɛ homho fī a ɔmma hom ho nntsew wɔ hɔn ho.
Na emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn: Dɛm ntsi hom ntsew homho, na hom nyɛ krɔnkrɔn; na meyɛ krɔnkrɔn: Nkyii so mma hom nngu homho fī wɔ aweaweabowa biara a otwuw noho adze wɔ asaase do no ho.
Na emi nye Ewuradze a miyii hom fii Egypt asaase do bae, dɛ meyɛ hom Nyankopɔn no; dɛm ntsi hom nyɛ krɔnkrɔn, na meyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Iyi nye anansabowa, nye etubowa, nye abowa biara a ɔwea wɔ asaase do no ho mbra:
Ma wɔdze apa adze a no ho nntsew nye dza no ho tsew mu, na adze a nkwa wɔ mu a wodzi nye dza nkwa wɔ mu a wonndzi mu.
12: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Sɛ ɔbaa bi nyinsen na ɔwo ɔbanyimba a, ɔno no ho nntsew ara nda esuon; dɛ mbrɛ no ho nntsew wɔ n'asabu nda no mu no.
Na da a otsīa awɔtwe no wontwa ne banyinwer no twatsia.
Na ɔnko ntandan mu adaduasa nda ebiasa wɔ n'ahoguar bɔgya mu; mma ɔnnkã adzekrɔnkrɔn biara, nkyii so ɔmmba krɔnkrɔn-bea, kyerɛ n'ahoguar nda ewie du ana.
Mbom sɛ ɔwo basiaba a, ɔno no ho nntsew ara adapɛn ebien, dɛ n'asabu mu: Na ɔnko ntandan mu adaduosia nda esia wɔ n'ahoguar bɔgya mu.

Na sɛ n'ahoguar nda no wie du, ma ɔbanyin, anaa ɔbabaa a, ɔmfa eguambaa a oedzi afrenhyia a wɔdze bɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr, nye aborɔnoma ba, anaa atamram a wɔdze bɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr, mbra ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano mbɛma ɔsɔfo no:
Na ɔmfa mbɔ afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na ɔmpata mma no; na no ho ntsew wɔ no bɔgyaagu no ho. Iyi nye mbra a ɔwɔ hɔ ma nyia ɔwo ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa.
Na sɛ ne nsa annsõ eguambaa do a, ɔno ɔmfa ntamram ebien; kor nyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr, na kor so nyɛ bɔn ho afɔr: Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no, na no ho ntsew.
13: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ,

Sɛ nyimpa bi nya no honam wer mu biribi soaa, anaa ntwintwamee, anaa ntokowa ntokowa, anaa odzidzi no honam wer mu yɛ kwata ntsetsewee a, ɔno wɔmfa no mbra ɔsɔfo Aaron, anaa ne mbabanyin asɔfo no mu kor:

Na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ honam wer no mu: Na sɛ nhwi a ɔwɔ ntsetsewee no mu adan fitaa na ntsetsewee no enyi atotɔ mu asen no honam wer no a, ɔyɛ kwata ntsetsewee; na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ no, na ɔnkã dɛ no ho nntsew.
Na sɛ ntokowa ntokowa no yɛ fitaa wɔ no honam wer no mu, na n'enyi atotɔ mu asen wer no, na no nhwi nndaan fitaa a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no ntow owuyarfo no mu nda esuon:
Na da a otsīa esuon no ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ no: Na, hwɛ, sɛ ntsetsewee no esianka wɔ n'enyi do, na ntsetsewee no nntserɛwee wɔ wer no mu a, ɔno asɔfo no ntow no mu nda esuon bio:

Na da a otsīa esuon no ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ no bio: Na, hwɛ, sɛ ntsetsewee no enyi edum, na ntsetsewee no nntserɛwee wɔ wer no mu a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no nkã dɛ no ho tsew: Ɔyɛ ntwintwamee: Na ɔnhor ne ntar, na no ho ntsew.
Mbom ɔdze noho akɛkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no wɔ n'ahotsewee ho ekyir no, na sɛ ntwintwamee no tserɛw wɔ wer no mu a, ɔmfa no ho nkɛkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no bio:
Na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ, na hwɛ, sɛ ntwintwamee no atserɛw wɔ wer no mu a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no nkã dɛ no ho nntsew: Ɔyɛ kwata.
Sɛ kwata ntsetsewee wɔ nyimpa bi ho a, ɔno wɔmfa no mbra ɔsɔfo no;
na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ, na, hwɛ, sɛ biribi fitaa soaa bi wɔbwer no mu, na ɔadan nhwi no fitaa, na honam momon rupuw wɔ soaa no mu a,
ɔyɛ kwata dadaw a ɔwɔ no honam wer no mu, na ɔsɔfo no nkã dɛ no ho nntsew: Mma ɔnntow no mu: Na no ho nntsew.
Na sɛ kwata no epue efi wer no mu, na kwata no akata owuyarfo no no wer nyinara ho fi n'etsifi keka n'ananadze dɛ mbrɛ ɔda edzi ma ɔsɔfo no ara a;
ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ: Na, hwɛ, sɛ kwata no akata no honam nyinara do a, ɔnkã dɛ owuyarfo no no ho tsew: Ne nyinara adan fitaa: No ho tsew.
Mbom aber biara a honam momon ada edzi wɔ no ho no, no ho nntsew.
Na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ honam momon no, na ɔnkã dɛ no ho nntsew: Honam momon no ho nntsew: Ɔyɛ kwata.
Anaa sɛ honam momon no dan bio, na adan fitaa a, ɔno ɔmbra ɔsɔfo no hɔ,
na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ no: Na, hwɛ, sɛ ntsetsewee no dan fitaa a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no nkã dɛ owuyarfo no no ho tsew: No ho atsew.
Na sɛ pɔmpɔ bi bɔ wɔ honam no wer no mu, na ɔsa,
na soaa fitaa bi bɔsoa anaa ntokowa ntokowa fitaa, ɔberhoamu, ba pɔmpɔ no ananmu a, ɔno wɔmfa nkɛkyerɛ asɔfo no;
na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ, na, hwɛ, sɛ n'enyi atotɔ mu asen wer no; na no nhwi no adan fitaa a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no nkã dɛ no ho nntsew: Ɔyɛ kwata ntsetsewee, oepue wɔ pɔmpɔ no mu.
Mbom sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na hwɛ, nhwi fitaa bi nnyi mu, na ɔnntotɔ mu nnsen wer no, na n'enyi dum a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no ntow no mu nda esuon:
Na sɛ ɔtserɛw wɔ wer no mu a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no nkã dɛ no ho nntsew: Ɔyɛ ntsetsewee.
Mbom sɛ ntokowa ntokowa no sianka n'ananmu, na ɔanntserɛw a, ɔyɛ pɔmpɔ no itua; na ɔsɔfo no nkã dɛ no ho tsew.
Anaa sɛ gya hyew-ano-tua bi ba honam no wer no mu, na ɔhyew-ano-tua no do rupuw yɛ ntokowa ntokowa, ɔberhoamu, anaa fitaa a;

ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ: Na, hwɛ, sɛ nhwi a ɔwɔ ntokowa ntokowa no do adan fitaa, na n'enyi atotɔ mu asen wer no a; ɔyɛ kwata, oepue wɔ ɔhyew-ano-tua no mu: Na ɔsɔfo no nkã dɛ no ho nntsew: Ɔyɛ kwata ntsetsewee.
Mbom sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na, hwɛ, nhwi fitaa bi nnyi ntokowa ntokowa no mu, na ɔnntotɔɔ mu nnseen wer no, na n'enyi dum a: Ɔno ɔsɔfo no ntow no mu nda esuon:
Na da a otsī esuon no ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ no: Sɛ ɔtserɛw wɔ wer no mu a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no nkã dɛ no ho nntsew: Ɔyɛ kwata ntsetsewee.
Na sɛ ntokowa ntokowa no sianka wɔ n'ananmu, na ɔanntserɛw wɔ wer no mu, na n'enyi dum a; ɔyɛ ɔhyew-ano-tua soaa, na ɔsɔfo no nkã dɛ no ho tsew: Na ɔyɛ ɔhyew-ano-tua no itua.
Na sɛ obanyin anaa ɔbaa bi nya ntsetsewee wɔ n'etsifi anaa n'abɔdwesa mu a,
ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ ntsetsewee no: Na, hwɛ, sɛ enyi atotɔ mu asen wer no, na nhwi memen tseatseaba bi wɔ mu a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no nkã dɛ no ho nntsew: Ɔyɛ ntutui, ɔyɛ tsir anaa abɔdwesa mu kwata.
Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ ntutui ne ntsetsewee no, na, hwɛ, n'enyi nntotɔ mu nnsen wer no, n anhwi tuntum bi nnyi mu a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no ntow ntutui owuyarfo no mu nda esuon:
Na da a otsīa esuon no ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ ntsetsewee no; na, hwɛ, sɛ ntutui no nntserɛwee, na nhwi memen bi nnyi mu, na ntutui no n'enyi nntotɔ mu nnsen wer no a,
ɔno wonyi no, mbom ntutui no na mma wonnyi; na ɔsɔfo no ntow nyia ɔyar ntutui no mu nda esuon bio:
Na da a otsīa esuon no mu ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ ntutui no: Na, hwɛ, sɛ ntutui no nntserɛw wer no do, na n'enyi nntotɔ mu nnsen wer no a; ɔno ɔsɔfo no nkã dɛ no ho tsew: na ɔnhor ne ntar, na no ho ntsew.
Mbom n'ahotsewee ekyir no sɛ ntutui no tserɛw wɔ wer no mu a;
ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ no; na, hwɛ, sɛ ntutui no tserɛW wɔ wer no mu a, mma ɔsɔfo no nnhwehwɛ nhwi memen no; no ho nntsew.
Mbom sɛ ntutui no yɛ n'enyiwa do dɛ oesianka, na nhwi tuntum efuw wɔ mu a; ntutui no asa, no ho atsew: na ɔsɔfo no nkã dɛ no ho atsew.
Na sɛ obanyin anaa ɔbaa nya ntokowa ntokowa, mekyerɛ ntokowa ntokowa fitaa wɔ hɔn honam wer mu a;
ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ: Na, hwɛ, sɛ ntokowa ntokowa a n'enyi dum fitaa na ɔwɔ hɔn honam wer mu a; ɔyɛ ayam na oepue wɔ wer no mu; no ho tsew.
Na sɛ obanyin bi no nhwi pepa wɔ n'etsifi a, ɔyɛ otsipaa; naaso no ho tsew.
Na sɛ no nhewi pepa wɔ n'etsifi enyim afamu a, ɔyɛ pampamu-tsipaa; naaso no ho tsew.
Mbom sɛ ntsetsewee ɔberhoamu bi tow ne tsipaa no mu, anaa ne pampamu paa no mu a; ɔyɛ kwata a orupue ne tsipaa, anaa ne pampamu paa no mu.
Nkyii ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ no; na, hwɛ, sɛ ntsetsewee no soaa no yɛ ɔberhoamu wɔ ne tsipaa no mu, anaa ne pampamu paa no mu, dɛ mbrɛ kwata firii tse wɔ honam wer no mu a;
ɔyɛ ɔkwatanyi, no ho nntsew: Kã ara na ɔsɔfo no nkã dɛ no ho nntsew; ne ntsetsewee wɔ n'etsifi.
Na ɔkwatanyi a owuyar no wɔ no ho no, onsuansuan ne ntar mu, na ɔmbɔ ne tsinhwi mpɛsɛw, na ɔnkata n'anofamfa sor no, na ɔntsēa mu dɛ, ɔho-nntsew o, ɔho-nntsew o.
Nda dodow a owuyar no wɔ no ho no nyinara no ho renntsew; no ho nntsew: Noara nkotoo ntsena; nseraban no ekyir na ɔnyɛ ne tsenabew.
Atar so a kwata ntsetsewee wɔ mu no, sɛ ɔyɛ kuntu atar o, ndwera atar o;
sɛ ndwera, anaa kuntu, ne nsa anaa ne mfa mu o; sɛ nwoma, anaa adze biara a wɔdze nwoma ayɛ mu o;
sɛ ntsetsewee no yɛ ebunebun anaa ɔberber wɔ atar no mu, anaa nwoma no mu, anaa nsa no mu, anaa mfa no mu, anaa nwoma adze biara mu a; ɔyɛ kwata ntsetsewee, na wɔmfa nkɛkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no:
Na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ ntsetsewee no, na ɔntow ntsetsewee adze no mu nda esuon:

Na da a otsīa esuon no ɔnhwɛ ntsetsewee no: Sɛ ntsetsewee no atserɛw wɔ atar no mu, anaa nsa no mu, anaa mfa no mu, anaa nwoma no mu, anaa biribiara a wɔdze nwoma ayɛ no mu a; ntsetsewee no yɛ kwata a ɔwewe; no ho nntsew.
Na ɔnhyew atar no, sɛ nsa no o, mfa no o, wɔ kuntu mu, anaa ndwera mu, anaa nwoma adze biara a ntsetsewee no wɔ mu no: Na ɔyɛ kwata a ɔwewe; wɔnkyew no wɔ gya mu.
Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na, hwɛ, ntsetsewee no nntserɛw wɔ atar no mu, wɔ nsa no mu, anaa mfa no mu, anaa nwoma adze biara mu a;
ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ ma wɔnhor adze no a ntsetsewee no wɔ mu no, na ɔntow no mu nda esuon bio:
Na ɔahor ntsetsewee no ekyir no, ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ: Na, hwɛ, sɛ ntsetsewee no nnsakyer n'enyi, na ntsetsewee no nntserɛwee a, no ho nntsew; hyew no wɔ ogya mu: ɔyɛ nwewee, sɛ kwawoow no wɔ mu o, ekyir o.
Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na, hwɛ, ntsetsewee no no hor ekyir no n'enyi edum a, ɔno ɔntsew mfi atar no ho, anaa nwoma no ho, anaa nsa no ho, anaa mfa no ho:
Na sɛ ɔda ho pue wɔ atar no mu, anaa nsa no mu, anaa mfa no mu, anaa nwoma adze biara no mu a, na orupue: Fa gya hyew dza ntsetsewee no wɔ mu no.
Na atar no, anaa nsa no, anaa mfa no, anaa nwoma adze biara a ebɔhor no, sɛ ntsetsewee no fi mu a, ɔno wɔnhor bio, na no ho atsew.
Iyi nye mbra a ɔwɔ hɔ ma kwata ntsetsewee wɔ kuntu anaa ndwera atar ho, wɔ nsa anaa mfa, anaa nwoma adze biara mu, ma wɔdze aakã dɛ no ho tsew, anaa wɔdze aakã dɛ no ho nntsew.
14: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Iyi nye mbra a ɔwɔ hɔ ma ɔkwatanyi wɔ n'ahotsewee da no mu: Wɔmfa no mbra ɔsɔfo no:
Na ɔsɔfo no mfir edzi nkɔ nseraban no ekyir: Na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ, na, hwɛ, sɛ kwata ntsetsewee no asa wɔ ɔkwatanyi no mu a;
ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ ma wɔmfa nnoma enyikan a hɔn ho tsew ebien, nye kyindur dua, nye serdaa, nye hyssop, mma nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no mbra:
Na ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ mma wonku nnoma no mu kor wɔ dɛtsesɛn bi mu wɔ mbasu do:
Anoma nyikan no dze, ɔmfa ɔno, nye kyindur dua no, nye serdaa no, nye hyssop no, na ɔmfa ne nyinara nye anoma nyikan no mbɔ anoma a wokum no wɔ mbasu do no no bɔgyaa mu:
Na ɔmfa mpetse nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho efi kwata ho no do mpɛn esuon, na ɔnka dɛ no ho atsew, na ongyaa anoma nyikan no ma ɔnkɔ haban mu.
Na nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no, nhor ne ntar, na onyi no nhwi nyinara, na onguar nsu mu, na no ho aatsew: Na n'ekyir no ɔmbra nseraban no mu dze, na ɔntsena no buw ekyir nda esuon.
Na ɔmbra dɛ da a otsīa esuon no, na onyi no nhwi nyinara wɔ n'etsifi nye n'abɔdwesa nye no ntɔn, mekyerɛ no nhwi nyinara na onyi: Na ɔnhor ne ntar, na onguar no honam wɔ nsu mu, na no ho aatsew.

Na da a otsīa awɔtwe no ɔmfa nguambaanyin ebien a wonndzi dzɛm, nye nguambaaber kor a oedzi afrenhyia a onndzi dzɛm, na edziban-afɔr esiam pa ephah ebupɛn du mu ebiasa a wɔdze ngo aforɔw, na ngo toa kor, mbra.
Na ɔsɔfo no a ɔtsew no ho mfa ɔbanyin a wɔrebɛtsew no ho no, nye ndzɛmba no, mbegyina Ewuradze enyim, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano:
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa nguambaanyin no mu kor, na ɔmfa no mbra dɛ asodzi ho afɔr, nye ngo toa no, na ɔntow no ɔtow-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim:

Na onku eguambaanyin no wɔ beebi mbrɛ woku bɔn ho afɔr nye ɔhyew-afɔr no, wɔ ahotseweebea no do hɔ: Na dɛ mbrɛ bɔn ho afɔr no yɛ ɔsɔfo no dze no, dɛmara na asodzi ho afɔr no so: Ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn:
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa asodzi ho afɔr bɔgyaa no bi, na ɔsɔfo no mfa nkeka nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no n'aso nyimfa ano, nye ne nsa nyimfa kokrobetsir, nye ne nan nyimfa kokonyin ano:
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ngo toa no, na onhue bi ngu nankasa ne nsa bankum mu:
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatseaba nyimfa mbɔ ngo no a ɔwɔ ne nsa bankum mu no mu, na ɔmfa ne nsatseaba mpetse ngo no bi mpɛn esuon wɔ Ewuradze enyim:
Na ngo no nkaa no a ɔwɔ ne nsamu no ɔsɔfo no mfa bi nkekã nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no n'aso nyimfa ano, nye ne nsa nyimfa kokurobetsir, nye ne nan nyimfa kokonyin ano, wɔ asodzi ho afɔr bɔgyaa no do:
Na ngo nkaa no a ɔwɔ ɔsɔfo ne nsamu no ɔmfa ngu nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no etsifi: Na ɔsɔfo mpata mma no wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na ɔsɔfo no mbɔ bɔn ho afɔr no, na ɔmpata mma nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho wɔ n'ahofi ntsi; na n'ekyir no onku hyew-afɔr no:
Na ɔsɔfo no mbɔ hyew-afɔr no nye edziban-afɔr no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no, na no ho ntsew.

Na sɛ odzi hia, na onnkotum enya no dodow dɛm a, ɔno ɔmfa eguambaanyin kor mbɛyɛ asodzi ho afɔr mma wɔntow mfa mpata mma no, na edziban-afɔr esiam pa ephah ebupɛn du mu kor a wɔdze ngo aforɔw, na ngo toa;
na ntamram ebien, anaa mborɔnoma mba ebien, dɛ mbrɛ ne nsa bɔsõ do ara; na kor nyɛ bɔn ho afɔr, na kor so, nyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr .
Na da a otsīa awɔtwe no ɔmfa mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no, wɔ ehiadzebuw no n'abowano, wɔ Ewuradze enyim, wɔ n'ahoguar ntsi.
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa asodzi ho afɔr eguambaa no, nye ngo toa no, na ɔsɔfo no ntow no nyɛ ɔtow-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim:
Na onku asozdi ho afɔr eguambaa no, na ɔsɔfo no mfa asodzi no afɔr bɔgyaa no bi, na ɔmfa nkekā nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no n'aso nyimfa ano, nye ne nsa nyimfa kokrobetsir nye ne nan nyimfa kokonyin ano:
Na ɔsɔfo no nhue ngo no bi ngu nankasa ne nsa bankum mu:
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatseaba nyimfa mfa ngo no a ɔwɔ ne nsa bankum mu no bi mpetse mpɛn esuon wɔ Ewuradze enyim:
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ngo no a ɔwɔ ne nsamu no bi nkekã nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no n'aso nyimfa ano, nye ne nsa nyimfa kokrobetsir, nye ne nan nyimfa kokonyin ano wɔ mbrɛ asodzi ho afɔr bɔgyaa no wɔ no:
Na ngo no ne nkaa no a ɔwɔ ɔsɔfo no nsamu no ɔmfa ngu nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no etsifi, mfa nyɛ mpata mma no wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na ɔmfa ntamram anaa mborɔnomamba no mu kor, dɛ mbrɛ ne nsa bɔsõ do no ara mbra;
mekyerɛ dɛ mbrɛ ne nsa bɔsõ do no ara, kor nyɛ bɔn ho afɔr, na kor so nyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr nka ezdiban-afɔr no ho: Na ɔsɔfo no mpata nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Iyi nye mbra a ɔwɔ hɔ ma nyia kwata ntsetsewee akã no a ne nsa nnsõ n'ahoguar adze do no.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ,
Sɛ hom du Canaan asaase a medze rema hom dɛ enyadze no do, na sɛ medze kwata ntsetsewee mobɔto hom enyadze asaase do ofi bi mu a;
ɔno ofi no wura no mbra, na ɔmbɛkã nkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no dɛ, ɔyɛ me dɛ biribi tse dɛ ntsetsewee bi esi ofi no mu hɔ:
Na ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ ma wɔnto ofi no pan, ansaana ɔsɔfo no akɔ mu akɔhwɛ ntsetsewee no, amma dza ɔwɔ ofi no mu nyinara ho eenngu fī: Na n'ekyir no ɔsɔfo no nkɔ mu nkɔhwɛ ofi no:
Na ɔnhwɛ ntsetsewee no, na, hwɛ, sɛ ntsetsewee no wɔ ofi no ne fadum ho ntokur-ntokur mu nkekaa ebunebun anaa mberberee, na n'enyi atotɔ mu asen ɔfadum no a;
ɔno ɔsɔfo no mfi ofi no mu mpue ofi no n'abowano, na ɔntow ofi no mu nda esuon:
Na da a otsīa esuon no ɔsɔfo no mbra bio, na ɔmbɔhwɛ: Na, hwɛ, sɛ ntsetsewee no atserɛw wɔ ofi no ne fadum ho a;
ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ ma wonyiyi abo a ntsetsewee no wɔ ho no, na wɔnkɔtow ngu kurow no n'ekyir mbrɛ hɔ nntsew:
Na ɔmma wɔntwerɛw ofi no mu nhyia, na wɔmfa dɛtse a wɔatwerɛw no nkogu kurow no ekyir mbrɛ hɔ nntsew:
Na wɔmfa abo fofor, na wɔmfa nhyehyɛ abo no n'ananmu; na ɔmfa dɛtse fofor, na ɔmfa ntetar ofi no ho.
Na oetutu abo no ekyir, na ɔatwerɛw ofi no mu ekyir, na ɔatetar ekyir no, na sɛ ntsetsewee no ba bio, na opue wɔ ofi no mu a;
ɔno ɔsɔfo no mbra mbɔhwɛ, na hwɛ, sɛ ntsetseweee no atserɛw wɔ ofi no mu a, ɔyɛ kwata nwewee wɔ ofi no mu: No ho nntsew.
Na ondwuruw ofi no ngu famu, n'abo, nye no mpuna, nye ofi no ne dɛtse nyinara; na ɔnsoa mfi kurow no mu mpue nkogu mbrɛ hɔ nntsew.
Afei so nyia ɔbɔkɔ ofi no mu wɔ aber a wɔatow mu no nyinara mu no, no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Na nyia ɔda wɔ ofi no mu no nhor ne ntar.
Na sɛ wɔatetar ofi no n'ekyir no, ɔsɔfo no ba, na ɔbɔhwɛ, na, hwɛ, ntsetsewee no nntserɛw wɔ ofi no mu a; ɔno ɔsɔfo no nkã dɛ ofi no ho tsew, osiandɛ ntsetsewee no asa.
Na ɔmfa nnoma ebien, nye kyindur dua, nye serdaa, nye hyssop ntsew ofi no ho:
Na onku nnoma no mu kor wɔ dɛtsesɛn mu wɔ mbasu do:
Na ɔmfa kyindur dua no, nye hyssop no, nye serdaa no, nye anoma nyikan no, na ɔmfa anoma a woeku no no no bɔgyaa mu, nye mbasu no mu, na ɔmfa mpetse ofi no do mpɛn esuon:
Na ɔmfa anoma no no bɔgyaa, nye mbasu no, nye anoma nyikan no, nye kyindur dua no, nye hyssop no, nye serdaa no, ntsew ofi no ho:
Mbom ongyaa anoma nyikan no ma omfi kurow no mu nkɔ haban hantann no mu: Ma ɔmpata mma ofi no: na no ho ntsew.
Iyi nye mbra a ɔwɔ hɔ ma kwata ntsetsewee ahorow nyinara, nye ntutui;
nye ntar nye ofi ho kwata;
na soaa, nye ntwintwamee, nye ntokowa ntokowa:
Ma wɔdze akyerɛkyerɛ aber a adze ho nntsew, nye aber a adze ho tsew: Iyi nye kwata ho mbra.
15: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron, dɛ,
Hom nkasa nkyerɛ Israelmba, na wonse hɔn dɛ, Sɔ ɔbanyin biara nya ahosen ma ofi no hanam mu gu a, n'ahosen no ntsi no ho nntsew.
Na iyi nye n'ahoɔfi wɔ n'ahosen no mu: Sɛ n'ahosen no fi no honam, anaa n'ahosen ma no honam n'ano siw a, ɔyɛ n'ahoɔfi.
Mpa biara a nyia ɔwɔ ahosen no da do no, no ho nntsew: Na adze biara a ɔko do no no ho nntsew.
Na obiara a ɔka ne mpa no, nhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, na no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Na nyia ɔko adze biara a nyia ɔwɔ ahosen no atsena do no, nhor ne ntar, na onguar no ho wɔ nsu mu, na no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Na nyia ɔkã nyia ɔwɔ ahosɛn no no honam no, nhor ne ntar, na onguar no ho wɔ nsu mu, na no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Na sɛ nyia ɔwɔ ahosen to ntafi gu nyia no ho tsew do a; ɔno ɔnhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, na noho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Na apɔnkɔgua biara a nyia ɔwɔ ahosɛn no bɛtsena do no, no ho nntsew.
Na obiara a ɔka adze biara a ɔhyɛ n'ase no, no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir: Na nyia ɔsoa dɛm ndzɛmba no nhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, na no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Obiara a nyia ɔwɔ ahosen annhohor ne nsa ho wɔ nsu mu na ɔdze bɛkã no no, ɔnhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, na no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Na dɛtsesɛn a nyia ɔwɔ ahosen no bɛka no, wɔmbɔ no: Na dua adze biara dze wɔnhor no wɔ nsu mu.
Na sɛ nyia ɔwɔ ahosen no wɔtsew no ho fi n'ahosen no mu a, ɔno ɔnkan nda esuon wɔ n'ahofir ntsi, na ɔnhor ne ntar, na onguar no honam wɔ mbasu mu, na no ho aatsew.
Na da a otsīa awɔtwe no ɔno noara mfa ntamram ebien, nye mborɔnomamba ebien, na ɔmfa mbra Ewuradze enyim wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano, na ɔmfa mma ɔsɔfo;
na ɔsɔfo no mfa mbɔ afɔr, kor nyɛ bɔn ho afɔr, na kor so nyɛ ɔhew-afɔr; na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ Ewuradze enyim wɔ n'ahosen no ntsi.
Na sɛ ɔbanyin bi n'ahoba fi no mu fir a, ɔno onguar no honam nyinara wɔ nsu mu, na no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Na atar biara, nye nwoma biara a ahoba bogu mu no, wɔmfa nsu nhor, na no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Ɔbaa so a ɔbanyin dze ahoba nye no da no, hɔn beenu nyinara nguar hɔnho wɔ nsu mu, na hɔn ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Na sɛ ɔbaa nya ahosen, na ahosen yɛ bɔgya fi no honam mu gu a, ɔntsena n'asabu mu nda esuon: Na obiara a ɔkã no no, no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Na adze biara a ɔda do wɔ n'asabu mu no, no ho nntsew, na adze biara so a ɔtsena do no, no ho nntsew.
Na obiara a ɔkã ne mpa no, nhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, na noho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Na obiara a ɔkã adze biara a ɔtsena do no, nhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, na noho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Na sɛ ɔwɔ mpa no do, anaa adze biara a ɔtsena do no do, na sɛ ɔkã a, no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Na sɛ ɔbanyin bi nye no da, na n'asabu adze no bi kã no ho a, no ho nntsew ara nda esuon; na mpa biara a ɔda do no no ho nntsew.
Na sɛ ɔbaa nya no bɔgyaa ahosen nda pii a ɔnnyɛ n'asabu aber mu, anaa onya ahosen ma ɔtra n'asabu aber a; n'ahoɔfi ahosen nda no nyinara ɔnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ n'asabu nda no mu tse: No ho nntsew.
Mpa biara a ɔda do wɔ n'ahosen nda nyinara mu no; ɔnyɛ no dɛ mbrɛ n'asabu mpa tse; na adze biara a ɔtsena do no no ho nntsew, dɛ mbrɛ n'asabu mu ahoɔfi tse.
Na obiara a ɔkã ndzɛmba no no ho nntsew, na ɔnhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, na no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir.
Mbom sɛ no ho tsew wɔ n'ahosen ho a, ɔno ɔnkan nda esuon, na n'ekyir no no ho aatsew.
Na da a otsīa awɔtwe no onnya ntamram ebien, anaa mborɔnomamba ebien, na ɔmfa mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano.
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa kor mbɔ bɔn ho afɔr, na kor so mbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr; na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ Ewuradze enyim wɔ n'ahoɔfi ahosen no ntsi.
Dɛm na hom mfa nyi Israel mfi hɔn ahoɔfi mu; amma woeennwuwu wɔ hɔn ahoɔfi mu, aber a worukogu me ntamadan a ɔwɔ hɔn mu no ho fī no.
Iyi nye mbra a ɔwɔ hɔ ma nyia ɔwɔ ahosen, nye nyia ɔwɔ ahoba a ofi no mu gu, ma ɔdze gu noho fī;
na nyia ɔyar wɔ n'asabu mu, nye nyia ɔnye nyia no ho nntsew da no.
16: Na Aaron ne mbabanyin beenu no hɔn wu a wɔtwee bɛɛn Ewuradze enyim, na wowuwui no ekyir no, Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses;

na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Kasa kyerɛ wo nua Aaron dɛ, Mma ɔnnhɛn bea krɔnkrɔn no mu nnkɔ ntwamutam no mu, wɔ mbɔbɔrhu-agua no a ɔwɔ adaka no do no enyim aber nyinara; amma woeennwuwu: Na mununkum no mu na mibeyi moho makyerɛ wɔ mbɔrbɔrhu-egua no do.
Iyi na Aaron mfa mbɛhɛn bea krɔnkrɔn no: Ɔnantwisaa eburwa a wɔdze bɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr, nye odwanyin a wɔdze bɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr.
Ɔnhyɛ ndwera sortar krɔnkrɔn no, na ndwera ntwontwo no nkata no ho, na ndwera abɔyamu no mbɔ do, na ɔnhyɛ ndwera asɔfohyew no: Ntar krɔnkrɔn no nye no; onguar no honam wɔ nsu mu, na ɔnhyɛ.
Na ɔngye Israelmba mboanofo no hɔ mpɔnkyenyin ebien mfa mbɔ bɔn ho afɔr, na odwanyin kor mfa mbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr.
Na Aaron mfa bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no a ɔyɛ nankasa nedze no, mbra, na ɔmfa mpata mma nankasa noho nye ne fi.
Na ɔmfa mpɔnkye ebien no, na ɔmfa hɔn mbegyina Ewuradze enyim wɔ ehyiadzebuw no n'abowano.
