Na Aaron ntwe mpɔnkye ebien no ho tonto; tonto kor nyɛ Ewuradze dze, na tonto kor so nyɛ Azazel dze.
Na Aaron mfa apɔnkye a Ewuradze tonto bɔɔ no no mbra, na ɔmfa mbɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr.
Apɔnkye a Azazel tonto bɔɔ no no dze, ɔmfa no enyikan mbegyina Ewuradze enyim, mfa mpata mma no, dɛ wokegyaa no ma Azazel ma ɔkɔ sar no do.
Na Aaron mfa bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no a ɔyɛ nankasa ne dze no mbra, ma ɔmfa mpata mma nankasa noho, nye ne fi, na onku bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no a ɔyɛ nankasa nedze no:
Na ɔmfa eduhuamsɛn gyabiriw mma omfi afɔrmbukyia no do wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na eduhuam a woesiw no mokomoko ne nsa mã, na ɔmfa mbra ntwamutam no mu:
Na ɔmfa eduhuam no ngu gya no do wɔ Ewuradze enyim, ama eduhuam no no wusiw aakata mbɔbɔrhu-egua no a ɔwɔ dase no do no ho, ma oeennwuwu:
Na ɔmfa nantwisaa no ho bɔgyaa bi, na ɔmfa ne nsatseaba nkã mpetse mbɔbɔrhu-egua no do wɔ boka afamu; na ɔmfa ne nsatseaba nkã bɔgya no bi mpetse mbɔbɔrhu-egua no enyim mpɛn esuon.

Nkyii onku bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkye no a ɔyɛ ɔman no dze no, na ɔmfa no bɔgyaa no mbra ntwamutam no mu, na ɔmfa no bɔgyaa no nyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔdze nantwisaa no no bɔgyaa yɛe no, na ɔmfa mpetse mbɔbɔrhu-egua no do, na mbɔbɔrhu-egua no enyim:
Na ɔmfa mpata mma bea krɔnkrɔn no, wɔ Israelmba hɔn efifidze, nye hɔn mbrato ntsi, mekyerɛ hɔn bɔn nyinara ho; na dɛm na ɔyɛ mma ehyiadzibuw no a osi hɔn mu wɔ hɔn hɔn efifidze mu no.
Na mma nyimpa biara nntsena ehyiadzibuw no mu aber a ɔrokɔ mu akɛpata wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn no ara nkodu dɛ obefir ezdi, na ɔapata ama nankasa noho, nye ne fifo, nye Israel bagua no nyinara.
Na omfir edzi nkɔ afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ Ewuradze enyim no ho, na ɔmpata mma no; na ɔmfa nantwisaa no no bɔgyaa no bi, nye apɔnkye no no bɔgyaa no bi na ɔmfa nkeka afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn ho nhyia.
Na ɔmfa ne nsatseaba nkã bɔgyaa no bi mpetse do mpɛn esuon, na ɔntsew ho, na ɔnyɛ no krɔnkrɔn mfi Israelmba hɔn efifidze no mu.
Na sɛ owie mpata ma bea krɔnkrɔn no, nye ehyiadzibuw no, nye afɔrmbukyia no a, ɔmfa apɔnkye nyikan no mbra:

Na Aaron mfa ne nsa ebien nyinara ngu apɔnkye nyikan no etsifi, na ɔnkã Israelmba hɔn emumuyɛ nyinara, nye hɔn mbrato nyinara, mekyerɛ hɔn bɔn nyinara, ngu no do; na ɔmfa ngu apɔnkye no etsifi, na ɔmfa no nhyɛ ɔbanyin a woeyi no esihɔ nsa ma onkegyaa no ma ɔnkɔ sar no do:
Na apɔnkye no nsoa hɔn emumuyɛ nyinara mfa nkɔ asaase kɔnkɔn do: Na ongyaa apɔnkye no wɔ sar no do.
Na Aaron mbra ehyiadzibuw no mu, na onyi ndwera ntar no a ɔhyɛe kɔr bea krɔnkrɔn no, na ongyaa no wɔ hɔ:
Na onguar no honam wɔ nsu mu wɔ beebi a ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn, na ɔnhyɛ ne ntar, na omfir edzi, na ɔnkɔbɔ ne hyew-afɔr nye ɔman no hɔn hyew-afɔr no, na ɔmpata mma nankasa noho, nye ɔman no.
Na bɔn ho afɔr seradze no ɔnhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.
Na nyia okegyaa apɔnkye no ma Azazel na ɔnhor ne ntar, na onguar no honam wɔ nsu mu, na n'ekyir no ɔmbra nseraban no mu.
Na bɔn ho Afɔr nantwisaa no, nye bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkye a wɔdze hɔn bɔgyaa baa bɛpataa wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn no, wɔmfa nkɔ nseraban no ekyir; na wɔnhyew hɔn nwoma, nye hɔn nam, nye hɔn bin wɔ gya mu.
Na nyia ɔhyew no no nhor ne ntar, na onguar no honam wɔ nsu mu, na n'ekyir no ɔmbra nseraban no mu.
Na ɔyɛ daa ahyɛdze ma hom: Bosoom a otsīa esuon no mu no, bosoom no ne da a otsīa du no, hom mbrɛ hom akra adze, na mma wɔnnyɛ edwuma biara, okuromnyi o, ɔhɔho a ɔbɔsoɛ hom mu o,
na da yi mu na wɔmpata mma hom, mfa ntsew homho; na hom ho aatsew efi hom bɔn nyinara mu wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Ɔyɛ ahomgye mu ahomgyeda ma hom, na hom mbrɛ hom akra adze; ɔyɛ daa ahyɛdze.
Na ɔsɔfo no a wɔsera no ngo no a woetu no esi nkyɛn dɛ ondzi ɔsɔfo no n'egya ananmu no mpata, na ɔhyɛ ndwerɛ ntar no, mekyerɛ ntar krɔnkrɔn no;
na ɔmpata mma ahotseweebea krɔnkrɔn no, na ɔmpata mma ehyiadzibuw no nye afɔrmbukyia no, na ɔmpata mma ɔsɔfo no nye ɔman baguafo no nyinara.
Na iyi nyɛ daa ahyɛdze mma hom, mfa mpata mma Israelmba wɔ hɔn bɔn nyinara ntsi prɛko wɔ afrenhyia mu. Na ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
17: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Aaron, nye ne mbabanyin no, nye Israelmba nyinara, na se hɔn dɛ: Iyi nye adze a Ewuradze ahyɛ ho mbra no dɛ,
Nyimpa biara a ofi Israel ofi mu a oku nantwinyin, anaa eguambaa, anaa apɔnkye wɔ nseraban no mu no, anaa nyia oku no wɔ nseraban no ekyir no,

na ɔmmfa no mma ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano dɛ ayɛyɛdze a ɔdze rebrɛ Ewuradze wɔ Ewuradze ntamadan enyim no: Bɔgya na wobobu egu nyimpa no do; ɔaka bɔgya egu; na nyimpa no wobotwa no efi ne man mu akyen:
Ama Israelmba dze hɔn afɔrbɔdze a wokum no wɔ sar no do no aaba, dɛ ama wɔdze aabrɛ Ewuradze, dze aaba ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano, dze aabrɛ asɔfo no, na woeeku no abɔ asomdwee-afɔr ama Ewuradze.
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa bɔgya no mpetse Ewuradze afɔrmbukyia no do wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano, na ɔnhyew seradze ma onyi nka huanhuam mma Ewuradze.
Na mma wonnku hɔn afɔrbɔdze mma mpɔnkyenyin a wodzi hɔn ekyir ebubudzi do no bio. Iyi nye daa ahyɛdze mma hɔn wɔ hɔn ebusuasantsen nyinara mu.
Na ɔwo kã kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Nyimpa biara a ofi Isreal ofi mu, anaa ofi ahɔho a wɔabɔsoɛ hɔn mu no mu a ɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr anaa okum-afɔr bi,
na ɔmmfa mmba ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano, mmbɔbɔ mma Ewuradze no: Mekyerɛ nyimpa wobotwa no efi ne man mu akyen.
Na nyimpa biara a ofi Israel ofi mu, anaa ofi ahɔho a wɔabosoɛ hɔn mu no mu a odzi bɔgya biara no; m'enyi bɛsa ɔkra no a ozdi bɔgya no, na metwa no efi ne man mu akyen.
Osiandɛ honam no nkwa wɔ bɔgya no mu: Na medze ama hom wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do dɛ wɔmfa mpata mma hom akra: Na osian nkwa no ntsi bɔgya no na ɔpata ma.
Dɛm ntsi na mesee Israelmba dɛ, mma hom mu ɔkra biara nndzi bɔgya, nkyii so mma ɔhɔho biara a ɔsoɛ hom mu nndzi bɔgya.
Na nyimpa biara a ofi Israelmba mu, anaa ofi ahɔho a wɔabɔsoɛ hɔn mu no mu a ɔyɛ ha no, ku abowa anaa anoma biara a wodzi a, ɔnsɔn no bɔgyaa ngu, na ɔmfa dɛtse nkata do.

Na honam nyinara no nkwa dze, no bɔgyaa ara nye no nkwa: Dɛm ntsi na mesee Israelmba dɛ, mma hom nndzi honam biara no bɔgyaa: Osiandɛ honam nyinara no nkwa nye no bɔgyaa: Obiara a odzi no, wobotwa no akyen.
Na ɔkra biara a odzi dza noara ewu no, anaa dza abowa atsetsew no no; sɛ ɔyɛ okuromnyi o, ɔhɔho o, onhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, na no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir: Ana afei no ho atsew.
Mbom sɛ ɔannhor, nkyii so oennguar no honam a, ɔno ɔnsoa no mbusu.
18: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Egypt asaase a hom tsenaa do no do nyɛe no, mma hom nnyɛ: Na Canaan asaase a medze hom rokɔ do no do nyɛe no so, mma hom nnyɛ: Nkyii so mma hom nndzi hɔn ahyɛdze do.
Me ntsɛmbu na hom nyɛ, na hom nsie m'ahyɛdze, dɛ wobedzi do: Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Dɛm ntsi hom nsie m'ahyɛdze, na me ntsɛmbu a sɛ nyimpa yɛ a, obenya nkwa wɔ mu no: Emi nye Ewuradze.
Mma hom mu biara nnkɔ obiara a ɔyɛ no bɔgyaa a ɔbɛn no nkyɛn nnkeyi n'adagyaw do: Emi nye Ewuradze.
W'egya n'adagyaw, mekyerɛ wo nã n'adagyaw no, mma nnyi do: Wo nã nye no; mma nnyi n'adagyaw do.
Mma nnyi w'egya ne yer n'adagyaw do: W'egya n'adagyaw ara nye no.
Mma nnyi w'akyerɛbaa a ɔyɛ w'egya ne babaa, anaa wo nã ne baaba, wɔwoo no fie o, wɔwoo no amanandze o, n'adagyaw do, mekyerɛ hɔn adagyaw no mma nnyi do.
Wo babanyin ne babaa n'adagyaw, anaa wo babaa ne babaa dze no, mekyerɛ hɔn adagyaw no mma nnyi do: Na hɔndze no ɔyɛ woankasa w'adagyaw.
W'egya ne yer ne babaa n'adagyaw, nyia w'egya awo no no, ɔyɛ w'akyerɛbaa, mma nnyi n'adagyaw do.
Mma nnyi w'egya n'akyerɛbaa n'adagyaw do: Ɔyɛ w'egya no bɔgyaa a ɔbɛn no.
Mma nnyi wo nã no nuabaa n'adagyaw do: Na ɔyɛ wo nã no bɔgyaa a ɔbɛn no.
Mma nnyi w'egya no nuabanyin n'adagyaw do, mma nnkɔ ne yer nkyɛn: Ɔyɛ wo nã nuabaa.
Mma nnyi w'asew n'adagyaw do: Ɔyɛ wo babanyin ne yer; mma nnyi n'adagyaw do.
Mma nnyi wo nua ne yer n'adagyaw do: Ɔyɛ wo nua n'adagyaw.
Mma nnyi ɔbaa bi nye ne babaa hɔn adagyaw do; mma mmfa ne babanyin ne babaa, anaa ne babaa ne baba nnyi hɔn adagyaw do; wɔyɛ bɔgya a ɔbɛn: Ɔyɛ ebusudze.
Mma mmfa ɔbaa bi nnka n'akyerɛbaa ho, dɛ ɔmbɛyɛ no korafo, nnyi n'adagyaw do, nnka kor no ho wɔ no nkwa ber mu.
Na mma nnkɔ ɔbaa bi nkyɛn nnkyeyi n'adagyaw do, aber tsentsen nyina a no ho nntsewee wɔ n'asabu mu no.
Mma nnye wo nyɛnko yer nnda mmfa wo ho nsu mma no, mmfa nngu woankasa nye ɔno ho fī.
Na mma mmfa w'asefo mu bi ma ɔnnkɛfa gya mu mma Molech, nkyii so mma nnhuru wo Nyankopɔn dzin ho: Emi nye Ewuradze.
Mma nnye banyin nnda dɛ mbrɛ enye ɔbaa da: Ɔyɛ ekyiwadze.
Na mma nnye abowa biara nnda mmfa nngu wo ho fi: Nkyii so ɔbaa biara nngyina abowa bi enyim nnda hɔ mma no: Ɔyɛ sakasakayɛ.
Mma hom nngu homho fī wɔ ndzɛmba iyinom mu biara mu: Na iyinom nyinara mu na amanaman a murutu hɔn efi hom enyim no dze egu hɔnho fī;
na asaase no do egu fi: Dɛm ntsi mohwɛ n'emumuyɛ no wɔ do, na asaase no fe no do atsefo no.
Dɛm ntsi hom nsie m'ahyɛdze na me ntsɛmbu, na mma hom nnyɛ ekyiwadze yi mu biara, okuromnyi o, ɔhɔho a ɔabɔsoɛ hom mu o:
(Na ekyiwadze yi nyinara na asaase no do nyimpa a wodzi hom enyim kan no ayɛ, na asaase no do egu fī);
Amma asaase no aammfe hom so eenngu, wɔ aber a hom egu do fī no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔfe ɔman a odzii hom enyim kan no.
Na obiara a ɔbɛyɛ ekyiwadze yi mu biara no, mekyerɛ akra no a wɔyɛ no, wobotwa hɔn efi hɔn man mu egu.
Dɛm na hom nhwɛ m'ahwɛdze do, na hom aannyɛ atɔrmudze nkɔnkɔw yi a wodzii hom enyim kan yɛe no mu biara, na hom eenngu homho fī wɔ mu: Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
19: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara, na se hɔn dɛ, Hom nyɛ krɔnkrɔn: Na emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn meyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Hom mu nyimpa biara nsuro ne nã, nye n'egya, na hom ndzi m'ahomgyeda do: Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Mma hom nndan nnkɔ abosom hɔ, nkyii so mma hom nnyɛ enyame a woegu mma homho: Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Na sɛ hom dze asomdwee-afɔr afɔrbɔdze rebrɛ Ewuradze a, hom mfa mbra ma ɔnsɔ enyi mma hom.
Wondzi no da no ara a hom dze ba no, nye n'adzekyee no: Na sɛ bi ka ma okodu da a otsīa ebiasa no a, wɔmfa gya nhyew no.
Na sɛ koraa wodzi no da a otsīa ebiasa no a, ɔyɛ ekyiwadze, ɔnnsɔ enyi:
Mbom obiara a odzi no, ɔbɔsoa no mbusu, osiandɛ oehura Ewuradze n'adzekrɔnkrɔn ho: Na ɔkra no wobotwa no efi ne man mu akyen.
Na sɛ hom twa hom asaase do ndɔbaa a, mma nntwa wo hanoa dze no korakora, nyii so mma nndzi wo ndɔbaa ne mpɛpɛw no.
Na mma nndzi wo wenyin ture mu mpɛpɛw, nkyii so mma nntase wo wenyin ture mu aba a atotɔ famu; gya no hɔ fa ma ohianyi, nye ɔhɔho: Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Mma hom nnwia adze, nkyii so mma hom nndzi nkɔnkɔnsa, na obi nntwa ne nyɛnko nkontompɔ.
Na mma hom nnkã me dzin ho ntam akɔhwi mu, amma eennhura wo Nyankopɔn ne dzin ho: Emi nye Ewuradze.
Mma nndzi wo nyɛnko emim, na mmfow no: Mma ɔpaanyi n'akatua nnko wo hɔ anago nyinara ma adze nnkyē.
Mma nndom otsitsifo, na mmfa fintsidua nnto ofurafo enyim, mbom suro wo Nyankopɔn: Emi nye Ewuradze.
Mma hom nnyɛ atsɛmbu mu dza ɔnntsen: Mma nnhwɛ ohianyi enyim, na nnhyehyɛ otumfo enyim: Mbom tsenenee mu na bu wo nyɛnko atsɛn.
Mma nnkyin sor nye ase dɛ afakɔafabanyi wɔ wo nkorɔfo mu: Nkyii so mma nnsoɛr nntsia wo nyɛnko no bɔgyaa: Emi nye Ewuradze.
Mma nntan wo nua wɔ w'akoma mu: Ɔkã na kã wo nyɛnko enyim, na mma nnsoa bɔn wɔ ɔno ntsi.
Mma nndzi wer, na mma nnya menasepɔw biara wɔ wo nkorɔfo mba ho, mbom dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ woho: Emi nye Ewuradze.
Hom ndzi m'ahyɛdze do. Mma mma wo fiembowa nndzi aforafora mmfofow hɔnho: Mma mmfa amba horow ebien mmfora mu nndua wo haban mu: Nkyii so mma atar a wɔdze atam horow ebien aforafora apam nnkã woho.

Na obiara a ɔnye ɔbaa bi da dze no ho nsu ma no, na sɛ ɔyɛ afonaba a wɔdze no ama okun bi awar, na pon na wonnyae mmpoon no, nkyii so wɔmmaa no fahodzi a; wɔntsēa hɔn; mma wonnku hɔn, osiandɛ ɔnndze noho.
Na ɔmfa n'asodzi ho afɔr mbra Ewuradze, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano, mekyerɛ odwanyin na ɔmfa nyɛ asodzi ho afɔr no.
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa asodzi ho afɔr odwanyin no mpata mma no wɔ Ewuradze enyim wɔ no bɔn a ɔayɛ no ntsi: Na wɔdze no bɔn a ɔayɛ no befir no.
Na sɛ hom du asaase no do, na wɔtsetsɛw ndua horow biara a wodzi a, ɔno hom mbu n'aba dɛ monomonomyɛdze: Mfe ebiasa na ɔnyɛ dɛ monomonomyɛdze mma hom; mma wonndzi.
Mbom afe a otsīa anan no n'aba nyinara nyɛ krɔnkrɔn, mfa mma Ewuradze ayɛyi.
Na afe a otsīa enum no hom ndzi n'aba bi, ama wɔaama hom no ndɔbaa: Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Mma hom nndzi adze biara nye no bɔgyaa no: Nkyii so mma hom nnkyer nkaber, na wɔnnyɛ akɔmfodze.
Mma hom mmpompon hom tsinhwi ano, nkyii so mma nnsɛɛ w'abɔdwesa ano.
Mma hom mmbobɔ hom honam ho akam biara mma ewufo, na hom nkyerɛkyerɛw homho nkyerɛkyerɛwee biara so: Emi nye Ewuradze.
Mma nnhura wo babaa ho nnyɛ no edwaman; bɛyɛ na asaase no adan ndwamanyɛ, na mbusu abɛyɛ asaase no do mã.
Hom ndzi m'ahomgyeda no, na hom ndzi m'ahotseweebea no nyi: Emi nye Ewuradze.
Mma hom nndan nnkɔ hɔn a wɔyɛ adzebisafo, nye esumamfo so hɔ: Mma wɔnnhwehwɛ hɔn ekyir kwan mmfa hɔn nngu homho fī: Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Soɛr wɔ tsigon no enyim, na dzi akɔdaa n'enyim nyi, na suro wo Nyankopɔn: Emi nye Ewuradze.
Na sɛ ɔhɔho bi bɔsoɛ wo wɔ hom asaase do a, mma hom nnyɛ no bɔn.
Ɔhɔho a ɔabɔsoɛ hom no wɔmma ɔnyɛ dɛ hom mu kuromnyi bi, na dɔ no dɛ woho; osiandɛ hom yɛɛ ahɔho wɔ Egypt asaase do: Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Mma hom nyɛ nkɔnkɔnsa wɔ atsɛmbu mu, adzesusu mu, adzeker mu, anaa adzenyɛ mu.
Nsɛn tsenn, abrambo tsenn, ephah tsenn, nye hin tsenn, na hom nnya: Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn a miyii hom fii Egypt asaase do no.
Na hom nhyɛ m'ahyɛdze nyinara, nye me ntsɛmbu nyinara nsew, na wondzi do: Emi nye Ewuradze.
20: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Afei so se Israelmba dɛ, Obiara a ofi Israelmba mu, anaa ahɔho a wɔabɔsoɛ Israel mu a ɔdze n'asefo mu bi ma Molech no; okum na wonku no: Asaase no do nkorɔfo no mfa abo nsiw no.
Mo so mebɛma m'enyi asa nyimpa no, na metwa no efi ne man mu akyen; osiandɛ ɔdze n'asefo mu bi ama Molech, dze egu m'ahotseweebea ho fī, na oehura me dzin krɔnkrɔn no ho.
Na sɛ ɔdze n'asefo mu bi rema Molech no, na asaase no do nkorɔfo na kwan biara so kata hɔn enyiwa fi nyimpa no do, na woennku no a:
Ɔno mebɛma m'enyi asa nyimpa no, na asa n'ebusuafo, na mubotwa no, ɔno nye hɔn a wodzi n'ekyir ndwamanyɛ mu, dɛ wɔnye Molech bɛyɛ ndwamandze no, efi hɔn man mu egu.
Na ɔkra a ɔdan kɔ hɔn a wɔyɛ adzebisafo, na esumamfo hɔ kezdi hɔn ekyir ndwamanyɛ mu no, mebɛma m'enyi asa ɔkra no, na metwa no efi ne man mu akyen.
Dɛm ntsi hom ntsew homho, na hom nyɛ krɔnkrɔn: Na emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Na hom ndzi m'ahyɛdze do, na wɔnyɛ: Emi nye Ewuradze a metsew hom ho no.
Na obiara a ɔdom n'egya anaa ne nã no, oku na wonku no: Ɔadom n'egya anaa ne nã; no bɔgyaa ngu n'etsifi.
Na ɔbanyin a ɔfa ɔbanyin bi so ne yer no, oku na wonku ɔyefafo nye okumfafo no.
Na ɔbanyin a ɔnye n'egya ne yer da no, oeyi n'egya n'adagyaw do, oku na wonku hɔn beenu nyina; hɔn bɔgyaa ngu hɔn etsifi.
Na sɛ ɔbanyin nye n'asew a ɔyɛ ne ba ne yer da a, okum na wonku hɔn beenu nyina: Wɔayɛ sakasaka; hɔn bɔgyaa nhu hɔn etsifi.
Na sɛ banyin nye banyin bi da, dɛ mbrɛ ɔnye ɔbaa da a, hɔn beenu nyina ayɛ akyiwadze: Okum na wonku hɔn; hɔn bɔgyaa ngu hɔn etsifi.
Na banyin fa yer nye ne nã nyinara a, ɔyɛ ebusudze: Wɔmfa gya nhyew hɔn, ɔno nye hɔn nyinara; ma ebusudze aammba hom mu.
Na sɛ ɔbanyin nye abowa bi da a, oku na wonku no: Na hom nku abowa no.
Na sɛ ɔbaa bi kɔ abowa biara hɔ, na ɔkɛda hɔ ma no a, ku ɔbaa no, nye abowa no: Oku na wonku hɔn; hɔn bɔgyaa ngu hɔn etsifi.

Na sɛ banyin fa n'akyerɛbaa, n'egya ne babaa, anaa ne nã ne babaa, na ohu n'adagyaw, na no so hu n'adagyaw a, ɔyɛ enyimguase adze; na wontwitwa hɔn ngu wɔ hɔn man mba enyim: Oeyi n'akyerɛbaa n'adagyaw do; ɔnsoa no mbusu.
Na sɛ ɔbanyin bi nye ɔbaa ɔbrafo bi da, na oyi d'adagyaw do a; na oebue no bura ano, na ɔno so oeyi no bɔgyaa bura do; na hɔn beenu nyina wontwitwa hɔn mfi hɔn man mu ngu.
Na mma nnyii wo nã n'akyerɛbaa anaa n'akyerɛbaa n'adagyaw do: Na oeyi no bɔgyaa a ɔbɛn n'adagyaw do: Wɔnsoa hɔn mbusu.
Na sɛ ɔbanyin bi nye ne wɔfa ne yer da a, oeyi no wɔfa n'adagyaw do: Wɔnsoa hɔn bɔn; wɔronnwo ɔba na woewu.
Na sɛ ɔbanyin bi fa no nua ne yer a, ɔyɛ adze fī: Oeyi no nua n'adagyaw do; worinnya ba.
Dɛm ntsi hom ndzi m'ahyɛdze nyinara, nye me ntsɛmbu nyinara do, na wɔnyɛ: Amma asaase no a medze hom rokɔ hɔ akɛtsena do no aammfe hom enngu.
Na mma hom mmfa ɔman a murubotu hɔn wɔ hom enyim no hɔn amambra do: Na wɔyɛɛ ndzɛmba iyinom nyinara, na dɛm ntsi hɔn ho yɛɛ me mfom.
Na mese hom dɛ, hom na wonnya hɔn asaase no ndzi, na medze mema hom dɛ hom enyadze, asaase a numfonsu nye wɔ pem wɔ do: Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn a mepaa hom efi amanaman mu no.

Dɛm ntsi hom mpaa mbowa a hɔn ho tsew nye dza hɔn ho nntsew mu, nye nnoma a hɔn ho nntsew nye dza hɔn ho tsew mu: Ma mma hom mmfa abowa, anaa anoma, anaa adze biara a ɔwea famu a mapaa no wɔ hom dɛ no ho nntsew no nngu hom akra ho fī.
Na hom nyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma me: Na emi Ewuradze meyɛ krɔnkrɔn, na mapaa hom efi amanaman mu dɛ hom bɛyɛ medze.
Ɔbanyin bi so anaa ɔbaa bi a ɔyɛ adzebisafo, anaa ɔyɛ esumamfo no, oku na wonku no: Wɔmfa abo nsiw hɔn: Hɔn bɔgyaa ngu hɔn etsifi.
21: Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, kasa kyerɛ Aaron ne mbabanyin asɔfo no, na se hɔn dɛ, mma hɔn mu biara nngu noho fī wɔ fun ho wɔ ne man mu;
gyedɛ no bɔgyaa a ɔbɛn no, ne nã, nye n'egya, nye ne babanyin, nye ne babaa, nye no nua;
nye n'akyerɛbaa a ɔyɛ ɔbaabun a ɔbɛn no a onnyae nnyaa okun no, ɔno ho na ɔmma noho nngu fī.
Mma onngu noho fī wɔ ne nyimpa tsitsir a ɔyɛ wɔ no nkorɔfo mu ntsi, dɛ obohura noho.
Mma wɔnnyɛ hɔn etsifi etsipaa, nkyii so mma wonnyi hɔn abɔdwesa ano, na wɔmmbobɔ hɔn honam mu akam so.
Wɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma hɔn Nyankopɔn, na mma wonnhura hɔn Nyankopɔn ne dzin ho: Na Ewuradze gya-afɔr no, hɔn Nyankopɔn edziban no, hɔn na wɔdze ba: Dɛm ntsi wɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Mma wɔmmfa ɔbaa a ɔyɛ ohuhunyi, anaa no ho ehura nnwar no; nkyii so mma wɔmmfa ɔbaa a no kun akõ no no nnwar no: Na ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn ma ne Nyankopɔn.
Dɛm ntsi tsew no ho; na ɔno na ɔdze wo Nyankopɔn edziban ba: Ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma wo: Na emi Ewuradze a metsew hom ho no, meyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Na ɔsɔfo biara ne babaa, sɛ ɔdze ehuhubra hura noho a, oehura n'egya no ho: Wɔmfa gya nhyew no.
Na nyia ɔyɛ no nuanom mu ɔsɔfopanyin a woehue ɔserango egu n'etsifi, na woetu no esi nkyɛn dɛ ɔnhyɛ ntar no, mma ɔmmbɔ ne tsinhwi mpɛsɛw, na onnsunsuan ne ntar mu;
nkyii so ɔnnkɔ fun biara ho, na onngu noho fī mma n'egya, anaa ne nã;
nkyii so ommfi ahotseweebea no do, na onnhura ne Nyankopɔn ahotseweebea ho; na ne Nyankopɔn ɔserango abɔtsir no wɔ n'etsifi: Emi nye Ewuradze.
Na ɔnodze ɔbaabun na ɔmfa no nwar no.
Okunafo, anaa obi a wɔakõ no, anaa ɔbaa a no ho ehura, ohuhunyi, iyinom dze mma ɔnnwar mu biara: Mbom nankasa ne man mu ɔbaabun na ɔmfa no nwar no.
Na mma onnhura n'asefo ho wɔ ne man mu: Na emi nye Ewuradze a metsew no ho.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Aaron dɛ, obiara a ofi w'asefo mu wɔ w'ebusuasantsen nyinara mu a odzi dzɛm no mma ɔmmbɛn mmbɛfa ne Nyankopɔn edziban mmba.
Na nyimpa biara a odzi dzɛm no, mma ɔmmbɛn: Ofurafo o, apakye o, ahwensin o, nyia no honam ho adze bi bor do o,
anansin o, abasin o,
efu o, akɔtsia o, onyitɔr o, ntwentwemfo o, konkondenyi o, nyia no ntɔhwɛbo abɔ o;
ɔsɔfo Aaron n'asefo mu nyimpa biara a odzi dzɛn no mma ɔnntwe mmbɛn mmbɛfa Ewuradze ogya-afɔr no mmba.
Ondzi ne Nyankopɔn edziban no, krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn no, na krɔnkrɔndze no nyinara bi.
Ntwamutam no mu nkotoo na mma ɔnnkɔ, na ɔmma ɔnntwe mmbɛn afɔrmbukyia no so, osiandɛ odzi dzɛm; amma oeennhura me mbeambea krɔnkrɔn no ho: Na emi nye Ewuradze a metsew hɔn ho no.
Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ Aaron, nye ne mbabanyin no, nye Israelmba nyinara.
22: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no, ma wɔmpaa hɔnho mfi Israelmba hɔn ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn no ho, wɔ dza wɔtsew ho ma me no ho, amma woeenhura me dzin krɔnkrɔn no ho: Emi nye Ewuradze.

Se hɔn dɛ, obiara a ofi hom asefo nyinara mu wɔ hom ebusuasantsen mu a, ɔtwe bɛn ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn a Israelmba tsew ho ma Ewuradze, na ɔwɔ n'ahoɔfi wɔ no ho no, okra no wobotwa no efi m'enyim akyen: Emi nye Ewuradze.

Ɔbanyin biara a ofi Aaron n'asefo mu a ɔyɛ kwatanyi, anaa ɔwɔ ahosen no; mma onndzi ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn no bi nnkodu dɛ no ho bɛtsew. Na obi a ɔkã adze biara a fun egu ho fī, anaa banyin a no ho nsu fi no mu;
anaa obiara a ɔkã adze biara a ɔwea, ɔdze bogu noho fī, anaa banyin bi a n'ahoɔfi biara a ɔwɔ no, ɔbɛma ɔafa no ho ahoɔfi no;
ɔkra a ɔkã dɛm biribi no, no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir, na mma onndzi ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn no bi, gyedɛ oguar no honam wɔ nsu mu ansaana.
Na sɛ iwi kɔtɔ a, no ho bɛtsew; na n'ekyir no ondzi ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn no bi, osiandɛ ɔyɛ n'edziban.
Dza noara ewu, anaa mbowa atsetsew no no, mma onndzi mmfa nngu noho fī: Emi nye Ewuradze.
Dɛm ntsi wɔnhwɛ m'ahwɛdze do, amma wɔaannsoa bɔn wɔ ho, na woeennwuwu wɔ mu; sɛ wohura ho a: Emi nye Ewuradze a metsew hɔn ho no.
Mma ɔhɔho biara nndzi adzekrɔnkrɔn no bi: Ɔsɔfo ne mamforanyi, anaa ɔpaanyi, nndzi adzekrɔnkrɔn no bi:
Mbom sɛ ɔsɔfo bi tɔ ɔkra bi a, ne sika enyadze no, ɔno na ondzi bi; na hɔn so a wɔwo hɔn wɔ ne fie no, hɔn na wondzi n'edziban no bi.
Na sɛ ɔsɔfo ne babaa bi wohyia no ma hɔho bi a, mma onndzi ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn ohim-afɔr no bi.
Mbom sɛ ɔsɔfo no ne babaa bi yɛ kunafo, anaa wɔkõ no, na onnyi ba, na ɔsan kɔ n'egya fie, dɛ ne mbafober mu a ondzi n'egya edziban no bi: Ɔhɔho biara dze na onndzi bi.
Na sɛ nyimpa bi dzi adzekrɔnkrɔn no bi ntɔgonmu a, ɔno ɔmfa n'abupɛn enum mu kor nto do, na ɔmfa adzekrɔnkrɔn no mma ɔsɔfo no.
Na mma wonnhura Israelmba hɔn ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn a wɔdze brɛ Ewuradze no ho;
amma wɔaannsoa asodzi ho mbusu biara, sɛ wodzi hɔn ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn no a: Na emi nye Ewuradze a metsew hɔn ho no.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,

Kasa kyerɛ Aaron, nye ne babanyin no, nye Israelmba nyinara, na se hɔn dɛ, obiara a ofi Israel ofi mu no, anaa ofi Israel mu ahɔho mu a ɔdze n'ayɛyɛdze ba, sɛ hɔn anohobadze mu biara, anaa hɔn ayamuyi-afɔr mu biara a wɔdze brɛ Ewuradze bɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr;
ma aasɔ enyi ama hom no, ɔnyɛ onyin a onnzdi dzɛm, anantwi mu o, nkɔsɔw mu o, mpɔnkye mu o.
Mbom adze biara a odzi dzɛm no, mma hom mmfa mmba: Na ɔrennyɛ enyisɔdze mma hom.
Na obiara a ɔdze asomdwee-afɔr bɛbrɛ Ewuradze dɛ ɔdze rehyɛ anohoba mã, anaa ɔdze reyɛ ayamuyi-afɔr no, ofi anantwikuw anaa nguankuw mu no, ɔmma ondzi mu na aasɔ enyi; dzɛm biara nnyi no ho.

Dza enyi efura, anaa oebubu, anaa oepira, anaa ɔahohon, anaa ntwem anaa ase egu no ho no, mma hom mmfa iyinom mmbrɛ Ewuradze, na mma mmfa hɔn mu bi mmbɔ ogya-afɔr so wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do mma Ewuradze.
Na ɔnantwisaa anaa eguambaa a no ho biribi bor do anaa ɔtɔ sin wɔ ne beebi no, ayamuyi-afɔr no fa no bɔ; na ɔyɛ anohobadze a ɔronnsɔ enyi.
Dza no ntɔhwɛbo ebubu, anaa adwerew, anaa abɔ, anaa etwa no, mma hom mmfa mmbrɛ Ewuradze; nkyii so mma hom nnyɛ dɛm wɔ hom asaase do.
Eso mma hom nngye iyinom mu biara wɔ ɔnanaben bi nsamu mmfa nnyɛ hom Nyankopɔn edziban mmba; osiandɛ hɔn sɛɛ wɔ hɔn ho, dzɛm bi wɔ hɔn ho: Wɔrennyɛ enyisɔdze mma hom.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
ɔnantwisaa, anaa ɔkɔsɔw, anaa apɔnkye, sɛ wɔwo no a, ɔno ɔnko ne nã n'ase nda esuon; na ofi da a otsīa awɔtwe no dze rokɔ no, ɔsɔ enyi dɛ ogya-afɔr ayɛyɛdze ma Ewuradze.
Na sɛ ɔnantwiber o, oguamber o, mma hom nnku ɔno nye ne ba nyina da kor.
Na sɛ hom bɔ aseda-afɔr ma Ewuradze a, hom mbɔ no ma ɔnsɔ enyi mma hom.
Da no ara na wondzi; mma hom nngya mu bi mma onnkodu anapa: Emi nye Ewuradze.
Dɛm ntsi hom nsie me mbra, na wondzi do: Emi nye Ewuradze.
Na mma hom nnhura me dzin krɔnkrɔn no ho: Mbom mo ho bɛtsew wɔ Israelmba mu: Emi nye Ewuradze a metsew hom ho no a
medze hom fi Egypt asaase do bae, dɛ mebɛyɛ hom Nyankopɔn no: Emi nye Ewuradze.
23: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, Ewuradze n'afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ a, hom mpaa dɛ ɔyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn no, mekyerɛ iyinom nye m'afahyɛ a mahyehyɛ.
Nda esia na wɔnyɛ edwuma: Na da a otsīa esuon no yɛ ahomgye mu ahomgyeda, nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn a; mma hom nnyɛ edwuma biara: Ɔyɛ ahomgyeda ma Ewuradze wɔ hom tsenabew nyina.
Iyinom nye Ewuradze n'afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ, mekyerɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn a hom mpaa wɔ ne mber a wɔahyɛ mu no.
Bosoom a odzi kan no mu, bosoom no ne da a otsīa duanan no n'ewimbir no ɔyɛ Ewuradze apaho.
Na bosoom no ara mu da a otsīa duenum no yɛ Ewuradze epitsi afahyɛ: Nda esuon na hom ndzi epitsi.
Da a odzi kan no mu nyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn: Mma hom nnyɛ dwumadzi edwuma biara.
Mbom hom mbɔ ogya-afɔr mma Ewuradze nda esuon: Da a otsīa esuon no mu ɔyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn; mma hom nnyɛ dwumadzi edwuma.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom du asaase a medze rema hom no do, na wotwa no do ndɔbaa a, ɔno hom mfa hom ndɔbaa mu nduadzewakan no ifī mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no:
Na ɔntow ifī no wɔ Ewuradze enyim, ma ɔnsɔ enyi mma hom: Ahomgyeda no n'adzekyee na ɔsɔfo no ntow.
Na da a hom tow ifī no, hom mfa eguambaanyin a onndzi dzɛm a oedzi afrenhyia mbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr mma Ewuradze.
Na no ho edziban-afɔr nyɛ isiam pa ephah ebupɛn du mu ebien a wɔdze ngo aforɔw, ogya-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma Ewuradze: Na no ho nom-afɔr nyɛ wenyin, hin ebupɛn anan mu kor.

Na mma hom nndzi boodoo, anaa eburow totõe, anaa nomanoma, ma onkodu da no ara, onkodu dɛ hom dze hom Nyankopɔn ayɛyɛdze no aba ana: Ɔyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ hom ebusuasantsen mu wɔ hom tsenabew nyinara mu.
Na hom mfitsi ahomgyeda no n'adzekyee nkan nda, mfa mfi da a hom dze ɔtow-afɔr ifī baa no do; ma ahomgyeda esuon nwie du:
Hom nkan adaduenum ma onkesi ahomgyeda a otsīa esuon no n'adzekyee; na hom mfa edziban-afɔr fofor mbrɛ Ewuradze.
Hom mfa ephah ebupɛn du mu ebien nyɛ ntɔwntɔwmu mfi hom tsenabew mbra: Ɔnyɛ isiam pa, wɔmfa mbɔrkaw ntõ, ma ɔnyɛ ndua dzewakan mma Ewuradze.

Na hom mfa nguambaa esuon a wonndzi dzɛm a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia, nye ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, nye ndwanyin ebien nka boodoo no ho mbra: Wɔnyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr mma Ewuradze, mfa nka hɔn edziban-afɔr, nye hɔn ɔnom-afɔr ho, mekyerɛ ogya-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma Ewuradze.
Na hom mfa apɔnkyenyin kor mbɔ ho afɔr, nye nguambaanyin ebien a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia mbɔ asomdwee-afɔr.
Na ɔsɔfo no ntow hɔn nye nduadzewakan bodoo no nyɛ ɔtow-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim, nka nguambaa ebien no ho: Ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma Ewuradze mfa mma ɔsɔfo no.
Na hom mbɔ dawur da no ara; ɔnyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn mma hom: Mma hom nnyɛ dwumadzi edwuma: Ɔyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ hom tsenabew nyinara mu wɔ hom ebusuasantsen mu.
Na sɛ hom twa hom asaase do ndɔbaa a, mma nntwa hanoa dze no korakora, nkyii so mma nndzi wo ndɔbaa no mpɛpɛw: Gya no hɔ fa ma ohianyi, nye ɔhɔho: Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, bosoom a otsīa esuon no mu, bosoom no ne da a odzi kan no mu, nyɛ ahomgye pa mma hom; wɔnhɛn totorobɛnto nyɛ nkaa, nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn.
Mma hom nnyɛ dwumadzi edwuma: Na hom mbɔ ogya-afɔr, mma Ewuradze.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Naaso bosoom a otsīa esuon yi ara ne da a otsīa du no nye mpata da: Ɔnyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn mma hom, na hom mbrɛ hom akra adze; na hom mbɔ ogya-afɔr mma Ewuradze.
Na mma hom nnyɛ edwuma biara wɔ no ara mu: Na ɔyɛ mpata da, ma wɔaapata ama hom wɔ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na ɔkra biara a ɔnnkɛbrɛ noho adze da no ara mu no, wobotwa no efi no man mu ekyen.
Na ɔkra biara a ɔyɛ edwuma biara wɔ da no ara mu no, wɔbɛsɛɛ no efi ne man mu.
Mma hom nnyɛ edwuma biara: Ɔyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ hom ebusuasantsen mu wɔ hom tsenabew nyinara.
Ɔnyɛ ahomgye pa mu ahomgyeda mma hom, na hom mbrɛ hom akra adze: Bosoom no ne da a otsīa akron no ewimbir, ofi ewimbir kodu ewimbir, na hom ndzi hom ahomgyeda no.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Bosoom a otsīa esuon no yi ara ne da a otsīa duenum no ɔyɛ ntamadan afahyɛ nda esuon ma Ewuradze.
Da a odzi kan no ɔyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn: Mma hom nyɛ dwumadzi edwuma.
Nda esuon na hom mbɔ ogya-afɔr mma Ewuradze: Da a otsia awɔtwe no nyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn mma hom; na hom mbɔ ogya afɔr mma Ewuradze: Ɔyɛ nguabɔ ewiei; mma hom nnyɛ dwumadzi edwuma.
Iyinom nye Ewuradze n'afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ a hom mpaa dɛ ɔyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn no, ma wɔmfa ogya-afɔr mbrɛ Ewuradze, ɔhyew-afɔr, nye edziban-afɔr, okum-afɔr, nye ɔnom-afɔr, kor wɔ nankasa ne da mu:
Ɔsor Ewuradze n'ahomgyeda no, na ɔsor hom ayɛyɛdze, na ɔsor hom anohoba, na ɔsor hom ayamuyi-afɔr nyinara a hom dze ma Ewuradze no.

Naaso bosoom a otsīa esuon no ne da a otsīa duenum no mu, sɛ hom roboaboa asaase no do nduadzewa ano a, hom nhyɛ Ewuradze fa no nda esuon: Da a odzi kan no nyɛ ahomgye pa, na da a otsīa awɔtwe no nyɛ ahomgye pa.
Na da a odzi kan no hom mfa ndua fɛɛfɛw do nduadzewa, nye menankɔnson, nye ndua wusuww n'abaw, nye esukɔn do ndua; na hom enyi ngye wɔ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn enyim nda esuon.
Na hom nhyɛ no fa mma Ewuradze nda esuon wɔ afrenhyia mu: Ɔyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ hom ebusuasantsen mu: Bosoom a otsīa esuon no mu na hom nhyɛ.
Hom ntsenatsena asese mu nda esuon; hɔn a wɔyɛ amamba wɔ Israel nyinara ntsenatsena asese mu:
Ama hom ebusuasantsen eehu dɛ emi na memaa Israelmba tsenatsenaa asese mu wɔ aber a miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do no: Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Na Moses kãa Ewuradze n'afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ no kyerɛɛ Israelmba.
24: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Hyɛ Israelmba ma wɔmbrɛ wo olive ngo krɔnkrɔn a woesiw a wɔdze sɔ gya, ma wɔmfa nyɛ ma kandzea nsi do daa.
Dase ntwamutam no ekyir, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, na Aaron nsiesie mfi ewimbir nkodu anapa wɔ Ewuradze enyim daa: Ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ ebusuasantsen mu.
Onsiesie nkandzea no wɔ kandzeadua a no ho tsew no do wɔ Ewuradze enyim daa.
Na fa isiam pa, na fa bi tõ tatar duebien; ephah ebupɛn du mu ebien nyɛ tatar kor.
Na hyehyɛ no akyerɛpɛn ebien, esia nyɛ kyerɛpɛn kor, wɔ ɔpon a no ho tsew do wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na fa krɔbɔw gyirengyirenn to kyerɛpɛn kor do, ma ɔnyɛ nkaadze wɔ boodoo no do, mekyerɛ ogya-afɔr mma Ewuradze.
Ahomgyeda biara ɔnhyehyɛ no yie wɔ Ewuradze enyim daa: Ɔyɛ Israelmba afamu daa ahyɛmu.
Na ɔnyɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin dze; na wondzi no wɔ mbrɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn: Na ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn mu adzekrɔnkrɔn a ofi Ewuradze ogya-afɔr do ma no wɔ daa ahyɛdze do.
Na Israelmba ɔbaa bi ne babanyin a n'egya yɛ Egyptnyi, fiir edzi wɔ Israelmba no mu: Na Israelnyi ɔbaa no ne babanyin no ɔnye Israelnyi ɔbanyin bi dzii aperper wɔ nseraban no mu;
na Israelnyi ɔbaa no ne babanyin no kaa Dzin no ho ebususɛm, na ɔdomee: Na wɔdze no brɛɛ Moses. Na ne nã ne dzin dze Shelomith, Dibri ne babaa a ofi Dan ebusuakuw mu.
Na wɔtoo no apo, ama woeenya Ewuradze n'anomu asɛm ma wɔaakã akyerɛ hɔn ana.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
fa nyia wɔadom no fir edzi kɔ nseraban no ekyir; na ma hɔn a wɔtsee no nyinara mfa hɔn nsa ngu n'etsifi, na ma mboanofo no nyinara nsiw no abo.
Na kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Obiara a ɔdom ne Nyankopɔn no ɔbɔsoa no bɔn.
Na nyia ɔkã Ewuradze ne dzin ho ebususɛm no, okum na wonku no; osiw na mboanofo no nyinara nsiw no abo: Ɔhɔho o, okuromnyi o, sɛ ɔkã Ewuradze ne dzin ho ebususɛm a, wonku no.
Na nyia ɔbɔ nyimpa biara adze biara ma ɔtɔr no, okum na wonku no;
na nyia ɔbɔ abowa adze ma owu no ɔnhyɛ ananmu: Nkwa nhyɛ nkwa ananmu.
Na sɛ nyimpa ma ne nyɛnko dzi dzɛm a; dɛ mbrɛ ɔno ɔayɛ no, dɛmara na wɔmfa nyɛ no;
Obu nhyɛ obu ananmu, enyiwa nhyɛ enyiwa ananmu, ese nhyɛ ese ananmu: Dɛ mbrɛ ɔamma nyimpa bi edzi dzɛm no, dɛmara na wɔnyɛ mma no.
Na nyia oku abowa no ɔnhyɛ ananmu: Na nyia oku nyimpa no wonku no.
Mbra kor ara nda hɔ mma hom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ma ɔhɔho no, ɔnyɛ dɛmara mma okuromnyi no: Na emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ Isrealmba, na wɔdze nyia ɔdomee no fiir edzi kɔr nseraban no ekyir, na wosiiw no abo. Na Israelmba yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
25: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses wɔ kokwaa Sinai do dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, sɛ hom du asaase a medze rema hom no do a, ɔno asaase no ndzi ahomgyeda mma Ewuradze.
Mfe esia na dua wo haban mu adze, na mfe esia na pempan wo wenyin ture mu ndua ho, na boaboa no mu nduadzewa ano;
Mbom afe a otsīa esuon no nyɛ ahomgye pa mu ahomgyeda mfa mma asaase no, nyɛ ahomgyeda mma Ewuradze: Mma nndua wo haban mu adze, na mmpempan wo wenyin ture mu ndua ho so.
Wo ndɔbaa mu dza nankasa efifir no mma nntwa, no wo wenyindua a ennsiesie ho no mma nntsetsew no do esikyireamba: Ɔnyɛ ahomgye pa afe mfa mma asaase no.
Na asaase no n'ahomgyeda no nyɛ edziban mma hom; mfa mma ɔwo, nye w'akowaa nye w'afonabaa, nye wo paanyi nye wo hɔho a ɔabɔsoɛ wo;
nye wo fiembowa, nye mbowa a wɔwɔ w'asaase no do, na no do ndɔbaa no nyinara nyɛ hɔn edziban.
Na kan ahomgyeda-mfe esuon ma woho, mfe esuon esuon ehorow esuon; na ɔnyɛ ahomgyeda-mfe esuon mu nda mma wo, mekyerɛ mfe eduanan akron.
Na nkyii bosoom a otsīa esuon no ne da a otsīa du no ma totorobɛnto ndzekɛse nkɔ aman do; mpata da no mu na hom mma totorobɛnto na nkɔ aman do ntwa mu wɔ hom asaase nyinara do.
Na hom ntsew afe a otsīa eduonum no ho, na wɔmpaa fahodzi wɔ asaase no do mma no do atsefo nyinara: Ɔnyɛ ahosɛpɛw-afe mma hom; na hom nsan, nyimpa biara nkɔ n'ebusua mu.
Ahosɛpɛw-afe na afe a otsīa eduonum no nyɛ mma hom: Mma hom nndua, nkyii so wonntwitwa dza nankasa efifir wɔ mu no, na wɔnntsetsew no mu wenyinndua a woennsiesie ho no do esikyireamba so.
Na ɔyɛ ahosɛpɛw-afe; ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma hom: Hom mfi haban no do ndzi do ndzɛmba a ɔba no.
Ahosɛpɛw-afe yi mu no hom nsan, nyimpa biara nkɔ n'enyadze ho.
Na sɛ etɔn biribi ma wo nyɛnko, anaa etɔ wɔ wo nyɛnko nsamu a, mma hom mu kor nndzi kor no emim:
Dɛ mbrɛ ahosɛpɛw-afe no ekyir mfe dodow tse no na tɔ wɔ wo nyɛnko hɔ, dɛ mbrɛ ndɔbaa mfe dodow tse no na ɔntɔn mma wo.
Dɛ mbrɛ mfe no dɔɔ sõ pa no na to no bo mu, na dɛ mbrɛ mfe no suar pa no na yi no bo do, wɔ ndɔbaa dodow a ɔtɔn ma wo no ho.
Na mma hom mu kor nndzi kor emim; mbom suro wo Nyankopɔn: Na emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Dɛm ntsi hom nyɛ m'ahyɛdze, na hom ndzi me ntsɛmbu do, na wɔnyɛ; na hom ntsena asaase no do dwudwoodwo.
Na asaase no bɛma no nsowee, na hom edzi amee, na wɔatsena do dwudwoodwo.
Na sɛ hom se dɛ, ebɛnadze na afe a otsīa esuon no yebedzi? Hwɛ, yerunndua, na yɛrommboaboa hɛn ndɔbaa ano a:
Ɔo mebɛhyɛ me nhyira wɔ hom do wɔ afe a otsīa awɔtwe no mu, na wondzi nduadzewa no bi, akoradze dadaw no;
nkodu afe a otsīa akron no, hom ndzi akoradze dadaw ara nkodu dɛ no nduadzewa bɛba.
Na asaase no mma wɔnntɔn no korakora; osiandɛ asaase no yɛ medze: Na hom yɛ ahɔho nye amamforafo wɔ me nkyɛn.
Na hom enyadze asaase no nyinara do na hom mma asaase no no pon ho kwan.
Sɛ ohia wo nua, na ɔtɔn n'enyadze mu bi a, ɔno no busuanyi a ɔbɛn no no mbra, na ɔmbɔpon dza no nua atɔn no.
Na sɛ nyimpa bi nnyi abi a ɔpon, na ne nsamu ba adze na onya dza ɔsõ pon a;
ɔno wɔmma ombu no ntɔnee mu mfe dodow ano, na ɔnhyɛ dza ɔbɔr do no ananmu mma nyimpa no a ɔtɔnee maa no no; na ɔnsan nkɔ n'enyadze ho.
Mbom sɛ orunntum nngye bio mma noho a, ɔno dza wɔatɔn no nko nyia ɔatɔ no nsamu nkodu ahosɛpɛw-afe no: Na ahosɛpɛw-afe no mu na omfi hɔ, na ɔnsan nkɔ n'enyadze ho.
Na sɛ nyimpa bi tɔn ofi a wɔatsena mu wɔ kurow a afadum wɔ ho mu a, ɔno ɔmpon no wɔ no ntɔnee ekyir afrenhyia no mu; na afrenhyia mu na ɔwɔ mponee ho kwan.
Na sɛ wɔammpon no wɔ afrenhyia mu ntamu a, ɔno ofi a ɔwɔ kurow a afadum wɔ ho mu no, ɔnko hɔ daa mma nyia ɔtɔe no korakora, wɔ n'ebusuasantsen mu: Ommfi hɔ wɔ ahosɛpɛw-afe no mu.
Na efiefi a ɔwowɔ nkuroba a onnyi fadum a ehyia ho mu dze, wombu nka ɔman no mu haban ho: Wɔropon a wɔmpon, na ahosɛpɛw-afe no mu omfi hɔ.
Naaso Levi nkurow no, hɔn enyadze nkurow mu efi no dze, Levifo no mpon no aber biara.
Na sɛ Levifo mu kor pon a, ɔno ofi no a wɔtɔnee, nye n'enyadze kurow no mfi hɔ wɔ ahosɛpɛw-afe no mu: Na Levifo nkurow mu efiefi no nye hɔn enyadze wɔ Israelmba mu.
Na nkurow no no kurotsia haban dze, mma wɔnntɔn, na ɔyɛ hɔn daa enyadze.
Na sɛ ohia wo nua, na ɔpa abaw wɔ wo nkyɛn a; ɔno suo no mu; na ɔntsena wo nkyɛn dɛ ɔhɔho nye ɔmamforanyi.
Mma nngye nsiho anaa ndɔree wɔ no hɔ; mbom suro wo Nyankopɔn: Ma wo nua nye wo tsena.
Mma mmfa wo sika mma no nsiho do, na mma no w'edzidzidze wɔ no ndɔree ntsi.
Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn a, miyii hom fii Egypt asaase do, dɛ medze Canaan asaase rema hom, na maayɛ hom Nyankopɔn.
Na sɛ ohia wo nua wɔ wo nkyɛn, na ɔtɔn noho ma wo a; mma mma ɔnnsom wo dɛ onyimfo:
Na ɔnyɛ wo nkyɛn dɛ mbrɛ ɔpaanyi nye ɔmamforanyi tse; ɔnsom wɔ wo nkyɛn ara ma onkodu ahosɛpɛw-afe no mu:
Na nkyii omfi wo nkyɛn nkɔ, ɔno nye ne mba a wɔwɔ wo nkyɛn, na ɔnsan nkɔ nankasa n'ebusua mu, na n'egyanom enyadze ho na ɔnsan nkɔ.
Na wɔyɛ mo nkowaa a miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do: Mma wɔnntɔn hɔn dɛ enyimfo.
Mma mmfa enyadze nnhyɛ no do; mbom suro wo Nyankopɔn.
Na wo nkowaa nye wo mfonabaa a ibenya no; amanaman a woehyia hom ho no, hɔn mu na hom ntotɔ nkowaa nye mfonabaa.
Nkyii so ahɔho a wɔabɔsoɛ hom mu hɔn mba no, hɔn hɔ na hom ntɔ, nye hɔn ebusuafo a wɔwɔ hom nkyɛn a wɔawo hɔn wɔ hom asaase do no hɔ: Na wɔnyɛ hom enyadze.

Na hom nyɛ hɔn egyapadze mma hom mba wɔ hom ekyir, ma woeesuo mu ayɛ enyadze; na hɔn mu na hom mfa hom enyimfo daa: Hom nuanom Israelmba dze mma hom nnhyɛ hɔn do, obiara mmfa enyadze mu nnhyɛ no nua do.
Na sɛ ɔhɔho anaa ɔmamforanyi bi a ɔwɔ hom nkyɛn nya adze, na ohia wo nua a ɔnye no wɔ hɔ no, na ɔtɔn noho ma ɔhɔho no anaa ɔmamforanyi no a ɔwɔ wo nkyɛn no, anaa ɔhɔho no n'ebusua mu asenyi a:
No ntɔnee ekyir no wɔmpon no; na no nuanom mu baako mpon no:
Anaa no wɔfa, anaa no wɔfa ne babanyin mpon no, anaa n'ebusua mu bɔgya biara a ɔbɛn mpon no; anaa sɛ oenya adze a, ɔmpon noho.
Na ɔnye nyia ɔtɔ no no mbubu mfitsi afe a ɔtɔɔn noho maa no no do nkodu ahosɛpɛw-afe no do: Na no ntɔnee bo no nyɛ dɛ mbrɛ mfe no no dodow tse.
Sɛ mfe no da ho dɔɔ sõ a, ne tsisika mu mponee bo no a ɔbɛdan ama no so ndɔɔ sõ dɛmara.
Na sɛ aka mfe kumaabi ma edu ahosɛpɛw-afe no do a, ɔno ɔnye no mbubu; dɛ mbrɛ ne mfe no tse no na ɔmfa no mponee sika no ndan mma.
Ɔnye no ntsena dɛ akowaa a wɔbɔ no paa afrenhyia afrenhyia: Mma ɔmmfa enyadze mu nnhyɛ no do wɔ w'enyim.
Na sɛ woenndua iyinom do ammpon no a, ɔno omfir edzi nkɔ wɔ ahosɛpɛw-afe no mu, ɔno nye ne mba nka no ho.
26: Mma hom nnyɛ abosom, nkyii so wɔnnsen ohonyi, anaa dum bi mma homho, nkyii so mma hom mmfa ɔbo a woedzi no akye nnsi hom asaase mu, mmbɔ hom mu adze mma no: Na emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Hom ndzi m'ahomgyeda no, na wondzi m'ahotseweebea no nyi. Emi nye Ewuradze.
Sɛ hom nantsew m'ahyɛdze mu, na wosie me mbra, na wɔyɛ a;
ɔno mebɛma hom nyankom atotɔ wɔ n'aber mu, na asaase no ama no ndɔbaa, na haban mu ndua asow n'aba.
Na hom ewuporow bokodu wenyin-aba-tsetsew mu, na wenyin-aba-tsetsew no bokodu odua ber mu: Na hom bedzi hom edziban amee, na wɔatsena hom asaase do dwudwoodwo.
Na mebɛma asomdwee aba asaase no do, na hom nda, na obiara rinnyi hom hu: Na mebɛma mbowa bɔn tun do etwa wɔ asaase no do, nkyii so nkrantsee remmfa hom asaase do.
Na hom betsiw hom atamfo, na wɔbɔtotɔr hom enyim wɔ nkrantsee ano.
Na hom mu beenu betsiw ɔha, na hom mu ɔha betsiw mpem du: Na hom atamfo bɔtotɔr hom enyim wɔ nkrantsee ano.
Na mebɛfɛr hom, na mama hom awowo, na hom adɔr, na mama menye hom ahyɛmu no etsim.
Na hom bedzi akoradze dadaw a wɔdze esie ma akyɛr no, na hom beyi dadaw no aba wɔ fofor no ntsi.
Na mibesi me ntamadan wɔ hom mu: Na me kra rinnkyir hom.
Na mebɛnantsew hom mu, na mayɛ hom Nyankopɔn, na hom ayɛ me man.
Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn a miyii hom fii Egypt asaase do dɛ mma hom nnyɛ hɔn nkowaa; na mebubu hom kɔndua, na memaa hom sii nkyiremben nantsewee no.
Mbom sɛ hom enntsie me, na wɔannyɛ me mbransɛm nyinara a;
na sɛ hom pow m'ahyɛdze, na hom kra kyir me ntsɛmbu, na hom annyɛ me mbransɛm nyinara, na mbom hom sɛɛ m'ahyɛmu a;
mo so mebɛyɛ hom iyi; mebɛma nketsenketse akyer hom, mekyerɛ sasawaw nye etsiridii a ɔbɛsɛɛ enyiwa, na ɔbɛma ɔkra atsetsew: Na hom bodua hom nduaba kwa, na hom atamfo bedzi.
Na mebɛma m'enyi asa hom, na hom edzi hom atamfo enyim nkogu: Hɔn a wokyir hom bɛhyɛ hom do; na hom boguan aber a obi nntsiw hom.
Na sɛ hom enntsie me wɔ iyinom mpo ntsi a, ɔno mebɛtsēa hom mpɛn esuon bio wɔ hom bɔn ntsi.
Na mubobuba hom tum ahokyerɛ no; na mayɛ hom sor dɛ dadze, nye hom asaase dɛ boran:
Na hom ahoɔdzen bɛsa kwa: Na asaase remma ndɔbaa, nkyii so asaase no do ndua ronnsow n'aba.
Na sɛ hom nantsew tsia me, na woenntsie me a; medze ɔhaw mpɛn esuon so mebɛma hom do dɛ mbrɛ hom bɔn tse no.
Na mobɔsoma haban mu mbowa wɔ hom mu a wɔbɛgye hom nsamu mba, na wɔasɛɛ hom fiembowa, na wɔama hom dodow esuar; na hom akwan ayɛ akwamfo.
Na sɛ hom amma iyinom annsakyer hom amma me, na mbom wɔnantsew tsia me a:
Ɔno mo so mebɛnantsew etsia hom; na emi mara mabɔ hom mpɛn esuon wɔ hom bɔn ntsi.
Na medze awerdzi nkrantsee a obedzi ahyɛmu no ho wer mebɛma hom do; na hom aboaboa hom ano wɔ hom nkurow mu: Na mobɔsoma ɔyardɔm wɔ hom mu; na woeyi hom ahyɛ ɔtamfo no nsa.
Sɛ mububu hom edziban dua a, mbaa du bɔtõ hɔn boodoo wɔ fononoo kor mu, na woeyi hom boodoo ama hom bio wɔ nsɛn do: Na hom bedzi, na wɔremmee.
Na sɛ iyi nyinara mu so hom enntsie me, na wɔnantsew tsia me a;
ɔno mebɛnantsew metsia hom ebufuw mu; na mo so matsēa hom mpɛn esuon wɔ hom bɔn ntsi.
Na hom bedzi hom mbabanyin nam, na hom mbabaa nam so hom edzi.
Na mebɛsɛɛ hom sorɔnsorɔmbea, na metwitwa hom iwi-honyi no egu, na matotow hom efun egu hom abosom efun no do; na me kra bekyir hom.
Na mebɛyɛ hom nkurow amamfo, na medze hom ahotseweebea akɔ ɔsɛɛ mu, na merenngye hom nduhuam ne nka.
Na medze asaase no bɔkɔ ɔsɛɛ mu: Na hom atamfo a wɔtse do no ayɛ hɔn nwanwa.
Na hom dze mobɔbɔ hom apetse amamaman mu, na matwe nkrantsee no edzi ekyir: Na hom asaase ayɛ ɔsɛɛ, na hom nkurow ayɛ amamfo.
Ɔno na asaase no benya n'ahomgyeda ho enyigye, mber tsentsen a ɔda hɔ kɔnn no nyinara, na hom wɔ hom atamfo asaase do no; mekyerɛ ɔno na asaase no bɔhom, na woenya n'ahomgyenda ho enyigye.
Mber tsentsen a ɔda hɔ kɔnn no nyinara obenya ahomgye; mekyerɛ ahomgye a woennya no wɔ hom ahomgyenda no mu, aber a hom tsenaa do no.

Na hom mu hɔn a wɔaka no dze, medze abawpa bɛhɛn hɔn akoma mu wɔ hɔn atamfo asaase do; na ahataw a atsew ne ndze etsiw hɔn; na woeguan dɛ obi ruguan nkrantsee ano; na wɔahwehwe ase aber a obi rinntsiw hɔn.
Na wobefintsiw hɔnho nkor-kor, dɛ nkrantsee enyim, aber a obi rinntsiw hɔn: Na hom rinnya tum nngyina hom atamfo enyim.
Na hom bɛsɛɛ wɔ amanaman mu, na hom atamfo asaase edzi hom.
Na hom mu hɔn a wɔaka no bɛtsetsew wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ mu wɔ hom atamfo asaase do; na eso hɔn egyanom emumuyɛ mu na wɔnye hɔn bɛtsetsew.
Na wɔbɛkã hɔn emumuyɛ, nye hɔn egyanom emumuyɛ, wɔ hɔn mfom a wɔfom mu no mu, na eso dɛ wɔanantsew etsia me ntsi,
mo so menantsewee tsiaa hɔn, na medze hɔn baa hɔn atamfo asaase do: Sɛ nkyii hɔn akoma monomonomyɛ no brɛ adze, na nkyii wɔpen hɔn emumuyɛ ho ntsēa do a;
ɔno na mebɛkaa menye Jacob ahyɛmu no; na menye Isaac ahyɛmu no so, na menye Abraham ahyɛmu no so mebɛkaa; na mebɛkaa asaase no.
Na asaase no so wɔbɛgye no hɔ, na woenya n'ahomgyeda mu enyigye, aber a woekwetsir hɔn ada hɔ kɔnn no; na wɔbɛpen hɔn emumuyɛ ho ntsēa do: Osiandɛ wɔpoow me ntsɛmbu, na hɔn kra kyiir m'ahyɛdze.

Na iyi nyinara so mpo ekyir, sɛ wɔwɔ hɔn atamfo asaase do a morommpow hɔn, nkyii so mirinnkyir hɔn, dɛ meresɛɛ hɔn korakora, na matsetsew menye hɔn ntamu ahyɛmu no mu; na emi nye Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn:
Mbom hɔn ntsi mebɛkaa hɔn nananom ahyɛmu no, hɔn a miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do wɔ amanaman enyim, dɛ mebɛyɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn no: Emi nye Ewuradze.
Iyinom nye ahyɛdze nye ntsɛmbu nye mbra a Ewuradze dze nam Moses ne nsa do hyɛe too ɔno nye Israelmba ntamu wɔ kokwaa Sinai do.
27: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ nyimpa bi hyɛ anohoba mã a, nkorɔfo no nyɛ Ewuradze dze dɛ mbrɛ w'abotwa tse.
Na w'abotwa wɔ ɔbanyin a oedzi mfe eduonu do dze kodu nyia oedzi mfe eduosia do no ho nyɛ, mekyerɛ w'abotwa, nyɛ dwɛɛtɛɛ shekel eduonum, dɛ mbrɛ krɔnkrɔn-bea shekel tse.
Na sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbaa a, ɔno w'abotwa nyɛ shekel eduasa.
Na sɛ ofi nyia oedzi mfe enum do dze kodu nyia oedzi mfe eduonu do da, ɔno w'abotwa wɔ ɔbanyin ho nyɛ shekel eduonu, na ɔbaa ho so shekel du.
Na sɛ ofi nyia oedzi bosoom do dze kodu nyia oedzi mfe enum do a, ɔno w'abotwa wɔ ɔbanyin ho nyɛ dwɛɛtɛɛ shekel enum, na ɔbaa ho so w'abotwa nyɛ dwɛɛtɛɛ shekel ebiasa.
Na sɛ ofi nyia oedzi mfe eduosia nye ekyir do a; sɛ ɔbanyin a, ɔno w'abotwa nyɛ shekel duenum, na ɔbaa ho so shekel du.
Mbom sɛ ɔyɛ ohianyi dodow kyɛn w'abotwa no a, ɔno wɔmfa no mbegyina ɔsɔfo no enyim, na ɔsɔfo no ntwa no bo; dɛ mbrɛ nyia ɔbɔɔ anohoba no ne nsa bɔsõ do no ara na ɔsɔfo no ntwa no bo.
Na sɛ ɔyɛ abowa a adasa dze bi yɛ ayɛyɛdze brɛ Ewuradze a, dza nyimpa biara dze mu bi ma Ewuradze no nyinara nyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Mma ɔnndan no, nkyii so ɔnnsakyer no, ɔmmfa papa nnsesa bɔn, anaa ɔmmfa bɔn nnsesa papa: Na sɛ koraa ɔdze abowa bɛsesa abowa a, ɔno emu ebien nyina ɔno nye dza wɔdze sesaa no no nyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Na sɛ ɔyɛ abowa biara a no ho nntsew a wɔmfa bi nnyɛ ayɛyɛdze mmbrɛ Ewuradze a, ɔno ɔmfa abowa no mbegyina ɔsɔfo no enyim:
Na ɔsɔfo no ntwa no bo, sɛ ɔye o, omuo o: Dɛ mbrɛ woara ɔsɔfo no botwa no bo no, dɛmara na ɔnyɛ.
Mbom sɛ pon ara na ɔbɔpon no a, ɔno ɔmfa no mu ebupɛn enum mu kor nto wo bo a itwae no do.
Na sɛ nyimpa bi tsew ne fi ho dɛ ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma Ewuradze a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no ntwa no bo, sɛ ɔye o, omuo o: Dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no botwa no bo no, dɛmara na ongyina.
Na sɛ nyia ɔtsew ho no bɔpon ne fi a, ɔno ɔmfa wo bo a itwae no ne sika no mu ebupɛn enum mu kor nto do, na ɔnyɛ nedze.
Na sɛ nyimpa bi tsew n'enyadze mu haban mu bi ho ma Ewuradze a, ɔno wabotwa nyɛ dɛ mbrɛ no nduae tse: Atoko a woedua no homer kor twa no bo dwɛɛtɛɛ shekel eduonum.
Sɛ ofi ahosɛpɛw-afe no do tsew ne haban ho a, dɛ mbrɛ w'abotwa tse no na ongyina.
Mbom sɛ ahosɛpɛw-afe no ekyir na ɔtsew ne haban ho a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no mbubu sika no ano mma no dɛ mbrɛ mfe a aka ma akɔsõ ahosɛpɛw-afe no tse no, na wɔntsew wo bo a itwae no do.
Na sɛ pon ara na nyia ɔtsew haban no ho no bɔpon a, ɔno ɔmfa wo bo a itwae no ne sika no mu ebupɛn enum mu kor nto do, na wonsi no pi mma no.
Na sɛ ɔammpon haban no, anaa sɛ ɔatɔn haban no ama nyimpa bi so a, mma wɔmmpon bio;
mbom haban no, sɛ ofir ezdi ahosɛpɛw-afe no mu kɔ a, ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma Ewuradze, dɛ haban a woehyira do ama; ɔnyɛ ɔsɔfo no n'enyadze.
Na sɛ ɔtsew haban no bi a ɔatɔ a ɔnnyɛ n'enyadze haban bi ho ma Ewuradze a;
ɔso ɔsɔfo no mbubu w'abotwa a ɔdze kodu ahosɛpɛw-afe no do no, no bo a ɔsom no mma no: Na ɔmma wo bo a itwae no da no ara, dɛ adzekrɔnkrɔn mma Ewuradze.
Ahosɛpɛw-afe no mu haban no nsan nkɔ nyia wɔtɔɔ no no hɔ, mekyerɛ nyia ɔyɛ n'enyadze asaase no no hɔ.
Na w'abotwitwa nyinara nyɛ dɛ mbrɛ krɔnkrɔn-bea shekel no tse: Gerah eduonu yɛ shekel kor.
Mbowa mu abakan a wɔayɛ no abakan ama Ewuradze no, noara nkotoo na nyimpa bi nntsew ho; sɛ ɔnantwinyin o, ɔkɔsɔw o, Ewuradze dze a.
Na sɛ ɔyɛ abowa a no ho nntsew bi a, ɔno ɔmma n'apondze dɛ mbrɛ w'abotwa tse no, na ɔmfa no mu ebupɛn enum mu kor nto do: Anaa sɛ wɔammpon no no a, ɔno wɔntɔn no dɛ mbrɛ w'abotwa tse no.

Naaso ehyiradze biara a nyimpa bi behyira do ama Ewuradze wɔ adze a ɔwɔ nyinara mu no sɛ nyimpa o, abowa o, n'enyadze mu haban o, mma wɔnntɔn anaa wɔmmpon: Ehyiradze biara yɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn ma Ewuradze.
Ehyiradze biara a woehyira do wɔ nyimpa mu no, mma wɔmmpon; oku na wonku no.
Na asaase no do ebupɛn du du nyinara, sɛ ofi asaase no do o, nduadzewa mu o, dua n'aba mu o, ɔyɛ Ewuradze dze; ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn ma Ewuradze.
Na sɛ nyimpa bi bɔpon n'ebupɛn dudu no mu bi a, ɔmfa no mu ebupɛn enum mu kor nto do.
Na anantwi anaa nguan mu ebupɛn du du nyinara, adze a ɔfa poma ase nyinara mu dza otsīa du du no nyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma Ewuradze.
Mma ɔnnhwehwɛ mu dɛ ɔyɛ papa anaa bɔn, nkyii so mma ɔnnsesa bi: Na sɛ koraa ɔbɛsesa bi a, ɔno emu ebien nyina, ɔno nye dza wɔdze sesa no no nyɛ krɔnkrɔn; mma wɔmmpon no.
Iyinom nye mbransɛm a Ewuradze dze hyɛɛ Moses wɔ bepɔw Sinai do ma ɔdze maa Israelmba no.

1: Susuampa dɛ doddwara dze nsa akã dɛ wobesina nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɔwɔ ndzɛmba a ahyɛ mã wɔ hɛn mu no ho,
dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a ahysɛse no wɔdze hɔn enyiwa hunii na wɔsoom asɛm no yii maa hɛn ntsi;
mohwɛ a oye ma mo so dɛ mekefitsi ase mahwehwɛ ne nyina pɛpɛɛpɛ yi, mekyerɛw no esiado brɛ wo, Theophilos pa,
ama eehu nsɛm a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ wo no no nokwar.
Judea ɔhen Herod n'aber do no,ɔsɔfo bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no Zacharias a ofir Abijah no kuw mu; na ne yer nye Aaron ne mbabaa no mo bi a wɔfrɛ no Elisabeth.
Na hɔn beenu nyinaa yɛ atseneneefo wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim, na wodzii Ewuradze ne mbrasɛm ɔnye n'ahyɛdze no nyina do, dɛ ɔho nnyi asɛm.
Na wonnyi ba, osiandɛ Elisabeth yɛ ɔbɔnyin, na hɔn beenu nyina so mfe pii etwa hɔn tsir do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ esia no kuw do na ɔreyɛ n'asɔfo dwuma wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim no,
dɛ mbrɛ asɔfo dwuma no ne nhyehyɛɛ tse no, edu no do dɛ ɔkɔ Ewuradze asɔrdan no mo kɛhyew huam.
Na ber a wɔrehyew huam no, nna ɔman no nyimpadodow nyina gyina abowano rosɔr.
Na Ewuradze bɔfoe yii noho kyerɛɛ no dɛ ogyina huam-afɔrmbukyia no nyimfa.
Na Zacharias hun no no, n'akoma tui, na hu kãa no.
Na bɔfo no see no dɛ, Mma nnsuro, Zacharias, na wɔatse wo nkotoserɛ, na wo yer Elisabeth bɔwo babanyin ama wo, na ato no dzin John.
Na ibenya dɛw nye enyigye, na dodowara bedzi n'awoo ho dɛw.
Na ɔbɛyɛ kɛse wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na ɔnnkɔnom wenyin anaaso nsã biara, na Sunsum Kronkron bɛhyɛ no mã fi ne nã ne yamu mpo.
Na ɔbɛdan Isrealmba dodowara aba Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn hɔ.
Na ɔnam Elijah no sunsum ɔnye no tum mu bedzi n'enyim akɛdan egyanom hɔn akoma aba'hɔn mba ho, nye asoɔdzenfo aba tseneneefo hɔn nyimdzee mu, na oesiesie ɔman a wɔaboaboa hɔnho ama Ewuradze.
Na Zacharias see bɔfo no dɛ, Mubodua dɛn mehu yi? Osiandɛ meyɛ akɔdaa na me yer so mfe pii etwa ne tsir do.
Na bɔfo no buae see no dɛ, Emi nye Gabriel a migyina Nyankopɔn enyim, na wɔasoma me dɛ membɛkasa nkyerɛ wo, na menkã wo nsɛmpa yi.
Na hwɛ, ebɔtɔ mmum, na irunntum nnkasa dze akɛpem da a yinom bɛyɛ hɔ, osiandɛ anngye me nsɛm a ɔbɛba mu wɔ n'aber do no endzi.
Na nkorɔfo no rotweɔn Zacharias no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn nwanwa dɛ ɔakyer dɛm wɔ asɔrdan no mu.
Na opuei no, oenntum annkasa annkyerɛ hɔn; na wohun dɛ oekohu enyido-adzehu bi wɔ asɔrdan mu hɔ; na ɔnodze, nna ɔroto hɔn nsa na ɔda ho tɔ mmum.
Na ɔbaa dɛ no som nda wiee du no, osii mu kɔr nankasa ne fie.
Na nda no ekyir no ne yer Elisabeth nyinsenii na osumaa noho abosoom enum see dɛ,
Dza Ewuradze ayɛ me, wɔ nda a ɔabɔhwɛ ma dɛ obeyi m'ahorohoraa wɔ nyimpa mu no, nye yi.
Na bosoom a otsìa esia no mu no, Nyankopɔn somaa bɔfo Gabriel wɔ Galilee kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Nazareth,
wɔ ɔbaabun bi a wɔdze no ama ɔbanyin bi a wɔfrɛ no Joseph a ofi David ebusua mu no awar no hɔ; na ɔbaabun no ne dzin dze Mary.
Na ɔbaa no hɔ bɛsee no dɛ, ɔwo a wɔadom wo kɛse, frɛ nkwa! Ewuradze nye wo tse.
Na n'akoma tui wɔ kasa no ho, na ɔdwendween ne tsir mu dɛ ebɛn nkyia na iyi bɛyɛ.
Na bɔfo no see no dɛ, Mary, mma nnsuro, na enya Nyankopɔn enyim adom.
Na hwɛ, ibenyinsen wɔ wo yamu, na awo babanyin na ato no dzin JESUS.
Ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ kɛse, na wɔbɛfrɛ no nyia ɔwɔ sorsor no ne Ba: na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn dze n'egya David ahengua no bɛma no:
na obedzi Jacob fi do hen daapem, na n'ahendzi nnkɔbɔ adze da.
Na Mary see bɔfo no dɛ, Minnyim banyin yi, yinom bɛyɛ dɛn aba?
Na bɔfo no buae see no dɛ, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn bɛba wo do, na nyia ɔwɔ sorsor no n'ahoɔdzen bɛkata wo do: dɛm ntsi so adze krɔnkrɔn a wɔbɔwo no no, wɔbɛfrɛ no Nyankopɔn Ba.
Na hwɛ, wo busuanyi Elisabeth so enyinsen babayin wɔ ne mbrewaber mu, na nyia wɔfrɛ no ɔbɔyin no, n'abosoom esia nye yi.
Na Nyankopɔn afamu dze, asɛm biara nnyi hɔ a tum nnyi mu.
Na Mary see dɛ, Hwɛ, Ewuradze afonabaa nye me: ɔnyɛ hɔ mma me dɛ mbrɛ w'asɛm se. Na bɔfo no fii ne nkyɛn kɔree.
Na nda no mu ara Mary soɛree kɔr Judah kurow bi mu ntsɛntsɛm wɔ nkokodo nkurow mu;
na ɔkɛhɛɛn Zacharias fie kekyiaa Elisabeth.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Elisabeth tsee Mary ne nkyia no, ɔba no huruuw ne yamu; na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn hyɛɛ Elisabeth mã,
na ɔdze ndze kɛse kasae see dɛ, Nhyira akã wo wɔ mbaa mu, na nhyira akã wo yamu aba.
Na yi fir hen ba mo hɔ, dɛ m'Ewuradze ne nã bɛba me nkyɛn?
Na hwɛ, ntsɛmara a wo nkyia twaa m'asomu no, na abofra no dze dɛw huruhuruwii wɔ mo mu.
Na nhyira akã nyia ɔagye edzi: na dza Ewuradze ama wɔabɛkã akyerɛ no no bɛba mu
Na Mary see dɛ: Me kraa tonton Ewuradze,
Na mo sunsum edzi dɛw wɔ m'Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn mu.
Osiandɛ ɔabɔhwɛ n'afonabaa wɔ ne mbrɛadze asetsena mu: Na hwɛ, ofitsi ndɛ ebususuasantsen nyina bɛfrɛ me osiarfo.
Osiandɛ Otumfo ayɛ adze kɛse ama me; Na dzin ho yɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Na n'ehumbɔbɔr wɔ hɔn a wosuro no do fir ebusuasantsen do kɛpem ebusuasantsen.
ɔdze ne basa akyerɛ ahoɔdzen, ɔapansam nkontompɔfo wɔ hɔn akoma adwen mu.
Oetu etumfo efi hɔn nhengua do, Na ɔama hɔn a wɔbrɛ adze no do.
ɔdze ndzepa amee hɔn a ɔkɔm dze hɔn, na oegya ahonyafo kwan wɔ yafumpan mu.
Oesuo n'abofra Isreal mu akaa n'ehumbɔbɔr,
(Dɛ mbrɛ ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɛn egyanom) Ama Abraham nyɛ n'asefo daa.
Na Mary nyɛ no tsenaa bɛyɛ abosoom ebiasa, na ɔsanee kɔr noara ne fie.
Na Elisabeth n'aber a ɔdze bɔwo durii, na ɔwoo babanyin.
Na no sɔnmufo, ɔnye n'ebusuafo tsee ehumbɔbɔr kɛse a Ewuradze dze ehu no, na wɔnye no dzii dɛw.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ne ndaawɔtwe sõe no, wɔbaa dɛ worubotwa abofra no twatsia, na wɔpɛɛ dɛ wɔfrɛ no Zacharias, dɛ mbrɛ n'egya ne dzin tse.
Na ne nã buae see dɛ, oho, na wɔbɛfrɛ no Jhon.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, Obiara nnyi w'ebusua mu a ne dzin dze dɛm.
Na wɔtoo nsa kyerɛɛ n'egya dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ dɛ wɔfrɛ no.
Na obisaa kyerɛw-pon kyerɛɛw dɛ, na dzin nye Jhon. Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn nyina nwanwa.
Na n'ano nye ne tɛkyerɛma buee amonmu hɔ ara, na ɔkasae yii Nyankopɔn ayɛw.
Na hu kãa hɔn a wɔtsetse hɔn ho nyina, na nsɛm yi nyina wɔkekãe wɔ Judæa nkokodo nkurow nyina mu.
Na hɔn a wɔtsee nyina dze too hɔn akoma mu dɛ, Abofra bɛn na oyi bɛyɛ? Na Ewuradze ne nsa nye no nam.
Na n'egya Zacharias dze, Sunsum krɔnkrɔn bɛhyɛɛ no mã na ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm dɛ,
Nhyira nkã Ewuradze, Isreal Nyankopɔn; Osiandɛ ɔabɔhwɛ no nkorɔfo na ɔapon hɔn,
Na ɔama nkwagye-ambɛn do ama hɛn Wɔ n'abofra David fie,
(Dɛ mbrɛ ɔdze no nkɔnhyɛfo krɔnkrɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ fi tsetse no hɔn ano kãe no)
Nkwangye efi hɛn atamfo nye hɔn a wokyir hɛn nyina nsamu;
Dɛ ɔbɛyɛ ehumbɔbɔr ama hɛn egyanom, Na ɔakaa n'ahyɛmu krɔnkrɔn no;
Ntam a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɛn egya Abraham dɛ
ɔbɛma woeyi hɛn efi hɛn atamfo nsamu, Na yɛasom no dɛ hu nnyi mu,
Wɔ ahotsewee nye tsenenee mu wɔ n'enyim hɛn nkwa nda nyina.
Na ɔwo abofra yi, wɔbɛfrɛ wo nyia ɔwɔ sorsor no nkɔnhyɛnyi: Osiandɛ ibedzi Ewuradze n'enyim kan ekesiesie n'akwan mu,
Dze nkwagye ho nyimdzee akɛ ma no nkorɔfo Wɔ hɔn bɔnfafir mu a
Ofir hɛn Nyankopɔn n'ayamuhyehye mbɔbɔrhu no mu, Osian ntsi ma adzekyee a ofir sor abɔhwɛ hɛn,
Dɛ ɔbɛhyerɛn ama hɔn a wɔtsetse sum mu nye owu no sunsuma ase; Na wɔatsentsen hɛn anan akɔ asomdwee kwan no do.
Na abofra no nyinii, na ɔhyɛɛ dzen wɔ sunsum mu; na ɔwɔ sar no do kodur da a ɔdze noho kɛkyerɛɛ Isreal.
2: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu, ɔmom bi fir Cæsar Augustus hɔ baa dɛ wɔnkan wiadze nyina nkyerɛw.
Yi nye ɔkankyerɛw asɔpɔn no a wɔyɛɛ no ber a Ɔuirinius dzi Syria ambrado no.
Na nyimpa nyina kɔr hɔnara hɔn nkurow mu dɛ wɔnkyerɛw hɔn dzin.
Na Joseph so fiir Galilee,wɔ Nazareth kurow no mu, kɔr Judæa, David kurow a wɔfrɛ no Bethlehem no mu, osiandɛ ofi David fie nye n'ebusua mu ntsi,
ma wɔaakan ɔno nye n'esiyer Mary a no mfua enyin no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔwɔ hɔ no,ne nda a ɔse dɛ ɔdze wo durii.
Na ɔwoo n'abakan barimba, na ɔdze adasoe kyekeer no ho, na ɔdze no too mbowa edzidzidzka mu, osiandɛ ɔkwan nnyi ahɔhodan no mo ma hɔn.
Na nguanhwɛfo bi wɔ ɔman no ara mu, da haban mu roweɔn hɔn nguankuw anago.
Na Ewuradze bɔfoe begyinaa hɔn nkyɛn, na Ewuradze n'enyimnyam hyerɛnee bɔɔ hɔn ho aprɔw, na hu kãa hɔn kɛse.
Na ɔbɔfo no see hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro; na hwɛ, mebrɛ ho, nsɛmpa a ɔyɛ dɛw kɛse a ɔbɛyɛ ɔman nyina dze,
na ndɛ wɔawo Agyenkwa ama hom wɔ David kurow mu, ɔno nye Christ Ewuradze.
Na iyi nye hom asɛnkyerɛdze: Hom bohu abofra bi dɛ ɔkyekyer adasoe mu da mbowa edzidzidaka mu.
Na awerɛfir mu ara ɔsor dɔm pii bɛkaa ɔbɔfo no ho yii Nyankopɔn ayɛw see dɛ,
Enyimnyam wɔ sorsor ma Nyankopɔn, na asomdwee nkã nyimpa a wɔ sɔ n'enyi wɔ asaase do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ abɔfo no fir hɔn nkyɛn kɔr sor no, ngaunhwɛfo no sesee hɔnho dɛ, hom mma yɛnkɔ Bethlehem nkɔhwɛ dza ɔaba a Ewuradze eyi akyerɛ hɛn yi.
Na wɔbaa ntsɛntsɛm, na wobohun Mary nye Joseph nye abofra no dɛ ɔda mbowa edzidzidaka mu.
Na wobohun no no, wɔkãa asɛm a wɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn abofra no ho no ma ɔtahyee.
Na hɔn a wɔtsee nyina, dza nguanhwɛfo no kãa kyerɛɛ hɔn no yɛɛ hɔn nwanwa.
Na Mary dze, ɔdze nsɛm yinyina siei, na ɔdween ho wɔ n'akoma mu.
Na nguanhwɛfo no sanee kɔree kɛhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam na woyii no ayɛw wɔ dza wɔtsee na wokohunii dɛ mbrɛ wɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn nyina tse.
Na ndaawɔtwe durii a worubotwa no twatsia no, wɔtoo no dzin JESUS, dɛ mbrɛ bɔfo no dze too no ana worinyinsen no yafun mu no.
Na hɔn ahoguar da no durii dɛ mbrɛ Moses mbra se no, wɔdze no kɔr Jerusalem dɛ wɔdze no rekɛkyɛ Ewuradze,
dɛ mbrɛ wɔa kyerɛw no Ewuradze ne mbra mu dɛ, Banyinba biara a obobuei awotoa ano no, wɔbɛfrɛ no krɔnkrɔn ama Ewuradze,
na wɔakɔbɔ afɔr dɛ mbrɛ wɔkãa no Ewuradze mbra no mu no, Ntamram ebien, anaadɛ mbuburmba ebien.
Na hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi wɔ Jerusalem a ne dzin dze Simeon; na nyimpa yi ɔtsen na ɔyɛ nyamesuronyi, ɔrotweɔn Isreal awerɛkyekyer, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn wɔ no do.
Na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn yii kyerɛɛ no dɛ onnkohu wu gyedɛ oehu Ewuradze ne Christ no ana.
Na ɔnam Sunsum no do baa asɔrdan no mu: na abofra Jesus n'awofo dze no baa dɛ wɔrebɛyɛ mbrɛ mbra no n'atɔrmuadze tse ama no no,
ɔnoara nna ɔfaa no too n'abaw mu, na ohyiraa Nyankopɔn see dɛ,
Ewuradze, nkyii gya w'akowaa kwan Asomdwee mu, dɛ mbrɛ w'asɛm se;
Osiandɛ m'enyiwa ehu wo nkwagye a,
Esiesie wɔ amanaman nyina enyim;
ɔkandzea a ɔbɛma amanamanfo do atsew, na wo man Isreal enyimnyam.
Na ɔyɛɛ n'egya nye ne nã nwanwa wɔ dza wɔkãa no wɔ no ho no ho;
na Simeon hyiraa hɔn, na ɔsee ne nã Mary dɛ, hwɛ, oyi na wɔdze no esi hɔ ama Isreal mu dodowara hɔn asehwe nye hɔn soɛr, ɔnye asɛnkyerɛdze a wɔbɛkasa etsia no;
ɛhɛɛ, nkrantsee bohwira woara so wo kra mu, ma akoma dodowara mu adwen aada edzi.
Na Anna, ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi bi a ɔyɛ Phanuel babaa a ofir Asher ebusuakuw mu wɔ hɔ: oenyin, na ofir ne nkatasiaaber mu nye no kun tsenaa mfe esuon,
na ɔyɛɛ okunafo bɛyɛ mfe eduowɔtwe anan, na ɔmmpa asɔrdan mu da, na ɔdze mbuada nye mpaabɔ som Nyankopɔn adzekyee nye adzesaa.
Na dɔn no ara mu, no so bae beyii Nyankopɔn ayɛw, na ɔkãa no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ hɔn a wɔrotweɔn Jerusalem no pon nyina.
Na wowiee dza Ewuradze mbra se nyina yɛ no, wɔsaan Galilee kɔr hɔnankasa hɔn kuro Nazareth mu.
Na abofra no nyinii, ma ɔhyɛɛ dzɛn, na nyansa hyɛɛ no mã, na Nyankoopɔn adom wɔ no do.
Na n'awofo no kɔr Jerusalem afe nyina wɔ apaho afahyɛ no mu.
Na odzii mfe duebien no, wɔkɔr Jerusalem, dɛ mbrɛ afahyɛ n'atɔrmuadze tse,
na wodzii nda no wiei, na wɔresan akɔ no, abofra Jesus no kaa ekyir wɔ Jerusalem, na n'egya nye ne nã dze, wonnyim;
na wosusuu dɛ ɔafora okuw no mu ntsi, wotwaa dakor kwansin ma wɔkɔhwehwɛɛ no wɔ hɔn ebusuafo nye hɔn amanyifo mu;
na woennhu no no, wɔsanee kɔr Jerusalem kɔhwehwɛɛ no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ne ndaansa durii no, wobohun no wɔ asɔr no mu dɛ ɔtse aKyerɛkyerɛfo no finimfin, oritsie hɔn na oribisabisa hɔn nsɛm;
na hɔn a wotsiee no nyina, ne ntseasee ɔnye ne mbuae yɛɛ hɔn nwanwa.
Na wohun no no, hɔn ho boow hɔn, na ne nã see no dɛ, ɔba, na ɔyɛ dɛn na enye hɛn edzi no dɛm yi? Hwɛ, w'agya nye emi dze yaw hwehwɛɛ wo.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom hwehwɛɛ me ayɛ dɛn? Ana hom nnyim dɛ otwar dɛ metsena m'Egya fie?
Na hɔndze, wɔanntse asɛm a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn ase.
Na ɔnye hɔn sii mu kɔr Nazareth, na ɔbrɛɛ noho adze maa hɔn; na ne nã dze, ɔdze nsɛm yi nyina siei wɔ n'akoma mu.
Na Jesus kɔr kan wɔ nyansa nye tsipɛn mu, na Nyankopɔn nye nyimpa hɔ enyimpa mu.
3: Na Tiberius Cæsar dzi adze, n'afe duenum no mu, na Pontius Pilate dzi Judæa ambrado, na Herod dzi Galilee ɔmansinhen, na no nua Philip dzi ɔmansinhen wɔ Ituræa nye Trachonitis asaase do, na Lysanias dzi Abilene ɔmansinhen,
na Annas nye Caiaphas dzi asɔfompanyin no, Nyankopɔn asɛm baa Zacharias ne ba John hɔ wɔ sar no do.
Na ɔbaa asaase a abɔ Jordan ho aprɔw nyina, na ɔpaa mu kãa nnuho enuma a ɔdze kɔ bɔnfafir mu no ho asɛm,
dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah ne nsɛm nwoma mu dɛ, Obi ne ndze retsēa mu wɔ sar no do dɛ, hom nsiesie Ewuradze no kwan, hom mma n'atsempɔn ntsentsen.
Wɔbɛhyɛ mbɔnsa nyina mã, na mbepɔw nye nkoko nyina wɔbɛbrɛ no adze; nkɔntɔnkye nyina bɛtsen, na akwan a ɔyɛ kekakeka ayɛ tromtrom.
Na honam nyina bohu Nyankopɔn no nkwagye.
Na ɔsee nyimpadodow a wofir edzi bae ma oeenuma hɔn no dɛ, nhurutsia mba! Woana tuee hom aso dɛ hom nguan mfi ebufuw a ɔreba no ho?
Na afei hom nsow aba a ɔfata nnuho na mma hom nnhyɛ ase nnkã wɔ hom mu dɛ, Hɛndze, hɛn egya nye Abraham: na mese hom dɛ Nyankopɔn botum dɛ onyan mba fi abo yi mu ma Abraham.
Na afei so dze, wɔdze abɔndua no ato ndua no ndwow ho dada, dɛ dua biara a ɔnnsow aba pa no wobotwa no ato gya mu.
Na nyimpadodow no bisaa no dɛ, na yɛnyɛ dɛn?
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, nyia ɔwɔ sorntar ebien, wɔmma ɔmma nyimpa a onni bi no bi; na nyia ɔwɔ edziban so, wɔmma ɔnyɛ dɛmara.
Na atowgyefo bi baa dɛ onnuma hɔn, na wɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yɛnyɛ dɛn?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nngye mma ɔnnkyɛn dza wɔahyɛ ato hɔ.
Na nsordaafo bi so bisaa no dɛ, hɛn so yɛnyɛ dɛn? Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnyɛ obiara heihei, eso mma hom nntoã obiara ano gyan, na hom mma hom akatua nsɔ hom enyi.
Na ɔman no hɔn enyiwa daa kwan, na hɔn nyina susui wɔ hɔn akoma mu wɔ John ho dɛ gyama ɔno nye Christ no,
John buae see hɔn nyina dɛ, Emidze munuma hom nsu mu; na nyia no ho yɛ dzen kyɛn me no reba a no nsokota ho ahoma no mennsɛ dɛ mesan: ɔno na obonuma hom wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu, na gya mu;
ɔno na no nhuwdo-apaawa kitsa ne nsamu, dɛ ɔrebɛpra ne famu hɔ kofee, na ɔaboaboa n'ewifua ano ekogu san do, na ntsɛw no ɔdze gya a onndum ahyew.
Na ndzɛmba pii ka ho wɔ n'afotu mu a ɔdze kãa nsɛmpa kyerɛɛ nkorɔfo no;
na ɔmansinhen Herod otwuuw n'enyim wɔ no nua Philip yer Herodias ntsi, ɔnye emumuyɛ a Herod ayɛ nyina ntsi no,
ɔdze yi kaa ne nyina ho dɛ ɔdze John too efiadze.
Na ɔbaa dɛ orunuma nkorɔfo nyina no, na Jesus so wonumaa no, na ɔrosɔr no, sor buei,
na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn sianee wɔ homan subae mu, tse dɛ ebubur baa no do, na ndze bi fi sor bae dɛ, ɔwo nye mo Dɔb a esɔ m'enyi.
Na Jesus anakasa ɔhyɛɛ ase no nna oedzi bɛyɛ mfe eduasa; na, dɛ mbrɛ wobuu no no, ɔyɛ Joseph ne be, Heli ne ba,
Matthat ne ba, Levi ne ba, Melchi ne ba, Jannai ne ba, Joseph ne ba,
Mattahias ne ba, Amos ne ba, Nahum ne ba, Esli ne ba, Naggai ne ba,
Maath ne ba, Mattahias ne ba, Semein ne ba, Josech ne ba, Joda ne ba,
Joanan ne ba, Rhesa ne ba, Zerubbabel ne ba, Shealtiel ne ba, Neri ne ba,
Melchi ne ba, Addi ne ba, Cosam ne ba, Elmadam ne ba, Er ne ba,
Jesus ne ba, Eliezer ne ba, Jorim ne ba, Matthat ne ba, Levi ne ba,
Symeon ne ba, Judas ne ba, Joseph ne ba, Jonam ne ba, Eliakim ne ba,
Melea ne ba, Menna ne ba, Mattatha ne ba, Nathan ne ba, David ne ba,
Jesse ne ba, Obed ne ba, Boaz ne ba, Salmon ne ba, Nahshon ne ba,
Amminabab ne ba, Arni ne ba, Hezron ne ba, Perez ne ba, Judah ne ba, 34, Jacob ne ba, Issac ne ba, Abraham ne ba, Terah ne ba, Nahor ne ba,
Serug ne ba, Reu ne ba, Peleg ne ba, Eber ne ba, Shelah ne ba,

4: Na Jesus, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn hyɛɛ no mã no, ɔsanee fii Jordan ho, na Sunsum no dze no duaduaa sar no do adaduanan,
na abɔnsamsɔɔ no hwɛe. Na nda no mu no oenndzi hwee; na ɔbɔɔ adzɛ no, ɔkɔm dzee no.
Na abɔnsam see no dɛ, Sɛ eyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba a, hyɛ ɔbo yi ma ɔndan paano.
Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, Wɔakyerɛw dɛ, nnyɛ paano nko bi na nyimpa nam do bɛtsena ase.
Na ɔdze no kɔr beebi a ɔkrɔn kɛkyerɛɛ no wiadze ahenman nyina prɛko.
Na abɔnsam see no dɛ, ɔwo na medze tum yi nyina nye no mu enyimnyam mamawo: na wɔdze ahyɛ me nsa, na obi a mepɛ no, medze mema no.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ ebɔsɔr wɔ m'enyim a, ne nyina bɛyɛ wodze
Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Sɔr Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, na no nko na som no.
Na ɔdze no kɔr Jerusalem, dze no kesii asɔrfi ne bea-sorɔnsorɔm no do, na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ eyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba a, tow woho fi ha kyen famu:
na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, ɔbɛhyɛ n'abɔfoe mbra wɔ wo ho, dɛ wɔmbɔhwɛ wo,
na, Wɔbɔsoa wo hɔn nsamu, Mma aammfa wo nan ammpem bo da.
Na Jesus buae see no dɛ Wɔakã dɛ, Mma nnsɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ.
Na abɔnsam wiee no nsɔhwɛ nyina no, ogyaa no hɔ kɔree ana.
Na Jesus nam Sunsum n'ahoɔdzen mu sanee baa Galilee, na ne nka tahyee nkurow a woetwa ehyia nyina mu.
Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn nhyiamudan no mu, na hɔn nyina hyɛɛ no enyimnyam.
Na ɔbaa Nazareth, mbrɛ wɔnyɛɛn no no, na mbrɛ ɔtɔ dɛ ɔyɛ no, ɔkɔr nhyiamudan no mu ahongyeda no, na ɔsoɛree gyinaa dɛ ɔrebɛkenkan.
Na wɔdze nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah no nwoma no maa no, na ɔtserɛɛw nwoma no mu, na ohun bea a wɔakyerɛw no hɔ dɛ,
Ewuradze no Sunsum wɔ mo do, osiandɛ ɔasera me dɛ membɛkã nsɛmpa menkyerɛ ehiafo; ɔasoma me dɛ membɛpaa ɔgye mma ndɔmmum, nye adzehu mma enyifurafo, na membɛgye hɔn a woepirapira hɔn mingyaa hɔn,
Na membɛkã Ewuradze n'enyisɔ afrenhyia.
Na ɔbobɔɔw nwoma no, na ɔdze maa ɔsomfo no, na ɔtsenaa ase; na hɔn a wɔwɔ nhyiamudan mu hɔ nyina, hɔn enyiwa tsiim no do.
Na ɔhyɛɛ ase kãa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Ndɛ na kyerɛw yi aba mu wɔ hom asowa mu.
Na hɔn nyina dzii no dase, na adom nsɛm a ofir n'anomu yɛɛ hɔn nwanwa; na wɔsee dɛ, Ana nnyɛ Joseph ba no nye yi?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ampaara, hom dze bɛ yi bobu me: Ɔsafo, sa woho yarba: biribiara a yɛatse dɛ wɔyɛe wɔ Capernaum no, yɛ no wankasa wo kurow mu ha so.
Na ɔsee dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ, nkɔnhyɛnyi biara wɔmmpɛ no noara no kurow mu.
Na mekã kyerɛ hom nokwar dɛ, Elijah n'aber do a wɔtoow ɔsor mu mfensa a bosoom esia no na ɔkɔm kɛsenara sii asaase nyina do no, nna ekunafo pii wɔ Isreal;
na wɔannsoma Elijah wɔ hɔn mu biara hɔ, gyedɛ Sidon kurow Zarephath mu, wɔ ɔbaa kunafo bi hɔ.
Na nkɔnhyɛnyi Elisha n'ber do no, nna akwatafo pii wɔ Isreal; na wɔamma hɔn mu biara ho annsan, gyedɛ Syrianyi Naaman.
Na hɔn a wɔwɔ nhyiamuda no mu nyina, wɔtsee dɛm yi no, ebufuw hyɛɛ hɔn mã;
na wɔsoɛree sunsuun no fii kurow no mu, dze no kɔr koko a hɔn kurow no si do no no kɔn do, dɛ wɔrokɔwɔ no akɔmfo.
Na ɔno dze ɔnam hɔn finimfin kɔree.
Na ɔbaa Galilee kurow bi Capernaum mu. Na ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ hɔn ahomgyeda;
na ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛɛ hɔn ahobow, osiandɛ n'asɛm dze tum nam.
Na nyimpa bi wɔ nhyiamudan no mu a ɔwɔ abɔnsam fì no sunsum, na ɔdze ndze kɛse kaa mu dɛ
Aa! Ebɛnadze na yɛnye wo wɔ yɛ, Jesus Nazarethnyi? Ana ebae abɛsɛɛ hɛn? minyim wo nyimpaban, Nyankopɔn no Hotseweenyi no.
Na Jesus bɔɔ no ham see dɛ, Ka w'ano to mu, na fi no mu fi. Na abɔnsam no twaa no hwee finimfin no, nna ofii no mu firii, na ɔannyɛ no hwee.
Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn nyina ahobow, na wɔkekãa kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔnho dɛ, ebɛn asɛm nye yi? Na ɔdze tum nye ahoɔdzen hyɛ asunsum fì ma wofir kɔ.
Na no ho asɛm tahyee man a woetwa ehyia hɔ no nkurow nyina mu.
Na ɔsoɛree fii nhiamudan no mu baa Simon fie. Na papu kɛse akã Simon n'asew, na wɔbɛserɛɛ no maa no.
Na obegyinaa no do tsēaa papu no, ma ofii no do, na ɔsoɛɛr ntsɛmara soom hɔn.
Na wi rokɔtɔ no, hɔn a wɔwɔ ayarfo a yarba horow dze hɔn nyina dze hɔn brɛɛ no, ma ɔdze na nsa too hɔn nyina do nkorkor yɛɛ hɔn edur.
Na mbɔsam so fiir dodwara mu firii, na wɔkaa mu kɛse see dɛ, ɔwo nyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba no. Na ɔbɔɔ hɔn ham, na ɔamma hɔn kwan dɛ wɔnkasa, osiandɛ wonyim dɛ ɔno nye Christ no.
Na adze kyee no, osii mu kɔr sar bi do, na nyimpadodow no hwehwɛɛ no, na wobodur ne nkyɛn no, wosiankaa no dɛ mma ommfi hɔn nkyɛn nnkɔ.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, otwar dɛ mekã Nyankopɔn ahenman ho nsɛmpa mekyerɛ nkurow bi so, osiandɛ iyi ntsi na wɔsomaa me.
Na ɔkɛkãa asɛm wɔ Galilee nhyiamudan mu.
5: Na ɔbaa dɛ nyimpadodow no bɛkyeer no do na wotsiee Nyankopɔn n'asɛm no, nna ogyina Gennesaret nsutaae ho;
na ohun ahɛn ebien dɛ wogyinagyina nsutaae no do: na enufo no efi mu rokɔhor hɔn asawu.
Na ɔkɔr hɛn no kor a ɔyɛ Simon dze no no mu, na ɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔnkwan mfi daadze kakra. Na ɔtsenaa ase na ofi hɛn no mu kyerɛkyerɛɛ nyimpadodow no.
Na ogyaa kasa no, ɔsee Simon dɛ, kwan kɔ mbrɛ ɔdɔ, na hom nkogu hom asawu mfa nam.
na Simon buae see dɛ, Yewura, yɛayɛ edwuma anafua yi nyina, na yeennya hwee; naaso w'asɛm ntsi mubogu asawu no.
Na wɔyɛɛ dɛm no, wobumaa nam pii, ma hɔn asawu retsetsew.
Na wɔtoo nsa kyerɛɛ hɔn asɛfo a wɔwɔ hɛn kor no mu dɛ bɛhyɛɛ ahɛn ebien nyina amaama, ma nkyɛ wɔreyɛ esiw.
Na Simon Peter hunii no, ɔhwee Jesus n'ananadze see dɛ, fi me nkyɛn kɔ, na meyɛ nyimpa dzebɔnyɛnyi, Ewuradze.
Na ɔno nye hɔn a wɔnye no wɔ hɔ nyina, nam dodow a wɔfae no yɛɛ hɔn ahobow;
na dɛm so na ɔyɛɛ James nye John, Zebedee mba no a wɔyɛ Simon ne mfɛfo no. Na Jesus see Simon dɛ, Mma nnsuro: na ofitsi ndɛ ibonu nyimpa.
Na wɔdze hɔn ahɛn bodwiir daadze no, wɔdaan ne nyina gyae, na wɔkaa no do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔwɔ nkurow no mu kor mu no, hwɛ, ɔbarimba a kwata ayɛ no ho mã wɔ hɔ; na ohun Jesus no, ɔdzen'enyim butuuw famu, na ɔserɛɛ no see dɛ, mo wura, sɛ epɛ a, ibotum dɛ ema mo ho san.
Na ɔtseen ne nsa dze kãa no see dɛ, mepɛ, wo ho nsan. Na ntsɛmara na kwata no fii no ho.
Na ɔbraa no dɛ mma ɔnnkã nnkyerɛ biara; na kɔ, fa woho kɛkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no, na w'ahosan ntsi kɛma dza Moses hyɛe no fa yɛ dase ma hɔn.
Na mbom ne nka tahyee mbordo, na nyimpadodow pii behyiaa dɛ woribetsie no, na ɔayɛ hɔn ahoɔmberɛw edur.
Na ɔtwee noho kɔr sar no do kɔsɔree.

Na ɔbaa dɛ da bi ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ no, nna Pharaseefo ɔnye mbra no n'aKyerɛkyerɛfo a wofi Galilee, ɔnye Judea ɔnye Jerusalem nkurow nyina mu aba tsetse hɔ; na Ewuradze n'ahoɔdzen wɔ hɔ dɛ ɔdze bɛsa yarba.
Na hwɛ, mbanyin bi dze nyimpa bi a ɔyar mbubui da mpa do bae, na wɔhwehwɛɛ kwan dze no abɔto n'enyim.
Na wonnya kwan a wɔdze no bodua mu aba wɔ nyimpadodow no ntsi no, wɔkɔr dan no etsifi, na wɔdze no duaa ntaayaa no mu wɔ ne mpa do besii finimfin wɔ Jesus n'enyim.
Na ohun hɔn gyedzi no, ɔsee dɛ, nyimpa, wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo.
Na kyerɛwfo ɔnye Phariseefo no hyɛɛ ase dwendween dɛ, na woana nye yi a ɔrekã ebususɛm yi? Woana botum dze bɔn akyɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn nko?
Na Jesus hun hɔn adendwen no, obuae see hɔn dɛ, ebɛnadze na hom rodwendwen wɔ hom akoma mu yi?
Mmuana na ɔyɛ mberɛw kɛse, ebɛse dɛ, wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo; anaa ebɛse dɛ, soɛr na nantsew a?
Na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma hom ehu dɛ nyimpa Ba no wɔ tum wɔ asaase do dɛ ɔdze bɔn kyɛ, (ɔkãa kyerɛɛ nyia ɔyar mbubui no dɛ) Mese wo dɛ, Soɛr, fa wo mpa na kɔ wo fie.
Na, ntsɛmara ɔsoɛree wɔ hɔn enyim na ɔfaa dza ɔda do no, na osii mu kɔr ne fie hyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
Na ahobow kãa hɔn nyina, na wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam; na hu hyɛɛ hɔn mã dɛ, yeehu anwanwandze ndɛ.
Na iyi ekyir no, ofiir edzi na okohun towgyenyi bi a ne dzin dze Levi, dɛ ɔtse atowgye, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ka mo do.
Na ɔdaan ne nyina gyae, na ɔsoɛree kaa no do.
Na Levi too no pon kɛsenara wɔ ne fie; na atowgyefo nye nkorɔfo bi, nyimpadodow kɛsenara, nye hɔn bɛtsenatsenaa ho.
Na Phariseefo nye hɔn kyerɛwfo no hwinhwinii wɔ n'esuafo no ho see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom nye atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo dzidzi nom yi?
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Hɔn a wɔtse hɔn apow mu no, wonnhia oduyɛfo, na mbom hɔn a wɔyar no a.
Mammbɛfrɛ atseneneefo, na mbom ndzebɔnyɛfo a, dɛ wonno hɔnho.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, John n'esuafo no dze, wɔtɔ dɛ wodzi mbuada pii, na wɔyɛ nkotoserɛ, na Phariseefo dze so dɛm ara; na wodze, wodzidzi na wɔnom.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Ayeforpia mu mba no, aber a ayeforkun no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn, hom botum ama woedzi mbuada anaa?
Na nda no bɛba, na sɛ woyi ayeforkun no fi hɔn nkyɛn a, ɔno na nda no mu wobedzi mbuada.
Na obuu bɛ yi so kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, obi nntsew tam fofor sin nntaa atar dadaw mu: Dɛm no, fofor no dze ɔbɛtsew, na sin a ofir fofor no mu no nye dadaw no nnkɛsaa.
Na obi mmfa wenyin fofor nngu nwomantoa dadaw mu: dɛm no, wenyin fofor no bɛpaa nwoma-ntoa no, na obohue egu, na ntoa no so bɛsɛɛ.
Na wenyin fofor ɔsɛ dɛ wɔdze gu ntoa fofor mu.
Na obi, ɔanom wenyin dadaw no, ɔnnhwehwɛ fofor: Na ɔkã dɛ, Dadaw no na oye.
6: Na ɔbaa dɛ okoduaa eburow kwã mu ahomgyeda, na nsuafo no pempaan eburow mbɛtsem no bi posae wɔ hɔn nsamu wee.
Na Phariseefo no mu binom see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom reyɛ dza ɔmmfa kwan mu dɛ wɔyɛ no ahomgyeda yi?
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nnkenkaan iyi mpo, dza David, aber a ɔkɔm dzee ɔnoara na hɔn a woka no ho no, ɔyɛe no?
mbrɛ ɔkɛhɛɛm Nyankopɔn fie, na ɔkɛfaa kyerɛpaanoo no dzii, na ɔmaa hɔn a wɔka no ho no so bi a ɔmmfa mbra mudɛ obiara dzi dɛ asɔfo no nkotoo?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, nyimpa Ba no yɛ ahomgyeda no no wura.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ahomgyeda kor bi so mu, ɔkɔr nhyiamudan mu kɛkyerɛkyerɛ; na nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a n'abanyimfa adwe.
Na kyerɛwfo nye Phariseefo no tsɛɛw no dɛ ɔbɛyɛ edur ahomgyeda no, ma woeenya biribi akɔtõa no.
Na ɔnodze onyim hɔn adwen, na ɔsee nyimpa a ne nsa adwe no dɛ, Soɛr gyina finimfin. Na ɔsoɛree gyinae.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Miribisa hom asɛm, Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ ahomgyeda wɔbɛyɛ yie, anaa wɔbɛyɛ mbusu a? wɔbɛgye nkwa, anaa wɔbɛsɛɛ a?
Na ɔhwɛɛ hɔnnyina hyiae, na ɔsee no dɛ, tsen wo nsa. Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm, na ne nsa no sanee yɛɛ mu.
Na hɔn nyina abɔdam hyɛɛ hɔn mã, na wotutuu adze kor a wɔdze bɛyɛ Jesus ho egyina.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu no, ɔkɔr koko bi do kɔsɔree; na ɔdaa ho anafua no nyina yɛɛ asɔr maa Nyankopɔn.
Na adze kyee no, ɔfrɛɛ n'esuafo no, na ɔpaa hɔn mu duebien a ɔfrɛɛ hɔn Ndwuma so no:
Simon a ɔtoo no Peter so, nye no nua Andrew, James nye John, Philip nye Bartholomew,
Matthew nye Thomas, Alphæusba James, Simon a wɔfrɛ no Zealot no,
nye James ne ba Judas, nye Judas Iscariot a oyii no mae no.
Na ɔnye hɔn sianee begyinaa taaedo, nye n'esuafo kuw kɛse no nye ɔman no mu nyimpadodow pii a wofi Judæa nyina, nye Jerusalem, nye Tyre nye Sidon mpoano a wɔbae betsiee no, na dɛ ɔbɛsa hɔn yarba;
na hɔn a esunsum fì rehaw hɔn no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn edur.
Na nyimpadodow nyina hwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔbɛkã no, osiandɛ ahoɔdzen fiir no mu bae bɛyɛɛ hɔn nyina edur.
Na ɔmaa n'enyi do wɔ n'asuafo no do, na ɔsee dɛ, Nhyira akã hom ehiafo, na hom na Nyankopɔn ahenman no yɛ homdze.
Nhyira akã hom a ɔkɔm dze hom sesei yi, na wɔbɛma hom amee. Nhyira akã hom a hom rusū sesei yi, na hom bɛserew.
Nhyira akã hom ber a nyimpa bekyir hom, na woeyi hom edzi efi mu, na wɔayaw hom, na wɔatow hom dzin akyen dɛ dzin bɔn wɔ nyimpa Ba no ntsi.
Da no hom ndzi dɛw, na hom ndzi ehurusi: Na hwɛ, hom akatua sõ wɔ sor: na dɛmara na hɔn egyanom dze yɛɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no.
Na hom ahoyafo, hom ndue! Hom enya hom awerɛkyeker dada.
Hom a hom amee sesei yi, hom ndue! Na ɔkɔm bɛdze hom. Hom a hom serew sesei yi, hom ndue! Na hom bedzi nkɔmbɔ na hom esū.
Aber a nyimpa nyina kasa hom ho yie no, hom ndue! Na dɛmara na hɔn egyanom yɛe maa nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo no.
27.Na mekã kyerɛ hom a hom ritsie yi dɛ, hom ndɔ hom atamfo, hom nyɛ hɔn a wɔtan hom yie,
hom nhyira hɔn a wɔdom hom, na hom nsɔr mma hɔn a wɔbɔ hom adapaa.
Na nyia ɔbɔ w'aso fakor mu no, dan fakor so ma no; na nyia ɔfa wo nkatado no, mma nnnsiw no w'asetar ho kwan.
Obiara a ɔserɛ wo no, ma no; na nyia ɔfa w'adze no, mma mmbisa no bio.
Na dza hom pɛ dɛ nyimpa yɛ ma hom no, hom so nyɛ dɛmara mma hɔn.
Na sɛ hom dɔ hɔn a wɔdɔ hom a, ebɛn ndaase na hom nya? Na ndzebɔnyefo mpo dɔ hɔn a wɔdɔ hɔn.
Na sɛ hom yɛ yie ma hɔn a wɔyɛ hom yie a, ebɛn ndaase na hom nya? Na ndzebɔnyɛfo so yɛ dɛmara.
Na sɛ hom dze fɛm hɔn a hom enyi da do dɛ hom nsa bɛkã no hɔn hɔ bio a, ebɛn ndaase na hom nya? ndzebɔnyɛfo so dze fɛm ndzebɔnyɛfo dɛ hɔn nsa bɛkã dɛm bio.
Na mbom hom ndɔ hom atamfo, na hom nyɛ yie, na hom mfɛm dɛ hom enyi nnda biribi do, na hom akatua bɔdɔɔ sõ, na hom ayɛ nyia ɔwɔ sorsor no ne mba, na ɔndze ɔyɛ adɔyɛ ma etsiafo nye emumuyɛfo.
Hom nyɛ mbɔbɔrhufo, dɛ mbrɛ hom Egya so yɛ mbɔbɔrhunyi.
Na mma hom mmbu atsɛn, na wonnkobu hom atsɛn; mma hom mmbu fɔ, nawonnkobu hom fɔ; hom mfa nkyɛ, na wɔdze akɛ hom;
hom mma, na wɔama hom: Esusudze pa a wɔahohom do na wɔawosow no ma ebu do na wɔdze bogu hom bo mu: Na esusudze kor a hom dze susu no, wɔdze bosusu ama hom bio.
Na obuu hɔn bɛ so dɛ, Ana onyifurafo botum akyerɛ onyinfrafo kwan? Hɔn beenu nyina nnkɔtɔ mona mu anaa?
Osuanyi nnkyɛn ne Kyerɛkyerɛfo, na obiara oedzi mu no bɛyɛ dɛ ne Kyerɛkyerɛfo.
Na ɔyɛ dɛn na ehwɛ duaba ɔwɔ wo nua enyiwa mu, na ennhwɛ mpuna a ɔwɔ woara w'enyiwa mu?

Anaadɛ ebɛyɛ dɛn etum ase wo nua dɛ, onua, ma minyi duaba a ɔwɔ w'enyiwa mu mu, na wankasa innhu w'enyiwa mpuna? Ɔwo dabrabanyi dzi kan yi mpuna fi wankasa w'enyiwa mu: Nna ibohu yie eyi duaba a ɔwɔ wo enyiwa mu no.
Na dua pa nnyi hɔ a ɔsow aba prɔwee na dua prɔwee so nnyi hɔ a ɔsow abba pa.
Na dua biara wɔdze n'aba hu no. Na nyimpa nntsetsew adɔnba wɔ nsoɛ do, na eso wɔnntsetsew wenyinaba wɔ kɔkrɔw do.
Nyimpa pa fi n'akoma mu ndzepz korabea na oyi adze pa pue, na yimpa bɔn fi ne ndzɛmba bɔn korabea na oyi dza omuo pue: Na ofi dza abor do wɔ akoma mu no na n'ano kasa.
Na ɔyɛ dɛn na hom frɛ me Ewuradze, Ewuradze, na hom nnyɛ dza mese?
Obiara a ɔba mo hɔ, na otsie m'asɛm, na ɔyɛ no, mebɛkyerɛ hom nyia ɔnyɛ no sɛ:
Ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a osii dan, na otui ma ɔdɔe, na ɔtoo fapem wɔ ɔbotan do; na nsu yirii no, esutsen pemee boor dan no, na oenntum annwosow no, osiandɛ woesi no yie.
Na nyia otsie na ɔnnyɛ no, ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a osii dan wɔ asaase enyi, na onnyi fapem; ɔno na esutsen pemee boor no, na ntsɛmara ɔhwee ase, na dan no ne sɛɛ yɛɛ kɛse.
7: Na owiee ne nsɛm no nyina kã wɔ nkorɔfo no asomu no, ɔkɛhɛɛn Capernaum.
Na ɔhamupanyin bi n'akowaa a ɔsom no bo kɛse yar da wosu.
Na ɔtsee Jesus nka no, ɔsomaa Jewfo mpanyin bi wɔ no hɔ kɛserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmbra mbɛgye n'akowaa no wɔserɛɛ
Na wɔbaa Jesus nnkyɛn no wɔserɛɛ no enyiberdo see dɛ, ɔsɛ dɛ ebɛyɛ dɛm adze ama no:
osiandɛ ɔdɔ hɛn man, na ɔnoara osii hɛn nhyiamudan.
Na Jesus nye hɔn kɔree. Na ɔrebɛn ofi no ho no, ɔhamupanyin no somaa n'asɛfoo bi wɔ no hɔ bɛsee no dɛ, mo wura, mma nnhaw woho: Na mennsɛ dɛ ebɛhɛn me hatsɛw ase;
dɛm ntsi manndwen moho dɛ mesɛ dɛ meba wo nkyɛn; na kã asɛm ara, na m'akowaa ho bɛsan.
Na mo so meyɛ nyimpa a wɔdze me ahyɛ tum ase, na mowɔ nsordaafo wɔ m'ase, na mese yi dɛ, kɔ a, ɔkɔ; namese obi so, bra a, ɔba, mese m'abofra dɛ, yɛ yi a, ɔyɛ.
Na Jesus tsee yinom no, no ho yɛɛ no nwanwa, na ɔsee nyimpadodow a wodzi n'ekyir no dɛ, Mese hom dɛ, Isreal mu mpo munnhun gyedzi a ɔtse dɛm yi pɛn.
Na hɔn a wɔsomaa hɔn no sanee kɔr fie kohun akowaa no dɛ no ho ayɛ no dzen
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔannkyɛr biara na ɔkɔr kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Nain mu; na n'esuafo no nye nyimpadodow pii nye no kɔree.
Na opinkyɛɛn kurow no n'abobow ekyir no, hwɛ, wɔso bi a Oewu a ɔyɛ ne nã ne ba kortoo, rifir edzi, na ɔbaa no yɛ okunafo; na nyimpadodow pii fi kurow no mu ka no ho.
Na Ewuradze hun no no, ne yamu hyehyee no maa no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Mma nnsū.
Na ɔbae bɛkãa bonto no, na hɔn a wɔso no no gyinae; na ɔsee dɛ, Aberatsɛ, mese wo dɛ, Soɛr.
Na nyia owuii no, ɔsoɛree, na ɔhyɛɛ ase kasae. Na ɔdze no hyɛɛ ne nã nsa.
Na hu kãa hɔn nyina; na wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam see dɛ, nkɔnhyɛnyi kɛse asoɛr wɔ hɛn mu, na, Nyankopɔn abɔhwɛ ne man.
Na no ho asɛm tahyee Judæa nyina, nye asaase a etwa ehyia nyina mu.
Na John n'esuafo kɛkãa yinom nyina ho asɛm kyerɛɛ no.
Na John frɛ n'esuafo mu beenu, na ɔsomaa hɔn Ewuradze hɔ see dɛ Ana ɔwo nye nyia ɔreba no, anaa yɛrotweɔn obi so?
Na mbarimba no baa ne nkyɛn no, wɔsee dɛ, John Onumanyi no asoma hɛn wo hɔ dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye nyia ɔreba no, anaa yɛrotweɔn obi so?
Na dɔnhwer kor no ara mu ɔyɛɛ dodowara hɔn nyarba nye hɔn mbusu edur, ɔnye hɔn a wɔwɔ esunsum fì, na ɔmaa enyifurafo pii hun adze.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɛkã dza hom ehu na hom atse yi nkyerɛ John, dɛ enyifurafo hu adze, mbubua nantsew, akwatafo ho san, etsitsifo tse asɛm, ewufo nyan, na wɔkã asɛmpa kyerɛ ehiafo.
Na nyia mennkɛyɛ no fintsidua no, nhyira akã no.
Na John n'abɔfoe no kɔree no, ɔhyɛɛ ase see nyimpadodow no wɔ John ho dɛ, ebɛnadza na hom fii redzi kɔr sar no do kɔhwɛe? Ndzɛmbir a mframa rihim no a?
Na ebɛnadze na hom firii kɔhwɛe? Nyimpa a ofura aberɛberɛ-tam a? Hwɛ, hɔn a wofura atam fenemm, na wɔyɛ anomu dɛw no, wɔwɔ ahemfie.
Na ebɛnadze na hom firii kɔhwɛe? Nkɔnhyɛnyi a? Nyew, mese hom dɛ, nyia ɔkyɛn nkɔnhyɛnyi mpo a.
Oyi nye nyia wɔakerɛw no ho dɛ, hwɛ, morosoma mo bɔfoe ma oeedzi, w'enyim kan a Obesiesie wo kwan edzi w'enyim.
Mese hom dɛ, hɔn a mbaa awo hɔn nyina mu biara mmpuei a ɔyɛ kɛse kyɛn John: naaso nyia ɔyɛ aketseaba wɔ sor ahenman no mu dze yɛ kɛse kyɛn no.
Na nkorɔfo a wɔtsee nyina, nye atowgyefo no, wobuu Nyankopɔn bem osiandɛ wɔdze John n'enuma no numaa hɔn.
Na Phariseefo nye mbrakyerɛfo no dze, wɔpoow Nyankopɔn n'apam maa hɔnho, osiandɛ wɔamma oennuma hɔn.
Dɛm ntsi ebɛnadze na medze ɔsantsen yi mu nyimpa mobɔto ho, na wɔtse dɛ ebɛnadze?
wɔtse dɛ mbofraba a wɔtsenatsena gua do, na wɔrefrɛfrɛ hɔnho sedɛ, yɛahɛn atɛntɛbɛn ama hom, na hom annsaw; yeetwa ewuo na hom ennsū
Na John Onumanyi no aba, onndzidzi, ɔnnom nsã, na hom sedɛ, ɔwɔ abɔnsam.
Nyimpa Ba no aba, odzidzi na ɔnom, na hom se dɛ, hwɛ, nyimpa tumfur, nsahweam, atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo nyɛnko!
Naaso nyansa ne mba bu no bem.
