Na Phariseefo no mu kor bisaa no dɛ ɔnye no nkedzidzi, na ɔkɔr Phariseenyi no ne fie kɛtsenaa edziban ho.
Na hwɛ, ɔbaa bi a ɔwɔ kurow no mu a ɔye dzebɔnyɛnyi; na ohun dɛ ɔtse edzidzi wɔ Phariseenyi no ne fie no, ɔdze ngohuam alabastron-toa mã bae,
na obegyinaa n'ekyir wɔ n'anan ho sūi, na ɔhyɛɛ ase dze ne nyinsuwa fɔɔw n'anan ho, na ɔdze ne tsinhwi pepae, na ofeew n'anan ho, na ɔdze ngohuam seraa ho.
Na Phariseenyi a ohyiaa no edzidzi no hunii no, ɔkãe wɔ no mu dɛ, Oyi, sɛ ɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi a, nkyɛ obohu onyi kor a, anaa ɔbaa kor ɔdze ne nsa kã no yi, dɛ ɔyɛ dzebɔnyɛnyi.
Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, Simon, mowɔ asɛm bi mekã mekyerɛ wo. Na ɔsee dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, kã.
Bosabɔnyi bi wɔ akafo beenu: Baako dze denare ahaenum, baako nso dze edunum.
Na wonnya bi nntua no, ɔdze kyɛɛ hɔn beenu myina kwa. Dɛm ntsi hɔn mu woana bɔdɔ no dodow?
Simon buae see dɛ, Mususu dɛ, nyia ɔdze dodow kyɛɛ no no a. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ebua atsɛn pa.
Na ɔdaan n'enyim wɔ ɔbaa no do see Simon dɛ, Ehu ɔbaa yi? Mebaa wo fie no, ɔwo amma me me nan ho nsu; na ɔndze ɔdze ne nyinsuwa afɔw me nan ho, na ɔdze ne tsinhwi apepa.
ɔwo emmfew m'ano, na ɔnodze, ofitsi dɛ mebaa ha yi, onngyaa me nan ho few.
ɔwo ammfa ngo annsera me tsirmu, na ɔnodze, ɔdze ngohuam asera me nan ho mpo.
Dɛm ntsi mese wo dɛ no bɔn a ɔdɔɔ sõ no, wɔdze akyɛ no, osiandɛ no dɔ dɔɔ sõ; na nyia wɔdze kumaabi akyɛ no, ɔdɔ kumaabi.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo.
Na hɔn a wɔnye no tse edzidzi no hyɛɛ ase kãe wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, woana nye oyi a ɔdze bɔn so kyɛ yi?
Na ɔsee ɔbaa no dɛ, wo gyedzi agye wo: kɔ asomdwee mu.
8: Na yinom ekyir no, ɔbaa dɛ annkyɛr biara na okoduaduaa nkurow mu nye nkurobaase kɛkãa Nyankopɔn n'ahenman no n'asɛmpa no kyerɛe; na duebien no ka no ho,
nye mbaa bi a wɔayɛ hɔn esunsum bɔn nye ahoɔmberɛw edur: Mary a wɔfrɛ no Magdalene a mbɔnsam esuon efir no mu no,
nye Joanna, Herod ne pianyi Chusa ne yer no, nye Susanna, nye dodowara so a wɔdze hɔn ahodze bi soom no no.
Na nyimpadodow pii boaa ano, na hɔn a wofir nkurow nyinaa mu baa ne nkyɛn no, obuu bɛ dɛ,
Oduafo no kɔree kɛpee n'aba; na ɔrepe no. bi koguu kwan nkyɛn, na wotsiatsiaa do, na wimu nnoma bɔsosɔwee.
Na bi so koguu ɔbotan do, na ofifirii no, ɔkyenkyenee, osiandɛ onnyi fawin ntsi.
Na bi so koguu nsoɛ finimfin, na nsoɛ no nye no fifirii, na omiaa no.
Na bi so koguu asaase pa do, na ofifirii na ɔsoow aba mbɔho ɔha. Na ɔkãa yinom no, ɔtsēaa mu dɛ, Nyia ɔwɔ aso a wɔdze tsie, ma ontsie.
Na n'esuafo no bisaa no dɛ bɛ yi n'ase nye dɛn.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Homdze, wɔdze ama hom dɛ hom nhu Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu esumasɛm; na nkaa no dze, wɔdze ma hɔn mbɛbu mu, na wɔhwɛa, woeennhu, na wɔtse a, wɔaanntse ase.
Na bɛ no nye yi: Aba no nye Nyankopɔn n'asɛm.
Hɔn a wɔwɔ kwan nkyɛn no nye hɔn a woetsie; nna abɔnsam ba, na obeyi asɛm no fi hɔn akoma mu, ma wɔaanngye eendzi na wɔaanngye hɔn nkwa.
Na hɔn a wɔwɔ ɔbotan do nye hɔn a wotsie a, wɔdze dɛw gye asɛm no; na yinom wonnyi ndwow, na wɔgye dzi ma ɔkyɛr kakra, na nsɔhwɛber ba a nna wɔhwe ase.
Na dza okoguu nsoɛ mu no, yinom nye hɔn a woetsie na wɔrokɔ no, ɔbra yi mu akɔdadwen nye ahonya nye enyigyedze mia hɔn, ma wɔnnsow aba mmber nndu mu.
Na dza ɔwɔ asaase pa mu no, yinom nye hɔn a wɔdze akoma pa a oye etsie asɛm no, wɔdze sie, na wɔnam abotar mu sow aba.
Obi nnsɔ kandzea na ɔmmfa kuruw mmbua do, anaa ɔmmfa nnsi mpa ase; na ɔdze si kandzeadua do, ma hɔn a wɔkɔ mu hɔ eehu ne kan.
Na biribi nnsuma a wonnkeyi no edzi, na onnhunta a wonnkohu na ɔnnkɛda gua.
Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie mbrɛ hom dua tsie; na obiara a ɔwɔ no, wɔbɛma no, na obiara a onnyi no, dza osusu dɛ ɔwɔ mpo wɔbɛgye ne nsamu.
Na ne nã nye no nuanom baa ne nkyɛn, na woenntum ammbɛn no wɔ nyimpadodow no ntsi.
Na wɔbɛkãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, wo nã nye wo nuanom gyina abow enyim rohwehwɛ ehu wo.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Me nã nye mo nuanom nye woyi a wotsie Nyankopɔn asɛn na wɔyɛ.
Na ɔbaa dɛ da bi mu ɔnye n'esuafo no kɔr hɛn mu, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mma yentwa nkɔ esuegya no ho, na wotui kɔree.
Na wɔrokɔ no ɔdae; na mframa kɛse bɔɔ huu baa esu no du, na nsu rehyɛ hɔn mã, na wɔwɔ amandzehu mu.
Na wɔbaa ne nkɛn benyaan no see dɛ, Yewura, yewura, yɛrehera. Na onyanee no, ɔbraa mframa no nye nsu no ne gyakagyaka no, na ogyaae, na hɔ taa dziin.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom gyedzi wɔ hen? Na wosuroi, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn nwanwa, na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, woana nye yi a ɔhyɛ mframa nye nsu mpo ma wotsie no yi?
Na wodur Gerasafo asaase do a ɔwɔ Galilee tsentsendo.
Na ofiir hɛn mu kɔr daadze no, ɔbarimba bi a ɔwɔ mbɔnsam fi kurow no mu behyiaa no: Na mber pii ɔnnhyɛ atar, ɔnntsena fi biara mu, na aboda mu na ɔtse.
Na ohun Jesus no, ɔkaa mu, na ɔhwee n'enyim daadze, na ɔdze ndze kɛse see dɛ, menye wo wɔ ebɛn yɛ, Jesus, ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn Ba? Meserɛ wo dɛ mma nnhaw me.
Osiandɛ ɔakã akyerɛ sunsum fī no dɛ omfi nyimpa no mu: na mber pii ɔkyer no, na wɔdze nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn nye mpokyerɛ to no weɔn no; na obubu dza wɔdze kyeker no no mu, na abɔnsam no pam no kɔ sar do.
Na Jesus bisaa no dɛ, wo dzin dze dɛn? Na ɔsee dɛ, Legion, osiandɛ mbɔsam pii ahɛn no mu.
Na mbɔnsam no serɛɛ no dɛ mma ɔnnhyɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnkɔ bun no mu.
Na mprekokuw kɛse bi wɔ hɔ a woridzidzowɔ kokwaa no do; na wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmma hɔn kwan ma wɔnkɔ hɔn mu. Na ɔmaa hɔn ho kwan.
Na mbɔsam no fii nyimpa no mu kɔr mpreko no mu, na okuw no faa twitwi kesiaan ɔbo kronn koguguu nsu no mu, na wɔtseetsee wui.
Na hɔn a wɔrenyɛn hɔn no hun dza ɔaba no, woguanee na wɔkɛkãe wɔ kurow no mu na no nkwaado.
Nna wofiir edzi bɔhwɛɛ dza ɔaba no, na wɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn bohun nyimpa a abɔnsam fii no mu kɔree no dɛ ɔtsena Jesus n'anan ho, hyɛ atar, na n'adwen mu atsew no, na wosuroi.
Na hɔn a wohunii no kãa kyerɛɛ hɔn mbrɛ ɔyɛe ma nyia nkyɛ abɔnsam wɔ no mu no no ho sanee.
Na Gerasafo nkurow a etwa ehyia mu nkorɔfo nyina bisaa no dɛ omfi hɔn nkyɛn nkɔ, osiandɛ hu kɛse kaa hɔn. Na ɔnodze osii hɛn mu sanee kɔree.
Na nyimpa a mbɔsam fii no mu kɔree no serɛɛ no dɛ ɔnye no bɛtsena; na Jesus gyaa no kwan dɛ,
San kɔ wo fie, na kɛkã ndzɛmba akɛse a Nyankopɔn ayɛ ama wo kyerɛ. Na osii mu kɔree kɛkãa ndzɛmba a Jesus ayɛ ama no wɔ kurow no nyina mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Jesus sanee kɔree no, nyimpadodow no gyee no, osiandɛ hɔn nyina rotweɔn no.
Na hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi a ne dzin dze Jairus a ɔyɛ nhyiamudan mu panyin no bae; na ɔbɔhwee Jesus n'ananadze, na ɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmbra ne fie;
na ɔwɔ babaa kor a oedzi bɛyɛ mfe duebien na ɔda hɔ ruwu. Na ɔrokɔ no nyimpadodow no kyeer no do.
Na ɔbaa bi oenya bɔgyaagu mfe duebien, na ɔahwer n'adze nyina ama eduyɛfo, na eso obiara enntum annsa no yarba,
bae bedzii n'ekyir kãa n'atar ano ndwow; na amonmu hɔ ara na no bɔgyaagu twae.
Na Jesus see dɛ, woana na ɔkãa me no? Na hɔn nyina resan no, Peter nye hɔn a wɔka no ho no kãa dɛ, Yewura, nyimpadodow akyer wo do na worimia wo.
Na Jesus see dɛ, Obi akã me, na mehu dɛ ahoɔdzen efi mo mu kɔ.
Na ɔbaa no hun dɛ oennsuma no, ɔdze ahopopo bae, na ɔbɔhwee n'enyim, na ɔkãa adze kor a osian ntsi ma ɔkãa no, na mbrɛ no ho yɛɛ no dzen amonmu hɔ ara kyerɛɛ no wɔ nkorɔfo nyina enyim.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Babaa, wo gyedzi agye wo: Kɔ asomdwee mu.
Na ɔrekasa no, obi fi nhyiamudan mu panyin no ne fie bae bɛsee dɛ, wo babaa no ewu: mma nnhaw Kyerɛkyerɛfo no.
Na Jesus tsee no, obuaa no dɛ, mma nnsuro, na gye dzi ara, na obenya nkwa.
Na ɔbaa ofi no mu no, ɔamma kwan mma obiara annkɔ mu, gyedɛ Peter, nye John, nye James, nye abofra no n'egya nye ne nã.
Na hɔn nyina rusū na woridzi nkɔmbɔ. Na ɔsee dɛ, mma hom nnsū: onnwui, na ɔada.
Na wɔsereew no twee, osiandɛ wonyim dɛ oewu,
Na ɔnodze osuoo ne nsamu, na ɔfrɛɛ dɛ, Ababaawa, nyan.
Na no sunsum sanee baa bio, na ɔsoɔree nsɛmara. Na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmma no biribi ma ondzo.
Na n'awofo no ho boow hɔn; na ɔbraa hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnkã dza wɔayɛ no nnkyerɛ obiara.
9: Na ɔfrɛɛ duebien no boaa ano, na ɔmaa hɔn ahoɔdzen nye tum wɔ mbɔnsam do, na dɛ wɔnsa nyarba.
Na ɔsomaa hɔn dɛ wɔnkɛkã Nyankopɔn ahenman ho asɛm, na wɔmma ayarfo ho nsan.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mma hɔn mmfa biribi nntu kwan, mma hom mmfa poma anaa kotoku anaa edziban anaa sika, na mma hom mmfa ntar ebien.
Na ofi biara a hom bɛhɛn mu no, hom ntsena hɔ ara, na hom eefi hɔ akɔ.
Na hɔn a wɔrenngye hom no, hom fi kurow mu hɔ rokɔ a, hom mporoporow hom ananadze huntuma ngye dase ntsia hɔn.
Na wosii mu koduaduaa nkurow no nyina mu kãa asɛmpa no, na wɔsaa yarba wɔ mbea nyina.
Na ɔmansinhen Herod tsee dza ɔyɛe nyina, na ne tsirmu yɛɛ no basabasa, osiandɛ binom kãa dɛ John efi ewufo mu asoɛr;
na binom so kãa dɛ Elijah eyi noho; na binom so dɛ tsetse nkɔnhyɛfo no mu baako asoɛr bio.
Na Herod see dɛ, John metwa ne tsir; na woana nye nyia metse no ho nsɛm dɛm yi? Na ɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ ohu no.
Na Ndwuma no sanee bae no, wɔbɛkãa dza wɔakɛyɛ nyina kyerɛɛ no. Na ɔfaa hɔn kɔr nkyɛn beebi, wɔ kurow a wɔfrɛ no Bethsaida no mu.
Na nyimpadodow no hunii no, wɔbɛkaa no do; na ɔgyee hɔn na ɔkãa Nyankopɔn ahenman no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ hɔn, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn a woehia eduyɛ no edur.
Na wi robɔtɔ no, duebien no bae bɛsee no dɛ, gya nyimpadodow yi kwan ma wɔnkɔ nkurowbaase nye mfuwa a woetwa ehyia yi mu nkɛtsena hɔ, na woeenya edziban: na mbrɛ yɛwɔ yi sar do a.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, homara hom mma hɔn biribi ma wɔndzi. Na wɔsee dɛ, yennyi biribiara dɛ paano enum, na esunam ebien, gyedɛ yɛkɔ kɔtɔ edziban ma nkorɔfo yi nyina.
Na wɔbɛyɛ mbarimba mpemenum. Na ɔsee n'esuafo no dɛ, Hom mma wɔntsenatsena famu ekuw mu, eduonum, eduonum.
Na wɔyɛɛ dɛm na wɔmaa hɔn nyina tsenaa famu.
Na ɔfaa paanoo enum no, nye esunam ebien no, na ɔhwɛɛ sor no, ohyiraa do, na obubui dze maa n'esuafo no dɛ wɔmfa ntoto nyimpadodow no enyim.
Na hɔn nyina dzidzi na wɔmee; na wɔtasee mporoporoba a ɔboor do no nkɛntsɛn dubeien.
Na ɔbaa dɛ noara nko wɔ hɔ rosɔr no, n'esuafo no kaa no ho; na obisaa hɔn dɛ, nyimpa dodow se dɛ woana nye me?
Na wobuae see dɛ, John onumanyi no a, na binom se Elijah a; binom so se dɛ tsetse nkɔnhyɛfo no bi na ɔasoɛr bio.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, na homdze hom se dɛ woana nye me? Na Peter buae see dɛ, Nyankopɔn ne Christ no a.
Na ɔbraa hɔn hyɛɛ hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnkã yi nnkyerɛ obiara,
na ɔsee dɛ, ɔsɛ nyimpa Ba no dɛ obohu amandze pii, na mpanyimfo nye asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no apow no, na woeku no, na da a otsîa ebiasa no oenyan.
Na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn nyina dɛ, sɛ obi pɛ dɛ odzi m'ekyir a, ma ɔmpa noho, na ompegya ne mbeamudua daa na ɔnka mo do.
Na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔgye no nkwa no, ɔbɛyew no, na obiara a ɔbɛyew no nkwa wɔ me ntsi, ɔno na ɔbɛgye no.
Na sɛ nyimpa nya wiadze nyina, na sɛ ɔyew noho, anaaso ɔhwer noho a, ebɛn mfaso na obenya?
Osiandɛ obiara a n'enyi bɔtõ emi nye me nsɛm ho no, ɔno na nyimpa Ba no n'enyi bɔtõ no ho, ber a ɔdze nanakasa nye n'Egya nye abɔfo krɔnkrɔn enyimnyam no bɛba no.
Na mekã kyerɛ hom nokwar dɛ, hɔn a wogyina ha yi, binom wɔ hɔ a wɔronnsɔ owu nnhwɛ ansaana woehu Nyankopɔn n'ahenman no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nsɛm yi ekyir bɛyɛ ndaawɔtwe, ɔfaa Peter nye John nye James, na ɔkɔr kokowaa bi do Kɔsɔree.
Na ɔrosɔr no, n'enyim su sakyeree, na na ntar yɛɛ fitaa hyɛnhyɛnn.
Na hwɛ, mbarimba beenu nye no kasae: wɔyɛ Moses ɔnye Elijah.
Hɔn na woyii hɔnho wɔ enyimnyam mu, na wɔkãa ka a ɔrekɛka beebi wɔ Jerusalem ho asɛm.
Na Peter ɔnye hɔn a wɔka no ho no nda kãa hɔn kɛsenara, na wonyanee no, wohun n'enyimnyam ɔnye mbarimba beenu a wogyina ne nkyɛn no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ worisi mu efi ne nkyɛn no, Peter see Jesus dɛ, Ewuradze, oye ma h!ɛn dɛ yɛtsena ha, na ma yɛmbɔ asese ebiasa, wodze kor; Moses dze kar, Elijah dze kor na onyim dze a ɔreka.
Na ɔrekã dɛm no, mununkum bɛkataa hɔn do; na wɔrehɛn mununkum no mu no, wosuroi.
Na ndze fi mununkum no mu baa dɛ, Oyi nye me Ba, nyia masan mu meyi no: hom ntsie no.
Na ndze no twaa mu no, nna Jesus nko wɔ hɔ. Na womuamuaa do, na nda no mu no wɔannkã ndzɛnba a wohunii no ho asɛm biara annkyerɛ obiara.
Na ɔbaa dɛ n'adzekyee a wofi kokwaa no do baa famu no, nyimpadodow pii behyiaa no.
Na hwɛ, nyimpadodow no mu nyimpa bi tsēaa mu dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, meserɛ wo, hwɛ me ba yi: na meba kor ara nye no;
na hwɛ, sunsum bi kyer no, na ɔka mu awerɛfir mu, na ɔtsetsew no ma n'ano twa ehur, na ɔposa no ma ɔyɛ dzen dɛ ogya no.
Na meserɛɛ w'esusfo dɛ wontu no, na woenntum.
Na Jesus buae see dɛ, Ao ɔsantsen a hom nnyi gyedzi na hom akyea, menye hom ntsena na minsie hom ho abotar nkodu dabɛn? Fa wo ba no bra ha.
Na ɔreba no, abɔnsam no twaa no hwee famu, na ɔtsewtseew no, na Jesus braa susnsum fī no, na ɔsaa abofra no yarba, na ɔdze no maa n'egya.
Na hɔn nyina ho boow hɔn, wɔ Nyankopɔn no tumdzi kɛse no ntsi. Na ndzɛmba a Jesus yɛe nyina ayɛ hɔn nwanwa no, ɔsee n'esuafo no dɛ,
Hom mma nsɛm yi nkɔ hom asomu: na nyimpa Ba no woribeyi no ahyɛ nyimpa nsa.
Na wɔanntse asɛm yi ase, na ohuntaa hɔn amma woeennhu, na wosuroo dɛ wobebisa no asɛm yi ho.
Na atsɛnyiyi baa hɔn mu dɛ hɔn mu woana na ɔbɛyɛ kɛse.
Na Jesus hun hɔn akoma mu adwen no, ɔfaa abofraba bi gyinaa ne nkyɛn,
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Obiara a ɔbɛgye abɔfraba yi wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔgye emi mara; na obiara a ɔgye me no, ɔgye nyia ɔsomaa me no: na nyia ɔyɛ ekumaba wɔ hom nyina mu no, ɔno na ɔyɛ kɛse.
Na John buae see dɛ, Yewura, yehun obi dɛ ɔdze wo dzinrutu mbɔsam, na yɛsiiw no kwan, ɔnam dɛ ɔnnka hɛn do ntsi.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, mma hom nnsiw no kwan: na nyia anntsia hom no, ɔwɔ hom afã.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nda a wɔrebɛfa no akɔ sor reyɛ edu no, osii n'enyim dzendzenndzen dɛ bɛ ɔbɔkɔ Jerusalem,
na ɔsomaa abɔfo dzii n'enyim kan; na wɔkɔree no, wɔkɛhɛɛn Samariafo kurow bi mu dɛ worikesiesie hɔ ama no.
Na wɔanngye no, osiandɛ n'enyi yɛ dɛ ɔrokɔ Jerusalem.
Na n'esuafo James nye John hunii no, wɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, ana epɛ dɛ yɛkã ma ogya fi sor ba bɛhyew hɔn?
Na ɔdaan noho twuuw hɔn enyim;
na wɔkɔr ekuroba bi so mu.
Na wɔnam kwan mu rokɔ no, obi kãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, beebiara a ebɔkɔ no, mebɛka wo do.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Nsɔ wɔ etu, na wimu nnoma wɔ mbrerɛbuw, na nyimpa Ba no nnyi mbrɛ ɔdze ne tsir to.
Na ɔsee obi so dɛ, Ka mo do, na ɔsee no dɛ, ma me kwan monkɔ minkesie m'egya ana.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, ma ewufo nsie hɔnara hɔn ewufo, na ɔwodze, kɔ kɛkã Nyankopɔn n'ahenman ho asɛm.
Na obi so see no dɛ, Ewuradze, mebɛka wo do, na ma me kwan menkɛkra hɔn a wɔwɔ me fie ana.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Obi a ɔdze ne nsa kosuo funtumdadze no mu, na ɔhwɛ n'ekyir no, ɔmmfata Nyankopɔn ahenman no.
10: Na iyi ekyir no, Ewuradze yii eduosuon afofor so, na ɔsomaa hɔn beenu beenu dzii n'enyim kan kɔr kurow anaa beebiara a nankasa robɔkɔ hɔ no mu.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Otwa-edwuma no dɔɔ sõ ampa, na edwumayɛfo no dze, wosuar: dɛm ntsi hom nserɛ otwa-edwuma no wura ma ɔnsoma edwumayɛfo mbra no twa-edwuma no mu.
Hom nkɔ: hwɛ, mosoma hom dɛ nguambaa wɔ mpataku finimfin.
Mma hom mmfa sika-kotoku, anaa bɔtɔ, anaa nsokota; na mma hom nnkyia obi wɔ kwan mu.
Na ofi biara a hom bɛhɛn mu no, hom ndzi kan nse dɛ, Asomdwee mbra ofi yi do.
Na sɛ asomdwee bɛtsena do, na sɛ ɔnntse dɛm a, ɔbɛsan aba hom hɔ bio.
Na ofie hɔ ara na hom ntsena, na hom ndzi na hom nnom dza wɔbɛma: Osiandɛ odwumayɛfo n'apaadze sɛ no: Mma hom mmfi ofi mu nnkɔ ofi mu.
Na kurow biara a hom kɔ mu, na wɔgye hom, hom ndzi dza wɔdze besi hom enyim;
na hom nsa no mu ayarfo yarba, na hom nse hɔn dɛ, Nyankopɔn ahenman no abɛn hom.
Na kurow biara a hom kɔ mu na wɔnngye hom, hom mfir nkɔ n'abɔntsen do, na hom nse dɛ,
Hom kurow mu huntuma a afemfam hɛn ho mpo yɛprapra gu hom do: na ɔyɛ dɛn ara a, hom nhu yi dɛ Nyankopɔn ahenman no abɛn hom.
Na mese hom dɛ ɔbɛfanyim Sodom wɔ da no mu akyɛn dɛm kurow no.
Chorazin ndue! Bethsaida ndue! Osiandɛ sɛ tum ndwuma a wɔyɛe wɔ hom mu yi, wɔyɛɛ no wɔ Tyre nye Sidon mu a, nkyɛ wɔtsenatsenaa eyitam nye nso mu nuu hɔn ho dada.
Na ɔbɛfanyim Tyre nye Sidon wɔ atsɛmbua no mu akyɛn hom.
Na ɔwo, Capernaum, wɔbɛma wo do akɔ sor anaa? Wɔbɛbrɛ wo adze akɔ samanzdae.
Nyia otsie hom, otsie me so, na nyia ɔpow hom, ɔpow me so, na nyia ɔpow me, ɔpow nyia ɔsomaa me no so.
Na eduoson no dze dɛw sanee bɛsee dɛ wo dzin ntsi mbɔnsam mpo abrɛ hɔnho adze ama hɛn.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Muhun Satan dɛ ofir sor rohwe ase dɛ enyinam.
Hwɛ, mama hom tum dɛ hom ntsiatsia nwɔ nyankoma-nketsebowa do nye ɔtamfo ahoɔdzen nyina hom do na biribiara runntum nyɛ hom hwee.
Naaso mma hom nndzi dɛw wɔ yi mu dɛ esunsum abrɛ hɔnho adze ama hom, na mbom hom ndzi dɛw dɛ wɔakyerɛw hom edzin wɔ sor.

Na dɔn no ara mu odzii ehurusi wɔ Sunsum krɔnkrɔn mu, na ɔsee dɛ, miyi wo ayɛw, Egya, sor nye asaase wura, dɛ edze ndzɛmba yi esuma enyansafo nye abadwembafo, na eyi akyerɛ nkɔkowaba: ampaara, Egya, na dɛm na ɔsɔɔ w'enyi.
Ndzemba nyina m'Egya dze ahyɛ me nsa; na obi nnyim mbrɛ ɔba no tse, gyedɛ Egya no; na obi nnyim mbrɛ Egya no tse, gyedɛ ɔba no, na nyia ɔba no pɛ dɛ oyi no kyerɛ no.
Na ɔdaan noho, kyerɛɛ n'esuafo no see hɔn nko dɛ, nhyira akã enyiwa a ohu dza hom hu yi.
Na mese hom dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛfo nye ahemfo pii pɛɛ dɛ wohu dza hom hu yi, na woennhu, na dɛ wɔtse dza hom tse yi, na wɔanntse.
Na hwɛ, mbrakyerɛfo, bi soɛree sɔɔ no hwɛɛ dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ebɛnadze na menyɛ na onnyiewiei nkwa ayɛ medze?
Na ɔsee no dɛ, ebɛnadze na wɔakyerɛw no mbra no mu? Ekenkan dɛn?
Na obuae see dɛ, dɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn wɔ w'akoma nyina mu, nye wo kra nyina mu, nye w'ahoɔdzen nyina mu, nye w'adwen nyina mu, na, dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa woho.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ebua yie: yɛ yi na ibenya nkwa.
Na ɔnodze, ɔpɛɛ dɛ obu noho bem no, ɔsee Jesus dɛ, nna me nkyɛn nye woana?
Jesus buae see dɛ, nyimpa bi fi Jerusalem risian akɔ Jericho, na ɔkɔtɔɔ edwotwfo mu a wɔpaa no ho tam na wopirapira no gya no hɔ kɔree, ma ɔatɔ akɔtɔmborɔnsa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔsɔfo bi bɛfaa kwan no do, na ohun no no, osii afã noho twaa mu.
Dɛmara na Levinyi bi so odur hɔ no, ɔbae na obohunii na osii afã noho twaa mu.
Na Samarianyi bi a ɔnam no kwan baa mbrɛ ɔwɔ no, na obohun no no, na yamu hyehyee no,
na ɔbaa ne nkyɛn bɛkye kyeer n'ekur dze ngo nye wenyin guguu mu, na ɔdze ngo no sii nankasa n'abowa do dze no kɔr ahɔhodan mu kɔhwɛɛ no.
Na adzekyee no oyii danare ebien dze maa ahɔhodan wura no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ no yie, na biribiara a ebɔhwer aka oh no, sɛ mesan ba a, mebɛhyɛ wo ananmu.
Afei hɔn baasa yi mu woana na ɔyɛɛ nyia ɔkɔtɔɔ edwotwafo mu no ne nyɛnko?
Na ɔsee dɛ, nyia ohun no mbɔbɔr na a. Na Jesus see no dɛ, kɔ na wo so kɛyɛ dɛmara.
Na ɔbaa dɛ wɔrokɔ no, wokodur ekuroba bi mu, na ɔbaa bi a ne dzin dze Martha faa no kɔr ne fie.
Na ɔwɔ onuabaa bi a wɔfrɛ no Mary, ɔno so na ɔtsena Jesus anan ho na otsiee ne nsɛm.
Na Martha fonaa noho wɔ ɔsom pii ho, na ɔbaa no ho bɛsee no dɛ, mo wura, ennhwɛ dɛ mo nua egyaa mo nko na morosom? Dɛm ntsi se no dɛ ombosuo mo mu.
Na Ewuradze buae see no dɛ, Martha, Martha, edwendwen na ehaw woho woho wɔ ndzɛmba pii ho;
na adze kor na ohia: ne Mary dze, oeyi dza oye a wɔrenngte ne nsamu.
11: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔwɔ beebi rosɔr, na ogyae no, n'esuafo nomu baako see no dɛ, Ewuradze, kyerɛkyerɛ hɛn asɔr yɛ, dɛ mbrɛ John so kyerɛkyerɛɛ n'esuafo no.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, sɛ hom rosɔr a, hom nse dɛ, Egya, wo dzin ho ntsew, w'ahendzi mbra.
Ma hɛn hɛn daa daa edziban daa.
Na fa hɛn bɔn kyɛ hɛn, na hɛn so yɛdze kyɛ obiara a ɔdze hɛn kaw. Na mma mmfa hɛn nnkɔ nsɔhwɛ mu.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mu woana na ɔwɔ nyɛnko, na ɔbɔkɔ ne nkyɛn esuom akɛse no dɛ, Damfo, fɛm me paanoo ebiasa:
na me nyɛnko bi nam kwan aba me nkyɛn na minnya hwɛɛ minsi n'enyim;
na ɔnodze, obefi dann mu nooho ebua dɛ, mma nnhaw me: wɔatow abow mu dada na me mba wɔ me nkyɛn wɔ mpa do: Murunntum monnsor memmbɛma wo bi
Mese hom dɛ, kaansa ɔnnkɔsoɛr abɛma no dɛ ɔyɛ ne nyɛnko ntsi a, n'anoɔdzen ntsi ɔbɔsoɛr abɛma no dodow a ohia no.
Na mese hom dɛ, Hom mbisa na wɔbɛma hom; hom nhwehwɛ na hom bohu; hom mbɔ mu na wobobue ama hom;
na obiara a obisa no onya; na nyia ɔhwehwɛ no hu; na nyia ɔbɔ mu no wobobue no.
Na hom mu woana na ɔyɛ egya, na sɛ ne ba bisa no paanoo a, ɔbɛma no ɔbo? Anaa esunam a, ɔdze ɔwɔ bɛyɛ esunam ama no?
Anaadɛ obisa kyirefuwa a, ɔbɛma no nyankoma-ketsebowa?
Na sɛ hom a hom muo yi nyim mbrɛ hom dze akyɛdze pa ma hom mba a, mpɛn ahen ara na hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor no nnkɛfa Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ama hɔn a wobisa no?
Na orutu abɔnsammmum. Na ɔbaa dɛ abɔnsam no fiir edzi no, mmum no kasae; na ɔyɛɛ nyimpadodow no nwanwa.
Na hɔn mu binom see dɛ, ɔnam mbɔnsam panyin Beelzebul do na otu mbɔnsam.
Na binom so sɔɔ no hwɛe bisaa no hɔ asɛnkyerɛdze a ofi sor.
Na ɔnodze onyim hɔn adwen no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ahenman biara nye noho dzi mpaapaamu a, ɔyɛ amamfõ, na ofi a, ɔhwe ase.
Na sɛ Satan so nye noho dzi mpaapaamu a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na n'ahenman egyina? Osiandɛ hom se dɛ menam Beelzebul do tu mbɔnsam.
Na sɛ emi menam Beelzebul do tu mbɔnsam a, woana do na hom mba nam tu atsɛmbuafo.
Na sɛ menam Nyankopɔn nsatseaba do tu mbɔnsam a, nna Nyankopɔn ahenman enya aba hom nkyɛn.
Sɛ ɔkatakyi emia roweɛn n'aban a, n'ahoɔdze wɔ hɔ komm:
na sɛ obi a ɔkyɛn no ahoɔdzen ba no do, na odzi no do nyim a, ɔgye n'akodze a no werɛ twer, na ɔkyɛ n'asadze.
Nyia ɔnnka mo ho no, na ɔnye me enya; nyia ɔnye me mmboaboa ano no, ɔhotse gu.
Na sunsum fī, sɛ ofi nyimpa mu fir a, okekyin wewewdo hwehwɛ ahomgye na onnya bi a, ɔse dɛ, mebɛsan akɔ me fie a mifii mu bae no mu;
na ɔba a, ɔto no dɛ wɔaprapra mu na wɔahyehyɛ mu.
Nna ɔkɔ kɛfa esunsum esuon afofor a womuo sen nankasa ka noho, na wɔbɛhɛn mu tsena hɔ: na nyimpa no n'ekyir asetsenna yɛ bɔn sen nkan no dze.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔrɛkã yinom no, ɔbaa bi a ɔwɔ nyimpadodow no mu maa ne ndze do see no dɛ, nhyira akã yafun a ɔwoo wo, nye numfo a inumii.
Na ɔnodze ɔsee dɛ, ɛhɛɛ: Mbom nhyira akã hɔn a wotsie Nyankpɔn asɛm na wodzi do.
Na nyimpadodow boaboa ano no, ɔhyɛɛ ase kãa dɛ, ɔsantsen yi yɛ ɔsantsen a omuo: Wɔhwehwɛ asɛnkyerɛdze, na wɔremma hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze biara dɛ Jonah n'asenkyerɛdze no.
Na dɛ mbrɛ Jonah wɔyɛɛ no asɛnkyerɛdze maa Ninevehfo no, dɛmara na nyimpa Ba no bɛyɛ ama ɔsantsen yi.
Pomu ɔhembaa nye ɔsantsen yi mbarimba bɔsoɛr wɔ atsɛmbu no mu, na oebu hɔn fɔ: osiandɛ ofi asaase ano noho bae betsiee Solomon ne nyansaa, na hwɛ, nyia ɔsen Solomon wɔ ha.
Nineveh mbarimba nye ɔsantsen yi bɔsoɛr wɔ atsɛmbu no mu, na woebu hɔn fɔ: Osiandɛ wonuu hɔnho wɔ Jonah n'asɛnka ase, na hwɛ, nyia ɔsen Jonah wɔ ha.
Obi nnsɔ kandzea nnsi kukua mu, anaa kuruw ase, na ɔdze si kandzeadua do, ma hɔn a wɔhɛn mu eehu kan no.
Nyimpadua ne kandzea nye w'enyiwa: dɛm ntsi ber a w'enyiwa yɛ kor no, nna wo nyimpadua nyina bɛyɛ kann; na ber a omuo no, nna wo nyimpadua no so yɛ kusuww.
Dɛm ntsi hwɛ ma kan a ɔwɔ wo mu aannyɛ sum.
Na sɛ wo nyimpadua nyina yɛ kann, na beebiara nnyi sum a, ne nyina bɛyɛ kann, dɛ mbrɛ kandzea dze ne gyigye hyɛnhyɛnn ma wo kan no.
Na ɔrekasa no, Phariseenyi bi bebisaa no dɛ ɔnye no nkedzidzi, na ɔkɔr mu kɛtsenaa edzidzi.
Na Phariseenyi no hunii no, ɔyɛɛ no nwanwa dɛ ɔannhohor ne nsa ho ansaana oedzidzi.
Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, Afei hom Phariseefo dze, hom twuw kuraba nye aboyaa ekyir, na hom mu dze, apempensi nye emumuyɛ ahyɛ mã.
Nkwasea, ana nnyɛ nyia ɔyɛɛ ekyir, na ɔyɛɛ mu so?
Na ɔyɛ dɛn ara, hom mfa dza ɔwɔ mu no bi nyɛ ayɛ, na hwɛ, adze nyina ho efir ama hom.
Na hom ndue, hom Phariseefo! Na hom yi emē nye nunum nye fan nyina ho tow du du ma, na hom twa atsɛmbu nye Nyankopɔn dɔ no gya: na yi ɔsɛ dɛ nkyɛ hom yɛ, na hom nndan dza ɔaka no so nngya.
Hom ndue, hom Phariseefo! Na hom pɛ mpanyin ngua wɔ nhyiamudan munye gua do nkyiakyia.
Hom ndue! Na hom tse dɛ nda a ɔnnda edzi, na nyimpa wɔnam do nnhu.
Na mbrakyerɛfo no mu baako buae see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ese dɛm a, nna erotom hɛn so.
Na ɔsee dɛ, hom mbrakyerɛfo so, hom ndue! Na hom soa nyimpa ndzesoadze a no soa yɛ yaw, na homankasa dze, hom mmfa hom nsatseaba kor nnkã ndzesoadze no.
Hom ndue! Na hom tow nkɔhyɛnfo nda do, na hom egyanom kumm hɔn.
Dɛm ntsi hom dzi hom egyanom ndwuma ho dase, na hom so pen do, osiandɛ! Hɔn na wokum hɔn, na hom na hom tow hɔn nda do.
Iyi ntsi na Nyankopɔn ne nyansaa se dɛ, mobɔsoma nkɔnhyɛfo nye Ndwuma wɔ hɔn hɔ, na woboku, na wobehiahia hɔn mu binom ho;
ama nkɔnhyɛfo nyina bɔgyaa a wɔkae gui, ofitsi wiadze ahyɛse no, wɔaahwehwɛ no ɔsantsen yi nsamu:
ofitsi Abel no bɔgyaa do besi Zachariah a ɔtɔr afɔrmbukyia nye asɔrdan ntamu no no bɔgya do, ɛhɛɛ, mese hom dɛ wɔbɔhwehwɛ no ɔsantsen yi nsamu.
Hom mbrakyerɛfo, hom ndue! Na hom afa nyimdzee saafe: homankasa hom annkɔ mu, na hɔn a wɔrokɔ mu no, hom siiw hɔn kwan.
Na ɔrekã yinom kyerɛ hɔn nɔ, kyerɛwfo nye Phariseefo noo hyɛɛ ase hyehyɛɛ no do pii, na wogyigyee no kasa wɔ ndzɛmba pii ho;
na wɔtsɛɛw no hwehwɛɛ n'anomu biribi eesuo mu.
12: Aber no mu ara, nyimpadodow mpempem boaboa ano, ma mpo wotsiatsiaa hɔnho do no, ɔhyɛɛ ase kãa kyerɛɛ n'esuafo no kan dɛ, hom nhwɛ yie wɔ Phariseefo mbɔrkaw ho: Ɔno nye ndabraba.
Na biribi do nnkatae a worinnyi no edzi, na onnhuntae a worunnhu.
Dɛm ntsi biribi a hom akã wɔ sum mu no, wɔbɛtse no wɔ kan mu; na dza hom akã wɔ asomu wɔ adankyir no, wɔbɛpaa mu akã wɔ adan etsifi.
Na mese hom me mfɛnom dɛ, mma hom nnsuro hɔn a woku honam, na n'ekyir no wonnyi biribi a wobotum ayɛ bio.
Na mebɛkyerɛ hom nyia hom nsuro no: Hom nsuro nyia oeku ewie no, ɔwɔ tum dɛ ɔdze kɔto Gehenna: Nyew, mese hom dɛ, ɔno na hom nsuro no.
Ana nsorɔm enum wɔnntɔn nngye mpowa ebien? Naaso hɔn mu kor ara enyi mmpa no do wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na hom tsinhwi mpo wɔakan ne nyina. Mma hom nnsuro: Hom som bo kyɛn nsorɔm pii.
Na mese hom dɛ, Obiara a ɔbɔbɔ me dzin wɔ nyimpa enyim no, ɔno na nyimpa Ba no bɔbɔ ne dzin wɔ Nyankopɔn abɔfoe enyim;
na nyia ɔpa me nyimpa enyim no, ɔno na wɔbɛpa no Nyankopɔn bɔfoe enyim.
Na obiara a ɔbɛkã asɛm etsia nyimpa Ba no, wɔdze bɛkyɛ no; na nyia ɔkã ebususɛm tsia Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no, wɔnnkɛfa akyɛ no.
Na sɛ wɔdze hom ba nhyiamudan mu nye npanyimfo nye etumfo enyim a, mma hom nndwedwen mbrɛ hom bɛyɛ anaa dza hom bɛkã eyi homho, anaa dza hom bɛse:
na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no bɛkyerɛ hom dɔn no ara mu dza ɔse dɛ hom bɛkã.
Na obi fi nyimpadodow no mu see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, kã kyerɛ mo nua ma ɔnye me nkyɛ ewungyadze no.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Nyimpa, woana yɛɛ me ɔsɛndzifo nye adzekyɛfo wɔ hom do?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ yie na hom nsie homho wɔ enyikaber nyina ho: na nyimpa no nkwa nnyi ndzɛnba a oenya abor do mu.
Na obuu hɔn bɛ bi dɛ, Nyimpa bi a ɔyɛ ɔdzefo n'asaase soow pii;
na osusuu ne tsir mu dɛ, Mebɛyɛ dɛn? Osiandɛ minnyi beebi mbrɛ medze mo nduadzdewa besie.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Iyi na mebɛyɛ: Mubodwuruw m'asan egu fam, na mesi akɛse; na hɔ na medze m'ekuadze nye me ndzɛmba nkaa no nyina besie.
Na mase me kra dɛ, ɔkra, ewɔ Ndɛmba pii a wɔdze egu hɔ ama mfe pii: Gye w'ahom, nom, na ma woho ntɔ wo.
Na Nyankopɔn see no dɛ, ɔkwasea, anafua yi wɔbɛgye wo kra wɔ wo nsamu; na dza esiesie no ɔbɛyɛ woana dze?
Mbrɛ nyia ɔboaboa akoradze ano ma noho, na ɔnnyɛ ɔdzefo wɔ Nyankopɔn afamu tse nye no.
Na ɔsee n'esuafo no dɛ, dɛm ntsi mese hom dɛ, Mma hom nndwendwen wɔ hom nkwa ho, dɛ ebɛnadze na hom bedzi, anaaso hom nyimpadua ho, dɛ ebɛnadze na hom bofura.
Nkwa kyɛn edziban, na nyimpadua kyɛn efuradze.
Hom nhwɛ nkonkoran dɛ wonndua na wommbu, wonnyi efiadze anaa ɔsan, naaso Nyankopɔn nyɛn hɛn: Ɔkyɛn bɛn na hom som bo kyɛn nnoma no.
Na hom mu woana na ɔdwendwen a, obotum dze basafa kor ato ne tsentsen do?
Na sɛ hom nntum adze ketseaba dɛm mpo yɛ a, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom dwendwen nkaa noho?
Hom nhwɛ haban mu nsukookoo, mbrɛ wonyin: Wɔnnyɛ edwuma, eso wɔnntow asaaba; naaso mese hom dɛ Solomon n'enyimnyam nyina mu ɔannka noho dɛ yinom mu kor.
Na sɛ Nyankopɔn ma haban mu efuw a ɔwɔ hɔ ndɛ na ɔkyena wɔdze gu fononoo mu efuradze dɛm a, ɔkyɛn bɛn na ɔbɛma hom akyɛn yi, hom a hom gyedzi suar?
Na mma hom nnhwehwɛ dza hom bedzi anaa dza hom bɔnom, eso mma hom adwen nnyɛ hom konsee.
Na dɛm ndzɛmba yi nyina na wiadze amanaman hwehwɛ: na hom Egya nyim dɛ yinom hia hom.
Na mbom hom nhwehwɛ n'ahenman no, na wɔdze yinom bɛka hom ho.
Mma hom nnsuro, oguankuw ketseaba: Na ɔyɛ hom Egya fɛw dɛ ɔdze ahenman no bɛma hom.
Hom ntɔn dza hom wɔ mfa nyɛ ayɛ; hom nyɛ nkotoku a ɔrennyɛ dadaw mma homho, akoradze wɔ sor a ɔnnsa, mbrɛ owifo mmbɛn ho, na kakraka nnsɛɛ no.
Na mbrɛ hom akoradze wɔ, hɔ na hom akoma so wɔ.
Hom mbɔ hom asen do, na hom nkandzea ndzɛw;
na homankasa hom nyɛ dɛ nyimpa a wɔrotweɔn hɔn wura, aber kor a obefi ayefor ase aba, ma sɛ ɔba na ɔbɔbɔ mu a, woeebue no ntsɛmara.
Nhyira akã nkowaa no a, sɛ owura no ba a, ɔbɔto hɔn dɛ wɔreweɔn: Nokwar mese hom dɛ ɔbɔbɔ noho do, na ɔama wɔatsena edzidzi, na ɔaba abɔsom hɔn.
Na sɛ ɔba dasu ebien anaa ebiasa mu, na ɔbɔto hɔn dɛm a, nhyira akã nkowaa no.
Na hom nhu yi, dɛ sɛ ofiwura no nyim dɔn kor a owifo no bɛba a, nkyɛ ɔbɔweɔn na ɔamma woemmbobubu na dan mu enndua mu.
Na hom so hom nyɛ krado, osiandɛ dɔn a hom nnsusu mu na nyimpa Ba no reba.
Na Peter see dɛ, Ewuradze, hɛn nko na ibu hɛn bɛ yi, anaa edze ma obiara so?
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, woana mbɔ nye ofihwɛfo nokwafo nye nyansafo a no wura dze no besi ne fifo do, dɛ ɔmma hɔn edziban a ɔyɛ hɔn kyɛpɛn wɔ ber a ɔsɛ mu?
Nhyira akã akowaa no a, sɛ no wura ba a, obohu no dɛ ɔreyɛ dɛm.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ ɔdze no besi n'adze a ɔwɔ nyina do.
Na sɛ akowaa no se n'akoma mu dɛ, mo wura rikyim ne ba; na ɔhyɛ ase bobɔ nkowaa nye mfonabaa no, na odzidzi na ɔnom ma ɔbow a;
akowaa no wura bɛba da a ɔnnhwɛ no kwan, ɔnyɛ dɔn a onnyim mu, na oetwa no mu ebien, na ɔama ɔnye ndabrabafo no edzi afora.
Na akowaa no a onyim no wura ne pɛ, na oennsiesie noho, na eso ɔannyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ no, wɔbɔhwe no mbaa pii.
Na nyia onnyim, na ɔyɛɛ ndzɛmba a ɔsɛ ɔhwe no, wɔbɔhwe no kakrabaa. Na obiara a wɔama no dodow na wɔbɛgye dodow wɔ no hɔ; nna wobebisa no dza ɔbor do.
Mebae mabɔsoma ogya wɔ asaase do, na sɛ asɔ dada a, mepɛ ebɛn sen dɛm?
Na mowɔ enuma bi a wɔdze bonuma me, na mbrɛ mo ho dua kyer me gyedɛ ayɛ hɔ ana!
Hom susu dɛ mebae mama asomdwee wɔ asaase do anaa? Mese hom dɛ, dabida, na mbom mpaapaamu a:
na ofitsi ndɛ beenum wɔ ofi kor mu bedzi mpaapaamu, baasa nye beenu enya, na beenu nye baasa enya.
Wobedzi mpaapaamu, ma egya nye ba enya, na ɔba nye n'egya enya; nã nye babaa enya, na babaa nye ne nã enya; asew nye n'asew enya, ne asew nye n'asew enya.
Na ɔsee nyimpadodow no so dɛ, Sɛ hom hu nsuwusiw fir anee rosoɛr a, ntsɛmara hom sedɛ, Nsu reba, na ɔba dɛm.
Na sɛ hom hu dɛ pomu mframa robɔ a, hom se dɛ, Ahohur reba, na ɔba mu.
Ndabrabafo, hom nyim asaase nye ɔsor enyim ndzɛmba ho ase kyerɛ; na ɔyɛ dɛn na hom nnhu aber yi ne nkkyerɛase?
Na ɔyɛ dɛn na homankasa so hom mmbua dza ɔtsen ho atsɛn?

Na enye wo tamfo rokɔ otumfo enyim a, enye no wɔ kwan mu no, bɔ mbɔdzen yi woho wɔ ne nsamu; amma ɔaammfa wo annhyɛ ɔsɛndzifo nsa, na ɔsɛndzifo no aammfa wo annhyɛ ɔsomfo no nsa, na, ɔsomfo no aammfa wo annkɔto efiadze.
Mese wo dɛ, Innekefi hɔ gyedɛ etua kɔɔberba a aka ekyir no ana.
13: Na aber no ara mu binom wɔ hɔ a wɔkãa Galileefo a Pilate dze hɔn bɔgyaa foraa hɔn afɔrbɔdze mu no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ no.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Ana hom susu dɛ Galileefo yi osiandɛ wohunu dɛm amandze ntsi, wɔyɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo kyɛn Galileefo nyina?
Mese hom dɛ, dabida: na mbom gyedɛ hom nu homho, ɔno hom nyina bɛhera dɛmara.
Anaaso duawɔtwe a Siloam abantsentsen hwee hɔn do kum hɔn no, hom susu dɛ wɔyɛ mbratofo kyɛn hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalem nyina?
Mese hom dɛ, dabida: na mbom gydɛ hom nu homho, ɔno hom nyina bɛhera dɛmara.
Na obuu bɛ yi so: Obi wɔ adɔmbadua a wɔtsɛɛw no wɔ no wenyin ture mu, na ɔbae bɔhwehwɛɛ aba wɔ do, na oennya bi.
Na ɔsee turehwɛfo no dɛ, hwɛ, mfe ebiasa nye yi a maba mabɔhwehwɛ adɔmbadua yi do aba, na minnya bi: twa no kyen; ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔkantan asaase no do so?
Na obuae see no dɛ, mo wura, ma onsi hɔ afe yi so nkodu dɛ mubofuntum ho, na megu ase efikyir:
na sɛ bi a ɔbɔsow aba a, oye; na sɛ ɔannsow a, nkyii etwa no akyen.
Na ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ nhyiamudan kor bi mu ahomgyeda.
Na hwɛ, ɔbaa bi wɔ hɔ a ɔwɔ ahoɔmberɛw sunsum mfe duawɔtwe, na ɔapon, na onntum nntsen no mu koraa.
Na Jesus hun no no, ɔfrɛɛ no see no dɛ, ɔbaa, wɔasan wo efi w'ahoɔmberɛw mu.
Na ɔdze ne nsa too no do, na ntsɛmara ɔtsenee, na ɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.

Na nhyiamudan mu panyim no, ɔyɛɛ no ebufuw dɛ Jesus asa yarba wɔ ahomgyeda mu no, obuae see nyimpadodow no dɛ, nda esia wɔ hɔ a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔbɛyɛ edwuma: No mu na hom mbra ma wɔnsa hom yarba, na nnyɛ ahomgyeda no mu a.
Na Ewuradze buae see no dɛ, Ndabrabafo, ana hom mu biara nnsan ne nantwi, anaa n'asoaso mmfi ban mu mmfa no nnkɔ esunomee ahomgyeda?
Na ɔnnsɛ dɛ ɔbaa yi a ɔyɛ Abraham babaa a Satan akyer no, hwɛ, mfe dwuawɔtwe yi, wɔsan no fi kyer yi mu ahomgyeda anaa?
Na ɔkãa dɛm no, hɔn a wotsiaa no no nyina enyi tõe, na nyimpadodow no nyinaa dzi dɛw wɔ dzɛmba a ɔyɛe no nyina ho.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn ahenman no tse dɛ ebɛnadze na medze mobɔto ho?
ɔtse dɛ sinape abafua a nyimpa fae kɔtoo no ture mu; na onyinii yɛɛ dua kɛse, na wimu nnoma bɛgyegyee n'abaw do.
Na ɔkãa bio dɛ, ebɛnadze na medze Nyankopɔn ahenman no mobɔto ho?
ɔtse dɛ mbɔrkaw a ɔbaa fae sumaa mbɔr korbaa ebiasa mu dze kesii dɛ ne nyina kawee.
Na okoduaduaa nkurow nye nkuroba mu kyerɛkyerɛe, na ɔnam do rokɔ Jerusalem.
Na obi see no dɛ, Ewuradze, ana kumaabi na wɔbɛgye hɔn nkwa? Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ,
Hom mper nhɛn abow tseaba no mu; na mese hom dɛ, dodowara bɔhwehwɛ mu ahɛn na wonnkotum.
Sɛ prɛko ara ofiwura no soɛr, na ɔtow abow no mu, na hom hyɛ ase begyina ekyir, na hom bɔ abow no mu se dɛ, Ewuradze, Ewuradze, bue hɛn a, ɔbɔbua ase hom dɛ, minnyim mbrɛ hom fir;
ɔno na hom bɛhyɛ ase akã dɛ, yeedzidzi yɛanom wɔ w'enyim, na akyerɛkyerɛ wɔ hɛn abrɔn mu pɛn;
na ɔbɛkã sɛ, mese hom dɛ, minnyim hom mbrɛ hom fir: hom mfi mo do, hom emumuyɛfo nyina.
Hɔ na osū nye asetwɛr bɛba, dɛ hom bohu Abraham nye Isaac nye Jacob, nye nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara wɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman mu, na homankasa dze, wɔatam hom efi mu.
na wofi boka nye anee nye pomu nye habanmu bɛba abɛtsena ase wɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman mu.
Na hwɛ, ekyidzifo bi wɔ hɔ a wobedzi kan, na edzikamfo bi wɔ hɔ a wobedzi ekyir.
Na dɔn kor no ara Phariseefo bi bae bɛsee no dɛ, fi ha kɔ, na Herod pɛ wo eeku wo.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɛse ɔsɔ no dɛ, hwɛ mutu mbɔnsam na mesa yarba ndɛ nye ɔkyena, na dza otsīa ebiasa no mewie.
Naaso ɔsɛ me dɛ mutu kwan ndɛ nye ɔkyena, nye dza ɔtoa do no: na ɔnnkɛyɛ dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi bɔkɔtɔ beebi gyedɛ Jerusalem.
Ao! Jerusalem, ɔwo a iku nkɔnhyɛfo no, na isiw hɔn a wɔasoma hɔn wo nkyɛn abo mpɛn ahen na mepɛɛ dɛ moboaboa wo mba ano, dɛ mbrɛ akokɔtan boaboa ne mba ano wɔ ne ntsaban ase, na hom ammpɛ!
Hwɛ, woegyaa wo fi efituo ama hom. Na mese hom dɛ, hom runnhu me gyedɛ da a ɔbɛba dɛ hom bɛse dɛ, nhyira nye nyia ɔnam Ewuradze ne dzin mu reba.
14: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔkɔr Phariseefo panyin bi fie ahomgyeda ekedzidzi, na wɔtsɛɛw no.
Na hwɛ, nyimpa bi wɔ n'enyim hɔ a ɔyar ahohon.
Na Jesus buae na ɔkãa kyerɛ mbrakyerɛfo nye Phariseefo no dɛ, Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ wɔsa yarba ahomgyeda anaa oho?
Na wɔyɛɛ kom. Na ɔfaa no saa no yarba, na ɔmaa ɔkɔree.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, hom mu woana, na n'asoaso anaa ne nantwi kɔtɔ bura mu a, ɔnnkɔtwe no ntsɛmara ahomgyeda?
Na woenntum emmbua no yinom ho bi bio.
Na ɔbɔɔ hɔn a wohyiaa hɔn edzidzi no nyikam mbrɛ wodua hwehwɛ mpanyin tsenabea no, obuu bɛ kãa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ,
Sɛ obi hyia wo ayefor ase a, mma nnkɛtsena mpanyin tsenabea; bi a oehyia obi a ɔyɛ nyimnyamfosen wo,
na nyia ohyiaa wo nye ɔno no ba a, ɔbɛse wo dɛ, ma oyi kwan, na edze enyiwu ahyɛ ase akɛfa ase tsenabea.
Na sɛ wohyia wo a, kɔ kɛtsena ase tsenabea, ma nyia ohyia wo no ba a, ɔaase wo dɛ, Awɛ, pin kɔ sor noho; nna ibenya enyidzi wɔ hɔn a wɔnye wo tse edzidzi no enyim.
Na obiara a ɔbɛma noho do no, wɔbɛbrɛ no adze; na obiara a ɔbɛbrɛ noho adze no, wɔbɛma no do.
Nna ɔsee nyia ohyiaa no no so dɛ, Sɛ eto pon ewia anaa anago a, mma mmfrɛ w'asɛfo, anaa wo nuanom, anaa w'ebusuafo, anaadɛ wo sɔnmufo ahonyafo: bɛyɛ na hɔn so ebehyia wo bi, ma enya akatua.
Na sɛ eto pon a, frɛ ehiafo, nye epirafo, nye mpakye, nye enyifurafo:
na ibenya nhyira, osiandɛ wonnyi dza wɔdze botua wo kaw; na atseneneefo wunyan no mu nna wobotua wo kaw.
Na hɔn a wɔnye no tse edzidzi no mu baako tsee dɛm no, ɔsee no dɛ, nhyira aka nyia obedzidzi wɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Nyimpa bi too pon kɛse, na ohyiaa nyimpa pii;
na edzidzi durii no, ɔsomaa n'akowaa dɛ ɔnkɛse hɔn a wohyiaa hɔn dɛ, Hom mbra, na ndɛmba nyina ayɛ krado.
Na hɔn nyina nam adwen kor do hyɛɛ ase yiyii ano. Nyia odzi kan no see dɛ, matɔ asaase bi, na ohia dɛ mokɔhwɛ: Meserɛ wo ma me kwan.
Na ɔbaako so see dɛ, matɔ anantwi mpamho enum, na morokɔsɔ hɔn ahwɛ: Meserɛ wo ma me kwan.
Na ɔbaako so see dɛ, Mawar yer na dɛm ntsi murunntum ba.

Na akowaa no bae bɛkãa yinom kyerɛɛ no wura. Nna ofiwura no no bo fuwii na ɔsee n'akowaa no dɛ, fir edzi ntsɛm kɔ kurow mu abɔntsen nye nsaaba mu, na kɛfa ehiafo nye epirafo nye enyifurafo nye mpakye bra ha.
Na akowaa no see dɛ, mo wura, ayɛ dɛ mbrɛ ehyɛe naaso ɔkwan da ho wɔ hɔ.
Na owura no kãa kyerɛɛ n'akowaa no dɛ, fir edzi kɔ akwantsen nye ban mu, na kɛhyɛ hɔn ma wɔmbra, ma me dan nyɛ mã.
Na mese hom dɛ, nyimpa no a wohyiaa hɔn no mu biara rennka m'edziban nnhwɛ.
Na nyimpadodow pii nye no kɔree: Na ɔdan noho kãa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ,
Sɛ obiara ba mo hɔ, na onnkyir n'egya nye ne nã, nye ne yer, nye ne mba, nye no nuanom, nye ne nkyerɛbaa, nye nankasa no nkwa.
Na obiara a ɔnnsoa ne mbeamudua na onndzi m'ekyir no, orunntum ayɛ suanyi.
Na hom mu woana, na ɔpɛ dɛ ɔtow abantsentsen, na ɔnndzi kan nntsena ase, na ommbu ho nkontaa, dɛ ɔwɔ dza ɔdze botum ewie anaa?
Bɛyɛ na oenya ato fapɛm no, na oenntum ennwie a, hɔn a wohu nyia ahyɛ ase esi no atwetwe dɛ,
Nyimpa yi hyɛɛ ase dɛ orisi, na oenntum ennwie.
Anaaso ɔhen bɛn na ɔrokɔ dɛ ɔnye ɔhen bi rokɔkõ a, onndzi kan nntsena ase na ɔmmfa apam dɛ obotum dze ɔpedu ekehyia nyia ɔdze ɔpenduonu reba no do anaa?
Annyɛ dɛm a, ɔbaako no da ho wɔ ekyirkyir no, otu abɔfo ma wɔkɛserɛ nsiesie.
Dɛmara so na hom mu biara a ɔnnkɔpow dza ɔwɔ nyina, orunntum nnyɛ mo suayi.
Nkyen dze, oye; na sɛ nkyen no mpo ayew ne dɛw a, wɔdze ebɛnadze bɔto mu?
ɔnnsɛ asaase anaa suminado, na wɔtow gu. Nyia ɔwɔ aso a ɔdze tsie, ma ontsie.
15: Na atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo nyina twee piin no dɛ woribetsie no.
Na Phariseefo nye mbrakyerɛfo no so hwinhwiin, oyi ɔgye ndzebɔyɛfo na ɔnye hɔn dzidzi.
Na obuu hɔn bɛ yi dɛ,
Hom mu nyimpa bɛn na sɛ ɔwɔ nguantsen ɔha, na hɔn mu kor kɛyew a, onnkegyaa eduokron akron no wɔ sar do, na Onnka dza ayew no do nnkodu dɛ obohu no?
Na sɛ ohu no a, ɔdze no to ne batsir do, na odzi dɛw.
Na sɛ ɔba fie a, ɔfrɛfrɛ n'asɛfo nye no sɔnmufo boa ano, na ɔse hɔn dɛ, hom nye me ndzi dɛw, na mehu mo guan a ɔyewee no.
Mese hom dɛ, dɛmara na dɛw bɛba ɔsor wɔ ɔdzendɔnyɛnyi baako a onu noho, sen atseneneefo eduokron akron a wonnhia nnuho.
Anaaso ɔbaa bɛn na ɔwɔ ndwetɛbona du na sɛ no mu kor yew a, ɔronnsɔ kandzea, na ɔmmpra dan mu, na ɔnnhwehwɛ yie ara nnkodu dɛ obohu?
Na sɛ ohu a, ɔfrɛfrɛ n'asɛfo nye no sɔnmufo boa ano se dɛ, Hom nye me ndzi dɛw, na mehu dwetɛbona a ɔyewee no.
Mese hom dɛ, dɛmara na dɛw ba Nyankopɔn abɔfoe enyim wɔ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi baako a onu noho.
Na ɔsee dɛ, nyimpa bi wɔ mbabanyin beenu:
na hɔn mu ekumaba see n'egya dɛ, Egya, fa w'ahodze mu kyɛpɛn a ɔbɛyɛ medze no ma me. Na ɔkyɛɛ n'asetsena mu maa hɔn.
Na endzi da biara na ɔba kumaba no boaboaa ne nyina ano, na ɔdɔɔ mu kɔr asaase bi do ekyirkyir; na hɔ na ɔkɔbɔɔ asakasakabra sɛɛ n'ahodze nyia.
Na owiee ne nyina hwer no, ɔkɔm kɛse bi baa asaase no do, na ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii hia.
Na ɔkɔree dze noho kɔbɔɔ asaase no do nkorɔfo no mu bi ho; na ɔsomaa no ma ɔkɔr ne hamu kɛnyɛɛn mprɛko.
Na no kɔn dɔɔ dɛ ɔdze asɛdua-hon a mprɛko dzii no bi hyɛɛ ne yafun mã; na obiara amma no.
Na n'enyi baa noho do no, ɔkãa dɛ, Apaafo ahen na m'egya wɔ a wɔwɔ edziban ma ɔbor do, na emi ɔkɔm ruku me yi?
Mobɔsoɛr, na makɔ m'egya nkyɛn, na mase no cdɛ, Egya, mayɛ bɔn etsia ɔsor nye w'enyim,
na memmfata dɛ wɔfrɛ me wo ba bio: na yɛ me dɛ w'apaafo no mu baako.
Na ɔsoɛree baa n'egya nkyɛn. Na ɔda ho wɔ ekyirkyir no, n'egya hun no, na ne yamu hyehyee no, na otuu mbirika kɛbaar no kɔn, na ofeew n'ano.
Na ɔba no see no dɛ, Egya, mayɛ bɔn etsia ɔsor nye w'enyim, na memmfata dɛ wɔfrɛ me wo ba bio.
Na n'egya no see no nkowaa dɛ, hom nyɛ ntsɛm mfa atar pa no mbra mbɛhyɛ no, na hom mfa pɛtsea nhyɛ ne nsa, nye nsokota nhyɛ ne nan;
na hom mfa nantwiba a ɔadɔ seradze no mbra mboku no, na yendzi, na hɛn ho ntɔ hɛn.
Na me babanyin yi owui, na oenyan bio; ɔyewee, na woehu no. Na wɔhyɛɛ ase maa hɔnho tɔɔ hɔn.
Na na ba panyin no wɔ hamu: Na ɔreba na opinkyɛɛn fie no, ɔtsee asanku nye asaw.
Na ɔfrɛɛ nkowaa no baako bisaa no wɔ ho dɛ iyi n'ase nye dɛn.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, wo nua aba, na w'egya eku nantwiba a ɔadɔ seradze no, osiandɛ ne nsa aka no nkwahosan mu.
Na bo fuwii, na ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔkɔ fie; na n'egya fiir edzi bɔtotɔe serɛɛ no.
Na ɔnodze obuae see n'egya dɛ, hwɛ, mfe pii yi na masom wo, eso mommfoom wo mbra do da; naaso emidze, emmaa me apɔnkyeba dɛ menye m'asɛfo mfa mma hɛnho ntɔ hɛn da;
na wo ba yi a ɔnye ndwaman edzi w'ahodze yi bae no dze, eku nantwi a ɔadɔ seradze no ama no.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, ɔba, ɔwo wɔ me nkyɛn daa, na dza mowɔ nyina yɛ wodze.
Na ɔsee dɛ hɛn ho tɔ hɛn, na yedzi dɛw: na wo nua yi, owui, na ɔtse ase bio: Ɔyewee, na woehu no.
16: Na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ esuafo no so dɛ, ɔhonyanyi bi wɔ hɔ a ɔwɔ ofihwɛfo bi, na wɔtõaa no maa no dɛ ɔresɛɛ n'adze.
Na ɔfrɛɛ no see no dɛ, ebɛnadze nye yi a metse no wɔ wo ho yi? Bobu wo fi hwɛ ho akontaa, na innyi ho kwan dɛ idzi fihwɛfo bio.
na ofihwɛfo no kãe wɔ no mu dɛ, mebɛyɛ dɛn? Mo wura rebɛgye ahwɛ-edwuma no wɔ me nsamu. Minnyi ahoɔdzen dɛ mubotutu; ehūa so yɛ me fɛr.
Mehu dza mebɛyɛ, ma woyi me ofihwɛ-edwuma do a, wɔaagye me akɔ hɔn efiefi.
nna ɔfrɛɛ no wura n'akafo nyina baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee nyia odzi kan dɛ, Edze mo wura dɛn?
Na ɔsee dɛ, ngo etwadze ɔha. Na ɔsee no dɛ, fa wo nwoma na tsena ase ntsɛm kyerɛw eduonum.
nna ɔsee baako so dɛ, wo so dze ahen? Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewifua etwadze ɔha. Ɔsee no dɛ, fa wo nwoma na kyerɛw eduowɔtwe.
Na owura no yii ofihwɛfo sisifo no ayɛw, dɛ ɔayɛ no nyansa mu: Na wiadze yi mba nye hɔnankasa hɔn santsen dzi no nyansa mu kyɛn kan mba.
Na mese hom dɛ, hom mfa mammon a ɔnntsen no bi nyɛ nyɛnko; na sɛ ohia hom a wɔaaye hom akɔ onnyiewiei ntamadan no mu.
Nyia odzi nokwar wɔ adze ketseaba mu no, odzi nokwar wɔ pii mu; na nyia ɔnntsen wɔ adze ketseaba mu no, ɔnntsen wɔ pii mu.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ hom enndzi nokwar wɔ mammon a ɔnntsen no mu a, woana dze dza ɔyɛ tsenene no bɛhyɛ hom nsa?
Na sɛ hom enndzi nokwar wɔ obi mu a, woana dze homankasa homdze bɛma hom?
ɔfienyimpa biara nntum nnsom wuranom beenu: Na obekyir kor no na ɔadɔ kor no, anaadɛ obosuo kor no mu na Oebu kor no enyimtsia. Hom runntum nnsom Nyankopɔn nye mammon.
Na Phariseefo no a wɔyɛ sikapɛfo tsee yinom nyina no, wosii no atwetwe.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nye hɔn a wobu hɔnho bem wɔ nyimpa enyim, na Nyankopɔn dze onyim hom akoma mu, na dza wohuhor no wɔ nyimpa mu no yɛ ekyiwadze wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Mbra no nye nkɔnhyɛfo no bɛpeem John do; na ofitsi no do Nyankopɔn ahenman ho asɛmpa wɔkã, na obiara nam enyiber do kɔ mu.
Na ɔyɛ mberɛw dɛ sor nye asaase botwa mu sen dɛ mbra no ne nsensanee bɔtɔ.
Obiara a ɔbɔkõ ne yer na ɔawar fofor ɔtõ awar; na obiara a ɔbɔwar nyia no kun akõ no no, ɔtõ awar.
Na obirɛmpɔn bi wɔ hɔ a ɔhyɛ atar memen nye ndwera pa, na ɔtsena enyigye nye afɛɛfɛdze mu daa.
Na ohianyi bi wɔ hɔ a ne dzin dze Lazarus a wɔdze no bɔtoo n'abowano a oetutu ekur,
na no kɔn dɔɔ dɛ odzi dza ofi obirɛmpɔn no no pon do gu famu mee; na mbɔdɔm bae bɛtafeer n'ekur mu mpo.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ohianyi no wui, na abɔfo bɔsoaa no kɔr Abraham no bo mu; na obirɛmpɔn no so wui na wosiee no.
Na samanadze na ɔmaa n'enyi do, na ɔwɔ amandzehu mu, na ohun Abraham wɔ ekyirkyir, na Lazarus wɔ no bo mu.
Na ɔtsēaa mu see dɛ, Egya Abraham, hu me mbɔbɔr, na soma Lazarus ma ɔmfa ne nsatseaba ano mbɔ nsu mu, na ɔmfa mbɔdwedwe me tɛkyerɛma: na muruhu ahoguan wɔ gyaframee yi mu.
Na Abraham see dɛ, ɔba, kaa dɛ wo nkwaber mu inyaa wo ndzepa, dɛmara Lazarus so nyaa ne ndzebɔn; na afei na werɛ akyekyer, na wo so ruhu ahoguan.
Na yinom nyina ekyir, ɔkã kɛse da yɛnye hom atamu, ma hɔn a wɔpɛ dɛ wofi ha tra ba hom nkyɛn nntum, na eso wonntum mmfi noho nntra mmba hɛn nkyɛn.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ɔnodze, egya, meserɛ wo, soma no wɔ m'egya fie,
na mowɔ nuanom beenum, ma onkedzi hɔn dase mma hɔn so aammba amandzehubea yi mu bi.
Na Abraham see dɛ, wɔwɔ Moses nye nkɔnhyɛfo no: ma wontsie hɔn.
Na ɔsee dɛ, oho, egya Abraham, na sɛ obi fi ewufo mu kɔ hɔn nkyɛn a, nna wobonu hɔnho.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, sɛ woenntsie Moses nye nkɔnhyɛfo no a, obi fi ewufo mu soɛr so a wɔrenngye nndzi.
17: Na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ n'esuafo no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ara a fintsiduato bɛba: Na nyia ɔnam no do ba no ndue!
Oye ma no dɛ wɔdze ewuyambo sɛn no kɔn mu, na wɔdze no kɔto po mu, kyɛn dɛ ɔbɔto nkakraba yi mu baako fintsidua.
Hom nhwɛ homho yie: Sɛ wo nua fom wo a, ka n'enyim; na sɛ onu noho a, fa kyɛ no.
Na sɛ ɔfom wo mpɛn esuon da kor, na sɛ ɔsan ba wo hɔ mpɛn esoun da kor se dɛ, menu moho a, fa kyɛ no.
na Ndwuma no see Ewuradze dɛ, to hɛn gyedzi mu.
na Ewuradze see dɛ, sɛ hom wɔ gyedzi a ɔtse dɛ sinape abafua a, nkyɛ hom bɛse sycamine-dua yi dɛ, wo ndwow ase ntutu, na kɛtsɛw po mu, na nkyɛ obetsie hom.
Na hom mu woana na ɔwɔ akowaa a ofuntum daadze, anaa ɔhwɛ nguantsen, na sɛ ofi hamu ba fie a, ɔbɛse no dɛ, bra ntsɛm bɛtsena edzidzi;
na mbom ɔrennse no dɛ, Siesie dza mibedzi na bɔ woho do bɔsom me, na mindzidzi na monnom ana, na ekyirii wo so edzidzi na anom?
Ana ɔbɛda akowaa no ase dɛ ɔayɛ dza wɔhyɛɛ no no?
Dɛmara na hom so sɛ hom wie dza wɔahyɛ hom nyina yɛ a, hom nse dɛ, yɛyɛ nkowaa a mfaso nnyi hɛn ho: Yɛayɛ dza ɔsɛ dɛ yɛyɛ.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔrokɔ Jerusalem no, orutwa mu wɔ Samaria nye Galilee ntoaado.
Na ɔrekɛhɛn kurow bi mu no, mbarimba du a wɔyɛ akwatafo hyiaa no a wogyinagyinaa ekyir;
na wɔmaa hɔn ndze do see dɛ, Yewura Jesus, hu hɛn mbɔbɔr.
Na ohun hɔn no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nkɔ mfa homho nkɛkyerɛ asɔfo no. Na ɔbaa dɛ wɔrokɔ no, hɔn ho sanee.
Na hɔn mu baako hun dɛ no ho asan no, ɔsaan n'ekyir dze ndze kɛse hyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam,
na ɔdze n'enyim butuu famu wɔ n'ananadze daa no ase: Na ɔno yɛ samarianyi.
Na Jesus buae see dɛ, Ana nnyɛ du na hɔn ho sanee? Na baakron no dze wɔ hen?
woennhu obiara a ɔsanee dze enyimnyam brɛɛ nyankopɔn, dɛ ɔhɔho yi nko?
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Soɛr kɔ: Wo gyedzi agye wo.
Na Phariseefo bisaa no dɛ aber bɛn na Nyankopɔn ahenman bɛba no, obuaa hɔn see dɛ, Nyankopɔn ahenman ɔmmba dɛ enyi tuae,
na eso wɔrennse dɛ, hwɛ ha, anaa, hwɛ hɔ: na hwɛ, Nyankopɔn ahenman wɔ hom mu.
Na ɔsee n'esuafo no dɛ, nda bi bɛba a hom bɛpɛ nyimpa Ba ne nda no mu kor ahwɛ, na hom nnkohu.
Na wɔbɛse hom dɛ, hwɛ ha, anaa, hwɛ hɔ no, mma hom nnkɔ, eso mma hom nndzi hɔn ekyir.
Na dɛ mbrɛ enyinam nyinam fi sor ase fã a ɔhyerɛn kɔ sor ase fã beebi no, dɛmara na nyimpa Ba no bɛyɛ wɔ ne da no mu.
Na otwar dɛ obohu amandze pii, na ɔsantsen yi apow no ana.
Na dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛe wɔ Noah nda no mu no, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ wɔ nyimpa Ba no ne nda mu ara nye no.
Na wodzidzii, wɔnomee, wɔwaree, wɔmaa awar dze kodur da a Noah kɔr hɛnadaka no mu, na nsuyirii no bae bɛsɛɛ hɔn nyina.
Dɛmara na ɔyɛe wɔ Lot nda no mu: Wodzidzii, wɔnomee, wɔtɔe, wɔtɔnee, woduae, wɔtowee;
na da ara a Lot fiir Sodom firii no, nna ogya nye brimstone fi sor tɔree bɛsɛɛ hɔn nyina;
dɛmara so na ɔbɛyɛ wɔ da a nyimpa Ba no wobeyi no edzi.
Da no, nyia ɔwɔ dan etsifi na n'adze wɔ mu no, mma onnsian mmbɛfa; na nyia ɔwɔ haban mu no so, mma ɔnnsan n'ekyir.
Hom nkaa Lot ne yer no.
Obiara a ɔbɔhwehwɛ dɛ ɔgye no nkwa ayɛ nedze no, ɔbɛyew no; na obiara a ɔbɛyew no nkwa no, obɛgye no.
Mese hom dɛ, anago no mbarimba beenu bɛda mpa kor do, na wɔbɛfa baako ne woegya baako.
Mbaa beenu bɔbɔ mu ayam ewu, na wɔbɛfa baako na woegya baako.
Mbarimba beenu bɔkɔ hamu, wɔbɛfa baako na woegya baako.
na wobuae see no dɛ, Hen a, Ewuradze? Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ fun wɔ no, hɔ na nkɔr bɔboaboa hɔn ano.
18: Na obuu hɔn bɛ bi dze kyerɛɛ dɛ otwar dɛ nyimpa yi mpaa daa, na wɔnntɔ bahaw,
dɛ, ɔtsɛmbuafo bi wɔ kurow bi mu a onnsuro Nyankopɔn, eso ɔmmfɛr nyimpa;
na okunafo bi wɔ kurow bi mua; na ɔdze ne nkyɛn mbae ara bɛsee dɛ, dzi m'asɛm gye me wɔ me tamfo nsamu.
Na ɔammpen ma ɔkyɛr kakra; na n'ekyir no ɔkãe wɔ no mu dɛ, munnsuro Nyankopɔn eso memmfɛr nyimpa dze,
naaso osiandɛ okunafo yi rehaw me ntsi, mibedzi n'asɛm ama no, mma ɔaammfa ne ba a ɔba daa amma mo ho ennguan me.
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, hom ntsie dza ɔtsɛmbuafo a ɔnntsen yi se yi;
na Nyankopɔn nnkedzi ama ne mpamufo a wosū frɛ no adzekyee nye adzesaa, sɛ ɔyɛ abotar ma ɔkyɛr hɔn asɛm ho mpo a?
Mese hon dɛ, obedzi asɛm agye hɔn ntsɛm. Naaso sɛ nyimpa Ba no ba a, obohu gyedzi wɔ asaase do anaa?
Na obuu binom a wɔdze hɔnho twer hɔnho dɛ wɔtsen, na wommbu nkaa no bi bɛ yi dɛ,
Nyimpa beenu kɔr asɔrfi mu dɛ wɔrokɔsɔr; ɔbaako yɛ Phariseenyi, ɔbaako yɛ towgyenyi.
Phariseenyi no gyinae sɔree wɔ no mu dɛ, Nyankopɔn, meda wo ase dɛ menntse dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa nkaa no tse, apempensifo, nkontompɔfo, nyefafo, anaa dɛ towgyenyi yi mpo.
Midzi mbuada mpɛn ebien wɔ dapɛn mu; miyi dza mowɔ nyina do du du mema.
Na towgyenyi no gyinaa ekyirkyir, ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔma n'enyiwa do kyerɛ sor mpo, na ɔbɔɔ no koko do see dɛ, Nyankopɔn, hu emi dzebɔnyɛnyi mbɔbɔr.
Mese hom dɛ, oyi dze bem saan ne fie mbom, kyɛɛn ɔbaako no: na obiara a ɔbɛma noho do no, wɔbɛbrɛ no adze; na obiara a ɔbɛbrɛ noho adze no, wɔbɛma no do.
Na wɔdze hɔn mbɔtowaba so brɛɛ no dɛ ɔmfa ne nsa nkã hɔn; na esuafo no hunii no, wotwuuw hɔn enyim.
Na Jesus frɛɛ hɔn baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, hom mma mbofraba no kwan ma wɔmbra me nkyɛn, na woyi dɛm na Nyankopɔn ahenman no yɛ hɔndze.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Obiara a ɔnnkɛgye Nyankopɔn ahenman no dɛ abofraba no, ɔnnkɔkɔ mu da.
Na ɔpanyin bi bisaa no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo pa, ebɛnadze na menyɛ ma meenya onnyiewiei nkwa ayɛ medze?
Na Jesus see no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na efrɛ me papa? Obiara nnyɛ papa gyedɛ baako: Ɔno nye Nyankopɔn.
Inyim mbransɛm no, mma nndzi ewu, mma nntõ awar, mma nnwia adze, mma nngye dasewia, Dzi w'egya nye wo nã nyi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Yinomnyinara mifitsi me mbafobermu na midzi do.

Na Jesus tsee dɛm no, ɔsee no dɛ, ɔda ho ka wo adze kor: Kɔtɔn dza ewɔ nyinara, na kyɛ ma ehiafo, na ibenya akoradze wɔ sor, na bra bɛka mo do 23.Na ɔtsee yi no ɔyɛɛ no awerɛhow dɛ, na ɔyɛ ɔhonyanyi papa.
Na Jesus hun no no, ɔsee dɛ, ebɛn dzen na ɔyɛ ma hɔn a wɔwɔ ahonya dɛ wɔbɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n'ahenman mu!
na ɔyɛ mberɛw ma efupɔnkɔ dɛ obodua doroba enyim mu kyɛn dɛ, ɔhonyanyi bɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n'ahenman mu.
Na hɔn a wɔtsee no kaa dɛ, woana mbɔ na wobotum agye no nkwa?
Na ɔsee dɛ, dza nyimpa nntum nnyɛ no, ɔnnsõ Nyankopɔn yɛ.
Na Peter see dɛ, hwɛ, yeegyaa hɛn ndzɛmba nyina na yɛabɛka wo do.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, obi nnyi hɔ a oegyaa fi anaa yer anaa enuanom anaa awofo anaa mba wɔ Nyankopɔn n'ahenman ntsi,
na onnkenya ho mbɔho pii wɔ ber yi mu, na wiadze a ɔreba no mu, onnyiewiei nkwa.
Na ɔfaa duebien no na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hwɛ, yɛrokɔ Jerusalem, na ndzɛmba a nkɔnhyɛfo no akyerɛw no nyimpa Ba no ho nyina bɛba mu.
Na wobeyi no ama amanamamfo, na wobesi no atwetwe, na wɔabɔ no adapaa, na wɔatoto ntafi egu no do;
na wɔakã no mpire, na woeku no; na da a otsīa ebiasa no ɔbɔsoɛr bio.
Na hɔndze wɔanntse yinom biara ase, na asɛm yi huntaa hɔn, na woennhu dza ɔrekã no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔbɛɛn Jericho no, onyifurafo bi tse kwan nkyɛn reserɛserɛ adze;
na ɔtsee dɛ nyimpadodow rutwa mu no, obisaa dɛ iyi ase nye dɛn.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ Jesus Nazarethnyi no na ɔresen .
Na ɔkaa mu see dɛ, Jesus, David ba, hu me mbɔbɔr.
Na hɔn a wodzi kan no braa no dɛ ɔnka n'ano nto mu; na ɔnodze mbom ɔtsēaa mu pii dɛ, David ba, hu me mbɔbɔr.
Na Jesus gyinae, na ɔkãa dɛ wɔmfa no mbra ne nkyɛn; na ɔbɛnee no, bisaa no dɛ,
Ebɛnadze na epɛ dɛ meyɛ mema wo? Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, nkyɛ meehu adze.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Hu adze: wo gyedzi agye wo.
Na amonmu hɔ ara ohun adze, na ɔkaa no do, dze enyimnyam maa Nyankopɔn; na nkorɔfo no nyina hunii no, wɔdze ayɛyi maa Nyankopɔn.
19: Na ɔkɛhɛɛn Jericho rutwa mu wɔ hɔ.
Na hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no Zacchæus a ɔyɛ towgyenyi panyin, na ɔyɛ ɔhonyanyi.
Na ɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ ohu Jesus ne nyimpa ban; na nyimpadodow no ntsi onntum, osiadɛ ɔyɛ akɔtsia.
Na otutuu mbirika dzii kan kɔfoow sycamore-dua dɛ ɔrokɔhwɛ no, na hɔ na ɔrebɛfa.
Na Jesus dur hɔ no, ɔhwɛɛ sor, na ɔsee no dɛ, Zacchæus, yɛ ntsɛm si famu, na ndɛ ɔsɛ dɛ metsena wo fie.
Na ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm sii famu, na ɔdze dɛw bɛgyee no.
Na wohunii no, hɔn nyina hwinhwiin dɛ, ɔkɔ akɔsoɛ nyimpa a ɔyɛ dzebɔnyɛnyi.
Na Zacchæus gyinae, na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ Ewuradze dɛ, hwɛ, Ewuradze, medze m'ahodze fã mekyɛ ehiafo; na sɛ menam ndabraba do magye obi ne biribi a, mobɔ ho mpɛn anan mutua kaw.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, ndɛ na nkwagye aba ofi yi mu, susuampa dɛ no so yɛ Abraham ba bi no.
Na nyimpa Ba no baa dɛ ɔrobɔhwehwɛɛ na ɔabɛgyɛ dza ɔayew no.
Na woritsie yinom no, ɔtoaa do buu bɛ yi, osiandɛ ɔabɛn Jerusalem na wosusuu dɛ amonmu hɔ ara na Nyankopɔn n'ahenman no ribeyi noho edzi.
Dɛm ntsi ɔsee dɛ, ɔdehye bi kɔr asaase bi do ekyirkyir dɛ ɔrekɛgye ahendzi, na ɔasan aba.
Na ɔfrɛɛ no nkowaa du, na ɔdze mpireguan du maa hɔn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mfa ndzi gua nkodu dɛ mebɛba.
Na ne mamfo no kyiir no, na wotuu abɔfo kaa no do kɛsee dɛ, yɛmmpɛ dɛ oyi dzi hɛn do hen.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ne nsa kaa ahendzi no, na ɔsanee bae no, ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfrɛ nkowaa no a ɔdze sika no maa hɔn no mbrɛ no, na onhu dza woedzi gua enyinya.
Na dza odzi kan no bae bɛsee dɛ, mo wura, wo pireguan no enya mpireguan du aka ho.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mbo, akowaa pa: Osiandɛ edzi ketseaba yi mu nokwar ntsi, dzi nkurow du do tum.
Na dza otsīa ebien no bae bɛsee dɛ, mo wura, wo pireguan no enya mpireguan enum aka ho.
Na ɔsee no so dɛ, wo so dzi nkurow enum do.
Na ɔbaako no bae bɛsee dɛ, Mo wura, hwɛ, wo pireguan a medze hyɛɛ duukuu mu siei no nye yi:
na musuroo wo, osiandɛ eyɛ nyimpa a eyɛ dzen: Efa dza emmfae nntoo hɔ, na itwa dza innduae.
ɔsee no dɛ, wankasa w'anomu asɛm na menam do bobu wo atsɛn, akowaa bɔn. Inyim dɛ meyɛ nyimpa a meyɛ dzen a mefa dza memmfae nntoo hɔ na mutwa dza munnduae:
na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ammfa me sika annkɔto sikasesafo adaka mu, na meba a maabɛgye m'adze nye no ho nsiho?
Na ɔsee hɔn a wogyinaa hɔ no dɛ, hom ngye ne nsamu pireuan no, na hom mfa mma nyia ɔwɔ du no.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, Owura, ɔwɔ mpireguan du.
Mese hom dɛ, obiara a ɔwɔ no, wɔbɛma no; na nyia onnyi no, dza ɔwɔ no mpo wɔbɛye no nsamu.
Na m'atamfo a wɔammpɛ dɛ midzi hɔn do hen no, hom mfa hɔn mbra ha, na hom mboku hɔn wɔ m'enyim.
Na owiee dɛm kã no, osii mu dzii kan rokɔ jerusalem.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔbɛɛn Bethphage nye Bethany wɔ bepɔw a wɔfrɛ no Ngo Bepɔw ho no, ɔsomaa n'esuafo beenu
dɛ, Hom nkɔ ekuroba a ɔda hom enyim no mu, na hom du mu a, hom bohu asoasoba a wɔamontam no a nyimpa bi nntsenaa do da: Hom nsan no mfa no mbra.
Na sɛ obi bisa hom dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom resan no a, dza hom nse nye dɛ, Ewuradze wɔ no ho hia.
Na hɔn a wɔsomaa hɔn no kɔree kohun dɛ mbrɛ ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn no ara.
Na wɔresan asoasoba no, no wuranom see hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom resan asoasoba no?
Na wɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze wɔ no ho hia.
Na wɔdze no brɛɛ Jesus, na wɔtoow hɔn ntar guu asoasoba no do, na wɔdze Jesus tsenaa do.
Na 0rokɔ no, wɔdze hɔn ntar sesɛɛw kwan mu.
Na ɔrebɛn mbrɛ woribesian Ngo Bepɔw no, n'esuafo kuw no nyina hyɛɛ ase dzii dɛw, na wɔdze ndze kɛse yii Nyankopɔn ayɛw wɔ tum ndwuma a woehu nyina ntsi,
dɛ, nhyira nye ɔhen a ɔnam Ewuradze dzin mu reba no: asomdwee wɔ sor, na enyimnyam wɔ sorsor no ho.
Na Phariseefo no binom a wɔwɔ nyimpadodow no mu no see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, twuw w'esuafo yi enyim.
Na obuae see dɛ mese hom dɛ, sɛ yinom mua hɔn ano a, nkyɛ abo bɛtsēa mu.
Na ɔbɛnee no, ɔhwɛɛ kurow no sūi wɔ do,
dɛ, sɛ wo so nkyɛ inyim, wɔ da yi mu mpo, ndzɛmba a ɔfa asomdwee ho a! Na afei ehunta efi w'eni do.
Na nda no bɛba wo do a w'atamfo bɔto pempe abɔ wo ho aprɔw, na wɔabɔ wo ho kɔntɔnrɔn, na wɔakã wo ahyɛ mu wɔ mbae nyina,
na woedwuruw wo egu famu, ɔnye wo mba a wɔwɔ wo mu, na worinngya wo mu ɔbo a ɔda bo do; osiandɛ ennhu wo ber a wɔbɔhwɛɛ wo no.
Na ɔkɔr asɔrfi no mu no, ɔhyɛɛ ase paam hɔn a wɔtɔn,
see hɔn dɛ, wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Na me fi bɛyɛ asɔryɛbea, na homdze hom ayɛ no edwotwafo tu.
Na ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ daa wɔ asɔrfi no mu. Na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo nye ɔman mu etsirtsir hwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔbɛsɛɛ no,
na woennhu mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ; osiandɛ ɔman no nyina dze hɔnho takyeer no ho tsiee no.
20: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu kor a ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ nkorɔfo no wɔ asɔrfi no mu, na ɔrekã asɛmpa no, asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo nye mpanyimfo no baa no do,
na wɔbɛkãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, kã tum kor a edze yɛ ndzɛmba yi, anaadɛ nyia ɔmaa wo tum yi, kyerɛ hɛn.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, mo so mibebisa hom asɛm, na hom nkã nkyerɛ me;
John enuma, ofir sor anaa ofir nyimpa?
Na wosusuu hɔn mu dɛ, sɛ yɛkã dɛ, ofi sor a, ɔbɛse dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom anngye no enndzi?
Na sɛ yɛkã dɛ, ofi nyimpa a, nkorɔfo no nyina besiw hɛn abo, osiandɛ wɔgye dzi ampa dɛ John yɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi.
Na wobuaa dɛ wonnyim mbrɛ ofi.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Mo so mennkyerɛ hom tum kor a medze meyɛ yinom.
na ɔhyɛɛ ase buu nkurɔfo no bɛ dɛ, nyimpa bi yɛɛ wenyin ture, na ɔdze fɛɛm ekuafo bi, na ɔdɔɔ mu kɔr beebi kɛkyɛree.
Na ber durii no, ɔsomaa akowaa bi wɔ ekuafo no hɔ dɛ wɔmfa wenyin ture eduaba no bi mma no: Na ekuafo no hwee no, na wɔmaa ɔdze nsaansa kɔree.
Na ɔtoaa do somaa akowaa fofor so; ɔno so wɔhwee no, na woguu n'enyim ase, na wɔmaa ɔdze nsaansa kɔree.
Na ɔtoaa do somaa dza otsīa ebiasa; na ɔno so wopiraa no na wɔtoow no fii hɔ kyenee.
Na wenyin ture no wura no see dɛ, mebɛyɛ dɛn? Mobɔsoma mo dɔba: Annyɛ a ɔnodze wɔbɛfɛr no.
Na ekuafo no hun no no, wosusuu hɔn mu dɛ, owuodzi no nye yi: Hom mma yenku no, ma egyapadze no aayɛ hɛndze.
Na wɔtoow no fii wenyin ture no mu kyenee, na wokum no. Dɛm ntsi ebɛnadze na wenyin ture no wura bɛyɛ hɔn?
ɔbɛba abɛsɛɛ ekuafo yi, na ɔdze wenyin ture no ama afofor. Na wɔtsee no, wɔsee dɛ, mma ɔnnyɛ dɛm.
Na ɔhwɛɛ hɔn see hɔn dɛ, ebɛnadze nye yi a wɔakyerɛw dɛ, ɔbo a adantofo powee no, ɔnoara na ɔabɛyɛ kutuwdo-bo?
Obiara ɔbɔhwe ɔbo yi do obobubu, na obiara a ɔbɔhwe no do no ɔbɔdwow no isiam.
Na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no hwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔdze nsa suo no mu kyer no dɔn no ara mu, na wosuroo nkorɔfo no; osiandɛ wohun dɛ bɛ yi a obui no tsia hɔn.
Na wɔweɔɔn no na wɔsomaa aserafo bi a wɔdaan hɔnho dɛ wɔyɛ atseneneefo, dɛ wonkosuo ne kasaa mu, na woeeyi no ahyɛ ambrado ne mbra nye no tum nsa.
Na wobisaa no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yenyim dɛ ekã na ekyerɛkyerɛ yie, eso emmfɛr obi enyim, na ekyerɛkyerɛ Nyankopɔn kwan no wɔ nokwar mu:
ɔfa mbra mu dɛ yɛma Cæsar ntoboa anaa oho?
Na ohun hɔn nkɔnkɔnsa no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ,
Hom mfa denare mbɛkyerɛ me. Woana honyi nye kyerɛw na ɔwɔ do yi? Na wɔsee dɛ, Cæsar dze a.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔnodze hom ndan dza ɔyɛ Cæsar dza mma Cæsar, na dza ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn dze mma Nyankopɔn.
Na woenntum ennsuo ne nsɛm mu wɔ nkorɔfo no enyim; na no mbuae no yɛɛ hɔn nwanwa na womuaa hɔn ano.
Na Sadduceefo no a wɔgye kyim dɛ wunyan nnyi hɔ no mu bi baa ne nkyɛn bebisaa no dɛ,
Kyerɛkyerɛfo, Moses kyerɛwee maa hɛn dɛ, sɛ obi no nua wu, na ɔwɔ yer, na ɔannwo mba a, no nua nwar ne yer no na ɔnwo mba mma no nua.
Na enuanom beesoun wɔn hɔ; na nyia odzi kan waar yer, na onnyi ba, na owui;
na nyia otsiia ebian no,
na nyia ostia ebiasa no so waar no, na dɛmara so hɔn beesuon nyina enngyaa mba, na wowuwui.
Na ekyir no, ɔbaa no so wui.
Dɛm ntsi ɔbaa no, wunyan no mu ɔbɛyɛ hɔn mu woana ne yer? Osiandɛ beesuon no awar no.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, wiadze yi mu mba war, na wɔdze hɔn ma awar:
na hɔn a wobobu hɔn dɛ wɔfata dɛ hɔn nsa bɛka wiadze no, nye nyan a wonyan fi ewufo mu no dze, wɔnnwar, eso wɔmma awar;
na eso wonntum nnwu bio, na wɔnye abɔfo no sɛ, na wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn mba, dɛ wɔyɛ owunyan mba ntsi.
Na dɛ ewufo nyan dze, Moses so kyerɛ wɔ Haban no mu, dɛ ɔfrɛ Ewuradze dɛ Abraham Nyankopɔn nye Isaac Nyankopɔn nye Jacob Nyankopɔn.
Na ɔnnyɛ ewufo Nyankopɔn, na enyikamfo Nyankopɔn a: Osiandɛ hɔn nyina tse ase ma no.
Na kyerɛwfo no bi buaa dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, akã no yie.
Na iyi ekyir, woennsi hɔn bo dɛ wobebisa no asɛm bi bio.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na wɔkã dɛ Christ no yɛ David ba?
Na David noara kã wɔ Ndwom nwoma no mu dɛ, Ewuradze see m'Ewuradze dɛ, Tsena m'abayimfa,
Kodu dɛ medze w'atamfo mebɛyɛ w'ananadzegua.
Dɛm ntsi David frɛ no Ewuradze, na ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔyɛ ne ba?
Na nkorɔfo no nyina tsee no, ɔsee n'esuafo no dɛ,
Hom nhwɛ yie wɔ kyerɛwfo a wɔpɛ ntar atsentsen mu nantsew, nye gua nkyiakyia, ɔnye mpanyin gua wɔ nhyiamufan mu, nye mpanyin tsenabea wɔ edzidzi ase ho:
hɔn na wɔmen ekunafo efi, na wopetuw yi mpaa atsentsen: yinom benya afɔbu kɛsenara.
21: Na ɔmaa n'enyi do hun ahonyafo a wɔrotow hɔn ayɛyɛdze gu sikakorobea no mu.
Na ohun kunafo hianyi bi so a ɔbɔtoow kɔɔbermba ebien guu mu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ okunafo hianyi yi dze pii ebogu mu akyɛn hɔn nyina:
na yinom nyina dza wɔwɔ ma abor hɔn do na wɔdze bi ebogu ayɛyɛdze no mu, na oyidze, ofi ne hia mu dze n'asetsena a ɔwɔ nyina ebogu mu.
Na binom rekã asɔrfi no ho asɛm, mbrɛ wɔdze abo fɛɛfɛw nye adzekyɛdze ahyehyɛ mu no, ɔsee dɛ,
Ndzɛmba yi a hom hu yi, nda bɛba a wonnkegya ɔbo kor a ɔda kor do wɔ mu a wonnkodwuruw egu famu.
Na wobisaa no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛnyi, dabɛn na yinom bɛyɛ hɔ, na yinom rebɛba mu a, n'asɛnkyerɛdze nye dɛn?
Na ɔsee dɛ, H0m nhwɛ yei amma wɔaanndaadaa hom: Na dodowara bɛba wɔ me dzin mu dɛ, emi nye no, na, Aber no abɛn: Mma hom nndzi hɔn ekyir.
Na sɛ hom tse ɔkõ nye wentwiwentwi nka a, mma ɔnnyɛ hom hu; na otwar dɛ yinom dzi kan ba, na ewiei no remmba ntsɛmara.
Nna ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔman bɔsoɛr ɔman do, na ahenman bɔsoɛr ahenman do,
na asaasawosow kɛse bɛba, na ɔkɔm nye ɔyardɔm bɛba mbeambea, na ehudze nye nsɛnkyerɛdze akɛse befi sor aba.
Na dza odzi yinom nyina kan nye dɛ wɔdze nsa bosuo hom mu, na wɔahaw hom, dze eyi hom akɔ nhyiamudan mu nye efiadze, na wɔdze hom aba ahemfo nye ambradofo enyim wɔ me dzin ntsi.
Ɔbɛdan dase ama hom.
Dɛm ntsi hom mfa nto hom akoma mu dɛ hom nnkedzi kan adwendwen dza hom dze beyi hom ano:
na emi na mebɛma hom ano nye nyansa a hom atamfo nyina runntum nngyina enyim, na worunntua ano.
Na awofo, nye nuanom, nye ebusuafo, nye mfɛfo beyi hom ama, na wɔama woeku hom mu binom,
na nyimpa nyina bɛtan hom wɔ me dzin ntsi.
Na hom tsinhwi kor rennhera.
Hom abotar mu na hom benya hom akra.
Na sɛ hom hu Jerusalem dɛ dɔm etwa ho ehyia a, nna hom nhu dɛ no mbɔe abɛn.
ɔno na hɔn a wɔwɔ Judæa nguan nkɔ nkokwaa do, na wɔamma hɔn a wɔwɔ mu no mfi mu nkɔ, na mma hɔn a wɔwɔmfuwa mu no nnkɔ mu.
Osiandɛ yi nye awerdzi nda, ma dza wɔakyerɛw nyina aaba mu.
Na hɔn a wɔafa efur, nye hɔn a wɔma numfo wɔ nda no mu ndue! Osiandɛ atseetsee kɛse bɛba asaase no do, na ebufuw bɛba ɔman no mu.
Na wɔbɔtotɔ nkrantsee anomu, na wɔafa hɔn ndɔmmum akɔ aman nyina do, na amanamamfo betsiatsia Jerusalem do ekodu dɛ amanaman aber no bɔsõ.
Na nsɛnkyerɛdze bɛba ewia nye bosoom nye nworaba mu, na asaase do amanaman ahoguan bɛba, ɔnye gyigyeegye dɛ po nye asorɛkye ruhur;
nyinpa bɔtɔ akɔtɔmborɔnsa wɔ hu nye ndzɛmba a hɔn enyi da kwan a ɔreba wiadze do ntsi, na ɔsor etum bɔwosow.
ɔno na wobohu nyimpa Ba no dɛ ɔreba wɔ nsuwusiw do, wɔ ahoɔdzen nye enyimnyam kɛse mu.
Na sɛ ndzɛmba yi hyɛ ase reba a, ɔno na hom nhwɛ sor, na hom mma hom tsir do, osiandɛ hom pon edu.
Na obuu hɔn bɛ dɛ, hom nhwɛ adɔmbadua nye ndua nyina:
sɛ wɔfefɛw a, hom hwɛ a, nna homankasa hom nyim dɛ ɔhyewber abɛn.
Dɛmara na hom so sɛ hom hu dɛ yinom yɛ hɔ a, hom nhu dɛ Nyankopɔn ahendzi no abɛn. 32.Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Mbasantsen yi runntwa mu akɔ gyedɛ ne nyina ayɛ hɔ ansaana.
Ɔsor nye asaase botwa mu akɔ; na me nsɛm dze, worunntwa mu akɔ.
Na hom nhwɛ homho yie, mma etumfursɛm nye asabow nye ɔbra yi ho dadwen aannhyɛ hom akoma do, mma nda no aammbɔto hom awora dɛ efir:
Na ɔbɛba hɔn a wɔtse asaase nyina enyi nyina do.
Mbom hom nweɔn daa, na hom ndzi nkotoserɛ, ma hom eenya tum dɛ hom dze befi ndzɛmba yi a ɔbɛba yi nyina nsa, na hom eengyina nyimpa Ba no enyim.
Na ewiaber biara na ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ asɔrfi mu, na anago biara na oefir edzi akɛtsena bepɔw a wɔfrɛ no Ngo Bepɔw do.
Na nkorɔfo no nyina baa ne nkyɛn anapaatu wɔ asɔrfi mu, dɛ wobetsie no.
22: Na epitsi-afahyɛ no a wɔfrɛ no Apaho no bɛnee.
Na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no hwehwɛɛ mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ eku no, na wosuroo nkorɔfo no.
Na Satan kɛhɛɛn Judas a wɔfrɛ no Iscariot a ɔyɛ duebien no mu baako mu.
Na ɔkɔree nye asɔfompanyin nye asafohen no kɛkekãa mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ eyi no ama hɔn.
Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn dɛw, na wɔnye no dzii dɛ wɔbɛma no sika.
Na ɔbɔɔ hɔn anohoba, na ɔhwehwɛɛ mbrɛ obenya kwan edua nyimpadodow no ekyir eyi no ama hɔn.
Na epitsi da a ɔsɛ dɛ woku apahoguan no durii.
Na ɔsomaa Peter nye John dɛ, hom nkɔ nkesiesie apaho no mma hɛn ma yembedzi.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, hen na epɛ dɛ yekesiesie?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hwɛ, hom du kurow no mu a, nyimpa bi a ɔso esuhina behyia hom: hom nka no do nkɔ ofi a ɔbɔkɔ mu no mu,
na hom nse ofi no no wura no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛnyi no se, Ahɔhodan a menye m'esuafo bedzi mu apaho no wɔ hen?
Na ɔbɛkyerɛhom sor dan kɛse bi a wɔahyehyɛ mu: Hɔ na hom nsiesie.
Na wɔkɔree kohun dɛ mbrɛ ɔsee hɔn, na wosiesiee apaho no.
Na dɔn no durii no, ɔbɛtsenaa ase, na Ndwuma duebien no ka no ho.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, medze akɔndɔ mahwehwɛ dɛ menye hom dzi apaho yi ansaana mehu amandze:
na mese hom dɛ, mirinndzi bi bio gyedɛ ber a ɔaba mu wɔ Nyankopɔn ahenmanmu.
Na ɔfaa kuraba, na ɔdaa ase no, ɔsee dɛ, Hom ngye yi nkyɛ mma homho:
na mese hom dɛ, moronnom wenyinaba no bi bio dze ekodu dɛ Nyankopɔn ahendzi bɛba.
Na ɔfaa paanoo na ɔdaa ase no, obubui, na ɔdze maa hɔn dɛ, iyi nye me nyimpadua a wɔdze rema wɔ hom ntsi: Hom nyɛ yi mfa nyɛ me nkaa.
Dɛmara so na wowiee edzidzi no, ɔfaa kuraba no see dɛ, Kuraba yi nye ahyɛmu fofor no wɔ mo bɔgyaa mu, ɔno na hom ntsi woruhue egu.
Na hwɛ, nyia oriyi me ama no ne nsa nye me wɔ pon no do.
Na nokwar, nyimpa Ba no rokɔ dɛ mbrɛ wɔahyɛ no dze, na nyimpa a wɔnam no do ribeyi no ama no ndue!
Na wɔhyɛɛ ase bisabisa hɔn mu dɛ woana na ɔrebɛyɛ dɛm adze yi.
Na noko bi so baa hɔn mu dɛ hɔn woana na wobobu ne kɛse.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Amanaman ahemfo dzi hɔn do wura, na hɔn a wodzi hɔn do tum no, wɔfrɛ hɔn Ayamuyiefo.
Na homdze, mma hom nnyɛ dɛm: na mbom nyia ɔyɛ homm mu kɛse, wɔmma ɔnyɛ dɛ ekumaba, na nyia ɔyɛ otsitsir no, ɔnyɛ dɛ nyia ɔsom.
Na woana na ɔyɛ kɛse, nyia ɔtse edziban ho anaa nyia ɔsom a? Nnyɛ nyia ɔtse edziban ho anaa? Na emidze mowɔ hom mu dɛ nyia ɔsom.
Na hom nye hɔn a hom ada ho aka mo ho wɔ mo nsɔhwɛ mu;
na mo so mehyɛ ahendzi mema hom, dɛ mbrɛ m'Egya ahyɛ ama me,
ama hom eedzidzi na hom aanom wɔ mo pon do wɔ m'ahenman mu; na hom bɛtsena nhengua do ebu Israel ebusuakuw duebien no atsɛn.
Simon, Simon, hwɛ, Satan bisaa enya hom dɛ ɔbɔpo hom do dɛ ewi;
na maserɛ mama wo, amma wo gyedzi aammpa, na sɛ daakye edan bio a, hyɛ wo nuanom dzen.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ewuradze, meyɛ krado dɛ menye wo bɔkɔ efiadze nye wu nyina mu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Peter, mekã kyerɛ wo dɛ akokɔ rommbɔn ndɛ ansaana asan mprɛnsa dɛ innyim me.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, mosomaa hom ma hom nndze sika-kotoku nye bɔtɔ nye nsokota no, biribi hiaa hom anaa? Na wɔsee dɛ ennhia hɛn hwee.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, afei dze, nyia ɔwɔ sika-kotoku, ma ɔmfa, na bɔtɔ so dɛmara, na nyia onnyi bi no, ma ɔntɔn no sortar ntɔ afõwa.
Na mese hom dɛ iyi a wɔakyerɛw no otwar dɛ ɔba mu wɔ mo ho dɛ, wɔkaan no furaa mbratofo, na dza ɔfa mo ho no rebɛba mu.
Na wɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, hwɛ, mfõwa ebien nye yi. Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔdɔɔ sõ.
na ofiir edzi, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔtɔ dɛ ɔyɛ no, ɔkɔr Ngo Bepɔw do, na n'esuafo no so kaa no do.
Na odur hɔ no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nsɔr ma hom aannkɔ nsɔhwɛ mu.
Na ɔtwee noho fii hɔn nkyɛn bɛyɛ dɛ ɔbo-towee na ɔkɔkosɔɔw no ntwɛr enyim sɔɔr dɛ,
Egya, sɛ epɛ a, yi kuraba yi pa mo ho; naaso nyɛ me pɛ a, na wodze na ɔnyɛ.
Na ɔbɔfo bi fi sor beyii noho kyerɛɛ no hyɛɛ no dzen.
Na owuyaw mu no, ɔsɔɔr enyiberdo, na ne fifir yɛ dɛ bɔgya atɔwatɔw a ogugu famu.
Na ɔsoɛree fii n'asɔryɛ mu no, ɔbaa n'esuafo nkyɛn na obohun hɔn dɛ awerɛhow ntsi wɔadeda.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na Hom ada yi? Hom nsoɛr nsɔr mma hom aannkɔ nsɔhwɛ mu.
Na ɔda do rekasa no, hwɛ, nyimpadodow nye nyia wɔfrɛ no Judas a ɔyɛ duebien no mu baako dzi hɔn enyim na ɔtwee bɛɛn Jesus dɛ obefew n'ano.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Judas, Edze mfewano riyi nyimpa Ba no ama?
Na hɔn a wɔwɔ no ho no hun dza ɔreba no, wɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, yɛmfa afõwa mbobɔ anaa?
Na hɔn mu baako bɔɔ ɔsɔfopanyin n'akowaa, na otwaa n'aso nyimfa.
Na Jesus buae see dɛ, hom mma ɔmpa ha ara; na ɔkãa n'aso yɛɛ no edur.
Na Jesus see asɔfompanyin nye asɔrfi mu asafohen, nye mpanyimfo a wɔbaa no do no dɛ, Ana hom firii baa no do dɛ owifo do, na hom dze mfõwa nye mpɔtsibaa yi?
Mowɔ hom nkyɛn wɔ asɔrfi mu hɔ daa no, hom anntsen hom nsa annkã me: na iyi nye hom ber, na sum mu tum.
Na wɔfaa no kɔree, na wɔdze no baa ɔsɔfopanyin fie. Na Peter dzii n'ekyir wɔ ekyirkyir.
Na wokūaa gya wɔ abangua finimfin na wɔtsenaa ho no, Peter bɛtsenaa hɔn mu.
Na ɔtse gya no ho no, abaawa bi hun no, na ɔhwɛɛ no komm, na ɔsee dɛ, oyi so nye no nam.
Na ɔsaan dɛ, ɔbaa, minnyim no.
Na ɔkyɛɛr kakra na obi so hun no, na ɔsee dɛ, wo so fi hɔn mu. Na Peter see dɛ, Awɛ, mimmfi mu.
Na n'ekyir bɛyɛ dɔnhwer kor na obi so kãe gyinaa do dɛ, nokwar, oyi so nye no nam: Na ɔyɛ Galileenyi.
Na Peter see dɛ, Awɛ, minnyim dza ese yi. Na amonmu hɔ ara a ɔda do rekasa no, na akokɔ bɔnee.
Na Ewuradze daan noho hwɛɛ Peter. Na Peter kaa Ewuradze asɛm no, mbrɛ ɔase no dɛ, Ansaana akokɔ bɔbɔn ndɛ, ebɛpa me mprɛnsa.
Na ofiir edzi, na okosūu pii.
Na mbanyin a wɔdze Jesus mu no, wosii no atwetwe bobɔɔ no.
Na wɔyɛɛ no akatanyi, na wobisaa no dɛ, hyɛ nkɔm! Woana na ɔbɔɔ wo?
Na nsɛmbɔn pii keka ho a wɔkãe tsiaa no.
Na adze kyee no, ɔman mpanyimfo nye asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no behyiae, na wɔdze no kɔr hɔn asɛndzii, dɛ,
Sɛ ɔwo nye Christ no a, kã kyerɛ hɛn. Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, sɛ mekã kyerɛ hom a, hom renngye nndzi;
na mo so mibisa hom a, hom rummbua bi.
Na daakye nyimpa Ba no bɛtsena Nyankopɔn n'ahoɔdzen nyimpa.
Na hɔn nyina see dɛ, nna ɔnodze ɔwo nye Nyankopɔn Ba nye no? Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom kã dɛ emi nye no.
Na wɔsee dɛ, ebɛn dase na ohia ma hɛn bio? Osiandɛ hɛnankasa yɛatse wɔ n'anomu.
23: Na hɔn nyimpadodow no nyina soɛree, na wɔdze no kɔr Pilate nkyɛn.
Na wɔhyɛɛ ase tõatoaa no dɛ, yeehu oyi dɛ ɔresɛɛ hɛn man yi na ɔbra dɛ mma wɔmma Cæsar ntoboa, na ɔkã dɛ nankasa nye Christ, ɔhen.
Na Pilate bisaa no dɛ, Ana Jewfo Hen nye wo? Na obuaa no see dɛ, Akã.
Pilate see asɔfompanyin nye nyimpadodow no dɛ, mummhu afɔdzi biara wɔ nyimpa yi ho.
Na mbom wogyinaa do dzendzen dɛ, ohuenyan ɔman no, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ Judæa man nyina mu, ɔhyɛɛ ase wɔ Galilee na ɔdze ebodu ha yi.
Na Pilate tsee no, obisaa dɛ nyimpa yi galileenyi anaa?
Na ohun dɛ ofir Herod ase no, ɔsomaa no wɔ Herod nkyɛn, na aber no mu nna nankasa so wɔ Jerusalem.
Na Herod hun Jesus no, ɔyɛɛ no dɛw pii: na ɔpɛɛ dɛ ohu no akyɛr, osiandɛ ɔatse no ho asɛm, na n'enyi daa kwan dɛ obohu asɛnkyerɛdze bi a ɔbɛyɛ.
Na obisabisaa no wɔ nsɛm pii mu, na ɔnodze oemmbua no hwee.
Na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no gyinae tõatoaa no ɔdzendo ara.
Na Herod nye no nsordaafo bɔɔ no adapaa, na wosii no atwetwe, na wɔhyɛɛ no efuradze dɛhyɛdɛhyɛ bi dze no kɛmaa Pilate bio.
Na da no ara na Pilate nye Herod yɛɛ nyɛnko: Na nkan no dze nna wɔrotwe manso wɔ hɔn mu.
Na Pilate frɛɛ asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo nye ɔman no boaa ano no,
ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom dze nyimpa yi brɛɛ me dɛ nyia ɔresɛɛ ɔman no, na hwɛ, mahwehwɛ no mu wɔ hom enyim, na mennhu ndzɛmba a hom dze tõatoa no yi ho afɔdzi biara wɔ nyimpa yi mu;
oho, nnyɛ Herod so a: Na ɔsomaa no sanee brɛɛ hɛn; na hwɛ, ɔnnyɛɛ okumadze biara.
Dɛm ntsi mobɔhwe no, na megyaa no.
Na otwar dɛ ogyaa kor ma hɔn afahyɛ no mu.
Na hɔn nyina tsēaa mu prɛko dɛ, fa yi kɔ, na gyaa Barabbas ma hɛn:
ɔno na osian sakasaka a wɔyɛɛ no kurow mu hɔ nye ewudzi ntsi wɔdze no too efiadze.
Na Pilate kasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn bio, ɔpɛ dɛ ogyaa Jesus ntsi;
na wɔtsēatseaa mu dɛ, Bɔ no mbeamudua mu, bɔ no mbeamudua mu!
Na ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn ne mprɛnsa dɛ, ebɛn bɔn na nyimpa yi ayɛ? Mennhu okumadze biara wɔ no ho: Dɛm ntsi mobɔhwe no, na megyaa no.
Na wɔdze ndze kɛse daa ho bisaa dɛ wɔmbɔ no mbeamudua mu. Na hɔn ndze hyɛɛ do.
Na Pilate buu atsɛn dɛ wɔnyɛ hɔn ebisadze mma hɔn.
Na nyia osian sakasaka nye ewudzi ntsi wɔdze no too efiadze no a wɔserɛɛ no no, ogyaa no, na Jesus dze, oyii no maa hɔn pɛ.
Na wɔdze no rokɔ no, wosuoo Simon bi a ofi Cryene a ofi haban mu reba mu, na wɔdze mbeamudua no too no do dɛ ɔnsoa ndzi Jesus ekyir.
Na ɔman no mu nyimpadodow kɛse kaa no do, ɔnye mbaa a woridzi no nkɔmbɔ na worusū.
Na Jesus daan noho baa hɔn do, na ɔsee dɛ, Jerusalem mbabaa, mma hom nnsū mma me, na hom nsū mma homho nye hom mba.
Na hwɛ, nda reba a wɔbɛse dɛ, nhyira nye abɔnyin, nye yafun a ɔnnwoo da, nye numfo a wonnuum da.
ɔno na wɔbɛhyɛ ase ase nkokwaa dɛ, hom nhwe hɛn do, na mbepɔw dɛ, Hom nkata hɛn do.
Na sɛ wɔdze iyi yɛ duamon a, ebɛnadze na wɔdze bɛyɛ duawui?
Na wɔdze mbratofo beenu kaa no ho kɔree, dɛ wonkoku hɔn.
Na wodur beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Nyitsirdo no, wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu wɔ hɔ, ɔnye mbratofo no, ɔbaako wɔ ne nyimfa, ɔbaako wɔ n'abankum.
Na Jesus see dɛ, Egya, fa kyɛ hɔn, na wonnyim dza wɔreyɛ. Na wɔkyɛɛ n'atar mu twee ho tonto.
Na ɔman no gyinaa hɔ hwɛe. Na mpanyinyimfo no so sii no atwetwe dɛ, ɔgyee binom: ma ɔngye noho, sɛ ɔno nye Christ a Nyankopɔn eyi no no a.
Na nsordaafo no so sii no atwetwe, na wɔdze wenyin yerɛyerɛw bɛmaa no,
na wɔsee dɛ, sɛ ɔwo nye Jewfo Hen no a, gye woho.
Na kyerɛw bi so wɔ n'etsifi dɛ, OYI NYE JEWFO HEN NO.
Na mbratofo a wɔsɛɛn hɔn no mu baako yaaw no dɛ, nnyɛ ɔwo nye Christ no a? Gye woho nye hɛn.
Na ɔbaako no buaa no kãa n'enyim dɛ, Ana innsuro Nyankopɔn, dɛ ewɔ afɔbu kor yi ara mu?
Na hɛndze, ɔtsen ampa, osiandɛ hɛn nsa aka akatua a ɔsɛ hɛn ndzeyɛɛ; na oyidze ɔmmfoom biribiara nnyɛe.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Jesus, sɛ eba w'ahendzi mu a, kaa me.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, nokwar mese wo dɛ ndɛ ebɛka mo ho wɔ Paradise hɔ.
Na bɛyɛ dɛ dɔn a otsīa esia no durii no, sum hyɛɛ asaase no nyina do kudor dɔn a otsīa akron no,
ewia kɔr sum ntsi; na asɔrdan no mu ntwamutam no tseew ebien wɔ finimfin.
Na Jesus dze ndze kɛse kaa mu dɛ, Egya, wo nsamu na medze mo sunsum mehyɛ. Na ɔsee dɛm no, ogyaa no sunsum mu.
Na ɔhamupanyin no hun dza ayɛ no, ɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam see dɛ, Ampaara nyimpa yi tseneneenyi a.
Na nyimpadodow a wɔbaa hɔ bɔhwɛɛ adze nyina, wohun dza ayɛ no, wɔbobɔɔ hɔn koko do sanee kɔree.
Na n'amanyimfo nyina, nye mbaa a wodzii n'ekyir fii Galilee nyina begyinaa ekyirkyir hwɛɛ ndzɛmba yi.
Na hwɛ, ɔbarimba a ne dzin dze Joseph a ɔyɛ baguanyi, na ɔyɛ nyimpa pa na ɔtsen,
(na ɔnodze ɔammpen hɔn apam nye hɔn ndzeyɛɛ) ofi Jewfo kurow Arimathæa mu, na ɔrotweɔn Nyankopɔn n'ahendzi;
ɔno na ɔkɔr Pilate hɔ kɛserɛ Jesus no fun.
Na oyi no bobɔɔw ndwera tam mu, na ɔdze no too ɔbo-ba a obiara nnda mu da mu.
Na da no yɛ Ahosiesieda, na ahomgyeda no rebɛn.
na mbaa a wɔnye no fii Galilee bae no dzii ekyir bɔhwɛɛ nda no, nye mbrɛ wɔdze no fun toe.
Na wɔsanee kesieksiee nduhuam nye ngohuam. Na ahomgyeda no wɔhomee, dɛ mbrɛ mbrasɛm no tse.
24: Na da a odzi dapɛn no kan no anapaatu wɔkɔr nda no do, na wɔdze nduhuam a wosiesiei no bae.
Na wobohun ɔbo no dɛ woepirew no efi nda no abowano.
Na wɔhɛɛn mu no, woennhu Ewuradze Jesus no fun.
Na ɔbaa dɛ iyi yɛɛ hɔn adwen mu basabasa no, hwɛ, mbarimba beenu begyinaa hɔn nkyɛn a wɔhyɛ ntar hyɛnhyɛn;
na hu kãa hɔn, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn enyi adze sensɛɛn famu no, wɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛdɛn na hom rohwehwɛ nyia ɔtse ase no wɔ ewufo mu yi?
Onnyi ha, na ɔasoɛr: hom nkaa mbrɛ ɔda ho wɔ Galilee no, ɔkãa kyerɛɛ hom dɛ
ɔsɛ nyimpa Ba no dɛ wobeyi no ahyɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo nsa na wɔabɔ no mbeamudua mu na da a otsīa ebiasa no ɔasoɛr bio.
na wɔkaa ne nsɛm no,
na wofii nda no do sanee bɛkãa ndzɛmba yi nyina kyerɛɛ dubiako no, nye nkaa no nyina.
Mary Magdalene nye Joanna nye James ne nã Mary, nye mbaa nkaa a wɔka hɔn ho na wɔbɛkãa ndzɛmba yinom kyerɛɛ Ndwuma no.
Na nsɛm yi yɛɛ hɔn dɛ nsɛnhun, na wɔanngye hɔn enndzi.
Na Peter dze, ɔsoɛree tutuu mbirika kɔr nda no do, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze no, ohun ndwera atam no nko gugu hɔ; na ɔsanee kɔr ne fie, na dza ayɛ no yɛɛ no nwanwa.
Na hwɛ, da no ara, hɔn mu beenu sii mu kɔr ekuroba bi a ne dzin dze Emmaus a ofi Jerusalem kɔ hɔ bɛyɛ akwansimba eduosia mu.
Na woridzi ndzɛmba a ɔaba yi nyina ho nkɔmbɔ.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, woridzi nkɔmbɔ na woribisabisa hɔnho no, Jesus ankasa twee bɛɛn hɔn nye hɔn siaan anan kɔree.
Na wosuoo hɔn enyiwa mu, ma woennhu ne nyimpa ban.
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ebɛn nsɛm nye yi a hom dze ridzi nkɔmbɔ nam yi? na wogyinae, na hɔn werɛ ahow.
Na hɔn mu baakoa ne dzin dze Cloepas see no dɛ, ɔwo nko na eyɛ ɔhɔho wɔ Jerusalem, na innyim dza ɔaba nda yi?
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ebɛnadze a? Na wɔsee no dɛ, dza ɔfa Jesus Nazarethnyi a ɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi tumfo wɔ ndzeyɛɛ nye kasa mu wɔ Nyankopɔn nye ɔman nyina enyim no ho:
mbrɛ asɔfompanyin nye hɛn mpayimfo no yii no maa dɛ wombu no fɔ nku no, na wɔbɔɔ no mneammudua mu.
Na hɛndze, hɛn enyi daa kwan dɛ nkyɛ ɔno nye nyia ɔrebɛgye Isreal. Na iyi nyina ekyir so, wɔyɛɛ ndzɛmba yi ndaansa nye ndɛ.
Na mbaa bi so a wofi hɛn mu a wɔkɔr nda no do anapahema abɛma hɛn ho abow hɛn;
na woennhu no fun no, wɔbae bɛkãa dɛ woehu abɔfo bi wɔ enyido-adzehu so a wɔkãa dɛ ɔtse ase.
Na hɔn a wɔnye hɛn wɔ hɔ binom kɔr nda no do, na wokohun dɛ mbrɛ mbaa no so kãe no ara, na ɔnodze woennhu no.
Na ɔnoara see hɔn dɛ, Ao nkwasea a hom yɛ nyaa wɔ hom akoma mu dɛ hom bɛgye dza nkɔnhyɛfo no kae no nyina edzi!
Ana ɔnnsɛ Christ no dɛ obohu dɛm amandze na ɔakɔ n'enyimnyam mu?
Na ɔhyɛɛ ase fi Moses nye kɔnhyɛfo no nyina do kyerɛɛ hɔn nkyerɛw nyina mu dza ɔfa no ho ase.
Na wɔbɛɛn ekuroba a wɔrokɔ mu no, nna ɔyɛɛ dɛ dza ɔrokɔ n'enyim.
Na wɔhyɛɛ no dɛ, nye hɛn tsena, na orudu ewimbir, na adze reyɛ asa. Na ɔmanee dɛ ɔnye hɔn bɛtsena.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔnye hɔn tse edzidzi no, ɔfaa paanoo, na ohyiraa do, na obubui maa hɔn.
Na hɔn enyiwa buei ma wohun no, na ɔyeew hɔn enyiwa do.
Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, ɔnye hɛn rekasa wɔ kwan mu, na obuee kyerɛnsɛm no mu kyerɛɛ hɛn no, hɛn akoma annhyehye hɛn anaa?
Na wɔsoɛɛr dɔn no ara mu sanee baa Jerusalem, na wobohun dubiako no nye hɔn a wɔka hɔn ho no dɛ wɔaboa hɔn ano,
na wɔrese dɛ Ewuradze asoɛr ampa, na oeyi noho akyerɛ Simon.
Na hɔn so wɔkãa dza ɔbaa kwan no mu, na mbrɛ wohun no wɔ paanoo bu mu no kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na wɔrekasa dɛm no, Jesus nankasa begyinaa hɔn finimfin, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Asomdwee nka hom.
Na wɔbobɔɔ piriw na hu kaa hɔn, na wosusuu dɛ woehu ɔsaman.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom bo etutu? Na ebɛnadzentsi na adwendwen soɛrsoɛr hom akoma mu yi?
hom nhwɛ me nsa nye me nan dɛ emi mankasa a: hom nkã me nhwɛ; na ɔsaman nnyi honam nye mbiew dɛ mbrɛ hom hu dɛ mowɔ yi.
Na ɔsee dɛm no, ɔdze ne nsa nye ne nan kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na wɔda ho nngye nndzi wɔ dɛw ntsi, na ɔyɛ hɔn nwanwa no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom wɔ edziban biwɔ ha?
na wɔmaa no esunam a wɔakyew sin.
Na ɔgyee na odzii wɔ hɔn enyim.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Iyi nye me nsɛm a meda ho wɔ hom nkyɛn no mekãa kyerɛɛ hom dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mo ho wɔ Moses mbra, nye nkɔnhyɛfo, nye ndwom no mu nyina bɛba mu.
Nna obuee hɔn adwen mu, ma wɔaatse kyerɛwnsɛm no ase;
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, dɛmara na wɔakyerɛw no, dɛ Christ no bohu amandze na da a otsīa ebiasa no ɔasoɛr efi ewufo mu;
na woedua ne dzin do akɛkã nnuho nye bɔnfakyɛ akyerɛ amanaman nyina, wobefitsi ase wɔ Jerusalem.
Hom yɛ yinom ho adasefo.
Na hwɛ, morosoma m'Egya n'anohoba maba hom do: na hom ntsena kurow no mu nkodu dɛ wobefi sor ahyɛ hom ahoɔdzen.
na ɔdze hɔn fiir edzi kodur Bethany tsentsendo, na ɔmaa ne nsa do nyiraa hɔn.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, orihyira hɔn no, ɔnye hɔn paa mu na wɔfaa no kɔ sor.
Na hɔndze, wɔkotowee sɔɔr no, na wɔdze dɛw kɛse sanee baa Jerusalem;
na wɔtsenaa asɔrfi mu hɔ daa hyiraa Nyankopɔn.

1: Ewuradze n’asem atsɛmbusɛm a ɔnam Malachi do baa Israel hɔ.
Madɔ hom, Ewuradze na ɔse. Naaso hom kã dɛ, ebɛn mu na adɔ hɛn? Ana nnyɛ Jacob no nua nye Esau? Ewuradze na ɔse: Naaso modɔɔ Jacob;
na Esau dze mikyiir no, na memaa ne mbepɔw yɛɛ afõ, na medze n’egyapadze memaa sar do mpataku.

Naaso mbrɛ Edom ka nye dɛ, wɔafetsew hɛn, na yɛbeɛsan akɛkyekyer mbeambea a ayeyɛ afoafo no; mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi, wɔbɛkyekyer, na emi so mubodwuruw egu famu: Na adasa bɛfrɛ hɔn dɛ, emumuyɛ he, na ɔman a Ewuradze afa hɔn ebufuw daapem.
Na hom enyiwa bohu, na hom akã dɛ, wonhuhor Ewuradze ntra Israel he do.

Ɔba dzi n'egya nyi, na akowaa dzi no wura nyi: Sɛ egya nye me mbo a, m’enyidzi wɔ hen? Na sɛ owura nye me a, mo ho suro wɔ hen? Dɔm Ewuradze na ɔkã kyerɛ hom, asɔfo a wobu me dzin enyimtsia. Na hom kã dɛ, ebɛn mu na yebu wo dzin enyimtsia?
Hom dze paanoo a no ho ekum brɛ me wɔ m’afɔrmbukyia do. Na hom se dɛ, ebɛn mu na yekum wo ho? Wɔ dɛ hom kã dɛ, Ewuradze n’edzidzipon no woebu no enyimtsia.

Na hom dze abowa nyitɔr ba bɔbɔ afɔr a, ɔnnyɛ bɔn bi! Na hom dze mpakye na ayarfo ba bɔbɔ afɔr a, ɔnnyɛ bɔn bi! Afei dze fa k!ma w’ambrado; aso n’enyi bɔsɔ wo? Anaa aso ɔbɔhwɛ w’enyim? Dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na afei, meserɛ hom, hom ntotɔ nserɛ Ewuradze n'enyimpa, ma ɔmbɔdom hɛn: Hom nsamu na iyi fi: Aso ɔbɔhwɛ hom mu obiara enyim? Dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Kɛtseankyɛ obi wɔ hom mu a ɔbɔtotow mbobow no mu, amma hom aannsɔ m’afɔrmbukyia do ogya kwa! M’enyi nnsɔ hom hwee, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, eso merenngye hom nsamu ayɛyɛdze biara.
