Na ofitsi wipuei dze kesi no tɔree mpo, me dzin yɛ kɛse wɔ Amanaman mu; na mbeambea nyina wɔhyew eduhuam bɔ afɔr ma me dzin, na ayɛyɛdze a no ho tsew: Na me dzin yɛ kɛse wɔ Amanaman mu, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na homdze hom hura ho, wɔ dɛ hom kã dɛ, Ewuradze n’edzidzipon no ho ekum, na no do aba, n’edziban no, wobu no enyimtsia.

Hom kã so dɛ, hwɛ, ɔhaw bɛn nye yi! Na hom akõ hom hwen mu egu do, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse; na hom dze dza wɔdze enyimpi fae, na mpakye na ayarfo no aba; dɛm na hom dze hom ayɛyɛdze ba: Aso mebɛgye iyi wɔ hom nsamu? Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na ndom nkã nyia osisi a ɔwɔ onyin wo no nguankuw mu, na ɔbɔ anohoba, na ɔdze dza odzi dzɛm bɔ Ewuradze okumafɔr: Na ɔhen kɛse nye me, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, na me dzin yɛ hu wɔ amanaman mu.
2: Na afei, hom asɔfo, mbrasɛm yi homdze a.

Sɛ hom enntsie, na sɛ hom ammfa annto akoma mu, dɛ hom dze enyimnyam bɛma me dzin a, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, ɔnodze mobɔsoma ndom maba hom do, na madom hom nhyira: Nyew, madom hɔn dada, osiandɛ hom mmfa nnto akoma mu.
Hwɛ, mubotwuw aba no enyim wɔ hom ntsi, na matow egyanan mapetse hom enyim, mekyerɛ hom kum-afɔr egyanan no; na wɔbɛsesaw hom akã ho akɔ.
Na hom bohu dɛ emi na masoma mbrasɛm yi mabrɛ hom, ma m'ahyɛmu aako Levi nkyɛn, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse
M'ahyɛmu a menye no dzii no yɛ nkwa na asomdwee; na medze maa no ma oeesuro, na osuroo me, na me dzin ho yɛɛ no hu.
Nokwar mbra no daa n’anomu na woennhu ɔbrakyewsɛm wɔ n’anomu; ɔnye me nantseew asomdwee na tɔɔtsennyɛ mu. Na ɔdaan dodowara fii emunuiyɛ ho.
Na ɔsɔfo a no sie nyimdzee, na otwar dɛ wɔhwehwɛ mbra no wɔ n’ano: Na ɔno nye dɔm Ewuradze no bɔfoe.
Na hom aman efi kwan no mu; hom ama dodowara efintsiw mbra no mu; hom asɛɛ Levi ahyɛmu no, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Dɛm ntsi na mo so mama hom ayɛ enyimguasefo na nkwahwehwe wɔ aman nyina enyim, dɛ mbrɛ hom nndzi m’akwan do, na hom ahwɛ nyimpa enyim wɔ mbra no mu ara.
Ana nnyɛ egya kor na hɛn nyina yɛwɔ? Ana nnyɛ Nyankopɔn kor na ɔbɔɔ hɛn nyina? Ɔyɛ dɛn mbɔ na hɛn mu obiara twa no nua nkontompɔ, yɛdze gu hɛn egyanom ahyɛmu ho fi yi?
Judah etwa nkontompɔ, na wɔayɛ ekyiwadze wɔ Israel na Jerusalem; osiandɛ Judah ehura Ewuradze no krɔnkrɔn-bea a ɔdɔ no no ho, na ɔawar anana bosom ne babaa.
Ewuradze botwa ɔbarimba a ɔyɛ yi no, ne bi a onyan, na ne bi a ɔgye do fii Jacob asese mu, na nyia ɔdze ayɛyɛdze brɛ dɔm Ewuradze no.
Na iyi so bio na hom yɛ: Hom dze nyinsuwa kata Ewuradze n’afɔrmbukyia no do, na osū na nkrumsi, ma dɛm ntsi ommbu ayɛyɛdze no bi bio, eso ɔmmfa ɔpɛ pa bi nngye no wɔ hom nsamu.
Naaso hom kã dɛ, ase nye dɛn? Ase nye dɛ Ewuradze ayɛ ɔwo na wo mberantsɛber mu yer no ntamu dasefo, ɔno na etwa no nkontompɔ, naaso ɔno nye wo kafo, na w’ahyɛmudzi yer.
Na baako biara a ɔwɔ sunsum nkaa no bi no annyɛ dɛm. Na ɔyɛ den na baako per? Ɔhwehwɛɛ Nyame mu asefo. Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie wɔ hom sunsum ho, na mma obiara nntwa ne mberantsɛber mu yer nkontompɔ.
Na emi mikyir awargu, Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na ɔse, na nyia ɔdze emimdzi kata n’atar do, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse: Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie wɔ hom sunsum ho, amma hom eenntwa nkontompɔ.
Hom dze hom nsɛm ama Ewuradze aberɛ. Naaso hom se dɛ, ebɛnadze mu na yɛama ɔaberɛ? Wɔ dɛ hom kã dɛ, obiara a ɔyɛ hɔn ho yɛ no enyigye, anaadɛ, atsɛmbu Nyankopɔn no wɔ hen?
3: Hwɛ, morosoma mo bɔfoe, na obesiesie kwan edzi m’enyim: Na Ewuradze a hom rohwehwɛ no no, ɔbɛba n'asɔrfi mu awora; na ahyɛmu no ho bɔfo a hom enyi gye no ho no, hwɛ, ɔreba, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na woana botum egyina ne mbae da no enyim? Na sɛ opue a, woana begyina? Na ɔtse dɛ namfo gya, na ɔtanhofo semina:
Na ɔbɛtsena ase dɛ dwetɛ namfo na yiyimufo, na ɔbɛtsew Levimba ho. Na ɔapɔw hɔn ho dɛ sika na dwetɛ, na wɔdze ayɛyɛdze bɛma Ewuradze wɔ tsenenee mu.
Nna Judah na Jerusalem ayɛyɛdze bɔsɔ Ewuradze enyi dɛ ndadaber no, na tsetse mfe no.

Na mebɛbɛn hom mebobu atsɛn; na mebɛyɛ ɔdasefo a no ho yɛ har metsia abayifo, na awartofo, na ntanhunkafo; na hɔn a wodzi ɔpaanyi emim wɔ n’apaadze mu, na osisi okunafo, na egyankaba, na wɔbɔ ɔhɔho enyi fi ne ndzinoa ho, na wonnsuro me, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na emi Ewuradze mennsakyer; dɛm ntsi na hom, Jacob mba, hom nnsãe a.
Ofitsi hom egyanom nda do na hom adan efi m’ahyɛdze ho, na hom enndzi do. Hom nsan mbra me nkyɛn, na mebɛsan maba hom nkyɛn, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse. Na hom kã dɛ, ebenadze mu na yɛnsan?
Aso nyimpa bowia Nyame adze? Naaso hom wia me. Na hom ka dɛ, ebɛnadze mu na yewia wo? Ebupɛn du na ayɛyɛdze mu a.
Wɔdze ndom adom hom; osiandɛ hom wia me, ɔman yi nyinara a.

Hom mfa ebupɛn du no nyina mbra adzekoradan no mu, ma edziban mbra me fie, na hom mfa yi nsɔ me nhwɛ, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ munnkobue ɔsor ntokura ama hom, na mehue nhyira ama hom a hom rinnya bea a ɔsõ a wɔdze bɛgye.

Na mubotwuw ɔsɛɛfo no enyim wɔ hom ntsi, na ɔnnkɛsɛɛ hom asaase do nduadzewa; eso hom wenyindua rommpo no nsowee egu famu ansaana ne ber edu, dɔm Ewuradze na ose, nsowee egu famu ansaana ne ber edu, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na amanaman nyina bɛfrɛ hom ahomkafo: Osiandɛ hom bɛyɛ enyika asaase, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hom akasa dzendzen wɔ mo do, Ewuradze na ɔse. Naaso hom kã dɛ, ebɛnadze mu na yɛakasa etsia wo?
Hom akã dɛ, Nyame som yɛ kwa: Na ebɛn mfaso na ɔyɛ dɛ yeedzi n'ahyɛdze do, na yɛanantsew eyitam mu wɔ dɔm Ewuradze enyim?
Na afei yɛfrɛ ɔhopɔwnyi ɔhomkanyi; ɛhɛɛ, hɔn a wɔyɛ emumuyɛ no esi hɔn yie; wɔsɔ Nyankopɔn hwɛ, na wofi mu fir.
Nna hɔn a wosuroo Ewuradze no kasaa kyerɛkyerɛ hɔnho: Na Ewuradze kyɛɛn aso, na otsiei, na wɔkyerɛɛw nkaa nwoma wɔ n'enyim maa hɔn a wosuroo Ewuradze, na wɔdwendween ne dzin ho no.
Na wɔbɛyɛ medze, dɔm Ewuradze no ɔse, wɔ da a mebɛyɛ yi no mu, mekyerɛ akoradze soronko; na mebɛkam hɔn do dɛ nyimpa rekam nankasa ne ba a ɔsom no do.
Ɔno na hom bɛsan ebohu sorbi a ɔda tseneneenyi na mumu yɛnyi ntamu, nyia ɔsom Nyame na nyia ɔnnsom no no ntamu.
4: Na, hwɛ, da no reba, ɔrehyew dɛ fononoo; na ahopɔwfo nyina, na hɔn a wɔyɛ emumuyɛ nyina bɛyɛ dɛ mburonan: Na da a ɔreba no bɛhyew hɔn, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ orinngya hɔn ndwow anaa abaw.
Na hom a hom suro me dzin no dze, ndzeyɛtsenenee ewia dze ɔyarsa wɔ ne ntsaban mu bopue ama hom; na hom befir edzi, na hom ehuruhuruw dɛ nantwiban mu anantwifɔr.
Na hom betsiatsia emumuyɛfo do; na wɔbɛyɛ nso wɔ hom ananadze wɔ da a mebɛyɛ yi no mu, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hom nkaa m'akoma Moses mbra a mehyɛɛ no wɔ Horeb maa Israel nyinara no, mekyerɛ ahyɛdze na atsɛmbudze no.
Hwɛ, mobɔsoma nkɔnhyɛnyi Elijah mabrɛ hom ansaana Ewuradze ne da kɛse a ɔyɛ hu no edu.
Na ɔbɛdandan egyanom hɔn akoma aba mba do, na mba hɔn akoma aba hɔn egyanom do; amma maammfa ndom mammbɔbɔ asaase no.

1: Jesus Christ, Nyankopɔn ba no, ne nsɛmpa no ahyɛse.
Dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah mu dɛ, hwɛ, morosoma mo bɔfoe ma oeedzi w'enyim kan a Obesiesie wo kwan mu;
Obi ne ndze retsēa mu wɔ sar no do dɛ, hom nsiesie Ewuradze no kwan, hom mma n'atsempɔn ntsentsen;
John bae bonumae wɔ sar no do na ɔpaa mu kãa nnuho enuma a ɔdze kɔ bɔnfafir mu no ho asɛm.
Na Judea man nyina, na Jerusalemfo nyina fir edzi kɔr no hɔ kɛkãa hɔn bɔn, na onumaa hɔn wɔ esutsen Jordan mu.
Na John fura efupɔnkɔnhwi tam na nwoma abɔdo bɔ n'asen, na odzi akyekyemawe na kwaa mu wo.
Na ɔpaa mu kãa dɛ, Obi a no ho yɛ dzen kyɛn me dzi m'ekyir reba a no nsokota ho ahoma no mennsɛ dɛ mbɔkotow masan.
Emidze, munumaa hom nsu mu, na ɔnodze, obonuma hom wɔ sunsum krɔnkrɔn mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu no Jesus fii Galilee Nazareth bae, na John numaa no wɔ Jordan mu.
Na ntsɛmara a ofi nsu no mu reba no, ohun dɛ sor apaa ebien na Sunsum no tse dɛ ebubur risian ba no do:
Na ndze bi fii sor baa dɛ, ɔwo nye mo Dɔba a m'enyi sɔ wo.
Na ntsɛmara na Sunsum no twee no kɔr sar no do.
Na odzii sar no do hɔ adaduanan, ma Satan sɔɔ no hwɛe; na ɔnye hambowa wɔ hɔ; na abɔfo no soom no.
Na afei woyii John mae no ekyir no, Jesus baa Galilee bɛkãa Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no, na ɔsee dɛ,
Aber no asõ na Nyankopɔn ahenman no abɛn: hom nnu homho, na hom ngye asɛmpa no ndzi.
Na ɔnenam Galilee po ho no ohun Simon nye Simon no nua Andrew dɛ worugu asawu wɔ po mu, osiandɛ wɔyɛ enufo.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, hom mbedzi n'ekyir na mebɛyɛ hom ma hom ayɛ nyimpa enufo.
Na ntsɛmara wɔdaan asawu no gyaae na wobedzi n'ekyir.
Na ɔkɔr enyim kakra no, ohun James, Zebedee ne ba no, ɔnye no nua John a hɔn so wɔwɔ hɛn mu resa hɔn asawu.
Na ntsɛmara ɔfrɛɛ hɔn; na wɔdaan hɔn egya Zebedee nye apaafo no gyaa hɛn no mu, na wokedzi n'akyir.
Na wɔkɔr Capernaum; na ntsɛmara ahomgyeda no ɔkɛhɛɛn nhyiamudan no mu kyerɛkyerɛ.
Na ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛɛ hɔn ahobow, osiandɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn dɛ nyia ɔwɔ tum, na ɔnntse dɛ kyerɛwfo no.
Na ntsɛmara nyimpa bi wɔ nhyiamudan no mu a ɔwɔ sunsum fi;
na ɔkaa mu see dɛ, ebɛnadze na yɛnye wo wɔ yɛ, Jesus Nazarethnyi? Ana ebae abɛsɛɛ hɛn? Minyim wo nyimpa ban, Nyankopɔn no Hotseweenyi no.
Na Jesus bɔɔ no ham dɛ, ka w'ano to mu, na fi no mu fi.
Na sunsum fī no twaa no ehim na ɔkaa mu kɛse fii no mu firii.
Na hɔn nyina ho boow hɔn ara ma wobisabisaa hɔnho dɛ, ebɛnadze nye yi? Nkyerɛkyerɛ fofor bɛn a! Ɔdze tum hyɛ esusum fī mpo, na wotsie n'asɛm.
Na ntsɛmara ne nka tahyee ɔman a etwa Galilee ho nyina mu.
Na ntsɛmara wofi nhyiamudan no mu firii no wɔbaa Simon nye Andrew fie, wɔnye James nye John.
Na Simon n'asɛw da hɔ yar papu; na ntsɛmara wɔkãa no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ no;
na ɔbae bosuoo ne nsamu maa no do; na papu no fii no do, na ɔsoom hɔn.
Na ewimbir a ewia kɔtɔree no wɔdze hɔn a wɔyaryar na hɔn a mbɔsam afa hɔn nyina brɛɛ no.
Na kurow no nyina behyiaa mu wɔ abow no ano.
Na ɔyɛɛ dodowara a wɔyar yarba horow edur, na otuu mbɔnsam pii na wɔamma mbɔnsam no kwan dɛ wɔnkasa, osiandɛ wonyim no.
Na anapaatu,ansaana adze rebɛkye no, ɔsoɛree na ofiri edzi kɔr sar bi do, na ɔkɔsɔree wɔ hɔ.
Na Simon ɔnye hɔn a wɔka no ho no, wotsiiw no;
na wohun no na wɔsee no dɛ, nyimpa nyina rohwehwɛ wo.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mma yɛnkɔ nkurow nkaa no so mu, ma maakɛkã asɛm no wɔ hɔ so, osiandɛ dɛm ntsi na mifir edzi.
Na ɔkɔr hɔn nhyiamudan a ɔwɔ Galilee nyina mu kɛkãa asɛm no, na otuu mbɔnsam.
Na kwatanyi bi baa no hɔ bɛserɛɛ no, bɔkotoow no, na ɔsee no dɛ, sɛ epɛ a, ibotum dɛ ema mo ho san.
Na ne yamu hyehyee no no, ɔtseen ne nsa dze kãa no, na ɔsee no dɛ,
Mepɛ, wo ho nsan. Na ntsɛmara na kwata no fii no ho, ma no ho sanee.
Na ɔbraa no dzendzenndzen, na ntsemara oyii no edzi, na ɔsee no dɛ,
Hwɛ ma aannkã biribi annkyerɛ biara; na san kɔ, fa woho kɛkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no, na w'ahosan ntsi kɛma dza Moses hyɛe no fa yɛ dase ma hɔn.
Na ɔnodze ɔdze kɛtahyee pii, na ɔmaa asɛm no trɛe, ma dɛm ntsi Jesus enntum annkɔ kurow bi mu petee bio, na sar do na ɔtsenae; na wofii mbea nyina baa ne nkyɛn.
2: Na nda kakra ekyir, ɔkɔr Capernaum bio no, wɔtsee dɛ ɔwɔ fie.
Na dodowara behyiaa mu, ma wonnya kwan bio mma hɔn, nnyɛ abowano mpo; na ɔkãa asɛm no kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na wɔdze mbubuinyi a wɔso no baanan baa no hɔ.
Na wonnya kwan nntwe mmbɛn no wɔ nyimpadodow ntsi no, wɔkɛpaa mbrɛ ɔwɔ no etsifi; na wonyae bɔɔr mu no, wɔdze kɛtɛ a mbubuinyi no da do no duaa mu gyaagyaa mu sii famu.
Na Jesus hun hɔn gyedzi no, ɔsee mububunyi no dɛ, ɔba, wɔdze wobɔn akyɛ wo.
Na kyerɛwfo no binom tsetse hɔ, na wɔrodwendwen hɔn akoma mu dɛ,
ɔyɛ dɛn na oyi kasa dɛm yi? Ebususɛm na ɔkã: woana botum dze bɔn akyɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn nkotoo?
Na ntsɛmara Jesus hun wɔ no sunsum mu dɛ wɔrodwendwen dɛm wɔ hɔn akoma mu no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom rodwendwen ndzɛmba yinom wɔ hom akoma mu yi?
Mmuana na ɔyɛ mberɛw kɛse, ebɛse mbubunyi no dɛ, wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo, anaa ebɛse dɛ, Soɛr, fa wo kɛtɛ, na nantsew, a?
Na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma hom ehu dɛ nyimpa Ba no wɔ tum wɔ asaase do dɛ ɔdze bɔn kyɛ, (ɔsee mbubuinyi no dɛ),
Mese wo dɛ, Soɛr, fa wo kɛtɛ na kɔ wo fie.
Na ɔsoɛree, na ntsɛmara ɔfaa kɛtɛ no, na osii mu wɔ hɔn nyina enyim kɔree. Na ɔmaa hɔn nyina ho boow hɔn, na wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam dɛ, Yennhun dɛm yi bi da.
Na ofir edzi bio kɔr mpoano; na nyimpadodow no nyina kɔr no hɔ, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na ɔresen no ohun Alphæus ne ba Levi dɛ ɔtse atowgye, na ɔsee no dɛ, ka mo do. Na ɔsoɛree kaa no do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔtse edzidzi wɔ ne fie; na atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo pii nye Jesus nye n'esuafo bɛtsenatsenaa hɔ: Na hɔn a wɔka no do no wɔdɔɔ sõ.
Na Phariseefo hɔn akyerɛwfo no wɔhun dɛ ɔnye ndzebɔnyɛfo nye atowgyefo ridzidzi no, wɔsee n'esuafo no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔnye atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo dzidzi nom yi?
Na Jesus tsee no ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hɔn a wɔtse hɔn apɔw mu no, wonnhia oduyɛfo, na mbom hɔn a wɔyar no a: mammbɛfrɛ atseneneefo, na mbom ndzebɔnyɛfo a.
Na John n'esuafo nye Phariseefo no wɔtɔ mbuada dzi: na wɔbae bɛsee no dɛ,ɔyɛ dɛn na John n'esuafo nye Phariseefo hɔn esuafo no wodzi mbuada, na w'esuafo dze, wonndzi mbuada?
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Ayeforpia mu mba no, aber a ayeforkun no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn, wobotum edzi mbuada anaa?
Aber tsentsen biara a wɔwɔ ayeforkun no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn no, worunntum nndzi mbuada. Na nda bɛba a wobeyi ayeforkun no efi hɔn nkyɛn, na da no mu nkyii wobedzi mbuada.
obi mmfa tam fofor sin nntaa atar dadaw mu: Dɛm no, dza wɔdze taa mu no yi fi mu, fofor no fi dadaw no mu, na ntsewee no yɛ kɛse.
Na obi mmfa wenyin fofor nngu nwomantoa dadaw mu dɛm no, wenuin no bɛpaa nwomantoa no, na wenyin asɛɛ, ɔnye nwomantoa no so: na wenyin fofor dze, wɔdze gu nwomantoa fofor mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ okoduaa eburow kwã mu ahomgyeda; na n'esuafo no, wɔ nam rokɔ no, wɔhyɛɛ ase pempaan eburow mbɛtsem no bi.
Na Phariseefo no se no dɛ, hwɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na wɔreyɛ dza ɔmmfa mbra mu wɔ ahomgyeda mu yi?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nnkenkaan ara pɛn dza David, aber a ohiaa no, na ɔkɔm dzee ɔnoara na hɔn a wɔka no ho no, ɔyɛe no?
mbrɛ ɔkɛhɛɛn Nyankopɔn fie, aber a Abiathar yɛ ɔsɔfopanyin no, na okedzii kyerɛpaanoo a ɔmmfa mbra mu dɛ obiara dzi dɛ asɔfo no nko, na ɔmaa hɔn a wɔka no ho no so bi?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, nyimpa ntsi na wɔyɛɛ ahomgyeda, na nnyɛ ahomgyeda ntsi nyimpa Ba no yɛ ahomgyeda no so mpo no wura.
3: Na ɔkɛhɛɛn nhyiamudan no mu bio; na nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a ne nsa adwe.
Na wɔtsɛɛw no dɛ ɔbɛyɛ no edur ahomgyeda no, ma wɔaatõa no.
Na ɔsee nyimapa no a ne nsa adwe no dɛ, Soɛr gyina finimfin.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ ahomgyeda wɔbɛyɛ dza oye, anan wɔbɛyɛ dza omuo? Wɔbɛgye nkwa, anaa woboku a?
Na womuaa hɔn ano. Na ɔhwɛɛ hɔn hyiae ebufuw do, na hɔn akoma dzen ntsi ɔyɛɛ no yaw no, ɔsee nyimpa no dɛ, tsen wo nsa. Na ɔtsenee; na ne nsa no sanee yɛɛ mu.
Na Phariseefo no fir edzi, na ntsɛmara wɔnye Herod akadofo kɛpaam no do mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ asɛɛ no.
Na Jesus nye n'esuafo twee hɔnho kɔr mpoano; na nyimpadodow pii fii Galilee kaa no do;
na wofi Judea, na wofi Jerusalem, na wofi Idumæa, na Jordan egya, na Tyre nye Sidon nkyɛn, nyimpadodow pii a wɔtsee ndzɛmba akɛse pii a ɔyɛe no, wɔbaa ne nkyɛn.
Na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ n'esuafo no dɛ hɛn kakraba bi ntweɔn no wɔ nyimpadodow no ntsi, mma wɔaannkyer no do,
osiandɛ ɔsaa pii yarba, na dɛm ntsi dodowara a mbusu horow aba hɔn do bɛkyeer no do dɛ wobosuo no mu.
Na esunsum fī so, sɛ wohu no a, wotwa hwe n'enyim, na wɔka mu dɛ, ɔwo nye Nyankopɔn Ba no.
Na ɔbraa hɔn ketsee dɛ mma wonnyi no nnkyerɛ
Na ɔkɔr koko do, na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn a noara rohwehwɛ hɔn no, na wɔkɔr ne nkyɛn.
Na oyii duebien, dɛ wɔnye no bɛtsena,
na dɛ obɔsoma hɔn ama wɔaakɛkã asɛm no na woeenya tum dze etu mbɔnsam
Na Simon ɔtoo no dzin Peter,
na Zebedee ba James, nye James no nua John; na ɔtoo hɔn dzin Boanerges, ɔno nye dɛ Senaman Mba;
nye Andrew, nye Matthew, nye Thomas, nye Alphæus ba James, nye Thaddæus
nye Canananyi Simon, nye Judah Iscariot a ɔnoara so yii no mae no.
Na ɔbaa fie; na nyimpadodow no behyiaa bio, ma dɛm ntsi woenntum enndi edziban mpo.
Na n'ebusuafo no tsee no, wofir edzi dɛ wɔrebɛkyer non, na wɔsee dɛ neyi nnyi no ho do.
Na kyerɛwfo no a wofi Jerusalem bae no see dɛ, ɔwɔ Beelzebul, na mbɔnsan hɔn panyin do na ɔnam tu mbɔnsam no.
Na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn baa ne nkyɛn no, obubuu mbɛ see hɔn dɛ, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na Satan botum etu Satan?
Na sɛ ahenman nye no ho dzi mpaapaamu a, ahenman no nntum nngyina.
Na sɛ ofi nye no ho dzi mpaapaamu a, ofi no runntum nngyina.
Na sɛ Satan asoɛr nankasa no do na oedzi mpaapaamu a, onntum nngyina na oedu ewie.
Na obi nntum nnkɔ ɔkatakyi fie nnkɔfow n'efidze, gyedɛ odzi kan kyerkyer ɔkatakyi no, ansaana ɔafow ne fie.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, bɔn nyina wɔdze bɛkyɛ nyimpa mba, nye ebususɛm a wɔbɛka nyina;
na nyia ɔbɛkã ebususɛm etsia Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no, onnya fakyɛ da, na onnyiewiei afɔdzi da no do:
osiandɛ wɔsee dɛ, ɔwɔ sunsum fi.
Na ne nã nye no nuanom bae begyinaa abow enyim somae ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ no.
Na nyimpadodow tsetse ne nkyɛn, na wɔsee no dɛ, hwɛ, wo nã ɔnye wo nuanom gyina abow enyim rohwehwɛ wo.
Na obuaa hɔn see dɛ, Woana nye me nã nye mo nuanom?
Na ɔtoo n'enyi hwɛɛ hɔn a wɔtsetse ne nkyɛn hyiae no, ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, me nã nye mo nuanom.
Na obiara a ɔbɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ne pɛ no, ɔno nye mo nua, nye m'akyerɛbaa, nye me nã.
4: Na ɔhyɛɛ ase bio kyerɛkyerɛ wɔ mpoano. Na nyimpadodow pii behyiaa ne nkyɛn, ma dɛm ntsi ɔkɔr hɛn mu kɛtsenaa ase wɔ po enyi, na nyimpadodow no nyina wɔ mpoano wɔ daadze.
Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn ndzemba pii wɔ mbɛbu mu, na ɔsee hɔn wɔ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu dɛ,
Hom ntsie: hwɛ, oduafo no kɔree kɛpee;
na ɔrepe no, ɔbaa dɛ bi koguu kwan nkyɛn na nnoma bae bɔsosɔwee.
Na bi koguu abosamdo mbrɛ oennya dɛtse pii; na ntsɛmara na ofirii, osiandɛ dɛtse a ɔdɔ;
na ewia soɛree no, ɔhyewee, na osiandɛ onnyi ndwow ntsi ɔkyenkyenee.
Na bi so koguu nsoɛ mu, na nsoɛ no nyinii, na omiaa no, ma ɔannsow aba.
Na bi so koguu asaase pa mu, na ɔsoow bi eduasa, bi eduosia, bi ɔha.
Na ɔsee dɛ, nyia ɔwɔ aso a wɔdze tsie, ma ontsie.
Na ɔkaa no nko no, hɔn a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no wɔnye duebien no bisaa no mbɛ no ase.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom na wɔdze Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu esumasɛm ama hom; na hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyir no dze, wɔkyerɛ hɔn ne nyina mbɛbu mu,
na ɔhwɛ a, wɔaahwɛ na woeenhu, na ɔtse a, wɔaatse na wɔaanntse ase, amma mber bi wɔaanndan na wɔaammfa hɔn bɔn annkyɛ hɔn.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nnyim bɛ yi? Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na hom ehu mbɛ nyina ase?
Oduafo no pe asɛm no.
Na iyinom nye hɔn a wɔwɔ kwan nkyɛn no, wɔ mbrɛ wɔpe asɛm no; na wɔatse no, Satan ba ntsɛmara beyi asɛm no a wɔpee wɔ hɔn mu no.
Na iyinom so nye hɔn a wɔpe hɔn abosamdo no; hɔn a wɔtse asɛm no a, ntsɛmara wɔdze dɛw gye;
na wonnyi ndwow wɔ hɔn mu, na wonnyi hɔ ma akyɛr ntsi, na sɛ abɛbrɛsɛ anaa ahohia soɛr wɔ asɛm no ntsi a, ntsɛmara no ato hɔn fintsidua.
Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔpe hɔn nsoɛ mu no, hɔn a wɔaste asɛm no,
na wiadze yi mu akɔdadwen nye ahonya adaadaa nye adzɛmba nkaa no ho akɔndɔ kɔ mu, na omia asɛm no, ma ɔnnsow aba.
Na iyinom nye hɔn a wɔpe hɔn asaase pa mu no, hɔn a wɔtse asɛm no na wɔgye na wɔsow aba, bi eduasa, bi edosia, bi ɔha.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana wɔdze kandzea ba dɛ wɔdze besi kuruw ase anaa mpa ase? Nnyɛ dɛ wɔdze besi kandzeadua do bi?
Na biribi nnsuma gyedɛ woribeyi akyerɛ, na woennhuntsa biribi gyedɛ ɔrebɛda gua.
Sɛ obi wɔ aso a wɔdze tsie a, ma ontsie.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ dza hom tse no yie: Esusudze kor a hom dze susu wɔdze bosusu ama hom, na wɔdze bi bɛka hom ho.
Na nyia ɔwɔ no, wɔbɛma no, na nyia onnyi no, dza ɔwɔ no mpo wɔbɛgye ne nsamu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, mbrɛ Nyankopɔn n'ahenman tse nye yi, dɛ nyimpa bɛpe aba wɔ famu;
na ɔbɛda na obenyan adzesaa nye adzekyee, na aba no befir na oenyin, na onnyim mbrɛ ɔyɛe.
Na asaase nankasa na ɔsow aba, ahaban no dzi kan, na nkyii ɔayɛ bɛtsem no mu.
Na sɛ aba no ber a, ntsemara na ɔdze kantankrankye ato mu, osiandɛ twaber edu.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ebɛnadze na yɛdze bɔto Nyankopɔn ahenman ho? Anaadɛ ebɛn dɛ na yɛdze bɛkyerɛ?
ɔtse dɛ sinape abafua a wodua no famu a osuar kyɛn aba a ɔwɔ asaase nyina;
na woedua no, onyin na ɔyɛ kɛse kyɛn nhaban nyina, na ɔtoto abaw akɛse, ma wimu nnoma botum agye no nwin ase.
Na mbɛ a ɔtsetse dɛm yi pii na ɔdze kãa asɛm kyerɛɛ hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ wobotum etsie.
Na oennkwetsi bɛ annkasa annkyerɛ hɔn, na ɔka hɔn nko a, ɔkyerɛ n'esafo no ndzɛmba nyina ase.
Na da kor no ara, odur ewimbir no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mma yentwa nkɔ esuegya noho.
Na wogyaa nyimpadodow no kwan no, wɔfaa no dɛ mbrɛ ɔwɔ hɛn no mu ara. Na ahɛn nkakraba bi so ka ho.
Na mframa kɛse bɔɔ huu, na asorɛkye bui bɔhwee hɛn no mu, na ɔyɛɛ mã.
Na ɔnodze, ɔwɔ hɛntu no da sundze do; na wonyaan no na wɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔnnyɛ wo asɛm dɛ yɛrehera?
Na onyanee no, ɔbraa mframa no, na ɔsee po no dɛ, taa dzinn! Na mframa no dwee, na ɔyɛɛ dzinn koraa.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na hom yɛ ehufo? Ana hom da ho nnyi gyedzi?
Na wosuroo pii, na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, woana nye yi a mframa na po mpo wotsie n'asɛm yi?
5: Na wɔbaa po no n'egya wɔ Gerasafo asaase do.
Na ofii hɛn no mu no, ntsɛmara na nyimpa bi a ɔwɔ sunsum fi fir aboda mu behyiaa no:
ɔno na ɔdze aboda mu ayɛ ne tsenabew; na obiara nntum mmfa nkɔnsɔnkɔsɔn mpo nnkyekyer no bio,
na mber pii wɔdze mpokyerɛ nye nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn akyekyer no, na ɔatsetsew nkɔnsɔkɔnsɔn no mu, na oebubu mpokyerɛ no, na obiara nnyi ahoɔdze dɛ ɔdɔdwedwe no.
Na dabaa adzesaa nye adzekyee na ɔwɔ aboda mu nye nkokwaa do, ɔretsēatsea mu, na ɔdze abo rutwitwa noho.
Na ohun Jesus wɔ ekyirkyir no, otutuu mbirika kɔkotow no;
na ɔdze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu see dɛ, menye wo wɔ ebɛn yɛ, Jesus, ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn Ba? Mekã Nyankopɔn dɛ mma nnhaw me.
Osiandɛ ɔase no dɛ, Sunsum fi, fi nyimpa no mu!
Na obisaa no dɛ, Wo dzin dze dɛn? Na ɔsee no dɛ, Me dzin dze Legion, osiandɛ yɛdɔɔ sõ.
Na ɔserɛɛ no pii dɛ mma ɔmmpam hɔn mmfi asaase no do.
Na mprekokuw kɛse bi wɔ kokwaa ne nkyɛn a woridzidzi.
Na wɔserɛɛ no see dɛ, Soma hɛn mpreko no mu, ma yɛnkɔ hɔn mu.
Na ɔmaa hɔn kwan. Na esunsum fī no fir edzi kɛhɛɛn mpreko no mu,na okuw no nyina faa twitwi kesiaan ɔbo kronn no koguguu po no mu, wɔbɛyɛ mpemebien, na wɔtseetse wui wɔ po no mu.
Na hɔn a wɔrenyn mpreko no guanee na wɔkɛkãe wɔ kurow no mu na no nkwaado. Na wofir edzi bɔhwɛɛ adze kor a aba no.
Na wɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn no, wobohun nyia mbɔnsan faa no dɛ ɔtse hɔ hyɛ atar, na n'adwen mu atsew no, nyia onyaa Legion no no a; na wosuroi.
Na hɔn a wohunii no kãa mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ nyia mbɔnsam faa no nye mpreko no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na wɔhyɛɛ ase serɛɛ no dɛ omfu hɔn ntoaado nkɔ.
Na ɔreba hɛn no mu no, nyimpa a nkan no mbɔnsam faa no no serɛɛ no dɛ ɔnye no bɛtsena.
na Jesus amma no kwan, na ɔsee no dɛ, kɔ wo fie w'ebususuafo nkyɛn kɛkã ndzemba akɛse a Ewuradze ayɛ ama wo, na oehu wo mbɔbɔr.
Na osii mu kɔree, na ɔkɛhyɛɛ ase kãa ndzɛmba akɛse a Jesus yɛe maa no wɔ Decapolis, na ɔyɛɛ nyimpa nyina nwanwa.
Na Jesus nam hɛn no mu twae baa esuegya bio no, nyimapdodow pii behyiaa no ho: na ɔwɔ mpoano.
Na nhyiamudan mu mpanyin no mu baako a ne dzin dze Jairus bae; na ohun no no, ɔhwee n'ananadze,
na ɔserɛɛ no pii dɛ, me babaa kakraba da wuso: meserɛ wo, bra bɛfa wo nsa to no do, ma no ho nyɛ no dzen na onnya nkwa.
Na ɔnye no kɔree, na nyimpadodow pii kaa no do, na wɔkyeer no do.
Na ɔbaa bi a oenya bɔgyaagu mfe duebien,
na oehu amandze pii wɔ eduyɛfo pii nsa, na ɔahwer dza ɔwɔ nyina, na ɔnnyɛ yie biara, na mbom ɔyɛ no kɛse,
ɔtsee Jesus nka no, obedzi n'ekyir nyimpadodow no mu bɛkãa n'atar;
osiandɛ ɔsee dɛ, sɛ mekã n'atar nko a, mo ho bɛyɛ me dzen.
Na ntsɛmara no bɔgya bura wewee, na ɔtsee wɔ no honam mu dɛ woeyi no mbusu no kɔ.
Na ntsɛmara Jesus hun wɔ no mu dɛ ahoɔdzen a ɔwɔ no mu bi efi mu efi no, ɔdaan noho wɔ nyimpadodow no mu see dɛ, woana kãa m'atar?
Na n'esuafo no see no dɛ, ihu dɛ nyimpadodow no akyer wo do, na ese dɛ, woana kãa me?
Na ɔtaa n'enyi aprɔw dɛ obohu nyia ɔyɛɛ adze no.
Na ɔbaa no, onyim dza wɔayɛ wɔ no mu no, ɔdze suro nye ahopopo bae botwae hwee n'enyim na ɔkãa no nokwar nyina kyerɛɛ no.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Babaa, wo gyedzi agye wo: kɔ asomdwee mu, na wo ho nyɛ wo dzen mfi wo mbusu mu.
Na ɔrekasa no, binom finhyiamudan mu panyin no ne fie bae bɛsee dɛ, wo babaa no ewu: eda ho haw Kyerɛkyerɛfo no ayɛ dɛn?
Na Jesus dze, ɔammfa asɛm a wɔrekã no annyɛ hwee; na ɔsee nhyiamudan mu panyin no dɛ, mma nnsuro, na gye dzi ara.
na ɔamma obiara kwan amma ɔnye no eenndzi n'ekyir, gyedɛ Peter nye James nye John, James no nua no.
Na wɔbaa nhyiamudan mu panyin ne fie; na ohun gyigyeegye, nye hɔn a worusū na wɔreka mmɔn;
na ɔkɔr mu no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom reyɛ dede na hom rusū yi? Abofraba no nnwiu, na ɔada.
Na wɔsereew no twee. Na ɔnodze, oyii hɔn nyina edzi no, ɔfaa abofraba no n'egya nye ne nã na ɔnye hɔn a wɔka no ho no kɔr mbrɛ abofraba no wɔ.
Na osuoo abofraba no ne nsamu, na ɔsee dɛ, Talitha, cumi: Ne nkyerɛase nye dɛ, Akataasia, mese wo dɛ, Nyan.
Na ntsɛmara na akataasia no soɛree na ɔnantsewee: Na oedzi mfe duebien. Na ntsɛmara hɔn ho boow hɔn kɛse.
Na ɔbara hɔn ketsee dɛ mma obiara nntse, na ɔsee dɛ wɔmma no biribi ma ondzi.
6: Na ofii hɔ kɔree, na ɔbaa nankasa no kurow mu, na n'esuafo no kaa no do.

Na ahomgyeda no durii no, ɔhyɛɛ ase kyerɛkyerɛ wɔ nhyiamudan no mu, na nyimpadodow no wotsie no no, hɔn ho boow hɔn dɛ, henfa na oyi nyaa ndzɛmba yi, na ebɛn nyansa nye dza wɔdze ama no yi, na tum ndwuma dɛm yi a ɔdze ne nsa ayɛ yi?
Ana nnyɛ dwimfo no a ayɛ Mary ba no, James nye Judas nye Simon hɔn nua no nye yi bi? Ana nnyɛ ne nkyerɛbaa na wɔwɔ hɛn nkyɛn ha yi? Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn fintsidua.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi nnhwer enyidzi gyedɛ nankasa no kurow mu, nye n'ebusuafo mu, nye nankasa ne fie.
Na oentum annyɛ tum edwuma biara wɔ hɔ, gyedɛ ɔdze ne nsa too ayarfo kumaabi do yɛɛ hɔn edur.
Na wonnyi gyedzi dɛm yi ntsi ɔyɛɛ no nwanwa. Na okekyiin nkurobaasa kyerɛkyerɛ.
Na ɔfrɛɛ duebien no, na ɔhyɛɛ ase somaa hɔn beenu beenu, na ɔmaa hɔn tum wɔ esusum fī do;
na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ mma wɔmmfa biribi nntu kwan, gyedɛ poma nko: Mma wɔmmfa edziban anaa kotoku, anaa sika wɔ hɔn abɔdo mu;
na wɔnhyɛ mpaboa, na mma wɔnnhyɛ ntar ebien.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, beebiara mbrɛ hom bɛhɛn fi biara mu no, hom ntsena hɔ nkodu dɛ hom befi hɔ akɔ.
Na kurow biara a ɔnnkɛgye hom no, na wonnketsie hom wɔ mu no, hom rokɔ a, hom mporoporow hom ananadze huntuma ngye hɔn dase.
Na wɔkɔree kɛkãa dɛ wonnu hɔnho.
na wtuu mbɔnsam pii na wɔdze ngo seraa ayarfo pii yɛɛ hɔn edur.
Na ɔhen Herod tsee, osiandɛ ne dzin tahyee: Na ɔsee dɛ, John Onumanyi no enyan efi ewufo mu: dɛm ntsi na tum ndzɛmba yi reyɛ no mu edwuma.
Na binom see dɛ, Elijah a; na binom so see dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi a, ɔtse dɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no mu baako.
Na Herod tsee no ɔsee dɛ, John a mutwaa ne tsir no enyan bio.
Nna Herod nankasa asoma ma woekosuo John mu akyer no akɔto efiadze, wɔ no nua Philip yer Herodias ntsi: na ɔawar no.
Na John see Herod dɛ, ɔmmfa mbra mu mma wo dɛ ebɔwar wo nua ne yer.
Na Herodias dze no hyɛɛ ne yamu, na ɔpɛɛ dɛ oku no, na oenntum:
Osiandɛ Herod suroo John, onyim dɛ ɔyɛ nyimpa tsenenee nye krɔnkrɔn ntsi, na ɔbɔɔ no ho ban. Na otsiee no no, ɔyɛɛ no ahokyer dodow, na ɔdze dɛw tsiee no.
Na da a ɔse durii a Herod ridzi n'awoda no, ɔtoo pon maa n'ekunyin nye n'asafohen nye Galilee mpanyimfo;
na Herodias ne babaa baa bɛsawee ma ɔsɔɔ Herod nye hɔn a wɔtse edzidzi no enyiwa: na ɔhen no see akataasia no dɛ, biribiara a ibebisa me, mebɛma wo.
Na ɔkãa ntam kyerɛɛ no dɛ, biribiara a ibebisa me, mebɛma wo dze ekesi m'ahenman ne fã.
Na ɔkɔree kɛsee ne nã dɛ, Mimbisa ebɛnadze? Na ɔsee dɛ, John Onumanyino ne tsir.
Na ntsɛmara ɔyɛɛ har baa ɔhen ne nkyɛn, na obebisaa no dɛ, Mepɛ dɛ edze John Onumanyi no ne tsir to aboyaa mu ma me seseiara.
Na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen no yaw dodoodow na osian ne ntam nye hɔn a wɔnye no tse edzidzi no ntsi, ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔkam no.
Na ntsɛmara ɔhen no somaa sordaanyi hyɛɛ no dɛ ɔnkɛfa ne tsir mbra; na ɔkɔree kotwaa ne tsir wɔ efiadze,
na ɔdze ne tsir too aboyaa mu bae, na ɔdze maa akataasia no, na akataasia no dze kɛmaa ne nã.
Na n'esuafo no tsee no, wɔbae bɛfaa no fun na wɔdze kɔtoo da bi mu.
Na Ndwuma no boaa hɔn ano baa Jesus nkyɛn na wɔbɛkãa no ne nyina, dza wɔayɛ nye dza wɔakyerɛkyerɛ.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom ankasa hom mbra sar do nkyɛn beebi, na hom mbɔhom kakra. Osiandɛ dodowara reba rokɔ, na wonnya adagyer nndzidzi mpo.
Na wosii mu nam hɛn mu kɔr sar do beebi.
Na nyimpa pii hun dɛ worisi mu, na wonyim hɔn no, wofi nkurow nyina mu tutuu mbirika nam daadze kɔr hɔ, na wotwaa hɔn ano.
Na ɔbaa daadze no, ohun nyimpadodow pii na ne yamu hyehyee no maa hɔn osiandɛ wɔtse dɛ nguan a wonnyi hwɛfo; na ɔhyɛɛ ase kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn ndzɛmba pii.
Na adze rebɛsã no, n'esuafo baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, Ha sar do a, na adze so resã;
gyaa hɔn ma wɔnkɔ mfuwa nye nkurobaasa a etwa ehyia yi mu nkɔtɔ biribi ndzi.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, homara hom mma hɔn biribi ma wondzi. Na wɔsee no dɛ, Ana yɛnkɔtɔ paanoo denare ahaenu mfa mma hɔn ma wondzi?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom wɔ paanoo ahen? Hom nkɔhwɛ. Na wokohunii no wɔsee dɛ, Enum, ɔnye esunam ebien.
Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔmma hɔn nyinara ntsenatsena ekuw wɔ efuw momm no do.
Na wɔtsenatsenaa akyerɛpɛn akyerɛpɛn, ɔha, ɔha, nye eduonum, eduonum.
Na ɔfaa paanoo enum no, nye esunam ebien no, na ɔhwɛɛ sor no, ohyiraa do, na obubuu paanoo no, na ɔdze maa n'esuafo no dɛ wɔmfa ntoto hɔn enyim; na ɔkyɛɛ esunam ebien mu maa hɔn nyinara.
Na hɔn nyina dzidzi na wɔmee.
Na wɔtasee mporoporoba nkɛntsɛn duebien nye esunam no so bi.
Na hɔn a wodzii paanoo no, wɔyɛ mbarimba mpemenum.
Na ntsɛmara opiapiaa n'esuafo no dɛ wɔnkɔ hɛn mu na wondzi n'enyim kan wɔ esuegya noho wɔ Bethsaida, ma ɔnodze, ongya nyimpadodow no kwan.
Na ɔkraa hɔn no, osii mu kɔr kokwaa do kɔsɔree.
Na odur anafua no, hɛn no wɔ po finimfin, na no nko wɔ daadze.
Na ohun dɛ wɔrofona akwan osiandɛ mframa dasu a otsia anan no mu no ɔnantseew po enyi baa hɔn nkyɛn, na nkyɛ ɔpɛ apa hɔn ho;
na hɔndze, wohun dɛ ɔrenantsew po enyi no, wɔdween dɛ saman a, na wɔkekaa mu,
osiandɛ hɔn nyina hun no ma hɔn akoma tui. Na ntsɛmara ɔnye hɔn kasae, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nhyɛ dzen; mara a, mma hom nnsuro.
Na ɔkɔr hɔn nkyɛn wɔ hɛn no mu, na mframa no gyaae. Na hɔn ho boow hɔn dodoodow koraa,
osiandɛ wɔammfa paanoo no ho adwen, na hɔn akoma epirim.
Na wotwae no, wɔbaa Gennesaret asaase do na wodwirii.
Na wofi hɛn mu no, ntsemara na wohun no,
na wotutuu mbirika kekyiin asaase nyina mu, na wɔhyɛɛ ase soaa hɔn a wɔyar wɔ nkɛtɛ do baa beebiara a wɔtsee dɛ ɔwɔ no.
Na beebiara a ɔkɔree, nkurobaase anaa nkurow anaa mfuwa mu o, wɔdze ayarfo toto gua do, na wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmma wɔnkã n'atar ano ndwow nko; na dodow a wɔkãa no no, hɔn ho yɛɛ hɔn dzen.
7: Na Phariseefo no nye kyerɛwfo bi a wofi Jerusalem bae behyiaa ne nkyɛn,
na wohun dɛ n'esuafo no bi dze nsa fī, ɔnye dɛ dza wɔannhohor ho, ridzi paanoo.
Na Phariseefo no nye Jewfo nyina, sɛ wɔannhohor hɔn nsa ho yie a, wonndzidzi, na wosuo mpanyimpafo atsetsem no mu;
na sɛ wofi gua do ba, na wɔannhohor hɔnho a, wonndzidzi, na ndzɛmba pii ka ho a wɔagye dɛ wobosuo mu, nkuraba nye nhia nye nyewasɛn ho hohor.
Na Pharisefo no nye kyerɛwfo no bisaa no dɛ, nɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w'esuafo nnantsew mpanyimfo atsetsesɛm no do, na wɔdze nsa fī dzidzi yi?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Isaiah hyɛɛ hom ndabrabafo ho nkɔm yie dɛ (dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no), ɔman yi dze hɔn anofamfa dzi me nyi, na hɔn akoma dze, ɔnye me ntamu twe kɛse;
Na wɔsɔr me gyan, wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɔyɛ nyimpa ahyɛdze.
Na hom egya Nyankopɔn ne mbra hɔ: Hom esuo nyimpa atsetsesɛm mu.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom pow Nyankopɔn ne mbra no papaara pi, ma ho eedzi ho atsetsesɛm do.
Na Moses kãa dɛ, dzi w'egya nye wo nã nyi, na obiara a ɔhyɛ egya anaa nã ahorohoraa no onwu owu no;
na homdze, hom se dɛ, sɛ nyimpa bi se n'egya anaa ne nã dɛ, Corban (ɔnye dɛ, Akyɛdze) nye biribiara a nkyɛ edze banya mo ho mfaso no a,
hom mma na kwan mma ɔnnyɛ biribi mma n'egya anaa ne na bio:
Ɔnam hom atsetseasɛm a hom dze bae no do, hom amma Nyankopɔn asɛm enntsim; na ndzɛmba a ɔtse dɛm pii na hom yɛ.
Na ɔfrɛɛ nyimpadodow no baa ne nkyɛn bio no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nyina ntsie me na hom ntse ase:
biribiara nnyi nyimpa ho a ɔkɔ no mu a obotum ayɛ no ho, nkɔw; na dza ofi nyimpa mu ba, ɔno na ɔyɛ nyimpa ho nkɔw.
Sɛ obiara wɔ aso a wɔdze tsie a, wɔmma ontsie.
Na ofir nyimpadodow no nkyɛn kɔr fie no, n'esuafo no bisaa no bɛ no ase.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nnhu dɛ biribiara a ofi nyimpa ho kɔ no mu, onntum nnyɛ no ho nkɔw,
osiandɛ ɔnnkɔ n'akoma mu, na mbom ɔkɔ yafun mu, na ofir edzi kɔ tsea mu. ɔkãa yi dze tseew adziban nyina ho.
Na ɔsee dɛ, dza ofi nyimpa no mu ba no, ɔno na ɔyɛ no ho nkɔw.
Na ofi mu, wɔ nyimpa akoma mu, na adwembɔn fi ba, ndwamanyɛ,
adzewia, ewudzi, ayefasɛm, enyikaber, emumuyɛ, nsisi, atantanbra, enyibɔn, ebususɛm, ntsɛn, nkwaseasɛm:
ndzebɔn yinom nyina fi mu na ɔba na ɔyɛ nyimpa no ho nkɔw.
Na ɔsoɛree fii hɔ kɔr Tyre nye Sidon ntoaado. Na ɔkɔr fi bi mu, na ɔammpɛ dɛ obiara tse, naaso oenntum ennsuma.
Na ntsɛmara ɔbaa bi a ne babaa kakraba no wɔ sunsum fi tsee ne nka no, ɔbae bɔhwee n'ananadze.
Na ɔbaa no yɛ Greeknyi, na n'awoo mu ɔyɛ Syrophoenicianyi; na ɔserɛɛ no dɛ ontu abɔnsɔm no mfi ne babaa no mu.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, ma mba no mmee anasaana, na ɔnnsɛ dɛ wɔfa mba edziban tow ma mbɔdɔmmba.
Na obuae see no dɛ, mo wura, nyew; naaso pon ase nkramanmba no, wodzi mba hɔn mporoporoba no bi.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, asɛm yi ntsi kɔ: Abɔnsam no efi wo babaa no mu.
Na osii mu kɔr ne fie no, ohun dɛ abofraba no da mpa do, na abɔnsam no efir edzi.
Na ofii Tyre ntoaado bio koduaa Sidon mu dze faa Decapolis ntoaado ne finimfin baa Galilee po ho.
Na wɔdze tsitsifo a ɔpo dodow brɛɛ no, na wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmfa ne nsa nto no do.
Na ɔdze no fii nyimpadodow no mu kɔr nkyɛn na ɔdze ne nsatseaba hyɛɛ n'asowa mu, na ɔtoo ntafi dze kãa ne tɛkyerɛma,
na ɔhwɛɛ sor sii nkrum see no dɛ, Ephphatha, ɔnye dɛ, Bue.
Na n'aso buebuei na ne tɛkyerɛma ase ahoma sanee, na ɔkaasaa yie.
Na ɔbraa hɔn dɛ, mma wɔnnkã nnkyerɛ obiara; na dodow kor a ɔbraa hɔn no, dodow kor a wɔdze tahyee kɛse nye no.
Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn ahobow mbordo, na wɔsee dɛ, ɔayɛ ndzemba nyina yie: ɔma tsitsifo tse asɛm na ɔma mmum kasa.
8: Nda no mu no nyimpadodow dɔɔ sõ bio na wonnyi biribi a wodzi no, Jesus frɛɛ n'esuafo see hɔ dɛ,
Me yamu hyehye me ma nyimpadodow yi, osiandɛ wɔatsena me nkyɛn ndaansa yi na wonnyi biribi a wɔdzi;
na sɛ migya hɔn kwan ma wɔdze kɔm kɔ fie a wɔbɔkɔtotɔ bitsi wɔ kwan mu, osiandɛ hɔn mu binom fi ekyirkyir bae.
Na n'esuafo no buaa no dɛ, henfa na nyimpa benya paaanoo a ɔdze bɛmee yinom wɔ sar yi do ha?
Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Paanooo ahen na hom wɔ? Na wɔsee dɛ, Esuon.
Na ɔhyɛɛ nyimpadodow no dɛ wɔntsena famu, na ɔfaa paanoo esuon no, na ɔdaa ase no, obubui, na ɔdze maa n'suafo no dɛ wɔmfa ntoto hɔn enyim; na wɔdze totoo nyimpadodow no enyim.
Na wɔwɔ esuanam kakraba bi, na ohyiraa do na ɔkãa dɛ wɔmfa no so ntoto hɔn enyim.
Na wodzidzii mee, na wɔtasee mporoporoba a ɔkae, mbirefi esuon.
Na nyimpa no bɛyɛ mpemanan. Na ogyaa hɔn kwan.
Na ntsɛmara ɔnye n'esuoafo no kɔr hɛn mu na ɔbaa Dalmanutha afamu.
Na Phariseefo no firii bae, na wɔhyɛɛ ase nye no yiyii asɛm ano, hwehwɛɛ asɛnkyerɛdze bi a ofi sor, dze sɔɔ no hwɛe.
Na osii nkrum kɛse wɔ no sunsum mu, na ɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔsantsen yi rohwehwɛ asɛnkyerɛdze yi? Nokwar mese hom dɛ, wɔremmfa asɛnkyerɛdze biara mma ɔsantsen yi.
Na ogyaa hɔn hɔ, na osii hɛn mu bio kɔr esuegya noho.
Na hɔn werɛ fiir dɛ wɔbɛfa paanoo, na wonnyi biribi wɔ hɛn no mu wɔ hɔn, nkyɛn dɛ paanoo kor pɛ.
Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ yie wɔ Phariseefo mbɔrkaw nye Herod no mbɔrkaw ho.
Na wosusui sesee hɔnho dɛ, Yennyi paanoo ntsi a.
Na Jesus hunii no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom susu dɛ osiandɛ hom nnyi paanoo ntsi a? Ana hom nnyae nnhunii, eso hom nntse ase? Hom akoma epirim anaa?
Ana hom wɔ enyiwa na hom nnhu adze? Na hom wɔ aso na hom nntse? Ana hom nnkaa?
Mububuu paanoo enum memaa mpemenum no, mporoporoba nkɛntsɛn-mã ahen na hom tasee? Na wɔsee no dɛ, Duebien.
Na esuon no so a memaa mpemanan no, mporoporoba mbirefi-mã ahen na hom tasee? Na wɔsee dɛ Esuon.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom da ho nntse ase?
Na wɔbaa Bethsaida; na wɔdze onyifurafo bi brɛɛ no, na wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔnkã no.
Na osuoo onyifurafo no ne nsamu dze no fii ekuroba no mu; na ɔtoo ntsfi guu n'enyiwa do, na ɔdze ne nsa too no do no, obisaa no dɛ, ihu adze anaa?
Na ɔmaa n'enyiwa do, na ɔsee dɛ, muhu nyimpa, na muhu hɔn tse dɛ ndua nenam.
Nkyii ɔdze ne nsa guu n'enyiwa do bio, ma ɔhwɛɛ n'enyim tɔɔtsenn, na no ho sanee, na ohun adze nyina krɔnn.
Na ɔmaa ɔkɔr ne fie see no dɛ, mma nnkɔ ekuroba no mu hɔ mpo.
Na Jesus nye n'esuafo no fii hɔ kɔr Cæsarea Philippi nkuroba no mu; na obisaa n'esusfo no wɔ kwan mu dɛ, Nyimpa se dɛ woana nye me?
Na wobuae see no dɛ, John onumanji no a, na binom se, Elijah a; binom so se nkɔnhyɛfo no mu baako a.
Na ɔnoara obisaa hɔn dɛ, na homdze, hom se dɛ woana nye me? Peter buae see no dɛ, Christ no nye wo.
Na ɔbraa hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnkã no ho asɛm nnkyerɛ obiara.
Na ɔhyɛɛ ase kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ ɔsɛ nyimpa Ba no dɛ obohu amandze pii, na mpanyimfo nye asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no apow no, na no, na woeku no, na ne ndaansa ɔasoɛr.
Na ɔkãa asɛm no petee. Na Peter suoo no mu, na ɔhyɛɛ ase twuuw n'enyim.
Na ɔnodze, ɔdaan noho hwɛɛ n'esuafo no no, otwuuw Peter n'enyim see dɛ, fi mo do, Satan: na enndwen Nyankopɔn dze, na nyimpa dze na edwen.
Na ɔfrɛɛ nyimpadodow no nye n'esuafo no so baa ne nkyɛn no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Sɛ obi pɛ dɛ odzi m'ekyir a, ma ɔmpa noho, na ompegya ne mbeamudua na ɔnka mo do.
Na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔgye no nkwa no, ɔbɛyew no, na obiara a emi nye asɛmpa no ntsi ɔbɛyew no nkwa no, ɔbɛgye no.
Na sɛ nyimpa nya wiadze nyina ma ntsi ɔhwer no nkwa a, ebɛn mfaso na obenya?
Na ebɛnadze na nyimpa bɛma dze asesa no nkwa?
Osiandɛ obiara a n'enyi bɔtõ emi nye me nsɛm ho wɔ awartofo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo santsen yi mu no, ɔno so na nyimpa Ba no n'enyi bɔtõ no ho, ber a ɔye n'abɔfoe krɔnkrɔn bɛba wɔ n'enyimnyam mu.
9: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ, Hɔn a wogyina ha yi, binom wɔ hɔ a wɔronnsɔ owu nnhwɛ ansaana woehu Nyankopɔn n'ahenman no dɛ ɔdze tum aba.
Na ndaesia ekyir no Jesus faa Peter nye James nye John, na ɔdze hɔn nko kɔr nkyɛn wɔ kokwaa tsentsen bi do; na ɔsakyeree wɔ hɔn enyim;
na n'atar hyerɛɛn fitafita, dɛ mbrɛ asaase yi do ɔtanhofo biara nntum nnhoa no dɛm.
Na Elijah ɔnye Moses puee hɔn nkyɛn, na wɔnye Jesus kasae.
Na Peter buae see Jesus dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, oye ma hɛn dɛ yɛtsena ha, na ma yembɔ asese ebiasa, wodze kor, Moses dze kor, Elijah dze kor.
Na onnyim dza ombua, osiandɛ wosuro dodow.
Na mumunkum bi bɛkataa hɔn do, na ndze fii mununkum no mu baa dɛ, oyi nye mo Dɔba no: hom ntsi no.
Na amonmu hɔ ara wɔtotoo hɔn enyiwa no, woennhu nyimpa biara dɛ Jesus nko, ɔnye hɔnara.
Na wofi kokwaa do risian no, ɔbraa hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnkã dza wohunii no nnkyerɛ obiara, gyedɛ nyimpa Ba no asoɛr efi ewufo mu ana.
Na wosuoo asɛm no mu, na wobiasabisaa hɔnho dɛ ewufo mu soɛr no ase nye dɛn.
Na wobisaa no see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na kyerɛwfo no kã dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ Elijah bedzi kan aba?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Elijah dze, odzi kan ba ampa, na ɔbɛsesɛw ndzɛmab nyina: Na ɔyɛ dɛn na wɔakyerɛw no nyimpa Ba no ho dɛ obohu amandze pii na wonnkobu no hwee?
Na mese hom dɛ Elijah aba dada, na eso wɔayɛ no dza wɔpɛ nyina, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ no ho.
Na wodur esuafo no nkyɛn no, wohun nyimpadodow pii wɔ hɔn ho, na kyerɛwfo dɛ wɔnye hɔn riyiyi asɛm ano.
Na ntsɛmara nyimapadodow nyina hun no no, hɔn bo wiriiw hɔn, na wotutuu mbirika bae bekyiaa no.
Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, ebɛn asɛm na hom nye hɔn riyiyi ano yi?
Na nyimpadodow no mu baako buaa no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo medze me babanyin mebrɛɛ wo, ɔwɔ sunsum mmum ntsi;
na beebiara a osua no mu no, ɔtsetsew noho gu, na n'aso twa ehur, na ɔtwɛr ne sē, na ɔkyernkyen: na mesee w'esuafo no dɛ wontu no, na woenntum.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Ao santsen a hom nnyi gyedzi, menye hom ntsena nkodu dabɛn? Hom mfa no mbrɛ me.
Na wɔdze no brɛɛ no; na ohun no no, ntsɛmara na sunsum no twaa no ehim, na ɔhwee daadze ma opirepirewii, na n'ano twaa ehur.
Na obisaa n'egya dɛ, iyi yɛɛ no mfe ahen nye yi? Na ɔsee dɛ, ofi mbofra mu;
na mpɛn pii na ɔaka no ato gya, nye nsu mu, dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ no; na sɛ ibotum biribi yɛ a, hu hɛn mbɔbɔr na boa hɛn.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, sɛ ibotum a! Nyia ɔgya dzi no, ndzɛmba nyina botum ayɛ hɔ ama no.
Na ntsɛmara abofra no n'egya kaa mu see dɛ, megye midzi: boa m'ekyingye.
Na Jesus hun nyimapdodow dze enguan reba no, ɔbɔɔ sunsum fi no ham see no dɛ, ɔwo, sunsum mmum nye tsitsifo, mara mehyɛ wo dɛ fi no mu fi, na mma nnkɔ no mu bio.
Na ɔkaa mu na otwaa no ehim pii no, ofi no mu firii; na ɔbɛyɛɛ dɛ owufo, ma dodowara see dɛ, Oewu.
Na Jesus suoo ne nsamu maa no do, na ɔsoɛree.
Na ɔbaa fie no, n'esuafo no bisaa no nsumaa mu dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na yeenntum enntu no?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, iyi ne saso nntum nndua biribiara do mmfir edzi gyedɛ mpaabɔ do.
Na wofii hɔ kotwaa mu wɔ Galilee, na ɔammpɛ dɛ obiara tse.
Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ nesuafo no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ woriyi nyimpa Ba no ahyɛ nyimpa nsa, na woboku no; na woku no a ne ndaansa no ɔbɔsoɛr bio.
Na hɔndze, wɔanntse asɛm no ase, na wosuroo dɛ wobebisa no.
Na wɔbaa Capernaum; na ɔwɔ fie no, obisaa hɔn dɛ ebɛnadze na hom dwendween ho wɔ kwan mu no?
Na womuaa hɔn ano: osiandɛ wɔadwendwen wɔ hɔn mu wɔ kwan mu dɛ woana na ɔyɛ kɛse.
Na ɔtsenaa ase no, ɔfrɛɛ duebien no see hɔn dɛ, sɛ obi pɛ kan edzi a, obedzi hom nyina ekyir na ɔbɛyɛ hom nyina somfa.
Na ɔfaa abofraba sii hɔn finimfin, na ɔyɛɛ no etuu, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ,
Obiara a ɔbɛgye dɛm mbofraba yi mu baako wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔgye emi mara, na obiara a ɔgye me no nnyɛ emi na ɔgye, na nyia ɔsomaa meno a.
Na John see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yenhun obi dɛ ɔdze wo dzin rutu mbɔnsam, na yesiiw no kwan, ɔnam dɛ ɔnnka hɛn do ntsi.
Na Jesus see dɛ, Mma hom nsiw no kwan, osiandɛ obi nnyi hɔ a ɔdze me dzin bɛyɛ tum edwuma bi na obotum ahyɛ me ahorohoraa ntsɛm.
Na nyia onntsia hɛn no, ɔwɔ hɛn afã.
Na obiara a hom yɛ Christ dze ntsi ɔbɛma hom nsu kuraba ma hom aanom no, nokwar mese hom dɛ ɔnnkɛyew n'akatua.
Na obiara a ɔbɔto nkakraba a wɔgye me dzi i mu baako fintsidua no, oye ma no dɛ wɔdze ewuyambo kɛse sɛn no kɔn mu na wɔdze no kɔto po mu.
Na sɛ wo nsa na ɔto wo fintsidua a, twa: oye ma wo dɛ edze abasin bɔkɔ nkwa mu kyɛn dɛ ewɔ wo nsa ebien dze bɔkɔ Gehenna, wɔ gya a orunndum da no mu.
Hɔ na hɔn abowaba nnwu, angya no nndum.
Na sɛ wo nan na ɔto wo fintsidua a, twa: oye ma wo dɛ ezde anansin bɔkɔ nkwa mu kyɛn dɛ ewɔ w'anan ebien na wɔdze wo bɔkɔto Gehenna.
Hɔ na hɔn abowaba nnwu, na gya no nndum.
Na sɛ w'enyiwa na ɔto wo fitsidua a, tu: oye ma wo dɛ edze enyi kor bɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n'ahenman mu kyɛn dɛ ewɔ enyiwa ebien na wɔdze wo bɔkɔto Gehenna.
hɔ na abowaba nnwu, na gya no onndum.
Na wɔdze gya bɛhyɛ nyimpa nyina nkyen.
Nkyen oye: na sɛ nkyen ayew ne nkyenkyen a, hom dze ebɛnadze bɔto mu? Hom nnya nkyen wɔ homara hom mu, na hom nnya asomdwee wɔ hom mu.
10: Na ɔsoɛree fii hɔ baa Judea nye Jordan ntoaado; na nyimpadodow boaboaa ano wɔ ne nkyɛn bio, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔtɔ dɛ ɔyɛ no ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn bio.
Na Phariseefo baa ne nkyɛn bebisaa no dɛ, Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ ɔbanyin kõ ne yer? Wɔdze sɔɔ no hwɛe.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Moses hyɛɛ hom dɛn?
Na wɔsee dɛ, Moses maa kwan dɛ wɔnkyerɛw ɔkõnwoma mma no, na wongyaa no.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, hom akoma dzen ntsi na ɔkyerɛɛw mbrasɛm yi maa hom.
Naaso ofir abɔdze ahyɛse no, ɔbanyin na ɔbaa na ɔyɛɛ hɔn.
Iyi ntsi na ɔbanyin begya n'egya nye ne nã hɔ, na ɔdze noho akɔbɔ ne yer ho;
na hɔn beenu ayɛ hinankor; dɛm no na wɔnnda ho nnyɛ beenu bio, na wɔyɛ honankor.
Ntsi dza Nyankopɔn dze abɔ mu no, mma nyimpa nntsew mu.
Na ɔwɔ fie no, n'esuafo no bisaa no asɛm kor yi ara ho bio.
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Nyimpa biara a ɔbɔkõ ne yer na ɔawar fofor no, ɔatõ awar wɔ ɔbaa no afã;
na sɛ ɔbaa no so ɔkõ no kun na ɔwar fofor a, ɔtõ awar.
Na binom dze mbofraba brɛɛ no dɛ ɔmfa ne nsa nkã hɔn; na n'esuafo no twuuw hɔn enyim.
Na Jesus hunii no, onyaa ebufuw, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mma mbofraba no kwan ma wɔmbra me nkyɛn, na woyi dɛm na Nyankopɔn ahenman no yɛ hɔndze.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Obiara a ɔnnkɛgye Nyankopɔn ahenman no dɛ abofraba no, ɔnnkɔkɔ mu da.
Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn etuu, na ɔdze ne nsa guu hɔn do dze hyiraa hɔn.
Na ofi hɔ sii kwan no mu no, obi tutuu mbirika bɔkotoow no, na obisaa no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo na, ebɛnadze na menyɛ ma meenya onnyiewiei nkwa ayɛ madze?
Na Jesus see no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na efrɛ me papa? Obiara nnyɛ papa gyedɛ baako: Ɔno nye Nyankopɔn.
Inyim mbrasɛm no, mma nndzi ewu, mma nntõ awar, mma nnwia adze, mma nngye dasewia, mma nnsisi, dzi w'egya nye wo nã nyi.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yinom nyinara mifitsi mo mbofraba mu na midzii do.
Na Jesus hwɛɛ no no, ɔdɔɔ no, na ɔsee no dɛ, aka wo adze kor: Kɔ, kɔtɔn dza ewɔ nyina fa kyɛ ehiafo, na ibenya akoradze wɔ sor, na bra bɛka mo do.
Na asɛm no ntsi omunae, na ɔdze yaw kɔree: Na ɔyɛ nyimpa a ɔwɔ ahonyadze pii.
Na Jesus too n'enyi hwɛɛ hɔn hyiae, na ɔsee n'esuafo no dɛ, ebɛn dzen na ɔyɛ ma hɔn a wɔwɔ ahonya dɛ wɔbɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n'ahenman mu!
Na asɛm no yɛɛ esuafo no ahobow. Na Jesus buae see hɔn bio dɛ,Mbofra, ebɛn dzen na ɔyɛ ma hɔn a wɔtwer ahonya dɛ wɔbɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n'ahenman mu!
Na ɔyɛ mberɛw ma efupɔnkɔ dɛ obodua doroba enyiwa mu kyɛn dɛ ɔhonduanyi bɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n'ahenman mu.
Na hɔn ho boow hɔn mbordo, na wɔsee no dɛ, woana mbɔ na wobotum agye no nkwa?
Na Jesus hwɛɛ hɔn see dɛ, nyimpa afã na iyi nntum dɛm yɛ, na nnyɛ Nyankopɔn afã a: Na Nyankopɔn afã dze, adze biara nnsõ no yɛ.
Na Peter hyɛɛ ase see no dɛ, hwɛ, yeegya ndzɛmba nyinara na yɛabɛka wo do.
Jesus see dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ, obi nnyi hɔ a oegya fi, anaa enuanom anaa nkyerɛbaa, anaa nã, anaa egya, anaa mba, anaa nsaase wɔ emi nye asɛmpa no ntsi
na onnkenya ho mbɔho mpɛn ɔha wɔ ber yi mu, efi, nye enuanom, nye nkyerɛbaa, nye nãnom, nye mba nsaase, ɔnye ayakayakadze, na wiadze a ɔreba no mu onnyiewiei nkwa.
Na edzikAmfo pii bedzi ekyir, na ekyidzifo so pii bedzu kan.
Na wɔwɔ kwan mu rokɔ Jerusalem; na Jesus dzi hɔn enyim kan, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn ahobow; na ɔfaa duebien no bio na ɔhyɛɛ ase kãa ndzɛmba a ɔbɛba no do no kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ,
Hwɛ, yɛrokɔ Jerusalem; na nyimpa Ba no wobeyi on ahyɛ asɔfompanyimfo nye kyerɛwfo no nsa, na woebu no fɔ ama wu, na woeyi no ama amanamamfo;
na wobesi no atwetwe, na wɔatoto ntafi egu no do, na wɔaka no mpire, na weku no; na ne ndaansa mu ɔbɔsoɛr.
Na James nye John, Zebedee mba no, baa no hɔ bɛsee dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yɛpɛ dɛ biribiara a yɛbɛserɛ wo no eyɛ ma hɛn.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ebɛnadze na hom pɛ dɛ meyɛ mema hom?
Na wɔsee no dɛ, Ma hɛn mu baako ntsena w'enyimafa, na baako so ntsena w'abankum wɔ w'enyimnyam mu.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom nnyim dza hom reserɛ yi: ana hom botum anom kuraba a monom no, anaa wɔdze enuma hom?
Na wɔsee no dɛ, Yebotum. Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, kuraba a monom no dze, hom bɔnom ampa, na enuma a wɔdze numa me no, wɔdze bonuma hom;
na m'enyimfa nye m'abankum tsena dze, ɔnnyɛ medze dɛ medze bɛma: na wɔdze bɛma hɔn a woesiesie ama hɔn.
Na du no tsee no wɔhyɛɛ ase nyaa ebufuw wɔ James nye John ho.
Na Jesus frɛɛ hɔn baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nyim dɛ hɔn a wɔbu hɔn dɛ wodzi amanaman do, wodzi hɔn do wura, na hɔn mu akɛse dzi hɔn do tum.
Na ɔnntse dɛm wɔ hom mu: na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔbɛyɛ kɛse wɔ hom mu no, ɔbɛyɛ hom somfo;
na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ odzi hom mu kan no, ɔbɛyɛ hom nyina hom akowaa.
Na nyimpa Ba no so, ɔammba ma wɔaasom no, na ɔbɔsomee, ma ɔdze no nkwa aayɛ werdam ama dodowara.
Na wodur Jericho; na ɔnye n'esuafo no nye nyimpadodow piii rifi Jericho akɔ no, Bartimæus, Timæus ne ba a ɔyɛ ohuafo onyifurafo, tse kwan nkyɛn.
Na ɔtsee dɛ ɔyɛ Jesus Nazarethnyi no no, ɔhyɛɛ ase tsēatseaa mu dɛ, Jesus, David ba, hu me mbɔbɔr.
Na dodowara braa no dɛ ommua n'ano; na mbom ɔtsēaa mu kɛse dɛ, ɔwo, David ba, hu me mbɔbɔr.
Na Jesus gyinae, na ɔsee dɛ, hom mfrɛ no. Na wɔfrɛɛ onyifurafo no see no dɛ, hyɛ dzen: soɛr, ɔfrɛ wo.
Na ɔtoow ne tam gui, na ɔsoɛree gyinae, na ɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn.
Na Jesus buaa no see dɛ, ebɛnadze na epɛ dɛ meyɛ mema wo? Na onyifurafo no see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, nkyɛ meehu adze bio.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, kɔ, wo gyedzi agye wo. Na ntsɛmara ohun adze, na ɔkaa Jesus do wɔ kwan no mu.
11: Na wɔbɛɛn Jerusalem wɔ Bethphage nye Bethany, wɔ Ngo Bepɔw ho no, ɔsomaa n'esuafo no mu beenu,
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nkɔ ekuroba a ɔda hom enyim no mu: Na ntsɛmara hom du mu a, hom bohu asoasoba a wɔamontan no a nyimpa bi nntsenaa do da: hom nsan no mfa no mbra.
Na sɛ obi se hom dɛ ɔyɛ dɛn na hom neyɛ yia, hon nse dɛ Ewuradze wɔ no ho hia, na ntsɛmara ɔbɛma wɔdze no aba ha.
Na wɔkɔree no wokohun asoasoba no dɛ wɔamontan no abow ho gua do, na wɔsaan no.
Na hɔn a wogyinaa hɔ no bi see dɛ, hom resan asoasoba no ayɛ dɛn?
Na wɔsee hɔn dɛ mbrɛ Jesus see hɔn do; na wɔmmba hɔn kwan.
Na wɔdze asoasoba no brɛɛ Jesus, na wɔtoow hɔn ntar guu no do; na ɔtsenaa no do.
Na dodowara dze hɔn ntar sesɛɛw kwan mu; na binom so dze ndubaa a woetwitwa wɔ mfuwa mu.
na hɔn a wodzii ekyir no tsēaa mu dɛ, Hosanna! Nhyira nye nyia ɔnam Ewuradze dzin mu reba no!
Nhyira nye ahendzi a ɔreba no, hɛn egya David ahendzi no a: Hosanna wɔ sorsor!
Na ɔkɛhɛɛn Jerusalem no, ɔkɔr asɔrfi no mu; na ɔahwɛ ndzɛmba nyina ewie, na adze resã no, ɔnye duebien no fii hɔ kɔr Bethany.
na adze kyee, na wofi Bethany reba no, ɔkɔm dzee no.
na ohun adɔmbadua bi wɔ ekyirkyir dɛ ahaban wɔ do, na odur hɔ no oennhu biribira dɛ ahaban nko: Osiandɛ adɔmba ber nndurii.
Na obuae see no dɛ, Mma obi nndzi wo do eduaba bio da. Na n'esuafo no tsee.
Na wodur Jerusalem; na ɔkɔr asɔrfi no mu, na ɔhyɛɛ ase paam hɔn a wɔtɔn nye hɔn a wɔtɔ wɔ asɔrfi no mu, na obutuuw sikasesafo hɔn apon nye hɔn a wɔtɔn mbubur no hɔn ngua;
na ɔamma kwan amma obiara aannsoa adze ammfa asɔrfi no mu.
Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛe see hɔn dɛ, Ana wɔannkyerɛw dɛ, wɔbɛfrɛ me fi asɔrbae ama amanaman nyinara? Na homdze, hom ayɛ no edwotwafo tu.
Na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no tsee, na wɔhwehwɛɛ mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ asɛɛ no: na wosuroo no, osiandɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛɛ nyimpadodow nyina ahobow.
Na adzesaa biara ofii kurow no mu hɔ.
Na anapa no wɔresen no, wohun adɔmbadua no dɛ ofitsi no ndwow akyenkyen.
Na Peter kaae na ɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, hwɛ, adɔmbadua a edoom no no akyenkyen.
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, hom nsie gyedzi wɔ Nyankopɔn mu.
Na nokwar mese hom dɛ, obiara a ɔbɛse kokwaa yi dɛ, Tutu na kɔhwe po mu, na ɔnnyɛ ekyingye wɔ n'akoma mu, na ɔbɛgye edzi dɛ a ɔrese no, ɔrey3 hɔ no ɔbɛye ama no.
Dɛm ntsi mese hom dɛ, biribiara a hom sɔr bisa no, hom ngye ndzi dɛ hom enya na hom benya.
Na sɛ hom gyina hɔ rosɔr, na sɛ hom nye bi wɔ asɛm bia hom mfa nkyɛ, ma hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor no so dze hom mfom aakyɛ hom.
Na sɛ hom ammfa annkyɛ a, hom egya a ɔwɔ sor no so nnkɛfa hom mfom akyɛ hom.
Na wɔbaa Jerusalem bio; na ɔnenam asɔrfi no mu no, asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo nye mpanyimfo no baa ne nkyɛn,
na wɔsee no dɛ, ebɛn tum na edze yɛ ndzɛmba yi, anaa woana na ɔmaa wo tum dɛ yɛ yinom?
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, mibebisa hom asɛm kor, na hom mbua me, na makyerɛ hom tum kor a medze meyɛ yinom:
John enuma, ofir sor anaa ofir nyimpa? Hom mbua me.
Na wosusuu hɔn mu dɛ, sɛ yɛkã dɛ, Ofir sor a, ɔbɛse dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom anngye no enndzi?
Na sɛ yɛkã dɛ, ofir nyimpa a wosuroo nkorɔfo no, osiandɛ hɔn nyinara buu John dɛ ɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi ampa.
Na wobuaa Jesus see no dɛ, yennyim. Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, mo so mennkɛkyerɛ hom tum kor a medze meyɛ yinom.
12: Na ɔhyɛɛ ase kasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn mbɛbu mu dɛ, nyimpa bi yɛɛ wenyin ture, na ɔgyee ho ban hyiae, na otuu wenyintwer, na ɔtoow abantsentsen wɔ mu, na ɔdze fɛɛm ekuafo bi, na ɔdɔɔ mu kɔr beebi.
Na ber durii no, ɔsomaa akowaa bi wɔ ekuafo no hɔ dɛ ɔnkɛgye wenyin ture eduaba no bi wɔ ekuafo no hɔ.
Na wɔkyeer no, na wɔhwee no, na wɔmaa ɔdze nsansaa kɔree.
Na bio ɔsomaa akowaa fofor wɔ hɔn hɔ, na wɔbobɔɔ ne tsir afɛr, na woguu n'enyim ase.
Na bio ɔsomaa fofor; na ɔnodze, wokum no, na aforfor pii so: Wɔhwee binom na wokum binom.
Na ɔwɔ obi so wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ no dɛba; na ekyir no ɔsomaa no so wɔ hɔn hɔ, na ɔsee dɛ, wɔbɛfɛr me ba.
Na ekuafo no dze, wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Owuodzi no nye yi: Hom mbra ma yenku no, na egyapadze no bɛyɛ hɛndze.
Na wɔfaa no kum no, na wɔtoow no fii wenyin ture mu hɔ kyenee.
Dɛm ntsi ebɛnadze na wenyin ture no wura bɛyɛ? Ɔbɛba abɛsɛɛ ekuafo no, na ɔdze wenyin ture no ama afofor.
Ana hom nnkenkaan kyerɛw yi pɛn dɛ, ɔbo a adantofo powee no, ɔnoara na, ɔabɛyɛ kutuwdo-bo;
iyi Ewuarzde nyɛe a, na ɔyɛ nwanwa wɔ hɛn enywa do?
Na wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔkyer no; na wosuroo nyimpadodow no; osiandɛ wohun dɛ bɛ yi a obui no tsia hɔn; na wogyaa no hɔ kɔree.
Na wɔsomaa Phariseefo nye Herod akadofo no mu bi dɛ wɔmbɛkyer no wɔ kasa mu.

Na wɔbae no wɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ye nyim dɛ eyɛ nokwafo, na emmfa nyimpa nnyɛ hwee; na ennhwɛ nyimpaenyim, na ekyerɛkyerɛ Nyankopɔn kwan no wɔ nokwar mu:ɔfa mbra mu dɛ yɛma Cæsar ntoboa anaa oho?
Yɛmma anaa mma yɛmma? Na ohun hɔn ndabraba no ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na hom rosɔ me hwɛ yi? Hom mfa denare mbrɛ me ma monhwɛ.
Na wɔdze bae. Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, woana honyi nye kyerɛw nye yi? Na wɔsee no dɛ, Cæsar dze a.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom ndan dza ɔyɛ Cæsar dze mma Cæsar, na dza ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn dze mma Nyankopɔn. Na no ho yɛɛ hɔn nwanwa dodow.
Na Sadduceefo so bi a wɔkã dɛ wunyan nnyi hɔ no baa ne nkyɛn; na wobisaa no dɛ,
Kyerɛkyerɛfo, Moses kyerɛwee maa hɛn dɛ, Sɛ obi no nua wu na ogya yer, na oenngya mba a, no nua nwar ne yer no na ɔnowo mba mma no nua.
Na enuanom beesuon wɔ hɔ: na nyia odzi kon no waar yer, na owui no, oenngya mba;
na nyia otsiã ebien no waar no, na owui, na no so enngya mba; nyia otsiã ebiasa no dɛmara;
na beesuon no engya mba. Ne nyina ekyir no, ɔbaa no so wui.
Na wunyan no mu, hɔn mu woana na ɔbɛyɛ ne yer? Osiandɛ beesuon no awar no.
Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Ana nnyɛ yi ntsi na hom fom yi, dɛ hom nnyim kyerɛwsɛm no nye Nyankopɔn ahoɔdzen no so?
Na wɔsoɛr fi ewufo mu a, wɔnnwar eso wɔmma awar, na wɔtse dɛ abɔfo a wɔwɔ sor.
Na ewufo no ho dze, dɛ wobenyan no, ana hom nnkenkaan no wɔ Moses nwoma no mu,mbrɛ Nyankopɔn kasaa kyerɛɛ no wɔ Haban no mu dɛ, Emi nye Abraham Nyankopɔn,Isaac Nyankopɔn, Jacob Nyankopɔn?
Ɔnnyɛ ewufo Nyankopɔn, na enyikamfo Nyankopɔn a: dɛm ntsi ho, fom do pii.
Na kyerɛwfo no mu baako bae bɛtsee dɛ woribisabisa asɛm no, na ohun dɛ oebua hɔn yie no, obisaa no dɛ, Mbransɛm ne nyina dza odzi kan nye mmuana?
Jesus buaa dɛ, Dza odzi kan no nye dɛ, Isreal, tsie: Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze kor:
Na dɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn wɔ w'akoma nyina mu nye wo kra nyina mu, nye w'adwen nyina mu, nye w'ahoɔdzen nyina mu.
Na dze otsia ebien no nye yi: dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa wo ho. Mbrasɛm biara nnyi hɔ a ɔsõ kyɛn yinom.
Na kyerɛwnyi no see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ampa akã no yie dɛ Nyankopɔn yɛ kor; na obi nnyi hɔ dɛ ɔno nko.
Na ebɔdɔ no wɔ w'akpma nyina mu, nye w'ahoɔdzen nyina mu, na ebɔdɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa wo ho, ɔkyɛn hyew-afɔr, nye afɔrbɔ nyina koraa.
Na Jesus hun dɛ oebua nyansa mu no, ɔsee no dɛ, ɔwo nye Nyankopɔn ahenman ntamu nntwe, na obi ennsi no bo dɛ obebisa no asɛm bi bio.
Na Jesus rekyerɛkyerɛ wɔ asɔrfi mu no, obuae see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na kyerɛwfo no kã dɛ Christ no yɛ David ba?
Na David nankasa nam Sunsum krɔnkrɔn mu kã dɛ, Ewuradze see m'Ewuradze dɛ, tsena m'abanyimfa kodu dɛ medze w'atamfo mebɛyɛ w'ananadzegua.
Dɛm ntsi David noara frɛ no Ewuradze; na ofi hen bɛyɛ ne ba? Na nyimpadodow nyina tsiee no ahomka mu.
Na ɔkãe wɔ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu dɛ, hom nhwɛ yie wɔ kyerɛwfo a wɔpɛ ntar atsentsen mu nantsew, nye gua do nkyiakyia;
ɔnye mpanyim gua wɔ nhyiamudan mu, nye mpanyin tsenabea wɔ edzidzi ase ho:
Hɔn na wɔmen ekunafo efi, na wopetuw yi mpaa tsentsen; yinom benya afɔbu kɛsenara.
Na ɔtsenaa ase wɔ sikakorabea tsentsendo na ɔhwɛɛ mbrɛ nyimpadodow no toow sika guu sikakorobea no mu; na dodow a wɔyɛ ahonyafo toow pii guu mu.
Na ɔbaa kunafo hianyi bi bae bɔtoow kɔɔbermba ebien a wɔbɛyɛ wen guu mu.
Na ɔfrɛɛ n'esuafo see hɔn dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ, kunafo hianyi yi dze pii ebogu mu akɛn hɔn woebogu sikakorabae no mu no nyina:
na hɔn nyinaa dza wɔwɔ ma abor do na wɔdze bi ebogu mu, na oyidze, ofi ne hia mu dze dza ɔwɔ nyina, n'astsena nyina na ɔdze ebogu mu.
13: Na orifi asɔrfi mu no, n'esuafo no mu baako see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, hwɛ, abo bi nye aban bi!
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Ehu aban akɛse yi? Wonnkegya ɔbo kor a ɔda kor do a wonnkodwuruw egu famu.
Na ɔtse Ngo bEpɔw no dO wɔ asɔrfi tsentsendo no, Peter nye James nye John nye Andrew bisaa no nsumaa mu dɛ,
Kyerɛ hɛn aber a yinom bɛyɛ hɔ: Na yinom nyina rebɛba mu a, n'asɛnkyerɛdze nye dɛn?
Na Jesus hyɛɛ ase see hɔn dɛ, hom nhwɛ yie amma obi aandaadaa hom.
Na dodowara bɛba wɔ me dzin mu dɛ, emi nye no, na wɔadaadaa pii.
Na sɛ hom tse kõ nye akosɛm a, mma hom akoma nntu: na otwar dɛ ɔba, na ewiei no nnyae nndurii.
Na ɔman bɔsoɛr ɔman do, na ahenman bɔsoɛr ahenman do; na asaasewosow bɛba mbeambea, na ɔkɔm bɔba: Yinom nye awoko ahyɛse.
Na hom nhwɛ homho yie: na wobeyi hom akɔ mpanyimfo bagua mu, na hom na wɔahwe hom wɔ nhyiamudan mu, na hom egyina ambradofo nye ahemfo enyim wɔ me ntsi, dze edzi dase ama hɔn.
Na asɛmpa no, otwar dɛ wɔkã kyerɛ amanaman nyina ansaana.
Na sɛ wɔdze hom rokɔ akɛma a, mma hom nndwendwen dza hom bɛkã ho anasaana: na biribi a wɔdze bɛma hom dɔn no mu no, ɔnoara na hom nkã: na nnyɛ hom na hom kasa, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no a.
Na nua beyi nua ama owu, egya beyi ba; na mba bɔsoɛr wɔ awofo do na wɔama woeku hɔn.
Na nyimpa nyina bɛtan hom wɔ me dzin ntsi; na nyia ɔbɛtsena mu ekodu ewiei no, ɔno na wɔbɛgye no nkwa.
Na sɛ hom hu amambɔe ekyiwadze no dɛ ogyina mbrɛ ɔnnsɛ a (ma nyia ɔkenkan no ntse ase), ɔno na hɔn a wɔwɔ Judæe nguan nkɔ nkokwaa do;
na mma nyimpa a ɔwɔ dan etsifi nnsian mmba dan mu, na eso ɔnnhɛn mu nnkɛfa biribi wɔ ne dan mu;
na nyia ɔwɔ hadan mu, mma ɔnnsan n'ekyir bio mmbɛfa ne nkatado.
Na hɔn a wɔafa efur nye hɔn a wɔma numfo wɔ nda no mu ndue!
Na hom nsɔr ma yinom aammba awɔwber mu.
Na nda no mu bɛba ahohia kɛse a ofitsi wiadze abɔdze a Nyankopɔn bɔe ahyɛse bodu aber no ɔmmba dɛm da, eso ɔremmba da.
Na sɛ Ewuradze enntwa nda no do tsia a, nkyɛhonam biara nnkenya nkwa, na ne mpamufo a ɔpaa hɔn na ntsi oetwa nda no do tsia.
Na aber no sɛ obiara se hom dɛ, hwɛ, ɔwɔ hɔ a, mma hom nngye nndzi,
na Christatofo, nye nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo bɔsoɛr na wɔakyerɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze a, sɛ ɔbɛyɛ a, wɔdze adaaadaa mpamufo no mpo.
Na homdze hom nhwɛ yie: hwɛ, makã ne nyina akyerɛ hom ansaana.
Na nda no mu ahohia no ekyir no, ewia bɛhyɛ sum, na bosoom nnkɛma ne kan,
na nworaba fi sor bɔtotɔ, na sor etum bɔwosow.
Ɔno no wobohu nyimpa Ba no dɛ ɔreba wɔ nsuwusiw do, wɔ ahodzen nye enyimnyam kɛse mu.
Na ɔno na ɔbɔsoma n'abɔfoe ma wɔaakɔboaboa ne mpamufo no an efi mframa anan no mu, ofi asaase ntuadze kesi sor ntuadze.
Hom nsūa adɔmbadua ho bɛ no: sɛ n'abaw yɛ momon, na oriyi ahaban a, nna hom nyim dɛ ɔhyewber abɛn;
dɛmara na hom so sɛ hom hu dɛ yinom yɛ hɔ a, hom nhu dɛ abɛn edu abowano.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Mbasantsen yi runntwa mu akɔ gyedɛ yinom nyina ayɛ hɔ ansaana.
Ɔsor nye asaase botwa mu akɔ na me nsɛm dze, worunntwa mu akɔ.
Na da no nye dɔn no dze obiara nnyim: abɔfo a wɔwɔ sor no nnyim, ɔba no so nnyim, gyedɛ Egya no.
Hom nhwɛ yie, hom nweɔn na hom nyi mpaa, na hom nnyim da kor a ber no du.
Ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a ɔrodɔ mu a ogyaa ne fi, na ɔmaa no nkowaa tum, na ɔmaa hɔn nyina hɔn edwuma nkorkor, na ɔhyɛɛ abowanohwɛfo no dɛ ɔnweɔn.
Dɛm ntsi hom nweɔn, na hom nnyim dɔn kor a ofiwura bɛba: Adansaber a, esuom o, akokɔbɔnee o, anapahema o;
amma ɔaammba awerɛfir mu emmbohu hom dɛ hom da.
Na dza mese hom yi, mese nyimpa nyina dɛ, Hom nweɔn.
14: Na aka nda ebien ma apaho nye epitsi-afahyɛ no edu; na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no hwehwɛɛ mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ nam nyansa mu akyer no na woeku no:
na wɔsee dɛ, Nnyɛ afahyɛ mu bi a, amma wetwiwentwi aammba ɔman mu.
Na ɔwɔ Bethany Simon kwatanyi no fie, na ɔtse edzidzi no, ɔbaa bi baa hɔ a ɔdze alabastron-toa a nard ngohuam a ɔsom bo wɔ mu; na ɔbɔɔ toa no na ohuei guu n'etsifi.
Na binom wɔ hɔ a wonyaa ebufuw wɔ hɔn mu, na wɔsee dɛ, Wɔsee ngohuam yi ayɛ dɛn?
Nkyɛ wɔbɔtɔn ngohuam yi agye bɔbor denare ahaasa na wɔdze ama ehiafo. Na wohwinhwinii tsiaa no.
Na Jesus see dɛ, hom ngyaa no; ebɛnadze ntsi na hom rehaw no? Ɔayɛ edwuma pa wɔ mo ho.
Na hom wɔ ehiafo wɔ hom nkyɛn daa, na aber biara a hom pɛ, hom botum ayɛ hɔn yie, na emidze, hom nnyi me daa.
Ɔayɛ dza obotum: Oedzi kan abɛsera me nyimpadua akɔ sie mu.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, beebiara a wɔbɛkã asɛmpa yi wɔ wiadze nyina mu no dza ɔbaa yi ayɛ so wɔbɛkã dze ayɛ ne nkaa.
Na Judas Iscariot a ɔyɛ duedien no mu baako fii hɔ kɔr asɔfompanyin no nkyɛn dɛ obeyi no ama hɔn.
Na wɔtsee no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn dɛw, na wɔbɔɔ anohoba dɛ wɔbɛma no sika. Na ɔhwehwɛɛ mbrɛ obesi eyi no ama wɔ ber a ɔsɛ mu.
Na epitsi da a odzi kan a woku apahoguan no, n'esuafo no see no dɛ, Hen na epɛ dɛ yekesiesie ma ikedzi apaho no?
Na ɔsomaa n'esuafo no mu beenu, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nkɔ kurow no mu, na nyimpa bi a ɔso nusuhina behyia hom: hom nka no do;
na beebiara a ɔbɛhɛn no hom nse ofiwura no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo no se, M'ahɔhodan a menye m'esuafo bedzi mu apaho no wɔ hen?
Na ɔnoara ɔbɛkyerɛ hom sordan kɛse bi a wɔahyehyɛ mu, na woesiesie mu; hɔ na hom nsiesie mma hɛn.
Na esuafo no sii mu kɔree, na wɔbaa kurow no mu na wobohun dɛ mbrɛ ɔsee hɔn no, na wosiesiee apaho no.
Na odur ewimbir no, ɔnye duebien no bae.
Na wɔtwetwer hɔ ridzidzi no, Jesus see dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ, hom mu baako a ɔnye me dzidzi na obeyi me ama.
Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn awerɛhow na wɔhyɛɛ ase nkorkor bisaa no dɛ, Ana emi a?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, duebien no mu baako a ɔnye me to nsa wɔ ɔsɛn no mu no a.
Na nyimpa Ba no rokɔ, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ no ho; na nyimpa a wɔnam do beyi nyimpa Ba no ama no ndue! Sɛ wɔannwo dɛm nyimpa no a, nkyɛ oye ma no.
Na woridzidzi no, ɔfaa paanoo na ohyiraa do na obubui, na ɔdze maa hɔn; na ɔsee dɛ, hom ngye: Iyi nye me nyimpadua.
Na ɔfaa kurada na ɔdaa ase no, ɔdze maa hɔn ma hɔn nyina nomee.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, iyi nye mo bɔgyaa a ɔyɛ ahyɛmu no dze a dodowara ntsi woruhue egu no.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, moronnom wenyinaba no bi bio, dze ekodu da a mobɔnom no fofor wɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu.
Na wɔtoow ndwom no, wofiir edzi kɔr Ngo Bepɔw no do.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Wɔbɔto hom nyina fintsidua: Na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, mobɔbɔ oguanhwɛfo no, na nguan no abɔ apetse.
Naaso menyan ekyir no mibedzi hom enyim akɔ Galilee.
Na Peter see no dɛ, sɛ wɔbɔto hɔn nyina fintsidua mpo a, nnyɛ emi a.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, nokwar mese wo dɛ, ndɛ anago yi, anasaana akokɔ bɔbɔn mprɛnu no, ebɛpa me mprɛnsa.
Na ɔnodze mbom ɔkãa no enyiberdo dɛ, sɛ menye wo bowu mpo a, meremmpa wo da; na dɛmara na hɔn nyian so kãe.
Na wodur beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Gethsemane; na ɔsee n'esuafo no dɛ, hom ntsena ho ma monkɔsɔr.
Na ɔfaa Peter nye James nye John kaa noho, na ɔhyɛɛ ase bɔɔ hu na ɔbɔmee.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Me kra awerɛhow ahyɛ no do dze kɔ owu mu: hom ntsena ha, na hom nweɔn.
Na ɔkɔr enyim kakra, na ɔkɔhwee famu na ɔsɔɔr dɛ, sɛ ɔbɛyɛ a, dɔn no mpa no ho nkɔ.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Abba Egya, adze biara nnsõ wo yɛ: yi kuraba yi pa mo ho; naaso nnyɛ dza mepɛ bi a, na dza ɔwo epɛ a.
Na ɔbae bohun dɛ wɔdeda, na ɔsee Peter dɛ, Simon, ana ada? Ana enntum annweɔn dɔnhwer kor?
Hom nweɔn na hom nsɔr, mma hom aannkɔ nsɔhwɛ mu: Sunsum pɛ dze, na honam yɛ mberɛw.
Na osii mu kɔr bio, na ɔkɔsɔree kãa asɛm kor no ara.
Na ɔsanee bae bohun hɔn dɛ wɔdeda bio, na hɔn enyiwa akom;na wonnyim dza wɔdze bobua no.
Na ɔbaa ne mpɛn ebiasa, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nda dza aka yi, na hom nhom: ɔdɔɔ sõ, dɔn no edu; hwɛ, woriyi nyimpa Ba no ahyɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo nsa.
Hom nsoɛr ma yɛnkɔ hwɛ, nyia oyi me ma no abɛn.
Na ntsɛmara a ɔda do rekasa no, Judas ɔyɛ duebien no mu baako bae, na nyimpadodow a wɔdzedze nkrantsee nye mpɔtsibaa fi asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo nye mpanyimfo no hɔ kaa no ho.
Na nyia oyii no mae no maa hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze dɛ, nyia mibefew n'ano no, ɔnye no: Hom nkyer no na hom nhwɛ no yie mfa no nkɔ.
Na odurii no, ntsɛmara na ɔbaa ne nkyɛn na ɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, na ofeew n'ano.
Na wɔdze hɔn nsa susuoo no mu na wɔkyekyer no.
Na hɔn a wogyinagyina hɔ no mu baako twee ne krantsee bɔɔ ɔsɔfopanyin n'akowaa twaa n'aso.
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Ana hom firii baa mo do dɛ owifo do, na hom dze nkrantsee nye mpɔtsibaa bɛkyer me yi?
Daa mowɔ hom nkyɛn wɔ asɔrfi mu mekyerɛkyerɛe no, hom annkyer me; na dɛ kyerɛwsɛm no mbra mu ntsi a.
Na hɔn nyinara gyaa no hɔ, na woguanee.
Na aberantsɛ baako bi kaa no do a oetu ndwera akata n'adagyaw do; na wɔkyeer no;
na ogyaa ndwera no hɔ na ɔdze adagyaw guanee.
Na wɔdze Jesus kɔr ɔsɔfopanyin no hɔ; na asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfa nye kyerɛwfo no nyina behyiaa ne nkyɛn.
Na Peter dzii n'ekyir wɔ ekyirkyir dze kodur ɔsɔfopanyin n'abanguado, na ɔnye asomfo no kɛtsenaa hɔ too gya.
Na asɔfompanyin nye baguafo no nyina hwehwɛɛ Jesus ho dase dze eeku no; na woennya bi.
Na dodowara gyee no ho dasewia, na hɔn dasee annsaa.
Na binom soɛree gyee no ho dasewie dɛ,
Yɛtsee dɛ ɔsee dɛ, mubodwuruw asɔrdan a wɔdze nsa ayɛ yi na ndaansa mu matow bi a wɔammfa nsa annyɛ.
Na dɛm mpo hɔn dasee annsaa.
Na ɔsɔfopanyin no gyinaa finimfin na obisaa Jesus dɛ, immbua bi? Ebɛnadze na yinom regye wo ho dase yi?
Na omuaa n'ano, na oemmbua bi. Na ɔsɔfopanyin no bisaa no bio dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye Chirst no nyia woehyira no no ne Ba no?
Na Jesus see dɛ, emi nye no: na hom bohu nyimpa Ba no dɛ ɔtse ahoɔdze nyimfa, na ɔreba wɔ sor nsuwusiw mu.
Na ɔsɔfopanyin no sunsuaan n'atar mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛn hia na ohia hɛn adasefo bio?
Hom atse ebususɛm no: Hom dwen dɛn? Na hɔn nyinara buu no fɔ dɛ ɔsɛ owu.
Na binom hyɛɛ ase hinaa ntafi guu no do, na wɔkataa n'ekyi, na wɔbobɔɔ no ekutuku, na wɔsee no dɛ, hyɛ nkɔm! Na asomfo no bobɔɔ no asotɔr.
Na Peter wɔ ase wɔ abangua no do hɔ no, ɔsɔfopanyin ne mbaawa no mu baako bae,
na ohun Peter dɛ ɔroto gya no, ɔgyeen no na ɔsee no dɛ, ɔwɔ so nye Nazarethnyi Jesus nam.
Na ɔsaan dɛ, minnyim no eso menntse dza erekã yi ase mpo. Na ofir edzi kɔr paado; na akokɔ bɔnee.
Na abaawa no hun no na ɔhyɛɛ ase see hɔn a wogyina hɔ no dɛ, oyi so fi hɔn mu.
Na ɔsaan bio. Na ɔkyɛɛr kakra no, hɔn a wogyina hɔ no see Peter bio dɛ, ampa dɛ ifi hɔn mu osiandɛ eyɛ Galileenyi.
Na ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii nsɛw na ɔkekãa ntam dɛ, minnyim nyimpa yi a hom rekã no ho asɛm yi.
Na ntsɛmara na akokɔ bɔɔn ne mpɛn ebien. Na Peter kaa asɛm no a Jesus kãa kyerɛɛ no no dɛ, ansaana akokɔ bɔbɔn mptrɛnu no, ebɛpa me mprɛnsa. Na ɔdween ho no osūi.
15: Na ntsɛmara adze kyee no asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimguafo no nyina kɔr apam, na wɔkyerkyeer Jesus dze no kɔree kɛhyɛɛ Pilate nsa.
Na Pilate bisaa no dɛ Ana ɔwo nye Jewfo hɛn no? Na obuaa no see dɛ, Akã.
Na asɔfompanyin no tõatoaa no pii.
Na Pilate bisaa no bio see dɛ, Immbua hwe? Hwɛ ndzɛmba pii a wɔdze tõatoa wo yi.
Na Jesus emmbua hwee bio, na ɔyɛɛ Pilate nwanwa.
Na afahyɛ du a, ɔtɔ dɛ ogyaa daduanyi kor biara a wɔbɛserɛ no ma hɔn.
Na woegu nyimpa a wɔfrɛ no Barabbas no nye hɔn a wɔka no ho twee manso a wodzii ewu wɔ mansotwe mu no mpokyerɛ.
Na nyimpadodow no kɔr no hɔ hyɛɛ ase serɛɛ no dɛ ɔnyɛ hɔn mbrɛ ɔtɔ dɛ ɔyɛ no.
Na Pilate buaa hɔn see dɛ, Ana hom pɛ dɛ migyaa Jewfo Hen no mema hom?
Na ohun dɛ enyitan ntsi na asɔfompanyin no yii no mae.
Na asɔfompanyin no hyɛɛ nyimpadodow no ntsirmu dɛ mbom ongyaa Barabbas mma hɔn.
Na Pilate buae see hɔn bio dɛ, ebɛnadze no hom pɛ dɛ meyɛ nyia hom frɛ no Jewfo Hen no?
Na wɔtsēaa mu bio dɛ, bɔ no mbeamudua mu!
Na Pilate see hɔn dɛ, ebɛn bɔn na ɔayɛ? Na wɔtsēatseaa mu mbordo dɛ, bɔ no mbeamudua mu!
Na Pilata pɛɛ dɛ ɔma nyimpadodow no abodwee no, ogyaa Barabbas maa hɔn, na Jesus dze, ɔkãa no mpire no, oyii no mae dɛ wɔnkɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Na nsordaafo no dze no kɔr abagua no a ɔyɛ Ambrado Aban no do; na wɔfrɛfrɛɛ nsordaafokuw ni nyina boaa ano.
Na wɔdze tam memen furaa no, na wɔbɔɔ nsoɛ katraka soaa no;
na wɔhyɛɛ ase kyiakyiaa no dɛ, Jewfo Hen, abao!
Na wɔdze ndzɛmbir bɔɔ n'etsifi na wohinahinaa ntafi guu no do, na wobuu ntwɛr sɔɔr no.
Na wowiee atwetwe si no woyii tam memen no wɔ no ho, na wɔdze no kɔr dɛ wɔrokɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Na wɔhyɛɛ Simon Cyrenanyi, obi a ofi kwaa rutwa mu, Aleɛander nye Rufus hɔn egya no, dɛ ɔnsoa ne mbeamudua.
Na wɔdze no kɔr beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Golgotha a ne nkyerɛase nye Nyitsirdo.
Na wɔmaa no wenyin wɔdze myrrh afora mu, na ɔanngye.
Na wɔbɔɔ no mbemudua mu, na wɔkyɛɛ n'atar mu, twee tonto hwehwɛɛ dza abiara bɛfa.
Na dɔnhwer a otsia ebiasa no mu na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Na wɔkyerɛɛw n'ewusi wɔ do dɛ Jewfo Hen.
Na wɔbɔɔ edwotwafo beenu mbemudua mu ka no ho, ɔbaako wɔ n'enyimfa, ɔbaako wɔ n'abankum.
Na kyerɔw no a ɔkã dɛ, wɔkaan no foraa emumuyɛfo no, baa mu.
Na hɔn a worutwa mu no, wodzii no nsɛmbɔn, na wɔwosowosoow hɔn tsir dɛ, Hwɛɛ! ɔwo a idwuruw asɔrdan no na etow no ndaansa mu,
gye woho fi mbeamudua si famu ɛ!
Dɛmara so na asɔfompanyin no sii no atwetwe wɔ hɔn mu, wɔnye kyerɛwfo no, dɛ, ɔgyee binom: Onntum nngye nankasa noho.
Afei wɔmma Chirst no, Isreal Hen no, mfi mbeamudua no ho nsi famu, ma yɛnhu na yɛngye ndzi. Na hɔn wɔnye no wɔbɔɔ hɔn mbeamudua mu no wɔyaaw no.
Na dɔn a tsia esia no durii no, sum hyɛɛ asaase no nyina do kodur dɔn a otisa akron no.
Na dɔn a otsia akron no mu no Jesus dze ndze kɛse kaa mu dɛ, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachtani? Ne nkyerɛase nye dɛ, Me Nyankopɔn, me Nyankopɔn, ɔyɛ dɛn na apa me yi?
Na hɔn a wogyinaa hɔ binom tsee no, wɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, ɔfrɛ Elijah.
Na baako tuu mbirika dze posaw kɔbɔɔ weyin yerɛyerɛw mu, dze tuaa nzdɛmbir ano maa no dɛ ɔnnom, na ɔsee dɛ, hom ngyaa ma yɛnhwɛ dɛ Elijah bɛba ebeyi no anaa.
Na Jesus dze ndze kɛse kaa mu no, ogyaa no sunsum mu.
Na asɔrdan no mu ntawamutam no tseew ebien fii sor besii ase.
Na ɔhamupanyin a ogyinaa hɔ wɔ ne tsentsendo no, ohun dɛ, ampaara nyimpa yi Nyankopɔn Ba a.
Na mbaa bi so wɔ hɔ a wofi ekyir hwɛe: Hɔn mu na Mary Magdalene, nye Mary, James kuma nye Jose hɔn nã, nye Salome wɔ;
na hɔn so na ɔwɔ Galilee no, wɔkaa no do na wɔsoom no, wɔnye mbaa pii a wɔnye no baa Jerusalem.
Na odur ewimbir no, na ɔyɛɛ Ahosiesieda no, ɔnye da a odzi ahomgyeda enyim, ntsi no,
Joseph a ofi Arimathæa, baguanyi nyimnyamfo a ɔno so rohwɛ Nyankopɔn ahenman kwan no bae, na osii no bo kɔr Pilate hɔ kɛseɛrɛɛ Jesus no fun no.
Na ɔyɛɛ Pilate nwanwa dɛ oewu dada; na ɔfrɛɛ ɔhamupanyin no bisaa no dɛ owui akyɛr anaa.
Na ɔtsee no wɔ ɔhamupanyin no hɔ no, ɔdze fun no kyɛɛ Joseph.
Na ɔtɔɔ ndwera bi, na oyii no dze no bobɔɔw ndwera no mu, na ɔdze no too nda a woetwa no ɔbotan bi mu no mu, na opireew ɔbo hiin nda no ano.
Na Mary Magdalene nye Mary, Joses ne nã, hwɛɛ mbrɛ wɔdze no toe.
16: Na ahomgyeda no twaa mu no, Mary Madgalene nye James ne nã Mary nye Salome, wɔtɔɔ nduhuam dɛ wɔdze reba abɛsera no.
Na da a odzi dapɛn no kan no n'anapatutu na wɔbaa nda no do, na ewia epue.
Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, woana bepirew ɔno no efi nda no abowano ama hɛn?
Na wɔtoto hɔn enyi no wohun dɛ woepirew ɔbo no efi hɔ: Osiandɛ ɔsõ kakraka.
Na wɔhɛɛn nda no mu no, wohun aberantsɛ bi a ɔtse nyimfa hyɛ atar fufuw, na wɔbɔɔ hu.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, mma hom mmbɔ hu: Hom rohwehwɛ Jesus Nazarethnyi a wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no; ɔasoɛr: Onnyi ha. Hwɛ mbrɛ wɔdze no toe!
Na hom nkɔ nkɛkã nkyerɛ n'esuafo no, ɔnye Peter, dɛ, oedzi hom enyim kɔ Galilee: Hɔ na hom bohu no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔsee hom.
Na wofiir edzi fiir nda no ho gyuanee, na ahopopo nye ahobow kaa hɔn, na wɔannkã hwee annkyerɛ abiara, osiandɛ wosuroi.
Na ɔsoɛɛr da a odzi dapɛn no kan no anapatutu no, odzii kan yii noho kyerɛɛ Mary Magdalene a otuu mbɔnsam esuon fii no mu no.
Na ɔkɔree kɛkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn a wɔnye no tsenae a woridzi nkɔmbɔ na worusū no.
Na hɔn dze wɔtsee dɛ ɔtse ase na oehu no no, wɔanngye enndzi.
Na n'ekyir no woyii no wɔ suban fofor mu kyerɛɛ hɔn mu beenu a wɔnam rokɔ ekuraase;
na hɔn so kɔree kɛkãa kyerɛɛ nkaa no; na wɔanngye hɔn so enndzi.
N'ekyir no a dubiako no tse edzidzi no, woyii no kyerɛɛ hɔn, na otwuuw hɔn enyim wɔ hɔn ekyingye nye hɔn akoma dzen ntsi, osiandɛ wɔanngye hɔn a wohun no dɛ ɔasoɛr no enndzi.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ wiadze nyinara nkɛkã asɛmpa no nkyerɛ abɔdze nyina.
Nyia ɔgye dzi na wonuma no no, obenya nkwa, na nyia ɔnngye nndzi no, wobobu no fɔ.
Na nsɛnkyerɛdze yi bɛka hɔn a wɔgye dzi do: wɔnam me dzin do botu mbɔnsam; wɔbɛkasa kasa fofor;
wɔbɛma nwɔ do, na sɛ wɔnom bɔr biara a, ɔrennyɛ hɔn hwee; wɔdze hɔn nsa bogu ayarfo do na hɔn ho ayɛ hɔn dzen.
Na afei Ewuradze Jesus kasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn ekyir no, wɔfaa no kɔr sor, na ɔkɛtsenaa Nyankopɔn abanyimfa.
Na hɔndze, wofii hɔ kɔree kɛkãa asɛm no wɔ mbae nyina, Ewuradze nye hɔn yɛɛ edwuma, na ɔdze nsɛnkyerɛdze a ɔka do no hyɛɛ asɛm no dzen. Amen.

1: Jesus Christ, David ne ba, Abraham ne ba, n’ebusuasantsen-nwoma.
Abraham woo Isaac, na Isaac woo Jacob; na Jacob woo Judah nye no nuanom;
na Judah nye Tamar woo Perez nye Zerah; na Perez woo Hezron; na Hezron woo Ram;
na Ram woo Amminadab; na Amminadab woo Nahshon; na Nahshon woo Salmon;
na Salmon nye Rahab woo Boaz; na Boaz nye Ruth woo Obed; na Obed woo Jesse;
na Jesse woo ɔhen David. Na David nye nyia nkyɛ ɔyɛ Uriah yer no woo Solomon;
na Solomon woo Rehoboam; na Rehoboam woo Abijah; na Abijah woo Asa;
na Asa woo Jehoshaphat; na Jehoshaphat woo Joram; na Joram woo Uzziah;
na Uzziah woo Jotham; na Jotham woo Ahaz; na Ahaz woo Hezekiah;
na Hezekiah woo Manasseh; na Manasseh woo Amon; na Amon woo Josiah;
na Josiah woo Jechoniah nye no nuanom wɔ Babylon ndɔmmumkɔ-ber no mu.
Na Babylon ndɔmmumkɔ-ber no ekyir no Jechoniah woo Shealtiel; na Shealtiel woo Zerubbabel;
na Zerubbabel woo Abiud; na Abiud woo Eliakim; na Eliakim woo Azor;
na Azor woo Sadoc; na Sadoc woo Achim; na Achim woo Eliud;
na Eliud woo Eleazar; na Eleazar woo Matthan; na Matthan woo Jacob;
na Jacob woo Joseph, Mary a ɔwoo nyia wɔfrɛ no Christ no no kun no.

Afei ebusuasantsen a ofi Abraham do besi David do nyina yɛ ebusuasantsen duanan; na ofi David do besi Babylon ndɔmmumkɔ-ber no do yɛ ebusuasantsen duanan; na ofi Babylon ndɔmmumkɔ-ber no do besi Christ no do yɛ ebusuasantsen duanan.
Na mbrɛ Jesus Christ n’awoo tse nye yi: Ber a wɔdze ne nã Mary maa Joseph awar, na wonnyae nnhyiaa mu no, wohun no dɛ onyinsen dza ofi Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu.
Na no kun Joseph yɛ nyimpa tsenenee, na ɔmmpɛ dɛ ɔhyɛ no eguasohorohoraa ntsi, ɔdween dɛ ɔbɔkõ no wɔ nsumaa mu.
Na aber a ɔrodwen yinom ho no, hwɛ, Ewuradze bɔfoe yii noho kyerɛɛ no wɔ adaaso mu see dɛ, Joseph, David ba, mma nnsuro dɛ ebɛfa wo yer Mary aba wo nkyɛn; na dza onyinsen no fi Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu.
Na ɔbɔwo babanyin, na ato no dzin Jesus, osiandɛ ɔno na ɔbɛgye ne man efi hɔn bɔn mu.
Na yinom nyina ayɛ hɔ, ma dza Ewuradze nam nkɔnhyɛnyi no do kãe no aaba mu dɛ,
Hwɛ, ɔbaabun benyinsen, na ɔawo babanyin, na wɔbɔto no dzin Immanuel a ne nkyerɛase nye dɛ, Onyame nye hɛn wɔ hɔ.
Na Joseph fii nda mu nyanee no, ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ bɔfo no hyɛɛ no no, na ɔkɛfaa ne yer baa ne nkyɛn;
na oennhu no araa dze kodur dɛ ɔwoo babanyin: Na ɔtoo no dzin Jesus.
2: Na ber a wɔwoo Jesus wɔ Bethlehem wɔ Judea, wɔ ɔhen Herod aber do no, hwɛ, enyansafo fi boka baa Jerusalem bebisaa dɛ,
Hen na nyia wɔawo no Jewfo Hen no wɔ? Na yehun no woraba wɔ boka, na yɛaba yɛrobɔkotow no,
Na ɔhen Herod tsee no, n’akoma tui, na Jerusalem nyina so dɛmara.
Na ohyiaa ɔman no asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo nyina no, obisabisaa hɔn fakor a wɔbɔwo Christ no.
Na wɔsee no dɛ. Wɔ Bethlehem wɔ Judea, na dɛm na nkɔnhyɛnyi no akyerɛw dɛ,
ɔwo, Bethlehem, Judah asaase ampaara ennyɛ kumaba wɔ Judah asafohen no mu: Na ɔwo wo mu na ambrado befi aba; ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ me man Israel no guanhwɛfo.
Na Herod frɛɛ enyansafo no wɔ nsumaa mu no, obisaa hɔn ber a woraba no puei no ara yie.
Na ɔsomaa hɔn Bethlehem dɛ, hom nkɔ nkɔhwehwɛ abofraba no ho asɛm yie, na sɛ hom hu no a, hom mbɛkã nkyerɛ me, ma mo so membra mombɔ-kotow no bi.
Na hɔndze, wotsiee ɔhen no no, wosii mu kɔree; na hwɛ, woraba a wohunii wɔ boka no dzii hɔn enyim kodur dɛ obegyinaa mbrɛ abofraba no wɔ no etsifi.
Na wohun woraba no, wodzii dɛw kɛse pa.
Na wɔbaa dan no mu bohun abofraba no ɔnye ne nã Mary, na wɔkotowee sɔɔr no, na wobuee hɔn akoradze kyɛɛ no adze, sika nye krɔbɔw nye myrrh.
Na woyii kyerɛɛ hɔn adaaso mu dɛ mma wɔnnsan nnkɔ Herod nkyɛn bio no, wɔfaa kwan fofor bi do sanee kɔr hɔn kurow mu.
Na wɔkɔree no, hwɛ, Ewuradze bɔfoe yii noho kyerɛɛ Joseph adaaso mu see no dɛ, soɛr, fa abofraba no nye ne nã guan kɔ Egypt, na tsena hɔ kodu dɛ mebɛse wo: na Herod bɔhwehwɛ abofraba no eku no.
Na ɔsoɛree no, ɔfaa abofraba no nye ne nã anago, na osii mu kɔr Egypt,
na ɔwɔ hɔ araa dze kodur Herod no wu, ma dza Ewuradze nam nkɔnhyɛnyi no do kãe no aaba mu dɛ, mefrɛɛ me ba fii Egypt.

Na Herod hun dɛ enyansafo no adaadaa no no, no bo fuuw kɛsenara, na ɔsomae ma wokokum mbofra nyina a wɔwɔ Bethlehem nye no ntoaado nyina a woedzi mfe ebien nye hɔn a wonnyae nndzii, dɛ mbrɛ mber a obisaa enyansafo no yie no wɔkyerɛɛ no.
Nna dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah kãe no baa mu dɛ,
Wɔtsee ndze bi wɔ Ramah, Osū nye ewuotwa kɛse, Rachel rusū ne mba, na ɔmmpɛ dɛ wɔkvekye no werɛ, osiandɛ wonnyi hɔ.
Na Herod wui no, hwɛ, Ewuradze no bɔfoe yii noho kyerɛɛ Joseph adaaso mu wɔ Egypt see no dɛ,
Soɛr, fa abofraba no nye ne na kɔ Israel asaase do, na hɔn a wɔhwehwɛɛ abofraba no nkwa no ewu.
Nna ɔsoɛree faa abofraba no nye ne nã na ɔbaa Israel asaase do.
Na ɔtsee dɛ Archelaus ridzi hen wɔ Judea wɔ n'egya Herod ananmu no, osuroo dɛ ɔbɔkɔ hɔ, na woyii kyerɛɛ no adaaso mu no, ɔmaan Galilee afamu,
na ɔbɛtsenaa kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Nazareth mu, ma dza nkɔnhyɛfo no kãe no aaba mu dɛ, wɔbɛfrɛ no Nazarethnyi.
3: Na nda no mu no John Onumanyi no bae bɛkãa asɛm wɔ Judea sar do,
na ɔsee dɛ, hom nnu homho, na ɔsor ahenman no abɛn
Na oyi nye nyia nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah kãa no ho asɛm dɛ, obi ne ndze retsēa mu wɔ sar no do dɛ, Hom nsiesie Ewuradze no kwan Hom mma n’atsempɔn ntsentsen
Na John fura efupɔnkɔnhwi tam na nwoma abɔdo bɔ n’asen, na n’edziban nye akyekyemawe na kwaa mu wo.
Na Jerusalem nye Judea nyina nye asaase a abɔ Jordan ho aprɔw nyina fiir edzi kɔr no hɔ
kɛkãa hɔn bɔn, na onumaa hɔn wɔ esutsen Jordan mu.
Na ohun Phariseefo nye Sadduceefo no mu pii dɛ wɔreba n’enuma ho no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Nhurutsia mba! Woana tuee hom aso dɛ hom nguan mfi ebufuw a ɔreba no ho?
Na afei hom nsow aba a ɔfata nnuho:
Na mma hom nnsusu nnkã wɔ hom mu dɛ, hɛndze, hɛn egya nye Abraham: Na mese hom dɛ, Nyankopɔn botum dɛ onyan mba fi abo yi mu ma Abraham.
Na afei so wɔdze abɔndua no ato ndua no ndwow ho dada, dɛ dua biara a ɔnnsow aba pa no wobotwa no ato gya mu.
Emidze, munuma hom nsu mu kɔ nnuho mu, na nyia odzi m'ekyir reba no no ho yɛ dzen kyɛn me, no nsokota mpo mennsɛ dɛ mikitsa: Ɔno na obonuma hom wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu, na gya mu;
ɔno na no nhuwdo-apaawa kitsa ne nsamu, na ɔbɛpra ne famu hɔ kofee, na ɔaboaboa n’ewifua ano ekogu san do, na ntsɛw no ɔdze gya a onndum ahyew.
Nna Jesus fii Galilee baa John hɔ wɔ Jordan dɛ onnuma no.
Na John dze, nkyɛ orisiw no kwan dɛ, emi na mihia dɛ ɔwo inuma me, na ɔwo ereba mo hɔ?
Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, ma ho kwan sesei, na dɛmara na ɔsɛ hɛn dɛ yɛhyɛ tsenenee nyina mã. Nna ɔmaa no kwan.
Na Jesus wowiee no numa no, ofii nsu no mu ntsɛmara, na hwɛ, ɔsor buei maa no, na ohun Nyankopɔn Sunsum tse dɛ ebubur risian ba no do;
na hwɛ, ndze bi fi sor kãa dɛ, oyi nye mo Dɔba a ɔsɔ m'enyi.
4: Nna Sunsum no dze Jesus kɔr sar no do ma abɔnsam no kasɔɔ no hwɛe.
Na odzii mbuada adaduanan adzekyee nye adzesaa no, ekyir no ɔkɔm dzee no.
Na ɔsɔhwɛfo no baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, sɛ eyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba a, kasa ma abo yi ndan paanoo.
Na obuae see dɛ, woakyerɛw dɛ, nnyɛ paanoo nko bi na nyimpa nam do bɛtsena ase, na asɛm biara a ofi Nyankopɔn anomu so.
Nna abɔnsam faa no kɔr kurow krɔnkrɔn no mu, na ɔdze no kesii asɔrfi ne bea-sorɔnsorɔm no do,
na ɔsee no dɛ, sɛ eyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba a, tow woho kyen famu: Na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, ɔbɛhyɛ n'abɔfoe mbra wɔ wo ho, na wɔbɔsoa wo hɔn nsamu, mma aammfa wo nan ammpem bo da,
Jesus see no dɛ, wɔakyerɛw bio dɛ, mma nnsɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ.
Na abɔnsam faa no bio kɔr kokwaa tsentsenntsen bi do, na ɔkyerɛɛ no wiadze ahenman nyina nye no mu enyimnyam.
Na ɔsee no dɛ. Yinom nyina na medze mebɛma wo, sɛ ebɔkotow asɔr me a.
Nna Jesus see no dɛ, fi ha fi, Satan: Na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, sɔr Ewuradze wo Nyakopɔn, na no nko na som no.
Nna abɔnsam no gyaa no hɔ; na hwɛ, abɔfo bae bɔsoom no.
Na Jesus tsee dɛ woeyi John ama no, ɔtwee noho kɔr Galilee;
na ofii Nazareth no, ɔbae bɛtsenaa Capernaum a ɔwɔ mpoano wɔ Zebulun nye Naphtali ntoaado no;
ma dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah kãe no aaba mu dɛ,
Zebulun asaase nye Naphtali asaase, Po kwan do, Jordan egya, Amanamamfo Galilee,
ɔman a wɔtse sum mu Hun kan kɛse, na hɔn a wɔtse owu asaase do, nye owu sunsuma mu. Kan epue ama hɔn.
Ofitsi aber no Jesus hyɛɛ ase kãa asɛm na ɔsee dɛ, hom nnu homho, na ɔsor ahenman no abɛn.
Na ɔnenam Galilee po ho no, ohun enuanom beenu, Simon a wɔfrɛ no Peter, nye Andrew no nua, dɛ worugu asawu wɔ po mu; osiandɛ wɔyɛ enufo.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mbedzi m'ekyir, na mebɛyɛ hom nyimpa enufo.
Na ntsɛmara wɔdaan asawu no gyae na wobedzii n’ekyir.
Na ofii hɔ kɔr n’enyim no, ohun enuanom beenu so, Zebedee ba James nye no nua John a wɔnye hɔn egya Zebedee wɔ hɛn mu resa hɔn asawu; na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn.
Na ntsɛmara wɔdaan hɛn no nye hɔn egya gyae, na wokedzii n'ekyir.
Na Jesus kekyimaa Galilee nyina kyerɛkyerɛe wɔ nhyiamudan mu; na ɔkãa ahenman no ho asɛmpa no, na ɔsaa nyarba nyina nye ahoɔmberɛw nyina wɔ ɔman no mu.
Na no ho asɛm tahyee kɔr Syria nyina; na wɔdze hɔn a wɔyar nyina a nyarba nye amandzehu horow ekitsa hɔn, nye hɔn a mbɔnsam afa hɔn, nye hɔn a wotwa ehim, nye mbubuifo brɛɛ no, ma ɔsaa hɔn yarba.
Na nyimpadodow pii a wofi Galilee nye Decapolis nye Jerusalem nye Judea nye Jordan egya kaa no do.
