5: Na ohun nyimpadodow no, ɔkɔr koko no do, na ɔtsenaa ase no, n’esuafo baa ne nkyɛn.
Na obuee n’ano kyerɛkyerɛɛ hon dɛ,
Nhyira akã sunsum mu ehiafo, na hɔn na ɔsor ahenman no yɛ hɔndze.
Nhyira akã hɔn a hɔn werɛ ahow, na hɔn na wɔbɛkyekye hɔn werɛ.
Nhyira akã abrɛfo, na hɔn na wobenya asaase no edzi.
Nhyira akã hɔn a tsenenee ho ɔkɔm nye nsukɔm dze hɔn, na hɔn na wɔbɛma wɔamee.
Nhyira aka mbɔbɔrhufo, na hɔn na wobohu hɔn mbɔbor.
Nhyira akã hɔn a hɔn akoma mu tsew, na hɔn na wobohu Nyankopɔn.
Nhyira akã esiesiefo, na hɔn na wɔbɛfrɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn mba.
Nhyira akã hɔn a tsenenee ntsi wɔahaw hɔn, na hon na ɔsor ahenman no yɛ hɔndze.
Nhyira akã hom ber a wɔbɛyaw hom na wɔahaw hom, na wɔakã nsɛmbɔn nyina ato hom do akɔhwi mu, wɔ me ntsi.
Hom ndzi dɛw na hom ho nsɛpɛw hom, na hom akatua sõ wɔ sor; na dɛmara na wɔhaaw nkɔnhyɛfo a wodzii hom kan no.
Hom nye asaase do nkyen; na sɛ nkyen no ayew ne dɛw a, wɔdze ebɛnadze bɛhyɛ no nkyen? Onnye mma hwee bio, na mbom wɔtow gu ma nyimpa tsiatsia do.
Hom nye wiadze kan no. Kurow a ɔda koko do nntum nnsuma.
Eso wɔnnsɔ kandzea mmfa nnsi kuruw ase; na wɔdze si kandzeadua do, ma ɔhyerɛn ma hɔn a wɔwɔ fie nyina.
Dɛmara na hom mma hom kan no nhyerɛn wɔ nyimpa enyim, ma woeehu hom ndwuma pa na wɔaahyɛ hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor enyimnyam.
Mma hom nndwen dɛ mebae ma bɛsɛɛ mbra no anaa nkɔnhyɛfo no: Mammbɛsɛɛ, na mebɛhyɛɛ mã.
Na nokwar mese hom dɛ, Sor nye asaase nnyae nntwaa mu yi, iota kor anaadɛ nsensanee kor nnkefi mbra no ho etwa mu, gyedɛ ne nyina ahyɛ ana.

Dɛm ntsi obiara a ɔbɔtõ mbransɛm nketseaba yi mu kor, na ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ nyimpa dɛm, wɔbɛfrɛ no aketseaba wɔ sor ahenman no mu; na obiara a ɔbɛyɛ na ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ no, ɔno na wɔbɛfrɛ no ɔkɛse wɔ sor ahenman no mu.
Na mese hom dɛ gyedɛ hom tsenenee kyɛn kyerɛwfo no nye Phariseefo no hɔn tsenenee, ɔno hom nnkɛhɛn sor ahenman no mu da.
Hom atse dɛ wokãa kyerɛɛ tsetsefo no dɛ, mma nndzi ewu, na obiara a obedzi ewu no, obedzi fɔ wɔ atsɛmbu no mu;

na emidze mese hom dɛ, obiara a no bo fuw no nua gyan, obedzi atsɛmbu no mu fɔ; na obiara a ɔbɛse no nua, Raca, obedzi fɔ wɔ mpanyimfo bagua mu; na obiara a ɔbɛse, ɔkwasea, obedzi fɔ akɔ Gehenna gya no mu.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ edze w’ayɛyɛdze ba afɔrmbukyia no ho, na sɛ ekaa wɔ hɔ dɛ wo nua wɔ wo ho asɛm bi a,
gyaa w’ayɛyɛdze wɔ afɔrmbukyia no enyim hɔ, na dzi kan kɔ nye wo nua nkɔbɔ mu, ana aba abɛma w’ayɛyɛdze.
Enye wo tamfo mbɔ mu ntsɛm ber a enye no wɔ kwan mu no; amma da bi wo tamfo eennyi wo annhyɛ ɔtsɛmbuafo nsa, na ɔtsɛmbuafo no eennyi wo annhyɛ ɔsomfo nsa, ma wɔaammfa wo annkɔto efiadze.
Nokwar mese wo dɛ, innkefi hɔ gyedɛ etua nyiwa a aka ekyir no ana.
Hom atse dɛ wɔkãa dɛ, Mma nntõ awar;
na emidze mese hom dɛ, Obiara a ɔhwɛ ɔbaa dɛ no kɔn dɔ no no, ɔafa no dada wɔ n'akoma mu.
Na sɛ w'enyiwa nyimfa to wo fintsidua a, tu, na tow fi woho kyen: Na oye ma wo dɛ wo nyimpa dua ne fã kor bɛsɛɛ na wɔammfa wo nyimpadua nyina annkɔto Gehenna,
Na sɛ wo nsa nyimfa to wo fintsidua a, twa, na tow fi woho kyen: Na oye ma wo dɛ wo nyimpadua ne fã kor bɛsɛɛ na wo nyimpadua nyina annkɔ Gehenna.
Wɔkãe so dɛ, Obiara a ɔbɔkõ ne yer, ma ɔmma no ɔkõ nwoma;
na emidza mese hom dɛ obiara a ɔbɔkõ ne yer, na sɛ nnyɛ ndwamanyɛ ntsi a, ɔma ɔtõ awar; na obiara a ɔbɔwar nyia wɔako no no, ɔtõ awar.
Bio hom atse dɛ wɔkãa kyerɛɛ tsetsefo no dɛ, mma nnkã ntanhun na fa w’atanyi ma Ewuradze;
na emidze, mese hom dɛ, mma hom nnkã ntam koraa: Mma hom nnkã ɔsor osiandɛ ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn n’ahengua;
mma hom nnkã asaase, osiandɛ ɔyɛ n'ananadzegua; mma hom nnkã Jerusalem, osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔhen kɛse no kurow.
Eso mma nnkã wo tsir ntam, osiandɛ irunntum ayɛ nhwi kor fufuw anaa tuntum.
Na hom mma hom kasaa nyɛ, nyew, nyew; oho, oho; na biribi a ɔkyɛn yinom fi ɔbɔn no mu.
Hom atse dɛ wɔkãa dɛ, enyiwa nsi enyiwa ananmu, na esē nsi esē ananmu;
na emidze, mese hom dɛ, mma hom nnsiw ɔbɔn no kwan; na obiara a ɔbɛpaa w’aso nyimfa mu no, dan kor no so ma no;
na sɛ obi pɛ dɛ ɔnye wo dzi asɛm, na ɔgye w’asetar a, ma ɔmfa wo nkatado no so;
na obiara a ɔbɛhyɛ wo dɛ enye no nkɔ ɔkwansin kor no, enye no nkɔ ebien.
Nyia ɔserɛ wo no, ma no; nyia ɔpɛ dɛ ɔfɛm wɔ wo hɔ no, mma nndan woho mmfi no ho.
Hom atse dɛ wɔkãa dɛ, dɔ wo nyɛnko na tan wo tamfo;
na emidze, mese hom dɛ, hom ndɔ hom atamfo, na hom nsɔr mma hɔn a wɔhaw hom;
ma hom aayɛ hom Egya a ɔwɔ so no ne mba: Na ɔma n’ewia fir wɔ nyimpa bɔn nye nyimpa pa do, na ɔtɔ nsu gu hɔn a wɔtsen nye hɔn a wɔnntsen do.
Na sɛ hom dɔ hɔn a wɔdɔ hom a, ebɛn akatua na hom nya? Ana atowgyefo no so nnyɛ dɛmara?
Na sɛ hom kyia hom nuanom nko a, ebɛnadze na hom ayɛ abor do? Ana amanamamfo no so nnyɛ dɛmara?
Dɛm ntsi hom ndzi mu, dɛ mbrɛ hom sor Egya no dzi mu.
6: Hom nhwɛyie, mma hom aannyɛ hom tsenenee wɔ nyimpa enyim dɛ wonhu: Ɔyɛ dɛm a, hom nnyi akatua wɔ hom egya a ɔwɔ sor no nkyɛn.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ ereyɛ ayɛ a, mma nnhɛn totorobɛnto wɔ w'enyim dɛ mbrɛ ndabrabafo no yɛ wɔ nhyiamudan nye abrɔn mu, ma woeenya nyimpa hɔ enyimnyam. Nokwar mese hom dɛ, woenya hɔn akatua dada.
Na sɛ ereyɛ ayɛ a, mma wo nsa bankum nnhu dza wo nsa nyimpa reyɛ;
ama w'ayɛ aaka nsumaa mu, na w'Egya a ohu nsumaa mu no obotua wo kaw wɔ gua do.
Na sɛ hom rosɔr a, mma hom nnyɛ dɛ ndabrabafo no; osiandɛ wɔpɛ dɛ wogyina nhyiamudan mu nye abɔntsen ntoaado sɔr, ma nyimpa eehu. Nokwar mese hom dɛ, woenya hɔn akatua dada.
Na ɔwɔdze, sɛ erosɔr a, hɛn wo pia mu, na atow w’abow mu no, sor ma w’Egya a owo nsumaa mu no, na w ’Egya a ohu nsumaa mu no obotua wo kaw wɔ gua do.
Na hom rosɔr a, mma hom nnyɛ kasansanmu gyan, dɛ amanamamfo no: Osiandɛ wɔdwen dɛ wobetsie hɔn wɔ hɔn kasa dodow ntsi.
Dɛm ntsi mma hom nye hɔn nnsɛ: Na hom Egya nyim ndzɛmba a ohia hom ansaana hom ribisa no.
Dɛm ntsi hom nsɔr dɛ iyi: Hɛn Egya a ewɔ sor, wo dzin ho ntsew,
w’ahendzi mbra, wɔnyɛ wo pɛ wɔ asaase do dɛ ɔsor.
Ma hɛn hen daa daa edziban ndɛ.
Na fa hɛn akaw kyɛ hɛn, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn so yɛdze akyɛ hɛn akafo.
Na mma mmfa hɛn nnkɔ nsɔhwɛ mu, na yi hɛn fi ɔbɔn no mu.
Na sɛ hom dze nyimpa hɔn mfom kyɛ hɔn a, hom sor Egya so dze bɛkyɛ hom.
Na sɛ hom ammfa nyimpa hɔn mfom annkyɛ hɔn a, hom Egya so remmfa hom mfom nnkyɛ hom.
Na eso sɛ hom ridzi mbuada a, mma hom nnyɛ dɛ ndabrabafo no mmunamuna hom enyim: Na wɔsɛɛ hɔn enyim ma nyimpa eehu dɛ woridzi mbuada. Nokwar mese hom dɛ, woenya hɔn akatua.
Na ɔwodze, sɛ idzi mbuada a, sera wo tsirmu na hohor w’enyim;
amma eennyi woho annkyerɛ nyimpa dɛ iridzi mbuada, na mbom wɔ w’Egya a ɔwɔ nsumaa mu no enyim, na w'Egya a ohu nsumaa mu no obotua wo kaw.
Mma hom mmpɛ akoradze nngu asaase do, mbrɛ nkakraka nye nkandar sɛɛ no, na ewifo bubu mu kowia;
na hom mpɛ akoradze ngu sor, mbrɛ nkakraka ɔnye nkandar nnsɛɛ no, na ewifo mmbubu mu nnkowia:
na mbrɛ w’akoradze wɔ no, hɔ na w’akoma so wɔ.
Nyimpadua ne kandzea nye enyiwa: dɛm ntsi sɛ w'enyiwa yɛ kor a, wo nyimpadua nyina bɛyɛ kann.
Na sɛ w'enyiwa muo a, wo nyimpadua nyina bɛyɛ kusuww. Na sɛ kan a ɔwɔ wo mu no yɛ sum a, sum no ne kɛse tse dɛn!
Obiara nntum nnsom wuranom beenu; na obekyir baako na ɔadɔ baako, anaadɛ obosuo baako mu na oebu baako cnyimtsia. Hom runnturn nnsom Nyankopɔn nye mammon.

Dɛm ntsi mese hom dɛ, Mma hom nndwendwen hom nkwa ho, dɛ ebɛnadze na hom bedzi anaa ebɛnadze na hom bɔnom, anaaso hom nyimpadua ho, dɛ ebenadze na hom bofura. Ana nkwa nnkyɛn edziban, anaa nyimpadua nnkyɛn efuradze?
Hom nhwɛ wimu nnoma dɛ wonndua na wommbu, eso wɔmmboaboa ano nnhyɛ san do; naaso hom sor Egya nyɛn hɔn. Ana hom nnsom bo pii nnkyɛn hɔn?
Na hom mu woana na ɔdwendwen a, obotum dze basafa kor ato ne tsentsen do?
Na ɔyɛ dɛn na hom dwendwen wɔ efuradze ho? Hom nhwɛ nsūa haban mu nsukookoo mbrɛ wonyin: wɔnnyɛ edwuma eso wɔnntow asaaba:
naaso mese hom dɛ Solomon n’enyimnyam nyina mu mpo ɔannka noho dɛ ymom mu kor.
Na sɛ Nyankopɔn ma haban mu efuw a ɔwɔ ha ndɛ na ɔkyena wɔdze gu fononoo mu efuradze dɛm a, ɔnnkɛyɛ akyɛn yi pii ama hom, hom a hom gyedzi suar?
Dɛm ntsi mma hom nndwendwen dɛ, ebɛnadze na yebedzi? Anaa, ebɛnadze na yɛbɔnom? Anaa, ebɛnadze na yebofura?
Na dɛm ndzɛmba yi nyina na amanamamfo hwehwɛ; na hom sor Egya nyim dɛ yinom nyina hia hom.
Na hom ndzi kan nhwehwɛ n’ahenman nye ne tsenenee, na wɔdze yinom nyina bɛka hom ho.
Dɛm ntsi mma hom nndwendwen ɔkyena ho; na ɔkyena bɔdwendwen nankasa no ho. Da kor no mu bɔn dɔɔ sõ ma no.
7: Mma hom mmbu atsɛn, ma wommbu hom atsɛn.
Na atsɛmbu kor a hom dze bobu no, wɔdze bobu hom; na esusudze kor a hom dze susu no, wɔdze bosusu ama hom.
Na ɔyɛ dɛn na ehwɛ duaba a ɔwɔ wo nua enyiwa mu, na enndwen mpuna a ɔwɔ wankasa w’enyiwa mu ho?
Anaaso ebɛyɛ dɛn ase wo nua dɛ, ma minyi duaba mfi w’enyiwa mu, na hwɛ, mpuna wɔ wankasa w’enyiwa mu?
Ɔwo dabrabanyi, dzi kan yi mpuna fi wankasa w’enyiwa mu: Nna ibohu yie eyi duaba no efi wo nua enyiwa mu.
Mma hom mmfa dza no ho tsew no mma nkraman, eso mma hom nntow hom ahondzepa nngu mpreko enyim, amma wɔaammfa hɔn anan enntsiatsia do, na wɔaannsan bio ammbɛtsetsew hom mu.
Hom mbisa na wɔbɛma hom; hom nhwehwɛ na hom bohu; hom mbɔ mu na wobobue hom:
na obiaɛa a obisa no onya; na nyia ɔhwehwɛ no ohu; na nyia ɔbɔ mu no wobobue no.
Anaaso hom mu woana, na sɛ ne ba bisa no paanoo a, ɔbɛma no ɔbo?
Anaaso sɛ obisa no esunam a, ɔbɛma no ɔwɔ?
Na sɛ hom a hom muo yi nyim mbrɛ hom dze akyɛdze pa ma hom mba a, mpɛn ahen ara na hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor no nnkɛfa ndzɛmba pa ama hɔn a wobisa no?
Dɛm ntsi adze biara a hom pɛ dɛ nyimpa yɛ ma hom no, hom nyɛ dɛmara so mma hɔn; na iyi nye mbra no nye nkɔnhyɛfo no.
Hom nhɛn abow tseaba no mu, na abow a ɔtsɛw, na ɔkwan a ɔyɛ tɛtɛr nye dza wɔdze kɔ sɛɛ mu, na piinara wɔ hɔ a wɔfa mu.
Na abow a ɔyɛ tseaba na ɔkwan a ɔyɛ heaheaba nye dza wɔdze kɔ nkwa mu, na kumaabi na wohu.
Hom nhwɛ yie wɔ nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo ho, na wɔba hom nkyɛn wɔ nguan-nwoma akataho mu, na hɔn mu dze, wɔyɛ mpataku edzifodzipɛfo.
Hɔn aba na hom dze bohu hɔn. Ana nyimpa tsetsew wenyinaba wɔ nsoɛ do, anaaso adɔmba wɔ kɔkrɔ do?
Dɛmara na dua pa ɔsow aba pa; na dua a ɔaprow dze, ɔsow aba bɔn.
Dua pa nntum nnsow aba bɔn, na eso dua a ɔaprɔw nntum nnsow aba pa.
Dua biara a ɔnnsow aba pa no, wotwa, na wɔtow kyen gya mu.
Dɛm ntsi hom dze hɔn aba bohu hɔn.
Nnyɛ obiara a ɔse me dɛ, Ewuradze, Ewuradze, na ɔbɔkɔ sor ahenman no mu; na nyia ɔbɛyɛ m'Egya a ɔwɔ sor no pɛ a.
Da no mu no dodowara bɛse me dɛ, Ewuradze, Ewuradze, ana yɛammfa wo dzin annhyɛ nkɔm, na yɛammfa wo dzin enntu mbɔnsam, na yɛammfa wo dzin aanyɛ tum ndwuma pii?
Na aber no, mebɛpaa mu makã akyerɛ hɔn dɛ, minnyim hom da: Hom mfi me nkyɛn nkɔ, hom a hom yɛ emumuyɛ.
Dɛm ntsi obiara a otsie me nsɛm yi na ɔyɛ no, wɔdze no bosusu badwem banyi a osii ne dan wɔ ɔbotan do no.
Na nsu tɔree, na nsuyirii bae, na ehum tui ma wɔboor dan no na ɔannhwe ase, osiandɛ wɔtoo ne fapem wɔ ɔbotan do.
Na obiara a otsie me nsɛm yi na ɔnnyɛ no, wɔdze no bosusu kotobonyi a osii ne dan wɔ anhwea do
Na nsu tɔree, na nsuyirii bae, na chum tui boor dan no, na ɔhwee ase. Na n'asehwe no so.
Na obaa dɛ Jesus wiee nsɛm yi no, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛɛ nyimpadodow no ahobow;
na okyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ nyia ɔwɔ tum, na ɔnntse dɛ kyerɛwfo no.
8: Na ofii koko no do sianee no, nyimpadodow pii kaa no do.
Na hwɛ, ɔkwatanyi bi bae bɔkotoow no see dɛ, mo wura, sɛ epɛ a, ibotum dɛ ema mo ho san.
Na ɔtseen ne nsa dze kãa no see dɛ, mepɛ, wo ho nsan. Na ntsɛmara na kwata no fii no ho.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, hwɛ mma aannkã annkyerɛ obiara, na san kɔ, fa woho kɛkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no, na kɛma ayɛyɛdze a Moses hyɛe no fa yɛ dase ma hɔn.
Na ɔkɛhɛɛn Capernaum no, ɔhamupanyin bi baa ne nkyɛn bɛserɛɛ no see no dɛ,
Mo wura, m'abofra da fie yar mbubui ruhu amandze dodow.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, mebɛba mabɛyɛ no edur.
Na ɔhamupanyin no buae see dɛ. Mo wura mennsɛ dɛ ebɛhɛn me hatsɛw ase; na kã asɛm no nko, na m’abofra ho bɛsan.
Na mo so meyɛ nyimpa a mowɔ tum ase, na mowɔ nsordaafo wɔ m’ase, na mese yi dɛ, kɔ a, ɔkɔ; na mese obi so dɛ, bra a, ɔba; na mese m'abofra dɛ, yɛ yi a, ɔyɛ.
Na Jesus tsee no, ɔyɛɛ no nwanwa, na ɔsee hɔn a wɔka no do, no dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ, Israel mu mpo munnhun gyedzi a ɔtse dɛm yi pɛn.
Na mese hom dɛ dodowara befi boka ɔnye anee aba, na wɔnye Abraham nye Isaac nye Jacob abɛtsena ase wɔ sor ahenman no mu;
na ahenman no ne mba no wɔbɔtow hɔn egu ekyirkyi sum no mu: Hɔ na osū nye asetwɛr wɔ.
Na Jesus see ɔhamupanym no dɛ, kɔ, na dɛ mbrɛ agye edzi yi ɔnyɛ dɛmara mma wo. Na abofra ho saan dɔn no ara mu.
Na Jesus baa Peter fie no, ohun n'asew dɛ ɔda hɔ yar papu.
Na ɔkãa ne nsa na papu no fii no do; na ɔsoɛree na ɔsoom no.
Na odur ewimbir no, wɔdze pii a mbɔnsam afa hɔn brɛɛ no, na ɔdze n'asɛm tuu esunsum no, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn a wɔyar nyina edur,
ama dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah kãe no aaba mu dɛ, ɔno na ɔfaa hɛn ahoɔmberɛw, na ɔsoaa hɛn nyarba.
Na Jesus hun nyimpadodow pii wɔ no ho no, ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔnkɔ esuegya no ho.
Na kyerɛwnyi bi bae bɛsee no dɛ, kyerɛkyerɛfo, beebiara a ebɔkɔ no, mebɛka wo do.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, nsɔ wɔ etu, na wimu nnoma wɔ mberɛbuw, na nyimpa Ba no nnyi mbrɛ ɔdze ne tsir to.
Na n’esuafo mu bi so see no dɛ, mo wura, ma me kwan ma monkɔ minkesie m’egya ana.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, ka mo do, na ma ewufo nsie hɔnara hɔn ewufo.
Na ɔkor hɛn mu no, n’esuafo no kaa no do.
Na hwɛ, ehum kɛse tui wɔ po no mu, na asorɛkye kataa hɛn no do, na ɔnodze ɔada.
Na wɔbae benyaan no see dɛ, Owura, gye hɛn, yɛrehera.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom yɛ ehufo, hom a hom gyedzi suar? Nna ɔsoɛree na ɔbraa mframa nye po no, na ɔtaa dzinn.
Na ɔyɛɛ nyimpa no nwanwa na wɔsee dɛ, ebɛn nyimpa nye yi a mframa na po mpo wotsie no yi?
Na odur esuegya no ho wɔ Gadarafo asaase do no, hɔn a mbɔnsam afa hɔn beenu behyiaa no kwan; wofi aboda mu na wɔyɛ abɔyafo mbordo dɛ, ma obi nntum nntwa mu wɔ kwan no do
Na hwɛ, wɔtsēaa mu see dɛ, yɛnye wo wɔ ebɛn yɛ, ɔwo, Nyankopɔn Ba? Ana ebaa ha dɛ erebɛhaw hɛn ansaana ber no edu?
Na ofi hɔn nkyɛn kɔ ekyir kakra no, mprekokuw kɛse bi wɔ hɔ ridzidzi.
Na mbɔnsam no serɛɛ no dɛ, sɛ itu hɛn a, soma hɛn mprekokuw no mu.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nkɔ. Na wofiir edzi sii mu kɔr mpreko no mu; na hwɛ, mprekokuw no nyina faa twitwi kesiaan ɔbo kronn no koguguu po no mu, na wowuwui wɔ nsu no mu.
Na hɔn a wɔrenyɛn hɔn no guanee kɔr kurow no mu kɛkãa ne nyina nye dza ɔbaa hɔn a mbɔnsam afa hɔn no do no ho asɛm.
Na hwɛ, kurow do nyina fur edzi behyiaa Jesus, na wohun no no, wɔserɛɛ no dɛ omfi hɔn ntoaado nkɔ.
9: Na ɔkɔr hɛn mu, na otwae baa nankasa no kurow mu.
Na hwɛ, wɔdze mbubuinyi a ɔda mpa do brɛɛ no; na Jesus hun hɔn gyedzi no, ɔsee mbubuinyi no dɛ, ɔba, hyɛ dzen, wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo.
Na hwɛ, kyerɛwfo no binom sesee wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, oyi ɔkã ebususɛm.
Na Jesus hun hɔn adwen no, ɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom rodwen dza omuo wɔ hom akoma mu yi?
Na mmuana na ɔyɛ mberɛw kɛse, ebɛse dɛ, wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo, anaa ebɛse dɛ, soɛr na nantsew, a?
Na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma hom ehu dɛ nyimpa Ba no wɔ tum wɔ asaase do dɛ ɔdze bɔn kyɛ a, (nna ɔsee mbubuinyi no dɛ) soɛr, fa wo mpa na kɔ wo fie.
Na ɔsoɛree na osii mu kor ne fie.
Na nyimpadodow no hunii no, wosuroi, na woyii Nyankopɔn a ɔdze dɛm tum ama nyimpa no ayɛw.
Na ɔresen no, ohun nyimpa bi a wɔfrɛ no Matthew dɛ ɔtse atowgye, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ka mo do. Na ɔsoɛree kaa no do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔtse edzidzi wɔ ne fie; na hwɛ, atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo pii nye Jesus nye n’esuafo bɛtsenatsenaa hɔ.
Na Phariseefo no hunii no, wɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom kyerɛkyerɛfo nye atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo dzidzi yi?
Na ɔtsee no, ɔsee dɛ, hɔn a wɔtse hɔn apɔw mu no, wonnhia oduyɛfo, na mbom hɔn a wɔyar no a.
Na hom nkɔ nkosūa iyi ase: Mepɛ ehumbɔbɔr, na nnyɛ afɔrbɔ a. Mammbɛfrɛ atseneneefo, ha mbom ndzebɔnyɛfo a.
Nna John n’esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na yɛnye Phariseefo no yɛtɔ dɛ yedzi mbuada, na w’esuafo dze, wonndzi mbuada yi?
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Ayeforpia mu mba no, aber a ayeforkun no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn, wobotum edzi nkɔmbɔ anaa? Na nda no bɛba a wobeyi ayeforkun no efi hɔn nkyɛn, na nkyii wobedzi mbuada.
Obi mmfa tam fofor sin nntaa atar dadaw mu: Dɛm no, dza wɔdze taa mu no yi fi atar no mu, na ntsewee no yɛ kɛse.
Na wɔmmfa wenyin fofor nngu nwomantoa dadaw mu: Dɛm no, nwomantoa no paa, na wenyin no hue gu, ma toa no so sɛɛ; na wɔdze wenyin fofor gu toa fofor mu, ma ebien nyina ayɛ yie.
Na ɔrekã yinom kyerɛ hɔn no, hwɛ, ɔpanyin bi bae bɔkotoow no see dɛ, me babaa ewu sesei; na bra bɛfa wo nsa to no do, na obenya nkwa.
Na Jesus soɛree kaa no do, na n’esuafo no so dɛmara.
Na hwɛ, ɔbaa bi a ɔyar bɔgyaagu mfe duebien bae bedzii n’ekyir kãa n’atar ano ndwow:
na ɔsee wɔ no mu dɛ, sɛ mekã n’atar nko ara a, mo ho bɛyɛ me dzen.
Na Jesus daan noho no, na ohun no no, ɔsee dɛ, Babaa, hyɛ dzen, wo gyedzi agye wo. Na ofitsi dɔn no ara mu na ɔbaa no no ho yɛɛ no dzen.
Na Jesus hɛɛn ɔpanyin ne fie, na ohun atɛntɛbɛnhɛmfo nye nyimpadodow a wɔreyɛ dedeede no,
ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom ntwe homho, na akataasiaba no nnwui, na ɔada. Na wɔsereew no twee.
Na woyii nyimpadodow no edzi no, ɔkɔr dan mu na okosuoo ne nsa mu, na akataasiaba no soɛree.
Na iyi ho asɛm tahyee asaase nyina do.
Na Jesus fi hɔ rokɔ no, enyifurafo beenu kaa no do tsēaa mu see dɛ, David ba, hu hɛn mbɔbɔr.
Na odur fi no mu no, enyifurafo no baa ne nkyɛn, na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, ana hom gye dzi dɛ mubotum ayɛ yi? Wɔsee no dɛ, nyew, Owura.
Nna ɔkãa hɔn enyiwa see dɛ, mbrɛ hom gyedzi tse no, ɔnyɛ dɛmara mma hom.
Na hɔn enyiwa buebuei. Na Jesus braa hɔn dzendzenndzen dɛ, Hom nhwɛ mma obiara eennhu.
Na hɔndze, wofii hɔ no, wɔdze ne nka kɛtahyee wɔ asaase nyina do.
Na worifir edzi no, hwɛ, wɔdze mmura a abɔnsam afa no brɛɛ no.
Na otuu abɔnsam no, mmura no kasae. Na ɔyɛɛ nyimpadodow no nwanwa, na wɔsee dɛ, wonnhun dɛm yi bi pɛn wɔ Israel.
Na Phariseefo no dze, wɔsee dɛ, Mbɔnsam hɔn panyin do na ɔnam tu mbɔnsam no.
Na Jesus kekyiin nkurow nye nkurobaase nyina mu kyerɛkyerɛe wɔ hɔn nhyiamudan mu, na ɔkãa ahenman no ne nsɛmpa no ho asɛm, na ɔsaa nyarba nyina nye ahoɔmberɛw nyina.
Na ohun nyimpadodow no, ne yamu hyehyee no maa hɔn, osiandɛ wɔahaw na wɔapetse dɛ nguan a wonnyi guanhwɛfo.
Na ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, Otwa-edwuma no dɔɔ sõ ampa, na edwumayɛfo no dze wosuar.
Dɛm ntsi hom nserɛ otwa-edwuma no wura ma ɔnsoma edwumayɛfo mbra no twa-edwuma no mu.
10: Na ɔfrɛɛ n'esuafo duebien no baa ne nkyɛn no, ɔmaa hɔn tum wɔ esunsum fi do, dɛ wontu hɔn, na wɔnsa nyarba nyina, nye ahoɔmberɛw nyina.
Na esuafo duebien no hɔn edzin nye yinom dza odzi kan no. Simon a wɔfrɛ no Peter, nye no nua Andrew; James, Zebedee ba no, nye no nua John;
Philip nye Bartholomew, Thomas nye Matthew towgyenyi no, James, Alphæus ba no, nye Thaddæus;
Simon Canananyi, nye Judas Iscariot a oyii no mae no so.
Duebien yinom na Jesus somaa hɔn, na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, mma hom nnkɔ amanaman kwan no mu, eso mma hom nnhɛn Samariafo kurow biara mu:
na mbom hom nkɔ Israel fie nguan a wɔayew no nkyɛn.
Na hom kɔ a, hom nkɛkã dɛ, ɔsor ahenman no abɛn.
Hom nyɛ ayarfo edur, hom hom nnyan ewufo, hom mma akwatafo ho nsan, hom ntu mbɔnsam hom enya no kwa hom mfa mma kwa.
Mma hom mmfa sika, anaa dwɛɛtɛɛ, anaa kɔɔber nngu hom abɔdo mu;
mma hom mmfa bɔtɔ, anaa sorntar ebien, anaa nsokota, anaa poma osiandɛ odwumayɛfo n'edziban sɛ no.
Na kurow anaa ekurobaase biara a hom bɛhɛn mu no, hom nhwehwɛ nyia ɔsɛ wɔ hɔ, na hɔ na hom ntsena nkodu dɛ hom befi hɔ akɔ.
Na sɛ hom rehɛn ofi no mu a, hom nkyia.
Na sɛ ofi no sɛ a, hom asomdwee mbra do, ma sɛ ɔnnsɛ a, hom asomdwee nsan mbra hom hɔ.
Na obiara a ɔnnkɛgye hom anaa onnketsie hom asɛm no, hom fi ofi anaa kurow no mu rokɔ a, hom mporoporow hom ananadze huntuma.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ atsɛmbua-da no mu ɔbɛfanyim Sodom nye Gomorrah asaase akyɛn kurow no.
Hwɛ, mosoma hom dɛ nguan wɔ mpataku finimfin: Dɛm ntsi hom nyɛ enyansafo dɛ nwɔ, na hom nyɛ krɔnn dɛ mbubur.
Na hom nhwɛ yie wɔ nyimpa ho, osiandɛ wobeyi hom akɔ mpanyimfo bagua mu, na wɔakã hom mpire wɔ hɔn nhyiamudan mu;
na eso wɔdze hom bɔkɔ ambradofo nye ahemfo enyim wɔ me ntsi, dze eedzi dase ama hɔn nye amanaman.
Na sɛ woyi hom ma a, mma hom nndwendwen mbrɛ hom bɛyɛ, anaa dza hom bɛkã, na wɔdze dza hom bɛkã bɛma hom dɔn no ara mu.
Na nnyɛ hom na hom na hom kasa, na hom Egya no Sunsum na ɔkasa wɔ hom mu.
Na nua beyi nua ama owu, egya beyi ba; na mba bɔsoɛr wɔ awofo do na wɔama woeku hɔn.
Na nyimpa nyina bɛtan hom wɔ me dzin nsti na nyia ɔbɛtsena mu ekodu ewiei no, ɔno na wɔbɛgye no nkwa.
Na sɛ wɔhaw hom wɔ kurow yi mu a, hom nguan nko bi so mu; na nokwar mese bom dɛ, hom nnkowie Israel nkurow nyjna do kɔ ansaana nyimpa Ba aba.
Osuanyi nnkyɛn ne kyerɛkyerɛfo, na akowaa nnkyɛn no wura.
Ɔdɔɔ sõ ma osuanyi dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dɛ ne kyerɛkyerɛfo, na akowaa dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dɛ no wura. Na sɛ wɔafrɛ ofiwura no Beelzebul a, mpɛn ahen ara na wɔdze bɛfrɛ n’efifo!
Dɛm ntsi mma hom nnsuro hɔn: Na biribi do nnkatae a worinnyi no edzi, na onnhuntae a worunnhu.
Dza mekã kyerɛ hom wɔ sum mu no, hom nkã no kan mu; na dza hom tse no asomu no, hom mpaa mu nka no adan etsifi.
Na mma hom nnsuro hɔn a woku nyimpadua no, na ɔkra dze, wonntum nnku no: Na mbom hom nsuro nyia obotum asɛɛ ɔkra nye nyimpadua nyina wɔ Gehenna.
Ana wɔnntɔn nsorɔm ebien nngye powa? Naaso hɔn mu kor ara nnkokwetsi hom Egya ahwe famu.
Na hom tsinhwi mpo wɔakan ne nyina.
Dɛm ntsi mma hom nnsuro: Na hom som bo kyɛn nsorɔm pii.
Dɛm ntsi obiara a ɔbɔbɔ me dzin wɔ nyimpa enyim no, ɔno na mo so mobobɔ ne dzin wɔ m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor n’enyim.
Na obiara a ɔbɛpa me wɔ nyimpa enyim no, ɔno na mo so mebɛpa no m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor n’enyim.
Mma hom nndwen dɛ mebae mobɔsomaa asomdwee wɔ asaase do: Mammba mammbɔsoma asomdwee, na mbom nkrantsee a.
Na mebae mebɛpaapaa mu ma nyimpa nye n’egya eenya, babaa nye ne nã eenya, asew nye ne sew eenya:
na nyimpa n'atamfo bɛyɛ ne fifo.
Nyia ɔdɔ egya anaa nã kyɛn me no, ɔnnsɛ me; na nyia ɔdɔ babanyin anaa babaa kyɛn me no, ɔnnsɛ me.
Na nyia ɔmmfa ne mbeamudua na ɔnnka mo do no, ɔnnsɛ me.
Nyia ohu no nkwa no, ɔbɛyew no; na nyia ɔyew no nkwa wɔ me ntsi no, obohu.
Nyia ɔgye hom no, ɔgye me; na nyia ɔgye me no, ɔgye nyia ɔsomaa me no.
Nyia ɔgye nkɔnhyɛnyi wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi dzin mu no, obenya nkɔnhyɛnyi akatua; na nyia ɔgye ɔtseneneenyi wɔ ɔtseneneenyi dzin mu no, obenya ɔtseneneenyi akatua.
Na obiara a ɔbɛma nketseaba yi mu baako nsunwin kuraba mã mpo wɔ osuanyi dzin mu no, nokwar mese hom dɛ ɔnnkɛyew n’akatua.
11: Na ɔbaa dɛ Jesus wiee n'esuafo duebien no kasakyerɛ no, ofii hɔ dɛ ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ na ɔakɛkã asɛm wɔ hɔn nkurow mu.
Na John tsee Christ no ndwuma wɔ efiadze no, ɔnam n’esuafo no do somae bɛsee no dɛ,
Ana ɔwo nye nyia ɔreba no, anaa yɛntweɔn obi so?
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɛkã dza hom ehu na hom atse yi nkyerɛ John:
Enyifurafo hu adze, mbubua nantsew, akwatafo ho san etsitsifo tse asɛm, ewufo nyan, na wɔkã asɛmpa kyerɛ ehiafo.
Na nyia mennkɛyɛ no fintsidua no, nhyira akã no.
Na yinom rokɔ no, Jesus hyɛɛ ase see nyimpadodow no wɔ John ho dɛ, ebɛnadze na hom fiir edzi kɔr sar no do kɔhwɛe? Ndzɛmbir a mframa rihim no a?
Na ebɛnadze na hom firii kɔhwee? Nyimpa a ofura aberɛberɛ-tam a? Hwɛ, hon a wofura aberɛ-berɛ-tam wɔ ahemfo fie mu.
Na ebɛnadze ntsi na hom firii? Ana dɛ hom bohu nkɔnhyɛnyi a? Nyew, mese hom dɛ nyia ɔkyɛn nkɔnhyɛnyi mpo a.
Oyi nye nyia wɔakyerɛw no ho dɛ, hwɛ, morosoma mo bɔfoe ma oeedzi w’enyim kan a Obesiesie wo kwan edzi w’enyim.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, hɔn a mbaa awo hɔn nyina mu biara mmpuei a ɔyɛ kɛse kyɛn John; naaso nyia ɔyɛ aketseaba wɔ sor ahenman no mu dze yɛ kɛse kyɛn no.
Na ofi John Onumanyi no nda do bodu sesei sor ahenman no gye enyiber, na hɔn a hɔn enyi aber no fa no enyimpi do.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo nyina nye mbra no hyɛɛ nkɔm bɛpeem John do.
Na sɛ hom pɛ dɛ hom gye to mu a, oyi nye Elijah a ɔreba no.
Nyia ɔwɔ aso a ɔdze tsie no ma ontsie.
Na ebɛnadze na medze ɔsantsen yi mobɔto ho? Ɔtse dɛ mbofraba a wɔtsenatsena gua do, na wɔrefrɛfrɛ hɔn mfɛfo,
sɛ dɛ, yɛahen atɛntɛbɛn ama hom, na hom annsaw; yeetwa ewuo na hom enndzi nkɔmbɔ.
Na John bae, onndzidzi eso ɔnnom, na wɔse dɛ, ɔwɔ abɔnsam.
Nyimpa Ba no bae, odzidzi na ɔnom, wɔse dɛ, hwɛ, nyimpa tumfur, nsahweam, atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo nyɛnko. Naaso nyansa no ndwuma bu no bem.
Nna ɔhyɛɛ ase twuuw nkurow a ɔyɛɛ no tum ndwuma pii wɔ mu no enyim, osiandɛ woennu hɔnho.
Chorazin, due! Bethsaida, due! Osiandɛ sɛ tum ndwuma a wɔyɛe wɔ hom mu yi, wɔyɛɛ no wɔ Tyre nye Sidon mu a, nkyɛ wonuu hɔnho dada wɔ eyitam nye nso mu.
Na mese hom dɛ atsɛmbua-da no mu ɔbɛfanyim Tyre nye Sidon akyɛn hom.
Na ɔwo, Capernaum, wɔbɛma wo do akɔ sor anaa? Wɔbɛbrɛ wo adze akɔ samanadze; osiandɛ tum ndwuma a wɔyɛe wɔ wo mu yi, sɛ wɔyɛɛ no wɔ Sodom a, nkyɛ ɔatsena hɔ ebodu ndɛ.
Na mese hom dɛ atsɛmbua-da no ɔbɛfanyim Sodom akyɛn wo.
Na aber no mu, Jesus buae see dɛ, miyi wo ayɛw, Egya, sor nye asaase wura, dɛ edze ndzɛmba yi esuma enyansafo nye abadwembafo, na eyi akyerɛ nkɔkowaba.
Ampaara, Egya, na dɛm na ɔsɔɔ w'enyi.
Ndzɛmba nyina m’Egya dze ahyɛ me nsa; na obiara nnyim ɔba no, gyedɛ Egya no; eso obiara nnyim Egya no gyedɛ ɔba no, na nyia ɔba no pɛ dɛ oyi no kyerɛ no.
Hom nyina hom mbra mo hɔ, hom a hom reyɛ edwuma berɛ na wɔasoa hom dza ɔyɛ dur, na mebɛma hom ahomgye.
Hom mfa mo kɔndua nto hom do, na hom nsūa me, osiandɛ modwe na mebrɛ moho adze wɔ akoma mu; na hom benya ahomgye ama hom akra. Na mo kɔndua yɛ mberɛw. na m’adzesoa yɛ har.
12: Na aber no mu Jesus koduaa eburow kwã mu ahomgyeda; na ɔkɔm dzee n'esuafo no, wɔhyɛɛ ase pempaan eburow mbɛtsem no wee.
Na Phariseefo no hunii no, wɔsee no dɛ, hwɛ, w'esuafo no reyɛ dza ɔmmfa mbra mu ahomgyeda.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ana hom nnkenkaan dza David yɛe aber a ɔkɔm dze ɔno nye hɔn a wɔka no ho no?
Mbrɛ ɔkɛhɛɛn Nyankopɔn fie na okedzii kyerɛpaanoo a ɔmmfa mbra mu dɛ odzi, anaa hɔn a wɔka no ho no, dɛ asɔfo no ara nko?
Anaaso hom nnkenkanee wɔ mbra no mu, mbrɛ ahomgyeda no mu asɔfo no wɔtõ ahomgyeda wɔ asɔrfi no mu, na wonndzi fɔ?
Na mese hom dɛ nyia ɔkyɛn asɔrfi no wɔ ha.
Na sɛ hom hun mbrɛ yi n'ase tse, dɛ, mepɛ ehumbɔbɔr na nnyɛ afɔrbɔ a, nkyɛ hom emmbu hɔn a wonndzi fɔ no fɔ.
Na nyimpa Ba no yɛ ahomgyeda no so no wura.
Na ofii hɔ kɔree, na ɔkɔr hɔn nhyiamudan no mu;
na hwɛ, nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a ne nsa adwe. Na wobisaa no see dɛ, ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ wɔsa yarba ahomgyeda? Ma wɔaatõa no.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mu nyimpa bɛn, na sɛ ɔwɔ oguan kor, na sɛ ɔkɔtɔ mona mu ahomgyeda a, onnkosuo no mu na ɔama no do?
Ebɛn kyɛn mbɔ na nyimpa kyɛn oguan? Dɛm ntsi ɔfa mbra mu dɛ wɔyɛ yie ahomgyeda.
Nna ɔsee nyimpa no dɛ, tsen wo nsa. Na ɔtsenee; na ɔsanee yɛɛ mu dɛ kor no.
Na Phariseefo no fiir edzi, na wɔkɛpaam no do, mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ asɛɛ no.
Na Jesus hunii no, ɔtwee noho fii hɔ, na dodowara kaa no do, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn nyina edur,
na ɔbraa hɔn dɛ mma wonnyi no nnkyerɛ;
ma dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah kãe no aaba mu dɛ
Hwɛ, mo somfo a meyi no, mo dɔfo a me kra enyiwa sɔ no: Medze mo Sunsum bogu no do, na ɔakã atsɛmbu akyerɛ amanaman.
Ɔnnkɛper, eso ɔnnkɛtsēa mu; eso obiara nnkɛtse ne ndze wɔ abɔntsen do.
Ndzɛmbir a ɔakonkon onnkobu, na asaaba a opun wusiw onnkodum, dze ekesi dɛ ɔbɛma atsɛmbu akɔ konyim mu.
Na ne dzin mu na amanaman dze hɔn enyiwa bɔto.
Nna wɔdze obi a abɔnsam afa no a ɔyɛ onyifurafo nye mmum brɛɛ no: na ɔyɛɛ no edur, na mmun no kasae na ohun adze.
Na nyimpadodow no nyina ho boow hɔn, na wɔsee dɛ, ana oyi nye David ba no?
Na Phariseefo no tsee no, wɔsee dɛ, oyi nntu mbɔnsam gyedɛ ɔnam mbɔnsam panyin Beelzebul do.
Na ohun hɔn adwen no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ahenman biara nye noho dzi mpaapaamu a, ɔyɛ amamfo, na kurow anaa fi biara ɔnye noho dzi mpaapaamu: ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na n'ahenman egyina?
Na sɛ emi menam Beelzebul do tu mbɔnsam a, woana do na hom mba nam tu hɔn? Dɛm ntsi hɔn na wɔbɛyɛ hom atsɛmbuafo.
Na sɛ menam Nyankopɔn Sunsum do tu mbɔnsam a ma Nyankopɔn aheman ahenman enya aba hom nkyɛn
Anaadɛ, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na obi botum akɔ ɔkatakyi fie akɔfow n'efidze, gyedɛ odzi kan kyekyer ɔkatakyi no ansaana ɔafow ne fie.
Nyia ɔnnka mo ho no, na ɔnye me enya; nyia ɔnye me mmboaboa minboaboa ano no, ɔhotse gu.
Dɛm ntsi mese hom dɛ, Bɔn biara, ɔnye ebususɛm biara, wɔdze bɛkyɛ nyimpa na ebususɛm a otsia Sunsum no dze, wɔnnkɛfa akyɛ nyimpa.
Na obiara a ɔbɛkã asɛm etsia nyimpa Ba no, wɔdze bɛkyɛ no, na obiara a ɔbɛkã asɛm etsia Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no, wɔnnkɛfa akyɛ no wɔ wiadze ha, nye wiadze a ɔreba no mu.
Hom mma dua no nyɛ yie, na n’aba so nyɛ yie; anaadɛ hom mma dua no mprɔw, na n’aba so mprɔw: osiandɛ dua wɔdze n’aba hu no.
Nhurutsia mba, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na hom muo yi, hom bɛkã nsɛm pa? Na dza ebu do wɔ akoma mu no na ano kã.
Nyimpa pa fi ne ndzepa korabea na oyi ndzepa fi ba; na nyimpa bɔn fi ne ndzɛmba bɔn korabea na oyi dza omuo fi ba.
Na mese hom dɛ nsɛngyan biara a nyimpa bɛkã no wobobu ho nkontaa wɔ atsɛmbua da mu.
Osiandɛ wo nsɛm do na wɔnam bobu wo bem; na wo nsɛm do na wɔnam bobu wo fɔ.
Nna kyerɛwfo no nye Phariseefo no mu binom buae see dɛ, kyerɛkyerɛfo, yɛpɛ dɛ yehu wo ho asɛnkyerɛdze.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, ɔsantsen bɔn nye awartofo rohwehwɛ asɛnkyerɛdze, na wɔremma hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze biara dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jonah asɛnkyerɛdze no:
na dɛ mbrɛ Jonah dzii ndaansa adzekyee nye adzesaa wɔ bonso yamu no, dɛmara na nyimpa Ba no bedzi ndaansa adzekyee nye adzesaa wɔ asaase akoma mu.
Nineveh mbarimba nye ɔsantsen yi bɔsoɛr wɔ atsɛmbu no mu, na woebu hɔn fo; osiandɛ wonuu hɔnho wɔ Jonah n’asɛnka ase, na hwɛ, nyia ɔsen Jonah wɔ ha.
Pomu ɔhemhaa nye ɔsantsen yi bɔsoɛr wɔ atsɛmbu no mu, na oebu hɔn fɔ: Osiandɛ ofii asaase ano noho bae betsiee Solomon ne nyansaa, na hwɛ, nyia ɔsen Solomon wɔ ha.
Na sunsum fi, sɛ ofi nyimpa mu fir a, okekyin wewew do hwehwɛ ahomgye na onnya bi.
Nna ɔse dɛ, mebɛsan akɔ me fie a mifii mu bae no mu, na ɔba a, ɔto no pon, wɔaprapra mu na wɔahyehyɛ mu.
Nna ɔkɔ kɛfa esunsum esuon fofor a womuo sen nankasa ka no ho na wɔbɛhɛn mu tsena hɔ: Na nyimpa no n'ekyir asetsena yɛ bɔn sen nkan no dze; dɛmara na ɔbɛyɛ ama ɔsantsen bɔn yi.
Na ɔda do rekasa kyerɛ nyimpa-dodow no, hwɛ, ne nã nye no nuanom begyinaa abow enyim hwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔnye no kasa.
Na obi see no dɛ, hwɛ, wo nã ɔnye wo nuanom gyina abow enyim rohwehwɛ nye wo akasa.
Na obuae see nyia ɔkãa kyerɛɛ no no dɛ, Woana nye me nã, na woananom nye mo nuanom?
Na ɔtseen ne nsa wɔ n’esuafo no do see dɛ, hwɛ, me nã nye mo nuanom.
Na obiara a ɔbɛyɛ m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor no ne pɛ no, ɔno nye mo nua, nye m’akyerɛbaa, nye me nã.
13: Da no ara, na Jesus fii fie kɛtsenaa mpoano.
Na nyimpadodow pii behyiaa ne nkyɛn, ma dɛm ntsi ɔkɔr hɛn mu kɛtsenaa ase wɔ mu; na nyimpadodow no nyina gyinagyinaa mpoano.
Na ɔkãa ndzɛmba pii kyerɛɛ hɔn wɔ mbɛbu mu see dɛ, hwɛ, oduafo no kɔree kɛpee;
na ɔrepe no, ɔbaa dɛ bi koguu kwan nkyɛn na nnoma bae bɔsosɔwee;
na bi kogniu abosam dɔ mbrɛ oennya dɛtse pii; na ntsɛmara na ofirii, osiandɛ oennya dɛtse a ɔdɔ;
na ewia soɛree no, ɔhyewee na osiandɛ onnyi ndwow ntsi ɔkyenkyenee.
Na bi so koguu nsoɛ mu, na nsoɛ no nyinii, na omiaa no.
Na bi so koguu asaase pa mu, na ɔsoow aba, ibi ɔha, ibi eduosia, ibi eduasa.
Nyia ɔwɔ aso, ma ontsie.
N’esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na ekasa kyerɛ hɔn mbɛbu mu yi?
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, homdze, wɔdze ama hom dɛ hom nhu sor ahenman no mu esumasɛm, na hɔndze, wɔmmfae mmaa hɔn.
Na obiara a ɔwɔ no, na wɔbɛma no na oenya mbordo, na obiara a onnyi no, dza ɔwɔ mpo wɔbɛgye ne nsamu.
Dɛm ntsi na mekasa kyerɛ hɔn mbɛbu mu, osiandɛ wɔhwɛ a wonnhu, wɔtse a wɔnntse, eso wɔnntse ase.
Na hɔn mu na Isaiah nkɔnhyɛ no aba mu dɛ, tse dze, hom bɛtse na hom nnkɛtse ase; na hwɛ dze, hom bɔhwɛ na hom nnkohu.

Na ɔman yi hɔn akoma epirim, na hɔn aso esisiw dɛ wobetsie, na woemuamua hɔn enyiwa, amma aber bi wɔaammfa hɔn enyiwa ennhu, na wɔaammfa hɔn aso anntse, na wɔaammfa hɔn akoma anntse ase, na wɔaannsakyer, mma mannsa hɔn yarba.
Na nhyira akã hom enyiwa dɛ wohu, nye hom aso dɛ wɔtse.
Na nokwar mese hom dɛ nkɔnhyɛfo nye atseneneefo pii pɛɛ dɛ wohu dza hom hu yi, na wɔennhu, na dɛ wɔtse dza hom tse yi, na wɔanntse.
Dɛm ntsi hom ntsie duafo no ne bɛ no.
Sɛ obiara tse ahenman no no ho asɛm, na ɔnntse ase a, ɔbɔn no ba bɛfa dza wɔpee no n’akoma mu no kɔ. Oyi nye dza wɔpee no wɔ kwan nkyɛn no.
Na dza wɔpee no abosam do no, ɔnye nyia otsie asɛm no, na ntsɛmara ɔdze dɛw gye;
na onnyi ndwow wɔ no mu, na ɔwɔ hɔ ma ɔkyɛr kakra, sɛ abɛbrɛsɛ anaa ahohia soɛr wɔ asɛm no ntsi a, ntsɛmara na ato no fintsidua.
Na dza wɔpee no nsoɛ mu no, ɔnye nyia otsie asɛm no, na wiadze yi mu akɔdadwen nye ahonya ndaadaa mia asɛm no, ma ɔnnsow aba.
Na dza wɔpee no asaase pa mu no, ɔnye nyia otsie asɛm no, na ɔtse ase; ɔno so na ɔsow aba, ibi ɔha, ibi eduosia, ibi eduasa.
Obuu bɛ fofor so kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, sor ahenman no tse dɛ nyimpa a oduaa aba pa wɔ no kwã mu;
na nyimpa dedae no, ne tamfo bae boduaa nworahaban so wɔ ewifua pa no mu, na ɔkɔree.
Na oyii ahaban na ɔsoow aba no, nna nworahaban no so daa edzi.
Na ofiwura no nkowaa bae bɛsee no dɛ, yewura, ana ammpe aba pa wɔ wo kwã no mu? Na nworahaban yi so fi hen?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔtamfo na ɔayɛ yi. Na nkowaa no see no dɛ, ana epɛ dɛ yɛkɔ kɔboaboa ano?
Na ɔsee dɛ, oho: Bɛyɛ na hom roboaboa nworahaban no ano no, hom etutu ewifua no so aka ho.
Hom mma n'ebien nyina nnyin nkesi twaber no; na twaber no mebɛse etwafo no dɛ, hom ndzi kan mboaboa nwora no ano, na hom nkyerkyer no efiefi ma wɔnhyew no, na hom mboaboa ewifua no ano nkɔ me san do.
Obuu bɛ fofor so kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, sor ahenman no tse dɛ sinape abafua a nyimpa fae koduaa no kwã mu;
ɔno na osuar kyɛn aba nyina; na sɛ onyin a, ɔyɛ kɛse kyɛn nhaban nyina na ɔyɛ dua, ma wimu nnoma bɛgyegye n’abaw do.
Obuu bɛ fofor so see hɔn dɛ, sor ahenman no tse dɛ mbɔrkaw a ɔbaa fae sumaa mbɔr korbaa ebiasa mu dze kesii dɛ ne nyina kawee.
Yinom nyina Jesus kãa kyereɛ nyimpadodow no wɔ mbɛbu mu, na oennkwetsi bɛ annkasa annkyerɛ hɔn;
ma dza nkɔnhyɛnyi no kãe no aaba mu dɛ, mubobue m'ano wɔ mbɛbu mu; mebɛpaa mu makã nsɛm a ohunta fi wiadze ahyɛse.
Nna Jesus gyaa nyimpadodow no kwan na obaa fie. Na n’esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, kyerɛ hɛn kwã mu nwora no bɛ n’ase.
Na obuae see dɛ, nyia oduaa aba pa no nye nyimpa Ba;
kwã no nye wiadze; aba pa no nye ahenman no ne mba; nwora no nye ɔbɔn no ne mba;
ɔtamfo a oduaa hɔn nye abɔnsam; twaber nye wiadze n’ewiei; na etwafo no nye abɔfo no.
Na dɛ mbrɛ wɔboaboa nwora no ano wɔhyew no wɔ gya mu no, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ wɔ wiadze n’ewiei nye no.
Nyimpa Ba no bɔsoma n’abɔfoe na wɔakɔboaboa dza ɔto fintsidua nyina ano efi n’ahenman mu; nye hɔn a wɔyɛ emumuyɛ nyina,
na wɔatow hɔn egu gya fononoo mu: Hɔ na osū nye asetwɛr wɔ.
Ɔno na atseneneefo bɛhyerɛn dɛ ewia wɔ hɔn Egya ahenman mu. Nyia ɔwɔ aso, ma ontsie.
Sor ahenman no tse dɛ akoradze a wɔdze sumaa haban mu a nyimpa hunii no, ɔdze huntae, na no ho dɛw ntsi ɔkɔree kɔtɔɔn dza ɔwɔ nyina na ɔtɔɔ haban no.
Bio, sor ahenman no tse dɛ batanyi a ɔrohwehwɛ ahondzepa;
na ohun ahondze kor a no bo sõ a, ɔkɔree kɔtɔɔn dza ɔwɔ nyina na ɔkɔtɔe.
Bio, sor ahenman no tse dɛ asawu a wɔtowee guu po mu a obumaa ahorow nyina bi;
na ɔyɛɛ mã no, wotwuwii baa mpoano na wɔtsenaa famu, na wɔboaboa papa no ano guu akorow mu, na wɔtoow dza omuo no gui.
Mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ wɔ wiadza ewiei nye no; abɔfo bɛba abɛpa nyimpa bɔn efi atseneneefo mu,
na wɔatow hɔn egu ogya fononoo mu; hɔ na osū nye asetwer wɔ.
Hom atse yinom nyina ase? Wɔsee no dɛ, nyew,
Na ɔsee dɛ, dɛm ntsi kyerɛwnyi a wɔayɛ no osuanyi ama sor ahenman no ɔtse dɛ ofiwura a ofi n’adzekorabea yi ndzɛmba afofor nye adadaw pue.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Jesus wiee mbɛ yi bu no, ofii hɔ kɔree.
Na ɔbaa nankasa no kurow mu no, ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn nhyiamudan mu, ma hɔn ho boow hɔn na wɔsee dɛ, oyi onyaa nyansa nye tum ndwuma yi wɔ hen?
Ana nnyɛ dwimfo no ne ba nye yi? Ana ne nã wɔmmfrɛ no Mary, na no nuanom James, nye Joseph, nye Simon, nye Judas?
Na nnyɛ ne nkyerɛbaa nyina na wɔnye hɛn wɔ ha yi? Na afei oyi nyaa ndzɛmba yinom nyina wɔ hen?
Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn fintsidua. Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, nkɔnhyɛnyi nnhwer enyidzi gyedɛ nankasa no kurow mu, nye nankasa ne fie.
Na wonnyi gyedzi ntsi ɔannyɛ tum ndwuma pii wo hɔ.
14: Aber no mu no, Herod ɔmansinhen no tsee Jesus ho asɛm,
na ɔsee n'asomfo no dɛ, John Onumanyi no nye no: Oenyan efi ewufo mu: Dɛm ntsi na etum reyɛ edwuma wɔ no mu yi.
Na Herod esuo John mu akyer no akɔto efiadze, wɔ no nua Philip yer Herodias ntsi.
Osiandɛ John see no dɛ, innyi ho kwan dɛ ewar no.
Na ɔpɛɛ dɛ oku no no, osuroo nyimpadodow no, osiandɛ wobuu no dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi.
Na wodzii Herod n'awoda no, Herodias ne babaa bae bɛsawee wɔ hɔn enyim, na ɔsɔɔ Herod enyiwa.
Ɔno do na ɔdze ntam bɔɔ no anohoba dɛ ɔbɛma no biribiara a obebisa.
Na ne nã hyɛɛ no ntsirmu no, ɔsee dɛ, fa John Onumanyi no ne tsir to aboyaa mu ma me ha.
Na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen no yaw; naaso ne ntam nye hɔn a wɔnye no tse edzidzi no ntsi, ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa mma no:
na ɔsomae ma wokotwaa John ne tsir wɔ efiadze.
Na wɔdze ne tsir too aboyaa mu bae, na wɔdze maa akataasia no, na ɔdze kɛmaa ne nã.
Na n'esuafo no bae bɛfaa no fun no kesiei, na wɔkɔree kɛkãa kyerɛɛ Jesus.
Na Jesus tsee no, ɔtwee noho fii hɔ nam hɛn mu kɔr sar do nkyɛn beebi, na nyimpadodow no tsee no, wofii nkurow mu nam daadze tsiiw no,
Na odwirii no, ohun nyimpadodow pii, na ne yamu hyehyee no maa hɔn, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn ayarfo edur.
Na odur ewimbir no, n'esuofo baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, ha yi sar do a, na ber enya abɛsen: Gya nyimpadodow yi kwan, ma ma wɔnkɔ nkurobaase nkɔtɔ edziban mma hɔnho.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, onnhia hɔn dɛ wɔkɔ: Homara hom mma hɔn biribi ma wondzi.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, yɛwɔ paanoo enum nye esunam ebien pɛ wɔ ha.
Na ɔsee dɛ, hom mfa mbrɛ me ha.
Na ɔhyɛɛ nyimpadodow no dɛ wɔntsenatsena mpɔnkɔfuw no do, na ɔfaa paanoo enum no, nye esunam ebien no, na ɔhwɛɛ sor no, ohyiraa do, na obubui, na n'esuafo no dze maa nyimpadodow no.
Na hɔn nyina dzidzii mee; na wɔtasee mporoporoba a ɔkae no, nkɛntsɛn duebien amaama.
Na hɔn a wodzidzii no, wɔbɛyɛ mpemenum, mbaa nye mbofraba mmīora.
Na ntsɛmara opiapiaa n'esuafo no dɛ wɔnkɔ hɛn mu na wondzi n'enyim kan wɔ esuegya no ho, ma ongya nyimpadodow no kwan.
Na ogyaa nyimpadodow no kwan no, ɔkɔr koko no do nkyɛn beebi kɔsɔree; na odur ewimbir no na noara nko wɔ hɔ.
Na aber yi mu no hɛn nowɔ po finimfin, na asorɛkye rubu bɔ no; na mframa sii hɔn enyim.
Na anafua dasu a otsia anan no mu ɔnantseew po enyi baa hɔn nkyɛn.
Na wohun dɛ ɔrenantsew po enyi no, hɔn akoma tui, na wɔsee dɛ, ɔsaman a! na wɔdze hu kekaa mu.
Na ntsɛmara ɔnye hɔn kasae, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nhyɛ dzen mara amma hom nnsuro
Na Peter suaa no see dɛ, Ewuradze, sɛ woara a, hyɛ me ma membra wo nkyɛn wɔ nsu no do.
Na ɔsee dɛ, bra. Na Peter fii hen no mu sii, na ɔnantseew nsu no do dɛ ɔrokɔ Jesus nkyɛn.
Na ohun mframa no, osuroi; na ɔhyɛɛ ase rodɔ no, ɔkaa mu dɛ, Ewuradze, gye me.
Na ntsɛmara Jesus too ne nsa suoo no mu, na ɔsee no dɛ, ɔwo a wo gyedzi suar, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na egyee kyim?
Na wɔbaa hɛn no mu no, mframa no gyaae.
Na hɔn a wɔwɔ hɛn no mu no kotoow no dɛ, nokwar, Nyankopɔn Ba nye wo.
Na wotwae no, wɔbaa Gennesaret asaase do.

Na nyimpa a wɔwɔ hɔ no hun no no, wɔsomae ma wɔkɔr nkurow a etwa ehyia nyina mu, na wɔdze hɔn a wɔyaryar nyina brɛɛ no, na wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmma wɔnkã n'atar ano ndwow nko ara: na dodow a wɔkãa no no, hɔn ho yɛɛ hɔn dzen.
15: Nna Phariseefo nye kyerɛwfo a wofi Jerusalem baa Jesus nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ,
ɔyɛ dɛn na w’esuafo fom mpanyimfo atsetsesɛm do? Na wɔnnhohor hɔn nsa ho na wodzidzi.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom so bom atsetsesɛm ntsi hom fom Nyankopɔn mbrasɛm do?
Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ dɛ, dzi w’egya nye wo nã nyi, na, obiara a ɔhyɛ egya anaa nã ahorohoraa no, onwu owu no.
Na homdze, hom se dɛ, obiara a ɔbɛse n’egya anaa ne nã dɛ, dza nkyɛ edze benya mo ho mfaso yɛ akyɛdze ma Nyankopɔn,
nna onnyi dɛ odzi n’egya nyi. Na hom atsetsesɛm ntsi hom amma Nyankopɔn mbra no enntsim.
Ndabrabafo, Isaiah hyɛɛ hom ho nkɔm yie dɛ ɔse,
ɔman yi dze hɔn anofamfa dzi me nyi, na hɔn akoma dze, ɔnye me ntamu twe kɛse;
Na wɔsɔr me gyan, wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɔyɛ nyimpa ahyɛdze.
Na ɔfrɛɛ nyimpadodow no baa ne nkyɛn no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom ntsie na hom ntse ase:
Nnyɛ dza ɔkɔ anomu na ɔyɛ nyimpa ho nkɔw, na mbom dza ofi anomu ba no na ɔyɛ nyimpa ho nkɔw.
Nna n’esuafo no bae bɛsee no dɛ, inyim dɛ Phariseefo no tsee asɛm yi no, ayɛ hɔn fin tsidua?
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, dua biara a m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor no anntsɛw no, wobotu.
Hom ngyaa hɔn: wɔyɛ akwankyerɛfo enyifurafo. Na sɛ onyifurafo kyerɛ onyifurafo kwan a, hɔn beenu nyina bɔtɔ mona mu.
Na Peter buae see no dɛ, kyerɛ hɛn bɛ yi ase.
Na ɔsee dɛ Anahom so nnyae nnyaa ntsease?
Ana hom nnhu dɛ biribiara a ɔhɛn anomu no ɔkɔ yafun mu, na woyi gu tsea mu?
Na dza ofi anomu ba no, ofi akoma mu, na ɔno na ɔyɛ nyimpa ho nkɔw.
Na akoma mu na adwembɔn fi ba, ewudzi, awarto, ndwamanyɛ, adzewia, dasewia, ebususɛm:
Yinom nye ndzɛmba a ɔyɛ nyimpa ho nkɔw; na edze nsa a wɔannhohor ho bedzidzi dze, ɔnnyɛ nyimpa ho nkɔw.
Na Jesus twee noho fii hɔ kɔr Tyre nye Sidon afamu.
Na hwɛ, Canaannyiɔbaa fi ntoaado hɔ bae bɛkaa mu dɛ, Ewuradze, David ba, hu me mbɔbɔr: Na abɔnsam rehaw me babaa papa.
Na oemmbuano asɛm biara, na n’esuafo no bae bɛserɛɛ no dɛ, gya no kwan ma ɔnkɔ, na ɔrekɛka mu dzi hɛn ekyir.
Na obuae see dɛ, wɔannsoma me biara hɔ dɛ Israel fie nguan a wɔayew no nko hɔ.
Na ɔbae bɔkotoow no see dɛ, Ewuradze boa me.
Na obuae see dɛ, ɔnnsɛ dɛ wɔfa mba edziban tow ma nkramanmba.
Na ɔsee dɛ, mo wura, nyew: Naaso nkramanmba no dzi mporoporoba a ofi hɔn wuranora pon do gu no bi.
Nna Jesus buae see no dɛ, ɔbaa, wo gyedzi sõ: Ɔnyɛ hɔ mma wo dɛ mbrɛ epɛ. Na ofi dɔn no ara mu ne babaa no ho yɛɛ no dzen.
Na Jesus fii hɔ baa Galilee po ho, na ɔkɔr koko do kɛtsenaa ase wɔ hɔ.
Na nyimpadodow pii baa ne nkyɛn a wɔdze mbubua, enyifurafo, mmum, mpakye, nye binom pii; na wɔdze hɔn boguu n'ananadze na ɔsaa hɔn yarba:
ma ɔyɛɛ nyimpadodow no nwanwa dɛ mmum rekasa, mpakye ridzi mu, mbubua renantsew, na enyifurafo ruhu adze; na wɔhyɛɛ Israel Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.

Na Jesus frɛɛ n'esuafo see hɔn dɛ, me yamu hyehye me ma nyimpadodow yi, osiandɛ wɔatsena me nkyɛn ndaansa yi na wonnyi biribi a wodzi; na memmpɛ dɛ migya hɔn kwan ma wɔdze kɔm kɔ, bɛyɛ na wɔakɔtɔ bitsi wɔ kwan mu.
Na n’esuafo no see no dɛ, henfa na yebenya paanoo a ɔbɛmee nyimpadodow pii yi wɔ sar do ha?
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Paanoo ahen na hom wɔ? Na wɔsee no dɛ, Esuon, nye esunam nketsenketse kakraabi.
Na ɔhyɛɛ nyimpadodow no dɛ wɔntsenatsena famu;
na ɔfaa paanoo esuon no, nye esunam no; na ɔdaa ase, na obubui, na ɔdze maa esuafo no, na esuafo no so dze maa nyimpadodow no.
Na hɔn nyina dzidzii mee; na wɔtasee mporoporoba a ɔkae no, mbirefi esuon amaama.
Na hɔn a wodzidzii, wɔyɛ mpemanan, mbaa nye mbofraba mmfora.
Na ogyaa nyimpadodow no kwan, na osii hɛn mu ba Magadan ntoaado.
16: Na Phariseefo nye Sadduceefo no bae bɔsɔɔ no hwɛe bisaa no dɛ ɔnkyerɛ hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze a ofi sor.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, odu ewinbir a, hom kã dɛ, wimu bɛtsew, osiandɛ sor aber.
Na anapa hom se dɛ, ndɛ wimu bɛyɛ munsumunsum, osiandɛ sor aber na eminsim. Hom tum hu ɔsor-enyi nsɛm, na aber nye aber n’asɛnkyerɛdze, hom nntum nnhu.
Ɔsantsen bɔn nye awartofo rohwehwɛ asɛnkyerɛdze, na wɔremma hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze bi dɛ Jonah dze no. Na ogyaa hɔn hɔ kɔree.
Na esuafo no dur esuegya noho no, nna hɔn werɛ efir dɛ wɔfa paanoo.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, hom nhwɛ, na hom nhwɛ yie wɔ Phariseefo nye Sadduceefo mbɔrkaw no ho.
Na wosusui sesee wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, yɛammfa paanoo ntsi a.
Na Jesus hunii no, ɔsee dɛ, hom a hom gyedzi suar, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom susu se wɔ hom mu dɛ osiandɛ hom ammfa paanoo ntsi a?
Ana hom nnyae nnhunii, anaa hom nnkaa nyimpa mpemenum paanoo enum no, nye nkɛntsɛn dodow a hom fae no?
Anaadɛ mpemanan paanoo esuon no, nye mbirefi dodow a hom fae no?
Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom nnhu dɛ nnyɛ paanoo ho asɛm bi na mekã? Na hom nhwɛ yie wɔ Phariseefo nye Saduceefo mbɔrkaw ho.
Nna wohun dɛ ɔannse hɔn dɛ wɔnhwɛ yie wɔ paanoo mbɔrkaw ho, na Phariseefo nye Sadduceefo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho a.
Na Jesus dur Cæsarea Philippi afamu no, obisaa n'esuafo dɛ, nyimpa se dɛ nyimpa Ba no nye woana?
Na wɔsee dɛ, Binom se John Onumanyi no a; binom se Elijah a; na binom so se Jeremiah anaa nkɔnhyeɛfo no mu baako a.
Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, na homdze, hom se dɛ woana nye me?
Na Simon Peter buae see dɛ, ɔwo nye Christ, tsease Nyankopɔn ne Ba no.
Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, nhyira akã wo, Simon, Jonah ba; na nnyɛ honam nye bɔgya na woeyi akyerɛ wo, na m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor no a.
Na mo so mese wo dɛ, ɔwo nye Peter, na ɔbotan yi do na medze m’asɔr besi; na samanadze aponkɛse rinndzi do nyim.
Medze sor ahenman ne nsaafee mebɛma wo: Na biribiara a ebɛkyekyer wɔ asaase do no, wɔbɛkyekyer wɔ sor, na biribiara a ebɛsan wɔ asaase do no, wobɛsan wɔ sor.
Nna ɔbraa n'esuafo no dɛ mma wɔnnkã nnkyerɛ dɛ ɔno nye Christ no.
Na ofitsi aber no na Jesus hyɛɛ ase kyerɛɛ n’esuafo dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ ɔkɔ Jerusalem, na okohu amandze pii wɔ mpanyimfo nye asɔfompanyin, nye kyerɛwfo nsa, na woeku no, na da a otsia ebiasa no ɔasoɛr.
Na Peter suoo no mu, na ɔhyɛɛ ase twuuw n’enyim, dɛ, wɔmma ɔmpar wo, Ewuradze: iyi remmba wo do.
Na ɔdaan noho see Peter dɛ, fi mo do, Satan: Eyɛ fintsidua ma me; na enndwen Nyankopɔn dze, na edwen nyimpa dze.
Nna Jesus see n’esuafo no dɛ, sɛ obi pɛ dɛ odzi m’ekyir a, ma ɔmpa noho, na ompegya ne mbeamudua na ɔnka mo do.
Na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔgye no nkwa no, ɔbɛyew no, na obiara a emi ntsi ɔbɛyew no nkwa no,obohu.
Na sɛ nyimpa nya wiadze nyina ma ntsi ɔhwer no nkwa a, ebɛn mfaso na obenya? Anaa ebɛnadze na nyimpa bɛma dze asesa no nkwa?
Na nyimpa Ba no dze n’Egya n’enyimnyam nye n’abɔfoe bɛba; na aber no na obotua nyimpa nyina kaw dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ tse.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, hɔn a wogyina ha yi, binom wɔ hɔ a wɔronnsɔ owu nnhwɛ ansaana woehu nyimpa Ba dɛ ɔreba wɔ n’ahendzi mu.
17: Na nda esia ekyir no Jesus faa Peter nye James nye no nua John, na ɔdze hɔn kɔr nkyɛn wɔ kokwaa tsentsen bi do;
na ɔsakyeree wɔ hɔn enyim, na n’enyim hyerɛɛn dɛ ewia, na n’atar yɛɛ fitaa dɛ kan.
Na hwɛ, Elijah ɔnye Moses puee hɔn nkyɛn, na wɔnye no kasae.
Na Peter buae see Jesus dɛ, Ewuradze, oye ma hɛn dɛ yɛtsena ha, na sɛ epɛ a, mobɔbɔ asese ebiasa, ɔwo wodze kor, Moses dze kor, Elijah dze kor.
Na ɔda do rekasa no hwɛ, mununkum hyɛnn bɛkataa hɔn do, na hwɛ, ndze fi mununkum no mu see dɛ, oyi nye mo dɔba a ɔsɔ m’enyi: Hom ntsie no.
Na esuafo no tsee no, wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu, na wosuroo pii.
Na Jesus bae dze ne nsa bɛkãa hɔn na ɔsee dɛ, hom nsoɛr, mma hom nnsuro.
Na wɔmemaa hɔn enyiwa do no, woennhu obiara dɛ Jesus nko.
Na wofi kokwaa do risian no, Jesus braa hɔn dɛ, mma hom nnkã dza hom ehu yi nnkyerɛ obiara, gyedɛ nyimpa Ba no asoɛr efi ewufo mu ana.
Na n'esuafo no bisaa no see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na kyerɛwfo no kã dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ Elijah bedzi kan aba?
Na obuae see dɛ, Elijah dze, odzi kan ba ampa, na ɔbɛsesɛw ndzɛmba nyina:
Na mese hom dɛ Elijah aba dada, na woennhu no anngye no, na wɔyɛɛ no dza wɔpɛe nyina. Dɛmara na nyimpa Ba no so bohu hɔn nsa amandze.
Nna esuafo no hun dɛ ɔrekã John Onumanyi no no ho asɛm.
Na wɔbaa nyimpadodow no nkyɛn no, nyimpa bi baa no hɔ bɔkotoow no see dɛ,
Ewuradze, hu me babanyin mbɔbɔr, na otwa ehim na ohu amandze bɔn, na ɔtɔ dɛ ɔhwe gya mu, na ɔtɔ dɛ ɔhwɛ nsu mu.
Na medze no brɛɛ w’esuafo, na woenntum annyɛ no edur.
Na Jesus buae see dɛ, ao ɔsantsen a hom nnyi gyedzi na hom akyea, menye hom ntsena nkodu dabɛn? Minsie hom ho abotar nkodu dabɛn? Hom mfa no mbrɛ me ha.
Na Jesus bɔɔ no ham, na abɔnsam no fi no mu firii; na ofitsi dɔn no ara mu na abofra no ne yarba gyaae.
Nna esuafo no baa Jesus hɔ wɔ nkyɛn, na wɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na yeenntum enntu no?

Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom gyedzi suar ntsi a: Na nokwar mese hom dɛ, sɛ hom wɔ gyedzi a ɔtse dɛ sinape abafua a, nkyɛ hom bɛse kokwaa yi dɛ, tutu fi ha kɔ noho, na nkyɛ obotutu, na nkyɛ biribiara ronnsõ hom yɛ.
Naaso iyi ne saso mm fir edzi, gyedɛ ɔnam asɔr ɔnye mbuada do.
Na worikyinkyim Galilee no, Jesus see hɔn dɛ, nyimpa Ba no woribeyi no ahyɛ nyimpa nsa;
na woboku no, na da a otsia ebiasa no obenyan. Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn awerɛhow pii.
Na wɔbaa Capernaum no, hɔn a wɔgyegye drachma ebien tow no baa Peter nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, ana hom kyerɛkyerɛfo remma drachma ebien tow no?
Ɔsee dɛ, obɛma na ɔbaa fie no, Jesus dzii kan see no dɛ, Simon, edwen dɛn? Asaase do ahemfo no woananom hɔ na wɔgyegye amandze anaa tow? Hɔn mba hɔ anaa anana hɔ a?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Anana hɔ no, Jesus see no dɛ, ɔnodze na mba no fa hɔnho dzi.
Naaso mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ na yɛannto hɔn fintsidua ntsi, kɔ mpoano kɔtow nkwaba, na fa nam a obedzi kan aba no, na ibue n'anomu a, ibohu stater wɔ mu: Fa kɛma ma emi nye wo.
18: Dɔn no ara mu na esuafo baa Jesus hɔ bɛsee dɛ, woana na ɔyɛ kɛse wɔ sor ahenman no mu?
Na ɔfrɛɛ abofraba baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔdze no sii hɔn finimfin,
na ɔsee dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ, gyedɛ hom dan na hom yɛ dɛ mbofraba, ɔno hom runntum nnhɛn Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu da.
Dɛm ntsi, obiara a ɔbɛbrɛ noho adze dɛ abofraba yi no ɔnoara na ɔyɛ kɛse wɔ sor ahenmam no mu.
Na obiara a ɔbɛgye abofraba a ɔtse dɛm yi kor wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔgye emi mara;
na obiara a ɔbɔto mbofra nkakraba a wɔgye me dzi yi mu baako fintsidua no, oye ma no dɛ wɔdze ewuyambo kɛse sɛn no kɔn mu, na wɔkɔtow no kyen nsu mu wɔ po bun mu.
Fintsiduato ntsi wiadze ndue! Na otwar dɛ fintsiduato ba, na nyimpa a fintsidua nam no do ba no, ndue!

Na sɛ wo nsa anaa wo nan to wo fintsidua a, twa, na tow fi woho kyen: Oye ma wo dɛ edze abasin anaa anansin bɔkɔ nkwa mu kyɛn dɛ ewɔ wo nsa ebien nye w’anan ebien, na wɔdze wo bɔkɔto onnyiewiei gya mu.
Na sɛ w’enyiwa to wo fintsidua a, tu, na tow fi woho kyen oye ma wo dɛ edze enyiwa kor bɔkɔ nkwa mu kyɛn dɛ ewɔ enyiwa ebien na wɔdze wo bɔkɔyie Gehenna gya mu.
Hom nhwɛ yie mma hom eemmbu mbofra nkakraba yi mu baako enyimtsia, na mese hom dɛ ɔsor noho hɔn abɔfoe hwɛ m'Egya a ɔwɔ sor no enyim daa.
Na nyimpa Ba bae dɛ ɔrebɛgye dza ayew no nkwa.
Hom dwen dɛn? Sɛ nyimpa bi wɔ nguan ɔha, na hɔn mu baako tɔ gon a, ana onngyaa eduokron akron no hɔ, na ɔnnkɔ nkokwaa do nnkɔhwehwɛ dza ɔatɔ gon?
Na sɛ ɔba dɛ ohu no a, nokwar mese hom dɛ odzi dɛw wo no ho kyen eduokron akron no a woannto gon no.
Dɛmara na ɔnnyɛ hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor ne pɛ dɛ mbofra nkakraba yi mu baako bɛyew.
Na sɛ wo nua fom wo a, kɔ na keyi no atsɛn wɔ wo nye no nko ntamu: Sɛ otsie wo a, enya wo nua.
Na sɛ oenntsie wo a, fa kor anaa ebien ka woho, ma asɛm biara ngyina adasefo beenu anaa baasa anomu.
Na ɔpow dɛ obetsie hɔn a, kɛkã kyerɛ asɔr, na sɛ ɔpow dɛ obetsie asɔr so a, bu no dɛ amanamamfo mu baako nye towgyenyi.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, biribiara a hom bɛkyekyer wɔ asaase do no, wɔbɛkyekyer no wɔ sor; na biribiara a hom bɛsan wɔ asaase do no, wɔbɛsan wɔ sor.
Bio, mese hom dɛ, sɛ hom mu beenu yɛ anokor wɔ asaase do wɔ biribi a wobebisa ho a, m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor bɛyɛ ama hɔn.
Na mbrɛ beenu anaa baasa ehyia wɔ me dzin mu no, hɔ na mowɔ hɔn finimfin.
Nna Peter bae bɛsee no dɛ, Ewuradze, mpɛn ahen na mo nua fom me a, memfa nkyɛ no? Onkodu mpɛn esuon anaa?
Jesus see no dɛ, mennse wo dɛ onkodu mpɛn esuon, na mpɛn eduosuon mbɔho esuon.
Dɛm ntsi sor ahenman no tse dɛ ɔhen bi a ɔpɛɛ dɛ ɔnye no nkowaa bu nkontaa.
Na ɔhyɛɛ ase rubu no, wɔdze baako a ɔmaa no talent pedu brɛɛ no.
Na osiandɛ onnyi dza ɔdze botua ntsi, no wura hyɛɛ dɛ wɔntɔn ɔno, nye ne yer, nye ne mba, nye dza ɔwɔ nyina mfa ntua kaw.
Dɛm ntsi akowaa no hwee daadze, na ɔkotoow no dɛ, mo wura, nya abotar wɔ mo ho, na mubotua wo ne nyina.
Na akowaa no wura ne yamu twee no, na ogyaa no, na ɔdze kaw no kyɛɛ no.
Na akowaa noara fiir edzi kohun no nwurakowaa no mu baako a ɔdze no denare ɔha; na osuoo no mu, na ɔtɔɔr ne meneba dɛ, tua dza edze me.
Na n'ewurakowaa no hwee daadze na ɔserɛɛ no dɛ, nya abotar wɔ mo ho, na mubotua wo.
Na ɔnodze ɔammpen, na ɔkɔree dze no kɔtoo efiadze dɛ onkodu dɛ obotua dza ɔdze no no.
Na no nwurakowaa no hun dza esi no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn yaw dɛ, na wɔbae bɛkãa dza esi no nyina kyerɛɛ hɔn wura.
Na no wura frɛɛ no see no dɛ, akowaa bɔn, medze wo kaw no nyina mekyɛɛ wo osiandɛ eserɛɛ me ntsi:
ana ɔnnsɛ wo so dɛ nkyɛ ihu w'ewurakowaa mbɔbɔr, dɛ mbrɛ muhun wo mbɔbɔr no?
Na no wura no bo fuwii, na oyii no maa hawfo dɛ onkodu dɛ obotua no dza ɔdze no nyina.
Dɛmara na mo sor Egya bɛyɛ ama hom, sɛ hom emmfi hom akoma mu ammfa obiara no nua no bɔn emmfir no a.
19: Na obaa dɛ, Jesus wiee nsɛm yi kã no, osii mu fii Galilee na ɔbaa Judea ntoaado wɔ Jordan egya;
na nyimpadodow pii kaa no do, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn edur wɔ hɔ.
Na Phariseefo no baa ne nkyɛn bɔsɔɔ no hwɛe see no dɛ, ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ nyimpa kõ ne yer wɔ asɛm biara ntsi?
Na obuae see dɛ, ana hom nnkenkaan dɛ nyia ɔyɛɛ hɔn ahyɛse no, ɔbanyin na ɔbaa na ɔyɛɛ hɔn?
na ɔsee dɛ, Iyi ntsi na ɔbanyin begya n’egya nye ne nã hɔ, na ɔdze noho akɔbɔ ne yer ho; na hɔn beenu ayɛ honankor?
Dɛm no na wɔnnda ho nnyɛ beenu bio, na wɔyɛ honankor. Ntsi dza Nyankopɔn dze abɔ mu no, mma nyimpa nntsew mu.
Wɔsee no dɛ, na ɔyɛ dɛn na Moses hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmma ɔkõ-nwoma na wongyaa no yi?
Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom akoma dzen ntsi na Moses maa hom kwan dɛ hom nkõ hom yernom, na ofi ahyɛse no dze ɔnntse dɛm.
Na mese hom dɛ, obiara a ɔbɔkõ ne yer, na nnyɛ ndwamanyɛ ntsi, na ɔbɔwar fofor no, ɔatõ awar; na nyia ɔbɔwar nyia wɔakõ no no, ɔatõ awar.
Esuafo no see no dɛ, sɛ ɔbanyin nye ne yer asɛm tse dɛm a, na onnye dɛ wɔwar.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, nnyɛ nyimpa nyina na wobotum agye asɛm yi, gyedɛ hɔn a wɔdze ama hɔn no.
Na asaa bi wɔ hɔ a wɔwoo hɔn fii hɔn nã yamu; na asaa bi wɔ hɔ a nyimpa saa hɔn; na asaa bi wɔ hɔ a wɔyɛɛ hɔn wɔ sor ahenman no ntsi. Nyia obotum agye no, ma ɔngye.
Nna wɔdze mbofraba brɛɛ no dɛ ɔmfa ne nsa ngu hɔn do, na ɔnsɔr; na esuafo no twuuw hɔn enyim.
Na Jesus see dɛ, hom mma mbofraba no kwan, mma hom nnsiw hɔn me nkyɛn ba kwan, na woyi dɛm na sor ahenman no yɛ hɔndze.
Na ɔdze ne nsa guu hɔn do no, ofii hɔ kɔree.
Na hwɛ, obi bae bɛsee no dɛ, kyerɛkyerɛfo, ebɛn adzepa na menyɛ ma meenya onnyiewiei nkwa?
Na ɔsee no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ibisa me papa ho asɛm? Baako pɛ na ɔyɛ papa; na sɛ epɛ dɛ ekɔ nkwa mu a, dzi mhransɛm no do.
Ɔsee no dɛ, Dza ɔwɔ hen a? Jesus see no dɛ, mma nndzi ewu, mma nntõ awar, mma nnwia adze, Mma nndzi dasewia,
Dzi w’egya nye wo nã nyi, na, dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa woho.
Aberantsɛ no see no dɛ, yinom nyina na medzi do: aka me ebɛn bio?
Jesus see no dɛ, sɛ epɛ dɛ idzi mu a, kɔ kɔtɔn dza ewɔ, na fa kyɛ ehiafo, na ibenya akoradze wɔ sor, na bra bɛka mo do.
Na aberantsɛ no tsee asɛm no, ɔdze yaw kɔree, na ɔyɛ nyimpa a ɔwɔ ahonyadze pii.
Na Jesus see n’esuafo no dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ ɔyɛ dzen ma ɔhonyanyi dɛ ɔbɔkɔ sor ahenman no mu.
Na bio mese hom dɛ ɔyɛ mberɛw ma efupɔnkɔ dɛ obodua doroba enyiwa mu kyɛn dɛ ɔhonyanyi bɔkɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu.
Na esuafo no tsee no, hɔn ho boow hɔn pii, na wɔsee dɛ, woana mbɔ na wobotum agye no nkwa?
Na Jesus hwɛɛ hɔn see dɛ, nyimpa afamu na iyi nntum dɛm yɛ, na Nyankopɔn afamu dze, adze biara nnsõ no yɛ.
Nna Peter buae see no dɛ, hwɛ, yeegyaa ndzɛmba nyina na yɛabɛka wo do: Ebɛnadze na yebenya?
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ hom a hom aka mo do, awofofor no mu a nyimpa Ba no bɛtsena n'eyimnyam ahengua do no, hom so bɛtsena nhengua duebien do ebu Israel ebusuakuw duebien no atsɛn.
Na obiara a oegyaa efi, anaa egya, anaa nã, anaa mba, anaa nsaase, wɔ me dzin ntsi, obenya mbɔho mpɛn ɔha, na oenya onnyiewiei nkwa ayɛ nedze.
Na edzikamfo pii bedzi ekyir na ekyidzifo so pii bedzi kan.
20: Na ɔsor ahenman no tse dɛ nyimpa a ɔyɛ ofiwura a ofiir edzi anapaatu dɛ ɔrokɔbɔ edwumafo paa akɔ no wenyin ture mu.
Na ɔnye edwumafo no dzii ano da kor denare kor no, ɔmaa wɔkɔr no wenyin ture mu.
Na ofiir edzi bɛyɛ dɛ dɔn a otsia ebiasa no, na okohun binom dɛ wogyinagyina gua do enyihaw mu:
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom so hom nkɔ wenyin ture no mu, na dza ɔtsen no mebɛma hom. Na wɔkɔree.
Ofiir edzi bio bɛyɛ dɛ dɔn a otsia esia nye akron no mu kɛyɛɛ dɛmara.
Na bɛyɛ dɛ dɔn a otsia dubiako mu no, ofiir edzi kohun binom dɛ wogyinagyina hɔ, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na adzekyee yi nyina hom gyinagyina ha enyihaw mu yi?
Wɔsee no dɛ, osiandɛ obiara mmbɔɔ hɛn paa, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom so hom nkɔ wenyin ture no mu.
Na odur ewimber no, wenyin ture no wura see ne fihwɛfo dɛ, frɛ edwumafo no, na ma hɔn hɔn apaabɔdze, hyɛ ase fi hɔn a wodzii ekyir no do kesi hɔn a wodzii kan no do.
Na dɔn-a-otsia-dubiako-fo no bae no, hɔn nyina nyaa denare nkorkor.
Na edzikamfo no bae no, wosusuu dɛ wobenya kɛse; na hɔn so hɔn mu biara nyaa denare nkorkor.
Na hɔn nsa kae no, wohwinhwiin ofiwura no ho
dɛ, Ekirfo yi dze, dɔnhwer kor pɛ na wɔyɛe, na ama wɔnye hɛn a adzekyee yi ne berɛ nye ne nyew ahyɛ hɛn do asɛ.
Na obuae see hɔn mu baako dɛ. Awɛ, mennyɛ wo bɔn bi: ana menye wo enndzi ano denare kor?
Fa wodze na kɔ; mepɛ dɛ mema ekyidzifo yi dɛ woara.
Ana minnyi ho kwan dɛ medze mankasa m'adze meyɛ dza mepɛ? W'enyi yɛ bɔn dɛ miye ntsi anaa?
Mbrɛ ekyidzifo bedzi kan, na edzikamfo edzi ekyir nye no.
Na Jesus rokɔ Jerusalem no, ɔfaa esuafo duebien no nko kɔr nkyɛn na ɔsee hɔn wɔ kwan no mu dɛ,
Hwɛ, yɛrokɔ Jerusalem, na nyimpa Ba no wobeyi no ahyɛ asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no nsa, na woebu no fɔ ama wu,
na woeyi no ama amanamamfo dɛ wonsi no atwwetwe na wɔnka no mpire, na wɔmbɔ no mbeamudua mu da a otsia ebiasa no obenyan.
Nna Zebedee mba no hɔn nã nye ne mba baa ne nkyɛn bɔkotoow no, na ɔserɛɛ no hɔ biribi.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, ebɛnadze na epɛ? Ɔsee no dɛ, hyɛ ma me mba beenu yi, baako aatsena w'enyimfa, na baako aatsena w'abankum, wɔ w'ahenman no mu.
Na Jesus buae see dɛ, hom nnyim dza hom reserɛ yi: Ana hom botum anom kuraba a morobɔnom no? Wɔsee no dɛ, yebotum.
Ɔsee hɔn dɛ. Mo kuraba dze hom bɔnom: Na m'enyimfa nye m'abankum tsena dze, ɔnnyɛ medze dɛ medze bɛma: Na wɔdze bɛma hɔn a m'Egya esiesie ama hɔn.
Na du no tsee no, wonyaa ebufuw wɔ enuanom beenu no ho.
Na Jesus frɛɛ hɔn baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔse dɛ, hom nyim dɛ amanaman ahemfo no, wodzi hɔn do wura, na hɔn mu akɛse dzi hɔn do tum.
Na ɔrennyɛ dɛm wɔ hom mu: Na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔbɛyɛ kɛse wɔ hom mu no, ɔbɛyɛ hom somfo;
na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ odzi hom mu kan no, ɔbɛyɛ hom akowaa:
Dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa Ba no so ɔammba ma wɔaasom no, na mbom ɔbɔsomee, ma ɔdze no nkwa aayɛ werdam ama dodowara.
Na wofi Jericho rokɔ no, nyimpadodow pii kaa no do.
Na hwɛ, enyifurafo beenu a wɔtse kwan nkyɛn no, wɔtsee dɛ Jesus rutwa mu no, wɔtsēatseaa mu dɛ, Ewuradze, David ba, hu hɛn mbɔbɔr.
Na nyimpadodow no braa hɔn dɛ wommua hɔn ano; na mbom wɔtsēatseaa mu kɛse see dɛ, Ewuradze, David ba, hu hɛn mbɔbɔr.
Na Jesus gyinae, na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn, na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom pɛ dɛ meyɛ mema hom?
Wɔsee no dɛ, Ewuradze, nkyɛ hɛn enyiwa eebue.
Na Jesus ne yamu hyehyee no wɔ hɔn ho, na ɔkãa hɔn enyiwa, na ntsɛmara wohun adze na wɔkaa no do.
21: Na wɔbɛɛn Jerusalem, na wodur Bethany, wɔ Ngo Bepɔw no ho no, Jesus somaa esuafo beenu
see hɔn dɛ, hom nkɔ ekuroba a ɔda hom enyim no mu, na ntsɛmara hom bohu asoaso a wɔamontan no, nye ne ba: Hom nsan hɔn na hom mfa mbrɛ me.
Na sɛ obiara se hom biribi a, hom nse dɛ, Ewuradze wɔ hɔn ho hia, na ntsɛmara ɔbɛma wɔdze aba.
Na wɔyɛɛ yinom ma dza nkɔnnyɛnyi no kãe no aaba mu dɛ,
Hom nse Zion babaa, hwɛ, wo hen reba wo nkyɛn: Ɔdwe, na ɔtse asoaso, nye asoaso a ɔsoa adze ba do.
Na esuafo no kɔree kɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Jesus nyɛɛ hɔn no,
na wɔdze asoaso no nye ne ba no bae, na wɔdze hɔn ntar guu hɔn do, na ɔtsenaa do.
Na nyimpadodow pii dze hɔn ntar sesɛɛw kwan no mu, na binom twitwaa ndubaa sesɛɛɛw kwan no mu.
Na nyimpadodow a wodzi enyim no, na hɔn a wodzi ekyir no tsēaa mu see dɛ, Hossana, David ba no! Nhyira nye nyia ɔnam Ewuradze dzin mu reba no! Hosanna wɔ sorsor!
na odur Jerusalem no, kurow no nyina bɔɔ twitwi dɛ, woana nye yi?
Na nyimpadodow no see dɛ, oyi nye Jesus nkɔnhyɛnyi a ofi Nazareth a ɔwɔ Galilee no.
Na Jesus kɔr Nyankopɔn asɔrfi no mu, na ɔkɛpaam hɔn a wɔtɔn nye hɔn a wɔtɔ wɔ asɔrfi no mu, na obutuuw sikasesafo hɔn ngua;
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, wɔakyerɛw dɛ, wɔbɛfrɛ me fi asɔryɛbea: Na homdze hom yɛ no edwotwafo tu.
Na enyifurafo nye mpakye baa no hɔ wɔ asɔrfi no mu, na ɔyɛe hɔn edur.
Na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no hun anwanwadze a ɔyɛe no, ɔnye mbofraba a wɔretsēatsea mu wɔ asɔrfi no mu dɛ, Hosanna, David ba no, wonyaa ebufuw pii.
na wɔsee no dɛ, Etse dza yinom rekã yi? Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, nyew: Ana hom nnkenkaan pɛn dɛ, Ofi nkɔkowaba nye numfoanomba anomu, na esiesie ayɛyi.
Na ogyaa hɔn hɔna ofii kurow no mu kɔr Bethany kɛtsenaa ho.
Na anapa no a ɔresan aba kurow no mu no, ɔkɔm dzee no.
Na ohun adɔmbadua wɔ kwan no do no, ɔbaa ho na oennhu biribiara wɔ do dɛ ahaban nko; na ɔsee no dɛ, Mma aba nnsow wo do dabiarada. Na amonmu hɔ ara adɔmbadua no kyenkyenee.
Na esuafo no hunii no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn nwanwa, na wɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na amonmu ha yi ara adɔmbadua yi akyenkyen yi?
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ, sɛ hom wɔ gyedzi, na hom nnyɛ ekyingye a, nkyɛ nnyɛ adɔmbadua dze yi nko na hom bɛyɛ, na mpo sɛ hom se koko yi dɛ, tutu na kɔhwe po mu, a, nkyɛ ɔbɛyɛ.
Na biribiara a hom bebisa no asɔr mu, na hom gye dzi no, hom nsa bɛkã.
Na ɔbaa asɔrfi mu, na ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ no, asɔfompanyin nye ɔman mpanyimfo no baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, ebɛn tum na enam do yɛ ndzɛmba yi, na woana maa wo tum yi?
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, mo so mibebisa hom asɛm kor a sɛ hom kyerɛ me ano a, mo so mebɛkyerɛ hom turn kor a medze meyɛ yinom.
John enuma no, ofi hen? Ofi sor anaa ofi nyimpa? Na wosusui wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, sɛ yɛkã dɛ, ofi sor, a, ɔbɛse hɛn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom anngye enndzi?
Na sɛ yɛkã dɛ, Ofi nyimpa, a, yesuro nyimpadodow no: Osiandɛ hɔn nyina bu John nkɔnhyɛnyi.
Na wobuaa Jesus see dɛ, yennyim. Na no so see hɔn dɛ, mo so mennkã tum kor a medze meyɛ yinom mennkyerɛ hom.
Na hom dwen dɛn? Nyimpa bi wɔ mba beenu; na ɔbaa nyia odzi kan no hɔ bɛsee no dɛ, ɔba, ndɛ kɔ kɛyɛ mo wenyin ture mu edwuma.
Na obuae see dɛ, moronnkɔ, na n’ekyir no onuu noho na ɔkɔree.
Na ɔbaa nyia otsīa ebien no hɔ bɛsee no dɛmara. Na obuae see dɛ, mo wura, mobɔkɔ, na ɔannkɔ.
Hɔn beenu yi mu woana na ɔyɛɛ n’egya ne pɛ? Wɔsee dɛ, nyia odzi kan no a. Jesus see hɔn dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ, towgyefo nye ndwaman ridzi hom enyim akɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu.
Na John nam tsenenee kwan mu baa hom nkyɛn, na hom anngye no enndzi: Na towgyefo nye ndwaman gyee no dzii: Na homdze, hom hunii no hom ammfe homho ekyir dɛ hom bɛgye no edzi.
Hom ntsie bɛ fofor so: Ofiwura bi wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛɛ wenyin ture, na ɔgyee ho ban hyiae, na otuu wenyintwer, na ɔtoow abantsentsen wɔ mu, na ɔdze fɛɛm ekuafo bi, na ɔdɔɔ mu kɔr beebi.
Na eduaba no ne ber durii no, ɔsomaa no nkowaa wɔ ekuafo no nkyɛn dɛ wɔnkeɛye n’eduaba no.
Na ekuafo no kyeer no nkowaa no, na wɔhwee bi, na wokum bi, na wosiiw bi abo.
Bio, ɔsomaa nkowaa fofor a wɔdɔɔ sõ kyɛn nkan dze no; na wɔyɛɛ hɔn dɛmara.
Na n'ekyir no, ɔsomaa ne babanyin wɔ hɔn hɔ, na ɔsee dɛ, wɔbɛfɛr me ba.
Na ekuafo no hun babanyin no, wɔsesee wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, owuodzi no nye yi: Hom mbra ma yenku no, na yɛmfa u’egyapadze no.
Na wɔkyeer no, na wɔtoow no fii wenyin ture mu ho kyenee, na wokum no.
Dɛm ntsi aber a wenyin ture no wura bɛba, ebɛnadze na ɔbɛyɛ ekuafo no?
Wɔsee no dɛ, ɔbɛsɛɛ nyimpa bɔn no pasaa, na ɔdze no wenyin ture no afɛm ekuafo fofor a wɔdze eduaba no bɛma no wɔ n’aber mu.
Jesus see hɔn dɛ, ana hom nnkenkaan kyerɛw nsɛm no mu pɛn dɛ, ɔbo a adantofo powee no, ɔnoara na ɔabɛyɛ kutuwdo-bo; iyi Ewuradze nyɛe a, na ɔyɛ nwanwa wɔ hɛn enyiwa do?
Dɛm ntsi mese hom dɛ, Nyankopɔn ahenman no, wɔbɛgye efi hom nsamu dze akɛma ɔman a wɔdze mu eduaba bɛba.
Na obiara a ɔbɔhwe ɔbo yi do obobubu, na obiara a ɔbɔhwe no do no, ɔbɔdwow no isiam.
Na asɔfompanyin nye Phariseefo no tsee ne mbɛ no, wohun dɛ ɔkãa hɔn ho asɛm.
Na wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔkyer no no, wosuroo nyimpadodow no, osiandɛ wobu no nkɔnhyɛnyi.
22: Na Jesus buae kasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn mbɛbu mu bio dɛ,
ɔsor ahenman tse dɛ ɔhen bi a onhiaa ayefor maa ne babanyin,
na ɔsomaa no nkowaa dɛ wɔnkɛfrɛ hɔn a wohyiaa hɔn ayefor ase no: na wɔammpɛ dɛ wɔba.
Bio ɔsomaa nkowaa afofor dɛ wɔnkɛkã nkyerɛ hɔn a woehyia hɔn no dɛ, hwɛ, mesiesie m edziban, meku m’anantwi nye m'anyɛmbowa, na woewie adze nyinara yɛ: hom mbra ayefor ase,
Na wɔammfa annyɛ hwee, na wɔkɔr hɔn beebi: obi kɔr no kwã mu, obi so kor n’eguadzi ho:
na nkaa no kyeer nkowaa no hyɛɛ hɔn fɛr, na wokum hɔn.
Na ɔhen no bo fuwii, na ɔsomaa no dɔm ma wɔkasɛɛ ewu- dzifo no, na wohyeew hɔn kurow.
Nnaosee no nkowaa nodɛ, woewie ayefor pon no siesie dze, na hɔn a wokehyiaa hɔn no annsɛ hɔn.
Dɛm ntsi hom nkɔ atsempon nkwanta do na dodo war a a hom bohu hɔn no, hom mfrɛ hɔn mbra ayefor ase.
Na nkowaa no fiir edzi kɔr atsempon do, na wokoboaboaa dodowara a wohun hɔn no ano, papa nye bɔn nyina, ma edzidzifo hyɛɛ ayefor no ase mã.
Na ɔhen no baa mu bɔhwɛɛ edzidzifo no, ohun nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a ɔnnhyɛ ayeforhyia atar;
na ɔsee no dɛ, awɛ, eyɛɛ dɛn baa mu ha, na ennhyɛ ayeforhyia atar yi? Na ɔtɔɔ mmum.
Nna ɔhen no see asomfo no dɛ, hom nkyckyer ne nsa nye n’anan na hom mfa no nkɔ nkɔtow no nkyen ekyirkyir sum no mu: hɔ na osū nye asetwɛr wɔ.
Osiandɛ wɔafrɛ pii, na kakraabi na wɔapa hɔn.
Nna Phariseefo no kɔree kɛfaa apam, mbrɛ wobosua no efir wɔ kasa mu.
Na wɔsomaa hɔn esuafo ɔnye Herod akadofo wɔ no hɔ, na wɔsee dɛ, kyerɛkyerɛfo, yenyim dɛ eyɛ nokwafo, na ekyerɛkyerɛ Nyankopɔn kwan no wɔ nokwar mu, na emmfa nyimpa nnyɛ hwee; na ennhwɛ nyimpa enyim.
Dɛm ntsi kã kyerɛ hɛn: edwen dɛn? Ɔfa mbra mu dɛ yɛma Cæsar ntoboa anaa oho?
Na Jesus hun hɔn emumuyɛ no, ɔsee dɛ, Ndabrabafo, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom rosɔ me hwɛ yi?
Hom mfa tow-sika no mbɛkyerɛ me. Na wɔdze denare brɛɛ no.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, woana honyi nye kyerɛw nye yi?
Wosee dɛ, Cæsar dze a. Nna ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ntsi hom ndan dza ɔyɛ Cæsar dze mma Cæsar, na dza ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn dze mma Nyankopɔn.
Na wɔtsee no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn nwanwa, na wogyaa no hɔ kɔree.
Da no ara na Sadduceefo a wɔkã dɛ wunyan nnyi hɔ no bae bebisaa no dɛ,
kyerɛkyerɛfo, Moses see dɛ, Sɛ obi wu, na sɛ onnyi mba a, no nua nwar ne yer, na ɔnwo mba mma no nua.
Na enuanom beesuon tsenaa hɛn nkyɛn ha; na nyia odzii kan no waree, na owui, na onnyi mba ɔdaan ne yer gyaa no nua;
nyia otsia ebien no ɔnye ebiasa no yɛɛ dɛm ara, bodur nyia otsia esuon no do.
Na ne nyina ekyir no, ɔbaa no so wui.
Dɛm ntsi wunyan no mu, beesuon no mu woana na ɔbɛyɛ ne yer? Osiandɛ hɔn nyina waar no.
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, hom fom do, hom nnyim kyerewnsɛm nye Nyankopɔn ahoɔdzen ntsi.
Na wunyan no mu, wɔnnwar eso wɔmma awar, na wɔtse dɛ Nyankopɔn abɔfoe wɔ sor.
Na ewufo hɔn nyan ho dze, ana hom nnkenkaan dza Nyankopɔn kãe no dɛ,
Emi nye Abraham Nyankopɔn, Isaac Nyankopɔn, Jacob Nyankopɔn? Ɔnnyɛ ewufo Nyankopɔn na enyikamfo Nyankopɔn a.
Na nyimpadodow tsee no, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛɛ hɔn ahohow
Na Phariseefo no tsee dɛ oetua Sadduceefo no ano no, wodzii ehyia.
Na hɔn mu baako a ɔyɛ mbrakyerɛfo sɔɔ no hwɛe bisaa no dɛ,
kyerɛkyerɛfo, mbra no mu asɛnkɛse nye mmuana?
Na ɔsee no dɛ, dɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn wɔ w’akoma nyina mu, nye wo kra nyina mu, nye w'adwen nyina mu.
Iyi nye mbra no mu asɛm a odzi kan, na ɔsõ.
Na dza otsia ebien no a ɔtse dɛ ɔno no nye dɛ, dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa woho.
Mbransɛm ebien yi do na mbra nye nkɔnhyɛfo no nyina sɛn.
Na Phariseefo no boaa ano no, Jesus bisaa hɔn dɛ,
hom dwen Christ no ho dɛn? Woana ba nye no? Wɔsee no dɛ, David a.
ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn mbɔ na David nam Sunsum mu frɛ no Ewuradze, dɛ,
Ewuradze see m’Ewuradze dɛ, tsena m’abanyimfa, Kodu dɛ medze w’atamfo mubogu w’ananadze?
Na sɛ David frɛ no Ewuradze a, ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔyɛ ne ba?
Na obiara enntum emmbua no asɛm biara, na ofitsi da no obiara ennsi no bo dɛ obebisa no asɛm bio.
23: Nna Jesus kasaa kyerɛɛ nyimpadodow no nye n'esuafo dɛ,
Kyerɛwfo nye Phariseefo no tse Moses egua do;
dɛm ntsi adze nyina a wɔbɛhyɛ hom no, hom ndzi do, na hom nyɛ: Na mma hom nnyɛ hɔn ndwuma bi; na wɔse na wɔnnyɛ.
Na wɔkyekyer ndzesoadze durdur a no soa yɛ yaw na wɔdze to nyimpa kɔn ho, na hɔndze, wɔmmpɛ dɛ wɔdze hɔn nsatseaba mpo suo mu
Na hɔn ndwuma nyi na wɔyɛ ma nyimpa eehu: Wɔyɛ hɔn nkaa-nwoma atɛtɛr, na woyi hon ntar ano ndwow akɛse,
na wɔpɛ mpanyin tsenabea wɔ edzidzi ase, nye mpanyin ngua wɔ nhyiamudan mu
nye gua do nkyiakyia, nye dɛ nyimpa bɛfrɛ hɔn Rabbi (Kyerɛkyerɛfo).
Na homdze mma wɔmmfrɛ hom Rabbi; na ɔbaako nye hom kyerɛkyerɛfo, na hom nyina yɛ enuanom.
Na mma hom mmfrɛ obi hom egya wɔ asaase do: Na ɔbaako nye hom Egya, ɔnye nyia ɔwɔ sor.
Eso mma wɔmmfrɛ hom akwankyerɛfo: Na ɔbaako nye hom kwankyerɛfo, ɔnye Christ no.
Na nyia ɔyɛ kɛse wɔ hom mu no, ɔbɛyɛ hom somfo.
Na obiara a ɔbɛma noho do no, wɔbɛbrɛ no adze, na obiara a ɔbɛbrɛ noho adze no, wɔbɛma no do.
Hom ndue! Kyerɛwfo nye Phariseefo, ndabrabafo! Na hom tow ɔsor ahenman mu wɔ nyimpa enyim, na homankasa hom nnkɔ mu, eso hɔn a wɔrokɔ mu no hom mma hɔn kwan mma wɔnnkɔ mu.
Hom ndue, kyerɛwfo nye Phariseefo, ndabrabafo! Na hom men ekunafo adan, na hom petuw yɛ asɔr tsentsen: dɛm ntsi hom benya afɔdzi kɛse.
Hom ndue, kyerɛwfo nye Phariseefo, ndabrabafo! Na hom bɔ po nye asaase aprɔw kɛyɛ nyimpa baako hom fɛkuwnyi; na sɛ ɔyɛ dɛm a, hom ma ɔyɛ Gehenna ba mbɔho ebien kyɛn homankasa.
Hom ndue! Enyifurafo akwankyerɛfo a hom se dɛ, obiara a ɔbɛkã asɔrfi no ntam no nnyɛ hwee; na obiara a ɔbɛkã sika a ɔwɔ asɔrfi no mu no, ɔda no do.
Nkwasea nye enyifurafo! Na mmuana na ɔsõ, sika no anaa asɔrfi no a ɔtsew sika no ho no a?
Na obiara a ɔbɛkã afɔrmbukyia no ntam no, ɔnnyɛ hwee; na obiara a ɔbɛkã ayɛyɛdze a ɔwɔ do no, ɔda no do.
Enyifurafo! na mmuana na ɔsõ: Ayɛyɛdze no anaa afɔrmbukyia a ɔtsew ayɛyɛdze no ho no a.
Dɛm ntsi nyia ɔkã afɔrmbukyia no ntam no, ɔkã ɔno nye dza ɔwɔ do no nyina.
Na nyia ɔkã asɔrfi ntam no, ɔkã ɔno nye nyia ɔtse mu no.
Na nyia ɔkã ɔsor ntam no, ɔkã Nyankopɔn n’ahengua nye nyia ɔtse do no.

Hom ndue, kyereɛfo nye Phariseefo, ndabrabafo! Na hom yi emē nye anise nye ho tow du du ma, na hom egyaa mbra no mu dza ɔyɛ dur no, atsɛmbu, nye ehumbɔbɔr nye gyedzi; yi ɔsɛ dɛ hom yɛ, na hom nndan kor no so nngya.
Enyifurafo akwankyerɛfo a hom sɔn ntonton do, na hom men efupɔnkɔ!
Hom ndue, kyerɛwfo nye Phariseefo, ndabrabafo! Hom twuw kuraba nye apaawa ekyir, na no mu dze, apempensi nye edzifodzi ahyɛ mã.
Phariseenyi onyifurafo, dzi kan twuw kuraba nye apaawa mu, ma n'ekyir so eefir.
Hom ndue, kyerɛwfo nye Phariseefo, ndabrabafo! Na hom tse dɛ nda a wɔahoa ho, na n’ekyir pue fɛfɛɛfɛw, na no mu dze efun mbiew ɔnye fl nyina ahyɛ mã.
Dɛmara so na hom yɛ dɛ nyimpa tsenenee wɔ nyimpa enyim na hom mu dze, ndabraba nye emumuyɛ nyina ahyɛ mã.
Hom ndue, kyerɛwfo nye Phariseefo, ndabrabafo! Osiandɛ hom tow nkɔnhyɛfo nda do na hom hyehyɛ nyimpa tsenenee aboda no,
na hom kã dɛ, sɛ yɛwɔ hɛn egyanom aber do a, nkyɛ yɛnye hɔn ammbɔ mu wɔ nkɔnhyɛfo no bɔgyaa ho.
Iyi ntsi hom dzi homho dase dɛ hɔn a wokum nkɔnhyɛfo no mba nye hom.
Ntsi hom hhye hom egyanom etwadze no mu.
Nwɔ, nhurutsia mba! Hom bɛye dɛn efi Gehenna atsemba nsa?

Dɛm ntsi hwɛ, morosoma nkɔnhyɛfo nye enyansafo nye kyerɛwfo wɔ hom hɔ, na hom boku hɔn mu bi, na hom abɔ hɔn mbeamudua mu; na hɔn mu bi so hom bɛkã hɔn mpire wɔ hom nhyiamudan mu, na hom atseetsee hɔn efi kurow mu akɔ kurow mu;
ma bɔgya tsenenee a wɔakã egu asaase yi do nyina eegu hom do, ofitsi tseneneenyi Abel bɔgyaa do kesi Barachiah ba Zachariah a hom kum no wɔ asɔrdan nye afɔrmbukyia no ntamu no bɔgyaa do.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ. Yinom nyina bɛba ɔsantsen yi do.

Ao! Jerusalem, Jerusalem, ɔwo a iku nkɔnhyɛfo no, na isiw hɔn a wɔasoma hɔn wo nkyɛn abo, mpɛn ahen na mepɛɛ dɛ moboaboa wo mba ano, dɛ mbrɛ akokɔtan boaboa ne mba ano wɔ ne ntsaban ase, na hom ammpɛ!
Hwɛ, woegyaa wo fi efituo ama hom.
Na mese hom dɛ, Ofitsi sesei yi hom runnhu me ara dze akɛpem dɛ hom bɛse dɛ, nhyira nye nyia ɔnam Ewuradze ne dzin reba.
24: Na Jesus fiir edzi fii asɔrfi no mu kɔree, na n’esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn bɛkyerɛɛ no asɔrfi no aban no.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, ana hom nnhu yinom nyina? Nokwar mese hom dɛ, wonnkegya ɔbo kor a ɔda kor do wɔ ha a wonnkodwuruw egu famu.
Na ɔko Ngo Bepɔw no do no, n’esuafo baa ne nkyɛn nsumaa mu bɛsee no dɛ, kyerɛ hɛn aber a yinom bɛyɛ hɔ, na wo ba nye wiadze ewiei ho asɛnkyerɛdze bɛyɛ dɛn?
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, hom nhwɛ yie amma obi aanndaadaa hom.
Na dodowara bɛba wɔ me dzin mu dɛ, emi nye Christ no, na wɔadaadaa pii.
Na hom bɛtse kõ nye akosɛm nka: Hom nhwɛ, mm a hom akoma nntu, na otwar dɛ yinom nyina ba, na ewiei no nnyae nndurii.
Na ɔman bɔsoɛr ɔman do, na ahenman bɔsoɛr ahenman do; na ɔkɔm nye asaasewosow bɛba mbeabea.
Na yinom nyina nye awoko ahyɛse.
Nna wobeyi hom ama ahohiahia na woeku hom, na amanaman nyina bɛtan hom wɔ me dzin ntsi.
Ɔno na ɔbɔto dodowara fintsidua, na wobeyiyi hɔnho ama, na wɔatentan hɔnho.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo pii bɔsoɛr na wɔadaadaa dodowara.
Na osiandɛ emumuyɛ bɔdɔɔ sõ ntsi, dodowara hɔn dɔ bɔgow.
Na nyia obetsim ekodu ewiei no, ɔno na wɔbɛgye no nkwa.
Na ahenman ho asɛmpa yi, wɔbɛkã wo wiadze nyina dze edzi amanaman nyina dase; na nkyii ewiei no bɛba.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ hom hu amambɔe ekyiwadze a Daniel nkɔnhyɛnyi kãa ho asɛm no, dɛ ogyina krɔnkrɔn-bea hɔ a (ma nyia ɔkenkan no ntse ase)
Ɔno na hɔn a wɔwɔ Judea nguan nkɔ nkokwaa do:
mma nyimpa a ɔwɔ dan-etsifi nnsian mmbɛfa biribi mmfi ne dan mu:
na nyia ɔwɔ haban mu, mma ɔnnsan n'ekyir bio mmbɛfa ne nkatado.
Na hɔn a wɔafa efur, nye hɔn a wɔma numfo wɔ nda no mu ndue!
Na hom nsɔr ma hom eguan aammba awɔwber mu, anaa ahomgyeda;
na aber no ahohiahia kɛse a ofitsi wiadze ahyɛse dze bodu aber no ɔmmba da, eso ɔremmba da, bɛba.
Na sɛ woenntwa nda no do tsia a, nkyɛ honam biara nnkenya nkwa; na mpamufo ntsi wo botwa nda no do tsia.
Na aber no sɛ obiara se hom dɛ, hwɛ, Christ no wɔ ha, anaaso, ɔwɔ ha a, mma hom nngye nndzi
Na Christ-atorfo nye nkɔnhyɛfo atɔrfo bɔsoɛr na wɔakyerɛ asɛnkyerɛdze kɛse nye anwanwadze, ma sɛ ɔbɛyɛ a mpamufo no mpo wɔaadaadaa hɔn.
Hwɛ, makã akyerɛ hom ansaana.
Dɛm ntsi, sɛ wɔse hom dɛ, hwɛ, ɔwɔ sar no do a, mma hom mmfir edzi, hwɛ, ɔwɔ adankyir a, mma hom nngye nndzi.
Na dɛ mbrɛ enyinam nymam fi boka, na ɔhyerɛn kɔ anee no, mbrɛ nyimpa Ba ne ba so bɛyɛ ara nye no.
Na beebiara mbrɛ fun wɔ no, hɔ na nkɔr bɔboaboa hɔn ano.
Na ntsɛmara, nda no mu ahohia no ekyir no, ewia bɛhyɛ sum, na bosoom nnkɛma ne kan, na nworaba fi sor bɔtotɔ, na sor etum bɔwosow:
na ɔno na nyimpa Ba no n’asɛnkyerɛdze bopue wimu, na wiadze mbusuakuw nyina bedzi nkɔmbɔ, na wobohu nyimpa Ba no dɛ ɔreba wɔ sor nsuwusiw do, wɔ ahoɔdzen nye enyimnyam kɛse mu.
Na ɔdze totorobɛnto a ne ndze sõ bɔsoma n'abɔfoe, ma wɔaabɔboaboa ne mpamufo no ano efi mframa a nan no mu, efi sor ntuadze ekesi ntuadze.
Hom nsūa adɔmbadua ho bɛ no: Sɛ n’abaw yɛ momon, na oriyi ahaban a, nna hom nyim dɛ ɔhyewber abɛn;
dɛmara na hom so sɛ hom hu dɛ yinom nyina yɛ hɔ a, hom nhu dɛ abɛn edu abowano.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ. Mbasantsen yi runntwa mu akɔ gyedɛ yinom nyina ayɛ hɔ ansaana.
Ɔsor nye asaase botwa mu akɔ na me nsɛm dze, orunntwa mu.
Na da no nye dɔn no obiara nnyim: Nnyɛ abɔfo a wɔwɔ sor no, nnyɛ ɔba no na Egya no nko a.
Na dɛ mbrɛ Noah nda no yɛe no, mbrɛ nyimpa Ba ne ba so bɛyɛ ara nye no.
Na dɛ mbrɛ nda no a odzi nsuyirii no kan no, wodzidzii, na wɔnomee, wɔwaree, na wɔmaa awar dze kodur da a Noah kɛhɛɛn hɛn-adaka no mu,
na woennhu araa dze kodur dɛ nsuyirii no bae bɛfaa hɔn nyinara kɔree no, mbrɛ nyimpa Ba no ne ba so bɛyɛ ara nye no.
Ɔno na nyimpa beenu wɔ haban mu a, wɔbɛfa baako na woegya baako.
Mbaa beenu bɛyam ewuyambo do a, wɔbɛfa baako na woegya baako.
Dɛm ntsi hom nweɔn, osiandɛ hom nnyim dɔn kor a hom wura bɛba.
Na hom nhu yi dɛ, sɛ ofiwura no nyim dasu kor a owifo no bɛba a, nkyɛ ɔweɔnee, na ɔmama woemmbobubu ne dan mu enndua mu.
Dɛm ntsi hom so hom nyɛ krado, osiandɛ dɔn a hom nnsusu mu na nyimpa Ba no reba.
Woana mbɔ nye akowaa nokwafo nye nyansafo a no wura dze no esi ne fikuw do, dɛ ɔmma hɔn edziban wɔ ber a ɔsɛ mu?
Nhyira akã akowaa no a, sɛ no wura ba a, obohu no dɛ ɔreyɛ dɛm,
Nokwar mese hom dɛ ɔdze no besi n’adze a ɔwɔ nyina do.
Na sɛ akowaa bɔn sɛ n’akoma mu dɛ, mo wura rikyim ne ba;
na sɛ ɔhyɛ ase bobɔ no nwurakowaa, na sɛ ɔnye asabokwafo dzidzi na ɔnom a.
akowaa no wura bɛba da a ɔnnhwɛ no kwan, ɔnye dɔn a onnyim mu,
na oetwa no mu ebien, na ɔama ɔnye ndabrabafo edzi afora: Hɔ na osū nye asetwɛr wɔ.
25: Na sor ahenman no wɔdze bɔto mbaabun du a wɔfaa hɔn nkandzea dɛ worikehyia ayeforkun kwan no ho.
Na hɔn mu beenum yɛɛ nkwasea, na beenum yɛɛ enyansafo.
Na hɔn a wɔyɛɛ nkwasea no, wɔfaa hɔn nkandzea no, wɔammfa ngo annka ho;
na enyansafo no faa ngo guu hɔn ntoa mu kaa hɔn nkandzea no ho.
Na ayeforkun no kyinkyimii no, hɔn nyina totɔɔ nkom na wɔdedae.
Na esuom no, wɔtsēaa mu dɛ, hwɛ, ayeforkun no reba o! Hom nkɔ nkehyia no.
Nna mbaabun no nyina soɛree na wɔkekaa hɔn nkandzea.
Na nkwasea no see enyansafo no dɛ, hom mma hɛn hom ego no bi, na hɛn nkandzea rudundum.
Na enyansafo no buaa dɛ, oho, bɛyɛ na ɔronnsõ hɛn nye hom; na mbom hom nkɔ hɔn a wɔtɔn no hɔ nkɔtɔ homdze.
Na wɔkɔree rokɔtɔ no, ayeforkun no bae, na hɔn a wɔayɛ krado no nye no kɔr ayefor ase, na wɔtoow abow no mu.
Na ekyir no na mbaabun nkaa no so bae bɛsee dɛ, Ewuradze, bue hɛn.
Na ɔnodze, obuae see hɔn dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ, minnyim hom.
Dɛm ntsi hom nweɔn, na hom nnyim da no anaa dɔn no.
Na ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a ɔrodɔ mu akɔ beebi a ɔfrɛɛ no nkowaa, na ɔdze n’adze a ɔwɔ hyɛɛ hɔn nsa.
Na ɔmaa baako talent enum, ɔbaako so ebien, na ɔbaako so kor, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nyina hon tum tse, na ɔkɔree.
Na ntsɛmara nyia onyaa talent enum no kɔree, na ɔdze kedzii gua, na onyaa ho talent enum so.
Dɛmara so na nyia onyaa ebien no, onyaa ho ebien so.
Na nyia onyaa kor no, ɔkɔree kɔbɔɔr daadze, na ɔdze no sika no sumae.
Na ɔkyɛree kyɛree no, nkowaa no hɔn wura no bae, na ɔnye hɔn bobuu nkontaa.
Na nyia onyaa talent enum no bae dze talent enum ka ho baa dɛ, mo wura, edze talent enum hyɛɛ me nsa: Hwɛ, menya ho talent enum aka ho.
No wura see no dɛ, Mbo! akowaa pa nye nokwafo, edzi ndzɛmba kumaabi ho nokwar: Medze wo besi ndzɛmba pil do: Kɔ wo wura dɛw mu.
Na nyia onyaa talent ebien no so bae, na ɔsee dɛ, mo wura, edze talent ebien hyɛɛ me nsa: Hwɛ, menya ho talent ebien aka ho.
No wura see no dɛ, Mbo! akowaa pa nye nokwafo, edzi ndzɛmba kumaabi ho nokwar, medze wo besi ndzɛmba pii do: Kɔ wo wura dɛw mu.
Na nyia onyaa talent kor no so bae bɛsee dɛ, mo wura, minyim wo dɛ eyɛ nyimpa a eyɛ dzen a itwa wɔ mbrɛ innduae, na eboaboa ano wɔ mbrɛ emmfae mmpetsee;
na musuroi, na mokɔree, na medze wo talent no kosumaa daadze: Hwɛ, w’adze nye yi.
Na no wura buae see no dɛ, akowaa bɔn nye kwadwefo, inyim dɛ mutwa wɔ mbrɛ munnduae, na moboaboa ano wɔ mbrɛ memmfae mmpetsee:
dɛm ntsi nkyɛ ɔsɛ wo dɛ edze me sika kɛma sikasesafo, na meba a, mabɛgye m’adze nye no ho nsiho.
Dɛm ntsi, hom ngye talent no wɔ ne nsamu, na hom mfa mma nyia ɔwɔ talent du no.
Osiandɛ obiara a ɔwɔ no, wɔbɛma no na oenya mbordo; na nyia onnyi no, dza ɔwɔ no mpo, wɔbɛgye ne nsamu.
Na akowaa ɔtɔbɔ no dze, hom ntow no nkyen ekyirkyir sum no mu: Hɔ na osū nye asetwɛr wɔ.
Na aber a nyimpa Ba no bɛba wɔ n'enyimnyam mu, na n'abɔfoe no nyina ka no ho no, nna ɔbɛtsena n enyimnyam ahengua no do;
na wɔbɔboaboa amanaman nyina ano wɔ n’enyim, na ɔbɛpaapaa hɔn mu dɛ mbrɛ oguanhwɛfo paapaa nguan nye mpɔnkye mu;
na ɔdze nguan no begyina n'enyimfa, na ɔdze mpɔnkye no egyina n’abankum.
Nna ɔhen no bɛse hɔn a wɔwɔ n’enyimfa no dɛ hom mbra, hom a m’Egya ehyira hom, hom mbɛfa ahenman a wofitsi wiadze ahyɛse siesiei maa hom no ntsena mu:
osiandɛ ɔkɔm dzee me, na hom maa me edziban; nsukɔm dzee me, na hom maa me anondze; meyɛɛ hɔho, na hom faa me kor fie;
midzii adagyaw, na hom furaa me tam; meyaree, na hom bɔhwɛɛ me; medaa efiadze na hom baa me nkyɛn.
Ɔno na nyimpa tsenenee bobua ase no dɛ, Ewuradze. Dabɛn na yehun wo dɛ ɔkɔm dze wo, na yɛmaa wo edziban, anaa nsukɔm dze wo, na yɛmaa wo anondze?
Dabɛn na yehun wo dɛ eyɛ hɔho na yɛfaa wo kɔr fie, anaa idzi adagyaw, na yefuraa wo tam?
Anaa dabɛn na yehun wo dɛ eyar anaa eda efiadze, na yɛbaa wo nkyɛn?
Na ɔhen no bobua ase hɔn dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ, susuampa dɛ hom ayɛ ama mo nuanom nketseaba yi mu kor no, hom ayɛ ama me.
Ɔno na ɔbɛse hɔn a wɔwɔ bankum no so dɛ, hom a wɔadom hom, hom mfi me nkyɛn nkɔ onnyiewiei gya a woesiesie ama abɔnsam nye n’abɔfoe no no mu.
Osiandɛ ɔkɔm dzee me, na hom amma me edziban; nsukɔm dzee me, na hom amma me anondze;
meyɛɛ hɔho, na hom ammfa me annkɔ fie; midzii adagyaw, na hom emmfura me tam; meyaree na medaa efiadze, na hom ammbɔhwɛ me.
Ɔno na hɔn so bobua ase dɛ, Ewuradze, dabɛn na yehun wo dɛ ɔkɔm dze wo, anaa nsukɔm dze wo, anaa eyɛ hɔho, anaa idzi adagyaw, anaa eyar, anaa eda efiadze, na yɛannsom wo?
Ɔno na obobua hɔn dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ, susuampa dɛ hom annyɛ amma mo nuanom nketseaba yi mu kor no hom annyɛ amma me.
Na yinom bɔkɔ onnyiewiei amandzehu no mu, na nyimpa tsenenee no bɔkɔ onnyiewiei nkwa no mu.
26: Na ɔbaa dɛ Jesus wiee nsɛm yi nyina kã no, ɔsee n'esuafo no dɛ,
Hom nyim dɛ aka nda ebien ma apaho no edu, na woribeyi nyimpa Ba no ama, ma wɔaabɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Nna asɔfompayin nye ɔman mpanyimfo no kehyiaa ɔsɔfopanyin a wɔfrɛ no Caiaphas n'aban mu,
na wotuu egyina mbrɛ wɔnam nyansa mu bɛkyer Jesus eku no.
Na wɔsee dɛ, nnyɛ afahyɛ mu bi a, amma wentwiwentwi aammba ɔman mu.
Na Jesus wɔ Bethany Simon kwatanyi no fie no,
ɔbaa bi a ɔdze ngohuam a ɔsom bo alabastron-toa mã baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔtse edzidzi no, obohuei guu n'etsifi.
Na esuafo no hunii no, wonyaa ebufuw na wɔsee dɛ. Adzesɛɛ yi ase nye dɛn?
Nkyɛ wɔbɔton ngohuam yi agye pii na wɔdze akyɛ ehiafo.
