Na Jesus tsee no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na hom rehaw ɔbaa no? Na ɔayɛ edwuma pa wɔ mo ho.
Na hom wɔ ehiafo wɔ hom nkyɛn daa; na emidze, hom nnyi me daa.
Na dɛ oehue ngohuam yi egu me nyimpadua do yi, ɔayɛ ama m’esiei.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, beebiara a wɔbɛkã asɛmpa yi wɔ wiadze nyina mu no, dza ɔbaa yi ayɛ so wɔbɛkã dze ayɛ ne nkaa.
Nna duebien no mu kor a wɔfrɛ no Judas Iscariot no kɔr asɔforapanyin no hɔ,
na ɔkɛsee hɔn dɛ, Hom bɛma me bɛn ma meeyi no mama hom? Na wokeer ndwetɛbona eduasa maa no.
Na ofitsi aber no, ɔhwehwɛɛ mbrɛ obenya kwan eyi no ama.
Na epitsi da a odzi kan no esuafo no baa Jesus nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, hen na epɛ dɛ yesiesie ma ikedzi apaho no?
Na ɔsee dɛ, hom nkɔ kurow no mu osimesi no hɔ, na hom nkɛse no dɛ, kyerɛkyerɛfo no se, me ber abɛn: wo fie na menye m’esuafo bedzi apaho no.
Na esuafo no kɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Jesus hyɛɛ hɔn no na wosiesiee apano no.
Na odur ewimbir no, ɔnye esuafo duebien no bɛtsenaa edzidzi.
Na woridzidzi no, ɔsee dɛ, nokwar mese hom dɛ, hom mu baako beyi me ama.
Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn awerɛhow pii, na wɔhyɛɛ ase see no nkorkor dɛ, Ewuradze, ana emi a?
Na obuae see dɛ, nyia ɔnye me to nsa wɔ ɔsɛn no mu no, ɔnoara na obeyi me ama.
Na nyimpa Ba no rokɔ, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ no ho: Na nyimpa no a, nkyɛ oye ma no.
Na Judas a oriyi no ama no buae see dɛ, kyerɛkyerɛfo, ana emi a? Ɔsee no dɛ, Akã.
Na woridzidzi no, Jesus faa paanoo na ohyiraa do na obubui, na ɔdze maa n'esuafo no na ɔsee dɛ, hom ngye ndzi: Iyi nye me nyimpadua.
Na ɔfaa kuraba, na ɔdaa ase, na ɔdze maa hɔn dɛ, hom nyinara nnom bi:
na iyi nye mo bɔgyaa a ɔyɛ ahyɛmu no dze a dodowara ntsi woruhue egu ama bɔnfafir.
Na mese hom dɛ, ofitsi ndɛ, moronnom wenyinaba yi bio dze ekesi da no a menye hom bɔnom no fofor wɔ m’Egya ahenman no mu.
Na wɔtoow ndwom no, wofiir edzi kɔr Ngo Bepɔw no do.
Nna Jesus see hɔn dɛ, mo ho bɛyɛ hom nyina fintsidua anago yi: Na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, mobɔbɔ oguanhwɛfo no, na kuw no mu nguan nyina abɔ apetse.
Naaso me nyan ekyir no mibedzi hom enyim akɔ Galilee.
Na Peter buae see no dɛ, sɛ wo ho bɛyɛ hɔn nyina fintsidua a, emidze, ɔnnkeyɛ me fintsidua.
Jesus see no dɛ, nokwar mese wo dɛ, Anago yi, ansaana akokɔ bɔbɔn no, ebɛpa me mprɛnsa.
Peter see no dɛ, sɛ menye wo bowu mpo a, meremmpa wo da; na dɛmara na hɔn nyina so kãe.
Nna Jesus nye hɔn baa beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Gethsemane, na ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, hom ntsena ha ma monkɔ noho monkɔsɔr.
Na ɔfaa Peter nye Zebedee mba beenu no kaa no ho, na no werɛ hyɛɛ ase howee, na ɔbɔmee.
Nna ɔsee hɔn dɛ, me kra awerɛhow ahyɛ no do dze kɔ owu mu: Hom ntsena ha na hom nye me nweɔn.
Na ɔkɔr enyim kakra na ɔdze n’enyim kobutuwii, na ɔsɔɔr dɛ, Egya, sɛ ɔbɛyɛ a, ma kuraba yi mpa mo ho nkɔ: Naaso nnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ mepɛ bi a, na mbrɛ ɔwo epɛ a.
Na ɔbaa esuafo no nkyɛn, na obohun dɛ wɔdeda, na ɔsee Peter dɛ, Aso hom enntum nye me annweɔn dɔnhwer kor?
Hom nweɔn na hom nsɔr, mma hom aannkɔ nsɔhwɛ mu: Sunsum pɛ dze.na hɔnam yɛ mberɛw.
Bio, ɔkɔr ne mpɛn ebien kɔsɔɔr dɛ, m’Egya, sɛ kuraba yi nnkɛpa mo ho akɔ gyedɛ monom a, wo pɛ nyɛ hɔ.
Na ɔbae no, obohun dɛ wɔdeda bio, osiandɛ hɔn enyiwa akom.
Na ogyaa hɔn hɔ kɔr bio kɔsɔɔr ne mprɛnsa kãa asɛm kor no ara.
Nna ɔbaa esuafo no nkyɛn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nda dza aka yi, na hom nhom: Hwɛ, dɔn no abɛn, na nyimpa. Ba woeyi no ahyɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo nsa.
Hom nsoɛr ma yɛnkɔ: hwɛ, nyia oyi me ma no abɛn.
Na ɔda do rekasa no, hwɛ, Judas a ɔyɛ duebien no mu baako no, bae, na nyimpadodow pii a wɔdzedze nkrantsee nye mpɔtsibaa fi asɔfompanyin nye ɔman mu mpanyimto no hɔ ka no ho.
Na nyia oyii no mae no maa hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze dɛ, nyia mibefew n’ano no, ɔno nye no: hom nkyer no.
Na ntsɛmara ɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn na ɔsee dɛ, kyerɛkyerɛfo, abao! Na ofeew n’ano.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Damfo, yɛ dza ɔnam do ma aba. Nna wɔbae dze hɔn nsa bosusuoo no mu, na wɔkyekyeer no.
Na hwɛ, hɔn a wɔnye Jesus nam no mu baako tseen ne nsa twee ne nkrantsee, na ɔdze bɔɔ ɔsɔfopanyin no n’akowaa n’aso twae.
Nna Jesus see no dɛ, fa wo nkrantsee hyɛ ne hyɛbea bio, na hɔn a wɔfa nkrantsee nyina, nkrantsee anomu na wɔbɛhera.
Ana edwen dɛ munntum mennserɛ m'Egya ma mprɛmprɛ ara ɔnnsoma abɔfo a wɔbɔbor asafokuw duebien?
Na ɔnodze, kyerɛwnsɛm no bɛyɛ dɛn aba mu dɛ otwar dɛ ɔyɛ dɛm?
Dɔn no ara mu na Jesus see nyimpadodow no dɛ, ana hom firii baa mo do dɛ owifo do, na hom dze nkrantsee nye mpɔtsibaa bɛkyer me yi? Daa metse asɔrfi mu mekyerɛkyerɛ no, hom an nkyer me.
Na yinom nyina yɛe ma nkɔnhyɛfo no kyerɛwnsɛm no aaba mu. Nna esuafo no nyina gyaa no hɔ, na woguanee.
Na hɔn a wɔkyeer Jesus no dze no kɔr Caiaphas asɔfopanyin no kyɛn. Mbrɛ kyerɛwfo nye mpanyimfo no ehyia.
Na Peter dzii n'ekyir wɔ ekyirkyir dze kodur ɔsɔfopanyin n'abanguado, na ɔkɛhɛɛn mu nye asomfo no kɛtsenaa hɔ dɛ ɔrohwɛ ewie no.
Na asɔfompanyin nye baguafo no nyina hwehwɛɛ Jesus ho dasekrum dze eku no:
Na adasetorfo pii naaso woennya bi. Na ekyir no beenu bae.
Na wɔsee dɛ, Oyi kãa dɛ, mubotum medwuruw Nyankopɔn asɔrdan no na mesi no ndaasa.
Na ɔsɔfopanyin no gyinae na ɔsee no dɛ immbua bi? Ebɛnadze na yinom ridzi dase wɔ wo ho yi?
Na Jesus muaa n'ano. Na ɔsɔfopanyin no see no dɛ, mekã tsease Nyankopɔn dɛ sɛ ɔwo nye Christ no, Nyankopɔn ba no a, kã kyerɛ hen.
Jesus see no dɛ. Akã eso mese wo dɛ. Ofi ndɛ hom bohu nyimpa Ba no dɛ ɔtse ahoɔdzen nsa nyimfa na ɔreba wɔ sor nsuwusiw do.
Nna ɔsɔfopanyin no sunsuaan n'atar mu na ɔsee dɛ, ɔakã ebususɛm: Ebɛn hia na ohia hɛn adasefo bio? Hwɛ afei hom atse ebususɛm no:
hom dwen dɛn? Wobuae see dɛ ɔsɛ owu.
Nna wohinaa n’enyi do ntafi na wɔbobɔɔ no ekutuku, na binom so bobɔɔ no asotɔr dɛ,
Christ, hyɛ nkɔm: Woana na ɔbɔɔ wo?
Na Peter dze, ɔtse abangua no do hɔ; na abaawa bi baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, ɔwo so enye Jesus Galilee-ny no nam.
Na ɔsanee wɔ hɔn nyina enyim dɛ, minnyim dza erekã yi.
Na ofiir edzi kɔr paado no, abaawa bi so hun no, na ɔsee hɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ no dɛ, oyi so nye Jesus Nazarethnyi no nam.
Na bio ɔdze ntam saan dɛ, minnyim nyimpa no.
Na ɔkyɛɛr kakra no hɔn a wogyina hɔ no bae bɛsee Peter dɛ, ampa dɛ ifi hɔn mu, na wo kasaa yi wo edzi.
Nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii nsew na ɔkekãa ntam dɛ, minnyim nyimpa no. Na ntsɛmara na akokɔ bɔnee.
Na Peter kãa Jesus asɛm a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, ansaana akokɔ bɔbɔn no, ebɛpa me mprɛnsa. Na ofiir edzi, na okosūu pii.
27: Na adze kyee no, asɔfompanyin nye ɔman mpanyimfo no nyina faa Jesus ho apam dɛ woboku no.
Na wɔkyekyeer no dze no kɔree kɛhyɛɛ ambrado Pilate nsa.
Nna Judas a oyii no mae no, ohun dɛ woebu no fɔ no, ɔfee noho ekyir, na ɔdze ndwetɛbona eduasa no brɛɛ asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo no dɛ.
Mayɛ bɔn dɛ meyi bɔgya a onndzi fɔ mama. Na wɔsee dɛ, ɔfa hɛn ho bɛn? Woara hwɛ.
Na ɔtoow ndwetɛbona no guu asɔrdan no mu, na osii mu kɔree kɛsɛɛn ne men.
Na asɔfompanyin no faa ndwetɛbona no na wɔsee dɛ, ɔmmfa mbra mu dɛ wɔdze to ayɛyɛdze-adaka no mu, osiandɛ ɔyɛ bɔgya ho bo.
Na wɔfaa apam, na wɔdze gyee ɔwemfo asaase no, ma woeesie ahɔho wɔ mu.
Dɛm ntsi asaase no, wɔfrɛ no bɔgya asaase dze bodu ndɛ.

Nna dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah kãe no baa mu dɛ, na wɔfaa ndwetɛbona eduasa no, nyia wodzii no tsir bo no no bo a Israelmba mu binom twae no, 1O. na wɔdze gyee ɔwemfo asaase no! Dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ me no.
Na Jesus gyinaa ambrado no enyim; na ambrado no bisaa no dɛ, ana Jewfo Hen nye wo? Na Jesus see no dɛ, Akã.
Na asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo no tõatoaa no no, oemmbua hwee.
Nna Pilate see no dɛ, ana enntse ndzɛmba pii a woridzi wo ho dase tsia wo yi?
Na oemmbua no asɛm kor ho mpo, ma ɔyɛɛ ambrado no nwanwa kɛse.
Na afahyɛ du a, ambrado no tɔ dɛ ogyaa daduanyi kor a wɔpɛ ma nyimpadodow.
Na wɔwɔ daduanyi bi a ɔwɔ dzin a wɔfrɛ no Barabbas.
Dɛm ntsi wobehyiae no, Pilate see hɔn dɛ, woana na hom pɛ dɛ migyaa no mema hom? Barabbas anaa Jesus a wɔfrɛ no Christ no a?
Na onyim dɛ enyitan ntsi na woyii no mae.
Na ɔtse atsɛmbu egua do no, ne yer somaa bi wɔ ne nkyɛn dɛ, mma ennye nyimpa tsenenee no nndzi asɛm bi, na ne ntsi mebu amandze pii wɔ adaaso mu ndɛ.
Na asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo no tuu nyimpadodow no aso sumae dɛ wombisa Barabbas, na wɔnsɛɛ Jesus.
Na ambrado no buae see hɔn dɛ, hɔn beenu yi mu woana na hom pɛ dɛ migyaa no ma hom? Wɔsee dɛ, Barabbas a.
Pilate see hɔn dɛ, na Jesus a wɔfrɛ no Christ no, menyɛ no dɛn? Hɔn nyina see dɛ, ma wɔmbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, ebɛn bɔn na ɔayɛ? Na wɔtsēatseaa mu mbordo dɛ, ma wɔmbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Na Pilate hun dɛ onntum nnyɛ ho hwee, na mbom wentwiwentwi reba no, ɔfaa nsu hohoor ne nsa ho wɔ nyimpadodow no enyim see dɛ, Minndzi sõ wɔ nyimpa tsenenee yi no bɔgyaa ho: homara hom nhwɛ.
Na ɔman no nyina buae see dɛ, no bɔgyaa ngu hɛn nye hɛn mba etsifi.
Nna ogyaa Barabbas maa hɔn, na Jesus dze, ɔkaa no mpire no, oyii no mae dɛ wɔnkɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Nna ambrado no no nsordaafo no faa Jesus kɔr ambrado aban hu nɔ, na wohyiahyiaa nsordaafo-kuw no nyina baa ne nkyɛn.
Na wɔpɔɔr n'atar, na wɔdze atar memen hyɛɛ no,
na wɔween nsoɛ katraka dze hyɛɛ ne tsir, na wɔdze ndzɛmbir hyɛɛ ne nsa nyimfa mu, na wobuu ntwɛr wɔ n'enyim, na wosii no atwetwe dɛ, Jewfo Hen, abao!
na wohinahinaa ntafi guu no do, na wɔgyee ndzɛmbir no na wɔdze bɔɔ n’etsifi.
Na wowiee no atwetwe si no, wɔpɔɔr atar no wɔ no ho, na wɔdze nankasa n’atar hyɛɛ no, na wɔdze no kɔree dɛ wɔrokɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Na worifir edzi no, wohun Cyrenenyi bi a ne dzin dze Simon: Ɔno na wɔhyɛɛ no dɛ ɔnsoa ne mbeamudua no nye hɔn nkɔ.
Na wokodur beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Golgotha, ɔnye dɛ Nyitsir-do no,
wɔmaa no wenyin a wɔdze bɔwema afora mu dɛ ɔnnom; na ɔkãa n’ano no ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔnom.
Na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no, wɔtwee tonto kyɛɛ n’atar;
na wɔtsenatsenaa ase weɔɔn no wɔ hɔ.
Na wɔdze n’ewusi a wɔkyerɛwee no faam n’etsifi dɛ, OYI NYE JESUS JEWFO HEN NO
Nna wɔbɔɔ edwotwafo beenu mbeamudua mu kaa no ho, ɔbaako wo n’enyimfa, ɔbaako wɔ n'abankum.
Na hɔn a worutwa mu no dzii no nsɛmbɔn, na wɔwosowosoow hɔn tsir
see dɛ, ɔwo a idwuruw asɔrdan no na isi no ndaansa, gye woho; sɛ eyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba no a, fi mbeamudua ho si famu ɛ!
Dɛmara so na asɔfompanyin no sii no atwetwe, wɔnye kyerɛwfo nye mpanyimfo no, see dɛ,
ɔgyee binom: onntum nngye nankasa noho. Ɔno nye Israel Hen no: Wɔmma omfi mbeamudua no ho nsi famu, na yɛbɛgye no edzi.
Ɔdze noho tweer Nyankopɔn: Sɛ ɔpɛ no a, wɔmma ɔngye no. Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn Ba nye me.
Dɛmara na edwotwafo no so a wɔbɔɔ hɔn nye no mbeamudua mu no wɔyaaw no.
Na ofi dɔn a otsīa esia no, sum hyɛɛ asaase nyina do kesii dɔn a otsīa akron no do.
Na bɛyɛ dɔn a otsīa akron no do no, Jesus dze ndze kɛse kaa mu dɛ, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? Ɔno nye dɛ, Me Nyankopɔn, me Nyankopɔn, ɔyɛ dɛn na apa me yi?
Na hɔn a wogyinaa hɔ binom tsee no, wɔsee dɛ, oyi refrɛ Elijah.
Na ntsɛmara hɔn mu baako tuu mbirika kɛfaa posaa dze kɔbɔɔ wenyin yerɛyerɛw mu, na ɔdze tuaa ndzɛmbir ano maa no dɛ ɔnnom.
Na nkaa no see dɛ, gyaa ma yɛnhwɛ dɛ Elijah bɛba abɛgye no anaa.
Na Jesus dze ndze kɛse kaa mu bio no, ogyaa no sunsum mu.
Na hwɛ, asɔrdan no mu ntwamutam no tseew ebien fi sor besi ase, na asaase wosowee, na abotan paapaae,
na ahotseweefo a wɔadeda dodowara hɔn efun nyanyanee,
na wofi nda no mu puepuei wɔ ne nyan no ekyir no, wɔkɔr kurow krɔnkrɔn no mu keyii hɔnho kyerɛɛ dodowara.
Na ɔhamupanyin no nye hɔn a wɔka no ho roweɔn Jesus no hun asaasewosow no nye ndzɛmba a ɔyɛe no, wosuroo pii na wɔsee dɛ, ampaara Nyankopɔn Ba nye yi.
Na mbaa dodowara wɔ hɔ a wogyinaa ekyir hwɛe, hɔn na wɔkaa Jesus do fiir Galilee na wɔsoom no;
na Mary Magdalene, nye James nye Joses hɔn nã Mary, nye Zebedee mba hɔn nã wɔ hɔn mu.
Na odur ewimbir no, ɔhonyanyi bi a ofi Arimathæa a wɔfrɛ no Joseph a noara so yɛ Jesus no suanyi bae;
ɔno na ɔkɔr Pilate hɔ kɛserɛɛ Jesus no fun. Nna Pilate hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa mma no.
Na Joseph faa fun no dze bobɔɔw ndwera a n’enyi tsew mu,
Na ɔdze too nankasa ne nda fofor a otwaa no ɔbotan mu no mu, na opireew obo kɛse hiin nda no ano, na ɔkɔree.
Na Mary Magdalene nye Mary baako no wɔ hɔ, wɔtsenatsena nda no enyim.
Na adze kyee a ɔyɛ da a odzi Ahosiesieda no ekyir no, asɔfompanyin nye Phariseefo no behyiae wɔ Pilate nkyɛn
bɛsee dɛ, yewura, yɛkaa dɛ daadaafo no tse ase no, ɔkãa dɛ, ndaansa mibenyan.
Dɛm ntsi kã ma wɔnkɛhyɛ nda no nsew nkodu da a otsīa ebiasa no, amma n'esuafo aammba emmbowia no, na wɔaannse ɔman no dɛ, oenyan efi ewufo mu; ɔno ekyir mfom no bɛsen kan dze no.
Pilate see hɔn dɛ, hom wɔ aweɔmfo: Hom nkɔ nkɛhyɛ nsew dɛ mbrɛ hom botum.
Na wɔkɔree, na wɔkɛhyɛɛ nda no nsew: Wɔsɔɔw ɔbo no ano, na aweɔmfo no ka hɔn ho.
28: Na ahomgyeda sae a da a odzi dapɛn no kan no enyim retsetsew no, Mary Magdalene nye Mary baako no baa dɛ wɔrobɔhwɛ nda no.
Na hwɛ, asaase wosoow kɛse, na Ewuradze bɔfoe fi sor sianee na ɔbae bepireew ɔbo no fii nda no ano, na ɔtsenaa do.
Na no ho tse dɛ enyinam, na n’efuradze hoa dɛ esukwankyɛba.
Na no ho hu ntsi hɔn a wɔroweɔn no ho popoe na wɔyɛɛ dɛ ewufo.
Na ɔbɔfo no buae see mbaa no dɛ, mma hom nnsuro, na minyim dɛ hom rohwehwɛ Jesus a wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no.
Onnyi ha: Na ɔasoɛr dɛ mbrɛ ɔkãe no: Hom mbra mbɔhwɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze dae.
Na hom nkɔ ntsɛm nkɛkã nkyerɛ n’esuafo no dɛ, ɔasoɛr efi ewufo mu; na hwɛ, oedzi hom enyim kɔ Galilee: Hɔ na hom bohu no; hwɛ, makã akyerɛ hom.
Na wofiir edzi ntsɛm fii nda no ho dze suro ɔnye dɛw kɛse tutuu mbirika dɛ wɔrekɛkã akyerɛ n’esuafo no.
Na hwɛ, Jesus hyiaa hɔn see hɔn dɛ, Abao! Na wɔbaa bososuoo n’anan mu, na wɔkotoow no.
Nna Jesus see hɔn dɛ, mma hom nnsuro; hom nkɔ nkɛkã nkyerɛ mo nuanom dɛ wɔnkɔ Galilee, na hɔ na wobohu me.
Na wɔrokɔ no, hwɛ, aweɔmfo no mu binom baa kurow no mu bɛkãa ndzɛmba a ɔyɛe no nyina kyerɛɛ asɔfompanyin no.
Na wɔnye mpanyimfo no hyiae na wɔfaa apam no, wɔmaa nsordaafo no sika kɛse,
na wɔsee dɛ, hom nkã dɛ, anago a yɛdae no na n’esuafo bae bowiaa no.
Na sɛ iyi du ambrado asomu a, yebotu n’aso esuma, na yɛamma annyɛ hom do asɛm.
Na wɔgyee sika no, na wɔkɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn no; na asɛm yi tahyee wɔ Jewfo mu dze bodu ndɛ.
Na esuafo dubiako no sii mu kɔr Galilee, wɔ kokwaa a Jesus kyerɛɛ hɔn no do.
Na wohun no no, wɔkotoow no; na binom gyee ekyingye.
Na Jesus bɛkasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, wɔdze sor nye asaase do turn nyina ama me.
Dɛm ntsi hom nkɔ nkɛyɛ amanaman nyina m esuafo, na hom nnuma hɔn nhyɛ Egya, nye ɔba, nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn dzin mu,
na hom nkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn dɛ wondzi dza mahyɛ hom nyina do: Na hwɛ, menye hom wɔ hɔ daa, dze kesi wiadze ewiei.

1: Ewuradze n'asɛm a ɔbaa Morashnyi Micah hɔ wɔ Judah ahemfo Jotham, Ahaz, na Hezekiah ber mu, dza ohunii wɔ Samaria na Jerusalem ho no.
Aman, hom nyina hom ntsie; asaase na dza ɔwɔ mu nyina, hom nkyɛn aso; na Ewuradze Nyankompɔn ndzi dase ntsia hom; Ewuradze a ofi n'asɔrdan krɔnkrɔn mu no.
Na, hwɛ, Ewuradze fi ne tsenabea epue, na obesian, na oebetsiatsia asaase nsorɔnsorɔmbea do.
Na mbepɔw bɛnan wɔ n'ase, ma mbɔnsa bɛpaapaa, dɛ mbrɛ hua nan wɔ gya enyim, dɛ nsu a woehue egu mbrɛ ɔyɛ mpatantwer.
Iyi nyina Jacob mbrato ntsi a, na Israel fi ne ndzebɔn ntsi a. Jacob mbrato nye mmuana? Ana nnyɛ Samaria a? Na Judah nsorɔnsorɔmbea nye mmuana? Ana nnyɛ Jerusalem a?
Dɛm ntsi mebɛyɛ Samaria dɛ hamu abokuw, na dɛ wenyin ture ntsetsɛwee: Na mubohue n'abo no megu bɔnsa no mu, na meyi ne fapem ato gua.
Na n'eguehonyi nyina wobobubu no pɔsɔpɔsɔ, na wɔdze gya ahyew n'apɛdze nyina, na mayɛ n'abosom nyina afoafo osiandɛ edwanman apɛdze na ɔdze aboa ano, na edwaman apɛdze na ɔbɛsan akɛyɛ.
Iyi ntsi na mubosū na metwa ewuo, na mibedzi kwatserkwa na adagyaw: Mubosū dɛ mpataku, na medzi nkɔmbɔ dɛ nsorhor.
Na n'epirakur ayɛ koannkɔ: Na oebodu Judah; oebodu me man abobokɛse ano, edu Jerusalem.
Mma hom nnkã no wɔ Gath, mma hom nnsū koraa: Beth-el-Aphrah na medze moho epirepirew huntuma mu.
Shaphir ɔtsefo e, twa mu kɔ wɔ adagyaw na enyito mu oo: Zaanan ɔtsefo mmpuei mmbae. Beth-ezel ewuotwa bɛma n'egyinae abɔ hom.
Na Maroth ɔtsefo rotweɔn papa ahomtsew mu: Osiandɛ mbusu fi Ewuradze hɔ aba Jerusalem abobokɛse mu.
Lachish ɔtsefo e, fa tseaseanam no sē pɔnkɔ ɔhoɔharfo no oo: Ɔno nye Zion babaa no bɔn ahyɛse; osiandɛ wohun Isreal mbrato no wɔ wo mu.
Dɛm ntsi ebɛma Moresheth-gath nkradzi akyɛdze: Achzib efi bɛyɛ ndaadaadze ama Israel ahemfo.
Mareshah ɔtsefo e, medze nyia ɔbɛfa wo ayɛ enyadze no bɛbrɛ wo oo: Isreal enyimnyam bɛba araa ebodu Adullam.
Yɛ etsipaa, na yi wo ho nhwi wɔ w'enyigye mba ntsi: Ma w'etsipaa ntserɛw dɛ ɔpɛtɛkwaakye dze; na woefi wo nkyɛn kɔ ndɔmmum.
2: Wondue! Hɔn a wɔhyehyɛ emumuyɛ wɔ tsirmu na wɔyɛ mbusu ho edwuma wɔ hɔn mpa do! Anapa yɛ kann a, nna wɔayɛ, osiandɛ ɔwɔ hɔn nsa no tum mu.
Na hɔn enyi ber akwã, na wohwinhwim; na efi, na wɔfefa: Na wosi nyimpa na ne fi apempem, mekyerɛ nyimpa na n'egyapadze.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Hwɛ, morodwendwen ebusua yi ho mbusu a hom runntum nnyi hom kɔn mmfi mu, eso hom runntum nnkyea ahopɔw mu; na ɔyɛ ber bɔn.
Da no mu na wobobu hom ho bɛ, na woetwa ewuo yayaw, na wɔase dɛ, wɔasɛɛ hɛn koraa: Ɔasakyer me nkyɛn a! Etuatsewfo na ɔkyɛ hɛn akwã ma hɔn.
Dɛm ntsi innkenya obi a ɔtow susuhoma wɔ wo kyɛfa do wɔ Ewuradze mboianofo no mu.
Mma hom nnhyɛ nkɔm, mbrɛ wɔkekã nye yi. Wɔrennkekã nnkyerɛ iyinom: Ahorohoraa rimmfi hɔ.
Ao Jacob fi, aso wɔbɛkã no dɛ, aso Ewuradze no sunsum etwa sin? Aso yinom nye ne nyɛe? Aso me nsɛm nnyɛ yie mma nyia ɔnantsew tɔɔtsenn?
Na ndaansa yi mu yi, me man asoɛr dɛ ɔtamfo: Hom yi egugudo no fi hɔn a wɔnam dwudwoodwo dɛ wɔmmpɛ kõ bi akõ no hɔn ntar do.
Hom apam me man mu mbaa efi hɔn adan fɛɛfɛw no mu; hom apa m'enyimnyam efi hɔn mbɔtowaba ho koraa.
Hom nsoɛr, na hom nkɔ; na nnyɛ hom ahomgyebea bi nye ha: Osian efifidze a ɔdze ɔsɛɛ yerɛyerɛw ba no ntsi.
Sɛ obi a ɔnam akɔhwi sunsum mu dzi ator, dɛ, mebɛhyɛ wo wenyin na nsadzen ho nkɔm a; ɔnoara na ɔbɛyɛ ɔman yi nkɔnhyɛnyi.
Ao Jacob, mobɔboa wodze nyina ano ampaara; ampaara mibehyiahyia Isreal nkaa no; mebɛka hɔn abɔ mu dɛ Bozrah nguan edzidzibea mu, nna nyimpa no dodow no ntsi, wɔbɛyɛ dede weɔɔ.
Obubufo no edzi hɔn enyim kan: Woetwa mu abɛsen kɔ abobokɛse no ano, na dzi hɔn enyim, na Ewuradze dzi hɔn tsir.
3: Na mesee dɛ, hom ntsie, meserɛ hom, hom Jacob etsitsir, na Isreal fie mpanyimfo: Aso ɔnnyɛ hom asɛm dɛ hom bohu atsɛmbu?
Hɔn a wɔtan papa, na wɔdɔ bɔn; hɔn a wogua hɔn mbiew ho;
hɔn a wodzi me man hɔn wer fi hɔn ho, na hɔn nam fi hɔn mbiew: Na wɔdɔ no epruw dɛ kutu mu adze, na dɛ nam a ɔwɔ dadzesɛn mu.
Ɔno na wobosū afrɛ Ewuradze, na ɔnnkɛgye hɔn do: Ɛhɛɛ, ɔdze n'enyim bosuma hɔn ber no, dɛ mbrɛ wɔayɛ emumuyɛ wɔ hɔn nyɛe mu no.
Dɛm na Ewuradze kã tsia nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔma me man fom no; na wɔdze hɔn sē ka na wɔtsēatsea mu dɛ, asomdwee oo; na obirara aɔnnhyɛ hɔn anomu no, wɔkyer no ho ɔsa mpo:
Dɛm ntsi adze bɛsã hom, dɛ hom nnkenya enyido-adzehu; na sum bɛgye hom, dɛ hom nnkɛhyɛ nkɔm; na wi bɔtɔ nkɔnhyɛfo no do, na adzekyee bɛyɛ katoo wɔ hɔn do.
Na adzehufo enyi bɔto, na nkɔnhyɛfo enyim egu ase; ɛhɛɛ, hɔn nyinara bɛkatakata hɔn ano: Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn mbuae bi nnyi hɔ.
Na emidze, tum nam Ewuradze no sunsum do ahyɛ me mã ara ampa, na atsɛmbu, na mbanyinndam, dɛ menda Jacob ne mbrato, na Isreal no bɔn edzi nkyerɛ hɔn.
Hom ntsie yi, meserɛ hom, hom Jacob fie etsitsir, na Isreal fie mpanyimpa, hom a hom kyir atsɛmbu, na hom kyea asɛntsenenee.
Wɔdze bɔgya kyekyer Zion, na wɔdze emumuyɛ kyekyer Jerusalem.
No mu etsitsir no bu atsɛn gye akatua, na no mu nkɔnhyɛfo hyɛ nkɔm gye sika: Naaso wɔdze hɔnho twer Ewuradze, na wɔse dɛ, ana nnyɛ Ewuradze na ɔwɔ hɛn do.
Dɛm ntsi wobofuntum zion dɛ kwã wɔ hom ntsi, na Jerusalem ayɛ ekurofõ, na ofie mbepɔw no ayɛ dɛ kwaa mu nsorɔnsorɔmbea.
4: Na ekyir nda no mu no ɔbɛba dɛ Ewuradze fie bepɔw no wɔdze betsim mbepɔw no etsifi, na wɔama no do abɔ akoko no do; na aman bɛpem aba mu.

Na amanaman pii bɔkɔ akɛse dɛ, hom mbra ma yɛnkɔ Ewuradze bepɔw no do, yɛnkɔ Jacob ne Nyankopɔn fie; na ɔbɛkyerɛ hɔn no kwan, na yɛanantsew n'atsempɔn mu: Na zion na mbra no befi aba, na Ewuradze n'asɛm efi Jerusalem.

Na obobua aman pii mu atsɛn, na ɔakã aman akɛse a ɔwɔ ekyirkyir no enyim; na wɔdze hɔn mfõwa bɔbobɔ nsɔw, na wɔdze hɔn mpeaa abobɔ ndar: Ɔman bi remma afõwa do nntsia ɔman bi, eso worunnsūa akodzi bio.
Na wɔbɛtsenatsena nyimpa biara wɔ no wenyindua na n'dɔmbadua ase; na obirinnyi hɔn hu: Na dɔm Ewuradze n'ano na ɔakã.
Na aman nyina bɛnantsew hɔn bosom dzin mu nkorkor, na hɛndze yɛbɛnantsew Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn ne dzin mu daa daa.
Da no mu no, Ewuradze na ɔse, mobɔboa osiifo no ano, na mehyia nyia wɔapam no no, na nyia mehiahia no ho no;
na mebɛma osiifo no ayɛ nkaase, na nyia wɔapam no kɔ ekyirkyir no ayɛ ɔman kɛse: Na Ewuradze bedzi hɔn do hen wɔ Zion bepɔw do, ofi ndɛ kesi daa.
Na ɔwo, mbowakuw abantsentsen, Zion babaa no kokoe, wo nkyɛn na ɔbɛba; ɛhɛɛ, tumdzi a odzi kan, Jerusalem babaa n'ahendzi no, ɔbɛba.
Na afie wɔyɛ no dɛn na etsēatsea mu dzendzen yi? Ana ɔhen bi nnyi wo mu, ana wo pamfo ahera, na ogyam ekitsa wo dɛ ɔbaa a ɔrokõ awoo yi?
Ao Zion babaa, kõ awoo na kyem,dɛ ɔbaa rokõ awoo: Na afei ibefi kurow no mu epue, na akɛtsena haban mu, na ekodu Babyion mpo; hɔ na wobeyi wo, hɔ na Ewuradze bɛgye wo efi w'atamfo nsamu.
Na afei amanaman pii asoɛr etsia wo, na wɔkã dɛ, wɔmma no ho ngu fi, na hɛn enyiwa nhu n'apɛdze wɔ Zion do.
Na wonnyim Ewuradze n'adwen, eso wɔnntse n'apam ase: Na ɔaboa hɔn ano dɛ efiefi a wɔdze rokɔ ewuporoweebea.
Ao Zion babaa, soɛr porow: Na mebɛyɛ w'ambɛn dadze, na mayɛ wo ntɔtse baron: Na ibobubu aman pii pɔsɔpɔsɔ: Na ibehyira hɔn ahonyadze do ama Ewuradze, na hɔn ahodze ama asaase nyina wura no.
5: Ao dɔmtukuw babaa, afei boa dɔmtukuw: Ɔakã hɛn ehin mu ehyia: Wɔdze abaa bobɔ Isreal tsɛmbufo ngyepi.
Na ɔwo, Beth-lehem Ephrathah wo a isuar dɛ ebɔfora Israel mpempem mu, wo mu na obi befir ama me, na oebedzi panyin wɔ Isreal do; no mpuei fir tsetse, ofir ɔdomankoma.
Dɛm ntsi obeyi hɔn ama no nuanom nkaase no bɛsan aba Isrealmba nkyɛn.
Na obegyina hɔ, na ɔanyɛn no nguankuw no wɔ Ewuradze n'ahoɔdzen mu, wɔ Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn no ne dzin tumdzi mu: Na wɔbɛtsena hɔ; osiandɛ ɔbɛyɛ kɛse ekesi asaase ewiei.
Na nyimpa yi na ɔbɛyɛ hɛn asomdwee: Na Assyrianyi ba hɛn asaase do, na otsiatsia hɛn ahemfi mu a, nna yɛbɛhyehyɛ nguanhwɛfo beesuon etsia no, na nyimpa etsitsir baawɔtwe.
Na wɔdze afõwa bɛyɛ Assyria asaase amamfõ, na Nimrod asaase no wɔ no mbobokɛse ano: Na ɔbɛgye hɛn efi Assyrianyi no bɛba hɛn asaase do, na oebetsiatsia hɛn he do no.
Na Jacob ne nkaase no ɔbɛyɛ dɛ ɔbɔsu a ofi Ewuradze hɔ wɔ amanaman pii mu, dɛ nkyɛkyɛr do nsupetsema a ɔnnhwɛ nyimpa bi kwan, eso ɔnntweɔn adasamba.
Na Jacob ne nkaase no bɛyɛ wɔ amanaman mu, wɔ aman pii mu, dɛ gyata wɔ hambowa mu, dɛ gyatafɔr wɔ nguan ekuwekuw mu: Ɔno a sɛ ɔhɛn mu a, otsiatsia do, na ɔtsetsew mu esinesin, na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔgye.
Ma wo nsa mma do wɔ w'ahohiahiafo do, na ma w'atamfo nyina tun ntwa.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no mu no, Ewuradze na ɔse, mubotwa wo mpɔnkɔ mefi wo finimfin, na masɛɛ wo ntseaseanam:
Na mubotwitwa w'asaase do nkurow no megu, na medwuruw w'aban dzendzen nyina:
Na mubotwitwa wo mbɔnsansɛm mefi wo nsamu; na innkenya sebramufo bio:
Na mubotwitwa w'eguehonyi na w'abosondum mefi wo finimfin; na ennkɔkotow asɔr wo nsaano edwuma bio.
Na mubotwitwa w'asherim mefi wo finimfin: Na masɛɛ wo nkurow.
Na mubotua amanaman a woenntsie no wer wɔ ebufum na ebufuhyew mu.
6: Afei hom ntsie dza Ewuradze se: Soɛr, dzi esi wɔ mbepɔw enyim, na ma nkoko no ntse wo ndze.
Hom mbepɔw, hom ntsie Ewuradze ne ham, na hom ntsie Ewuradze ne ham, na hom asaase mfapew a wɔwɔ hɔ daa no: Na Ewuradze nye ne man enya ham, na ɔnye Isreal beyi atsɛn.
Ao me man, mayɛ wo dɛn? Na mafona wo ebɛnadze mu? Dzi dzse tsia me ɛ.
Na emi na medze wo mifi Egypt asaase do bae, na mopoon wo mifii nkowaayɛ fi no mu; na mosomaa Moses, Aaron, na Miriam dzii w'enyim.
Ao me man, kaa egyina a Moabhen Balak tui, na dza Beor ba Balaam dze buaa no; kaa ofitsi Shittim kodu Gilgal, ma hom eehu Ewuradze ne ndzeyɛtsenenee.
Ebɛn na memfa mbra Ewuradze enyim, na mombɔkotow ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn no? Aso memfa ɔhyew-afɔr membra, ɔnye anantwimba a woedzi afe kor?
Aso Ewuradze n'enyi bɔsɔ ndwanyin mpempem, anaa ngo esutsen mpem du du? Aso memfa m'abakan mma wɔ me mbrato ntsi, mo honam mu aba memma wɔ me kra no bɔn ntsi?
Ao onyimpa, wɔakyerɛ wo dza oye; na wo hɔ, dɛ ebɛyɛ tsenenee na ebɔdɔ mbɔbɔrhu ara, na enye wo Nyankopɔn bɛnantsew ahobrɛadze mu?
Ewuradze ne ndze refrɛ kurow no, na onyansafo no bohu wo dzin: Hom ntsie abaa no, na nyia ɔahyɛ no.
Aso emumuyɛ akoradze wɔ emumuyɛ fi no mu, na annsõ esusudze aɔyɛ ekyiwadze no.
Aso emumuyɛ nsɛn na foto a nsisi abrambɔwɔ mu bɛtsew mo ho?
Osiandɛ emimdzi ahyɛ no mu ahonyafo na amaama, ma no mu atsefo no akã atofosɛm, na hɔn gyirama daadaa wɔ hɔn anomu.
Dɛm ntsi na mepira wo pira dzen; wo bɔn ntsi na mayɛ wo afoafo.
Ɔwo ibedzidzi, na eremmee; w'ahobrɛadze bɔko wo mu: Na ibeyi, na ennkɛfa no tɔtrɔtɔ akɔ; na dza edze bɔkɔ no, medze bɛma afõwa.
Ibodua, na innkobu: Ibetsiatsia ngoaba do, na ennkɛsera woho ngo; na wenyinaba do, na eronnom nsã.
Osiandɛ woedzi Omri ahyɛdze na Ahab fifo nyɛe nyina do, na hom nantsew hɔn apam mu: Ama maayɛ wo amamfõ, na hom aasoa me man n'ahorohoraa.
7: Mundue! Na mayɛ dɛ ɔpɛber eduaba a wɔatsew, dɛ wenyinaba mpɛpɛwdzi: Siaw a wodzi biara nnyi hɔ; mo kɔn adɔ adɔmba abakan beree.
Onyamesuronyi ahera asaase do, na obiara nntsen wɔ adasamba mu: Hɔn nyina tsetsɛw bɔgya; hɔn mu nyimpa biara sua no nua efir.
Hɔn nsa ebien nyina gu emumuyɛdze do dɛ wɔreyɛ no mbɔdzen do; safohen bisa, na tsɛmbuafo ayɛ krado regye akatua; na nyimpa kɛse no, ɔkã ne kra no mbusupɛ: Mbrɛ wɔbɔ mu wen nye yi.
Hɔn mu dza oye kyɛn biara tse dɛ ohwirom: Tɔɔtsennyɛnyi biara a ɔkyɛn no, omuo sen nsoɛban: W'aweɔmfo da no, wo sera da no, aba; afei na hɔn basabasayɛ bɛba.
Mma mmfa wo werɛ nntwer ɔnyɛnko, mma mmfa woho nndan ɔnyɛnko berɛbo: Weɔn w'ano wɔ ɔbaa a ɔda wo bo mu no ho.
Na ɔbabanyin sesar n'egya, ɔbabaa soɛr hyɛ n'asew do; nyimpa n'atamfo nye nankasa ne fienyimpa.
Na emidze, Ewuradze na mobɔhwɛ no kwan; mobɔtweɔn mo nkwagye Nyankopɔn: Me Nyankopɔn betsie me.
Ao me tamfo, mma nndzi me eduwa: Sɛ mohwe ase a, mobɔsoɛr; sɛ metse sum mu a, Ewuradze bɛyɛ kan ama me.
Mobɔsoa Ewuradze n'ebufuhyew no, osiandɛ mayɛ bɔn etsia no; ekodu dɛ obedzi m'asɛm ama me, na oebua me atsɛn: Ɔdze me bɛba kan mu, na mahwɛ ne tsenenee no.
Nna me tamfo bohu, na enyito akata no do; ɔno a ɔsee me dɛ, Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn no wɔ henfa? M'enyiwa bohu no; afie na wobetsiatsia no do dɛ abrɔn mu dɛtse.
Da a wɔdze tow w'afasu! Da no mu na mom no bɔkɔ ekyirkyir.
Da no mu no wobefi Assyira na Egypt nkurow mu ebodu wo nkyɛn, na woefi Egypt araa ekodu esutsen no ho, na wofi po ho akɔ po ho, na wofi bepɔw ho akɔ bepɔw ho.
Naaso asaase no bɛyɛ amamfõ osian no mu atsefo no ntsi, wɔ hɔn nyɛe no nsowee ntsi.
Fa wo poma nyɛn wo man, w'egyapadze mbowakuw a wɔabɔ kɔnn tse kwaa mu wɔ Carmel etsifi no: Ma wondzidzi wɔ Bashan na Gilead dɛ tsetse nda no mu.
Mebɛma oehu anwanwadze dɛ nda a ifii Egypt bae no.
Amanaman bohu na hɔn enyi atõ hɔn mbanyindze nyina ho: Wɔdze hɔn nsa botuatua hɔn ano, hɔn aso besisiw.
Wɔbɛtafer huntuma dɛ abowatsena; dɛ asaase mbowa a wɔtsen famu, na wɔdze ahohim befir hɔn dabew aba: Wɔdze suro bɛba Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na wɔabɔ hu wo ntsi.
Woana nye Onyame a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo a ɔdze emumuyɛ fir, na ɔpa n'egyapadze nkaa no hɔn mbrato ho?
Ɔbɛsan ebeya hɛn ho ayamuhyehye; ɔdze n'ananadze betsiatsia hɛn emumuyɛ do: Na ɔwo ebɔtow hɔn emumumyɛ do: Na ɔwo ebɔtom hɔn bɔn nyina egu po bun mu.
Ɔwo edze nokwar no bɛma Jacob, na edze mbɔbɔrhu ama Abraham, dɛ mbrɛ ekãa ntam kyerɛɛ hɛn egyanom fir tsetse nda mu no.

1: Nineveh ho atsɛmbusɛm. Elkoshnyi Nahum n'enyido-adze-hu nwoma.
Ewuradze yɛ Nyame nyinkufo a odzi wer; Ewuradze dzi wer na ebufuw ahyɛ no mã; Ewuradze dzi n'ahohiahiafo wer, na osie ebufuw ma n'atamfo.
Ewuradze fa ebufuw nyaa, na no tum sõ, na orummbu fɔdzinyi bem ara da: Ewuradze no kwan wɔ ekyinehyia-mframa no ehum mu, na nsuwusiw yɛ n'ananadze huntuma.
Ɔkã po enyim ma ɔwew; na ɔma esutsen nyina memem: Bashan na Carmel twintwam, na Lebanon nhyiren kyenkyen.
Mbepɔw wosow n'enyim, na akoko nan; na asaase puhuw noho wɔ n'enyim, ɛhɛɛ, wiadze, na hɔn a wɔtse mu nyina.
Woana botum n'ebufuhyew enyim gyina? Na woana na obotum n'ebufuw kuntann no mu tsena? N'enyiber ehue dɛ gya, na obubu abotan mu esinesin.
Ewuradze ye, ɔyɛ akodan wɔ ɔfona da mu; na onyim hɔn a wɔdze hɔn werɛ hyɛ no mu no.
Na ɔdze nsupramee bɛma ne sibea ahera na obetsiw n'atamfo akɔ sum mu.
Ebɛn na hom dwendwen tsia Ewuradze yi? Ɔbɛma oewie sã koraa: Ahohia ronnsoɛr mpɛn ebien.
Na sɛ wɔayɛ dɛ nsoɛ kantankantan, na wɔafɔw takaa wɔ hɔn nsanom mu mpo a, wɔbɛhyew wɔ hɔn koraa dɛ mburinan guanee.
Wo mu na obi a osusu Ewuradze ho mbusu, na ɔpam emumuyɛ ɔpam fir epue.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Sɛ wɔayeyɛ petsepetsee, na wɔdɔɔ sõ mpo a, dɛmara so na wobotwitwa hɔn egu, na oetwa mu akɔ. Sɛ mehiahia wo ho mpo a, mirinnhiahia wo ho bio.
Na afei mubobubu no kɔndua no mu mefi wo do, na matsetsew wo nkyehoma mu.
Na Ewuradze ahyɛ wo ho mbra, dɛ mma wonndua wo dzin bi bio: Mubotwitwa asen-ehonyi na egu-ehonyi mefi w'abosondan mu; mobɔbɔ wo da; osiandɛ wo ho yɛ nkɔw.
Hwɛ, hɔn a wɔdze nsɛmpa ba hɔn anan wɔ mbepɔw no do, hɔn a wɔdze asomdwee tahye! Ao Judah, dzi wo ndapɔn, ma w'anohobadze: Na omumuyɛfo no remmfa wo mu bio; woetwa no akyen koraa.
2: Nyia obubu mu pɔsɔpɔsɔ no afow aba w’enyim: Kora w’akodze do, sera kwan no do, mia w’asen mu, hyɛ w’ahoɔdzen mu dzen paara.
Na Ewuradze dze Jacob n’abɔsoyɛ reba bio, dɛ Israel abɔsoyɛ: Na atopamfo ato hɔn pan, na wɔasɛɛ hɔn wenyindua abaw.
N’akatakyi kyɛm ho aber, n’adɔm mbarimba efurafura serdaa: Ntseaseanam fram dadzegya wɔ n’ahosiesie da no mu, na wɔwosow mpeaa no ma ɔyɛ hu.
Ntseaseanam no egyim wɔ abrɔn mu, wɔsesɛ ho wɔ eguaber mu; hɔn hwɛbea tse dɛ ngyatsɛn, woguan dɛ enyinam.
Ɔkaa n’ekunyin: Wofintsiw hɔn nantsew mu; wɔyɛ har kɔ ne fasu no ho, na wosiesie akataso no.
Woebuebue esutsen ano mbobokɛse no, na ahemfi no edwuruw.
Na woɔda Huzzab edzi, wɔasoa no kɔ, na ne mbaawa dze mborɔnoma ndze si nkrum, wɔyan hɔn akoko.
Na Nineveh dze, ɔtse dɛ nsutaae fi ne tsetseberdo: Naaso woguan; wɔkeka mu dɛ, hom ngyina, hom ngyina; na obiara annhwɛ n’ekyir.
Hom mfa dwetɛ afo, hom mfa sika afo: Na akoradze nnyi ewiei adanmudze fɛɛfɛw nyina n’enyimnyam no.
Ɔatɔ pan, na ɔayɛ hahoo, na ɔayɛ afoafo: Na akoma nan, na anankoroma sesɛ ho, na hɔn asen nyina mu guan hɔn, na hɔn enyim nyinara atotow fitaa.
Ngyata bɔn no wɔ henfa, na ngyatafɔr no hɔn edzidzibea no, mbrɛ nkyɛ ogyatanyin na ogyataber, na ogyataba nantsew, na obi nnyi hɔn hu no?
Ogyata tsetseew dza ɔsõ ne mba mu esinesin, na okunsakunsae maa n’aber no, na ɔdze afonam hyɛɛ n’etu mã, na ɔdze ntsetsewee hyɛɛ n’abɔn mã.
Hwɛ, menye wo enya, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, na mebɛhyew wo ntseaseanam wɔ wusiw mu, na afõwa bedzi wo ngyatafɔr na mubotwitwa w'afonam mefi asaase do, na wɔrenntse w’abɔfoe ndze bio.
3: Bɔgya kurow no ndue! Atofosɛm na epoobɔsɛm ara na ahyɛ mu mã; afonam no mmfi mu.
Apɔnkɔbaa ne gyegye, na ntseaseanam anan ne kyirdidi; mpɔnkɔ hɔn kwam kwam tutu, na ntseaseanam hɔn ehuruhuruw;
ɔpɔnkɔdofo dze rokɔbɔ enyi, na afõwa rinyinam, na peaa reyerɛyerɛw; na atɔfo pii, na efun kuw kɛsenara: Na efun no wonnbu ewiei; wofintsifintsiw hɔn efun no do:
Ofir edwaman fɛɛfɛw, abayifo wuraba no, no ndwamansɛm dodow ntsi, ɔno a ɔdze ndwamansɛm tɔn amanaman, na ɔdze n’abayisɛm tɔn mbusua.
Hwɛ, menye wo enya, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, na mubobu w’asetam egu w’etsifi wɔ w'enyim, na mama amanaman ehu w'adagyaw, na ahenman ehu w’ahoto.
Na mobɔtow fi tantanntan megu wo do, na mama wo ho ayɛ nkɔw, na medze wo esi hɔ dɛ ahwɛdze.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ hɔn a wɔhwɛ wo nyina befi wo nkyɛn eguan, na wɔasɛ dɛ, Nineveh ayɛ ekurofõ: Woana na obedzi no nkɔmbɔ? Henfa na mobɔhwehwɛ akyekyewerɛ mama wo?
Aso ɔwo iye sen No-amon a osi esutsen ntamu a esu etwa no ho ehyia no; ne ban nye po, na po yɛ n’afasu no?
Ethiopia na Egypt nye n’ahoɔdzen, na onnyi mbanano; Put na Lubim nye n’aboafo.
Naaso wɔdze no kɔree, wɔfaa no kɔr ndɔmmum: Hɔn mbɔtowaba so wɔdze hɔn abobɔ abrɔn nyina etsifi: Na wɔtwe n’enyimnyamfo ho tonto, na ne nyimpa akɛse nyina wogugu mpokyerɛ mu.
Ɔwo so ebɔbow, ibosuma, ɔwo so ebɔhwehwɛ akobaa wɔ ɔtamfo no ntsi.
W’abankɛse nyinara bɛyɛ dɛ adɔmbandua no do wɔ adɔmbakan beree: Wɔwosow a, ɔtotɔ odzifo no n’anomu.
Hwɛ, wo mbarimba yɛ mbaa wɔ wo mu; woebuebue w’asaase no mbobokɛse no pataa ama w’atamfo: Gya ahyew w’abokɛse ekyir adaban.
Sesaw nsu sie ntuae no, miamia w’abankɛse no mu: Tsia dɛtse, na wɔw kaadow dɛtse, ma ntayaa fononoo no nyɛ dzen.
Hɔ na gya bɛmen wo; afõwa botwa wo akyen, ɔbɛmen wo dɛ nkonyinko: Ma wo dodow ndɔɔ sõ dɛ nkonyinko, na wo dodow ndɔɔ sõ dɛ mbɛbɛw.
Ama w’eguadzifo adɔɔ sõ asen ɔsor nworaba; nkonyinko fa afo, na otu kɔ.
Wo dɔm a wɔbobɔ abatsir tse dɛ mbɛbɛw, na w’asafohemfo tse dɛ mbɛbɛw mintsimintsi a wɔsensam ban ho wɔ awɔw da mu, na sɛ ewia fir a, wotu kɔ, na wonnhu fakor a wɔwɔ.
Ao Assyriahen, w’ahwɛfo atotɔ nkom: W’ekunyin regye hɔn ahom: Wɔabɔ wo man apetse mbepɔw do, na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔboaboa hɔn ano.
Wo kur no nnyi mbotowee; wopirakur no yɛ dzen: Hɔn a wɔtse wo nka nyina bɔ hɔn nsamu gu wo do; na woana na w’emumuyɛ nnguu no do daa?

1: Hacaliah ba Nehemiah nsem nye yi. Afei ɔbaa dɛ bosoom Chislev mu, wɔ afe a otsia eduonu no mu no, aber a mowɔ Shushan aban mu no,
nna Hanani, mo nuanom mu baako, bae, ɔno na mbarimba bi a wofi Judah; na mibisaa hɔn Judahfo a wofii nsa firii a wɔkae wɔ ndɔmmumkɔfo no mu, na Jerusalem ho nsɛm.
Na wɔsee me dɛ, ndɔmmumkɔfo no mu nkaa a wɔaka wɔ ɔmansin no mu hɔ no, wɔwɔ ahohiahia kɛse na ahorohoraa mu; na Jerusalem fasu no ebubu, na no nkuropɔn so wɔdze gya ahyew no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a metsee nsɛm yi no, nna metsenaa famu musūi, na migyaam nda kakra; na midzii mbuada na mobɔɔ mpaa wɔ osor Nyankopɔn no enyim,
na mesee dɛ, ao, Ewuradze, sor Nyankopɔn, Nyame kɛse a no ho yɛ hu a osie ahyɛmu na mbɔbɔrhu dze ma hɔn a wɔdɔ no na wodzi ne mbransɛm do, mokotow serɛ wo:

Afei ma w’aso mbra do, na w enyiwa mbue, na fa tsie w’akowaa mpaa a morobɔ no wɔ w’enyim aber yi, adzekyee na adzesaa, wɔ wo nkowaa Israelmba ntsi no, wɔ mber a merekã Israelmba bɔn a yɛayɛ etsia wo no: Ɛhɛɛ, emi na m’egya fie so yɛayɛ bɔn.
Yɛabɔ brafun etsia wo, na yenndzi mbransɛm, na ahyɛdze, na atsɛmbunsɛm so a edze hyɛɛ w’akowaa Moses no do.
Mokotow serɛ wo, kaa asɛm a edze hyɛɛ w’akowaa Moses no, dɛ, sɛ hom fom a, mobɔbɔ hom mapetse aman mu:

Na sɛ hom san ba me nkyɛn, na hom dzi me mbransɛm do na wɔyɛ a, ɔnodze kaansa sɛ hom adedamfikyirfo wɔwɔ sor ano no ho mpo a, mobɔpon hɔn mefi hɔ, na medze hɔn maba bea a masan mu meyi dɛ mebɛma me dzin atsena hɔ no do.
Afei woyinom wɔyɛ wo nkowaa na wo man a ɔwoara edze wo tum kɛse, na wo nsa a ɔyɛ dzen agye hɔn.

Ao, Ewuradze, mokotow serɛ wo, afei ma w’aso mbra w’akowaa mpaabɔ, na wo nkowaa a wɔpɛ dɛ wosuro wo dzin no mpaabɔ do: Na, meserɛ wo, ma onsi yie mma w’akowaa ndɛ da yi, na ma no mbɔbɔrhu wɔ ɔbarimba yi enyim. (Afei meyɛ nsãhyɛfo dze ma ɔhen no).
2: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔh en Artaɛerɛes n’afe a otsia eduonu no mu, bosoom Nisan mu no a nsã si n’enyim no, nna memaa nsã no do, na medze memaa ɔhen no. Afei nna mennyɛɛ m’enyim mbɔbɔmbɔbɔr da.
Na ɔhen no see me dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w’enyim ayɛ mbɔbɔmbɔbɔr, na ennyar so yi? Iyi nnyɛ hweeara dɛ akoma mu awerɛhow a. Nna m'akoma tuu dodoodow.
Na mesee ɔhen no dɛ, wɔmma ɔhen ntsena ase daa: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na m’enyim nnkɛyɛ mbɔbɔmbɔbɔr, wɔ aber a kurow no, m’egyanom asamandan bea no, da hɔ pan, na wɔdze gya ahyew no nkuropon no?
Nna ɔhen no see me dɛ, na ebɛnadze na erohwehwɛ yi? Nna mobɔɔ mpaa memaa sor Nyankopɔn no.
Na mesee dɛ, sɛ ɔhen pɛ, na sɛ w’akowaa enya enyimpa wɔ w’enyim a, nkyɛ aasoma me wɔ Judah, m’egyanom asamandan kurow no mu, ma makɛkyekyer bio.
Na ɔhen no see me dɛ, (ɔhembaa no so ko ne nkyɛn), na w’akwantu no bɛkyɛr ahen ara? Na aber bɛn na ebɛsan aba? Nna ɔhen no pɛɛ dɛ ogya me kwan; na mehyɛɛ no mber.
Nkyii so mesee ɔhen no dɛ, sɛ ɔhen pɛ a, ɔno wɔmma me nwoma ma memfa menkema esuegya noho ambradofo no, ma wɔmma me kwan ma muntwa mu munkodu Judah ana;

na nwoma so a medze mebɛkɛma ɔhen kwaamu-hwɛfo Asaph, ma ɔmma me ndua ma memfa menyɛ aban a ɔwɔ fi no ho no, no mbobotsen no, no mpuna, na kurow no ne fasu no, dze, na ofi a morokɔ mu no, dze. Na ɔhen no yɛe maa me, dɛ mbrɛ me Nyankopɔn nsa pa a ɔwɔ mo do no tse.
Nna mudur esuegya noho ambradofo no nkyɛn, na medze ɔhen no nwoma no memaa hɔn. Afei nna ɔhen asoma dɔm do nsafohemfo na mpɔnkɔdofo akã mo ho.
Na aber a Horonnyi Sanballat na akowaa Tobiah, Ammonnyi no, tsee no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn yaw mbordo, dɛ nyimpa bi aba dɛ ɔrobɔhwehwɛ Israelmba hɔn yiee.
Nna mebaa Jerusalem, na midzii hɔ ndaansa.

Na mosoɛɛr hɔ anago, emi na mbarimba kakra bi kã mo ho; nkyii so mannkã dza me Nyankopɔn dze hyɛɛ m’akoma mu dɛ menyɛ memma Jerusalem no mannkyerɛ nyimpa biara: Nkyii so abowa biara nnyi me nkyɛn, gyedɛ abowa a metsenaa no do no.
Na menam bɔnsa kuropon no mu mifiir edzi anago, mekyerɛ ɔdze kɔ dragon nsubura ho, na mokɔr sumina kuropon no ano, na mokɔhwɛɛ Jerusalem afasu a ebubu, na no kuropon a wɔdze gya ahyew no.
Nna misii mu mokɔr nsunyiwa kuropon no ano na ɔhen nsutaae ho: Na ɔkwan nnyi hɔ mma m’abowa a ɔwɔ m’ase no dɛ obotwa mu.
Nna menam ɔwora no ho mofoow anago no, na mokɔhwɛɛ fasu no; na mesaan m’ekyir, na mekɛfaa bɔnsa kuropon no mu, na mesanee bae.
Na mpanyimfo no nnyim mbrɛ mokɔree, anaa dza meyɛe; nkyii so nna minnyae mennkãa mennkyerɛɛ Judahfo, na asɔfo no, na ekunyin no, na mpanyimfo no, na nkaa a wɔyɛɛ edwuma no so.
Nna mesee hɔn dɛ, homara hom hu ahokyer a yɛwɔ mu, mbrɛ Jerusalem edua da hɔ pan, na no ho nkuropon so wɔdze gya ahyew no: Hom mbra ma yɛntow Jerusalem afasu no, ma yaannda ho annyɛ ahorohoraafo.
Na mekãa hɔn me Nyankopɔn ne nsa a oye wɔ mo do no ho nsɛm; na ɔhen ne nsɛm a ɔkãa kyerɛɛ me no so. Na wɔsee dɛ, wɔmma yɛnsoɛr na yensi. Nna wɔhyehyɛɛ hɔn nsa dzen maa edwuma pa no.

Na aber a Horonnyi Sanballat, na akowaa Tobiah, Ammonnyi no, na Arabianyi Geshem, tsee no, wɔseresereew hɛn, na wobuu hɛn enyimtsia, na wɔsee dɛ, ebɛnadze na hom reyɛ yi? Ana hom retsew etūa wɔ ɔhen do a?
Nna mubuaa hɔn, na mesee hɔn dɛ, sor Nyankopɔn no, ɔno na ɔbɛma esi hɛn yie; dɛm ntsi hɛn no nkowaa dze, yɛbɔsoɛr na yeesi: Na homdze, hom nnyi kyɛfa, na ndzinoa, na nkaa biara so wɔ Jerusalem.
3: Nna sɔfopanyin Eliashib nye no nuanom asɔfo no soɛree, na wosii nguan kuropon no; hɔn na wɔyɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn, na wosisii no mbobow no; mekyerɛ wɔyɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn dze kodur Hammeah abantsentsen no ho, dze kodur Hananel abantsentsen no ho.
Na ne nkyɛnmu na Jericho mbarimba sii. Na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Imri ba Zaccur sii.
Na enam abotsen no, Hassenaah mba na wosii; hɔn na wɔdze no mpuna gui, na wosisii no mbobow, na nkrɔkrɔw, na n’adaban.
Na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Meremoth, Uriah ba no, Hakkoz ba no, miamiaa mu. Na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Meshullam, Berechiah ba no, Meshezabel ba no, miamiaa mu. Na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Zadok, Baana ba no, miamiaa mu.
Na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Tekoafo miamiaa mu; na hɔn ekunyin no woammfa hɔn kɔn ammbɛhyɛ hɔn wura n’edwuma no mu.
Na abotsen dadaw no, Paseah ba Joiada na Besodeiah ba Meshullam na womiamiaa mu, hɔn na wɔdze no mpuna gui, na wosisii no mbobow, na no nkrɔkrɔw, na n’adaban.
Na hɔn nkyɛnmu Gibeonnyi Melatiah, na Meronothnyi Jadon, Gibeon na Mizpah mbarimba a wodzi wɔ esuegya noho ambrado n’ahengua no.

Na ne nkyɛnmu na Harhaiah esikadwimfo no mu bi no ba Uzziel miamiaa mu. Na ne nkyɛnmu, na Hananiah, nduforaforafo no mu bi no miamiaa mu, na wɔyɛɛ Jerusalem dzendzen ara dze kodur fasu tɛtɛɛtɛr no do.
Na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Rephaiah, Hur ba no, Jerusalem amantɔw fã do hwɛfo no, miamiaa mu.
Na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Harumaph ba Jedaiah, miamiaa mu, mekyerɛ noara ne fie tsentsendo no a. Na ne nkyɛnmu na Hashabneiah ba Hattush miamiaa mu.
Harim ba Malchijah, na Pahath-moab ba Hasshub, miamiaa sin bi so, na mfononoo abantsentsen no mu.
Na ne nkyɛnmu na Hallohesh ba Shallum, Jerusalem amantɔw fã do hwɛfo no, miamiaa mu, ɔno na ne mbabaa.
Bɔnsa kuropon no, Hanun, na Zanoah atsefo na womiamiaa mu; hɔn na wɔtowee, na wosisii no mbobow, no nkrɔkrɔw, na n’adaban, na wɔtoow fasu no mu basafa apem dze kodur sumina kuropon no ho.
Na sumina kuropon no, Rechab ba Malchijah, Beth-haccherem amantɔw do hwɛfo no, na omiamiaa mu; ɔno na ɔtowee, na osisii no mbobow, no nkrɔkrɔw, na n’adaban.

Na nsunyiwa kuropon no, Colhozeh ba Shallum, Mizpah amantɔw do hwɛfo no, na omiamiaa mu; na ɔtowee, na ɔkataa do, na osisii no mbobow, no nkrɔkrɔw na n’adaban na ɔtow Shelah nsutaae ho fasu so wɔ ɔhen no ture no ho araa dze kodur ntwer a osian fi David kurow mu no ho.
Ɔno n’ekyir na Azbuk ba Nehemiah, Beth-zur ɔmantɔw fã do hwɛfo no, miamiaa mu, dze kodur David asamandan no ne tsentsendo bea no do, na nsutaae a wɔyɛe no ho na mbarimba akatakyi no hɔn fi no ho.
Ɔno n’ekyir na Levifo no, Bani ba Rehum miamiaa mu. Ne nkyɛnmu na Hashabiah, Keilah ɔmantɔw fã do hwɛfo no miamiaa mu dze maa ne mantɔw.
Ɔno n’ekyir na hɔn nuanom, Henadad ba Bawai, Keilah ɔmantɔw fã do hwɛfo no, miamiaa mu.
Na ne nkyɛnmu na Joshua ba Ezer, Mizpah hwɛfo no, miamiaa sin bi so mu, wɔ fasu no ne mbekyewee no mu akodzedan no mfowee no ne tsentsendo.
Ɔno n’ekyir na Zabbai ba Baruch miamiaa sin bi so mu enyiberdo, fi fasu no ne mbekyewee no mu, dze kodu sɔfopanyin Eliashib ne fi abow ho.
Ɔno n’ekyir na Meremoth, Uriah ba no, Hakkoz ba no, miamiaa sin bi so mu, fi Eliashib ne fi abow ho araa dze kodu Eliashib ne fi tsir.
Na ɔno n’ekyir na asɔfo no, ɔbɔn no mu mbarimba no boɔtoaa do miamiaa mu.
Hɔn ekyir na Benjamin na Hasshub miamiaa mu wɔ hɔn fi ne tsentsendo. Hon ekyir na Azariah, Maaseiah ba no, Ananiah ba no, miamiaa mu wɔ nankasa ne fi nkyɛn.
Ɔno n’ekyir na Henadad ba Binnui miamiaa sin bi so mu, fi Azariah fi ho dze kodu fasu no ne mbekyewee no mu, na kutuw no ho.
Uzai ba Palal na omiamiaa fasu no ne mbekyewee no, na abantsentsen a ɔworɔw fi n’etsifi fi no a ɔwɔ aweɔmfo abangua ho no ne tsentsendo. Ɔno n’ekyir na Parosh ba Pedaiah miamiaa mu.
(Afei Nethinfo no tsenaa Ophel do, mbrɛ ɔdze kɔ nsu kuropon ne tsentsendo wɔ boka, na abantsentsen a ɔworɔw no n’afamu).
Ɔno n’ekyir na Tekoafo no miamiaa sin bi so mu, wɔ abantsentsen kɛse a ɔworɔw no ne tsentsendo, na ɔdze kodu Ophel ho fasu no ho.
Ofi mpɔnkɔ kuropon ano na asɔfo no miamiaa mu, obiara wɔ nankasa ne fi no ne tsentsendo.
Hɔn ekyir na Immer ba Zado minmiaa mu wɔ nankasa no fi no ne tsentsendo. Na ɔno n’ekyir na Shecnniah ba Shemaiah, boka kuropon-anohwɛfo no, miamiaa mu.
Ɔno n’ekyir na Shelemiah ba Hananiah, na Hanun, Zalaph ba no a otsia esia no, miamiaa sin bi so mu. Ɔno n’ekyir na Berechiah ba Meshullam, miamiaa mu wɔ ne pia ne tsentsendo.
Ɔno n'ekyir na Malchijah, esikadwimfo no mu baako no miamiaa mu kodur Nethinfo na eguadzifo no fi wɔ Hammiphkad kuropon ne tsentsendo, na ɔdze kodu kutuw do afowee no.
Na kutuw do afowee no na nguan kuropon no ntamu na esikadwimfo na eguadzifo no na womiamiaa mu.
4: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Sanballat tsee dɛ yɛrotow fasu no, nna no bo fuwii, na ɔyɛɛ no ehi kɛse, na osii Judahfo no atwetwe.

Na ɔkasae wɔ no nuanom na Samaria dɔm no enyim, see dɛ, ebɛnadze na Judahfo mberɛmberɛwfo reyɛ yi? Ana wɔbɛyɛ hɔnho dzendzen a? ana wobɔbɔ afɔr a? Ana wobowie no dakor a? Ana wobenyanyan abo no efi wura ekuwekuw yi mu, osiandɛ wɔahyehyew ntsi?
Afei na Ammonnyi Tobiah wɔ ne nkyɛn, na ɔno na ɔsee dɛ, dza wɔrotow yi mpo, sɛ odompo fow a, obobubu hɔn abo fasu no.
Hɛn Nyankopɔn e, tsie, na woebu hɛn enyimtsia; na dan hɔn ahorohoraa bua hɔnankasa hɔn etsifi, na gyaa hɔn ma ɔfom wɔ ndɔmmumkɔ asaase do:
Na mma nnkata hɔn emumuyɛ do, na mma wɔmmpepa hɔn bɔn so mmfi w’enyim: Osiandɛ woeyi wɔ ebufuw wɔ adantofo no enyim.
Nna yɛtoow fasu no; na fasu no nyinara wɔtoatoae kodur no krɔn ne fã do: Osiandɛ ɔman no nyaa adwen dɛ wɔbɛyɛ edwuma.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Sanballat, na Tobiah, na Arabiafo, na Ammonfo, na Ashdodfo no tsee dɛ Jerusalem afasu no ne mmiamiamu no akɔ kan, na etokur no ahyɛ ase risisiw no, nna hɔn bo fuuw dodoodow;
na hɔn nyinara kɔr apam yɛɛ kɔr dɛ wɔreba na wɔnye Jerusalem abɔkõ, na wɔayɛ ma no mu ayɛ sakasaka.
Na hɛndze, yɛbɔɔ hɛn mpaa maa hɛn Nyankopɔn, na osian hɔn ntsi, yesisii do aweɔmfo adzekyee na adzesaa.
Na Judah see dɛ, ndzesoadzefo hɔn ahoɔdzen asã, na wura no so dɔɔ sõ; ma dɛm ntsi yenntum nntow fasu no.
Na hɛn atamfo no see dɛ, mma wɔnntse, nkyii so mma wonnhu, nkodu dɛ yebodu hɔn mu, na yeekuku hɔn, na yɛama edwuma no etwa sin.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Judahfo a wɔtsetse hɔn nkyɛn no bae no, nna wofi mbeambea nyinara see hɛn mpen du dɛ, hom nsan mbra hɛn nkyɛn.
Dɛm ntsi na medze nyimpa mesisi ɔkwan a ɔwɔ fasu no n’ekyir asease no do hɔ, wɔ guadoguado, na medze ɔman no misisii hɔ dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuaebusua tsetsee, wɔdzedze hɔn mfõwa, hɔn mpeaa, na hɔn ngyen.

Na mohwɛe, na mosoɛree, na mesee ekunyin, na mpanyimfo, na ɔman no nkaa no dɛ, mma hom nnsuro hɔn: Hom nkaa Ewuradze a no ho yɛ hu no, na hom nkõ mma hom nuanom, hom mba na hom mbabaa, hom yernom na hom efiefi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a hɛn atamfo no tsee dɛ yɛatse, na Nyankopɔn ama hɔn egyinatutu ayɛ gyan no, nna hɛn nyinara sanee kɔr fasu no ho, obiara kosuoo n’edwuma mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ofi ber no do dze kɔ no, mo nkowaa mu fã foraa mu yɛɛ edwuma, na hɔn mu fã so dzedze mpeaa, akyɛm, na ngyen, na dadzentar; na mpanyimfo no wowɔ Judah fi nyinara ekyir.
Hɔn a wɔtoow fasu no na hɔn a wɔsoasoaa ndzesoadze no miaa hɔnho, obiara dze ne nsa kor yɛɛ edwuma, na ɔdze kor no so suoo n’akodze mu;
na adantofo no mu obiara bɔɔ n’afõwa wɔ ne nkyɛnmu, na wɔdze no dɛm dze towee. Na nyia ɔhen abɛn no wɔ me nkyɛn.
Na mesee ekunyin no, na mpanyimfo no, na ɔman no nkaa no dɛ, edwuma no sõ na no mu trɛ, na hɛn so hɛn mu ebuebue wɔ fasu no do ɔbaako na ɔbaako so ntamu twe:
Dɛm ntsi beebiara a hom bɛtse abɛn ndze no, hom ntsīa homho ndan mbra hɛn nkyɛn wɔ hɔ; hɛn Nyankopɔn bɔkõ ama hɛn.
Dɛm na yɛyɛɛ edwuma no: Na hɔn mu fã dzedze mpeaa fi adzekyee araa kodur dɛ nworaba puepuei.
Dɛmara so na ber no ara mu no mesee ɔman no dɛ, wɔmma obiara nye n'akowaa nda wɔ Jerusalem, ma wɔnyɛ aweɔmfo mma hɛn anago, na wɔnyɛ edwuma ewiaber.
Dɛm ntsi emi, na mo nuanom, na mo nkowaa, na mbarimba aweɔmfo so a wodzi m’ekyir no, hɛn mu biara yerinnyiyi hɛn ntar, obiara dze ne dadzedze dze kɔ nsu.
5: Nna ɔman no na hɔn yernom mu nkekamu kɛse soɛree tsiaa hɔn nuanom Judahfo no.
Na binom wɔ hɔ a wɔsee dɛ, hɛn, hɛn mbabanyin na hɛn mbabaa, yɛdɔɔ sõ: Wɔmma yɛnhwehwɛ eburow, na yendzi na yeenya nkwa.
Binom so wɔ hɔ a wɔsee dɛ, yɛdze hɛn haban, na wenyin nture, na hɛn adan risisi nhoba: Wo mm a yɛnhwehwɛ eburow osian ɔkɔm no ntsi.
Binom so wɔ hɔ a wɔsee dɛ, yɛafemfɛm sika dze eyi ɔhen no tow, wo hɛn nhaban na hɛn wenyin nture no do.

Naaso afei hɛn honam tse dɛ hɛn nuanom honam, hɛn mba tse dɛ hɔn mba: Na, hwɛ, yedze hɛn mbabanyin na hɛn mbabaa reba enyadzi mu dɛ wɔnyɛ asomfo, na hɛn mbabaa mu binom wɔ hɔ a wɔahɛn enyadzi mu dada: Nkyii so ahoɔdzen bi nnyi hɛn afamu a yɛdze bɛyɛ hwee: Osiandɛ hɛn nhaban na hɛn wenyin nture wowɔ wobinom nsamu.
Na aber a metsee hɔn nkekamu na nsɛm yi no, mo bo fuuw dodow.
Nna mara mutuu me tsir mu egyina, na menye ekunyin na mpanyimfo no hamee, na mesee hɔn dɛ, hom sii akaperɛ gyegyee nsiho, obiara wɔ no nua hɔ. Na mobɔɔ hɔn do ngua kɛse.

Na mesee hɔn dɛ, hɛndze, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn tum tse no na yɛdze apon hɛn nuanom Judahfo a wɔtɔɔn hɔn maa amanamamfo no; na hom so hom pɛ dɛ wɔtontɔn hom nuanom, na wɔntontɔn hɔn mma hɛn anaa? Nna wɔyɛɛ komm, na woennhu asɛm biaraa wɔdze bua.
Eso mesee dɛ, adze a hom reyɛ yi onnye: Nna ɔnnsɛ dɛ hom nantsew hom Nyankopɔn no suro mu, osian hɛn atamfo amanamamfo ahorohoraa no ntsi bi a?
Na emi so dɛmara, mo nuanom na mo nkowaa, yɛfemfɛm hɔn sika na eburow gye nsiho, meserɛ hom, wɔmma yengyaa nsiho yi ekyir dzi.
Meserɛ hom, ndɛ da yi ara, hom ndan hɔn nhaban, hɔn wenyin nture, hɔn olive ndua, na hɔn efi mma hon, na sika, na eburow, nsã, na ngo mu ɔha mu ebupɛn no a hom si akaperɛ gyegye no wɔ hɔn hɔ no.
Nna wɔsee dɛ, yɛbɛdan ama, na yɛnnkɔhwehwɛ hɔn hɔ hwee; dɛmara na yɛbɛyɛ, dɛ mbrɛ erekã no ara. Nna mefrɛɛ asɔfo no, na memaa wɔkekkãa ntam, dɛ wɔbɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ anohoba yi tse.

Eso mopopoo m’akoko mu na mesee dɛ, dɛmara na Nyankopɔn mpopo nyimpa biara a ɔmma anohoba yi nntsiw no mfi ne fi, na n'edwuma mu; mekyerɛ mbrɛ wobesi apopo no, na wɔato no pan nye yi. Na mboanofo no nyinara see dɛ, Amen, na woyii Ewuradze ayɛw. Na ɔman no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ anohoba yi tse.

Nkyii so ofi ber a wɔdze me hyɛɛ hɔn ambrado wɔ Judah asaase do no, ofi ɔhen Artaɛerɛes n’afe a otsia eduonu do araa dze kodu afe a otsia eduasa ebien do no, ɔnye dɛ, mfe duebien, emi na mo nuanom yenndzii ambrado edziban.

Na kan no ambradofo a wodzii m’enyim no wɔyɛɛ dur dze maa ɔman no, na wɔgyee hɔn hɔ edziban na nsã, ɔsor dwetɛ shekel eduanan so; nyew, hɔn nkowaa mpo so hoom ɔman no do: Na emidze, osian Nyankopɔn no suro ntsi, mannyɛ dɛm.
Nyew, fasu yi ho edwuma no so mowɔɔw do ara suoo mu, nkyii so yɛanntɔ asaase biara: Na mo nkowaa nyinara ano boae wɔ edwuma no ho hɔ.
Nkyii so Judahfo na mpanyimfo no mu nyimpa ɔha eduonum kã hɔn a wofifi amanamamfo a wɔabɔ hɛn ho aprɔw no mu ba hɛn nkyɛn no ho, na wɔwɔ mo pon ho.

Afei dza wosiesiei dze maa da kor nye ɔnantwi kor na nguan a wɔasan mu eyiyi esia; eso ntumbowa na wosiesiei maa me, na dadu biara mu nsã ahorow nyinara pii: Naaso iyi nyinara mu memmbisa ambrado edziban, osiandɛ nkowaasom no yɛɛ durdur wɔ ɔman yi do.
Me Nyankopɔn, kaa dza osian ɔman yi ntsi mayɛ no nyinara fa ma me wɔ me yiee ntsi.
6: Afei ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔkãa kyerɛɛ Sanballat na Tobiah, na Arabianyi Geshem, na hɛn atamfo nkaa no dɛ matow fasu no, na otukur bi nnkae wɔ mu bio no; (naaso aber no mu na minnsisii mbobow no wɔ nkuropon no ano):
Nna Sanbailat na Geshem somae ma wɔbaa me nkyɛn, dɛ, bra, ma yenhyia mu wɔ nkuroba no mu kor mu wɔ Ono tɛtɛr no mu. Na hɔndze, wɔdween dɛ wɔbɛyɛ me bɔn.
Na mosomaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr hɔn nkyɛn, dɛ, mereyɛ edwuma kɛse, dɛm ntsi murunntum minnsian memmba: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edwuma no ntwa sin mber a mirigya no hɔ, na mesian maba hom nkyɛn no?
Na wɔsomae ma wɔbaa me nkyɛn dɛmara mpɛn anan; na mubuaa hɔn dɛmara.
Nna Sanballat somaa n'akowaa ma ɔbaa me nkyɛn dɛmara otsia enum, ɔdze nwoma a n’ano da ha kitsa ne nsamu;
wɔakyerɛw wɔ mu dɛ, wɔkekã no wɔ amanaman mu, na Gashmu se dɛ, ɔwo na Judahfo no wɔrodwen dɛ wɔbɛtsew etūa; ɔno ntsi na erotow fasu no yi: Na ɔwoara so epɛ dɛ ibedzi hɔn hen, dɛ mbrɛ nsem yi tse.
Na ɔwoara so ahyehyɛ nkɔnhyɛfo so dɛ wɔnkã wo ho asɛm wɔ Jerusalem, dɛ, ɔhen bi wɔ Judah: Na afei wɔbɛkã akyerɛ ɔhen dɛ mbrɛ nsɛm yi tse. Dɛm ntsi afei bra, na ma yɛmbɔ mu ntu egyina.
Nna mosomae ma wɔkɔr ne nkyɛn, dɛ, wɔnnyɛɛ ndzɛmba biara dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo erekã yi, mbom ofi wankasa w'akoma mu na irususu kã.
Na hɔn nyinara pɛɛ dɛ wɔyɛ ma hɛn akoma tu, dɛ, hɔn nsamu bɔgow efi edwuma no ho, amma wɔaannyɛ. Na afei, Nyankopɔn, hyɛ me nsa dzen.

Na misii mu kɔr Shemaiah, Delaiah ba no, Mehetabel ba no a wɔatow no mu no ne fie; na ɔsee dɛ, ma yenhyia mu wo Nyankopɔn fie, wɔ asɔrdan no mu na ma yɛntotow asɔrdan no no mbobow mu: Osiandɛ wɔbɛba dɛ woruboku wo: Nyew, anago na wɔbɛba eboku wo.
Na mesee dɛ, Aso ɔbarimba a ɔtse dɛ emi boguan? Na woana na ɔwɔ hɔ a ɔtse dɛ emi a ɔbɛkɛhɛn asɔrdan mu dze agye noho nkwa? Moronnkɔ mu.
Na mohwɛɛ mu, na, hwɛ, nnyɛ Nyankopɔn bi nna ɔsomaa no: Na ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm yi dze tsiaa me, na Tobiah na Sanballat na wɔabɔ no paa.
Na iyi ntsi na wɔbɔɔ no paa, dɛ ama meesuro, na maayɛ dɛm, na maayɛ bɔn, ma woeenya dzin bɔn bi abɔyie, ma wɔdze aasopa me.
Ao me Nyankopɔn, kaa Tobiah na Sanballat dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndwuma yi tse, na eso nkɔnhyɛfobaa Noadiah, na nkɔnhyɛfo nkaa no a nkyɛ wɔrepɛ eyi me hu no.
Nna wowiee fasu no wɔ bosoom Elul mu da a otsia eduonu enum no, wɔ adaduonum ebien mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a hɛn atamfo nyinara tsee no, nna amanamamfo a wɔwowɔ hɛn ho no surosuroi, na wɔbombɔmee wo hɔnankasa hɔn enyiwa do dodoodow: Na wohun dɛ edwuma yi hɛn Nyankopɔn na ɔyɛe.
Nkyii so nda mu no Judah ekunyin no somae ma wɔdze nwoma pii kɛmaa Tobiah, na Tobiah so no nwoma baa hɔn nkyɛn.
Na dodowara wɔ Judah a woesua akyerɛ no, osiandɛ ɔyɛ Arah ba Shecaniah n’asew; na ne ba Jehohanan afa Berechiah ba Meshuliam ne babaa awar.
Eso wɔbɛkãa ne ndzeyɛɛ pa ho asɛm wɔ m'enyim, na wɔbɛkãa me nsɛm so kyerɛɛ no. Na Tobiah dze nwoma somae dɛ ɔdze ribeyi me hu.
7: Afei ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔtoow fasu no, na misisii mbobow no, na wɔhyehyɛɛ mbobowano-ahwɛfo na adwontofo na Levifo no,
nna mehyɛɛ mo nua Hanani, na Hananiah aban no mu ambrado no, mom wɔ Jerusalem do: Na ɔyɛ ɔbarimba nokwafo, na osuro Nyankopɔn sen dodowara.

Na mesee hɔn dɛ, mma hom mma wommbuebue Jerusalem nkuropon ma ewia ano nyɛ hyew ana; na mber a wogyina apata mu no, wɔmma wɔntotow mbobow no mu, na hom ntotow ekyir: Na wonyi Jerusalem atsefo no bi aweɔmfo nsisi hɔ, obiara ngyina n’aweɔmber do, na obiara ngyina ne fi tsentsendo.
Afei kurow no mu tsɛw na ɔsõ: Na ɔman no suar wɔ mu, na adan no so wonnsisii.
Na me Nyankopɔn dze hyɛɛ m’akoma mu dɛ morapon ekunyin, na mpanyimfo, na ɔman no nhyia, ma wɔnkan hɔn ananakan do. Na muhun hɔn a wodzii kan bae no hɔn ananakan nwoma, na muhun dɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ mu dɛ:
Woyinom nye ɔmansin no mu mba a wofi ndɔmmumkɔfo no a Babylonhen Nebuchadnezzar faa hɔn kɔree no mu fowee bae, na wɔsanee baa Jerusalem na Judah, obiara kɔr no kurow mu no a
wɔnye Zerubbabel, Joshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah bae no. Israel ɔman mu mbarimba dodow nye yi:
Parosh mba, mpemebien ɔha eduoson ebien.
Sheohaiah mba, ahaasa eduoson ebien.
Arah mba, ahaesia eduonum ebien.
Pahathmoab mba, Joshua na Joab mba dze, mpem ebien, ahaawɔtwe duawɔtwe.
Elam mba, apem ahaenu eduonum anan.
Lattu mba, ahaawɔtwe eduanan enum.
Laccai mba, ahaesuon eduosia.
Binnui mba, ahaesia eduanan awɔtwe.
Bebai mba, ahaesia eduonu awɔtwe.
Azgad mba, mpemebien ahaasa
Adonikan mba, ahaesia eduosia esuon.
Bigvai mba, mpemebien edusia esuon.
Adin mba, ahaesia eduonum enum.
Ater mba, Heshum mba, ahaasa eduonu awɔtwe.
Hashum mba, ahaasa eduonu awɔtwe.
Bezai mba, ahaasa eduonu anan.
Hariph mba, ɔha duebien.
Gibeon mba, eduokron enum.
Beth-lehem na Netophah mba, ɔha eduowɔtwe awɔtwe.
Anathoth mbarimba, ɔha eduonu awɔtwe.
Beth-azmaveth mbarimba, eduanan ebien.
Kiriath-jearim, Cheriphirah, na Beeroth mbarimba, ahaesuon eduanan ebiasa.
Ram ah na Geba mbarimba, ahaesia eduonu biako.
Michmas mbarimba, ɔha eduonu ebien.
Beth-el na Ai mbarimba, ɔha eduonu ebiasa.
Nebo kor no mu mbarimba, eduonum ebien.
Elam baako no mba, apem ahaenu eduonum anan.
Harim mba, ahaasa eduonu.
Jericho mba, ahaasa eduanan enum.
Lod, Hadid, na Ono mba, ahaesuon eduonu biako.
Senaah mba, mpemebiasa ahaakron eduasa.
Asɔfo no: Jedaiah mba, Joshua fie dze, ahaakron eduosuon ebiasa.
Immer mba, apem eduonum ebien.
Pashhur mba, apem ahaenu eduanan esuon.
Harim mba, apem eduosuon.
Levifo no: Joshua mba, Kadmiel dze, Hodevah mba dze, eduosuon anan.
Adwontofo no: Asaph mba, ɔha eduanan awotwe.
Mbobowanoafawɛfo no: Shallum mba, Ater mba, Talmon mba, Akkub mba, Hatita mba, Shobai mba, ɔha eduasa awɔtwe.
Nethinfo no: Ziha mba, Hasupha mba, Tabbaoth mba;
Keros mba, Sia mba, Padon mba;
Lebana mba, Hagaba mba, Salmai mba;
Hanan mba, Giddel mba, Gahar mba;
Reaiah mba, Rezin mba, Nekoda mba,
Gazzam mba, Uzza mba, Paseah mba;
Besai mba, Meunim mba, Nephushesim mba;
Bakbuk mba, Hakupha mba, Harhur mba;
Bazlith mba, Mehida mba, Harsha mba;
Barkos mba, Sisera mba, Temah mba;
Neziah mba, Hatipha mba.
Solomon no nkowaa mba: Sotai mba, Sophereth mba, Perida mba;
Jaala mba, Darkon mba, Giddel-mba;
Shephatiah mba, Hattil mba, Pochereth-hazzebaim mba Amon mba.
Nethinfo nyinara na Solomon no nkowaa mba no, wɔyɛ ahaasa eduokron ebien.
Na Woyinom nye hɔn a wofi Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addon, na Immer bae no: Na woenntum annkyerɛ hɔn egyanom efiefi; na hɔn asɔfo so, dɛ wofi Israel mu:
Delaiah mba Tobiah mba, Nekoda mba, ahaesia eduanan ebien.
Na asɔfo no: Hobaiah mba, Hakkoz mba, Barzillai a ɔwaar Gileadnyi Barzillai ne mbabaa mu bi, na wɔdze hɔn dzin too no no ne mba.
Woyinom hwehwɛɛ hɔn ebusua nwoma wɔ hɔn a wɔnam ananakan do buu hɔn ano no mu, na woennhu: Dɛm ntsi wobuu hɔn ahoɔ-fifo na wotuu hɔn fii asɔfodze no mu.
Na Tirshafcha no see hɔn dɛ mma wonndzi krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn no bi, ma onkodu dɛ ɔsɔfo bi ɔdze Urim na Thummim begyinaa hɔ.
Mboanofo kuw no nyina yɛ mpemeduanan ebien ahaasa eduosia,
ɔsor hɔn nkowaa na hɔn mfonabaa a hɔn so wɔyɛ mpemesuon ahaasa eduasa esuon: Na wɔwɔ mbarimba adwontofo ahaenu eduanan enum.
Hɔn mpɔnkɔ yɛ ahaesuon eduasa esia; hɔn asoasompɔnkɔ, ahaenu eduanan enum;
hɔn efumpɔnkɔ, ahaanan eduasa enum; hɔn nsoaso, mpemesia ahaesuon eduonu.
Na egyanom efiefi etsitsir no mu binom bɛkyekyɛɛ edwuma no ho adze. Tirshatha no maa sika daric apem, mbeesin eduonum, asɔfo ntar ahaenura eduasa dɛ wɔmfa ngu adzekoradze no mu.
Na egyanom etsitsir no mu binom guguu edwuma no ho adzekoradze no mu sika daric mpemeduonu, na dwetɛ abɛndaa mpemebien ahaenu.
Na dza ɔman no nkaa no wɔdze mae no nye sika daric mpemeduonu, na dwetɛ abɛndaa mpemebien, na asɔfo ntar eduosia esuon.

Nna asɔfo no na Levifo no, na mbobowanoahwɛfo no, na adwontofo no, na ɔman no mu binom, na Nethinfo no, na Israel nyinara, tsenatsenaa hɔn nkurow mu. Na aber a ɔbosoom a otsia esuon no durii no, nna Israelmba no wowɔ hon nkurow mu.
8: Na ɔman no nyinara poon hɔnho hyiae dɛ nyimpa kor kɔr bea tɛtɛr no a ɔwɔ nsu kuropon no enyim no do; wɔkãa kyerɛɛ kyerɛwfo Ezra dɛ ɔmfa Moses mbra a Ewuradze dze hyɛɛ Israel no mbra.
Na ɔsɔfo Ezra dze mbra no baa mboanofo no enyim, mbarimba na mbaa nyina, na hɔn a wobotum dze ntseasee etsie no nyinara, wɔ bosoom a otsia esuon no ne da a odzi kan no mu.

Na ɔkenkaan mu wɔ bea tɛtɛr no a ɔwɔ nsu kuropon no enyim no do fi ahanamakye kodur wigyinae, wɔ mbarimba na mbaa, na hɔn a wobotum atse ase no enyim; na ɔman no nyinara kyɛɛn hɔn aso wɔ mbra nwoma no do.

Na kyerɛwfo Ezra gyinaa dua asɛnkadaka bi a asɛm no ntsi wɔyɛe no do; na Mattithiah, na Shema, na Anaiah, na Uriah, na Hilkiah, na Maaseiah, gyinagyina ne nkyɛn, wɔ n’enyimfa; na n’abankum so, Pedaiah, na Mishael, na Malchijah, na Hashum, na Hashbad-danah, Zechariah, na Meshullam.
Na Ezra buee nwoma no mu wɔ ɔman no nyinara enyim; (osiandɛ ɔbor ɔman no nyinara do); na obuee mu no, ɔman no nyinara soɛree gyinagyinae:
Na Ezra hyiraa Ewuradze, Nyankopɔn kɛse no. Na ɔman no nyinara dze hɔn nsa ne memado gyee do dɛ, Amen, Amen: Na wɔbobɔɔ hɔn tsir adze, na wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu sɔɔr Ewuradze.
Eso Joshua, na Bani, na Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, na Levifo no, maa ɔman no tsee mbra no ase: Na ɔman no gyinaa hɔn ananmu.
Na wɔkenkaan buukuu no mu, wɔ Nyankopɔn ne mbra no mu, kofee; na wɔkyerɛɛ ase, ma wɔtsee akenkan no ase.

Na Nehemiah a ɔyɛ Tirshatha no, na ɔsɔfo Ezra, ɔkyerɛwfo no, na Levifo a wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ ɔman no, see ɔman no nyinara dɛ, ndɛ da yi ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn ma Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn; mma hom nndzi nkɔmbɔ, na wonnsusu so. Osiandɛ ɔman no nyinara sūi wɔ aber a wɔtsee mbra no mu nsɛm no.

Nna ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nkɔ hom kwan, nkedzi seradzenam, na wɔnnom adɔkɔdɔkɔdze, na wɔmfa bi nkɛma nyia woennsiesie hwee amma no no: Osiandɛ nde da yi ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn ma hɛn Ewuradze: Nkyii so mma hom werɛ nnhow; na Ewuradze n’enyigye nye hom ahoɔdzen.
Nna Levifo no dwedwee ɔman no nyinara, dɛ, hom nyɛ dzinn, na da yi yɛ krɔnkrɔn; nkyii so mma hom werɛ nnhow.
Na ɔman no nyinara sii mu kɔr hɔn kwan kedzidzii, na wɔnomee, na wɔdze bi kɛkyekyɛe, na wonyaa enyigye kɛse, osiandɛ wɔtsee nsɛm a wɔdaa no edzi kyerɛɛ hɔn no ase.
Na da a otsīa ebien no, ɔman no nyinara mu egyanom efiefi etsitsir, na Levifo no boaboaa hɔn ano kɔr kyerɛwfo Ezra nkyɛn, dɛ ɔmma wɔntse mbra no ase.
Na wohun dɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mbra no mu, mbrɛ Ewuradze sii na ɔnam Moses do hyɛe, dɛ Israelmba no wɔntsenatsena mpata mu wɔ ɔbosoom a otsia esuon no mu afahyɛ no mu:

Na dɛ wɔmma ɔntahye na wɔmbɔ no dawur wɔ hɔn nkurow nyinara mu, na Jerusalem, dɛ, hom mfir nkɔ bepɔw no do, na wɔnkɛfa olive n’abaw, na sɛsɛw n’abaw, na myrtle n’abaw, na abɛ n’abaw, na ndua wusuww n’abaw, mbra mbɔbobɔ mpata, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no.
Nna ɔman no fir edzi, na wɔkɛfae bae, na wɔbobɔɔ mpata maa hɔnho, obiara wɔ ne dan etsifi na hɔn abanguado, na Nyankopɔn ne fi abanguado, na nsu kuropon ho bea tɛtɛr no do.

Na hɔn a wɔsanee fi ndɔmmumkɔ mu bae no mu mboanofo no nyinara bobɔɔ mpata, na wɔtsenatsenaa mpata no mu: Osiandɛ ofitsi Nun ba Joshua ne nda do dze bodu da no Israelmba nnyɛɛ dɛm da. Na enyigye kɛsenara sii hɔ.
Eso ɔkenkaan Nyankopɔn mbra nwoma no mu daa daa, ofi da a odzi kan no do dze bodur da a odzi ekyir no do. Na wɔhyɛɛ fa no nda esuon; na da a otsīa awɔtwe no yɛ ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn, dɛ mbrɛ mom no tse.
9: Afei ɔbosoom ne da a otsīa eduonu anan no mu no IsraeLmba no dze mbuadadzi, na eyitam, na hɔnho dɛtsedɛtse, bɔɔ ngua.
Na Israel asefo no tseew hɔnho fii ahɔho nyinara ho, na wogyinagyinaa hɔ kekãa hɔn bɔn, na hɔn egyanom emumuyɛ no.

Na wɔsoɛree gyinagyinaa hɔn gyinabew, na wokenkaan Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn mbra nwoma no mu, wɔ adzekyee mu nkyɛmu anan mu kor mu; na nkyɛmu anan mu kor so mu wɔdze kãa hɔn bɔn, na wɔdze sɔɔr Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn.
Nna Joshua, na Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Shere-biah, Bani, na Chenani, soɛree gyinagymaa Levifo sumpii no do, na wɔdze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu frɛɛ Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn.

Nna Levifo no, Joshua, na Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, na Pethahiah, see dɛ, hom nsoɛr nhyira Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn mfi daapem nkesi daapem: Na wonhyira w’enyimnyam dzin a wɔama do atra nhyira na ayɛyi nyinara no.

Ɔwo nye Ewuradze, mekyerɛ wo nkotoo korɛ; ɔwo na eyɛɛ sor, ɔsor mu sor, nye hɔn dɔm nyinara, asaase na ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ do nyinara, po na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara, na ɔwoara na ekora hɔn nyinara do; na sor dɔm no, ɔwo na wɔsɔr wo.
Ɔwo nye Ewuradze Nyankopɔn no a esaan mu faa Abram, na edze no fiir edzi fii Chaldeafo Ur bae, na emaa no dzin Abraham;

ihun n’akoma dɛ ɔyɛ nokwar wɔ w’enyim, na enye no dzii ahyɛmu dɛ edze Canaanfo, Hittifo, Amorifo, na Perizzfo, na Jebusfo, na Girgashfo asaase bɛma, mekyerɛ dɛ edze bɛma n’asefo, na ama wo nsɛm no etsim; osiandɛ ɔwo yɛ ɔtseneneenyi.
Na ɔwo hun hɛn egyanom ahohiahia wɔ Egypt, na etsee hɔn nkekamu wɔ epo memen no ho;
na ekyerɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze na anwanwadze wɔ Pharaoh, na no nkowaa nyinara, na n’asaase do ɔman no nyinara do; na ɔwoara hun dɛ woedzi hɔn do nkontompɔsɛm; na edze gyee dzin, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
Na ɔwo epaa po no mu wɔ hɔn enyim, na wɔfaa po no ne finimfin wɔ asaase kɛsɛɛ do; na hɔn a wotsiiw hɔn no, itoow hɔn guu ebun no mu, dɛ mbrɛ wɔtow ɔbo kyen nsu a ɔyɛ dzen mu.
Nkyii so ɔwo igyaa hɔn wɔ mununkum dum mu ewiaber; na gya dum mu an ago, dɛ ɔmma hɔn kan wɔ kwan a wɔwɔ dɛ wodua do no mu.
Eso ɔwo isianee baa bepɔw Sinai do, na fii sor nye hɔn kasae, na emaa hɔn atsɛmbu tsenenee na nokwar mbra, ahyɛdze a oye na mbransɛm:
Na emaa wohun w’ahomgyeda krɔnkrɔn no, na enam w’akowaa Moses ne nsa do hyɛɛ hɔn mbransɛm, na ahyɛdze, na mbra:
Na emaa hɔn sor edziban dze kum hɔn kɔm, na edze nsu fi botan mu puei maa hɔn dze kum hɔn nsukɔm, na ehyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnkɔ nkɛfa asaase a emaa wo nsa do dɛ edze bɛma hɔn no.
Na hɔn na hɛn egyanom dzi nkontompɔsɛm, na wɔkyēe hɔn kɔn, na woenntsie wo mbransɛm no,

na wɔpoow dɛ wobetsie nkyii so wɔannkaa w'anwanwadze a eyɛɛ no wɔ hɔn mu no; mbom wɔkyēe hɔn kɔn, na hɔn etuatsew no mu wɔhyɛɛ hɔn do safohen dɛ wɔresan akɔ hɔn nkowaasom no mu: Na ɔwo yɛ fafirfo Nyankopɔn, ɔdomfo na mbɔbɔrhufo, efa ebufuw nyaa, na w’adɔyɛ so, na ammpow hɔn.
Nyew, aber a wɔyɛɛ nantwiba a woegu maa hɔnho, na wɔsee dɛ, iyi nye wo Nyankopɔn a ɔdze wo fi Egypt bae, na woyii ehi kɛse mpo;
ɔwo wo mbobɔrhu pii no ntsi ammpow hɔn wɔ sar no do: Mununkum dum no emmfi hɔn do ewiaber, dɛ obegya hɔn wɔ kwan no mu; nkyii so gya dum no anago, dɛ obema hɔn kan wɔ kwan a wɔwɔ dɛ wofa do mu.
Ɔwo edze wo sunsum pa no so maa dɛ ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn, na wo manna so amma ammpa hɔn ano, na emaa hɔn nsu dze kum hɔn nsukɔm.
Nyew, ɔwo ehwɛɛ hɔn mfe eduanan wɔ sar no do, na woennhia hwee; hɔn ntar ennsusuw, na hɔn anan annhohon.
Nkyii so ɔwo maa hɔn nhenman na am an a ɔwoara ekyɛe no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kyɛpɛn tse: Nna wɔfaa Sihon asaase, mekyerɛ Heshbonhen asaase, na Bashanhen Og asaase no.
Hɔn mba so, ɔwo maa wɔdɔɔr dɛ sor nworaba, na edze hɔn baa asaase a ɔwoara esee hɔn egyanom dɛ wɔbɔkɔ do akɛfa no do.
Nna mba no kɔree na wɔkɛfaa asaase no, na ɔwo ebrɛɛ asaase no do atsefo no, Canaanfo no, adze wɔ hɔn enyim, na edze hɔn hyɛɛ hɔn nsa, nye hɔn hen, na asaase no do aman no, ma wɔaayɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ wɔpɛ.

Na wɔgyegyee nkurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban, na asaase a ɔadɔ seradze, na wonyaa efi a ndzɛmba pa nyinara ahyehyɛ mu amaama, nsubura a wotwae, wenyin nture, na olive nture, na ndua a wodzi no nsowee, piigyan: Nna wodzidzii, na wɔmee, na wɔyeyɛɛ abran, na wɔgyee hɔn enyi wɔ wo papayɛ kɛse no mu.
Naaso wɔyɛɛ asoɔdzen, na wɔtseew etūa wɔ wo do, na wɔtoow wo mbra kyeen hɔn ekyir, na wokunkum wo nkɔnhyɛfo a wodzii dase tsiaa hɔn dɛ wɔdze resan hɔn aba wo nkyɛn no, na woyii ehi kɛse.

Dɛm ntsi ɔwo edze hɔn hyɛɛ hɔn atamfo nsa, hɔn na wohiahiaa hɔn ho: Na hɔn ahokyer ber mu no a wosūi frɛɛ wo no, ɔwo fi sor tsiee hɔn; na dɛ mbrɛ w’adɔyɛ pii tse no, ɔwo maa hɔn agyefo a wɔgyee hɔn fii hɔn atamfo nsamu.

Na wonyaa ahodwe ekyir no, wɔyɛɛ w’enyim bɔn bio: Dɛm ntsi ɔwo igyaa hɔn hyɛɛ hɔn atamfo nsa, na wonyaa hɔn do tum: Naaso aber a wɔsanee, na wosūi frɛɛ wo no, nna ɔwo fi sor tsiei; na mber pii na ɔwo gyee hɔn dɛ mbrɛ wo mbɔbɔrhu no tse;

na idzii dase tsiaa hɔn dɛ edze hɔn bɛba wo mbra no mu bio: Naaso wodzii nkontompɔsɛm, na woenntsie wo mbransɛm, na wɔyɛɛ bɔn tsiaa w'atsɛmbunsɛm (dza sɛ nyimpa yɛ a, obenya mu nkwa no a), na wɔtwee abatsir, na wɔkyēe hɔn kɔn, na wɔammpɛ dɛ wotsie.
Naaso mber pii na ɔwo ekoraa hɔn, na edze wo sunsum nam wo nkɔnhyɛfo do dzii dase tsiaa hɔn: Naaso wɔammpɛ dɛ wɔma aso: Dɛm ntsi ɔwo edze hɔn hyɛɛ asaase no do aman no nsa.
Naaso wo mbɔbɔrhu pii no ntsi ɔwo ennkum hɔn ase, na ammpow hɔn so; osiandɛ ɔwo yɛ ɔdomfo na mbɔbɔrhufo Nyankopɔn.

Dɛm ntsi afei, hɛn Nyankopɔn, Nyame kɛse, ɔkatakyi a wo ho yɛ hu a isie ahyɛmu na adɔyɛ, mma mma ɔfona nyinara a aba hɛn, hɛn ahemfo, hɛn mbapɔmba, na hɔn asɔfoe na hɛn nkɔnhyɛfo, na hɛn egyanom, na wo man nyinara do, ofitsi Assyriaahemfo ber do aba hɛn do nyinara mu.
Naaso ɔwo etsen wɔ dza aba hɛn do nyinara mu; osiandɛ ɔwo edzi no nokwar mu, na hɛndze yɛayɛ no emumuyɛ mu:
Nkyii so hɛn ahemfo, hɛn mbapɔmba, hɛn asɔfoe, na hɛn egyanom so, woenndzi wo mbra do, eso woenntsie wo mbransɛm na w’adasesɛm a edze dzii dase tsiaa hɔn no.
Osiandɛ wɔannsom wo wɔ hɔn ahendzi mu, na wo papayɛ kɛse a edze maa hɔn, na asaase tɛtɛr a ɔadɔ seradze a edze mae wɔ hɔn enyim no mu no, nkyii so wɔannsan emmfi hɔn ndzeyɛɛ bɔn no mu.
Hwɛ, yɛyɛ nkowaa ndɛ da yi, na asaase a ɔwo edze maa hɛn egyanom, dɛ wondzi no do aba na no do ndzepa bi no, dze, hwɛ, yɛyɛ nkowaa wɔ do.
Na ɔsow ndɔbaa pii dze ma ahemfo a osian hɛn bɔn ntsi ma edze hɔn esisi hɛn do no: Eso wɔwɔ tum wɔ hɛn nyimpadua do, na hɛn mbowa do, dɛ mbrɛ wɔpɛ, na yɛwɔ atseetsee kɛse mu.
Na iyi nyinara so mpo no yeridzi nokwar ahyɛmu, na yɛrekyerɛw; na hɛn mbapɔmba, na hɛn Levifo, na hɛn asɔfoe, rosɔw ano.
10: Afei hɔn a wɔsɔɔw ano nye yi, Nehemiah, Tishatha no, Hacaliah ba no, na Zedekiah;
Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah;
Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah;
Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch;
Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah;
Daniel, Ginnnethon, Baruch;
Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin;
Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: Woyinom nye asɔfo no.
Na Levifo no: Ɔnye dɛ, Joshua Azaniah ba no, Binnui a ofi Henadad mba mu, Kadmiel;
nahon nuanom, Sheba­niah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan;
Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah;
Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah;
Hodiah, Bani, Beninu.
Ɔman no mu etsitsir: Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani;
Bunni, Azgad, Bebai;
Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin;
Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur;
Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai;
Hariph, Anathoth, Nobai;
Magpiah, Meshullam, Hezir;
Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua;
Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah;
Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub;
Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek;
Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah;
na Ahiah, Hanan, Anan;
Malluch, Harim, Baanah.

Na ɔman no, nkaa no, Levifo, mbobowano-ahwɛfo, adwontofo, Nethinfo, na hɔn a wɔtseew hɔnho fi asaase do aman ho baa Nyankopɔn mbra ho no, hɔn yernom, hɔn mbabanyin, na hɔn mbabaa, obiara a ɔwɔ nyimdzii na ntseasee;

wɔbɛtakyeer hɔn nuanom, hɔn ekunyin no ho, na wɔhɛɛn ndom, na ntanka mu, dɛ wɔbɛnantsew Nyankopɔn mbra a wɔnam Nyankopɔn n’akowaa Moses do hyɛe no do, na wɔaahwɛ na wɔaayɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jehovah ne mbransɛm, na n’atsɛmbunsɛm, na n’ahyɛdze nyinara;
na dɛ yɛremmfa hɛn mbabaa mma no do aman, na eso yɛremmfa hɔn mbabaa mma hɛn mbabanyin;

na sɛ asaase no do aman no dze adzetɔndze anaa edzidzidze biara ba ahomgyeda no mu bɔtɔn a, yɛronntɔ no wɔ hɔn hɔ ahomgyeda no mu, anaa da krɔnkrɔn bi mu; na yebegyaa afe a otsīa esuon no, na akaperɛ biara si
Eso yɛhyehyɛɛ hɛnho mom, dɛ hɛnara yɛdze shekel mbumu ebiasa mu kor bɛma afrenhyia afrenhyia ma wɔdze ama hɛn Nyankopɔn fi ho som no;

ama kyerɛpaanoo, na daa edziban-afɔr, na daa ɔhyew-afɔr, ahomgyeda dze no, abosoom fofor dze no, ama afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ, na ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn na bɔn ho afɔr no dɛ wɔmfa mpata mma Israel no, na hɛn Nyankopɔn fi ho edwuma nyinara.

Na yɛtwee enyena ayɛyɛdze ho tonto, asɔfo, Levifo, na ɔman no, dɛ womfa mbrɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn fi mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn egyanom efiefi tsetsee, wɔ mber a wɔahyehyɛ mu, afrenhyia afrenhyia, ma wɔaasɔ no wɔ Ewuradze hen Nyankopɔn n’afɔrmbukyia no do, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mbra no mu no:
Na yɛdze hɛn asaase do nduadzewakan, na ndua ahorow nyinara n’amba nyinara mu nduadzewakan, bɛba Ewuradze fi mu, afrenhyia afrenhyia:

Na yɛdze hɛn mbabanyin, na hɛn mbowa mu mbakan so, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mbra no mu so, na hɛn anantwi na hɛn nguan mu mbakan, bɛba hɛn Nyankopɔn fi mu, dze abrɛ asɔfo a wɔsom wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn fi mu no:

Na yɛdze hɛn mbɔr, na hɛn mado afɔrbɔdze, na ndua horow nyinara n’aba, nsã na ngo mu nduadzewakan no bɛba, dze abrɛ asɔfo no, ma wɔdze aaba hɛn Nyankopɔn fie mpia no mu; na yɛdze hɛn asaase do ebupɛn du du no bɛma Levifo no; na hɔnara, Levifo no, na wɔgyegye ebupɛn du du no wɔ hɛn ekuayɛ nkurow nyinara mu.
Na Aaron ba, ɔsɔfo no, nkã Levifo no ho, aber a Levifo no regyegye ebupɛn du du no: Na Levifo no mfa ebupɛn du du no mu ebupen a otsia du no mbra hɛn Nyankopɔn fi mu mpia no mu, wɔ adzekoradan no mu.

Na Israelmba na Levifo no mfa eburow, nsã, na ngo mado-afɔrbɔdze no mbra mpia no mu, mbrɛ krɔnkrɔnbea ndzɛmba, na asɔfo a wɔsom, na mbobowanoahwɛfo, na adwontofo no wɔ: Na yɛrommpow hɛn Nyankopɔn fi no.
11: Na ɔman no mu mbapɔmba no tsenaa Jerusalem: Na ɔman no nkaa no dze, wɔtwee tonto dɛ wɔdze nyimpa du mu baako bɛtsena Jerusalem, kurow krɔnkrɔn no mu, na baakrɔn no so atsenatsena nkurow nkaa no mu.
Na ɔman no hyiraa mbarimba no a woyii hɔn yamu dze hɔnho mae dɛ wɔbɛtsena Jerusalem no,

Afei woyinom nye amansin mu etsitsir a wɔtsenaa Jerusalem no na Judah nkurow no mu dze, obiara tsenaa n’enyadze do wɔ hɔn nkurow do, ɔnye dɛ, Israel asɔfɔ, na Levifo na Nethinfo, na Solomon no nkowaa mba no.
Na Jerusalem hɔ na Judahmba no mu bi, na Benjaminmba no mu bi tsenae. Judahmba no mu; Athaiah, Uzziah ba no, Zechariah ba no, Amariah ba no, Shephatiah ba no, Mahalalel ba no a ofi Perezmba no mu no;
na Maaseiah, Baruch ba no, Col-hozeh ba no, Hazaiah ba no, Adaiah ba no, Joiarib ba no, Zechariah ba no, Shilonnyi ba no.
Perezmba nyinara a wɔtsenaa Jerusalem no wɔyɛ mbarimba ahaanan eduosia awɔtwe a wɔyɛ ndam.
Na Benjaminmba nye yi: Shallu, Meshullam ba no, Joed ba no, Pedaiah ba no, Kolaiah ba no, Maaseiah ba no, Ithiel ba no, Jeshaiah ba no.
Na ɔno n’ekyir Gabbai, Sallai, ahaakron eduonu awɔtwe.
Na Joel, Zichri ba no nye hɔn hwɛdofo: Na Judah, Hassenuah ba no, nye nyia otsia ebien a ɔhwɛ kurow no do.
Asɔfo no mu: Jedaiah, Joiarib ba no, Jachin.
Seraiah, Hiikiah ba no, Meshullam ba no, Zadok ba no, Meraioth ba no, Ahitub ba no, Nyankopɔn fi mu panyin no,
na hɔn nuanom a wɔyɛ ofi no mu edwuma no, ahaawɔtwe eduonu ebien: Na Adaiah, Jeroham ba no, Pelaliah ba no, Amzi ba no, Zechariah ba no, Pashhur ba no, Malchijah ba no,
na no nuanom, egyanom efiefi etsitsir, ahaenu eduanan ebien: Na Amashsai, Azarel ba no, Ahzai ba no, Meshillemoth ba no, Immer ba no,
na hɔn nuanom, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, ɔha eduonu awɔtwe: Na hɔn hwɛdofo nye Zabdiel, Haggedolira ba no.
Na Levifo no mu: Shemaiah, Hasshub ba no, Azrikam ba no, Hashabiah ba no, Bunni ba no;
na Shabbethai na Jozabad a wofi Levifo mu etsitsir no mu, hɔn na wɔhwɛ Nyankopɔn fie edwuma no do,
na Mattaniah, Mica ba no, Zabdi ba no, Asaph ba no a ɔyɛ otsitsir a ɔhyɛ mpaabɔ mu ndaasema ase no, na Bakbukiah a odzi do wɔ no nuanom mu no; na Abda, Shammua ba no, Galal ba no, Jeduthun ba no.
Levifo nyinara a wɔwɔ kurow krɔnkrɔn no mu no wɔyɛ ahaenu eduowɔtwe anan.
Nkyii so mbobowanoahwɛfo no, Akkub, Talmon, na hɔn nuanom a wɔweɔn nkuropon ano no, wɔyɛ ɔha eduosuon ebien.
Na Israel nkaa no, asɔfo no, Levifo no, wɔwowɔ Judah nkurow no nyinara mu, obiara tse n’egyapadze do.
Nethinfo no dze wɔtsenaa Ophel: Na Ziha na Gishpa na wɔhwɛ Nethinfo no do.
Na Levifo do ɔhwɛfo so a ɔwɔ Jerusalem nye Uzzi, Bani ba no, Hashabiah ba no, Mattaniah ba no, Mica ba no, Asaphmba no mu adwontofo no, wɔhwɛ Nyankopɔn fi mu edwuma no do.
Na ɔhen hɔ mbrasɛm bi wɔ hɔn ho, na wɔaahyɛ edzidzidze bi ama adwontofo no, dɛ mbrɛ da biara regye.
Na Pethahiah, Meshezabel ba no a ofi Judah ba Zerah mba mu no, na ɔdze ɔhen no nsaano wɔ ɔman no ho nsɛm nyinara mu.
Na ɔwɔ nkurobaase, nye hɔn nhaban ho dze, Judahmba no mu bi tsenatsenaa Kiriath-arba na no nkuroba mu, na Dibon na no nkuroba mu, na Jekabzeel na no nkuroba mu;
na Joshua, na Moladah, na Bethpelet;
na Hazar-shual, na Beer-sheba na no nkuroba mu;
na Ziklag, na Meconah na no nkuroba mu;
na En-rimmon, na Zorah, na Jarmuth;
Zanoah, Adullam, na hɔn nkurobaase, Lachish na ne nhaban, Azekah na no nkuroba. Nna wɔtsenatsenae fi Beer-sheba kodur Hinnom bɔnsa mu.
Benjaminmba so tsenae fi Geba araa kɔr Michmash na Aija, na Beth-el na no nkuroba mu.
Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah;
Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim;
Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat;
Lod, na Ono, edwimfo bɔnsa mu.
Na Levifo no mu, nkyekyɛmu bi a wɔyɛ Judah dze no bi kɛkaa Benjamin ho.
12: Afei woyinom nye asɔfo na Levifo a wɔnye Zerubbabel, Shealtiel ba no, na Joshua sii mu kɔree no: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra;
Amariah, Malluch, Hattush;
Shecaniah, Rehum, Mereraoth;
Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah;
Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah;
Shemaiah, na Joiarib, Jedaiah;
Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. Woyinom nye asɔfo no na hɔn nuanom no mu etsitsir wo Joshua nda mu.
Nkyii so Levifo no: Joshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, na Mattaniah a ɔhwɛ ndaasema no do, ɔnoara na no nuanom.
Eso Bakbukiah na Unno, hɔn nuanom na wodzi hɔn tsentsendo wɔ ɔweɔn no mu.
Na Joshua woo Joiakim, na Joiakim woo Eliashib, na Eliashib woo Joiada,
na Joiada woo Jonathan, na Jonathan woo Jaddua.
Na Joiakim nda mu asɔfo no, egyanom efiefi etsitsir no nye yi: Seraiah dze, Meraiah; Jeremiah dze, Hananiah;
Ezra dze, Meshullam; Amariah dze, Tehohanan;
Malluchi dze, Jonathan; Shebaniah dze, Joseph;
Harim dze, Adna; Meraioth dze, Helkai;
Iddo dze, Zechariah; Ginnethon dze, Meshullam;
Abijah dze, Zichri; Miniamin dze, Moadiah dze, Piltai;
Bilgah dze, Shammua; Shemaiah dze, Jehonathan;
Joiarib dze, Mattenai; Jedaiah dze, Uzzi;
Sallai dze, Kallai; Amok dze, Eber;
Hilkiah dze, Hashabiah; Jedaiah dze, Nethanel.
Levifo no, Eliashib, Joiada, na Johanan, na Jaddua, nda no mu no, na wɔkyerɛɛw egyanom efiefi etsitsir no: Asɔfo no so wɔ Persianyi Darius n’ahendzi no mu.
Levifo mba no, egyanom efiefi etsitsir no, wɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu araa dze bodur Eliashib ba Johanan ne nda no mu.

Na Levifo mu etsitsir no: Heshabiah, Sherebiah, na Joshua, Kadmiel ba no, ɔnye hɔn nuanom a wodzii hɔn tsentsendo, dɛ woyi ayɛw na wɔda ase, dɛ mbrɛ Nyame nyimpa David ne mbrasɛm no tse, aweɔmfo na aweɔmfo.
Mattaniah, na Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talraon, Akkub, na wɔyɛ mbobowanoahwɛfo wɔ nkuropon ano ndzekoraadan no mu.
Iyinom wɔ Joiakim, Joshua ba no, Jozadak ba no, nda mu, na ambrado Nehemiah, na ɔsɔfo Ezra, ɔkyerɛwfo no nda mu.

Na Jerusalem afasu no no mbueidapa no, wɔhwehwɛɛ Levifo no wɔ hɔn tsenabew nyinara, dɛ wɔdze hɔn reba Jerusalem, ma wɔdze ndaasema na ɔnye ndwom, ɔnye nkasaa, mbɛntaasanku, na ɔnye nsankutsen, eedzi mbueidapa no enyigye mu.
Na adwontofomba no boaboaa hɔn ano hyiaa fi tɛtɛr a abɔ Jerusalem ho aprɔw no mu, na Netophathfo nkurobaase;
eso wofi Beth-gilgal, na Geba nkwaado na Azmaveth; osiandɛ adwontofo no akyekyer nkuroba ama hɔnho dze abɔ Jerusalem ho aprɔw.
Na asɔfo na Levifo no tseew hɔnho: Na wɔtseew ɔman no, na nkuropon no, na fasu no ho.
Nna medze Judah mbapɔmba no fowee baa fasu no do, na miyii ekuw akɛse ebien a wɔda ase na wɔtow santsen nantsew sisii hɔ; no mu kor faa enyimfa wɔ fasu no do ɔdze kɔ sumina kuropon no ano:
Na Hoshaiah, na Judah mbapɔmba no mu fã na wodzi hɔn ekyir,
na Azariah, Ezra, na Meshullam,
Judah, na Benjamin, na Shemaiah, na Jeremiah,
na asɔfomba no mu binom dzedze mbɛn: Zechariah, Jonathan ba no, Shemaiah ba no, Mattaniah ba no, Micaiah ba no, Zaccur ba no, Asaph ba no;
na no nuanom, Shemaiah, na Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, na Judah, Hanani, wɔdzedze Nyame nyimpa David ne nsanku adwontondzɛmbano; na kyerɛwfo Ezra dzi hɔn enyim:
Na nsunyiwa kuropon no ano, na hɔn enyim tsentsendo no, wɔfoow David kurow ntwer no, na fasu no n’afowee no, wɔ David fi no n’etsifi, mekyerɛ ɔdze kɔ nsu kuropon no nkyɛn boka afamu.
Na hɔn a wɔda ase kuw kor no so sii mu kehyiaa hɔn, nna mo so midzii hɔn ekyir, ɔnye ɔman no fã no, wɔ fasu no do, dze kesi mfononoo abantsentsen no do, mekyerɛ ɔdze kɔ fasu tɛtɛr no do;

na Ephraim kuropon no do, na kuropon dadaw no do, na enara kuropon no ho, na Hananel abantsentsen na Hammeah abantsentsen no do araa dze kodu nguan kuropon no ano: Na woke gy maa adaduafo dan kuropon no ano dzinn.
Nna hɔn a wɔda ase ekuw ebien no kegyinaa Nyankopɔn fi no mu, na emi, na mpanyimfo no fã a wɔkã mo ho no:
Na asɔfo no, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, na Hananiah, wɔdzedze mbɛn;
na Maaseiah, na Shemaiah, na Eleazar, na Uzzi, na Jehohanan, na Malchijah, na Elam, na Ezer. Na adwontofo no, wɔnve hɔn hwɛdofo Jezrahiah, memaa hɔn ndze do ma wɔtsee.
Na wɔbobɔɔ afɔr akɛse da no, na hɔn enyi gyee; osiandɛ Nyankopɔn dze enyigye kɛse ama hɔn enyi agye; na mbaa na mbofra no so enyi gye ma wɔtsee Jerusalem enyigye no ne nkã wɔ ekyir noho ara.

Na da no ara na woyiyii mbarimba binom sisii akoradze, madoafɔr, nduadzewakan, na ebupɛn du du mpia no do, dɛ wɔmboaboa kyɛfa a mbra no hyɛe dze maa asɔfo na Levifo no ano ngu mu, dɛ osiandɛ Judah nyaa asɔfo na Levifo a wɔhyehyɛɛ hɔn no ho enyigye.
Na wɔhwɛɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn ahwɛdodze no, na ahoguar ahwɛdodze no, na dɛmara so na adwontofo no na mbobowanoahwɛfo no so yɛe, dɛ mbrɛ David na ne ba Solomon mbrasɛm no tse.
Osiandɛ tsetsefo David na Asaph nda mu, wɔhyehyɛɛ adwontofo, na Nyankopɔn ayɛyi na ndaasema do etsitsir.

Na Zerubbabel nda mu, na Nehemiah nda mu no, Israel nyinara memaa adwontofo na mbobowanoahwɛfo no kyɛfa, dɛ mbrɛ da biara regye: Na wɔdze sii nkyɛn maa Levifo no; na Levifo no so dze sii nkyɛn maa Aaronmba no.
13: Da no ara mu na wɔkenkaan Moses nwoma no mu wɔ ɔman no asomu; na wohun dɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mu dɛ, rama Ammonnyi na Moabnyi nnhɛn Nyankopɔn ne baguaa mu dabiarada;
osiandɛ wɔammfa edziban na nsu emmbehyia Israelmba kwan, na mbom wɔkɔbɔɔ Balaam paa tsiaa hɔn, dɛ ɔmbɔdom hɔn, naaso hɛn Nyankopɔn daan ndom no nhyira.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔtsee mbra no, nna woyiyii amamforafo no nyinara fii Israel mu.
Afei iyi nnyae mmbae no, ɔsɔfo Eleashib a wɔdze no sii hɛn Nyankopɔn fie mpia no do no, ɔnye Tobiah ayɛ kor ntsi,

oesiesie pia kɛse bi dze ama no, wɔ mbrɛ nkan no wɔdze edziban ayɛyɛdze, krɔbow, na ndzɛmba ndzɛmba, na eburow, nsã, na ngo mu ebupɛn du du a wɔahyɛ dɛ wɔmfa mma Levifo, na adwontofo, na mbobowanoahwɛfo no; na mado-afɔr a wɔdze ma asɔfo no, sie no.
Na aber yi nyinara mu no nna minnyi Jerusalem: Osiandɛ Babylonhen Artaɛerɛes n’afe a otsīa eduasa ebien mu no nna mokɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn; na nda bi ekyir no na mibisaa ɔhen hɔ kwan:
Na mebaa Jerusalem, na mubohun mbusu a Eliashib dze abɔ Tobiah, dɛ oesiesie pia ama no wɔ Nyankopɔn fie abanguado no.
Na ɔyɛɛ me awerɛhow dodow: Dɛm ntsi miyiyii Tobiah fidua mu ndzɛmba no nyinara fii pia no mu towee gui.
Nna mehyɛe ma wɔhohoor mpia no mu: Na medze Nyankopɔn ne ndzɛmba no sanee baa hɔ bio, ɔnye edziban ayɛyɛdze na krɔbɔw no.
Na muhun dɛ Levifo kyɛpɛn no wɔammfa amma hon; na Levifo na adwontofo no a wɔyɛ edwuma no woeguanguan ma obiara kɔ ne haban mu.
