Nna menye mpanyimfo no hamee, na mesee dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔapow Nyankopɔn fi yi? Na mopoon hɔn boaa ano, na medze hɔn sisii hɔn ananmu.
Nna Judah nyinara dze eburow na nsã na ngo ebupɛn du du bae boguu adzekoradze no mu.

Na mehyɛɛ adzekoradzehwɛfo wɔ ndzekoradze no do, ɔsɔfo Shelemiah, kyerɛwfo Zadok, na Pedaiah a ofi Levifo no mu: Na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Hanan, Zaccur ba no, Mattaniah ba no wɔ: Osiandɛ wobuu hɔn anokwafo, na hɔn edwuma nye dɛ wɔkyekyɛ ma hɔn nuanom.
Me Nyankopɔn, kaa ma me wɔ iyi ho, na mma mmpepa me nyɛe pa a mayɛ mama me Nyankopɔn fi, na ne nsewhyɛ no.

Nda no mu na muhun Judah mu binom a wotsiatsia nsãtwer do ahomgyeda, na wɔdze eburow efiefi so ba, na wɔdze soasoa nsoaso; dɛ nsã so, na esikyireamba, na ndɔmba, na ndzesoadze ahorow nyinara a wɔdze ba Jerusalem ahomgyeda: Na midzii dase tsiaa hɔn wɔ da a wɔrotɔn edzidzidze no.
Na Tyre mbarimba so tsenaa hɔ a wɔdze enam, na adzetɔndze horow nyinara bae, na wɔbɔtɔɔn no ahomgyeda no maa Judahmba no, wɔ Jerusalem.
Nna menye Judah ekunyin no hamee, na mesee hɔn dɛ, ebɛn mbusu na hom robɔ, dze rugu ahomgyeda ho fi yi?
Ana hom egyanom annyɛ dɛm, ana hɛn Nyankopɔn ammfa mbusu yi nyinara ammba hɛn, na kurow yi do bi a? Naaso hom dze ebufuw bi so reba Israel do, dɛ worugu ahomgyeda ho fi.

Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Jerusalem nkuropon no mu rehyɛ ase ayɛ sum ansaana ahomgyeda rudu no, nna mehyɛɛ dɛ mbobow no wɔntotow mu, na mehyɛɛ dɛ mma wommbuebue gyedɛ ahomgyeda no etwa mu ana: Na medze mo nkowaa no mu binom sisii nkuropon no ano, amma adzesoa bi aammba mu ahomgyeda no.
Nna eguadzifo na adzetɔndze horow no nyinara atɔmfo no, soɛsoɛɛ Jerusalem nkuropon no ekyir prɛko anaa mprɛnu.
Nna midzii dase tsiaa hɔn, na mesee hɔn dɛ, ɔye dɛn ntsi na hom soɛsoɛ deda fasu no ekyir? Sɛ hom yɛ dɛm bio a, medze nsa mobɔto hom do. Ofitsi ber no, wɔammba ahomgyeda bio.
Na mehyɛɛ Levifo no dɛ wɔntsew hɔnho, na wɔmbra mbɔhwɛ kuropon no ano, ma wɔntsew ahomgyeda no ho. Me Nyankopɔn, iyi so kaa ma me, na kora mo do dɛ mbrɛ w’adɔyɛ ne kɛseyɛ tse.
Nda no mu so na muhun Judahfo a wɔawarwar Ashdod mu mbaa, Ammon mu mbaa, na Moab mu mbaa:
Na hɔn mba kasa Ashdod kasa fã, na wonntum nnkasa Judahfo kasaa, na mbom dɛ mbrɛ ɔman na ɔman kasaa tse.

Na menye hɔn hamee na modoom hɔn, na mobobɔɔ hɔn mu binom, na mututuu hɔn nhwi na memaa wɔdze Nyankopɔn dzii nsew, dɛ, hom remmfa hom mbabaa mmema hɔn mbabanyin, na hom remmfa hɔn mbabaa mmema hom mbabanyin, anaa homara homho awar.

Ana nnyɛ iyinom na Israelhen Solomon nam do yɛɛ bɔn no bi? Naaso amanaman dodowara mu ɔhen biara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔno, na nyimpa a ne Nyankopɔn do no, na Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ no hen wɔ Israel nyinara do: Naaso ono mpo na ananaben wɔmaa ɔyɛɛ bɔn.
Aso yentsie hom dɛ yɛbɛyɛ bɔn kɛse yi nyinara, ma yaafom hɛn Nyankopɔn wɔ mbaa ananaben awarwar mu anaa?
Na sɔfopanyin Eliashib ba, Joiadamba no mu baako, ɔyɛ Horonnyi Sanballat n’asew: Dɛm ntsi mepaam no fii mo do.
Me Nyankopɔn, kaa ma hɔn, osiandɛ woegu asɔfodzi mo ho fi, na asɔfodzi ahyɛmu no, na Levifo no ahyɛmu no ho fi.
Dɛm na metseew hɔn ho fii ahɔho nyinara ho, na medze asɔfo na Levifo no mu ahwɛdzehwɛfo sisii hɔ, obiara wɔ n'edwuma mu;
na mber a wɔahyehyɛ no mu, enyena ayɛyɛdze no dze, na nduadzewakan no dze no. Me Nyankopɔn, kaa ma me, wɔ yie do

1: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses wɔ Sinai sar do, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, wofii Egypt asaase do firii no n'ekyir afe a otsia ebien no mu, bosoom a otsia ebien no ne da a odzi kan no, dɛ,
Hom mbu Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara ano, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, na mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, ɔbanyin biara, mbrɛ wɔtse nkorkor;
hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, Israel mu hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara, ɔwo na Aaron wɔnkan hɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse.
Na ebusuakuw biara mu ɔbanyin bi nka hom ho; kor biara a ɔyɛ n'egyanom ofi mu otsitsir.
Na mbanyin a wombegyina hom nkyɛn no hɔn edzin nye yi: Reuben dze; Shedeur ne babanyin Elizur.
Simeon dze; Zurishaddai ne babanyin Shelumiel.
Judah dze; Amminadab ne babanyin Nahshon.
Issachar dze; Zuar ne babanyin Nethanel.
Zebulun dze; Helon ne babanyin Eliab.
Joseph ne mba no dze; Ephraim dze; Ammihud ne babanyin Elishama: Manasseh dze; Pedahzur ne babanyin Gamaliel.
Benjamin dze; Gideoni ne babanyin Abidan.
Dan dze; Ammishaddai ne babanyin Ahiezer.
Asher dze; Ochran ne babanyin Pagiel.
Gad dze; Deuel ne babanyin Eliasaph.
Naphtali dze; Enan ne babanyin Ahira.
Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔfrɛɛ hɔn wɔ mboanofo no mu, hɔn egyanom ebusuakuw mu mbapɔmba no; wuyɛ Israel mpem mpem mu etsitsir.
Na Moses nye Aaron faa mbanyin a wɔabobɔ hɔn edzin yi:

Na wohyiaa mboanofo no nyinara boaa ano wɔ bosoom a otsia no ne da a odzi kan no mu, na wɔkyerɛɛ hɔn asefo dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, dɛ mbrɛ wɔtse nkorkor.
Dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no, dɛmara na ɔkaan hɔn wɔ Sinai sar no do.

Na Israel n'abakan Reuben, ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, na mbrɛ wɔtse nkorkor, ɔbanyin biara a oedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara;
hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, wɔ Reuben ebusuakuw mu, wɔyɛ mpemeduanan esia na ahaenum.

Simeon ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, na mbrɛ wɔtse nkorkor, ɔbanyin biara a oedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara;
hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, wɔ Simeon ebusuakuw mu, wɔyɛ mpemeduonum akron na ahaasa.
Gad ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara:
Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, wɔ Gad ebusuakuw mu, wɔyɛ mpemeduanan enum ahaesia na eduonum.
Judah ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara;
hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, wɔ Judah ebusuakuw mu, wɔyɛ mpemeduosuon anan na ahaesia.
Issachar ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara;
hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, wɔ Issachar ebusuakuw mu, wɔyɛ mpemeduonum anan na ahaanan.
Zebulun ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara;
hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, wɔ Zebelun ebusuakuw mu, wɔyɛ mpemeduonum esuon na ahaanan.

Joseph ne mba, dɛ, Ephraim dɛ mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara;
hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, wɔ Ephraim ebusuakuw mu, wɔyɛ mpemeduanan na ahaenum.
Manasseh ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara;
hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, wɔ Manasseh ebusuakuw mu, wɔyɛ mpemeduasa ebien na ahaenu.
Benjamin ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara;
Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, wɔ Benjamin ebusuakuw mu, wɔyɛ mpemeduasa enum na ahaanan.
Dan ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinaa;
hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, wɔ Dan ebusuakuw mu wɔyɛ mpemeduosia ebien na ahaesuon.
Asher ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara;
hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, wɔ Asher ebusuakuw mu, wɔyɛ mpemeduanan biako na ahaenum.
Naphtali ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara;
hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, wɔ Naphtali ebusuakuw mu, wɔyɛ mpemeduonum ebiasa na ahaanan.
Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn no, dza Moses na Aaron, nye Israel mbapɔmba no a wɔyɛ mbanyin duebien no, kanee no: Wogyinagyinaa hɔn egyanom efi ananmu nkorkor.
Dɛm ntsi hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Israelmba mu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee nyinara, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa wɔ Israel mu;
mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ mpemahaesia na mpensa na ahaenum eduonum.
Levifo no dze, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom ebusuakuw tse no, wɔannkan hɔn ammfora hɔn.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛ Moses dɛ,
Levi ebusaukuw nkotoo na mma nnkan, nkyii so mma mmbu hɔn dodow ano mmfora Israelmba:

Mbom woara fa Levifo no si dase ntamadan no na no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, na dza odzi wɔ no nyinara do: hɔn na wɔnsoa ntamadan no, na no ho ndzɛmba nyinara; na wɔnyɛ ho edwuma, na wɔmbɔ nseraban nhyia ntamadan no ho.
Na sɛ ntamadan no rutu akɔ kan a, Levifo no na wɔmpa: Na sɛ ntamadan no wɔrekyer no nsera a, Levifo no na wonsi: Na ɔhɔho a ɔba ho no wonku no.
Na Israelmba nombɔ hɔn asesee, nyimpa biara wɔ nankasa ne nseraban do, na nyimpa biara wɔ nankasa ne frankaa ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse.
Levifo no dze wɔnkyer nsera wɔ dase ntamadan no ho nhyia, amma ebufuw bi aammba Israelmba mboanofo no do: Na Levifo no nhwɛ dase ntamadan ahwɛdze no do.
Dɛm na Israelmba no yɛe; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no nyinara, dɛmara na wɔyɛe.
2: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛ Moses na Aaron dɛ,
Israelmba no nkyer nsera wɔ nyimpa biara nankasa ne frankaa ho, wɔ hɔn egyanom efi nsɛnkyerɛdze do: Ehyiadzibuw no ne tsentsendo na wɔnkyer hɔn nsera no nhyia.
Na hɔn a wɔnkyer nsera wɔ boka afamu a odzi kɔ wipuei no nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Judah nseraban do frankaa ho no, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse: Na Amminadab ne babayin Nashon na ɔnyɛ Judahmba ɔsafohen panyin.
Na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduosuon anan na ahaesia.
Na hɔn a wɔnkyer nsera ntoa no do nye Issachar ebusuakuw: Na Zuar ne babanyin Nethanel na ɔnyɛ Issacharmba ɔsafohen panyin:
Na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduonum anan na ahaanan:
Na Zebulun ebusuakuw: Na Helon ne babanyin Eliab na ɔnyɛ Zebulunmba ɔsafohen panyin:
Na no dɛm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduonum esuon na ahaanan.
Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Judah nseraban do nyinara wɔyɛ mpem ɔha na mpemeduawɔtwe esia na ahaanan, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse. Hɔn na wondzi kan ntu.
Pomu afamu na Reuben nseraban do frankaa ndzi dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse: Na Shedeur ne babanyin Elizur na ɔnyɛ Reubenmba ɔsafohen panyin.
Na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduanan esia na ahaenum.
Na hɔn a wɔnkyer nsera ntoa no do nyɛ Simeon ebusuakuw: Na Zurishaddai ne babanyin Shelumiel na ɔnyɛ Simeonmba ɔsafohen panyin:
Na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduonum akron na ahaasa:
Na Gad ebusuakuw: Na Reuel ne babanyin Eliasaph na ɔnyɛ Gadmba ɔsafohen panyin:
Na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduanan enum na ahaesia eduonum.
Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Reuben nseraban do nyinara wɔyɛ mpem ɔha na mpemeduonum biako na ahaanan eduonum, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse. Na hɔn na wondzi otsīa ebien ntu.
Nkyii so ehyiadzibuw no, nye Levifo nseraban no ntu ndzi nseraban nseraban no ne finimfin: Dɛ mbrɛ wɔbɔ nseraban no, dɛmara na wontu, nyimpa biara wɔ ne dzibew, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mfrankaa no tse.
Ephraim ne nseraban do frankaa ndzi anee afamu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse: Na Ammihud ne babanyin Elishama na ɔnyɛ Ephraimmba ɔsafohen panyin.
Na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduanan na ahaenum.
Na Manasseh ebusuakuw ntoa no do: Na Pedahzur ne bababyin Gamaliel na ɔnyɛ Manassehmba ɔsafohen panyin.
Na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduasa ebien na ahaemu:
Na Benjamin ebusuakuw no: Na Gideoni ne babanyin Abidan na ɔnyɛ Benjaminmba ɔsafohen panyin:
Na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduasa enum na ahaanan.
Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Ephraim nseraban do nyinara wɔyɛ mpem ɔha na mpemawɔtwe na ɔha, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse. Na hɔn na wondzi otsīa ebiasa ntu.
Dan ne nseraban do frankaa ndzi kwaamu afamu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse: Na Ammishaddai ne babanyin Ahiezer na ɔnyɛ Danmba ɔsafohen panyin.
Na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduosia ebien na ahaesuon.
Na hɔn a wɔnkyer nsera ntoa no do nye Asher ebusuakuw: Na Ochran ne babanyin Pagiel na ɔnyɛ Ashermba ɔsafohen panyin:
Na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduanan biako na ahaenum:
Na Naphthali ebusuakuw no: Na Enan ne babanyin Ahira na ɔnyɛ Naphthalimba ɔsafohen panyin:
Na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduonum ebiasa na ahaanan.
Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Dan ne nseraban do nyinara wɔyɛ mpem ɔha na mpemeduonu esuon na ahaesia. Hɔn na wondzi ekyir ntu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mfrankaa no tse.
Iyinom nye Israelmba mu hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee: Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ nseraban nseraban do dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse nyinara wɔyɛ mpemahaesia na mpensa na ahaenum eduonum.
Levifo no dze, wɔannkan hɔn ammfora Israelmba no; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
Dɛm na Israelmba no yɛe; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no nyinara, dɛmara na wɔkyeer nsera dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mfrankaa no tsee, na dɛmara so na wotui, obiara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee.
3: Afei iyinom nye Aaron nye Moses hɔn ebusuasantsen wɔ da a Ewuradze nye Moses kasae, wɔ kokwaa Sinai do no.
Na iyinom nye Aaron ne mbabanyin no hɔn edzin; Nadab abakan no, nye Abihu, Eleazar, nye Ithamar.
Iyinom nye Aaron ne mbabanyin, asɔfo a wɔseraa hɔn ngo a wotuu hɔn sii nkyɛn dɛ wondzi asɔfo no, hɔn edzin.
Na Nadab nye Abihu wuwui wɔ Ewuradze enyim, aber a wɔdze ananagya baa Ewuradze enyim, wɔ Sinai sar do no, na woennya mba: Na Eleazar nye Ithamar dzii asɔfo wɔ hɔn egya Aaron enyim.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Fa Levi ebusuakuw no bɛn, na fa hɔn begyina ɔsofo Aaron enyim ma wɔsom me.
Na wɔnhwɛ n'ahwɛdze do, nye mboanofo no nyinara ahwɛdze no do wɔ ehyiadzibuw no enyim, mfa nyɛ ntamadan no ho edwuma no.
Na wɔnhwɛ ehyiadzibuw no ne ndzɛmba no nyinara, nye ntamdan no ho edwuma no.
Na fa Levifo no ma Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no: Wɔdze hɔn ama no koraa wɔ Israelmba no afamu.
Na yi Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no si hɔ, na wɔnhwɛ hɔn asɔfodzi no do: Na ɔhɔho a ɔba ho no wonku no.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Na emi, hwɛ, mafa Levifo no efi Israelmba mu mbakan a wobue ɔyafun mu no nyinara ananmu; na Levifo no nyɛ medze:

Na mbakan nyinara yɛ medze; da a mobobɔɔ Egypt asaase do mbakan nyinara no na metseew Israel mu mbakan nyinara no na metseew Israel mu mbakan nyinara ho maa moho, nyimpa nye abowa nyina: Wɔyɛ medze; emi nye Ewuradze.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses wɔ Sinai sar do dɛ,
Kan Levimba no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi, nye hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Ɔbanyin biara a oedzi bosoom nye ekyir no kan hɔn.
Na Moses kaan hɔn dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm tse, dɛ mbrɛ wɔhyɛɛ no no.
Na iyinom nye Levi mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn edzin no tse; Gershon, nye Kohath, nye Merari.
Na iyinom nye Gershon ne mbabanyin edzin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee; Libni nye Shimei.
Na Kohath mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee; Amram, nye Izhar, Hebron nye Uzziel.
Na Merari mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee; Mahli nye Mushi. Iyinom nye Levifo ebusua ebusua no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi no tsetsee.
Gershon dze nye Libnifo ebusua, nye Shimeifo ebusua: Iyinom nye Gershonfo ebusua ebusua no.
Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, dɛ mbrɛ mbanyin no nyinara a woedzi bosoom nye ekyir no hɔn dodow tse no, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no wɔyɛ mpemesuon nye ahaenum.
Gershonfo ebusua ebusua no nkyer nsera wɔ ntamadan no ekyir anee afamu.
Na Lael ne babanyin Eliasaph na ɔnyɛ Gershonfo egyanom efi mu ɔsafohen panyin
Na Gershon ne mbabanyin no hɔn ahwɛdze wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu nye ntamadan no, nye Buw no, n'akatado, nye ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano nkataano,
nye pampan no ne nsensɛnho, nye pampan no n'abowano nkataano no, dza ɔwɔ ntamadan no ho, na otwa afɔrmbukyia no ho hyia no, nye ne ntampeehoma wɔ no ho edwuma nyinara ho.
Na Kohath dze nye Amramfo ebusua, nye Izharfo ebusua, nye Hebronfo ebusua, nye Uzzielfo ebusua: Iyinom nye Kohathfo ebusua ebusua no.
Dɛ mbrɛ mbanyin nyinara a woedzi bosoom nye ekyir no hɔn dodow tse no, wɔyɛ mpemawɔtwe nye ahaesia a wɔhwɛ ahotseweebea ahwɛdodze no do.
Kohath ne mbabanyin ebusua ebusua no nkyer nsera wɔ ntamadan no nkyɛn wɔ pomu afamu.
Na Uzziel ne mbabanyin Elizaphan a ɔnyɛ ɔsafohen panyin wɔ Kohathfo ebusua ebusua no hɔn egyanom ofi mu.
Na ahwɛdze nye adaka no, nye ɔpon no, nye kandzedua no, nye afɔrmbukyia no, nye ahotseweebea ndzɛmba no a wɔdze som no nye nkataano no, nye no ho edwuma nyinara.
Na ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Eleazar na ɔnyɛ ɔsafohen panyin wɔ Levifo asafohemfo mu, na ɔnhwɛ hɔn a wɔhwɛ ahotseweebea no do ahwɛdodze do no do.
Merari dze nye Mahifo ebusua, nye Mushfo ebusua: Iyinom nye Merari ebusua ebusua no.
Na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, dɛ mbrɛ mbanyin no nyinara a woedzi bosoom nye ekyir no hɔn dodow tse no, wɔyɛ mpemesia nye ahaenu.
Abihail ne babanyin Zuriel nye Merari ebusua ebusua no mu egyanom ofi mu ɔsafohen panyin: Wɔnkyer nsera wɔ ntamadan no nkyɛn wɔ kwaamu afamu.
Na ahwɛdodze a wɔahyɛ ama Merari ne mbabanyin no nye ntamadan no ne ntaabow, nye ne ndaban, nye n'edum, nye ne ntaataese, nye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, nye no ho edwuma nyinara;
na pampan no n'edum a ehyia ho no, nye ne ntaease no, nye no mbɔfondua, nye ne ntampeehoma.

Na hɔn a wɔnkyer nsera wɔ ntamadan no enyim wɔ boka afamu, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no enyim a odzi kɔ wipuei no, nye Moses, nye Aaron nye ne mbabanyin a wɔhwɛ ahotseweebea ahwɛdodze no ma Israelmba ahwɛdodze no; na ɔhɔho a ɔba ho no wonku no.
Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Levifo mu nyinara a Moses nye Aaron nam Ewuradze mbrasɛm do kaan hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua no tse no, mbabanyin a woedzi bosoom nye ekyir no nyinara, wɔyɛ mpemeduonu ebien.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Kan Israelmba mu mbakan mbanyin a woedzi bosoom nye ekyir no nyinara, na bu hɔn edzin no dodow ano.
Na fa Levifo no ma me (emi nye Ewuradze) fa hyɛ Israelmba mu mbakan no nyinara ananmu.
Na Moses kaan Israelmba mu mbakan no nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ no no.
Na mbakan mbanyin a woedzidzi bosoom nye ekyir, dɛ mbrɛ edzin dodow no tse, wɔ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduonu ebien ahaenu eduosuon ebiasa.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛ Moses dɛ,
Fa Levifo no hyɛ Israelmba mu mbakan no nyinara ananmu, na fa Levifo ofiembowa no hyɛ hɔn ofiembowa no ananmu: Na Levifo no nyɛ medze; emi nye Ewuradze.
Na Israelmba mbakan ahaenu eduosuon ebiasa a wɔbor Levifo no hɔn dodow do no hɔn apondze no dze,
gyegye hɔn tsir shekel enum enum dɛ mbrɛ wɔtse nkorkor; mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse no na gye hɔn (Shekel ɔyɛ gerah enum):
Na fa sika no a wɔdze poon hɔn a wɔbor hɔn do no ma Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no.
Na Moses gyegyee apondze-sika no wɔ hɔn wɔbor hɔn a Levifo poon hɔn no hɔ:
Israelmba mbakan hɔ na ɔgyegyee sika no; shekel ɔpem ahaasa eduosia enum, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse:
Na Moses dze apondze-sika no maa Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm tse, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm tse, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
4: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ,
Bu Kohath ne mbabanyin no ano fa fi Levi mbabanyin no mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, nye hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee,
ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa nye ekyir do kodu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do, hɔn a wɔhɛn ɔsom no mu nyinara, kɛyɛ edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no.
Iyi nye Kohath ne mbabanyin no hɔn edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, wɔ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn ho:
Sɛ nseraban no rubotu a, Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no na wɔnkɔ mu, na wonkeyi ntwamutam nkataano no, na wɔmfa nkata dasedaka no do:
Na wɔmfa esukraman nwoma akatado nto do, na wɔmfa ɔtam a ne nyinara yɛ bibir nkata do, na wɔmfa no mpoma no nhyehyɛ mu.
Na wɔmfa tam bibir nkata ɔkyerɛpaanoo pon no do, na wɔmfa nkwansɛn no, nye ntser no nye nkora, nye nkuraba a wɔdze hue no nsisi do: Na daa paanoo no nsi do:
Na wɔmfa tam memen nkata do, na wɔmfa esukraman nwoma akatado nkata ho, na wɔmfa no mpoma no nhyehyɛ mu.
Na wɔmfa tam bibir, na wɔmfa nkata kandzea no ne kandzeadua nye ne nkandzea nye no ngo ntoaba nyinara a wɔdze som no ho:
Na wɔmfa ɔno nye no ho adze nyinara nhyɛ esukraman nwoma akatado mu, na wɔmfa nto pata no do.
Na wɔmfa tam bibir nkata sika afɔrmbukyia no do, na wɔmfa esukraman nwoma akatado nkata do, na wɔmfa no mpoma no nhyehyɛ mu:
Na wɔmfa ɔsom ho ndzɛmba nyinara a wɔdze som wɔ ahotseweebea no, na wɔmfa nhyɛ tam bibir mu, na wɔmfa esukraman nwoma akatado nkata ho, na wɔmfa nto pata no do.
Na wɔnsesaw nso no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, na wɔmfa tam ɔberdum nkata do:

Na wɔmfa no ho ndzɛmba nyinara a wɔdze som wɔ ho no ngu do, ogyasɛn, edzinam, nye nsofi, nye mbɛɛsen, afɔrmbukyia no ho ndzɛmba no nyinara; na wɔmfa esukraman nwoma akatado nkata do, na wɔmfa no mpoma no nhyehyɛ mu.

Na sɛ nseraban no rubotu, na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no ewie ahotseweebea no, nye ahotsewebea no ho ndzɛmba no nyinara do kata a; nna nkyii Kohath ne mbabanyin no mbra mbɔsoa: Ahotseweebea no dze mma wɔnnkã amma woeennwuwu. Ndzɛmba yi nye Kohath ne mbabanyin no hɔn adzesoa ehyiadzibuw no mu.

Na ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Eleazar n'ahwɛdodze nye kandzea no ho ngo no, nye nduhuanhuam no, nye daa daa edziban-afɔr no, nye ɔserango no, ntamadan no nyinara nye dza ɔwɔ mu no nyinara ahwɛdodze no, ahotseweebea no, nye no ho ndzɛmba no.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ,
Mma hom nntwa Kohathfo ebusua ebusua mu ebusuakuw no mmfi Levifo no mu:
Mbom dɛm na hom nyɛ mma hɔn, ama woeenya nkwa, na woeennwuwu, sɛ wɔbɛn krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn no a: Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no nhɛn mu, na wɔmfa hɔn nsisi obiara n'edwuma nye n'adzesoa ho:
Na hɔndze mma wɔnnhɛn mu nnkɔhwɛ ahotseweebea no dɛ enyi robɔ do mpo, amma woeennwuwu
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Bu Gershon mbabanyin no so ano, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi, nye hɔn ebusua tsetsee;
ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa nye ekyir do kodu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do na kan hɔn; hɔn a wɔhɛn mu kɔsom nyinara, dɛ wɔkɛyɛ edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no.
Iyi nye Gershonfo ebusua ebusua hɔn som, wɔ ɔsom mu nye ndzesoa soa mu:
Hɔn na wɔnsoa ntamadan no ne nsensɛnho atam no, nye ehyiadzibuw no, ne nkatado, nye esukraman nwoma akatado no a ɔwɔ no do ɔsor no, nye ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano nkataano;

nye pampan no ne nsensɛnho no, nye pampan no n'abotsen abowano nkataano, dza etwa ntamadan no nye afɔrmbukyia no ho ehyia no, nye ne ntampeehoma, nye no ho edwuma ho ndzɛmba nyinara, nye biribiara a wɔdze bɛyɛ no, no mu na wɔnsom.
Aaron nye ne mbabanyin mbrasɛm do na Gershonfo mbabanyin no nyɛ hɔn edwuma nyinara, wɔ hɔn adzesoa nyinara, nye hɔn edwuma nyinara mu: Na hom mfa hɔn adzesoa nyinara nhyɛ hɔn nsa ma wɔnhwɛ do.
Iyi nye Gershonfo mbabanyin ebusua ebusua edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu: Na hɔn ahwɛdodze wɔ ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Ithamar nsamu.
Merari ne mbabanyin no dze, kan hɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, nye hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee;
ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa nye ekyir do kodu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do na kan hɔn, obiara a ɔhɛn ɔsom no mu, dɛ ɔkɛyɛ edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no.
Na iyi nye hɔn adzesoa ahwɛdodze, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn edwuma nyinara tse wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu; ntamadan no ne ntaabow, nye n'adaban, nye n'edum, nye ne ngyinado,

na pampan no n'edum a etwa ho ehyia no, nye ne ngyinado, nye no mbɔfondua, nye ne ntampeehoma, ɔnye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, na ɔnye n'edwuma nyinara: Na hom mfa hɔn adzesoa ahwɛdodze ndzɛmba no mbɔ dzin nhyɛ hɔn nsa.
Iyi nye Merari mbabanyin ebusua ebusua edwuma, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn edwuma nyinara tse, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, wɔ ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Ithamar nsamu.
Na Moses nye Aaron nye mboanofo no mu mbapɔmba no kaan Kohathfo mbabanyin no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, nye hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee,
ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa nye ekyir do kodu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do, dɛ ɔkɛyɛ edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no:
Na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee no wɔyɛ mpemebien ahaesuon eduonum.
Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Kohathfo ebusua ebusua mu, hɔn a wɔsoom wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu nyinara a Moses nye Aaron nam Ewuradze mbrasɛm a ɔwɔ Moses nsamu no kanee no.
Na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Gershon mbabanyin mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, nye hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee,
ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa nye ekyir do kodu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do, obiara a ɔhɛn ɔsom no mu, dɛ ɔkɛyɛ edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no,
mehyerɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua, nye hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee no, wɔyɛ mpemebien nye ahaesia eduasa.
Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Gershon ne mbabanyin ebusua ebusua mu, hɔn a wɔsoom wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu nyinara a Moses nye Aaron nam Ewuradze mbrasɛm do kanee no.
Na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Merari mbabanyin ebusua ebusua mu, dɛ mbrɛ ebusua ebusua nye hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee,
ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa nye ekyir kodu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do, obiara a ɔhɛn ɔsom no mu, dɛ ɔkɛyɛ edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no,
mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tse no, wɔyɛ mpemebiasa nye ahaenu.
Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Merari ne mbabanyin ebusua ebusua a Moses nye Aaron nam Ewuradze mbrasɛm a ɔwɔ Moses nsamu no do kanee no.
Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Levifo mu nyinara a Moses nye Aaron nye Israel mbapɔmba no kanee, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, nye hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee,
ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa nye ekyir do kodu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do, obiara a ɔhɛn mu dɛ ɔkɛyɛ ɔsom edwuma, nye ndzesoa soa mu,
mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu, wɔyɛ mpemawɔtwe nye ahaenum eduawɔtwe.
Dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze mbrasɛm tse na wɔnam Moses nsa do kaan hɔn, obiara dɛ mbrɛ no som tse, nye mbrɛ n'adzesoa tse no ara: Dɛm na ɔkaan hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
5: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Hyɛ Israelmba ma wontu ɔkwatanyi biara, nye obiara a ɔwɔ ahosen, nye nyia biara a ɔdze fun egu noho fi, mfi nseraban no mu:
Ɔbanyin nye ɔbaa nyina na hom ntu hɔn, nseraban no ekyir na hom ntu hɔn nkogu; amma woeenngu hɔn nseraban a metse ne finimfin no ho fi.
Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dɛmara, na wotuu hɔn koguu nseraban ekyir: Dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses no, dɛmara na Israelmba no yɛe.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, sɛ ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa yɛ bɔn biara a adasa yɛ no bi, dze fom Ewuradze, na ɔkra no dzi so a;
ɔno wɔmpaa mu nka hɔn bɔn a wɔayɛ no: Na ontua n'asodzidze no imu, na ɔmfa no mu ebupɛn enum mu kor nto do, na ɔmfa mma nyia ɔamfom no edzi so no.

Mbom sɛ nyimpa no nnyi bɔgya bi a ɔbɛn no a wɔdze asodzidze bɛma no wɔ asodzi no ntsi a, asodzi no ho asodzidze a wɔyɛ ma Ewuradze no nyɛ ɔsofo no dze; nka mpata odwanyin no a wɔdze rebɛpata ama no no ho.
Na ɔtow-afɔr biara a ɔwɔ Israelmba adzekrɔnkrɔn nyinara mu a wɔdze brɛ ɔsɔfo no, nyɛ nedze.
Na nyimpa biara n'adzekrɔnkrɔn nyɛ nedze: Biribiara a nyimpa biara dze ma ɔsofo no, nedze ara na ɔnyɛ.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, sɛ ɔbanyin bi ne yer fi ne nkyɛn, na ɔkɔfom no,
na ɔbanyin bi nye no da dze no ho nsu ma no, na wɔdze suma wɔ no kun enyi do, na wosiw do, na ogu noho fi, na no ho ɔdasefo bi nnyi hɔ, nkyii so wɔannkyer no wɔ do;
na nyinkun sunsum ba no do, na ɔtwe ne yer no ho nyinkun, na ogu noho fi: Anaa sɛ nyinkun sunsum ba no do, na ɔtwe ne yer no ho nyinkun, na oenngu noho fi a:

Ɔno ɔbanyin no mfa ne yer no mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no, na ɔmfa no ho ayɛyɛdze mbra, atoko isiam ephah ebupɛn du mu kor; mma ɔmmfa ngo nngu do, na ɔmmfa krɔbɔw so nnto do; osiandɛ ɔyɛ nyinkun ho edziban-afɔr na nkaa ho edziban-afɔr, a wɔdze kaa emumyɛ.
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa no mbɛn, na ɔmfa no mbegyina Ewuradze enyim:
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa nsu krɔnkrɔn ngu dɛtse kuraba bi mu; na ɔsɔfo no mfa ntamadan no ne daadze huntuma bi, na ɔmfa ngu nsu no mu:
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ɔbaa no ngyina Ewuradze enyim, na ontutu na ɔbaa no ne tsinhwi ngu do, na ɔmfa nkaa edziban-afɔr no nhyɛ ne nsamu: Na ɔsɔfo no nkitsa nsu wenwen a ɔdze ndom ba no wɔ ne nsamu:
Na ɔsɔfo no mma ondzi nsew, na ɔnse ɔbaa no dɛ, sɛ ɔbanyin bi nnye wo nndae, na sɛ immfii wo kun nkyɛn nnkoguu ho fi a, wo ho nyɛ tɔtrɔtɔ wo nsu wenwen a ɔdze ndom ba yi ho:
Mbom sɛ efi wo kun nkyɛn, ber a ewar wo kun yi na sɛ ekogu woho fi, na ɔbanyin bi nye wo ada ka wo kun ho a:
Nkyii ɔsɔfo no mma ɔbaa no mfa ndom ntam ndzi nsew, na ɔsɔfo no nse ɔbaa no dɛ, Ewuradze nyɛ wo ndom nye ntam wɔ wo man mu, aber a Ewuradze bɛma w'aserɛ atotɔ mu, na wo yafun ahon;
na nsu ɔdze ndom ba yi akɛhɛn wo nson mu, na ɔama wo yafun ahon, na w'aserɛ atotɔ mu: Na ɔbaa no nse dɛ, Amen, Amen.
Na ɔsɔfo no nkyerɛw ndom yi wɔ nwoma mu, na ɔmpepa ngu nsu wenwen no mu:
Na ɔmma ɔbaa no nnom nsu wenwen a ɔdze ndom ba no: Na nsu a ɔdze ndom ba no nkɔ no mu nkɛyɛ wenwen.
Na ɔsɔfo no ngye nyinkun ho edziban-afɔr no wɔ ɔbaa no nsamu, na ɔntow edziban-afɔr no wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na ɔmfa mbra afɔrmbukyia no ho;
na ɔsɔfo no mfa edziban-afɔr no mu nsapuw, dɛ ne nkaadze, na ɔnhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, na n'ekyir no ɔmma ɔbaa no nnom nsu no.

Na aber a ɔama ɔanom nsu no, ɔno ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ oegu noho fi, na ɔayɛ bɔn etsia no kun a, nsu no a ɔdze ndom ba no bɛhɛn no mu akɛyɛ wenwen, na ne yafun ahon, na n'serɛ atotɔ mu: Na ɔbaa no ayɛ ndom wɔ ne man mu.
Na sɛ ɔbaa no ho enngu fi, na no ho tsew dze a; ɔno no ho bɛyɛ tɔtrɔtɔ, na oenyinsen ɔba.
Iyi nye nyinkun ho mbar, sɛ ɔyer bi fi no kun nkyɛn, na okogu noho fi;
anaa sɛ nyinkun sunsum ba ɔbanyin bi do, na ɔtwe ne yer ho nyinkun a; ɔno ɔmfa ɔbaa no mbegyina Ewuradze enyim, na ɔsɔfo no nyɛ no mbra yi mu adze nyinara.
Na ɔbanyin no ho bɛyɛ tɔtrɔtɔ wɔ emumuyɛ ho, na ɔbaa no asoa n'emumuyɛ.
6: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, sɛ ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa bi bɔ anohoba soronko, Nazirinyi anohoba, dɛ orutua noho dze ama Ewuradze a:
Ontua noho wɔ wenyin nye nsa dzendzen ho: Mma ɔnnom wentin kawee, anaa nsã dzendzen kawee, nkyii so mma ɔnnom esikyireamba nsa biara, na onndzi esikyireamba momon anaa guanee so.
N'ahotua nda nyinara mu mma onndzi biribiara a wɔdze wenyindua ho biribi ayɛ, no nsowee mu aba o, no ho ahon o.
N'ahotua anohoba nda nyinara mu no oyindam bi nnka ne tsir: Ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn nkodu dɛ nda a otuaa noho maa Ewuradze wɔ mu no bɔsō, osie etsimum.
Nda a oetua noho ama Ewuradze no nyinara mma ɔnnkɔ nyimpa fun bi ho.
Sɛ n'egya, anaa ne na, no nua anaa n'kyerɛbaa mpo wowuwu a, mma onnkogu noho fi: Osiandɛ n'ahotua a ɔdze ma Nyankopɔn no ɔwɔ n'etsifi.
N'ahotua nda nyinara ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn ma Ewuradze.
Na sɛ nyimpa bi wu awerɛfir mu wɔ ne nkyɛn, na ogu n'ahotua tsir ho fi a; ɔno onyi ne tsir wɔ n'ahoguar da no mu, da a otsia esuon no na onyi.
Na da a otsia awɔtwe no ɔmfa ntamram ebien, mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano:
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa kor mbɔ bɔn ho afɔr, na kor no so ɔmfa nyɛ ɔhyew-afɔr, na ɔmpata mma no, dɛ ɔafom wɔ fun no ho, na ɔntsew ne tsir ho da no ara.
Na ontua n'ahotua nda no mma Ewuradze, na ɔmfa eguambaanyin a oedzi afrenhyia mbra mbɔbɔ asodzi ho afɔr: Mbom nkan no nda no ayɛ kwa, osiandɛ n'ahotua no ho egu fi.
Na iyi nye Nazirinyi ho mbra, aber a n'ahotua nda ewie du no: Wɔmfa no mbra ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano:
Na ɔmfa ayɛyɛdze mbrɛ Ewuradze, eguambaanyin a oedzi afrenhyia a onndzi dzɛm kor mbɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr, nye odwanyin a onndzi dzɛm kor mbɔbɔ asomdweeafɔr,
nye epitsi boodoo kɛntsɛn no, nye isiam pa tatar a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, nye epitsi tatar ntrɛtraba a wɔdze ngo egu do, nye n'edziban-afɔr, nye no nom-afɔr.
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa mbra Ewuradze enyim, na ɔmbɔ no bɔn ho afɔr, nye ne hyew-afɔr:
Na ɔmfa odwanyin no mbɔ asomdwee-afɔr ma Ewuradze, nka epitsi boodoo kɛntsɛn no ho: Ɔsɔfo no mbɔ n'edziban-afɔr, nye no nom-afɔr no so.
Na Nazirinyi no nyi n'ahotua tsir no wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano, na ɔmfa n'ahotua tsinhwi no, na ɔmfa ngu ogya no a ɔwɔ asomdwee-afɔr ase no mu.
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa odwanyin abasa a wɔanoa, nye kɛntsɛn no mu epitsi tatar kor, na epitsi tatar ntrɛtraba kor na ɔmfa ngu Nazirinyino nsamu, oeyi n'ahotua tsir no ekyir no:
Na ɔsɔfo no ntow no ɔtow-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim; iyi yɛ krɔnkrɔn ma ɔsɔfo no, dze kã ɔtow-nyan no nye ohim-aserɛ no ho: Na ɔno ekyir no Nazirinyi no nnom wenyin.

Iyi nye mbra a ɔwɔ hɔ ma Nazirinyi a ɔbɔ anohoba, nye n'asyɛyɛdze a ɔdze ma Ewuradze wɔ n'ahotua ntsi no, ka dza ne nsa bɔso do ho no: Dɛ mbrɛ n'anohoba a ɔbɔ tse no, dɛmara na otwar dɛ odzi n'ahotua mbra ekyir yɛ.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no dɛ, Mbrɛ hom nsi nhyira Israelmba no nye yi; hom nse hɔn dɛ,
Ewuradze nhyira wo, na ɔnhwɛ wo do:
Ewuradze ntsew n'enyim nkyerɛ wo, na ɔndom wo:
Ewuradze mma n'enyi do nhwɛ wo, na ɔmma wo asomdwee.
Na wɔmfa me dzin nto Israelmba do dɛm; na mibehyira hɔn.
7: Na ɔbaa dɛ da a Moses wiee ntamadan no si, na ɔseraa ho ngo na ɔtseew ɔno, nye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, nye afɔrmbukyia no no ho ndzɛmba nyinara ho, na ɔsera ho ngo na ɔtseew ho no;
nna Israel mbapɔmba, hɔn egyanom efi mu etsitsir no, bɔɔ afɔr; iyinom nye ebusuakuw ebusuakuw do asafohen mpanyin, iyinom nye hɔn a wɔhwɛɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn no do no:
Na wɔdze hɔn ayɛyɛdze baa Ewuradze enyim, ntseaseanam a wɔakata do esia, nye anantwi duebien; mbapɔmba beenu dze tseaseanam kor, na ɔbaako ɔnantwi kor: Na wɔdze baa ntamadan no enyim.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
gye no wɔ hɔn nsamu ma wɔmfa nyɛ ehyiadzibuw no ho edwuma; na fa ma Levifo no, dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa biara n'edwuma tse.
Na Moses gyee ntseaseanam no nye anantwi no na ɔdze maa Levifo no.
Ntseaseanam ebien nye anantwi anan na ɔdze maa Gershon mbabanyin no, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn edwuma tse:
Na ɔdze ntseaseanam anan nye anantwi awɔtwe maa Merari mbabanyin no, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn edwuma tse, wɔ ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Ithamar nsamu.
Na Kohath mbabanyin no dze ɔamma hɔn bi: Osiandɛ ahotseweebea edwuma no yɛ hɔndze; hɔn na wɔsoa no wɔ hɔn mbatsir do.
Na mbapɔmba no dze afɔrmbukyia oyimadze bae wɔ da a wɔseraa ho ngo np mu, mekyerɛ mbapɔmba no dze hɔn ayɛyɛdze baa afɔrmbukyia no enyim.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, wɔmfa hɔn ayɛyɛdze mbra, ɔbapɔmba kor wɔ ne da mu, mfa mbɛyɛ afɔrmbukyia oyimadze.
Na nyia ɔdze n'ayɛyɛdze baa da a odzi kan no nye Aminadab a ofi Judah ebusuakuw mu no, ne babanyin Nahshon:

Na n'ayɛyɛdze nye dwetɛboyaa kor, n'ano tow skekel ɔha eduasa, dwetɛkora kor a ɔyɛ skekel eduosuo, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse: N'ebien nyina isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw dze rekɛyɛ edziban-afɔr ayeyɛ no amaama;
sika atser kor a ɔyɛ shekel du a eduhuam ayɛ no ma;
ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, odwanyin kor, eguambaanyin kor a oedzi afrenhyia a wɔdze rokɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr;
mpɔnkye mu onyin kor a wɔdze rokɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr;
nye asomdwee-afɔr dze, anantwi ebien, ndwanyin enum, mpɔnkyenyin enum, nguambaanyin enum a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia: Iyi nye Aminadab ne babanyin Nahshon n'ayɛyɛdze.
Da a otsia ebien no Zuar ne babanyin Nethanel, Issachar ɔbapɔmba no, dze bae:

N'ayɛyɛdze a ɔdze bae nye dwetɛboyaa kor, n'ano tow shekel ɔha eduasa, dwetɛkora kor a ɔyɛ shekel eduosuon, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse; n'ebien nyina isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw dze rekɛyɛ edziban-afɔr ayeyɛ no amaama;
sika atser kor a ɔyɛ shekel du a eduhuam ayɛ no ma;
ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, odwanyin kor, eguambaanyin kor a oedzi afrenhyia a wɔdze rokɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr;
mpɔnkye mu onyin kor a wɔdze rokɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr:
Nye asomdwee-afɔr dze, anantwi ebien, ndwanyin enum, mpɔnkye-nyin enum, nguambaanyin enum a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia: Iyi nye Zuar ne babanyin Nethanel n'ayɛyɛdze.
Da a otsia ebiasa no Helon ne babanyin Eliab, Zebulunmba mu ɔbapɔmba:

N'ayɛyɛdze nye dwetɛboyaa kor, n'ano tow shekel ɔha eduasa, dwetɛkora kor a ɔyɛ shekel eduosuo, dɛ mbrɛ ahotsewebea shekel tse: N'ebien nyina isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw dze rekɛyɛ edziban-afɔr ayeyɛ no amaama;
sika atser kor a ɔyɛ shekel du a eduhuam ayɛ no ma;
ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, odwanyin kor, eguambaanyin kor a oedzi afrenhyia a wɔdze rokɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr;
mpɔnkye mu onyin kor a wɔdze rokɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr;
nye asomdwe-afɔr dze, anantwi ebien, ndwanyin enum, mpɔnkyenyin enum, nguambaanyin enum a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia: Iyi nye Helon ne babanyin Eliab n'ayɛyɛdze.
Da a otsia anan no Shedeur ne babanyin Elizur, Reubenmba mu ɔbapɔmba:

N'ayɛyɛdze nye dwetɛboyaa kor n'ano tow shekel ɔha eduasa, dwetɛkora a ɔyɛ shekel eduosuon, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse; n'ebien nyina isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afɔrw dze rekɛyɛ edzibanafɔ ayeyɛ no amaama;
sika atser kor a ɔyɛ shekel du a eduhuam ayɛ no ma;
ɔnanatwisaa eburwa kor, odwanyin kor, eguambaanyin kor a oedzi afrenyia a wɔdze rokɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr;
mpɔnkye mu onyin kor a wɔdze rokɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr;
nye asomdwee-afɔr dze, anantwi ebien, ndwanyin enum, mpɔnkyenyin enum, nguambaanyin enum a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia: Iyi nye Shedeur ne babanyin Elizur n'ayɛyɛdze.
Da a otsia enum no Zurishaddai ne babanyin Shelumiel, Simeonmba mu ɔbapɔmba:

N'ayɛyɛdze nye dwetɛboyaa kor, n'ano tow shekel ɔha eduasa, dwetɛkora kor a ɔyɛ shekel eduosuon, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse; n'ebien nyina isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw dze rekɛyɛ edziban-afɔr ayeyɛ no amaama;
sika atser kor a ɔyɛ shekel du a eduhuam ayɛ no ma;
ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, odwanyin kor, eguambaanyin kor a oedzi afrenhyia a wɔdze rokɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr;
mpɔnkye mu onyin kor a wɔdze rokɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr;
nye asomdwee-afor dze, anantwi ebien, ndwanyin enum, mpɔnkyenyin enum, nguambaanyin enum a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia: Iyi nye Zurishaddai ne babanyin Shelumiel n'ayɛyɛdze.
Da a otsia esia no Deuel ne babanyin Eliasaph, Gadmba mu ɔbapɔmba:

N'ayɛyɛdze nye dwetɛboyaa kor, n'ano tow shekel ɔha eduasa, dwetɛkora kor a ɔyɛ shekel eduosuo, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse; n'ebien nyina isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw dze rekɛyɛ edziban-afɔr ayeyɛ no amaama;
sika atser kor a ɔyɛ shekel du a eduhuam ayɛ no mã;
ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, odwanyin kor, eguambaanyin kor a oedzi afrenhyia a wɔdze rokɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr;
mpɔnkye mu onyin kor a wɔdze rokɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr;
nye asomdwee-afɔr dze, anantwi ebien, ndwanyin enum, mpɔnkyenyin enum, nguambaanyin enum a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia: Iyi nye Deuel ne babanyin Eliasap n'ayɛyɛdze.
Da a otsia esuon no Ammihud ne babanyin Elishama, Ephraimmba mu ɔbapɔmba:

N'ayɛyɛdze nye dwetɛboyaa kor, n'ano tow shekel ɔha eduasa, dwetɛkora kor a ɔyɛ shekel eduosuon, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse; n'ebien nyina isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw dze rekɛyɛ edziban-afɔr ayeyɛ no amaama;
sika atser kor a ɔyɛ shekel du a eduhuan ayɛ no ma;
ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, odwanyin kor, eguambaanyin kor a oedzi afrenhyia a wɔdze rokɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr;
mpɔnkye mu onyin kor a wɔdze rokɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr;
nye asomdwee-afɔr dze, anantwi ebien, ndwanyin enum, mpɔnkyenyin enum, nguambaanyin enum a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia: Iyi nye Ammihud ne babanyin Elishama n'ayɛyɛdze.
Da a otsia awɔtwe no Pedahzur ne babanyin Gamaliel, Manassehmba mu ɔbapɔmba:

N'ayɛyɛdze nye dwetɛboyaa kor, n'ano tow shekel ɔha eduasa, dwetɛkora kor a ɔyɛ shekel eduosuon, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse; n'ebien nyina isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw dze rekɛyɛ edziban-afɔr ayeyɛ no amaama;
sika atser kor a ɔyɛ shekel du a eduhuam ayɛ no mã;
ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, odwanyin kor, eguambaanyin kor oedzi afrenhyia a wɔdze rokɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr;
mpɔnkyen mu onyin kor a wɔdze rokɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr;
nye asomdwee afɔr dze, anantwi ebian, ndwanyin enum, mpɔnkyenyin enum, nguambaanyin enum a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia: Iyi nye Pedahzur ne babanyin Gamaliel n'ayɛyɛdze.
Da a otsia akron no Gideoni ne babanyin Abidan, Benjaminmba mu ɔbapɔmba:

N'ayɛyɛdze nye dwetɛboyaa kor, n'ano tow shekel ɔha eduasa, dwetɛkora kor a ɔyɛ shekel eduosuon, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse; n'ebien nyina isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw dze rekɛyɛ edziban-afɔr ayeyɛ no amaama;
sika atser a ɔyɛ shekel du a eduhuam ayɛ no ma;
ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, odwanyin kor, eguambaanyin kor a oedzi afrenhyia a wɔdze rokɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr;
mpɔnkye mu onyin kor a wɔdze rokɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr;
nye asomdwee afɔr dze, anantwi ebien, ndwanyin enum, mpɔnkyenyin enum, nguambaanyin enum a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia: Iyi nye Gideoni ne babanyin Abidan n'ayɛyɛdze.
Da a otsia du no Ammishaddai ne babanyin Ahiezer, Danmba mu ɔbapɔmba:

N'ayɛyɛdze nye dwetɛboyaa kor, n'ano tow shekel ɔha eduasa, dwetɛkora kor a ɔyɛ shekel edusuon, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse; n'ebien nyina isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw dze rekɛyɛ edziban-afɔr ayeyɛ no amaama;
sika atser kor a ɔyɛ shekel du a eduhuam ayɛ no ma;
ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, odwanyin kor, eguambaanyin kor a oedzi afrenhyia a wɔdze rokɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr;
mpɔnkye mu onyin kor a wɔdze rokɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr;
nye asomdwee afɔr dze anantwi ebien, ndwanyin enum, mpɔnkyenyin enum, nguabaanyin enum a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia: Iyi nye Ammishaddai ne babanyin Ahiezer n'ayɛyɛdze.
Da a otsia dubiako no Ochran ne babanyin Pagiel, Ashermba mu ɔbapɔmba:

N'asyɛyɛdze nye dwetɛboyaa kor, n'ano tow shekel ɔha eduasa, dwetɛkora kor a ɔyɛ shekel edusuon, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse; n'ebien nyina isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw dze rekɛyɛ edziban-afɔr ayeyɛ no amaama;
sika atser kor a ɔyɛ shekel du a eduhuam ayɛ no ma;
ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, odwanyin kor, eguambaanyin kor a oedzi afrenhyia a wɔdze rokɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr;
mpɔnkyen mu onyin kor a wɔdze rokɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr;
nye asomdwee afɔr dze, anantwi ebien, ndwanyin enum, mpɔnkyenyin enum, nguambaanyin enum a woedzi afenhyia afrenhyia: Iyi nye Ochran ne babanyin Pagiel n'ayɛyɛdze.
Da a otsia duebien no Enam ne babnyin Ahira, Naphtalimba mu ɔbapɔmba:

N'ayɛyɛdze nye dwetɛboyaa kor, n'ano tow shekel ɔha eduasa, dwetɛkora kor a ɔyɛ shekel eduosuon, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse; n'ebien nyina isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw dze rekɛyɛ edziban-afɔr ayeyɛ no amaama;
sika atser kor a ɔyɛ shekel du a eduhuam ayɛ no ma;
ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, odwanyin kor, eguambaanyin kor a oedzi afrenhyia a wɔdze rokɔbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr;
mpɔnkye mu onyin kor a wɔdze rokɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr;
nye asomdwee afɔr dze, anantwi ebien, ndwanyin enum, mpɔnkyenyin enum, nguabaanyin enum a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia: Iyi nye Enam ne babanyin Ahira n'ayɛyɛdze.
Iyi nye afɔrmbukyia no oyimadze a ofi Israel mbapɔmba no hɔ bae, wɔ da a wɔsera hɔn ngo no: Ndwetɛboyaa duebien, ndwetɛkora duebien, sika ntser duebien:
Dwetɛboyaa kor n'ano tow shekel ɔha eduasa, na kora kor dwetɛ nyinara yɛ shekel mpemebien ahaanan, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse;
sika ntser a eduahuam ayeyɛ no amaama duebien, kor n'ano tow shekel du, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse: Ntser no ne sika nyinara yɛ shekel ɔha eduonu:
Ɔhyew-afɔr anantwi no nyinara yɛ anantwisaa duebien, ndwanyin no duebien, nguambaanyin a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia no duebien; mpɔnkye mu enyin a wɔdze rokɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr duebien:

Na asomdwee afɔr anantwi no nyinara yɛ anantwisaa eduonu anan, ndwanyin no eduosia, mpɔnkyenyin no eduosia, nguambaanyin a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia no eduosia. Iyi nye afɔrmbukyia no no ngosera ekyir oyimadze.
Na aber a Moses hɛn ehyiadzibuw no mu dɛ ɔnye no rekɛkasa no, nna ɔtsee ndze a ɔrekasa kyerɛ no fi mbɔbɔrhu egua a ɔwɔ dasedaka no do no do, wɔ cherubfo ebien no ntamu: Na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ no.
8: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Aaron na se no dɛ, Sɛ esosɔ nkandzea no a, nkandzea esuon no ngyegye kandzeadua no enyim.
Na Aaron yɛɛ dɛm; ɔsosɔɔ ne nkandzea ma ɔgyegyee kandzeadua no enyim, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
Na iyi nye kandzeadua no ne yɛbea, sika ɔbor-edwuma ara nko; ofi n'ase dze kodu ne nhyiren do ɔyɛ ɔbor-edwuma: Dɛ mbrɛ nsusudo a Ewuradze dze kyerɛɛ Moses tse no, dɛmara na ɔyɛɛ kandzedua no.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
yi Levifo no wɔ Israelmba mu, na tsew hɔn ho.
Na dɛm na yɛ hɔn fa tsew hɔn ho: Fa bɔn-yi ho nsu petse hɔn do, na ma wɔmfa oyindam nyiyi hɔnho nyinara, na ma wɔnhor hɔn ntar, na wɔmfa ntsew hɔnho.
Nna ma wɔmfa ɔnantwisaa eburwa, nye n'edziban-afɔr, isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, na fa ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor so bɔ bɔn ho afɔr.
Na fa Levifo no bra ehyiadzibuw no enyim: Na ma Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara mbɔbɔ ngua:
Na fa Levifo no bra Ewuradze enyim: Na Israelmba mfa hɔn nsa ngu Levifo no do:
Na Aaron mfa Levifo no ntow nyɛ ɔtow-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim, mfa ngyina Israelmba no ananmu, ma wɔntsena hɔ nyɛ Ewuradze n'edwuma.
Na Levifo no mfa hɔn nsa ngu anantwisaa no etsifi: Na fa kor bɔ hɔn ho afɔr, na fa kor so bɔ ɔhyew-afɔr ma Ewuradze, ma ɔnyɛ mpata mma Levifo no.
Na fa Levifo no gyina Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no enyim, na tow hɔn yɛ ɔtow-afɔr ma Ewuradze.
Dɛm na tsew Levifo no fi Israelmba mu: Na Levifo no mbɛyɛ medze.
Na n'ekyir no Levifo no nkɔ nkɛyɛ ehyiadzibuw no edwuma: Na tsew hɔn ho, na tow hɔn yɛ ɔtow-afɔr.
Osiandɛ wɔdze hɔn ama me koraa efi Israelmba no mu: Medze hɔn ahyɛ dza obue yafun nyinara, mekyerɛ Israelmba mu mbakan nyinara ananmu mafa.
Na Israelmba mu mbakan nyinara yɛ medze, nyimpa nye abowa nyina da a mobobɔɔ Egypt asaase do mbakan nyinara no na metseew hɔn ho maa moho.
Na mafa Levifo no ahyɛ Israelmba mu mbakan nyinara ananmu.

Na medze Levifo no mama Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no dɛ akyɛdze mefi Israelmba no edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, na wɔmpata mma Israelmba no: Amma sɛ Israelmba no rotwe bɛn ahotseweebea no a, ɔyardoɔm bi aammba Israelmba no mu.
Dɛm na Moses, nye Aaron, nye Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara, yɛɛ Levifo no: Dɛ mfrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ wɔ Levifo ho nyinara no, dɛmara no, dɛmara na Israelmba no yɛɛ hɔn.
Na Levifo no tseew hɔnho fii bɔn ho, na wɔhoor hɔn ntar; na Aaron toow hɔn yɛɛ ɔtow-afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim; na Aaron patae maa hɔn dze tseew hɔn ho.
Na n'ekyir no Levifo no kɔree kɛyɛɛ hɔn edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu wɔ Aaron, nye ne mbabanyin no enyim: Dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses wɔ Levifo no ho, dɛmara na wɔyɛɛ hɔn.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
dza ɔyɛ Levifo dze no ye yi: Hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu enum nye ekyir no nkɔ nkɔsom wɔ ehyiadzibuw no edwuma no mu:
Na ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do no ngyaa edwuma yɛ, na mma wɔnnkɔsom bio;
mbom wɔnye hɔn nuanom nsom wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, nhwɛ ahwɛdodze no, na ɔsom edwuma no na mma wɔnnyɛ. Dɛm na yɛ ma Levifo no wɔ hɔn ahwɛdodze ho afamu.
9: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses wɔ Sinai sar do, wofii Egypt asaase do firii no n'ekyir afe a otsīa ebien no no bosoom a odzi kan no mu dɛ,
Nkyii so ma Israelmba ndzi apaho no wɔ n'aber a wɔahyɛ mu.
Bosoom yi ne da a otsīa duanan no mu ewimbir, na hom ndzi no wɔ n'aber a wɔahyɛ mu: Dɛ mbrɛ n'ahyɛdze nyinara tse, na mbrɛ no ho mmom nyinara tse no, na hom ndzi.
Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba no dɛ wondzi apaho no.
Na wodzii apaho no wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu, wɔ bosoom no ne da a otsia duanan no mu, ewimbir, wɔ Sinai sar do: Dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no nyinara, dɛmara na Israelmba no yeɛ.
Na mbabanyin bi wɔ hɔ a hɔn ho egu fi wɔ nyimpa bi no fun ho, ma dɛm ntsi woenntum enndzi apaho no da no ara:
Na mbanyin no see no dɛ, Hɛn ho egu fi wɔ nyimpa bi no fun ho: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔakam hɔn, dɛ mma yɛmmfa Ewuradze ayɛyɛdze mmba wɔ n'aber a wɔahyɛ mu wɔ Israelmba no mu?
Na Moses see hɔn dɛ, Hom ngyina hɔ; ma minkatsie dza Ewuradze bɛhyɛ wɔ hom ho.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Sɛ nyimpa bi no ho ngu fi wɔ fun bi ho, anaa ɔwɔ ekyirkyir akwantu mu, wɔ hom mu, anaa hom ebusuasantsen mu a, ondzi apaho no mma Ewuradze ara:
Bosoom a otsīa ebien no mu da a otsīa duanan no ewimbir na wondzi; epitsi boodoo nye fan wenwen na wɔmfa ndzi:
Mma wonngya mu bi mma onnkodu anapa, na wommbu ne biew bi mu so: Dɛ mbrɛ apaho no no ho ahyɛdze no nyinara tse na wondzi.

Mbom nyimpa no a no ho tsew, na orunntu kwan, na ogyaa dɛ odzi ap aho no, ɔkra no wobotwa no efi ne man mu akyen: Osiandɛ ɔammfa Ewuradze ayɛyɛdze no ammba wɔ n'aber a wɔahyɛ mu, nyimpa no nsoa no bɔn.
Na sɛ ɔhɔho bi bɔsoɛ hom mu, na oridzi apaho no ama Ewuradze a; ɔno dɛ mbrɛ apaho ahyɛdze kor mfa mma ɔhɔho, nye nyia wɔawo no wɔ asaase no do nyina.
Na da a wɔmaa ntamdan no do sii hɔ no mununkum no bɛkataa ntamadan no do, mekyerɛ dasebuw no: Na ewimbir no na ɔwɔ ntamadan no do epue tse dɛ ogya dze kodu anapa.
Dɛm na ɔtse daa: Mununkum no kataa do, na ogya no puee anago.
Na aber biara a wɔma mununkum no do ma ɔma noho do fi Buw no do no, ɔno n'ekyir no Israelmba tu kwan, na beebi mbrɛ munukum no gyinae no, hɔ na Israelmba kyeer nsera.
Ewuradze mbrasɛm do na Israelmba nam tuu kwan, na Ewuradze mbrasɛm do na wɔnam kyeer nsera: Aber tsentsen a mununkum no tsena ntamadan no do nyinara wɔtsena nserakyer mu.
Na sɛ mununkum no kyinkyim ntamadan no do nda pii a, ɔno na Israelmba hwɛ Ewuradze ahwɛdodze no do, na wonntu kwan.
Na ɔtɔfabi a mununkum no dzi nda kakrabaa bi wɔ ntamadan no do; nna dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze mbrasɛm tse no wɔatsena nsera no mu, na dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze mbrasɛm tse no, nna wɔnam do etu.

Na ɔtɔfabi so a mununkum no wɔ hɔ araa fi ewimbir kodu anapa; na sɛ mununkum no ma noho do anapa; na sɛ mununkum no ma noho do anapa a, na woetu: anaa sɛ ɔwɔw do adzekyee nye adzesaa, na sɛ mununkum no ma no ho do a, nna woetu.
Sɛ nda ebien o, bosoom o, afrenhyia o, nna mununkum no kyinkyim wɔ ntamadan no do tsena do a, Israelmba no tsena nsera no mu, na wonntu: Na sɛ ɔma no ho do a, nna woetu.
Ewuradze ne mbrasɛm na wɔnam dokyeer nsera, na Ewuradze ne mbrsɛm na wɔnam do tui: Wɔhwɛɛ Ewuradze ne mbrasɛm a ɔnam Moses ne nsa do no do.
10: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Yɛ dwetɛ ntotorobɛnto ebien fa ma woho: Ɔbor-edwuma na fa yɛ: Na dze aafrɛ mboanofo no aba, na dze ama woeetu nseraban no akɔ.
Na sɛ wɔhɛn n'ebien nyina a, mboanofo no nyinara hɔn ano nhyia wo nkyɛn wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano.
Na sɛ wɔhɛn kor a, ɔno mbapɔmba no, Israel mpempem mu etsitsir no, hɔn ano nhyia wo nkyɛn.
Na sɛ hom hɛn ewubɔ a, nseraban a ɔdeda boka afamu no ntutu nkɔ.
Na sɛ hom hɛn ewubɔ toa do ebien a, nseraban a ɔdeda pomu afamu no ntutu nkɔ: Worubotu no, wɔnhɛn ewubɔ.
Mbom sɛ bagua no ribehyia a, hom nhɛn, na mma hom nnhɛn ewubɔ.
Na Aaron ne mbabanyin asɔfo no, na wɔmfa ntotorobɛnto no nhɛn; na ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze mma hom wɔ hom ebusuasantsen nyinara mu.
Na sɛ hom rokɔɔsa wɔ hom asaase do nyue ɔtamfo a ohiahia hom ho akɔko a, ɔno hom mfa ntotorobɛnto no nhɛn ewubɔ; na wɔnkaa hom wɔ Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn enyim, na wɔngye hom nkwa wɔ hom atamfo nsamu.

Na hom enyigye nda mu, nye hom afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ mu, na hom abosoom ahyɛse mu so, hom mfa ntotorobɛnto no nhɛn no wɔ hom ɔhyew-afɔr nye hom asomdwee afɔr no do; na ɔnyɛ nkaa mma hom wɔ hom Nyankopɔn enyim: Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
Na ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsia ebien no, bosoom a otsia ebien no, wɔ bosoom no ne da a otsia eduonu no mu no, mununkum no maa noho do fii dase ntamadan no do.
Na Israelmba no sii mu fii Sinai sar do dɛ mbrɛ hɔn akwantu no tse: Na mununkum no kegyinaa Paran sardo.
Na wodzii kan tuu hɔn akwantu no dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze mbrasɛm a ɔwɔ Moses nsamu no tse.
Na Judahmba nseraban do frankaa na odzii kan tui dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tsetsee: Na Aminadab ne babanyin Nahshon na ɔhwɛɛ no dɔm no do.
Na Zuar ne babanyin Nethanel na ɔhwɛɛ Issacharmba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
Na Helon ne babanyin Eliab na ɔhwɛɛ Zebulunmba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
Na wɔpaa ntamadan no; na Gershon ne babanyin nye Merari ne mbabanyin a wɔsoasoaa ntamadan no tui.
Na Reuben nseraban do frankaa tui dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tsetsee: Na Shedeur ne babanyin Elizur na ɔhwɛɛ no dɔm no do.
Na Zurishaddai ne babanyin Shelumiel na ɔhwɛɛ Simeonmba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
Na Deuel ne babanyin Eliasaph na ɔhwɛɛ Gadmba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
Na Kohathfo no soasoaa ahotseweebea no dze tui: Na binom so sii ntamadan no dze kodur dɛ wɔbae.
Na Ephraimmba nseraban do frankaa tui dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tsetsee: Na Ammihud ne babanyin Elishama na ɔhwɛɛ no dɔm no do.
Na Pedahzur ne babanyin Gamaliel na ɔhwɛɛ Manassehmba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
Na Gideoni ne babanyin Abidan na ɔhwɛɛ Benjaminmba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
Na Danmba nseraban do frankaa a ɔyɛ nseraban nseraban nyinara ne nkyidɔm no, tui dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tsetsee: Na Ammishaddai ne babanyin Ahiezer na ɔhwɛɛ no dɔm no do.
Na Ochran ne babanyin Pagiel na ɔhwɛɛ Ashermba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
Na Enan ne babanyin Ahira na ɔhwɛɛ Naphtalimba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
Israelmba akwantu a wotui dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tsetsee no nye yi; na wotui.
Na Moses see Hobab, Moses n'asew Midiannyi Reuel ne babanyin no, dɛ, Yerutu akɔ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze kasaa ho dɛ, Medze mebɛma hom no: Ra ma yɛnkɔ, na yɛbɛyɛ wo yie: Na Ewuradze aka Israel ho asɛm pa.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Moronnkɔ; mbom mobɔkɔ mankasa m'asaase do, nye m'ebusua mu.
Na ɔseedɛ, Mepa wo kyɛw, mma nngya hɛn; susuampa dɛ ɔwo inyim mbrɛ yebesi akyer nsera wɔ sar no do ntsi, ɔwo yɛ enyiwa fa ma hɛn.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ ɔwo nye hɛn kɔ a, ampa, ɔbɛba dɛ papa kor a Ewuradze dze bɛyɛ hɛn no, ɔnoara na yɛdze bɛyɛ wo.
Na wotutui fii Ewuradze bepɔw no ho tuu ndaansa kwan; na Ewuradze ahyɛmudaka no tui dzii hɔn enyim kɔr ndaansa kwan, dɛ ɔrokɔhwehwɛ ahomgyebea ama hɔn.
Na sɛ wotu fi nseraban no mu a, nna Ewuradze mununkum no wɔ hɔn do adzekyee.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ adaka no rutu a, Moses ka dɛ, Ewuradze, soɛr ɛ, na ma w'atamfo mbɔ mpetse; na ma hɔn a wokyir wo nguan w'enyim.
Na sɛ ɔsoɛ a, ɔkã dɛ, Ewuradze, san bra Israel mpemmpem mu mpedu mpedu nkyɛn.
11: Na ɔman no tse dɛ ehwinhwimfo a wɔkasa bɔn wɔ Ewuradze asomu: Na Ewuradze tsee no, n'ebufuw dzɛwee; na Ewuradze ogya hyewee wɔ hɔn mu, na ɔmeen nseraban no ano noho.
Na ɔman no sui tɔɔ Moses do; na Moses paa Ewuradze kyɛw, na ogya no dumii.
Na wɔfrɛɛ bea no dzin dɛ Taberah: Osiandɛ Ewuradze ogya hyewee wɔ hɔn mu.
Na aforafora nyimpa dodow a wɔwɔ hɔn mu no hɔn kɔn dɔɔ adze: Na Israelmba no so suu bio, na wɔsee dɛ, Woana na ɔbɛma hɛn nam ma yeedzi?
Yɛkaakaa esunam a yedzii no wɔ Egypt no kwa; efer, nye anamuna, nye fan, nye anwew, nye enyian no:
Afei dze hɛn kra etwintwam; biribi biribiara nnyi hɔ: Yennyi hwee gyedɛ manna yi ara na yɛahwɛ.
Na manna no tse dɛ coriander aba, na no ho tse dɛ bdellium-hyɛ ho.
Ɔman no kekyinii, na wɔtasetasee, na wɔyaam no wɔ nwuyambo do, anaa wosiiw no nwɔdur mu, na wɔnoaa no wɔ asɛn mu, na wɔyɛɛ no tatar: na ne dɛw tse dɛ ngo momon ne dɛw.
Na sɛ ɔbɔsu tɔ gu nseraban no do anago a, manna no so tɔ gu do.
Na Moses tsee dɛ ɔman no worususu wɔ hɔn ebusua ebusua mu: Nyimpa biara ɔwɔ no buw abowano: Na Ewuradze n'ebufuw dzɛɛw kɛsenara; na ɔyɛɛ Moses ahomtsew.
Na Moses see Ewuradze dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔwo nye w'akowaa edzi no bɔn? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mennya w'enyim enyimnyam, dɛ edze ɔman yi nyinara adzesoa ato mo do yi?
Ana emi na minyinseen ɔman yi nyinara? Emi na mowoo hɔm, ne esee me dɛ Tur hɔn wɔ wo koko do, dɛ mbrɛ egya-bagyegyefo tur enumfoanoba, fa kɔ asaase a ekaa ho ntam maa hɔn egyanom no do?
Henfa na minya nam mema ɔman yi nyinara? Osiandɛ wosusu gu mo do, ɛ, ma hɛn nam, ma yendzi.
Monko murunntum nnkora ɔman yi nyinara, osiandɛ ɔyɛ dur dodow ma me.
Na sɛ dɛm na enye me bedzi no a, mepa wo kyɛw, sɛ menya w'enyim enyimnyam a, ɔnodze oku mbom na ku me; na mma munnhu m'awerɛhow.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Boa Israel mpanyimfo mu eduosuon ano ma me hɔn a inyim dɛ wɔyɛ ɔman no mpanyimfo, nye hɔn do asafohemfo; na fa hɔn bra ehyiadzibuw no ho, ma wɔnye wo ngyina hɔ.
Na mibesian na menye wo abɛkasa wɔ hɔ: Na mebɛfa sunsum a ɔwɔ wo do no bi, na medze egu hɔn do; na wɔnye wo aasoa ɔman no adzesoa no, mma woara nko aannsoa.
Na se ɔman no dɛ, Hom ntsew homho nsie ɔkyena, na hom bedzi nam: Osiandɛ hom ekosu egu Ewuradze asomu dɛ, Woana na ɔbɛma hɛn wɔ Egypt mbom: Dɛm ntsi Ewuradze bɛma bom nam, na hom eedzi.
Nnyɛ da kor na hom bedzi, anaa nda ebien anaa nda enum, nnyɛ dadu, anaa adaduonu.
Mbom bosoom ara mu, ekodu dɛ obefifir hom ahwentokur mu na ayɛ hom mfon: Osiandɛ hom apow Ewuradze a ɔwɔ hom mu no, na hom esu wɔ n'enyim aka, ebɛn ntsi na yefii Egypt bae?
Na Moses see dɛ. ɔman a mowɔ hɔn mu yi yɛ anamɔnmufo mpemahaesia; na ɔwo ese dɛ, mebɛma hɔn nam m a woeedzi no bosoom ara mu.
Aso wobokuku nguan nye anantwi ama hɔn ma aaso hɔn? Anaa wɔbɔboaboa po mu nam nyinara ano ama hɔn, ma aasõ hɔn?
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Ana woetwa Ewuradze nsa do a? Afei na ibohu kyerɛ dɛ m'asɛm bɛba mu ama wo, anaa ɔnnkɛba mu.
Na Moses fiir edzi, na ɔkɛkaa Ewuradze n'asɛm no kyerɛɛ ɔman no: Na ɔboa ɔman mpanyimfo no mu mbanyin eduosuon ano, na ɔdze hɔn begyinaa Buw no ho hyiae.

Na Ewuradze sianee wɔ mununkum no mu, na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ no, na ɔfaa sunsum a ɔwɔ no do no bi, na ɔdze guu mpanyimfo eduosuon no do: Na ɔbaa dɛ, sunsum no sisii hɔn do no, wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm, naaso wɔannyɛ dɛm bio.

Mbom ɔkaa mbanyini beenu wɔ nseraban no mu, ɔbaako ne dzin nye Eldad, na kor no so ne dzin dze Medad: Na sunsum no sisii hɔn do; na wɔfora hɔn a wɔkyerɛɛw hɔn no mu dze, na wonnyae nnkɔr Buw no ho: Na wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm wɔ nseraban no mu.
Na aberantsɛ bi tutuu mbirinka kɛkaa kyerɛ Moses, na ɔsee dɛ, Eldad nye Medad rehyɛ nkɔm wɔ nseraban no mu.
Na Nun ne babanyin Joshua, Moses no somfo no, ɔyɛ ne mbabanyin mpamufo mu kor no, buae see dɛ, mo wura Moses, bra hɔn.
Na Moses see no dɛ, Ana emi ntsi erotwe nyinkun a? Ɔka mo nko a nkyɛ Nyankopɔn aama Ewuradze ne man nyinara ayɛ nkɔnhyɛfo, ma Ewuradze dze no sunsum eegu hɔn do.
Na Moses sanee baa nseraban no mu, ɔno nye Israel mpanyimfo no.

Na mframa fi Ewuradze nkyɛn bɔe, na ɔdze nkokɔhwerɛw fi po no ho boguu nseraban no ho, bɛyɛ da kor akwantu wɔ afa ha, nye da kor akwantu wɔ afa ha so, dze hyiaa nseraban no ho, na hɔn sinsim bɛyɛ abasafa ebien wɔ asaase enyi.
Na ɔman no soɛɛr adzekyee no nyinara, nye anago no nyinara, na wɔkɔboaboa nkokɔhwerɛw no ano: Nyia ɔboaa kumaabi ano mpo, onyaa homer du: Na wɔtahatae araa dze twaa nseraban no ho hyiae maa hɔnho.
Aber a nam no da o wowɔ hɔn se mu a wonnyae nnkosae no, Ewuradze ebifiw fraam ɔman no do, na Ewuradze dze ɔyardɔm kɛsenara bobɔɔ ɔman no.
Na wɔfrɛɛ bea no dzin dɛ Kibroth-hat-taavah: Osiandɛ hɔ na wosiee ɔman a hɔn kɔn dɔɔ adze no.
Na ɔmanno tui fii Kibroth-hattaavah kɔr Hazeroth; na wɔtsenaa Hazeroth.
12: Na Miriam nye Aaron kasaa tsiaa Moses wɔ Cushnyi ɔbaa bi a ɔawar no no ntsi: Nna ɔawar Cushnyi ɔbaa bi.
Na wɔsee dɛ, Ana ampaara dɛ Moses nko na Ewuradze tsee.
Afei ɔbarimba Moses no dwe dodoodow, ɔbor nyimpa a wɔwɔ asaase do nyinara do
Na Ewuradze kasaa awerɛfir mu kyerɛɛ Moses, nye Aaron, nye Miriam dɛ, hom baasa hom mfir edzi mbra ehyiadzibuw no ho.
Na Ewuradze sianee wɔ mununkum dum mu, na obegyinaa Buw no n'abowano, na ɔfrɛɛ Aaron nye Miriam: Na hɔn beenu no fiir edzi bae.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Afei hom ntsie me nsɛm: Sɛ nkɔnhyɛfo bi wɔ hom mu a, emi Ewuradze mibeyi moho makyerɛ no wɔ enyido-adzehumu, adaaso mu na menye no bɛkasa.
M'akowaa Moses nntse dɛm; oedzi nokwar wɔ me fi nyinara mu:
Ano nye ano na menye no rekasa, mekyerɛ petee mu a, na nnyɛ mbɛbu mu a na ɔbɔhwɛ Ewuradze no su: Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi a hom ennsuro dɛ wɔbɛkasa etsia m'akowaa Moses?
Na Ewuradze ebufuw fraam hɔn do; na ofii hɔ kɔree.
Na mununkum no twee fii Buw no do; na, hwɛ, Miriam ayar kwata, ɔhoa dɛ esukwankyɛba: Na Aaron hwɛɛ Miriam, na, hwɛ, ɔayar kwata.
Na Aaron see Moses dɛ, Ao mo wura, mepawo kyɛw, mma mmfa bɔn nnto hɛn do, na yɛayɛ nkwaseadze, na ɔno ho yɛayɛ bɔn.
Me kyɛw ara nye yi, mma ɔnnyɛ dɛ obi a oewu, ofi ne na yamu aba a woedzino honamfa dada.
Na Moses sui frɛɛ Ewuradze dɛ, Ao Nyankopɔn, meserɛ wo, sa no yarba.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, sɛ n'egya hina n'enyi do ntafi a, ana nkyɛ n'enyi nnwu nda esuon bi a? Ma wɔnow no mu nda esuon wɔ nseraban no ekyir, na n'ekyir no na wɔmfa nombra mu bio.
Na wɔtoow Miriam mu wɔ nseraban no ekyir nda esuon: Na ɔman no enntu araa kodur dɛ wɔfaa Miriam baa mu bio.
Na n'ekyir no na ɔman no tui fii Hazeroth, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Paran sar do.
13: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
soma mbanyin ma wɔnkɛsera Canaan asaase a medze merema Israelmba no: Hɔn egyanom ebusuakuw biara mu hom nsoma mu ɔbanyin kor, hɔn nyina nyɛ hɔn mbapɔmba no bi.
Na Moses somaa hɔn fi Para sar do dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze mbrasɛm tse: Hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ mbanyin a wɔyɛ Israelmba mu etsitsir.
Na hɔn edzin nye yi: Reuben ebusuakuw dze, Zaccur ne babnyin Shammua.
Simeon ebusuakuw dze, Hori ne babanyin Shaphat.
Judah ebusuakuw dze, Jephunneh ne babanyin Caleb.
Issachar ebusuakuw dze, Joseph ne babanyin Igal.
Epharaim ebusuakuw dze, Nun ne babanyin Hoshea.
Benjamin ebusuakuw dze, Raphu ne babanyin Palti.
Zebulun ebusuakuw dze, Sodi ne babanyin Gaddiel.
Joseph ebusuakuw dze, mekyerɛ Manasseh ebusuakuw dze, Susi ne babanyin Gaddi.
Dan ebusuakuw dze, Gemalli ne babanyin Ammiel.
Asher ebusuakuw dze, Michael ne babanyin Sethur.
Naphtali ebusuakuw dze, Vophsi ne babanyin Nahbi.
Gad ebusuakuw dze, Machi ne babanyin Geuel.
Iyinom nye mbanyin a Moses somaa hɔn edzin. Na Moses frɛɛ Nun ne babanyin Hoshea no dɛ Joshua.
Na Moses somaa hɔn dɛ wɔnkɛsefra Canaan asaase no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom mfa pomu afamu ɔkwan yi do, na hom nkɔfow mbepɔw no:
Na wɔnhwɛ asaase no, mbrɛ ɔtse; nye ɔman a wɔtse do no, kyerɛ dɛ wɔyɛ mberɛw dɛ wosuar anaa wɔsõ;
nye mbrɛ asaase a wɔtse dono tse; dɛ oye anaa omuo; na mbrɛ nkuro a wɔtsetse nseraban mu, anaa akoban mu;
na mbrɛ asaase no tse, dɛ ɔyɛ sɔɔsɔɔ anaa etwee, dɛ ndua wɔ do anaa ɔnntse dɛm. Na hom nnya akokodur, na wɔmfa asaase no do aba bi mbra. Nna aber no yɛ esikyireamba ababer a odzi kan n'aber.
Nna wosii mu kɔree, na wɔkɛsera asaase no fi Zin sar do kodur Rehob, wɔ mbrɛ wɔnam kɔ Hamath no.
Na wɔfowee faa Pomu afamu, na wodur Hebron; na hɔ na Anakmba no, Ahiman, Sheshai, nye Talmai, wɔwɔ. (Na Hebron yi wɔkyekyeer no mfe esuon ansaana wɔrekyekyer Zoan a ɔwɔ Egypt).
Na wodur Eshcol ɔbɔn no mu, na wotwaa abaw a esikyireamba siaw kor wɔ do wɔ hɔ, na beenu wuraa no dua soae; na wɔdze pomegranate-ekutu, nye adɔmba so bi bae.
Wɔfrɛɛ bea no Eschol ɔbɔn no mu, osian siaw no a Israelmba twaa no wɔ hɔ no ntsi.
Na adaduanan sõe no, wɔsanee fii asaase no ne nserae mu bae.

Na wosii mu na wɔbaa Moses, nye Aaron, nye Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara nkyɛn, wɔ Paran sar do, wɔ Kadesh; na wɔbɔɔ hɔn amandzɛɛ kyerɛɛ hɔn, nye mboanofo no nyinara, na wɔdze asaase no do aba no kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ no, na wɔsee dɛ, yɛkɔr asaase a esomaa hɛn do no do, na numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do ampa; na no do aba nye yi.
Naaso ɔman a wɔtse asaase no do no na wɔyɛ dzen, na nkurow no wɔabɔ ho ban, ɔsoso dodow: Na nkyii so yehun Anakmba wɔ hɔ.
Amalek tse Pomu afamu asaase no do: Na Hittifo, nye Jebusfo, nye Amorifo, tsetse mbepɔw no do: Na Canaanfo tse po no ho, nye Jordan nkyɛn.
Na Caleb dwedwee ɔman no wɔ Moses enyim, na ɔsee dɛ, hom mma yɛnkɔfow nkɔ prɛko, na yɛnkɛfa, na yebotum edzi hɔn do nyim.
Na mbanyin a wɔnye no kɔree no dze see dɛ, yeruntum nnkɔfow nnkɔ nnkɛhyɛ ɔman no do; osiandɛ wɔyɛ dzen sen hɛn.

Na wɔdze asaase a wɔkɛserae no ho atsenka bɔn brɛɛ Israelmba no dɛ, asaase a yɛakɛfa mu akɛsera no, ɔyɛ asaase a yɛakɛfa mu akɛsera no, ɔyɛ asaase a odzi no do atsefo no; na nkorɔfo a yehun hɔn wɔ do no nyinara wɔyɛ nyimpa a wɔyɛ akraban.
Na hɔ na yehun Nephilfo, Anak ne mbabanyin no a wofi Nephilfo mu no: Na yɛyɛɛ dɛ mbɛbɛw wɔ hɛnankasa hɛn enyi do, na dɛmara na yɛyɛe wɔ hɔn enyi do.
14: Na mboanofo no nyinara memaa hɔn ndze do, na wɔkekaa mu: Na ɔman no suu anago no.

Na Israelmba no nyinara hwinhwiin Moses nye Aaron ho: Na mboanofo no nyinara see hɔn dɛ, ka hɔn nko a nkyɛ Nyankopɔn maa yewuwui wɔ Egypt asaase do! anaa sar yi do ha ara mpo, ka hɛn nko a nkyɛ Nyankopɔn maa yewuwui!
Na ebɛn ntsi na Ewuradze dze hɔn reba asaase yi do, dɛ yɛmbɔtotɔr nkrantsee ano? Hɛn yernom nye hɛn mbofraba bɛyɛ afonam; ana onnye mma hɛn dɛ yɛbɛsan akɔ Egypt bi a?
Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, wɔmma yɛnhyɛ ɔpanyin, na yɛnsan nkɔ Egypt.
Nna Moses nye Aaron dze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu wɔ Israelmba mboanofo bagua no nyinara enyim.
Na Nun ne babanyin Joshua nye Jephunneh ne babanyin Caleb a wofi hɔn a wɔkɛseraa asaase no mu no, sunsuaan hɔn ntar mu:
Na wɔkasaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara dɛ, asaase a yetwaa mu kɔree kɛserae no, ɔyɛ asaase pa mbordo.
Sɛ Ewuradze pɛ hɛn a, ɔno ɔdze hɛn bodu asaase no do, na ɔdze ama hen; asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem do.
Ewuradze do etūa ara nko na mma hom nntsew, nkyii so mma hom nnsuro asaase no do nkorɔfo no; na wɔyɛ edziban ma hɛn: Hɔn akataman efi hɔn do, na Ewuradze nye hɛn wɔ hɔ: Mma wonnsuro hɔn.
Na mboanofo no nyinara dze kãa dɛ wonsiw hɔn abo. Na Ewuradze enyimnyam puee ehyiadzibuw no mu kyerɛɛ Israelmba no nyinara.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Dabɛn na ɔman yi rubu me enyimtsia ekodu? Na dabɛn na wɔrenngye me nndzi, wɔ nsɛnkyerɛdze a mayɛ wɔ hɔn mu nyinara mu no ekodu?
Medze owuyarba mobɔbɔ hɔn, na masɛɛ hɔn, na medze wo mayɛ ɔman kɛse a ɔwɔ dzin sen hɔn.
Na Moses see dɛ, ɔno Egyptfo bɛtse; na ɔwo dze wo tum na edze eyi ɔman yi efi hɔn mu;

na wɔbɛkã akyerɛ asaase yi do atsefo: Wɔatse dɛ ɔwo Ewuradze ewɔ ɔman yi mu; na ɔwo Ewuradze wohu wo enyirn nye enyim, na wo mununkum gyina hɔn do, na ɔwo na idzi hɔn enyim, wo mununkum dum mu adzekyee, nye ogya dum mu adzesaa.
Afei sɛ iku ɔman yi de nyimpa kor a, ɔno amanaman a wɔatse wo nka no bɛkã dɛ,
osiandɛ Ewuradze enntum dɛ ɔdze ɔman yi kɔ asaase a ɔkãa hɔn ho ntam no do no, ntsi na oeku hɔn wɔ sar no do no.
Na afei, mepa wo kyɛw, ma Ewuradze no tum nyɛ kɛse, dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo akã dɛ,
Ewuradze fa ebufuw nyaa, na n’adɔyɛ sõ, ɔdze emumuyɛ nye mbrato fir, na bem bi na onnkobu ɔfɔdzinyi no; ɔdze egyanom hɔn emumuyɛ hwɛ mba, kodu ebusuasantsen ebiasa nye anan do.
Mepa wo kyɛw, fa ɔman yi hɔn emumuyɛ fir hɔn dɛ mbrɛ w’adɔyɛ ne kɛse tse, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo dze efir ɔman yi, efi Egypt araa ebodu sesei.
Na Ewuradze see dɛ, Medze mefir dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse no:
Mbom nokwar ara, dɛ metse ase, na dɛ Ewuradze enyimnyam bɛhyɛ asaase nyinara mã yi;
osiandɛ nyimpa nyina a woehu m’enyimnyam, nye me nsɛnkyerɛdze a meyɛe wɔ Egypt nye sar no do no, naaso wɔasɔ me ahwɛ mpɛn du nye yi, na woenntsie me ndze no;
ampaara wonnkohu asaase a mekãa ho ntam mekyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom no, nkyii so hɔn mu biara a obu me enyimtsia no runnhu:
Na m’akowaa Caleb dze, osiandɛ ɔwo sunsum bi so wɔ no mu, na oedzi m’ekyir koraa no ntsi, medze no mubodu asaase a ɔkɔr do no do; na n’asefo afa.
Afei Amalekfo nye Canaanfo tse ɔbɔn no mu: Ɔkyena hom ndan, na hom ntu nko sar no do wɔ Epo Memen kwan do.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ,
Dabɛn na memma mboanofo bɔn yi a wohwinhwin tsia me yi kwan ma onkodu? Israelmba hɔn ehwinhwin a wohwinhwin tsia me no matse.
Se hɔn dɛ, metse ase yi, Ewuradze na ɔse, ampaara dɛ mbrɛ hom akasa wɔ m’asomu no, dɛmara so na mebɛyɛ hom:
Sar yi do ara na hom efun bɛdeda; nye hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ hom mu no nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ hom dodow nyina tse, ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu nye ekyir do no a woehwinhwin etsia me no,
ampaara hom runndu asaase a memaa me nsa do mekyerɛɛ dɛ mebɛma hom atsena do no do, gyedɛ Jephunneh ne babanyin Caleb, nye Nun ne babanyin Joshua.
Mbom hom mbofraba a hom see dɛ wɔbɛyɛ afonam no, hɔn na medze hɔn bɔkɔ do, na wobohu asaase a hom apow no.
Na homdze, sar yi do ara na hom efun bɛdeda.
Na hom mba ayɛ aworamafo wɔ sar no do mfe eduanan, na wɔasoa hom ndwamanyɛ, ekodu dɛ hom efun bɛsa wɔ sar no do.
Nda a hom dze kɛseraa asaase no, no dodow mbrɛ ɔtse no, mekyerɛɛ adaduanan na da kor nye afe kor, nna hom nsoa hom emumuyɛ, mekyirɛ mfe eduanan, na hom ehu mbrɛ me pa tse.
Emi Ewuradze na makã, ampaara iyi na medze bɛyɛ, mboanofo bɔn yi nyinara a woedzi ehyia etsia me yi: Sar yi do ara na wɔbɛsa, na hɔ na wobowuwu.
Na mbanyin no a Moses somaa hɔn ma wɔkɛseraa asaase no a wɔsanee bae, na wɔmaa mboanofo no nyinara hwinhwinii tsiaa me no, dɛ wɔdze asaase no ho atsenka bɔn bae no,
mekyerɛ mbanyin no a wɔdze asaase no ho atsenka bɔn bae no, wowuu owuyar wu wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Mbom Nun ne babanyin Joshua, nye Jephunneh ne babanyin Caleb, na wonyaa nkwa wɔ mbanyin a wɔkɔree kɛseraa asaase no mu.
Na Moses kãa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Israelmba no nyinara: na ɔman no gyaam kɛsenara.
Na wɔsoɛɛr ahanamakye, na wɔfowee kɔr bepɔw no etsifi, dɛ, hwɛ hɛn nye yi, yɛbɔfow akɔ beebi mbrɛ Ewuradze abɔ ho anohoba no: Na yɛayɛ bɔn.
Na Moses see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na afei hom tõ Ewuradze mbrasɛm yi, na iyidze ɔrennyɛ yie?
Mma hom mmfow nnkɔ, na Ewuradze nnyi hom mu; mma hom aanntotɔr wɔ hom atamfo enyim.
Na Amalekfo nye Canaanfo wɔ hom enyim hɔ, na hom bɔtotɔr wɔ nkrantsee ano: Osiandɛ hom asan efi Ewuradze ekyir ntsi Ewuradze so rinndzi hom ekyir.
Na wotsītsii hɔn enyiwa ho ara dɛ wɔrofow akɔ bepɔw no etsifi: Naaso Ewuradze n’ahyɛmudaka na Moses dze, woemmfi nseraban no mu emmfi.
Nna Amalekfo, nye Canaanfo a wɔtse bepɔw no do no sianee bae bokunkum hɔn na wɔbɔɔ hɔn petsee araa kodur Hormah.
15: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, sɛ hom du hom tsenabew asaase a medze rema hom no do,

na wɔrobɔ ogya-afɔr ama Ewuradze, ɔhyew-afɔr, anaa okum-afɔr, dze ahyɛ anohoba bi ma, anaa dɛ ayamuyi-afɔr, anaa hom afahyɛ a wɔahyɛ no mu, dze eyi nka huanhuam ama Ewuradze a ofi anatwi, anaa nguan mu a:
Ɔno nyia ɔdze n'ayɛyɛdze ba no, ɔmfa edziban-afɔr isiam pa ephah ebupɛn du mu kor nka ngo hin ebupɛn anan mu kor ho mbrɛ Ewuradze:
Na ɔnom-afɔr wenyin, hin ebupɛn anan mu kor, na fa ka ɔhyew-afɔr, anaa okum-afɔr eguambaa kor ho siesie.
Na odwanyin dze, fa isiam pa ephah ebupɛn du mu ebien a wɔdze ngo hin ebupɛn ebiasa mu kor afrɔw, siesie yɛ edziban-afɔr:
Na ɔnom-afɔr no fa wenyin hin ebupɛn ebiasa mu kor bra, ma onyi nka huanhuam mma Ewuradze.
Na sɛ ɔnantwisaa na irisiesie abɔ ɔhyew-afɔr, anaa okum-afɔr, dze ahyɛ anohoba bi ma, anaa edze robɔbɔ asomdwee afɔr ama Ewuradze a:
Ɔno edziban-afɔr a ɔmfa nka ɔnantwisaa no ho nye isiam pa ephah ebupɛn du mu ebiasa a wɔdze ngo hin ɔfã afrɔw.
Na fa wenyin hin ɔfã yɛ ɔnom-afɔr no bra bɔbɔ ogya-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma Ewuradze.
Dɛm na wɔnyɛ ɔnanatwisaa kor, anaa odwanyin kor, anaa nguambaanyin no, anaa mpɔnkyemba no nkorkor.
Dɛ mbrɛ dodow a hom besiesie no tse no, dɛmara na hom nyɛ no nkorkor dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse.
Ekuromfo nyinara nyɛ ndzɛmba yi dɛm mfa mbɔ ogyaafɔr a oyi nka huanhuam mma Ewuradze.
Na sɛ ɔhɔho bi soɛ hom mu, anaa obiara a ɔwɔ hom mu wɔhom ebusuasantsen nyina mu no, na ɔbɔbɔ ogya-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ama Ewuradze no; dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛ no dɛmara so na ɔnyɛ.
Bagua no, ahyɛdze kor na ɔnda hɔ mma hom na ɔhɔho a ɔbɔsoɛ hom mu no ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ hom ebusuasantsen nyina mu: Dɛ mbrɛ hom tse no, dɛmara so na ɔhɔho no nyɛ wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Mbra kor nye ɔmom kor na ɔnda hɔ mma hom, nye ɔhɔho a ɔabɔsoɛ hom mu nyina.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, sɛ ho, du asaase a medze hom rokɔ do no do a,
ɔno ɔba dɛ, sɛ hom ridzi asaase no do edziban no bi a, hom mbɔ ohim-afɔr mma Ewuradze.
Hom mbɔrkan no bi ne tatar na hom mfa nyɛ ohim-afɔr: Dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛ ewuporoweebea ohim-afɔr no, dɛmara so na hom nhim no.
Hom mbɔrkan no bi na hom mfa mma Ewuradze dɛ ohim-afɔr wɔ hom ebusuasantsen nyina mu.
Na sɛ hom fom, na hom annhyɛ mbransɛm yi a Ewuradze akã akyerɛ Moses no nyinara nsew,
mekyerɛ dza Ewuradze nam Moses nsa do ahyɛ hom nyinara, ofi da a Ewuradze hyɛɛ mbra no, na ɔdze-ba-yi wɔ hom ebusuasantsen nyina mu no a;

ɔno ɔba dɛ, sɛ wɔyɛ no ntɔgon mu, dɛ mboanofo no nnyim a, mboanofono nyinara mfa ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor mbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma Ewuradze, nka n'edziban-afɔr, nye no nom-afɔr no ho dɛ mbrɛ ɔmom no tse, nye apɔkyenyin kor na ɔnyɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma Israelmba mboanofo no nyina, na wɔdze befir hɔn; na ɔyɛ mfom, na hɔn mfom no ntsi, wɔdze hɔn ayɛyɛdze aba dɛ Ewuradze ogya-afɔr, nye hɔn bɔn ho afɔr wɔ Ewuradze enyim:
Na wɔdze befir Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara, nye ɔhɔho a ɔabɔsoɛ hɔn mu no; na ɔman no nyinara afamu na wɔyɛɛ no ntɔgon mu.
Na sɛ nyimpa kor yɛ bɔn ntɔgon mu a, ɔno ɔmfa apɔnkyeber a oedzi afrenhyia mbra mbɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr.
Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma ɔkra aɔfom no, sɛ ɔyɛ bɔn ntɔgon mu a, wɔ Ewuradze enyim, dɛ ɔbɛpata ama no; na wɔdze befir no.
Hom nnya mbra kor nto hɔ mma nyia ɔyɛ biribi ntɔgon mu, nyia ɔyɛ okurommnyi wɔ Israelmba mu, nye ɔhɔho a ɔbɔsoɛ hom mu no.
ɔkra a ɔhyɛ da ara yɛ bɔn no dze, sɛ ɔyɛ okuromnyi bi o, ɔhɔho bi o, oedzi Ewuradze enyiaa; na ɔkra no wobotwa no efi ne man mu akyen.
Osiandɛ oebu Ewuradze n'asɛm enyimtsia, na ɔato ne mbra no; otwa ara na wobotwa ɔkra no akyen, n'emumuyɛ nda no do.
Na aber a Israelmba wɔwɔ sar no do no, wohun ɔbanyin bi a ɔrepɛ nyena ahomgyeda.
Na hɔn a wohun no dɛ ɔrepɛ nyena no wɔdze no brɛɛ Moses nye Aaron, nye mboanofo no nyinara.
Na wɔbɔɔ no dua mu, osiandɛ wonnyae nnkyerɛɛ dza wɔmfa nyɛ no.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, Oku na wonku ɔbanyin no: Mboanofo no nyinara nsiw no abo wɔ nseraban no ekyir.
Na mboanofo no nyinara dze no baa nseraban no ekyir na wosiiw no abo ma owui; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na hyɛ hɔn ma wɔnyɛ hɔn ntar ano ndwow wɔ hɔn ebusuasantsen nyina mu, na wɔmfa biribi ahoma nsusuo n'ano ndwow no mu:
Na ɔnyɛ ndwow mma hom, ma hom aahwɛ, na wɔaakaa Ewuradze mbransɛm nyinara, na wɔaayɛ; na hom eennkekyin enndzi hom akoma nye hom enyiwa ekyir, dza hom tɔ dɛ wodzi ekyir ndwamanyɛ mu no:
Ama hom aakaa na hom aayɛ krɔnkrɔn ama hom Nyankopɔn.
Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn a miyii hom fii Egypt asaase do dɛ mebɛyɛ hom Nyankopɔn no: Emi nye Ewuradze hom Nyankopɔn.
16: Afei Korah, Izhar ne babanyin no, Kohath ne babanyin no, Levi ne bababyin no, nye Dathan nye Abiram, Eliab ne bababyin ni, nye On, Peleth ne bababyin no, Reuben ne mbabanyin no, faa nyimpa:
Na wɔsuɛree tsiaa Moses, wɔnye Israelmba no mu bi, mboanofono mu mbapɔmba no mu bi, mboanofo no mu mbapɔmba ahaenu eduonum a wɔfrɛ hɔn bagua mu, nyimpa a wɔwɔ dzin:

Na wɔpoon hɔnho hyiae bɔɔ Moses nye Aaron do ngua, na wɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom yɛ dodow, na mboanofo nyinara yɛ krɔnkrɔn, hɔn mu obiara, na Ewuradze wɔ hɔn mu: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na hom mema homho do wɔ Ewuradze ne baguaa do?
Na Moses tsee no, ɔdze n'enyim butuuw famu:
Na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ Korah nye ne kuw no nyinara dɛ, anapa Ewuradze bɛkyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ nedze, nye nyia ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn, na ɔbɛma ɔaba ne nkyɛn: Mekyerɛ nyia ɔbɛsan mu eyi no no nna ɔbɛma ɔaba ne nkyɛn.
Iyi na hom nyɛ; hom mfa nduhuamsɛm, Korah nye no kuw nyinara;
na wɔmfa ogya ngu mu, na wɔmfa eduhuam ngu do wɔ Ewuradze enyim ɔkyena: Na ɔbɛba dɛ nyimpa a Ewuradze bɛfa no no. ɔbɛyɛ krɔnkrɔn: hom yɛ dodow, hom Levi mbabanyin.
Na moses see Korah dɛ, afei hom ntsie, hom Levi mbabanyin:
Ana ɔyɛ hom adze ketseaba, dɛ Israel Nyankopɔn no atsew hom efi Israel mboanofo mu dɛ ɔdze hom rebɛn noho; ma aayɛ Ewuradze natamdan no ho edwuma, na hom eegyina mboanofo no enyin asom hɔn;
na ɔdze wo aaka wo nuanom, Levi ne bababyin no nyinara ho abɛn? Na hom rohwehwɛ asɔfodzi so yi?
Dɛm ntsi na ɔwo nye wo kuw nyinara ehyia wɔ Ewuradze do: Na Aaron dze, woana nye no na hom hwinhwin tsia no?
Na Moses somae wɔkɛfrɛɛ Dathan nye Abiram, Eliab ne mbabanyin no: Na wɔsee dɛ, Yɛremmba:
Ana ɔyɛ adze ketseaba dɛ eyi hɛn efi asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do do, ruboku hɛn wɔ sar do, na kyenkyennkyen iridzi hɛn do ahenmbasɛm so yi?
Nkyii so emmfaa hɛn mmbaa asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no do, na emmfaa haban nye wenyin nture enyadze no so mmaa hɛn; ana mbanyin yi enyiwa na irubotutu? Yɛremmba.
Na Moses no bo fuuw kɛsenara, na ɔsee Ewuradze dɛ, mma w'enyi nnsɔ hɔn afɔrbɔ: Menngyee hɔn nsamu asoaso kor, nkyii so mennyɛɛ hɔn mu ko biara bɔn.
Na Moses see Korah dɛ, ɔwo nye wo mboanofo no nyinara mbra Ewuradze enyim, ɔwo, nye hɔn, nye Aaron, mbra ɔkyena:
Na hom mu nyimpa biara mfa n'eduhuamsɛn, na hom mfa eduhuam ngugu mu, na hom nyimpa biara mfa n'eduhuamsɛn mbra Ewuradze enyim, nduhuasɛn ahaenu eduonum; ɔwo so, nye Aaron, ɔbaako nye n'eduhuamsɛn.
Na wɔfefae, nyimpa biara nye n'eduhuansɛn, na wɔdze ogya guguu mu na wɔnye Moses nye Aaron kegyinagyinaa ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano.
Na korah poon mboanofo no nyinara hyiae bɔɔ hɔn do ngua wɔ ehyiadzibuuwno n'abowano: Na Ewuradze enyimnyam yii noho edzi kyerɛɛ mboanofo no nyinara.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ,
hom ntsew homho fi mboanofo yi mu, ma menhyew hɔn amon mu.
Na wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu, na wɔsee dɛ, Ao Nyankopɔn, honam nyinara hɔn esunsum Nyankopɔn ana nyimpa kor bɛyɛ bɔn, na wo bo efuw mboanofo no nyinara?
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ mboanofo no dɛ, hom mma homho do mfi Korah, Dathan nye Abiram ntamadan ho.
Na Moses soɛree na ɔkɔr Dathan nye Abiram nkyɛn; na Israel mpanyimfo no dzii n'ekyir kɔree.
Na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no dɛ, mepa hom kyɛw hom ntwe homho mfi nyimpa bɔn yi hɔn asesee ho, na mma hom nnka hɔn biribiara, bɛyɛ na hom ahyew wɔ hɔn bɔn nyinara mu.

Nna wɔmaa hɔnho do fii Korah, Dathan, nye Abiram ntamadan ho wɔ afa nyina: Na Dathan nye Abiram ntamadan ho wɔ afa nyina: Na Dathan nye Abiram fiir edzi, na wobegyinagyinaa hɔn asesee abowano, hɔn yernom, nye hɔn mbabanyin, nye hɔn mbɔtoaba so.
Na Moses see dɛ, iyi na hom dze bohu dɛ Ewuradze na ɔsoma me dɛ mindzi dwuma yi nyinara; na mommbɔɔ mankasa me tsir mu yɛ.
Sɛ nyimpa nyinara wu ara na iyinom bowuwu, anaa sɛ nyimpa nyinara sera na wɔdze bɛsera hɔn a, ɔnodze na nnyɛ Ewuradze na ɔasoma me.
Na sɛ adze fofor bi dze na Ewuradze bɛyɛ, na asaase bobue n'ano, na ɔamen hɔn, nye dza odzi wɔ hɔn nyinara, na wɔnam enyikan akɔ samanadze a; ɔnodze hom ntse ase dɛ mbanyin yi ebu Ewuradze enyimtsia.
Na ɔbaa dɛ owiee nsɛm yi nyinara ka no, asaase a ɔwɔ hɔn ase no paae:
Na asaase buee n'ano, na ɔmeen hɔn, nye hɔn efifo, nye nyimpa a wodzi wɔ Korah nyinara, nye hɔn adze nyinara.
Nna hɔn, nye dza odzi wɔ hɔn nyinara, nam enyikan sianee kɔr samanadze: Na asaase no seraam hɔn do, na wɔherae wɔ bagua no mu.
Na Israel a woetwa hɔnho ehyia no nyinara guanee wɔ hɔn nkekamu no ntsi: Na wɔsee dɛ, Bɛyɛ na asaase amen hɛn.
Na ogya fii Ewuradze hɔ bae, na ɔbɛhyeew mbanyin ahaenu eduonum a wɔdze eduhuam bae no.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
kasa kyerɛ ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Eleazar dɛ, ɔntase nduhuamsɛn no mfi ogyahyewee no mu, na fa ogya no petsepetse enyim noho; na ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn:

Mekyerɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo yi a wɔayɛ hɔnanakasa hɔn nkwa ho bɔn nduhuamsɛn no, na ma wɔnyɛ no ɔbor-ntɛrba mfa nyɛ afɔrmbukyia no ho nkataho: Osiandɛ wɔdze baa Ewuradze enyim, dɛm ntsi ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn: Na ɔnyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze mma Israelmba.
Na ɔsɔfo Eleazar faa boran nduhuamasɛn no a hɔn a wɔhyewee no dze bae no; na wɔboree dze yɛɛ afɔrmbukyia no ho nkataho:

Dɛ ɔnye nkaadze mma Israelmba, amma ɔhɔho bi a ommfi Aaron n’asefo mu aammba ho ammbɛhyew eduhuam wɔ Ewuradze enyim; mma ɔaannyɛ dɛ Korah, nye no kuw no: Dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze nam Moses do kãa kyerɛɛ no no.
Na n’adzekyee no Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara hwinhwinii tsiaa Moses nye Aaron dɛ, Hom na hom eku Ewuradze ne man.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a mboanofo no boaboaa hɔn ano tsiaa Moses nye Aaron no, wɔdandaan hɔn enyi wɔ ehyiadzibuw no do: Na, hwɛ, mununkum no akata do, na Ewuradze enyimnyam no yii noho edzi.
Na Moses nye Aaron baa ehyiadzibuw no enyim.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
hom mma homho do mfi mboanofo yi mu, ma menhyew hɔn amon mu. Na wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu.

Na Moses see Aaron dɛ, Fa w’eduhuamsɛn, na sɔ aformbukyia no do ogya gu mu, na fa eduhuam to do, na suo mu nantsew ntsɛmara kɔ mboanofo no nkyɛn, na kɛpata ma hɔn: Na ebufuhyew efi Ewuradze hɔ efir; ɔyardɔm no ahyɛ ase.
Na Aaron fae dɛ mbrɛ Moses kãe no, na otuu mbirika kɔr bagua no finimfin; na, hwɛ, ɔyardɔm no ahyɛ ase wɔ ɔman no mu: Na ɔdze eduhuam no gui, na ɔpatae maa ɔman no.
Na ogyinaa ewufo nye enyikamfo no ntamu; na wosiankaa ɔyardɔm no.
Afei hɔn a wowuwui wo ɔyardɔm no mu wɔyɛ mpemduanan nye ahaesuon, ɔsor hɔn a Korah asɛm no ntsi wowuwui no.
Na Aaron sanee baa Moses nkyɛn wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano: Na wosiankaa ɔyardɔm no.
17: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na gyegye hɔn hɔ mpoma, egyanom ofi kor mu kor, wɔ hɔn mbapɔmba no nyinara hɔ dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, mpoma duebin: Kyerɛw nyimpa biara ne dzin wɔ no poma do.
Na kyerɛw Aaron ne dzin wɔ Levi poma do: Na poma kor nyɛ hɔn egyanom efi do tsitsir kor dze.
Na gyaa mu gu ehyiadzibuw no mu wɔ dase no enyim, mbrɛ menye hom hyia no.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ ɔbanyin a mibeyi no no, no poma bɛfefɛw: Na mebɛma mo ho ehwinhwin a Israelmba hwinhwin tsia hom no egyaa.
Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba, na hɔn mbapɔmba no nyinara emaa no mpoma, ɔbapɔmba kor nedze kor, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetse no, mekyerɛ mpoma duebien: Na Aaron no poma wɔ hɔn mpoma no mu.
Na Moses gyaa mpoma no mu guu Ewuradze enyim wɔ dasebuw no mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ adze kyee no, Moses kɔr dasebuw no mu no; na, hwɛ, Aaron no poma no a ɔyɛ Levi ofi dze no afefɛw, ayɛ frɔmfrɔm. na egu nhyiren, na asow almond aba beree.
Na Moses dze mpoma no nyinara fi Ewuradze enyim brɛɛ Israelmba no nyinara: Na wɔhwɛe, na nyimpa biara faa no poma.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, fa Aaron no poma no san to dase no enyim, ma wɔmfa nsie nyɛ asɛnkyerɛdzemma mba asoɔdzenfo no; ama eetwa hɔn ehwinhwin a wohwinhwin tsia me no do, amma woeennwuwu.
Dɛm na Moses yɛe: Dɛ Mbrɛ Ewuradze dɛ mbrɛ hyɛɛ nono dɛm ara na ɔyɛe.
