Na Israelmba no kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses, dɛ, hwɛ yeruwu, yɛreyerea, hɛn nyinara.
Obiara a ɔba Ewuradze ntamadan no ho, owu: Ana nyinara yenwuwu?
18: Na Ewuradze see Aaron dɛ, ɔwo nye wo mbabanyin nye w'egyanom fi a wɔka wo ho no nsoa ahotseweebea no ho emumuyɛ: Na ɔwo nye wo mbabanyin a wɔka wo ho no nsoa hom asɔfodzi ho emumuyɛ.
Na wo nuanom no so, Levi ebusuakuw no, w'egya n'ebusuakuw no, fa hɔn ka woho bra ho, ma wɔmbɛfam wo ho, na wɔnsom wo: Na ɔwo nye wo mbabanyin a wɔka wo ho no nsom wɔ dasebuw no enyim.
Na wɔnhwɛ w'ahwɛdodze, nye Buw no nyinara ahwɛdodze no: Ahotseweebea ndzɛmba ho nye afɔrmbukyia no ho nko ara na mma wɔmmba, amma woeennwuwu, hɔn o, hom o.
Na wɔmfam wo ho, na wɔnhwɛ ehyiadzibuw no n'ahwɛdodze, dɛ mbrɛ Buw no no ho edwuma nyinara tse: Na mma ɔhɔho bi mmba hom nkyɛn.
Na hom nhwɛ ahotseweebea ahwɛdodze no, nye afɔrmbukyia no ahwɛdodze no: Amma ebufuhyew bi aammba Israelmba do bio.
Na mara, hwɛ, mafa wo nuanom Levifo no mefi Israelmba no mu: Mama hom dɛ wɔyɛ akyɛdze a wɔdze ama Ewuradze, dɛ wɔnyɛ ehyiadzibuw no ho edwuma.

Na ɔwo nye wo mbabanyin a wɔka wo ho no nhwɛ hom asɔfodzi no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no n'adze biara mu, na ntwamutam no mu dze no mu; na hom mfa nsom: Medze asɔfodzi no mema hom dɛ akyɛdze dwuma: Na ɔhɔho a ɔba ho no wonku no.

Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Aaron dɛ, na emidze, hwɛ, medze me mado-afɔr ahwɛdodze mama wo, mekyerɛ Israelmba adzekrɔnkrɔn nyinara, medze ama ɔwo nye wo mbabanyin no osian ngosera no ntsi, dɛ daa ahyɛdze.

Iyi na ɔnyɛ wodze wɔ krɔnkrɔn a wɔdze esie efi ogya no mu no mu: Hɔn ayɛyɛdze biara, mekyerɛ hɔn edziban-afɔr biara, nye hɔn bɔn ho afɔr biara, nye hɔn asodzi ho afɔr biara a wɔdze brɛ me no, ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn mma ɔwo nye wo mbabanyin no.
Dzi bi dɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn: Ɔbanyin biara ndzi bi; ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma wo.

Na iyi nyɛ wodze; hɔn ayɛyɛdze mu ɔmado-afɔr, mekyerɛ Israelmba hɔn ohim-afɔr nyinara; medze ama ɔwo, nye wo mbabanyin, nye wo mbabaa a wɔka wo ho, dɛ daa ahyɛdze: Obiara a no ho tsew wɔ wo fi mu no ndzi bi.
Ngo mu papa nyinara, nye wenyin nye eburow mu papa nyinara no mu nduadzewakan a wɔdze ma Ewuradze no, ɔwo na medze ama wo.
Hɔn asaase do nduadzewa nyinara mu edziban-beree a wɔdze brɛ Ewuradze no, ɔnyɛ wodze; obiara a no ho tsew wɔ wo fi mu no ndzi bi.
Israel mu adze biara a woehyira do ama nyɛ wodze.
Adze biara a obue ɔyafun, wɔhonam a wɔdze brɛ Ewuradze no nyinara mu, nyimpa nye abowa nyina, nyɛ wodze: Naaso ɔpon na pon nyimpa mbakan, nye abowa a hɔn ho nntsew mbakan so pon hɔn,
na hɔn a wɔrobɔpon hɔn a woedzi bosoom no, pon hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ w'abotwa tse, sika shekel enum, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea shekel tse (Ɔnoara yɛ gerah eduonu).
Na ɔnantwi abakan, anaa apɔnkye abakan dze, mma mmpon; wɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn: Fa hɔn bɔgyaa no petse afɔrmbukyia no do, na hyew hɔn seradze yɛ ogya-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma Ewuradze.
Na hɔn nam nyɛ wodze, dɛ mbrɛ ohim-nyan nye aserɛ nyimfa no yɛ wodze no.

Ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn mu ɔmado-afɔr nyinara a Israelmba dze brɛ Ewuradze no, medze mama ɔwo, nye wo mbabanyin, nye wo mbabaa a wɔka wo ho no, dɛ daa ahyɛdze: Ɔyɛ Ewuradze enyim daa nkyen ahyɛmu dze ma ɔwo nye w'asefo a wɔka wo ho no.
Na Ewuradze see Aaron dɛ, mma nnya egyapadze wɔ hɔn asaase mu, nkyii so mma nnya kyɛfa bi wɔ hɔn mu: Emi nye wo kyɛfa nye w'egyapadze wɔ Israelmba mu.
Na Levimba no dze, hwɛ, medze Israel mu ebupɛn du du nyinara mama hɔn dɛ egyapadze, ahyɛ hɔn som a wɔsom no ananmu, mekyerɛ ehyiadzebuw no ho ɔsom no a.
Na ɔdze-kɔ yi mma Israelmba no mmba ehyiadzibuw no ho, bɛyɛ na wɔasoa bɔn, na woewuwu.
Na Levifo no dze wɔnyɛ ehyiadzibuw no ho ɔsomedwuma, na wɔnsoa hɔn emumuyɛ: Ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ hom ebusuasantsen nyina mu, na Israelmba mu dze worinnya egyapadze.
Na Israelmba ebupɛn du du a wɔdze ma dɛ ɔmado-afɔr ma Ewuradze no, medze mama Levifo no dɛ egyapadze: Dɛm ntsi na mase hɔn dɛ, Israelmba mu dze worinnya egyapadze no.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,

afei so kasa kyerɛ Levifo no, na se hɔn dɛ, sɛ hom regyegye Israelmba no hɔ ebupɛn du du no a medze fi hɔn hɔ mama hom dɛ hom egyapadze no a, ɔno hom mfa no mu ebupɛn du du mu ebupɛn du nyɛ no ɔmado-afɔr mma Ewuradze.
Na wombu hom ɔmado-afɔr mma hom dɛ ewuporoweebea eburow, nye wenyintwer mãyɛ.
Dɛm na hom so mbɔ ɔmado-afɔr mma Ewuradze wɔ hom ebupɛn du du a, hom gyegye no wɔ Israelmba hɔ nyinara mu; na hom mfa no mu Ewuradze ɔmado-afɔr no mma ɔsɔfo Aaron.
Hom akyɛdze nyinara mu na hom mfa mu Ewuradze ɔmado-afɔr biara mbra, no mu papa nyinara, mekyerɛ no mu adzekrɔnkrɔn no.
Dɛm ntsi se hɔn dɛ, sɛ hom rema no mu papa no do a, ɔno wombu mma Levifo no dɛ ewuporoweebea ndɔree, nye wenyintwer ndɔree.
Na hom ndzi no beebiara, hom nye hom efifo: Na ɔyɛ hom akatua a ɔhyɛ hom ehyiadzibuw ho ɔsom edwuma ananmu.
Na sɛ hom rema no mu papa no do a, hom ronnsoa bɔn bi wɔ ne ntsi: Na mma hom nnhura Israelmba adzekrɔnkrɔn ho, mma hom eennwuwu.
19: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ,
Iyi nye mbra ahyɛdze a Ewuradze ahyɛ, dɛ, kasa kyerɛ Israelmba no, ma wɔmfa ɔnantwiber memen a nkekaa nnyi ho a onndzi dzɛm a kɔndua nnkɔr no do pɛn:
Na hom mfa no mma ɔsɔfo Eleaza, na ɔmfa no mfir edzi mbra nseraban no ekyir, na obi nku no wɔ n'enyim:
Na ɔsɔfo Eleazar mfa ne nsatseaba mfa no bɔgyaa bi, na ɔmpetse no bɔgyaa no bi ngu ehyiadzibuw no enyim afamu mpɛn esuon:
Na obinhyew ɔnantwiber no wɔ n'enyim; no nwoma, nye ne nam, nye no bɔgyaa, nye n'egyanan no, ɔnhyew:
Na ɔsɔfo no mfa kyindurdua, nye hyssop, nye serdaa, na ɔntow ngu ɔnantwiber a ɔrehyew no do.
Na afei ɔsɔfo no nhor ne ntar, na onguar no honam wɔ nsu mu, na n'ekyir no na ɔmbra nseraban no mu, na ɔsɔfo no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
Na nyia ɔhyew no no nhor ne ntar wɔ nsu mu, na onguar no honam wɔ nsu mu, na no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
Na ɔbanyin bi a no ho tsew nsesaw ɔnantwiber no nso no, na ɔmfa nkogu nseraban no ekyir beebi a ɔtsew, na wɔmfa nsie nyɛ Israelmba mboanofo ahoguar nsu: Ɔyɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
Na nyia ɔsesaw ɔnantwiber no nso no ɔnhor ne ntar, na no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir: Na ɔnyɛ Israelmba no, nye ɔhɔho a ɔsoɛ hɔn mu no, daa ahyɛdze.
Nyia ɔkã nyimpa biara no fun no no ho nntsew araa nda esuon:
Ɔnoara na ɔmfa iyi nguar noho da a otsīa ebiasa no, na da a otsīa esuon no na no ho atsew: Na sɛ oennguar noho da a otsīa ebiasa no, nye da a otsīa esuon no a, no ho renntsew.

Obiara a ɔkã nyimpa biara a oewu no fun no, na onnguar noho no, ogu Ewuradze ntamadan no ho fi; na ɔkra no wobotwa no efi Israel akyen: Osiandɛ wɔammpetse ahoguar nsu no enngu no do, no ho nntsew araa nda esuon.
Sɛ nyimpa wu asese mu a no ho mbra nye yi: Obiara a ɔba asese no mu, na obiara a ɔwɔ asese no mu no, no ho nntsew araa nda esuon.
Na kuraba biara a n'ano da hɔ a onnyi ebuado kyekyer do no, no ho nntsew.
Na obiara a ɔkã obi a ɔatɔr nkrantsee ano, anaa fun bi, anaa nyimpa biew bi, anaa nda bi wɔ haban mu no, no ho nntsew araa nda esuon.
Na nyia no ho nntsew no wɔmfa bɔn ho afɔr nhyewee no no nso no bi, na wɔmfa mbasu ngu do wɔ kuraba mu mma no:
Na nyimpa a no ho tsew bi mfa hyssop, na ɔmfa mbɔ nsu no mu, na ɔmfa mpetse asese no, nye ndzɛmba no nyinara, nye nyimpa a wɔwɔ hɔ no, nye nyia ɔkã obiew, anaa ɔtɔfo, anaa fun, anaa nda bi no do:

Na nyimpa a no ho tsew no mfa mpetse nyia no ho nntsew no do da a otsīa ebiasa no, nye da a otsīa esuon no onnguar no: na da a otsīa esuon no onguar no; na ɔnhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, na no ho ntsew ewimbir no.
Na nyimpa a no ho nntsew, na oennguar noho no, ɔkra no wobotwa no efi bagua no mu akyen, osiandɛ oegu Ewuradze krɔnkrɔn-bea ho fī: Wɔmmpetsee ahoguar nsu no wɔ no do; no ho nntsew.
Na ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze mma hɔn: Na nyia ɔkã ahoguar nsu no no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
Na adze biara a nyimapa a no ho nntsew no kã no, no ho nntsew; na ɔkra a ɔka no no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
20: Na Israelmba no, mekyerɛ mboanofo no nyina, baa Zin sar do wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu: Na ɔman no tsenaa Kadesh; na Miriam wui wɔ hɔ, na wosiee no wɔ hɔ.
Na nsu nnyi hɔ mma mboanofo no: Na wohyiaa hɔnho hyiae tsiaa Moses nye Aaron.
Na ɔman no nye Moses hamee, na wɔkãa dɛ, Ka hɛn nko a nkyɛ hɛn nuanom wuwui wɔ Ewuradze enyim no yewuwui!
Na ebɛn ntsi na hom dze Ewuradze baguaa aba sar yi do, dɛ yembowuwu wɔ ha, hɛn nye hɛn mbowa?
Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom ayɛ ma yeefi Egypt efir, dɛ hom dze hɛn reba bea bɔn yi do yi? Ɔnnyɛ abadua, anaa adɔmba, anaa wenyindua, anaa pomegranate-ekutu bea: Nkyii so nsu mpo a wɔnom bi nnyi hɔ.
Na Moses nye Aaron fii bagua no enyim kɔr ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano, na wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw hɔ: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛ Moses dɛ,
Fa poma no, na boa mboanofo no ano, ɔwo, nye wo nua Aaron, na hom nkasa nkyerɛ ɔbotan no wɔ hɔn enyim, ma ɔmma no nsu; na yi ɔbotan no mu nsu ma hɔn: Ma mboanofo no nye hɔn mbowannom.
Na Moses faa poma no fii Ewuradze enyim, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhyɛɛ no no.
Na Moses nye Aaron boaboaa bagua no ano wɔ ɔbotan no enyim, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, afei hom ntsie, hom asoɔdzenfo; ana yɛntwe ɔbotan yi mu nsu mma hom?
Na Moses maa ne nsa do, na ɔdze no poma no bɔɔ ɔbotan no mpɛn ebien: Na nsu fiir edzi naa pii, na mboanofo no nye hɔn mbowa nomee.
Na Ewuradze see Moses nye Aaron dɛ, osiandɛ hom anngye me enndzi, ammfa anntsew mo ho wɔ Israelmba enyim mu ntsi, hom remmfa bagua yi nndu asaase a medze mama hɔn no do.
Iyi nye Meriba nsu no; osiandɛ Israelmba nye Ewuradze hamee, na ɔtseew noho wɔ hɔn mu.
Na Moses somaa abɔfo fii Kadesh kɔr Edomhen hɔ dɛ, mbrɛ wo nua Israel se nye yi, Woara inyim awoko a aba hɛn do nyinara:
Mbrɛ hɛn egyanom dze sianee kɔr Egypt, na yɛdze tsenaa Egypt mber tsentsen; na Egyptfo yɛɛ hɛn, nye hɛn egyanom bɔn:
Na yesūi frɛɛ Ewuradze a, otsiee hɛn ndze, na ɔsomaa ɔbɔfo, na oyii hɛn fii Egypt no: Na, hwɛ yɛwɔ Kadesh, kurow a ɔwɔ wo ntoaado noho no mu:

Meserɛ wo, ma yentwa mu mfa w'asaase do: Yerunntwa mu mmfa haban anaa wenyin ture mu, nkyii so yɛronnom bura mu nsu bi: Yɛbɛfa ɔhɛn ne tsempɔn do ara akɔ, yɛremman enyimfa anaa abankum, ekodu dɛ yeetwa mu wɔ wo ntoaado.
Na Edom see no dɛ, mma mmbɛfa mo mu, bɛyɛ na medze nkrantsee efir edzi ebehyia wo.
Na Isrealmba no see no dɛ, yɛrebɛfa ɔtsempɔn do akɔ: Na sɛ emi nye mo mbowa nom wo nsu bi a, ɔno yebotua kaw: Ɔnnyɛ biribi ara, ma mo nko ara mfa m'anamɔn do ara mbotwa mu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Mma nntwa mu. Na Edom dze nkorɔfo pii, nye nsa a ɔyɛ dzen fiir edzi behyiaa no.
Dɛm na Edom poow dɛ ɔma Israel kwan wɔ no ntoaado: Dɛm ntsi Israel danee fii noho.
Na wotui fii Kadesh: Na Israelmba no, mekyerɛ mboanofo no nyina, baa bepɔw Hor ho.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron wɔ bepɔw Hor ho, wɔ Edom asaase ntoaado dɛ,
wɔrobɔboa Aaron ano ama no nkorɔfo: Na ɔronnkɔ asaase a medze mama Israelmba no do, osiandɛ hom yɛɛ asoɔdzen wɔ m'asɛm do wɔ Meribah nsu ho.
Fa Aaron nye ne babanyin Eleazar, na fa hɔn fow bepɔw Hor:
Na pɔr Aaron ne ntar no, na fa hyɛ ne babanyin Eleazar: Na wɔmboaboa Aaron mma nonkorɔfo, na onwu wɔ hɔ.
Na Moses yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ no: Na wɔfoow bepɔw Hor wɔ mboanofo no nyinara enyim.
Na Moses pɔɔr Aaron ne ntar no, na ɔdze hyɛɛ ne babanyin Eleazar; na Aaron wui wɔ bepɔw no etsifi hɔ: Na Moses nye Eleazar fii bepɔw no do sianee.
Na aber a mboanofo no nyinara hun dɛ Aaron ewu no, wosūu Aaron adaduasa, mekyerɛ Israel fi no nyinara.
21: Na Aradhen, Canaannyi no a, ɔtse Poma afamu no, tsee dɛ wɔrekã dɛ Israel nam Atharim ɔkwan do aba no; nna ɔnye Israel bɔkõe, na ɔfaa hɔn mu binom ndɔmmum.
Na Israel bɔɔ Ewuradze anohoba see dɛ, sɛ ɔwo dze ɔman yi rehyɛ me nsa dze a, nkyɛ mebɛsɛɛ hɔn nkurow huntuhuntu.
Na Ewuradze tsiee Israel ne ndze, na oyii Canaanfo no mae; na wɔsɛɛ hɔn nye hɔn nkurow no huntuhuntu: Na wɔtoo bea no dzin Hormah.
Na wotui fi bepɔw Hor ho dze faa Epo Memen kwan do, dɛ wɔrobɔ Edom asaase ho aprɔw akɔ: Na ahomtsew kãa ɔman no hɔn kra pii wɔ ɔkwan no ntsi.
Na ɔman no kasaa tsiaa Nyankopɔn, nye Moses, dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom eyi hɛn efi dɛ Egypt dɛ yembowuwu wɔ sar do yi? Na edzibanhun yi afon hɛn kra.
Na Ewuradze somaa abowatsena a wɔsɔw wɔ ɔman no mu, na wɔbɛkekaa ɔman no; na Israel mu nkorɔfo pii wuwuii.
Na ɔman no baa Moses nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, yɛayɛ bɔn, osiandɛ yɛakasa etsia Ewuradze, nye ɔwo: Pa Ewuradze kyɛw, ma ombeyi mbowatsena no mfi hɛn do. Na Moses paa kyɛw maa ɔman no.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, yɛ boran abowatsena, na fa si dua do: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, obiara a wɔaka no no, sɛ ohu a, obenya nkwa.
Na Moses yɛɛ boran abowatsena, na ɔdze sii dua no do: Na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ abowatsena ka nyimpa bi a, ɔhwɛ boran abowatsena no a, onya nkwa.
Na Israelmba no tui, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Oboth.
Na wotui fii Oboth, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Zered bɔnsa mu.
Hɔ na wofi tui, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Arnon a ɔwɔ sar do a ofi Amorifo ntoaado ba no, n'egya: Na Arnon nye Moab ntoaado a, ɔda Moab nye Amorifo ntamu.
Dɛm ntsi wɔkã no Ewuradze akodzi nwoma no mu dɛ, Vaheb wɔ Suphah, nye Arnon mbɔnsa no,
nye mbɔnsa no a ɔtserew no a ɔkom kɔ Ar tsenabew afamu no, Na ɔtwer Moab ntoaado ho no.
Na hɔ na wofi tui kɔr Beer: Ɔno nye nsubura a Ewuradze kãa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ, Boa ɔman no ano, na mebɛba hɔn nsu.
Aber no mu na Israel toow ndwom yi dɛ: Nsubura tue ɛ; hom ngye no do:
Nsubura a ahenmba tui no, ɔman no mu ekunyin no fumfunii, wɔdze ahempoma, ɔnye hɔn mpoma. Na wofi sar no do tui kɔr Mattanah:
Na wofi Mattanah kɔr Nahaliel: Na wofi Nahaliel kɔr Bamoth:
Na wofi Bamoth kɔr bɔnsa a ɔwɔ Moab haban mu wɔ Pisgah etsifi a ɔhwɛ sar yiredede no enyi no mu.
Na Israel somaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Amorifo hen Sihon nkyɛn, dɛ,
ma muntwa mu mfa w'asaase do: Yɛremman haban mu, anaa wenyin ture mu; yɛronnom nsubura mu nsu bi: Yɛrefa ɔhen tsepɔn do akɔ, ekodu dɛ yeetwa mu wɔ wo ntoaado.
Na Sihon amma Israel kwan ma woeenntwa mu wɔ no ntoado: Na mbom ɔboaa ne man nyinara ano, na ofiir edzi kehyiaa Israel wɔ sar no do, na ɔbaa Jahaz: Na ɔnye Israel bɔkõe.
Na Israel dze nkrantsee ano kum no, na ɔfaa n'asaase ofi Arnon do dze kɔ Jabbok do, mekyerɛ okodu Ammonmba ho: Osiandɛ Ammonmba ntoaado no Oɔyɛ dzen.
Na Israel faa nkurow yi nyinara: Na Israel tsenaa Amorifo nkurow no nyinara mu, wɔ Heshbon, nye no ho nkuroba nyinara mu.
Na Heshbon yɛ Amorifo hen Sihon kurow, ɔno na ɔnye nkan no Moabhen no akõ, na ɔagye ne nsamu n'asaase nyinara kodu Arnon ho.
Dɛm ntsi hɔn a wɔkasa wɔ mbɛbu mu no kã dɛ, hom mbra Heshbon, ma wɔnkyekyer na wontsintsim Sihon kurow no:
Na ogya bii efi Heshbon, Ogyaframee efi Sihon kurow mu: Ɔamen Moab Ar, Arnon mbea sorɔnsorɔm do ekunyin no
ɔwo Moab, due! Chemosh ɔman, ɔwo ayera: Oeyi ne mbabanyin ama dɛ eguamfo, na ne mbabaa akɔ ndɔmmum mu, wɔ Amorifo hen Sihon hɔ.
Yɛatotow hɔn; Heshbon ayera araa ekodu Dibon, yɛasɛɛ hɔn araa akɔ Nophah a ɔdze kodu Medeba.
Dɛm na Israel tsenaa Amorifo asaase do.
Na Moses somae ma wɔkɛseraa Jazer, na wɔfaa no nkuroba no, na wotuu Amorifo a wɔwɔ hɔ no.
Na wɔdanee na wɔkɔfowee kɔr Bashan ɔkwan do: Na Bashanhen Og fiir edzi kehyiaa hɔn, ɔno nye ne man nyinara, dɛ wɔrokɔkõ wɔ Edrei.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, mma nnsuro no: Na meyi ɔno, nye ne man nyinara, nye n'asaase mahyɛ wo nsa; na yɛ no dɛ mbrɛ eyɛɛ Amorifo hen Sihon a ɔtsenaa Heshbon no.
Nna wokunkum ɔno, nye ne mbabayin, nye ne man nyinara, kodur dɛ woenngyaa obi amma no: Na wɔfaa n'asaase no.
22: Na Israelmba no tui, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu wɔ Jericho Jordan egya.
Na Zippor ne babanyin Balak hun dza Israel ayɛ Amorifo no nyinara.
Na Moab suroo ɔman no dodow, osiandɛ wɔdɔɔ sõ: Na nketsenketse kitsaa hɔn wɔ Israelmba no ntsi.
Na Moab see Midian mpanyimfo dɛ, afei nyimpadodow yi bɛtafer dza etwa ehyia hɛn ho nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ ɔnantwi tafer haban mu efuw. Na Zippor ne babanyin Balak nna aber no mu ɔyɛ Moabhen.

Na ɔsomaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Boer ne babanyin Balaam hɔ, wɔ Pethor a ɔwɔ Esutsen no ho wɔ ne man mba asaase do dɛ wonkehyia no, dɛ, hwɛ, ɔman bi efi Egypt aba: Hwɛ, wɔkata asaase enyi, na wogu me tsentsendo:
Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, bra bɔdom ɔman yi ma me; na wɔyɛ dzen dodow ma me: Dɛ bi a mibedzi nyim, ma yeekuku hɔn, na maapam hɔn mefi asaase no do: Na minyim dɛ na nyia ɔwo edom no no wɔadom no.
Na Moab mpanyin nye Midian mpanyin no sii mu dze bunkɔ ho akatua no wɔ hɔn nsamu kɔree; na wɔbaa Balaam hɔ, na wɔbɛkãa Balak ne nsɛm no kyerɛɛ no.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nsoɛ ha anago yi, na mumbodua hom bi, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze bɛkã akyerɛ me no: Na Moab mbapɔmba no nye Balaam tsenae.
Na Nyankopɔn baa Balaam nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, mbayin bɛn na wɔnye wo wɔ hɔ yi?
Na Balaam see Nyankopɔn dɛ, Zippor ne babanyin Balak, Moabhen no, na ɔasoma ma woaba mo hɔ dɛ,
hwɛ, ɔman a woefi Egypt aba no, ɔkata asaase enyi: Afei, bra bɔdom hɔn ma me; dɛ bi a mubotum menye hɔn akõ, na mapam hɔn.
Na Nyankopɔn see Balaam dɛ, mma nnye hɔn nnkɔ, mma nndom ɔman no: na woehyira hɔn.
Na Balaam soɛɛr anapa no na ɔsee Balak mbapɔmba no dɛ, Hom nkɔ hom asaase do: Na Ewuradze mmpen dɛ ɔbɛma me kwan ma menye hom akɔ.
Na Moab mbapɔmba no soɛree, na wɔbaa Balak nkyɛn, na wɔsee dɛ, Balaam ammpen dɛ ɔnye hɛn bɛba.
Na Balak somaa mbapɔmba a wɔdɔɔ sõ, na hɔn enyim wɔ nyam sen hɔn so bio.
Na wɔbaa Balaam nkyɛn, na wɔsee no dɛ, mbrɛ Zippor babanyin Balak se nye yi, mepa wo kyɛw, mma biribi nnsiw wo me nkyɛn ba ho kwan:
Na mebɛhyɛ wo enyimnyam kɛsenara, na biribiara a ebɛse meno mebɛyɛ: Dɛm ntsi bra, meserɛ wo, bɔdom ɔman yi ma me.
Na Balaam buae na ɔsee Balak nkowaa no dɛ, sɛ Balak dze dwetɛ nye sika ne fi mã mpo bɛma me a, murunntum mummbu Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn n'asɛm do mennkɛyɛ biribi ketseaba anaa kɛse.
Afei dɛm ntsi, mɛserɛ hom, hom so ntsintsim ha anago yi, ma munhu dza Ewuradze bɛkã akyerɛ me bio.
Na Nyankopɔn baa Balaam nkyɛn anago, na ɔsee no dɛ, sɛ mbanyin no ba behyia wo a, soɛr, nye hɔn nkɔ; mbom asɛm a mekã mekyerɛ wo no nko na yɛ.
Na Balaam soɛɛr anapa no, na ɔhyehyɛɛ n'asoaso, na ɔnye Moab mbapɔmba no kɔree.
Na Nyankopɔn ebufuw dzɛwee dɛ ɔkɔree: Na Ewuradze bɔfoe begyinaa ɔkwan no do dɛ ɔyɛfo bi a otsia no. Na ɔnodze ɔtse n'asoaso do reba, na no nkowaa beenu ka no ho.
Na asoaso no hun Ewuradze no bɔfoe no dɛ ogyina ɔkwan no mu, ɔatwe ne nkrantsee kitsa ne nsamu: Na asoaso no danee fii ɔkwan no mu: Na Balaam bɔɔ asoaso no dɛ ɔdze redan no aba ɔkwan mu.
Nna Ewuradze no bɔfoe no kegyinaa wenyin nture ntamu ɔkwan tokur bi mu, ban wɔ afã ha, na ban wɔ afã ha.
Na asoaso no hun Ewuradze no bɔfoe no, na ɔdze noho miaa ɔfadum no ho, na ɔdze Balaam n'anan miaa ɔfadum no: Na ɔbɔɔ no bio.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no kɔr kan, na okegyinaa beebi a ɔmoa, mbrɛ ɔkwan bi nnyi a wɔdan fa enyimfa anaa abankum.
Na asoaso no hun Ewuradze no bofoe no, na obutuuw famu wɔ Balaam n'ase: Na Balaam n'ebufuw dzɛwee, na ɔdze n'abaa bɔ asoaso no.
Na Ewuradze buee asoaso no ano, na ɔsee Balaam dɛ, ebɛnadze na mayɛ wo, na abɔ me mpɛn ebiasa yi?
Na Balaam see asoaso no dɛ, osiandɛ esi me atwetwe: Kɛtseankyɛ nkrantsee kitsa me nsamu, nkyɛ sisei meku wo.
Na asoaso no see Balaam dɛ, Ana nnyɛ w'asoaso nye me a atsena mo do wo nkwa tsentsen nyinara dze ebodu ndɛ da yi? Ana menya wo dɛm nyɛe pɛn? Na ɔsee dɛ, Oho.
Nna Ewuradze buee Balaam n'enyiwa, na ohun Ewuradze no bɔfoe no dɛ ogyina ɔkwna no mu, wɔatwe ne nkrantse kitsa ne nsamu: Na ɔbɔɔ ne tsir adze, na ɔdze n'enyim butuuw famu.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no see no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na abɔ w'asoaso mpɛn ebiasa yi? Hwɛ, emi na mefir edzi abɛyɛ wo ɔyɛfo osiandɛ wo kwan no akyea wɔ m'enyim:
Na asoaso no hun me, na ɔdanee fii m'enyim mpɛn ebiasa yi: Sɛ wɔanndan emmfi m'enyim dze a, nkyɛ wo so sisei meku wo, na magye wo nkwa.
Na Balaam see Ewuradze no bɔfoe no dɛ, Mayɛ bɔn; na minnyim dɛ ɔwo na igyinaa ɔkwan no mu tsiaa me: Dɛm ntsi afei, sɛ emmpɛ a, mebɛsan m'ekyir bio.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe no see Balaam dɛ, Nye mbanyin no nkɔ: Na mbom asɛm a mebɛkã makyerɛ wo no nko na kã. Nna Balaam nye balak mbapɔmba no kɔree.
Na aber a Balak tsee dɛ Balaam reba no, ofiir edzi kehyiaa no wɔ Moab Kurow a ɔda Arnon ntoaado a ɔwɔ ntoaado ano no.
Na Balak see Balaam dɛ, Ana nnyɛ enyiberdo ara an amosomaa dɛ wombehyia wo ma bra? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ammba me nkyɛn? Ampa dɛ murunntum mennhyɛ wo enyimnyam a?
Na Balaam see Balak dɛ, hwɛ, maba wo nkyɛn: Ana afei mowɔ tum biara a medze mekã asɛm bi? Asɛm a Nyankopɔn dze bɛhyɛ m'anomu no, ɔno na mebɛkã.
Na Balaam nye Balak kɔree, na wɔbaa Kiriath-huzoth.
Na Balak dze anantwi nye nguan bɔɔ okum-afɔr, na ɔdze kɛmaa Balaam nye mbapɔmba a wɔnye no wɔ hɔ no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ anapa no, Balak faa Balaam, na ɔdze no fowee kɔr Baal ne mbea sorɔsorɔm no do, na ofi hɔ hun ɔman no ano.
23: Na balaam see Balak dɛ, sisi afɔrmbukyia esuon ma me wɔ ha, na siesie anantwisaa esuon nye ndwanyin euson ma me wɔ ha.
Na Balak yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Balaam kãe no; na Balak nye Balaam dze ɔnantwisaa kor nye odwanyin kor bobɔɔ afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia biara do.
Na Balaam see Balak dɛ, gyina wo hyew-afɔr no ho, na monkɔ, anyanyanbiara Ewuradze bɛba ebehyia me a: Na biribiara a ɔdze bɛkyerɛ me no mebɛkã makyerɛ wo. Na osii mu kɔr sorɔnsorɔm pataa bi do.
Na Nyankopɔn behyiaa Balaam: Na ɔsee no dɛ, mesiesie afɔrmbukyia esuon no, na medze ɔnantwisaa nye odwanyin nkorkor mabobɔ afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia biara do.
Na Ewuradze dze asɛm hyɛɛ Balaam anomu, see dɛ, san kɔ Balak nkyɛn, na mbrɛ kã nye yi.
Na ɔsanee kɔr ne nkyɛn, na, hwɛ, ogyina ne hyew-afɔr no ho, ɔno nye Moab mbapɔmba no nyinara.
Na obuu ne bɛ see dɛ, Aram na Balak kɛfaa me fi bae, Moabhen no faa me fi Boka mbepɛw no mu dɛ: Bra, bɔdom Jacob ma me, na bra, bɛhyɛ Israel ahoraa.
Meyɛ dɛn na modom nyia Nyame nndoom no? Na meyɛ dɛn na mehyɛ nyia Ewuradze nnhyɛɛ no ahorohoraa?
Abotan etsifi na mifi munhun no, na akoko do na mifi megyeen no: Hwɛ, ɔman a no nko bɛtsena a, na worummbu no mmfora amanamn.
Woana botum akan Jacob huntuma, anaa Israel ebupɛn anan mu kor no dodow? Ma munwu ɔtseneneenyi wu, na ma m'ewiei nyɛ dɛ nedze!
Na Balak see Balaam dɛ, ebɛnadze na edze ayɛ me yi? Mekɛfaa wo dɛ bɔdom m'atamfo, na, hwɛ, ehyira hɔn koraa.
Na obuae see dɛ, Ana onnhia dɛ mohwɛ yie na mekã dza Ewuradze dze hyɛɛ m'anomu no bi a?
Na Balak see no dɛ, mepa wo kyɛw, bra ma yɛnkɔ beebi fofor, mbrɛ ifi bohu hɔn; ibohu hɔn ano nko, na innkohu hɔn nyinara: Na dom hɔn ma me wɔ hɔ.
Na ɔfaa no kɔr Zophim haban mu, wɔ Pisgah etsifi, na osisii mbukyia esuon, na ɔdzde ɔnantwisaa, nye odwanyin bobɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia biara do.
Na ɔsee Balak dɛ, gyina wo hyew-afɔr ho ha, ber a mirikehyia Ewuradze wɔ enyim noho yi.
Na Ewuradze behyiaa Balaam, na ɔdze asɛm hyɛɛ n'anomu, see dɛ, san kɔ Balak nkyɛn, na mbrɛ kã nye yi.
Na ɔbaa ne nkyɛn, na, hwɛ, ogyina ne hyew-afɔr no ho, na Moab mbapɔmba ka no ho. Na Balak see no dɛ, Ewuradze akã dɛn?
Na obuu ne bɛ see dɛ, soɛr, Balak, na tsie; yɛ aso ma me, Zippor babanyin:
Nyankopɔn nnyɛ nyimpa, na oeedzi ator; anaaso nyimpa ba, na oeenu noho: Ana ɔase, na ɔrennyɛ? Ana ɔakasa, na ɔremma onntsim?
Hwɛ, nhyira ho mbra na menya: Na oehyira, na murunntum menndan enyi.
Ɔnnhwɛɛ emumuyɛ wɔ Jacob mu, nkyii so onnhun nkontompɔ wɔ Israel mu: Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn nye no wɔ hɔ, Na ɔhen ho esebɔ wɔ hɔn mu.
Nyame eyi hɔn wɔ Egypt; ɔwɔ ahoɔdzen dɛ ɔnantwi bɔyafo.
Ampaara nkaber bi nnyi Jacob mu, nkyii so bunkɔ bi nnyi Israel mu: Afei na wɔbɛkã no wɔ Jacob nye Israel ho dɛ, ebɛnadze na Nyame ayɛ yi!
Hwɛ, ɔman no soɛr dɛ ogyataber, na ɔma noho do dɛ ogyata: Orummbutuw gyedɛ oedzi afonam, na ɔanom ɔtɔfo bɔgyaa ana.
Na Balak see Balaam dɛ, ndom na enndom hɔn a, na nhyira so innhyira hɔn.
Na Balaam buae na ɔsee Balak dɛ, Ana mannkã mannkyerɛ wo dɛ, dza Ewuradze bɛkã no nyinara, nna mebɛyɛ?
Na Balak see Balaam dɛ, afei bra, ma memfa wo monkɔ beebi fofor; anyanyanbiara ɔbɔsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi ma efi hɔ adom hɔn ama me.
Na Balak faa Balaam kɔr Peor etsifi a ɔhwɛ sar pradada no enyi no.
Na Balaam see Balak dɛ, sisi afɔrmbukyia esuon ma me wɔ ha, na siesie anantwisaa esuon nye ndwanyin esuon ma me wɔ ha.
Na Balak yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Balaam see no, na ɔdze ɔnantwisaa nye odwanyin bobɔɔ ɔhyew-afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia biara do.
24: Na aber a Balaam hun dɛ asɔ Ewuradze enyi dɛ ohyira Israel no, ɔannkɔ annkɔhwehwɛ nkaber, dɛ nkan no, mbom ɔdze n'enyi kedzii sar no do.
Na Balaam maa n'enyi do, na ohun Israel dɛ wogu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuakuw ebusuakuw tsetsee; na Nyankopɔn sunsum baa no do.
Na obuu ne bɛ see dɛ, Boer babanyin Balaam se dɛ, ɔbanyin a n'enyi emua no se dɛ:
Nyia otsie Nyame ne nsɛm no, nyia ohu Twerammpon enyidoadze no, ɔrohwe ase a, wɔtseew n'enyi do no, ɔse dɛ:
Ao Jacob, mbrɛ wo tsenabea dua yɛ fɛw a, wo ntamadan no, Ao Israel!
Wɔtserɛw dɛ mbɔnsa, dɛ esutsen ho nture, dɛ aloe-ndua a Ewuradze atsetsɛw, dɛ nsu ho kyindur-ndua.
No mbokitsi mu nsu bobu do, na n'asefo bɛtsena nsu pii mu, na ne hen bɔkrɔn asen Agag, na wɔbɛma n'ahendzi do.
Nyame eyi no efi Egypt; ɔwɔ ahoɔdzen dɛ ɔnantwi bɔyafo: Obedzi amanaman a wɔyɛ n'atamfo, na woebubu hɔn mbiew esinesin, na ɔdze n'egyen-menaba ehwirahwira hɔn mu.
Ɔkotowee, ɔdaa famu dɛ ogyata, na dɛ ogyataber; woana na obopusuw no? Nhyira nkã obiara a ohyira wo, na ndom nkã obiara a ɔdom wo.
Na Balak n'ebufuw dzɛɛw Balaam do, na ɔbɔɔ ne nsamu: Na Balak see Balaam dɛ, mibehyiaa wo dɛ bɔdom m'atamfo, na, hwɛ, ɔwo ehyira hɔn mpɛn ebiasa nye yi.
Dɛm ntsi afei guan kɔ mbrɛ ifi: Modween dɛ nkyɛ mebɛhyɛ wo enyimnyam kɛse; na, hwɛ, Ewuradze esiw w'enyimnyam ho kwan.
Na Balaam see Balak dɛ, Ana mannkã annkyerɛ w'abɔfoe a esomaa hɔn me nkyɛn no so dɛ,
sɛ Balak dze dwetɛ nye sika nye fi mã mpo bɛma me a, murunntum mummbu Ewuradze n'asɛm do mommbɔ me tsir mu nnkɛyɛ papa anaa bɔn: Dza Ewuradze bɛkã no, ɔno na mebɛkã?
Na afei, hwɛ, morokɔ me man mu: Bra, na memma ihu dza ɔman yi dze bɛyɛ wo man wɔ nda a odzi ekyir no mu.
Na obuu ne bɛ see dɛ, Boer babanyin Balaam se dɛ, ɔbanyin a n'enyi emua no se dɛ:
Nyia otsie Nyame ne nsɛm no, na onyim Abɔso no ho nyimdzee no, nyia ohu Twerammpon enyidoadze no, ɔrohwe ase a, wɔtseew n'enyi do no ɔse dɛ:
Muhu no, nnyɛ sesei dze a; mohwɛ no, ɔmmbɛn dze: Nworaba bi fi Jacob mu bopue, na ahempoma befi Israel mu asoɛr, na wɔabɔ afa Moab nkukuwa mu, na wɔadwerew mba gyigyeegye no nyinara.
Na Edom bɛyɛ adzenyadze, seir so a wɔyɛ n'atamfo bɛyɛ n'adzeyadze; na Israel bɛyɛ mbanyindze ara.
Na obi fi Jacob mu bedzi tum, na ɔasɛɛ kurow no mu dza aka no.
Na ɔhwɛɛ Amalek, na obuu ne bɛ see dɛ, Amalek nye amanaman mu odzikamfo; na n'ewiei bowie no ɔsɛɛ mu.
Na ɔhwɛɛ Kennyi, na obuu ne bɛ see dɛ, wo tsenabew si hɔ pintsinn, na wɔdze wo berɛbuw ahyɛ ɔbotan mu.
Na obuu ne bɛ see dɛ, ebei, Nyame reyɛ iyi no woana bɛtsena ase?
Na ahɛn befi Kittim mbew do aba, na wɔabɛhaw Asshur, na wɔahaw Eber, na ɔnoara so ewie no ɔsɛɛ mu.
Na Balaam soɛree, na osii mu sanee kɔr ne tsenabew: Na Balak so faa no kwan kɔree.
25: Na Israel tsenaa Shittim, na ɔman no hyɛɛ ase nye Moab mbabaa no yɛɛ ehuhudze:
Na wohyiahyiaa ɔman no kɔr hɔn enyame okum-afɔr ho; na ɔman no dzidzii, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze maa hɔn enyame no.
Na Israel dze noho bɔɔ Baal-peor ho: Na Ewuradze ebufuw dzɛɛw Israel do.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, fa ɔman no mu etsitsir nyinara, na sensɛn hɔn ma Ewuradze ewia do, ma Ewuradze ebufuhyew no ndan mfi Israel do.
Na Moses see Israel atsɛmbuafo no dɛ, hom mu obiara nkuku ne mbanyin a wɔdze hɔnho akɔbɔ Baal-peor ho no.
Na hwɛ, Israelmba no mu kor ɔdze Midiannyi ɔbaa bi baa no nuanom no nkyɛn wɔ Moses n'enyim, nye Israelmba mboanofo no nyinra enyim, aber a worusūsu wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano.
Na aber a ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Eleazar, ne babanyin Phinehas, hunii no, ɔsoɛree fii mboanofo no mu, na ɔfaa nkambaa kitsaa ne nsamu;
na odzii Israelnyi no ekyir kɔr pia no mu, na ɔdze wowɔɔ hɔn mu ebien nyina hwirahwiraa mu, Israelnyi no, nye ɔbaa no ohwiraa no fur mu. Nna ɔyardɔm no siankae fii Israelmba no do.
Na hɔn a wowuwui wɔ ɔyardɔm no mu no wɔyɛ mpemeduonu anan.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Eleazar, ne Babanyin Phinehas, adan ebufuw efi Israelmba do, wɔ dɛ ɔatwe me nyinkuntwe ho nyinkun wɔ hɔn mu, ma mannhyew Israelmba no wɔ me nyinkuntwe mu.
Dɛm ntsi se dɛ, hwɛ, medze m'asomdwee ahyɛmu mema no:
Ɔnyɛ ɔno, nye n'asefo a wobedzi n'ekyir no daa asɔfodzi ahyɛmu: Osiandɛ ɔatwe ne Nyankopɔn ho nyinkun, na ɔapata ama Israelmba no.
Na Israelnyi no a wokum no no, nyia wokum no kaa Midiannyi ɔbaa no ho no, ne dzin dze Zimri, Salu ne babanyin a, ɔyɛ Simeonfo egyanom ofi mu ɔbapɔmba.
Na Midiannyi ɔbaa no a wokum no no, ne dzindze Cozbi, Zur a ɔyɛ otsitsir wɔ Midian egyanom ofi bi mu nkorɔfo do no, ne babaa a.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Hom nhiahia Midianfo no ho, na wonku hɔn:

Na hɔn so wɔdze hɔn ndaadaa a wɔdze adaadaa hom wɔ Peor ho asɛm no mu, nye Cozbi, Midian ɔsafohen no ne babaa no, hɔn akyerɛbaa no a wokum no wɔ ɔyardɔm da no mu wɔ Peor ho asɛm no mu, ehiahia hom ho.
26: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔyardɔm no ekyir no, Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin dɛ,
hom nkan Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara, ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu do dzerokɔ no, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, hɔn a wotum ɔsa kɔ wɔ Israel nyinara.
Na Moses nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar nye hɔn kasae wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu wɔ Jericho Jordan nkyɛn dɛ,
Hom nkan ɔman no ɔfi hɔn a woedzi mfe edonu do dze rokɔ no; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses nye Israelmba a wofi Egypt asaase do bae no.
Reuben, Israel n'abakan no: Reuben ne mbabanyin; Hanoch dze, Hanochfo ebusua: Pallu dze, Pallufo ebusua:
Hezron dze, Hezronfo ebusua: Carmi dze, Carmifo ebusua.
Iyinom nye Reubenfo ebusua ebusua: Na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu wɔyɛ mpemeduanan ebiasa nye ahaesuon eduasa.
Na Pallu ne mbabanyin; Eliab.

Na Eliab ne mbabanyin; Nemuel, nye Dathan, nye Abiram. Iyinom nye Dathan, nye Abiram no a wɔfrɛɛ hɔn wɔ mboanofo no mu no a wɔhaam Moses nye Aaron ho wɔ Korah no kuw no mu, wɔ aber a wɔhaam Ewuradze ho:
Na asaase buee n'ano, na ɔmemeen hɔn dze kaa Korah ho, aber a kuw no wuwui no; wɔ aber a ogya memeen nyimpa ahaenu eduonum, na wɔbɛyɛɛ asɛnkyerɛdze no.
Naaso Korah ne mbabanyin no woennwuwu.
Simeon ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua tsetsee: Nemuel dze, Nemuelfo ebusua: Jamin dze, Jaminfo ebusua: Jachin dze, Jachinfo ebusua:
Zerah dze, Zerahfo ebusua: Shaul dze, Shaulfo ebusua.
Iyinom nye Simeonfo ebusua, mpemeduonu ebien nye ahaenu.
Gad ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua tsetsee: Zephon dze, Zephonfo ebusua: Haggi dze, Haggifo ebusua: Shuni dze, Shunifo ebusua:
Ozni dze, Oznifo ebusua: Eri dze, Erifo ebusua:
Arod dze, Arodfo ebusua: Areli dze, Arelifo ebusua.
Iyinom nye Gad ne mbabanyin ebusua ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu tse, mpeneduanan nye ahaenum.
Judah ne mbabanyin, Er nye Onan: Na Er nye Onan wowui wɔ Canaan asaase do.
Na Judah ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua tsetsee nye yi; Shelah dze, Shelahfo ebusua: Perez dze, Perezfo ebusua: Zerah dze, Zerahfo ebusua.
Na Perez ne mbabanyin nye yi; Hezron dze Hezronfo ebusua: Hamul dze Hamulfo ebusua.
Iyinom nye Judah ebusua ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu tse, mpemeduosuon esia nye ahaenum.
Issachar ne mbabanyin: Tola dze, Tolafo ebusua: Puvah dze, Punifo ebusua:
Jashub dze, Jashubfo ebusua: Shimron dze, Shimron fo ebusua.
Iyinom nye Issachar ebusua ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu tse, mpemeduosia anan nye ahaasa.
Zebulun ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua tsetsee: Serad dze, Seredfo ebusua: Elon dze, Elonfo ebusua: Jahleel dze Jahleelfo ebusua.
Iyinom nye Zebulunfo ebusua ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu tse, mpemeduosia nye ahaenum.
Joseph ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Manasse nye Ephraim.
Manasseh ne mbabanyin: Machir dze Machirfo ebusua: Na Machir woo Gilead Gilead: Gilead dze, Gileadfo ebusua.
Iyinom nye Gilead ne mbabanyin: Iezer dze, Iezerfo ebusua: Helek dze, Helekfo ebusua:
Asriel dze, Asrielfo ebusua: Na Shechem dze, Shechemfo ebusua:
Na Shemida dze, Shemidafo ebusua: Na Hepher dze, Hepherfo ebusua.
Na Hepher ne mbabanyin Zelophehad ennya mbabanyin, na onyaa mbabaa: A Zelophehad ne mbabaa edzin nye Mahlah, nye Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, nye Tirzah.
Iyinom nye Manasseh ebusua ebusua: Na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu wɔyɛ mpemeduonum ebien nye ahaesuon.
Iyinom nye Ephraim ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Shuthelah dze, Shuthelafo ebusua: Becher dze, Becherfo ebusua: Tahan dze, Tahanfo ebusua.
Na iyinom nye Shuthelah ne mbabanyin: Eran dze, Eranfo ebusua.
Iyinom nye Ephrain ne mbabanyin ebusua ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu tse, mpemeduasa ebien nye ahaenum. Iyinom nye Joseph ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua tsetsee.
Benjamin ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Bela dze, Belafo ebusua: Ashbel dze, Ashbelfo ebusua: Ahiram dze, Ahiramfo ebusua:
Shephupham dze, Shuphamfo ebusua: Hupham dze, Huphamfo ebusua.
Na Bela ne mbabanyin nye Ard nye Naaman: Ard dze, Ardfo ebusua: Naaman dze, Naamanfo ebusua.
Iyinomnye Benjamin ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu wɔyɛ mpemeduanan enum nye ahaesia.
Iyinom nye Dan ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Shuham dze, Shuhamfo ebusua. Iyinom nye Dan ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Shuhamfo ebusua ebusua nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu tse, wɔyɛ mpemeduosia anan nye ahaanan.
Asher ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Imnah dze, Imnahfo ebusua: Ishvi dze, Ishvifo ebusua: Beria dze, Beriafo ebusua.
Beria ne mbabanyin dze: Heber dze, Heberfo ebusua: Malchiel dze, Machielfo ebusua.
Na Asher ne babaa ne dzin dze Serah.
Iyinom nye Asher ne mbabanyin ebusua ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu tse, mpemeduonum ebiasa nye ahaanan.
Naphtali ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Jahzeel dze, Jahzeelfo ebusua: Guni dze, Gunifo ebusua:
Jezer dze, Jezerfo ebusua: Shillem dze, Shillemfo ebusua.
Iyinom nye Naphtali ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔm wɔ mu wɔyɛ mpemeduanan enum nye ahaanan.
Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Israelmba mu, mpemahaesia nye apem ahaesuon eduasa.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Iyinom na wɔnkyɛ asaase no mma hɔn dɛ egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse.
Nyia ɔsõ no ma no egyapadze a ɔsõ, na nyia osuar no ma no egyapadze a osuar: Obiara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn no mu tse no na wɔmfa n'egyapadze mma no.
Naaso asaase no wɔmfa tonto nkyɛ: Dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom ebusuakuw ebusuakuw edzin tsetsee no na wonnya egyapadze no.
Dɛ mbrɛ tonto no tse no na wɔmfa nkyɛ hɔn egyapadze no mma hɔn a wɔso nye hɔn a wosuar.
Na iyinom nye hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Levifo mu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Gershon dze, Gershonfo ebusua: Kohath dze, Kohathfo ebusua: Merari dze, Merarifo ebusua.
Iyinom nye Levi ebusua ebusua: Libnifo ebusua, Hebronfo ebusua, Mahlfo ebusua, Korahfo ebusua. Na Kohath woo Amram.
Na Amram ne yer dzin dze Jochebed, Levi ne babaa a wɔwoo no ma Levi wɔ Egypt no a: Na ɔwoo Aaron nye Moses nye hɔn akyerɛbaa Miriam maa Amram.
Na Aaron so wɔwoo Nadab nye Abihu, Eleazar nye Ithamar maa no.
Na Nadab nye Abihu wuwui, wɔ aber a wɔdze ananagya baa Ewuradze enyim no.
Na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu wɔyɛ mpemeduonu ebiasa, ɔbanyin biara a oedzi bosoom nye ekyir no: Na wɔannkan hɔn ammfora Israelmba, osiandɛ wɔamma hɔn egyapadze wɔ Israelmba no mu.
Iyinom nye hɔn a Moses nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar kaan hɔn no; hɔn a wɔkaan Israelmba wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu wɔ Jericho Jordan ho no a.
Na iyinom mu dze ɔbanyin biara nnyi mu a ofi hɔn a Moses nye ɔsɔfo Aaron kaan hɔn wɔ aber a wɔkaan Israelmba wɔ Sinai sar do no mu.
Na Ewuradze akã no wɔ hɔn ho dɛ, owu na wobowuwu wɔ sar no do. Na hɔn mu nyimpa biara annka, gyedɛ Jephunneh ne babanyin Caleb, nye Nun ne babanyin Joshua.
27: Nna Zelophehad, Hepher ne babanyin no, Gilead ne babanyin no, Machir ne babanyin no, manasseh ne babanyin no, ne mbabaa a wofi Joseph ne babanyin Manasseh ebusua ebusua mu no, twee bɛnee: na ne babaa no hɔn edzin nye yi; Mahlah, Noah, nye Hoglah, nye Milcah, nye Tirzah.
Na wobegyinaa Moses, nye ɔsɔfo mboanofo no nyinara enyim, nye ehyiadzibuw no n'abowano dɛ,
Hɛn egya wui wɔ sar no do, nna onnyi kuw no a wohyiahyiaa hɔnho hyiaa dze tsiaa Ewuradze wɔ Korah kuw no mu no mu: Mbom owui wɔ nankasa no bɔn mu: Na oennya mbabanyin.
Ebɛnadze ntsi na wonyi hɛn egya ne dzin mfi n'ebusua mu, dɛ oennya ɔbanyin ntsi yi? Ma hɛn enyadze wɔ hɛn egya no nuanom mu.
Na Moses dze hɔn asɛm no baa Ewuradze enyim.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Zelophehad me mbabaa no akã no tsenn: Ɔma na ma hɔn egyapadze mu enyadze wɔ hɔn egya no nuanom mu; na ma hɔn egya n'egyapadze no nkɔ hɔn hɔ.
Na kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Sɛ ɔbanyin bi wu, na onnyi ɔbabanyin a, ɔno hom mma n'egyapadze nkɔ ne babaa hɔ.
Na sɛ onnyi ɔbabaa a ɔno hom mfa n'egyapadze mma no nuanom.
Na sɛ onnyi nuanom a, ɔno hom mfa n'egyapadze mma egya no nuanom.
Na sɛ n'egya nnyi nuanom a, ɔno hom mfa n'egyapadze mma no bɔgyaa a ɔbɛn no wɔ n'ebusua mu, na ɔmfa: Na iyi nyɛ atsɛmbu ahyɛdze mma Israelmba, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, fow Abarim bepow yi, na kɔhwɛ asaase a medze mama Israelmba no.
Na sɛ inya hu a, wo so wɔaboaboa wo ama wo nkorɔfo, dɛ mbrɛ wɔboaboa wo nua Aaron no:
Osiandɛ hom yɛɛ asoɔdzen wɔ n'asɛm ho wɔ Zin sar do, wɔ mboanofo ham no mu, dɛ nkyɛ wɔtsew mo ho wɔ nsu no ho wɔ hɔn enyim. (Iyi nye Meribah nsu no wɔ Kadesh wɔ Sin sar do no.)
Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ Ewuradze dɛ,
ma Ewuradze, honam nyinara esunsum Nyankopɔn, nhwehwɛ ɔbanyin bi nsi mboanofo no do a
obedzi hɔn enyim efir edzi, na obedzi hɔn enyim aba mu a obegya hɔn epue, na ɔdze hɔn bɛba mu; amma Ewuradze no mboanofo aannyɛ dɛ nguan a wonnyi oguanhwɛfo.
Na Ewuradze see Moses dɛ, fa Joshua, Nun ne babanyin no, ɔbanyin a sunsum no wɔ no mu no, na fa wo nsa to no do;
na fa no gyina ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye mboanofo no nyinara enyim; na hyɛ no mbra wɔ hɔn enyim.
Na fa w'enyimnyam no bi ma no, ma Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara ntsie no.

Na onkegyina ɔsɔfo Eleazar enyim, ɔno na obebisa Urim atsɛmbu ama no wɔ Ewuradze enyim: N'asɛm do na womfir edzi, na n'asɛm do na wɔmbra mu, ɔno nye Israelmba nyinara a wɔka no no nyina, mekyerɛ mboanofo no nyinara.
Na Moses yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ no no nyinara: Na ɔfaa Joshua, na ɔdze no kegyinaa ɔsɔfo Eleazer, nye mboanofo no nyinara enyim:
Na ɔdze ne nsa guu no do, na ɔhyɛɛ no mbra, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze nam Moses do kãe no.
28: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
hyɛ Israelmba no, na se hɔn dɛ, m'ayɛyɛdze, me gya-afɔr edziban a oyi nka huanhuam ma me no, hom ndwen do mfa mbrɛ me wɔ ne ber a ɔsɛ mu.
Na se hɔn dɛ, Ogya-afɔr a hom mfa mbra Ewuradze nye yi; nguambaanyin a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm, na wɔmfa ebien da kor mbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr daa.
Eguambaa kor na fa bɔ afɔr anapa na eguambaa kor so fa bɔ afɔr ewimbir;
na fa isiam pa ephah ebupɛn du mu kor yɛ edziban-afɔr a wɔdze ngo a woesiw hin ebupɛn anan mu kor afrɔw.
Ɔyɛ daa afɔr a wɔhyehyɛe wɔ bepɔw Sinai do a oyi nka huanhuam a ɔyɛ ogya-afɔr ma Ewuradze.
Na no nom-afɔr wɔ eguambaa kor ho nyɛ hin ebupɛn anan mu kor: Na bea krɔnkrɔn no do na hue ɔnom-afɔr nsãdzen no ma Ewuradze.
Na eguambaa kor no so fa bɔ afɔr ewimbir no: Dɛ mbrɛ anapa edziban-afɔr no tse, na mbrɛ no nom-afɔr no tse no, na fa bɔ ne gya-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma Ewuradze.
Na ahomgyeda no nguanbaanyin ebien a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm, nye edziban-afɔr isiam pa ephah ebupɛn du mu ebien a wɔdze ngo afrɔw nye no nom-afɔr:
Iyi nye ahomgyeda biara ne hyew-afɔr a ɔka daa ɔhyew-afɔr, nye no nom-afɔr ho.
Na hom abosoom ahyɛse no hom mbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr mma Ewuradze; anantwisaa mburwa ebien, nye odwanyin kor, nguambaanyin esuon a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm;
na edziban-afɔr isiam pa ephah ebupɛn du mu ebiasa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, nka ɔnantwisaa kor ho; na edziban-afɔr isiam pa ebupɛn du mu ebien a wɔdze ngo afrɔw nka odwanyin kor no ho;
na edziban-afɔr isiam pa ebupɛn du mu nkorkor a wɔdze no afrɔw, nka eguambaa biara ho; nye ɔhyew-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam, ogya-afɔr mma Ewuradze.

Na no nom-afɔr nyɛ wenyin hin ɔfã nka ɔnantwisaa kor ho, na hin ebupɛn ebiasa mu kor nka odwanyin no ho, na hin ebupɛn anan mu kor nka eguambaa kor ho: Iyi nye bosoom biara ne hyew-afɔr wɔ afrenhyia abosoom no nyina mu.
Na wɔmfa apɔnkyenyin kor mbɔ bɔn ho afɔr mma Ewuradze; mfa nka daa ɔhyew-afɔr no, nye no nom-afɔr no ho.
Na bosoom a odzi kan no mu, bosoom no ne da a otsīa duanan no, ɔyɛ Ewuradze apaho.
Na bosoom no ara ne da a otsīa duenum no, nyɛ afahyɛ da: Nda esuon na wondzi epitsi boodoo.
Da a odzi kan no nyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn; mma mma hom nnyɛ dwumadzi edwuma:
mbom hom mbɔ ogya-afɔr, ɔhyew-afɔr mma Ewuradze; anantwisaa mburwa ebien, nye odwanyin kor, nye nguambaanyin esuon a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia: Wɔnyɛ dza wonndzii dzɛm mma hom:
Nye n'edziban-afɔr, isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw: Ebupɛn du mu ebiasa na hom mfa nka ɔnantwisaa kor ho, na ebupɛn du mu ebien nka odwanyin no ho mbra;
ebupɛn du mu nkorkor na fa ka nguambaa esuon no mu eguambaa biara ho bra;
na bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor, ma wɔmfa mpata mma hom.
Hom nyɛ iyinom nka anapa ɔhyew-afɔr a ɔyɛ daa ɔhyew-afɔr no ho.
Dɛm yi ara na hom nyɛ ogya-afɔr edziban a oyi nka huanhuam ma Ewuradze no, daa daa, nda esuon: Wɔnyɛ nka daa ɔhyew-afɔr no, na no nom-afɔr no ho.
Na da a otsīa esuon no hom nyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn; mma hom nyɛ dwumadzi edwuma.
Eso nduadzewakan da no mu, sɛ hom dze edziban-fofor-afɔr rebrɛ Ewuradze wɔ hom adapɛn afahyɛ mu a, hom nyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn; mma hom nnyɛ dwumadzi edwuma:
Mbom hom mbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam mma Ewuradze; anantwisaa mburwa ebien, odwanyin kor, nguambaanyin esuon a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia;
na n'edziban-afɔr, isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, ebupɛn du mu ebiasa nka ɔnantwisaa kor ho, ebupɛn du mu ebien nka odwanyin kor no ho,
ebupɛn du mu nkorkor nka eguambaa esuon no mu eguambaa biara ho;
apɔnkyenyin kor, ma wɔmfa mpata mma hom.
Hom nyɛ mfa nka daa ɔhyew-afɔr no, nye n'edziban-afɔr no (wɔnyɛ dza wonndzii dzɛm mma hom), nye no nom-afɔr no ho.
29: Na bosoom a otsīa esuon no mu, bosoom no ne da a odzi kan no, hom nyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn; mma hom nnyɛ dwumadzi edwuma: Ɔyɛ totorobɛnto-hɛn da ma hom.
Na hom mbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam mma Ewuradze; ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, odwanyin kor, nguanbaanyin esuon a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm;
na n'edziban-afɔr, isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, ebupɛn du mu ebiasa nka odwanyin no ho,
na ebupɛn du mu nkorkor nka eguambaa esuon no mu eguambaa biara ho:
Na bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor, ma wɔmfa mpata mma hom:
Mfa nka bo soom fofor ɔhyew-afɔr, nye n'edziban-afɔr, nye no nom-afɔr ho, dɛ mbrɛ no ho ɔmom tsetsee, nyɛ ogya-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam mma Ewuradze.
Na bosoom a otsīa du no hom nyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn; na hom mbrɛ hom akra adze; mma hom nnyɛ edwuma biara:
Na hom mbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam mma Ewuradze; ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, odwanyin kor, nguambaanyin esuon a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia; wɔnyɛ dza wonndzii dzɛm mma hom:
Na n'edziban-afɔr, isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, ebupɛn du mu ebiasa nka ɔnantwisaa no ho, ebupɛn du mu ebien nka odwanyin kor no ho,
ebupɛn du mu nkorkor nka nguambaa esuon no mu eguambaa biara ho:
Bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka mpata bɔn ho afɔr, nye daa ɔhyew-afɔr, nye n'edziban-afɔr, nye no nom-afɔr no ho.
Na bosoom a otsīa esuon no ne da a otsīa duenum no hom nyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn; mma hom nnyɛ dwumadzi edwuma, na hom nhyɛ fa nda esuon mma Ewuradze:
Na hom mbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr, ogya-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam mma Ewuradze; anantwisaa mburwa duebiasa, ndwanyin ebien, nguambaanyin duanan a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia; wɔnyɛ dza wonndzii dzɛm:
Na n'edziban-afɔr, isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, ebupɛn du mu ebiasa ebiasa nkeka anantwisaa du ebiasa no mu ɔnantwisaa biara ho, ebupɛn du mu ebien ebien nkeka ndwanyin ebien no mu kor ho,
na ebupɛn du mu nkorkor nka nguambaa duanan no mu eguambaa biara ho:
Na bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka daa ɔhyew-afɔr, n'edziban-afɔr, nye no nom-afɔr no ho.
Na da a otsīa ebien no hom mfa anantwisaa mburwa duebien, ndwanyin ebien, nguambaanyin duanan a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm mbra:
Na n'edziban-afɔr nye no nom-afɔr nka anantwisaa, ndwanyin nye nguambaa no ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse, wɔ ɔmom no do:
Nye bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka daa ɔhyew-afɔr, nye n'edziban-afɔr, nye no nom-afɔr no ho.
Na da a otsīa ebiasa no anantwisaa dubiako, ndwanyin ebien, nguambaanyin duanan a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm;
na n'edziban-afɔr nye no nom-afɔr nka anantwisaa, ndwanyin, nye nguambaa no ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse, wɔ ɔmom no do:
Nye bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka daa ɔhyew-afɔr, nye n'edziban-afɔr, nye no nom-afɔr no ho.
Na da a otsīa anan no anantwisaa du, ndwanyin ebien, nguambaanyin duanan a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm:
N'edziban-afɔr nye no nom-afɔr nka anantwisaa, ndwanyin, nye nguambaa no ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse, wɔ ɔmom no do:
Nye bɔn ho aɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka daa ɔhyew-afɔr, n'edziban-afɔr, nye no nom-afɔr no ho.
Na da a otsīa enum no anantwisaa akron, ndwanyin ebien, nguambaanyin duanan a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm:
Na n'edziban-afɔr nye no nom-afɔr nka anantwisaa, ndwanyin, nye nguambaa no ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse, wɔ ɔmom no do:
Nye bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka daa ɔhyew-afɔr, n'edziban-afɔr, nye nye no nom-afɔr no ho.
Na da a otsīa esia no anantwisaa awɔtwe, ndwanyin ebien, nguambaanyin duanan a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm:
Na n'edziban-afɔr nye no nom-afɔr nka anantwisaa, ndwanyin, nye nguanbaa ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse, wɔ ɔmom no do:
Nye bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka daa ɔhyew-afɔr, n'edziban-afɔr, nye no nom-afɔr no ho.
Na da a otsīa esuon no anantwisaa esuon, ndwanyin ebien, nguambaanyin duanan a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm:
Na n'edziban-afɔr nye no nom-afɔr nka anantwisaa, ndwanyin, nye nguambaa no ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse, wɔ ɔmom no do:
Nye bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka daa ɔhyew-afɔr, n'edziban-afɔr, nye no nom-afɔr no ho.
Da a otsīa awɔtwe no hom mbɔ ngua a no mu yɛ nwin: Mma hom nnyɛ dwumadzi edwuma:
Mbom hom mbɔ ɔhyew-afɔr, ogya-afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam mma Ewuradze: Ɔnantwisaa kor, odwanyin kor, nguambaanyin esuon a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm:
N'dziban-afɔr nye no nom-afɔr nka ɔnantwisaa, odwanyin, nye nguambaa no ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse, wɔ ɔmom no do:
Nye bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor: Mfa nka daa ɔhyew-afɔr, nye edziban afɔr, nye no nom-afɔr no ho.
Iyinom na hom mfa mbrɛ Ewuradze wɔ hom afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ no mu, mfa nka hom anohobadze nye hom ayamuyi-afɔr ho, wɔ hom ɔhyew-afɔr, nye hom edziban-afɔr, nye hom ɔnom-afɔr, nye hom asomdwee-afɔr mu.
Na Moses kãa kyerɛɛ Israelmba no dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no nyinara.
30: Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu etsitsir no dɛ, Iyi nye adze a Ewuradze ahyɛ.
Sɛ nyimpa bi bɔ Ewuradze anohoba, anaa ɔkã ntam dze nkyehoma kyekyer ne kra a, mma ommbu n'asɛm do; ɔnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ dza ofi n'anomu nyinara tse.
Eso sɛ ɔbaa bi bɔ anohoba ma Ewuradze, na ɔdze nkyehoma kyekyer noho, wɔ n'egya fie, ne nkataasiaber mu;
na n'egya tse n'anohoba, nye ne nkyehoma a ɔdze akyekyer ne kra, na n'egya yɛ no komm a: ɔno n'anohoba nyinara ntsim hɔ, na nkyehoma biara a ɔdze akyekyer ne kra no ntsim hɔ.
Sɛ da a n'egya tse no osiw no kwan dze a; ɔno n'anohoba, anaa ne nkyehoma a ɔdze akyekyer ne kra no mu biara rinntsim hɔ: Na Ewuradze dze befir no, osiandɛ n'egya siiw no kwan.
Na sɛ ɔwɔ kun, wɔ aber a n'anohoba, anaa n'anosɛm hurutuhurutu a ɔdze akyekyer ne kra, ɔwɔ no do;
na no kun tse, na da a ɔtse no ɔyɛ no komm a: Ɔno n'anohoba no ntsim hɔ na ne nkyehoma a ɔdze akyekyer ne kra no ntsim hɔ.
Sɛ no kun siw no kwan da a ɔtse no dze a; ɔno ɔmma n'anohoba a ɔwɔ no do, nye n'anosɛm hurutuhurutu a ɔdze akyekyer ne kra no nye kwa: Na Ewuradze dze befir no.
Na okunafo, anaa nyia wɔakõ no no n'anohoba dze, mekyerɛ adze biara a ɔdze kyekyer ne kra no, otsim no do.
Na sɛ ɔwɔ no kun fie na ɔbɔɔ anohoba, anaa ɔdze ntam dze nkyehoma kyekyeer ne kra,
na no kun tsee, na ɔyɛɛ no komm, na oennsiw no kwan a; ɔno n'anohoba nyinara tsim hɔ, na nkyehoma biara a ɔdze akyekyer ne kra no tsim hɔ.
Sɛ no kun no ma ɔyɛ kwa wɔ da a ɔtsee no dze a; ɔno biribiara a ofii n'anofamfa do wɔ n'anohoba ho, anaa ne kra nkyehoma ho no, rinntsim hɔ: no kun no ama ayɛ kwa; na Ewuradze dze befir no.
Anohoba biara, nye ntam biara a wɔdze brɛ ɔkra adze no, no kunn na ɔma otsintsim, anaa no kun na ɔma ɔyɛ kwa.
Na sɛ no kun yɛ no komm koraa fi da to da a; ɔno otsintsim n'anohoba nyinara, anaa ne nkyehoma nyinara a ɔwɔ no do no: oetsintsim no, osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ no komm wɔ da a ɔtsee no.
Sɛ ɔatse no ekyir no ɔma ɔyɛ kwa dze a; ɔno ɔnsoa n'emumuyɛ.
Iyinom nye ahyɛdze a Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses dɛ ɔnda ɔbanyin nye ne yer ntamu, ɔnda egya nye ne babaa a ɔwɔ ne nkataasiaber mu, wɔ n'egya fie ntamu.
31: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Dzi Midianfo wer wɔ Israelmba ho: Na n'ekyir no wɔaboaboa wo akɔ wo nkorɔfo nkyɛn.
Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no dɛ, Hom mma hom mu mbanyin mmia mma ɔsa no, ama woeetu akɔ Midian do, woeekedzi Ewuradze no wer wɔ Midianfo do.
Hom mma Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu, ebusuakuw biara mu nyimpa apem nkɔ ɔsa no.
Nna woyiyii Israel mpemmpem mu mpemduebien a womiae maa ɔsa no, ebusuakuw biara mu apem.
Na Moses somaa hɔn, ebusuakuw biara mu apem no, ma wɔkɔr ɔsa no, hɔn nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar ne babanyin Phinehas, ɔdze ahotseweebea ndzɛmba no na ewubɔ ntotorobɛnto no wɔ ne nsamu na wɔkɔr ɔsa no.
Na wɔnye Midian kɔkõe dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no; na wokunkum mbanyin no nyinara.
Na wokunkum Midian ahemfo no kaa hɔn atɔfo nkaa no ho; Evi, nye Rekem, nye Zur, nye Hur, nye Reba, nye Midian ahemfo beenu no; na wɔdze nkrantsee kum Beor ne babanyin Balaam so.
Na Israelmba no faa Midian mbaa no nye hɔn mbofraba no ndɔmmum; na wɔfoom hɔn ofiembowa nyinara, nye hɔn nguankuw nyinara, nye hɔn ahodze nyinara.
Na wɔdze ogya hyehyeew hɔn nkurow nyinara wɔ mbeambea a wɔtsetsee no, nye hɔn nseraban nyinara.
Na wɔfaa asadze no nyinara, nye afonam no nyinara, nyimpa nye abowa nyina.
Na wɔdze ndɔmmum no, nye afonam no, nye asadze no, brɛɛ Moses, nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye Israel mboanofo no; wɔ nseraban no mu wɔ Moab tɛtɛr a ɔda Jericho Jordan ho no do.
Na Moses, nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye mboanofo no mu mbapɔmba no nyinara fiir edzi kehyiaa hɔn wɔ nseraban no ekyir.
Na Moses no bo fuuw dɔm no hɔn asafohemfo no, apem apem do asafohemfo nye ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo a wofi asayɛ bae no.
Na Moses see hɔn dɛ, Ana hom agye mbaa no nyinara nkwa?
Hwɛ, iyinom, na ɔnam Balaam apam do, wɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔn tsiaa Ewuradze wɔ Peor asɛm no mu, na ɔmaa ɔyardɔm baa Ewuradze no mboanofo mu no.
Afei dɛm ntsi hom nkuku mbofraba no mu mbanyin nyinara, na wonku ɔbaa biara a oehu ɔbanyin dɛ ɔnye no ada.
Na mbaa mbofraba a wonnhun ɔbanyin dɛ wɔnye no ada no dze, hom ngye hɔn nkwa mma homho.

Na hom nkyer nsera wɔ nseraban no ekyir nda esuon: Obiara a oeku nyimpa bi no, nye obiara a ɔakã ɔtɔfo bi no, hom nyiyi homho fī da a otsīa ebiasa no, nye da a otsīa esuon no, hom nye hom ndɔmmumfo no.
Na atar biara dze, nye adze a wɔdze nwoma ayɛ nyinara, nye mpɔnkyenhwi edwuma nyinara, nye adze a wɔdze dua ayɛ nyinara, homara hom nyiyi ho fī.
Na ɔsɔfo Eleazar see mbanyinfo akofo a wɔkɔr akono no dɛ, iyi nye mbra a Ewuradze dze ahyɛ Moses no mu ahyɛdze:
Naaso sika nye dwetɛ, boran, dadze, seenyaa, nye sumbui no,
adze biara a obotum ogya no, hom mma ɔnkɛfa ogya mu, na no ho ntsew; naaso hom mfa ahoguar nsu no nyi no ho fī: Na adze a onnkotum ogya no nyinara, hom mma ɔnkɛfa nsu mu.
Na hom nhor hom ntar da a otsīa esuon no, na hom ho ntsew, na n'ekyir no na hom mbra nseraban no mu.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
bu afonam a wɔfae no ano, nyimpa nye mbowa nyina, ɔwo, nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye mboanofo no mu egyanom efi mu etsitsir no:
Na kyɛ afonam no mu akyɛkyɛ ebien; ma mbanyin akofo a wɔkɔr akono no, nye mboanofo no nyinara:
Na gye mbanyin asayɛfo a wɔkɔr akono no hɔ ɔtow ma Ewuradze: Nyimpa, nye anantwi, nye nsoaso, nye nguankuw mu ahaenum mu nkorkor:
Gye no wɔ hɔn ɔfã no mu, na fa ma ɔsɔfo Eleazar, dɛ Ewuradze ɔmado-afɔr.
Na Israelmba ɔfã mu dze, gya nyimpa, anantwi, nsoaso, nye nguankuw no, mekyerɛ ofiembowa nyinara mu eduonum eduonum mu nkorkor, na fa ma Levifo no a wɔhwɛ Ewuradze ntamdan ahwɛdodze do no.
Na Moses nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
Afei afonam a ɔbor asadze a mbanyin asayɛfo no fae no do no, ɔyɛ nguan mpemahaesia nye mpemeduosuon nye mpemenum,
nye anantwi mpemeduosuon ebien,
nye nsoaso mpemeduosia biako,
nye nyimpa, mbaa a wonnhun ɔbanyin dɛ wɔnye no ada, nyinara wɔyɛ mpemeduasa ebien.
Na ɔfã no a ɔyɛ hɔn a wotui kɔr ɔsa no hɔn kyɛfa no, no dodow yɛ nguan mpemahaasa nye mpemeduasa nye mpemesuon nye ahaenum:
Na nguan no mu ɔtow a woyiyii maa Ewuradze no yɛ ahaesia eduosuon enum.
Na anantwi no yɛ mpemeduasa esia; hɔn mu ɔtow a woyiyii maa Ewuradze yɛ eduosuon ebien.
Na nsoaso no hyɛ mpemeduasa nye ahaenum; hɔn mu ɔtow a woyiyii maa Ewuradze yɛ eduosia biako.
Na nyimpa no yɛ mpemduesia; hɔn mu ɔtow a woyiyii maa Ewuradze yɛ nyimpa eduasa ebien.
Na Moses dze ɔtow a ɔyɛ Ewuradze ɔmado-afɔr no maa ɔsɔfo Eleazar, dɛ mbɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
Na Israelmba hɔn ɔfã no a Moses gyee no wɔ akofo no hɔ no mu dze,
(afei mboanofo no hɔn ɔfã no yɛ nguan mpenahaasa nye mpemeduasa, mpemesuon nye ahaenum,
nye anantwi mpemeduasaesia,
nye nsoaso mpemeduasa nye ahaenum,
nye nyimpa mpemduesia;)
nye Israelmba hɔn ɔfã no mu dze, Moses faa eduonum eduonum mu nkorkor nyimpa nye mbowa nyina, na ɔdze maa Levifo no a wɔhwɛ Ewuradze ntamadan ahwɛdodze do no; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
Na asafohemfo a wɔhwɛ dɔm mpemmpem do no, nye apem apem do asafohemfo, nye ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no, baa Moses nkyɛn:
Na wɔbɛsee no dɛ, wo nkowaa yeebu akofo a wɔwɔ hɛn nsamu no ano, na hɛn mu nyimpa kor mpo annka.
Na yɛdze Ewuradze n'ayɛyɛdze aba, dza nyimpa biara enya no a, sika ndwindze, anandze ntweaban, nye nsakɔnadze, nsɔwanonkaba, nsowamuadze, nye nkrakyer, dɛ wɔmfa mpata mma hɛn akra wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na Moses nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar gyee hɔn hɔ sika no, mekyerɛ edwindze no nyinara.
Na ɔmado-afɔr sika nyinara a wɔdze brɛ Ewuradze a ofi apem apem do asafohemfo, nye ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo hɔ no, ɔyɛ shekel mpemduesia ahaesuon eduonum.
(Na akofo no afom asadze, hɔnankasa wɔafefa.)
Na Moses nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar gyee sika no wɔ apem apem nye ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no hɔ, na wɔdze baa ehyiadzibuw no mu, dɛ ɔnyɛ Israelmba no nkaadze wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
32: Afei Reubenmba nye Gadmba no wɔ ofiembowa dodow a wɔdɔɔ sõ kɛsenara: Na aber a wohun Jazer asaase, nye Gilead asaase no, na hwɛ, bea no ɔfata ofiembowa bea no;
Gadmba no nye Reubenmba no bae bɛkãa kyerɛɛ Moses, nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye mboanofo no mu mbapɔmba no dɛ,
Ataroth, nye Dibon, nye Jazer, nye Nimrah, nye Heshbon, nye Elealeh, nye Sebam, nye Nebo, nye Beon,
asaase a Ewuradze bɔɔ no wɔ Israel mboanofo no enyim no, ɔyɛ ofiembowa asaase, na wo nkowaa wɔ ofiembowa.
Na wɔsee dɛ, sɛ yeenya w'enyim enyimnyam a, ma wɔmfa asaase yi mma wo nkowaa ma yɛmfa; mma mmfa hɛn nntwa Jordan.
Na Moses see Gadmba nye Reubenmba no dɛ, Aso hom nuanom nkɔ ɔsa, na hom ntsena ha?
Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom tu Israelmba akoma dɛ mma wonntwa nnkɔ asaase a Ewuradze dze ama hɔn no do yi?
Dɛm na hom egyanom yɛe, wɔ aber a mosomaa hɔn fii Kadesh-barnea dɛ wɔnkɔhwɛ asaase no.
Na aber a wɔfowee kɔr Eshcol mbɔnsa mu, na wohun asaase no, wobotuu Israelmba akoma dɛ mma wɔnnkɔ asaase a Ewuradze dze ama hɔn no do.
Na Ewuradze ebufuw dzɛɛw da no, na ɔkãa ntam dɛ,
ampaara mbanyin a wofi Egypt bae no a woedzi mfe eduonu nye ekyir no mu biara runnhu asaase a mekãa ho ntam mekyerɛɛ Abraham, nye Isaac, nye Jacob no; osiandɛ woennwie m'ekyir dzi:
Gyedɛ Kenizznyi Jephunneh ne babanyin Caleb, nye Nun ne babanyin Joshua: Osiandɛ hɔn na woedzi Ewuradze ekyir ewie.
Na Ewuradze ebufuw dzɛɛw Israel do, na ɔmaa wokekyiin sar no do mfe eduanan, ma okodur dɛ ebusuasantsen no a wɔyɛɛ bɔn wɔ Ewuradze enyim no nyinara hyewee.
Na, hwɛ, hom asoɛr egyina hom egyanom ananmu, ndzebɔnyɛfo ndɔree a wɔdze da ho ara rodɔr Ewuradze ebufuhyew no dze aba Israel do.
Na sɛ hom dan fi n'ekyir a, ɔbɛda ho ara adan hɔn egya wɔ sar no do; na hom asɛɛ ɔman yi nyinara.
Na wɔbaa ne nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, nguamban na yɛbɛgyegye ama hɛn ofiembowa wɔ ha, na nkurow so yɛbɛkyekyer ama hɛn mbofraba:
Na hɛnankasa dze hɛn ho bɛyɛ har yeemia edzi Israelmba enyim, ekodu dɛ yɛdze hɔn ekodu hɔn tsenabew ana: Na hɛn mbofraba no ntsenatsena nkurow a wɔagye ho ban mu osian asaase no do atsefo no ntsi.
Yɛrennsan mmba hɛn efiefi, gyedɛ Israelmba ɔbanyin biara enya egyapadze edzi.
Na yɛnnye hɔn remmfa enyadze wɔ Jordan egya, ɔdze kɔ no; osiandɛ hɛn egyapadze ebefir hɛn Jordan nkyɛn ha boka afamu.
Na Moses see hɔn dɛ, sɛ hom bɛyɛ iyi; sɛ hom bemia homho edzi Ewuradze enyim akɔ ɔsa,
na hom mu nyimpa biara a oemia botwa Jordan edzi Ewuradze enyim, ekodu dɛ ɔbɛpam n'atamfo efi n'enyim,
na wɔabrɛ asaase no adze wɔ Ewuradze enyim a: Nna n'ekyir no hom bɛsan na hom edzi bem wɔ Ewuradze nye Israelmba ho; na asaase yi nyɛ hom enyadze wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
Na sɛ hom annyɛ dɛm a, hwɛ hom ayɛ bɔn etsia Ewuradze: Na hom nhu dɛ hom bɔn beyi hom epue.
Hom nkyekyer nkurow mma hom mbofraba, na nguamban mma hom nguan; na hom nyɛ dza efi hom anomu epue no.
Na Gadmba nye Reubenmba no kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ, wo nkowaa bɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ mo wura ahyɛ no.
Hɛn mbofraba hɛn yernom hɛn nguankuw, nye hɛn ofiembowa nyinara, bɛtsena Gilead nkurow no mu hɔ:
Na wo nkowaa dze, ɔbanyin biara a oemia rokɔ ɔsa no, botwa mu edzi Ewuradze enyim akɔkõ, dɛ mbrɛ mo wura akã no.
Nna Moses dze hɔn ho mbra hyɛɛ ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye Nun ne babanyin Joshua, nye Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu egyanom efi do etsitsir no.

Na Moses see hɔn dɛ, sɛ Gadmba nye Reubenmba nye hom twa Jordan, ɔbanyin biara a oemia dzi Ewuradze enyim rokɔkõ no, na wɔbrɛ asaase no adze wɔ hom enyim a; ɔno hom mfa Gilead asaase mma hɔn ma wɔmfa:
Na sɛ woemmia nye hom enntwa a, ɔnodze wɔmma wonnya enyadze wɔ hom mu wɔ Canaan asaase do.
Na Gadmba nye Reubenmba no buaa dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze akã akyerɛ wo nkowaa no, dɛmara na yɛbɛyɛ.
Yebemia edzi Ewuradze enyim etwa mu akɔ Canaan asaase do, na hɛn egyapadze a yeenya no wɔ Jordan egya ha no ako hɛn hɔ.

Na Moses dze Amorifo hen Sihon n'ahendzi, nye Bashanhen Og n'ahendzi, asaase no, dɛ mbrɛ no do nkurow nye no ntoaado tsetsee no, mekyerɛ asaase no do nkurow a ehyia do no, maa hɔn, mekyerɛ Gadmba, nye reubenmba, nye Joseph ne babanyin Manasseh n'ebuasuakuw ɔfã no a.
Na Gadmba no kyekeer Dibon, nye Ataroth, nye Aroer;
nye Atroth-shophan, nye Jazer, nye Jogbehah,
nye Beth-nimrah, nye Beth-haran: Nkurow a wɔagyegye ho ban, nye nguanmban.
Na Reubenmba no kyekyeer Heshbon, nye Elealeh, nye Kiriathiam;
nye Nebo, nye Baalmeon, (hɔn edzin no sakyesakyeree), nye Sibmah: Na wɔdze edzin fofor totoo nkurow a wɔkyekyeree no.
Na Manasseh ne babanyin Machir mba no sii mu Gilead, na wɔkɛfae, na wotuu Amorifo a wɔwɔ mu hɔ no.
Na Moses dze Gilead maa Manasseh ne babanyin Machir; na otsenaa mu.
Na Manasseh ne babanyin Jair sii mu kɛfaa no nkurow no na ɔfrɛɛ no Havvoth-jair.
Na Nobah sii mu kɛfaa Kenath nye no nkuroba na ɔfrɛɛ no Nobah, dɛ mbrɛ nankasa ne dzin no tse.
33: Iyinom nye Israelmba a kwantu wɔnam Moses nye Aaron nsa do fi Egypt asaase do tutui dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm tsetsee.
Na Moses nam Ewuradze mbrasɛm do kyerɛɛw hɔn edzifir dɛ mbrɛ hɔn akwantu mu asoɛe no tse: Na iyinom nye hɔn edzifir tse.
Na bosoom a odzi kan no mu wotui fii Rameses, wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu da a otsīa duenum no; apano no ekyir adzekyee na Israelmba no dze ahosɛpɛw kɛse fiir edzi wɔ Egyptfo nyinara enyim,
wɔ aber a Egyptfo risiesie hɔn mbakan nyinara a Ewuradze kunkum hɔn wɔ hɔn mu no: Hɔn enyam no so Ewuradze buu hɔn ntsɛn.
Na Israelmba no tui fii Rameses na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Succoth.
Na wotui fi Succoth, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Etham a ɔwɔ sar no ano no.
Na wotui fii Etham, na wɔdanee baa Pi-hahiroth a ɔwɔ Baal-zephon enyim no bio: Na wɔkyeer nsera wɔ Migdol enyim.
Na wotui fii Hahiroth enyim, na wokotwaa mu faa po no ne finimfin kɔr sar no do: Na wɔnantseew ndaansa kwan wɔ Etham sar no do, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Marah.
Na wotui fii Marah, na wɔbaa Elim: Na Elim hɔ na nsunyiwa duebien, nye nkyiresua-ndua eduosuon wɔ: Na wɔkɛkyeer hɔ nsera.
Na wotui fii Elim, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Epo Memen no ho.
Na wotui fii Epo Memen no ho, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Sin sar do.
Na wotui fii Sin sar do, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Dophkah.
Na wotui fii Dophkah, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Alush.
Na wotui fii Alush, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Rephidim, mbrɛ ɔman no ennya nsu annom no a.
Na wotui fii Rephidim, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Sinai sar do.
Na wotui fii Sinai sar do na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Kibroth-hattaavah.
Na wotui fii Kibroth-hattaavah, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Hazeroth.
Na wotui fii Hazeroth, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Rithmah.
Na wotui fii Rithmah, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Rimmonperez.
Na wotui fii Rimmonperez, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Libnah.
Na wotui fii Libnah, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Rissah.
Na wotui fii Rissah, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Kehelathah.
Na wotui fii Kehelathah, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ bepɔw Shepher do.
Na woyui fii bepɔw Shepher do, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Haradah.
Na wotui fii Haradah, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Makheloth.
Na wotui fii fii Makheloth na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Tahath.
Na wotui fii Tahath, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Terah.
Na wotui fii Terah, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Mithkah.
Na wotui fii Mithkah, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ hashmonah.
Na wotui fii hashmonah, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Maseroth.
Na wotui fii Benejaakan, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Hor-haggidgah.
Na wotui fii Hor-ggidgah, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Jotbathah.
Na wotui fii Jotbathah, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Abronah.
Na wotui fii Abrinah, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Ezion-geber.
Na wotui fii Ezion-geber, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Zin sar do (Ɔnoara nye Kadesh).
Na wotui fii Kadesh, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ bepɔw Hor do, wɔ Edom asaase ano.

Na ɔsɔfo Aaron nam Ewuradze mbrasɛm do fowee kɔr bepɔw Hor do na okowui wɔ hɔ, wɔ afe a Israelmba fi Egypt asaase do firii no ekyir dza otsīa eduonum no mu, bosoom a otsīa enum no mu da a odzi bosoom no ne kan no.
Na aber a Aaron wui wɔ bepɔw Hor do no na oedzi mfe ɔha eduonum ebiasa.
Na Canaannyi, Aradhen no a ɔtse Canaan asaase do wɔ Pomu afamu no tsee dɛ Israelmba no reba.
Na wotui fii bepɔw Hor ho, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Zalmonah.
Na wotui fi Zalmonah, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Punon.
Na wotui fii Punon, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Oboth.
Na wotui fii Oboth, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Iyeabarim, wɔ Moab ntoaado.
Na wotui fii Iyim, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Dibon-gad.
Na wotui fii Dibon-gad, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Almon-diblathaim.
Na wotui fii Almon-diblathaim, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Abarim mbepɔw do, wɔ Nebo enyim.
Na wotui fii Abarim mbepɔw do, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu, wɔ Jericho Jordan ho.
Na wɔkyeer jordan ho nsera, fi Beth-jeshimoth araa kodur Abel-Shittim wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu wɔ Jericho Jordan ho, dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, sɛ hom twa Jordan kɔ Canaan asaase do a,
ɔno hom mpam asaase no do atsefo no nyinara mfi hom enyim, na hom nsɛɛ hɔn abo-honyi nyinara, na hon nsɛɛ hɔn ehonyi a woegu no nyinara, na hom ndwurudwuruw mbae sorɔnsorɔm nyinara:
Na hom mfa asaase no mfa, nahom ntsena do: Na hom na medze asaase no mama hom dɛ hom mfa.

Na hom ntwe tonto mfa nkyɛ asaase no dɛ mbrɛ hom ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Hɔn a wɔsõ no hom mma hɔn egyapadze a ɔsõ, na hɔn a wosuar no ma hɔn egyapadze a osuar: Beebiara mbrɛ tonto no abɔ nyimpa biara no hɔ na ɔnyɛ nedze; dɛ mbrɛ hom egyanom mbusuakuw tsetsee no na hom nyinya hom egyapadze.

Na sɛ hom ammpam asaase no do atsefo no wɔ hom enyim a; ɔno hɔn mu hɔn a hom ama wɔaka no bɛyɛ dɛ awowɔdze wɔ hom enyiwa mu, na ayɛ dɛ nsoɛ, wɔ hom mfe mu, na woehiahia hom ho wɔ asaase a hom tse do no do.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ modween dɛ mebɛyɛ hɔn no, dɛmara na mebɛyɛ hom.
34: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
hyɛ Israelmba no mbra, na se hɔn dɛ, sɛ hom du Canaan asaase no do a, (iyi nye asaase a ɔda hɔ ma hom dɛ egyapadze, mekyerɛ Canaan asaase no dɛ mebrɛ n'ahe tsetsee,)
ɔno hom pomu-afamu nkyɛn mfi Zin sar do wɔ Edom nkyɛn mu, na hom pomu ɔhe mfi Nkyen Epo ano wɔ boka afamu:
Na hom ɔhe no ndan mfa Akrabbim mfowee pomu afamu, na ontwa mu nkɔ Zin: Na n'edzifir ndu Kadesh-barnea pomu afamu; na ɔnkɔ Hazar-addar, na ontwa mu nkɛfa Azmon:
Na ɔhe no mpon mfi Azmon nkɔ Egypt ɔwora ho, na n'edzifir ndu po no ano.
Na anee afamu ɔhe no dze, hom wɔ po kɛse no dze yɛ ne he: Iyi na ɔnyɛ hom anee ɔhe.
Na iyi nyɛ hom kwaamu ɔhe: Hom mfi po kɛse no ho nsan bepɔw Hor mfa:
Bepɔw Hor ho na hom mfi nsan mbrɛ wɔfa kɔ Hamath; na ɔhe no n'edzifir ndu Zedad:
Na ɔhe no mfir edzi nkɔ Ziphron, na n'edzifir ndu Hazar-enan: Iyi na ɔnyɛ hom kwaamy ɔhe.
Na hom nsan boka he mfa mfi Hazar-enan nkɔ Shepham:
Na ɔhe no mfi Shepham nsian nkɔ Riblah, wɔ Ain no boka afamu, na ɔhe no nsian araa nkodu Chinnereth pomu afamu wɔ boka afamu:
Na ɔhe no nsian nkodu Jordan do, na n'edzifir ndu Nkyen Epo ho: Iyi nye homm asaase dɛ mbrɛ no ho ahe tsetsee.
Na Moses hyɛɛ Israelmba no mbra dɛ, iyi nye asaase a hom ntwe ho tonto mfa nkyɛ no a Ewuradze ahyɛ dɛ wɔmfa mma mbusuakuw akron, nye ebusuakuw ɔfã no;
nye Reubenmba ebusuakuw, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee nye Gadmba ebusuakuw dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, nye Manaaseh ebusuakuw ɔfã no, woenya hɔn egyapadze:
Na mbusuakuw ebien no nye ebusuakuw ɔfa no enya hɔn egyapadze wɔ Jericho Jordan egya wɔ boka afamu ɔdze kɔ wipuei no.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Iyinom nye mbanyin wɔnkyɛ asaase no mu mma hom no hɔn edzin: Ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye Nun ne babanyin Joshua.
Na hom nyi ebusuakuw biara mu ɔbapɔmba kor ma wɔnkyɛ asaase no mu.
Na mbanyin no hɔn edzin nye yi: Judah n'ebusuakuw mu, Jephunneh ne babanyin Caleb.
Nye Simeon ne mba ebusuakuw mu, Ammihud ne babanyin Shemuel.
Benjamin n'ebusuakuw mu, Chisloh ne babanyin Elidad.
Nye dan ne mba ebusuakuw mu ɔbapɔmba, Jogli ne babanyin Bukki.
Joseph ne mba mu: Manasseh ne mba ebusuakuw mu ɔbpɔmba, Ephod ne babanyin Hanniel:
Nye Ephraim ne mba ebusuakuw my ɔbapɔmba, Shiphtan ne babanyin Kemuel.
Na Zebulun ne mba ebusuakuw mu ɔbapɔmba, Parnach ne babanyin Elizaphan.
Na Issachar ne mba ebusuakuw mu ɔbapɔmba, Azzan ne babanyin Paltiel.
Na Asher ne mba ebusuakuw my ɔbapɔmba, Shelomi ne babanyin Ahihud.
Na Naphtali ne mba ebusuakuw mu ɔbapɔmba, Ammihud ne babanyin Pedahel.
Iyinom nye hɔn a Ewuradze hyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnkyɛ Canaan asaase no mu mma Israelmba no.
35: Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu wɔ Jericho Jordan do dɛ,
Hyɛ Israelmba no ma wɔmfa hɔn enyadze egyapadze no mu nkurow bi mma Levifo no ma wɔntsena mu; na nkurow no ho mfikyisaase no so hom mfa mma Levifo no.
Na nkurow no na wonnya wɔntsena mu: Na no ho mfikyisaase no ndeda ho mma hɔn ofiembowa, nye hɔn ahodze, nye hɔnmbowa nyinara.
Na nkurow no ho mfikykisaase a hom dze bɛma Levifo no, mfi kurow no fasu ekyir nkɔ basafa apem apem ntwa ho nhyia.

Na hom nsusu kurow no ekyir boka afamu basafa mpemebien, nye pomu afamu basafa mpemebien, nye anee afamu basafa mpemebien, nye kwaamu afamu basafa mpemebien, na kurow no nda ne finimfin. Iyi na ɔnyɛ nkurow no ho mfikyisaase mma hɔn.
Na nkurow no a hom dze bɛma Levifo no nyɛ guansumabew nkurow esia no a, hom dze bɛma dɛ onyimpakumfo nguan nkɔ hɔ no: Na hom mfa nkurow eduanan ebien nka ho.
Nkurow a hom dze bɛma Levifo no nyinara nyɛ nkurow eduanan awɔtwe: Hom mfa nka ne mfikyisaase no ho mma.
Na nkurow a hom bɛgye no wɔ Israelmba enyadze mu ama no ho dze, hɔn a hɔndze dɔɔ sõ: Na hɔn a hɔndze suar no hɔ na hom ngye dza osuar: Obiara no tse no na ɔmfa no nkurow no mu bi mma Levifo no.
Na Ewuradze kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, ne se hɔn dɛ, sɛ hom twa Jordan kɔ Canaan asaase do a,
ɔno hom nyiyi nkurow ma ɔnyɛ guansumabew nkurow mma hom; na onyimpakumfo a oku onyimpa bi ntɔgon mu no oeeguan akɔ hɔ.
Na nkurow no nyɛ hom nguansumabew wɔ ɔwerdzinyi no nsamu; amma onyimpakumfo no eennwu, ma eekodu dɛ obegyina mboanofo no enyim ma woeebu no atsɛn ana.
Na nkurow a hom beyi ama no nyɛ hom guansumabew nkurow esia.
Hom nyi nkurow ebiasa mma wɔ Jordan egya, na nkurow ebiasa so na hom nyi mma wɔ Canaan asaase do; ɔnyɛ guansumabew nkurow.
Na Israelmba, nye ɔhɔho, nye ɔkwantunyi a ɔwɔ hɔn mu, nye nkurow esia yi nyɛ hɔn gguansumabew: na obiara a oeku nyimpa ntɔgon mu no oeeguan akɔ hɔ.
Na sɛ ɔdze dadze bi bɔ no, ma owu a, ɔyɛ onyimpakumfo; oku na wonku onyimpakumfo no.
Na sɛ okura ɔbo a obotum eku nyimpa dze bɔ no, ma owu a, ɔyɛ onyimpakumfo: Oku na wonku onyimpakumfo no.
Anaa sɛ okura dua a obotum eku nyimpa dze bɔ no, ma owu a, ɔyɛ onyimpakumfo: Oku na wonku onyimpakumfo no.
Bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no noara na onku onyimpakumfo no: Sɛ ɔto no a, onku no.
Na sɛ ɔtan do na osun no, anaa ɔboapa ɔtow biribi dze bɔ no ma owu;
anaa enyitan do na ɔdze ne nsa dze bɔ no ma owu a: Oku a wonku nyia ɔbɔ no no; ɔyɛ nyimpakumfo: Bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no nku onyimpakumfo no, sɛ ɔto no a.
Na sɛ osun no awerɛfir mu na nnyɛ enyitan do, anaa ɔtow adze biara ma ɔbɔ no na ɔammboapa,
anaa ɔdze ɔbo biara a obotum eku nyimpa, na oennhu no, na ɔtow bɔ no, ma owu, na nnyɛ ne tamfo nkyii so ɔmmpɛ no bɔn bi a:
Ɔno mboanofo no mbu nyia ɔbɔe nye no bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no ntamu atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ ntsɛmbu yi tsetsee:

Na mboanofo no nyi onyimpakumfo no mfi bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no nsamu, na mboanofo no mfa no nsan nkɔ no guansumabew kurow no mu, mbrɛ oguanee kɔree no: Na ɔnkɛtsena hɔ ma onkodu ɔsɔfopanyin a wɔdze ngo krɔnkrɔn asera no no wu.
Na sɛ onyimpakumfo no fir edzi aber biara tra no guansumabew kurow a oguanee kɔr hɔ no ne he do;
na bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no ho wɔ guansumabew kurow no ne he ekyir, na bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no koku onyimpakumfo no a; onndzi bɔgya bi ho sõ:
Osiandɛ no guansumabew kurow no mu na ɔsɛ no dɛ nkyɛ ɔtsena kudo ɔsɔfopanyin no no wo do: Na ɔsɔfopanyin no no wo ekyir no dze onyimpakumfo no nsan mbra n'enyadze asaase do bio.
Na iyi nyɛ tsɛmbu ahyɛdze mma hom wɔ hom ebusuasantsen nyina mu wɔ hom tsenabew nyinara mu.
Obiara a oku nyimpa biara no, adasefo enum na wɔmfa do nku onyimpakumfo no: Na ɔdasefo kor dze onndzi dase nntsia nyimpa biara mma onnwu.
Nkyii so mma hom nngye onyimpakumfo a ɔsɛ owu no nkwa tsir mpata biara: Na oku ara na wonku no.
Na mma hom nngye nyia oeguan kɔ no guansumabew kurow mu ne tsir mpata biara dɛ ɔnsan mbɛtsena asaase no do bio, nkodu ɔsɔfo no wu do.

Dɛm ntsi mma hom nngu asaase no a hom tse do no ho fī: Na bɔgya ara na ogu asaase no ho fi: Na wɔrennyɛ mpatadze biara mma asaase no wɔ bɔgya a woehue egu do ntsi, gyedɛ nyia ɔkaa bɔgya gui no ara no bɔgya mu.
Na mma nngu asaase a hom tse do a mo so metse ne finimfin no do fī: Na emi Ewuradze na metse Israelmba finimfin.
36: Na Gilead, Machir ne babanyin, Manasseh ne babanyin, Joseph ne mbabanyin ebusua ebusua mu egyanom efi do etsitsir no bae, na wɔbɛkasae wɔ Moses, nye mbapɔmba no, Israelmba egyanom efi do etsitsir no enyim:
Na wɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze hyɛɛ mo wura dɛ ɔmfa tontotwe nkyɛ asaase no mu mma Israelmba ma wɔnyɛ no egyapadze: Na mo wura na Ewuradze hyɛɛ no dɛ ɔmfa hɛn nua Zelohad n'egyapadze mma ne mbabaa.

Na sɛ wɔwar hɔn ma Israelmba ebusuakuw bi mu mbabanyin biara a, ɔno wonyi hɔn egyapadze no mfi hɛn egyanom egyapadze mu, na wɔmfa nkɛka ebusuakuw kor a wɔakɛyɛ hɔndze no egyapadze ho: Dɛm na wonyi mfi hɛn egyapadze kyɛfa no mu.
Na sɛ Israelmba ahosɛpɛw afe no du a, ɔno wɔmfa hɔn egyapadze no nkɛka ebusuakuw kor a wɔakɛyɛ hɔndze no egyapadze ho: Ma woeyi hɔn egyapadze efi hɔn egyanom ebusuakuw egyapadze no mu.
Na Moses hyɛɛ Israelmba no dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze n'asɛm tse, dɛ, Joseph ne mbabanyin ebusuakuw no akã no tsenn.
Iyi nye adze a Ewuradze hyɛe wɔ Zelophehad mbabaa no ho no, dɛ, wɔmma wɔnwarwar hɔn a wɔdwen hɔn dɛ woye no: Hɔn egya n'ebusuakuw mu ebusua no ara nko na wɔnwarwar wɔ mu.
Amma Israelmba egyapadze biara eemmfi ebusuakuw mu: Na Israelma no ntakyer hɔn egyanom ebusuakuw egyapadze ho.
Na ɔbabaa biara a onya egyapadze wɔ Israelmba ebusuakuw biara mu no, ɔnyɛ n'egya ebusuakuw mu ebusua no mu obi ne yer, na Israelmba no eenyinya nyimpa biara n'egyanom egyapadze edzi.
Amma egyapadze biara eemfi ebusuakuw kor mu annkɔ ebusuakuw kor so mu; na Israelmba ebusuakuw no ntakyer hɔnankasa hɔn egyapadze ho.
Mekyerɛ dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no, dɛmara na Zelophelad ne mbabaa no yɛe:
Na Mahlah, nye Noah, Zelophelad mbabaa no warwaar hɔn egya no nuanom mbabanyin no.
Wɔwarwaar hɔn kɔr Joseph ne babanyin Manasseh mbabanyin ebusua ebusua mu, na hɔn egyapadze no kaa hɔn egya n'ebusua ebusuakuw no mu.
Iyinom nye mbransɛm nye ntsɛmbu a, Ewuradze nam Moses nsa do hyɛɛ Israelmba wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu wɔ Jericho Jordan do.

1: Obadiah n'enyido-adzehu. Mbrɛ Ewuradze ka wɔ Edom ho nye yi. Yɛatse Ewuradze n'anosɛm, na wɔasoma ahembɔfo wɔ amanaman mu, dɛ hom nsoɛr, na yentu nkɛhyɛ no do nye no nkõ.
Hwɛ mayɛ wo ɔketseaba wɔ amanaman mu: Woebu wo enyimtsia papaara.
W'akoma no nkontompɔ adaadaa wo, ao wo a etse abotan ntokur mu a wo tsenabea krɔn; ɔno a ɔkã no n'akoma mu dɛ, woana dze me bodwir famu?
Sɛ efow kɔ mbrɛ ɔkrɔn dɛ ɔkɔr, na sɛ edze berɛbiw kesi nworaba ntamu a, medze wo befi hɔ edwir, Ewuradze na ɔse.

Sɛ ewifo, sɛ edwotwafo baa wo do anago a, (mbrɛ woedua etwa wo akyen a!) aso nkyɛ wonnkowia ma ekodu dɛ woenya dza ɔsõ hɔn? Sɛ wenyinaba tsetsewfo baa wo do a, aso nkyɛ wonnkegye aba a wodzi no mpɛpɛw?
Mbrɛ woedua atwee Esau ndzɛmba mu a! Mbrɛ woedua ahwehwɛ n'akoradze a osumae no mu a!
W'apambuafo nyina egya wo kwan ara ekodu ɔhe do: Mbarimba a wɔnye wo tse nsiesie mu no adaadaa wo, na woedzi wo do nyim; hɔn a wodzi w'edziban esua w'ase efir; ntseasee abɔ no.
Aso nnyɛ da no mu, Ewuradze na ɔse, na mebɛsɛɛ enyansafo mefi Edom, na ntseasee mefi Esau bepɔw do?
Na Teman e, w'akatakyi bo botu oo, ma ekodu dɛ wɔdze oku etwa obiara efi Esau bepɔw do.
W'etsiɔdzendze a edze yɛɛ wo nua Jacob ntsi, enyito bɛkata wo do, na woetwa wo akyen daa.
Da no a igyinaa nkyɛn, wɔ da a ananaben soaa n'ahodze kɔree, na ahɔho kɛhɛɛn no mbobokɛse mu, na wɔtwee Jerusalem ho tonto no mu no, ɔwoara so yɛɛ dɛ hɔn mu baako.
Na mma nnhwɛ wo nua ne da no wɔ n'ahokyer da no mu, na mma nndzi Judahmba eduwa wɔ hɔn sɛɛe da no mu; eso mma nnkã nkontompɔsɛm wɔ hɔn ahohia da no mu.
Mma nnhɛn me man n'abobokɛse mu wɔ hɔn mbusu da no mu; ɛhɛɛ, mma nnhwɛ hɔn ahohia wɔ hɔn mbusu da no mu, eso mma hom mmfa hom nsa nnto hɔn ahodze do wɔ hɔn mbusu da no mu.
Na mma nngyina nkwanta do nntwitwa ne nyimpa a wofi nsa no: Na mma nnyi ne nyimpa a ɔka no mma wɔ ahokyer da no mu.
Na Ewuradze ne da no abɛn wɔ amanaman nyina do: Mbrɛ ɔwo ayɛ no ma wɔdze bɛyɛ wo; wo ndzeyɛɛ bɛsan ebobua woara w'etsifi.
Na dɛ mbrɛ hom anom nsã wɔ me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do no, dɛmara so na amanaman nyina bɔnom daa, ɛhɛɛ, wɔbɔnom, na wɔamen, na wɔayɛ dɛ gyama wɔmmbaa hɔ da.
Na Zion bepɔw do hɔ na hɔn a woefi nsa bɛtsena, na ɔbɛyɛ krɔnkrɔn; na Jacob fie bɛfa hɔn enyadze no edzi.
Na Jacob fi bɛyɛ ogya, Joseph fi ayɛ ogyaframee, na Esau fi ayɛ dɛ mburonan, na wɔbɛhyew wɔ hɔn mu, na wɔamemen hɔn: Na obiara rennka mma Esau fi; na Ewuradze na ɔakã.
Na Pomu afamufo no, wɔbɛfa Esau bepɔw no ayɛ enyadze; na ɔbɔnmufo no bɛfa Philistiafo: Na wɔbɛfa Samaria asaase na Ephraim asaase edzi: Na Benjamin bɛfa Gilead edzi.
Na Israelmba dɔm yi ndɔmmumfo no bɛfa dza ɔyɛ Canaanfo dze no dze ekesi Zarephath; na Jerusalem ndɔmmum a wɔwɔ Sepharad no wɔbɛfa Pomu afamu nkurow no edzi.
Na agyefo bɔfow aba Zion bepɔw do ebobu Esau bepɔw no atsɛn; na ahendzi no bɛyɛ Ewuradze dze.
Paul, Christ Jesus daduanyi, nye onua Timothy dze kɛma Philemon hɛn dɔfo nye hɛn nyɛnkodwumayɛnyi,
nye hɛn akyerɛbaa Aphia, nye hɛn nyɛnko-sordaanyi Archippus, nye asɔr a ɔwɔ wo fie:
Adom nkã hom nye asomdwee a ofir hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Christ hɔ.
Meda me Nyankopɔn ase daa, mobɔ wo dzin wɔ m'asɔr mu,
dɛ metse wo dɔ nye gyedzi a ewɔ wɔ Ewuradze Jesus Christ nye ahotsewfo nyina ho,
ma wo gyedzi anyɛnkofa aayɛ edwuma pa wɔ Christ afamu, ɔnam adzepa nyina a ɔwɔ hom mu no no ho nyimdzee no do.
Na minya enyigye nye awerɛkyekyer kɛse wɔ wo dɔ ho, enua, osiandɛ ahotsewfo akoma atɔ hɔn yamu wɔ wo ntsi.
Dɛm ntsi, kaansa meyɛ ndam pii wɔ Christ mu dɛ mebɛhyɛ wo wɔ dza ɔsɛ ho a,
ɔdɔ ntsi mokotow serɛ wo mbom, emi a meyɛ akɔdaa Paul, na afei meyɛ Jesus Christ daduanyi so:
Mototɔ serɛ wo ma me ba a mawo no wɔ mo nkurufi mu,
Onesimus a nkan no no ho nnyi mfaso mma wo,
na afei dze no ho wɔ mfaso ma emi nye ɔwo. Ɔnoara nkasa na masoma no wo hɔ bio, onyia ɔtse dɛ mara m'akoma.
Na nkyɛ mepɛ dɛ misianka no me nkyɛn, ma oeedzi w'ananmu asom me wɔ asɛmpa no no nkurufi no mu:
Na mammpɛ dɛ migya wo ekyir meyɛ biribiara, amma w'ayamuyie aannyɛ dɛ ofir ɔhyɛ mu, na mbom eefir ɔpɛ mu.
Na bi a iyi ntsi na ɔnye wo paa mu kakra, ama eenya no daa,
nnyɛ dɛ akowaa bio, na nyia ɔsen akowaa, onua dɔfo a oye ma me kɛe, na ankantam ɔwo, wɔ honam ɔnye Ewuradze mu.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ ibu me dɛ damfo pa a, gye no dɛ mankasa.
Na sɛ ɔayɛ wo bɔn biara, anaa ɔdze wo kaw bi a, fa yɛ mo nkontaa;
mankasa Paul na medze me nsa mekyerɛw dɛ emi mara mubotua: na mennkã mennkyerɛ wo mbrɛ edze me kaw, wankasa wo ho mpo ka ho.
Nyew, enua, ma minnya wo ho mfaso wɔ Ewuradze mu; ma m'akoma ntɔ mu wɔ Christ mu.
Na mowɔ werɛ wɔ wo sestsie ho ntsi na merekyerɛw wo, minyim dɛ ebɛyɛ ma aakyɛn dza makã mpo.
Afei so, siesie soɛbew ma me, na m'enyi da dɛ ɔnam hom asɔr ntsi wɔdze me bɛkyɛ hom.
Epaphras, me nyɛnko-daduanyi wɔ Christ Jesus mu, kyia wo,
Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, Luke m'afɛdwumadzifo kyiakyia wo.
Ewuradze Jesus adom nkã hom sunsum. Amen
Paul nye Timothy, Christ Jesus nkowaa, dze kɛma Christ Jesus mu ahotsewfo nyina a wɔwɔ Philippi, nye hɔn mu ahwɛfo nye asomfo:
Adom nye asomdwee a ofir Nyankopɔn Egya nye Ewuradze Jesus Christ nkã hom.
Meda me Nyankopɔn ase wɔ nkae biara a mekaa hom,
daa mo nkotoserɛ mu medze dɛw meserɛ mema hom nyina,
wɔ hom nkitahodzi a hom wɔ no asɛmpa no ne tserɛw ho ofitsi da a odzi kan no dze bodu sesi:
Na mowɔ werɛ wɔ iyiara mu dɛ nyia ɔhyɛɛ edwuma pa ase wɔ hom mu no ɔbɛma oedzi mu dze ekodu Jesus Christ do no:
Dɛ mbrɛ ɔtsen ma me dɛ modwen dɛm wɔ hom ho, osiandɛ mukura hom m'akoma mu, wɔ dɛ mo mpokyerɛ nye asɛmpa no ho anoyi nye mfoado mu nyina nye me yɛ adom no fafafo.
Nyankopɔn nye me dasefo mbra mudua nam Christ Jesus ne yamu ara fe hom nyina.
Na iyi nna mosɔr ho dɛ hom nda ho ara mbor do wɔ nyimdzee nye nhumu nyina mu;
ma hom aasɔ ndzɛmba a ɔsosoree ahwɛ, na hom aayɛ kotoo dɛ mfom bi nnyi hom mu dze ekodu Christ do no;
na tsenenee aba a ɔnam Jesus Christ do no aayɛ hom mã ama Nyame enyimnyam nye ayɛyi.
Na mepɛ dɛ hom hu, enuanom dɛ dze ɔaba mo do no aba wɔ asɛmpa no ne kankɔ ntsi mbom;
ma mo mpokyerɛ no aada edzi wɔ praetorium nsordaafo nye hɔn a wɔaka no nyina mu;
ma enuanom no pii nam mo mpokyerɛ no do eenya werɛ ayɛ ndam abor do, dɛ wɔkã Nyankopɔn asɛm no a, wonnsuro.
Binom wɔ hɔ a nyitan nye mansotwe ntsi wɔkã Christ ho asɛm ampa dze; naaso binom wɔ hɔ a wɔdze pɛ pa ka:
Wobi fir dɔ mu, dɛ wonyim dɛ asɛmpa no ho anoyi ntsi nna wɔdze me esi hɔ:
Na wobi fir mansotwe mu kã Christ ho asɛm, nnyɛ kotooyɛ mu bi a, nna wɔdwen dɛ wɔdze ahohia bɛka mo mpokyerɛ ho.
Nna ɔyɛ dɛn? Akwan nyian mu ara, sɛ nyaatwem mu o, sɛ nokwar mu o, Christ ho asɛm ara nna wɔkã; na ɔno mu nna midzi dɛw, na eso mibedzi dɛw.
Osiandɛ minyim dɛ iyi bɛdan mo nkwagye, ɔnam hom asɔr nye Jesus Christ no Sunsum do,
dɛ mbrɛ m'enyisun nye m'enyidado tse, dɛ m'enyi runnwu wɔ biribiara mu, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse daa no, sesei so ɔnam nkwa do o, owu do o, wɔdze ndam nyina bɛkamfo Chrsit wɔ me nyimpadua mu.
Na emidze, ase a metse yi Christ a, na owu yɛ me mfaso.
Na sɛ honam mu nye m'edwuma ho aba a, ɔnodze minnyim mu dza memfa.
Na mehin adze ebien no ntamu; mowɔ akɔndɔ dɛ mu tutu ha nye Christ kɛtsena, ɔno na ouye koraa,
naaso honam mu tsena no hia pii wɔ hom ntsi.
Na mowɔ werɛ yi, minyim dɛ mebɛtsena hɔ na menya hom nyina atsena, wɔ hom kankɔ nye hom gyedzi mu dɛw ntsi;
ama hom aahyehyɛ homho mbordo wɔ Christ mu wɔ me ntsi wɔ dɛ mebɛba hom nkyɛn bio.

Hom mma hom abrabɔ nyɛ dza ɔfata Christ asɛmpa no, ma sɛ meba mubohu hom o, sɛ minnyi hɔ o, maatse hom asetsena ho asɛm dɛ hom gyina pintsinn wɔ Sunsum kor mu, na hom dze ɔkra kor aabɔ mu edzi aper ama asɛmpa no gyedzi no;
na mma hom mma atamfo no nnyi hom hu wɔ biribiara mu: Ɔno nna ɔyɛ ɔhera ho asɛnkyerɛdze ma hɔn, na homdze ɔyɛ nkwagyedze ma hom,na dɛm no fir Nyame;
na ntsi, nnyɛ dɛ hom gye no dzi nko, na mbom dɛ hom hu amandze wɔ ne ntsi so;
na hom nyaa ɔkõ kor no ara a hom hun no wɔ mo mu no, nna sesei so hom tse no mo ho no.
2: Dɛm ntsi sɛ Christ Jesus mu afotu bi, sɛ dɔ awerɛkyekyer bi, sɛ Sunsum anyɛnkoyɛ bi, sɛ ayamuhyehye nye tsimbɔbɔr bi wɔ hɔ a,
hom nhyɛ me dɛw mã dɛ hom bɔdwen adze kor, enya ɔdɔ kor, adwensaa kor, adwen kor.
Mma hom nnyɛ biribi mansotwe do, anaa enyimyam hun do, na mbom obiara nam ahobrɛadze adwen mu bu ne nyɛnko hyɛn nankasa noho;
mma obiara nnhwɛ no nko n'adze, na mbom ɔnhwɛ ne mfɛfo dze so bi.
Hom nnya adwen a ɔwɔ Christ Jesus mu no wɔ hom mu;
