Ewuradze, gye me fi m'atamfo nsa: Muguan toa wo dɛ fa me huntsa.
Kyerɛkyerɛ me ma menyɛ wo pɛ; na ɔwo nye me Nyankopɔn: Wo sunsum ye; gye me wɔ tsenenee asaase do.
Ewuradze, ma me nkwa bio wɔ wo dzin ntsi: Yi me kra fi ɔfona mu wɔ wo ndzeyɛtsenenee mu.
Na twa m'atamfo gu wɔ w'adɔyɛ mu, na sɛɛ hɔn a wohiahia me kra ho nyinara; osiandɛ meyɛ w'akowaa.
144: Nhyira nkã Ewuradze mo botan, ɔno a ɔkyerɛkyerɛ me nsa asayɛ, na me nsatseaba akodzi:
M'adɔyɛ, na m'akoban, M'abantsentsen na me gyefo; me kyɛm, na nyia motwer no; ɔno a ɔbrɛ me man adze hyɛ m'ase.
Ewuradze, ɔdasanyi nye woana, na ɔwo edwen no do yi? Anaa ɔdasanyi ne ba, na ɔwo ibu no bi yi?
Ɔdasanyi tse dɛ ehuhuw: Ne nda tse dɛ nwinwin a ɔresen.
Ewuradze, kontom wo sorsor, na si famu: Keka mbepɔw, na wobopun wusiw.
Paapaa asenaman, na pansam hɔn; totow w'egyen-menaba na bɔ hɔn.
To wo nsa fi sor; hwim me, na gye me fi esu akɛse mu, fi ananaben nsamu;
Hɔn na hɔn ano kã nsɛnhun, na hɔn abanyimfa yɛ ator abanyimfa.
Nyankopɔn, mobɔtow ndwom fofor ama wo: Medze nsankutsen a no do nhoma du mobɔtow ayɛyindwom ama wo.
Ɔno na ɔdze nkwagye ma ahemfo: Na ɔgye n'akowaa David fi afõwa ndam ndam no ano.
Hwim me, na gye me fi ananaben nsamu, hɔn a hɔn ano kã nsɛnhun, na hɔn abanyimfa yɛ ator abanyimfa.
Ber a hɛn mbabanyin bɛyɛ dɛ atsɛndua a woenyin yie wɔ hɔn mberantsɛber mu; na hɛn mbabaa ayɛ kutuwdo-abo a wɔasen no ahemfie dze no saso.
Ber a hɛn asan ayeyɛ amaama a ɔma adze horow nyinara; na hɛn nguan awowo mpempem na pedu-pedu wɔ hɛn haban mu;
Ber a hɛn anantwi hɔn apɔw ewiawia do; ber a ɔbɔhɛn na otukotua bi nnyi, na nkekamu bi nnyi hɛn abrɔn mu;
Esiarfo nye ɔman a wɔtse dɛm asetsena yi mu: Ampaara esiarfo nye ɔman a Ewuradze yɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn.
145: Mobɔtonton wo, me Nyankopɔn, ɔhen; na mehyira wo dzin daa daa daa.
Daa nyina na mibehyira wo; na meyi wo dzin ayɛw daa daa daa.
Ɔkɛse nye Ewuradze, na ɔsɛ ayɛyi ntrado; na n'akɛseyɛ mu yɛ hwehwɛ-na.
Mbasantsen kor bɛkamfo wo ndwuma akyerɛ kor so, na wɔakã w'akatakyi ndzeyɛɛ akyerɛ.
W'enyidzii n'enyimnyam tum no, na w'anwanwa ndwuma no, na mobɔdwendwen ho.
Na adasa kekã wo ndzeyɛɛ a ɔyɛ hu no tum no ho asɛm; na emidze mebɛkã w'akɛseyɛ makyerɛ.
Wɔbɔtoa wo papayɛ kɛse ne nkaa no ho atsɛn, na wɔatow wo ndzeyɛtsenenee ho ndwom.
Ewuradze yɛ adom, na mbɔbɔrhu ahyɛ no mã; ebufufa mu nyaa, na adɔyɛ mu ɔkɛse.
Ewuradze ye ma nyimpa nyinara, Na n'ayamuhyehye wɔ no ndwuma nyinara do.
Ewuradze, wo ndwuma nyinara dze ndaase bɛma wo; na w'ahotseweefo behyira wo.
Wɔbɛkã w'ahendzi n'enyimnyam no ho nsɛm, na wɔabɔ wo tum dzin.
Ma adasamba eehu n'akatakyi ndzeyɛɛ, na n'ahendzi no tum n'enyimnyam no.
W'ahendzi yɛ ɔdomankoma ahendzi, na w'ahenman wɔ hɔ mbasantsen nyinara mu.
Ewuradze wowaw hɔn a wɔhwe ase nyinara, na ɔma hɔn a wɔbrɛ adze do.
Enyiwaenyiwa nyinara hwɛ wo kwan; na ɔwo ema hɔn hɔn edziban wɔ n'aber ano.
Ɔwo ibue wo nsamu, na ema atseasefo nyinara nya hɔn akɔndɔdze mee.
Ewuradze tsen wɔ n'akwan nyinara mu, na ɔyɛ adom wɔ no ndwuma nyinara mu.
Ewuradze bɛn hɔn a wɔfrɛ no nyinara, hɔn a wosū frɛ no nokwar mu nyinara.
Ɔbɛma hɔn a wosuro no no hɔn apɛdze ayɛ hɔ; obetsie hɔn nkekamu so na ɔagye hɔn nkwa.
Ewuradze kora hɔn a wɔdɔ no nyinara do, na emumuyɛfo nyinara dze, ɔbɛsɛɛ hɔn.
M'ano bɛkã Ewuradze n'ayɛyi; na wɔmma honam nyinara nhyira ne dzin krɔnkrɔn no daa daa daa.
146: Hom nyi Ewuradze ayɛw. Me kra, yi Ewuradze ayɛw.
Metse ase yi, mibeyi Ewuradze ayɛw: Mobɔtow ayɛyindwom mama me Nyankopɔn, ber a metse nkwa mu yi.
Mma hom mmfa hom werɛ nnhyɛ ahemfo mu, anaa ɔdasanyi ne ba a mboa bi nnyi no mu no mu.
N'ahom fir edzi kɔ, ɔsan kɔ ne dɛtse mu; da no ara na ne tsirmu nsɛm ahera.
Ɔhomkanyi nye nyia ɔwɔ Jacob ne Nyankopɔn dɛ no boafo, nyia n'enyidado wɔ Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn mu:
Ɔno a ɔyɛɛ ɔsor na asaase, po na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara; ɔno a osie nokwar daa:
Ɔno a obua atsɛn ma hɔn a wodzi hɔn emim; ɔno a ɔdze edziban ma hɔn a ɔkɔm dze hɔn: Ewuradze tu adaduafo dua mu.
Ewuradze bue enyifurafo hɔn enyiwa; Ewuradze ma hɔn a wɔabrɛ adze do; Ewuradze dɔ atseneneefo.
Ewuradze kora ananaben do; ɔwowaw ngyanka na okunafo; na emumuyɛfo kwan dze ɔdan no butuw.
Ewuradze bedzi hen daa, Zion, wo Nyankopɔn ekodu mbasantsen nyinara do. Hom nyi Ewuradze ayɛw.
147: Hom nyi Ewuradze ayɛw; na oye dɛ wɔtow ayɛyindwom ma hɛn Nyankopɔn; na ɔyɛ enyika, na ayɛyi yɛ fɛw.
Ewuradze na ɔkyekyer Jerusalem; ɔno na ɔpon Israelfo a wɔapetse boa ano.
Ɔsa hɔn a hɔn akoma ebubu yarba, na ɔkyekyer hɔn ekur.
Ɔkyerɛ nworaba hɔn dodow ano; ɔtoto hɔn nyinara edzin.
Hɛn Ewuradze yɛ kɛse, na tum mu ɔkatakyi; ne ntseasee nnyi mbanano.
Ewuradze wowaw abrɛfo: Ɔno na ɔdze emumuyɛfo hwe famu.
Hom mfa ndaase ntow ndwom mma Ewuradze; hom ntow ayɛyindwom wɔ nsankutsen do mma hɛn Nyankopɔn:
Ɔno a ɔdze mununkum kata sor, ɔno a osiesie nyankom ma asaase, ɔno a ɔma nkyɛkyɛr fifir mbepɔw do.
Ɔdze abowa n'edziban ma no, na nkonkoranmba a wosū no.
N'enyi nngye ɔpɔnkɔ n'ahoɔdzen mu: Onnya enyika wɔ ɔdasanyi ne nantu ho.
Ewuradze n'enyi gye hɔn a wosuro no no mu; hɔn a hɔn enyi da no mbɔbɔrhu do no mu.
Jerusalem, yi Ewuradze ayɛw; Zion, yi wo Nyankopɔn ayɛw.
Na ɔahyɛ w'aponkɛse n'adaban no dzen; oehyira wo mba a wɔwɔ wo mu.
Ɔma wo ntoaado dwe; ɔdze ewifua pa mee wo.
Ɔsoma ne mbrasɛm ba asaase do; n'asɛm tu mbirika harhar.
Ɔma esukwankyɛba dɛ kuntu fufuw; ɔpetse ɔbɔsu daa dɛ nso,
ɔtow n'esubɔ gu dɛ ntrɔma: Woana botum n'awɔw enyim gyina?
Ɔsoma n'asɛm, na ɔnan hɔn: Ɔma ne mframa bɔ, na esu pem.
Oyi n'asɛm kyerɛ Jacob, no mmom na n'atsɛmbu kyerɛ Israel.
Ɔnnye ɔman biara nndzii no dɛm da: Na n'atsɛmbu dze, wonnhunii. Hom nyi Ewuradze ayɛw.
148: Hom nyi Ewuradze ayɛw. Hom mfi sorsor nyi Ewuradze ayɛw: Hom nyi no ayɛw wɔ wimu noho noho.
N'abɔfoe nyinara, hom nyi no ayɛw: No dɔm nyinara, hom nyi no ayɛw.
Ewia na bosoom, hom nyi no ayɛw: Hom kan na nworaba nyinara, hom nyi no ayɛw.
Hom sorsor no sorsor, hom nyi no ayɛw, na hom esuesu a wɔwɔ sorsor n'etsifi.
Wɔmma wonyi Ewuradze ne dzin ayɛw: Na ɔno na ɔhyɛe, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn.
Ɔno na ɔdze hɔn etsintsim hɔ so daa daa daa. Ɔahyɛ mmom a orunntwa mu nnkɔ.
Hom mfi asaase do nyi Ewuradze ayɛw, hom mbonso, na ebun nyinara:
Ogya na sorbo, esukwankyɛba na ehubɔhubɔw; ehum dzendzen a ɔhyɛ n'asɛm mã:
Nkokwaa na akoko nyinara; nduaber na cedar nyinara;
Hambowa na fiembowa nyinara; aweaweambowa na tumbowa:
Asaase do ahemfo na aman nyinara; asafohemfo na atsɛmbuafo a wɔwɔ asaase do nyinara:
Mberantsɛ na mbabaawa; nkɔdaa na mbofraba:
Wɔmma wonyi Ewuradze ne dzin ayɛw; na ne dzin nkotoo na ɔkrɔn: N'enyimnyam bɔ asaase na sor do.
Na ɔama ambɛn do ama ne man, n'ahotseweefo nyinara hɔn ayɛyi; mekyerɛ Israelmba, ɔman a wɔbɛn no no. Hom nyi Ewuradze ayɛw.
149: Hom nyi Ewuradze ayɛw. Hom ntow ndwom fofor mma Ewuradze, na n'ayɛyi wɔ n'ahotseweefo ehyiadzi no mu.
Wɔmma Israel ndzi ehurusi wɔ nyia ɔyɛɛ no no mu: Wɔmma Zionmba hɔn enyi ngye hɔn hen ho.
Wɔmma wɔmfa asaw nyi ne dzin ayɛw: Wɔmma wɔmfa mpintsin na nsankutsen ntow n'ayɛyindwom.
Na Ewuradze n'enyi ka ne man ho: Ɔdze nkwagye bɛhyehyɛ abrɛfo.
Wɔmma ahotseweefo nhyehyɛ hɔnho wɔ enyimnyam mu: Wɔmma wɔntow enyigye ndwom wɔ hɔn mpa do.
Wɔmma Nyame n'ayɛyi a ɔkrɔn ntsena hɔn anomu, na mfõwa anofanu nkura hɔn nsamu;
dɛ wɔdze bedzi amanaman wer, na wɔdze atsēa aman;
dɛ wɔdze nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn bɛkyekyer hɔn ahemfo, na wɔdze dadze mpokyerɛ atoto hɔn etsitsir;
dɛ wɔdze atsɛmbu a wɔakyerɛw no bodu hɔn: Enyidzi yi na n'ahotseweefo nyinara wɔ. Hom nyi Ewuradze ayɛw.
150: Hom nyi Ewuradze ayɛw. Hom nyi Nyame ayɛw wɔ no krɔnkrɔn-bea: Hom nyi no ayɛw wɔ no tum wi no mu.
Hom nyi no ayɛw wɔ n'akatakyi ndzeyɛɛ ntsi: Hom nyi no ayɛw dɛ mbrɛ n'akɛseyɛ nkyɛnee tse.
Hom mfa akasamu ndze nyi no ayɛw: Hom mfa bɛnta na nsankutsen nyi no ayɛw.
Hom mfa mpintsin na asaw nyi no ayɛw: Hom mfa nhoma-nsanku na atɛntɛbɛn nyi no ayɛw.
Hom nyi no ayɛw wɔ akasaa a ne ndze sõ do: Hom nyi no ayɛw wɔ akasaa a ɔgyegye dzendzen do.
Wɔmma adze biara a ogu ahom no nyi Ewuradze ayɛw. Hom nyi Ewuradze ayɛw.

1: Jesus Christ ne Nyikyerɛ a Nyankopɔn dze maa no dɛ ɔnkyerɛ no nkowaa dza otwar dɛ ɔbɛba ntsɛm; na ɔsomae nam no bɔfoe do dze bɛkyerɛɛ n'akowaa John;
ɔno na odzii dase wɔ Nyankopɔn asɛm nye Jesus Christ dasedzi ho, wɔ ndzɛmba a ohunii nyina ho.
Nhyira nye onyii no a ɔkenkan, nye hɔn wotsie nkɔnkyɛnsɛm no, na wɔdze dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mu no sie: Na ber no abɛn.
John dze kɛma asɔrtɔw esuon a wɔwɔ Asia: Adom nye asomdwee mfi nyia ɔwɔ hɔ, ɔwɔ hɔ dada, na ɔreba no: Nye esunsum esuon wɔwɔ n'ahengua no enyim no;
nye Jesus Christ a ɔyɛ dasefo nokwafo, ewufo mu abakan, nye asaase do ahɛmfo hɔn do hwɛdofo no nkyɛn, nkã hom. Nyia ɔdɔ hɛn, na ɔdze no bɔgyaa saan hɛn fii hɛn bɔn mu;
na ɔayɛ hɛn aHenman, asɔfo ama n'Egya Nyankopɔn no; ɔno na enyimnyam nye tumdzi nkã no mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
Hwɛ, ɔnam nsuwusiw mu reba; na enyiwa nyina bohu no, nye hɔn a wɔwɔɔ no peaa no; na wiadze mbusuakuw nyina bɔbɔ no ho mbubuw. Ɔtse sa, Amen.
Emi nye Alpha nye Omega, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn na ɔse, nyia ɔwɔ hɔ, ɔwɔ hɔ dada, na ɔreba no, adze nyina do Tumfo no.
Emi John a meyɛ hom nua, nye Jesus Christ dasedzi ntsi.
Mowɔ Sunsum no mu Ewuradze ne da no mu, na metsee m'ekyir ndze kɛse bi, tse dɛ totorobɛnto,
dɛ, Dza ihu yi kyerɛw no nwoma mu, na soma kɛma asɔrtɔw esuon no: Fa kɛma Ephesus, nye Smyrna, nye Pergamum, nye Thyatira, nye Sardis, nye Philadelphia nye Laodicea.
Na medaan moho dɛ morokɔhwɛ ndze a ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ me no. Na medaan moho no, muhun nkandzeadua esuon:
Na nkandzeadua esuon no finimfin no muhun obi a ɔtse dɛ nyimpa ba, ɔhyɛ atar wiww kã ne nansa, na ɔdze sika abɔdo abɔ no koko do.
Na ne tsir nye ne tsinhwi hoa dɛ nguanhwi fitaa, ɔtse dɛ esukwankyɛba; na n'enyiwa tse dɛ gyaframee;
na n'anan tse dɛ ayewa a wɔapɔw ho a adɔ wɔ fononoo mu, na ne ndze tse dɛ esu pii ndze.
Na okura nworaba esuon wɔ ne nsa nyimfa mu, na afõwa anofanu ndandam fi n'anomu. Na no momapɔw tse dɛ ewia rehyerɛn n'ahoɔdzen mu.
Na muhun no no, mohwee n'ananadze dɛ owufo. Na ɔdze ne nsa nyimfa too mo do, see dɛ, Mma nnsuro, emi nye ɔkandzifo nye okyidzifo no,
nye nyia ɔtse ase no; na muwui; na hwɛ, metse ase mbersantsen mfesantsen, na mukura owu nye samanadze asaafee.
Ntsi kyerɛw dza ehu, nye dza ɔwɔ hɔ, nye dza iyi ekyir ɔbɛba no:
Nworaba esuon a ihunii wɔ me nsa nyimfa mu no ho esumasɛm no, nye nkandzeadua esuon no. Nworaba esuon no nye asɔrtɔw esoun no mu abɔfo: Na nkandzeadua esuon no nye asɔrtɔw esuon no.
2: Ephesus asɔr mu ɔbɔfo no, kyerɛw kɛma no dɛ; iyi na nyia okura nworaba esuon no wɔ ne nsa nyimfa mu, na ɔnantsew sika nkandzeadua esuon no finimfin no, se:
Minyim wo ndwuma, nye wo berɛ, nye w'abotar, mbrɛ inntum nnkora emumuyɛfo, na esɔɔ hɔn a wɔfrɛ hɔnho asomafo na wɔnnyɛ no hwɛe, na ihun hɔn atorfo;
na ayɛ abotar na ekura mu wɔ me dzin ntsi, na ammberɛ.
Naaso mowɔ biribiri tsia wo, dɛ igyaa wo dɔ kan no.
Dɛm ntsi, kaa mbrɛ ifi ahwe ase, na nu woho, na yɛ kan no ndwuma no; annyɛ dɛm a, mbɛba wo do, na mebeyi wo kandzeadua no mefi ne sibea; gyedɛ inu woho.
Naaso iyidze ewɔ, dɛ ikyir Nicolaifo ndwuma a mo so mikyir.
Onyia ɔwɔ aso no ma ontsie dza Sunsum kã kyerɛ asɔrtɔw no, nyia odzi nyim no, mebɛma no nkwadua a osi Nyankopɔn Paradise no, n'aba bi ma oeedzi.
Na Smyrna asɔr mu ɔbɔfo no, kyerɛw kɛma no dɛ; iyi na ɔkandzifo nye okyidzifo, nyia owui na ɔtse ase bio no se:
Minyim w'ahohia nye wo hia (naaso eyɛ ɔhonyanyi), nye hɔn a wɔdɛ wɔyɛ Jewfo, na wɔnnyɛ, na mbom wɔyɛ Satan nhyiamudan, hɔn ebususɛm no.
Mma nnsuro amandze a irubohu biara: hwɛ, abɔnsam dze hom mu binom rubogu efiadze, na wɔaasɔ hom ahwɛ; na hom bohu amandze dadu. Dzi nokwar kesi owu mu, na mebɛma wo nkwa aHenkyɛw.
Onyia ɔwɔ aso, ma ontsie dza Sunsum no ka kyerɛ asɔtɔw no. Nyia obedzi nyim no, owu mprɛnu rennyɛ no mbusu biara.
Na Pergamum asɔr mu ɔbɔfo no kyerɛw kɛma no dɛ; iyi na nyia okura afõwa anofanu ndandam no se:
minyim mbrɛ etse, mbrɛ Satan ahengua si; na ikura me dzin mu dzen, na ammpa me gyedzi, wɔ nda a wokum me dasefo nokwafo Antipas wɔ hom mu, mbrɛ Satan tse hɔ.
Naaso mowɔ asɛm kakra tsia wo, osiandɛ ewɔ wo hɔ binom a wokura Balaam nkyerɛkyerɛ mu, nyia ɔkyerɛɛ Balak dɛ ɔnto Israelma fintsidua, dɛ wondzi adze a wɔdze abɔ abosom afɔr, na wɔnyɛ ndwaman no.
Dɛmara so na ewɔ binom a wokura Nicolaifo nkyerɛkyerɛ a mikyir no mu.
Dɛm ntsi nu woho; aanyɛ dɛm a, mebɛba wo do ntsɛmara, na medze m'anomu afõwa abɛnye hɔn akõ.
Nyia obedzi nyim no, ɔno na mebɛma no manna a ohuntsa no bi, na mama no bobaa fufuw, na bobaa no do dzin a wɔakyerɛw a obi nnyim gyedɛ nyia onya no.
Na Thyatira asɔr mu ɔbɔfo no, kyerɛ kɛma no dɛ; iyi na Nyankopɔn Ba no a ɔwɔ enyiwa a ɔtse dɛ gyaframee, na n'anan tse dɛ ayewa a wɔapɔw ho no se:
Minyim wo ndwuma, nye w'abotar, nye dɛ wo ndwuma a odzi ekyir kyɛn dza odzi kan no.
Na mowɔ biribi tsia wo, dɛ ema ɔbaa Jezebel a ɔfrɛ noho nkɔnkyɛnyi no kwan, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ na ɔdaadaa mo nkowaa ma wɔyɛ ndwaman, na wodzi dza wɔdze abɔ abosom afɔr.
Na memaa no mber dɛ onnu noho, na ɔmmpɛ dɛ onu noho fi no ndwamansɛm mu.
Hwɛ, medze no bɔto mpa do, na medze hɔn a wɔnye no tõo awar no egu ahohia kɛse mu, gyedɛ wonu hɔnho wɔ hɔn ndwuma ho.
Na medze owu boku ne mba; na asɔrtɔw nyina bohu dɛ emi nye nyia ɔhwehwɛ asabu nye akoma mu; na mebɛma hom mu biara dɛ mbrɛ no ndwuma tse.
Na mese hom a hom aka Thyatira, dodow a wonnyi dɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ yi, hɔn a wonnyim Satan no bun no, dɛ mbrɛ wɔkã; moronnsoa hom adzesoa fofor.
Naaso dza hom wɔ no, hom nsuo mu dzen ma onkodu dɛ mebɛba.
Na nyia obedzi nyim na oekura mo ndwuma mu ekesi ase no, mebɛma no amanaman do tum:
Na ɔdze dadze poma bɔhwɛ hɔn do, na obobubu hɔn posoposo dɛ ɔwemfo nsenaba; dɛ mbrɛ mo so menya no m'Egya nsamu:
Na mebɛma no adzekyee woraba no.
Nyia ɔwɔ aso, ma ontsie dza Sunsum no kã kyerɛ asɔrtɔw no.
3: Na Sardis asɔr mu ɔbɔfo no, kyerɛw kɛma no dɛ; iyi na nyia ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn esunsum esuon no nye nworaba esuon no se: Minyim wo ndwuma, dɛ ewɔ dzin dɛ etse ase, naaso ewu.
Weɔn, na hyɛ ndzɛmba a ɔaka a nkyɛ worubowu no dze: Na mennhu wo ndwuma mu dza oedzi mu wɔ me Nyankopɔn enyim.
Dɛm ntsi kaa mbrɛ inyae, na etsee; na suo mu na nu woho. Na sɛ annweɔn a, mebɛba dɛ owifo, na irunnhu dɔn kor a mebɛba wo do.
Naaso ewɔ edzin kumaabi wɔ Sardis a wonnguu hɔn ntar ho fi, na wɔnye me bɛnantsew wɔ fitaa mu; osiandɛ wɔfata.
Nyia obedzi nyim no, ɔnoara na wobowuna no ntar fitaa; na meremmpepa ne dzin wɔ nkwa nwoma no mu, na mobɔbɔ ne dzin wɔ m'Egya, nye n'abɔfoe enyim.
Onyia ɔwɔ aso, ma ontsie dza Sunsum no kã kyerɛ asɔrtɔw no.
Na Philadelphia asɔr mu ɔbɔfo no, kyerɛw kɛma no dɛ; iyi na krɔnkrɔnnyi, nokwafo no, nyia okura David saafee, na obue a obi nntow mu, na ɔtow mu a obi mmbue no, se:
minyim wo ndwuma (na hwɛ mama abow a woebue ada w'enyim a obi nntum nntow mu), dɛ ewɔ ahoɔdzen kakra, na esie m'asɛm na ammpow me dzin.
Hwɛ, medze binom a wofi Satan nhyiamudan mu a wɔkã dɛ wɔyɛ Jewfo, na wɔnnyɛ no, na wodzi ator no, mema: Hwɛ mebɛma wɔaba abɔkotow w'ananadze na woebu dɛ madɔ wo.
Osiandɛ esie m'abotar asɛm no, mo so medze wo besie wɔ nsɔhwɛ dɔn a ɔbɛba wiadze nyina do aabɔsɔ hɔn a wɔtse asaase do ahwɛ no mu.
Mereba ntsɛm: Suo dza ewɔ mu dzen, mma obi aangye w'aHenkyɛw.

Nyia obedzi nyim no, mebɛyɛ no fadum wɔ wɔ me Nyankopɔn asɔrdan mu, ba orimmfi mu efir bio: Na mebɛkyerɛw me Nyankopɔn dzin wɔ no do, nye me Nyankopɔn kurow no ne dzin, Jerusalem fofor a ofi me Nyankopɔn hɔ fi sor ba asaase no, nye mankasa me dzin fofor no.
Nyia ɔwɔ aso, a ontsie dza Sunsum no kã kyerɛ asɔrtɔw no.
Na Laodicea asɔr mu ɔbɔfo no kyerɛw kɛma no dɛ. Iyi na Amen, ɔdasefo sɛnkordzifo nye nokwafo, Nyame abɔdze farbaa no, se:
Minyim wo ndwuma dɛ ennyɛ nwin nnyɛ hyɛw: Eyɛɛ nwin anaa eyɛɛ hyew a, nkyɛ mepɛ mbom.
Na osiandɛ eyɛ abɔtrɔbɔdwe, na ennyɛ hyew nnyɛ nwin ntsi, mebɛfe wo mefi m'anomu egu.
Osiandɛ ese dɛ, meyɛ ɔhonyanyi, menya moho, onnhua me hwee; na innyim dɛ ɔwo nye ɔwerɛhonyi nye busuyɛnyi nye hianyi nye furafo nye kwatserkwaa:
mepam wo dɛ bɔtɔ mo hɔ sika a wɔaber ho wɔ gya mu, na aayɛ ɔhonyanyi; nye ntar fitaa, na edze aahyɛ woho, na w'adagyaw ne fɛr aannda edzi, nye enyiwa edur a edze bɛsera w'enyi, na eehu adze.
Dodow a modɔ hɔn no, mekã hɔn enyim na metsēa hɔn: Bɔ mbɔdzen nu woho.
Hwɛ, migyina abowano na morobɔ mu: Sɛ obi tsie me ndze na obue abow no a, mebɛhɛn mu aba ne nkyɛn, na menye no bedzidzi na ɔno so nye me edzidzi.
Nyia obedzi nyim no, mebɛma ɔnye me atsena m'ahengua do, dɛ mbrɛ mo so midzii nyim, na menye m'Egya tsenaa n'ahengua do.
Nyia ɔwɔ aso, ma ontsie dza Sunsum no kã kyerɛ asɔrtɔw no.
4: Iyi ekyir no muhunii, na hwɛ, abow a woebue wɔ sor, na nkan no ndze a metsee a ɔtse dɛ totorobɛnto nye me rekasa no see me dɛ, fow bra ha, na mebɛkyerɛ wo dza otwar dɛ ɔbɛba mu wɔ iyi ekyir.
Ntsɛmara na mowɔ Sunsum mu: Na hwɛ, wɔdze ahengua esi sor, na obi tse ahengua no do;
na nyia ɔtse do no, ehwɛ no a ɔtse dɛ jasper no nye sardius: Na nyankontɔn a ehwɛ a ɔtse dɛ emerald bo etwa ahengua no ho ehyia.
Na nHengua eduonu anan etwa ahengua no ho ehyia: Na muhun mpanyimfo eduonu anan tsetse nHengua no do, hyehyɛ ntar fitaa, na sika nHenkyɛw soso hɔn etsifi.
Na enyinam, nye ndze horow nye asenaman fi ahengua no mu firii, nye gya nkandzea esuon a wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn esunsum no, redzɛw ahengua no enyim;
na ahwehwɛ po a ɔtse dɛ crystal wɔ ahengua no enyim; na atseasefo anan a enyiwa ayɛ hɔn enyim nye hɔn ekyir mã, wɔ ahengua no ho ehyia mã, wɔ ahengua no ho wɔ finimfin, na woetwa ahengua no ho ehyia.
Na ɔtseasefo a odzi kan no tse dɛ gyata, dza otsia ebien no tse dɛ nantwiba, dza otsia ebiasa no wɔ enyim dɛ nyimpa, na dza otsia anan no tse dɛ ɔkɔr a orutu.

Na atseasefo anan no wɔwɔ ntsaban esia nkorkor, na enyiwa ahyɛ hɔn ho nye hɔn mu mã; na wɔnnhom adzekyee nye adzesaa, wɔkasa se dɛ; Krɔnkrɔn, Krɔnkrɔn, Krɔnkɔn nye Ewuradze Nyankopɔn Tumfo a ɔwɔ hɔ dada, ɔwɔ hɔ, na ɔreba.
Na aber a atseasefo no dze enyimnyam nye enyidzi nye ndaase ma nyia ɔtse ahengua no do no a ɔtse hɔ mbersantsen mfesantsen no,
mpanyimafo eduonu anan no hwe ase wɔ dza ɔtse ahengua no do no enyim, na wɔkotow dza ɔtse ase mbersantsen mfesantsen no, na wotutu hɔn aHenkyɛw gu ahengua no enyim dɛ,
Hɛn Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, ɔwo efata dɛ egye enyimnyam nye enyidzi nye tum: Na ɔwo na ebɔɔ adze nyina, na wo pɛ ntsi na wɔwowɔ hɔ, na wɔbɔe.
5: Na muhun nyia ɔtse ahengua no do no ne nsa nyimfa mu nwoma a wɔakyerɛw no mu nye n'ekyir, na wɔdze nsɔwano esuon asɔw ano.
Na muhun ɔbɔfo hoɔdzenfo bi a ɔdze ndze kɛse retsēa mu dɛ, woana na ɔfata dɛ obue nwoma no, na ɔtsew no nsɔwano?
Na obiara nnyi sor, anaa asaase, anaa asaase ase a otumii dɛ obue nwoma no, anaa ɔhwɛ,
Na musūu pii, osiandɛ woennhu obiara a ɔfata dɛ obobue nwoma no, ana ɔbɔhwɛ
na mpanyimfo no baako see me dɛ, Mma nnsū: Na Judah ebusuakuw mu Gyata no, David Ndwow no oedzi nyim, dɛ obobue nwoma no ano.
Na muhun ahengua no nye atseasefo anan no ntamu, nye mpanyimfo no ntamu, Eguambaa bi gyina hɔ a ɔtse dɛ woeku no, ɔwɔ mmbɛn esuon, nye enyiwa esuon a wɔasoma hɔn akɔ asaase nyina do no.
Na ɔbae bɛgyee nwoma no wɔ nyia ɔtse ahengua no do no ne nyimfa.
Na ɔgyee nwoma no, atseasefo anan no hwee ase wɔ Eguambaa no enyim, wɔdzedze nsanku nye sika nkuraba a ohuam ahyɛ no mã a ɔyɛ ahotsefo mpaayi no.

Na wɔtoow ndwom fofor bi dɛ, ɔwo na efata dɛ egye mwoma no, na etsew no nsɔwano no: Osiandɛ wokum wo, na edze wo bɔgyaa tɔɔ binom maa Nyankopɔn wofi mbusuakuw nye kasa, nye nkorɔfo, nye aman nyina mu,
na emaa wɔyɛɛ aHenman nye asɔfo maa hɛn Nyankopɔn: Na wodzi Hen wɔ asaase do.
Na mohwɛe, na metsee abɔfo pii a wɔabɔ ahengua no ho kɔntɔnkrɔn nye atseasefo no nye mpanyimfo no hɔn ndze, na hɔn dodow yɛ ɔpɛdu horow ɔpedu, nye mpem horow mpem;
na wɔdze ndze kɛse see dɛ, Eguamba no a wokum no no ɔfata dɛ ɔgye tumdzi, nye ahonya, nye nyansa, nye ahoɔdzen, nye enyidzi, nye enyimnyam, nye nhyira.

Na abɔdze a ɔwɔ sor, nye asaase, nye asaase ase, nye dza ɔwɔ po do, nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyina, metsee dɛ wɔse, Nhyira, nye enyidzi, nye enyimnyam, nye tumdzi, nkã nyia ɔtse ahengua no do no, nye Eguambaa no, mbersantsen mfesantsen.
na atseasefo anan no see dɛ, Amen. Na mpanyimfo eduonu anan no hwehwee ase, na wɔkotoow no.
6: Na muhun dɛ Eguambaa no tseew nsɔwano esuon no mu kor ano, na metsee atseasefo anan no baako dɛ ɔdze ndze a ɔtse dɛ sena man see dɛ, Bra.
Na mohwɛe, na hwɛ, ɔpɔnkɔ fufuw, na nyia ɔtse no do no kura egyenna wɔmaa no aHenkyɛw: na ofiir edzi ridzi konyim akɔ konyim mu.
Na ɔtseew nsɔwano a otsia ebien no ano no, metsee ɔtseasefo a otsia ebien no dɛ ɔse, Bra.
Na ɔpɔnkɔ fofor memen fiir edzi, na wɔmaa nyia ɔtse no do tum dɛ onkeyi asomdwee mfi asaase do, na wonkuku hɔnho, na wɔmaa no afõwa kɛse bi.
Na ɔtseew nsɔwano a otsīa ebiasa no ano no, metsee ɔtseasefo a otsīa ebiasa no dɛ ɔse, Bra. Na mohwɛe, na hwɛ, ɔpɔnkɔ tuntum, na nyia ɔtse no do no kura nsɛn wɔ ne nsamu.
Na metsee ndze bi wɔ atseasefo anan no finimfin dɛ ɔse, Ewifua esusudze denare, na atoko esusudze ebiasa denare, na wenyin nye ngo no dze, mma nnkã.
Na ɔtseew nsɔwano a otsīa anan no ano no, metsee ɔtseasefo a otsīa anan no ndze dɛ ɔse, Bra.

Na mohwɛe, na hwɛ, ɔpɔnkɔ nsonso: Na nyia ɔtse no do no, ne dzin dze Owu; na Samanadze dzi n'ekyir. Na wɔmaa hɔn asaase nkyekyɛmu anan mu kor do tum, dɛ wɔmfa afõwa, nye ɔkɔm, nye owu, nye asaase do mbowa abɔyafo nkuku hɔn.
Na ɔtseew nsɔwano a otsia enum no ano no, muhun hɔn a Nyankopɔn asɛm nye dase a wodzii ntsi wokunkum hɔn no, hɔn akra wɔ afɔrmbukyia no ase:
Na wɔdze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu dɛ, Ewuradze Krɔnkrɔnnyi nye nokwafo, onkodu dabɛn na irummbua atsen atsɛn na irinndzi hɔn a wɔtse asaase do hɔn bɔgyaa ho wer?
Na wɔmemaa hɔn mu baako biara atar fitaa; na wɔsee hɔn dɛ wɔnda ho nhom mber kakra, nkodu dɛ hɔn nwurakowaa nye hɔn nuanom a woboku hɔn dɛ hɔnara so no hɔn dodow ewie sõ.
Na ɔtseew nsɔwano a otsīa esia no ano no, mohwɛe, na hwɛ, asaase wosoow kɛse, na ewia yɛɛ tumm dɛ nhwi eyitam, na bosoom yɛɛ dɛ bɔgya,
na sor nworaba totɔɔ asaase do, dɛ adɔmbadua a mframa kɛse wosow no ropo n'adɔmba bun.
Na woyii ɔsor kɔr dɛ nwoma a wɔabobɔw; na mbepɔw nye nsupɔw nyina tutui fifii mbrɛ wɔwɔ.
Na asaase do ahemfo, nye adehye nyina, sumasumaa abodan nye mbepɔw do abotan no mu;
na wɔsee abotan nye mbepɔw no dɛ, hom nhwe hɛn do mfa hɛn nsuma mfi nyia ɔtse ahengua do no n'enyim, nye Eguambaa no n'ebufuw da kɛse no aba, na woana na obotum egyina?
7: Na iyi ekyir muhun abɔfo baanan a wogyinagyina asaase mfɛndzanan no ano, dzedze asaase mframa anan no mu, na mfram aammbɔ wɔ asaase anaa po anaa dua biara do.
Na muhun ɔbɔfo bi so a ɔdze Nyankopɔn tseasefo no nsɔwano no dɛ ofi wipuei reba: Na ɔdze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu kyerɛɛ abɔfo anan a wɔama hɔn kwan dɛ wɔnhaw po nye asaase no,
dɛ, Mma hom nnhaw asaase anaa po, anaa ndua, ma onkodu dɛ yɛasɔw hɛn Nyankopɔn nkowaa ano wɔ hɔn momapɔw do.
Na metsee hɔn a wɔsɔɔw hɔn ano no hɔn dodow, mpem ɔha eduanan anan a wɔasɔw hɔn a wɔsɔɔw hɔn ano wɔ Israelmba mbusuakuw nyina mu.
Judah ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien: Reuben ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien: Gad ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien:
Asher ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien: Naphtali ebuasuakuw mu mpemduebien: Manasseh ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien:
Simeon ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien: Levi ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien: Issachar ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien:
Zebulun ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien: Joseph ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien: Benjamin ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien:

Na iyi ekyir no mohwɛe, na hwɛ, nyimpadodow kɛse a obi nntum nnkan hɔn a wofii aman, nye mbusuakuw, nye nkorɔfo, nye kasa nyina mu, gyinagyina ahengua no nye Eguambaa no enyim, hyehyɛ ntar fitaa, na berɛw kurakura hɔn nsamu;
na wɔdze ndze kɛse tsēa mu dɛ, nkwagye nkã hɛn Nyankopɔn a ɔtse ahengua no do, nye Eguambaa no,
Na abɔfo no nyina etwa ahengua no nye mpanyimfo no nye atseasefo no ho ehyia, na wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu, na wɔkotoow Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Amen;
nhyira, nye enyimnyam, nye nyansa, nye ndaase, nye enyidzi, nye tumdzi, nye ahoɔdzen nkã hɛn Nyankopɔn mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
Na mpanyimfo no baako buae see me dɛ, woananom nye hɔn a wɔhyehyɛ ntar fitaa yi? Na wofi Hen?
Na mesee no dɛ, mo wura, ɔwo na inyim. Na ɔsee me dɛ, woyi nye hɔn a wofi ahohia kɛse no mu no, na wɔahor hɔn ntar, na ayɛ fitaa wɔ Eguambaa no bɔgyaa mu.
Dɛm ntsi na wɔwɔ Nyankopɔn ahengua no enyim; na wɔsom no adzekyee nye adzesaa wɔ n'asɔrdan mu; na nyia ɔtse ahengua no do no bɛtserɛw ne ntamadan mu akata hɔn do.
Ɔkɔm renndze hɔn bio, na eso nsukɔm renndze hɔn bio; na eso ewia anaa ɔhyew biara rennkã hɔn:
na Eguambaa no a ɔwɔ ahengua no finimfin no bɛyɛ hɔn guanhwɛfo, na ɔdze hɔn akɔ nkwa nsubura ho: Na Nyankopɔn bɛpepa nyinsuwa nyina efi hɔn enyiwa mu.
8: Na ɔtseew nsɔwano a otsīa esuon no ano no, ɔsor taa tsinkonn bɛyɛ dɔnhwerfa.
Na muhun abɔfo esuon a wogyinagyina Nyankopɔn enyim no; na wɔmaa hɔn totorobɛnto esuon.
Na ɔbɔfo bi so bae begyinaa afɔrmbukyia no ho a okura sika nduhuamkuraba; na wɔdze nduhuam pii maa no, dɛ ɔmfa mfora ahotsewfo mpaayi no mbɔ afɔr wɔ sika afɔrmbuhyia no a osi ahengua no enyim no do.
Na nduhuam no wusiw foraa ahotsewfo mpaayi no fii abɔfo no nsamu faa sor kɔr Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na ɔbɔfo no faa nduhuam kuraba no; na ɔdze afɔrmbukyia no do gya no bi hyɛɛ no mã, na ɔtowee kyeen asaase do: Na asenaman nye ndze horow, nye enyinam, nye asaasewosow bae.

Na nyia odzi kan no hɛnee, na ɔsorbo nye gya a bɔgya edzi afora bae, na wɔtowee guu asaase do: Na asaase nkyekyɛmu abiasa mu kor hyewee, na ndua nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor hyewee, na efuw momon nyina hyewee.
Na ɔbɔfo a otsīa ebien no hɛnee, na wɔtoow adze a ɔtse dɛ bepɔw kɛse a ɔredzɛw gya kyeen po mu; na po nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor daan bɔgya;
na abɔdze a nkwa wɔ mu a wɔwɔ po mu nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor wuwui; na ahɛn nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor sɛɛe.
Na ɔbɔfo a otsīa ebiasa no hɛnee, na woraba kɛse bi fi sor hwee famu redw!w dɛ ogyatsɛn, na ɔkɔhwee esutsen nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor do, nye nsunyiwa do;
na woraba no dzin dze Bɔwen; na esu no nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor yɛɛ wenwen; na nyimpa piinara wuwui wɔ nsu no wen a ɔayɛ ntsi.

Na ɔbɔfo a otsīa anan no hɛnee, na wɔbɔɔ ewia nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor, nye bosoom nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor, nye nworaba nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor; ma hɔn nkyekyɛmu a otsīa ebiasa no yeyɛɛ sum, na adzekyee nkyekyɛmu a otsīa ebiasa annhyerɛn, na adzesaa so dɛmara.
Na muhunii, na metsee ɔkɔr a orutu fa sor finimfin, dɛ ɔdze ndze kɛse se dɛ, wondue, wondue, wondue, hɔn a wɔtse asaase do, wɔ abɔfo baasa a wɔrehehɛn no hɔn totrobɛnto ndze a ɔaka no ntsi.
9: Na ɔbɔfo a otsīa enum no hɛnee, na muhun woraba bi a ofi sor atɔ asaase: Na wɔdze mona a onnyi ntuadze no ano saafee maa no.
Na obuee mona a onnyi ntuadze no; na wusiw a ɔtse dɛ fononoo kɛse mu wusiw no fii mona no mu firii; na ewia na wimu yɛɛ sum wɔ mona no no wusiw no ntsi.
Na mbɛbɛw fi wusiw no mu baa asaase do; na wɔmma hɔn tum a ɔtse dɛ asaase nyankoma-nketsebowa tum.
Na wɔkãa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnhaw asaase do nkyɛkyɛr, anaa haban momon biara, anaa dua biara, gyesɛ nyimpa a wonnyi Nyankopɔn nsɔwano wɔ hɔn momapɔw do no nko.
na wɔmaa hɔn kwan dɛ mma wonnku hɔn, na mbom wɔnhaw hɔn ara abosoom enum: Na hɔn haw tse dɛ nyankoma-nketsebowa akã nyimpa.
Na nda no mu nyimpa bɔhwehwɛ owu na worinnya; na hɔn kɔn bɔdɔ dɛ wowu, na owu befi hɔn nkyɛn eguan.
Na mbɛbɛw no suban tse dɛ mpɔnkɔ a woesiesie hɔn ama akodzi; na hɔn etsifi wɔ adze bi a ɔyɛ dɛ sika aHenkyɛw, na hɔn enyim tse dɛ nyimpa enyim.
Na wɔwɔ nhwi tse dɛ mbaa dze, na hɔn sē tse dɛ ngyata dze.
Na wɔwɔ nkatabo a ɔtse dɛ dadze nkatabo; na hɔn ntsaban mu gyegye tse dɛ mpɔnkɔ pii tseaseanam a wɔdze twitwi rokɔ sa dze.
Na wɔwɔ ndua dɛ nyankoma-nketsebowa dze, na ohwirom so; na hɔn ndua mu na hɔn tum a wɔdze haw nyimpa abosoom enum no wɔ.
Na wɔwɔ hɔn do Hen a ɔno nye mona a onnyi ntuadze no mu ɔbɔfo no: Ne dzin wɔ Hebrew mu nye Abaddon, na Greek kasa mu dze, ne dzin dze Apollyon.
Mbusu kor etwa mu: hwɛ, iyi ekyir mbusu ebien da ho reba.
Na ɔbɔfo a otsīa esia no hɛnee, na metsee ndze kor bi a ofi sika afɔrmbukyia a osi Nyankopɔn enyim no ne mmbɛn no mu,
obi a ɔse ɔbɔfo a otsīa esia no a okura totorobɛnto no dɛ, Sansan abɔfo baanan a wɔamontan hɔn esutsen Euphrates ho no.
Na wɔsansaan abɔfo baanan no a woesiesie ama dɔn, nye da, nye bosoom, nye afe no, dɛ wonkuku nyimpa nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor no.
Na mpɔnkɔdofo dɔm no dodow yɛ peduonu horow pedu: Metsee hɔn dodow ano.

Na mbrɛ muhun mpɔnkɔ no nye hɔn a wɔtsetse hɔn do, wɔ enyido-adzehu mu nye yi, wɔwɔ gya nye hyacinth nye brimstone nkatabo, na mpɔnkɔ no etsir tse dɛ ngyata etsir, na gya nye wusiw nye brimstone fi hɔn anomu.
Wɔnam mbusuhaw ebiasa yi do na wokunkum nyimpa nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor, wɔdze gya, nye wusiw, nye brimstone a ofi hɔn anomu no.
Na mpɔnkɔ nohɔn ahoɔdzen wɔ hɔn ano nye hɔn ndua: Na wɔdze haw.

Na adasa nkaa a wɔammfa mbusuhaw yi ennkuku hɔn no, woennu hɔnho emmfi hɔn nsaano ndwuma ho, dɛ wɔnnkɔsom mbɔnsam, nye sika, nye dwetɛ, nye ayewa, nye ɔbo, nye dua ehonyi a wonnhu adze, na wɔnntse asɛm, na wonntum nnantsew:
Na woennu hɔnho emmfi hɔn ewudzi, nye hɔn abayisɛm, nye hɔn ndwanmansɛm, nye hɔn nwuradansɛm ho.
10: Na muhun ɔbɔfo fofor hoɔdzenfo a ofi sor risian no, na ɔahyɛ nsuwusiw; nyankontɔn wɔ ne tsir do, na n'enyim tse dɛ ewia, na n'anan tse dɛ gyafadum:
na okura nwoma ketseaba bi a woebue mu: Na ɔdze ne nan nyimfa sii po do, na ɔdze bankum no sii asaase do;
na ɔdze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu dɛ gyata ropɔw; na ɔtsëaa mu no, asenaman esuon no bɔɔ hɔn ndze mu.
Na asenaman esuon bɔɔ mu no, nkyɛ mereyɛ makyerɛw: Na metsee ndze bi fi sor see me dɛ, sow dza asenaman esuon no kãe no ano, mma nnkyerɛw.
Na ɔbɔfo no a muhun dɛ ogyina po nye asaase do no, maa ne nsa do kyerɛɛ sor,
na ɔkãa nyia ɔtse ase mbersantsen mfesantsen a ɔbɔɔ sor nye dza ɔwɔ mu, nye asaase nye dza ɔwɔ mu, nye po nye dza ɔwɔ mu ho ntam dɛ, ber bi nnyi hɔ bio:
Na ɔbɔfo a otsīa esuon no ndze a ɔrebɛhɛn no ne nda mu, nna woewie Nyankopɔn esumasɛm no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkãa asɛmpa kyerɛɛ no nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no.
Na ndze a metsee fii sor no nye me kasaa bio dɛ, kɔ, kɛgye nwoma ketseaba a woebue mu no wɔ ɔbɔfo a ogyina po nye asaase do no ne nsamu.
Na mokɔr ɔbɔfo no hɔ kɛsee no dɛ ɔmfa nwoma ketseaba no mma me. Na ɔsee me dɛ, gye, na dzi; na ɔbɛyɛ wenwen wɔ wo yamu, na w'anomu dze ɔbɛyɛ fenemfenem dɛ ewo.
Na megyee nwoma ketseaba no wɔ bɔfo no nsamu, na midzii; na ɔyɛɛ fenemfenem wɔ m'anomu dɛ ewo, na muwiee dzi no, ɔyɛɛ wenwen wɔ me yamu.
Na wɔsee me dɛ, otwar dɛ ehyɛ nkɔm bio wɔ nkorɔfo, nye aman, nye kasa, nye ahemfo pii ho.
11: Na wɔmaa me ndzɛmbir a ɔtse dɛ abaa: Na obi see dɛ, soɛr, na susu Nyankopɔn asɔrdan, nye afɔrmbukyia nye hɔn a wɔsɔr wɔ mu no.
Na paa a ɔwɔ asɔrdan no ho no dze, gya no hɔ, na mma nnsusu; na wɔdze ama amanaman; na wobetsiatsia kurow krɔnkrɔn no do abosoom eduanan ebien.
na mebɛma m'adasefo beenu efurafura eyitam abɛhyɛ nkɔm nda apem ahaenu eduosia.
Iyinom nye ngodua ebien nye nkandzeadua ebien a wosisi asaase Wura enyim no.
Sɛ obi pɛ ahaw hɔn a, ogya fi hɔn anomu bɛmen hɔn atamfo: Sɛ obi pɛ ahaw hɔn a, otwar dɛ woku no dɛm
Iyinom wɔwɔ tum dɛ wɔtow ɔsor mu ma nsu nntɔ wɔ hɔn nkɔnhyɛ nda no mu: Na wɔwɔ esu no do tum dɛ wɔdan bɔgya, na wɔdze ɔyardɔm biara bɔ asaase da biara a wɔpɛ.
Na sɛ wowie hɔn adasedzi a, abowa no a ofi mona a onnyi ntuadze mu no nye hɔn bedzi akõ, na oedzi hɔn do konyim, na oeku hɔn.
Na hɔn efun bɛdeda kurow kɛse no n'abrɔn mu, ɔno na sunsum mu wɔfrɛ no Sodom nye Egypt, mbrɛ wɔbɔɔ hɔn Ewuradze so mbeamudua mu no.
Na binom fi nkorɔfo nye mbusuakuw nye kasa nye aman mu bɔhwɛ hɔn efun ndaansa na fã, na wɔnnkɛma kwan ma wɔdze hɔn efun atoto nda mu.
Na hɔn a wɔtse asaase do hɔn enyiwa gye wɔ hɔn ho, na hɔn ahom kã hɔnho; na wɔbɛkyekyɛ hɔnho adze; osiandɛ nkɔnhyɛfo beenu yi haaw hɔn a wɔtse asaase do.
Na ndaansa na fã ekyir no nkwahom fi Nyankopɔn mu kɛhɛɛn hɔn mu, na wogyinagyinaa hɔn anan do; na hu kɛse kaã hɔn a wohun hɔn no,
Na wɔtsee ndze kɛse bi fi sor see hɔn dɛ, hom mbra ɔsor ha. Na wɔkɔr sor wɔ nsuwusiw no mu: Na hɔn atamfo hun hɔn.
Na dɔn no mu asaasewosow kɛse bae, na kurow ne nkyekyɛmu du mu kor hwee ase; na asaasewosow no kum nyimpa mpemesuon: Na nkaa no bɔɔ hu, na wɔhyɛɛ ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
Mbusu a otsīa ebien no ebotwa mu: Hwɛ, mbusu a otsīa ebiasa no reba ntsɛmara.
Na ɔbɔfo a otsīa esuon no hɛnee, na ndze akɛse gyegyegyegyee wɔ sor, na wɔsee dɛ, wiadze aHendzi abɛyɛ hɛn Ewuradze nye ne Christ dze: Na obedzi Hen mbersantsen mfesantsen.
Na mpanyimfo eduonu anan no a wɔtsetse hɔn ahengua do wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim no dze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu, na wɔkotoow Nyankopɔn,
see dɛ, yɛda wo ase, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, adze nyina do Tumfo a ewɔ hɔ dada, na ewɔ hɔ, osiandɛ afa wo tum kɛse no, na edzi Hen.

Na aman bo efuw, na w'ebufuw aba, nye w'ewufo ber no dɛ ibobu hɔn atsɛn, na edze w'akatua ama wo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no, nye ahotsewfo no, nye hɔn a wosuro wo dzin, akɛse nye nkakraba; na asɛɛ hɔn a wɔsɛɛ asaase no.
Na wobuee Nyankopɔn asɔrdan a ɔwɔ sor no; na wohun ahyɛmu adaka no wɔ asɔrdan no mu; na enyinam nye ndze, nye asenaman, nye asaasewosow, nye ɔsorbo kɛse bae.
12: Na wohun asɛnkyerɛdze kɛse bi wɔ sor: Ɔbaa a ofura ewia, na bosoom wɔ n'ananadze, na nworaba duebien aHenkyɛw wɔ n'etsifi;
na onyinsen: Na ɔrekeka mu rokõ awoo, na awoo no adzen no.
Na wohun asɛnkyerɛdze fofor bi so wɔ ɔsor; na hwɛ, dragon memen kokroko a ɔwɔ etsir esuon wowɔ n'etsifi,
Na no dua twee ɔsor nworaba nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor, na ɔtotowee guu asaase do. Na dragon no gyinaa ɔbaa no a ɔrobɔwo no enyim, na sɛ ɔwo a, ɔaamen ne ba no.
Na ɔwoo baba nyin a ɔdze dadze poma robɔhwɛ amanaman nyina do: Na wohwiim ne ba no kɔr Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, nye n'ahengua ho.
Na ɔbaa no guanee kɔr sar do mbrɛ Nyankopɔn esiesie beebi ama no, dɛ wɔnyɛn no wɔ hɔ nda apem ahaenu eduosia.
Na akodzi baa sor: Michael nye n'abɔfoe nye dragon no dzii akõ, na dragon nye n'abɔfoe no wɔkõe;
na woenntum hɔn, eso woennya tseanabea wɔ sor bio.
Na dragon kokroko no, ɔwɔ dadaw no a wɔfrɛ no Abɔnsam nye Satan no, wiadze nyina daadaafo no, wɔtoow no kyeen asaase, na wɔtoow n'bɔfoe kãa no ho gui.

Na metsee ndze kɛse bi wɔ sor dɛ, afei na hɛn Nyankopɔn nkwagye, nye ahoɔdzen, nye aHendzi nye ne Christ no tumdzi no aba: Osiandɛ wɔatow hɛn nuanom hɔn tõafo no akyen, ɔno a ɔtõatoa hɔn wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn enyim adzekyee nye adzesaa no.
Na wɔnam Eguambaa bɔgyaa, nye hɔn dasesɛm do dzii konyim; na wɔanndɔ hɔn nkwa araa dze kodur wu mu.
Dɛm ntsi hom sorsor, nye hom a hom tsetse no mu no ndzi dɛw. Na asaase nye po ndue: Osiandɛ abɔnsam dze ebufuw kɛse esian aba hom nkyɛn osiandɛ onyim dɛne ber a ɔwɔ yɛ tsia.
Na dragon no hun dɛ wɔatow no akyen asaase do no, ɔtaa ɔbaa no a ɔwoo ɔba no do.
Na wɔdze ɔkorpɔn ne ntsaban ebien no maa ɔbaa no, dɛ ɔmfa ntu nkɔ ne tsenabea wɔ sar no do, mbrɛ wɔbɛmema no ber tsia, nye mber, nye ber fã, efi ɔwɔ no enyim.
Na ɔwɔ no puuw n'anomu nsu dɛ esutsen guu ɔbaa no ekyir, dɛ ɔbɛma esu no afa no akɔ.
Na, asaase boaa ɔbaa no, na asaase buee n'anomu na ɔmeen esutsen no a dragon no puwii fii n'anomu no.
Na dragon no bo fuuw ɔbaa no; no okotuu n'asefo nkaa a wosie Nyankopɔn ahyɛdze, na wokura Jesus dasedzi mu no hɔn do sa:
13: Na okegyinaa mpoano anhwea do. Na muhun abowa bi dɛ ofi po mu reba a ɔwɔ mmbɛn du nye etsir esuon, na aHenkyɛw du soso ne mmbɛn, na ebusu edzin wowɔ n'etsir do,
Na abowa no a muhun no no tse dɛ ɔsebɔ, na ne nan tse dɛ sisi, na n'ano tse dɛ gyata: Na dragon no dze no tum, nye n'ahengua, nye ahoɔdzen kɛse maa no.
Na muhun n'etsir mu kor tse dɛ wɔabɔ no ɔbɔkum; na wɔayɛ no bɔkum fɛr no edur: Na abowa no ho yɛɛ wiadzefo nyina nwanwa,
na wɔkotowee sɔɔr dragon no, dɛ ɔdze no tum ama abowa no, na wɔkotowee sɔɔr abowa no see dɛ, woana nye abowa no sɛ? Na woana botum nye no edzi akõ?
na wɔmaa no ano a ɔkã nsɛnkɛse nye ebususɛm; na wɔmaa no kwan dɛ ondzi tum abosoom eduanan ebien.
Na obuee n'ano kãa ebususɛm tsiaa Nyankopɔn, dɛ ɔbɛkã ne dzin, nye ne ntamadan, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔtsetse sor noho no ebususɛm
Na wɔmaa no ho kwan dɛ ɔnye ahotsewfo no ndzi akõ, na ondzi hɔn do konyim: Na wɔmaa no tum wɔ mbusuakuw nye nkorɔfo, nye kasa nye aman nyina do.
Na hɔn a wɔtsetse asaase do nyina bɔkotow no, hɔn a wɔannkyerɛw hɔn edzin wɔ Eguambaa no a wofi wiadze ahyɛse kum no no no nwoma no mu no.
Sɛ obi wɔ aso a, wɔmma ontsie,
Sɛ obi dze kɔ ndɔmmum a, ndɔmmum na ɔbɔkɔ: Sɛ obi dze afõwa ku a, afõwa na wɔdze boku no. Ha na ahotsewfo abotar nye gyedzi wɔ.
Na muhun abowa bi so dɛ ofi asaase rupue; na ɔwɔ mmbɛn ebien dɛ eguambaa, na ɔkasaa dɛ dragon.
Na ɔdze abowa a odzi kan no no tum nyina wɔ n'enyim. Na ɔmaa asaase nye hɔn a wɔtsetse do kotoow abowa a odzi kan no a wɔyɛɛ no bɔkum fɛr edur no.
Na ɔyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze akɛse dɛ ɔma ogya mpo fi sor ba asaase do wɔ nyimpa enyim.
Na ɔdaadaa hɔn a wɔtsetse asaase do, wɔ nsɛnkyerɛdze a wɔdze maa no dɛ ɔnyɛ wɔ abowa no enyim ntsi: Ɔkã dɛ wɔnyɛ abowa no a afõwa piraa no, na ɔtse ase no no honyi.
Na wɔdze maa no dɛ ɔmfa ahom mma abowa no no honyi no, ma abowa no no honyi no aakasa, na ɔmma wonku dodow a wɔnnkɔkotow abowa no no honyi no.
Na ɔma wɔhyɛ, nkakraba nye akɛse, ahonyafo nye ehiafo, adehye nye nkowaa nsew wɔ hɔn nsa nyimfa, nye hɔn momapɔw do;
na eso dɛ obi nntum nntɔ anaa anntɔn, gyedɛ nyia ɔwɔ nsewhyɛ no, anaa abowa no ne dzin nkanee nko.
Ha na nyansa wɔ. Obi a ɔwɔ ntseasee, wɔmma ɔnkan abowa no ne nkanee dodow; na ɔyɛ nyimpa nkanee: Na ne nkanee si ahaesia eduosia esia.
14: Na mohwɛe, na hwɛ Eguambaa no gyina Zion bepɔw do, na mpemɔhaeduananan ka no ho a wɔakyerɛw ne dzin, nye Egya no ne dzin, wɔ hɔn momapɔw do.
Na metsee ndze fi sor dɛ esu pii nye senaman kɛse bi ndze: Na ndze no a metsee no tse dɛ asankubɔfo a wɔrobɔ hɔn nsanku:
na wɔtoow ndwom fofor bi wɔ ahengua no nye atseasefo anan no enyim: Na obiara enntum ndwom no sūa, gyedɛ mpemɔhaeduananan a wɔtɔɔ hɔn fii asaase no nko.

Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔammfa mbaa enngu hɔn ho fi, na wɔyɛ mbaabun. Iyinom na nye hɔn a wodzi Eguambaa no ekyir wɔ beebiara a ɔkɔ. Iyinom na wɔtɔɔ hɔn fii nyimpa mu yɛɛ aba kan maa Nyankopɔn nye Eguambaa no.
Na woennhu ator bi wɔ hɔn anomu: Na wonndzi dzɛm bi.
Na muhun ɔbɔfo bi so a orutu nam ɔsor finimfin a okura onnyiewiei asɛmpa bi rekɛkã akyerɛ hɔn a wɔtsetse asaase do, aman nye mbusuakuw nye kasa nye nkorɔfo;
na ɔdze ndze kɛse kãa dɛ, hom nsuro Nyankopɔn, na hom nhyɛ no enyimnyam; na n'atsɛmbu dɔn no edu: Na hom nkotow nyia ɔbɔɔ ɔsor nye asaase nye po nye nsunyiwa no.
Na ɔbɔfo bi so a otsīa ebien dzi ekyir see dɛ, Babylon kɛse no ahwe ase, ahwe ase, dza ɔama amanaman nyina anom no ndwamanyɛ ebufuw wenyin no bi.
Na ɔbɔfo bi so a otsīa ebiasa dzi hɔn ekyir, dze ndze kɛse see dɛ, sɛ obiara kotow abowa no nye no honyi, na ɔgye ne nsewhyɛ wɔ no momapɔw anaa ne nsa do a,
ɔno na ɔbɔnom Nyankopɔn ebufuw wenyin a wosiesie no gyenengyenen gu n'ebufuw kuraba mu no bi; na wɔbɛyɛ hɔn ayakayakadze, wɔ ogya nye brimstone mu, wɔ abɔfo krɔnkrɔn no nye Eguambaa no enyim:
Na hɔn ayakayakadze wusiw bɔfow sor mbersantsen mfesantsen; na hɔn a wɔkotow abowa no nye no honyi nye obiara a ɔgye ne dzin nsewhyɛ no, wonnyi ahomgye adzekyee nye adzesaa.
Ha na ahotsewfo abotar wɔ, hɔn a wosie Nyankopɔn ahyɛdze nye Jesus gyedzi no.
Na metsee ndze bi fi sor see me dɛ, kyerɛw, Ofitsi dze kɔ yi, nkyira nye ewufo a wowu Ewuradze mu; nyew, Sunsum no se, ama wɔaahom efi hɔn berɛ mu; na hɔn ndwuma dzi hɔn ekyir.
Na mohwɛe, na hwɛ, nsuwusiw fitaa, na obi a ɔtse dɛ nyimpa ba tse nsuwusiw no do a sika aHenkyɛw wɔ n'etsifi, na kantankrankye ndandam kura ne nsamu.
Na ɔbɔfo bi so fi asɔrdan no mu fiir edzi dze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu kyerɛɛ nyia ɔtse nsuwusiw no do no dɛ, tow wo kantankrankye twitwa: Na otwaber edu; na asaase do ndɔbaa eguan.
Na nyia ɔtse nsuwusiw do no dze ne kantankrankye toow asaase do; na wotwitwaa asaase do ahadze.
Na ɔbɔfo kɛse bi so fi sor asɔrdan no mu, na so kura kantankrankye ndandam.
Na ɔbɔfo kɛse bi so a ɔwɔ gya do tum fi afɔrmbukyia no no mu bae; na ɔdze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu frɛɛ nyia okura kantankrankye ndandam twitwa asaase wenyinaba nsiawnsiaw no; na ne wenyinaba ewie ber.
Na ɔbɔfo no dze ne kantankrankye toow asaase do, na otwitwaa asaase do wenyinaba na ɔdze guu Nyankopɔn ebufuw wenyintwer kɛse no mu.
Na wotsiatsiaa twer no do wɔ kurow no ekyir, na bɔgya fi wenyintwer no mu kãa mpɔnkɔ no hɔn menyiamfrɛ no mpo pemee kodur akwansimba apem ahaesia.
15: Na muhun asɛnkyerɛdze bi so a ɔsõ na ɔyɛ nwanwa wɔ sor, abɔfo esuon a wokura mbusuhaw esuon a odzi ewiei na hɔn mu na Nyankopɔn ebufuw ebua tun.
Na muhun biribi a ɔtse dɛ ahwehwɛ po a ogya fora mu, na hɔn a wodzii abowa no nye no hinyi, nye ne nsewhyɛ, nye ne dzin nkanee ho konyim no gyinagyina ahwehwɛ po no ho kurakura Nyankopɔn nsanku.
Na wɔtow Nyankopɔn akowaa Moses ndwom, nye Eguambaa no no ndwom, dɛ, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, adze nyina do Tumfo, wo ndwuma yɛ akɛse na ɔyɛ nwanwa; mbersantsen Hen, w'akwan tsen na ɔyɛ nokwar.
Ewuradze, woana na onnkosuro, na ɔnnkɛhyɛ wo dzin enyimnyan? Na wo nko na eyɛ krɔnkrɔn; na amanaman nyina bɛba abɔkotow w'enyim; osiandɛ wo ndzeyɛtsenenee ada edzi.
Na iyi ekyir mohwɛe, na hwɛ, woebue adasedzi-ntamadan asɔrdan no wɔ sor:
na abɔfo esuon a wokura mbusuhaw esuon fi asɔrdan no mu fiir edzi, wɔhyehyɛ ndwera fitafita a ɔhyerɛn dɛhyɛdɛhyɛ, na wɔdze sika abɔdo abodɔ hɔn koko.
Na atseasefo baanan no mu baako maa abɔfo esuon no sika nkuraba esuon a wɔdze Nyankopɔn a ɔtse ase mbersantsen mfesantsen no n'ebufuw ahyɛ mu mã.
Na wusiw a ofi Nyankopɔn enyimnyam nye no tum mu hyɛɛ asɔrdan no mã; na obi enntum annhɛn asɔrdan no mu dze kesii dɛ woewie abɔfo esuon no hɔn mbusuhaw esuon no ansaana.
16: Na metsee ndze kɛse bi a ofi asɔrdan no mu rese abɔfo esuon no dɛ, hom nkɔ nkohue Nyankopɔn ebufuw nkuraba esuon no ngu asaase do.
Na dza odzi kan no kɔree kohuee no kuraba guu asaase do, na ɔdaan kur mpɔtɔwee a ɔyɛ yaw wɔ nyimpa a wɔwɔ abowa no ne nsewhyɛ, na wɔkotoow no honyi no do.
Na dza otsia ebien no huee no kuraba guu po mu, na ɔdaan dɛ owufo bɔgyaa; na tseasefo biara wui, dza ɔwɔ po no mu.
Na dza otsia ebiasa no huee no kuraba guu esutsen nye nsunyiwa do, na ɔdaan bɔgya.
Na metsee dɛ esu bɔfo no rese dɛ, ɔtseneneenyi nye ɔwo a ewɔ hɔ, na ewɔ hɔ dada, ɔwo Krɔnkrɔnnyi, dɛ ebu atsɛn dɛm:
Osiandɛ wohuee ahotsewfo nye nkɔnhyɛfo no bɔgyaa gui, na ama hɔn bɔgya dɛ wɔnnom: Wɔfata dɛm.
Na metsee ndze bi so fi afɔrmbukyia no mu se dɛ, nyew, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, adze nyina do Tumfo, w'atsɛmbua yɛ nokwar nye tsenenee.
Na dza otsia anan no huee no kuraba guu ewia do; na wɔmaa no ahoɔdzen dɛ ɔmfa gya nhyehye myimpa.
Na wɔdze ɔhyew kɛse hyehyee nyimpa: Na wɔkãa Nyankopɔn a ɔwɔ tum wɔ dɛm mbusuhaw yi do no ne dzin ho ebususɛm na woennu hɔnho annhyɛ no enyimnyam.
Na dza otsia enum no huee no kuraba guu abowa no n'ahengua no do; na n'aHenman yɛɛ sum; na ɔyaw no ntsi wɔkekaa hɔn tɛkyerɛma,
na wɔkãa sor Nyankopɔn ho ebususɛm, wɔ hɔn yaw nye hɔn ekur no ntsi; na woennu hɔnho emmfi hɔn ndwuma mu.
Na dza otsia esia no huee no kuraba guu esutsen kɛse Euphrates mu; na no mu nsu wewee, ama woeesiesie kwan ama ahemfo a wofi wipuei no.
Na muhun esunsum fi ebiasa a wɔtse dɛ ntwer fi dragon no anomu, nye abowa no anomu, nye nkɔnkyɛnyi torfo no anomu:
Na wɔyɛ mbɔnsam esunsuma wɔyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze, na wofir kɔ wiadze nyina ahemfo hɔ, kɔboaboa hɔn ano ma Nyankopɔn, adze nyina do Tumfo, ne da kɛse kõ no.
(Hwɛ, mereba dɛ owifo. Nhyira nye onyia ɔweɔn, na osie ne ntar, amma ɔaanantsew adagyaw na woeennhu n'ahoto.)
Na wɔboaboaa hɔn ano kɔr beebi a wɔfrɛ no Hebrew kasa mu Har-Magedon.
Na dza otsia esuon no huee no kuraba guu ehumenyi; na ndze kɛse bi fi asɔrdan no mu ahengua no do bae dɛ, woewie:
na enyinam, nye ndze, nye asenaman bae; na asaase wosow kɛse bi bae a ofitsi ber a nyimpa baa asaase do wonnhun bi pɛn, asaasewosow kɛse a ɔyɛ dzen a.
Na kurow kɛse no mu paa afãafa ebiasa, na amanamamfo nkurow hwehwee ase: Na wɔkãa Babylon kɛse no wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim, dɛ wɔbɛma no n'ebufuw a ɔyɛ hyew no no wenyin kuraba.
Na nsupɔw nyina guanguanee, na woennhu mbepɔw.
Na ɔsorbo a kor no dur bɛyɛ talent kor, fi sor bɔhwehwee nyimpa do: Na nyimpa kasaa Nyankopɔn ho ebususɛm, wɔ ɔsorbo no ne haw ntsi: Osiandɛ ne haw no sõ kɛse.
17: Na abɔfo beesuon no a wokurakura nkuraba esuon no mu baako bae nye me bɛkasae, dɛ, Bra ha, ma menkyerɛ wo edwaman kɛse no a ɔtse esu pii do no n'atsɛmbu;
ɔno na asaase do ahemfo nye no agor ndwamangor, na no ndwaman wenyin abobow hɔn a wɔtsetse asaase do no.
Na ɔdze me nam Sunsum mu kɔr sar do: Na muhun ɔbaa bi a ɔtse abowa memen bi do, na ebususɛm edzin ahyɛ no mã, na ɔwɔ etsir esuon nye mmbɛn du.
Na ɔbaa no hyɛ atar serdaa nye memen, na wɔahyehyɛ no sika nye aboɔdzen bo, nye ahondze pa, na okura sika kuraba a ekyiwadze nye no ndwamanyɛ fi ahyɛ no mã,
na wɔakyerɛw dzin bi wɔ no momapɔw do dɛ, ESUMASƐM, BABYLON KƐSE, NDWAMAN NYE ASAASE DO EKYIWADZE NE NÃ.
Na muhun ɔbaa no dɛ ahotsewfo no bɔgyaa nye Jesus atɔfo bɔgyaa abow no. Na muhunuu no, ɔyɛɛ me nwanwa kɛse.
Na ɔbɔfo no see me dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na ɔyɛ wo nwanwa? Mebɛkã wo ɔbaa no nye abowa a ɔso no a ɔwɔ etsir esuon nye mmbɛn du no ho esumasɛm no.

Abowa no a ihunii no no, nkyɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na onnyi hɔ, na oribefi bun no mu aba, na ɔaka ɔsɛɛ mu. Na ɔbɛyɛ hɔn hɔn a wɔtsetse asaase a woemmfi wiadze ahyɛse annkyerɛw hɔn edzin wɔ nkwa nwoma no mu no nwanwa, dɛ wobohu abowa no a nkyɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na onnyi hɔ, na ɔbɛba no.
Eha na adwen a ɔwɔ nyansa wɔ. Etsir esoun no yɛ mbepɔw esuon a ɔbaa no tse do:
na wɔyɛ ahemfo esuon; na beenum ahwe ase, na ɔbaako wɔ hɔ, na ɔbaako no so nnyae hɔ kakraabi.
Na abowa no a nkyɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na onnyi hɔ no, ɔnoara nye nyia otsia awɔtwe, na ofi esuon no mu, na ɔrokɔ ɔsɛɛ mu.
Na mmbɛn du no a ihunii no, wɔyɛ ahemfo du a wonnyae nnyaa aHendzi; naaso wɔnye abowa no nya tum dɛ ahemfo dɔnhwer kor.

Iyinom na wɔnye Eguambaa no bedzi akõ, na Eguambaa no bedzi hɔn do konyim, osiandɛ ɔno nye ewuranom Wura, nye ahemfo Hen; na hɔn a wɔafrɛ hɔn, wɔka no ho. 15, Na ɔsee me dɛ, Esu no a ihun dɛ ɔbaa no tse do no yɛ nkorɔfo nye nyimpadodow, nye aman, nye kasa.
Na mmbɛn du no a ihunii no, nye abowa no, hɔn na wobekyir edwaman no, na wɔato no seraha, na wɔato no etumpan, na woedzi ne nam, na wɔdze ogya ahyew no koraa.
Na Nyankopɔn dze hyɛɛ hɔn akoma mu dɛ wɔnyɛ ne tsirmsɛm, na wɔnyɛ adwenkor, na tsirmsɛm, na wɔnyɛ adwenkor, na wɔmfa hɔn aHenman mma abowa no nkesi dɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm no bɛba mu.
Na ɔbaa no a ihun no no nye kurow kɛse no a odzi Hen wɔ asaase ahemfo do no.
18: Iyinom ekyir muhun ɔbɔfo bi so a ofi sor risian ba a ɔwɔ ahoɔdzen kɛse; na n'enyimnyam hyerɛɛn asaase do.
Na ɔdze ndze a ɔyɛ dzen tsēaa mu dɛ, ɔahwe ase, Babylon kɛse no ahwe ase, na adan mbɔnsam tsenabea, nye sunsum fi nyina efiadze, nye nnoma a hɔn ho nntsew na hɔn ho yɛ nkɔw efiadze.
Osiandɛ no ndwamanyɛ ebufuw wenyin na ama aman nyina ahwehwe ase; na asaase do ahemfo nye no agor ndwamangor, na wiadze eguadzifo nam n'adɔkɔdɔkɔdzepɛ ahoɔdzen do enya hɔnho.
Na metsee dɛ ndze bi so fi sor rese dɛ, me man, hom mfi no mu mfi, mma hom aammfora no bɔn, na hom nsa aannkã no mbusuhaw no bi:
Na ne ndzebɔn atsen ekodu sor mpo, na Nyankopɔn akaa n'emumuyɛ.
Hom ntua no kaw dɛ mbrɛ otuae, hom mfa mbɔho ebien mma no dɛ mbrɛ no ndwuma tse: Kuraba a ɔforae no, hom mmfora no mbɔhho ebien mma no.
Dodow a ɔhyehyɛɛ no ho na ɔyɛɛ adɔkɔdɔkɔdzepɛ no, hom mma no ɔhaw nye awerɛhow dɛmara: Ha ɔkã wɔ n'akoma mu dɛ, metse hɔ dɛ ɔhembaa, mennyɛ okunafo, murunnhu awerɛhow ara da.
Dɛm ntsi no mbusuhaw bɛba da kor mu, owu nye awerɛhow nye ɔkɔm: Na wɔdze gya bɛhyew no koraa, osiandɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn a obu no atsɛn no ɔyɛ ɔhoɔdzenfo.
Na asaase ahemfo a wɔnye no yɛɛ edwaman no wɔnye no tsenaa adɔkɔdɔkɔdzepɛ mu no, sɛ wohu ne hyew no wusiw a, wobosū akã mmɔn,
egyinagyina ekyir wɔ no mbusuhaw no hu ntsi, dɛ, due, due kurow kɛse Babylon, kurow a ɔyɛ dzen! Osiandɛ dɔnhwer kor mu na w'atsɛmbu aba.
Na asaase do eguadzifo sū no dzi no nkɔmbɔ, osiandɛ obi nntɔ hɔn eguaadze bio;

sika, nye dwetɛ, nye aboɔdzen bo nye ahondze pa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw, nye serdaa tam; nye serekye, nye memen; nye thyine dua nyina; nye asombɛn edwindze nyina, nye ndwindze a wɔdze ndua a ɔsom bo, nye ayewa, nye dadze, nye ɔbohɛn ayɛ nyina;

nye cinnamon, nye mpɛpɛerwa, nye nduhuam, nye nseradza, nye krɔbɔw, nye wenyin, nye ngo, nye isiam fekɔɔ, nye ewifua, nye nnyɛmbowa, nye nguan, nye mpɔnkɔ, nye ntseaseanam, nye ntanyi, nye nyimpa akra.
Na nduaba a wo kra kɔn dɔe no efi wo nkyɛn, na w'anomudɛdze nye wo ndzepa efi wo nkyɛn ahera, na worunnhu bio koraa.
Na ndzɛmba yi ho eguadzifo a ɔmaa wonyaa hɔnho no begyinagyina ekyir wɔ ne haw no hu ntsi, na woesū na woedzi nkɔmbɔ;
dɛ, Due, due, kurow kɛse a ofuraa ndwera pa, nye serdaa nye memen, na ɔhyehyɛ sika nye aboɔdzen bo, nye ahondze pa!
osiandɛ dɔnhwer kor pɛ mu na dɛm ahonya kɛse yi ayɛ amamfõ. Na hɛnwura biara nye hɔn a wɔnam hɛn mu kɔ beebi nyina, nye hɛnmufo, nye dodow a wɔyɛ po do edwuma, gyinagyinaa ekyirkyir,
na wohun ne hyew no no wusiw no, wɔtsēaa mu dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ɔtse dɛ kurow kɛse yi?

Na wotuu dɛtse guu hɔn etsifi, na wɔdze osū nye nkɔmbɔdzi tsēaa mu dɛ, due, due, kurow kɛse a w'boɔdzendze ntsi hɔn a wɔwɔ hɛn wɔ po do nyina enyinya hɔnho wɔ mu! Osiandɛ dɔnhwer kor pɛ mu na wɔayɛ no amamfõ.
Ɔsor, dzi no eduwa, nye hom ahotsewfo, nye asomafo, nye nkɔnhyɛfo; osiandɛ Nyankopɔn ebu no hom atsɛn.
Na ɔbɔfo baako hoɔdzenfo bi maa ɔbo a ɔtse dɛ ewuyambo kɛse bi do, na ɔtowee kyeen po mu, dɛ, mbrɛ wɔbɔtow Babylon, kurow kɛse no akyɛn hwii nye no, na worunnhu no bio koraa.
Na wɔrenntse asankubɔfo, nye ndwontofo, nye mbɛnhɛmfo, nye totorobɛntohɛmfo ndze wɔ wo mu bio; na worunnhu edwindzi biara ho dwimfo wɔ wo mu bio; na wɔrenntse ewuyambo nka wɔ wo mu bio;
na ɔkandzea kan rennhyerɛn wɔ wo mu bio, na wɔrenntse ayeforkun nue ayefor ndze wɔ wo mu bio: W'eguadzifo yɛɛ asaase do ahemfo; osiandɛ edze w'abayisɛm daadaa aman nyina.
Na no mu na wohun nkɔnhyɛfo, nye ahotsewfo, nye hɔn a woeku hɔn asaase do nyina hɔn bɔgyaa.
19: Iyinomekyir no metsee biribi tse dɛ nyimpadodow ndze kɛse wɔ sor dɛ. Alleluia; nkwagye, nye enyimnyam, nye ahoɔdzen yɛ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn dze:
Osiandɛ n'atsɛmbu yɛ nokwar na ɔtsen; na oebu edwaman kɛse a ɔdze no ndwamanyɛ asɛɛ asaase no atsɛn, na oedzi no nkowaa bɔgyaa ho wer wɔ ne nsamu.
Na wɔsee bio dɛ, Alleluia. Na no wusiw fow sor mbersantsen mfesantsen.
Na mpanyimfo eduonu anan no nye atseasefo anan no hwee ase kotoow Nyankpoɔn a ɔtse ahengua no no do no dɛ, Amen; Alleluia.
Na ndze bi fi ahengua no no mu see dɛ, Hom nyi Nyankpoɔn ayɛw, hom a hom yɛ no nkowaa, nye hom a hom suro no nyina, akɛse nye nkakraba.
Na metsee biribi dɛ nyimapadodow kɛse ndze, nye esu pii ndze, nye asenaman pii a ɔyɛ dzen ndze, dɛ, Alleluia osiandɛ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn, adze nyina do Tumfo no, dzi Hen.
Hom mma yendzi dɛw na hɛn enyi ngye mbordo, na hom mma yɛmfa enyimnyam ahyɛ no, na Eguambaa no n'ayeforhyia no edu, na ne yer esiesie noho.
Na wɔmaa no dɛ omfura ndwera fɛɛfɛw a ɔhoa fitaa: Na ndwera fɛɛfɛw no nye ahotsewfo no ndzeyɛtsenenee.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, kyerɛw, Nhyira nye hɔn a woehyia hɔn Eguambaa no n'ayeforase. Na ɔsee me dɛ, iyinom yɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm a ɔyɛ nokwar.
Na mohwee ase wɔ n'ananadze dɛ morokotow no. Na ɔsee me dɛ, hwɛ, mma nnyɛ dɛm: Meyɛ w'ewurakowaa nye wo nuanom a wokura Jesus dase mu no dze: Kotow Nyankopɔn: Na Jesus dase nye nkɔnhyɛ sunsum no.
Na muhun dɛ sor ebue; na hwɛ, ɔpɔnkɔ fufuw, nye nyia ɔtse no do no, wɔfrɛ no ɔsenkordzifo nye Nokwafo; na obu atsɛn na odzi akõ wɔ nokwar mu.
Na n'enyiwa tse dɛ gyaframee, na nHenkyɛw pii soso n'etsifi, na wɔakyerɛw ne dzin bi a obiara nnyim dɛ ɔno nko.
Na ɔhyɛ atar bi a wɔdze abɔ bɔgya mu: Na ne dzin dze Nyankopɔn asɛm.
Na dɔm a wɔwɔ sor tsetse mpɔnkɔ efufuw do dzi n'ekyir, hyehyɛ ndwera pa a ɔhoa fitaa.
Na afõwa ndandam fi n'anomu fir a ɔdze rubotwitwa amanaman: Na ɔdze dadze poma bɔhwɛ hɔn do na ɔno na otsiatsia Nyankopɔn adze nyina do Tumfo no n'ebufuhyew wenyintwer no do.
Na ɔwɔ dzin bii a wɔakyerɛw no ne ntar do nye n'aserɛ do, AHEMFO Hen, NYE EWURANOM EWURADZE.
Na muhun ɔbɔfo baako a ogyina ewia mu: Na ɔdze ndze kɛse tsēaa mu see nnoma a wotu nam sor finimfin no nyina dɛ, Hom mbra mbehyia Nyankopɔn edzidzi kɛse no ase;
na hom mbedzi ahemfo nam, nye asafohemfo nam, nye ahoɔdzenfo nam, nye mpɔnkɔ nye hɔn a wɔtsetse do hɔn nam, ne nyimpa nyinara hɔn nam, adehye nye nkowaa, akɛse nye nkakraba.
na muhun dɛ abowa no, nye asase do ahemfo, nye hɔn dɔm, aboaboa hɔn ano sɛ wɔnye nyia ɔtse ɔpɔnkɔ no do nye no dɔm ribedzi akõ

Na wɔkyeer abowa no, nye nkɔnhyɛnyi torfo no a ɔyɛɛ n'enyim nsɛnkyerɛdze dze daadaa hɔn a wɔgyee abowa no ne nsewhyɛ, nye hɔn a wɔkotoow no honyi: wɔtoow hɔn beenu enyimon guu ogya nsutaae a brimstone dzew mu nu mu:
na nkaa no wɔdze nyia ɔtse pɔnkɔ no do a'afōwa a ofi n'anomu kunkum hɔn, na nnoma no nyina dzii hɔn nam mee.
20: Na muhun ɔbɔfo bi dɛ ofi sor risian a okura bun no ne saafee na nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn kɛse wɔ ne nsamu.
Na ɔkyeer dragon no, ɔwɔ dadaw no a ɔno nye Abɔnsam nye Satan no, na ɔkyekyeer no mfe apem,
na ɔtoow no kyeen bun no mu, na ɔtoow no mu, na ɔsɔɔw ano wɔ no do, mma ɔaannkɛdaadaa aman no bio, gyedɛ mfe apem no asõ ana: na ɔno ekyir otwar dɛ wɔsan no mber kakra.

Na muhun nHengua, na wɔtsenatsenaa do, na wɔdze atsɛmbu maa hɔn: Na muhun hɔn a wotwitwaa hɔn etsir wɔ Jesus dasedzi, nye hɔn a wɔannkotow abowa no, anaa no honyi, na wɔanngye nsewhyɛ no wɔ hɔn momapɔw nye hɔn nsa do no; na wɔtsenaa ase nye Christ dzii Hen mfe apem.
Na ewufo nkaa no dze, woennya nkwa bio dze kodur dɛ mfe apem no bowie du. Iyi nye owusoɛr a odzi kan no,
Nhyira nye krɔnkrɔn nye onyia no a onya kyɛfa wɔ owusoɛr a odzi kan no mu: Woyi na owu mprɛnu no nnyi hɔn do tum; na wɔbɛyɛ Nyankopɔn nye Christ asɔfo, na wɔnye no edzi Hen mfe apem.
Na sɛ mfe apem no wie du a, wɔbɛsan Satan efi n'efiadze,
na obefir edzi akɛdaadaa amanaman a wɔwɔ asaase mfɛndzanan no, Gog nye Magog, akɔboaboa hɔn ano akɔ sa: Hɔn na hɔn dodow tse dɛ mpoano anhwea.
Na wɔfowee kegyinaa asaase tɛtɛr do, na wokotwaa ahotsewfo nseraban nye kurow a wɔdɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn bɛhyeew hɔn
Na abɔnsam a ɔdaadaa hɔn no, wɔtoow no kyeen gya nye brimstone nsutaae no mu, hɔ na abowa no nye nkɔnhyɛnyi torfo no so wɔ; na wɔbɛyɛ hɔn ayaayaadze adzekyee nye adzesaa mbersantsen mfesantsen.
Na muhun ahengua fufuw kokroko, nye nyia ɔtse do no a asaase nye ɔsor fii n'enyim guanee; na woennya beebi amma hɔn.

Na muhun ewufo, nkakraba nye akɛse, dɛ wogyinagyina ahengua no enyim; na woebuebue nwoma mu: Na woebue nwoma bi so a ɔyɛ nkwa nwoma no mu: Na wɔnam dza wɔakyerɛw wɔ nwoma no mu no do buu wufo no atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndwuma tse.
Na po yii ewufo a wɔwɔ no mu mae; na owu nye samanadze yii ewufo a wɔwɔ hɔn mu mae, na wobuu hɔn mu biara atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndwuma tse.
Na wɔtoow owu nye samanadze guu ogya nsutaae no mu. Iyi nye owu mprɛnu no.
Na obiara a woennhu no dɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nkwa nwoma no mu no, wɔtoow no kyeen ogya nsutaae no mu.
21: Na muhun sor fofor nye asaase fofor: Na kan sor no, nye kan asaase no etwa mu kɔ, na po nnyi hɔ bio.
Na muhun kurow krɔnkrɔn, Jerusalem fofor no, dɛ ofi sor Nyankopɔn nkyɛn risian, woesiesie no dɛ ayefor a wɔahyehyɛ no ama no kun.
Na metsee ndze kɛse bi fi ahengua no mu see dɛ, hwɛ, Nyankopɔn ntamadan wɔ hɔn mu, na wɔayɛ ne man, na Nyankopɔn nankasa nye hɔn bɛtsena, na ɔayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn:
na ɔbɛpepa hɔn enyiwa mu nyinsuwa nyina; na owu nnyi hɔ bio; na awerɛhow, nye sū, nye yaw bi nnyi hɔ bio: Osiandɛ nkan no ndzɛmba no etwa mu.
Na nyia ɔtse ahengua do no see dɛ, hwɛ, meyɛ adze nyina fofor. Na ɔsee me dɛ; kyerɛw: Na nsɛm no yɛ ampa nye nokwar.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, ayɛ hɔ. Emi nye Alpha nye Omega, ahyɛse nye ewiei. Emi na medze nkwa nsubura no mu nsu mebɛkyɛ onyia nsukɔm dze no kwa.
Nyia odzi konyim no, obenya iyinom edzi; na mebɛyɛ ne Nyankopɔn, na ɔno so ayɛ me ba.
Na ehufo, nye ekyingyefo, nye ekyidzifo, nye ewudzifo, nye ndwaman, nye abayifo, nye abosonsɔrfo, nye atorfo nyina, hɔn kyɛfa wɔ nsutaae a ogya nye brimstone dzɛw mu no mu; ɔno nye owu mprɛnu no.
Na abɔfo beesuon a wokurakura nkuraba esuon no a wɔdze mbusuhaw esuon a odzi ekyir no ahyɛ mu no mu baako baa me nkyɛn nye me bɛkasaa dɛ, Bra ha, na menkyerɛ wo ayefor no, Eguambaa no ne yer no.
Na ɔdze me Sunsum mu kɔr bepɔw kɛse tsentsen bi do, na ɔkyerɛɛ me kurow krɔnkrɔn Jerusalem, dɛ ofi sor Nyankopɔn nkyɛn risian,
ɔdze Nyankopɔn enyimnyam: Ne kan tse dɛ ɔbo a ɔsom bo kɛse dze, dɛ jasper bo a ɔtsew dɛ ahwehwɛ:
Ɔwɔ fasu kɛse tsentsen; ɔwɔ mbobow akɛse duebien; na wɔakyerɛkyerɛw edzin a ɔyɛ Israel mbusuakuw duebien no edzin wowɔ do:
Boka, mbobow ebiasa: Kwaamu, mbobow ebiasa; pomu, mbobow ebiasa; anee, mbobow ebiasa.
Na ɔfasu no no wɔ mfapem duebien, na Eguambaa no n'asomafo duebien no edzin duebien wowɔ do.
Na nyia ɔnye me kasae no kura susudua a ɔyɛ sika ndzɛmbir a ɔdze rubosusu kurow no, nye no mbobow, nye n'afasu.
Na kurow no da etwaanan, na ne tsentsen sõ dɛ ne tɛtɛr: Na ɔdze ndzɛmbir no susuu kurow no akwansin apem ahaenum: Ne tsentsen nye ne tɛtɛr nye no krɔn sɛ.
Na osusuu n'afasu no, basafa ɔha eduanan anan dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa no nsusui, ɔnye dɛ ɔbɔfo no dze tse.
Na dza wɔdze toow ne fasu nye jasper bo: Na kurow no yɛ sika mapa dɛ ahwehwɛ a ɔtsew.
Na wɔdze aboɔdzen bo horow nyina ahyehyɛ kurow no ne fasu fapem no: Fapem a odzi kan yɛ Jasper; otsia ebien yɛ sapphire; otsia ebiasa, chalcedony; otsia anan, emerald;
otsia enum, sardonyɛ; otsia esia, sardius; otsia esuon, chrysolyte; otsia awɔtwe, beryl; otsia akron, topaz; otsia du, chrysoprasus; otsia dubiako, jacinth; otsia duebien, amethyst.
Na mbobow duebien no yɛ ahondze pa duebien; abobow kor wɔdze ahondze pa kor yɛe: Na kurow no n'abrɔn yɛ sika mapa tse dɛ ahwehwɛ a ɔtsew.
Na mennhu asɔrdan wɔ mu: na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, adze nyina do Tumfo no, nye Eguambaa no na wɔyɛ n'asɔrdan.
Na kurow no nnhia dɛ ewia anaa bosoom hyerɛn wɔ do: Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam hyerɛɛn wɔ do, na ne nkandzea nye Eguambaa no.
Na amanaman bɛnantsew ne kan mu: Na asaase ahemfo dze hɔn enyimnyam ba mu.
Na wɔronntow kurow no mu adzekyee, (na adzesaa nnyi hɔ bio):
Na wɔdze amanaman enyimnyam nye enydzi bɛba mu:
Na efifidze biara nye dza ɔyɛ ekyiwadze na odzi ator rennhɛn mu koraa: Gyedɛ hɔn a wɔakyerɛw hɔn edzin wɔ Eguambaa no nkwa nwoma no mu no.
22: Na ɔkyerɛɛ me nkwa nsu esutsen krɔnkrɔn a n'enyi tsew dɛ ahwehwɛ a ofi Nyankopɔn nye Eguambaa no n'ahengua no mu,
ɔwɔ n'abɔntsen finimfin. Na esutsen n'afa ha na ha na nkwadua no wɔ a ɔsow eduaba horow duebien, na ɔsow aba bosoom nyina: Na dua no n'ahaban wɔdze sa amanaman yarba.
Na ndom biara nnyi hɔ bio: Na Nyankopɔn nye Eguambaa no ahengua besi mu: Na no nkowaa bɔsom no:
Na wobohu n'enyim: na ne dzin wɔ hɔn momapɔw do.
Na adzesaa nnyi hɔ bio: Na wonnhia kandzea anaa ewia ne kan: Osiandɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn bɛhyerɛn hɔn do; na wobedzi Hen mbersantsen mfesantsen.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, nsɛm yi yɛ ampa nye nokwar: Na Ewuradze, nkɔnhyɛfo esunsum hɔn Nyankopɔn no, asoma no bɔfoe dɛ ɔmbɛkyerɛ n'akowaa dza otwar dɛ ɔba mu ntsɛm.
Na hwɛ, mereba ntsɛm; nhyira nye nyia osie nwoma yi mu nkɔnhyɛnsɛm no.
Na emi John nye nyia ɔtsee na ohun ndzɛmba yi. Na metsee na muhunii no, mohwee ase dɛ morokotow ɔbɔfo a ɔkyerɛɛ me ndzɛmba yi n'anan ase.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, mma nnyɛ dɛm; na meyɛ w'ewurakowaa nye wo nuanom nkɔnhyɛfo, nye hɔn a wosie nwoma yi mu nsɛm no dze: Kotow sɔr Nyankopɔn.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, mma nnsɔw nwoma yi mu nkɔnhyɛnsɛm no ano: Na ber no edu.
Nyia ɔnntsen no, ɔnda ho ara nyɛ dza ɔnntsen: Na nyia ɔyɛ fifi, ɔnda ho nyɛ fifi: Na nyia ɔtsen no, ɔnda ho nyɛ dza ɔtsen: Na nyia ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn no, ɔnda ho nyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Hwɛ, mereba ntsɛm: Medze m'akatua dɛ medze rebɛma obiara dɛ mbrɛ no ndwuma tse.
Emi nye Alpha nye Omega, ahyɛse nye ewiei no, ɔkandzifo nye ekyidzifo.
Nhyira nye hɔn a wɔhor hɔn ntar, na woeenya nkwadua no ho kwan, na wɔaahɛn mbobow no mu akɔ kurow no mu.
Na n'ekyir na nkraman, nye abayifo, nye ndwaman, nye ewudzifo, nye abosonsɔrfo, nye obiara a ɔpɛ na odzi ator wɔ.
Emi, Jesus, na mosoma mo bɔfoe dɛ ombedzi ndzɛmba yi ho dase nkyerɛ hom mma asɔr horow no. Emi na meyɛ David ndwow nye aba, adzekyee woraba a ɔhyerɛn no.
Na Sunsum nye ayefor no se, Bra. Na nyia ɔtse, ɔnse dɛ, Bra. Na nyia nsukɔm dze no ɔmbra: Obi a ɔpɛ, ɔmbra mbɛfa nkwa nsu no kwa.
Midzi obiara a ɔtse nwoma yi mu nkɔnhyɛnsɛm no dase dɛ, sɛ obiara dze bi kã ho a, Nyankopɔn dze mbusuhaw a wɔakyerɛw no nwoma yi mu no bi bɛkã no ho:
Na sɛ obiara yi nwoma yi mu nkɔnhyɛnsɛm no bi a, Nyankopɔn beyi ne kyɛfa efi nkwadua, nye kurow krɔnkrɔn a wɔakyerɛw no nwoma yi mu no mu.
Nyia odzi ndzɛmba yi ho dase no se, Ampaara: Mereba ntsɛm. Amen. Ewuradze Jesus, bra.
Ewuradze Jesus adom nye ahotsewfo no ntsena. Amen

1: Paul, Jesus Christ akowaa, ɔsomafo a wɔafrɛ no na woeyi no esi nkyɛn ama Nyankopɔn asɛmpa a.
Ɔnam no nkɔnhyɛfo no do dzii kan bɔɔ anohoba wɔ kyerɛwsɛm krɔnkrɔn no mu,
wɔ ne Ba ho, nyia wɔwoo no David asenyi wɔ honma afamu,
Na woyii no kyerɛɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn Ba wɔ tum mu, wɔ ahotsewee sunsum afamu, ɔnam ewufo mu soɛr do; Jesus Christ hɛn Ewuradze a,
yɛnam no do enya adom nye asomafodwuma akɔ gyedzi setsie mu wɔ amanaman nyina mu, wɔ ne dzin ntsi:
hɔn mu na hom so wɔ, hom a Jesus Christ afrɛ hom ayɛ nedze:
Ɔdze kɛma hɔn a wɔwɔ Rome nyina, Nyankopɔn n'adɔfo, ahotsewfo a wɔafrɛ hɔn: Adom nye asomdwee a ofi hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Christ hɔ nkã hom.
Dza odzi hɛn nye dɛ menam Jesus Christ do da me Nyankopɔn ase wɔ hom nyina ntsi, osiandɛ wɔkã hom gyedzi ho asɛm wɔ wiadze nyina.
Na me dasefo nye Nyankopɔn a mosom no mo sunsum mu wɔ ne Ba n'asɛmpa no mu, mbrɛ minngyaa hom dzin bɔ da,
na meserɛ wɔ m'asɔryɛ mu daa dɛ bi a da bi Nyankopɔn pɛ a, ongya me kwan pa ma membra hom nkyɛn.
Na m'enyi gyina dɛ muhu hom, ma meeyi sunsum mu akyɛdze bi mama hom, ama hom eetsintsim:
Ɔnye dɛ yɛnam homankasa hom gyedzi na emi medze so do hɛn nyina eenya awerɛkyekyer wɔ hom mu.
Na eso, enuanom, memmpɛ dɛ misiw hom do dɛ mpɛn pii nye yi a mabɔ me tsirmu pɔw dɛ mebɛda hom nkyɛn, (na woesiw me kwan ebodu sesei) ama meenya hom so hom mu aba bi, dɛ amanamamfo nkaa no so.
Meyɛ kafonyi ma Greekfo nye Apɔtɔfo nyina, enyansafo nye nkwasea nyina.
Dɛm ntsi, m'afamu dze a, mayɛ krado dɛ mebɛkã asɛmpa no makyerɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ Rome so.
Na m'enyi nntõ Christ asɛmpa no ho, osiandɛ ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn tum a ɔdze kɔ nkwagye mu ma hɔn a wɔgye dzi nyina, Jewfo kan, ɔnye Greekfo so.
Na no mu na woyi Nyankopɔn tsenenee bo edzi, fi gyedzi mu kɔ gyedzi mu: Dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ, ɔtseneneenyi nam gyedzi do benya nkwa.
Na wofi sor ada Nyankopɔn ebufuw no edzi etsia nyimpa a wɔdze brakyew siw nokwar no kwan no hɔn emumuyɛ nye hɔn brakyew nyina;
Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn ho dza wohu a ɔyɛ no da hɔ pefee wɔ hɔn mu: Na Nyankopɔn na oeyi akyerɛ hɔn.
Osiandɛ no ho adze a wonnhu no, ofitsi wiadze no bɔ do da hɔ pefee, wɔnam ndzɛmba a wɔayɛ do dze adwen hu mu, mekyerɛ no tum a onnyi ewiei nye ne nyamesu no; ma dɛm ntsi woeenya anoyi,
osiandɛ wohun Nyankopɔn no, wɔannhyɛ no enyimnyam dɛ Nyankopɔn, eso wɔannda no ase; na mbom wɔyeyɛɛ gyan wɔ hɔn nsusui mu, na hɔn akoma a ntseasoe nnyi mu no hyɛɛ sum.
Wɔse wɔyɛ enyansafo no, wɔdaan nkwasea,
na wɔsakyeer Nyankopɔn a ɔmmprɔw n'enyimnyam yɛɛ nyimpa a ɔprɔw no honyi saso, nye ntumbowa, nye mbowa a wotsia ntwɛr-nam, nye aweaweambowa dze.
Dɛm ntsi Nyankopɔn yii hɔn maa efifidze wɔ hɔn akoma akɔndɔ mu, dɛ wɔmbɔ hɔn nyimpadua adapaa wɔ hɔn mu,
Osiandɛ wɔsesãa Nyankopɔn no nokwar no gyee ator, na wɔfɛree, na wɔsoom abɔdze seen Bɔadze: Ɔno na woehyira no daa; Amen.
Dɛm ntsi Nyankopɔn yii hɔn maa enyimguase akɔndɔ nhyɛdo mu: Na hɔn mbaa dze hɔn nyɛbea a ɔsɛ hɔn suban sesãe gyee dza otsia hɔn suban;

Dɛmara so na hɔn mbarimba so gyaa ɔbaa ho nyɛbea a ɔfata hɔn suban, dzedzɛwee wɔ hɔn akɔndɔ mu wɔ hɔnho nkorkor, mbarimba nye mbarimba yɛɛ adapaadze, na wonyaa akatua a ɔfata hɔn mfom wɔ hɔnankasa hɔn mu.
Na dɛ mbrɛ wɔammpen dɛ wɔbɔkora Nyankopɔn wɔ hɔn nyimdzee mu no, Nyankopɔn gyaa hɔn maa adwen a ɔmmfora, dɛ wɔnyɛ dza ɔmmfata:
brakyew nyina hyɛɛ hɔn mã, emumuyɛ, enyiber, ɔyamugya; nyitan, ewudzi, ndzebɔ, ndaadaa, subea bɔn;
wɔyɛ asotufo, nsekubɔfo, nyame-tamfo, ntsɛntsɛmfo, nkontompɔfo, ahotufo, ndzebɔn-fabafo, awofo do asoɔdzenfo,
wonnyi tsir, ahyɛmutofo, wonnyi dɔ, wonnyi ehumbɔbɔr:
Hɔn na wonyim Nyankopɔn amambu, dɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛm ndzɛmba yi owu sɛ hɔn, naaso nnyɛ yɛ nko na wɔyɛ, na wɔpen hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛ ndzɛmba so.
2: Dɛm ntsi, ɔwo nyimpa a ibu atsɛn, anoyi bi nnyi hɔ mma wo, na dza ibu obi atsɛn wɔ mu no ibu wankasa woho fɔ; osiandɛ ɔwo a ibu atsɛn no, eyɛ adze kor no ara.
Na yenyim dɛ Nyankopɔn atsɛmbu tse dɛ mbrɛ nokwar tse wɔ hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛm ndzɛmba no do.
Na ɔwo, nyimpa a ibu hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛm ndzɛmba atsɛn, na eyɛ dɛmara, ana isusu dɛ ibefi Nyankopɔn atsɛmbu nsa?
Anaaso immbu n'ayamuyie nye tartweɔn nye penkyɛr ahonya bi, dɛ innyim dɛ Nyankopɔn ayamuyie rigya wo akɔ nnuho mu?
Na w'akoma dzendzen a ɔmmpɛ dɛ ɔsakyer ntsi, eroboaboa ebufuw ano ma woho wɔ ebufuw nye Nyankopɔn atsɛmbu tsenenee ne nyikyerɛ da no?
Ɔno na obosusu ama nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ no ndwuma tse:
hɔn a wɔdze papayɛ mu abotar hwehwɛ enyimnyam nye enyidzi, nye dza ɔmmprɔw no, ɔbɛma hɔn onnyiewiei nkwa;
Na hɔn a wɔyɛ mansopɛ, na wonntsie nokwar no, na wotsie dza ɔnntsen, ebufuw nye ebufuhyew,
ahohia nye ahoguan bɛba nyimpa a wɔyɛ bɔn nyina akra do, Jewfo dzi kan, nye Greekfo so bi;
na enyimnyam nye enyidzi nye asomdwee bɛkã hɔn a wɔyɛ papa nyina, Jewfo dzi kan, nye Greekfo so bi:
Na Nyankopɔ afamu nyimpa enyimhwɛ nnyi hɔ.
Na dodow a woekwetsi mbra ayɛ bɔn no, wobokwetsi mbra so ahera; na dodow a wɔayɛ bɔn wɔ mbra mu no wɔnam mbra do bobu hɔn atsɛn.
Na nnyɛ mbrantsefo nye atseneneefo wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim, na mbom mbrayɛfo na wobobu hɔn bem.
Na sɛ amanamamfo a wonnyi mbra nam hɔn awosu do yɛ mbra mu ndzɛmba a, iyinom a wonnyi mbra no yɛ mbra ma hɔnankasa hɔnho;
hɔn na wɔkyerɛ dɛ wɔakyerɛw mbra ndwuma no wɔ hɔn akoma mu, hɔn tsibowa dzi hɔn dase, hɔn adwen so tõatoa hɔn anaadɛ oyiyi hɔn ano,
wɔ da a Nyankopɔn nam Jesus Christ do bobu nyimpa asumansɛm atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ me nsɛmpa tse no.
Na sɛ wɔfrɛ wo Jewnyi, na edze woho twer mbra no, na itwuw woho wɔ Nyankopɔn mu,
na inyim n'apɛdze, na inyim ndzɛmba a ɔsosoree mu pa, dɛ wofi mbra no mu akyerɛkyerɛ wo ntsi,
Na edze wo tsir twer wo bo dɛ eyɛ enyifurafo kwankyerɛfo, hɔn a wɔwɔ sum mu kan,
Nkwasea fotufo, nkɔkowaba kyerɛkyerɛfo, ewɔ nyimdzee nye nokwar suban wɔ mbra no mu a;
afei ɔwɔ a ekyerɛkyerɛ obi no, ennkyerɛkyerɛ wankasa woho? Ɔwo a ekã dɛ mma obi nnwia adze no, woara iwia adze?
Ɔwo a edɛ mma wɔnntõ awar no, woara etõ awar? Ɔwo a ikyir abosom no, efow abosondan mu adze?
Ɔwo a itwuw woho wɔ mbra mu no, enam mbratõ do dze Nyankopɔn enyim twutwuw famu?
Na hom ntsi na wɔsɛɛ Nyankopɔn dzin wɔ amanaman mu, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no.
Na sɛ idzi mbra no do a, twatsiatwa yɛ mfaso, na sɛ eyɛ mbratonyi a, wo twatsiatwa adan monomonomyɛ.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ monomonomnyi dzi mbra nsɛntsenenee no do a, ana wonnkobu no monomonomyɛ dɛ twatsiatwa?
na awosu mu monomonomnyi, sɛ odzi mbra no do a, ana onnkobu wo a enam kyerɛw nye twatsiatwa do eyɛ mbratonyi atsɛn?
Na nnyɛ Jewnyi nye dza ɔyɛ dɛm wɔ enyiwa do, eso nnyɛ twatsiatwa nye dza ɔda enyiwa do wɔ honam mu;
na Jewnyi nye nyia ɔtse dɛm wɔ no mu, na twatsiatwa nye dza ɔyɛ akoma mu dze wɔ sunsum mu, nnyɛ kyerɛw mu a: Ɔno na n'ayɛyi mmfir nyimpa, na ofir Nyankopɔn.
3: Na ebɛnadze mbɔ na Jewnyi enya abor do? anaadɛ twatsiatwa ho mfaso nye bɛn?
Ɔdɔɔ sõ akwan nyina mu: dza odzi kan nye dɛ wɔdze Nyankopɔn nsɛm hyɛɛ hɔn nsa.
Na sɛ binom anngye enndzi a, ɔyɛ dɛn? Ana hɔn ekyingye bɛma Nyankopɔn nokwardzi ayɛ kwa?
Dabida: Na mbom ma Nyankopɔn nyɛ nokwafo, na nyimpa nyina nyɛ atorfo; dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ama eedzi bem wɔ wo nsɛm mu, Na wobu wo atsɛn a, eedzi nyim.
Na sɛ hɛn brakyew yi Nyankopɔn tsenenee kyerɛ a, yɛbɛse dɛn? Nyankopɔn a ɔdze ebufuw sera no nntsen anaa? (mekã no nyimpamu.)
Dabida: sɛ ɔtse dɛm a, nkyɛ Nyankopɔn bɛyɛ dɛn ebu wiadze atsɛn?
Na sɛ wɔnam m'ator do ahyɛ Nyankopɔn no nokwar enyimnyam mbordo a, ɔyɛ dɛn na wɔda ho bu me atsɛn dɛ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi?
na ebɛn ntsi mbɔ na (dɛ mbrɛ wɔto hɛn sõ, na binom kã dɛ yɛse), hom mma yɛnyɛ bɔn ama papa aaba? Hɔn na hɔn afɔbu tsen.
Na ebɛn mbɔ a? wɔkyɛn hɛn anaa? Dabiarada: Osiandɛ yeedzi kan dze edu Jewfo nye Greekfo nyina, dɛ hɔn nyina hyɛ bɔn ase;
dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ, ɔtseneneenyi nnyi hɔ, nnyɛ ɔbaako mpo;
Obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse ase, obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔhwehwɛ Nyankopɔn ekyir kwan;
Hɔn nyina amanman, hɔn nyina ayɛ dza mfaso nnyi ho; Obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔyɛ papa, nnyɛ ɔbaako mpo:
Hɔn meneba yɛ nda a oebue; Wɔdze hɔn tɛkyerɛma adaadaa; Nhurutsia bɔr wɔ hɔn anofamfa ase:
Hɔn anomu ahyɛ ndom nye wenwen mã;
hɔn anan yɛ har dɛ wɔdze keka bɔgya gu:
Ɔsɛɛ nye amandzehu wɔ hɔn akwan do,
Na asomdwee kwan no dze, woennhu:
Nyankopɔn ho suro biara nnyi hɔn enyiwa do.
Na yenyim dɛ biribiara a mbra no se no, ɔkã kyerɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ mbra no ase, ma wɔaaka ano nyina ato mu, ma wiadze nyina eedzi Nyankopɔn atsɛmbu mu fɔ.
Osiandɛ ɔnam mbra no ndwuma do a worummbu honam biara bem wɔ n'enyim: Na mbra no do na wɔnam hu bɔn mbrɛ ɔtse.
Na afei dze, woekwetsi mbra no eyi Nyankopɔn ne tsenenee bi edzi, no ho dase na mbra no nye nkɔnhyɛfo no dzii:
dza ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn tsenenee no a ɔnam Jesus Christ ho gyedzi do hɛn hɔn a wɔgye dzi nyina mu. Osiandɛ sorbi biara nnyi hɔ;
na hɔn nyina ayɛ bɔn, na wɔatɔ sin wɔ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam ho;
Na wɔdze n'adom nam pon a ɔwɔ Jesus Christ mu no do bu hɔn bem kwa.
Ɔno na Nyankopɔn dze no sii hɔ dɛ mpatadze a ɔnam gyedzi do wɔ no bɔgyaa mu, dɛ ɔdze bɛkyerɛ ne tsenenee, wɔ bɔn a kan no wɔyɛe no twa a ɔama etwa mu, wɔ Nyankopɔn n'abotar mu;
medɛ, ɔdze kyerɛe ne tsenenee wɔ ber yi mu, ama nankasa oeedzi bem, na ɔaayɛ nyia ɔwɔ gyedzi wɔ Jesus Christ mu bembufo.
Afei ahohyehyɛ wɔ hen mbɔ? Woeyi no mu. Ɔnam mbra bɛn do? Ndwuma dze no a? Dabi, na ɔnam gyedzi mbra bi do.
Dɛm ntsi yebu no dɛ wokwetsi mbra ndwuma no nam gyedzi do bu nyimpa bem.
Anaa Nyankopɔn yɛ Jewfo nko dze? Na ɔnnyɛ amanamamfo nso dze bi:
Sɛ ɔtse dɛm dɛ Nyankopɔn kor no ara na ofir gyedzi mu bobu etwatsiafo bem, na ɔnam gyedzi do bobu monomonomfo bem a.
Nna yɛnam gyedzi do ma mbra no yɛ gyan nye no? Dabida: Mbom yɛma mbra no tsim.
4: Ebɛnadze mbɔ na yɛbɛkã dɛ hɛn honam afamu egya Abraham enya?
Na sɛ ofir ndwuma mu na wobuu Abraham bem a, ɔwɔ dza ɔdze tuw: Na nnyɛ Nyankopɔn afamu a.
Na ebɛnadze na kyerɛw no ka? Na Abraham gyee Nyankopɔn dzii, na wobuu no tsenenee maa no.
Na Nyia ɔyɛ edwuma no, wommbu n'akatua dɛ adom, na dɛ kaw.
Na nyia ɔnnyɛ edwuma, na ɔgye nyia obu busuyɛfo ben dzi no, wobu ne gyedzi dɛ tsenenee ma no.
Dɛ mbrɛ David so bɔ nhyira ma nyimpa a Nyankopɔn kwetsi ndwuma bu tsenenee ma no, dɛ,
Nhyira nye hɔn a wɔdze hɔn mbrato efir hɔn, na hɔn ndzebɔn wɔakata do.
Nhyira nye nyimpa a Ewuradze rummbu bɔn nngu no do.
Ana nhyira yi wɔbɔ ma twatsiafo nkom anaa monomonomfo so? Osiandɛ yɛkã dɛ, Wobuu gyedzi dɛ tsenenee maa Abraham.
Na wobui maa no dɛn? Ɔwɔ twatsiatwa mu anaa ɔwɔ monomonomyɛ mu a? Nnyɛ twatsiatwa mu a, na mbom monomonomyɛ mu a;
na onyaa twatsiatwa asɛnkyerɛdze no dɛ gyedzi a onyae wɔ no monomonomyɛ mu no ne tsenenee ho nsɔwano: Ama ɔaayɛ monomonomyɛ mu gyedzifo nyina egya, na woeebu tsenenee ama hɔn;
Na ɔaayɛ twatsiafo egya ama hɔn a nnyɛ dɛ wofi twatsiafo mu nko, na mbom so wotsiatsia gyedzi a hɛn egya Abraham nyaa no wɔ monomonomyɛ mu no anamɔn mu a.
Na nnyɛ mbra no do na anohoba a wɔbɔɔ Abraham anaa n'asefo dɛ wɔbɛyɛ wiadze dzifo nam bae, na mbom ɔnam gyedzi tsenenee do.
Na sɛ hɔn a wofi mbra mu no yɛ adzedzifo a gyedzi no ayɛ kwa, na anohoba no annyɛ hwee:
na mbra no twe ebufuw ba, na mbrɛ mbra bi nnyi no, mbrato bi so nnyi hɔ.
Iyi ntsi na ofi gyedzi mu, ma oeefi adom mu, ma anohoba no eetsim ama asefo no nyina; nnyɛ hɔn a wofi mbra mu nko, na hɔn a wofi Abraham a ɔyɛ hɛn nyina egya no ne gyedzi mu no so,
(dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, medze wo bɛyɛ aman pii hɔn egya) wɔ nyia ɔgyee no dzii no enyim, Nyankopɔn a ɔma ewufo nkwa, na ɔfrɛ ndzɛmba a wonnyi hɔ dɛ gyama wɔwɔ hɔ no.
Ɔno a enyidado nnyi no, ɔgyee dzii enyidado mu, ma ɔaayɛ aman pii egya, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakã no dɛ, Dɛm na w'asefo bɛyɛ.
Na ɔannyɛ gyedzi mu mberɛw annhwɛ ne nyimpadua a ewu no (nna oedzi mfe bɛyɛ ɔha), nye Sarah a no wotoa ewu no;
na ɔhwɛɛ Nyankopɔn anohoba no, ɔammfa ekyingye annyɛ anyanyan, na mbom ɔyɛɛ gyedzi mu ahoɔdzen hyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam,
na ohun ampa dɛ dza ɔabɔ anohoba no, obotum ayɛ.
Dɛm ntsi so wobuu no dɛ tsenenee maa no.
Na nnyɛ no nko bi ntsi na wɔakyerɛw yi dɛ wobui maa no,
na mbom hɛn so a wobobu ama hɛn dɛ yɛgye nyia onyaan hɛn Ewuradze Jesus fii ewufo mu dzi no ntsi a,
ɔno na hɛn mfom ntsi woyii no mae, na hɛn abendzi ntsi wonyaan no.
5: Na afei wɔnam gyedzi do ebu hɛn bem ntsi, hom mma yendua hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ do nnya Nyankopɔn afamu asomdwee;
ɔnam no do so na yɛdze gyedzi enya adom yi a yegyina mu yi mu kwan; na hom mma yɛnhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam ho enyidado mu.
Na nnyɛ yi nko bi, na mbom hom mma yɛnhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ ahohia mu so: Osiandɛ yenyim dɛ ahohia dze abotar ba;
na abotar dze osuahu ba; na osuahu dze enyidado ba;
na enyidado nnhyɛ enyito, osiandɛ wɔnam Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a wɔdze ama hɛn no do ehue Nyankopɔn dɔ egu hɛn akoma mu.
Na yɛda ho nnyi ahoɔdzen no, ber a ɔsɛ mu na Christ wui maa ebusuyɛfo.
Na nyia ɔyɛ nyimpa tsenenee mpo, ɔbɛyɛ dzen ana obi ewu ama no: annyɛ bi a, nyia ɔyɛ nyimpa pa no, obi besi no bo dɛ obowu ama no.
Na Nyankopɔn kyerɛ no dɔ wɔ hɛn do dɛ yɛda ho yɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo no, Christ wui maa hɛn.
Dɛm ntsi afei mbom a woedua no bɔgyaa do ebu hɛn bem yi, wɔnam no do bɛgye hɛn nkwa efi ebufuw no mu.
Na sɛ yɛyɛɛ atamfo no, wɔnam ne Ba no no wu do kaa hɛn nye Nyankopɔn bɔɔ mu a, afei mbom a wɔaka hɛn abɔ mu yi wobodua no nkwa no do agye hɛn nkwa;
Na nnyɛ yi nko bi, na yɛnam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ a, yeenya no mu mbɔmu yi do hyehyɛ hɛnho so wɔ Nyankopɔn mu.
Dɛm ntsi dɛ mbrɛ bɔn nam nyimpa kor do baa wiadze, na owu nam bɔn do bae no, dɛm na owu twaa mu baa nyimpa nyina do, dɛ hɔn nyina ayɛ bɔn ntsi:
Na bɔn wɔ wiadze besii mbra no do, na mbra nnyi hɔ a, wommbu bɔn nngu obi do.
Na owu dzii hen fii Adam do besii Moses do, wɔ hɔn a wɔannyɛ Adam ne mbrato no saso bɔn do mpo, ɔno na ɔyɛ nyia ɔbɛba no ho asɛnkyerɛdze.
Na nnyɛ mbrɛ mbrato no tse na adom akyɛdze no so tse. Na sɛ ɔbaakofo mbrato ntsi dodowara ewu a, Nyankopɔn adom nye adom akyɛdze a ɔwɔ nyimpa kor Jesus Christ mu no abor do ama dodowara.
Na nnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔnam ɔbaakofo a ɔyɛɛ bɔn no do bae no, na akyɛdze no tse, na atsɛmbu no nam baakofo do bɛdaan afɔbu, na adom akyɛdze no nam mbrato do bɛdaan abembu.
Na sɛ ɔbaakofo ne mbrato ntsi na owu nam ɔbaakofo no do dzii hen a, hɔn a woenya adom nye tsenenee akyɛdze no mbordo no nam ɔbaakofo, Jesus Christ do bedzi hen wɔ nkwa mu akyɛn dɛm.
Dɛm ntsi afɛi dɛ mbrɛ afɔbu nam ɔbaakofo mbrato do baa nyimpa nyina do no, dɛmara so na nkwa abembu nam ɔbaakofo abendzi do baa nyimpa nyina do nye no.
Na dɛ mbrɛ dodowara nam nyimpa kor n'asoɔdzen do bɛyɛɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo no, mbrɛ dodowara nam ɔbaakofo ne setsie do bɛyɛ atseneneefo nye no.
Na mbra no kaa ho bae, ma mbrato aadɔɔ sõ: Na mbrɛ bɔn adɔɔ sõ no, adom abor do akyɛn no;
Ma dɛ mbrɛ bɔn edzi hen wɔ wu mu no, dɛmara so adom nam tsenenee do eedzi hen akɔ onnyiewiei nkwa mu, ɔnam Jesus Christ hɛn Ewuradze do.
6: Dɛm ntsi yɛbɛse dɛn? Ana yɛnda ho ntsena bɔn mu, ma adom no ndɔɔ sõ?
Dabida. Ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na hɛn a yewui maa bɔn yɛbɛda ho atsena ase wɔ mu?
Ana hom nnyim dɛ hɛn a wonumaa hɛn hyɛɛ Christ Jesus mu no nyina, wonumaa hɛn hyɛɛ no wu mu?
Dɛm ntsi wɔnam enuma mu esie yɛnye no wɔ owu mu, ma dɛ mbrɛ wɔnam Egya no n'enyimnyam do nyaan Christ fii ewufo mu no, dɛmara hɛn so yaanantsew nkwa fofor mu.
Na sɛ yɛnye no abɔ mu kor wɔ no wu no saso mu a, nna yɛnye no bɔbɔ mu kor wɔ no wusoɛr no so saso mu.
Na yenyim dɛ wɔbɔɔ hɛn nyimpa dadaw no nye no mbeamudua mu, ma bɔn nyimpadua no eewu, amma yaannyɛ bɔn nkowaa bio:
na nyia oewu no, woebu no bem wɔ bɔn ho.
Na sɛ yɛnye Christ wui a, yɛgye dzi dɛ yɛnye no bɛtsena ase so;
osiandɛ yenyim Christ a wonyaan no fii ewufo mu no runnwu bio, owu nndzi no do tum bio.
Na owu a owui no, owui maa hɔn prɛko, na ase a ɔtse no ɔtse ma Nyankopɔn.
Dɛmara so na hom mbubu homho dɛ hom ewu ama bɔn, na hom tse ase ma Nyankopɔn wɔ Christ Jesus mu.
Dɛm ntsi mma hom mma bɔn nndzi hen wɔ hom nyimpadua a obowu no mu, dɛ hom betsie no wɔ n'akɔndɔ mu;

eso mma hom nngyaa hom nyimpadua mfafakuwa mma bɔn dɛ brakyew edwindadze, na mbom hom mfa homho mma Nyankopɔn dɛ hɔn a woefi ewufo mu tse ase, na hom ngyaa hom nyimpadua mfafakuwa mma Nyankopɔn dɛ ɔtsenenee edwindadze.
Na bɔn rinndzi hom do tum bio; na hom nnyi mbra ase, na mbom hom wɔ adom ase.
Ebɛn mbɔ a? Yɛnyɛ bɔn, osiandɛ yennyi mbra ase na yɛwɔ adom ase ntsi? Dabida.
Ana hom nnyim dɛ onyia hom egyaa homho ama no dɛ nkowaa dɛ hom betsie no no, ɔno a hom tsie no no no nkowaa nye hom, sɛ bɔn a ɔdze kɔ owu mu o, sɛ setsie a ɔdze kɔ ɔtsenenee mu o.
Na ndaase nkã Nyankopɔn dɛ nkyɛ hom yɛ bɔn nkowaa, na afei hom fi hom akoma mu ayɛ setsie ama nkyerɛkyerɛ suban a wɔdze hom hyɛɛ mu no;
na hom dzii homho wɔ bɔn ho no, hom bɛyɛɛ tsenenee nkowaa.

Mekasa no nyimpamu wɔ hom honam ne mberɛw ntsi dɛ, Mbrɛ hom gyaa hom nyimpadua mfafakuwa dɛ nkowaa maa efifidze nye emumuyɛ dze kɔr emumuyɛ mu no, dɛmara na afei hom ngyaa hom nyimpadua mfafakuwa dɛ nkowaa mma tsenenee nkɔ ahotsewee mu.
Na hom yɛɛ bɔn nkowaa no, hom dzii homho wɔ tsenenee ho.
Ebɛn eduaba na hom nyaa no wɔ ber no mu wɔ ndzɛmba a afei ɔyɛ hom fɛr no mu? Na ndzɛmba no n'ewiei nye owu.
Na afei hom edzi homho efi bɔn ho, na hom abɛyɛ Nyankopɔn nkowaa yi, hom wɔ hom aba a ɔdze kɔ ahotsewee mu, na n'ewiei nye onnyiewiei nkwa.
Osiandɛ bɔn akatua nye owu, na Nyankopɔn n'adom akyɛdze nye onnyiewiei nkwa wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Christ Jesus mu.
7: Anaa hom nnyim, enuanom, (na mekasa kyerɛ hɔn a wonyim mbra no) dɛ mbra no dzi nyimpa do tum ber a ɔtse ase nyina?
Na ɔbaa a ɔwɔ kun wɔdze mbra no kyer no sē no kun mber tsentsen a ɔtse ase nyina; na sɛ kun no wu a, wɔasan no efi kun no ne mbra no ho.
Dɛm ntsi kun no tse ase no, sɛ ɔdze noho kɔbɔ banyin bi ho a, wɔbɛfrɛ no ɔwartofo, na sɛ kun no wu a, oedzi noho efi mbra no ho, ma ɔdze noho kɔbɔ banyin bi ho a, ɔnnyɛ ɔwartofo.
Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, hom so wɔnam Christ nyimpadua do eku hom ama mbra no, ma hom dze homho akɔbɔ ɔfofor ho, nyia woenyan no efi ewufo mu no, ma yaasow aba ama Nyankopɔn.
Na yɛwɔ honam mu no, bɔn ne nhyɛdodze a ɔnam mbra no do no yɛɛ edwuma wɔ hɛn nyimpadua mfafakuwa mu dze soow aba maa owu.
Na afei yeewu ama dza nkyɛ ɔdze hɛn mu ntsim, wɔasan hɛn efi mbra no ho, ma yɛsom wɔ sunsum foforyɛ mu, na nnyɛ kyerɛw no adadayɛ mu a.
Ebɛn mbɔ na yɛbɛse? Mbra no nye bɔn anaa? Dabida. Naaso mennhu bɔn gyedɛ ɔnam mbra no do: Nkyɛ minnyim enyiber gyedɛ mbra no kãa dɛ, Mma w'enyi mmber adze.
Na bɔn nam mbrasɛm no do nyaa kwan yɛɛ enyiber nyina wɔ mo mu: na sɛ mbra nnyi hɔ a, bɔn ewu.
Na emidze, mukwetsii mbra no bɔɔ bra pɛn, na mbrasɛm no bae no, bɔn nyanee na muwui;
na mbrasɛm a wɔdze kɔ nkwa mu no, emidze muhun dɛ ɔdze me kɔr wu mu.
Na bɔn nam mbrasɛm no do nyaa kwan daadaa me, na ɔnam do kum me.
Dɛm ntsi mbra no yɛ krɔnkrɔn, na mbrasɛm no yɛ krɔnkrɔn, nye tsenenee, nye papa.
Nna dza ɔyɛ papa no daan me owu nye no? Dabida, na mbom bɔn, ama ɔaada edzi dɛ ɔyɛ bɔn ntsi, na ɔnam dza ɔyɛ papa no do dze wu aba mo do, ama bɔn aayɛ bɔn ntrado.
Na yenyim dɛ mbra no yɛ sunsumadze, na emidze, meyɛ honamnyi a wɔatɔn me akɔ bɔn ase.
Na dza meyɛ no, minnyim: na nnyɛ dza mepɛ na meyɛ, na dza mikyir na meyɛ.
Na sɛ meyɛ dza memmpɛ a, mepen mbra no dɛ oye.
Na afei nnyɛ emi na meyɛ, na bɔn a ɔtse mo mu no a.
Na minyim dɛ mo mu, ɔnye dɛ, mo honam mu, papa bi nntse mu; na ɔpɛ dze, ɔnye me tse, na mbrɛ minsi nyɛ dza oye no, munnhu.
Na papa a mepɛ no mennyɛ, na bɔn a memmpɛ no ɔno na meyɛ.
Na sɛ dza memmpɛ no, iyi na meyɛ a, nna nnyɛ emi na meyɛ bio, na bɔn a ɔtse mo mu no a.
Na muhu mbra bi dɛ emi a mepɛ papa ayɛ no, bɔn nye me tse.
Na mo mu nyimpa afamu dze m'enyi gye Nyankopɔn mbra ho;
na muhu mbra fofor bi wɔ me nyimpadua mfafakuwa mu a ɔnye m'adwen mbra kõ, dɛ ɔfa me ndɔmmum ma bɔn a ɔwɔ me nyimpadua mfafakuwa mu no.
Ao, emi ɔmandzehunyi! Woana beyi me efi owu yi nyimpadua no mu?
Menam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ mu da Nyankopɔn ase. Na afei mankasa dze, medze m'adwen som Nyankopɔn mbra, na ɔh nam dze, medze som bɔn mbra.
8: Dɛm ntsi afei afɔbu nnyi hɔ mma hɔn a wɔwɔ Christ Jesus mu.
Na Christ Jesus mu nkw Sunsum mbra no ama medzi moho efi bɔn nye wu mbra no mu.
Na dza mbra no enntum yɛ, dɛ ɔnam honam no do yɛ mberɛw ntsi no, Nyankopɔn somaa nankasa ne Ba wɔ bɔn honam suban no mu, wɔ bɔn ntsi, dze buu bɔn fɔ wɔ honam mu,
ma mbra no n'ahyɛdze no aahyɛ mã wɔ hɛn a yɛnnantsew honam afamu, na yɛnantsew sunsum afamu no mu.
Na hɔn a wɔtɔ kɔ honam do no dwen honam dze, na hɔn a wɔtɔ kɔ sunsum do no dwen sunsum dze.
Na honam adwen yɛ wu, na sunsum adwen yɛ nkwa nye asomdwee.
