Osiandɛ honam adwen yɛ Nyankopɔn do mansotwe na ɔmmfa noho nnhyɛ Nyankopɔn mbra no ase, eso orunntum ampa;
na hɔn a wɔwɔ honam mu nntum nnsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi.
Na homdze, hom nnyi honam mu, na mbom hom wɔ sunsum mu, sɛ ɔba dɛ Nyankopɔn Sunsum tse hom mu a. Na sɛ obiara nnyi Christ no Sunsum a, ɔnnyɛ nedze.
Na sɛ Christ wɔ hom mu a, bɔn ntsi nyimpadua no ewu, na tsenenee ntsi sunsum no nya nkwa.
Na sɛ nyia onyaan Jesus fii ewufo mu no no Sunsum tse hom mu a, nyia onyaan Christ Jesus fii ewufo mu no bɛma hom nyimpadua a owu yi so enya nkwa, ɔnam no Sunsum a ɔtse hom mu no do.
Dɛm ntsi afei, enuanom, yɛyɛ akafo, na nnyɛ honam dze bi a, dɛ yɛbɛtsena asa honam afamu:
na sɛ hom tsena ase honam afamu a, hom bowu, na sɛ hom nam sunsum mu ku nyimpadua ne nyɛe a, hom bɛtsena ase.
Na dodow a Nyankopɔn Sunsum gya hɔn no, hɔn na wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn mba.
Na hom ennya nkowaayɛ sunsum a hom dze bosuro bio, na hom enya abayɛ sunsum a yɛnam do tsēa mu dɛ, Abba, Egya.
Na Sunsum nankasa nye hɛn sunsum dzi dase dɛ yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn mba;
na sɛ yɛyɛ mba a, yɛyɛ adzedzifo so, Nyankopɔn adzedzifo nye Christ n'afɛ-adzedzifo, sɛ yɛnye no hu amandze ama wɔaahyɛ yɛnye no enyimnyam a.
Na mubu dɛ sesei ber yi mu amandzehu nnsɛ dɛ wɔdze to enyimnyam a woribeyi no edzi ama hɛn no ho.
Na abɔdze no n'enyisun rotweɔn Nyankopɔn mba hɔn ahonyi.
Na wɔdze abɔdze no hyɛɛ adze gyan ase, wɔ enyidado mu, nnyɛ nankasa ne pɛ a, na mbom nyia ɔdze hyɛɛ ase no ntsi a.
Osiandɛ abɔdze nankasa so wobeyi no mpɔtɔwee nkowaasom no ase akɔ Nyankopɔn mba enyimnyam adehyedzi no mu.
Na yenyim dɛ abɔdze no nyina nye hɛn pen, na ɔnye hɛn ko awoo bodu ndɛ.
Na nnyɛ dɛm nko, na hɛnankasa so a yɛwɔ Sunsum no aba kan no, hɛn so yɛpen wɔ hɛn mu rotweɔn abayɛ no a ɔyɛ nyimpadua no pon no.
Na enyidado mu na wɔgyee hɛn nkwa: na enyidado a wohu no nnyɛ enyidado, na dza obi hu no, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na n'enyi bɛda do?
Na sɛ hɛn enyi da dza yennhu do a, nna yɛdze abotar tweɔn.
Dɛmara so na Sunsum no suo hɛn mu wɔ mberɛwyɛ mu, osiandɛ yennyim mbrɛ yendua nyi mpaa a ɔsɛ; na Sunsum nankasa na ɔdze apensi a onnyi kabea dzi ma hɛn.
Na nyia ɔpɛnsa akoma mu no nyim Sunsum no n'adwen mbrɛ ɔtse, osiandɛ ɔkasa dzi ma ahotsewfo no dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn pɛ.
Na yenyim dɛ hɔn a wɔdɔ Nyankopɔn, ɔdze adze nyina bɔ mu yɛ edwuma ma hɔn yie, hɔn a wɔnam ne tsirmpɔw do afrɛ hɔn no.
Na hɔn a ohun hɔn siei no, hɔn so na oyii hɔn too hɔ dɛ wɔnye ne Ba no suban nsɛ, ma ɔnodze, ɔaayɛ enuanom pii mu abakan.
Na hɔn a oyii hɔn too hɔ no, hɔn so na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn, na hɔn a ɔfrɛɛ hɔn no, hɔn so na obuu hɔn bem, na hɔn a obuu hɔn bem no, hɔn so na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn enyimnyam.
Nna afei yɛbakã yinom ho asɛm bɛn?
Sɛ Naynkopɔn wɔ hɛn afã a, woana na otsia hɛn? Ɔno a ɔannkam nankasa ne Ba, na oyii no mae wɔ hɛn nyina ntsi no, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na ɔnnkɛfa adze nyina aka no ho adom hɛn?
Woana botum dze biribi edu hɔn a Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi hɔn no? Nyia obu bem nye Nyankopɔn.
Woana nye nyia obu fɔ? Christ Jesus a owui, na mbom ɔsoɛree fii ewufo mu, nyia ɔtse Nyankopɔn nyimfa no, ɔno so na odzi ma hɛn.
Woana bɛtsew hɛn efi Christ dɔ no ho? Ahohia, anaa ahomtsew, anaa ɔhaw, anaa ɔkɔm, anaa adagyaw, anaa amandze, anaa afõwa a?
Dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, ɔwo ntsi woku hɛn daa nyina; wobubu hɛn dɛ nguan a woruboku hɔn.
Naaso iyi nyina mu yɛnam nyia ɔdɔɔ hɛn no do dzi konyim bor do.
Na megye dzi ampa dɛ, owu anaa nkwa, anaa abɔfo, anaa etumfo, anaa dza ɔwɔ hɔ sesei, anaa dza ɔrebɛba, anaa ahoɔdzenfo,
anaa kɔnkrtɔnn, anaa bun, anaa abɔdze biara runntum nntsew hɛn efi Nyankopɔn dɔ no a ɔwɔ hɛn Ewuradze Christ Jesus mu no ho.
9: Mekã no nokwar wɔ Christ mu, minndzi ator, na me tsibowa so regye me dase wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu,
dɛ mowɔ awerɛhow kɛse nye yaw a ɔmmbotow wɔ m'akoma mu.
Na nkyɛ mepɛ dɛ wɔyɛɛ mara ebusudze fii Christ ho, ma mo nuanom a wɔyɛ m'ebusuafo wɔ honam afamu:
wɔyɛ Israelfo a abayɛ no, nye enyimnyam no, nye ahyɛmu no, nye mbrahyɛ no, nye Nyankopɔn som no, nye anohoba no dzi wɔ hɔn;
na egyanom dzi wɔ hɔn, na honam afamu Christ fi hɔn mu bae a odzi adze nyina do, Nyankopɔn a wohyira no daa. Amen.
Na nnyɛ dɛ gyama Nyankopɔn asɛm atɔ famu. Na nnyɛ hɔn a wofi Israel mu nyina nye Israel;
na eso nnyɛ dɛ wɔyɛ Abraham asefo ntsi na hom nyina yɛ mba, na mbom, Isaac mu na wɔbɛfrɛ w'asefo.
Ɔnye dɛ nnyɛ honam mu aba na wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn mba, na mbom anohoba mba no na wobu hɔn asefo.
Na anohobasɛm nye asɛm yi, Afedan sisei mebɛba, na Sarah enya ba.
Na nnyɛ dɛm nko, na Rebecca so nye ɔbaako a ɔno nye hɛn egya Isaac nyinsenii no,
na mba no wonnyae wɔnnwoo hɔn no, na wonnyae nnyɛɛ papa anaa bɔn no, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma Nyankopɔn ne nsanmuyi tsirmpɔw no eegyina, na eemmfi ndwuma mu na mbom eefi nyia ɔfrɛ no ntsi no,
wɔsee no dɛ, ɔpanyin no bɔsom ekumaba no,
dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Jacob na modɔɔ no, na Esau dze, metaan no.
Ebɛn na yɛbɛse mbɔ? Dza ɔnntsen wɔ Nyankopɔn ho anaa? Dabida.
Na ɔse Moses dɛ, Nyia muhu no mbɔbɔr ara na mubohu no mbɔbɔr, na nyia me yamu hyehye me ma no ara na me yamu bɛhyehye me ama no.
Ntsi, ommfi nyia ɔpɛ, anaa nyia otutu mbirika, na ofi Nyankopɔn a ohu mbɔbɔr.
Na kyerɛw no se Pharaoh dɛ, Iyi ntsi na memaa wo do, dɛ mibeyi mo tum edzi wɔ wo mu, ma wɔaabɔ me dzin wɔ asaase nyina do.
Dɛm ntsi nyia ɔpɛ na ohu no mbɔbɔr, na nyia ɔpɛ na opirim n'akoma.
Na bi a ebɛse me dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔda ho num nyimpa? Woana botum esiw ne pɛ kwan?
Yɛɛ, nyimpa, woana nye wo na itua Nyankopɔn asɛm ano? Ana awendze bɛse ɔwemfo dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na eyɛɛ me dɛm?
Ana senaba-wemfo nnyi dɛtse do tum dɛ ɔdze dɛtsetɔw kor noara bi wen kuraba a onya enyidzi, na ɔdze bi so wen kor so a onnya enyidzi?
Na sɛ Nyankopɔn pɛ akyerɛ n'ebufuw, na oeyi no tum edzi ntsi, ɔdze penkyɛr pii peen ebufuw nkuraba a woesiesie hɔn ama ɔsɛɛ no;
na sɛ ɔbɛma woehu n'enyimnyam ahonya no so wɔ mbɔbɔrhu nkuraba a oesiesie ama enyimnyam no no do a, ebɛn a?
Mekyerɛ hɛn a wɔafrɛ hɛnnom so, nnyɛ Jewfo nko, na amanamamfo so bi.
Dɛ mbrɛ ɔkã so wɔ Hosea mu dɛ, mebɛfrɛ dza ɔnnyɛ me man, me man, na nyia ɔnnyɛ mo dɔfo, mo dɔfo.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, mbrɛ wɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom nnyɛ me man no, hɔ na wɔbɛfrɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn tseasefo no mba.
Na Isaiah so tsēa mu wɔ Israel ho dɛ, sɛ Israelmba dodow tse dɛ mpoano anhwea mpo a, nkaa no na wɔbɛgye hɔn nkwa.
Na n'asɛm no wie nye ne tsiatwa ntsi, Ewuradze bɛyɛ yi wɔ asaase do.
Na dɛ mbrɛ Isaiah kãe too hɔ, sɛ Sabaoth Ewuradze enngya hɛn aba a, nkyɛ yɛayɛ dɛ Sodom, na wɔaman yɛayɛ dɛ Gomorrah.
Ebɛn na yɛbɛse mbɔ? Dɛ amanamamfo a woenntsiw tsenenee no nsa aka tsenenee a ɔyɛ tsenenee a ofi gyedzi mu;
na Israel a otsiiw tsenenee mbra no enndu tsenenee mbra no ho.
Ebɛn ntsi a? Osiandɛ woenndua gyedzi do, na dɛ gyama odua ndwuma do. Wofintsiiw fintsiw bo no do,
dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, hwɛ, moto fintsiw bo wɔ Zion, nye abew botan: Na nyia ɔbɛgye no edzi n'enyi runnwu.
10: Enuanom, m'akoma n'apɛdze pa ara nye mo nkotoserɛ a meserɛ Nyankopɔn na medze mema hɔn, ama wɔaagye hɔn nkwa.
Na midzi hɔn dase dɛ wɔwɔ Nyankopɔn ho mbɔdzembɔ, na wonnyi no nyimdzee mu.
Na wonnyim Nyankopɔn ne tsenenee na mohwehwɛ dɛ wɔdze hɔnankasa hɔndze si hɔ ntsi, wɔammbrɛ hɔnho adze annhyɛ Nyankopɔn tsenenee no ase.
Na Christ nye mbra no n'ewiei a ɔdze obiara a ɔgye dzi kɔ tsenenee mu.
Na Moses kyerɛw dɛ nyimpa a ɔyɛ tsenenee a ofi mbra no mu no na obenya nkwa wɔ mu.
Na mbrɛ tsenenee a ofi gyedzi mu no kã nye yi, mma nnse wɔ w'akoma mu dɛ, woana bɔfow akɔ sor? (Ɔnye dɛ, ɔrekɛfa Christ esian:)
anaadɛ, Woana besian akɔ bun no mu? (Ɔnye dɛ, ɔrekɛfa Christ efi ewufo mu aba).
Na ɔkã dɛn? Asɛm no abɛn wo, ɔwɔ w'anomu, ɔwɔ w'akoma mu: Ɔno nye gyedzi asɛm a yɛkã no,
dɛ, sɛ edze w'ano paa mu kã dɛ Jesus nye Ewuradze, na egye dzi wɔ w'akoma mu dɛ Nyankopɔn nyaan no fii ewufo mu a, wɔbɛgye no nkwa:
Na akoma na wɔdze gye dzi kɔ tsenenee mu, na ano na wɔdze paa mu kã kɔ nkwagye mu.
Na kyerɛw no kã dɛ obiara a ɔbɛgye no edzi no n'enyi runnwu.
Na sorbi biara nnyi Jewnyi nye Greeknyi ntamu: na Ewuradze kor no ara na odzi hɔn nyina do, na ɔyɛ ɔhonyanyi ma hɔn a wɔfrɛ no nyina:
Na, Obiara a ɔbɔbɔ Ewuradze dzin no obenya nkwa.
Na wɔbɛyɛ dɛn afrɛ nyia wɔnngyee no nndzii? Na wɔbɔyɛ dɛn agye nyia wɔnntsee no ho asɛm edzi? Na sɛ ɔsɛnkafo nnyi hɔ a, wɔbɛyɛ dɛn atse?
Na sɛ wɔnnsomaa hɔn a, wɔbɛyɛ dɛn akã asɛm? Dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, hɔn a wɔdze ndzepa ho asɛmpa ba mbrɛ hɔn anan dua yɛ fɛw a!
Na hɔn nyinara amma asɛmpa noa so. Na Isaiah se dɛ, Ewuradze, woana na ɔagye hɛn amandzɛɛ edzi?
Nna gyedzi no fi otsie mu, na otsie nam Christ asɛm do na ɔba.
Na mese, Ana wɔanntse koraa? Nyew, ampa, hɔn ndze firii kɔr asaase nyina do, na hɔn asɛm dur wiadze ewiei.
Na mese, Ana Israel anntse ase? Moses dzi kan kã dɛ, medze hɔn a wɔnnyɛ ɔman beyi hom nyinkun, ɔman a wonnyi ntseasee na medze beyi hom ebufuw.
Isaiah dze, ɔyɛ ndam papa na ɔse, Hɔn a wɔannhwehwɛ me ehu me; meyi moho akyerɛ hɔn a woemmbisa m'ekyir kwan.
Na Israel dze, ɔkã kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Adzekyee tsentsen nyina metserɛɛw me nsa maa ɔman asokyewfo nye nyiyianofo.
11: Na afei mese, aso Nyankopɔn toow ne man kyenee? Dabida. Na makasa so meyɛ Israelnyi a mifi Abraham asefo mu, Benjamin busuakuw mu.
Nyankopɔn anntow ne man a ohun hɔn siei no annkyen. Ana hom nnyim dza kyerɛw no kã wɔ Elijah ho? Mbrɛ ɔtõatoa Israel ma Nyankopɔn dɛ,
Ewuradze, wo nkɔnhyɛfo woekuku hɔn, na w'afɔrmbukyia woedwurudwuw, na mo nko na aka, na wɔrohwehwɛ mo nkwa.
Na Nyankopɔn mbuae no se no dɛn? Megya mbarimba mpenesuon mama moho a wommbuu nkotodwe mma Baal.
Dɛmara so mbɔ na seseiara nkaa bi wɔ hɔ dɛ mbrɛ adom nsanmuyi no tse.
Na sɛ ɔnam adom do a, nna ommfir ndwuma bio: Ɔnodze na nkyɛ adom nnyɛ adom bio.
Nna ebɛn a? Dza Israel hwehwɛ no, ne nsa annkã; na hɔn a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn no nsa kãe, na nkaa no piriim hɔn akoma:
Dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Nyankopɔn maa hɔn nkomtɔ sunsum, enyiwa a wɔmfa nnhu, nye aso a wɔmfa nntse dze ebodu ndɛ da yi.
Na David se, ma hɔn edzidzipon nyɛ efir, nye apafir, nye fintsidua nye akatua mma hɔn:
Ma hɔn enyiwa nyɛ sum ma woeennhu adze, na kontom hɔn ekyir daa.
Na afei mese, Ana wofintsiwii ma wɔaahwe ase? Dabida. Na mbom ɔnam hɔn ntserho do na nkwagye abɛyɛ amanamamfo dze, na ɔdze eyi hɔn nyinkun.
Na sɛ hɔn ntserho yɛ wiadze ahonya, na hɔn ahwerdzi ayɛ amanamamfo ahonya a, hɔn amayɛ dze bɛkyɛn dɛm dɛn ara?
Na hom amanamamfo na mekasa mekyerɛ hom. Dɛ meyɛ amanamamfo somafo ntsi, mehyɛ mo som yi enyimnyam,
dɛ bi a mibeyi hɔn a wɔyɛ mo honam no nyinkun, na magye hɔn mu binom nkwa.
Na sɛ ɔtow a wɔtoow hɔn kyenee ayɛ wiadze nkabɔmu a, ɔgye a wɔbɛgye hɔn dze bɛyɛ dɛn, dɛ nkwa a ofi ewufo mu?
Na sɛ aba kan no yɛ krɔnkrɔn a, ɔtow no so yɛ bi; na sɛ ndwow no yɛ krɔnkrɔn a, ndubaa no so yɛ bi.
Na sɛ ndubaa no bi ebubu, na wɔdze ɔwo a eyɛ kwaa mu ngodua afora ahyɛ mu, ma enya ngodua no do ndwow nye no mu ngo bi a,
mma nnhyehyɛ woho wɔ ndubaa no do: Na sɛ ehyehyɛ woho a, nnyɛ ɔwo na eso ndwow no, na ndwow no na ɔso wo.
Na bi a ebɛse dɛ, wobubuu ndubaa no, ama wɔdze me aahyɛ mu.
Yɛɛ: Ekyingye ntsi na wobubu hɔn, na wo so gyedzi ntsi na igyina hɔ. Mma nndwen ekuromponsɛm, na mbom suro.
Na sɛ Nyankopɔn annkam ndubaa a wofi dua no ara mu fifir no a, ɔrennkam wo so.
Afei hwɛ Naynkopɔn n'ayamuyie nye ne dzenyɛ: Ɔyɛ dzen ma hɔn a wɔhwee ase no do, na wo do dze ɔyɛ ayamuyie, sɛ eda ho tsena n'ayamuyie mu a: Annyɛ dɛm a, wobotwa wo so akyen.
Na hɔn so sɛ wɔannda ho anntsena hɔn ekyingye mu a, wɔdze hɔn bɛhyɛ mu bio, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn botum dze hɔn ahyɛ mu bio.
Na sɛ ɔwo wotwaa wo dza noara yɛ kwaa mu ngodua ho, na sɛ wokwetsii bɔbea dze wo bɛhyɛɛ ngodua pa mu a, mpɛn ahen ara na wɔdze woyi a wɔyɛ bɔbea mu ndubaa no bɛhyɛ hɔnara hɔn ngodua mu?
Na, enuanom, memmpɛ dɛ misiw hom esumasɛm yi do, amma hom eemmbu homho enyansafo, dɛ akomapirim afaafa aba Israel do dze kodu dɛ amanaman mãhyɛ no bɛba mu;
na ɔno Israel nyina benya nkwa, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, ɔgyefo no befi Zion aba, ɔbɛdan emumuyɛ efi Jacob ho:
Na yi nye m'ahyɛmu a menye hɔn edzi, Ber a mibeyi hɔn bɔn akɔ.
Asɛmpa no afamu dze, wɔyɛ atamfo wɔ hom ntsi; na nsanmuyi no afamu wɔyɛ adɔfo wɔ egyanom ntsi.
Na Nyankopɔn n'adom akyɛdze nye ne frɛ nnyi mfihoekyir.
Dɛ mbrɛ ber a ɔabɛsen hom yɛɛ asoɔdzen, na sesei ɔnam yinom yinom asoɔdzen do hom enya ehumbɔbɔr no,
Dɛmara so na yinom ayɛ asoɔdzen sesei, ma ɔnam ehumbɔbɔr a wɔdze ehu hom no do, hɔn so woeenya ehumbɔbɔr.
Na Nyankopɔn aka hɔn nyina ahyɛ asoɔdzen mu ma oeehu hɔn nyina mbɔbɔr.
O Nyankopɔn ne nyansaa nye ne nyimdzee ahonya no bun a no mu dɔ! N'atsɛmbu wɔmmpɛ mu nnhu, n'akwan so tra ntseasee.
Na woana na oehu Ewuradze adwen? Anaa woana na ɔayɛ ne pamfo?
Anaa woana na oedzi kan dze biribi ama no, ma wɔaahyɛ no ananmu bio?
Na adze nyin afi no hɔ, na ɔnam no do, na ɔkɔ no mu. Ɔno na enyimnyam nkã no afebɔɔ! Amen.
12: Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, menam Nyankopɔn ehumbɔbɔr do serɛ hom dɛ hom ntu hom nyimpadua nsi hɔ dɛ afɔrbɔdze nyikan nye krɔnkrɔn a ɔsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi a ɔyɛ hom som a ɔwɔ siantsir.
Na mma hom nnyɛ homho dɛ wiadze yi: Na mbom hom ndua hom adwen foforyɛ mu nsakyer homho, ma hom aasɔ Nyankopɔn pɛ no a oye na ɔsɔ enyi na odzi mu no ahwɛ.
Na menam adom a wɔdze adom me no do mekã kyerɛ hom mu nyimpa biara dɛ mma ɔnndwen nntra dza ɔsɛ dɛ ɔdwen, na mbom ɔdwen enyidahɔ adwen, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn akyɛ gyedzi nsusui ama obiara.
Na dɛ mbrɛ yɛwɔ nyimpadua kor yi mu mfafakuwa pii, na mfafakuwa no nyina nndzi dwuma kor no,
dɛmara so na hɛn a yɛdɔɔ sõ no, yɛyɛ nyimpadua kor wɔ Christ mu, na yɛyɛ mfafakuwa ma hɛnho nkorkor.
Na yɛwowɔ adom akyɛdze a ɔsosoree dɛ mbrɛ adom a wɔdze adom hɛn no tse no, sɛ nkɔnhyɛ a, hom mma yɛnhyɛ nkɔm dɛ mbrɛ hɛn gyedzi nsusui pa;
sɛ ɔsom a, yemfua hɛn som mu, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo mfua ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu,
nyia otu fo mfua n'afotu mu, nyia ɔkyɛ adze mfa komakor nyɛ, nyia odzi panyin, ɔmbɔ ho mbɔdzen, nyia ohu mbɔbɔr, ɔmfa enyimtswew nyɛ.
Mma ndabraba mfora ɔdɔ mu. Hom nkyir dza omuo na hom ntakyer dza oye ho.
Enuadɔ mu a, hom ndɔdɔ homho yie nkokor; enyidzi mu a, hom ndzi kan ndzidzi homho nyi;
mbɔdzembɔ mu a, mma hom nnyɛ nyaa nyaa; hom nyɛ sunsum mu hyew; hom nsom Ewuradze;
Hom ndzi dɛw wɔ enyidado mu; hom nto hom bo ase wɔ ahohia mu; hom nda ho nkura asɔryɛ mu;
hom nkɔ ahotsewfo hia mboa; hom ntɔ ahɔhoyɛ.
Hom nhyira hɔn a wohiahia hom ho: Hom nhyira na mma hom nndom.
Hom nye hɔn a wodzi dɛw ndzi dɛw; hom nye hɔn a wosū nsū.
Hom nnyinya adwenkor wɔ homho. Mma hom mmfa hom adwen nngyina ekuromponsɛm do, na mbom hom mbrɛ homho adze mma dza ɔbrɛ adze. Mma hom mmbu homho enyansafo.
Mma hom mmfa bɔn nntua bɔn kaw. Hom ndwen dza ɔyɛ enyidzi wɔ nyimpa nyina enyim.
Sɛ ɔbɛyɛ a, hom afamu dze, hom nye nyimpa nyina ntsena asomdwee mu.
Adɔfo, mma hom nndzidzi homho wer, na mbom hom mma ebufuw kwan: Na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Awerdzi dzi wɔ me: Emi na mubotua kaw, Ewuardze na ɔse.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ kɔm dze wo tamfo a, ma no edziban; sɛ nsukɔm dze no a, ma no biribi ma ɔnom: Na eyɛ dɛm a, edze bɔboa gyansenama ano egu n'etsifi.
Mma bɔn nndzi hom do nyim, na hom mfa papa ndzi nyim wɔ bɔn do.
13: Hom mma akra nyina mbrɛ hɔnho adze mma etum a ɔkrɔn: Na tum biara nnyi hɔ dɛ dza ofir Nyankopɔn, na etum a wɔwɔ hɔ no Nyankopɔn na ɔhyehyɛe.
Dɛm ntsi obiara a osi tum yi mpa no, osi Nyankopɔn ahyehyɛdze mpa; na hɔn a wosi mpa no benya afɔbu ama hɔnho.
Na hɔn a wodzi mpanyin no ho nnyɛ hu mma ndwuma pa, na mbom ɔdze ma bɔn. Ana emmpɛ dɛ isuro tum no? Nna yɛ papa ara, na ibenya ho ayɛyi:
Na ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn somfo ma wo yie. Na sɛ eyɛ dza ɔyɛ bɔn a, suro: Na ommfua afõwa no kwa, na ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn somfo nye werdzifo a ɔdze ebufuw ba nyia ɔyɛ bɔn do.
Dɛm ntsi otwar dɛ hom brɛ homho adze, nnyɛ dɛ ebufuw nko ntsi, na mbom tsibowa ntsi so bi.
Iyi ntsi so na hom yi tow; na wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn asomfo fua mu ara hwɛ dɛm adze yi do.
Dɛm ntsi hom ntua obiara ne ndzinoa mma no: Hom nyi tow mma nyia tow sɛ no, amandze mma nyia amandze sɛ no, suro mma nyia suro sɛ no, enyidzi mma nyia enyidze sɛ no.
Mma hom mma obiara kaw gyesɛ ɔdɔ a hom bɔdodɔ homho: Na nyia ɔdɔ ne nyɛnko no oedzi mbra no do.
Na asɛm a wɔkã dɛ, mma nntõ awar, mma nndzi ewu, mma nnwia adze, mma w'enyi mmber adze no, anaa sɛ ahyɛdze biara ka ho a, woesi ne nyina tam wɔ asɛm yi mu dɛ, Dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ woho.
Ɔdɔ nnyɛ ne nyɛnko bɔn biara: Dɛm ntsi ɔdɔ nye mbra no no do dzi.
Na iyi mbom, osiandɛ yenyim ber no, dɛ ber enya edu a yefir hɛn nda mu nyan: na afei na hɛn nkwagye abɛn akyɛn ber a yɛgyee dzii no.
Adzesaa akɔ enyim, adzekyee abɛn: Dɛm ntsi hom mma yenyi sum mu ndwuma no ngu, na yɛnhyɛ kan akondze no.
Hom mma yɛnnantsew yie dɛ adzekyee mu, nnyɛ edzidzintrudu nye asabow mu, nnyɛ ndwamanyɛ nye atantandze mu, nnyɛ aperper nye nyinkun mu.
Na mbom hom nhyɛ Ewuradze Jesus Christ, na mma hom nnhwehwɛ nnsie honam nhyɛ n'akɔndɔdze mã.
14: Nyia ɔyɛ gyedzi mu mberɛw no hom ngye no, na mbom nnyɛ nokotwa a ɔyɛ anyanyan mu.
Obi wɔ gyedzi dɛ odzi adze nyina: Na nyia ɔyɛ mberɛw no dze, odzi nhabanhaban nko.
Nyia odzi no mma ommbu nyia onndzi no enyimtsia, na nyia onndzi no mma ommbu nyia odzi no atsɛn: na Nyankopɔn agye no.
Woana nye ɔwo a ibu obi fienyimpa atsɛn? Nankasa no wura na ogyina anaa ɔhwe ase ma no. Na obegyina so, osiandɛ Ewuradze botum ama oegyina.
Na obi bu da kor bi kyɛn bi, obi so bu nda nyina pɛr. Hom mma obiara nankasa n'adwen nsi no tadua.
Nyia ɔdwen da no do dwen ma Ewuradze, na nyia odzi no dzi ma Ewuradze, na ɔdze ndaase ma Nyankopɔn; na nyia onndzi no, Ewuradze na onndzi mma no, na ɔdze ndaase ma Nyankopɔn.
Na hɛn mu biara nntse ase mma noho, na hɛn mu biara nnwu mma noho.
Na sɛ yetse ase a, yɛtse ase ma Ewuradze, na sɛ yewu a, yewu ma Ewuradze: Dɛm ntsi yɛtse ase o, yewu o, yɛyɛ Ewuradze dze.
Na iyi ntsi na Christ wui na ɔsoɛree baa nkwa mu, ama ɔaayɛ ewufo nye atseasefo hɔn Ewuradze.
Na ɔwodze, ɔyɛ dɛn na ibu wo nua atsɛn? Anaaso ɔwodze, ɔyɛ dɛn na ibu wo nua enyimtsia? Na hɛn nyina begyina Nyankopɔn asɛndzii gua no enyim.
Na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Ewuradze se, metse ase yi, emi na anankoroma nyina bɔkotow me, Na tɛkyerɛma nyina bɔbɔ Nyankopɔn dzin.
Ntsi hɛn nyina bobu hɛnankasa hɛnho akontaa nkorkor akyerɛ Nyankopɔn.
Dɛm ntsi mma hom mma yemmbubu hɛnho atsɛn nkokor, na mbom hom mbu yi ho atsɛn, dɛ obiara nnkɛfa fintsidua anaa abew bi ato no nua kwan mu.
Minnyim na megye dzi pi wɔ Ewuardze Jesus mu dɛ biribiara nankasa nnyɛ ekyiwadze, na nyia obu biribi ekyiwadze no, ɔnoara na ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma no.
Na sɛ w'edziban ntsi wo nua werɛ how a, nna ennam ɔdɔ mu bio. Mma mmfa w'edziban nnsɛɛ nyia Christ wui maa no.
Ntsi mma wɔnnkasa wo papa ho bɔn:
Na Nyankopɔn ahenman nnyɛ edzidzi nye ɔnom, na mbom ɔyɛ tsenenee, nye asomdwee, nye Sunsum krɔnkrɔn mu dɛw.
Na nyia ɔsom Christ wɔ iyinom mu no, ɔsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi na nyimpa pen no.
Ntsi hom mma yentsiw dza ɔyɛ asomdwee, nye dza yɛdze bɔtotow hɛnho do nkorkor.
Mma onnsian edziban ntsi mma nndwuruw Nyankopɔn ndwuma. Adze nyina ho tsew, naaso ɔyɛ bɔn ma nyia ɔdze adwen mu pem dzi.
Oye dɛ inndzi edziban anaa ennom wenyin anaa ennyɛ dza ɔbɛpem wo nua biara.
Gyedzi a ewɔ no, kitsa no ma woho wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim. Nhyira nye nyia ommbu noho atsɛn wɔ dza obu no dɛ oye no ho.
Na nyia n'adwen mu yɛ no konsee no, sɛ odzi a, oedzi fɔ, osiandɛ ommfi gyedzi mu dzi: Na biribiara a ommfi gyidzi mu no, ɔyɛ bɔn.
15: Na hɛn a yɛyɛ dzen no, ɔsɛ dɛ yɛsoa hɔn a wɔnnyɛ dzen no hɔn mberɛwyɛ, na yɛnnsɔ hɛnara hɛn enyi.
Hom mma hɛn mu obiara nsɔ ne nyɛnko enyi mma ne yie, mfa nyɛ ntowdo.
Na Christ so annsɔ nankasa noho enyi, na dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no, hɔn a wɔtoom wo no, hɔn ntom no tɔɔ mo do.
Na biribiara a wɔakyerɛɛw no nkan no, wɔkyerɛwee maa hɛn nkyerɛkyerɛ, ama ɔnam abotar na kyerɛwnsɛm no n'awerɛkyekyer do yeenya enyidado.
Na abotar nye awerɛkyekyer Nyankopɔn no mma hom nnya adwenkor wɔ homho nkorkor dɛ Christ Jesus dze tse,
ama hom dze adwenkor nye anokor aahyɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ ne Nyankopɔn nye n'Egya enyimnyam.
Dɛm ntsi hom ngyegye homho, dɛ mbrɛ Christ so agye hom, ama Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
Na mese dɛ wɔayɛ Christ twatsiatwa no ho somfo wɔ Nyankopɔn nokwar no ntsi, ma ɔaahyɛ egyanom anohoba no dzen,
na amanamamfo aahyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ n'ehumbɔbɔr ntsi; dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, dɛm ntsi mibeyi wo ayɛw wɔ amanaman mu, na mabɔ wo dzin matow ndwom.
Na ɔse bio dɛ, Amanaman, hom nye ne man ndzi ehurusi,
Na bio, Amanaman, hom nyi Ewuradze ayɛw, na hom mma aman horow nyina nkamfo no.
Na bio Isaiah se dɛ, Jesse ndwow no bɛba, nye nyia ɔbɔsoɛr ebedzi amanaman do: No mu na amanaman benya enyidado.
Na enyidado Nyankopɔn mfa gyedzi mu dɛw nye asomdwee nyina nhyɛ hom mã, ma hom aabor do wɔ enyidado mu, wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ahoɔdzen mu.
Na megye dzi pi wɔ hom ho, m'enuanom, dɛ homankasa so papayɛ nyina ahyɛ hom mã, na nyimdzee nyina ahyɛ hom mã tɔr, na eso hom tum tutu homho fo.
Naaso medze ndam pii makyerɛw nsɛm yi ho bi mabrɛ hom, dɛ medze rebɛkaa hom bio wɔ adom a Nyankopɔn adom me ntsi,
dɛ menyɛ Christ Jesus somfo mma amanamamfo, na menkɛyɛ Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no ho asɔfodwuma, na amanaman nyɛ afɔr a ɔsɔ enyi a wɔatsew ho wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu.
Dɛm ntsi mowɔ m'ahohyehyɛ wɔ Christ Jesus mu wɔ ndzɛmba a ɔfa Nyankopɔn ho mu.
Na mirinnsi mo bo mmbɔ biribi dzin gyedɛ dza Christ edua mo do ayɛ ama amanaman setsie, wɔ asɛm nye ndwuma mu,
wɔ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze tum mu, wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn tum mu: ma ofi Jerusalem na no ho nkurow mu dze ekesi Illyricum mama Christ n'asɛmpa no ayɛ mã;
Ma dza m'enyi ber nye dɛ mekã asɛmpa no, nnyɛ mbrɛ wɔabɔ Christ dzin wɔ hɔ pɛn bi a, mma maannkɔtow obi fapem do,
na mbom dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Hɔn a no ho asɛm enndu hɔn nkyɛn bohu, na hɔn a wɔanntse bɛtse ase.
Na iyi ntsi so na mpɛn pii nye yi a woesiw me kwan amma maammba hom nkyɛn.
Na afei, minnyi mbew yi do beebi bio, na mfe pii yi nyina mepɛ dɛ meba hom nkyɛn ntsi,
da biara a mubotu kwan akɔ Spain no (osiandɛ m'enyi da dɛ murutwa mu a, mubohu hom, na sɛ hom agor mee me kra a, hom egya me kwan akɔ hɔ)
na sesei dze morokɔ Jerusalem akɔsom ahotsewfo no.
Na ayɛ Macedonia nye Achia fɛw dɛ wɔdze ntoboa bi kɛma ahotsewfo a wɔwɔ Jerusalem mu ehiafo.
Ɛhɛɛ, ayɛ hɔn fɛw, naaso wɔdze hɔn kaw. Na sɛ amanamamfo enya hɔn sunsum mu ndzɛmba bi a, wɔdze hɔn kaw dɛ wɔdze hɔn honam mu ndzɛmba bi som hɔn.
Dɛm ntsi muwie yi na minya mosɔw aba yi ano ma hɔn a, mebɛba mabɛfa hom nkyɛn akɔ Spain.
Na minyim dɛ meba hom nkyɛn a, mebɛba no Christ asɛmpa nhyira ne mãyɛ mu.
Na afei, enuanom, menam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ nye Sunsum no dɔ do meserɛ hom dɛ hom nkõ me ebia wɔ asɔr a hom yɛ ma Nyankopɔn ma me no mu;
dɛ wobeyi me efi asoɔdzenfo a wɔwɔ Judæa nsa, na mo som a morokɔsom wɔ Jerusalem asɔ ahotsewfo no enyi,
ma menam Nyankopɔn pɛ do maaba hom nkyɛn wɔ enyigye mu, na emi nye hom nyina hɛn ho aatɔ hɛn.
Na asomdwee Nyankopɔn nye hom nyina ntsena. Amen.
16: Mobɔ hɛn akyerɛba Phœbe a ɔyɛ Cenchreæ asɔr mu asomfo no dzin medze no hyɛ hom nsa,
dɛ hom ngye no Ewuradze mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ ahotsewfo, na hom mboa no wɔ biribiara a obehia hom wɔ mu no mu: Na nankasa so ayɛ ɔboafo ama nyimpa pii, nye mara so.
Hom nkyia Prisca nye Aɔuila, m'asɛfo dwumadzifo wɔ Christ Jesus mu a
mo nkwa ntsi wɔdze hɔnankasa hɔn kɔn too hɔ: Na nnyɛ mo nko na meda hɔn ase, na mbom asɔr a wɔwɔ amanaman do nyina;
Na hom nkyia asɔr a ɔwɔ hɔn fie no so. Hom nkyia mo dɔfo Epænetus a ɔyɛ aba kan a ofi Asia ayɛ Christ dze.
Hom nkyia Mary a ɔbɔɔ mbɔdzen pii maa hom.
Hom nkyia Andronicus nye Junias, m'ebusuafo nye m'afɛ mpokyerɛfo a wɔwɔ dzin wɔ asomafo no mu, na eso wodzii m'enyim kan wɔ Christ mu no.
Hom nkyia m'Ewuradze mu dɔfo Ampliatus.
Hom nkyia Urbanus, hɛn afɛ dwumadzinyi wɔ Christ mu, nye mo dɔfo Stachys.
Hom nkyia Apellas a wɔasɔ no ahwɛ wɔ Christ mu. Hom nkyia hɔn a wofi Aristobulus fidua mu no.
Hom nkyia mo busuanyi Herodion. Hom nkyia hɔn a wofi Narcissus fidua mu a wɔwɔ Ewuradze mu no.
Hom nkyia Tryphæna nye Tryphosa a wɔbɔ Ewuradze mu mbɔdzen. Hom nkyia ɔdɔfo Persis a ɔbɔɔ Ewuardze mu mbɔdzen pii no.
Hom nkyia Rufus a wɔasan mu eyi no EWuradze mu no, ɔnye ɔno nye emi hɛn nã no.
Hom nkyia Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, nye enuanom a wɔka hɔn ho no.
Hom nkyia Philologus nye Julia, Nereus nye n'akyerɛbaa, nye Olympas, nye ahotsewfo a wɔka hɔn ho no nyina.
Hom mfa mfewano krɔnkrɔn nkyiankyia homho nkorkor. Christ Jesus asɔrasɔr nyina kyiakyia hom.
Na afei, enuanom, meserɛ hom dɛ, hɔn a wɔdze mpaapaamu ba na wɔto fintsidua a otsia nkyerɛkyerɛ a hom esūa no, hom mbɔ hɔn nyikam, na hom ntwe homho mfi hɔn ho.
Na hɔn a wɔtse dɛm no wɔnnsom hɛn Ewuradze Christ, na mbom hɔnankasa hɔn yafun a, na wɔdze tɛkyerɛma-dɛw nye adɔkɔdɔkɔsɛm daadaa hɔn a wonnyim biribi akoma.
Na homdze, hom setsie atahye edu nyimpa nyina asomu. Iyi ntsi midzi hom ho dɛw, naaso mepɛ dɛ hom yɛ enyansafo wɔ papa ho, na hom yɛ krɔnn wɔ bɔn ho.
Na asomdwee Nyankopɔn bodwuruw Satan wɔ hom ananadze ntsɛmara. Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ adom nkã hom.
M'afɛ dwumadzinyi Timothy kyia hom; nye m'ebusuafo Lucius nye Jason nye Sosipater.
Emi Tertius a mekyerɛw nwoma yi, mikyia hom Ewuradze mu.
Gaius a ɔsom me nye asɔrmba nyina hɔnho no kyia hom. Erastus a ɔyɛ kurow yi mu sikakurafo no ɔnye no nua Ɔuartus kyia hom.
Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Christ adom nye hom nyina ntsena. Amen.
Na afei, nyia otum dɛ ɔhyɛ hom dzen, dɛ mbrɛ m'asɛmpa nye Jesus Christ ho asɛnka tse, dɛ mbrɛ esuasɛm nyikyerɛ a wofir tsetse esie no fõo no,
Na afei dze woeyi no edzi, na ɔnam nkɔnhyɛfo kyerɛwnsɛm no do, dɛ mbrɛ onnyiewiei Nyankopɔn ne mbrasɛm tse no, woyi kyerɛ amanaman nyina kɔ gyedzi setsie mu,
Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛ nyansafo kortoo no, ɔno na enyimnyam ndua Jesus Christ nkã no afebɔɔ. Amen.

1: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu no a atsɛmbuafo buu atsɛn no, ɔkɔm baa asaase no do. Na ɔbarimba bi a ofi Beth-lehem-Judah otutui kɛtsenaa Moab man mu, ɔnoara, na ne yer, na ne mbabanyin beenu.
Na ɔbarimba no ne dzin dze Elimelech, na ne yer dzin dze Naomi, na ne mbabanyin beenu no edzin nye Mahlon na Chilion, Ephrathfo a wofi Beth-lehem-Judah a. Na wɔbaa Moab man mu, na wɔtsenaa hɔ.
Na Naomi no kun Elimelech wui; na ɔkaa ɔnoara, na ne mbabanyin beenu no.
Na wohyiahyiaa yernom wɔ Moab mbaa no mu; ɔbaako ne dzin dze Orpah, na ɔbaako no so ne dzin dze Ruth: Na wɔtsenaa hɔ araa bɛyɛ mfe du.
Na Mahlon na Chilion hɔn beenu nyina so wuwui; na ɔbaa no ne mba beenu no na no kun no daan no gyae.
Nna ɔnye ne nsewnom soɛree dɛ ɔresan efi Moab man mu akɔ: Osiandɛ ɔtsee no wɔ Moab man mu mbrɛ Ewuradze esi abɛserɛ ne man dɛ ɔrema hɔn edziban.
Na osii mu fii beebi mbrɛ ɔwɔ no, na ne nsewnom beenu no kã no ho; na wosii kwan do dɛ ɔresan akɔ Judah asaase do.
Na Naomi see ne nsewnom beenu no dɛ, hom nkɔ, obiara nsan nkɔ ne nã fie: Ewuradze nye hom ndzi no ayamuyie mu, dɛ mbrɛ hom nye ewufo no, na ɔnye emi edzi no no.
Ewuradze ndom hom ma hom mu biara nnya ahomgye wɔ no kun fie. Nna ofeew hɔn ano; na wɔmemaa hɔn ndze do, na wosūi.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, dabida, mbom yɛnye wo bɛsan akɔ wo nkorɔfo nkyɛn.
Na Naomi see dɛ, me mbabaa, hom nsan hom ekyir; ebɛnazde ntsi na hom nye me bɔkɔ? Ana meda ho wɔ mbabanyin wɔ me yamu, ma wɔaabɛyɛ hom kunnom?
Me mbabaa, hom nsann hom ekyir, wɔnkɔ hom kwan; na menyin dodow dɛ mibenya kun. Sɛ mese dɛ, mowɔ enyidado, na so mpo mirinya okun anago yi, na so morowo mbabanyin a;
ana dɛm ntsi nkyɛ hom bɔtweɔn ma woeenyinyin anaa? Ana nkyɛ dɛm ntsi hom besiw homho kwan dɛ wɔnkɔhwehwɛ kunnom? Dabida, me mbabaa; ɔyɛ me awerɛhow dodow wɔ hom ntsi, na Ewuradze nsa asoɛr wɔ mo do.
Na wɔmemaa hɔn ndze do, na wosuu bio: Na Orpah feew n'asew no ano; na Ruth dze, ɔtakyeer no ho.
Na ɔsee dɛ, hwɛ, wo korafowa asan n'ekyir kɔ no nkorɔfo nkyɛn, na ne nyame nkyɛn: San kedzi wo korafowa no ekyir.

Na Ruth see dɛ, mma nhyɛ me dɛ mendan wo ngya, na mingyaa w'ekyir dzi nsan nkɔ: Na beebiara mbrɛ ebɔkɔ no, mobɔkɔ, na mbrɛ ebɔsoɛ no, na mobɔsoɛ: Wo nkorɔfo bɛyɛ mo nkorɔfo, na wo Nyankopɔn ayɛ me Nyankopɔn:
Mbrɛ ibowu ada, na mubowu ada, na hɔ ara na wobesie me: Ewuradze mma dza ɔyɛ yaw nyɛ me, ebu mbu me, sɛ biribiara, gyedɛ owu, paa emi na ɔwo ntamu a.
Na aber a ohun dɛ ɔayɛ n'adwen dzendzenndzen dɛ ɔnye no bɔkɔ no, ogyaa dɛ ɔkasa kyerɛ no.
Nna ɔbaa dɛ, wodur Beth-lehem no, kurow no nyinara bɔɔ twitwi baa hɔn nkyɛn, na mbaa no see dɛ, ana Naomi nye yi?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, mma wɔmmfrɛ me Naomi, wɔmfrɛ me Mara: Na Otumfo nye me edzi no wenwen dodow.
Mokɔr no mã, na Ewuradze dze me pan aba fie bio: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom frɛ me Naomi, aber a Ewuradze ebua me atsɛn, na otumfo no atseetsee me yi?
Nna Naomi sanee bae, na n'asew Ruth, Moabnyi a ofi Moab man mu no kã no ho sanee bae: Na wobodur Beth-lehem wɔ atoko twaber ahyɛse mu.
2: Na Naomi wɔ no kun no busuanyi bi, ɔbarimba kunyin bi, ofi Elimelech n'ebusua mu; na ne dzin dze Boaz.
Na Ruth, Moabnyi no see Naomi dɛ, afei ma monkɔ haban mu minkedzi eburow mbɛtsem mpɛpɛw wɔ nyia mibenya n'enyim enyimnyam no ekyir. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Me babaa, Kɔ ɛ.
Na osii mu kɔree, na okedzii mpɛpɛw wɔ haban mu wɔ etwafo no ekyir: Na ɔbaa dɛ okefiir haban a ɔyɛ Boaz a ofi Elimelech ebusua mu no nedze mu.
Na, hwɛ, Boaz fi Beth-lehem bae, na ɔsee etwafo no dɛ, Ewuradze ndzi hom ekyir. Na wɔgyee no do dɛ, Ewuradze nhyira wo.
Nna Boaz see n'akowaa a ɔhwɛ etwafo no do no dɛ, Woana n'akataasia nye yi?
Na akowaa no a ɔhwɛ etwafo no do no buae see dɛ, Moabnyi akataasia no a ɔnye Naomi fi Moab man mu sanee bae no a:
Na ɔsee dɛ, meserɛ wo, ma mindzi etwafo no ekyir mindzi mpɛpɛw, na mentasetase efīefī no ntamu: Nna ɔbae, na ɔdze mu araa dze fi anapa dze ebodu sisei, dan mu na gyama ɔtsenaa kakraabi.
Nna Boaz see Ruth dɛ, me babaa, enntse a? Mma nnkɔ haban bi so mu nnkedzi mpɛpɛw, nkyii so mma mmfi ha, na tsena ha tsintsim me mbaawa nkyɛn.

Ma w'enyi mbra haban a worutwa no do, na dzi hɔn ekyir: Ana mennhyɛɛ mberantsɛ no dɛ mma mma wɔmmfa hɔn nsa nnkã wo bi a? Na sɛ nsukɔm dze wo a, kɔ ndzɛmba no ho, na kɔnom dza mberantsɛ no akɛsaw no bi.
Nna ɔdze n'enyim butuwii, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ famu, na ɔsee no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na menya w'enyim enyimnyam, na w'enyi kukū emi a meyɛ ɔhɔho ho yi?

Na Boaz buae na ɔsee no dɛ, ɔkã na wɔakã dza wo kun wu ekyir no edze ayɛ w'asew no nyinara akyerɛ me: Na mbrɛ esi egya w'egya na wo nã, na w'awobea asaase, na aba nkorɔfo a innyim hɔn dada bi nkyɛn no.
Ewuradze nhyɛ wo dwumadzi ananmu, na Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn no a aba robɔdɔ n'atsaban ase no, ɔmfa akatua imu mma wo.
Nna ɔsee dɛ, Mo wura ma minnya w'enyim enyimnyam; osiandɛ ɔwoara akyekye mo werɛ, na akasa ayamuyie mu akyerɛ w'abaawa, kaansa menntse dɛ wo mbaawa no mu bi mpo a.
Na edzidziber sõe no Boaz see no dɛ, bra ha, na bedzi edziban no bi, na fa wo trɔma bɔ mfenangya no mu. Na ɔbɛtsenaa etwafo no nkyɛn: Na wɔmaa no eburow kyewee na ɔwee mee ma bi kae.
Na aber a ɔsoɛree dɛ orikedzi mpɛpɛw no, Boaz hyɛɛ ne mberantsɛ no dɛ, wɔmma ondzi efīefi no mpo mu mpɛpɛw, na mma wɔnnhyɛ no ahoraa.
Na eso wɔntwetwe mboano no bi ngu, na wɔndan ngya mma no, ma ondzi no mpɛpɛw, na mma wɔnnyeyaw no.
Nna odzii haban no mu mpɛpɛw ara kodur ewimbir; na ɔporoow dza odzii no mpɛpɛw no, na ɔyɛɛ bɛyɛ atoko ephah kor.
Na ɔmaa do, na ɔdze sii mu baa kurow no mu: Na n'asew no hun dza odzii no mpɛpɛw no: Na ɔdze dza odzii mee ne nkaa no bae na ɔdze maa no.

Na n'asew no see no dɛ, Ehen na ikedzii mpɛpɛw ndɛ? Na ekɛyɛɛ edwuma wɔ hen? Nhyira nkã nyia n'enyi kukūu wo ho no. Na ɔkyerɛɛ n'asew nyia ɔnye no kɛyɛɛ edwuma, na ɔsee dɛ, ɔbarimba a menye no kɛyɛɛ edwuma ndɛ no ne dzin dze Boaz.
Na Naomi see n'asew no dɛ, Ewuradze nhyira nyia onngyaa atseasefo na ewufo ayamuyie yɛ no. Na Naomi see no dɛ, ɔbarimba no yɛ obusuanyi a ɔbɛn hɛn, hɛn ebusuafo a wɔbɛn no mu baako a.
Na Ruth, Moabnyi no see dɛ, nyew, ɔsee me dɛ, ɔwo takyer me mberantsɛ yi ho araa kodu dɛ wobowie mo ndɔbaa nyinara twa.
Na Naomi see n'asew Ruth dɛ, me babaa, oye dɛ enye ne mbaawa no befir edzi, na woeennhyia wo wɔ haban bi mu.
Nna ɔtakyeer Boaz mbaawa no ho dzii mpɛpɛw dze kodur atoko twaber na ewifua twaber ewiei; na ɔnye n'asew tsenae.
3: Na n'asew Naomi see no dɛ, me babaa, ana monnkɔhwehwɛ ahomgye mama wo, ma wɔaakɔ wo yie?
Na afei ana hɛn busuanyi Boaz a ekɔr ne mbaawa nkyɛn no nnyi hɔ bi a? Hwɛ, oruhuw atoko do anago yi wɔ ewuporowee.
Dɛm ntsi hohor woho, na sera, na fa w'atar hyɛ, na sian kɔ ewuporowee hɔ: Na mma nnyi woho nnkyerɛ ɔbarimba no araa ma onwie edzidzi na ɔnnom ansaana.
Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ɔkɛda a, ahyɛ beebi mbrɛ ɔbɛkɛda no nsew, na akɔ hɔ, na ekeyi n'anaafo tam, na ada hɔ; na ɔnoara bɛkã dza yɛ kyerɛ wo.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, dza ese nyinara mebɛyɛ.
Na osii mu kɔr ewuporowee no, na ɔkɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ n'asew hyɛɛ no no nyinara.
Na Boaz dzidzii na ɔnomee, na n'akoma tɔɔ ne yamu no, osii mu kɔree kɛdaa eburow kuw no ano hɔ: Na otsiaa dɔn dɔn bae, na obeyii n'anaafo tam, na ɔdaa hɔ.
Na ɔbaa dɛ esuom no, ɔbarimba no bɔɔ pikyiw, na otwaa adafa: Na, hwɛ, ɔbaa bi da n'anaafo.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Woana nye wo? Na obuaa dɛ, Mara w'abaawa Ruth a: Dɛm ntsi tserɛw wo nsiase mu fa kata w'abaawa do; osiandɛ obusuanyi a ɔbɛn nye wo.
Na ɔsee dɛ, me babaa, Ewuradze nhyira wo: Ekyir yi akyerɛ ayamuyie dodow asen ahyɛse no, susuampaa dɛ annkã mberantsɛ do, ehiafo o, ebirɛmpɔmfo o.
Na afei, me babaa, mma nsuro; dza ese nyinara mebɛyɛ mama wo osiandɛ mo nkorɔfo kuropon ano nyinara nyim dɛ ɔbaa pa nye wo.
Na afei ɔyɛ nokwar dɛ obusuanyi a ɔbɛn nye me: Naaso obusuanyi bi a ɔbɛn dodow sen me wɔ hɔ.

Tsintsim anago yi, na ɔmbra dɛ anapa, na sɛ ɔyɛ obusuanyi afamudze dze ma wo a, oye; ma ɔnyɛ obusuanyi afamudzi no: Na sɛ ɔnnkɛpɛ dɛ ɔyɛ obusuanyi afamudze dze ma wo a, ɔnodze, dɛ Ewuradze tse ase yi, mara mebɛyɛ obusuanyi afamudze dze ama wo: Da ma adze nkye ana.
Na ɔdaa n'anaafo hɔ ma adze kyee: Na ɔsoɛree ansaana obi rutum hu ne nyɛnko yie. Na ɔsee dɛ, Mma wonnhu dɛ ɔbaa no baa ewuporowee no do.
Na ɔsee dɛ, fa akatakɔnmu no a ogu wo do no bra, na suo mu; na osuoo mu: Na osusuu atoko etwadze esia, na ɔdze soaa no: Na osii mu kɔr kurow no mu.
Na ɔbaa n'asew nkyɛn no ɔsee dɛ, wɔyɛ no dɛn, me babaa? Na ɔkãa dza ɔbarimba no dze yɛɛ no nyinara kyerɛɛ no.
Na ɔsee dɛ, atoko etwadze esia yi na ɔdze maa me; na ɔsee dɛ, mma mmfa nsapan nnkɔ w'asew nkyɛn.
Nna ɔsee dɛ, me babaa tsena hɔ dzinn, na hu mbrɛ asɛm no besi ana: Na ɔbarimba no renngye n'ahom araa kyerɛ oewie asɛm no dzi ndɛ da yi.
4: Afei Boaz sii mu kɔr kuropon no ano, na ɔkɛtsenaa hɔ: Na, hwɛ, obusuanyi a ɔbɛn no a Boaz kãa no ho asɛm no botwaa mu; na ɔsee no dɛ, hwɛ o, osimesi e! Man bra, bɛtsena famu ha. Na ɔmanee, na ɔkɛtsenaa famu.
Na ɔfaa kurow no mu mpanyimfo mu mbarimba du, na ɔsee dɛ, hom ntsena famu ha. Na wɔtsenaa famu.
Na ɔsee obusuanyi a ɔbɛn no dɛ, Naomi a ofi Moab man mu asan aba no, ɔrotɔn asaasetɔw no a ɔyɛ hɛn nua Elimelech dze no:

Na modween dɛ mebɛda no edzi makyerɛ wo, dɛ, tɔ no wɔ hɔn a wɔtsena ha yi enyim, na me man mpanyimfo yi enyim. Sɛ ebɔpon a, pon: Na sɛ ennkɔpon so a, ɔno kã kyerɛ me, ma munhu: Osiandɛ obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔpon kã wo ho; na emi na midzi w'ekyir. Na ɔsee dɛ, mobɔpon.
Nna Boaz see dɛ, da biara a ebɔtɔ Naomi nsamu haban no, nna ewɔ dɛ etɔ no wɔ Moabnyi Ruth a ɔyɛ owufo yer no so hɔ, na ama owufo no ne dzin do wɔ n'egyapadze do.
Na obusuanyi a ɔbɛn no see dɛ, murunntum mommpon mma moho, ɔno bɛyɛ na masɛɛ mankasa m'egyapadze: Ɔwoara fa mo pon ho eyiedzi no fa, na murunntum mommpon.
Afei iyi nye atɔrmuadze a nkan no ɔwɔ Israel wɔ ɔpon ho na nsesa ho, ma wɔdze hyɛ ndzɛmba nyinara dzen; nyimpa yi ne mpaboa, na ɔdze ma ne nyɛnko: Na iyi nye mbrɛ wosi hyɛ dase wɔ Israel mu.
Dɛm ntsi obusuanyi a ɔbɛn no see Boaz dɛ, woara tɔ fa. Na oyii ne mpaboa.
Na Boaz see mpanyimfo no, na ɔman no nyinara dɛ, ndɛ da yi hom yɛ adasefo dɛ matɔ dza ɔyɛ Elimelech dze nyinara, na dza ɔyɛ Chilion na Mahlon dze nyinara, wɔ Naomi nsamu.

Nkyii so magye Moabnyi Ruth, Mahlon yer no, ma ɔaabɛyɛ me yer, ma maama owufo no ne dzin do wɔ n'egyapadze do, amma woeenntwa owufo no ne dzin emmfi no nuanom mu, na no kuropon ano: Hom yɛ adasefo ndɛ da yi.

Na ɔman no a wɔwɔ kuropon ano no nyinara, na mpanyimfo no see dɛ, yɛyɛ adasefo. Ewuradze nyɛ ɔbaa no a ɔaba wo fie no dɛ Rachel na Leah a hɔn beenu no kyekyeer Israel fi no: Na yɛ okunyin wɔ Ephrathah, na gye dzin wɔ Beth-lehem:
Na ɔmma wo fi nyɛ dɛ Perez a Tamar woo no maa Judah no ne fi, wɔ asefɔ a Ewuradze dze fi ababaawa yi mu bɛma wo no mu.
Nna Boaz faa Ruth, na ɔbɛyɛɛ ne yer; na ɔkɔr ne nkyɛn, na Ewuradze maa onyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin.
Na ɔbaa no see Naomi dɛ, Nhyira nkã Ewuradze a ɔamma obusuanyi a ɔbɛn ammbɔ wo ndɛ da yi, na wɔmma ongye ne dzin wɔ Israel mu.
Na ɔbɛyɛ nkwamafo ama wo, na wo mpanyinyɛber mu ɔhwɛfo: Osiandɛ w'asew a ɔdɔ wo a oye ma wo ma ɔsen mbabanyin beesuon, awo no.
Na Naomi faa abofra no, na ɔdze no too no bo mu, na ɔbɛyɛɛ ne gyegyefo.
Na n'efisamenafo mbaa no maa no dzin dɛ, wɔawo babanyin ama Naomi; na wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Obed: Ɔno nye David n'egya Jesse n'egya.
Afei iyinom nye Perez ne mbasantsen: Perez woo Hezron;
na Hezron woo Ram, na Ram woo Amminadab;
na Amminadab woo Nahshon, na Nahshon woo Salmon;
Na Salmon woo Boaz, na Boaz woo Obed;
na Obed woo Jesse na Jesse woo David.

1: Ndwom mu ndwom a ɔyɛ Solomon dze.
Ma ɔmfa n'ano mfewano mfew m'ano:
Wo seradze yɛ huam papa; wo dzin tse dɛ ngohuam a woehue egu; dɛm ntsi na mbaabun dɔ wo a.
Twe me; yɛdze mbirika bedzi w'ekyir: Ɔhen dze me aba ne mpia mu: Hɛn enyi bɛgye na yeedzi ehurusi wɔ wo mu, yɛbɔbɔ wo dɔ dzin asen nsã: N'akwantsen ara na wɔdɔ wo a.
Mibir dze, naaso mo ho yɛ fɛw, Jerusalem mbabaa e, dɛ mbrɛ Kedar asese tse, dɛ mbrɛ Solomon nkatahotam tse.
Mma nnhwɛ me dɛ mebir ntsi, dɛ ewia ahye me ntsi. Me nã mbabanyin bo fuuw me, wɔdze me yɛɛ wenyin nture mu ɔhwɛfo; na mbom mankasa mo wenyin ture no mannhwɛ.
ɔwo a me kra dɔ wo, kã kyerɛ me, henfa na enyɛn wo nguan, henfa na ema wɔhom ewiaber? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na menyɛ dɛ nyia wɔakata n’enyim; wɔ wo mfɛfo hɔn nguankuw nkyɛn?
Ao, mbaa mu ɔhoɔfɛfo, sɛ ɔwo innyim a, kɔ, ketsin nguankuw anamɔn no, na nyɛn wo nguambaa wɔ nguanhwɛfo ntamadan no nkyɛn.
M’Adamfowa e, medze wo mato Pharaoh ne ntseaseanam ɔpɔnkɔ ho.
W’afon yɛ fɛw wɔ tsidwow mu, wo kɔn yɛ few wɔ ntweaban mu.
Yɛbɛyɛ sika edwindzi ndwowee ama wo a dwetɛ sisi mu.
Aber a ɔhen tse no pon ho no, nna me seradzehuam ayɛ huatsee.
Mo dɔfo yɛ myrrh-siaw dze ma me, ɔda m’enumfo ntamu.
Mo dɔfo tse dɛ henna-siaw dze ma me wɔ Engedi wenyin nture mu.
Hwɛ, m’adamfowa, wo ho yɛ fɛw; hwɛ, wo ho yɛ fɛw; w'enyiwamba tse dɛ ebubur dze.
Hwɛ, mo dɔfo, wo ho yɛ fɛw, nyew, wo ho yɛ akɔndɔ: Hɛn mpikyi so yɛ efuw momon.
Hɛn dan no mpuna yɛ cedar na hɛn mpar so yɛ kupresi.
2: Emidze meyɛ Sharon nhyiren, nbɔnsa mu esukookoo.
Mbrɛ esukookoo tse wɔ nsoɛ mu no, dɛmara so na m'adamfowa tse wɔ mbabaa mu
Dɛ mbrɛ aperdua tse wɔ haban mu ndua mu no, dɛmara so na mo dɔfo tse wɔ mbabanyin mu. Medze enyigye kɛse tsenaa no nwinwin ase, na no nduadzewa yɛɛ m’anomu dɔkɔdɔkɔ.
Ɔdze me baa aponto ase, na ne frankaa a osi mo do yɛ ɔdɔ.
Hom mfa esikyireamba nsianka me, hom mfa aper nkyekye mo werɛ: Osiandɛ meyar ɔdɔ.
N’abankum da me tsiadze, na n’abanyimfa abra me.
Jerusalem mbabaa e, mekã Nwansan, na nsatwe a wɔwɔ hamu, dɛ mma hom mmpusuw ɔdɔ, anaa wonnyan no, kyerɛ noara ɔpɛ.
Mo dɔfo ne ndze nye no! Hwɛ, ɔreba, oruhuruhuruw mbepɔw do, ɔrobɔ nkoko do mpentsenkwa.
Mo dɔfo tse dɛ wansan anaadɛ ɔtweba: Hwɛ, ogyina hɛn fasu ekyir, ɔhwɛ ntokura mu, onyinam noho wɔ atenatokura mu.
Mo dɔfo kasae na ɔsee me dɛ, soɛr, m’adamfowa, me yima, na bra ɛ.
Na, hwɛ, awɔwber etwa mu, esusow atsew na ɔkɔ;
Nhyiren efifir asaase do; nnoma adwontober edu, wɔtse atamram nka wɔ hɛn asaase do;
adɔmbadua n’amba ebun ebun reber, na wenyinndua robɔ nhyiren, woriyi hɔn huam. M’adamfowa e, me yima e, soɛr na bra ɛ.
Ao m’ebubur, ɔwo a ewɔ ɔbotan ne mpaae mu, wɔ bea sorɔnsorɔm no n’ehuntsae mu, ma munhu w’enyim, ma mentse wo ndze; na wo ndze yɛ dɛw, na wo ho yɛ fɛw.
Hom nkyekyer nsɔ no mma hɛn nsɔ nkakraba a wɔsɛɛ wenyin nture no; na hɛn wenyin nture no abobɔ nhyiren.
Mo dɔfo yeɛmedze, na meyɛ nedze: Ɔnyɛn no nguan wɔ nsukookoo mu.
Mo dɔfo, san w’ekyir, na yɛ dɛ ɔwansan anaadɛ ɔtweba a; ɔwo Bether mbepɔw do, ma onkodu dɛ wi ano bɔdwe, na sunsuma bɛsen akɔ.
3: Me mpa do anago na mohwehwɛɛ nyia me kra dɔɔ no no: Mohwehwɛɛ no, na mennhu no.
Mesee dɛ, afei mobɔsoɛr, na mekekyin kurow no ho, wɔ abrɔn mu na gua do, mobɔhwehwɛ nyia me kra dɔ no no: Mohwehwɛɛ no, na mennhu no.
Aweɔmfo a wokyin kurow no ho no hun me: Hɔn na mesee hɔn dɛ, ana hom ehu nyia me kra dɔ no no?
Mepaa hɔn ho kakra ara pɛr, nna muhun nyia me kra dɔ no no: Musuoo no mu dɛ minnkegyaa no ma ɔaakɔ, ekodu dɛ medze no enya aba me nã fie, na nyia onyinseen me no ne pia mu ana.
Jerusalem mbabaa e, mekã nwansan na nsatwe a wɔwɔ hamu, dɛ mma hom mmpusuw ɔdɔ, anaa wonnyan no, kyerɛ noara ɔpɛ.
Woana nye oyi a ofi sar do reba dɛ wusiw fadum, myrrh na krɔbɔw, na oguadzifo nduhuam ayɛ no ho huatsee yi?
Hwɛ, Solomon n’apakan a; mbarimba akatakyi eduosia na woetwa ho ehyia, Israel mbarimba akatakyi no mu bi a.
Hɔn nyinara wɔdzedze mfõwa, na wɔawea asayɛ ho: Nyimpa biara n'afõwa bɔ n'asen; wɔ anago wubɔ ntsi.
Ɔhen Solomon yɛɛ denkyedenkye maa noho, ɔdze Lebanon ndua.
Ɔdze dwetɛ yɛɛ ne fadum no. N’ase no so sika a, n'egua no ɔberdum a; Jerusalem mbabaa wɔdze bakundua Edura no mu no.
Zion mbabaa e, hom mfir edzi mbɔhwɛ ɔhen Solomon a ɔbo n’abɔtsir a ne nã dze bɔɔ ne tsir wɔ n’ayehyia da, da a n’akoma nyaa enyigye no.
4: Hwɛ, wo ho yɛ fɛw, m’adamfowa; hwɛ, wo ho yɛ fɛw; w’enyiwamba tse dɛ ebubur dze wɔ w’akataenyim n’ekyir: Wo tsinhwi tse dɛ mpɔnkyekuw a Wobutubutuw Gilead bepɔw ho.
Wo sē tse dɛ nguanmber kuw a woetwitwa hɔn ho nhwi fofor a Wofi eguaree aba; hɔn nyinara wɔawowo nta nta, na hɔn mu biara nndzi awo-mba-ewu.
W’anofamfa tse dɛ adaaben ahoma, na w’ano kasa yɛ dɛw: W’asontoɔmu tse dɛ pomegranate-ekutu fã; wɔ wo nkataenyim n’ekyir.
Wo kɔndua tse dɛ Dayid abantsentsen a woesi ama akodze a; dadze nkataenyim apem sensɛn ho, ne nyinara akatakyifo hɔn akyɛm a.
W’enumfo ebien tsetse dɛ wansanmba ebien a wɔyɛ ntafo a; wodzidzi nsukookoo mu.
Mobɔkɔ myrrh bepɔw, na krɔbɔw koko no do, ma ekodu dɛ wi ano bɔdwe, na sunsuma bɛsen akɔ.
Wo ho nyinara yɛ fɛw, m’adamfowa; na dzɛm biara nnyi wo ho.
Ma yemfi Lebanon, m’ayefor, ma yemfi Lebanon nkɔ: Ma yemfi Amana etsifi, yemfi Senir na Hermon etsifi, yemfi ngyata buw no do, yemfi nsebɔ mbepɔw no do nhwɛ famu.
M'akyerɛbaa, m’ayefor, ɔwo atwe m’akoma, edze w’enyiwa mu kor atwe m'akoma, edze wo kɔn mu ntweaban kor.
M’akyerɛbaa, m’ayefor, mbrɛ wo dɔ dua no ho yɛ ahomka a! Mbrɛ wo dɔ dua ye sen nsã a! Na mbrɛ wo seradze ne nka dua yɛ huam sen nduhuam nyinara a!
Ao m’ayefor, w’ano sosɔw dɛ wokyɛm: Ewo na numfonsu wɔ wo tɛkyerɛma ase; na w’atar no huam tse dɛ Lebanon no huam.
Ture a wɔatow mu nye m'akyerɛbaa, m’ayefor; nsunyiwa a woesiw ano, nsubura a wɔasɔw ano.
Wo mfefɛwee tse dɛ pomegranate ekutu ture a no mu aba som bo; henna na seradzehuam ndua,
Seradzehuam na saffron, Calamus na cinnamon, na krɔbɔw ndua nyinara; myrrh na aloe, ɔnye nduhuam etsitsir nyinara.
ɔwo eyɛ nture mu nsunyiwa, ɔwo eyɛ mbasu, na esutsen a ofi Lebanon pem.
Kwaamu mframa, nyan; na ɔwo pomu afamu, bra; bɔ fa mo ture do, ma no mu nduhuam ntu mpetse. Ma mo dɔfo mbra no ture mu, na ombedzi no nduadzewa a ɔsom no no bi.
5: M’akyerɛbaa, m’ayefor, maba wo ture mu oo: Matsetsew me myrrh akã m’eduhuam ho; medzi mo wokyɛm akã mo wo ho; manom me nsã akã m’enumfonsu ho. Mfɛfo e, hom ndzidzi oo; adɔfo e, hom nnom, nyew, hom nnom tosee.
Medae, na m’akoma nyanee: Mo dɔfo a ɔrobɔ mu ne ndze a, dɛ, m’akyerɛbaa, m’adamfowa, m’ebubur, m’adze-a-idzi-mu e, bue me ɛ: Na bɔw atɔ me tsir do mã, anago bɔw ayɛ me mpɛsɛw mã.
Mapɔr m’atar; meyɛ dɛn mehyɛ? Mahohor m’anan ho; meyɛ dɛn mugu ho fi?
Mo dɔfo tseen ne nsa duaa abow no tokura no mu, na me yamu hyehyee me maa no.
Mosoɛɛr dɛ murukobue mo dɔfo; na me nsa ho sosɔɔw myrrh, na me nsatseaba sosɔɔw myrrh a ɔanan, guguu krɔkrɔw n’esuomu no do.
Mubuei maa mo dɔfo; Nna mo dɔfo atwe noho, na ɔkɔ. Ber a ɔkasae no, m’ahom pae: Mohwehwɛɛ no, na mennhu no; mefrɛfrɛɛ no, na ɔanngye me do.
Aweɔmfo a wokyin kurow no ho no hun me, wɔbobɔɔ me, wopirapiraa me. Afasu no ho ahwɛfo no yii me nkataenyim kɔree.
Ao Jerusalem mbabaa, mekã ntam gu hom do dɛ sɛ hom hu mo dɔfo no a, ɔno hom nse no dɛ meyar ɔdɔ.
Adze bɛn na wo dɔfo dze sen ɔdɔfo bi, ɔwo mbaa mu ɔhoɔfɛfo kɛse? Adze bɛn na wo dɔfo dze sen ɔdɔfo bi, na ɔwo kã ntam gu hɛn do dɛm yi?
Mo dɔfo hoa na ɔber mu, ɔpedu mu dansewa a.
Ne tsir tse dɛ sika pa mapa, ne tsir do nhwi fukuww, dukuduku dɛ akonkoran.
N’enyiwamba tse dɛ esutsen ho mbubur; wɔdze numfonsu ahohɔr, na woesisi yie.
N’afon tse dɛ nduhuam akɔfi, dɛ nduadzewa dɛɛdɛw a wɔahohɔr isiw. N’anofamfa tse dɛ esukookoo a ɔsosɔw myrrh nanee.
Ne nsa tse dɛ sika mpɛtsea a wɔdze beryl esisi do: Ne nyimpadua tse dɛ asombɛn edwindzi a wɔdze sapphire-abo edura ho.
No ntwer tse dɛ marble edum a osisi sika pa ngyinado do: No suban tse de Lebanon, fɛfɛɛfɛw dɛ cedar-ndua.
N’anomu yɛ huam dodow: Ɔyew, no ho nyinara yɛ akɔndɔ. Mo dɔfo no nye yi, na me nyɛnko no nye yi, Ao Jerusalem mbabaa.
6: Henfa na wo dɔfo kɔ, ɔwo mbaa mu ɔhoɔfɛfo kɛse? Henfa na wo dɔfo etwa noho afa, ma yɛnye wo nkɔhwehwɛ no?
Mo dɔfo esian kɔ no ture mu, nduhuam akɔfi no mu, Dɛ orikedzidzi wɔ ture mu, na ɔatsetsɛw nsukookoo.
Emidze meyɛ mo dɔfo nedze, na mo dɔfo so yɛ medze: Ɔnyɛn no nguankuw wɔ nsukookoo no mu.
Ao m’adamfowa, wo ho yɛ fɛw dɛ Tirzah, Eyɛ oyima dɛ Jerusalem, wo ho yɛ hu dɛ dɔm a wɔdze mfrankaa.
Yi w’enyiwa fa fi mo do, na oedzi mo do nyim. Wo tsinhwi tse dɛ mpɔnkyekuw a wobutubutuw Gilead bepɔw nkyɛn.
Wo sē tse dɛ nguamber a wofi eguaree aba a hɔn nyinara wɔawowo nta nta, na hɔn mu biara nndzi awo-mba- ewu.
W’asontɔrmu tse dɛ pomegranate-ekutu fã; wɔ wo nkataenyim no mu.
Ahembaa eduosia, na nwewefo eduowɔtwe, na mbaabun a wonnyi anobu na wɔwɔ ho.
M’ebubur, m’adze-a-odzi-mu, ɔyɛ ɔbaako ara pɛr; ne nã ne ba kor ara nye no; nyia ɔwoo no no n’adɔnadze nye no. Mbabaa hun no, na wɔfrɛɛ no osiarfo; ampaara, ahembaa na nwewefo so, na wɔkamfoo no.
Woana nye nyia opue dɛ adzekyee, ɔyɛ fɛw dɛ bosoom, n'enyim tsew dɛ ewia, no ho yɛ dɛ dɔm a wɔdze mfrankaa yi?

Misianee mokɔr nkatse ture no mu, dɛ morokɔhwɛ bɔnsa no mu ndua ebun ebun, dɛ morokɔhwɛ bɔnsa no mu ndua ebun ebun, dɛ morokɔhwɛ dɛ wenyindua no abɔ nkukuduuduw, na dɛ pomegranate-ekutu no abɔ nhyiren a.
Ansaana mara murubohu no, nna me kra dze me esisi me mna mbapɔmba hɔn ntseaseanam mu.
San bra, san bra, ao Shulamnyi; san bra, san bra, ma yɛnhwɛ wo, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom bɔhwɛ Shulamnyi no, dɛ gyama hom rohwɛ Mahanaim asaw?
7: Ao ɔhen ne babaa, mbrɛ wo mpaboa mu anamɔntutu dua yɛ fɛw a! W’aserɛ no ntoado tse dɛ edwindzi a odwimfo pa ne nsa ayɛ.
Wo funuma tse dɛ kuraba korkorba a nsã mforaforae mmpa mu: Wo yafun tse dɛ ewifua kuw a wɔdze nsukookoo abɔ ho aprɔw.
W’enumfo ebien tsetse dɛ wansanmba beenu a wɔyɛ ntafo.
Wo kɔndua tse dɛ asombɛn abantsentsen; w’enyiwamba tse dɛ Heshbon nsutaae a ɔwɔ Bath-rabbim ɔponkɛse ho; wo hwen tse dɛ Lebanon abantsentsen a ɔdzi kɔ Damascus afamu no.
Wo tsir a ɔso wo tse dɛ Carmel, na wo tsir do nhwi tse dɛ adaaben; no do ataku akyer ɔhen no ndɔmmum.
Mbrɛ wo ho dua yɛ fɛw na mbrɛ eyɛ enyisɔ, ao m’adamfowa, wɔ enyigye enyigye mu a!
Wo pankor yi tse dɛ abɛdua, na w'enumfo tse dɛ esikyireamba siawsiaw.
Mekã dɛ, mobɔfow abɛdua no, mebɛtam esuo n'abaw no mu: Ma w'enumfo nyɛ dɛ wenyinamba siawsiaw, na wo hwen mu hūa nyɛ dɛ aper;
na w’anomu tse dɛ nsã pa a Osian kɔ mo dɔfo yie, ɔma hɔn a wɔatotɔ nkom buebue hɔn ano.
Meyɛ mo dɔfo nedze, na n’akɔndɔ gyina mo do.
Mo dɔfo e, bra ma yemfir edzi nkɔ haban mu; ma yɛnkɛtsena nkurobaadze.
Ma yɛnsoɛr ahanamakye nkɔ we nyin nture mu; ma yɛnkɔhwɛ dɛ wenyindua no abɔ nkukuduuduw, na ne nhyiren epuepue, na pomegranate-ekutu no abɔ nhyiren: Hɔ na mibeyi mo dɔ mama wo.
Mandrake no riyi huam, na hɛn mbobowano ahyɛ nduaba horow nyinara a wɔsom bo ma, afofor na adadaw a; medze esie ama wo, ao mo dɔfo.
8: Ao kɛtseankyɛ eyɛ mo nuabanyin a onuum me nã n’enumfo ano! Sɛ muhu wo wɔ ehuw mu beebi a, nkyɛ mibefew w’ano; nyew, na nkyɛ obiara nnkobu me enyimtsia.
Nkyɛ mibegya wo kwan, na medze wo aba me nã fie, na ɔakyerɛkyerɛ me adze; nkyɛ mebɛma anom nsã a eduhuam wɔ mu, mo pomegranate-ekutu mu nsã fenemfenem no bi.
N’abankum bɛda me tsiadze, na n’abanyimfa abar me.
Jerusalem mbabaa e, mekã mekã dɛ mma hom mpusuw ɔdɔ, anaa wonnyan no, kyerɛ noara ɔpɛ.
Woana nye nyia ofir sar do reba, ɔtwer no dɔfo no bo mu yi? Aperdua n’ase na minyaan wo: Hɔ na wo nã woo wo, hɔ na nyia ɔwoo wo no ɔkõo awo.
Fa me si w’akoma do dɛ nsɔwano, dɛ w’abaw do nsɔwano: Na ɔdɔ yɛ dzen dɛ owu; nyinkun ne tsirmu yɛ dzen dɛ adakamaa: N’enyinam yɛ ogya enyinam, Ewuradze ne gyaframee ara ampa.
Nsu pii nntum nndum ɔdɔ, nkyii so nsuyirii nntum nnkata do: Sɛ nyimpa dze fie adze nyinara bɛma wɔ ɔdɔ ntsi a, enyimtsia ara na wobobu no.
Yɛwɔ akyerɛbaa ekumaba bi, na ɔmmbɔɔ enumfo: Ebɛnadze na yɛbɛyɛ ama hɛn akyerɛbaa wɔ da a wɔbɛba ebebisa no ayewar no mu?
Sɛ ɔyɛ ɔfasu a, yɛbɔtow no do dwetɛ aban: Na sɛ ɔyɛ abow a, yɛdze cedar ntaabow botwa no ho ehyia.
Emidze meyɛ ɔfasu, na m’enumfo tse dɛ no do abantsentsen: Ɔno na meyɛɛ n’enyiwa do dɛ obi a oenya asomdwee.
Solomon nyaa wenyin ture wɔ Baal-hamon; ɔdze wenyin ture no hyɛɛ ahwɛfo nsa; no mu nduadzewa no ntsi, obiara obiara wɔ dɛ ɔdze dwetɛbona apem brɛ no.
Mo wenyin ture a ɔyɛ medze no ɔwɔ m’enyim: Ɔwo, Solomon, ibenya apem no, na hɔn a wɔhwɛ no nduadzewa no do no so wobenya ahaebien.
Ɔwo a etse nture mu, mfeɛo ritsie wo ndze: Ma mo so mintsie e.
Mo dɔfo, yɛ ntsɛm, na yɛ woho dɛ ɔwansan ɔtweba wɔ nduhuam mbepɔw no do.

1: Paul, Nyankopɔn Jesus Christ somafo, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi hɔn no hɔn gyedzi, nye nokwar a okura nyamesom ne nyimdzee no tse,
wɔ onnyiewiei nkwa do a Nyankopɔn a onndzi ator dze bɔɔ anohoba tsetseetse no ho enyidado mu,
na n'aber a ɔsɛ mu oyii n'asɛm edzi wɔ amandzɛɛ a wɔnam Nynakopɔn hɛn Agyenkwa ahyɛdze do dze hyɛɛ me nsa no mu;
dze kɛma Titus, mo nokwar ba wɔ gyedzi kor no ara mu; Adom nye Christ Jesus hɛn Agyenkwa hɔ nkã wo.
Iyi ntsi na medze wo migyaa Crete, ma aasesɛw ndzɛmba a ɔaka no pɛpɛɛpɛr, na aahyehyɛ panyimfo wɔ kurow biara mu dɛ mbrɛ mehyɛɛ wo;
mekyerɛ obi a no ho nnyi asɛm bi, ɔyer baako kun, na ɔwɔ mba agyedzifo a wɔnntse asakakabra anaa asoɔdzen nka wɔ hɔn ho.
Osiandɛ ɔhwɛfo ɔsɛ dɛ no ho nnyi asɛm dɛ Nyankopɔn fihwɛfo; ɔnnyɛ ntsintsiman, ebufuw ebufuw, nsahweam, pupopupo, odzifodzipɛfo;
na mbom ɔpɛ ahɔhoyɛ, ɔpɛ papa, n'adwen mu tsew, ɔtsen, no ho tsew, n'enyi dwe;
ɔdze nsɛm odzi nokwasɛm no mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔkyerɛ no tse, na oeetum dze nkyerɛkyerɛ pa etu fo, na oeeyi hɔn a wotsia no atsɛn.
Na asoɔdzenfo pii wɔ hɔ, nsɛnhuhukafo nye adaadaafo, nkanka hɔn a wofi etwatsiatwafo mu a ɔsɛ dɛ wosiw hɔn ano no:
nyimpa a mfaso tantan ntsi wɔkyerɛkyereɛ dza ɔnnsɛ dze butubutuw efiefi mpo.
Hɔn mu ɔbaako, hɔnankasa hɔn nkɔhyɛnyi, kã dɛ, Cretefo yɛ atorfo daa, mbowa bɔn, akwadwefo etumfur.
Dase yi yɛ nokwar. Dɛm ntsi kã hɔn enyim pasaa, ma woedzi mu wɔ gyedzi no mu,
amma wɔaammfa aso annkɔ Jewfo anansesɛm, nye hɔn a woetwa hɔnho efi nokwar no ho ahyɛdze do.
Adze nyina ho tsew ma hɔn a hɔn ho tsew: Na hɔn a wɔyɛ ahonamfi, na wɔnngye nndzi no dze, biribiara ho nntsew mma hɔn, na adwen nye hɔn tsibowa nyina ho wɔ fi.
Wɔkã dɛ wonyim Nyankopɔn, naaso wɔdze hɔn ndwuma san no, hɔn ho yɛ tan, wɔyɛ asoɔdzenfo, na wɔnnkan hɔn mmfora edwuma pa bi ara.
2: Na ɔwodze, kã nsɛm a ɔfata nkyerɛkyerɛ a odzi mu no:
Dɛ nkɔdaa nyɛ enyidahɔ nyɛ fɔntɔmm, hɔn adwen mu ntsew, nndzi mu wɔ gyedzi mu ɔdɔ mu, nye abotar mu:
dɛ mberwa so ndzi hɔnho nyi wɔ ndzeyɛɛ mu, wɔnnyɛ nsekubɔfo, wɔnnyɛ nsahwerm, wɔnkyerɛkyewrɛ edwuma pa;
ma wɔaanyɛn mbabaawa ma wɔaadɔ hɔn kunnom, wɔaadɔ hɔn mba,
na wɔaayɛ adwenmutsewfo, ahosiefo, fiedzeyɛfo, ayamuyiefo, aabeɛ hɔnho adze ama hɔnankasa hɔn kunnom, amma wɔaannkā Nyankopɔn asɛm ho asɛmbɔn;
mberantsɛ no so tu hɔn fo dɛmara ma wɔnyɛ adwenmutsewfo:
Adze nyina mu kyerɛ woho dɛ eyɛ ndwuma pa ho ntoho; nkyerɛkyerɛ kotooyɛ, fɔntɔmmyɛ,
ɔkasa a odzi mu a wonnya ho asɛm bi nnkã, ma nyia otsia hɛn no afɛr dɛ onnya asɛm bɔn bi nnkã.
Nkowaa nyɛ setsie mma hɔnankasa hɔn wuranom, wɔnsɔ hɔn enyi wɔ adze nyina mu, wonnyiyi hɔn asɛm ano;
wɔmmbebɛw adze, na mobom wɔnkyerɛ nokwardzi pa nyina, ma wɔdze aahoran Nyankopɔn hɛn Agyenkwa nkyerɛkyerɛ no wɔ adze nyina mu.
Na Nyankopɔn adom a ɔdze nkwagye brɛ nyimpa nyina eyi noho adzi,
ɔtsetse hɛn dɛ yɛmpa mbusubɔ nye wiadze akɔndɔ, na yɛmfa enyidado, nye tsenenee, nye nyamesompa ntsena sesei wiadze yi mu,
nhwɛ nhyira enyidado no, nye hɛn Nyankopɔn kɛse, hɛn Agyenkwa Jesus Christ n'enyimnyam mfirii no kwan;
ɔno a ɔdze noho mae maa hɛn, ma ɔaapon hɛn efi emumuyɛ nyina mu, na ɔaatsew ɔman a ɔyɛ nankasa nedze a ɔbɔ ndwuma papa ho mbɔdzen ho.
Iyinom no fa tum nyina kã, tu ho fo, na kã ho enyim. Mma obi mmbu wo enyimtsia.
3: Kaa hɔn ma wɔmbrɛ hɔnho adze mma mpanyimfo, nye tum horow nyina, ma wɔnyɛ setsie, na wonsiesie hɔnho mma edwuma pa biara;
wɔnnkã obiara ho asɛm bɔn, wɔnnyɛ etutuwpɛfo, wɔnyɛ bɛtɛɛ na wɔnnkyerɛ ɔdwe nyina wɔ nyimpa nyina do.
Na hɛn so nkyɛ nkan no yɛyɛ nkwasea, asoɔdzenfo, yɛafomfom, yɛsom akɔndɔ nye enyigyedze horow, yɛtse ɔyamugya nye nyitan mu, hɛn ho yɛ ehi, na yɛtentan hɛnho.
Na Nynakopɔn hɛn Agyenkwa n'ayamuyie nye no dɔ a ɔwɔ nyimpa do yii noho edzi no,
ommfi tsenenee mu ndwuma a yɛayɛ, na mbom ofi noara n'ehumbɔbɔr, na ɔnam awofofor eguar nye Sunsum Krɔkrɔn foforyɛ do gyee hɛn nkwa;
ɔno na ɔnam Jesus Christ hɛn Agyenkwa do huei guu hɛn do pii,
ma wɔnam n'adom do bu hɛn bem a, yaayɛ onnyiewiei nkwa hi enyidado no edzifo.
ɔyɛ nokwasɛm, na iyinom na mepɛ dɛ ekã no ɔdzendo, ma hɔn a wɔagye Nyankopɔn edzi aadwen do esuo ndwuma pa mu. Ndzɛmba yi ye na wɔyɛ mfaso ma nyimpa:
na nkwasea ekyingyebra nye nanakan, nye wentwiwentwi, nye mbra ho akasakasa dze, yi woho fi ho; osiandɛ mfaso nnyi ho na wɔyɛ adze gyan.
Mpaapaamu farbaa a akasa akyerɛ no prɛko nye mpɛn ebien no, yi no akwa:
hu dɛ obi a ɔtse dɛm no ɔakyea, ɔyɛ bɔn bu nankasa no ho fɔ.
Sɛ mosoma Artemas anaa Tychicus wɔ wo nkyɛn a, bɔ mbɔdzen bra me nkyɛn wɔ Nicopolis: Na hɔ na mesua me tsirmu dɛ mirikedzi awɔwber.
Bɔ mbɔdzen gya Zenas mbranyimfo no, nye Apollos kwan yie, mma eennhia hɔn hwee.
Na ma hɛn nkorɔfo so nsūa ndwuma pa ho mbɔdzembɔ wɔ dza ohia ho, na aba aammbɔ hɔn.
Hɔn a wɔwɔ me nkyɛn nyina kyiakyia wo. Kyiakyia hɔn a wɔdɔ hɛn wɔ gyedzi mu. Adom nkã hom nyina.

1: Darius afe a otsīa ebien no mu bosoom a otsia awɔtwe no, Ewuradze n'asɛm baa Iddo ba Berechiah ne ba Zechariah, nkɔnhyɛnyi no hɔ, dɛ,
Ewuradze no bo efuw hom egyanom dodow.
Dɛm ntsi se hɔn dɛ, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Hom nsan mbra me nkyɛn, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, na mebɛsan maba hom nkyɛn, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.

Mma hom nnyɛ dɛ hom egyanom a nkɔnhyɛfo a wodzii kan no tsēatseaa mu kyerɛɛ hɔn, dɛ, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi, afei hom nsan mfi hom akwan bɔn, na hom ndzeyɛɛ bɔn no ho: Na wɔanntse, eso wɔannyɛ aso amma me, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Hom egyanom no, wɔwɔ hen? Na nkɔnhyɛfo no, aso wɔtse ase dabaa?

Na me nsɛm nye m'ahyɛdze a medze mebyɛɛ mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no, aso wɔannto hom egyanom? Na wɔsanee see dɛ, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze dween dɛ ɔdze bɛyɛ hɛn, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn akwan, na hɛn ndzeyɛɛ tse no, dɛmara na ɔnye hɛn edzi.
Bosoom a otsia dubiako no a ɔyɛ Shebat bosoom no ne da a otsia eduonu anan no, Darius afe a ostsia ebien no mu, nna Ewuradze n'asɛm baa Iddo ba Berechiah, ne ba Zechariah, nkɔnhyɛnyi no hɔ, dɛ,
muhun anago, na hwɛ, nyimpa a ɔtse ɔpɔnkɔ memen do, na ogyina myrtlendua a ɔwɔ ɔbɔn mu no ntamu; na mpɔnkɔ amemen, ntokowa ntokowa na efufuw dzi n'ekyir.
Nna me see dɛ, ao mo wura, na iyinom ebɛnadze a? Na ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no see me dɛ, mebɛkyerɛ wo iyinom hɔn adzeban.
Na nyimpa a ogyina myrtlendua ntamu no buae see dɛ, woyinom nye hɔn a Ewuradze asoma dɛ wɔnnantsew ndzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do no.
Na wobuaa Ewuradze no bɔfoe a ogyina myrtlendua ntamu no see dɛ, yɛanantsew edzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do, na, hwɛ, asaase nyina tse hɔ komm, dwudwoodwo.
Nna Ewuradze no bɔfoe no buae see dɛ, ao dɔm Ewuradze, onkodu dabɛn na wo yamu rennhyehye wo wɔ Jerusalem na Judah nkurow a w'ebufuhyew asoɛr hɔn do mfe eduosuon yi ho?
Na Ewuradze buaa ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no nsɛm pa a ɔyɛ awerɛkyekyer nsɛm.
Nna ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no see me dɛ, tsēa mu kã dɛ, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Nyinkuntwe kɛse na medze motwe Jerusalem ho na Zion ho nyinkun.
Na mo bo efuw amanaman a hɔn ho adwe hɔn no dodow: Na mo bo fuuw kakraabi, na hɔnara wɔboae ma ahohia no yɛɛ kɛse.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi: Medze mbɔbɔrhu na masan maba Jerusalem nkyɛn; wobesi me dan wɔ mu, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, na wɔbɔtwe susuhoma mu wɔ Jerusalem.
Tsētsea mu bi so bio, dɛ, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Mo nkurow no prɔmprɔmyɛ bobu do; na Ewuradze bɛda ho akyekye Zion no werɛ, na ɔada ho ara asan mu eyi Jerusalem.
Na memaa m'enyi do na mohwɛe, na hwɛ, mmbɛn anan nye yi.
Na mesee ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no dɛ, iyinom nye mmbɛn a abɔ Judah, Isreal, na Jerusalem apetse no.
Na Ewuradze kyerɛɛ me atomfo baanan.

Nna mesee dɛ, ebɛnadze na iyinom bae bɛyɛɛ? Na ɔkasae see dɛ, iyinom nye mmbɛn a wɔbɔɔ Judah petsee, ma nyimpa bi amma ne tsir do no: Na iyinom aba rebɛpra hɔn ho, na woetutu amanaman a wɔmaa hɔn mmbɛn do tsiaa Judah asaase dze bɔɔ hɔn petsee no hɔn mmbɛn.
2: Na memaa m'enyi do mohwɛe, na hwɛ, nyimpa a susuhoma kitsa ne nsamu a.
Nna mesee dɛ, Erokɔ hen? Na ɔsee me dɛ, murukosusu Jerusalem mahwɛ ne tɛtɛr, na ne tsentsen.
Na, hwɛ, ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no fiir edzi, na ɔbɔfo fofor fir edzi kehyiaa no,
na ɔsee no dɛ, Tutu mbirika, kɛkã kyerɛ aberantsɛ yi, dɛ, Jerusalem wɔbɛtsena mu dɛ nkuroba a wonnyi afasu, ɔnam nyimpa na anyɛmbowa dodow a wɔwɔ mu ntsi.
Na emi, Ewuradze na ɔse, mebɛyɛ gya fasu mabɔ no ho aprɔw, na mayɛ enyimnayam wɔ ne finimfin.
Ao o, ao o, guan fi kwaamu afamu asaase no do, Ewuradze na ɔse: Na matserɛw hom mu dɛ sor mframa anan no, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Ao o, Zion, guan, ɔwo a enye Babylon babaa tse.
Na mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Enyimnyam ekyir na ɔasoma me amanaman a wɔfaa hom afo no nkytɛn: Na nyia ɔka hom no, ɔka n'enyi kyiresua.
Na, hwɛ, mobɔwosow me nsa egu hɔn do, na wɔayɛ afodze ama hɔn a wɔsoom hɔn no: Na hom bohu dɛ dɔm Ewuradze na ɔasoma me.
Ao Zion babaa, tow ndwon na dzi ehurusi: Na, hwɛ, mereba, na mabɛtsena wo finimfin, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na amananman pii dze hɔnho bɔbɔ Ewuradze ho wɔ da no mu, na wɔayɛ me man: Na mebɛtsena wo mu, na ehu dɛ dɔm Ewuradze na ɔasoma me wo nkyɛn.
Na Ewuradze bɛfa Judah edzi do dɛ ne kyɛfa wɔ asaase krɔnkrɔn no do, na ɔada ho asan mu eyi Jerusalem.
Adasa nyina, hom ntaa dzinn wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Na oenyan efi ne tsenabea krɔnkrɔn no do.
3: Na ɔkyerɛɛ me Joshua, ɔsɔfopanyin no, dɛ ogyina Ewuradze no bɔfoe no enyi, na Satan gyi n'abanyimfa rotõatoa no.
Ewuradze see Satan dɛ, Satan e, Ewuradze ntwuw w'enyim; ɛhɛɛ, Ewuradze a ɔasan mu eyi Jerusalem no ontwuw w'enyim: Aso iyi nnyɛ gyantsia a woehwim efi gya mu?
Nna Joshua hyɛ ntar fī, na ogyinaa ɔbɔfo no enyim.
Na obuae kãa kyerɛɛ hɔn a wogyinagyina n'enyim no, dɛ, hom nyi ntar fi no mfi no ho. Na ɔsee no dɛ, hwɛ mama w'emumuyɛ efi wo ho kɔ, na mebɛhyɛ wo ebirɛmpɔn ntar.
Na mesee dɛ, ma wɔmfa asɔfokyɛw a ɔyɛ fɛw nsoa ne tsir. Nna wɔdze asɔfokyɛw a ɔyɛ fɛw soaa ne tsir, na wɔhyɛɛ no ntar; nna Ewuradze bɔfoe no gyina hɔ.
Na Ewuradze dze bɔfoe no dzii Joshua dase dɛ,
mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Sɛ ebɛnantsew m'akwan do, na esie m'ahyɛdze a, ɔno na wo so bohu me fie atsɛn, na aweɔn m'abangua so, na mama enya hɔn a wogyina ha ntamu beebi egyina.
Ao ɔsɔfopanyin Joshua, ɔwo na wo mfɛfo a wɔtsetse w'enyim, afie hom ntsie; na wɔyɛ nyimpa a wɔyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze: Na, hwɛ, medze m'akowaa, mfefɛwee no, bopue aba.
Na hwɛ, abo a medze mato Joshua enyim; enyiwa esuon wɔ ɔbo kor do: Hwɛ, mubokrukye no nkrukyie no, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, na mibeyi asaase no n'emumuyɛ da kor.
Da no mu, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, hom mu nyimpa biara bɛfrɛfrɛ ne nyɛnko aba wenyindua ase na adɔmbadua ase.
4: Na ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no baa bio, na obenyaan me dɛ nyimpa a woenyan no efi ne nda mu.

Na ɔsee me dɛ, ihu ebɛn? Na mesee dɛ, mahwɛ, na hwɛ kandzeadua a ne nyina yɛ sika, na no ngotoa taa n'etsifi, na ne nkandzea esuon no wowɔ do; ndodobɛn esuon wɔ nkandzea a wɔwɔ n'etsifi no do nkorkor:
Na ngondua ebien sisi ne nkyɛnmu, kor si ngotoa no n'enyimfa, na kor so si n'abankum.
Na mubuae kasaa kyerɛɛ ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no, dɛ, mo wura, iyinom ebɛnadze a?
Nna ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no buae see me dɛ, aso innyim iyinom n'adzeban? Na mesee dɛ, mo wura, oho.
Nna obuae see dɛ, iyi nye Ewuradze n'asɛm a ɔbaa Zerubbabel hɔ, dɛ ɔnnam ahoɔdzen do, ɔnnam tum do, na ɔnam mo susum do, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Ao bepɔw kɛse, woana nye wo? Ebɛdan asaase tɛtɛr wɔ Zerubbabel enyim: Na ɔdze etsifi bo no bopue aba abɔbɔ do ose dɛ, adom, adom mbra do.
Na Ewuradze n'asɛm baa me nkyɛn bio dɛ
Zerubbabel ne nsa na ɔatow ofi yi fapem; na ne nsa na obowie so; na ɔwo ehu dɛ dɔm Ewuradze na ɔasoma me wo nkyɛn.
Na woana na oebu ndzɛmba nketseaba ne da tootooba? Na wobedzi ehurusi, na owehu promo no wɔ Zerubbabel nsamu, iyinom esuon yi a wɔyɛ Ewuradze n'enyiwa; wokyin dzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do.
Nna mubuae, na mesee no dɛ, ebɛn nye ngondua ebien yi a wosisi kandzeadua no no n'enyimfa na n'abankum yi?
Na mubuaa ne mpɛn ebien na mesee dɛ, ebɛn ngondua abaw ebien nye iyinom yi a wɔwɔ sika ano ebien a ohue sika ngo no ma ofi hɔn mu yi?
Na obuaa me see dɛ, aso innyim iyinom hɔn adzeban? Na mesee dɛ, mo wura, oho.
Na ɔsee dɛ, iyinom nye ngo mba beenu a wogyinagyina asaase nyina Ewuradze nkyɛn no.
5: Nna memaa m'enyi do bio, na muhunii, na hwɛ, nwoma mbobɔwee a ɔnenam wimu a.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, ihu ebɛn? Na mubuaa dɛ, muhu nwoma mbobɔwee a ɔnenam wimu; ne tsentsen yɛ basafa du.
Nna ɔsee me dɛ, iyi nye ndom a ofir edzi kɔ asaase nyina enyi no: Na obiara a owia adze no wɔbɔpo no wɔ afã kor dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse; na obiara so dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse.
Mebɛma oefir edzi, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, na ɔakɛ hɛn owifo no fie, na nyia ɔdze me dzin kã ntanhun no fie: Na ɔbɛtsena ne fi mu, na ɔahyew ɔno nye no ndua na n'abo.
Nna ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no fir edzi, na ɔsee me dɛ, afei ma w'enyi do, na hwɛ adzekor a orifir edzi yi.
Na mesee dɛ, Ebɛnadze a? Na ɔsee me dɛ, iyi nye ephah esusudze a orifir edzi no, ɔkãa bio so dɛ, iyi nye hɔn hwɛbea wɔ asaase nyina do:
(Na hwɛ, wɔmaa sumbui talent kor do:) Na iyi nye ɔbaaa a ɔtse ephah esusudze no mu:
Na ɔsee dɛ, emumuyɛ nye yi; na ɔtoow no kyeen ephah esusudze no mu: Na ɔtoow sumbui durdur no hin ano.
Nna memaa m'enyi do, na muhunii, na hwɛ, mbaa beenu fir edzi, na mframa wɔ hɔn ntsaban mu; na hɔn ntsaban tse dɛ ɔkompɛtɛ ne ntsaban: Na wɔmaa ephah esusudze no do wɔ asaase na sor ntamu.
Nna mesee ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no dɛ, iyinom so ephah esusudze no dze rokɔ hen?
Na ɔsee me dɛ, wɔdze rokɔ ekesi dan ama no wɔ Shinar asaase do: Na sɛ wowie siesie a, wɔdze no besi ne bea no do wɔ hɔ.
6: Na memaa m'enyi do bio, na muhunii, na hwɛ, ntseaseanam anan a wofi mbepɔw ebien ntamu reba; na mbepɔw no yɛ boran mbepɔw.
Tseaseanam a odzi kan no, mpɔnkɔ memen wɔ mu; na tsetseanam a otsia ebien no, mpɔnkɔ tuntum wɔ mu;
na tseseanam a otsia ebiasa no, mpɔnkɔ fitaa wɔ mu; na tseaseanam a otsia anan no, mpɔnkɔ wonawona ahoɔdzefo wɔ mu.
Nna mubuae mesee ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no dɛ, mo wura, iyinom ebɛnadze a?
Na ɔbɔfo no buae see me dɛ, iyinom nye sor mframa anan a wofir edzi fi asaase nyina Ewuradze n'enyim no.
Tseaseanam a mpɔnkɔtuntum wɔ mu no fir edzi kɔr kwaamu afamu asaase do, na efufuw no fir edzi kɔr pomu afamu asaase do.
Na ahoɔdzenfo no fir edzi, na wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ wokekyin dzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do: Na ɔsee dɛ, hom mfi ha nkɔ nkekyin ndzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do. Nna wokekyinii dzii akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do.
Nna ɔbɔɔ mu kasaa kyerɛɛ me, dɛ, hwɛ, hɔn a wɔkɔ kwaamu afamu asaase do no wɔama mo sunsum abɔm wɔ kwaamu afamu asaase do.
Na Ewuradze n'asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
fa ndɔmmumfo no bi, Heldai, na Tobijah, na Jedaiah; na ɔwodze, da no ara kɔ kɛhɛn Zephaniah ba Josiah fie, mbrɛ woefi Babylon aba no;
ɛhɛɛ, gye hɔn hɔ dwetɛ na sika, na fa yɛ abɔtsir, na fa bɔ ɔsɔfopanyin Joshua, Jehozadah ba no ne tsir;
na kasa kyerɛ no, dɛ, mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze kasa se nye yi, dɛ, hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi a ne dzin dze mfefɛwee no; na ɔbɛfefɛw wɔ n'ananmu, na oesi Ewuradze n'asɔrdan no:
Ɔno na obesi Ewuradze n'asɔrdan no; na ɔbɔsoa enyimnyam no, na ɔatsena n'ahengua do edzi hen; na ɔbɛyɛ ɔsɔfo wɔ n'ahengua do: Na asomdwee ahyɛmu no bɛtsena hɔn beenu ntamu.
Na abɔtsir no bɛyɛ nkaadze ama Helem, na Tobijah, na Jedaiah, na Zephaniah ba Hen, wɔ Ewuradze asɔrdan no mu.
Na hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyirkyir no bɛba ebesi Ewuradze asɔrdan no bi, na hom ehu dɛ dɔm Ewuradze na ɔasoma me hom hɔ. Na sɛ hom Nyankopɔn ne ndze a, iyi bɛba mu.
7: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔhen Darius afe a otsia anan mu no, Ewuradze n'asɛm baa Zechariah hɔ wɔ bosoom a otsia akron a ɔno nye bosoom a otsia akron a ɔno nye chislev no, ne da a otsia anan mu no.
Nna bethelfo asoma Sharezer na Regem-melech, na hɔn nyimpa ada dɛ wɔmbɔkotow nserɛ Ewuradze n'enyimpa,
na fie asɔfo no na nkɔnhyɛfo no, dɛ, aso munsū wɔ bosoom a otsia enum no mu, na me ntse moho, dɛ mbrɛ mayɛ no wɔ mfe pii mu yi?
Nna dɔm Ewuradze n'asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
kã kyerɛ asaase no do man nyina, na asɔfo no dɛ, ana hom dzii mbuada na na awerɛhow wɔ, mfe eduosuon yi no, hom dzii mbuada yi maa emi mara?
Na sɛ hom dzidzi, na hom nom a, hom nndzi mma homankasa homho, na hom nnom mma homankasa homho?
Aso ɔnnsɛ dɛ hom tsie nsɛm a Ewuradze nam nkɔnhyɛfo a wodzii kan no do tsēaa mu wɔ ber a Jerusalem wɔtse mu no, na ɔyɛɛ prɔmprɔm,na no nkurow etwa no ho ehyia, na wɔtse pomu afamu na ɔbɔn mu no?
Na Ewuradze n'asɛm baa Zechariah hɔ dɛ,
mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze akã nye yi, dɛ, hom mbu nokwatsɛn, na nyimpa biara nkyerɛ mbɔbɔrhu na ayamuhyehye wɔ no nua do:
Na mma hom nntseetsee okunafo na egyankaba, ɔnana na ɔbɔbɔfo; na mma hom mu biara mmfa no nua ho adwembɔn.
Na wɔammpen dɛ wobetsie, na wɔkõakoaa hɔn mbatsir, na wosisiiw hɔn aso, amma wɔaanntse.
Nyew, wɔyɛɛ hɔn akoma dɛ dɛnkyɛmbo, amma wɔaanntse mbra no, na nsɛm a dɔm Ewuradze hɔ bae no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ ɔno ɔtsēaa mu, na woenntsie no, dɛmara na hɔn so wɔbɛtsēa mu na mirinntsie, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse;
na medze ekyinehyia-mframa bɔbɔ hɔn apetse amanaman nyina a wonnyim hɔn no mu. Dɛm na asaase no bɛyɛɛ amamfo wɔ hɔn ekyir, dɛ obiara ammfa do annsan: Osiandɛ wɔmaa asaase fɛɛfɛɛ no yɛɛ afõ.
8: Na dɔm Ewuradze n'asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Motwe Zion ho nyinkun kɛse, na enyiber kɛse na medze twe no ho nyinkun.
Mbrɛ Ewutradze se nye yi: Masan maba Zion nkyɛn, na mebɛtsena Jerusalem Nokwar kurow no; na dɔm Ewuradze ne bepɔw no, bepɔw krɔnkrɔn.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Nkɔdaa na mberwa bɛba ho atsenatsetsena Jerusalem abrɔn mu, nyimpa biara no poma kitsa ne nsamu wɔ onyin dodow ntsi.
Na mbanyimbasiaba na nkataasia bɛhyɛ kurow no n'abrɔn no amaama, woedzi agor wɔ abrɔn no mu.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Sɛ ɔyɛ ɔman yi nkaa no nwanwa wɔ nda no mu a, aso ɔbɛyɛ nwanwa wɔ emi so m'enyi do? Dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Hwɛ, mebɛgye me man nkwa mefi boka asaase no do, na anee asaase no do:
Na medze hɔn mada, na wɔabɛtsena Jerusalem mu; na wɔbɛyɛ me man, na emi so mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn, wɔ nokwar na tsenenee mu.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Hom nhyehyɛ hom nsamu dzen, hom a hom tse nsɛm yi wɔ nkɔnhyɛfo anomu wɔ nda yi mu, hɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ da no a wɔtoow dɔm Ewuradze ne fi fapem no, dɛ worisi asɔrdan no.
Na anasaana da no reba no, na apaabɔ nnyi hɔ mma abowa; eso asomdwee biara nnyi hɔ mma nyia opue anaa nyia ɔba mu wɔ ɔhohiahiafo no ntsi: Na memaa nyimpa nyina obiara nye ne nyɛnko dzii esi.
Na afei dze mennkɛyɛ dɛ nkan no ama ɔman yi nkaa no, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na asomdwee aba bɛba hɔ; weyindua bɔsom n'aba, na asaase ama no ndɔbaa,na sorsor bɔtɔ no bɔsu; na mebɛma ɔman yi nkaa no enya ndzemba yinom nyina edzi.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛɛ ndom wɔ amanaman mu no, ao Judah fifo na Isreal fifo, dɛmara na mebɛgye hom nsamu dzen.
Na mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Dɛ mbrɛ modween dɛ medɛyɛ hom bɔn, ber a hom egyanom yii me ebufuw, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, na mennu moho no;
dɛm ara so bio na madwen nda yi mu dɛ mebɛyɛ Jerusalem na Judah fi yie: Mma hom nyɛ;mma hom nnsuro.
Iyinom nye ndzɛmba a hom nyɛ; hom mu nyimpa biara nkasa nokwar nkyerɛ ne nyɛnko; hom mbua nokwar na asomdwee atsɛn wɔ hom mbobokɛse mu:
Na mma hom mu obiara nndwen n'akoma mu bɔn wɔ ne nyɛnko ho; na mma hom mmpɛ ator ntanka: Na mma hom mmpɛ ator ntanka: Na iyinom nyina yɛ ndzɛmba a mikyir, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na dɔm Ewuradze n'asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,

mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Bosoom a otsia anan no mu mbuadadzi, na bosoom a otsia esuon no mu mbuadadzi, na bosoom a otsia esuon no mu mbuadadzi, na bosoom a otsia du no mu mbuadadzi, ɔbɛyɛ enyigye na ahosɛpɛw, na ahotɔ afahyɛ ama Judah fi; dɛm ntsi hom ndɔ nokwar na asomdwee.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nye yi: Ɔbaa no dɛmara, dɛ aman, na nkurow pii mu atsefo bɛba:
Na kurow kor mu atsefo bɔkɔ kor so mu akɛse dɛ, hom mma yɛnkɔ ntsɛmara nkɔtotɔ nserɛ Ewuradze n'enyimpa, na yɛnhwehwɛ dɔm Ewuradze n'ekyir kwan: Mo so mobɔkɔ.
Nyew, aman pii na amanaman a wɔyɛ dzen bɛba abɔhwehwɛ dɔm Ewuradze n'ekyir kwan wɔ Jerusalem, na wɔatotɔ aserɛ Ewuradze n'enyimpa.
Mbrɛ dɔm Ewuradze se nyi yi: Nda no mu na ɔbɛba dɛ mbarimba du a wofi amanaman kasaa nyina mu bosusuo Jewnyi baako n'atar ano, dɛ yɛnye hom bɔkɔ, osiandɛ yɛatse dɛ Nyankopɔn nye hom wɔ hɔ.
9: Ewuradze n'asɛm atsɛmbudze wɔ Hadrach asaase do, na Damascus bɛyɛ n'asoɛe: Na ɔdasanyi na Isreal mbusuakuw nyina enyiwa wɔ Ewuradze do:
Na Hamath so a ɔtoa do; Tyre na Zion, osiandɛ onyim nyansa papa.
Na Tyer sii akoban maa noho, na otsiaa dwetɛ dɛ huntuma, na sika mapa dɛ abrɔn mu dɛtse.
Hwɛ, Ewuradze bɛma efi ne nsa, na ɔabɔ no tum a ɔwɔ po mu no; na ogya ahyew nankasa.
Ashkelon bohu, na oesuro; Gaza so, na ayɛ no yayaayaw; na Ekron, na ɔahyɛ n'enyisun enyito: Na ɔhen bɛhera efi Gaza, na Ashkelon so wɔrenntsena mu bio.
Na amamanforafo bɛtsena Ashdod, na metwa Philistiafo ahopɔw do.
Na mibeyi no bɔgyaa mefi n'anomu, na n'ekyirwadze no mefi ne sē mu; na no so bɛyɛ nkaa ama hɛn Nyankopɔn: Na ɔayɛ dɛ safohen bi wɔ Judah, na Ekron ayɛ dɛ Jebusnyi.
Na mobɔbɔ nsera mehyia me fi ho wɔ dɔm no enyim, na obi enntwa mu annkɔ, annsan ammba: Na ahohiahiafo biara enntwa mu ammafa hɔn mu bio: Na afei na medze m'enyi mehu.
Dzi ehurusi kɛse,ao Zion babaa; bɔ ose,ao Jerusalem babaa: Hwɛ, wo hen reba wo nkyɛn: Ɔtsen, na ɔwɔ nkwagye; ɔdwe na ɔtse asoaso do, asoaso a ɔyɛ asoasober ne ba do.

Na mubotwa ntseaseanam mefi Ephraim, na pɔnkɔ mefi Jerusalem, na woetwa akodzi egyen so; na ɔbɛkasa asomdwee akyerɛ amanaman: Na n'ahendzi befi po ho ekesi po ho, na oefi Esutsen no ho ekesi asaase ano noho.
Na ɔwo so, w'ahyɛmudzi bɔgyaa no ntsi meyi w'adaduafo mefi mona a nsu nnyi mu no mu.
Hom nsan mbra akoban no mu, hom enydado adaduafo: Ndɛ mpo mekã kyerɛ dɛ mubobu no mbɔho mama wo.
Na makom Judah mama moho, medze Ephraim ahyɛ egyen no mu; na mibekenyan wo mbabanyin, ao Zion, medze etsia wo mbabanyin, ao Zion medze etsia wo mbabanyin, ao Greece, na mebɛyɛ wo dɛ ɔkatakyi afõwa.
Na wobohu Ewuradze wɔ hɔn do, na n'egyen-menaba befir edzi dɛ enyinam: Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn bɛhɛn akasamu no, na ɔdze pomu afamu ekyirnehyia-mframa efir edzi.
Dɔm Ewuradze botwitwa agye hɔn; na wɔamemen, na woetsiatsia tseabo do; na wɔanom, na wɔayɛ weɔɔweɔɔ dɛ nsã ntsi: Na wɔbɛhyɛ hɔn amaama dɛ ndweraa, dɛ afɔrmbukyia no adɔdow.
Na da no Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn no bɛgye hɔn nkwa dɛ ne man nguankuw: Na wɔbɛyɛ abɔtsir ho abo a wɔama do wɔ asaase no do.
Na mbrɛ ne yie dua sõ a, na n'ahoɔfɛw dua sõ a! Edziban bɛma mberantse no ayɛ prɔmprɔm, na nsã so ama mbabaawa no ayɛ dɛmara.
10: Hom mbisa Ewuradze, Ewuradze a ɔma asenaman paapaa no hɔ nsu wɔ ɔbɛsɛber; na ɔbɛma nsu atɔ berdzedzeedze ama hɔn, na hɔn nyina enyinya sar mu mfunoma.
Na terphim no akã nsɛngyan, na nkɔnhyɛfo no ehu atofosɛm; na adaasofo kã akɔhwisɛm. wɔkyekye werɛ kwa: Dɛm ntsi wɔfa hɔn kwan dɛ nguan, hɔn ho hiahia hɔn,osiandɛ guanhwɛfo bi nnyi hɔ.
Mo bo efuw nguanhwɛfo no, na mobɔhwe mpɔnkyenyin no: Na dɔm Ewuradze abɛsera no nguankuw Judah fi no, na ɔdze hɔn bɛyɛ n'enyimnyam pɔnkɔ wɔ ɔsa mu.
No mu na kutuwdo-bo, no mu na prɛgow, no mu na akodzi egyen no mu fi aba.
Na wɔbɛyɛ dɛ mbarimba akatakyi a wotsiatsia abrɔn mu dɛtse do wɔ ɔkõ no mu; na wɔbɔkõ osiandɛ Ewuradze nye hɔn wɔ hɔ; na pɔnkɔdoatsefo enyim bogu ase.
Na mebɛhyɛ Judah fi dzen, na magye Joseph fi nkwa, na medze hɔn masan aba, na muhu hɔn mbɔbɔr nambɛyɛ dɛ gyama manntow hɔn akyen na emi nye Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn, na mibetsie hɔn.
Na Ephraim bɛyɛ dɛ ɔkatakyi, na hɔn akoma edzi ehurusi dɛ gyama nsã ntsi a: Ɛhɛɛ, hɔn mba bohu, na woedzi ehurun; hɔn akoma enyi bɛgye Ewuradze mu.
Mobɔbɔ seesee mafrɛ hɔn, na maboa hɔn ano; osiandɛ mapon hɔn: Ma wɔbɔdɔr dɛ mbrɛ wɔadɔr yi.
Na mubodua hɔn amanaman mu; na wɔbɛkaa me wɔ ekyirkyir nkurow mu: Na wɔnye hɔn mba bɛtsena ase, na wɔasan aba.
Medze hɔn mibefi Egypt asaase so do aba bio, na maboa hɔn ano mefi Assyria; na medze hɔn mebɛba Gilead na Lebanon asaase do; na worinnya kwan ama hɔn mpo.
Na obodua ahohia po no mu, na ɔabobo po asorɛkye no, na Nile mu ebun nyina awewew: Na Assyria no nkontompɔ no abrɛ adze, na Egypt ahempoma no efi hɔ akɔ.
Na mebɛhyɛ hɔn dzen wɔ Ewuradze mu; na wɔbɛnantsew afow esian wɔ Ewuradze dzin mu, Ewuradze na ɔse.
11: Ao Lebanon, buebue wo mbobow, ma gya nhyew wo cedar.
Ao kupresidua, twa ewuo, na cedar ahwe ase, osiandɛ enyimnyamfo no asɛɛ: Ao hom Bashan nsudur, hom ntwa ewuo, na kwaa dzendzen no aba famu.
Nguanhwɛfo ewuotwa ne gyegye nye no! na hɔn enyimyam asɛɛ: Ngyatafɔr pɔw ne gyegye nye no osiandɛ Jordan ahyehyɛ asɛɛ.
Mbrɛ Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Hom nnyɛn okum nguankum no a
hɔn a wɔtɔ hɔn no woku hɔn, na wonndzi sõ; na hɔn a wɔtɔn hɔn no kã dɛ, nhyira nkã Ewuradze, na menya moho: Na hɔnankasa hɔn ahwɛfo no nnhu hɔn mbɔbɔr.
Na merennda ho nnya asaase no do atsefo no ho tsimbɔbɔr bio, Ewuradze na ɔse: Na hwɛ, mibeyi obiara mahyɛ ne nyɛnko nsa na ne hen nsa na wɔbɔbobɔ asaase no, mirinnyi hɔn mmfi hɔn nsɛmu.
Nna menyɛɛn okum nguankuw no, nguankuw no mu dza wɔyɛ mbɔbɔr no. Na mefaa mpoma ebien; mefrɛɛ kor ahoɔfɛw, na mefrɛɛ kor so Nkyehoma; na menyɛɛn nguankuw no.
Na mutwaa nguanhwɛfo baasaa no kyenee wɔ bosoom kor mu; na hɔn ho foon me kra, na mo so ho foon hɔn kra.
Nna mesee dɛ, merennyɛn hom: Dza oruwu no, ma onwu; na dza wotwa no kyen no, wontwa no nkyen; na hɔn a aka no, obiara ndzi ne nyɛnko nam.
Na mefaa mo poma ahoɔfɛw, na mutwaa mu, dɛ morotõ m'ahyɛmu a menye aman nyina edzi no.
Na wɔtõo no da no ara: Nna ma tserɛ nguankuw no mu abɔbɔfo a wɔhwɛɛ me no wohun dɛ Ewuradze asɛm ampa.
Na mesee hɔn dɛ, sɛ oye wɔ hom adwen mu a, hom mma me m'apaadze; na sɛ ɔnntse dɛm a, hom mma ɔnka. Nna wokeer m'apaadze ndwetɛbona eduasa.
Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, tow gu adzekorabea, enyimnyam bo a woetwa no me tsir no. Na mefaa ndwetɛbona eduasa no, na motowee muguu adzekorabea, wɔ Ewuradze fie.
Na mutwaa mo poma kor no, nkyehoma no mu, ama maasɛɛ Judah na Isreal ntamu enuayɛ no.
Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, nkyii so bio fa guanhwɛfo kwasea no n'edwindadze no.

Na, hwɛ, mebɛma guanhwɛfo bi do wɔ asaase do a ɔrennsera hɔn a woetwa hɔn akyen no, eso ɔronnhwehwɛ hɔn a wɔapetse no, na ɔrennsa dza ebubu no yarba; eso ɔrennsa dza ɔtse apɔw no, na mbom obedzi dza atɔ angoa ne nam, na ɔapaapaa no ntɔtse mu esinesin.
Oguanhwɛfo gyangyan a ɔdan nguan no gya no, ondua! Afõwa bɛba n'abasa do, na n'enyiwa nyimfa do: Ne basa bɛkyenkyen, na n'enyiwa nyimpa efura kusuww.
12: Ewuradze n'asɛm ho atsɛmbusɛm a ɔwɔ Isreal ho. Mbrɛ Ewuradze a ɔtserɛw sorsor mu, na ɔto asaase fapew, na ɔbɔ nyimpa no sunsum wɔ no mu no, se nye yi:
Hwɛ, mebɛyɛ Jerusalem ntentan kuraba mama aman a etwa ehyia ho nyina, na Jerusalem dze no ntuae no aba abɔwe Judah so do.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ mebɛyɛ Jerusalem ɔbo durdur mama aman nyina; hɔn a wɔdze bɔsoa hɔnho nyina bepirapira; na asaase do amanaman nyina bɔboa hɔn ano aba no do.
Da no mu no, Ewuradze na ɔse, medze ahobow mobɔbɔ mpɔnkɔ nyina, na medze abɔdam mabɔ hɔn do atsefo: Na mubobue m'enyi wɔ Judah fi do, na medze enyifura abɔ aman no mpɔnkɔ nyina.
Na Judah ebusuampanyin bɛse wɔ hɔn akoma mu dɛ, Jerusalem atsefo nye m'ahoɔdzen wɔ dɔm Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn no mu.

Da no mu na mebɛyɛ Judah ebusuampanyin dɛ gyasɛn wɔ nyena mu na gyaatsɛn wɔ efiefi mu; na wɔahyew aman a etwa ho ehyia no wɔ bankum na nyimfa: Na Jerusalem bɛba ho atsena ne tsenabea bio, wɔ Jerusalem ara.
Ewuradze so bedzi kan agye Judah asese nkwa, amma David fie enyimnyam na aammemaa hɔnho do ammbɔ Judah do.
Da no mu no Ewuradze botwitwa agye Jerusalem atsefo; na nyia ɔyɛ mberɛw wɔ hɔn mu wɔ da no mu no ayɛ dɛ David; na David fie bɛyɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn, dɛ Ewuradze bɔfoe a odzi hɔn enyim.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ mobɔhwehwɛ amanaman a wɔbaa Jerusalem do nyina masɛɛ hɔn.
Na mubohue adom na ntotɔserɛ sunsum megu David fi na Jerusalem atsefo do; na wɔbɔhwɛ ɔno a wɔwɔɔ no peaa no: Na woesū no, dɛ mbrɛ obi sū ne ba kor, na woegyam no, dɛ mbrɛ obi gyam n'abakan.
Da no mu no, ewuotwa kɛse bɛba Jerusalem, dɛ Hadadrimmon ewotwa wɔ Megiddon bɔnsa mu.
Na asaase no botwa ewuo, ebusua biara no nko; David fie ebusua nko, na hɔn yernom nko; Nathan fie ebusua nko, na hɔn yernom nko;
Levi fie ebusua nko, na hɔn yernom nko; Shimei ebusua nko, na hɔn yernom nko;
ebusua ebusua a aka no nyina, ebusua biara nko, na hɔn yernom nko.
13: Da no mu no wobobue nsunyiwa ama David fi na Jerusalem atsefo, wɔ bɔn na ahonamfi ntsi.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse, mubotwa abosom no edzi mefi asaase no do, na wɔrennkaa hɔn bio: Na eso mebɛma nkɔnhyɛfo no na sunsum fi no efi asaase no do efir.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ obi da ho hyɛ nkɔm a, nna n'egya na ne nã a wɔwoo no no wɔbɛse no dɛ, erenntsena ase; na ekã atofosɛm wɔ Ewuradze na dzin mu: Na sɛ ɔhyɛ nkɔm a, n'egya na ne nã a wɔwoo no no, wɔbɔwɔ no nkratsee.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ, sɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no biara hyɛ nkɔm a, n'enyi bɔtõ wɔ noara n'enyido-adzehu no mu; eso wɔrennhyɛ nhwi egugudo dze esisi bio:
Na mbom ɔbɛkã dɛ, mennyɛ nkɔnhyɛyi bi, meyɛ okuafo; na mayɛ obi n'akowaa fitsi me mbafobermu.
Na obi bɛse no dɛ, ebɛn nye wo nsa ntamu epirakur yi? Ɔno na obobua dɛ, dza wɔdze piraa me wɔ m'adɔfo fie no a.
Afõwa e, nyan hyɛ mo guanhwɛfo no do ɛ, na ɔbarimba a ɔyɛ mo ho no do ɛ, dɔm Ewuradze na ɔse: Bɔ guanhwɛfo no ma nguan no mpetse; na mebɛdan me nsa metsia nkakraba no.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ asaase nyina do, Ewuradze na ɔse, dɛ, no mu nkyekyɛmu ebien wobotwitwa, na woewuwu; na dza otsia ebiasa no, wobegya no wɔ mu.

Na medze nkyekyɛmu a otsia ebiasa no mubodua gya mu maba, na mahoa hɔn ho dɛ mbrɛ wɔhoa dwetɛ ho, na mahwɛ hɔn hɔn mu dɛ mbrɛ wɔhwɛ sika mu: Wɔbɛfrɛ me dzin, na emi so metsie hɔn: Mebɛse dɛ, me man nye hɔn; na hɔn so wɔase dɛ, Ewuradze nye me Nyankopɔn.
14: Hwɛ, Ewuradze ne da reba a wɔbɛkyɛ w'asadze mu wɔ wo finimfin.

Na mobɔboa amanaman nyina ano aba Jerusalem do nye no abɔkõ; na wɔbɛgye kurow no, na wɔafom efi no, na wɔatoto mbaa no mbɔndar: Na kurow no fã botu akɔ ndɔmmum mu, na ɔman no nkaase no dze worunntwitwa hɔn mmfi kurow no mu.
Nna Ewuradze befir edzi, na ɔnye amanaman no akɔkõ, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkõe wɔ nkõda mu no.

Na da no, n'anan besisi ngo bepɔw no a ɔwɔ Jerusalem tsentsendo wɔ boka afamu no do, na ngo bepɔw no bɛpaa ebien wɔ ne fifimfin fi boka afamu dze ekesi anee afamu, na ɔayɛ bɔnsa kɛsenara; na bepɔw no ne fã so atwe akɔ kwaamu afamu, na ne fã so atwe akɔ pomu afamu.

Na ho, boguanguan afa me mbepɔw no no bɔnsaa no mu; na me bepɔw no no bɔnsaa no bokodu Azel: Ɛhɛɛ, hom boguanguan, dɛ mbrɛ hom guanuanee wɔ asaasewosow enyim wɔ Judahhen Uzziah nda mu no: Na Ewuradze me Nyankopɔn bɛba, na akrɔnkrɔnmfo nyina bɛkã wo ho.
Na da no, ɔbɛba dɛ kan nnkɛba a hyerɛn na sum kã ho:
Na mbom ɔbɛyɛ adzekyee kor a Ewuradze na onyim; ɔnnyɛ adzekyee, ɔnnyɛ adzesaa: Na ɔbɛba dɛ ewimbir no na kan bɛba.
Na da no, ɔbɛba dɛ nkwa nsu befi Jerusalem apem; no mu fã so akɔ boka afamu po no mu, na no mu fã so akɔ anee afamu po no mu: Ɔpɛber na awɔwber mu na ɔbɛba.
Na Ewuradze bedzi hen wɔ asaase no nyina do: Da no mu na Ewuradze bɛyɛ baako, na ne dzin baako.

Asaase no nyina bɛdan dɛ Arabah, efi Geba ekesi Rimmom wɔ Jerusalem pomu afamu; na ɔbɔkrɔn, na ɔatsena ne tsenabea, dze efi Benjamin abobokɛse no ano dze ekesi odzi kan no ho, dze ekesi kutuwdo abobokɛse no ano, na efi Hananel abatsentsen no ho dze ekesi ɔhen ne nsatwer no ho.
Na nyimpa bɛtsena mu, na ndom biara remmba hɔ bio; na mbom Jerusalem bɛtsena dwudwoodwo.

Na iyi bɛyɛ ɔyardɔm a Ewuradze dze bɔbɔ amanaman a woetu Jerusalem do sa no nyina: Ber a wogyinagyina hɔn anan do no, hɔn honam botwintwam, na hɔn enyiwa so etwintwam wɔ hɔn etu mu, na hɔn tɛkyerɛma etwintwam wɔ hɔn anomu.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ weɔɔweɔɔyɛ kɛse fi Ewuradze hɔ bɛba hɔn mu; na hɔn mu obiara bosuo ne nyɛnko ne nsamu, na ne nsa ama do etsia ne nyɛnko nsa.
