Na Judah so nye Jerusalem bɔkõ; na wɔbɔboaboa amanaman a etwa ehyia nyina hɔn ahonya ano, sika, na dwetɛ na ntar pii.
Na ɔpɔnkɔ, asoasopɔnkɔ, efupɔnkɔ, na asoaso, na mbowa a wɔwɔ nsera mu no hɔn yardɔm bɛyɛ dɛ yardɔm yi ara.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, amanaman a wotuu Jerusalem do sa no nyinara mu dza aka no nyinara bɔfow aba, afrenhyia afrenhyia abɔkotow asɔr ɔhen, dɔm Ewuaradze no, na wɔahyɛ atamadan afahyɛ no.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ asaase do mbusua nyinara mu hɔn a wɔnnkɔfow aba Jerusalem abɔkotow asɔr ɔhen, dɔm Ewuradze no, nsu ronntɔ hɔn do.
Na sɛ Egypt ebusua ammfow annkɔ ammba a, ɔronntɔ hɔn do; yardɔm a Ewuradze dze bɔbɔ amanaman a wɔnnkɔfow aba abɛhyɛ ntamadan afahyɛ no ɔbɛba hɔ.
Iyi bɛyɛ Egypt ne ntsēa, na amanaman a wɔnnkɔfow aba abɛhyɛ ntamadan afahyɛ no nyinara hɔn ntsēa.
Da no mu no, wɔbɛkyerɛw no wɔ mpɔnkɔ ndɔndɔmba do dɛ, krɔnkrɔn ma Ewuradze na Ewuradze fie nkutu bɛyɛ dɛ afɔrmbukyia enyim ndweraa.

Ɛhɛɛ, nkutu a wɔwɔ Jerusalem na Judah mu nyina bɛyɛ krɔnkrɔn ama dɔm Ewuradze: Na hɔn a wɔbɔ okum-afɔr nyina bɛba abɛfa mu bi akɔnoa adze wɔ mu: Na da no mu no Canaannyi bi renntsena dɔm Ewuradze fie bio.

1: Ewuradze n'asɛm a ɔbaa Hezekiah ne ba Amariah, ne ba Gedaliah, ne ba Cushi, ne ba Zephaniah hɔ, wɔ Judahhen Josiah, Amon ne ba no, n'aber do.
Mebɛpra adze nyina mefi asaase enyi makɔ koraa, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Mebɛpra nyimpa na mbowa makɔ; mebɛpra sor ntumbowa, na po mu nam, na fintsidua makã emumuyɛfo ho makɔ; na mubotwa nyimpa mefi asaase enyi megu, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Na mebɛtsen me nsa wɔ Judah do, na Jerusalem atsefo nyina do; na mubotwa Baal nkaa mefi bea yi do, na Chemarim no hɔn dzin ɔnye asɔfo no;
na hɔn a wɔkotow sɔr sor dɔm wɔ adan etsifi; na hɔn a wɔkotow sɔr a wɔkekã Ewuradze ntam na wɔkekã Malcam ntam;
na hɔn a wɔasan efi Ewuradze ekyir; na hɔn a wɔnnhwehwɛ Ewuradze, eso wommbisa n’ekyir kwan.
Mua w’ano wɔ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn enyim: Na Ewuradze ne da no abɛn: Na Ewuradze esiesie okumafɔr, ɔatsew hɔn a ɔafrɛ hɔn no ho.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ Ewuradze no kumafɔr da no mu no mebɛtsēa asafohemfo no, na ahenmba no, na hɔn a wɔhyɛ ananaben ntar nyina.
Na da no mu mebɛtsēa hɔn a wohuruw tra abowano, na wɔdze enyimpisɛm na ndaadaa hyɛ hɔn wura ne fi mã no.
Na da no mu no, Ewuradze na ɔse, osū ne dede fi Nam Abotsen no ano aba. Na ewuotwa efi kurofã a otsia ebien no mu, na ɔdwerew kɛse efi akoko no do aba.
Hom ntwa ewuo, hom Maktesh atsefo, na Canaan man nyina ennwie yie: Hɔn a wɔsoaa hɔn dwetɛ no nyina, woetwitwa hɔn egu.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ ber no mu dɛ medze nkandzea mobɔhwehwɛ Jerusalem mu; na mebɛtsea nyimpa a wɔada hɔn nsaa do a wɔkã wɔ hɔn akoma mu dɛ, Ewuradze rennyɛ papa, eso ɔrennyɛ bɔn.
Na hɔn ahonyadze bɛyɛ afofadze, na hɔn efi ayɛ efitu: Ɛhɛɛ, wobesisi adan, na wɔrenntsena mu: Na wɔbɛtsetsew wenyin nture, na wɔronnom mu nsã.
Ewuradze ne da kɛse no abɛn, abɛn, na ɔpɛ ntsɛm dɛ, Ewuradze ne da no ne ndze no a; ɔkatakyi rekeka mu wɔ hɔ yayaayaw.
Da, no yɛ ebufuw da, ɔfona na ahoguan da, ɔsɛɛ na amamfoyɛ da, sum na kusuwwyɛ da, nsuwusiw na sum kebii da,
akasamu na ehubo da a oreba nkuropon a woagye ho ban na aban atsentsen do.
Na medze ahoguan beba nyimpa do, ma woaanantsew dɛ efurafo, osiandɛ woayɛ bɔn etsia Ewuradze: Na wobohue hɔn bogyaa egu dɛ huntuma, na hɔn honam dɛ efikyir.

Eso hon dwetɛ na hɔn sika runntum nngye hɔn wɔ Ewuradze n’ebufuw da no mu; na ne nyinkun gya no bɛma asaase no nyina: Na odwuruw, ehɛɛ, odwuruw a ɔye hu, na ɔdze bodwuruw hɔn a wotse asaase no do nyina.
2: Hom nka homho mboa ano, ɛhɛɛ, hom mboa homho ano, ao ɔman a hom nnyi enyito;
ansaana ɔmom no awo, ansaana da no asen dɛ ntsɛw, ansaana Ewuradze n'ebufuw dzendzen no aba hom do, ansaana Ewuradze n’ebufuw da no aba hom do.
Hom nhwehwɛ Ewuradze, hom asaase do abrɛfo nyina a hom ayɛ n’atsɛmbudze; hom nhwehwɛ tsenenee, hom nhwehwɛ ɔdwe: Bi a wɔdze hom bosuma wɔ Ewuradze n’ebufuw da no mu.
Na wɔbɛdan Gaza egya, na Ashkelon ayɛ ekurofõ: Wobeyi Ashdod edzi ewiaber ketee, na woetutu Ekron ase.
Ndom nkã nsuanofo, Cherethfo man no! Ao Canaan, Philistiafo asaase, Ewuradze n’asɛm tsia hom: Mebɛsɛɛ wo ara ma ɔtsefo biara nnkɛka.
Na nsuano bɛyɛ mbowa dzidzibea a nguanhwɛfo nsuaba na nguankuw nguamban wowɔ mu.
Na nsuano no bɛyɛ Judah fi nkaa no dze; wɔbɛnyɛn hɔn nguankuw no wɔ do: Wobobutubutuw Ashkelon efi mu ewimbir; na Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn bɛsera hɔn, na ɔdze hɔn ndɔmmumkɔ no asan aba.
Matse Moab nsopa, na Ammonmba yeyaw a wɔdze asopa me man, na wɔamema hɔnho do ahyɛ hɔn he do.

Dɛm ntsi metse ase yi, dɔm Ewuradze Israel Nyankopɔn no, na ɔse, ampaara Moab bɛyɛ dɛ Sodom, na Ammonmba ayɛ dɛ Gomorrah nsason sisibea, na nkyen maa, na daa amamfoyɛ: Mo nkorɔfo nkaase bɛfa hɔn afo, na me man nkaa so afa hɔn edzi.
Hɔn nkontompɔ ntsi na wobenya iyi, osiandɛ wɔasopa dɔm Ewuradze ne man na wɔamema hɔnho do etsia hɔn.
Ewuradze no ho bɛyɛ hu ama hɔn: Osiandɛ ɔbɛma asaase do abosom nyina asã; na adasa bɔsom ɔno, obiara fi ne tsenabea, amanaman nsupɔw nyina mpo.
Hom Ethiopiafo so, m’afowa boku hom.
Na ɔbɛtsen ne nsa wɔ kwaamu afamu, na ɔasɛɛ Assyria; na ɔbɛma Nineveh ayɛ amamfo, na ɔawow kɛsɛɛ dɛ sar do.
Na mbowakuw bobutubutuw mu, amanaman mbowadoma nyinara: Opoku na kɔtɔkɔ bɛtsena n’edum etsifi: Hɔn ndze bɔtow ndwom wɔ ntokura mu; ɔmamfoyɛ bɛba hɔn mbobow ano: Na ɔama cedar edwin ho ada hɔ.

Iyi nye kurow a odzii ehurusi a ɔtsenaa dɛ ɔmmfa hwee nnyɛ dze no, na ɔsee wɔ n’akoma mu dɛ, emi mara a, na obi nnyi hɔ kã mo ho: Mbrɛ oesi adan amamfõ, mbowa ebutuwii a! Obiara a ɔnam ho twa mu no, ɔbɛsesar, na oehuhuw ne nsa.
3: Ndom nkã etuatsew kurow a no ho egu fi, nhyɛdo kurow no!
Oenntsie ndze no; ɔanngye ntsēa; ɔammfa no werɛ annhyɛ Ewuradze mu; ɔanntwe ammbɛn ne Nyankopɔn.
N’asafohemfo yɛ ngyata a wɔpɔw wɔ no mu; n’atsɛmbuafo yɛ ewimbir mpataku; wonngya biribi ma ɔnnka anapa.
No nkɔnhyɛfo yɛ etsiharfo, nkontompɔtwafo ara nko: N'asɔfoe ehura krɔnkrɔn-bea no ho, woedzi mbra no ewuramim.
Ewuradze a ɔwɔ no mu no ɔtsen; ɔrennyɛ emumuyɛ; daa anapa ɔdze n'atsɛmbu ba kan mu, onngyaa da; na nyia ɔnntsen dze, onnyim enyito.
Metwitwa amanaman egu, hɔn akoban ayeyɛ afoafo; mama hɔn abrɔn atotɔ pan ma obi nntwa mu wɔ do: Wɔasɛɛ hɔn nkurow, ma nyimpa bi nnyi hɔ, ɔtsefo bi nnyi do.
Mekãa dɛ, ampaara ibosuro me, ebɛgye ntsēa; na worunntwa ne tsenabea nnkyen, dɛ mbrɛ dza mahyɛ wɔ no ho nyina tse; naaso wɔsoɛr ahema na wɔsɛɛ hɔn nyɛe.

Dɛm ntsi hom ntweɔn me, Ewuradze na ɔse, nkodu da a mobɔsoɛr maba afonam do: Na mo sua nye dɛ mibɛhyia amanaman ano, na mehyia ahenman, dɛ mubohue m'ebufuw egu hɔn do, m'ebufuhyew dzendzen nyina; na me nyinkun gya no bɛmen asaase no nyina.
Ɔno na mebɛdan ano krɔnkrɔn makyerɛ aman no, ama hɔn nyinara wɔaabɔ Ewuradze ne dzin, dɛ wɔdze batsir kor asom no.
Ethiopia nsutsen egya na mo ntotɔdzefo, me petsefo babaa no, dze ayɛyɛdze bɛba.
Da no mu na w’enyi ronntõ wɔ wo nyɛe nyina a edze atõ me mbra no ho bio: Na ber no mu no na mibeyi hɔn a wɔdze wo hyehyɛ hɔnho no efi wo mu, na erennda ho apɔw woho wɔ me bepow krɔnkrɔn no do.
Na mibegya amandzehufo na abɔbɔfo wɔ wo mu na wɔdze hɔn werɛ behye Ewuradze ne dzin mu.
Na Israel nkaa nnkɛyɛ emumuyɛ, eso worinndzi atofosɛm; eso worunnhu ndaadaa gyirama wɔ hɔn anomu: Na wɔbɛnyɛn hɔnho na woebutubutuw hɔ, na obi rinnyi hɔn hu.
Ao Zion babaa, tow ndwom; ao Israel, bɔ se; ao Jerusalem babaa, ma w’enyi ngye na fa w’akoma nyina dzi ehurusi.
Ewuradze eyi w’atsɛmbu kɔ, ɔatow w’atamfo akyen: Israelhen, Ewuradze, wɔ wo finimfin: Erennda ho nnsuro mbusu bio.
Da no mu no wɔbɛse Jerusalem dɛ, mma nnsuro: Ao Zion, mma w’abaw mu nntu.
Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn wɔ wo finimfin, ɔkatakyi a ɔbɛgye nkwa no a: Ɔdze enyigye bedzi wo ho ehurusi, ɔbɔhom wo no dɔ no mu, ɔdze ndwom bedzi wo ho ehurusi.
Mobɔboa hɔn a wodzi awerɛhow wɔ ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn no ho no ano, hɔn a wofi wo mu no: Hɔn na wo do adzesoa no yɛɛ ahorohoraa maa hɔn.
Hwɛ, ber no menye hɔn a wohiahia wo ho no nyina bedzi: Na mebɛgye osiifo no nkwa, na matase nyia wɔapam no no; na medze hɔn mebɛyɛ ayeyi na dzin, hɔn a hon enyito aba asaase nyina do no.
Ber no mu na medze hom bɛba, na ber no mu na mobɔboa hom ano: Na mebɛma hom ayɛ dzin na ayɛyi wɔ asaase do aman nyinara mu, ber a medze hom ndɔmmum bɛsan aba bio wɔ hom enyiwa mu no, Ewuradze na ɔse.
